e: [AI] I heard Abu Umamah say: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "What is faith?" He replied, "When your good deeds make you happy and your bad deeds make you remorseful, then you are a believer."
hi: Abu Umamah (RA) ne kaha: aik shakhs ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha, "Eman kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhari neki tumhe khush kare aur tumhari burai tumhe udas kare, to tum momin ho."

e:
[AI] The following is the translation of the given Arabic text into English:

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked, "What is faith (Iman)?" He replied, "One whose good deeds please him and whose evil deeds bother him, and that is a true believer." "All these hadiths are authentic and connected according to the condition of the two Shaykhs."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Eman kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis shakhs ko uski neki khush kare aur uski burai use bura lage, wahi momin hai." (Yeh tamam ahadith sahih aur mutasil hain, Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart ke mutabiq.)

e: [AI] "I heard 'Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'i saying, 'We stayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a place so when I woke up at night, I couldn't see anything taller than the back of my saddle in the camp. It seemed like every person and their camel had stuck to the ground. I got up and started moving through the people until I reached the place where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was supposed to be sleeping, but he wasn't there. I put my hand on the bed and found it cold. I went out among the people saying, 'Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had gone beyond our sight. I left the entire camp and saw a darkness, so I threw a stone and headed towards it. I found Mu'adh ibn Jabal and Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah there, and there was a sound in front of us like the clattering of pebbles or the sound of a thicket when the wind blows through it. Some of us said to others, 'O people, stay here until morning or until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  comes to you.' We stayed for as long as Allah willed, and then he called out, 'Has Mu'adh ibn Jabal, Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah, and 'Awf ibn Malik arrived?' We replied, 'Yes.' So he came to us, and we walked with him without asking him anything or informing him of anything. He sat on his bed and asked, 'Do you know what my Lord has given me as a choice tonight?' We replied, 'Allah and His Messenger know best.' He said, 'Indeed, He has given me the choice between admitting half of my Ummah to Paradise and intercession, so I chose intercession.' We said, 'O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make us among its people.' He said, 'It is for every Muslim.'"
hi: Maine Auf bin Malik al-Ashja'i (RA) ko kehte hue suna: hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik jagah thehre. Raat ko main jaaga to lashkar mein apne kajawe ke pichhle hisse se lambi koi cheez nazar nahi aayi - har insaan aur uska unt zameen se chipke hue the. Main uthkar logon ke darmiyan se guzarne laga yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke sone ki jagah tak pahuncha, magar wahan aap (SAW) nahi the. Maine apna haath bistar par rakha to woh thanda tha. Main logon ke darmiyan se guzarte hue bahar nikla aur kehne laga: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un' (Surah al-Baqarah 156) - Rasulullah (SAW) ko le jaya gaya! Yahan tak ke main puray lashkar se bahar nikal aaya. Maine ek kaali cheez dekhi to uski taraf pathar phenka, phir us kaali cheez ki taraf badha to dekha Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) aur Abu Ubaydah bin al-Jarrah (RA) wahan hain, aur hamare saamne chakki ki awaz ya tez hawa mein kankariyon ki awaz jaisi koi awaz thi. Hum aapas mein kehne lage: 'Ae logo, subah tak yahin theher jao ya Rasulullah (SAW) tumhare paas aa jayen.' Hum jitni der Allah ne chaha thehre rahe, phir aap (SAW) ne pukara: 'Kya wahan Mu'adh bin Jabal, Abu Ubaydah bin al-Jarrah aur Auf bin Malik hain?' Hum ne kaha: 'Ji haan.' Aap (SAW) humari taraf tashreef laaye aur hum aap (SAW) ke sath chalne lage, na hum ne aap (SAW) se kuch poocha na hum ne aap (SAW) ko kuch bataya. Aap (SAW) apne bistar par baith gaye aur farmaya: 'Kya tumhe pata hai aaj raat mere Rab ne mujhe kis cheez ka ikhtiyar diya?' Hum ne arz kiya: 'Allah aur uska Rasool (SAW) behtar jaante hain.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Usne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke ya to meri aadhi ummat ko jannat mein dakhil kar de ya shafa'at ka haq de, to maine shafa'at ko chun liya.' Hum ne arz kiya: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah se dua kijiye ke humein bhi is (shafa'at) ke ahl mein shamil kare.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Yeh har Musalman ke liye hai.'

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad pbuh didn't fight a people until he called them.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne kisi qaum se us waqt tak jang nahi ki jab tak unhe (Islam ki taraf) dawat na di ho.

e: [AI] Rabi'ah ibn 'Ibad al-Du'ali heard Abu Lahab say, "I saw the Messenger of Allah (Peace be upon him) in Mina, in their dwellings, before he migrated to Madinah. He said, 'O people, indeed Allah commands you to worship Him and not associate anything with Him.'" I asked, "Who is this man behind him?" It was said, "Abu Lahab."
hi: Rabi'ah bin 'Ibad al-Du'ali (RA) se riwayat hai, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Mina mein, unke ghar mein, Madinah hijrat karne se pehle, yeh farmate hue dekha: "Aye logo! Allah tumhe hukum deta hai ke uski ibadat karo aur uske sath kisi ko shareek na thehrao." Aap (SAW) ke peechhe aik shakhs kehta tha: "Aye logo, yeh tumhe apne baap-dada ke deen ko chhorne ka hukum deta hai." Maine poocha yeh shakhs kaun hai? Kaha gaya: Abu Lahab.

e: [AI] I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during the pre-Islamic period at the market of Dhi Majaaz, saying, "O people, say there is no god but Allah, you will succeed." He repeated it multiple times, and people gathered around him, following him. Behind him was a man with tangled hair and a glowing face, saying, "He is a lying magician!" So I asked, "Who is this?" They said, "His uncle, Abu Lahab." "I only mentioned 'Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Al-Zinad as my source of testimony because I wanted to follow their example, as they both testified by him," they said. But indeed, I had only testified by Ibn Abi Al-Zinad, for they both testified by him.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko zamana-e-jahiliyat mein Souq Dhi al-Majaz mein yeh farmate hue dekha: "Aye logo! Kaho La ilaha illallah, kamyab ho jaoge." Aap (SAW) baar baar yeh dohrate the aur log aap (SAW) ke gird jama hokar aap (SAW) ki pairavi kar rahe the. Aap (SAW) ke peechhe aik bhainga, do choti waala, roshan chehre wala shakhs kehta tha: "Yeh jhoota jaadugar hai." Maine poocha yeh kaun hai? Logon ne kaha: iska chacha Abu Lahab. (Maine Abdur Rahman bin Abi al-Zinad ko is riwayat ka gawah banaya hai, un dono ki pairavi mein, kyunke un dono ne bhi isi ki gawahi di hai.)

e: [AI] An old woman came to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  while I was with him, and he said to her, "Who are you?" She replied, "I am Jathama Al-Muzaniyah." He said, "No, you are Hasanah Al-Muzaniyah. How are you? How is your condition? How have you been since we last saw you?" She said, "I am doing well, by my father and mother, O Messenger of Allah." When she left, I said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, you showed great regard for this old woman. What was the reason for this?" He replied, "She used to visit us during the time of Khadijah, and indeed, having good relations is part of faith."
hi: Aik budhi aurat Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hui jab main wahan mojood tha. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Tum kaun ho?" Unhone kaha: "Main Jassamah al-Muzaniyyah hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke tum Hassanah al-Muzaniyyah ho. Tum kaise ho? Tumhara haal kaisa hai? Hamare baad tum kaise rahe?" Unhone arz kiya: "Khairiyat se hoon, mere maa-baap aap (SAW) par qurbaan hon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Jab woh chali gayi to maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap is budhi aurat se itni tawajjo aur izzat se pesh aaye?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Khadijah (RA) ke zamane mein humare paas aaya karti thi, aur purani nisbaton ka khayal rakhna Eman mein se hai."

e: “Indeed, Allah has ninety-nine Names, one hundred less one, whoever counts them shall enter Paradise. He is Allah, the one whom there is none worthy of worship except for Him (Allāhu Lā Ilāha Illā Huwa), the Most Merciful (to the creation) (Ar-Raḥmān), the Most Beneficent (to the believers) (Ar-Raḥīm), the King (Al-Malik), the Free of Deficiencies (Al-Quddūs), the Granter of Safety (As-Salām), the Granter of Security (Al-Mu’min), the Watcher (Al-Muhaimin), the Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), the Compeller (Al-Jabbār), the Supreme (Al-Mutakabbir), the Creator (Al-Khāliq), the Originator (Al-Bāri’), the Fashioner (Al-Muṣawwir), the Pardoner (Al-Ghaffār), the Overwhelming (Al-Qahhār), the Giving (Al-Wahhāb), the Provider (Ar-Razzāq), the Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), the Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), the Taker (Al-Qābiḍ), the Giver (Al-Bāsiṭ), the Abaser (Al-Khāfiḍ), the Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), the One who grants honor (Al-Muʿizz), the One who humiliates (Al-Mudhil), the Hearing (As-Samīʿ), the Seeing (Al-Baṣīr), the Judge (Al-Ḥakam), the Just (Al-ʿAdl), the Kind (Al-Laṭīf), the Aware (Al-Khabīr), the Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), the Magnificent (Al-ʿAẓīm), the Oft-Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), the Grateful (Ash-Shakūr), the Most High (Al-ʿAliyy), the Great (Al-Kabīr), the Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), the Powerful (Al-Muqīt), the Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), the Glorious (Al-Jalīl), the Generous (Al-Karīm), the Watcher (Ar-Raqīb), the Responder (Al-Mujīb), the Liberal Giver (Al-Wāsiʿ), the Wise (Al-Ḥakīm), the Loving (Al-Wadūd), the Majestic (Al-Majīd), the Reviver (Al-Bāʿith), the Witness (Ash-Shahīd), the Truth (Al-Ḥaqq), the Guarantor (Al-Wakīl), the Strong (Al-Qawiyy), the Firm (Al-Matīn), the One Who Aids (Al-Waliyy), the Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd), the Encompasser (Al-Muḥṣi), the One Who Begins things (Al-Mubdi’), the One Who brings things back (Al-Muʿīd), the One Who gives life (Al-Muḥyi), the One Who causes death (Al-Mumīt), the Living (Al-Ḥayyu), the Self-Sufficient (Al-Qayyūm), the One Who brings into existence (Al-Wājid), the Illustrious (Al-Mājid), the One (Al-Wāḥid), the Master (Aṣ-Ṣamad), the Able (Al-Qādir), the Powerful (Al-Muqtadir), the One who hastens (Al-Muqaddim), the One who delays (Al-Mu’akhkhir), the First (Al-Awwal), the Last (Al-Ākhir), the Apparent (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), the Inner (Al-Bāṭin), the Owner (Al-Wāli), the Exalted (Al-Mutaʿāli), the Doer of Good (Al-Barr), the Acceptor of repentance (At-Tawwāb), the Avenger (Al-Muntaqim), the Pardoning (Al-ʿAfuww), the Kind (Ar-Ra’ūf), the Owner of Dominion (Mālikul-Mulk), the Possessor of Glory and Generosity (Dhul Jalāli wal Ikrām), the One who does justice (Al-Muqsiṭ), the Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ), the Rich (Al-Ghaniyy), the Enricher (Al-Mughni), the Preventer (Al-Māniʿ), the Harmer (Aḍ-Ḍār), the One who benefits (An-Nāfiʿ), the Light (An-Nūr), the Guide (Al-Hādi), the Originator (Al-Badīʿ), the Lasting (Al-Bāqi), the Inheritor (Al-Wārith), the Guide (Ar-Rashīd), the Tolerant (Aṣ-Ṣabūr).” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3507)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala ke ninyanwe (99) naam hain, ya'ni sau mein se aik kam, jo koi inhe shumaar kare woh jannat mein dakhil hoga. Woh (Allah) taaq hai aur taaq ko pasand karta hai. Woh Allah hai jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi: Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim, Al-Malik, Al-Quddus, As-Salam, Al-Mu'min, Al-Muhaimin, Al-'Aziz, Al-Jabbar, Al-Mutakabbir, Al-Khaliq, Al-Bari, Al-Musawwir, Al-Ghaffar, Al-Qahhar, Al-Wahhab, Ar-Razzaq, Al-Fattah, Al-'Alim, Al-Qabid, Al-Basit, Al-Khafid, Ar-Rafi', Al-Mu'izz, Al-Mudhill, As-Sami', Al-Basir, Al-Hakam, Al-'Adl, Al-Latif, Al-Khabir, Al-Halim, Al-'Azim, Al-Ghafur, Ash-Shakur, Al-'Ali, Al-Kabir, Al-Hafiz, Al-Mughith." Safwan apni riwayat mein 'Al-Muqit' bhi kehte hain, aur isi taraf Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Ishaq apni 'Mukhtasar as-Sahih' mein gaye hain: Al-Hasib, Al-Jalil, Al-Karim, Ar-Raqib, Al-Mujib, Al-Wasi', Al-Hakim, Al-Wadud, Al-Majid, Al-Ba'ith, Ash-Shahid, Al-Haqq, Al-Wakil, Al-Qawi, Al-Matin, Al-Wali, Al-Hamid, Al-Muhsi, Al-Mubdi', Al-Mu'id, Al-Muhyi, Al-Mumit, Al-Hayy, Al-Qayyum, Al-Wajid, Al-Majid, Al-Wahid, As-Samad, Al-Qadir, Al-Muqtadir, Al-Muqaddim, Al-Mu'akhkhir, Al-Awwal, Al-Akhir, Az-Zahir, Al-Batin, Al-Wali, Al-Muta'ali, Al-Barr, At-Tawwab, Al-Muntaqim, Al-'Afuww, Ar-Ra'uf, Malik-ul-Mulk, Dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram, Al-Muqsit, Al-Jami', Al-Ghani, Al-Mughni, Al-Mani', Ad-Darr, An-Nafi', An-Nur, Al-Hadi, Al-Badi', Al-Baqi, Al-Warith, Ar-Rashid, As-Sabur."

e: the Messenger of Allah (saas) said: "Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one, for He is One and loves the odd (numbered). Whoever learns them will enter Paradise. They are: Allah, Al-Wahid (the One), As-Samad (the Self-Sufficient Master who all creatures need, He neither eats nor drinks), Al-Awwal (the First), Al-Akhir (the Last), Az-Zahir (the Most High), Al-Batin (the Most Near), Al-Khaliq (the Creator), Al-Bari (the Inventor of all things), Al-Musawwir (the Bestower of forms), Al-Malik (the King), Al-Haqq (the Truth), As-Salam (the One free from all defects), Al-Mu'min (the Giver of security), Al-Muhaymin (the Watcher over His creatures), Al-'Aziz (the All-Mighty), Al-Jabbar (the Compeller), Al-Mutakabbir (the Supreme), Ar-Rahman (the Most Gracious), Ar-Rahim (the Most Merciful), Al-Latif (the Most Subtle and Courteous), Al-Khabir (the Aware), As-Sami' (the Hearing), Al-Basir (the Seeing), Al-'Alim (the All-Knowing), Al-'Azim (the Most Great), Al-Barr (the Source of goodness), Al-Muta'al (the Most Exalted), Al-Jalil (the Sublime One), Al-Jamil (the Beautiful), Al-Hayy (the Ever-Living), Al-Qayyum (the One Who sustains and protects all that exists), Al-Qadir (the Able), Al-Qahir (the Irrestible), Al-'Ali (the Exalted), Al-Hakim (the Most Wise), Al-Qarib (the Ever-Near), Al-Mujib (the Responsive), Al-Ghani (the Self-Sufficient), Al-Wahhab (the Bestower), Al-Wadud (the Loving), Ash-Shakur (the Appreciative), Al-Majid (the Most Gentle), Al-Wajid (the Patron), Al-Wali (the Governor), Al-Rashid (the Guide), Al-'Afuw (the Pardoner), Al-Ghafur (the Forgiver), Al-Halim (the Forbearing One), Al-Karim (the Most Generous), At-Tawwab (the Acceptor of Repentance), Ar-Rabb (the Lord and Cherisher), Al-Majid (the Most Glorious), Al-Wali (the Helper), Ash-Shahid (the Witness), Al-Mubin (the Manifest), Al-Burhan (the Proof), Ar-Ra'uf (the Compassionate), Ar-Rahim (the Most Merciful), Al-Mubdi' (the Originator), Al-Mu'id (the Restorer), Al-Ba'ith (the Resurrector), Al-Warith (the Supreme Inheritor), Al-Qawi (the All-Strong), Ash-Shadid (the Severe), Ad-Darr (the One Who harms), An-Nafi' (the One Who benefits), Al-Baqi' (the Everlasting), Al-Waqi (the Protector), Al-Khafid (the Humble), Ar-Rafi' (the Exalter), Al-Qabid (the Retainer), Al-Basit (the Expander), Al-Mu'izz (the Honorer), Al-Mudhill (the Humiliator), Al-Muqsit (the Equitable), Ar-Razzaq (the Providor), Dhul-Quwwah (the Powerful), Al-Matin (the Most Strong), Al-Qa'im (the Firm), Ad-Da'im (the Eternal), Al-Hafiz (the Guardian), Al-Wakil (the Trustee), Al-Fatir (the Originator of creation), As-Sami' (the Hearer), Al-Mu'ti (the Giver), Al-Muhyi (the Giver of life), Al-Mumit (the Giver of death), Al-Mani' (the Withholder), Al-Jami' (the Gatherer), Al-Hadi (the Guide), Al-Kafi (the Sufficient), Al-Abad (the Eternal), Al-'Alim (the Knower), As-Sadiq (the Truthful), An-Nur (the Light), Al-Munir (the Giver of light), At-Tamm (the Perfect), Al-Qadim (the Earlier), Al-Witr (the One), Al-Ahad (the Lone), As-Samad [(the Self-sufficient Master, Who all creatures need, (He neither eats no drinks)]. He begets not, nor was He begotten. And there is none co-equal or comparable unto him."(One of the narrators) Zuhair said: We heard from more than one of the scholars that the first of these (names) should begin after saying: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, bi yadihil-khair wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay-in Qadir, la ilaha illallahu lahul-asma'ul-husna [None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, with no partner or associate. His is the dominion and all praise is His. In His Hand is (all) goodness, and He is Able to do all things, none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and His are the (Most) Beautiful Names]. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3861)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala ke ninyanwe naam hain, jo unhe shumaar kare woh jannat mein dakhil hoga: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim, Al-Ilah, Ar-Rabb, Al-Malik, Al-Quddus, As-Salam, Al-Mu'min, Al-Muhaimin, Al-'Aziz, Al-Jabbar, Al-Mutakabbir, Al-Khaliq, Al-Bari, Al-Musawwir, Al-Halim, Al-'Alim, As-Sami', Al-Basir, Al-Hayy, Al-Qayyum, Al-Wasi', Al-Latif, Al-Khabir, Al-Hannan, Al-Mannan, Al-Badi', Al-Wadud, Al-Ghafur, Ash-Shakur, Al-Majid, Al-Mubdi', Al-Mu'id, An-Nur, Al-Awwal, Al-Akhir, Az-Zahir, Al-Batin, Al-Ghaffar, Al-Wahhab, Al-Qadir, Al-Ahad, As-Samad, Al-Kafi, Al-Baqi, Al-Wakil, Al-Majid, Al-Mughith, Ad-Da'im, Al-Muta'al, Dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram, Al-Mawla, An-Nasir, Al-Haqq, Al-Mubin, Al-Ba'ith, Al-Mujib, Al-Muhyi, Al-Mumit, Al-Jamil, As-Sadiq, Al-Hafiz, Al-Kabir, Al-Qarib, Ar-Raqib, Al-Fattah, At-Tawwab, Al-Qadim, Al-Witr, Al-Fatir, Ar-Razzaq, Al-'Allam, Al-'Ali, Al-'Azim, Al-Ghani, Al-Malik, Al-Muqtadir, Al-Akram, Ar-Ra'uf, Al-Mudabbir, Al-Malik, Al-Qadir, Al-Hadi, Ash-Shakir, Ar-Rafi', Ash-Shahid, Al-Wahid, Dhut-Tawl, Dhul-Ma'arij, Dhul-Fadl, Al-Khallaq, Al-Kafil, Al-Jalil, Al-Karim."

e: [AI] I heard Jesus, a man from the Bani Assad tribe, narrating about Zir from Abdullah from the Prophet PBUH, who said, "Seeking omens is a form of shirk (associating partners with Allah), but Allah the Exalted removes it through trust in Him." And this Jesus is the son of Aasim Al-Asadi, a trustworthy Kufi.
hi: Maine Isa naami aik shakhs ko, jo Bani Asad se tha, Zirr se, unhone Abdullah se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hue suna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Badshugoni shirk hai, magar Allah Ta'ala tawakkul (Allah par bharosa) ke zariye ise door kar deta hai." Aur yeh Isa, Ibn Aasim al-Asadi hain, Kufi aur thiqa (mo'tabar) hain.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Omens are a form of shirk (associating partners with Allah), but they will be removed through reliance on Allah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Badshugoni shirk mein se hai, magar Allah ise tawakkul ke zariye door kar deta hai."

e: [AI] Concerning the Prophet (pbuh), he said, "Whoever swears by other than Allah has indeed committed disbelief."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki qasam khaaye, usne kufr kiya."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Every oath taken with anything other than Allah is considered as associating partners with Him." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Har woh qasam jo Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki khai jaye, woh shirk hai." Iske baare mein Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] Abu Al-A'alia and I went to Nasr ibn Aasim Al-Laythi. He said, "You two seem more knowledgeable and aware in discussion than me. Come with me." He took us until we reached Nasr ibn Aasim Al-Laythi. He said, "Relay these two hadiths to me." Nasr said, "Uqbah ibn Malik narrated to me, and he was from our tribe. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a military expedition. They became envious of a certain group [of people], so a man from that group separated himself. A man from the military expedition followed him with a drawn sword. The man who separated said, 'I am a Muslim!' but he did not pay attention to his plea and struck and killed him. The news reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he expressed strong disapproval. The murderer was informed [of the Prophet's disapproval]. While the Prophet ﷺ  was delivering a sermon, the killer said, 'By Allah, the one who spoke did not say anything except seeking protection from being killed.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  turned away from him and from those who were near him among the people, and he continued his sermon. Then another person said, 'O Messenger of Allah, by Allah, the one who spoke did not say anything except seeking protection from being killed.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  turned away from him and from those who were near him among the people, and he continued his sermon. He could not bear it anymore, so a third person said, 'By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, the one who spoke did not say anything except seeking protection from being killed.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  approached him, and it was apparent on his face that he was displeased. Then he said, 'Verily, Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has refused to accept from me whoever kills a believer.' He repeated this statement three times."
hi: Abu al-'Aliyah aur mera aik saathi mere paas aaye, unhone kaha: 'Aao, tum dono mujhse zyada jawan aur hadith yaad rakhne mein behtar ho.' Woh humein lekar Nasr bin Aasim al-Laythi ke paas pahunche aur kaha: 'Inhein apni hadith sunao.' Nasr ne kaha: humein Uqbah bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya, jo unke qabile se the, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik lashkar bheja, unhone aik qaum par hamla kiya. Us qaum ka aik shakhs alag ho gaya, to lashkar ka aik aadmi talwar sonte hue uske peechhe gaya. Us alag hone waale ne kaha: 'Main Musalman hoon,' magar us (lashkari) ne is baat par ghaur na kiya aur use maar kar qatl kar diya. Yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi to aap (SAW) ne sakhti se baat farmayi, jo qatil tak pahunch gayi. Ek din jab Rasulullah (SAW) khutba de rahe the, to qatil ne kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ki qasam, us shakhs ne yeh baat sirf maut se bachne ke liye kahi thi.' Rasulullah (SAW) ne uski taraf se aur uske aas-paas ke logon se mun pher liya aur apna khutba jari rakha. Phir usne dobara kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ki qasam, us shakhs ne yeh baat sirf maut se bachne ke liye kahi thi.' Aap (SAW) ne phir uski taraf se mun pher liya aur khutba jari rakha. Phir woh sabr na kar saka aur teesri baar kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), us shakhs ne yeh baat sirf maut se bachne ke liye kahi thi.' To Rasulullah (SAW) uski taraf mutawajjeh hue, aap (SAW) ke chehre par naraazgi zaahir thi, phir farmaya: 'Beshak Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe kisi momin ke qatil (ke amal) ko qabool karne se mana farmaya hai.' Yeh baat aap (SAW) ne teen martaba farmayi.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "After that, what is the matter with a man killing another man while he says, 'I am a Muslim?' The killer said, 'O Messenger of Allah, he said it seeking refuge (from harm).' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Thus did he utter it in a vain attempt to protect himself.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  turned his face away from him. He said, 'Allah has forbidden the killing of a person who testifies that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that I am the Messenger of Allah. Although he did not comment on it, Al-Dhahabi recognized it in his summary."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ammaa ba'd, is shakhs ka kya maamla hai jo doosre shakhs ko qatl karta hai jabke woh keh raha tha 'main Musalman hoon'?" Qatil ne arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), usne to sirf (maut se) panah maangne ke liye yeh baat kahi thi." Rasulullah (SAW) ne is baat ko napasand kiya aur apna chehra us (qatil) se pher liya, phir farmaya: "Allah ne us shakhs (ke amal) ko mana kiya jo kisi Musalman ko qatl kare, Allah ne us shakhs (ke amal) ko mana kiya jo kisi Musalman ko qatl kare." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There are three things that I swear upon, that Allah does not let anyone who has a share in Islam be like the one who has no share. The arrows of Islam are fasting, prayer, and charity. And Allah does not appoint a servant to manage the affairs of others on the Day of Resurrection, and Allah does not love a man who loves a group except that Allah makes him among them. And the fourth thing, if I swear upon it, I hope that I will not commit any sin that Allah conceals for a servant in this world except that He conceals it for him in the Hereafter." Umar ibn Abdul Aziz said, "If you hear a hadith like this narrated by Urwah from Aisha, then preserve it, for Shaybah al-Hadrami reported it and Bukhari mentioned it in his book of history. It is also said that al-Khudri heard it from Urwah and Umar ibn Abdul Aziz. This hadith has a sound chain of narrators and has not been reported by anyone other than Shu'ayb al-Hadrami, except for al-Nasa'i." The statement "وَفِيهِ جَهَالَةٌ" at the end indicates uncertainty about who reported the hadith.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen baatein hain jin par main qasam khata hoon: Allah kisi aise shakhs ko jiska Islam mein hissa ho, us jaisa nahi banata jiska koi hissa na ho, aur Islam ke hisse (ya'ni buniyaadi arkan) hain: rozah, namaz aur sadaqah. Allah kisi bande ko (apni hifazat mein) nahi leta phir Qiyamat ke din kisi aur ko uska sarparast banaye. Aur koi shakhs kisi qaum se mohabbat nahi karta magar Allah use unke sath (shamil) kar deta hai. Aur chauthi baat, agar main us par bhi qasam khaun to mujhe umeed hai ke gunehgar na hounga: Allah duniya mein kisi bande ki jo bhi parda-poshi karta hai, wahi akhirat mein bhi uski parda-poshi karta hai." Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne kaha: "Jab tum aisi hadith suno jo Urwah, Aisha (RA) se bayan karte hain, to use yaad rakho." Shaybah al-Hadrami - Bukhari ne unse riwayat li hai aur 'Tareekh' mein kaha hai, aur unhein Al-Khudri bhi kaha jata hai, unhone Urwah aur Umar bin Abdul Aziz se suna hai. Yeh hadith sanad ke lihaz se sahih hai, magar Bukhari aur Muslim dono ne ise riwayat nahi kiya. Shaybah al-Hadrami se, Nasa'i ke ilawa kisi ne yeh hadith riwayat nahi ki, aur is mein (raawi ki) na-ma'loomiyat (jahalat) hai.

e: [AI] I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, I want to embrace Islam, so teach me some of the laws of Islam." He mentioned prayer, the month of Ramadan, and the prayer times. So I said, "O Messenger of Allah, you mention hours when I am busy, but teach me something collective." He said, "If you are occupied, do not neglect the afternoon and evening prayers." I asked, "And what are the afternoon and evening prayers?" And it was not my people's language. He said, "The dawn and the afternoon."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur arz kiya: "Main Islam qubool karna chahta hoon, mujhe Islam ke kuch ahkaam sikha dijiye." Aap (SAW) ne namaz, mah-e-Ramzan aur namaz ke auqat ka zikr farmaya. Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap un auqat ka zikr farma rahe hain jab main mashghool hota hoon, lekin mujhe koi jaame (sab kuch samete hue) baat sikha dijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum mashghool ho jao to (kam az kam) do 'asr (waqton) ko na chhodo." Maine poocha: "Do 'asr kya hain?" - yeh meri qaum ki zaban nahi thi (is liye mujhe pata nahi tha). Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fajr aur Asr."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah taught me, saying, "Guard the five daily prayers." I said, "These are times when I am occupied, so tell me something comprehensive that I can practice and it will suffice for me." He said, "Guard the two prayers of Asr." I asked, "What are the two Asrs?" He said, "The prayer before the rising of the sun and the prayer before its setting." Abu Harb ibn Abi al-Aswad al-Dilili, one of my senior Tabi'een (followers of the Companions), a man whose hearing of narrations from Fadalah ibn 'Ubayd al-Laythi is not incomplete, for Hisham ibn Bashir is a well-known memorizer, and Khalid ibn Abdullah al-Wasiti is the author of a book, and this hadith is mentioned by Muslim in his book of faith, narrated by Shu'ba from 'Uthman ibn 'Abdullah ibn Muhab and after him from Muhammad ibn 'Uthman from his father." And Khulaf Hisham narrated it from Khalid ibn Abdullah from Abu Harb from 'Abdullah ibn Fadalah from his father. The Messenger of Allah taught me.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaya, aur jo kuch aap (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaya usmein farmaya: "Paanch namazon ki hifazat karo." Maine arz kiya: "Yeh aise auqat hain jinmein mujhe mashghooliyat hoti hai, mujhe koi jaame baat bata dijiye jise agar main karoon to mere liye kaafi ho jaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do 'asron ki hifazat karo." (Ravi ne kaha: yeh humari zaban mein na thi.) Maine poocha: "Do 'asr kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik namaz suraj nikalne se pehle aur aik namaz suraj doobne se pehle." (Abu Harb bin Abi al-Aswad al-Dili aik bade Tabi'i hain, unke paas bade Sahaba (RA) ka ilm hai, unka Fadalah bin 'Ubayd al-Laythi (RA) se sunna kam nahi samjha jata, kyunke Husheim bin Bashir hifz mein mash'hoor hafiz hain, aur Khalid bin Abdullah al-Wasiti kitaab ke saahib hain, aur yeh majmoo'i taur par waisa hi hai jaisa Muslim ne Kitaab al-Iman mein Shu'bah ki Uthman bin Abdullah bin Mauhab se riwayat, aur uske baad Muhammad bin Uthman ki apne walid se riwayat, naql ki hai.) Husheim ki mukhalifat ki gayi hai: ise Khalid bin Abdullah ne Abu Harb se, unhone Abdullah bin Fadalah se, unhone apne walid se riwayat kiya hai ke unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaya...

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Indeed, Islam has a light and a beacon, similar to the light of a road."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Islam ke liye ek roshni aur ek mainaar (nishani) hai, jaise raste ka mainaar (nishaan) hota hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Islam is to worship Allah alone, without associating any partners with Him, and to establish the prayer, give the obligatory charity (Zakat), observe fasting during Ramadan, perform Hajj to the House (Kaaba), enjoin good and forbid evil, and greet your family with peace. Whoever neglects any of these obligations has forfeited a portion of Islam and whoever abandons them all has turned his back on Islam." This hadith is like the previous one in terms of its importance. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Islam yeh hai ke tum Allah ki ibadat karo, uske sath kisi ko shareek na thehrao, namaz qaim karo, zakat do, Ramzan ke roze rakho, Baitullah ka Hajj karo, neki ka hukum do aur burai se roko, aur apne ghar walon ko salaam karo. Jo shakhs in mein se kisi cheez mein kami kare, to woh Islam ke ek hisse ko chhod deta hai, aur jo in sab ko chhod de, usne Islam ki taraf se apni peeth pher li." Yeh hadith pehli hadith ki tarah istiqaamat (Islam ki mazbooti) ke baare mein hai. Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Shall I not teach you, or shall I not guide you to a word from beneath the Throne, from the treasures of Paradise?' You say: 'There is no power or might except with Allah.' So Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, says: 'My slave has submitted and surrendered.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhe aik aisa kalima na sikhaun - ya farmaya: kya main tumhe rehnumai na karoon - jo Arsh ke neeche se, jannat ke khazane mein se hai? Tum kaho: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah (Allah ke siwa koi taqat aur qudrat nahi). To Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: mera banda musalman ho gaya aur usne sar jhuka diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If two men enter Islam and then one of them commits a sin, he will remain outside of Islam until the oppressor repents."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar do aadmi Islam mein daakhil hon aur phir aapas mein qata'-e-ta'alluq (bol-chaal band) kar len, to un mein se aik Islam se bahar samjha jayega yahan tak ke zalim (galti karne wala) wapas aa jaye (sulah kar le)."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When a man commits fornication, faith departs from him and there is something like a canvas roof over his head; and when he quits that action, faith returns to him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4690)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab banda zina karta hai to uska Eman uske andar se nikal jata hai, aur (Eman) uske sar par saaye ki tarah ho jata hai; phir jab woh is amal se ruk jata hai to Eman uski taraf wapas aa jata hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever commits adultery and drinks alcohol, Allah will remove faith from him, just as a person removes a shirt from his head." Muslim relied on the testimony of Abdullah bin Al-Walid and Abdullah bin Hajirah, who are both Shami.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs zina kare aur sharab piye, Allah uska Eman yun nikal deta hai jaise insaan apne sar se qamees utaarta hai." Muslim ne Abdur Rahman bin Hujairah aur Abdullah bin al-Walid, jo dono Shaami hain, ki hadith se hujjat pakdi hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet said, "Modesty and faith are closely connected. If one is lifted, the other is also lifted."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haya aur Eman dono aik sath jude hue hain, jab un mein se aik uthaya jata hai to doosra bhi uth jata hai."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase is:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Verily, the believer is kind and there is no goodness in one who is not kind and is not shown kindness.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak momin (logon se) ulfat rakhta hai, aur us shakhs mein koi khair nahi jo na khud ulfat rakhe aur na doosron ki ulfat ka mustahiq ho."

e: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "Whoever comes worshipping Allah and not associating anything with Him, establishing Salah, paying Zakah and avoiding major sins, Paradise will be his." They asked him about major sins and he said: "Associating others with Allah, killing a Muslim soul, and fleeing (from the battlefield) on the day of the march." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4009)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi banda Allah ki ibadat kare, uske sath kisi ko shareek na thehraye, namaz qaim kare, zakat de aur kabaair (bade gunahon) se bache, woh zaroor jannat mein dakhil hoga." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Kabaair kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke sath shirk karna, jang ke maidan se bhagna aur (kisi be-gunah) jaan ka qatl karna."

e: [AI] "When he visited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what actions lead to Paradise?' He (the Prophet) replied, 'You should excel in good speech and generosity in giving food.'"
hi: Jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua to arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsi cheez jannat ko wajib karti hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Achhi baat karo aur khana khilao."

e: [AI] He came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and the Prophet ﷺ  heard them referring to him as "Abu al-Hakam" (the father of wisdom). The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah is the Wisest. Why do you call him 'Abu al-Hakam'?" They replied, "Whenever my people have a dispute, I judge between them, and both parties are satisfied with my judgment." The Prophet ﷺ  asked, "Do you have children?" He replied, "Shurayh, Abdullah, Musli, sons of Hanif." The Prophet ﷺ  then asked, "Who among them is the oldest?" He replied, "Shurayh." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Then you are Abu Shurayh," and he prayed for him and his children. "I have mentioned in the book of knowledge in the mention of the Makhzumites, Shurayh bin Hanif, who lived in the Jahiliyyah era and embraced Islam, but did not see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He belonged to the generation that followed." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in his summary.
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua, to Nabi (SAW) ne suna ke log use 'Abu al-Hakam' kahkar pukarte hain, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah hi Al-Hakam (faisla karne wala) hai, tumhe Abu al-Hakam kyun kaha jata hai?" Usne kaha: "Meri qaum jab aapas mein ikhtilaf karti hai to main unke darmiyan faisla karta hoon aur dono giroh raazi ho jate hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhare koi aulad hai?" Usne kaha: "Shurayh, Abdullah aur Muslim, Hani' ke bete." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To sabse bada kaun hai?" Usne kaha: "Shurayh." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To tum Abu Shurayh ho," aur aap (SAW) ne uske aur uski aulad ke liye dua ki. (Maine 'Kitab al-Ma'rifah' mein Mukhadramin ke zikr mein Shurayh bin Hani' ka zikr kiya hai, kyunke usne Jahiliyat aur Islam dono dor paye lekin Rasulullah (SAW) ko nahi dekha, is liye woh Tabi'in mein shumaar hota hai.) Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  read the verse "Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing" [Quran 4:58], then he placed his finger of supplication on his eyes and his thumbs on his ears.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat parhi: "Beshak Allah sunne wala, dekhne wala hai" (Surah An-Nisa 58), phir aap (SAW) ne dua wali ungli apni aankhon par aur apne dono anguthe apne kaanon par rakhe.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No trial has occurred and will occur until the Hour is established that is greater than the trial of the Dajjal (false messiah). And there is no prophet except that he has warned his people. And I am informing you about something that no prophet before me had informed about." Then he placed his hand on his eye and said, "I bear witness that Allah, the Most High, is not one-eyed." This hadith is narrated by Zuhayr and Mu'awiyah from Zaid.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qayamat qaim hone tak, na koi fitna guzra aur na hi koi fitna aayega jo Dajjal ke fitne se bada ho. Koi Nabi aisa nahi guzra jisne apni qaum ko is se khabardar na kiya ho, aur main tumhe uske baare mein aisi baat batata hoon jo mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ne nahi batayi." Phir aap (SAW) ne apna haath apni aankh par rakha aur farmaya: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah Ta'ala kaana (aik aankh wala) nahi hai." Ise Zuhayr aur Mu'awiyah ne Zaid se riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while I was wearing a piece of clothing. He said, "Do you have any wealth?" I said, "Yes." He asked, "What kind of wealth?" I replied, "I have camels, horses, slaves, and sheep." He said, "When Allah gives you wealth, let it be evident on you." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  also said, "Do the camels of your people produce sound ears? If so, purposely inflict a cut on their ears and say that it is a defect. Or tear their skin and say that it is haram (forbidden), so it becomes forbidden for you and your family." I said, "Yes." He said, "Whatever Allah gives you is permissible for you, and the assistance of Allah is greater than your own assistance. And Musa (Moses) was the strongest of all who aided their people."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua jabke meri halat purani-si (maamooli libaas mein) thi. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhare paas koi maal hai?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kaunse maal se?" Maine kaha: "Unt, ghoray, ghulam aur bakriyon, sab se." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah tumhe maal de to woh (uska asar) tum par zaahir hona chahiye." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhari qaum ke unt saabit kaanon ke sath paida hote hain, phir tum ustra lekar unke kaan kaat dete ho aur kehte ho yeh 'bahirah' hai, ya unki khaal cheer dete ho aur kehte ho yeh 'haram' hai, is tarah use apne aur apne ghar walon par haram thehra dete ho?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To jo kuch Allah tumhe de woh tumhare liye halal hai, aur Allah ki madad tumhari madad se zyada mazboot hai, aur Allah ka ustra tumhare ustre se zyada tez hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said about this verse, 'So when his Lord manifested His glory to the mountain, He made it (the mountain) crumble to pieces'" [Surah Al-A'raf 143]. 'From this appeared the greatness (of Allah)' on the condition of being a Muslim."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne is ayat ke baare mein farmaya: "Jab uske Rab ne pahaad par tajalli (jalwa) farmaya to usne pahaad ko (rezah-rezah) kar diya" (Surah Al-A'raf 143): "Ussi mein se itna zahir hua tha." Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  read, "He said, 'My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You.' [Allah] said, 'You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me.' But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious." The mountain crumbled after that.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat parhi: "Usne kaha: Aye mere Rab, mujhe apna deedar dikha, ke main tujhe dekhoon" (Surah Al-A'raf 143). Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To (Allah ne) noor mein se itna zahir kiya" - aap (SAW) ne apne haath se apni chhoti ungli ki adhi pore ki taraf ishara kiya, phir usse Hammad ke seene par maara - aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To pahaad dhas gaya."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'There are three types of people whom Allah loves and to whom He smiles: a person who, when a group of people disperses, fights alone for the sake of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and another person who, when a group of people follows him, fights along with them for the sake of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (qism ke log) hain jinhe Allah mohabbat karta hai aur unki taraf muskura kar dekhta hai: (unmein se aik) woh shakhs hai jo jab koi giroh (jang ke maidan mein) bikhar jaye to woh akela uske peechhe rehkar Allah Azza wa Jalla ki khatir apni jaan se ladta hai."

e: [AI] It was narrated from the Prophet ﷺ  that he said, "Whoever has an atom's weight of arrogance in his heart will not enter Paradise." A man said, "O Messenger of Allah, I like for my clothes to be nice, my head to be neat, and my sandals to be new." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Verily, Allah is Beautiful and He loves beauty. Arrogance means rejecting the truth and looking down on people."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiske dil mein zarra barabar takabbur (ghuroor) ho, woh jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga." Aik shakhs ne arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe achha lagta hai ke mera kapda naya ho, mera sar tel se sanwara ho aur meri jooti ka tasma naya ho." Aap (SAW) ne aur bhi kai cheezon ka zikr kiya, yahan tak ke apne kode ke fite ka bhi zikr kiya, phir farmaya: "Yeh husn hai, aur Allah husn-wala (Jameel) hai, husn ko pasand karta hai, lekin takabbur yeh hai ke haq ko thukra diya jaye aur logon ko haqir samjha jaye."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, is it arrogance to wear nice clothes?" He replied, "Indeed, Allah is beautiful and He loves beauty."
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya achhe kapde pehnna takabbur mein shumaar hota hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Jameel (khoobsurat) hai, husn ko pasand karta hai."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: Allah called upon Gabriel and sent him to the paradise, and he said: Look at it and what I have prepared in it for its people. Gabriel said: By Your Honor, no one hears of it except that he enters it. It is surrounded by detestable things." So He said: Return to it and look at it. So he returned and said: By Your Honor, I feared that no one would enter it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ne Jibra'il (AS) ko bulaya aur use Jannat ki taraf bheja aur farmaya: "Isse dekho aur jo maine iske ahl ke liye taiyyar kiya hai (woh bhi dekho)." Jibra'il (AS) ne kaha: "Teri izzat ki qasam, jo bhi iske baare mein sunega, zaroor ismein dakhil hoga." Phir jannat ko takleef-deh cheezon se gher diya gaya. Allah ne farmaya: "Wapas jao aur isse (dobara) dekho." Jibra'il (AS) wapas gaye, phir kaha: "Teri izzat ki qasam, mujhe darr hai ke ab koi ismein dakhil na ho sakega."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: When Allah created Paradise, He said to Gabriel: Go and look at it. He went and looked at it, then came and said: O my Lord! By Thy might, no one who hears of it will fail to enter it. He then surrounded it with disagreeable things, and said: Go and look at it, Gabriel. He went and looked at it, then came and said: O my Lord! By Thy might, I am afraid that no one will enter it. When Allah created Hell, He said: Go and look at it, Gabriel. He went and looked at it, then came and said: O my Lord! By Thy might, no one who hears of it will enter it. He then surrounded it with desirable things and said: Go and look at it, Gabriel. He went, looked at it, then came and said: O my Lord! By Thy might and power, I am afraid that no one will remain who does not enter it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4744)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Allah ne Jannat banayi to farmaya: "Aye Jibra'il, jao aur ise dekho." Woh gaye aur dekha, phir aakar kaha: "Aye mere Rab! Teri izzat ki qasam, jo bhi iske baare mein sunega zaroor ismein dakhil hoga." Phir Allah ne ise takleef-deh cheezon se gher diya, aur farmaya: "Jao aur ise dobara dekho." Woh gaye, dekha, phir aakar kaha: "Aye mere Rab! Teri izzat ki qasam, mujhe darr hai ke ab ismein koi dakhil na ho sakega." Phir Allah ne Jahannam ko banaya aur farmaya: "Aye Jibra'il, jao aur ise dekho." Woh gaye, dekha, phir aakar kaha: "Iske baare mein sunkar koi bhi ismein dakhil nahi hoga." Phir Allah ne ise (nafsani) khwahishon se gher diya, aur farmaya: "Jao aur ise dobara dekho." Woh gaye, dekha, phir aakar kaha: "Aye mere Rab! Teri izzat ki qasam, mujhe darr hai ke ab koi bhi ismein dakhil hone se na bach sakega." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] "Come willingly or by force," he said to the sky, "Bring forth your sun, moon, and stars." He said to the earth, "Split open and bring forth your rivers and fruits." So they both said, "We come obediently."
hi: ...Us (aasman) aur zameen se (Allah ne) farmaya: "Khushi se aao ya na-khushi se." Aap (SAW) ne aasman se farmaya: "Apna suraj, apna chand aur apne sitaray nikaal," aur zameen se farmaya: "Apni nadiyan phaad aur apne phal nikaal." To dono ne kaha: "Hum khushi se hazir hain."

e: [AI] Narrated to us Al-Qa'nabi in what was recited from Malik, from Zaid ibn Abi Unaysah, from Abdul-Hameed ibn Abdul-Rahman ibn Zaid ibn Al-Khattab, from Muslim ibn Yasir Al-Juhani, that Umar ibn Al-Khattab was asked about this verse: "And when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants" [Al-A'raf 172]. Umar ibn Al-Khattab said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ being asked about it, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Indeed, Allah created Adam and then wiped his back with His right hand, and extracted from him his offspring. Allah said, "I created these for Paradise and they will perform the deeds of the people of Paradise." Then, He wiped his back and extracted from him his offspring. Allah said, "I created these for the Hellfire and they will perform the deeds of the people of the Hellfire."
hi: Humein Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, jo Malik par parha gaya, unhone Zaid bin Abi Unaysah se, unhone Abdul Hamid bin Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Al-Khattab se, unhone Muslim bin Yasar Al-Juhani se (riwayat ki) ke Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se is ayat ke baare mein poocha gaya: "Aur jab tere Rab ne Bani Adam ki pushton se unki zurriyat nikaali" (Surah Al-A'raf 172). Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha jate hue suna, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne Adam (AS) ko paida kiya, phir unki pusht par apna daayan haath phera aur ussay se aulad nikaali, aur farmaya: 'Maine inhe Jannat ke liye paida kiya hai, aur yeh Jannatiyon ka amal karenge.' Phir unki pusht par (dobara) haath phera aur ussay se aulad nikaali, aur farmaya: 'Maine inhe Jahannam ke liye paida kiya hai, aur yeh Jahannamiyon ka amal karenge.'"

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ, Allah took a covenant from the back of Adam and extracted from his loins his offspring and dispersed them, face to face, before Him, like small particles, then He spoke to them and said, "Am I not your Lord?" They replied, "Indeed, we bear witness." [This] testifies lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, "Verily, we have been unaware of this." Or lest you should say, "It was only our fathers aforetime who took others as partners in worship along with Allah, and we were (merely their) descendants after them; will You then destroy us because of the deeds of men who practised Al-Batil (i.e. polytheism and committing crimes and sins, invoking and worshipping others besides Allah)?"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne Adam (AS) ki pusht se ahd liya, aur unki pusht se unki zurriyat nikaali aur unhe apne saamne bikher diya jaise choti choti chuntiyan, phir unse kalaam kiya aur farmaya: 'Kya main tumhara Rab nahi hoon?' Unhone kaha: 'Kyun nahi, hum gawahi dete hain' - taake tum Qayamat ke din yeh na kaho ke 'hum is se ghafil the,' ya yeh na kaho ke 'humse pehle sirf hamare baap-dada ne shirk kiya tha aur hum to unke baad ki aulad the; kya tu humein us amal ki wajah se halaak karega jo baatil kaam karne walon ne kiya?'"

e: [AI] "Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: 'On the day that Allah spoke to Moses, he was wearing a woolen cloak, woolen trousers, a woolen cap, a woolen shawl, and sandals made of non-tanned donkey skin.' They all unanimously agreed to use the narration of Sa'id ibn Mansur and Humayd, who is not Ibn Qays al-A'raj. Al-Bukhari said in his history that Humayd ibn Ali al-A'raj al-Kufi is unreliable in narration, while Abdullah bin al-Harith al-Najrani used it as evidence. Only Muslim used Khilafah bin Khalifah as evidence."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis din Allah ne Musa (AS) se kalaam kiya, unhone oon (pashmine) ka jubbah, oon ki shalwar, oon ki topi, oon ki chadar aur ghair-zibah kiye gaye gadhe ki khaal ki do jootiyan pehni hui thi." In dono (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne Sa'eed bin Mansoor ki hadith ko hujjat maana hai, aur yeh Humaid, Ibn Qais Al-A'raj nahi hai. Bukhari ne 'Tareekh' mein kaha: Humaid bin Ali Al-A'raj Al-Kufi munkar-ul-hadith (na-qabil-e-e'temaad) hai, aur Abdullah bin Al-Harith An-Najrani ki riwayat ko hujjat mana gaya hai. Aur Muslim ne akele Khalaf bin Khalifah ki riwayat ko hujjat maana hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Stick to wearing woolen garments, for you will find the sweetness of faith in your hearts." This hadith is narrated from a weak source.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Oon (pashmina) ke kapde pehno, tumhe apne dilon mein Eman ki mithaas milegi." Isse aik za'if (kamzor) sanad se naql kiya gaya hai.

e: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey when some of his Companions fell behind. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his voice reciting these two Ayat: "O mankind! Have Taqwa of your Lord! Verily the earthquake of the hour is a terrible thing..." up to His saying: but Allah's torment is severe (21:1 & 2)." When his Companions heard that, they hastened to catch up with him, since they knew that he had something to say. He ﷺ said: 'Do you know what Day this is? That is the Day when Adam will be called. His Lord will call him and say: O Adam, send forth those who are to be sent to the Fire. He will say: O Lord! How many are to be sent to the Fire? He will say: From every one-thousand there are nine-hundred and ninety-nine for the Fire and one for Paradise. So the people despaired as if they would not smile again. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw the state of his Companions, he said: 'Strive hard and receive the good news. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad, you will be counted with two creations who are immense in numbers; Ya'juj and Ma'juj, and those who have died among the progeny of Adam and the progeny of Iblis.'" He said: "So some of the people's grief went away, and he ﷺ said: 'Strive hard and receive the good news. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad! Among mankind, you are but like the mole on the flank of a camel, or a mark on the foreleg of a beast.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3169)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apne kisi safar mein the aur aap (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) chalte hue aap (SAW) ke qareeb aa gaye, to aap (SAW) ne in do ayaton se apni awaaz buland ki: "Aye logo, apne Rab se daro, beshak Qayamat ka zalzala aik badi cheez hai. Jis din tum ise dekhoge, har doodh pilane wali apne doodh pite bachche ko bhool jayegi, aur har hamal wali apna hamal gira degi, aur tum logon ko nashe mein dekhoge halanke woh nashe mein nahi honge, balke Allah ka azab bahut sakht hai" (Surah Al-Hajj 2). Jab sahaba (RA) ne yeh suna to unhone apni sawariyon ko tez kar diya aur samajh gaye ke aap (SAW) kisi khaas baat ke waqt hain. Jab woh sab aap (SAW) ke gird jama ho gaye to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhe pata hai woh kaunsa din hoga?" Unhone arz kiya: "Allah aur uska Rasool (SAW) behtar jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh woh din hai jab Adam (AS) ko pukaara jayega, unka Rab unhein pukarega aur farmayega: 'Aye Adam, Jahannam ka hissa (nikal kar) bhej.' Woh puchenge: 'Jahannam ka hissa kya hai?' Farmaya jayega: 'Har hazar mein se nau sau ninyanwe (999) Jahannam mein aur aik Jannat mein.'" Yeh sunkar sahaba (RA) ghabra gaye yahan tak ke unke chehron par koi muskurahat nazar nahi aayi. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh dekha to farmaya: "Jaan lo aur khush ho jao, us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, tumhare sath do aisi makhlooqein hain jo jis cheez ke sath bhi hoti hain use zyada kar deti hain: Ya'juj-Ma'juj, aur woh log jo Bani Adam aur Bani Iblis mein se halaak ho chuke hain." Yeh sunkar logon ki pareshani kam ho gayi. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jaan lo aur khush ho jao, us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, tum logon ke darmiyan bas itne (kam) ho jitna kisi jaanwar ki kalai par nishaan, ya jaise unt ki pahlu (baaju) par koi til."

e: [AI] "When this verse was revealed: 'O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing' [22:1] until His saying: 'But the punishment of Allah is severe' [22:2], it was on the Prophet ﷺ while he was on a journey. He mentioned the hadith in a similar manner. Both Abu Salih and Abu Sa'id agreed to narrate the hadith from Al-A'mash."
hi: Jab yeh ayat Nabi (SAW) par nazil hui: "Aye logo, apne Rab se daro, beshak Qayamat ka zalzala aik badi cheez hai" (Surah Al-Hajj 1) "lekin Allah ka azab sakht hai" (Surah Al-Hajj 2) tak, jabke aap (SAW) apne kisi safar mein the, to aap (SAW) ne isi tarah ki hadith bayan ki. In dono (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne Al-A'mash ki, Abu Salih se, unhone Abu Sa'id (RA) se, is matn ke kuch hisse ki riwayat nikali hai.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: Allah says, "O Adam!" and Adam responds by saying, "At your service and happiness, and goodness is in your hands." Allah then says, "Expel the inhabitants of the Hellfire." This hadith was mentioned briefly without mentioning specific details and other narrations. It was reported by Al-Bukhari from 'Umar ibn Hafs from his father from Al-A'mash, and it was also reported by Muslim from Abu Bakr from Waki'.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah farmayega: "Aye Adam!" Woh kahenge: "Main hazir hoon aur khush-o-khurram hoon, aur bhalai tere hi haath mein hai." Allah farmayega: "Jahannam ka hissa nikal." (Aap (SAW) ne yeh hadith mukhtasar bayan ki, nuzool waghera ka zikr kiye baghair.) Ise Bukhari ne Umar bin Hafs se, unhone apne walid se, unhone Al-A'mash se riwayat kiya hai, aur Muslim ne Abu Bakr se, unhone Waki' se riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Fear the supplication of the oppressed, for it ascends to the heavens as sparks." "Muslim and others have presented Asim ibn Kulayb and others as narrators of this hadith, and they have unanimously agreed to accept their testimony." Muslim presented Asim as proof.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mazloom ki bad-dua se daro, kyunke woh chingaari ki tarah aasman ki taraf chadhti hai." Muslim ne Aasim bin Kulaib ko hujjat banaya hai, aur is hadith ke baqi raawi bhi sab ke nazdeek hujjat mane gaye hain, magar Bukhari aur Muslim dono ne ise apni kitaabon mein shamil nahi kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am the leader of the people on the Day of Resurrection, and there is no pride for anyone except under my banner. On the Day of Resurrection, they will wait for relief, and I will have the banner of praise with me. I will walk and the people will walk with me until I reach the gate of Paradise. I will seek permission to enter and it will be asked, 'Who is this?' I will say, 'Muhammad.' It will be said, 'Welcome, Muhammad.' When I see my Lord, I will prostrate to Him. He will then look at me."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Qayamat ke din tamam logon ka sardar houn, aur is mein koi fakhr (ghuroor) nahi. Koi shakhs aisa nahi jo Qayamat ke din mere jhande ke neeche na ho, riha hone ka intezar karte hue. Aur mere sath 'Liwa-ul-Hamd' (Hamd ka jhanda) hoga. Main chaloonga aur log mere sath chalenge, yahan tak ke main Jannat ke darwaze par pahunchunga aur khulwane ki darkhwast karoonga. Poocha jayega: 'Yeh kaun hai?' Main kahoonga: 'Muhammad.' Kaha jayega: 'Muhammad ko khush-aamdeed.' Jab main apne Rab ko dekhunga to sajde mein gir jaunga, unhe dekhta rahunga."

e:
[AI] Al-Awza'i praised and the wording of this hadith is from Abu al-Abbas who said: Rabia bin Yazid and Yahya bin Abi 'Amr al-Saybani narrated to me, they said: 'Abdullah bin Firoz al-Daylami narrated to me, he said: I entered upon Abdullah bin 'Amr bin al-'As while he was in a wall in Taif called al-Wahat and he was lecturing a young man from the Quraysh. And this young man would indulge in drinking wine.

So I said to Abdullah bin 'Amr bin al-'As, "Tell me something about you that I can narrate from you about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said, "Whoever drinks wine, his repentance will not be accepted for forty mornings." The young man clenched his hand with the hand of Abdullah, then he turned away. Abdullah said: "Indeed, a miserable person is the one who is miserable in his mother's womb. And whoever leaves his house intending only to pray in al-Masjid al-Haram, he will come out of his sin like the day his mother gave birth to him."

Abdullah bin 'Amr bin al-'As said: "O Allah! I will not permit anyone to attribute to me what I did not say. Indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever drinks wine, his repentance will not be accepted for forty mornings. But if he repents, Allah will accept his repentance. But if he returns to it, his repentance will not be accepted for forty mornings.' I do not remember if it was on the third or fourth time that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Then it is a right upon Allah to make him drink from the mud of the Kohl on the Day of Resurrection.'"

He said: "I also heard the Prophet ﷺ say: 'Indeed, Allah created His creation in darkness and then He cast upon them some of His light. So whoever receives some of that light on that day, then he has been guided. And whoever is misguided, then it is because of that.' So I say: The pen has dried upon the knowledge of Allah."

And I also heard the Prophet ﷺ say: 'Indeed, Sulaiman bin Dawud asked his Lord three times, so He gave him two and we hope that He gave him the third. He asked Him for a judgment that aligns with his judgment, so He gave it to him. And he asked Him for a kingdom that none after him should have, so He gave it to him. And he asked Him that whenever a man leaves his house and intends only to pray in this mosque, he should come out of his sin like the day his mother gave birth to him. We hope that Allah has given him that.' Al-Awza'i said: Rabia bin Yazid narrated this hadith to me between al-Miqsilat and al-Jasa'ir.
hi: Main Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-'As (RA) ki khidmat mein hazir hua jabke woh Taif mein apne aik bagh mein the jise 'Al-Wahat' kaha jata tha, aur woh Quraysh ke aik naujawan ko samjha rahe the, jo sharab peene ka ilzaam rakhta tha. Maine Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se kaha: "Aap se kuch baatein mujhtak pahunchi hain jo aap Rasulullah (SAW) se bayan karte hain, ke jo shakhs sharab ka aik ghoont bhi piye uski tauba chaalees subhon tak qubool nahi hoti." To us naujawan ne apna haath Abdullah (RA) ke haath se chhuda liya aur mun mod kar chala gaya - kyunke bad-naseeb wahi hai jo apni maa ke pet mein hi bad-naseeb ho chuka ho - aur jo shakhs apne ghar se sirf Bait-ul-Maqdis mein namaz padhne ki niyat se nikle woh apne gunahon se aise nikal jata hai jaise us din jab uski maa ne use paida kiya. Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Allah, main kisi ko yeh haq nahi deta ke woh mere baare mein woh baat kahe jo maine nahi kahi. Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Jo shakhs sharab piye uski tauba chaalees subhon tak qubool nahi hoti; agar woh tauba kare to Allah uski tauba qubool farmata hai; aur agar woh dobara piye to uski tauba chaalees subhon tak qubool nahi hoti'" - mujhe yaad nahi ke teesri baar tha ya chauthi baar aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "aur agar woh dobara aisa kare to Allah par yeh haq ban jata hai ke woh use Qayamat ke din Jahannamiyon ke ghande paani (radghat-ul-khabaal) se pilaye." Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh bhi farmate hue suna: 'Allah ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kiya, phir unpar apne noor mein se dala. To jise us din us noor mein se kuch mil gaya woh hidayat pa gaya, aur jise nahi mila woh gumraah ho gaya - isi liye main kehta hoon: qalam Allah ke ilm ke mutabiq (likh kar) khushk ho chuka hai.'" Aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh bhi farmate hue suna: "Sulaiman bin Dawud (AS) ne apne Rab se teen cheezein maangi, unhe do di gayi, aur hum ummeed rakhte hain ke unhe teesri bhi di gayi hogi: unhone aisa faisla mangaa jo Allah ke faisle se mutabiq ho, to unhe woh diya gaya; unhone aisi hukumat mangi jo unke baad kisi aur ke laayak na ho, to unhe woh di gayi; aur unhone yeh dua maangi ke jo bhi shakhs apne ghar se sirf isi masjid mein namaz padhne ki niyat se nikle woh apne gunah se aise nikle jaise us din jab uski maa ne use paida kiya - hum ummeed rakhte hain ke Allah ne unhe woh bhi de diya hoga." Al-Awza'i ne kaha: mujhe Rabi'ah bin Yazid ne yeh hadith Al-Miqsilat aur Al-Jasa'ir ke darmiyan bayan ki.

e: [AI] From 'Abdullah bin Qatada Al-Sulami, who was one of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Allah created Adam, then He created the offspring from his back. He said, 'These are for Paradise, and I do not care,' and he said, 'These are for the Hellfire, and I do not care.' It was said, 'O Messenger of Allah, then what should we do?' He said, 'We should strive to follow destiny.'"
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Qatadah As-Sulami (RA) se riwayat hai, jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Allah ne Adam (AS) ko paida kiya, phir unki pusht se (baaki) makhlooq paida ki, phir farmaya: 'Yeh Jannat ke liye hain, aur mujhe koi parwah nahi,' aur farmaya: 'Yeh Jahannam ke liye hain, aur mujhe koi parwah nahi.'" Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), phir hum kis buniyaad par amal karein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Taqdeer ke mutabiq (jo tumhare liye muqarrar hai)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah is the Creator of every creator and their creations." According to a condition set by a Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah har banane wale aur uski banayi hui cheez ka Khaaliq (Paida karne wala) hai." Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah is the creator of every creator and their creations."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah har banane wale aur uski banayi hui cheez ka Khaaliq hai."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, we used to seek protection with it and use medicine for healing with it. Does it go against the decree of Allah, the Most High?" He said, "It is from the decree of Allah."
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum jo dam-jhaad karte the aur jo dawaiyan istemal karte the, kya woh Allah Ta'ala ki taqdeer ko badal sakti hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh bhi Allah ki taqdeer mein se hai."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, we used to practice ruqyah (healing through recitation) and seek treatment through medicines. Does that go against the qadr (predestination) of Allah?" He replied, "It is part of the qadr of Allah."
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum jo dam-jhaad karte the aur jo dawaiyan istemal karte the, kya woh Allah ki taqdeer ko badalti hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Allah ki taqdeer mein se hai."

e: [AI] I went to Aisha and said, "O Mother, tell me something you heard from the Messenger of Allah." She said, "The Messenger of Allah said, 'Birds fly according to their destiny, and he was pleased with good omens.'" The two Sheikhs (referring to Muslim and Bukhari) have provided evidence for this hadith from their narrators, except for Yusuf ibn Abi Burdah. And what I have is that they did not neglect it due to any criticism or weakness, but rather because of the scarcity of its narration. Indeed, it is a very valuable hadith, and they did not include it in their collections of hadiths, while it is authentic.
hi: Main Aisha (RA) ke paas gaya aur arz kiya: "Ammi jaan, mujhe koi baat sunaiye jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho." Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Parinde taqdeer ke mutabiq udte hain," aur aap (SAW) ko achha shugoon pasand tha. Shaykhain (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne is hadith ke tamam raawiyon ko hujjat mana hai, siwaye Yusuf bin Abi Burdah ke. Aur mera khayal hai ke unhone use kisi jarah (aib) ya za'af ki wajah se nahi chhoda, balke uski hadith ki kami ki wajah se, kyunke uski riwayat bohot kam hai.

e: ʿNo one (truly) believes until he believes in four things; until he believes that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah Who sent me with the truth, and until he believes in the resurrection after death, and until he believes in the divine will and decree.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 758)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Banda us waqt tak (sahih) momin nahi hota jab tak woh chaar baaton par Eman na laaye: yahan tak ke gawahi de ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool (SAW) hoon, jise usne haq ke sath bheja hai; aur maut ke baad dobara uthaye jane par Eman laaye; aur taqdeer par Eman laaye."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, Abu Hudhayfah Musa ibn Masood al-Nahdi, though al-Bukhari disputed this. However, al-Bukhari often jumps to conclusions and his judgments cannot be derived from Abu Asim al-Nabeel and Muhammad ibn Kathir and their contemporaries. An error is required if it contradicts them, and the evidence for what I have mentioned is the continuation of Jarir ibn Abdul Hamid al-Thawri's narration from Mansour from Rabi'i from Ali. Jarir is one of the most knowledgeable people in narrating from Mansour.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) Abu Hudhayfah Musa bin Mas'ood An-Nahdi - agarche Bukhari ne unse hujjat pakdi hai, lekin unse kasrat se wahm (galtiyan) hoti thi, unhe Abu Aasim An-Nabeel aur Muhammad bin Kathir jaise unke hum-asr logon par tarjeeh nahi di ja sakti, balke jab woh in se ikhtilaf karein to ghalti unhi ki maani jayegi. Iski daleel yeh hai ke Jareer bin Abdul Hamid Ath-Thawri ne Mansoor se, unhone Rib'i se, unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, isi riwayat ki mutaba'at (tasdeeq) ki hai, aur Jareer, Mansoor ki hadith ko sabse zyada pehchanne walon mein se hain.

e: ʿNo one (truly) believes until he believes in four things; until he believes that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah Who sent me with the truth, and until he believes in the resurrection after death, and until he believes in the divine will and decree.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 758)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Banda us waqt tak momin nahi hota jab tak woh chaar baaton par Eman na laaye: gawahi de ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, aur main Allah ka Rasool (SAW) hoon jise usne haq ke sath bheja hai; aur yeh ke maut ke baad (dobara) uthaya jana haq hai; aur mukammal taqdeer par Eman laaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The affair of this Ummah will continue to be successful or near success, as long as they do not discuss children and fate."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is Ummat ka maamla hamesha durust - ya farmaya: qareeb-qareeb durust - rahega, jab tak yeh log bachon (ki taqdeer) aur taqdeer ke baare mein guftagu na karein."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah has divided between you your characters just as he has divided between you your provisions. Allah gives worldly ˹provisions˺ to the one He loves and to the one whom He does not love, but He does not faith except to the one He loves."[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne tumhare darmiyan tumhari khasail (aadaten) yun taqseem ki hain jaise usne tumhare darmiyan tumhare rizq taqseem kiye hain. Aur Allah duniya (ka maal) us shakhs ko bhi deta hai jise woh pasand karta hai aur us shakhs ko bhi jise woh pasand nahi karta, magar Eman sirf us shakhs ko deta hai jise woh pasand karta hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Indeed, Allah has divided your manners as He has divided your provisions. And indeed, Allah gives wealth to those He loves and those He does not love. And He does not give faith except to those He loves. And when Allah loves a servant, He gives him faith. As for the narrator who is not mentioned in this book, he is Abd al-Aziz ibn Aban, and his hadith is known with it. It is authenticated by two narrators of Isa ibn Yunus, then by a narrator of al-Thawri from Zubaid, and he is Hamzah al-Zayyat." This was narrated by Abd al-Aziz ibn Aban, and it is not a condition of our book concerning al-Thawri.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne tumhare darmiyan tumhari khasail yun taqseem ki hain jaise usne tumhare darmiyan tumhare rizq taqseem kiye hain, aur Allah maal us shakhs ko bhi deta hai jise woh pasand karta hai aur us shakhs ko bhi jise woh pasand nahi karta, magar Eman sirf us shakhs ko deta hai jise woh pasand karta hai; aur jab Allah kisi bande se mohabbat karta hai to use Eman ata karta hai." (Aur jo mutabi' raawi is kitab ki shart par nahi hai woh Abdul Aziz bin Aban hain, aur yeh hadith unse mash'hoor hai. Yeh Isa bin Yunus ki do mutaba'aton se sahih sabit hoti hai, phir Ath-Thawri ki aik mutaba'at se, jo Zubaid se hai, aur woh Hamzah Az-Zayyat hain.)

e: [AI] I heard Kurz bin 'Alqamah saying, "A man asked the Prophet ﷺ, 'O Messenger of Allah, does Islam have a limit?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, 'Yes, whoever from the Arab or non-Arab people who Allah intends good for, He will enter Islam upon them. Then, the trials will occur like the darknesses.'" Muhammad bin Rashid and Yunus bin Yazid narrated this from Az-Zuhri, but they did not mention it to be solely narrated by 'Urwah while he was a companion.
hi: Maine Kurz bin Alqamah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: aik shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) se poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya Islam ki koi intaha (had) hai?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, jis bhi ghar wale, khwah Arab hon ya Ajami, ke sath Allah bhalai chahta hai, unhe Islam mein daakhil kar deta hai, phir fitne aise (chha jate hain) jaise saaye (ghatayen)." Muhammad bin Rashid aur Yunus bin Yazid ne Az-Zuhri se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikala, kyunke Urwah Kurz se akele riwayat karte hain, aur woh (Kurz) sahabi hain.

e: [AI] An Arab man said, "O Messenger of Allah, does Islam have a limit?" He replied, "Yes, whoever among the Arab or non-Arab people that Allah intends good for, He will enter Islam upon them. Then, the trials will occur to them like the darkness of the night."
hi: Aik Arab (dehati) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya Islam ki koi intaha hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, jis bhi ghar wale, khwah Arab hon ya Ajami, ke sath Allah bhalai chahta hai, unhe Islam mein daakhil kar deta hai, phir fitne aise (chha jate hain) jaise raat ka andhera."

e: [AI] Abu Ali Al-Janbi informed him that he heard Fadalah bin Ubaid telling that he heard the Prophet ﷺ saying: "Blessed is the one who is guided to Islam and his livelihood is sufficient and content."
hi: Abu Ali Al-Janbi ne bataya ke unhone Fadalah bin Ubaid (RA) ko yeh bayan karte hue suna ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Khush-naseeb hai woh shakhs jise Islam ki hidayat mili, uska guzr-bassar munasib tha aur woh usi par qana'at karta tha."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief, poverty, and the punishment of the grave."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Aye Allah, main kufr, mohtaji aur qabar ke azab se teri panah maangta hoon."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O people, I am only a bestowed mercy."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye logo, main to bas (Allah ki taraf se) bheji hui rahmat hoon."

e:
[AI] The translation of the provided Arabic text is:

Narrated to us: Faith was revealed before the Quran, and the surahs are revealed to Muhammad (pbuh), so that he may learn their permissibility and prohibition, and what should be emphasized in. Just as you know that you are the Quran." Then, he said, "I have seen men who are given the Quran and they read from the beginning to the end, not knowing what to do or what to avoid, or what to emphasize out of it. They scatter it like scattered seeds."
hi: Humein bataya gaya: "Eman Quran se pehle ata kiya jata tha, aur Muhammad (SAW) par (Quran ki) surah nazil hoti thi to woh uska halal aur haram seekhte aur jahan (ruk kar ghor karna) zaroori hota wahan thehrte, jaise tum khud Quran seekhte ho." Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine aise log dekhe hain ke unme se kisi ko Quran diya jata hai aur woh uski ibtida se intiha tak parh jata hai, magar use na uska hukum maloom hota hai na uski mumaana't (rok), na yeh maloom hota hai ke ismein kahan thehrna chahiye - woh use aise bikher deta hai jaise (bekaar) khajoor ke danon ko bikhera jaye."

e: " Six are cursed, being cursed by Allah and by every Prophet that came: The one who adds to Allah's Book, the one who denies Allah's Qadar, the one who rules with tyranny by which he honors whom Allah has debased, and he dishonors whom Allah has honored, and the one who legalizes what Allah forbade, and the one from my family who legalizes what Allah forbade, and the abandoner of my Sunnah." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2154)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chhe (qism ke log) hain jinpar maine la'nat ki hai, Allah aur har mustajaab-ud-dua Nabi bhi unpar la'nat karta hai: woh jo Allah ki taqdeer ko jhutlaye, jo Allah ki Kitab mein izafa kare, jo zulm-o-jabr se hukumat kare - jinhe Allah ne izzat di unhe zaleel kare aur jinhe Allah ne zaleel kiya unhe izzat de - jo Allah ki haram cheezon ko halal samjhe, jo meri Ahl-e-Bait mein se un cheezon ko halal samjhe jo Allah ne haram ki hain, aur jo meri Sunnat ko tark kare." (Bukhari ne Abdur Rahman bin Abi al-Mawal se hujjat pakdi hai...)

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet Muhammad and said, "O Muhammad, do you see a paradise as wide as the heavens and the earth? So, where is the fire?" The Prophet replied, "Have you not seen the night that covers everything? So, where does it put the day?" Allah knows best. The man said, "Indeed, Allah can do whatever He wills."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, aapne dekha, jannat jiski chaudai (wusaat) aasmanon aur zameen jitni hai, to phir jahannam kahan hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumne raat dekhi hai jo har cheez ko dhaank leti hai, to phir din kahan hota hai?" Usne kaha: "Allah behtar jaanta hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isi tarah Allah jo chahe karta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "I do not know whether Tubba' was a Prophet or not, and I do not know whether Dhul-Qarnayn was a Prophet or not, and I do not know whether the prescribed punishments (hudood) are expiations for the people or not."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata Tubba' Nabi tha ya nahi; aur mujhe nahi pata Zul-Qarnain Nabi tha ya nahi; aur mujhe nahi pata hudood (shar'i sazayen) unke ahl ke gunahon ka kaffara hain ya nahi."

e: When Allah fashioned Adam in Paradise, He left him as He liked him to leave. Then Iblis roamed round him to see what actually that was and when he found him hollow from within, he recognised that he had been created with a disposition that he would not have control over himself. (Using translation from Muslim 2611a)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah ne Adam (AS) ko banaya to unhe surat di aur jitna Allah ne chaha unhe Jannat mein chhoda rahne diya. Iblis unke gird chakkar lagane laga, jab usne unhe khokla (andar se khaali) paya to jaan liya ke yeh aisi makhlooq hai jo apne aap par qaboo nahi rakh sakti."

e: “You will most certainly follow the ways of those who came before you, arm’s length by arm’s length, forearm’s length by forearm’s length, hand span by hand span, until even if they entered a hole of a mastigure (lizard) you will enter it too.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, (do you mean) the Jews and the Christians?” He said: “Who else?” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3994)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum zaroor apne se pehle logon ke raste par chaloge, haath-bhar haath-bhar, gaz-bhar gaz-bhar, bitta-bhar bitta-bhar, yahan tak ke agar woh chhipkali ke bill mein bhi ghuse to tum bhi unke sath usi mein ghus jaoge." Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), (kya matlab) Yahood aur Nasara?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Phir aur kaun?"

e: [AI] I heard Al-Bara' bin 'Azib saying: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  for the funeral of a man from the Ansar. When we reached the grave, and it was about to be covered with soil, the Prophet ﷺ  sat down and looked towards the sky and the earth. He raised his gaze and lowered it three times, then he said, "O Allah! I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave." Then he said, "Verily, when a believing man is about to depart from this world and enter the Hereafter, angels with faces as bright as the sun descend upon him. They bring with them shrouds from Paradise and perfumes from Paradise. They sit with him as far as the eye can see." He said, "Then the angel of death comes to him and sits by
hi: Maine Al-Bara' bin Azib (RA) ko kehte hue suna: hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik Ansari shakhs ke janaze mein nikle. Hum qabar tak pahunche, abhi lahad nahi banayi gayi thi. (Ravi ne kaha:) hum Nabi (SAW) ke gird baith gaye, to aap (SAW) aasman ki taraf dekhne lage aur zameen ki taraf dekhne lage, aur teen martaba apni nazar upar utha kar neeche kar rahe the. Phir farmaya: "Aye Allah, main qabar ke azab se teri panah maangta hoon." Phir farmaya: "Beshak jab momin bandah aakhirat ki taraf mutawajjeh hota hai aur duniya se kat jata hai, to maut ka farishta (Malak-ul-Maut) aata hai aur uske sar ke paas baith jata hai, aur aasman se farishte utarte hain jinke chehre suraj ki tarah (roshan) hote hain, unke sath Jannat ke kafan aur Jannat ki khushbu hoti hai, aur woh jahan tak nazar jaye wahan tak (uske gird) baith jate hain. Malak-ul-Maut kehta hai: 'Aye itminaan wali rooh, Allah ki maghfirat aur raza ki taraf nikal aa.' (Ravi ne kaha:) to woh (rooh) is tarah nikalti hai jaise mashkeezay se qatra bahta hai. Woh use aik palak jhapakne bhar bhi apne haath mein nahi rakhte, balke usse aasman ki taraf le jate hain. Woh farishton ke jis bhi giroh ke paas se guzarte hain, woh kehte hain: 'Yeh kaunsi paak rooh hai?' To woh (le jane wale farishte) uska sabse acha naam lekar kehte hain: 'Fulan bin Fulan.' Jab woh aasman tak pahunchta hai to uske liye aasman ke darwaze khol diye jate hain, aur har aasman ke muqarrab farishte usse agle aasman tak pahunchate hain, yahan tak ke saatwe aasman tak pahunch jata hai. Phir kaha jata hai: 'Iska naamah-e-a'maal Illiyyeen mein likh do.' Phir kaha jata hai: 'Mere bande ko zameen ki taraf wapas bhejo, kyunke maine unse wada kiya hai ke maine unhe usi (zameen) se paida kiya, usi mein wapas bhejunga aur usi se dobara nikaalunga.' To uski rooh uske jism mein wapas bheji jati hai. Phir do farishte uske paas aakar puchte hain: 'Tera Rab kaun hai?' Woh kehta hai: 'Allah.' Woh puchte hain: 'Tera deen kya hai?' Woh kehta hai: 'Islam.' Woh puchte hain: 'Yeh kaun shakhs hai jo tum mein bheja gaya?' Woh kehta hai: 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW).' Woh puchte hain: 'Tumhe kaise pata chala?'
