Woh kehta hai: 'Maine Allah ki Kitab parhi, ussay Eman laaya aur tasdeeq ki.' Phir aasman se aik pukarne wala pukarta hai: 'Isne sach kaha, ise Jannat ka bistar bicha do, ise Jannat ka libaas pehnao aur ise Jannat mein uska thikana dikhao.' (Ravi ne kaha:) uski qabar ussay liye kushada kar di jati hai aur Jannat ki thandi hawa aur khushbu ussay tak pahunchti hai. Aur uske paas achhi shakl, achhe kapdon aur khushbudaar wala aik shakhs numaayan hota hai jo kehta hai: 'Khush ho jao us cheez se jo tumhe khush karegi, yeh woh din hai jiska tumse wada kiya jata tha.' Woh poochta hai: 'Tum kaun ho? Tumhari shakal to bhalai ki khushkhabri deti hai.' Woh kehta hai: 'Main tera nek amal hoon.' To woh kehta hai: 'Aye Rab, Qayamat qaim kar de taake main apne ghar walon aur apne maal ki taraf laut jaun.' Phir aap (SAW) ne yeh ayat parhi: 'Allah Eman walon ko is duniya ki zindagi mein aur aakhirat mein pukhta baat par saabit rakhta hai' (Surah Ibrahim 27). Lekin fajir (badkaar) shakhs jab aakhirat ki taraf mutawajjeh hota hai aur duniya se kat jata hai, to Malak-ul-Maut aata hai aur uske sar ke paas baith jata hai, aur kaale chehron wale farishte utarte hain jinke sath khurdare kambal hote hain, aur woh jahan tak nazar jaye wahan tak baith jate hain. Malak-ul-Maut kehta hai: 'Aye khabees (napaak) rooh, Allah ki naraazgi aur ghazab ki taraf nikal aa.' (Ravi ne kaha:) to woh (rooh) uske jism mein bikhar jati hai, aur uske sath ragein aur pathe is tarah tootte hain jaise geeli oon ko kaanton wale seekh se kheenchkar nikala jata hai. Woh us par jhapatte hain aur usse aik palak jhapakne bhar bhi apne haath mein nahi rakhte, balke usse aasman ki taraf le jate hain. Woh farishton ke jis bhi giroh ke paas se guzarte hain, woh kehte hain: 'Yeh kaunsi napaak rooh hai?' To woh kehte hain: 'Fulan,' uska sabse bura naam lekar. Jab usse aasman tak le jaya jata hai to uske aage aasmanon ke darwaze band kar diye jate hain. Kaha jata hai: 'Iska naamah-e-a'maal Sijjeen mein likh do.' Phir kaha jata hai: 'Mere bande ko zameen ki taraf wapas bhejo, kyunke maine unse wada kiya hai ke maine unhe usi se paida kiya, usi mein wapas bhejunga aur usi se dobara nikaalunga.' To uski rooh phenki jati hai yahan tak ke woh uske jism mein gir jati hai. Phir aap (SAW) ne yeh ayat parhi: 'Aur jo Allah ke sath shirk kare to goya woh aasman se gira aur usse parinde uchak le jayen ya hawa usse kisi door ki jagah phenk de' (Surah Al-Hajj 31). Phir do farishte uske paas aakar puchte hain: 'Tera Rab kaun hai?' Woh kehta hai: 'Mujhe nahi pata.' To aasman se aik pukarne wala pukarta hai: 'Isne jhoot kaha, ise Jahannam ka bistar bicha do, ise Jahannam ka libaas pehnao aur ise Jahannam mein uska thikana dikhao.' (Ravi ne kaha:) uski qabar us par tang kar di jati hai yahan tak ke uski paslian aik doosre mein ghus jati hain, aur Jahannam ki garmi aur badbu ussay tak pahunchti hai. Aur uske paas aik badsurat shakal, badsurat kapdon aur badbudaar shakhs numaayan hota hai, jo kehta hai: 'Khush ho jao us cheez se jo tumhe ranj degi, yeh woh din hai jiska tumse wada kiya jata tha.' Woh poochta hai: 'Tum kaun ho? Tumhari shakal to burai ki khabar deti hai.' Woh kehta hai: 'Main tera napaak amal hoon.' To woh kehta hai: 'Aye Rab, Qayamat qaim na kar.'"

e: [AI] From Abu Hurayrah, approximately from this narration, he wanted the narration of Al-Bara' except that he said, "Sleep like the believers sleep, and it is said to the wicked person, 'Sleep like the snoring one.' For there is no creature on the Earth except that it has a share in its body." This was narrated by Sufyan bin Sa'id, Shu'bah bin al-Hajjaj, and Zaidah bin Qudamah, who are the imams and preservers of the Ahmash. As for the narration of Thawri...
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se isi jaisi riwayat hai, ya'ni Al-Bara' ki hadith jaisi, magar unhone kaha: (momin ko kaha jata hai) 'Muttaqiyon ki neend so ja,' jabke pehle momin ke liye yeh alfaz the, aur fajir (badkar) se kaha jata hai: 'Nochi hui halat mein so ja,' kyunke zameen ka koi jaanwar aisa nahi jiska uske jism mein koi hissa na ho. Ise Sufyan bin Sa'eed, Shu'bah bin Al-Hajjaj aur Za'idah bin Qudamah ne riwayat kiya hai, jo Al-A'mash se riwayat karne wale hafiz imam hain. Baaqi raha Ath-Thawri ki hadith...

e: [AI] "We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a funeral procession until we reached the grave, and when no one was addressing the grave." And he mentioned the narration, as for the narration of Shu'bah."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik janaze mein nikle, hum qabar tak pahunche, abhi lahad nahi banayi gayi thi." (Aage) hadith ka zikr kiya. Aur Shu'bah ki hadith yeh hai...

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ  in the hadith of the grave, upon their condition, it has been extracted with the Manhal (a type of water source). As for the hadith of Zaidah
hi: Nabi (SAW) se qabar ki hadith mein (isi tarah riwayat hai) - yeh dono (Bukhari aur Muslim) ki shart par hai, kyunke inhone Al-Minhal se hujjat pakdi hai. Aur Za'idah ki hadith yeh hai...

e: [AI] "We prayed with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for the funeral of a man from the Ansar. Then he mentioned the hadith of the grave and its length."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik Ansari shakhs ke janaze ki namaz padhi," phir qabar ki poori hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  mentioned the believer and the disbeliever, and then mentioned a portion of the hadith of the grave. The authenticity of this hadith is evident by its origin and witness. Perhaps someone may mistakenly think that the hadith that"
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne momin aur kafir ka zikr kiya, phir qabar ki hadith ka aik hissa bayan kiya." Is hadith ki sehat (sahih hona) asal aur shahid (dono) se zahir ho chuki hai. Shayad koi ghalat-fahmi mein mubtala shakhs yeh samjhe ke jo hadith...

e: [AI] He said, "We went out with the messenger of Allah ﷺ  for the funeral of an Ansari man. When we reached the grave and it was being prepared, the messenger of Allah ﷺ  sat down and faced the qibla (the direction of prayer). We sat around him." Then he mentioned the hadith, "This hadith is explained in this way, and not like that. Indeed, the mention of Abu Al-Bakhtari in this hadith is a fabrication by Shuayb ibn Safwan, according to the consensus of the trustworthy narrators," in his narration from Yunus ibn Khubbab from Al-Minhali ibn Amr from Zadhan that he heard Al-Bara' narrate to us the authenticity of what I mentioned from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Nasr al-Khuldii dictating in Baghdad. 'Ali ibn Abd al-Aziz narrated to us from Ibrahim ibn Ziyad Sabalan, who narrated from Abbada ibn Abbada who said, "I came to Yunus ibn Khubbab in Mina by the minaret, and he was narrating. So I asked him about the hadith of the torment of the grave, and he narrated it to me."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik Ansari shakhs ke janaze mein nikle, hum qabar tak pahunche, abhi lahad nahi banayi gayi thi, to Rasulullah (SAW) baith gaye aur Qibla ki taraf mun kiya, aur hum aap (SAW) ke gird baith gaye," phir hadith ka zikr kiya. (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Is hadith mein aib nikala jata hai lekin baat aisi nahi hai, kyunke is hadith mein Abu Al-Bakhtari ka zikr Shu'aib bin Safwan ka wahm (galti) hai, kyunke sab thiqa imamon ka is baat par ittifaq hai" ke woh (Shu'aib) Yunus bin Khabbab se, unhone Al-Minhal bin Amr se, unhone Zaadhan se riwayat karte hain ke unhone Al-Bara' (RA) ko sunte hue riwayat ki. Jo kuch maine bayan kiya uski sehat humein Ja'far bin Muhammad bin Nasr Al-Khuldi ne Baghdad mein imla karte hue bataya, humein Ali bin Abdul Aziz ne bataya, humein Ibrahim bin Ziyad Sabalan ne bataya, humein Abbad bin Abbad ne bataya, unhone kaha: main Yunus bin Khabbab ke paas Mina mein, minaret ke paas gaya jabke woh qissa bayan kar rahe the, to maine unse qabar ke azab ki hadith ke baare mein poocha, to unhone mujhe woh hadith bayan ki.

e: [AI] "We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a funeral procession. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sat on the grave and we sat around him." And he mentioned the hadith in its entirety: "This is the authentic preserved hadith from the narration of Yunus ibn Khabbab." And thus Abu Khaled Ad-Dalani, Amr ibn Qais Al-Mulaiy, and Al-Hasan ibn Abdullah Al-Nakha'i narrated it from Minh'al ibn Amr. "As for the hadith of Abu Khaled Ad-Dalani..."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik janaze mein nikle, to Rasulullah (SAW) qabar par baith gaye aur hum aap (SAW) ke gird baith gaye," phir poori hadith ka zikr kiya. "Yehi Yunus bin Khabbab ki hadith se sahih aur mahfooz (yaad rakhi gayi) riwayat hai." Isi tarah Abu Khalid Ad-Dalani, Amr bin Qais Al-Mula'i aur Al-Hasan bin Abdullah An-Nakha'i ne bhi Al-Minhal bin Amr se riwayat ki hai. "Ab Abu Khalid Ad-Dalani ki hadith yeh hai..."

e: [AI] Regarding Minhal bin 'Amr: "And as for the narration of 'Amr bin Qais al-Mula'iyyah"
hi: Al-Minhal bin Amr se riwayat hai. "Ab Amr bin Qais Al-Mula'i ki hadith yeh hai..."

e: [AI] Concerning Al-Minhāl ibn 'Amr's narration, "As for the hadith of Al-Hasan ibn 'Ubaidillah..."
hi: Al-Minhal bin Amr se riwayat hai. "Ab Al-Hasan bin Ubaidullah ki hadith yeh hai..."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , the narrations that I mentioned, all of them are authentic according to the conditions of the two trustworthy sheikhs.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Yeh tamam asaneed jo maine zikr ki hain, sab Bukhari aur Muslim dono ki shart par sahih hain.

e: [AI] While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Bilal were walking in al-Baqi', the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Bilal, do you hear what I hear?" Bilal replied, "No, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah. I do not hear it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do you not hear the punishment of the inhabitants of the graves?"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aur Bilal (RA) Baqi' mein chal rahe the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Bilal, kya tum woh sun rahe ho jo main sun raha hoon?" Bilal (RA) ne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main nahi sun raha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum qabar walon ko azab diye jate hue nahi sun rahe?"

e: [AI] Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri entered upon the Messenger of Allah while he was wrapped in a Qatifa (a type of Yemeni garment made of wool) and he placed his hand on it and felt its heat above the Qatifa. Abu Sa'id said, "O Messenger of Allah, your cloak is very hot!" The Messenger of Allah said, "Indeed, we are inflicted with trials in this manner, and our reward is multiplied." Then Abu Sa'id asked, "O Messenger of Allah, who experiences the most severe trials?" The Messenger of Allah replied, "The prophets." Abu Sa'id asked again, "Then who?" He replied, "The scholars." Abu Sa'id asked once more, "Then who?" He replied, "Then the righteous." One of them would be tested with poverty to the extent that he could only find a garment to wear, and another would be tested with lice to the point of killing them. And none of them would be happier with trials than one of you would be with receiving gifts." Abu Al-Abbas narrated this to us from Bahar in the Musnad, and from Ar-Rabi' in Al-Fawaid, and I have combined both narrations.
hi: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hue jabke aap (SAW) ko bukhar tha aur aap (SAW) par aik moti chadar thi. Unhone apna haath us par rakha to chadar ke upar se hi (bukhar ki) garmi mehsoos ki. Abu Sa'id (RA) ne arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapke bukhar ki garmi kitni shadeed hai?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hum is tarah hain ke humpar azmaish sakht ki jati hai aur humare liye ajr (sawab) doguna kar diya jata hai." Phir unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), sabse zyada azmaish kis ki hoti hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ambiya (AS) ki." Unhone poocha: "Phir kis ki?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ulama ki." Unhone poocha: "Phir kis ki?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Phir nek (saleh) logon ki." Unmein se aik ko itni ghurbat (mohtaji) mein azmaya jata tha ke usse siwaye aik chadar ke, jo woh pehnta, kuch aur na milta, aur usse jooon (aisi susriyon) mein bhi azmaya jata yahan tak ke woh use maar dalen. Aur unmein se aik shakhs apni azmaish se utna khush hota jitna tum mein se koi ata (inaam) milne par khush hota hai. (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) Humein Abu al-Abbas ne Bahr se 'Al-Musnad' mein aur Ar-Rabi' se 'Al-Fawaid' mein bataya, aur maine dono ko jama kar diya hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was asked, "Who are the people who face the most severe trials?" He replied, "The prophets, then those who are most like them, then those who are most like them. When a person has strong faith, they are tested in accordance with their level of faith. And whoever has weak faith, will have weak trials."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Kaun log sabse zyada azmaish mein hote hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ambiya (AS), phir jo unke qareeb hon, phir jo unke qareeb hon. Jab koi shakhs deen mein mazboot hota hai to use uske deen ke mutabiq azmaya jata hai; jiska deen mazboot hota hai uski azmaish bhi shadeed hoti hai, aur jiska deen kamzor hota hai uski azmaish bhi kamzor hoti hai."

e: “I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, which people are most severely tested?’ He said: ‘The Prophets, then the next best and the next best. A person is tested according to his religious commitment. If he is steadfast in his religious commitment, he will be tested more severely, and if he is frail in his religious commitment, his test will be according to his commitment. Trials will continue to afflict a person until they leave him walking on the earth with no sin on him.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4023)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Sabse zyada azmaish kis ki hoti hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ambiya (AS) ki, phir jo unke qareeb hon, phir jo unke qareeb hon. Insaan ko uske deen ke hisab se azmaya jata hai; agar uska deen mazboot ho to uski azmaish shadeed hoti hai, aur agar uske deen mein narmi (kamzori) ho to uski azmaish bhi uske deen ke mutabiq hoti hai. Azmaish bande par (is tarah) laagu rehti hai yahan tak ke woh use is haal mein chhod deti hai ke woh zameen par chalta hai aur uspar koi gunah nahi hota."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "When the appointed term of one of you is near and Allah has granted him a need in a specific land, then when he reaches the furthest extent of his footsteps, he will die. On the Day of Resurrection, the earth will say, 'O Lord, this is what You entrusted to me.' The two trustworthy men, the sheikhs, have attested to the authenticity of this hadith, with their narrators ending with 'Umar ibn Ali al-Muqaddami, which is agreed upon to be included in Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim. Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Wahbi has also followed him in his chain of narration from Isma'il, based on their conditions."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ki maut kisi zameen mein muqarrar ho, to Allah uski koi zaroorat wahan paida kar deta hai, yahan tak ke jab woh apne aakhri qadam tak pahuncha jata hai to Allah uski rooh qabz kar leta hai. Phir Qayamat ke din woh zameen kahegi: 'Aye mere Rab, yeh woh hai jo tune mere paas amanat rakha tha.'" Shaykhain (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne is hadith ke tamam raawiyon ko hujjat mana hai, aur Umar bin Ali Al-Muqaddami par dono ki riwayat par ittifaq hai. Muhammad bin Khalid Al-Wahbi ne bhi isi sanad par Isma'il se mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "If anyone's buried body is in the ground, and the need of that person arises, he is allowed to be dug up. When the remains are taken out, the earth will say on the Day of Resurrection: 'O Lord, this is what You entrusted me with.' And this hadith is narrated by Hisham from Ismail ibn Abi Khalid."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ki maut kisi zameen mein muqarrar ho, to uski koi zaroorat wahan paida kar di jati hai, phir woh usi taraf jata hai, yahan tak ke uska aakhri qadam wahin hota hai aur uski rooh wahin qabz ki jati hai. To zameen Qayamat ke din kahegi: 'Aye Rab, yeh woh hai jo tune mere paas amanat rakha tha.'" Ise Husheim ne Isma'il bin Abi Khalid se sanad ke sath riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "When the term of one of you is near and he is in need of something in the land, Allah will fulfill it for him. Then on the Day of Resurrection, the earth will say, 'O Lord, this is what You entrusted to me.'" This hadith is supported by three trustworthy individuals reporting it from Isma'il, and Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah also agreed with them. We are adhering to the condition of excluding additional reports from trustworthy sources in the chain of narration, and for this hadith, there are further evidence supporting the condition of the two sheikhs. Among them is...
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ki maut kisi zameen mein muqarrar ho, to uske liye wahan koi zaroorat paida kar di jati hai, phir Allah use wahin poora (rooh qabz) karta hai. To zameen Qayamat ke din kahegi: 'Aye Rab, yeh woh hai jo tune mere paas amanat rakha tha.'" Teen thiqa raawiyon ne yeh hadith Isma'il se sanad ke sath riwayat ki hai, aur Sufyan bin Uyaynah ne bhi unki mutaba'at ki hai. Hum apni us shart par qaim hain jo humne kisi thiqa ki ziyadti ko mutasil sanad mein shamil karne ke liye rakhi hai. Phir is hadith ke Shaykhain ki shart par shawahid bhi hain, unmein se...

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said: "When Allah decrees death for a person in a certain place, He provides for him a need in that place." This is according to the condition of both.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah kisi shakhs ki maut kisi shehar mein muqarrar karta hai, to uske liye wahan koi zaroorat bana deta hai." Yeh dono ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Allah has not appointed a man to live on Earth except that He has made for him a need in it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne kisi shakhs ki maut kisi zameen mein nahi rakhi magar yeh ke uske liye wahan koi zaroorat bhi bana di."

e: "When Allah decrees that a slave (of His) is to die in a land, He makes him have some need from it." Another chain reports a similar narration. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2146)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah kisi bande ki rooh kisi zameen mein qabz karna chahta hai, to uske liye wahan koi zaroorat bana deta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The believer is honorable and generous, while the sinner is hypocritical and contemptible." This was narrated by Ibn Shihab, 'Abd Rabih ibn Nafi‘ al-Hannat and Yahya ibn al-Durays from al-Thawri during his stay. Hajjaj ibn Abid is acceptable.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin sadah-dil (bhola) aur karim (fayyaz) hota hai, aur fajir (badkaar) makkaar aur kamina hota hai." Ibn Shihab, Abdu Rabbihi bin Nafi' Al-Hannat aur Yahya bin Ad-Durais ne Ath-Thawri se, unki (Sufyan ki) is sanad ko qaim rakhte hue, mutaba'at ki hai. (Hajjaj ibaadat-guzar hai, koi harj nahi.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The believer is noble and generous, while the sinful one is humble and contemptible." As for the narration of Yahya ibn Dhirays, Muhammad ibn Humayd differs from it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin sadah-dil aur karim hota hai, aur fajir makkaar aur kamina hota hai." Baaqi raha Yahya bin Ad-Durais ki hadith, to usme Muhammad bin Humaid mukhtalif hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The believer is simple and generous, but the profligate is deceitful and ignoble. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4790)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin sadah-dil aur karim hota hai, aur fajir makkaar aur kamina hota hai."

e: [AI] To read to him and his son the book of instructions, I said, "When I go to Mina, I will tell you." So when I went to Mina, I took my book and told him. Then I went to Mecca for a visit, where I met Abu Usama who said to me, "O Yamani, that boy from Rawas deceived you." I said, "How did he deceive me?" He said, "You took your book to him and told him." I said, "It's not surprising that he deceived me." Barth narrated to me from Yahya bin Abi Kathir from Abu Salama from Abu Hurayrah who said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The believer is simple and generous while the evildoer is deceitful and ignoble." He then took out the singular narration and said, "Dictate to me." I said, "By Allah, I will not dictate it to you." So he left. I heard Ali bin Isa saying, "I heard Husayn bin Muhammad bin Ziyad saying, 'I heard Muhammad bin Yahya saying, 'Abu al-Asbat al-Harithi is Bashr bin Rafi'.''"
hi: (Mujhe hukum diya gaya) ke main use aur uske bete ko 'Kitab al-Wasaya' padh kar sunaun. Maine kaha: "Jab main Mina pahunchunga to bayan karunga." Jab main Mina pahuncha to main apni kitab lekar gaya aur usse hadith bayan ki. Phir main ziyarat ke liye Makkah gaya, to mujhe Abu Usama mile aur mujhse kaha: "Aye Yamani, us Ruwasi ladke ne tumhe dhoka diya." Maine kaha: "Usne mujhe kaise dhoka diya?" Unhone kaha: "Tumne apni kitab uske paas le jakar usse hadith sunayi." Maine kaha: "Isme koi ta'ajjub nahi ke woh mujhe dhoka de, kyunke mujhe Bishr bin Rafi' ne Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, unhone Abu Salama se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se bayan kiya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Momin sadah-dil aur karim hota hai, aur fajir makkaar aur kamina hota hai.'" Unhone (Ruwasi ladke ne) sirf yeh aik hadith nikali aur kaha: "Mujhe (baaki bhi) imla karao." Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main tumhe imla nahi karaunga," to woh chala gaya. (Ravi ne kaha:) maine Ali bin Isa ko kehte sunaa, unhone Husain bin Muhammad bin Ziyad ko kehte sunaa, unhone Muhammad bin Yahya ko kehte sunaa: "Abu al-Asbat Al-Harithi hi Bishr bin Rafi' hain."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The believer is simple and generous, but the profligate is deceitful and ignoble. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4790)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin sadah-dil aur karim hota hai, aur fajir makkaar aur kamina hota hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever kills a person who has a treaty with the Muslims unjustly, his smell will not reach Paradise, even though its fragrance can be smelled from a distance of five hundred years of travel."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs kisi ahd (mo'ahida/zimmi) waale insaan ko na-haq qatl kare, woh Jannat ki khushbu tak nahi paayega, halanke uski khushbu paanch sau saal ki masaafat se mehsoos ki jati hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Whoever kills a person who has a treaty with the Muslims, unjustly, Allah has made Paradise forbidden for him. The smell of its fragrance can be found from a distance of five hundred years." As for the saying of Yunus bin Ubaid on behalf of Al-Hakam bin Al-Araj
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo shakhs kisi ahd waale insaan ko na-haq qatl kare, Allah uspar Jannat haram kar deta hai ke woh uski khushbu bhi sunghe, jabke uski khushbu paanch sau saal ki masaafat se mehsoos ki jati hai." Ab Yunus bin Ubaid ki Al-Hakam bin Al-A'raj se riwayat ke bare mein jo kaha jata hai, woh yeh hai...

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone kills a man whom he grants protection prematurely, Allah will forbid him to enter Paradise. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2760)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs kisi ahd waale insaan ko na-haq qatl kare, Allah uspar Jannat haram kar deta hai."

e: [AI] There was a lazy man who used to enter upon the rulers and make them laugh. So my grandfather said to him, "Woe to you, O so-and-so! Why do you enter upon them and make them laugh? I have heard Bilal ibn Al-Harith Al-Muzani, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , narrate that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Verily, a servant may speak a word that pleases Allah, thinking it will not reach what it reached, and Allah is pleased with it for him until the Day of Resurrection. And indeed, a servant may speak a word that angers Allah, thinking it will not reach what it reached, and Allah is angered by it until the day he meets Him.'"
hi: Aik nikamma (fuzool) shakhs tha jo hukmaraanon ke paas jata aur unhein hansata tha. Mere dada ne usse kaha: "Afsos ho tum par, aye fulan, tum in logon ke paas kyun jate ho aur unhein hansate ho? Maine Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani (RA), jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain, ko yeh bayan karte hue suna ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak banda Allah ki raza wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, magar Allah usse raazi ho jata hai Qayamat ke din tak. Aur beshak banda Allah ki naraazgi wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, magar Allah usse naraaz ho jata hai us din tak jab woh usse milega.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A person may utter a word without thinking about its consequences, which displeases Allah. As a result, Allah writes His displeasure for him until the Day of Resurrection. Similarly, a person may speak a word without realizing its reach, which pleases Allah. Consequently, Allah records His pleasure for him until the day he meets Him." (Narrated by Isma'il ibn Ja'far)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak aadmi Allah ki naraazgi wali koi baat keh deta hai, use nahi pata hota ke uska itna asar hoga, to Allah uske liye apni naraazgi Qayamat ke din tak likh deta hai. Aur beshak aadmi Allah ki raza wali koi baat keh deta hai, use nahi pata hota ke uska itna asar hoga, to Allah uske liye apni raza us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega." (Ab Isma'il bin Ja'far ki hadith yeh hai...)

e: [AI] He heard the Prophet (pbuh) saying, "Indeed, one of you may speak a word that pleases Allah, not realizing how far it will reach, and Allah will write His pleasure with that word for him until the day he meets Him. And indeed, one of you may speak a word that angers Allah, not realizing how far it will reach, and Allah will write His anger with that word against him until the day he meets Him." (Reported by Muslim)
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak tum mein se koi Allah ki raza wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, to Allah uske liye apni raza us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega. Aur beshak tum mein se koi Allah ki naraazgi wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, to Allah uspar apni naraazgi us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega." (Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad ki hadith Muslim ne nikali hai.)

e: [AI] He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "Verily, one of you may speak a word that pleases Allah, thinking it will not reach the extent it has reached, so Allah records His pleasure with it until the day he meets Him, and indeed one of you may speak a word that angers Allah, not realizing its extent, so Allah records His anger with it until the day he meets Him."
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak tum mein se koi Allah ki raza wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, to Allah uske liye apni raza us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega. Aur beshak tum mein se koi Allah ki naraazgi wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, to Allah uspar apni naraazgi us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega."

e: A man with honor passed by him while he was in the city market and greeted him. Alqamah said to him, "O so-and-so, you have a heart and a right. I have seen you enter upon these princes and speak to them as Allah wills you to speak. I have heard Bilal ibn Al-Harith Al-Muzani, the companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), say: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Verily, one of you speaks a word from Allah's pleasure, not realizing how far it reaches, but Allah writes His Pleasure therewith until the Day he shall meet Him. And verily, one of you speaks a word from Allah's displeasure, not realizing how far it reaches, but Allah writes His displeasure therewith until the Day he shall meet Him.'" Alqamah said, "Woe to you! Consider what you say and what you speak. Much of what I have heard from Bilal ibn Al-Harith has prevented me from what you are saying. Malik ibn Anas also shortened the narration of this Hadith from Muhammad ibn Amr, and did not mention Alqamah ibn Waqqas."
hi: Aik izzat-dar shakhs unke paas se guzra, jabke woh Madinah ke bazar mein the, aur usne unhein salaam kiya. Alqamah ne usse kaha: "Aye fulan, tumhara mujh par rishtay ka aur haq ka ta'alluq hai, aur maine tumhe dekha hai ke tum in hukmaraanon ke paas jate ho aur unke saamne Allah jo chahe bulwaye, woh baatein karte ho. Maine Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani (RA), jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain, ko kehte hue suna, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak tum mein se koi Allah ki raza wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, to Allah uske liye apni raza us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega. Aur beshak tum mein se koi Allah ki naraazgi wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, to Allah uspar apni naraazgi us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega.'" Alqamah ne kaha: "Afsos ho tumpar, dekho tum kya kehte ho aur kya baat karte ho? Kayi baar aisi baat hoti hai jo mujhe rok deti hai, kyunke maine woh Bilal bin Al-Harith se suna hai." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Malik bin Anas ne yeh hadith Muhammad bin Amr se riwayat karte hue mukhtasar bayan ki hai aur Alqamah bin Waqqas ka zikr nahi kiya."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi praised what was recited on Malik, and Abu Bakr ibn Ishaq informed us that Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Ziyad informed us that Ibn Abi Uwais narrated to us that Malik reported from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Alqamah from his father from Bilal ibn Al-Harith Al-Muzani that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, a person may speak a word from the pleasure of Allah, not realizing its significance, and Allah will record His pleasure for him with it until the day he meets Him. And indeed, a person may speak a word of Allah's anger, not realizing its significance, and Allah will record His anger for him with it until the day he meets Him."
hi: Al-Qa'nabi ne bayan kiya, jo Malik par parha gaya, aur humein Abu Bakr bin Ishaq ne bataya, unhone kaha: humein Al-Hasan bin Ali bin Ziyad ne bataya, unhone kaha: humein Ibn Abi Uwais ne bataya, mujhe Malik ne Muhammad bin Amr bin Alqamah se, unhone apne walid se, unhone Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani (RA) se bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak aadmi Allah ki raza wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, to Allah uske liye apni raza us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega. Aur beshak aadmi Allah ki naraazgi wali aisi baat keh deta hai jiske itna asar ka use gumaan bhi nahi hota, to Allah uske liye apni naraazgi us din tak likh deta hai jab woh usse milega."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Woe to him who tells things, speaking falsely, to make people laugh thereby. Woe to him! Woe to him!. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4990)
hi: Maine Nabiyullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Halaakat ho us shakhs ke liye jo (koi) baat karta hai aur jhoot bolta hai taake log uspar hansen. Halaakat ho uske liye, halaakat ho uske liye!"

e: [AI] O Messenger of Allah, Omar said, "I heard so-and-so mentioning and praising you, claiming that you gave him two dinars." The Prophet replied, "But that is not true. However, Omar, he did receive a sum of money from me, ranging between one hundred to ten." Then he said, "And indeed, one of you may come to me with their request, and I will give it to them while holding firmly onto it." Ahmad or someone similar said, "And it is nothing but fire." Omar then said, "O Messenger of Allah, why did you give them?" He replied, "What can I do? They ask of me and Allah refuses to make me stingy."
hi: Umar (RA) ne arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine fulan ko sunaa hai ke woh khair ka zikr karke aapki tareef kar raha tha, uska gumaan hai ke aapne usse do dinar diye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, fulan aisa nahi kehta, aur usne to mujhse dus se sau (dinar) ke darmiyan koi raqam paayi hai." Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur tum mein se koi mere paas se apna sawaal (maang) bagal mein daba kar nikalta hai." Ahmad ne kaha ya isi jaisa: "Aur woh (raqam) sirf aag hai." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), phir aap unhe kyun dete hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main kya karoon? Yeh log mujhse maangte hain, aur Allah mujhe bakhili (kanjoosi) karne se rok deta hai."

e: [AI] Two men entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and asked him for something. So, he prayed for them with two dinars. And then they praised him for the good fortune. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "However, so-and-so did not say that, and I have given him between ten and one hundred. What he says does not matter, for one of you may give in charity (sadaqah) from me and hold it tightly, but it is only for him a fire." So, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, how do you give him knowing that it is only a fire for him?" He said, "What can I do? They only ask me, and Allah does not like me to be miserly." "As for Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman ar-Raqqi, they did not bring him out, but Muslim ibn Abdillah ibn Bashr ar-Raqqi reported it, except that this hadith is not the cause for the hadith of al-A'mash from Abu Salih, for indeed he has another chain of narration serving as a witness for him."
hi: Do aadmi Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur aap (SAW) se kuch maanga, to aap (SAW) ne unke liye do dinar mangwaye, phir woh dono (aap SAW ki) tareef karne lage. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Lekin fulan aisa nahi kehta, halanke maine usse dus se sau (dinar) ke darmiyan diya hai, phir bhi woh aisa nahi kehta. Beshak tum mein se koi mere paas se sadaqah lekar bagal mein dabaye nikalta hai, jabke woh uske liye sirf aag hai." Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap use kyun dete hain jabke aap jaante hain ke yeh uske liye aag hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main kya karoon? Yeh log mujhse maangne se baaz nahi aate, aur Allah mujhe bakhili se rokta hai." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Rahi baat Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman Ar-Raqqi ki, to inhone (Bukhari-Muslim) usse riwayat nahi nikali, aur Muslim ne Abdullah bin Bishr Ar-Raqqi se riwayat nikali hai, magar yeh hadith Al-A'mash ki Abu Salih waali hadith ke liye aib nahi banti, kyunke yeh dusri sanad se uski shahid (tasdeeq) hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "It is not appropriate for a believer to be foul-mouthed."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ke liye munasib nahi ke woh bohot la'nat karne wala ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "It is not becoming for a Muslim to be foul-mouthed." Salim said, "I have never heard Ibn Umar curse anything."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman ke liye munasib nahi ke woh bohot la'nat karne wala ho." Salim ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Umar (RA) ko kabhi kisi cheez par la'nat karte nahi suna."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "It is not possible for you to be backbiters and at the same time be sincere friends." This was followed by Isra'il ibn Yunus, who narrated it from Abu Hasin.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh mumkin nahi ke tum la'nat karne wale bhi ho aur sachche (imandaar dost) bhi." Isra'il bin Yunus ne Abu Hasin se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "It is not possible for you to be both foul-mouthed and true friends."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh mumkin nahi ke tum la'nat karne wale bhi ho aur sachche dost bhi."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Those who frequently curse will not be witnesses or intercessors." "Muslim reported it with this wording." This is reported by Muslim.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Bohot la'nat karne wale na gawah ban sakte hain na sifarish karne wale." Muslim ne ise isi lafz ke sath riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Do not curse with the curse of Allah, or with the anger of Allah, or with the fire." "These are the hadiths that he mentioned in this chapter, all of them are authentic in their chains of narration." Its chain of narration is authentic.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aapas mein aik doosre par Allah ki la'nat, Allah ke ghazab ya jahannam ki la'nat na bhejo." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Is baab mein jitni riwayaten mukhtalif alfaz ke sath naql hui hain, sab ki sanad sahih hai."

e: that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Indeed, Allah is generous, he loves those of elevated character and dislikes those of inferior ˹character˺.”
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak Allah karim hai, sakhawat ko pasand karta hai aur baland akhlaq ko pasand karta hai, aur ghatiya akhlaq ko napasand karta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah is generous and loves generosity and noble manners, and despises obscenity."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah karim hai, sakhawat aur baland akhlaq ko pasand karta hai, aur ghatiya akhlaq se nafrat karta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah is generous and loves generosity and noble deeds, and He hates vulgarity or indecency." This does not weaken the narration of Sahl ibn Sa'd on what I have mentioned earlier regarding accepting additional information from trustworthy individuals, and Allah knows best.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah karim hai, sakhawat aur baland kaamon ko pasand karta hai, aur ghatiya (kaamon) ko napasand - ya farmaya: nafrat - karta hai." Yeh Sahl bin Sa'd ki hadith ko kamzor nahi karta, jaisa ke maine pehle bayan kiya hai ke thiqa raawiyon ki ziyaadti qubool ki jati hai, wallahu a'lam.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  once met a Bedouin man wearing a cloak made of camel hair, blindfolded with a dirty piece of cloth. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Your companion here wants to elevate every shepherd and their son, and to bring down every nobleman and their son." The Prophet ﷺ  then stood and sat down, and said, "When death was near for Prophet Noah ﷺ , he called his sons and said to them, 'I will give you some advice. I command you with two things and forbid you from two things. I command you to avoid associating partners with Allah and to avoid pride. And I command you to believe in the oneness of Allah, for if the heavens and the earth and everything in them were to be put on one side of a weighing scale, and the statement 'La ilaha illa Allah' (there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah) was to be put on the other side, the latter would outweigh them. And if the heavens and the earth and everything in them were to be turned into a ring and this statement was to be placed on it, it would shatter them." And the Prophet ﷺ  concluded by saying, "I command you to glorify Allah and to praise Him, as it is the prayer for everything and through it everything is provided."
hi: Aik dehati Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya, uspar taialisan (dhaari-daar) jubbah tha jiske kinare reshmi kaam se sanwaray hue the. Usne kaha: "Yeh tumhara saathi (Rasool) har charwahe aur charwahe ke bete ko upar utha dena chahta hai aur har sawaar aur sawaar ke bete ko neeche gira dena chahta hai." Nabi (SAW) (jo baithe hue the) khade huay, phir baith gaye, aur farmaya: "Jab Nuh (AS) ki wafat ka waqt aaya to unhone apne do beton ko bulaya aur farmaya: 'Main tumhein wasiyat sunata hoon: tumhein do baaton ka hukum deta hoon aur do baaton se rokta hoon. Main tumhein shirk aur takabbur se rokta hoon, aur tumhein La ilaha illallah ka hukum deta hoon, kyunke agar aasmaan, zameen aur unke andar jo kuch hai woh taraazu ke aik pallay mein rakha jaye aur La ilaha illallah doosre pallay mein rakha jaye, to yeh (kalima) un dono se bhaari ho jayega. Aur agar aasmaan, zameen aur unke andar jo kuch hai woh aik halqe (chhalle) ki tarah ho jayen aur La ilaha illallah unpar rakha jaye, to woh unhein tod dega. Aur main tumhein Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi ka hukum deta hoon, kyunke yeh har cheez ki namaz hai, aur isi ke zariye har cheez ko rizq milta hai.'"

e: [AI] "A man said to the Prophet ﷺ, 'I have never seen a man who gave more to the shepherd of sheep than Muhammad, and then he mentioned him in a way similar to Sahih Al-Isnad.'"
hi: Aik shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Maine Muhammad (SAW) se zyada bakriyon ke charwahe ko dene wala koi shakhs nahi dekha." Phir unhone isi jaisi baat ka zikr kiya. Sanad sahih hai.

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Indeed, the punishment of this Ummah (nation) has been placed in its worldly life.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak is Ummat ka azab (sirf) uski duniya mein rakha gaya hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "The punishment of my ummah (nation) is in this world."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Meri Ummat ka azab uski duniya mein hai."

e: [AI] The plague was mentioned in front of Abu Musa al-Ash'ari. He said that we asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about it, and he said, "Your brothers or your enemies from the jinn, and it is their destruction, is a testimony."
hi: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) ke paas ta'oon (plague) ka zikr hua to unhone kaha: "Humne is baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Yeh tumhare bhai' - ya farmaya: 'tumhare dushman' - 'jinnat mein se hain, aur yeh tumhare liye shahadat hai.'"

e: [AI] This phrase, "عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُعلى شرط مسلم" translates to "From the Prophet ﷺ like it upon the condition of a Muslim."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever plays backgammon has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3762)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs 'nard' (chausar/backgammon) khele usne Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki na-farmani ki."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever plays with dice or says by the dice, he has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger." "And this is not a weak Hadith nor is it excusable, as Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn al-Had narrated it from Sa'id ibn Abi Hind."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs pansay (kauri/dice) se khele - ya farmaya: kauriyon se - usne Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki na-farmani ki." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Yeh baat Nafi' ki hadith ko kamzor nahi karti aur na hi ismein koi aib daalti hai, kyunke Yazid bin Abdullah bin Al-Had ne Nafi' ki, Sa'eed bin Abi Hind ki riwayat par, mutaba'at ki hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  mentioning during his presence that "Whoever hits the dice, he is playing with that which disobeys Allah and His Messenger."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko suna jabke unke saamne 'nard' (chausar) ka zikr hua: "Jo koi iski kauriyon se khelte hue haath maare, usne Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki na-farmani ki, Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki na-farmani ki."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, the best of Allah's worshippers are those who pay attention to the sun, moon, stars, and shadows for the remembrance of Allah." Basheer ibn Musa said, "This hadith was not found with al-Humaidi in his Musnad. This is an authentic chain of narration and Abdul-Jabbar al-Attar is trustworthy. Muslim and Bukhari have relied on Ibrahim al-Sikassiki's narration, and if there is such correctness, it is not harmed by the criticism of those who have corrupted its chain of narration." The chain of narration is authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ke behtareen bande woh hain jo Allah ki yaad ke liye suraj, chand, sitaron aur saayon ka khayal rakhte hain." Bishr bin Musa ne kaha: "Yeh hadith Al-Humaidi ke paas unke Musnad mein nahi thi. Yeh sanad sahih hai, aur Abdul Jabbar Al-Attar thiqa (mo'tabar) hain, aur Muslim aur Bukhari dono ne Ibrahim As-Saksaki se hujjat pakdi hai, aur jab aisi durustagi sahih ho jaye to jo koi iski sanad mein aib nikale, uska koi nuqsan nahi hota."

e: [AI] "And Abu al-Muwajjah informed us that Abdan reported from Abdullah who reported from Mis'ar, from Ibrahim al-Saksaki, who said: Our companions narrated to us from Abu al-Darda, that he said: Indeed, the most beloved of Allah's servants to Allah are those who make Allah beloved to people and those who show respect to the sun and the moon. This does not corrupt the first narration nor does it invalidate it, for Ibn Uyainah is a reliable memorizer (hafiz) and so is Ibn al-Mubarak, except that he has also brought other chains of narration similar to the meaning of the first hadith."
hi: Humein Abu Al-Muwajjah ne bataya, unhein Abdan ne bataya, unhein Abdullah ne Mis'ar se, unhone Ibrahim As-Saksaki se bataya, unhone kaha: humein hamare saathiyon ne Abu Ad-Darda (RA) se bayan kiya ke unhone kaha: "Allah ke sabse aziz bande woh hain jo logon mein Allah ki mohabbat paida karte hain, aur woh jo suraj aur chand ka khayal rakhte hain." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Yeh pehli riwayat ko kharab nahi karta aur na hi ismein koi aib daalta hai, kyunke Ibn Uyainah thiqa hafiz hain, aur isi tarah Ibn Al-Mubarak bhi, sirf itna hai ke unhone doosri asaneed bhi laayi hain jo pehli hadith ke hum-ma'ni hain."

e: [AI] Abu Al-Nadr Al-Faqih and Abu Al-Hasan Al-Anbari said: Uthman bin Sa'id Al-Darimi narrated to us, and Ahmad bin Ya'qub Al-Thaqafi narrated to me, then Muhammad bin Ayyub said, they all said: Muhammad bin Al-Subbah narrated to me from Sa'id bin Abdul Rahman Al-Jumahii from Ubaidullah bin Umar, he said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "Advise me." He said, "Worship Allah and do not associate anything with Him, establish prayer, pay zakat, fast in the month of Ramadan, perform Hajj and Umrah, listen and obey."
hi: Humein Abu An-Nadr Al-Faqih aur Abu Al-Hasan Al-Anbari ne bataya, unhone kaha: humein Uthman bin Sa'eed Ad-Darimi ne bataya, aur mujhe Ahmad bin Ya'qub Ath-Thaqafi ne bataya, unhein Muhammad bin Ayyub ne bataya, unhone (sab ne) kaha: humein Muhammad bin As-Sabbah ne bataya, humein Sa'eed bin Abdur Rahman Al-Jumahi ne Ubaidullah bin Umar se, unhone Nafi' se, unhone Ibn Umar (RA) se bataya, unhone kaha: aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur kaha: "Mujhe naseehat kijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki ibadat karo aur uske sath kisi ko shareek na thehrao, namaz qaim karo, zakat do, Ramzan ke roze rakho, Baitullah ka Hajj karo, umrah karo, suno aur (hukum) maano."

e: [AI] "And Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and you establish prayer, and give zakah, and fast in the month of Ramadan, and perform Hajj to the House, and you adhere to transparency and avoid secrecy, and you refrain from anything that you feel ashamed of." He (Umar) said, "When you meet Allah, say: 'O Allah, You commanded me with this, and Umar ibn al-Khattab said to me, 'O Abdullah, hold onto this.' So when you meet Allah, the Most High, say: 'What appears to You.'" Al-Qabbani said, "I asked Muhammad ibn Yahya, which narration is preserved - the narration of Yunus from al-Hasan from Umar, or the narration of Nafi from Ibn Umar?" So Muhammad ibn Yahya said, "The narration of al-Hasan is more similar."
hi: "Aur (gawahi do) ke Muhammad (SAW) Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz qaim karo, zakat do, Ramzan ke roze rakho, Baitullah ka Hajj karo, aur khule-aam (achhe kaam) karo, chhupkar (bure kaam) karne se bacho, aur har us cheez se bacho jiski tumhein sharam aati ho." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum Allah se milo to kaho: mujhe Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne yeh hukum diya tha." Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abdullah, isse pakde raho, aur jab tum Allah Ta'ala se milo to jo tumhare dil mein aaye kaho." Al-Qabbani ne kaha: maine Muhammad bin Yahya se poocha: "Kaunsi riwayat mahfooz hai - Yunus ki, Al-Hasan se, Umar (RA) se, ya Nafi' ki, Ibn Umar (RA) se?" To Muhammad bin Yahya ne kaha: "Al-Hasan ki riwayat zyada mushabeh (milti-julti) hai."

e: No, by my father. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Stop it! whoever swears by anything other than Allah has committed an act of shirk.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 329)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne baap-dada ki qasam na khao, jo shakhs Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki qasam khaaye usne shirk kiya."

e: [AI] Omar used to swear by his father, so the Prophet ﷺ  forbade him from doing so, and he said, "Whoever swears by anything other than Allah has committed shirk (associating partners with Allah)." The other person said, "So it is a form of shirk."
hi: Umar (RA) apne baap ki qasam khaya karte the, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein rok diya aur farmaya: "Jo shakhs Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki qasam khaaye usne shirk kiya." Aur dusre (raawi) ne kaha: "Yeh shirk hai."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Whoever swears by someone other than Allah has committed disbelief."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki qasam khaaye, usne kufr kiya."

e: the Messenger of Allah Prophet ﷺ said: Hesitation and shyness ˹in speech˺ are two branches of Iman, ˹while˺ crudeness and antipathy are two branches of hypocrisy.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kam-goi (kum bolna) aur haya, Eman ki do shaakhein hain, aur badzabani aur sakhti (be-rukhi), nifaq ki do shaakhein hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Modesty is a part of faith, and faith is in Paradise. Indecency is a part of rudeness, and rudeness is in Hell." "And he has two reliable witnesses on the condition of a Muslim." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haya Eman mein se hai, aur Eman Jannat mein (le jane wala) hai; aur badzabani sakhti mein se hai, aur sakhti Jahannam mein (le jane wali) hai." Iska dusra shahid bhi Muslim ki shart par hai. Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: “Modesty is part of faith, and faith will be in Paradise. Obscenity in speech is part of harshness and harshness will be in Hell.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4184)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haya Eman mein se hai, aur Eman Jannat mein hai; aur badzabani sakhti mein se hai, aur sakhti Jahannam mein hai."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi narrated, who narrated from Yazid ibn Zuray', who was informed by Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Shaybani, who narrated from Yahya ibn Yahya, who narrated from Mousaddad, who narrated from Yazid ibn Zuray', who narrated from Khalid al-Hadha', who narrated from Abu Qilabah, who narrated from Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her, who said: "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'The most perfect believers in faith are those with the best character, and the kindest to their families.'" The narrators of this hadith, from its end, are trustworthy according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, and they did not mention this wording. This hadith has a gap.
hi: Al-Qa'nabi ne humein bataya, unhein Yazid bin Zurai' ne bataya, aur humein Muhammad bin Ya'qub Ash-Shaybani ne bataya, unhein Yahya bin Yahya ne bataya, humein Musaddad ne bataya, unhein Yazid bin Zurai' ne Khalid Al-Hadhdha se, unhone Abu Qilabah se, unhone Aisha (RA) se bataya, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse mukammal Eman waale momin woh hain jinka akhlaq sabse achha ho aur jo apne ghar walon ke sath sabse nazuk-mizaaj (narm-dil) hon." Is hadith ke tamam raawi aakhir tak Shaykhain ki shart par thiqa hain, magar unhone ise is lafz ke sath nahi nikala. Ismein inqita' (sanad mein kami) hai.

e: [AI] Translation: "Quraysh people said to the Prophet ﷺ , 'Call upon your Lord to make Safa a gold for us, and we will believe in you.' The Prophet replied, 'Will you really do that?' They said, 'Yes.' So he supplicated, and then Gabriel came to him and said, 'Verily, Allah sends His greetings upon you and says, "If you wish, I can make Safa turn into gold, but whoever disbelieves after that, I will punish him with a punishment that I do not inflict upon anyone in the worlds. And if you wish, I can open for them the doors of repentance and mercy."' The Prophet said, 'Rather, it is the door of repentance and mercy.'"
hi: Quraish ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Apne Rab se dua kijiye ke Safa (pahaad) ko humare liye sona bana de, to hum aap par Eman le aayenge." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum waqai aisa karoge?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To aap (SAW) ne dua ki, phir Jibra'il (AS) aap (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Beshak Allah aap par salaam bhejta hai aur farmata hai: agar aap chahen to Safa sona ban jaye, phir jo iske baad kufr kare, main use aisa azab dunga jo maine duniyaon mein kisi ko nahi diya; aur agar aap chahen to main unke liye tauba aur rahmat ke darwaze khol dun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza (hi behtar hai)."

e: [AI] From Salamah ibn Kuhayl and Imran ibn Al-Hakam Al-Sulami, both being senior followers who considered this hadith as a weak one. They neglected this hadith and Allah knows best that there are contradictions in the chain narrated by Yahya ibn Salamah ibn Kuhayl, who is known to have many misconceptions compared to his father.
hi: Salamah bin Kuhail aur Imran bin Al-Hakam As-Sulami se (riwayat hai) - yeh aik bade Tabi'i hain jinki riwayat hujjat mani jati hai - lekin in dono ne is hadith ko chhod diya, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai, iski wajah Yahya bin Salamah bin Kuhail ki sanad mein paayi jaane wali ikhtilaf hai, aur Yahya apne walid ke muqable mein kasrat se wahm (galtiyan) karte hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "What are you doing?" They said, "We are doing well." So Jibril came and said, "Be firm." Then Jibril came and said, "O Muhammad, indeed Allah has given you what you asked for. If you wish, the mountain of Safa will turn into gold for you, and whoever disbelieves after that, I will punish them with a punishment that I will not inflict on anyone in the world. And if you wish, I will open for them the door of repentance and submission." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The door of repentance and mercy is more beloved to me." "This confusion does not weaken the narration of Ath-Thawri, for I do not know Imran ibn Al-Ja'd among the followers, and Ismail ibn Abi Khalid only narrated from Imran ibn Al-Ja'd. As for Imran ibn Al-Ja'd, he is from the followers."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum waqai aisa karoge?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To Jibra'il (AS) aaye aur kaha: "Pakka iraada kar lo." Phir Jibra'il (AS) dobara aaye aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, Allah ne aapko woh de diya jo aapne maanga tha: agar aap chahen to Safa aapke liye sona ban jaye, aur jo iske baad kufr kare, main use aisa azab dunga jo maine duniyaon mein kisi ko nahi diya; aur agar aap chahen to main unke liye tauba aur rujoo ka darwaza khol dun." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza mujhe zyada pasand hai." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Yeh wahm Ath-Thawri ki hadith ko kamzor nahi karta, kyunke mujhe Tabi'in mein Imran bin Al-Ja'd ka koi ilm nahi, balke Isma'il bin Abi Khalid ne Imran bin Abi Al-Ja'd se riwayat ki hai. Rahi baat Imran bin Al-Ja'd ki, to woh Tabi'in ke baad wale (Atba' at-Tabi'in) mein se hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever commits a bad deed and dislikes it while doing it, and performs a good deed and feels happy about it, then he is a believer."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs koi burai kare aur karte waqt use napasand kare, aur koi neki kare aur usse khush ho, to woh momin hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Abu Dharr, fear Allah wherever you are, and follow a bad deed with a good deed, as it will erase it, and treat people with good manners."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Dharr (RA), jahan bhi ho Allah se daro, aur burai ke baad neki karo, woh use mita degi, aur logon ke sath achhe akhlaq se pesh aao."

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, advise me." He said, "Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him." He said, "O Messenger of Allah, tell me more." He said, "If you do evil, then do good." He said, "O Messenger of Allah, tell me more." He said, "Be upright and strive to improve your character."
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe naseehat kijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki ibadat karo aur uske sath kisi ko shareek na thehrao." Usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe aur bataiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum burai karo to (uske baad) neki karo." Usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe aur bataiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Seedhe raho aur apne akhlaq ko behtar banao."

e: [AI] "He who commits a sin and then repents from it, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'O Allah, if You forgive, forgive abundantly, for there is no servant of Yours who does not sin.'"
hi: Yeh (murad) hai ke aadmi buri harkat (bad-fe'li) kare phir uski tauba kare. (Ravi ne kaha:) aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, agar tu maaf kare to bohot maaf kar, aur tera kaunsa banda hai jo gunah na kare?"

e:
[AI] The one who acknowledges their sin and then leaves it behind, don't you hear the words of the poet [in Al-Bahr Al-Rajz]:

"If you forgive, O Allah, you forgive a multitude,
And no servant is like You, when he doesn't sin."

And this narration does not weaken the first evidence, as Zakariya ibn Ishaq is a trustworthy and reliable narrator, and Rawh ibn Ubada narrated from Zakariya. And I have mentioned in the conditions of this book the exclusion of interpretations from the companions.
hi: Woh jo gunah ko chhoo jata hai phir usse chhod deta hai. Kya tumne shaayar ka yeh sher nahi suna: "Agar tu maaf kare aye Allah to bohot maaf kar, aur tera kaunsa banda hai jo gunah na kare?" Yeh (bayan) pehli sanad ko kamzor nahi karta, kyunke Zakariya bin Ishaq thiqa hafiz hain, aur Rauh bin Ubadah ne Zakariya se yeh hadith bayan ki hai. Aur maine is kitab ki shuroot mein zikr kiya hai ke Sahaba (RA) se aayi hui tafseer (is kitab mein) shamil nahi ki jayegi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "All my Ummah (followers) will enter Paradise except those who refuse." They asked, "Who would refuse, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Those who disobey me, they are the ones who refuse."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri saari Ummat Jannat mein dakhil hogi, siwaye us shakhs ke jo inkaar kare." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), inkaar kaun karega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne meri na-farmani ki, usne inkaar kar diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "You will not enter Paradise except those who refuse and wander astray from the path of Allah, like the stray camel." And he has another witness from Abu Umamah Al-Bahili.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum zaroor Jannat mein dakhil hoge, siwaye us shakhs ke jo inkaar kare aur Allah se aise bhaag jaye jaise unt bhaagta hai." Iska aik aur shahid Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (RA) se bhi milta hai.

e: [AI] Ali heard a word from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'All of you will enter Paradise except for those who transgress against Allah like the wandering camel against its people.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: (Unse) sabse narm baat ke baare mein poocha gaya jo unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se suni thi, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Tum sab Jannat mein dakhil hoge, siwaye us shakhs ke jo Allah se aise bhaag jaye jaise unt apne malik se bhaagta hai." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Verily, Allah has one hundred portions of mercy, of which He has distributed one portion among His creation in this world. Through this small portion, His creatures experience love, kindness, and mercy. Allah has kept ninety-nine portions of mercy for the Day of Resurrection, where He will shower His beloved servants with His immense mercy."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ki sau rahmatein hain, unme se aik rahmat usne duniya walon ke darmiyan taqseem ki, jisne unhein unki maut tak kaafi rakha, aur ninyanwe (99) apne dosto (auliya) ke liye mo'akhkhar (safe) rakh li hain. Aur Allah Azza wa Jalla us rahmat ko jo usne duniya walon ke darmiyan taqseem ki thi, ninyanwe (rahmaton) ke sath mila lega, is tarah sau (100) rahmatein Qayamat ke din apne auliya ke liye poori kar dega."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Verily, Allah created on the day He created the heavens and the earth one hundred mercies. Each mercy encompasses the heavens and the earth. He distributed one mercy among all of His creation and kept ninety-nine mercies for Himself. On the Day of Judgment, He will restore this mercy, and thus it will become one hundred mercies, by which He will have mercy upon His servants." Another commentator, Jundub ibn Abdullah, also attested to this. Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah ne aasman aur zameen banaye, us din usne sau rahmatein paida kin, har rahmat aasmanon aur zameen ke barabar (waseeh) hai. To usne aik rahmat tamam makhlooq ke darmiyan taqseem ki, aur ninyanwe (99) rahmatein apne liye mo'akhkhar rakh li. Phir Qayamat ke din jab yeh rahmat wapas laayega, to sau rahmatein ho jayengi, jinse woh apne bandon par reham karega." Iska aik aur mufassal shahid Jundub bin Abdullah (RA) se bhi milta hai. Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] An Arab came with his camel. He tied its reins and then secured it. He prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  finished his prayer, the man went to his camel, removed its reins, and mounted it. Then he called out, "O Allah, have mercy on me and Muhammad and do not include anyone else in Your mercy." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "What are you saying? Is he (the camel) more misguided or you?" They replied, "We heard what he said." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, mercy is vast. Allah has created one hundred mercies, and He has sent down only one of them for His creation. Through this mercy, creatures show compassion to one another, including jinn, humans, and animals. Ninety-nine mercies remain with Allah. Do you consider him more misguided or you?"
hi: Aik dehati aaya, usne apni sawari bithaayi aur bandh di, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe namaz padhi. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne salaam phera to woh apni sawari ke paas gaya, uski rassi khol kar uspar sawaar hua, phir pukaara: "Aye Allah, mujh par aur Muhammad (SAW) par reham kar, aur humari rahmat mein kisi aur ko shareek na kar." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum kya kehte ho, kya yeh zyada gumraah hai ya uska unt? Kya tumne nahi suna usne kya kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usne aik waseeh rahmat ko mehdood (tang) kar diya. Beshak Allah ne sau rahmatein paida kin, unme se aik rahmat nazil ki jiske zariye tamam makhlooqaat - jinnat, insaan aur jaanwar - aapas mein narmi aur mohabbat rakhte hain, aur ninyanwe (99) uske paas (mahfooz) hain. Tum kehte ho ke kya yeh zyada gumraah hai ya uska unt?"

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas reported that one of them (the narrators) raised him to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "Verily, Gabriel used to put clay in the mouth of Pharaoh for fear that he would say, 'There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah'."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai, unme se aik ravi ne isse Nabi (SAW) tak marfoo' kiya: "Beshak Jibra'il (AS) Fir'aun ke mun mein mitti thoonste rehte the, is dar se ke kahin woh 'La ilaha illallah' na keh de."

e: "'Adi bin Thabit and 'Ata bin As-Sa'ib informed me, from Sa'eed bin Jubair, from Ibn 'Abbas - and one of them mentioned that it was from the Prophet ﷺ - that he mentioned that Jibra'il began shoving clay in the mouth of Fir'awn out of fear that he would say La Ilaha Illallah and Allah would have mercy upon him - or fearing that Allah would have mercy upon him." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3108)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, unhone zikr kiya ke Jibra'il (AS) Fir'aun ke mun mein mitti thoonste the is dar se ke kahin woh 'La ilaha illallah' na keh de aur Allah usse reham na kare - ya farmaya: is dar se ke Allah usse reham kare.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying in one of his prayers, "O Allah, reckon me with an easy reckoning." When he finished, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the reckoning?" He said, "It is to be examined in His book, and be pardoned. Verily, whoever undergoes reckoning on that day, O Aisha, he shall perish. Every hardship that afflicts a believer, even a thorn prick, will be expiation for him from Allah."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko apni kisi namaz mein farmate hue suna: "Aye Allah, mera hisaab aasan lena." Jab aap (SAW) namaz se farigh huay to maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hisaab kya hota hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uske naamah-e-a'maal mein dekha jayega aur usse darguzar kiya jayega. Beshak jiska us din baaqaida munaqasha (behas-o-mubahisa) kiya gaya, aye Aisha (RA), woh halaak ho gaya. Aur jo bhi museebat momin ko pahunchti hai, Allah usi ke zariye uske gunah utaar deta hai, yahan tak ke ek kaanta bhi jo usse chubhe."

e: “The wise man is the one who takes account of himself and strives for that which is after death. And the helpless man is the one who follows his own whims then indulges in wishful thinking about Allah.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4260)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aqalmand woh hai jo apne nafs ka muhasaba kare aur maut ke baad ke liye amal kare, aur aajiz (kamzor) woh hai jo apne nafs ki khwahishaat ki pairavi kare aur Allah se (bina amal ke) ummeedein lagaye rakhe."

e: [AI] وَأَبِي دَاوُدَ» «فَصَحُّ الْحَدِيثِ.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin (apni azmaishon ke zariye) gunahon se paak kar diya jata hai." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Dono (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne Abdur Rahman bin Humaid aur Abu Dawud (dono raawiyon) par ittifaq kiya hai, to yeh hadith sahih hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "This nation will be gathered into three groups: a group that will enter Paradise without any reckoning, a group that will be held accountable with an easy reckoning before entering Paradise, and a group that will come on their hands and knees like mountains, burdened with sins. Allah will ask about them although He is most aware of them, and they will say, 'These are your servants, O Allah.' Allah will then relieve them of their burden and place it upon the Jews and Christians, and admit them to Paradise through His mercy."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Yeh Ummat teen giroh mein uthayi jayegi: aik giroh bagair hisaab ke Jannat mein dakhil hoga; aik giroh ka aasaan hisaab hoga phir woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga; aur aik giroh apni pusht par pahaadon jaisi bhaari gunahon ki gathri lekar aayega, to Allah unke baare mein poochega - halanke woh unhein khoob jaanta hai - aur farmayega: "Yeh kaun hain?" To (farishte) kahenge: "Yeh tere bandon mein se hain." Allah farmayega: "In (gunahon) ko inse utaar do aur Yahood-o-Nasara par daal do, aur inhein meri rahmat se Jannat mein dakhil kar do."

e: [AI] There was a boy on the side of the road, and the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  passed by with people. When the boy's mother saw the crowd, she was afraid her son would be trampled, so she picked him up and said, "My son, my son." The people asked the Prophet, "O Messenger of Allah, why would this woman throw her son into the fire?" The Prophet ﷺ  said, "By Allah, His beloved ones will not be thrown into the fire."
hi: Aik bachcha raste ke kinare tha, aur Nabi (SAW) apne saathiyon ke sath wahan se guzre. Jab bachche ki maa ne logon ko dekha to darr gayi ke kahin uska beta kuchla na jaye, to usne use utha liya aur kaha: "Mera beta, mera beta!" Logon ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh (aurat) apne bete ko aag mein nahi daalna chahegi." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur na hi Allah apne mehboob bande ko aag mein daalega."

e: [AI] A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, one of us commits a sin." He said, "It is written against him." The man said, "Then he seeks forgiveness from Him and repents." He said, "He will be forgiven and granted repentance, and Allah does not become weary until you become weary."
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum mein se koi gunah kar leta hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh uske naamah-e-a'maal mein likh diya jata hai." Usne kaha: "Phir woh istighfar karta hai aur tauba karta hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usse maaf kar diya jata hai aur uski tauba qubool ki jati hai, aur Allah (maaf karne se) nahi thaktaa jab tak tum (maangne se) na thak jao."

e: [AI] "The major sins, from the beginning of Surah An-Nisa' until 'if you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden from' [An-Nisa' 31], are thirty verses from the beginning of the Surah."
hi: Kabaair (bade gunah) Surah An-Nisa ki ibtida se lekar ayat "Agar tum un bade gunahon se bacho jinse tumhein roka gaya hai" (An-Nisa 31) tak, ya'ni surah ki pehli tees (30) ayaat mein (bayan hue) hain.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said during the Farewell Pilgrimage: "Indeed, the allies of Allah are those who establish the five daily prayers that Allah prescribed for them, fast during Ramadan and consider it as an obligation, give Zakat (charity) from their wealth and consider it as an obligation, and avoid major sins that Allah has forbidden." Then a man asked him, "O Messenger of Allah, what are the major sins?" He replied, "They are nine: associating partners with Allah, killing a believer unjustly, fleeing from the battlefield, consuming the property of orphans, consuming interest, slandering chaste women, disobeying one's Muslim parents, participating in the violation of the sanctity of the Kaaba, whether you are alive or dead." Then he said, "A man does not die until he commits these major sins, establishes prayer, and gives Zakat, except that he will be with the Prophet ﷺ in a dwelling whose doors are made of gold." "This hadith has been cited through narrators other than Abd al-Hameed ibn Sinan. As for Umayr ibn Qatadah, he is a companion of the Prophet ﷺ and his son Ubaid agreed on its authenticity and its use as evidence." Umayr ibn Qatadah was a companion of the Prophet, and there was no need for Abd al-Hameed ibn Sinan to state that. I said this to clarify his ignorance and confirm his reliability according to Ibn Hibban.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida (Farewell Hajj) mein farmaya: "Suno! Allah ke wali (dost) woh namazi hain jo apne upar farz ki gayi paanch namazein qaim karte hain, Ramzan ke roze rakhte hain aur unhein farz samajhte hain, apne maal ki zakat deni farz samajh kar dete hain, aur un bade gunahon se bachte hain jinse Allah ne mana kiya hai." Phir aik shakhs ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kabaair kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh nau (9) hain: Allah ke sath shirk karna, kisi momin ki jaan ko na-haq qatl karna, jang ke maidan se bhagna, yateem ka maal khana, sood khana, paak-daaman aurat par tohmat lagana, Musalman waalidain ki na-farmani karna, aur Baitul Haram - jo tumhara qibla hai - ki hurmat ko halal samajhna, chahe zinda ho ya murda." Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs in kabaair mein se kuch na kare, aur namaz qaim kare aur zakat de, woh nahi marega magar Nabi (SAW) ke sath us ghar mein hoga jiske darwaze sone ke honge." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Is hadith ke tamam raawiyon ko - Abdul Hamid bin Sinan ke siwa - hujjat mana gaya hai. Rahi baat Umayr bin Qatadah (RA) ki, to woh sahabi hain, aur unke bete Ubaid ki riwayat par ittifaq hai. Umayr bin Qatadah sahabi hain, aur inhein Abdul Hamid ki zaroorat nahi thi. Maine yeh unki na-shanaakht (majhooliyat) ki wazahat ke liye kaha, aur Ibn Hibban ne unhein thiqa qaraar diya hai."

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Abbas and Ibn Amr met and Ibn Abbas asked him, "Which verse in the Book of Allah do you find the most hopeful?" Ibn Amr replied, "O my servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah." (Surah Az-Zumar, 39:53) Ibn Abbas said, "But what about the statement of Ibrahim, 'My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead.' He said, 'Have you not believed?' He said, 'Yes, but I ask only that my heart may be satisfied.'" (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:260) This is because of what is in the hearts and whispers of Satan, so Allah was pleased with the statement of Ibrahim by His saying, 'Did you not believe?' He said, 'Yes.'" (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:260)
hi: Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) aur Ibn Amr (RA) ki mulaqat hui to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unse poocha: "Allah ki Kitab mein aapke nazdeek sabse zyada ummeed dilane wali ayat kaunsi hai?" Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ne kaha: "'Aye mere bando jinhone apni jaan par zulm kiya hai, Allah ki rahmat se mayoos na ho' (Surah Az-Zumar 53)." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Lekin Ibrahim (AS) ka yeh kehna: 'Aye Rab, mujhe dikha tu murdon ko kaise zinda karta hai. Allah ne farmaya: Kya tujhe Eman nahi? Unhone kaha: Kyun nahi, magar (yeh sawal isliye kiya) taake mera dil mutmain ho jaye' (Surah Al-Baqarah 260) - yeh us waswase ke baare mein hai jo dilon mein hota hai aur Shaitan waswasa daalta hai, to Allah Ibrahim (AS) ke is jawaab se raazi ho gaya: 'Kya tujhe Eman nahi? Unhone kaha: Kyun nahi' (Surah Al-Baqarah 260)."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Indeed, a person can attain the status of those who observe night prayers and fast during the day through their good character."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak insaan apne achhe akhlaq ki wajah se raat ko namaz padhne wale aur din ko roze rakhne wale ke darjaat tak pahunch jata hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah will elevate the rank of a servant through his good character, just as He elevates him through fasting and prayer." This is according to the condition of being a Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah bande ko uske achhe akhlaq ki wajah se roze aur namaz ke darje tak pahunchata hai." Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] O Abu Abdur Rahman, indeed, we are descendants of Al-Mughira, a people who possess arrogance. Have you heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say anything about this? Abdullah ibn Umar said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'No man who has arrogance in himself and walks arrogantly will meet Allah while Allah is angry with him.'"
hi: (Kisi ne) unse kaha: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, hum Bani Al-Mughira hain, humme ghuroor (nakhwat) hai, kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko is baare mein kuch farmate hue suna hai?" To Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Koi aisa aadmi nahi jo apne aap ko bada samjhe aur akad kar chale, magar woh Allah se is haal mein milega ke Allah usse naraaz hoga.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Shall I not inform you about the people of Paradise? They are the meek and weak. And the people of Hellfire are every haughty, arrogant, and contemptuous person."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein Jannat walon ki khabar na doon? Woh maghloob (dabaye hue) kamzor log hain. Aur Jahannam waale har sakht-mizaaj, moti-taazi wala, ghamandi (mustakbir) shakhs hai."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ in what he narrated from his Lord, the Almighty, he said, "Pride is My cloak, so anyone who competes with Me over My cloak, I will break it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, apne Rab Azza wa Jalla se naql karte hue, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kibriya (bazurgi) meri chadar hai, jo koi mujh se meri chadar mein jhagda kare, main use tod dunga."

e: [AI] The translation of the sentence into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to ride a donkey, wear woolen clothing, tend to sheep, and visit the welcoming of guests."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) gadhe par sawar hote, oon (pashmina) pehnte, bakri ko khud baandhte, aur mehmaan ki khidmat khud karte the. Yeh dono ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The translation in English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to ride a donkey, wear wool clothes, free sheep, and visit guests."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) gadhe par sawar hote, oon pehnte, bakri ko khud baandhte, aur mehmaan ki khidmat khud karte the.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: "Whoever gives up wearing clothes, while being able to do so, out of humility for Allah, Allah will call him to the heads of creation until he is given a choice in the garments of faith, and he can wear whichever he wishes." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Allah ke saamne tawadu' (inkisari) ke tor par (achha) libaas chhod de, jabke woh uski taaqat rakhta ho, to Allah use Qayamat ke din tamam makhlooq ke saamne bulayega, yahan tak ke use Eman ke jubbe (libaas) mein se chunne ka ikhtiyar diya jayega, woh jo chahe pehne." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] He took off his shoes, put them on his shoulder, and took hold of the reins of his camel. He then led her through the crowd. Abu Ubaydah said, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, you are doing this? You are taking off your shoes and putting them on your shoulder, and taking hold of the reins of your camel and leading her through the crowd? It pleases me that the people of the city are honoring you." 'Umar said, "Oh, it isn't that anyone other than you said this, Abu Ubaydah. I only did it so that I could be an example for the nation of Muhammad ﷺ . Verily, we were the most humiliated people and Allah honored us with Islam. So, whatever we seek honor in, other than what Allah has honored us with, Allah will humiliate us."
hi: ...(Umar RA) ne apne dono khuff (jooray) utaar liye aur unhein apne kandhe par rakh liya, aur apni unti (sawari) ki lagaam pakad kar usse nadi paar karayi. Abu Ubaydah (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aap yeh kaam kar rahe hain? Apne jooray utaar kar kandhe par rakh rahe hain aur apni unti ki lagaam pakad kar usse nadi paar kara rahe hain? Mujhe achha nahi lagega ke shehar wale aapko is haal mein dekh len." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Afsos, kaash yeh baat tumhare siwa koi aur na kehta, Abu Ubaydah! Maine yeh kaam Ummat-e-Muhammad (SAW) ke liye aik misaal banane ke liye kiya hai. Beshak hum sabse zaleel qaum thay, phir Allah ne humein Islam ke zariye izzat di, to jab bhi hum Islam ke alawa kisi aur cheez se izzat chahenge, Allah humein zaleel kar dega."

e: [AI] When Umar arrived in Sham, the soldiers met him while he was wearing a garment and sandals and had a turban on his head. He was holding the reins of his camel as he crossed the water. Someone said to him, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, the soldiers and the elite of Sham meet you while you are in this state?" Umar replied, "Verily, we are a nation whom Allah has honored with Islam, and we will not seek honor through anything else." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in the summary translation.
hi: Jab Umar (RA) Sham (Shaam) pahunche to fauj unse milne aayi, jabke unhone tehband, do jooray aur pagdi pehni hui thi, aur woh apne unt ka sar pakde huay paani mein guzar rahe the. Kisi kehne wale ne unse kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, fauj aur Sham ke sardar aapse milne aa rahe hain, aur aap is haal mein hain?" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Hum aisi qaum hain jinhe Allah ne Islam ke zariye izzat di, hum uske siwa kisi aur cheez se izzat nahi chahenge." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Those who do not show mercy to our young ones and do not realise the right of our elders are not from us. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4943)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh humme se nahi jo humare chhoton par reham na kare aur humare baron ka haq na pehchane."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Blessings are with your elders."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Barkat tumhare baron ke sath hoti hai."

e: "O Allah, bear witness that I have issued a warning concerning (failure to fulfill) the rights of the two weak ones: Orphans and women.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3678)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein do kamzoron ke haq ke baare mein daraata hoon: yateem aur aurat."

e: [AI] "He gathered a group of people and met Aba Dhar while he was near the middle pillar and the people were around him. So, I sat with him until my knees touched his knees. I forgot the mentioned conversation and everything I wanted to ask him slipped away from me. So, I raised my head towards the sky and tried to remember.
