I said, 'O Aba Dhar, guide me towards an action that, if a servant performs it, they would enter Paradise.' He said, 'The Prophet ﷺ  said: "Believe in Allah."' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, is there an action that accompanies faith?' He said, 'He should be content with whatever Allah has provided for him.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what if he has nothing?' He said, 'He should speak kindly.' I said, 'What if he is unable to speak?' He said, 'Then, let him help a person in need.' I said, 'What if he is weak and powerless?' He said, 'Then, let him do good to others by joining their good actions.' I said, 'What if he is crippled?' Then, he turned towards me and said, 'What do you want for your companion?' I said, 'Let him refrain from hurting others.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, indeed all of this seems easy.' He said, 'By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, there is no characteristic that a servant acts upon seeking the face of Allah, except that it will hold his hand on the Day of Resurrection and not leave him until it enters him into Paradise.'"
hi: ...to usne (kuch) hadith jama ki, phir Abu Dharr (RA) se mulaqat ki jabke woh Jamratul-Wusta ke paas the aur log unke gird thay. (Ravi ne kaha:) main unke paas baith gaya yahan tak ke mera ghutna unke ghutne se laga, to main woh (pehli) hadith bhool gaya aur jo kuch bhi maine unse poochna chaha tha woh sab mere zehen se nikal gaya, to maine apna sar aasman ki taraf uthaya aur yaad karne ki koshish karne laga, phir maine kaha: "Aye Abu Dharr (RA), mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jo agar banda kare to Jannat mein dakhil ho jaye." Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah par Eman lao." Maine (poocha:) "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya Eman ke sath koi amal bhi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne jo rizq diya hai usme se kuch de." Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar woh nadaar ho aur uske paas kuch na ho?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To apni zabaan se achhi baat kahe." Maine poocha: "Agar woh gungi zabaan wala ho aur uski baat na pahunch sake?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To kisi maghloob (dabey hue) ki madad kare." Maine poocha: "Agar woh kamzor ho aur uske paas taaqat na ho?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To kisi na-samajh (be-tajruba) ki madad kare." Maine poocha: "Agar woh khud na-samajh ho?" To aap (SAW) ne meri taraf mudkar farmaya: "Tum apne saathi mein kaunsi neki baaqi rehne dena chahte ho?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To woh logon ko apni takleef se bacha kar rakhe." Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh sab to bohot aasan hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, in mein se koi bhi khaslat aisi nahi jise koi banda Allah ki raza ke liye karta ho, magar woh Qayamat ke din uska haath thaam legi aur usse tab tak alag nahi hogi jab tak use Jannat mein dakhil na kar de."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: There is hesitation in everything except in the actions of the next world. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4810)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har cheez mein itminaan (aahista rehna) behtar hai, siwaye aakhirat ke amal ke."

e: “When Allah created Adam, He breathed the soul into him, then he sneezed and said: ‘All praise is due to Allah.’ So he praised Allah by His permission. Then His Lord said to him: ‘May Allah have mercy upon you O Adam. Go to those angels – to that gathering of them sitting – so say: 'As-Salamu alaikum.' They said 'Wa Alaikas-Salamu Wa Rahmatullah’. Then he returned to his Lord, He said: ‘This is your greeting and the greeting of your children among each other.’ Then Allah said to him – while His Two Hands were closed – ‘Choose which of them you wish.’ He said: ‘I chose the right My Lord and both of the Hands of my Lord are right, blessed.’ Then He extended it, and there was Adam and his offspring in it.’ So he said: ‘What are these O my Lord?’ He said: ‘These are your offspring?’ Each one of them had his age written between his eyes. But among them there was a man who was the most illuminating of them – or among the most illuminated of them. He said: ‘O Lord! Who is this?’ He said: ‘This is your son Dawud, I wrote forty years for him.’ He said: ‘O Lord! Add to his age.’ He said: ‘That is what I have written for him.’ He said: ‘O Lord! Give him sixty of my years.’ He said: ‘So you shall have it.’” He said: “Then, he resided in Paradise as long as Allah willed, then he was cast from it, so Adam was counting for himself.” He said: “So the Angel of death came to him, and Adam said to him: ‘You are hasty, one-thousand years were written for me.’ He said: ‘Of course! But you gave sixty years to your son Dawud.’ So he rejected, and his offspring rejected, and he forgot, and his offspring forgot.” He said: “So ever since that day, what is written and witnessed has been decreed.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3367)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Allah ne Adam (AS) ko banaya aur unme rooh phoonki, to unhein cheenk aayi aur unhone kaha: "Alhamdulillah." Unhone Allah ki hamd Allah ki ijazat se ki. Unke Rab ne unse farmaya: "Yarhamuk Allah (Allah tujh par reham kare), aye Adam." Aur unse farmaya: "Aye Adam, un farishton ke paas jao, unke aik jamaat ke paas jo baithe hue hain, aur kaho: As-salamu alaikum." Woh gaye, to unhone kaha: "Wa alaikas-salam wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh." Phir woh apne Rab ki taraf laut aaye, to Allah ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhara aur tumhari aulad ka salaam hai." Phir Allah ne farmaya, jabke uske dono haath band the: "Jo tum chaho chun lo." Unhone kaha: "Maine apne Rab ka dayan haath chun liya," aur mere Rab ke dono haath mubarak (bhare hue) hain. Phir usne apna haath khola, to usme Adam (AS) aur unki zurriyat thi. Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, yeh kaun hain?" Allah ne farmaya: "Yeh teri zurriyat hai." To har insaan ki umr uski aankhon ke darmiyan likhi hui thi. Unme se aik shakhs jo sabse zyada roshan tha - ya farmaya: sabse roshan logon mein se tha - uske liye sirf chaalees (40) saal likhi hui thi. Adam (AS) ne kaha: "Aye Rab, iski umr badha de." Allah ne farmaya: "Yeh woh hai jo iske liye likh diya gaya hai." Adam (AS) ne kaha: "To maine apni umr mein se saath (60) saal isse de diye." Allah ne farmaya: "Tumhari marzi." Phir Adam (AS) ko jitna Allah ne chaha Jannat mein rakha, phir unhein wahan se utaara gaya, aur Adam (AS) apni umr gin rahe thay, to unke paas maut ka farishta aaya. Adam (AS) ne usse kaha: "Tumne jaldi ki, mere liye to hazar (1000) saal likhi gayi thi." Farishte ne kaha: "Ji haan, lekin tumne apne bete Dawud (AS) ko usme se saath (60) saal de diye thay." To Adam (AS) ne inkaar kar diya, aur unki zurriyat ne bhi inkaar kiya; aur woh bhool gaye, to unki zurriyat bhi bhool gayi. Usi din se humein likhne aur gawah rakhne ka hukum diya gaya.

e: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 99)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Sahih hai.

e: [AI] "To be solitude for Ibrahim, words for Musa, and visions for Muhammad ﷺ ."
hi: Yeh (khaas martaba) ke Khullat (gehri dosti) Ibrahim (AS) ke liye ho, kalaam Musa (AS) ke liye ho, aur (Allah ka) deedar Muhammad (SAW) ke liye ho.

e: [AI] Mohammed ﷺ  saw his Lord, and he had a third witness with a reliable chain of narrators.
hi: Muhammad (SAW) ne apne Rab ko dekha. Iska teesra shahid bhi sahih sanad ke sath hai.

e: [AI] "Muhammad ﷺ  saw his Lord."
hi: Beshak Muhammad (SAW) ne apne Rab ko dekha.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic text into English is: "That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saw Gabriel (Jibril), peace be upon him, and these news that I mentioned are all authentic, and Allah knows best."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Jibra'il (AS) ko dekha. (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Yeh tamam riwayaten jo maine bayan ki hain sab sahih hain, wallahu a'lam."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "To the prophets belong golden pulpits." He said, "They sit and my pulpit remains empty. I do not sit or recline on it, standing before my Lord, fearing that He may raise me up to Paradise and leave my nation behind. So I say, 'O Lord, my nation, my nation.' And Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, says, 'O Muhammad, what do you want me to do with your nation?' So I say, 'O Lord, hasten their reckoning.' So they are called and held accountable. Among them are those who enter Paradise by the mercy of Allah, and among them are those who enter Paradise by my intercession. And I will continue to intercede until I am given a parchment with the names of men who have been sent to the Fire, and I will present it to Malik, the guardian of the Fire. He will say, 'O Muhammad, have you left anything in the Fire due to the anger of your Lord against your nation?' Then I will give him the remaining portion."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ambiya (AS) ke liye sone ke mimbar hongay," (ravi ne kaha:) "woh unpar baithengay, magar mera mimbar khaali reh jayega, main us par nahi baithunga - ya farmaya: nahi baithunga - balke apne Rab ke saamne khada rahunga, is dar se ke mujhe Jannat mein bhej diya jaye aur meri Ummat mere baad reh jaye. To main kahunga: 'Aye Rab, meri Ummat, meri Ummat.' Allah Azza wa Jalla farmayenge: 'Aye Muhammad, tum apni Ummat ke sath kya karwana chahte ho?' To main kahunga: 'Aye Rab, unka hisaab jaldi le.' To unhein bulaya jayega aur unka hisaab liya jayega, unme se kuch Allah ki rahmat se Jannat mein dakhil hongay aur kuch meri shafa'at se Jannat mein dakhil hongay. Main shafa'at karta rahunga yahan tak ke mujhe un logon ki fehristein (parwane) di jayengi jo Jahannam bheje ja chuke hain, aur main Jahannam ke daroga Malik ke paas jaunga, to woh kahenge: 'Aye Muhammad, tumne apne Rab ke ghazab ki wajah se apni Ummat ke liye Jahannam mein kuch baaqi bhi chhoda hai?'"

e: [AI] I heard Awf ibn Malik Al-Ashja'i say: "We stayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a place for the night. I woke up during the night, and found that there was something longer than the back of my saddle that had stuck to the ground, due to every person and his camel being stuck to the ground. So I walked through the people until I came to the sleeping place of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , but he was not there. I placed my hand on his bed and found that it was cold. I went through the people and said, 'Indeed, we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.' The news of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  spread until I left the whole camp and saw a darkness. I threw a stone and moved towards the darkness. Then I saw Mu'adh ibn Jabal and Abu 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah in front of me, and there was a sound between us like the clapping of sandals or the sound of pebbles when they are hit by the wind. Some of us said to others, 'O people, remain steady until the morning comes or the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  comes to you.' So we remained as long as Allah willed, then he called out, 'Did Mu'adh ibn Jabal, Abu 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah, and Awf ibn Malik come?' So we said, 'Yes.' He came towards us and we came out to him. We did not ask him anything, nor did he inform us anything, until he sat on his bed and said, 'Do you know what my Lord has chosen for me tonight?' We said, 'Allah and His Messenger know best.' He said, 'Indeed, He has chosen to give me a choice between having half of my Ummah enter Paradise or intercession, and I have chosen intercession.' So we said, 'O Messenger of Allah, supplicate to Allah to make us among its people.' He said, 'It is for every Muslim.'"
hi: Maine Auf bin Malik al-Ashja'i (RA) ko kehte hue suna: hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik jagah thehre. Raat ko main jaaga to mujhe apne kajawe ke pichhle hisse se lambi koi cheez nazar nahi aayi, har insaan aur uska unt zameen se chipke hue the. Main uthkar logon ke darmiyan se guzarne laga yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke sone ki jagah tak pahuncha, magar wahan aap (SAW) nahi thay. Maine apna haath bistar par rakha to woh thanda tha. Main logon ke darmiyan se guzarte hue bahar nikla aur kehne laga: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un" (Surah Al-Baqarah 156) - Rasulullah (SAW) ko le jaya gaya! Yahan tak ke main puray lashkar se bahar nikal aaya. Maine ek kaali cheez dekhi to uski taraf pathar phenka, phir us kaali cheez ki taraf badha to dekha Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) aur Abu Ubaydah bin al-Jarrah (RA) wahan hain, aur hamare saamne chakki ki awaz ya tez hawa mein kankariyon ki awaz jaisi koi awaz thi. Hum aapas mein kehne lage: "Ae logo, subah tak yahin theher jao ya Rasulullah (SAW) tumhare paas aa jayen." Hum jitni der Allah ne chaha thehre rahe, phir aap (SAW) ne pukara: "Kya wahan Mu'adh bin Jabal, Abu Ubaydah bin al-Jarrah aur Auf bin Malik hain?" Hum ne kaha: "Haan." Aap (SAW) humari taraf tashreef laaye aur hum (aap SAW ke sath) bahar nikle, na hum ne aap (SAW) se kuch poocha na aap (SAW) ne humein kuch bataya, yahan tak ke aap (SAW) apne bistar par baith gaye aur farmaya: "Kya tumhe pata hai aaj raat mere Rab ne mujhe kis cheez ka ikhtiyar diya?" Hum ne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool (SAW) behtar jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke ya to meri aadhi ummat ko jannat mein dakhil kar de ya shafa'at ka haq de, to maine shafa'at ko chun liya." Hum ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah se dua kijiye ke humein bhi is (shafa'at) ke ahl mein shamil kare." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh har Musalman ke liye hai."

e: [AI] "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during some of his journeys. He mentioned the hadith" and as for the hadith of Hisham Al-Dastuway."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath apne kisi safar mein thay," phir hadith ka zikr kiya. Aur Husham Ad-Dastuwai ki hadith yeh hai...

e: [AI] "We were with the Prophet ﷺ ," then he mentioned the hadith at length, "the hadith of Qatadah."
hi: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke sath thay," phir poori hadith ka zikr kiya. "Qatadah ki hadith yeh hai..."

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in some of his expeditions, and one night we ended up not finding the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his place. Suddenly, the camels were tied up, and then I saw Mu'adh ibn Jabal. He called out to me and I responded to him, asking, "Where is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He replied, "Behind me." This Hadith is authentic from the narration of Abu Qilabah with the condition of the two Sheikhs. And this Hadith has been narrated from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari from Awf ibn Malik with a valid chain of narrators upon the condition of the two Sheikhs, and they did not compile it. According to Muslim.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath apne kisi ghazwe mein thay, aik raat hum thehre magar humein Rasulullah (SAW) apni jagah par nazar nahi aaye, aur unt apne gale zameen par rakh chuke thay. Achanak mujhe rassiyan nazar aayin, to dekha Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) wahan the. Unhone mujhe dekha aur maine unhein dekha, to maine poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) kahan hain?" Unhone kaha: "Mere peechhe," phir hadith ka zikr kiya. (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Yeh Abu Qilabah ki hadith se dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ki shart par sahih hai." Yeh hadith Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) se, Auf bin Malik (RA) se, sahih sanad ke sath bhi riwayat hui hai, dono ki shart par, magar unhone ise nahi nikala. Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] On the authority of Awf ibn Malik, he said: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ  in some of his expeditions. Awf said, "I heard a rustling sound behind me like the sound of a millstone. I turned around and there was the Prophet ﷺ ." So I said: "Indeed, when the Prophet ﷺ  is in the enemy's land, he is guarded." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "It is a messenger from my Lord, coming to me and giving me the choice between allowing half of my Ummah to enter Paradise or intercede for them." So I chose intercession." Muadh ibn Jabal said: "O Messenger of Allah, you have certainly recognized your followers, so make me one of them." He ﷺ  said, "You are one of them." Awf ibn Malik said: "O Messenger of Allah, you have indeed recognized that we left our people and our wealth with a desire for Allah and His Messenger, so make us one of them." He ﷺ  said, "You are one of them." So we came back to the people and they were in uproar. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Sit down," and they all sat down as if none of them had stood up. He ﷺ  said, "A messenger from my Lord came to me and gave me the choice between allowing half of my Ummah to enter Paradise or intercede for them. So I chose intercession." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, make us one of them." He ﷺ  said, "It is for those who die without associating anything with Allah."
hi: Auf bin Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ke woh Nabi (SAW) ke sath apne kisi ghazwe mein thay. Auf (RA) ne kaha: maine apne peechhe chakki jaisi aawaz suni, dekha to Nabi (SAW) thay. Maine kaha: "Nabi (SAW) jab dushman ki zameen mein hote hain to unke gird pehredaar hote hain." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere paas mere Rab ki taraf se aik aane wala (farishta) aaya, usne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke ya to meri aadhi Ummat Jannat mein dakhil ho ya shafa'at ka haq mile, to maine shafa'at chun li." Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap meri (imandaari) jaante hain, mujhe bhi unme shamil kar dijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum unme se ho." Auf bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap jaante hain ke humne apni qaum aur apne maal ko Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki khatir chhod diya, to humein bhi unme shamil kar dijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum bhi unme se ho." Phir hum log logon ke paas pahunche jo hangama macha rahe thay, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Baith jao." To woh sab baith gaye jaise unme se koi khada hi nahi hua tha. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere Rab ki taraf se aik aane wala mere paas aaya aur mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke meri aadhi Ummat Jannat mein dakhil ho ya shafa'at, to maine shafa'at chun li." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein bhi unme shamil kar dijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh us shakhs ke liye hai jo is haal mein mare ke usne Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho."

e:
[AI] I visited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a delegation from Thaqif, and we set up a camp along one of the routes of Madinah until we reached the gate. There was no person among the people more disliked by us than a man who entered and we entered, greeted and pledged our allegiance. We did not leave his presence until there was no person among the people more beloved to us than the one who left his presence. So I said, "O Messenger of Allah, did you not ask your Lord for a kingdom like that of Sulaiman?" He laughed and said, "Perhaps your companion with Allah is better than the kingdom of Sulaiman. Indeed, Allah has not sent a prophet except that He has given him a supplication. And among them are those who took it for the rewards of this world and some of them invoked it against their people until they were destroyed by it. And indeed, Allah has given me a supplication and I have kept it with my Lord as intercession for my Ummah on the Day of Judgment."

And indeed, Muslim has mentioned the authority of Ali ibn Hashim and Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Aqil Al-Thaqafi, who are companions known for their narrations. Our imams have relied on them in their collections. As for Abd al-Jabbar ibn al-Abbas, he is the one who collected and organized his narrations among the people of Kufa. However, this narration is not confirmed.
hi: Main Thaqif ke wafd mein Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Hum Madinah ke aik raste par chal kar darwaze tak pahunche aur apni sawariyan bithayin, aur humme koi shakhs aisa na tha jise hum us insaan se zyada napasand karte ho jiske paas hum jaane wale thay. Hum andar gaye, salaam kiya aur bai'at ki, aur jab hum unke paas se nikle to humme koi shakhs aisa na tha jise hum us insaan se zyada pasand karte ho jiske paas se hum nikle thay. Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne apne Rab se Sulaiman (AS) jaisi hukumat kyun na maangi?" Aap (SAW) muskuraye aur farmaya: "Shayad tumhara saathi Allah ke nazdeek Sulaiman (AS) ki hukumat se behtar ho. Beshak Allah ne jitne bhi Nabi bheje unhein aik dua di, unme se kisi ne is duniya ki koi cheez maang li aur usse woh de di gayi, aur kisi ne apni qaum ke khilaf beddua ki to woh usse halaak ho gaye. Aur Allah ne mujhe bhi aik dua di, magar maine usse apne Rab ke paas mehfooz rakh liya, apni Ummat ke liye Qayamat ke din shafa'at ke tor par." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Muslim ne Ali bin Hashim se hujjat pakdi hai, aur Abdur Rahman bin Abi Aqeel Ath-Thaqafi Sahabi hain, hamare a'imma unhein apni Musnad kitaabon mein hujjat maante hain. Rahi baat Abdul Jabbar bin Al-Abbas ki, to woh Kufa ke logon mein se hain jinki hadith jama ki jaati hai aur unki musnad ginwai jaati hai." Yeh sabit nahi hai.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ that he said, "I have been shown what will happen to my Ummah after me; some of them will shed the blood of others, and this will be preceded by Allah as it happened in the nations before them. So I asked Allah to grant me intercession on the Day of Resurrection for them, and He granted it to me."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe dikhaya gaya ke mere baad meri Ummat ko kya pesh aayega, aur unme se kuch aik doosre ka khoon bahayenge, aur yeh baat Allah ki taraf se pehle hi muqarrar ho chuki thi jaise pichli ummaton ke sath ho chuka tha. To maine Allah se darkhwast ki ke woh Qayamat ke din unke haq mein mujhe shafa'at ka ikhtiyar de, to usne aisa hi kiya."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: My intercession will be for those of my people who have committed major sins. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4739)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri shafa'at meri Ummat ke un logon ke liye hai jinhone kabaair (bade gunah) kiye hon."

e: "My intercession is for the people who committed the major sins in my Ummah." Another chain reports a similar narration. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2435)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat ke kabaair karne walon ke liye shafa'at hai."

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, 'My intercession is for the people of major sins among my Ummah (community). And he has a valid witness according to the condition of a Muslim.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri shafa'at meri Ummat ke kabaair (bade gunah) karne walon ke liye hai." Iska aik sahih shahid bhi Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "My intercession is for the people of major sins among my Ummah." "All have attested to the testimony of Zuhair ibn Muhammad al-Anbari." And Muhammad ibn Thabit al-Bunani narrated it from Ja'far.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri shafa'at meri Ummat ke kabaair karne walon ke liye hai." Dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ne Zuhair bin Muhammad Al-Anbari se hujjat pakdi hai, aur Muhammad bin Thabit Al-Bunani ne Ja'far se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'My intercession is for the people who comitted major sins in my Ummah.'" Muhammad bin 'Ali said: "Jabir said to me: 'O Muhammad! Whoever is not among the people of major sins, then there is no need in the intercession for him.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2436)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri shafa'at meri Ummat ke kabaair karne walon ke liye hai." Abu Ja'far ne kaha: Jabir (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Muhammad, jo shakhs kabaair karne walon mein se na ho, uska shafa'at se kya lena-dena?"

e: [AI] He heard him say, "I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , 'What did your Lord say to you regarding intercession?' He replied, 'By the One in whose hand is my soul, I thought that you would be the first to ask me about this, due to your eagerness for knowledge. By the One in whose hand is my soul, what concerns me most is not the completion of my intercession, but rather my intercession for those who testify sincerely that there is no god but Allah, and their hearts and tongues are in accordance with that.'"
hi: Unhone (kisi shakhs ne) usse yeh kehte hue suna: maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Aapke Rab ne shafa'at ke baare mein aapko kya jawab diya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe pehle hi gumaan tha ke tum sabse pehle mujh se yeh sawal karoge, tumhari ilm ki chahat dekh kar. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe apni shafa'at ke poore hone se zyada fikr is baat ki hai ke log Jannat ke darwaze par kaise (bikhar kar) tootenge. Aur meri shafa'at us shakhs ke liye hai jo ikhlaas ke sath gawahi de ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, jiska dil uski zabaan ki tasdeeq kare aur uski zabaan uske dil ki."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Allah, the Exalted, says, 'Remove from the Fire those who say 'There is no god except Allah' and have in their hearts the weight of an atom of faith. Remove from the Fire those who say 'There is no god except Allah' or remember Me or fear Me in a gathering."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Azza wa Jalla farmata hai: "Jahannam se us shakhs ko nikaalo jisne 'La ilaha illallah' kaha ho aur uske dil mein zarra barabar Eman ho. Jahannam se us shakhs ko nikaalo jisne 'La ilaha illallah' kaha ho, ya kisi majlis mein mujhe yaad kiya ho ya mujh se darr gaya ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Allah says: 'Remove from the fire whoever remembers me or fears me in a position/place.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah farmata hai: "Jahannam se us shakhs ko nikaalo jisne kisi majlis mein mujhe yaad kiya ho ya mujh se darr gaya ho."

e: [AI] From a man from the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  named Ibn Abi Al-Jad'aa, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "A man from my nation will enter Paradise through the intercession of a man, who is more than the Banu Tamim tribe." This is Abdullah ibn Abi Al-Jad'aa, a famous companion, mentioned in the narrations, and he was from the residents of Mecca among the companions.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke aik sahabi (RA), jinhein Ibn Abi Al-Jad'aa kaha jata hai, unse riwayat hai, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Meri Ummat ke aik shakhs ki shafa'at se Bani Tameem se bhi zyada log Jannat mein dakhil hongay." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Yeh Abdullah bin Abi Al-Jad'aa hain, aik mash'hoor sahabi (RA), jinka zikr Masaneed (hadith majmuon) mein kiya gaya hai, aur woh Makkah mein rehne wale sahaba (RA) mein se the."

e: " I was with a troop in Jerusalem, and a man among them said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "From the intersection of one man in my Ummah more (people) then Banu Tamim will be admitted into Paradise.' It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Someone other than you?' He said: 'Other than me.' So when he stood, I said: 'Who is this?' They said: 'This is Ibn Abi Al-Jadh'a.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2438)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Meri Ummat ke aik shakhs ki shafa'at se Bani Tameem se bhi zyada log Jannat mein dakhil hongay." Hum ne kaha: "Aapke siwa (koi aur), Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere siwa." Maine (raawi se) poocha: "Kya aapne yeh khud Rasulullah (SAW) se suna?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Jab woh khade huay to maine poocha: "Yeh kaun hain?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh Ibn Abi Al-Jad'aa hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There are no two Muslims who kill three people before they reach the age of accountability except that Allah will admit them both into Paradise by His mercy." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, what about the one who kills two people?" He said, "Even the one who kills two people." And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, there are those among my Ummah who will enter Paradise by his intercession, more than the count of Mudar, and indeed there are those among my Ummah who will be doomed to the Fire until one of its corners is filled."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi do Musalman aise nahi jinke teen bachche - jo baaligh hone se pehle guzar gaye ho - foot jayen, magar Allah apni rahmat ke fazl se un dono ko Jannat mein dakhil kar dega." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aur do (bachchon) waale?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do waale bhi." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak meri Ummat mein aik aisa shakhs hoga jiski shafa'at se Mudar (qabile) se zyada log Jannat mein dakhil hongay, aur beshak meri Ummat mein aik aisa shakhs bhi hoga jo Jahannam ke liye itna bada ho jayega ke woh uska aik konah ban jayega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, a man from my nation will enter Paradise and intercede for more than one thousand people."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak meri Ummat ka aik shakhs Jannat mein dakhil hoga aur Mudar (qabile) se zyada logon ki shafa'at karega."

e: “When the Day of Resurrection comes, I will be the leader of the Prophets and the one who addresses them, and the one among them who will agree to intercede, and it is no boast.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4314)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Qayamat ka din hoga to main Ambiya (AS) ka imam, unka khatib aur unki shafa'at karne wala hounga, aur yeh koi fakhr (ghuroor) ki baat nahi." Sanad sahih hai.

e: “When the Day of Resurrection comes, I will be the leader of the Prophets and the one who addresses them, and the one among them who will agree to intercede, and it is no boast.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4314)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Qayamat ka din hoga to main Ambiya (AS) ka imam, unka khatib aur unki shafa'at karne wala hounga, aur yeh koi fakhr ki baat nahi."

e: [AI] I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "I know a word that no servant truly says from their heart except that Allah will make it forbidden for them from the Fire: 'There is no god but Allah'."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Main aik aisa kalima jaanta hoon ke koi banda apne dil se sachai ke sath ise kahe aur usi haal mein mar jaye, to Allah usse Jahannam par haram kar deta hai: 'La ilaha illallah.'"

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, he said, "Whoever knows that sending blessings upon him is a right and an obligation, will enter Paradise."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs yeh jaan le ke mujh par durood bhejna aik haq aur wajib cheez hai, woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ  that he said, "There are three types of people who will not enter Paradise: the disobedient to their parents, the adulterer, and the man who imitates women."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (qism ke log) Jannat mein dakhil nahi hongay: waalidain ki na-farmani karne wala, dayyus (be-ghairat shohar), aur aurton jaisi harkat karne wala mard."

e: [AI] From Nuwas bin Sam'an, a companion of the Prophet ﷺ , who narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Allah sets forth an example of a straight path with walls on both sides. Between these walls, there are open doors, and on these doors, there are curtains. On this path, there is a caller who calls out, saying: 'Oh people, walk on this path altogether and do not deviate.' There is also a caller who calls out against this path, and if any one of you wants to open any of those doors, he will say: 'Woe to you! Do not open it, for if you do, you will enter it.' This path represents Islam, the walls are the limits of Allah, the open doors are the prohibitions of Allah, the caller on top of the path is the Qur'an, and the caller from above is Allah's admonition, reminding every Muslim in their hearts."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ne aik seedhe raste ki misaal di hai, raste ke dono taraf deewaarein hain jinme khule darwaze hain, aur darwazon par latke hue parde hain. Raste par aik pukarne wala pukarta hai, kehta hai: "Aye logo, sab log is raste par chalo aur is se tedha na ho." Aur aik doosra pukarne wala raste ke upar se pukarta hai, jab bhi tum mein se koi in darwazon mein se kisi ko kholna chahe, to kehta hai: "Afsos ho tujh par, ise mat khol, kyunke agar tune ise khola to tu ismein dakhil ho jayega." To (is misaal mein) raasta Islam hai, parde Allah ki hudood (hadd bandiyan) hain, khule darwaze Allah ki haram ki hui cheezein hain, aur raste ke sar par pukarne wala Allah ki Kitab hai, aur upar se pukarne wala Allah ka naseehat karne wala hai jo har Musalman ke dil mein yaad dilata hai.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'The example of a believer is like a piece of iron that is struck by lightning and burns with a fever. Its impurities are removed, leaving it pure.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak momin bande ki misaal, jab usse bukhar aur (halki) larzish (raad) lagti hai, us loha ki tarah hai jo aag mein daala jaye, to uski gandagi (khoat) chali jaati hai aur uski achaai baaqi reh jaati hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet (Peace be upon him) entered upon one of his family members while he was suffering from a fever. The Prophet (Peace be upon him) said, "Umm Milhan." A woman answered, "Yes." Allah cursed her. The Prophet (Peace be upon him) then said, "Do not curse her, for she washes away the sins of the descendants of Adam as fire removes impurities from iron."
hi: Nabi (SAW) apne kisi ghar wale ke paas gaye jinhein bukhar tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Umm Mildam (bukhar)." Aik aurat ne kaha: "Ji haan (yehi hai)," aur Allah ki la'nat ho isse. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse la'nat na do, kyunke yeh Bani Adam ke gunahon ko dho deti hai ya door kar deti hai jaise bhatti loha ki gandagi door kar deti hai."

e: [AI] "He (the speaker) said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: There are three kinds of friends. The first kind is a friend who says to you, 'What you have given and what you have withheld is not yours, it is for us.' The second kind is a friend who says, 'I will be with you until you reach the door of the king, then I will leave you and depart. That is your family and relatives who will take care of you until you reach your grave, then they will leave you.' The third kind is a friend who says, 'I will be with you wherever you go, from the time you enter until the time you leave. That is your own work.' And then the Messenger ﷺ  said, 'By Allah, you are indeed the easiest of the three.'
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dost teen tarah ke hote hain: aik dost woh hai jo tumse kahe: jo tumne diya aur jo tumne roka, dono tumhare nahi - yeh tumhara maal hai (jo tum yahan chhod jaoge); aur aik dost woh hai jo kahe: main tumhare sath hoon yahan tak ke tum badshah ke darwaze tak pahunch jao, phir main wapas laut jaunga aur tumhein chhod dunga - yeh tumhare ghar waale aur qabila hain, jo tumhein tumhari qabar tak pahunchate hain phir wapas laut jate hain aur tumhein chhod dete hain; aur aik dost woh hai jo kahe: main tumhare sath hoon, jahan tum jao aur jahan se nikalo - yeh tumhara (nek) amal hai." Phir (woh dost) kehta hai: "Allah ki qasam, tum teenon mein sabse kam ahmiyat wale the mere nazdeek."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said: After the death of a believer, three things follow him: his family, his wealth, and his deeds. Two of them return, and only one remains. His family and wealth return, while his deeds remain. Imran al-Qattan al-Hajjaj continued the narration with its length.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ki maut ke baad teen cheezein uske peechhe jaati hain: uske ghar waale, uska maal aur uska amal. Do wapas laut aate hain aur aik baaqi reh jaata hai: uske ghar waale aur uska maal wapas laut aate hain, aur uska amal baaqi reh jaata hai." Imran Al-Qattan ne Al-Hajjaj ki isme mutaba'at ki hai aur poori hadith bayan ki hai.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "There is no servant except that he has three intimate friends." He mentioned the narration in its entirety similar to the narration of Ibrahim ibn Tahman, "And he has another witness upon the condition of a Muslim."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi banda aisa nahi jiske teen dost na hon," phir Ibrahim bin Tahman ki hadith ki tarah poori hadith ka zikr kiya. Iska aik aur shahid Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: The likeness of the believer and the likeness of death is that of a man who has three close friends. One of them said to him: 'Your wealth is my wealth; take whatever you wish and leave whatever you wish.' The other said: 'I will carry you and put you on me, and if you die, I will not leave you.' And the third said: 'I will be with you wherever you go, whether you live or die.' So the man said: 'This is his family.' And he said about the third: 'This is his deed according to the condition of a Muslim.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Momin aur ajal (maut ke waqt) ki misaal us aadmi jaisi hai jiske teen dost hon. Uske maal ne kaha: "Main tumhara maal hoon, mujhse jo chaho lelo aur jo chaho chhod do." Doosre (dost) ne kaha: "Main tumhare sath hoon, main tumhein uthaunga aur (tumhare sath) rakhunga, aur jab tum mar jaoge to main tumhein chhod dunga" - yeh uska qabila hai. Aur teesre ne kaha: "Main tumhare sath hoon, tumhare sath dakhil hounga aur tumhare sath nikalunga, chahe tum maro ya zinda raho" - yeh uska (nek) amal hai. Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered me (to learn the writing of the Jews), so I learnt for him the writing of the Jews. He said: I swear by Allah, I do not trust Jews in respect of writing for me. So I learnt it, and only a fortnight passed before I mastered it. I would write for him when he wrote (to them), and read to him when something was written to him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3645)
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya, to maine unke liye Yahood ki likhaai seekhi, aur aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe apne khat ke maamle mein Yahood par bharosa nahi." To maine woh seekh li, aur mujh par pandra din bhi na guzre thay ke maine usme mahaarat haasil kar li. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main unke liye likhta tha jab woh (Rasulullah SAW ko) likhte thay, aur unhein padh kar sunata tha jab unhein (kisi ki taraf se) likha jata." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "In dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ne Abdur Rahman bin Abi Al-Zinad ko gawah banaya hai aur..."

e: [AI] Abu Sabrah ibn Salamah al-Hudhali heard Ibn Zyad asking about the Pool of Muhammad ﷺ , and he replied, "I do not truly see it because Abu Barzah al-Aslami, Al-Bara' ibn 'Azib, and 'A'idh ibn 'Amr were asked about it, and they said they did not believe in them." So Abu Sabrah said, "Shall I not tell you a healing narration? Your father sent me with money to Muawiyah, and I met Abdullah ibn Amr who narrated it to me. I wrote it with my own hand exactly as I heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . I did not add or subtract anything." He narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, Allah does not love obscenity and foul language. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, the Hour will not come until there appears obscenity, foul language, severing of family ties, bad treatment of neighbors, betrayal by the trustworthy, trustworthiness by the treacherous, and the likeness of the believer is that of a bee that eats what is good and lays good. When it lands on something, it does not corrupt it or break it. And the likeness of a believing servant is that of a good piece of gold, which is blown upon and remains pure and heavy." He ﷺ  also said, "Your appointment is at my Pool. Its width is like its length, and it is farther than the distance between Ayla and Makkah. Its journey takes a month, and it contains cups whiter than silver, and whoever drinks from it will never be thirsty again." Ibn Zyad said, "No one has narrated to me a narration like this. I bear witness that the Pool is true and obligatory." And he took the scroll that Abu Sabrah had brought, and in the narration of Abu Usamah from Abdullah ibn Buraidah from Abu Sabrah.
hi: Abu Sabrah bin Salamah Al-Hudhali ne Ibn Ziyad ko Hawd - Muhammad (SAW) ke hawd - ke baare mein poochte hue suna, to unhone kaha: "Mujhe iski sachai ka yaqeen nahi, jabke maine Abu Barzah Al-Aslami (RA), Al-Bara' bin Azib (RA) aur A'idh bin Amr (RA) se poocha aur woh saare kehte hain: main inhein sach nahi maanta." Abu Sabrah ne kaha: "Kya main tumhein aik shifa-bakhsh hadith na sunaun? Tumhare walid ne mujhe maal ke sath Muawiyah (RA) ki taraf bheja, to mujhe Abdullah bin Amr (RA) mile, unhone mujhe apni zubaan se bayan ki, aur maine apni kalam se woh likh li, jaisa unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se suna tha, na ek harf badhaya na ghataya. Unhone mujhe bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah be-hayaai aur be-hayaai phailane wale ko pasand nahi karta. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, Qayamat nahi aayegi jab tak be-hayaai aur be-hayaai phailana, rishtedariyon ka qat'a (todna), padosiyon ke sath bura sulook, aamanat-daar ko be-imaan samjhna aur khaayin (be-imaan) ko amanat-daar samjhna aam na ho jaye. Aur momin ki misaal shehad ki makhi jaisi hai jo achhi cheez khaati hai, achhi cheez rakhti hai aur achhi jagah baithti hai, na kharaab hoti hai na tooti hai. Aur momin bande ki misaal sone ke achhe tukdon jaisi hai jise phoonka jaye to woh khoobsurat nikalta hai aur jab tola jaye to kam nahi hota.' Aur aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tumhara waada mere hawd par hai, jiski chaudai uski lambai jaisi hai, aur woh Aylah aur Makkah ke darmiyan ki masaafat se bhi zyada door hai, ya'ni aik mahine ki masaafat, ismein sitaron ki tarah surahiyan hain, iska paani chandi se zyada saaf hai, jo ismein aaye aur pi le woh phir kabhi pyaasa nahi hoga.'" Ibn Ziyad ne kaha: "Mujhe kisi ne is jaisi hadith nahi sunayi, main gawahi deta hoon ke Hawd haq aur wajib hai," aur usne woh sahifa (kaghaz) le liya jo Abu Sabrah laaye thay. Aur Abu Usama ki hadith mein hai, Abdullah bin Buraidah se, Abu Sabrah se...

e: [AI] From Abu Sabrah Al-Hudhali, he mentioned the lengthy narration.
hi: Abu Sabrah Al-Hudhali se riwayat hai, phir poori hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'My pool (in Paradise) extends from Aylah to Sana'a, its width is equivalent to its length. It has two spouts from which pouring is as abundant as the water of Jannah. One spout is made of silver and the other is made of gold. They are both more fragrant than musk and cooler than ice, and whiter than milk and smoother than butter. Within it are pitchers in number equal to the stars of the sky. Whoever drinks from it will never feel thirst until they enter Paradise.' Ayub added from Abu Al-Wazi' from Abu Barzah that the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'It will flow into the hands of the believers.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Mera hawd Aylah se Sana'a tak hai, uski chaudai uski lambai jaisi hai, ismein do naaliyan hain jo Jannat se bahti hain, unme se aik chandi ki hai aur doosri sone ki, (uska paani) shehad se zyada meetha, barf se zyada thanda, doodh se zyada safed aur makkhan se zyada narm hai. Ismein aasman ke sitaron ki tadaad jitni surahiyan hain, jo ismein se piye woh Jannat mein dakhil hone tak kabhi pyaasa nahi hoga." Ayyub ne ismein Abu Al-Wazi' se, unhone Abu Barzah (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se yeh ziyaada ki hai ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh momino ke haathon mein uchhalta (behta) hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "You are not a part of one hundred thousandth of those who will come to the Pond." They asked him, "How many will you be?" He said, "Eight hundred or nine hundred." "Abu Hamzah Al-Ansari, this is Talhah ibn Yazid, and Al-Bukhari has attested to his authenticity."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum hawd par aane walon ka aik lakhwan hissa (bhi) nahi ho." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Hum kitne thay?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aath sau ya nau sau." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Yeh Abu Hamzah Al-Ansari, ya'ni Talhah bin Yazid hain, aur Bukhari ne unse hujjat pakdi hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "You are not a part of one thousand parts who will come to me at the Fountain on the Day of Resurrection." So we asked Zaid, "How many were you then?" He said, "Between six hundred and nine hundred."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai: "Tum Qayamat ke din mere hawd par aane walon ka hazaarwan hissa (bhi) nahi ho." Hum ne Zaid (bin Thabit RA) se poocha: "Us waqt aap log kitne thay?" Unhone kaha: "Chhe sau se lekar nau sau ke darmiyan."

e: [AI] I have not received any reports about you from which I could take any information to narrate about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. You claim that he has a basin in Paradise. He informed us about it and promised it to us. But you said, "You lied. However, you are an old man who has lost his mind." As for me, I have heard it with my own ears from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I mean, I heard him saying, "Whoever intentionally lies about me, let him take his place in the Fire." And I have not lied about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
hi: "Aap se mujh tak jo ahadith pahunchi hain jo aap Rasulullah (SAW) se bayan karte hain, unmein aap dawa karte hain ke unke (Rasulullah SAW ke) liye Jannat mein aik hawd hai?" Unhone kaha: "Humein Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh bayan ki thi aur hum se iska wada kiya tha." To (dusre ne) kaha: "Tumne jhoot kaha, balke tum aik boodha shaikh ho jo bhoolne laga hai." Unhone kaha: "Meri in kaanon ne isse Rasulullah (SAW) se suna hai," - matlab, maine unhein yeh farmate hue suna: "Jo mujh par jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apna thikana Jahannam mein bana le." Aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) par jhoot nahi kaha.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever separates himself from the congregation by the length of a cubit has taken off the band of Islam from his neck until he returns to them." He said, "And whoever dies without an imam of the congregation over him, his death is a death of ignorance." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered a sermon and said, "O people, I am ahead of you at the pond (in Paradise), and its capacity is between Al-Kufah and the Black Stone, and its utensils are like the number of stars. And I saw people from my Ummah, but when they approached me, a man came out among them and said about them (to me). Then another group came and he did the same with them, and none of them escaped except like a stray camel. Abu Bakr said to Ali, "O Prophet of Allah, perhaps I am one of them?" He said, "Not you, but there are people who will come after you who will walk the path of deviation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs jama'at se aik bitte (chhoti si doori) bhi nikal jaye, usne Islam ka tauq apni gardan se utaar diya, yahan tak ke woh usi (jama'at) ki taraf laut aaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur jo shakhs is haal mein mare ke uspar jama'at ka koi imam na ho, uski maut jahiliyat ki maut hai." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne khutba diya aur farmaya: "Aye logo, main tumse pehle hawd par pahunchunga, aur uski wus'at Kufa aur Hajr-e-Aswad ke darmiyan jitni hai, aur uske bartan sitaron ki tarah (be-shumar) hain. Maine apni Ummat ke kuch logon ko dekha, jab woh mere qareeb aaye to unke saamne aik shakhs nikla aur unhe mujh se hataya, phir aik aur giroh aaya to usne bhi unke sath aisa hi kiya, yahan tak ke unme se bahut kam log bach paaye, jaise (kisi rewad ke) jaanwar bachte hain." Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Shayad main unme se hoon, aye Allah ke Nabi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke yeh woh log hain jo tumhare baad nikal ayenge aur ulti (peechhe ki) chaal chalengay."

e: [AI] "O Anas, what do you say about the Pool (in Paradise)?" He replied, "I said, 'I never thought that I would live to see anyone like you (referring to the Prophet Muhammad) drinking from the Pool. After me, there will be elderly women who have never missed a prayer, and for every prayer they have prayed, they would ask their Lord to be admitted to the Pool of Muhammad ﷺ ."
hi: "Aye Anas (RA), tum hawd ke baare mein kya kehte ho?" Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Mujhe gumaan nahi tha ke main itna zinda rahunga ke tum jaise log hawd ke baare mein shak karenge. Maine apne baad aisi boodhi auratein chhodi hain jinme se koi bhi namaz padhti to Allah se yeh dua zaroor mangti thi ke woh usse Muhammad (SAW) ke hawd par pahunchaye."

e: [AI] I entered upon Ubaidullah bin Ziyad while they were discussing and reminiscing about the pond, then he mentioned it in a similar manner to them.
hi: Main Ubaidullah bin Ziyad ki khidmat mein hazir hua jabke woh log Hawd ka zikr karte hue aapas mein bahes kar rahe thay, phir unhone isi jaisi baat bayan ki. Yeh dono ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] "He was sitting by the Prophet's door ﷺ  when he came out and we were sitting. He said, 'Listen.' We said, 'We are listening, O Messenger of Allah.' He said, 'Verily, there will be rulers after me, so do not believe them in their lies, nor support them in their cruelty. Whoever believes them in their lies and supports them in their cruelty, he will not meet me at the Fountain (in Paradise).'"
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke darwaze par baithe hue thay. Unhone kaha: aap (SAW) bahar tashreef laaye jabke hum baithe hue thay, aur farmaya: "Suno." Hum ne kaha: "Hum sun rahe hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad aisay hukmaraan aayenge, unki jhooti baaton ki tasdeeq na karna aur na hi unke zulm mein unki madad karna. Jo shakhs unki jhooti baaton ki tasdeeq kare aur unke zulm mein madad kare, woh mere hawd tak nahi pahunch payega."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us, we were made up of nine; five and four. The first of the numbers for the Arabs, and the latter for the non-Arabs. He said: 'Listen, have you heard that after me there will leaders, whoever enters upon them and condones to their lies, and supports them in their oppression, then he is not from me and I am not from him, and he shall not drink with me from the Hawd. And whoever does not enter upon them, nor help them in their oppression, nor condones to their lies, then he is from me, and I am from him, and he shall drink with me at the Hawd.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2259)
hi: Aik din Rasulullah (SAW) hamare paas tashreef laaye jabke hum masjid mein thay, paanch Arab aur chaar Ajami. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum sun rahe ho?" Hum ne kaha: "Hum ne do martaba (haan) sun liya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suno, mere baad aise hukmaraan aayengay, jo koi unke paas jaye aur unki jhooti baaton ki tasdeeq kare aur unke zulm mein unki madad kare, woh mujh se nahi aur main us se nahi, aur woh mere hawd par nahi pahunchega. Aur jo unke paas na jaye, na unki jhooti baaton ki tasdeeq kare aur na unke zulm mein madad kare, woh mujh se hai aur main usse hoon, aur woh mere hawd par pahunchega." Ise Mis'ar bin Kidam aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne Abu Hasin se, unhone Ash-Sha'bi se, unhone Aasim Al-Adawi se, unhone Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) se riwayat kiya hai. Ab Ath-Thawri ki hadith yeh hai...

e: "The Messenger of Allah came out to us, and there were nine of us. He said; 'After me there will be rulers, whoever believes in their lies and helps them in their wrongdoing is not of me, and I am not of him, and he will not come to me at the Cistern. Whoever does not believe their lies and does not help them in their wrongdoing, he is of me, and I am of hi, and he will come to me at the Cistern."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4207)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) hamare paas tashreef laaye jabke hum nau (log) thay, aur hamare darmiyan surkh chamdey ke takiye rakhe thay. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad aise hukmaraan aayengay, jo unki jhooti baaton ki tasdeeq kare aur unke zulm mein unki madad kare, woh mujh se nahi aur main usse nahi, aur woh mere hawd par kabhi nahi pahunchega. Aur jo unki jhooti baaton ki tasdeeq na kare aur unke zulm mein madad na kare, woh mujh se hai aur main usse hoon, aur woh mere hawd par pahunchega." Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke is farmaan ka gawah diya hai, jo Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) ke liye kaha gaya tha.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to Ka'ab ibn 'Ujrah, "May Allah protect you, O Ka'ab ibn 'Ujrah, from the rule of fools." Ka'ab asked, "What is the rule of fools?" The Prophet replied, "They are rulers who will come after me, neither following my guidance nor adhering to my Sunnah. Whoever believes in their lies and supports them in their injustice is not one of me, and I am not one of them. They will not join me at my Fountain. But those who do not believe in their lies and do not support them in their injustice are truly from me, and I am from them. They will join me at my Fountain. O Ka'ab ibn 'Ujrah, fasting is a shield, charity extinguishes sins, and prayers are either an offering or a proof."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Ka'b bin Ujrah, Allah tumhein na-samajh (be-wuqoof) hukmaraanon ki hukumat se bachaye." Unhone poocha: "Na-samajh hukmaraanon ki hukumat kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aise hukmaraan jo mere baad aayenge, na meri hidayat par chalengay aur na meri sunnat apnayenge. Jo unki jhooti baaton ki tasdeeq kare aur unke zulm mein unki madad kare, aise log mujh se nahi hain aur main unse nahi hoon, aur woh mere hawd par nahi pahunchengay. Aur jo unki jhooti baaton ki tasdeeq na kare aur unke zulm mein madad na kare, aise log mujh se hain aur main unse hoon, aur woh mere hawd par pahunchengay. Aye Ka'b bin Ujrah, roza (aik) dhaal hai, sadaqah gunah ko bujha deta hai, aur namaz (Allah ke) qareeb le jane wali cheez hai - ya farmaya: (Eman ki) daleel hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I entered Paradise and there I saw a river, on the banks of which were tents made of pearls. I struck the water with my hand and it emitted a fragrance of musk. I said to Jibril, 'What is this?' He replied, 'This is Al-Kawthar which your Lord, Exalted and Mighty, has granted you.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Jannat mein dakhil hua to dekha aik nahar beh rahi hai jiske kinaron par moti ke khaimay hain. Maine apna haath us paani ki dhaar mein daala to dekha khushbudaar mushk hai. Maine Jibra'il (AS) se poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh Al-Kawthar hai jo tumhare Rab Azza wa Jalla ne tumhein diya hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Paradise has one hundred levels, between each two levels is like the distance between the heavens and the earth. And the highest level of Paradise is Al-Firdaus, and from it springs the rivers of Paradise. So when you ask Allah, ask Him for Al-Firdaus."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ke sau (100) darje hain, har do darjon ke darmiyan itna faasla hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan hai. Aur Firdaus unme sabse ooncha darja hai, aur ussi se Jannat ki nadiyan phootti hain. Jab tum Allah se maango to Firdaus maango."

e: [AI] About the Prophet, peace be upon him, in a similar manner, it was narrated with an authentic chain of narrators from Ubada bin As-Samit, following their conditions.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai, aur isi tarah aik sahih sanad ke sath Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) se bhi riwayat hui hai. Yeh dono ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Paradise has one hundred levels, between each two levels there is a distance like that between the heavens and the earth. And Al-Firdaus is the highest level of Paradise, from which the rivers of Paradise spring forth. So when you ask Allah, ask Him for Al-Firdaus."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ke sau darje hain, har do darjon ke darmiyan itna faasla hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan hai. Aur Firdaus unme sabse ooncha darja hai, aur ussi se Jannat ki nadiyan phootti hain. Jab tum Allah se maango to Firdaus maango."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ʿIn Paradise there are chambers the inside of which can be seen from the outside and the outside can be seen from the inside.ʿ A Bedouin said: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who are they for? He said: “For the one who speaks kind words, feeds people and prays to Allah at night when people are asleep.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1338)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Jannat mein kuch aise kamre hain jinka bahar ka hissa andar se aur andar ka hissa bahar se dekha ja sakta hai." Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (RA) ne poocha: "Yeh kiske liye hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ke liye jo achhi baat kare, khana khilaye, aur raat ko (namaz mein) khada rahe jab log soye huay hon."

e: [AI] From Anas, in his statement {by the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary}, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "A tree was raised for me whose boundaries reach the seventh heaven. Its fruits are like the baskets of Hiraa, and its leaves are like the ears of elephants. Two visible rivers flow from its trunk, and two hidden rivers flow from it." I said: "O Jibril, what are these?" He said: "As for the hidden rivers, they are in Paradise, and as for the visible rivers, they are the Nile and the Euphrates."
hi: Anas (RA) se riwayat hai, Allah Azza wa Jalla ke farmaan 'Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas' (Surah An-Najm 14) ke baare mein, ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere liye aik sidra (bairi ka darakht) uthaya gaya jiski aakhri hadd saatwe aasman mein thi, uske phal Hajar (shehar) ke matkon jaise the, aur uske pattay haathi ke kaanon jaise the. Uske tane se do zaahiri nahrein aur do baatini nahrein niklin." Maine poocha: "Aye Jibra'il (AS), yeh kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Baatini nahrein Jannat mein hain, aur zaahiri nahrein Nile aur Furat hain."

e: [AI] He said, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I was lifted to the Sidrah (lote tree) when there were four rivers, two visible and two hidden. As for the visible ones, they are the Nile and the Euphrates, and as for the hidden ones, they are two rivers in Paradise. I was brought three cups, one filled with milk, one filled with honey, and one filled with wine. So I took the one with milk and drank from it. It was said to me, 'You have chosen the Fitrah (natural disposition) for yourself and your nation.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere liye Sidra uthayi gayi, to dekha chaar nahrein hain, do zaahiri aur do baatini. Zaahiri nahrein Nile aur Furat hain, aur baatini nahrein Jannat ki do nahrein hain. Aur mere paas teen pyaale laaye gaye: aik pyaala doodh ka, aik shehad ka aur aik sharab ka. Maine woh liya jismein doodh tha aur pi liya, to mujhse kaha gaya: 'Tumne aur tumhari Ummat ne fitrat (paak deen) ko paa liya.'"

e: "The people of Paradise are a hundred and twenty rows, eighty of them are from this nation, and forty are from the rest of the nations." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2546)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat waalon ki sau bees (120) safein hongi, is Ummat ki unme se assi (80) safein hongi."

e: [AI] Abu Ali al-Hafiz narrated to us that Abdan al-Ahwazi informed us that al-Hasan ibn al-Harith informed him that Mu'ammal ibn Isma'il informed him that Sufyan reported to us and Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi informed us that Muhammad ibn Ghaleb informed him that Abdullah ibn Umar narrated to him from Amr ibn Muhammad al-Anqazi from Sufyan from Alqamah ibn Marthad from Sulaiman ibn Buraida from his father that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The people of Paradise are eighty from this Ummah." This hadith was transmitted by Yahya ibn Sa'id and Abdul Rahman ibn Mahdi from ath-Thawri.
hi: Humein Abu Ali Al-Hafiz ne bataya, unhein Abdan Al-Ahwazi ne bataya, unhein Al-Hasan bin Al-Harith ne bataya, unhein Mu'ammal bin Isma'il ne bataya, unhein Sufyan ne bataya. Aur humein Bakr bin Muhammad As-Sairafi ne bataya, unhein Muhammad bin Ghalib ne bataya, unhein Abdullah bin Umar ne bataya, unhein Amr bin Muhammad Al-Anqazi ne Sufyan se, unhone Alqamah bin Marthad se, unhone Sulaiman bin Buraidah se, unhone apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat waalon ki sau bees (120) safein hain, unme se assi (80) is Ummat mein se hain." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Ise Yahya bin Sa'eed aur Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi ne Ath-Thawri se mursal (bagair sahabi ke) riwayat kiya hai."

e: [AI] "We have the Messenger of Allah ﷺ among us, and he asked, 'How many of you are from the people of Paradise?' We replied, 'Many.' He then asked, 'How about you and the third?' We said, 'That is even more.' He asked, 'How about you and half?' We said, 'That is the majority.' He said, 'The people of Paradise are 120 ranks, and you are 80 ranks among them.' We asked, 'Then, what about the remaining two-thirds, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'Indeed.' 'Abdul Rahman ibn 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud did not hear from his father about most of the conversations.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) hamare darmiyan (baithe) thay aur hum unke gird thay, (aap SAW ne farmaya:) "Tumhara kya khayal hai, kya tum Jannat waalon ka chautha hissa ho?" Hum ne kaha: "Yeh to bohot zyada hoga." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhara kya khayal hai, kya tum tihaai ho?" Hum ne kaha: "Yeh (bhi) zyada hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhara kya khayal hai, kya tum aadha ho?" Hum ne kaha: "Yeh (bhi) zyada hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat waalon ki sau bees (120) safein hain, tum unme se assi (80) safein ho." Hum ne kaha: "To phir baaqi do tihaai kya hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan (yehi sahih hai)." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Abdur Rahman bin Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne aksar riwayaton mein apne walid se (seedha) nahi suna."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, Allah, the Almighty, will ask them, 'Do you desire anything more so that I may increase it for you?' They will reply, 'Our Lord, what more can we desire when You have given us everything?' He will say, 'My pleasure is greater than all that.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Jannat waale Jannat mein dakhil hongay, Allah Azza wa Jalla farmayenge: "Kya tumhein kisi cheez ki khwahish hai ke main tumhein aur dun?" Woh kahengay: "Aye humare Rab, jo tune humein diya hai usse zyada kya hoga?" Allah farmayenge: "Meri raza (khushi) sabse badi (cheez) hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, will say, 'Shall I not inform you of something greater than this?' They will say, 'Yes, O Allah! What is greater than this?' He will say, 'My pleasure.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab Jannat waale Jannat mein dakhil hongay, Allah Azza wa Jalla farmayenge: "Kya main tumhein isse badi cheez na batau?" Woh kahengay: "Kyun nahi, isse badi kya cheez hai?" Allah farmayenge: "Woh Raza (meri khushnoodi) hai."

e: ‘Death will be brought on the Day of Resurrection and made to stand on the Sirat (the Bridge over Hell). It will be said: “O people of Paradise!” And they will look. Anxious and afraid lest they be brought out of the place they are in. Then it will be said: “O people of Hell!” and they will look, hoping that they will be brought out of the place they are in. Then it will be said: “Do you know what this is?” They will say: “Yes, this is Death.” Then the command will be given for it to be slaughtered on the Sirat, and it will be said to both groups: “It is eternal wherever you are, and there will never be any death therein.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4327)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Qayamat ke din maut ko aik chitkabre mendhe ki shakl mein laaya jayega, phir kaha jayega: "Aye Jannat walo!" To woh (Jannat waale) darte hue aur khauf-zada ho kar jhaanke ngey, is dar se ke kahin unhein us cheez se nikal na diya jaye jismein woh hain. Kaha jayega: "Kya tum ise pehchante ho?" Woh kahengay: "Haan, yeh maut hai." Phir kaha jayega: "Aye Jahannam walo!" To woh khushi aur khush-o-khurrami se jhaankengay, is ummeed mein ke shayad unhein us cheez se nikal diya jaye jismein woh hain. Kaha jayega: "Kya tum ise pehchante ho?" Woh kahengay: "Haan, yeh maut hai." Phir uske zibah karne ka hukum diya jayega aur use Siraat par zibah kar diya jayega, phir dono giroh se kaha jayega: "Ab tum jis haal mein ho usme hamesha rahoge, ab kabhi maut nahi aayegi."

e: [AI] "The arrival of death on the Day of Resurrection is mentioned as 'And as for the hadith of Abdul Wahhab bin Abdul Majid, it is quoted."
hi: "Qayamat ke din maut ko laaya jayega," phir hadith mauqoof (ya'ni raawi tak mahdood, Nabi (SAW) tak marfoo' nahi) bayan ki. Ab Abdul Wahhab bin Abdul Majid ki hadith yeh hai...

e: [AI] From Abu Hurairah: "The two sheikhs agreed to narrate this hadith with a different wording from the narration of Al-A'mash from Abu Salih from Abu Sa'eed." This is according to the condition set by Muslim.
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai. (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ne is hadith ko doosre alfaz ke sath, Al-A'mash ki Abu Salih se, unhone Abu Sa'eed (RA) se riwayat mein nikala hai." Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] "O my sons, indeed I am the messenger of Allah ﷺ. You know the destination, to Allah and then to Paradise or to Hellfire. It is an eternal stay wherein there is no weakening, and an everlasting existence in bodies that do not die."
hi: "Aye Bani Aud, main Allah ka Rasool hoon, tum jaante ho ke wapas laut'na Allah ki taraf hai, phir ya Jannat ya Jahannam ki taraf, jahan hamesha rehna hai, na wahan se ja sakoge, aur hamesha rahoge, kabhi maut nahi hogi, un jismon mein jo kabhi nahi marengay."

e: [AI] Abu Musa said about the saying of Allah Almighty: "And for those who fear the position of their Lord, there will be two gardens" [Ar-Rahman verse 46]. He said: "Two gardens of gold for those who race ahead and two gardens of silver for those who follow." This is an authentic chain of narration according to the conditions of Imam Muslim. However, they did not mention it like this. Rather, they cited it from the narration of Al-Harith ibn 'Ubayd and 'Abdul 'Aziz ibn 'Abdus Samad from Abu Imran Al-Jawni from Abu Bakr ibn Abu Musa from his father who narrated it from the Prophet ﷺ. The hadith mentions "two gardens of silver" but does not mention the "racing ahead" and "following" parts. I heard Abu Hasan 'Ali ibn 'Umar Al-Hafiz saying that he heard Abu Fadl Al-Wazir saying that he heard Ma'mun Al-Misri saying: I asked Abu 'Abdul Rahman An-Nasai, "Why did Muhammad ibn Ismail leave the hadith of Hammad ibn Salamah?" He said, "By Allah, Hammad ibn Salamah is more reliable and truthful than Ismail ibn Abi Uways." And he mentioned a long story similar to the replacement of Al-Harith ibn 'Ubayd with Hammad.
hi: Abu Musa (RA) se riwayat hai, Allah Azza wa Jalla ke farmaan ke baare mein: "Aur jo apne Rab ke saamne khade hone se dara, uske liye do baagh hain" (Surah Ar-Rahman 46), unhone kaha: "Do baagh sone ke un logon ke liye jo sabqat (aage) le gaye, aur do baagh chandi ke un logon ke liye jo pairavi karne wale (taabi'in) hain." Yeh sanad Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, magar dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ne ise is tarah nahi nikala, balke unhone ise Al-Harith bin Ubaid aur Abdul Aziz bin Abdus Samad ki, Abu Imran Al-Jauni se, unhone Abu Bakr bin Abi Musa se, unhone apne walid se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai: 'Chandi ke do baagh...' hadith, jismein sabiqeen aur taabi'in ka zikr nahi hai. Maine Abu Al-Hasan Ali bin Umar Al-Hafiz ko kehte hue suna, unhone Abu Al-Fadl Al-Wazir ko kehte hue suna, unhone Ma'mun Al-Misri ko kehte hue suna, unhone kaha: maine Abu Abdur Rahman An-Nasa'i se poocha: "Muhammad bin Isma'il ne Hammad bin Salamah ki hadith kyun chhod di?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Hammad bin Salamah, Isma'il bin Abi Uwais se behtar aur zyada sachche hain," aur unhone aik lambi kahani bayan ki jo Al-Harith bin Ubaid ki Hammad ki jagah lene se milti julti hai. Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "On the Day of Judgment, it will be like the duration between Dhuhr (noon) and Asr (afternoon prayer)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qayamat ka din, Zuhr aur Asr ke darmiyan jitna waqt hota hai utna hoga."

e: [AI] "On the Day of Resurrection, the believers will be held accountable as much as the time between noon and afternoon."
hi: "Qayamat ka din momino par, Zuhr aur Asr ke darmiyan jitna waqt hota hai utna hoga."

e: [AI] "He informed me that you spoke about a matter related to destiny, so beware of writing to me about it. I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Indeed, there will be people in my Ummah who will deny destiny.'"
hi: "Mujhe pata chala hai ke tumne qadr ke baare mein kuch baat ki hai, khabardar mujhe (aisi baat) na likhna, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Meri Ummat mein aise log hongay jo qadr ko jhutlayengay.'"

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The Qadariyyah are the Magians of this community. If they are ill, do not pay a sick visit to them, and if they die, do not attend their funerals. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4691)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qadariyyah is Ummat ke Majoos (aatish-parast) hain. Agar woh bimar hon to unki ayadat na karo, aur agar woh mar jayen to unke janaze mein shirkat na karo."

e: Ibn ʿUmar used to send his Hadi from Jam' (to Mina) in the last third of the night with the pilgrims amongst whom there were free men and slaves, till it was taken into the Manhar (slaughtering place) of the Prophet ﷺ . (Using translation from Bukhārī 1711)
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) apna Hadi (qurbani ka janwar) Jam' (Muzdalifah) se raat ke aakhri tihaai mein hajiyon ke sath bhej diya karte the, jinme aazad aur ghulam dono shamil hote, yahan tak ke use Nabi (SAW) ke Manhar (zibah karne ki jagah) tak pahuncha diya jata.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The most complete of the believers in faith are those with the best character.”
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momino mein sabse mukammal Eman waala woh hai jiska akhlaq sabse achha ho."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The most perfect believer in respect of faith is he who is best of them in manners. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4682)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momino mein sabse mukammal Eman waala woh hai jiska akhlaq sabse achha ho."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Whoever desires to taste the sweetness of faith, let them love a person only for the sake of Allah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise achha lage ke woh Eman ki mithaas mehsoos kare, to use chahiye ke woh kisi insaan se sirf Allah ki khatir mohabbat kare."

e: “Why are you weeping?” He said: “I am weeping because of something that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘A little showing off is polytheism and whoever shows enmity towards a friend of Allah has declared war on Allah. Allah loves those who se righteousness and piety are hidden, those who, if they are absent, are not missed, and if they are present, they are not invited or acknowledged. Their hearts are lamps of guidance and they get out of every trial and difficulty.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3989)
hi: Umar (RA) aik din masjid ki taraf nikle to unhone Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ki qabar ke paas rote hue paaya. Unhone poocha: "Kis baat ne tumhein rulaya, aye Mu'adh?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe aik hadith ne rulaya jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suni thi, aap (SAW) farma rahe the: 'Zara sa riya (dikhawa) bhi shirk hai, aur jo Allah ke waliyon se dushmani rakhe, usne Allah se jang chhed di. Beshak Allah un neko-kaar, muttaqi aur poshida (gumnaam) logon se mohabbat karta hai jo agar gaib ho jayen to unhein talaash nahi kiya jata, aur agar hazir hon to unhein pehchana nahi jata. Unke dil hidayat ke chiraagh hain, woh har tareeki-bhare andhere se nikal aate hain.'"

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, *"Īmān (faith) wears out (deteriorates) within ˹the depths˺ of each one of you just as worn out clothing has been worn out. Therefore, ask Allah to renew Īmān in your hearts."*[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Eman tum mein se kisi ke seene mein isi tarah purana ho jata hai jaise kapda purana ho jata hai, isliye Allah se dua karo ke woh tumhare dilon mein Eman ko naya kar de."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “When the servant ˹of Allah˺ commits a sin, a black spot appears upon his heart. If he repents, it is polished away. But if he repeats, ˹the black spot˺ increases until it grows large in his heart. That is the "rān" that Allah mentions in His Book: “Nay! But on their hearts is the rān...” [Muṭaffifīn 83:14][^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab banda gunah karta hai to uske dil par aik kaala nishaan lag jata hai. Agar woh tauba kare to woh chamka diya jata hai, aur agar woh dobara (gunah) kare to woh (nishaan) badh jata hai yahan tak ke uske dil par chha jata hai, aur yahi woh 'raan' (zang) hai jiska zikr Allah Ta'ala ne kiya hai: 'Hargiz nahi, balke unke dilon par unke amal ka zang chadh gaya hai' (Surah Al-Mutaffifin 14)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to be asked about the Hour until the verse was revealed, "About what are they asking one another? About the great news (i.e., the Hour) - that concerning which they are in disagreement. No! They are going to know." [An-Naba' 1-3]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se Qayamat ke baare mein baar baar poocha jata raha, yahan tak ke yeh ayat nazil hui: "Tumhein iska zikr karne se kya (fayda), iska ilm to tumhare Rab ke paas hai" (Surah An-Nazi'at 44).

e: "If a person says: 'La ilaha illallahu wa Allahu Akbar (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Allah is the Most Great),'Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, and I am the Most Great.' If a person says: La ilaha Illallah wahdahu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone), Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, alone.' If he says, La ilaha illallahu la sharikalahu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah with no partner or associate),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, with no partner or associate.' If he says: 'La illah illallah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah, all dominion is His and all praise is to Him),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none of worthy of worship except I, all dominion Mine and all praise is due to Me.' If he says: ' La illaha illallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is none worthy of worship and there is no power and no strength except with Allah),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken then truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, and tehre is no power and no strength except with Me.' One of the narrators Abu Ishaq said: "Then Agharr (another narrator) said something that I did not understand. I said to Abu Jafar: 'What did he say?' He said: 'Whoever is blessed with (the ability to say) them (these words) at the time of death, the Fire will not touch him.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3794)
hi: In dono ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein gawahi di, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab banda kahe: 'La ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar,' to uska Rab uski tasdeeq karta hai aur farmata hai: 'Mere bande ne sach kaha, mere siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main akela hoon.' Aur jab woh kahe: 'La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu,' to uska Rab uski tasdeeq karta hai aur farmata hai: 'Mere bande ne sach kaha, mere siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur mera koi shareek nahi.' Aur jab woh kahe: 'La ilaha illallah lahul mulku wa lahul hamd,' to Allah farmata hai: 'Mere bande ne sach kaha, mere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, mulk mera hai aur hamd meri hai.' Aur jab woh kahe: 'La ilaha illallah wa la hawla wala quwwata illa billah,' to Allah farmata hai: 'Mere bande ne sach kaha, mujhe chhod kar na koi taaqat hai na koi qudrat.'"

e: “A man from my nation will be called before all of creation on the Day of Resurrection, and ninety-nine scrolls will be spread out for him, each one extending as far as the eye can see. Then Allah will say: “Do you deny anything of this?” He will say: “No, O Lord.” He will say: “Have My recording scribes been unfair to you?” Then He will say: “Apart from that, do you have any good deeds?” The man will be terrified and will say: “No.” (Allah) will say: “Indeed, you have good deeds with Us, and you will not be treated unjustly this Day.” Then a card will be brought out on which is written Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasuluhu (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger). He will say: “O Lord, what is this card compared with these scrolls?” He will say: “You will not be treated unjustly.” Then the scrolls will be placed in one side of the Balance and the card in the other. The scrolls will go up (i.e., be light) and the card will go down (i.e., will weigh heavily).” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4300)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Qayamat ke din Allah meri Ummat mein se aik shakhs ko tamam makhlooq ke saamne chun lega, uske saamne ninyanwe (99) daftar (register) khole jayenge, har daftar itna lamba jitni nazar jaaye. Phir Allah farmayega: "Kya tum ismein se kisi cheez ka inkaar karte ho? Kya mere hifazat karne wale likhne walon ne tum par zulm kiya?" Woh kahega: "Nahi, aye Rab." Allah farmayega: "Kya tumhara koi uzr hai?" Woh kahega: "Nahi, aye Rab." Allah farmayega: "Kyun nahi, tumhari aik neki humare paas hai, aur aaj tum par koi zulm nahi hoga." Phir aik parchi (card) nikaali jayegi jismein likha hoga: "Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluh." Woh kahega: "Aye Rab, is chhoti si parchi ka in itne daftaron ke saamne kya wazan?" Allah farmayega: "Beshak tum par zulm nahi hoga." Phir woh daftar aik pallay mein rakhe jayengay aur woh parchi doosre pallay mein, to daftar halke pad jayengay aur parchi bhaari ho jayegi, aur Allah ke naam ke sath koi cheez bhaari nahi ho sakti.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The Jews were split up into seventy-one or seventy-two sects; and the Christians were split up into seventy one or seventy-two sects; and my community will be split up into seventy-three sects. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4596)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yahood ikhattar (71) ya bahattar (72) firqon mein bant gaye, aur Nasara bhi isi tarah, aur meri Ummat tehattar (73) firqon mein bant jayegi."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The covenant that distinguishes between us and them is prayer; so whoever leaves it, he has committed Kufr.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1079)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh ahd (waada) jo humare aur unke (kufr karne walon ke) darmiyan hai, namaz hai, to jo shakhs ise chhod de, usne kufr kiya."

e: [AI] "The companions of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) did not consider any act, except for prayer, to be a form of disbelief."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) kisi bhi amal ko chhorne ko kufr nahi samajhte thay, siwaye namaz ke.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ʿWhoever commits a sin in this world and is punished therein. Allah is too generous to repeat His punishment of His slave [in the Hereafter], whoever commits a sin in this world and Allah conceals it and pardons him, Allah is too generous to retract His pardon when He has granted it.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 775)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis shakhs ko koi hadd (shar'i saza) laage aur Allah usse duniya mein hi jaldi saza de de, to Allah is se zyada adal-pasand hai ke apne bande ko aakhirat mein dobara saza de. Aur jis shakhs ko koi hadd laage aur Allah usse chhupa de aur maaf kar de, to Allah is se zyada karam wala hai ke jise woh maaf kar chuka ho usme dobara pakde."

e: [AI] He was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when a man came to him with a horse that he was riding and a mare following him. He asked him, "Who are you?" He said, "I am a prophet." He asked, "What kind of prophet?" He said, "The Messenger of Allah." He asked, "When will the Hour (Day of Judgment) be established?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is knowledge that is only with Allah and no one knows about it except Him." He said, "Show me your sword." So the Prophet ﷺ gave him his sword. The man shook it and then returned it to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, you were not able to do what you wanted to." He said, "And he (the Prophet) had said to him, 'Go to him and ask him about these characteristics.'"
