hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath thay, ke aik shakhs aik ghoray ko le kar aaya jismein uski bachhiya (foal) bhi uske peechhe thi, usne poocha: "Tum kaun ho?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Nabi hoon." Usne poocha: "Kaunsa Nabi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ka Rasool." Usne poocha: "Qayamat kab qaim hogi?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh ghaib ki baat hai, aur ghaib sirf Allah jaanta hai." Usne kaha: "Mujhe apni talwar dikhaiye." Nabi (SAW) ne usse apni talwar de di. Us shakhs ne usse hilaya, phir wapas kar di. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suno, tum woh nahi kar sakte the jo tum karna chahte the." Ravi ne kaha: aap (SAW) ne (kisi aur se) farmaya tha: "Uske paas jao aur usse in khasail ke baare mein poocho."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever has intercourse with a menstruating woman, or with a woman in her rear, or who goes to a fortuneteller and believes what he says, he has disbelieved in that which was revealed to Muhammad.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 639)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs kisi (nujoom/ghaib bataane wale) 'arraaf' ya kaahin ke paas jaye aur uski baaton ki tasdeeq kare, usne us cheez ka inkaar kar diya jo Muhammad (SAW) par nazil ki gayi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "There is no soul on earth that dies while not associating anything with Allah, testifying that I am the Messenger of Allah, that it does not return to a confident heart, except that Allah forgives it." I said, "Have you heard this from Mu'adh?" They rebuked me and said, "Leave him alone, for he did not say anything wrong." Yes, I heard it from Mu'adh bin Jabal, and Mu'adh claimed that he heard it from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zameen par koi jaan aisi nahi jo mar jaye is haal mein ke woh Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na thehraye, aur gawahi de ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon, aur yeh (Eman) uske yaqeen rakhne wale dil se ho, magar Allah usse maaf kar dega." (Ravi ne kaha:) maine poocha: "Kya aapne yeh Mu'adh (RA) se suna?" Log mujh par naraaz huay, to (raawi ne) kaha: "Isse chhodo, isne buri baat nahi kahi. Haan, maine yeh Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) se suna, aur Mu'adh ka dawa tha ke unhone yeh Rasulullah (SAW) se suna."

e: Shyness and hesitation in speech are two branches of Iman, ˹while˺ crudeness and ˹bluntness˺ are two branches of hypocrisy."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haya aur kam-goi (kum bolna), Eman ki do shaakhein hain, aur badzabani aur zabaan-daraazi, nifaq ki do shaakhein hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Cleanliness is a part of faith, cleanliness is a part of faith." "A Muslim has raised his argument by the good deeds of Saleh ibn Abi Saleh Samman." A Muslim has raised his argument.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sadgi (saadi zindagi/be-takalluf rehna) Eman mein se hai, sadgi Eman mein se hai." Muslim ne Salih bin Abi Salih As-Samman se hujjat pakdi hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say on the Day of Arafah: "Worship your Lord, perform your five daily prayers, fast during your month (Ramadan), give your wealth in charity, and obey those in charge of you, and you will enter the Paradise of your Lord."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Hajjat-ul-Wida ke din farmate hue suna: "Apne Rab ki ibadat karo, apni paanch namazein padho, apne mahine (Ramzan) ke roze rakho, apne maal ki zakat ada karo, aur apne hukmaraan ki itaa'at karo, tum apne Rab ki Jannat mein dakhil ho jaoge."

e: "A Jew said to his companion: 'Let us go to this Prophet.' His companion said to him: 'Do not say Prophet; if he hears you, he will become big-headed.' So they came to the Messenger of Allah [SAW] and asked him about nine clear signs. He said to them: 'Do not associate anything with Allah, do not steal, do not commit adultery, do not kill any soul whom Allah has forbidden you to kill, except by right, do not speak falsely about an innocent man before a ruler, do not engage in magic, do not consume Riba (usury), do not slander chaste women, and do not flee on the day of the march (to battle). And for you Jews especially, do not break the Sabbath.' They kissed his hands and feet and said: 'We bear witness that you are a Prophet.' He said: 'What is keeping you from following me?' They said: 'Dawud prayed that there would always be a Prophet among his descendants, and we are afraid that if we follow you, the Jews will kill us.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4078)
hi: Aik yahoodi ne apne saathi se kaha: "Chalo hum is Nabi (SAW) ke paas chalein, humein is ayat ke baare mein poochna hai: 'Aur beshak humne Musa (AS) ko nau roshan nishaniyan di thin' (Surah Al-Isra 101)." Doosre ne kaha: "Ise Nabi na kaho, agar usne sun liya to iski chaar aankhein ho jayengi (matlab ghamand mein aa jayega)." (Ravi ne kaha:) unhone (Nabi SAW se) poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na thehrao, chori na karo, zina na karo, kisi jaan ko na-haq qatl na karo jise Allah ne haram qaraar diya hai, jaadu na karo, sood na khao, kisi be-gunah ko kisi hukmaraan ke paas le jakar qatl na karwao, kisi paak-daaman aurat par tohmat na lagao, aur tum yahood khaas taur par, sabt (haftay) ke din hadd se na badho." To un dono ne aap (SAW) ke haath aur pair choom liye aur kaha: "Hum gawahi dete hain ke aap Nabi hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Phir tumhein Musalman hone se kya rok raha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Dawud (AS) ne dua ki thi ke unki nasl mein hamesha koi Nabi rahe, aur humein dar hai ke yahood humein qatl kar denge."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "By Allah, he does not believe, by Allah, he does not believe, by Allah, he does not believe." They said, "And what is that, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "A neighbor who is not safe from his neighbor's mischief." They said, "And what is his mischief?" He said, "His evil."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, woh Eman nahi laaya, Allah ki qasam, woh Eman nahi laaya, Allah ki qasam, woh Eman nahi laaya." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Yeh kaun hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh padosi jiska padosi uski takleefon se mahfooz na ho." Unhone poocha: "Uski takleefein kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uski burai."

e: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the people are safe, and the believer is the one from whom the people's lives and wealth are safe." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4995)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman woh hai jiski zabaan aur haath se doosre Musalman mahfooz rahein, aur momin woh hai jispar log apni jaan aur maal ke maamle mein bharosa karein."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The most complete of believers is the one who the Muslims are safe from his tongue and hand."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse mukammal momin woh hai jiski zabaan aur haath se Musalman mahfooz rahein."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (Peace be upon him) said during the Farewell Pilgrimage, "Shall I inform you about the believer? The believer is the one whom people trust with their lives and wealth. And a Muslim is one from whose tongue and hands other Muslims are safe. And the Mujahid (striver in the cause of Allah) is the one who strives against his soul in obedience to Allah. And the Muhajir (emigrant) is the one who emigrates from sins and wrongdoing." There is another addition to the condition of being a Muslim that Al-Dhahabi omitted in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke moqe par farmaya: "Kya main tumhe momin ke baare mein na bataun? Woh shakhs jispar log apni jaan aur maal ke maamle mein bharosa karein. Aur Musalman woh hai jiski zabaan aur haath se Musalman mahfooz rahein. Aur mujahid woh hai jo Allah ki itaa'at mein apne nafs se jihaad kare. Aur muhajir woh hai jo khataon aur gunahon ko chhod de." Iska aik aur izafa Muslim ki shart par hai jise dono ne nahi nikala. Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The believer is the one whom people trust, and the Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe. And the migrant is the one who leaves evil. By the One in whose hand is my soul, no one enters Paradise without his neighbors being safe from his harm."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin woh hai jispar log bharosa karein, aur Musalman woh hai jiski zabaan aur haath se Musalman mahfooz rahein, aur muhajir woh hai jo burai chhod de. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, koi banda Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga jiska padosi uski takleefon se mahfooz na ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered a speech and said, "Beware of injustice, for indeed, injustice will be darkness on the Day of Resurrection. Beware of indecency and obscenity. Beware of greed, for those who came before you were destroyed because of their greed. They cut off ties of kinship and they were miserly. They committed immoral deeds and transgressions." A man stood up and asked, "O Messenger of Allah, which aspect of Islam is the best?" He replied, "That the Muslims are safe from your tongue and hand." The man then asked, "O Messenger of Allah, which migration is better?" He replied, "To migrate from what Allah dislikes." The migration has two types: the migration of the one who resides and the migration of the one who travels. The migration of the one who travels is to respond when called upon and to obey when commanded. The migration of the one who resides is greater in difficulty and better in reward. They both fulfill the requirements of this Hadith. This Hadith was narrated by Al-Sha'bi from Ibn Umar in summary, while Abi Kathir Zuhair bin Al-Aqmar Al-Zubaidi heard it from Ali and Abdullah bin Masood, and after them, from the Sahaba (companions of the Prophet). This Hadith is narrated in its entirety by Al-A'mash, from Amr bin Murrah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein khutba diya aur farmaya: "Zulm se bacho, kyunke zulm Qayamat ke din andheron ka sabab banega. Aur fahashi aur be-hayaai se bacho. Aur kanjoosi (bukhl/shuh) se bacho, kyunke tum se pehle log kanjoosi ki wajah se hi halaak huay - unhein rishtedariyan todne ka hukum diya gaya to unhone toda, kanjoosi karne ka hukum diya gaya to unhone ki, aur fajr (bad-amali) karne ka hukum diya gaya to unhone ki." Aik shakhs khada hua aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsa Islam sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh ke Musalman tumhari zabaan aur haath se mahfooz rahein." Ussi shakhs ne ya kisi doosre ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsi hijrat sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh ke tum us cheez ko chhod do jo tumhare Rab ko napasand ho." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hijrat do tarah ki hai: shehar mein rehne wale ki hijrat aur dehat mein rehne wale ki hijrat. Dehat waale ki hijrat yeh hai ke jab bulaya jaye to jawaab de aur jab hukum diya jaye to maane. Aur shehar waale ki hijrat sabse zyada aazmaish wali aur sabse zyada ajr wali hai." (Al-Hakim kehte hain:) "Dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ne Ash-Sha'bi ki, Abdullah bin Amr se, mukhtasar riwayat nikali hai, lekin yeh hadith unhone nahi nikali. Amr bin Murrah aur Abdullah bin Al-Harith An-Najrani par dono ka ittifaq hai. Rahi baat Abu Kathir Zuhair bin Al-Aqmar Az-Zubaidi ki, to unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ko aur unke baad ke sahaba (RA) ko suna hai. Yehi hadith Al-A'mash ke paas Amr bin Murrah se bhi (isi tarah) hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Beware of injustice." He mentioned the hadith in its entirety, "And for these additional narrations that we mentioned from Abdullah bin Amr." It is a valid witness according to the conditions of Muslim, from the narration of Abu Huraira and Amr, agreed upon by Amr and Abdullah bin Al-Harith Al-Najrani. As for Abu Kathir Zuhair bin Al-Aqmar Al-Zubaydi, he heard from Ali and Abdullah, and it was narrated by Al-Amash from Al-Amash from Amr.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zulm se bacho." Phir puri hadith ka zikr kiya. Aur in izafi riwayaton ka jo humne Abdullah bin Amr se zikr kiya hai, Muslim ki shart par aik sahih shahid Abu Hurairah (RA) ki riwayat se milta hai. Amr aur Abdullah bin Al-Harith An-Najrani par (dono ka) ittifaq hai. Rahi baat Abu Kathir Zuhair bin Al-Aqmar Az-Zubaidi ki, to unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ko suna hai, aur ise Al-A'mash ne Amr se riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Beware of indecency and obscenity, for surely Allah does not love those who are obscene and vulgar. And beware of injustice, for it is darkness on the Day of Resurrection. And beware of greed, for indeed it destroyed those who came before you and led them to shed one another's blood, and it caused those who came before you to sever the ties of their kinship, and it caused those who came before you to make lawful what was forbidden for them." (Reported by Al-Layth and An-Nabil)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fahashi aur be-hayaai se bacho, kyunke Allah be-haya aur fahash kaam karne wale ko pasand nahi karta. Aur zulm se bacho, kyunke woh Qayamat ke din (ghor) andhera hai. Aur kanjoosi se bacho, kyunke isi ne tumse pehle logon ko halaak kiya - isne unhein aapas mein khoon bahane par ubhaara, aur isne unhein rishtedariyan todne par ubhaara, aur isne unhein apni haram cheezon ko halal samajhne par ubhaara." Ise Al-Laith aur An-Nabil ne isse riwayat kiya hai.

e: "The believer does not insult the honor of others, nor curse, nor commit Fahishah, nor is he foul." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1977)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin taana-zani karne wala, la'nat karne wala, fahash-goi karne wala aur badzabaan nahi hota."

e:
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The believer does not use foul language, curse, behave indecently, or be obscene."

"There is another witness regarding this hadith from Ibrahim al-Nakha'i. It must be mentioned, even if its chain of transmission does not meet the conditions of the two Sheikhs."

Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin taana-zani karne wala, la'nat karne wala, fahash-goi karne wala aur badzabaan nahi hota." Iska aik doosra shahid Ibrahim An-Nakha'i se bhi hai, jiska zikr zaroori hai, agarche uski sanad Shaykhain ki shart par nahi hai. Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'A believer does not exhibit slandering, obscenity, or indecency.' This is narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Layla, even though he was attributed to having a poor memory. However, he is one of the knowledgeable scholars of Islam, with great virtues. He is among the prominent children of the companions and followers from the Ansar, may Allah have mercy upon them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin taana-zani karne wala, fahash-goi karne wala aur badzabaan nahi hota." Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman bin Abi Layla, agarche unhein kamzor hifz ki taraf mansoob kiya jata hai, lekin woh Islam ke bade fuqaha (fiqh ke imamon) mein se aur Ansar ke Sahaba (RA) aur Tabi'in ki aulad mein se aik bade shakhs hain, rahmatullahi alaihim. Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever dislikes an evil deed while performing it and performs a good deed and is happy with it, he is a believer." It has been authenticated by the narrators of this hadith until the end, and it is authentic according to their criteria. They did not mention it except in the sermon of Umar ibn Al-Khattab. Whoever is pleased with his good deeds and feels regret for his bad deeds is a believer, and he has a witness to this statement (hadith) by these words.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs koi burai kare aur karte waqt use napasand kare, aur koi neki kare aur usse khush ho, woh momin hai." Dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ne is hadith ke aakhir tak sab raawiyon se hujjat pakdi hai, aur yeh dono ki shart par sahih hai, magar unhone ise nahi nikala. Yeh sirf Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke khutbe mein zikr hui hai: "Jise uski neki khush kare aur uski burai use bura lage, woh momin hai," aur iska isi lafz ke sath aik shahid bhi hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked by a man, "O Messenger of Allah, what is faith?" He replied, "When your good deeds make you happy and your bad deeds make you feel sad, then you are a believer." The man then asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what is sin?" He replied, "When something disturbs your heart, leave it." And this is how it has been narrated by Ali ibn Al-Mubarak and Ma'mar ibn Rashid through Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, following their conditions.
hi: Aik shakhs ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Eman kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhari neki tumhein khush kare aur tumhari burai tumhein bura lage, to tum momin ho." Usne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), gunah kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhare seene mein koi cheez khatke (khalish paida kare), to use chhod do." Isi tarah Ali bin Al-Mubarak aur Ma'mar bin Rashid ne Yahya bin Abi Kathir se riwayat ki hai.

e: The Prophet said: "Do not seek knowledge in order to show off in front of the scholars, or to argue with the foolish, and do not choose the best seat in a gathering, due to it (i.e. the knowledge which you have learned) for whoever does that, the Fire, the Fire (awaits him)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 254)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ilm is liye na seekho ke ulama ke saamne fakhr karo, ya jaahilon se bahes karo, ya majlis mein khaas jagah haasil karo. Jo aisa kare, uske liye aag hai, aag hai."

e: [AI] Regarding Ibn Jurayj, he transmitted it, and Yahya also agreed on its inclusion in the authentic books. Abdullah ibn Wahb sent it to me. I adhere to the principle that I established in accepting additional narrations from trustworthy sources in both the chains of transmission and the texts. This was narrated by Ibn Wahb and he sent it to me.
hi: Ibn Jurayj se riwayat hai, unhone ise mutasil (jud gayi hui sanad ke sath) bayan kiya, aur Yahya ke is hadith ko Sahihain mein shamil karne par ittifaq hai. Abdullah bin Wahb ne ise mursal (bina sahabi ke) riwayat kiya hai, aur main us usool par qaim hoon jo maine sanad aur matan dono mein kisi thiqa raawi ki ziyaadti qubool karne ke liye tay kiya hai.

e: The Prophet said: "Do not seek knowledge in order to show off in front of the scholars, or to argue with the foolish, and do not choose the best seat in a gathering, due to it (i.e. the knowledge which you have learned) for whoever does that, the Fire, the Fire (awaits him)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 254)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ilm is liye na seekho ke ulama ke saamne fakhr karo, na jaahilon se bahes karne ke liye, aur na hi majlison mein (ise sunane) ke liye. Jo aisa kare, uske liye aag hai, aag hai."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: "Whoever seeks knowledge to show off to scholars or to compete with fools or to gain praise from people, then they are destined for hell." "The two sheikhs did not produce anything to Ishaaq bin Yahya, I only made him a witness for what I have fulfilled from their condition, and Ishaaq bin Yahya is from the noble descendants of Quraysh." They did not send out for Ishaaq, but I only made him a witness.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi ilm ki talaash isliye kare ke ulama ke saamne fakhr kare, ya jaahilon se bahes kare, ya logon ki tawajjo apni taraf khinche, to woh Jahannam ki taraf (jaega)." Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ne Ishaq bin Yahya se koi hadith nahi nikali, maine unhein sirf isliye shahid banaya hai jaisa maine pehle unki shart bayan ki hai, aur Ishaq bin Yahya Quraish ke sharif logon mein se hain.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up in Khaif in Mina, and said: ‘May Allah make his face shine, the man who hears my words and conveys them. It may be that the bearer of knowledge does not understand it, and it may be that he takes it to one who will understand it more than he does. There are three things in which the heart of the believer does not betray: sincerity of action for the sake of Allah, offering sincere advice to the rulers of the Muslims, and adhering to the Jama’ah (main body of the Muslims). Their supplication is answered (i.e. encompassing every good, and all of the people).” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3056)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Mina ke Khaif (jagah) mein khade huay aur farmaya: "Allah us bande ko taro-taaza (khush) rakhe jisne meri baat suni, usse yaad rakha, phir usse un logon tak pahuncha diya jinhone use nahi suna. Kayi baar ilm uthane wala khud faqeeh nahi hota, aur kayi baar woh ilm aise shakhs tak pahuncha deta hai jo usse zyada faqeeh ho. Teen cheezein aisi hain jinpar momin ka dil kabhi khiyanat nahi karta: Allah ke liye amal mein ikhlaas, hukmaraanon ke liye khair-khwahi, aur Musalmanon ki jama'at se juda na hona, kyunke unki dua unhein (sab ko) apne gird se ghere rehti hai."

e:
[AI] Abu Ali Al-Hafiz told us that Abu Ya'la narrated to him, who narrated from Abu Khaythama, who said: Ya'qub bin Ibrahim bin Sa'd narrated from his father, who narrated from Ibn Ishaq, who narrated from Abu Al-Hassan Muhammad bin Abdullah Al-Jawhary, who narrated from Muhammad bin Ishaq, who narrated from Muhammad bin Ya'la, who narrated from Yahya bin 'Ubaid Al-Tanafisi, and Ahmad bin Khalid Al-Wahbi, who said: Muhammad bin Ishaq narrated to us, who narrated from Muhammad bin Al-Muzaffar Al-Hafiz, who narrated from Muhammad bin Harun, who narrated from Sulaiman bin 'Umar, who narrated from Yahya bin Sa'id Al-Umawi, who narrated from Muhammad bin Ishaq, who narrated from Abu 'Amr Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Ishaq Al-'Adl, who narrated from Muhammad bin Khuza'im Al-Dimashqi, who narrated from Hisham bin 'Ammar, who said: Sa'id bin Yahya Al-Lakhmi narrated to me, who narrated from Ibn Ishaq, and Ali bin 'Isa also narrated to me. The wording is from Musaddad bin Qatan, who narrated from 'Uthman bin Abi Shaybah, who narrated from Yahya bin 'Ubaid, who narrated from Muhammad bin Ishaq, who narrated from Al-Zuhri, who narrated from Muhammad bin Jubair:

The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, stood in the valley of Mina and said, "May Allah brighten the face of the servant who hears my words and memorizes them, then conveys them to those who have not heard them. Perhaps there is a scholar who is not knowledgeable, but carries the knowledge to someone more knowledgeable than him. There are three qualities that a believer's heart should not hold any animosity towards: sincerity in actions for Allah, loyalty to the rulers, and adherence to the congregation. Their supplication is answered even if it comes from behind them."

These trustworthy narrators have unanimously agreed upon narrating this hadith from Muhammad bin Ishaq, from Al-Zuhri, except for Abdullah bin Numayr who differs with them. He narrates it from Muhammad bin Ishaq through Abdus Salam, son of Abi Al-Janub, who narrates from Al-Zuhri and Ibn Numayr is trustworthy. Allah knows best. Then we examined it and found that Al-Zuhri has a continuous chain narrating from Muhammad bin Jubair.
hi: Humein Abu Ali Al-Hafiz ne bataya, unhein Abu Ya'la ne bataya, unhein Abu Khaithamah ne bataya, dono (ravioun) ne kaha: humein Ya'qub bin Ibrahim bin Sa'd ne bataya, humein mere walid ne Ibn Ishaq se bataya. Aur mujhe Abu Al-Hasan Muhammad bin Abdullah Al-Jauhari ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Ishaq ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Ya'la ne bataya, humein Yahya ne bataya, humein Ya'la bin Ubaid At-Tanafisi aur Ahmad bin Khalid Al-Wahbi ne bataya, dono ne kaha: humein Muhammad bin Ishaq ne bataya. Aur mujhe Muhammad bin Al-Muzaffar Al-Hafiz ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Harun ne bataya, humein Sulaiman bin Umar ne bataya, humein Yahya bin Sa'eed Al-Umawi ne Muhammad bin Ishaq se bataya. Aur mujhe Abu Amr Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Ishaq Al-Adl ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Khuzaim Ad-Dimashqi ne bataya, humein Hisham bin Ammar ne bataya, unhone kaha: mujhe Sa'eed bin Yahya Al-Lakhmi ne bataya, humein Ibn Ishaq ne bataya. Aur mujhse Ali bin Isa ne bayan kiya, aur yehi lafz unke hain, humein Musaddad bin Qatan ne bataya, humein Uthman bin Abi Shaybah ne bataya, humein Ya'la bin Ubaid ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Ishaq ne Az-Zuhri se, unhone Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im se, unhone apne walid se bataya, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) Mina ke Khaif mein khade huay aur farmaya: "Allah us bande ko taro-taaza rakhe jisne meri baat suni, usse yaad rakha, phir usse un logon tak pahuncha diya jinhone use nahi suna. Kayi baar ilm uthane wala khud faqeeh nahi hota, aur kayi baar woh ilm aise shakhs tak pahuncha deta hai jo usse zyada faqeeh ho. Teen cheezein aisi hain jinpar momin ka dil kabhi khiyanat nahi karta: Allah ke liye amal mein ikhlaas, hukmaraanon ke liye khair-khwahi, aur jama'at se juda na hona, kyunke unki dua unhein apne gird se ghere rehti hai." In tamam thiqa raawiyon ka is hadith ko Muhammad bin Ishaq se, unhone Az-Zuhri se, riwayat karne par ittifaq hai, aur sirf Abdullah bin Numair ne inse ikhtilaf kiya hai, unhone ise Muhammad bin Ishaq se, Abdus Salam - jo Ibn Abi Al-Janub hain - se, unhone Az-Zuhri se riwayat kiya hai, aur Ibn Numair thiqa hain, wallahu a'lam. Phir humne ghor kiya to Az-Zuhri ka aik mutabi' (tasdeeq karne wala) Muhammad bin Jubair se paaya.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, while he was in Khayf from Mina: "May Allah have mercy on a servant who hears my words, memorizes them, and conveys them to those who have not heard them. It is possible that the one who conveys knowledge may be more knowledgeable than the one receiving it. There are three qualities that the heart of a believer should not harbor: insincerity in actions, giving advice to the rulers, and abandoning the Muslim community. Their supplications will come from behind them." This is also narrated by a group of companions including Umar, Uthman, Ali, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Muadh bin Jabal, Ibn Umar, Ibn Abbas, Abu Huraira, Anas, and others. The narration of Nu'man bin Bashir is mentioned as a condition for the authenticity of this hadith.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Mina ke Khaif mein yeh farmate hue suna: "Allah us bande par reham kare jisne meri baat suni, usse yaad rakha, phir usse un logon tak pahuncha diya jinhone use nahi suna. Kayi baar ilm uthane wala khud faqeeh nahi hota, aur kayi baar woh ilm aise shakhs tak pahuncha deta hai jo usse zyada faqeeh ho. Teen cheezein aisi hain jinpar momin ka dil kabhi khiyanat nahi karta: amal mein ikhlaas, hukmaraanon ke liye khair-khwahi, aur jama'at se juda na hona, kyunke unki dua unhein apne gird se ghere rehti hai." Is baab mein Sahaba (RA) ke aik giroh se riwayaten hain, unme Umar (RA), Uthman (RA), Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA), Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA), Ibn Umar (RA), Ibn Abbas (RA), Abu Hurairah (RA), Anas (RA) aur kayi doosre shamil hain. Aur Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ki hadith Sahih ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered a sermon and said, "May Allah enlighten the face of a person who hears my words and bears them. Many individuals who possess knowledge are not truly wise, and many individuals who possess knowledge convey it to someone who is more knowledgeable than them. There are three things that do not burden the heart of a believer: sincere actions for the sake of Allah, advising the leaders, and remaining steadfast in the Muslim community." A Muslim has cited a hadith in the authentic Musnad, narrated by Simak bin Harb from Nu'man bin Bashir, who said, "I once saw our Prophet ﷺ  filling his stomach with dates." It was also narrated by Simak bin Harb from Nu'man that the Prophet ﷺ  used to straighten our rows, and this hadith has been agreed upon for its authenticity. It was also reported by Sha'bi and Mujahid from Nu'man bin Bashir, from the Prophet ﷺ , and this is according to the condition set by Imam Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein khutba diya aur farmaya: "Allah us shakhs ko taro-taaza rakhe jisne meri baat suni aur usse yaad rakha. Kayi baar ilm uthane wala khud faqeeh nahi hota, aur kayi baar woh ilm aise shakhs tak pahuncha deta hai jo usse zyada faqeeh ho. Teen cheezein aisi hain jinpar momin ka dil kabhi khiyanat nahi karta: Allah Ta'ala ke liye amal mein ikhlaas, hukmaraanon ke liye khair-khwahi, aur Musalmanon ki jama'at se juda na hona." Muslim ne apni Musnad Sahih mein Simak bin Harb ki, Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) se, hadith ko hujjat mana hai, jismein unhone kaha: "Maine humare Nabi (SAW) ko aik din khajoor ki khushk giriyon se apna pet bharte dekha." Aur Simak se, Nu'man (RA) se, riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) humari safein seedhi karte the, poori hadith. Aur Hatim bin Abi Sagheerah aur Abdullah bin Bakr As-Sahmi par (dono ki riwayat) ittifaq hai. Yeh bhi Ash-Sha'bi aur Mujahid se, Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) se, Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hui hai. Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] He said, "Welcome to the will of the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him. The Messenger of Allah peace be upon him used to give us advice about you."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki wasiyat ko khush-aamdeed, Rasulullah (SAW) humein tumhare (achhe sulook ke) baare mein wasiyat kiya karte the."

e: If anyone pursues a path in search of knowledge, Allah will thereby make easy for him a path to paradise; and he who is made slow by his actions will not be speeded by his genealogy. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3643)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs ilm ki talaash mein koi raasta chale, Allah usse jannat ka raasta aasan kar deta hai, aur jise uska amal peechhe chhod de, uska nasab (khandani nasab) usse aage nahi le jaayega." Abu Muawiyah ne isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever takes a path upon which to obtain knowledge, Allah makes the path to Paradise easy for him." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2646)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs kisi raste par chale jismein woh ilm dhoondta ho, Allah usse Jannat ka raasta aasan kar deta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Know your lineage, maintain your ties of kinship. For there is no relationship for the one whose ties of kinship have been cut, even if they were close, nor distance for the one whose ties of kinship have been maintained, even if they were far."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne nasab (khandani rishte) pehchano taake tum apni rishtedariyan jod sako, kyunke agar rishtedari qareeb bhi ho lekin toad di jaye to uska koi qurb nahi rehta, aur agar woh door bhi ho lekin jod di jaye to uski koi doori nahi rehti."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Learn about your lineage, so you can maintain your family ties." Ali ibn 'Isa al-Hiri reported to us, Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Ziyad narrated, "I heard Muhammad ibn Yahya say that Abu al-Asbat al-Harithi is Bashir ibn Rafi'."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne nasab seekho taake tum apni rishtedariyan jod sako." Humein Ali bin Isa Al-Hiri ne bataya, humein Al-Husain bin Muhammad bin Ziyad ne bataya, unhone kaha: maine Muhammad bin Yahya ko kehte suna: "Abu Al-Asbat Al-Harithi hi Bishr bin Rafi' hain."

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  and asked, "O Messenger of Allah, which cities are the worst?" The Prophet replied, "I do not know." When Gabriel (the angel) came to him, he said, "O Gabriel, which cities are the worst?" Gabriel replied, "I do not know until I ask my Lord." Then Gabriel left and stayed as long as Allah willed, then he returned and said, "O Muhammad, you asked me which cities are the worst? And I said, 'I do not know' and I asked my Lord. He replied, 'The worst of them are the markets.'" This hadith has been transmitted by all narrators, except Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqil. Al-Bukhari has unique narration with Abu Hudhaifah as the witness. This hadith is the origin for the saying of the scholar, "I do not know," and it has a witness from Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqil. Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata." Jab Jibra'il (AS) aap (SAW) ke paas aaye to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Jibra'il, sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata, jab tak main apne Rab se na poochun." Jibra'il (AS) chale gaye, jitni der Allah ne chaha thehre rahe, phir wapas aakar kaha: "Aye Muhammad, aapne mujhse poocha tha sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai, aur maine kaha tha mujhe nahi pata, to maine apne Rab se poocha, sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai, to usne farmaya: 'Uske bazaar.'" In tamam raawiyon ko - Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqeel ke siwa - hujjat mana gaya hai, aur Bukhari akele Abu Hudhaifah ko hujjat maante hain. Yeh hadith us qaida ki asal hai jismein aalim 'mujhe nahi pata' kehta hai, aur iska aik shahid Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqeel se bhi hai. Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, which land is the worst?" He ﷺ  said, "I do not know." When Gabriel came to Muhammad ﷺ , he said, "O Gabriel, which land is the worst?" Gabriel replied, "I do not know until I ask my Lord." So Gabriel went and stayed as long as Allah willed, then he came back and said, "O Muhammad, you asked me which land is the worst? Indeed, it is its markets. 'Amr ibn Thabit is the son of Abu al-Miqdam al-Kufi, and he is not one of the two sheikhs (al-Bukhari and Muslim). I mentioned him as a witness, and the narration is from Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak, who urged me to mention him. But I have doubted the authenticity of this narration from multiple aspects."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata." Jab Jibra'il (AS) Muhammad (SAW) ke paas aaye to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Jibra'il, sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata, jab tak main apne Rab se na poochun." Jibra'il (AS) chale gaye, jitni der Allah ne chaha thehre rahe, phir wapas aakar kaha: "Aye Muhammad, aapne mujhse poocha tha sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai? Aur maine kaha tha mujhe nahi pata, to maine apne Rab se poocha sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai, to usne farmaya: 'Uske bazaar.'" Amr bin Thabit, jo Ibn Abi Al-Miqdam Al-Kufi hain, Shaykhain ki shart par nahi hain, maine unhein sirf shahid ke tor par zikr kiya hai, aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak ki unse riwayat ne mujhe isse peesh karne par ubhaara, kyunke maine ismein aik aisa raasta paaya jispar bharosa nahi kiya jata.

e: [AI] About him is Abdul Samad bin Al-Nu'man and he is weak.
hi: Unse Abdus Samad bin An-Nu'man ne riwayat ki hai, aur woh za'if (kamzor) hain.

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, which places are better?" The Prophet replied, "I don't know." The man then asked, "Which places are worse?" again the Prophet replied, "I don't know." The man advised him to ask his Lord, so when Gabriel descended, the Prophet said, "I was asked about the better places and the worse places, but I didn't know." Gabriel said, "I also don't know until I ask my Lord." Suddenly, Gabriel shuddered and almost got shocked, then Allah said to Gabriel, "O Gabriel, Muhammad is asking you which places are better." Gabriel replied, "I don't know." Then the Prophet asked, "Which places are worse?" and Gabriel replied, "I don't know. However, the best places are the mosques and the worst places are the markets."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), sabse achhi jagah kaunsi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata." Usne poocha: "Sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata." Usne kaha: "Apne Rab se poochiye." (Ravi ne kaha:) jab Jibra'il (AS) utre to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhse poocha gaya tha sabse achhi jagah kaunsi hai aur sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai, to maine kaha tha mujhe nahi pata." Jibra'il (AS) ne kaha: "Mujhe bhi nahi pata, jab tak main apne Rab se na poochun." (Ravi ne kaha:) Jibra'il (AS) is kadar larzay ke Muhammad (SAW) qareeb tha behosh ho jayen. Allah ne farmaya: "Aye Jibra'il, Muhammad tumse poochte hain sabse achhi jagah kaunsi hai, to tumne kaha mujhe nahi pata, aur unhone poocha sabse buri jagah kaunsi hai, to tumne kaha mujhe nahi pata: (jaan lo ke) sabse achhi jagah masjidein hain, aur sabse buri jagah bazaar hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "People will soon beat the backs of camels but will not find a knowledgeable person more knowledgeable than the knowledgeable person of Madinah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aqareeb hai ke log unton ke kalejay peet-peet kar (safar karengay) magar unhein Madinah ke aalim se zyada 'aalim koi nahi milega."

e: [AI] "To strike the livers of camels." This is not something that weakens the hadith, for Al-Humaydi is the authority in his hadith due to his knowledge and his frequent adherence to it. Ibn 'Uyaynah used to say, "We consider this scholar, Maalik ibn Anas."
hi: "Unton ke kalejay peet-peet kar (safar karengay)" - poori hadith. Yeh un cheezon mein se nahi jo hadith ko kamzor karti hain, kyunke Al-Humaidi apni hadith ke maamle mein sanad ke faisla-kun hain, kyunke woh usse waqif hain aur unhone usse kaafi lambe arse tak lazim rakha hai. Aur Ibn Uyainah kaha karte the: "Hum is aalim ko Malik bin Anas samajhte hain."

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: 'Whoever comes to our mosque to learn or teach, then he is like a Mujahid in the way of Allah. And whoever comes for other than this, he is like a person who sees something he likes but does not possess it. Perhaps he will say: 'He sees those who are praying but he is not one of them, and he sees those who are remembering Allah but he is not one of them.' This hadith was narrated by Abu Sa'd and it is on their conditions (referring to the narrators) and I do not know any faults in it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi bhalai seekhne ya sikhaane ke liye humari is masjid mein aaye, woh Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wale jaisa hai. Aur jo iske alawa kisi aur maqsad se aaye, woh us aadmi ki tarah hai jo koi cheez dekhta hai jo usse achhi lagti hai lekin uski nahi hoti." Kabhi kabhi aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh namazi logon ko dekhta hai magar unme se nahi hota, aur zikr karne walon ko dekhta hai magar unme se nahi hota." Ise Haywah ne Abu Sakhr se, isi tarah riwayat kiya hai, aur yeh dono ki shart par hai, aur mujhe ismein koi khaami maloom nahi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  heard saying: "Whoever enters our mosque to learn or teach something good, he is like a warrior in the cause of Allah, and whoever enters it for any other reason, he is like someone who looks at what does not belong to him."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo koi bhalai seekhne ya sikhaane ke liye humari is masjid mein daakhil ho, woh Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wale jaisa hai, aur jo iske alawa kisi aur maqsad se daakhil ho, woh us shakhs ki tarah hai jo aisi cheez ko dekh raha ho jo uski nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever goes to the mosque desiring only to learn good or to teach it, will have the reward of a complete Umrah pilgrimage. And whoever goes to the mosque desiring only to learn good or to teach it, will have the reward of a complete Hajj pilgrimage." (Bukhari has cited Thawr bin Yazid in his book "Al-Usul", and Muslim has mentioned it in "Al-Shawahid". As for Thawr bin Yazid Al-Daili, there is agreement on its authenticity according to Al-Bukhari's criteria.)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs subah masjid ki taraf jaye sirf isliye ke woh koi bhalai seekhe ya sikhaye, to usse mukammal Umrah karne wale jaisa ajr milega. Aur jo shaam ko masjid ki taraf jaye sirf isliye ke woh koi bhalai seekhe ya sikhaye, to usse mukammal Hajj karne wale jaisa ajr milega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Two are never satisfied- one who is consumed by knowledge can never be satisfied, and one who is consumed by worldly desires can never be satisfied."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Do (log) hain jo kabhi seer (aasoodah) nahi hote: ilm ka bhookha (kabhi) seer nahi hota, aur duniya ka bhookha (kabhi) seer nahi hota.

e: [AI] Abu Huraira came to Ka'b to ask about someone, and Ka'b was among the people. Ka'b asked, "What do you want from him?" Abu Huraira replied, "I do not know anyone from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  who preserves his hadiths better than me." Ka'b responded, "Indeed, you have not found anyone who seeks something without being satisfied with it for a day in his entire life, except for a seeker of knowledge and a seeker of worldly gains." Then he said to Abu Huraira, "You are Ka'b, so I have come for something like this."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) Ka'b ke paas aaye unse (kisi ke baare mein) poochne, jabke Ka'b logon ke darmiyan the. Ka'b ne poocha: "Tumhein usse kya chahiye?" Unhone kaha: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se kisi ko nahi jaanta jo mujhse zyada aap (SAW) ki hadith yaad rakhta ho." Ka'b ne kaha: "Tumne kabhi kisi shakhs ko koi cheez talaash karte nahi paaya jo ek din bhi ussay seer ho jaye, siwaye ilm ke talibgar aur duniya ke talibgar ke." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Tum Ka'b ho, aur main isi jaisi baat ke liye aaya tha."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "The virtue of knowledge is dearer to me than the virtue of worship, and the best of your religion is being cautious and mindful."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ilm ki fazeelat mujhe ibadat ki fazeelat se zyada mehboob hai, aur tumhare deen ki behtareen cheez taqwa (parhezgari) hai."

e: [AI] About Mus'ab ibn Sa'd, he mentioned him without mentioning the judge.
hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd se, unhone bhi isi tarah ki riwayat ki hai, aur unhone 'Al-Hakam' ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said as follows: "Then we looked and found Khalid bin Makhlad to be more steadfast, cautious, and trustworthy than Bakr bin Bakkir, so we appointed him to the extra task." This hadith was narrated by Abdullah bin Abdul-Qudus, transmitted by Al-A'mash with another chain of narration.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne isi tarah farmaya. "Phir humne ghor kiya to Khalid bin Makhlad ko Bakr bin Bakkar se zyada mazboot, zyada hafiz aur zyada qabil-e-e'timaad paaya, isliye humne ziyaadti (zyada riwayat) ko unhi ke haq mein tarjeeh di." Ise Abdullah bin Abdul Quddus ne Al-A'mash se aik doosri sanad ke sath riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The superiority of knowledge is better than the superiority of worship, and the best of your religion is piety."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ilm ki fazeelat ibadat ki fazeelat se behtar hai, aur tumhare deen ki behtareen cheez taqwa hai."

e:
[AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ addressed the people during the Farewell Pilgrimage and said, "Satan has despaired of being worshipped in your land. However, he is content to be obeyed in matters other than that which you belittle from your actions. So beware, O people, I have left among you that which, if you hold fast to it, you will never go astray—the Book of Allah and the Sunnah of His Messenger ﷺ. Indeed, every Muslim is the brother of another Muslim. The Muslims are brothers to one another and it is not permissible for a person to take from his brother's wealth except what is given willingly. Do not wrong one another, nor turn back as disbelievers after me. Some of you strike the necks of others." Al-Bukhari has cited this hadith through the narration of 'Ikrimah, and Muslim has cited it through the narration of Abu Uwais and through other narrators. This hadith, regarding the Prophet's sermon, is agreed upon to have been included in the authentic collections. 

The mention of holding fast to the Sunnah in this sermon is strange and requires emphasis. I have found evidence for it in a hadith narrated by Abu Hurairah. Al-Bukhari has cited it through 'Umar and 'Ali, and Muslim has cited it through Abu Hurairah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke moqe par logon ko khutba diya aur farmaya: "Shaitan is baat se mayoos ho chuka hai ke usko tumhari zameen mein ibadat ki jaye, lekin woh is baat par raazi ho gaya hai ke usse tumhare un chhote-chhote aamal mein itaa'at ki jaye jinhe tum haqir samajhte ho, isliye bacho, aye logo! Maine tum mein aisi cheez chhodi hai ke agar tum usse mazbooti se pakde raho to kabhi gumraah nahi hoge: Allah ki Kitab aur uske Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat. Beshak har Musalman doosre Musalman ka bhai hai, Musalman aapas mein bhai bhai hain, aur kisi shakhs ke liye apne bhai ka maal halal nahi magar jo woh khush-dili se de. Zulm na karo, aur mere baad kaafir (jaise) na ban jana ke aik doosre ki gardanein maaro." Bukhari ne Ikrimah ki ahadith se hujjat pakdi hai, aur Muslim ne Abu Uwais se hujjat pakdi hai, aur baaqi tamam raawiyon par ittifaq hai. Yeh hadith Nabi (SAW) ke khutbe ke baare mein hai jise Sahih mein shamil karne par ittifaq hai: "Aye logo, maine tum mein aisi cheez chhodi hai ke agar tum usse mazbooti se pakde raho to kabhi gumraah nahi hoge - Allah ki Kitab - aur tum mere baare mein poochhe jaoge, to tum kya kahoge?" Is khutbe mein Sunnat ko mazbooti se pakadne ka zikr gharib (kam-yaab) hai aur zaroori hai; maine iska aik shahid Abu Hurairah (RA) ki hadith mein bhi paaya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, I have left among you two things that you will never go astray as long as you hold fast to them: the Book of Allah and my Sunnah. And they will never separate from each other until they meet me at the Pond."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak maine tum mein do cheezein chhodi hain, jab tak inhein pakde raho, kabhi gumraah nahi hoge: Allah ki Kitab aur meri Sunnat, aur yeh dono kabhi juda nahi hongay yahan tak ke Qayamat ke din mere hawd par mujh se aa milen."

e: "There were two brothers during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. One of them used to come to the prophet ﷺ, and the other had some business. The businessman among them complained to the Prophet ﷺ about his brother, so he said:'Perhaps you are provided for because of him.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2345)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein do bhai the, un mein se aik Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aata-jaata tha aur doosra kaam-kaaj karta tha. Kaam karne wale bhai ne Nabi (SAW) se apne bhai ki shikayat ki, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shayad tumhe usi ki wajah se rizq mil raha ho."

e: [AI] "Bring me the clothes of my servant, so he brought them to me, and then he entered the Mosque of Homs and performed two units of prayer. When he finished, he found people sitting, so he asked them, 'What made you sit here?' They replied, 'We have prayed the obligatory prayer.' Then the storyteller began his tale, and when he finished, we sat discussing the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Muawiyah said, 'No man has retained fewer narrations from the Prophet ﷺ  than me. I will tell you two qualities that I retained from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . No man supervises others and feels pleased about having many opponents near him, except that he enters Paradise.' He said, 'I was with the Prophet ﷺ  one day when he entered the mosque and found people sitting inside. He said, 'What made you sit here?' They replied, 'We have prayed the obligatory prayer.' Then they sat discussing the Book of Allah and the Sunnah of His Prophet ﷺ .' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, when Allah is mentioned, His remembrance becomes greater.'"
hi: "Apne ghulam se kaha: mere do achhe kapde le aao." Usne woh pehne, phir Homs (Hims) ki masjid mein dakhil huay aur do rakat namaz padhi. Jab farigh huay to dekha kuch log baithe hain. Unhone poocha: "Tumhein kis cheez ne baitha rakha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Humne farz namaz padh li hai, phir qissah-go (waaz karne wala) ne apni baat bayan ki, jab woh farigh hua to hum baith kar Rasulullah (SAW) ki Sunnat ka zikr karne lage." To Muawiyah (RA) ne kaha: "Koi bhi shakhs jisne Nabi (SAW) ko paaya ho, mujhse kam hadith bayan nahi karta. Main tumhein do khaslatein bataunga jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se yaad rakhi hain: koi bhi shakhs jo logon par hukmaraan ho aur log uske sar par khade rehte hon, agar woh chahe ke uske paas jhagdalu zyada aayen, to (uski aisi khwahish) usse Jannat mein na le jayegi." Unhone kaha: main aik din Nabi (SAW) ke sath tha, aap (SAW) masjid mein dakhil huay to wahan kuch log baithe huay thay. Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein kis cheez ne baitha rakha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Humne farz namaz padh li, phir hum baith kar Allah ki Kitab aur uske Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat ka zikr karne lage." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak jab Allah kisi cheez ka zikr karta hai to uska zikr azeem ho jata hai."

e: [AI] "When the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  would gather, their discussion would mainly revolve around fiqh (jurisprudence), unless a person would recite a Surah (chapter from the Quran) or instruct someone to recite a Surah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) jab baithte the to unki guftagu fiqh (deen ki samajh) ke baare mein hoti thi, siwaye jab koi shakhs koi surah padhta ya kisi ko surah padhne ka hukum deta.

e:
[AI] "Study the hadith, for indeed studying the hadith helps in understanding the hadith."

"And it has been narrated in the hadith about studying the hadith from Ali ibn Abi Talib and Abdullah ibn Mas'ood with authentic hadiths according to the criteria of the two shaykhs."
hi: Hadith ka aapas mein tazkirah (mudhakara) karo, kyunke hadith ka mudhakara hadith ko taaza (zinda) rakhta hai. Aur hadith ke mudhakare ke baare mein Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se sahih ahadith Shaykhain ki shart par riwayat hui hain.

e: [AI] About him, he said, "Study the hadith, for you are only benefiting from it."
hi: "Hadith ka aapas mein tazkirah karo, kyunke agar tum aisa na karo to woh mit jaati hai."

e: [AI] "Abdullah said, 'Study and memorize the hadith, as the remembrance of hadith is his (Prophet Muhammad's) life.'"
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA) ne kaha: "Hadith ka aapas mein tazkirah karo, kyunke hadith ka zikr hi uski zindagi hai."

e: [AI] We heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that he used to narrate to us while our companions and we were occupied with the care of camels.
hi: Humne Rasulullah (SAW) se (ahadith) suni, humare sathi humein sunaya karte the jabke hum unton ki dekh-bhaal mein mashghool hote thay.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You hear from me, and it is heard from you, and it is heard from those who hear from you." This was reported by Jarir ibn Abdullah al-Bajali from al-A'mash, on their authority and there is no objection to it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum (mujhse) suno gay, aur tumse suna jayega, aur jo tumse sunengay unse bhi suna jayega." Ise Jarir bin Abdul Hameed ne Al-A'mash se pahuncha diya hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: You hear (from me), and others will hear from you; and people will hear from them who heard from you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3659)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum (mujhse) suno gay, aur tumse suna jayega, aur jo tumse sunengay unse bhi suna jayega."

e: AbdurRahman ibn Amr as-Sulami and Hujr ibn Hujr said: We came to Irbad ibn Sariyah who was among those about whom the following verse was revealed: "Nor (is there blame) on those who come to thee to be provided with mounts, and when thou saidst: "I can find no mounts for you." We greeted him and said: We have come to see you to give healing and obtain benefit from you. Al-Irbad said: One day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in prayer, then faced us and gave us a lengthy exhortation at which the eyes shed tears and the hearts were afraid. A man said: Messenger of Allah! It seems as if it were a farewell exhortation, so what injunction do you give us? He then said: I enjoin you to fear Allah, and to hear and obey even if it be an Abyssinian slave, for those of you who live after me will see great disagreement. You must then follow my sunnah and that of the rightly-guided caliphs. Hold to it and stick fast to it. Avoid novelties, for every novelty is an innovation, and every innovation is an error. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4607)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Fajr ki namaz padhayi, phir humari taraf mutawajjeh hokar humein aisi naseehat ki jisse dil dar gaye aur aankhon se aansu beh nikle. Hum ne arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh to jaise kisi rukhsat hone wale ki naseehat hai, humein koi wasiyat farmaiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein Allah se darne, aur (apne hukmaraan ki baat) sunne aur uski itaa'at karne ki wasiyat karta hoon, chahe woh koi habshi ghulam hi kyun na ho. Beshak jo tum mein se zinda rahega woh (mere baad) bohot ikhtilaf dekhega, isliye tum meri Sunnat aur khulafa-e-Rashideen aur Mahdiyeen ki Sunnat ko lazim pakdo, use daadhon se (mazbooti se) pakdo, aur naye (deen mein) gharat kiye gaye maamlon se bacho, kyunke har bid'at gumraahi hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out to us one day and stood up to address the people. He urged them, warned them, and said, "Whatever Allah wills, I shall say." Then he said, "Worship Allah and do not associate anything with Him. Obey those who are in authority over you, even if they are Abyssinian slaves. Hold fast to the teachings of your Prophet and the rightly guided caliphs, and bite onto it with your molar teeth." "This is an authentic chain of narration according to their conditions, and I do not know any flaw in it. DAMRAH BIN HABIB followed up through the narration of this hadith from Abdul Rahman bin Amr Al-Sulami, according to their conditions, and I do not know any flaw in it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik din humare paas nikle, khade huay, logon ko naseehat ki, unhein raghbat dilai aur khabardar kiya, aur jo Allah ne chaha kaha, phir farmaya: "Allah ki ibadat karo aur uske sath kisi ko shareek na thehrao, aur jise Allah ne tumhare maamlon ka waali banaya uski itaa'at karo, aur maamle ke ahl (haqdar) se maamla chheeno mat, chahe woh koi kaala ghulam hi kyun na ho, aur apne Nabi (SAW) aur khulafa-e-Rashideen aur Mahdiyeen ki Sunnat par qaim raho, aur usse apni daadhon se haq ke sath pakde raho." Yeh isnad dono (Bukhari aur Muslim) ki shart par sahih hai aur mujhe iski koi illat maloom nahi, aur Damrah bin Habib ne is hadith ki riwayat mein Khalid bin Ma'daan ki, Abdur Rahman bin Amr As-Sulami se, mutaba'at ki hai.

e: He heard Al-'Irbad bin Sariyah say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a moving speech to us which made our eyes flow with tears and made our hearts melt. We said: 'O Messenger of Allah. This is a speech of farewell. What did you enjoin upon us?' He said: 'I am leaving you upon a (path of) brightness whose night is like its day. No one will deviate from it after I am gone but one who is doomed. Whoever among you lives will see great conflict. I urge you to adhere to what you know of my Sunnah and the path of the Rightly-Guided Caliphs, and cling stubbornly to it. And you must obey, even if (your leader is) an Abyssinian leader. For the true believer is like a camel with a ring in its nose; wherever it is driven, it complies." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 43)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein aisi naseehat ki jisse aankhon se aansu beh nikle aur dil dar gaye. Hum ne arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh to jaise kisi rukhsat hone wale ki naseehat hai, ab aap humein kya wasiyat karte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein aik roshan raaste par chhoda hai, jiski raat uske din ki tarah hai, mere baad koi usse nahi hatega magar woh jo halaak hoga. Aur jo tum mein se zinda rahega woh bohot ikhtilaf dekhega. Isliye jo kuch tum meri aur khulafa-e-Mahdiyeen-Rashideen ki Sunnat se jaante ho usse lazim pakdo, aur itaa'at ko lazim pakdo, chahe woh koi habshi ghulam hi kyun na ho, aur usse daadhon se (mazbooti se) pakdo." Asad bin Wada'ah is hadith mein yeh ziyaadti karte thay: "Beshak momin us naath diye gaye unt ki tarah hai, jahan bhi le jaya jaye woh chala jata hai." Aur Abdur Rahman bin Amr ki Al-Irbaad bin Saariyah se riwayat par ahl-e-Sham ke aimma mein se teen siqah, mazboot raawiyon ne mutaba'at ki hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: AbdurRahman ibn Amr as-Sulami and Hujr ibn Hujr said: We came to Irbad ibn Sariyah who was among those about whom the following verse was revealed: "Nor (is there blame) on those who come to thee to be provided with mounts, and when thou saidst: "I can find no mounts for you." We greeted him and said: We have come to see you to give healing and obtain benefit from you. Al-Irbad said: One day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in prayer, then faced us and gave us a lengthy exhortation at which the eyes shed tears and the hearts were afraid. A man said: Messenger of Allah! It seems as if it were a farewell exhortation, so what injunction do you give us? He then said: I enjoin you to fear Allah, and to hear and obey even if it be an Abyssinian slave, for those of you who live after me will see great disagreement. You must then follow my sunnah and that of the rightly-guided caliphs. Hold to it and stick fast to it. Avoid novelties, for every novelty is an innovation, and every innovation is an error. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4607)
hi: Al-Irbad (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein aik din Fajr ki namaz padhayi, phir humari taraf mutawajjeh hue aur humein aisi jaandaar naseehat ki jisse aankhon se aansu beh nikle aur dil dar gaye. Kisi kehne wale ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh to jaise kisi rukhsat hone wale ki naseehat hai, ab aap humein kya wasiyat karte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein Allah se darne, aur (apne hukmaraan ki baat) sunne aur uski itaa'at karne ki wasiyat karta hoon, chahe woh koi habshi ghulam hi kyun na ho, beshak jo tum mein se zinda rahega woh bohot ikhtilaf dekhega, isliye tum meri Sunnat aur khulafa-e-Rashideen aur Mahdiyeen ki Sunnat ko lazim pakdo, isse mazbooti se pakdo aur daadhon se pakdo, aur naye (deen mein) gharat kiye gaye maamlon se bacho, kyunke har nayi cheez bid'at hai aur har bid'at gumraahi hai."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Arbaad bin Sariyah Al-Sulami saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once stood among us during a morning gathering and delivered a powerful sermon that made our hearts tremble and tears flow from our eyes." We said, "O Messenger of Allah, you have delivered to us a farewell sermon. Advise us." He said, "I enjoin upon you the fear of Allah, and I presume that this is what I have been ordered to advise you. And listen and obey, even if an Abyssinian slave were to rule over you. For surely, he among you who lives long will see great conflict. Therefore, hold fast to my Sunnah and the sunnah of the rightly guided caliphs after me. Bite onto it with your molar teeth and beware of newly invented matters (in religion), for every innovation is a misguidance." And among these innovators is Ma'bad bin Abdullah bin Hisham Al-Qurashi, and the way to him is not a condition of this book. So I left him, although I have diligently researched this hadith and have written about it, as Imam Shu'bah mentioned in the narration of Abdullah bin Ata' from Uqbah bin Amir when he sought it in Basrah, Kufa, Al-Madinah, and Makkah. The hadith then returned to Shah bin Hawshab, who left it. Then Shu'bah said, "For me to narrate a hadith like this one from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is more beloved to me than having my parents, children, and all the people." And this hadith is authentic, and all praise is due to Allah, and may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.
hi: Maine Al-Irbad bin Sariyah As-Sulami (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) aik subah humare darmiyan khade huay aur humein aisi naseehat ki jisse dil dar gaye aur aankhon se aansu beh nikle. Hum ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne to humein jaise kisi rukhsat hone wale ki naseehat ki hai, humein wasiyat farmaiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah se daro" - mera khayal hai unhone kaha - "aur suno aur itaa'at karo, aur tum mere baad sakht ya bohot ikhtilaf dekhogay, isliye meri Sunnat aur khulafa-e-Mahdiyeen ki Sunnat lazim pakdo, isse daadhon se pakdo, aur naye maamlon se bacho, kyunke har bid'at gumraahi hai." In (raawiyon) mein Ma'bad bin Abdullah bin Hisham Al-Qurashi bhi hain, aur unke paas jane wala raasta is kitab ki shart par nahi hai, isliye maine unhein chhod diya. Maine is hadith ki sehat ko sabit karne mein apni poori koshish ki hai jahan tak mera ijtihaad pahuncha, aur ismein aisa likha gaya hai jaisa muhaddiseen ke imam Shu'bah ne Abdullah bin Ata' ki, Uqbah bin Aamir se, riwayat ke baare mein kaha tha, jab unhone use Basra, Kufa, Madinah aur Makkah mein talaash kiya, phir hadith Shahr bin Hawshab tak wapas aayi to unhone use chhod diya, phir Shu'bah ne kaha: "Agar mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) se aisi hi koi hadith sahih mil jaye, to yeh mujhe apne waalid, apni aulad aur tamam logon se zyada mehboob hoga." Aur yeh hadith sahih sabit ho chuki hai, walhamdulillah, wa sallallahu ala Muhammadin wa aalihi ajma'in.

e: [AI] "Verily, knowledge and faith are sought at their places. Whoever seeks them, shall find them." He said that three times. Seek knowledge from four men: Uwaymir, the father of Darad, Salman al-Farsi, and Abdullah ibn Mas'ood, and Abdullah ibn Salam. Verily, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Indeed, he is one of the ten in Paradise."
hi: "Beshak ilm aur Eman apni jagah par hain, jo unhein talaash kare woh unhein paa lega," yeh baat aap (SAW) ne teen martaba farmayi. "Aur ilm ko chaar logon ke paas talaash karo: Uwaimir Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ke paas, Salman Al-Farisi (RA) ke paas, Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ke paas aur Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ke paas, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Yeh Jannat mein das logon mein se daswan hai.'"

e: [AI] It saddens me that I used to ask you every day, but you would stay away from me. Mu'adh said, "Knowledge and faith are like two smiling faces; go and seek them." Yazid asked, "Where can I find them?" Mu'adh said, "With four people; with Uwaimir, father of Dardaa, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Salman the Persian, and Abdullah bin Salam. It is said that they are the ten companions of Paradise." Yazid said, "I also heard that they could be found with Umar ibn al-Khattab." Mu'adh said, "Do not ask him about anything, for he is busy with other matters." Al-Zuhri narrated part of this hadith from Abu Idris.
hi: "Mujhe rulata hai ke main har roz tumse (jo) poochta tha woh mujhse kat jata hai." To Mu'adh (RA) ne kaha: "Beshak ilm aur Eman khush-mizaaj (khush-numa) hain, utho aur unhein talaash karo." Yazid ne poocha: "Aur main unhein kiske paas talaash karoon?" Mu'adh (RA) ne kaha: "Chaar logon ke paas: Uwaimir Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ke paas, Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ke paas, Salman Al-Farisi (RA) ke paas aur Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ke paas, kyunke kaha jata tha ke woh Jannat mein das logon mein se daswan hai." Yazid ne kaha: maine poocha: "Aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke paas?" Unhone kaha: "Unse kuch na poochna, kyunke woh tumhari taraf se mashghool hain (unke paas tumhare liye waqt nahi)." Az-Zuhri ne Abu Idris se is hadith ka aik hissa riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] "Knowledge and faith are found by those who seek them."
hi: "Ilm aur Eman apni jagah par hain, jo unhein talaash kare woh unhein paa lega."

e: [AI] He (the narrator) said, Al-Awf bin Malik al-Ashja'i reported: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, looked at the sky one day and said, "This is the time when knowledge is raised." A man from the Ansar, known as Ibn Labid, said, "O Messenger of Allah, how is knowledge raised when it has been established in the Book and firmly established in the hearts?" The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "If only I considered you one of the most knowledgeable people of Madinah." Then he mentioned the misguidance of the Jews and the Christians regarding what they have in their hands from the Book of Allah. He said, "So I met Shaddad ibn Aws and I informed him of the hadith of Awf bin Malik." Shaddad ibn Aws said, "Awf spoke the truth. Should I inform you of the first thing to be raised?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Humility until you do not see a person in a state of fear and awe." I said, "This is correct." The two sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim) have relied on all of its narrators, and the witness to that is Shaddad ibn Aws, as Jubayr bin Nufayr has heard the hadith from both of them collectively. And it is also confirmed by a third companion, which is Abu Darda.
hi: Auf bin Malik Al-Ashja'i (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din aasman ki taraf dekha aur farmaya: "Yeh woh waqt hai jab ilm uthaya jayega." To Ansar mein se aik shakhs, jise Ibn Labid kaha jata tha, ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), ilm kaise uthaya jayega jabke woh Kitab mein sabit hai aur dilon ne isse yaad rakha hai?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main to tumhein Madinah ke sabse faqeeh logon mein se samajhta tha!" Phir aap (SAW) ne Yahood-o-Nasara ki gumraahi ka zikr kiya, halanke unke paas Allah ki Kitab (Tawrat-Injeel) mojood thi. (Ravi ne kaha:) main Shaddad bin Aws (RA) se mila aur unhein Auf bin Malik (RA) ki hadith sunayi, to unhone kaha: "Auf ne sach kaha. Kya main tumhein na bataun sabse pehle kya cheez uthai jayegi?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor." Unhone kaha: "Khushu (dil ki inkisaari), yahan tak ke tum kisi khaashi' (inkisaar karne wale) ko nahi dekhogay."

e: [AI] "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , when he glanced with his eyes towards the sky and then said, 'This is the time when knowledge will be taken away from people until they will not be able to learn anything from it.' Ziyad ibn Labid al-Ansari said, 'O Messenger of Allah, how will knowledge be taken away from us when we have read the Qur'an? By Allah, we will recite it and teach it to our women and children.' The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'May your mother grieve for you, O Ziyad! I used to consider you among the knowledgeable people of Madinah. This Torah and Injil (Gospel) are with the Jews and Christians, so what will be the use of them?' Jubair said, 'I met Ubadah ibn as-Samit and said to him, 'Don't you listen to what your brother Abu ad-Darda is saying?' I informed him about what he said. He replied, 'Abu ad-Darda has spoken the truth. If you wish, I can tell you about the first knowledge to be lifted from people, which is khushu (humility and submissiveness in prayer). Soon, you will enter a congregational mosque, but you will not find a single person in it who is truly humble.'"
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath thay, aap (SAW) ne apni nazar aasman ki taraf uthai, phir farmaya: "Yeh woh waqt hai jab ilm logon se chheen liya jayega yahan tak ke woh usme se kuch bhi haasil na kar sakengay." Ziyad bin Labid Al-Ansari (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humse yeh kaise chheena jayega jabke humne Quran padha hai? Allah ki qasam, hum ise zaroor padhengay aur apni auraton aur bachon ko bhi padhaengay." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teri maa tujhe royen, aye Ziyad! Main to tumhein Madinah ke faqeehon mein se samajhta tha. Yeh Tawrat aur Injeel Yahood aur Nasara ke paas hain, to woh unhein kya fayda de rahi hain?" Jubair ne kaha: main Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) se mila aur unse kaha: "Kya tum nahi sunte tumhare bhai Abu Ad-Darda (RA) kya keh rahe hain?" aur unhein woh baat batayi jo unhone kahi thi. Unhone kaha: "Abu Ad-Darda ne sach kaha. Agar tum chaho to main tumhein bataun sabse pehla ilm jo logon se uthaya jayega: khushu. Aqareeb hai ke tum kisi jama'at ki masjid mein dakhil ho aur usme koi khaashi' (khushu wala) shakhs na paao."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "This is the time of the disappearance of knowledge." Shu'bah (narrator) said, "Or he said, the time of the interruption of knowledge." They asked, "How can this be when we have the Book of Allah, and we teach it to our children and their children?" He (the Messenger of Allah) replied, "May your mother lose you! I thought you were one of the most knowledgeable people in Madinah. Are not the Jews and Christians among them who have the Book of Allah, the Torah and the Gospel, but they do not benefit from it in any way?" "The hadith is well established without any doubt, with the narration of Ziyad ibn Labid with a clear chain of transmission."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh woh waqt hai jab ilm chala jayega" - Shu'bah ne kaha, ya farmaya: "ilm ke munqate' (khatam) hone ka waqt hai." Logon ne poocha: "Yeh kaise ho sakta hai jabke humare paas Allah ki Kitab hai, jise hamare bete apne beton ko sikhate hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teri maa tujhe royen, aye Ibn Labid! Main to tumhein Madinah ke sabse aqalmand logon mein se samajhta tha. Kya Yahood-o-Nasara ke paas Allah ki Kitab - Tawrat aur Injeel - nahi hai? Phir bhi unhone usse koi fayda nahi uthaya." Yeh hadith bila shuba sabit hai, Ziyad bin Labid ki isi tarah ki wazeh sanad ki riwayat se.

e: [AI] "A narration from Zirr ibn Hubaysh, trustworthy witnesses, other than Asim ibn Bahdalah. Among them is Al-Minhaal ibn Amr, and they both agreed upon it." The chain of narration is authentic.
hi: Zirr bin Hubaysh se, Aasim bin Bahdalah ke ilawa thiqa gawahon ne riwayat ki hai, unme Al-Minhal bin Amr bhi shamil hain, aur dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ka is par ittifaq hai. Iski sanad sahih hai.

e: [AI] A man named Safwan ibn Assal came from Murad to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was in the mosque. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked him, "What brought you here?" He replied, "Seeking knowledge." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, the angels spread their wings in approval of the seeker of knowledge." The narration mentions, "This is Arim, Abu Nu'man Muhammad ibn Al-Fadl Al-Basri, a knowledgeable and trustworthy person whom Al-Bukhari relied upon in various narrations of this hadith. He narrated it from him in Sahih. However, Sinan ibn Farrowkh contradicted him in this hadith, and he narrated it from As-Sa'q ibn Hazn."
hi: Murad qabile ka aik shakhs, jise Safwan bin Assal (RA) kaha jata tha, Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya jabke aap (SAW) masjid mein thay. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Tumhein kya lekar aaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ilm ki talaash." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak farishte ilm ke talibgar ke liye apne par bichhaate hain, uske amal se raazi hokar." Phir hadith ka zikr kiya. ('Aarim' yeh Abu Nu'man Muhammad bin Al-Fadl Al-Basri hain, hafiz aur thiqa, Bukhari ne is hadith ke kayi hisson mein unpar bharosa kiya hai aur Sahih mein unse riwayat ki hai. Sinan bin Farrukh ne is hadith mein unse ikhtilaf kiya hai, unhone ise As-Sa'q bin Hazn se riwayat kiya hai.)

e: [AI] "I came to the Messenger of Allah and he mentioned the hadith, 'And Abu Janab Al-Kalbi prevented Talhah bin Musarrif from narrating from Zirr bin Hubaysh. And Abu Janab, whoever does not rely on his narration in this book, Shiban contradicted him."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua, phir hadith ka zikr kiya. (Abu Janab Al-Kalbi ne ise Talhah bin Musarrif se, unhone Zirr bin Hubaysh se, mauqoof (raawi tak mahdood) riwayat kiya hai, aur Abu Janab ki riwayat is kitab mein hujjat nahi mani jati.) Shaiban ne inse ikhtilaf kiya hai.

e: [AI] "Indeed, he does not do what you have done for him, except that the angels have placed their wings over him in satisfaction of what he does. And we have mentioned in this Hadith of what is not weakened, as this Hadith has been narrated by a group and another group has stopped at it, and the one who narrated it is more reliable, and the addition from them is accepted."
hi: "Suno, jo koi bhi tumhare jaisa (amal) kare, uske liye farishte apne par bichhate hain, uske amal se raazi hokar." Aur humne is hadith ke baare mein jo zikr kiya hai woh is hadith ko kamzor nahi karta, kyunke aik jama'at ne ise musnad (mutasil sanad ke sath) riwayat kiya hai aur aik jama'at ne ise mauqoof riwayat kiya hai, aur jisne ise musnad kiya woh zyada hafiz hai, aur unki ziyaadti qubool ki jati hai.

e: [AI] So we asked him, "Do you talk like this and you're Iraqi?" He replied, "Because I heard Abu Huraira narrating from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: 'Whoever is asked about knowledge and conceals it, will be brought with a bridle of fire on the Day of Judgment.'"
hi: To unhone humein yeh hadith bayan ki. Humne unse poocha: "Tum yeh bayan kar rahe ho jabke tum Iraqi ho?" Unhone kaha: "Kyunke maine Abu Hurairah (RA) ko Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte hue suna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis se koi ilm ke baare mein poocha jaye aur woh ise chhupaye, use Qayamat ke din is haal mein laaya jayega ke uske mun mein aag ki lagam di gayi hogi.'"

e:
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever is asked about knowledge and conceals it, Allah will bridle him with a bridle of fire on the Day of Resurrection." 

"So I said to him, 'He made a mistake in this regard, either Azhar bin Marwan or your teacher Ibn Ahmad Al-Wasiti, and excluding both of them is far-fetched.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis se koi ilm ke baare mein poocha jaye aur woh ise chhupaye, Allah use Qayamat ke din aag ki lagam pehnaega." (Maine unse kaha: is mein Azhar bin Marwan ya tumhare ustad Ibn Ahmad Al-Wasiti ne ghalti ki hai, aur dono se hi wahm ka ho jana door nahi.)

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Whoever conceals knowledge, Allah will bridle him with a bridle of fire on the Day of Resurrection.' This is an authentic narration from the Egyptians, according to the conditions of both Al-Bukhari and Muslim, and it does not have any defects. It is also narrated in the same chapter through a group of companions, other than Abu Hurairah, according to their condition, and it does not have any defect."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs koi ilm chhupaye, Allah use Qayamat ke din aag ki lagam pehnaega." Yeh Misr walon ki hadith se Shaykhain ki shart par sahih sanad hai aur ismein koi khaami nahi. Is baab mein Abu Hurairah (RA) ke ilawa Sahaba (RA) ke aik giroh se bhi riwayaten hain.

e: [AI] "Do you know why I walked with you?" They said, "Yes, we are the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and you walked with us." He said, "Indeed, you are visiting a people who have a recitation of the Qur'an like the buzzing of bees. Do not distract them with your narrations, narrow down the recitation of the Qur'an, and decrease the narrations from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . And I am your partner." When they arrived at Qaraza, they said, "Tell us." He said, "Ibn al-Khattab prohibited us."
hi: "Kya tumhein pata hai maine tumhare sath kyun chala?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba hain, aap humare sath chale." Unhone (Umar RA ne) kaha: "Tum aik aisi basti ke logon ke paas ja rahe ho jinki Quran ki (tilawat ki) gunjaish shehad ki makkhiyon ki tarah hai, isliye unhein ahadith se pehle mat sunao, warna woh isi mein mashghool ho jayengay. Sirf Quran par dhyan do aur Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat kam karo, aur aage badho, main tumhare sath (is baat ka) shareek hoon." Jab Qaraza (RA) wapas aaye to log kehne lage: "Humein hadith sunao." Unhone kaha: "Ibn Al-Khattab (RA) ne humein mana kiya tha."

e: [AI] "I entered upon Qaradah ibn Ka'b, Abu Mas'ud, and Zaid ibn Thabit, and found slave girls with them singing. So I said to them, 'Are you doing this while being companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?' They replied, 'If you can hear, then listen; otherwise, leave. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  allowed us to engage in playful activities, participate in weddings, and cry at funerals.'"
hi: Main Qaraza bin Ka'b (RA), Abu Mas'ud (RA) aur Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ke paas gaya, to unke paas kuch lounDiyan gaana ga rahi thin. Maine unse kaha: "Aap yeh kar rahe hain jabke aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba hain?" Unhone kaha: "Agar tum sunna chaho to suno, warna chale jao, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein shaadi mein khushi manane aur mayyat par rone ki ijaazat di hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever attributes to me what I have not said should take his place in Hellfire, and whoever seeks advice from his brother and he misguides him, then he has betrayed him. And whoever issues a fatwa without knowledge, then his sin is upon the one who takes his fatwa." This was narrated by Yahya ibn Ayyub from Bakr ibn Amr, who relied on his narrations except for Amr, and he was trustworthy.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo mujh par woh baat mansoob kare jo maine nahi kahi, woh apna thikana Jahannam mein bana le. Aur jis se uske bhai ne mashwara maanga aur usne bagair sahih rai ke mashwara diya, usne uske sath khiyanat ki. Aur jisne bagair pukhta ilm ke fatwa diya, uska gunah usi par hai jisne fatwa diya." Yahya bin Ayyub ne Bakr bin Amr se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever attributes to me that which I did not say, let him take his place in Hellfire. And whoever gives a fatwa (religious verdict) without knowledge, his sin is upon the one who gave him the fatwa. And whoever points to his brother with something he knows is wrong, then he has betrayed him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo mujh par woh baat mansoob kare jo maine nahi kahi, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein bana le. Aur jisne bagair ilm ke fatwa diya, uska gunah usi par hai jisne fatwa diya. Aur jisne apne bhai ko aisi baat ka mashwara diya jismein woh jaanta ho ke sahih rai kisi aur mein hai, usne uske sath khiyanat ki."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: "There will be, in the last days, people from my Ummah (nation) who will inform you about things you and your fathers have not heard. So, be cautious of them and their words."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aakhri zamane mein meri Ummat mein aise log hongay jo tumhe woh baatein sunayengay jo na tumne suni hongi na tumhare baap-dada ne, isliye unse bacho aur unse door raho."

e: [AI] "Economy in the Sunnah is better than striving in innovation." Narrated by Thawri from Al-A'mash from Malik ibn Al-Harith.
hi: "Sunnat par mianah-ravi (mo'tadil chalna) bid'at mein mehnat karne se behtar hai." Ise Ath-Thawri ne Al-A'mash se, unhone Malik bin Al-Harith se riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] "From Abdullah like him."
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA) se bhi isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: "O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from four things: Knowledge which does not profit, a heart which is not submissive, a soul which has an insatiable appetite, and a supplication which is not heard." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1548)
hi: Unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) dua karte hue farmate the: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon chaar cheezon se: aise ilm se jo faidamand na ho, aise dil se jo khushu (Allah ka khauf) na kare, aisi jaan se jo kabhi seer na ho, aur aisi dua se jo qubool na ki jaye."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to supplicate and say: "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not fear (You), from a soul that is not satisfied, and from a prayer that is not heard." And he has a authentic witness in the narration of Anas bin Malik on the condition of being narrated by Muslim.
hi: Nabi (SAW) dua karte hue farmate the: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon chaar cheezon se: aise ilm se jo faidamand na ho, aise dil se jo khushu na kare, aisi jaan se jo kabhi seer na ho, aur aisi dua se jo qubool na ki jaye." Iska aik sahih shahid Anas bin Malik (RA) ki riwayat se Muslim ki shart par bhi hai.

e: [AI] One of the supplications of the Prophet ﷺ  was: "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that is of no benefit, from a heart that does not humble itself, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a prayer that is not answered." And he would say at the end of it, "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from these four." "And it has been reported to me that Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj included it in his narration from Zaid ibn Arqam from the Prophet ﷺ ." And this is according to the condition of Muslim.
