hi: Nabi (SAW) ki duaon mein se yeh bhi thi: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon aise ilm se jo faidamand na ho, aise dil se jo khushu na kare, aisi jaan se jo seer na ho, aur aisi dua se jo qubool na ki jaye," aur aakhir mein farmate: "Aye Allah, main in chaaron se teri panah maangta hoon." (Mujhe pata chala hai ke Muslim bin Al-Hajjaj ne ise Zaid bin Arqam (RA) ki Nabi (SAW) se riwayat mein bhi shamil kiya hai.) Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] "About the Prophet ﷺ, he is just a human being who gets angry just like other humans. So I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, the Quraysh say that I write about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but he is just a human being who gets angry just like other humans.' He motioned with his lips and said, 'By the One in whose hand is my soul, nothing comes out from between these two lips except the truth, so write.'"
hi: ...(Rasulullah SAW) ke baare mein, ke woh sirf aik insaan hain jo insaano ki tarah ghussa hote hain. To main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Quraish kehte hain ke main Rasulullah (SAW) se (sab kuch) likhta hoon jabke aap (SAW) bhi aik insaan hain jo insaano ki tarah ghussa hote hain." Aap (SAW) ne apne honthon ki taraf ishara kiya aur farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, in dono (honthon) ke darmiyan se sirf haq nikalta hai, isliye likh lo."

e: [AI] He said, "O Messenger of Allah, should I write down what I hear from you?" He said, "Yes." I said, "Should I write down both when you are angry and when you are pleased?" He said, "Yes, for it is not permissible for me to speak except the truth." So let the seeker of this knowledge know that no one ever narrated in the lifetime of Amr ibn Shu'aib except Muslim, who heard from Shu'aib through Abdullah ibn Amr. And when a hadith is narrated from Amr ibn Shu'aib from Mujahid from Abdullah ibn Amr, then it is an authentic hadith, although I have mentioned it as a witness to the hadith of Abdul Wahid ibn Qays, and this same hadith has been narrated verbatim from Yusuf ibn Mahak.
hi: Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main woh sab likhun jo aap se sunta hoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Maine poocha: "Ghusse aur khushi dono halaton mein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, kyunke mujhe sirf haq baat kehna hi laayak hai." Is ilm ke talibgar ko jaan lena chahiye ke Amr bin Shu'aib par kabhi kisi ne kalaam (aitraaz) nahi kiya, balke Muslim ne sirf Shu'aib ka Abdullah bin Amr se sunna hone par kalaam kiya hai. Jab yeh hadith Amr bin Shu'aib se, Mujahid se, Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se aaye to woh sahih hoti hai, agarche maine ise sirf Abdul Wahid bin Qais ki hadith ke liye shahid ke tor par zikr kiya hai. Yeh hadith ain isi tarah Yusuf bin Mahak se bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: [AI] I used to write everything I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I wanted to memorize it, but the Quraysh forbade me and said, "You write everything you hear from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is a human who speaks in a state of satisfaction and anger?" So I refrained and mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said, "Write, by the One in whose hand is my soul, nothing comes out of him except the truth." And he pointed with his hand towards those who narrated this Hadith, as they were used as evidence by others after them, excluding Al-Walid. And I think it is Al-Walid ibn Abi Al-Walid Al-Shami, for he is Al-Walid ibn Abdullah, and it is known that his father was literate. If that is the case, then Muslim used him as evidence, and the narration from Amir al-Mu'minin Umar ibn al-Khattab has been authenticated, in which he said, "Limit the knowledge with the book." If Al-Walid is the son of Abu al-Walid al-Shami, then he is a condition set by Muslim.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) se jo bhi sunta har cheez likh leta tha, aur ise yaad rakhna chahta tha, to Quraish ne mujhe mana kiya aur kaha: "Tum har woh cheez likh lete ho jo Rasulullah (SAW) se sunte ho, jabke Rasulullah (SAW) bhi aik insaan hain jo khushi aur ghusse dono mein baat karte hain?" To main ruk gaya aur yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Likho, us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, ismein se sirf haq hi niklta hai," aur aap (SAW) ne apne haath se apne mun ki taraf ishara kiya. Is hadith ke tamam raawiyon ko - is Waleed ke siwa - hujjat mana gaya hai, aur mera khayal hai yeh Waleed bin Abi Al-Waleed Ash-Shami hain, ya'ni Waleed bin Abdullah, aur unke waalid ke likhne ka ilm hai. Agar aisa hai to Muslim ne unhein hujjat mana hai. Aur Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se sahih riwayat hai ke unhone farmaya: "Ilm ko likhne se qaid karo (mahfooz banao)."

e: [AI] This is a authentic narration from Anas ibn Malik and it has been attributed to him from a reliable source. As for the narration from his saying, it is also correct and has been confirmed to be his statement.
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se, unke apne qaul se, sahih hai, aur isse aik ghair-mo'tabar tareeqe se bhi mutasil sanad ke sath riwayat kiya gaya hai. Rahi baat unke apne qaul se riwayat ki, to woh sahih hai.

e: [AI] "He used to say to his sons, 'Record knowledge in writing.' It was narrated by some of the people of Basra from the Ansari, and it was also narrated by a respected elder from the people of Mecca who heard it from Ibn Jurayj."
hi: Woh apne beton se kaha karte the: "Ilm ko likhne se qaid karo." Kuch Basra walon ne ise Al-Ansari se riwayat kiya hai, aur isi tarah Makkah ke aik ustad ne bhi ise Ibn Jurayj se, ghair-mo'tabar tareeqe se, riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Attach importance to knowledge." I asked, "And how should we attach importance to it?" He said, "By writing it down." Ibn al-Mumal is considered weak.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ilm ko qaid karo." Maine poocha: "Isse qaid karne ka kya matlab hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise likhna." (Ibn Al-Mu'ammal za'if (kamzor) hain.)

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away, I said to a man from the Ansar, "Come, let us ask the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , for today they are many.” He said, astonished, "Oh Ibn Abbas, do you think people are in need of you while there are companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  among the people?" He said, "So I left that and approached to ask the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and if the narration reached me from a person, I would go to his door, leaning my shawl against it while the wind blew dust on me. Then he would come out and see me, and he would say, 'O cousin of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , what brought you? Why didn't you send someone to come to me?' I would say, 'I am more deserving to come to you.'" He said, "So I would ask him about the hadith and this Ansari man lived until he saw me and the people gathered around me to ask me, and he would say, 'This young boy was more intelligent than me.'"
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafat ho gayi to maine Ansar mein se aik shakhs se kaha: "Aao, hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba se (masail) poochein, kyunke aaj woh kaseer tadaad mein maujood hain." Unhone kaha: "Tumhein ta'ajjub hai, aye Ibn Abbas! Kya tum samajhte ho ke log tumhari zaroorat mehsoos karenge jabke unke darmiyan Rasulullah (SAW) ke aise sahaba maujood hain?" (Ibn Abbas RA ne kaha:) "To maine yeh khayal chhod diya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba se poochna shuru kiya, aur agar mujhe kisi shakhs se koi hadith pahunchti to main uske darwaze par jata jabke woh qailoolah kar raha hota, to main apni chadar apne darwaze par bichhakar leta, hawa mujh par mitti udati rehti, phir woh bahar aata aur mujhe dekhta." To woh kehta: "Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke chacha zaad bhai, aap kyun aaye? Aapne mujhe bulwa liya hota to main khud aa jaata." Main kehta: "Nahi, mera hi haq zyada hai ke main tumhare paas aaun." (Ibn Abbas RA ne kaha:) "To main unse hadith poochta." Yeh Ansari shakhs itna zinda raha ke usne mujhe dekha jab log mere gird jama hokar mujhse (masail) poochte the, to woh kehta: "Yeh naujawan mujhse zyada aqalmand tha."

e: People dispersed from around Abu Huraira, and Natil, who was from the Syrians. said to him: O Shaikh, relate (to us) a tradition you have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: Yes. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: The first of men (whose case) will be decided on the Day of Judgment will be a man who died as a martyr. He shall be brought (before the Judgment Seat). Allah will make him recount His blessings (i. e. the blessings which He had bestowed upon him) and he will recount them (and admit having enjoyed them in his life). (Then) will Allah say: What did you do (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I fought for Thee until I died as a martyr. Allah will say: You have told a lie. You fought that you might be called a" brave warrior". And you were called so. (Then) orders will be passed against him and he will be dragged with his face downward and cast into Hell. Then will be brought forward a man who acquired knowledge and imparted it (to others) and recited the Qur'an. He will be brought And Allah will make him recount His blessings and he will recount them (and admit having enjoyed them in his lifetime). Then will Allah ask: What did you do (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I acquired knowledge and disseminated it and recited the Qur'an seeking Thy pleasure. Allah will say: You have told a lie. You acquired knowledge so that you might be called" a scholar," and you recited the Qur'an so that it might be said:" He is a Qari" and such has been said. Then orders will be passed against him and he shall be dragged with his face downward and cast into the Fire. Then will be brought a man whom Allah had made abundantly rich and had granted every kind of wealth. He will be brought and Allah will make him recount His blessings and he will recount them and (admit having enjoyed them in his lifetime). Allah will (then) ask: What have you done (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I spent money in every cause in which Thou wished that it should be spent. Allah will say: You are lying. You did (so) that it might be said about (You):" He is a generous fellow" and so it was said. Then will Allah pass orders and he will be dragged with his face downward and thrown into Hell. (Using translation from Muslim 1905a)
hi: Unke paas Naatil, jo Shaam walon ka bhai (sathi) tha, aaya (aur kaha): "Aye Abu Hurairah (RA), humein woh hadith sunaiye jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho." Unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Sabse pehle jin logon ka Qayamat ke din faisla kiya jayega woh teen hain: aik shakhs jo shaheed hua, use laaya jayega, Allah use apni ne'matein yaad dilayega, woh unhein pehchan lega. Allah poochega: 'Tumne inke badle mein kya amal kiya?' Woh kahega: 'Maine teri raah mein jang ki yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaya.' Allah farmayega: 'Tumne jhoot kaha, tumne to yeh chaha tha ke log tumhein bahaadur kahein, so keh diya gaya.' Phir hukum diya jayega aur use mun ke bal ghaseet kar Jahannam mein daal diya jayega. Aur aik shakhs jisne ilm seekha aur Quran padha, use laaya jayega, Allah use apni ne'matein yaad dilayega, woh unhein pehchan lega. Allah poochega: 'Tumne inke badle mein kya amal kiya?' Woh kahega: 'Maine ilm seekha, Quran padha aur ise teri khatir kiya.' Allah farmayega: 'Tumne jhoot kaha, tumne to yeh chaha tha ke log tumhein aalim aur qari kahein, so keh diya gaya.' Phir hukum diya jayega aur use mun ke bal ghaseet kar Jahannam mein daal diya jayega. Aur aik shakhs jisse Allah ne har tarah ka maal ata kiya, use laaya jayega, Allah use apni ne'matein yaad dilayega, woh unhein pehchan lega. Allah poochega: 'Tumne inke badle mein kya amal kiya?' Woh kahega: 'Maine har us jagah kharch kiya jahan tu pasand karta tha ke kharch kiya jaye, sab tere liye kharch kiya.' Allah farmayega: 'Tumne jhoot kaha, tumne to yeh chaha tha ke log tumhein saakhi (dariya-dil) kahein, so keh diya gaya.' Phir hukum diya jayega aur use mun ke bal ghaseet kar Jahannam mein daal diya jayega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "There are three types of people who are doomed at the time of reckoning: a generous person who is extravagant, a brave person who is reckless, and a knowledgeable person who does not act upon his knowledge."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (log) hisaab ke waqt halaak ho jaate hain: fuzool-kharch daata, be-parwaah bahaadur, aur (apne ilm par amal na karne wala) aalim."

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah, if it were not for the fact that Allah had taken a covenant from the People of the Book, I would not have told you about anything. Then he recited, "And [mention] when Allah took a covenant from those who were given the Scripture, [saying], 'You must make it clear to the people and not conceal it.'" [Quran 3:187]
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) (ne kaha): "Agar Allah ne Ahl-e-Kitab se woh ahd na liya hota, to main tumhein kabhi kuch bhi na bataata." Phir unhone yeh ayat parhi: "Aur jab Allah ne un logon se ahd liya jinhein Kitab di gayi thi ke tum ise logon ke saamne zaroor zaahir karoge aur ise chhupaoge nahi" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 187).

e: [AI] Abu Hurayrah used to stand on the side of the pulpit on Fridays, throwing the straps of his sandals on his arms. Then he would grab onto the handle of the pulpit and say, "Abu Al-Qasim (the Prophet Muhammad) said, 'The Messenger of Allah said, 'The truthful, the trustworthy person said.''' And then he would say about some of that, "Woe to the Arabs from an impending evil." When he heard the sound of the door of the prayer area opening for the Imam to come out, he would sit down.
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) jum'a ke din mimbar ke ek taraf khade hote, apne jooton ki aidiyan apni baazuon mein daal lete, phir mimbar ke rumana (gol hisse) ko pakad kar kehte: "Abu Al-Qasim (SAW) ne farmaya," "Muhammad (SAW) ne farmaya," "Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya," "Sachche aur sach-maane gaye (Nabi SAW) ne farmaya." Phir kabhi kabhi kehte: "Arab ke liye halaakat hai us burai se jo qareeb aa chuki hai." Jab woh maqsoorah (khaas hujray) ke darwaze ki aawaz sunte, ke Imam bahar aa raha hai, to baith jate.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "I do not trust anyone of you while reclining on his couch, when something from my commands or prohibitions comes to him and he says, 'We do not know what we found in the Book of Allah, so we followed it.'" Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah has established this chain and it is authentic according to the conditions of both al-Bukhari and Muslim, but they did not include it. As for me, they left it due to the disagreement of the Egyptians regarding this chain according to their conditions and they left it.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tum mein se kisi ko is haal mein na paun ke woh apne takht par takiya lagaye baitha ho aur usske paas mera koi hukum ya mumaana't pahunche, phir woh kahe: humein nahi pata, jo humein Allah ki Kitab mein mila woh humne pairavi ki." Sufyan bin Uyainah ne is sanad ko mustaqil (jama) kiya hai, aur yeh Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai magar unhone ise nahi nikala. Mera khayal hai unhone ise Misr walon ke is sanad mein ikhtilaf ki wajah se chhoda hai.

e:
[AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I do not know of a man who reclines, and then an affair of my affairs comes to him which I have commanded or forbidden, and he says, "I don't know, this is the Book of Allah and it does not contain it."'"

Note: The English translation of the phrase "ﷺ" is "peace be upon him".
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main kisi shakhs ko is haal mein na jaanun ke woh takiya lagaye ho aur usske paas mera koi hukum ya mumaana't pahunche, phir woh kahe: humein nahi pata, yeh to Allah ki Kitab hai, ismein yeh baat nahi."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "And the people around him do not know if any of you receives a matter from my affairs that I have commanded or prohibited, and he is reclining on his couch and says, 'We did not find anything in the Book of Allah that we acted upon, and if it was otherwise, then no.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne, logon ke apne gird hote hue, farmaya: "Main tum mein se kisi ko is haal mein na jaanun ke uske paas mera koi hukum ya mumaana't pahunche jabke woh apne takht par takiya lagaye ho, phir woh kahe: jo humein Allah ki Kitab mein mila usi par amal kiya, warna nahi."

e: [AI] He heard Al-Miqdam ibn Ma'di Yakrib Al-Kindi, the companion of the Prophet (pbuh), saying: "The Prophet (pbuh) declared certain things forbidden on the day of Khaybar, including domestic donkeys and others." The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) then said: "Soon, a person from among you will sit on his couch and narrate my hadith, saying, 'Between me and you is the Book of Allah. Whatever we find permissible in it, we declare it permissible, and whatever we find forbidden in it, we declare it forbidden.' Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) forbade only what Allah had forbidden." As for the second hadith, Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Unhone Al-Miqdam bin Ma'di Yakrib Al-Kindi (RA), jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi hain, ko yeh kehte hue suna: Nabi (SAW) ne Khaybar ke din kuch cheezein haram qaraar din, unme paalthu gadha aur kuch aur cheezein shamil thin. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qareeb hai ke tum mein se koi apne takht par baithkar meri hadith sunega, to woh kahega: humare aur tumhare darmiyan Allah ki Kitab hai, jo halal ismein paayenge use halal maanenge aur jo haram ismein paayenge use haram maanenge - halanke Rasulullah (SAW) ne to sirf woh haram qaraar diya jo Allah ne haram kiya." (Doosri hadith ke baare mein) Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] From the tradition of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , when a man said to him, "O Abu Nujayd, tell us about the Quran," Imran (may Allah be pleased with him) said, "Are you and your companions reciting the Quran? Were you informed about the prayer and its obligations? Were you informed about the zakat (charity) in terms of gold, camels, cows, and different forms of wealth? However, I have witnessed and you have been absent." Then he said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  made it obligatory for us in zakat such and such." The man said, "You have revived me, may Allah revive you." Al-Hasan said, "That man did not die until he became one of the scholars of the Muslims, Uqbah ibn Khalid Al-Shanni, from the trustworthy people of Basra and its worshipers. He was an esteemed narrator of hadith whose narrations were compiled, but he did not reach the perfection of the ten merits (top narrators). May peace be upon Muhammad and his family, all of them."
hi: ...humare Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat ke baare mein, jab aik shakhs ne unse kaha: "Aye Abu Nujaid, humein Quran sunao," to Imran (RA) ne usse kaha: "Tum aur tumhare saathi Quran padhte ho, kya tum mujhe namaz, uske arkaan aur uski hudood ke baare mein bata sakte ho? Kya tum mujhe zakat ke baare mein bata sakte ho - sone, unton, gaay-bail aur maal ki tamam qismon mein? Lekin main (yeh sab) mojood tha aur tum ghair-mojood the." Phir unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humpar zakat mein itna-itna farz kiya tha." Us shakhs ne kaha: "Aapne mujhe (dobara) zinda kar diya, Allah aapko zinda rakhe." Al-Hasan ne kaha: "Woh shakhs is waqt tak nahi mara jab tak woh Musalmanon ke fuqaha mein se aik na ban gaya." Uqbah bin Khalid Ash-Shanni Basra ke thiqa aur ibadat-guzaar logon mein se hain, aur unki hadith kam-yaab hai, unki jama'shuda hadith das tak bhi nahi pahunchti.

e: [AI] "Tauus used to pray two units of prayer after Asr (afternoon prayer), so Ibn Abbas said to him: 'Leave it.' Tauus replied: 'We have only been prohibited from them if they are made to resemble the obligatory prayer before sunset.' Ibn Abbas said: 'Verily, the Prophet ﷺ used to prohibit prayer after Asr, and I do not know if one would be punished for it or rewarded, for Allah Almighty says: 'And it is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair.' (Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:36)."
hi: Tawus Asr ke baad do rak'at namaz padha karte the, to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unse kaha: "Ise chhod do." Unhone kaha: "In (do rak'aton) se sirf isliye mana kiya gaya hai ke unhein sooraj doobne tak jaari rakhne ka zariya na banaya jaye." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Asr ke baad namaz se mana kiya hai, aur mujhe nahi pata ke (is amal par) azab hoga ya ajr milega, kyunke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: 'Aur kisi momin mard ya momin aurat ke liye yeh haq nahi ke jab Allah aur uska Rasool kisi maamle ka faisla kar den to unke liye us maamle mein koi ikhtiyar baaqi rahe' (Surah Al-Ahzab 36)."

e: [AI] To Ibn Mas'ud, Abu Darda, and Abu Dharr, "What is this hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ? I think they held it back in Madinah until they were able to write it down." Reported by Affan and others from him, meaning from Shu'bah.
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA), Abu Ad-Darda (RA) aur Abu Dharr (RA) ke liye: "Rasulullah (SAW) se yeh hadith kya hai? Mera khayal hai unhein Madinah mein rok liya gaya tha yahan tak ke woh (kisi museebat mein) mubtala ho gaye." Ise Affan aur doosron ne unse - ya'ni Shu'bah se - riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] Concerning the branch, he mentioned the hadith with its Isnad (chain of narrators) in a similar manner.
hi: Shu'bah se, unhone isi jaisi sanad ke sath hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] "On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , his clothing became wrinkled or disheveled." Then he said, "Or similar to this."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai... woh larzay aur unke kapde bhi larzay, phir farmaya: "ya isi jaisi koi baat."

e: [AI] A partner praised him in his own way.
hi: Humein Shareek ne bataya, phir unhone isi jaisi baat ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Until at the time of nightfall, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'So I looked at him and behold, his shirt buttons were undone, his hair was disheveled and there were marks around his eyes.' Then he said, 'It was like this or higher than this, or close to this, or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya... yahan tak ke aik shaam hui, (raawi ne) kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine unki taraf dekha to dekha unki qamees ke botam khule hue thay, unki rag-e-jaan phooli hui thi, unki aankhon mein aansu bhare hue thay," phir farmaya: "isi tarah, ya isse zyada, ya isi ke qareeb, ya jaisa Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi narrated to me, Abu Shihab narrated to me, and Ali ibn Hamshad al-Adl narrated to me, Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Awdhi narrated to me, Abu al-Rabi'i narrated to me, Abu Shihab narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Ma'bad ibn Ka'b ibn Malik who said, "I heard Abu Qatada saying, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, while he was on the pulpit, 'Beware of excessive talking about me. Whoever says about me something that I have not said, let him take his place in Hellfire.' And in the narration of Muhammad ibn 'Ubayd, he narrated to me from Ibn Ka'b and others, from Abu Qatada."
hi: Maine Abu Qatadah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko mimbar par yeh farmate hue suna: "Mujh se zyada hadith bayan karne se bacho, jo mujh se koi baat bayan kare to sirf haq baat kahe, aur jo mujh par woh baat mansoob kare jo maine nahi kahi, woh apna thikana Jahannam mein bana le." Aur Muhammad bin Ubaid ki hadith mein hai: "mujhe Ibn Ka'b aur doosron ne Abu Qatadah (RA) se bayan ki."

e: [AI] Tell me something you heard from the Messenger of Allah, may peace and blessings be upon him. He said, "I fear that my tongue may slip into saying something that the Messenger of Allah, may peace and blessings be upon him, did not say. I have heard the Messenger of Allah, may peace and blessings be upon him, say, 'Beware of speaking excessively about me. Whoever intentionally lies about me should prepare his place in the Fire.'"
hi: "Mujhe koi aisi baat sunao jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe darr hai ke kahin meri zabaan aisi koi baat na phisla de jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne na kahi ho. Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Mujh se zyada hadith bayan karne se bacho, jo mujh par jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apna thikana Jahannam mein bana le.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is enough for a person to be sinful by speaking about everything he hears." Muslim mentioned this hadith in the midst of the narrations he mentioned in his sermon in the book, regarding Muhammad ibn Rafee', without using it as evidence in its proper place in the book. Ali ibn Ja'far al-Madaini is trustworthy, and he warned us at the beginning of the book to debate using the statements of trustworthy narrators. A group of Shu'bah's companions transmitted this. Muslim mentioned it in an authentic sermon.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Insaan ke gunahgar hone ke liye itna kaafi hai ke woh har suni hui baat bayan kar de." Muslim ne is hadith ka zikr apni kitaab ke muqaddime ki kahaniyon ke darmiyan Muhammad bin Rafi' se kiya hai, magar isse kisi jagah hujjat ke tor par nahi nikala. Ali bin Ja'far Al-Madaini thiqa hain, aur humne kitaab ke shuru mein isharah kiya hai ke thiqa raawiyon ki ziyaadti ko hujjat mana jayega. Isse Shu'bah ke kayi shagirdon ne mursal (bina sahabi ke) riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "It is sufficient for a person to be considered sinful by narrating everything he hears."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Insaan ke gunahgar hone ke liye itna kaafi hai ke woh har suni hui baat bayan kar de."

e: [AI] This is a valid chain of narration according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, and it has another similar witness.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai... "yahan tak ke tum log mushkil aur aasaan (dono qism ki sawariyon) par sawaar ho gaye." Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, aur iska aik aur milta-julta shahid bhi hai.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he was not lying, when the people faced difficulty and humiliation, we stopped talking about it and sent peace and blessings upon Muhammad and his family.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, jab tak unpar jhoot na bola jaye, (hum riwayat karte the). Phir jab log mushkil aur aasaan (har qism ki sawariyon) par sawaar ho gaye, to humne unse hadith bayan karna chhod diya. Wa sallallahu ala Muhammadin wa aalihi wa sallam.

e: [AI] The last thing the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to us was: "Stick to the Book of Allah, and you will return to a people who love Hadiths about me or something similar. Whoever memorizes something should narrate it, and whoever attributes to me something I did not say should take his seat in the Fire." This hadith is narrated by the last among them, and it is referenced by them. As for Abu Musa Malik ibn Ubada al-Ghafari, he is a companion who settled in Egypt. This hadith is one of the things we have transmitted from the companion if the way to him is authentic, although the farewell of al-Juhani also narrates it from Malik ibn Ubada al-Ghafari. This hadith combines two strange phrases, one of them being: "You will return to a people who love Hadiths about me," and the other being: "Whoever memorizes something should narrate it." A group of Islamic scholars have concluded that a narrator should only narrate what he has memorized, and they did not consider these two phrases as evidence.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein aakhri wasiyat mein farmaya: "Allah ki Kitab ko lazim pakdo, aur tum aise logon ki taraf laut kar jaoge jo mujh se hadith sunna pasand karengay - ya isi jaisa lafz - to jo shakhs koi baat yaad rakhe woh use bayan kare, aur jo mujh par woh baat mansoob kare jo maine nahi kahi, woh apna thikana Jahannam mein bana le." Is hadith ke tamam raawiyon ko hujjat mana jata hai. Rahi baat Abu Musa Malik bin Ubadah Al-Ghafiqi (RA) ki, to woh aik sahabi hain jo Misr mein rehte thay, aur yeh hadith un ahadith mein se hai jo humne kisi sahabi se, jab unka raasta sahih ho, nikaali hain, agarche Wada'ah Al-Juhani ne bhi Malik bin Ubadah Al-Ghafiqi se riwayat ki hai. Is hadith mein do gharib (kam-yaab) alfaz jama hain: aik unka farmaan 'tum aise logon ki taraf laut kar jaoge jo mujh se hadith sunna pasand karengay,' aur doosra 'jo koi baat yaad rakhe woh use bayan kare.' Islam ke kayi imamon ne kaha hai ke muhaddis ko woh baat bayan nahi karni chahiye jo usne yaad na rakhi ho, aur dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ne ise nahi nikala.

e: The people used to ask Messenger of Allah ﷺ about good, but I used to ask him about evil for fear that it might overtake me. Once I said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! We were in ignorance and in evil and Allah has bestowed upon us the present good; will there by any evil after this good?" He said, "Yes." I asked, "Will there be good after that evil?" He said, "Yes, but it would be tained with Dakhan (i.e. Little evil)." I asked, "What will its Dakhan be?" He said, "There will be some people who will lead (people) according to principles other than my tradition. You will see their actions and disapprove of them." I said, "Will there by any evil after that good?" He said, "Yes, there will be some people who will invite others to the doors of Hell, and whoever accepts their invitation to it will be thrown in it (by them)." I said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! Describe those people to us." He said, "They will belong to us and speak our language" I asked, "What do you order me to do if such a thing should take place in my life?" He said, "Adhere to the group of Muslims and their Chief." I asked, "If there is neither a group (of Muslims) nor a chief (what shall I do)?" He said, "Keep away from all those different sects, even if you had to bite (i.e. eat) the root of a tree, till you meet Allah while you are still in that state." (Using translation from Bukhārī 3606)
hi: Unhone Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (RA) ko kehte hue suna: log Rasulullah (SAW) se khair (bhalai) ke baare mein poochte thay, aur main aap (SAW) se sharr (burai) ke baare mein poochta tha, is darr se ke kahin woh mujh tak na pahunch jaye. Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum jahiliyat aur burai mein thay, phir Allah yeh khair lekar aaya, to kya is khair ke baad koi sharr aayega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, aur ismein dhuan (halka fasad) hoga." Maine poocha: "Uska dhuan kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aise log jo meri hidayat ke ilawa kisi aur tareeqe par hidayat denge, tum unme se kuch (baaton) ko pehchanoge aur kuch ko napasand karoge." Maine poocha: "Kya is khair ke baad koi sharr aayega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, Jahannam ke darwazon par dawat dene wale (log honge), jo unki dawat qubool karega, woh use usme phenk denge." Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), unki sifat humein bataiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh humari hi qaum ke honge aur humari hi zabaan bolengay." Maine poocha: "To agar main woh zamana paun to mujhe kya hukum dete hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalmanon ki jama'at aur unke imam ko lazim pakdo." Maine poocha: "Aur agar unka koi imam na ho aur na jama'at ho?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To un tamam firqon se alag ho jao, chahe tumhein kisi darakht ki jad chabana pade, yahan tak ke tumhein isi haal mein maut aa jaye."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood before us as I am standing before you, and said: ʿI urge you to show respect to my Companions, then those who come after them, then those who come after them, then lying will become so widespread that a man will start to give testimony before he is asked to do so.Whoever among you wants to attain a spacious abode in Paradise, let him adhere to the jama'ah (main body of Muslims), for the Shaitan is with the one who is alone, but he is further away from two. And no one of you should be alone with a woman for the Shaitan will be the third one present. The one who is pleased with his good deeds and upset by his bad deeds is a believer.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 114)
hi: "Main tum mein aisi jagah khada hua hoon jaisi Rasulullah (SAW) humare darmiyan khade huay thay." Phir farmaya: "Main tumhein apne sahaba ke baare mein wasiyat karta hoon, phir unke baad walon ke baare mein, phir unke baad walon ke baare mein, phir jhoot itna aam ho jayega ke aadmi qasam khayega bina usse maanga jaye, aur gawahi dega bina usse maanga jaye. Jo tum mein se Jannat ke beech (khushgawaar hisse) mein rehna chahe use jama'at ko lazim pakdna chahiye, kyunke Shaitan akele shakhs ke sath hota hai, aur do logon se woh zyada door rehta hai. Suno! Koi mard kisi aurat ke sath tanhaai mein na baithe, kyunke unka teesra sathi Shaitan hoga." Yeh baat aap (SAW) ne teen martaba farmayi. "Jama'at ko lazim pakdo, kyunke Shaitan akele shakhs ke sath hota hai, aur do logon se woh zyada door rehta hai. Suno! Jise apni neki khush kare aur apni burai bura lage, woh momin hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once stood among us and said, "I urge you to treat my companions well." Then he mentioned the hadith in the following way, "And as for the second witness..."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humare darmiyan usi tarah khade huay jaise main tumhare darmiyan khada hoon, aur farmaya: "Mere sahaba ke sath achha sulook karo." Phir hadith ka zikr kiya isi jaisa. (Doosra shahid...)

e: [AI] I have stood among you as the position of the messenger of Allah ﷺ  among us, so he mentioned the hadith in this way: "As for the differences in this hadith from Abdul Malik ibn Umayr, it is a composition that is in my collection. And what I have is that the two Imams narrate this hadith from that difference between the Imams about Abdul Malik in it, and these chains are not justified by these chains that come out of it." And we have narrated it with a authentic chain from Saad ibn Abi Waqqas from Umar, their condition.
hi: "Main tum mein aisi jagah khada hua hoon jaisi Rasulullah (SAW) humare darmiyan khade huay thay," phir hadith ka zikr isi jaisa kiya. (Abdul Malik bin Umair ki riwayat mein is hadith ke baare mein jo ikhtilaf hai, woh mere paas aik juz (kitaabi hissa) mein jama hai, aur mera khayal hai ke dono Imam (Bukhari-Muslim) is hadith ko us ikhtilaf ki wajah se riwayat karte hain jo a'imma ke darmiyan Abdul Malik ke baare mein hai, aur woh asaneed in bahar wali asaneed se aib-daar nahi kiye jate.) Aur humne ise Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) se, unhone Umar (RA) se, sahih sanad ke sath riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] He heard my article and paid attention to it. I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  standing among us as I am standing among you now. Then he said, "Preserve me among my companions, then among those who follow them, then among those who follow them." "Then there will be a lot of noise, falsehood will appear, a man will give testimony without being asked, and will swear without being asked to swear. Whoever loves someone for the sake of Paradise, let them stick to the congregation, as the devil is with the individual, but he is farther away from two. Beware! No man should be alone with a woman, as the devil will be the third of them. Whoever is pleased with his good deed and displeased with his evil deed, then he is a believer." This is the second Hadith in which scholars use it as evidence that consensus is a proof. It is a disputed Hadith different from Ma'tamir ibn Sulayman in seven aspects. The first aspect is this, and it is authentic.
hi: ...usne meri baat suni aur usse yaad rakha. Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha ke woh humare darmiyan khade huay jaise main tumhare darmiyan khada hoon, phir farmaya: "Mujhe apne sahaba ke baare mein yaad rakho, phir unke baad walon ke baare mein, phir unke baad walon ke baare mein" - yeh teen martaba farmaya - "phir fasad badh jayega, jhoot zaahir hoga, aadmi gawahi dega bina usse maanga jaye, aur qasam khayega bina usse maanga jaye. Jo tum mein se Jannat ke beech (khushgawaar hisse) mein rehna chahe use jama'at ko lazim pakdna chahiye, kyunke Shaitan akele shakhs ke sath hota hai, aur do logon se woh zyada door rehta hai. Suno! Koi mard kisi aurat ke sath tanhaai mein na baithe, kyunke Shaitan unka teesra hoga. Jise apni neki khush kare aur apni burai bura lage, woh momin hai." Doosri hadith jise ulama ne is baat par daleel banaya hai ke ijma' (Ummat ka ittifaq) hujjat hai, yeh Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman se saat tareeqon se mukhtalif riwayat hui hai, pehla tareeqa yeh hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah will never unite this ummah upon misguidance." And he also said: "The hand of Allah is over a ˹united˺ group, so follow the majority, for whoever deviates will deviate into the Hellfire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah is Ummat ko kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega," aur farmaya: "Allah ka haath jama'at ke sath hai, isliye sabse bade giroh (Ahl-e-Sunnat wal-Jama'at) ki pairavi karo, kyunke jo alag hua woh aag mein alag hua."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah will never unite my Ummah on misguidance, and the Allah's hand (blessings) is upon the Jamāʿah (majority)." (Using translation from Ḥākim 399)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah is Ummat ko kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega, aur Allah ka haath jama'at ke sath hai, jo alag hua woh aag mein alag hua."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah will never unite my Ummah on misguidance, and the Allah's hand (blessings) is upon the Jamāʿah (majority)." (Using translation from Ḥākim 399)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah meri Ummat ko kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Allah will never gather my Ummah (community) upon misguidance, and the hand of Allah is over the group (Jama'ah) like this - and he raised his hands - for whoever deviates, then he deviates to the Hellfire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah meri Ummat ko kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega, aur Allah ka haath jama'at ke sath hai isi tarah" - aur aap (SAW) ne apne dono haath uthaye - "kyunke jo alag hua woh aag mein alag hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Allah will never unite this ummah - or he said, my ummah - on misguidance. They will follow the greatest group of Muslims. So whoever deviates, deviates into the Hellfire." Umair bin Ja'far Al-Basri narrated to us, saying: "This is mentioned in the book of Abu Al-Husayn, from Salim bin Abi Al-Dhayyal."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah is Ummat ko - ya farmaya: meri Ummat ko - kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega, aur sabse bade giroh ki pairavi karo, kyunke jo alag hua woh aag mein alag hua." Humein Umar bin Ja'far Al-Basri ne bataya: "Isi tarah Abu Al-Husain ki kitaab mein hai, Salim bin Abi Adh-Dhayyal se."

e: [AI] The Prophet of Allah (SAW) said, "Allah will never unite my Ummah upon misguidance, and the hand of Allah is upon the group here (indicating a straight path). So follow the majority, for whoever deviates will be in Hellfire."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah meri Ummat ko kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega, aur Allah ka haath jama'at ke sath isi tarah hai, isliye sabse bade giroh ki pairavi karo, kyunke jo alag hua woh aag mein alag hua."

e: 'Indeed Allah will not gather my Ummah " - or he said: "[Muhammad's]Ummah upon deviation, and Allah's Hand is over the Jama'ah, and whoever deviates, he deviates to the Fire." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2167)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah meri Ummat ko - ya farmaya: Muhammad (SAW) ki Ummat ko - kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega, aur Allah ka haath jama'at ke sath hai," aur aap (SAW) ne apna haath phaila kar farmaya: "jo alag hua woh aag mein alag hua."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah will never unite my Ummah on misguidance, and the Allah's hand (blessings) is upon the Jamāʿah (majority)." (Using translation from Ḥākim 399)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah meri Ummat ko - ya farmaya: is Ummat ko - kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega, aur Allah ka haath jama'at ke sath hai."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah will never unite my Ummah on misguidance, and the Allah's hand (blessings) is upon the Jamāʿah (majority)."[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah meri Ummat ko kabhi gumraahi par jama nahi karega, aur Allah ka haath jama'at ke sath hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ  that he asked his Lord four things, "He asked his Lord not to die of hunger, and he was granted that. He asked his Lord that they would not gather upon misguidance, and he was granted that. He asked his Lord that they would not turn back to disbelief, and he was granted that. He asked his Lord that their enemies would not overpower them to the extent that they would have the upper hand against them, and he was granted that. He asked his Lord that there would be no fighting amongst them, but he was not granted that." "As for Mubarak bin Suhaim, he is among those who do not walk in the footsteps of this Hadith, but I mentioned him by necessity. The third Hadith is regarding the argument of scholars that consensus is a proof."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke baare mein, ke unhone apne Rab se chaar cheezein maangi: "Unhone apne Rab se maanga ke unki Ummat bhook se na mare, to unhein woh de diya gaya. Unhone apne Rab se maanga ke woh gumraahi par jama na hon, to unhein woh de diya gaya. Unhone apne Rab se maanga ke woh murtad hokar kafir na ban jayen, to unhein woh de diya gaya. Unhone apne Rab se maanga ke koi dushman unpar ghalib na aaye jo unki taqat ko mubah (khatam) kar de, to unhein woh de diya gaya. Aur unhone apne Rab se maanga ke unke darmiyan aapas mein jang na ho, to unhein yeh nahi diya gaya." (Rahi baat Mubarak bin Suhaim ki, to woh un logon mein se hain jinka is kitaab jaisi kitaab mein zikr munasib nahi, lekin maine unhein majboori mein zikr kiya hai. Yeh teesri hadith hai ulama ki us daleel mein ke ijma' hujjat hai.)

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: He who separates from the community within a span takes off the noose of Islam from his neck. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4758)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs jama'at se aik bitte (chhoti si doori) bhi alag ho jaye, usne Islam ka tauq apni gardan se utaar diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever goes against the Muslim community even by an inch, has removed the cloak of Islam from his neck." "Khalid bin Wuhban was not criticized in his narrations, and he is known as a reliable follower, except that the two sheikhs did not include him (in their compilations)." And this text has been narrated from Abdullah bin Umar with a sound chain of narration according to their conditions. Khalid has not weakened.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Musalmanon ki jama'at se aik bitte bhi ikhtilaf kare, usne Islam ka tauq apni gardan se utaar diya." (Khalid bin Wahban ki riwayat mein koi aib nahi paaya gaya, aur woh aik jaana-mana Tabi'i hain, sirf itna hai ke Shaykhain ne unse riwayat nahi nikali.) Yeh matan Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se bhi sahih sanad ke sath, dono ki shart par, riwayat hui hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever separates from the congregation by a hand span has removed the bond of Islam from his neck until he returns." He also said, "Whoever dies without having an imam of the congregation, his death is like the death of the pre-Islamic era." This is the fourth hadith indicating that the consensus of scholars is considered valid evidence. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs jama'at se aik bitte bhi nikal jaye, usne Islam ka tauq apni gardan se utaar diya, yahan tak ke woh usi (jama'at) ki taraf laut aaye." Aur farmaya: "Jo shakhs is haal mein mare ke uspar jama'at ka koi imam na ho, uski maut jahiliyat ki maut hai." (Yeh chauthi hadith hai jo isse ishara karti hai ke ulama ka ijma' hujjat hai.) Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "I command you with five things that Allah has commanded me with: the congregation, listening, obedience, migration, and striving in the way of Allah. Whoever separates himself from the congregation by a handspan has removed the bond of Islam from his head, unless he returns." This narration was reported by Mu'awiya bin Salam and Aban bin Yazid al-Attar from Yahya bin Abi Kathir. As for the narration of Mu'awiya, Adh-Dhahabi refrained from summarizing it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: main tumhein paanch baaton ka hukum deta hoon jinka Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai: jama'at, sunna, itaa'at, hijrat, aur Allah ki raah mein jihad. Jo shakhs jama'at se aik bitte bhi nikal jaye, usne Islam ka tauq apne sar se utaar diya, siwaye is ke ke woh wapas aa jaye. (Isi tarah Muawiyah bin Sallam aur Aban bin Yazid Al-Attar ne Yahya bin Abi Kathir se poori lambai ke sath riwayat kiya hai.) Rahi baat Muawiyah ki hadith ki, Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah has commanded me with five actions, which I adhere to." He then narrated the long hadith, and as for the hadith of Aban ibn Yazid from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, (it is not mentioned in the given text).
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne mujhe paanch cheezon ka hukum diya hai jinpar main amal karta hoon," phir poori hadith ka zikr kiya. (Rahi baat Aban bin Yazid ki, Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, riwayat ki...)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah commanded Yahya ibn Zakariyya with five deeds to act upon, and He commanded the Children of Israel to act upon them as well." He mentioned the Hadith and said in it, "Verily, Allah commands me with five deeds," and he mentioned it in its entirety.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ko paanch baaton ka hukum diya jinpar amal karna tha, aur Bani Israel ko hukum diya ke woh bhi unpar amal karein," phir hadith ka zikr kiya aur ismein farmaya: "Beshak Allah mujhe bhi paanch baaton ka hukum deta hai," phir poori tafseel ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Whoever leaves the congregation even by a handspan, enters the Fire." "The fifth hadith that indicates that consensus is an evidence."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs jama'at se aik bitte bhi alag ho, woh Jahannam mein dakhil hoga." (Paanchwi hadith hai jo isse ishara karti hai ke ijma' hujjat hai.)

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Whoever separates from a community or reverts to being a Bedouin after his migration, he will have no proof (of his claim)." The two scholars (Bukhari and Muslim) agreed on excluding the hadith of Ghailan ibn Jarir from Ziyad ibn Ri'ah, from Abu Hurairah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever separates from the congregation and dies, his death is the death of ignorance." This wording is different from the sixth hadith indicating that consensus is a source of proof. They agreed on excluding Abu Hurairah in such cases.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo shakhs Ummat se alag ho jaye ya apni hijrat ke baad dobara dehati (jaisa) ban jaye, uske paas koi daleel nahi." Shaykhain ka is baat par ittifaq hai ke Ghailan bin Jarir ki, Ziyad bin Riyah se, Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat sahih hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs jama'at se alag ho aur usi haal mein mar jaye, uski maut jahiliyat ki maut hai." Yeh matan us hadith se alag hai. (Chhati hadith hai jo isse ishara karti hai ke ijma' hujjat hai.)

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Whoever separates from the community and becomes submissive to authority, will meet Allah with no proof for himself." This was reported by Abu Asim from Kathir.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo shakhs jama'at se alag ho aur hukumat ko haqir samjhe, woh Allah se is haal mein milega ke uske paas koi daleel nahi hogi." Abu Aasim ne Kathir se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say: "Whoever separates from the community and becomes humiliated by authority, he will meet Allah and will have no evidence with Allah."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo shakhs jama'at se alag ho aur hukumat ko haqir samjhe, woh Allah se is haal mein milega ke uske paas Allah ke huzoor koi daleel nahi hogi."

e: [AI] Abu Ali al-Janbi told him that Amr ibn Malik narrated to him from Fadalah ibn Ubayd from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said: "There are three people that a man should not ask about: a person who separates from the community and disobeys his leader and dies in disobedience, a slave or servant who runs away from his master and dies, and a woman whose husband is absent and she has sufficient means of livelihood and then she adorns herself after his departure, so do not ask about them."
hi: Abu Ali Al-Janbi, Amr bin Malik, ne unhein Fadalah bin Ubaid (RA) se bataya, Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat karte hue, ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (log) hain jinke baare mein na poochho: woh shakhs jo jama'at se alag ho aur apne imam ki na-farmani kare aur na-farmani ki haalat mein mar jaye; aur woh laundi ya ghulam jo apne malik se bhaag jaye aur usi haal mein mar jaye; aur woh aurat jiska shohar (safar par) gaya ho aur usne duniya ki (tamam) zaroorat poori kar rakhi ho, phir woh uske baad khud ko sanwar kar zaahir kare - inke baare mein na poochho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The obligatory prayer to the obligatory prayer that follows it is an expiation for what is between them. And the Friday prayer to the Friday prayer, and the fasting of one month to the fasting of another month, which means from the month of Ramadan to the month of Ramadan, is an expiation for what is between them." Then he said afterwards, "Except for three." So I understood that this is something important that he is about to mention. He said, "Except for associating partners with Allah, breaking a deal, and abandoning the Sunnah." I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, we understand what it means to associate partners with Allah, but what does breaking a deal and abandoning the Sunnah mean?" He said, "Breaking a deal is when you make a transaction with someone and then you dispute with them, you confront them with your sword. And abandoning the Sunnah is leaving the congregation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Farz namaz apne baad ki farz namaz tak, unke darmiyan (ke sagheera gunahon) ka kaffara hai, aur jum'a apne baad ke jum'e tak, aur mahina apne baad ke mahine tak - ya'ni Ramzan se Ramzan tak - unke darmiyan (gunahon) ka kaffara hai," phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "siwaye teen (baaton) ke." Maine samajh liya ke yeh koi khaas baat hai, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Siwaye Allah ke sath shirk karne, ahd todne aur Sunnat chhorne ke." Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ke sath shirk to humein maloom hai, lekin ahd todna aur Sunnat chhodna kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ahd todna yeh hai ke tum kisi shakhs se apne haath se bai'at karo, phir usse ikhtilaf karo aur apni talwar se uska saamna karo. Aur Sunnat chhodna yeh hai ke jama'at se nikal jao."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us in Nabawah” or Banawah – he (one of the narrators) said: “Nabawah is near Ta’if” – “And said: ‘Soon you will be able to tell the people of Paradise from the people of Hell.’ They said: ‘How O Messenger of Allah?’ He said: ‘By praise and condemnation. You are Allah’s witnesses over one another.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4221)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Nabaat ya Nabawah (jagah) mein yeh farmate hue suna: "Aqareeb hai ke tum Jannat walon ko Jahannam walon se pehchan loge" - ya farmaya: "apne achhon ko apne buron se" - poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kis zariye se?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Achhi tareef aur buri tareef se, tum aik doosre par gawah ho."

e: [AI] "We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a funeral procession of a man from the Ansar. When we reached the grave and it was being prepared, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sat down and we sat around him as if birds were perched on our heads." The narration mentioned the authenticity of this hadith, which is documented in the Book of Faith, and that it was not omitted.
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik Ansari shakhs ke janaze mein nikle, hum qabar tak pahunche, abhi lahad nahi banayi gayi thi, to Rasulullah (SAW) baith gaye aur hum aap (SAW) ke gird is tarah baithe jaise humare saron par parinde (baithe) hon," phir hadith ka zikr kiya. Is hadith ki sehat Kitab al-Iman mein sabit ho chuki hai, aur dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "When we used to sit with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we would not raise our heads to him out of respect for him."
hi: "Jab hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas baithte to hum apne sar aap (SAW) ki taraf nahi uthate the, aap (SAW) ki ta'zeem ki wajah se."

e: [AI] I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his Companions were with him. It was as if birds were on their heads. So, I greeted and sat down. Then, some Bedouins came to ask him about certain things, until they asked, "Should we seek medication?" He said, "Seek medication, for indeed Allah the Most High has not placed a disease except that He has also placed a cure for it." Then, they asked him about other things, and he said, "O servants of Allah, hardship is placed upon people. It is not permissible for a person to borrow from another person unjustly. That is a hardship and destruction." They then asked him, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the best thing that people can be given?" He said, "Good character."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua jabke aap (SAW) ke sahaba aap (SAW) ke paas is tarah baithe the jaise unke saron par parinde (baithe) hon. Maine salaam kiya aur baith gaya, to kuch dehati aaye aur aap (SAW) se kuch cheezon ke baare mein poochne lage, yahan tak ke unhone poocha: "Kya hum dawa lein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dawa lo, kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne koi bimari nahi utaari magar uska ilaaj bhi utara hai." Phir unhone kuch aur baaton ke baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah ke bando, tangi (mushkil) uthai gayi hai, magar us shakhs ke liye jo kisi aur shakhs par na-haq zulm kare, to yeh tangi hai aur (woh) halaak ho gaya." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), logon ko di jane wali sabse behtareen cheez kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Achha akhlaq."

e: [AI] I entered the mosque, and I saw a group that seemed as if their heads were cut off. Then a man spoke to them, and it turned out to be Hudhayfah. He said, "People used to ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about good, while I used to ask him about evil," and he mentioned the hadith in its entirety. The text of this hadith is mentioned in both books (referring to Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim). However, I mentioned it in this specific context to listen to the narrator and to understand how to show respect to him. Indeed, they did not mention this wording in both books.
hi: Main masjid mein dakhil hua to aik halqa (baithak) dekha, jaise unke sar kaat diye gaye hon (itna khamosh baithe the). To aik shakhs unhein hadith sunata dikha, aur woh Hudhaifah (RA) thay. Unhone kaha: log Rasulullah (SAW) se khair ke baare mein poochte thay aur main sharr ke baare mein poochta tha, phir poori hadith ka zikr kiya. Is hadith ka matan dono kitaabon (Bukhari-Muslim) mein nikala gaya hai, maine ise yahan sirf isliye zikr kiya hai taake muhaddis ko dhyan se sunne aur uski ta'zeem karne ka tareeqa maloom ho, kyunke yeh alfaz dono kitaabon mein nahi nikale gaye.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to enter the mosque and none of us would raise our heads except for Abu Bakr and Umar. They would smile at him and he would smile back at them."
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) masjid mein dakhil hote to hum mein se koi apna sar nahi uthata tha, siwaye Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ke, kyunke woh dono aap (SAW) ki taraf muskurate the aur aap (SAW) unki taraf muskurate the."

e: [AI] Salman was in a group of people who used to remember Allah. Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by them, intending to join them, until he approached them. They stopped talking out of respect for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, "What were you saying? I saw mercy descending upon you, so I wanted to participate in it with you."
hi: Salman (RA) aik jama'at ke sath the jo Allah ka zikr kar rahe thay, to Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas se guzre aur qasdan unke paas aaye yahan tak ke unke qareeb pahunch gaye, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki ta'zeem mein khamosh ho gaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum kya keh rahe thay? Maine dekha ke rahmat tum par utar rahi hai, to mujhe achha laga ke main bhi ismein tumhare sath shareek ho jaun."

e: [AI] About something, I don't know what to say to him. He said, "Have you seen a disciplined, active, and eager man who is keen on jihad, saying that our leaders are planning things that we cannot count?" I said, "By Allah, I don't know what to say to you except that we used to be with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and perhaps he would not command anything unless we did it. And whatever resembles the obscurity of this world is like the foam from the drink, its clarity has been consumed leaving only its dregs. And indeed, one of you will continue to be in goodness as long as they fear Allah Almighty. And when something troubles them, they should approach a knowledgeable person to ask for guidance, and I swear by Allah, they will soon discover that they will not find a solution."
hi: ...(kisi baat ke baare mein), mujhe nahi pata mein usse kya kahoon. Unhone kaha: "Tumne dekha aik tarbiyat-yafta, phurtila, jihad ka khwahishmand shakhs, kehta hai: humare hukmaraan humpar itni baatein muqarrar karte hain jinhe hum gin nahi sakte?" Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata main tumhein kya kahoon, siwaye is ke ke hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath rehte the, to shayad aap (SAW) kisi baat ka hukum dete to hum use kar dete, aur duniya ka jo hissa baaqi bacha hai woh usi chashme jaisa hai jiska saaf paani pee liya gaya ho aur sirf gandla (mailla) paani baaqi bacha ho. Aur tum mein se koi khair mein rahega jab tak Allah Azza wa Jalla se darta rahega, aur agar uske dil mein koi khalish paida ho to woh kisi (aalim) shakhs ke paas jaye aur usse poochein, woh use shifa dega. Allah ki qasam, aqareeb hai ke tum aisa (aalim) na paao."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "He is not one of us who does not honor our elders, show mercy to our young ones, and acknowledge the scholars amongst us." "Malik bin Khayr Al-Ziyadi is a trustworthy Egyptian, and Abu Qabeel is a respected follower." Malik is a trustworthy Egyptian.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh humse nahi jo humare baron ki izzat na kare, humare chhoton par reham na kare, aur humare aalim ka haq na pehchane." (Malik bin Khair Az-Ziyadi Misri thiqa hain, aur Abu Qabeel aik bade Tabi'i hain.)

e: [AI] From Jabir ibn Abdullah: "Obey Allah, obey the Messenger, and those in authority among you." [Quran 4:59] He said, "Those with knowledge and goodness."
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se, is ayat ke baare mein: "Allah ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo aur apne mein se saahib-e-ikhtiyaar logon ki" (Surah An-Nisa 59), unhone kaha: "(Iska matlab hai) fiqh aur khair wale log (ya'ni ulama)."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas said about the saying of Allah, "Obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you" [Quran 4:59] - it means the people of knowledge and religion and the people of obedience to Allah who teach the people the noble aspects of their religion, command them to do good, and forbid them from evil. So, Allah has made it obligatory to obey them. These are the statements that indicate the necessity for scholars to be humble towards those whom they teach.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "Allah ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo aur apne mein se saahib-e-ikhtiyaar logon ki" (Surah An-Nisa 59) ke baare mein, unhone farmaya: "Iska matlab hai fiqh aur deen wale log, aur Allah ki itaa'at karne wale log jo logon ko unke deen ki achhi baatein sikhate hain, unhein neki ka hukum dete hain aur burai se rokte hain, to Allah ne unki itaa'at farz kar di." Yeh ahadith is baat ko zaahir karti hain ke ulama par apne shagirdon ke saamne tawadu' (inkisari) lazim hai.

e: [AI] "For the sake of Omar, do not wear a garment softer than yours and do not eat more delicious food than yours, even though Allah has granted you ease and plenty. She said, 'I will argue with you until you speak for yourself.' He then mentioned the condition of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and what he endured in his life. She continued to remind him until she cried, and he said, 'Indeed, I have declared that I will share with them in their harsh living conditions, hoping that I will attain their comfortable living conditions.'"
hi: 'Umar ke liye (kaha):' "Kya tum apne kapdon se zyada narm kapda nahi pehnte aur apne khaane se zyada achha khaana nahi khate, jabke Allah ne tum par (khilafat ka) maamla khol diya hai aur tumhare rizq ko waseeh kar diya hai?" To unhone (Umar RA ne) farmaya: "Main isi (baat) se tumhare khilaaf hujjat qaim karunga," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ka waqia aur aap (SAW) ki zindagi ki sakhti ka zikr kiya. Woh (Umar RA) yeh zikr karte rahe yahan tak ke woh (unki biwi) ro pareen. To unhone farmaya: "Maine kaha hai ke main un dono (Rasulullah SAW aur Abu Bakr RA) ki tarah sakht zindagi mein shareek rahunga, taake main unke sath unki aasoodagi (aaraam) bhi paun."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The nobleness of a believer lies in his faith, his integrity, his intelligence, and his character."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ki sharafat uska deen hai, uski mardaangi uski aql hai, aur uska hasab (khaandaani izzat) uska akhlaq hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The nobility of a believer is in their religion, their character, and their manners."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ki sharafat uska deen hai, uski mardaangi uski aql hai, aur uska hasab uska akhlaq hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You will not be able to please people with your wealth, but it is your good manners and kindness that will please them." It was narrated by Sufyan Ath-Thawri from Abdullah ibn Sa'id. I said, Abdullah means Abdullah ibn Sa'id Al-Maqbari (from the tribe of Maqbara in Yemen).
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum apne maal se logon ko itna nahi de sakte (jitna woh chahte hain), isliye khush-mizaaji aur achhe akhlaq se unhein khush kar do." Ise Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne Abdullah bin Sa'eed se riwayat kiya hai. (Maine kaha: Abdullah se murad Abdullah bin Sa'eed Al-Maqbari hain, jo za'if hain.)

e: [AI] "You cannot please people with your money, but you can please them with a generous smile and good character."
hi: "Tum apne maal se logon ko itna nahi de sakte (jitna woh chahte hain), isliye khush-mizaaji aur achhe akhlaq se unhein khush kar do."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Doing good towards people protects the person from evil, harm, and destruction. Those who do good in this world will be considered the doers of good in the Hereafter." I heard Abu Ali Al-Hafiz saying, "I did not write this hadith except from Abu Abdullah As-Saffar, Muhammad bin Ishaq, and his son, who are both from Al-Basri. We did not know them to have any criticism. As for the saying ‘those who do good in this world,’ it has been narrated without a clear chain of narration from Al-Munkadir from his father, from Jabir, who said, ‘And Al-Munkadir, even if they do not exclude him, he is still mentioned in Al-Shawahid.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Logon ke sath neki karna, karne wale ko bure anjaam, museebaton aur halaakaton se bachaata hai, aur duniya mein neki karne wale hi aakhirat mein bhi neki karne wale hongay." Maine Abu Ali Al-Hafiz ko kehte hue suna: "Yeh hadith maine sirf Abu Abdullah As-Saffar se likhi hai," aur Muhammad bin Ishaq aur unke bete Basra ke logon mein se hain, humein unpar koi aitraaz maloom nahi. Aur unka farmaan "duniya mein neki karne wale" kayi doosre tareeqon se Al-Munkadir se, unhone Al-Munkadir bin Muhammad se, unhone apne walid se, unhone Jabir (RA) se riwayat hua hai. (Agarche Shaykhain ne ise nahi nikala, phir bhi isse shawahid mein zikr kiya jata hai.)

e: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ was commanded to hold to forgiveness from the conduct of the people. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4787)
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "Maafi (aur asaani) ikhtiyar karo" (Surah Al-A'raf 199) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko hukum diya ke woh logon ke akhlaq mein maafi (aasaani) ikhtiyar karein."

e: [AI] Allah has revealed this verse only in the character of the people: "Take forgiveness" [Al-A'raf: 199] and enjoin what is right and turn away from the ignorant.
hi: Allah ne yeh ayat sirf logon ke akhlaq ke baare mein nazil ki: "Maafi (aasaani) ikhtiyar karo, aur bhalai ka hukum do, aur jaahilon se mun mod lo" (Surah Al-A'raf 199).

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  imprisoned a man from his tribe on charges. Then, a man from his tribe came to the Prophet ﷺ  while he was delivering a sermon and said, "O Muhammad, why do you imprison my kinsman?" The Prophet ﷺ  remained silent and said, "There are people who say that I forbid evil while indulging in it. What do you say?" I turned away from both of them, fearing that he would understand my gesture and invoke a curse upon my people in a way that they would never succeed thereafter. The Prophet ﷺ  did not stop until he understood it and said, "Have they said so? Is the one saying this among them? By Allah, if I had done so, it would have been upon them to keep away from their neighbors." The statement has been previously mentioned in the document of Bahz ibn Hakim, but repeating it doesn't add anything to its reliability, as there are authentic references to this hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim. Some of these references include the hadith of Al-A'mash from Abu Wail from Abdullah, where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  divided something and a man from the Ansar said, "This division, I did not intend to obtain the face of Allah with it." And the hadith of Malik from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abu Talhah from Anas, where Anas said, "I was walking with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he was wearing a thick Burd (cloak) with a rough edge. Then, an Arab Bedouin snatched the edge of his Burd." There is also the hadith of Shurayk ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Namir from Anas in the story of Hunayn, when he said, "What is forcing me to join this tree? And there are other narrations that are too lengthy to mention."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne apni qaum ke aik shakhs ko kisi ilzaam mein qaid kar diya, to unki qaum ka aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke aap (SAW) khutba de rahe thay, aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, tum mere padosi ko kis liye qaid kiye ho?" Nabi (SAW) khamosh ho gaye, phir usne kaha: "Log kehte hain ke tum burai se rokte ho aur khud usse khush hote ho." Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum kya keh rahe ho?" Maine (raawi ne) unke darmiyan baat ko toda-mora karna shuru kar diya, is darr se ke agar aap (SAW) ise poori tarah samajh gaye to meri qaum par aisi bad-dua kar dengay ke woh phir kabhi kaamyaab na hon. Lekin Nabi (SAW) is baat ko samajh gaye, to farmaya: "Kya unhone yeh kaha? Kya isse kehne wala khud unmein se hai? Allah ki qasam, agar maine aisa kiya hota to woh usi anjaam ko pahunch jaate jo unpar ho chuka. Uske padosiyon ko chhod do." Yeh baat pehle Behz bin Hakim ki riwayat mein zikr ho chuki hai, ise dobara zikr karne ki zaroorat nahi, kyunke is hadith ke shawahid Sahihain mein nikale ja chuke hain. Unme se Al-A'mash ki, Abu Wa'il se, Abdullah se, riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne (maal ki) taqseem ki, to Ansar mein se aik shakhs ne kaha: "Yeh taqseem aisi hai jismein Allah ki raza maqsood nahi thi." Aur unme se Malik ki, Ishaq bin Abdullah bin Abi Talha se, unhone Anas (RA) se, riwayat hai: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath chal raha tha jabke aap (SAW) par mota kinaara wali Najrani chadar thi, to aik dehati ne aap (SAW) ki chadar khainch li," poori hadith. Aur unme se Sharik bin Abdullah bin Abi Namir ki, Anas (RA) se, riwayat hai, Hunain ke waqia mein: "Tum mujhe is darakht ki taraf kyun majboor kar rahe ho," aur isi jaisi doosri riwayaten hain jinka zikr lamba ho jayega.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are three qualities, whoever possesses them, Allah will provide him refuge in His protection, cover him with His mercy, and admit him in His love." It was asked, "What are these qualities, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "The one who, when given, shows gratitude, when judged, forgives, and when angry, remains silent."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (khaslatein) hain, jisme yeh hon Allah use apni panah mein rakhega, apni rahmat se dhaank lega aur apni mohabbat mein shamil kar lega." Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs (kuch) diya jaye to shukr kare, jab qudrat rakhta ho to maaf kar de, aur jab ghussa aaye to khud ko rok le."

e: [AI] When Umar ibn Al-Khattab assumed leadership, he addressed the people on the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He praised and thanked Allah and praised the Prophet. Then he said, "O people, I have learned from you that you find me strict and harsh. This is because I used to be with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I was his servant and companion. Allah described him as being compassionate and merciful to the believers. I used to be in front of him like a drawn sword, except when he would calm me down or prohibit me from doing something. Then I would stop, otherwise, I would act forcefully towards people with leniency."
hi: Jab Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) khalifa bane, to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke mimbar par logon ko khutba diya, Allah ki hamd aur sana ki, phir farmaya: "Aye logo, mujhe pata hai ke tum mujh mein sakhti aur ghilzat mehsoos karte ho, iski wajah yeh hai ke main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tha, to main unka ghulam aur khadim tha, aur aap (SAW) waise hi thay jaise Allah ne farmaya: 'Momino ke liye narm-dil aur meharban' (Surah At-Tawbah 128), to main aap (SAW) ke saamne aik nange talwar jaisa hota, siwaye is ke ke aap (SAW) mujhe rok den ya kisi kaam se mana karen to main ruk jata, warna main logon par aap (SAW) ki narmi ki wajah se (khud) aage badh jata."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever is gentle, kind, and close to others, Allah will keep them away from the Hellfire."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs narm-mizaaj, naram-dil aur (logon se) qareeb ho, Allah use aag par haram kar deta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever gives religious verdicts to people without knowledge, his sin is upon the one who asked him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs logon ko bagair ilm ke fatwa de, uska gunah usi par hai jisne usse fatwa maanga."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not write down anything from me except the Quran. Whoever writes down anything from me other than the Quran, let him erase it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujh se Quran ke siwa kuch na likho, jisne mujh se Quran ke siwa kuch likha ho woh use mita de."

e: [AI] "He heard the narration of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , we had a village and livelihoods, but people were not lying at that time, so the absent witness would narrate."
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ki hadith suni: "Humare paas zameen aur mashghooliyaat thin, magar log us zamane mein jhoot nahi bolte the, isliye hazir shakhs ghair-hazir ko hadith sunata tha."

e: [AI] "If it is not in the Book of Allah, and it is something that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, then indeed, if it is not from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but it is something that Abu Bakr and Umar said, then if Abu Bakr and Umar do not have anything regarding it, then he said it based on his own opinion."
hi: ...usi se (faisla karega). Agar Allah ki Kitab mein na ho aur Rasulullah (SAW) se koi baat mili ho to usi se faisla karega. Agar Rasulullah (SAW) se bhi koi baat na mili ho to jo Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ne kaha usi se faisla karega. Agar Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) se bhi koi baat na mili ho to apni rai se faisla karega.

e: [AI] "Abdullah reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Verily, lying is not appropriate whether it is done seriously or in jest, or when a person promises his son but does not fulfill it. Indeed, truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. And indeed, lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire. It is said about the truthful person, 'He is truthful and virtuous,' and about the liar, 'He lied and is treacherous.' Indeed, a person continues to tell the truth until they are recorded with Allah as truthful, or they keep lying until they are recorded with Allah as a liar.'"
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA) se, unhone yeh hadith Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchayi: "Jhoot kisi bhi surat mein - chahe mazaaq mein ho ya sanjeedgi mein - durust nahi, aur na hi yeh durust hai ke koi shakhs apne bete se wada kare phir use poora na kare. Beshak sachai neki ki taraf le jaati hai, aur neki Jannat ki taraf le jaati hai. Aur beshak jhoot badkaari ki taraf le jaata hai, aur badkaari Jahannam ki taraf le jaati hai. Sachche shakhs ke baare mein kaha jata hai: usne sach kaha aur nek kaam kiya, aur jhoote ke baare mein kaha jata hai: usne jhoot bola aur badkaari ki. Aur insaan sach bolta rehta hai yahan tak ke Allah ke yahan usse sachcha likh diya jata hai, ya jhoot bolta rehta hai yahan tak ke Allah ke yahan usse jhoota likh diya jata hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The Jews were split up into seventy-one or seventy-two sects; and the Christians were split up into seventy one or seventy-two sects; and my community will be split up into seventy-three sects. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4596)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yahood ikhattar (71) ya bahattar (72) firqon mein bant gaye, aur Nasara bhi ikhattar (71) ya bahattar (72) firqon mein bant gaye, aur meri Ummat tehattar (73) firqon mein bant jayegi."

e: “The Jews split into seventy-one sects and my nation will split into seventy-three sects.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3991)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yahood ikhattar (71) firqon mein bant gaye, aur Nasara bhi isi tarah, aur meri Ummat tehattar (73) firqon mein bant jayegi."

e:
[AI] We performed Hajj with Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, and when we arrived in Mecca, he was informed of a storyteller who was narrating to the people of Mecca, a servant of the Banu Farrukh. Mu'awiya sent for him and asked, "Were you ordered to give these narrations?" He replied, "No." Mu'awiya then asked, "So what led you to narrate without permission?" The man replied, "We are imparting knowledge that Allah has taught us." Mu'awiya said, "Had I warned you beforehand, I would have severed a part of you." 

Then, after the Dhuhr prayer in Mecca, Mu'awiya stood up and said: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The People of the Book divided themselves into seventy-two sects in their religion, and this Ummah will divide into seventy-three, all of which will be in the fire except one, which is the congregation. From my Ummah, there will emerge people driven by desires just as rabies drives its host, leaving no vein or joint without being infected. By Allah, O Arabs, if you do not uphold that which Muhammad ﷺ brought, surely nothing else will you uphold."[^1]
hi: Hum Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan ke sath Hajj ke liye gaye, jab hum Makkah pahunche to unhein bataya gaya ke Banu Farrukh ka aik ghulam Makkah walon ko qissa suna raha hai. Muawiyah ne usse bulwaya aur poocha: "Kya tumhein in qisson ki ijaazat di gayi hai?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Unhone poocha: "Phir tumhein bagair ijaazat qissa sunane par kis cheez ne ubhaara?" Usne kaha: "Hum woh ilm phaila rahe hain jo Allah Ta'ala ne humein sikhaya hai." Muawiyah ne kaha: "Agar mujhe pehle se pata hota to main tumhare aik hissay ko kaat deta." Phir jab unhone Makkah mein Zuhr ki namaz padhi to woh khade huay aur kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Ahl-e-Kitab apne deen mein bahattar (72) firqon mein bant gaye, aur yeh Ummat tehattar (73) firqon mein bant jayegi, sab jahannam mein jayengi siwaye aik ke, aur woh jama'at hai. Aur meri Ummat mein se aise log niklengay jinme yeh khwahishaat isi tarah phailengi jaise kutta apne maalik ke jism mein pagalpan phaila deta hai, koi rag ya jod aisi nahi bachegi jismein yeh na ghusa ho. Allah ki qasam, aye Arabo, agar tum Muhammad (SAW) ki laayi hui cheez par qaim na raho, to (yeh soch lo ke) iske ilawa kisi aur cheez par qaim rehne ki tumhari zyada koi wajah nahi."

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What befell the children of Isra'il will befall my Ummah, step by step, such that if there was one who had intercourse with his mother in the open, then there would be someone from my Ummah who would do that. Indeed the children of Isra'il split into seventy-two sects, and my Ummah will split into seventy-three sects. All of them are in the Fire Except one sect." He said: "And which is it O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "What I am upon and my Companions." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2641)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat par bhi wahi guzregi jo Bani Israel par guzri, misaal ke tor par, jaise aik jooti doosri jooti ke barabar ho, yahan tak ke agar unme se kisi ne apni maa se khule-aam nikah kiya ho to meri Ummat mein bhi aisa hi koi hoga. Beshak Bani Israel ikhattar (71) firqon mein bant gaye, aur meri Ummat tehattar (73) firqon mein bant jayegi, sab jahannam mein jayengi siwaye aik firqe ke." Poocha gaya: "Woh aik kaunsa hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis (raste) par main aur mere sahaba aaj hain."

e: [AI] We were sitting around the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his mosque when he said, "You will follow the practices of those before you, step by step, to the extent that if they were to enter a lizard's hole, you would enter it too." We asked, "O Messenger of Allah, are you referring to the Jews and Christians?" He replied, "Who else?" The Jews split into seventy-one groups, all misguided except one. The Christians split into seventy-two groups, all misguided except one. And this Ummah will split into seventy-three groups, all misguided except one: the Jamāʿah (the united group) and the true understanding of Islam." [At-Tirmidhi]
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke gird unki masjid mein baithe thay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum zaroor apne se pehle logon ke raste par chaloge, bilkul waise hi jaise jooti jooti ke barabar hoti hai, aur tum unhi ki tarah lena shuru karoge - bitta bhar to bitta bhar, gaz bhar to gaz bhar, baan bhar to baan bhar - yahan tak ke agar woh chhipkali ke bill mein bhi ghuse to tum bhi usme ghus jaoge." Suno! Bani Israel Musa (AS) ke maamle mein ikhattar (71) firqon mein bant gaye, sab gumraah thay siwaye aik firqe ke: Islam aur unki jama'at. Aur woh Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke maamle mein bhi ikhattar (71) firqon mein bant gaye, sab gumraah thay siwaye aik firqe ke: Islam aur unki jama'at. Phir yeh Ummat bahattar (72) firqon mein bant jayegi, sab gumraah hongi siwaye aik firqe ke: Islam aur unki jama'at." (Kitab-ul-Ilm khatam hui.)

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone acquires knowledge that should be sought seeking the Face of Allah, but he acquires it only to get some worldly advantage, he will not experience the arf, i.e. the fragrance, of Paradise. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3664)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs woh ilm seekhe jise Allah ki raza ke liye talaash kiya jata hai, magar woh isse sirf duniya ka koi maqsad haasil karne ke liye seekhe, to woh Qayamat ke din Jannat ki khushbu bhi nahi paayega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Whoever learns knowledge seeking the pleasure of Allah, but not for any worldly gain, will not attain it except that it will lead him to a purpose of the Hereafter. Falih said, 'Its recognition is its fragrance.' This hadith has been narrated with two authentic chains of transmission from Jabir ibn Abdullah and Ka'ab ibn Malik."
