hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs woh ilm seekhe jise Allah ki raza ke liye talaash kiya jata hai, magar woh isse sirf duniya ka koi maqsad haasil karne ke liye seekhe, to woh Jannat ki khushbu bhi nahi paayega." Fulaih ne kaha: "Iski khushbu se murad iski mehek hai." Yeh hadith Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) aur Ka'b bin Malik (RA) se do sahih asaneed ke sath bhi riwayat hui hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever touches his private parts should perform ablution." Uruwah narrated that he asked Busrah, she confirmed it, and among them was Muzhir bin Abdullah al-Hizami al-Madani.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apni sharamgaah ko chhoye, use wudu karna chahiye." Urwah ne kaha: maine Busrah (RA) se poocha to unhone iski tasdeeq ki. Aur unme se Al-Mundhir bin Abdullah Al-Hizami Al-Madani bhi hain.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Whoever touches his private parts should perform ablution." Uruwah disapproved, so he asked Busrah, who affirmed it.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apni sharamgaah ko chhoye, use wudu karna chahiye." Urwah ne (is baat ka) inkaar kiya, to unhone Busrah (RA) se poocha, unhone iski tasdeeq ki.

e: [AI] She said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Whoever touches their private parts should not pray until they perform ablution.'" I went to Busrah and she told me the same as Marwan told me, that she said, "I heard the Prophet ﷺ  say that."
hi: Unhone (Busrah RA ne) kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apni sharamgaah ko chhoye, woh namaz na padhe jab tak wudu na kar le." (Ravi ne kaha:) main Busrah (RA) ke paas gaya, unhone mujhe wahi hadith sunayi jo Marwan ne unse mujhe sunayi thi, ke unhone kaha: maine Nabi (SAW) ko yeh farmate hue suna.

e: [AI] On the authority of Busrah bint Safwan, who was a companion of the Prophet ﷺ , she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If one of you touches his private parts, he should not perform the prayer until he performs ablution." Urwah disapproved of this and asked Busrah, and she confirmed it. Al-Hazm Al-Ansari, Muhammad ibn Muslim Al-Zuhri, Abu Al-Zinad Abdullah ibn Zakwan Al-Qurashi, Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Urwah, Abu Al-Aswad Muhammad ibn Abdur Rahman ibn Nawfal Al-Qurashi, and Abd Al-Hameed ibn Jafar Al-Ansari, Hassan ibn Muslim ibn Yannaqin, and others among the Tabi'een and their followers are all in agreement on this. As for Busrah bint Safwan, she is from the noble women of the Quraysh.
hi: Busrah bint Safwan (RA) se riwayat hai, jo Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat mein rahi hain, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apni sharamgaah ko chhoye, woh namaz na padhe jab tak wudu na kar le." Urwah ne ismein inkaar kiya, to unhone Busrah (RA) se poocha, unhone iski tasdeeq ki. (Isi hadith ko) Hazm Al-Ansari, Muhammad bin Muslim Az-Zuhri, Abu Az-Zinad Abdullah bin Dhakwan Al-Qurashi, Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Urwah, Abu Al-Aswad Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman bin Nawfal Al-Qurashi, Abdul Hameed bin Ja'far Al-Ansari, Al-Hasan bin Muslim bin Yannaq aur doosre Tabi'in aur unke shagirdon ne bhi riwayat kiya hai. Rahi baat Busrah bint Safwan (RA) ki, to woh Quraish ki sardaraana khawateen mein se hain.

e: [AI] "We have Malik ibn Anas. Do you know who is Busrah bint Safwan? She is the grandmother of Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, the mother of his mother. Therefore, recognize her."
hi: Humein Malik bin Anas ne bataya: "Kya tumhein pata hai Busrah bint Safwan (RA) kaun hain? Woh Abdul Malik bin Marwan ki naani hain, unki maa ki maa, isliye unhein pehchano."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , there are five hadiths apart from this hadith (mentioned above) that have been proven to be famous through the narration of Busrabint Safwan. The name of ignorance has been lifted from her with these narrations. We have also narrated the obligation of performing ablution from touching the private parts, from a group of companions and female companions, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  among them Abdullah bin Umar, Abu Huraira, Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani, Saad bin Abi Waqqas, Jabir bin Abdullah, Umm Habiba, Umm Salama, and I have also narrated a sound hadith.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se is hadith ke ilawa paanch aur hadithein bhi hain, aur jo humne zikr kiya hai usse Busrah bint Safwan (RA) ki shohrat sabit ho chuki hai aur in riwayaton se unse na-shanaakht (majhooliyat) ka naam bhi utar gaya hai. Humne sharamgaah chhoone se wudu farz hone ki riwayat Rasulullah (SAW) se aik jama'at Sahaba (RA) aur Sahabiyaat (RA) se bhi naql ki hai, unme Abdullah bin Umar (RA), Abu Hurairah (RA), Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani (RA), Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA), Jabir bin Abdullah (RA), Umm Habibah (RA), Umm Salamah (RA) aur Arwa shamil hain. Yeh hadith sahih hai.

e: [AI] "If a woman touches her private parts with her hand, then she must perform ablution (wudu')." Sahih.
hi: "Jab aurat apni sharamgaah ko apne haath se chhoye to uspar wudu wajib ho jata hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] "When a woman touches her private parts, she must perform ablution." "And this is a debate that took place among the guardians in this matter."
hi: "Jab aurat apni sharamgaah ko chhoye to woh wudu kare." (Yeh aik ilmi bahes hai jo is baab mein huffaz-e-hadith ke a'imma ke darmiyan hui.)

e: [AI] Yahya was not convinced of that until he brought Busra and asked her, and she confirmed it through conversation. Then Yahya said, "People have talked a lot about Qais ibn Talq and that his narration is not reliable." Ahmad ibn Hanbal said, "Both statements are accepted." Then Yahya said, "Malik narrated from Nafi' that Ibn 'Umar performed ablution after touching his private parts." Ali said, "Ibn Mas'ud used to say, 'You do not need to perform ablution after touching it; it is just a part of your body.'" Yahya said, "Who narrated from whom?" He said, "Sufyan related from Abu Qais, from Huzail, from Abdullah." Ibn Mas'ud and Ibn 'Umar disagreed, and Ibn Mas'ud had more right to be followed. Ahmad bin Hanbal said to him, "Yes, but Abu Qais Al-Awdi's narration is not reliable." Ali said, "Abu Nuaym told me, narrated by Misaar, from Umayr bin Sa'id, from Ammar bin Yasir, he said, 'I do not care if I touch it or not.'" Ahmad said, "Both Umayr and Ammar hold equal positions, so whoever wishes can follow this opinion, and whoever wishes can follow that opinion." Then Yahya said, "Between Umayr bin Sa'id and Ammar bin Yasir, there is a difference of opinion."
hi: Yahya ko yeh baat qaani' na kar saki, yahan tak ke woh Busrah (RA) ke paas gaye aur unse poocha, unhone use samne se hadith sunayi. Phir Yahya ne kaha: "Logon ne Qais bin Talq ke baare mein bohot baatein ki hain, ke unki hadith hujjat nahi maani jaati." Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: "Dono baatein waisi hi hain jaisi tum dono ne kaha." Yahya ne kaha: "Malik ne Nafi' se, unhone Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat ki hai ke unhone sharamgaah chhoone se wudu kiya." Ali ne kaha: "Ibn Mas'ud (RA) kaha karte the ke ismein wudu nahi hota, yeh to sirf tumhare jism ka aik tukda hai." Yahya ne poocha: "Kiske hawale se?" Unhone kaha: "Sufyan se, unhone Abu Qais se, unhone Huzail se, unhone Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA) se, aur jab Ibn Mas'ud (RA) aur Ibn Umar (RA) ka ikhtilaf ho jaye to Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ki pairavi zyada munasib hai." Ahmad bin Hanbal ne unse kaha: "Haan, lekin Abu Qais Al-Awdi ki hadith hujjat nahi maani jaati." Ali ne kaha: "Mujhe Abu Nu'aim ne bataya, humein Mis'ar ne Umair bin Sa'eed se, unhone Ammar bin Yasir (RA) se bataya, unhone kaha: mujhe parwah nahi ke main isse chhoo lun ya bacho." Ahmad ne kaha: "Ammar (RA) aur Ibn Umar (RA) dono barabar hain, jo chahe is par amal kare aur jo chahe us par." Yahya ne kaha: "Umair bin Sa'eed aur Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ke darmiyan (ravi ke lihaz se) faasla hai."

e: [AI] "We used to pray with the Prophet ﷺ  without performing ablution from the place where we were sitting." Abu Mu'awiya and Abdullah ibn Idris reported this narration from Al-A'mash. "As for the Hadith of Abu Mu'awiya," according to their condition.
hi: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke sath namaz padhte the aur pair ke neeche (kisi cheez ko) chhoone se wudu nahi karte the." Abu Muawiyah aur Abdullah bin Idris ne Al-A'mash se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai. (Rahi baat Abu Muawiyah ki hadith ki...)

e: [AI] Abu Mu'awiya praised him and mentioned him with his chain of narration similar to him: "As for the hadith of Abu Idris"
hi: Humein Abu Muawiyah ne bataya, phir unhone isi jaisi sanad ke sath ise zikr kiya. (Rahi baat Abu Idris ki hadith ki...)

e: [AI] Regarding Al-A'mash, so he mentioned it like this.
hi: Al-A'mash se, unhone isi jaisi baat ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  never took off his shoes in prayer except for once. When he removed them, the people followed his example. He then asked, "Why did you do that?" They replied, "You took off your shoes, so we did too." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Gabriel informed me that there was some impurity or harm in them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne kabhi bhi namaz mein apne joote nahi utaare siwaye aik martaba, jab aap (SAW) ne unhein utaara to logon ne bhi utaar diye. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) ne utaare to humne bhi utaar diye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Jibra'il (AS) ne mujhe bataya ke inme napaaki ya koi takleef-deh cheez hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  took off his shoes and said, "Gabriel informed me that..."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne apna joote utaara aur farmaya: "Beshak Jibra'il (AS) ne mujhe bataya ke..."

e: [AI] About Al-Mughira ibn Shu'ba
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) se riwayat hai.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wanted to fulfill his need, he would go far away so that no one could see him."
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) apni zaroorat (qaza-e-hajat) ke liye jate to itna door jate ke koi unhein na dekh sake."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was asked about the water of the sea, and he said, "The water of the sea is purifying."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se samandar ke paani ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Samandar ka paani pakeeza karne wala hai."

e: [AI] The narrator Al-Qa'nabi mentioned that all of them, from Malik, heard from Safwan bin Sulaiman, who heard from Sa'id bin Salamah, a man from the tribe of Azraq, that Al-Mughirah bin Abi Burdah, a man from the Banu Abd al-Dar, informed him that he heard Abu Hurairah saying: "A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , 'O Messenger of Allah, we travel on the sea and carry a small amount of water with us. If we perform ablution with it, we become thirsty. Can we perform ablution with seawater?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'Its water is pure, and its dead creatures are lawful food.' Malik bin Anas also narrated this hadith from Safwan bin Sulaiman, who heard it from Abdul Rahman bin Ishaq, who heard it from Abdul Rahman bin Ishaq, who heard it from Safwan bin Sulaiman. Abdul Rahman bin Ishaq narrated it from his father, and his father narrated it from Abdullah bin Ayyub bin Zadhan. Muhammad bin Al-Minhall narrated it from Yazid bin Zurai', who narrated it from Abdul Rahman bin Ishaq, who narrated it from Safwan bin Sulaiman, who said that Abu Yusuf bin Ya'qub narrated it from Muhammad bin Abi Bakr, who narrated it from Yazid bin Zurai', who narrated it from Abdul Rahman bin Ishaq, who narrated it from Safwan bin Sulaiman, who narrated it from Sa'id bin Salamah, who narrated it from Al-Mughirah bin Abi Burdah, who narrated it from Abu Hurairah, who narrated it from the Prophet ﷺ ."
hi: Aik shakhs ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum samandar mein safar karte hain aur apne sath thoda paani rakhte hain, agar hum usse wudu karein to pyaase reh jayengay, to kya hum samandar ke paani se wudu kar sakte hain?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh (samandar) pakeeza (karne wala) hai, iska paani (wudu ke liye) halal hai aur iska murda (jaanwar khane ke liye) halal hai." Malik bin Anas ki is riwayat ki, Safwan bin Sulaim se, Abdur Rahman bin Ishaq aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim Al-Muzani ne bhi mutaba'at ki hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters. (Using translation from Muslim 1716b)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai.

e: [AI] He informed him that he heard Abu Huraira say, "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ one day when a hunter came to him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, we go out to sea to seek game, and one of us carries a water skin, hoping to catch the game soon. Perhaps he will find it as he hopes, or perhaps he will not find the game until he reaches a place in the sea that he never expected to reach. He might then become thirsty or be in need of performing ablution. If he performs ablution or uses this water, will any of us be harmed by thirst? Do you see it permissible for us to perform ablution or use this water if we fear that?' It is reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Perform ablution with it and use it, for its water is pure and its dead are lawful.' Muslim, with the authority of Jullah ibn Kathir, followed Yahya ibn Sa`id al-Ansari and Yazid ibn Muhammad al-Qurashi, who followed Sa`id ibn Salama al-Makhzumi in narrating this Hadith, but they differed on this Hadith."
hi: Unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: hum aik din Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas thay ke aik shikaari aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum samandar mein shikar ke liye jate hain, humme se koi mashk (paani ka bartan) sath le jata hai is ummeed mein ke qareeb hi shikar mil jayega, kabhi aisa hota hai aur kabhi shikar itni door tak nahi milta jahan pahunchne ki ummeed nahi hoti. Shayad usse ehtelaam ho jaye ya wudu ki zaroorat ho, agar woh isi paani se ghusl ya wudu kare to shayad pyaas humme se kisi ko halaak kar de - to kya aap ijaazat dete hain ke hum samandar ke paani se ghusl ya wudu karein jab humein aisa darr ho?" Kaha jata hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isi se ghusl karo aur isi se wudu karo, kyunke yeh pakeeza (karne wala) hai, iska paani halal hai aur iska murda halal hai."

e: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 99)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, a narration was reported that Sulaiman ibn Bilal narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id, who narrated from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, who narrated from his father, that Muslim sought the judgment with the weapon.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: [AI] A group of people came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "We are fishing in the sea, and we have fresh water with us. We are afraid of getting thirsty. Is it permissible for us to perform ablution with the salty water of the sea?" He ﷺ  replied, "Yes, perform ablution with it." Al-Bukhari, Yazid ibn Muhammad al-Qurashi, has narrated this in the history, and it has also been narrated by Layth ibn Abi Burdah from him, and among them is Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib.
hi: Kuch log Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir huay aur kaha: "Hum samandar mein shikar karte hain aur humare paas meetha paani hota hai, kabhi humein pyaas ka darr hota hai, to kya humare liye khaari samandar ke paani se wudu karna theek hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, isi se wudu karo."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was asked about performing ablution with seawater. He replied, "Its water is pure and its dead creatures are permissible."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se samandar ke paani ke baare mein poocha gaya, kya hum ismein se wudu karein? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iska paani pakeeza hai aur iska murda halal hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was asked about performing ablution (wudu) using seawater. He said, "Its water is pure, and its dead creatures are lawful."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se samandar ke paani se wudu karne ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh (samandar) pakeeza (karne wala) hai, iska paani halal hai aur iska murda halal hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about the water of the sea, and he said, "Its water is pure, and its dead creatures are lawful." "As for the narration of Ibn Abbas, we have mentioned it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se samandar ke paani ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh pakeeza (karne wala) hai, iska paani halal hai aur iska murda halal hai." (Rahi baat Ibn Abbas (RA) ki hadith ki, to humne uska zikr kar diya hai.)

e: "Its water is pure (and Purification) and its 'dead meat' is permissible (to eat)." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4350)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne samandar ke baare mein farmaya: "Yeh pakeeza (karne wala) hai, iska paani halal hai aur iska murda halal hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Dead sea creatures are permissible to eat and its water is pure."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Samandar ka murda (jaanwar) halal hai aur iska paani pakeeza hai."

e: [AI] He came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, we are in a land of the people of the Book (Christians and Jews), they drink alcohol and eat pork. So what do you think about their utensils and pots?" He said, "Leave them as long as you do not find any impurities on them. But if you do not find any impurities, then wash them with water or pour water over them." Then he said, "Cook in them and eat." Hammad said, I think he said, "And drink." This is how Shu'bah narrated it from Ayyub.
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum Ahl-e-Kitab ki zameen mein rehte hain, jo sharab peete aur suar ka gosht khate hain, to unke bartanon aur degon ke baare mein aapki kya rai hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumhein koi aur bartan mil sake to inhein chhod do, aur agar koi aur bartan na mile to unhein paani se dho lo," - ya farmaya: "unpar paani chhidak do" - phir farmaya: "inme pakao aur khao." Hammad ne kaha: "Mera khayal hai unhone yeh bhi kaha: aur piyo bhi." Ise Shu'bah ne Ayyub se isi tarah riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] He asked the Prophet ﷺ , "Indeed, we live among the people of the Book, so how should we deal with their utensils?" The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "Leave what you find impure among them. If you cannot find any impurity, then wash them with water and then you may cook in them." This is how Khalid Al-Hadha' narrated it from Abu Qilabah.
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) se poocha: "Hum Ahl-e-Kitab ki aksariyat wali zameen mein rehte hain, to unke bartanon ke sath hum kya karein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar koi aur bartan mile to inhein chhod do, aur agar na mile to unhein paani se dho lo, phir pakao." Ise Khalid Al-Hadhdha ne Abu Qilabah se isi tarah riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] I asked the Prophet ﷺ about the vessels of the polytheists, so he said, "Wash them and then cook in them."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) se mushrikeen ke bartanon ke baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein dho lo, phir inme pakao."

e: [AI] He said, "O Messenger of Allah, we live in the land of the People of the Book, so we cook in their pots and drink from their utensils." He replied, "If you cannot find any alternative, then wash them thoroughly."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum Ahl-e-Kitab ki zameen mein rehte hain, to kya hum unke degon mein pakayen aur unke bartanon mein piyen?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumhein inke ilawa (kuch aur) na mile to inhein istemal karne ki ijazat hai."

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and I said, "We raid and travel in the land of the disbelievers, and we need some utensils from their possessions in order to cook in them." He said, "Wash them with water and then cook in them and benefit from them."[^1]
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha aur arz kiya: "Hum jihad karte hain aur mushrikeen ki zameen mein safar karte hain, to humein unke bartanon mein se kisi ki zaroorat pad jaati hai jismein hum pakate hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein paani se dho lo, phir usme pakao aur (bila jhijhak) istemal karo."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade (the use of) the skins of beasts of prey. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4132)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne darinda janwaron ki khaalon (se banaye gaye cheezon ke istemal) se mana kiya."

e: [AI] Sa'id praised him in a way that was mentioned by a sheikh from the people of Basra, from Muhammad ibn al-Minhal, who narrated that Shu'ba, who is mistaken in this, said, "And this chain of narration is authentic. Abu al-Malih's name is 'Amir ibn Usama, and his father is Usama ibn 'Umayr, who is a companion from the Banu Lihyan tribe. His hadith is mentioned in the books of chains of narrators, but they did not mention it."
hi: Humein Sa'eed ne bataya, phir unhone isi jaisi baat ka zikr kiya. Ise Basra ke aik ustad ne Muhammad bin Al-Minhal se riwayat kiya aur ismein "Shu'bah se" kaha, jo unki taraf se aik wahm (galti) hai. (Yeh sanad sahih hai, kyunke Abu Al-Malih ka naam Aamir bin Usama hai, aur unke waalid Usama bin Umair aik sahabi hain, Banu Lihyan se, jinki hadith Masaneed mein zikr hui hai, magar Shaykhain ne ise nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] The translation of the given phrase is: "The Prophet ﷺ  was brought two-thirds of a container of water, so he performed ablution and began to wipe his forearms."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas paani ke aik do-tihaai maap (mudd) laaya gaya, to aap (SAW) ne wudu kiya aur apni baazuon ko malna shuru kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said during his illness in which he passed away, "Pour upon me from seven Qirab, which have not been mixed or touched, in order that I may make a bequest to the people." Aisha said, so we sat him in a basin made of copper for Hafsa and poured water on him, and he gestured to us that we had indeed done so, then he left.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni us bimari mein, jismein aap (SAW) ki wafat hui, farmaya: "Mujh par saat mashkon ka paani daalo, jinke munh na khole gaye hon, shayad main logon ko koi naseehat kar sakoon." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: humne aap (SAW) ko Hafsa (RA) ke tambe ke bartan mein bithaya aur aap (SAW) par paani daala, yahan tak ke aap (SAW) hamein ishara karne lage ke tumne kar liya, phir aap (SAW) bahar tashreef laaye.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said in his illness before he passed away, "Pour onto me water from seven wells."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni us bimari mein, jismein aap (SAW) ki wafat hui, farmaya: "Mujh par saat mashkon ka paani daalo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said during his illness in which he died, "Pour seven buckets of water over me." "Both chains of narrations are authentic according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni us bimari mein, jismein aap (SAW) ki wafat hui, farmaya: "Mujh par saat mashkon ka paani daalo." (Dono asaneed Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hain.)

e: ʿAbdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr came holding a Siwak with which he was cleaning his teeth. Allah's Apostle looked at him. I requested ʿAbdur-Rahman to give the Siwak to me and after he gave it to me I divided it, chewed it and gave it to Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then he cleaned his teeth with it and (at that time) he was resting against my chest. (Using translation from Bukhārī 890)
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr (RA) apne haath mein siwak liye dakhil huay jise woh apne daant saaf karne ke liye istemal kar rahe thay." To maine unse kaha: "Aye Abdur Rahman, yeh siwak mujhe de do," unhone mujhe de diya, to maine use kaat kar chaba liya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ko de diya, aap (SAW) ne usse apne daant saaf kiye jabke aap (SAW) mere seene se takiya lagaye hue thay.

e: "The Messenger of Allah used to pray in the night (Qiyamul-Lail) two Rak'ah by two, then when he finished he would use the tooth stick." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 288)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) raat ko do rakat namaz padhte, phir jab farigh hote to miswaak karte."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The merit of the prayer which is performed in congregation is seventy times greater than the prayer which is performed individually."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us namaz ki fazeelat jo miswaak karke padhi jaye, us namaz par jo bagair miswaak ke padhi jaye, sattar (70) guna zyada hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If it were not difficult for my nation, I would have made it obligatory for them to use the siwak (tooth stick) with every ablution, and I would have delayed the Isha prayer until half of the night." This is narrated by Abu Hurairah in this chapter, and they did not mention the word "obligatory" in it, and it is authentic according to both of them, and it has no defect. And it has a witness with this wording, as they did not mention the word "made obligatory," and it is according to their requirement and it has no defect.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar mujhe apni Ummat par mushkil na hoti to main unpar wudu ke sath miswaak karna farz kar deta, aur Isha ki namaz ko aadhi raat tak mo'akhkhar kar deta." Yeh Abu Hurairah (RA) se is baab mein riwayat hai, dono ne (Bukhari-Muslim) ismein 'farz' ka lafz nahi nikala, halanke yeh dono ki shart par sahih hai aur ismein koi khaami nahi, aur iska isi lafz ke sath aik shahid bhi hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "If it were not difficult for my Ummah (followers), I would have made it obligatory for them to use the Siwak (tooth stick) before every prayer, just as I made it obligatory for them to perform ablution before prayer."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar mujhe apni Ummat par mushkil na hoti to main unpar har namaz ke waqt miswaak farz kar deta, jaise maine unpar wudu farz kiya hai."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'There is no prayer for one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for one who does not mention the name of Allah upon it.' Muhammad bin Isma'il bin Abi Fudayk narrated it from Muhammad bin Musa al-Makhzumi.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jiska wudu na ho, aur us shakhs ka wudu nahi jisne uspar Allah ka naam na liya ho." Ise Muhammad bin Isma'il bin Abi Fudaik ne Muhammad bin Musa Al-Makhzumi se riwayat kiya hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The prayer of a person who does not perform ablution is not valid, and the ablution of a person who does not mention the name of Allah (in the beginning) is not valid. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 101)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jiska wudu na ho, aur us shakhs ka wudu nahi jisne uspar Allah ka naam na liya ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no prayer for someone who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for someone who does not mention the name of Allah upon it." Ali ibn Bundar Az-Zahid informed me, narrating from Umar ibn Muhammad ibn Jubayr, narrating from Abu Bakr Al-Athram, who said, "I heard Ahmad ibn Hanbal being asked about someone who performs ablution but does not mention (the name of Allah). Ahmad replied, 'The best that can be said about this hadith is what Kathir ibn Zayd has narrated.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jiska wudu na ho, aur us shakhs ka wudu nahi jisne uspar Allah ka naam na liya ho." Mujhe Ali bin Bundar Az-Zahid ne bataya, unhein Umar bin Muhammad bin Jubair ne bataya, unhein Abu Bakr Al-Athram ne bataya, unhone kaha: maine Ahmad bin Hanbal se suna, unse poocha gaya un logon ke baare mein jo wudu karte hain magar (Bismillah) nahi kehte, to Ahmad ne kaha: "Is hadith ke baare mein sabse achhi riwayat Kathir bin Zaid ki hai."

e: Do you like that I should show you how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution? He then called for a vessel of water and took out a handful of water with his right hand. He then rinsed his mouth and snuffed up water. He then took out another handful of water and washed his face by both his hands together. He then took out another handful of water and washed his right hand and then washed his left hand by taking out another. He then took out some water and shook off his hand and wiped his head and ears with it. He then took out a handful of water and sprinkled it over his right foot in his shoe and wiped the upper part of the foot with his one hand, and beneath the shoe with his other hand. He then did the same with his left foot. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 137)
hi: "Kya main tumhein na dikhaun Rasulullah (SAW) kaise wudu kiya karte thay?" Phir unhone paani se bhara aik bartan mangwaya, aik chullu paani liya, kulli ki aur naak mein paani chadhaya, phir doosra chullu liya aur dono haathon se apna chehra dhoya, phir doosra chullu liya aur apna dayan haath dhoya, phir aik aur chullu liya aur apna baayan haath dhoya, phir paani ki aik mutthi li aur apna haath jhatak kar usse apne sar aur kaanon ka masah kiya, phir aik aur chullu liya aur apne dayan pair par (paani) chhidka jismein jooti thi, aur baayan pair par bhi isi tarah, aur jooton ke neeche ka bhi masah kiya. Phir farmaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) ka wudu isi tarah tha."

e: [AI] He came to the Prophet ﷺ  and mentioned things, so the Prophet ﷺ  said to him, "Make your ablution thoroughly, alternate between your fingers, and when you rinse your nose, do it thoroughly unless you are fasting."
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kuch baatein zikr kiin, to Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Wudu poori tarah karo, ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karo, aur jab naak mein paani chadhao to poori taaqat se karo, siwaye is soorat mein jab tum roze se ho."

e: [AI] "He ﷺ  came to Aisha and his companion seeking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , but they did not find him. So Aisha fed them dates and porridge. They had not stayed for long before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came wearing a garment and wrapping his head. He said, 'Has anyone fed you?' I said, 'Yes, Messenger of Allah.' Then I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, tell us about prayer.' He said, 'Perform complete ablution, separate your fingers, and when you sniff water in your nostrils, do so abundantly unless you are fasting.'"
hi: Woh aur unka aik saathi Aisha (RA) ke paas aaye Rasulullah (SAW) ki talaash mein, magar unhein aap (SAW) na mile, to Aisha (RA) ne unhein khajoor aur harisah (dalya) khilaya. Abhi zyada waqt nahi guzra tha ke Rasulullah (SAW) chalte hue tashreef laaye. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein kisi ne khilaaya?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Phir maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein namaz ke baare mein bataiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wudu poori tarah karo, ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karo, aur jab naak mein paani chadhao to poori taaqat se karo, siwaye is soorat mein jab tum roze se ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you make istinja, perform it thoroughly, unless you are fasting, and do not hit your private parts with your right hand as you hit your slaves."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab naak mein paani chadhao to poori taaqat se karo, siwaye is soorat mein jab tum roze se ho, aur apni biwi ko aise na maaro jaise apni laundi ko maarte ho."

e: [AI] I was a new arrival among the Banu Al-Muntafiq when I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, inform me about ablution." He said, "Complete the ablution, run your fingers through your toes, and exaggerate in inhaling water during the sniffing [water into the nostril], except for when you are fasting." This narration is witnessed by Ibn Abbas.
hi: Main Banu Al-Muntafiq ka wafd (namaindah) banke Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya, maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe wudu ke baare mein bataiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wudu poori tarah karo, ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karo, aur naak mein paani chadhane mein poori taaqat lagao, siwaye is soorat mein jab tum roze se ho." Is hadith ka aik shahid Ibn Abbas (RA) se bhi hai.

e: [AI] The translation of the given text is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Perform the ritual cleansing (Istinthar) two or three times thoroughly." This is a witness to the news of a foundling.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Naak jhaadne (istinsaar) mein do ya teen martaba poori taaqat lagao." Yeh Laqit ki hadith ka shahid hai.

e: [AI] I saw Uthman perform ablution. He washed his face, rinsed his mouth and nose three times, wiped his head and both ears, both outside and inside, and he combed his beard three times while washing his face before washing his feet. Then he said, "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  do what you have witnessed me doing." The two scholars, Al-Bukhari and Muslim, both agreed to exclude the mentioning of combing the beard three times in their narrations about Uthman's ablution. This hadith is authentic and it has been supported by all of its narrators except 'Amir ibn Shaqiq. I do not know of any criticism against 'Amir ibn Shaqiq from any other source. Additionally, there is a valid witness regarding combing the beard from 'Ammar ibn Yasir, Anas ibn Malik, and Aisha bin Mu'awiyah, son of Mu'awiyah. Then he said, "And he has a valid witness."
hi: Maine Uthman (RA) ko wudu karte dekha, unhone apna chehra dhoya, naak mein paani chadhaya aur kulli ki teen martaba, apne sar aur kaanon ka - bahar aur andar dono taraf se - masah kiya, aur apni daadhi mein ungliyan phera teen martaba jab apna chehra dho rahe thay, apne paon dhone se pehle. Phir unhone farmaya: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko wahi karte dekha jo tumne mujhe karte dekha hai." Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ka Uthman (RA) ki wudu ki hadith ke aakhri hisse ki kayi riwayaton ko nikalne par ittifaq hai, magar unhone apni riwayaton mein daadhi mein teen martaba khilal karne ka zikr nahi kiya. Yeh sanad sahih hai, dono ne is hadith ke tamam raawiyon ko - Aamir bin Shaqiq ke siwa - hujjat maana hai, aur mujhe Aamir bin Shaqiq par kisi bhi tarah ka aitraaz maloom nahi. Daadhi mein khilal karne ka sahih shahid Ammar bin Yasir (RA), Anas bin Malik (RA) aur Aisha (RA) se bhi milta hai.

e: [AI] "And what prevents me while I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  trimming his beard?" Sufyan said: And Sa'id ibn Abi 'Arubah narrated to us from Qatadah from Hassan ibn Bilal from 'Ammar from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  similar to it.
hi: "Mujhe kya rok sakta hai jabke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko apni daadhi mein khilal karte dekha hai?" Sufyan ne kaha: humein Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah ne Qatadah se, unhone Hassan bin Bilal se, unhone Ammar (RA) se, Rasulullah (SAW) se isi jaisi hadith bayan ki.

e: [AI] I saw the Prophet ﷺ  performing ablution and passing his fingers through his beard from underneath it. He said, "My Lord commanded me to do this."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha: "Aap (SAW) ne wudu kiya aur apni ungliyon se apni daadhi mein neeche se khilal kiya," aur farmaya: "Mujhe mere Rab ne isi ka hukum diya hai."

e: [AI] I saw the Prophet ﷺ performing ablution and trimming his beard, and he said, "My Lord commanded me to do this."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha: "Aap (SAW) ne wudu kiya aur apni daadhi mein khilal kiya," aur farmaya: "Mujhe mere Rab ne isi ka hukum diya hai."

e: [AI] The translation of the given text is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to clean his beard when he performed ablution, and this is a valid evidence for wiping the inner parts of the ears."
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) wudu karte to apni daadhi mein khilal karte." (Yeh kaanon ke andar hisse ka masah karne ka bhi sahih shahid hai.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed ablution and wiped the inside and outside of his ears. Ibn Mas'ud used to order for the same. Zaidah bin Qudamah is considered trustworthy and reliable, as he narrated this from Thawri and others have also confirmed it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne wudu kiya aur apne kaanon ke andar aur bahar dono hisson ka masah kiya. (Ravi ne kaha:) aur Ibn Mas'ud (RA) isi ka hukum diya karte thay. (Za'idah bin Qudamah thiqa aur mo'tabar hain, unhone ise Ath-Thawri se musnad riwayat kiya hai, aur doosron ne ise mauqoof riwayat kiya hai.)

e: The Prophet ﷺ performed ablution by washing the body parts twice. (Using translation from Bukhārī 158)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne wudu ke har amal ko do do martaba kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ used to perform wudu (ablution) step by step and combined between gargling and rinsing the nose.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne wudu ke har amal ko aik aik martaba kiya, aur kulli karne aur naak mein paani chadhane ko aik sath jama kiya. (Dono ne iska pehla hissa nikala hai.)

e: [AI] "Al-Qa'nabi narrated from Dawud bin Qais al-Farra' from Zaid bin Aslam from 'Ata' bin Yasar from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ performed ablution in two separate rooms."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat hai, Nabi (SAW) ne "chullu chullu (paani lekar) wudu kiya."

e: [AI] "I entered the market with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he went to fulfill his needs. Then he returned, and I gave him water so he performed ablution. He then tried to take out his arms from his pocket but couldn't, so he took them out from under his cloak. Then he performed ablution and wiped over his socks."
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath bazaar mein dakhil hua, to aap (SAW) apni zaroorat (qaza-e-hajat) ke liye gaye," unhone kaha: "Phir aap (SAW) aaye to maine unhein paani diya, aap (SAW) ne wudu kiya, phir apni baazuain apni aasteen se nikaalna chahi to na nikal saken, to unhein jubbe ke neeche se nikaala, phir wudu kiya aur apne mozon (khuffain) par masah kiya."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ entered the markets and went to fulfill his need accompanied by Bilal. Then they came out, and I asked Bilal, "What did he do?" He said, "He performed ablution and washed his face and hands, wiped his head, and wiped over his socks."
hi: Nabi (SAW) bazaar mein dakhil huay aur apni zaroorat ke liye gaye, aur Bilal (RA) unke sath thay, phir dono bahar aaye. Maine Bilal (RA) se poocha: "Aap (SAW) ne kya kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) ne wudu kiya, apna chehra aur haath dhoye, apne sar ka masah kiya aur apne mozon par masah kiya."

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) performing ablution and he took water for his ears separately from the water with which he wiped his head."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko wudu karte dekha, aap (SAW) ne apne kaanon ke liye alag paani liya, us paani se hatkar jisse aap (SAW) ne apne sar ka masah kiya tha."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  wiped his ears without the same water he used to wipe his head, and this is a clear statement with the same meaning as the first, and it is authentic, like it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne apne kaanon ka masah us paani se nahi kiya jisse aap (SAW) ne apne sar ka masah kiya tha. (Yeh pehli hadith ke matlab ko wazeh karta hai, aur yeh bhi usi tarah sahih hai.) Sahih.

e: [AI] That the Prophet ﷺ  wiped the inner and outer parts of his ears, and he did not require Ibn 'Aqil, who was straightforward in narration, as a witness for this noble act.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne apne kaanon ke andar aur bahar dono hisson ka masah kiya. (Dono ne Ibn Aqeel ko hujjat nahi banaya, halanke unki hadith durust hai aur woh sharaafat mein aagey hain.)

e: [AI] "We entered upon Ali, me and two other men, one of whom was from our tribe and the other from the tribe of Banu Asad. Ali said to them, 'So they sent them for a need, and he said, "Indeed, you two are sick, so treat yourselves according to your religion."' Then he entered the restroom and came out. He called for water and washed his hands, then he began to recite the Quran. It seemed as if we disapproved, so he said, 'It seems that you two disapproved. The Messenger of Allah used to fulfill his needs, recite the Qur'an, and eat meat without anything preventing him from recitation except impurity (janabah).'"
hi: Hum Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas gaye, main aur do aur aadmi - aik humare (qabile) se aur aik Banu Asad se. Unhone (Ali ne) un dono ko kisi kaam se bheja aur farmaya: "Tum dono bimaar (mushkil mein) ho, isliye apne deen ke muta'alliq apna ilaaj karo." Phir woh qaza-e-hajat ke liye gaye, phir bahar aaye, paani mangwaya aur apne haath dhoye, phir Quran padhne lage. Humein jaise iska inkaar hua (achha na laga), to unhone farmaya: "Lagta hai tum dono ne isse bura samjha. Rasulullah (SAW) qaza-e-hajat karte, Quran padhte aur gosht khate, aur janabat ke ilawa koi cheez aap (SAW) ko (Quran) parhne se nahi rokti thi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "If one of you comes to his family and then wants to return, let him perform ablution, for he will be more lively in his return."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apni biwi ke paas jaye, phir dobara jana chahe, to use wudu kar lena chahiye, kyunke yeh dobara (jaane) ke liye zyada tarotaaza (nashat-angez) hota hai."

e: [AI] I asked Aisha, "How did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  behave when he was in a state of janabah (major ritual impurity)? Would he take a bath before sleeping, or did he sleep before taking a bath?" She said, "He would sometimes take a bath and then sleep, and sometimes he would perform ablution (wudu) and then sleep." I said, "All praise is due to Allah, who made this matter flexible." This hadith was narrated by Muslim in his Sahih from Qutaybah, and Ghudayf ibn al-Harith narrated from Aisha as well.
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) janabat ki halat mein kya karte the? Kya woh sone se pehle ghusl karte the ya ghusl se pehle so jate the?" Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) dono tarah karte the, kabhi ghusl karke sote aur kabhi wudu karke so jate." Maine kaha: "Alhamdulillah jisne is maamle mein waseeh gunjaish rakhi hai." Ise Muslim ne apni Sahih mein Qutaybah se riwayat kiya hai, agarche unhone iske shawahid ke alfaz zikr nahi kiye. Ghudaif bin Al-Harith ne bhi Aisha (RA) se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] About the Prophet's ﷺ ritual washing from sexual impurity, she said: "He might have washed before sleeping, and he might have slept before washing." It was followed by Kahmas ibn al-Hasan reporting from Burd.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke janabat ke ghusl ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Kabhi woh sone se pehle ghusl karte aur kabhi ghusl se pehle so jate." Kahmas bin Al-Hasan ne Burd se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] I asked Aisha, "Did the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, wash himself from the beginning or from the end when he experienced seminal emission?" She replied, "Sometimes he would wash from the beginning and sometimes from the end." I said, "Allah is the greatest. All praise is due to Allah who has made things easy for us." And I sent blessings upon our master Muhammad, his family, and all his companions.
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ko janabat ho jaati to woh (raat ki) shuru mein ghusl karte the ya aakhir mein?" Unhone kaha: "Kabhi shuru mein ghusl karte aur kabhi aakhir mein." Maine kaha: "Allahu Akbar, Alhamdulillah jisne is maamle mein waseeh gunjaish rakhi hai," wa sallallahu ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa aalihi wa ashabihi ajma'in.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took a bath and offered two rak'ahs of prayer and said the dawn prayer. I do not think he performed ablution afresh after taking a bath. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 250)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) subah ki namaz se pehle do rakat namaz padhte, aur main nahi samajhta ke aap (SAW) ghusl ke baad naya wudu karte the."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic text is: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to not perform ablution (wudhu) after performing a full bath (ghusl), and there is an authentic narration (hadith) from Ibn Umar supporting this."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ghusl ke baad wudu nahi karte the. Iska aik sahih shahid Ibn Umar (RA) se bhi milta hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was asked about performing ablution after washing, so he replied, "And which ablution is superior to washing?"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se ghusl ke baad wudu karne ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaunsa wudu ghusl se behtar ho sakta hai?"

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  used to warm himself with it after performing ablution."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ghusl ke baad usse (kapde/chadar se) khud ko garam kar liya karte thay.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  had a piece of cloth that he would use to dry himself after performing ablution. Abu Mu'adh, who is Fadl ibn Maysarah Basri, narrated this hadith that was also narrated by Yahya ibn Sa'id, who praised him. This hadith has been narrated from Anas ibn Malik and others, but they did not include it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas aik kapda hota tha jisse woh wudu ke baad khud ko sukhaate. (Abu Muadh, yeh Al-Fadl bin Maisarah Basri hain, unse Yahya bin Sa'eed ne riwayat ki hai aur unki tareef ki hai. Yeh hadith Anas bin Malik (RA) aur doosron se bhi riwayat hui hai, magar Shaykhain ne ise nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] From Jabir, "Authentic according to the condition of Muslim" according to the condition of Al-Bukhari.
hi: Jabir (RA) se riwayat hai. (Yeh Muslim ki shart par sahih hai.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prohibited us from turning our backs to the Qibla or facing it with our private parts exposed when we urinate. However, we saw him do this before his death while facing the Qibla.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein mana kiya tha ke jab hum paishab karein to Qibla ki taraf peeth na karein ya apni sharamgaah usse mutawajjeh na karein, phir humne unhein unki wafat se kuch pehle Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh hokar paishab karte dekha.

e: [AI] The following translation from Arabic to English is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The price of a dog is impure, and it is even more impure than it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kutte ki qeemat napaak hai, aur woh (khud) usse bhi zyada napaak hai."

e: [AI] From the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, on this verse: {In it are men who love to purify themselves. And Allah loves those who purify themselves.} [Surah At-Tawbah: 108], the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "O Ansar! Indeed, Allah has praised you for the goodness in purity. What is your purification?" They said, "O messenger of Allah, we perform ablution for prayer and purify ourselves from janabah (state of impurity after sexual intercourse)." The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Is there anything else besides that?" They said, "No, except that when one of us goes to the restroom, he prefers to cleanse himself with water." He said, "That is it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se is ayat ke baare mein: "Ismein aise log hain jo paak rehna pasand karte hain, aur Allah paak rehne walon ko pasand karta hai" (Surah At-Tawbah 108), Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ansar ki jama'at, Allah ne tumhari taharat ke baare mein achhi tareef ki hai, to yeh tumhari taharat kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum namaz ke liye wudu karte hain aur janabat se ghusl karte hain." Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Iske ilawa bhi kuch hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, magar itna ke hum mein se koi jab qaza-e-hajat se nikalta hai to paani se istinja karna pasand karta hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bas yehi (woh cheez) hai."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ said to the people of Quba': 'Indeed, Allah has praised you for your cleanliness.' And He said, 'In it are men who love to purify themselves' (Quran 9:108) until the verse was completed. Then he asked them, 'What is this purification?'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Quba walon se farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne tumhari taharat ki achhi tareef ki hai," aur farmaya: "Ismein aise log hain jo paak rehna pasand karte hain" (Surah At-Tawbah 108) yahan tak ke ayat khatam hui, phir unse poocha: "Yeh taharat kya hai?"

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Hanzala ibn Abi Amer Al-Ghasil has narrated it.
hi: Abdullah bin Hanzalah bin Abi Aamir Al-Ghaseel (RA) ne unhein yeh bataya.

e: [AI] We went with the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم on the expedition of Dhat al-Riqa'a from a place full of palm trees. One of the Muslims happened to approach a woman from the polytheists and took her, then when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم left with the caravan, he went to her husband who was absent. When he was informed of the news, he swore not to stop shedding the blood of the companions of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم until it settled in his heart. He then went to follow the traces of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم stopped at a place and said, "Who will guard us tonight?" A man from the Emigrants and a man from the Helpers came forward and said, "We will, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Then be at the mouth of the valley." The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم and his companions had settled at the valley. When the two men reached the mouth of the valley, the Helper asked the Emigrant, "Which part of the night do you prefer for me to guard?" He said, "I prefer you to guard the first part." So the Emigrant rested, and the Helper started to pray. Then the husband of the woman came, and when he saw a person, he recognized him as the lord of his people, so he shot an arrow at him. The Helper withdrew the arrow and put it in himself, and he remained standing in prayer. Then the husband tried to shoot the Helper with another arrow, but the Helper withdrew it and put it in himself, and he remained standing in prayer. Then he tried for the third time, but this time the Helper allowed it to hit him, then he performed a prostration and alerted his companion, saying, "Sit down, I have established myself." He then jumped up, and when the man saw them, he realized that he had made a vow regarding them, so he ran away. When the Emigrant saw the blood on the Helper from the injuries inflicted by the arrows, he said, "Glory be to Allah! Why didn't you call me when he first shot you?" The Helper replied, "I was in the middle of reciting a surah and I did not want to interrupt it until I completed it. When he continued to shoot me, I performed a prostration and warned you. By Allah, if it were not for the order of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم to protect him, my life would have been cut off before I finished reciting the surah or performed the prostration."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Ghazwa Dhat-ur-Riqa' mein aik khajoor ke jangal se nikle, to Musalmanon mein se aik shakhs ne mushrikeen ki aik aurat ko (qaid mein) le liya. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) wapasi ke liye rawana huay to uska shohar aaya, jo (pehle) ghayab tha. Jab usse khabar mili to usne qasam khayi ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ka khoon bahaye baghair chain nahi lega, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke nishaan ki pairavi mein nikla. Rasulullah (SAW) aik jagah thehre aur farmaya: "Kaun shakhs aaj raat humari pehredaari karega?" To Muhajireen mein se aik aur Ansar mein se aik shakhs aage aaye aur kaha: "Hum karengay, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To ghaati ke munh par (pehra) do." Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke sahaba wadi se ghaati mein utar chuke thay. Jab dono aadmi ghaati ke munh tak pahunche to Ansari ne Muhajir se poocha: "Raat ka kaunsa hissa tumhein pasand hai ke main tumhare liye sambhalun?" Usne kaha: "Pehla hissa sambhal lo." Muhajir let gaya aur Ansari namaz padhne khada ho gaya. Aurat ka shohar aaya, jab usne kisi shakhs ko dekha to pehchan liya ke yeh (in logon ka) sardar hai. Usne aik teer maara jo usme lag gaya. Usne teer nikaala aur rakh diya, aur khada rehkar namaz padhta raha. Phir usne doosra teer maara jo usme lag gaya, usne phir nikaala aur rakh diya, aur khada rehkar namaz padhta raha. Phir teesri baar bhi aisa hi hua, teer usme lag gaya, usne nikaala aur rakh diya, phir ruku kiya aur apne sathi ko jaga diya. Usne kaha: "Baith jao, mujhe (teer) lag chuka hai." Woh uchhal kar khada ho gaya. Jab us (dushman) shakhs ne un dono ko dekha to samajh gaya ke uske irade ka pata chal gaya, to woh bhaag gaya. Jab Muhajir ne Ansari par khoon dekha to kaha: "Subhan Allah, tumne mujhe pehle hi teer par kyun na jagaya?" Usne kaha: "Main aik surah padh raha tha, mujhe achha nahi laga ke ise adhoora chhodun jab tak use poora na kar lun. Jab teer barabar lagne lage to maine ruku kiya aur tumhein khabar di. Allah ki qasam, agar mujhe darr na hota ke main us morche ko zaya kar dunga jiski hifazat ka hukum Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe diya tha, to meri jaan nikal jaati, is se pehle ke main isse (surah ko) toad deta ya poora kar leta."

e:
[AI] Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade two men from conversing with each other, for Allah hates that.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Humein Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad bin Ya'qub ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Ali Al-Warraq, jinka laqab Hamdaan hai, ne bataya, humein Abu Yahya Abdus Samad bin Hassan Al-Marwazi ne bataya, humein Sufyan bin Sa'eed ne Ikrimah bin Ammar se bataya. Aur humein Abu Bakr bin Ishaq Al-Faqih ne bataya, aur lafz unke hain, humein Ali bin Abdul Aziz ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Ammar ne bataya, humein Qasim bin Yazid Al-Jarmi ne bataya, humein Sufyan ne Ikrimah bin Ammar se, unhone Yahya bin Abi Kathir se, unhone Iyad se, unhone Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se bataya, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne do qaza-e-hajat karne walon ko aapas mein baat karne se mana kiya, kyunke Allah is par naraaz hota hai."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade the two men who had contracted diarrhea from speaking and he said, 'Indeed, Allah dislikes that.' This is 'Uyayd ibn Hilal Al-Ansari, a well-known scholar from the Tabi'in (followers of the Prophet's companions), from the people of Madinah, and he participated in the Battle of Yamamah. And this is mentioned in a valid (authentic) narration." (Sahih)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne do qaza-e-hajat karne walon ko aapas mein baat karne se mana kiya aur farmaya: "Kyunke Allah is par naraaz hota hai." (Yeh Iyad bin Hilal Al-Ansari hain, aik jaana-mana Tabi'i buzurg, Madinah ke rehne wale, jo Yamamah tak gaye, aur jo maine bayan kiya uski sehat sahih hai.) Sahih.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Two men should not go out to relieve themselves, exposing their private parts to one another, for surely Allah dislikes that."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Do aadmi qaza-e-hajat ke liye is haal mein na nikle ke unki sharamgaahein khuli hon, kyunke Allah is par naraaz hota hai."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'When any one of you performs wudu, let him perform an odd number of units (of prayer) as Allah is odd and He loves that which is odd. Have you not seen that the heavens are seven and the earths are seven and tawaf is seven?' And he mentioned other things."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi istinja (pathar se safai) kare, to taaq adad mein kare, kyunke Allah taaq hai aur taaq ko pasand karta hai. Kya tumne nahi dekha ke aasmaan saat hain, zameenein saat hain, aur tawaaf (bhi saat chakkar)?" Aur aap (SAW) ne kuch aur baatein bhi zikr kiin.

e: [AI] "I entered upon Aisha and heard her saying, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say 'Your forgiveness' when he came out of the toilet.'"
hi: Main Aisha (RA) ke paas gaya, to maine unhein yeh kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) jab qaza-e-hajat se nikalte to farmate: "Ghufranaka" (Aye Allah, teri maghfirat maangta hoon).

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to get up from relieving himself, he would say, "I seek Your forgiveness."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) qaza-e-hajat se uthte to farmate: "Ghufranaka."

e: One of the wives of the Prophet took a bath to cleanse herself from sexual impurity, then the Prophet performed ablution and had a bath with the water left over from her ablution." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 371)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki azwaaj mein se aik ne janabat se ghusl kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne wudu kiya - ya ghusl kiya - unke bachay hue paani se. Shu'bah ne Simak se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  wanted to perform ablution from a container, so one of his wives said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have already performed ablution from this." So the Prophet ﷺ  performed ablution and said, "Nothing makes the water impure." Al-Bukhari cited the hadith of Ikrimah as evidence, and Muslim cited the hadith of Simak ibn Harb as evidence.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik bartan se wudu karna chaha, to unki aik biwi ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine ismein se wudu kar liya hai." To Nabi (SAW) ne (phir bhi usi se) wudu kiya aur farmaya: "Paani ko koi cheez napaak nahi karti." Bukhari ne Ikrimah ki ahadith se hujjat pakdi hai, aur Muslim ne Simak bin Harb ki ahadith se hujjat pakdi hai.

e: [AI] Omar, we went to Tabuk during extreme heat. We found a place where we felt extremely thirsty to the point that we thought our necks would be severed. People would slaughter their camels for their milk and drink it, and use their intestines to store any remaining liquid. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said to the Prophet, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah has accustomed you to good supplication, so please make supplication for rain." The Prophet asked, "Do you like that?" Abu Bakr replied, "Yes." So the Prophet raised his hands and did not put them down until the sky became shaded and then poured rain. They filled what they had with them, and then we looked and did not find a single trace of it, except that the army continued its journey.
hi: Umar (RA) [ne bayan kiya]: hum Tabuk ki taraf sakht garmi mein nikle, hum aik jagah utre jahan humein aisi pyaas lagi ke humein laga humari gardanein toot jayengi, yahan tak ke aik shakhs apna unt zibah karta aur uski aant nichod kar peeta aur baaki hissa apne jigar par rakh leta. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ne aapki dua ko humesha khair (barkat) diya hai, to (baarish ke liye) dua kijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum yeh chahte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To aap (SAW) ne apne dono haath uthaye aur unhein waapas nahi kiya yahan tak ke aasman ne (baadal se) chhaya kiya, phir barsa diya, to humne apne bartan bhar liye. Phir hum dekhne gaye to hum ise (baarish ko) lashkar se aage badhte hue na paaya.

e: Kabshah, daughter of Ka'b ibn Malik and wife of Ibn AbuQatadah, reported: AbuQatadah visited (me) and I poured out water for him for ablution. A cat came and drank some of it and he tilted the vessel for it until it drank some of it. Kabshah said: He saw me looking at him; he asked me: Are you surprised, my niece? I said: Yes. He then reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: It is not unclean; it is one of those (males or females) who go round among you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 75)
hi: Abu Qatadah (RA) unke (Kabshah) paas aaye, to unhone unke liye wudu ka paani daala, aik billi peene ke liye aayi to Abu Qatadah (RA) ne uske liye bartan jhuka diya yahan tak ke usne pi liya. Kabshah (RA) ne kaha: unhone mujhe dekha ke main use dekh rahi hoon, to unhone kaha: "Kya tumhein ta'ajjub ho raha hai, aye bhatiji?" Maine kaha: "Haan." Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya hai: 'Yeh napaak nahi, yeh un (janwaron) mein se hai jo tumhare gird ghoomte hain.'"

e: [AI] Regarding Aisha, "And it was confirmed by the two sheiks as opposed to this, and they did not exclude it either." Authentic.
hi: Aisha (RA) se, (jismein iske ulat aik baat bhi Shaykhain ki shart par sahih sabit hui hai, aur unhone bhi ise nahi nikala.) Sahih.

e:
[AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "The purification of the vessel of one of you, if it is licked by a dog, is to wash it seven times. The first time with dirt and the second time with cat."

Note: ﷺ is an honorific used in Islamic tradition after mentioning the name of the Prophet Muhammad to mean "peace be upon him".
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab kutta tumhare kisi bartan mein munh daal de to uski taharat yeh hai ke use saat martaba dhoya jaye, pehli martaba mitti se, aur billi ka masla bhi isi tarah hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The purification of a vessel in which a dog has licked is to wash it seven times, the first of which is with dirt, and once or twice with sand." "This is a source of doubt."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bartan ki taharat jab kutta usme munh daal de, yeh hai ke use saat martaba dhoya jaye, pehli martaba mitti se, aur billi ke liye aik ya do martaba." (Qurrah ko shak hai.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Regarding a cat, once or twice." It means washing the vessel if a cat has touched it. "Ali ibn Nasr al-Jahdamy cured a soreness in explaining this statement."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Billi ke liye aik ya do martaba" - ya'ni bartan ko dhona jab billi usme munh daal de. (Ali bin Nasr Al-Jahdami ne is lafz ki wazahat mein Qurrah se (riwayat) ki hai.)

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The purification of the utensil belonging to any one of you, after it is licked by a dog, lies in washing it seven times, using sand for the first time. (Using translation from Muslim 279d)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se kisi ke bartan ki taharat jab kutta usme munh daal de, yeh hai ke use saat martaba dhoya jaye, pehli martaba mitti se." Phir Abu Hurairah (RA) ne billi ka zikr kiya - mujhe yaad nahi ke aik martaba kaha ya do martaba. Nasr bin Ali ne kaha: "Maine ise apne walid ki kitaab mein aik aur jagah Qurrah se, unhone Ibn Sireen se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se paaya - kutte ke maamle mein musnad (mutasil sanad se) aur billi ke maamle mein mauqoof (raawi tak mahdood)." Iski mutaba'at billi ka zikr mauqoof karne mein Muslim bin Ibrahim ne Qurrah se ki hai.

e: [AI] Translation: Abu Hurairah narrated regarding a cat that licks inside a container, he said, "It should be washed once or twice." "The permissibility of reusing the container is established in Islamic Shariah based on the hadith of Malik ibn Anas regarding the purity of the cat, and Allah knows best."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, billi ke bartan mein munh daalne ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Ise aik ya do martaba dhoya jaye." (Shari'at ke hukum mein Malik bin Anas ki, billi ki taharat ke baare mein, hadith ki taraf rujoo sabit ho chuka hai, wallahu a'lam.)

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  wanted to perform ablution using a water container, so he was told that it was dead (impure) water. He then said, "Its impurity will remove its impurities or filthiness."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik mashk (chamde ke bartan) se wudu karna chaha, to unse kaha gaya ke yeh murda (jaanwar ki khaal se banaya gaya) hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iski charmsazi (dabgh) iski gandagi ya napaaki ko door kar deti hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him, said, "A measure of water is sufficient for ablution, and a Sa' is sufficient for sexual impurity." A man said to him, "That is not enough for us, O Jabir." He replied, "It is enough for someone who is better than you and has more hair."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wudu ke liye aik mudd (paani ka pyaana) kaafi hai, aur janabat ke liye aik saa'." Aik shakhs ne unse (Jabir RA se) kaha: "Yeh humare liye kaafi nahi, aye Jabir." Unhone kaha: "Yeh us shakhs ke liye kaafi tha jo tumse behtar aur zyada baalon wala tha."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  was brought two-thirds of a bucket of water, so he performed ablution and began wiping his arms."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas paani ke do-tihaai maap (mudd) laaye gaye, to aap (SAW) ne wudu kiya aur apni baazuain malna shuru kiya.

e: [AI] "We used to perform ablution, both men and women, and wash our hands in a single vessel during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein mard aur aurat sab aik hi bartan mein wudu karte aur apne haath dhote thay."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Verily, there is a devil for ablution called Al-Walahan, so beware of it and be cautious of the whisperings of water." "And he has another narrated witness that is more authentic than this."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wudu ka aik shaitan hai jise Al-Walahan kaha jata hai, isse bacho aur paani ke waswase se bacho." Iska aik doosra shahid aik aur sanad se hai jo isse zyada sahih hai.

e: Abdullah heard his son praying to Allah: O Allah, I ask Thee a white palace on the right of Paradise when I enter it. He said: O my son, ask Allah for Paradise and seek refuge in Him from Hell-Fire, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: In this community there will be some people who will exceed the limits in purification as well as in supplication. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 96)
hi: Unhone apne bete ko yeh kehte hue suna: "Aye Allah, main tujhse Jannat mein dakhil hote hi daayan taraf ka safed mahal maangta hoon." To unhone kaha: "Aye mere bete, Allah se Jannat maango aur Jahannam se uski panah maango, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Is Ummat mein aise log hongay jo taharat aur dua mein hadd se tajawuz karengay.'" (Ismein irsaal hai - ya'ni sanad mein kadi ka toot.)

e: [AI] He (someone) heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "Woe to the ankles and bellies of the feet from the Fire."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Halaakat hai un aidiyon aur paon ke talwon ke liye jo (wudu mein sukhe reh jaayen aur) aag se (mutasir hon)."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  forbade a man from entering the water except with a waist covering."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mard ko bagair tehband ke paani mein dakhil hone se mana kiya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ used to take a bath on account of sexual defilement, on Friday, for cupping and washing the dead. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3160)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chaar cheezon se ghusl kiya jata hai: janabat se, jum'e ke din, mayyat ke ghusl (dene) se, aur pachkari (hijamat) lagwane se."

e: [AI] Fatimah entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while she was crying, so he said, "O my daughter, what makes you cry?" She said, "O father, why shouldn't I cry when those leaders of the Quraysh in the chamber are making a contract with Al-Lat, Al-Uzza, and Manat? If they saw you, they would stand up and kill you, and there is not one of them except that he knows his share of your blood." He said, "O my daughter, bring me water for ablution." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed ablution, then he went out to the mosque. When they saw him, they said, "There he is, so bow down." Their foreheads fell and their beards touched the ground, and they did not raise their eyes until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took a handful of dust and threw it at them, saying, "May their faces be disfigured." None of them was touched by a pebble from his handful except that he was killed on the Day of Badr as a disbeliever.
hi: Fatimah (Alayha as-Salam) rote hue Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aayi, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye meri beti, tumhein kya rula raha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aye abba jaan, main kyun na roun jabke yeh Quraish ke sardar Hijr (Hateem) mein Laat, Uzza aur teesri Manat ki qasam khakar aapas mein ahd baandh rahe hain (ke woh aapko qatl karengay), agar unhone aapko dekh liya to aapki taraf khade ho jayengay aur aapko qatl kar denge, aur unme se koi bhi aisa nahi jise apne (khoon bahane wale) hissay ka pata na ho." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye meri beti, mere liye wudu ka paani lao." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne wudu kiya, phir masjid ki taraf nikle. Jab unhone (Quraish ne) aap (SAW) ko dekha to kaha: "Woh raha," to unhone apne sar jhuka liye aur unki thoRiyan unke aage lat'ak gayin, unhone apni nazrein na uthain. Rasulullah (SAW) ne mitti ki aik mutthi uthai aur unpar dal di aur farmaya: "Chehre bigad jayen." Unme se jis kisi ko bhi us mitti ka koi zarra laga, woh Badar ke din kaafir hi qatl hua.

e: [AI] "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the early days of his prophethood in Makkah. He was at that time in a state of concealment. I asked him, 'Who are you?' He replied, 'I am a prophet.' I asked, 'What is a prophet?' He said, 'I am the Messenger of Allah.' I asked, 'Did Allah send you?' He replied, 'Yes.' I asked, 'With what did He send you?' He said, 'To worship Allah alone and to break idols and false religions, and to maintain family ties.' I said, 'Yes, indeed. What did He send you with?' I asked, 'Who follows you in this?' He said, 'Slave and free, meaning Abu Bakr and Bilal.' Umar used to say, 'I was a quarter or a fourth of Islam when I accepted Islam.' I said, 'Shall I follow you, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'No, but the truth will come to your people. When you hear that I have left, follow me.' So, I caught up with my people and I anticipated his news of departure and arrival until a group from Yathrib (Madina) came and I met them. I asked them about the news and they said, 'The Messenger of Allah has left Makkah for Madina.' I asked, 'Has he arrived there?' They replied, 'Yes.' I then proceeded until I reached him. I said, 'Do you recognize me, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'Yes, you are the man who came to me in Makkah.' I began to observe his seclusion and when he was alone, I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, teach me about what Allah has taught you and make it concise.' He said, 'Ask me about anything.' I said, 'During which part of the night should I perform the night prayer?' He replied, 'The last part of the night. And pray as much as you wish because the prayer is witnessed and recorded until you pray the dawn prayer. Then shorten your prayer until the sun rises and its rays are like the length of a spear or a pair of spears. Because at that time, the disbelievers prostrate to it. Then, pray as much as you wish, for the prayer is witnessed and recorded until the shadow of your spear becomes equal to its length. Then, shorten your prayer because Hellfire is kindled and its gates are opened. When the sun declines, pray as much as you wish, for the prayer is witnessed and recorded until you pray the afternoon prayer. Then, shorten your prayer until the sun sets, for it sets between the two horns of Satan and the disbelievers prostrate to it. When you perform ablution, wash your hands, for when you wash your hands, your sins leave from the sides of your arms. Then, when you wipe your head, your sins leave from the tips of your hair. And when you wash your feet, your sins leave from your feet. If you remain seated in your place, you will have a share of your ablution. If you stand up and remember your Lord and praise Him and perform two raka'ahs facing the Qiblah, with your heart, you will be free from your sins as on the day your mother gave birth to you.' I said, 'O Umar, I know what I am saying. You are saying something great.' He said, 'By Allah, my age has increased and my death is near, and I am not in need of lying. Even if I had heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ only once or twice, I would have conveyed it. But I have heard it more than that. This is how Abu Salamah narrated it from him, from Abu Umamah, except for any possible error or addition. And Muslim has recorded some of these words from the hadith of Nadr ibn Muhammad al-Jurashi, from Ikrimah ibn Ammar, from Shaddad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Umamah.' Umar ibn Abbas said, 'And the hadith of Abbas ibn Salim is more comprehensive and complete than the hadith of Ikrimah ibn Ammar.'"
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua jab aap (SAW) ko Nabuwwat mile hi thi aur aap (SAW) Makkah mein chhupe huay thay. Maine poocha: "Aap kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Nabi hoon." Maine poocha: "Nabi kya hota hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ka Rasool." Maine poocha: "Kya Allah ne aapko bheja hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Maine poocha: "Kis baat ke sath aapko bheja hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is baat ke sath ke tum Allah ki ibadat karo, buton aur (baatil) mazhabon ko torh do, aur rishtedariyan jodo." Maine kaha: "Kitni achhi baat ke sath aapko bheja gaya hai." Maine poocha: "Iss par aapki pairavi kaun karta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik ghulam aur aik azaad," ya'ni Abu Bakr (RA) aur Bilal (RA). Amr (RA) kaha karte the: "Maine khud ko dekha ke main Islam ka aik chauthai ya chautha hissa hoon." Unhone kaha: main Musalman ho gaya, maine kaha: "Kya main aapki pairavi karoon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke apni qaum ke paas jao, aur jab tumhein khabar mile ke main nikal chuka hoon to meri pairavi karna." Unhone kaha: main apni qaum ke paas gaya aur aap (SAW) ki khabar aur nikalne ka intezar karne laga, yahan tak ke Yathrib se aik qafila aaya, maine unse mulaqat ki aur khabar poochi, to unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah se Madinah nikal chuke hain." Maine poocha: "Kya woh wahan pahunch chuke hain?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." To main safar karke unke paas pahuncha, maine poocha: "Kya aap mujhe pehchante hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, tum wahi shakhs ho jo Makkah mein mere paas aaye thay." Phir main aap (SAW) ki tanhaai ka intezar karne laga, jab aap (SAW) akele huay to maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ne aapko jo sikhaya hai usme se mujhe (kuch) sikhaiye, aur mukhtasar rakhiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo chaho poocho." Maine poocha: "Raat ke kis hissay mein Allah (dua) sunta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raat ke aakhri hisse mein, to jitni chaho namaz padho, kyunke namaz mahfooz aur likhi jaati hai yahan tak ke tum Fajr padh lo, phir ruk jao yahan tak ke suraj nikal aaye aur nezay ya do nezay ki lambai tak buland ho jaye, kyunke suraj Shaitan ke sar ke do singon ke darmiyan niklta hai, aur uske liye kaafir sajda karte hain. Phir jitni chaho namaz padho, kyunke namaz mahfooz aur likhi jaati hai yahan tak ke nezay ka saaya barabar ho jaye, phir ruk jao kyunke us waqt Jahannam ko dahkaya jata hai aur uske darwaze khole jate hain. Jab suraj dhal jaye to jitni chaho namaz padho, kyunke namaz mahfooz aur likhi jaati hai, phir Asr tak namaz padhte raho, phir ruk jao yahan tak ke suraj doob jaye, kyunke woh Shaitan ke sar ke do singon ke darmiyan doobta hai, aur uske liye kaafir sajda karte hain. Aur jab tum wudu karo to apne haath dho lo, kyunke jab tum apne haath dhote ho to tumhare gunah tumhari baazuon se nikal jate hain, phir jab tum apne sar ka masah karte ho to tumhare gunah tumhare baalon ke sirose nikal jate hain, phir jab tum apne paon dhote ho to tumhare gunah tumhare paon se nikal jate hain. Agar tum apni jagah baithe raho to yeh tumhare wudu ka aik hissa hoga, aur agar tum khade hokar apne Rab ko yaad karo, uski hamd karo aur do rakat namaz padho, apne dil ko unki taraf mutawajjeh karke, to tum apne gunahon se aise saaf ho jaoge jaise us din tha jab tumhari maa ne tumhein paida kiya." Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: maine kaha: "Aye Amr, apni baat par ghor karo, tum aik bohot badi baat keh rahe ho." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, meri umar zyada ho chuki hai, aur meri maut qareeb hai, mujhe jhoot bolne ki koi zaroorat nahi. Agar maine yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se sirf aik ya do baar suni hoti to main isse bayan na karta, lekin maine ise usse bhi zyada martaba suna hai." Isi tarah mujhe Abu Sallam ne unse, unhone Abu Umamah (RA) se, bayan kiya, siwaye is ke ke agar mujhse koi ghalti ho ya izafa ho jaye, to main Allah se maafi maangta hoon aur uski taraf rujoo karta hoon. (Muslim ne in mein se kuch alfaz Nadr bin Muhammad Al-Jurashi ki, Ikrimah bin Ammar se, unhone Shaddad bin Abdullah se, unhone Abu Umamah (RA) se, riwayat mein nikale hain.) Amr bin Abasah (RA) ne kaha: aur Abbas bin Salim ki yeh hadith, Ikrimah bin Ammar ki hadith se zyada mukammal aur waazeh hai.

e: [AI] A man became unwell during winter, so he asked if he could perform ablution (washing). He then performed the ablution and passed away. The Prophet ﷺ  was informed of this incident and he said, "Why did they kill him? Allah has killed them all." He repeated this thrice and added, "Allah has made the desert or dry ablution (tayammum) sufficient for purification."
hi: Aik shakhs ko sardi mein janabat ho gayi, usne (masla) poocha aur use ghusl karne ka hukum diya gaya, usne ghusl kiya to mar gaya. Yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki gayi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein kya hua, unhone usse maar dala, Allah unhein maar dale!" - teen martaba - "Allah ne mitti ya tayammum ko taharat ka zariya banaya hai."

e: [AI] "If a man is performing surgery in the way of Allah, or has wounds or chickenpox, and he avoids washing due to fear of death, then he should perform tayammum."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "Aur agar tum bimaar ho ya safar mein ho" (Surah An-Nisa 43) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jab kisi shakhs ko Allah ki raah mein zakhm laga ho, ya usse phode (zakhm) ya chechak ho, aur usse janabat ho jaye aur ghusl karne se maut ka khatra ho, to woh tayammum kare."

e: The Messenger of Allah said: "The urine of a boy should be sprinkled over and the urine of a girl should be washed." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 527)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne doodh peete bachche ke paishab ke baare mein farmaya: "Larkay ke paishab par (paani) chhidak diya jaye, aur larki ke paishab ko dhoya jaye."

e: [AI] "When Al-Hussein came into Prophet Muhammad's room, I said to him, 'Give me your garment so I can wash it.' He replied, 'It is only washed by the urine of a female and sprinkled with the urine of a male.' And the second witness is authentic."
hi: Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) ne Nabi (SAW) ki god mein paishab kar diya, to maine kaha: "Apna kapda dijiye, main use dho dun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Larki ka paishab dhoya jata hai, aur larke ka paishab (sirf) chhidka jata hai." (Yeh doosra shahid sahih hai.) Sahih.

e: [AI] "I was a servant of the Prophet ﷺ, and I brought Hassan or Hussein, and the Prophet put him on his chest. They wanted to wash him, so he said, 'Sprinkle him with water, as he is washed with the urine of a little girl and sprinkled with the urine of a boy.' The two sheikhs have mentioned the urination of the baby, a narration from Aisha and Umm Qais bint Muhsin, that the Prophet ﷺ ordered water to be poured on the urine of the baby. As for the mention of the urine of the baby girl, they did not mention it."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ka khadim tha, to Hasan ya Husain (Alayhis Salam) ko laaya gaya, unhone aap (SAW) ke seene par paishab kar diya, to unhein dhone ka irada kiya gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isspar sirf paani chhidak do, kyunke larki ka paishab dhoya jata hai aur larke ka paishab chhidka jata hai." (Shaykhain ne bachche ke paishab ke baare mein Aisha (RA) aur Umm Qais bint Mihsan (RA) ki hadith nikali hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne paani mangwaya aur bachche ke paishab par dalwaya, lekin larki ke paishab ka zikr dono ne nahi nikala.) Sahih.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "If one of you steps on something harmful with his shoe, then indeed the dirt is purification for him." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne jooton se kisi napaak cheez ko rondh de, to mitti hi uske liye taharat ka zariya hai." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: When any one of you treads with his sandal upon an unclean place, the earth will render it purified. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 385)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne jooton se kisi napaak cheez ko rondh de, to mitti dono (jooton) ke liye taharat ka zariya hai."

e: Muhajir came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was urinating. He saluted him. The Prophet ﷺ did not return the salutation to him until he performed ablution. He then apologised to him, saying: I disliked remembering Allah except in the state of purification. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 17)
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke aap (SAW) paishab kar rahe thay, usne salaam kiya, to aap (SAW) ne jawaab nahi diya yahan tak ke wudu kar liya, phir usse maazrat ki aur farmaya: "Mujhe napasand tha ke main Allah ka zikr sirf taharat ki halat mein karoon" - ya farmaya: "paakizgi ki halat mein."

e: The Prophet ﷺ had a wooden vessel under his bed in which he would urinate at night. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 24)
hi: Unhone kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ke paas lakdi ka aik pyaala tha jo unke takht ke neeche rehta tha, aap (SAW) raat ko usme paishab karte thay."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Be on your guard against three things which provoke cursing: easing in the watering places and on the thoroughfares, and in the shade (of the tree). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 26)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Un teen la'nat-yafta jaghon se bacho: paani ke ghaton par qaza-e-hajat karna, raste ke beech mein, aur saaye mein qaza-e-hajat karna."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: No one of you should make water in his bath and then wash himself there (after urination). The version of Ahmad has: Then performs ablution there, for evil thoughts come from it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 27)
