hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne ghusl-khane mein paishab na kare, phir usi mein ghusl ya wudu kare, kyunke aksar waswase isi se aate hain." (Ahmad ki riwayat ke alfaz hain.)

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ prohibited one of us from rubbing his body or urinating in his bathing place every day.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein mana kiya ke koi rozana apne baal na kanghi kare ya apne ghusl-khane mein paishab na kare."

e: [AI] He went out as a pilgrim or a performer of Umrah, with people accompanying him, and he was leading them. One day, after he performed the morning prayer, he said, "Let one of you proceed and go to the restroom." Then he said, "Indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'When one of you wants to go to the restroom and the prayer has been established, they should start with the restroom.'"
hi: Woh Hajj ya Umrah ke liye nikle aur unke sath log thay aur woh unki imamat kar rahe thay. Aik din jab Fajr ki namaz shuru ki to farmaya: "Tum mein se koi aage badh jaye," aur khud qaza-e-hajat ke liye chale gaye. Phir farmaya: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Jab tum mein se koi qaza-e-hajat ke liye jana chahe aur namaz khadi ho jaye, to pehle qaza-e-hajat se shuru kare.'"

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "It is not permissible for a man who believes in Allah and the Last Day to pray while he is in a state of impurity until he relieves himself."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Allah aur aakhirat ke din par Eman rakhta hai, uske liye jaiz nahi ke woh (paishab ki) haajat rakhte hue namaz padhe, jab tak woh apni haajat halki na kar le."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say: "One should not pray in the presence of food, nor while he is defending the two things that invalidates the prayer."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Khana saamne rakha ho to namaz na padhi jaye, aur na hi (namaz padhi jaye) jab insaan (peshaab-paakhana ki) do buri cheezon se apne aap ko rokta ho."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to us, so we brought him water in a container made of animal skin. He performed ablution with it." "This is a authentic hadith according to the condition set by the two scholars (i.e., Bukhari and Muslim) and they did not narrate it themselves." "There is a corroborating witness from the narration of Aisha, according to their condition."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) hamare paas tashreef laaye, to humne unke liye peetal ke bartan mein paani nikaala, aap (SAW) ne isi se wudu kiya." (Yeh hadith Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar unhone ise nahi nikala.) Iska aik shahid Aisha (RA) ki hadith se bhi milta hai, dono ki shart par.

e: I and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to take bath with a brass vessel. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 98)
hi: "Main aur Rasulullah (SAW) tamre (peetal jaisi dhaat) ke bartan mein ghusl kiya karte thay."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent out an expedition. They were affected by cold. When they returned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he commanded them to wipe over turbans and stockings. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 146)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik dasta (chhota lashkar) bheja, unhein sardi lag gayi, jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas wapas aaye to aap (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh apni pagdiyon aur mozon (jurabon) par masah karein.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ablution (wudu') while wearing a Qatari turban (imamah), then he would put his hand under the turban and wipe the front part of his head without uncovering the turban. Although this hadith may not meet the criteria set by scholars, it contains an unusual phrase stating that he wiped a part of his head without wiping his turban. If this is correct, it indicates that he wiped a part of his head.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) wudu karte the jabke unpar Qitri pagdi hoti, to aap (SAW) apna haath pagdi ke neeche daal kar apne sar ke agle hisse ka masah karte aur pagdi nahi khonlte. (Yeh hadith agarche apni sanad ki roo se is kitaab ki shart par nahi hai, lekin ismein aik gharib (kam-yaab) lafz hai, ke aap (SAW) ne sar ke kisi hisse ka masah kiya aur apni pagdi par masah nahi kiya. Agar yeh sahih ho to sar ke kisi hisse ke masah par daleel hai.)

e: Jarir urinated. He then performed ablution and wiped over the socks. He said: What can prevent me from wiping (over the socks); I saw the Messenger of Allah (doing so). They (the people) said: This (action of yours) might be valid before the revelation of Surat al-Ma’idah. He replied: I embraced Islam after the revelation of Surat al-Ma’idah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 154)
hi: Jarir (RA) ne paishab kiya, phir wudu kiya aur mozon par masah kiya, aur farmaya: "Mujhe masah karne se kya rok sakta hai jabke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko masah karte dekha hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh to Surah Al-Ma'idah ke nazil hone se pehle ki baat thi." Unhone kaha: "Main to Surah Al-Ma'idah ke nazil hone ke baad hi Musalman hua tha."

e: [AI] Regarding the ablution of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , it was reported that he used to leave to attend to his needs, then he would come back with water, perform ablution, and wipe over his turban and shoes.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke wudu ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) apni zaroorat ke liye jate, phir main aap (SAW) ke paas paani laata, to aap (SAW) wudu karte aur apni pagdi aur mozon par masah karte."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given passage into English is:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed wiping over his leather socks. So, I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, you have forgotten!' He replied, 'No, you have forgotten what my Lord, the Exalted and Glorious, commanded me.' 'The two sheikhs' (referring to Bukhari and Muslim) have agreed to narrate the hadith of Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah regarding wiping, and they did not mention the phrase 'my Lord, the Exalted, commanded me.' Its chain of narration is authentic."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mozon par masah kiya, to maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap bhool gaye?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke tum bhool gaye, mujhe mere Rab Azza wa Jalla ne isi ka hukum diya hai." (Shaykhain ka Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) ki masah ke baare mein hadith ke tareeqon ko nikalne par ittifaq hai, magar unhone aap (SAW) ka yeh farmaan 'mujhe mere Rab ne isi ka hukum diya hai' nahi nikala, aur iski sanad sahih hai.) Sahih.

e: [AI] From Ubayy ibn Umayrah, who prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the direction of both qiblas, it is reported that he asked, "O Messenger of Allah, should I wipe over both socks?" He said, "Yes." He asked, "For a day?" He replied, "And two days." He asked, "And three?" He said, "Yes, as long as you wish." Ubayy ibn Umayrah was a well-known companion, and this is a reliable chain of narration that has not been attributed to any invalid narrator. Malik ibn Anas and others have reported it.
hi: Ubay bin Umarah (RA) se, jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath dono qiblon ki taraf namaz padhi thi, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main mozon par masah karoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Unhone poocha: "Aik din?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur do din." Unhone poocha: "Aur teen?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, jitna chaho." (Ubay bin Umarah (RA) aik jaana-mana sahabi hain, aur yeh Misr ki sanad hai jiske kisi bhi raawi par jarah (aitraaz) nahi ki gayi, aur Malik bin Anas ne bhi isi rai ko apnaya hai, magar dono ne ise nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wake up, he would perform ablution and brush his teeth."
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) paishab karte to wudu karte aur (sharamgaah par paani) chhidak lete."

e: [AI] I saw the Prophet ﷺ  sneezing and then he wiped his face.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha: "Aap (SAW) ne paishab kiya, phir apni sharamgaah par paani chhidka."

e: [AI] "Abdullah said, 'We used to not perform ablution from a designated place, nor did we remove hair or clothing.'"
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA ne kaha): "Hum kisi cheez par pair rakhne se wudu nahi karte the aur na hi apne baal ya kapde (dhone ki majboori se) rokte the."

e: “The angels do not enter a house in which there is an image or a person who is junub or a dog.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 1172)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Farishte us ghar mein dakhil nahi hote jismein koi tasveer ho, na kutta ho, aur na koi janabat wala shakhs ho."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said about a man who has sexual intercourse with a menstruating woman: He should give one or half dinar as sadaqah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2168)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, us shakhs ke baare mein jo apni haiz waali biwi ke paas jaye, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh aik dinar ya aadhe dinar ka sadaqah kare."

e: [AI] "If it causes bleeding, then the compensation is one dinar, and if it causes minor bleeding, then the compensation is half a dinar." "This hadith has been transmitted and documented, and we have established our foundation based on the saying that is attributed and connected to a trusted source."
hi: "Agar usne khoon (aane) ke waqt ussay milap kiya ho to aik dinar, aur agar khoon rukne ke baad kiya ho to aadha dinar." (Yeh hadith mursal bhi hai aur mauqoof bhi, aur hum apne us usool par qaim hain jo humne tay kiya hai ke agar mutasil sanad wala raawi thiqa ho to uski baat maani jayegi.)

e: 'Aishah said; The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) would ask us in the beginning of our menstruation to tie the waist-wrapper. Then he would embrace us. And who amongst you can have as much control over his desire as the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) had over his desire? (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 273)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humein humari haiz ke shuru mein hukum dete the ke hum tehband baandh lein, phir woh humse mubashirat (halki cheDh-chaad) karte. Tum mein se kaun apni khwahish par itna qaboo rakh sakta hai jitna Rasulullah (SAW) apni khwahish par qaboo rakhte thay?

e: Hamnah said my menstruation was great in quantity and severe. So I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for a decision and told him. I found him in the house of my sister, Zaynab, daughter of Jahsh. I said: Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who menstruates in great quantity and it is severe, so what do you think about it? It has prevented me from praying and fasting. He said: I suggest that you should use cotton, for it absorbs the blood. She replied: It is too copious for that. He said: Then take a cloth. She replied: It is too copious for that, for my blood keeps flowing. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I shall give you two commands; whichever of them you follow, that will be sufficient for you without the other, but you know best whether you are strong enough to follow both of them. He added: This is a stroke of the Devil, so observe your menses for six or seven days, Allah alone knows which it should be; then wash. And when you see that you are purified and quite clean, pray during twenty-three or twenty-four days and nights and fast, for that will be enough for you, and do so every month, just as women menstruate and are purified at the time of their menstruation and their purification. But if you are strong enough to delay the noon (Zuhr) prayer and advance the afternoon ('Asr) prayer, to wash, and then combine the noon and the afternoon prayer; to delay the sunset prayer and advance the night prayer, to wash, and then combine the two prayers, do so: and to wash at dawn, do so: and fast if you are able to do so if possible. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Of the two commands this is more to my liking.1 Abu Dawud said: 'Amr b. Thabit narrated from Ibn 'Aqil: Hamnah said: Of the two commands this is the one which is more to my liking.2 In this version these words were not quoted as the statement of the Prophet ﷺ; it gives it as a statement of Hamnah. Abu Dawud said: 'Amr b. Thabit was a Rafidi. This has been said by Yahya b. Ma'in. Abu Dawud said: I heard Ahmad (b. Hanbal) say: I am doubtful about the tradition transmitted by Ibn 'Aqil. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 287)
hi: Mujhe bohot zyada aur sakht istihadha (be-qaida khoon) hota tha, to main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein fatwa lene aur unhein bataane aayi, mujhe woh apni bahen Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) ke ghar mile. Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe bohot zyada aur sakht istihadha hota hai, iske baare mein aapki kya rai hai? Isne mujhe namaz aur roze se rok diya hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein rooi (kursuf) ka mashwara deta hoon, kyunke woh khoon ko sokh leti hai." Unhone kaha: "Yeh usse zyada hai, khoon to bahta hi rehta hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein do baatein bataunga, jo bhi tum karo, doosri ki tumhein zaroorat nahi rahegi, aur agar dono par amal kar sako to tum khud behtar jaanti ho." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Shaitan ki aik dhakel hai, isliye chhe ya saat din tak - Allah ke ilm ke mutabiq - apne aap ko haiz-waali samjho, phir ghusl karo, yahan tak ke jab tumhein lage ke tum paak ho chuki ho aur saaf ho gayi ho, to teis (23) raatein ya chaubees (24) raatein aur unke din namaz padho aur roze rakho, kyunke yeh tumhare liye kaafi hoga. Isi tarah har mahine karo jaise aurton ko haiz aata hai aur unki paakizgi ka waqt hota hai. Aur agar tum itni himmat rakhti ho ke Zuhr ko mo'akhkhar karo aur Asr ko jaldi padho, to ghusl karke Zuhr aur Asr ki namazein jama kar lo, aur Maghrib ko mo'akhkhar karo aur Isha ko jaldi padho, phir ghusl karke dono namazein jama kar lo, to aisa karo, aur agar tum sako to roze bhi rakho." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur yeh dono baaton mein se mujhe zyada pasand hai." (Shaykhain ka istihadha ki hadith Az-Zuhri aur Hisham bin Urwah ki, Aisha (RA) se, riwayat mein nikalne par ittifaq hai ke Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se poocha tha, magar ismein woh alfaz nahi hain jo Hamnah bint Jahsh (RA) ki hadith mein hain.) Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, this is not menstrual blood, rather it is only a vein, so perform ablution.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh haiz nahi hai, balke yeh (kisi) rag (ka khoon) hai, isliye ghusl kar lo."

e: [AI] Um Habibah experienced Istihadah for seven years while she was under the care of Abdul Rahman ibn Auf. The Prophet ﷺ  instructed her, saying, "When the menstrual bleeding starts, leave the prayer. And when it stops, perform ablution and pray." This narration is authentic according to the conditions of both Al-Bukhari and Muslim. It was not included by them, but it was included by Muslim in a different narration from Sufyan ibn `Uyaynah and Ibrahim ibn Sa`d, narrated from Az-Zuhri. Muhammad ibn `Amr ibn Alqamah Al-Awza`i also narrated this hadith from Az-Zuhri using the same wording, and it is considered authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, although he did not include it.
hi: Umm Habibah (RA) ko istihadha (be-qaida khoon) hota tha jabke woh Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA) ke nikah mein thin, yeh saat saal tak chala, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab haiz aaye to namaz chhod do, aur jab woh guzar jaye to ghusl karke namaz padho." (Amr bin Al-Harith aur Al-Awza'i ki hadith Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar unhone ise nahi nikala, sirf Muslim ne Sufyan bin Uyainah aur Ibrahim bin Sa'd ki, Az-Zuhri se, hadith nikali hai. Muhammad bin Amr bin Alqamah ne Al-Awza'i ki is riwayat ki, Az-Zuhri se, isi alfaz ke sath mutaba'at ki hai, aur yeh Muslim ki shart par sahih hai magar unhone ise nahi nikala.)

e: "If it is menstrual blood then it is blood that is black and recognizable, so stop praying, and if it is other than that then perform Wudu', for it is just a vein." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 215)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Jab haiz ka khoon ho, to woh kaala khoon hota hai jo pehchana jata hai, to jab aisa ho to namaz se ruk jao, aur jab doosra (khoon) ho to wudu karo aur namaz padho, kyunke yeh (sirf) aik rag hai."

e: [AI] I said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "Indeed, Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh is experiencing continuous bleeding from such and such time, and she is unable to perform the prayer." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Glory be to Allah! This is from Satan trying to prevent her from praying. When she sees a yellowish discharge above the water, let her perform one ablution for Dhuhr and Asr prayers, and another ablution for Maghrib and Isha prayers. And let her perform ghusl (ritual bath) for Fajr prayer, and in between, she should perform ablution."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se arz kiya: "Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh (RA) ko itne itne arse se istihadha ho raha hai aur woh namaz nahi padh rahi." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Subhan Allah, yeh Shaitan ki taraf se hai, use chahiye ke woh aik tashtari (bade bartan) mein baithe, phir agar woh paani ke upar zardi (peela rang) dekhe to Zuhr aur Asr ke liye aik ghusl kare, aur Maghrib aur Isha ke liye aik ghusl kare, aur Fajr ke liye ghusl kare, aur inke darmiyan wudu kare."

e: We never considered yellowish discharge as a thing of importance (as menses). (Using translation from Bukhārī 326)
hi: "Hum kudurat (miley-julay dhundhle rang) aur zardi ko (haiz mein se) kuch nahi samajhte the."

e: We would not take into consideration brown and yellow (fluid) after purification. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 307)
hi: Umm Atiyyah (RA) se, jinhone Nabi (SAW) se bai'at ki thi, unhone kaha: "Hum taharat ke baad kudurat aur zardi ko kuch nahi samajhte the."

e: [AI] "She does not have to make up for the postpartum prayer, as the Prophet ﷺ did not command her to pray for forty nights."
hi: "Unhein qaza nahi karni padti thi. Nabi (SAW) ki azwaaj mein se aik aurat nifas mein chaalees (40) raatein baithi rehti thi, Nabi (SAW) unhein nifas ki namaz ki qaza ka hukum nahi dete the."

e: [AI] Abu Asim Al-Nabil narrated to us, Uthman bin Saad Al-Qurashi narrated to us, Ibn Abi Mulaykah said: "My aunt Fatimah bint Abu Hubaysh came to Aisha and said: 'I fear that I will fall into the Fire for abandoning the voluntary prayers for a year or two, as I do not pray them.' Aisha said to her: 'Wait until the Prophet ﷺ  comes.' When he arrived, Aisha said: 'This is Fatimah, she says such and such.' The Prophet ﷺ  said to her: 'Tell her to leave the voluntary prayers each month for the days when they are read, then she should wash herself with a single wash every day, then she should perform the purification before every prayer, and she should clean herself and put on perfume. Verily, it is just a symptom, or a trick from Satan, or a severed muscle.'"
hi: Meri khala Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh (RA) Aisha (RA) ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Mujhe darr hai ke main aag mein na chali jaun, main saal ya do saal tak namaz chhod deti hoon, namaz nahi padhti." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Intezar karo yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) aa jayen." Aap (SAW) tashreef laaye to Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh Fatimah hain, aisa aisa keh rahi hain." Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Unse kaho ke har mahine apne haiz ke dinon mein namaz chhod dein, phir har din aik ghusl karein, phir har namaz ke waqt taharat (wudu) karein, aur khud ko saaf-suthra rakhein aur (rooi waghera) rok lein, kyunke yeh to bas aik bimari, koi zaahiri asar, ya Shaitan ki koi dhakel, ya kisi rag ka toot jaana hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Women must observe forty days of postnatal bleeding." "This is a confirmed Sunnah (practice) because this chain of narration, starting from Abu Bilal, is sound and authentic. However, Al-Hasan did not hear it directly from Uthman ibn Abi al-'As, but he has a similar chain of narration as testimony." This statement is attributed uniquely to Abu Bilal al-Ash'ari via Ibn Shihab. If it is sound in transmission from him, then it is an authentic hadith. However, Al-Hasan did not hear directly from Uthman ibn Abi al-'As, but he has a similar chain of narration as testimony.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Aurton ke liye unke nifas mein chaalees din muqarrar kiye gaye hain." (Yeh aik ahamm Sunnat hai; agar yeh sanad Abu Bilal se sahih ho jaye to yeh mursal (bina sahabi ke) hai lekin sahih hai, kyunke Al-Hasan ne Uthman bin Abi Al-Aas (RA) se nahi suna, aur iska aik aur shahid bhi isi tarah ki sanad se hai.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Women wait for forty nights. If they see purity before that, then they are pure. But if they exceed the forty nights, then they are in the state of istihada (abnormal bleeding). They should wash and pray, and if bleeding overwhelms them, they should perform ablution for each prayer." "Amr bin Al-Husayn and Muhammad bin Uthatha are not among the two Sheikhs (referring to Abu Bakr and Umar), and I only mentioned this Hadith as a witness marveling."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nifas waali aurat chaalees raatein intezar kare, agar isse pehle woh paak ho jaye to woh paak hai, aur agar chaalees se zyada ho jaye to woh mustahaada (istihadha waali) ki tarah hai, ghusl kare aur namaz padhe, aur agar khoon ghalib aa jaye to har namaz ke liye wudu kare." (Amr bin Al-Hasin aur Muhammad bin Ulathah Shaykhain ki shart par nahi hain, maine yeh hadith sirf ta'ajjub se shahid ke tor par zikr ki hai.)

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "When a woman experiences menstrual bleeding for seven days and then sees signs of purity, she should perform ghusl (ritual bath) and offer prayers." Muslim has cited the narration with the addition of Baqiyyah bin al-Walid, while as for Al-Aswad bin Tha'labah, he is a well-known person from Syria, and the hadith is considered strange in this context.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab nifas waali aurat ko saat (din) guzar jayen phir woh paaki dekhe, to woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe." Muslim ne Baqiyyah bin Al-Walid ko shahid ke tor par pesh kiya hai, aur rahi baat Al-Aswad bin Tha'labah ki, to woh Shaam ke jaana-mane (shakhs) hain, aur yeh hadith is baab mein gharib (kam-yaab) hai.

e: A few goats got collected with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: Abu Dharr, drive them to the wood. I drove them to Rabadhah (a place near Medina). I would have sexual defilement (during my stay there) and I would remain (in this condition) for five or six days. Then I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: O Abu Dharr. I kept silence. He then said: May your mother bereave you, Abu Dharr: woe be to your mother. He then called a black slave-girl for me. She brought a vessel which contained water. She then concealed me by drawing a curtain and I concealed myself behind a she-camel, and took a bath. I felt as if I had thrown away a mountain from me. He said: Clean earth is a means for ablution for a Muslim, even for ten years (he does not find water); but when you find water, you should make it touch your skin, for that is better. The version of Musaddad has: "the goats (were collected) from the alms," and the tradition reported by 'Amr is complete. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 332)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas bakriyan jama ho gayin, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Dharr, inhein le jao (charane)." Main Rabadhah ki taraf nikla, mujhe janabat ho jaati aur main paanch-chhe din tak isi haal mein rehta, phir main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aata. Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: main khamosh raha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teri maa tujhe royen, aye Abu Dharr, teri maa par afsos!" Aap (SAW) ne aik laundi bulwayi, woh aik bartan mein paani lekar aayi, usne mujhe kapde se aad kiya aur main sawari ke peechhe chhup gaya, phir maine ghusl kiya, jaise mujhe laga ke maine apne oopar se aik pahaad utaar diya ho. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paak mitti Musalman ke liye wudu ka zariya hai, chahe dus saal tak (paani na mile), aur jab tumhein paani mil jaye to use apni khaal se lagao, kyunke yeh behtar hai."

e:
[AI] By Allah, I had a dream last night, and by Allah, I have never seen such cold before. Has it ever passed by your faces like this?
They replied, "No." He washed his private parts and performed ablution for prayer. Then he prayed with them. When he reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "How did you find 'Amr and his companions?"
They praised him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, he prayed with us while he was in a state of major impurity." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for 'Amr and asked him, and he informed him about that and what he had experienced from the cold.
'Amr said, "O Messenger of Allah, Allah says (interpretation of the meaning): 'And do not kill yourselves.' [Quran 4:29] If I had taken a bath while I was still impure, he laughed to 'Amr. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
hi: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe kal raat ehtelaam hua, lekin Allah ki qasam maine aisi sardi kabhi nahi dekhi. Kya tumhare chehron par kabhi aisi (sardi) guzri hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." To unhone apne pasino wale hisson ko dhoya aur namaz ke liye apna wudu kiya, phir unhein namaz padhayi. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahunche to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne Amr aur unke sathiyon ko kaisa paaya?" To unhone unki tareef ki aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), unhone humein namaz padhayi jabke woh janabat mein thay." Rasulullah (SAW) ne Amr (RA) ki taraf paighaam bheja aur unse poocha, to unhone yeh baat aur sardi ka jo haal unhone dekha tha, bata diya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ne farmaya hai: 'Apni jaanon ko qatl na karo' (Surah An-Nisa 29), agar main ghusl karta to mar jata." To Rasulullah (SAW) Amr (RA) ki taraf muskuraye.

e: I had a sexual dream on a cold night in the battle of Dhat as-Salasil. I was afraid, if I washed I would die. I, therefore, performed tayammum and led my companions in the dawn prayer. They mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: Amr, you led your companions is prayer while you were sexually defiled? I informed him of the cause which impeded me from washing. And I said: I heard Allah say: "Do not kill yourself, verily Allah is merciful to you." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ laughed and did not say anything. Abu Dawud said: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Jubair is an Egyptian and a freed slave of Kharijah b. Hudhafah. He is not Jubair b. Nufair (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 334)
hi: Ghazwa Dhat-us-Salasil mein aik sard raat ko mujhe ehtelaam ho gaya, mujhe darr laga ke agar main ghusl karunga to halaak ho jaunga, to maine tayammum kiya, phir apne sathiyon ko Fajr ki namaz padhayi. Unhone yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Amr, tumne apne sathiyon ko namaz padhayi jabke tum junub thay?" Maine aap (SAW) ko woh baat bata di jisne mujhe ghusl karne se roka tha, aur maine kaha: "Maine suna hai ke Allah farmata hai: 'Apni jaanon ko qatl na karo, beshak Allah tumpar meharban hai' (Surah An-Nisa 29)." Rasulullah (SAW) muskuraye aur kuch nahi farmaya.

e: [AI] A man got injured during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . Then he experienced a wet dream, so he took a bath and died. This news reached the Prophet ﷺ , and he said, "They killed him, may Allah kill them. Wasn't the treatment for a sick eye to ask for a cure?" It has reached us that the Prophet ﷺ  was asked about this incident, and he said, "If he had washed his body and left his head where the injury was, it would have been sufficient." Al-Hakam ibn Ziyad narrated this, and he is considered reliable among the companions of Al-Awza'i. However, he did not mention hearing it from Ata.
hi: Aik shakhs ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein zakhm laga, phir usse ehtelaam ho gaya, to usne ghusl kiya aur mar gaya. Yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhone usse qatl kar diya, Allah unhein qatl kare! Kya na-samjh cheez ka ilaaj sawaal karna nahi tha?" Humein khabar mili ke Rasulullah (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaash usne apna (baaki) jism dho liya hota aur apna sar - jahan zakhm laga tha - chhod diya hota (aur uspar tayammum kar liya hota)." (Ise Al-Hiql bin Ziyad ne bhi riwayat kiya hai, jo Al-Awza'i ke sabse mo'tabar shagirdon mein se hain, aur unhone Al-Awza'i ka Ata se sunna zikr nahi kiya.)

e: [AI] A man was injured during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  and it caused him to have a state of impurity (janabah). He sought advice and was instructed to perform a ritual washing (ghusl), which he did. However, he died afterwards. When the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  was informed about this, he said, "They killed him, may Allah kill them. Wasn't the washing of the affected area sufficient for him?" Ata, a companion of the Prophet, reported that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  was asked about this incident later on and he replied, "If he had washed his body and left the area affected by the injury, it would have been sufficient for him."
hi: Aik shakhs ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein zakhm laga, phir usse janabat ho gayi, usne fatwa poocha to use ghusl ka hukum diya gaya, usne ghusl kiya aur mar gaya. Yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhone usse qatl kar diya, Allah unhein qatl kare! Kya na-samjh cheez ka ilaaj sawaal karna nahi tha?" Ata ne kaha: mujhe khabar mili ke Rasulullah (SAW) se baad mein iske baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaash usne apna (baaki) jism dho liya hota aur jahan zakhm laga tha use chhod diya hota, to yeh uske liye kaafi hota."

e: Two persons set out on a journey. Meanwhile the time of prayer came and they had no water. They performed tayammum with clean earth and prayed. Later on they found water within the time of the prayer. One of them repeated the prayer and ablution but the other did not repeat. Then they came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and related the matter to him. Addressing himself to the one who did not repeat, he said: You followed the sunnah (model behavior of the Prophet) and your (first) prayer was enough for you. He said to the one who performed ablution and repeated: For you there is the double reward. Abu Dawud said: Besides Ibn Nafi' this is transmitted by al-Laith from 'Umairah b. Abi Najiyyah from Bakr b. Sawadah on the authority of 'Ata b. Yasar from the Prophet ﷺ. Abu Dawud said: The mention of (the name of the Companion) Abu Sa'id in this tradition is not guarded. This is a mural tradition (i.e. the Successor 'Ata b. Yasar directly narrates it from the Prophet, leaving the name of the Companion in the chain.) (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 338)
hi: Do aadmi safar mein nikle, namaz ka waqt aa gaya aur unke paas paani na tha, to unhone paak mitti se tayammum kiya aur namaz padhi, phir usi waqt ke andar unhein paani mil gaya. Un mein se aik ne namaz aur wudu dobara kiya, aur doosre ne dobara nahi kiya. Phir dono Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaye aur yeh baat zikr ki. Aap (SAW) ne us shakhs se jisne dobara nahi kiya farmaya: "Tumne Sunnat ko paa liya, aur tumhari namaz tumhare liye kaafi hai." Aur us shakhs se jisne wudu karke dobara padhi, farmaya: "Tumhare liye dohra ajr hai."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , and Allah knows best, according to their condition and Ibn Nafi', a reliable person who focused on his lineage.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai, wallahu a'lam.

e: [AI] From the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, he said: "Tayammum consists of two strikes, one for the face and one for the hands up to the elbows." The two sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim) agreed on the hadith of Al-Hakam, on the authority of Tharr, on the authority of Sa'id ibn Abdur-Rahman ibn Abza, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Umar regarding Tayammum, and they did not mention it in this wording. And I do not know anyone who attributed it to Ubaidullah other than Ali ibn Zabyan, and he is truthful, and he was narrated by Yahya ibn Sa'id and Hisham ibn Basheer and others. And Malik ibn Anas attributed it to Nafi' in Al-Muwatta' in a different wording, except that my condition in the chain of narrators of the truthful hadith, when others narrate it, is different.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tayammum do zarab (haath maarna) hain: aik zarab chehre ke liye aur aik zarab dono haathon ke liye, kohniyon tak."

e: [AI] "We performed Tayammum with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . We struck the ground with our hands on the clean surface, then we shook off our hands and wiped our faces with them. Then we struck the ground again with our hands on the clean surface, and then shook off our hands and wiped our hands from the elbow to the fingertips, over the strands of hair, both apparent and hidden."
hi: "Humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tayammum kiya, humne apne haath paak mitti par maare, phir apne haath jhaad kar unse apne chehre ka masah kiya, phir humne dobara paak mitti par haath maare, phir apne haath jhaad kar kohni se hatheli tak, upar aur neeche ubhre baalon samet, masah kiya."

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , regarding Tayammum (dry ablution), it consists of two strikes: one strike on the face and another strike on the hands up to the elbows. Sulaiman ibn Abi Dawud did not mention this, but we mentioned it in Ash-Shawahid. We have also narrated the meaning of this hadith from Jabir ibn Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ , with a sound chain of narration.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tayammum do zarab hain: aik chehre ke liye aur aik dono haathon ke liye, kohniyon tak." (Sulaiman bin Abi Dawud ki bhi is riwayat ko dono ne nahi nikala, humne ise sirf shawahid mein zikr kiya hai. Humne is hadith ka matlab Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se, Nabi (SAW) se, sahih sanad ke sath bhi riwayat kiya hai.)

e: [AI] A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "I have been affected by seminal discharge and I have rubbed myself with dust." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do this." And he struck the ground with his hands, then wiped his face with them, then he struck the ground again with his hands and wiped his arms with them up to the elbows.
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur kaha: "Mujhe janabat ho gayi thi to maine mitti mein lot-pot kar liya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isi tarah karo," aur apne dono haathon se zameen par maara, phir apna chehra masah kiya, phir dobara apne haath maare aur unse kohniyon tak masah kiya. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Tayammum (dry ablution) consists of two strikes, one strike on the face and one strike on the hands up to the elbows."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tayammum do zarab hain: aik chehre ke liye aur aik dono haathon ke liye, kohniyon tak."

e: [AI] I saw the Prophet ﷺ performing dry ablution (tayammum) at a place called Mirbad al-Na'am while he was observing the houses of the city.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha: "Aap (SAW) ne aik jagah tayammum kiya jise Mirbad-un-Na'am kaha jata hai, jabke aap (SAW) Madinah ke ghar dekh rahe thay."

e: [AI] Ibn Umar performed Tayammum on a mound or two mounds of sand near Al-Madinah, then he prayed Asr, and he arrived while the sun was still high, and he did not repeat the prayer.
hi: "Ibn Umar (RA) ne Madinah se aik ya do meel ki doori par tayammum kiya, Asr ki namaz padhi, phir Madinah pahunche jabke suraj abhi buland tha, unhone namaz dobara nahi padhi."

e: [AI] "To me, 'When did you put on your shoes?' I said, 'On Friday.' He said, 'Did you take them off?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'You have followed the Sunnah.'"
hi: "Tumne apne mozey kab pehne the?" Maine kaha: "Jum'e ke din." Unhone poocha: "Kya tumne unhein utaara?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." To unhone farmaya: "Tumne Sunnat ko paa liya."

e: [AI] "Aukbatu (a person's name) and Ali were wearing light sandals unlike those thick ones, so Umar asked me, 'When did you adopt their dress?' I said, 'I wore them on Friday and today is Friday.' He said to me, 'You have followed the Sunnah.' The narration from Ubaidullah ibn Umar from Nafi from Ibn Umar is authentic, that he did not set a specific time for wiping over the two khuffs (socks or sandals), and this hadith has also been narrated from Anas ibn Malik from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with a valid chain of narrators except that it is an exception, just once."
hi: Uqbah (RA) [ne bayan kiya]: mujhpar in jaisi moti mozey (khuff) pehni hui thi, to Umar (RA) ne mujhse poocha: "Tumne inhein kab pehna?" Maine kaha: "Maine inhein Jum'e ke din pehna tha, aur aaj Jum'e ka din hai." Unhone mujhse farmaya: "Tumne Sunnat ko paa liya." Aur Ubaidullah bin Umar ki, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar (RA) se, sahih riwayat hai ke woh mozon par masah ke liye koi waqt muqarrar nahi karte the. Yeh hadith Anas bin Malik (RA) se, Rasulullah (SAW) se, sahih sanad ke sath bhi riwayat hui hai, jiske tamam raawi aakhir tak thiqa hain, magar yeh (riwayat) bilkul shaaz (ajeeb) hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'When one of you performs ablution and puts on his socks, he should pray in them and wipe over them, and he should not take them off unless he is in a state of major ritual impurity.' This is a Sahih (authentic) narration according to the criteria of Muslim and Abdul-Ghaffar ibn Dawud is a trustworthy narrator, except he is not accepted by the people of Basrah due to Hammad's contradictory narration."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi wudu kare aur apne mozey pehne, to unhi mein namaz padhe aur unpar masah kare, phir unhein na utaare agar chahe, siwaye janabat ke." (Yeh sanad Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, aur Abdul Ghaffar bin Dawud thiqa hain, sirf itna hai ke Basra walon ke paas yeh riwayat Hammad se nahi hai.)

e: [AI] "Why is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ standing since the revelation of the criterion has been sent to him?"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) khade hokar (namaz padhte) rahe jabse unpar Al-Furqan (Quran) nazil hua, unhein kya hua?"

e: [AI] It means: "The Prophet ﷺ  entered while he was walking with a wound on his thigh."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne apne ghutne ke peechhe (mafsal) ke zakhm ki wajah se khade hokar paishab kiya.

e: "1 saw the Prophet rinse his mouth and sniff water in his nose using one hand, he did that thrice," (Using translation from Tirmidhī 28)
hi: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, aap (SAW) ne aik hi chullu se kulli ki aur naak mein paani chadhaya, aisa aap (SAW) ne teen martaba kiya."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you perform Wudu', do so properly, and wash in between the fingers (Al-Asabi')."[2] [1] Al-Asabi' is plural meaning fingers as well as toes, and the author mentioned only one narration on the topic whereas some of them clarify "of the hands and feet." So he mentioned the general wording amids chapters how to wash the feet. [2] Part of this narration preceded under No. 87. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 114)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum wudu karo to ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you perform ablution, interlace your fingers and toes." "This narration is credited to Salih. I assume he is among the freed slaves of At-Taw'amah. If so, this is not a condition of this book, and I have only mentioned it as a supporting evidence."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum wudu karo to apne haathon aur paon ki ungliyon ke darmiyan khilal karo." (Yeh Salih hain, mera khayal hai woh Taw'amah ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam hain, agar aisa hai to yeh is kitaab ki shart par nahi hain, maine ise sirf shahid ke tor par nikala hai.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to visit the houses of a certain group of the Ansar (Helpers), while ignoring others. This bothered them, so they said, "O Messenger of Allah, you visit the house of so-and-so but not our house." The Prophet ﷺ  responded, "There is a dog in your house." They replied, "But there is a lamp in their house." The Prophet ﷺ  then said, "The lamb has seven tails."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Ansar ke aik qabile ke ghar aate the, aur unke qareeb ke doosre ghar chhod dete the, unhein wahan nahi aate. Yeh unhein giraan (mushkil) laga, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap fulan ke ghar aate hain aur humare ghar nahi aate?" Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare ghar mein kutta hai." Unhone kaha: "Unke ghar mein to billi hai." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Billi (bhi) aik darinda hai."

e: [AI] Abu Hatem said, "He is not strong."
hi: Abu Hatim ne kaha: "Yeh (raawi) mazboot nahi hai."

e: [AI] We were with Salman al-Farsi on a journey, and he fulfilled his needs. So we said to him, "Perform ablution so that we may ask you about a verse from the Quran." He said, "Ask me, for I did not lose it." Then he recited to us what we desired, and there was no water between us and him.
hi: Hum Salman Al-Farisi (RA) ke sath safar mein thay, unhone qaza-e-hajat ki, to humne unse kaha: "Wudu kijiye taake hum aapse Quran ki aik ayat ke baare mein poochein." Unhone kaha: "Mujhse poocho, main to isse chhoo nahi raha," phir unhone humein woh sunaya jo hum chahte the, halanke humare aur unke darmiyan koi paani na tha.

e: [AI] Regarding Salman, he mentioned him in a similar manner.
hi: Salman (RA) se, unhone isi jaisi baat zikr ki.

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Most of the torment of the grave is because of ˹carelessness with˺ urine."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qabar ka aksar azab paishab (ki be-ehtiyaati) ki wajah se hota hai."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas reported that he raised it to the Prophet ﷺ, who said, "The majority of the punishment in the grave is due to urine."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, unhone ise Nabi (SAW) tak marfoo' kiya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qabar ka aam azab paishab ki wajah se hota hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If any of you makes a mistake in his prayer, let him rub his nose and then continue." This was followed by Umar ibn Ali al-Muqaddami and Muhammad ibn Bishr al-Abdi and others from Hisham ibn Uruwah, "And it is authentic according to their conditions, and they did not exclude it." According to their conditions.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ki namaz mein hadath (wudu toot jaye) ho jaye, to woh apni naak pakde aur (namaz se) chala jaye." Is par Umar bin Ali Al-Muqaddami, Muhammad bin Bishr Al-Abdi aur doosron ne Hisham bin Urwah se mutaba'at ki hai. Yeh dono ki shart par sahih hai magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "If anyone of you sneezes during prayer, he should cover his nose and leave the prayer to perform ablution." I heard Ali ibn Umar Ad-Dar Qutni Al-Hafiz saying, "I heard Abu Bakr Ash-Shafi'i As-Sairafi saying, 'Whoever issues a fatwa (religious ruling) from the Imams of the Muslims regarding matters of tricks and deception, he has taken it from this hadith.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ki namaz mein hadath ho jaye, to woh apni naak pakde, chala jaye aur wudu kare." Maine Ali bin Umar Ad-Daraqutni Al-Hafiz ko kehte hue suna, unhone Abu Bakr Ash-Shafi'i As-Sairafi ko kehte hue suna: "Musalman a'imma mein se jitno ne bhi tadbeer-ul-hiyal (chaal-baazi ke tareeqon) ka fatwa diya, unhone yeh isi hadith se liya hai."

e: [AI] I and Amr ibn Al-Aas set off, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to us holding a utensil or something similar to it in his hand, and he covered himself with it. He urinated while sitting. So I said to my companion, "Don't you see how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  urinates like a woman?" He came to us and said, "Do you not know what happened to the companion of the children of Israel? Whenever he was afflicted with something from urine, he would perform istinja' (cleaning the private parts with water after urination) with a clump of soil." He said, "So he was forbidden from doing that, and he was punished in his grave."
hi: Main aur Amr bin Al-'As (RA) chal rahe thay, ke Rasulullah (SAW) hamare paas nikle, aap (SAW) ke haath mein dhaal ya dhaal jaisi koi cheez thi, aap (SAW) ne usse aad kiya aur baithe hue paishab kiya. Maine apne saathi se kaha: "Kya tum Rasulullah (SAW) ko nahi dekh rahe, kaise paishab kar rahe hain jaise aurat paishab karti hai?" Aap (SAW) hamare paas aaye aur farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata nahi Bani Israel ke us shakhs ko kya pesh aaya tha, jab kisi ko paishab ka koi chheeta lag jata to woh kainchi se woh jagah kaat deta." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unhein isse mana kiya gaya, aur woh apni qabar mein azab diya gaya."

e: [AI] "When the Prophet ﷺ needed to relieve himself while he was covered with a garment, they asked him, 'Do you urinate like women do?' The Prophet ﷺ replied, 'Indeed, the Bani Israel (Children of Israel) used to suffer from urinary ailments, so they would cauterize themselves with metal objects. Allah forbade them from doing so, and as a punishment, they would be tormented in their graves.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik chadar (juhfah) ki aad lekar paishab kiya, to unhone kaha: "Kya aap aurat ki tarah paishab karte hain?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Bani Israel mein jab kisi ko paishab ka koi chheeta lagta to woh use kainchi se kaat deta, aur unhein isse mana kiya gaya, to woh apni qabar mein azab diya jata hai."

e: [AI] She said, "What is wrong with the Messenger of Allah standing firm upon receiving the criterion" according to their condition.
hi: Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) khade hokar (paishab karte) kyun rahe jabse unpar Al-Furqan (Quran) nazil hua?"

e: [AI] I heard Aisha swear by Allah that no one has seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  urinating while standing since the revelation of the Quran.
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) ko Allah ki qasam khakar kehte hue suna ke: "Kisi ne bhi Rasulullah (SAW) ko khade hokar paishab karte nahi dekha jabse unpar Al-Furqan nazil hua."

e: "The Messenger of Allah saw me urinating while standing, and he said: 'O 'Umar, do not urinate standing up.' So I never urinated whilst standing after that." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 308)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe khade hokar paishab karte dekha to farmaya: "Aye Umar, khade hokar paishab na karo." Unhone kaha: "Iske baad main kabhi khade hokar paishab nahi kiya." Aur Abu Hurairah (RA) se bhi, Nabi (SAW) se, isse mana karne ke baare mein riwayat hui hai.

e: "None of you should urinate in the place where he bathes, for most Waswas (devilish whispers) [1] come from that." [1] I.e., with regard to whether the urine has soiled his body or not. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 36)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne ghusl-khane mein paishab na kare, kyunke aksar waswase isi se aate hain."

e: [AI] "To fulfill the condition of them being immersed in the bath."
hi: ...ke ghusl-khane mein paishab kiya jaye.

e: The Prophet (sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam ) as saying : Be on your guard against two things which provoke cursing. They (the hearers) said : Prophet of Allaah ( sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam), what are these things which provoke cursing: easing in the watering places and on the thoroughfares, and in the shade (of the tree)(where they take shelter and rest). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 25)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do la'nat-yafta kaamon se bacho." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Woh do la'nat-yafta kaam kya hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Musalmanon ke raste mein aur unke saaye (aaram karne ki jagah) mein qaza-e-hajat kare."

e: [AI] "A man said to Abu Hurairah, 'You have given us fatwas regarding everything, to the point that you are about to give us a fatwa about excrement.' Abu Hurairah said, 'I have heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) saying, "Whoever releases his anger on a pathway frequented by the Muslims, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people."' Muhammad ibn Amr al-Ansari is among those whose narrations are commonly accepted among the people of Basrah, and he is highly esteemed in his narrations."
hi: Aik shakhs ne Abu Hurairah (RA) se kaha: "Aapne humein har cheez ka fatwa diya hai, yahan tak ke ab aap humein paakhane (istinja) ka bhi fatwa denge." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine har cheez Rasulullah (SAW) se suni hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo Musalmanon ke aam raste par apni ghandagi (napaaki/qaza-e-hajat) nikale, uspar Allah, farishton aur tamam logon ki la'nat ho.'" (Muhammad bin Amr Al-Ansari un logon mein se hain jinki hadith Basra walon mein jama ki jaati hai, aur woh hadith mein bohot kam-yaab hain.)

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "No one of you should urinate in a hole." according to their condition.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi bill (chhed) mein paishab na kare."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "None of you should urinate in burrows." Qatadah also said, "Indeed, these are the dwellings of the jinn, and I do not deny the statement that they are the dwellings of the jinn because this is from the saying of Qatadah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi bill mein paishab na kare." Qatadah ne kaha: "Yeh jinnaat ke rehne ki jagah hain." (Main is baat ka qat'ai faisla nahi karta ke yeh jinnaat ka thikana hai, kyunke yeh Qatadah ka apna qaul hai.)

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "Verily, these toilets are inhabited by jinns. So, when any one of you enters the toilet, let him say: 'I seek refuge with Allah from impure male and female jinns.'" A Muslim presented a narration by Qatadah from Anas bin Malik from Zaid bin Arqam, and Al-Bukhari presented a narration by 'Amr bin Marzuq. This hadith is disputed by Qatadah, Sa'id bin Abi 'Arubah, and Qasim bin 'Awf Al-Shaybani from Zaid bin Arqam. Both of these meaning this hadith are in accordance with the condition of being authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak yeh paakhane (jagah) haazir rehte hain (jinnaat ke), isliye jab tum mein se koi qaza-e-hajat ki jagah dakhil ho to kahe: 'A'oozu billahi minar-rijsin-najisish-shaitanir-rajeem' (Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon napaak, murdaar, dhutkare hue Shaitan se)." (Muslim ne Qatadah ki, An-Nadr bin Anas se, unhone Zaid bin Arqam (RA) se, hadith se hujjat pakdi hai, aur Bukhari ne Amr bin Marzuq se hujjat pakdi hai. Yeh hadith Qatadah par mukhtalif riwayat hui hai, Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah ne ise Qatadah se, unhone Al-Qasim bin Awf Ash-Shaybani se, unhone Zaid bin Arqam (RA) se riwayat kiya hai.) Sahih.

e:
[AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Verily, these bushes are inhabited by deadly creatures. So, when any one of you enters it, let him say, 'I seek refuge in Allah from the filth and evil spirits.'"

Neither of these two chains of narration fulfill the condition of authenticity, and they did not exclude it from this wording. They only agreed upon the hadeeth of 'Abdul-Azeez ibn Suhayb from Anas, mentioning seeking refuge [with Allah] exclusively."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak yeh paakhane haazir rehte hain, isliye jab tum mein se koi ismein dakhil ho to kahe: 'A'oozu bika minal khubthi wal-khaba'ith' (Main teri panah maangta hoon napaki aur napaak (jinnaat) se)." (Dono asaneed Sahih ki shart par hain, magar dono ne ise is lafz ke sath nahi nikala, sirf Abdul Aziz bin Suhaib ki, Anas (RA) se, hadith par ittifaq kiya hai jismein sirf panah maangne ka zikr hai.)

e: When the Prophet entered the toilet, he would take off his ring. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 303)
hi: Nabi (SAW) "jab qaza-e-hajat ki jagah jate to apni ungoothi utaar dete."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to wear a ring with the inscription "Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah" and whenever he entered the bathroom, he would remove it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik ungoothi pehni hui thi jispar "Muhammadur Rasoolullah" khuda hua tha, aap (SAW) jab qaza-e-hajat ki jagah jate to usse utaar dete.

e: [AI] When this verse was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a messenger to Uwaim bin Sa'ida and said, "What is this purification that Allah has praised you for?" They replied, "O Prophet of Allah, no man or woman among us goes to defecate except that they wash their backsides or, instead, they wash their sitting areas." So the Prophet ﷺ  said, "This (cleanliness) applies to this (situation)."
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Uwaim bin Sa'idah (RA) ki taraf paighaam bheja aur poocha: "Yeh kaunsi taharat hai jiski Allah ne tumhari tareef ki hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, hum mein se koi mard ya aurat qaza-e-hajat se nahi nikalta magar apni pichhli sharamgaah - ya farmaya: apni nashist ki jagah - dhota hai." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "To bas yehi (woh cheez) hai."

e: [AI] They said, "O Messenger of Allah, who are these people [in whom there are men who love to purify themselves and Allah loves those who purify themselves]?" He said, "They are the ones who perform istinja' (cleansing after using the bathroom) with water and they do not sleep throughout the night." This is the last information that reached us from the Book of Purification according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, unless they have omitted it.
hi: Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh log kaun hain jinke baare mein farmaya gaya: 'Ismein aise log hain jo paak rehna pasand karte hain, aur Allah paak rehne walon ko pasand karta hai' (Surah At-Tawbah 108)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh paani se istinja karte the, aur woh poori raat nahi sote the." (Yeh 'Kitab-ut-Taharat' se humein pahunchi hui aakhri riwayat hai, Shaykhain ki shart par, jinhein unhone nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "Which action is the best?" He said, "Praying at the beginning of its prescribed time." I asked, "Then which action?" He said, "Jihad in the cause of Allah." I asked, "Then which action?" He said, "Being dutiful to one's parents."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz apne pehle waqt mein padhna." Maine poocha: "Phir kaunsa?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein jihad." Maine poocha: "Phir kaunsa?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Waalidain ke sath achha sulook."

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  which action is best? He said, "Prayer at its proper time." This statement has been confirmed by trustworthy narrators Bundar ibn Bashar and Al-Hasan ibn Mukram, who reported it from Uthman ibn Umar. It is considered authentic according to the conditions of the two esteemed scholars, and they did not exclude it. There are also supporting evidences regarding this matter.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz apne pehle waqt mein padhna." (Yeh alfaz do thiqa raawiyon Bundar bin Bashshar aur Al-Hasan bin Mukram ki, Uthman bin Umar se riwayat karne mein ittifaq se sahih hain, aur yeh Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai magar unhone ise nahi nikala, aur is baab mein iske aur bhi shawahid hain.)

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "Which actions are the best?" He said, "Praying in its earliest time." I asked, "Then what?" He said, "Striving in the cause of Allah." I asked, "Then what?" He said, "Showing kindness and obedience to parents, even if they are unjust towards me." "This hadith has been narrated by a group from Shu'bah, but this wording is not mentioned except by Hujaj bin Al-Sha'ir from Ali bin Hafs and Hujaj is a trustworthy preserver. Muslim relied on Ali bin Hafs Al-Madaini in his argument."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Kaunse amal sabse afzal hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz apne pehle waqt mein padhna." Maine poocha: "Phir kya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein jihad." Maine poocha: "Phir kya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Waalidain ke sath achha sulook, aur agar main aur mangta to aap (SAW) mujhe aur (bhi) bataate." (Yeh hadith aik jama'at ne Shu'bah se riwayat ki hai, magar yeh alfaz Hajjaj bin Ash-Sha'ir ke ilawa kisi ne, Ali bin Hafs se, zikr nahi kiye, aur Hajjaj hafiz aur thiqa hain, aur Muslim ne Ali bin Hafs Al-Madaini se hujjat pakdi hai.)

e: [AI] From a man of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked, "Which action is best?" He replied, "Offering prayers at its appointed time." The man was Abdullah ibn Mas'ud according to the consensus of the narrators on the authority of Abu Amr Ash-Shaybani.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik shakhs se riwayat hai, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz apne pehle waqt mein padhna." (Yeh shakhs Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) hain, is par raawiyon ka Abu Amr Ash-Shaybani ki riwayat mein ittifaq hai.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of deeds is praying in its appointed time." "Yaqoob ibn al-Walid is an elder from the people of Madinah who resides in Baghdad and is not a condition of this book, except that he is a witness for Ubaidullah." Yaqoob is a liar, meaning Yaqoob ibn al-Walid.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen amal namaz ko uske pehle waqt mein padhna hai." (Ya'qub bin Al-Walid Madinah ke aik buzurg hain jo Baghdad mein rehte the, yeh is kitaab ki shart par nahi hain, sirf Ubaidullah ke liye shahid ke tor par hain.) (Ya'qub jhoote hain, ya'ni Ya'qub bin Al-Walid.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked, "Which action is the best?" He replied, "Offering the prayer at its earliest time."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz apne pehle waqt mein padhna."

e: [AI] "From his grandmother, the world."
hi: ...apni naani (Ad-Dunya) se.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , I heard Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad ibn Ya'qub saying: I heard Al-Abbas ibn Muhammad Ad-Duri saying, I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in saying: Abdullah ibn Umar narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Ghannam but his brother Ubaidullah ibn Umar did not narrate from him.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Maine Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad bin Ya'qub ko kehte hue suna, unhone Al-Abbas bin Muhammad Ad-Dawri ko kehte hue suna, unhone Yahya bin Ma'in ko kehte hue suna: Abdullah bin Umar ne Al-Qasim bin Ghannam se riwayat ki hai, magar unke bhai Ubaidullah bin Umar ne unse riwayat nahi ki.

e: "Messenger of Allah did not pray any Salat at the end of its time two times, until Allah took him." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 174)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne kabhi bhi koi namaz uske aakhri waqt mein (do martaba) nahi padhi, yahan tak ke Allah ne unhein wafat de di."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not pray the prayer at its final time twice until Allah took him. And he has another witness from the Hadith of Al-Waqidi, and it is not a condition of this book."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne kabhi bhi koi namaz uske aakhri waqt mein do martaba nahi padhi, yahan tak ke Allah ne unhein wafat de di." Iska aik aur shahid Al-Waqidi ki hadith se bhi milta hai, magar woh is kitaab ki shart par nahi hai.

e: [AI] "I have never seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delay a prayer until its last time, until Allah took him (in death)."
hi: "Maine kabhi Rasulullah (SAW) ko koi namaz aakhri waqt tak mo'akhkhar karte nahi dekha, yahan tak ke Allah ne unhein wafat de di."

e: [AI] "People think that you have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  doing such things. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "My Ummah will always be on the right path as long as they do not delay Maghrib prayer until the stars start to appear.""
hi: ...ke log yeh na samjhein ke tumne Rasulullah (SAW) ko aisa karte dekha hai. Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Meri Ummat hamesha khair par - ya fitrat par - rahegi jab tak woh Maghrib ko itna mo'akhkhar na karein ke sitare aapas mein ulajh jayen (numaayan ho jayen)."

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "The matter of my Ummah will remain upon the Fitrah (natural disposition) as long as they do not delay the Maghrib prayer until the stars appear."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat ka maamla fitrat par rahega jab tak woh Maghrib ko itna mo'akhkhar na karein ke sitare aapas mein ulajh jayen."

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: There are two ˹types˺ of Fajr (dawn) ˹times˺: a Fajr in which food is forbidden while prayer becomes permissible, and a Fajr in which prayer is forbidden while food becomes permissible.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fajr do tarah ki hai: aik fajr jismein khana haram ho jata hai aur namaz halal ho jaati hai, aur aik fajr jismein namaz haram hoti hai aur khana halal hota hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: There are two types of dawn. As for the dawn that appears like the tail of a wolf, prayer is not permissible at that time but eating is permissible. However, as for the dawn that spreads horizontally in the sky, prayer is permissible and eating is not permissible.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Fajr do tarah ki hai: jo fajr bheriye ki dum jaisi (upar ko uthi hui, lambwat) hoti hai, usmein namaz halal nahi hoti aur na hi khana haram hota hai; aur jo fajr ufaq mein phailti hui (chaudi) hoti hai, woh namaz ko halal karti hai aur khane ko haram karti hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Shall I not guide you to what Allah wipes away sins with and increases in good deeds?" They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Performing ablution more than is required, even in disliked situations, and staying in place after prayer until the next prayer. None among you leaves his house to perform prayer with the Imam and then sits waiting for the next prayer, except that the angels say, 'O Allah, forgive him, O Allah, have mercy on him.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein na bataun woh cheez jiske zariye Allah gunahon ko mita deta hai aur nekiyan badha deta hai?" Sahaba (RA) ne kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mushkil (sardi waghera) mein bhi mukammal wudu karna, aur aik namaz ke baad doosri namaz ka intezar karna. Tum mein se koi shakhs apne ghar se nikal kar imam ke sath namaz padhta hai, phir baithkar doosri namaz ka intezar karta hai, to farishte kehte rehte hain: 'Aye Allah, isse maaf kar de, aye Allah, ispar reham kar.'"

e: [AI] We were sitting with Ali in the Great Mosque, and it was a special occasion in Al-Kufa that day. The Muadhin came to him and said, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, it is time for Asr prayer." Ali replied, "Sit down." So he sat down, then the Muadhin came again and said the same thing. Ali said, "This dog teaches us about the Sunnah." So Ali stood up and led us in performing the Asr prayer. After we finished, we returned to the place where we were sitting, and we prostrated on our knees, observing the setting sun until we could no longer see it.
hi: Hum Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke sath Masjid-e-Azam mein baithe hue thay, aur us waqt Kufa mein makanaat khaas (kachche/mamooli) the, to unke paas mu'adhdhin aaya aur kaha: "Ameer-ul-Momineen, Asr ki namaz (ka waqt ho gaya)." Unhone farmaya: "Baith jao." Woh baith gaya, phir dobara aaya aur wahi baat kahi. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne farmaya: "Yeh kutta humein Sunnat sikhata hai." Phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) khade huay aur humein Asr ki namaz padhayi, phir hum wapas laut kar usi jagah aa gaye jahan hum baithe huay thay, aur hum ghutnon ke bal baith gaye, aur suraj doobne ke liye jhukne laga, hum use dekh rahe the.

e: [AI] "We used to pray Asr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , then we would slaughter the animals, divide them into ten portions, cook them, and eat the cooked meat before the sun sets." Both Bukhari and Muslim agreed upon narrating the hadith of Al-Awza'i from Abu Al-Najashi from Rafi' ibn Khadeej, who said, "We used to pray Maghrib with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , then we would leave, and one of us would mark the places of his arrows, and he had two valid witnesses regarding expediting the prayer, but they did not testify." The first witness among them is
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Asr ki namaz padhte, phir unt zibah karte aur dus hisson mein taqseem karte, phir pakate aur suraj doobne se pehle pakka gosht kha lete." Bukhari aur Muslim ka Al-Awza'i ki, Abu An-Najashi se, Rafi' bin Khadeej (RA) se, hadith nikalne par ittifaq hai, unhone kaha: hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Maghrib padhte, phir chale jate aur hum mein se koi apne teer girne ki jagah dekh leta. Iske do sahih shawahid namaz jaldi padhne ke baare mein hain jo dono ne nahi nikale, pehla shahid unme se yeh hai.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, that he used to pray Asr when the sun is high and bright, then the man walks until he moves away from it towards Dhul-Hulayfah, which is six miles before the sunset. They both agreed upon the narration of Bashir ibn Abu Mas'ud in the last narration of Az-Zuhri from Urwah, with a different wording. As for the second witness...
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap (SAW) "Asr ki namaz us waqt padhte jab suraj safed aur buland hota, phir aadmi chalta yahan tak ke Dhul-Hulaifah tak pahunch jata, jo chhe meel ki doori par hai, suraj doobne se pehle." (Dono ka Bashir bin Abi Mas'ud ki hadith par, Az-Zuhri ki, Urwah se, aakhri riwayat mein, doosre alfaz ke sath, ittifaq hai. Rahi baat doosre shahid ki...)

e: [AI] "Or did the prophet Gabriel ﷺ  come to the Prophet ﷺ  twice at the house, so he prayed the noon prayer when the sun had declined and it was the length of a sandal strap, then he prayed the afternoon prayer when the shadow of everything was in proportion to it, then he prayed the sunset prayer when the fasting person broke their fast, then he prayed the night prayer when the twilight disappeared, then he prayed the dawn prayer when eating and drinking became prohibited for the one fasting, then he prayed the noon prayer the next day when the shadow of everything was in proportion to it, like the time of the afternoon prayer the previous day, then he prayed the afternoon prayer when the shadow of everything was equal to it, then he prayed the sunset prayer when the fasting person broke their fast, then he prayed the night prayer for one-third of the first part of the night, then he prayed the dawn prayer when it became light, then he said, 'O Muhammad, this is the time of the prophets before you, and the time between these two times.' As for the statement of Abdul Aziz ibn Muhammad..."
hi: Jibra'il (AS) ne Nabi (SAW) ki Baitullah ke paas do martaba imamat ki, unhone unhein Zuhr padhayi jab suraj dhal gaya aur (saaya) tasme jitna tha, phir unhein Asr padhayi jab har cheez ka saaya uske barabar ho gaya, aur unhein Maghrib padhayi jab roze-daar ne roza khola, phir unhein Isha padhayi jab shafaq (surkhi) ghayab ho gayi, phir unhein Fajr padhayi jab roze-daar par khana-peena haram ho gaya. Phir agle din unhein Zuhr padhayi jab har cheez ka saaya uske barabar ho gaya, jaisa pichle din Asr ka waqt tha, phir unhein Asr padhayi jab har cheez ka saaya uske do guna ho gaya, phir unhein Maghrib padhayi jab roze-daar ne roza khola (usi waqt), phir unhein Isha padhayi raat ke pehle tihaai mein, phir unhein Fajr padhayi jab roshni phail gayi. Phir farmaya: "Aye Muhammad, yeh tumse pehle Ambiya (AS) ka waqt hai, aur (asal) waqt inhi do waqton ke darmiyan hai." Rahi baat Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad ki hadith ki...

e: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted in a similar manner by Ibn 'Abbas from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1491)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet peace be upon him was asked about the timing of prayers, so he advanced and postponed and said, "There is a time between them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se namaz ke auqaat ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne (waqt) pehle bhi liya aur baad mein bhi, aur farmaya: "Un dono ke darmiyan (asal) waqt hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ told them that Jibril came to him and prayed with him in two timings, except Maghrib. He said, 'He came to me and prayed with me when the sun had set, then he came to me the next day and prayed with me when the sun had set, he did not change it.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein bataya ke Jibra'il (AS) unke paas aaye aur do waqton mein namaz padhayi, siwaye Maghrib ke. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh mere paas aaye aur suraj doobte hi mujhe namaz padhayi, phir agle din mere paas aaye aur suraj doobte hi mujhe namaz padhayi, waqt nahi badla."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "This is Jibril (Gabriel), teaching you your religion." Then he mentioned the times of prayer, and he mentioned that he prayed Maghrib when the sun set. Then, when it came to him on the next day, he prayed Maghrib when the sun set at the same time, as a condition for Muslims.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Jibra'il (AS) hain, tumhein tumhara deen sikha rahe hain," phir namaz ke auqaat ka zikr kiya, phir zikr kiya ke unhone Maghrib suraj doobte hi padhi, phir jab agle din aaye to Maghrib usi ek waqt par padhi.

e: [AI] "I know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to perform the last evening prayer when the moon sets by three moments. Raqaba bin Masqala narrated from Abu Bishr, and Raqaba and Hushaym agreed on narrating this hadith from Abu Bishr through Habib bin Salim, and their chain of narration is authentic. However, Shu'ba and Abu Awanah disagreed with them and said that it was narrated from Abu Bishr through Bishr bin Thabit and then through Habib bin Salim, and this chain of narration is also authentic."
hi: "Main logon mein sabse zyada is namaz - Isha ki aakhri namaz - ke waqt ko jaanta hoon. Rasulullah (SAW) ise chand ke doobne ke waqt padhte, teesri raat ke liye." Raqabah bin Masqalah ne Abu Bishr se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai. Isi tarah Raqabah aur Husheim dono ka is hadith ko Abu Bishr se, Habib bin Salim se, riwayat karne par ittifaq hai, aur yeh sanad sahih hai. Shu'bah aur Abu Awanah ne inse ikhtilaf kiya hai, unhone Abu Bishr se, Bishr bin Thabit se, Habib bin Salim se, riwayat ki hai, aur iski sanad bhi sahih hai.

e: I am the one who is best informed of the time of this prayer, i.e. the night prayer. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to offer it at the hour when the moon went down on its third night. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 419)
hi: "Main logon mein sabse zyada is Isha ki aakhri namaz ke waqt ko jaanta hoon. Rasulullah (SAW) ise chand ke doobne ke waqt padhte, teesri ya chauthi raat ke liye." (Shu'bah ko shak hai.)

e: I am the one who is best informed of the time of this prayer, i.e. the night prayer. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to offer it at the hour when the moon went down on its third night. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 419)
hi: "Main logon mein sabse zyada is namaz - Isha ki aakhri namaz - ke waqt ko jaanta hoon. Rasulullah (SAW) ise chand ke doobne ke waqt padhte, teesri raat ke liye."

e: I would offer my noon prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and took a handful of gravels so that they might become cold in my hand and I placed them (before me) so that I may put my forehead on them at the time when I would prostrate. I did this due to the intensity of heat. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 399)
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Zuhr ki namaz padhta, to main kankariyon ki aik mutthi le leta taake woh meri hatheli mein thandi ho jayen, unhein apni peshani ke liye rakh leta aur unpar sajda karta, garmi ki shiddat ki wajah se."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Shall I not inform you about the prayer of the hypocrite? It is when he delays the Asr (afternoon) prayer until the sun becomes like the hump of a camel." This hadith was narrated by Muslim from the narration of Al-Ala' bin Abdul Rahman from Anas from the Prophet ﷺ  who said, "This is the prayer of the hypocrite: he sits until the sun turns yellow."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein munafiq ki namaz na bataun? Woh Asr ko itna mo'akhkhar karta hai ke jab suraj gaay ke peth ki tarah (peela, dhundhla) ho jata hai to woh use padhta hai." Muslim ne Al-Ala' bin Abdur Rahman ki, Anas (RA) se, Nabi (SAW) se, hadith nikali hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh munafiq ki namaz hai, woh baitha rehta hai yahan tak ke jab suraj peela ho jaye" - hadith.

e: [AI] "The farthest two men in companionship of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  were Abu Lubabah ibn Abd al-Mundhir and his family in Quba, and Abu Abs ibn Jabr with his residence in Bani Harithah. They used to pray the Asr prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and then they would go to their people who had not yet prayed, in order to hasten the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se do aadmi, jinke ghar sabse door thay, Abu Lubabah bin Abdul Mundhir (RA) aur unke ghar wale Quba mein, aur Abu Abs bin Jabr (RA), jinka ghar Banu Haritha mein tha, woh dono Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Asr ki namaz padhte, phir apni qaum ke paas jate jinhone abhi namaz nahi padhi hoti, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) Asr jaldi padha lete.

e: [AI] That the angel Gabriel came to the Prophet ﷺ to teach him the prayer, and he recited it word for word, like the hadith of Wahb bin Kaysan, equally for both "and as for the second witness." Authentic and well-known.
hi: Jibra'il (AS) Nabi (SAW) ke paas namaz sikhane aaye, phir unhone poora matan Wahb bin Kaysan ki hadith jaisa hi bayan kiya. (Rahi baat doosre shahid ki...) Sahih, mash'hoor.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Gabriel visited me in Mecca twice." Then he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner, "Abdul Kareem, this is the son of Abu Al-Mukhariq, without a doubt, and I have only brought him as a witness." Abdul Kareem is present.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS) ne Makkah mein do martaba meri imamat ki," phir isi tarah ki hadith zikr ki. (Yeh Abdul Karim, bila shak Ibn Abi Al-Mukharaq hain, maine ise sirf shahid ke tor par nikala hai.) (Abdul Karim kamzor hain.)

e: [AI] That Jibril came to the Prophet ﷺ  and prayed the prayers with him twice, except for the Maghrib prayer.
hi: Jibra'il (AS) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein namazein do do waqton mein padhayin, siwaye Maghrib ke.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Command the children to pray at the age of seven and discipline them for it at the age of ten, and separate them in their beds." I heard Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad ibn Ya'qub say, I heard Al-Abbas ibn Muhammad Al-Duri say, I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in say, Amr ibn Shuayb is trustworthy.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bachon ko saat saal ki umar mein namaz ka hukum do, aur dus saal ki umar mein (na padhne par) unhein maaro, aur unke bistar aapas mein alag kar do." Maine Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad bin Ya'qub ko kehte hue suna, unhone Al-Abbas bin Muhammad Ad-Duri ko kehte hue suna, unhone Yahya bin Ma'in ko kehte hue suna: "Amr bin Shu'aib thiqa hain."

e: The words of adhan were pronounced from the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ twice in pairs (i.e. four times) each, and the words of iqamah were pronounced once in pairs (twice each), except that the phrase "The time for prayer has come" would be pronounced twice. When we heard iqamah, we would perform ablution, and go out for prayer. Shu'bah said: I did not hear AbuJa'far narrating any other tradition except this one. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 510)
hi: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein azan har jumla do do martaba kaha jata tha, aur iqamat aik aik martaba, siwaye is ke ke "Qad qaamatis salaah" do martaba kaha jata. Jab hum iqamat sunte to wudu karte, phir namaz ke liye nikalte.

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Bilal to say the phrases of the Adhan twice and the phrases of the Iqamah once." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 627)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya ke woh azan ke jumle joda (do do) karein aur iqamat ke jumle taaq (aik aik) karein.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered Bilal to give the call to prayer and perform the qiyam (night prayer). The two shaykhs did not mention this context, but it is correct according to their condition.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya ke woh azan ke jumle joda karein aur iqamat ke jumle taaq karein. (Shaykhain ne is siyaaq (tarteeb) ke sath nahi nikala, aur yeh unki shart par sahih hai.)

e: [AI] He informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: There are two things that are not rejected or rarely rejected: supplication when called upon, and supplication during a time of hardship when they are fighting against each other.
hi: Unhein bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do (duayein) radd nahi ki jatin - ya kam hi radd ki jati hain: azan ke waqt ki dua, aur jang ki shiddat ke waqt ki dua jab log aapas mein bhid jate hain."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Prayer is answered as long as the caller does not rush."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dua qubool hoti hai azan (aur iqamat) ke darmiyan."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me to say when the adhan for the sunset prayer was called; "O Allah, this is the time when Thy night comes on, Thy day retires, and the voices of Thy summoners are heard, so forgive me." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 530)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaya ke Maghrib ki azan ke waqt kahoon: "Aye Allah, yeh teri raat ka aana aur tere din ka jaana hai, aur tere pukarne walon ki awazein hain, to mujhe maaf kar de."

e: Messenger of Allah, appoint me the leader of the tribe in prayer. He said: You are their leader, but you should follow on who is the weakest of them: and appoint a mu'adhdhin who does not charge for the calling of adhan. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 531)
hi: Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe apni qaum ka imam bana dijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum unke imam ho, unme se sabse kamzor ka khayal rakhna, aur aisa mu'adhdhin rakhna jo azan par koi ujrat na le."

e: The extent of the shadow when the Messenger of Allah prayed (the noon prayer) was three to five feet in summer and five to seven feet in winter. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 400)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki namaz ke waqt (saaye ki) andaazan lambai teen qadam hoti thi, aur sardi mein paanch se saat qadam.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me and what he taught me is this: Observe the five prayers regularly. He said: I told (him): I have many works at these times; so give me a comprehensive advice which, if I follow, should be enough for me. He said: Observe the two afternoon prayers (al-asrayn). But the term al-asrayn (two afternoon prayers) was not used in our language. Hence I said: What is al-asrayn? He said: A prayer before the sunrise and a prayer before the sunset (i.e. the dawn and the afternoon prayers). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 428)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaya, aur jo kuch unhone mujhe sikhaya usmein yeh tha: "Paanch namazon ki hifazat karo." Maine arz kiya: "Yeh aise auqat hain jinmein mujhe mashghooliyaat hoti hain, mujhe koi jaame baat ka hukum dijiye jise agar main karoon to mere liye kaafi ho jaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do 'asron ki hifazat karo" - jo humari zaban mein na thi. Maine poocha: "Do 'asr kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suraj nikalne se pehle ki namaz aur suraj doobne se pehle ki namaz."

e: [AI] "I heard Sa'd and some of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'There were two brothers during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and one of them was better than the other. The one who was better passed away, and the other brother lived for forty more days before he also passed away. So they mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  the virtue of the first over the second. He said, 'Was the second one not praying?' They replied, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah, he was praying and there was no problem with his prayer.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'What do you think the value of his prayers reached? The example of prayer is like a river flowing at the gate of a man's house, and he immerses himself in it five times a day. So what do you think remains of his dirt?' You do not know how far his prayers reached."
hi: Maine Sa'd (RA) aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein do bhai the, aur unme se aik doosre se afzal tha. Jo afzal tha woh wafat pa gaya, phir doosra uske baad chaalees din aur zinda raha, phir woh bhi wafat pa gaya. Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se pehle ki afzaliyat doosre par zikr ki, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya doosra namaz nahi padhta tha?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aur uski namaz mein koi kharabi na thi." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "To tumhein kya khabar uski namaz kahan tak pahunchi? Namaz ki misaal aik behta hua dariya hai jo kisi shakhs ke darwaze par ho, gehra aur meetha, jismein woh har din paanch martaba doob'ta ho, to tumhara kya khayal hai uski gandagi mein se kya baaqi rahega? Tumhein nahi pata uski namaz kahan tak pahunchi."
