e: [AI] He heard Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah reporting about the Prophet ﷺ  that he sat on the pulpit and said, "By the One in Whose hand is my soul..." three times, then he remained silent. Then, every man among us shed tears of sadness to the right of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Then he said, "There is no servant who performs the five daily prayers, fasts during Ramadan, and avoids the major sins except that the gates of Paradise will be opened for him on the Day of Judgment until it even claps. Then he recited, "If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance [into Paradise]." (Surah An-Nisa, 31)
hi: Unhone Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) aur Abu Hurairah (RA) ko Nabi (SAW) se bayan karte hue suna ke aap (SAW) mimbar par baithe, phir farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai" - teen martaba - phir khamosh ho gaye. To hum mein se har aadmi Rasulullah (SAW) ki qasam ki wajah se ghum se sar jhukae rota raha. Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi banda paanch namazein padhta hai, Ramzan ke roze rakhta hai, aur saat kabaair (bade gunahon) se bachta hai, uske liye Qayamat ke din Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jayengay, yahan tak ke woh (khushi se) khud aapas mein takra jayengay." Phir aap (SAW) ne yeh ayat parhi: "Agar tum un bade gunahon se bacho jinse tumhein mana kiya gaya hai, to hum tumhare (chhote) gunah mita dengay" (Surah An-Nisa 31).

e: "A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: 'O Messenger of Allah, how many prayers has Allah enjoined upon His slaves?' He said: 'Allah has enjoined upon His slaves (five) prayers.' He said: 'O Messenger of Allah, is there anything before them or after them?' He said: 'Allah has enjoined upon His salves (five) prayers.' The man swore that he would not do anything more or less than that. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'If he is speaking the truth he will most certainly enter Paradise.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 459)
hi: Aik shakhs ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ne apne bandon par kitni namazein farz ki hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paanch namazein." Usne poocha: "Kya inse pehle ya baad mein kuch aur bhi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne apne bandon par paanch namazein farz ki hain." To us shakhs ne Allah ki qasam khayi ke woh na inse zyada karega na kam. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar usne sach kaha to woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga."

e: [AI] His grandfather reported that he raised him to the Prophet ﷺ who said, "When your children reach the age of seven, separate their sleeping positions. And when they reach the age of ten, discipline them regarding prayer."
hi: Apne dada se, unhone ise Nabi (SAW) tak marfoo' kiya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhare bachche saat saal ke ho jayen to unke bistar alag kar do, aur jab woh das saal ke ho jayen to unhein namaz par maaro."

e: Messenger of Allah, appoint me the leader of the tribe in prayer. He said: You are their leader, but you should follow on who is the weakest of them: and appoint a mu'adhdhin who does not charge for the calling of adhan. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 531)
hi: Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe apni qaum ka imam bana dijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum unke imam ho, unme se sabse kamzor ka khayal rakhna, aur aisa mu'adhdhin rakhna jo azan par ujrat na le."

e: Bilal would call the Adhan, then he used come to wait. When he would see that the prophet ﷺ had come out (of his house), he would pronounce the iqama. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 537)
hi: "Bilal (RA) azan dete, phir intezar karte, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ko nikalta hua dekhte to iqamat kehte."

e: when the Iqamah was pronounced and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw that they (the people) were small in number, he would sit down, nd would not pray; but when he saw them (the people) large in number, he would pray. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 545)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) masjid mein hote jab namaz ki iqamat hoti, agar aap (SAW) log kam dekhte to baith jate (aur intezar karte), aur agar zyada log dekhte to namaz padhte."

e: "I saw Bilal calling the Adhan, and turning, and his (face) was following here and there, and his (index) fingers were in his ears, and Messenger of Allah was in a small red tent" - "I think," he (one of the narrators) said, "it was made from a hide" - so Bilal went out in front of him with an Anazah which he planted (in the ground) at Batha. Messenger of Allah prayed facing it, and a dog and a donkey passed in front of him; he was wearing a red Hullah, and it is as if I am now looking at the radiance of his shins." Sufyan said: "We think that it was a Hibrah." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 197)
hi: Unhone kaha: "Maine Bilal (RA) ko azan dete dekha, woh ghoom rahe the aur unka munh idhar-udhar ho raha tha, unki ungliyan unke kaanon mein thi, aur Rasulullah (SAW) chamde ke aik surkh khaimay mein thay. Bilal (RA) unke aage aik chhoti neze (asa/anaza) lekar nikle aur usse Batha mein gaad diya, Rasulullah (SAW) ne uski taraf mun karke namaz padhi. Unke saamne se kutta aur gadha guzarte the, aur aap (SAW) par surkh joda tha, jaise main abhi bhi aap (SAW) ki pindliyon ki chamak dekh raha hoon."

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  descend to Al-Abtah and mentioned the Hadith in its similar form: 'The two Shaykhs (Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim) agreed on the authenticity of the Hadith of Malik bin Mighwal and Umar bin Abi Zaidah from Awn bin Abu Juhaifah from his father, regarding his ﷺ  descent to Al-Abtah. However, they did not mention in it the inserting of the finger into the ears and the turning in the ears, which is correct according to both of them (Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim), and it is two recommended Sunnahs.'"
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Al-Abtah mein utarte dekha," phir isi tarah hadith zikr ki. (Shaykhain ka Malik bin Mighwal aur Umar bin Abi Za'idah ki, Aun bin Abi Juhaifah se, unke walid se, hadith ko - Aap (SAW) ke Abtah mein utarne ke zikr mein - nikalne par ittifaq hai, magar unhone ismein ungli kaanon mein daalna aur azan mein ghoomna zikr nahi kiya, aur yeh dono ki shart par sahih hai, aur yeh dono mustahab Sunnatein hain.)

e: [AI] About him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "Whoever says, when he hears the Mu'adhin (the caller to prayer), 'I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, without any partners, and that Muhammad is His slave and messenger, I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Muhammad as His slave, and Islam as my religion, his sins will be forgiven.'" This hadith is authentic and it was not narrated by al-Hakam bin Abdullah. He is the brother of Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Qais bin Makhrama al-Qurashi. Additionally, it was also narrated from above Ali bin Abi Talib al-Himsi in the addition of al-Thabit.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs mu'adhdhin ko sunkar kahe: 'Wa ana ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluh, radeetu billahi Rabban wa bi Muhammadin Nabiyyan wa bil-Islami deenan' (Aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai uska koi shareek nahi, aur Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain, main Allah ke Rab hone, Muhammad (SAW) ke Nabi hone aur Islam ke deen hone par raazi hua), to uske gunah maaf kar diye jayenge." Sahih, magar dono ne ise nahi nikala. Al-Hakam bin Abdullah, Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Qais bin Makhramah Al-Qurashi ke bhai hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If one of you hears the call to prayer and has a vessel in his hand, he should not put it down until he fulfills his need from it." And in the narration of Abu Bakr ibn Ishaq, it is stated, "And Hammad narrated to us from Ammar, from Abu Hurairah with a similar wording."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi azan sune aur uske haath mein bartan ho, to woh use na rakhe jab tak apni zaroorat pura na kar le." Aur Abu Bakr bin Ishaq ki hadith mein hai, unhone kaha: humein Hammad ne Ammar se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, isi jaisi hadith bayan ki.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, used to say, "Join us in visiting the martyrs." And he commanded that the call to prayer be made for them, and that prayer be established and be led by the people of the house. "Muslim has argued with Al-Walid bin Jumayy, and this is a strange practice which I do not know of any hadith other than this." And we have narrated that "Aisha, the mother of the believers, used to make the call to prayer, establish prayer, and lead the women in prayer." Muslim argued with Al-Walid.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Chalo hum us shahida (Shuhada mein shumaar) aurat ke paas chalte hain aur uski ziyarat karte hain," aur hukum diya ke uske liye azan aur iqamat kahi jaaye aur uske ghar wale (namaz mein) farz namazon mein imamat karein. (Muslim ne Al-Waleed bin Jumai' se hujjat pakdi hai, aur yeh aik ajeeb-o-ghareeb Sunnat hai, is baab mein iske ilawa koi musnad hadith mujhe maloom nahi.) Humne yeh bhi riwayat ki hai ke Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha (RA) azan bhi deti thin, iqamat bhi kehti thin aur auraton ki imamat bhi karti thin.

e: [AI] She used to give the call to prayer, establish prayer, lead women in prayer, stand among them.
hi: Woh "azan bhi deti thin, iqamat bhi kehti thin, auraton ki imamat karti thin, aur unke beech mein khadi hoti thin."

e: "Messenger of Allah said to Bilal: "O Bilal! When you call the Adhan then do so deliberately and slowly, and when you call the Iqamah then be quick. Allow enough time between your Adhan and Iqamah for the person eating to finish what he is eating, the person drinking to finish what he is drinking, and the one who needs time to relive himself, and do not stand until you see me." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 195)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) se farmaya: "Jab tum azan do to araam se, tehr tehr kar do, aur jab iqamat kaho to jaldi karo, aur apni azan aur iqamat ke darmiyan itna waqfa rakho ke khane wala apna khana khatam kar le, peene wala apna pani pi le, aur qaza-e-hajat ke liye jane wala apni zaroorat poori kar le."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase into English is as follows:

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say, when he heard the caller to prayer, he would repeat what the caller said until he became silent.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab mu'adhdhin ko sunte to wahi kehte jo woh kehta, yahan tak ke woh khamosh ho jata.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "Indeed, when the Prophet ﷺ  heard the muezzin, he would say 'and me, and me'." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) jab mu'adhdhin ko sunte to farmate: "Aur main bhi, aur main bhi." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Bilal stood up and gave the call. When he fell silent the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever says the same as this (what the Mu'adhdhin) with certainty, he will enter Paradise. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 674)
hi: Unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath thay, Bilal (RA) khade hokar azan dene lage, jab woh khamosh huay to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs isi tarah yaqeen ke sath kahe, woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga."

e: The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever calls the Adhan for twelve years, he will be guaranteed Paradise, and for each day sixty Hasanat (good deeds) will be recorded for him by virtue of his Adhan, and thirty Hasanat by virtue of his Iqamah." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 728)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs baarah (12) saal tak azan de, uske liye Jannat wajib ho jati hai, aur har martaba azan dene par usse saath (60) neki aur iqamat kehne par tees (30) neki likhi jaati hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever calls the Adhan for twelve years, he will be guaranteed Paradise, and for each day sixty Hasanat (good deeds) will be recorded for him by virtue of his Adhan, and thirty Hasanat by virtue of his Iqamah." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 728)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs baarah saal tak azan de, uske liye Jannat wajib ho jati hai, aur har azan par usse saath neki aur har iqamat par tees neki likhi jaati hai." Muslim ne isse shahid ke tor par pesh kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to not give the call to prayer for any of the prayers during a journey and he would only establish the Fajr prayer, as he used to give the call to prayer and establish it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) safar mein kisi bhi namaz ke liye azan nahi dete the, aur sirf Fajr ke liye iqamat kehte, ya'ni Fajr ke liye azan bhi dete aur iqamat bhi kehte.

e: [AI] That Ibn Umar used to "not perform the call to prayer while traveling and not perform any of his prayers"
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) safar mein azan nahi dete the aur na apni kisi namaz ke liye iqamat kehte.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When any of you hears the summons to prayer while he has a vessel in his hand, he should not lay it down till he fulfils his need. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2350)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi azan sune aur uske haath mein bartan ho, to woh use na rakhe jab tak apni zaroorat pura na kar le."

e: Messenger of Allah said: "What is between the east and the west is Qiblah." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 344)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan (poori simt) Qibla hai."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘What is between the east and the west is the Qiblah (prayer direction).’”* *This refers to the Qiblah for the the inhabitants of Al-Madinah. (Makkah is to the exact south of Al-Madinah.) (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1011)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan Qibla hai."

e: [AI] We used to pray with the Prophet ﷺ during a journey or travel, and then a cloud overshadowed us and confused us in determining the direction of the qibla (direction of prayer). So, each of us prayed individually in a different direction. Then, each of us marked a spot in front of himself so that we could identify our positions. We mentioned this incident to the Prophet ﷺ, and he did not command us to repeat the prayers. He said, "Your prayers have been accepted."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik safar mein namaz padh rahe thay, ke hum par baadal chha gaye, hum uljhan mein pad gaye aur Qibla ki simt mein humara ikhtilaf ho gaya, to hum mein se har aik ne alag alag namaz padhi, aur hum mein se har aik ne apne aage nishaan bana liya taake hum apni jagahon ko pehchan sakein. Humne yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, to aap (SAW) ne humein dobara padhne ka hukum nahi diya aur farmaya: "Tumhari namazein kaafi ho gayin."

e: [AI] "About Al-Maqburi and it is authentic according to the condition of the Muslims, on their condition."
hi: Al-Maqburi se, aur yeh Muslim ki shart par sahih hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to Ka'b bin 'Ujrah, "When you perform ablution and enter the mosque, do not intertwine your fingers." This was narrated by Shurayk bin 'Abdullah from Muhammad bin 'Ajlan in its chain of narration. Shurayk narrated it from Ibn 'Ajlan, who heard it from his father, who heard it from Abu Hurairah.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) se farmaya: "Jab tum wudu karo phir masjid mein dakhil ho, to apni ungliyan aapas mein na phansao." Ise Sharik bin Abdullah ne Muhammad bin Ajlan se riwayat kiya hai, aur unhone iski sanad mein galti ki hai. (Sharik ne Ibn Ajlan se, unke walid se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat ki hai, Sharik ne galti ki.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you are in the mosque, do not hold your fingers like this," meaning intertwined.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum masjid mein ho to apni ungliyan aise na karo," ya'ni unhein aapas mein na phansao.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "When one of you enters the mosque, let him send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ  and say: ‘O Allah, grant me protection from the accursed Satan.’"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein dakhil ho, to Nabi (SAW) par durood bheje aur kahe: 'Aye Allah, mujhe dhutkare hue Shaitan se panah de.'"

e: [AI] A man came to pray and the Prophet ﷺ  was leading the prayer. When he finished his prayer, he said, "O Allah, give me the best of what You give to your righteous servants." When the Prophet ﷺ  finished the prayer, he said, "Who was the one speaking earlier?" The man said, "It was me, O Messenger of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Then your camel will stumble and you will be martyred in the cause of Allah."
hi: Aik shakhs namaz ke liye aaya jabke Nabi (SAW) humein namaz padha rahe thay, to jab woh saff mein pahuncha to usne kaha: "Aye Allah, mujhe woh behtareen (ne'mat) ata kar jo tu apne nek bandon ko ata karta hai." Jab Nabi (SAW) ne namaz mukammal ki to farmaya: "Abhi kaun bol raha tha?" Us shakhs ne kaha: "Main tha, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "To (is soorat mein) tumhara ghoda zakhmi kiya jayega aur tum Allah ki raah mein shaheed hoge."

e: “Allahumma inni a’udhu bika minash-Shaitanir-rajim, wa hamzihi wa nafkhihi wa nafthihi (O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the accursed Satan, from his madness, his pride, and his poetry).” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 808)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) namaz shuru karte waqt farmate: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon dhutkare hue Shaitan se, uske ubharne (junoon), uske phoolne (ghuroor) aur uski shayari (waswase) se." Ravi ne kaha: "Uska ubharna maut ka daura hai, uski shayari (waswase-bhari) shaayari hai, aur uska phoolna ghuroor hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to recite aloud "Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim". Al-Bukhari reported it with a sound chain of narrators including Salim, who was the son of Ajlan al-Aftas, and Muslim also reported it with a chain that includes Sharik. Both of these chains are authentic and have no flaws, and they have not been rejected.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" buland awaz se padhte. (Bukhari ne isi Salim se hujjat pakdi hai, jo Ibn Ajlan Al-Aftas hain, aur Muslim ne Sharik se hujjat pakdi hai, aur yeh sanad sahih hai, ismein koi aib nahi, magar dono ne ise nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] Abu Ja'far Mohammad ibn Ali ibn Duhaime Al Shybayani informed us.
hi: Humein Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali bin Duhaim Ash-Shaybani ne bataya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The further one is from the mosque , the greater will be one's reward. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 556)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo masjid se jitna zyada door ho, uska ajr utna hi zyada hota hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Praying in congregation is rewarded as twenty-five times greater than praying alone. And if one perfects the bowing and the prostration in the prayer, it reaches the reward of fifty prayers."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jama'at ki namaz akeli namaz se pachees (25) guna zyada ajr rakhti hai, aur agar woh khuli maidaan mein padhi jaye aur uska ruku aur sajda mukammal kiya jaye, to woh pachaas (50) namazon ke barabar ho jaati hai."

e:
[AI] Abdullah bin Muslima al-Qa'nabi narrated from Abd al-Aziz bin Muhammad, from Muhammad bin Tahala, from Muhsin bin Ali, from Awf bin al-Harith who said:

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever performs ablution and perfects it, then goes and finds the people already praying, Allah Almighty will grant him the same reward as those who prayed without reducing their rewards in any way."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs wudu kare aur usse achhi tarah kare, phir chal pade aur logon ko namaz padh chuka paaye, to Allah use utna hi ajr dega jitna us shakhs ko jisne namaz padhi aur usme haazir hua, unke ajr mein koi kami nahi hogi."

e: Ibn ‘Umar reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying; Do not prevent your women from visiting the mosque; but their houses are better for them (for praying). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 567)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni auraton ko masjidon (jaane) se na roko, halanke unke ghar unke liye behtar hain."

e: [AI] From Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , that the Prophet ﷺ  said: "The best mosques for women are the innermost parts of their houses." Al-Dhahabi did not comment on this in his summary.
hi: Umm Salamah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki zaujah, se riwayat hai, Nabi (SAW) se: "Auraton ki behtareen masjidein unke gharon ke sabse andar wale hisse hain." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: ‘Abd Allah (b. Mas’ud) reported the prophet ﷺ as saying; it is more excellent for a woman to pray in her house than in her courtyard, and more excellent for her to pray in her private chamber than in her house. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 570)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat ki apne ghar mein namaz uske aangan mein namaz se afzal hai, aur uski apne (chhote) kamre mein namaz uske ghar mein namaz se afzal hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a person praying alone. He said: Is there any man who may do good with this (man) and pray along with him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 574)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko akela namaz padhte dekha, to farmaya: "Koi hai jo is (shakhs) par sadqa kare aur iske sath namaz padhe?"

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: He who leads the people in prayer, and he does so at the right time, will receive, as well as those who are led (in prayer) will get (the reward). He who delays (prayer) from the appointed time will be responsible (for this delay) and not those who are led in prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 580)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo shakhs logon ki imamat kare aur waqt par (namaz) padhaye, to uske liye bhi ajr hai aur unke liye bhi, aur jo isme kuch kami kare, to woh usi par hai, unpar nahi."

e: Hudhaifah led the people in prayer in al-Mada’in standing on the shop(or a bench). Abu Mas’ud took him by his shirt, and brought him down. When he( Abu Mas’ud) finished his prayer, he said: Do you not know that they(the people) were prohibited to do so. He said: Yes, I remembered when you pulled me down. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 597)
hi: Hudhaifah (RA) ne Madain mein logon ki imamat aik chabootre (uthi hui jagah) par khade hokar ki, to Abu Mas'ud (RA) ne unki qamees pakad kar unhein kheench liya. Jab unhone apni namaz mukammal ki to (Abu Mas'ud RA ne) kaha: "Kya tumhein nahi maloom ke isse mana kiya jata tha?" - ya kaha: "Kya tumhein nahi maloom ke isse mana kiya jata tha?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, mujhe yaad aa gaya jab tumne mujhe kheencha."

e: [AI] Hudhaifah prayed with the people in the cities, then he went ahead and climbed over a shop. Abu Mas'ood grabbed him by his clothes' collars and pulled him down. When they finished the prayer, Abu Mas'ood said to him, "Didn't you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade the Imam to step ahead while the people remain behind him?" Hudhaifah said, "So why didn't you say so when you pulled me?"
hi: Hudhaifah (RA) ne Madain mein logon ki imamat ki, woh chabootre ke upar aage badh gaye, to Abu Mas'ud (RA) ne unke kapdon ka gala pakad kar unhein kheencha, woh wapas aa gaye. Jab namaz mukammal hui to Abu Mas'ud (RA) ne unse kaha: "Kya tumhein nahi maloom ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne mana kiya hai ke imam upar khada ho aur log uske peechhe (neeche) rahein?" Unhone kaha: "Phir tumne mujhe kis liye dekha ke maine jawaab diya jab tumne mujhe kheencha?"

e: "We prayed behind one of the Amirs, the people compelled us such that we prayed between two columns. When we had prayed, Anas bin Malik said: 'We would be prevented from this during the time of Messenger of Allah.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 229)
hi: Hum aik hukmaraan ke peechhe namaz padh rahe thay, to logon ki majboori ki wajah se humne do satoonon ke darmiyan namaz padhi. Jab humne namaz padh li to Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein isse bachte the."

e: [AI] About the Prophet, peace be upon him, in his saying, "Indeed, the recitation of the Quran during Fajr is witnessed" [al-Isra' 78], he said, "The angels of the night and the angels of the day gather in it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "Beshak Fajr ki Quran-khwani hazir ki jaati hai" (Surah Al-Isra 78) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isme raat ke farishte aur din ke farishte hazir hote hain, ismein jama ho jate hain."

e: [AI] Abdullah bin Umar used to say, "When we lost someone during the prayers of Al-Isha and Al-Fajr, we would suspect them as being the cause."
hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) kaha karte the: "Hum jab kisi shakhs ko Isha ki aakhri namaz aur Fajr mein na paate to uske baare mein bura gumaan karte."

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: If there are three men in a village or in the desert among whom prayer is not offered (in congregation), the devil has got the mastery over them. So observe (prayer) in congregation), for the wolf eats only the straggling animal. Sa'ib said: By the word Jama'ah he meant saying prayer in company or in congregation. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 547)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jis basti ya registan mein teen aadmi hon aur wahan jama'at se namaz na qaim ki jaye, to Shaitan unpar ghalib aa jata hai, isliye jama'at ko lazim pakdo, kyunke bheriya sirf us bakri ko khata hai jo (gale se) alag ho jaye."

e: [AI] "On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, 'When a person performs ablution and then goes to the mosque to observe prayer, for every step he takes towards the mosque, a good deed will be written for him by his recorder or recorders. And whoever remains seated, observing the prayer of someone, will receive the same reward as the one offering the prayer, and this reward will be written for him from the moment he leaves his house until he returns.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab koi shakhs taharat kare, phir masjid ki taraf chale aur namaz ka intezar kare, to uska likhne wala (farishta) - ya uske dono likhne wale - masjid ki taraf uthaye har qadam par usse dus nekiyan likhte hain, aur baitha hua shakhs jo namaz ka intezar kare woh ibadat-guzaar jaisa hai, aur woh apne ghar se nikalne se lekar wapas aane tak namaziyon mein shumaar hota hai."

e: [AI] He, Abdullah, what is your concern, O Abu Abdurrahman? He said, "Why would I want the enemy of Allah to distract me from something I heard from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him?" He said, "Do not exert yourself excessively, oh Adam! Do not go out to the mosque to talk. And I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say, 'Whoever strives in the cause of Allah is guaranteed by Allah, and whoever sits in his house and refrains from speaking ill of anyone is guaranteed by Allah, and whoever visits a sick person is guaranteed by Allah, and whoever goes to the mosque or returns is guaranteed by Allah, and whoever goes to an Imam seeking counsel is guaranteed by Allah.' But the enemy of Allah wants to drive me out of my house to the gathering."
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA) [se poocha gaya]: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, tumhein kya hua ke tum apne aap se baatein kar rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe kya hua, Allah ka dushman (Shaitan) chahta hai ke mujhe us baat se ghafil kar de jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suni thi." Unhone kaha: "Insaan (khwahish) se apna dil takleef mat do, kya tum masjid nahi jate ke wahan baat karo?" Aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo Allah ki raah mein jihad kare, Allah uska zamin (zimmedar) hai; aur jo apne ghar mein baithkar kisi ki bad-goi na kare, Allah uska zamin hai; aur jo kisi mareez ki ayadat kare, Allah uska zamin hai; aur jo subah ya shaam masjid ki taraf jaye, Allah uska zamin hai; aur jo kisi imam ke paas jaye jo uski ta'zeer kare, Allah uska zamin hai - isliye Allah ka dushman chahta hai ke mujhe mere ghar se nikaal kar (fuzool ki) majlis mein le jaye."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Give glad tidings to those who walk to the mosques in the dark, of perfect light on the Day of Resurrection.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 781)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Andheron mein masjidon ki taraf chalne walon ko Qayamat ke din mukammal noor ki khushkhabri do."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Give good tidings to those who walk to the mosques in darkness for having a perfect light on the Day of Judgment. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 561)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raat ke andheron mein masjidon ki taraf chalne walon ko Qayamat ke din mukammal noor ki khushkhabri do."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you see a man frequenting the mosque, bear witness to his faith." Allah, the Exalted, said: "Verily, those who attend to the mosques of Allah are those who believe in Allah and the Last Day." [Surah At-Tawbah: 18] This is a translation for the Egyptians. They did not differ in its accuracy and the truthfulness of its narrators, except that the two authentic scholars did not mention it. However, I have mentioned the statement regarding its authenticity in the previous explanation.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum kisi shakhs ko masjid ka aadi dekho, to uske Eman ki gawahi do." Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Allah ki masjidon ko woh hi aabaad karta hai jo Allah aur aakhirat ke din par Eman laaya" (Surah At-Tawbah 18). (Yeh Misr walon ki tarjuma hai, unhone iski sehat aur raawiyon ki sachai mein ikhtilaf nahi kiya, sirf itna hai ke Sahihain ke musannifain ne ise nahi nikala, aur maine iski sehat ke baare mein pehle bayan kar diya hai.) (Darraj bohot munkir riwayaten karne wale hain.)

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: "No one of you should enter the mosque for prayer except that Allah will mush and shake him from where he comes out of his home, just as the people of absentees become mush and shake when they receive news about them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz ke liye masjid ki taraf kadam badhata hai, to Allah uski taraf usi jagah se khush hota hai jahan se woh apne ghar se nikalta hai, jaise ghar wale apne ghair-hazir (safar par gaye) shakhs ke aane par khush hote hain."

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: He who leads the people in prayer, and he does so at the right time, will receive, as well as those who are led (in prayer) will get (the reward). He who delays (prayer) from the appointed time will be responsible (for this delay) and not those who are led in prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 580)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo shakhs logon ki imamat kare aur waqt par (namaz) padhaye, to uske liye bhi ajr hai aur unke liye bhi, aur jo isme kuch kami kare, to woh usi par hai, unpar nahi."

e: [AI] The Prophet's muezzin would call for prayer, then wait. And when he saw the Prophet approaching, he would start reciting the adhan.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ke mu'adhdhin azan dete, phir intezar karte, jab woh Nabi (SAW) ko aata hua dekhte to iqamat kehna shuru kar dete."

e: "Whoever completes a row, may Allah be generous to him, and whoever cuts a row, may Allah cut him off." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 819)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs saff jode (mila kar khade ho), Allah use jode (apni rahmat se), aur jo shakhs saff kaate, Allah use kaat de."

e: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Allah and the angels send blessings upon the first row.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 997)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah aur uske farishte un logon par rahmat bhejte hain jo saffein jodte hain."

e: It was narrated from ‘Irbad bin Sariyah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to ask for forgiveness for the first row three times and for the second row twice. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 996)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) pehli saff ke liye teen martaba aur doosri saff ke liye aik martaba maghfirat maangte."

e: [AI] Giving, and I have seen him do that.
hi: Ata ne (bhi yeh baat kahi), aur maine unhein khud aisa karte dekha hai.

e: [AI] "While I was in the city, in the mosque, standing in the front row, ready to pray, a man behind me pushed me forcefully, making me lose my balance. He took my place and said, 'By Allah, I did not understand my prayer.' When he finished, I realized it was Ubay ibn Ka'b. He said, 'O young man, may Allah not cause you harm. This was a command from the Prophet ﷺ  to us to give him our place, then he faced the qibla.' He said, 'Woe to the people who break their covenants three times, and by the Lord of the Kaaba, it is not upon them any anguish, but it is upon me for what they have misled.' I asked, 'Who do you mean by this?' He said, 'The rulers.'"
hi: Main Madinah mein masjid mein pehli saff mein khada namaz padh raha tha, ke mere peechhe se aik shakhs ne mujhe zor se kheench liya aur mujhe hata kar meri jagah khade ho gaye. Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe apni namaz ka hosh na raha. Jab woh (namaz se) faarigh huay to dekha ke yeh Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) hain. Unhone kaha: "Aye jawan, Allah tujhe koi takleef na de, yeh (aage khade hone ki baat) Nabi (SAW) ka humse waada tha ke hum ise sambhaalein," phir woh Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh huay aur kaha: "Ahd (waade) ke ahl halaak ho gaye," teen martaba, "Kaaba ke Rab ki qasam," phir kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe unpar afsos nahi, balke mujhe is baat ka afsos hai ke unhone kisko gumraah kiya." Maine poocha: "Aap iska ishara kis taraf kar rahe hain?" Unhone kaha: "Hukmaraanon ki taraf."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The Imam is appointed to be followed, so when he says the takbir, say the takbir, and when he recites, be silent, and when he says: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah (Allah hears those who praise Him)," say: "Allahumma rabbana lakal-hamd (Our Lord, to You be praise)." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 921)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Imam 'Allahu Akbar' kahe to tum bhi 'Allahu Akbar' kaho, aur jab woh 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah' kahe to tum 'Rabbana wa lakal hamd' kaho."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, two moments of silence: a moment of silence when he finished reciting the Takbir, and a moment of silence when he finished reciting during his bowing.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se do khaamoshiyon (sukoot) ki riwayat hai: "Aik khamoshi jab woh takbeer kahen, aur aik khamoshi jab woh apni qira'at se ruku ke waqt farigh ho jayen."

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah came to us in the mosque of Bani Zurayq and said three times, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do these three things and people have abandoned them: He would raise his hands until they passed his ears, then he would remain silent for a moment after reciting, and then he would ask Allah for His blessings."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) humare paas Banu Zuraiq ki masjid mein aaye aur teen martaba kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) teen kaam kiya karte the jinhein logon ne chhod diya hai: aap (SAW) apne dono haath itne uthate ke woh apne kaanon se aage badh jate, aur qira'at ke baad thodi der khamosh rehte, Allah se uske fazl ka sawaal karte hue."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to start his day by saying, 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all worlds,' and he would not remain silent (after that)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab doosri rak'at ke liye khade hote to 'Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen' se shuru karte aur (pehle) khamosh nahi hote."

e: Abu Hurairah reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying; when you come to pray while we are prostrating ourselves, you must prostrate yourselves, and do not reckon it anything (rak’ah) he has been present at the prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 893)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum aao aur hum sajde mein hon, to tum bhi sajda karo, aur ise (poori rak'at) kuch na samjho, aur jo shakhs aik rak'at pa le, usne (poori) namaz pa li."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to perform the prayer in complete secrecy." He said, "I prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he used to say the Tasleem (salutation) after standing for a while. Then, I also prayed with Abu Bakr and when he said the Tasleem, he would immediately rise from his place as if he was standing on hot coals."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) logon mein sabse mukhtasar (halki) namaz padhne wale the, magar mukammal tor par." Unhone kaha: "Aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath namaz padhi, to jab aap (SAW) salaam phertay to (thodi der) khade rehte, phir maine Abu Bakr (RA) ke sath namaz padhi, to jab woh salaam phertay to fauran apni jagah se aise uchhalte jaise tapte pathar se uth rahe hon."

e: [AI] I saw him leading boys from his people and they prayed behind him. So I said, "You are the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and you have more virtue and precedence. Why don't you lead these boys in prayer? Will you not take the initiative and pray for your people?" He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'The Imam (leader in prayer) is a guarantor. If he completes (the prayer) correctly, he gets the reward and the people get the reward, and if he makes a mistake, he bears the burden while the people are not held responsible for it. I do not want to take on that responsibility.'"
hi: Maine dekha ke woh apni qaum ke naujawano mein se kisi ko aage badhate the aur woh unki imamat karte. Maine kaha: "Aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain aur aapko fazeelat aur sabqat (Islam laane mein sabqat) haasil hai, aap in bachon ko aage kyun badhate hain jo aapki imamat karte hain? Aap khud aage kyun nahi badhte aur apni qaum ki imamat khud kyun nahi karte?" To unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Imam zamin (zimmedar) hai, agar woh (namaz) mukammal kare to uske liye bhi hai aur unke liye bhi, aur agar usme kami kare to woh usi par hai, unpar nahi - isliye main yeh zimmedari uthana nahi chahta."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Line up in the rows, and do not let the offspring of Al-Hadaf pass through you." I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what are the offspring of Al-Hadaf?" He said, "They are black, stripped sheep that are found in the land of Yemen."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Saffon mein mil kar khade ho, aisa na ho ke tumhare darmiyan Hadaf ke bachche (khaali jagah) aa jayen." Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Hadaf ke bachche kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh chhote, baal-rahit, kaali bakriyan hain jo Yemen ki zameen mein hoti hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Among the beauty of prayer is maintaining the rows."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz ki khoobi mein saff seedhi karna shamil hai."

e: It was narrated from ‘Irbad bin Sariyah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to ask for forgiveness for the first row three times and for the second row twice. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 996)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) pehli saff ke liye teen martaba aur doosri saff ke liye aik martaba maghfirat maangte.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "From the time one of you leaves his home to go to his mosque, a foot writes a good deed and another erases a bad deed."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne ghar se apni masjid ki taraf nikalta hai, to aik qadam neki likhta hai aur doosra gunah mitata hai."

e: [AI] It was narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "When one of you performs ablution and completes it perfectly, then goes out to perform prayer, the foot of his left side continues to be wiped away from sins and written for him is a good deed until he enters the masjid (mosque)." "Kathir ibn Zaid and Abu Abdullah Al-Qarrazi are two people from Madinah whom we do not know except that they are truthful."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi wudu kare aur usse achha kare, phir namaz ke liye nikle - masjid ke ilawa kuch aur usse nahi rokta - to uska baayan qadam koi na koi gunah mitata rahega aur uska dayan qadam koi na koi neki likhta rahega, yahan tak ke woh masjid mein dakhil ho jaye." (Kathir bin Zaid aur Abu Abdullah Al-Qarraz dono Madinah wale hain, humein unki sachai ke ilawa aur kuch maloom nahi.)

e: [AI] "He used to say, 'It is from the sunnah that when you enter the mosque, you start with your right foot, and when you leave, you start with your left foot.'"
hi: Woh kaha karte the: "Sunnat mein se hai ke jab tum masjid mein dakhil ho to apna dayan qadam pehle rakho, aur jab bahar niklo to apna baayan qadam pehle rakho."

e: The prophet ﷺ persuaded them to say prayer in congregation and prohibited them to leave before he goes away from the prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 624)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unhein namaz par ubhaara aur unhein mana kiya ke woh aap (SAW) ke (namaz se) chale jane se pehle na chalein.

e: I offered the Friday prayer along with Anas ibn Malik. We were pushed to the pillars (due to the crowd of people). We, therefore, stopped forward and backward. Anas then said: We used to avoid it (setting a row between the pillars) during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 673)
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein isse bachte the."

e: [AI] The meaning of the provided text in English is: "Both chains are authentic and they did not mention anything related to this topic."
hi: ...isse (bachne) ki taraf. (Dono asaneed sahih hain, aur unhone is baab mein kuch nahi nikala.) Sahih.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ liked the Muhajirun and Ansar to stand closest to him, so that they could learn from him.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 977)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) pasand karte the ke Muhajireen aur Ansar unke qareeb khade hon taake woh unse (deen) seekhein.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The ones who will convey from me at night will be those who are proficient in performing the prayer. The two sheikhs have agreed upon the hadith of Abu Mas'ud. The ones proficient in dreams and divine inspirations are also included in this only, and this addition is supported by a valid chain of narrators according to their conditions, and it has a valid testimony.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se woh log jo mujhse (namaz) seekhte hain - ya'ni namaz mein - mere qareeb khade hon." (Shaykhain ka Abu Mas'ud (RA) ki hadith par ittifaq hai:) "Mere qareeb woh khade hon jo aql aur samajh wale hain." (Yeh izafa sahih sanad ke sath hai, dono ki shart par.)

e: Messenger of Allah, do not say Amin before me. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 937)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujh se pehle 'Ameen' na kaho."

e: In the year of Conquest the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited a verse at which a prostration should be made and all the people prostrated themselves. Some were mounted, and some were prostrating themselves on the ground, and those who were mounted prostrated themselves on their hands. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1411)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne fatah ke saal aik sajda wali ayat padhi, to tamam log sajde mein chale gaye, unme se sawar bhi thay aur zameen par sajda karne wale bhi, yahan tak ke sawar apne haath par sajda karta.

e:
[AI] A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I saw in this night, as a sleeper sees, that I was praying behind a tree. I then saw that I recited a prostration and I prostrated. I saw the tree as if it were prostrating with my prostration. I heard it while it was prostrating and saying, 'O Allah, write for me with it (the prostration) a reward with You, make it a treasure for me in Your presence, and remove from me by means of it a sin. Accept it from me as You accepted from Your servant Dawud (David).'"

Ibn Abbas said, "Then I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recite the prostration, then he prostrated. I heard him while he was prostrating saying the same as the man said about the speech of the tree."

(Sahih)
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine aaj raat khwab mein dekha, jaisa sone wala dekhta hai, ke goya main aik darakht ke peechhe namaz padh raha hoon. Maine dekha ke goya maine sajda wali ayat padhi to sajda kiya, to maine dekha ke goya darakht mere sajde ke sath sajda kar raha hai, aur maine use sajda ki halat mein yeh kehte suna: 'Aye Allah, iske badle mere liye apne paas ajr likh de, ise mere liye apne paas zakheera bana de, iske zariye mujh se koi bojh utaar de, aur ise mujh se qubool kar jaise tune apne bande Dawud (AS) se qubool kiya tha.'" Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: phir maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha ke "aap (SAW) ne sajda wali ayat padhi, phir sajda kiya, to maine aap (SAW) ko sajde ki halat mein wahi kehte suna jo us shakhs ne darakht ki baat ke baare mein kaha tha." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say during his prostration in the night prayer of the Quran: "I prostrate my face to the One who created it and opened up his hearing and sight through His power and strength." Wahb, Khalid, and Abdul-Wahhab Al-Thaqafi narrated this with an addition from Khalid.
hi: Nabi (SAW) raat ko Quran ke sajdon mein kaha karte the: "Mera chehra usse sajda karta hai jisne ise paida kiya aur apni qudrat aur taaqat se iske kaan aur aankh khole (banaye)." Wahaib ne Khalid se aur Abdul Wahhab Ath-Thaqafi ne Khalid se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai, thodi si ziyaadti ke sath.

e: The Prophet ﷺ used to say, when he did a prostration that was required when reciting Quran at night: "Sajada wajhi lilladhi khalaqahu wa sawwarahu wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu bihawlihi wa quwwatih (My face has prostrated to the One Who created it and formed it, and brought forth its hearing and sight by His power and strength.)" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1129)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Quran ke sajdon mein kaha karte: "Mera chehra usse sajda karta hai jisne ise paida kiya aur uske kaan aur aankh khole."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated himself at night when reciting the Qur'an. He said repeatedly: My face prostrates itself to Him Who created it and brought forth its hearing and seeing by His might and power. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1414)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) raat ko Quran ke sajdon mein kaha karte: "Mera chehra usse sajda karta hai jisne ise paida kiya, aur apni qudrat aur taaqat se iske kaan aur aankh khole, to bohot bab-barkat hai Allah, sabse behtareen paida karne wala."

e: [AI] The first chapter in which the sajda (prostration) was revealed is Surah Al-Hajj. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited it, and he performed the sajda, and the people also performed the sajda except for one man who took dust and performed sajda on it. I saw him being killed as a disbeliever. This narration is followed by Zakariyya ibn Abi Zaidah narrating it from Abu Ishaq upon their conditions.
hi: Sabse pehli surah jismein sajda nazil hua woh Al-Hajj thi. Rasulullah (SAW) ne use padha to sajda kiya, aur logon ne bhi sajda kiya, siwaye aik shakhs ke jisne mitti uthai aur usi par sajda kiya, maine dekha ke woh kaafir hi qatl hua.

e: [AI] "The first Surah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited to the people during Hajj was the Surah Al-Hajj. When he recited it, the people all prostrated except for one man who took some soil and prostrated on it. I saw him being killed as a disbeliever."
hi: "Sabse pehli surah jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne logon ke saamne padhi woh Al-Hajj thi, jab aap (SAW) ne use padha to sajda kiya, aur logon ne bhi sajda kiya, siwaye aik shakhs ke jisne mitti uthai aur usi par sajda kiya, maine dekha ke woh kaafir hi qatl hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Surah Al-Hajj is preferred with two prostrations, so whoever does not prostrate during its recitation, should not recite it." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Surah Al-Hajj ko do sajdon se fazeelat di gayi hai, to jo unme sajda na kare woh unhein na padhe." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  prayed the noon prayer, so we assumed that he recited the chapter of prostration.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne "Zuhr ki namaz padhi to humein gumaan hua ke aap (SAW) ne Surah As-Sajdah (Tanzeel) padhi hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, spent a night at my place. I noticed that he was missing, so I thought he had gone to some of his wives. I searched for him and found him in prostration. I placed my hand on him and heard him saying, "Forgive me for what I have concealed and what I have made public."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik raat mere paas thay, unhone kaha: main unhein na paakar, mujhe gumaan hua ke woh apni kisi doosri biwi ke paas gaye hain. Unhone kaha: main unhein dhoondhne lagi, to unke paas pahunchi jabke woh sajde mein thay, maine apna haath unpar rakha to unhein yeh kehte suna: "Mujhe maaf kar de jo maine chhupaya aur jo zaahir kiya."

e: [AI] "We used to sit with the Prophet ﷺ , and he would recite the Quran. Sometimes, he would come across a verse that required prostration, and he would prostrate, and we would prostrate with him."
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas baithte the, "to aap (SAW) Quran padhte, kabhi kabhi aap (SAW) kisi sajda wali ayat se guzarte to sajda karte aur hum bhi aap (SAW) ke sath sajda karte."

e: [AI] When it was the day of Badr, I fought in a battle for a while, then I came quickly to see what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was doing. I found him prostrating and saying, "O Ever Living, O Sustainer." He did not say anything else, so I returned to the battle. Then I came back and found him prostrating and saying the same. I returned to the battle again, then came back and found him prostrating and saying the same. He continued saying that until Allah granted him victory.
hi: Jab Badr ka din tha to maine thodi der jang ki, phir jaldi se Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekhne aaya ke aap (SAW) kya kar rahe hain, to maine paaya ke aap (SAW) sajde mein hain aur farma rahe hain: "Aye Zinda, Aye Qaim rakhne wale," isse zyada kuch nahi kehte the. Main wapas jang mein chala gaya, phir aaya to aap (SAW) sajde mein wahi keh rahe thay, phir main jang mein gaya, phir aaya to aap (SAW) sajde mein wahi keh rahe thay, aap (SAW) yeh kehte rahe yahan tak ke Allah ne aap (SAW) ko fatah ata ki.

e: [AI] "I entered the mosque and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was leaving the mosque. I followed him walking behind him, and he did not notice until he entered a date palm grove and faced the direction of the Qibla and prostrated. He prolonged his prostration while I was behind him, until I thought that Allah had taken his soul. So, I approached him walking until I reached him and I lowered my head to look at his face. He raised his head and said, 'What is the matter, O Abdur Rahman?' I said, 'When you prolonged the prostration, O Messenger of Allah, I feared that your soul had been taken, so I came to look.' He said, 'When I entered the date palm grove, I met Jibril, who said to me, "I bring you glad tidings that Allah says: 'Whoever sends his Salam upon you, I will send my Salam upon him, and whoever performs prayer upon you, I will perform prayer upon him.'"'"
hi: Main masjid mein dakhil hua jabke Rasulullah (SAW) masjid se bahar nikal rahe thay, main unke peechhe chalne laga aur aap (SAW) ko iska ehsaas na hua, yahan tak ke aap (SAW) khajooron mein dakhil huay, Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh hokar sajda kiya aur sajda lamba kar diya, main aap (SAW) ke peechhe (khada) tha yahan tak ke mujhe gumaan hua ke Allah ne aap (SAW) ko wafat de di hai. Main chal kar aap (SAW) ke paas pahuncha, apna sar jhuka kar aap (SAW) ka chehra dekhne laga, to aap (SAW) ne apna sar uthaya aur farmaya: "Tumhein kya hua, aye Abdur Rahman (RA)?" Maine kaha: "Jab aapne sajda lamba kiya, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to mujhe darr laga ke kahin aapki jaan na nikal gayi ho, to main dekhne aaya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab main khajooron mein dakhil hua to mujhe Jibra'il (AS) mile, unhone kaha: 'Main aapko khushkhabri deta hoon ke Allah farmata hai: jo aapko salaam kare main usse salaam karta hoon, aur jo aap par durood bheje main usse durood bhejta hoon.'"

e: It was narrated from ‘Amr bin ‘As that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught him fifteen prostrations in the Qur’an, including three in the Mufassal and two in Al-Hajj. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1057)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Quran mein pandra (15) sajde padhaye, teen Mufassal mein aur Surah Al-Hajj mein do sajde.

e: [AI] The translation of the given text into English is: "When the Prophet ﷺ finished reciting Surah Al-Fatiha, he raised his voice and said, 'Ameen.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab Umm-ul-Quran (Surah Fatihah) se farigh hote to apni awaz buland karte aur "Ameen" kehte.

e: [AI] Abu Hurayrah complained or disappeared, so Abu Sa'eed al-Khudri prayed for us and he raised his voice with the takbeer when he started the prayer, and when he bowed, and when he said "Sami'a Allahu liman hamidah" (Allah hears those who praise Him), and when he raised his head from sujood (prostration), and when he prostrated, and when he raised from prostration, and when he stood up after the two rak'ahs until he completed his prayer in that manner. It was said to him, "Indeed, the people have differed in your prayer." So he came out and stood on the pulpit and said, "O people, I swear by Allah, I do not care if your prayers differ or not. This is how I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) bimaar ho gaye - ya kahin ghair-hazir thay - to Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne humein namaz padhayi, aur unhone takbeer buland awaz se kahi jab namaz shuru ki, aur jab ruku kiya, aur jab "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah" kaha, aur jab sajde se apna sar uthaya, aur jab sajda kiya, aur jab uthe, aur jab do rakaton ke baad khade huay, yahan tak ke unhone isi tarah apni namaz mukammal ki. To unse kaha gaya: "Logon ne aapki namaz (ke tareeqe) mein ikhtilaf kiya hai." To woh bahar aaye aur mimbar par khade hokar farmaya: "Aye logo, Allah ki qasam, mujhe koi parwah nahi ke tumhari namaz alag ho ya na ho, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko isi tarah namaz padhte dekha hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to separate his fingers when he performed the ruku' (bowing) position.
hi: Nabi (SAW) jab ruku karte to apni ungliyan alag-alag (khuli) rakhte.

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught us the prayer. He stood up and said the takbir, and when he wanted to bow, he put his hands together and put his hands between his knees and bowed." News of that reached Sa'd and he said: "My brother has spoken the truth. We used to do that, then we were commanded to do this," meaning to hold the knees. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1031)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein namaz sikhayi. Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) ne takbeer kahi, phir jab ruku karna chaha to apne dono haath apne ghutnon ke darmiyan jode." Unhone kaha: yeh baat Sa'd (RA) tak pahunchi to unhone kaha: "Mere bhai ne sach kaha, hum aisa hi kiya karte the, phir humein is (nayi baat) ka hukum diya gaya" - ya'ni ghutnon ko pakadne ka.

e: [AI] "Tell us about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he stood in front of us in the mosque. He said the Takbeer (Allahu Akbar) and when he went into the bowing position, he said the Takbeer and placed his hands on his knees, with his fingers below them, and then straightened his back to stand up again. This is how we saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  do it."
hi: "Humein Rasulullah (SAW) ki namaz ke baare mein bataiye," to woh humare saamne masjid mein khade huay. "Unhone takbeer kahi, phir jab ruku kiya to takbeer kahi aur apni hatheliyan apne ghutnon par rakhi, apni ungliyan usse neeche rakhi, phir apni kohniyan (apne pehlu se) alag rakhin," phir unhone kaha: "Hum ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko isi tarah karte dekha hai."

e: [AI] Translation: We have the messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Place it in your bowing."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: "Ise apne ruku mein (padho)."

e: When "Glorify the name of your mighty Lord" was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Use it when bowing, and when "Glorify the name of your most high Lord" was revealed, he said: Use it when prostrating yourself. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 869)
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "Apne Rab-e-Azeem ke naam ki tasbeeh karo" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 74), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: "Ise apne ruku mein padho." Phir jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "Apne Rab-e-A'la ke naam ki tasbeeh karo" (Surah Al-A'la 1), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: "Ise apne sajde mein padho."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi praised what was recited by Malik and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Salamah informed me, narrating from Uthman ibn Sa'id al-Darimi, who narrated from Yahya ibn Bukayr, who narrated from Malik, and Ahmad ibn Ja'far informed us, narrating from Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Hanbal, who narrated from his father, who said: I read upon Abdurrahman ibn Mahdi from Malik, from Nuaim ibn Abdullah al-Mujmir, from Ali ibn Yahya ibn Khalbadd al-Zurqi, from his father, from Rifaa'ah ibn Rafa', from whom he narrated that he said: "One day, we were praying with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When he raised his head from the prostration, he said, 'Allah listens to the one who praises Him.' A man said, 'Our Lord, to You belongs all praise, abundant, pure, blessed, and plentiful.' When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  finished, he said, 'Who spoke earlier?' The man said, 'It was me, O Messenger of Allah.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I saw thirty-two angels competing to write it down.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: aik din hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath namaz padh rahe the, jab aap (SAW) ne ruku se apna sar uthaya to farmaya: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah" (Allah ne suni us ki jisne uski hamd ki). Aik shakhs ne kaha: "Rabbana wa lakal hamd, hamdan kaseeran tayyiban mubarakan feehi" (Aye humare Rab, tere hi liye hamd hai, bohot, paak aur barkat wali hamd). Jab Rasulullah (SAW) namaz se farigh huay to poocha: "Abhi kaun bol raha tha?" Us shakhs ne kaha: "Main tha, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine teentees se zyada farishton ko dekha, aik doosre se aage badh kar isse likhne ki koshish kar rahe the."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited the supplication (Qunut) daily for a month at the noon, afternoon, sunset, night and morning prayers. When he said: "Allah listens to him who praises Him" in the last rak'ah, invoking a curse on some clans of Banu Sulaym, Ri'l, Dhakwan and Usayyah, and those who were standing behind him said: Amen. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1443)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik mahine tak musalsal Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha aur Fajr mein har namaz ke aakhir mein qunut padhi, jab bhi "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah" kehte, aakhri rak'at mein Bani Sulaim ke qabile - Ri'l, Dhakwan aur Usayyah - ke khilaf bad-dua karte, aur unke peechhe wale "Ameen" kehte. Aap (SAW) ne unki taraf Islam ki dawat dene ke liye (qasid) bheje thay, magar unhone unhein qatl kar diya tha. Ikrimah ne kaha: "Yehi qunut ki chaabi (asal wajah) hai."

e: It was narrated from ‘Alqamah that Ibn Mas’ud prostrated twice for the prostrations of forgetfulness after the Salam, and he mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ did that.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1218)
hi: ...aur farmaya: "Nabi (SAW) aisa kiya karte thay."

e:
[AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  raising his hands until they were level with his ears, then he performed the bowing (rukoo') until every joint in his body was settled, and he extended the takbeer until his hands were level with his knees."

"This is an authentic chain of narration according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs, and I do not know of any defect in it as they have not rejected it."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, aap (SAW) ne takbeer kahi aur apne dono anguthe apne kaanon ke barabar kiye, phir ruku kiya yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ka har mafsal (jod) sukoon se aa gaya, aur takbeer ke sath jhuke yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ke ghutne aap (SAW) ke haathon se pehle (zameen ki taraf) badh gaye." Yeh isnad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai aur mujhe iski koi illat maloom nahi, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Both hands prostrate as the face prostrates. When one of you puts his face (on the ground) he should put his hands too (on the ground). And when he raises it, he should raise them too. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 892)
hi: "Beshak dono haath bhi usi tarah sajda karte hain jaise chehra sajda karta hai, isliye jab tum mein se koi apna chehra (zameen par) rakhe to apne haath bhi rakhe, aur jab use uthaye to unhein bhi uthaye."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Bara' ibn 'Azib saying that the Prophet ﷺ used to prostrate on the palms of his hands.
hi: Maine Al-Bara' bin Azib (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Nabi (SAW) "apni hatheli ke gudde (aidiyon) par sajda karte thay."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'ani reported that Dawud ibn Qais narrated from Ubaidullah ibn Abdullah ibn Akram, from his father, that he was with his father in a place called al-Qa'a, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed the prayer. He said, "I used to look at the armpits of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  whenever he prostrated."
hi: ...jabke woh apne walid ke sath Naa'mira ke maidaan mein thay, ke Rasulullah (SAW) namaz padh rahe thay, "to main Rasulullah (SAW) ki baaghlon ki safedi dekhta jab bhi aap (SAW) sajda karte."

e: [AI] The translation of the given text in English is: "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  used to "place his fingers together when he prostrated."
hi: Nabi (SAW) "jab sajda karte to apni ungliyan mila lete."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not stretch out your arms and lean on your sides, and do not neglect your feet. For if you do that, every part of your body will prostrate along with you." "Al-Bukhari relied on the testimony of Adam ibn Ali al-Bakri, and Muslim relied on the testimony of Muhammad ibn Ishaq, and this is authentic and they did not exclude it." Authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni baazuon ko na phailao, apni hatheliyon par sahara lo, aur apne pehlu se apni kohniyan alag rakho, kyunke agar tum aisa karoge to tumhare sath tumhara har ang bhi sajda karega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say, "When a man prays with tranquility, I heard Abu Zakaria al-Anbari saying, 'He prays with tranquility when he extends his arms and keeps them away during ruku' (bowing) and sujud' (prostration)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab namaz padhte to (baazuon ko) phailate." Maine Abu Zakariya Al-Anbari ko kehte hue suna: "Aadmi apni namaz mein 'jakh' karta hai jab woh apni kohniyan phailaye aur ruku-o-sajda mein (pehlu se) alag rakhe."

e: I came to the Prophet ﷺ from behind. I saw the whiteness of his armpits and he kept his arms away from his sides and raised his stomach (from the ground). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 899)
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas peechhe se aaya, "to maine aap (SAW) ki baaghlon ki safedi dekhi jabke aap (SAW) (kohniyan) phailaye huay the aur apne haath bahar nikale huay the."

e: [AI] The translation of the given text from Arabic to English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to place his arms firmly on the ground when he prostrated."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab sajda karte to aap (SAW) ki baaghlon ki safedi dikhai deti."

e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated himself, if a lamb wanted to pass between his arms, it could pass. (Using translation from Muslim 496)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab sajda karte to agar koi bakri ka bachcha aap (SAW) ke haathon ke darmiyan se guzarna chahta to guzar sakta tha."

e: [AI] Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , I lost the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he was lying on my bed, and I found him prostrating, with his feet facing towards the Qibla, and I heard him saying, "I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your wrath, and in Your forgiveness from Your punishment, and I praise You in a manner that befits You. I cannot fully encompass Your greatness." When he finished, he said, "O Aisha, did your Shaytan deceive you?" So I said, "Do you have a Shaytan, Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Every person has a Shaytan." I said, "And even you, Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Yes, but Allah has helped me against him, so he has become a Muslim."
hi: Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki zaujah, [ne kaha]: main ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko na paya, jabke woh mere sath mere bistar par thay, to maine unhein sajde mein paaya, apni aidiyan milaye huay, apni ungliyon ke sironse Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh, maine unhein yeh kehte suna: "Main teri raza ki panah maangta hoon tere ghazab se, aur teri maafi ki panah maangta hoon teri saza se, aur teri hi panah maangta hoon tujh se, main teri tareef bayan nahi kar sakta jaisi tu khud apni tareef karta hai." Jab aap (SAW) namaz se farigh huay to farmaya: "Aye Aisha, kya tumhare Shaitan ne tumhein pakad liya?" Maine kaha: "Kya aapka koi Shaitan hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi insaan aisa nahi jiska koi Shaitan na ho." Maine kaha: "Aapka bhi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mera bhi, lekin Allah ne mujhe uske khilaf madad ki, to woh Musalman ho gaya."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited to peck like a crow, and to spread (the forearms) like a wild beast, and to fix a place in the mosque like a camel which fixes its place. These are the wordings of Qutaybah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 862)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mana kiya kaunwe ki tarah (jaldi jaldi) chonch marne se, darinde ki tarah (baazuain) bichhane se, aur is baat se ke koi aadmi masjid mein khaas jagah muqarrar kar le jaise unt apni jagah muqarrar kar leta hai.

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters. (Using translation from Muslim 1716b)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The worst of people in stealing is the one who steals their own prayer." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, how does one steal their own prayer?" He said, "They do not complete the bowing or prostration."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse bura chor woh hai jo apni namaz mein chori kare." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh apni namaz mein kaise chori karta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh apna ruku aur sajda mukammal nahi karta."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The worst of people in terms of theft is the one who steals his own prayer." They asked, "O Messenger of Allah, how does one steal their own prayer?" He said, "They do not complete its bowing and prostration." Both chains of narration are authentic and have not been reported separately.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak sabse bura chor woh hai jo apni namaz mein chori kare." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh apni namaz mein kaise chori karta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh apna ruku aur sajda mukammal nahi karta." (Dono asaneed sahih hain, aur unhone ise nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  prohibited a man from relying on his left hand when sitting in prayer." In the hadith of Ishaq, it is mentioned: "A man should rely on his hands in prayer."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mana kiya ke aadmi namaz mein baithte waqt apne baayan haath par sahara le. Ishaq ki hadith mein hai: "aadmi namaz mein apne dono haathon par sahara le."

e: It pertains to the sunnah to utter the tashahhud quietly. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 986)
hi: ...ke tashahhud khaamoshi se (aahista) kaha jaye.

e: [AI] This verse is recited in the tashahhud: "And do not be loud in your prayer or too low - and seek between that a way." [Al Isra 110]
hi: Yeh ayat tashahhud ke baare mein nazil hui: "Aur apni namaz mein na bohot buland awaz se paDho aur na bilkul aahista" (Surah Al-Isra 110).

e: [AI] On the authority of Abu Ali Al-Junbi, from Fadalah bin Ubaid Al-Ansari, who said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw a man praying but he did not praise Allah, glorify Him, or send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ . The man then departed, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Hurry after him." So he called him, and said to him and others, "When any of you prays, let him begin with praising his Lord, glorifying Him, and sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ . Then let him supplicate with whatever he desires."
hi: Abu Ali Al-Janbi se, unhone Fadalah bin Ubaid Al-Ansari (RA) se, ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko namaz padhte dekha jisne na Allah ki hamd ki, na uski ta'zeem ki, na Nabi (SAW) par durood bheja, aur (namaz se) chala gaya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isne jaldi ki." Phir aap (SAW) ne use bulwaya aur usse aur doosron se farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe to use chahiye ke pehle apne Rab ki hamd aur sana bayan kare, phir Nabi (SAW) par durood bheje, phir jo chahe dua kare."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  used to give one single salutation in prayer, tilting his face slightly towards the right side."
hi: Nabi (SAW) "namaz mein aik hi salaam phertay the, apne chehre ke saamne, thoda sa dayan taraf ki jaanib jhukte hue."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Omitting the greeting of peace (salam) is a sunnah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Salaam ko mukhtasar karna Sunnat hai."

e: [AI] Abu Al-Muwajjah narrated that Abdan reported that Abdullah reported from Al-Awza'i from Qurrat ibn Abdul Rahman from Al-Zuhri from Abu Salamah from Abu Hurayrah who said, "Omitting the greeting of peace (salaam) is a Sunnah."
hi: Abu Al-Muwajjah ne humein bataya, unhein Abdan ne bataya, unhein Abdullah ne Al-Awza'i se, unhone Qurrah bin Abdur Rahman se, unhone Az-Zuhri se, unhone Abu Salamah se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se bataya, unhone kaha: "Salaam ko mukhtasar karna Sunnat hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to recognize that it was a Surah when Gabriel came to him and recited "Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim"
hi: Nabi (SAW) "jab Jibra'il (AS) aap (SAW) ke paas aate aur 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem' padhte, to aap (SAW) jaan lete ke yeh koi surah hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to not know the end of a chapter until the verse "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful" was revealed.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ko surah ke khatam hone ka pata nahi chalta tha jab tak "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" nazil na hoti.

e: [AI] "The Muslims did not know the completion of a Surah until the Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim was revealed. When the Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim was revealed, they knew that the Surah had been completed." No mention was made of Rahim, Sa'id bin Jubayr."
hi: Musalmanon ko surah ke khatam hone ka pata nahi chalta tha jab tak "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" nazil na hoti, phir jab "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" nazil hoti to unhein pata chal jata ke surah khatam ho gayi hai. Raheem (raawi) ne Sa'eed bin Jubair ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to recite "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful" [Chapter Al-Fatiha, verse 1], and "All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds" [Chapter Al-Fatiha, verse 2]. He would recite them letter by letter.
hi: Nabi (SAW) "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" (Surah Al-Fatiha 1) aur "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen" (Surah Al-Fatiha 2) padhte, aur ise harf-ba-harf (rok-rok kar) padhte.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited in the prayer [Surah Al-Fatiha]: "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful." (1) He considered it as one verse. Then he recited: "Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds." (2) He considered it as two verses. Then he recited: "The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful." (1) He considered it as three verses. Then he recited: "Master of the Day of Judgment." He considered it as four verses. And he said: "This is how we worship You and seek help from You." (5) He showed the five fingers of his hand. "Umar ibn Harun said, 'This is a foundation in the Sunnah, and I have not seen anyone else mention it as a witness.' They unanimously agreed on its weakness, meaning Umar ibn Harun's statement. And Al-Nasai said, 'It is considered abandoned.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz mein "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" (Surah Al-Fatiha 1) padhi to ise aik ayat shumaar kiya, "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen" (Surah Al-Fatiha 2) do ayaat, "Ar-Rahmanir Raheem" teen ayaat, "Maliki Yaumid-Deen" chaar ayaat, aur farmaya isi tarah "Iyyaka Na'budu wa Iyyaka Nasta'een" (Surah Al-Fatiha 5), aur apni paanch ungliyan jama' ki. (Umar bin Harun Sunnat mein asal hain, magar dono ne ise nahi nikala, maine ise sirf shahid ke tor par nikala hai.) (Sabne unki (Umar bin Harun ki) kamzori par ittifaq kiya hai, aur Nasa'i ne unhein matrook (chhoda hua) kaha hai.)

e: "I prayed behind Abu Hurairah and he recited: In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, then he recited Umm Al-Qur'an (Al Fatihah), and when he reached: not (the way) of those who earned Your anger, nor of those who went astray, he said: 'Amin and the people said 'Amin. And every time he prostrated he said: 'Allahu Akbar and when he stood up from sitting after two Rak'ahs he said: 'Allahu Akbar'. And after he had said the Salam he said: 'By the One in Whose Hand is my soul! My prayer most closely remembers the prayer of the Messenger of Allah.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 905)
hi: Main Abu Hurairah (RA) ke peechhe (namaz mein) tha, unhone "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" padha, phir Umm-ul-Quran (Surah Fatiha) padhi yahan tak ke "Wala-ddaalleen" tak pahunche, to "Ameen" kaha, aur logon ne bhi "Ameen" kaha. Jab bhi sajda karte to "Allahu Akbar" kehte, aur jab salaam phertay to kehte: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tum sabse zyada apni namaz mein Rasulullah (SAW) ki namaz se milta-julta hoon."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful" out loud. Muhammad is weak, meaning Muhammad ibn Qais.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" buland awaz se padhte. (Muhammad za'if hain, ya'ni Muhammad bin Qais.)

e: [AI] "Muawiya performed salah (prayer) in Al-Madinah loudly, reciting with a loud voice. He recited in it (the prayer) 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' for Umm al-Quran (the opening chapter of the Quran) but did not recite 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' for the following chapter until he completed that recitation. When he finished the prayer, someone who heard this from the Muhajireen (Emigrants) and the Ansar (Helpers) called out to him, 'O Muawiya, did you steal the prayer or forget?' When he prayed after that, he recited 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' for the following chapter after Umm al-Quran and made a loud takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar) when he prostrated."
hi: "Muawiyah (RA) ne Madinah mein aik namaz padhi jismein qira'at buland awaz se ki, unhone usme Umm-ul-Quran (Surah Fatiha) ke liye 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem' padha, magar uske baad wali surah ke liye 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem' nahi padha yahan tak ke woh qira'at mukammal kar li." Jab unhone salaam phera to jinhone yeh suna, Muhajireen aur Ansar mein se, har jagah se unhein pukaara: "Aye Muawiyah, kya tumne namaz chura li ya bhool gaye?" "Phir jab unhone iske baad namaz padhi to Umm-ul-Quran ke baad wali surah ke liye 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem' padha aur sajde mein jate waqt takbeer kahi."

e: [AI] Anas bin Malik was asked, "How was the recitation of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He said, "It was elongated. He would recite, 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful,' (Surah Al-Fatiha, verse 1) elongating 'the Most Gracious' and 'the Most Merciful.'"
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se poocha gaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki qira'at kaisi thi?" Unhone kaha: "Woh lambi (madd wali) thi," phir unhone "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" padha, "Rahman" ko lamba karte huay aur "Raheem" ko lamba karte huay.

e: [AI] "Anas ibn Malik"
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) se.

e: [AI] "To follow the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the narrators of this hadith, including the last of them, are trustworthy and reliable."
hi: ...ke main Rasulullah (SAW) ki namaz ki iqtida (pairavi) karoon. (Is hadith ke raawi aakhir tak thiqa hain, aur unme se...)

e: [AI] I prayed behind the Prophet ﷺ , behind Abu Bakr, behind Umar, behind Uthman, and behind Ali, and all of them used to recite "Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim" out loud. I mentioned this hadith as evidence for what has been mentioned before. In these narrations that we have mentioned, there is a contradiction to the narration of Qatadah that our Imams narrated from him, and it has remained in this chapter concerning the Commander of the Faithful Uthman, Ali, Talhah ibn Ubayd Allah, Jabir ibn Abdullah, Abdullah ibn Umar, Al-Hakam ibn Umayr ath-Thumali, Nu'man ibn Bashir, Samurah ibn Jundub, Buraydah al-Aslami, and Aisha bint Siddiq. All of these are mentioned by me in this chapter. I have omitted some of them in order to simplify, and I have mentioned what is appropriate to this chapter. Similarly, I mentioned in this chapter the companions, followers, and their followers who recited Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim out loud. As for the author's hesitation to mention this fabricated hadith, I swear by Allah that he is lying and Allah knows best.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ke peechhe namaz padhi, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ke peechhe, aur Umar (RA) ke peechhe, aur Uthman (RA) ke peechhe, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke peechhe, aur woh sab "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" buland awaz se padhte the. (Maine yeh hadith sirf pehle wali baat ke liye shahid ke tor par zikr ki hai, kyunke in riwayaton mein Qatadah ki us hadith ka mu'aarza (ta'aarud) hai jo hamare a'imma unse riwayat karte hain, aur is baab mein Ameer-ul-Momineen Uthman (RA), Ali (Alayhis Salam), Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA), Jabir bin Abdullah (RA), Abdullah bin Umar (RA), Al-Hakam bin Umair Ath-Thumali (RA), Nu'man bin Bashir (RA), Samurah bin Jundub (RA), Buraidah Al-Aslami (RA) aur Aisha bint As-Siddiq (RA) se bhi (riwayaten) baaqi hain - yeh sab mere paas is baab mein nikali hui hain, maine unhein takhfeef (mukhtasar rakhne) ki khatir chhod diya hai, aur unme se sirf woh liya hai jo is baab ke munasib tha, aur isi tarah maine is baab mein un Sahaba (RA), Tabi'in aur unke shagirdon ka bhi zikr kiya hai jinhone 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem' buland awaz se padhi.) Musannif ne is jhoothi hadith ko zikr karne mein sharm mahsoos nahi ki, main Allah ki qasam khakar aur Allah ke liye gawahi deta hoon ke yeh jhoot hai.

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah entered the mosque of Bani Zuraiq and said, "There are three things that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do, but people have neglected them. When he stood up for prayer, he would say this, and Abu 'Amir pointed with his hand, not separating his fingers and not closing them."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) humare paas Banu Zuraiq ki masjid mein aaye aur kaha: "Teen (baatein) hain jo Rasulullah (SAW) kiya karte the, logon ne unhein chhod diya hai: aap (SAW) jab namaz ke liye khade hote to aisa karte" - aur Abu Aamir ne apne haath se ishara kiya, apni ungliyan na alag rakhte huay na milaate huay.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to spread his fingers during prayer is narrated by Sa'id ibn Sam'an, a well-known follower from the people of Madinah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "namaz mein apni ungliyan poori tarah phailate the." (Sa'eed bin Sam'an aik jaana-mana Tabi'i hain, Madinah ke rehne wale.)

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say, when starting the prayer, "Allah is the greatest, the Most Great, and all praise is due to Allah abundantly. Glory be to Allah in the morning and evening." He would repeat this three times. Then he would say, "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the accursed Satan, from his whispers, his spitting, and his breath."
hi: Nabi (SAW) "jab namaz shuru karte to farmate: 'Allahu Akbaru Kabeera, wal-hamdu lillahi Katheera, wa Subhanallahi bukratan wa asila' (Allah bohot bada hai, Allah ki bohot hamd hai, aur Allah ki subah-shaam tasbeeh)," teen martaba, "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon dhutkare hue Shaitan se, uske waswase, uske thookne aur uske phoonkne (ghuroor) se."

e: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ started to pray, he would say: 'Subhanakallahumma, wa bihamdika tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghairuk (Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. Blessed be Your name and exalted be Your majesty, there is none worthy of worship except You.)" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 900)
