hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab namaz shuru karte to farmate: 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghairuk' (Aye Allah, tu paak hai aur tera hi hamd hai, tera naam bab-barkat hai, teri shaan buland hai, aur tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi)."

e: [AI] "Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name, and exalted is Your greatness. There is no god but You." "This hadith (narration) has been attributed to Umar, but it is not considered authentic."
hi: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghairuk." (Yeh hadith Umar (RA) se bhi mansoob ki gayi hai, magar woh sahih nahi hai.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Dhuhr prayer with us, and when he finished, he called out to a man who was at the back of the rows and said, "O so-and-so, don't you fear Allah? Don't you pay attention to how you pray? Indeed, when any of you stands for prayer, he is conversing privately with his Lord, so let him pay attention to how he converses with Him. Surely, you all see me, but by Allah, I see what is behind my back just as I see what is in front of me."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Zuhr ki namaz padhayi, jab salaam phera to aik shakhs ko pukaara jo pichli saffon mein tha, aur farmaya: "Aye fulan, kya tum Allah se nahi darte? Kya tum nahi dekhte tum kaise namaz padh rahe ho? Beshak tum mein se koi jab namaz ke liye khada hota hai to woh apne Rab se munajat (sirgoshi) karta hai, isliye use dekhna chahiye ke woh kaise munajat kar raha hai. Tum samajhte ho ke main tumhein nahi dekhta, lekin Allah ki qasam, main apni peeth ke peechhe se bhi waisa hi dekhta hoon jaisa apne saamne se dekhta hoon."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Allah, the Most High, continues to turn favourably towards a servant while he is engaged in prayer as long as he does not look to the side (by turning the neck), but if he does so, He turns away from him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 909)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah bande ki taraf tawajjo diye rehta hai jab tak woh idhar-udhar na dekhe, phir jab woh apna chehra pher le to Allah bhi uski taraf se mun mod leta hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  informed them, saying: "Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, commanded Yahya ibn Zakariya with five words that he should act upon. So when you stand in prayer, do not turn your faces away, for indeed, Allah, the Exalted, turns His face towards the face of His servant, until He prays for him. He does not turn His face away from him until the servant turns away." The two scholars, with their chains of narration, have narrated this hadith from the last of them. However, we did not find any other narrators for Al-Harith Al-Ash'ari except for Mamtuur Ibn Abi Salam, so they abandoned it. I have spoken about this matter in another place, and it suffices to not repeat it. The hadith is authentic, and preserved according to the conditions of the Imams.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unhein bataya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ko paanch baaton ka hukum diya jinpar unhein amal karna tha: jab tum apne chehre (namaz mein Allah ki taraf) sidhaayo to idhar-udhar na dekho, kyunke Allah Ta'ala apna chehra apne bande ke chehre ki taraf sidha rakhta hai yahan tak ke woh uski taraf namaz padhe, to woh apna chehra usse nahi phairta jab tak ke bande khud (namaz se) na phir jaye." (Shaykhain ne is hadith ke raawiyon ko - Al-Harith Al-Ash'ari ke ilawa - aakhir tak riwayat kiya hai, aur humein Al-Harith Al-Ash'ari ka koi raawi Mamtoor Abu Sallam ke ilawa nahi mila, isliye unhone unhein chhod diya. Maine is tarah ki baat aur jagah bhi ki hai, isliye dobara zikr ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh hadith a'imma ki shart par sahih aur mahfooz hai.)

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to turn to his right and left when praying, but he did not twist his neck to look behind him." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1201)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "namaz mein dayan aur bayan taraf dekhte the, lekin apni gardan apni peeth ke peechhe nahi modte the."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was heading towards Hunayn, he said, "Will anyone keep watch over us tonight?" Anas ibn Abi Marthad al-Ghanawi said, "I will, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Go." The next day, the Prophet ﷺ  came out and asked, "Have you spotted your warrior?" They replied, "No." So, the Prophet ﷺ  started praying and turned towards the troops. When he finished his prayer, he said, "Your warrior has come forward." When he arrived, the Prophet ﷺ  asked, "Have you descended?" He replied, "No, except for prayer or to fulfill a need." Then he said, "I surveyed the two armies, and I found that they are well-equipped and at their best, heading towards Hunayn." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There will be spoils for the Muslims tomorrow, if Allah wills." (Sahih)
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Hunain ki taraf rawana huay to farmaya: "Kya koi hai jo aaj raat humari raakhwaali kare?" To Anas bin Abi Marthad Al-Ghanawi (RA) ne kaha: "Main, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jao." Jab subah hui to Nabi (SAW) nikle aur poocha: "Kya tumne apne sawaar ka koi ehsaas kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." To Nabi (SAW) namaz padhne lage aur ghaati ki taraf dekhte rahe, jab salaam phera to farmaya: "Beshak tumhara sawaar aa gaya hai." Jab woh aaye to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Shayad tum utar gaye the?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, sirf namaz ke liye ya zaroorat poori karne ke liye." Phir unhone kaha: "Maine do ghaatiyon ka mu'aina kiya, to Hawazin apne khaimon, bakriyon aur maweshiyon ke sath Hunain ki taraf jaate hue paaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kal Musalmanon ke liye ghaneemat hai, Insha'Allah." Sahih.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited Surat Al-A'raf in maghrib and split it between two rak'ahs. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 991)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "Maghrib ki dono rak'aton mein Surah Al-A'raf padhte the."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said, 'The mother of the Quran is a substitute and there is no substitute for it.' The two scholars agree on narrating this Hadith from Zubair with different wording. The narrators of this Hadith are mostly Imams, and all of them are trustworthy according to their conditions. There are multiple variations of this Hadith in different words that have not been mentioned. The chains of narration are authentic, and among them..."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Umm-ul-Quran (Surah Fatiha) doosri (surahon) ka badal hai, magar koi doosri (surah) iska badal nahi ho sakti." (Shaykhain ka is hadith ko Az-Zuhri se mukhtalif tareeqon se, doosre alfaz ke sath, nikalne par ittifaq hai, aur is hadith ke aksar raawi a'imma hain aur sab unki shart par thiqa hain, aur is hadith ke mukhtalif alfaz mein shawahid bhi hain jo unhone nahi nikale aur unki asaneed durust hain, unme se...)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever prays a prescribed prayer with the imam, let him recite the opening chapter of the book (i.e., Al-Fatiha) silently. And whoever reaches the mother of the book (i.e., Surah Al-Fatiha), then he has completed his prayer."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs imam ke sath farz namaz padhe, use chahiye ke woh Fatihat-ul-Kitab (Surah Fatiha) imam ki khaamoshiyon mein padhe, aur jo Umm-ul-Kitab tak pahunch jaye to yeh usske liye kaafi hai."

e: "Messenger of Allah prayed the Subh prayer, and he had difficulty with the recitation. When turned (after finishing) he said: 'I think that you are reciting behind your Imam?'" He said: "We said: 'Yes, Messenger of Allah, by Allah!' He said: 'Do not do that, except for Umm Al-Kitab, for there is no Salat for one who does not recite it.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 311)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fajr ki namaz padhi to qira'at unpar bhaari (mushkil) ho gayi, jab woh farigh huay to farmaya: "Main tumhein apne Imam ke peechhe (Quran) padhte hue dekh raha hoon." Hum ne kaha: "Ji haan, Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aisa hi hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aisa mat karo, siwaye Umm-ul-Quran ke, kyunke jo ise nahi padhta uski namaz nahi hoti." (Mahmood bin Ar-Rabi' ne apne aur Ubadah (RA) ke darmiyan Wahb bin Kaysan ko shamil kiya hai.)

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Do you all read in prayer with me?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Do not do so except with the opening chapter of the Book (Al-Fatiha) and among its verses."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum mere sath (namaz mein) qira'at karte ho?" Hum ne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To sirf Fatihat-ul-Kitab (Surah Fatiha) ke sath hi aisa karo," aur usme se...

e: [AI] Abadah bin As-Samit stood by my side and recited alongside the imam while he was reciting. When he finished, I said, "O Abu Al-Walid, you recite and listen while he recites aloud?" He replied, "Yes, we used to recite with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  made a mistake. Then he praised Allah and said to us when he finished, 'Did anyone recite along with me?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'I am amazed by this person who argues with me in recitation. When the imam recites, do not recite except with the Ummul Quran (Surah Al-Fatiha), for there is no prayer for those who do not recite it.' This is a narration from Makhul from Mahmoud bin Ar-Rabi' who is esteemed. And if it is a narration from Ishaq bin Abi Farwah, I remembered it as a witness."
hi: Mere pehlu mein Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) khade huay aur unhone imam ke sath, jab woh (jahri) qira'at kar raha tha, khud bhi qira'at ki. Jab woh (namaz se) farigh huay to maine kaha: "Aye Abu Al-Waleed, aap qira'at karte hain aur (khud bhi) sunte hain jabke woh (imam) buland awaz se qira'at kar raha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath qira'at karte the, phir Rasulullah (SAW) se (qira'at mein) ghalti ho gayi, phir aap (SAW) ne tasbeeh padhi aur jab farigh huay to humse farmaya: 'Kya mere sath kisi ne qira'at ki?' Hum ne kaha: 'Ji haan.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mujhe ta'ajjub hua,' maine kaha: 'isi (shakhs) se jo Quran mein mujh se jhagda karta hai. Jab imam qira'at kare to sirf Umm-ul-Quran (Surah Fatiha) ke sath (khamoshi se) qira'at karo, kyunke jo ise nahi padhta uski namaz nahi hoti.'" (Yeh Makhool ki, Mahmood bin Ar-Rabi' se riwayat mein, mutaba'at hai, aur yeh gharib (kam-yaab) hai.) Agarche yeh Ishaq bin Abi Farwah ki riwayat hai, phir bhi maine ise shahid ke tor par zikr kiya hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me to announce that prayer is not valid but with the recitation of Fatihat al-kitab and something more. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 820)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh bahar jakar logon mein aelaan karein ke Fatihat-ul-Kitab (Surah Fatiha) ki qira'at aur usse zyada ke bagair namaz nahi hoti.

e:
[AI] Read with the opening of the book, I said, "And if you are?"
He said, "And if I am," I said, "And if you speak loudly?"
He said, "And if I speak loudly." Correct.
hi: "Fatihat-ul-Kitab padho." Maine poocha: "Agarche aap khud (imam) hon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agarche main khud (imam) hoon." Maine poocha: "Agarche aap buland awaz se padhen?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agarche main buland awaz se padhoon." Sahih.

e: “We used to recite the Opening of the Book and a Surah behind the Imam in the first two Rak’ah of the Zuhr and the ‘Asr, and in the last wo Rak’ah (we would recite) the Opening of the Book.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 843)
hi: Ke imam ke peechhe pehli do rak'aton mein Fatihat-ul-Kitab aur (koi) surah padhi jaye, aur baaqi (do) mein sirf Fatihat-ul-Kitab. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to pray a similar prayer to yours, but he used to shorten the prayer. He would recite Surah Al-Waqi'ah and similar Surahs in the Fajr prayer.
hi: Nabi (SAW) "tumhari namaz jaisi hi namaz padhte the, lekin aap (SAW) namaz halki (mukhtasar) karte the. Aap (SAW) Fajr ki namaz mein Surah Al-Waqi'ah aur usi jaisi (lambi) surahein padhte the."

e: [AI] I asked Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  about the "Mu'awwidhatayn" from the Quran. What are they? The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "They are the two surahs with which the Prophet ﷺ  sought refuge in the Fajr prayer."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se Mu'awwidhatayn (Surah Al-Falaq aur An-Nas) ke baare mein poocha ke kya woh Quran mein se hain? "To Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Fajr ki namaz mein unhi ke sath imamat ki."

e: [AI] "I was driving the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ  mount during a journey when he said, 'O Uqbah, shall I not teach you two surahs that are recited?' I said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak" and say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind".' When he descended, he prayed them during the morning prayer, then he asked me, 'How do you see it, O Uqbah?' As for the hadith of Zaid ibn Al-Hubab from Mu'awiya ibn Salih, it is similar to this chain of narration. And Allah knows best."
hi: Main safar mein Rasulullah (SAW) ki sawari ki lagaam pakde chal raha tha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Uqbah, kya main tumhein do behtareen padhi jane wali surahein na sikhaun?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: A'oozu bi Rabbil-Falaq, aur kaho: A'oozu bi Rabbin-Naas." Jab aap (SAW) (sawari se) utre to Fajr ki namaz unhi ke sath padhi, phir farmaya: "Kaisa laga, aye Uqbah?" Rahi baat Zaid bin Al-Hubab ki, Muawiyah bin Salih se, isi sanad ki hadith ki, to yeh sanad pehli ko kamzor nahi karti, kyunke yeh doosri matan ki sanad hai, wallahu a'lam.

e: [AI] A man used to lead them (the prayer) in Quba, so whenever he intended to start a surah, he would recite "Say, He is Allah, the One," then continue reciting the rest of the surah throughout his prayer. His companions said to him, "Shouldn't you leave this surah or recite another one instead of always reciting 'Say, He is Allah, the One?'" He replied, "I will not leave it, and if you want me to lead you in prayer with it, then I will continue doing so. Otherwise, no." He was one of the best amongst them, and they disliked anyone else leading them in prayer. So they went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and mentioned that to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called him and said, "O so-and-so, what prevents you from doing what your companions ask you to do? What makes you adhere to this surah?" He replied, "I love it, O Messenger of Allah!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Your love for it has admitted you to Paradise."
hi: Aik shakhs Quba mein logon ki imamat karta tha, jab woh koi surah shuru karta to "Qul Huwallahu Ahad" padhta, phir usi ke sath (doosri) surah padhta, apni har namaz mein aisa hi karta. Uske sathiyon ne usse kaha: "Kya tum is surah ko chhod nahi sakte, ya 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad' hi padh liya karo aur (doosri surah) chhod diya karo?" Usne unse kaha: "Main ise nahi chhodunga, agar tum chaho to main tumhein isi tarah imamat karaunga, warna nahi," aur woh unme sabse afzal tha, aur woh nahi chahte the ke koi aur unki imamat kare. To woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaye aur yeh baat zikr ki. Rasulullah (SAW) ne use bulwaya aur farmaya: "Aye fulan, tumhein apne sathiyon ke hukum par amal karne se kya rok raha hai? Aur tumhein is surah ko lazim pakadne par kis cheez ne ubhaara hai?" Usne kaha: "Mujhe ye pasand hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iski mohabbat ne tumhein Jannat mein dakhil kar diya hai."

e: “I heard Abu Dharr say: ‘The Prophet ﷺ stood reciting a Verse and repeating it until morning came. That Verse was: “If you punish them, they are Your slaves, and if You forgive them, verily You, only You, are the All- Mighty, the All-Wise.’”” [5:118] (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1350)
hi: Maine Abu Dharr (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Nabi (SAW) aik ayat ko dohrate hue subah tak khade rahe, aur woh ayat thi: "Agar tu unhein azab de to woh tere bande hain, aur agar tu unhein maaf kar de to beshak tu hi ghalib, hikmat wala hai" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 118).

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, teach me something from the Quran that will suffice me." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Say: Subhanallah (Glory be to Allah), Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah), La ilaha illallah (There is no god but Allah), Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest), La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no power or might except with Allah)." The man repeated these words with his hand on his chest and said, "This is for my Lord, what should I do next?" The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Say: 'Forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, provide for me, and protect me.'" The man repeated these words with his other hand on his chest, and then he stood up. Ja'far ibn Awf added to his narration, "I was present with Ibrahim when he narrated this hadith, and I memorized it from him."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe Quran mein se koi aisi cheez sikha dijiye jo mere liye kaafi ho, kyunke main padh nahi sakta." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: Subhanallah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah." Us shakhs ne apne haath se (ungliyan) band kar li aur kaha: "Yeh mere Rab ke liye hai, to mere liye kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar, mujh par reham kar, mujhe hidayat de, mujhe rizq de aur mujhe aafiyat de." Usne apne doosre haath se bhi (ungliyan) band kar li aur khada ho gaya." Ja'far bin Awn ne apni hadith mein ziyaadti ki. Mis'ar ne kaha: "Main Ibrahim ke paas tha jabke woh yeh hadith bayan kar rahe the, to maine ise doosre se bhi tasdeeq karaya."

e: [AI] He was sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when a man came and entered the mosque and prayed. When he finished his prayer, he greeted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and the people. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Go back and pray, as you have not prayed." He mentioned this either twice or three times. The man said, "I do not know what you mean by not praying properly." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The prayer of none of you is complete until he performs ablution as Allah the Almighty has commanded. He washes his face and hands up to the elbows, wipes his head and feet up to the ankles. Then he says the takbeer, praises and glorifies Allah, recites from the Qur'an what Allah has permitted him, then he says the takbeer, bows and places his hands on his knees until his joints are still. Then he stands straight, saying, 'Allah hears whoever praises Him.' He stands straight until every bone returns to its place. Then he performs prostration and places his forehead on the ground until his joints are still. He stands straight, saying the takbeer, raises his head and sits straight on his sitting position while keeping his back straight. He establishes his prayer in this manner until he is finished. Then he said, 'None of your prayers are complete until you do this.'"
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas baithe huay thay ke aik shakhs aaya, masjid mein dakhil hua aur namaz padhi. Jab usne apni namaz mukammal ki to aaya, Rasulullah (SAW) ko aur logon ko salaam kiya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunke tumne namaz nahi padhi," aur yeh baat do ya teen martaba farmayi. To us shakhs ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata aapne meri namaz mein kya aib nikala." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi ki namaz us waqt tak mukammal nahi hoti jab tak woh wudu poora na kare, jaise Allah Azza wa Jalla ne use hukum diya hai: apna chehra aur haath kohniyon tak dhoye, apne sar aur paon ka takhnon tak masah kare, phir takbeer kahe, Allah ki hamd aur ta'zeem bayan kare, aur Quran mein se jo Allah ne ijaazat di ho woh padhe, phir takbeer kahe, ruku kare aur apni hatheliyan apne ghutnon par rakhe yahan tak ke uske mafaasil (jod) sukoon se aa jaayen aur woh seedha ho jaye, phir kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' aur khada ho jaye yahan tak ke uski har haddi apni jagah aa jaye, phir apni kamar seedhi kare, phir takbeer kahe aur sajda kare, apni peshani zameen par jama de yahan tak ke uske mafaasil sukoon se aa jaayen aur woh seedha ho jaye, phir takbeer kahe aur apna sar uthaye, apni sarin (nashist) par seedha baithe aur apni kamar seedhi kare." Isi tarah aap (SAW) ne poori namaz bayan ki yahan tak ke woh khatam ho gayi, phir farmaya: "Tum mein se kisi ki namaz mukammal nahi hoti jab tak woh aisa na kare."

e: [AI] A man entered the mosque after the Prophet ﷺ had prayed, then he prayed. Then he mentioned the narration, and this chain of narration was reported by Dawud ibn Qays al-Farra, Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Yasār, and Isma'il ibn Ja'far ibn Abi Kathir. As for the narration of Dawud ibn Qays...
hi: Aik shakhs masjid mein dakhil hua jabke Nabi (SAW) namaz padh chuke thay, to usne namaz padhi, "phir hadith ka zikr kiya." Is sanad ko Dawud bin Qais Al-Farra, Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar aur Isma'il bin Ja'far bin Abi Kathir ne qaim rakha hai. Rahi baat Dawud bin Qais ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] "I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the mosque when a man entered and prayed two Rak'ahs, then he came and greeted us." And he mentioned the Hadith in its entirety, "As for the Hadith of Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Yasar"
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath masjid mein baitha tha, ke aik shakhs dakhil hua aur do rak'at namaz padhi, phir aaya aur salaam kiya," phir poori hadith ka zikr kiya. "Rahi baat Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar ki hadith ki..."

e: [AI] While we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the mosque, a man from the Ansar came after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had finished praying and he prayed. Then he approached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and greeted him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Go back and pray, for you have not prayed." Then he mentioned the hadith of Ismail bin Ja'far.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas masjid mein thay ke Ansar mein se aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke namaz se farigh hone ke baad aaya aur namaz padhi, phir aage aakar Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne khada hua aur salaam kiya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wa alaikum, wapas jao aur namaz padho, kyunke tumne namaz nahi padhi," phir hadith ka zikr kiya. "Rahi baat Isma'il bin Ja'far ki hadith ki..."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was sitting in the mosque one day, Rafaa'ah and I were with him, when a man resembling a Bedouin came and prayed. Then he mentioned a long Hadith (narration) according to their agreement.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik din masjid mein baithe huay thay - Rifa'ah ne kaha: hum bhi aap (SAW) ke sath thay - ke aik dehati jaisa shakhs aaya aur namaz padhi, phir hadith ka poora zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The one who leads the people in prayer is the one who knows the most Qur'an. And if they are equal in their knowledge of the Qur'an, then the one with the most emigration is the most deserving. And if they are equal in emigration, then the one with the most understanding of the religion is the most deserving. And if they are equal in their understanding, then the oldest among them is the most deserving." "Muslim has narrated the hadith of Isma'il ibn Raja'ah without mentioning the phrase 'the one with the most understanding of the religion'. This phrase is a rare but valuable wording in this authentic chain, and there is a supporting narration from Hujjaj ibn Arta'ah." Sahih.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qaum ki imamat woh kare jo sabse zyada Quran jaanta ho, agar Quran mein sab barabar hon to jo hijrat mein sabse pehle ho, agar hijrat mein bhi sab barabar hon to jo fiqh mein sabse zyada mahir ho, agar fiqh mein bhi sab barabar hon to jo umar mein sabse bada ho." Muslim ne Ismail bin Raja' ki yeh hadith nikali hai magar ismein 'jo fiqh mein sabse zyada mahir ho' ka zikr nahi kiya. Yeh lafz is sahih sanad ke sath gharib (kam-yaab) aur qeemti hai, aur iska aik shahid Hajjaj bin Artaah ki hadith se bhi milta hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The one with the most seniority in migration should lead the people. If they are equal in migration, then the one with the most knowledge in religion should lead them. If they are equal in religion, then the one who recites the Qur'an best should lead them. A man should not lead others in his dominion, nor should he sit on his honored seat without permission."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qaum ki imamat woh kare jo hijrat mein sabse pehle ho, agar hijrat mein sab barabar hon to jo deen ke fiqh mein sabse zyada mahir ho, agar deen mein bhi sab barabar hon to jo Quran ka sabse achha qari ho. Aur koi shakhs kisi doosre ki hukumat (ya ghar) mein uski imamat na kare, aur na hi uski ijazat ke bagair uski izzat wali jagah par baithe."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A prophet does not pass away until he is succeeded by a man from his own people."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Nabi is waqt tak wafat nahi paata jab tak uski qaum ka koi shakhs uski imamat na kar le."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up for prayer, he would say such and such from his right and from his left, then he would say, "Stand upright and align yourselves."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab namaz ke liye khade hote to apni dayan aur bayan taraf isi tarah kehte," phir farmate: "Seedhe khade ho jao aur (saffon mein) barabar ho jao."

e: "What kept you from praying? Are you not a Muslim man?" He said: "Yes, but I had already prayed with my family." The Messenger of Allah ﷺsaid to him: "When you come you should pray with the people even if you have already prayed." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 857)
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath baithe huay thay ke namaz ki azan hui, Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay aur namaz padhi, phir wapas aaye jabke Mihjan apni jagah baithe hue the. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Tumhein logon ke sath namaz padhne se kis cheez ne roka? Kya tum Musalman nahi ho?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), lekin Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine apne ghar walon ke sath namaz padh li thi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum (masjid mein) aao to logon ke sath namaz padho, chahe tumne (pehle) padh li ho."

e: [AI] It means: "The companion, if he does not have two narrators, his son should not take the narration from him."
hi: Ke sahabi ka, agar uske do raawi na hon, to unhone (Bukhari-Muslim) usse (riwayat) nahi nikali. Mihjan se sirf unke bete ne akele riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] I prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in Mina. When he finished the prayer, he noticed two men at the back of the people. He called them and said, "What prevented you from praying with the people?" They said, "O Messenger of Allah, we already prayed in our tents." He said, "Do not do so if any of you prays in his tent and then catches up with the congregation prayer, let him join them, as it will be a voluntary prayer for him."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Mina mein namaz padhi, jab aap (SAW) ne salaam phera to do aadmiyon ko logon ke pichle hisse mein dekha, unhein bulaya aur poocha: "Tumhein logon ke sath namaz padhne se kis cheez ne roka?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humne apne khaimon mein namaz padh li thi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aisa mat karo, jab tum mein se koi apne khaime mein namaz padh le, phir imam ke sath namaz pa le, to use chahiye ke woh unke sath bhi padhe, kyunke yeh uske liye nafl ban jayegi."

e: The Prophet said: "Whoever hears the call and does not come, his prayer is not valid, except for those who have an excuse." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 793)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs azan sune aur (uske) jawaab mein na aaye, uski koi namaz nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever hears the call to prayer and does not respond, his prayer is invalid unless he has a valid excuse." This narration is also relayed by Dawood bin Al-Hakam through Shu'bah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs azan sune aur uske paas na aaye, uski koi namaz nahi, siwaye kisi uzr (majboori) ke," aur usme se... (Dawud bin Al-Hakam ne Shu'bah se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever hears the call to prayer and does not respond to it, there will be no prayer for him except with an excuse." And in the narrations of Shu'bah, there are accompanying reports that are authenticated, some of which are...
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs azan sune aur uske paas na aaye, uski koi namaz nahi, siwaye kisi uzr ke." Aur Shu'bah ke shawahid mein iski musnad mutaba'aten hain, unme se...

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever hears the caller (to prayer) and does not prevent himself from following it has no prayer." They asked, "And what is the excuse?" He said, "Fear or illness."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs mu'adhdhin ko sune aur koi uzr use pairavi karne se na roke, uski koi namaz nahi." Sahaba (RA) ne poocha: "Uzr kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khauf ya bimari."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever hears the call to prayer and does not respond without excuse, Allah will not accept their prayer in any other way." It was asked, "What is considered an excuse?" He replied, "Sickness or fear." And among them.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs namaz ki sahih azan sune bagair kisi uzr ke aur us (namaz) mein na aaye, Allah uski kisi aur (jagah ki) namaz qubool nahi karega." Poocha gaya: "Uzr kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bimari ya khauf," aur usme se...

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no prayer for the neighbor of the mosque except in the mosque." This narration has been authenticated and reported by Abu Musa from his father, who heard the call to prayer but did not respond to the hadith.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Masjid ke padosi ki namaz sirf masjid mein hoti hai." Iski riwayat Abu Musa se, unke walid se, sahih sabit hui hai: "Jo azan sune aur jawaab na de" - hadith.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever hears the call and is free and in good health, yet does not respond, his prayer will not be accepted." Sahih.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs azan sune jabke woh farigh aur tandurust ho, phir jawaab na de, uski koi namaz nahi." Sahih.

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'There are no three individuals in a village or desert where the prayer is not established except that Satan has seized control over them. So, stick to the congregation.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Kisi basti ya registan mein teen (aadmi) aise nahi hote jinme namaz qaim na ki jaye, magar Shaitan unpar qaboo pa leta hai, isliye jama'at ko lazim pakdo."

e: "0 Messenger of Allah ﷺ, there are many (dangerous) pests and wild animals in Al-Madinah." He said: "Can you hear (the words) 'Come prayer, come to prosperity'?" He said "Yes." He said: "Then be quick to respond," and he did not grant him a dispensation. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 851)
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Madinah mein kaide-fasid janwar aur darinde bohot hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum 'Hayya alas-Salah, Hayya alal-Falah' sunte ho?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To (fauran) hazir ho jao," aur aap (SAW) ne unhein koi rukhsat (chhoot) nahi di.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  faced the people in the prayer of Isha and said, "I had intended to go to those who neglect this prayer and burn their houses upon them." Then, Ibn Umm Maktum stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, you know that I am blind and I have no guide." He asked, "Can you hear the call to prayer?" He replied, "Yes." He said, "Then come to it." He said, "O Messenger of Allah, there is a date palm tree and a tree between me and it, and I have no guide." He asked, "Can you hear the call to prayer?" He replied, "Yes." He said, "Then come to it." And he was not given permission, and there is another witness from the narration of Asim bin Bahdala.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Isha ki namaz mein logon ki taraf mutawajjeh huay aur farmaya: "Beshak mera iraada hai ke un logon ke paas jaun jo is namaz mein shareek nahi hote aur unke ghar jala dun." To Ibn Umm Maktum (RA) khade huay aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap jaante hain mera kya haal hai, mera koi rehnuma (rasta dikhaane wala) nahi hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum iqamat sunte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To hazir ho jao." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere aur masjid ke darmiyan khajooren aur darakht hain, aur mera koi rehnuma nahi." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum iqamat sunte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To hazir ho jao," aur unhein koi rukhsat nahi di. (Iska aik aur shahid Aasim bin Bahdalah ki hadith se bhi milta hai.)

e: Ibn Umm Maktum asked the Prophet ﷺ saying: Messenger of Allah, I am a blind man, my house is far away (from the mosque), and I have a guide who does not follow me. Is it possible that permission be granted to me for saying prayer in my house? He asked: Do you hear summons (adhan)? He said: Yes. He said: I do not find any permission for you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 552)
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) se poocha, kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aik nabeena (andha) shakhs hoon, mera ghar door hai, aur mera koi aisa rehnuma nahi jo mere sath munasib ho, to kya mujhe apne ghar mein namaz padhne ki rukhsat hai?" Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum azan sunte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe tumhare liye koi rukhsat nahi milti."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed the Fajr prayer and then asked, "Is so-and-so present?" For a group of hypocrites who did not attend the prayer. Then he said, "Indeed, these two prayers are the heaviest prayers on the hypocrites. If they knew the reward that these prayers contain, they would have come to them, even if they had to crawl." He means the Isha prayer and the Fajr prayer.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fajr ki namaz padhi, phir munafiqeen mein se aik giroh ke baare mein poocha jo namaz mein hazir nahi huay the: "Kya fulan hazir tha?" Phir farmaya: "Beshak yeh do namazein - Isha aur Fajr - munafiqeen par sabse bhaari namazein hain, aur agar unhein pata hota ke inme kya (sawab) hai to woh reng kar bhi aate."

e: [AI] "From Ubayy bin Ka'ab."
hi: Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) se.

e: [AI] About Ubayy ibn Ka'b, "As for the story of Al-Thawri..."
hi: Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) se. (Rahi baat Ath-Thawri ki hadith ki...)

e: [AI] "Ubayy ibn Ka'b, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him, prayed with us one morning along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When he finished his prayer, he said, 'I witnessed so and so.' Then he mentioned the hadith of Abu Al-Ahwas."
hi: Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) [ne kaha]: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din humein subah ki namaz padhayi, jab salaam phera to poocha: "Kya fulan hazir tha?" Phir hadith ka zikr kiya. (Rahi baat Abu Al-Ahwas ki hadith ki...)

e: [AI] Ubayy ibn Ka'b performed the Fajr prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , then he mentioned the narration: "They disagreed in the narration on Abu Ishaq from four aspects, and the narration about it from Abu Basir and his son Abdullah is all correct, and the evidence for it is the narration of Khalid ibn al-Harith." Shu'bah narrated this from Abu Ishaq, and Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh al-Anbari and Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated from Shu'bah: "As for the narration of Khalid ibn al-Harith..."
hi: Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) [ne kaha]: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Fajr ki namaz padhayi, phir hadith ka zikr kiya. (Is hadith ke baare mein Abu Ishaq se chaar tareeqon se ikhtilaf hua hai, aur Abu Basir aur unke bete Abdullah se ki gayi tamam riwayaten sahih hain, aur iski daleel Khalid bin Al-Harith ki riwayat hai.) Humein Shu'bah ne Abu Ishaq se, aur Muadh bin Muadh Al-Anbari aur Yahya bin Sa'eed ne Shu'bah se bataya. (Rahi baat Khalid bin Al-Harith ki hadith ki...)

e: [AI] I heard Ubayy bin Ka'b saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  led us in prayer and mentioned the hadith, 'Now as for Mu'adh bin Mu'adh...'"
hi: Maine Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein namaz padhayi, phir hadith ka zikr kiya. (Rahi baat Muadh bin Muadh ki...)

e: [AI] Abu Ishaq heard it from him and from his father, from Ubay ibn Ka'b, who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the Fajr prayer and mentioned the hadith of Yahya ibn Sa'id."
hi: Abu Ishaq [ne kaha]: maine yeh unse aur unke walid se, Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) se, suna hai, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fajr ki namaz padhi, phir hadith ka zikr kiya. (Rahi baat Yahya bin Sa'eed ki hadith ki...)

e: [AI] "Abu Ishaq, I heard from him and from his father, from Ubayy who said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed the morning prayer.' And he mentioned the narration, 'The scholars of hadith, Yahya ibn Ma'in, Ali ibn Al-Madini, Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Zuhri, and others have ruled the authenticity of this hadith.' I heard Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad ibn Ya'qub saying, 'I heard Abbas ibn Muhammad Al-Dawri saying, 'I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in saying, 'The hadith of Abu Ishaq from Abu Basir from Ubayy ibn Ka'b is mentioned by Zuhayr ibn Mu'awiya and Shu'bah narrated it from Abu Ishaq from Abdullah ibn Abu Basir and from his father from Ubayy ibn Ka'b. The statement is Shu'bah's and it is more reliable than Zuhayr's.'"
hi: Abu Ishaq [ne kaha]: maine yeh unse aur unke walid se, Ubay (RA) se, suna hai, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fajr padhi," phir hadith ka zikr kiya. (Aur hadith ke a'imma - Yahya bin Ma'in, Ali bin Al-Madini, Muhammad bin Yahya Adh-Dhuhli aur doosron ne - is hadith ki sehat ka faisla diya hai.) Maine Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad bin Ya'qub ko kehte hue suna, unhone Abbas bin Muhammad Ad-Duri ko kehte hue suna, unhone Yahya bin Ma'in ko kehte hue suna: Abu Ishaq ki, Abu Basir se, Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) se, yeh hadith Zuhair bin Muawiyah kehte hain, aur Shu'bah ise Abu Ishaq se, Abdullah bin Abi Basir se aur unke walid se, Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) se, riwayat karte hain. To baat Shu'bah ki hai, aur woh Zuhair se zyada mo'tabar hain.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  prayed the morning prayer and then said, 'I bear witness to so-and-so.' Abu Ishaq reported this from a sheikh whom he had never heard anything else from, except for this hadith. And that sheikh was Abdullah bin Abi Basir. Shu'bah also reported from Abu Ishaq that he heard it from his father, and Abu Ishaq heard it from Al-Aizar bin Hurayth who said, 'I only consider a hadith authentic.' And I heard Abu Bakr bin Ishaq, the jurist, saying, 'I heard Ibrahim bin Ishaq Al-Harbi saying, "I heard Ali bin Al-Madini saying that Abu Ishaq heard from Abdullah bin Abi Basir and his father Abi Basir." Abu Bakr bin Ishaq said, "I heard Abdullah bin Muhammad Al-Madini saying, 'I heard Muhammad bin Yahya saying that the narration of Yahya bin Sa'id and Khalid bin Al-Harith from Shu'bah and the saying of Abu Al-Ahwas from Abu Ishaq, from Al-Aizar bin Hurayth are all preserved.' The validity of these narrations has been confirmed by the statements of Hadith scholars. As for the two sheikhs, they did not present any opposition to this.'"
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne Fajr ki namaz padhi to farmaya: "Kya fulan hazir tha?" Isse Abu Ishaq ne aik ustad se riwayat kiya jinse unhone sirf yehi (aik hadith) suni thi, aur woh Abdullah bin Abi Basir hain. Shu'bah ne Abu Ishaq se kaha hai ke unhone unke walid se bhi aur unse bhi suna hai, aur Al-Ahwas ne Abu Ishaq se, Al-Aizar bin Hurayth se, kaha hai: "Mujhe yeh hadith sahih hi lagti hai." Maine Abu Bakr bin Ishaq Al-Faqih ko kehte hue suna, unhone Ibrahim bin Ishaq Al-Harbi ko kehte hue suna, unhone Ali bin Al-Madini ko kehte hue suna: "Abu Ishaq ne Abdullah bin Abi Basir se aur unke walid Abi Basir se suna hai." Humein Abu Bakr bin Ishaq ne bataya, unhone kaha: maine Abdullah bin Muhammad Al-Madini ko kehte hue suna, unhone Muhammad bin Yahya ko kehte hue suna: "Yahya bin Sa'eed aur Khalid bin Al-Harith ki, Shu'bah se, riwayat, aur Abu Al-Ahwas ki, Abu Ishaq se, Al-Aizar bin Hurayth se, riwayat - yeh sab mahfooz (sahih) hain, isliye hadith ke a'imma ke aqwaal se is hadith ki sehat zaahir ho chuki hai. Rahi baat Shaykhain ki, to unhone isse is ikhtilaf ki wajah se nahi nikala."

e: [AI] I heard Salamah bin Al-Akwa' saying, "I asked the Prophet ﷺ, 'If I am engaged in hunting and I have nothing except one shirt or one cloak, should I tighten or tuck it up?' He said, 'Yes, even if it is done with a thorn.'"
hi: Maine Salamah bin Al-Akwa' (RA) ko kehte hue suna: maine Nabi (SAW) se poocha, arz kiya: "Main shikar mein hota hoon aur mere paas sirf aik qamees ya aik jubbah hota hai, to kya main use bandh loon?" - ya kaha: "Kya main use button laga loon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, chahe kaante se hi ho."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited us to pray in a sheet of cloth without crossing both its ends, and he also prohibited us to pray in a wrapper without putting on a sheet. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 636)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mana kiya ke koi aisi chadar mein namaz padhe jise woh apne kandhon par (crosswise) na daale, aur mana kiya ke koi aadmi sirf pajama (sirwal) mein namaz padhe jabke uske upar koi chadar na ho.

e: [AI] She asked the Prophet ﷺ, "Should a woman pray in a cloak and headscarf without an undergarment?" He said, "If the cloak is long enough to cover the backs of her feet."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) se poocha: "Kya aurat sirf qamees aur dupatta pehankar, bagair tehband ke, namaz padh sakti hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar qamees itni lambi ho ke uske paon ki pusht (upar wala hissa) dhaank le (to theek hai)."

e: "We prayed with Abdullah bin Mas'ud in his house. He stood between us and we placed our hands on our knees, but he took them off and made us interlace our fingers, and said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do that.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1030)
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko aisa karte dekha hai."

e: The Prophet said: "Allah does not accept the prayer of a woman who menstruates (i.e., an adult woman) except with a head cover." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 655)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haiz waali (ya'ni baaligh) aurat ki namaz bagair dupatte (sar dhaankne) ke qubool nahi hoti."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'The prayer of a menstruating woman is not accepted without a headscarf.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haiz waali (baaligh) aurat ki namaz bagair dupatte ke qubool nahi hoti."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The entire Earth is a mosque, except for the bathroom and the graveyard." This was reported by Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad from Amr ibn Yahya.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Poori zameen masjid hai, siwaye hamaam (ghusl-khana) aur qabristan ke." Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad ne Amr bin Yahya se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The entire earth is a masjid (place of prayer), except for the bathroom and the graveyard." "All these chains of narration (Asanid) are authentic according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim, and they did not exclude it (the hadith)." Both of them, meaning Bukhari and Muslim, refer to this hadith with the number 919, according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Poori zameen masjid hai, siwaye hamaam aur qabristan ke." (Yeh tamam asaneed Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par sahih hain, magar dono ne ise nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Do not pray except behind a barrier, and do not let anyone pass in front of you. If they insist, then fight them, for with them is a devil."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sirf sutrah (aad) ki taraf hi namaz padho, aur kisi ko apne saamne se guzarne mat do, agar woh na maane to usse jhagdo, kyunke uske sath (Shaitan ka) hum-nasheen hota hai."

e: "When anyone of you prays toward a Sutra, let him get close to it and not allow the Shaitan to sever his prayer for him." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 748)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe to sutrah ki taraf padhe aur usse qareeb ho jaye, taake Shaitan uski namaz mein ruqawat na daale."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not pray in our wrappers or in our quilts. Ubaydullah said: My father (Mu'adh) doubted this. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 367)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "humare baal (se bane kapdon) aur luhaaf (kambal) mein namaz nahi padhte the." Ubaidullah ne kaha: "Mere waalid ko is baat mein shak tha."

e: [AI] From the Prophet, peace be upon him, he said, "The portion of the sutrah (partition) is equivalent to the back of a saddle, even if it is as narrow as the width of a hair."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sutrah ke liye kajawe ke pichhle hisse jitni cheez kaafi hai, chahe woh baal jitni patli hi kyun na ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "None of you should neglect his prayer, even if it is with an arrow."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se har koi apni namaz ko kisi (sutrah) se aad kare, chahe woh aik teer hi ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Cover yourselves with your prayers, even with an arrow if necessary, as long as a Muslim fulfills his conditions."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni namaz ko sutrah se aad karo, chahe woh aik teer hi ho." (Muslim ki shart par.)

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say after prayer, "O Allah, indeed I seek refuge in You from disbelief, poverty, and the punishment of the grave."
hi: Nabi (SAW) namaz ke aakhir mein farmaya karte the: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon kufr se, faqr (mohtaji) se aur qabar ke azab se."

e: "They were commanded to say the tasbih thirty-three times following the prayer, and to say the tahmid thirty-three times, and to say the takbir thirty-four times, then a man from among the Ansar was told in a dream: 'Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ command you to say the tasbih thirty-three times following the prayer, and to say the tahmid thirty-three times, and to say the takbir thirty-four times?' He said: 'Yes.' 'Instead of that, say each one twenty-five times, and include the tahlil among them.' The next morning he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and told him about that, and he said: 'Do that.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1350)
hi: Ke hum har namaz ke aakhir mein tainteess (33) baar tasbeeh padhen, tainteess (33) baar hamd karen, aur chauntees (34) baar takbeer kahen. Unhone kaha: phir Ansar mein se aik shakhs ko neend mein (khwab mein) dikhaya gaya, usse kaha gaya: "Kya Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumhein hukum diya tha ke har namaz ke aakhir mein isi tarah tasbeeh padho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Usne kaha: "To inhein pachees-pachees (25) bana lo aur inme tahleel (La ilaha illallah) bhi shamil kar lo." Jab subah hui to woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein bataya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aisa hi karo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Recite the Mu'awwidhat (Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas) after every prayer." "It is authentically established upon the condition of being a Muslim and not omitting them." According to a Muslim condition.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har namaz ke aakhir mein Mu'awwidhat (Surah Al-Falaq aur An-Nas) padho." (Muslim ki shart par sahih, dono ne ise nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When one of you prays in a single garment, then let him tighten it properly and not cover himself like the Jews do."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi aik kapde mein namaz padhe, to use apni kamar par bandh le, aur Yahood ki tarah (dhilay dhang se apne aap ko) lapetne se bacho."

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited ˹doing˺ "sadal" (wrapping garments around oneself and having arms tucked inside during prayer). (Using translation from Aḥmad 8582)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "sadal" (kapda dhilay dhang se latkane) se aur aadmi ke apna munh dhaankne se mana kiya.

e: we came to Jabir b. ‘Abd Allah. He said : I (Jabir) accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a battle. He got up to pray. I had a sheet of cloth upon me, and I began to cross both the ends, but they did not reach (my shoulders). It had fringes which I turned over and crossed the two ends, and bowed down retaining it with my neck lest it should fall down. Then I came and stood on the left side of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He then took and brought me around him and set me on his right side. Then Ibn Sakhr came and stood on his left side. he then took us with his both hands and made us stand behind him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ began to look at me furtive glances, but I could not understand. When I understood, he hinted at me tie the wrapper. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished the prayer, he said (to me): O Jabir. I said; Yes, Messenger of Allah. He said; if it (the sheet) is wide, cross both its ends (over the shoulders); if it is tight, tie it over your loins. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 634)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik ghazwe mein chal raha tha, aap (SAW) namaz ke liye khade huay, mujh par aik chadar thi, main uske kinaron ko ulat-palat (crosswise) karne laga, phir maine isse mazbooti se pakad liya taake yeh gire na, phir main Rasulullah (SAW) ke baayen taraf aaya, to aap (SAW) ne mera haath pakda aur mujhe ghuma kar apne dayen taraf khada kar diya. Phir Ibn Sakhr aaye aur aap (SAW) ke baayen taraf khade ho gaye, to aap (SAW) ne humein dono haathon se pakda aur apne peechhe khada kar diya. Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe (baar-baar) dekhne lage jabke mujhe ehsaas nahi tha, phir mujhe iska pata chala, to aap (SAW) ne mujhe ishara kiya ke ise (chadar ko) kamar par bandh loon. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) namaz se farigh huay to farmaya: "Aye Jabir." Maine kaha: "Ji, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab (chadar) waseeh ho to iske dono kinaron ko ulat-palat kar lo, aur jab tang ho to isse apni kamar par bandh lo." (Yeh Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.)

e: "I saw the Prophet when he had completed his seven (circuits of Tawaf); he came to the edge of the Mataf and prayed two Rakahs, with nothing in between him and people who were circumambulating." (Daif) (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2959)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, "jab aap (SAW) apne tawaaf se farigh huay to Mataaf ke kinare aaye aur do rakat namaz padhi, aap (SAW) ke aur tawaaf karne walon ke darmiyan koi (rukaawat) na thi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ used to pray, and a sheep passed in front of him, so he moved it towards qibla until his belly stuck to qibla.
hi: Nabi (SAW) "namaz padh rahe thay ke aik bakri unke saamne se guzri, to aap (SAW) ne usse Qibla ki taraf dhakel diya yahan tak ke uska pet Qibla se chipak gaya."

e: The Messenger of Allah said: "Cats do not invalidate the prayer, because they are one of the things that are useful in the house." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 369)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Billi namaz nahi todti, kyunke woh ghar ke saaman mein se hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say during one of his prayers, "O Allah, hold me accountable with an easy reckoning." When he finished, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is an easy reckoning?" He replied, "It is when one's book is examined, and Allah overlooks some of it for him. Verily, whoever is questioned on the Day of Judgement, O Aisha, will be destroyed. For every affliction that befalls the believer, Allah will expiate his sins, even to the extent that a thorn pricks him."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko apni kisi namaz mein farmate hue suna: "Aye Allah, mera hisaab aasan lena." Jab aap (SAW) namaz se farigh huay to maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aasaan hisaab kya hota hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uske naamah-e-a'maal mein dekha jayega aur usse darguzar kiya jayega. Beshak jiska us din baaqaida munaqasha (behas-o-mubahisa) kiya gaya, aye Aisha (RA), woh halaak ho gaya. Aur jo bhi museebat momin ko pahunchti hai, Allah usi ke zariye uske gunah utaar deta hai, yahan tak ke ek kaanta bhi jo usse chubhe."

e: "Umm Sulaim came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, teach me some words that I may supplicate with during my prayer.' He said: 'Glorify Allah (by saying SubhanAllah) ten times, and praise Him (by saying Alhamdulilah) ten times, and magnify Him (by saying Allahu Akbar) ten times, then ask Him for what you need; He will say: 'Yes, yes.' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1299)
hi: Umm Sulaim (RA) Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aayi aur arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe koi aisi baat sikhaiye jo main apni namaz mein dua ke tor par padhun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Das martaba Allah ki tasbeeh karo, das martaba Allah ki hamd karo, das martaba Allah ki takbeer kaho, phir Allah se jo chaho maango."

e: [AI] He saw Abu Barza al-Aslami praying while holding the reins of his horse. When he went into the bowing position, the reins slipped from his hand and the horse ran off. Abu Barza fell onto his back and did not turn around until he caught the horse and took hold of it. Then he continued walking as he was and came to the place where he had prayed. He completed his prayer and then said, "I have accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in many battles, even counting the number of expeditions. I have seen his leniency and ease, so I followed that. If I had left my horse until it reached the desert and then walked slowly like an old man, stumbling in darkness, it would have been more difficult for me."
hi: Unhone Abu Barzah Al-Aslami (RA) ko namaz padhte dekha jabke unke jaanwar ki lagaam unke haath mein thi, jab unhone ruku kiya to lagaam unke haath se chhoot gayi aur jaanwar chal diya. Abu Barzah (RA) apni aidiyon ke bal peeche hate, magar (namaz se) mun nahi phera, yahan tak ke jaanwar ko pakad liya, phir waisi hi chal se wapas aaye, apni jagah par pahunche jahan namaz padh rahe the, aur apni namaz mukammal ki, phir salaam phera aur kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath bohot se ghazwaat mein sohbat ki hai - yahan tak ke unhone (kayi) ghazwaat ginwaye - to maine aap (SAW) ki rukhsat aur aasaani (ka tareeqa) dekha, to maine usi ko apnaya. Agar main apne jaanwar ko sehra tak jaane deta, phir aik boodhe aadmi ki tarah, andhere mein thokrein khate hue, chalta, to yeh mere liye zyada mushkil hota."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Kill the two black things during prayer, the snake and scorpion. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 921)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz mein donon kaale (khatarnak janwaron) - saanp aur bichchu - ko maar dene ka hukum diya.

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to turn to his right and left when praying, but he did not twist his neck to look behind him." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1201)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "namaz mein dayan aur bayan taraf dekhte the, lekin apni gardan apni peeth ke peechhe nahi modte the."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you are in prayer, do not spit in front of you nor to your right, but spit towards your left if it is empty or under your feet." And he indicated with his foot as if he were directing it towards his foot. "This saying is from Abu Al-Abbas's Hadith."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum namaz mein ho to apne saamne ya apni dayen taraf mat thooko, balke apni bayen taraf thooko agar woh khaali ho, ya apne paon ke neeche," aur aap (SAW) ne apne pair se ishara kiya jaise woh usse dabaate hon. (Yeh alfaz Abu Al-Abbas ki hadith ke hain.)

e: 'Abdullah b. Shakhkhir narrated it on the authority of his father that he said prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he spat and then rubbed it off with his left shoe. (Using translation from Muslim 554b)
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath namaz padhi, "to unhein khaansi aayi (ya thook aaya), to unhone use apne baayen joote se mal diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to like to hold the prayer beads in his hand. One day, he entered the mosque with one of them in his hand and saw some debris in the direction of the mosque's Qibla. He cleaned them until they were removed, then he turned to the people angrily and said, "Would any of you like to be faced by a man who spits in his face? When one of you stands up for prayer, he faces his Lord and the angels are on his right, so he should not spit in front of him, nor to his right. Rather, he should spit under his left foot or to his left. If he needs to spit urgently, then he should cover it with a part of his clothing." Some narrations reported some parts to others.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ko khajoor ki tehniyan (araajeen) pasand thi ke woh unhein apne haath mein pakden. Aik din aap (SAW) masjid mein dakhil huay jabke aap (SAW) ke haath mein unme se aik thi, to aap (SAW) ne masjid ke Qibla mein kuch balgham (khaansi ke asaar) dekhe, unhein khurach kar saaf kar diya, phir logon ki taraf ghusse mein mutawajjeh huay aur farmaya: "Kya tum mein se koi pasand karega ke koi shakhs uske saamne aakar uske chehre par thook de? Beshak tum mein se koi jab namaz ke liye khada hota hai to woh apne Rab ke saamne hota hai, aur farishta uski dayen taraf hota hai, isliye woh apne saamne ya apni dayen taraf na thooke, balke apne baayen paon ke neeche ya apni bayen taraf thooke, aur agar usse achanak (thookne ki) zaroorat mehsoos ho to woh apne kapde ke aik kinare mein isi tarah thook le," aur aap (SAW) ne uske aik hisse ko doosre hisse par mod diya.

e: [AI] "He used to lead his people in prayer, and one time he came and the prayer had already been established. He said, "Let one of you lead the prayer, for I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'When the prayer starts and the call of nature also starts, begin with the call of nature.'"
hi: Woh apni qaum ki imamat karte the, aik din woh aaye jabke namaz ki iqamat ho chuki thi, unhone kaha: "Tum mein se koi (imamat kare) namaz padhe, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Jab namaz ka waqt ho aur qaza-e-hajat ki bhi zaroorat ho, to pehle qaza-e-hajat se shuru karo.'"

e: [AI] About him, they said, "He has gone to Makkah." So they followed him and found him in Ta'if. They followed him again and found him in the hill called Al-Waht. Ibn Dailami said, "I went to him and found him walking, lecturing to a man from Quraysh, and Quraysh measure with alcohol (drink). So I met him and greeted him, and he greeted me back. Then he asked me, 'What brings you here today, and where are you coming from?' I informed him, and then I asked him, 'O Abdullah ibn Amr, have you heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'No man from my Ummah drinks alcohol and attains forty mornings of accepted prayers'?"
hi: Unke baare mein poocha gaya to logon ne kaha: "Woh Makkah ki taraf chale gaye hain." Unki pairavi ki gayi to unhein maloom hua ke woh Taif ki taraf chale gaye hain, unki pairavi ki gayi to unhein Al-Waht naam ke bagh mein paaya. Ibn Ad-Dailami ne kaha: main unke paas gaya to unhein aik Quraishi shakhs ke sath chalte hue paaya jabke Quraishi sharab (ki qeemat) taul raha tha. Main unse mila, salaam kiya aur unhone bhi salaam ka jawaab diya, phir unhone kaha: "Aaj tumhein kis cheez ne subah subah yahan bheja, aur tum kahan se aaye ho?" Maine unhein bataya, phir maine poocha: "Aye Abdullah bin Amr (RA), kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate hue suna hai: 'Meri Ummat ka koi aadmi sharab na piye, warna chaalees subhon tak uski namaz qubool nahi hogi'?"

e: “We find (mention of) the prayer of the resident and the prayer in a state of fear in the Qur’an, but we do not find any mention of the prayer of the traveler. ‘Abdullah said to him: “Allah sent Muhammad ﷺ to us, and we did not know anything, rather we do what we saw Muhammad ﷺ doing.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1066)
hi: Abdullah (RA) [ne kaha]: "Aye mere bhatije, Allah ne Muhammad (SAW) ko humari taraf bheja aur hum kuch nahi jaante the, hum to sirf wahi karte hain jo humne Muhammad (SAW) ko karte dekha."

e: [AI] I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  praying while sitting with crossed legs.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko "chaar-zaanu (paalti maar kar) baithkar namaz padhte dekha."

e: Messenger of Allah (S) said: "Teach the boy Salat when he is seven years old, and beat him (if he does not pray) when he is ten." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 407)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bachche ko saat saal ki umar mein namaz sikhao, aur dus saal ki umar mein (na padhne par) usse maaro."

e: Ibn Abbas said: A lunatic woman passed by Ali ibn AbuTalib. He then mentioned the rest of the tradition to the same effect as Uthman mentioned. This version has: Do you not remember that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has said: There are three whose actions are not recorded: a lunatic whose mind is deranged till he is restored to consciousness, a sleeper till he awakes, and a boy till he reaches puberty? (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4401)
hi: Unhone Umar (RA) se kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, kya main isse (uski saza) baksh dun?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Unhone kaha: "Kya tumhein yaad nahi ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Qalam teen logon se utha liya gaya hai: pagal se jiski aql ghalib aa chuki ho, sone wale se jab tak woh jaage, aur bachche se jab tak woh baligh ho jaye'?" Unhone kaha: "Tumne sach kaha," to unhone usse chhod diya.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on a mat and on a tanned skin. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 659)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "chatai (hasir) aur dabgh ki hui khaal (farwah) par namaz padhte the."

e: [AI] Abu Asim noble who narrated, that Zam'ah bin Salih narrated from Salamah bin Wahram, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas that he prayed on a mat and then said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed on a mat."
hi: Humein Abu Aasim An-Nabeel ne bataya, humein Zam'ah bin Salih ne Salamah bin Wahram se, unhone Ikrimah se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se bataya ke unhone aik farsh (bisaat) par namaz padhi, phir kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne (bhi) aik farsh par namaz padhi thi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When one of you prays, let him wear his sandals or remove them between his feet and not harm others with them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe, to apne joote pehne rahe ya unhein apne dono paon ke darmiyan utaar de, aur unse kisi doosre ko takleef na de."

e: [AI] "I accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during the year of the conquest. He prayed the dawn prayer and removed his sandals, placing them on his left side."
hi: "Main fatah ke saal Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath hazir tha, aap (SAW) ne Fajr ki namaz padhi, apne joote utaare aur unhein apni bayen taraf rakh diya."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When any of you prays, he should not place his sandals on his right side or on his left so as to be on the right side of someone else, unless no one is at his left, but should place them between his feet. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 654)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe, to apne joote apni dayen taraf na rakhe aur na apni bayen taraf, siwaye is soorat mein jab uski bayen taraf koi na ho, aur unhein apne dono paon ke darmiyan rakhe." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed and took off his sandals. The people also took off their sandals. When he finished, he asked, "Why did you take off your sandals?" They replied, "O Messenger of Allah, we saw you take off your sandals, so we took off ours." He said, "Indeed, Jibril came to me and informed me that there was some impurity on them. So when one of you enters the masjid, let him flip his sandals and examine them for any impurity. If he finds any impurity, let him wipe them on the ground and then pray in them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz padhi aur apne joote utaar diye, to logon ne bhi apne joote utaar diye. Jab aap (SAW) farigh huay to farmaya: "Tumne apne joote kyun utaare?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humne dekha aap (SAW) ne utaare to humne bhi utaar diye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Jibra'il (AS) mere paas aaye aur mujhe bataya ke unme napaaki hai, isliye jab tum mein se koi masjid mein aaye to apne jooton ko ulta kar dekh le, agar unme napaaki paaye to unhein zameen par rag'ad kar (rub kar) saaf kar le, phir unhi mein namaz padh le."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Act differently from the Jews, for they do not pray in their sandals or their shoes. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 652)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yahood ki mukhalifat karo, kyunke woh apne mozon (khuffain) ya apne jooton mein namaz nahi padhte."

e: when any of you prays and takes off his sandals, he should not harm anyone by them. He should place them between his feet or pray with them on (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 655)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe, to apne joote apne dono paon ke darmiyan utaar de ya unhi mein namaz padh le." Shaykhain ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If one of you experiences something unusual while praying, he should place his hand on his nose and then continue." Some of them stopped him on this condition.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ka namaz mein wudu toot jaye, to woh apna haath apni naak par rakhe, phir chala jaye." (Ba'z ne ise mauqoof (raawi tak mahdood) bhi rakha hai.) Shaykhain ki shart par.

e: [AI] The translation of the given text in English is: "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'When one of you prays and doesn't know how much he has prayed, whether it is three or four (raka'at), let him perform one additional raka'ah, perfecting its bowing and prostration, and then make two prostrations.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko shak ho ke usne teen padhi hain ya chaar, to woh aik rak'at aur padh le, uska ruku aur sajda achhi tarah kare, phir do sajde kare."

e: [AI] "I prayed the Maghrib prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He performed the prayer and then said Taslim (the concluding greeting). A man said to him, 'O Messenger of Allah, you forgot and performed Taslim in two Rak'ahs.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded Bilal to establish the prayer and complete that Rak'ah. I asked the people about the man who said, 'O Messenger of Allah, you forgot.' They informed me that I would recognize him if I saw him. Then, a man passed by me, and I said, 'He is the one.' They said, 'He is Talhah bin 'Ubaidullah, and Al-Laith bin Sa'd narrated this hadith from Abi Habib, who narrated it from Yazid as an abridged version while they both met its condition."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Maghrib ki namaz padhi, aap (SAW) se bhool ho gayi aur aap (SAW) ne do rak'aton mein salaam pher diya, phir wapas jaane lage. Aik shakhs ne aap (SAW) se kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapse bhool hui hai aur aapne do rak'aton mein salaam pher diya." To aap (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya, unhone iqamat kahi, phir aap (SAW) ne woh (baaqi) rak'at mukammal ki. Maine logon se us shakhs ke baare mein poocha jisne kaha tha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapse bhool hui hai," to mujhse kaha gaya: "Kya tum unhein pehchante ho?" Maine kaha: "Nahi, siwaye is ke ke main unhein dekh loon." Phir mere paas se aik shakhs guzra, maine kaha: "Yehi hain." To unhone kaha: "Yeh Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA) hain."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase into English is: "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, prayed and then he finished and left, though there remained a unit of prayer (rak'ah)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "aik din namaz padhi aur salaam pherkar chale gaye, jabke namaz ki aik rak'at baaqi thi."

e: The Prophet ﷺ named the two prostrations of forgetfulness disgraceful for the devil. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1025)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne "sahw (bhool) ke dono sajdon ko 'Al-Murghimatayn' (Shaitan ko zaleel karne wale do sajde) ka naam diya."

e: Sa'id ibn AbuSa'id al-Maqburi reported on the authority of his father that he saw AbuRafi' the freed slave of the Prophet ﷺ, passing by Hasan ibn Ali (Allah be pleased with them) when he was standing offering his prayer. He had tied the back knot of his hair. AbuRafi' untied it. Hasan turned to him with anger, AbuRafi' said to him: Concentrate on your prayer and do not be angry: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: This is the seat of the devil, referring to the back knot of the hair. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 646)
hi: Unhone Abu Rafi' (RA), jo Nabi (SAW) ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam hain, ko Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas se guzarte dekha jabke woh khade hokar namaz padh rahe the aur unhone apni choti apni gardan ke peechhe bandh rakhi thi, to Abu Rafi' (RA) ne usse khol diya. Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ne ghusse mein unki taraf mudkar dekha, to Abu Rafi' (RA) ne kaha: "Apni namaz par tawajjo do aur ghussa mat karo, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Yeh Shaitan ki nashist (baithne ki jagah) hai,' ya'ni choti bandhne ki jagah ko Shaitan ki nashist kaha."

e: The Prophet ﷺ used to say between the two prostrations: "O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, heal me, and provide for me." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 850)
hi: Nabi (SAW) do sajdon ke darmiyan farmaya karte the: "Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar, mujh par reham kar, mujhe hidayat de, mujhe aafiyat de aur mujhe rizq de."

e: Anas ibn Hakim ad-Dabbi said that he feared Ziyad or Ibn Ziyad; so he came to Medina and met AbuHurayrah. He attributed his lineage to me and I became a member of his lineage. AbuHurayrah said (to me): O youth, should I not narrate a tradition to you? I said: Why not, may Allah have mercy on you? (Yunus (a narrator) said: I think he narrated it (the tradition) from the Prophet ﷺ:) The first thing about which the people will be called to account out of their actions on the Day of Judgment is prayer. Our Lord, the Exalted, will say to the angels - though He knows better: Look into the prayer of My servant and see whether he has offered it perfectly or imperfectly. If it is perfect, that will be recorded perfect. If it is defective, He will say: See there are some optional prayers offered by My servant. If there are optional prayer to his credit, He will say: Compensate the obligatory prayer by the optional prayer for My servant. Then all the actions will be considered similarly. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 864)
hi: ...unhone mujhse mera nasab poocha, to maine apna nasab bataya, unhone kaha: "Aye jawan, kya main tumhein aik hadith na sunaun?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi, Allah aap par reham kare." Yunus ne kaha: mera khayal hai unhone ise Nabi (SAW) se naql kiya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qayamat ke din logon ke amal mein se sabse pehle jiska hisaab liya jayega woh namaz hai." Unhone kaha: humara Rab Azza wa Jalla farishton se farmayega - halanke woh khud zyada jaanta hai - "Mere bande ki namaz dekho, usne isse mukammal ki ya isme kami ki? Agar mukammal hai to usse mukammal likh do, aur agar isme kuch kami hai to dekho kya mere bande ka koi nafl (amal) hai. Agar uska koi nafl hai to farmayega: mere bande ka farz uske nafl se poora kar do," phir usi hisaab se baaqi tamam amal liye jayenge.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The first thing for which a person will be held accountable on the Day of Judgment is prayer. If it is perfect, it will be written as perfect for him. If it is not complete, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, will say to His angels, 'Look for any voluntary prayers with which My servant may complete what is lacking from his obligatory prayers.' Then, the same will be done with regards to zakah (obligatory charity) and all other deeds." This wording has been shortened by some of the companions of Hammād ibn Salamah and Musa ibn Ismail al-Hukm in their narration.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Qayamat ke din bande ka jis cheez ka sabse pehle hisaab liya jayega woh namaz hai. Agar usne ise mukammal kiya ho to usse mukammal likh diya jayega, aur agar mukammal nahi kiya to Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala apne farishton se farmayega: "Dekho mere bande ka koi nafl hai jisse tum uske farz ki kami poori kar sako?" Phir zakat ka bhi yehi hisaab hoga, phir baaqi tamam amal isi tarah (napay) jayenge. (Hammad bin Salamah ke kuch shagirdon aur Musa bin Isma'il ne apni hadith mein isse mukhtasar rakha hai.)

e: [AI] About a man from the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  and about Dawud ibn Abi Hind, he narrated from Zurarah ibn Awfa that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The first thing for which a person will be held accountable on the Day of Judgment is his prayer." And he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik shakhs se, aur Dawud bin Abi Hind se, unhone Zurarah bin Awfa se, unhone Tamim Ad-Dari (RA) se, ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qayamat ke din bande ka jis cheez ka sabse pehle hisaab liya jayega woh uski namaz hai," phir usi jaisi hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ , it was mentioned about him that regarding the narration of Hammad ibn Salamah, so that the contemplator may know that what we have authenticated is the hadith of Dawud ibn Abi Hind, and it does not involve any contradiction with Hammad or the rest of the narrations about it. There are chains of narration from Hammad, other than Dawud, praying upon Muhammad and his family altogether.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. (Hammad bin Salamah ke baare mein yeh ikhtilaf zikr kiya gaya hai taake ghor karne wala jaan le ke jise humne sahih qaraar diya hai, woh Dawud bin Abi Hind ki hadith hai, jismein Hammad par koi ikhtilaf nahi, aur baaqi tamam riwayaton ki asaneed Hammad se, Dawud ke ilawa kisi aur se, hain. Sallallahu ala Muhammadin wa aalihi ajma'in.)

e: The prophet ﷺ used to say when prostrating himself: “O Allah. Forgive me all my sins, small and great, first and last. “ the narrator Ibn al-sarh added: “open and secret.” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 878)
hi: Nabi (SAW) apne sajde mein farmaya karte the: "Aye Allah, mujhe mere sab gunah maaf kar de, chhote bhi aur bade bhi, pehle bhi aur baad ke bhi, khule bhi aur chhupe bhi."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet, peace be upon him, used to say "Glory be to my Lord, the Most High" when he recited "Subhan Rabbi al-A'la" (Glorified is my Lord, the Most High).
hi: Nabi (SAW) "jab 'Sabbih isma Rabbika al-A'la' padhte to farmate: 'Subhana Rabbi-al-A'la.'"

e: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying and a sound came from his breast like the rumbling of a mill owing to weeping. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 904)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, "aap (SAW) namaz padh rahe the aur aap (SAW) ke seene se roone ki wajah se aisi aawaz aa rahi thi jaise deg (bartan) ke ubalne ki aawaz hoti hai."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "There is no deception in prayer or in the greetings." Ahmad ibn Hanbal said from what he saw that he wanted not to give the greeting and to give the greeting to you. The deception of a person in his prayer is to give the greeting while he is doubting in it.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz mein aur salaam mein koi dhoka (jaldi ya lapak) nahi." Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha, jaisa unhone samjha: "Iska matlab hai ke na khud (jaldi se) salaam phere aur na tumhein salaam kiya jaye (jaldi mein), aur aadmi ka apni namaz mein dhoka yeh hai ke woh shak ki halat mein hi salaam pher de."

e: [AI] "There is no deception in surrender and no prayer."
hi: "Na salaam mein koi dhoka hai aur na namaz mein."

e: Abu hurairah said that the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) forbade putting hands on the waist during prayer. Abu Dawud said; The word Ikhtisar means to put one’s hands on one’s waist. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 947)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz mein "ikhtisar" (kamar par haath rakhne) se mana kiya. Abu Abdullah Al-Abdi ne kaha: "iska matlab hai ke aadmi apna haath apni kamar par rakhe."

e: Hilal ibn Yasaf said: I came to ar-Raqqah (a place in Syria). One of my companions said to me: Do you want to see any of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ? I said: A good opportunity. So we went to Wabisah. I said to my friend: Let us first see his mode of living. He had a cap with two ears stuck (to his head), and wearing a brown silken robe. He was resting on a staff during prayer. We asked him (about resting on the staff) after salutation; He said: Umm Qays daughter of Mihsan said to me that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ became aged and the flesh grew increasingly on him, he took a prop at his place of prayer and rested on it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 948)
hi: Mere kisi saathi ne mujhse kaha: "Kya tumhein Nabi (SAW) ke aik sahabi se milna pasand hai?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan, yeh to ghaneemat (bahut achhi baat) hai." To hum Wabisah bin Ma'bad (RA) ke paas gaye. Maine apne saathi se kaha: "Pehle hum unka wateera (tareeqa) dekhein," to unhone unke pehnaawe ki taraf dekha, unpar aik chapti topi thi jiske do kaan the, aur baingani rang ka reshmi burnus (aabaa) tha, aur woh apni namaz mein aik lathi (asa) par tikke huay the. Salaam karne ke baad humne unse (iska sabab) poocha, to unhone kaha: "Mujhe Umm Qais bint Mihsan (RA) ne bataya ke jab Rasulullah (SAW) buddhe ho gaye aur unka jism bhaari ho gaya, to aap (SAW) ne namaz mein tikne ke liye aik lathi (amood) bana li thi."

e: I asked ‘A’ishah whether the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited a whole Surah (of the Quran) in one Rak’ah of the prayer. She replied : (He recited from among) the Mufassal surahs. I asked: Did he pray (at night) sitting? She replied : (he prayed sitting) when the people made him old. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 956)
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Kya Rasulullah (SAW) namaz ki aik rak'at mein poori surah padhte the?" Unhone kaha: "Mufassal (surahon) mein se." Maine poocha: "Kya aap (SAW) baithkar namaz padhte the?" Unhone kaha: "Jab umar ne unhein kamzor kar diya (to aisa karte)."

e: We did not know what we should say when we sat during prayer. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was taught (by Allah). He then narrated the tradition to the same effect. Sharik reported from Jami', from AbuWa'il on the authority of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud something similar. He said: He used to teach us also some other words, but he did not teach them as he taught us the tashahhud: O Allah, join our hearts, mend our social relationship, guide us to the path of peace, bring us from darkness to light, save us from obscenities, outward or inward, and bless our ears, our eyes, our hearts, our wives, our children, and relent toward us; Thou art the Relenting, the Merciful. And make us grateful for Thy blessing and make us praise it while accepting it and give it to us in full. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 969)
hi: Humein nahi pata tha ke jab hum namaz mein baithte to kya kahein, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko jame' kalimaat aur unke khatme (waale alfaz) sikhaye gaye the. Unhone kaha: phir tashahhud ka zikr kiya, aur kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) humein kuch aur kalimaat bhi sikhaya karte the jaise woh humein tashahhud sikhate: "Aye Allah, humare dilon ko jod de, humare aapasi maamlaat theek kar de, humein salamati ke raste dikha, humein andheron se roshni ki taraf nikal, humein khule aur chhupe fahash (be-hayaai wale) kaamon se door rakh, humare kaanon, aankhon aur dilon mein barkat de, humari biwiyon aur aulad mein barkat de, humari tauba qubool kar, beshak tu hi bohot tauba qubool karne wala, bohot reham karne wala hai, aur humein apni ne'maton ka shukr guzaar bana, unki tareef karne wala aur unhein qubool karne wala bana, aur humpar unhein poora kar."

e: [AI] The translation of the sentence is as follows: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to teach us, so he mentioned it just like it on the condition of a Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humein sikhaya karte the, phir usi jaisi baat zikr ki. (Muslim ki shart par.)

e: The Messenger of Allah( may peace be upon him) used to teach us the tashahhud as he would teach us the Qur’an, and would say: The blessed adoration of the tongue, acts of worship (and) all good things are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah’s upright servants. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is Allah’s apostle (peace be upon him). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 974)
hi: Woh mimbar par logon ko tashahhud sikhate aur kehte: "At-Tahiyyatu lillah, Az-Zakiyatu lillah, At-Tayyibatu lillah, As-Salamu alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, As-Salamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis-saliheen, Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluh."
