e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Salama Al-Qa'nabi reported that Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad narrated from Hisham ibn Uruwah, from his father, that Umar ibn al-Khattab used to teach the people how to recite the Tashahhud in prayer while delivering a sermon on the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He would say, "When one of you recites Tashahhud in prayer, let them say: 'In the name of Allah, the most beneficial, the most merciful. All pure prayers, good greetings and pure acts of worship to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah. I bear witness that there is no God but Allah alone, without any partners, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.' Umar said, 'Begin with yourselves after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and send peace upon the righteous slaves of Allah.'"
hi: Abdullah bin Salamah Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, unhein Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad ne Hisham bin Urwah se, unke walid se, bataya ke Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) mimbar-e-Rasool (SAW) par khutba dete huay logon ko namaz mein tashahhud sikhaya karte the, woh kehte: "Jab tum mein se koi tashahhud kare to kahe: 'Bismillah, sabse achhe naamon ke sath, At-Tahiyyatuz-Zakiyatus-Salawaatut-Tayyibatu lillah, As-Salamu alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, As-Salamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis-saliheen, Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluh.'" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad apne aap se shuru karo, aur Allah ke nek bandon par salaam bhejo."

e: [AI] Omar said, "I hold your hand as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  held mine. Therefore, the testimony, greetings, prayers, and pure acts of worship to Allah are recited in it." And he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner, "As for the addition in the beginning of the testimony with the name of Allah and with Allah, it is authentic according to the condition of Bukhari."
hi: Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine tumhara haath usi tarah pakda hai jaise Rasulullah (SAW) ne mera haath pakda tha," phir usme tashahhud ginwaya: "At-Tahiyyatus-Salawaatut-Tayyibatuz-Zakiyatu lillah," phir usi jaisi hadith ka zikr kiya. (Rahi baat tashahhud ke shuru mein 'Bismillah' aur 'Billah' ki ziyaadti ki, to yeh Bukhari ki shart se sahih hai.)

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to teach us tashahhud as he would teach us a Sura of the Qur'an. (Using translation from Muslim 403b)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "humein tashahhud isi tarah sikhate jaise Quran ki koi surah sikhate: 'Bismillah wa billah, At-Tahiyyatu lillah.'" Abu Al-Abbas ne kaha: phir hadith ka zikr kiya, aur uske aakhir mein: "Aye Allah, main tujhse Jannat maangta hoon aur teri panah maangta hoon Jahannam se."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to teach us the Tashah-hud as he used to teach us a Surah from the Qur’an: ‘Bismillahi wa Billahi; at-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibatu lillahi; as-salamu ‘alayka ayyuhan- Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu; as-salamu ‘alayna wa ‘ala ‘ibadillahis-salihin. Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasuluhu. As’alu Allahal-jannah, wa a’udhu billahi minannar (In the name of Allah and by the grace of Allah. All compliments are due to Allah and all prayers and good words are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings; peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. I ask Allah for Paradise and I seek refuge with Allah from the Fire).’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 902)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "humein tashahhud isi tarah sikhate jaise Quran ki koi surah sikhate: 'Bismillah wa billah, At-Tahiyyatu lillah, As-Salawaatut-Tayyibatu lillah, As-Salamu alaika ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, As-Salamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis-saliheen, Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluh, nas'alullahal-Jannah wa na'oozu bihi minan-Naar.'"

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ, it was narrated from him, "I heard Abu Ali Al-Hafiz certifying Ibn Qahtaba, except that he made a mistake in it, as it is with Al-Mu'tamir from Aiman bin Nabil, as we mentioned before. May Allah bless Muhammad and his family, all of them." Aiman used it as evidence and Al-Bukhari narrated it from him through a group.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. (Maine Abu Ali Al-Hafiz ko Ibn Qahtabah ko sahih maante hue suna hai, magar unhone ismein ghalti ki hai, kyunke yeh Al-Mu'tamir ke paas Aiman bin Nabil se hai, jaisa humne pehle zikr kiya hai. Sallallahu ala Muhammadin wa aalihi ajma'in.) Aiman ko Bukhari ne hujjat maana hai, aur aik jama'at ne unse riwayat ki hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the mosque and saw a man who had finished his prayer, and was reciting the tashahhud saying: O Allah, I ask you, O Allah, the One, the eternally besought of all, He begetteth not, nor was He begotten, and there is none comparable unto Him, that you may forgive me my sins, you are Most Forgiving, Merciful. He (the Prophet) said: He was forgiven (repeating three times.) (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 985)
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) masjid mein dakhil huay, to dekha aik shakhs apni namaz padh chuka hai aur tashahhud mein baitha yeh keh raha hai: "Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon, tu jo Ahad, Samad hai, jisne na kisi ko paida kiya na khud paida kiya gaya, aur na uska koi hum-sar hai, ke tu mere gunah maaf kar de, beshak tu bohot maaf karne wala, bohot reham karne wala hai." To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse maaf kar diya gaya, isse maaf kar diya gaya, isse maaf kar diya gaya."

e: It pertains to the sunnah to utter the tashahhud quietly. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 986)
hi: Ke tashahhud khaamoshi se (aahista) kaha jaye.

e: [AI] "He narrated to me regarding sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ , 'When a Muslim person prays upon him in their prayer.'"
hi: Aur unhone mujhe Nabi (SAW) par durood bhejne ke baare mein bataya: "Jab Musalman aadmi apni namaz mein aap (SAW) par durood bheje..."

e: [AI] A man approached and sat in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while we were with him. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, we know how to greet you with peace, but how do we send blessings upon you when we have already sent blessings upon you in our prayers and Allah has already sent blessings upon you?" He remained silent until we wished that the man had not asked him. Then he said, "When you say the prayer upon me, say: 'O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, the Prophet who is unlettered, and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. And bless Muhammad, the Prophet who is unlettered, and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.'"
hi: Aik shakhs aaya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne baith gaya, hum bhi aap (SAW) ke paas thay, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap par salaam bhejna to hum jaante hain, lekin hum aap par durood kaise bhejein jab hum apni namaz mein aap par durood bhejte hain?" Unhone kaha: aap (SAW) khamosh ho gaye yahan tak ke humein bura laga ke us shakhs ne yeh sawaal kyun kiya, phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mujh par durood bhejo to kaho: 'Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin an-Nabiyyil-Ummiyyi wa ala aali Muhammadin kama sallayta ala Ibrahima wa ala aali Ibrahima, wa baarik ala Muhammadin an-Nabiyyil-Ummiyyi wa ala aali Muhammadin kama baarakta ala Ibrahima wa ala aali Ibrahima, innaka Hameedun Majeed' (Aye Allah, Muhammad, ummi Nabi, aur unki aal par apni rahmat naazil kar jaise tu ne Ibrahim aur unki aal par ki, aur Muhammad, ummi Nabi, aur unki aal par barkat naazil kar jaise tu ne Ibrahim aur unki aal par ki, beshak tu qaabil-e-tareef, azmat wala hai)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw a man praying without praising or glorifying Allah, nor sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ , and then he left. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Bring him quickly." He called him and said to him and others, "When one of you prays, let him start with praising his Lord and glorifying Him, then let him send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ , and then he may supplicate with whatever he wishes."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko namaz padhte dekha jisne na Allah ki hamd ki, na uski ta'zeem ki, na Nabi (SAW) par durood bheja, aur (namaz se) chala gaya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isne jaldi ki." Phir aap (SAW) ne use bulwaya aur usse aur doosron se farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe to pehle apne Rab ki hamd aur sana bayan kare, phir Nabi (SAW) par durood bheje, phir jo chahe dua kare."

e: [AI] "Abdullah says, 'A man should first recite the testimony of faith, then send blessings upon the Prophet (pbuh), and then make supplications for himself.' 'This hadith has been transmitted from Abdullah ibn Mas'ood with an authentic chain of narrators."
hi: Abdullah (RA) [ne kaha]: "Aadmi tashahhud kare, phir Nabi (SAW) par durood bheje, phir apne liye dua kare." (Yeh hadith Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se sahih sanad ke sath riwayat hui hai.)

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said, "When any one of you performs the Tashahhud (bearing witness) in prayer, let him say: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and have mercy upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You have sent prayers, blessed, and had mercy upon Ibrahim. Verily, You are Worthy of Praise and Glorious. And the majority of the narrations for this principle are for the obligations of prayer."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz mein tashahhud kare to kahe: 'Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammadin, wa baarik ala Muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammadin, warham Muhammadan wa aala Muhammadin, kama sallayta wa baarakta wa tarahhamta ala Ibrahima, innaka Hameedun Majeed.'" Is qaide (usool) ke shawahid namaz ke faraiz mein sabse zyada hain.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ used to say, "There is no prayer for the one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for the one who does not mention Allah upon it, and there is no prayer for the one who does not send blessings upon the Prophet of Allah in his prayer." This hadith was not narrated by them according to their condition, as they did not narrate it through 'Abdul-Muhyi.
hi: Nabi (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jiska wudu na ho, aur us shakhs ka wudu nahi jisne uspar Allah ka naam na liya ho, aur us shakhs ki namaz nahi jisne apni namaz mein Allah ke Nabi (SAW) par durood na bheja ho." (Yeh hadith dono ki shart par nahi riwayat hui, kyunke unhone Abdul Muhaimin se riwayat nahi ki.) Abdul Muhaimin kamzor hain.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ that in the first two units of prayer, he would be as if he was on a rug. We asked him until when he would stand and he replied, "Until he stands." Mas'ar narrated it from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke woh pehli do rak'aton mein aisay hote (jaldi mein) jaise garam angaaron par (baithe) hon. Unhone kaha: humne poocha: "Yahan tak ke khade ho jaayen?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, yahan tak ke khade ho jaayen." Mis'ar ne Sa'd bin Ibrahim se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: So he mentioned it in similar wording.[^1]
hi: Phir isi jaisi baat ka zikr kiya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ commanded us to respond to the salutation of the imam. and to love each other, and to salute each other. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1001)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ke hum imam ka jawaab dein, aapas mein mohabbat karein, aur aapas mein aik doosre ko salaam karein.

e:
An imam of ours, whose kunyah was Abu Rimthah, led us in prayer. He said: I performed this prayer—or one like it—with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: Abu Bakr and Umar would stand in the front row to his right. A man had caught the opening takbir of the prayer. The Prophet of Allah ﷺ prayed, then gave salam to his right and his left until we could see the whiteness of his cheek. He then turned around as Abu Rimthah turned—meaning himself.

The man who had caught the opening takbir of the prayer with him then stood to add another prayer. Umar sprang toward him, took him by the shoulder, shook him, and said: Sit down, for the People of the Book were only ruined because there was no separation between their prayers. The Prophet ﷺ raised his gaze and said: *"Allah has guided you to what is right, O son of al-Khattab."*[^1]
hi: Humare imam ne, jinka kunya Abu Rimthah (RA) tha, humein namaz padhayi, unhone kaha: "Maine yeh namaz - ya isi jaisi namaz - Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath padhi thi." Unhone kaha: Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) aap (SAW) ke dayen taraf agli saff mein khade hote the, aur aik shakhs ne namaz ki pehli takbeer paayi thi. Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz padhi, phir apni dayen aur bayen taraf salaam phera, yahan tak ke humne aap (SAW) ke gaal ki safedi dekh li, phir aap (SAW) usi tarah mude jaise Abu Rimthah (RA) khud mude - ya'ni woh apni hi baat kar rahe hain. Woh shakhs jisne aap (SAW) ke sath pehli takbeer paayi thi, khada hua taake (aik rak'at) poori kar le, to Umar (RA) uski taraf uchhal kar gaye, uska kandha pakad kar jhinjhoda, aur kaha: "Baith jao, Ahl-e-Kitab isi liye halaak huay ke unki namaz mein koi wast (faasla) na tha." To Nabi (SAW) ne apni nazar uthai aur farmaya: "Allah ne tumhein sahih baat sikhayi, aye Ibn Al-Khattab."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "There is no prayer for those who do not touch their nose to the ground."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jiski naak zameen ko na chhoye."

e: [AI] "There is no prayer for those whose nose did not touch the ground."
hi: "Us shakhs ki namaz nahi jiski naak zameen ko na chhoye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded the placement of the hands and the positioning of the feet during prayer.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "namaz mein haathon ko (theek jagah) rakhne aur paon ko (theek tarah) khade karne" ka hukum diya.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded to place the hands and position the feet in prayer."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz mein hatheliyon ko rakhne aur paon ko khade karne ka hukum diya."

e: [AI] I was at Umm Salamah's house when a relative of hers, a young man with curly hair, entered. He stood up to pray and then blew. He said, "O my son, do not blow, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say to a servant of ours, Aswad, 'What a good fortune lies in your face!'"
hi: Main Umm Salamah (RA) ke paas thi, ke unke paas unke aik rishtedaar, aik ghunghraale baalon wale naujawan, aaye, woh khade hokar namaz padhne lage aur (dua mein) phoonkne lage. Unhone kaha: "Aye mere bete, phoonko mat, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko hamare aik kaale ghulam se yeh kehte hue suna: 'Aye Rabah, tera chehra khaak-aalood ho (yani Allah teri madad kare).'"

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade attempting to compete with another person in their prayer."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aadmi ko apni namaz mein jaldbaazi (be-sukooni) karne se mana kiya.

e: [AI] The translation is: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say when he raised his head from prostration, 'O Lord, forgive me.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) sajde se apna sar uthate waqt farmate: "Rabbighfir li" (Aye mere Rab, mujhe maaf kar de).

e: “When praying at night (Qiyamul-Lail), the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say between the two prostrations: ‘Rabbighfir li warhamni wajburni warzuqni warfa’ni (O Lord, forgive me, have mercy on me, improve my situation, grant me provision and raise me in status).’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 898)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) do sajdon ke darmiyan farmaya karte the: "Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar, mujh par reham kar, mera haal durust kar, mujhe buland kar, mujhe hidayat de aur mujhe rizq de."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited leaning during prayer."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz mein "iq'a" (aik khaas tarah baithne) se mana kiya.

e: [AI] "He heard a peacock saying, 'I asked Ibn Abbas about iqa' (a type of bird), and he said, 'It is a sunnah (recommended act).' I said, 'We see it as detestable.' Ibn Abbas said, 'Indeed, it is a sunnah.' And it is correct to allow it on the condition mentioned by Muslim."
hi: Unhone Tawus ko kehte hue suna: maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se iq'a ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Yeh Sunnat hai." Maine kaha: "Hum ise sakhti (be-adabi) samajhte hain." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh Sunnat hai." Aur iski ijaazat Muslim ki shart par sahih sabit hui hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  forbade a man who was sitting and leaning on his left hand during prayer, saying, "Indeed, this is the way of the Jews."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko namaz mein baithe hue apne baayen haath par sahara lete dekha to mana kiya aur farmaya: "Yeh Yahood ka tareeqa hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "There are two steps; one of them is more beloved to Allah and the other is more disliked by Allah. As for the step that is more beloved to Allah the Mighty and Majestic, it is a man rectifying a flaw in the row. As for the step that is more disliked by Allah, it is when a man raises his right foot to place it and firmly establishes his left foot, then stands up."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do qadam hain, aik Allah ko sabse zyada pasand hai aur doosra Allah ko sabse zyada napasand. Rahi baat woh qadam jo Allah Azza wa Jalla ko pasand hai, to woh us aadmi ka hai jo saff mein khaali jagah dekhe aur usse bhar de. Aur rahi baat woh jo Allah ko napasand hai, to jab aadmi khada hona chahta hai to apna dayan paon aage badhaye, uspar apna haath rakhe aur apna baayan paon jamaye, phir khada ho."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet, peace be upon him, used to say "Subhanal-Malikil-Qudoos" three times in a raised voice after saying the Salam. It has been narrated by Abdur-Rahman ibn Abza, who is one of those considered reliable by us, that he never met the Prophet, peace be upon him, except that his most frequent report was from Ubay ibn Ka'b and the Companions. This chain of narrators is authentic according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim, and they did not exclude it, and the Hadith is authentic.
hi: Nabi (SAW) "jab salaam phertay to teen martaba buland awaz se kehte: 'Subhanal-Malikil-Quddus' (Paak hai Baadshah, nihaayat paak)." (Abdur Rahman bin Abza unme se hain jinke baare mein humare nazdeek sahih hai ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko paaya, magar unki aksar riwayaten Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) aur (doosre) Sahaba (RA) se hain.) Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur yeh hadith sahih hai.

e: By Allah, I love you, Mu'adh. I give some instruction to you. Never leave to recite this supplication after every (prescribed) prayer: "O Allah, help me in remembering You, in giving You thanks, and worshipping You well." Mu'adh willed this supplication to the narrator al-Sunabihi and al-Sunabihi to 'Abu Abd al-Rahman. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1522)
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din mera haath pakda, phir farmaya: "Aye Mu'adh, Allah ki qasam, main tumse mohabbat karta hoon." Mu'adh (RA) ne kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap (SAW) par qurbaan hon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aur main bhi Allah ki qasam aapse mohabbat karta hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Mu'adh, main tumhein wasiyat karta hoon ke har namaz ke aakhir mein yeh kehna kabhi na chhodo: 'Allahumma a'inni ala zikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik' (Aye Allah, apne zikr, apne shukr aur apni achhi ibadat par meri madad kar)." Unhone kaha: Mu'adh (RA) ne yehi wasiyat As-Sunabihi ko ki, aur As-Sunabihi ne Abu Abdur Rahman Al-Hubuli ko ki, aur Abu Abdur Rahman ne Uqbah bin Muslim ko ki.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic text into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say after every prayer, 'O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and from the punishment of the Hellfire, and from the trials of life and death, and from the trial of the false messiah (the Antichrist).' "
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) har namaz ke aakhir mein farmate: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon qabar ke azab se, aag ke azab se, zindagi aur maut ke fitne se, aur Maseeh Dajjal ke fitne se."

e: Abu Hurairah reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying; when you come to pray while we are prostrating ourselves, you must prostrate yourselves, and do not reckon it anything (rak’ah) he has been present at the prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 893)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum namaz ke liye aao aur hum sajde mein hon, to sajda karo, aur ise (poori rak'at) kuch na samjho, aur jo shakhs aik rak'at pa le, usne (poori) namaz pa li."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Whoever prays a unit of prayer at the time of dawn, and then the sun rises, let him pray the morning prayer."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Fajr ki aik rak'at padh le, phir suraj nikal aaye, to woh Fajr ki namaz padh le."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  said: 'Whoever prays a single unit of prayer (rak'ah) from the dawn prayer (Fajr) until the rising of the sun, let him complete his prayer.' This hadith has two authentic chains of narration and has been corroborated by Khalas ibn 'Amr as a witness."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Fajr ki namaz ki aik rak'at padh le, phir suraj nikal aaye, to woh apni namaz mukammal kar le." Dono asaneed sahih hain, dono ne Khilas bin Amr ko shahid ke tor par hujjat maana hai.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever has not prayed the two Rak'ahs of Fajr prayer until the sun rises, then let him pray them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Fajr ki do (sunnah) rak'atein suraj nikalne se pehle na padh saka ho, to woh unhein (baad mein) padh le."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was on his journey. They (the people) slept abandoning the Fajr prayer. They awoke by the heat of the sun. Then they travelled a little until the sun rose high. He (the Prophet) commanded the mu'adhdhin (one who called for prayer) to call for prayer. He then offered two rak'ahs of prayer (sunnah prayer) before the (obligatory) fajr prayer. Then he (the mu'adhdhin) announced for saying the prayer in congregation (i.e. he uttered iqamah). Then he led them in the morning prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 443)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apne kisi safar mein thay, log Fajr ki namaz se so gaye, suraj ki garmi se jaage, thoda aage badhe yahan tak ke suraj buland ho gaya, phir aap (SAW) ne mu'adhdhin ko hukum diya, usne azan di, phir aap (SAW) ne Fajr se pehle wali do rak'atein padhi, phir mu'adhdhin ne iqamat kahi to aap (SAW) ne Fajr ki namaz padhi.

e: [AI] "He came while the Prophet ﷺ  was praying the Fajr prayer, so he prayed with him. When the Prophet ﷺ  finished, he stood up and prayed the two Rak'ahs of Fajr. The Prophet ﷺ  asked him, 'What are these two Rak'ahs?' He replied, 'I did not pray them before the Fajr prayer.' Then he remained silent and did not say anything. Qais bin Fahd Al-Ansari, a companion, narrated this incident, and the chain of narration is authentic according to their conditions. And it has also been narrated by Muhammad bin Ibrahim at-Taymi from Qais bin Fahd, who is a companion and has a witness."
hi: Woh aaye jabke Nabi (SAW) Fajr ki namaz padh rahe thay, unhone aap (SAW) ke sath namaz padhi, jab aap (SAW) ne salaam phera to woh khade huay aur Fajr ki (sunnah) do rak'atein padhi. Nabi (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Yeh do rak'atein kaisi hain?" Unhone kaha: "Maine yeh Fajr se pehle nahi padhi thi." To aap (SAW) khamosh rahe aur kuch nahi farmaya. (Qais bin Fahd Al-Ansari (RA) sahabi hain, aur unke paas jaane wala tareeqa dono ki shart par sahih hai.) Ise Muhammad bin Ibrahim At-Taimi ne bhi Qais bin Fahd (RA) se riwayat kiya hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a person praying after the congregational prayer at dawn was over. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There are two rak'ahs of the dawn prayer (i.e. the prescribed rak'ahs). The man replied: I did not pray the two rak'ahs before the dawn prayer. Hence I offered them now. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kept silent. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1267)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko Fajr ki namaz ke baad do rak'atein padhte dekha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya Fajr ki namaz do martaba (padhi jaati hai)?" Us shakhs ne kaha: "Maine woh do rak'atein jo isse pehle (padhni chahiye thi) nahi padhi thi, to abhi padh li." To Rasulullah (SAW) khamosh ho gaye.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ was asked about praying on a ship, so he said, "How should I pray on a ship?" He said, "Pray standing on it, unless you fear drowning."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se kashti mein namaz ke baare mein poocha gaya, (poochne wale ne kaha:) "Main kashti mein kaise namaz padhun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usme khade hokar namaz padho, siwaye is soorat mein jab tumhein doobne ka darr ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever combines two prayers without an excuse has opened a door from the gates of major sins." Hanash bin Qays Al-Rahbi, also known as Abu Ali from the people of Yemen, resided in Kufa and was trustworthy. And Al-Bukhari referred to Ikrimah as evidence, and this hadith is a basis for prohibition against combining prayers without an excuse, and they did not exclude it. This was mentioned in the context of validating the narration of Hakeem regarding Hanash, but they weakened it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs bagair kisi uzr ke do namazon ko jama kare, usne kabaair (bade gunahon) ke darwazon mein se aik darwaza khol diya." (Hanash bin Qais Ar-Rahbi, jinhein Abu Ali kaha jata hai, Yemen ke rehne wale hain, Kufa mein sukoonat pazeer huay, thiqa hain. Bukhari ne Ikrimah ko hujjat maana hai, aur yeh hadith bagair uzr ke jama karne se rokne ka aik usool hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.)

e: [AI] She said, "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  praying while seated."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko chaar-zaanu (baith kar) namaz padhte dekha."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray standing at night for a long time, and used to pray sitting at night for a long time. When he prayed standing, he bowed standing, and when he prayed sitting, he bowed sitting. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 955)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) raat ko lambi der khade hokar namaz padhte aur lambi der baith kar bhi. Jab khade hokar padhte to ruku bhi khade hokar karte, aur jab baith kar padhte to ruku bhi baith kar karte."

e: [AI] "We used to go and discuss with the imams during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Yahya bin Ghailan and Abdullah bin Bazie were two trustworthy individuals."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein imaamon ko (bhoolne par qira'at mein) yaad dilaya karte the."

e: [AI] The companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  used to teach each other about the prayer.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) namaz mein aik doosre ko (bhoolne par) yaad dilaya karte the."

e: [AI] The translation of the given phrase is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to prostrate in gratitude to Allah Almighty whenever something pleasing or joyful came to him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab koi khushi ki baat aati ya unhein khush karti to Allah Ta'ala ka shukr ada karte hue sajde mein gir jate."

e: "When the believing slave performs Wudu' and rinses his mouth, his sins come out from his mouth. When he sniffs water into his nose and blows it out, his sins come from his nose. When he washes his face, his sins come out from his face, even from beneath his eyelashes. When he washes his hands, his sins come out from his hands, even from beneath his fingernails. When he wipes his head, his sins come out from his head, even from his ears. When washes his feet, his sins come from his feet, even from beneath his toenails. Then his walking to the Masjid and his Salah will earn extra merit for him." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 103)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab banda wudu karta hai aur kulli karta hai, to gunah uske mun se nikal jate hain, phir jab woh naak jhaadta hai, to gunah uski naak se nikal jate hain, phir jab woh apna chehra dhota hai, to gunah uske chehre se nikal jate hain yahan tak ke uski palkon ke kinaron se bhi nikal jate hain, phir jab woh apne haath dhota hai, to gunah uske haathon se nikal jate hain yahan tak ke uske naakhoonon ke neeche se bhi nikal jate hain, phir jab woh apne sar ka masah karta hai, to gunah uske sar se nikal jate hain yahan tak ke uske kaanon se bhi nikal jate hain, phir jab woh apne paon dhota hai, to gunah uske paon se nikal jate hain yahan tak ke uske paon ke naakhoonon ke neeche se bhi nikal jate hain, phir uska masjid ki taraf chalna aur uski namaz nafl (izafi sawab) ban jati hai."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Adhere to righteousness even though you will not be able to do all acts of virtue. Know that the best of your deeds is Salat (prayer) and that no one maintains his ablution except a believer.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 277)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Seedhe raho, aur tum (nekiyan) gin nahi paoge, aur jaan lo ke tumhare deen ki behtareen cheez namaz hai, aur wudu ki hifazat sirf momin hi karta hai."

e: [AI] "About Thawban."
hi: Thawban (RA) se.

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Adhere to righteousness even though you will not be able to do all acts of virtue. Know that the best of your deeds is Salat (prayer) and that no one maintains his ablution except a believer.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 277)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Seedhe raho, aur tum (nekiyan) gin nahi paoge, aur jaan lo ke tumhare amalon mein sabse behtareen namaz hai, aur wudu ki hifazat sirf momin hi karta hai."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Adhere to righteousness even though you will not be able to do all acts of virtue. Know that the best of your deeds is Salat (prayer) and that no one maintains his ablution except a believer.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 277)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Seedhe raho, aur tum (nekiyan) gin nahi paoge, aur jaan lo ke tumhare amalon mein sabse behtareen namaz hai, aur wudu par hamesha qaim rehna sirf momin hi karta hai."

e: Anyone who performs ablution and performs his ablution well, and then he offers two rak’ahs of prayers in a way that he does not forget ( anything in it), will be forgiven all his past sins. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 905)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs wudu kare aur usse achha kare, phir do rak'atein padhe jinme koi ghaflat (bhool) na ho, uske pichle gunah maaf kar diye jate hain."

e: [AI] About Hisham ibn Saad, he mentioned it in a similar manner.
hi: Hisham bin Sa'd se, unhone isi jaisi baat zikr ki.

e: [AI] "From Uqbah ibn Amir."
hi: Uqbah bin Aamir (RA) se.

e: [AI] We were informed of a hadith that you heard from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, who said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, more than once or twice or three times, saying, 'When a believing servant performs ablution and rinses his mouth and snuffs water in his nose, sins come out from the corners of his mouth. Then, when he washes his hands, sins come out from the tips of his fingers. When he wipes his head, sins come out from the corners of his head. If he stands up and prays two units of prayer, focusing his heart and his extremities towards Allah Almighty, he will come out of his sins as he was born from his mother.'"
hi: ...humein woh hadith sunaao jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni hai. Unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko aik baar nahi, do baar nahi, teen baar nahi, balke kayi baar yeh farmate suna: "Jab momin bandah wudu karta hai aur kulli karta hai aur naak jhaadta hai, to gunah uske mun ke kinaron se nikal jate hain, phir jab woh apne haath dhota hai, to gunah uske naakhoonon se jhad jate hain, phir jab woh apne sar ka masah karta hai, to gunah uske sar ke kinaron se jhad jate hain, phir agar woh khada hokar do rak'atein padhe jinme apna dil aur apni nazar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf mutawajjeh rakhe, to woh apne gunahon se aise nikal jata hai jaise us din tha jab uski maa ne use paida kiya."

e: [AI] They asked us about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so 'Amr ibn Abasa said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say five times, 'When a Muslim performs ablution and washes his hands, his sins come out from between his fingers and the tips of his fingers. Then when he washes his face, his sins come out from the ends of his beard. Then when he wipes his head, his sins come out from the ends of his hair. Then when he washes his feet, his sins come out from the soles of his feet."
hi: ...humein Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein bataiye? To Amr bin Abasah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko aik ya do baar nahi, balke paanch baar yeh farmate suna: 'Jab Musalman apna wudu (shuru) karta hai aur apne haath dhota hai, to uske gunah uski ungliyon aur ungliyon ke kinaron se nikal jate hain, phir jab woh apna chehra dhota hai, to gunah uski daadhi ke kinaron se nikal jate hain, phir jab woh apne sar ka masah karta hai, to gunah uske baalon ke kinaron se nikal jate hain, phir jab woh apne paon dhota hai, to gunah uske paon ke talwon se nikal jate hain.'"

e: The Prophet said: "Sins are expiated by well-performed ablution despite difficulties, increasing the number of steps one takes towards the mosque, (and waiting for the next prayer after prayer)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 428)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mushkil (sardi waghera) mein bhi wudu ko mukammal karna, masjidon ki taraf zyada qadam uthana, aur namaz ke baad doosri namaz ka intezar karna - yeh gunahon ko dho dalta hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The key to prayer is wudoo’, entering it is takbeer and exiting it is tasleem.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 1072)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz ki kunji wudu hai, iska (namaz mein) dakhil hona takbeer hai, aur iska khatm hona salaam hai."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr and Uthman, the sons of Abu Shaybah, narrated: Abu Usamah told us that Abu Al-Walid Al-Faqih reported to him, who was informed by Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Shirawayh, who was informed by Ishaq bin Ibrahim, who was informed by Abu Usamah, who was informed by Al-Walid bin Kathir, who heard from Muhammad bin Ja'far bin Zubair, who heard from Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about water that is found in Al-Falaa land and the animals that drink from it and their impurity. He said, "If the water is two small amounts, nothing will render it impure."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se registan (khuli zameen) ke paani ke baare mein poocha gaya, jismein darinde aur jaanwar (aa jaate) hain, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab paani do qullon (bade matkon) jitna ho, to koi cheez usse napaak nahi karti."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about water and how some animals and carnivorous beasts might drink from it. He said: 'If the water is more than two Qullahs, it will not carry filth.'"[1] [1]It comes with some explanation in Sunan At Timidhi 'Abdah (one of the narrators) said: "Muhammad bin Ishaq said: 'A Qullah refers to Jirar (These are two nouns describing large casks that are used to hold water), and a Qullah is the thing that drinking water is held in."' At-Tirmidhi said: "This is the saying of Ash Shafa'i, Ahmad and Ishaq. They say that when the water is two Qullahs then nothing makes it impure, as long as it does not change its smell, and its taste. And they say, it is approximately fifty Qirbahs (waterskins)." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 52)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se paani aur usme jaanwaron aur darindon ke aane ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab paani do qullon jitna ho, to woh napaaki nahi uthata (qubool nahi karta)." (Imam Shafa'i ne bhi ise 'Al-Mabsoot' mein aik thiqa raawi se, ya'ni bila shak Abu Usama se, isi tarah riwayat kiya hai.)

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'If water is two Qullat (a measure) in quantity, it does not carry impurity or filth.' This is a contradictory narration that does not weaken this Hadith, for both Shaykhs (referring to Al-Bukhari and Muslim) relied on Al-Walid ibn Kathir and Muhammad ibn Abbad ibn Ja'far as their sources. Abu Usamah connected it to Muhammad ibn Ja'far. He narrated it once from this person and another time from that person. The evidence supports this."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab paani do qullon jitna ho to woh napaaki - ya farmaya: khabaasat - nahi uthata." Yeh ikhtilaf is hadith ko kamzor nahi karta, kyunke Shaykhain dono ne Al-Waleed bin Kathir aur Muhammad bin Abbad bin Ja'far ko hujjat maana hai, aur Abu Usama ne isse Muhammad bin Ja'far se joda hai, phir kabhi isse in se aur kabhi un se riwayat ki, aur iski daleel...

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ was asked about water and what animals depend on it. The Prophet ﷺ said, "If water is two qullas, it does not carry impurities." It is confirmed and established through this narration that the hadith is authentic. It is clear that Abu Usama narrated the hadith from Al-Walid ibn Kathir, both of whom are reliable and trustworthy individuals. Shu'ayb ibn Ayyub As-Sarifi is also trustworthy, and the route to him is via Al-Walid ibn Kathir. Moreover, Al-Walid ibn Kathir followed Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn Az-Zubair, and Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Yasir Al-Qurashi.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se paani aur usme jaanwaron aur darindon ke aane ke baare mein poocha gaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab paani do qullon jitna ho to woh napaaki nahi uthata." Is riwayat se hadith ki sehat sabit aur mustahkam ho gayi hai, aur zaahir ho gaya ke Abu Usama ne yeh hadith Al-Waleed bin Kathir se, dono (raawiyon) se, riwayat ki hai, kyunke Shu'aib bin Ayyub As-Sarifini thiqa aur mo'tabar hain, aur unke paas jaane wala tareeqa bhi (sahih hai), aur Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar Al-Qurashi ne bhi Al-Waleed bin Kathir ki, Muhammad bin Ja'far bin Az-Zubair se riwayat mein, mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  being asked about the water that is in the valleys and the animals and wild beasts drink from it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied: "If the water is the quantity of two Qullat (i.e., a large water container), it does not carry impurity." This narration is reported by Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Zaidah bin Qudamah, Hammad bin Salamah, Ibrahim bin Sa'd, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Yazid bin Zurai', Sa'id bin Zaid (the brother of Hammad bin Zaid), Abu Mu'awiyah, and Abdah bin Sulaiman, all of whom narrated it from Abdullah bin Ubaidullah. "And all of them reported it as I have mentioned."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) se poocha jate hue suna, registan ke paani aur usme jaanwaron aur darindon ke aane ke baare mein, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab paani do qullon ke barabar ho to woh napaaki nahi uthata." Isi tarah Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Za'idah bin Qudamah, Hammad bin Salamah, Ibrahim bin Sa'd, Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, Yazid bin Zurai', Sa'eed bin Zaid - Hammad bin Zaid ke bhai - Abu Muawiyah aur Abdah bin Sulaiman ne bhi isse riwayat kiya hai, Abdullah ne ise Ubaidullah bin Abdullah se bayan kiya. (Aur yeh sab isi baat ki sehat par ittifaq rakhte hain jo maine zikr ki hai.)

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ who said, "When water reaches two or three qullat, nothing impure can spoil it." This was narrated by Al-Hassan ibn Sufyan and also narrated by Affan ibn Muslim and others from the memorizers, such as Hammad ibn Salamah, but they did not mention whether it is two or three.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab paani do ya teen qullon tak pahunch jaye to koi cheez usse napaak nahi karti." Isi tarah humein Al-Hasan bin Sufyan se yeh riwayat pahunchi hai, aur Affan bin Muslim aur doosre huffaz ne bhi ise Hammad bin Salamah se riwayat kiya hai, magar unhone ismein 'ya teen' ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: [AI] I asked Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri and said, "One of us prays but doesn't know how much he has prayed. "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If any one of you prays and is unsure of how much he has prayed, let him prostrate twice while sitting. And if any one of you doubts that he has spoken, let him say, 'I have not spoken except by feeling a smell from his nose or hearing a sound from his ear.'"
hi: Maine Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se poocha, arz kiya: "Hum mein se koi namaz padhta hai magar use nahi pata ke usne kitni padhi." Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe aur use pata na ho ke usne kitni padhi, to woh baithe-baithe do sajde kar le. Aur jab tum mein se kisi ke paas Shaitan aakar kahe: 'Tumhara wudu toot gaya hai,' to woh kahe: 'Tu jhoota hai,' siwaye is soorat mein jab usse apni naak se koi badbu mehsoos ho ya apne kaan se koi awaz sune."

e: [AI] "He asked Abu Sa'eed al-Khudri, who mentioned it in a similar manner: 'As for the narration of Ali ibn al-Mubarak...'"
hi: Ke unhone Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se poocha, phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki. (Rahi baat Ali bin Al-Mubarak ki hadith ki...)

e: [AI] Regarding 'Uyad, he mentioned it in a similar manner. As for the narrative of Ma'mar...
hi: Ayaad se, phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki. (Rahi baat Ma'mar ki hadith ki...)

e: [AI] About 'Iyad, he mentioned something similar to this: "Al-Bukhari and Muslim agreed on extracting scattered hadiths from the two Sahih collections, which are used as evidence that touching is not considered adultery. Among them is the hadith of Abu Hurairah: 'The hand is its own adultery' and the hadith of Ibn Abbas: 'Perhaps you touched' and the hadith of Ibn Mas'ood: 'Establish the prayer at the two ends of the day.' There are still authentic hadiths related to them in tafsir and other matters."
hi: Ayaad se, phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki. Bukhari aur Muslim dono ne apni Sahihain mein mukhtalif hadithein nikali hain jinse yeh isteedlal (daleel) liya jata hai ke jima se kam chhoona bhi (wudu tod deta hai), unme se Abu Hurairah (RA) ki hadith hai: "Haath ka zina chhoona hai," aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ki hadith hai: "Shayad tumne chhua ho," aur Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ki hadith hai: "Din ke dono kinaron par namaz qaim karo." Inke ilawa bhi sahih ahadith tafseer waghera mein baaqi hain, unme se...

e: [AI] "Every day, or almost every day, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would visit us and kiss and touch everything below the Kaaba except for the corner where he prayed, and when he came to that corner, he would stand steadfastly by it."
hi: "Koi din aisa nahi guzarta tha, ya kam hi koi din guzarta, jab Rasulullah (SAW) hum sab (azwaaj) ke paas chakkar na lagate, aap (SAW) bosa dete aur chhoote, jima ke ilawa, aur jab us (biwi) ke paas jate jiski baari hoti to wahin theher jate."

e: [AI] From Abdullah in his statement of Allah Almighty: "Or if you have been intimate with women" [Quran 4:43], he said, "This refers to anything less than sexual intercourse, and in this case, ablution is required."
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "Aw lamastumun-nisa" (Surah An-Nisa 43) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh jima se kam (hai), aur ismein wudu wajib hai."

e: [AI] "The direction of prayer (qibla) is from the touch, so purify yourselves from it."
hi: "Beshak bosa bhi chhoone mein shamil hai, isliye ismein wudu karo."

e: [AI] "He (the narrator) was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when a man came to him and asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, what do you say about a man who has had sexual intercourse with a woman who is forbidden for him?' The Prophet ﷺ remained silent, and then said, 'Perform ablution and then pray.' Allah Almighty also revealed the verse, 'Establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night' [Hud 114]. The man then asked, 'Is this specific to me or for all Muslims?' The Prophet ﷺ replied, 'It is for all believing Muslims.' These narrations and the ones I mentioned indicate that the two respected scholars agreed on them, except that they were mentioned separately in the two books with slight variations. All of them are authentic and serve as evidence that any physical contact that requires ablution does not include sexual intercourse."
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas baithe huay thay ke aik shakhs aaya aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap us aadmi ke baare mein kya kehte hain jisne kisi aisi aurat ko chhu liya jo uske liye halal nahi thi?" Aap (SAW) ne kuch nahi chhoda... "achha wudu karo, phir khade hokar namaz padho." Unhone kaha: aur Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "Din ke dono sirron par aur raat ke kuch hisson mein namaz qaim karo" (Surah Hud 114). Unhone kaha: to usne poocha: "Yeh sirf mere liye khaas hai ya tamam Musalmanon ke liye aam hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke tamam momino ke liye aam hai." (Yeh tamam ahadith jo maine zikr ki hain, un par Shaykhain ka ittifaq hai, magar woh dono kitaabon mein alag-alag tor par nikali gayi hain, aur sab sahih hain, is baat par daleel ke ke jo chhoona wudu wajib karta hai woh jima se kam (darje ka) hota hai.)

e: [AI] About the touching of the private parts, if it is touched without any harm, then 'Urwah narrated that Busrah bint Safwan informed me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "When one of you touches his private parts, he should not pray until he performs ablution." Marwan sent someone to ask Busrah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned and said: "Yes, he (Hisham) used to say, 'When one touches his private parts or his organs or his anus, he should not pray until he performs ablution.' It is like this," and Hammad bin Zaid reported this Hadith and mentioned the hearing of 'Urwah from Busrah and Khalaf bin Hisham as proof of its authenticity. Khalaf is trustworthy and one of the leading Qur'an reciters. Among the evidence confirming the authenticity of the narration from the majority of the companions of Hisham bin 'Urwah from Hisham, from his father, from Busrah, including Ayub bin Abu Tameemah As-Sakhtiyani, Qays bin Sa'd Al-Makki, Ibn Jurayj, Ibn 'Uyaynah, 'Abdul-'Aziz bin Abu Hazim, Yahya bin Sa'id, Hammad bin Salamah, Ma'mar bin Rashid, Hisham bin Hassan, 'Abdullah bin Muhammad Abu 'Alqamah, 'Asim bin Hilal Al-Bariqi, Yahya bin Tha'labah Al-Mazini, Sa'id bin 'Abd Ar-Rahman Al-Jumahi, 'Ali bin Al-Mubarak Al-Hunai'i, Aban bin Yazid Al-'Atari, Muhammad bin 'Abd Ar-Rahman At-Tufawi, 'Abdul-Hamid bin Ja'far Al-Ansari, 'Abdul-'Aziz bin Muhammad Ad-Darawardi, Yazid bin Sinan Al-Jazri, 'Abd Ar-Rahman bin Abi Az-Zinad, 'Abd Ar-Rahman bin 'Abdul-'Aziz, Harithah bin Harimah Al-Fuqaymi, Abu Ma'mar, 'Abbad bin Suhayb, and others. A group has differed from them, but they transmitted it from Hisham bin 'Urwah from his father from Marwan, including Sufyan bin Sa'id Ath-Thawri, and it has been narrated from Hisham bin Hassan, and Hammad bin Salamah, Malik bin Anas, Wahb bin Khalid, Salam bin Abi Muti', 'Umar bin 'Ali Al-Muqaddami, 'Abdullah bin Idris, 'Ali bin Musahir, Abu Usamah, and others. The difference in the narration has been mentioned regarding Hisham bin 'Urwah among his companions, so we looked into it and found that the group who confirmed hearing 'Urwah from Busrah were greater in number, and some of them were more trustworthy than those who transmitted it from Marwan, except that also some of the reliable Hafiz were mentioned among them who mentioned hearing Marwan from Busrah. So, we considered that those who did not mention this difference had not studied it, and that it is baseless to criticize the narrators of Hadith for narrating from Marwan. Therefore, we found a group of reliable Hafiz narrating this statement from Hisham bin 'Urwah from his father from Marwan from Busrah, and then they mentioned in their narrations that 'Urwah said, 'Then I met Busrah after that, and she narrated the Hadith to me from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  as Marwan narrated it from her.' This indicated the authenticity and preservation of the Hadith according to the condition of the two sheikhs, and the difference and doubt were eliminated. The hearing of 'Urwah from Busrah has been confirmed, and among those mentioned who heard 'Urwah from Busrah is Shu'ayb bin Ishaq Ad-Dimashqi.
hi: Zakar (sharamgaah) ko chhoone ke baare mein (poocha gaya), unhone (Marwan ne) ismein koi harj na samjha, to Urwah ne kaha: "Busrah bint Safwan (RA) ne mujhe bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se koi apni sharamgaah ko chhu le, to woh wudu kiye bagair namaz na padhe.'" To Marwan ne aik pehredaar ko Busrah (RA) ke paas bheja, qaasid wapas aaya aur kaha: "Haan (yehi baat hai)." Hisham ne kaha: "Mere waalid kaha karte the: 'Jab woh apni sharamgaah, apne khusiyon ya apni sharamgaah ke kisi hisse ko chhue, to woh wudu kiye bagair namaz na padhe.'" Isi tarah Hammad bin Zaid ne yeh hadith bayan ki hai, aur ismein Urwah ka Busrah (RA) se sunna zikr kiya hai, aur Khalaf bin Hisham thiqa hain aur woh Quraa (Quran padhne walon) ke a'imma mein se hain. Hisham bin Urwah ke aksar shagirdon ki, Hisham se, unke walid se, Busrah (RA) se, riwayat ki sehat par jo daleel milti hai, unme Ayyub bin Abi Tamimah As-Sakhtiyani, Qais bin Sa'd Al-Makki, Ibn Jurayj, Ibn Uyainah, Abdul Aziz bin Abi Hazim, Yahya bin Sa'eed, Hammad bin Salamah, Ma'mar bin Rashid, Hisham bin Hassan, Abdullah bin Muhammad Abu Alqamah, Aasim bin Hilal Al-Bariqi, Yahya bin Tha'labah Al-Mazini, Sa'eed bin Abdur Rahman Al-Jumahi, Ali bin Al-Mubarak Al-Hunai'i, Aban bin Yazid Al-Attar, Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman At-Tufawi, Abdul Hameed bin Ja'far Al-Ansari, Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad Ad-Darawardi, Yazid bin Sinan Al-Jazri, Abdur Rahman bin Abi Az-Zinad, Abdur Rahman bin Abdul Aziz, Harithah bin Harimah Al-Fuqaymi, Abu Ma'mar, Abbad bin Suhaib aur doosre shamil hain. Aik jama'at ne inse ikhtilaf kiya, unhone ise Hisham bin Urwah se, unke walid se, Marwan se, Busrah (RA) se riwayat kiya, unme Sufyan bin Sa'eed Ath-Thawri, aur Hisham bin Hassan ki, Hammad bin Salamah ki, Malik bin Anas ki, Wahb bin Khalid ki, Salam bin Abi Muti' ki, Umar bin Ali Al-Muqaddami ki, Abdullah bin Idris ki, Ali bin Mushir ki, Abu Usama ki aur doosron ki riwayaten shamil hain. Hisham bin Urwah par unke shagirdon ke darmiyan yeh ikhtilaf zikr kiya gaya hai, to humne ghor kiya to paaya ke jinhone Urwah ka Busrah (RA) se sunna sabit kiya hai woh tadaad mein zyada hain aur unme se kuch un logon se zyada mo'tabar hain jinhone ise Marwan se (riwayat) kiya, magar hadith ke huffaz a'imma mein se aik jama'at ne bhi ismein Marwan ka zikr kiya hai, unme Malik bin Anas, Ath-Thawri aur unke hum-martaba log shamil hain, isliye aik giroh ne jinhone is ikhtilaf par achhi tarah ghor nahi kiya, samjha ke yeh khabar kamzor hai, kyunke hadith ke a'imma ne Marwan par aitraaz kiya hai. Phir humne ghor kiya to thiqa huffaz ki aik jama'at paayi jinhone yeh hadith Hisham bin Urwah se, unke walid se, Marwan se, Busrah (RA) se, riwayat ki hai, phir unhone apni riwayaton mein zikr kiya ke Urwah ne kaha: 'Phir maine iske baad Busrah (RA) se mulaqat ki, to unhone mujhe woh hadith Rasulullah (SAW) se bayan ki jaisi Marwan ne unse (naql karke) mujhe bayan ki thi.' To isse humein hadith ki sehat aur Shaykhain ki shart par iski mazbooti ka pata chala, aur ismein ikhtilaf aur shubha khatam ho gaya, aur Urwah ka Busrah (RA) se sunna sabit ho gaya. Un logon mein se jinka zikr humne Urwah ke Busrah (RA) se sunne ke baare mein kiya, Shu'aib bin Ishaq Ad-Dimashqi hain.

e: [AI] About Busra bint Safwan, who had accompanied the Prophet ﷺ , it is reported that the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever touches their private parts should perform ablution." Urwah narrated, "I asked Busra about this and she confirmed what the Prophet ﷺ  had said."
hi: Busrah bint Safwan (RA) se, jo Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat mein rahi hain, ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apni sharamgaah ko chhue woh wudu kare." Urwah ne kaha: phir maine Busrah (RA) se poocha, to unhone unki (baat ki) tasdeeq ki jo unhone kahi thi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever washes and purifies himself, then goes early and sits close to the Imam, listening and being attentive, will have the reward of fasting and praying the whole year for every step he takes."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs (achhi tarah) dhoye aur ghusl kare, phir subah subah jaldi nikle, imam ke qareeb baithe, tawajjo se sune aur khamosh rahe, to har qadam ke badle usse aik saal ke roze aur qiyaam (raat ki ibadat) ka ajr milega."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Whoever performs ghusl (ritual bath) and purifies themselves on the day of Jumu'ah (Friday), then hastens to the mosque early and attends the Friday prayer without engaging in any distraction, they will receive the reward of a whole year's worth of fasting and praying for every step they take." This hadith has been authenticated through these chains of narrators according to the conditions set by the two leading scholars (Bukhari and Muslim). They did not exclude it, and I believe this narration is weak and cannot be justified with such chains." This is a narration with a flawed chain.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo shakhs Jum'e ke din (achhi tarah) dhoye aur ghusl kare, phir jaldi aur subah subah jaye, imam ke qareeb baithe, tawajjo se sune aur be-faida baat na kare, to har qadam ke badle jo woh uthaye, usse aik saal ke amal, uske qiyaam aur roze ka ajr milega." Yeh hadith in asaneed ke sath Shaykhain ki shart par sahih sabit hui hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. (Mera khayal hai yeh aik kamzor hadith hai, aisi asaneed ke sath is tarah ki hadith ko sahih nahi maana jata.) Yeh hadith aik khaami rakhti hai jo nazarandaaz ki gayi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever performs ghusl on the day of Jumu'ah (Friday), then performs wudu' (ablution), then goes close to the Imam, listens attentively, and remains silent, for every step he takes, he will receive the reward equivalent to a year of fasting and standing (in prayer)." This does not justify the established authentic narrations for several reasons. Firstly, Hassan ibn Atiyya has mentioned the hearing of Aws ibn Aws from the Prophet ﷺ. Secondly, Thor ibn Yazid is not included in those who can be cited as evidence against them. And thirdly, Othman Ash-Shaibani is considered unknown.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Jum'e ke din dhoye, ghusl kare, imam ke qareeb ho, nazdeek jaye, tawajjo se sune aur khamosh rahe, to har qadam ke badle jo woh uthaye, usse aik saal ke roze aur qiyaam ka ajr milega." Yeh hadith mustahkam sahih ahadith ko kamzor nahi karti, kayi wajahon se: pehli yeh ke Hassan bin Atiyyah ne Aws bin Aws ka Nabi (SAW) se sunna zikr kiya hai; doosri yeh ke Thawr bin Yazid ka darja unse kam hai hujjat mein; teesri yeh ke Uthman Ash-Shaibani majhool (na-maloom) hain.

e: [AI] My father entered while I was bathing on Friday, and he asked, "Is it a bath due to impurity or for Friday?" I replied, "It's for impurity." He said, "Prepare another bath because I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Whoever bathes on the day of Friday will remain in a state of purity until the next Friday.'"
hi: Mere waalid mere paas aaye jabke main Jum'e ke din ghusl kar raha tha, unhone poocha: "Janabat ka ghusl hai ya Jum'e ke liye?" Maine kaha: "Janabat ka." Unhone kaha: "Doosra ghusl bhi kar lo, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Jo Jum'e ke din ghusl kare, woh agle Jum'e tak paakizgi mein rahega.'"

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Whoever performs ghusl (ritual bath) on the day of Jumu'ah (Friday), puts on his best clothes, applies perfume if he has it, then goes to Jumu'ah prayer and does not engage in any wrongdoing or cross the lines of others, and then prays whatever Allah wishes him to pray, and remains silent when the Imam comes out, then this is an expiation (kaffarah) for all sins until the next Jumu'ah.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Jum'e ke din ghusl kare, miswaak kare, apne behtareen kapde pehne, agar khushbu mile to lagaaye, phir aaye aur logon ko phaandta hua na guzre, phir jitni Allah chahe namaz padhe, jab imam bahar nikle to khamosh ho jaye, to yeh agle Jum'e tak (gunahon ka) kaffara ban jata hai."

e: [AI] We heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: "Whoever takes a bath on the day of Jumu'ah, purifies himself, uses some perfume if he has it, wears his best clothes, then goes to the mosque without causing harm to others, and prays as many voluntary prayers as Allah enables him to, then remains silent until the Imam finishes the prayer, his acts will serve as an expiation for the sins committed between that Jumu'ah and the previous one." Abu Hurairah said: "And three more days are considered extra rewards, as Allah has made the reward of a good deed ten times its value." (Isma'il ibn 'Ulayyah narrated this hadith, and both he and Abu Hurairah agreed on its authenticity.)
hi: Humne Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo Jum'e ke din ghusl kare, miswaak kare, agar khushbu ho to lagaaye, apne behtareen kapde pehne, phir masjid ki taraf aaye aur logon ki gardan phaandta hua na guzre, phir jitni Allah chahe (nafl) namaz padhe, phir jab imam bahar nikle to khamosh rahe yahan tak ke namaz padh le, to yeh us Jum'e aur usse pehle wale Jum'e ke darmiyan (gunahon ka) kaffara ban jata hai." Abu Hurairah (RA) kehte hain: "Aur teen din ziyada, kyunke Allah ne neki ka badla das guna kiya hai." (Isma'il bin Ulayyah un thiqa raawiyon mein se hain jinki riwayat ko dono ne nikalne par ittifaq kiya hai.)

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to, when he would go out on the day of Friday, sit on the pulpit and Bilal would call the prayer.
hi: Nabi (SAW) "jab Jum'e ke din bahar nikalte aur mimbar par baithte, to Bilal (RA) azan dete."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  ascended the pulpit on Friday and said to the people, "Sit down." Ibn Mas'ood heard it while he was at the door of the mosque, so he sat down. The Prophet ﷺ  then said to him, "Come, O Ibn Mas'ood."
hi: Nabi (SAW) Jum'e ke din mimbar par sidhe khade huay aur logon se farmaya: "Baith jao." Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne yeh suna jabke woh masjid ke darwaze par thay, to woh (wahin) baith gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aao, aye Ibn Mas'ud."

e: Ibn ‘Abbas said to his mu’adhdhin on a rainy day: “when you utter the words ‘ I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah,” do not say,” Come to prayer” but say “Pray at your homes,” By this (announcement) the people were surprised. He said: One who was better than me has done it. The Friday prayer is an obligatory duty. But I disliked to put you to hardship so that you might walk in mud and rain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1066)
hi: Apne mu'adhdhin se, baarish waale din, (kaha): "Jab tum kaho 'Ashhadu anna Muhammadar Rasoolullah' to 'Hayya alas-Salah' mat kaho, kaho 'Sallu fi buyootikum' (Apne gharon mein namaz padho)." To logon ko yeh baat ajeeb lagi, unhone kaha: "Yeh kaam mujh se behtar shakhs ne bhi kiya hai, beshak Jum'a zaroori (farz) hai, magar mujhe napasand tha ke main tumhein (ghar se) nikaalun aur tum kichad aur paani mein chalo." Sahih.

e: [AI] "I did not memorize it except from what I heard from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, reciting it every Friday." She said, "And it used to be our light, and the light of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was one."
hi: "Maine Surah Qaf sirf Rasulullah (SAW) ke mubarak mun se hi yaad ki, jise aap (SAW) har Jum'e ke din padhte the." Unhone kaha: "Aur hamara tandoor aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka tandoor aik hi tha (ya'ni hum unke bilkul qareeb rehte the)."

e: [AI] "I read Surah Al-Quran Al-Majeed from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He used to recite it every Friday when addressing the people." Yahya bin Abdullah is the son of Abdul Rahman bin Asad bin Zurarah.
hi: "Maine 'Qaf wal-Qur'anil-Majeed' Rasulullah (SAW) ke mubarak mun se padhi hai, aap (SAW) ise har Jum'e ke din, jab logon ko khutba dete, padhte the." Yahya bin Abdullah, yeh Ibn Abdur Rahman bin Asad bin Zurarah hain.

e: [AI] He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  addressed us one day and recited Surah "Sad". When he reached the prostration in the recitation, he descended and prostrated, and we also prostrated. He recited it again and when he reached the prostration, he informed us about the prostration. When he saw us, he said, "Indeed, it is the repentance of a Prophet, but I see that you have already prepared for the prostration." So he descended and prostrated, and we also prostrated."
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein aik din khutba di aur Surah Sad padhi, jab sajda wali ayat par pahunche to (mimbar se) utre aur sajda kiya, humne bhi sajda kiya. Doosri baar phir usse padha, jab sajda wali ayat par pahunche to hum sajde ke liye taiyyar ho gaye. Jab aap (SAW) ne humein (taiyyar) dekha to farmaya: "Yeh to (bas) aik Nabi ki tauba hai, lekin main dekh raha hoon tum sajda karne ke liye taiyyar ho chuke ho," to aap (SAW) utre aur sajda kiya, humne bhi sajda kiya.

e: [AI] "When I approached the city of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , I dismounted my ride and removed my traveling clothes. I adorned my best clothes and entered while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was delivering a sermon. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  greeted me and the people stared at me. I said to my companion, 'O Abdullah, did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  mention anything about me?' He replied, 'Yes, he mentioned you in the best possible way.' The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, he will enter upon you through this door or through this gap, bringing good tidings from the right side, and on his face will be the mark of an angel.' So I thanked Allah for what had been made clear to me."
hi: Jab main Rasulullah (SAW) ke shehar ke qareeb pahuncha, to maine apni sawari bithai, apna asbaab khola, apna behtareen joda pehna, phir dakhil hua jabke Rasulullah (SAW) khutba de rahe thay. Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe salaam kiya, to logon ne mujhe ghoor kar dekha. Maine apne sathi se poocha: "Aye Abdullah, kya Rasulullah (SAW) ne mere baare mein kuch zikr kiya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, aap (SAW) ne aapka bohot achha zikr kiya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aqareeb hai ke tumhare paas is darwaze se - ya is raste se - khair-o-barkat wala aik shakhs dakhil hoga, jiske chehre par farishte ki (si) alaamat hai.'" To maine Allah ki hamd ki us azmaish par jo mujhpar aayi.

e: [AI] "I would not leave it after seeing it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then, a man mentioned it who came on Friday while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was giving the sermon. Then, another Friday came and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was giving the sermon, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded the people to give charity. The man then threw one of his garments, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed and then reproached him, saying, 'Take your garment.' Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'This entered into a reprehensible form, so I commanded the people to give charity.' So, he threw this garment, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him to pray two Rak'ahs."
hi: Main isse (Jum'e ki namaz) chhodta nahi tha jabse maine Rasulullah (SAW) se kuch dekha tha. Phir unhone aik shakhs ka zikr kiya jo Jum'e ke din aaya jabke Rasulullah (SAW) khutba de rahe thay, phir agle Jum'e ko bhi aaya jabke Rasulullah (SAW) khutba de rahe thay, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne logon ko sadqa dene ka hukum diya, us shakhs ne apna aik kapda phenk diya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz padhi, phir usse jhidka aur farmaya: "Apna kapda le lo," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh maamooli (purane) libaas mein aaya tha to maine logon ko sadqa dene ka hukum diya, isne apna aik kapda de diya." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse hukum diya ke woh do rak'atein padhe.

e: "Abu Rifa'ah said: 'I came to the Messenger of Allah [SAW] while he was delivering a Khutbah, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, a stranger has come to ask about his religion, for he does not know what his religion is." The Messenger of Allah [SAW] stopped delivering his Khutbah and turned to me. A chair was brought, and I think its legs were of iron. The Messenger of Allah [SAW] sat down on it and started to teach me what Allah has taught him, then he went and completed his Khutbah.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5377)
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) tak pahuncha jabke woh khutba de rahe thay, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aik ajnabi shakhs apne deen ke baare mein poochne aaya hai, use nahi pata uska deen kya hai?" To aap (SAW) meri taraf mutawajjeh huay aur apna khutba chhod diya, aik kursi laayi gayi jiske paaye loha ke thay, aap (SAW) ne mujhe wahi sikhaya jo Allah ne aap (SAW) ko sikhaya tha, phir aap (SAW) apne khutba ki taraf laut aaye aur uska aakhri hissa mukammal kiya. (Muslim ki shart par.)

e: [AI] When the Prophet ﷺ ascended the pulpit, he said, "Sit down." Ibn Masud heard this and sat at the entrance of the mosque. The Prophet ﷺ saw him and said, "Come here, O Abdullah ibn Masud."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) mimbar par sidhe khade huay to farmaya: "Baith jao." Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne yeh suna to woh masjid ke darwaze par baith gaye. Nabi (SAW) ne unhein dekha to farmaya: "Aao, aye Abdullah bin Mas'ud."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to deliver his sermons while sitting on the pulpit. Someone denied this, but I bear witness that I saw him delivering his sermon while standing, then he would sit, then stand again and deliver another sermon. I asked, "How was his sermon?" He said, "He would speak words that would admonish the people and recite verses from the Book of Allah. Then he would descend. His sermon was concise, and his prayer was towards the sun when it had passed its zenith, towards the sky, and towards the morning and evening stars, except for the Fajr (dawn) prayer and the Dhuhr (noon) prayer. Bilal would call the prayer when the sun declined. If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived, he would stand up, and if not, he would remain silent until he came out. As for the Asr (afternoon) prayer, it was performed similar to how you perform it, and the Maghrib (evening) prayer was performed similar to how you perform it. He would delay the Isha (night) prayer a little for your sake."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mimbar par baithkar khutba dete the, isse jhutlao, kyunke maine khud dekha hai "aap (SAW) khade hokar khutba dete, phir baith jate, phir khade hokar doosra khutba dete." Maine poocha: "Aap (SAW) ka khutba kaisa hota tha?" Unhone kaha: "Aisi baat jismein aap (SAW) logon ko naseehat karte aur Allah ki Kitab se kuch ayaat padhte, phir (mimbar se) utar aate, aur (aap SAW ka) khutba mo'tadil (na lamba na chhota) hota tha, aur aap (SAW) ki namaz bhi mo'tadil hoti thi, Surah Ash-Shams, Surah As-Sama' aur Surah At-Tariq jaisi surahon jitni, siwaye Fajr aur Zuhr ki namaz ke. Bilal (RA) us waqt azan dete jab suraj dhal jata, to agar Rasulullah (SAW) aa jate to (Bilal RA) iqamat kehte, warna khamosh rehte yahan tak ke aap (SAW) bahar tashreef laate. Aur Asr ki namaz kuch usi tarah hoti jaise tum padhte ho, aur Maghrib bhi usi tarah hoti jaise tum padhte ho, aur Isha ki aakhri namaz tumhari namaz se thodi der baad hoti thi."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, giving a sermon, saying, "I have warned you of the Fire, I have warned you of the Fire." Even if a man was in the market, he would have heard it from my place until a garment that was on his shoulders fell down to his ankles.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko khutba dete hue farmate suna: "Maine tumhein aag se daraaya! Maine tumhein aag se daraaya!" yahan tak ke agar koi shakhs bazaar mein hota to woh use mere is muqam se sun leta, yahan tak ke jo chadar aap (SAW) ke kandhe par thi woh (jazbaat ki shiddat se) aap (SAW) ke paon tak gir gayi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to deliver a sermon. Al-Hasan and Al-Husain (peace be upon them) came wearing two red shirts, stumbling and walking. He welcomed them and took them in front of him. Then he said, "Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth: Verily, your wealth and your children are but a trial." [Surah Al-Taghabun, verse 15] I saw these two children of mine and could not bear it until I came down and took them. Then he continued with his sermon. This is an authentic hadith according to the conditions of Muslim, and it has not been excluded. It is the basis for interrupting the sermon and descending from the pulpit when necessary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) khutba de rahe thay ke Al-Hasan aur Al-Husain (Alayhima as-Salam) surkh qamees pehne, thokrein khate aur uthte huay aaye, to aap (SAW) (mimbar se) utre, unhein utha liya aur apne saamne bitha liya, phir farmaya: "Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ne sach farmaya: 'Beshak tumhare maal aur tumhari aulad aazmaish hain' (Surah At-Taghabun 15). Maine apne yeh donon bachay dekhe to sabr na kar saka yahan tak ke main utar aaya aur unhein utha liya," phir aap (SAW) ne apna khutba dobara shuru kiya. Yeh hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur yeh khutba ko rok kar zaroorat ke waqt mimbar se utarne ka aik usool hai.

e: [AI] I entered the mosque and the Prophet ﷺ  was delivering a sermon, so I sat close to Ubayy ibn Ka'b. The Prophet ﷺ  recited Surah Bara'ah, so I asked Ubayy, "When was this Surah revealed?" "The narration goes that it was revealed..."
hi: Main masjid mein dakhil hua jabke Nabi (SAW) khutba de rahe thay, main Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) ke qareeb baith gaya, "Nabi (SAW) ne Surah Bara'ah padhi," to maine Ubay (RA) se poocha: "Yeh surah kab nazil hui thi?" hadith...

e: [AI] He talked to us until the Imam left, and then a man came who was taller than everyone else, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was giving a sermon. The Messenger said to him, "Sit down, for you have caused harm and disturbance."
hi: Woh humein hadith bayan kar rahe the yahan tak ke imam nikle, to aik shakhs logon ki gardanein phaandta hua aaya jabke Rasulullah (SAW) khutba de rahe thay, aap (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Baith jao, tumne (logon ko) takleef di hai aur der kar di hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The Friday prayer in congregation is a necessary duty for every Muslim, with four exceptions; a slave, a woman, a boy, and a sick person. Abu Dawud said: Tariq b. Shihab had seen the Prophet ﷺ but not heard anything from him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1067)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jum'a har Musalman par jama'at mein (ada karna) wajib haq hai, siwaye chaar (logon) ke: ghulam, aurat, bachcha ya bimaar."

e: Ilyas ibn AbuRamlah ash-Shami said: I witnessed Mu'awiyah ibn AbuSufyan asking Zayd ibn Arqam: Did you offer along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the Friday and 'Id prayers synchronised on the same day? He said: Yes. He asked: How did he do? He replied: He offered the 'Id prayer, then granted concession to offer the Friday prayer, and said: If anyone wants to offer it, he may offer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1070)
hi: Maine Muawiyah bin Abi Sufyan (RA) ko Zaid bin Arqam (RA) se yeh poochte hue dekha: "Kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath do Eidein aik hi din mein jama hoti dekhi hain?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone poocha: "Aap (SAW) ne kya kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) ne Eid ki namaz padhi, phir Jum'e mein rukhsat (chhoot) di aur farmaya: 'Jo chahe namaz padhe, woh padh le.'"

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Two festivals ('Id and Friday) have synchronised on this day. If anyone does not want to offer the Friday prayer, the 'Id prayer is sufficient for him. But we shall offer the Friday prayer. This tradition has been narrated by 'Umar from Shu'bah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1073)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aaj tumhare is din mein do Eidein jama ho gayi hain, to jo chahe, uske liye yeh Jum'e se kaafi hai, lekin hum Jum'a qaim karengay."

e: A speaker gave sermon before the prophet (May peace be upon him). He said : he who obeys Allah and his Prophet will follow the right course, and he who disobeys them. He (The prophet) said: get up; he said: go away, a bad speaker you are. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4981)
hi: Aik khateeb ne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne khutba diya aur kaha: "Jo Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki itaa'at kare, woh hidayat pa gaya, aur jo dono ki na-farmani kare, woh gumraah ho gaya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khade ho jao" - ya farmaya: "Chale jao, tum bohot bura khateeb ho."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to shorten the speeches. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1106)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein khutbon ko mukhtasar rakhne ka hukum diya.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not lengthen the sermon on Friday. He would say a few words. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1107)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Jum'e ke din waaz ko lamba nahi karte the, woh bas chand mukhtasar alfaz hote the."

e: [AI] The Prophet of Allah ﷺ  said, "Seek out the remembrance (of Allah) and come close to the Imam, for a person will continue to separate (from Allah) until he is left behind in Paradise, even if he enters it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zikr (majlis) mein hazir ho aur imam ke qareeb ho jao, kyunke aadmi (imam se) door hota rehta hai yahan tak ke usse Jannat mein bhi pichhe rakh diya jata hai, agarche woh usme dakhil ho jaye."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited to sit on hips by erecting feet, sticking them to the stomach and holding them with hands on Friday while the imam is delivering the sermon. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1110)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Jum'e ke din, jab imam khutba de raha ho, "hibwah" (ghutne moD kar baithne) se mana kiya.

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  descending from the pulpit, and a man came to him with a need. He stood with him until he fulfilled his need."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko mimbar se utarte dekha, to aik shakhs ne aap (SAW) ke saamne apni zaroorat pesh ki, aap (SAW) uske sath khade rahe yahan tak ke uski zaroorat poori ho gayi."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the prayer in his apartment and people were following him behind apartment. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1126)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne hujray mein namaz padhi, aur log hujray ke peechhe se aap (SAW) ki iqtida (pairavi) kar rahe the."

e: When Ibn 'Umar offered the Friday prayer in Mecca he would go forward and pray two rak'ahs, he would then go forward and pray four rak'ahs; but when he was in Medina, he offered the Friday prayer, then returned to his house and prayed two rak'ahs, not praying them in the mosque. Someone mentioned this to him and he replied that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1130)
hi: "Jab woh Makkah mein hote aur Jum'e ki namaz padhte, to aage badhkar do rak'atein padhte, phir aage badhkar chaar rak'atein padhte. Aur jab Madinah mein hote to Jum'e ki namaz padhte, phir apne ghar wapas jaakar do rak'atein padhte, masjid mein nahi padhte." Unse (iski wajah) poochi gayi to unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) aisa hi kiya karte the."

e: Ibn Jurayj said: Ata' told me that he saw Ibn Umar pray after the Friday prayer. He moved a little from the place where he offered the Friday prayer. Then he would pray two rak'ahs. He then walked far away from that place and would offer four rak'ahs. I asked Ata': How many times did you see Ibn Umar do that? He replied: Many times. AbuDawud said: This has been narrated by AbdulMalik ibn AbuSulayman, but did not narrate it completely. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1133)
hi: ...jis jagah unhone Jum'e ki namaz padhi thi, wahan se thodi si (door) hatkar, na zyada door, to woh do rak'atein padhte." Unhone kaha: "Phir usse bhi zyada aage jaate to chaar rak'atein padhte." Maine Ata' se poocha: "Aapne Ibn Umar (RA) ko kitni martaba aisa karte dekha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Kayi martaba."

e: “Whoever takes a bath on a Friday and does it well, and purifies himself and does it well, and puts on his best clothes, and puts on whatever Allah decrees for him of the perfume of his family, then comes to the mosque and does not engage in idle talk or separate (pushing between) two people; he will be forgiven for (his sins) between that day and the previous Friday.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1097)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Jum'e ke din ghusl kare aur achhi tarah kare, phir taharat kare aur achhi tarah kare, apne behtareen kapde pehne, jo Allah ne uske liye muqaddar kiya ho usme se khushbu ya apne ghar ki koi tel lagaaye, aur do logon ke darmiyan alag na kare, to Allah usse agle Jum'e tak maaf kar deta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If any of you dozes off on Friday in his gathering, then he should move from that gathering."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko Jum'e ke din apni majlis mein neend aane lage, to woh apni us majlis se hat jaye."

e: [AI] "We used to pray the Friday prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and we would rush towards the soft-ground. There would only be as much space as the length of one or two feet."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Jum'e ki namaz padhte the, phir hum saaye ki taraf jaldi karte, jo sirf aik ya do qadam jitna hota tha."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever catches up with a rak'ah of Jumu'ah prayer has caught up with it." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1425)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Jum'e ki namaz ki aik rak'at pa le, usne (poori) namaz pa li."

e: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters. (Using translation from Muslim 1716b)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever catches a rak'ah (unit of prayer) of Jumu'ah (Friday prayer), let him pray another rak'ah with it." All of these three chains of narration are authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to Bukhari and Muslim), and they did not exclude it with this wording. Rather, they agreed upon the hadith of Az-Zuhri from Abu Salamah from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever catches a rak'ah of the prayer, and whoever catches a rak'ah of Asr prayer." And Muslim included it with the addition, so whoever catches all of them, has indeed caught them all.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Jum'e ki aik rak'at pa le, to woh uske sath aik aur rak'at padh le." Yeh teenon asaneed Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hain, magar unhone ise is lafz ke sath nahi nikala, balke unhone Az-Zuhri ki, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah (RA) se, hadith par ittifaq kiya hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo namaz ki aik rak'at pa le," aur "jo Asr ki namaz ki aik rak'at pa le." Muslim ke paas ismein ziyaadti hai: "To usne woh puri (namaz) pa li" - itna hi.

e: I intend that I should command a person to lead people in prayer, and then burn those persons who absent themselves from Jumu'a prayer in their houses. (Using translation from Muslim 652)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne un logon se farmaya jo Jum'a chhod dete the: "Mera iraada hai ke main kisi shakhs ko hukum dun ke woh logon ki imamat kare, phir main un logon ke gharon ko jala dun jo Jum'a chhod dete hain." Isi tarah Abu Dawud At-Tayalisi ne Zuhair se riwayat ki hai, aur yeh Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar unhone ise is tarah nahi nikala, balke unhone 'Isha' aur baaqi namazon ka zikr karke nikala hai.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever abandons Friday (prayer) three times, for no necessary reason, Allah will place a seal over his heart.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1126)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs bagair kisi majboori ke teen martaba Jum'a chhod de, Allah uske dil par mohar laga deta hai."

e: [AI] About Abu Al-Jaad Al-Dimri, "I verified it according to the conditions of Muslim, and this is a reliable witness. I found it later, and it has another witness from the hadith of Muhammad ibn Ajlan, which is also authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, and they did not exclude it." Authentic.
hi: Abu Al-Ja'd Ad-Damri se. (Maine ise Muslim ki shart par sahih qaraar diya hai, aur yeh aik oonchi (mo'tabar) sanad hai jo maine baad mein paayi, iska aik aur shahid bhi Muhammad bin Ajlan ki hadith se milta hai, Muslim ki shart par sahih, dono ne ise nahi nikala.) Sahih.
