e: [AI] The Prophet (pbuh) said, "Indeed, can one of you imagine taking a rope from a sheep's wool, which is a mile or two miles long, and then finding it difficult to loosen it from his neck, causing him to be elevated until Friday comes, and he does not attend it until it is engraved on his heart." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his concise summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khabardar! Kya tum mein se koi (yeh chahega) ke woh aik ya do meel ki doori par bakriyon ka rewad rakhe, phir chaara (aik ya do meel ki doori par) mushkil ho jaye, to woh (aur door) chala jaye, yahan tak ke Jum'a aa jaye aur woh usme haazir na ho, yahan tak ke uske dil par mohar laga di jaye." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When it rains heavily, pray in your tents." Naseeh bin Al-Ala' Basri, who is trustworthy, narrated that [...] Indeed, the one who criticized this hadith is Naseeh Abu Abdullah Al-Muhalimi Al-Kufi, as it was reported by Samaak bin Harb. Al-Nasa'i considered him weak. This means that Naseeh bin Al-Ala' is trustworthy. Al-Bukhari said that he is a denier of hadith.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tez baarish ho, to apne dabon (khaimon/gharon) mein namaz padho." Nasih bin Al-Ala Basri thiqa hain, jinpar aitraaz kiya jata hai woh Nasih Abu Abdullah Al-Muhallami Al-Kufi hain, kyunke unse Simak bin Harb ne munkar (na-qabil-e-qabool) riwayaten ki hain. Nasa'i ne unhein kamzor kaha - ya'ni Nasih bin Al-Ala ko - aur Bukhari ne kaha: "Unki hadith munkar hai."

e: [AI] "He witnessed Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, during the time of Hudaybiyah, and they were struck by rain on a Friday that did not wet the soles of their footwear. Then the Prophet, peace be upon him, commanded them to pray in their places of encampment. This is a hadith with a sound chain of narration. The two sheikhs have cited its narrators as evidence, and it is of the kind for which they requested a continuous chain of transmission from the Successor to the Companions, and they did not exclude it." This is authentic.
hi: Woh Hudaybiyah ke zamane mein Nabi (SAW) ke sath hazir the, aur unhein Jum'e ke din aisi baarish lagi jisne unke jooton ke tale bhi na bhigoye, to "Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh apne (rehne ke) mukaam mein hi namaz padh len." Sahih.

e: [AI] "I prayed with him in the secluded area, then I stood up to pray in my place. He said, 'Do not pray until you pass in front of that or speak, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded us to do so.'"
hi: Maine unke sath maqsoorah (khaas hujray) mein namaz padhi, main apni jagah namaz padhne ke liye khada hua, to unhone kaha: "Namaz na padho jab tak (pehli namaz se) aage na badh jao ya baat na kar lo, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein isi ka hukum diya hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "One should not get up from his brother's gathering and then leave him behind." So, I said to him, "Even on Fridays?" He replied, "On Fridays and other days as well."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne bhai ko uski majlis se na uthaye, phir khud wahan baith jaye." Maine unse poocha: "Yeh Jum'e ke din ke liye hai?" Unhone kaha: "Jum'e ke din aur doosre dinon mein bhi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The master of days is Friday; on it, Adam was created, on it he entered Paradise, and on it he was expelled from it. And there is no Hour except that it will be established on Friday."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dinon ka sardar Jum'a ka din hai, isi mein Adam (AS) paida kiye gaye, isi mein Jannat mein dakhil kiye gaye, aur isi mein usse nikale gaye, aur Qayamat sirf Jum'e ke din hi qaim hogi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah will resurrect the days on the Day of Judgment in their own nature, and He will raise Friday as a radiant and shining day. Its people will be protected by it like brides being presented to their husbands, and it will illuminate for them as they walk in its light. Their colors will be as white as snow, and their fragrance will shine like musk. They will enter the mount of camphor and the two weighty things (heavens and earth) will look at them in amazement. They will not be touched by anything until they enter Paradise. No one will be in their company except the Mu'adhins (callers to prayer) who keep account."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Qayamat ke din tamam dinon ko unki asal soorat mein uthayega, aur Jum'e ko roshan aur chamakta hua uthayega, uske ahl (log) uske gird is tarah honge jaise dulhan ko uske khaawand ke paas laaya jata hai, woh unke liye roshni deta hoga, woh uski roshni mein chalengay, unke rang barf jaisay safed hongay, aur unki khushbu mushk jaisi mehkegi, woh kaafoor ke pahaadon mein guzrengay, insaan aur jinnat dono unhein hairat se dekhenge, yahan tak ke woh Jannat mein dakhil ho jayen, koi unke sath shamil nahi hoga siwaye un mu'adhdhinon ke jo (apna kaam) sirf Allah ki raza ke liye karte the."

e: [AI] About Qarthaei al-Dabbi, who was one of the first reciters, Salman reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said to him, "O Salman, what is the day of Friday?" Salman replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "O Salman, on the day of Friday, your father or your fathers congregate and I will tell you about the day of Friday. There is no man who purifies himself on the day of Friday as he has been commanded, then utters a word from his house until he comes to Friday prayer and sits and listens until he completes his prayer, except that it will serve as an expiation for what came before it from the previous Friday."
hi: Qarthaa Ad-Dabbi se, jo pehle daur ke Qura mein se the, Salman (RA) ne kaha: mujhse Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Salman, Jum'e ka din kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool (SAW) behtar jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Salman, Jum'e ke din tumhare baap - ya tumhare baap-dada - ne jama'at ki thi, aur main tumhein Jum'e ke din ke baare mein bataata hoon: koi shakhs Jum'e ke din jaise hukum diya gaya hai waise paakizgi haasil na kare, phir apne ghar se nikal kar Jum'e ke liye aaye, phir baithe aur khamosh rahe yahan tak ke apni namaz mukammal kar le, magar yeh pichle Jum'e (ke gunahon) ka kaffara ban jata hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Among the most excellent of your days is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he died, on it the last trumpet will be blown, and on it the shout will be made, so invoke more blessings on me that day, for your blessings will be submitted to me. The people asked: Messenger of Allah, how can it be that our blessings will be submitted to you while your body is decayed? He replied: Allah, the Exalted, has prohibited the earth from consuming the bodies of Prophets. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1047)
hi: Mujhse Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare behtareen dinon mein se Jum'e ka din hai, isi mein Adam (AS) paida kiye gaye, isi mein unka wisaal hua, isi mein soor phoonka jayega aur isi mein (be-hoshi ki) chingaari (aayegi), isliye is din mujhpar zyada durood bhejo, kyunke tumhara durood mujhpar pesh kiya jata hai." Unhone poocha: "Aur hamara durood aap (SAW) par kaise pesh kiya jayega jabke aap (SAW) (mitti mein) mil chuke honge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne zameen par Ambiya (AS) ke jismon ko khane se haram kar diya hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he was expelled (from Paradise), on it his contrition was accepted, on it he died, and on it the Last Hour will take place. On Friday every beast is on the lookout from dawn to sunrise in fear of the Last Hour, but not jinn and men, and it contains a time at which no Muslim prays and asks anything from Allah but He will give it to him. Ka'b said: That is one day every year. So I said: It is on every Friday. Ka'b read the Torah and said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has spoken the truth. AbuHurayrah said: I met Abdullah ibn Salam and told him of my meeting with Ka'b. Abdullah ibn Salam said: I know what time it is. AbuHurayrah said: I asked him to tell me about it. Abdullah ibn Salam said: It is at the very end of Friday. I asked: How can it be when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has said: "No Muslim finds it while he is praying...." and this is the moment when no prayer is offered. Abdullah ibn Salam said: Has the Messenger of Allah ﷺ not said: "If anyone is seated waiting for the prayer, he is engaged in the prayer until he observes it." I said: Yes, it is so. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1046)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suraj tulu' hone wale dinon mein sabse behtareen din Jum'e ka din hai, isi mein Adam (AS) paida kiye gaye, isi mein (Jannat se) utaare gaye, isi mein unki tauba qubool hui, isi mein unka wisaal hua, aur isi mein Qayamat qaim hogi. Koi jaandaar (janwar) aisa nahi jo Jum'e ke din subah se lekar suraj ki lali (ghuroob) tak Qayamat ke khauf se kaan lagaaye na ho, siwaye jinnat aur insaan ke. Aur ismein aik ghari (aisi) hai jise koi Musalman banda namaz padhte hue na paaye aur Allah se kuch maange magar Allah use woh de deta hai." Ka'b ne poocha: "Kya yeh saal mein aik din hai?" Maine kaha: "Balke har Jum'e ko." To Ka'b ne Taurat padhi aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne sach farmaya." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: phir mujhe Abdullah bin Salam (RA) mile, maine unhein Ka'b ke sath apni majlis ke baare mein bataya, to Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe pata hai woh kaunsi ghari hai." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: maine kaha: "To mujhe bata dijiye." Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ne kaha: "Woh Jum'e ke din ki aakhri ghari hai." Maine kaha: "Yeh Jum'e ke din ki aakhri ghari kaise ho sakti hai jabke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Koi Musalman banda ise namaz padhte hue na paaye,' aur us waqt to namaz nahi padhi jaati?" To Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ne kaha: "Kya Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh nahi farmaya: 'Jo koi (namaz ke intezar mein) baithe rehta hai, woh namaz mein hi shumaar hota hai yahan tak ke woh namaz padh le'?"

e: [AI] I went to Mount Taur and there I met Ka'b al-Ahbar, so I told him about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he spoke about the Torah, and they did not differ until I passed through Friday. I said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "In every Friday, there is a moment where a believer prays and asks Allah for something, and Allah grants it to him." Ka'b asked, "Is this every year?" I said, "No, it is not like that." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, so he returned and recited (the Qur'an), and then said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  spoke the truth, in every Friday." Abu Hurairah said, "Then I met Abdullah ibn Salam, so I told him in my gathering with Ka'b, and he mentioned the Hadith in a similar way to that of Malik."
hi: Main (Koh) Toor par aaya, wahan mujhe Ka'b Al-Ahbar mile, maine unhein Rasulullah (SAW) se (suni) baatein sunayi, aur unhone Taurat se baatein bayan ki, humara ikhtilaf na hua yahan tak ke main Jum'e ke din ka zikr le aaya. Unhone kaha: maine kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har Jum'e ke din aik ghari aisi hai jisme koi momin namaz padhte hue Allah se kuch maange magar Allah use woh de deta hai." Ka'b ne poocha: "Kya yeh saal mein aik baar hai?" Maine kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne aisa nahi farmaya." To woh wapas gaye aur (Taurat) padhi, phir kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne sach farmaya, har Jum'e mein (aisi ghari hoti hai)." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: phir mujhe Abdullah bin Salam (RA) mile, maine unhein Ka'b ke sath apni majlis ke baare mein bataya, phir unhone hadith zikr ki, Malik ki hadith jaisi hi.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Friday is divided into twelve hours. Amongst them there is an hour in which a Muslim does not ask Allah for anything but He gives it to him. So seek it in the last hour after the afternoon prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1048)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jum'e ka din baarah ghantay ka hota hai, aur koi Musalman banda aisa nahi milta jo Allah se kuch maange magar Allah use woh de deta hai, isliye ise Asr ke baad ki aakhri ghari mein talaash karo."

e: [AI] I said by Allah, if I come to Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri and ask him about this hour, he might have knowledge about it. So I went to him and said, "O Abu Sa'id, Abu Hurayrah narrated to us about the hour that occurs on Fridays. Do you have any knowledge about it?" He said, "We asked the Prophet ﷺ about it, and he said, 'I used to know about it but then I forgot it like I forgot the Night of Decree.'" Then I left him and went to Abdullah bin Salam and mentioned the narration. "And this is a valid witness according to the conditions of the two sheikhs for the hadith of Yazid bin Al-Had and Muhammad bin Ishaq, and they did not exclude it." Valid.
hi: Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar main Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ke paas jaun aur unse is ghari ke baare mein poochun, shayad unhein iska koi ilm ho. To main unke paas gaya aur kaha: "Aye Abu Sa'eed, Abu Hurairah (RA) ne humein Jum'e ke din ki (khaas) ghari ke baare mein bataya, kya aapko iska koi ilm hai?" Unhone kaha: humne Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe iska ilm tha, phir mujhe bhula diya gaya, jaise mujhe Lailatul-Qadr bhula di gayi thi." Phir main unke paas se nikla aur Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ke paas gaya, phir hadith zikr ki. Sahih.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: He who leaves the Friday prayer (continuously) for three Friday on account of slackness, Allah will print a stamp on his heart. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1052)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs susti ki wajah se teen Jum'e chhod de, Allah uske dil par mohar laga deta hai."

e: “Whoever abandons Friday deliberately, let him give a Dinar in charity, and if he cannot afford that, then (let him give) half a Dinar.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1128)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs bagair kisi uzr ke Jum'a chhod de, woh aik dinar ka sadqa kare, aur agar na mile to aadhe dinar ka."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever misses the Jumu'ah (Friday prayer) without an excuse, let him give charity of a dirham or half a dirham or a measurement of wheat or half a measurement of wheat." This is the wording of the hadith narrated by Al-'Anbari. And Shaykh Abu Bakr did not add anything to it in his transmission.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs bagair uzr ke Jum'a chhod de, woh aik dirham ya aadha dirham, ya aik sa' gehun ya aadha sa' ka sadqa kare." Yeh Al-Anbari ki hadith ke alfaz hain, aur shaikh Abu Bakr ne ismein irsaal (sanad mein kadi ki kami) ke ilawa kuch ziyaada nahi kiya.

e: [AI] We have a pigeon named Ayyub ibn Al-Ala'.
hi: Hammam hamare nazdeek Ayyub bin Al-Ala' se zyada hafiz (yaad rakhne wale) hain.

e: [AI] Two men from Iraq came to him and asked about performing the Friday bath, is it obligatory? Ibn Abbas said to them, "Whoever performs the bath, it is better and purer." Then he informed them that at the beginning of performing the bath, during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , people used to be in need, wearing wool, and water from palm trees would be poured on their backs. The mosque was narrow, reaching close to the ceiling. On a hot summer day, the Prophet ﷺ  came out on Friday and his pulpit was short, consisting of only three steps. He addressed the people, and the people sweated profusely in their wool garments. The smell of sweat and wool filled the air to the point where some people were harming each other. Finally, the smell reached the Prophet while he was on the pulpit, and he said, "O people, if it is this day, then perform the bath and let each one of you apply the best fragrance or perfume that he can find."
hi: Do Iraqi shakhs unke paas aaye aur poocha: "Jum'e ke din ghusl karna wajib hai kya?" Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unse kaha: "Jo ghusl kare woh behtar aur zyada paak hai, aur main tumhein bataata hoon ghusl kaise shuru hua: Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein log muhtaaj thay, oon (pashmina) pehante the, apni peethon par (paani laa kar) khajooron ko sinchte the, aur masjid tang thi, chhat qareeb thi. Aik garam garmiyon ke din Rasulullah (SAW) Jum'e ke din bahar tashreef laaye, aap (SAW) ka mimbar chhota tha, sirf teen zeenon ka, aap (SAW) ne logon ko khutba diya, log oon (ke kapdon) mein pasine se bheeg gaye, unke jismon se pasine aur oon ki badbu uthi yahan tak ke woh aik doosre ko takleef dene lage, yahan tak ke unki badbu Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi jabke aap (SAW) mimbar par thay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye logo, jab yeh din aaye to ghusl karo, aur tum mein se har koi apni khushbu ya tel mein se jo behtareen mile woh lagaaye.'"

e: [AI] I was the leader of my father when his eyesight deteriorated, so I went with him to the Friday prayer. When he heard the call to prayer, he prayed for Abu Umamah As'ad bin Zurarah and sought forgiveness for him. So I stayed for a long time without hearing the call to Friday prayer until he did that. So I said, "Oh father, do you see your seeking forgiveness for Abu Umamah every time you hear the call to Friday prayer?" He said, "O my son, he was the first one to gather with us in Madinah during the Battle of Khandaq from the tribe of Banu Bayadah, which is called Naqiyah Al-Khadamat." I said, "How many were you that day?" He said, "Forty men."
hi: Main apne waalid ka rehnuma tha jab unki aankhon ki roshni chali gayi thi, jab main unhein Jum'e ke liye le kar nikla, unhone azan suni, to Abu Umamah Asa'd bin Zurarah (RA) ke liye dua ki aur unke liye maghfirat maangi, main der tak intezar karta raha, unhein jab bhi Jum'e ki azan sunayi deti woh aisa hi karte. Maine kaha: "Aye abba, aap Abu Umamah ke liye jab bhi Jum'e ki azan sunte hain maghfirat mangte hain, iski kya wajah hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aye mere bete, woh Madinah mein sabse pehle shakhs the jinhone Harra Bani Bayadah mein Hazm-un-Nabt naami jagah, jise Naqi'ul-Khadmaat kaha jata hai, hamare sath jama'at qaim ki." Maine poocha: "Us din tum kitne log thay?" Unhone kaha: "Chalees (40) aadmi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said and mentioned on the day of Friday, "Whoever performs ghusl (ritual bath), cleans and beautifies himself, goes early to the mosque, listens attentively and remains silent, will have his sins forgiven from that Friday until the next, along with an additional three days. And whoever touches pebbles has certainly committed a wrongdoing." This was narrated by Yahya ibn al-Harith al-Thumari and Hassaan ibn Atiyyah, from Abu Al-Ash'ath. It is reported that Ibrahim ibn Abi Al-Layth narrated this hadith exclusively, but he is unreliable (wah) and the wording is rejected by others.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya, Jum'e ke din ka zikr karte hue: "Jo dhoye aur ghusl kare, subah subah jaldi jaye, imam ke qareeb ho, khamosh rahe aur sune, uske aur agle Jum'e ke darmiyan (gunah) maaf kar diye jate hain, aur teen din ziyada, aur jo kankariyon ko chhue usne fuzool (be-faida) kaam kiya." Yahya bin Al-Harith Ath-Thumari aur Hassan bin Atiyyah ne ise Abu Al-Ash'ath se riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] Ali used to make takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar) after the Fajr prayer on the day of Arafah, and he would not stop until he prayed behind the imam on the last days of Tashreeq, then he would make takbeer after Asr prayer.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) Arafah ki subah Fajr ki namaz ke baad takbeer kehte, phir tashreeq ke aakhri dinon mein imam ki namaz tak isse na todte, phir Asr ke baad bhi takbeer kehte.

e: [AI] He used to perform the takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) from the morning of the day of Arafah until the Asr prayer of the last days of Tashreeq.
hi: Woh "Arafah ki subah se tashreeq ke aakhri din ki Asr ki namaz tak takbeer kehte the."

e: [AI] Ibn Masood came to us and he used to say, "The Prophet ﷺ  would prolong the prayer of Fajr (dawn prayer) on the day of Arafah (the ninth day of the Islamic month of Dhul-Hijjah) until the prayer of Asr (afternoon prayer) on the last days of Tashreeq."
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) hamare paas aaye, to woh "Arafah ke din ki Fajr ki namaz se tashreeq ke aakhri din ki Asr ki namaz tak takbeer kehte the."

e: [AI] "It is recommended to perform Takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar) from the morning of Arafa Day until the end of the days of Tashreeq, just as Ali and Abdullah did." - Last part of the book of the two Eids.
hi: "Arafah ki subah se tashreeq ke aakhri dinon tak takbeer kahi jaye, jaise Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Abdullah (RA) ne kahi." (Kitab-ul-Eidain ka aakhri hissa.)

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to not go out on the day of Eid al-Fitr until he had eaten, and he would not eat on the day of Eid al-Adha until he returned."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Eid-ul-Fitr ke din bahar nahi nikalte the jab tak khaana na kha lete, aur Eid-ul-Adha ke din khaana nahi khaate the jab tak (namaz se) wapas na aa jate."

e: [AI] The translation of the given text into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to break his fast on the morning of Eid with dates before he sets out (for Eid prayer)."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Eid-ul-Fitr ke din khajooron se roza khola karte the, isse pehle ke woh (namaz ke liye) nikalte."

e: [AI] I heard Anas saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  never left on the day of Eid al-Fitr until he had eaten an odd number of dates, either three, five, seven, or less than that, or more than that in odd numbers." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Maine Anas (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) Eid-ul-Fitr ke din bahar nahi nikalte the jab tak teen, paanch ya saat khajooren, ya usse kam ya zyada, taaq (adad mein) na kha lete." Is par Dhahabi apni Talkhis mein khamosh rahe.

e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Medina, the people had two days on which they engaged in games. He asked: What are these two days (what is the significance)? They said: We used to engage ourselves on them in the pre-Islamic period. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah has substituted for them something better than them, the day of sacrifice and the day of the breaking of the fast. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1134)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah tashreef laaye jabke unke (logon ke) do din the jinme woh khel-kood karte the, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh do din kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh do din hain jinme hum jahiliyat mein khel-kood karte the." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne tumhein inke badle unse behtar do din diye hain: Eid-ul-Adha aur Eid-ul-Fitr."

e: Yazid ibn Khumayr ar-Rahbi said: Abdullah ibn Busr, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out along with the people on the day of the breaking of the fast or on the day of sacrifice (to offer the prayer). He disliked the delay of the imam, and said: We would finish (our 'Id prayer) at this moment, that is, at the time of forenoon. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1135)
hi: Abdullah bin Busr (RA), Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi, Eid-ul-Fitr ya Eid-ul-Adha ke din logon ke sath (namaz ke liye) nikle, to unhein imam ki der pasand na aayi, unhone kaha: "Hum Nabi (SAW) ke sath (namaz se) is waqt tak farigh ho jaya karte the, aur yeh tasbeeh (chasht) ka waqt hai."

e: [AI] I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ on the day of Eid. When he finished the prayer, he said, "We will give a sermon, so whoever wishes to stay for the sermon may sit, and whoever wishes to leave may leave." This is a "authentic hadith according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), and they have not excluded it." This is the meaning of the hadith that is asked about during the holidays, except that it is narrated by Ibn Abbas according to the conditions of the two sheikhs.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Eid mein hazir tha, jab aap (SAW) ne namaz mukammal ki to farmaya: "Hum khutba dete hain, to jo khutba ke liye baithna chahe woh baith jaye, aur jo jana chahe woh chala jaye." Yeh hadith Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur yeh us hadith ka hum-mafhoom hai jiske baare mein Eidain ke baab mein poocha jaata hai, siwaye iske ke woh Ibn Abbas se hai.

e: [AI] "He heard Abu Yahya 'Ubaidullah Al-Taimi talking about Abu Huraira that they were hit by rain on the day of Eid. "So the Prophet ﷺ performed the Eid prayer with them in the mosque." This Hadith is "authentic in its chain of narration and has not been rejected" by Abu Yahya Al-Taimi, who is trustworthy. The only criticized person is Yahya ibn 'Ubaidullah, his son, according to their standards."
hi: Abu Yahya Ubaidullah At-Taimi ne Abu Hurairah (RA) se bayan karte huay suna ke Eid ke din un par baarish ho gayi, to "Nabi (SAW) ne unhein masjid mein Eid ki namaz padhayi." Yeh hadith sahih ul-isnad hai aur dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Abu Yahya At-Taimi sadooq hain, jarh to unke bete Yahya bin Ubaidullah par hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: "He went out on the day of Eid, and he did not pray before it nor after it. He mentioned that the Prophet did so." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 538)
hi: Unhone Eid ke din namaz ki jagah ki taraf nikle, to na usse pehle namaz padhi na uske baad, aur zikr kiya ke "Nabi (SAW) ne bhi aisa hi kiya tha."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  prayed before the sermon on the day of Eid. This is the wording of the hadith narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdah, and in the narration of Sulaiman, it is mentioned as a shortening."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Eid ke din khutbe se pehle namaz padhi."

e: [AI] I witnessed Ibn al-Zubayr in Mecca while he was the emir, and it happened to be either the day of Fitr or Adha coinciding with a Friday. He delayed going out until the day had risen high, then he went out and ascended the pulpit, delivered a lengthy sermon, and then performed two rak'ahs (units of prayer) and did not perform the Friday prayer. Some people from Banu Umayya ibn Abd Shams reproached him for this. When Ibn Abbas heard about it, he said, "Ibn al-Zubayr has followed the Sunnah." When Ibn al-Zubayr heard about Ibn Abbas's comment, he said, "I saw Umar ibn al-Khattab do the same thing when both Eids coincided."
hi: Main Ibn Az-Zubair (RA) ke sath Makkah mein hazir tha jabke woh ameer thay, aur Eid-ul-Fitr ya Eid-ul-Adha Jum'e ke din se mil gaya, to "unhone nikalne mein der ki yahan tak ke din chadh gaya, phir nikle aur mimbar par chadhe, khutba diya aur usse lamba kiya, phir do rak'atein padhi aur Jum'a nahi padha." Banu Umayyah bin Abd Shams ke kuch logon ne is par unpar aitraaz kiya, yeh baat Ibn Abbas (RA) tak pahunchi to unhone kaha: "Ibn Az-Zubair (RA) ne Sunnat ko paaya hai." Yeh baat Ibn Az-Zubair (RA) tak pahunchi to unhone kaha: "Maine Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko dekha, jab do Eidein jama ho jatin to woh isi tarah kiya karte the."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out by one road on the day of the 'Id (festival) and returned by another. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1156)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Eid ke din aik raste se jate aur doosre raste se wapas aate."

e: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that when the Prophet ﷺ went out to ‘Eid (prayers), he would return via another route than the first one he took. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1301)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) jab Eidein ke liye nikalte to jis raste se nikalte the usse alag raste se wapas aate."

e: I used to go to the place of prayer on the day of the breaking of the fast, and on the day of sacrifice along with the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. We would walk through a valley known as Batn Bathan till we came to the place of prayer. Then we would pray along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and return through Batn Bathan to our house. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1158)
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) ke sath Eid-ul-Fitr ke din namaz ki jagah ki taraf subah subah jata, hum Batn Buthan (naami wadi) se guzarte yahan tak ke namaz ki jagah pahunch jate, phir Nabi (SAW) ke sath namaz padhte, phir apne gharon ko wapas aa jate."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to go out on the day of Eid al-Fitr and offer two units of prayer, then he would give the salaam (greeting) and stand up facing the people while they were sitting. He would say, "Give charity, give charity." The majority of those who would give charity were women with their earrings and rings.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Eid-ul-Fitr ke din nikalte, woh do rak'atein padhte, phir salaam phertay, phir khade hokar logon ki taraf mutawajjeh hote jabke woh baithe hote, aap (SAW) farmate: "Sadqa do, sadqa do," to sadqa dene walon mein sabse zyada auratein hoti thin, jo apni baaliyan aur anguthiyan de deti thin.

e: [AI] The translation of the sentence is as follows: "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, used to pray two units of prayer when he returned from the mosque. This is a recommended practice with a valid and authentic chain of narration, and it has not been disputed as authentic."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab namaz ki jagah se wapas aate to do rak'atein padhte." Yeh aik ahamm (qeemti) Sunnat hai jiski sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "The people began fasting for the completion of thirty days, and then two men came and testified that they saw the new moon yesterday. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded the people to break their fast."
hi: Log tees (30) din poore roze rakhkar subah utthe, phir do aadmi aaye aur gawahi di ke unhone kal chand dekha tha, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne logon ko hukum diya ke woh roza khol den."

e: “A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘I have seen the new crescent tonight.’ He said: ‘Do you bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ He said: ‘Get up, O Bilal, and announce to the people that they should fast tomorrow.’” Abu 'Ali said: "This is how it was narrated from Walid bin Abu Thawr and Hasan bin 'Ali. It was also narrated from Hammad bin Salamah, but he did not mention Ibn 'Abbas. He said: 'And he announced that they should perform the prayer and that they should fast.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1652)
hi: Aik dehati Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Maine aaj raat chand dekha hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad uske bande aur Rasool hain?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khade ho jao, aye Bilal (RA), logon mein aelaan karo ke woh roza rakhein."

e: [AI] "He informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to make takbeer (say Allahu Akbar) on the day of Eid from the time he left his house until he reached the place of prayer."
hi: Unhone bataya ke "Rasulullah (SAW) Eid-ul-Fitr ke din apne ghar se nikalte hi takbeer kehna shuru kar dete yahan tak ke namaz ki jagah pahunch jate."

e: [AI] He used to go out of the mosque on both Eids and would continue to recite the takbeer until he reached the prayer place.
hi: Woh "dono Eidon mein masjid se nikalte aur takbeer kehte rehte yahan tak ke namaz ki jagah pahunch jate."

e: [AI] "They were louder in Takbeer during Eid al-Fitr than in Eid al-Adha."
hi: "Woh Eid-ul-Fitr ki takbeer mein Eid-ul-Adha se zyada shiddat rakhte the."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ used to make Takbeer in the two Eids twelve times, except for the Takbeer of the opening, and he used to recite Surah Qaf and Surah Al-Qur'an Al-Majeed, and the hour was near.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) dono Eidon mein baarah (12) takbeerein kehte, iftitaah (shuru) ki takbeer ke ilawa, aur 'Qaf wal-Qur'anil-Majeed' aur 'Iqtarabatis-Sa'ah' padhte."

e: [AI] She said, "The Prophet ﷺ  used to recite the takbeer (Allahu Akbar) seven times on the first day of Eid and five times on the second day before the prayer."
hi: Unhone (Aisha RA ne) kaha: "Nabi (SAW) dono Eidon mein pehli (rak'at) mein saat (7) takbeerein aur doosri (rak'at) mein paanch (5) takbeerein, qira'at se pehle, kehte the."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu Bakr, 'Umar, may Allah (SWT) be pleased with them, used to offer the 'Eid prayer before the Khutbah. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1564)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW), Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) dono Eidon ki namaz khutbe se pehle padhte the."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ used to recite out loud the phrase "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful" in his written communications. He used to observe great devotion in performing the Fajr prayer. On the day of Arafah, he would magnify the morning prayer and complete it with the afternoon prayer in the last days of Tashriq."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) farz namazon mein 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem' buland awaz se padhte the, aur Fajr ki namaz mein qunut karte the, aur Arafah ke din Fajr ki namaz se takbeer kehna shuru karte aur tashreeq ke aakhri dinon ki Asr ki namaz par khatam karte."

e: [AI] Umar ibn al-Khattab used to say the takbeer (proclaiming the greatness of Allah) from the time of Fajr prayer on the day of Arafah until the Dhuhr prayer on the last days of Tashreeq.
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) "Arafah ke din Fajr ki namaz ke baad se tashreeq ke aakhri din ki Zuhr ki namaz tak takbeer kehte the."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Odd numbers for prayers of Witr are either five, three, or one."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Witr paanch, ya teen, ya aik (rakat) hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: *“Witr is a confirmed duty; whoever wishes may perform it with three (units), and whoever wishes may perform it with five, and whoever would like to perform witr with one (unit), let him perform it with one.”*
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Witr haq hai, jo chahe teen se witr kare, jo chahe paanch se witr kare, aur jo aik se witr karna pasand kare woh aik se witr kare."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Perform Witr prayer in odd numbers, and if you are unable, then perform it in three, and if you are still unable, then perform it in one."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Witr paanch se karo, agar (yeh) na kar sako to teen se, agar (yeh bhi) na kar sako to aik se, agar (yeh bhi) na kar sako to" - ishare se (padho).

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Witr (odd number of units for prayer) is a right (obligation)." So he mentioned it in this way and they left it.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Witr haq hai," phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki. (Ijli ne is (raawi) ko chhod diya.)

e: [AI] "Al-Witr is a right" so Abu Ayyub mentioned it repeatedly.
hi: "Witr haq hai," phir isi ka zikr kiya, Abu Ayyub (RA) tak mauqoof (mahdood) rakhte hue.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Witr (the nightly odd numbered prayer) is a right (that it should be performed)." Then the narrated something similar.[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Witr haq hai," phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki.

e: Perhaps I saw the Prophet ﷺ  praying witr (odd numbered night prayer) while the people were standing for Fajr prayer.
hi: Shayad "maine Nabi (SAW) ko Witr padhte dekha ho jabke log Fajr ki namaz ke liye khade ho chuke thay."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When one of you wakes up in the morning and has not performed the Witr prayer, let them perform it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ki subah ho jaye aur usne Witr na padhi ho, to woh (ab) padh le."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not perform Witr (the odd numbered nightly prayer) to three rakahs making is seem like the Maghrib prayer. Rather extend it to five, or seven, nine, or eleven rakahs, or even more than that."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (rakat) se Witr na karo ke Maghrib ki namaz jaisa lage, balke paanch, saat, nau, gyarah rakat ya usse zyada se Witr karo."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not perform Witr (the odd numbered nightly prayer) to three rakahs making is seem like the Maghrib prayer. Rather extend it to five, or seven."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen se Witr na karo aur Maghrib ki namaz jaisi shabahat na banao, paanch ya saat se Witr karo."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not offer the taslim (salam) after the first two rakahs of the Witr prayer.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Witr ki pehli do rak'aton mein salaam nahi phertay the."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to perform the Witr prayer with three rakahs, and he would do the taslim only in the last rakah. And this is the Witr prayer of Amir al-Muminin, Umar b. al-Khattab"[^1]
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) teen (rakat) se Witr karte, salaam sirf aakhir mein phertay." Aur yehi Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ka Witr tha.

e: It was said to Al-Hasan that Ibn Umar used to do the taslim after the two rakahs of Witr. He replied, "Umar ᴿᴬ was more knowledgeable than him; he would rise up for the third rakah with the takbir."
hi: Al-Hasan se kaha gaya: "Ibn Umar (RA) Witr ki do rak'aton mein salaam phertay the." Unhone kaha: "Umar (RA) unse zyada faqeeh thay, woh teesri (rak'at) ke liye takbeer ke sath uthte the."

e: He used to perform the Witr prayer with three rakahs without the tashahhud (sitting) in between them, and he would not do the tashahhud except in the last rakah."
hi: Woh "teen se Witr karte, unme (darmiyan mein) baithte nahi the aur na hi tashahhud karte the, siwaye aakhir mein."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to recite in the two Rak'ahs of Witr after them "Subhanallahi Walhamdulillahi Wa La Ilaha Illallah Wallahu Akbar" (Glorified is Allah, and praised is Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest), and recite in Witr "Qul Huwallahu Ahad" (Say, He is Allah, the One), and say "A'udhu bi Rabbil Falaq" (I seek refuge with the Lord of Daybreak), and say "A'udhu bi Rabbin Nas" (I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind). Sa'id bin Abi Maryam narrated it from Yahya bin Ayyub.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) un do rak'aton mein, jinke baad woh Witr karte, 'Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la' aur 'Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun' padhte, aur Witr mein 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad,' 'Qul A'oozu bi Rabbil-Falaq' aur 'Qul A'oozu bi Rabbin-Naas' padhte." Sa'eed bin Abi Maryam ne Yahya bin Ayyub se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] The translation is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to perform the Witr prayer with three units. In the first unit, he would recite "Subhanak Allahumma wa bihamdika, tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghairuka" (Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name and exalted is Your majesty. There is no deity worthy of worship except You). In the second unit, he would recite "Qul ya ayyuhal kafirun" (Say, O disbelievers). And in the third unit, he would recite "Qul huwa Allahu ahad" (Say, He is Allah, the One). Then he would seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak (Al-Falaq) and seek refuge in the Lord of mankind (An-Nas)."[^1]
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) teen se Witr karte, pehli rak'at mein 'Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la' padhte, doosri mein 'Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun,' aur teesri mein 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad,' 'Qul A'oozu bi Rabbil-Falaq' aur 'Qul A'oozu bi Rabbin-Naas' padhte."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to perform Tahiyyatul-Wudu (a prayer after performing ablution) consisting of five units (rak'ahs). He would not sit down except in the fifth unit, and he would only give the salaam (conclude the prayer) in the fifth unit.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW)" paanch rak'aton se Witr karte, sirf paanchvi mein baithte, aur sirf paanchvi mein salaam phertay.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Witr (odd-numbered prayers) is a right, so whoever does not perform Witr is not among us."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Witr haq hai, jo Witr na kare woh humme se nahi."

e:
[AI] The passage translates to:

"He mentioned it similarly, 'This is an authentic hadith.' Abu Al-Munib Al-Ataki from Marw is trustworthy, and his hadith is compiled."
hi: Phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki. Yeh sahih hadith hai, aur Abu Al-Munib Al-Ataki Marwazi thiqa hain, unki hadith jama ki jaati hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us and said: Allah the Exalted has given you an extra prayer which is better for you then the red camels (i.e. high breed camels). This is the witr which Allah has appointed for you between the night prayer and the daybreak. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1418)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas tashreef laaye aur farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne tumhein aik aisi namaz se nawaza hai jo tumhare liye surkh unton se bhi behtar hai, aur woh Witr hai, isliye Allah ne ise tumhare liye Isha ki namaz aur Fajr ki namaz ke darmiyan muqarrar kiya hai."

e: "The Prophet would perform Witr with thirteen [Rak'ah]. When he was older and became weak he performed Witr with seven." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 457)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) terah (13) se Witr karte the, jab aap (SAW) buddhe ho gaye aur kamzor ho gaye to saat (7) se Witr karte."

e: It was narrated from ʿAli ؓ that The Prophet ﷺ used to say at the end of his Witr ʿO Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your wrath, I seek refuge in Your forgiveness from Your punishment, I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot praise You enough, You are as You have praised Yourself.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 751)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apne Witr ke aakhir mein farmate: "Aye Allah, main teri raza ki panah maangta hoon tere ghazab se, aur teri maafi ki panah maangta hoon teri saza se, aur teri hi panah maangta hoon tujh se, main teri tareef bayan nahi kar sakta jaisi tu khud apni tareef karta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The two units of prayer at Fajr (dawn) are better than the whole world." And in the hadith of Yazid ibn Zurai, he said, "They are better than the world and everything in it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fajr ki do rakatein poori duniya se behtar hain." Yazid bin Zurai' ki hadith mein hai: "Duniya aur jo kuch usme hai usse behtar hain."

e:
[AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  used to recite the following in the two rak'ahs of the Fajr prayer:

"In the first rakah, recite from the verse, 'Say, "We have believed in Allah and what has been revealed to us and what has been revealed to Abraham and Ishmael"' until the end of the verse [Al-Baqarah 136]. And in the second rakah, recite from the verse, 'Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you"' until the words 'And bear witness that we are Muslims' [Al-Imran 64]."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Fajr ki do rakaton mein aksar "{Kaho: Hum Allah par Eman laaye aur us par jo humpar utara gaya aur jo Ibrahim (AS) par utara gaya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 136) ayat ke aakhir tak padhte, aur doosri rak'at mein "{Kaho: Aye Ahl-e-Kitab, aao us baat ki taraf jo humare aur tumhare darmiyan barabar hai}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 64) se lekar "{aur gawah raho ke hum Musalman hain}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 52) tak padhte.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever forgets the two Rak'ahs of Fajr prayer should pray them when the sun rises."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Fajr ki do rakatein bhool jaye, woh unhein suraj nikalne ke baad padh le."

e: [AI] "The prayer was established, so I stood up to perform the two units of prayer. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ attracted my attention and said, "Do you pray Fajr as four units?"
hi: Namaz ki iqamat hui, main do rakatein padhne ke liye khada hua, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe kheench liya aur farmaya: "Kya tum Fajr chaar rakat padh rahe ho?"

e: [AI] On the authority of Abu Hurairah, he said: It was narrated to the Prophet ﷺ that he was asked, "Which prayer is best after the obligatory prayers?" And, "Which fasting is best after the month of Ramadan?" He replied, "The best prayer after the obligatory prayers is the prayer in the middle of the night. And the best fasting after the month of Ramadan is the fasting in the month of Allah, Muharram."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, unhone ise Nabi (SAW) tak marfoo' kiya, ke aap (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Farz namaz ke baad kaunsi namaz sabse afzal hai? Aur Ramzan ke mahine ke baad kaunsa roza sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Farz namaz ke baad sabse afzal namaz raat ke beech mein padhi jane wali namaz hai, aur Ramzan ke baad sabse afzal roza Allah ke mahine, Muharram, ke rozay hain."

e: “Ishaq bin Mansur narrated to us, from Isra’il” with this (Another chain) Bilal narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Hold fast to Qiyam al-Lail, for it is the practice of the righteous before you, and indeed Qiyam al-Lail is a means of nearness to Allah, a means of prevention from sin, an expiation for bad deeds, and a barrier for the body against disease.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3549)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raat ki namaz (qiyaam) ko lazim pakdo, kyunke yeh tumse pehle nek logon ka tareeqa tha, aur yeh tumhare Rab ka qurb haasil karne ka zariya hai, gunahon ka kaffara hai, aur gunah se rokne wali cheez hai."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  found something one night. When morning came, it was said, "O Messenger of Allah, the signs of pain are evident on you." He said, "Indeed, I am only facing what you see with the praise of Allah. I have recited the seven long surahs."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ko aik raat kuch mehsoos hua, jab subah hui to poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap par takleef ke asaraat zaahir ho rahe hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main to bas jo tum dekh rahe ho usi wajah se hoon, Allah ka shukr hai, maine (raat ko) saat lambi surahein padhi hain."

e: Do not give up prayer at night, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not leave it. Whenever he fell ill or lethargic, he would offer it sitting. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1307)
hi: Aisha (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Raat ki namaz (qiyaam) na chhodo, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ise nahi chhodte the, aur jab bimar hote ya thake huay hote to baithkar padh lete the."

e: [AI] Shu'bah praised and mentioned a narration that had a similar chain of transmission and content altogether.
hi: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, phir isi jaisi baat zikr ki, sanad aur matan dono aik jaisay.

e: [AI] Abu Al-Muwajjah praised Abdan who praised Abu Hamzah who narrated from Al-A'mash who narrated from Abu Salih who narrated from Abu Hurairah, who said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever preserves these prescribed prayers will not be recorded among the heedless, and whoever recites one hundred verses in a night will be recorded among the devout."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs in farz namazon ki hifazat kare, woh ghafil logon mein shumaar nahi hoga, aur jo raat mein sau (100) ayaat padhe, woh (Allah ke aage) khusu' karne walon mein likha jayega."

e: [AI] On the authority of his father Abu Abdullah Salman Al-Agharr, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever performs the night prayer and recites one hundred verses, they will not be counted among the heedless, and whoever performs the night prayer and recites two hundred verses, they will be counted among the devout and sincere."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs raat mein sau (100) ayaat padh kar namaz padhe, woh ghafil logon mein shumaar nahi hoga, aur jo raat mein do sau (200) ayaat padh kar namaz padhe, woh (Allah ke aage) khaalis khusu' karne walon mein likha jayega."

e: [AI] I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was descending from 'Ukaz. So I said, "O Messenger of Allah, is there any invocation closer (to Allah) than another, or a time that should be observed, or something that should be mentioned?" He said, "Yes, indeed. The closest that a servant can be to his Lord is during the last third of the night. If you can be among those who remember Allah during that time, then do so."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein hazir hua jabke aap (SAW) Ukaz mein qayaam pazeer thay, maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya koi dua doosri se zyada qareeb (qubool hone wali) hai, ya koi (aisi) ghari baaqi hai, ya iska zikr karna munasib hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, Rab bande ke sabse zyada qareeb raat ke aakhri hisse mein hota hai, isliye agar tum us waqt Allah ka zikr karne walon mein se ho sako to raho."

e: [AI] Indeed, Allah guided His Prophet to a proof, so he said to them, "Guide me to what my Prophet ﷺ  guided to." So, they said, "Indeed, Allah guided him to the Night Prayer."
hi: Beshak Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko aik daleel (rehnumai) di, to unhone (azwaaj se) kaha: "Mujhe us baat ki rehnumai karo jiski Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko rehnumai di." To unhone kaha: "Beshak Allah ne unhein raat ki namaz (qiyaam) ki rehnumai di."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: May Allah have mercy on a man who gets up at night and prays, and awakens his wife; if she refuses, he should sprinkle water on her face. May Allah have mercy on a woman who gets up at night and prays, and awakens her husband; if he refuses, she would sprinkle water on his face. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1308)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah us mard par reham kare jo raat ko uthe, namaz padhe aur apni biwi ko jagaaye, agar woh inkaar kare to uske chehre par paani ke chhinte maare. Allah us aurat par reham kare jo raat ko uthe, namaz padhe aur apne shohar ko jagaaye, agar woh inkaar kare to uske chehre par paani ke chhinte maare."

e: Ya'la ibn Mumallak said that he asked Umm Salamah about the recitation and prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She said: What have you to do with his prayer? He would pray, then sleep as long as he had prayed, till morning. She then described his recitation and did so with an exposition word by word. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1466)
hi: Unhone Umm Salamah (RA) se Rasulullah (SAW) ki raat ki qira'at ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Tumhein aap (SAW) ki namaz se kya (matlab)?" "Aap (SAW) namaz padhte, phir utni hi der sote jitni namaz padhi hoti, phir utni hi der namaz padhte jitni der soye hote, phir utni hi der sote jitni namaz padhi hoti, yahan tak ke subah ho jaati." Unhone aap (SAW) ki qira'at ka bhi zikr kiya, to unhone use bayan kiya: "harf-ba-harf saaf saaf padhne wali qira'at."

e: [AI] "He used to raise his voice in recitation during the night and lower it [during the day], and he would mention that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to do the same."
hi: Woh "raat ko uthkar kabhi apni awaz buland karte aur kabhi past karte," aur zikr karte ke "Rasulullah (SAW) bhi aisa hi kiya karte the."

e: [AI] "He asked Aisha, 'How was the Prophet's reading from the Qur'an at night? Did he recite audibly or in a subdued voice?' She said, 'He would do both, sometimes reciting audibly and sometimes in a subdued voice.' He (the questioner) said, 'Praise be to Allah who has made ease in this matter.'"
hi: Unhone Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki raat ki qira'at kaisi hoti thi, buland awaz se ya aahista?" Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) dono karte the, kabhi buland awaz se aur kabhi aahista." Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Allah ki hamd hai jisne is maamle mein waseeh gunjaish rakhi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  passed by Abu Bakr while he was praying and he lowered his voice. He also passed by Umar while he was praying and he raised his voice. When they both gathered in front of the Prophet ﷺ , he said to Abu Bakr, "O Abu Bakr, I passed by you while you were praying and you were lowering your voice?" Abu Bakr replied, "I heard the one I was conversing with." The Prophet ﷺ  then said, "O Umar, I passed by you while you were praying and you were raising your voice?" Umar replied, "O Messenger of Allah, I use my voice to keep myself alert." The Prophet ﷺ  said to Abu Bakr, "Raise your voice a little." And he said to Umar, "Lower your voice."
hi: Nabi (SAW) Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas se guzre jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, apni awaz past rakhe huay, aur Umar (RA) ke paas se guzre jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, apni awaz buland rakhe huay. Unhone kaha: jab dono Nabi (SAW) ke paas jama huay to aap (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Abu Bakr, mera tumhare paas se guzr hua jabke tum namaz padh rahe the, apni awaz past rakhe huay?" Unhone kaha: "Maine use sunaya jisse main munajat kar raha tha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Umar, mera tumhare paas se guzr hua jabke tum apni awaz buland kar rahe the?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main isse (khud ko) neend se jaganay ka zariya samajhta hoon." Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) se farmaya: "Apni awaz thodi buland karo," aur Umar (RA) se farmaya: "Apni awaz kuch past karo."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ retired to the mosque. He heard them (the people) reciting the Qur'an in a loud voice. He removed the curtain and said: Lo! every one of you is calling his Lord quietly. One should not trouble the other and one should not raise the voice in recitation or in prayer over the voice of the other. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1332)
hi: Nabi (SAW) masjid mein a'tikaaf mein baithe, unhone unhein buland awaz se qira'at karte suna jabke woh apne khaimay mein thay, to aap (SAW) ne parde hataye aur farmaya: "Khabardar, tum sab apne Rab se munajat kar rahe ho, isliye aik doosre ko takleef na do, aur na hi namaz mein qira'at ke waqt aik doosre par (awaz) buland karo."

e: [AI] The Prophet  ﷺ  said, "Whoever goes to bed intending to stand (in prayer) during the night, but his eyes overpower him (i.e., he falls asleep) until morning, then his intention will be recorded for him, and his sleep will be a charity from his Lord."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apne bistar par is niyat se aaye ke woh raat ko (namaz ke liye) uthega, phir uski aankh usse ghalib aa jaye yahan tak ke subah ho jaye, to uski niyat uske liye likh di jaati hai, aur uski neend uske Rab ki taraf se uske liye sadqa ban jati hai."

e: [AI] Zaidah was praised, so he mentioned it with its chain of narration from the statement of Abu Darda', and this is one of the proofs that do not weaken. Indeed, Al-Husayn bin Ali Al-Ju'fi is the most ancient, protective, and knowledgeable in the hadith of Zaidah than others, and Allah knows best.
hi: Humein Za'idah ne bataya, phir unhone ise Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ke apne qaul se sanad ke sath zikr kiya. Yeh un cheezon mein se nahi jo kamzor karti hain, kyunke Al-Husain bin Ali Al-Ju'fi Za'idah ki hadith mein doosron se zyada purana, zyada hafiz aur zyada waqif hain, wallahu a'lam.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do not single out Friday with fasting among the days, and do not single out the night of Friday with prayer among the nights."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jum'e ke din ko doosre dinon se alag karke roza na rakho, aur Jum'e ki raat ko doosri raaton se alag karke qiyaam (namaz) na karo."

e: [AI] About the sister of Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, that he said: "Whoever prays twelve units of prayer in a day, Allah will build for him a house in Paradise: four units before Dhuhr prayer, two units after it, two units before Asr prayer, two units after Maghrib prayer, and two units before Fajr prayer." This narration has been authenticated by two reliable narrators according to the conditions of Imam Muslim, and they did not exclude it. All of its supporting evidences are authentic, including the narrations of Nu'man ibn Salim, Mak'hool, and Al-Musayyab ibn Rafe'.
hi: Apni behen Umm Habibah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki zaujah, se, Rasulullah (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs din mein baarah (12) rakat namaz padhe, Allah uske liye Jannat mein aik ghar bana deta hai: chaar Zuhr se pehle, do uske baad, do rakat Asr se pehle, do rakat Maghrib ke baad, aur do rakat Subah se pehle."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever prays twelve voluntary prostrations, Allah will build a house for him in paradise."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs nafl ke tor par baarah (12) sajde (rak'atein) padhe, Allah uske liye Jannat mein aik ghar bana deta hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: "Whoever prays four rak'ahs before Zuhr and four after, Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, will forbid him from the Fire." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1814)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs Zuhr se pehle chaar rakat aur uske baad chaar rakat ki hifazat kare, Allah use aag par haram kar deta hai."

e: [AI] Buraydah, one day I went out to walk in need, and suddenly I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  walking. I thought he had some need, so I avoided him and kept doing that until he saw me and gestured towards me. So I approached him and he took my hand, and we started walking together. Suddenly, we came across a man in front of us who was praying and he was increasing his bowing and prostration. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked me, "Do you think this person is showing off?" I replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He then extended his hand and placed it between the man's hands three times, raising his hands and straightening them, and saying, "May guidance and sincerity be upon you, may guidance and sincerity be upon you, for indeed the one who seeks fame in this religion will be defeated."
hi: Buraidah (RA) [ne kaha]: main aik din kisi zaroorat mein chal raha tha, achanak maine dekha Rasulullah (SAW) chal rahe hain, mujhe laga aap (SAW) ko kisi zaroorat ke liye jana hai, to main aap (SAW) se hatne laga, main yehi karta raha yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ne mujhe dekh liya aur ishara kiya, main aap (SAW) ke paas aaya, aap (SAW) ne mera haath pakda aur hum sath chalne lage. Achanak humare saamne aik shakhs namaz padh raha tha, bohot zyada ruku aur sajda kar raha tha. Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein lagta hai yeh dikhawa kar raha hai?" Maine kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool (SAW) behtar jaante hain." Unhone kaha: aap (SAW) ne mera haath chhoda aur apne dono haathon ko teen martaba mila kar uthaya aur neeche laaye, aur farmaya: "Tum par mo'tadil raah lazim hai, tum par mo'tadil raah lazim hai, kyunke jo shakhs is deen mein sakhti karega, deen usse ghalib aa jayega."

e: [AI] He ﷺ  prayed with the Prophet ﷺ  the Maghrib prayer, then he continued praying until he prayed the Isha prayer.
hi: Woh "Nabi (SAW) ke sath Maghrib padhte, phir namaz padhte rehte yahan tak ke Isha padh lete."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Honor your homes with some of your prayers."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne kuch namazon se apne gharon ko izzat do."

e: [AI] "One day, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke up and called Bilal. He said, 'O Bilal, what deeds have you done that have caused you to surpass me in entering Paradise? Yesterday, I entered Paradise and heard the sound of your footsteps ahead of me.' Bilal replied, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have never called the Adhan (call to prayer) without praying two Rak'ahs (units of prayer), and I have never experienced any impurity without performing ablution.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Because of this.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) subah utthe, Bilal (RA) ko bulaya aur farmaya: "Aye Bilal, tum kis amal ki wajah se mujh se pehle Jannat mein pahunch gaye? Maine kal raat Jannat mein dakhil hokar dekha to mere aage tumhare qadmon ki aahat suni." Bilal (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine kabhi azan nahi di magar do rakat namaz zaroor padhi, aur mujhe kabhi wudu tootne ka koi asar nahi hua magar maine foran wudu kiya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isi ki wajah se."

e: “Pray to Allah to heal me.” He said: “If you wish to store your reward for the Hereafter, that is better, or if you wish, I will supplicate for you.” He said: “Supplicate.” So he told him to perform ablution and do it well, and to pray two Rak’ah, and to say this supplication: “Allahumma inni as’aluka wa atawajjahu ilaika bimuhammadin nabiyyir-rahmah. Ya Muhammadu inni qad tawajjahtu bika ila rabbi fi hajati hadhihi lituqda. Allahumma fashaffi’hu fiya (O Allah, I ask of You and I turn my face towards You by virtue of the intercession of Muhammad the Prophet of mercy. O Muhammad, I have turned to my Lord by virtue of your intercession concerning this need of mine so that it may be met. O Allah, accept his intercession concerning me)”. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1385)
hi: Aik nabeena (andha) shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe aafiyat de." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum chaho to (aakhirat ke liye) isse mo'akhkhar kar do, yeh behtar hai, aur agar chaho to main dua kar deta hoon." Usne kaha: "To dua kijiye." Unhone kaha: aap (SAW) ne usse hukum diya ke woh wudu kare aur achha wudu kare, do rakat namaz padhe, aur yeh dua kare: "Allahumma inni as'aluka wa atawajjahu ilaika bi Nabiyyika Muhammadin, Nabiyyir-Rahmah, ya Muhammad, inni tawajjahtu bika ila Rabbi fi haajati hazihi fa tuqda li, Allahumma shaffi'hu fiyya wa shaffi'ni fihi" (Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon aur tere Nabi Muhammad, rahmat wale Nabi, ke waseele se tujhe mutawajjeh hota hoon, aye Muhammad, main aapke waseele se apne Rab ki taraf mutawajjeh hua hoon apni is zaroorat mein, taake woh poori ho jaye, aye Allah, unki shafa'at mujhpar qubool kar aur meri (dua) unke haq mein qubool kar).

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: Keep the sermon secret, then perform ablution and perfect your ablution, then perform the prayer that Allah prescribed for you, then praise and glorify your Lord, then say: O Allah, You are able and I am not able, You know and I do not know, and You are the Knower of the unseen. So if You know that this matter (mention the matter) is good for me in my religion, my life, and the Hereafter, then decree it for me and make it easy for me, then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is not good for me in my religion, my life, and the Hereafter, then divert it from me and divert me from it. And decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me satisfied with it." This is the Sunnah of the Istikhara prayer, a precious tradition that the people of Egypt have exclusively practiced, and their narrators until the end are trustworthy and have not been disputed."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni khwahish (khitbah/iraade) ko chhupa kar rakho, phir wudu karo aur achha wudu karo, phir jitni namaz Allah ne tumhare liye muqarrar ki ho padho, phir apne Rab ki hamd aur bara'i bayan karo, phir kaho: 'Aye Allah, tu qudrat rakhta hai aur main nahi rakhta, tu jaanta hai aur main nahi jaanta, aur tu ghaib ki baaton ka jaanne wala hai, agar tu dekhe ke fulani (uska naam le) meri deen, duniya aur aakhirat ke liye mere haq mein behtar hai, to use mere muqaddar mein likh de, aur agar koi doosri (aurat) mere liye usse behtar ho, meri deen, duniya aur aakhirat mein, to woh mujhe ata kar de' - ya farmaya: 'to usse mere muqaddar mein likh de.'" Yeh Istikharah ki namaz ki aik qeemti Sunnat hai jise sirf Misr walon ne akela naql kiya hai, aur unke aakhri raawi tak sab thiqa hain, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No one preserves the Duha prayer except a repentant person." He also said, "It is the prayer of the repentant."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chasht ki namaz ki hifazat sirf bohot tauba karne wala hi karta hai," aur farmaya: "yeh tauba karne walon ki namaz hai."

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during a journey and he performed eight units of the Dhuha prayer. When he finished, he said, 'I prayed a voluntary prayer out of desire and awe, so I asked my Lord three things. He granted me two and denied me one. I asked Him not to cause my ummah to perish due to famine, and He accepted. I asked Him not to expose them to external enemies, and He accepted. And I asked Him not to cause division and discord among them, but He denied me that.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko aik safar mein Chasht ki namaz aath (8) rakat padhte dekha, jab aap (SAW) farigh huay to farmaya: "Maine yeh namaz raghbat (khwahish) aur khauf ke sath padhi hai, maine apne Rab se teen cheezein maangi, usne mujhe do di aur aik se mana kiya: maine usse maanga ke woh meri Ummat ko qehatsaali (kaal) se halaak na kare, to usne aisa kiya; maine usse maanga ke woh unpar kisi dushman ko ghalib na kare, to usne aisa kiya; aur maine usse maanga ke woh unhein alag alag firqon mein na baante, to usne mujhe mana kar diya."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not die until his most frequent prayer was performed sitting."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) is haal mein wafat paaye ke aap (SAW) ki aksar namaz baithkar padhi jaane wali thi."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray standing and sitting. If he started to pray standing, he would bow standing and if he started to pray sitting, he would bow sitting." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1647)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) khade hokar bhi namaz padhte the aur baithkar bhi, jab woh namaz khade hokar shuru karte to ruku bhi khade hokar karte, aur jab baithkar shuru karte to ruku bhi baithkar karte."

e: I had a fistula; so I asked the prophet ﷺ. He said: offer prayer in standing condition; if you are unable to do so, then in sitting condition: if you are then at your side(i.e, in lying condition). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 952)
hi: Mujhe naasoor (bawaseer jaisi bimari) thi, maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khade hokar namaz padho, agar taaqat na ho to baithkar, agar (yeh bhi) taaqat na ho to karwat (pehlu) ke bal."

e: [AI] He said, "I traveled with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  eighteen times and I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  leave the two Rak'ahs (units of prayer) when the sun began to decline [(at midday)]."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath atharah (18) safar kiye, maine kabhi Rasulullah (SAW) ko woh do rakatein chhodte nahi dekha jab suraj dhalta."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase is: "The Prophet ﷺ  would not leave a house without offering two Rak'ahs (units of prayer)."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) kisi jagah nahi utarte magar do rakat namaz se usse rukhsat lete."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When a man himself wakes at night and wakens his wife and they pray two rak'ahs together, they are recorded among the men and women who make much mention of Allah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1451)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs raat ko jaage aur apne ghar walon ko jagaaye, phir dono mil kar do rakat namaz padhein, to unhein Allah ka bohot zikr karne walon aur karne wali auraton mein likh diya jata hai."

e: Ibn ʿAbbas said: “We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when ʿAli bin Abi Talib came to him, and he said: ‘May my father and mother be ransomed for you! This Qur’an has suddenly left my heart, and I do not find myself capable of it.’ So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: ‘O Abul-Hasan! Should I not teach you words that Allah shall benefit you with, and benefit whomever you teach, and they will make whatever you have learned in your chest firm?’ He said: ‘Of course, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so teach me.’ He ﷺ said: ‘When it is the night of (before) Friday, then if you are able to stand in the last third of the night, then verily it is a witnessed hour, and supplication is answered in it. And my brother Yaʿqub (as) did say to his sons: I shall seek forgiveness for you from my Lord. He said: “Until the night of Friday comes.” So if you are not able, then stand in the middle of it, and if you are not able then stand in the first of it. And pray four Rakʿah. Recite Fatihatul-Kitab (the Opening of the Book) and Surat Ya-Sin in the first Rakʿah, and Fatihatul-Kitab and Ha-Mim Ad-Dukhan in the second Rakʿah, and Fatihatul-Kitab and Alif Lam Mim Tanzil As-Sajdah in the third Rakʿah, and Fatihatul-Kitab and Tabarak Al-Mufassal in the fourth Rakʿah. So when you have finished with the Tasha-hud, then praise Allah and mention Allah’s greatness in an excellent manner, and send Salat upon me - and be excellent in it - and upon the rest of the Prophets. And seek forgiveness for the believing men and the believing women, and for your brothers who have preceded you in faith. Then say in the end of that: “O Allah, have mercy on me by abandonment of sins forever, so long as You keep me remaining. And have mercy on me from taking upon myself what does not concern me, and provide me good sight for what will make You pleased with me. O Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Possessor of glory, and generosity, and honor that is not exceeded. I ask you, O Allah, O Rahman, by Your glory and the light of Your Face, to make my heart constant in remembering Your Book as You taught me, and grant me that I recite it in the manner that will make You pleased with me. O Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Possessor of glory, and generosity, and honor that is not exceeded. I ask you, O Allah, O Rahman, by Your glory and the light of Your Face, to enlighten my sight with Your Book, and make my tongue free with it, and to relieve my heart with it, and to expand my chest with it, and to wash my body with it. For indeed, none aids me upon the truth other than You, and none gives it except You, and there is no might or power except by Allah, the High, the Magnificent. (Allāhummarḥamnī bitarkil-maʿāṣī abadan mā abqaitanī, warḥamnī an atakallafa mā lā yaʿnīnī, warzuqnī ḥusnan-naẓari fī mā yurḍīka ʿannī. Allāhumma badīʿas-samāwāti wal-arḍi dhal-jalāli wal-ikrāmi wal-ʿizzatil-latī lā turāmu, as’aluka yā Allāhu yā Raḥmānu bi-jalālika wa nūri wajhika, an tulzima qalbī ḥifẓa kitābika kamā ʿallamtanī, warzuqnī an atluwahū ʿalan-naḥwil-ladhī yurḍīka ʿannī. Allāhumma badīʿas-samāwāti wal arḍi dhal-jalāli wal-ikrāmi wal ʿizzati-llatī lā turāmu, as’aluka yā Allāhu, yā Raḥmānu bi-jalālika wa nūri wajhika, an tunawwira bi-kitābika baṣarī, wa an tuṭliqa bihī lisānī, wa an tufarrija bihī ʿan qalbī, wa an tashraḥa bihī ṣadrī, wa an taghsila bihī badanī, fa innahu lā yuʿīnunī ʿalal-ḥaqqi ghairuka wa lā yu’tīhi illā anta wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāhil-ʿAliyyil-ʿAẓīm).” O Abul-Hasan! So do this three Fridays, or five, or seven, you will be answered - by the will of Allah - by the One Who sent me with the Truth, it has not failed a believer once.’” ʿAbdullah bin ʿAbbas said: “So, by Allah, ʿAli did not wait but five or seven until [ʿAli] came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a gathering similar to that and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, indeed I was [a man] in the time that passed, who used to not take except four Ayat or about that much, so when I would recite them to myself they would suddenly depart from me, and today I learn forty Ayat or about that much, and when I recite them to myself, then it is as if the Book of Allah is before my eyes. I used to hear a Hadith and when I would repeat it, it would suddenly depart from me, and today I hear Ahadith, and when I report them, I do not err in a single letter.’ So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said at that point: ‘A believer, by the Lord of the Kaʿbah, O Abul-Hasan.’” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3570)
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas baithe huay thay ke Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap (SAW) par qurbaan hon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh Quran mere seene se nikal (bhool) raha hai, mujhe apne aap par qaboo nahi lagta." Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye Abul-Hasan, kya main tumhein aise kalimaat na sikhaun jinse Allah tumhein fayda de, aur jisse tum sikhao usse bhi fayda de, aur jo tumne seekha usse tumhare seene mein pukhta kar de?" Unhone kaha: "Zaroor, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe sikhaiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Jum'e ki raat (guzashta) ho, agar tum raat ke aakhri tihaai mein khada ho sako, to yeh aik mash-hood (haazir ki jaane wali) ghari hai jisme dua qubool hoti hai, aur yehi meray bhai Ya'qub (AS) ka apne beton se kehna hai: 'Main tumhare liye apne Rab se maghfirat maangunga,' (unhone kaha:) 'yahan tak ke Jum'e ki raat aa jaye.' Agar (yeh) na kar sako to raat ke beech mein khade ho jao, agar (yeh bhi) na kar sako to raat ke shuru mein khade ho jao, phir chaar rak'atein padho, pehli mein Fatihat-ul-Kitab aur Surah Yaseen padho, doosri rak'at mein Fatihat-ul-Kitab aur Ha-Meem Ad-Dukhan padho, teesri rak'at mein Fatihat-ul-Kitab aur Ha-Meem As-Sajdah (Alif-Laam-Meem Tanzeel) padho, aur chauthi rak'at mein Fatihat-ul-Kitab aur Tabaarak Al-Mufassal padho. Jab tashahhud se farigh ho jao to Allah ki hamd karo aur Allah ki behtareen tareef bayan karo, aur mujh par aur baaqi tamam Ambiya (AS) par durood bhejo, aur achhe tareeqe se karo, aur apne un bhaiyon ke liye maghfirat maango jinhone tumse pehle Eman qubool kiya, aur momin mardon aur momin auraton ke liye maghfirat maango, phir aakhir mein kaho: 'Aye Allah, mujhpar reham kar ke main gunahon ko hamesha ke liye chhod dun, jab tak tu mujhe zinda rakhe, aur mujhpar is baat mein reham kar ke main un cheezon mein takleef na uthaun jo mujhse ta'alluq nahi rakhtin, aur mujhe achhi nazar (soch-samajh) ata kar un baaton mein jinse tu mujhse raazi ho. Aye Allah, aasmaano aur zameen ke banane wale, jalaal aur ikraam wale, aur is izzat wale jo mangi nahi ja sakti, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon, aye Allah, aye Rahman, teri jalaal aur tere chehre ke noor ke waseele se, ke tu mere dil ko apni Kitab ki hifazat par qaim kar de jaise tune mujhe sikhaya, aur mujhe rizq ata kar ke main isse us tareeqe se padhoon jisse tu mujhse raazi ho. Aye Allah, aasmaano aur zameen ke banane wale, jalaal aur ikraam wale, aur is izzat wale jo mangi nahi ja sakti, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon, aye Allah, aye Rahman, teri jalaal aur tere chehre ke noor ke waseele se, ke tu apni Kitab se meri nazar ko roshan kar de, aur usse mera zaban ko azad kar de, aur usse mere dil ko kushaadgi de, aur usse mera seena khol de, aur usse mera jism (ibadat mein) mashghool kar de, kyunke haq par koi tere siwa meri madad nahi kar sakta, aur woh (Kitab) koi tere siwa ata nahi kar sakta, aur koi taqat ya qudrat nahi magar Allah, jo buland aur azeem hai.' Aye Abul-Hasan, yeh teen Jum'e, ya paanch, ya saat martaba karo, Allah ki ijaazat se qubool hoga, us zaat ki qasam jisne mujhe haq ke sath bheja, is (dua) ne kisi momin ko kabhi nakaam nahi kiya." Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne kaha: to Allah ki qasam, Ali (Alayhis Salam) sirf paanch ya saat (din) rukay yahan tak ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas usi tarah ki majlis mein aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), pehle mujhe chaar ayaat ya usi jaisi (kam) yaad karna mushkil tha, aur jab main unhein apne aap par padhta to woh nikal jaati thin, lekin aaj main chaalees (40) ayaat ya usi jaisi (zyada) yaad karta hoon, aur jab main unhein apne aap par padhta hoon to Allah ki Kitab jaise meri aankhon ke saamne (mahfooz) rehti hai. Aur pehle main hadith sunta tha, jab main use dohrana chahta to woh nikal jaati, lekin aaj main ahadith sunta hoon aur jab main unhein bayan karta hoon to unme aik harf bhi chhoot nahi'ta." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne is par unse farmaya: "Momin hai, Ka'be ke Rab ki qasam, Abul-Hasan!"

e: "Umm Sulaim came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, teach me some words that I may supplicate with during my prayer.' He said: 'Glorify Allah (by saying SubhanAllah) ten times, and praise Him (by saying Alhamdulilah) ten times, and magnify Him (by saying Allahu Akbar) ten times, then ask Him for what you need; He will say: 'Yes, yes.' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1299)
hi: Umm Sulaim (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas subah subah aayi aur kaha: "Mujhe kuch kalimaat sikha dijiye jo main apni namaz mein kahoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Das martaba Allah ki takbeer kaho, das martaba Allah ki tasbeeh karo - ya das martaba uski hamd karo - phir jo chaho maango, woh kahega: 'Haan, haan.'"

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to al-Abbas ibn AbdulMuttalib: Abbas, my uncle, shall I not give you, shall I not present to you, shall I not donate to you, shall I not produce for you ten things? If you act upon them, Allah will forgive you your sins, first and last, old and new, involuntary and voluntary, small and great, secret and open. These are the ten things: you should pray four rak'ahs, reciting in each one Fatihat al-Kitab and a surah. When you finish the recitation of the first rak'ah you should say fifteen times while standing: "Glory be to Allah", "Praise be to Allah", "There is no god but Allah", "Allah is most great". Then you should bow and say it ten times while bowing. Then you should raise your head after bowing and say it ten times. Then you should kneel down in prostration and say it ten times while prostrating yourself. Then you should raise your head after prostration and say it ten times. Then you should prostrate yourself and say it ten times. Then you should raise your head after prostrating and say it ten times in every rak'ah. You should do that in four rak'ahs. If you can observe it once daily, do so; if not, then once weekly; if not, then once a month; if not, then once a year; if not, then once in your lifetime. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1297)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Abbas, aye mere chacha, kya main aapko na dun, kya main aapko tohfa na dun, kya main aapke liye das khaslatein na karoon, agar aap yeh karein to Allah aapke gunah maaf kar dega, pehla-aakhri, purana-naya, khata-jaan-boojh kar, chhota-bada, chhupa-khula? (Yeh das khaslatein yeh hain:) aap chaar rak'atein padhein, har rak'at mein Fatihat-ul-Kitab aur koi surah padhein, jab aap pehli rak'at mein qira'at se farigh hon to khade rehte hue pandra (15) martaba kahein: 'Subhanallah wal-hamdulillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar,' phir ruku karein aur ruku ki halat mein das martaba kahein, phir apna sar uthayein aur das martaba kahein, phir sajda karein aur das martaba kahein, phir apna sar uthayein aur das martaba kahein, phir sajda karein aur das martaba kahein, phir apna sar uthayein aur das martaba kahein - yeh har rak'at mein pachhattar (75) martaba hui, aap chaar rak'aton mein yeh karein. Agar aap isse har din padh sakein to padhein, warna har Jum'e mein aik martaba, warna har mahine mein aik martaba, warna har saal mein aik martaba, warna zindagi mein aik martaba (padh lein)."

e: "Yahya bin Adam narrated to us, he said: "Malik narrated to us from Zubaid, from Dharr, from Ibn Abza.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1738)
hi: Apne walid se.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to his uncle Al-Abbas, and he mentioned the Hadith: 'This transmission does not weaken the bond of Hadith (knowledge). Indeed, increasing trustworthiness is more important than transmission itself. The Imam of his time in Hadith, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali, established this chain of narration from Ibrahim ibn al-Hakam ibn Aban and connected it.'"
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne chacha Abbas (RA) se farmaya, phir hadith zikr ki. (Yeh irsaal hadith ki sanad ko kamzor nahi karta, kyunke thiqa raawi ki ziyaadti irsaal se behtar hai, khaas taur par jab apne daur ke imam-e-hadith Ishaq bin Ibrahim Al-Hanzali ne is sanad ko Ibrahim bin Al-Hakam bin Aban se qaim kiya aur usse joda hai.)

e: [AI] From the Prophet, peace be upon him, with a narration similar to the hadith of Musa ibn Abdul Aziz from Al-Hakam: "The narration is authentic that Abdullah ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab reported that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, taught his cousin Ja'far ibn Abi Talib this prayer as he taught it to his uncle Abbas."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Musa bin Abdul Aziz ki, Al-Hakam se, hadith jaisi riwayat. (Aur Abdullah bin Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se sahih riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne chachazaad bhai Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ko yeh namaz sikhayi jaisa unhone apne chacha Abbas (RA) ko sikhaya tha.)

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent Ja'far ibn Abi Talib to the land of Habasha (Ethiopia). When he arrived there, the king embraced him, kissed him between the eyes, and said, "Do you not want me to give you gifts, inform you, honor you, and entertain you?" Ja'far replied, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." The king then instructed him to perform four units of prayer, reciting Alhamdulillah and a Surah in each unit, and after completing the recitation, say the following while still standing upright, before going into prostration: Subhan Allahi walhamdulillahi wala ilaha illallah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah (Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the greatest, and there is no power or strength except with Allah) fifteen times. Then, in the bowing position, say the same words ten times. Complete this entire unit before starting the second unit.
