Ja'far followed these instructions for three units, as described, until he had completed four units. "This is an authentic narration, with no doubt about it. One of the proofs of the authenticity of this hadith is the fact that the Imams of the Tabi'een in our time used it, as well as their consistent teaching of it to the people, such as Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak. May Allah have mercy on him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ko Habasha (Ethiopia) ki zameen ki taraf bheja, jab woh wapas aaye to aap (SAW) ne unhein gale lagaya aur unki peshani ke darmiyan bosa diya, phir farmaya: "Kya main aapko koi tohfa na dun, kya main aapko khushkhabri na dun, kya main aapko koi ata na dun, kya main aapko koi hadiya na dun?" Unhone kaha: "Zaroor, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aap chaar rak'atein padhein, har rak'at mein Al-Hamd aur koi surah padhein, phir qira'at ke baad, khade hue, ruku se pehle, pandra (15) martaba kahein: 'Subhanallah wal-hamdulillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah,' phir ruku karein aur is rak'at ki takmeel tak das martaba kahein, isse pehle ke doosri rak'at shuru karein, teenon rak'aton mein bhi isi tarah karein jaisa maine aapko bataya, yahan tak ke chaar rak'atein mukammal ho jayein." Yeh aik sahih sanad hai jispar koi gard-o-ghubaar nahi, aur is hadith ki sehat ki daleel yeh hai ke Tabi'in ke shagirdon se lekar hamare zamane tak ke a'imma isse istemal karte rahe hain, isse musalsal karte rahe hain aur logon ko sikhate rahe hain, unme Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak, rahmatullahi alaih, bhi shamil hain.

e: [AI] You begin by saying "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghayruka." Then, you say "Subhanallah walhamdulillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar" fifteen times. Next, you seek refuge and recite "Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim" and Al-Fatiha, followed by saying "Subhanallah walhamdulillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar" ten times while in the standing position of prayer. Then, you perform a bowing (rukoo) position and say it ten times, followed by raising your head and saying it ten times again. After that, you prostrate (sujood) and say it ten times, then raise your head and say it ten times again. Finally, you perform a second prostration and say it ten times, raise your head and say it ten times again. This completes one unit (rak'ah). You perform this prayer for a total of four units, resulting in seventy-five tasbih in each unit, making a total of three hundred. If you pray this at night, it is preferred to conclude with the tasleem (peace greeting) after the two units. If you pray during the day, you may choose to perform the tasleem or not. All narrators of this hadith from Ibn al-Mubarak are trustworthy and reliable, and it is not accused that Abdullah taught something that is not valid according to his chain of narration.
hi: Takbeer kahein, phir kahein: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghairuk," phir pandra (15) martaba kahein: "Subhanallah wal-hamdulillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar," phir panah maangein aur "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem" padhein, Fatihat-ul-Kitab aur koi surah padhein, phir das martaba kahein: "Subhanallah wal-hamdulillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu Akbar," phir ruku karein aur das martaba kahein, phir apna sar uthayein aur das martaba kahein, phir sajda karein aur das martaba kahein, phir apna sar uthayein aur das martaba kahein, phir doosri baar sajda karein aur das martaba kahein, phir apna sar uthayein aur das martaba kahein. Aap isi tarah chaar rak'atein padhein, to yeh har rak'at mein pachhattar (75) tasbeehat hain, aur yeh teen sau (300) poori hoti hain. Agar aap ise raat ko padhein to mujhe zyada pasand hai ke aap har do rak'aton mein salaam phere, aur agar aap ise din mein padhein to chaho to salaam pherein, chaho to na pherein. Is hadith ke Ibn Al-Mubarak se aane wale tamam raawi thiqa aur mo'tabar hain, aur Abdullah par yeh ilzaam nahi lagaya ja sakta ke unhone woh baat sikhayi ho jiski sanad unke nazdeek sahih na thi.

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "And at the setting of the stars (52:49) (about) the two Rak'ah before Fajr. And after the prostrations (50:40) 'The two Rak'at after Al-Maghrib.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3275)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fajr ki namaz se pehle ki do rak'atein sitaron ke chhupne (ke waqt) mein hain, aur Maghrib ke baad ki do rak'atein sehri (ke waqt) ke chhupne mein hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out to us one day and sat down. He said, "Whoever has a need to ask Allah for or to ask any human being from the children of Adam, should perform ablution and perfect his ablution, then pray two units of prayer and praise Allah, and send prayers upon the Prophet ﷺ . Then let him say, 'There is no deity except Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the Great Throne. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all worlds. I ask You for firm determination in seeking Your forgiveness and protection from every sin and safety from every offense.'" This narration is from Fa'idh bin 'Abdul-Rahman Abu al-Warqa' al-Kufi, who is counted among the followers (tabi'in), and I have seen a group of his contemporaries, and he was upright in narrating hadith, except that the two sheikhs did not narrate from him. I only included this narration as evidence for what was mentioned previously.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik din humare paas nikle aur baithe, phir farmaya: "Jise Allah se ya kisi Aadam ki aulad se koi zaroorat ho, use chahiye ke woh wudu kare aur achha wudu kare, phir do rak'atein padhe, phir Allah ki tareef kare aur Nabi (SAW) par durood bheje, aur kahe: 'La ilaha illallahul-Haleemul-Kareem, Subhanallahi Rabbil-Arshil-Azeem, Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen, as'aluka azaa'ima maghfiratika wal-ismata min kulli dhanbin was-salamata min kulli ithm.'"

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ʿIn Paradise there are chambers the inside of which can be seen from the outside and the outside can be seen from the inside.ʿ A Bedouin said: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who are they for? He said: “For the one who speaks kind words, feeds people and prays to Allah at night when people are asleep.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1338)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Jannat mein aise kamre hain jinke bahar ka hissa andar se aur andar ka hissa bahar se dikhai deta hai." Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (RA) ne poocha: "Yeh kiske liye hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ke liye jo achhi baat kare, khana khilaaye, aur raat ko (namaz mein) khada rahe jabke log so rahe hon."

e: [AI] "I prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a night in Ramadan in a room made of palm leaves. He stood up, raised his voice saying, "Allah is the greatest, the possessor of might, dominion, magnificence, and grandeur." Then, he began the recitation with Surah Al-Baqarah, and I thought he would stop at one hundred verses, but he continued until he reached two hundred. Then, he began the recitation of Surah Al-Imran, and he recited it. After that, he began the recitation of Surah An-Nisa and recited it. He would not pass by a verse of admonition without pausing to seek refuge with Allah. Then, he performed a rukoo' (bowing) similar to his standing position, saying, "Subhan Rabbiyal Azeem," which he would repeat. Then, he raised his head and said, "Allah listens to the one who praises Him. O our Lord, all praise is due to You." He repeated this statement, similar to his rukoo'. Then, he prostrated as he did in his standing position, saying, "Subhan Rabbiyal A'la." He would say, between the two prostrations, "O Lord, forgive me." He did not pray more than four units of prayer, similar to the Tahajjud prayer, from the beginning of the night until the end of it, until Bilal came and called the Adhan for Fajr prayer."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Ramzan ki aik raat khajoor ki tehniyon se bane aik kamre mein namaz padhi. Unhone kaha: aap (SAW) khade huay aur takbeer kahi, farmaya: "Allahu Akbar, zul-jabaroot wal-malakoot wa zul-kibriya-i wal-azamah," phir Surah Al-Baqarah shuru ki aur padhi. Maine socha aap (SAW) sau ayaat tak pahunchengay, phir socha do sau tak pahunchengay. Unhone kaha: phir aap (SAW) ne Surah Aal-e-Imran shuru ki aur padhi, phir Surah An-Nisa shuru ki aur padhi, jab bhi koi khauf wali ayat aati to aap (SAW) rukte aur panah maangte, phir aap (SAW) ne ruku kiya, itni hi der jitni khade rehte the, "Subhana Rabbiyal-Azeem" kehte huay, isse baar-baar dohrate, phir apna sar uthaya aur farmaya: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamd," itni hi der jitna ruku kiya, phir sajda kiya itni hi der jitni khade rehte the, kehte huay: "Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la," aur dono sajdon ke darmiyan kehte: "Rabbighfir li." Aap (SAW) ne Isha ki namaz se raat ke shuru se aakhir tak sirf chaar rak'atein padhin, yahan tak ke Bilal (RA) aaye aur Fajr ki namaz ki khabar di.

e: [AI] "A good practice, performed by the Prophet ﷺ  and Muslims after him, but it is not obligatory."
hi: Aik achha amal, "jispar Nabi (SAW) aur unke baad Musalmanon ne amal kiya, magar yeh wajib nahi."

e: ‘Ali ؓ said: Verily, Witr is not a must like your prescribed prayers, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed Witr, then he said: “Pray Witr, O people of the Qurʿan. Pray Witr, for Allah is One and loves that which is odd numbered.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1262)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) [ne kaha]: "Witr tumhari farz namazon ki tarah zaroori nahi hai, lekin Rasulullah (SAW) ne Witr padhi, phir farmaya: 'Aye Quran walon, Witr karo, kyunke Allah taaq (witr) hai aur taaq ko pasand karta hai.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: There are three obligations upon me, and optional acts for you: the sacrifice, Witr prayer, and the two units of prayer before Fajr prayer.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen cheezein hain jo mujh par farz hain aur tumhare liye nafl: qurbani, Witr, aur Fajr ki do rak'atein."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to Abu Bakr, "When do you perform the Witr prayer?" He said, "I perform it before I sleep." And he said to Umar, "When do you perform the Witr prayer?" He said, "I sleep first and then perform it." The Prophet ﷺ  said to Abu Bakr, "You have chosen certainty" or "the definite way." And he said to Umar, "You have chosen strength."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) se poocha: "Aap Witr kab padhte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Main sone se pehle Witr padh leta hoon." Aur Umar (RA) se poocha: "Aap Witr kab padhte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Main sota hoon phir Witr padhta hoon." To aap (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) se farmaya: "Aapne yaqeen (pukhta raah) ko apnaya hai" - ya "mazbooti ko," aur Umar (RA) se farmaya: "Aapne taaqat (wali raah) ko apnaya hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Bakr, "When do you pray the Witr?" He said, "I pray Witr and then sleep." The Prophet ﷺ said, "You have taken the decisive action." He asked Umar and he said, "When do you pray the Witr?" He said, "I sleep and then I wake up during the night to pray Witr." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Doing what the strong one does, you have done." Sahih.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) se poocha: "Aap Witr kab padhte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Main Witr padh kar sota hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aapne pukhta raah apnayi." Aur Umar (RA) se poocha: "Aap Witr kab padhte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Main sota hoon phir raat ko uthkar Witr padhta hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aapne mazboot (aadmi) ka kaam kiya." Sahih.

e: [AI] "That Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri informed them that they asked the Prophet ﷺ  about Al-Witr (a prayer performed in odd numbers) and he said, 'Perform Witr before the Fajr (dawn) prayer.' Ma'mar ibn Rashid continued, narrating from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir."
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ne unhein bataya ke unhone Nabi (SAW) se Witr ke baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Subah se pehle Witr karo." Ma'mar bin Rashid ne Yahya bin Abi Kathir se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: Observe Witr prayer before it is morning. Abu Sa'id reported that they (the Prophet's Companions) asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about Witr (prayer). (In reply to their inquiry) he said: Observe Witr prayer before it is morning. (Using translation from Muslim 754a)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Subah hone se pehle Witr karo."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Hasten to perform the Witr (odd) prayer before dawn." Sahih (authentic).
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Subah se pehle Witr karne mein jaldi karo." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Whoever experiences dawn and does not perform the Witr prayer, there is no Witr prayer for them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo subah ko pahunch jaye aur usne Witr na padhi ho, uski koi Witr nahi."

e: [AI] Ibn Umar used to say: "Whoever prays at night, let him make the Witr prayer his last prayer. For the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded that. So, when it is dawn, the night prayer and the Witr are gone. For the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: ‘Perform the Witr prayer before dawn.'" (Sahih)
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) kaha karte the: "Jo raat ko namaz padhe, use chahiye ke apni aakhri namaz Witr banaye, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne isi ka hukum diya hai. Jab Fajr ho jaye to raat ki tamam namaz aur Witr ka waqt guzar jata hai, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Fajr se pehle Witr karo.'" Sahih.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone oversleeps and misses the witr, or forgets it, he should pray when he remembers. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1431)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apni Witr se so jaye ya use bhool jaye, to woh subah hone par - ya yaad aane par - use padh le."

e: “Witr is Haqq.* Whoever wishes let him pray Witr with five (Rak’ah), and whoever wishes let him pray Witr with three (Rak’ah), and whoever wishes let him pray Witr with one (Rak’ah).” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1190)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Witr haq hai, jo chahe paanch se Witr kare, jo chahe teen se Witr kare, aur jo chahe aik se Witr kare."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If one of you doubts in his prayer, let him cast aside the doubt and build on what he is certain of. If he becomes certain that he has completed it, he should perform two prostrations. If his prayer was complete, then the (extra) rak‘ah and the two prostrations will be voluntary; and if it was incomplete, then the rak‘ah will complete his prayer, and the two prostrations will rub Satan’s nose in the dust.”
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko apni namaz mein shak ho, to woh shak ko chhod de aur yaqeen par binaa kare, agar use takmeel ka yaqeen ho jaye to woh do sajde kare, agar uski namaz mukammal thi to yeh rak'at aur do sajde nafl ban jayenge, aur agar woh naqis (kam) thi to yeh rak'at uski namaz ko mukammal kar degi, aur yeh do sajde Shaitan ki naak zameen mein ragadenge."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When one of you prays, he does not know whether he has prayed three or four (rak'ahs). So let him perform one extra rak'ah, perfecting its prostration and bowing, and then make two prostrations."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe aur use pata na ho ke usne teen padhi hain ya chaar, to woh aik rak'at aur padh le, uska sajda aur ruku achha kare, phir do sajde kare."

e: [AI] He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed a prayer that consisted of two cycles. After finishing his prayer, he remained seated and made a double prostration before giving the Salam."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein aik namaz padhayi, do (rak'aton) ke baad khade ho gaye, to logon ne tasbeeh kahi, aap (SAW) chalte rahe yahan tak ke apni namaz mukammal kar li, aur sirf salaam baaqi raha, to aap (SAW) ne baithe-baithe salaam phere se pehle do sajde kiye."

e: [AI] He stood up in the two units of prayer and they praised him, then he completed the prayer and prostrated for the prostrations of forgetfulness. When he finished, he said, "Did you see me sitting? I only did as I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Woh do rak'aton ke baad khade ho gaye, to logon ne tasbeeh kahi, phir unhone (namaz) mukammal ki, phir sahw ke do sajde kiye." Jab woh (namaz se) farigh huay to kaha: "Kya tumne mujhe baithte nahi dekha? Maine to bas wahi kiya jaisa maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko karte dekha hai."

e: [AI] "I prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  the Maghrib prayer, then he mistakenly offered two extra units of prayer and concluded. A man said to him, 'O Messenger of Allah, you made a mistake and concluded the prayer after two units.' The Prophet then ordered Bilal to lead the prayer and complete those units. I asked people about the man who said to the Prophet that he made a mistake, and they told me, 'Do you know him?' I said, 'No, unless I see him.' Then a man passed by me, and I said, 'He is the one.' They said, 'That is Talhah bin 'Ubaydullah.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Maghrib ki namaz padhi, aap (SAW) se bhool hui aur aap (SAW) ne do rak'aton mein salaam pher diya, phir wapas jaane lage. Aik shakhs ne aap (SAW) se kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapse bhool hui hai aur aapne do rak'aton mein salaam pher diya." To aap (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya, unhone iqamat kahi, phir aap (SAW) ne woh (baaqi) rak'at mukammal ki. Maine logon se us shakhs ke baare mein poocha jisne kaha tha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapse bhool hui hai," to mujhse kaha gaya: "Kya tum unhein pehchante ho?" Maine kaha: "Nahi, siwaye is ke ke main unhein dekh loon." Phir mere paas se aik shakhs guzra, maine kaha: "Yehi hain." To unhone kaha: "Yeh Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA) hain."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  gave the testimony of faith in the two prostrations of forgetfulness, and then he concluded the prayer by saying the salaam.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne sahw ke do sajdon mein tashahhud kiya, phir salaam phera."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ prayed with them, but he made a mistake in his prayer, so he performed the two prostrations of forgetfulness after the salaam and speech."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne unhein namaz padhayi aur unki namaz mein bhool hui, to aap (SAW) ne salaam aur baat karne ke baad sahw ke do sajde kiye."

e: The Prophet ﷺ named the two prostrations of forgetfulness disgraceful for the devil. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1025)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne sahw ke dono sajdon ko 'Al-Murghimatayn' (Shaitan ko zaleel karne wale) ka naam diya."

e: [AI] I asked Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and said, "One of us prays but does not know how much he has prayed." He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: If anyone of you prays and does not know how much he has prayed, he should prostrate two prostrations. And if Satan comes to anyone and says, 'You have prayed', let him say, 'I have not prayed,' except if he finds the smell of something or hear a sound with his ears."
hi: Maine Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se poocha, arz kiya: "Hum mein se koi namaz padhta hai magar use nahi pata ke usne kitni padhi." Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe aur use pata na ho ke usne kitni padhi, to woh do sajde kar le. Aur jab tum mein se kisi ke paas Shaitan aakar kahe: 'Tumhara wudu toot gaya hai,' to woh kahe: 'Tu jhoota hai,' siwaye is soorat mein jab usse apni naak se koi badbu mehsoos ho ya apne kaan se koi awaz sune."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Whoever rushes in his prayer in three and four units, then let him complete it, for surely addition is better than deficiency."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apni namaz mein teen ya chaar (rak'aton) mein shak kare, to woh mukammal kar le, kyunke ziyaadti kami se behtar hai."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ said, "There should be no pause in the continuity of prayer, except for standing up from sitting and sitting from standing."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Namaz ke tasalsul mein koi tawaqquf (bhool) nahi, siwaye baithne se khade hone aur khade hone se baithne ke."

e: [AI] I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ or from one of his companions what he mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded when a person makes a mistake in their prayer. I asked: "Have you heard anything about this, O Amir al-Mumineen?" He replied: "No." Then Abdullah ibn Awf entered upon us and asked: "What are you discussing?" Umar said: "I asked him if he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ or any of his companions mention what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded when a person makes a mistake in their prayer." Abdullah ibn Awf said: "I have knowledge of that." Umar said: "Come forth and narrate, for you are the just and trustworthy." Abdullah ibn Awf said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'If one of you is uncertain between two scenarios [in prayer], then they should choose the one that is less in number. And if one is uncertain between two scenarios and a third, they should choose the two. And if one is uncertain between three scenarios and four, they should choose the three. Then they should complete what remains of their prayer until the doubt only pertains to the extra [acts of worship]. Then they should prostrate twice while sitting before completing their prayer.'"
hi: "Kya tumne Rasulullah (SAW) se ya unke kisi sahabi se woh baat suni hai jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne hukum di thi jab kisi shakhs ko apni namaz mein bhool ho jaye?" Maine kaha: "Nahi. Kya aapne suni hai, aye Ameer-ul-Momineen?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." To humare paas Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA) aaye aur poocha: "Tum dono kis baat mein hain?" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Maine inse poocha ke kya unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se ya unke kisi sahabi se woh baat suni hai jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne hukum di thi jab kisi shakhs ko apni namaz mein bhool ho jaye." To Abdur Rahman (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe iska ilm hai." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Batao, tum insaaf pasand aur qaabil-e-e'timaad ho." Abdur Rahman (RA) ne kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko do (rak'aton) mein shak ho, to woh unhein aik (rak'at) mana le, aur jab do aur teen mein shak ho, to woh unhein do mana le, aur jab teen aur chaar mein shak ho, to woh unhein teen mana le, phir apni baaqi namaz mukammal kare yahan tak ke wahm ziyaadti mein ho jaye, phir salaam se pehle baithe-baithe do sajde kare."

e: [AI] "People, glorified is Allah, glorified is Allah. Then he did not sit and left while he was standing. And when he was in the last part of his prayer, he performed two prostrations while he was sitting. When he finished the prayer, he said, 'Indeed, I heard you all saying 'glorified is Allah' earlier, so that I may sit, but the Sunnah which I have done is'"
hi: Log "Subhanallah, Subhanallah" kehne lage, "to woh na baithe aur apne khade rehne par qaim rahe, jab unki namaz ka aakhri hissa aaya to unhone baithe-baithe do sajde kiye." Jab unhone salaam phera to kaha: "Maine abhi tumhein 'Subhanallah' kehte suna taake main baith jaun, lekin Sunnat wahi hai jo maine kiya."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "A prophet came out from among the prophets seeking rain. Suddenly, he saw an ant lifting one of its legs towards the sky. He said, 'Go back, for you have been answered due to the status of this ant.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Ambiya mein se aik Nabi baarish ki dua maangne nikle, achanak unhone aik chyunti dekhi jo apni kuch taangein aasman ki taraf uthaye hui thi, to unhone farmaya: 'Wapas chalo, tumhari dua is chyunti ke maamle ki wajah se qubool ho chuki hai.'"

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sought rain and turned his cloak so that the drought may be transformed."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne baarish ki dua maangi aur apni chadar ulat di taake qehat (khushk-saali) badal jaye."

e: [AI] "The sunnah of seeking rain refers to the sunnah of performing prayer on the two Eids, except that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned his cloak inside out and placed his right over his left and his left over his right and prayed the two units of prayer. He magnified during the first unit with seven takbeerat and recited "Subhan Allahi-l-A'la" and recited "Hal ataaka hadithu-l-ghashiya" in the second unit, and magnified it with five takbeerat."
hi: "Istisqa ki Sunnat Eidon ki namaz ki Sunnat jaisi hai, siwaye is ke ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni chadar ulat di, apna dayan hissa bayen taraf aur bayan hissa dayen taraf kar diya, phir do rak'atein padhi, pehli mein saat (7) takbeerein kahin aur 'Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la' padhi, aur doosri mein 'Hal Ataka Hadithul-Ghashiyah' padhi aur usme paanch (5) takbeerein kahin."

e: [AI] O son of my brother, how did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform the rain prayer on the day he prayed for rain with the people? He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out humbly, humble, and humble, and he performed in it as he would in the Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha."
hi: "Aye mere bhatije, jis din Rasulullah (SAW) ne logon ke sath baarish ki dua maangi, aap (SAW) ne Istisqa mein kaise kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) inkisaari, aajizi aur saadgi ke sath nikle, aur usme aisa hi kiya jaisa woh Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha mein karte the."

e: His father said: "One of the governors sent me to Ibn Abbas to ask him about the prayer for rain. He said: 'What kept him from asking me? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out humbly, (dressed) in a state of humility, submissiveness and beseeching, and he prayed two rak'ahs as in the Eid prayer, but he did not deliver a Khutbah like this Khutbah of yours.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1521)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) inkisaari, saadgi, aajizi, gidgidaate huay aur araam se chalte huay nikle, phir do rak'atein padhi jaise Eid mein padhte the, aur tumhari is (lambi) khutbah jaisi khutbah nahi di."

e: "The Prophet ﷺ would not raise his hands in any of his supplications except when praying for rain (Al-Istisqa')." (One of the narrators) Shu'bah said: "I said to Thabit: 'Did you hear it from Anas?' He said: 'Subhan Allah!' I said: 'Did you hear it?' He said: 'Subhan Allah!' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1748)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) apni kisi dua mein apne haath nahi uthate the, siwaye Istisqa ke." Shu'bah ne kaha: maine Thabit se poocha: "Kya aapne isse Anas (RA) se suna hai?" Unhone kaha: "Subhanallah!" Maine poocha: "Kya aapne Anas (RA) se suna?" Unhone kaha: "Subhanallah!"

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  drank water and had a black cloak on him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wanted to take hold of its lower part and place it on top of him, but when it became heavy on him, he put it on his shoulders. They both agreed to narrate the hadith of Abbad ibn Tamim, but they did not narrate it in this wording, and it is authentic according to the conditions of Muslim."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne baarish ki dua maangi jabke aap (SAW) par aik kaali chadar thi, Rasulullah (SAW) ne chaha ke uske neeche wale hisse ko pakad kar upar kar dein, jab woh unpar bhaari ho gayi to unhone use apne kandhe par palat diya." Dono ne Abbad bin Tamim ki hadith nikalne par ittifaq kiya hai, magar unhone isi lafz ke sath nahi nikala, aur yeh Muslim ki shart par sahih hai.

e: The people came to the Prophet ﷺ weeping (due to drought). He said (making supplication): O Allah! give us rain which will replenish us, abundant, fertilising and profitable, not injurious, granting it now without delay. He (the narrator) said: Thereupon the sky became overcast. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1169)
hi: Roti hui auratein Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayin, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, humein aisi baarish de jo madadgar, khush-gawaar, pheldaar, jaldi aane wali, na der se aane wali, faidamand, na nuqsaan dene wali ho," to aasman unpar chha gaya.

e: He saw the Messenger of Allah at Ahjar Az-Zait praying for rain and raising his hands, making supplications. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1514)
hi: Umair (RA), Abu Al-Lahm ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam, se, unhone "Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ahjar Az-Zayt ke paas baarish ki dua maangte dekha, apni hatheliyan chhupaye huay, isi tarah dua kar rahe the."

e: [AI] "I witnessed the Battle of Khaybar with my leaders, so they spoke to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about me and informed him that I am a servant. So he ordered for me to receive the sword, and when I tried it, I found it to be heavy. Then he ordered for me to be given some of the spoils of war, and I presented a piece of cloth to him that I used to heal the insane. He commanded me to throw away some of it and keep some."
hi: "Main apne sardaron ke sath Khaybar mein hazir tha, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se mere baare mein baat ki aur unhein bataya ke main ghulam hoon, to aap (SAW) ne mere liye hukum diya aur mujhe talwar pehnayi gayi, to main use ghaseet raha tha, phir aap (SAW) ne mere liye maal-e-ghaneemat ke kuch mamooli saaman ka hukum diya, aur maine unhein aik ruqyah (dam) pesh ki jo main deewano ko padha karta tha, to aap (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke uska kuch hissa phenk dun aur kuch rakh lun."

e: The people complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ of the lack of rain, so he gave an order for a pulpit. It was then set up for him in the place of prayer. He fixed a day for the people on which they should come out. Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when the rim of the sun appeared, sat down on the pulpit, and having pronounced the greatness of Allah and expressed His praise, he said: You have complained of drought in your homes, and of the delay in receiving rain at the beginning of its season. Allah has ordered you to supplicate Him has and promised that He will answer your prayer. Then he said: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe, the Compassionate, the Merciful, the Master of the Day of Judgment. There is no god but Allah Who does what He wishes. O Allah, Thou art Allah, there is no deity but Thou, the Rich, while we are the poor. Send down the rain upon us and make what Thou sendest down a strength and satisfaction for a time. He then raised his hands, and kept raising them till the whiteness under his armpits was visible. He then turned his back to the people and inverted or turned round his cloak while keeping his hands aloft. He then faced the people, descended and prayed two rak'ahs. Allah then produced a cloud, and the storm of thunder and lightning came on. Then the rain fell by Allah's permission, and before he reached his mosque streams were flowing. When he saw the speed with which the people were seeking shelter, he ﷺ laughed till his back teeth were visible. Then he said: I testify that Allah is Omnipotent and that I am Allah's servant and apostle. Abu Dawud said: This is a ghraib (rate) tradition, but its chain is sound. The people of Medina recite "maliki" (instead of maaliki) yawm al-din" (the master of the Day of Judgement). But this tradition (in which the word maalik occurs) is an evidence for them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1173)
hi: Logon ne Rasulullah (SAW) se baarish ki kami ki shikayat ki, to aap (SAW) ne mimbar ka hukum diya, use namaz ki jagah rakha gaya, aur aap (SAW) ne logon se aik din ka wada kiya jisme woh nikalengay. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) jab suraj ka kinara zaahir hua to nikle, mimbar par baithe, takbeer kahi aur Allah ki hamd ki, phir farmaya: "Tumne apne gharon ki khushk-saali aur baarish ke apne mausam se der hone ki shikayat ki hai, aur Allah ne tumhein hukum diya hai ke tum usse dua karo, aur wada kiya hai ke woh tumhari dua qubool karega," phir farmaya: "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen, Ar-Rahmanir-Raheem, Maliki Yaumid-Deen, la ilaha illallahu yaf'alu ma yureed, Allahumma anta la ilaha illa anta, al-Ghaniyyu wa nahnul-fuqara, anzil alainal-ghaith, waj'al ma anzalta lana quwwatan wa balaghan ila heen," phir apne dono haath uthaye, aur haath uthaye rahe yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ki baaghlon ki safedi zaahir ho gayi, phir aap (SAW) ne logon ki taraf apni peeth pheri, apni chadar ulat di ya palat di, jabke aap (SAW) ke haath abhi bhi uthe huay the, phir logon ki taraf mutawajjeh huay aur (mimbar se) utre aur do rak'atein padhi. Allah ne aik baadal paida kiya, garaj-chamak hui, phir Allah ki ijaazat se baarish hui, aap (SAW) apni masjid tak nahi pahunche the ke seylaab bahne lage. Jab aap (SAW) ne dekha ke log panah ki taraf jaldi jaldi ja rahe hain to hanse, yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ki daadhein zaahir ho gayin, phir farmaya: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah har cheez par qaadir hai, aur ke main Allah ka banda aur uska Rasool hoon."

e: [AI] "Tell us a story that you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  supplicate against Mudar, so I went to him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, indeed Allah has given you and answered your supplication, while your people have perished. So pray to Allah for them.' He said, 'O Allah, send us a beneficial, abundant rainfall, quickly and continuously, that will be ample, immediate, and beneficial, without causing harm.' And from then on, there was only a Friday or something similar until they received rain.'"
hi: "Humein koi hadith sunao jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho." Unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Mudar (qabile) ke khilaf bad-dua karte suna, to main aap (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ne aapko (jo maanga tha) ata kiya aur aapki dua qubool ki, aur beshak aapki qaum halaak ho rahi hai, to unke liye dua kijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, humein aisi baarish de jo madadgar, khush-gawaar, jaldi barasne wali, garqaab (kaseer), musalsal, jaldi aane wali, na der se aane wali, faidamand, na nuqsaan dene wali ho," to Jum'e ka din ya usi jaise waqt se zyada nahi guzra ke unpar baarish barasne lagi.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  supplicated during the prayer for rain and said, 'O Allah, give us abundant rain, refreshing and plentiful, quickly and continuously, good and beneficial, not harmful.' It was only a Friday or something similar until they were given rain at the end of the supplication."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Istisqa mein dua ki aur farmaya: "Aye Allah, humein aisi baarish de jo madadgar, khush-gawaar, jaldi barasne wali, garqaab, musalsal, jaldi aane wali, na der se aane wali, faidamand, na nuqsaan dene wali ho," to Jum'e ka din ya usi jaise waqt se zyada nahi guzra ke unpar baarish barasne lagi. (Kitab-ul-Istisqa ka aakhri hissa.)

e: [AI] "While I was throwing arrows, the sun appeared, so I abandoned them and went towards the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . I reached him while he was standing, raising his hands, glorifying, magnifying, praising his Lord, and supplicating until it got clear. He then recited two surahs in two units of prayer."
hi: "Main teer chala raha tha ke suraj ko grahan lag gaya, maine unhein chhod diya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf chal pada, main unke paas pahuncha jabke woh khade the, apne haath uthaye huay the, tasbeeh, takbeer aur apne Rab ki hamd kar rahe the aur dua kar rahe the yahan tak ke (grahan) chhat gaya, aur aap (SAW) ne do rak'aton mein do surahein padhin."

e: [AI] "The sun set during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up and prolonged his standing until it was said he would not prostrate. Then he prostrated and prolonged his prostration until it was said he would not raise his head. Then he raised his head and prolonged his standing until it was said he would not bow. Then he bowed and prolonged his bow until it was said he would not raise his head. Then he raised his head and prolonged his standing until it was said he would not prostrate." And the rest of the narration mentions the Hadith of Al-Thawri narrated by Ya'la bin 'Ata', which is a strange, authentic Hadith. "So the two sheikhs have provided evidence with Mu'ammal ibn Isma'il, but they did not exclude it. As for 'Ata' bin Al-Sa'ib, they did not exclude it."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein suraj ko grahan laga, to Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay aur khada rehna itna lamba kiya ke kaha jane laga ke woh ruku nahi karengay, phir ruku kiya aur usse itna lamba kiya ke kaha jane laga ke woh (sar) nahi uthayengay, phir apna sar uthaya aur khada rehna itna lamba kiya ke kaha jane laga ke woh (dobara) ruku nahi karengay, phir ruku kiya aur usse itna lamba kiya ke kaha jane laga ke woh (sar) nahi uthayengay, phir apna sar uthaya aur khada rehna itna lamba kiya ke kaha jane laga ke woh sajda nahi karengay," aur baaqi hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] Sumurah, while I was a young boy from the Ansar, we were throwing objects for ourselves during the time of the Prophet ﷺ. When the sun reached the height of two or three lances above the horizon, it became darkened and shone like a firefly. One of us said to his companion, "Let's go to the mosque, and I swear by Allah that this matter of the sun will be mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his Ummah." So we went to the mosque, and we found the Messenger of Allah ﷺ standing among the people. He came forward and led us in prayer, the longest prayer he ever prayed with us, in which we could not even hear his voice. Then he performed ruku (bowing) with us, the longest ruku he ever performed with us, in which we could not hear his voice. Then he performed sujud (prostration) with us, the longest sujud he ever performed with us, in which we could not hear his voice. Then he did the same in the second raka'ah, and when the sun reappeared during the second raka'ah, he sat down. Then he said, "O people, indeed I am only a human being and the Messenger of Allah. But I remind you of Allah, if you know that I have not conveyed any of the messages of my Lord, which you informed me of, until I convey them as they should be conveyed. And if you know that I have conveyed the messages of my Lord, which you informed me of." Then the people stood up and said, "We bear witness that you have conveyed the messages of your Lord and advised your Ummah, and you have fulfilled what is upon you." Then they fell silent, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "As for what follows, there are men who claim that the eclipse of this sun, the eclipse of this moon, and the disappearance of these stars from their stations cause the death of great men from the people of the earth. Indeed, they are liars, but they are signs from the signs of Allah by which He tests His servants. Let the one among them who will repent come forward." By Allah, since I started praying, I have not met any of you in your current worldly and hereafter conditions. And by Allah, the Hour will not be established until thirty liars will appear, the last of them being the lame Dajjal. He will have a deformed eye like the eye of Abi Yahya, a sheikh from the Ansar. And when he appears, he will claim that he is Allah. Whoever believes in him, verifies his claim, and follows him, then none of his past deeds will benefit him. And whoever denies him and rejects him, then none of his past deeds will harm him. Indeed, he will appear on the entire earth except for the Haram and Bayt al-Maqdis. And indeed, he will besiege the believers in Bayt al-Maqdis, and they will shake violently. Then Jesus, the son of Mary, will descend among them, and Allah will defeat him and his soldiers, to the extent that the black stone will call out, "O believer! This is a disbeliever hiding behind me, so come and kill him." He said, "But that will not happen until you see matters becoming widespread and severe. You will ask each other, 'Did your Prophet ﷺ mention anything about this?' And until mountains move from their places and continue to move until the seizing (of souls) comes. He pointed with his hand, and he said, "Then he delivered another sermon, in which he mentioned what he mentioned before and did not delay it or precede it."
hi: Samurah (RA) [ne kaha]: aik din main aur Ansar ka aik ladka Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein apna nishana lagane mein mashghool the, yahan tak ke jab suraj dekhne wale ki nazar mein ufaq se do ya teen nezon jitna oopar tha, woh kaala pad gaya yahan tak ke woh (raat ki tarah) tareek ho gaya. Hum mein se aik ne apne sathi se kaha: "Chalo humare sath masjid chalo, Allah ki qasam is suraj ke maamle se Rasulullah (SAW) ki Ummat mein zaroor koi bada waqia hoga." Hum masjid ki taraf badhe to woh khula (khaali) tha, humein Rasulullah (SAW) us waqt mile jab woh logon ke paas nikle, unhone kaha: aap (SAW) aage badhe aur humein namaz padhayi, itni lambi jaisi kabhi kisi namaz mein humein na padhayi thi, na hum aap (SAW) ki awaz sun rahe the, phir humein utna lamba ruku karaya jitna kisi namaz mein na kiya, na hum aap (SAW) ki awaz sun rahe the, phir humein utna lamba sajda karaya jitna kisi namaz mein na kiya, na hum aap (SAW) ki awaz sun rahe the. Unhone kaha: phir doosri rak'at mein bhi aisa hi kiya. Unhone kaha: to suraj ka chhatna doosri rak'at ke baithne se mel khaya. Unhone kaha: phir aap (SAW) ne salaam phera, Allah ki hamd ki, uski tareef bayan ki, gawahi di ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur gawahi di ke woh uske bande aur Rasool hain, phir farmaya: "Aye logo, main to sirf aik insaan hoon aur Allah ka Rasool, main tumhein Allah ki qasam dilata hoon, agar tum jaante ho ke maine apne Rab ke paighamat pahunchane mein koi kotahi ki hai, to mujhe zaroor batao, yahan tak ke main apne Rab ke paighamat is tarah pahuncha dun jaise unhein pahunchana chahiye, aur agar tum jaante ho ke maine apne Rab ke paighamat pahunchaye hain, to mujhe zaroor batao." Unhone kaha: log khade huay aur kaha: "Hum gawahi dete hain ke aapne apne Rab ke paighamat pahunchaye, apni Ummat ko naseehat ki, aur jo aap par farz tha woh poora kiya." Unhone kaha: phir woh khamosh ho gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ammaba'd, kuch log yeh samajhte hain ke is suraj ka grahan lagna, is chaand ka grahan lagna, aur in sitaron ka apni jagahon se hatna, zameen ke kisi bade shakhs ki maut ki wajah se hota hai, aur unhone jhoot kaha, balke yeh Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain jinse woh apne bandon ko azmata hai, taake dekhe unme se kaun tauba karta hai. Allah ki qasam, jabse main khada hokar namaz padha raha hoon, maine woh sab kuch dekh liya hai jo tumhein apni duniya aur aakhirat mein pesh aane wala hai. Aur Allah ki qasam, Qayamat is waqt tak qaim nahi hogi jab tak teess (30) jhoote (mudda'i-e-nabuwwat) na nikal aayen, unme aakhri kaana Dajjal hoga, jiski baayin aankh mit-si gayi hogi, jaise Ansar ke aik boodhe, Abu Yahya, ki aankh. Woh jab bhi nikalega to dawa karega ke woh Allah hai, to jo bhi usse Eman laaye, usse sach maane aur uski pairavi kare, to uska koi pichla nek amal usse fayda na dega, aur jo usse kufr kare aur usse jhutlaaye, to usse uske pichle kisi amal ki wajah se saza nahi di jayegi. Beshak woh poori zameen par ghalib aa jayega siwaye Haram (Makkah) aur Bait-ul-Maqdis ke, aur woh momino ko Bait-ul-Maqdis mein ghere ga, to woh sakht zalzale se hilaenge, to unme Isa bin Maryam (AS) subah karengay, aur Allah use aur uski faujon ko shikast dega, yahan tak ke deewar ka kata-phoota hissa aur darakht ki jad bhi momin ko pukaarengay: 'Yeh kaafir hai jo mere peechhe chhupa hai, aa, isse qatl kar de.' Unhone kaha: 'Aisa tab tak nahi hoga jab tak tum aise maamlaat na dekho jinka maamla tumhare nazdeek bohot bada ho jaye, tum aapas mein poochhoge ke kya tumhare Nabi (SAW) ne tumhein ismein se kuch bataya tha, aur jab tak pahaad apni jagah se na hat jaayen, phir uske baad (rooh) qabz hogi,' aur aap (SAW) ne apne haath se ishara kiya. Unhone kaha: phir aap (SAW) ne aik aur khutba di, phir yeh hadith zikr ki, na aage badhaya na peechhe hataya.

e: [AI] Indeed, the sun eclipsed on the day Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, passed away. The people thought that it had eclipsed due to his death. Then the Prophet ﷺ stood up and said, "O people, indeed the sun and the moon are two signs from the signs of Allah. They do not eclipse due to the death or life of anyone. So, when you witness this, stand up for prayer, remember Allah, supplicate, and give in charity."
hi: Ke suraj ko us din grahan laga jis din Rasulullah (SAW) ke bete Ibrahim ka intiqal hua, to logon ne samjha ke yeh unki maut ki wajah se grahan laga hai, to Nabi (SAW) khade huay aur farmaya: "Aye logo, suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyan hain, yeh kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, isliye jab tum yeh dekho to namaz ki taraf aur Allah ke zikr ki taraf khade ho jao, dua karo aur sadqa do."

e: [AI] The translation of the given phrase into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered the emancipation of slaves during a solar eclipse."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne suraj grahan ke waqt ghulam azaad karne ka hukum diya."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered the freeing of slaves when the sun eclipsed."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne suraj grahan ke waqt ghulam azaad karne ka hukum diya."

e: [AI] The sun eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he mentioned the event and said in it, "So when you see that, invoke Allah, pray, give charity, and free slaves."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein suraj ko grahan laga, phir hadith ka zikr kiya aur usme farmaya: "Jab tum yeh dekho to Allah se dua karo, namaz padho, sadqa do aur ghulam azaad karo."

e: That there was an eclipse of the sun and the Prophet of Allah ﷺ prayed two rak'ahs until it ended. Then he said: "The sun and the moon do not become eclipsed for the death of anyone, but they are two of His creations. Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, causes whatever He wants to happen in His creation. If Allah (SWT), the Mighty and Sublime, manifests Himself to any of His creation, it humbles itself before Him, so if either of them (solar or lunar eclipse) happens, pray until it is over or until Allah causes something to happen." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1487)
hi: Suraj ko grahan laga, to Nabi (SAW) ne do rak'atein padhi yahan tak ke (grahan) chhat gaya, phir farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balke yeh dono uski makhlooq mein se hain, aur Allah apni makhlooq mein jo chahe paida karta hai. Phir beshak Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala jab apni kisi makhlooq ke liye tajalli farmata hai to woh uske liye khushu' karti hai, isliye jab bhi inme se koi grahan-zada ho to namaz padho yahan tak ke woh chhat jaye ya Allah koi (aur) maamla paida kar de."

e: There was an eclipse of the sun in the time of the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet stood for a long time, accompanied by the people. He then bowed, then raised his head, then he bowed and then he raised his head, and again he bowed and prayed two rak'ahs of prayer. In each rak'ah he bowed three times. After bowing for the third time he prostrated himself. He stood for such a long time that some people became unconscious on that occasion and buckets of water had to be poured on them. When he bowed, he said, Allah is most great; and when he raised his head, he said, Allah listens to him who praises Him, till the sun became bright. then he said: The sun and the moon are not eclipsed on account of anyone's death or on account of anyone's birth, but they are two of Allah's signs, He produces dread in His servants by means of them. When they are eclipsed, hasten to prayer (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1177)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein suraj ko grahan laga, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne bohot lamba khada hokar logon ki imamat ki, phir ruku kiya, phir khade huay, phir ruku kiya, phir khade huay, phir ruku kiya - do rak'aton mein ruku kiya, har rak'at mein teen ruku, teesri martaba ruku kiya, phir sajda kiya, yahan tak ke us din kuch log itna khade rehne ki wajah se behosh ho gaye ke unpar paani ke bartan (dale) gaye. Jab ruku karte to farmate: "Allahu Akbar," aur jab sar uthate to farmate: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah," yahan tak ke suraj saaf ho gaya. Phir farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balke yeh dono Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyan hain jinse Allah apne bandon ko dara-ta hai, isliye jab inhein grahan lage to namaz ki taraf jaldi karo."

e: [AI] "The sun was eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the Prophet ﷺ  led them in prayer. He recited a long Surah, then performed five rak'ahs, and made two prostrations. Then he stood for the second time, recited from the same long Surah, and performed five rak'ahs again, followed by two prostrations. Then he sat facing the Qiblah, making supplications, until the eclipse was over. The two Shaykhs (Abu Bakr and Umar) may Allah be pleased with them, both narrated this hadith from Abu Ja'far al-Razi, and did not differ on its authenticity. His status among other scholars was the most honorable. This hadith contains words and its transmitters are trustworthy."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein suraj ko grahan laga, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unhein namaz padhayi, aap (SAW) ne lambi surahon mein se aik padhi, paanch (5) ruku kiye aur do sajde, phir doosri baar khade huay aur lambi surahon mein se padha, phir paanch (5) ruku kiye aur do sajde, phir Qibla ki taraf mun karke baithe huay dua karte rahe yahan tak ke grahan chhat gaya." Shaykhain ne Abu Ja'far Ar-Razi ko chhod diya hai aur unse riwayat nahi ki, halanke baaqi tamam a'imma ke nazdeek unka haal sabse achha hai, aur is hadith mein kuch alfaz hain, aur iske raawi sachche hain.

e: There was an eclipse of the sun in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He came out bewildered pulling his garment, and I was in his company at Medina. He prayed two rak'ahs and stood for a long time in them. He then departed and the sun became bright. He then said: There are the signs by means of which Allah, the Exalted, produces dread (in His servants). When you see anything of this nature, then pray as you are praying a fresh obligatory prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1185)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein suraj ko grahan laga, to aap (SAW) ghabraye huay apna kapda ghaseette huay nikle, aur main us din Madinah mein aap (SAW) ke sath tha, aap (SAW) ne do rak'atein padhi aur unme khade rehna bohot lamba kiya, phir wapas gaye aur (grahan) chhat chuka tha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Yeh sirf woh nishaaniyan hain jinse Allah dara-ta hai, jab tum inhein dekho,' ya'ni 'to namaz aise padho jaisi tumhari sabse taaza farz namaz thi.'"

e: There was an eclipse of the sun in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and led the people in prayer. he stood up and I guessed that he recited Surah al-Baqarah. The narrator then further transmitted the tradition. He (the Prophet) then prostrated himself twice, and then stood up and prolonged the recitation. then I guessed his recitation and knew that he recited Surah Al-i-Imran. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1187)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein suraj ko grahan laga, to Rasulullah (SAW) bahar nikle aur logon ki imamat ki. Unhone kaha: maine aap (SAW) ki qira'at ka andaaza lagaya, to humein laga ke aap (SAW) ne Surah Al-Baqarah padhi hai, phir aap (SAW) ne do sajde kiye, phir unhone kaha: aap (SAW) ne qira'at lambi ki, to maine aap (SAW) ki qira'at ka andaaza lagaya aur mujhe laga ke aap (SAW) ne Surah Aal-e-Imran padhi hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon on him) recited from teh Qur'an in a loud voice in the prayer at an eclipse. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1188)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne kusoof (grahan) ki namaz mein lambi qira'at ki, buland awaz se padhi."

e: Ubaydullah ibn an-Nadr reported on the authority of his father: Darkness prevailed in the time of Anas ibn Malik, I came to Anas and said (to him): AbuHamzah, did anything like this happen to you in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He replied: Take refuge in Allah. If the wind blew violently, we would run quickly towards the mosque for fear of the coming of the Day of Judgment. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1196)
hi: To main Anas bin Malik (RA) ke paas aaya aur poocha: "Aye Abu Hamzah, kya Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein tumhein bhi is jaisa (waqia) pesh aata tha?" Unhone kaha: "Maazallah, jab bhi tez hawa chalti to hum Qayamat ke khauf se masjid ki taraf jaldi karte the."

e: "The Prophet led us in prayer during an eclipse; we did not hear his voice." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 562)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne humein kusoof mein namaz padhayi, hum aap (SAW) ki awaz nahi sun rahe the."

e: [AI] "The sun eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he said, 'Verily, the sun and the moon are two signs from the signs of Allah. They do not eclipse because of the death or life of anyone. So when you see them, give charity, pray, glorify Allah, and supplicate to Him.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein suraj ko grahan laga, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyan hain, yeh kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, isliye jab tum inhein dekho to sadqa do, namaz padho, takbeer kaho aur Allah se dua karo."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  performed two units of prayer, similar to your prayer now, at the time of the solar and lunar eclipses. He did not delay it and may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and all of his companions."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne suraj aur chaand ke grahan mein do rak'atein padhin, tumhari isi namaz jaisi." Dono ne ise nahi nikala. Wa sallallahu ala Muhammadin wa aalihi ajma'in.

e: "We were with Sa'eed bin Al-'Asi in Tabaristan, and Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman was with us. He said: 'Which of you offered the fear prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?' Hudhaifah said: 'I did.' So Hudhaifah stood and the people formed two rows behind him, one row behind him and one row facing the enemy. He led those who were behind him in praying one rak'ah, then they went and took the place of the others, and the others came and he led them in praying one rak'ah, and they did not make it up." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1530)
hi: Hum Sa'eed bin Al-Aas ke sath Tabaristan mein thay, unhone poocha: "Tum mein se kisne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath khauf ki namaz padhi hai?" To Hudhaifah (RA) khade huay, "unhone logon ko apne peechhe do saffon mein khada kiya, aik saff dushman ke muqaabil, phir apne peechhe walon ko aik rak'at padhayi, phir yeh log wahan chale gaye jahan doosre thay, aur doosre aa gaye, to unhein bhi aik rak'at padhayi, aur unhone (baaqi) poori nahi ki."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed the prayer of fear with one who had gonorrhea, performing the prayer, bowing and prostrating, without making up any missed actions." This is a witness to the hadith that preceded it, and it is authentic in its chain of narration.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Dhi Qarad mein khauf ki namaz aik-aik rak'at padhi, aur unhone (baaqi) poori nahi ki." Yeh pichli hadith ka shahid hai, "aur iski sanad sahih hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, performed the prayer of fear with a group of his companions. He arranged them in rows and prayed alongside them, matching the movements of the enemy. Then they went towards the enemy, and the enemy came towards them, and they all prayed with the Prophet, peace be upon him, a unit of prayer. Then he greeted them."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Dhi Qarad mein khauf ki namaz padhi, apne peechhe saffein banayin, aik saff dushman ke muqaabil, phir unke sath aik rak'at padhi, phir woh doosri saff ki jagah gaye aur doosri saff yahan aa gayi, aur Nabi (SAW) ke sath aik rak'at padhi, phir aap (SAW) ne unpar salaam phera."

e: [AI] He asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about praying in a bow, so he said, "Pray in a bow and drop the horn."
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se kamaan (dhanush) mein namaz ke baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kamaan mein namaz padho aur teer-daan (qarn) ko utaar do."

e: [AI] Regarding the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on the prayer of fear, he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood with a group behind him, and another group behind the group that was behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stayed seated, all facing the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said the takbeer, then the two groups behind him also said the takbeer. He performed the first prostration, and they performed prostration with him while the others remained seated. Then he stood up and they stood up and moved behind him until they were in the position of their companions sitting, and the other group came forward and he prayed a Rak'ah and performed two prostrations, then he made the salaam and the others stayed seated. Then the two groups, one after the other, performed a Rak'ah and two prostrations each."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, khauf ki namaz ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay, aik giroh unke peechhe, aur aik giroh us giroh ke peechhe jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe tha, baithe huay, sab ke chehre Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf thay. Rasulullah (SAW) ne takbeer kahi, dono giroh ne takbeer kahi, phir aap (SAW) ne ruku kiya, to woh giroh jo aap (SAW) ke peechhe tha unke sath ruku kiya, aur doosre baithe rahe, phir aap (SAW) ne sajda kiya to unhone bhi sajda kiya, aur doosre baithe rahe, phir aap (SAW) khade huay to woh (bhi) khade huay aur unke peechhe hat gaye yahan tak ke woh apne sathiyon ki jagah baithe hue aa gaye, aur doosra giroh aa gaya, to aap (SAW) ne unhein aik rak'at aur do sajde padhaye, phir salaam phera jabke doosre baithe hue thay, phir doosron ne salaam phera. Phir dono giroh khade huay aur apne apne liye aik rak'at aur do sajde padhe, aik rak'at aur do sajde."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed the prayer of fear. He divided the people into two groups: one group stood behind him, and another group stood in front of him. When the enemy approached, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  raised his voice in takbir (saying Allahu Akbar), and the group that stood behind him also raised their voices in takbir. Then he bowed and they all bowed, prostrated and they all prostrated. Then he raised his head and they all raised their heads, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sat down while the others prostrated for themselves a second prostration. Then they stood up and proceeded towards the back until they were no longer behind him, and another group emerged and stood behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . They raised their voices in takbir, then bowed and prostrated for themselves. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed his second prostration, and they prostrated with him. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up in his prayer and they prostrated for themselves a second prostration. Finally, both groups stood together behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he performed a rak'ah (unit of prayer) with them, and they all bowed and prostrated. All of these actions were performed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  very swiftly, without any delay, to the best of his ability. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  gave the salam (Islamic greeting) and they also gave the salam. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up again, and the people followed him in all his prayers."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne khauf ki namaz padhi." Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne logon ko do hisson mein baant diya, aik giroh unke peechhe saff mein khada hua aur doosra giroh khada raha, aur dushman aa gaya. Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne takbeer kahi aur woh giroh jo unke peechhe saff mein khada tha unhone takbeer kahi, phir aap (SAW) ne ruku kiya aur unhone bhi ruku kiya, phir aap (SAW) ne sajda kiya to unhone bhi sajda kiya, phir aap (SAW) ne apna sar uthaya to unhone bhi uthaya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) baithe rahe aur unhone apne liye doosra sajda kiya, phir woh khade huay aur peeche hat gaye, ulti chaal chalte huay, yahan tak ke woh apne (sathiyon ke) peechhe khade ho gaye, aur doosra giroh aage badha aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe saff mein khada hua, unhone takbeer kahi, phir apne liye ruku kiya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne apna doosra sajda kiya, to unhone bhi aap (SAW) ke sath sajda kiya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) apni rak'at mein khade huay aur unhone apne liye doosra sajda kiya, phir dono giroh sath khade huay aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe saff mein khade ho gaye, to aap (SAW) ne unhein aik rak'at padhayi aur sab ne sath ruku kiya, phir sajda kiya to sab ne sath sajda kiya, phir aap (SAW) ne apna sar uthaya aur unhone bhi aap (SAW) ke sath uthaya, yeh sab Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf se bohot jaldi hua, jitna ho sake mukhtasar karne mein koi kami na chhodi, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne salaam phera to unhone bhi salaam phera, phir Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay, aur log apni poori namaz mein aap (SAW) ke sath shareek ho gaye the."

e: [AI] "I heard Abu Ali Al-Hafiz saying: The Prophet ﷺ  led the people in the prayer of fear, which is the Maghrib prayer, with three rak'ahs. Then, he left and the others came, and he led them in three rak'ahs."
hi: Maine Abu Ali Al-Hafiz ko kehte hue suna: "Nabi (SAW) ne logon ko khauf ki namaz mein Maghrib ki namaz teen rak'atein padhayi, phir wapas gaye aur doosre aaye, unhein bhi teen rak'atein padhayi."

e: We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Usfan, and Khalid ibn al-Walid was the chief of unbelievers. We offered the noon prayer. Thereupon, the unbelievers said: We suffered from negligence; we became careless. We should have attacked them while they were praying. Thereupon the verse was revealed, relating to the shortening of the prayer (in time of danger) between the noon and afternoon (prayer). When the time of the afternoon prayer came, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood facing the qiblah, and the unbelievers were standing in front of him. The people stood in a row behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and there was another row behind this row. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ bowed and all of them bowed. He then prostrated and also the row near him prostrated. The other people in the second row remained standing and stood guard over them. When they performed two prostrations and stood up, those who were behind them prostrated. The people in the front row near him then stepped backward taking the place of the people in the second row and the second row took the place of the first row. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then bowed and all of them bowed together. Then he and the row near him prostrated themselves. The other people in the second row remained standing and stood guard over them. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the row near him (i.e. the front row) were seated, the people in the second row behind them prostrated themselves. Then all of them were seated. (He (the Prophet) then uttered the salutation upon all of them. He prayed in his manner at Usfan as well as at the territory of Banu Sulaym. Abu Dawud said: This tradition has been narrated by Ayyub and Hisham from Abu al-Zubair on the authority of Jabir to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ. Similarly, this has been transmitted by Dawud b. Husain from 'Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas. This has also been reported by 'Abd al-Malik, from 'Ata' from Jabir in like manner. This has also been narrated by Qatadah from al-Hasan from Hittan on the authority of Abu Musa in a similar way. Similarly, this has been reported by 'Ikrimah b. Khalid from Mujahid from the Prophet ﷺ. This has also been reported by Hisham b. 'Urwah from his father from the Prophet ﷺ. This is the opinion of al-Thawri. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1236)
hi: Hum Usfan mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath thay, aur mushrikeen par Khalid bin Al-Walid ka sardaraana tha, humne Zuhr ki namaz padhi, to mushrikeen ne kaha: "Humne aik moqa haasil kar liya tha, humne aik ghaflat paayi thi, kaash hum unpar hamla karte jabke woh namaz mein hote," to Qasr (qasar/mukhtasar) ki ayat Zuhr aur Asr ke darmiyan nazil hui. Jab Asr ka waqt aaya to Rasulullah (SAW) Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh hokar khade huay, aur mushrikeen aap (SAW) ke saamne thay, to Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe aik saff khadi hui, aur us saff ke baad aik doosri saff khadi hui. Rasulullah (SAW) ne ruku kiya to sab ne ruku kiya, phir aap (SAW) ne sajda kiya to unke qareeb wali saff ne sajda kiya, aur doosre khade rahe unki hifazat karte huay. Jab in logon ne do sajde kar liye aur khade ho gaye, to woh doosre log jo unke peechhe thay sajda karne lage, phir woh saff jo qareeb thi peeche hatkar doosron ki jagah aa gayi aur sab ne ruku kiya, phir woh saff jo qareeb thi sajda karne lagi aur doosre khade rahe unki hifazat karte huay. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke qareeb wali saff baith gaye, to doosre bhi sajda karne lage, phir sab sath baith gaye, to aap (SAW) ne unpar salaam phera. Aap (SAW) ne yeh namaz Usfan mein padhi aur Banu Sulaim ke din bhi isi tarah padhi.

e: Did you pray in time of danger with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? AbuHurayrah replied: Yes. Marwan then asked: When? AbuHurayrah said: On the occasion of the Battle of Najd. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up to offer the afternoon prayer. One section stood with him (to pray) and the other was standing before the enemy, and their backs were towards the qiblah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ uttered the takbir and all of them too uttered the takbir, i.e. those who were with him and those who were facing the enemy. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered one rak'ah and the section that was with him also prayed one rak'ah. He then prostrated himself and those who were with him also prostrated, while the other section was standing before the enemy. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then stood up and the section with him also stood up. They went and faced the enemy and the section that was previously facing the enemy stepped forward. They bowed and prostrated while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was standing in the same position. Then they stood up and the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon) prayed another rak'ah and all of them bowed and prostrated along with him. After that the section that was standing before the enemy came forward and they bowed and prostrated, while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained seated and also those who were with him. The salutation then followed. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ uttered the salutation and all of them uttered it together. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed two rak'ahs and each of the two sections prayed one rak'ah with him (and the other by themselves). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1240)
hi: Unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se poocha: "Kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath khauf ki namaz padhi hai?" Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Ji haan." Marwan ne poocha: "Kab?" To Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Ghazwa Najd ke saal, Rasulullah (SAW) Asr ki namaz ke liye khade huay, aik giroh unke sath khada hua aur doosra giroh dushman ke muqaabil, unki peethein Qibla ki taraf thin. Rasulullah (SAW) ne takbeer kahi aur sab ne takbeer kahi, jo aap (SAW) ke sath the aur jo dushman ke muqaabil the. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik rak'at ruku kiya aur unke peechhe wali saff ne (bhi) ruku kiya, phir aap (SAW) ne sajda kiya to unke qareeb wali saff ne sajda kiya aur doosre dushman ke muqaabil khade rahe. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay aur unke sath wali saff khadi hui aur dushman ki taraf chali gayi aur unka saamna kiya, aur woh saff jo dushman ke muqaabil thi aage aayi, ruku kiya aur sajda kiya jabke Rasulullah (SAW) apni jagah khade rahe, phir woh khade huay to Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik aur rak'at ruku kiya aur unhone bhi aap (SAW) ke sath ruku kiya aur sajda kiya. Phir woh saff jo dushman ke muqaabil thi aage aayi, ruku kiya aur sajda kiya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) baithe huay the aur jo unke sath the (bhi baithe huay the). Phir salaam ka waqt aaya to Rasulullah (SAW) ne salaam phera aur sab ne salaam phera. To Rasulullah (SAW) ke do rak'atein hui, aur har giroh ke har shakhs ki aik-aik rak'at hui."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered upon them and 'Abbas, the uncle of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , was complaining, so 'Abbas wished for death. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "O uncle, do not wish for death, for if you are good, then if it is delayed, you will increase in goodness towards your goodness. And if you are evil, then if it is delayed, you will be blamed for your wrongdoing, and it is better for you to not wish for death."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas dakhil huay jabke Abbas (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke chacha, bimaar the aur shikayat kar rahe the, to Abbas (RA) ne maut ki tamanna ki. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye chacha, maut ki tamanna na karo, kyunke agar tum nek ho to (zindagi) mo'akhkhar hone se tumhari neki mein aur izafa hoga, jo tumhare liye behtar hai, aur agar tum bura ho to (zindagi) mo'akhkhar hone se tumhein apni buraai se tauba karne ka moqa milega, jo tumhare liye behtar hai, isliye maut ki tamanna na karo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Shall I not inform you about your best among you from your worst?" They said, "Yes." He said, "The best of you are those with long lives and the best in their deeds."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein tumhare behtareen logon ki tumhare bad-tareen logon se khabar na dun?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare behtareen log woh hain jinki umrein sabse lambi aur amal sabse achhe hon."

e: "O Messenger of Allah! Which of the people is the best?" He said: "He whose life is long and his deeds are good." He said: "Then which of the people is the worst?" He said: "He whose life is long and his deeds are bad." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2330)
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), logon mein sabse behtar kaun hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiski umar lambi ho aur amal achha ho." Unhone poocha: "Aur logon mein sabse bura kaun hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiski umar lambi ho aur amal bura ho."

e: "When Allah wants good for a slave, He puts him in action." It was said: "How does he put him in action O Messenger Of Allah?" He said: "By making him meet up with the righteous deeds before death." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2142)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah kisi bande ke liye khair chahta hai, to use (nek kaam mein) laga deta hai." Poocha gaya: "Woh use kaise lagata hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maut se pehle use nek amal ki taufeeq deta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When Allah loves a servant, He grants him success. The companion asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, what does He grant him success on?' He replied, 'He grants him success in performing good deeds in the period of time before his death, so that his neighbors or those around him are pleased with him.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah kisi bande se mohabbat karta hai to use 'asal' (shahad) deta hai." Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), uska 'asal' kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uski maut se pehle use nek amal ki taufeeq deta hai, yahan tak ke uske padosi usse raazi ho jaayen," ya farmaya: "uske aas-paas wale."

e: I heard Allah's Apostle ﷺ as saying. Every servant would be raised (in the same very state) in which he dies. (Using translation from Muslim 2878a)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Har bande ko usi haal mein uthaya jayega jisme woh mara."

e: When the time of his death came, he called for new clothes and put on them. He then said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: A deceased will be raised in the clothes in which he died. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3114)
hi: Jab unki maut ka waqt aaya to unhone naye kapde mangwaye aur unhein pehna, phir kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak mayyat ko usi kapde mein uthaya jata hai jisme woh marta hai."

e: I heard the Prophet ﷺ many times say: When a servant of Allah is accustomed to do a good work, then becomes ill or goes on journey, what was accustomed to do when he was well and staying at home will be recorded for him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3091)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko aik nahi do martaba nahi, balke kayi martaba yeh farmate suna: "Jab banda koi nek amal karta ho, phir bimari ya safar usse rok de, to uske liye woh usi tarah likha jata hai jaisa woh tandurust aur muqeem hokar karta tha."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out to visit 'Abd Allah b. Ubayy during his illness of which he died. When he entered upon him, he realised death on him. He said: I used to forbid you from the love of Jews. He ('Abd Allah) said: As'ad b. Zurarah hated them. So what (the benefited) ? When he died, his son came and said: Prophet of Allah, 'Abd Allah b. Ubayy has died, give me your shirt, so that I shroud him in it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took off his shirt and gave it to him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3094)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Abdullah bin Ubayy ki bimaari mein unki tibbi-ayaadat (mizaj-purssi) ke liye nikle, jis bimaari mein unka intiqal hua. Jab aap (SAW) unke paas dakhil huay to unme maut ke asaraat pehchaan liye, farmaya: "Main tumhein Yahood se mohabbat karne se mana kiya karta tha." Usne kaha: "Sa'd bin Zurarah bhi unse nafrat karte the, to iska kya fayda?" Jab woh mar gaya to uska beta aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Abdullah bin Ubayy ka intiqal ho gaya hai, mujhe apni qamees dijiye taake main use isi mein kafnaun." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni qamees utaari aur use de di.

e: The Prophet ﷺ would visit me (during my illness) riding neither a mule nor a pony. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3096)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) meri tibbi-ayaadat ke liye aate the, na khachar par sawaar hokar aur na tattoo (ghode ki chhoti nasl) par."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Whenever a person visits a sick person in the evening, seventy thousand angels go out with him and seek forgiveness for him until morning. He will also have a garden (i.e., a reward) in Paradise. And whoever visits a sick person in the morning, seventy thousand angels go out with him and seek forgiveness for him until evening. He will also have a garden (i.e., a reward) in Paradise." This hadith has a valid chain of narrators according to the conditions set by the two sheikhs (i.e., Bukhari and Muslim), but they did not include it in their collections as a group of narrators did not include it due to the statement of Al-Hakam bin 'Utaybah and Mansur bin Al-Mu'tamir and their narrations from Ibn Abi Layla from Ali. However, I believe in the authenticity of the additional narrator.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi shaam ko kisi mareez ki ayaadat (bimar-purssi) ke liye jata hai, uske sath sattar hazaar (70,000) farishte nikalte hain jo subah tak uske liye maghfirat maangte hain, aur uske liye Jannat mein aik khareef (phal ka bagh) hota hai, aur jo koi subah ko usse aata hai, uske sath sattar hazaar farishte nikalte hain jo shaam tak uske liye maghfirat maangte hain, aur uske liye Jannat mein aik khareef hota hai." Yeh isnad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar dono ne ise isliye nahi nikaala ke raawiyon ki aik jama'at ne ise Al-Hakam bin Utaibah aur Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir se, Ibn Abi Laila se, Ali (RA) par mauqoof riwayat kiya hai, Shu'bah ki hadith se, aur main ziyaadati bayan karne wale raawi ke baare mein apne usool par houn.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited me while I was suffering from pain in my eyes. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3102)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne meri ayaadat ki jab mujhe apni aankhon mein takleef thi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, returned with Zaid ibn Arqam from Ramad.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zaid bin Arqam (RA) ki ayaadat ki jab unhein aankh ki soojan (ramad) thi."

e: That her father said: I had a complaint at Mecca. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to pay a sick-visit to me. He put his hand on my forehead, wiped my chest and belly, and then said: O Allah! heal up Sa'd and complete his immigration. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3104)
hi: Unke waalid ne kaha: "Mujhe Makkah mein bimari lagi, to Rasulullah (SAW) meri ayaadat ke liye aaye, apna haath meri peshani par rakha, phir mera seena aur pet masah kiya," phir farmaya: "Aye Allah, Sa'd ko shifa de aur unki hijrat mukammal kar."

e: A similar tradition has also been transmitted by Ibn 'Abbas through a different chain of narrators. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2127)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever visits his Muslim brother and sits by his head, then says seven times, 'I ask Allah, the Great, the Lord of the Great Throne, to cure you of your illness, if it is not his appointed time (to die),' Allah will cure him of his illness if it is not his appointed time."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apne Musalman bhai ki ayaadat kare aur uske sar ke paas baithe, phir yeh kahe saat martaba: 'As'alullahal-Azeem, Rabbal-Arshil-Azeem, an yashfiyak' (Main Azeem Allah se, Arsh-e-Azeem ke Rab se, sawaal karta hoon ke woh tumhein shifa de), to Allah use shifa deta hai agar uska waqt (maut ka) nahi aaya hota."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Any Muslim who visits his brother and enters upon him, but does not reach his appointed time, should say, 'I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the great Throne, to heal so-and-so from his illness seven times, except that Allah will heal him from it.' This is one of the invocations that cannot be rejected. For indeed, Al-Hajjaj bin Artah is more reliable than 'Abd al-Rabb bin Sa'id and Abu Khalid ad-Dalani in terms of memorization and precision. If the narration of 'Abdullah bin Al-Harith is proven true from this narration, then it is a witness for Sa'id bin Jubayr."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Musalman kisi bhai ki ayaadat na kare aur uske paas jaye jabke uska waqt (maut ka) na aaya ho, phir kahe: 'As'alullahal-Azeem, Rabbal-Arshil-Azeem, an yashfiya fulanan min maradihi' (Main Azeem Allah se, Arsh-e-Azeem ke Rab se, sawaal karta hoon ke woh fulan ko uski bimari se shifa de), saat martaba, magar Allah use usse shifa de deta hai."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi narrated from Malik, from Yazid ibn Khusayifah, that Abu al-Fadl Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Muzakki reported to us, narrating from Ahmad ibn Salamah, from Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from Yazid ibn Khusayifah, from 'Amr ibn 'Abdullah ibn Ka'b al-Sulami, that Nafi' ibn Jubayr informed him that 'Uthman ibn Abi al-'As came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while suffering from severe pain that was about to weaken him. He mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who claimed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Place your right hand on the area where you feel pain and wipe it seven times, and say, 'I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil that I feel in every wipe.'"
hi: Uthman bin Abi Al-Aas (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat mein aaye jabke unhein aisi takleef thi jo unhein taqreeban be-kaar kar rahi thi, unhone yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apna dayan haath us jagah rakho jahan takleef hai, aur usse saat martaba masah karo, aur (har masah ke sath) kaho: 'A'oozu bi Izzatillahi wa Qudratihi min sharri ma ajid' (Main Allah ki izzat aur uski qudrat ki panah maangta hoon us buraai se jo main mehsoos kar raha hoon)."

e: [AI] Two men sought a cure for urinary ailments, so they went to Abu Darda. They mentioned their ailments to him, and he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say, 'If any one of you complains of anything, or his brother complains about something, let him say, 'Our Lord is Allah Who is in heaven, holy is Your name. Your command comes from heaven and earth, as Your mercy is in heaven, so make Your mercy in the earth. Forgive us our sins and our transgressions. Surely, You are the Lord of good people, so send down mercy from Your mercy, and healing from Your healing, and cure this illness, if it is Your will, Most High.' The two sheikhs, other than Ziyad ibn Muhammad, have confirmed the authenticity of this Hadith with all its narrators. Ziyad ibn Muhammad is a sheikh from the people of Egypt who narrates few Hadiths."
