hi: Do aadmi ilaaj ki talaash mein aaye kyunke unhein paishab ki (koi) bimari thi, unhein Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ke paas le jaya gaya, unhone apne khusiyon ke dard ka zikr kiya, to unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo koi tum mein se kisi cheez ki shikayat kare, ya uska koi bhai (kisi cheez ki) shikayat kare, to woh kahe: 'Rabbana Allahu-lladhi fis-sama'i, taqaddasa ismuka, amruka fis-sama'i wal-ard, kama rahmatuka fis-sama'i faj'al rahmataka fil-ard, waghfir lana dhunubana wa khatayana, innaka Rabbut-Tayyibeen, fa anzil rahmatan min rahmatika wa shifa'an min shifa'ika ala hazal-waja'' (Humara Rab Allah hai jo aasman mein hai, tera naam pak hai, tera hukum aasman aur zameen mein hai, jaise teri rahmat aasman mein hai, waise apni rahmat zameen mein bhi ata kar, aur humein humare gunah aur khataayen maaf kar de, beshak tu paak logon ka Rab hai, isliye apni rahmat mein se rahmat aur apni shifa mein se shifa is takleef par naazil kar), to Allah ki ijaazat se woh theek ho jayega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When any of you visit a sick person, let him say: 'O Allah, heal Your servant who has become ill. He either raises enemies against You or goes to perform prayer for You.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi kisi mareez ki ayaadat kare, to kahe: 'Allahummashfi abdaka, yanka'u laka aduwwan aw yamshi laka ila salah' (Aye Allah, apne bande ko shifa de, taake woh tere dushman ko takleef pahunchaye ya tere liye namaz ki taraf chale)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, a person attains a high rank with Allah through their actions. And as long as they continue to reach that rank through their actions, Allah will continue to test them with things they dislike until they reach it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak kisi aadmi ke liye Allah ke haan aik martaba hoti hai jispar woh apne amal se nahi pahunch pata, to Allah usse mubtala karta rehta hai jo use napasand hota hai, yahan tak ke usse woh martaba pahuncha deta hai."

e: [AI] From the Prophet (pbuh), he said, when Adam ﷺ  was about to die, he said to his sons, "Go and gather for me fruits from Paradise." So, his sons went out and the angels met them and asked, "Where are you going, O sons of Adam?" They replied, "Our father sent us to bring fruits from Paradise for him." The angels said, "Return, for you have been deceived." So, they went back along with the angels until they entered upon Adam. When Eve saw them, she became afraid of them and clung to Adam. Adam said to her, "Get away from me! You were the cause of this." By your fault, my Lord's angels have left me. The angels then took his soul and washed, enshrouded, and prayed over it. Then, they dug a grave for him, buried him, and said, "O sons of Adam, this is the tradition regarding the death of your father. So, do likewise.”
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: jab Adam (AS) ki maut haazir hui, to unhone apne beton se kaha: "Jao aur mere liye Jannat ke phalon mein se kuch chun kar lao." Unhone kaha: to unke bete nikle, farishtay unse mile aur poocha: "Kahan ja rahe ho, aye Adam ke beto?" Unhone kaha: "Humare waalid ne humein bheja hai ke hum unke liye Jannat ke phalon mein se kuch chun laayen." Unhone kaha: "Wapas jao, tumhein iski zaroorat nahi rahi." Unhone kaha: to woh unke sath wapas aaye, yahan tak ke Adam (AS) ke paas dakhil huay. Jab Hawwa ne unhein dekha to woh unse dar gayi aur Adam (AS) ke qareeb hoti gayi, unse chipatne lagi. Adam (AS) ne unse kaha: "Mujh se door ho jao, mujh se door ho jao, tumhari hi taraf se yeh (musibat) mujhpar aayi hai, mujhe aur mere Rab ke farishton ko chhod do." Unhone kaha: to unhone unki rooh qabz ki, phir unhein ghusl diya, hunoot lagayi aur kafnaya, phir unpar namaz padhi, phir unke liye qabar khodi, phir unhein dafnaya, phir kaha: "Aye Adam ke beto, yeh tumhari Sunnat hai apne murdon ke liye, isliye tum bhi isi tarah karo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Adam was a tall man." He mentioned a long hadith, in which he said at the end, "Leave a gap between me and the messengers of my Lord, for indeed you have brought this to me." So they took his soul, washed it with water and sidr (a type of herb) three times, shrouded it, prayed for him, and buried him. Then they said, "This is the Sunnah (way) for your children after you." This does not explain the hadith of Yunus ibn Ubaid, for he is more knowledgeable about the hadith of Al-Hasan from the people of Madinah and Egypt, and Allah knows best.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Adam (AS) lambe qad ke aadmi thay," phir aik lambi hadith zikr ki, aur uske aakhir mein unhone kaha: "Mujhe aur mere Rab ke rasoolon ko chhod do, tumne hi to mujhpar yeh (museebat) laayi hai," to unhone unki jaan qabz ki, unhein paani aur beri ke pattay se teen martaba ghusl diya, kafnaya, unpar namaz padhi aur unhein dafnaya, phir kaha: "Yeh tumhare baad tumhari aulad ki Sunnat hai." Yeh Yunus bin Ubaid ki hadith ko kamzor nahi karta, kyunke woh Al-Hasan ki hadith ko Madinah aur Misr walon se zyada jaante hain, wallahu a'lam.

e: “Be of good cheer, for Allah says: ‘It is My fire which I have causes to overwhelm My believing slave in this world, to be his share of the Fire in the Hereafter.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3470)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik mareez ki ayaadat ki jise bukhaar tha, unke sath Abu Hurairah (RA) bhi thay, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khush ho jao, kyunke Allah farmata hai: yeh meri aag hai jo main duniya mein apne momin bande par musallat karta hoon, taake yeh aakhirat mein aag ka uska hissa ban jaye."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  suffered from a headache, so he kept turning on his bed. So I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, if one of us did this, we would fear that it would have consequences for him.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Verily, a believer is tried and indeed, no affliction or illness befalls him except that Allah expiates his sins and raises him in rank.'"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko raat ko takleef hui aur woh apne bistar par karvatein badalne lage," to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar hum mein se koi aisa karta to hume darr hota ke aap use bura samjhengay." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak momin par sakhti ki jaati hai, aur koi momin nahi jisse koi museebat ya takleef pahunchti ho magar Allah uski wajah se uska aik gunah mita deta hai aur uska darja buland karta hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, returned to a woman from the Ansar and said to her, 'Are you Umm Miladam?' She replied, 'Yes.' Allah cursed her, so the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'Do not curse her, for she washes away the sins of the servant just as the Kir (strong alkaline substance) removes impurities from iron.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ansar ki aik aurat ki ayaadat ki, unse poocha: "Kya tumhein 'Umm Miladam' (bukhaar) hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Allah isse la'nat kare." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse gaali mat do, kyunke yeh bande ke gunah aise dho deti hai jaise bhatti loha ki gandagi door karti hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ was affected by a fever, so she sought his permission and said, "Who are you?" She replied, "I am Umm Miladim." He asked, "Are you heading towards the people of Quba?" She replied, "Yes." He said, "Go to them, for the fever is a form of purification."
hi: Bukhaar Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur ijaazat maangi, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum kaun ho?" Usne kaha: "Main 'Umm Miladam' hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum Quba walon ki taraf hadiya (bheji jaane wali) ho?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unke paas jao." To unhein bukhaar chadh gaya aur unhein isse sakht takleef pahunchi, unhone Nabi (SAW) se shikayat ki aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein bukhaar se kya museebat pesh aayi hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum chaho to main Allah se dua karta hoon ke woh ise tumse hata de, aur agar tum chaho to yeh tumhare liye paakizgi ban jaye."

e: "Trials will not cease afflicting the believing man and the believing woman in their self, children, and wealth, until they meet Allah without having any sin." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2399)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Museebat momin par uski jaan, maal aur aulad mein aati rehti hai, yahan tak ke woh Allah se milta hai aur uspar koi gunah baaqi nahi rehta."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The morning prayer at its prescribed time expiates for sins committed between it and the previous evening prayer."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Momin ki takleef (bimari ki thakaan) uske gunahon ka kaffara hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a bedouin, "Has your mother ever experienced the pain of childbirth?" He asked, "What is the pain of childbirth?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "It is a burning sensation between the skin and the flesh." He said, "I have never experienced this before." The Prophet ﷺ then asked, "Have you ever experienced a headache?" He asked, "What is a headache?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "It is a vein that strikes a person in their head." He said, "I have never experienced this before." When the bedouin turned away, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever is pleased to look at a man from the people of Hell, let them look at this person."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik dehati se poocha: "Kya tumhein kabhi 'Umm Miladam' (bukhaar) laga hai?" Usne poocha: "'Umm Miladam' kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khaal aur gosht ke darmiyan garmi (jalan)." Usne kaha: "Mujhe yeh kabhi mehsoos nahi hui." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein kabhi sirdard hua hai?" Usne poocha: "Sirdard kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik rag jo insaan ke sar mein dhadakti hai." Usne kaha: "Mujhe yeh kabhi mehsoos nahi hui." Jab woh chala gaya to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise khushi ho ke woh Jahannami logon mein se kisi aadmi ko dekhe, to woh isse dekh le."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Whenever a believer is afflicted with a hardship, Allah removes from him a sin and writes for him a good deed, and elevates him in rank."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Momin ki koi rag nahi dhadakti magar Allah usse aik gunah mita deta hai, aik neki likh deta hai, aur uska darja buland karta hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "There is nothing that afflicts a believer in his body, except that it expiates from his sins."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Momin ke jism ko koi cheez takleef nahi pahunchati magar woh uski buraaiyon ka kaffara ban jati hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Indeed, Allah tests His servant with illness until it expiates all his sins."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Allah apne bande ko bimari se azmata hai yahan tak ke woh uske har gunah ka kaffara ban jati hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "No Muslim is afflicted with a calamity in his body except that Allah commands the keepers of the night and day to write for my servant good deeds equal to what he used to do as long as he remains imprisoned in his affliction."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Musalman jisme koi jismani museebat aaye, magar Allah un mohaafizon (hifazat karne wale farishton) ko jo uski hifazat karte hain hukum deta hai: 'Mere bande ke liye har din aur raat woh neki likho jo woh (pehle) amal karta tha, jab tak woh meri qaid (bimari) mein mehsoos hai.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the example of a believing servant when he is afflicted with hardship or fever is like that of a piece of iron that is put into the fire, its impurities are removed, and what remains is its purity."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin bande ki misaal, jab usse bukhaar ya bimari pahunchti hai, us loha jaisi hai jo aag mein daala jaye, uski gandagi nikal jati hai aur uski achhai baaqi reh jati hai."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ  saying, "Indeed, Allah said: 'O Jesus, I will make you die and raise you to Myself and purify you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ. And as for those who disbelieve, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.'" (Quran 3:55)
hi: Maine Abul-Qasim (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: Beshak Allah ne farmaya: "Aye Isa, main tumhare baad aik Ummat khada karne wala hoon, agar unhein woh cheez pahunche jo unhein pasand ho to woh Allah ki hamd karengay, aur agar unhein woh cheez pahunche jo unhein napasand ho to woh sawab ki ummeed rakhte huay sabr karengay, halanke unke paas na (poora) hilm hoga na (poora) ilm." Unhone (Isa AS ne) poocha: "Aye Rab, yeh unke liye kaise hoga jabke unke paas na hilm hai na ilm?" Farmaya: "Main unhein apne hilm aur apne ilm mein se ata karunga."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: Allah, the Most High, said: When I afflict My believing servant and he does not complain to anyone but Me, I release him from the bondage of his affliction and exchange it for better flesh than his own and better blood than his own. Then he resumes his work.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Jab main apne momin bande ko azmata hoon aur woh mujhse mera shikwa uske ayaadat karne walon se nahi karta, to main use uski qaid se azaad kar deta hoon, phir uske gosht ki jagah usse behtar gosht aur khoon ki jagah usse behtar khoon deta hoon, phir woh naye sire se amal shuru karta hai."

e: [AI] A woman who was a sinner in the pre-Islamic era passed by a man or the man passed by her, and he stretched out his hand towards her. She said, "What? Indeed, Allah has eliminated polytheism and brought Islam. So he left her and turned away. He kept looking at her until he hit his face on the wall. He then came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned this to him, so the Prophet said, "You are a servant of Allah who Allah intends good for. Indeed, Allah, blessed and exalted, when He intends good for a servant, He hastens the punishment for his sin so that it is fulfilled for him on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Aik aurat jahiliyat mein badkaar thi, aik shakhs uske paas se guzra - ya woh uske paas se guzri - usne apna haath uski taraf badhaya, to usne kaha: "Ruk jao, Allah ne shirk ko khatam kar diya hai aur Islam le aaya hai." To usne use chhod diya aur mudkar chala, aur usse dekhta raha yahan tak ke uska chehra deewar se takra gaya. Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur yeh baat unse zikr ki, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum aik aisa bandah ho jiske liye Allah ne khair chaha hai, beshak Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala jab kisi bande ke liye khair chahta hai, to uske gunah ki saza jaldi de deta hai, yahan tak ke Qayamat ke din woh (paak) mil jaye."

e: “The Muslim has four things due from the Muslim: He should answer [by saying Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you)] to him if he sneezes (and says Al-Hamdulillah); he should accept his invitation if he invites him; he should attend his funeral if he dies; and he should visit him if he falls sick.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1434)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman ka Musalman par chaar haq hain: jab woh bulaaye to uski dawat qubool kare, jab bimar ho to uski ayaadat kare, jab chheenke to usse dua de, aur jab mar jaye to uske janaze mein shareek ho."

e: Abu Moosa came to al-Hasan bin ʿAli to visit him when he was sick. ʿAli ؓ said: Have you come to visit him or to gloat? He said: No. I have come to visit him because he is sick. ʿAli ؓ said to him: Since you have come to visit him because he is sick, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “If a man visits his Muslim brother when he is sick, he is walking amongst the fruits of Paradise until he sits down, and when he sits down he is covered with mercy. If it is morning, seventy thousand angels will send blessings upon him until evening, and if it is evening, seventy thousand angels will send blessings upon him until morning.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 612)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unse poocha: "Kya tum ayaadat karne aaye ho ya taana-zani karne?" Unhone kaha: "Balke ayaadat karne aaya hoon." To Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Agar tum ayaadat karne aaye ho, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Jo apne bhai ki ayaadat ke liye aata hai, woh Jannat ke phalon mein (chal raha) hota hai, jab woh baithta hai to rahmat use dhaank leti hai, agar subah ho to sattar hazaar (70,000) farishte shaam tak uspar durood bhejte hain, aur agar shaam ho to sattar hazaar farishte subah tak uspar durood bhejte hain.'"

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "No Muslim visits a sick person except that seventy thousand angels accompany him until evening, and he will have a garden (of paradise) as recompense. If he visits him in the evening, seventy thousand angels will accompany him until morning, and he will have a garden (of paradise) as recompense." This is the type I have mentioned more than once that does not require condition. For Abu Mu'awiyah is more knowledgeable about the people of A'amash, and A'amash is more knowledgeable about the hadith of Al-Hakam than others.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Koi Musalman kisi mareez ki ayaadat nahi karta magar uske sath sattar hazaar (70,000) farishte nikalte hain jo shaam tak, agar subah ho, uske sath rehte hain, aur uske liye Jannat mein aik khareef hota hai, aur agar shaam ho to sattar hazaar farishte subah tak uske sath rehte hain, aur uske liye Jannat mein aik khareef hota hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever visits a sick person, he continues to be enshrouded in mercy until he sits down. Then, when he sits down, he is submerged in it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi mareez ki ayaadat kare, woh rahmat mein doobta rehta hai yahan tak ke baith jaye, jab baith jaye to usme doob jata hai."

e: “Do not force your sick ones to eat or drink. Allah will feed them and give them to drink.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3444)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne mareezon ko khana khane par majboor na karo, kyunke Allah unhein khilata aur pilata hai."

e: “What is the matter with you, O Abu Muhammad? Perhaps you are upset about your cousin being appointed as caliph?” [referring to Abu Bakrؓ ]. He said: “No.” And he spoke highly of Abu Bakr ؓ , [then he said:] “But I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ʿ[There is] a word which no one says when he is dying but Allah will relieve him of distress and his colour will brighten.” Nothing prevented me from asking him about it except the fear of not being able to comply with it and I did not ask him about it until he died.” ‘Umar said to him: “I know what it is.” Talhah said to him: “What is it?ʿ ‘Umar said: “Do you know any word that is greater than the word he enjoined his uncle to say when he was dying, ‘La ilaha illallah’?” Talhah said: “You are right. By Allah, that is what it is.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1386)
hi: "Nahi," aur unhone Abu Bakr (RA) ki tareef ki, "lekin maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: 'Aik kalima hai jise koi bandah apni maut ke waqt kahe magar Allah uski museebat door kar deta hai aur uska rang chamak jata hai,' to mujhe usse poochne se sirf isi cheez ne roka ke main isse pura kar sakunga ya nahi, yahan tak ke woh (Abu Bakr RA) intiqal kar gaye." To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe yeh maloom hai." Talhah (RA) ne unse poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Umar (RA) ne unse kaha: "Kya tumhein koi aisa kalima maloom hai jo us kalime se azeem ho jiska Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne chacha ko hukum diya tha: La ilaha illallah?" Talhah (RA) ne unse kaha: "Yehi hai, Allah ki qasam, yehi hai."

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ʿI know a word which no one says, sincerely from the heart, but he will be forbidden to the Fire.” ʿUmar bin al-Khattab ؓ said to him: I will tell you what it is: it is the word of al-ikhlas by means of which Allah, may He be blessed and exalted, caused Muhammad ﷺ and his companions to prevail and it is the word of taqwa that the Prophet ﷺ of Allah urged his uncle Abu Talib to say when he was dying, the testimony that there is no god but Allah. (Using translation from Aḥmad 447)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Main aik kalima jaanta hoon jise koi bandah dil se sacha bolkar mar jaye magar woh aag par haram ho jata hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) wafat paa gaye aur humein woh nahi bata gaye. Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Main tumhein woh bata deta hoon, woh kalima-e-ikhlaas hai jiska hukum Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne chacha Abu Talib ko maut ke waqt diya tha: gawahi dena ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur yehi woh kalima hai jiske zariye Allah ne Muhammad (SAW) aur unke sahaba (RA) ko izzat di."

e: [AI] Abu Asim al-Nabeel narrated that Abdul Hamid ibn Ja'far narrated from Saleh ibn Abi Ariba from Kathir ibn Murrah from Muadh ibn Jabal who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever's last words are 'There is no god but Allah' shall enter Paradise."
hi: Muadh bin Jabal (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiska aakhri kalaam 'La ilaha illallah' ho, woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to visit Abdullah ibn Thabit who was ill. He found that he was dominated (by the divine decree). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ called him loudly, but he did not respond. He uttered the Qur'anic verse "We belong to Allah and to Him do we return" and he said: We have been dominated against you, AburRabi'. Then the women cried and wept, and Ibn Atik began to silence them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Leave them, when the divine decree is made, no woman should weep. They (the people) asked: What is necessary happening, Messenger of Allah? He replied: Death. His daughter said: I hope you will be a martyr, for you have completed your preparations for jihad. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah Most High gave him a reward according to his intentions. What do you consider martyrdom? They said: Being killed in the cause of Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There are seven types of martyrdom in addition to being killed in Allah's cause: one who dies of plague is a martyr; one who is drowned is a martyr; one who dies of pleurisy is a martyr; one who dies of an internal complaint is a martyr; one who is burnt to death is a martyr; who one is killed by a building falling on him is a martyr; and a woman who dies while pregnant is a martyr. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3111)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Abdullah bin Thabit (RA) ki ayaadat ke liye aaye, unhein pareshan haal paaya, unhein pukaara magar unhone jawaab nahi diya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne "Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon" padha aur farmaya: "Aye Abu Ar-Rabi', hum tumhare aage majboor ho gaye." Auratein cheekhne aur rone lagin, to Ibn Atik unhein khamosh karane laga, lekin Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein rehne do, jab (maut) wajib ho jaye to koi rone wali na roye." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), wujoob kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab woh mar jaye." To unki beti ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe ummeed thi ke aap shaheed hongay, kyunke aap apna saaman (jihad ke liye) taiyyar kar chuke thay." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne uska ajr uski niyat ke mutabiq muqarrar kar diya hai, aur tum shahadat kise samajhte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki raah mein qatl hona." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shahadat Allah ki raah mein qatl ke ilawa saat (7) aur (soorat) hain: taa'oon (waba) se marne wala shaheed hai, doobkar marne wala shaheed hai, zaat-ul-janb (phephdon ki bimari) se marne wala shaheed hai, pait ki bimari se marne wala shaheed hai, aag mein jalne wala shaheed hai, imarat ke gir jane se marne wala shaheed hai, aur aurat jo (bacha janam dete waqt) fout ho jaye woh shaheed hai."

e: “When you come to your dead ones, close their eyes, for the sight follows the soul. And say good things, for the Angels say Amin to what the members of the household say.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1455)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mayyat ke paas hazir ho to aankhein band kar do, kyunke nazar rooh ke peechhe jati hai, aur achhi baat kaho, kyunke farishte ghar walon ki dua par 'Ameen' kehte hain."

e: "When the believer is dying, the angels of mercy come to him with white silk and sya: 'Come out content and with the pleasure of Allah upon you to the mercy of Allah, fragrance and a Lord Who is not angry; So it comes out like the best fragrance of musk. They pass him from one to another until they bring him to the gate of heaven, where they say: '; How good is this fragrance that has come to you from the Earth! Then the souls of the believers come to him and they rejoice more over him than any one of you rejoices when his absent loved one comes to him. They ask him: 'What happened to so-and-so, what happened to so-and-so?' They say: 'Let him be, for he was in the hardship of the world. When he says, 'Did he not come here?' They say: 'He was taken to the pit (of Hell).' Come out discontent, subject of Divine wrath, to the punishment of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime; So it comes out like the foulest stench of a corpse. They bring him to the gates of the Earth, where they say: 'How foul is this stench!' Then they bring him to the souls of the disbelievers." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1833)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak jab momin ki jaan nikalne lagti hai to rahmat ke farishte safed resham lekar aate hain, aur kehte hain: 'Raazi aur pasandeeda hokar Allah ki rahmat, khushbu aur us Rab ki taraf nikal jo ghazabnaak nahi,' to woh mushk ki sabse achhi khushbu ki tarah nikalti hai, yahan tak ke woh aik doosre ko de-kar isse soonghte hain, yahan tak ke woh usse aasman ke darwaze tak le aate hain, to woh kehte hain: 'Kitni achhi hai yeh khushbu jo zameen se aapke paas aayi hai?' Har aasman par jate huay woh yehi kehte hain, yahan tak ke usse momino ki roohon ke paas le aate hain," aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To woh (rooh) unhein tum mein se kisi apne ghair-hazir shakhs ki aamad par khushi se zyada khush hote hain," aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To woh usse poochte hain: 'Fulan ne kya kiya?'" aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To woh (jawab mein) kehte hain: 'Usse chhodo yahan tak ke woh aaram kar le, kyunke woh duniya ki takleef mein tha,' phir jab woh unse poochte hain: 'Kya woh tumhare paas nahi aaya?' to unhein pata chalta hai ke woh mar chuka hai," aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To woh kehte hain: 'Use uski maa Haaviya (Jahannam) ki taraf le jaya gaya.'" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur rahi baat kaafir ki, to azab ke farishte uske paas aate hain aur kehte hain: 'Napasand aur naraaz kiya hua nikal Allah ke azab aur uske ghazab ki taraf,' to woh murda jaanwar ki sabse badbudaar boo ki tarah nikalta hai, phir woh usse zameen ke darwaze tak le jaate hain, to woh kehte hain: 'Kitni badbudaar hai yeh boo,' zameen par jate huay woh yehi kehte hain, yahan tak ke woh usse kaafiron ki roohon ke paas le aate hain."

e: [AI] About the Prophet (pbuh), Hammam ibn Yahya narrated from Qatadah, who narrated from Abu Al-Jawza'a, who narrated from Abu Hurairah.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai, aur Hammam bin Yahya ne Qatadah se, unhone Abu Al-Jawza se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "When death approaches a believer, the angels of mercy also approach him." Then he mentioned the hadith in a similar way to this, "All of these chains (of narration) are authentic, and their witness is the hadith of Bara' ibn 'Azib, and I have dictated it in the Book of Faith."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak jab momin ki maut haazir hoti hai to rahmat ke farishte uske paas haazir hote hain," phir isi jaisi hadith ka zikr kiya. Yeh "tamam asaneed sahih hain, aur inka shahid Al-Bara bin Azib ki hadith hai jo maine Kitab-ul-Iman mein likhwa di hai."

e: [AI] Indeed, when the Prophet (pbuh) arrived in Medina, he asked about Al-Bara' bin Ma'rur. They informed him that he had passed away and had instructed that one-third of his wealth be given to the Prophet (pbuh) and also that he be directed towards the Qibla (direction of prayer) when he was close to death. The Prophet (pbuh) said, "He has done well, and I have already returned two-thirds of his wealth to his children." Then he went and offered the funeral prayer for him saying, "O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, and admit him into your Paradise, for you have done so." This is an authentic Hadith, as Al-Bukhari attested through Nu'aim bin Hammad, and Muslim attested through Al-Daraqutni. They did not exclude this Hadith, and I do not know of any other Hadith regarding the dying person facing the Qibla.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne jab Madinah tashreef laaye to Al-Bara bin Ma'rur (RA) ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Unka intiqal ho gaya hai aur unhone apna tihaai maal aapke liye wasiyat kiya hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aur unhone wasiyat ki thi ke maut ke waqt unhein Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh kar diya jaye." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhone fitrat ko paaya hai, aur maine unka tihaai maal unki aulad ko wapas kar diya hai," phir aap (SAW) gaye aur unpar namaz padhi, aur farmaya: "Aye Allah, unhein maaf kar de, unpar reham kar aur unhein apni Jannat mein dakhil kar, aur tune aisa kar diya hai."

e: “When they started to wash the Prophet ﷺ, a voice called out from inside (the house) saying: ‘Do not remove the shirt of the Messenger of Allah.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1466)
hi: Jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghusl dene lage, to unhein andar se aik pukaarne wale ki awaz aayi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki qamees na utaro."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever washes a deceased person and conceals it, forty times will be forgiven for him. And whoever shrouds a deceased person, Allah will cover him with silk and spread the paradise for him. And whoever digs a grave for a deceased person and straightens it, he will be rewarded with the reward of a house in which he will be housed until the Day of Judgment."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi mayyat ko ghusl de aur usse (uske ayb) chhupaye, use chaalees (40) martaba maaf kiya jata hai, aur jo kisi mayyat ko kafan de, Allah use Jannat ke reshmi kapdon se pehnata hai, aur jo kisi mayyat ke liye qabar khode aur use usme daale, uske liye Qayamat ke din tak makaan mein rehne jaisa ajr milta hai."

e: “The best of your garments are those which are white, so shroud your dead in them, and wear them.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1472)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare kapdon mein sabse behtareen safed hai, isliye apne zinda logon ko yehi pehnao aur apne murdon ko isi mein kafnao."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Wear white, for indeed it is very pure and cleaner, and shroud your dead in it.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2810)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Safed kapde pehno aur apne murdon ko isi mein kafnao, kyunke yeh sabse paak aur sabse behtareen hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you bury the deceased, then offer Witr (an odd number of prayers)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mayyat ko khushbu lagao to taaq adad mein lagao."

e: [AI] "I saw us with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and we were almost throwing sand on the funeral."
hi: "Maine dekha ke hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath thay aur hum janaze ke sath taqreeban daudte the."

e: [AI] Wonderful is what has changed the condition of people. By Allah, it is nothing but a chameleon, and when a man harms another man, he says, "O servant of Allah, fear Allah!" as if he is blaming him for being slow in his walking.
hi: Ta'ajjub hai logon ke haal mein jo tabdeeli aayi hai, Allah ki qasam, pehle to sirf tez chaal hoti thi, aur agar koi shakhs kisi doosre ko dabaata to kehta: "Aye Allah ke bande, Allah se daro," goya use jaldi karne par majboor kiya ja raha ho, unke aahista chalne par ta'ajjub karte huay.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The person who walks in front of the funeral procession, the one who rides behind it, and the child should all pray for the deceased."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paidal chalne wala janaze ke aage chale, sawaar uske peechhe, aur bachche par namaz padhi jaye."

e: An animal was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was going with a funeral. He refused to ride on it. When the funeral was away, the animal was brought to him and he rode on it. He was asked about it. He said: The angels were on their feet. I was not to ride while they were walking. When they went away, I rode. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3177)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne aik janaze ki tashee'-e-mayyat ki, aap (SAW) ke paas aik sawari laayi gayi, aap (SAW) ne usse sawaar hone se inkaar kar diya, jab (janaze se) wapas huay to sawari laayi gayi to aap (SAW) usme sawaar ho gaye." Aap (SAW) se poocha gaya to farmaya: "Farishte paidal chal rahe the, isliye main sawaar nahi hona chahta tha jabke woh paidal chal rahe hon, jab woh chale gaye - ya farmaya: upar chale gaye - to main sawaar ho gaya."

e: "We went with the Prophet (following) a funeral. He saw people riding so he said: 'Are you not ashamed? Indeed Allah's angels are on their feet, while you are on the backs of your beasts'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1012)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) aik janaze mein nikle, unhone logon ko sawaar dekha," to farmaya: "Kya tumhein sharam nahi aati, Allah ke farishte apne qadmon par (paidal) hain aur tum jaanwaron ki peethon par (sawaar) ho?"

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was accompanying a funeral, he would not sit down until the deceased was lifted up or placed down."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab kisi janaze ke sath hote to nahi baithte the yahan tak ke woh uthaya jaye ya rakh diya jaye."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "When you follow a funeral procession, do not sit down until it is laid down." The two sheikhs agreed on narrating Ibn Umar's Hadith from Aamir ibn Rabee'ah, "Whoever follows it should not sit until it is laid down."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum kisi janaze ki pairavi karo to na baitho yahan tak ke woh rakh di jaye." Shaykhain ne Ibn Umar (RA) ki hadith Aamir bin Rabi'ah se nikalne par ittifaq kiya hai: "Jo iski pairavi kare woh na baithe yahan tak ke woh rakh di jaye," aur...

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to stop whenever a funeral passed by."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab koi janaza guzarta to khade ho jate yahan tak ke woh guzar jata."

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw a funeral procession, he used to stand up until it passed and say: 'Verily, death is a reality.' Marwan said, 'O Abu Hurairah, did you speak the truth?' He replied, 'Yes.' Marwan then asked, 'So what prevented you from informing me?' Abu Hurairah answered, 'I saw that you were an imam (leader), so I sat down, and consequently, I sat down as well.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab koi janaza dekhte to khade ho jate yahan tak ke woh guzar jata, aur farmate: "Beshak maut aik dahshat hai." To Marwan ne poocha: "Kya yeh sach hai, aye Abu Hurairah?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone poocha: "To phir tumne mujhe kyun nahi bataya?" Unhone kaha: "Tum imam thay, tum baith gaye to main bhi baith gaya."

e: [AI] He said: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "O Messenger of Allah, a funeral procession of disbelievers passes by us, should we stand up for it?" He ﷺ  said, "Yes, stand up for it, for you are not standing up for them, rather you are standing up in reverence for the One who holds the souls."
hi: Aik shakhs ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humare paas kaafiron ka janaza guzarta hai, kya hum uske liye khade hon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, uske liye khade ho jao, kyunke tum uske liye nahi khade hote, balke tum us (Zaat) ki ta'zeem mein khade hote ho jo jaanein qabz karta hai."

e: a funeral passed by the Messenger of Allah and he stood up. It was said: "It is the funeral of a Jew." He said: "We stood up for the angels." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1929)
hi: Aik Yahoodi ka janaza Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas se guzra, to aap (SAW) khade ho gaye, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh to aik Yahoodi ka janaza hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main to farishton ke liye khada hua tha."

e: [AI] We used to inform the Prophet, peace be upon him, when one of us passed away. The Prophet, peace be upon him, would then come and pray for the deceased. Sometimes, he and the people accompanying him would stay until the body was buried. This continued for some time and caused hardship to the Prophet, peace be upon him. So, some people said to each other, "If we do not inform the Prophet, peace be upon him, until the body is buried, there will be no hardship or delay." Therefore, we started informing him after the burial so that he would come and pray for the deceased.
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aage-aage rehte the, jab hum mein se koi mayyat haazir hota to hum Nabi (SAW) ko khabar dete, to aap (SAW) tashreef laate aur uske liye maghfirat maangte, yahan tak ke jab hum pahunch jate to Nabi (SAW) aur unke sath log wapas ho jate, aur kabhi kabhi woh (dafan hone tak) baithe rehte, aur kabhi kabhi yeh (intezar) Nabi Allah (SAW) par lamba ho jata. Jab humein iski mushkil ka andesha hua to logon ne aapas mein kaha: "Kaash hum Nabi (SAW) ko kisi ki maut ki khabar tab tak na dein jab tak uski rooh qabz na ho jaye, phir jab qabz ho jaye to hum unhein khabar dein," isse na koi mushkil hoti na koi intezar, isliye hum unhein mayyat ki khabar uski maut ke baad dete, to aap (SAW) aate aur uspar namaz padhte.

e: I offered the funeral prayer behind Ibn ʿAbbas and he recited Al-Fatiha and said, "You should know that it (i.e. recitation of Al-Fatiha) is the tradition of the Prophet ﷺ Muhammad. (Using translation from Bukhārī 1335)
hi: Ke yeh Sunnat hai.

e: [AI] "Yes, indeed it is a right and a tradition. It has a witness and an interpreter from the narration of Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya."
hi: "Haan, beshak yeh haq aur Sunnat hai." Iska aik tafseeli shahid Ibrahim bin Abi Yahya ki hadith se milta hai.

e:
[AI] The translation of the given phrase from Arabic to English is:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say the takbeer four times over our funeral processions and recite the opening chapter of the Quran in the first takbeer."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) humare janazon par chaar (4) takbeerein kehte the, aur pehli takbeer mein Fatihat-ul-Kitab padhte the."

e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed over a dead person, he said: O Allah, forgive those of us who are living and those of us who are dead, those of us who are present and those of us who are absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, to whomsoever of us Thou givest life grant him life as a believer, and whomsoever of us Thou takest in death take him in death as a follower of Islam. O Allah, do not withhold from us the reward (of faith) and do not lead us astray after his death. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3201)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab kisi janaze par namaz padhte to farmate: "Aye Allah, humare zinda aur mare huay ko, hamare haazir aur ghaib ko, hamare chhote aur bade ko, hamare mard aur aurat ko maaf kar de. Aye Allah, jise tu humme se zinda rakhe usse Islam par zinda rakh, aur jise tu humme se wafat de usse Eman par wafat de."

e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed over a dead person, he said: O Allah, forgive those of us who are living and those of us who are dead, those of us who are present and those of us who are absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, to whomsoever of us Thou givest life grant him life as a believer, and whomsoever of us Thou takest in death take him in death as a follower of Islam. O Allah, do not withhold from us the reward (of faith) and do not lead us astray after his death. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3201)
hi: Maine Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki mayyat par namaz kaisi hoti thi?" Unhone kaha: aap (SAW) farmate: "Aye Allah, humare zinda aur mare huay ko, hamare mard aur aurat ko, hamare haazir aur ghaib ko, hamare chhote aur bade ko maaf kar de. Aye Allah, jise tu humme se zinda rakhe usse Islam par zinda rakh, aur jise tu humme se wafat de usse Eman par wafat de."

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up for a funeral prayer, he would say, 'O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your female servant is in need of Your mercy, while You are not in need of His punishment. If he was righteous, then increase his good deeds, and if he was a wrongdoer, then overlook his sins.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab janaze ki namaz ke liye khade hote to farmate: "Aye Allah, tera bandah aur teri laundi ka beta tere rahmat ka mohtaaj hai, aur tu uske azab se be-niyaz hai, agar woh nek tha to uski neki mein izafa kar, aur agar woh bura tha to usse darguzar kar."

e: [AI] I attended the funeral with Abdullah ibn Abbas. He led the prayer, reciting loudly from Surah Al-Qamar. Then he prayed upon the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Allah, your servant and the son of your servant and the son of your female servant testifies that there is no deity worthy of worship except You alone, without partner. And he testifies that Muhammad is your servant and Messenger. He has become in need of Your mercy, while You are free from his punishment. He has departed from this world and its people. If he was righteous, then increase his righteousness, and if he made mistakes, then forgive him. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not lead us astray after him." Then he made three takbirs (saying Allahu Akbar) and left, saying, "O people, whenever I recite openly, it is so that you may know that this is the Sunnah." The two scholars, Shurahbil ibn Sa'd, who is from the Tabi'in (successors of the Companions of the Prophet), did not object. I have narrated this Hadith as evidence for the Hadiths that we have presented earlier. It is summarized and concise.
hi: Main Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ki khidmat mein hazir tha, unhone humein Al-Abwa mein aik janaze ki namaz padhayi, takbeer kahi, phir Umm-ul-Quran buland awaz se padhi, phir Nabi (SAW) par durood bheja, phir farmaya: "Aye Allah, tera bandah aur tere bande ka beta aur teri laundi ka beta gawahi deta hai ke tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tu akela hai, tera koi shareek nahi, aur gawahi deta hai ke Muhammad tera bandah aur tera Rasool hai, woh teri rahmat ka mohtaaj ho chuka hai aur tu uske azab se be-niyaz ho chuka hai, duniya aur uske ahl se juda kiya ja raha hai, agar woh paak tha to usse aur paak kar, aur agar woh khataakaar tha to usse maaf kar de, Aye Allah, humein uske ajr se mehroom na kar aur uske baad humein gumraah na kar," phir teen (3) takbeerein kahin, phir wapas hue aur farmaya: "Aye logo, maine sirf isliye buland awaz se padha taake tumhein pata chale ke yehi Sunnat hai."

e: [AI] A daughter of his died, so he followed her on a mule, walking behind the funeral procession, while women were mourning her. He said, "Let them mourn or not mourn. Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade mourning." And he said, "One of you should take off her outer garment as she wishes, then he offered the funeral prayer over her, and he performed four Takbirs (saying Allahu Akbar, meaning Allah is the Greatest) over her grave, then he stood after the fourth Takbir for as long as it takes to say the distance between the two Takbirs, seeking forgiveness for her and supplicating. It was narrated, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do it like this.'"
hi: Unki aik beti ka intiqal ho gaya, unhone khachar par sawaar hokar janaze ke peechhe chal kar uski tashee' ki, jabke auratein noha kar rahi thin, to unhone kaha: "Chahe noha karo ya na karo," "Rasulullah (SAW) ne noha karne se mana kiya hai," "aur tum mein se koi apne aansu jitne chaahe baha le." Phir "unpar namaz padhi, chaar (4) takbeerein kahin, phir chauthi ke baad utni hi der khade rahe jitni do takbeeron ke darmiyan hoti hai, uske liye maghfirat maangte aur dua karte huay," aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) isi tarah kiya karte the."

e:
[AI] the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  informed him about the funeral prayer. "The Imam should start by saying the takbir, then send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ , and complete the prayer with three additional takbirs before making the tasleem in a quiet manner when he leaves. And the Sunnah is for those behind him to do the same as what he has done." 
Zuhri said, "Abu Umamah and Ibn al-Musayyib informed me about this, and Ibn Shihab mentioned what Abu Umamah had told me about the Sunnah in the funeral prayer for Muhammad bin Suyaid." He said, "And I heard ad-Dahhak ibn Qays narrating from Habib ibn Muslimah in a prayer he performed for the deceased, similar to what Abu Umamah informed us."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) mein se kayi logon ne unhein janaze ki namaz ke baare mein bataya: "Imam takbeer kahe, phir Nabi (SAW) par durood bheje, aur teen (3) takbeeron mein poori tawajjo ke sath dua kare, phir wapas jate waqt aahista se salaam phere, aur Sunnat yeh hai ke uske peechhe wale bhi wahi karein jo usne aage kiya." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Mujhe yeh baat Abu Umamah (RA) ne batayi, aur Ibn Al-Musayyib sun rahe the, unhone iska inkaar nahi kiya." Ibn Shihab ne kaha: phir maine woh baat jo mujhe Abu Umamah (RA) ne mayyat ki namaz ki Sunnat ke baare mein batayi thi, Muhammad bin Suwaid ko sunayi, unhone kaha: "Aur maine Ad-Dahhak bin Qais ko Habib bin Muslimah se, aik mayyat ki namaz ke baare mein, wahi hadith bayan karte suna jo humein Abu Umamah (RA) ne bayan ki thi."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed over a funeral and he uttered four takbeers over it, and he gave salutations at the end, one salutation on the funeral." This narration has been authenticated in the reports of Ali ibn Abi Talib, Abdullah ibn Umar, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Jabir ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa, and Abu Hurairah, that they used to give one salutation on the funeral."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik janaze par namaz padhi, chaar (4) takbeerein kahin aur aik salaam phera, janaze ke liye aik hi salaam kaafi hai." Iski riwayat Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam), Abdullah bin Umar (RA), Abdullah bin Abbas (RA), Jabir bin Abdullah (RA), Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) aur Abu Hurairah (RA) se sahih sabit hui hai ke woh janaze par aik hi salaam phera karte the.

e: "The believer dies with sweat on his forehead." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1828)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin peshani ke paseene ke sath marta hai."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ kissed Uthman bin Mazhun while he was dead and crying" He said, "And his eyes were shedding tears."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Uthman bin Mazhun (RA) ko, jabke woh mar chuke thay, bosa diya, aap (SAW) rote hue thay," unhone kaha: "aur aap (SAW) ki aankhon se aansu baha rahe thay."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best of fragrance is musk." This was followed by Al-Mustamir bin Al-Rayyan reporting from Abu Nadrah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen khushbu mushk hai."

e: The Prophet was asked about musk and he said: "It is the best of your perfumes." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 992)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se musk ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhari sabse behtareen khushbu hai."

e: [AI] Ali said, "And it is the virtue of Hanoot, the messenger of Allah peace be upon him."
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Aur yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ke hunoot (kafan ki khushbu) ka bacha hua hissa hai."

e: “When they started to wash the Prophet ﷺ, a voice called out from inside (the house) saying: ‘Do not remove the shirt of the Messenger of Allah.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1466)
hi: Jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghusl dene lage, to unhein andar se aik pukaarne wale ki awaz aayi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki qamees na utaro."

e: [AI] Ali ibn Abi Talib, I washed the Messenger of Allah, then I went to see what would happen to the deceased, but I did not see anything. He was a good person, both alive and dead. I had the duty to bury him and shroud him. Four people were with me: Ali, al-Abbas, al-Fadl, and Salih, who was a servant of the Messenger of Allah. We buried the Messenger of Allah according to Islamic customs, and poured milk over his grave.
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) [ne kaha]: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghusl diya, phir main dekhne laga ke mayyat mein kya (tabdeeli) hoti hai, magar mujhe kuch nazar nahi aaya, aap (SAW) zinda aur mardah dono halaton mein paak the." Unki tadfeen aur unhein qabar mein utaarne ki zimmedari logon ke ilawa sirf chaar (afraad) ki thi: Ali (Alayhis Salam), Abbas (RA), Al-Fadl (RA) aur Salih (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam. Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye lahd (aik taraf khudi hui qabar) banayi gayi aur uspar kachi eenten khadi ki gayin.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever washes a dead body and keeps it secret, forgiveness will be granted to him forty times. Whoever shrouds a dead body, Allah will clothe him with silk and brocade from Paradise. And whoever digs a grave for a dead person and then buries him in it, he will be rewarded with the reward of providing a dwelling until the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kisi mayyat ko ghusl de aur usse chhupaye, use chaalees (40) martaba maaf kiya jata hai, aur jo kisi mayyat ko kafan de, Allah use Jannat ke reshmi kapdon se pehnata hai, aur jo kisi mayyat ke liye qabar khode aur use usme daale, uske liye Qayamat ke din tak makaan (mein rehne) jaisa ajr chalta hai."

e: [AI] "When a funeral was brought for him (the Prophet), he would place the family of the deceased in three rows, and he would pray over them. He would say, 'Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No three rows of Muslims pray over a deceased except that they will be granted forgiveness."' This wording is a narration of Ibn Ulayyah in the wording of Al-Mahbubi, 'Except that he will be forgiven.'"
hi: Jab unke paas koi janaza laaya jata jispar namaz padhni hoti aur uske ahl-e-khana kam hote, to woh unhein teen saffon mein taqseem kar dete aur unke sath uspar namaz padhte, aur kehte: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Musalmanon ki teen saffein kisi janaze par khadi nahi hotin magar yeh (Jannat) uske liye wajib kar deti hain.'" Yeh alfaz Ibn Ulayyah ki hadith ke hain, Al-Mahbubi ki riwayat mein: "magar usse maaf kar diya jata hai."

e: [AI] There was a Jewish boy who served the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . He fell sick, and when the Prophet visited him, the boy said: "Say, I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that you are the Messenger of Allah." The boy then looked at his father, who said: "Say what Muhammad says to you." After the boy passed away, the Prophet ﷺ  said: "Pray upon your brother."
hi: Aik Yahoodi ladka Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat karta tha, woh bimar ho gaya, to aap (SAW) ne uski ayaadat ki aur farmaya: "Kaho: ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa annaka Rasoolullah (main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur aap Allah ke Rasool hain)." Ladke ne apne waalid ki taraf dekha, to unhone kaha: "Jo Muhammad (SAW) kehte hain woh kaho." Unhone kaha: jab woh mar gaya to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne bhai par namaz padho."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "The one riding behind the funeral procession, the one walking close to it, and the child, they should all pray for it." Narrated by Yunus bin Ubaid from Ziyad bin Jubair.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Sawaar janaze ke peechhe (chale), paidal chalne wala uske qareeb (chale), aur bachche par namaz padhi jaye."

e: [AI] He (the Prophet ﷺ) raised it (the Hadith) to him and said, "The rider walks behind the funeral procession, and the one on foot walks near it on its right and left. The miscarried fetus is prayed for, and blessings and mercy are invoked upon its parents." Ibrahim ibn Abi Talib commented on this Hadith saying, "Yunus ibn Ubaid narrated to me, and some of his family members also narrated to me, that he (the Prophet ﷺ) raised it (the Hadith) to him as a narration from Yunus ibn Ubaid through Sa'id ibn Ubaidullah ibn Jubayr ibn Hayyah."
hi: Unhone ise Nabi (SAW) tak marfoo' kiya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sawaar janaze ke peechhe chalta hai, aur paidal chalne wala uske dayen aur bayen qareeb (chalta hai), aur saqt (adhoore paida huay) bachche par namaz padhi jaati hai aur uske waalidain ke liye aafiyat aur rahmat ki dua ki jaati hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When a young child inherits, perform the funeral prayer for him." The two scholars did not mention Isma'il ibn Muslim by name.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab bachcha (paida hote waqt) chillaye (zinda hone ki alaamat dikhaye), to woh waaris banta hai aur uspar namaz padhi jati hai."

e: [AI] We were with the Prophet ﷺ  in Khaybar when a man from among us died, who was one of the bravest. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Pray for him." So we went to look for something to use as a shroud, and we found only two dirhams worth of beads belonging to Jews. This hadith was narrated by people from Yahya ibn Sa'id. This is Abu 'Amrah, a man from Juhaynah known for his honesty, and he did not lie.
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke sath Khaybar mein thay, hum mein se Ashja' qabile ka aik shakhs faut ho gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uspar namaz padho." Hum dekhne gaye to humein Yahood ki kuch mohron mein se kuch mohrein milin jinki qeemat do dirham bhi nahi thi.

e: [AI] A man died during the time of the Prophet ﷺ, and another man approached and said, "So-and-so has died." The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "He has not died." Then a second man approached and said, "So-and-so has died." The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "He has not died." Then a third man approached and said, "So-and-so has died." The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "How did he die?" He said, "He killed himself with a knife that he had with him, so the Prophet ﷺ did not pray for him."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein aik shakhs faut ho gaya, aik aadmi aap (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Fulan faut ho gaya." Nabi (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Woh nahi mara." Phir woh doosri martaba aaya aur kaha: "Fulan faut ho gaya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh nahi mara." Phir woh teesri martaba aaya aur kaha: "Fulan faut ho gaya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Woh kaise mara?" Usne kaha: "Usne apne paas maujood aik teer ki nok se apni jaan le li." To Nabi (SAW) ne uspar namaz nahi padhi.

e: [AI] The Prophet, peace be upon him, used to ask about a funeral when he was invited to it. If he praised the deceased, he would pray for them. If he did not praise them, he would say to their family, "What is your opinion of this person?" And he would not pray for them.
hi: Nabi (SAW) jab kisi janaze ki taraf bulaaye jate to uske baare mein poochte, agar uski achhi tareef ki jati to uspar namaz padhte, aur agar uski koi aur baat batayi jati to uske ahl se farmate: "Tumhara maamla tum jaano," aur uspar namaz nahi padhte.

e: [AI] We used to inform the Prophet ﷺ  whenever one of us passed away, and he would attend the deceased and seek forgiveness for him. He would stay with him until he was buried, and sometimes this process would take a long time for the Prophet ﷺ . When we feared that this might be burdensome for him, some of the people said to others, "If we don't inform the Prophet ﷺ  about someone's death until he is already buried, then he wouldn't have to go through any difficulty or delay." So we started doing that and would inform him about the deceased after they were buried, and he would come and offer prayers for them. Sometimes he would come immediately, and sometimes he would delay until the deceased was buried. We were doing this at that time, and then we said, "If the Prophet ﷺ  himself attended our funeral and prayed for us at our homes, it would be even better." So we did that, and this practice continues till today.
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat mein aage-aage rehte the, jab hum mein se koi mayyat haazir hoti to hum Nabi (SAW) ko khabar dete, to aap (SAW) tashreef laate aur uske liye maghfirat maangte, yahan tak ke jab woh qabz ho jata to Nabi (SAW) aur unke sath log wapas ho jate yahan tak ke woh dafan ho jata, aur kabhi kabhi yeh (intezar) Nabi (SAW) par lamba ho jata. Jab humein iski mushkil ka andesha hua to logon ne aapas mein kaha: "Kaash hum Nabi ko kisi ki maut ki khabar tab tak na dein jab tak uski rooh qabz na ho jaye, phir jab qabz ho jaye to hum unhein khabar dein," isse unpar na koi mushkil hoti na koi intezar, to humne aisa hi kiya, aur hum unhein mayyat ki khabar uski maut ke baad dete, to aap (SAW) aate aur uspar namaz padhte, kabhi kabhi wapas ho jate aur kabhi kabhi rukte yahan tak ke mayyat dafan ho jaati. Hum kuch waqt tak isi tarah rahe, phir humne kaha: "Kaash Nabi (SAW) khud na nikaltay aur hum apna janaza unke paas laate taake woh apne ghar ke paas hi uspar namaz padh len, yeh unke liye zyada munasib hoga," to humne aisa hi kiya, aur yehi maamla aaj tak chala aa raha hai.

e: [AI] Abu Talhah invited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to the funeral of Umair ibn Abu Talhah when he passed away. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went to their house and performed the funeral prayer for him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went forward, with Abu Talhah following him, and Umm Salamah following Abu Talhah. No one else was with them.
hi: Abu Talhah (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko Umair bin Abi Talhah ke intiqal par unke janaze ke liye bulaya, Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas tashreef laaye aur unke ghar mein uspar namaz padhi, Rasulullah (SAW) aage badhe, Abu Talhah (RA) unke peechhe thay, aur Umm Sulaim (RA) Abu Talhah (RA) ke peechhe thin, aur unke ilawa koi aur unke sath nahi tha.

e: [AI] On the day of Uhud, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib while he was wounded and disfigured. He said, "If it were not for the fact that Safiyya will miss him until Allah gathers him from the bellies of birds and wild animals, I would have left him." So he wrapped him in a cloth. When his head was covered, his feet were exposed, and when his feet were covered, his head was exposed. His head was covered and he did not offer funeral prayer for any martyr other than him. He said, "I bear witness against you all today." He used to bury three or two people in one grave and ask, "Which of them has more Qur'an?" Then he would place the most knowledgeable one in front during the burial. He wrapped the bodies of two men and three men in one cloth.
hi: Jab Uhud ka din tha, Rasulullah (SAW) Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ke paas se guzre, jinke naak-kaan kaate gaye the aur jinka muthla (badan bigaad diya gaya) kiya gaya tha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar Safiyyah (RA) ko bura na lagta to main unhein chhod deta yahan tak ke Allah unhein parindon aur darindon ke pait se uthata," phir unhein aik dhaari-daar chadar mein kafnaya, jab unka sar dhaanka jata to unke paon zaahir ho jate, aur jab unke paon dhaanke jate to unka sar zaahir ho jata, to unka sar dhaanka gaya. Aap (SAW) ne unke ilawa kisi aur shaheed par namaz nahi padhi, aur farmaya: "Main aaj tumpar gawah hoon." Aap (SAW) teen aur do (shuhada) ko aik hi qabar mein jama karte the, aur poochte: "In mein se kaunsa Quran zyada jaanta hai?" phir usse lahd mein aage rakhte. Aap (SAW) ne do aur teen aadmiyon ko aik hi kapde mein kafnaya.

e: The martyrs of Uhud were not washed, and they were buried with their blood. No prayer was offered over them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3135)
hi: "Uhud ke shuhada ko ghusl nahi diya gaya, unhein unke khoon samet dafnaya gaya, aur unpar namaz nahi padhi gayi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you lay your deceased in their graves, say 'Bismillah' (in the name of Allah) and according to the way of the Messenger of Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum apne murdon ko unki qabron mein rakho to kaho: 'Bismillah, wa ala millati Rasoolillah' (Allah ke naam se, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki millat par)."

e: [AI] "When he used to place the deceased in his grave, he would say, 'In the name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.' A hadith of Al-Baihaqi, which is well-known among the Companions, serves as evidence for the hadith of Hammam narrated by Qatadah as well."
hi: Woh jab mayyat ko qabar mein rakhte to kehte: "Bismillah, wa ala Sunnati Rasoolillah" (Allah ke naam se, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat par). Al-Bayadi ki hadith Sahaba (RA) mein mash'hoor hai, aur yeh Hammam ki, Qatadah se, musnad hadith ka shahid hai.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: When the deceased is placed in their grave, those who are placing them should say, "In the name of Allah and by the permission of Allah and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab mayyat ko qabar mein rakha jaye, to jo log use lahd mein rakh rahe hon woh kahein: 'Bismillahi wa billahi wa ala millati Rasoolillah (SAW)' (Allah ke naam se, aur Allah ke sath, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki millat par)."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  passed by a funeral at a grave and said, "Whose grave is this?" They said, "It is the grave of Fulan al-Habashi, O Messenger of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, "There is no deity but Allah, there is no deity but Allah. He will be transported from his land and heavens to the earth from which he was created."
hi: Nabi (SAW) aik janaze ke paas qabar par se guzre, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kiski qabar hai?" Unhone kaha: "Fulan Habashi ki, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "La ilaha illallah, la ilaha illallah, isse uski zameen aur aasman se uski us mitti ki taraf le jaya gaya jisse woh paida kiya gaya tha."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When Allah intends to take the life of a servant on land, He grants him a need in it or with it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah kisi bande ki jaan kisi zameen mein qabz karna chahta hai, to usme uske liye koi zaroorat paida kar deta hai."

e: (Another chain) with similar meaning. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3093)
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No man is placed on earth without having a need fulfilled for him within it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi shakhs ki maut kisi zameen mein muqarrar nahi ki jaati magar uske liye usme koi zaroorat rakh di jaati hai," aur usme se...

e: "When Allah decrees that a slave (of His) is to die in a land, He makes him have some need from it." Another chain reports a similar narration. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2146)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah kisi bande ki jaan kisi zameen mein qabz karna chahta hai, to uski taraf uski koi zaroorat paida kar deta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, he is being punished." So he died, and a man saw fire in his grave. He approached him, and behold, it was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Come to your companion." And behold, it was the man who used to raise his voice in remembrance.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) [ne farmaya]: "Beshak woh bohot ronay-gidgidaanay wala hai." Unhone kaha: phir woh faut ho gaya, aik shakhs ne uski qabar mein aag dekhi, woh uske paas gaya, to dekha Rasulullah (SAW) usme hain aur farma rahe hain: "Aao apne sathi ke paas," to woh wahi shakhs tha jo zikr mein apni awaz buland kiya karta tha.

e: [AI] "I saw a fire in the cemeteries, so I approached them and found the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the grave, saying, 'Bring me your companion.'"
hi: "Maine qabristan mein aag dekhi, main unke paas gaya to Rasulullah (SAW) qabar mein thay aur farma rahe thay: 'Mujhe apna sathi de do.'"

e: [AI] I heard a man who was in Mecca and was Roman. In the narration of Shu'bah, his name is Waggas. He used to go around the Kaaba and say in his supplication, "Oh, Oh." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, he is a lunatic." Abu Dharr said, "So I went out one night, and I found the Prophet ﷺ  burying that man in the cemetery along with a lantern."
hi: Maine aik shakhs ko suna jo Makkah mein tha aur Roomi tha - Shu'bah ki riwayat mein uska naam Waqqas hai - woh Abu Dharr (RA) se riwayat karte hue keh raha tha: aik shakhs Baitullah ka tawaf kar raha tha aur apni dua mein "Awwah, Awwah" keh raha tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh to bohot (Allah ke aage) gidgidaane wala hai." Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: main aik raat nikla to Nabi (SAW) ko qabristan mein us shakhs ko dafna te huay paaya, aap (SAW) ke sath chiraag tha.

e: The Prophet ﷺ made a speech one day and mentioned a man from among his Companions who died and was shrouded in a shroud of bad quality, and was buried at night. The Prophet ﷺ rebuked that man be buried at night until prayer was offered over him, except that a man was forced to do that. The Prophet ﷺ said: When one of you shrouds his brother, he should use a shroud of good quality. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3148)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik din khutba diya, unhone apne sahaba (RA) mein se aik shakhs ka zikr kiya jinka intiqal ho gaya tha aur unhein aik mamooli kafan mein kafnaya gaya tha, aur unhein raat ko dafnaya gaya tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne kisi shakhs ko raat ko dafnaane se mana kiya jab tak uspar namaz na padh li jaye, siwaye is soorat ke jab koi shakhs is par majboor ho jaye, aur farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai ko kafnaaye to achha kafan de."

e: Messenger of Allah ﷺ one day in the course of his sermon made mention of a person among his Companions who had died and had been wrapped in a shroud not long (enough to cover his whole body) and was buried during the night. The Apostle of Allah ﷺ reprimanded (the audience) that a person was buried during the night (in a state that) funeral prayer could not be offered (over him by the Messenger of Allah). (And this is permissible only) when it becomes a dire necessity for a man. The Apostle of Allah ﷺ also said: When any one of you shrouds his brother, he should shroud him well. (Using translation from Muslim 943)
hi: Unhone mujhe bataya ke Nabi (SAW) ne aik din khutba diya, unhone apne sahaba (RA) mein se aik shakhs ka zikr kiya jinka intiqal ho gaya tha aur unhein aik mamooli kafan mein kafnaya gaya tha aur raat ko dafnaya gaya tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne kisi shakhs ko raat ko dafnaane, jabke uspar namaz na padhi gayi ho, se mana kiya, siwaye is soorat ke jab koi shakhs is par majboor ho jaye, aur farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai ki zimmedari le to use achha kafan de."

e: ʿAli ؓ said to me: I shall send you on the same mission as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me: do not leave any image without erasing it or any built-up grave without levelling it. (Using translation from Aḥmad 741)
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Abu Al-Hayyaj se kaha: "Kya main tumhein usi maqsad par na bheju jispar Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bheja tha, ke koi tasveer chhodo mat magar usse mita do, aur koi uthi hui qabar chhodo mat magar usse barabar kar do."

e: [AI] I Ali, am unwilling to send you on what the Prophet ﷺ did not command me regarding, so he mentioned the narration in its form.
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne mujhse kaha: "Kya main tumhein usi maqsad par na bheju jispar Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe bheja tha," phir isi jaisi hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: I said to Aisha! Mother, show me the grave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his two Companions (Allah be pleased with them). She showed me three graves which were neither high nor low, but were spread with soft red pebbles in an open space. Abu 'Ali said: It is said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is forward, Abu Bakr is near his head and 'Umar is near is feet. His head is at the feet of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3220)
hi: Main Aisha (RA) ki khidmat mein hazir hua, maine kaha: "Aye ammi jaan, mujhe Nabi (SAW) aur unke dono sathiyon ki qabar dikha dijiye." Unhone mujhe teen qabrein dikhayin, na uthi hui na zameen mein dhansi hui, unpar Al-Arsa ki surkh bajri bichhi hui thi, "to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko aage dekha, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ka sar Nabi (SAW) ke dono kandhon ke darmiyan tha, aur Umar (RA) ka sar Nabi (SAW) ke paon ke qareeb tha."

e: "The Messenger of Allah forbade building over graves, making them larger or plastering over them." (One of two narrators) Sulaiman bin Musa added: "Or writing on them." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2027)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mana kiya ke qabar par imarat banayi jaye, use pukhta (plaster) kiya jaye, ya uspar baitha jaye, aur mana kiya ke uspar (kuch) likha jaye."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ prohibited engraving on graves, writing on them, building on them, and sitting on them. These narrations are authentic. However, their implementation differs, as the leaders of the Muslims from the East to the West have writings on their graves, which is a practice inherited from the previous generations."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne qabron par plaster karne, unpar likhne, unpar imarat banane, aur unpar baithne se mana kiya." Yeh asaneed sahih hain, "lekin amal isse mutabiq nahi, kyunke Mashriq se Maghrib tak Musalmanon ke a'imma ki qabron par (naam waghera) likha hota hai, aur yeh aik amal hai jise ba'd walon ne agalon se apnaya hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "My Ummah, or this Ummah, will continue to adhere to their religion as long as they do not neglect to bury the deceased in their own families."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat - ya yeh Ummat - apne deen ke aik hisse par qaim rahegi jab tak woh janazon (ki zimmedari) ko unke ahl-e-khana par hi na chhod dein."

e: [AI] I heard Uthman ibn Affan say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by a funeral at a grave, and the person accompanying the deceased was being buried. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Seek forgiveness for your brother and ask Allah to grant him steadfastness, for he is now being questioned."
hi: Maine Uthman bin Affan (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) aik janaze ke paas qabar par se guzre jabke uske sathi ko dafnaya jaa raha tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne bhai ke liye maghfirat maango aur Allah se uski (jawaab mein) sabaat (mazbooti) maango, kyunke abhi uspar sawaal kiya jaa raha hai."

e: ʿUthman ؓ used to stand by a grave and weep until his beard became wet. It was said to him: You remember Paradise and Hell and you do not weep, but you weep for this? He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ʿThe grave is the first stage of the hereafter. If one is saved from it (i.e., its torments), then what comes after it is easier than it. But if one is not saved from it {i.e. its torments), then what comes after it is worse.ʿ And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: By Allah, I have never seen any frightening scene but the grave is more frightening than it.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 454)
hi: Unse kaha jata: "Aap Jannat aur Jahannam yaad karte hain magar rote nahi, aur is (qabar) par rote hain?" To woh kehte: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak qabar aakhirat ki pehli manzil hai, agar koi usse bach gaya to uske baad ka (safar) usse aasan hai, aur agar koi usse na bach saka to uske baad ka (safar) usse zyada sakht hai." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine koi manzar nahi dekha magar qabar usse zyada khaufnaak hai."

e: [AI] "I traveled with the Prophet ﷺ  more than once, and every time I saw him pass by the grave of a person, he would command for their burial. He did not discriminate whether the deceased was a Muslim or a non-Muslim."
hi: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ke sath kayi baar safar kiya, maine kabhi nahi dekha ke aap (SAW) kisi insaan ki laash ke paas se guzre hon magar unhein dafnaane ka hukum diya ho, chahe woh Musalman ho ya kaafir."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every person has three close friends. As for the first friend, when you spend, he says, 'It is yours and you deserve it,' and when you withhold, he says, 'It is not yours and you should not keep it,' and that is his wealth. As for the second friend, he says, 'I am with you, if you go to the king's gate, I will leave you and return, that is his family and honor. And as for the third friend, he says, 'I am with you wherever you go, that is his own deed. If I have made these three people less important to me…"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har insaan ke teen dost hote hain: aik dost kehta hai: 'Jo tu kharch kare woh tera hai, aur jo tu roke woh tera nahi,' aur yeh uska maal hai; doosra dost kehta hai: 'Main tere sath hoon, jab tu Baadshah ke darwaze par pahuncha to main tujhe chhod kar wapas chala jaunga,' aur yeh uske ghar wale aur khidmatgar hain; aur teesra dost kehta hai: 'Main tere sath hoon jahan bhi tu jaye, chahe andar ho ya bahar,' aur yeh uska amal hai. To woh (insaan) kahega: tum teenon mein se sabse kam-tar (ehmiyat wale) mere liye tha."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The example of a man and death is like the example of a man who has three friends. One of them said, 'This is my wealth, take whatever you want from it.' The other said, 'I am with you in your life, but when you die, I will leave you.' And the third said, 'I am with you in life and I will enter and leave with you, whether you live or die.' As for the one who said, 'Take whatever you want from it, and leave whatever you want,' that is his wealth. As for the other, it is his family. And as for the third, it is his deeds."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Insaan aur maut ki misaal us aadmi jaisi hai jiske teen dost hon, aik ne kaha: "Yeh mera maal hai, isme se jo chaho le lo," doosre ne kaha: "Main teri zindagi mein tere sath hoon, jab tu mar jayega to main tujhe chhod dunga," aur teesre ne kaha: "Main tere sath hoon, tere sath andar aata-jaata hoon, chahe tu mare ya zinda rahe." Rahi baat us dost ki jisne kaha "jo chaho le lo aur jo chaho chhod do," to woh uska maal hai; aur doosra uska qabila hai; aur teesra uska amal hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Prepare food for the family of Ja'far for there came upon them an incident which has engaged them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3132)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ke ghar walon ke liye khana taiyyar karo, kyunke unpar aisi khabar aayi hai jisne unhein mashghool kar diya hai."

e: [AI] "If you had seen me, Qatham and Ubaidullah ibn Abbas playing when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by on a mount, and he said, 'Bring this to me.' He made me stand in front of him, and then he said to Qatham, 'Bring this to me.' He made him stand behind him. Abbas, his uncle, was too shy to carry Qatham, so he left him and wiped my head three times. When he finished wiping, he said, 'O Allah, replace Jafar with him in his offspring.' I asked Abdullah ibn Jafar, 'What happened to Qatham?' He said, 'He was martyred.' I said to Abdullah, 'Allah and His Messenger knew better about his news.' He said, 'Yes.'"
hi: "Kaash tum mujhe, Qutham bin Abbas (RA) aur Ubaidullah bin Abbas (RA) ko khelte huay dekhte, jab Rasulullah (SAW) aik jaanwar par sawaar hokar guzre, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Isse mere paas laao,'" to aap (SAW) ne mujhe apne aage bitha liya, phir Qutham (RA) se farmaya: "'Isse mere paas laao,'" to unhein apne peechhe bitha liya, aap (SAW) ne apne chacha Abbas (RA) ki wajah se sharm mahsoos ki ke Qutham (RA) ko uthayen aur Ubaidullah (RA) ko chhod dein, phir aap (SAW) ne mera sar teen martaba masah kiya, jab masah kiya to farmaya: "Aye Allah, Ja'far (RA) ki unki aulad mein jaanasheeni farma." Maine Abdullah bin Ja'far (RA) se poocha: "Qutham (RA) ka kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Woh shaheed ho gaye." Maine Abdullah (RA) se kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ko unke anjaam ka zyada ilm tha." Unhone kaha: "Haan."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiped his hand on my head and said, "I think he said it three times. After wiping, he said, 'O Allah, bless Jafar in his children.' Jafar ibn Khalid brought two valuable things, one of which was wiping the head of the orphan, and the other was checking on the people affected by the calamity with what they needed for their night. 'And Allah guided us to use it on their behalf.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne haath se mera sar masah kiya - mera khayal hai unhone kaha teen martaba - jab masah kiya to farmaya: "Aye Allah, Ja'far (RA) ki unki aulad mein jaanasheeni farma." Ja'far bin Khalid do qeemti (amal) le kar aaye hain: aik yateem ka sar masah karna, aur doosra museebat-zada logon ki khabar-giri lena ke unhein raat guzarne ke liye khana milta hai ya nahi. Allah ne humein iske amal ki taufeeq di.

e: [AI] Bashir, the messenger of Allah ﷺ, narrated to me, and his name in the pre-Islamic era was Zahm bin Ma'bad. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him, "What is your name?" He responded, "Zahm bin Ma'bad." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You are Bashir (meaning bearer of glad tidings)." So his name became Bashir. He said, "While I was walking with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said to me, 'O son of a noble! Why seek revenge against Allah? You have become someone who walks with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.' So I said, 'I do not seek revenge against Allah for anything. Every good has been done by the Prophet of Allah.' Then he went to the graves of the polytheists and said, 'These people were preceded by many good deeds.' He repeated this statement three times. Then he went to the graves of the Muslims and said, 'These people have attained much good.' He repeated this statement three times. While he was walking, he cast a glance and saw a man walking among the graves wearing sandals. He said, 'O wearer of the two sandals! Woe to you! Throw away your sandals.' So the man looked, and when he recognized the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he took off his sandals and threw them away.
hi: Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke Basheer (khushkhabri dene wale) ne bataya, jinka jahiliyat mein naam Zahm bin Ma'bad tha, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Tumhara naam kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Zahm bin Ma'bad." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum Basheer ho," to yehi unka naam ban gaya. Unhone kaha: main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath chal raha tha ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ibn Al-Khasasiyah, tum Allah par kya aitraaz karte ho, tum subah Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath chal rahe ho?" Maine kaha: "Mujhe Allah par koi aitraaz nahi, Allah ke Nabi ne har khair kiya hai." Phir aap (SAW) mushrikeen ki qabron ke paas aaye aur farmaya: "Yeh log bohot khair se aage nikal gaye," teen martaba. Phir aap (SAW) Musalmanon ki qabron ke paas aaye aur farmaya: "Yeh log bohot khair ko pa gaye," teen martaba. Aap (SAW) chal rahe thay ke achanak aap (SAW) ki nazar padi, to dekha aik shakhs qabron ke darmiyan chal raha tha jispar do joote thay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye chamde ke jooton wale, tumhein afsos ho, apne joote utaar do," woh mudkar dekhne laga, jab us shakhs ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko pehchan liya to usne apne joote utaar kar phenk diye.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saw a man walking between graves wearing two slippers, so he said, "O the one with the two slippers, throw them away."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko qabron ke darmiyan do jooton mein chalte dekha, to farmaya: "Aye chamde ke jooton wale, unhein utaar do."

e: [AI] We buried a man with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When we returned and approached his door, we found him with a woman whom we did not think he knew. He said, "O Fatimah, where did you come from?" She replied, "I came from the family of the deceased, I showed them sympathy for their dead and offered them condolences." He asked, "Did you reach the graves with them?" She said, "May Allah forbid me from reaching the graves with them, but I heard you mentioning something about them." He said, "If you had reached the graves with them, you would not have seen Paradise until your grandfather sees it." The graves are called "al-Kuda." This narration was reported by Haywah bin Shurayh al-Hadrami from Rabee'ah bin Seef.
hi: Humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik shakhs ko dafnaya, jab hum wapas huay aur unke darwaze ke saamne pahunche to unhone aik aurat ko dekha jinhein hum nahi samajhte the ke aap (SAW) unhein pehchante hain, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Fatimah, tum kahan se aa rahi ho?"
