Unhone kaha: "Main mayyat ke ghar walon ke paas se aa rahi hoon, main unke mayyat par unke sath dukh mehsoos kiya aur unhein tasalli di." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Shayad tum unke sath qabron (Al-Kuda) tak pahunch gayi thin?" Unhone kaha: "Maazallah ke main unke sath qabron tak pahunchti, jabke maine aapko usme woh baat kehte suna hai jo aap kehte hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum unke sath qabron tak pahunchti to tum Jannat na dekhti jab tak tumhare dada ke dada woh na dekh len." Aur Al-Kuda qabron ko kehte hain, ise Haywah bin Shuraih Al-Hadrami ne Rabi'ah bin Saif se riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw a woman leaving a funeral procession and asked her, "Where have you come from?" She replied, "From offering condolences to the family of this deceased." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "By Allah, even if you had reached the heights of the stars, you would not see Paradise until your father sees it first."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik aurat ko janaze se wapas aate dekha, unse poocha: "Tum kahan se aa rahi ho?" Unhone kaha: "Is mayyat ke ghar walon ko tasalli dene se." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, agar tum unke sath qabron tak pahunchti to tum Jannat na dekhti jab tak tumhare dada ke dada woh na dekh len."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed women who visit graves, those who built mosques over them and erected lamps (there). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3236)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne qabron ki ziyarat karne wali auraton par, aur unpar masajid aur chiraag banane walon par, la'nat bheji."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  cursed those who visit graves. And these narrated traditions regarding the prohibition of visiting graves have been abrogated."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne qabron ki ziyarat karne wali auraton par la'nat bheji." Aur yeh qabron ki ziyarat se mana karne wali ahadith mansookh (mansookh/uthai gayi) hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger ﷺ said: "I have forbidden you from visiting graves, so visit them as there is a lesson in it. And I have forbidden you from drinking wine, so abstain from it. I have also forbidden you from seeking intoxication, so do not use any intoxicants. And I have forbidden you from eating the meat of sacrificial animals, so eat from them and save some for later."
hi: Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein qabron ki ziyarat se mana kiya tha, ab unki ziyarat karo, kyunke usme sabaq hai, aur maine tumhein nabidh (khajoor/kishmish ka sharbat) se mana kiya tha, khabardar, ab isse piyo, lekin main koi nashe wali cheez halal nahi karta, aur maine tumhein qurbani ka gosht (teen din se zyada rakhne) se mana kiya tha, ab khao aur (chaho to) rakh lo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I used to prohibit you from visiting graves, eating the meat of sacrificial animals after three days, and drinking from vessels made of clay. But now visit graves, for they remind you of the Hereafter and make you abstain from worldly desires. Eat the meat of sacrificial animals and keep what you wish, for I only advised against it because it was difficult for people. Indeed, every intoxicant is prohibited."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein qabron ki ziyarat se, teen din se zyada qurbani ka gosht khane se, aur bartano mein nabidh banane se mana kiya tha, khabardar! Ab qabron ki ziyarat karo, kyunke yeh duniya se be-raghbat karti hai aur aakhirat yaad dilati hai, aur qurbani ka gosht khao aur jitna chaho rakh lo, kyunke maine tumhein sirf isliye mana kiya tha ke woh waqt tang tha, taake logon ko aasani ho, khabardar! Koi bartan kisi cheez ko haram nahi karta, balke har nashe wali cheez haram hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: I forbade you to visit graves, but you may now visit them, for in visiting them there is a reminder (of death). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3235)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein qabron ki ziyarat se mana kiya tha, ab unki ziyarat karo, kyunke yeh tumhein maut yaad dilati hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ visited his mother's grave in a thousand turbans and he was never seen crying so much as on that day.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne apni waalida ki qabar ki ziyarat ki, hazar (1000) parde-daar logon ke sath, aap (SAW) ko us din se zyada rote hue kabhi nahi dekha gaya."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited his mother's grave and wept and cause those around him to weep. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said: I asked my Lord's permission to pray for forgiveness for her, but I was not allowed. I then asked His permission to visit her grave, and I was allowed. So visit graves, for they make one mindful of death. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3234)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni waalida ki qabar ki ziyarat ki, to aap (SAW) roye aur apne aas-paas walon ko bhi rulaaya, phir farmaya: "Maine apne Rab se ijaazat maangi ke main unke liye maghfirat maangun, mujhe ijaazat nahi mili, aur maine unse ijaazat maangi ke main unki qabar ki ziyarat karun, to mujhe ijaazat mil gayi, isliye qabron ki ziyarat karo, kyunke yeh maut yaad dilati hai." Yeh hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih hai magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  close to a thousand riders, so he stopped with us and prayed two units of prayer. Then he turned to us with his face, and his eyes were shedding tears. Umar approached him and said, "May my mother and father be sacrificed for you, O Messenger of Allah! What's wrong with you?" He said, "I sought permission from my Lord to seek forgiveness for my mother, but He did not grant me permission. So, my eyes shed tears out of mercy for her. And I sought permission from my Lord to visit her grave, and He granted me permission. And indeed, I had prohibited you from visiting graves, but now visit them, as it will increase you in goodness."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath taqreeban aik hazar (1000) sawaaron ke sath thay, aap (SAW) humare sath rukay aur humein do rak'atein padhayi, phir apna chehra humari taraf kiya jabke aap (SAW) ki aankhon se aansu beh rahe the. Umar (RA) unke paas gaye aur apne maa-baap unpar qurbaan karte huay poocha: "Aapko kya hua hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine apne Rab se apni waalida ke liye maghfirat maangne ki ijaazat maangi thi, mujhe ijaazat nahi mili, to unpar reham khakar meri aankhon se aansu beh gaye, aur maine apne Rab se unki qabar ki ziyarat ki ijaazat maangi, to mujhe ijaazat mil gayi, aur maine tumhein qabron ki ziyarat se mana kiya tha, ab unki ziyarat karo, aur unki ziyarat tumhein khair mein badhaye."

e: [AI] "Aisha arrived one day from the graves, so I said to her, 'O mother of the believers, from where did you come?' She said, 'From the grave of my brother Abdul-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr.' So I said to her, 'Wasn't it the case that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited visiting graves?' She said, 'Yes, he indeed prohibited it, then he was commanded to visit them.'"
hi: Aisha (RA) aik din qabristan se wapas aayi, maine unse poocha: "Aye Umm-ul-Momineen, aap kahan se aa rahi hain?" Unhone kaha: "Apne bhai Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr (RA) ki qabar se." Maine unse poocha: "Kya Rasulullah (SAW) ne qabron ki ziyarat se mana nahi kiya tha?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, mana kiya tha, phir unki ziyarat ka hukum diya gaya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I used to prohibit you from visiting graves, but now I encourage you to do so, for it softens the heart, brings tears to the eyes, and reminds you of the hereafter. However, do not say anything that will bring harm."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein qabron ki ziyarat se mana kiya tha, khabardar! Ab unki ziyarat karo, kyunke yeh dil ko naram karti hai, aankh ko nam karti hai, aur aakhirat yaad dilati hai, aur bakwaas (be-hooda baatein) na karo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "I used to forbid you from visiting graves, but whoever wishes to visit a grave, let him do so, as it softens the heart, brings tears to the eyes, and reminds of the Hereafter."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein qabron ki ziyarat se mana kiya tha, ab jo chahe kisi qabar ki ziyarat kare, kyunke yeh dil ko naram karti hai, aankh ko nam karti hai, aur aakhirat yaad dilati hai."

e: [AI] "To me, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ , visit the graves, as it reminds one of the hereafter. Wash the dead, for treating their bodies is a powerful reminder. Pray for the deceased, as it may sadden you, but surely, the one who is saddened in the shade of Allah will encounter all good."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Qabron ki ziyarat karo taake aakhirat yaad rahe, murdon ko ghusl do, kyunke jism ke sath (yeh) mu'aamla karna aik bharpoor naseehat hai, aur janazon par namaz padho, shayad yeh tumhein ghamgeen kar de, kyunke ghamgeen shakhs Allah ke saaye mein har khair ke saamne aata hai."

e: [AI] That Fatimah, the daughter of the Prophet (Peace be upon him), used to visit the grave of her uncle Hamza every Friday and pray and cry by it. This hadith is narrated by trustworthy narrators, and I have thoroughly researched the encouragement to visit graves in order to participate in promoting its virtues and for the sinner to know his own shortcomings. It is a recommended practice. May Allah bless Muhammad and his family.
hi: Fatimah (Alayha as-Salam), Nabi (SAW) ki beti, "har Jum'e apne chacha Hamzah (RA) ki qabar ki ziyarat karti thin, wahan namaz padhti thin aur rotin thin." Is hadith ke raawi aakhir tak thiqa hain, aur maine qabron ki ziyarat ki targheeb mein poori koshish ki hai taake main is neki mein shareek ho sakun, aur taake kanjoos shakhs apni kotahi jaan le ke yeh aik masnoon Sunnat hai. Wa sallallahu ala Muhammadin wa aalihi ajma'in.

e: [AI] I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ  when a funeral procession passed by. He asked, "What is this?" They replied, "It is the funeral of so and so, who used to love Allah and His Messenger, and act obediently towards Allah and strive in His cause." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "It is obligatory, it is obligatory, it is obligatory." Then another funeral procession passed by, and they said, "It is the funeral of so and so, who used to despise Allah and His Messenger, and disobey Allah and strive in sins." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "It is obligatory, it is obligatory, it is obligatory." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, your statement about the funeral and praising it, you praised the first and condemned the second." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Yes, indeed, O Abu Bakr. Verily, Allah has angels who convey the words of the people to other humans, whether they are good or bad."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke sath baitha tha ke aik janaza guzra, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Fulan bin Fulan ka janaza hai, woh Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) se mohabbat karta tha aur Allah ki itaa'at mein amal karta aur uski koshish karta tha." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wajib ho gayi, wajib ho gayi, wajib ho gayi." Phir aik doosra janaza guzra, unhone kaha: "Fulan bin Fulan ka janaza hai, woh Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) se nafrat karta tha aur Allah ki na-farmani mein amal karta aur uski koshish karta tha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wajib ho gayi, wajib ho gayi, wajib ho gayi." To unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapki baat janaze ke baare mein aur uski tareef ke baare mein - pehle ki tareef achhi hui aur doosre ki bura, aur aapne dono ke baare mein farmaya: 'wajib ho gayi, wajib ho gayi, wajib ho gayi'?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, aye Abu Bakr (RA), Allah ke kuch farishte hain jo Aadam ki aulad ki zubaanon par insaan mein maujood khair aur sharr ka bayan karte hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "There is no Muslim who dies and four people from his closest neighbors testify that they only knew goodness from him, except that Allah, the Exalted and Blessed, accepts your testimony and forgives him for what you do not know."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Musalman aisa nahi jo mar jaye aur uske sabse qareebi padosiyon ke gharon mein se chaar log uske liye gawahi dein ke unhein usme siwaye khair ke aur kuch pata nahi, magar Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala farmata hai: 'Maine tumhari baat,' - ya farmaya: 'tumhari gawahi qubool kar li,' 'aur jo tum nahi jaante usse bhi maaf kar diya.'"

e: [AI] A man came to the messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O messenger of Allah, guide me to a deed that if I do it, I will enter paradise." He replied, "Be good and kind to others." The man asked, "How will I know if I am good and kind?" He said, "Ask your neighbors. If they say that you are good and kind, then you are, and if they say that you are not, then you are not."
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye ke agar main uspar amal karoon to Jannat mein dakhil ho jaun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nek insaan bano." Usne poocha: "Mujhe kaise pata chalega ke main nek hoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne padosiyon se poocho, agar woh kahein ke tum nek ho to tum nek ho, aur agar woh kahein ke tum bure ho to tum bure ho."

e: [AI] It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, who are the people of Paradise?" He said, "Those who do not die until their ears are filled with what they love." It was said, "Who are the people of Hell?" He said, "Those who do not die until their ears are filled with what they dislike."
hi: Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Jannat wale kaun hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh jo nahi marta jab tak uske kaan usse aziz cheez se bhar nahi jaate." Poocha gaya: "Jahannam wale kaun hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh jo nahi marta jab tak uske kaan usse napasand cheez se bhar nahi jaate."

e: Um Al-ʿAla an Ansari woman who had given a pledge of allegiance to Messenger of Allah ﷺ told me:, "The Muhajirln (emigrants) were distributed amongst us by drawing lots, and we got ʿUthman bin Maz'un in our share. We made him stay with us in our house. Then he suffered from a disease which proved fatal. When he died and was given a bath and was shrouded in his clothes. Messenger of Allah ﷺ came, I said, (addressing the dead body), 'O Aba As-Sa'ib! May Allah be Merciful to you! I testify that Allah has honored you.' Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'How do you know that Allah has honored him?" I replied, 'Let my father be sacrificed for you, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! On whom else shall Allah bestow. His honor?' Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'As for him, by Allah, death has come to him. By Allah, I wish him all good (from Allah). By Allah, in spite of the fact that I am Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I do not know what Allah will do to me.", Um Al-ʿAla added, "By Allah, I will never attest the righteousness of anybody after that." (Using translation from Bukhārī 7003)
hi: Unhone unhein bataya ke Umm Al-Ala (RA), jo Ansar ki aik aurat thi aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se bai'at ki thi, unhone unhein bataya ke Muhajireen ko unke darmiyan qur'e ke zariye taqseem kiya gaya, to humein Uthman bin Mazhun (RA) mile, humne unhein apne gharon mein thaharaya, phir woh us bimari mein mubtala huay jisme unka intiqal ho gaya. Jab unka intiqal hua, unhein ghusl diya gaya aur unhi ke kapdon mein kafnaya gaya, Rasulullah (SAW) tashreef laaye, to maine kaha: "Aye Uthman bin Mazhun (RA), Allah ki rahmat ho tumpar, aye Abu As-Sa'ib, meri gawahi hai ke Allah ne tumhein izzat di hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhein kaise pata ke Allah ne unhein izzat di hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap (SAW) par qurbaan hon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), phir Allah kise izzat dega?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahi baat unki, to unhein yaqeen (maut) aa chuki hai, Allah ki qasam, main unke liye khair ki ummeed rakhta hoon, aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe khud nahi pata, jabke main Allah ka Rasool hoon, mere sath kya kiya jayega." Unhone kaha: to Allah ki qasam, iske baad maine kabhi kisi ke liye (bila shak) neki ki gawahi nahi di.

e: [AI] "He used to say after the Tashahhud words that he would greatly emphasize them. I said, 'Both of them?' He replied, 'Rather, in the other second unit of prayer after the Tashahhud.' I asked, 'What are they?' He said, 'I seek refuge in Allah from the punishment of Hell, and I seek refuge in Allah from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in Allah from the evil of the Antichrist, and I seek refuge in Allah from the trials of life and death.' He used to greatly emphasize them." Ibn Jurayj said, "Abdullah ibn Tawus informed me, who informed me from his father, who heard it from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ ."
hi: "Woh tashahhud ke baad kuch kalimaat kaha karte the jinhein woh bohot ehmiyat dete the." Maine poocha: "Dono (rak'aton) mein?" Unhone kaha: "Balke doosri (aakhri) do-rakati (namaz) mein, tashahhud ke baad." Maine poocha: "Woh kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "A'oozu billahi min azabi Jahannam, wa a'oozu billahi min azabil-qabr, wa a'oozu billahi min sharril-Maseehid-Dajjal, wa a'oozu billahi min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat (Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon Jahannam ke azab se, aur Allah ki panah maangta hoon qabar ke azab se, aur Allah ki panah maangta hoon Maseeh Dajjal ke sharr se, aur Allah ki panah maangta hoon zindagi aur maut ke fitne se)." Unhone kaha: aur woh isse bohot ehmiyat dete the. Ibn Jurayj ne kaha: mujhe Abdullah bin Tawus ne apne walid se, unhone Aisha (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, yeh bataya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, the deceased can hear the sound of their footsteps when they turn away. If they are a believer, their prayer will be near their head, their fasting will be on their right, and their zakat will be on their left. The acts of goodness such as charity, prayer, maintaining family ties, and kindness towards people will come in front of their feet. Then it will be said to them to sit down, and they will sit down. The sun will be shown to them, nearing its setting. They will be asked, 'What do you say about this man who was among you and what do you testify about him?' They will say, 'Let me pray.' They will be told, 'You will pray, but inform us about what we ask you.' They will say, 'Let me pray.' They will be told, 'You will pray, but inform us about what we ask you.' They will say, 'Let me pray.' They will be told, 'You will pray, but inform us about what we ask you.' They will say, 'Let me pray.' They will be told, 'You will pray, but inform us about what we ask you.' They will say, 'Let me pray.' They will say, 'What do you say about this man who was among you and what do you testify about him?' They will say, 'Which man?' They will be asked, 'The man who was among you.' They will say, 'He is not guided by him.' They will be asked, 'Muhammad?' They will say, 'I heard people say, so I said as they said.' They will be told, 'You lived and died upon that. And you will be resurrected upon that, if Allah wills.' Then a door to the Hellfire will be opened before them and it will be said, 'Look at your place and what Allah has prepared for you, had you obeyed.' They will gain more regret and sorrow. Then a door to Paradise will be opened before them and it will be said, 'Look at your place and what Allah has prepared for you.' They will gain more happiness and joy. This is the saying of Allah: 'Allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allah sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allah does what He wills.' [Ibrahim 27]." Abu Al-Hakam narrated it from Abu Hurairah, and it was said to him, "Let him rest, the rest of a bridegroom who is not awakened except by the closest of his family or the ones dearest to his heart." Then he returned to the Hadith of Abu Salamah from Abu Hurairah, who said, "And if he is a disbeliever, nothing comes to him from his head, and nothing comes to him from his right, and nothing comes to him from his left, and nothing comes to him from his feet. It will be said to him to sit down, and he will sit down in fear and terror. He will be asked, 'What do you say about this man who was among you and what do you testify about him?' He will say, 'Which man?' They will say, 'The man who was among you.' He will say, 'I say nothing about him.' They will be asked, 'Muhammad?' He will say, 'I didn't hear anything about him.' They will be told, 'You lived and died upon that. And you will be resurrected upon that, if Allah wills.' Then a door to Paradise will be opened before them and it will be said, 'Look at your place and what Allah has prepared for you, had you obeyed.' They will gain more regret and destruction. Then his grave will constrict upon him until his ribs close in on each other. This is the saying of Allah: 'Then indeed, for him is a restricted living. And We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind.' [Ta-Ha 124]."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak mayyat unke jooton ki aahat sunta hai jab woh mudkar chale jaate hain. Agar woh momin ho to namaz uske sar ke paas, roza uski dayen taraf, zakat uski bayen taraf, aur neki ke kaam - sadqa, sila-e-rahmi, achhaai aur logon ke sath ehsaan - uske paon ke paas hote hain. To (farishte) uske sar ki taraf se aate hain, namaz kehti hai: "Mera koi rasta (mujhse) nahi." Woh uski dayen taraf se aate hain, roza kehta hai: "Mera koi rasta nahi." Woh uski bayen taraf se aate hain, zakat kehti hai: "Mera koi rasta nahi." Woh uske paon ki taraf se aate hain, neki ke kaam kehte hain: "Mera koi rasta nahi." To usse kaha jata hai: "Baith jao," woh baith jata hai, aur usse suraj dikhaya jata hai jo ghurub hone ke qareeb hota hai, to usse kaha jata hai: "Tum us aadmi ke baare mein kya kehte ho jo tum mein tha, aur uske baare mein kya gawahi dete ho?" Woh kehta hai: "Mujhe namaz padhne do." Woh kehte hain: "Tum zaroor padhoge, lekin pehle humein woh bata do jo hum tumse poochte hain." Woh kehta hai: "Tum mujhse kis baare mein poochte ho?" Woh kehte hain: "Humein bata do jo hum tumse poochte hain." Woh kehta hai: "Mujhe namaz padhne do." Woh kehte hain: "Tum zaroor padhoge, lekin pehle humein woh bata do jo hum tumse poochte hain." Woh kehta hai: "Tum mujhse kya poochte ho?" Woh kehte hain: "Humein bata do tum us aadmi ke baare mein kya kehte ho jo tum mein tha, aur uske baare mein kya gawahi dete ho?" Woh kehta hai: "Muhammad (SAW), main gawahi deta hoon ke woh Allah ke bande hain, aur ke woh Allah ki taraf se haq lekar aaye." To usse kaha jata hai: "Isi par tum zinda rahe, isi par tum mare, aur isi par Insha'Allah tumhein uthaya jayega." Phir uske liye aag ki taraf se aik darwaza khola jata hai, usse kaha jata hai: "Apni jagah dekho aur (dekho) Allah ne tumhare liye kya taiyyar kiya tha agar tumne na-farmani ki hoti," to uski khushi aur masarrat aur badh jati hai. Phir uske liye Jannat ki taraf se aik darwaza khola jata hai, usse kaha jata hai: "Apni jagah dekho aur (dekho) Allah ne tumhare liye kya taiyyar kiya hai," to uski khushi aur masarrat aur badh jati hai. Aur yehi hai Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Allah eman walon ko mazboot baat ke sath sabit rakhta hai duniya ki zindagi mein aur aakhirat mein, aur Allah zaalimon ko gumraah karta hai, aur Allah jo chahe karta hai}" (Surah Ibrahim 27). Unhone kaha: aur Abu Al-Hakam ne Abu Hurairah (RA) se kaha: to usse kaha jata hai: "Isse dulhan ki neend sula do, jise sirf uske ghar walon mein sabse aziz ya sabse mehboob shakhs hi jagaata hai." Phir Abu Salamah ki, Abu Hurairah (RA) se, hadith ki taraf laut aaye, unhone kaha: aur agar woh kaafir ho, to uske sar ki taraf se aaya jata hai, kuch nahi milta, aur uski dayen taraf se aaya jata hai, kuch nahi milta, phir uski bayen taraf se aaya jata hai, kuch nahi milta, phir uske paon ki taraf se aaya jata hai, kuch nahi milta, to usse kaha jata hai: "Baith jao," woh khauf aur dehshat mein baith jata hai, to usse kaha jata hai: "Tum us aadmi ke baare mein kya kehte ho jo tum mein tha, aur uske baare mein kya gawahi dete ho?" Woh kehta hai: "Kaunsa aadmi?" Woh kehte hain: "Woh aadmi jo tum mein tha." Unhone kaha: to usse rehnumai nahi milti. Unhone kaha: woh kehte hain: "Muhammad." Woh kehta hai: "Maine logon ko kehte suna tha, to maine bhi wahi kaha jo unhone kaha." Woh kehte hain: "Isi par tum zinda rahe, isi par tum mare, aur isi par Insha'Allah tumhein uthaya jayega." Phir uske liye Jannat ki taraf se aik darwaza khola jata hai, usse kaha jata hai: "Apni jagah dekho aur (dekho) Allah ne tumhare liye kya taiyyar kiya tha agar tumne uski itaa'at ki hoti," to uska afsos aur halakat aur badh jati hai. Unhone kaha: phir uski qabar usse itni tang kar di jati hai ke uski paslian aik doosre mein ghus jati hain. Unhone kaha: aur yehi hai Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{To uske liye tangi wali zindagi hai, aur hum use Qayamat ke din andha uthayenge}" (Surah Ta-Ha 124).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "I swear by the One in whose hand is my soul, he can hear the sound of their footsteps when they turn away from him." Then he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner, except that the hadith of Sa'id ibn 'Amir is more complete.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, beshak woh unke jooton ki aahat sunta hai jab woh uski taraf se mudkar chalte hain," phir hadith isi jaisi zikr ki, siwaye is ke ke Sa'eed bin Aamir ki hadith zyada mukammal hai.

e: [AI] From Abu Hurairah, in his saying, Almighty and Sublime: "In a narrow means of subsistence" [Taha 124], he said, "the punishment of the grave."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, Allah Azza wa Jalla ke farmaan "{Tangi wali zindagi}" (Surah Ta-Ha 124) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Qabar ka azab."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  went out for a funeral procession with Umar ibn Al-Khattab. He heard women crying, so Umar raised his voice to calm them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Umar, "O Umar, let them be, for the eye sheds tears, the soul feels sorrow, and the appointed time is near."
hi: Nabi (SAW) aik janaze ke liye nikle, unke sath Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) thay, aap (SAW) ne auraton ko rote hue suna, to Umar (RA) ne unhein daanta, Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Umar, unhein rehne do, kyunke aankh aansu bahati hai, dil ghamgeen hota hai, aur judaai abhi taaza hai."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned from Uhud, he heard the women of the Ansar crying, so he said, "But Hamza has no sisters." This reached the women of the Ansar, so they cried for Hamza. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then slept, and when he woke up and saw them crying, he said, "Woe to them, why do they continue to cry since that day? They should remain silent and not cry for this deceased after today."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Uhud se wapas aaye to unhone Ansar ki auraton ko rote hue suna, to farmaya: "Magar Hamzah (RA) ke liye koi rone wali nahi." Yeh baat Ansar ki auraton tak pahunchi, to unhone Hamzah (RA) ke liye rona shuru kar diya. Rasulullah (SAW) so gaye, phir jaage jabke woh (abhi bhi) ro rahi thin, to farmaya: "Inhein afsos ho, yeh aaj se hi ro rahi hain, ab inhein khamosh ho jana chahiye aur aaj ke baad kisi mayyat par na rona chahiye."

e: [AI] "To take handfuls of dirt and throw it at the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ? Fatimah said, 'O my dear father, he answered a call from his Lord, O my dear father, an invitation from his Lord, O my dear father, Paradise of Al-Firdaus is his abode, O my dear father, Jibril has informed him.' Sa'id ibn Mansur added in his narration from Abu Usamah who said, 'I heard Hammad ibn Zaid saying, 'I saw Thabit al-Bunani when he narrated this hadith, he cried until I saw his ribs trembling.'''
hi: ...ke Rasulullah (SAW) par mitti dalen? Unhone kaha: aur Fatimah (Alayha as-Salam) ne kaha: "Aye mere abba, unhone aik Rab ki pukaar ka jawaab diya jisne unhein bulaya. Aye mere abba, apne Rab se kitne qareeb ho gaye. Aye mere abba, Jannat-ul-Firdaus unka thikaana hai. Aye mere abba, hum Jibra'il (AS) ko unki khabar dete hain." Sa'eed bin Mansoor ne apni hadith mein, Abu Usama se, ziyaadti ki, unhone kaha: maine Hammad bin Zaid ko kehte hue suna: "Maine Thabit Al-Bunani ko dekha, jab unhone humein yeh hadith sunayi, woh rone lage yahan tak ke maine unki paslian kaanpte huay dekhein."

e: "Do not wail over me, for no one wailed over the Messenger of Allah." This is an abridgment. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1851)
hi: "Jab main mar jaun to mujhpar noha na karo, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) par noha nahi kiya gaya tha."

e: [AI] When Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, died, Osama bin Zaid shouted, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "This is not from me, nor is it the cry of someone truly grieving. The heart feels sorrow and the eye sheds tears, but Allah is not angered."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ke bete Ibrahim ka intiqal hua to Usamah bin Zaid (RA) cheekh utthe, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh mujhse (mansoob) nahi hai, aur na hi cheekhna sahih (tareeqa) hai, dil ghamgeen hota hai aur aankh aansu bahati hai, magar Rab naraaz nahi hota."

e: [AI] "Abu Huraira said: 'When I die, do not lament over me, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was not lamented over.' This statement attributed to Abu Huraira is very strange, except that Uthman Al-Ghaffani is not one of the conditions of our book here."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) [ne kaha]: "Jab main mar jaun to mujhpar noha na karo, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) par noha nahi kiya gaya tha." Yeh ziyaadti Abu Hurairah (RA) se bohot gharib (na-mamool) hai, magar Uthman Al-Ghatafani hamari is kitaab ki shart mein shamil nahi.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to discourage mourning for the deceased. Ibrahim ibn Muslim al-Hajari is not the only one who reported this, except that the two Sheikh's did not use it as evidence. And this hadith is a witness to what has been mentioned before, and it is a strange but authentic hadith. Indeed, Muslim has used it as evidence, along with Shareek ibn Abdullah.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) marasi (murdon par nauha/marsiye) se mana kiya karte the." Ibrahim bin Muslim Al-Hajari matrook (chhoda hua) nahi hain, magar Shaykhain ne unhein hujjat nahi maana, aur yeh hadith pichli baat ka shahid hai, aur yeh gharib sahih hai, kyunke Muslim ne Shareek bin Abdullah ko hujjat maana hai.

e: [AI] Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, in my Ummah (community) there are four aspects of the pre-Islamic era (Ignorance) that they will not abandon: boasting in lineage, ridiculing one's ancestry, seeking rain by the stars, and wailing over the deceased. Indeed, if the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment wearing garments of molten tar, and boiling will be poured on them from the flames of Hell."
hi: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (RA) [ne kaha]: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat mein jahiliyat ke chaar (kaam) hain jinhein woh chhodne wale nahi: hasab-nasab par fakhr karna, ansaab mein taana-zani, sitaron se baarish maangna, aur mayyat par noha karna. Beshak noha karne wali agar khadi hone se pehle tauba na kare, to woh Qayamat ke din is haal mein uthegi ke uspar tar (qatran) ke kurte hongay, phir unpar aag ke sholon se banay huay zire (kavach) ubalengay."

e: [AI] "When the verse 'When the believing women come to you to pledge allegiance to you' [Al-Mumtahina 12] until the phrase 'and they do not disobey you' [Al-Mumtahina 12] was revealed, there was a mourning from him. So I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, except for the family of so-and-so, as they used to make me happy during the period of ignorance, so I must make them happy.' He said, 'Except for the family of so-and-so.'"
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Jab momin auratein aapse bai'at karne aayen}" (Surah Al-Mumtahanah 12) "{aur woh aapki na-farmani na karengi}" tak, to isme noha (na karne ki shart) shamil thi, to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), siwaye fulan khandan ke, kyunke unhone jahiliyat mein mujhe khush kiya tha, isliye mujhe unhein bhi khush karna hoga." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Siwaye fulan khandan ke (bhi nahi)."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Huraira while he was in the house of Umm al-Darda saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are three acts that constitute disbelief in Allah: tearing the garment, wailing and lamenting, and slandering one's lineage." (Authentic in its chain of narrators, but they did not record it.)
hi: Maine Abu Hurairah (RA) ko, jabke woh Umm Ad-Darda (RA) ke ghar mein thay, yeh kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen baatein Allah ke sath kufr mein se hain: girebaan phaadna, noha karna, aur ansaab mein taana-zani." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to visit and inquire about the Ansar. He was informed about a woman from the Ansar whose son had died and she had no one else. She was grieving intensely. The Prophet ﷺ  went to her and advised her to fear Allah and to be patient. She said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who cannot give birth and I have no one else." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The one whose children remain alive is considered to have riqqub." Then he said, "There is no Muslim man or woman who loses three of their children except that Allah will admit them to Paradise because of them." Omar said, "O Messenger of Allah, even if they are two?" He replied, "Even if they are two." The chain of narration is authentic and they did not mention riqqub.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Ansar ki khabar-giri karte aur unki ayaadat karte aur unke haal poochte the, to unhein Ansar ki aik aurat ke baare mein khabar mili jiska beta mar gaya tha aur uske ilawa koi aur beta na tha, aur woh uspar bohot bequraar thi. Nabi (SAW) uske paas aaye aur usse taqwa aur sabr ka hukum diya, to usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aik 'raqub' (bad-naseeb) aurat hoon, mujhe aur aulad nahi hoti, aur mera koi aur beta nahi tha." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "'Raqub' woh hai jiski aulad zinda rehti hai (uske marne ke baad)," phir farmaya: "Koi Musalman mard ya aurat aisi nahi jiski teen aulaadein mar jaayen magar Allah unki wajah se unhein Jannat mein dakhil kar deta hai." Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, aur do (aulaadein)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur do bhi." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise "raqub" ke zikr ke sath nahi nikala.

e: [AI] A man used to come to the Prophet ﷺ  with his son. The Prophet ﷺ  asked him, "Do you love him?" He (the man) replied, "I love him, as Allah has loved him." The Prophet ﷺ  then lost the son and asked, "What happened to so-and-so?" They replied, "His son has passed away." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Would it not please you that every time you enter one of the gates of Paradise, you find him waiting for you?" A man asked, "Even for me specifically or for all of us?" The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "For all of you."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aata tha aur apne bete ko sath laata tha, Nabi (SAW) ne usse poocha: "Kya tum isse mohabbat karte ho?" Usne kaha: "Allah aapko usi tarah mohabbat kare jaise aap usse mohabbat karte hain." Phir Nabi (SAW) ne usse na paaya to poocha: "Fulan ka kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Unka beta mar gaya." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein yeh baat khush nahi karti ke tum Jannat ke kisi darwaze par na aao magar use apna intezar karta hua paao?" Aik shakhs ne poocha: "Kya yeh sirf unke liye hai ya humme sab ke liye?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke tum sabke liye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The children of the believers are in a mountain in paradise, protected by Ibrahim and Sarah, until they are returned to their fathers on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momino ki aulaadein Jannat mein aik pahaad par hongi, Ibrahim (AS) aur Sarah unki kafalat karengay, yahan tak ke Qayamat ke din unhein unke waalidain ko wapas kar dengay."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prohibited insulting the deceased, so why do you insult Ali even though he has passed away?
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne murdon ko gaali dene se mana kiya, to tum Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kyun gaali dete ho jabke woh guzar chuke hain?

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do not harm a Muslim by insulting a non-believer."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi kaafir ko gaali dekar kisi Musalman ko takleef na do."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Make a mention of the virtues of your dead, and refrain from (mentioning) their evils. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4900)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne murdon ki achhaiyon ka zikr karo aur unki buraiyon se ruk jao."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr and Uthman, the sons of Abu Shaybah, narrated from Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah, who narrated from 'Amr ibn Dinar, who narrated from 'Ata' ibn Abi Rabah, who narrated from Ibn Abbas, who said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Do not defile your deceased, for a Muslim does not defile the living or the dead." This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of al-Bukhari and Muslim, but they did not include it in their collections.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne murdon ko napaak mat samjho, kyunke Musalman napaak nahi hota, chahe woh zinda ho ya mardah." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "The angels praised Adam four times, Abu Bakr praised the Prophet four times, Umar praised Abu Bakr four times, Suhaib praised Umar four times, Hasan praised Ali four times, and Husayn praised Hasan four times."
hi: "Farishton ne Adam (AS) par chaar (4) takbeerein kahin, Abu Bakr (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) par chaar takbeerein kahin, Umar (RA) ne Abu Bakr (RA) par chaar takbeerein kahin, Suhaib (RA) ne Umar (RA) par chaar takbeerein kahin, Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) par chaar takbeerein kahin, aur Al-Husain (Alayhis Salam) ne Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) par chaar takbeerein kahin."

e: [AI] "The last thing that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  made tasbih (saying Allahu akbar) for at funerals was four takbeers. Umar made four takbeers for Abu Bakr, Abdullah bin Umar made four takbeers for Umar, Hasan bin Ali made four takbeers for Ali, and Husayn bin Ali made four takbeers for Hasan. The angels made four takbeers for Adam. I am not unaware that Furat ibn Al-Sa'ib is not among the conditions of this book, but I have mentioned him as a witness."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne janazon par jo aakhri takbeerein kahin woh chaar (4) thin." Umar (RA) ne Abu Bakr (RA) par chaar takbeerein kahin, Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Umar (RA) par chaar takbeerein kahin, Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) par chaar takbeerein kahin, Al-Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) par chaar takbeerein kahin, aur farishton ne Adam (AS) par chaar takbeerein kahin. "Main un logon mein se nahi jisse yeh baat chhupi ho ke Furat bin As-Saib hamari is kitaab ki shart mein shamil nahi, maine unhein sirf shahid ke tor par nikala hai."

e: "Ibn Abbas performed Salat for a funeral and he recited Fatihatil-Kitab. So I asked him about it and he said: 'It is from the Sunnah' or, 'From the completeness of the Sunnah.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1027)
hi: Ke yeh Sunnat hai, ya Sunnat ki takmeel mein se hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no obligatory washing upon you when washing your deceased. When you wash them, your deceased is not impure. It is sufficient for you to wash your hands."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne mayyat ko ghusl dene ke baad tumpar (khud) ghusl (wajib) nahi, kyunke tumhara mayyat napaak nahi hota, tumhare liye apne haath dhona hi kaafi hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded for charity, and a man came forward with some broken items. Sufyan, referring to the man, said, "He means wooden items." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "Who brought these?" No one used to bring anything unless it was attributed to the one who brought it. Then the verse was revealed, "And do not give the weak-minded your property, which Allah has made a means of sustenance for you" (Quran 2:267). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  also forbade using damaged items and the skin of the grape (as means of charity). Az-Zuhri said, "Two types of dates were used as charity."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne sadqe ka hukum diya, to aik shakhs is (bagair) bachche (khajoor) mein se khushk khajoorein le aaya, Sufyan ne kaha: ya'ni khushk (bekaar) khajoorein, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kaun laaya hai?" Aur koi shakhs kuch nahi laata tha magar usse laane wale ki taraf mansoob kar diya jata tha, to yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Aur bekaar cheez ka qasad na karo ke usme se kharch karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267). Unhone kaha: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Al-Ju'rur aur Lawn Al-Hubaiq (khajoor ki do kamzor qismein) ko sadqe mein lene se mana kiya." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Yeh sadqe ki khajoor ki do (kamzor) qismein hain."

e: [AI] "People used to seek good omens by examining the characteristics of their fruits. So Allah, the Almighty, revealed the following verse: 'Do not seek to gain evil omens from it that you may spend your wealth, while you know its harm; and you will not obtain anything except that you overlook its evil.' [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:267] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then prohibited seeking omens from two things: the jujube fruit and the hubeiq fruit."
hi: Log jaan-boojh kar apne phalon mein se sabse bekaar (fruits) (sadqe mein) dete the, to Allah Azza wa Jalla ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "{Aur bekaar cheez ka qasad na karo ke usme se kharch karo, jabke tum khud use lene wale nahi, siwaye is ke ke tum aankh band kar lo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267). Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne khajoor ki do (kamzor) qismon - Al-Ju'rur aur Lawn Al-Hubaiq - se mana kiya.

e: "Sahl bin Abi Hathmah came to us when we were in the market and said: "The Messenger of Allah said: When you have estimated, take two-thirds (of the portion you have estimated as Zakah) and leave one-third, and if you do not take (two-thirds) or leave one-third. (One of the reporters) Shu 'bah doubted - leave one quarter." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2491)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum andaaza lagao to (do tihaai) le lo aur (aik) tihaai chhod do, agar tum na lo ya (aik) tihaai na chhodo" - Shu'bah ko tihaai mein shak tha - "to (aik) chauthaai chhod do."

e: [AI] And he said: "When you come to a land, cultivate it and leave for them what they eat."
hi: Aur farmaya: "Jab tum kisi zameen (ke phal) ka andaaza lagane aao, to unke liye utna chhod do jitna woh kha sakein."

e: [AI] A man from the Banu 'Amir passed by him, and it was said, "This man is one of the wealthiest people." Abu Huraira called him and asked him about that. It was said, "Yes, I have a hundred red camels, and I have a hundred black camels, and I have such and such a number of sheep." Abu Huraira said, "Beware of exaggerating in your camels and your sheep. Indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'No man has camels, and he does not fulfill their rights regarding their food and water, their crossings, their difficulties and ease, except that a bald spot appears on his head, and he comes walking on his feet as a result of the camels walking on his feet. Whenever they pass, the last ones are sent back to him before the first ones on a day whose duration is fifty thousand years, until Allah judges between people, and he sees his path. And there is no servant who possesses cows and does not fulfill their rights regarding their food and water, their good condition, and their signs of health, except that a bald spot appears on his head, and he comes walking on his feet as a result of the cows walking on his feet. Whenever they pass, the last ones are sent back to him before the first ones on a day whose duration is fifty thousand years, until Allah judges between people, and he sees his path.'” Abbas said to him, "What are the rights of the camels, O Abu Huraira?" He said, "They should be given the best, they should be given water abundantly, they should be fattened, their backs should be protected, and they should be given milk."
hi: Banu Aamir ka aik shakhs unke paas se guzra, kaha gaya: "Yeh sabse zyada maal wale logon mein se hai." To Abu Hurairah (RA) ne usse bulaya aur is baare mein poocha, to usne kaha: "Ji haan, mere paas sau (100) surkh (oont) hain, aur sau (100) saanwle (oont) hain, aur mere paas itni-itni bakriyaan hain." To Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Oonton ke khuron se bacho, bakriyon ke khuron se bacho, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Koi aisa aadmi nahi jiske paas oont hon aur woh unke mushkil aur aasan waqt mein unki mehnat aur doodh ka haq ada na kare, magar Qayamat ke din woh khule maidan mein us shakhs ke saamne pesh kiye jayenge jitne mote aur taaqatwar - ya sabse mote, ya sabse bade - woh ho sakte hain, woh apne khuron se usse rondengay aur apne seengon se usse maarengay, jab jab unka aakhri (oont) guzar jayega to unka pehla wapas laaya jayega, aik aise din mein jiski miqdaar pachaas hazaar (50,000) saal hogi, yahan tak ke logon ke darmiyan faisla ho jaye, phir woh apna rasta dekhega. Aur koi aisa bandah nahi jiske paas gaay-bail hon aur woh unke mushkil aur aasan waqt mein unka haq ada na kare.'" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "'Aur unki mehnat aur doodh, mushkil aur aasan waqt mein, magar woh khule maidan mein pesh kiye jayenge jitne mote aur taaqatwar woh ho sakte hain, apne khuron se usse rondengay aur apne seengon se usse maarengay, jab jab unka pehla guzar jayega to unka aakhri wapas laaya jayega, aik aise din mein jiski miqdaar pachaas hazaar (50,000) saal hogi, yahan tak ke Allah logon ke darmiyan faisla kar de, phir woh apna rasta dekhega.'" To Abbas (RA) ne unse poocha: "Oonton ka haq kya hai, aye Abu Hurairah?" Unhone kaha: "Behtareen (oont) dena, zyada doodh wale (oont) udhar dena, kamzor (oont) ko aaram dena, nar (oont) ko (mila kar) prajanan ke liye dena, aur doodh pilana."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to take charity from the pre-Islamic treasures and he gave Bilal ibn al-Harith an agate. When Umar came, he said to Bilal, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  didn't give you this agate to keep it away from the people. He only gave it to you so that you could work with it." Umar then cut the agate for the people. Bukhari and Muslim both narrated this incident.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne pehle daur ke ma'danon (khanon) se sadqa liya, aur unhone Bilal bin Al-Harith (RA) ko poora Al-Aqiq (ilaqa) inaayat kiya." Jab Umar (RA) ka daur aaya to unhone Bilal (RA) se kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne aapko yeh isliye nahi diya tha ke aap ise logon se roken, sirf isliye diya tha ke ismein kaam kiya jaye." Unhone kaha: to Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne Al-Aqiq ka baaqi hissa logon ke liye khol diya. Bukhari ne Nu'aim bin Hammad ko aur Muslim ne Ad-Darawardi ko hujjat maana hai...

e: the Messenger of Allah sent a man from Banu Makhzun to collect charity, so he said to Abu Rafi: "Accompany me so that perhaps you may have some of it." So he said: "Not until I ask the Messenger of Allah." So he went to the Prophet to ask him, and he said: "Charity is not lawful for us, and to be the Mawda of a people to be the same as them." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 657)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Banu Makhzum ke aik shakhs ko sadqa (jama karne) par bheja, usne Abu Rafi' (RA) se kaha: "Mere sath chalo taake hum ismein se kuch hissa paayen." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, jab tak main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas jakar na poochun." To woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak sadqa humare liye halal nahi, aur (kisi) qaum ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam unhi mein se shumaar hote hain."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The person who hoards will not enter Paradise." Yazid bin Harun said, "He means the one who engages in usury."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Naajaiz mahsool (toll tax) lene wala Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga." Yazid bin Harun ne kaha: "Ya'ni Al-Ashshaar (mahsool wasool karne wale)."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  was in her house with some of his companions talking when a man came and said, "O Messenger of Allah, how much charity is required for such and such amount of dates?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "For such and such amount of dates, this much charity is required." Then the man said, "Indeed, so-and-so has wronged me and took from me such and such amount, increasing it by a sa' (a unit of measurement)." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "So what would you do if someone does more harm to you than this harm?" The people became engaged in the conversation and the narrative became fascinating, until a man among them said, "O Messenger of Allah, if a man who is absent from you takes care of his camels, his livestock, and his crops, and pays his Zakat (obligatory charity) on them, but his rights are violated, what should he do while he is absent?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever pays his Zakat with good intention, seeking the face of Allah and the Hereafter, and does not keep anything hidden from his wealth, and establishes the prayer and pays the Zakat, then if his rights are violated, he should take his weapon and fight, and if he is killed, he is a martyr."
hi: Nabi (SAW) unke ghar mein thay, aur unke paas kuch sahaba (RA) mein se log baithe baatein kar rahe the, ke aik shakhs aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), fulan-fulan khajoor ka sadqa kitna hai?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Itni-itni khajoor." To us shakhs ne kaha: "Fulan ne mujhpar zyaadti ki aur mujhse itna-itna le liya, aik sa' ziyaada le liya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "To phir kaisa hoga jab tumpar aisa shakhs muqarrar kiya jaye jo tumpar isse bhi zyada zulm kare?" Log baaton mein mashghool ho gaye aur hadith ne unhein hairat mein daal diya, yahan tak ke unme se aik shakhs ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar koi shakhs apne oonton, maweshiyon aur khaiti mein aap se door ho, aur apne maal ki zakat ada kar de, phir uspar haq ke naam par zyaadti ki jaye, to woh ghair-hazir hote huay kya kare?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs apne maal ki zakat khushi-khushi ada kare, Allah ki raza aur aakhirat ka ghar chahte huay, apne maal mein se kuch bhi na chhupaaye, namaz qaim kare aur zakat ada kare, phir uspar haq ke naam par zyaadti ki jaye, to woh apna hathiyar uthaye aur ladai kare, agar woh maara jaye to woh shaheed hai."

e: [AI] Al-Umari informed me that it wouldn't matter to you if you gained weight, and who before you would become lean, and who before me. And with God's assistance, Amr wrote: Peace be upon you. Afterward, I am here for you. A flock of camels has come to you, the first of which is with you, and the last of which is with me. Although I hope to find two ways to carry in the sea. When the first flock arrived, he called Zubair and said, "Go out with the first flock and face it tomorrow. Carry to each household what you can carry to me, and if you are unable to carry it, pass each household with a camel with what is on it, and let them dress people like we dressed them, and let them slaughter the camel, carry its hair, arrange its meat, and tan its skin. Then let them take a bowl of dough and a bowl of fat, and a handful of flour. So let them cook and eat until Allah brings them sustenance." Zubair refused to go out and said, "By Allah, you won't find anything like it until you leave this world." Then he called another person, who I think is Talha, and he came. Then he called Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah, and he participated in that. When he returned, he sent him one thousand dinars. Abu Ubaidah said, "I didn't do this for you, son of Khattab. I only did it for Allah, and I don't take anything in return for it." Umar said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  gave us some things that we were hesitant about, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  insisted on them. Accept it, O man, and seek assistance from it in your worldly affairs." Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah accepted it.
hi: Al-Umari ne mujhe khabar di: "Tumhein kya farq padta hai agar tum aur tumhare paas wale mote ho jayein aur main aur mere paas wale dubla ho jayein? Aye madad!" To Amr (RA) ne likha: "Salaam ho aap par, ammaba'd: Labbaik, Labbaik, tumhare paas aik qaafila aa raha hai jiska pehla hissa tumhare paas hoga aur aakhri hissa mere paas, isi ke sath mujhe ummeed hai ke mujhe do raaste milengay, main samundar ke raste bhi (rasad) bheju." Jab pehla qaafila pahuncha to unhone Zubair (RA) ko bulaya aur kaha: "Is qaafile ke aage nikal jao, kal isse istaqbaal karo, phir har ghar ko jitna tum le ja sako le jao, aur jise tum le jaane ki taaqat na rakho, uske liye har ghar ko aik oont uske saaman samet muqarrar kar do, aur unhein hukum do ke jaisa unhein diya jaye woh logon ko pehnayen, aur oont ko zabah karke uske baal utaarein, uska gosht sukha lein, aur uski khaal se joote banayein, phir sukhe gosht ki aik gaanth, charbi ki aik gaanth aur atte ka aik tashtari lein, use pakayen aur khayen, yahan tak ke Allah unhein rizq de." To Zubair (RA) ne nikalne se inkaar kar diya, unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tumhein iske jaisa (moqa) tab tak nahi milega jab tak tum duniya se na chale jao." Phir unhone kisi aur ko bulaya, mera khayal hai Talhah (RA) the, to woh aaye. Phir unhone Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (RA) ko bulaya, to woh usme nikle. Jab woh wapas aaye to unhone unke paas hazar (1000) dinar bheje, to Abu Ubaidah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine yeh aapke liye nahi kiya, aye Ibn Khattab, maine sirf Allah ke liye kiya hai, aur main ismein se kuch nahi loonga." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein kayi cheezon mein diya jinme humein bheja gaya tha, humein woh napasand tha, magar Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein isse inkaar karne se roka, isliye ise qubool karo, aye shakhs, aur apni duniya (ki zaroorton) mein ismein madad lo." To Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (RA) ne ise qubool kar liya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ as saying: When we appoint someone to an administrative post and provide him with an allowance, anything he takes beyond that is unfaithful dealing. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2943)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise humne kisi kaam par muqarrar kiya aur usse rizq (mu'aawiza) diya, phir usne uske baad jo kuch liya woh khiyanat hai."

e: Al-Mustawrid heard the Prophet ﷺ say: He who acts as an employee for us must get a wife; if he has not a servant, he must get one, and if he has not a dwelling, he must get one. He said that Abu Bakr reported: I was told that the Prophet ﷺ said: He who takes anything else he is unfaithful or thief. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2945)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo humara aamil ho, use chahiye ke woh biwi haasil kare, aur agar uske paas koi khadim na ho to khadim haasil kare, aur jiske paas rehne ki jagah na ho, woh rehne ki jagah haasil kare." Unhone kaha: aur mujhe bataya gaya ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo iske ilawa kuch aur haasil kare, woh khiyanat karne wala ya chor hai."

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: The official who collects sadaqah (zakat) in a just manner is like him who fights in Allah's path till he returns home. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2936)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sadqe par haq ke sath muqarrar aamil us mujahid jaisa hai jo Allah ki raah mein jihad karta hai, yahan tak ke woh apne ghar wapas aa jaye."

e: [AI] Sufyan used to pray with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, facing both Qiblas. He said, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "The best charity is that given by a person with surplus wealth to his relatives."
hi: Sufyan [ne kaha]: aur woh (unhone) Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath dono Qiblon ki taraf namaz padhi thi, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse afzal sadqa woh hai jo aise rishtedaar ko diya jaye jo dushmani rakhta ho."

e: the Messenger of Allah said: “Charity given to the poor is charity, and that given to a relative is two things: charity and upholding the ties of kinship.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1844)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Miskeen ko sadqa dena sirf sadqa hai, aur rishtedaar ko dena do cheezein hain: sadqa aur sila-e-rahmi."

e: the Messenger of Allah said: “Charity is not permissible for a rich person, or for one who is strong and healthy. ” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1839)
hi: "Sadqa kisi maal-daar ke liye halal nahi, na hi kisi taakatwar tandurust shakhs ke liye."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , he said: "Charity is not permissible for a wealthy person or for one who is capable." This is what Ath-Thawri and Shu'bah said, and in the narration of Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, it is mentioned as "fair."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sadqa kisi maal-daar ke liye halal nahi, na hi kisi taakatwar mazboot shakhs ke liye." Isi tarah Ath-Thawri aur Shu'bah ne kaha, aur Ibrahim bin Sa'd ki riwayat mein 'sawiyy' (tandurust) hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: He who begs (from people) when he is affluent will come on the Day of Resurrection with scrapes, scratchings, or lacerations on his face. He was asked: What constitutes affluence, Messenger of Allah? He replied:It is fifty dirhams or its value in gold. The narrator Yahya said: Abdullah ibn Sufyan said to Sufyan: I remember that Shu'bah does not narrate from Hakim ibn Jubayr. Sufyan said: Zubayr transmitted to us this tradition from Muhammad ibn AbdurRahman ibn Yazid. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1626)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs (logon se) maange jabke uske paas itna ho jo usse be-niyaz kar sake, woh Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke uske chehre par khurach, ya nishaan, ya zakham hongay." Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), be-niyaz hone ki miqdaar kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Pachaas (50) dirham, ya sone mein uski qeemat." Yahya bin Adam ne kaha: to Abdullah bin Uthman ne Sufyan se kaha: "Mera yaad hai ke Shu'bah Hakim bin Jubair se riwayat nahi karte the." Sufyan ne kaha: "To humein Zubaid ne Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman bin Yazid se bataya hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Sadaqah may not be given to rich man, with the exception of five classes: One who fights in Allah's path, or who collects it, or a debtor, or a man who buys it with his money, or a man who has a poor neighbour who has been given sadaqah and gives a present to the rich man. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1635)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sadqa kisi maal-daar ke liye halal nahi, siwaye paanch (logon) ke: Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wala, ya usme kaam karne wala, ya qarzdaar, ya woh shakhs jisne ise apne maal se khareeda ho, ya woh shakhs jiska koi miskeen padosi ho, use sadqa diya gaya ho aur usne (miskeen padosi ne) maal-daar ko tohfa diya ho."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi praised what was narrated from Malik, from Zaid ibn Aslam, from Ata ibn Yasar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Donations are only permissible for five [purposes]." He mentioned this hadith in a condition in his sermon that it is authentic. Malik could send in the hadith and receive it, or he could transmit it from someone trustworthy. The saying about it is the saying of the trustworthy one who transmits and attributes it.
hi: Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, jo Malik par padha gaya, Zaid bin Aslam se, unhone Ata' bin Yasar se, ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sadqa sirf paanch (logon) ke liye halal hai," phir hadith zikr ki. Yeh meri (is kitaab ki) shart mein se hai jo maine kitaab ke khutbe mein bayan ki thi ke yeh sahih hai, kyunke Malik kabhi hadith ko mursal chhodte hain aur kabhi usse joad dete hain, ya koi thiqa (raawi) usse sanad ke sath riwayat karta hai, aur is baare mein baat usi thiqa ki maani jaati hai jo usse joade aur sanad de.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If one who is afflicted with poverty refers it to me, his poverty will not be brought to an end; but if one refers it to Allah, He will soon give him sufficiency, either by a speedy death or by a sufficiency which comes later. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1645)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise faaqa (mohtaji) pahunche aur woh usse logon ke saamne pesh kare, uska faaqa khatam nahi hoga, aur jo usse Allah ke saamne pesh kare, to qareeb hai ke Allah usse be-niyazi de, chahe der se maut ke zariye ho ya jaldi be-niyazi ke zariye."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Hands are of three types: Allah's hand is the upper one; the bestower's hand is the one near it; the beggar's hand is the lower one. So bestow what is surplus, and do not submit yourself to the demand of your soul. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1649)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haath teen hain: Allah ka haath sabse oopar, uske baad dene wale ka haath, aur maangne wale ka haath sabse neeche. Isliye zaroorat se zyada (maal) do, aur apne aap ko (be-hunar/kamzor) na banao."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Hands are of three types, one is spread out till the end of the Hadith."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haath teen hain," hadith ki takmeel tak isi tarah zikr ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "There are three hands of Allah: the upper hand of Allah, the giving hand that follows it, and the lower hand of the one who seeks help, until the Day of Resurrection. So, refrain from asking as much as you can."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haath teen hain: Allah ka haath sabse oopar, uske baad dene wale ka haath, aur maangne wale ka haath sabse neeche, Qayamat ke din tak, isliye jitna ho sake maangne se bacho."

e: [AI] "Regarding the question, do what you can."
hi: "...maangne (ke baare) mein, jitna tum kar sako."

e: When this verse was revealed: "And those who hoard gold and silver," the Muslims were grieved about it. Umar said: I shall dispel your care. He, therefore, went and said: Prophet of Allah, your Companions were grieved by this verse. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah has made zakat obligatory simply to purify your remaining property, and He made inheritances obligatory that they might come to those who survive you. Umar then said: Allah is most great. He then said to him: Let me inform you about the best a man hoards; it is a virtuous woman who pleases him when he looks at her, obeys him when he gives her a command, and guards his interests when he is away from her. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1664)
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Aur jo log jama karte hain}" (Surah At-Tawbah 34) sona aur chandi, to yeh Musalmanon par bhaari guzri, to Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Main tumhare liye isse aasan kar dunga." Woh gaye aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, yeh ayat aapke sahaba (RA) par bhaari guzri hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne zakat sirf isliye farz ki hai ke woh tumhare baaqi maal ko paak kare, aur usne meeraath (waraasat) isliye farz ki ke woh tumhare baad walon tak pahunche," aur aik aur baat bhi kahi ke woh tumhare baad walon ke liye ho. Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) ne takbeer kahi.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prescribed the sadaqah (alms) relating to the breaking of the fast as a purification of the fasting from empty and obscene talk and as food for the poor. If anyone pays it before the prayer (of 'Id), it will be accepted as zakat. If anyone pays it after the prayer, that will be a sadaqah like other sadaqahs (alms). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1609)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zakat-ul-Fitr ko farz kiya, roze ko be-hooda baaton aur be-hayaai se paak karne ke liye, aur miskeeno ke liye khana muhaiya karne ke liye. Jo isse namaz se pehle ada kare, uski zakat qubool hai, aur jo isse namaz ke baad ada kare, woh aam sadqon mein se aik sadqa hai."

e: [AI] "People used to give Zakat al-Fitr during the time of the Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him, as a saa' of dates or a saa' of barley or a saa' of raisins or a saa' of wheat."
hi: "Log Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein Sadqa-e-Fitr aik sa' khajoor, ya aik sa' jau, ya sult (aik qism ka gehun), ya kishmish mein nikala karte the."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When he (referring to Prophet Muhammad) mandated the payment of Zakat al-Fitr, he ordered to give a Sa'a (a measure) of dates or a Sa'a of barley, and nothing else was to be given as Zakat al-Fitr except dates."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna, jab unhone Sadqa-e-Fitr farz ki, aik sa' khajoor ya aik sa' jau, aur us waqt sirf khajoor hi di jaati thi.

e: Qais bin Sa'ad said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ enjoined Sadaqatul-Fitr upon is before (the command of) Zakat was revealed. He neither ordered us (to pay) nor forbade us (from paying it), so we did it.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1828)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Sadqa-e-Fitr ka hukum diya isse pehle ke zakat nazil ho, jab zakat nazil hui to na unhone humein hukum diya aur na hi mana kiya, aur hum ise (waise hi) karte rahe."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered loudly from the belly of Makkah, proclaiming that the Zakat al-Fitr is an obligatory duty upon every Muslim, whether young or old, male or female, free or slave, present or absent. It is to be given in a measure of barley or dates.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Makkah ke andaruni hisse mein aik pukaarne wale ko hukum diya ke woh aelaan kare: "Sadqa-e-Fitr har Musalman par - chhota ho ya bada, mard ho ya aurat, azaad ho ya ghulam, haazir ho ya ghair-haazir - wajib haq hai, aik sa' jau ya khajoor."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  emphasized the importance of giving charity during Ramadan, with each person being urged to give a saa' (a measurement) of dates, barley, or wheat.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Ramzan ke sadqe (Fitrana) ki targheeb di, har insaan par aik sa' khajoor, ya aik sa' jau, ya aik sa' gehun.

e: Messenger of Allah ﷺ made it incumbent on all the slave or free Muslims, male or female, to pay one Sa' of dates or barley as Zakat-ul-Fitr. (Using translation from Bukhārī 1504)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zakat-ul-Fitr farz ki, aik sa' khajoor ya aik sa' gehun, har azaad ya ghulam, mard ya aurat, Musalman par."

e: [AI] Abu Sa'id mentioned to him the payment of Zakat al-Fitr, so he said, "I will not give except what I used to give during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, which is a sa' of dates or a sa' of barley or a sa' of wheat or a sa' of raisins." Then a man from the people or a debtor from the wheat said to him, "What about the value of Mu'awiyah? Will you not accept it or deal with it?" He replied, "That is not the value of Mu'awiyah. I neither accept it nor deal with it." These are the chains of narrations that I mentioned in relation to the mention of the measurement of barley. All of them are authentic, and the most famous of them is the hadith of Abu Mas'har from Nafi' from Ibn 'Umar, which we have high regard for. However, I left it because it is not a condition of the book. It was also narrated from Ali ibn Abi Talib.
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) [se riwayat hai], unke saamne Sadqa-e-Fitr ka zikr aaya, to unhone kaha: "Main sirf wahi nikaalunga jo main Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein nikaala karta tha: aik sa' khajoor, ya aik sa' gehun, ya aik sa' jau, ya aik sa' aqit (khushk dahi)." To qaum mein se aik shakhs ne unse poocha: "Ya do mud gehun?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, yeh Muawiyah ki (muqarrar kardah) qeemat hai, main use qubool nahi karta aur na hi uspar amal karta hoon." Yeh tamam asaneed jo maine gehun ke sa' ke zikr mein pehle bayan ki hain, sab sahih hain, aur inme sabse mash-hoor Abu Ma'shar ki, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar (RA) se, hadith hai jise humne oonchi sanad ke sath paaya, lekin maine ise chhod diya kyunke yeh kitaab ki shart mein shamil nahi, aur yeh Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] "On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said regarding the Zakat al-Fitr (charity given at the end of Ramadan): 'For every free person, whether young or old, and for every slave, a saa' (measurement) of wheat or a saa' of dates.' 'This is transmitted from Ali and others have confirmed it.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne Sadqa-e-Fitr ke baare mein farmaya: "Har chhote-bade, azaad ya ghulam par, aik sa' gehun ya aik sa' khajoor." Isi tarah Ali (Alayhis Salam) se sanad ke sath riwayat hui hai, aur doosron ne ise mauqoof (Ali tak mahdood) rakha hai.

e: Abu Dawud said “I heard Muhammad bin Isa narrating this tradition who said Mu’tamar narrated it to us. And he (Mu’tamar) said “ I heard Al Hakam bin Aban narrating this tradition. He did not mention the name of Ibn ‘Abbas. Abu Dawud said “Al Hussain bin Huraith wrote to me saying “Al Fadl bin Musa narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2225)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai. Abu Dawud ne kaha: "Maine Muhammad bin Isa ko yeh hadith bayan karte suna, unhone kaha: Mu'tamar ne humein bataya." Aur unhone (Mu'tamar ne) kaha: "Maine Al-Hakam bin Aban ko yeh hadith bayan karte suna, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) ka naam zikr nahi kiya." Abu Dawud ne kaha: "Al-Husain bin Huraith ne mujhe likha ke Al-Fadl bin Musa ne Ibn Abbas (RA) se isi mazmoon ki riwayat ki hai, Nabi (SAW) se."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ delivered a sermon and said, "Whoever has food should give charity with a sa' [unit of measurement] of wheat, barley, dates, flour, raisins, or salt."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein khutba diya aur farmaya: "Jiske paas khana ho, woh sadqa kare: aik sa' gehun, ya aik sa' jau, ya aik sa' khajoor, ya aik sa' aata, ya aik sa' kishmish, ya aik sa' sult (aik qism ka gehun)."

e: [AI] She informed him that they used to give Zakat al-Fitr during the time of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, in the measure that sustains the household or the measure that sustains them individually. The people of Madinah all used to do that.
hi: Unhone unhein bataya ke woh "Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein Sadqa-e-Fitr usi mud (paimane) se nikalte the jisse ghar wale khana khate the, ya us sa' se jisse woh khana khate, Madinah ke tamam log aisa hi karte the."

e: If anyone guarantees me that he will not beg from people, I will guarantee him Paradise. Thawban said : I (will not beg). He never asked anyone for anything. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1643)
hi: Thawban (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam, se riwayat hai, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo mujhe zamanat de ke woh logon se kuch nahi maangega, main uske liye Jannat ki zamanat deta hoon?" To Thawban (RA) ne kaha: "Main." Phir woh logon se kuch nahi maangte the.

e: ‘Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) said The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked Is there anyone of you who provided food to a poor man today? Abu Bakr said I entered the mosque where a beggar was begging ; I found a piece of bread in the hand of ‘Abdal-Rahman which I took and gave it to him (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1670)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se kisi ne aaj kisi miskeen ko khana khilaya hai?" To Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Main masjid mein dakhil hua, wahan aik maangne wala maang raha tha, mujhe Abdur Rahman (RA) ke haath mein roti ka tukda mila, maine woh le liya aur usse de diya."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone seeks protection in Allah's name, grant him protection; if anyone begs in Allah's name, give him something; if anyone gives you an invitation, accept it; and if anyone does you a kindness, recompense him; but if you have not the means to do so, pray for him until you feel that you have compensated him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1672)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tumse Allah ke naam par maange, use do, aur jo tumse Allah ke naam par panah maange, use panah do, aur jo tumhein bulaaye, uski dawat qubool karo, aur jo tumhein tohfa de, uska badla do, aur agar tumhein badle dene ki koi cheez na mile, to uske liye dua karo yahan tak ke tumhein lage ke tumne uska badla de diya hai."

e: [AI] Abu Awana praised and as for the speech of Jarir
hi: Humein Abu Awana ne bataya. Rahi baat Jarir ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] Thanaa Jarir, and as for the story of Abdul Aziz ibn Muslim
hi: Humein Jarir ne bataya. Rahi baat Abdul Aziz bin Muslim ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] About Mujahid and with Al-A'mash, there is another authentic chain that meets their conditions.
hi: Mujahid se, aur Al-A'mash ke paas ismein aik aur sahih sanad hai jo dono (Bukhari-Muslim) ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever asks you for something in the name of Allah, give it to him, and whoever seeks refuge with you in the name of Allah, grant him refuge, and whoever invites you, respond to him." This is a sound chain of narration, as it has been authenticated by both Al-A'mash and the two sheikhs, and we adhere to our principle of accepting additional trustworthy narrators in the chains of transmission and texts.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tumse Allah ke naam par maange, use do, aur jo tumse Allah ke naam par panah maange, use panah do, aur jo tumhein bulaaye, uski dawat qubool karo." Yeh sahih sanad hai, Al-A'mash ke paas dono asaneed Shaykhain ki shart par sahih sabit hui hain, aur hum apne usool par qaim hain ke asaneed aur mutoon mein thiqa raawiyon ki ziyaadti qubool ki jaye.

e: While we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a man brought him some gold equal in weight to an egg, and said: Messenger of Allah, I have got this from a mine; take it; it is sadaqah. I have no more than this. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned his attention from him. Then he came to him from his right side and repeated the same words. But he (the Prophet) turned his attention from him. He then came to him from his left side and repeated the same words. But he (again) turned his attention from him. He then came to him from behind. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took it and threw it away. Had it hit him, it would have hurt him or wounded him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: One of you brings all that he possesses and says: This is sadaqah. Then he sits down and spreads his hand before the people. The best sadaqah is that which leaves a competence. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1673)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas thay ke aik shakhs unke paas anday jaisa sona lekar aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe yeh kisi kaan se mila hai, ise le lijiye, yeh sadqa hai, mere paas iske ilawa aur kuch nahi." Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse mun pher liya, phir woh unke dayen taraf se aaya aur wahi baat dohrayi, aap (SAW) ne phir mun pher liya, phir woh unke bayen taraf se aaya, aap (SAW) ne phir mun pher liya, phir woh unke peechhe se aaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse le liya aur usi shakhs ki taraf phenk diya, agar woh use lagta to usse takleef pahunchati aur zakhmi kar deti. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apna sab kuch le aata hai aur kehta hai: 'Yeh sadqa hai,' phir baith kar logon se maangne lagta hai, behtareen sadqa woh hai jo zaroorat se zyada (maal) se diya jaye."

e: A man entered the mosque. The Prophet ﷺ commanded the people to throw their clothes as sadaqah. Thereupon they threw their clothes (as sadaqah). He then asked him to take two clothes from them. He reprimanded him and said: Take your clothe. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1675)
hi: Unhone Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ko kehte hue suna: aik shakhs masjid mein dakhil hua, Nabi (SAW) ne hukum diya ke uske liye kapde daale jayein, to unhone daale, aap (SAW) ne unme se do kapdon ka hukum diya, phir sadqe ki targheeb di, to woh (dobara) aaya aur un do kapdon mein se aik daal diya, aap (SAW) ne usse pukaara aur farmaya: "Apna kapda le lo."

e: Abu Hurairah reported I asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ, What kind of sadaqah is most excellent? He replied What a man with little property can afford to give; and begin with those for whom you are responsible. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1677)
hi: Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), sabse afzal sadqa kaunsa hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh koshish jo kam-hisiyat wala shakhs karta hai, aur pehle unse shuru karo jinki tumpar zimmedari hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us one day to give sadaqah. At that time I had some property. I said: Today I shall surpass AbuBakr if I surpass him any day. I, therefore, brought half my property. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked: What did you leave for your family? I replied: The same amount. AbuBakr brought all that he had with him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him: What did you leave for your family? He replied: I left Allah and His Apostle for them. I said: I shall never compete you in anything. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1678)
hi: Maine Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein aik din sadqa karne ka hukum diya, aur us waqt mere paas maal maujood tha, maine kaha: "Aaj main Abu Bakr (RA) se aage nikal jaunga agar kabhi unse aage nikal saka." To main apna aadha maal le aaya, Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne apne ghar walon ke liye kya chhoda?" Maine kaha: "Utna hi." Aur Abu Bakr (RA) apna sab kuch le aaye, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Abu Bakr, tumne apne ghar walon ke liye kya chhoda?" Unhone kaha: "Maine unke liye Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ko chhoda hai." Maine kaha: "Main kabhi bhi kisi cheez mein aapse aage nikalne ki koshish nahi karunga."

e: [AI] Saad ibn Ubadah came to the Prophet ﷺ  and asked, "Which charity do you find most admirable?" The Prophet replied, "Providing water." This was followed by Hammam quoting Qatadah.
hi: Sa'd bin Ubadah (RA) se riwayat hai, woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur poocha: "Aapko sabse zyada pasand sadqa kaunsa hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paani pilana." Hammam ne Qatadah se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: Sa’id reported Sa’d came to the Prophet (SWAS) and asked him Which sadaqah do you like most? He replied Water. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1679)
hi: Sa'd (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur poocha: "Aapko sabse zyada pasand sadqa kaunsa hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paani."

e: I had a slave girl and I set her free. When the Prophet ﷺ entered upon me, I informed him (of this). He said : May Allah give reward for it; if you had given her to your maternal uncles, it would have increased your reward (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1690)
hi: Maimoonah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki zaujah, se riwayat hai, unhone kaha: "Meri aik laundi thi, maine usse azaad kar diya, Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas tashreef laaye to maine unhein bataya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah tumhein ajr de, agar tum use apne mamu-zaad (rishtedaaron) ko de deti to tumhare liye zyada ajr hota.'"

e: The Prophet ﷺ commanded to give sadaqah. A man said: Messenger of Allah, I have a dinar. He said: Spend it on yourself. He again said: I have another. He said: Spend it on your children. He again said: I have another. He said: Spend it on your wife. He again said: I have another. He said: Spend it on your servant. He finally said: I have another. He replied: You know best (what to do with it). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1691)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne sadqe ka hukum diya, aik shakhs ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere paas aik dinar hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne aap par sadqa karo (kharch karo)." Usne kaha: "Mere paas aik aur hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne bachche par kharch karo." Usne kaha: "Mere paas aik aur hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni biwi par kharch karo" - ya farmaya: "apni zaujah par." Usne kaha: "Mere paas aik aur hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne khadim par kharch karo." Usne kaha: "Mere paas aik aur hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum khud behtar samajhte ho."

e: It is sufficient sin for a man that he neglects him whom he maintains. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1692)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Insaan ke liye itna gunah hi kaafi hai ke woh un logon ko zaya kare jinka woh zimmedar hai."

e: [AI] Abu 'Amir Al-'Aqadi and Abu Dawud Al-Tayalisi narrated to us, they said: Shu'bah narrated to us, and Abu al-'Abbas Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated to us, they said: Ibrahim ibn Marzuq narrated to us, and Bishr ibn 'Umar and Wahb ibn Jarir narrated to us, they said: Shu'bah narrated to us, from 'Amr ibn Murrah, from 'Abdullah ibn al-Harith, from Abu Kathir, from 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered a sermon and said, "Beware of miserliness, for indeed those who came before you were destroyed because of it. They were commanded to be stingy, so they became stingy. They were commanded to cut off ties, so they cut off ties. And they were commanded to engage in immoral acts, so they engaged in immoral acts."
