hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se riwayat hai, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne khutba diya aur farmaya: "Kanjoosi se bacho, kyunke tumse pehle log kanjoosi ki wajah se halaak huay, unhein kanjoosi ka hukum diya gaya to unhone kanjoosi ki, aur unhein rishtey todne ka hukum diya gaya to unhone rishtey tode, aur unhein bad-amali ka hukum diya gaya to unhone bad-amali ki."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Every person will remain in the shade of their charity until the judgment is made among the people." Or he said, "until the judgment is passed among the people." Yazid said, and Abu Al-Khair used to say, "A day will not pass without him giving charity, even if it is a small piece of bread or an onion."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Har insaan apne sadqe ke saaye mein hota hai, yahan tak ke logon ke darmiyan faisla ho jaye" - ya farmaya: "yahan tak ke logon ke darmiyan hukum diya jaye." Yazid ne kaha: aur Abu Al-Khair "kisi din ko bhi bagair sadqa kiye nahi guzarne dete the, chahe woh aik kaik (cake) hi ho ya aik pyaaz."

e: [AI] Indeed, actions compete with one another so that charity says, "I am the best among you."
hi: Beshak amal aapas mein muqaabla karte hain, to sadqa kehta hai: "Main tum sabse afzal hoon."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'A Dirham was better than a hundred thousand Dirhams.' They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, how?' He said: 'A man had two Dirhams and gave one in charity, and another man went to part of his wealth and took out a hundred thousand Dirhams and gave them in charity."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2528)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik dirham ne aik lakh (dirham) ko pichhe chhod diya." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aik dirham aik lakh ko kaise pichhe chhod sakta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik shakhs ke paas do dirham the, usne unme se aik lekar sadqa kar diya, aur doosre ke paas bohot maal tha, usne apne maal ke aik hisse se aik lakh nikaal kar (sadqa kar diya)."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: "There are three whom Allah (SWT) loves: A man who comes to some people and asks (to be given something) for the sake of Allah and not for the sake of their relationship, but they do not give him, so a man stayed behind and gave it to him in secret, and no one knew of his giving except Allah (SWT) and the one to whom he gave it. People who travel all night until sleep becomes dearer to them than anything equated with it, so they lay down their heads (and slept), then a man among them got up and started praying to Me and beseeching Me, reciting My Verses. And a man who was on a campaign and met the enemy and they fled, but he went forward (pursuing them) until he was killed or victory was granted." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1615)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (log) hain jinse Allah mohabbat karta hai, aur teen (log) hain jinse Allah nafrat karta hai. Rahi baat un teen ki jinse Allah mohabbat karta hai: aik shakhs jo kisi qaum ke paas aaya aur unse Allah ke naam par maanga, na ke unke aur uske darmiyan kisi rishtedaari ke naam par, to unme se aik shakhs peechhe reh gaya aur usse chhupkar de diya, jise sirf Allah aur dene wala hi jaanta hai; aur woh log jo apni raat safar karte rahe yahan tak ke neend unhein har cheez se zyada aziz lagne lagi, to woh utre aur apne sar rakh diye, phir unme se aik shakhs khada hua jo mujhe rijhaane lagta hai aur meri ayaatein padhta hai; aur aik shakhs jo kisi lashkar mein tha, dushman se mila, to woh (log) haar gaye, magar woh apna seena aage kiye raha yahan tak ke woh maara gaya ya usse fatah mili. Aur teen (log) jinse Allah nafrat karta hai: budha zina karne wala, ghamand karne wala faqeer, aur zulm karne wala maal-daar."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A man does not give in charity any amount until seventy devils are detached from it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi aadmi kisi cheez ka sadqa nahi nikaalta jab tak us (maal) se sattar (70) shayateen ke jabde na khol diye jayein."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  ordered that every wall of the mosque be adorned with a niche.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne hukum diya ke har baagh (wale) se aik khoshaa (khajoor ka guchcha) masjid ke liye (diya jaye)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  allowed the exchange of 'wasq' (a unit of measure for dates) and 'wasqayn' (two 'wasq' combined) and 'thulatha' (three 'wasq' combined) and 'arba'a' (four 'wasq' combined). He stated, "For every ten 'wasq', a qinu (a container) is to be placed in the mosque for the poor."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne 'araaya' (taaza khajoor bech kar sukhi khajoor lene) mein aik, do, teen ya chaar wasq tak ki rukhsat di, aur farmaya: "Har dus (10) wasq ki fasal katne par aik khoshaa (khajoor ka guchcha) masjid mein miskeeno ke liye rakh diya jaye."

e: She took the oath of allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said to him: Messenger of Allah, a poor man stands at my door, but I find nothing to give him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: If you do not find anything to give him, put something in his hand, even though it should be a burnt hoof. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1667)
hi: Unki dadi ne unhein bataya, jo Umm Bujaid (RA) thin, aur woh un logon mein se thin jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) se bai'at ki thi, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ki qasam, miskeen mere darwaze par khada hota hai magar humein use dene ke liye kuch nahi milta." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Agar tumhein use dene ke liye kuch na mile, siwaye aik jala hua khur (janwar ka pair) ke, to woh bhi uske haath mein de do." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are two types of jealousy, one that Allah loves and the other that Allah hates, and there are two types of suspicion, one that Allah loves and the other that Allah hates. The type of jealousy that Allah loves is when it is regarding something doubtful, and the type of jealousy that Allah hates is when it is regarding something without doubt. And the type of suspicion that Allah loves is when a person gives in charity, and the type of suspicion that Allah hates is when it comes from arrogance."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do tarah ki ghairat hain, aik ko Allah pasand karta hai aur doosri ko Allah napasand karta hai, aur do tarah ka ghuroor hai, aik ko Allah pasand karta hai aur doosre ko Allah napasand karta hai. To shak (badgumaani ki wajah) wali ghairat ko Allah pasand karta hai, aur bagair kisi shak ke ghairat ko Allah napasand karta hai. Aur woh ghuroor jab aadmi sadqa karta hai, use Allah pasand karta hai, aur ghamand se aane wale ghuroor ko Allah napasand karta hai."

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: When My servant sought to borrow from Me, but I did not grant him the loan, and he began to curse Me, while he does not know, I say: 'Dahrahu, dahrahu', and I am the Everlasting."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Azza wa Jalla farmata hai: "Maine apne bande se qarz maanga, usne mujhe qarz nahi diya, aur mere bande ne mujhe gaali di jabke use pata nahi tha, woh kehta hai: 'Haay zamana, haay zamana,' (halanke) main hi zamana hoon."

e: " Who is this?" They said: "Abu Hurairah." (He said):So I got close to him until I was sitting in front of him as he was narrating to the people. When he was silent and alone, I said to him: " I ask youabsolute truth if you would narrate to me a Hadith which you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, That you understand and know." So Abu Hurairah said: "You want me to narrate a Hadith to you which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated to me that I understand and know." Then Abu Hurairah began sobbing profusely. We sat for a while, then he recovered and said: "I shall narrate to you a Hadith which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated in this House, while there was no one with us other than he and I." Then, again, Abu Hurairah began sobbing severely. Then he recovered, and wiped his face, and said: "you want me to narrate to you a Hadith which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated while he and I were sitting in this House, and no one was with us but he and I." Then Abu Hurairah began sobbing severely. Then he bent, falling on his face, so I supported him for a long time. Then he recovered and said: "The Messenger of Allah narrated to me that on the Day of Judgement, Allah, Most High, will descend to His slaves t judge between them. Every nation shall be kneeling. The first of those who will be called before him will be a man who memorized the Qur'an, and a man who was killed in Allah's cause, and a wealthy man. Allah will say to the reciter: 'Did I not teach you what I revealed to My Messenger?" He says: 'Of course O Lord!' He says: 'Then what did you do with what you learned?' He said: 'I would stand (in prayer reciting) with it during all hours of the night and all hours of the day.' Then Allah would say to him: 'You have lied.' And the angels will say: 'You have lied.'Allah will say to him: 'Rather, you wanted it to be said that so-and-so is a reciter. And that was said.' The person with the wealth will be brought, and Allah will say to him: 'Was I not so generous with you, such that I did not leave you having any need from anyone?' He will say: 'Of course O Lord!' He says: 'Then what did you do with what I gave to you?' He says: 'I would nurture the ties of kinship and give charity.' Then Allah will say to him: 'You have lied.' And the angels will say to him: 'You have lied.' Allah, Most High, will say: 'Rather, you wanted it to be said that so-and-so is so generous, and that was said.' Then the one who was killed in Allah's cause shall be brought, and Allah will say to him : 'For what were you killed?' So he says: 'I was commanded to fight in Your cause ,so I fought until I was killed.' Allah [Most High] will say to him: 'You have lied.' And the angels will say to him: 'You have lied.' Allah [Most High] will say: 'Rather, you wanted it be said that so-and-so is brave, and that was said.' "Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺhit me on my knees and said: 'O Abu Hurairah! These first three are the creatures of Allah with whom the fire will be enflamed on the Day of Judgement.'" Al-Walid Abu 'Uthman Al-Mada'ini said: "So 'Uqbah bin Muslim informed me that Shaufaiy, is the one who entered upon Mu'awiyah to inform him about this." Abu Uthman said: 'This has been done with these people, then how about with those who remain among the people?" Then Mu'awiyah begin weeping so intensely, that we thought that he will kill himself with excessive weeping. We said: "This man came to us to cause evil." Then Mu'awiyah recovered, wiped off his face and said: "Allah and His Messenger told the truth: Whosoever desires the life of the world and its glitter, then we shall pay in full (the wages of) their deeds therein, and they shall have no diminution therein. They are those for whom there is nothing in the Hereafter Fire, and vain are the deeds they did therein. And of no effect is that which they used to do." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2382)
hi: ..."Yeh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Abu Hurairah (RA)." Unhone kaha: to main unke qareeb hua yahan tak ke main unke saamne baith gaya jabke woh logon ko hadith sunaa rahe the, jab woh khamosh huay aur akela reh gaye, to maine kaha: "Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta hoon, sachi baat ke haq se, ke aap mujhe woh hadith sunaayen jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni aur seekhi ho." To Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Zaroor karunga, main tumhein zaroor woh hadith sunaunga jo mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne sunayi thi, maine ise samjha aur seekha." Phir Abu Hurairah (RA) ko hichki (sisak) aayi, thodi der ruke rahe, phir hosh mein aaye aur kaha: "Main tumhein zaroor woh hadith sunaunga jo mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne sunayi, main aur woh is ghar mein thay, humare sath koi aur na tha siwaye mere aur unke." Phir Abu Hurairah (RA) ko doosri hichki aayi, thodi der isi haal mein rahe, phir hosh mein aaye aur apna chehra pochha, phir kaha: "Zaroor karunga, main tumhein zaroor woh hadith sunaunga jo mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne sunayi, main aur woh is ghar mein thay, humare sath koi aur na tha siwaye mere aur unke." Phir Abu Hurairah (RA) ko teesri hichki aayi, phir woh apne mun ke bal jhuk gaye, maine unhein der tak sambhala, phir woh hosh mein aaye aur kaha: mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne bataya ke Allah Azza wa Jalla Qayamat ke din bandon ki taraf utrega taake unke darmiyan faisla kare, aur har Ummat ghutnon ke bal baithi hogi, to sabse pehle jise bulaya jayega woh aik shakhs hoga jisne Quran jama kiya, aik shakhs jo Allah ki raah mein qatl kiya gaya, aur aik shakhs jiske paas bohot maal tha. To Allah Quran padhne wale se kahega: "Kya maine tumhein woh nahi sikhaya jo maine apne Rasool par nazil kiya?" Woh kahega: "Kyun nahi, Aye Rab." Allah kahega: "To jo tumne seekha usme tumne kya amal kiya?" Woh kahega: "Main raat aur din ke lamho mein isse khada hokar padhta tha." To Allah usse kahega: "Tumne jhoot bola," aur farishte bhi kahengay: "Tumne jhoot bola." Allah kahega: "Tum chahte the ke kaha jaye fulan Quran padhne wala hai, so yeh keh diya gaya." Phir maal-daar shakhs laaya jayega, Allah kahega: "Kya maine tumhein itni wus'at nahi di ke tumhein kisi ki zaroorat na rahi?" Woh kahega: "Kyun nahi." Allah kahega: "To jo maine tumhein diya usme tumne kya amal kiya?" Woh kahega: "Main sila-e-rahmi karta tha aur sadqa deta tha." Allah kahega: "Tumne jhoot bola," aur farishte bhi kahengay: "Tumne jhoot bola." Allah kahega: "Balke tum chahte the ke kaha jaye fulan bohot saqhi hai, so yeh keh diya gaya." Phir woh shakhs laaya jayega jo Allah ki raah mein qatl kiya gaya tha, usse poocha jayega: "Tum kis liye qatl huay?" Woh kahega: "Mujhe teri raah mein jihad ka hukum diya gaya, to maine ladai ki yahan tak ke main qatl ho gaya." Allah kahega: "Tumne jhoot bola," aur farishte bhi kahengay: "Tumne jhoot bola." Allah kahega: "Balke tum chahte the ke kaha jaye fulan bohot bahaadur hai, so yeh keh diya gaya." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne mere ghutne par (haath se) maara aur farmaya: "Aye Abu Hurairah, yeh teenon Allah ki makhlooq mein se pehle hongay jinse Qayamat ke din Jahannam bharki jayegi."

e: [AI] "And by Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not leave behind at his death a dinar or a dirham, nor a slave nor a female slave, except for his mule and weapons, and a piece of land that he left as charity."
hi: "Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni maut ke waqt na koi dinar chhoda, na dirham, na ghulam, na launDi, siwaye apne khachar, apne hathiyaar, aur aik zameen jo unhone sadqe ke tor par chhodi thi."

e: [AI] Indeed, no one used to drink from Rome except by paying a price. So, I bought it with my money and made it available for the rich, the poor, and the traveler." They said, "Yes."
hi: "Rumah (kuen) se koi bagair qeemat ke pani nahi peeta tha, to maine ise apne maal se khareed liya aur ise maal-daar, faqeer aur musafir sabke liye (mufid) bana diya?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan."

e: "Sa'd bin 'Ubadah went out with the Prophet on one of his campaigns, and death came to his mother in Al-Madinah. It was said to her (as she was dying): 'Make a will.' She said: 'To whom shall I make a will? The wealth belongs to Sa'd.' Then she died before Sa'd came. When Sa'd came, he was told about that and he said: 'O Messenger of Allah, will it benefit her if I give in charity on her behalf?' The Prophet said: 'Yes.' Sa'd said: 'Such and such a garden is given in charity on her behalf' -regarding a garden that he named." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3650)
hi: Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, jo Malik par padha gaya, Sa'eed bin Amr bin Shurahbeel bin Sa'eed bin Abbad se, unke walid se, unke dada se, unhone kaha: Sa'd bin Ubadah (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke sath kisi ghazwe mein nikle, is dauran Sa'd (RA) ki waalida ki wafat ka waqt aa gaya, unse kaha gaya: "Wasiyat kar do," unhone kaha: "Main kis cheez ki wasiyat karoon? Maal to Sa'd (RA) ka hai." Woh Sa'd (RA) ke aane se pehle wafat pa gayin. Jab Sa'd (RA) aaye to unhein yeh baat bataayi gayi, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya unhein fayda hoga agar main unki taraf se sadqa karoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: "Fulan-fulan bagh unki taraf se sadqa hai" - bagh ka naam le kar.

e: "O Messenger of Allah, my mother died; will it benefit her if I give in charity on her behalf?" He said: "Yes." He said: "I have a garden and I ask you to bear witness that I am giving it in charity on her behalf." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3655)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se: "Meri waalida ka intiqal ho gaya hai, kya unhein fayda hoga agar main unki taraf se sadqa karoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Unhone kaha: "Mere paas aik bagh hai, main aapko gawah banaata hoon ke maine woh unki taraf se sadqa kar diya hai."

e: "When the Messenger of Allah [SAW] died, the 'Arabs apostatized, so 'Umar said: 'O Abu Bakr, how can you fight the 'Arabs?' Abu Bakr said: 'The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "I have been commanded to fight the people until they bear witness to La ilaha illallah (there is none worthy of worship except Allah) and that I am the Messenger of Allah, and they establish Salah and pay Zakah." By Allah, if they withhold from me a young goat that they used to give to the Messenger of Allah [SAW], I will fight them for it.' 'Umar said: 'By Allah, as soon as I realized how certain Abu Bakr was, I knew that it was the truth.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3969)
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafat hui, to Arab murtad ho gaye, to Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Abu Bakr, kya aap Arabon se ladna chahte hain?" Unhone kaha: to Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne to sirf yeh farmaya tha: 'Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se ladoon yahan tak ke woh gawahi den ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon, aur namaz qaim karein aur zakat adaa karein. Allah ki qasam, agar woh mujhse aik bachhiya bhi rokein jo woh Rasulullah (SAW) ko diya karte the, to main iske liye unse zaroor ladunga.'" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Jab maine dekha ke Abu Bakr (RA) ki raay khul kar saamne aa gayi hai, to mujhe yaqeen ho gaya ke yehi haq hai."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I have been commanded to fight the people until they testify to La ilaha ill-allah (none has the right to be worshipped but Allah) and that I am the Messenger of Allah, and establish regular prayers and pay Zakat.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 71)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se ladoon yahan tak ke woh gawahi den ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur namaz qaim karein aur zakat adaa karein, phir unka khoon aur maal mujh par haram ho jayega, aur unka hisaab Allah Azza wa Jalla par hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The first three to enter Paradise are: the martyr, the servant who worships his Lord well and is loyal to his master, and the one who is chaste and of good character and has dependents. As for the first three to enter Hellfire, they are: a tyrant ruler, a wealthy person who does not fulfill the rights of Allah with his wealth, and a poor person who is inclined towards evil." This hadith was narrated by 'Amr ibn Shu'ayb al-'Uqayli, a knowledgeable sheikh from the people of Madinah, and he is recognized for his reliable narrations. This is a narration that stands alone as 'Yahya ibn Abi Kathir did not mention it, however, the narration is supported by the hadith of Al-Amash from 'Abdullah ibn Murrat.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Mujh par woh pehle teen (log) pesh kiye gaye jo Jannat mein dakhil hongay, aur pehle teen (log) jo Jahannam mein dakhil hongay. Rahi baat un pehle teen ki jo Jannat mein dakhil hongay: shaheed, aur woh ghulam jisne apne Rab ki achhi ibadat ki aur apne aaqa ka khair-khwaah raha, aur woh paakdaman shakhs jisne apne aap ko rok rakha ho jabke uske ashiyaal (bal-bachche) ho. Aur rahi baat un pehle teen ki jo Jahannam mein dakhil hongay: zaalim hukmaraan, aur woh maal-daar shakhs jo apne maal mein Allah ka haq ada nahi karta, aur be-hayaa faqeer. Aamir bin Shabib Al-Uqaili Madinah ke buzurgon mein se hain, jinki hadith seedhi (sahih) hai, aur yeh is baab mein aik bunyaadi hadith hai jisme unse akele Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne riwayat ki hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur iska shahid Al-A'mash ki, Abdullah bin Murrah se, hadith hai.

e: "The one who consumes Riba, the one who pays it, and the one who writes it down, if they know that it is Riba; the woman who does tattoos and the woman who has that done for the purpose of beautification; the one who withholds Sadaqah (Zakah); and the one who reverts to the life of a Bedouin after having emigrated- they will (all) be cursed upon the tongue of Muhammad [SAW] on the Day of Resurrection." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5102)
hi: "Sood khane wala, sood khilaane wala, aur uske dono gawah jab woh use jaante hon, gudwaane wali aur gudwaane wali (aurat), sadqe ko rokne wala, aur hijrat ke baad dobara badu ban jaane wala - Qayamat ke din Muhammad (SAW) ki zubaan par mal'oon hongay."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "In camels, their charity is in their offspring, in sheep, their charity is in their milk, in cows, their charity is their milk, and in horses, their charity is in their offspring. Whoever accumulates silver coins, gold coins, or land and does not count them as a debt nor spends them in the cause of Allah, it will be a treasure folded for him on the Day of Judgment." This was narrated by Ibn Jarir from Imran ibn Abi Anas.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Oonton mein unki zakat hai, bakriyon mein unki zakat hai, gaay-bail mein unki zakat hai, aur gehun mein uski zakat hai, aur jo koi dinar, dirham, sona ya chandi jama kare aur usse kisi qarzdaar ke liye na gine aur na Allah ki raah mein kharch kare, to woh khazana hai jisse Qayamat ke din daagha jayega." Ibn Jarir ne Imran bin Abi Anas se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'In camels, their charity is in their milk, and in sheep, their charity is in their wool, and in cows, their charity is in their milk.' Both chains of narration are authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, and they did not exclude it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Oonton mein unki zakat hai, bakriyon mein unki zakat hai, aur gehun mein uski zakat hai." Dono asaneed Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hain, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent him to Yemen and said, "Take wheat from wheat, wool from sheep, and camels from camels, and cows from cows." This is a authentic chain of narration according to the conditions set by the two scholars, if the hearing of Ata ibn Yasar from Muadh ibn Jabal is correct. I do not know it perfectly.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Yemen bheja aur farmaya: "Anaaj se anaaj lo, bakri se bakri lo, oont se oont lo, aur gaay se gaay lo." Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai agar Ata' bin Yasar ka Muadh bin Jabal (RA) se sunna sahih ho, lekin mujhe ismein poora yaqeen nahi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever leaves behind a treasure similar to him on the Day of Judgment, brave and strong, two grapes will be given to him that follow his mouth. He will say, 'Woe to you, I am your treasure that you left behind after you.' He will continue to follow him until he feeds him with his hand and he bites it. Then the rest of his body will follow."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi apne peechhe khazana chhode, use Qayamat ke din aik ganja saanp banaakar dikhaya jayega, jiske do zeher-bhare dhabbe hongay, woh uske mun ke peechhe padega aur kahega: 'Tujhpar afsos ho, main tera woh khazana hoon jo tu apne peechhe chhod gaya,' to woh use peechha karta rahega yahan tak ke woh uska haath uske mun mein de dega, to woh use kaat lega, phir uska baaqi jism bhi (isi tarah) uska peechha karega."

e:
[AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "One of you will have a treasure on the Day of Judgment, which appears as a bald-headed man with two raised parts on his scalp. His owner will follow him while seeking refuge from him, but he will continue to follow him as he tries to flee until he devours him with his two fingers."
The two sheikhs (referring to Bukhari and Muslim) agreed to include the hadith of Ibn Masud and Ibn Umar in this chapter, in a summarized form, as a warning against preventing payment of Zakat. However, they did not include the hadith of Abu Hurairah and Thawban.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se kisi ka khazana Qayamat ke din aik ganja saanp bankar aayega jiske do zeher-bhare dhabbe hongay, apne maalik ka peechha karega jabke woh usse panah maangta hoga, woh usse bhaagta rahega yahan tak ke woh usse apni do ungliyan khilaa dega." Shaykhain ne is baab mein Ibn Mas'ud (RA) aur Ibn Amr (RA) ki hadith ko mukhtasar tor par nikalne par ittifaq kiya hai, aur zakat rokne walon ke liye sakhti ke silsile mein, magar unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) aur Thawban (RA) ki hadith nahi nikali.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Umamah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood among us during the Farewell Pilgrimage on his young camel. He had placed his feet in the stirrups to make himself taller and said, "Can you hear me?" A man from the masses asked, "What obligations do you have for us?" The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "Worship your Lord, establish prayer, observe fasting in Ramadan, pay Zakat on your wealth, and obey your leaders, then you will enter the Paradise of your Lord." I asked Abu Umamah, "Who were you at that time?" He replied, "I, my nephew, was thirty years old. I was pushing my camel closer to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: Maine Abu Umamah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein humare darmiyan khade huay, apni katti-kaan wali unteni par sawaar the, apne paon rikaab ki jagah rakhe huay, lambe hokar logon ko sunwa rahe the, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum meri awaz sun rahe ho?" To logon ke giroh mein se aik shakhs ne poocha: "Aap humein kya wasiyat karte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne Rab ki ibadat karo, apni paanch (namazein) padho, apna (Ramzan ka) mahina roza rakho, apne maal ki zakat ada karo, aur apne (waqt ke) hukmaraan ki itaa'at karo, tum apne Rab ki Jannat mein dakhil ho jaoge." Unhone kaha: maine poocha: "Aye Abu Umamah, us waqt aap kis umar ke the?" Unhone kaha: "Aye mere bhatije, main us waqt tees (30) saal ka tha, main oont ko dhakel raha tha, use Rasulullah (SAW) ke qareeb le ja raha tha."

e: We entered upon A’ishah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ. She said The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ entered upon me and saw two silver rings in my hand. He asked What is this, Aishah? I said I have made two ornaments myself for you, Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He asked Do you pay zakat on them? I said No or I said Whatever Allah willed. He said this is sufficient for you (to take you) to the Hell fire. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1565)
hi: Hum Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki zaujah, ke paas gaye, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas aaye aur unhone mere haath mein chandi ki kuch mohrein dekhin, poocha: 'Yeh kya hai, Aye Aisha?' Maine kaha: 'Maine yeh apne liye banwaayi hain ke inme aapke liye zeenat karoon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW).' Aap (SAW) ne poocha: 'Kya tum inki zakat adaa karti ho?' Maine kaha: 'Nahi,' ya jo bhi Allah ne chaha, unhone kaha. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Yehi tumhein Jahannam mein le jaane ke liye kaafi hai.'"

e: [AI] "She used to wear golden bracelets, so she asked the Prophet ﷺ about it, saying: 'Is this considered a treasure?' He replied, 'If you give its Zakat, then it is not considered a treasure.'"
hi: Woh sone ke kangan (kada) pehanti thin, unhone Nabi (SAW) se is baare mein poocha, kaha: "Kya yeh khazana hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum iski zakat ada karti ho, to yeh khazana nahi."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "When you pay the zakat of your wealth, you have eliminated its harm from yourself."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum apne maal ki zakat ada kar do, to tumne uska nuqsaan apne aap se door kar diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you give zakat, you have fulfilled what is upon you, and whoever accumulates wealth unlawfully and then gives it in charity, he will not have any reward, and his burden will be upon him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumne zakat ada kar di, to tumne apne zimme ka haq poora kar diya, aur jisne haraam maal jama kiya, phir usse sadqa kar diya, to usme uske liye koi ajr nahi, aur uska gunah usi par hoga."

e: I took a letter from Thumamah bin ‘Abd Allah bin Anas. He presumed that Abu Bakr had written it for Anas when he sent him (to Al Bahrain) as a collector of zakat. This (letter) was stamped with the stamp of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and was written by Abu Bakr for him(Anas). This letter goes “This is the obligatory sadaqah(zakat) which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ imposed on Muslims which Allah commanded his Prophet ﷺ to impose. Those Muslims who are asked for the proper amount must give it, but those who are asked for more than that must not give it. For less than twenty five Camels a goat is to be given for every five Camels. When they reach twenty five to thirty five, a she Camel in her second year is to be given. If there is no she Camel in her second year, a male Camel in its third year is to be given. When they reach thirty six to forty five, a she Camel in her third year is to be given. When they reach forty six to sixty , a she Camel in her fourth year which is ready to be covered by a stallion is to be given. When they reach sixty one to seventy five, a she Camel in her fifth year is to be given. When they reach seventy six to ninety, two she Camel in their third year are to be given. When they reach ninety one to a hundred and twenty, two she Camels in their fourth year are ready to be covered by a stallion are to be given. When they exceed a hundred and twenty, a she Camel in her third year is to be given for every forty and a she Camel in her fourth year for every fifty(Camels). In case the ages of the Camel vary in the payment of obligatory sadaqah(zakat) If anyone whose Camels reach the number on which a she Camel in her fifth year is payable does not possess one but possess one in her fourth year, that will be accepted from him along with two goats if he can conveniently give them, or else twenty dirhams. If anyone whose Camels reach the number on which a she Camel in her fourth year is payable does not possess but possesses one in her fifth year, that will be accepted from him, and the collector must give him twenty dirhams or two goats. If anyone whose Camels reach the number on which a she Camel in her fourth year is payable possesses only one in her third year, that will be accepted from him.” Abu Dawud said From here I could not retain accurately from Musa as I liked “And he must give along with it two goats if he can conveniently give them, or else twenty dirhams. If anyone whose Camels reach the number on which a she Camel in her third year is payable possesses only one in her fourth year, that will be accepted from him.” Abu Dawud said (I was doubtful) up to here, and retained correctly onward “and the collector must give him twenty dirhams or two goats. If anyone whose Camels reach the number on which a she Camel in her third year is payable does not possess one but possesses one in her second year, that will be accepted from him, but he must give two goats or twenty dirhams. Anyone whose Camels reach the number on which a she Camel in her second year is payable does not possess one but possesses a male Camel in its third year, that will be accepted from him, and nothing extra will be demanded along with it. If anyone possesses only four Camels, no zakat will be payable on them unless their owner wishes. If the numbers of the pasturing goats reach forty to one hundred and twenty, one goat is to be given. Over one hundred and twenty up to two hundred, two goats are to be given. If they exceed two hundred reaching three hundred, three goats are to be given. If they exceed three hundred, a goat is to be for every hundred. An old sheep, one with a defect in the eye, or a male goat is not to be accepted as sadaqah (zakat) unless the collector wishes. Those which are in separate flocks are not to be brought together and those which are in one flock are not to be separated from fear of sadaqah(zakat). Regarding what belongs to two partners, they can make claims for restitution from one another with equity, If a man’s pasturing animals are less than forty, no sadaqah(zakat) is due on them unless their owner wishes. On sliver dirhams a fortieth is payable, but if there are only a hundred and ninety, nothing is payable unless their owner wishes.” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1567)
hi: Abu Bakr (RA) ne Anas (RA) ke liye yeh (patra) likha, jispar Rasulullah (SAW) ki mohar thi, jab unhone unhein zakat wasool karne wala bana kar bheja aur yeh unke liye likha, ismein yeh tha: "Yeh woh zakat ka farz hai jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne Musalmanon par muqarrar kiya, jiska hukum Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko diya. To Musalmanon mein se jisse yeh (sahih tareeqe se) maanga jaye, use adaa karna chahiye, aur jisse isse zyada maanga jaye, use na de. Pachees (25) se kam oonton mein, har paanch oont par aik bakri hai. Jab oont pachees tak pahunch jaayen to unme aik saal ki oontni (bint-e-makhaad) hai, yahan tak ke woh paintees (35) tak pahunch jaayen; agar unme aik saal ki oontni na ho to aik nar oont (ibn-e-laboon) diya jaye. Jab woh chattees (36) tak pahunch jaayen to unme do saal ki oontni (bint-e-laboon) hai, yahan tak ke paintalees (45) tak. Jab woh chhiyaalees (46) tak pahunch jaayen to unme teen saal ki oontni (hiqqa) hai jo mila-e-nar ke qabil ho, yahan tak ke saath (60) tak. Jab woh iksath (61) tak pahunch jaayen to unme chaar saal ki oontni (jaz'ah) hai, yahan tak ke pachhattar (75) tak. Jab woh chhiyattar (76) tak pahunch jaayen to unme do do-saal ki oontniyaan (bint-e-laboon) hain, yahan tak ke nabbe (90) tak. Jab woh ikyaanwe (91) tak pahunch jaayen to unme do teen-saal ki oontniyaan (hiqqatan) hain jo mila-e-nar ke qabil hon, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Jab woh aik sau bees se zyada ho jaayen to har chalees (40) par aik do-saal ki oontni, aur har pachaas (50) par aik teen-saal ki oontni. Jab oonton ki umrein zakat ke faraiz mein mel na khaayen, to jiske paas jaz'ah (chaar saal ki) ka wajib ho aur uske paas jaz'ah na ho balke hiqqa ho, to woh usse qubool ki jayegi, aur woh iske sath do bakriyaan bhi de agar uske liye aasan ho, ya bees (20) dirham. Aur jiske paas hiqqa wajib ho aur uske paas hiqqa na ho balke jaz'ah ho, to woh usse qubool ki jayegi, aur zakat wasool karne wala use bees dirham ya do bakriyaan dega. Aur jiske paas bint-e-laboon wajib ho aur uske paas siwaye hiqqa ke kuch na ho, to woh usse qubool ki jayegi, aur zakat wasool karne wala use bees dirham aur do bakriyaan dega. Aur jiske paas bint-e-laboon wajib ho aur uske paas siwaye bint-e-makhaad ke kuch na ho, to woh usse qubool ki jayegi, aur (uske sath) do bakriyaan ya bees dirham (bhi lega). Aur jiske paas bint-e-makhaad wajib ho aur uske paas siwaye ibn-e-laboon (nar) ke kuch na ho, to woh usse qubool ki jayegi, aur uske sath kuch nahi (liya jayega). Aur jiske paas sirf chaar (oont) hon, to unme kuch (zakat) nahi, magar yeh ke unka maalik khud (kuch dena) chahe. Aur charne wali bakriyon mein, jab woh chaalees (40) hon, to unme aik bakri, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Jab woh aik sau bees se zyada ho jaayen to unme do bakriyaan, yahan tak ke do sau (200) tak. Jab woh do sau se zyada ho jaayen to unme teen bakriyaan, yahan tak ke teen sau (300) tak. Jab woh teen sau se zyada ho jaayen to har sau bakri par aik bakri. Aur zakat mein na koi budhi (bakri), na koi aib wali (bakri), aur na koi bakra liya jaye, magar yeh ke zakat lene wala khud chahe. Aur alag-alag (maal) ko sadqa (bachaane) ke khauf se jama na kiya jaye, aur jama (maal) ko alag na kiya jaye. Aur jo do sharikon ke paas ho, to woh aapas mein barabari se hisaab kar lenge. Agar kisi shakhs ki charne wali bakriyaan chaalees tak na pahunchen, to unme kuch (zakat) nahi, magar yeh ke unka maalik khud (kuch dena) chahe. Aur chandi mein chaalisven ka chauthaai hissa (zakat) hai, aur agar maal sirf aik sau nabbe (190) hi ho, to usme kuch (zakat) nahi, magar yeh ke uska maalik khud (kuch dena) chahe."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ : "Then he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner to the hadith of Musa ibn Isma'il from Hammad with its length, and for these words, there is evidence from the hadith of Az-Zuhri from Salim from his father."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, "phir unhone Musa bin Ismail ki, Hammad se, hadith ke qareeb-qareeb lambi hadith zikr ki, aur in alfaz ka shahid Az-Zuhri ki, Salim se, unke walid se, hadith mein milta hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote a letter about sadaqah (zakat) but he died before he could send it to his governors. He had kept it with his sword. So AbuBakr acted upon it till he died, and then Umar acted upon it till he died. It contained: "For five camels one goat is to be given; for ten camels two goats are to be given; for fifteen camels three goats are to be given; for twenty camels four goats are to be given; for twenty-five to thirty-five camels a she-camel in her second year is to be given. If the number exceeds by one up to seventy camels, a she-camel in her fourth year is to be given; if they exceed by one up to seventy-five camels, a she-camel in her fifth year is to be given; if they exceed by one up to ninety camels, two she-camels in their third year are to be given; if they exceed by one up to one hundred and twenty, two she-camels in their fourth year are to be given. If the camels are more than this, a she-camel in her fourth year is to be given for every fifty camels, and a she-camel in her third year is to be given for every forty camels. For forty to one hundred and twenty goats one goat is to be given; if they exceed by one up to two hundred, two goats are to be given. If they exceed by one up to three hundred, three goats are to be given; if the goats are more than this, one goat for every hundred goats is to be given. Nothing is payable until they reach one hundred. Those which are in one flock are not to be separated, and those which are in separate flocks are not be brought together from fear of sadaqah (zakat). Regarding that which belongs to two partners, they can make claims for restitution from each other with equity. An old goat and a defective one are not to be accepted as sadaqah (zakat)." Az-Zuhri said: When the collector comes, the goats will be apportioned into three flocks: one containing bad, the second good, and the third moderate. The collector will take zakat from the moderate. Az-Zuhri did not mention the cows (to be apportioned in three flocks). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1568)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne sadqe ka patra likha lekin isse apne aamilon tak bhejne se pehle wafat pa gaye, unhone ise apni talwar ke sath rakh chhoda tha. Abu Bakr (RA) ne iske mutabiq amal kiya yahan tak ke unka bhi intiqal ho gaya, phir Umar (RA) ne iske mutabiq amal kiya yahan tak ke unka bhi intiqal ho gaya. Ismein yeh tha: "Paanch oonton mein aik bakri, dus mein do bakriyaan, pandra mein teen bakriyaan, bees mein chaar bakriyaan, aur pachees mein aik saal ki oontni (bint-e-makhaad), yahan tak ke paintalees (45) tak. Agar aik zyada ho jaaye to usme teen saal ki oontni (hiqqa) hai, yahan tak ke saath (60) tak. Agar aik zyada ho jaaye to usme chaar saal ki oontni (jaz'ah) hai, yahan tak ke pachhattar (75) tak. Agar aik zyada ho jaaye to usme do do-saal ki oontniyaan (bint-e-laboon) hain, yahan tak ke nabbe (90) tak. Agar aik zyada ho jaaye to usme do teen-saal ki oontniyaan (hiqqatan) hain, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Agar oont isse zyada ho jaayen to har pachaas par aik teen-saal ki oontni, aur har chaalees par aik do-saal ki oontni. Aur bakriyon mein, har chaalees bakri par aik bakri, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Agar aik zyada ho jaaye to do bakriyaan, yahan tak ke do sau (200) tak. Agar do sau se aik zyada ho jaaye to usme teen bakriyaan, yahan tak ke teen sau (300) tak. Agar bakriyaan isse zyada ho jaayen to har sau bakri par aik bakri, aur jab tak sau tak na pahunche usme kuch (zakat) nahi. Aur jama (maal) ko alag nahi kiya jayega aur na alag (maal) ko sadqa (bachaane) ke khauf se jama kiya jayega, aur jo do sharikon ke paas ho, to woh aapas mein barabari se hisaab kar lenge, aur zakat mein na koi budhi aur na koi aib wali (bakri) li jayegi." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Jab zakat wasool karne wala aata to bakriyon ko teen hisson mein baanta jata - aik tihaai kharaab, aik tihaai behtareen, aur aik tihaai darmiyani - to zakat wasool karne wala darmiyani hisse se leta." Aur Az-Zuhri ne gaay-bail ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: [AI] This is a copy of the book of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, in which he wrote about charity. It is with the family of Umar ibn Al-Khattab. Ibn Shihab said, "Sālim ibn Abdullah ibn Umar read it to me, and I memorized it as it was on his face. This is the one that Umar ibn Abdul Aziz copied from Abdullah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar and Sālim ibn Abdullah when he was commanded over the city. He commanded his workers to act according to it and wrote to Al-Walīd, and Al-Walīd commanded his workers to act according to it. The caliphs continued to order this after Umar ibn Abdul Aziz. Then Hisham ordered that it be copied and given to every worker from the Muslims, and they were commanded to act according to its contents and not go beyond it. This is a book that explains what cannot be taken as charity from camels until they have reached five shepherd's share (thuwd). Once they reach five, then there should be a sheep until they reach ten. Once they reach ten, then there should be two sheep until they reach fifteen. Once they reach fifteen, then there should be four mature she-camels until they reach twenty-five. Once they reach twenty-five, a yearling she-camel is obligatory until they reach thirty-five. If there is no yearling she-camel, then a one-year-old male camel until they reach thirty-five. If they reach thirty-five, then a female camel is obligatory until they reach forty-five. If they reach forty-five, then two she-camels are obligatory until they reach fifty-five. If they reach fifty-five, then three mature she-camels are obligatory until they reach sixty. If they reach sixty-one, then a young healthy she-camel until they reach seventy-five. If they reach seventy-six, then a female camel is obligatory until they reach ninety. If they reach ninety-one, then two young healthy she-camels until they reach one hundred and twenty. If they reach one hundred and twenty-one, then three daughters of Laboon until they reach one hundred and twenty-five. If they reach one hundred and thirty, then two daughters of Laboon and a mature she-camel until they reach one hundred and thirty-five
hi: Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ke us patre ki naqal hai jismein unhone zakat ke baare mein likha, aur yeh Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke gharane ke paas mahfooz hai. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: "Mujhe Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar ne yeh padh kar sunaya, aur maine ise usi soorat mein yaad kar liya jaisa woh tha, aur yehi woh (naqal) hai jise Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Umar aur Salim bin Abdullah se, jab woh Madinah ke gawarnar bana diye gaye, dobara likhwaaya, phir apne aamilon ko iske mutabiq amal karne ka hukum diya aur Al-Walid ko bhi likh bheja, to Al-Walid ne apne aamilon ko iske mutabiq amal karne ka hukum diya, phir khulafa iske baad bhi isi ka hukum dete rahe, phir Hisham ne iska hukum diya, to usne ise Musalmanon ke har aamil ke liye naqal kiya aur unhein isme jo hai uske mutabiq amal karne aur usse tajaawuz na karne ka hukum diya. Aur yeh aik aisa patra hai jo isko wazeh karta hai: Oonton mein se kisi cheez ki zakat us waqt tak nahi li jaati jab tak woh paanch (5) tak na pahunch jaayen. Jab woh paanch tak pahunch jaayen to unme aik bakri hai, yahan tak ke dus (10) tak. Jab woh dus tak pahunch jaayen to unme do bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke pandra (15) tak. Jab woh pandra tak pahunch jaayen to unme chaar bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke pachees (25) tak. Jab woh pachees tak pahunch jaayen to unpar farz muqarrar hota hai, unme aik saal ki oontni (bint-e-makhaad) farz hai, agar bint-e-makhaad na mile to nar oont (ibn-e-laboon) diya jaye, yahan tak ke paintees (35) tak. Jab woh chattees (36) tak pahunch jaayen to unme do saal ki oontni (bint-e-laboon) hai, yahan tak ke paintalees (45) tak. Jab woh chhiyaalees (46) ho jaayen to unme teen saal ki oontni (hiqqa) hai jo unt ke mila-e-nar ke qabil ho, yahan tak ke saath (60) tak. Jab woh iksath (61) ho jaayen to unme chaar saal ki oontni (jaz'ah) hai, yahan tak ke pachhattar (75) tak. Jab woh chhiyattar (76) tak pahunch jaayen to unme do saal ki oontni hai (bint-e-laboon), yahan tak ke nabbe (90) tak. Jab woh ikyaanwe (91) ho jaayen to unme do teen-saal ki oontniyaan (hiqqatan) hain jo unt ke mila-e-nar ke qabil hon, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Jab woh aik sau ikkis (121) ho jaayen to unme teen do-saal ki oontniyaan (banaat-e-laboon) hain, yahan tak ke aik sau untees (129) tak. Jab woh aik sau tees (130) ho jaayen to unme do do-saal ki oontniyaan aur aik teen-saal ki oontni hain, yahan tak ke aik sau unchaas (139) tak. Jab woh aik sau chalees (140) ho jaayen to unme do teen-saal ki oontniyaan aur aik do-saal ki oontni hain, yahan tak ke aik sau unnchaas (149) tak. Jab woh aik sau pachaas (150) ho jaayen to unme teen teen-saal ki oontniyaan hain, yahan tak ke aik sau unsath (159) tak. Jab woh aik sau saath (160) ho jaayen to unme chaar do-saal ki oontniyaan hain, yahan tak ke aik sau unhattar (169) tak. Jab woh aik sau sattar (170) ho jaayen to unme teen do-saal ki oontniyaan aur aik teen-saal ki oontni hain, yahan tak ke aik sau unyaasi (179) tak. Jab woh aik sau assi (180) ho jaayen to unme do teen-saal ki oontniyaan aur do do-saal ki oontniyaan hain, yahan tak ke aik sau nawwaasi (189) tak. Jab woh aik sau nabbe (190) ho jaayen to unme teen teen-saal ki oontniyaan aur teen do-saal ki oontniyaan hain, yahan tak ke aik sau ninyaanwe (199) tak. Jab woh do sau (200) ho jaayen to unme chaar teen-saal ki oontniyaan hain, ya paanch do-saal ki oontniyaan, jo bhi umar mile usi hisaab se lo jaisa humne is patre mein likha hai. Phir isse zyada har oont isi tarah, jaisa humne is patre mein likha, liya jayega. Aur bakriyon se koi zakat us waqt tak nahi li jaati jab tak woh chaalees (40) tak na pahunch jaayen. Jab woh chaalees tak pahunch jaayen to unme aik bakri hai, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Jab woh aik sau ikkis (121) ho jaayen to unme do bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke do sau (200) tak. Jab woh do sau aik (201) ho jaayen to unme teen bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke teen sau (300) tak. Jab woh teen sau bakriyon se zyada ho jaayen to unme sirf teen bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke chaar sau (400) tak. Jab woh chaar sau tak pahunch jaayen to unme chaar bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke paanch sau (500) tak. Jab woh paanch sau tak pahunch jaayen to unme paanch bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke chhah sau (600) tak, unme chhah bakriyaan hain. Jab woh saat sau (700) tak pahunch jaayen to unme saat bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke aath sau (800) tak. Jab woh aath sau tak pahunch jaayen to unme aath bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke nau sau (900) tak. Jab woh nau sau tak pahunch jaayen to unme nau bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke aik hazar (1000) tak. Jab woh aik hazar bakriyon tak pahunch jaayen to unme dus bakriyaan hain, phir jitni sau bakri zyada ho, utni hi bakri zyada." Aur is hadith ki sehat par jo shahid hai...

e: [AI] When Umar bin Abdul Aziz assumed the caliphate, he sent to Madinah to seek the legacy of the Prophet ﷺ and to inquire about the secret of charity. He found a letter from Umar bin Khattab to his workers regarding charity, similar to the letter of the Prophet ﷺ to Amr ibn Hazm. Umar bin Abdul Aziz then ordered his workers to follow the instructions in both letters. In those letters was stated that camel charity should not exceed ninety-one, and in that case, it should be divided between twenty and one hundred. If the number exceeds one hundred and twenty-one, then three Libuun daughters should be added until it reaches one hundred and twenty-nine. If the number of camels is larger than that, then no share is given unless it reaches ten camels. As for the letter of the Prophet ﷺ to Amr ibn Hazm, its chain of narration is accepted because of the condition mentioned in this letter, and that is why I mentioned the length of the context.
hi: Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne, jab woh khalifa bana diye gaye, Madinah ki taraf sandesa bheja ke woh Nabi (SAW) ka wo ahd-naama, aur zakaton ke silsile mein rasm-o-riwaaz, talaash karein, to unhein Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke gharane ke paas Umar (RA) ka apne aamilon ko likha hua zakaton ke baare mein aik patra mila, jo Nabi (SAW) ke Amr bin Hazm (RA) ke naam patre jaisa tha. To Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne apne zakat aamilon ko hukum diya ke woh un dono patron mein jo likha hai usi ke mutabiq amal karein. Un dono mein yeh tha: "Oonton ki zakat, jab woh nabbe (90) se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme do teen-saal ki oontniyaan (hiqqatan) hain, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Jab woh aik sau bees se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme teen do-saal ki oontniyaan (banaat-e-laboon) hain, yahan tak ke aik sau untees (129) tak. Jab oont isse zyada ho jaayen to jitni us se kam dus tak na pahunche usme kuch nahi jab tak dus tak na pahunch jaayen." Rahi baat Nabi (SAW) ke Amr bin Hazm (RA) ke naam patre ki, to iski sanad is kitaab ki shart mein shamil hai, isi liye maine iska poora silsila zikr kiya hai.

e: [AI] "The book which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wrote for 'Amr ibn Hazm states, 'When the value of gold reaches 200 dirhams, then for every 40 dirhams, there shall be a dirham.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, woh patra jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne Amr bin Hazm (RA) ke liye likha: "Jab sone ki qeemat do sau (200) dirham tak pahunch jaaye to har chaalees (40) dirham par aik dirham (zakat) hai."

e: [AI] "On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, that he wrote to the people of Yemen in a letter that included the obligatory duties, the recommended practices, and the charitable donations. The letter was sent with 'Amr ibn Hazm, and I read it to the people of Yemen. This is a copy of it: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. From Muhammad, the Prophet, to Shurahbil ibn 'Abd Kulal, Harith ibn 'Abd Kulal, and Nu'aim ibn Kulal, also known as the people of Ru'ayn, Ma'aafir, and Hamdan. After that, your messenger has returned and you have been given one-fifth of the spoils of war, as well as the fixed amount that Allah has prescribed for the believers from the agricultural lands that are irrigated naturally or by artificial means, or that are situated on hills. The fixed amount should be paid when the crops reach five usq in quantity. And what is watered by rain or springs, the fixed amount should be paid when the crops reach half of the usq requirement. And for every five camels that graze free, one sheep should be given until they reach twenty-four. And if one more is added, a one-year-old offspring should be given. If it is not available, then a male lamb until they reach thirty-five. And if one more is added, a one-year-old offspring should be given until they reach fifty. And if one more is added, a she-camel that is ready to mate should be given until they reach sixty. And if one more is added, a leg should be given until they reach seventy-five. And if one more is added, a female lamb should be given until they reach ninety. And if one more is added, two leg joints should be given until they reach one hundred and twenty. And if one more is added, then three thighs should be given until they reach three hundred. And whatever exceeds that, for every one hundred sheep, one sheep should be given. And there should not be haramah, nor unhealthy animals, nor animals with injuries, nor the offspring of a goat, except out of the will of the donor. And it should not be collected from disunited groups, nor separated among combined groups, for fear of causing a decrease in charity. And whatever is taken from the two mixed substances, they should be separated equally. And for every forty counts of paper currency, five dirhams should be given. And for every additional forty dirhams, one dirham should be given. And there is nothing less than five dirhams. And for every forty dinars, one dinar should be given. Verily, sadaqah is not permissible for Muhammad nor for the family of Muhammad. Rather, it is zakah, by which they purify themselves and support the poor believers, in the cause of Allah and the stranded traveler. And there is nothing for the slave or his horse.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne Yemen walon ke liye aik patra likha jismein faraaiz, sunan aur diyaat (khoon-baha) ki tafseel thi, aur Amr bin Hazm (RA) ke sath bheja. Unhone kaha: maine ise Yemen walon ko padh kar sunaya, aur yeh iski naqal hai: "Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem. Muhammad Nabi ki taraf se, Shurahbeel bin Abd Kulal, Al-Harith bin Abd Kulal, aur Nu'aim bin Kulal - jo Zi Ru'ain, Ma'afir aur Hamdan kehlaate hain - ke naam, ammaba'd: 'Tumhara qaasid wapas aa gaya hai, aur tumhein maal-e-ghaneemat mein se Allah ka paanchwan hissa (khums) diya gaya hai, aur woh dushwan hissa (ushr) jo Allah ne momino par zameen ki paidawaar mein muqarrar kiya hai - jise aasman ne seencha ho, ya musalsal barsa ho, ya buland zameen se seencha ho - usme ushr hai jab woh paanch wasq tak pahunch jaaye. Aur jise rassi aur dol se seencha jaye, usme aadha ushr hai jab woh paanch wasq tak pahunch jaaye. Aur charne wale oonton mein se har paanch par aik bakri hai, yahan tak ke chaubees (24) tak. Jab woh chaubees se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme aik saal ki oontni (bint-e-makhaad) hai, agar na mile to nar oont (ibn-e-laboon), yahan tak ke paintees (35) tak. Jab woh paintees se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme do saal ki oontni (bint-e-laboon) hai, yahan tak ke paintalees (45) tak. Agar woh paintalees se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme teen saal ki oontni (hiqqa) hai jo mila-e-nar ke qabil ho, yahan tak ke saath (60) tak. Agar woh saath se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme chaar saal ki oontni (jaz'ah) hai, yahan tak ke pachhattar (75) tak. Agar woh pachhattar se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme do saal ki oontni (bint-e-laboon) hai, yahan tak ke nabbe (90) tak. Agar woh nabbe se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme do teen-saal ki oontniyaan (hiqqatan) hain jo mila-e-nar ke qabil hon, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Jitni bhi aik sau bees se zyada ho jaayen to har chaalees par aik do-saal ki oontni, aur har pachaas par aik teen-saal ki oontni jo mila-e-nar ke qabil ho. Aur har tees (30) gaay-bail par aik saal ki bachhda-bachhi (tabee'-jaza'), aur har chaalees (40) gaay-bail par aik gaay. Aur charne wali har chaalees bakriyon par aik bakri, yahan tak ke aik sau bees (120) tak. Agar woh aik sau bees se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme do bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke do sau (200) tak. Agar woh do sau se aik zyada ho jaayen to unme teen bakriyaan hain, yahan tak ke teen sau (300) tak. Agar isse zyada ho jaayen to jo bhi zyada ho, har sau par aik bakri. Aur zakat mein na koi budhi (bakri), na koi kamzor, na koi aib wali (bakri), aur na koi bakra liya jaye, magar yeh ke zakat wasool karne wala khud chahe. Aur alag-alag (maal) ko sadqa (bachaane) ke khauf se jama na kiya jaye, aur jama (maal) ko alag na kiya jaye. Aur jo do sharikon ke paas ho, to woh aapas mein barabari se hisaab kar lenge. Aur chandi ki har paanch auqiya par paanch dirham (zakat) hai, aur jitna zyada ho, har chaalees dirham par aik dirham, aur paanch auqiya se kam mein kuch nahi. Aur har chaalees dinar par aik dinar. Beshak sadqa Muhammad (SAW) ke liye halal nahi, aur na hi Muhammad (SAW) ke ghar walon ke liye, yeh to sirf zakat hai jise woh apni jaanon ko paak karne ke liye dete hain, aur yeh momino ke faqeeron, Allah ki raah aur musafiron ke liye hai. Aur kisi ghulam mein aur na hi khaiti mein aur na hi uske kaam karne walon mein kuch (zakat) nahi jab woh apni zakat ushr se ada karta ho, aur beshak kisi Musalman ghulam mein aur na hi uske ghode mein kuch (zakat) nahi.'"

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'With regard to grazing camels, for every forty a Bint Labun. No differentiation is to be made between camels when calculating them. Whoever gives it seeking reward will be rewarded for it. Whoever refuses, we will take it and half of his camels, as one of the rights of our Lord. And it is not permissible for the family of Muhammad to have any of them."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2449)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Har charne wale oont mein, har chaalees (40) par aik do-saal ka nar oont (ibn-e-laboon) hai, oonton ko unke hisaab se alag na kiya jaye. Jo isse sawab ki niyat se de, use uska ajr milega, aur jo ise rok le, to hum use zaroor lengay, aur uske aadhe oont bhi, yeh humare Rab ke ahkaam mein se aik pukhta hukum hai, ismein se Aal-e-Muhammad (SAW) ke liye kuch bhi halal nahi."

e: That the Messenger of Allah sent him to Yemen, and he commanded him to take a Dinar, or its equivalent in Maafr,[1] from each person who had reached the age of puberty. And with regard to cattle, from every thirty a male or female Tabi '(two-year-old). And from every forty a Musinnah (three-year-old). (Daif) (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2450)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Yemen bheja aur unhein hukum diya ke woh gaay-bail mein se har tees (30) par aik saal ka bachhda (tabee'), aur har chaalees (40) par aik pukhta gaay (musinna) lein, aur har baligh shakhs se aik dinar, ya uske barabar Ma'afir (ka aik) kapda, lein."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent him as a messenger, and his father said, "Do not leave until you make a covenant with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." When he wanted to leave, he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  who said to him, "O Qais, do not come on the Day of Resurrection with a camel that has spots, or a cow that has horns, or a sheep that has been borrowed, and do not be like Abu Righal." So Saad asked, "Who is Abu Righal?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "He is a truthful person whom Saleh, the messenger, sent. He found a man in Ta'if with a near abundance of a hundred sheep, except for one sheep and a young boy who has no mother. And that sheep is his sustenance." The owner of the sheep asked, "Who are you?" He replied, "I am the messenger of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." The man greeted him and said, "These are my sheep, take whatever you like." He looked at the spotted sheep and said, "This one." The man said, "This young boy, as you can see, has no food or drink except for it." He said, "If you like milk, I also like it." So he said, "Take two sheep instead of it." He refused, but he continued to increase and offer until he gave him five pairs of sheep instead of it. Then he refused to give him more. When he saw that, he went to his bow and shot him, killing him. Then he said, "It is not appropriate for anyone to come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with such news before me." So the owner of the sheep went to Saleh, the Prophet ﷺ , and informed him. Saleh cursed Abu Righal twice. Then Saad bin Ubada said, "O Messenger of Allah, forgive Qais for the water."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein zakat wasool karne wala bana kar bheja, to unke waalid ne kaha: "Jab tak Rasulullah (SAW) se dobara ahd na kar lo, mat nikalna." Jab woh nikalne lage to Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye Qais, Qayamat ke din apni gardan par koi bolta hua oont, ya bolti hui gaay, ya cheekhti hui bakri lekar na aana, aur Abu Righal jaisa na banna." Sa'd (RA) ne poocha: "Abu Righal kaun tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik zakat wasool karne wala jise Salih (AS) ne bheja tha, usne Taif mein aik shakhs ko paaya jiske paas aik sau ke qareeb kamzor bakriyaan thin, siwaye aik bakri ke, aur aik chhota yateem ladka tha jiski koi maa nahi thi, aur us aik bakri ka doodh hi uski roz-marra ki khuraak thi. Bakriyon ke maalik ne poocha: 'Tum kaun ho?' Usne kaha: 'Main Rasulullah (SAW) ka bheja hua qaasid hoon.' Usne khush-aamdeed kaha aur kaha: 'Yeh meri bakriyaan hain, jo tumhein pasand ho le lo.' To usne doodh dene wali bakri ko dekha aur kaha: 'Yehi (loonga).' Us shakhs ne kaha: 'Yeh bachcha, jaisa tum dekh rahe ho, iske ilawa (khaane-peene ke liye) uske paas koi khana ya pani nahi hai.' Usne kaha: 'Agar tumhein doodh pasand hai to mujhe bhi pasand hai.' Us shakhs ne kaha: 'Iske badle do bakriyaan le lo.' Usne inkaar kar diya, phir woh badle mein zyada aur zyada peshkash karta raha yahan tak ke usne kamzor bakriyon mein se paanch bakriyan uske badle peshkash ki, phir bhi usne inkaar kiya. Jab usne yeh dekha to apne kamaan ki taraf mudkar usse teer maara aur usse qatl kar diya, phir kaha: 'Kisi ke liye munasib nahi ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas yeh khabar mujh se pehle le jaaye.' To bakriyon ka maalik Salih (AS) Nabi ke paas gaya aur unhein bataya, to Salih (AS) ne kaha: 'Aye Allah, Abu Righal par la'nat kar, Aye Allah, Abu Righal par la'nat kar.'" Sa'd bin Ubadah (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Qais ko paani (ki zimmedari) se mu'aaf kar dijiye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent Saad bin Ubada as a witness. He said, "O Saad, be careful not to come on the Day of Resurrection with a camel carrying its saddle." Saad said, "I cannot find it and I will not bring it." So, the Prophet forgave him.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Sa'd bin Ubadah (RA) ko zakat wasool karne bheja, aur farmaya: "Aye Sa'd, khabardar Qayamat ke din tum kisi bolte hue oont ko uthaaye hue na aana." Unhone kaha: "Main aisa nahi paaunga aur na hi aisa laaunga." To aap (SAW) ne unhein mu'aaf kar diya.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commissioned me as a collector of zakat. I visited a man. When he had collected his property of camels, I found that a she-camel in her second year was due from him. I said to him: Pay a she-camel in her second year, for she is to be paid as sadaqah (zakat) by you. He said: That one is not worthy of milking and riding. Here is another she-camel which is young, grand and fat. So take it. I said to him: I shall not take an animal for which I have not been commanded. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ is here near to you. If you like, go to him, and present to him what you presented to me. Do that; if he accepts it from you, I shall accept it; if he rejects it, I shall reject it. He said: I shall do it. He accompanied me and took with him the she-camel which he had presented to me. We came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said to him: Prophet of Allah, your messenger came to me to collect zakat on my property. By Allah, neither the Messenger of Allah nor his messenger has ever seen my property before. I gathered my property (camels), and he estimated that a she-camel in her second year would be payable by me. But that has neither milk nor is it worth riding. So I presented to him a grand young she-camel for acceptance as zakat. But he has refused to take her. Look, she is here; I have brought her to you, Messenger of Allah. Take her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: That is what is due from you. If you give voluntarily a better (animal) Allah will give a reward to you for it. We accept her from you. She is here, Messenger of Allah; I have brought her to you. So take her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then ordered me to take possession of it, and he prayed for a blessing on his property. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1583)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe zakat wasool karne bheja, main aik shakhs ke paas se guzra, usne mere liye apna maal jama kiya, mujhe usme sirf aik saal ki oontni (bint-e-makhaad) hi (zakat ke tor par) waajib mili, to maine usse kaha: "Bint-e-makhaad ada karo, kyunke yehi tumhari zakat hai." Usne kaha: "Yeh to aisi hai jismein na doodh hai na sawaari, lekin yeh aik badi mote-taze oontni hai, isse le lo." Maine usse kaha: "Main jo mujhe hukum nahi diya gaya woh nahi loonga, aur Rasulullah (SAW) tumhare qareeb hi hain, agar tum chaho to unke paas jao aur jo mujhe peshkash ki hai woh unhein bhi karo, agar unhone tumse qubool kar li to main bhi qubool kar loonga, aur agar unhone tumhein rad kar diya to main bhi rad kar dunga." Usne kaha: "To main aisa hi karunga." Unhone kaha: to woh mere sath nikla aur woh oontni bhi le kar chala jo usne mujhe peshkash ki thi, yahan tak ke hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahunche, usne kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, aapka aik qaasid mere paas aaya taake mere maal ki zakat le, Allah ki qasam, mere maal ke paas Rasulullah (SAW) ya unka koi qaasid isse pehle kabhi khada nahi hua tha, to maine unke liye apna maal jama kiya, unhone kaha ke mujh par sirf aik saal ki oontni (bint-e-makhaad) hi wajib hai, aur yeh to aisi hai jismein na doodh hai na sawaari, aur maine unhein aik badi mote-taze oontni peshkash ki taake woh le lein, lekin unhone mujhse inkaar kar diya, aur woh yeh rahi, main ise aapke paas le aaya hoon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), ise le lijiye." Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Yehi hai jo tum par wajib hai, agar tum apni khushi se koi behtar cheez do to Allah tumhein iska ajr dega aur hum ise tumse qubool kar lenge." Usne kaha: "To yeh rahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main ise aapke paas le aaya hoon, ise le lijiye." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne ise qubool karne ka hukum diya aur uske maal mein barkat ki dua ki.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (Peace be upon him) said, "There is no charity in a small amount until it reaches two hundred dirhams."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chandi mein sadqa (zakat) us waqt tak nahi jab tak woh do sau (200) dirham tak na pahunche."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "There is nothing in ninety-nine, but when it reaches two hundred, it contains five dirhams."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik sau nabbe (190) mein kuch (zakat) nahi, jab woh do sau (200) tak pahunch jaaye to usme paanch dirham (zakat) hai."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ that he sent to a man and sent to him a mixed camel. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He came to him as a believer in Allah and a believer in His Messenger, so he sent a mixed camel. O Allah, do not bless him in it or in his camels." The man conveyed this and sent to him a camel from his good and beautiful ones. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "So-and-so said what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, so he sent him a camel from his good ones. O Allah, bless him and his camels."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne aik shakhs ke paas (zakat lene) bheja, to usne unke paas kamzor, dubla (bhaaga hua) oont ka bachcha bhej diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uske paas Allah ka tasdeeq karne wala aur uske Rasool ka tasdeeq karne wala aaya, to usne kamzor, dubla bachcha bheja, Aye Allah, na isme aur na iske oonton mein barkat de." Yeh baat us shakhs tak pahunchi, to usne apni khoobsurat aur khoob-shakl oontniyon mein se aik oontni bhej di, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fulan ko Rasulullah (SAW) ki baat pahunchi, to usne apni khoobsurat oontniyon mein se aik bheji, Aye Allah, usme aur uske oonton mein barkat de."

e: Some people from Syria came to ‘Umar and said: We have acquired wealth and horses and slaves,and we want to pay zakah on them as a purification. He said: I shall do what my two predecessors did. He consulted the Companions of Muhammad ﷺ, among whom was ‘Ali, and ‘Ali said: It is good, provided it does not become a regular tax that is taken from them after you are gone. (Using translation from Aḥmad 82)
hi: Sham ke kuch log Umar (RA) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Humein maal, ghode aur ghulam mile hain, hum chahte hain ke inme humari zakat aur paakizgi ho." Unhone kaha: "Jo mere donon saathiyon ne mujhse pehle kiya, wahi karunga." To Umar (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) ke aik giroh mein Ali (Alayhis Salam) se mashwara kiya, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Yeh achha hai, agar yeh koi jizya (tax) na ban jaaye jo unse musalsal (har saal) liya jaaye."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ that he only took zakat from wheat, barley, raisins, and dates.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap (SAW) sirf "gehun, jau, kishmish aur khajoor" se sadqa liya karte the.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Regarding what is watered by rain, natural springs, and the overflow of rivers, one-tenth (of the crops) is due. And regarding what is watered through irrigation channels, half of one-tenth (of the crops) is due. This applies only to dates, wheat, and grains. As for cucumbers, watermelons, pomegranates, and sugarcanes, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  exempted them from this."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo cheez aasman ke paani se, ya jad (zameen ki nami) se, ya seylaab se seenchi jaye, usme ushr (dushwan hissa) hai, aur jo (rehat) kheenchne se seenchi jaye usme aadha ushr hai, aur yeh sirf khajoor, gehun aur anaaj mein hota hai, rahi baat kheera, tarbooz, anaar aur ganne ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne inhein maaf kar diya."

e: [AI] "From Abu Musa and Muadh ibn Jabal when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent them to Yemen to teach the people about their religious affairs, he said to them, 'Do not take charity except from these four things: barley, wheat, raisins, and dates.'"
hi: Abu Musa (RA) aur Muadh bin Jabal (RA) se, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Yemen bheja taake woh logon ko unke deen ki baatein sikhayen: "(Unhein hukum diya:) Sadqa sirf in chaar cheezon se lo: jau, gehun, kishmish aur khajoor."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "A Muslim man is not required to pay Zakat on his generosity or on his crops if they are less than five awsuq."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman aadmi par apne angoor ke baagh mein aur na hi apni khaiti mein zakat nahi, jab woh paanch wasq se kam ho."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ forbid two types of dates, the Juhur dates and Hubayq dates. He said that there were people who would take their bad dates to give them in charity, so they were prohibited from using these two types of dates. Then, the verse was revealed "Do not give the bad among them in charity" [Quran 2:267].
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne khajoor ki do (kamzor) qismon - Al-Ju'rur aur Lawn Al-Hubaiq - se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: aur log jaan-boojh kar apni sabse bekaar khajoorein sadqe mein nikaalte the, to unhein in do qismon se mana kar diya gaya, phir yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Aur bekaar cheez ka qasad na karo ke usme se kharch karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267).

e: [AI] A Bedouin man came to the Messenger of Allah on the night of the sighting of the crescent moon of Ramadan, and he said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have seen the moon." The Messenger of Allah asked him, "Do you testify that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?" The man replied, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah then said, "Proclaim to the people to begin fasting." This narration was reported by Al-Fadl ibn Musa from Sufyan Ath-Thawri.
hi: Aik dehati shakhs Ramzan ke chaand ki raat aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine chaand dekha hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur gawahi dete ho ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To logon mein aelaan karo ke woh roza rakhein." Isi tarah Al-Fadl bin Musa ne Sufyan Ath-Thawri se isi ki riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, I have seen the crescent moon." He said, "Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Then announce that the people should fast."
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine chaand dekha hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To aelaan karo ke woh roza rakhein."

e: [AI] "That they should neither stand nor fast, then a Bedouin from the Harra came and testified that he saw the crescent moon. So the Prophet ﷺ ordered Bilal to make the call for the people to stand and fast. Al-Bukhari referenced the narrations of Ikrimah, while Muslim referenced the narrations of Simak ibn Harb and Hammad ibn Salamah in support of this hadith, which is authentic and was not rejected by them."
hi: "...ke woh na khadi ho (namaz ke liye) aur na roza rakhein," phir Al-Harrah se aik dehati aaya aur gawahi di ke usne chaand dekha hai, "to Nabi (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya ke woh (logon se) khade hone aur roza rakhne ka aelaan karein." Bukhari ne Ikrimah ki ahadith ko, aur Muslim ne Simak bin Harb aur Hammad bin Salamah ki ahadith ko hujjat maana hai, aur yeh hadith sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] I entered upon Ikrimah on the day where there was uncertainty about Ramadan, and he was eating. So he said, "Come closer and eat." I said, "Indeed, I am fasting." He said, "By Allah, you will still eat." I said, "Inform me then." He said, "Ibn Abbas narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Do not fast until you see the month (i.e., the crescent moon), and do not break your fast until you see it. But if it is cloudy or overcast and you cannot see it, then complete the count of thirty days.'"
hi: Main Ikrimah ke paas dakhil hua us din jab Ramzan mein shak tha, woh khana kha rahe the, unhone kaha: "Aao, khao." Maine kaha: "Main roze se hoon." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tum zaroor aaoge." Maine kaha: "To mujhe hadith sunao." Unhone kaha: mujhe Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mahine ka istiqbaal (pehle se andaaza) na karo, uske dekhne par roza rakho aur uske dekhne par roza kholo, aur agar tumhare aur uske manzar ke darmiyan baadal ya gubaar aa jaye, to teen (30) din poore karo."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Observe the crescent moon of Sha'ban for the sighting of Ramadan." It is an authentic narration according to the conditions set by Muslim, and it was not contradicted.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sha'ban ke chaand ka Ramzan ke liye shumaar (hisaab) rakho." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Dawn is of two types. As for the first type, it does not prohibit eating nor permit prayer. And as for the second type, it prohibits eating and permits prayer."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fajr do (tarah ki) hain: pehli woh jo na khane ko haram karti hai aur na namaz ko halal karti hai, aur doosri woh jo khane ko haram karti hai aur namaz ko halal karti hai."

e: The Adhan of Bilal should not mislead you nor the whiteness (of the pillar) of dawn, for it is not the whiteness of the true dawn, but that of the false dawn which is vertical like a pillar and you can eat food till the streaks of whiteness spread like it. (Using translation from Muslim 1094b)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bilal (RA) ki azan tumhein dhoka na de, aur na hi Subah ke satoon jaisi yeh safedi, jab tak woh phail na jaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Seek help in fasting during the day with the Sahur (pre-dawn meal), and seek help in standing for prayer at night with the Qaylulah (midday nap)." Zam'ah ibn Salih and Salamah ibn Wahram are not unreliable narrators, as they can be referred to. However, the two Sheikh's did not exclude them and this is one of the hidden gems in this hadith in this regard.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sehri ke khane se din ke roze mein madad lo, aur din ki qailoolah (thodi der aaram) se raat ke qiyaam mein madad lo." Zam'ah bin Salih aur Salamah bin Wahram matrook (chhode huay) nahi hain jinki hujjat na li jaaye, lekin Shaykhain ne unse riwayat nahi ki, aur yeh is baab ki khaas ahadith mein se hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When any of you hears the summons to prayer while he has a vessel in his hand, he should not lay it down till he fulfils his need. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2350)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi azan sune jabke bartan uske haath mein ho, to use na rakhe jab tak apni zaroorat poori na kar le."

e: "Messenger of Allah vomited [so he broke fast] so he performed Wudu." So I met Thawban in a Masjid in Damascus, and I mentioned that to him. He said: 'He told the truth, I poured the water for his Wudu." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 87)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ko qai (ulti) aayi, to unhone roza tod diya," phir main Thawban (RA) se Damascus ki masjid mein mila aur unhein yeh baat bataayi, to unhone kaha: "Sach kaha, maine hi unke wudu ke liye paani dala tha."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  ate and broke his fast.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ko qai (ulti) aayi, to unhone roza tod diya."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, fasted and then broke his fast."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko qai aayi, to unhone roza tod diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If the fasting person mistakenly eats or drinks, then he should continue fasting, and if he vomits involuntarily, then it does not break his fast." This was narrated by Isa ibn Yunus from Hisham.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab roze-daar jaan-boojh kar qai kare to uska roza toot jata hai, aur jab use khud-ba-khud qai aa jaye (bagair iraade ke) to uska roza nahi tootta." Isa bin Yunus ne Hisham se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever is overwhelmed by vomiting, it is not obligatory for him to make up for missed prayers. And whoever intentionally vomits, he must make up for the missed prayers." This is an authentic hadith according to the condition of the two sheikhs (referring to Abu Bakr and Umar) and they did not exclude it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise khud-ba-khud qai aa jaye, uspar qaza nahi, aur jo jaan-boojh kar qai kare, woh qaza kare." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] I went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  for eighteen nights of Ramadan. When we were in al-Baqi', the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw a man performing Halq(Removing some or all of the hair on the head) and he said, "The one doing Halq and the one performing Taqsir (trimming the hair but not shaving it completely) have broken their fast." Al-Awza'i established this chain of narration, verified and clarified the hearing of each narrator from their respective sources. Shayban ibn Abdur Rahman an-Nahwi and Hisham ibn Abi Abdullah ad-Dastuwai followed him in that. All of them are trustworthy narrators. So, this hadith is authentic according to the criteria of the two Shaykhs (Imams Bukhari and Muslim), and they did not exclude it.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Ramzan ke ataaraah (18) raaton guzarne ke baad safar kiya, jab hum Al-Baqi' mein thay to Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko hijamah (pachhna/cupping) karwate dekha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale, dono ka roza toot gaya." Al-Awza'i ne is sanad ko qaim kiya aur ise durust kiya, aur har raawi ka apne saathi se sunna wazeh kiya, "aur Shayban bin Abdur Rahman An-Nahwi aur Hisham bin Abi Abdullah Ad-Dastuwai ne isi ki mutaba'at ki, aur sab thiqa hain," to yeh hadith Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "That two of the servants of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was walking in Al-Baqi' during Ramadan, he saw a man shaving his head. He said, 'The one who shaved and the one whose head was shaved have broken their fast.' Ahmed bin Hanbal said, 'And this is the most authentic narration in this matter.'"
hi: Thawban (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam, ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) Ramzan mein Al-Baqi' mein chal rahe the ke unhone aik shakhs ko hijamah karwate dekha, to farmaya: "Hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale, dono ka roza toot gaya." Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: "Yeh is baab mein riwayat ki gayi sabse sahih hadith hai."
