e: [AI] He said: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was walking in Al-Baqi' during Ramadan, he saw a man who was shaving his head. he (the Prophet) said: "The one who shaves his head and the one who has his head shaved are breaking their fast." This is a clear chain of narrators, including the transmission of the narrators who reported it and the trustworthy ones who confirmed it. It cannot be criticized by any difference among those who were deemed weak by Abi Qilabah and others. And according to Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, there is another sound chain of narration regarding it, according to the conditions of the two Shaykhs.
hi: Unhone unhein bataya, kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) Ramzan mein Al-Baqi' mein chal rahe the ke unhone aik shakhs ko hijamah karwate dekha, to farmaya: "Hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale, dono ka roza toot gaya." Yeh woh asaneed hain jinme raawiyon ka sunna wazeh hai jinhone ise naql kiya, aur woh thiqa aur mo'tabar hain, inpar Abu Qilabah aur doosron ke darmiyan majrooh raawiyon ke ikhtilaf se koi aitraaz nahi kiya ja sakta, aur Yahya bin Abi Kathir ke paas iski aik aur sahih sanad hai jo Shaykhain ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The Hājim (a person who uses cupping for treatment) and the Mahjūm (a person whose head is shaved) break their fast." In the narration of Ishāq al-Dabari, it mentions the Mustahjim (a person who administers cupping) as well. Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Ishāq said in his narration, "I heard al-‘Abbās ibn ‘Abd al-‘Azīm say, 'I heard ‘Ali ibn al-Madīni say, 'I do not know of any hadith more authentic than this one.'" Mu‘āwiyah ibn Salām followed up with a narration from Yahyā ibn Abī Kathīr.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale, dono ka roza toot gaya." Ishaq Ad-Dabri ki hadith mein 'Al-Mustahjim' (hijamah karwaane ka khwahishmand) bhi hai, aur Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Ishaq ne apni hadith mein kaha: maine Al-Abbas bin Abdul Azeem ko kehte hue suna, unhone Ali bin Al-Madini ko kehte hue suna: "Mujhe hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale ke baare mein isse zyada sahih koi hadith maloom nahi." Muawiyah bin Sallam ne Yahya bin Abi Kathir se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] "Regarding the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about it, the seeker of this knowledge should know that both chains of narration for Yahya Ibn Abi Kathir have been ruled as authentic, one by Ahmad Ibn Hanbal and the other by Ali Ibn Madini. Therefore, one should not use one ruling to criticize the other. Additionally, Ishaq Ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali has ruled the hadith of Shaddad Ibn Aws as authentic."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Is ilm ke talib ko jaan lena chahiye ke Yahya bin Abi Kathir ki donon asaneed ko, aik ko Ahmad bin Hanbal ne sahih qaraar diya hai, aur doosri ko Ali bin Al-Madini ne sahih qaraar diya hai, isliye aik ko doosri se kamzor nahi kiya ja sakta, aur Ishaq bin Ibrahim Al-Hanzali ne Shaddad bin Aws (RA) ki hadith ko bhi sahih qaraar diya hai.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by a man in Al-Baqi' who was wrapping himself, and it was eighteen days into Ramadan, he said, 'The person who performs Hijamah (cupping) and the person who has it done for him have broken their fast.' I heard Muhammad ibn Salih saying that he heard Ahmad ibn Salamah saying that he heard Ishaq ibn Ibrahim saying, 'This is a sound chain of narration, supported by evidence. And this hadith has been confirmed by its chains. Abu Ya'qub, may Allah be pleased with him, has approved its authenticity based on a hadith that is clearly reliable.' He said, 'Both Thurayyi and Shu'bah agree on narrating it from Asim Al-Ahwal from Abu Qilabah in the same manner.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Al-Baqi' mein aik shakhs ke paas se guzre jo hijamah karwa raha tha, jabke aap (SAW) mera haath thaame huay the, Ramzan ki attaraveen (18) tareekh guzar chuki thi, to farmaya: "Hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale, dono ka roza toot gaya." Maine Muhammad bin Salih ko kehte hue suna, unhone Ahmad bin Salamah ko kehte hue suna, unhone Ishaq bin Ibrahim ko kehte hue suna: "Yeh sahih sanad hai jispar hujjat qaim hoti hai," aur yeh hadith kayi asaneed se sahih sabit hui hai, aur isi baat ke sath humare imam Abu Ya'qub - Allah unse raazi ho - ne bhi is zaahir sahih hadith ki sehat ka faisla kiya aur isi ka qaayil huay, aur Ath-Thawri aur Shu'bah dono ne Aasim Al-Ahwal se, Abu Qilabah se, isi tarah riwayat karne par ittifaq kiya hai.

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, passed by Ma'qil ibn Yasir in the morning of the eighteenth day of Ramadan while he was performing ihtikaam (a form of voluntary fasting where one continues fasting from the previous day without breaking it). The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "The one who is performing ihtikaam has broken his fast, as well as the one who has been restrained."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Ramzan ki attaraveen (18) subah Ma'qil bin Yasar (RA) ke paas se guzre jabke woh hijamah karwa rahe the, to farmaya: "Hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale, dono ka roza toot gaya."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ passed by a man who was getting bloodletting done on the seventeenth day of Ramadan, so he said, "The one who gets bloodletting done and the one who does it for others have broken their fast." Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Ishaq Al-Isfaraini told us, Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Al-Bara' told us, 'Ali bin Al-Madinani said, "Shaddad bin Aws narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he saw a man getting bloodletting done in Ramadan." Aasim Al-Ahwal narrated it from Abu Qilabah, who narrated it from Abu Al-Ash'ath, and Yahya bin Abi Kathir narrated it from Abu Qilabah, who narrated it from Abu Asma', who narrated it from Thawban. "I do not see the authenticity of the two narrations except as Sahih, for it is possible that he heard it from all of them." As for the permission for cupping for the fasting person, it was reported by Muhammad ibn Isma'il Al-Bukhari in Al-Jami'al-Sahih.
hi: Nabi (SAW) sattarah (17) Ramzan ko aik shakhs ke paas se guzre jo hijamah karwa raha tha, to farmaya: "Hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale, dono ka roza toot gaya." Humein Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan bin Muhammad bin Ishaq Al-Isfaraini ne bataya, unhein Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Al-Bara' ne bataya, unhein Ali bin Al-Madini ne bataya, unhone kaha: Shaddad bin Aws (RA) ki hadith, Rasulullah (SAW) se, ke unhone aik shakhs ko Ramzan mein hijamah karwate dekha, ise Aasim Al-Ahwal ne Abu Qilabah se, unhone Abu Al-Ash'ath se, riwayat kiya hai, aur Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne Abu Qilabah se, unhone Abu Asma' se, unhone Thawban (RA) se, riwayat ki hai. "Aur mujhe dono hadithein sahih hi lagti hain, ho sakta hai unhone yeh dono se hi suna ho." Rahi baat roze-daar ke liye hijamah ki rukhsat ki, to isse Muhammad bin Ismail Al-Bukhari ne 'Al-Jami Al-Sahih' mein bhi nikala hai.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed ihtijam while he was fasting. So now, listen to the words of the Imam of Ahl al-Hadith in his time without arguing about this narration, so that you may be guided by it to the most correct opinion."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne roza rakhte huay hijamah karwayi." Ab is daur ke ahl-e-hadith ke imam ki is hadith ke baare mein baat suno, bagair kisi mudaafa'at ke, taake tum ise sahih raah ki daleel bana sako.

e: [AI] Abu Ali Al-Hafiz informed me that Abu Ya'la said: Abu Khaythamah Zuhayr ibn Harbin narrated to us, and Rawh ibn Ubadah narrated from Sa'id ibn Abi 'Arubah, from Matar Al-Warraqi, from Bakr ibn Abdullah Al-Muzani, from Abu Rafa' who said: We entered upon Abu Musa, and he was cupping himself after Maghrib. So I said: Did you not get cupped during the day? He replied: Are you commanding me to pour out my blood while I am fasting? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The one who performs cupping and the one who is cupped both break their fast."
hi: Mujhe Abu Ali Al-Hafiz ne khabar di, unhein Abu Ya'la ne bataya, unhein Abu Khaithamah Zuhair bin Harb ne bataya, unhein Rawh bin Ubadah ne, Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah se, unhone Matar Al-Warraq se, unhone Bakr bin Abdullah Al-Muzani se, unhone Abu Rafi' (RA) se bataya, unhone kaha: hum Abu Musa (RA) ke paas gaye jabke woh Maghrib ke baad hijamah karwa rahe the, maine kaha: "Aapne din mein hijamah kyun nahi karwaayi?" Unhone kaha: "Kya tum mujhe hukum de rahe ho ke main apna khoon bahaun jabke main roze se hoon? Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Hijamah karne wale aur karwaane wale, dono ka roza toot gaya.'"

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: While I was sleeping, two men came to me and held my upper arms and took me to a steep mountain. They said to me, "Climb." I said, "I am not able to climb." They said, "We will make it easy for you." So I climbed until I reached the top of the mountain. When I was on the top, I heard loud voices. I said, "What are these voices?" They said, "This is the crying of the people of Hell." Then they took me until I saw people hanging by their hamstrings, with the corners of their mouths torn and bleeding. I said, "Who are these?" They said, "These are the people who break their fast before it is permissible to do so."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Main so raha tha ke do aadmi mere paas aaye, unhone mere bazu pakde aur mujhe aik dushwar pahaad par le gaye, unhone mujhse kaha: 'Chadho.' Maine kaha: 'Mujhme itni taaqat nahi.' Unhone kaha: 'Hum isse tumhare liye aasan kar dengay.' To main chadhta gaya yahan tak ke jab main pahaad ke beechon-beech pahuncha, achanak mujhe sakht awazein sunayi din, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaisi awazein hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh Jahannamiyon ki cheekh-o-pukaar hai.' Phir woh mujhe le gaye, achanak maine dekha kuch log apni aidiyon (peechhe ki taraf) latke huay hain, unke mun (kinare se) phate huay hain aur unke munh se khoon beh raha hai, maine kaha: 'Yeh log kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh woh log hain jo apne roze ka waqt poora hone se pehle hi roza tod dete hain.'"

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever breaks their fast in Ramadan due to forgetfulness, there is no expiation or compensation upon them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Ramzan mein bhool kar roza tod de, uspar na qaza hai na kaffara."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Fasting is not merely abstaining from food and drink. Rather, fasting is from vain talk and immorality. So if someone argues with you or tries to pick a fight with you, say: "I am fasting."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Roza sirf khane-peene se (parheiz) nahi, balke roza to be-hooda baaton aur be-hayaai se (bachne ka naam) hai, isliye agar koi tumhein gaali de ya tumse jahilaana harkat kare to kaho: 'Main roze se hoon.'"

e: “There are people who fast and get nothing from their fast except hunger, and there are those who pray and get nothing from their prayer but a sleepless night.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1690)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kitne hi roze-daar hain jinke roze ka hissa sirf bhook hai, aur kitne hi raat mein qiyaam karne wale hain jinke qiyaam ka hissa sirf jaagna hai."

e: I was in good spirits one day and kissed (my wife) when I was fasting. I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: I have done something serious. I kissed (my wife) when I was fasting. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “What do you think if you rinse your mouth with water when you are fasting?ʿ I said: There is nothing wrong with it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Then why (are you worried)?ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 138)
hi: Unhone kaha: "Aik din mujhe achhi tabiyat (khush-mizaji) hui, to maine bosa liya jabke main roze se tha, phir main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Aaj maine aik bada kaam kar diya hai, maine bosa liya jabke main roze se tha.' Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Batao, agar tum roze mein kulli karte to (kya hota)?'" Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Ismein koi harj nahi." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yehi (jawaab hai)." Sahih hadith, Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Religion will continue to prevail as long as people hasten to break the fast, because the Jews and the Christians delay doing so. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2353)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Deen hamesha ghalib rahega jab tak log iftaar mein jaldi karte rahenge, kyunke Yahood aur Nasaara (iftaar mein) der karte hain."

e: the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever has dried dates, then let him break the fast with that, and whoever does not, then let him break the fast with water, for indeed water is purifying." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 694)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise khajoor mile woh usi se roza khole, aur jise na mile woh paani se roza khole, kyunke woh paak karne wala hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When one of you is fasting, he should break his fast with dates; but if he cannot get any, then (he should break his fast) with water, for water is purifying. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2355)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi roze se ho to khajoor se iftaar kare, agar khajoor na mile to paani se, kyunke paani paak karne wala hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to break his fast before praying with some fresh dates; but if there were no fresh dates, he had a few dry dates, and if there were no dry dates, he took some mouthfuls of water. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2356)
hi: Unhone Anas bin Malik (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) namaz se pehle taaza khajooron se iftaar karte the, agar taaza khajoor na hoti to sukhi khajooron se, aur agar sukhi khajoor bhi na hoti to paani ke kuch ghoont peete."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ would not pray Maghrib until he had broken his fast, even if it was with a sip of water."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) Maghrib ki namaz nahi padhte the jab tak roza na khol lete, chahe woh sirf aik ghoont paani se hi kyun na ho."

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  pouring water over his head due to the heat while he was fasting."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Al-Arj mein dekha, aap (SAW) garmi ki wajah se apne sar par paani daal rahe the jabke aap (SAW) roze se the."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi narrated on what was recited from Malik, from Sumayy, the freed slave of Abu Bakr, from Abu Bakr ibn Abdur-Rahman, from some of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , who said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanding the people during his travel in the year of conquest, saying: "Prepare yourselves for your enemy."
hi: Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, jo Malik par padha gaya, Sumayy - Abu Bakr ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam - se, unhone Abu Bakr bin Abdur Rahman se, unhone Nabi (SAW) ke kisi sahabi se, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko apne safar mein, fatah (Makkah) ke saal, logon ko roza kholne ka hukum dete dekha, aur farmaya: "Apne dushman (ka saamna karne) ke liye taaqat hasil karo."

e: "It is not righteousness to fast when traveling." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2261)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Safar mein roza rakhna neki mein se nahi."

e: I said: Messenger of Allah. I am a master of mounts and I use them ! I myself travel on them and I rent them. This month, that is, Ramadan, happend to come to me (while I am on a journey), and I find myself strong enough (to fast) as I am young, and I find that it is easier for me to fast than to postpone it, and i becomes debt due from me. Does it bring me more reward, Messenger of Allah, if I fast, or if I break ? He replied: Whichever you like, Hamzah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2403)
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main saamaan dhone wale jaanwaron ka maalik hoon, unhi par safar karta hoon aur unhein kiraaye par bhi deta hoon, aur kabhi kabhi yeh mahina - ya'ni Ramzan ka mahina - mujhe (safar mein) mil jata hai jabke main jawaan hoon aur apne aap mein taaqat mehsoos karta hoon, aur mujhe lagta hai ke roza rakhna, ise pichhe daalne se - jo mujh par qarz ban jaye - zyada aasan hai. To Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya roza rakhna mere ajr ke liye zyada behtar hai ya roza na rakhna?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tumhein pasand ho, aye Hamzah."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  traveled during Ramadan, and fasting became difficult for one of his companions. So his riding animal wandered with him under a tree. The Prophet ﷺ  was informed about his situation, so he ordered him to break his fast. Then the Prophet ﷺ  called for a vessel, placed it in his hand, and he drank while the people were watching."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Ramzan mein safar kiya, to unke sahaba (RA) mein se aik shakhs par roza bhaari ho gaya, uski sawari use lekar aik darakht ke neeche bhatakne lagi, Nabi (SAW) ko iski khabar di gayi, to aap (SAW) ne use hukum diya ke woh roza tod de, phir Nabi (SAW) ne aik bartan mangwaya, use apne haath par rakha, phir piya jabke log dekh rahe the."

e: "Some food was brought to the Messenger of Allah at Marr Az-Zahran, and he said to Abu Bakr and 'Umar: 'Come and eat.' They said: 'We are fasting.' He said: 'Saddle the camels for your companions, and help your companions."'(Daif) (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2264)
hi: Hum Marr Az-Zahran mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath thay, khana laaya gaya, to aap (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) se farmaya: "Qareeb aao aur khao." Unhone kaha: "Hum roze se hain." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne sathi ke liye (safar ka) intezaam karo, apne sathi ke liye kooch karo, qareeb aao aur khao."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "My nation will continue to follow my Sunnah as long as they do not hasten the breaking of their fast until the stars appear." And the Prophet ﷺ  would command a person to complete their fast if they were in doubt about the sunset, and when they say, "The sun has set," then they may break their fast.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat meri Sunnat par qaim rahegi jab tak woh apne iftaar mein sitaron ka intezar na karein." Aur Nabi (SAW) jab roze se hote to aik shakhs ko hukum dete jo kisi buland jagah par chadh jata, jab woh kehta: "Suraj ghurub ho gaya hai," to aap (SAW) roza kholte.

e: The month most liked by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for fasting was Sha'ban. He then joined it with Ramadan. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2431)
hi: Unhone Aisha (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko sabse aziz mahina jisme roza rakhna hota, woh Sha'ban tha, phir woh use Ramzan se joad dete the."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The day of Arafah, the day of sacrifice, the days of tashriq are (the days of) our festival, O people of Islam. These are the days of eating and drinking. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2419)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Arafah ka din, qurbani ka din, aur tashreeq ke din - Musalmanon ki Eid hain, aur yeh khane-peene ke din hain."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has prohibited fasting on the Day of Arafah at Arafat."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Arafat mein Arafah ke din roza rakhne se mana kiya."

e: It is as if I can see ʿAli bin Abi Talib ؓ , riding the white mule of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he stood at the mountain pass of the Ansar during the Farewell Pilgrimage and said: O people, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ says: ʿThese are not the days of fasting, rather they are days of eating, drinking and remembering Allah.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 708)
hi: "Goya main Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke safed khachar par, Ansar ki ghaati mein, dekh raha hoon, woh keh rahe hain: 'Aye logo, beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya hai: \"Yeh roze ke din nahi, yeh khane, peene aur zikr ke din hain.\"'"

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi praised what was narrated about Malik from Yazid bin Al-Had from Abu Murrah, the client of Umm Hani', that he entered upon Abdullah bin Amr to his father Amr bin Al-Aas. He brought them food and said, "Eat." Abdullah said, "I am fasting." Amr said, "Eat, for these are the days that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to order us to break our fast and forbid us from fasting them." Malik said, "And these are the days of Tashreeq."
hi: Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, jo Malik par padha gaya, Yazid bin Al-Had se, unhone Abu Murrah - Umm Hani' (RA) ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam - se, unhone kaha ke woh Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ke paas unke waalid Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ke haan dakhil huay, to unke saamne khana pesh kiya gaya, unhone kaha: "Khao." Unhone kaha: "Main roze se hoon." To Amr (RA) ne kaha: "Khao, kyunke yeh woh din hain jinme Rasulullah (SAW) humein roza kholne ka hukum dete the aur inme roza rakhne se mana karte the." Malik ne kaha: "Aur yeh tashreeq ke din hain."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever fasts the whole year as if they didn't fast at all or as if they didn't break their fast."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo (hamesha) zamane bhar roza rakhe, usne na roza rakha na khola," ya farmaya: "na usne roza rakha na roza tod."

e: "It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah, so and so never broke his fast, even for one day for the rest of his life.' He said: 'He has neither fasted nor broken his fast."" 'Ata said: "someone who heard him told me that Ibn 'Umar (said) that the Prophet said: 'Whoever fasts every day of his life, then he has not fasted." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2379)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se kaha gaya: "Fulan shakhs hamesha (bila naaghah) din mein roza rakhta hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Na usne roza rakha na khola."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Do not fast on Saturday except what has been made obligatory on you; and if one of you can get nothing but a grape skin or a piece of wood from a tree, he should chew it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2421)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hafte ke din roza mat rakho, siwaye us (roze) ke jo tum par farz kiya gaya ho, aur agar tum mein se kisi ko angoor ke chhilke ya darakht ki lakdi ke ilawa kuch na mile, to woh use chaba le."

e:
[AI] He informed him that Ibn Abbas and some of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ sent me to Umm Salamah to ask her on which days did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ fast the most? She said, "On Saturdays and Sundays."

So I returned to them and informed them, and it seemed as if they denied it. So they all went to her and said, "We sent this to you about so and so and you mentioned that you said so and so." She said, "Yes, it is true that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to fast the most on the days of Saturday and Sunday, and he used to say, 'They are the days of celebration for the polytheists and I want to differ from them.'"
hi: Unhein bataya gaya ke Ibn Abbas (RA) aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) mein se kuch logon ne mujhe Umm Salamah (RA) ke paas bheja taake main unse poochun ke kin dinon mein Rasulullah (SAW) sabse zyada roza rakhte the. Unhone kaha: "Hafte aur Itwaar ke din." Main unke paas wapas gaya aur unhein bataya, goya unhone iska inkaar kiya, to sab ke sab uske paas gaye aur kaha: "Humne aapke paas isi silsile mein isse bheja tha, isne bataya ke aapne aisa-aisa kaha," to unhone kaha: "Sach kaha, Rasulullah (SAW) sabse zyada Hafte aur Itwaar ke din roza rakhte the, aur farmate: 'Yeh dono mushrikeen ki Eid ke din hain, aur main inki mukhalifat karna chahta hoon.'"

e: A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ while we were with him. She said: Messenger of Allah, my husband, Safwan ibn al-Mu'attal, beats me when I pray, and makes me break my fast when I keep a fast, and he does not offer the dawn prayer until the sun rises. He asked Safwan, who was present, about what she had said. He replied: Messenger of Allah, as for her statement "he beats me when I pray", she recites two surahs (during prayer) and I have prohibited her (to do so). He (the Prophet) said: If one surah is recited (during prayer), that is sufficient for the people. (Safwan continued:) As regards her saying "he makes me break my fast," she dotes on fasting; I am a young man, I cannot restrain myself. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on that day: A woman should not fast except with the permission of her husband. (Safwan said:) As for her statement that I do not pray until the sun rises, we are a people belonging to a class, and that (our profession of supplying water) is already known about us. We do not awake until the sun rises. He said: When you awake, offer your prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2459)
hi: Aik aurat Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi jabke hum unke paas thay, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mera shohar Safwan bin Al-Mu'attal (RA) mujhe maarta hai jab main namaz padhti hoon, aur mujhe roza tudwaa deta hai jab main roza rakhti hoon, aur Fajr ki namaz nahi padhta jab tak suraj na nikal aaye." Unhone kaha: aur Safwan bhi wahan maujood the. Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) ne unse us baat ke baare mein poocha jo usne kahi thi, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), rahi baat uske yeh kehne ki ke main use maarta hoon jab woh namaz padhti hai, to woh do surahein padhti hai jinse maine use mana kiya hai, aur maine kaha tha agar sirf aik surah bhi ho to woh logon ke liye kaafi hai. Aur rahi baat uske yeh kehne ki ke main use roza tudwaa deta hoon jab woh roza rakhti hai, to woh (bila ijaazat) chali jati hai aur roza rakhti hai, aur main jawaan aadmi hoon, sabr nahi kar pata." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne us din farmaya: "Koi aurat apne shohar ki ijaazat ke bagair roza na rakhe." Aur rahi baat uske yeh kehne ki ke main namaz nahi padhta jab tak suraj na nikal aaye, to hum aik aisa gharana hain jinke baare mein yeh baat maloom hai, hum jaagte hi nahi jab tak suraj na nikal aaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To jab tum jaago to namaz padho."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Friday is a day of celebration, so do not make the day of your celebration a day of fasting unless you fast either before it or after it."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jum'e ka din Eid hai, isliye apni Eid ke din ko apne roze ka din na banao, siwaye is soorat mein jab tum uske pehle ya baad roza rakho."

e: [AI] I asked Abu Dharr, and I said, "Did you ask the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, about Laylat al-Qadr?" He said, "I used to ask people about it." I said, "O Messenger of Allah, inform me about Laylat al-Qadr. Is it in Ramadan or in another month?" He said, "Verily, it is in Ramadan." I said, "O Messenger of Allah, is it with the Prophets? When the Prophets are taken, is it also taken until the Day of Resurrection?" He said, "Indeed, it is taken until the Day of Resurrection." I said, "O Messenger of Allah, in which Ramadan is it?" He said, "Seek it in the first ten days and the last ten days." He said, "Then the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, spoke and I was distracted by his words, so I said, "O Messenger of Allah, in which of the twenty days is it?" He said, "Seek it in the last ten days, and do not ask me about anything after that." The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, then spoke and I was distracted by his words. So I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I swear by you, tell me, or if you do not tell me, in which of the ten days is it?" He became angry with me in a way that no one had seen him angry before or after, and he said, "If Allah willed, He would have made it known to you. Seek it in the last seven days."
hi: Maine Abu Dharr (RA) se poocha, arz kiya: "Kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se Lailatul-Qadr ke baare mein poocha tha?" Unhone kaha: "Main khud logon se iske baare mein poocha karta tha." Unhone kaha: maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe Lailatul-Qadr ke baare mein bataiye, kya yeh Ramzan mein hai ya kisi aur mahine mein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke yeh Ramzan mein hai." Unhone kaha: maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya yeh Ambiya (AS) ke sath hai jab tak woh (zinda) rahe, phir jab Ambiya (AS) wafat pa jaayen to yeh utha li jaati hai, ya yeh Qayamat ke din tak baaqi rahegi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke yeh Qayamat ke din tak baaqi rahegi." Unhone kaha: maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh Ramzan ke kis hisse mein hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse pehle ashray (10 dinon) aur aakhri ashray mein talaash karo." Unhone kaha: phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne baat ki aur baat ki, to maine unki ghaflat ka faayda uthate huay arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunse bees (dinon) mein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aakhri ashray mein talaash karo, uske baad mujhse kuch na poochna." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne baat ki aur baat ki, to maine phir unki ghaflat ka faayda uthate huay arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aapko qasam deta hoon, aap mujhe zaroor bataen, ya main aapko bataunga na kaunse ashray mein hai?" Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) mujhpar itne ghusse huay jitna kabhi pehle ya baad mein nahi huay, phir farmaya: "Agar Allah chahta to tumhein iska pata de deta, isse aakhri saat (raaton) mein talaash karo."

e: [AI] Have you heard the saying of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "Try to seek it in the last ten nights, on a night which you see?" He asked, and some said it's on the first night, and some others said it's on the third night, and another said it's on the fifth night. And I remained silent, so he said, "Why are you not speaking?" So I said, "If you permit me, O Amir al-Mu'minin, I will speak." He said, "Did I not send you except to speak?" I said, "Shall I tell you my opinion?" He said, "We ask you about that." I said, "I believe that there are seven. Allah mentioned seven skies, and there are seven earths, and He created man from seven (elements), and plants emerge from the earth in seven (days)." He said, "This is what I was informed of, and I know it. Have you seen something that I don't know? What do you say about the plants that emerge from the earth in seven?" I said, "Allah says, 'We have split open the earth.' (Surah Abasa, 26), until His saying, 'And fruit and pasture (for livestock).' (Surah Abasa, 31). And pasture is what the animals eat and not humans." Umar said, "Are you amazed that this young man has spoken in a manner that his affairs have not yet gathered? By Allah, I do not see any other saying except what you have said." He said, "And he (Umar) said, 'I had ordered you not to speak until they spoke, and now I order you to speak with them.'" Ibn Idris narrated this from Abdul-Malik, from Sa'id bin Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, with a similar narration.
hi: "Tumne Rasulullah (SAW) ki yeh baat dekhi hai: 'Ise aakhri ashray mein talaash karo,' tumhein kaunsi raat lagti hai?" Unhone kaha: to kisi ne kaha: "Gyarahvi raat," aur kisi ne kaha: "Teesri raat," aur kisi aur ne kaha: "Paanchvi," aur main khamosh raha. To unhone poocha: "Tumhein kya hua, tum kuch kehte kyun nahi?" Maine kaha: "Agar aap ijaazat dein, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, to main kahun." Unhone kaha: "Maine tumhein isi liye bheja tha ke tum baat karo." Maine kaha: "Kya main aapko apni raay bataun?" Unhone kaha: "Isi ke baare mein to hum tumse poochte hain." Maine kaha: "Saat (satveen raat), maine dekha Allah ne saat aasman, aur zamino mein se saat, ka zikr kiya, aur insaan ko saat (cheezon) se paida kiya, aur zameen ki nabaatat saat (cheezon) se nikalti hai." Unhone kaha: to unhone kaha: "Yeh to tumne mujhe woh bataya jo main jaanta hoon, mujhe woh batao jo main nahi jaanta, tumhare is kehne ka kya matlab hai ke zameen ki nabaatat saat se hai?" Maine kaha: "Allah farmata hai: '{Humne zameen ko phaada, phaadna}' (Surah Abasa 26) se lekar '{aur mewa aur charagaah}' (Surah Abasa 31) tak, aur 'abb' zameen ki nabaatat hai jo jaanwar khaate hain aur log nahi khaate." Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Kya tum log usi tarah nahi keh sakte the jaise is naujawan ne kaha jiske sar ke baal abhi tak (poori tarah) jama nahi huay? Allah ki qasam, mujhe to yehi baat sahih lagti hai jaisa tumne kaha." Unhone kaha: aur unhone kaha: "Maine tumhein hukum diya tha ke tum tab tak na bolo jab tak yeh log bol na len, aur ab main tumhein hukum deta hoon ke tum unke sath bolo." Ibn Idris ne kaha: humein Abdul Malik ne Sa'eed bin Jubair se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, isi jaisi hadith bayan ki.

e: [AI] I mentioned the Night of Decree to Abu Bakrah and he said, "I only seek it in the last ten nights, either in the ninth, seventh, fifth, or in the last night." He used to pray in the last ten nights the entire year, and when the last ten nights started, he would strive even more.
hi: Maine Abu Bakrah (RA) ke paas Lailatul-Qadr ka zikr kiya, to unhone kaha: "Main isse sirf aakhri ashray mein talaash karta hoon, chahe naun (9) raat baaqi ho, ya saat (7) baaqi ho, ya paanch (5) baaqi ho, ya teen (3) baaqi ho, ya aakhri raat ho." Woh bees (raaton) mein sirf itni hi namaz padhte the jitni saal bhar padhte the, jab ashray shuru hota to woh (ibadat mein) koshish badha dete.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say, "The voluntary fasting person is the master of his own self; if he wants, he fasts, and if he wants, he breaks his fast."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Nafl roza rakhne wala apne aap ka maalik hai, chahe to roza rakhe aur chahe to roza tod de."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The one who observes voluntary fasting has the choice to either fast or break it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nafl roza rakhne wale ko ikhtiyar hai, chahe to roza rakhe aur chahe to roza tod de."

e: Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to practice Iʿtikaf in the last ten days of the month of Ramadan. (Using translation from Bukhārī 2025)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri ashray mein aitikaaf kiya karte the, phir aik saal aitikaaf nahi kiya, jab agla saal aaya to unhone bees (20) din aitikaaf kiya."

e: The Prophet ﷺ used to observe i'tikaf during the last ten days of Ramadan. One year he did not observe i'tikaf. When the next year came, he observed i'tikaf for twenty nights (i.e. days). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2463)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) Ramzan ke aakhri (ashray) mein aitikaaf kiya karte the, phir aik saal safar mein gaye aur aitikaaf nahi kiya, to agle saal unhone bees (20) raaton ka aitikaaf kiya."

e: [AI] The prophet ﷺ said, "The person who is in I'tikaf (seclusion for worship) does not have to fast except if they wish to do so voluntarily."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aitikaaf karne wale par roza (wajib) nahi, magar yeh ke woh khud apne upar (roze ko) wajib kar le."

e: [AI] To stay overnight and the next day he sought the advice of the Prophet ﷺ  who said, "Stay overnight and observe fasting for a day." This is the second Hadith.
hi: Ke woh aik din aitikaaf karna chahte the, to unhone Nabi (SAW) se poocha, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aitikaaf karo aur aik din roza rakho." Doosri hadith.

e: [AI] The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: "There is no seclusion (i'tikaf) except with fasting." The two sheikhs, Sufyan ibn Husayn and Abdullah ibn Yazid, did not object.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Roze ke bagair koi aitikaaf nahi." Shaykhain ne Sufyan bin Husain aur Abdullah bin Yazid ko hujjat nahi maana.

e: [AI] "He has made it permissible for the elderly sheikh who is unable to fast, and ordered that he feeds the one whom he knows cannot bear it."
hi: Unhone us buzurg buddhe ke liye jo roza rakhne ki taaqat nahi rakhta rukhsat muqarrar ki, aur hukum diya ke jise pata ho ke woh (roza) sambhaal nahi sakta, woh (miskeen ko) khilaaye.

e: [AI] "To fast and feed a poor person every day and not skip any day."
hi: Ke woh roza na rakhe aur har din aik miskeen ko khilaaye, aur uspar koi qaza nahi.

e: "I heard An-Nu'man bin Bashir on the minbar in Hims saying: "We prayed Qiyam with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during Ramadan on the night of the twenty-third until one-third of the night had passed, then we prayed Qiyam with him on the night of the twenty-fifth until one-half of the night had passed, then we prayed Qiyam with him on the night of the twenty-seventh until we thought that we would miss Al-Falah- that is what they used to call suhur." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1606)
hi: Maine An-Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ko Hims ke mimbar par kehte suna: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Ramzan mein teiswi (23) raat ko raat ke tihaai hisse tak (namaz mein) khade rahe, phir hum unke sath pachchiswi (25) raat ko aadhi raat tak khade rahe, phir hum unke sath sattaiswi (27) raat ko aadhi raat tak khade rahe, phir hum unke sath sattaiswi raat ko (itni der tak) khade rahe ke humein laga ke hum falah (kaamyaabi) nahi paayenge, aur hum ise 'Al-Falah' kehte the, aur tum log ise sehri kehte ho."

e: “When the first night of Ramadan comes, the satans and mischievous jinns are chained up, and the gates of the Fire are closed, and none of its gates are opened. The gates of Paradise are opened and none of its gates are closed. And a caller cries out: ‘O seeker of good, proceed, O seeker of evil, stop.’ And Allah has necks (people) whom He frees (from the Fire), and that happens every day.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1642)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Ramzan ki pehli raat aati hai to shayateen aur sarkash jinnaat ko qaid kar diya jata hai, aur Jahannam ke darwaze band kar diye jaate hain, unme se koi darwaza nahi khulta, aur Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jaate hain, unme se koi darwaza band nahi hota, aur aik pukaarne wala pukaarta hai: 'Aye khair ke talibgaar, aage badh, aur aye sharr ke talibgaar, ruk ja,' aur Allah ke liye (har raat) aag se azaad kiye jaane wale (bande) hote hain."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, guide me to a deed." He said, "You should fast, for there is no equal to it."
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe koi amal bataiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Roze ko lazim pakdo, kyunke iska koi barabar nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Indeed, Allah revealed to Yahya, son of Zachariah (peace be upon them), with five words that he should act upon and command the Children of Israel to act upon. He seemed to delay in conveying them, so Jesus ﷺ  came to him and said: 'Indeed, Allah has commanded you with five words that you should act upon and command the Children of Israel to act upon. Either you inform them or I will inform them.' Yahya replied: 'O brother, do not do so, for I fear that if you inform them before me, I will be swallowed and punished.' Jesus said: 'So gather the Children of Israel in the Masjid al-Aqsa until it fills up and let them sit on the parapets, then give them a sermon.' Yahya did as he was told and said: 'Indeed, Allah has revealed to me with five words that I should act upon and command the Children of Israel to act upon. The first of them is to not associate partners with Allah. Verily, the example of one who associates others with Allah is like a man who buys a slave with his wealth, whether it be gold or silver, then shelters him in a house and says to him: 'Do work and bring it to me,' but the slave works and brings it to someone other than his master. Which one of you would be pleased if his slave is like that? Verily, Allah has created you and provided for you, so do not associate anything with Him. And when you stand for prayer, do not look around, for indeed Allah turns His face towards His slave as long as the latter does not turn away. He has also commanded you with fasting, and the example of fasting is like a man who has a group of people with him, each one of them carrying a bag filled with musk. They all love to find its fragrance. Indeed, the fragrance of fasting is like the fragrance of musk. He has also commanded you with giving charity, and the example of giving charity is like a man whom his enemy has captured and secured his hands on his neck, ready to kill him. But the man extends his hand to his enemy, providing him with whatever he wishes, even if it is little or abundant, until he saves himself from death. And He has also commanded you with abundant remembrance of Allah, and the example of abundant remembrance of Allah is like a man whom his enemy chases rapidly until he reaches a fortified castle and secures himself inside. Similarly, the slave does not escape from Shaytan except through the remembrance of Allah.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Allah ne Yahya bin Zakariya (Alayhima as-Salam) ko paanch baaton ki wahi ki ke woh khud unpar amal karein aur Bani Israel ko bhi unpar amal karne ka hukum dein, aur goya unhone (ismein) der kar di, to Isa (AS) unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Beshak Allah ne aapko paanch baaton ka hukum diya hai ke aap khud unpar amal karein aur Bani Israel ko bhi unpar amal karne ka hukum dein, to ya to aap unhein batayen ya main unhein bataun." Unhone kaha: "Aye mere bhai, aisa mat karo, mujhe darr hai ke agar tumne mujhse pehle yeh baatein bata din to mujhe zameen mein dhansaya jaye ya mujhpar azab kiya jaye." Unhone kaha: to unhone Bani Israel ko Bait-ul-Maqdis mein jama kiya yahan tak ke masjid bhar gayi aur log baaladiyon (chhaton) par baith gaye, phir unhein khutba dete huay kaha: "Beshak Allah ne mujhe paanch baaton ki wahi ki hai ke main khud unpar amal karoon aur Bani Israel ko bhi unpar amal karne ka hukum dun, unme pehli yeh hai ke tum Allah ke sath kisi cheez ko shareek na thehrao, kyunke Allah ke sath shirk karne wale ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jisne apne khalis maal se sona ya chandi dekar aik ghulam khareeda, phir usse aik ghar mein basaya aur kaha: 'Kaam karo aur mujhe (uski aamdani) de do,' to woh kaam karta aur apne malik ke ilawa kisi aur ko dene lagta, to tum mein se kaun raazi hoga ke uska ghulam aisa ho? Beshak Allah ne tumhein paida kiya aur tumhein rizq diya, isliye uske sath kisi ko shareek na thehrao. Aur jab tum namaz ke liye khade ho to (idhar-udhar) mudkar mat dekho, kyunke Allah apna chehra apne bande ke chehre ki taraf pheraye rakhta hai jab tak woh (idhar-udhar) na dekhe. Aur tumhein roze ka hukum diya hai, aur iski misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jo aik giroh mein ho aur uske paas mushk ki aik potli ho, sab log uski khushbu paana pasand karte hon, aur beshak roze ki khushbu Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushbu jaisi hai. Aur tumhein sadqe ka hukum diya hai, aur iski misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jise dushman ne qaid kar liya ho, uske haath uski gardan se bandh diye hon, aur usse gardan maarne ke liye qareeb kiya jaa raha ho, to woh kehne lage: 'Kya tum mujhe apni jaan chhudane doge?' aur woh kam aur zyada (jo bhi mil sake) dene lage yahan tak ke woh apni jaan bacha le. Aur tumhein Allah ke bohot zikr ka hukum diya hai, aur Allah ke zikr ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jise dushman tezi se peechha kar raha ho, yahan tak ke woh aik mazboot qile mein pahunch kar apni jaan mehfooz kar le, isi tarah bandah Shaitan se sirf Allah ke zikr ke zariye hi nijaat pa sakta hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Verily, the fasting person has a supplication at the time of breaking his fast, O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which encompasses everything, to forgive my sins." This is reported by Ishaq if Ibn Abdullah is his freed slave. Muslim did not report it if Ibn Abi Farwah is the one reporting it.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak roze-daar ke liye iftaar ke waqt aik dua hoti hai: 'Aye Allah, main tujhse teri us rahmat ke wasile se sawaal karta hoon jo har cheez ko ghere hue hai, ke tu mere gunah maaf kar de.'" Ishaq, agar yeh Ibn Abdullah, Za'idah ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam hain, to Muslim ne unse riwayat nikali hai, aur agar yeh Ibn Abi Farwah hain, to dono ne unse riwayat nahi nikali.

e: I saw Ibn Umar holding his beard with his hand and cutting what exceeded the handful of it. He (Ibn Umar) said that the Prophet ﷺ said when he broke his fast: Thirst has gone, the arteries are moist, and the reward is sure, if Allah wills. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2357)
hi: Aur unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) jab roza kholte to farmate: "Pyaas chali gayi, ragein tar ho gayin, aur Insha'Allah ajr sabit ho gaya."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The thankful eater is like the patient fasting person."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Shukr karne wala khane wala us sabr karne wale roze-daar jaisa hai."

e: [AI] We were in Ramadan during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Whoever wanted to fast, fasted, and whoever wanted to break the fast, broke it and made up for it by feeding a poor person until the verse was revealed: "So whoever sights [the new moon of] the month, let him fast it" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:185).
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein Ramzan mein the, jo chahta roza rakhta aur jo chahta roza nahi rakhta aur miskeen ko khana khila kar iska badla de deta, yahan tak ke yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Jo tum mein se (Ramzan ke) mahine mein maujood ho, use roza rakhna chahiye}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 185).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah has made the sighting of the moon the timing for acts of worship. So, when you spot it, begin fasting, and when you see it again, end the fast. If it is obscured from your view, then estimate it. And know that the months do not exceed thirty days."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne chaandon ko waqt muqarrar karne ke liye banaya hai, isliye jab tum ise dekho to roza rakho, aur jab tum ise (agle mahine ka) dekho to roza kholo, aur agar woh tumhare liye chhup jaaye to iska andaaza lagao, aur jaan lo ke mahine tees (30) se zyada nahi hote."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to count the days in Sha'ban in a manner he did not count any other month; then he fasted when he sighted the new moon of Ramadan; but if the weather was cloudy he counted thirty days and then fasted. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2325)
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) Sha'ban ke chaand ka itna khayal rakhte the jitna kisi aur (mahine) ka nahi rakhte the, phir Ramzan ka chaand dekh kar roza rakhte, agar woh unse chhup jata to tees (30) din ginte, phir roza rakhte."

e: [AI] The people saw the crescent, so I informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that I had seen it. "So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  fasted and ordered the people to fast." It is correct according to the condition of Muslim, and they did not dispute it.
hi: Log chaand dekhne ki koshish kar rahe the, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko bataya ke maine ise dekh liya hai, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne roza rakha aur logon ko roza rakhne ka hukum diya." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "Ammar said: 'Whoever fasts on the Day of Doubt (the day before the new moon is sighted to mark the beginning of Ramadan), has disobeyed Abu Al-Qasim (referring to Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him)."
hi: Ammar (RA) [ne kaha]: "Jo shak ke din roza rakhe, usne Abul-Qasim (SAW) ki na-farmani ki."

e: A bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: I have sighted the moon. Al-Hasan added in his version: that is, of Ramadan. He asked: Do you testify that there is no god but Allah? He replied: Yes. He again asked: Do you testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? He replied: Yes. and he testified that he had sighted the moon. He said: Bilal, announce to the people that they must fast tomorrow. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2340)
hi: Aik dehati Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Maine chaand dekha hai," ya'ni Ramzan ka chaand. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Bilal, logon mein aelaan karo ke woh kal roza rakhein." Sufyan Ath-Thawri aur Hammad bin Salamah ne Simak bin Harb se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ, when he went out for battles, his first concern was always Fatimah." Then he mentioned the rest of the narration with different wording.
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) kisi ghazwe ke liye nikalte to unka sabse pehla thikaana Fatimah (Alayha as-Salam) ke paas hota," phir baaqi hadith kisi aur alfaz ke sath zikr ki.

e: [AI] "That Ibn Umar used to vie for the two corners (of the Kaaba). So I said, 'O Abu Abdullah, indeed you vie for the two corners with great competition; I have not seen anyone among the companions of the Messenger of Allah vie for them.' He said, 'If I do so, then indeed I have heard the Messenger of Allah say, 'Indeed, wiping over them (the two corners) is an expiation for sins.""
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) donon rukn (Hajr-e-Aswad aur Rukn-e-Yamani) ko chhoone ke liye dhakka-mukki karte the, maine kaha: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, aap in dono ko chhoone ke liye itni dhakka-mukki karte hain, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke kisi sahabi ko isme itni dhakka-mukki karte nahi dekha." Unhone kaha: "Agar main aisa karta hoon to isliye ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Inhein chhoona gunahon ka kaffara hai.'"

e: The night which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed with me was the one that followed the day of sacrifice. He came to me and Wahb ibn Zam'ah also visited me. A man belonging to the lineage of AbuUmayyah accompanied him. Both of them were wearing shirts. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Wahb: Did you perform the obligatory circumambulation (Tawaf az-Ziyarah), AbuAbdullah? He said: No, by Allah Messenger of Allah. He (the Prophet) said: Take off your shirt. He then took it off over his head, and his companion too took his shirt off over his head. He then asked: And why (this), Messenger of Allah? He replied: On this day you have been allowed to take off ihram when you have thrown the stones at the jamrahs, that is, everything prohibited during the state of ihram is lawful except intercourse with a woman. If the evening comes before you go round this House (the Ka'bah) you will remain in the sacred state (i.e. ihram), just like the state in which you were before you threw stones at the jamrahs, until you perform the circumambulation of it (i.e. the Ka'bah). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1999)
hi: Aur unki waalida Zainab bint Abi Salamah dono (raawi) Umm Salamah (RA) se yeh hadith bayan karte hain, unhone kaha: "Meri raat thi jisme Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas aane wale the, to mere paas Wahb bin Zam'ah (RA) aaye, unke sath Aal-e-Abi Umayyah ka aik shakhs bhi tha, dono qamees pehne huay the. Nabi (SAW) ne Wahb se poocha: 'Kya aapne Tawaf-e-Ifadah kar liya, Aye Abu Abdullah?' Unhone kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW).' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Apni qamees utaar do.' Unhone kaha: to unhone use apne sar se utaara, aur unke sathi ne bhi apni qamees apne sar se utaari. Unhone poocha: 'Kyun, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak jab tum Jamrah ko kankariyan maar chuke ho to tumhein rukhsat mili hai ke tum har us cheez se halal ho jao jo tumpar haram thi, siwaye auraton ke, aur agar tum is Ghar (Ka'bah) ka tawaaf kiye bagair shaam kar lo, to tum aise hi ehraam mein wapas aa jaoge jaise tum Jamrah ko kankariyan maarne se pehle the, yahan tak ke tum tawaaf kar lo.'" Abu Ubaidah ne kaha: "Aur mujhe Umm Qais (RA) ne bataya..."

e: [AI] Indeed, Al-Aqra' bin Habis asked the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, is Hajj to be performed every year or once?" He replied, "Once, and whoever wishes may perform it voluntarily." This is an authentic narration, and Abu Sinan is the narrator. They did not exclude Sufyan bin Husayn, who is among the reliable narrators whose narrations are accepted.
hi: Al-Aqra' bin Habis (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Hajj har saal (farz) hai ya sirf aik martaba?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sirf aik martaba, phir jo chahe woh nafl kare."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Enjoy this house because it has been destroyed twice and will be raised for the third time."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is Ghar (Ka'bah) se faida uthao, kyunke yeh do martaba dhaya ja chuka hai, aur teesri martaba (bhi) utha liya jayega."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The guests of Allah are three: The ghazi, the Hajj (pilgrim) and the Mu'tamir''' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2625)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke mehmaan teen hain: mujahid, Haji, aur Umrah karne wala."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Allah, forgive the pilgrim and those for whom the pilgrim seeks forgiveness."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, Haji ko maaf kar de, aur jiske liye Haji maghfirat maange usse bhi maaf kar de."

e: [AI] From the prophet ﷺ  regarding his saying, "And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way" [Al Imran 97]. It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the way?" He said, "Provision and means of transportation."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Allah ke liye logon par Bait (Ka'bah) ka Hajj farz hai, jo isski taraf raah paa sake}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 97) ke baare mein, poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), raah kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zaad-e-raah (safar ka saaman) aur sawari."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about the saying of Allah, "Whoever is able to find a way [to perform Hajj]/[to reach it]" [Surah Al-Imran 97]. So, it was said, "What is the way?" He said, "Provisions and a means of transportation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se Allah ke farmaan "{Jo iski taraf raah paa sake}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 97) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to poocha gaya: "Raah kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zaad-e-raah aur sawari."

e: “A woman is not to travel the distance of a day and a night unless she is accompanied by someone who is a Mahram.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1170)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi aurat aik raat ka safar bagair mahram ke na kare."

e: “A woman is not to travel the distance of a day and a night unless she is accompanied by someone who is a Mahram.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1170)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi aurat bareed (masaafat) bhar ka safar mahram ke bagair na kare."

e: [AI] Abdullah, wait until I bid you farewell as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to bid us farewell. I entrust to Allah your religion, your trustworthiness, and the conclusion of your deeds.
hi: "Aye Abdullah, thoda ruko taake main tumhein aisi hi rukhsati doon jaisi Rasulullah (SAW) humein rukhsat kiya karte the: Main tumhare deen, tumhari amaanat aur tumhare aamaal ke anjaam ko Allah ke supurd karta hoon."

e: “The Prophet ﷺ and his Companions performed Hajj walking from Al-Madinah to Makkah. He said: ‘Tie your lower garments around your waists,’ and he alternated between walking and jogging.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3119)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) aur unke sahaba (RA) ne Madinah se Makkah tak paidal Hajj kiya," aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni kamron par apne tehband bandh lo," aur woh chalne aur halki daud ke darmiyan chalte the.

e: [AI] People complained to the Prophet ﷺ about the long distance they had to walk, so he called them and said: "You should embrace walking." We then started walking and found it easier than we thought.
hi: Log Nabi (SAW) se chalne ki (mushkil ki) shikayat karne lage, aap (SAW) ne unhein bulaya aur farmaya: "Halki daud lagao," to humne halki daud lagaayi aur usse humein aasani mehsoos hui.

e: "The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1944)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek behtareen saathi woh hai jo apne saathi ke liye behtareen ho, aur Allah ke nazdeek behtareen padosi woh hai jo apne padosi ke liye behtareen ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best of companions are four, and the best armies are four thousand, and they have not been defeated by a force of twelve thousand due to their small numbers." This is an authentic narration according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (i.e. Al-Bukhari and Muslim), and they have not excluded it. There are differences of opinion regarding this narration from Az-Zuhri from four different aspects, which I have explained in detail in the book of Al-Talkhees.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen (safar ke) sathi chaar (4) hain, aur sabse behtareen lashkar chaar hazaar (4,000) hai, aur baarah hazaar (12,000) kabhi kami ki wajah se maghloob nahi hote." Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur Az-Zuhri par is baare mein chaar tareeqon se ikhtilaf hai jise maine 'Kitab-ut-Talkhees' mein tafseel se bayan kiya hai.

e: [AI] Ibrahim ibn Abdullah narrated that Abu Asim al-Nabil narrated from Abdul Hamid ibn Ja'far, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Ata', from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a group of people and said, "What portion of the Quran do you have with you?" So, they recited it to him. He continued doing this until he came across a man who was the youngest among them. He asked him, "What do you have with you, O so and so?" The man replied, "I have this and that, and Surah Al-Baqarah." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Go, for you are their leader."
hi: Humein Ibrahim bin Abdullah ne bataya, unhein Abu Aasim An-Nabeel ne khabar di, unhein Abdul Hameed bin Ja'far ne, Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, unhone Ata' se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se bataya, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik dasta bheja jo chand logon par mushtamil tha, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhare paas Quran mein se kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne unse isi tarah padhwaya yahan tak ke unme se aik shakhs, jo unme sabse kam-umar tha, ke paas pahunche, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye fulan, tumhare paas kya hai?" Usne kaha: "Mere paas aisa-aisa hai, aur Surah Al-Baqarah hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jao, tum inke ameer ho."

e: [AI] Umar ibn Al-Khattab said, "If there are three people, let one of them be appointed as their leader, whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has commanded."
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) [ne kaha]: "Jab teen log (safar mein) hon to unhein apna aik ameer bana lena chahiye, yeh hukum Rasulullah (SAW) ne diya hai."

e: [AI] We carried the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on weak camels from the charity camels for Hajj. We said, "O Messenger of Allah, we do not see it fit for you to ride these." He said, "Every camel has a devil on its back, so remember the name of Allah when you mount it, as He has commanded you, then leave it to its own devices, for Allah alone carries (the weight)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein sadqe ke kamzor oonton par Hajj ke liye sawaar kiya, humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein nahi lagta ke yeh humein le ja sakenge." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi oont aisa nahi jiski koohaan par Shaitan (sawaar) na ho, isliye jab tum unpar sawaar ho to Allah ka naam lo jaise usne tumhein hukum diya hai, phir unhein apne liye qaboo mein rakho, kyunke asal mein Allah hi (bojh) uthata hai."

e: [AI] From his father that he was one of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , that the Prophet ﷺ  said: "Ride these animals safely and treat them safely, and do not make them a means of sitting."
hi: Unke waalid se, jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) mein se the, ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "In jaanwaron par salamati ke sath sawaar ho, aur salamati ke sath (unse) kaam lo, aur inhein kursiyaan mat banao."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "On the back of every camel, there is a devil. When you ride them, remember the name of Allah, and do not neglect your needs."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har oont ki peeth par aik Shaitan (sawaar) hai, jab tum unpar sawaar ho to Allah ka naam lo, apni zaroorat (ki dua) mein kotahi na karo."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "Indeed, on every thorny peak of a camel, there is a devil. So, make them familiar with riding, for surely Allah, the Almighty, carries them."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Har oont ki koohaan par aik Shaitan hota hai, isliye unhein sawaari se qaboo mein rakho, kyunke asal mein Allah hi (bojh) uthata hai."

e: "The Messenger of Allah forbade (eating) animals that had been taken as targets, the milk of Al-Jallalah (animals that eat dung), and drinking directly from water skins." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4448)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mashk ke mun se (seedha) paani peene se mana kiya, aur 'jallalah' (napaak cheezein khane wale jaanwar) aur 'mujath-thamah' (bandhkar nishana banaye gaye jaanwar) se bhi mana kiya."

e: The bell is the musical instrument of the Satan. (Using translation from Muslim 2114)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ghanti Shaitan ki bansuri hai."

e: Anas reported the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ as saying “Keep to travelling by night, for the earth is traversed (more easily) by night. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2571)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raat ko chalna ikhtiyar karo, kyunke zameen musafir ke liye raat mein simat jati hai (yani safar aasan ho jata hai)."

e: [AI] The translation of the given text into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to lie down on his right side when he got married at night, and when he got married before dawn, he would lean on his arms and place his head on his hand."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab raat mein kahin thehrte to apne dayen paslu par let jate, aur jab Subah se pehle thehrte to apne bazu khade karte aur apna sar apni hatheli par rakh lete."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Decrease going out when the man is calm, for surely Allah spreads out His creations at night as He wills."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab pair thak jaye (raat mein aaram karne laga ho) to bahar nikalna kam karo, kyunke Allah apni makhlooq mein se raat ko jise chahe phaila deta hai."

e: [AI] "A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wishing to travel. He said, 'O Messenger of Allah, advise me.' He replied, 'I advise you to have Taqwa (fear and consciousness) of Allah and to make Takbir (proclaim the greatness) on every hill.' After he left, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O Allah, make his journey easy for him and facilitate his travel.'"
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, woh safar par jaana chahta tha, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe wasiyat kijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein Allah se darne aur har buland jagah par takbeer kehne ki wasiyat karta hoon." Jab woh chala gaya to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, uske liye zameen samet de aur uska safar aasan kar de."

e: [AI] Suhaib, the companion of the Prophet ﷺ , reported that the Prophet ﷺ  said whenever he wanted to enter a town, he would say upon seeing it, "O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they overshadow, Lord of the seven earths and what they contain, Lord of the devils and what they lead astray, Lord of the winds and what they scatter. We ask You for the goodness of this town and the goodness of its people, and seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of its people and the evil within it."
hi: Suhaib (RA), Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi, ne bataya ke Nabi (SAW) jab bhi kisi basti mein dakhil hone ka irada karte aur usse dekhte to farmate: "Aye Allah, saat aasmano ke Rab aur jo woh saaya karte hain, aur saat zaminon ke Rab aur jo woh uthaaye huay hain, aur shayateen ke Rab aur jinhein woh gumraah karte hain, aur hawaon ke Rab aur jo woh udaati hain, hum tujhse is basti ki bhalaai aur iske ahl ki bhalaai maangte hain, aur hum tujhse iski buraai, iske ahl ki buraai, aur ismein maujood buraai se panah maangte hain."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase is:

"The Prophet ﷺ  used to never enter a house without offering two voluntary units of prayer."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) kisi manzil (thikaane) par nahi utarte magar do rak'aton se usse rukhsat lete."

e: Let a hearer hear beginning with praise of Allah and His good favours and blessing to us. Our Lord, accompany us and show favour to us, and I seek refuge in Allah from Hell. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5086)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab safar mein hote aur Fajr ho jati to farmate: "Kisi sunne wale ne Allah ki hamd, uski ne'mat aur humpar uske achhe imtihaan ka sunaa, Aye humare Rab, humare sath rah aur humpar apna fazl farma, main aag se Allah ki panah maangta hoon," yeh baat teen martaba kehte aur apni awaz buland karte.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would go on a military expedition or travel, and the night would catch up with him, he would say, 'O earth, my Lord and your Lord is Allah. I seek refuge in Allah from the evil of every lion, every black snake, every scorpion, and every inhabitant of the land. And from the evil of a parent and the offspring.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab ghazwe ya safar par nikalte aur raat ho jati to farmate: "Aye zameen, mera Rab aur tera Rab Allah hai, main Allah ki panah maangta hoon har sher, har kaale (khatarnak) jaanwar, saanp aur bichchu ke sharr se, aur is jagah ke rehne walon ke sharr se, aur (buri) maa-baap aur unki aulad ke sharr se."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took a bath, then he wore his clothes. When he reached Dhul-Hulayfah, he prayed two Rak'ahs and then sat on his camel. When he reached the open desert, he entered into the state of ihram for Hajj.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne ghusl kiya, phir apne kapde pehne, jab woh Zul-Hulaifah pahunche to do rak'atein padhi, phir apne oont par baithe, jab woh Al-Baida par seedhe huay to unhone Hajj ka ehraam bandh liya."

e: [AI] To enter Makkah (Mecca) is considered valid according to the condition of the two sheikhs.
hi: ...ke woh Makkah mein dakhil ho. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par.

e: [AI] Nasiyah Al-Khuzaiyyah, the companion of Budn, the messenger of Allah ﷺ, narrated to me that he asked the messenger of Allah ﷺ how he should deal with the parts of his body that are defective. The messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him to slaughter every defective part, then throw its sandal into its blood, and then separate it from the people so they can eat it.
hi: Mujhe Naasiyah Al-Khuza'i (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ki qurbani ke oonton ke zimmedar, ne bataya ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Main apne qurbani ke oonton mein se zakhmi (chalne se maajoor) oont ka kya karoon?" To aap (SAW) ne hukum diya ke "main har zakhmi oont ko zibah kar dun, phir uske gale mein latki hui pehchaan (joota) uske khoon mein daal dun, phir usse logon ke liye chhod dun taake woh use khaayen."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever performs an extra voluntary deed and then becomes uncertain, if he wishes he can replace it and if he wishes he can leave it. But if it was a vow, then he must replace it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi nafl ke tor par qurbani ka jaanwar muqarrar kare, phir woh gum ho jaaye, to woh chahe to badal le aur chahe to (waisa hi) chhod de, lekin agar yeh mannat (nazr) mein tha, to woh zaroor badle."

e: [AI] "Hajj is only forbidden during the month of Hajj, and it is from the Sunnah of Hajj to prohibit oneself from Hajj during the month of Hajj."
hi: "Hajj ka ehraam sirf Hajj ke mahinon mein hi bandha jaata hai, kyunke Hajj ki Sunnat yehi hai ke Hajj ka ehraam Hajj ke mahinon mein hi bandha jaaye."

e: "O Banu 'Abd Manaf, do not prevent anyone from circumambulating this House and praying at any time he wants of night or day." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 585)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Banu Abd Manaf, kisi ko is Ghar (Ka'bah) ka tawaaf karne aur raat ya din ki kisi bhi ghari mein jab woh chahe namaz padhne se mat roko."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Islam does not allow for failure to perform the hajj. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1729)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Islam mein koi 'sururah' (Hajj na karne wala) nahi."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: He who intends to perform hajj should hasten to do so. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1732)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Hajj karna chahe, use jaldi karni chahiye."

e: [AI] I heard Ali say, "Perform Hajj before you are unable to do so." It was as if I could see a deaf Abyssinian breaking down a building stone by stone with a pickaxe in his hand. I asked him, "Is this something you are saying based on your own opinion, or did you hear it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He replied, "No, by the One who split the grain and created the soul, but I heard it from your Prophet ﷺ."
hi: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kehte hue suna: "Hajj karo isse pehle ke tum Hajj na kar sako," goya main aik Habashi ko dekh raha hoon jo chhote sar wala, tedhe haath-pair wala hai, uske haath mein aik phaawda hai jisse woh use (Ka'bah ko) pathhar-pathhar todta hai. Maine unse poocha: "Yeh koi baat hai jo aap apni raay se keh rahe hain ya aapne ise Rasulullah (SAW) se suna hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jisne daane ko phaada aur rooh ko paida kiya, balke maine ise tumhare Nabi (SAW) se suna hai."

e: I was a man who used to give (riding-beasts) on hire for this purpose (for travelling during the pilgrimage) and the people would tell (me): Your hajj is not valid. So I met Ibn Umar and told him: AbuAbdurRahman, I am a man who gives (riding-beast) on hire for this purpose (i.e. for hajj), and the people tell me: Your hajj is not valid. Ibn Umar replied: Do you not put on ihram (the pilgrim dress), call the talbiyah (labbayk), circumambulate the Ka'bah, return from Arafat and lapidate jamrahs? I said: Why not? Then he said: Your hajj is valid. a man came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him the same question you have asked me. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kept silence and did not answer him till this verse came down: "It is no sin for you that you seek the bounty of your Lord." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for him and recited this verse to him and said: Your hajj is valid. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1733)
hi: "...Kya tum ehraam nahi bandhte, talbiyah nahi kehte, tawaaf nahi karte, Arafaat se wapas nahi aate, aur jamraat ko kankariyan nahi maarte?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "To tumhara Hajj sahih hai. Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse waisa hi sawaal poocha jaisa tumne mujhse poocha, to Rasulullah (SAW) khamosh rahe aur usse koi jawaab nahi diya yahan tak ke yeh ayat nazil hui: '{Tumpar koi gunah nahi ke tum apne Rab ka fazl talaash karo}' (Surah Al-Baqarah 198), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse bulwaya, yeh ayat usse padh kar sunayi, aur farmaya: 'Tumhara Hajj sahih hai.'"

e: The people used to trade, in the beginning, at Mina, Arafat, the market place of Dhul-Majaz, and during the season of hajj. But (later on) they became afraid of trading while they were putting on ihram. So Allah, glory be to Him, sent down this verse: "It is no sin for you that you seek the bounty of your Lord during the seasons of hajj." Ubayd ibn Umayr told me that he (Ibn Abbas) used to recite this verse in his codex. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1734)
hi: Log Hajj ke shuru daur mein Mina, Arafah, Zul-Majaz ke bazaar aur Hajj ke mausamon mein khareed-o-farokht kiya karte the, phir unhein ehraam ki halat mein tijarat karne se darr laga, to Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "{Tumpar koi gunah nahi ke tum apne Rab ka fazl talaash karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 198), Hajj ke mausamon mein. Unhone kaha: mujhe Ubaid bin Umair ne bataya ke woh ise mushaf mein isi tarah padha karte the.

e: Nafi' said: Ibn Umar used to lengthen his prayer before the Friday prayer and would offer two rak'ahs after it in his house. He used to say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would do that. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1128)
hi: ...ke Rasulullah (SAW) bhi aisa hi kiya karte the.

e: [AI] It was from the obedience to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to respond, "Here I am, O God of truth."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki talbiyah mein se yeh (bhi) tha: 'Labbaika Ilaahal-Haqq' (Main haazir hoon, Aye Haqq ke Ma'bood)."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  used to wear a head covering.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) buland awaz se talbiyah kaha karte the."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ said: Gabriel came to me and said, "Tell your companions to raise their voices in pronouncing the Takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar), the Tasbeeh (saying Subhan Allah), and the Talbiyah (saying Labbayk Allahumma labbayk). It has been narrated that Khalad ibn Sa'ib reported from Zaid ibn Khalid al-Juhani.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere paas Jibra'il (AS) aaye aur kaha: apne sahaba (RA) ko hukum do ke woh ihlal (ehraam ka aelaan) aur talbiyah mein apni awazein buland karein." Aur yeh Khallad bin As-Saib se, Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani (RA) se, bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Jibriel came to me and said, 'O Muhammad, command your companions to raise their voices with the talbiyah, as it is the slogan of Hajj.' And it was reported from Al-Muttalib bin 'Abdullah bin Hantab, from Abu Hurairah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS) mere paas aaye aur kaha: 'Aye Muhammad, apne sahaba (RA) ko hukum do ke woh talbiyah mein apni awazein buland karein, kyunke yeh Hajj ki alaamat hai.'" Aur yeh Al-Muttalib bin Abdullah bin Hantab se, Abu Hurairah (RA) se, bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Gabriel commanded me to raise my voice during the call to prayer, for it is one of the signs of Hajj." All of these chains of narration are authentic, and none of them contradict each other. The early generations used to gather chains of narration for the same text, just as we do now, and the two sheikhs did not exclude this hadith.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main ihlal (ehraam ke aelaan) mein apni awaz buland karoon, kyunke yeh Hajj ki alaamaton mein se hai." Yeh sab asaneed sahih hain, aur inme se koi doosre ko kamzor nahi karta, kyunke salaf ke nazdeek aik hi matan ke liye kayi asaneed jama ho jaya karti thin, jaisa aajkal hamare nazdeek jama hoti hain, aur Shaykhain ne yeh hadith nahi nikali.

e: “Which actions are best?” He said: “Raising one’s voice and slaughtering the sacrificial animal.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2924)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "'Al-Ajj wath-Thajj' (buland awaz se talbiyah kehna aur qurbani ka khoon bahaana)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "No believing person performs the Tawaf around the Kaaba except that he encompasses what is on his right and left sides from trees and rocks until the earth is cut off from here and there on his right and left."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi momin talbiyah nahi kehta magar uske dayen aur bayen taraf ke darakht aur pathhar bhi (uske sath) talbiyah kehte hain, yahan tak ke zameen yahan se wahan tak, uske dayen aur bayen taraf se, khatam ho jaati hai."

e: Sa'id ibn Jubayr said: I said to Abdullah ibn Abbas: AbulAbbas, I am surprised to see the difference of opinion amongst the companions of the Apostle ﷺ about the wearing of ihram by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he made it obligatory. He replied: I am aware of it more than the people. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed only one hajj. Hence the people differed among themselves. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out (from Medina) with the intention of performing hajj. When he offered two rak'ahs of prayer in the mosque at Dhul-Hulayfah, he made it obligatory by wearing it. At the same meeting, he raised his voice in the talbiyah for hajj, when he finished his two rak'ahs. Some people heard it and I retained it from him. He then rode (on the she-camel), and when it (the she-camel) stood up, with him on its back, he raised his voice in the talbiyah and some people heard it at that moment. This is because the people were coming in groups, so they heard him raising his voice calling the talbiyah when his she-camel stood up with him on its back, and they thought that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had raised his voice in the talbiyah when his she-camel stood up with him on its back. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ proceeded further; when he ascended the height of al-Bayda' he raised his voice in the talbiyah. Some people heard it at that moment. They thought that he had raised his voice in the talbiyah when he ascended the height of al-Bayda'. I swear by Allah, he raised his voice in the talbiyah at the place where he prayed, and he raised his voice in the talbiyah when his she-camel stood up with him on its back, and he raised his voice in the talbiyah when he ascended the height of al-Bayda'. Sa'id (ibn Jubayr) said; He who follows the view of Ibn Abbas raises his voice in talbiyah (and ihram) at the place of is prayer after he finishes two rak'ahs of his prayer. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1770)
hi: Maine Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) se kaha: "Aye Ibn Abbas, mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke ihlal ke waqt ke ikhtilaf par ta'ajjub hai, jab unhone (Hajj) wajib kiya." Unhone kaha: "Main is baare mein logon se zyada jaanta hoon, beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ka Hajj sirf aik hi tha, isi wajah se log ikhtilaf mein pad gaye. Rasulullah (SAW) Hajj ki niyat se nikle, jab unhone Zul-Hulaifah ki apni masjid mein apni do rak'atein padhi to apni majlis mein hi (Hajj) wajib kar liya, aur apni do rak'aton se farigh hote hi Hajj ka ihlal kiya, kuch qaumon ne unse yeh suna aur ise apne zehen mein rakha, phir woh sawaar huay, jab unki oontni unhein lekar khadi hui to unhone ihlal kiya, aur kuch aur qaumon ne unse yeh suna. Aisa isliye hua ke log guroh-guroh (mukhtalif waqton par) aa rahe the, to unhone ise suna jab unki oontni unhein lekar khadi hui aur woh ihlal kar rahe the, to unhone kaha: 'Rasulullah (SAW) ne to sirf tab ihlal kiya jab unki oontni unhein lekar khadi hui.' Phir Rasulullah (SAW) aage badhe, jab woh Al-Baida ki buland jagah par chadhe to (phir) ihlal kiya, aur kuch aur qaumon ne yeh mehsoos kiya, to unhone kaha: 'Unhone to sirf tab ihlal kiya jab woh Al-Baida ki buland jagah par chadhe.' Allah ki qasam, unhone apni jaaye-namaz par (Hajj) wajib kiya, aur jab unki oontni unhein lekar khadi hui tab bhi ihlal kiya, aur jab woh Al-Baida ki buland jagah par chadhe tab bhi ihlal kiya." Sa'eed bin Jubair ne kaha: "To jo Ibn Abbas (RA) ki baat par amal kare, woh apni jaaye-namaz par hi ihlal kare jab woh apni do rak'aton se farigh ho."

e: [AI] Saad ibn Abi Waqqas, "The messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to accompany his people when they rode with him on a journey."
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) [ne kaha]: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab Al-Fur' ka raasta lete to jab unki sawari unhein lekar khadi hoti tab ihlal karte."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , it was narrated that he used to say, "The game meat from the land is halal (permissible) for you, but you are forbidden from it if you did not hunt it or it was not hunted for you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Khushki ke shikaar ka gosht tumhare liye halal hai jabke tum ehraam mein ho, jab tak tum khud usska shikaar na karo ya tumhare liye shikaar na kiya jaaye."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is:

"Yes, it is narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was presented with ostrich eggs as a gift, but he returned them as they were deemed haram (prohibited)."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko shutar-murgh (ostrich) ke ande tohfe mein diye gaye jabke aap (SAW) ehraam mein thay, to aap (SAW) ne unhein wapas kar diya." Poocha gaya: "(Kya aisa hua)?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan."

e: I asked AbulAshhab: Did AbdurRahman ibn Tarafah meet his grandfather Arfajah? He replied: Yes. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4233)
hi: "Ji haan."

e: “I asked Jabir bin ‘Abdullah about hyenas: ‘Are they game (that can be hunted)?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ I said: ‘Can I eat them?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ I said: ‘Is this something that you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?’ He said: ‘Yes.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3236)
hi: Maine poocha: "Kya lakdbaghha (hyena) khaya ja sakta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Maine poocha: "Kya yeh shikaar (ki fehrist) mein aati hai?" Unhone poocha: "Kya tumne yeh Rasulullah (SAW) se suna hai?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The hyena is a prey, so if it is caught by a person in the state of ihram (pilgrim sanctity), there is a compensation of a mature sheep and it can be eaten."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Lakdbaghha (hyena) shikaar mein shaamil hai, agar koi muhrim (ehraam wala) ise maar de, to iska kaffara aik pukhta mendha hai, aur ise khaya ja sakta hai."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  shaved his head while he was in a state of ihram."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) [ne kaha]: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sar par hijamah (pachhna/cupping) karwayi jabke aap (SAW) ehraam mein thay."
