e: [AI] The Prophet, peace be upon him, performed "Ihtijam" while he was in a state of "Ihram" (ritual consecration) on the back of his feet to alleviate pain that he was experiencing.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne ehraam ki halat mein apne paon ke oopri hisse par hijamah karwayi, kisi dard ki wajah se jo unhein tha."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ ordered a sanctified person to kill a snake in the sacred area of Mina."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne aik muhrim (ehraam wale) ko hukum diya ke woh Mina ke Haram mein aik saanp ko maar daale."

e: We came out for performing hajj along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When we reached al-Araj, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ alighted and we also alighted. Aisha sat beside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I sat beside my father (AbuBakr). The equipment and personal effects of AbuBakr and of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were placed with AbuBakr's slave on a camel. AbuBakr was sitting and waiting for his arrival. He arrived but he had no camel with him. He asked: Where is your camel? He replied: I lost it last night. AbuBakr said: There was only one camel, even that you have lost. He then began to beat him while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was smiling and saying: Look at this man who is in the sacred state (putting on ihram), what is he doing? Ibn AbuRizmah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke nothing except the words: Look at this man who is in the sacred state (wearing ihram), what is he doing? He was smiling (when he uttered these words). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1818)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hajj ke liye nikle, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka saaman aur Abu Bakr (RA) ka saaman aik hi (oont par) tha. Hum Al-Arj mein utre, aur humara saaman Abu Bakr (RA) ke ghulam ke sath tha. Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) baithe, aur Aisha (RA) unke pehlu mein baithi, aur Abu Bakr (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke doosre pehlu mein baithe, aur main apne waalid (Abu Bakr) ke pehlu mein baithi, unke ghulam aur saaman ka intezar karte huay ke woh kab humare paas aata hai. Achanak ghulam paidal chala aa raha tha, uske sath uska oont nahi tha. Unhone kaha: to Abu Bakr (RA) ne usse poocha: "Tera oont kahan hai?" Usne kaha: "Woh aaj raat mujhse gum ho gaya." Unhone kaha: to Abu Bakr (RA) khade huay aur usse maarne lage, aur kehte jaate: "Aik hi oont tha aur woh bhi tumse gum ho gaya, aur tum aik mard ho!" To Rasulullah (SAW) sirf muskuraate rahe aur farmaate rahe: "Dekho is muhrim (ehraam wale) ko, yeh kya kar raha hai."

e: [AI] "We used to cover our faces from men and we used to comb our hair before that in ihram."
hi: "Hum mardon se apne chehre chhupaya karte the, aur usse pehle hum ehraam mein baal bhi kanghi kar liya karte the."

e: I heard ʿUmar bin al-Khattab say: Why are we running now and uncovering our shoulders (in tawaf) when Allah has caused Islam to prevail and has eliminated kufr and its people? Whatever the case, we will never give up something that we did at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Aḥmad 317)
hi: ...kandhon (nangi karne) ke baare mein, jabke Allah ne Islam ko mazboot kar diya hai aur kufr aur uske ahl ko nikaal diya hai? Iske bawajood, hum kuch bhi woh cheez nahi chhodenge jo hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath kiya karte the.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to face the Stone, then he put his lips on it and wept for a long time. Then he turned and saw ‘Umar bin Khattab weeping. He said: ‘O ‘Umar, this is the place where tears should be shed.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2945)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hajr (Aswad) ki taraf mun kiya, use chooma, phir apne hoant usspar rakh diye aur der tak roye," phir mudkar dekha to Umar (RA) ko rote paaya, to farmaya: "Aye Umar, yahin par aansu bahaaye jaate hain."

e: [AI] We entered Mecca in the morning. The Prophet ﷺ  came to the door of the mosque and I handed over his mount to him. Then he entered the mosque and began by touching the Black Stone and kissing it. Then he performed Tawaf (circumambulation) three times and walked quickly between the two hills of Safa and Marwa four times until he finished. When he finished, he kissed the Black Stone again and placed his hands on it and wiped his face with them.
hi: Hum Makkah mein duha (chaasht) ke waqt dakhil huay, "to Nabi (SAW) masjid ke darwaze par pahunche, apni sawari bithayi, phir masjid mein dakhil huay, Hajr (Aswad) se shuru kiya aur use chooma, aap (SAW) ki aankhon se aansu beh rahe the, phir teen chakkar ramal (tez chaal) se aur chaar chakkar mamooli chaal se lagaye yahan tak ke tawaaf mukammal hua, jab mukammal hua to Hajr ko chooma, apne dono haath usspar rakhe aur unse apna chehra masah kiya."

e: [AI] Abu Asim Al-Nabil narrated that Ja'far ibn Abdullah, son of Al-Hakam, said: "I saw Muhammad ibn Abbad ibn Ja'far kiss the stone and prostrate on it. Then he said, 'I saw your uncle Ibn Abbas kiss it and prostrate on it.' Ibn Abbas said, 'I saw Umar ibn Al-Khattab kiss it and prostrate on it, and then he said, 'I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  do the same, so I did it.'"
hi: Humein Abu Aasim An-Nabeel ne bataya, humein Ja'far bin Abdullah - jo Ibn Al-Hakam hain - ne bataya, unhone kaha: maine Muhammad bin Abbad bin Ja'far ko Hajr ko chumte aur uspar sajda karte dekha, phir unhone kaha: "Maine tumhare mamu Ibn Abbas (RA) ko ise chumte aur uspar sajda karte dekha." Aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko ise chumte aur uspar sajda karte dekha," phir unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko aisa hi karte dekha, isliye maine bhi aisa hi kiya."

e: [AI] He informed him that he heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "O our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."
hi: Unhone unhein khabar di ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko Banu Jumah ke rukn aur Rukn-e-Aswad ke darmiyan yeh kehte suna: "Rabbana aatina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qina azaaban-naar" (Aye humare Rab, humein duniya mein bhi bhalaai de aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalaai de, aur humein aag ke azab se bacha).

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas used to say, "Preserve this hadith and he used to recite it to the Prophet ﷺ and he used to recite it between the two corners, 'O Lord, suffice me with what You have provided for me, bless it for me, and make it replace every loss for me with something better.'"
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) kaha karte the: "Is hadith ko yaad rakho," aur woh ise Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchate the, aur woh dono rukno ke darmiyan yeh dua karte: "Rab, qanni'ni bima razaqtani wa baarik li fihi wakhluf ala kulli ghaa'ibatin li bikhair" (Aye mere Rab, jo tune mujhe diya hai usi par mujhe qana'at ata kar, aur usme mere liye barkat de, aur meri har ghair-hazir (gum-shuda) cheez ka mujhe behtar badla de).

e: [AI] The translation of the Arabic text "أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَبَّلَ الرُّكْنَ الْيَمَانِيَّ وَوَضَعَ خَدَّهُ عَلَيْهِ" into English is: "That the Messenger of Allah kissed the Yemeni corner and placed his cheek on it."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Rukn-e-Yamani ko chooma aur apna gaal usspar rakha."

e: [AI] The translation is as follows: It is narrated that the Prophet of Allah, peace be upon him, used to when circumambulating the Ka'bah, he would touch or he said he would grasp the Black Stone and the Corner in every circumambulation.
hi: Ke Allah ke Nabi (SAW) jab Ka'bah ka tawaaf karte to har chakkar mein Hajr aur Rukn (Yamani) ko masah karte - ya kaha: chhoote.

e: He heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "Indeed the Corner and the Maqam are two corundums from the corundum of Paradise. Allah removed their lights, and if their lights had not been removed then they would illuminate what is between east and the west." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 878)
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Rukn (Hajr-e-Aswad) aur Maqaam (Ibrahim) Jannat ke yaqoot patharon mein se do yaqoot hain, Allah ne unka noor mita diya, aur agar aisa na hota to woh Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan (poori duniya ko) roshan kar dete."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Al-Rukn and al-Maqaam are two rubies from the jewels of Paradise."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rukn aur Maqaam Jannat ke yaqoot patharon mein se do yaqoot hain."

e: He heard the Messenger of Allah saying: "Indeed the Corner and the Maqam are two corundums from the corundum of Paradise. Allah removed their lights, and if their lights had not been removed then they would illuminate what is between east and the west." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 878)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Rukn aur Maqaam Jannat ke yaqoot patharon mein se do yaqoot hain, Allah ne unka noor mita diya, aur agar aisa na hota to woh Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan (poori duniya ko) roshan kar dete." Aur yeh Az-Zuhri ki, Musafi se, hadith ka shahid hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, this stone has a tongue and lips that will bear witness on the Day of Judgment for the one who takes possession of it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak is pathhar (Hajr-e-Aswad) ki aik zaban aur do hoant hain, jo Qayamat ke din, haq ke sath, us shakhs ke liye gawahi dega jisne ise chooma ho."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'The Cornerstone (al-Rukn) on the Day of Judgment will come with a greater size than Mount Abu Qubays, and it will have a tongue and lips to speak about whomever it received with intention, and it is on the right side of Allah with which He shakes hands with His creation.' This hadith has been narrated by a reliable commentator, although it is not a condition of the two shaykhs (referring to Abu Bakr and Umar). They did not argue with Abu Haroon Umarah bin Juwayn Al-Abdi about it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rukn (Hajr-e-Aswad) Qayamat ke din Abu Qubais (pahaad) se bhi bada hokar aayega, uski aik zaban aur do hoant hongay, jo us shakhs ke haq mein bolega jisne ise sacchi niyat se chooma ho, aur yeh Allah ka dayan haath hai jisse woh apni makhlooq se musafiha karta hai." Iska aik tafseeli shahid bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai, magar yeh Shaykhain ki shart mein shamil nahi, kyunke unhone Abu Haroon Umarah bin Juwain Al-Abdi ko hujjat nahi maana.

e: ʿUmar came near the Black Stone and kissed it and said "No doubt, I know that you are a stone and can neither benefit anyone nor harm anyone. Had I not seen Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissing you I would not have kissed you." (Using translation from Bukhārī 1597)
hi: "Main jaanta hoon ke tu aik pathhar hai, na nuqsaan pahuncha sakta hai na fayda, aur agar maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko tujhe chumte na dekha hota to main tujhe na chumta," phir usse chooma. To Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne unse kaha: "Kyun nahi, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, yeh nuqsaan bhi pahunchata hai aur fayda bhi." Unhone kaha: phir kaha: "Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ki Kitaab ki roshni mein." Unhone poocha: "Yeh Allah ki Kitaab mein kahan hai?" Unhone kaha: Allah ne farmaya: "{Aur jab tere Rab ne Bani Adam ki pusht se unki nasal nikaali aur unhein khud unke upar gawah banaya, 'Kya main tumhara Rab nahi?' Unhone kaha: 'Kyun nahi'}" (Surah Al-A'raaf 172). Allah ne Adam (AS) ko paida kiya aur unki pusht par haath phera, phir unse iqraar karaaya ke woh Rab hai aur woh (uske) bande hain, aur unse ahd aur mithaaq liye, aur unhein aik chamde ke tukde par likha, aur is pathhar (Hajr-e-Aswad) ki do aankhein aur aik zaban thi, usse kaha gaya: "Apna mun khol," unhone kaha: to usne apna mun khola, to usme woh likha hua chamda daal diya gaya, aur kaha gaya: "Jo tujhse Qayamat ke din milaap kare, uske liye gawahi dena." Aur main gawahi deta hoon, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Qayamat ke din Hajr-e-Aswad ko laaya jayega, uski aik chaalaak (saaf-saaf bolne wali) zaban hogi, jo us shakhs ke liye jo ise chhue tauheed ki gawahi degi," isliye, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, yeh nuqsaan bhi pahunchata hai aur fayda bhi. To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon ke main aisi qaum mein zinda rahun jismein tum na ho, Aye Abul-Hasan."

e: [AI] "I used to worship him, so if there was something in the house, I would send it to him. And when there was a day with good milk, I would send it to him, and they had a disagreement among the Quraysh when they wanted to place it, to the point that it almost led to a fight with swords among them. So he said, let the first man to enter from the door decide. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered and they said, this is the trustworthy one, and they used to call him the trustworthy in the era of ignorance. So they said, O Muhammad, we are pleased with you. So he called for a garment, spread it out, and placed the stone on it, then he said, each tribe should hold a corner of the garment except for him, because he is the one who should place it. Then they did so, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took it and placed it with his own hand."
hi: To main uski ibadat karta tha, agar ghar mein koi cheez hoti to main use uski taraf bhej deta, yahan tak ke aik din achha doodh mila to maine use uski taraf bheja, unhone use usspar unDayla. Aur Quraish ne Hajr (Aswad) ko rakhne mein ikhtilaf kiya jab woh use (naye tameer shuda Ka'bah mein) rakhna chahte the, yahan tak ke unke darmiyan talwaron se ladai hone ke qareeb thi, to (kisi ne) kaha: "Apne darmiyan (faisla) us pehle shakhs ke hawale karo jo darwaze se dakhil ho." To Rasulullah (SAW) dakhil huay, unhone kaha: "Yeh to Al-Ameen (amanatdaar) hai," aur woh jaahiliyat mein unhein 'Al-Ameen' kaha karte the. Unhone kaha: "Aye Muhammad, hum aapse raazi hain." To aap (SAW) ne aik kapda mangwaya, use bichhaya aur usme Hajr rakh diya, phir farmaya: "Is khandan ke liye aur us khandan ke liye," aur unhone khandaan ka naam liya taake tum mein se har khandan kapde ka aik kona pakde. To unhone aisa hi kiya, phir use uthaya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne use apne haath se le kar rakh diya.

e: [AI] When Uthman was killed, the people were extremely alarmed on that day. The sword of peace among us was greatly shaken. I sat in my house when a need arose for me in the market, so I went out. Then, in the shade of the palace, I saw a group of about forty men sitting. There was a chain hung on the door. I wanted to enter, but the gatekeeper stopped me. The people said, "Let him in," so I entered. Then, the leaders of the people and their faces appeared. A beautiful man came in without a shirt or turban and sat down. It was Ali bin Abi Talib. Then he said, "When Ibrahim wanted to build the Kaaba, he faced a difficulty and did not know what to do. Allah sent tranquility, which was a pleasant breeze. He used it as a foundation and built upon it every day. Makkah was extremely hot. When he reached the place of the stone, he told Ismail to go and search for a stone and put it here. Ismail went to search for it and Jibril came with the stone and placed it. Ismail asked, 'Who brought this? From where is this stone brought?' He said, 'This is brought by the one who does not depend on my building and your building.' So, he built it. Then it was demolished by the giants, then they built it. Then it was demolished by a flood and they rebuilt it. When Quraysh wanted to put the stone, they argued about its placement. The first one who exits from this door will place it." So, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  exited from the side of Banu Shaybah, ordered a cloth to be spread, and placed the stone in the middle of it. Then, he ordered a man from each tribe of Quraysh to hold a corner of the cloth, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took it with his own hands and placed it. The scholars have agreed on narrating this long hadith from Ayoub Al-Sakhtiani and Kathir bin Kathir from Sa'eed bin Jubayr from Ibn Abbas about the story of building the Kaaba. This incident is different from the others.
hi: Jab Uthman (RA) shaheed kiye gaye to us din log sakht khauf-zada ho gaye, aur humare yahan talwaron ka nikalna aam baat thi, to main apne ghar mein baitha tha, mujhe bazaar mein koi zaroorat pesh aayi, to main nikla, achanak mahal ke saaye mein taqreeban chalees (40) aadmiyon ka aik giroh baitha tha, aur darwaze par aik zanjeer laga hua tha, main dakhil hona chahta tha to darbaan ne mujhe roka, to logon ne kaha: "Is shakhs ko jaane do," main dakhil hua, to wahan buzurg aur mo'tabar log the. Phir aik khoobsurat shakhs, aik jubbe mein, jispar na qamees thi na amaamah, aaya aur baith gaya, dekha to woh Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) thay, phir unhone kaha: "Jab Ibrahim (AS) ne Ka'bah ki tameer ka irada kiya to unhein pareshaani hui aur unhein samajh nahi aaya ke kya karein, to Allah ne sakinah (itminaan) bheja, jo aik gunjti hui hawa thi, jo lapet gayi, phir woh usspar har din aik manzil tameer karte gaye, aur Makkah sakht garmi wala tha. Jab woh Hajr (Aswad) ki jagah tak pahunche to Ismail (AS) se kaha: 'Jao aur koi pathhar dhoondo, ise yahan rakh do.' To woh pahaadon mein ghoomne lage, Jibra'il (AS) unke paas woh pathhar le aaye aur usse rakh diya. Ismail (AS) aaye aur poocha: 'Yeh kaun laaya?' ya 'Yeh kahan se aaya?' ya 'Yeh kahan se laaya gaya?' To unhone kaha: 'Isse woh laaya hai jo meri tameer aur teri tameer par bharosa nahi karta.' To unhone use tameer kiya, phir woh gir gaya, to Amaaliqah (Amalekites) ne use dobara tameer kiya, phir woh gir gaya, to Jurhum ne use tameer kiya, phir woh gir gaya, to Quraish ne use tameer kiya. Jab unhone Hajr ko rakhna chaha to woh iski jagah ke baare mein jhagadne lage, to kaha gaya: 'Jo pehla shakhs is darwaze se nikle, wahi ise rakhega.' To Rasulullah (SAW) Banu Shaibah ke darwaze ki taraf se nikle, aap (SAW) ne aik kapde ka hukum diya, use bichhaya gaya, aap (SAW) ne Hajr ko uske beechon-beech rakh diya, phir Quraish ke har khandan mein se aik shakhs ko hukum diya ke woh kapde ka aik kona pakde, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne use apne haath se le liya aur rakh diya." Shaykhain dono is lambi hadith ko Ayyub As-Sakhtiyani aur Kaseer bin Kaseer se, unhone Sa'eed bin Jubair se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, nikalne par muttafiq hain, Ka'bah ki tameer ki kahani jo pehle-pehl Ibrahim Khalilullah (AS) ne tameer ki thi, aur yeh us se alag hai.

e: The Prophet said: "Stoning the Jimari and Sa'i between As-Safa and Al-Marwah are only done for the establishment of Allah's remembrance." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 902)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jamraat ko kankariyan maarna, tawaaf, aur Safa-Marwah ke darmiyan sa'i, sirf Allah ke zikr ko qaim karne ke liye muqarrar ki gayi hain, kisi aur maqsad ke liye nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Circumambulating the Ka'bah is a form of worship, except that Allah has permitted you to speak during it. So, whoever speaks, let them only speak good."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ka'bah ka tawaaf namaz hai, siwaye is ke ke Allah ne ismein baat karne ki ijaazat di hai, isliye jo bole woh sirf achhi baat kare."

e: the Prophet said: "Tawaf around the House is similar to Salat except that you talk during it. So whoever talks in it, then let him not say but good." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 960)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, unhone ise Nabi (SAW) tak marfoo' kiya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Ka'bah ka tawaaf namaz jaisa hai, siwaye is ke ke tum ismein baat karte ho, isliye jo baat kare, woh sirf achhi baat kare."

e: [AI] "Because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  circumambulated the Kaaba from behind it," Allah, the Most Blessed and Exalted, said, "And let them go around the ancient House" (Surah Al-Hajj, 22:29).
hi: ...kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ka'bah ka tawaaf uske peechhe se kiya. Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur woh is purane Ghar ka tawaaf karein}" (Surah Al-Hajj 29).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  drank water during Tawaf.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne tawaaf ke dauran paani piya."

e: [AI] He informed him that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) passed by the Kaaba and saw a man leading another man with a belt around his nose. The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) cut the belt with his hand and then ordered him to lead him by his hand. It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) passed by a man who was circumambulating (tawaf) while holding onto a walking stick, or a leg, or a thread, or something else. The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) cut it and said, "Hold onto it with your hand." Ibn Jurayj said: Sulayman al-Ahwal informed me of this hadith, and Tawus also informed him that Ibn Abbas said that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said this.
hi: Unhein khabar di ke Rasulullah (SAW) Ka'bah ke paas se guzre, aik shakhs doosre shakhs ko naak mein bandhi hui rassi se lekar chal raha tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne use apne haath se kaat diya, phir usse hukum diya ke woh use apne haath se le jaaye. Unhone kaha: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) tawaaf karte huay aik shakhs ke paas se guzre jise haath ya paon mein tasme se, ya dhaage se, ya kisi aur cheez se baandha gaya tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne use kaat diya," aur farmaya: "Ise apne haath se le jao." Ibn Jurayj ne kaha: mujhe yeh sab Sulaiman Al-Ahwal ne bataya ke Tawus ne unhein bataya ke Ibn Abbas (RA) ne yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se naql ki.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every path and valley in Makkah is a sacred site."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Makkah ki har ghaati (rasta) chalne aur qurbani karne ki jagah hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: "Whoever performs Hajj from Makkah on foot and returns to Makkah, Allah will write for him for every step seven hundred good deeds. Each good deed is equivalent to the good deeds of the Sacred Mosque." It was asked, "What are the good deeds of the Sacred Mosque?" He said, "Each good deed is equivalent to a hundred thousand good deeds."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo shakhs Makkah se paidal Hajj kare yahan tak ke woh Makkah wapas aa jaaye, Allah har qadam ke badle usse saat sau (700) neki likhta hai, har neki Haram ki nekiyon jaisi." Poocha gaya: "Haram ki nekiyaan kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har neki ke badle aik lakh (100,000) nekiyaan."

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would be one day before the pilgrimage season, he would address the people and inform them about their rituals."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab tarwiyah (8 Zul-Hijjah) se aik din pehle hote to logon ko khutba dete aur unhein unke manaasik (Hajj ke ahkaam) bataate."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ performed five prayers in Mina."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Mina mein paanch namazein padhi."

e: [AI] That the imam should pray Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, the last Fajr prayer in Mina, then proceed to Arafah and face the direction where he had completed his obligations. When the sun sets, he should address the people, then pray Dhuhr and Asr together. Then he should stand in Arafah until the sun disappears. After that, he should proceed to Muzdalifah and pray there or wherever Allah has ordained. Then he should stand in congregation until dawn and depart before sunrise. When he throws the Jamrat al-Aqaba, everything that is prohibited for him becomes permissible except women and perfume, until he visits the House.
hi: Ke imam Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha aur Fajr Mina mein padhe, phir Arafah ki taraf subah subah jaaye, jahan uske liye muqarrar hai wahan pahunche, jab suraj dhal jaaye to logon ko khutba de, phir Zuhr aur Asr ikathi padhe, phir Arafaat mein thehre yahan tak ke suraj chhup jaaye, phir wapas ho aur Muzdalifah mein namaz padhe ya jahan Allah ne muqarrar kiya ho, phir Jam' (Muzdalifah) mein thehre yahan tak ke roshni ho jaaye aur suraj nikalne se pehle wahan se rawana ho. Jab woh badi Jamrah ko kankariyan maare, to uspar haram ki gayi har cheez uske liye halal ho jaati hai, siwaye auraton aur khushbu ke, yahan tak ke woh Ghar (Ka'bah) ki ziyarat kare.

e: [AI] Did people not know, or did they forget? And the one who sent Muhammad ﷺ with the truth, "I certainly went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from Mina to Arafah, and he did not abandon performing the circumambulation (tawaf) until he cast the pebbles at the Jamarat, except that he mixed it with takbeer or tahleel."
hi: "Kya log jahil ho gaye hain ya bhool gaye hain? Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad (SAW) ko haq ke sath bheja, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Mina se Arafah tak safar kiya, aap (SAW) ne talbiyah nahi chhodi yahan tak ke Jamrah ko kankariyan maar chuke, siwaye is ke ke aap (SAW) ismein takbeer ya tahleel bhi mila lete."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Raise those who are suffering from hunger and distance yourselves from those who overeat."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wadi Urnah se door raho, aur Wadi Muhassir se door raho."

e: [AI] "Regarding the 'urunat', it means to not stand on one leg. As for the statement 'an muhassir', it means descending in a group except if they descend individually."
hi: ...'Uranaat' ke baare mein, unka farmaan 'Al-Uranaat' Uranah mein waqoof (thehrne) ka zikr hai, ya'ni Uranah mein na thehro, aur unka farmaan 'Muhassir se' iska matlab Jam' (Muzdalifah) mein utarna hai, siwaye is ke ke woh Muhassir mein hi utar jaayen.

e: “We were standing in a place that was far from the place of standing. Ibn Mirba’ came to us and said: ‘I am the messenger of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to you. He said: “Stay where you are today for today you are on the legacy of Ibrahim.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3011)
hi: "Main tumhare paas Rasulullah (SAW) ka bheja hua qaasid hoon, woh tumse farmate hain: 'Apne inhi jagahon par qaim raho, kyunke tum Ibrahim (AS) ki miraas mein se aik miraas par ho.'"

e: "I came to the Prophet in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah) and said: 'Is there Hajj for me?' He said: 'Whoever offers this prayer with us and observed this standing until he departed, and he departed before that from Arafat by night or by day, then his Hajj is complete. And he has completed the prescribed duties.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3042)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke woh Jam' (Muzdalifah) mein thay, maine poocha: "Kya mera Hajj (mukammal) hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo humare sath yeh namaz is jagah par padhe, phir humare sath yahan thehre yahan tak ke imam rawana ho jaaye, aur isse pehle raat ya din mein Arafaat se aa chuka ho, uska Hajj mukammal ho gaya aur usne apna tafas (gard-o-ghubaar) door kar liya."

e: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the place of halting, that is, al-Muzdalifah. I said: I have come from the mountains of Tayy. I fatigued my mount and fatigued myself. By Allah, I found no hill (on my way) but I halted there. Have I completed my hajj? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Anyone who offers this prayer along with us and comes over to Arafat before it by night or day will complete his hajj and he may wash away the dirt (of his body). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1950)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke woh (Muzdalifah mein) waqoof kar rahe the, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main Tayy pahaad se aaya hoon, maine apni sawari thaka di hai aur khud ko bhi thaka diya hai, Allah ki qasam, maine koi pahaad nahi chhoda jispar main na thehra hoon, to kya mera Hajj (mukammal) hai?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo humare sath yeh namaz paa le, aur isse pehle Arafaat aa chuka ho, raat ya din mein, usne apna tafas door kar liya aur uska Hajj mukammal ho gaya."

e: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was at the standing place (Arafah), and I said, “O Messenger of Allah, I have come from the mountain of Tayy; I have worn out my riding mount and exhausted myself. By Allah, there was no mountain among those mountains except that I stood upon it.” He said: *"Whoever catches this prayer with us —that is, the morning prayer— and had come to Arafah before that, by night or day, has completed his Hajj and fulfilled his tafath."*[^1]
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke woh maukif (thehrne ki jagah) mein thay, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main Tayy pahaad se aaya hoon, maine apni sawari thaka di hai aur khud ko bhi thaka diya hai, Allah ki qasam, un pahaadon mein se koi aisa nahi bacha jispar main na thehra hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo humare sath yeh namaz, ya'ni subah ki namaz, paa le, aur isse pehle Arafah aa chuka ho, raat ya din mein, uska Hajj mukammal ho gaya aur usne apna tafas door kar liya."

e: "I saw the prophet in Arafat when some people from Najd coame to him. They told a man to ask him about Hajj. He said: "Hajj is Arafat. Whoever comes on the night of Jam (Al-Muzdalifah) before Subh prayer, then he has caought up with Hajj. And the days of Mina are three days. But whoever hastens to leave in two days, there is no sion on him, and whoever stays on, there is no sino on him.' Then he made a man ride behind him, and he started proclaiming it to the people." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3044)
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas Arafah mein aaya, aur Najd ke kuch log bhi unke paas aaye jabke woh Arafah mein the, unhone aap (SAW) se poocha, to aap (SAW) ne aik munaadi ko hukum diya, usne aelaan kiya: "Hajj Arafah hai, aur jo Jam' (Muzdalifah) ki raat Fajr se pehle aa jaaye, usne Mina ke din pa liye, teen din hain, jo do dinon mein jaldi kare uspar koi gunah nahi, aur jo der kare uspar bhi koi gunah nahi." Aur aap (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko apne peechhe bithaya jo yeh aelaan karta gaya.

e: [AI] The Quraysh used to only go from Muzdalifah and say, "We are exempt from leaving the sanctuary," even though they had left the standing place in Arafat. He ﷺ  said, "So I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the Jahiliyyah standing with the people in Arafat on a camel he had. Then he would spend the morning with his people in Muzdalifah, standing with them and pushing when they pushed."
hi: Quraish sirf Muzdalifah se hi rawaana hote the aur kehte the: "Hum Al-Khums (khaas/mumtaz) hain, isliye hum Haram se bahar nahi nikalte," aur unhone Arafah mein waqoof karna chhod diya tha. Unhone kaha: "To maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko jaahiliyat mein logon ke sath Arafah mein apne aik oont par khada dekha, phir woh apni qaum ke sath Muzdalifah mein subah karte aur unke sath thehrte, jab woh rawaana hote to unke sath rawaana hote."

e: There is no day when God sets free more servants from Hell than the Day of 'Arafa. He draws near, then praises them to the angels, saying: What do these want? (Using translation from Muslim 1348)
hi: Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki zaujah, se riwayat hai, ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi din aisa nahi jisme Allah Arafah ke din se zyada bandon ko aag se azaad karta ho, aur woh (Allah) qareeb hota hai, phir farishton par (unpar) fakhr karta hai aur kehta hai: 'Yeh log kya chahte hain?'"

e: [AI] "To me, Sir, what is wrong with people that I do not hear them respond?" So I said, "They fear Muawiyah." Then Ibn Abbas came out of his tent and said, "Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Indeed, they have abandoned the Sunnah out of hatred for Ali."
hi: "...Aye sardaar, kya baat hai ke main logon ko talbiyah kehte nahi sunta?" Maine kaha: "Woh Muawiyah (RA) se darte hain." Unhone kaha: to Ibn Abbas (RA) apne khaimay se nikle aur (buland awaz se) kaha: "Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik, beshak inhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se nafrat ki wajah se Sunnat chhod di hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood at Arafat, and when he said "Labbaik Allahumma labbaik", he said, "Verily, the best is the good of the Hereafter." Al-Bukhari narrated this with the chain of Ikrima, and Muslim narrated it with the chain of Dawud. This hadith is authentic and they both did not exclude it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Arafaat mein khade the, jab unhone kaha: "Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik," to farmaya: "Khair to bas aakhirat ki khair hai." Bukhari ne Ikrimah ko, aur Muslim ne Dawud ko, hujjat maana hai, aur yeh hadith sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Verily, Allah takes pride in the people of Arafat - the people of the heavens - and He says to them: Look at my servants who have come to me with disheveled hair and covered in dust."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Arafah walon par aasman walon ke saamne fakhr karta hai, aur unse kehta hai: 'Mere bandon ko dekho, mere paas bikhre baalon aur gard-o-ghubaar mein aaye hain.'"

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  recited it when he left from Arafat and he recited it with tranquility." And he said: "O People, upon you is tranquility." And he said: "Righteousness is not determined by the raising of horses and camels." And I did not see a camel raising its hand until it reached Mina."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne jab Arafah se rawaana huay to unhein apne peechhe bithaya, aur sakinah (itminaan/aaram) ke sath rawaana huay," aur farmaya: "Aye logo, sakinah (aaram) ikhtiyar karo," aur farmaya: "Neki ghodon aur oonton ko tez daudaane mein nahi," to maine unki oontni ka paon uthate huay nahi dekha yahan tak ke woh Mina pahunche.

e: [AI] "The Bedouins were the ones who used to camp on the outskirts of people's settlements. They would tie their camels and lean their sticks, and when they dismount, they would make a clattering sound, causing people to scatter. I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and even the hooves of his she-camel did not touch the ground as it walked. He used to say, 'O people, maintain tranquility!'"
hi: "Tezi (se chalne) ki shuruat gaon walon ki taraf se hui thi, woh logon ke kinaron par khade hote, apne bartan aur laathiyan latka rakhte, jab woh (Arafah se) rawaana hote to (unke saaman se) khadkhadaahat hoti, jisse log bidak jaate. Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, unki oontni ki gardan ka pichla hissa zameen ko chhu-chhu kar chal raha tha," aur woh farma rahe the: "Aye logo, sakinah (aaram) ikhtiyar karo."

e: "Ibn Abbas said: "On the morning of Al-Aqabah, while he was on his mount, the Messenger of Allah said to me: "Pick up (some pebbles) for me." So I picked up some pebbles for him that were the size of date stones or fingertips, and when I placed them in his hand he said: "Like these. And beware of going to extremes in religious matters, for those who came before you were destroyed because of going to extremes in religious matters." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3057)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Aqabah ki subah mujhse farmaya: "Mere liye chhote (khadf jaise) kankar chun kar laao." Jab woh unke haath mein rakhe gaye to farmaya: "Inhi jaisi, inhi jaisi (kankariyan maaro), aur deen mein ghuluww (had se aage badhna) se bacho, kyunke tumse pehle log deen mein ghuluww ki wajah se hi halaak huay."

e: [AI] Abu Ali Al-Hanafi and Abu Aasim Al-Nabeel said that Ayman Ibn Nabil said: I heard Qudamah Ibn Abdullah Ibn Ammar Al-Kalabi saying, "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stoning the Jamrah on the day of sacrifice while riding a white camel, without striking or driving the camel forcefully."
hi: Maine Qudamah bin Abdullah bin Ammar Al-Kilabi ko kehte hue suna: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko qurbani ke din, aik surkhi maayil oontni par, Jamrah ko kankariyan maarte dekha, na maarna tha, na hi (jaanwar ko) hankna, na 'hato, hato' (kehna)."

e:
*"When Ibrahim, the beloved friend of Allah, performed the rituals, Satan appeared to him at the Jamrat al-Aqabah and threw stones at him seven times until he sank into the ground. Then he appeared to him at the second Jamrah and threw stones at him seven times until he sank into the ground. Then he appeared to him at the third Jamrah and threw stones at him seven times until he sank into the ground."*

Ibn Abbas said, "You are stoning the Shaytan and boasting about the faith of your father."
hi: "Jab Ibrahim Khalilullah (AS) manaasik (Hajj ke ahkaam) ada karne aaye, to Shaitan unke saamne Jamrah Aqabah ke paas aaya, to unhone usse saat kankariyan maarin yahan tak ke woh zameen mein dhans gaya. Phir woh doosri Jamrah ke paas unke saamne aaya, to unhone usse saat kankariyan maarin yahan tak ke woh zameen mein dhans gaya. Phir woh teesri Jamrah ke paas unke saamne aaya, to unhone usse saat kankariyan maarin yahan tak ke woh zameen mein dhans gaya." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Tum Shaitan ko sang-saar (kankariyan maar) rahe ho aur apne baap (Ibrahim AS) ki millat ka izhaar kar rahe ho."

e: ‘I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, should we not build you a house in Mina?’ He said: ‘No, Mina is just a stopping place for those who get there first.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3006)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se kaha gaya: "Kya hum Mina mein aapke liye koi imarat na banayein jo aapko saaya de?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, Mina to us shakhs ke thehrne ki jagah hai jo pehle pahunche."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  gave as a gift a camel to Abu Jahl with a silver helmet on its head, in order to provoke the polytheists with it."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hudaibiyah ke saal apni qurbani ke jaanwaron mein Abu Jahl ka aik oont bhi qurbani ke liye bheja, jiske sar mein chandi ki aik naath (nakel) thi, taake ismein mushrikeen ko ghussa dilaaya jaaye."

e: The Prophet ﷺ sacrificed two horned rams which were white with black markings and had been castrated. When he made them face the qiblah, he said: I have turned my face towards Him. Who created the heavens and the earth, following Abraham's religion, the true in faith, and I am not one of the polytheists. My prayer, and my service of sacrifice, my life and my death are all for Allah, the Lord of the Universe, Who has no partner. That is what I was commanded to do, and I am one of the Muslims. O Allah it comes from Thee and is given to Thee from Muhammad and his people. In the name of Allah, and Allah is Most Great. He then made sacrifice. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2795)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Eid ke din do mendhe zibah kiye, jab unhein Qibla-rukh kiya to farmaya: "Maine apna chehra us Zaat ki taraf kar liya jisne aasmano aur zameen ko paida kiya, sidhe raaste par, aur main mushrikeen mein se nahi. Beshak meri namaz, meri qurbani, meri zindagi aur meri maut Allah, Rabb-ul-Aalameen, ke liye hai, uska koi shareek nahi, aur mujhe isi ka hukum diya gaya hai, aur main sabse pehle Musalman hoon. Bismillah, wallahu Akbar, Aye Allah, yeh tujhi se hai aur tujhi ke liye hai, Muhammad aur uski Ummat ki taraf se."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ slaughtered a cow on behalf of all his wives who had performed ‘Umrah, during the Farewell Pilgrimage.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3133)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein apni un biwiyon ki taraf se, jinhone Umrah kiya tha, unke darmiyan aik gaay zibah ki."

e: "I said to Al-Bara bin Azib: 'Tell me of the sacrificial animals that the Messenger of Allah dislike or forbade. He said: "The Messenger of Allah gestured like this with his hand, and my hands are shorter than the hand of the Messenger of Allah, (and he said). 'There are four that will not do as sacrifices: The animal that clearly has one bad eye: the sick animals that is obviously sick; the lame animal with an obvious lamp; and the animal that is so emaciated that it is as if there is no marrow in its bones: He said: "And I dislike that the animal should have some fault in its horns or ears." He said: "What you dislike, forget about it, and do not make it forbidden to anyone." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4370)
hi: Maine Al-Bara (RA) se kaha: "Mujhe woh baat bataiye jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne qurbani ke jaanwaron mein napasand ki ya jisse mana kiya." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne haath se yun (ishara) kiya - aur mera haath Rasulullah (SAW) ke haath se chhota hai - "Chaar (jaanwar) qurbani mein kaam nahi aate: woh kaani (aankh wali) jiska kaanapan zaahir ho, woh bimar jiski bimari zaahir ho, woh langdi jiska langdapan zaahir ho, aur woh dubli-patli jismein gooda (haddi ka masala) na ho." Maine kaha: "Mujhe kaan aur seeng mein kami bhi napasand hai." Unhone kaha: "Jo tumhein napasand ho, use chhod do, magar usse doosron par haram na karo."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited that an animal with a A'dab (stump) horn or ear should be slaughtered as a sacrifice." Qatadah (one of the narrators) said: "So I mentioned this to Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab and he said: 'The A'dab is that which equals or more than that.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1504)
hi: "Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne katay huay seeng aur kaan wale jaanwar ki qurbani se mana kiya." Qatadah ne kaha: to maine yeh baat Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab se zikr ki, unhone kaha: "Al-Adab (kaTaa hua) woh hai jo aadha ya usse zyada ho," aur usme se...

e: " The Messenger of Allah commanded us to examine the eyes and ears (of animals for sacrifice)." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4376)
hi: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ke hum (qurbani ke jaanwar ki) aankh aur kaan ko achhi tarah dekh len," aur usme se...

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to check the eyes and ears [when selecting an animal for sacrifice] (Using translation from Aḥmad 732)
hi: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein hukum diya tha ke hum (qurbani ke jaanwar ki) aankh aur kaan ko achhi tarah dekh len," aur usme se...

e:
[AI] "O Abu Al-Walid, indeed we left early in the morning to search for the remnants of the fallen prey, but we could hardly find anything to be gathered except that I found a fat thigh. Utbah said, "Why did you not bring it to us?" So, he invoked, "O Allah, forgive me for surpassing you while you do not surpass me." He said, "Yes." He said, "Why is that?" He said, "You doubt, while I do not doubt." Then, Utbah brought out his hand and said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade five things: the hunted animal with severed horns, the hunted bird with severed wings, the drowned fish, the dead mouse, and the broken egg." He said, "And the hunted animal with severed horns is the one whose horn is cut, the hunted bird with severed wings is the one whose wings are cut, the drowned fish is the one whose eyes are white, the dead mouse has visible traces of death, and the broken egg is the empty one or the one inhabited by illness that does not follow the flock."

Note: The translation provided is a general interpretation of the Arabic text and may not capture all the nuances and details of the original language.
hi: ...Utbah se: "Aye Abu Al-Waleed, hum abhi qurbani ke liye aik bakri dhoondne nikle the, lekin humein koi aisi cheez nahi mili jo poori tarah theek ho, siwaye is ke ke mujhe aik mote-taaze daant-tuti (bakri) mili." Utbah ne kaha: "To tum use kyun nahi le aaye?" Usne kaha: "Aye Allah, maghfirat farma, kya yeh tumhare liye jaayaz hai aur mere liye nahi?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Usne poocha: "Aisa kyun?" Unhone kaha: "Kyunke tumhein shak hai aur mujhe shak nahi." Unhone kaha: phir Utbah ne apna haath nikala aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne sirf paanch (aibon) se mana kiya tha: 'Al-Muwsilah' (jud kar milaayi hui seeng wali), 'Al-Musaffarah' (jad se kati hui kaan wali), 'Al-Bakhqa' (jiska kaanapan zaahir ho), 'Al-Mushayya'ah' (kamzor ya bimar jo bakriyon ke sath na chal sake), aur 'Al-Kasra' (tooti hui/langdi)." Unhone kaha: "Aur 'Al-Muwsilah' woh hai jiski seeng jad se ukhdi hui ho, aur 'Al-Musaffarah' woh hai jiski kaan jad se ukhdi hui ho, aur 'Al-Bakhqa' woh hai jiska kaanapan zaahir ho, aur 'Al-Mushayya'ah' woh kamzor ya bimar (bakri) hai jo bakriyon ke sath na chal sake."

e: The Prophet ﷺ sent Umm Salamah on the night before the day of sacrifice and she threw pebbles at the jamrah before dawn. She hastened (to Mecca) and performed the circumambulation. That day was the one the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spent with her. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1942)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne qurbani ki raat Umm Salamah (RA) ko (aage) bheja, unhone Fajr se pehle Jamrah ko kankariyan maarin, phir aage badh gayin aur (Tawaf-e-Ifadah ke liye) chali gayin, aur yeh woh doosra din tha jab Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas hote." Sahih, dono ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "If any of you go out, the last place of his vow should be the House (Kaaba), except for the menstruation. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  allowed it for them."
hi: "Jab tum mein se koi rawaana ho, to uska aakhri amal Ghar (Ka'bah) ki ziyarat ho, siwaye haiz waali auraton ke, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein rukhsat di hai."

e: Al Hajjaj bin ‘Amr Al Ansari reported the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ as saying “ If anyone breaks (a bone or leg) or becomes lame, he has come out of the sacred state and must perform Hajj the following year.” ‘Ikrimah said I asked Ibn ‘Abbas and Abu Hurairah about this. They replied He spoke the truth. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1862)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo (haddi) toot jaaye ya langda ho jaaye, uska ehraam khatam ho gaya, aur uspar agle saal Hajj (lazim) hai." Ikrimah ne kaha: to maine Abu Hurairah (RA) aur Ibn Abbas (RA) se poocha, dono ne kaha: "Sach kaha."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  performed two Hajj, one before his migration (to Medina), and one after he migrated, during which he also performed Umrah."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne hijrat se pehle do Hajj kiye, aur hijrat ke baad aik Hajj kiya jismein unhone Umrah bhi mila liya tha."

e: [AI] It says, "Indeed, Al-Aqra bin Habis asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ if Hajj is obligatory every year. He replied, 'No, rather it is obligatory once, and if I had said yes, it would have become obligatory, and if it had become obligatory, you would not have been able to afford it or bear it.'"
hi: Al-Aqra' bin Habis (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Kya Hajj har saal (farz) hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke sirf aik martaba, aur agar main 'haan' kehta to yeh farz ho jaata, aur agar farz ho jaata to tum na sun pate aur na hi taaqat rakhte."

e: Allah, Most High, has decreed Hajj for you. Al-Aqra' bin Habis At-Tamimi said: "Every year, O Messenger of Allah?" But he remained silent, then he said: "If I said yes, it would become obligatory, then you would not hear and obey. Rather it is just one Hajj." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2620)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye logo, tumpar Hajj farz kiya gaya hai." To Al-Aqra' bin Habis (RA) ne poocha: "Kya har saal, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Rasulullah (SAW) khamosh rahe, phir farmaya: "Nahi, balke sirf aik martaba, phir jo iske baad Hajj kare to woh nafl hai. Aur agar main 'haan' kehta to yeh tumpar farz ho jaata, phir tum na sun pate aur na hi taaqat rakhte."

e: [AI] "Hajj and Umrah are obligatory for all people except the people of Makkah. For them, their Umrah is their Tawaf (circumambulation), so they should leave for Tan'eem and then enter it (the Masjid al-Haram). By Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  never entered it except for Hajj or Umrah."
hi: "Hajj aur Umrah tamam logon par farz hain, siwaye Makkah walon ke, kyunke unka Umrah unka tawaaf hai, isliye unhein Tan'eem ki taraf nikalna chahiye phir (ehraam bandh kar) dobara dakhil hona chahiye, kyunke Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah mein sirf Haji ya Mu'tamir (Umrah karne wale) ki haisiyat se hi dakhil huay."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Hajj and Umrah are obligatory acts of worship, and it does not harm you which of them you start with." And it is confirmed from Zaid ibn Thabit that he said.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Hajj aur Umrah dono farz hain, tumhein koi nuqsaan nahi ke tum in mein se kis se shuru karo." Aur sahih baat yeh hai ke yeh Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ka apna qaul hai.

e: [AI] "Two prayers, whichever of the two you start with will not harm you."
hi: "Do namazein, tumhein koi nuqsaan nahi ke tum in mein se kis se shuru karo."

e: [AI] Abdullah bin Umar used to say, "There is not a person among Allah's creation except that upon him is an obligatory Hajj and Umrah, for those who are able to do so. Whoever does more than that, it is better and considered voluntary."
hi: Ke Abdullah bin Umar (RA) kaha karte the: "Allah ki makhlooq mein koi aisa nahi jispar Hajj aur Umrah dono farz na hon, jo iski taaqat rakhta ho, aur jo iske baad kuch aur (nafl) kare, to yeh behtar aur nafl hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said to her during her pilgrimage, "You will receive reward according to the effort and the expenses you incurred."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse, unke Umrah ke baare mein, farmaya: "Tumhara ajr tumhari mehnat aur tumhare kharch ke mutabiq hai."

e: [AI] The translation of the provided Arabic sentence into English is: "The Prophet ﷺ  said to her during her pilgrimage, 'Your reward for the pilgrimage is based on the extent of your spending.'"
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne unse, unke Umrah ke baare mein, farmaya: "Tumhara ajr tumhare Umrah mein tumhare kharch ke mutabiq hi hai."

e: [AI] Ali and Uthman performed Hajj. When they were on the way, Uthman prohibited himself from performing Umrah before Hajj. It was said to Ali that he prohibited them from performing Umrah, so Ali said, "If you see him depart, then depart." So Ali and his companions performed Umrah without being prohibited by Uthman. Ali said, "Did I not inform you that he prohibits performing Umrah?" Uthman replied, "Yes." Ali then said, "Did you not hear the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, permitting it?" Uthman replied, "Yes."
hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Uthman (RA) ne Hajj kiya, jab woh raaste mein kahin thay to Uthman (RA) ne Umrah ko Hajj ke sath jodne (Tamattu') se mana kiya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha gaya ke unhone Tamattu' se mana kiya hai, to unhone farmaya: "Jab tum dekho ke woh (Uthman) kooch kar gaye hain, to tum bhi kooch kar jaana." To Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur unke saathiyon ne Umrah ka talbiyah kaha, aur Uthman (RA) ne unhein mana nahi kiya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Kya mujhe khabar nahi di gayi thi ke aap Umrah ko Hajj ke sath jodne se mana karte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi." To Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko Tamattu' karte hue nahi suna?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi."

e: “Labbaika bi-‘Umratin wa hajjatin [Here I am (O Allah), for ‘Umrah and Hajj].” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2969)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Labbaik bi-Hajjatin wa Umratin ma'an' (Main haazir hoon, Hajj aur Umrah donon ke liye ikathe)."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  combined Hajj and Umrah because he knew that he would not perform Hajj again after that.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne sirf isliye Hajj aur Umrah ko jama kiya kyunke unhein ilm tha ke iske baad woh Hajj nahi karenge."

e: “I was sitting with Ibn ‘Abbas, and a man came to him and he said: ‘Where have you come from?’ He said: ‘From Zamzam.’ He said: ‘Did you drink from it as you should?’ He said: ‘How is that?’ He said: ‘When you drink from it, turn to face the Qiblah and mention the name of Allah, drink three draughts and drink your fill of it. When you have finished, then praise Allah.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The sign (that differentiates) between us and the hypocrites is that they do not drink their fill from Zamzam.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3061)
hi: "Jab tum ismein se piyo, to Qibla-rukh ho jao, Allah ka naam lo, teen saans lo, aur jitna pi sako piyo, jab tum farigh ho jao to Allah ki hamd karo, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Humare aur munafiqeen ke darmiyan aik nishani yeh hai ke woh Zamzam se pait bhar kar nahi peete.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The water of Zamzam is for whatever purpose it is drunk for. If you drink it to alleviate illness, Allah will heal you, and if you drink it seeking refuge, Allah will protect you, and if you drink it to quench your thirst, Allah will satisfy it." Ibn Abbas used to say when he drank the water of Zamzam, "O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and healing from all ailments."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zamzam ka paani jis maqsad se piya jaaye, usi ke liye hai, agar tum ise shifa ke liye piyo to Allah tumhein shifa dega, aur agar tum ise panah maangte huay piyo to Allah tumhein panah dega, aur agar tum ise apni pyaas bujhaane ke liye piyo to woh bujh jayegi." Unhone kaha: aur Ibn Abbas (RA) jab Zamzam ka paani peete to kehte: "Aye Allah, main tujhse nafa'-bakhsh ilm, wasee' rizq, aur har bimari se shifa maangta hoon."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  prostrated on the stone."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne pathhar (Hajr-e-Aswad) par sajda kiya."

e: "I heard Abu Umamah saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah giving a Khutbah during the Farewell Hajj, and he said: 'Have Taqwa of your Lord, and pray your five (prayers), and fast your month, and pay the Zakat on your wealth, and obey thosewho are in charge of you, you will enter the Paradise of your Lord.'" He said: "I said to Abu Umamah: 'How old were you when you heard this Hadith (from the Messenger of Allah)?' He said: 'I heard it when I was thirty years old.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 616)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna, jab woh apni katti-kaan wali oontni par Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein logon ko khutba de rahe thay: "Aye logo, apne Rab ki itaa'at karo, apni paanch (namazein) padho, apne maal ki zakat ada karo, apna mahina (Ramzan ka) roza rakho, aur apne hukmaraan ki itaa'at karo, tum apne Rab ki Jannat mein dakhil ho jaoge." Maine Abu Umamah (RA) se poocha: "Aapne yeh hadith kitni umar mein suni thi?" Unhone kaha: "Maine ise suna jab main tees (30) saal ka tha."

e: [AI] The number of people in the camp became numerous, so we went out as pilgrims, until there was no time for us to do anything other than a few nights. We were commanded to enter the state of Ihram, so one of us would go to Arafat, and his semen would drip. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was informed of this, so he stood and delivered a sermon, saying, "By Allah, you people should teach me! For I am the one who knows Allah the best among you and fears Him the most. If I have known that I will face what you are facing now, I would have prepared better. I have not brought the sacrificial animals with me and I have not still made my sacrificial rites. So whoever does not have an animal for sacrifice, let him fast for three days during Hajj and seven days after returning home. And whoever finds an animal, let him sacrifice it. We used to sacrifice the jazoor for seven people."
hi: Logon mein baatein badh gayin, to hum Hajj ke liye nikle, yahan tak ke jab humare aur ehraam khatam karne ke darmiyan sirf chand raaten reh gayin, to humein ehraam khatam karne ka hukum diya gaya, to hum mein se koi Arafah ki taraf jaata jabke uske aalaat se abhi bhi mani (jima ke asraat) tapak rahe hote. Yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) khade huay aur khutba diya, farmaya: "Kya tum mujhe Allah (ke ahkaam) sikhaate ho, aye logo? Allah ki qasam, main tum mein Allah ko sabse zyada jaanne wala aur usse sabse zyada darne wala hoon. Agar mera pehla maamla dobara aata jaisa akhir mein hua, to main qurbani ka jaanwar sath na laata aur waise hi ehraam khatam kar leta jaise unhone kiya, isliye jiske paas qurbani ka jaanwar na ho, woh teen din (Hajj mein) aur saat din apne ghar wapas jaane ke baad roza rakhe, aur jise qurbani ka jaanwar mile, woh use zibah kare." To hum aik oont saat aadmiyon ki taraf se zibah karte the.

e: [AI] "He said, 'When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw the pebbles at the Jamrah (stone pillars), and slaughtered his sacrificial animal, and had his head shaved by the right side of his head, then he had his head shaved by the left side, and then he instructed Abu Talha to distribute it among the people.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Jamrah ko kankariyan maarin aur apna qurbani ka jaanwar zibah kiya, to unhone haajaam ko apna dayan hissa diya, usne use mundwaya, phir unhone bayan hissa diya, usne use bhi mundwaya, phir unhone Abu Talha (RA) ko diya aur hukum diya ke woh ise logon mein taqseem karein."

e: [AI] His father was present with the Prophet ﷺ  at Al-Manhar during the Hajj pilgrimage. The Prophet ﷺ  shaved his head and gave his father a portion of his hair. He also cut his nails and gave them to his companion. They said, "Indeed, he is with us and has applied henna and kohl."
hi: Ke unke waalid, aur Ansar ka aik shakhs, Nabi (SAW) ke sath nahar (qurbani ki jagah) mein hazir thay, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne kapde mein apna sar mundwaya, phir unhein de diya, unhone usme se kuch aadmiyon mein taqseem kiya, aur apne naakhoon kaate aur apne saathi ko de diye. Unhone kaha: "Yeh humare paas hina aur katam (rang) se rangi hui hai."

e: Ibn Umar reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ observed the circumambulation of Ifada on the Day of Nabr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja), and then came back and observed the noon prayer at Mina. Nafi' (one of the narrators) said that Ibn Umar used to observe the circumambulation of Ifada on the Day of Nahr, and then return and observe the noon prayer at Mina, and mentioned that Allah's Apostle ﷺ did that. (Using translation from Muslim 1308)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne qurbani ke din Tawaaf-e-Ifadah kiya, phir wapas aa kar Zuhr ki namaz Mina mein padhi." Nafi' ne kaha: aur Ibn Umar (RA) "qurbani ke din Tawaaf-e-Ifadah karte, phir wapas aa kar Zuhr ki namaz Mina mein padhte," aur zikr karte ke Nabi (SAW) ne bhi aisa hi kiya tha.

e: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ did not walk quickly (Ramal) during the seven circuits of Tawaful-Ifadah (done on 10th day of Dhul-Hijjah). (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3060)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne un saat chakkaron mein ramal (tez chaal) nahi ki jinme unhone Tawaaf-e-Ifadah kiya tha." Ata' ne kaha: "Ismein koi ramal nahi."

e: Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to the drinking place and asked for water. Al-Abbas said, "O Fadl! Go to your mother and bring water from her for Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Give me water to drink." Al-Abbas said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! The people put their hands in it." Messenger of Allah ﷺ again said, 'Give me water to drink. So, he drank from that water and then went to the Zamzam (well) and there the people were offering water to the others and working at it (drawing water from the well). The Prophet ﷺ then said to them, "Carry on! You are doing a good deed." Then he said, "Were I not afraid that other people would compete with you (in drawing water from Zamzam), I would certainly take the rope and put it over this (i.e. his shoulder) (to draw water)." On saying that the Prophet ﷺ pointed to his shoulder. (Using translation from Bukhārī 1635)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) siqayah (paani pilaane ki jagah) ke paas aaye aur paani maanga, to Abbas (RA) ne kaha: 'Aye Fadl, apni maa ke paas jao aur unke paas se Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye sharbat le aao.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mujhe pilao.' Unhone kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), log ismein apne haath daal dete hain.' Aap (SAW) ne (dobara) farmaya: 'Mujhe pilao,'" to aap (SAW) ne usse piya, phir Zamzam ki taraf aaye jabke log wahan paani nikaal rahe the aur kaam kar rahe the, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaam karo, kyunke tum aik nek amal par ho," phir farmaya: "Agar mujhe darr na hota ke tum maghloob ho jaoge, to main zaroor utarta yahan tak ke main is (kandhe) par rassi rakh leta," ya'ni apna kandha, aur aap (SAW) ne apne kandhe ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "The game of the land is lawful for you while you are forbidden from what you have not hunted or has been hunted for you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khushki ke shikaar ka gosht tumhare liye halal hai jabke tum ehraam mein ho, jab tak tum khud usska shikaar na karo ya tumhare liye shikaar na kiya jaaye."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , regarding his words, the hadith of Sulaiman ibn Bilal.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Rahi baat Sulaiman bin Bilal ki hadith ki...

e: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 99)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: [AI] "People used to dislike returning from Mina due to their physical appearance. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered them to make their last act in Mina by circling the Kaaba and then granted permission for menstruating women."
hi: "Log Mina se apne apne rukh ki taraf seedhe rawaana ho jaate the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke unka aakhri amal Ghar (Ka'bah) se ho, aur unhone haiz waali auraton ko rukhsat di."

e: [AI] We said, "O Messenger of Allah, these are the stones that you throw and they are carried, and it seems as if they are sinking." He said, "Indeed, whatever is accepted from it is lifted up, and if it were not for that, you would have seen it like mountains."
hi: Humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh kankariyan jo tum maarte ho, kya inhein uthaya jaata hai, aur kya tumhein lagta hai ke yeh zameen mein dhans jaati hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo (kankariyan) qubool ki jaati hain, unhein utha liya jaata hai, aur agar aisa na hota to tum unhein pahaadon jitna dekhte."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: "When one of you completes his pilgrimage, he should direct his journey towards his family, for indeed it is the greatest in reward."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apna Hajj mukammal kar le, to woh apne ghar walon ki taraf safar ikhtiyar kare, kyunke iska ajr zyada hai."

e: [AI] "Gabriel came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and took him to show him the rituals. A slit opened for him, and he entered Mina. He saw the Jamrat Al-Aqaba (stone pillars) and then saw Arafat. The devil intercepted the Prophet ﷺ  at the Jamrat, so he pelted him with seven pebbles until he disappeared. Then he intercepted him at the second Jamrat and pelted him with seven pebbles until he disappeared. Then he intercepted him at the Jamrat Al-Aqaba and he pelted him with seven pebbles until he disappeared. And that's how it ended."
hi: "Jibra'il (AS) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein le gaye taake unhein manaasik (Hajj ke ahkaam) dikhaayen, Thabir (pahaad) unke liye phat gaya, to woh Mina mein dakhil huay, unhein Jamraat dikhaayen, phir unhein Arafaat dikhaya. Shaitan Nabi (SAW) ke saamne Jamrah ke paas aaya, to usse saat kankariyan maari gayin yahan tak ke woh dhans gaya, phir woh doosri Jamrah mein unke saamne aaya, to unhone usse saat kankariyan maarin yahan tak ke woh dhans gaya, phir woh Jamrah Aqabah mein unke saamne aaya, to unhone usse saat kankariyan maarin yahan tak ke woh dhans gaya aur chala gaya."

e: [AI] The translation of the given text into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to throw pebbles on the day of sacrifice before noon, but afterwards, he did it at noon."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) qurbani ke din zawaal (dopahar) se pehle kankariyan maarte the, magar uske baad (dinon mein) zawaal ke waqt."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the obligatory circumambulation of the Ka'bah at the end of the day of sacrifice after he had offered the noon prayer. He hen returned to Mina and stayed there during the tashriq days and he threw pebbles at the jamrahs when the sun declined. He threw seven pebbles at each of the jamrahs, uttering the takbir (Allah is most great) at the time of the throwing the pebble. He stood at the first and the second jamrah, and prolonged his standing there, making supplications with humilation. He threw pebbles at the third jamrah but did not stand there. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1973)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne (qurbani ke) din ke aakhir mein Tawaaf-e-Ifadah kiya, jab unhone Zuhr ki namaz padh li, phir wapas aaye aur tashreeq ke dinon ki raaton mein Mina mein thehre, jab suraj dhal jata to Jamrah ko kankariyan maarte, har Jamrah ko saat kankariyan, har kankari ke sath takbeer kehte, pehli aur doosri Jamrah ke paas thehr kar der tak khade rehte aur gidgidaate, phir teesri ko kankariyan maarte magar usske paas nahi thehrte."

e: Whenever Messenger of Allah ﷺ stoned the Jamra near Mina Mosque, he would do Ramy of it with seven small pebbles and say Takbir on throwing each pebble. Then he would go ahead and stand facing the Qiblah with his hands raised, and invoke (Allah) and he sued to stand for a long period. Then he would come to the second Jamra (Al-Wusta) and stone it will seven small stones, reciting Takbir on throwing each stone. Then he would stand facing the Qiblah with raised hands to invoke (Allah). Then he would come to the Jamra near the 'Aqaba (Jamrat-ul-'Aqaba) and do Ramy of it with seven small pebbles, reciting Takbir on throwing each stone. he then would leave and not stay by it. Narrated Az-Zuhri: I heard Salim bin 'Abdullah saying the same that his father said on the authority of the Prophet ﷺ. And Ibn 'Umar used to do the same. (Using translation from Bukhārī 1753)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab Mina ki masjid ke qareeb wali Jamrah ko kankariyan maarte to usse saat kankariyan maarte, har kankari maarte waqt takbeer kehte, phir uske aage badh kar Qibla-rukh khade hote, apne haath uthaakar dua karte, aur der tak khade rehte, phir doosri Jamrah ke paas aate aur usse saat kankariyan maarte, har kankari maarte waqt takbeer kehte, phir bayin taraf wadi ki jaanib utarte aur Qibla-rukh khade hokar apne haath uthate, phir Aqabah wali Jamrah ke paas aate aur usse saat kankariyan maarte, har kankari ke sath takbeer kehte, phir chale jate aur usske paas nahi thehrte." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: maine Salim bin Abdullah ko isi jaisi baat apne walid se, Nabi (SAW) se, bayan karte suna, unhone kaha: "Aur Ibn Umar (RA) isi ko qubool karte the."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  allowed the shepherds to let their animals graze one day and to withhold them another day." Abu Al-Baddah is the son of Asim ibn Adi and he is famous among the followers (of the Prophet). Asim ibn Adi is famous among the companions and he is the companion of the Li'an (a legal punishment in Islam). So whoever speaks about Abu Al-Baddah ibn Adi, it is because of his lineage to his grandfather and the authenticity of what I mentioned."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne charwahon ko rukhsat di ke woh Jamraat ko aik din kankariyan maarein aur aik din chhod dein." Abu Al-Baddah, Aasim bin Adi (RA) ke bete hain, aur woh Tabi'in mein mash-hoor hain, aur Aasim bin Adi (RA) Sahaba mein mash-hoor hain, aur woh Li'aan (qasam khakar aik doosre par ilzaam lagaane) ke waaqi'e wale hain, isliye jo bhi Abu Al-Baddah bin Adi kehta hai, usne ise uske dada ki taraf mansoob kiya hai, aur jo maine bayan kiya woh sahih hai.

e: On the authority of his father 'Asim: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave permission to the herdsmen of the camels not to pass night at Mina and asked them to throw pebbles on the day of sacrifice, and to throw pebbles at the jamrahs the next day and the following two days, and on the day of their return. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1975)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne oont charane walon ko raat guzarne (Mina mein) ki chhoot di, woh qurbani ke din kankariyan maarte, phir agle din ya usse agle din, do dinon ki, kankariyan maarte, phir rawaangi ke din kankariyan maarte."

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) perform the Asr prayer with two Raka'at (units) while sitting."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Al-Abtah mein Asr ki namaz do rak'aton mein padhte dekha."

e: [AI] Aisha used to say that it is amazing for a Muslim when he enters the Kaaba that he raises his gaze towards the ceiling, as a sign of reverence and magnification for Allah. "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered the Kaaba and his gaze did not leave the place of his prostration until he left it."
hi: Ke Aisha (RA) kaha karti thin: "Ta'ajjub hai us Musalman aadmi par jo Ka'bah mein dakhil ho aur apni nazar chhat ki taraf uthaaye, use Allah ki azmat aur ta'zeem ki khatir aisa nahi karna chahiye." "Rasulullah (SAW) Ka'bah mein dakhil huay, unki nazar apni sajda ki jagah se nahi hati yahan tak ke woh usse bahar nikle."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out delighted, then he came back to me sad. I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, (why did) you go out happy and come back sad?’ He said: ‘I entered the Ka’bah, and I wish that I had not done that, because I am afraid that I may have caused difficulty for my nation after I am gone.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3064)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas se nikle, aankh thandi (khush) aur dil khush karte huay, phir mere paas wapas aaye to woh ghamgeen the, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap mere paas se aise-aise (khush) nikle the?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Ka'bah mein dakhil hua tha, aur mujhe kaash aisa na kiya hota, mujhe darr hai ke maine apne baad apni Ummat ke liye mushkil paida kar di ho."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  entered the house, and when he came out, he performed two raka'ahs (units of prayer) facing the direction of the house and said, 'This is the qibla (direction of prayer).'"
hi: "Nabi (SAW) Ghar (Ka'bah) mein dakhil huay, jab bahar nikle to Ghar ke saamne do rak'atein padhi aur farmaya: 'Yehi Qibla hai.'"

e: [AI] To Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her), the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Aisha, if it were not for the fact that your people have recent memories of ignorance, I would have demolished the Kaaba and rebuilt it on the foundation that was laid by Ibrahim (Abraham). For they were unable to afford the expenses of its rebuilding, and I would have added two doors to it, one facing east and one facing west, and I would have attached it to the ground, unlike its current construction." Ibn Zubayr called for the demolition and construction of the Kaaba, and Yazid bin Ruman witnessed its demolition. He extracted the foundation of the Kaaba like disconnected blocks and I asked Yazid bin Ruman, while I was walking with him, to show me what they had taken out from the Kaaba's structure. He said, "I will show it to you now." When he finished the demolition, he said, "This is the spot." Jarir (bin Abdullah Al-Bajali) said, "I estimated it to be about six cubits away."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aye Aisha, agar tumhari qaum jaahiliyat se abhi abhi (nikli) na hoti, to main Ghar (Ka'bah) ko gira deta yahan tak ke usme woh (hissa) shaamil kar deta jo unhone Hijr mein se nikaal diya tha, kyunke woh iske kharch (ki taaqat) se aajiz aa gaye the, aur main iske do darwaze bana deta, aik mashriq ki taraf aur aik maghrib ki taraf, aur ise zameen se mila deta, aur ise Ibrahim (AS) ki buniyaad par rakh deta." Unhone kaha: to yehi baat thi jisne Ibn Az-Zubair (RA) ko ise girane aur (dobara) tameer karne par uksaaya. Yazid bin Rouman ne kaha: main Ibn Az-Zubair (RA) ke sath us waqt maujood tha jab unhone ise giraya, unhone Ghar ki buniyaad Bukht (oont ki nasl) ki koohaano jaisi, aik doosre se mili hui, nikaali. Maine Yazid bin Rouman se kaha, jabke main us din unke sath tawaaf kar raha tha: "Mujhe dikhaao unhone Hijr mein se kya nikaala tha." Unhone kaha: "Abhi dikhaata hoon." Jab woh wahan pahunche to kaha: "Yeh jagah hai." Jarir (RA) ne kaha: to maine iska andaaza taqreeban chhah haath lagaya.

e: [AI] "He informed him that the Prophet ﷺ  shaved his head during the farewell Hajj. So people used to shave their heads during Hajj and then perform Umrah along with the departing caravan, and they would ask why they were shaving their heads. He would reply, 'Pass on the statement of Musa (Moses) on your head.'"
hi: Unhein khabar di ke Nabi (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein apna sar mundwaya. Unhone kaha: to log Hajj mein (sar) mundwate, phir rawaangi ke waqt Umrah karte, aur poochte: "Yeh kis (maqsad) se mundwaya ja raha hai?" To jawaab milta: "Apne sar par ustra pheron."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  consummated his marriage with Aisha during the month of Dhul-Hijjah, on the night of the Pebble Stoning (of Jamrat al-Aqaba)."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Aisha (RA) ko Zul-Hijjah mein, Al-Hasbah ki raat, Tan'eem se Umrah karwaya."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was approached by a man who said, "My father is an elderly man who embraced Islam but has not performed Hajj. He does not have a transportation and if I were to tie him with a rope to a mount for the journey, I fear that it may cause him harm." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Perform Hajj on behalf of your father."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik shakhs aaya aur kaha: "Mere waalid boodhe hain, unhone Islam paaya lekin Hajj nahi kar sake, aur woh sawari par nahi baith sakte, aur agar main unhein rassi se sawari par bandhun to mujhe darr hai ke kahin unhein nuqsaan na pahunche." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne waalid ki taraf se Hajj karo."

e: “O Messenger of Allah, my father is an old man and he cannot perform Hajj or ‘Umrah, and he is not able to ride the mount (due to old age).” He said: “Perform Hajj and ‘Umrah on behalf of your father.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2906)
hi: Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere waalid boodhe hain, na Hajj ki taaqat rakhte hain na Umrah ki, na hi safar ki." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne waalid ki taraf se Hajj aur Umrah karo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "If a young boy performs Hajj, it is Hajj for him until he reaches the age of understanding. And when he reaches the age of understanding, he must perform another Hajj. And if an Arab performs Hajj, it is Hajj for him. And if he migrates, he must perform another Hajj."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab koi bachcha Hajj kare, to yeh uske liye Hajj shumaar hoga jab tak woh baaligh na ho jaaye, aur jab woh baaligh ho jaaye to uspar aik aur Hajj hoga, aur jab koi dehati Hajj kare, to yeh uske liye Hajj shumaar hoga, phir jab woh hijrat kare to uspar aik aur Hajj hoga."

e: [AI] "I have hired myself out to a group, so I left some of my earnings for them to take charge of the rituals. Will that be sufficient on my part?" Ibn Abbas replied, "This is among those about whom Allah, Almighty, said, 'For them is a share of what they have earned, and Allah is swift in account.' [Al-Baqarah 202]."
hi: "Maine apne aap ko aik qaum ke liye kiraaye par diya, aur unke liye apni kuch mazdoori chhod di taake woh mujhe manaasik (Hajj ke ahkaam) ke darmiyan azaad chhod dein, kya yeh mere liye kaafi hai?" To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh un logon mein se hai jinke baare mein Allah ne farmaya: '{Unhi ke liye hissa hai jo unhone kamaya, aur Allah jald hisaab lene wala hai}' (Surah Al-Baqarah 202)."

e: The people used to trade, in the beginning, at Mina, Arafat, the market place of Dhul-Majaz, and during the season of hajj. But (later on) they became afraid of trading while they were putting on ihram. So Allah, glory be to Him, sent down this verse: "It is no sin for you that you seek the bounty of your Lord during the seasons of hajj." Ubayd ibn Umayr told me that he (Ibn Abbas) used to recite this verse in his codex. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1734)
hi: Log Hajj ke shuru daur mein Mina, Arafah, Zul-Majaz ke bazaar aur Hajj ke mausamon mein khareed-o-farokht kiya karte the, phir unhein ehraam ki halat mein tijarat karne se darr laga, to Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "{Tumpar koi gunah nahi ke tum apne Rab ka fazl talaash karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 198), Hajj ke mausamon mein.

e: [AI] "I have indeed seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  before the revelation (of Prophethood) came to him, and indeed he was standing on a camel in Arafat with the people, pushing it along with them. And that was only by the facilitation from Allah Almighty."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko, wahi nazil hone se pehle, dekha ke woh apne aik oont par Arafaat mein logon ke sath khade the, unke sath rawaana ho rahe the, aur yeh Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ki taraf se unke liye khaas taufeeq ke ilawa kuch na tha."

e: [AI] From his father, he narrated about mentioning Al-Hums, that indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to stand in Arafah, Makkah.
hi: Unke waalid se, Al-Hums ke zikr wali hadith mein, ke Rasulullah (SAW) Arafah, Makkah mein waqoof karte the.

e: [AI] Marwan sent to Umm Maqil to ask her about this narration. She narrated that her husband made a vow to perform Jihad in the way of Allah, and she intended to perform Umrah. She asked her husband, who refused her request. So she came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and mentioned this to him. The Prophet ﷺ  ordered him to give her what she requested and said, "Verily, Hajj and Umrah are from the ways of Allah, and verily, performing Umrah in Ramadan is equal to performing Hajj, or it is sufficient for Hajj."
hi: Marwan ne Umm Maqil (RA) ke paas (qaasid) bheja taake unse is hadith ke baare mein poocha jaaye, to unhone bataya ke unke shohar ne aik jawaan oont Allah ki raah mein waqf kar diya tha, aur unhone Umrah karne ka irada kiya, to apne shohar se woh jawaan oont maanga, unhone unhein mana kar diya. To woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayin aur unhein yeh baat batayi, Nabi (SAW) ne unke shohar ko hukum diya ke woh unhein (woh oont) de dein, aur farmaya: "Beshak Hajj aur Umrah Allah ki raah mein se hain, aur beshak Ramzan mein Umrah karna Hajj ke barabar hai," ya "Hajj ke liye kaafi hai."

e: “Hajjaj bin ‘Amr Ansari narrated to me, he said: ‘I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Whoever breaks a bone or becomes lame, has exited Ihram, but he must perform another Hajj.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3077)
hi: Ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko sunaa: "Jo (haddi) toot jaaye ya langda ho jaaye, uska ehraam khatam ho gaya, aur uspar aik aur Hajj (lazim) hai." Unhone kaha: to maine yeh baat Ibn Abbas (RA) aur Abu Hurairah (RA) ko bataayi, dono ne kaha: "Sach kaha."

e: Al Hajjaj bin ‘Amr Al Ansari reported the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ as saying “ If anyone breaks (a bone or leg) or becomes lame, he has come out of the sacred state and must perform Hajj the following year.” ‘Ikrimah said I asked Ibn ‘Abbas and Abu Hurairah about this. They replied He spoke the truth. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1862)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo (haddi) toot jaaye ya langda ho jaaye, uska ehraam khatam ho gaya, aur uspar agle saal Hajj (lazim) hai." Ikrimah ne kaha: to maine yeh baat Ibn Abbas (RA) aur Abu Hurairah (RA) ko bataayi, dono ne kaha: "Al-Hajjaj (RA) ne sach kaha."

e: [AI] The Quraysh used to call for al-Hums (a form of idol worship) and they would enter from the doors during the pilgrimage. The Ansar and the rest of the Arabs would not enter from the doors during the pilgrimage. While the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was in a garden, he came out of its door and Qutbah ibn Amir al-Ansari came out with him. They said, "O Messenger of Allah, Qutbah ibn Amir is an immoral man, and he came out with you from the door." He said, "What made you say that?" He said, "I saw you do it, so I did it as well." He said, "I am performing al-Hums." He said, "My religion is your religion." So, Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, revealed: "It is not righteousness that you enter houses from the back, but righteousness is [in] one who fears Allah." [Quran 2:189]
hi: "Quraish 'Al-Hums' kehlaate the, aur woh ehraam mein darwazon se dakhil hote the, jabke Ansar aur baaqi Arab ehraam mein darwazon se dakhil nahi hote the. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) aik baagh mein thay, to aap (SAW) uske darwaze se nikle, aur Qutbah bin Amir Al-Ansari (RA) unke sath nikle, to logon ne kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Qutbah bin Amir aik fasiq shakhs hai, woh aapke sath darwaze se nikla.'" Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein isse yeh karne par kis cheez ne ubhaara?" Unhone kaha: "Maine aapko aisa karte dekha, to maine bhi waisa hi kiya jaisa aapne kiya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Ahmasi (Al-Hums mein se) hoon." Unhone kaha: "Mera deen aapka hi deen hai." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "{Neki yeh nahi ke tum gharon mein unki peeth ki taraf se aao, balke neki to yeh hai ke jo taqwa ikhtiyar kare, aur gharon mein unke darwazon se dakhil ho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 189).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked, "What is the righteousness of Hajj?" He said, "Feeding the food and speaking good words."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Hajj ki neki kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khana khilaana aur achhi baat karna."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wanted to perform Hajj, so a woman said to her husband, "Let me go for Hajj with the Messenger of Allah." He replied, "I do not have anything to perform Hajj with." She said, "Take me with you on your camel." He responded, "That is what I am anticipating for myself and our child." She said, "Take me with you on your riding animal." He said, "That is what is needed in the way of Allah." She said, "Then sell your dates and raisins." He said, "That is our sustenance, yours and mine."
