When the Prophet ﷺ  returned from Makkah, the woman sent a message to him, saying, "Peace be upon you, Messenger of Allah. Please ask him (her husband) what credits a Hajj with you." Her husband went to the Prophet and said, "O Messenger of Allah, my wife sends greetings to you, and she said that she asked me to take her for Hajj with you. I told her I do not have anything. Then she said, 'Take me on my riding animal.' I responded, 'That is what is needed in the way of Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'If you had taken her, you would have been rewarded for performing Hajj in the way of Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ  then laughed in astonishment at her eagerness to perform Hajj." He (the husband) continued, "She also requested me to ask you what is equivalent to a Hajj with you." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Tell her peace and mercy from me, and inform her that performing Umrah in Ramadan is equivalent to a Hajj with me."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hajj ka irada kiya, to aik aurat ne apne shohar se kaha: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hajj karwao." Usne kaha: "Mere paas kuch nahi jisse main tumhein Hajj karwaun." Usne kaha: "Mujhe apni paani dhone wali oontni par Hajj karwao." Usne kaha: "Woh to main aur tumhara beta bari-bari istemal karte hain." Usne kaha: "To mujhe apne fulan oont par Hajj karwao." Usne kaha: "Woh to Allah ki raah mein waqf hai." Usne kaha: "To apne ghulam ki khajoor bech do." Usne kaha: "Woh to mera aur tumhara khuraak hai." Unhone kaha: jab Nabi (SAW) Makkah se wapas aaye to usne apne shohar ko unke paas bheja, kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko mera salaam kehna aur unse poochna ke unke sath Hajj karne ke barabar kya hai?" To uska shohar Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), meri biwi aapko salaam aur Allah ki rahmat bhejti hai, aur usne kaha tha ke main use aapke sath Hajj karwaun, to maine usse kaha ke mere paas kuch nahi. Usne kaha: 'To mujhe apne fulan oont par Hajj karwao,' maine usse kaha: 'Woh to Allah ki raah mein waqf hai.'" Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum use usi par Hajj karwaate, to yeh Allah ki raah mein hi hota." Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) uski Hajj ki chaahat par ta'ajjub karte huay hanse. Usne kaha: "Aur usne mujhe hukum diya ke main aapse poochun ke aapke sath Hajj karne ke barabar kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usse mera salaam aur Allah ki rahmat kehna, aur usse bata dena ke Ramzan mein Umrah mere sath Hajj karne ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet of Allah ﷺ  ordered the people during the Farewell Pilgrimage, saying, "Whoever desires to perform Umrah before Hajj, then he should do so."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida' ke saal logon ko hukum diya aur farmaya: "Jo Hajj se pehle Umrah ke sath wapas jaana pasand kare, woh aisa kar le."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed three rounds of circumambulation (Tawaf) and walked four times between Safa and Marwa when he arrived for Hajj and Umrah when he performed 'Umrah.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hajj aur Umrah ke liye pahunchne par sa'i mein teen chakkar daudkar aur chaar chakkar chalkar lagaye."

e: “We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for Hajj in three ways. Some of us began the Talbiyah for Hajj and ‘Umrah together, some of us began the Talbiyah for Hajj on its own, and some of us began the Talbiyah for ‘Umrah on its own. Those who began the Talbiyah for Hajj and ‘Umrah together did not exit Ihram at all until they had completed the rites of Hajj. Those who began the Talbiyah for Hajj on its own did not exit ihram at all until they had completed the rites of Hajj. And those who began the Talbiyah for ‘Umrah on its own circumambulated the House and ran between Safa and Marwah, then whatever had been forbidden to them became permissible until the time for Hajj came.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3075)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath teen tarah se nikle - hum mein se kuch ne Hajj aur Umrah dono ka ihlal kiya, kuch ne akele Hajj ka ihlal kiya, aur kuch ne akele Umrah ka ihlal kiya. Jisne Hajj aur Umrah dono ka ihlal kiya, woh kisi bhi haram cheez se halal nahi hua jab tak usne Hajj ke manaasik poore na kar liye. Aur jisne akele Hajj ka ihlal kiya, woh bhi kisi cheez se halal nahi hua jab tak usne Hajj ke manaasik poore na kar liye. Aur jisne akele Umrah ka ihlal kiya, usne Ghar (Ka'bah) ka aur Safa-Marwah ka tawaaf kiya to woh halal ho gaya, phir usne Hajj (ke liye dobara ehraam) ka intezar kiya.

e: from his father about Aishah, that she would carry some Zamzam water, and she would say: "Indeed the Messenger of Allah would carry it." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 963)
hi: Ke Aisha (RA) "Zamzam ka paani (apne sath) le jaati thin, aur bataati thin ke Rasulullah (SAW) bhi aisa kiya karte the."

e: [AI] "From Hisham ibn Urwah, so he mentioned it."
hi: Hisham bin Urwah se, unhone ise zikr kiya.

e: [AI] "From Amr ibn Maymun, explaining and summarizing."
hi: Amr bin Maimoon se, tafseeli aur mukhtasar.

e: [AI] "Swap the sacrifice/animal offerings, as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded his companions to replace the sacrifice they made in the year of Hudaybiyah during the Umrah of Qadaa. Umar said, 'My father was very worried about the sacrifice they made in the year of Hudaybiyah, he used to say, 'I don't know whether the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  substituted the gifts they offered in Hudaybiyah during the Umrah of Qadaa or not', until Abu Hadr (his father) informed him.'"
hi: "Qurbani ka jaanwar badal do," "kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba (RA) ko hukum diya tha ke woh Hudaibiyah ke saal zibah kiye gaye qurbani ke jaanwaron ko Umrat-ul-Qada mein badal dein." Amr ne kaha: to mere waalid ko is baat ki fikr thi jo Hudaibiyah ke saal zibah ki gayi thi, woh kehte the: "Mujhe nahi pata ke Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) ne Hudaibiyah mein zibah kiye gaye tohfe Umrat-ul-Qada mein badle ya nahi," yahan tak ke Abu Hadir ne unhein bataya.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said about Makkah: "How sweet of a land you are and how dear you are to me, and if it were not that my people expelled me from you, I would not have lived in other than you." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3926)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Makkah se farmaya: "Tu kitni achhi basti hai, aur mujhe kitni azeez hai, aur agar meri qaum ne mujhe (yahan se) na nikaala hota, to main tere siwa kahin aur na basta."

e: [AI] He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Women are forbidden during Hajj to wear gloves, veils, garments touched by perfume, clothes colored with saffron, yellow, or red, jewelry, pants, slippers, or shirts. Instead, they should wear whatever colors of garments they like, such as green, white, or black."
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Auraton ko unke ehraam mein dastaane aur naqaab pehanne se, aur waras ya za'faran se rangay huay kapdon se mana karta hoon, iske baad woh jo bhi rang ke kapde pasand karein pehan sakti hain, chahe woh gulnaar (rangeen), reshmi kapda, zewar, pajama, moza, ya qamees ho."

e: [AI] He used to leave the city and find firewood from the lumberjack, along with him a moist tree from some of the trees of the city. So he takes his goods and speaks to him, saying a good word. He speaks about it, saying, "I don't leave any booty that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has gained and I am one of the richest people."
hi: Ke woh Madinah se nikalte the aur kisi lakdi kaatne wale ko paate jiske paas Madinah ke kuch darakhton mein se kisi taaza darakht ki lakdi hoti jo usne kaati hoti, to woh uska saaman le lete aur usse iske baare mein baat karte. Bishr ne kaha: to usse baat karte, woh (sahabi) kehte: "Main woh maal-e-ghaneemat nahi chhodunga jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe diya hai, chahe main sabse zyada maal-daar logon mein se hoon."

e: [AI] Saad rode to his palace in Al-Aqeeq and found a slave cutting a tree. He seized him and when he returned, the family of the slave came to ask him to return what he had taken from their slave. He said, "May Allah forbid that I return anything that the Prophet ﷺ  has given me as a gift." So, he did not return anything to them.
hi: Ke Sa'd (RA) apne mahal ki taraf, Al-Aqiq mein, sawaar hokar gaye, unhone aik ghulam ko darakht kaatte paaya, to unhone uska saaman le liya. Jab woh wapas aaye to ghulam ke ghar wale unke paas aaye aur unse guzarish ki ke woh unke ghulam se liya hua saaman wapas kar dein. Unhone kaha: "Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon ke main woh cheez wapas karun jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe inaam mein di hai," to unhone unhein kuch bhi wapas nahi kiya.

e: [AI] And Al-Khudri said, "This is the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ," so we went to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him. He said, "This is my mosque, and there is much goodness in it."
hi: Al-Khudri ne kaha: "Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid hai." To dono Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh meri yehi masjid hai, aur ismein bohot bhalaai hai."

e: “One prayer in the Quba’ Mosque is like ‘Umrah.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1411)
hi: Unhone Usaid bin Zuhair Al-Ansari (RA), jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, ko Nabi (SAW) se riwayat karte suna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Masjid-e-Quba mein namaz Umrah ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] The translation in English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to frequently go to Quba, whether on foot or riding."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) aksar Quba jaya karte the, kabhi paidal aur kabhi sawaar hokar."

e: "The Messenger of Allah got up one night and got dressed, then he went out. I told my slave girl Barirah to follow him, so she followed him until he came to Al-Baqi. Then he stood near if for as long as Allah willed that he should stand, then he left. Barirah came back before he did and told me, but I did not mention anything until morning came, then I mentioned that to him. He said: 'I was sent to the people of Al-Baqi' to pray for them."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2038)
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) uthe, apne kapde pehne, phir bahar nikle," to maine apni laundi Barirah (RA) ko hukum diya ke woh unka peechha kare aur dekhe ke woh kahan jaate hain, to usne unka peechha kiya yahan tak ke "woh Al-Baqi' aaye, wahan jitni der Allah ne chaha khade rahe, phir wapas lautay." To Barirah (RA) unse pehle wapas aa gayin. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "to unhone mujhe khabar di." Unhone kaha: "Maine iske baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) se kuch zikr nahi kiya yahan tak ke subah hui, phir maine unse yeh baat zikr ki, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mujhe Al-Baqi' walon ke paas bheja gaya hai taake main unke liye dua karoon.'"

e: [AI] The translation of the sentence into English is as follows: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to return from a journey and saw his family, he would say, 'O turn, O turn to our Lord, a turn that will not leave any fault on us.'"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab safar se aate aur apne ghar walon ko dekhte to farmate: 'Aub, aub, apne Rab ki taraf, tauba, jo humpar koi gunah baaqi na chhode.'"

e: [AI] "We set out from Mecca on a pilgrimage or Umrah, and Usaid ibn Hudair was walking in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . We met a group of young men from the Ansar who used to receive their families when they arrived."
hi: "Hum Makkah se Hajj ya Umrah mein wapas aa rahe the, aur Usaid bin Hudair (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke aage aage chal rahe the, humein Ansar ke kuch ladke mile jo apne ghar walon ka istaqbaal karte the jab woh wapas aate."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came from a expedition, entered the mosque, and performed two units of prayer. He used to like, when he returned from a journey, to enter the mosque and pray two units of prayer, then leave." He then went to Fatimah and started kissing her face and eyes. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked her, "What is wrong with you?" She replied, "O Messenger of Allah, I see that your complexion has turned pale." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to her, "O Fatimah, Allah, the Almighty, has sent your father with a command that not a single dwelling or strand of hair on the face of the earth remains without Allah either granting it honor or humiliating it until the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Maine Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) aik ghazwe se aaye, masjid mein dakhil huay aur usme do rak'atein padhi, aur unhein pasand tha ke jab woh safar se aate to masjid mein dakhil hokar do rak'atein padhen, phir bahar nikle." To woh Fatimah (Alayha as-Salam) ke paas aaye, pehle unhi ke paas gaye, unhone unka istaqbaal kiya aur unke chehre aur aankhon ko chumne lagi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kya baat hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main dekh rahi hoon aapka rang uda hua hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye Fatimah, beshak Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare abba ko aisi baat lekar bheja hai ke zameen par koi mitti ka ghar ya baal ka khaima nahi bacha jismein Allah izzat ya zillat dakhil na kar de, yahan tak ke woh wahan pahunche jahan raat pahunchi hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: "O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from four things: Knowledge which does not profit, a heart which is not submissive, a soul which has an insatiable appetite, and a supplication which is not heard." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1548)
hi: Unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon chaar cheezon se: aisa ilm jo faida na de, aisa dil jo khushu' na kare, aisi jaan jo kabhi na bhare, aur aisi dua jo qubool na ki jaaye."

e: [AI] The translation of the above sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sought refuge from knowledge that does not benefit, supplication that is not answered, a heart that does not humbly fear Allah, and a soul that is never satisfied."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) panah maangte the: aisa ilm jo faida na de, aisi dua jo qubool na ki jaaye, aisa dil jo khushu' na kare, aur aisi jaan jo kabhi na bhare."

e: “Whoever asks for Paradise, three times, Paradise will say: “O Allah, admit him to Paradise.” And whoever asked to be saved from Hell, three times, Hell will say: “O Allah, save him from Hell.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4340)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se teen martaba Jannat maange, Jannat kehti hai: 'Aye Allah, use Jannat mein dakhil kar,' aur jo teen martaba Allah se aag se panah maange, Jahannam kehti hai: 'Aye Allah, ise aag se bacha.'"

e: l heard 'Umar bin al-Khattab say: When the Revelation came down to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a sound could be heard near his face like the buzzing of bees. We waited a while, then he turned to face the qiblah and raised his hands, then he said: “O Allah, give us more (blessing) and do not give us less; honour us and do not humiliate us, give to us and do not deprive us, give precedence to us and do not give others precedence over us; be pleased with us and make us pleased.” Then he said: “Ten verses have been revealed to me; whoever adheres to thern will enter Paradise.” Then he recited to us: “Successful indeed are the believers” [al-Mu'minoon 23:1] until he completed the ten verses. (Using translation from Aḥmad 223)
hi: Maine Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) par wahi nazil hoti to hum unke chehre ke paas shehad ki makkhiyon jaisi awaz sunte the. Aik din unpar wahi nazil hui, hum kuch der khamosh rahe, phir aap (SAW) ne Qibla-rukh hokar apne haath uthaaye aur farmaya: "Aye Allah, humein zyada de aur kam na kar, humein izzat de aur zaleel na kar, humein ata kar aur mehroom na kar, humein tarjeeh de aur humpar kisi ko tarjeeh na de, humse raazi ho ja aur humein raazi kar de." Phir farmaya: "Mujhpar dus ayaat nazil hui hain, jo unhein qaim kare woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga," phir aap (SAW) ne "{Yaqeenan momin kaamyaab ho gaye}" (Surah Al-Mu'minoon 1) se lekar dus ayaat tak padha.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah is too merciful to be ashamed to turn away the hands of His servant empty-handed."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah apne bande se sharm karta hai ke woh apne haath uske aage uthaaye, phir Allah unhein khaali laut de."

e: He saw the Messenger of Allah at Ahjar Az-Zait praying for rain and raising his hands, making supplications. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1514)
hi: Ke unhone "Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ahjar Az-Zayt ke paas dua karte dekha, aap (SAW) apni hatheliyan (chehre ke saamne) rakhe huay the."

e: [AI] I did not see the Prophet ﷺ  waving his hands while calling from his pulpit or otherwise. Rather, he would raise his two fingers towards his shoulders and then make supplication.
hi: "Maine kabhi Nabi (SAW) ko apne mimbar par ya kahin aur dua karte huay apne haath (buland karke) lehraate hue nahi dekha, balke woh apni do ungliyan apne kandhon ke barabar rakhte aur dua karte."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "One, One." This Sunnah has been narrated from Saad ibn Abi Waqqas.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik, Aik." Yeh Sunnat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ passed by me while I was supplicating by pointing with two fingers of mine. He said: Point with one finger; point with one finger. He then himself pointed with the forefinger. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1499)
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) se, Nabi (SAW) mere paas se guzre jabke main apni do ungliyon se dua kar raha tha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik, Aik," aur shahaadat (angli) se ishara kiya.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, used to keep his hands extended in supplication, and would not retract them until he wiped his face with them." And it has been narrated from Abdullah bin Abbas.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab dua mein apne haath phailate to unhein wapas nahi laate the jab tak unse apna chehra masah na kar lete." Aur yeh Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you ask Allah, ask Him with the palms of your hands and do not ask Him with the backs of them, and wipe your faces with them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum Allah se maango to apni hatheliyon ke andar wale hisse se maango, unke peechhe wale hisse se na maango, aur unse apne chehre masah karo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "No people gather together in one of the houses of Allah, reciting the Book of Allah and studying it among themselves, except that tranquility descends upon them, mercy covers them, the angels surround them, and Allah mentions them amongst those who are with Him. And whoever is hindered by his deeds will obtain it when he stops doing them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi qaum aisi majlis mein nahi baithti jismein bohot fuzool baatein hoti hon, phir koi shakhs khade hone se pehle yeh kahe: 'Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka thumma atubu ilaik,' magar uski us majlis ki (har baat) maaf kar di jaati hai." Yeh sanad Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, siwaye is ke ke Bukhari ne isse Wuhaib ki, Musa bin Uqbah se, unhone Suhail se, unke walid se, Ka'b Al-Ahbar ke apne qaul se, hadith ke sath ma'lool qaraar diya hai, wallahu a'lam. Aur is hadith ke shawahid Jubair bin Mut'im (RA), Abu Barzah Al-Aslami (RA) aur Rafi' bin Khadij (RA) se bhi milte hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever says, 'SubhanAllah wa bihamdihi, Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk,' in a gathering of remembrance, it will be like a seal stamping it on him. And whoever says it in a gathering of idle talk, it will be an expiation for him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs 'Subhanallah wa bihamdihi, Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik' kahe, aur woh zikr ki majlis mein kahe, to yeh (majlis) usspar mohar jaisi ban jaati hai, aur jo ise fuzool baaton wali majlis mein kahe, to yeh uske liye kaffara ban jaati hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say at the end of a lengthy gathering: "Glory be to You, O Allah, and Praise be to You. I testify that there is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You." Some of us said, "O Messenger of Allah, we have never heard you say this before." He said, "This is a expiation for anything that occurs in the gathering."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab majlis lambi ho jaati to aakhir mein kehte: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik," to hum mein se kisi ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh baat to hum aapse pehle nahi sunte the." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh majlis mein hone wali (baaton) ka kaffara hai."

e: [AI] "When the companions of the Prophet ﷺ gathered around him and he wanted to get up, he would say, 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk. Amiltu su'an wa thalamtu nafsi faghfirli, fa innahu la yaghfiru adh-dhunuba illa anta.' We said, 'O Messenger of Allah, did you come up with these words?' He said, 'Yes, Jibril came to me and said, O Muhammad, these are the expiation for gatherings.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab unke sahaba (RA) unke paas jama hote aur woh uthna chahte to farmate: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik, amiltu su'an wa zalamtu nafsi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta." To humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh kalimaat hain jinhein aapne naye banaya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, Jibra'il (AS) mere paas aaye aur mujhse farmaya: 'Aye Muhammad, yeh majaalis ka kaffara hain.'"

e: that a Mukatib came to him and said: “Indeed I am not capable of my Kitabah so aid me.” He said: “Should I not teach you words that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me? If you had a debt upon you similar to the mountain of Sir, Allah would fulfill it for you. He said: ‘Say: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your prohibited, and make me independent of all those besides You (Allāhummakfinī biḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmika, wa aghninī bi faḍlika ʿamman siwāka).’” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3563)
hi: "Kya main tumhein woh kalimaat na sikhaun jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaaye, agar tumpar Jabal Sabir jitna qarz ho to Allah tumhari taraf se use ada kar dega, kaho: 'Allahummakfini bi-halalika an haramik, wa aghnini bi-fadlika amman siwaak' (Aye Allah, mujhe apne halal se apne haram se bacha, aur mujhe apne fazl se tere siwa sab se be-niyaz kar de)."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "Whoever enters the market and says, 'There is no god but Allah, alone without partner. His is the dominion, and His is the praise. He brings life and causes death, and He is over all things capable' - Allah will write for him a million good deeds, erase from him a million bad deeds, and build for him a house in Paradise." The narrator said, "So I went to Khorasan and I came to Qutaybah ibn Muslim and said to him, 'I have come to you with a gift and to inform you about this narration.' He would ride in his procession until he reached the entrance of the market, then he would say it and leave."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bazaar mein dakhil ho aur kahe: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, biyadihil-khair, wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer' (Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, badshahi usi ki hai aur hamd usi ki hai, woh zindagi deta hai aur maut deta hai, bhalaai uske haath mein hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai), Allah uske liye das lakh (1,000,000) nekiyaan likhta hai, das lakh buraiyaan mita deta hai, das lakh darje buland karta hai, aur uske liye Jannat mein aik ghar banata hai." Unhone kaha: to main Khurasan gaya aur Qutaibah bin Muslim ke paas aaya, maine unse kaha: "Main aapke liye aik tohfa laaya hoon," phir maine unhein yeh hadith sunayi, to Qutaibah bin Muslim apni sawari mein bazaar ke darwaze tak jaate, phir yeh kalimaat kehte, phir wapas chale jaate.

e: "Whoever says, when he enters the marketplace: 'La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa Huwa hayyun la yamutu, bi yadihil-khairu kulluhu, wa Huwa ala kulli shay’in Qadir (None has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone, with no partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him is the praise, He gives life and gives death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die; in His Hand is all goodness and He is Able to do all things),' Allah will record for him one million good deeds, and will erase from him one million bad deeds, and will build for him a house in Paradise. " (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2235)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bazaar mein dakhil ho, wahan bech-o-khareed kare, aur kahe: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer' (Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, badshahi usi ki hai aur hamd usi ki hai, woh zindagi deta hai aur maut deta hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai), Allah uske liye das lakh nekiyaan likhta hai, das lakh buraiyaan mita deta hai, aur uske liye Jannat mein aik ghar banata hai." Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, wallahu a'lam. Imran bin Muslim ne Abdullah bin Dinar se isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever says in a marketplace, There is no God but Allah alone, with no partner or associate, His is the dominion, to Him all praise is due, all goodness is in His hand, He grants life and death and He has power overall things,ʿ Allah will record for him one thousand thousand good deeds and will erase from him one thousand thousand bad deeds, and will build a house for him in Paradise.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 327)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bazaar mein kahe: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, biyadihil-khair, wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer' (Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, badshahi usi ki hai aur hamd usi ki hai, bhalaai uske haath mein hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai), Allah uske liye das lakh nekiyaan likhta hai, das lakh buraiyaan mita deta hai, aur uske liye Jannat mein aik ghar banata hai." Is baab mein Jabir (RA), Abu Hurairah (RA), Buraidah Al-Aslami (RA) aur Anas (RA) sabse bhi riwayat hai, "aur is kitaab ki shuroot ke sath sabse qareeb Buraidah (RA) ki hadith hai, doosre alfaz mein."

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered the market, he would say, 'In the name of Allah, O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this market and the goodness within it. And I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil within it. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from acquiring an unrighteous oath or a losing transaction within it.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab bazaar mein dakhil hote to farmate: "Bismillah, Aye Allah, main tujhse is bazaar ki bhalaai aur ismein jo hai uski bhalaai maangta hoon, aur is ki buraai aur ismein jo hai uski buraai se teri panah maangta hoon, Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon ke ismein main jhoot ki qasam khaaun ya ghaate wali soda karoon."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to prefer concise supplications and leave what is beyond that."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko jama-daar (mukhtasar-jaame') duayen pasand thi, aur unke darmiyan wali (lambi) duayen chhod diya karte the."

e: Abdullah heard his son praying to Allah: O Allah, I ask Thee a white palace on the right of Paradise when I enter it. He said: O my son, ask Allah for Paradise and seek refuge in Him from Hell-Fire, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: In this community there will be some people who will exceed the limits in purification as well as in supplication. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 96)
hi: Unhone apne bete ko yeh kehte suna: "Aye Allah, main tujhse Jannat ke dayen taraf ka safed mahal maangta hoon." Unhone kaha: "Aye mere bete, Allah se Jannat maango aur Jahannam se uski panah maango, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Is Ummat mein aise log honge jo dua aur taharat mein had se tajaawuz karengay.'"

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say, when he first woke up at night, 'There is no god but Allah, the One, the Subjugator, Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Almighty, the Forgiving.'"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab raat ko karvat badalte to farmate: 'La ilaha illallahul-Wahidul-Qahhar, Rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma bainahuma, al-Azizul-Ghaffar' (Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela, sab par ghalib hai, aasmano aur zameen ka Rab hai aur jo unke darmiyan hai uska bhi, woh zabardast, bohot maaf karne wala hai)."

e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ awake at night, he said: There is no god but thou, glory be to Thee, O Allah, I ask Thy pardon for my sin and I ask Thee for Thy mercy. O Allah! advance me in knowledge: do not cause my heart to deviate (from guidance) after Thou hast guided me, and grant me mercy from thyself; verily thou art the grantor. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5061)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab raat ko jaagte to farmate: "La ilaha illa anta, Subhanaka Allahumma, main tujhse apne gunah ki maghfirat maangta hoon aur teri rahmat ka sawaal karta hoon, Aye Allah, mujhe ilm mein izafa kar, aur jab tune mujhe hidayat de di hai to mere dil ko na bhataka, aur apni taraf se mujhe rahmat ata kar, beshak tu hi bohot ata karne wala hai."

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went to bed, he would say: 'O Allah, forgive me, drive away my Shaytaan, loosen my tongue, weigh my deeds, and grant me a place in the highest paradise.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab apne bistar par lete to farmate: "Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar de, mera Shaitan door kar de, mera girvi (rihan) chhuda de, mera taraazu bhaari kar de, aur mujhe sabse buland majlis mein shaamil kar."

e: The Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from poverty", lack and abasement, and I seek refuge in Thee lest I cause or suffer wrong." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1544)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apni dua mein kehte: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon faqr, kami aur zillat se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon is baat se ke main zulm karoon ya mujhpar zulm kiya jaaye."

e: Prophet (saas) would supplicate with these words: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min fitnatin-nari wa 'adhabin-nar, wa min fitnatil-qabri wa 'adhabil-qabr, wa min sharri fitnatil-ghina wa min sharri fitnatil-faqr, wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal. Allahumma aghsil khatayaya bima'ith-thalfi wal-barad, wa naqqi qalbi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyad minad-danas. Wa ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kasali wal-harami wal-ma'thami wal-maghrami (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the tribulation of the Fire and the torment of the Fire, and from the tribulation of the grave, and from the evil of the tribulation of richness and the evil of the tribulation of poverty, and from the evil of the trial of the False Christ. O Allah! Wash away my sins with the water of snow and hail, and cleanse my heart from sin as a white garment is cleansed from filth, and put a great distance between me and my sins, as great as the distance You have made between the east and the west. O Allah! I seek refuge with You from laziness and old age, and from sins and debt)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3838)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) yeh dua kiya karte the: "Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon aag ke fitne aur aag ke azab se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon qabar ke fitne aur qabar ke azab se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon maal-daari ke fitne ki buraai se aur faqr ke fitne ki buraai se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon Maseeh Dajjal ke fitne ki buraai se. Aye Allah, mere gunahon ko barf aur olon ke paani se dho de, aur mujhe apne gunahon se aise paak kar de jaise tu ne safed kapde ko maile-pan se paak kiya, aur mere aur mere gunahon ke darmiyan itni doori kar de jitni tu ne Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan ki hai. Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon susti se, budhaape se, gunah se aur qarz se."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Seize your paradise." We asked, "O Messenger of Allah, from an enemy that has arrived?" He said, "No, your paradise from the Fire. Say, 'Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the greatest.' For indeed, they will come on the Day of Resurrection as saviors and precedents, and they are the lasting good deeds."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni dhaal pakdo." Humne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kisi mojood dushman se?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, apni dhaal aag se (bachao ke liye), kaho: 'Subhanallah, wal-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar,' kyunke yeh Qayamat ke din nijaat dilaane wali aur aage badhne wali hongi, aur yeh baaqi rehne wali nekiyaan hain."

e: The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) used to pray, "O Allah, I ask You for a pure life, a just death, and a return that is not shameful or embarrassing."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) dua kiya karte the: "Aye Allah, main tujhse pakeezah zindagi, munasib maut, aur aisi wapsi maangta hoon jo na sharmindagi wali ho na ruswaai wali."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to supplicate: "O Allah, make Your provision abundant upon me as my age increases and my life approaches its end."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) dua kiya karte the: "Aye Allah, meri umar ki dhalti (buddhape) aur zindagi ke khatm hone ke waqt mera rizq wasee' kar de."

e: [AI] There were two groups among you. One of them has already passed, and the other one remains. Allah would not punish them while you are among them, nor would Allah punish them while they seek forgiveness. [Quran 8:33]
hi: "Tum mein do amaan (hifazatein) thin, unme se aik guzar chuki, aur doosri baaqi hai: '{Aur Allah unhein azab dene wala nahi jabke tum unke darmiyan mojood ho, aur Allah unhein azab dene wala nahi jabke woh istighfaar kar rahe hon}' (Surah Al-Anfal 33)."

e: [AI] There were two guarantees on earth. One of them was lifted, while the other remained. “And it is not for Allah to punish them while you are among them, and Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.” (Quran, Al-Anfal 33)
hi: "Zameen mein do amaan thin, unme se aik utha li gayi, aur doosri baaqi hai: '{Aur Allah unhein azab dene wala nahi jabke tum unke darmiyan mojood ho, aur Allah unhein azab dene wala nahi jabke woh istighfaar kar rahe hon}' (Surah Al-Anfal 33)."

e: [AI] "On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who said: 'Whoever says "There is no power or strength except with Allah" it will be a cure for ninety-nine ailments, the least of which is anxiety.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' kahe, yeh ninnaanwe (99) bimariyon ka ilaaj hai, jinme sabse halki bimari fikr-mandi (pareshaani) hai."

e: [AI] "That Abu Talib fell ill and his condition worsened, so the Prophet ﷺ  visited him and said, 'O son of my uncle, seek the help of your Lord who has sent you to heal me.' The Prophet ﷺ  then said, 'O Allah, cure my uncle.' Abu Talib responded as if he had become rejuvenated and said, 'Indeed, your Lord has sent you to be obeyed.' The Prophet ﷺ  replied, 'And you, O uncle, if you were to obey Allah, He would surely make others obey you.'"
hi: Abu Talib bimar huay aur unka haal bigad gaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unki ayaadat ki, unhone kaha: "Aye mere bhatije, apne Rab se dua karo jisne tumhein bheja hai ke woh mujhe shifa de." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, mere chacha ko shifa de." Unhone kaha: goya woh (bandhan se) azaad ho gaye. Abu Talib ne kaha: "Tumhare Rab ne tumhein isliye bheja hai ke tumhari itaa'at ki jaaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur aap, aye chacha, agar aap Allah ki itaa'at karein, to woh (bhi) zaroor aapki itaa'at karega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked, "Which supplication is the best?" He replied, "The supplication of a person for oneself."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Sabse afzal dua kaunsi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadmi ka apne liye dua karna."

e: [AI] A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Awf ibn Malik saw him. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, the people of my tribe have become jealous of me, so they took my son and my camels." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The family of Muhammad has such and such a number of household members, and I think he said nine, in which there is not even a sa' of food nor a mudd of food. So ask Allah, the Mighty and Majestic." He (the man) went back to his wife. She said, "What did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say to you?" He informed her. It was not long until the man's camels and his son were returned to him with more than he had before. So he came to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him. The Prophet ﷺ ascended the pulpit and praised Allah and glorified Him, and ordered them to seek Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and to be interested in Him. Then he recited to them, "And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out and will provide for him from where he does not expect." [Quran 65:3]
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, aur mera khayal hai woh Awf bin Malik (RA) the, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), fulan qabile walon ne mujhpar chadhaai ki aur mera beta aur mere oont le gaye." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Aal-e-Muhammad (SAW) ke itne-itne ghar hain" - aur mera khayal hai aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "nau ghar" - "jinme na aik saa' khana hai na aik mud khana, isliye Allah se maango." Unhone kaha: to woh apni biwi ke paas wapas gaye, usne poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumhein kya jawaab diya?" To unhone use bataya. Unhone kaha: phir zyada waqt nahi guzra ke us shakhs ke oont aur beta unhein wapas mil gaye, pehle se bhi zyada, to woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein bataya, to aap (SAW) mimbar par khade huay, Allah ki hamd ki aur uski tareef bayan ki, unhein Allah se maangne aur uski taraf raghbat rakhne ka hukum diya, aur unhein yeh ayat padh kar sunayi: "{Aur jo Allah se dare, Allah uske liye koi rasta nikaal deta hai, aur use aise raste se rizq deta hai jiska use gumaan bhi nahi hota}" (Surah At-Talaq 3).

e: [AI] "A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'Oh Messenger of Allah, forgive my sins, forgive my sins.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'This statement has been said two or three times.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, 'Say: O Allah, Your forgiveness is wider than my sins, and Your mercy is more hopeful to me than my actions.' He said it, then the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Repeat it.' He repeated it, then the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Repeat it.' He repeated it, then the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Stand up, for Allah has forgiven you.' This hadith comes from narrators where the last among them are from Madinah, none of whom can be identified by their criticism, and they did not exclude him."
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Haay mere gunah, haay mere gunah," yeh baat do ya teen martaba kahi. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Kaho: 'Aye Allah, teri maghfirat mere gunahon se zyada wasee' hai, aur teri rahmat mujhe mere amal se zyada ummeed dilaati hai.'" Usne yeh kaha, phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dobara kaho," usne dobara kaha, phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dobara kaho," usne dobara kaha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khade ho jao, Allah ne tumhein maaf kar diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by a man who was saying, "O most merciful of the merciful." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Ask for surely Allah has looked at you." Al-Fadl bin Isa al-Raqashi is the one who said this, and I fear that his (i.e., the man's) uncle Yazid bin Aban said it. However, I have found a witness for him in the hadith of Abu Umamah al-Bahili.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik shakhs ke paas se guzre jo keh raha tha: "Aye sabse zyada reham karne walon ke reham karne wale." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Maango, Allah ne tumhari taraf (rehmat se) dekh liya hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah has an angel appointed over the one who says, 'O Most Merciful of the Merciful.' So whoever says it three times, the angel says, 'Indeed, the Most Merciful of the Merciful has accepted your supplication, so ask.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ka aik farishta muqarrar hai us shakhs par jo 'Aye sabse zyada reham karne walon ke reham karne wale' kahe, jo ise teen martaba kahe, farishta kehta hai: 'Sabse zyada reham karne wala tumhari taraf mutawajjeh ho chuka hai, ab maango.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever wishes to have his supplication answered during times of difficulty and hardship, then let him increase his supplication in times of ease." This hadith has a strong chain of narration, and al-Bukhari referred to it with Abu Salih and Abu 'Amir al-Alhani, and I believe it is al-Hawzani, and he is truthful.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise yeh pasand ho ke museebat aur sakhtiyon ke waqt uski dua qubool ho, use chahiye ke woh khushhaali (aasaani) ke waqt zyada dua kare." Yeh hadith sahih ul-isnad hai, Bukhari ne Abu Saalih se hujjat li hai, aur Abu Aamir Al-Alhaani, mera khayaal hai ke woh Al-Hawzani hain, aur woh sadooq hain.

e: [AI] Gabriel, peace be upon him, came to the Prophet, upon him be peace, in the most beautiful form that he had never appeared in before, laughing and giving glad tidings. He greeted the Prophet, saying, "Peace be upon you, O Muhammad." The Prophet replied, "And peace be upon you, O Gabriel." Gabriel said, "Indeed, Allah has sent me to you with a gift from the treasures of the Throne, which Allah has honored you with." The Prophet asked, "And what is this gift, O Gabriel?" Gabriel replied, "Say: O One who manifests beauty and conceals ugliness, O One who does not take account of the garment nor expose the defects, O Mighty in forgiving, O One who pardons gracefully, O One who extends His hands with mercy, O Companion of every secret and the end of every complaint, O Generous in forgiveness, O Great in beneficence, O Initiator of blessings before they are deserved, O Our Lord, O Our Master, O Our Protector, O the ultimate goal of our desires. I ask You, O Allah, not to burn my creation with fire." The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, asked, "What is the reward for these words?" Then he mentioned the rest of the narration after the supplication, at length.
hi: Jibra'il (AS) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aik aisi khoobsurat soorat mein utre jaisi kabhi nahi utre the, hanste aur khushkhabri dete huay, unhone kaha: "Assalamu Alaika, Aye Muhammad." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wa alaikas-salam, Aye Jibra'il." Unhone kaha: "Beshak Allah ne mujhe aapki taraf Arsh ke khazano ka tohfa dekar bheja hai, Allah ne aapko in (kalimaat) se izzat di hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Woh kya tohfa hai, Aye Jibra'il?" To Jibra'il (AS) ne kaha: "Kaho: 'Aye woh Zaat jisne (bandon ki) achhaai zaahir ki aur (unki) buraai chhupaayi, Aye woh Zaat jo (kisi) qasoor par pakadta nahi aur parda faash nahi karta, Aye Azeem-ul-Afw (bohot maaf karne wale), Aye Hasan-ut-Tajawuz (achhi tarah darguzar karne wale), Aye Wasee-ul-Maghfirah (bohot zyada maaf karne wale), Aye Baasit-ul-Yadain bir-Rahmah (rahmat ke sath dono haath phailane wale), Aye har raaz ke saathi, Aye har shikayat ki intiha, Aye Kareem-us-Safh (izzat se darguzar karne wale), Aye Azeem-ul-Mann (bohot ehsaan karne wale), Aye woh Zaat jo ne'maton ki shuruaat unke haqdaar hone se pehle karta hai, Aye humare Rab, Aye humare Sardaar, Aye humare Moula, aur Aye humari sabse badi khwahish, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon, Aye Allah, ke tu meri makhlooq ko aag se na jala.'" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "In kalimaat ka sawaab kya hai?" Phir unhone dua ke baad baaqi hadith tafseel se zikr ki.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say, "What prevents any of you, when he knows the answer himself, from being cured of a disease or returning from a journey and saying Alhamdulillah (praise be to Allah) by His might and glory, good deeds are completed?" Isa ibn Maymun, distinct from Qasim ibn Muhammad, narrated from Aisha and Isa is not accused of fabrication.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Tum mein se kisi ko kya rokta hai jab woh apne andar (dua ki) qubooliyat mehsoos kare, jaise woh kisi bimari se shifa paaye ya safar se wapas aaye, ke woh kahe: 'Alhamdulillahil-ladhi bi-izzatihi wa jalalihi tatimmus-salihat' (Sab tareef us Allah ke liye hai jiski izzat aur jalaal se achhe kaam mukammal hote hain)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to Fatimah, "What prevents you from listening to what I advise you to say when you wake up and when you go to sleep: 'O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy, I seek help. Set right for me all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fatimah (Alayha as-Salam) se farmaya: "Tumhein kis cheez ne rokha hai ke tum meri wasiyat suno, ke jab subah karo aur jab shaam karo to kaho: 'Aye Zinda, Aye Qaim rehne wale, teri rahmat ke wasile se madad maangta hoon, mera har maamla durust kar de, aur mujhe aankh jhapakne bhar ke liye bhi mere apne hawale na chhod.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever says, when he goes to his bed, 'Alhamdulillahil-ladhi kafaani wa aawani, Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amani wa saqaani, Alhamdulillahil-ladhi mann 'alayya fa afdala. Allahumma inni as-aluka bi'izzatika an tunajjiyani min an-naar, faqad hamidallaha bijami'i mahamidil-khalqi kullihim,' it will be a source of thanksgiving to Allah for all the praises of creation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apne bistar mein jate waqt kahe: 'Alhamdulillahil-ladhi kafani wa aawani, Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amani wa saqani, Alhamdulillahil-ladhi manna alayya fa afdal, Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-izzatika an tunajjiyani minan-naar' (Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe kaafi hai aur mujhe basaya, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe khilaaya aur pilaaya, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhpar ehsaan kiya aur bakhsha, Aye Allah, main teri izzat ke wasile se sawaal karta hoon ke tu mujhe aag se bacha le), to usne Allah ki poori makhlooq ki sari tareefon ke barabar Allah ki tareef ki hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When one of you goes to his bed, let him say: 'O Allah, Lord of the heavens and the earth, our Lord and Lord of all things, You are the One who takes hold of him by his forelock. You are the First, and there is nothing before You. You are the Last, and there is nothing after You. You are the Manifest, and there is nothing above You. Make us self-sufficient from poverty and relieve us from debt.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne bistar par aaye to kahe: 'Aye Allah, aasmano ke Rab aur zameen ke Rab, humare Rab aur har cheez ke Rab, tu har cheez ki paishani pakde huay hai, tu Awwal hai, tujh se pehle kuch nahi, aur tu Aakhir hai, tere baad kuch nahi, aur tu Zaahir hai, tujh se oopar kuch nahi, humein faqr se be-niyaz kar de aur humara qarz ada kar de.'"

e: [AI] A man from the Ansar, from the people of Qubaa, of the prophet ﷺ issued an invitation. So we went with him, when he finished eating and washed his hands (or said his hand), he said, "Praise be to Allah who feeds us and is not fed by us. He has guided us, nourished us, and given us drink. Every excellent trial has been a source of good for us. Praise be to Allah who is neither leaving, nor requiring compensation, nor is in need of us. Praise be to Allah who has given us food to eat, drink to quench our thirst, clothed us, guided us when we were astray, restored our sight when we were blind, and has favored us over many of those He has created. Praise be to Allah, Lord of all the worlds."
hi: Ansar mein se Quba ke aik shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) ko dawat di, hum unke sath gaye, jab aap (SAW) ne khaana khaaya aur apne haath (ya haath) dhoye, to farmaya: "Alhamdulillahil-ladhi yut'imu wa la yut'am, manna alaina fahadaana wa at'amana wa saqaana, wa kulla bala'in hasanin ablana, Alhamdulillahi ghaira mudda'in wa la muk'afa'in wa la makfoorin wa la mustaghnan anhu, Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'ama minat-ta'am wa saqa minash-sharaab wa kasa minal-uryi wa hada minad-dalalati wa bassara minal-'ama wa faddala ala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela, Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen" (Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jo khilaata hai aur khilaaya nahi jaata, usne humpar ehsaan kiya to humein hidayat di aur khilaaya aur pilaaya, aur har achha imtihaan humein diya, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, na chhodne wala hai na badla lene wala hai na na-shukra hai na uski zaroorat khatam hoti hai, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne khana khilaya, sharaab pilaayi, barhanagi mein kapda pehnaaya, gumraahi se hidayat di, andhepan se roshni di, aur apni bohot si makhlooq par barhaawa diya, sab tareef Allah, Rabb-ul-Aalameen, ke liye hai).

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: When the caller calls for prayer, the gates of heaven are opened and the supplication is answered. So, whoever is inflicted with distress or hardship, let them be cautious of the caller. And when he says: "Allahu Akbar", say: "Allahu Akbar", and when he says: "Ashhadu an la ilaha illa Allah", say: "Ashhadu an la ilaha illa Allah", and when he says: "Hayya 'ala as-Salah", say: "Hayya 'ala as-Salah", and when he says: "Hayya 'ala al-Falah", say: "Hayya 'ala al-Falah". Then, say: "Allahumma rabba hadhihid da'watit-tammati, salatiqa al-mustajabati, mustajabatan laha, da'wati al-haqi, wa kalimati at-taqwa, ahina 'alayha wa amitna 'alayha, wa ab'athna 'alayha, waj'alna min khayri ahliha ahyaa wa amwatan". Then, ask Allah for your need.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab pukaarne wala (azan dene wala) pukaarta hai to aasman ke darwaze khul jaate hain aur dua qubool hoti hai, isliye jispar museebat ya sakhti aaye, use pukaarne wale (ke waqt) ka intezar karna chahiye, jab woh takbeer kahe to takbeer kaho, jab woh tashahhud kahe to tashahhud kaho, jab woh 'Hayya alas-salah' kahe to 'Hayya alas-salah' kaho, aur jab woh 'Hayya alal-falah' kahe to 'Hayya alal-falah' kaho, phir kaho: 'Aye Allah, is sacchi, qubool ki jaane wali pukaar ke Rab, is haq ki pukaar aur taqwa ke kalime ke (Rab), humein isi par zinda rakh, isi par maut de, isi par uthaa, aur humein iske behtareen ahl mein shaamil kar, zinda aur murda dono halaton mein,' phir Allah se apni zaroorat maange."

e: [AI] I saw the Prophet ﷺ holding the Tasbih (prayer beads). This was narrated by Al-A'mash from Ataa ibn As-Sa'ib.
hi: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko tasbeeh (ungliyon par) ginte dekha." Isse Al-A'mash ne Ata' bin As-Sa'ib se riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] I saw the Prophet ﷺ  holding the beads for reciting tasbih.
hi: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko tasbeeh (ungliyon par) ginte dekha."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Adhere to glorification, exaltation, and sanctification, and do not be neglectful so as to forget the oneness of Allah. Cling to your fingers, for they will be questioned and will speak."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tasbeeh, tahleel aur taqdees ko lazim pakdo, aur ghaflat na karo ke tum tawheed bhool jao, aur ungliyon ke joadon par ginti karo, kyunke un (ungliyon) se sawaal hoga aur unhein bulwaya jayega."

e: [AI] The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم came to me and there were four thousand date pits in front of me. I was using them to make tasbeeh (to glorify Allah). He said, "O daughter of Huwayy! What is this?" I said, "I am making tasbeeh with them." He said, "I have been making tasbeeh since I ascended to your head more than this." I said, "Teach me, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Say, 'Subhanallah' (Glory be to Allah) the number of all the things He created."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas tashreef laaye, aur mere saamne chaar hazaar (4000) khajoor ki guthaliyaan thin jinse main tasbeeh kar rahi thi, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Huyayy ki beti, yeh kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Main inse tasbeeh kar rahi hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab se main tumhare paas se utha hoon, main isse zyada tasbeeh kar chuka hoon." Maine kaha: "Mujhe sikhaaiye, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Subhanallahi adada ma khalaqa min shai'' (Allah paak hai, uski har cheez ki tadaad ke barabar jo usne paida ki)."

e: Once Sa'd, with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, visited a woman in front of whom were some date-stones or pebbles which she was using as a rosary to glorify Allah. He (the Prophet) said: I tell you something which would be easier (or more excellent) for you than that. He said (it consisted of saying): "Glory be to Allah" as many times as the number of that which He has created in Heaven; "Glory be to Allah" as many times as the number of that which He has created on Earth; "Glory be to Allah" as many times as the number of that which He has created between them; "Glory be to Allah" as many times as the number of that which He is creating; "Allah is most great" a similar number of times; "Praise (be to Allah)" a similar number of times; and "There is no god but Allah" a similar number of times; "There is no might and no power except in Allah" a similar number of times. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1500)
hi: Ke woh Nabi (SAW) ke sath aik aurat ke paas gaye jiske saamne khajoor ki guthaliyaan ya kankariyan thin (jinse woh tasbeeh kar rahi thi), "Kya main tumhein woh na bataun jo isse tumhare liye zyada aasan aur behtar hai? Kaho: 'Subhanallahi adada ma khalaqa fis-sama, Subhanallahi adada ma khalaqa fil-ard' (Allah paak hai jitni cheezein usne aasman mein paida ki, Allah paak hai jitni cheezein usne zameen mein paida ki), tum tasbeeh karo," to aap (SAW) ne (khud) farmaya: "'Subhanallahi adada ma bayna dhalik, wa Subhanallahi adada ma huwa khaliq, wallahu Akbaru mithla dhalik, wal-hamdulillahi mithla dhalik, wa la ilaha illallahu mithla dhalik, wa la quwwata illa billahi mithla dhalik' (Allah paak hai jitni cheezein unke darmiyan hain, aur Allah paak hai jitni cheezein woh paida karne wala hai, Allah sabse bada hai isi tadaad mein, aur sab tareef Allah ke liye hai isi tadaad mein, aur Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi isi tadaad mein, aur koi taaqat nahi magar Allah ke sath isi tadaad mein)."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanding with these words of alarm, "I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger, His punishment, the evil deeds of His servants, and the whispers of devils, and that they come near." Abdullah bin Umar and those who reached from his children taught them to him, so he recited them in front of his people. And whoever did not reach from them, he wrote them and hung them around his neck.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dahshat (khauf) ke waqt yeh kalimaat kehne ka hukum dete suna: "A'oozu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa min iqabihi wa min sharri ibadihi wa min hamazatish-shayateeni wa an yahduroon" (Main Allah ke mukammal kalimaat ki panah maangta hoon uske ghusse se, uski saza se, uske bandon ki buraai se, shayateen ke waswason se, aur is baat se ke woh mere paas aayen). Unhone kaha: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) apne un bachchon ko jo (samajhne ki umar ko) pahunch chuke hote, yeh kalimaat sikhaate, to woh apni qaum ke saamne inhein kehte, aur jo abhi (us umar ko) na pahuncha hota, uske liye woh ise likh kar uski gardan mein latka dete.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When one of you goes to his bed, an angel and a devil come to him. The devil makes him open his mouth with evil, while the angel makes him open his mouth with good. If he remembers Allah, the devil goes away and the angel stays with him. When he wakes up, an angel and a devil come to him. The devil makes him open his mouth with evil, while the angel makes him open his mouth with good. If he says 'Alhamdulillah' (Praise be to Allah) who restored my soul to me after taking it in sleep, the devil goes away and the angel stays with him. If he gets up and prays, the angel keeps praying for goodness."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi apne bistar par jaata hai to aik farishta aur aik Shaitan uske paas jaldi aate hain, Shaitan kehta hai: 'Buraai se shuru kar,' aur farishta kehta hai: 'Bhalaai se shuru kar,' to agar woh Allah ka zikr kare to Shaitan chala jata hai aur farishta aa kar uski hifazat karta hai, aur jab woh jaagta hai to bhi aik farishta aur aik Shaitan uske paas jaldi aate hain, Shaitan kehta hai: 'Buraai se shuru kar,' aur farishta kehta hai: 'Bhalaai se shuru kar,' to agar woh kahe: 'Alhamdulillahil-ladhi radda ilayya nafsi ba'da mawtiha wa lam yumitha fi manamiha, Alhamdulillahil-ladhi yumsikus-sama'a an taqa'a alal-ardi illa bi-idhnihi, innallaha bin-nasi lara'oofur-raheem, Alhamdulillahil-ladhi yuhyil-mawta wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer' (Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne meri jaan uski maut ke baad mujhe wapas lautaayi aur usse neend mein maut nahi di, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jo aasman ko zameen par girne se rokta hai magar uski ijaazat se, beshak Allah logon par bohot shafqat karne wala, rahem karne wala hai, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jo murdon ko zinda karta hai aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai), to agar woh kisi sawari se gir kar mar jaaye to shaheed hokar mare, aur agar woh uth kar namaz padhe to woh fazeelaton (waali namaz) padhega."

e: [AI] The translation of the Arabic phrase is: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would lie down in his bed, he would say, 'O Allah, forgive my sins, expel my Shaytan, remove the burden from my heart, make my scale heavy (with good deeds), and place me in the highest assembly.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab apne bistar par lete to farmate: "Aye Allah, mera gunah maaf kar de, mera Shaitan door kar de, mera girvi (rihan) chhuda de, mera taraazu bhaari kar de, aur mujhe sabse buland jama'at mein shaamil kar."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "When a person returns from visiting a sick person, let him say, 'O Allah, cure Your servant who has become ill and is in pain. Or, let him walk to You for prayer.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab koi aadmi kisi bimar ki ayaadat ko aaye to woh kahe: 'Allahummashfi abdaka yankau laka aduwwan aw yamshi laka ila salaatin' (Aye Allah, apne bande ko shifa de, taake woh tere liye kisi dushman ko zakhmi kare ya tere liye namaz ke liye chale)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  visited me when I was sick and said, "O Salman, may Allah heal your sickness, forgive your sins, and grant you health and strength until the end of your life."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne meri bimari mein meri ayaadat ki aur farmaya: "Aye Salman, Allah tumhari bimari ko shifa de, tumhare gunah maaf kare, aur tumhein tumhare jism aur badan mein tumhari maut ke waqt tak aafiyat de."

e: “The stingy person is the one before whom I am mentioned, and he does not send Salat upon me.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3546)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak kanjoos woh hai jiske saamne mera zikr kiya jaaye aur woh mujhpar durood na bheje."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Woe to the person in whose presence I am mentioned and he does not send blessings upon me."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us shakhs ki naak khaak mein ral jaaye jiske saamne mera zikr kiya jaaye aur woh mujhpar durood na bheje."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "No group of people gather together to remember Allah without sending blessings upon their Prophet ﷺ , except that this gathering becomes a source of blessings for them. And no group of people sit together without remembering Allah, except that this sitting becomes a source of regret for them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi qaum aisi majlis mein nahi baithti jismein woh Allah ka zikr karte hon lekin apne Nabi (SAW) par durood na bhejte hon, magar yeh majlis unke liye nuqsaan ka baa'is banti hai, aur koi qaum aisi nahi baithti jismein woh Allah ka zikr na karte hon, magar yeh bhi unke liye nuqsaan ka baa'is banti hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever sends blessings upon me, Allah will send blessings upon him ten times, and will erase ten of his sins."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo mujhpar aik martaba durood bheje, Allah uspar das martaba durood bhejta hai aur uski das khataayen mita deta hai."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I met Jibril (Gabriel) ﷺ  who gave me glad tidings and said, 'Verily, your Lord says: Whoever supplicates upon you, I supplicate upon him, and whoever sends peace upon you, I send peace upon him.' So I prostrated in gratitude to Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Jibra'il (AS) se mila, unhone mujhe khushkhabri di aur kaha: 'Beshak tera Rab farmata hai: jo tujhpar durood bheje, main uspar durood bhejta hoon, aur jo tujhpar salaam bheje, main uspar salaam bhejta hoon,' to maine Allah ke shukr mein sajda kiya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is nothing more honorable to Allah than supplication."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek dua se zyada izzat wali koi cheez nahi."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Supplication (du'a') is itself the worship. (He then recited:) "And your Lord said: Call on Me, I will answer you" (xI.60). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1479)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak dua hi ibadat hai," phir aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Aur tumhare Rab ne farmaya: 'Mujhe pukaro, main tumhari sununga'}" (Surah Ghafir 60).

e: [AI] About Thar towards him, and as for the story of Jarir
hi: Zarr se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Rahi baat Jarir (RA) ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] About Thar, he mentioned it with its chain of narration like it, and for this hadith there is a corroborating witness with a sound chain of narration from Abdullah ibn Abbas.
hi: Zarr se, unhone ise isi jaisi sanad ke sath zikr kiya, aur is hadith ka aik sahih sanad ke sath shahid Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) se bhi milta hai.

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Supplication is the worship." Then he recited: 'And your Lord said: 'Call upon Me, I will answer you. Verily, those who scorn my My worship, they will surely enter Hell in humiliation (40:60).'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3247)
hi: "{Aur tumhare Rab ne farmaya: 'Mujhe pukaro, main tumhari sununga, beshak jo log meri ibadat se ghamand karte hain, woh jald hi zaleel hokar Jahannam mein dakhil honge'}" (Surah Ghafir 60).

e: Messenger of Allah (saas) said: "Whoever does not call upon Allah, He will be angry with him." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3827)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se dua na kare, Allah uspar naraaz hota hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever does not supplicate to Allah, He becomes angry with him. Indeed, Allah becomes angry with the one who does not supplicate to Him, and no one does that except himself."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se dua na kare, Allah uspar naraaz hota hai, aur beshak Allah us shakhs par naraaz hota hai jo aisa kare, aur iske ilawa koi aur (Rab) aisa nahi karta," ya'ni dua mein.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no group of people who sit together in a gathering and disperse from it without mentioning Allah in it, except that it is as if they have dispersed from the carcass of a dead donkey, and they will have regret on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi qaum aisi majlis mein nahi baithti aur usse bagair Allah ka zikr kiye alag nahi hoti, magar goya woh gadhe ki laash se alag hue hon, aur yeh Qayamat ke din unke liye hasrat (afsos) ka baa'is banti hai."

e: The same as No. 290. from the Prophet. (Using translation from Bukhārī 1199b)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: [AI] "A group of people who gather and then disperse without remembering Allah and sending peace and blessings upon His Prophet ﷺ , will have regret on the Day of Judgment."
hi: "Koi qaum aisi majlis mein nahi baithti, phir Allah ka zikr aur unke Nabi (SAW) par durood bheje bagair alag hoti hai, magar yeh Qayamat ke din unke liye hasrat ka baa'is banti hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No group of people gathers and then disperses without mentioning the name of Allah, as if they have dispersed with nothing but the hoofprints of a donkey."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi qaum jama nahi hoti phir Allah ka naam liye bagair alag hoti hai, magar goya woh gadhe ki laash se hi alag hue hon."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Duʿāʾ (supplication) is the weapon of the believer, the pillar of religion, and the nūr (light) of the heavens and the earth."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dua momin ka hathiyar hai, deen ka satoon hai, aur aasmano aur zameen ka noor hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Precaution does not protect a person from Fate, and supplication benefits from what has descended and what has not descended. And indeed, calamity descends, and supplication intercepts it until the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ehtiyaat taqdeer se bacha nahi sakti, aur dua us cheez ke khilaaf bhi kaam aati hai jo nazil ho chuki ho aur jo nazil na hui ho, aur beshak museebat nazil hoti hai to dua usse takra jaati hai, phir dono Qayamat ke din tak (aapas mein) kashmakash mein rehte hain."

e: “Nothing increases one’s life span except righteousness and nothing repels the Divine decree except supplication, and a man may be deprived of provision by a sin that he commits.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4022)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Taqdeer ko sirf dua hi laut sakti hai, aur umar mein sirf neki hi izafa karti hai, aur beshak aadmi apne kiye gunah ki wajah se rizq se mehroom ho jata hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Supplication benefits from what has come down and what has not yet come down, so upon you is to supplicate, O servants of Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dua us cheez ke khilaaf bhi kaam aati hai jo nazil ho chuki ho aur jo nazil na hui ho, isliye Allah ke bando, dua ko lazim pakdo."

e:
that the Prophet ﷺ said, "There is no Muslim who calls upon Allah, without sin or cutting family ties, but that Allah will give him one of three answers: (1) He will quickly fulfill his supplication, (2) He will store it for him in the Hereafter, or (3) He will divert an evil from him similar to it.”
They said, “In that case we will ask for more.” The Prophet said, “Allah has even more.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 11133)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi Musalman Allah se aisi dua nahi karta jismein koi gunah ya rishta todna shaamil na ho, magar Allah usse teen cheezon mein se aik zaroor deta hai: ya to uski dua qubool karta hai, ya usse utni hi buraai door kar deta hai, ya usse utna hi ajr aakhirat ke liye jama kar deta hai." Sahaba (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), phir to hum zyada (dua) karengay." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah (uski) zyada (nawazish karta) hai."

e: “Call upon Allah while being certain of being answered, and know that Allah does not respond to a supplication from the heart of one heedless and occupied by play.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3479)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah se dua karo is yaqeen ke sath ke woh qubool hogi, aur jaan lo ke Allah kisi ghaafil, khel mein masroof dil se dua qubool nahi karta."

e: [AI] "About the Prophet ﷺ, he said, 'Do not feel incapable in making supplication, for no one is ever destroyed by supplicating.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dua mein kamzori mat dikhaao, kyunke dua ke sath koi halaak nahi hota."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Allah will answer the call of the believer on the Day of Judgment until He places him before Him. Then He will say, 'My servant, I commanded you to supplicate to Me and promised to answer you. Were you supplicating to Me?' The servant will say, 'Yes, O Lord.' Allah will say, 'Did you not supplicate to Me with a supplication except that I answered it for you? Did you not supplicate to Me on such and such day due to distress that befell you, that I relieve you from it?' The servant will respond, 'Yes, O Lord.' Allah will then say, 'Indeed, I stored this for you in Paradise.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Allah does not leave unanswered a supplication made by a believing servant. Either He hastens its fulfillment in this world or He stores it for the Hereafter.' The believer will say in that situation, 'I wish none of my supplications had been answered hastily.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah momin ko Qayamat ke din bulaayega yahan tak ke use apne saamne khada kar dega, phir kahega: "Mere bande, maine tumhein hukum diya tha ke tum mujhse dua karo, aur maine tumse wada kiya tha ke main tumhari dua qubool karunga, to kya tum mujhse dua karte the?" Woh kahega: "Ji haan, Aye mere Rab." Allah kahega: "Kya tumne mujhse koi dua ki jo maine qubool na ki ho? Kya tumne fulan din, jab tumpar koi museebat aayi thi, mujhse dua nahi ki thi ke main woh museebat door kar dun, to maine woh door kar di?" Woh kahega: "Ji haan, Aye mere Rab." Allah kahega: "Woh maine tumhein duniya mein hi jaldi de di thi, aur tumne mujhse fulan din, jab tumpar museebat aayi, dua ki thi ke main woh door kar dun, magar tumhein koi rahat nazar nahi aayi?" Woh kahega: "Ji haan, Aye mere Rab." Allah kahega: "Beshak maine iske badle tumhare liye Jannat mein aisa-aisa jama kar rakha hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: to Allah apne momin bande ki koi dua zaaya nahi hone deta, ya to woh usse duniya mein hi jaldi de deta hai, ya usse aakhirat ke liye jama kar deta hai. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: to momin us maqaam par kahega: "Kaash meri koi bhi dua duniya mein jaldi qubool na ki gayi hoti."

e: [AI] Jabir ibn Abdullah said, "The Prophet ﷺ  came out to us and said, 'O people, indeed Allah has gardens among the angels that come to sit in gatherings of remembrance on earth, so spread yourselves in the gardens of Paradise.' They asked, 'And where are the gardens of Paradise?' He said, 'The gatherings of remembrance. So rise and go in the remembrance of Allah and remind yourselves. Whoever would like to know their position with Allah, let them look at Allah's position with them. Indeed, Allah will lower the servant from their position as according to their own self.'"
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) [ne kaha]: Nabi (SAW) humare paas tashreef laaye aur farmaya: "Aye logo, Allah ke farishton ke kaafile hote hain jo zameen mein zikr ki majaalis mein utarte aur thehrte hain, isliye Jannat ke baaghon mein charo." Unhone poocha: "Jannat ke baagh kahan hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zikr ki majaalis, isliye subah-shaam Allah ke zikr mein guzaro aur apne aap ko yaad dilaate raho. Jo apni Allah ke nazdeek manzilat jaanna chahe, use dekhna chahiye ke Allah ki manzilat uske dil mein kya hai, kyunke Allah bande ko wahi manzilat deta hai jo woh Allah ko apne dil mein deta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Verily, Allah has angels who roam the earth in search of gatherings of remembrance. When they find such a gathering, they surround it with their wings until it reaches the heavens. Then Allah asks them, although He already knows the answer: 'From where have you come?' They reply: 'We have come from Your servants on Earth who glorify You, praise You, and declare Your greatness. They seek Your forgiveness, ask for Your protection, and beseech You.' Allah then asks: 'What do they ask of Me?' And He already knows the answer. They reply: 'They ask for Paradise.' Allah asks: 'Have they seen it?' They reply: 'No, O Lord.' He then asks: 'How would it be if they were to see Paradise?' They respond: 'They would be even more eager in their worship and obedience to You.' He asks: 'From what do they seek protection?' And He already knows the answer. They reply: 'From the Fire.' Allah asks: 'Have they seen it?' They reply: 'No, O Lord.' He then asks: 'How would it be if they were to see it?' They respond: 'They would be even more fearful and committed to avoiding it.' Then Allah says: 'Bear witness, O angels, that I have forgiven them and granted them what they asked for, and I have accepted their seeking of my protection.' They say: 'Our Lord, among them is a servant who is a sinner. He happens to be sitting amongst them, although he is not truly one of them.' Allah says, 'He too is forgiven, for they are a people whose sitting companions will not be unfortunate.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Allah ke kuch chalte-phirte aur fazeelat wale farishte hain jo zameen mein zikr ki majaalis dhoondte hain, jab woh kisi zikr ki majlis ke paas aate hain to aik doosre ko apne paron se ghere kar aasman tak pahunch jaate hain, to Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala poochta hai - jabke woh khud zyada jaanta hai - "Tum kahan se aaye ho?" Woh kehte hain: "Aye humare Rab, hum tere bandon ke paas se aaye hain, jo teri tasbeeh, takbeer, tahmeed aur tahleel karte hain, aur tujhse sawaal karte hain aur teri panah maangte hain." Allah poochta hai: "Woh mujhse kya maangte hain?" - aur woh khud zyada jaanta hai - Woh kehte hain: "Aye humare Rab, woh tujhse Jannat maangte hain." Allah poochta hai: "Kya unhone use dekha hai?" Woh kehte hain: "Nahi, Aye Rab." Allah kehta hai: "Agar woh use dekh lete to kaisa hota?" Phir woh poochta hai: "Woh kis cheez se meri panah maangte hain?" - aur woh khud zyada jaanta hai - Woh kehte hain: "Aag se." Allah poochta hai: "Kya unhone use dekha hai?" Woh kehte hain: "Nahi." Allah kehta hai: "Agar woh use dekh lete to kaisa hota?" Phir Allah farmata hai: "Gawah raho, maine unhein maaf kar diya hai, aur unhein jo unhone mujhse maanga hai woh de diya hai, aur unhein jiski panah unhone maangi hai usse panah de di hai." Woh kehte hain: "Aye humare Rab, unme aik gunahgaar bandah bhi hai jo unke paas baitha hai, unme se nahi hai." Allah kehta hai: "Use bhi maine maaf kar diya, yeh log aise hain ke inke sath baithne wala bhi mahroom nahi hota."

e: "The laws of Islam are burdensome for me. Tell me of something that I will be able to adhere to. He said: 'Always keep your tongue moist with the remembrance of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3793)
hi: Kisi shakhs ne Rasulullah (SAW) se arz kiya: "Islam ki shara'ein mujh par bohot ziyada ho gayi hain, mujhe koi aisi cheez bataiye jise main pakad loon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhari zubaan hamesha Allah ke zikr se tar rahe."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The ones who excel are the Mufridoon." They asked, "O Messenger of Allah, who are the Mufridoon?" He said, "Those who constantly remember Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Mufarridoon aage nikal gaye." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Al-Mufarridoon kaun hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh log jo Allah ke zikr mein khoya rehte hain."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Indeed, Allah says, 'I am with My servant as long as he remembers Me and his lips move in My remembrance."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: Beshak Allah farmata hai: "Main apne bande ke sath hota hoon jab woh mujhe yaad kare aur uske hoant mere zikr se harkat karein."

e: "Shall I not tell you of the best of your deeds, the most pleasing to your Sovereign, those that raise you most in status, that are better than your gold and silver, or meeting you enemy (in battle) and you strike their necks and they strike your necks?" They said: " WHat is that, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Remembering Allah(Dhikr)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3790)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein tumhare sabse behtareen amal, apne Maalik ke nazdeek sabse paakeeza, tumhare darjaat mein sabse buland, aur sona-chandi dene se behtar, aur apne dushman se milkar unki gardanein maarne aur unka tumhari gardanein maarne se behtar amal na bataun?" Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ka zikr." Muadh bin Jabal (RA) ne kaha: "Kisi insaan ne Allah ke zikr se zyada koi aisa amal nahi kiya jo use Allah ke azab se zyada bachaaye."

e: [AI] "Abu al-Qasim ﷺ  said: 'Any group of people who gather and prolong their sitting without mentioning Allah and sending blessings upon his Prophet ﷺ , they will be held accountable by Allah. If He wills, He will punish them, and if He wills, He will forgive them.'"
hi: Abul-Qasim (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi log baithen aur der tak baithen rahen, phir Allah ka zikr aur unke Nabi (SAW) par durood bheje bagair alag hon, magar Allah ki taraf se unpar zimmedari (nuqsaan) rahegi, agar Allah chahe to unhein azab de aur agar chahe to unhein maaf kar de."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ used to say "Subhanak Allahumma rabbi wa bihamdik, la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk" whenever he would rise from a gathering. So, I asked him, "O Messenger of Allah, why do you often say these words when you rise?" He replied, "Whoever says these words when rising from a gathering, all his sins committed in that gathering will be forgiven."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab kisi majlis se uthte to yeh kehte the: "Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbi wa bihamdika, la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik." Maine unse arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), jab aap uthte hain to yeh kalimaat kitni martaba kehte hain!" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi bhi apni majlis se uthte waqt yeh kahe, to use us majlis mein hui har baat maaf kar di jaati hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: Allah, Mighty and Exalted, says, "I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me. Mentioning Me is a way to bring me closer, and making supplication is a unique way to gain nearness to Me. Indeed, Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim is trustworthy and in this chain of narration Saleh narrates, 'Jazra said.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Mere bande, main tumhare mere baare mein gumaan ke mutabiq hoon, aur main tumhare sath hota hoon jab tum mujhe yaad karte ho." Zikr-e-zann (gumaan waala hissa) Sahih mein bhi mila hai, aur zikr-e-dua (dua waala hissa) gharib sahih hai, kyunke Muhammad bin Al-Qasim thiqa hain, aur is sanad mein Salih Jazrah ne kaha hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no servant who directs his face towards Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, in supplication, except that Allah grants him what he asks for, either by hastening its fulfillment or by saving it for him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bandah apna chehra Allah ki taraf kisi maang mein nahi karta magar Allah use zaroor deta hai, ya to jaldi deta hai ya usse jama kar rakhta hai."

e: [AI] "From Abu Uthman Al-Nahdi."
hi: Abu Uthman An-Nahdi se.

e: The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah is Ḥayī (shy) and Karīm (generous). He is too shy to let His servant extend his hands in supplication and then return them empty."[^1]
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah bohot sharm karne wala, bohot ata karne wala hai, apne bande se sharm karta hai ke woh apne haath uske aage phailaaye, phir woh unhein khaali laut de."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Verily, Allah is Merciful, Modest, and Generous. He is too modest to let his servant raise his hands to Him and then not put anything good in them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah bohot reham karne wala, bohot sharm karne wala, bohot ata karne wala hai, apne bande se sharm karta hai ke woh apne haath uske aage uthaaye, phir woh unme koi bhalaai na rakhe."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever is granted in supplication from among you, the gates of Paradise are opened for him, and a servant does not ask Allah for anything more beloved to Him than to ask for well-being (health and wellness)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise tum mein se dua ki taufeeq mil jaaye, uske liye Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jaate hain, aur koi bandah Allah se aisi koi cheez nahi maangta jo usse zyada aziz ho jitni aafiyat maangna."
