e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'The best of remembrance is La ilaha illallah (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah), and the best of supplication is Al-Hamdu Lillah (praise is to Allah).'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3800)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Sabse afzal zikr 'La ilaha illallah' hai, aur sabse afzal dua 'Alhamdulillah' hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  begin a supplication by saying: "Subhan Rabbi al-A'la al-Wahhab."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko jab bhi dua shuru karte suna, to woh use "Subhana Rabbiyal-Aliyyil-A'lal-Wahhab" (Paak hai mera Rab, sabse buland, bohot ata karne wala) se hi shuru karte.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "Glorify and exalt the Lord of Majesty and Honor."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Isse lipte raho: 'Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram' (Aye Jalaal aur Ikraam wale)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Glorify and honor with me, O Possessor of Glory and Generosity."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse lipte raho: 'Ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram' (Aye Jalaal aur Ikraam wale)."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ asked them, "Do you want, O people, to exert yourselves in supplication?" They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Say, 'O Allah, help me in remembering You, expressing gratitude to You, and worshiping You excellently.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye logo, kya tum chahte ho ke tum dua mein koshish karo?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik' (Aye Allah, apne zikr, apne shukr, aur apni achhi ibadat par meri madad kar)."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Increase in the remembrance of Allah until people consider you insane.' This is an authentic newspaper for Egyptians with a sound chain of narration, and Abu Haytham Sulaiman ibn Uthbah Al-Utwari is reliable from the people of Egypt."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ka zikr itna zyada karo ke log kahne lagen: 'Yeh deewana hai.'" Yeh Misr walon ka aik nuskha (majmoo'a) hai jiski sanad sahih hai, aur Abu Al-Haitham Sulaiman bin Utbah Al-Utwari Misr ke thiqa logon mein se hain.

e: [AI] "When a matter was brought to the Prophet, peace be upon him, which pleased him, he would say, 'Praise be to Allah by whose blessings good deeds are perfected.' And when a matter was brought to him that displeased him, he would say, 'Praise be to Allah in every circumstance.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) jab koi khushi wali baat aati to farmate: "Alhamdulillahil-ladhi bini'matihi tatimmus-salihat" (Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jiski ne'mat se achhe kaam mukammal hote hain), aur jab koi napasand baat aati to farmate: "Alhamdulillahi ala kulli haal" (Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai har haal mein).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Those who remember Allah with majestic glorification, praise, magnification, and glorification, gather around the Throne. They have a sound like the sound of bees, and they say to their companion, 'Doesn't one of you love to have something with the Most Merciful that reminds him of Him?'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo log Allah ka zikr jalaal ki tamjeed, tasbeeh, takbeer aur tahleel ke sath karte hain, woh Arsh ke ird-gird ghoomte hain, unki aik gunj hoti hai shehad ki makkhiyon ki gunj jaisi, woh apne sathi se kehte hain: 'Kya tum mein se koi yeh pasand nahi karta ke Rahman ke nazdeek uske liye koi aisi cheez ho jo use uski yaad dilaaye?'"

e: [AI] Abu Asim al-Nabil narrated to us that Abdul Hamid ibn Ja'far narrated to him, who said that Saleh ibn Abi 'Ariib narrated to him, from Kathir ibn Murrah, from Muadh ibn Jabal, who said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever's last words are 'There is no god but Allah' will enter Paradise."
hi: Maadh bin Jabal (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiske aakhri alfaaz 'La ilaha illallah' hon, woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever says 'There is no god but Allah, alone without partner, to Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is able to do all things' one hundred times in a day, no one will have done better than him except for someone who does more than that." I heard the teacher Abu al-Walid al-Qurashi saying, "I heard Ibrahim ibn Abi Talib saying, 'I heard Ishaq ibn Ibrahim saying, 'If the narrator is trustworthy, then he is like Ayyub reporting from Nafi' reporting from Ibn Umar.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo din mein sau (100) martaba kahe: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer' (Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, badshahi usi ki hai aur hamd usi ki hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai), to koi bhi shakhs jo usse pehle guzra ho usse aage nahi nikal sakega, aur koi bhi jo uske baad aaye usse (sawaab mein) na pahunch sakega, siwaye uske jo isse behtar amal kare." Maine Ustad Abu Al-Waleed Al-Qurashi ko kehte hue suna, unhone Ibrahim bin Abi Talib ko kehte hue suna, unhone Ishaq bin Ibrahim ko kehte hue suna: "Jab Amr bin Shu'aib se riwayat karne wala thiqa ho, to woh Ayyub ki, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar (RA) se, riwayat jaisa hai."

e: [AI] "We were in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when he said, 'Is there a stranger among you?' meaning the people of the Book. We replied, 'No, O Messenger of Allah.' He then ordered the door to be closed and said, 'Raise your hands and say, "There is no god but Allah." ' We raised our hands for a while, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  placed his hand down and said, 'All praise is due to Allah. O Allah, you have sent me with this word, commanded me to follow it, and promised me Paradise in return for it. Surely, you do not break your promise.' Then he said, 'Rejoice, for surely Allah has forgiven you.'"
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas the ke aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum mein koi ajnabi (ghair-Muslim, Ahl-e-Kitab) to nahi?" Humne kaha: "Nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." To aap (SAW) ne darwaza band karne ka hukum diya, phir farmaya: "Apne haath uthaao aur kaho: 'La ilaha illallah.'" Humne apne haath thodi der uthaaye rakhe, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne apna haath neeche kiya aur farmaya: "Alhamdulillah, Aye Allah, tune mujhe is kalime ke sath bheja hai, aur mujhe iska hukum diya hai, aur mujhse iske badle Jannat ka wada kiya hai, beshak tu wada khilaafi nahi karta." Phir farmaya: "Khushkhabri ho tumhein, kyunke Allah ne tumhein maaf kar diya hai."

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , "Whoever says 'There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, alone, without any partners. To Him belongs the kingdom and all praise, and He is capable of all things' ten times, they will be rewarded as if they have freed a slave."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer' (Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, badshahi usi ki hai aur hamd usi ki hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai) dus (10) martaba kahe, to yeh aik ghulam azaad karne ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] From Abu Abdullah Al-Jassari, who heard it from Hyyun min Anazah, who heard it from Abdullah ibn As-Samit, who heard it from Abu Dharr, who said: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, which speech is most beloved to Allah, from my mother and father?" He said, "Whatever Allah has chosen for His angels to say, 'Glory be to my Lord, and praise be to Him'."
hi: Abu Abdullah Al-Jasri se - jo Anazah qabile ke aik shakhs hain - unhone Abdullah bin As-Samit se, unhone Abu Dharr (RA) se riwayat ki, unhone kaha: maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, Allah ko sabse zyada pasand kaunsi baat hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh jo Allah ne apne farishton ke liye pasand ki: 'Subhana Rabbi wa bihamdihi, Subhana Rabbi wa bihamdihi' (Paak hai mera Rab aur usi ki tareef hai, paak hai mera Rab aur usi ki tareef hai)."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever says: ‘Glory is to Allah, the Magnificent, and with His Praise (Subḥān Allāhil-Aẓīm, wa biḥamdih)’ a date-palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3464)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo 'Subhanallahil-Azeem' (Paak hai Allah, sabse bada) kahe, uske liye Jannat mein aik khajoor ka darakht lagaya jaata hai."

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about the interpretation of "Subhan Allah". He said, "It is the glorification of Allah and His purity from all evil."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se 'Subhanallah' ki tafseer ke baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Allah ko har buraai se paak qaraar dena hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to frequently say, "Subhanak Allahumma wa bihamdik Allahumma ighfir li" (Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me). But when the verse "When the help of Allah comes and the victory" [Surah An-Nasr, verse 1] was revealed, he said, "Subhanak Allahumma Allahumma ighfir li, innaka antal Wahhab" (Glory be to You, O Allah! O Allah, forgive me. You are the Generous Bestower). This is a valid chain of narration if Abu Ubaydah ibn Abdullah ibn Mas'ud heard it from his father and they did not omit it.
hi: Nabi (SAW) aksar farmaya karte the: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, Allahummaghfir li" (Paak hai tu, Aye Allah, aur teri hi tareef hai, Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar de). Jab yeh nazil hui: "{Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aa jaaye}" (Surah An-Nasr 1), to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Subhanaka Allahumma, Allahummaghfir li, innaka antal-Wahhab" (Paak hai tu, Aye Allah, Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar de, beshak tu hi bohot ata karne wala hai). Yeh sanad sahih hai agar Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah bin Mas'ud ne apne walid Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se suna ho, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] He heard the Prophet ﷺ saying: Whoever says "Subhanallah (Glory be to Allah), Alhamdulillah (All praise be to Allah), La ilaha illa Allah (There is no god except Allah), Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest), and there is no power or strength except with Allah," Allah says: "My servant has submitted and surrendered."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo 'Subhanallah, wal-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' kahe, Allah farmata hai: 'Mera bandah farmaanbardaar ho gaya aur (mere aage) supurd ho gaya.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The first people to be called to Paradise are those who praise Allah in times of ease and hardship."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse pehle Jannat ki taraf bulaaye jaayenge woh log jo khushi aur museebat dono mein Allah ki hamd karte hain."

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'The best of remembrance is La ilaha illallah (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah), and the best of supplication is Al-Hamdu Lillah (praise is to Allah).'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3800)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: Sabse afzal zikr 'La ilaha illallah' hai, aur sabse afzal dua 'Alhamdulillah' hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no person on Earth who says, 'There is no deity except Allah, Allah is the Greatest, Glory be to Allah, Praise be to Allah, and there is no power or strength except with Allah,' except that his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as abundant as the foam of the sea." This was narrated by Shu'bah from Abi Balj Yahya ibn Abi Sulaim, and he narrated it standing.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zameen par koi aisa aadmi nahi jo 'La ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, wa Subhanallah, wal-hamdulillah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' kahe, magar uske gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain, chahe woh samundar ke jhaag se bhi zyada hon." Ise Shu'bah ne Abu Balj Yahya bin Abi Sulaim se riwayat kiya hai, aur unhone ise mauqoof (raawi tak mahdood) bataya hai.

e: [AI] "And Ahmad al-Qa'nabi informed us, narrating from Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Hanbal, who narrated from my father, who narrated from Muhammad ibn Ja'far, who narrated from Shu'bah, who narrated from Abu Balj, who narrated from Amru ibn Maymun, who narrated from Abdullah ibn Amr, that he said: Whoever says, 'There is no god but Allah, and Allah is the greatest, and all praise is due to Allah, and glory be to Allah abundantly, and there is no power or might except with Allah,' his sins will be forgiven, even if they were to be more than the foam of the sea. This is a hadith of Hatim ibn Abi Saghira, authenticated according to the conditions of Muslim, and the addition to it is acceptable."
hi: Ahmad Al-Qa'nabi ne humein khabar di, unhein Abdullah bin Ahmad bin Hanbal ne bataya, unhein mere waalid ne bataya, unhein Muhammad bin Ja'far ne bataya, unhein Shu'bah ne, Abu Balj se, unhone Amr bin Maimoon se, unhone Abdullah bin Amr (RA) se, ke unhone kaha: "Jo 'La ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, wal-hamdulillah, wa Subhanallah' bohot zyada aur 'la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' kahe, uski khataayen maaf ho jaati hain, chahe woh samundar ke jhaag se bhi zyada hon." Hatim bin Abi Saghirah ki hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, kyunke aise (thiqa raawi) se ziyaadti qubool ki jaati hai.

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What you mention of glory of Allah, of Tabsih (Subhan-Allah), Tahlil (Allahu-Akbar) and Tahmid (Al-Hamdu lillah), revolves around the Throne, buzzing like bees, reminding of the one who said it. Wouldn't any one of you like to have, or continue to have, something that reminds of him (in the presence of Allah)?'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3809)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ki azmat mein se hai ke jo tasbeeh, tahmeed aur tahleel woh (log) karte hain, woh Arsh ke ird-gird ghoomti hain, unki gunj hoti hai shehad ki makkhiyon ki gunj jaisi, jo apne kehne wale ko yaad dilaati hain, to kya tum mein se koi yeh pasand nahi karta ke Allah ke nazdeek uske liye koi aisi cheez ho jo use uski yaad dilaaye?"

e: I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and a man was offering prayer. He then made supplication: O Allah, I ask Thee by virtue of the fact that praise is due to Thee, there is no deity but Thou, Who showest favour and beneficence, the Originator of the Heavens and the earth, O Lord of Majesty and Splendour, O Living One, O Eternal One. The Prophet ﷺ then said: He has supplicated Allah using His Greatest Name, when supplicated by this name, He answers, and when asked by this name He gives. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1495)
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke sath aik halqe mein thay, aik shakhs khada namaz padh raha tha, jab usne ruku aur sajda kiya, tashahhud padha aur dua ki, to apni dua mein kaha: "Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-anna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa anta, badi'us-samawati wal-ard, ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram, ya Hayyu ya Qayyum" (Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon is baat ke wasile se ke sab tareef teri hai, tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aasmano aur zameen ke ijaad karne wale, Aye Jalaal aur Ikraam wale, Aye Zinda, Aye Qaim rehne wale). To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isne Allah ke us buzurgtareen naam se dua ki hai ke jab uske zariye dua ki jaaye to woh qubool karta hai, aur jab uske zariye maanga jaaye to woh ata karta hai."

e: I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and a man was offering prayer. He then made supplication: O Allah, I ask Thee by virtue of the fact that praise is due to Thee, there is no deity but Thou, Who showest favour and beneficence, the Originator of the Heavens and the earth, O Lord of Majesty and Splendour, O Living One, O Eternal One. The Prophet ﷺ then said: He has supplicated Allah using His Greatest Name, when supplicated by this name, He answers, and when asked by this name He gives. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1495)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko yeh kehte suna: "Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-anna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa anta, antal-Mannan, badi'us-samawati wal-ard, dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram, as'alukal-Jannah wa a'oodhu bika minan-nar" (Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon is baat ke wasile se ke sab tareef teri hai, tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tu hi bohot ehsaan karne wala hai, aasmano aur zameen ke ijaad karne wale, Jalaal aur Ikraam wale, main tujhse Jannat maangta hoon aur aag se teri panah maangta hoon). To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh us naam ke qareeb pahunch gaya hai ke jis se Allah ko pukaara jaaye to woh qubool karta hai, aur jis se maanga jaaye to woh ata karta hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard a man saying: O Allah, I ask Thee, I bear witness that there is no god but Thou, the One, He to Whom men repair, Who has not begotten, and has not been begotten, and to Whom no one is equal, and he said: You have supplicated Allah using His Greatest Name, when asked with this name He gives, and when supplicated by this name he answers. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1493)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko yeh kehte suna: "Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-annaka anta, la ilaha illa anta, Al-Ahad, As-Samad, alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan Ahad" (Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon is baat ke wasile se ke tu hi hai, tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tu Aik hai, Be-niyaz hai, jisne na kisi ko janam diya na khud janam liya, aur na hi koi uske barabar hai). To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isne Allah se uske us buzurgtareen naam se maanga hai ke jis se maanga jaaye to woh ata karta hai, aur jis se dua ki jaaye to woh qubool karta hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard a man saying: O Allah, I ask Thee, I bear witness that there is no god but Thou, the One, He to Whom men repair, Who has not begotten, and has not been begotten, and to Whom no one is equal, and he said: You have supplicated Allah using His Greatest Name, when asked with this name He gives, and when supplicated by this name he answers. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1493)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko yeh kehte suna: "Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-annaka Ahadun Samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan Ahad" (Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon is baat ke wasile se ke tu Aik, Be-niyaz hai, jisne na kisi ko janam diya na khud janam liya, aur na hi koi uske barabar hai). To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isne Allah se uske sabse buzurg aur sabse bade naam se sawaal kiya hai ke jis se dua ki jaaye to woh qubool karta hai, aur jis se maanga jaaye to woh ata karta hai."

e: [AI] Abu Darda and Ibn Abbas said, "Indeed, the greatest name of Allah is 'Rabb Rabb'."
hi: Ke Abu Darda (RA) aur Ibn Abbas (RA) dono ne kaha: "Beshak Allah ka sabse bada naam 'Rabbi, Rabbi' (Aye mere Rab, Aye mere Rab) hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Verily, the greatest name of Allah is mentioned in three Surahs of the Quran: Surah Al-Baqarah, Surah Al-Imran, and Surah Ta-Ha." Al-Qasim said, "So I sought it, and it is 'Al-Hayy, Al-Qayyum.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ka sabse bada naam Quran ki teen surahon mein hai: Surah Al-Baqarah, Aal-e-Imran, aur Ta-Ha." Al-Qasim ne kaha: "To maine ise talaash kiya, woh 'Al-Hayyul-Qayyum' (Zinda, Qaim rehne wala) hai."

e: “The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Prophet Yunus) when he supplicated, while in the belly of the whale was: ‘There is none worthy of worship except You, Glory to You, Indeed, I have been of the transgressors. (Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn)’ So indeed, no Muslim man supplicates with it for anything, ever, except Allah responds to him.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3505)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zun-Noon (Yunus AS) ki dua, jab unhone machhli ke pait mein dua ki: 'La ilaha illa anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen' (Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tu paak hai, beshak main zaalimon mein se tha), koi Musalman kabhi kisi cheez ke liye is dua se dua nahi karta magar Allah usse zaroor qubool karta hai."

e: “The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Prophet Yunus) when he supplicated, while in the belly of the whale was: ‘There is none worthy of worship except You, Glory to You, Indeed, I have been of the transgressors. (Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn)’ So indeed, no Muslim man supplicates with it for anything, ever, except Allah responds to him.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3505)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Zun-Noon (Yunus AS) ki dua, jab unhone machhli ke pait mein dua ki: "La ilaha illa anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen" (Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tu paak hai, beshak main zaalimon mein se tha), koi Musalman kabhi kisi cheez ke liye is dua se dua nahi karta magar Allah usse zaroor qubool karta hai.

e: [AI] We were sitting with the Prophet ﷺ , and he said, "Shall I not inform you of something that, if a distress or calamity were to befall one of you, he would supplicate with it and it would be relieved?" They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "It is the supplication of Dhu'l-Nun, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.'"
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas baithe thay, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein aisi cheez na bataun ke agar tum mein se kisi par duniya ki museebaton mein se koi museebat ya azmaish aaye aur woh isse dua kare to woh door ho jaaye?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zun-Noon (Yunus AS) ki dua: 'La ilaha illa anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen.'"

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Shall I not inform you of the greatest name of Allah, by which when invoked, He answers, and when asked by it, He gives?" It is the supplication that Yunus (Jonah) called upon when he was in the belly of the whale, saying, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.'" A man then asked, "O Messenger of Allah, was this supplication specific to Yunus or general for all believers?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "Don't you hear the saying of Allah the Almighty, 'And We saved him from the distress, and thus do We save the believers'?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  also said, "Whoever recites this supplication forty times during his illness, and then dies due to that illness, he will be rewarded like a martyr, and if he recovers from the illness, he will be reconciled and all his sins will be forgiven."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Kya main tumhein Allah ke sabse bade naam ki rehnumaai na karoon jise agar pukaara jaaye to woh qubool karta hai, aur jis se maanga jaaye to woh ata karta hai? Yeh woh dua hai jo Yunus (AS) ne ki thi jab unhone teen andheron mein pukaara: 'La ilaha illa anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen.'" To aik shakhs ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya yeh sirf Yunus (AS) ke liye khaas thi ya aam momino ke liye bhi?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farmaan nahi sunte: '{Aur humne unhein museebat se nijaat di, aur isi tarah hum momino ko nijaat dete hain}' (Surah Al-Anbiya 88)?" Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Musalman apni bimari mein chalees (40) martaba isse dua kare, phir usi bimari mein wafat pa jaaye, to use shaheed ka ajr milega, aur agar woh theek ho jaaye to woh theek ho jayega jabke uske sare gunah maaf ho chuke hongay."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Indeed, the greatest name of Allah is in three Surahs of the Quran: Surah Al-Baqarah, Surah Al-Imran, and Surah Taha. So, I searched for it and found it in Surah Al-Baqarah, Ayat Al-Kursi (Allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-Hayyul-Qayyum) [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:255], and in Surah Al-Imran (Alif Lam Meem Allah la ilaha illa huwa al-Hayyul-Qayyum) [Surah Al-Imran 3:2], and in Surah Taha (And the faces will humble themselves before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence) [Surah Taha 20:111]."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ka sabse bada naam Quran ki teen surahon mein hai: Surah Al-Baqarah, Aal-e-Imran, aur Ta-Ha." To maine ise talaash kiya, mujhe Surah Al-Baqarah mein Ayat-ul-Kursi mili: "{Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Zinda, Qaim rehne wala}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 255), aur Surah Aal-e-Imran mein: "{Alif Laam Meem, Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Zinda, Qaim rehne wala}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 2), aur Surah Ta-Ha mein: "{Aur chehre Zinda, Qaim rehne wale ke aage jhuk gaye}" (Surah Ta-Ha 111).

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ: "Indeed, the greatest name of Allah is found in three Surahs of the Quran." Isa ibn Musa said, while I was listening, "O Aba Zabir, I heard Ghaylan ibn Anas say that he heard Al-Qasim Abu Abdur Rahman say that he heard Abu Umamah narrate from the Prophet ﷺ: 'Indeed, the greatest name of Allah is found in three Surahs.' Then he mentioned a similar narration from Amr ibn Abi Salamah: 'This does not invalidate the hadith of Al-Walid ibn Muslim, for Al-Walid is more knowledgeable, skillful, and well-acquainted with the hadith of his land, although the two sheikhs did not rely on Al-Qasim Abu Abdur Rahman.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai: "Allah ka sabse bada naam teen surahon mein hai." Isa bin Musa ne unse kaha jabke main sun raha tha: "Aye Abu Zabr, maine Ghailan bin Anas ko kehte hue suna, unhone Al-Qasim Abu Abdur Rahman ko kehte hue suna, unhone Abu Umamah (RA) ko Nabi (SAW) se bayan karte suna: 'Allah ka sabse bada naam teen surahon mein hai.'" Phir unhone Amr bin Abi Salamah ki hadith ki tarah zikr kiya. "Yeh Al-Walid bin Muslim ki hadith ko kamzor nahi karta, kyunke Al-Walid zyada yaad rakhne wale, zyada mahir aur apne ilaqe ki hadith ke zyada jaankaar hain, halanke Shaykhain ne Al-Qasim Abu Abdur Rahman ko hujjat nahi maana."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Stand until I praise my Lord.' So they formed rows behind him. Then he said, 'O Allah, all praise is due to You. O Allah, there is no one who can withhold what You have given, nor can anyone give what You have withheld. There is no guide for the one You have led astray, nor is there anyone who can lead astray the one You have guided. There is no provider for the one You have prevented, nor is there anyone who can prevent what You have provided. There is no one who can bring closer what You have distanced, nor is there anyone who can distance what You have brought closer. O Allah, bestow upon us Your blessings, mercy, favor, and sustenance. O Allah, I ask for the blessings of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection, and security on the Day of fear. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You have granted us and from the evil of what You have withheld from us. O Allah, make faith beloved to us and beautify it in our hearts. Make disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience detested by us. Make us among the rightly guided. O Allah, cause us to die as Muslims, and let us live as Muslims. Join us with the righteous, without disgrace or trial. O Allah, combat the disbelievers who deny Your messengers and obstruct Your path. Place upon them Your curse and punishment, O Lord of Truth."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) [ne farmaya]: "Seedhe ho jao taake main apne Rab ki tareef karoon," to woh unke peechhe saffon mein khade ho gaye, phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, sari tareef teri hi hai, Aye Allah, jo tu phailaaye use koi rok nahi sakta, aur jo tu rok le use koi phaila nahi sakta, aur jise tu gumraah kare use koi hidayat nahi de sakta, aur jise tu hidayat de use koi gumraah nahi kar sakta, aur jo tu na de use koi de nahi sakta, aur jo tu de use koi rok nahi sakta, aur jise tu door kare use koi qareeb nahi kar sakta, aur jise tu qareeb kare use koi door nahi kar sakta. Aye Allah, humpar apni barkatein, apni rahmat, apna fazl aur apna rizq phaila de. Aye Allah, main tujhse Qayamat ke din ki ne'mat aur khauf ke din ki amaan maangta hoon. Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon us cheez ki buraai se jo tune humein di hai aur us cheez ki buraai se jo tune humse rok li hai. Aye Allah, humein imaan aziz bana de aur usse humare dilon mein sanwaar de, aur humein kufr, fisq aur na-farmani se napasand kar de, aur humein raah-yaab logon mein shaamil kar. Aye Allah, humein Musalman honay ki halat mein maut de, aur Musalman honay ki halat mein zindagi de, aur humein nek logon ke sath mila de, na ruswa hote huay na fitne mein padte huay. Aye Allah, un kaafiron se ladh jo teri Rasoolon ko jhutlate hain aur tere raaste se rokte hain, aur unpar apna azab aur apna qahar utaar, Aye Haqq ke Ma'bood."

e: [AI] "A time will come upon you when none will be saved except those who pray the prayer of a drowning person."
hi: "Tumpar aisa zamana aayega ke jismein sirf woh shakhs nijaat paayega jo doobne wale ki dua kare."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone eats food and then says: "Praise be to Allah Who has fed me with this food and provided me with it through no might and power on my part," he will be forgiven his former and later sins. If anyone puts on a garment and says: "Praise be to Allah Who has clothed me with this and provided me with it through no might and power on my part," he will be forgiven his former and later sins. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4023)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo khana khaaye aur kahe: 'Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghairi hawlin minni wa la quwwah' (Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe yeh khilaaya aur bagair meri kisi taaqat ke mujhe yeh rizq diya), uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain, aur jo koi kapda pehne aur kahe: 'Alhamdulillahil-ladhi kasani hadha min ghairi hawlin minni wa la quwwah' (Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe yeh pehnaaya bagair meri kisi taaqat ke), uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Whenever Allah bestows a blessing upon a servant and he says, 'Alhamdulillah (all praise be to Allah),' Allah rewards him for it. If he says it again, Allah multiplies his reward. And if he says it a third time, Allah forgives his sins."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah kisi bande par jo bhi ne'mat karta hai, agar woh 'Alhamdulillah' kahe, to usne uska shukr ada kar diya, aur agar woh doosri baar kahe to Allah uske liye sawaab ko naya kar deta hai, aur agar woh teesri baar kahe to Allah uske gunah maaf kar deta hai."

e: [AI] While they were traveling, the group stopped at dawn. Shaddad said, "Let's take a break here and have some fun." Then he said, "I seek forgiveness from Allah for speaking a word since I embraced Islam, without pondering over it and weighing it against my other words. This is not right." Muhammad ﷺ  said, "O Shaddad, if you see people hoarding gold and silver, then hoard these words: 'O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in matters, determination in righteousness, gratitude for Your blessings, excellence in worship, a sound heart, a truthful tongue, and upright character. I seek Your forgiveness for what You know, and I ask You for the best of what You know. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You know, for You are the Knower of the unseen."
hi: Woh log safar mein thay ke qaum ne subah ke waqt padaav dala, to Shaddad (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh dastarkhaan qareeb lao, hum khel karengay," phir kaha: "Astaghfirullah, jab se maine Islam qubool kiya hai maine koi baat nahi ki magar main use apne is kalime se pehle bhi rok-tok kar hi kehta tha, aisa nahi tha." Muhammad (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Shaddad, jab tum logon ko sona-chandi jama karte dekho, to tum yeh kalimaat jama karo: Aye Allah, main tujhse har maamle mein saabit-qadmi aur hidayat par pukhta iraade ka sawaal karta hoon, aur main tujhse teri ne'mat ka shukr aur teri achhi ibadat ka sawaal karta hoon, aur main tujhse aik salamat dil, sacchi zubaan, aur seedhe akhlaaq ka sawaal karta hoon, aur main tujhse un cheezon ki maghfirat maangta hoon jo tu jaanta hai, aur main tujhse un cheezon ki bhalaai maangta hoon jo tu jaanta hai, aur main un cheezon ki buraai se teri panah maangta hoon jo tu jaanta hai, beshak tu ghaib ki har baat khoob jaanne wala hai.'"

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me to say, if calamity befell me: “There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing the Most Generous; glory be to Allah, blessed be Allah, the Lord of the mighty Throne; praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 701)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaaya ke jab mujhpar koi museebat aaye to main kahun: "La ilaha illallahul-Haleemul-Kareem, Subhanallahi wa Tabarakallahu Rabbul-Arshil-Azeem, wal-hamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen" (Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh nihaayat bardaasht karne wala, bohot ata karne wala hai, paak hai Allah aur mubarak hai Allah, Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rab, aur sab tareef Allah, Rabb-ul-Aalameen, ke liye hai).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  taught me these words to say when I am afflicted with hardship or distress: "There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Honorable, Glorified and Exalted is He. Blessed is Allah, the Lord of the Great Throne, and all praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all worlds." Abdullah bin Ja'far used to teach this to a dead person and blow it on the afflicted area. Bukhari and Muslim have narrated this hadith in a summarized form from Qatadah, from Abu Al-'Aliyah, from Ibn Abbas.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe yeh kalimaat sikhaaye ke jab mujhpar sakhti ya museebat aaye to main inhein kahun: "La ilaha illallahul-Haleemul-Kareem, Subhanahu wa Ta'ala, Tabarakallahu Rabbul-Arshil-Azeem, wal-hamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen." Unhone kaha: "To Abdullah bin Ja'far (RA) marne wale ko yeh sikhaate the aur bukhaar zada shakhs par isse dam karte the." Bukhari aur Muslim ne yeh hadith mukhtasar tor par Qatadah ki, Abu Al-Aaliyah se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, riwayat mein nikala hai.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was afflicted with worry or distress, he would say, "O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, I seek help through Your mercy."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab unpar koi fikr ya ghum aata to farmate: "Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astagheeth" (Aye Zinda, Aye Qaim rehne wale, teri rahmat ke wasile se madad maangta hoon).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whenever I faced a difficulty, Gabriel appeared to me in the form of a man and said, 'O Muhammad! Say: I have relied on the Ever-living, the One who does not die, and praise be to Allah who has never taken a son, nor does He have any partner in His Kingdom, nor is He in need of a protector out of weakness. And magnify Him with all magnificence.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhpar koi bhi museebat nahi aati magar Jibra'il (AS) mere saamne aa jaate hain aur kehte hain: 'Aye Muhammad, kaho: Tawakkaltu alal-Hayyil-ladhi la yamoot, wal-hamdulillahil-ladhi lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu shareekun fil-mulki wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun minaz-zulli wa kabbirhu takbeera (Maine us Zinda Zaat par bharosa kiya jo kabhi nahi marega, aur sab tareef us Allah ke liye hai jisne na kisi ko beta banaya, na uska koi shareek badshahi mein hai, na hi usse kisi madadgaar ki zaroorat kamzori ki wajah se hai, aur uski buland tareen buzurgi bayan karo).'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No Muslim is afflicted with any hardship or grief, and they say: 'O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant, my forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is forever executed, and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You have named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my chest, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.' So Allah will remove his hardship and replace it with ease." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, should we not learn these words?" He replied, "Of course, whoever hears them should learn them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Musalman ko kabhi bhi koi fikr ya ghum nahi aata aur woh kahe: 'Allahumma inni abduka wabnu amatika, naasiyati bi-yadika, maadin fiyya hukmuka, adlun fiyya qada'uka, as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka sammaita bihi nafsaka aw anzaltahu fi kitabika aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqika awista'tharta bihi fi ilmil-ghaibi indaka an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabee'a qalbi wa jala'a huzni wa dhahaba hammi' (Aye Allah, main tera bandah hoon, tere bandi (behen) ka beta hoon, meri paishani teri hi haath mein hai, tera hukum mujh par jaari hai, tera faisla mujhpar aadil hai, main tujhse tere har us naam ke wasile se sawaal karta hoon jo tera hai, jo tu ne apne aap ko diya, ya apni kitaab mein nazil kiya, ya apni kisi makhlooq ko sikhaya, ya apne paas ghaib ke ilm mein rakh liya, ke tu Quran ko mere dil ki bahaar, mere ghum ki safaai, aur meri fikr ka khatma bana de),' magar Allah uski fikr door kar deta hai aur uske ghum ki jagah khushi de deta hai." Sahaba ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya hum yeh kalimaat na seekhein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kyun nahi, jo bhi inhein sune use inhein seekhna chahiye."

e: [AI] The translation of the phrase is: "The Prophet ﷺ  used to supplicate, saying, 'O Allah, suffice me with what You have provided me, and bless it for me, and replace any loss I have with something better.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) yeh dua kiya karte the: "Allahumma qanni'ni bima razaqtani wa barik li fihi wakhluf ala kulli gha'ibatin li bikhair" (Aye Allah, jo tu ne mujhe diya hai usi par mujhe qana'at ata kar, aur usme mere liye barkat de, aur meri har ghair-hazir cheez ka mujhe achha badla de).

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah used to say, 'O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, and teach me what will benefit me, and grant me knowledge that will be beneficial for me.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) yeh dua kiya karte the: "Allahummanfa'ni bima allamtani wa allimni ma yanfa'uni warzuqni ilman tanfa'uni bihi" (Aye Allah, jo tu ne mujhe sikhaaya hai usse mujhe faida pahuncha, aur mujhe woh sikha jo mujhe faida de, aur mujhe aisa ilm ata kar jisse tu mujhe faida pahunchaaye).

e: [AI] "He came to the Prophet ﷺ before embracing Islam. When he wanted to leave, he asked, "What should I say?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Say, 'O Allah, protect me from the evil of myself and guide me to do what is right.' " He said it and then left without embracing Islam. Later, he embraced Islam and asked the Prophet ﷺ, "What should I say now that I have embraced Islam?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Say, 'O Allah, protect me from the evil of myself and guide me to do what is right. O Allah, forgive me for what I have hidden, what I have made public, what I have done mistakenly, what I have done intentionally, what I have known, and what I have been ignorant of.' "
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas Islam qubool karne se pehle aaya, jab woh jaane laga to poocha: "Main kya kahoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma qini sharra nafsi wa'zim li ala arshadi amri' (Aye Allah, mujhe apne nafs ki buraai se bacha, aur mere liye sabse seedhe maamle par pukhta iraada kar)." Usne yeh kaha, phir woh chala gaya aur Islam qubool nahi kiya. Phir usne Islam qubool kiya aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), ab main kya kahoon jabke maine Islam qubool kar liya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma qini sharra nafsi wa'zim li ala arshadi amri, Allahummaghfir li ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu wa ma akhta'tu wa ma amadtu wa ma alimtu wa ma jahiltu' (Aye Allah, mujhe apne nafs ki buraai se bacha, aur mere liye sabse seedhe maamle par pukhta iraada kar, Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar de jo maine chhupaaya, jo zaahir kiya, jo galti se kiya, jo jaan-boojh kar kiya, jo jaanta hoon, aur jo nahi jaanta)."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Al-Mughirah or Al-Mughirah Abu Al-Walid narrating about Hudhayfah that he said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am a person whose tongue slips, and this often affects my family." He said, "So where are you in seeking forgiveness? Verily, I seek forgiveness from Allah a hundred times in a day and night, or in a night or in a day."
hi: Maine Abu Al-Mughirah, ya Al-Mughirah Abu Al-Waleed, ko Hudhaifah (RA) se hadith bayan karte suna, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main tez-zubaan aadmi hoon, aur iska zyada hissa mere ghar walon par hota hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To tum istighfaar se kahan ho? Main to din-raat mein - ya raat mein ya din mein - sau (100) martaba Allah se istighfaar karta hoon."

e: [AI] I used to have a problem with my tongue towards my family, so I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I fear that my tongue will lead me to Hell." He said, "So where are you with seeking forgiveness? Verily, I seek forgiveness from Allah one hundred times a day." Abu Ishaq said, "I mentioned that to Abu Burdah, and he said, 'And I repent.'"
hi: Main apne ghar walon ke saath tez-zubaan tha, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe darr hai ke meri zubaan mujhe Jahannam mein na le jaaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To tum istighfaar se kahan ho? Main to din mein sau (100) martaba Allah se istighfaar karta hoon." Abu Ishaq ne kaha: to maine yeh baat Abu Burdah ko bataayi, unhone kaha: "'wa atoob' (aur main tauba karta hoon) bhi (kaha karte the)."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "O Allah! Indeed, I seek your forgiveness for what I have done in the past and what I will do in the future, what I have made public and what I have concealed. You are the One who brings forward and the One who delays, and You are capable of all things."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Allahumma inni astaghfiruka lima qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu wa ma a'lantu wa ma asrartu, antal-Muqaddimu wa antal-Mu'akhkhiru wa anta ala kulli shai'in qadeer" (Aye Allah, main tujhse maghfirat maangta hoon jo maine aage kiya aur jo pichhe rakha, jo zaahir kiya aur jo chhupaaya, tu hi aage badhaane wala hai aur tu hi pichhe rakhne wala hai, aur tu har cheez par qaadir hai).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever says, 'Astaghfirullah al-'Azeem, alladhee la ilaha illa huwal Hayyul Qayyum, wa atubu ilayhi,' three times, his sins will be forgiven, even if he had run away from the battle."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo 'Astaghfirullahal-Azeem alladhi la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilaihi' teen martaba kahe, uske gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain, chahe woh jung se bhaagne wala hi kyun na ho."

e: [AI] Abu Salamah, the shepherd of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , told me and I met him in the mosque of Kufa. He said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Bah, bah, and khams (five), nothing weighs heavier in the scale than them: Subhan Allah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar, and a righteous child who dies and the Muslim parent expects reward from Allah for their patience.'"
hi: Mujhe Abu Salma (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke charwaahe, ne hadith bayan ki, main unse Kufa ki masjid mein mila, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Bakh, Bakh, paanch cheezon par, taraazu mein woh kitni bhaari hain: Subhanallah, wal-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, aur woh nek aulaad jo kisi Musalman ki wafat pa jaaye aur woh (sabr par) ajr ki ummeed rakhe."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah has chosen specific phrases from Subhan Allah (glory be to Allah), Alhamdulillah (praise be to Allah), La ilaha illallah (there is no god but Allah), and Allahu akbar (Allah is the greatest). When a servant says Subhan Allah, Allah writes for him twenty good deeds and removes from him twenty bad deeds. When a servant says Allahu akbar, the same happens. And when a servant says La ilaha illallah, the same happens. And when a servant says Alhamdulillah, the Lord of all worlds, on his own, thirty good deeds are written for him and thirty bad deeds are removed from him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne kalaam mein se 'Subhanallah', 'Alhamdulillah', 'La ilaha illallah' aur 'Allahu Akbar' ko chun liya hai. Jab bandah 'Subhanallah' kahe, Allah uske liye bees (20) nekiyaan likhta hai aur bees buraiyaan mita deta hai, aur jab woh 'Allahu Akbar' kahe to isi tarah, aur jab woh 'La ilaha illallah' kahe to isi tarah, aur jab bandah apni taraf se 'Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen' kahe, to uske liye tees (30) nekiyaan likhi jaati hain aur tees buraiyaan mita di jaati hain."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by him when he was planting a plant, and said: "O Abu Hurairah, what are you planting?" I said: "A plant for me." He said: "Shall I not tell you of a plant that is better than this?" He said: "Of course, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Say: 'Subhan-Allah, wal-hamdu-lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wa Allahu Akbar (Glory is to Allah, praise is to Allah, none has the right to be worshiped but Allah and Allah is the Most Great.)' For each one a tree will be planted for you in Paradise." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3807)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas se guzre jabke woh paudha laga rahe the, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya kar rahe ho, Aye Abu Hurairah?" Unhone kaha: "Paudha laga raha hoon." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein isse behtar paudhe ki taraf rehnumaai na karoon?" Maine kaha: "Woh kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "'Subhanallah, wal-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar,' har aik ke badle tumhare liye aik darakht lagaya jayega."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever says: ‘Glory is to Allah, the Magnificent, and with His Praise (Subḥān Allāhil-Aẓīm, wa biḥamdih)’ a date-palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3464)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo 'Subhanallahil-Azeem' kahe, uske liye Jannat mein aik khajoor ka darakht lagaya jaata hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Increase in performing good deeds.' It was asked, 'What are those good deeds, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied, 'The remembrance of Allah, saying Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest), La ilaha illallah (there is no deity but Allah), SubhanAllah (Glory be to Allah), Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah), and La hawla wala quwwata illa billah (There is no power or strength except with Allah).' This is the most authentic narration of the Egyptians and they did not exclude it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Baaqi rehne wali nekiyon ko zyada karo." Poocha gaya: "Woh kya hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "'Al-Millah' (deen ki baatein)." Poocha gaya: "Woh kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Takbeer, tahleel, tasbeeh, tahmeed, aur 'la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.'" Yeh Misr walon ki sabse sahih sanad hai, magar dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Prophet (pbuh) said, "Whoever says Allahu Akbar (God is the Greatest) once, twenty good deeds will be written for him and twenty bad deeds will be erased. And whoever says Subhanallah (Glory be to Allah) once, twenty good deeds will be written for him and twenty bad deeds will be erased. And whoever says Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah) once, thirty good deeds will be written for him and thirty bad deeds will be erased."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo aik martaba takbeer kahe, uske liye bees (20) nekiyaan likhi jaati hain aur bees buraiyaan mita di jaati hain, aur jo aik martaba tasbeeh kahe, uske liye bees nekiyaan likhi jaati hain aur bees buraiyaan mita di jaati hain, aur jo aik martaba tahmeed kahe, uske liye tees (30) nekiyaan likhi jaati hain aur tees buraiyaan mita di jaati hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "There is no servant who recites 'Alhamdulillah' (praise be to Allah) as many times as the number of His creations, and there is no servant who recites 'Alhamdulillah' filling what Allah has created, and there is no servant who recites 'Alhamdulillah' as many times as what is in the heavens and the earth, and there is no servant who recites 'Alhamdulillah' as many times as the number that His book enumerates, and there is no servant who recites 'Alhamdulillah' as many times as everything and glorified is Allah and similar to them." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "That is the greatest."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bandah nahi jo kahe: 'Alhamdulillahi adada ma khalaqallah, wal-hamdulillahi mil'a ma khalaqallah, wal-hamdulillahi adada ma fis-samawati wal-ard, wal-hamdulillahi adada ma ahsa kitabuhu, wal-hamdulillahi adada kulli shai', wa Subhanallahi mithlahunna' (Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, uski har cheez ki tadaad ke barabar jo usne paida ki, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, jo kuch usne paida kiya usse bharpoor, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai uski tadaad ke barabar, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, uski kitaab ne jo kuch shumaar kiya uski tadaad ke barabar, sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, har cheez ki tadaad ke barabar, aur Allah paak hai isi tadaad mein)." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne isse bohot azeem qaraar diya.

e: AbuBakr as-Siddiq said: Messenger of Allah! command me something to say in the morning and in the evening. He said: Say "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who knowest the unseen and the seen, Lord and Possessor of everything. I testify that there is no god but Thee; I seek refuge in Thee from the evil within myself, from the evil of the devil, and his (incitement to) attributing partners (to Allah)." He said: Say this in the morning. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5067)
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se poocha aur kaha: "Mujhe kuch aise kalimaat bataiye jo main subah aur shaam kahun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Aalimal-ghaibi wash-shahadah, Rabba kulli shai'in wa malikahu, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsi wa sharrish-shaitani wa shirkihi' (Aye Allah, aasmano aur zameen ke banaane wale, ghaib aur zaahir ke jaanne wale, har cheez ke Rab aur uske Maalik, main gawahi deta hoon ke tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, main teri panah maangta hoon apne nafs ki buraai se aur Shaitan aur uske shirk ki buraai se)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse subah, shaam, aur jab tum apne bistar par jao, tab kaho."

e: [AI] I said, "O Prophet of Allah, I am a woman who has become old and weak, so guide me towards a deed." He said, "Glorify Allah one hundred times, praise Allah one hundred times, and exalt Allah one hundred times. It is better for you than offering one hundred acceptable sacrifices, better than riding one hundred well-trained horses for the sake of Allah, and better than freeing one hundred slaves whose freedom is accepted. Saying 'there is no god but Allah' does not leave any sin or action similar to it."
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, main aik aurat hoon jo boodhi aur kamzor ho chuki hoon, mujhe koi amal bataiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sau (100) martaba Allah ki takbeer kaho, sau martaba Allah ki hamd karo, aur sau martaba Allah ki tasbeeh karo, yeh tumhare liye sau maqbool oonton se, aur sau zeen-lagam wale ghodon se Allah ki raah mein, aur sau maqbool ghulam azaad karne se behtar hai, aur 'La ilaha illallah' kehna koi gunah nahi chhodta aur koi amal isse mel nahi khaata."

e:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Never a blessing that Allah bestows upon a servant and he realizes that it is from Allah, except that Allah writes down his gratitude for it even before he praises Him for it. 
Never a servant commits a sin and he feels remorse for it, except that Allah writes down his forgiveness for it even before he seeks His forgiveness. 
And never a servant purchases a garment for a dirham or half a dirham, and he wears it and praises Allah for it, except that Allah forgives him before his knees to touch the ground ˹in prayer˺."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah kisi bande par jo bhi ne'mat karta hai aur woh jaan le ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai, magar Allah uske liye uska shukr likh deta hai isse pehle ke woh Allah ki tareef kare. Aur koi bandah koi gunah nahi karta phir uspar nadaamat mehsoos karta hai, magar Allah uske liye uski maghfirat likh deta hai isse pehle ke woh Allah se maafi maange. Aur koi bandah aik dinar ya aadhe dinar ka kapda nahi khareedta, phir use pehen kar Allah ki tareef karta hai, magar uske ghutne (sajda mein) zameen tak nahi pahunchte jab tak Allah use maaf na kar de."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Whoever says in the morning and evening of every day the following words: 'In the name of Allah with Whose name nothing in the earth or sky can harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing,' three times, nothing will harm him."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Koi bandah nahi jo har din ki subah aur har raat ki shaam yeh kahe: 'Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shai'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama, wa huwas-Samee'ul-Alim' (Allah ke naam se jiske naam ke sath zameen aur aasman mein koi cheez nuqsaan nahi pahuncha sakti, aur woh Sunne wala, Jaanne wala hai) teen martaba, magar usse koi cheez nuqsaan nahi pahunchaati."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone says in the morning or in the evening: "O Allah! Thou art my Lord; there is no god but Thee, Thou hast created me, and I am Thy servant and hold to Thy covenant and promise as much as I can; I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I have done: I acknowledge Thy favour to me, and I acknowledge my sin; pardon me, for none but Thee pardons sins, and dies during the daytime or during the night." he will go to Paradise. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5070)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kahe: 'Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana abduka wa ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'oodhu bika min kulli ma sana'tu wa aboo'u bidhanbi faghfir li dhunoobi innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunooba illa anta' (Aye Allah, tu mera Rab hai, tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tune mujhe paida kiya aur main tera bandah hoon, aur main apni taaqat ke mutabiq tere ahd aur wade par qaayam hoon, main teri panah maangta hoon un sab cheezon se jo maine kiya, aur main apne gunah ka iqraar karta hoon, isliye mere gunah maaf kar de, kyunke tere siwa koi gunah maaf nahi karta),' phir usi din ya usi raat mar jaaye, to woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "No one among you can do a thousand good deeds until he says 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi' (Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him) a hundred times in the morning. It is equal to a thousand good deeds and he will not do anything like it in his day except for that, and much more."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi bhi hazaar (1000) nekiyaan nahi kar sakta jab tak woh subah 'Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi' sau (100) martaba na kahe, kyunke yeh hazaar nekiyon ke barabar hai, aur usne Insha'Allah usi din itne hi gunah nahi kiye hongay, aur iske ilawa jo bhi neki karega woh (alag se) poori rahegi."

e:
Abū Bakr came to me and said, "Have you heard a supplication from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he taught me?" I asked, "What is it?" He said, "Jesus, the son of Mary, used to teach it to his companions. If any of you had a debt as great as a mountain, and he invoked Allah with it, Allah would fulfill it for him. Say: allāhuma fārij al-hamm, kāshif al-ghamm, mujība daʿwat al-muḍṭarrīn, Raḥmān al-dunyā wa-al-ākhirah wa-raḥīmahumā, anta tarḥamunī, fa-irḥamnī bi-raḥmatin tughnīnī bihā ʿan raḥmati man siwāk (O Allah, reliever of distress, dispeller of sorrow, answerer of the supplication of the distressed, al-Raḥmān (Most Merciful) of the world and the Hereafter and the One Who who bestows mercy upon them, You are the One who ˹also˺ bestows mercy upon me, so bestow mercy upon me with a mercy that will suffice me from the mercy of anyone other than You.)"
Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq said, "I had some remaining debt that I was a burden on me. I invoked Allah with this supplication, and Allah fulfilled it for me."
ʿĀʾishah said, "Asmāʾ b. ʿUmays had a debt of one dinar and three dirhams upon me, and she used to visit me. I was embarrassed to face her because I had nothing to pay her with. So, I invoked Allah with this supplication, and soon after, Allah provided me with some wealth, not as charity to be given, nor as a heritage received, but Allah settled it for me. I distributed a good share among my relatives and set free the slave girl of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān with three 'ūqiyyah and he had a good favor upon us."[^1]
hi: Abu Bakr (RA) mere paas aaye aur poochne lage: "Kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se koi aisi dua suni hai jo unhone mujhe sikhaayi thi?" Maine poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Isa bin Maryam (AS) apne sahaba (RA) ko yeh sikhaate the." Unhone kaha: "Agar tum mein se kisi par sone ke pahaad jitna qarz ho aur woh isse Allah se dua kare, to Allah use uski taraf se ada kar dega: 'Allahumma Farijal-Hamm, Kashifal-Ghamm, Mujiba Da'watil-Mudtarreen, Rahmanad-Dunya wal-Aakhirati wa Raheemahuma, Anta Tarhamuni, Farhamni bi-Rahmatin Tughnini biha an Rahmati man Siwaak' (Aye Allah, museebat door karne wale, ghum hataane wale, bebason ki pukaar sunne wale, duniya aur aakhirat ke Rahman aur Raheem, tu mujhpar reham karta hai, to mujhpar aisa reham kar jo mujhe tere siwa har kisi ke reham se be-niyaz kar de)." Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne kaha: "Mere zimme kuch qarz baaqi tha, aur main qarz se nafrat karta tha, to main yeh dua karta raha, phir Allah ne mujhe faida diya aur mera qarz ada ho gaya." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Asma bint Umais (RA) ke mere zimme aik dinar aur teen dirham the, woh mere paas aati thin, aur mujhe unke chehre ki taraf dekhne mein sharm aati thi kyunke mere paas unhein dene ke liye kuch nahi hota tha. To main yeh dua karti rahi, thodi hi der guzri thi ke Allah ne mujhe aisa rizq ata kiya jo na koi sadqa tha jo mujhpar kiya gaya ho, na koi meeraath jo maine paayi ho, to Allah ne mera qarz ada karwa diya, aur maine apne ghar walon mein aik achhi taqseem ki, aur maine Abdur Rahman (RA) ki beti ko teen auqiya chandi (ke zewar) se sanwaara, aur humare paas kaafi kuch bach gaya."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Everything that the son of Adam speaks is recorded against him. So if he makes a mistake and wants to repent to Allah, let him go to His highness and stretch out his hands to Allah, the Almighty. Then let him say: O Allah, I repent to You from it and I will never return to it again. For indeed, what he does not return to in his actions will be forgiven for him."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ibn Adam jo bhi baat karta hai, woh uske khilaaf likh di jaati hai, isliye agar woh koi galti kare aur Allah ki taraf tauba karna chahe, to woh apni buland jagah par aaye aur Allah ki taraf apne dono haath phailaaye, phir kahe: 'Aye Allah, main isse tauba karta hoon, kabhi bhi isse dobara nahi karunga,' to jab tak woh us amal ki taraf wapas nahi jaata, use maaf kar diya jaata hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, taught him and commanded him to make a pact with his family every morning, saying: "Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. All good is in Your hands, and the evil is not attributed to You. Here I am. Whatever I say, or swear, or vow, Your will comes before all of that. Whatever You will, it happens, and whatever You do not will, does not happen. There is no power or ability except through You. Indeed, You are capable of everything. O Allah, whatever I pray, I ask You to bestow it upon the one I prayed for. Whatever I curse, I ask You to curse the one I cursed. You are my guardian in this world and in the Hereafter. Make me die as a Muslim and join me with the righteous. O Allah, I ask You for satisfaction after decree, and coolness after death, and the pleasure of looking at Your face, and the eagerness to meet You without any harm or misleading trial. I seek Your protection from oppressing or being oppressed, transgressing or being transgressed upon, committing a sinful act or bringing about a sin that You do not forgive. O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Owner of majesty and honor. I make my pledge to You in this world, and I bear witness to You (that I have done that), and it is enough for You as a witness that I bear witness that there is no god but You alone, with no partner, Yours is the dominion, and Yours is the praise, and You are capable of everything. And I bear witness that Muhammad is Your slave and Messenger, and I bear witness that Your promise is true, and meeting You is true, and the Hour is coming, there is no doubt in it, and that You will resurrect those who are in the graves. And if You entrust me to myself, You entrust me to weakness, vulnerability, sin, and error. And I have no trust except in Your mercy. So forgive all of my sins, for indeed, no one forgives sins except You, and accept my repentance, for indeed, You are the Acceptor of repentance, the Merciful."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein sikhaya aur hukum diya ke woh har subah apne ghar walon se yeh ahd karein: "Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik, wa Sa'daik, wal-khairu fi yadaik, wa minka wa ilaik. Allahumma ma qultu min qawlin aw halaftu min hilfin aw nadhartu min nadhrin, fa mashee'atuka baina yadai dhalika kullihi, ma shi'ta kana wa ma lam tasha' la yakoon, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bik, innaka ala kulli shai'in qadeer. Allahumma ma sallaitu min salatin fa ala man sallaita, wa ma la'antu min la'nin fa ala man la'anta, anta waliyyi fid-dunya wal-aakhirah, tawaffani Musliman wa alhiqni bis-saliheen. Allahumma inni as'alukar-rida ba'dal-qada, wa barda-l-'aishi ba'dal-mawt, wa ladhdhatan-nazari ila wajhika, wa shawqan ila liqa'ika, fi ghairi darra'a mudirratin wa la fitnatin mudillah. Wa a'oodhu bika an azlima aw uzlama aw a'tadiya aw yu'tada alayya aw aksiba khati'atan aw dhanban la taghfir. Allahumma Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Aalimal-ghaibi wash-shahadah, Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram, fa inni a'ahadu ilaika fi hadhihid-dunya wa ushhiduka, wa kafa bika shahida, anni ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika lak, lakal-mulku wa lakal-hamdu, wa anta ala kulli shai'in qadeer, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduka wa rasooluka, wa ashhadu anna wa'daka haqqun wa liqa'aka haqqun, was-sa'atu atiyatun la raiba fiha, wa annaka tab'athu man fil-quboor, wa annaka in takilni ila nafsi takilni ila da'fin wa awratin wa dhanbin wa khati'ah, wa inni la athiqu illa bi-rahmatik, faghfir li dhunoobi kulliha, innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunooba illa anta, wa tub alayya innaka antat-Tawwabur-Raheem" (Main haazir hoon, Aye Allah, main haazir hoon, aur teri madad ke liye tayyar hoon, aur bhalaai tere haath mein hai, aur woh tujhi se hai aur tujhi ki taraf hai. Aye Allah, jo bhi baat maine kahi ho ya jo bhi qasam khaayi ho ya jo bhi nazar maani ho, teri mashiyat un sab par muqaddam hai, jo tu chahega hoga aur jo tu na chahe woh nahi hoga, aur koi taaqat aur qudrat sirf teri hi wajah se hai, beshak tu har cheez par qaadir hai. Aye Allah, jo bhi dua maine ki ho, woh us shakhs ke liye ho jiske liye tu chahe, aur jo bhi la'nat maine bheji ho, woh us shakhs par ho jispar tu la'nat bheje, tu hi mera madadgaar hai duniya aur aakhirat mein, mujhe Musalman honay ki halat mein maut de aur mujhe nek logon ke sath mila. Aye Allah, main tujhse taqdeer ke baad raza-mandi, maut ke baad zindagi ki thandak, tere chehre ko dekhne ki lazzat, aur tujhse milne ki tamanna maangta hoon, bagair kisi nuqsaan-deh takleef ke aur bagair kisi gumraah karne wale fitne ke. Aur main teri panah maangta hoon is baat se ke main zulm karoon ya mujhpar zulm ho, ya main zyaadti karoon ya mujhpar zyaadti ho, ya main koi aisi khataa ya gunah kama loon jo tu maaf na kare. Aye Allah, aasmano aur zameen ke banaane wale, ghaib aur zaahir ke jaanne wale, Jalaal aur Ikraam wale, main is duniya mein tujhse ahd karta hoon aur tujhe gawah banaata hoon, aur tera gawah hona hi kaafi hai, ke main gawahi deta hoon ke tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tu akela hai, tera koi shareek nahi, badshahi teri hai aur tareef teri hai, aur tu har cheez par qaadir hai, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad tera bandah aur Rasool hai, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke tera wada haq hai aur tujhse milna haq hai, aur Qayamat aane wali hai jismein koi shak nahi, aur beshak tu qabron mein maujood logon ko uthaayega, aur beshak agar tu mujhe mere hawale kar de to tu mujhe kamzori, kami, gunah aur khataa ke hawale kar dega, aur main sirf teri hi rahmat par bharosa karta hoon, isliye mere sare gunah maaf kar de, kyunke tere siwa koi gunah maaf nahi karta, aur meri tauba qubool kar, beshak tu hi bohot tauba qubool karne wala, bohot reham karne wala hai).

e: [AI] We used to walk with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ along some walls of the city. He said, "O Abu Huraira!" I said, "At your service, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Indeed, those who have more are the ones with less, except for those who say with their wealth, 'Such and such.' " And he gestured with his hand to his right and left, and few are they.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Madinah ki kuch deewaron ke paas chal rahe the, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Hurairah." Maine kaha: "Labbaik, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak zyada maal wale hi (sawaab mein) kam hain, siwaye us shakhs ke jo apne maal se aise-aise kare," aur aap (SAW) ne apne haath se dayen aur bayen ishara kiya, "aur aise log kam hain."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never failed to utter these supplications in the evening and in the morning: O Allah, I ask Thee for security in this world and in the Hereafter: O Allah! I ask Thee for forgiveness and security in my religion and my worldly affairs, in my family and my property; O Allah! conceal my fault or faults (according to Uthman's version), and keep me safe from the things which I fear; O Allah! guard me in front of me and behind me, on my right hand and on my left, and from above me: and I seek in Thy greatness from receiving unexpected harm from below me." AbuDawud said: Waki' said: That is to say, swallowing by the earth. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5074)
hi: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) yeh kalimaat subah aur shaam kabhi nahi chhodte the: "Allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-aafiyata fi deeni wa dunyaya wa ahli wa maali. Allahummastur awrati wa aamin raw'ati. Allahummahfazni min baini yadayya wa min khalfi wa an yamini wa an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'oodhu bi-azamatika an ughtala min tahti" (Aye Allah, main tujhse apne deen, duniya, ghar walon aur maal mein maafi aur aafiyat maangta hoon. Aye Allah, mere aib chhupa de aur mere dar ko amaan de de. Aye Allah, meri hifaazat kar mere aage se, mere peechhe se, mere dayen se, mere bayen se, aur mere oopar se, aur main teri azmat ke wasile se panah maangta hoon is baat se ke main apne neeche se pakda jaaun - ya'ni zameen mein dhansaya jaaun.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "One of the happinesses of the son of Adam is to seek Allah's guidance (Istikhara), and one of the miseries of the son of Adam is to abandon seeking Allah's guidance (Istikhara)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ibn Adam ki khushnaseebi mein se hai ke woh Allah se istikhaara kare, aur Ibn Adam ki bad-naseebi mein se hai ke woh Allah se istikhaara karna chhod de."

e: If anyone says "I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion and with Muhammad ﷺ as Apostle" Paradise will be his due. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1529)
hi: Maine Abu Ali Al-Janbi ko kehte hue suna, unhone kaha: maine Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ko kehte hue suna, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kahe: 'Raziitu billahi Rabban wa bil-Islami deenan wa bi-Muhammadin Rasoola' (Main Allah ko Rab maankar, Islam ko deen maankar, aur Muhammad (SAW) ko Rasool maankar raazi hoon), uske liye Jannat wajib ho jaati hai."

e: AbuSallam told that he was in the mosque of Hims. A man passed him and the people said about him that he served the Prophet ﷺ. He (AbuSallam) went to him and said: Tell me any tradition which you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and there were no man between him and you. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: If anyone says in the morning and in the evening: "I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, with Muhammad as Prophet," Allah will certainly please him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5072)
hi: Hum Hims ki masjid mein baithe thay ke aik shakhs guzra, logon ne kaha: "Isne Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat ki hai." To main uski taraf uthkar gaya aur usse poocha, maine kaha: "Mujhe woh hadith bataiye jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho aur woh tum logon mein aam na phaili ho." Unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Koi bandah nahi jo shaam aur subah kahe: 'Raziitu billahi Rabban wa bil-Islami deenan wa bi-Muhammadin Nabiyya' (Main Allah ko Rab maankar, Islam ko deen maankar, aur Muhammad (SAW) ko Nabi maankar raazi hoon), magar Allah par yeh haq ban jaata hai ke woh use Qayamat ke din raazi kare."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  heard saying, "Whoever says 'SubhanAllah wa bihamdihi' one hundred times in the morning and one hundred times in the evening, all his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as much as the foam of the sea."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo subah sau (100) martaba aur shaam sau martaba 'Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi' kahe, uske gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain, chahe woh samundar ke jhaag se bhi zyada hon."

e: “Allahumma inni a’udhu bika an adilla aw azilla, aw azlima aw uzlama, aw ajhala aw yujhala ‘alayya (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from going astray or stumbling, from wronging others or being wronged, and from behaving or being treated in an ignorant manner).” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3884)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab apne ghar se nikalte to farmate: "Bismillahi Rabbi, a'oodhu bika an azilla aw adilla aw azlima aw uzlama aw ajhala aw yujhala alayya" (Allah ke naam se, mere Rab, main teri panah maangta hoon is baat se ke main phisal jaaun ya gumraah ho jaaun, ya zulm karoon ya mujhpar zulm ho, ya main jahilana harkat karoon ya mujhpar jahilana harkat ki jaaye).

e: “Bismillah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, at-tuklanu ‘ala Allah (In the Name of Allah, there is no power and strength except with Allah, and trust is placed in Allah).” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3885)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab apne ghar se nikalte to farmate: "Bismillah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, at-tuklanu alallah" (Allah ke naam se, koi taaqat aur qudrat sirf Allah ke sath hai, Allah par hi bharosa hai).

e: “Pray to Allah to heal me.” He said: “If you wish to store your reward for the Hereafter, that is better, or if you wish, I will supplicate for you.” He said: “Supplicate.” So he told him to perform ablution and do it well, and to pray two Rak’ah, and to say this supplication: “Allahumma inni as’aluka wa atawajjahu ilaika bimuhammadin nabiyyir-rahmah. Ya Muhammadu inni qad tawajjahtu bika ila rabbi fi hajati hadhihi lituqda. Allahumma fashaffi’hu fiya (O Allah, I ask of You and I turn my face towards You by virtue of the intercession of Muhammad the Prophet of mercy. O Muhammad, I have turned to my Lord by virtue of your intercession concerning this need of mine so that it may be met. O Allah, accept his intercession concerning me)”. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1385)
hi: Aik nabeena shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe aafiyat de." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum chaho to (iska ajr aakhirat ke liye) mo'akhkhar kar dun, aur agar chaho to dua karoon." Usne kaha: "To dua kijiye." Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne usse wudu achhi tarah karne, do rak'atein padhne, aur yeh dua karne ka hukum diya: "Allahumma inni as'aluka wa atawajjahu ilaika bi-Nabiyyika Muhammadin Nabiyyir-Rahmah, Ya Muhammadu inni atawajjahu bika ila Rabbika fi hajati hadhihi fataqdiha li, Allahumma shaffi'hu fiyya wa shaffi'ni fihi" (Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon aur teri taraf mutawajjeh hota hoon tere Nabi Muhammad (SAW), Rahmat ke Nabi, ke wasile se, Aye Muhammad, main aapke wasile se apne Rab ki taraf mutawajjeh hota hoon apni is zaroorat mein taake woh poori ho jaaye, Aye Allah, unhein mere haq mein shafa'at qubool karne de aur mujhe unke haq mein shafa'at qubool karne de).

e: “The Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate, saying: “My Lord, aid me and do not aid against me, and grant me victory and do not grant victory over me, plot for me and do not plot against me, guide me and facilitate guidance for me, grant me victory over those who transgress against me. My Lord, make me ever-grateful to You, ever-remembering of You, ever-fearful of You, ever-obedient to You, ever-humble to You, oft-turning and returning to You. My Lord, accept my repentance, wash my sin, answer my call, make firm my proof, make firm my tongue, guide my heart, and remove the treachery of my chest (Rabbi aʿinnī wa lā tuʿin ʿalayya, wanṣurnī wa lā tanṣur ʿalayya, wamkur lī wa lā tamkur ʿalayya, wahdinī wa yassiril-huda lī, wanṣurnī ʿalā man baghā ʿalayya. Rabbijʿalnī laka shakkāran, laka dhakkāran, laka rahhāban, laka miṭwāʿan, laka mukhbitan, ilaika awwāhan munība. Rabbi taqabbal tawbatī, waghsil ḥawbatī, wa ajib daʿwatī, wa thabbit ḥujjatī, wa saddid lisānī, wahdi qalbī, waslul sakhīmata ṣadrī).” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3551)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki dua mein se yeh tha: "Rabbi a'inni wa la tu'in alayya, wansurni wa la tansur alayya, wamkur li wa la tamkur alayya, wahdini wa yassiril-huda li, wansurni ala man bagha alayya. Rabbij'alni laka shakkaran, laka dhakkaran, laka rahhaban, laka mitwaa'an, laka mukhbitan ilaika awwahan muniba. Rabbi taqabbal tawbati, waghsil hawbati, wa ajib da'wati, wa thabbit hujjati, wa saddid lisani, wahdi qalbi, waslul sakheemata sadri" (Aye mere Rab, meri madad kar aur mere khilaaf kisi ki madad na kar, aur meri madad kar aur mujh par kisi ko madad na de, aur mere liye tadbeer kar aur mere khilaaf koi tadbeer na kar, aur mujhe hidayat de aur meri hidayat aasan kar, aur jo mujhpar zulm kare uspar mujhe fatah de. Aye mere Rab, mujhe apna bohot shukr karne wala, bohot zikr karne wala, bohot darne wala, bohot farmaanbardaar, aur tere aage jhukne wala, gidgidaane wala, tauba karne wala bana de. Aye mere Rab, meri tauba qubool kar, mera gunah dho de, meri dua qubool kar, meri daleel pukhta kar, meri zubaan durust kar, mera dil hidayat de, aur mere seene ki kudurat nikaal de).

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , this is what Muhammad asked his Lord: "O Allah, I ask You for the best of requests, the best of supplications, the best of success, the best of actions, the best of rewards, the best of lives, the best of deaths, and to make me steadfast. And make my scales heavy, and fulfill my faith, and elevate my ranks, and accept my prayers, and forgive my sins. And I ask You for the highest levels of Paradise, O Allah, I ask You for the beginnings of goodness, the endings of goodness, and the entirety of goodness, the outward and the inward, and the highest levels of Paradise. Amen, O Allah, I ask You for the best of what I am given, and the best of what I do, and the best of what I work for, and the best of what is invisible to others, and the best of what is visible, and the highest levels of Paradise. Amen, O Allah, I ask You to elevate my remembrance, and to take away my sins, and to rectify my affairs, and to purify my heart, and to protect my modesty, and to enlighten my heart, and to forgive my sins, and I ask You for the highest levels of Paradise. Amen, O Allah, I ask You to bless me in my self, and in my hearing, and in my sight, and in my soul, and in my creation, and in my disposition, and in my family, and in my life, and in my death, and in my actions. So accept my good deeds, and I ask You for the highest levels of Paradise. Amen."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, yeh woh dua hai jo Muhammad (SAW) ne apne Rab se maangi: "Allahumma inni as'aluka khairal-mas'alati wa khairad-du'a'i wa khairan-najahi wa khairal-amali wa khairath-thawabi wa khairal-hayati wa khairal-mamaati, wa thabbitni, wa thaqqil mawazini, wa haqqiq imani, warfa' darajaati, wa taqabbal salaati, waghfir khati'ati, wa as'alukad-darajatil-ula minal-jannah. Allahumma inni as'aluka fawatihal-khairi wa khawatimahu wa jawami'ahu wa awwalahu wa zahirahu wa batinahu wad-darajatil-ula minal-jannah, Ameen. Allahumma inni as'aluka khaira ma aati wa khaira ma af'alu wa khaira ma a'malu wa khaira ma batana wa khaira ma zahara wad-darajatil-ula minal-jannah, Ameen. Allahumma inni as'aluka an tarfa'a dhikri wa tada'a wizri wa tuslih amri wa tutahhira qalbi wa tuhassina farji wa tunawwira li qalbi wa taghfira li dhanbi wa as'alukad-darajatil-ula minal-jannah, Ameen. Allahumma inni as'aluka an tubarika li fi nafsi wa fi sam'i wa fi basari wa fi roohi wa fi khalqi wa fi khuluqi wa fi ahli wa fi mahyaya wa fi mamaati wa fi amali, fataqabbal hasanati wa as'alukad-darajatil-ula minal-jannah, Ameen" (Aye Allah, main tujhse behtareen sawaal, behtareen dua, behtareen kaamyaabi, behtareen amal, behtareen sawaab, behtareen zindagi, aur behtareen maut ka sawaal karta hoon, aur mujhe saabit-qadam bana, mera taraazu bhaari kar, mera imaan sacha kar, mere darje buland kar, meri namaz qubool kar, aur meri khataa maaf kar, aur main tujhse Jannat ke sabse buland darje maangta hoon. Aye Allah, main tujhse har bhalaai ki shuruaat, uske anjaam, uski jaam'iyat, uski ibtida, uski zaahiri aur baatini soorat maangta hoon, aur Jannat ke sabse buland darje, Ameen. Aye Allah, main tujhse behtareen cheez maangta hoon jo main laaun, behtareen cheez jo main karoon, behtareen cheez jo main amal karoon, behtareen cheez jo poshida ho, aur behtareen cheez jo zaahir ho, aur Jannat ke sabse buland darje, Ameen. Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon ke tu mera zikr buland kare, mera bojh halka kare, mera maamla sanwaar de, mera dil paak kar de, mere sharm-gaah ki hifazat kar, mere dil ko roshan kar, aur mera gunah maaf kar, aur main tujhse Jannat ke sabse buland darje maangta hoon, Ameen. Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon ke tu mujhme, meri sunne ki taaqat mein, meri dekhne ki taaqat mein, meri rooh mein, meri takhleeq mein, mere akhlaaq mein, mere ghar walon mein, meri zindagi mein, meri maut mein, aur mere amal mein barkat de, phir meri nekiyaan qubool kar, aur main tujhse Jannat ke sabse buland darje maangta hoon, Ameen)."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "And the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, mentioned, saying: Say, 'O Allah, I ask You for what is good and to refrain from what is evil, and to love the poor, and to forgive me, and have mercy on me. And if You intend to afflict a people with a trial, then take me to You without affecting me.' And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Teach them to your womenfolk, for by the One in whose Hand is my soul, they are true.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna, unhone Rab Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ka zikr kiya aur farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma inni as'alukat-tayyibati wa tarkal-munkarati wa hubbal-masakini wa an tatooba alayya wa taghfira li wa tarhamani, wa idha aradta fitnatan fi qawmin fatawaffani ghaira maftoon' (Aye Allah, main tujhse paakeeza cheezein aur bad-amaliyon ko chhodna, aur miskeeno se mohabbat maangta hoon, aur yeh ke tu meri tauba qubool kare aur mujhe maaf kare aur mujhpar reham kare, aur jab tu kisi qaum par fitna daalna chahe, to mujhe fitne mein daale bagair maut de)." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "To inhein sikhaao, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh sab haq hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delayed the Fajr prayer, so much so that the sun almost caught up with us. Then he came out and led us in prayer, reducing its length. Afterwards, he turned to us and said: "Do you know what caused me to delay the prayer today? I prayed during this night as Allah willed, but then my eyes closed and I fell asleep. I saw my Lord, the Blessed and Exalted, who inspired me to say: 'O Allah, I ask You for all that is good, for abandoning evil deeds, for loving the poor, for granting me repentance and forgiveness, for having mercy on me, and when You decree a trial upon Your creation, save me from it without being affected. O Allah, I ask You for Your love, for the love of those who love You, and for the love of deeds that will draw me closer to Your love.'" Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  turned to us and said: "Teach them and instruct them, for they deserve it."
