hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Fajr ki namaz mein der kar di yahan tak ke suraj humein pakadne ke qareeb hone laga, phir aap (SAW) nikle aur humein namaz padhayi, apni namaz mukhtasar ki, phir wapas hokar apna chehra humari taraf kiya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni jagah par raho, main tumhein bataata hoon ke aaj is namaz mein mujhe kis cheez ne der karayi. Maine apni is raat mein jitna Allah ne chaha namaz padhi, phir meri aankhon ne mujhpar qaboo pa liya aur main so gaya, to maine apne Rab Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ko dekha, unhone mujhe ilhaam kiya ke main kahun: 'Allahumma inni as'alukat-tayyibati wa tarkal-munkarati wa hubbal-masakini wa an tatooba alayya wa taghfira li wa tarhamani, wa idha aradta fi khalqika fitnatan fanajjini ilaika minha ghaira maftoon. Allahumma wa as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuka wa hubba amalin yuqarribuni ila hubbik' (Aye Allah, main tujhse paakeeza cheezein aur bad-amaliyon ko chhodna, aur miskeeno se mohabbat maangta hoon, aur yeh ke tu meri tauba qubool kare aur mujhe maaf kare aur mujhpar reham kare, aur jab tu apni makhlooq mein fitna daalna chahe, to mujhe uski taraf, us fitne se bacha kar, fitne mein daale bagair bulaa le. Aye Allah, main tujhse teri mohabbat, aur teri mohabbat karne wale ki mohabbat, aur us amal ki mohabbat maangta hoon jo mujhe teri mohabbat ke qareeb kare)." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne humari taraf mudkar farmaya: "Inhein seekho aur inhein padho, kyunke yeh haq hain."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr As-Siddiq entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and spoke to him about something he concealed from Aisha. Aisha was praying, so the Prophet ﷺ  said, "O Aisha, beware of the hypocrites!" or other words. When Aisha finished praying, she asked him about it, and he said to her, "Say, 'O Allah, I ask You for all the good, both immediate and future, that I know and that I do not know. And I seek refuge in You from all the evil, both immediate and future, that I know and that I do not know. And I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings one closer to it in speech or action. And I seek refuge in You from the Hellfire and whatever brings one closer to it in speech or action. And I ask You for the best of what Your servant and Messenger Muhammad asked of You, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what Your servant and Messenger Muhammad sought refuge in You from.' And I ask You for whatever You have decreed for me in any matter, that it may lead to righteousness."
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay aur unse kisi baat mein baat ki jise woh Aisha (RA) se chhupa rahe the, jabke Aisha (RA) namaz padh rahi thin, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Aisha, in mukammal (duaon) ko lazim pakdo," ya koi aur lafz kaha. Jab Aisha (RA) namaz se farigh hui to unhone iske baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khairi kullihi, aajilihi wa aajilihi, ma alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa a'oodhu bika minash-sharri kullihi, aajilihi wa aajilihi, ma alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa as'alukal-jannata wa ma qarraba ilaiha min qawlin aw amalin, wa a'oodhu bika minan-nari wa ma qarraba ilaiha min qawlin aw amalin, wa as'aluka khaira ma sa'alaka abduka wa rasooluka Muhammad, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri masta'adha bika minhu abduka wa rasooluka Muhammad (SAW), wa as'aluka ma qadaita li min amrin an taj'ala aaqibatahu rushda' (Aye Allah, main tujhse har bhalaai maangta hoon, us mein se jo turant ho aur jo der se ho, jo main jaanta hoon aur jo nahi jaanta, aur main teri panah maangta hoon har buraai se, us mein se jo turant ho aur jo der se ho, jo main jaanta hoon aur jo nahi jaanta, aur main tujhse Jannat aur us mein qareeb karne wale har qaul ya amal ka sawaal karta hoon, aur main teri panah maangta hoon Jahannam se aur us ki taraf qareeb karne wale har qaul ya amal se, aur main tujhse woh behtareen cheez maangta hoon jo tere bandey aur Rasool Muhammad (SAW) ne tujhse maangi, aur main teri panah maangta hoon us buraai se jissey tere bandey aur Rasool Muhammad (SAW) ne teri panah maangi, aur main tujhse yeh sawaal karta hoon ke jo bhi maamla tu ne mere liye muqarrar kiya hai, uska anjaam hidayat bana de)."

e: [AI] "Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, this is what Abu Na'ama and Shu'bah said about him: I preserve it and if he contradicted it, then the saying is that of Shu'bah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Isse Abu Na'amah ne bhi isi tarah kaha, aur Shu'bah unse zyada yaad rakhne wale hain, aur agar unse ikhtilaaf ho to baat Shu'bah ki hi maani jaayegi.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, it is narrated that he used to call upon Allah and say, "O Allah, forgive our sins, our injustices, our jokes, our seriousness, our deliberate actions, and all of that which is with us."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) dua kiya karte the aur kehte: "Allahummaghfir lana dhunoobana wa zulmana wa hazlana wa jiddana wa amadana wa kulla dhalika indana" (Aye Allah, humare gunah, humari zyaadti, humari mazaaq, humari sanjidgi, aur humare jaan-boojh kar kiye gaye kaam maaf kar de, aur yeh sab kuch humare paas hai).

e: [AI] She said, "Gabriel ﷺ  came to the Prophet (saw) and said, 'Verily, Allah commands you to invoke these words, for He will grant you one of them. O Allah, I ask for Your expedited recovery, patience in facing Your trials, or departure from this world to Your mercy.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: Jibra'il (AS) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Allah aapko hukum deta hai ke aap in kalimaat se dua karein, kyunke woh aapko in mein se aik zaroor ata karega: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka ta'jeela aafiyatika wa sabran ala baliyyatika aw khurujan minad-dunya ila rahmatika' (Aye Allah, main tujhse teri aafiyat jaldi maangta hoon, aur teri azmaish par sabr, ya duniya se teri rahmat ki taraf jaana)."

e: [AI] It was from the supplication of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "O Allah, bless me with good hearing and eyesight, and make them an inheritance from me. Grant me victory over those who wronged me, and show me vengeance in them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki dua mein se yeh tha: "Allahumma matti'ni bi-sam'i wa basari waj'alhumal-waaritha minni, wansurni ala man zalamani wa arini fihi tha'ri" (Aye Allah, mujhe mere kaan aur meri aankh se faida uthaane de aur unhein mera waaris bana de, aur mujhe us par fatah de jisne mujhpar zulm kiya aur mujhe uske khilaaf mera badla dikha).

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  advised Salman al-Khair and said, 'O Salman, indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wants to grant you words that you ask the Most Merciful for, and seek His pleasure through them day and night. Say, "O Allah, I ask You for a sound faith, and faith in good character, and success that is followed by prosperity, and mercy and well-being and forgiveness and satisfaction from You."'
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Salman-e-Khair (RA) ko wasiyat ki aur farmaya: "Aye Salman, Rasulullah (SAW) aapko kuch kalimaat ata karna chahte hain jinhein aap Rahman se maangein aur unki taraf raghbat rakhein aur unhein raat-din duaon mein kahein: kaho: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka sihhatan fi imanin wa imanan fi husni khuluqin wa najahan yatba'uhu falahun wa rahmatan minka wa aafiyatan wa maghfiratan minka wa ridwana' (Aye Allah, main tujhse imaan mein sehat, aur achhe akhlaaq mein imaan, aur woh kaamyaabi jiske saath falaah aaye, aur teri taraf se rahmat, aafiyat, maghfirat, aur raza-mandi maangta hoon)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever says, 'O Allah, I testify that You are Allah, there is no god but You, alone, without partner, and I testify that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger,' Allah will free one-third of him from the Fire. Whoever says it twice, Allah will free two-thirds of him from the Fire. Whoever says it three times, Allah will free him completely from the Fire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kahe: 'Allahumma inni ushhiduka wa ushhidu mala'ikataka wa hamalata arshika wa ushhidu man fis-samawati wa man fil-ard, annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika laka, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduka wa rasooluk' (Aye Allah, main tujhe gawah banaata hoon aur tere farishton aur tere Arsh uthaane walon ko gawah banaata hoon, aur aasmano aur zameen mein maujood sab ko gawah banaata hoon, ke tu hi Allah hai, tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tu akela hai, tera koi shareek nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad tera bandah aur Rasool hai), jo ise aik martaba kahe, Allah uska tihaai hissa aag se azaad kar deta hai, aur jo ise do martaba kahe, Allah uske do-tihaai hisse aag se azaad kar deta hai, aur jo ise teen martaba kahe, Allah use poora aag se azaad kar deta hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by me while I was praying, and he said, "Ask and you shall be given, O son of Umme Abd." Omar said, "I started doing it, along with Abu Bakr. But Abu Bakr surpassed me and said, 'Verily, among my supplications that I hardly fail to make is O Allah, I ask You for eternal bliss that never perishes, and the delight of the eye that never fades, and the companionship of the Prophet ﷺ  in the highest paradise.'
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas se guzre jabke main namaz padh raha tha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maango, tumhein diya jayega, Aye Ibn Umm Abd." Umar (RA) ne kaha: to main aur Abu Bakr (RA) dono jaldi karne lage, magar Abu Bakr (RA) mujhse aage nikal gaye, unhone kaha: "Meri dua mein se aik yeh hai jo main taqreeban kabhi nahi chhodta: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka na'eeman la yabeedu, wa qurrata ainin la tanfad, wa murafaqatan-Nabiyya (SAW) fi a'la Jannatil-Khuld' (Aye Allah, main tujhse aisi ne'mat maangta hoon jo kabhi khatam na ho, aur aisi aankhon ki thandak jo kabhi khatam na ho, aur Nabi (SAW) ki rifaqat Jannat-ul-Khuld ke sabse buland hisse mein)."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he used to supplicate with these words: "O Allah, You are the First, there is nothing before You, and You are the Last, there is nothing after You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of every creature whose forelock is in Your hand. I seek refuge in You from sin and laziness, and from the punishment of the grave, and from the trials of wealth, and from the trials of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from sins and debts. O Allah, purify my heart from sins as You purify the white garment from filth. O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) yeh kalimaat kehte huay dua kiya karte the: "Allahumma antal-Awwalu fa la shai'a qablak, wa antal-Aakhiru fa la shai'a ba'dak, a'oodhu bika min sharri kulli dabbatin naasiyatuha bi-yadik, wa a'oodhu bika minal-ithmi wal-kasal, wa min azabil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-ghina, wa min fitnatil-qabr, wa a'oodhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram. Allahumma naqqi qalbi minal-khataya kama naqqaital-thawbal-abyada minad-danas. Allahumma ba'id baini wa baina khati'ati kama ba'adta bainal-mashriqi wal-maghrib" (Aye Allah, tu Awwal hai, tujh se pehle kuch nahi, aur tu Aakhir hai, tere baad kuch nahi, main teri panah maangta hoon har us jaanwar ki buraai se jiski paishani teri haath mein hai, aur main teri panah maangta hoon gunah aur susti se, aur qabar ke azab se, aur maal-daari ke fitne se, aur qabar ke fitne se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon gunah aur qarz se. Aye Allah, mere dil ko gunahon se aise paak kar jaise tu ne safed kapde ko maile-pan se paak kiya. Aye Allah, mujhe mere gunah se itni door kar de jitna tu ne Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan door kiya).

e: "Ammar bin Yasir led us in prayer and he made it brief. Some of the people said to him: 'You made the prayer sort (or brief).' He said: 'Nevertheless I still recited supplications that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.' When he got up and left, a man -- he was my father but he did not name himself -- followed him and asked him about that supplication, then he came and told the people: "Allāhumma bi ʿilmikal-ghaiba wa qudratika 'alal-khalqi aḥyinī mā ʿalimtal-ḥayāta khairan lī, wa tawaffanī idhā ʿalimtal-wafāta khairan lī. Allāhumma wa 'as'aluka khashyataka fil-ghaibi wash-shahādati wa 'as'aluka kalimatal-ḥaqqi fir-riḍā'i wal ghaḍab, wa as'alukal-qaṣda fil faqri wal-ghina, wa 'as'aluka naʿīman lā yanfadu wa 'as'aluka qurrata ʿainin lā tanqaṭiʿu wa as'alukar-riḍā'i baʿdal-qaḍā'i wa 'as'aluka bardal ʿaishi baʿdal-mawti, wa 'as'aluka ladhdhatan-naẓari ilā wajhika wash-shawqa ilā liqā'ika fī ghairi ḍarrā'a muḍirratin wa lā fitnatin muḍillatin, Allāhumma zayyinnā bizīnatil-īmāni wajʿalna hudātan muhtadīn (O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know that living is good for me and cause me to die when You know that death is better for me. O Allah, cause me to fear You in secret and in public. I ask You to make me true in speech in times of pleasure and of anger. I ask You to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty. And I ask You for everlasting delight and joy that will never cease. I ask You to make me pleased with that which You have decreed and for an easy life after death. I askYou for the sweetness of looking upon Your face and a longing to meet You in a manner that does not entail a calamity that will bring about harm or a trial that will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us among those who guide and are rightly guided." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1305)
hi: Unhone apne sathiyon ko namaz padhayi aur koi namaz itni mukhtasar nahi thi, to unse kaha gaya: "Aye Abul-Yaqzan, aapne mukhtasar kar diya?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhpar ismein koi harj nahi, maine ismein woh duayen ki hain jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suni thin." Unhone kaha: to aik shakhs khada hua aur unke peechhe gaya, woh Abu Ata' the, unhone unse dua ke baare mein poocha, woh wapas aaye aur bataya: "Allahumma bi-ilmikal-ghaiba wa qudratika alal-khalqi ahyini ma alimtal-hayata khairan li wa tawaffani idha kaanatil-wafatu khairan li. Allahumma wa as'aluka khashyataka fil-ghaibi wash-shahadah, wa as'aluka kalimatal-hukmi fil-ghadabi war-rida, wa as'alukal-qasda fil-ghina wal-faqr, wa as'aluka na'eeman la yabeedu, wa as'aluka qurrata ainin la tanfadu wa la tanqati', wa as'alukar-rida ba'dal-qada, wa as'aluka barda-l-'aishi ba'dal-mawt, wa as'alukan-nazara ila ladhdhati wajhika, wa as'alukash-shawqa ila liqa'ika fi ghairi darra'a mudirratin wa la fitnatin mudillah. Allahumma zayyinna bi-zeenatil-imani waj'alna hudatan muhtadeen" (Aye Allah, apne ghaib ke ilm aur apni makhlooq par apni qudrat ke wasile se, mujhe zinda rakh jab tak tu jaane ke zindagi mere liye behtar hai, aur mujhe maut de jab tak wafat mere liye behtar ho. Aye Allah, main tujhse ghaib aur zaahir mein tera khauf maangta hoon, aur main tujhse ghusse aur raza-mandi mein haq ki baat maangta hoon, aur main tujhse maal-daari aur ghurbat mein miyaanaravi maangta hoon, aur main tujhse aisi ne'mat maangta hoon jo kabhi khatam na ho, aur main tujhse aisi aankhon ki thandak maangta hoon jo kabhi khatam na ho aur kabhi na tute, aur main tujhse taqdeer ke baad raza-mandi maangta hoon, aur main tujhse maut ke baad zindagi ki thandak maangta hoon, aur main tujhse tere chehre ki lazzat dekhne ka sawaal karta hoon, aur main tujhse tujhse milne ki tamanna maangta hoon, bagair kisi nuqsaan-deh takleef ke aur bagair kisi gumraah karne wale fitne ke. Aye Allah, humein imaan ki zeenat se sanwaar de aur humein hidayat-yaafta hidayat dene wale bana de)."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , that he used to supplicate: "O Allah, keep me steadfast in Islam whether standing, sitting, or lying down. And protect me from an enemy who is envious. O Allah, I ask You for all goodness whose treasures are within Your hands, and I seek refuge in You from all evil whose treasures are within Your hands."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) dua kiya karte the: "Allahummahfazni bil-Islami qa'iman, wahfazni bil-Islami qa'idan, wahfazni bil-Islami raqidan, wa la tushmit bi aduwwan hasidan. Wallahumma inni as'aluka min kulli khairin khaza'inuhu bi-yadik, wa a'oodhu bika min kulli sharrin khaza'inuhu bi-yadik" (Aye Allah, mujhe Islam ke sath khade rehte huay hifaazat de, aur mujhe Islam ke sath baithe huay hifaazat de, aur mujhe Islam ke sath sote huay hifaazat de, aur kisi hasad karne wale dushman ko mujhpar khush na hone de. Aur Aye Allah, main tujhse har us bhalaai ka sawaal karta hoon jiske khazaane tere haath mein hain, aur main teri panah maangta hoon har us buraai se jiske khazaane tere haath mein hain).

e:
It was among the duas of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: 

***allāhumma innā nasʾaluka mūjibāti raḥmatik, wa-ʿazāʾima maghfiratik, wa-al-salāmata min kulli ithm, wa-al-ghanīmata min kulli birr, wa-al-fawza bi-al-jannah, wa-al-najāta bi-ʿawnika mina al-nār***

*(O Allah, we ask You for the causes that make Your mercy incumbent, the firm means to Your forgiveness, safety from every sin, the gain of every righteousness, success in attaining Paradise, and salvation, by Your help, from the Fire.)*[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki dua mein se yeh tha: "Allahumma inna nas'aluka moojibaati rahmatik, wa azaa'ima maghfiratik, was-salamata min kulli ithm, wal-ghaneemata min kulli birr, wal-fawza bil-jannah, wan-najata bi-awnika minan-naar" (Aye Allah, hum tujhse teri rahmat ke sabab maangte hain, aur teri maghfirat ke pukhta zaraye, aur har gunah se salaamati, aur har neki se faida, aur Jannat mein kaamyaabi, aur teri madad se Jahannam se nijaat).

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'There is no heart that is not between two of the Fingers of the Most Merciful. If He wills, He guides it and if He wills, He sends it astray.' The Messenger of Allah used to say: 'O You Who makes hearts steadfast make our hearts steadfast in adhering to Your religion.' And he said: 'The Scale is in the Hand of the Most Merciful; He will cause some peoples to rise and others to fall until the day of Resurrection.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 199)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Koi dil aisa nahi jo Rahman ki do ungliyon ke darmiyan na ho, agar woh chahe to usse seedha rakhe aur agar chahe to usse gumraah kar de." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) yeh kaha karte the: "Aye Allah, dilon ko pherne wale, mera dil apne deen par saabit rakh," aur taraazu Rahman ke haath mein hai, woh kuch qaumon ko buland karta hai aur kuch ko past karta hai, Qayamat ke din tak.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to frequently say, "O Turner of the hearts! Keep my heart steadfast on Your religion."
hi: Nabi (SAW) aksar farmaya karte the: "Ya Muqallibal-Quloob, thabbit qalbi ala deenik" (Aye dilon ko pherne wale, mera dil apne deen par saabit rakh).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Ask and you will be given." I said, "O Allah, I ask You for oaths that will not be broken, blessings that will not be exhausted, and the companionship of Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  in the highest level of Paradise, the everlasting Paradise."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maango, tumhein diya jayega." Maine kaha: "Aye Allah, main tujhse aisa imaan maangta hoon jo palte nahi, aur aisi ne'mat jo khatam na ho, aur tere Nabi Muhammad (SAW) ki rifaqat Jannat-ul-Khuld ke sabse buland darje mein."

e: [AI] A blind man came to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, teach me a supplication that I can make to Allah, through which He will restore my sight." The Prophet responded to him, saying, "Say, 'O Allah, I ask You and turn to You through Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy, O Muhammad. I have turned to my Lord with you, so intercede for me and advocate for me in my plea.' " The man then made this supplication, and when he stood up, he found that his sight had been restored. Shabib bin Sa'id Al-Habti, who narrated this incident from Ru'h bin Al-Qasim, added, "There are additions to the text and chain of narration, and the statement attributed to Shabib is trustworthy and reliable."
hi: Aik nabeena shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe aik aisi dua sikha dijiye jisse main dua karoon aur Allah meri aankhein wapas kar de." Aap (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka wa atawajjahu ilaika bi-Nabiyyika Nabiyyir-Rahmah, Ya Muhammadu inni qad tawajjahtu bika ila Rabbi, Allahumma shaffi'hu fiyya wa shaffi'ni fi nafsi' (Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon aur teri taraf mutawajjeh hota hoon tere Nabi, Rahmat ke Nabi, ke wasile se, Aye Muhammad, main aapke wasile se apne Rab ki taraf mutawajjeh hua hoon, Aye Allah, unhein mere haq mein shafa'at qubool karne de aur mujhe apne haq mein shafa'at qubool karne de)." To usne yeh dua ki, phir woh khada hua aur dekhne laga.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and a blind man came to him, complaining about the loss of his eyesight. The blind man said, "O Messenger of Allah, I do not have a guide and it has become difficult for me." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Go to the pool, perform ablution, then pray two units of prayer. After that, say: 'O Allah, I ask You and turn to You through Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , the Prophet of Mercy. O Muhammad, I turn to Allah through you, so that Allah may restore my eyesight.' O Allah, intercede for him and intercede for me." Uthman said, "By Allah, we did not separate and the conversation did not take long until the man entered, as if he had never had any sight problems."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko suna, jab unke paas aik nabeena shakhs aaya aur apni bina-e-basar ki shikayat ki, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mera koi rehnuma nahi hai, aur mujhpar yeh bohot mushkil ho gaya hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wudu-khaane jao aur wudu karo, phir do rak'atein padho, phir kaho: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka wa atawajjahu ilaika bi-Nabiyyika Muhammadin Nabiyyir-Rahmah, Ya Muhammadu inni atawajjahu bika ila Rabbika fayujalli li an basari, Allahumma shaffi'hu fiyya wa shaffi'ni fi nafsi' (Aye Allah, main tujhse sawaal karta hoon aur teri taraf mutawajjeh hota hoon tere Nabi Muhammad (SAW), Rahmat ke Nabi, ke wasile se, Aye Muhammad, main aapke wasile se apne Rab ki taraf mutawajjeh hota hoon taake woh meri nazar khol de, Aye Allah, unhein mere haq mein shafa'at qubool karne de aur mujhe apne haq mein shafa'at qubool karne de)." Uthman (RA) ne kaha: to Allah ki qasam, hum abhi alag bhi nahi hue the aur hamari baat lambi bhi nahi hui thi ke woh shakhs andar aaya jaise use kabhi koi taklif hi nahi thi.

e: [AI] To the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , say: "O Allah, I am weak, so grant me strength in seeking your pleasure. Take hold of goodness with the best of my efforts, and make Islam the ultimate source of my satisfaction. O Allah, I am weak, so strengthen me. I am humiliated, so honor me. I am poor, so provide for me."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma inni da'eefun faqawwi fi ridaka da'fi, wa khudh liyal-khaira bi-naasiyati, waj'alil-Islama muntaha rida'i. Allahumma inni da'eefun faqawwini, wa inni dhaleelun fa a'izzani, wa inni faqeerun farzuqni' (Aye Allah, main kamzor hoon, isliye apni raza mein meri kamzori ko taaqat de, aur mere liye bhalaai ko mere paishani se pakad, aur Islam ko meri sabse badi raza-mandi bana de. Aye Allah, main kamzor hoon, mujhe taaqat de, aur main zaleel hoon, mujhe izzat de, aur main faqeer hoon, mujhe rizq de)."

e: [AI] From Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: I was asked, "O Muhammad! Say something to me so that I may benefit from it." He replied, "Say, 'O Allah! I ask You for the performance of good deeds, the abandoning of evil deeds, love for the poor, and that You forgive me and have mercy on me. And when You intend to afflict a people with a trial, take me unto You without having been affected by it. O Allah! I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and love for actions that will make me reach Your love.'"
hi: Thawban (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam, ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhse kaha gaya: 'Aye Muhammad, kaho, tumhein sunaa jayega, aur maango, tumhein diya jayega.'" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: to maine kaha: "Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal-khairati wa tarkal-munkarati wa hubbal-masakini wa an taghfira li wa tarhamani, wa idha aradta bi-qawmin fitnatan fatawaffani ilaika wa ana ghairu maftoon. Allahumma inni as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuka wa hubban yuballighuni hubbak" (Aye Allah, main tujhse nek kaam karna, bad-amaliyon ko chhodna, aur miskeeno se mohabbat maangta hoon, aur yeh ke tu mujhe maaf kare aur mujhpar reham kare, aur jab tu kisi qaum par fitna daalna chahe, to mujhe fitne mein daale bagair apni taraf bulaa le. Aye Allah, main tujhse teri mohabbat, aur teri mohabbat karne wale ki mohabbat, aur aisi mohabbat maangta hoon jo mujhe teri mohabbat tak pahunchaaye).

e: [AI] One of the supplications of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was: "O Allah, grant me enjoyment of my hearing and sight until You make them my inheritance, and make me well in my religion, body, and help me against those who wrong me, until You show me vengeance against them. O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, and entrusted my affair to You, and have relied on You for protection from the back, and directed my face towards You. There is no refuge from You except to You. I have believed in Your Messenger whom You have sent, and in Your Book which You have revealed."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki dua mein se yeh tha: "Allahumma matti'ni bi-sam'i wa basari hatta taj'alahumal-waaritha minni, wa aafini fi deeni wa jasadi, wansurni mimman zalamani hatta turiyani fihi tha'ri. Allahumma inni aslamtu nafsi ilaika, wa fawwadtu amri ilaika, wa alja'tu zahri ilaika, wa khallaitu wajhi ilaika, la malja'a minka illa ilaika, aamantu bi-Rasoolikal-ladhi arsalta wa bi-Kitabikal-ladhi anzalt" (Aye Allah, mujhe mere kaan aur meri aankh se faida uthaane de yahan tak ke tu unhein mera waaris bana de, aur mujhe mere deen aur mere jism mein aafiyat de, aur mujhe us par fatah de jisne mujhpar zulm kiya yahan tak ke tu mujhe uske khilaaf mera badla dikha de. Aye Allah, main ne apni jaan tere hawale kar di, aur main ne apna maamla tere hawale kiya, aur main ne apni peeth teri taraf lagaayi, aur main ne apna chehra teri taraf kar diya, tere siwa koi panah nahi magar tujhi ki taraf, main tere us Rasool par imaan laaya jise tu ne bheja, aur teri us Kitaab par jo tu ne nazil ki).

e: [AI] "He would never sit in a gathering without anyone else present, except that he would say, 'O Allah, forgive me for what I have done in the past and what I will do in the future, and what I have hidden and what I have made public, and what You know of me that I do not know. O Allah, grant me from Your obedience what will come between me and Your disobedience, and grant me from Your fear what will bring me closer to Your mercy, and grant me from certainty what will make worldly tribulations easier for me. Bless my hearing and my vision and make them my heirs. O Allah, seek revenge for me from those who wrong me, and help me against those who oppose me, and do not make the world my greatest concern, and do not allow knowledge to be beyond my reach. O Allah, do not let those who do not show mercy towards me have control over me.'" Ibn 'Umar was asked about them, and he said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to conclude his gatherings with them."
hi: Ke woh kisi majlis mein nahi baithte the jismein koi aur maujood hota, magar woh kehte: "Allahummaghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni. Allahummarzuqni min taa'atika ma tahoolu baini wa baina ma'siyatik, warzuqni min khashyatika ma tuballighuni bihi rahmatak, warzuqni minal-yaqeeni ma tuhawwinu bihi alayya masa'ibad-dunya, wa barik li fi sam'i wa basari waj'alhumal-waaritha minni. Allahumma wa khudh bi-tha'ri mimman zalamani, wansurni ala man 'aadani, wa la taj'alid-dunya akbara hammi wa la mablagha ilmi. Allahumma wa la tusallit alayya man la yarhamani" (Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar de jo maine aage kiya aur jo pichhe rakha, jo chhupaaya aur jo zaahir kiya, aur jo tu mujhse zyada jaanta hai. Aye Allah, mujhe apni itaa'at se woh de jo mere aur teri na-farmani ke darmiyan hail ho jaaye, aur mujhe apna khauf de jisse tu mujhe apni rahmat tak pahunchaaye, aur mujhe yaqeen de jisse tu duniya ki museebaton ko mujhpar aasan kar de, aur mere kaan aur meri aankh mein barkat de aur unhein mera waaris bana de. Aye Allah, jisne mujhpar zulm kiya uske khilaaf mera badla le, aur jo mera dushman ho uspar mujhe fatah de, aur duniya ko meri sabse badi fikr aur meri ilm ki inteha na bana. Aye Allah, mujhpar aise shakhs ko musallat na kar jo mujhpar reham na kare)." Ibn Umar (RA) se in kalimaat ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) apni majlis inhi kalimaat par khatm karte the."

e: When the food cloth was removed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “praise be to Allah abundantly and sincerely, of such a nature as is productive of blessing, is not insufficient, Abandoned, or ignored, O our lord.” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3849)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab dastarkhaan uthaya jaata to farmate: "Alhamdulillahi katheeran tayyiban fihi ghaira makfiyyin wa la muwadda'in wa la mustaghnan anhu, Rabbana" (Bohot bohot paakeeza tareef Allah ke liye hai, jismein na koi kami hai na woh chhoda gaya hai na uski zaroorat khatam hoti hai, Aye humare Rab).

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: Moses, peace be upon him, said: O Lord, teach me something by which I may remember You and supplicate to You. He said: O Moses, say: There is no deity but Allah. He said: O Lord, all Your servants say this. He said: Say: There is no deity but Allah. He said: There is no deity but You, O Lord. Verily, I desire something exclusive to me. He said: O Moses, if the seven heavens and all that they contain besides Me, as well as the seven earths, were all placed in one pan of a scale, and "There is no deity but Allah" placed in the other, the latter would outweigh them all.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Musa (AS) ne kaha: "Aye Rab, mujhe kuch aisa sikha jisse main teri yaad karoon aur tujhse dua karoon." Allah ne farmaya: "Aye Musa, kaho: 'La ilaha illallah.'" Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, tere sab bandey yehi kehte hain." Allah ne farmaya: "Kaho: 'La ilaha illallah.'" Unhone kaha: "Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Aye Rab, main to koi aisi cheez chahta hoon jo mujhe khaas ho." Allah ne farmaya: "Aye Musa, agar saat aasman aur unke rehne wale, mere siwa, aur saat zameenein aik taraazu ke paalde mein hon, aur 'La ilaha illallah' doosre paalde mein ho, to 'La ilaha illallah' un sabko jhukaa de."

e: “A man from my nation will be called before all of creation on the Day of Resurrection, and ninety-nine scrolls will be spread out for him, each one extending as far as the eye can see. Then Allah will say: “Do you deny anything of this?” He will say: “No, O Lord.” He will say: “Have My recording scribes been unfair to you?” Then He will say: “Apart from that, do you have any good deeds?” The man will be terrified and will say: “No.” (Allah) will say: “Indeed, you have good deeds with Us, and you will not be treated unjustly this Day.” Then a card will be brought out on which is written Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasuluhu (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger). He will say: “O Lord, what is this card compared with these scrolls?” He will say: “You will not be treated unjustly.” Then the scrolls will be placed in one side of the Balance and the card in the other. The scrolls will go up (i.e., be light) and the card will go down (i.e., will weigh heavily).” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4300)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Ummat mein se aik shakhs ko Qayamat ke din tamam makhlooq ke saamne pukaara jayega, uske liye ninnaanwe (99) register khole jaayenge, har register hadd-e-nazar tak lamba hoga, phir usse kaha jayega: "Kya tum ismein se kisi cheez ka inkaar karte ho?" Woh kahega: "Nahi, Aye Rab." Allah kahega: "Kya tumhare paas koi uzr hai ya koi neki?" To woh shakhs ghabra jayega aur kahega: "Nahi, Aye Rab." Allah kahega: "Kyun nahi, tumhare paas humare paas nekiyaan hain, aur beshak aaj tumpar koi zulm nahi hoga." Phir uske liye aik card nikaala jayega jispar likha hoga: "Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wa Rasooluh" (Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur Muhammad uske bandey aur Rasool hain). Woh kahega: "Aye Rab, in registeron ke saamne yeh card kya cheez hai?" Allah kahega: "Beshak tumpar zulm nahi kiya jayega." Unhone kaha: to registeron ko aik paalde mein rakha jayega aur card ko doosre paalde mein, to register halke reh jaayenge aur card bhaari ho jayega.

e: [AI] I heard Awsat al-Bajali on the pulpit of Hims saying, "I heard Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq on the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Verily, certainty in the first and the last, so ask Allah for forgiveness, well-being, and certainty in both worlds. For indeed, what the servant attains after certainty is better than well-being.'"
hi: Maine Awsat Al-Bajali ko Hims ke mimbar par kehte hue suna, unhone kaha: maine Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke mimbar par kehte hue suna, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna, unhone kaha: (yahan raawi ki aankhon mein aansu aa gaye aur woh rone lage, phir unhone kaha:) maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko isi mimbar par pehle saal yeh farmate hue suna: "Allah se maafi, aafiyat, aur yaqeen duniya aur aakhirat mein maango, kyunke bande ko yaqeen ke baad aafiyat se behtar kuch nahi diya gaya."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to his uncle, "Pray for good health frequently."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne apne chacha se farmaya: "Aafiyat ki dua zyada karo."

e: " O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to the path of righteousness and provide me sustenance." (Using translation from Muslim 2697a)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jo bhi shakhs Islam qubool karta, use yeh kehna sikhaate: "Allahummahdini, warzuqni, wa aafini, warhamni" (Aye Allah, mujhe hidayat de, mujhe rizq de, mujhe aafiyat de, aur mujhpar reham kar).

e: “O Allah, grant me health in my body, and grant me health in my sight, and make it the inheritor from me, there is none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous, Glory is to Allah, the Lord of the Magnificent Throne, and all praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all that exists (Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī jasadi, wa ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, wajʿalhul-wāritha minnī, lā ilāha illāllah, al-ḥalīmul-karīm, subḥān Allāhi rabbil-ʿarshil-aẓīm, wal-ḥamdulillāhi rabbil-ʿalamīn).” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3480)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Allahumma aafini fi jasadi, wa aafini fi basari, waj'alhul-waaritha minni, la ilaha illallahul-Haleemul-Kareem, Subhanallahi Rabbil-Arshil-Azeem, wal-hamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen" (Aye Allah, mujhe mere jism mein aafiyat de, aur mujhe meri nazar mein aafiyat de, aur usse mera waaris bana de, Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh Haleem, Kareem hai, paak hai Allah, Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rab, aur sab tareef Allah, Rabb-ul-Aalameen, ke liye hai).

e: "O Messenger of Allah, what do you think I should say in my supplication, if I come upon Laylatul-Qadr?" He said: "Say: 'Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa, fa'fu 'anni (O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me).'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3850)
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar mujhe Lailatul-Qadr mil jaaye to main usme kya kahun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma innaka Afuwwun tuhibbul-afwa fa'fu anni' (Aye Allah, tu maaf karne wala hai aur maafi pasand karta hai, isliye mujhe maaf kar de)."

e: from miserliness, cowardice, the tribulations of the heart (grudges, envy, bad attitude and bad beliefs), the torment of the grave and old age. (Using translation from Aḥmad 145)
hi: Nabi (SAW) paanch cheezon se panah maangte the: buzdili, kanjoosi, bad-anjaam umar, qabar ke azab, aur seene ke fitne (dilon ke waswase) se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say in his invocation: "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, old age, harshness, neglectfulness, ill-heartedness, humility, humiliation, poverty, disbelief, disobedience, sinfulness, discord, hypocrisy, bad reputation, showing off, and I seek refuge in You from deafness, dumbness, madness, leprosy, and bad diseases."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apni dua mein kehte: "Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-bukhli wal-harami wal-qaswati wal-ghaflati wal-'ailati wadh-dhillati wal-maskanah, wa a'oodhu bika minal-faqri wal-kufri wal-fusooqi wash-shiqaqi wan-nifaqi was-sum'ati war-riya, wa a'oodhu bika minas-samami wal-bakami wal-junooni wal-judhami wal-barasi wa sayyi'il-asqam" (Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon aajizi, susti, buzdili, kanjoosi, budhaape, sakhti, ghaflat, muhtaji, zillat, aur na-daari se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon faqr, kufr, fisq, ikhtilaaf, nifaaq, riyakaari, aur dikhawe se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon behraape, gungepan, paagalpan, koddh, safed daagon, aur bad-tareen bimariyon se).

e: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] used to say these words in his supplication: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dain, wa ghalabatil-'aduwwi, wa shamatatil-a'da'. (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from being overwhelmed with debt, from being overpowered by the enemy and from the enemy rejoicing over my misfortunes.)'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5475)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) yeh kalimaat kehte huay dua kiya karte the: "Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika min ghalabatid-dain, wa ghalabatil-aduwwi, wa shamaatatil-a'da" (Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon qarz ke ghaalib aane se, dushman ke ghaalib aane se, aur dushmano ki khushi se).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to supplicate and say, "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the passing of Your blessings, the changing of Your health, the suddenness of Your punishment, and all of Your anger." Ibn Wahb mentioned that Ya'qub reported this from Abdullah ibn Dinar from Ibn Umar. And Hafs transmitted it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) yeh dua kiya karte the: "Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika min zawali ni'matika, wa min tahawwuli aafiyatika, wa min fuja'ati niqmatika, wa min jami'i sakhatik" (Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon teri ne'mat ke chale jaane se, teri aafiyat ke badal jaane se, teri sazaa ke achanak aane se, aur teri sari naraazgi se).

e: the Messenger of Allah (saas) said: "Seek refuge with Allah from poverty, insufficiency and humiliation, and from wronging (others) and being wronged.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3842)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki panah maango faqr, kami, zillat se, aur is baat se ke tum zulm karo ya tumpar zulm ho."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to supplicate: "O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from my house falling on me, I seek refuge in Thee from falling into an abyss, I seek refuge in Thee from drowning burning and decrepitude. I seek refuge in Thee from the devil harming me at the time of my death, I seek refuge in Thee from dying in Thy path while retreating, and I seek refuge in Thee from dying of the sting of a poisonous creature." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1552)
hi: Nabi (SAW) yeh dua kiya karte the: "Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika minal-hadmi wat-taraddi wal-harami wal-ghammi wal-gharaqi wal-haraqi, wa a'oodhu bika an yatakhabbatani-ish-Shaitanu indal-mawt, wa a'oodhu bika an amoota fi sabilika mudbiran, wa a'oodhu bika an amoota fi sabilika ladeegha" (Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon (imaarat ke) girne se, (kisi jagah se) girne se, bad-tareen budhaape se, ghum se, doobne se, jalne se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon is baat se ke Shaitan mujhe maut ke waqt bahka de, aur main teri panah maangta hoon is baat se ke main teri raah mein peeth pher kar maroon, aur main teri panah maangta hoon is baat se ke main teri raah mein kisi zehreele dank se maroon).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say, "O Allah, protect me from immoral manners, desires, actions, and diseases."
hi: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the: "Allahumma jannibni munkaratal-akhlaqi wal-ahwa'i wal-a'mali wal-adwa'" (Aye Allah, mujhe bure akhlaaq, khwahishaat, aamaal, aur bimariyon se door rakh).

e: The Prophet [SAW] said: "A'udhu billahi minal-kufri wad-dain. (I seek refuge with Allah from Kufr and debt.)" A man said: "Are you equating debt with Kufr?" He said: "Yes." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5474)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "A'oodhu billahi minal-kufri wad-dain" (Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon kufr aur qarz se). To aik shakhs ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap kufr ko qarz ke barabar rakhte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say in his supplication, "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil neighbor in the abode of residence, for the neighbor of the desert easily changes."
hi: Nabi (SAW) apni dua mein kehte the: "Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika min jaris-soo'i fi dari-l-muqamah, fa inna jaral-badiyati yatahawwal" (Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon mustaqil ghar mein bure padosi se, kyunke registaani padosi to yahan-wahan chala jaata hai).

e: [AI] The Prophet, peace be upon him, used to say: "Seek refuge in Allah from the evil of the neighbor of the residence, for the neighbor of the traveler may choose to depart."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) kaha karte the: "Mustaqil ghar ke bure padosi se Allah ki panah maango, kyunke musafir ka padosi jab chahe alag ho jaata hai."

e: [AI] "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, teach me a refuge that I can seek refuge with.' So, he took hold of my hand and said, 'Say: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil of my hearing, from the evil of my sight, from the evil of my soul, and from the evil of my desires, until He completes the whole supplication.'"
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe koi panah maangne wali dua sikha dijiye jisse main panah maangoon." To aap (SAW) ne mera haath pakda aur farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika min sharri sam'i wa min sharri basari wa min sharri nafsi wa min sharri manniyyi' (Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon apne kaan ki buraai se, apni aankh ki buraai se, apne nafs ki buraai se, aur apni khwahish ki buraai se)," yahan tak ke maine ise yaad kar liya.

e: “My father heard me while I was saying: “O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sadness and laziness and the punishment of the grave (Allāhumma, innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-kasali wa ʿadhābil-qabr).’ He said: ‘O my son, from who did you hear this?’” He said: “I said: ‘I heard you saying them.’ He said: ‘Stick to them, for indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying them.’” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3503)
hi: Muslim bin Abi Bakrah ne kaha: mere waalid ne mujhe yeh kehte hue suna: "Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-kasali wa azabil-qabr" (Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon fikr, susti, aur qabar ke azab se), to unhone poocha: "Aye mere bete, tumne yeh kis se suna?" Maine kaha: "Maine aapko yeh kehte suna tha." Unhone kaha: "Isse lazim pakdo, kyunke maine ise Rasulullah (SAW) se kehte suna hai."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic text is:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say, 'I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hellfire and the punishment of the grave, and from the trials of life and the trials of death, and from the trial of the False Messiah.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte the: "A'oodhu bika min azabi Jahannam, wa azabil-qabr, wa fitnatil-mahya, wa fitnatil-mamat, wa fitnatid-Dajjal" (Main teri panah maangta hoon Jahannam ke azab se, qabar ke azab se, zindagi ke fitne se, maut ke fitne se, aur Dajjal ke fitne se).

e: [AI] The translation is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Seek refuge in Allah from greed that leads to unrestrained desires and from having desires without any purpose when there is no need."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki panah maango us lalach se jo aadat bana de, aur us lalach se jo aisi cheez ke liye ho jiske paas kuch bhi haasil hone wala na ho."

e: [AI] It was from the supplication of the Messenger of Allah (saws): "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, and a heart that does not feel humility, and a supplication that is not heard, and a soul that is never satisfied, and from hunger as it is a dreadful pain, and from betrayal as it is a wretched disgrace, and from laziness, Stinginess, and cowardice, and from old age, and from being taken to the worst part of life, and from the trial of the False Messiah, and from the punishment of the grave, and from the trial of life and death. O Allah, we ask You for hearts that are humble, submissive, repentant in Your cause. O Allah, we ask You for determination to seek Your forgiveness and the means of Your command, and safety from every sin, and profit from every act of goodness, and success in entering Paradise, and salvation from the Fire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki dua mein se yeh tha: "Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika min ilmin la yanfa', wa qalbin la yakhsha', wa du'a'in la yusma', wa nafsin la tashba', wa minal-joo'i fa innahu bi'sad-dajee', wa minal-khiyanati fa innaha bi'satil-bitanah, wa minal-kasali wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa minal-harami, wa min an uradda ila ardhalil-umr, wa min fitnatid-Dajjal, wa azabil-qabr, wa fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat. Allahumma inna nas'aluka quloobana awwahatan mukhbitatan munibatan fi sabilik. Allahumma inna nas'aluka azaa'ima maghfiratika wa munjiyaati amrik, was-salamata min kulli ithm, wal-ghaneemata min kulli birr, wal-fawza bil-jannati, wan-najata minan-nar" (Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon aisi ilm se jo faida na de, aisa dil jo na jhuke, aisi dua jo suni na jaaye, aisi jaan jo kabhi na bhare, aur bhook se, kyunke woh bura saathi hai, aur khiyanat se, kyunke woh buri saathi hai, aur susti, kanjoosi aur buzdili se, aur budhaape se, aur is baat se ke mujhe zindagi ke sabse buray hisse mein pahuncha diya jaaye, aur Dajjal ke fitne, qabar ke azab, aur zindagi aur maut ke fitne se. Aye Allah, hum tujhse gidgidaane wale, jhukne wale, tauba karne wale dil teri raah mein maangte hain. Aye Allah, hum tujhse teri maghfirat ke pukhta zaraye aur tere hukum ke nijaat-dahinda tareeqe maangte hain, aur har gunah se salaamati, aur har neki se faida, aur Jannat mein kaamyaabi, aur Jahannam se nijaat).

e: [AI] He said, "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, is it a verse from the Book of Allah?" He said, "Yes." Then he said, "Ibn Abbas recited it, 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful,' in both raka'ahs."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, kya yeh Allah ki Kitaab ki aik ayat hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Phir unhone kaha: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne dono rak'aton mein 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' padhi.

e:
[AI] "And indeed We have granted you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an." (Surah Al-Hijr 15:87)

He (Said bin Jubair) recited it to me as, "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful" (Surah Al-Fatiha 1) when he completed it, and he said, "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful" (Surah Al-Fatiha 1) is the seventh verse. And Sa'id bin Jubair said to me, 'Indeed Allah has brought it out for you, and He did not bring it out for anyone before you.'"
hi: "{Aur beshak humne tumhein saat baar dohraayi jaane wali (ayaat) aur Quran-e-Azeem ata kiya}" (Surah Al-Hijr 87). Unhone kaha: aur Sa'eed bin Jubair ne mujhe 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' (Surah Al-Fatihah 1) padh kar sunayi jab unhone (Al-Fatihah) khatm ki, aur kaha 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' (Surah Al-Fatihah 1) saatvi ayat hai. Unhone kaha: aur Sa'eed bin Jubair ne mujhse kaha: "Allah ne ise tumhare liye nikaala hai, aur usne ise tumse pehle kisi ke liye nahi nikala."

e: [AI] "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds." [Al-Fatiha 2] So I said to my father, 'Saeed informed you that Ibn Abbas said, "Is 'Bismillah Hir-Rahman Nir-Rahim' a verse from the Book of Allah?"' He said, 'Yes.'"
hi: "{Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen}" (Surah Al-Fatihah 2). To maine apne waalid se kaha: "To Sa'eed ne aapko bataya ke Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha tha: 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, kya yeh Allah ki Kitaab ki aik ayat hai?'" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan."

e: [AI] "The Opening of the Book" it was said to Ibn Abbas, "Where is the seventh one?" He said, "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful." [Al-Fatiha 1]
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur beshak humne tumhein saat baar dohraayi jaane wali (ayaat) di hai}" (Surah Al-Hijr 87) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Fatihatul-Kitaab (Surah Al-Fatihah)." Ibn Abbas (RA) se poocha gaya: "To saatvi kahan hai?" Unhone kaha: "'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem'" (Surah Al-Fatihah 1).

e: [AI] "He counted it for me in my hand {In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, praise be to Allah, the Lord of all worlds, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us on the Straight Path, the path of those who have received Your grace; not the path of those who have brought down wrath upon themselves, nor of those who have gone astray.} Then he said, 'Allah brought it out for you, and not for anyone else.'"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan 'Saba' Al-Mathani' (saat baar dohraayi jaane wali ayaat) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unhone ise mere haath par gin kar bataya: 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen, Ar-Rahmanir-Raheem, Maliki Yawmid-Deen, Iyyaka Na'budu wa Iyyaka Nasta'een, Ihdinas-Siratal-Mustaqeem, Siratal-ladhina An'amta Alaihim Ghairil-Maghdoobi Alaihim wa lad-Dalleen'" (Bismillah ke sath Al-Fatihah ki poori ayaatein), phir unhone kaha: "Allah ne ise tumhare liye nikaala hai, aur usne ise tumhare siwa kisi aur ke liye nahi nikaala."

e: [AI] "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful." [Chapter 1, Al-Fatiha] Ibn Abbas said, "And Allah has kept it preserved for you, so no one before you has brought it out."
hi: "{Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem}" (Surah Al-Fatihah 1), saatvi (ayat). Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur Allah ne ise tumhare liye mahfooz rakha, aur usne ise tumse pehle kisi ke liye nahi nikaala."

e: [AI] Uthman ibn Affan asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about "Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim." He said, "It is a name among the names of Allah, and there is nothing between it and the name of Allah al-Akbar except like the difference between the blackness and whiteness of the eye from its proximity."
hi: Ke Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' ke baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Allah ke naamon mein se aik naam hai, aur iske aur Allah ke sabse bade naam ke darmiyan bas itni hi qurbat hai jitni aankh ki kaali putli aur uski safedi ke darmiyan hoti hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Whoever recites the Quran has indeed brought himself closer to prophethood, though he does not receive revelation. It is not appropriate for the companion of the Quran to associate with those who cut off ties, nor to remain ignorant when others are ignorant. The words of Allah, the Most High, are within his chest.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Quran padhta hai, usne apne seene mein nabuwwat ko qareeb kar liya hai, siwaye is ke ke uspar wahi nazil nahi hoti. Quran wale ko yeh zeb nahi deta ke woh sakhti karne walon ke sath sakhti kare, aur na hi jahilana harkat karne walon ke sath jahilana harkat kare, jabke uske andar Allah Ta'ala ka kalaam ho."

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "The one who memorized the Qur'an shall come on the Day of Judgement and (the reward for reciting the Qur'an) says: 'O Lord! Decorate him." So he is donned with a crown of nobility. Then it says: "O Lord! Give him more!' So he is donned with a suit of nobility. Then it says: "O Lord! Be pleased with him.' So He is pleased with him and says: "Recite and rise up, and be increased in reward with every Ayah.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2915)
hi: Quran wala Qayamat ke din aayega, to Quran kahega: "Aye Rab, ise sanwaar de," to usse izzat ka taaj pehnaaya jayega, phir woh (Quran) kahega: "Aye Rab, isse zyada de," "Aye Rab, isse raazi ho ja," to Allah usse raazi ho jayega aur usse kaha jayega: "Padho aur (darjaat mein) chadho," aur har ayat ke sath usme neki barhti jayegi.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "On the Day of Judgment, it will be said to the companion of the Quran: 'Recite, rise in status and recite with a melodious voice as you used to recite in the worldly life. Indeed, your rank will be at the very last verse you recite.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran wale se Qayamat ke din kaha jayega: 'Padho, chadho, aur tarteel se padho jaise tum duniya mein tarteel se padha karte the, kyunke teri manzil us aakhri ayat par hai jise tu padhta hai.'"

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ:  The first book was revealed through one door and on one letter. The Quran was revealed through seven doors and on seven letters, commanding and prohibiting, declaring lawful and unlawful, with unambiguous verses and ambiguous verses, and examples. So make lawful what it permits, and prohibit what it forbids, and do what you are commanded to do, and refrain from what you are prohibited from, and consider its examples, and follow its unambiguous verses, and believe in its ambiguous verses, and say, "We believe in it; all of it is from our Lord."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Pehli kitaab aik hi darwaze se aik hi harf (lahje) par nazil hui, aur Quran saat darwazon se saat harfon par nazil hua, roakne wala aur hukum dene wala, halal aur haram, muhkam aur mutashabih, aur misalein deta hua, isliye iske halal ko halal jaano, iske haram ko haram jaano, jo tumhein hukum diya gaya use karo, jisse tumhein mana kiya gaya usse ruk jao, iski misalon se ibrat lo, iske muhkam par amal karo, iske mutashabih par imaan lao, aur kaho: 'Hum ispar imaan laaye, yeh sab humare Rab ki taraf se hai.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Hold fast to this Quran, for it is more eloquent and detailed than the chests of men in relation to their camels, and none of you should say, 'I have forgotten a verse,' instead, it is a case of being made to forget."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is Quran ki hifaazat karte raho, kyunke yeh jangli (jaanwar) hai, oonton ke apne bandhan se chhoot jaane se bhi zyada tezi se logon ke seenon se nikal jaata hai, aur tum mein se koi yeh na kahe ke maine fulan ayat bhula di, balke usse bhulaaya gaya hai."

e: [AI] "He used to recite while sitting on the porch of his house, and he had a beautiful voice. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came and said, 'I heard you reciting while something like a cloud overshadowed you, and there was a woman in the house and a horse in the yard, so I feared that the woman would fall and the horse would run away. So I left.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, 'Continue reciting, O master, for it was an angel who was listening to the Quran.'"
hi: Ke woh apne ghar ki chhat par Quran padh rahe the, aur unki awaz bohot achhi thi, ke Rasulullah (SAW) aaye aur unhone kaha: "Main padh raha tha ke achanak mujhpar baadal jaisi koi cheez chha gayi, aur ghar mein aurat thi aur aangan mein ghoda tha, to mujhe darr laga ke aurat na gir jaaye aur ghoda na bhaag jaaye, isliye main ruk gaya." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Padho, Aye Usaid, yeh to bas aik farishta tha jo Quran sun raha tha."

e: [AI] "That Usayd ibn Hudayr came to the Prophet ﷺ and recited the Hadith in its manner and said in it, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Recite, Usayd, recite, Usayd, for indeed, that is an angel who listens to the Quran.'"
hi: Ke Usaid bin Hudair (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhone hadith isi jaisi zikr ki, aur usme kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Padho, Usaid, padho, Usaid, kyunke woh aik farishta tha jo Quran sun raha tha."

e: [AI] He said, "While I was reciting Surah Al-Baqarah tonight, when I reached its end, I heard a noise from behind me and thought that my horse was being released. He said, 'Recite, O Abu 'Atiq,' and I turned around, and behold, there were lamps suspended between the heavens and the earth." He said, "O Messenger of Allah, I swear by Allah, I am not capable of continuing." He said, "Those are the angels who have descended to listen to the recitation of the Quran. Surely if you had continued, you would have seen wonders."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Main aaj raat Surah Al-Baqarah padh raha tha, jab main uske aakhir tak pahuncha to maine apne peechhe koi gir'ne ki awaz suni, mujhe laga mera ghoda chhoot gaya hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Padho, Aye Abu Atik," aur main mudkar dekha to chiraagon jaisi cheezein aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan latki hui thin. Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ki qasam, main aage nahi badh saka." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh farishte the jo Quran ki tilawat sunne ke liye utre the, agar tum aage badhte to tum ajeeb-o-ghareeb cheezein dekhte."

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “Fasting and the Quran will intercede for the servant on the Day of Resurrection: Fasting will say, 'O Lord, I prevented him from food and desires during the day, so let me intercede for him.' The Quran will say. 'O Lord, I prevented him from sleeping during the night, so let me intercede for him.'" He said, "˹Thus˺ they will both intercede for him.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 6626)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Roza aur Quran bande ki shafa'at karengay, roza kahega: "Aye Rab, maine ise din mein khaana aur khwahishaat se roka, isliye mujhe uske haq mein shafa'at karne de," aur Quran kahega: "Maine ise raat ko sone se roka," to dono ki shafa'at qubool ki jayegi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Verily, the one who has nothing of the Quran in his heart is like a ruined house."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak jiske seene mein Quran ka kuch bhi na ho, woh ujde huay ghar jaisa hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: One who recites the Qur'an in a loud voice is like one who gives alms openly; and one who recites the Qur'an quietly is one who gives alms secretly. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1333)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Quran buland awaz se padhne wala buland awaz se sadqa dene wale jaisa hai, aur Quran chupke se padhne wala chupke se sadqa dene wale jaisa hai." Sahih hadith, Bukhari ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "You shall not return to Allah with what is more virtuous than what came from Him." Meaning the Qur'an. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2912)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum Allah ki taraf kisi behtareen cheez ke sath wapas nahi laut sakte us cheez se jo usi se nikli" - ya'ni Quran.

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Indeed, this Quran is the banquet of Allah, so accept from His banquet what you can. Indeed, this Quran is the rope of Allah, the bright light, and the beneficial cure. It is a protection for those who hold onto it and a means of salvation for those who follow it. It does not deviate, so it should be sought for refuge and it does not twist, so it should be reinforced. Its wonders do not cease to exist and it is not created by the abundance of repetition. Recite it, for indeed, Allah rewards you for every letter with ten good deeds. I do not say 'Alif, Lam, Meem' is one letter, but rather 'Alif' is one letter, 'Lam' is one letter, and 'Meem' is one letter."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak yeh Quran Allah ka dastarkhaan hai, isliye jitna ho sake iske dastarkhaan se qubool karo. Beshak yeh Quran Allah ki rassi hai, roshan noor hai, faidamand shifa hai, jo ise pakde use hifaazat deta hai, aur jo iski pairavi kare use nijaat deta hai. Yeh na tedha hota hai ke sudhaara jaaye, na hi jhukta hai ke seedha kiya jaaye, iske ajaib khatam nahi hote, aur baar-baar dohraane se yeh puraana nahi padta. Ise padho, kyunke Allah tumhein iski tilawat par har harf par das nekiyaan deta hai, aur main yeh nahi kehta ke 'Alif Laam Meem' aik harf hai, balke Alif aik harf hai, Laam aik harf hai, aur Meem aik harf hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever recites ten verses in one night, will not be recorded among the heedless."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo raat mein dus (10) ayaat padhe, woh ghaafilon mein se nahi likha jaata."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, he said: "Whoever recites ten verses in a night, will not be recorded among those who are heedless, and whoever recites one hundred verses will be recorded among the devout."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo raat mein dus (10) ayaat padhe, woh ghaafilon mein se nahi likha jaata, aur jo sau (100) ayaat padhe, woh farmaanbardaaron mein se likha jaata hai."

e: "The Quran will come on the Day of Resurrection, like a pale man, and will say: 'I am the one that kept you awake at night and made you thirsty during the day." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3781)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Quran Qayamat ke din aik jawaan aadmi ki tarah aayega, apne saathi se kahega: "Main woh hoon jisne teri raat jagayi aur tera din pyaasa rakha."

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Prophet of Allah, I have bought a piece of land from the sons of so-and-so for a certain amount. Should I inform you about something that is more valuable than it?" The Prophet ﷺ asked, "Is there anything more valuable than it?" The man replied, "A person who memorized ten verses." The man then went and memorized ten verses and came back to inform the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ told him, "If 'Amr bin Khalid transmitted it through Salim bin Abi Al-Ja'd and if the narrators from Basra among the Muhajirun confirmed it, then it is authentic according to the conditions of Muslim except that the Basris among the Mu'tamirin (people who had performed Umrah) differed in its narration."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, maine fulan qabile ka hissa aik sanduk mein, jismein itna-itna (maal) tha, khareeda hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein aisi cheez na bataun jiski khushbu (qeemat) isse bhi zyada hai?" Usne poocha: "Kya aisi koi cheez milti hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh aadmi jo dus (10) ayaat seekhe." To woh shakhs gaya aur dus ayaat seekhi, phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas aakar unhein bataya. Agar Amr bin Khalid ne apni isnad mein Saalim bin Abi Al-Ja'd ko mehfooz rakha ho, to yeh Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, siwaye iske ke Mu'tamir ke Basri shagirdon ne is mein unki mukhaalifat ki hai.

e: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 99)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Allah has His own people among mankind.' They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, who are they?' He said: 'The people of the Qur'an, the people of Allah and those who are closest to Him.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 215)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ke logon mein se kuch khaas ghar wale hain." Sahaba ne poocha: "Woh kaun hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ahl-e-Quran, Allah ke log aur uske khaas log hain." Yeh hadith Anas (RA) se teen tareeqon se riwayat ki gayi hai, yeh unme sabse behtareen hai.

e: [AI] "When we used to learn ten verses from the Quran from the Prophet ﷺ , we would not learn from the next ten verses that were revealed until we understood what was in them." It was said to a partner in work, and he said, "Yes."
hi: "Jab hum Nabi (SAW) se Quran ki dus (10) ayaat seekhte the, to hum agli dus ayaat, jo iske baad nazil hui hotin, tab tak nahi seekhte the jab tak humein pehli ka ilm na ho jaata." Sharik se poocha gaya: "Amal ke silsile mein?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Shall I not teach you a Surah that was not revealed in the Torah, nor in the Injeel, nor in the Zabur, and not even in the Quran like it?" I said, "Certainly." He said, "Verily, I hope that it will not depart from this door until you learn it." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up and I stood up with him, and he started to teach me and I had my hand in his hand. I began to slow down, disliking to go ahead before he informed me about it. When I reached the door, I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, the Surah that you promised to teach me?' He said, 'How will you recite it when you stand to perform the prayer?' So I recited Al-Fatiha, and he said, 'It is this, it is this.' And it is the seven repeatedly recited verses and the great Quran that Allah, the Almighty, says, 'And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.' (Surah Al-Hijr 15:87), that which I was given."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein aisi Surah na sikhaun jaisi na Tauraat mein nazil hui, na Injeel mein, na Zaboor mein, aur na hi Quran mein iske jaisi koi aur?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe ummeed hai ke tum us darwaze se bahar nahi niklogay jab tak tumhein yeh yaad na ho jaaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay aur main unke sath khada hua, aap (SAW) mujhse baatein karte rahe jabke mera haath unke haath mein tha, main jaan-boojh kar dheere chal raha tha is baat se bachne ke liye ke kahin aap (SAW) mujhe bataaye bagair bahar na nikal jaayen. Jab main darwaze ke qareeb pahuncha to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh Surah jiska aapne mujhse wada kiya tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum namaz ke liye khade hote ho to kya padhte ho?" Maine Fatihatul-Kitaab padhi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yehi hai, yehi hai, aur yehi woh saat baar dohraayi jaane wali (ayaat) hain jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: '{Aur beshak humne tumhein saat baar dohraayi jaane wali (ayaat) aur Quran-e-Azeem ata kiya}' (Surah Al-Hijr 87), jo mujhe di gayi hain."

e: [AI] He informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Ubayy bin Ka'b while he was praying. When he finished his prayer, he placed his hand on Ubayy's hand and said, while he intended to leave through the door of the masjid, "I hope that you do not leave the masjid until you learn a Surah that has been revealed in the Torah, the Injeel, and the Qur'an, like it." Ubayy said, "So I slowed down in my walking, hoping for that. Then I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, which Surah did you promise me?' He said, 'How do you recite it when the prayer is first opened?' I said, "I recite, All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds" until I reached its end. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'It is this Surah and it is the seven repeated verses and the Glorious Qur'an which I have been given.'"
hi: Unhein khabar di ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) se farmaya jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, jab woh namaz se farigh huay to aap (SAW) ne unka haath thaama, phir Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath mere haath par rakha, unhone kaha: jabke aap (SAW) masjid ke darwaze se nikalna chahte the, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe ummeed hai ke tum masjid se bahar nahi niklogay jab tak tumhein aisi Surah yaad na ho jaaye jaisi na Tauraat mein nazil hui, na Injeel mein, aur na hi Quran mein iske jaisi koi aur." Unhone kaha: to main jaan-boojh kar dheere chalne laga is ummeed mein, phir maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh Surah jiska aapne mujhse wada kiya tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab namaz shuru hoti hai to tum kya padhte ho?" Unhone kaha: to maine 'Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen' padhi yahan tak ke main uske aakhir tak pahuncha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yehi hai woh Surah, aur yehi woh saat baar dohraayi jaane wali ayaat aur Quran-e-Azeem hai, jo mujhe di gayi hain."

e: [AI] "He (the narrator) recited upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds,' until he completed it, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, it is the seven often repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an that I have been given.' 'And I found that for the narration of Abdul Hamid ibn Ja'far, a witness to hearing from Abu Hurairah, this hadith from Ubay ibn Ka'b from the narration of the people of Madinah.'"
hi: Ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko 'Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen' padh kar sunayi yahan tak ke woh khatm ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yehi hai woh saat baar dohraayi jaane wali ayaat aur Quran-e-Azeem hai, jo mujhe di gayi hain." "Aur maine Abdul Hameed bin Ja'far ki hadith ka shahid Abu Hurairah (RA) ke is hadith ko Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) se sunne mein paaya hai, Madinah walon ki hadith mein se."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  called Ubbay ibn Ka'b while he was praying, but Ubbay did not answer him. The Prophet asked, "What prevented you from answering me, O Ubbay?" Ubbay replied, "I was praying." The Prophet reminded him, saying, "Did Allah, the Exalted, not say: 'Respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you'?" Ubbay then said, "I will not leave the mosque until you teach me a surah that Allah has revealed in the Torah, the Injeel, and the Zabur, like this one. Indeed, it is the Seven Oft-Repeated [Verses], which I have been given exclusively, and it is the Great Quran." This statement has been reported by Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih, in the hadith narrated by Ibn Abi Dhi'b from Sa'id al-Maqburi from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet ﷺ , who said, "The praise is due to Allah, the Mother of the Quran, the Seven Oft-Repeated [Verses], and the Great Quran."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ko pukaara jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, unhone jawaab nahi diya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ubayy, tumhein mujhe jawaab dene se kis cheez ne roka?" Unhone kaha: "Main namaz padh raha tha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne yeh nahi farmaya: '{Allah aur Rasool ki baat maano jab woh tumhein bulaayen}' (Surah Al-Anfal 24)? Masjid se bahar mat nikalna jab tak main tumhein aisi Surah na sikha dun jaisi na Allah ne Tauraat mein nazil ki, na Injeel mein, na Zaboor mein, aur beshak yeh saat (ayaat) hain jo mujhe di gayi hain, taweel wali, aur beshak yeh Quran-e-Azeem hai." Bukhari ne 'Al-Jami As-Sahih' mein Ibn Abi Dhi'b ki, Sa'eed Al-Maqburi se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat nikali hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Alhamdulillah, Umm-ul-Quran hai, aur Saba-ul-Mathani hai, aur Quran-e-Azeem hai." Yeh alfaaz sirf itne hi hain.

e: [AI] While Jibril ﷺ  was sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he heard a creaking sound from the sky. He raised his head and said, "A door has been opened in the sky that has never been opened before. Behold, there is an angel saying, 'Rejoice in two lights that you have been given, which no prophet before you has been granted: the opening chapter of the Book (Al-Fatiha) and the concluding verses of Surah Al-Baqarah. You will not recite a letter from them except that you will be given it.'"
hi: Jibra'il (AS) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas baithe huay the ke unhone aasman se aik chatakhne ki awaz suni, to unhone apna sar uthaya aur kaha: "Aasman mein aik darwaza khula hai jo isse pehle kabhi nahi khula tha." To dekha aik farishta keh raha hai: "Khushkhabri ho tumhein do noor ki, jo tumhein diye gaye hain, tumse pehle kisi Nabi ko nahi diye gaye - Fatihatul-Kitaab, aur Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri ayaatein - tum inme se koi harf nahi padhoge magar tumhein woh (uska sawaab) diya jayega."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said: "I was given the Opening of the Book (i.e., Al-Fatiha) from beneath the Throne, and the last verses of Surah Al-Baqarah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe Fatihatul-Kitaab Arsh ke neeche se di gayi hai, aur Mufassal (chhoti surahein) nafl ke tor par."

e: [AI] "We sent the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a battle or military expedition, and we passed by the people of Abiyat and sought their hospitality, but they did not offer us any. So we moved on and their leader was bitten by a snake. They came to us and asked if anyone among us can heal, and I said, 'I can heal.' They said, 'Then go with our leader.' I replied, 'No, we sought your hospitality and you did not offer us any.' They said, 'Okay, we will give you thirty sheep.' So I went with them, performed Ruqyah (healing through recitation) and recited Surah Al-Fatiha for him until he recovered. Then I took the sheep, but I did not feel comfortable eating them without asking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ first. So we approached him and told him the whole story. He said, 'What made you know that it was a Ruqyah?' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I did not know it was a Ruqyah, but something Allah has put in me.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Eat and share with me a portion.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein kisi ghazwe ya dastay mein bheja, hum kuch gharon walon ke paas se guzre, humne unse mehmaan-nawaazi maangi lekin unhone humari mehmaan-nawaazi nahi ki, to hum aage badhkar kisi aur jagah utre. Unka sardaar kisi (zehreeli cheez) se dank khaa baitha, woh humare paas aaye aur poocha: "Kya tum mein se koi dam kar sakta hai?" Maine kaha: "Main dam karta hoon." Unhone kaha: "To humare saathi ka dam karo." Maine kaha: "Nahi, humne tumse mehmaan-nawaazi maangi thi lekin tumne nahi ki." Unhone kaha: "To hum tumhein kuch dengay." Unhone humein tees (30) bakriyaan de dein. Unhone kaha: to main uske paas gaya, use masah karta gaya aur Fatihatul-Kitaab padhta gaya, use baar-baar dohraata raha yahan tak ke woh theek ho gaya. Humne bakriyaan le lin, phir humne kaha: "Humne yeh le li hain, lekin hum dam karne mein maahir nahi hain, hum inhein khaayenge nahi jab tak Rasulullah (SAW) se na poochh lein." To hum unke paas aaye aur unhein bataya, aap (SAW) kehne lage: "Tumhein kaise pata chala ke yeh dam hai?" Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe nahi pata tha ke yeh dam hai, magar Allah ne mere dil mein aik baat daali." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khao, aur mera hissa bhi mere sath rakhna."

e: [AI] He passed by a group of people who had a chained madman with them. One of them said to him, "Do you have anything that can heal this person? For your companion has brought something good." He replied, "I recited Surah Al-Fatiha upon him twice a day for three consecutive days, and he was cured." So they gave him a hundred sheep. He came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned this to him, and the Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever eats from a false incantation has indeed eaten from a true one."
hi: Unhone kaha: woh aik qaum ke paas se guzre, unke paas aik paagal shakhs loha (zanjeeron) mein jakda hua tha, unme se aik ne unse kaha: "Kya aapke paas is (bimari) ka koi ilaaj hai? Kyunke aapke saathi (Prophet) achhi cheez lekar aaye hain." Unhone kaha: maine usse Fatihatul-Kitaab teen din tak, har din do martaba, padh kar sunayi, to woh theek ho gaya, unhone unhein sau (100) bakriyaan din. Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur yeh baat unhein bataayi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khao, kyunke jisne kisi jhooti ruqya ke badle khaaya ho, tumne to sacchi ruqya ke badle khaaya hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was on a journey when a man came and stood beside him. The Prophet ﷺ  turned to him and said, "Shall I not inform you of the best of the Quran?" The man replied, "Indeed, please recite it to me." Then the Prophet ﷺ  recited, "All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds."
hi: Nabi (SAW) safar mein thay, aap (SAW) utre, aik shakhs bhi unke paas utra, Nabi (SAW) mudkar unki taraf dekhne lage aur farmaya: "Kya main tumhein Quran ki sabse afzal Surah na bataun?" Phir aap (SAW) ne unhein 'Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen' padh kar sunayi.

e: [AI] I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ and he said, "Learn Surah Al-Baqarah and Surah Al-Imran, for they are the two radiant lights that will shade their companion on the Day of Resurrection, like two clouds, or two shades, or two flocks of birds in rows."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas baitha tha ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Surah Al-Baqarah aur Aal-e-Imran seekho, kyunke yeh dono Zahrawan (chamakti hui) hain jo Qayamat ke din apne saathi ko saaya deti hain jaise woh do baadal hon, ya do saaye hon, ya parindon ke do jhund hon apni safon mein."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, everything has a pinnacle, and the pinnacle of the Quran is Surah Al-Baqarah." It was narrated by Sufyan bin 'Uyaynah from Hakim bin Jubair with an addition in it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har cheez ka aik koohaan (sabse ooncha hissa) hota hai, aur Quran ka koohaan Surah Al-Baqarah hai." Sufyan bin Uyainah ne isse Hakim bin Jubair se, ismein ziyaadti ke sath, riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "In Surah Al-Baqarah, there is a verse that is the chief of all verses in the Qur'an. It is not recited in a house where there is a devil except that the devil leaves that house. It is the verse of Al-Kursi."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Surah Al-Baqarah mein aik ayat hai jo Quran ki tamam ayaton ki sardaar hai, jis ghar mein woh padhi jaaye aur usme Shaitan ho, magar woh usse nikal jaata hai - yeh Ayat-ul-Kursi hai."

e: [AI] "Every thing has a summit, and the summit of the Quran is Surah Al-Baqarah. And when Satan hears Surah Al-Baqarah being recited, he retreats from the house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited."
hi: "Har cheez ka aik koohaan hota hai, aur Quran ka koohaan Surah Al-Baqarah hai, aur beshak jab Shaitan Surah Al-Baqarah padhi jaate suna hai to woh us ghar se nikal jaata hai jismein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi jaa rahi ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I was given Surah Al-Baqarah from the first remembrance."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe Surah Al-Baqarah pehli zikr (kitaab) mein se di gayi hai."

e: [AI] From Abu Al-Ahwas
hi: Abu Al-Ahwas se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Read Surah Al-Baqarah in your homes, for indeed Satan does not enter a house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne gharon mein Surah Al-Baqarah padho, kyunke Shaitan us ghar mein dakhil nahi hota jismein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi jaati hai."

e: [AI] He had a garden of dates, but he found it diminishing, so he guarded it one night. Behold, there he is like a young boy. He greeted him and he returned the greeting, saying, "Are you a jinn or a human?" He said, "Rather, I am a jinn." He said, "Show me your hand." So he showed it and his hand had the appearance of a dog's hand and fur. He said, "This is how the jinn are created." He said, "The jinn knew that there is no man among them stronger than me." He said, "What brought you?" He said, "We were informed that you love to give charity, so we came to have our share of your food." He said, "What prevents us from you?" He said, "Recite Ayat al-Kursi from Surah Al-Baqarah {Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence}. [Al-Baqarah 255]" He said, "Yes." He said, "If you recite it in the morning, you will be protected from us until the evening, and if you recite it in the evening, you will be protected from us until the morning." Ubayy said: So I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and told him about that, and he said, "He has spoken the truth, but he is a wicked one."
hi: Unke paas khajoor sukhaane ki jagah thi, unhein lagta ke wahan se (khajoor) kam ho rahi hai, to unhone aik raat pehra diya, achanak unhein baaligh honay ke qareeb aik ladke jaisi soorat nazar aayi, unhone use salaam kiya, usne bhi salaam ka jawaab diya, to unhone poocha: "Jinn ho ya insaan?" Usne kaha: "Balke jinn hoon." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe apna haath dikhaao." To usne dikhaaya, to woh kutte jaisa haath tha aur kutte jaise baal, unhone kaha: "Jinnaat ki takhleeq aisi hi hai?"
