Usne kaha: "Jinnaat ko yeh maloom hai ke unme mujhse zyada taaqatwar koi mard nahi." Unhone poocha: "Tum yahan kis liye aaye ho?" Usne kaha: "Humein bataya gaya ke tum sadqa pasand karte ho, isliye hum tumhare khaane mein se kuch le jaane aaye hain." Unhone poocha: "Humein tum se kya bacha sakta hai?" Usne kaha: "Surah Al-Baqarah ki Ayat-ul-Kursi padho: '{Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Zinda, Qaim rehne wala}' (Surah Al-Baqarah 255)." Unhone poocha: "Bas itna hi?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan, agar tum ise subah padho to shaam tak humse mehfooz rahogay, aur agar shaam ko padho to subah tak humse mehfooz rahogay." Ubayy (RA) ne kaha: to main subah Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein yeh baat bataayi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us khabees ne sach kaha."

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah wrote in a book two thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, and He sent down two Ayat from it to end Surat Al-Baqarah with. If they are recited for three nights in a home, no Shaitan shall come near it." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2882)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne aasman aur zameen banaane se do hazaar (2000) saal pehle aik kitaab likhi, aur usme se do ayaatein nazil ki jinke sath Surah Al-Baqarah khatm hoti hai, agar yeh do ayaatein kisi ghar mein teen raatein padhi jaayen to Shaitan uske qareeb nahi aata."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Verily, Allah concluded the Surah Al-Baqarah with two verses which He has granted me from His treasures beneath the throne. Learn and teach them to your wives, for indeed they are a prayer, recitation of the Quran, and supplication."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne Surah Al-Baqarah ko do ayaaton par khatm kiya jo usne mujhe apne us khazane se diya hai jo Arsh ke neeche hai, isliye inhein seekho aur apni biwiyon ko sikhaao, kyunke yeh namaz, Quran, aur dua hai."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , there is a narration from Muslim Ibn Malik Al-Ashja'i from Rabi'i Ibn Hiraash from Hudhayfah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I have been given the seal rings of Surah Al-Baqarah from a treasure beneath the Throne."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Muslim ne Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari ki, Rib'i bin Hiraash se, unhone Hudhaifah (RA) se, hadith nikali hai, ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri ayaatein Arsh ke neeche waale khazane se di gayi hain."

e: [AI] He made me the messenger of Allah ﷺ  in charge of the Muslims' charity, so I placed the dates in a room. I found that there was a decrease in the amount, so I informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, "This is the work of the devil." I entered the room and closed the door behind me. An immense darkness covered the door, then it took the form of an elephant, and then it took another form. It entered through a crack in the door, so I tightened my garment around me. It started eating from the dates, and I crawled towards it until I was able to capture it with my hands. I said, "O enemy of Allah!" It said, "Leave me, for I am an old jinn with many offspring, and I am poor. Before your companion was sent, this village used to belong to us, but when he was sent, we were expelled from it. Leave me and I won't come back to you." So, I let it go. Jibril ﷺ  came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him of what happened. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed Fajr prayer and called out, "Where is Mu'adh bin Jabal?" I went to him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked me, "What happened to your captive, O Mu'adh?" I informed him, and he said, "Indeed, it will return." It came back, and I entered the room and closed the door behind me. It entered through the crack in the door and started eating from the dates. I dealt with it as I did the first time, and it said, "Leave me, for I won't come back to you." I said, "O enemy of Allah! Didn't you say you won't come back?" It replied, "I won't come back, and the sign of this is that nobody among you should recite the concluding verses of Surah Al-Baqarah tonight and one of us will enter the house that night."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe Musalmanon ke sadqe (ki nigraani) par muqarrar kiya, to maine phal aik kamre mein rakha, mujhe usme kami mehsoos hui, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko bataya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Shaitan hai jo isse leta hai." Unhone kaha: to main kamre mein dakhil hua aur darwaza band kar liya, achanak bohot zyada andhera chha gaya aur darwaze ko dhaanp liya, phir woh haathi ki soorat mein dhal gaya, phir kisi aur soorat mein dhal gaya, phir darwaze ki daraar se andar aaya, to maine apna kapda apne aas-paas kas liya, woh khajoor khaane laga, unhone kaha: to main uski taraf uchal pada aur usse pakad liya, mere haath uspar milkar band ho gaye, maine kaha: "Aye Allah ke dushman!" Usne kaha: "Mujhe chhod do, main boodha hoon, mere bohot se bacche hain, main faqeer hoon, main Nasibin ke jinnaat mein se hoon, yeh basti tumhare saathi ke bheje jaane se pehle humari thi, jab woh bheje gaye to humein isse nikaal diya gaya, isliye mujhe chhod do, main dobara nahi aaunga." To maine usse chhod diya, aur Jibra'il (AS) aaye aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh baat bataayi jo hui thi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Subah ki namaz padhi, phir apne munaadi se pukaara: "Muadh bin Jabal kahan hai?" Main unke paas gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Muadh, tumhare qaidi ne kya kiya?" Maine unhein bataya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh dobara zaroor aayega." To woh dobara aaya, unhone kaha: to main kamre mein dakhil hua aur darwaza band kiya, woh darwaze ki daraar se andar aaya aur khajoor khaane laga, maine usse waisa hi kiya jaisa pehli baar kiya tha, usne kaha: "Mujhe chhod do, main dobara nahi aaunga." Maine kaha: "Aye Allah ke dushman, kya tumne nahi kaha tha ke main dobara nahi aaunga?" Usne kaha: "Main zaroor dobara nahi aaunga, aur iski nishaani yeh hai ke tum mein se koi Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri ayaatein padhega to hum mein se koi bhi uske ghar mein us raat dakhil nahi hoga."

e: [AI] Tell me about the story of the devil, and then mention the hadith.
hi: "Mujhe Shaitan ke qisse ke baare mein bataao," phir hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Whoever takes the first seven verses of the Quran, they are the best."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Quran ki pehli saat (7) ayaat le, woh uske liye behtareen hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Learn the Quran, for it will intercede for its people on the Day of Resurrection. And recite the two bright Surahs (Al-Baqarah and Al-Imran), for they will come on the Day of Resurrection like two clouds or like two shades, or like two flocks of birds in ranks, pleading for their companions. Learn Al-Baqarah, for learning it is a blessing and abandoning it is a regret, and the sorceresses cannot memorize it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran seekho, kyunke yeh Qayamat ke din apne ahl ke liye shafa'at karega, aur Zahrawain (do chamakti hui surahein) padho." Poocha gaya: "Zahrawain kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Baqarah aur Aal-e-Imran, kyunke yeh dono Qayamat ke din is tarah aayengay jaise woh do baadal hon, ya do saaye hon, ya safed parindon ke do jhund apni safon mein, apne paron se apne saathiyon ka daafa karte huay. Al-Baqarah seekho, kyunke iska seekhna barkat hai, aur ise chhodna hasrat (afsos) hai, aur jaadu-gar ise (haasil karne mein) kamyaab nahi hote."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever recites Surah Al-Kahf as it was revealed, it will be a light for him on the Day of Resurrection from his place to Mecca. And whoever recites the last ten verses of it and then the Antichrist appears, he will not be harmed by him. And whoever performs ablution and then says: 'Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. There is no god except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You,' it will be written on a parchment, then sealed with a seal and it will not be broken until the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Surah Al-Kahf jaisi woh nazil hui thi padhe, uske liye Qayamat ke din uski jagah se Makkah tak noor hoga, aur jo iski aakhri dus (10) ayaat padhe, phir Dajjal nikle, to woh uspar musallat nahi hoga, aur jo wudu kare phir kahe: 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik,' to yeh chamde par likh diya jaata hai, phir uspar mohar lagayi jaati hai jo Qayamat ke din tak nahi tooti."

e: [AI] Whoever reads Surah Al-Kahf and recites it in a similar manner.
hi: Jo Surah Al-Kahf padhe," phir hadith isi jaisi zikr ki.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Recite Surah Yasin at the time of your death." Yahya ibn Sa'id and others narrated this from Sulaiman al-Taymi. "And the saying concerning it is the saying of Ibn al-Mubarak when he said, 'The additional narration from a trustworthy individual is accepted.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Surah Yaseen, ise apne marne walon ke paas padho." Yahya bin Sa'eed aur doosron ne ise Sulaiman At-Taimi se mauqoof (raawi tak mahdood) bataya hai, aur is baare mein Ibn Al-Mubarak ki baat maani jaati hai, kyunke thiqa (raawi) ki ziyaadti qubool ki jaati hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: A surah of the Qur'an containing thirty verses will intercede its reader till he will be forgiven. That is: "Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the sovereignty" (Surah 67). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1400)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ki aik Surah, jismein tees (30) ayaat hain, aik aadmi ke liye shafa'at karti hai yahan tak ke woh maaf kar diya jaata hai, aur woh 'Tabarak-alladhi biyadihil-mulk' (Surah Al-Mulk) hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I wish that it [the Quran] was in the heart of every believer." Meaning, blessed is the One in whose hand is the dominion. This is a sahih (authentic) chain of narration according to the Yemeni scholars and they did not exclude it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mera dil chaahta hai ke yeh (Surah) har momin ke dil mein ho," ya'ni 'Tabarak-alladhi biyadihil-mulk' (Surah Al-Mulk). Yeh sanad Yemen walon ke nazdeek sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "From his father, the Prophet ﷺ  gave his daughter Umm Salama to him and said, 'You are my son-in-law.' He then approached him and said, 'What did you do with Juwayriyah or the slave girl?' I said, 'She was with her mother.' He said, 'So, what you have come for?' I said, 'I came so that you can teach me something to say in my dreams.' He said, 'Recite: Say, O disbelievers, for it is a disassociation from polytheism.'"
hi: Apne waalid se riwayat hai, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unhein apni beti Umm Salamah supurd ki thi aur farmaya tha: "Tum sirf meri daaya (dudh pilaane wali) ho." Unhone kaha: main unke paas aaya, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Choti bachi (Juwairiyah) ya ladki ne kya kiya?" Maine kaha: "Woh apni maa ke paas hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "To phir tum kis liye aaye ho?" Maine kaha: "Main aaya hoon ke aap mujhe kuch aisa sikha dein jo main apni neend ke waqt kahun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Padho: 'Qul ya ayyuhal kafiroon' (Kaho: Aye kaafiro), kyunke yeh shirk se baraa'at (bezaari) hai."

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Idha Zulzilat is equal to half of the Qur'an, Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad is equal to a third of the Qur'an, and Yul Ya Ayyuhal-Kafirun is equal to a fourth of the Qur'an." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2894)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iza Zulzilat (Surah Az-Zalzalah) Quran ke aadhe hisse ke barabar hai, aur Qul ya ayyuhal kafiroon (Surah Al-Kafiroon) Quran ke chauthaai hisse ke barabar hai, aur Qul huwa Allahu Ahad (Surah Al-Ikhlas) Quran ke tihaai hisse ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] He heard Abu Hurairah say, "I accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I heard a man reciting, 'Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent,' [Quran 112]. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'It (Paradise) is obligatory.' So I asked him, 'What, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'Paradise.' Abu Hurairah said, 'I wanted to go to the man and give him the glad tidings, then I opted not to miss lunch with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ so I preferred the lunch, then I went to the man and found that he had left.'"
hi: Unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aaya, aap (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko yeh padhte suna: "{Kaho: Woh Allah aik hai, Allah be-niyaz hai, na usne kisi ko paida kiya na woh kisi se paida hua, aur na hi koi uske barabar hai}" (Surah Al-Ikhlas 2). To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wajib ho gayi." Maine poocha: "Kya cheez, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: to maine chaha ke us shakhs ke paas jaakar use khushkhabri dun, phir mujhe darr laga ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath khaana khaane ka mauqa na chhoot jaaye, to maine khaane ko tarjeeh di, phir main us shakhs ke paas gaya to woh ja chuka tha.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the yellow house is a house in which there is nothing from the Book of Allah. So recite the Quran, for indeed you will be rewarded for every letter with ten good deeds. As for me, I do not say 'Alif, Lam, Mim,' but rather I say 'Alif, Lam, Mim.' It was recorded by someone other than Ad-Dashtaki. Abu Sa'id Ahmad ibn Ya'qub Ath-Thaqafi narrated to us, Abd Allah ibn Abd ar-Rahman ibn Abd Allah Ad-Dashtaki narrated to us, my father narrated to us, Amr ibn Abi Qays narrated to us, from Asim, from Abu Al-Ahwas, from Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ  in a similar manner."
hi: "Beshak sabse ujda (bad-rang) ghar woh hai jismein Allah ki Kitaab se kuch bhi na ho, isliye Quran padho, kyunke tumhein iski tilawat par har harf par das nekiyaan milti hain, aur main yeh nahi kehta ke 'Alif Laam Meem' aik harf hai, balke main kehta hoon Alif aik harf hai, Laam aik harf hai, aur Meem aik harf hai." Isse kisi aur ne bhi Ad-Dashtaki se marfoo' (Nabi tak pahunchne wali) riwayat kiya hai. Humein Abu Sa'eed Ahmad bin Ya'qub Ath-Thaqafi ne bataya, unhein Abdullah bin Abdur Rahman bin Abdullah Ad-Dashtaki ne bataya, unhein mere waalid ne bataya, unhein Amr bin Abi Qais ne, Aasim se, unhone Abu Al-Ahwas se, unhone Abdullah se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Can any of you recite a thousand verses every day?" They asked, "Who among us can do that?" He replied, "Can any of you recite Surah Al-Haqqah?" All the narrators of this hadith are reliable and the authenticity of this statement is not known.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se koi har din hazar (1000) ayaat padhne ki taaqat nahi rakhta?" Unhone poocha: "Yeh kaun kar sakta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se koi 'Alhakumut-takathur' (Surah At-Takathur) padhne ki taaqat nahi rakhta?" Is hadith ke sare raawi thiqa hain, aur yeh Uqbah mash-hoor nahi hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None of you should sleep until he recites one-third of the Quran." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, how can any of us recite one-third of the Quran?" He said, "Can anyone of you not recite Say: He is Allah, the One, and Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, and Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind?"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi na soye jab tak woh Quran ka tihaai hissa na padh le." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humme se koi Quran ka tihaai hissa kaise padh sakta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se koi 'Qul huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas), 'Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbil-Falaq' (Surah Al-Falaq), aur 'Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbin-Naas' (Surah An-Naas) padhne ki taaqat nahi rakhta?"

e: He asked the Prophet ﷺ about Al-Mua'awwidhatain. Uqbah said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in praying Fajr and recited them." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 952)
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se Al-Mu'awwidhatain (Surah Al-Falaq aur An-Naas) ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "To Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Fajr ki namaz mein inhi dono se namaz padhayi."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  sent Mu'adh and Abu Musa to Yemen and instructed them to teach the people the Quran.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "Muadh (RA) aur Abu Musa (RA) ko Yemen bheja aur unhein hukum diya ke woh logon ko Quran sikhaayen."

e: If anyone recites the Qur'an and acts according to its content, on the Day of Judgement his parents will be given to wear a crown whose light is better than the light of the sun in the dwellings of this world if it were among you. So what do you think of him who acts according to this ? (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1453)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Quran padhe aur usme jo hai uspar amal kare, uske waalid ko Qayamat ke din aik taaj pehnaaya jayega jiski roshni duniya ke gharon ke suraj ki roshni se behtar hogi, jabke woh (Quran) khud unke sath tha, to tumhara us shakhs ke baare mein kya khayaal hai jisne khud iske mutabiq amal kiya?"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever reads the Quran, learns it, and acts upon it, will be adorned on the Day of Resurrection with a crown of light, the brightness of which is like the brightness of the sun. His parents will be dressed in two garments that the worldly life cannot provide, and they will say, 'By what were we dressed?' It will be said, 'By the recitation of your child of the Quran.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Quran padhe, usse seekhe, aur uspar amal kare, use Qayamat ke din noor ka taaj pehnaaya jayega jiski roshni suraj ki roshni jaisi hogi, aur uske dono waalidain ko do aise kapde pehnaaye jaayenge jinke barabar duniya khadi nahi ho sakti, woh donon poochenge: 'Humein yeh kis wajah se pehnaaye gaye?' To kaha jayega: 'Tumhare bachche ke Quran haasil karne ki wajah se.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Act according to the Quran, make its halal (lawful) lawful for yourself and its haram (forbidden) forbidden for yourself, follow it, and do not disbelieve in anything from it. If there is something ambiguous to you in it, refer it back to Allah and to those in authority after me, so that they may clarify it for you. Believe in the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and what the prophets received from their Lord. The Quran and its explanations are sufficient for you, as it is an intercessor and an intermediary. Every verse of it is a light on the Day of Judgment. Indeed, I have been given Surah Al-Baqarah from the initial revelation and I have been given Taha and Al-Hawamim from the Tablets of Moses, and I have been given the Opening of the Book from beneath the Throne."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran par amal karo, iske halal ko halal jaano aur iske haram ko haram jaano, iski pairavi karo, aur ismein se kisi cheez ka inkaar na karo, aur jo tumhein ismein mutashabih (mushkil samajh aane wali) lage, use Allah ki taraf aur mere baad ke sahib-e-amr (zimmedaron) ki taraf palta do, taake woh tumhein bataayen, aur Tauraat, Injeel, Zaboor, aur jo Ambiya ko unke Rab ki taraf se diya gaya uspar imaan lao, aur Quran aur iske bayaan par iktifa karo, kyunke yeh shafa'at karne wala hai aur uski shafa'at qubool ki jaati hai, aur jo isse tasdeeq kare woh haq hai, aur har ayat ke liye Qayamat ke din aik noor hai, aur beshak mujhe Surah Al-Baqarah pehli zikr (kitaab) mein se di gayi hai, aur mujhe Ta-Ha aur Tawaseen aur Hawameem (surahein) Musa (AS) ke takhton mein se di gayi hain, aur mujhe Fatihatul-Kitaab Arsh ke neeche se di gayi hai."

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, which actions are the best?" He replied, "The one who goes on a journey." He asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what is a journey?" He said, "Reciting the Quran from the beginning to the end and from the end to the beginning."
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Haal Al-Murtahil (utarne wala, kooch karne wala)." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Al-Haal Al-Murtahil kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ke shuru se aakhir tak, aur aakhir se shuru tak, guzarta rehta hai."

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, which actions are the best?" He said, "The state of a constant traveler." He said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the state of a constant traveler?" He said, "The one who is constantly engaging with the Quran, reciting from the beginning until the end and from the end until the beginning. Every time he finishes, he starts again." "Salih Al-Murriyyu, a righteous person from the ascetics of Basra, excelled in this, except that the two Sheikhs (Abu Bakr and Umar) did not narrate from him." And he has a witness from the narration of Abu Huraira.
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Haal Al-Murtahil." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Al-Haal Al-Murtahil kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran wala, jo iske shuru se leke iske aakhir tak pahunche, phir iske aakhir se leke iske shuru tak pahunche, jab bhi utarta hai, phir kooch kar deta hai." Isse sirf Salih Al-Murri ne riwayat kiya hai, jo Basra ke zaahidon mein se hain, magar Shaykhain ne unse riwayat nahi nikali. Iska aik shahid Abu Hurairah (RA) ki hadith mein hai.

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, which action is better? Or which action is more beloved to Allah?" He replied, "The one who is constantly on the move, opening the Quran and completing it; the companion of the Quran. He starts from the beginning and finishes at the end, and from the end to the beginning. Whenever he finishes, he starts again."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas khada hua aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsa amal sabse afzal hai? Ya kaunsa amal Allah ko sabse zyada mahboob hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Haal Al-Murtahil, jo Quran ko khole aur khatm kare, Quran wala apne shuru se aakhir tak, aur aakhir se shuru tak, guzarta hai, jab bhi utarta hai, phir kooch kar deta hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "He is not one of us who does not find comfort in the Quran." Sufyan said, "He means to be self-sufficient with it." "And according to Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah, there is another chain of narration regarding this."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Woh humme se nahi jo Quran ko khush-ilhaani se na padhe." Sufyan ne kaha: "Iska matlab hai ke woh ismein be-niyaz ho jaaye." Sufyan bin Uyainah ke paas iski aik aur sanad bhi hai.

e: (The narrator Qutaibah said: This tradition has been narrated by Sa'id b. Abu Sa'id in my collection): The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: He who does not chant the Qur'an is not one of us. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1469)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Woh humme se nahi jo Quran ko khush-ilhaani se na padhe."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "He who does not recite the Quran is not of us." "The narration of Layth does not prevent the narration of Abdullah ibn Abi Nahik, for they are two followers and the evidence of the authenticity of both narrations is the narration of Amr ibn al-Harith, who is one of the reliable memorizers, narrating from Ibn Abi Muleika."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh humme se nahi jo Quran ko khush-ilhaani se na padhe." Al-Laith ki riwayat ko Abdullah bin Abi Nuhaik ki in riwayaton se rad nahi kiya jaata, kyunke woh dono Tabi'i bhai hain, aur dono riwayaton ki sehat ki daleel Amr bin Al-Harith ki riwayat hai, jo pukhta yaad rakhne walon mein se hain, Ibn Abi Mulaikah se.

e: People entered upon Saad b. Abu Waqqas and asked him about the Quran. Saad said, "Indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: *"He is not one of us who does not recite the Quran melodiously."*"[^1]
hi: Kuch log Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ke paas aaye aur unse Quran ke baare mein poocha, to Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: "Beshak maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Woh humme se nahi jo Quran ko khush-ilhaani se na padhe.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "He is not one of us who does not sing with the Quran." And it was narrated by Al-Harith ibn Murrah Al-Thaqafi Al-Basri from 'Asl ibn Sufyan from Ibn Abi Mulaykah from Aisha from the Prophet ﷺ . And Al-Harith narrated it with this chain of narration from Ibn Abbas.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh humme se nahi jo Quran ko khush-ilhaani se na padhe." Al-Harith bin Murrah Ath-Thaqafi Al-Basri ne ise Isl bin Sufyan se, unhone Ibn Abi Mulaikah se, unhone Aisha (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se riwayat kiya hai, aur Al-Harith ne isi sanad se Ibn Abbas (RA) se bhi riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "He is not one of us who does not recite the Quran beautifully." This hadith does not exclude 'Asl bin Sufyan Al Wahm. The narration is attributed to the hadith of Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas, and Allah knows best. As for the hadith that both scholars unanimously agree upon its authenticity in Sahih Al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim, it is different from this text. They both agreed upon the narration of Az-Zuhri from Abu Salamah from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Allah did not permit anyone to sing the Quran as it was permitted for the Prophet."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh humme se nahi jo Quran ko khush-ilhaani se na padhe." Isl bin Sufyan se ghalati ka imkaan door nahi, aur yeh hadith Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ki hadith ki taraf lautati hai, wallahu a'lam. Rahi baat us hadith ki jispar Shaykhain ne Sahihain mein ittifaq kiya hai, to woh is matan se alag hai, dono ne Az-Zuhri ki, Abu Salamah se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, hadith nikaalne par ittifaq kiya hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne kisi cheez ki utni ijaazat nahi di jitni usne kisi Nabi ko Quran ko khush-ilhaani se padhne ki ijaazat di."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Allah listens more attentively to a man with a beautiful voice who recites Qur’an out loud than the master of a singing slave listens to his slave.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1340)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah kisi achhi awaz wale aadmi ki Quran (tilawat) ki taraf, kisi gaane wali laundi ke maalik ki uski awaz sunne se bhi zyada, kaan lagata hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Adorn the Quran with your voices." This was narrated by Mansur ibn al-Mu'tamir.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro." Isse Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir ne isi tarah riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the forward rows." And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Adorn your voices with the Qur'an." This was narrated by Zaidah bin Qudamah, Amr bin Abi Qays, Jarir bin Abdul-Hamid, Ammar bin Muhammad, and Ibrahim bin Tahman, from Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah aur uske farishte agli safon par durood bhejte hain." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni awazon ko Quran se sanwaaro." Isse Za'idah bin Qudamah, Amr bin Abi Qais, Jarir bin Abdul Hameed, Ammar bin Muhammad, aur Ibrahim bin Tahman ne, Mansoor bin Al-Mu'tamir se, isi tarah riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, in a long hadith, "Adorn the Quran with your voices."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, aik lambi hadith mein: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Allah and the angels send blessings upon the first row.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 999)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah aur uske farishte pehli safon par durood bhejte hain, aur Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Adorn the Quran with your voices." This was narrated by Jarir ibn Hazim from Zubeid ibn Al-Harith from Talhah ibn Musarrif. The narration was lengthy and did not mention "Adorn the Quran with your voices."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro." Isse Jarir bin Hazim ne Zubaid bin Al-Harith se, unhone Talhah bin Musarrif se, poori lambi hadith riwayat ki hai, magar 'Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro' ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: [AI] About Talhah ibn Musarrif, so he mentioned him.
hi: Talhah bin Musarrif se, phir unhone isi ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Embélissez le Coran avec vos voix", and in the Hadith of Ma'mar, "Embélissez vos voix avec le Coran."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro," aur Ma'mar ki hadith mein hai: "Apni awazon ko Quran se sanwaaro."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Make your voices beautiful when you recite Quran.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1016)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro." Abdur Rahman ne kaha: aur main yeh kalima bhool gaya tha yahan tak ke Ad-Dahhak bin Muzahim ne mujhe yaad dilaaya.

e: [AI] Regarding the branch, he mentioned the hadith in its entirety.
hi: Shu'bah se, phir unhone poori lambi hadith zikr ki.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ  that he used to come to the back of the row to the last position and even out the chests and shoulders of the people, and he would say, "Do not differ, lest your hearts differ. Verily, Allah and His angels pray upon the first ranks."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) saf ke aik kinare se doosre kinare tak jaate, logon ke seenon aur kandhon ko barabar karte, aur farmate: "Ikhtilaaf mat karo warna tumhare dil mein ikhtilaaf paida ho jayega, beshak Allah aur uske farishte pehli safon par durood bhejte hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to come to us after the prayer was established, and he would wipe our shoulders and say, "Arrange your rows and do not differ, for your hearts may differ. Let those among you who have knowledge and authority lead, and beautify the Quran with your voices. Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the front line."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas aate jab namaz qaim ki jaati, hamare kandhe seedhe karte aur farmate: "Apni safein durust karo aur ikhtilaaf mat karo warna tumhare dil mein ikhtilaaf paida ho jayega, aur tum mein se aqal-mand aur baalig log mere qareeb khade hon, aur Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro, beshak Allah aur uske farishte agli saf par durood bhejte hain."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wipe our shoulders during the prayer" and he mentioned the narration.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) namaz mein humare kandhe seedhe karte the," phir hadith ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say, "Do not differ, lest your hearts differ. Verily, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the first row, and beautify the Quran with your voices."
hi: Nabi (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Ikhtilaaf mat karo warna tumhare dil mein ikhtilaaf paida ho jayega, beshak Allah aur uske farishte pehli saf par durood bhejte hain, aur Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Aur unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: [AI] The translation of the given sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to come to us while we were in prayer and he would gently wipe our chests and say, 'Adorn the Quran with your voices.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aate jabke hum namaz mein hote, humare seene seedhe karte aur farmate: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)

hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Adorn the Quran with your voices." We found that Abdurrahman ibn Awsaja had followers in narrating this hadith from Al-Bara' ibn 'Azib, and they were Zadhan Abu Umar, Adi ibn Thabit, and Aus ibn Damaj.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro." "Aur humein Abdur Rahman bin Awsajah ke liye Al-Bara' (RA) se is hadith ki riwayat mein mutaba'at karne wale mile hain, aur woh Zadhan Abu Umar, Adi bin Thabit, aur Aws bin Dam'aj hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Adorn the Quran with your voices, for indeed the beautiful voice enhances the beauty of the Quran."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro, kyunke achhi awaz Quran ki khoobsurati ko badhaati hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Embroider the Quran with your voices." "Then we looked and found Talha bin Musarrif following in his narration from Abdul Rahman bin Awusajah, and they were Hakam bin Utaybah and Zubaid bin Al-Harith."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro." "Phir humne dekha to Talhah bin Musarrif ki, Abdur Rahman bin Awsajah se riwayat mein, unke do mutaba'at karne wale mile, aur woh Al-Hakam bin Utaibah aur Zubaid bin Al-Harith hain."

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Allah and the angels send blessings upon the first row.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 999)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah aur uske farishte pehli saf par durood bhejte hain."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Beautify the Qur'an with your voices. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1468)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko apni awazon se sanwaaro."

e: [AI] He narrated that he said, "And certainly, We have given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an." He said, "It is the mother of the Qur'an." My father recited to me, Sa'id bin Jubayr, "In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful." [Surah Al-Fatiha 1] the seventh verse. Sa'id bin Jubayr recited it to me, and Ibn Abbas also recited it to me as I recited it to you. Then he said, "In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful." [Surah Al-Fatiha 1] the seventh verse. Ibn Abbas said, "Allah has revealed it to you and never revealed it to anyone before you."
hi: Unhein khabar di, kaha: "{Aur beshak humne tumhein saat baar dohraayi jaane wali (ayaat) di hain}" (Surah Al-Hijr 87), unhone kaha: "Yeh Umm-ul-Quran (Surah Al-Fatihah) hai." Unke waalid ne kaha: aur Sa'eed bin Jubair ne mujhe 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' (Surah Al-Fatihah 1) saatvi ayat ke tor par padh kar sunayi. Sa'eed bin Jubair ne kaha: aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ne mujhe ise waise hi padh kar sunayi thi jaise maine tumhein padh kar sunayi, phir unhone kaha: 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' (Surah Al-Fatihah 1) saatvi ayat hai. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "To Allah ne ise tumhare liye nikaala, aur usne ise tumse pehle kisi ke liye nahi nikaala."

e: "In Al-Madinah we used to buy and sell Wasqs (of goods), and we used to call ourselves Samasir (brokers), and the people used to call us like that. The Messenger of Allah came out to us one day, and called us by a name that was better than that which we called ourselves and which the people called us. He said: 'O Tujjar (traders), your selling involves (false) oaths and lies, so mix some charity with it.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3800)
hi: Hum Madinah mein wasq (anaaj ke bade paimane) bechte aur khareedte the, aur hum khud ko "Samasira" (dalaal) kehte the, aur log bhi humein isi naam se pukaarte the. Aik din Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas tashreef laaye, aur unhone humein aisa naam diya jo humare khud ke rakhe huay naam se aur logon ke diye huay naam se behtar tha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye tujjaar ke giroh, tumhari khareed-o-farokht mein fuzool baatein aur qasmein shaamil hoti hain, isliye ise sadqe se mila do."

e: [AI] The Prophet, peace be upon him, came to us to the market and said, "Oh merchants, indeed, this marketplace is mixed with oath-taking, so purify it with charity."
hi: Nabi (SAW) humare paas bazaar mein aaye aur farmaya: "Aye tujjaar ke giroh, is bazaar mein qasmein mili hoti hain, isliye ise sadqe se mila do."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  came to us while we were selling slaves in the city, and we used to call ourselves brokers. He then gave us a better name than what we called ourselves. He said, "O merchants! This trade involves idle talk and oaths, so purify it with charity." This is the wording of the hadith of Thawri.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas aaye jabke hum Madinah mein ghulam bech rahe the, aur hum "Samasira" kehlaate the, to aap (SAW) ne humein humare khud ke rakhe huay naam se behtar naam diya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye tujjaar ke giroh, is khareed-o-farokht mein fuzool baatein aur qasmein shaamil hoti hain, isliye ise sadqe se mila do." Yeh Ath-Thawri ki hadith ke alfaaz hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The truthful, trustworthy Muslim merchant will be with the martyrs on the Day of Resurrection." Kulthum, who has limited speech, reported this hadith, but it has not been mentioned by any other narrator. However, there is a witness in the narrations of Al-Hasan. Kulthum bin Jusham's weakness has been mentioned by Abu Hatim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sachcha, amanatdaar Musalman tajir Qayamat ke din shuhada ke sath hoga." Yeh Kulthum Basra ke hain, jinki hadith kam hai, dono ne inse riwayat nahi nikali, aur inka aik shahid Al-Hasan ki mursal riwayaton mein hai. Kulthum bin Jawshan ko Abu Hatim ne kamzor qaraar diya hai.

e: "The truthful, trustworthy merchant is with the Prophets, the truthful, and the martyrs." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1209)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sachcha, amanatdaar tajir Ambiya, Siddiqeen, aur Shuhada ke sath hoga."

e: From his father, from his grandfather, that he went with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to the Musalla, and he saw the people doing business so he said: 'O people of trade!' and they replied to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turning their necks and their gazes towards him, and he said: Indeed the merchants will be resurrected on the Day of judgement with the wicked, except the one who has Taqwa of Allah, who behaves charitably and is truthful.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1210)
hi: Ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Madinah ki namaz-gaah ki taraf nikle, wahan unhone logon ko khareed-o-farokht karte paaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye tujjaar ke giroh!" To unhone jawaab diya aur apni nazrein aur gardanein Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf uthaayi, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak tujjaar Qayamat ke din fujjaar (gunahgaar) hokar uthaaye jaayenge, siwaye us shakhs ke jo Allah se dara, neki ki, aur sach bola."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "Indeed, the traders are the wicked." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, hasn't Allah made trading permissible?" He said, "Yes, but they swear falsely and commit sins, and they engage in deception and lie."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak tujjaar hi fujjaar (gunahgaar) hain." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya Allah ne khareed-o-farokht ko halal nahi kiya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kyun nahi, lekin woh qasmein khaate hain aur gunahgaar ho jaate hain, aur baatein karte hain aur jhoot bolte hain."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Merchants are the sinful ones, merchants are the sinful ones." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, hasn't Allah made trade lawful?" He said, "Indeed, but they lie and commit perjury, so they sin."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Tujjaar hi fujjaar hain, tujjaar hi fujjaar hain." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya Allah ne khareed-o-farokht ko halal nahi kiya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kyun nahi, lekin woh baatein karte hain aur jhoot bolte hain, aur qasmein khaate hain aur gunahgaar ho jaate hain."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, among the signs of the Hour are that wealth will overflow, ignorance will increase, turmoil will appear, and commerce will spread."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se hai ke maal bohot zyada ho jaaye, jahalat badh jaaye, fitne zaahir hon, aur tijarat aam ho jaaye."

e: [AI] A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, which cities are the worst?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "I do not know." When Jibril (Gabriel) came to him, he asked him the same question. Jibril replied, "I don't know until I ask my Lord." So, Jibril went away and stayed as long as Allah willed, then he returned and said, "O Muhammad, indeed you asked me which cities are the worst, and I said I don't know, but I asked my Lord, and He answered: 'The worst of them in terms of their markets.'"
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsa shehar sabse bura hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata." Jab Jibra'il (AS) unke paas aaye to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Jibra'il, kaunsa shehar sabse bura hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata, jab tak main apne Rab se na poochun." To Jibra'il (AS) chale gaye aur jitni der Allah ne chaha thehre, phir aaye aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, aapne mujhse poocha tha ke kaunsa shehar sabse bura hai, aur maine kaha tha mujhe nahi pata, to maine apne Rab se poocha, maine poocha: 'Kaunsa shehar sabse bura hai?' To usne farmaya: 'Unke bazaar.'"

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, which are the best places?" The Prophet replied, "I do not know." The man asked, "Which are the worst places?" The Prophet again replied, "I do not know." Then, Jibril came to him and said, "Ask your Lord." So, the Prophet asked Allah, and Jibril informed him that Allah had asked which are the best places, to which the Prophet had replied, "I do not know," and which are the worst places, to which the Prophet had also replied, "I do not know." Jibril then said, "Yes." Then, Jibril told him that the best places are the mosques, and the worst places are the marketplaces.
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsi jagah sabse behtareen hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata." Usne poocha: "To kaunsi jagah sabse buri hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata." To Jibra'il (AS) unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Apne Rab se poochiye." Jibra'il (AS) ne kaha: "Hum usse kisi cheez ke baare mein nahi poochte," to Muhammad (SAW) itni shiddat se kaanp gaye ke qareeb tha ke woh dono behosh ho jaate. Jab Jibra'il (AS) (aasman ki taraf) chadhe, to Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Muhammad (SAW) ne tumse poocha tha ke kaunsi jagah sabse behtareen hai, to tumne kaha 'mujhe nahi pata,' aur unhone tumse poocha ke kaunsi jagah sabse buri hai, to tumne kaha 'mujhe nahi pata,'" Allah ne kaha: "Haan," phir farmaya: "To unhein bata do ke sabse behtareen jagahein masjidein hain, aur sabse buri jagahein bazaar hain." Sahih.

e: let those of your who are sedate and prudent be near me, then those who are next to them, then those who are next to them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 674)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se aqal-mand aur baaligh log mere qareeb khade hon, phir jo unke baad hon, phir jo unke baad hon, aur ikhtilaaf mat karo warna tumhare dil mein ikhtilaaf paida ho jayega, aur bazaaron ke hangaame se bacho."

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah narrated that a man swore an oath regarding his possession, and this narration is different from that due to the addition of the verse's revelation and others. It is authentic.
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, ke aik shakhs ne apne maal ke baare mein qasam khaayi, hadith (isi tarah hai), aur yeh us (pichli) se alag hai kyunke ismein ayat ke nazil honay ka izafa hai aur doosri baatein bhi.

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'The Muslim is the brother of another Muslim, and it is not permissible for a Muslim to sell his brother goods in which there is a defect, without pointing that out to him."' (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2246)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Musalman Musalman ka bhai hai, aur kisi Musalman ke liye jaayaz nahi ke woh apne bhai ko koi ayb-daar cheez beche aur use na bataaye."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  passed by a man selling food, and it impressed him. So, he put his hand in it, and it turned out to be wet food. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "He who deceives us is not one of us."
hi: Nabi (SAW) aik shakhs ke paas se guzre jo khana bech raha tha, unhein woh pasand aaya, to unhone apna haath usme daala, to dekha neeche geela khana tha, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo humein dhoka de woh humme se nahi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ came to the market and saw a pile of wheat. He put his hand in it and found it damp. He said, "Whoever deceives us is not one of us." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) bazaar aaye aur dabaay huay gehun dekhe, unhone apna haath usme daala to nami mehsoos hui, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khabardar! Jo humein dhoka de woh humme se nahi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by a dish of food and put his hand into it. His fingers became wet, so he said, "What is this, O owner of the food?" The food's owner said, "It has been rained on, O Messenger of Allah." The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "So why didn't you put it on top of the food so that people could see it?" Then he said, "Whoever deceives us is not one of us." Muslim has also reported a hadith from Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, that the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever deceives us is not one of us." As for the explanation of these narrations, it has not been mentioned, but all of them are authentic according to the standards of Muslim's narration.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik dhair khaane ke paas se guzre, unhone apna haath usme daala to unki ungliyon ko nami mehsoos hui, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai, aye khaane wale?" Usne kaha: "Baarish ne ise bhigo diya, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Phir tumne ise oopar kyun nahi rakha taake log ise dekh sakein?" Phir farmaya: "Jo humein dhoka de woh mujhse nahi." Muslim ne Suhail ki, unke waalid se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, hadith bhi nikali hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo humein dhoka de woh humme se nahi." In ahadith ki tafseel dono ne nahi nikaali, magar sab Muslim ki shart par sahih hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out to Al-Baqi' and saw some food being sold in dirty containers. He put his hand in and took out something he disliked and said, "Whoever deceives us is not one of us."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Al-Baqi' ki taraf nikle, unhone bori mein khana bikte dekha, unhone apna haath daala aur aisi cheez nikaali jo unhein napasand aayi, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo humein dhoka de woh humme se nahi."

e: [AI] "O Abdullah, did you buy it?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Did he explain to you what is in it?" I said, "And what is in it? It is a visible fat and healthy." He said, "Did you intend to use it for travel or intended to use it for meat?" I said, "I intended to use it for Hajj." He said, "Return it." Then its owner said, "You only wanted this, may Allah rectify you. It would have caused me harm." He said, "Indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'It is not permissible for anyone to sell something unless he clarifies what is in it, and it is not permissible for anyone who knows that to conceal it.'"
hi: "Aye Abdullah, kya tumne khareeda?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone poocha: "Kya usne tumhein bataya jo ismein tha?" Maine kaha: "Ismein kya hai? Yeh to mota-taaza aur zaahiri tor par tandurust hai." Unhone poocha: "Kya tum ise safar ke liye chahte ho ya gosht ke liye?" Maine kaha: "Main ise Hajj ke liye chahta hoon." Unhone kaha: "To ise wapas kar do." To uske maalik ne kaha: "Aapko yehi karna tha, Allah aapko theek kare, aap mera nuqsaan kar rahe hain." Unhone kaha: to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Kisi ke liye jaayaz nahi ke woh koi cheez beche jab tak usme jo hai woh na bataaye, aur jo yeh jaanta ho, uske liye jaayaz nahi ke woh use na bataaye."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was asked, "Which earning is the best or most excellent?" He replied, "The work of a person's own hands and every lawful transaction." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Kaunsi kamai sabse paakeeza ya sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadmi ka apne haath se kaam karna, aur har jaayaz (barkat wali) khareed-o-farokht." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked, "Which earnings are the best?" He replied, "Earnings that are earned through lawful means."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Kaunsi kamai sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jaayaz (barkat wali) kamai."

e: [AI] It was asked, "O Messenger of Allah, which type of earnings is the best?" He said, "The earnings of a man through his own hand and every transaction that is free from deceit." And this is a third difference from Wail ibn Dawood, except that the two sheikhs did not exclude it from Mas'oodi, and its place is in truthfulness. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaunsi kamai sabse paakeeza hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadmi ka apne haath se kamaana, aur har jaayaz (barkat wali) khareed-o-farokht." Yeh Wa'il bin Dawud par teesra ikhtilaaf hai, magar Shaykhain ne Al-Mas'udi se riwayat nahi nikali, aur unka mauqaf sachchai ka hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Narrated by Abdullah bin Muslima Al-Qa'nabi, narrated by Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad, on the authority of Amr bin Abi Amr, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, that a man had a dispute with his opponent for ten dinars, and he said, "By Allah, I will not let you go until you settle me or bring me a camel." The Prophet ﷺ  took the responsibility and brought him the amount he had promised. The Prophet ﷺ  then asked him, "Where did you get this gold from?" He replied, "From a mine." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "We are not in need of it; it does not contain any goodness." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  settled the matter on his behalf.
hi: Humein Abdullah bin Maslamah Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, humein Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad ne, Amr bin Abi Amr se, unhone Ikrimah se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se bataya, ke aik shakhs ne apne qarzdaar ko dus (10) dinar ke liye pakad rakha tha aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main tumhein tab tak nahi chhodunga jab tak tum mujhe ada na karo ya koi zaamin na laao." Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) ne uski zimmedari li, phir woh (qarzdaar) unke paas jitna wada kiya tha utna le aaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne usse poocha: "Yeh sona tumhein kahan se mila?" Usne kaha: "Kisi kaan se." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Humein ismein koi zaroorat nahi, ismein koi bhalaai nahi," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne (apni taraf se) uski taraf se ada kar diya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "There will come a time for people when no one will remain who has not consumed riba (usury), and if he does not consume it, its dust will reach him." Our scholars have differed in hearing from Al-Hasan through Abu Hurairah, so if his hearing from him is proven to be authentic, then...
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Logon par aisa waqt zaroor aayega jismein koi bhi aisa nahi bachega jo sood na khaaye, aur agar woh use na bhi khaaye to uska gubaar zaroor usse chhu jayega." Humare a'immah (imamon) ne Al-Hasan ke Abu Hurairah (RA) se sunne ke baare mein ikhtilaaf kiya hai, agar unka sunna sahih sabit ho jaaye to...

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited hoarding food." Muslim narrated a hadith from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, who narrated from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Ata, who narrated from Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib, who narrated from Ma'mar ibn Abdullah ibn Nadlah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Only a sinner hoards." This hadith is one of the arguments used to establish that a narration from a companion is not valid unless it is narrated by two successors. Ma'mar does not have any narrators other than Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib. As for the narration of Al-Qasim from Abu Umamah, the wording is not the same. It has been narrated in regards to forbidding hoarding of food and refraining from assisting Muslims in times of hardship. It is essential to mention these narrations in this context, as the Muslims were inclined towards them at that time. Thus, Ibn Al-Jawzi omitted it in his summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne khaane ko jama karke rokne (ehtikaar) se mana kiya." Muslim ne Muhammad bin Ishaq ki, Muhammad bin Amr bin Ata' se, unhone Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab se, unhone Ma'mar bin Abdullah bin Nadlah se, hadith nikaali hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sirf khataakaar hi jama karke rokta hai." Yeh hadith un mein se hai jinpar yeh baat rad ki jaati hai ke kisi sahabi ki hadith sahih nahi hoti jab tak use do Tabi'i na riwayat karein, kyunke is Ma'mar ke koi doosre raawi nahi, siwaye Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab ke. Rahi baat Al-Qasim ki, Abu Umamah se, hadith ki, to woh isi alfaaz mein nahi hai, aur khaana jama karke rokne aur tangi mein Musalmanon ki madad na karne ki mumaana'at ke baare mein riwayaton ka is jagah zikr zaroori hai, jaisa Musalmanon ne us waqt is par amal kiya, unme se... Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The hoarder is cursed." And Ali ibn Salim is weak.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jama karke rokne wala mal'oon hai." Aur unme se Ali bin Salim kamzor hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever hoards food for forty nights, he is free from Allah and Allah is free from him. And whoever among the people of a town wakes up in the morning while there is a hungry person among them, then the punishment of Allah is lifted from them." This hadith is narrated by Amr bin Al-Hassan Al-Aqili and Asbah bin Zaid Al-Juhani has a leniency in it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo khaana chalees (40) raaton tak jama karke roke, woh Allah se bari ho gaya aur Allah usse bari ho gaya, aur jis basti walon mein koi bhookha subah kare, to Allah ki zimmadari unse uth jaati hai." Aur unme se Amr bin Al-Hasan Al-Aqili hain, jinhein chhod diya gaya hai, aur Asba' bin Zaid Al-Juhani mein narmi (kamzori) hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever hoards with the intention of exploiting it against the Muslims, then he is a wrongdoer and has violated the trust of Allah." And from it, Asili used to steal the tradition.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo jama karke roke is niyat se ke woh Musalmanon par qeemat badhaaye, woh khataakaar hai aur Allah ki zimmadari usse uth chuki hai." Aur unme se Al-Usaili hain, jo hadith churaaya karte the.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by a man in the marketplace selling food at a price lower than the market price. He said, "You sell in our market at a price lower than ours?" The man replied, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah asked, "With patience and fairness?" The man replied, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah said, "Rejoice! For the one who brings goods to our market is like the one who fights in the cause of Allah, and the one who monopolizes in our market is like the one who denies the Book of Allah." This Hadith is considered weak in its narration and its chain of narrators is obscure.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) bazaar mein aik shakhs ke paas se guzre jo khana bazaar ke bhaav se sasta bech raha tha, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum humare bazaar mein humare bhaav se sasta bech rahe ho?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Sabr aur sawaab ki niyat se?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khushkhabri ho, kyunke humare bazaar mein maal laane wala Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wale jaisa hai, aur humare bazaar mein jama karke rokne wala Allah ki Kitaab mein tehreef karne wale (mulhid) jaisa hai." Aur unme se... yeh riwayat munkar (mushtabah) hai aur iski sanad andheri (kamzor) hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Whoever enters into any dealings with the prices of Muslims and cheats them, it is the right of Allah to throw him into the depths of Hell, placing his head at the lowest point." I sought and included these six hadiths in their proper place in this book, taking into account the difficulties that people face. Allah will alleviate them, even if it is not a condition of this book. I do not know any addition, so reflect on these six hadiths.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo Musalmanon ki qeemton mein kisi tarah dakhil ho taake unpar mehngaai kare, to Allah par yeh haq ban jaata hai ke woh use Jahannam ke sabse gehre hisse mein, uska sar neeche aur pair oopar, phenk de." Yeh chhah (6) ahadith maine talaash kar ke is kitaab mein unki jagah par nikaali hain, is baat ka khayal karte huay ke logon ko is (mehngaai) se kitni takleef hai, aur Allah ise door karega, agarche yeh is kitaab ki shart mein na bhi ho. Mujhe Zaid ka pata nahi, isliye in chhah ahadith par ghor karo.

e: [AI] I asked Hassan bin Ali what he remembers from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, "I heard him saying, 'Leave that which causes doubt for that which does not cause doubt. Verily, goodness brings tranquility, and evil brings doubt.'"
hi: Maine Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) se poocha ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) se kya yaad rakhte hain, unhone kaha: maine unhein farmate hue suna: "Jo cheez tumhein shak mein daale usse chhod do us cheez ki taraf jo tumhein shak mein na daale, kyunke bhalaai itminaan hai aur buraai shak hai."

e: [AI] I said to Hassan ibn Ali: "Tell me about an incident you witnessed during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and what you understood from it." He replied, "A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I heard him say, 'Leave what causes you doubt for that which does not cause you doubt, for indeed, evil is uncertainty and good is tranquility.' This is a narration from my father, Ummamah al-Bahili." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in this context.
hi: Maine Al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein aap jaise the aur aapne unse kya samjha?" Unhone kaha: aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo cheez tumhein shak mein daale usse chhod do us cheez ki taraf jo tumhein shak mein na daale, kyunke buraai shak hai aur bhalaai itminaan hai." Iska shahid Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (RA) ki hadith hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: that a man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "What is Īmān (faith)?" He said, "If you are happy with your good deeds and are saddened by your bad deeds, then you are a believer." The man said, “O Messenger of Allah, then what is sin?” He said, "If something ˹you do˺ troubles you within, then you should abandon it." (Using translation from Aḥmad 22166)
hi: Aik shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) se poocha: "Imaan kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhari neki tumhein khush kare aur tumhari buraai tumhein ghamgeen kare, to tum momin ho." Usne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), gunah kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab koi cheez tumhare seene mein khatka paida kare, to usse chhod do." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: I asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ about virtue and vice. He said: Virtue is a kind disposition and vice is what rankles in your heart and that you disapprove that people should come to know of it. (Using translation from Muslim 2553a)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) se neki aur gunah ke baare mein poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Neki achhe akhlaaq ka naam hai, aur gunah woh hai jo tumhare seene mein khatka paida kare aur tum napasand karo ke log usse waqif hon."

e: [AI] The translation of the provided Arabic text is as follows: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke up one night and he was asked: What kept you awake? He replied, 'I found a fallen date and ate it. Then I remembered that there was a date from the Sadaqah (charity) dates at our place. So, I do not know whether that date was from the Sadaqah dates or from my family's dates, and that is what kept me awake.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik raat karvat badalte rahe, unse poocha gaya: "Aapko kis cheez ne jaagta rakha hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe aik gira hua khajoor mila to maine use kha liya, phir mujhe yaad aaya ke humare paas sadqe ki khajoor bhi hoti thi, mujhe nahi pata ke woh khajoor usi mein se thi ya humare apne ghar ki khajoor mein se, isi baat ne mujhe jaagta rakha."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I do not know whether Tubba was a cursed or not. And, I do not know whether Dhu al-Qarnayn was a Prophet or not. And, I do not know whether hudud (capital punishments) ˹serve˺ as expiation for those are deserve them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata ke Tubba' mal'oon tha ya nahi, aur mujhe nahi pata ke Dhul-Qarnain Nabi the ya nahi, aur mujhe nahi pata ke hudood (muqarrar sazaayen) unke ahl ke liye kaffara hain ya nahi."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him: "Whoever buys merchandise, they are obligated to have the option of keeping it until the seller separates from it. If the owner wishes, they may take it. However, if the owner separates from it, they no longer have the option."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai: "Jo koi khareedari kare jismein khiyar (rukhsat) wajib ho, to woh uske liye hai jab tak uska saathi (bechne wala) usse alag na ho, agar woh chahe to use le le, aur agar woh alag ho jaaye to uske liye koi khiyar nahi."

e: [AI] A man bought a slave from another man during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . He possessed him and owned him freely. Then he returned him due to a defect that was found in him. The man said when the slave was returned to him, "O Messenger of Allah, he has been utilizing my slave since he acquired him." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The transaction is undertaken with guarantee."
hi: Aik shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein kisi aur shakhs se aik ghulam khareeda, jab tak Allah ne chaha woh uske paas raha, phir usne ismein paayi gayi aik ayb ki wajah se use wapas kar diya. Jab ghulam wapas kiya gaya to us shakhs (bechne wale) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), isne mere ghulam se jab tak yeh uske paas raha, faida uthaya hai." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Faida (kharaaj) zimmedari (dhamaan) ke sath hota hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] A man bought a servant during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The servant had a defect that the man was not aware of, and he took advantage of him. Later, when the man discovered the defect, he returned the servant and argued with him before the Prophet ﷺ. The man said, "O Messenger of Allah, he was in my possession for a long time." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "The defective merchandise is under warranty."
hi: Aik shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein aik ghulam khareeda jismein aik ayb thi jiski usse khabar nahi thi, usne uska faida uthaya, phir usse ayb ka pata chala to usne use wapas kar diya, aur is baare mein Nabi (SAW) ke paas jhagda kiya, to usne (bechne wale ne) kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), isne kaafi arse tak iska faida uthaya hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Faida (ghallah) zimmedari (dhamaan) ke sath hota hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the taxes should be paid with surety." And the narration of Aasim states, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has decreed that taxes should be paid with surety." This was narrated by Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, and Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b. As for the narration of Thawri,
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak faida zimmedari ke sath hota hai." Aur Aasim ki hadith mein hai: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne faisla kiya ke faida zimmedari ke sath hota hai." Isse Ath-Thawri, Ibn Al-Mubarak, aur Yahya bin Sa'eed ne, Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, riwayat kiya hai. Rahi baat Ath-Thawri ki hadith ki...

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ judged: "The produce is for the responsible one." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1285)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne faisla kiya ke 'faida zimmedari ke sath hota hai.' Aur rahi baat Ibn Al-Mubarak ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Al-Kharaj (land tax) is with responsibility." As for the saying of Yahya ibn Sa'id...
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Faida zimmedari ke sath hota hai." Aur rahi baat Yahya bin Sa'eed ki (hadith) ki...

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ judged: "The produce is for the responsible one." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1285)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne faisla kiya ke 'faida zimmedari ke sath hota hai.'

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said: "The two parties in a transaction have the option to cancel as long as they do not separate. Each one should take from the transaction what pleases them." He repeated this statement three times.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bechne wale aur khareedne wale dono ko khiyar (rukhsat) hai jab tak woh alag na hon, aur har aik apni khareed-o-farokht mein se jo chahe le sakta hai," aap (SAW) ne yeh teen martaba kaha.

e: [AI] When Salman arrived at the city, he went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with a gift on a plate and placed it before him. The Prophet ﷺ  asked, "What is this, O Salman?" He replied, "It is a charity for you and your companions." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "I do not eat charity." So Salman took it back. The next day, he came with the same gift and placed it before the Prophet ﷺ . He asked, "What is this?" Salman replied, "It is a gift for you." The Prophet ﷺ  then said to his companions, "Eat." They asked, "For whom is it?" The Prophet ﷺ  answered, "For a group of people. Ask them to write for you." Salman said, "They wrote for me that I should plant this and that number of palm trees for them, and Salman will take care of them until they bear fruit." He (Salman) did as they requested. The Prophet ﷺ  came and planted all the palm trees except for one, which Umar planted, and Salman took care of it from his own date farm, except for that one palm tree. The Prophet ﷺ  asked, "Who planted this tree?" They replied, "Umar." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I planted it from my own hands, and Umar carried it from its first year."
hi: Jab Salman (RA) Madinah aaye, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik thaali mein tohfa lekar aaye aur use unke saamne rakha, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai, Aye Salman?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh aapke aur aapke sathiyon ke liye sadqa hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main sadqa nahi khaata." To unhone use utha liya, phir agle din waisa hi (tohfa) lekar aaye aur use unke saamne rakha, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh aapke liye tohfa hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sathiyon se farmaya: "Khao." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum kiske ho?" Unhone kaha: "Aik qaum ke." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unse guzarish karo ke woh tumhare sath (azaadi ka) muahida likh dein." Unhone kaha: to unhone mere sath itne-itne khajoor ke darakhton ka muahida likha jinhein main unke liye lagaaun, aur Salman (RA) inki dekh-bhaal karengay yahan tak ke yeh phal dein. Unhone aisa hi kiya. Phir Nabi (SAW) tashreef laaye aur khud sab khajoor ke darakht lagaaye, siwaye aik darakht ke jise Umar (RA) ne lagaya tha, aur unke (Nabi ke lagaaye huay) tamam darakht usi saal phal laaye, siwaye us darakht ke (jo Umar ne lagaya). Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Isse kisne lagaaya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Umar (RA) ne." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne use apne haath se (dobara) lagaya, to woh usi saal phal laaya.

e: [AI] A man from the Jewish community bought him (a person), so he brought him to the city. He said, "So I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a gift, and I said, 'This is a charity.' He said to his companions, 'Eat,' but he (the Messenger of Allah) did not eat. Then he (the person) mentioned the Hadith similar to it, according to the condition of Muslim.
hi: Ke aik Yahoodi shakhs ne unhein khareeda aur unhein Madinah le aaya, unhone kaha: to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik tohfa lekar aaya aur kaha: "Yeh sadqa hai." To aap (SAW) ne apne sathiyon se farmaya: "Khao," aur khud nahi khaaya, phir hadith isi jaisi zikr ki. Muslim ki shart par.

e: On his father's authority, said that his grandfather 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: The proviso of a loan combined with a sale is not allowable, nor two conditions relating to one transaction, nor profit arising from something which is not in one's charge, nor selling what is not in your possession. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3504)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qarz aur bay' (khareed-o-farokht) ko milaana jaayaz nahi, aur na hi aik hi bay' mein do shartein, aur na hi aisi cheez ka nafa jo zimmedari mein na ho, aur na hi aisi cheez bechna jo tumhare paas na ho."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I hear from you things that I fear I may forget. May I have permission to write them down?" He said, "Yes." I then wrote down from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, that when 'Attab bin Usaid was sent to the people of Makkah, he said, "Inform them that it is not permissible to have two transactions in one sale, nor to sell what one does not possess, nor to give a loan and conduct a sale simultaneously, nor to have multiple conditions in a sale."
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aapse aisi baatein sunta hoon jinke bhoolne ka mujhe darr hai, kya aap mujhe ijaazat dete hain ke main unhein likh loon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Unhone kaha: to jo unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se likha usme yeh tha ke jab aap (SAW) ne Attab bin Usaid (RA) ko Makkah walon ke paas bheja to farmaya: "Unhein bata do ke aik hi bay' mein do bay' jaayaz nahi, aur na hi aisi cheez bechna jaayaz hai jiske woh maalik nahi, aur na hi qarz aur bay' ko milaana, aur na hi aik hi bay' mein do shartein."

e: [AI] "And he was one of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ . Ali ibn Hamsad al-Adl narrated to us, Ismail ibn Ishaq al-Qadi and Hassan ibn Ali ibn Ziyad narrated to us, they said: Ismail ibn Abi Uwais narrated to us, my brother Abu Bakr narrated to us, from Sulaiman ibn Bilal, from Muhammad ibn Abi Atiq, from Ibn Shihab, from Umara ibn Khuzaimah, that his uncle informed him that he was one of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  bought a horse from a man from the Bedouins, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  followed him to pay the price for the horse. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  walked faster while the Bedouin walked slower. Some men intercepted the Bedouin and offered to buy the horse from him, not knowing that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had already bought it. Some of them increased the bid, so when they did, the Bedouin called out, "O Messenger of Allah, if you intend to buy this horse, then take it; otherwise, I will sell it to them." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up when he heard the call of the Bedouin and went to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked him, "Didn't I buy it from you?" He replied, "No, by Allah, I didn't sell it to you." The people started to resort to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and the Bedouin, while they were moving back. Then the Bedouin said, "Come here, witness that I have sold it to you." Khuzaimah said, "I bear witness that you have sold it to him." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  approached Khuzaimah and asked, "What do you bear witness to?" He replied, "I bear witness to your truthfulness." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The testimony of Khuzaimah is the testimony of two men."
hi: Aur unke chacha, jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) mein se the, ne unhein bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik badu se aik ghoda khareeda, Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse apne pichhe chalne ko kaha taake woh ghode ki qeemat ada kar sakein, to Rasulullah (SAW) tezi se chalne lage aur badu dheere chalne laga, to log badu ko ghere ne lage aur usse ghode ke liye qeemat lagaane lage, unhein khabar na thi ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne use pehle hi khareed liya hai, yahan tak ke unme se kuch logon ne badu ko qeemat mein zyada di, jab unhone zyada di to badu ne pukaara: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar aap yeh ghoda khareedna chahte hain to khareed lein, warna main isse bech dunga." To Rasulullah (SAW) jab badu ki pukaar suni to khade huay yahan tak ke badu ke paas pahunche, Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya maine tumse yeh nahi khareeda?" Usne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, maine yeh aapko nahi becha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke maine yeh tumse khareeda hai." To log Rasulullah (SAW) aur badu ke aas-paas jama hone lage jabke woh dono aapas mein baat-cheet kar rahe the, to badu kehne laga: "Koi gawah lao ke maine tumhein becha hai." To Khuzaimah (RA) ne kaha: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke aapne isse (Nabi ko) becha hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) Khuzaimah (RA) ki taraf mudkar poochne lage: "Tum kis buniyaad par gawahi de rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: "Aapki sachchaai par." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne "Khuzaimah (RA) ki gawahi ko do aadmiyon ki gawahi ke barabar" qaraar de diya.

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  purchased a horse from Sawwah ibn al-Harith al-Muharibi, but he denied it. Khuzaymah ibn Thabit testified for him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "What made you give witness for him, despite not being present?" He said, "You have spoken the truth, O Messenger of Allah, but I believed you based on what you said, and I know that you do not speak anything except the truth." Then he said, "Whoever testifies for him and I testify against him, it will be sufficient for him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Sawa bin Al-Harith Al-Muharibi se aik ghoda khareeda, usne inkaar kar diya, to Khuzaimah bin Thabit (RA) ne unke haq mein gawahi di, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Tumhein gawahi dene par kis cheez ne ubhaara jabke tum uske sath nahi the?" Unhone kaha: "Aapne sach kaha, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), lekin maine aapki baat ki tasdeeq ki kyunke mujhe pata hai ke aap sirf haq hi kehte hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiske haq mein Khuzaimah (RA) gawahi den, aur jiske khilaaf woh gawahi den, unke liye yehi kaafi hai."

e: We sold slave-mothers during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and of AbuBakr. When Umar was in power, he forbade us and we stopped. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3954)
hi: "Hum ummahaat-ul-awlaad ko Rasulullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) ke zamane mein bechte the, jab Umar (RA) ka daur aaya to unhone humein mana kar diya, to hum ruk gaye."

e: [AI] "We used to sell slaves during the time of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)."
hi: "Hum ummahaat-ul-awlaad ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein bechte the." Sahih.

e: [AI] "He said, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Any woman who gives birth from her master, she becomes free after his death.'"
hi: Ke unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat apne aaqa se bachcha janam de, woh uski maut ke baad azaad hai."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling fruits until they have changed the color, and selling grapes until they have turned black, and selling grains until they have hardened. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2217)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "anaaj bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh sakht na ho jaaye, aur angoor bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh kaale na ho jaayen, aur khajoor bechne se mana kiya jab tak woh surkh ya zard na ho jaaye."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Sa'id Al-Sa'idi and Ibn Abbas issuing a fatwa that a dinar should be exchanged for two dinars. Abu Usaid Al-Sa'idi replied to him angrily, saying, "I did not think that anyone knew of my close relationship with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and would say such a thing to me, O Abu Usaid." Ibn Abbas then said, "I only said what I used to say before, as I have not heard anything about it." Abu Usaid said, "I testify that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'A dinar should be exchanged for a dinar, and a dirham for a dirham, and a measure of wheat for a measure of wheat, and a measure of barley for a measure of barley, and a measure of salt for a measure of salt. There should be no surplus or deficiency in any of these exchanges.'" Ibn Abbas said, "This is something I used to say, and I did not hear anything contrary to it."
hi: Maine Abu Sa'eed As-Sa'idi (RA) aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ko yeh fatwa dete suna ke aik dinar do dinaron ke badle (becha ja sakta hai), to Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi (RA) ne unse sakhti se kaha, unhone kaha: to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe yeh gumaan nahi tha ke koi shakhs jo Rasulullah (SAW) se meri qaraabat ko jaanta ho, mujhse aisi baat kahega, Aye Abu Usaid." To Abu Usaid (RA) ne kaha: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Dinar dinar ke badle, dirham dirham ke badle, gehun ka aik sa' gehun ke aik sa' ke badle, jau ka aik sa' jau ke aik sa' ke badle, aur namak ka aik sa' namak ke aik sa' ke badle, ismein koi izaafa jaayaz nahi.'" To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh sirf aik baat thi jo main kehta tha, aur maine ismein koi (mustanad) cheez nahi suni thi."

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, Fulan has a palm tree, and I constructed my wall using it. So please command him to give me the palm tree in exchange for my wall." The Prophet ﷺ  told Fulan, "Give it to him in return for a palm tree in Paradise." However, Fulan refused and Abu Al-Dahdah came to him saying, "Sell your palm tree to him in exchange for his wall." Fulan agreed and sold it to him. Abu Al-Dahdah then went to the Prophet ﷺ  and informed him, saying, "O Messenger of Allah, I have acquired the palm tree in exchange for my wall." The Prophet ﷺ  said multiple times, "How much shade and clusters (of dates) in Paradise belongs to Abu Al-Dahdah." Then, Abu Al-Dahdah went to his wife and said, "O Um Dahdah, vacate the wall, for I have sold it in exchange for a palm tree in Paradise." She responded, "Indeed, you have made a profitable sale or an equivalent word."
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), fulan ke paas aik khajoor ka darakht hai aur main apni deewaar usi se qaayam karta hoon, to unhein hukum dein ke woh mujhe woh (darakht) de dein taake main apni deewaar usse qaayam kar sakun." To Nabi (SAW) ne usse kaha: "Woh isse Jannat mein aik khajoor ke darakht ke badle de do." Usne inkaar kar diya. Phir Abu Ad-Dahdah (RA) unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Apna khajoor ka darakht mujhe meri deewaar ke badle bech do." Unhone kaha: to usne aisa kiya. Unhone kaha: phir woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine woh khajoor ka darakht apni deewaar ke badle khareed liya hai," aur use us (zaroorat-mand) ke liye kar diya. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Ad-Dahdah (RA) ke liye Jannat mein kitne hi jhukte huay khajoor ke guchche hain," baar baar. Phir woh apni biwi ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Aye Umm Ad-Dahdah, deewaar se bahar nikal aao, kyunke maine ise Jannat mein aik khajoor ke darakht ke badle bech diya hai." Unhone kaha: "Tumne to munaafe wala soda kiya hai," ya isi jaisi koi baat kahi.

e: [AI] A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "Indeed, so-and-so has a date palm tree in my wall, and it annoys me and harms me in its place in my wall." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a message to him and said, "Sell it to me, your date palm tree that is in so-and-so's wall." He said, "No." He said, "Give it to me." He said, "No." He said, "Then exchange it with a date palm tree in Jannah (Paradise)." He said, "No." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I have not seen anyone more stingy than you who withholds saying salaam (greeting of peace)."
