hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Fulan ke paas meri deewaar mein aik khajoor ki shaakh hai jisne mujhe takleef di hai, aur uski shaakh ki jagah mere liye mushkil ban gayi hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse (fulan ko) bulaawa bheja aur farmaya: "Woh apni khajoor ki shaakh jo fulan ki deewaar mein hai mujhe bech do." Usne kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe de do." Usne kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To ise mujhse Jannat ki aik khajoor ki shaakh ke badle bech do." Usne kaha: "Nahi." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumse zyada kanjoos kisi ko nahi dekha, siwaye us shakhs ke jo salaam karne mein kanjoosi kare."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "It is enough for a person to be considered a liar that he narrates everything he hears, and it is enough for a person to be considered greedy that he says, 'I will take my right and leave nothing of it.'" This is a reliable chain of narration, as the fathers of Hilal bin Al-Ala are trustworthy imams, and Hilal himself is the leader of the people of the Arabian Peninsula in his time. The fathers of Hilal are reliable.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadmi ke liye jhoot mein itna hi kaafi hai ke woh har suni hui baat bayan kar de, aur aadmi ke liye lalach mein itna hi kaafi hai ke woh kahe: 'Main apna haq loonga, isme se kuch bhi na chhodunga.'" Yeh sanad sahih hai, kyunke Hilal bin Al-Ala ke waalid aur dada thiqa aur mo'tabar imaam hain, aur Hilal apne daur mein Al-Jazeerah ke logon ke imaam hain.

e: the Prophet ﷺ bought Safiyyah for seven slaves. (Sahih) (One of the narrators) 'Abdur-Rahman said: "From Dihyah Kalbi.' (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2272)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Safiyyah (RA) ko Dihyah Al-Kalbi (RA) se saat (7) qaidiyon ke badle liya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "During the custody of the slave, there are three nights." Sa'id said, "I asked Qatadah, 'How does this happen?'" He replied, "If the buyer finds a defect in the merchandise, he can return it within those days without asking for proof. However, after those days pass, he can only return it with proof that he bought it and that defect was present. Otherwise, the seller can swear that he did not sell it, and that is his defense." Sa'id and Hammam reported this narration from Qatadah, and likewise Yunus ibn 'Ubaid from Al-Hasan.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ghulam ki zimmedari (guarantee) teen raaton ki hai." Sa'eed ne kaha: maine Qatadah se poocha: "Yeh kaise hoga?" Unhone kaha: "Jab khareedar ko maal mein koi ayb mile, to woh use un dinon mein wapas kar sakta hai bagair kisi gawah ke, aur jab woh din guzar jaayen, to use wapas karne ka haq sirf tab hai jab gawah dein ke usne ise khareeda tha aur ayb usme thi, warna bechne wale ki qasam maani jaayegi ke usne ise bechte waqt uski bimari (ayb) ke sath nahi becha tha." Isi tarah Sa'eed aur Hammam ne, Qatadah se, kaha, aur isi tarah Yunus bin Ubaid ne bhi Al-Hasan se riwayat ki hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no marriage contract that is valid above four (wives)." As for the disagreement between Hisham al-Dasiti and the two of them.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zimmedari (guarantee ki muddat) chaar (raaton) se zyada nahi." Aur rahi baat Hisham Ad-Dastuwai ke un dono se ikhtilaaf ki...

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The contractual obligation of a slave is three days. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3506)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ghulam ki zimmedari (guarantee) chaar (4) raaton ki hai."

e: [AI] Hibban ibn Munqidh was a weak man who had been hit in his head, causing a lump. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  selected good items for him to buy, he bought three. His tongue was heavy, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  told him to sell and say: "No decrease in the price." I used to hear him saying "no decrease in the price." He used to buy something and bring it to his family, and they would say it is expensive. He would say: "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has chosen me in my trade."
hi: Hibban bin Munqidh (RA) kamzor aadmi the, unke sar mein zakham lag chuka tha jo dimaag tak pahuncha tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein unki khareedari mein teen (din ka) khiyar (rukhsat) diya, aur unki zubaan bhaari (lakhnat-daar) ho gayi thi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Bech do aur kaho: 'Koi dhoka nahi (La khilabah).'" To main unhein kehte suna karta tha: "La khizabah, la khizabah" (unki zubaan ki wajah se), aur woh koi cheez khareedte aur apne ghar walon ke paas laate, to woh kehte: "Yeh to mehngi hai," to woh kehte: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe apni khareed-o-farokht mein khiyar diya hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] She used to repay her debts. It was said to her, "Why do you have debts and you have no means to pay?" She said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'No slave has the intention to repay his debt except that Allah will assist him in doing so, so I seek that assistance.'"
hi: Ke woh qarz liya karti thin, unse kaha gaya: "Aapko qarz se kya matlab jabke aapke paas ada karne ke liye kuch nahi?" Unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Koi bandah aisa nahi jiski niyat apna qarz ada karne ki ho, magar Allah ki taraf se uske liye madad hoti hai, isliye main woh madad talaash karti hoon."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "No servant has the intention to fulfill his debt except that Allah will provide him with assistance, and I seek that assistance." And his witness to this hadith is Maymunah.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Koi bandah aisa nahi jiski niyat apna qarz ada karne ki ho, magar Allah ki taraf se uske liye madad hoti hai, isliye main woh madad talaash karti hoon." Aur iska shahid Maimoonah (RA) ki hadith hai.

e: [AI] She used to repay regularly, and it was said to her about that, she said, "I will not abandon the debt because it has assistance from Allah, and I seek that assistance."
hi: Ke woh qarz liya karti thin aur bohot zyada leti thin, unse iske baare mein kaha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Main qarz nahi chhodti kyunke ismein Allah ki taraf se madad hoti hai, isliye main woh madad talaash karti hoon."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Indeed, Allah supports those who are in debt until they pay off their debt, as long as it does not involve something that Allah dislikes."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah qarz dene wale ke sath hota hai yahan tak ke uska qarz ada ho jaaye, jab tak isme koi aisi cheez shaamil na ho jo Allah ko napasand ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever borrows a debt and has the means to repay it, then dies without paying it, Allah will disregard it for him and will satisfy his creditor with whatever He wills. And whoever borrows a debt and does not have the means to repay it, then dies, Allah will take retribution from his creditor on his behalf on the Day of Resurrection." This is glad tidings for the abandoned.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi qarz le aur uski niyat use ada karne ki ho, phir woh mar jaaye, to Allah uski taraf se darguzar karega aur uske qarzdaar ko jaisa chahega raazi karega, aur jo koi qarz le aur uski niyat use ada karne ki na ho, phir woh mar jaaye, to Allah Qayamat ke din uske qarzdaar ke liye uski taraf se badla lega." Bishr matrook (chhoda hua raawi) hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had two thick and rough cotton garments. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, your clothes are rough and harsh, and you perspire in them, causing them to become heavy on you. So-and-so has received some clothes from Sham (Syria), if you sent a message to him and took two garments in exchange for mine." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a messenger to him and he said, "I know what Muhammad wants; he wants to take my clothes and delay their return." The man came to the Prophet ﷺ  and informed him, so the Prophet ﷺ  said, "He is lying. They know that I treat them with piety and fulfill my trust."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) par do moti aur khurdari qatri (chaadrein) thin, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapke kapde khurdare aur mote hain, aap inme pasine se bhar jaate hain to yeh aap par bhaari ho jaate hain, aur fulan ke paas Sham se kapda aaya hai, agar aap usse bheja hota aur udhaar par do kapde le lete jab tak aasani ho jaaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne uske paas (qaasid) bheja, to usne kaha: "Mujhe pata hai Muhammad (SAW) kya chahte hain, woh mera kapda le jaana chahte hain aur mujhe usme takleef dena chahte hain." To qaasid Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein bataya, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usne jhoot bola, unhein pata hai ke main unme sabse zyada Allah se darne wala aur amaanat ada karne wala hoon."

e: [AI] I said, O Messenger of Allah, your clothes are thick. If you take them off and send them to the merchant Fulan, he will send two clothes to you in return to Al-Maysarah. He said, "Should I send him two clothes to Al-Maysarah? He refused."
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapke dono kapde mote hain, agar aap inhein utaar dete aur fulan tajir ke paas bhejte to woh aapko do kapde udhaar par bhej deta jab tak aasani ho jaaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: to unhone (qaasid) usse kaha: "Mujhe do kapde udhaar bhej do jab tak aasani ho jaaye?" To usne inkaar kar diya.

e: [AI] A camel arrived, so the Prophet ﷺ bought it and made a profit by selling its gold adornments. Then he gave it in charity to the sons of Banu 'Abd al-Muttalib and said, "I do not buy something that I do not have the price for." Al-Bukhari relied on the narration of 'Ikrimah and Muslim relied on the narrations of Simak and Shareek, and they both said, "The hadith is authentic and they did not exclude it." Authentic.
hi: Aik qaafila aaya, Nabi (SAW) ne usme se kuch khareeda aur kuch auqiya sona munafe mein kamaaya, phir usse Banu Abdul Muttalib ke bachchon mein sadqa kar diya, aur farmaya: "Main woh cheez nahi khareedta jiski qeemat mere paas na ho." Bukhari ne Ikrimah ko, aur Muslim ne Simak aur Shareek ko, hujjat maana hai, "aur yeh hadith sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Debt is the banner of Allah on earth, and if He wants to humiliate a servant, He places it around his neck."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qarz zameen mein Allah ka jhanda hai, jab woh kisi bande ko zaleel karna chahta hai to use uski gardan mein daal deta hai."

e: [AI] "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , that he used to supplicate with these words: 'O Allah, You are the First, there is nothing before You, and You are the Last, there is nothing after You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of every creature whose forelock is in Your hand, and I seek refuge in You from sin and laziness, and from the punishment of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire, and from the trials of wealth and from the trials of poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the sin and debt.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) yeh kalimaat kehte huay dua kiya karte the: "Allahumma antal-Awwalu fa la shai'a qablaka, wa antal-Aakhiru fa la shai'a ba'daka, a'oodhu bika min sharri kulli dabbatin naasiyatuha biyadika, wa a'oodhu bika minal-ithmi wal-kasali, wa min azabil-qabri, wa min azabin-nari, wa min fitnatil-ghina, wa min fitnatil-faqri, wa a'oodhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram" (Aye Allah, tu Awwal hai, tujh se pehle kuch nahi, aur tu Aakhir hai, tere baad kuch nahi, main teri panah maangta hoon har us jaanwar ki buraai se jiski paishani teri haath mein hai, aur main teri panah maangta hoon gunah aur susti se, aur qabar ke azab se, aur aag ke azab se, aur maal-daari ke fitne se, aur ghurbat ke fitne se, aur main teri panah maangta hoon gunah aur qarz se).

e: [AI] We were informed by Al-Qa'nabi, who was informed by Abdul Aziz ibn Muhammad, who was informed by Al-Ala ibn Abdul Rahman, from Abu Kathir, the freed slave of Muhammad ibn Jahsh, from Muhammad ibn Jahsh, who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was sitting where the deceased are laid, so he lifted his head towards the sky, then lowered his gaze and placed his hand on his forehead and said: 'Glory be to Allah, glory be to Allah, He has not sent down anything to fear.' We understood but remained silent until the next day, when I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , 'O Messenger of Allah, what is the fear that has been sent down?' He said, 'In regard to debt, by Him in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, if a man is killed in the cause of Allah and he still has a debt, he will not enter Paradise until his debt is paid off.'
hi: Humein Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, humein Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad ne bataya, humein Al-Ala' bin Abdur Rahman ne, Abu Kathir se, jo Muhammad bin Jahsh ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam hain, unhone Muhammad bin Jahsh se bataya, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) wahan baithe the jahan janazay rakhe jaate the, aap (SAW) ne apna sar aasman ki taraf uthaya, phir apni nazrein neechi ki aur apna haath apni peshani par rakh liya, phir farmaya: "Subhanallah, Subhanallah, Allah ne kitni sakhti nazil ki hai!" Unhone kaha: to humein ehsaas hua aur hum khamosh rahe, jab agla din aaya to maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh kaunsi sakhti nazil hui thi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qarz ke baare mein, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, agar koi shakhs Allah ki raah mein shaheed ho jaaye, phir zinda ho jaaye, aur uspar qarz ho, to woh Jannat mein tab tak dakhil nahi hoga jab tak apna qarz ada na kar de."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once offered a prayer, and when he finished, he said, "Is there anyone here from the tribe of so-and-so?" The people remained silent, for whenever he asked about something, they would remain silent until he repeated the question. So he said, "Is there anyone here from the tribe of so-and-so?" A man then said, "Here, this is so-and-so." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, your companion has been held at the gates of Paradise due to a debt he owed." A man then said, "I will pay off his debt." And Firas bin Shaabi narrated this incident from Ash-Sha'bi.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din namaz padhi, jab aap (SAW) mudkar aaye to farmaya: "Kya yahan Banu Fulan mein se koi hai?" To log khamosh rahe, aur jab kabhi aap (SAW) unse kuch chahte to woh khamosh rehte, phir farmaya: "Kya yahan Banu Fulan mein se koi hai?" To aik shakhs ne kaha: "Yeh fulan hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare saathi ko Jannat ke darwaze par us qarz ki wajah se roka gaya hai jo uspar tha." To aik shakhs ne kaha: "Uska qarz mujh par hai," aur usne woh ada kar diya. Isi tarah Firas ne Ash-Sha'bi se riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  prayed one day and then said, "Is there anyone from the family of so-and-so?" He repeated this three times with no one responding. Then he said, "Indeed, the man who died among you has been detained from entering Paradise because of the debt he owes. If you wish, you can pay it off for him, and if you wish, you can hand him over to the punishment of Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din namaz padhi, phir farmaya: "Kya yahan Banu Fulan mein se koi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne teen martaba pukaara, koi jawaab nahi diya, phir farmaya: "Beshak woh shakhs jo tum mein se mar gaya, use uske qarz ki wajah se Jannat se roka gaya hai, agar tum chaho to use chhudaa lo, aur agar chaho to use Allah ke azab ke hawale kar do."

e: [AI] "Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, it is possible to excuse the narration about Ismail ibn Abi Khalid and Firas ibn Yahya, as they are from the narrations of the trustworthy Imams who have narrated similar narrations. And Allah knows best."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai, aur uzr karne wale ke liye mumkin hai ke woh Ismail bin Abi Khalid aur Firas bin Yahya ki riwayat ko, jo unse pukhta imamon ki riwayaton se milti-julti hain, isi tarah ki riwayaton se ta'leel kare, wallahu a'lam.

e: [AI] He said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying to his companions, "Do not put yourselves in debt." So, they asked, "O Messenger of Allah, how can we avoid putting ourselves in debt?" He said, "By avoiding borrowing money."
hi: Unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko apne sathiyon se farmate suna: "Apne aap ko mat chheelo (barbaad na karo)." To poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum apne aap ko kaise chheelenge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qarz se."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever passes away, while free from three things, will enter Paradise: theft, debt, and arrogance." Abu Awana reported from Qatadah in the authenticity of this narration, following the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo rooh aur jism ka alag hona is haal mein ho ke woh teen cheezon se bari ho, woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga: khiyanat (maal-e-ghaneemat mein), qarz, aur takabbur." Abu Awana ne Qatadah se, is sanad ko qaim karne mein, unki mutaba'at ki hai, Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever dies and he is free of three: Kibr (Pride), Ghulul, and debt, he will enter paradise." There are narrations on this topic from Abu Hurairah and Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhni Footnote: Ghulul refers to goods stolen from the spoils of war, or concealed, before it is divided among the soldiers (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1572)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo teen cheezon se bari hokar mare - takabbur, khiyanat, aur qarz - woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga."

e: The Messenger of Allah said: "The believer's soul is suspended by his debt until it is settled for him." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1079)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ki jaan uske qarz se latki rehti hai yahan tak ke woh us (qarz) ki taraf se ada kar diya jaaye."

e: “The soul of the believer is attached to his debt until it is paid off.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2413)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ki jaan uske qarz se latki rehti hai yahan tak ke woh us (qarz) ki taraf se ada kar diya jaaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, Satan has given up that the idols in the land of Arabia will be worshipped. However, he will be pleased with you if you commit sins and engage in destructive actions. So, beware of injustice as much as you can. Indeed, on the Day of Judgment, a servant will come with a good amount of good deeds, thinking that it will save him. But then he will find that a person has wronged him, so it will be said to him, 'Wipe off from his good deeds until he has no good deed left.'"
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Iblis maayoos ho chuka hai ke Arab ki zameen mein buton ki ibadat ki jaaye, lekin woh iske ilawa tum mein se un chhote-mote gunahon par raazi ho jayega jo (asal mein) halaakat wale hain, isliye jahan tak ho sake zulm se bacho, kyunke bandah Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke uske paas itni nekiyaan hongi ke usse laga ke woh use nijaat dilaayengi, magar koi bandah khada hoga aur kahega: "Aye mere Rab, fulan ne mujhpar zulm kiya tha," to kaha jayega: "Uski nekiyon mein se mita do," yahan tak ke uski koi neki baaqi na rahe.

e: We were sitting waiting for Abdullah ibn Umar who came out to us and sat. He then said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: If anyone's intercession intervenes as an obstacle to one of the punishments prescribed by Allah, he has opposed Allah; if anyone disputes knowingly about something which is false, he remains in the displeasure of Allah till he desists, and if anyone makes an untruthful accusation against a Muslim, he will be made by Allah to dwell in the corrupt fluid flowing from the inhabitants of Hell till he retracts his statement. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3597)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiski shafa'at Allah ki muqarrar hadd (sazaon) mein se kisi hadd ko rokne aaye, usne Allah ke maamle mein Allah ka muqaabla kiya, aur jo qarz-daar hokar mare, to wahan koi dinar ya dirham nahi (jo qarz chukaaye), balke nekiyaan aur buraiyaan (hi kaam aati hain), aur jo jaante bujhte baatil mein jhagda kare, woh Allah ki naraazgi mein rehta hai yahan tak ke woh baaz aa jaaye, aur jo kisi momin ke baare mein aisi baat kahe jo usme na ho, use 'Radghatul-Khabaal' (Jahannamiyon ke ghao ka gandagi wala paani) mein qaid kar diya jaayega yahan tak ke woh apni kahi baat se nikalne ka rasta (wapas leke) na laaye."

e: "There was a man who never did any good deed, but he used to lend to people and he would say to this messenger: "Take what can be paid easily and leave what is difficult, let them off, and perhaps Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, said to him: 'Did you ever do any good did? He said: No, but I had a slave and I used to lend to people. When I sent him to collect the debts I said to him: Take what can he paid easily and leave what is difficult; let them off, and perhaps Allah will let us off. Allah, the Most High, said: 'I have let you off."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4694)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Aik shakhs ne kabhi koi neki nahi ki thi, aur woh logon ko qarz diya karta tha, apne qaasid se kehta: "Jo aasani se mil jaaye woh le lo, aur jo mushkil ho use chhod do, aur darguzar karo, shayad Allah bhi humse darguzar kare." Jab woh mar gaya to Allah ne poocha: "Kya tumne kabhi koi neki ki thi?" Usne kaha: "Nahi, siwaye is ke ke mera aik ghulam tha aur main logon ko qarz diya karta tha, jab main use qarz wasool karne bhejta to maine usse kehta: 'Jo aasani se mil jaaye woh le lo, aur jo mushkil ho use chhod do, aur darguzar karo, shayad Allah bhi humse darguzar kare.'" Allah ne farmaya: "Maine tumse darguzar kar diya."

e: [AI] I and my father went out to seek knowledge in this neighborhood from the Ansar before they perish. So, the first person we met was Abu Al-Yassar, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He had a servant with him, wearing a tattered cloak, and his servant also had a tattered cloak. He also had a pile of scriptures with him. My father said to him, "I see a trace of anger on your face." He replied, "Yes, I had some wealth that belonged to so-and-so, the thief. So, I went to his family and asked them if it was permissible for me to keep it. They said, 'No,' so his son came out. I asked him, 'Where is your father?' He replied, 'He heard what you said and went to hide in my mother's bed.' So, I said, 'Come out, for I know where you are.' He came out to me, and I asked him, 'What made you hide from me?' He replied, 'By Allah, I was telling you the truth and feared that I would lie to you or you would accuse me falsely. You used to be a companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so I said, 'By Allah, were you not a person who used to struggle financially?' I said, 'By Allah, I was.' He said, 'By Allah.' I said, 'By Allah.' He said, 'By Allah,' and repeated it. Then, he spread out the scripture and erased the debt, saying, 'If you find a case, judge accordingly, but if not, then you are free.' He then pointed to the corners of his heart and said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Whosoever removes a hardship from a believer, Allah will remove a hardship from him in this world and the Hereafter.'"
hi: Main aur mere waalid dono is Ansar ke muhalle mein ilm haasil karne nikle, unke wafaat paane se pehle, to sabse pehla shakhs jisse hum mile woh Abu Al-Yasar (RA) the, jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain, unke sath unka aik ghulam tha, unpar aik Ma'afiri chaadar thi aur unke ghulam par bhi aik Ma'afiri chaadar thi, aur unke paas kaghazaat ka aik bundle tha. Mere waalid ne unse kaha: "Mujhe aapke chehre par ghusse ka koi asar nazar aa raha hai." Unhone kaha: "Haan, fulan bin fulan Al-Harami ke zimme mera kuch maal tha, main uske ghar walon ke paas gaya aur poocha: 'Kya woh wahan hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Nahi.' To uska aik beta nikla, maine usse poocha: 'Tera abba kahan hai?' Usne kaha: 'Aapki awaz suni to woh meri ammi ke bistar mein chhup gaya.' Maine kaha: 'Bahar aa jao, mujhe pata chal chuka hai tum kahan ho,' to woh mere paas aaya, maine usse kaha: 'Tumhein mujhse chhupne par kis cheez ne majboor kiya?' Usne kaha: 'Main, Allah ki qasam, aapko sach batata hoon aur jhoot nahi bolta, mujhe Allah ki qasam darr laga ke agar main aapko bataun to jhoot bol jaaun, ya wada karun to wada tod dun, aur aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain.' Maine kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, kya tum sach mein mushkil mein ho?' Usne kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, haan.' Maine kaha: 'Allah ki qasam?' Usne kaha: 'Allah ki qasam.' Maine kaha: 'Allah ki qasam?' Usne kaha: 'Allah ki qasam.'" Unhone kaha: to unhone dastavez khol di aur qarz mita diya, aur kaha: "Agar tumhein ada karne ka mauqa mile to ada kar dena, warna tum azaad ho." Main gawahi deta hoon ke meri in donon aankhon ne dekha - aur unhone apni do ungliyan apni aankhon par rakhi - aur in donon kaanon ne suna - aur unhone apni ungliyan apne kaano mein rakhi - aur mere dil ne yaad rakha - aur unhone apne dil ki taraf ishara kiya - Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue: "Jo kisi mushkil mein padhe shakhs ko mohlat de aur uske liye aasani kare, Allah use apne saaye mein saaya dega."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "Whoever assists a debtor, he will have a charity for every day before the debt is due. And when the debt becomes due, if he waits for it (to be repaid), then he will have a similar charity for every day."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo kisi mushkil mein padhe shakhs ko mohlat de, to qarz ke waqt aane se pehle har din uske liye sadqe ke barabar hai, aur jab qarz ka waqt aa jaaye aur woh uske baad bhi mohlat de, to har din uske liye usi jaisa sadqa hai."

e: [AI] A man was tyrannical and wealthy, he would lend people money and say to his slaves, "If you find someone wealthy, take from him, and if you find someone in debt, forgive him, perhaps Allah will forgive me." Then Allah said, "I am more deserving of forgiving him." This is an authentic report according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs [Al-Bukhari and Muslim], but they did not include it. It has also been narrated from Abdullah bin Numayr from Al-A'mash.
hi: Aik shakhs ka hisaab liya gaya, uske liye koi neki nahi mili, aur woh maal-daar tha aur logon ko qarz diya karta tha, aur apne ghulamon se kehta: "Jo tumhein maal-daar mile usse le lo, aur jo tumhein mushkil mein mile usse darguzar karo, shayad Allah bhi mujhse darguzar kare." To Allah ne farmaya: "Main isse darguzar karne ka zyada haqdaar hoon." Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur yeh Abdullah bin Numair ki, Al-A'mash se, sanad ke sath bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] The translation of the given text is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A man will be brought to account and no good will be found for him, so his deeds will be mentioned similarly in accordance with the condition of Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Aik shakhs ka hisaab liya gaya, uske liye koi neki nahi mili, phir isi jaisa zikr kiya. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Narrated to us Al-Qanabi, narrated to us Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad, from Amr bin Abi Amr, from Ikrima, from Ibn Abbas, that a man had a dispute with his opponent over ten silver coins. The man said to him, "By Allah, I do not currently have the means to pay you today." The opponent said, "By Allah, I will not leave you until you settle the debt or bring someone who will pay on your behalf." The man said, "By Allah, I do not have the means to settle the debt, nor can I find anyone to pay on my behalf." He then brought the case to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, this man is insisting and I have given him a one-month extension, but he refuses to wait until I can settle the debt or find someone to pay on my behalf." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "Do you expect him to wait for only one month?" The man replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Then I will bear this debt on your behalf." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took responsibility for the debt and the man went and brought the agreed amount. The Prophet ﷺ  asked him, "Where did you get this gold from?" The man replied, "From a mine." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Go, we have no need for it as it does not contain any goodness." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  settled the debt on behalf of the man.
hi: Humein Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, humein Abdul Aziz bin Muhammad ne, Amr bin Abi Amr se, unhone Ikrimah se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se bataya, ke aik shakhs ne apne qarzdaar ko dus (10) dinar ke liye pakad rakha tha, usne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mere paas aaj ada karne ke liye kuch nahi." Woh (qarz dene wala) kehne laga: "Allah ki qasam, main tumhein tab tak nahi chhodunga jab tak tum ada na karo ya koi zaamin na laao jo tumhari taraf se zimmedari le." Usne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mere paas ada karne ke liye kuch nahi, aur mujhe koi aisa shakhs bhi nahi milta jo mere liye zaamin bane." Unhone kaha: to woh usse ghaseet kar Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas le aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh mujhpar (qarz ke liye) pakda hua hai, maine ise aik mahine ki mohlat maangi thi lekin usne inkaar kar diya jab tak main ada na karun ya zaamin na laaun, maine kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe zaamin nahi milta aur mere paas aaj ada karne ke liye kuch nahi.'" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse (qarzdaar se) poocha: "Kya tum use sirf aik mahine ki mohlat doge?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To main iski zimmedari leta hoon." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne uski taraf se zimmedari li, woh shakhs gaya aur jitna wada kiya tha utna le aaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse poocha: "Yeh sona tumhein kahan se mila?" Usne kaha: "Kisi kaan se." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise le jao, humein ismein koi zaroorat nahi, ismein koi bhalaai nahi." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne (apni taraf se) uski taraf se ada kar diya.

e: [AI] I sold a camel to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once. I went to collect the payment, and I said, "O Messenger of Allah, please pay the price for my camel." He replied, "I will not pay you until I receive the camel." So, he then received the camel from me. He admired my camel and said, "This is better than the one I had." Later, an Arab man came and asked the Messenger of Allah, "Please pay me for my camel." The Messenger of Allah paid him without any delay. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, my camel was better than his." He replied, "It is for you, as the best among people in terms of character is the best in their transactions."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko aik jawaan oont becha, phir main uski qeemat maangne aaya, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere jawaan oont ki qeemat ada kijiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, main tumhein uska waqt aane par hi ada karunga," phir aap (SAW) ne mujhe ada kiya aur bohot achhi tarah ada kiya. Phir aik badu unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere jawaan oont ki qeemat ada kijiye." To aap (SAW) ne use bagair kisi der ke ada kar diya, to usne (badu ne) kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh mere jawaan oont se behtar hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhara hai, beshak logon mein sabse behtareen woh hai jo ada karne mein sabse behtareen ho."

e: [AI] I and Makhrama Al-Abdi brought some goat meat from Hajr or Al-Bahrain. When we were in Mina, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to us and bought pants, a cloak, and scales that weigh with stones. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  paid us the price and said, "Weigh and balance." This was narrated by Shu'bah from Samaak ibn Harb.
hi: Main aur Makhramah Al-Abdi Hajr ya Bahrain se kapda lekar aaye, jab hum Mina mein thay to Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas tashreef laaye, unhone humse pajama aur qaba khareedi, aur aik taulnay wala (jo mazdoori par tolta tha) tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne use qeemat de di aur farmaya: "Tolo aur zyada do." Isse Shu'bah ne, Simak bin Harb se, riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Safwan say that I sent Sarawil, and he weighed them for me and they were the correct weight. Abu Safwan is the kunya of Suwaid bin Qais, who is one of my companions from the Ansar. And the hadith is authentic according to the conditions set by Muslim, and they did not exclude it.
hi: Maine Abu Safwan ko kehte hue suna: maine Nabi (SAW) ko pajama becha, "to unhone mere liye tola aur zyada diya." Abu Safwan, Suwaid bin Qais (RA) ki kunyat hai, dono aik hi shakhs hain, Ansar ke sahaba mein se. "Yeh hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala."

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the people of weights and measures: "Indeed you have been entrusted with two matters that nations preceding you in the past were destroyed for." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1217)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne naapne aur tolne walon se farmaya: "Tumhein aisi zimmedari di gayi hai jismein pichli Ummat ki halaakat thi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited breaking the path of the Muslims that is permissible to be taken between them, except in the case of harm, or if a silver coin is broken, it should be made into silver, or if a gold coin is broken, it should be made into gold. The Ansari did not mention his father Alqamah in his narration, and it was mentioned by Al-Mu'tamir. The Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "Musalmanon ke aapas mein chalne wale jaayaz sikkon ko todne se mana kiya, siwaye kisi zaroorat ke, ya isse ke dirham tod kar chandi bana diya jaaye, ya dinar tod kar sona bana diya jaaye." Al-Ansari ne apni hadith mein Alqamah ke waalid ka zikr nahi kiya, jabke Al-Mu'tamir ne unka zikr kiya hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "Gabriel came to me and said, 'O Muhammad, Allah has cursed alcohol and its drinker, its server, its squeezer, its carrier, the one to whom it is carried, its seller, its buyer, and its server.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: Jibra'il (AS) mere paas aaye aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, Allah ne sharaab par la'nat bheji hai, aur uske nichodne wale par, uske liye nichodwaane wale par, uske peene wale par, uske uthaane wale par, aur jiske liye uthaayi jaaye uspar, uske bechne wale par, uske pilaane wale par, aur jise pilaaya jaaye uspar."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Allah has cursed wine, its drinker, its server, its seller, its buyer, its presser, the one for whom it is pressed, the one who conveys it, and the one to whom it is conveyed. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3674)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne sharaab par la'nat bheji, aur uske pilaane wale par, uske peene wale par, uske nichodne wale par, uske liye nichodwaane wale par, uske uthaane wale par, aur jiske liye uthaayi jaaye uspar, uske bechne wale par, uske khareedne wale par, aur uski qeemat khaane wale par la'nat bheji."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  purchased a sheep from a Bedouin with dates. When he saw that the dates were not enough, with some being left with him and others not, he said, "Can you take some of your dates and some of them to the fields?" The Bedouin refused, so the Prophet ﷺ  borrowed dates from him and returned them to him.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik badu se aik oont khajoor ke badle khareeda, aap (SAW) ka khayal tha ke khajoor unke paas maujood hai, magar (baad mein pata chala ke) uska kuch hissa unke paas tha aur kuch nahi tha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum apni kuch khajoor abhi le lo aur baaqi khajoor katai (fasal) tak intezar karo?" Usne inkaar kar diya, to Nabi (SAW) ne uske liye khajoor udhaar li aur usse ada kar di.

e: [AI] "That Zaid ibn Sa'na was one of the scribes of the Jews. He came to the Prophet ﷺ  to get his due payment. The Prophet ﷺ  pulled his garment from his right shoulder and said, 'O sons of Abd al-Muttalib, you are the heirs, and I am well acquainted with your rights.' Umar reproached him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, 'O Umar, both he and I were in need of something other than this. It would have been better if you had advised me to give him his due honorably and advised him to demand it honorably. Depart, O Umar, and fulfill his right. Indeed, he has three sa' left of his due, so give him an extra thirty sa' for your attempt to cheat him.'"
hi: Zaid bin Sa'nah, jo Yahoodi ulama mein se the, Nabi (SAW) ke paas apna qarz maangne aaye, unhone aap (SAW) ki chaadar unke dayen kandhe se khainch li, phir kaha: "Tum, Aye Banu Abdul Muttalib, taal-matol karne walon mein se ho, aur main tumhein achhi tarah pehchaanta hoon." Umar (RA) ne unhein daanta, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye Umar, main aur yeh (shakhs) tumse kisi aur cheez ke zyada muhtaaj the, mujhe achhi tarah ada karne ka hukum dete aur isse achhi tarah maangne ka hukum dete. Jao, Aye Umar, iska haq poora karo, aur beshak iski muddat mein teen din baaqi hain, isliye tumhari sakhti ki wajah se ise tees (30) sa' zyada de do."

e: “Whoever demands his rights let him do so in a decent manner as much as he can.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2421)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi haq maange, use waqar aur sharaafat se maangna chahiye, chahe woh (poora) mile ya na mile."

e: “Take your rights in a decent manner as much as he can.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2422)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne haq-daar se farmaya: "Apna haq waqar se lo," aur mera khayal hai unhone kaha: "chahe poora mile ya na mile."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived in Medina, they were people who cheated others in terms of measures. So Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, revealed, "Woe to those who give less [than due] measure" [Quran 99:1]. After that, they started to be honest in their measurements.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah tashreef laaye, to woh log naap-tol mein sabse zyada kami karne walon mein se the, to Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "{Halaakat hai kam naapne-tolne walon ke liye}" (Surah Al-Mutaffifin 1), iske baad unhone achhi tarah naap-tol karna shuru kar diya.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went to Khaybar, he appointed Siba' bin 'Urfuta Al-Ghifari as a deputy. We arrived and witnessed the Fajr prayer with him. In the first rak'ah, he recited {Kaf Ha Ya 'Ain Sad} [Maryam 1], and in the second rak'ah, {Woe to those who give insufficient measure} [Al-Mutaffifin 1]. I said to myself, "Woe to Abu Fulan! He has two measures, and he fulfills with one and takes away with the other." We went to Siba' bin 'Urfuta and prepared a complaint. Then we went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  either the day before or after the conquest."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Khaybar ki taraf nikle to unhone Siba' bin Urfutah Al-Ghifari (RA) ko apna khalifa (nayab) muqarrar kiya, hum aaye aur unke sath Fajr ki namaz mein shareek huay, to unhone pehli rak'at mein "{Kaf Ha Ya Ain Sad}" (Surah Maryam 1) padhi, aur doosri mein "{Halaakat hai kam naapne-tolne walon ke liye}" (Surah Al-Mutaffifin 1) padhi, to maine apne dil mein socha: "Halaakat hai Abu Fulan ke liye, uske do naap ke bartan hain, aik se poora naapta hai aur doosre se kam deta hai." Phir hum Siba' bin Urfutah (RA) ke paas aaye, unhone hamein taiyyar kiya, "phir hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas fatah se aik din pehle ya aik din baad gaye."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "There is no dowry for the adulteress, nor the price of a dog is permissible."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zaaniya (bad-chalan aurat) ka mehr aur kutte ki qeemat halal nahi."

e: "The Messenger of Allah forbade the price of a dog, the gift of a female fornicator and the fees of a fortuneteller."( Sahih) (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4292)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne kutte ki qeemat, bad-chalan aurat ke mehr, aur kaahin (ghaib-goo) ki mazdoori se mana kiya."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prohibited the selling of dogs and monkeys." It was followed by Isa ibn Yunus, narrated from Al-A'mash, on the condition of Muslim.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne kutte aur billi ki qeemat se mana kiya." Isa bin Yunus ne, Al-A'mash se, isi ki mutaba'at ki hai. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Muslimah al-Qa'nabi narrated that Isa ibn Yunus narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade the selling of dogs and wild animals." Abu Zubair also narrated this from Jabir.
hi: Humein Abdullah bin Maslamah Al-Qa'nabi ne bataya, humein Isa bin Yunus ne, Al-A'mash se, unhone Abu Sufyan se, unhone Jabir (RA) se bataya, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne kutte aur billi ki qeemat se mana kiya." Isse Abu Az-Zubair ne bhi, Jabir (RA) se, riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating cats and eating their price." This is a hadith narrated by Al-A'mash from Abu Sufyan. It is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim, but he did not include it in his compilation.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne billi khaane aur uski qeemat khaane se mana kiya." Al-A'mash ki, Abu Sufyan se, hadith "Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Umar bin Zaid kamzor hain.

e: "The Messenger of Allah forbade (eating) animals that had been taken as targets, the milk of Al-Jallalah (animals that eat dung), and drinking directly from water skins." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4448)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne jallalah (napaak cheezein khane wale jaanwar) ke doodh se, mujaththamah (bandhkar nishana banaaye gaye jaanwar) khane se, aur mashk ke mun se (seedha) paani peene se mana kiya."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited eating the animal which feeds on filth and drinking its milk. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3785)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne jallalah khaane aur uska doodh peene se mana kiya."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited to ride a camel which eats dung. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2558)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne jallalah se mana kiya - ya'ni un oonton se jo napaak cheezein khaate hain - ke unpar sawaari ki jaaye ya unka doodh piya jaaye."

e: "The Messenger of Allah forbade (eating) animals that had been taken as targets, the milk of Al-Jallalah (animals that eat dung), and drinking directly from water skins." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4448)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujaththamah aur jallalah se mana kiya."

e: [AI] "The Prophet, peace be upon him, prohibited selling sheep by its meat."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "bakri ko gosht ke badle bechne se mana kiya."

e: The Prophet ﷺ forbade selling animals for animals when payment was to be made at a later date. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3356)
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "gosht ko zinda jaanwar ke badle bechne se mana kiya."

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet, peace be upon him, "Whoever buys stolen goods, knowing that they are stolen, he has shared in its shame and sin." This is Shurahbil, the son of Sa'd al-Ansari, who was reported by Malik ibn Anas after he had a negative opinion about him. The hadith is authentic and they did not exclude it.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi chori ki hui cheez khareede jabke use pata ho ke yeh chori ki hui hai, to woh iski ruswaai aur gunah dono mein shareek ho gaya." Yeh Shurahbil, Sa'd Al-Ansari ke bete hain, Malik bin Anas ne unse riwayat ki hai, halanke pehle unke baare mein unki raay achhi nahi thi. Yeh hadith sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Any woman who is married by two guardians (to two different men) belongs to the first woman who is married by two guardians (to two different men) belongs to the first of them and anything sold by a man to two persons belongs to the first of them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2088)
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi shakhs kisi cheez ko aik ya do aadmiyon ko bech de, to woh un dono mein se pehle ki hai, aur jo koi aurat do waliyon ke zariye byaahi jaaye (do alag logon se), to woh un dono mein se pehle (nikah) ki hai."

e: [AI] Kaataba Muawiya ila Marwan: "If a man steals and his theft is found, he is entitled to it wherever it is found." Fa qataba ilayya bi dhalika Marwan wa ana 'ala al-yamamah. Fa katabtu ila Marwan anna Nabiyya Allah (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam) qada 'itha kana 'inda al-rajul ghayr al-mutaham, fa in shaa'a sayyiduha akhadhaha bil-thaman wa in shaa'a ittaba'a saariqahu. Thumma qada bi dhalika ba'dahu Abu Bakrin wa 'Umaru wa 'Uthman. Qala fa kataba Marwanu ila Muawiyyah bi kitabihi. Fa kataba Muawiyyatu ila Marwana, innaka lasta anta wala usayidun taqdiyana 'alayya fi ma wullita wa lakinni aqdi 'alaykuma, fanfudh lima amartuka bihi. Wa ba'atha Marwanu bi kitabi Muawiyyata ilayhi fa qala wallahi la aqdi bihi abadan.
hi: Unhone kaha: Muawiyah (RA) ne Marwan ko likha: "Jab koi aadmi chori kare aur apni churaayi hui cheez (kahin) paaye, to woh isko wahin se lene ka zyada haqdaar hai jahan use paaye." Unhone kaha: to Marwan ne mujhe isi baat ki taraf likha, jabke main Yamamah mein tha, to maine Marwan ko likha ke Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne yeh faisla diya tha: "Jab (churaayi hui cheez) kisi aise shakhs ke paas ho jo mutahham (shak-zada) na ho, to agar uska maalik chahe to woh use qeemat de kar le le, aur agar chahe to chor ka peechha kare." Phir aap (SAW) ke baad Abu Bakr (RA), Umar (RA) aur Uthman (RA) ne bhi isi ka faisla diya." Unhone kaha: to Marwan ne mera khat Muawiyah (RA) ko bheja, to Muawiyah (RA) ne Marwan ko likha: "Tum aur na hi Usaid, mujh par mere ilaaqe ke maamlaat mein faisla nahi kar sakte, balke main tum dono par faisla karta hoon, isliye jo maine tumhein hukum diya hai use nafiz karo." Aur Marwan ne Muawiyah (RA) ka khat mere paas bheja, to maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main iske mutabiq kabhi faisla nahi karunga."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: If you were to sell dried dates to your brother and they were smitten by blight, it will not be allowable for you to take your brother's property unjustly. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3470)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum apne bhai ko khajoorein becho aur unpar koi aafat aa jaaye, to tumhare liye jaayaz nahi ke tum uske paas se kuch lo, ya apne bhai ka maal uski ijaazat ke bagair lo."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "By what means does anyone of you allow himself to take his brother's wealth if a calamity from the sky befalls him?"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne bhai ka maal apne liye kis tarah halal karega agar (uspar) aasman se koi aafat aa jaaye?"

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'What would you think if Allah were to forbid the dates, so how then would anyone of you be allowed to consume the wealth of his brother?'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai agar Allah khajoor ko rok le, to phir tum mein se koi apne bhai ka maal kis tarah apne liye halal karega?"

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "Usury (interest) has seventy-three doors, the easiest of which is equivalent to a man marrying his own mother, and indeed the greatest form of usury is the violation of a Muslim man's honor."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sood ke tehattar (73) darwaze hain, jinme sabse halka darwaza aisa hai jaise koi aadmi apni maa se nikah kar le, aur beshak sabse bada sood kisi Musalman aadmi ki izzat (par hamla karna) hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are four individuals who have no right to enter Paradise and will not taste its blessings: the habitual drinker, the one who consumes interest, the one who unjustly consumes the wealth of orphans, and the one who disobeys and mistreats their parents."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Chaar (log) hain jinke baare mein Allah ka haq hai ke woh unhein Jannat mein dakhil na kare aur na hi unhein iski ne'maton ka mazaa chakhaaye: sharaab ka aadi, sood khaane wala, yateem ka maal bagair haq ke khaane wala, aur apne waalidain ka na-farmaan.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) forbade buying fruits until they are ripe. He also said, "When fornication and usury appear in a town, then they have brought upon themselves the punishment of Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne phal khareedne se mana kiya jab tak woh pak (khaane laayaq) na ho jaaye, aur farmaya: "Jab kisi basti mein zina aur sood zaahir ho jaayen, to unhone apne aap par Allah ka azab halal kar liya hai."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Even if interest (usury) increases, its outcome becomes less."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sood, chahe woh badh jaaye, iska anjaam aakhir mein kami ki taraf hi jaata hai."

e: "The Messenger of Allah forbade selling a heap of dried dates whose volume is unknown for known volume of dried dates," (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4547)
hi: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne khajoor ke aise dhair ko bechne se mana kiya jiska naap maloom na ho, kisi muqarrar naap ki khajoor ke badle."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  being asked about fresh dates and he asked those around him, "Does it decrease when it becomes dry?" They replied, "Yes." He then said, "Then no." Abu al-Walid said, "I heard Malik ibn Anas saying on another occasion that he disliked this wording of the hadith of Abu al-Walid." Isma'il ibn Umayyah narrated it from Abdullah ibn Yazid, a servant of Aswad ibn Sufyan. Malik narrated it once and disliked it.
hi: Maine (kisi ko) Rasulullah (SAW) se taaza khajoor ko sukhi khajoor ke badle (bechne) ke baare mein poochte suna, to aap (SAW) ne apne aas-paas walon se poocha: "Kya yeh sukh jaane par kam ho jaati hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To phir nahi." Abu Al-Waleed ne kaha: aur maine Malik bin Anas se aik aur dafa suna, unhone kaha to unhone ise napasand kiya. Yeh Abu Al-Waleed ki hadith ke alfaaz hain, isse Ismail bin Umayyah ne, Abdullah bin Yazid Maula Al-Aswad bin Sufyan se, isi ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] Two men made a contract during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, regarding fresh dates and dried dates. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "Does the dried date decrease in weight when it becomes dry?" They replied, "Yes." He then said, "Then it is not permissible." This was narrated by Sufyan Ath-Thawri from Ismail bin Umayyah.
hi: Do aadmiyon ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein kacchi khajoor aur taaza khajoor ka mu'aamla kiya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya taaza khajoor sukh jaane par kam ho jaati hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To phir nahi." Isi tarah Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne, Ismail bin Umayyah se, riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was asked about eating dried dates, and he said, "Will it cause any decrease if it dries?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Then refrain from it." This ruling was also confirmed by Yahya ibn Abi Kathir in his narration from Abdullah ibn Yazid.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se taaza khajoor ko sukhi khajoor ke badle (bechne) ke baare mein poocha gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya yeh sukh jaane par kam ho jaati hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To (isse) mana kiya." Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne bhi, Abdullah bin Yazid se apni riwayat mein, in dono ki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] He informed him that he heard Saad ibn Abi Waqqas saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling fresh dates for dried dates, as it is detrimental."
hi: Unhein khabar di ke unhone Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne taaza khajoor ko sukhi khajoor ke badle udhaar (nasee'ah) bechne se mana kiya."

e:
[AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "A man will be presented with a scroll on the Day of Judgment until he sees that he has been saved. The injustices of the children of Adam will continue to follow him until he has no good deeds left, and his sins will be added to him."

I (or Asim, according to another narration) asked him, "From whom, O Abu Uthman?" He said, "From Salman, Sa'd, Ibn Mas'ud, and two other men who were not named." Shu'bah said, "So I asked Asim about this hadith, and he narrated it to me from Abu Uthman, who narrated it from Salman and the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his family."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadmi ke liye Qayamat ke din aik namaa'-nama uthaaya jaata hai yahan tak ke usse lagta hai ke woh nijaat pa gaya, phir Bani Adam ke mazloom haq usse peechha karte rehte hain yahan tak ke uski koi neki baaqi nahi rehti, aur unke gunah usme zyada kar diye jaate hain." Unhone kaha: maine unse poocha - ya Aasim ne unse poocha - "Kis se, Aye Abu Uthman?" Unhone kaha: "Salman (RA), Sa'd (RA), Ibn Mas'ud (RA), aur do aur aadmiyon se jinhein woh yaad nahi rakh sake." Shu'bah ne kaha: to maine Aasim se is hadith ke baare mein poocha, unhone mujhe isse Abu Uthman se, Salman (RA) se, bayan ki, aur mujhe Uthman bin Ghiyath ne khabar di ke unhone Abu Uthman ko yeh Salman (RA) aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) se bayan karte suna.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ prohibited eating the flesh and drinking the milk of the sacrificial animals (for Hajj or Udhiyah) and people riding on them, until they are grazed for forty nights.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne jallalah (napaak cheezein khane wale jaanwar) ke gosht khane, uska doodh peene, uspar saaman ladne, aur log uspar sawaari karne se mana kiya, jab tak use chalees (40) raaton tak (paak) chaara na khilaaya jaaye."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, it is narrated that he said, "It is prohibited to sell goods where they are bought until the buyer has taken possession of them, even if it requires carrying them to his ride. And if he needs to send men to carry them, then they should be entrusted to that duty."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne "saamaan ko wahin bechne se mana kiya jahan khareeda gaya ho, jab tak khareedar use apne thikaane tak na le jaaye, chahe woh (khud le jaane ke bajaaye) aadmi bhej de jo (usse) uthaayein."

e: I bought olive oil in the market. When I became its owner, a man met me and offered good profit for it. I intended to settle the bargain with him, but a man caught hold of my hand from behind. When I turned I found that he was Zayd ibn Thabit. He said: Do not sell it on the spot where you have bought it until you take it to your house, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade to sell the goods where they are bought until the tradesmen take them to their houses. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3499)
hi: Maine bazaar mein tel khareeda, jab main iska maalik ban gaya to aik shakhs mujhse mila aur usne mujhe achha munafa dene ki peshkash ki, maine chaaha ke uske haath par (soda) pakka kar loon, ke aik shakhs ne mere peechhe se meri baazu pakad li, main uski taraf mudkar dekha to woh Zaid bin Thabit (RA) the, unhone kaha: "Isse wahin mat becho jahan tumne isse khareeda hai, jab tak isse apne thikaane tak na le jaao, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne 'saamaan ko wahin bechne se mana kiya jahan khareeda jaaye, jab tak tujjaar use apne thikaanon tak na le jaayen.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited killing any animal with fangs from among the predatory animals, killing children, and purchasing stolen goods until they are divided.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne har naab-daar darinde (jaanwar) khane se, aur bachchon ko qatl karne se, aur maal-e-ghaneemat ko taqseem hone se pehle khareedne-bechne se mana kiya."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ prohibited the selling of spoils of war until they are divided. Sahih.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne maal-e-ghaneemat ko taqseem hone se pehle bechne se mana kiya." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, "placed the pandemics." Ali bin Al-Madini said, and Sufyan informed us about Abu Zubair, who narrated from Jabir, who narrated from the Prophet, peace be upon him, that he "placed the pandemics."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne (khareede huay phalon par aane wali) qudrati aafaton (ki qeemat) ko maaf kar diya." Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: aur Sufyan ne humein Abu Az-Zubair se, unhone Jabir (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se bayan ki ke aap (SAW) ne "qudrati aafaton (ki qeemat) ko maaf kar diya."

e: In the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a man suffered loss affecting fruits he had bought and owed a large debt, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Give him sadaqah (alms). So the people gave him sadaqah (alms), but as that was not enough to pay the debt in full, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Take what you find. But that is all you may have. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3469)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein aik shakhs ko phalon mein nuqsaan pahuncha jo usne khareede the, uska qarz badh gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ispar sadqa karo," to logon ne sadqa kiya lekin woh uska qarz poora ada karne ke liye kaafi nahi hua, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tumhein mila hai woh le lo, iske ilawa tumhare liye kuch nahi hai."

e: Rafi' had cultivated a land. The Prophet ﷺ passed him when he was watering it. So he asked him: To whom does the crop belong, and to whom does the land belong? He replied: The crop is mine for my seed and labour. The half (of the crop) is mine and the half for so-and-so. He said: You conducted usurious transaction. Return the land to its owner and take your wages and cost. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3402)
hi: Unhone zameen mein khaiti ki, Nabi (SAW) unke paas se guzre jabke woh usse seench rahe the, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh khaiti kiski hai, aur zameen kiski hai?" Unhone kaha: "Khaiti mera beej aur meri mehnat se hai, aadha hissa mera hai aur aadha hissa fulan khandan ka hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum dono ne sood ka mu'aamla kiya hai, isliye zameen uske maalikon ko wapas kar do aur apna kharcha le lo."

e: I taught some persons of the people of Suffah writing and the Qur'an. A man of them presented to me a bow. I said: It cannot be reckoned property; may I shoot with it in Allah's path? I must come to the Apostle of of Allah ﷺ and ask him (about it). So I came to him and said : Messenger of Allah ﷺ, one of those whom I have been teaching writing and the Qur'an has presented me a bow, and as it cannot be reckoned property, may I shoot with it in Allah's path? He said: If you want to have a necklace of fire on you, accept it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3416)
hi: Maine As-Suffah walon mein se kuch logon ko likhna aur Quran sikhaya, unme se aik shakhs ne mujhe aik kamaan (dhanush) tohfe mein di, maine kaha: "Yeh maal (paisa) nahi hai, aur main ise Allah ki raah mein (jihad ke liye) chalaaunga, lekin main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas zaroor jaaunga aur unse zaroor poochunga." To main unke paas gaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aik shakhs, jise main likhna aur Quran sikhaata tha, usne mujhe aik kamaan tohfe mein di hai, aur yeh maal nahi hai, kya main ise Allah ki raah mein chalaa sakta hoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum chahte ho ke tumhein aag ka aik tauq pehnaaya jaaye, to ise qubool kar lo."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The earnings of a cupper are impure, the price paid for a dog is impure, and the hire paid to a prostitute is impure. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3421)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hijamah (pachhna/cupping) karne wale ki kamai khabees (napaak) hai, kutte ki qeemat khabees hai, aur bad-chalan aurat ka mehr khabees hai."

e: Rafi' ibn Rifa'ah came to a meeting of the Ansar and said: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ forbade us (from some things) today, and he mentioned some things. He forbade the earning of a slave-girl except what she earned with her hand. He indicated (some things) with his fingers such as baking, spinning, and ginning. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3426)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne aaj humein kuch cheezon se mana kiya hai," phir unhone kuch cheezein zikr ki aur kaha: "Humein laundi ki kamai se mana kiya siwaye us kamai ke jo woh apne haath se kamaaye," aur aap (SAW) ne apni ungli se ishara karte huay kaha - kaatai, roti banaana, aur oon dhunkne ki taraf.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade earnings of a slave-girl unless it is known from where it came. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3427)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne laundi ki kamai se mana kiya jab tak yeh maloom na ho ke woh kahan se aayi hai." Humne ise shahid ke tor par nikaala hai.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade (taking hire for) a stallion's covering. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3429)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne nar jaanwar ki nasal-kashi (breeding) ki mazdoori lene se mana kiya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said on one day while he was with his wife Umm Salamah: "I desire some date palm (type of dates) called 'ajwah'. So she sent two handfuls of dates to a man from the Ansar (helpers of the Prophet). He brought back two handfuls of 'ajwah dates instead. She presented them to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and when he saw them, he was pleased. He took one date, then another, and then he held them and said, 'Where did you get these?' Umm Salamah said, 'I sent two handfuls of dates to a man from the Ansar, and he brought back two handfuls of these 'ajwah dates.' This is one of the handfuls.' He held the dates out before him and said, 'Return it; I have no need for this. Dates should be exchanged for dates, barley for barley, wheat for wheat, gold for gold, silver for silver, hand to hand, like for like, equal for equal. If there is more, it is usury.' Then he said, 'This is how it should be weighed and measured.' Ibn Abbas said, 'May Allah reward you, O Abu Sa'id, with Paradise, for you reminded me of something I had forgotten. I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.' After that, he disliked it (usury), and prohibited it more strongly."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din, jab woh apni biwi Umm Salamah (RA) ke paas thay, farmaya: "Mujhe ajwa khajoor ki khwahish hai." To unhone Ansar ke aik shakhs ke paas do sa' khajoor bheji, woh do sa' ke badle aik sa' ajwa khajoor le aaya, to unhone khade hokar woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne pesh ki, jab aap (SAW) ne use dekha to unhein pasand aayi, unhone aik khajoor uthaayi, phir ruk gaye aur poocha: "Yeh tumhein kahan se mili?" Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Ansar ke aik shakhs ke paas do sa' khajoor bheji thi, woh humare paas do sa' ke badle yeh aik sa' laaya hai, aur yeh hai, khaayein." To aap (SAW) ne khajoor apne saamne daal di aur farmaya: "Ise wapas karo, mujhe iski zaroorat nahi, khajoor khajoor ke badle, gehun gehun ke badle, jau jau ke badle, sona sone ke badle, chandi chandi ke badle, haath-dar-haath, barabar-barabar, mithl bil-mithl, jo koi ziyaadti kare woh sood hai." Phir farmaya: "Isi tarah jo cheez naapi aur toli jaati hai, uska bhi yehi hukum hai." To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah aapko Jannat ki jaza de, Aye Abu Sa'eed, aapne mujhe woh baat yaad dilaayi jise main bhool chuka tha, main Allah se maghfirat maangta hoon aur uski taraf tauba karta hoon," aur iske baad woh isse sakht tareen mana' karne lage.

e: [AI] And Saad said, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about buying fresh dates with dried dates. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Is there any difference between the two?" They said, "Yes, fresh dates are lesser in quantity." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, "Then it is not permissible."
hi: Aur Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) se taaza khajoor ko sukhi khajoor ke badle khareedne ke baare mein poocha gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya dono ke darmiyan koi kami-beshi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, taaza khajoor (sukh kar) kam ho jaati hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "To yeh sahih nahi."

e: [AI] It was asked to the Prophet ﷺ  about a "correct" (authentic) hadith according to the condition of a Muslim, and he did not exclude it as authentic.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) se poocha gaya... Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: I used to sell camels at al-Baqi for dinars and take dirhams for them, and sell for dirhams and take dinars for them. I would take these for these and give these for these. I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was in the house of Hafsah. I said: Messenger of Allah , take it easy, I shall ask you (a question): I sell camels at al-Baqi'. I sell (them) for dinars and take dirhams and I sell for dirhams and take dinars. I take these for these, and give these for these. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said: There is no harm in taking them at the current rate so long as you do not separate leaving something to be settled. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3354)
hi: Main Al-Baqi' mein oont bechta tha, kabhi dinaron mein bechta aur dirham le leta, aur kabhi dirhamon mein bechta aur dinar le leta, to mere dil mein iske baare mein (shak) paida hua, to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaya jabke woh Hafsah (RA) ke ghar mein thay - ya jab woh Hafsah (RA) ke ghar se nikal rahe the - maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), zara thehriye, main aapse aik sawaal poochna chahta hoon, main Al-Baqi' mein oont bechta hoon, dinaron mein bech kar dirham leta hoon, aur dirhamon mein bech kar dinar leta hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi harj nahi ke tum inhein us din ke bhaav par lo, jab tak tum alag na ho jaao jabke tumhare darmiyan (koi hisaab) baaqi ho."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbidding the sale of water, on the condition of being a Muslim.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko "paani bechne se mana karte" suna. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "Do not sell the gift of water to people, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the selling of water." And Ibn Jurayj also has another report regarding this matter.
hi: Logon ke liye (kaha): "Faaltu paani mat becho, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne paani bechne se mana kiya hai." Aur Ibn Jurayj ke paas iski aik aur sanad bhi hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling water, hitting camels, and selling one's land and water. These are all authentic narrations according to the conditions of Imam Muslim and they have not been excluded. The best narration in this regard is the Hadith of Husayn ibn Waqid, according to the conditions of Imam Muslim."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne paani bechne se, oont ki nasal-kashi (ki mazdoori lene) se, aur aadmi ke apni zameen aur uska paani (alag) bechne se mana kiya." Yeh sab asaneed Muslim ki shart par sahih hain, dono ne inhein nahi nikala, aur is baab mein sabse behtareen Husain bin Waqid ki hadith hai. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] It is reported that the Prophet ﷺ  prohibited the selling of water. This narration was narrated exclusively by Al-Husayn ibn Waqid from Ayyub and it is not considered a strong or widely known narration.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "paani bechne se mana kiya." Isse sirf Husain bin Waqid ne, Ayyub se, riwayat kiya hai, aur yeh sahih nahi. Ghareeb sahih, Husain isse akele riwayat karte hain.

e: We made a journey to Syria on an expedition along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Nabateans of Syria came to us and we paid in advance to them (in a salam contract) in wheat and olive oil at a specified rate and for a specified time. He asked (by the people): you might have contracted with him who had these things in his possession? He replied: We did not ask them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3466)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Sham mein jihad karne gaye, to Sham ke Anbaat (Nabati log) humare paas aate the, hum unhein gehun aur zaitoon (tel) mein muqarrar bhaav aur muqarrar waqt ke sath aage se paisa dete the." Unse poocha gaya: "Kya woh cheezein unke apne paas hoti thin?" Unhone kaha: "Hum unse (yeh) nahi poochte the."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone rescinds a sale with a Muslim, Allah will cancel his slip, on the Day of Resurrection. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3460)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Musalman (ki dilajoi ke liye) khareed-o-farokht mansookh kare (soda toad de), Allah uski lagzish (khataa) ko mansookh kar dega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever sells two sales in one transaction, he shall have only one of them, or it would be usury." This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim and it was not contradicted by Imam Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi aik hi bay' mein do bay' kare, to uske liye un dono mein se kam waali qeemat hai, warna woh sood hai." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: Muhammad ibn al-Ash'ath said: Al-Ash'ath bought slaves of booty from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud for twenty thousand (dirhams. Abdullah asked him for payment of their price. He said: I bought them for ten thousand (dirhams). Abdullah said: Appoint a man who may adjudicate between me and you. Al-Ash'ath said: (I appoint) you between me and yourself. Abdullah said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: If both parties in a business transaction differ (on the price of an article), and they have witness between them, the statement of the owner of the article will be accepted (as correct) or they may annul the transaction. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3511)
hi: Al-Ash'ath ne khums (paanchve hisse) ke ghulamon mein se kuch ghulam Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se bees hazaar (20,000) mein khareede, Abdullah (RA) ne unki qeemat ke baare mein unke paas (qaasid) bheja, to unhone kaha: "Maine to ye dus hazaar (10,000) mein li thin." Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "To koi aadmi chun lo jo mere aur tumhare darmiyan faisla kare." Al-Ash'ath ne kaha: "Aap khud hi mere aur apne darmiyan (faisla) hain." Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "To maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Jab bechne wale aur khareedne wale mein ikhtilaaf ho aur unke darmiyan koi gawah na ho, to woh (baat maani jayegi) jo maal ka maalik kahe, ya woh dono soda cancel kar dein.'"

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The child of a person is a result of their best earnings, so enjoy the wealth that you have earned."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadmi ka bachcha uski kamai mein se, uski sabse paakeeza kamai mein se hai, isliye unke maal se khao."

e: The aunt of Umarah ibn Umayr asked Aisha: I have an orphan in my guardianship. May I enjoy from his property? She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The pleasantest things a man enjoys come from what he earns, and his child comes from what he earns. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3528)
hi: Ke unhone Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Meri sarparasti mein aik yateem hai, kya main uske maal se kha sakti hoon?" Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak aadmi jo sabse paakeeza cheez khaata hai woh uski apni kamai hai, aur uska bachcha bhi uski kamai mein se hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Give the entrusted to the one who entrusted you and do not betray the one who betrayed you." Al-Abbas said, "I told Talq, 'Write "partner" and leave out "Qays"?' He said, 'You are right. This hadith of Sharik is narrated by Abu Hurairah, and it is authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, and they did not exclude it.' And he has a witness from Anas according to the conditions of Muslim, and he is also his witness."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Amaanat us shakhs ko wapas karo jisne tumhein amaanat di hai, aur jisne tumhare sath khiyanat ki ho usse (badle mein) khiyanat na karo." Al-Abbas ne kaha: maine Talq se kaha: "Main 'Shareek' likhoon aur 'Qais' chhod dun?" Unhone kaha: "Tum zyada behtar samajhte ho." Shareek ki, Abu Husain se, hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur iska shahid Anas (RA) se bhi milta hai. Muslim ki shart par, aur uska shahid.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Pay the deposit to him who deposited it with you, and do not betray him who betrayed you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3535)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Amaanat us shakhs ko wapas karo jisne tumhein amaanat di hai, aur jisne tumhare sath khiyanat ki ho usse (badle mein) khiyanat na karo."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: It is not lawful for a man to make a donation or give a gift and then take it back, except a father regarding what he gives his child. One who gives a gift and then takes it back is like a dog which eats and vomits when it is full, then returns to its vomit. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3539)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi aadmi ke liye jaayaz nahi ke woh koi tohfa de ya koi cheez hadiya kare, phir usse wapas le le, siwaye waalid ke jo apne bachche ko de, aur jo koi tohfa deta hai phir usse wapas leta hai, uski misaal us kutte jaisi hai jo khaata hai, jab pait bhar jaaye to qai kar deta hai, phir apni qai ki taraf lautta hai (usse khaata hai)."

e: On his father's authority, said that his grandfather reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: It is not permissible for a woman to present a gift from the property which she has in her possession when her husband owns her chastity. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3546)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat ke liye apne maal mein koi maamla (khud se karna) jaayaz nahi jab uske shohar ne uski zimmedari le li ho."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  borrowed a shield from him on the day of Hunayn, so he said, "Should I rob you, O Muhammad?" He (the Prophet) said, "No, but it is guaranteed (to be returned)." This is witnessed by Ibn Abbas.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unse Hunain ke din kuch zirahein udhaar mangi, usne poocha: "Kya yeh zabardasti hai, Aye Muhammad?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke yeh zimmedari wali udhaar hai." Iska shahid Ibn Abbas (RA) se bhi milta hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  borrowed armor and weapons from Safwan bin Umayyah during the Battle of Hunayn. Safwan asked, "O Messenger of Allah, should I lend them to you as a gift or as a loan?" The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "As a loan."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Safwan bin Umayyah (RA) se, ghazwa Hunain mein, kuch zirahein aur aik neza udhaar mangi, unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya yeh zimmedari wali udhaar hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zimmedari wali udhaar hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ as saying: The hand which takes is responsible till it pays. Then al-Hasan forgot and said: (If you give something on loan to a man), he is your depositor ; there is no compensation (for it) on him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3561)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haath par woh cheez zimmedari hai jo usne li hai, jab tak woh use wapas na kar de." Phir Al-Hasan is hadith ko bhool gaye aur kehne lage: "Woh to tumhara amaanatdaar hai, uspar koi zimmedari nahi."

e: Al-Bara' had a she-camel which was accustomed to graze the standing crop belonging to the people. She entered a garden and did damage to it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was informed about it. So he gave decision that the owners of gardens are responsible for guarding them by day, and the owners of the animals are responsible for guarding them by night. Any damage done by animals during the night is a responsibility lying on their owners. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3570)
hi: Unke paas aik jangli-mizaaj oontni thi, jo aik baagh mein ghus gayi aur usme nuqsaan pahunchaaya, is baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) se baat ki gayi, "to aap (SAW) ne yeh faisla diya ke din mein baaghon ki hifaazat unke maalikon ki zimmedari hai, aur raat mein maweshiyon ki hifaazat unke maalikon ki zimmedari hai, aur jo nuqsaan maweshi (raat mein) pahunchaayen uske zimmedar unke maalik hain."

e: "We were with Abu 'Ubaidah bin 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud when two men who were involved in a transaction came to him. One of them said: 'I bought it for such and such', and the other said; 'I sold it to him for such and such,' Abu 'Ubaidah said" 'something like this was brought to Ibn Masud, and he said; I was with something like this was brought to him. He told the seller to swear an oath, them he gave the purchaser the choice; If he wished, he could buy it, and if he wished he could cancel (the transaction)'' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4649)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas is jaisi (soorat-e-haal) mein maujood tha, "to aap (SAW) ne hukum diya ke bechne wale se qasam li jaaye, phir khareedne wale ko ikhtiyar diya jaaye, agar woh chahe to le le aur agar chahe to chhod de."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  bought from an Arab man. I thought he said from the Banu 'Amir ibn Sa'sa'ah, a load of dates. When it was time to pay him, the Prophet ﷺ  said to him, "Choose." The Arab man said, "If I see anyone like you today, I will sell my life to him. Who are you?" The Prophet ﷺ  said, "I am from the Quraysh." Ibn Wahb narrated this from Ibn Jurayj, following the condition of Muslim.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik badu se - mera khayal hai unhone kaha Banu Aamir bin Sa'sa'ah mein se - khabat (jhaadi ke pattay) ka aik load khareeda, jab (soda) unpar wajib ho gaya to Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Chuno (ikhtiyar karo)." To badu ne kaha: "Agar aaj jaisa koi aur tumhare jaisa bechne wala dekhun, Allah tumhein umar de, tum kis (qabile) se ho?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quraish se." Isse Ibn Wahab ne, Ibn Jurayj se, mutaba'at ki hai. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "The Prophet, peace be upon him, purchased a camel from a Bedouin that had a defect. When the selling was due, the Prophet, peace be upon him, said to him, 'Choose.' So, the Bedouin said, 'May Allah bless your sale.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik badu se khabat (jhaadi ke pattay) ka aik load khareeda, jab soda wajib ho gaya to Nabi (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Chuno." To badu ne kaha: "Allah tumhein umar de, kitna achha bechne wala hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The taker and the giver are equal in interest."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sood mein lene wala aur dene wala dono barabar (gunahgar) hain."

e: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Dinar for Dinar, Dirham for Dirham, with no increase between them. Whoever has need of silver, let him trade gold for it, and whoever has need of gold, let him trade silver for it, and let the transaction be done on the spot."' (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2261)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dinar dinar ke badle, dirham dirham ke badle, dono ke darmiyan koi izaafa nahi, isliye jise chandi ki zaroorat ho woh use sone se badal le, aur jise sone ki zaroorat ho woh use chandi se badal le, aur badalna haath-dar-haath hona chahiye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Muslims are bound by their conditions, and reconciliation is permissible among them." This hadith is narrated by dwellers of Madinah and they did not exclude it. This is also an established principle in the book (the Quran). It is supported by a testimony from the hadith of Aisha and Anas ibn Malik, but it was not verified, and it is weakened by An-Nasa'i and other narrators.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman apni shartein poori karne ke paaband hain, aur Musalmanon ke darmiyan sulah jaayaz hai." Is hadith ke raawi Madinah ke hain, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur yeh is kitaab (fiqh) ki aik bunyaad hai, "aur iska shahid Aisha (RA) aur Anas bin Malik (RA) ki hadith mein bhi hai, jise sahih qaraar nahi diya gaya, aur An-Nasa'i ne isse kamzor qaraar diya, jabke doosron ne ise chalne diya."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "Muslims are with their conditions as long as it is in accordance with the truth."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman apni shartein poori karne ke paaband hain, jab tak woh haq ke mutabiq hon."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Every good deed is charity, and whatever a man spends on himself and his family is considered charity for him. Whatever a person saves from the things he possesses is considered charity for him. And whatever a believer spends from his wealth, Allah guarantees him reward for it, except for that which is spent on building or sin." So I asked Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir, "What does a person save from his possessions?" He replied, "Whatever he gives to a poet or a person who speaks well."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har achha kaam sadqa hai, aur jo aadmi apne aap aur apne ghar walon par kharch kare, uske liye woh sadqa likha jaata hai, aur jis cheez se aadmi apni izzat bachaaye, uske liye woh bhi sadqa likha jaata hai, aur momin jo kharch kare, agar uska badla Allah ke zimme ho, to Allah zaamin hai, siwaye is ke jo imaarat banaane ya gunah mein ho." Maine Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir se poocha: "Aadmi apni izzat kis cheez se bachaata hai?" Unhone kaha: "Jo woh kisi shaayar ya zabaan-daar (bad-zabaan) aadmi ko de (taake woh usse na kahe kuch bura), taake usse bachaaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever among you is capable of protecting his religion and honor with his wealth, then let him do so." Abu Asma Halik.
