hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se jo apne deen aur apni izzat ko apne maal se bachaa sake, use aisa karna chahiye." Abu Ismah halaak (kamzor/ghair-mo'tabar) hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Reconciliation between Muslims is permissible."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalmanon ke darmiyan sulah jaayaz hai."

e: We came to Abu Hurairah and asked him about a companion of ours who had become bankrupt. He said: “This is what the Prophet ﷺ ruled: 'Any man who dies or becomes bankrupt, the owner of the product has more right to it, if he finds the exact thing.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2360)
hi: Hum Abu Hurairah (RA) ke paas apne aik saathi ke baare mein aaye jo diwaaliya ho gaya tha, unhone kaha: "Yehi woh maamla hai jismein Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh faisla diya tha: 'Jo koi aadmi mar jaaye ya diwaaliya ho jaaye, to saaman ka maalik apne saaman ka zyada haqdaar hai agar use waise ka waisa paaye.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "One's belongings should not be seized while he is still indebted."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Girvi rakhi hui cheez (rehn) apne maalik se qabza karke rok nahi li jaati, uska faida uske maalik ka hai, aur uska nuqsaan bhi uspar hai."

e: [AI] Regarding Al-Zuhri, he mentioned it with a similar chain of narrations to it, on the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim, and they did not exclude it due to their disagreement with Al-Zuhri.
hi: Az-Zuhri se, unhone isi jaisi sanad ke sath zikr ki. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala, kyunke ulama ka Az-Zuhri par ikhtilaaf hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The pledge of a person should not be held as collateral for his own animals, and he is also not allowed to charge interest on it." It has been narrated that Ibn Abi Dhi'b, through Zuhri, through Sa'id and Abu Salama, through Abu Hurayrah, said this.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Girvi rakhi hui cheez apne maalik se rok nahi li jaati, uska faida uska hai, aur uska nuqsaan bhi uspar hai." Yeh Ibn Abi Dhi'b ki, Az-Zuhri se, unhone Sa'eed aur Abu Salamah se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The collateral cannot be taken and kept by the one who received it as collateral, and he must also pay the interest (fine)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Girvi rakhi hui cheez jisne girvi rakhi ho usi ki hai, aur uska nuqsaan bhi uspar hai."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "The pledge does not close until you have your item and its price is on you."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Girvi rakhi hui cheez rok nahi li jaati, balke uska faida tera hai aur uska nuqsaan bhi tujh par hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "His livestock should not be held as collateral for his debt, and he should not be burdened with interest."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Girvi rakhi hui cheez apne maalik se rok nahi li jaati, uska faida uska hai, aur uska nuqsaan bhi uspar hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The collateral is not withheld from you, and you bear the penalty."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Girvi rakhi hui cheez rok nahi li jaati, uska faida tera hai, aur uska nuqsaan bhi tujh par hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ having said: Allah, Most High, says: "I make a third with two partners as long as one of them does not cheat the other, but when he cheats him, I depart from them." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3383)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya, Allah farmata hai: "Main do saajhedaaron ke beech teesra hoon jab tak unme se koi apne saathi ke sath khiyanat na kare, jab woh khiyanat karta hai to main unke darmiyan se nikal jaata hoon."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Whoever gives a gift, he is more deserving of it as long as he has not taken anything from it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi tohfa de, woh uska zyada haqdaar hai jab tak uska badla na mil jaaye."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "When a gift is given to someone who is a close relative, it is not to be taken back."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab hadiya kisi mahram rishtedaar (jisse nikah haram ho) ko diya jaaye, to woh isse wapas nahi le sakta."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wanted to expel the Banu Nadir, they said, "O Messenger of Allah, you have ordered us to leave and we have debts to the people that have not yet been settled." He said, "Leave and hurry."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Banu An-Nadir ko (Madinah se) nikalne ka irada kiya, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne humein nikalne ka hukum diya hai, jabke logon par humara qarz baaqi hai jo abhi ada karne ka waqt nahi aaya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "(Kuch) chhod do aur jaldi (baaqi) le lo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Makkah is a sanctuary that cannot be sold or rented out, and its houses cannot be leased."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Makkah (sab ke liye) padaav ki jagah hai, iske ghar na beche jaate hain na kiraaye par diye jaate hain."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Makkah is sacred, and its inhabitants’ properties are sacred, and the rewards of performing good deeds in its houses are also sacred." It is confirmed in narrations that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah in a state of peace, so from there, Abdullah ibn Abi Ziyad became a slave of Allah.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Makkah haram (muqaddas) hai, iske gharon ka bechna haram hai, aur inka kiraaya lena bhi haram hai." Riwayaton se sahih sabit hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah mein sulah (aman) ke sath dakhil huay, aur unme se aik riwayat mein Ubaidullah bin Abi Ziyad hain, jo layyin (kamzor) hain.

e: [AI] That the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, when he set out to conquer Makkah, said to Abu Huraira, "Cheer for the Ansar." So he said, "O Ansar, respond to the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him." So they came as if they were on a meeting. Then he said, "Take this path, and no one should come near you except that you guarantee his safety." So the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, set out and Allah granted him victory. The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, then circumambulated the Kaaba and prayed two Rak'ahs, then he went out through the gate near Safa and climbed on Safa. He addressed the people while the Ansar were below him. The Ansar said to one another, "The man has been taken by mercy towards his people and his desire to return to his city." Allah sent revelation regarding what the Ansar said, and the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "O Ansar, you say that the man has been taken by mercy towards his people and his desire to return to his city." He said, "Who am I then? By Allah, I am certainly the slave of Allah and His messenger. The life of you is my life, and your death is my death." They said, "By Allah, O messenger of Allah, we did not say that except out of fear that they may attack us." He said, "You are truthful in the sight of Allah and His messenger." He said, "By Allah, there is none among them except that we have slaughtered them with tears." And this is from Sahih Bukhari.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah ki fatah ke liye rawaana huay, to unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se farmaya: "Ansar ko awaz do." To unhone kaha: "Aye Ansar ke giroh, Rasulullah (SAW) ki pukaar ka jawaab do," to woh aise aaye jaise koi pehle se muqarrar waqt tha. Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is raaste par chalo, aur jo bhi tumhare saamne aaye, use amaan do." To Rasulullah (SAW) rawaana huay aur Allah ne unhein Makkah par fatah di, Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ka'bah ka tawaaf kiya, do rak'atein padhi, phir Safa ki taraf wale darwaze se nikle aur Safa par chadhe, logon ko khutba di jabke Ansar unke neeche the. To Ansar mein se kuch ne aapas mein kaha: "Rahi baat is aadmi (Rasulullah SAW) ki, to unhein apni qaum ke liye nazm aur apni basti (Makkah) ki khwahish ne pakad liya." Allah ne wahi nazil ki us baat ke baare mein jo Ansar ne kahi thi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ansar ke giroh, tum keh rahe ho ke is aadmi (mujhe) apni qaum ke liye nazm aur apni basti ki khwahish ne pakad liya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Phir main kaun hoon? Hargiz nahi! Allah ki qasam, main Allah ka bandah aur uska sacha Rasool hoon, isliye meri zindagi tumhari zindagi hai, aur meri maut tumhari maut hai." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humne yeh sirf isliye kaha tha ke kahin tumhare khilaaf (kisi ko) dushmani na ho." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum Allah aur uske Rasool ke nazdeek sacche ho." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, unme se koi bhi aisa nahi bacha jiski gardan aansuo se tar na huyi ho."

e: [AI] On the day of the conquest of Mecca, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted security to all except for four men and two women. He said, "Kill them even if you find them clinging to the curtains of the Kaaba." The four men were Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl, Abdallah ibn Khatal, Maqis ibn Subabah, and Abdallah ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Sarh.
hi: Jab Makkah ki fatah ka din tha, Rasulullah (SAW) ne sab logon ko amaan di siwaye chaar aadmiyon aur do auraton ke, aur farmaya: "Inhein qatl kar do, chahe tum inhein Ka'bah ke pardon se lipta hua paao - Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl, Abdullah bin Khatal, Maqis bin Subabah, aur Abdullah bin Sa'd bin Abi Sarh."

e: [AI] He is called a thief, so I asked him, "What is this name?" He said, "It is a name given to me by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I will not abandon it." I asked him, "Why did he name you like that?" He said, "I came to the city and informed them that the slaves had sold me and consumed their wealth. So they brought me to the Prophet ﷺ and he said, 'You are a thief.' He sold me for four female camels and asked the wealthy people who bought me, 'What will you do with him?' They said, 'We will set him free.' He said, 'Then we are not more righteous than you in the Hereafter.' So they set me free among them, and my name remained."
hi: Use "Sarraq" (chor) kaha jaata tha, maine unse poocha: "Yeh naam kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh naam Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe diya hai, aur main ise kabhi nahi chhodunga." Maine poocha: "Unhone aapko yeh naam kyun diya?" Unhone kaha: "Main Madinah aaya aur unhein bataya ke mere maalikon ne mujhe becha tha aur maine unka maal barbaad kar diya tha, to woh mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke paas le aaye, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum sarraq (chor) ho,' aur mujhe chaar oonton mein bech diya, phir un qarzdaaron se jinhone mujhe khareeda tha poocha: 'Tum iska kya karoge?' Unhone kaha: 'Hum ise azaad kar dengay.' Unhone kaha: 'To hum bhi aakhirat ke maamle mein tumse kam nahi,' to unhone mujhe aapas mein (mil kar) azaad kar diya, aur mera naam wahi reh gaya."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  received some captured prisoners, and he instructed me to sell two of them. So I sold them and separated them from each other. Then I went to the Prophet ﷺ  and informed him, and he said, "Find them and bring them back, and sell them together, and do not separate them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas kuch qaidi aaye, unhone mujhe do bhaiyon ko bechne ka hukum diya, to maine unhein bech diya aur unke darmiyan judaai daal di, phir main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein bataya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein dhoondo aur wapas le aao, aur unhein sath mein becho, unke darmiyan judaai mat daalo."

e: [AI] "He sold a female slave and her child, and separated between them, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prohibited him from doing so." This is another narration with an authentic chain of narration.
hi: "Unhone aik laundi aur uske bachche ko becha aur unke darmiyan judaai daal di, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein isse mana kiya." Yeh doosra matan hai, sahih sanad ke sath. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Cursed is the one who causes division." This is a authentic narration and they did not mention its narrator. Its explanation is mentioned in the hadith of Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari, which is authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mal'oon hai woh jo (maa-bachche ko) judaa kare." Yeh sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur iski tafseer Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari (RA) ki hadith mein hai, jo sahih hai.

e: "I narrated heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'Whoever seperates a mother from her child, Allah seperates him and his most beloved on the Day of Judgement.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1283)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi maa ko uske bachche se judaa kare, Allah Qayamat ke din usse aur uske mehboobon se judaa kar dega."

e: [AI] He heard Ubada ibn as-Samit saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade separating a mother from her child. It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, until when?" He said: "Until the boy reaches puberty and the girl attains menstruation."
hi: Unhone Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne maa ko uske bachche se judaa karne se mana kiya." To poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kab tak?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tak ladka baaligh na ho jaaye aur ladki haiz shuru na kare."

e: [AI] "He said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prohibited the sale of spoils of war until they are distributed, and he prohibited the trampling of women slaves until they have been determined of what is in their bellies, and he said, 'Do not irrigate the crops of others,' and he prohibited the consumption of the meat of domestic donkeys, and the meat of every predatory animal with fangs."
hi: Ke unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khaybar ke din maal-e-ghaneemat ko taqseem hone se pehle bechne se mana kiya, aur haamila qaidiyon se sambhog karne se mana kiya jab tak woh apne pait ka bachcha na jan de, aur farmaya: "Kisi doosre ki khaiti ko mat seencho," aur ghar palu gadhon ka gosht khane se, aur har naab-daar darinde ke gosht khane se mana kiya.

e: That Allah's Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever has a partner in an orchard, then he is not to sell his share of that until he proposes that to his partner." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1312)
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiska kisi baagh mein shareek ho, use apna hissa tab tak nahi bechna chahiye jab tak woh use apne shareek ko pesh na kare." Sahih.

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah loves tolerance in selling, tolerance in buying, and tolerance in repaying." He said: There is something on this topic from Jabir. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1319)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah aasaan bechne wale, aasaan khareedne wale, aur aasaan qarz ada karne wale ko pasand karta hai."

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you see someone selling or buying in the Masjid then say: 'May Allah not profit your business.' And when you see someone announcing about something lost then say: 'May Allah not return it to you.'" The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Gharib. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. They dislike selling and buying in the Masjid. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge permitted selling and buying in the Masjid. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1321)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum kisi ko masjid mein bechte ya khareedte dekho, to kaho: 'Allah tumhari tijarat mein munafa na de,' aur jab tum kisi ko masjid mein apni gum-shuda cheez dhoondte dekho, to kaho: 'Allah tumhein woh wapas na kare.'"

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him to equip an army, but the camels were insufficient. So he commanded him to keep back the young camels of sadaqah, and he was taking a camel to be replaced by two when the camels of sadaqah came. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3357)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein aik lashkar taiyyar karne ka hukum diya, oont kam pad gaye, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main sadqe ke jawaan oonton mein se lun, to main aik oont badle mein do (baad mein) leta."

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited ˹doing˺ "sadal" (wrapping garments around oneself and having arms tucked inside during prayer). (Using translation from Aḥmad 8582)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "jaanwaron mein salaf (pehle se ada kiya hua soda) karne se mana kiya."

e: [AI] That the Prophet ﷺ  forbade selling sick animals with sick animals.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "udhaar ko udhaar ke badle bechne se mana kiya."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , he forbade the exchange of harmful things with harmful things.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne "udhaar ko udhaar ke badle bechne se mana kiya, ya'ni ada karne ki muddat ko ada karne ki muddat ke badle." Zuhaib kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "The messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited quarreling, arguing, and turning away." Professor Abu Al-Walid said that nothing from it should be sold until it turns red or yellow."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Muhaqalah (khadi fasal ka anaaj ke badle sauda), Mukhadarah (kacche phal ka sauda), aur Munabadhah (phenk kar sauda) se mana kiya." Ustad Abu Al-Waleed ne kaha: "Mukhadarah yeh hai ke koi cheez tab tak na bechi jaaye jab tak woh surkh ya zard na ho jaaye."

e: “Whoever harms others, Allah (SWT) will harm him; and whoever causes hardship to other Allah will cause hardship to him.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2342)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Na khud nuqsaan pahunchaao aur na (badle mein) nuqsaan pahunchaao, jo nuqsaan pahunchaaye Allah use nuqsaan pahunchaayega, aur jo sakhti kare Allah uspar sakhti karega."

e: [AI] "A man died, so we washed him, shrouded him, perfumed him, and placed him before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , where the deceased are placed near the station of Gabriel. Then we sought permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to offer the funeral prayer for him. He joined us, taking steps with us, and then he said: 'Is your companion in debt?' They replied: 'Yes, two dinars.' So he fell behind and a man among us, known as Abu Qatadah, said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I will take care of it.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'They are upon you and in your possession, and the deceased is absolved of them.' He prayed for him and when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  met Abu Qatadah, he would say: 'What have you done with the two dinars?' This continued until the last time, and Abu Qatadah said: 'I have settled them, O Messenger of Allah.' He ﷺ  said: 'Now, when his skin has cooled down.'"
hi: Aik shakhs ka inteqaal ho gaya, humne unhein ghusl diya, kafan pehnaaya, khushbu lagaayi, aur unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye wahin rakha jahan janaaze Jibra'il (AS) ke maqaam ke paas rakhe jaate the, phir humne Rasulullah (SAW) ko unki namaz-e-janaza ke liye ijaazat li. Aap (SAW) humare sath kuch qadam chale, phir farmaya: "Shayad tumhare saathi par koi qarz hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, do dinar." To aap (SAW) peechhe ho gaye, humme se aik shakhs jise Abu Qatadah (RA) kaha jaata tha, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh do dinar mujhpar hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) kehne lage: "Woh tujhpar hain aur tere maal mein se hain, aur mayyat unse baree hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To aap (SAW) ne unki namaz padhi. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) jab bhi Abu Qatadah (RA) se milte to poochte: "Un do dinaron ka kya bana?" Yahan tak ke aakhir mein unhone kaha: "Maine woh ada kar diye hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ab, is waqt uski jild thandi hui hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "A pledge is both taken and given." Al-A'mash said, "I mentioned this to Ibrahim, but he disliked benefiting from it." This is a reliable narration according to the condition of the two sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), and it was not rejected by Ath-Thawri and Shu'bah. I affirm its authenticity in accepting the increase of trust according to the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Girvi rakha hua jaanwar doodh bhi diya jaata hai aur sawaari ke kaam bhi aata hai (uske kharche ke badle)." Al-A'mash ne kaha: to maine yeh baat Ibrahim ko bataayi, to unhone ismein se kisi cheez ka faida uthaana napasand kiya. Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, kyunke Ath-Thawri aur Shu'bah ka ittifaq hai ke yeh Al-A'mash tak mauqoof (rukti) hai, aur main apne is usool par qaayam hoon jo maine thiqa raawi ki ziyaadti qubool karne mein banaaya hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ cursed the one who withholds his wealth from Mu'adh and sells it for a debt against him.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Muadh (RA) ke maal par pabandi lagaayi aur unpar jo qarz tha uski wajah se use bech diya."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ considered the following individuals to be the least significant on the Day of Uhud: Zaid bin Harithah, Bara bin Azib, Zaid bin Arqam, Saad, Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri, Abdullah bin Umar, and Jabir bin Abdullah.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Uhud ke din kuch logon ko kam-umar samajh kar (jung se) rok diya tha, unme se Zaid bin Harithah (RA) - ya'ni khud raawi - aur Al-Bara' bin Azib (RA), Zaid bin Arqam (RA), Sa'd (RA), Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA), Abdullah bin Umar (RA) the, aur Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ka bhi zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The pen has been lifted from three: the child until he reaches puberty, the insane person until he regains his sanity, and the sleeper until he wakes up."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qalam teen logon se uthaa liya gaya hai: bachche se jab tak woh baaligh na ho jaaye, paagal se jab tak use hosh na aa jaaye, aur sone wale se jab tak woh jaag na jaaye."

e: [AI] And he said to Umar, "O Commander of the believers, did you order the stoning of this person?" Umar replied, "Yes." He said, "Don't you remember that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'The pen has been lifted from three: the insane person until he comes to his senses, the sleeper until he wakes up, and the child until he reaches puberty.'" Umar said, "You are correct," and he decided not to carry out the punishment. Abu Abdullah said, "Regarding stoning the insane man or woman, there is a difference of opinion among the scholars that I am not knowledgeable about."
hi: Aur unhone Umar (RA) se kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aapne is (aurat) ko sang-saar karne ka hukum diya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Kya aapko yaad nahi ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: 'Qalam teen logon se uthaa liya gaya hai: paagal se jiska aqal par qaboo na ho, sone wale se jab tak woh jaag na jaaye, aur bachche se jab tak woh baaligh na ho jaaye'?" Unhone kaha: "Tumne sach kaha," aur unhein chhod diya. Abu Abdullah (Al-Hakim) ne kaha: "Paagal mard aur aurat par pabandi lagaane ke baare mein, mujhe ulama ke darmiyan koi ikhtilaaf maloom nahi."

e: "This Verse 'And making peace is better.' was revealed concerning a man who had been married to a woman for a long time, and she had given birth to his children and he wanted to exchange her (for a new wife). She agreed that he would stay with her (the new wife) and would not give her (the first wife) a share of his time. (i.e.) not spend the nights with her)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1974)
hi: Yeh ayat "{Aur sulah behtar hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 128) aik aise aadmi ke baare mein nazil hui jiske nikah mein aik aurat thi jiski sohbat lambi ho chuki thi aur usse bachche bhi paida huay the, woh usse badalna chahta tha, to usne (aurat ne) usse raazi kar liya ke woh uske paas rahegi lekin woh uske liye (raaton ki) taqseem na kare.

e: [AI] That Sauda (the Prophet's wife) made her day for Aisha, and I suppose that this verse was revealed concerning her: "And if a woman fears from her husband contempt or evasion." [Quran 4:128]
hi: Ke Saudah (RA) ne apna din Aisha (RA) ko de diya, aur mera khayal hai ke isi baare mein yeh nazil hui: "{Aur agar kisi aurat ko apne shohar se bad-sulooki ya bezaari ka darr ho}" (Surah An-Nisa 128).

e: [AI] "The truce between the Prophet ﷺ and the people of Makkah in Hudaybiyah lasted for four years."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) aur Makkah walon ke darmiyan Hudaybiyyah mein sulah chaar saal ke liye thi."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "I am the leader and the leader is the protector for those who believe in me, embrace Islam, and migrate for the sake of a house in the gardens of Paradise."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Main zaamin hoon, aur zaamin zimmedari uthaane wala hota hai, us shakhs ke liye jo mujhpar imaan laaye, Islam qubool kare, aur hijrat kare - Jannat ke kinaare mein aik ghar (ka wada)."

e: [AI] My mother lost her father and came to the city, and the people proposed to her. She said, "I will not marry except to a man who takes care of this orphan for me." So a man from the Ansar married her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to present the young men of the Ansar every year, and he would marry off those who reached the age of marriage. So I was presented one year, and a young man married me, and then divorced me. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, you have married me off, and he divorced me." He said, "Marry him." So I married him, and I prevailed over him.
hi: Meri walida bewa ho gayi thin aur Madinah aayi thin, logon ne unhein shaadi ka payaam diya, unhone kaha: "Main sirf us aadmi se shaadi karungi jo mere is yateem ki zimmedari le." To Ansar mein se aik shakhs ne unse shaadi kar li. Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) Ansar ke ladkon ko har saal (jang ke liye) pesh karte the, aur jo baaligh ho chuka hota use shaamil kar lete. Unhone kaha: to mujhe aik saal pesh kiya gaya, aap (SAW) ne aik doosre ladke ko shaamil kar liya aur mujhe wapas kar diya, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne usse shaamil kiya aur mujhe wapas kar diya, jabke agar main usse kushti larta to main use zameen par pataq deta." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To usse kushti lado." To maine usse kushti ladi aur use zameen par pataq diya, to aap (SAW) ne mujhe shaamil kar liya.

e: [AI] He was the Prophet's partner in trade at the beginning of Islam. When the day of victory came, he said, "Welcome to my brother and partner, who does not deceive or disappoint." And he mentioned the rest of the speech.
hi: Ke woh Islam ke ibtida'i daur mein Nabi (SAW) ke tijarat mein shareek the, jab fatah ka din aaya to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khushamdeed mere bhai aur mere shareek ko, jo na dhoka deta tha aur na jhagda karta tha," aur baaqi hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] Translation: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, protected Al-Baqi' and said, "There is no sanctity except for Allah and His Messenger." They both agreed on the hadith of Yunus from Az-Zuhri through its chain of narrators: "There is no sanctity except for Allah and His Messenger." They did not exclude it from it, and it is authentic in its chain of narration according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim. And they narrated it until its end.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Al-Baqi' ko hima (mahfooz zameen) qaraar diya aur farmaya: "Koi hima (mahfooz zameen banaana) nahi siwaye Allah aur uske Rasool ke." Dono ne Yunus ki, Az-Zuhri se, unki sanad ke sath, "Koi hima nahi siwaye Allah aur uske Rasool ke" ittifaq kiya hai, magar dono ne ise is tarah nahi nikala, jabke iski sanad sahih hai.

e: the Messenger of Allah forbade selling water. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4660)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne paani bechne se mana kiya."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  forbade the sale of water rights.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne faaltu paani bechne se mana kiya."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The sharing of a well does not prevent drinking from it." Abdur-Rahman said, "I heard my father saying that sharing means a well owned by multiple people where the water is distributed among them, and everyone benefits from it without preventing others from their fair share."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai: "Kuwein ke faaltu paani ko rokna jaayaz nahi, aur yehi 'Ar-Rahw' hai." Abdur Rahman ne kaha: maine apne waalid ko kehte suna: "Ar-Rahw yeh hai ke kuwan shareekon ke darmiyan ho jismein paani ho, aur kisi aadmi ko usme se faaltu hissa mile, to woh apne shareek ko (uske hisse se) na roke."

e: [AI] The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said, "It is decreed for one steeped in sin and transgression that the Most High sends calamities upon him and restrains his provisions like the distance of two heels."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "Mahzur aur Mudhainib ke seelaabi paani ke baare mein yeh faisla diya ke oopar wale (khet wala) neeche wale ki taraf paani chhode, aur ispar itna hi rok sakta hai jitna do takhno tak (paani thehre)."

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "Whoever receives a good deed about his brother without asking for it or supervising himself, he should accept it and not reject it. Indeed, it is a provision that Allah has bestowed upon him."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jise apne bhai se koi bhalaai pahunche bagair maange aur bagair khwahish kiye, use woh qubool kar leni chahiye aur usse thukraana nahi chahiye, kyunke yeh sirf woh rizq hai jo Allah ne uski taraf bheja hai."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given sentence is:

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do not persist in asking for something, for by Allah, nobody asks me for anything and I give it to him from myself, even though I dislike it, but he will be blessed in what I give him."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maangne mein hadd se zyada israar mat karo, Allah ki qasam, tum mein se koi bhi mujhse kuch nahi maangta jo mujhe maangne par majboor kare aur main use woh de doon jabke main napasand karta hoon, magar jo main use deta hoon usme uske liye barkat daali jaati hai."

e: [AI] A man gifted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with a female camel, and in return, the Messenger rewarded him with six young camels. However, the man became angry and said, "O Messenger of Allah, who will excuse me from this camel? It was as if I saw her in the face of one of her people, so I stood firm and refused to accept any gift except from a Qurayshi, an Ansari, a Thaqafi, or a Dausi."
hi: Aik shakhs ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko aik doodh wali oontni tohfe mein di, to aap (SAW) ne usse badle mein chhah (6) jawaan oont diye, magar woh shakhs isse naraaz ho gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaun mujhe fulan (shakhs) se maazrat dilaayega? Usne mujhe aik oontni tohfe mein di, aur mujhe aisa lag raha hai jaise (uska lalach) uske kisi ghar wale ke chehre mein dekh raha hoon, to maine usse badle mein chhah jawaan oont diye, phir bhi woh naraaz ho gaya. Maine iraada kar liya hai ke ab main koi tohfa qubool nahi karunga siwaye is ke ke woh kisi Quraishi, Ansari, Thaqafi, ya Dausi se ho."

e: [AI] My family sent me with a gift of milk to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When I presented it to him, he told me, "Milk it and leave the one who calls for the milk." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Mere ghar walon ne mujhe aik doodh wali oontni ke sath Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas bheja jo unhone unhein tohfe mein di thi, to aap (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Isse doodh nikaalo, aur doodh bulaane wale (bachhda) ko chhod do." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu narrated to me that Umm Khalid bint Khalid said, "The Prophet ﷺ  was brought garments with a small black shirt in them. He asked, 'Who would dress this?' The people remained silent, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Bring Umm Khalid to me.' She was then brought to him, and he dressed me with it using his own hands while saying, 'Adorn yourself and be beautiful.' He said this twice while looking at a mark on the shirt that had yellow and red colors, and he said, 'O Umm Khalid, this is good fortune in the tongue of Abyssinia.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas kuch kapde laaye gaye jinme aik chhoti kaali khamisah (chaadar) thi, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhara khayal hai main yeh kise pehnaaun?" Log khamosh rahe, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Umm Khalid ko mere paas lao." Unhone kaha: to mujhe laaya gaya, aap (SAW) ne apne haath se mujhe woh pehnaayi aur farmaya: "Ise purana kar do aur ghisa do," yeh do martaba kaha, aur aap (SAW) khamisah mein maujood aik zard aur surkh nishaan ki taraf dekhne lage aur kehne lage: "Aye Umm Khalid, yeh 'sana' hai, 'sana'," aur "sana" Habsha ki zubaan mein "achha/khoobsurat" ke ma'ne mein hai.

e: The Immigrants (Muhajirun) said: Messenger of Allah! the Helpers (Ansar) got the entire reward. He said: no, so long as you pray to Allah for them and praise them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4812)
hi: Ke Muhajireen ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Ansar sara ajr le gaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, jab tak tum Allah se unke liye dua karte raho aur unki tareef karte raho."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever seeks refuge with (the name of) Allah, grant him refuge; whoever asks of you in (the name of) Allah, give him; whoever seeks protection with (the name of Allah, give him protection. Whoever does you a favor, then reciprocate, and if you cannot, then supplicate for him until you think that you have repaid him."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2567)
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tumse Allah ke naam par maange use do, jo Allah ke naam par tumse panah maange use panah do, jo tumhare sath koi bhalaai kare uska badla do, aur agar tumhein badla dene ke liye kuch na mile to uske liye dua karo yahan tak ke tumhein yaqeen ho jaaye ke tumne uska badla ada kar diya hai, aur jo Allah ke naam par tumse hifaazat maange use hifaazat do."

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet (SAW) with a donkey while he was walking. The Prophet (SAW) said, "Ride on it O Messenger of Allah." The man replied, "The owner of the animal has more right to ride on its back, unless you give it to me." The Prophet (SAW) said, "I have given it to you."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas gadha lekar aaya jabke aap (SAW) paidal chal rahe the, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), sawaar ho jaayein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jaanwar ka maalik uski peeth par sawaari ka zyada haqdaar hai, siwaye is ke ke tum ise mere liye (khaas) kar do." Usne kaha: "Maine aisa hi kar diya."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic text is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever gives shelter to a lost person, he himself remains lost until he shows them the way (i.e., helps them find their way)." This narration has an authentic chain of narrators, and it has not been included in Sahih Bukhari.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi gum-shuda jaanwar apne paas rakh le, woh khud gum-raah hai jab tak woh uska ailaan na kare." Sanad sahih, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about lost and found items. He said, 'They should be announced and not concealed or kept hidden. If the rightful owner comes forward, it should be returned to him, otherwise, it belongs to Allah and He gives it to whom He wills.'"
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) se gum-shuda cheez (luqata) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uska ailaan kiya jaaye, na usse chhupaaya jaaye na dhaanpa jaaye, agar uska maalik aa jaaye (to use de do), warna woh Allah ka maal hai jise woh jise chahe ata karta hai."

e: 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Uthman al-Taimi reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade taking into custody the stray thing of the pilgrims. (Using translation from Muslim 1724)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "haajiyon ki gum-shuda cheez uthaane se mana kiya."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said about a treasure found by a man, 'If you find it in an inhabited town or on a well-known path, then announce it. But if you find it in a ruined village or in an uninhabited area or on a path less traveled, then it belongs to you along with one fifth of its value.' I have extensively mentioned the evidence in this book for the correct narrations of 'Amr ibn Shuayb, if the narrator is trustworthy and no better narrations are attributed to him. I have sought clear evidence in hearing from Shuayb ibn Muhammad from 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr, yet I have not found it until now."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik aadmi ke paaye huay khazane ke baare mein farmaya: "Agar tumne ise kisi aabaad basti mein ya chalte hue raaste mein paaya hai, to iska ailaan karo, aur agar tumne ise kisi jaahiliyat ke khandar mein ya kisi ghair-aabaad basti mein ya ghair-chalte raaste mein paaya hai, to ismein aur rikaaz (dabe khazane) mein khums (paanchwan hissa) wajib hai." Maine is kitaab mein Amr bin Shu'aib ki riwayaton ko sahih saabit karne ke liye bohot saari daleelein di hain jab raawi unse sunne wala thiqa ho, aur inse behtareen koi riwayat unke baare mein zikr nahi ki jaati, aur main Shu'aib bin Muhammad ke apne dada Abdullah bin Amr se sunne ki zaahiri daleel dhoondh raha tha, lekin abhi tak main isse nahi pahunch saka.

e:
[AI] A man came to Abdullah b. Amr, asking him about a muhrim who had intercourse with his wife. He pointed to Abdullah b. Umar and said, “Go to that one and ask him.” Shuayb said: The man did not recognize him, so I went with him, and he asked Ibn Umar. He said, “Your Hajj is invalid.” The man said, “So what should I do?” He said, “Enter ihram with the people, do what they do, and when you reach the coming year, perform Hajj and offer a sacrificial animal.” He then returned to Abdullah b. Amr while I was with him, and he said, “Go to Ibn Abbas and ask him.” Shuayb said: So I went with him to Ibn Abbas, and he asked him, and he said to him the same as Ibn Umar had said. He returned to Abdullah b. Amr while I was with him and informed him of what Ibn Abbas had said. Then he said, “What do you say?” He replied, “My view is like what the two of them said.”

This is a hadith of trustworthy narrators; its transmitters are memorizers. It is as if it takes one by the hand in establishing the soundness of Shuayb b. Muhammad’s hearing from his grandfather Abdullah b. Amr. This is the end of what my independent effort has led me to add in the Book of Sale beyond what the two imams, Abu Abdullah al-Bukhari and Abu al-Husayn al-Qushayri, compiled. Within this book I have mentioned books for which al-Bukhari set chapter headings at the end of the Book of Sales, among them: the Book of Salam, the Book of Pre-emption, the Book of Leasing, the Book of Transfer of Debt, the Book of Cultivation, the Book of Sharecropping, the Book of Irrigation Partnerships, the Book of Grants, the Book of Gifts, the Book of Qirad, the Book of Lost Property, the Book of Wrongs, the Book of Refraining from Begging, the Book of Pledge, the Book of Partnership, the Book of Manumission, the Book of the Mukatab, the Book of Testimonies, the Book of Settlement, the Book of Conditions, the Book of Bequests, and the Book of Endowment. I have only explained them at the end of this book so that no one might suppose that I left the Book of Sales devoid of these books. Allah is the Helper in what I establish through tracing the reports of the two imams, and He is sufficient for me and the best disposer of affairs.[^1]
hi: Aik shakhs Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ke paas aaya aur unse aik muhrim (ihraam mein) ke baare mein poocha jisne kisi aurat se sambhog kiya tha, to unhone Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: "Unke paas jao aur unse poocho." Shu'aib ne kaha: to woh shakhs unhein pehchaanta nahi tha, main unke sath gaya, unhone Ibn Umar (RA) se poocha, unhone kaha: "Tumhara Hajj baatil ho gaya." Us shakhs ne poocha: "To main kya karoon?" Unhone kaha: "Logon ke sath ihraam mein raho aur woh sab karo jo woh karte hain, aur jab agla saal aaye to Hajj karo aur qurbani do." To woh Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ke paas wapas aaya aur main uske sath tha, unhone kaha: "Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas jao aur unse poocho." Shu'aib ne kaha: to main uske sath Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas gaya, usne unse poocha, to unhone bhi wahi kaha jo Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha tha. To woh Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ke paas wapas aaya aur main uske sath tha, usne unhein bataya jo Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha tha, phir unhone poocha: "Tum kya kehte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Wahi kaho jo un dono ne kaha." Yeh hadith thiqa aur hafiz raawiyon ki hai, aur yeh Shu'aib bin Muhammad ke apne dada Abdullah bin Amr se sunne ki sehat ko haath se pakadne jaisa hai. Yeh mera aakhri ijtihaad hai jo maine Kitaab-ul-Bay' (khareed-o-farokht) mein imaam Abu Abdullah Al-Bukhari aur Abu Al-Husain Al-Qushairi (Muslim) ke nikaale huay se ziyaada is kitaab mein daakhil kiya hai. Maine is kitaab ke andar unhi kitaabon ka zikr kiya hai jinke unwaan Bukhari ne Kitaab-ul-Buyu' ke aakhir mein diye hain, unme se: Kitaab-us-Salam, Kitaab-ush-Shufa'ah, Kitaab-ul-Ijaarah, Kitaab-ul-Hawaalah, Kitaab-ul-Harth, Kitaab-ul-Muzaara'ah, Kitaab-ul-Musaqaat, Kitaab-ul-Ataaya, Kitaab-ul-Hibaat, Kitaab-ul-Qiraad, Kitaab-ul-Luqatah, Kitaab-ul-Mazaalim, Kitaab-ut-Ta'affuf anil-Mas'alah, Kitaab-ur-Rehn, Kitaab-ush-Shirkah, Kitaab-ul-Itq, Kitaab-ul-Mukaatab, Kitaab-ush-Shahaadaat, Kitaab-us-Sulh, Kitaab-ush-Shurut, Kitaab-ul-Wasaaya, aur Kitaab-ul-Waqf. Maine inhein is kitaab ke aakhir mein isliye samjhaya taake koi yeh gumaan na kare ke maine Kitaab-ul-Buyu' ko in kitaabon se khaali chhod diya hai, aur Allah hi madadgaar hai us kaam mein jiski buniyaad main un dono imamon ke asaar ki pairavi mein rakhta hoon, aur woh hi mere liye kaafi hai aur behtareen kaargusaar hai.

e: [AI] I heard 'Amr ibn Al-'Aas say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent for me, so I went to him. He commanded me to take my clothes and weapons with me and come to him." He said, "So I did that, and I went to him while he was performing ablution. He extended his gaze towards me, then lowered his eyes, and said, 'O 'Amr, I want to send you on an expedition, and Allah will enrich you and grant you security. I also desire a good reward for you from the spoils of war.'" He said, "So I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have not embraced Islam for the sake of wealth, but I have embraced Islam to be with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He said, "O 'Amr, indeed, wealth is good for a righteous man."
hi: Maine Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bulaawa bheja, main unke paas gaya, to aap (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main apne kapde aur hathiyaar le kar unke paas aaun. Unhone kaha: to maine aisa kiya, phir main unke paas aaya jabke woh wudu kar rahe the, unhone meri taraf nazar uthaayi phir neechi ki, phir farmaya: "Aye Amr, main tumhein aik lashkar ka sardaar banaakar bhejna chahta hoon, taake Allah tumhein maal-e-ghaneemat de aur tumhein salaamati de, aur main tumhare liye maal mein se aik achhi khwahish rakhta hoon." Unhone kaha: to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main maal ki khwahish mein Musalman nahi hua, balke main Islam ki khwahish mein aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath rehne ke liye Musalman hua." To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Amr, kitna achha hai neek maal neek aadmi ke liye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out to them with the trace of washing on him and he had a pleasant fragrance. So, we thought that he had an intimate relationship with his wives, and we said, "O Messenger of Allah, we see you have woken up with a pleasant fragrance." He said, "Indeed, thanks to Allah." Then, he mentioned wealth and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no harm in wealth for those who are righteous, and good health for those who are righteous is better than wealth, and a pleasant soul is better than all the blessings."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas nikle jabke unpar ghusl ke asaar the aur woh khush-mizaaj the, humne khayal kiya ke woh apne ghar walon ke paas gaye the, humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum dekh rahe hain aap subah khush-mizaaj hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, aur Alhamdulillah." Phir maal-daari ka zikr aaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maal-daari mein koi harj nahi jo taqwa waale ke liye ho, aur sehat jo taqwa waale ke liye ho, maal-daari se behtar hai, aur khush-mizaaji ne'maton mein se hai."

e: [AI] That Hakim ibn Hizam was jealous of two horses on the day of Khaybar, and they were injured. So he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "My horses were injured, O Messenger of Allah." So he gave him, then he asked for more and he gave him more, and then he asked for more and he gave him more. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Hakim, indeed this wealth is green and sweet, and whoever asks people, they will give him. And the one who asks from it is like one who eats and is never satisfied."
hi: Ke Hakim bin Hizam (RA) ke do ghode Khaybar ke din chadhaai mein maare gaye, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere dono ghode maare gaye hain." To aap (SAW) ne unhein ata kiya, phir unhone zyada maanga to aap (SAW) ne zyada de diya, phir unhone zyada maanga, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Hakim, beshak yeh maal sabz aur meetha hai, aur jo log se maange, use diya jaata hai, magar isme maangne wala us khaane wale jaisa hai jo kabhi nahi bharta."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Seek the beauty in pursuit of the world, for indeed every person is facilitated for what has been written for them from it."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Duniya ki talaash mein narmi aur miyaanaravi ikhtiyar karo, kyunke har shakhs ke liye jo usko muqaddar mein likh diya gaya hai woh aasaan kar diya gaya hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not be lazy in seeking sustenance, for a servant will not die until he reaches his last provision that is meant for him. So, excel in seeking lawful earnings and abstaining from the forbidden."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rizq mein dair mat samjho, kyunke koi bandah nahi marta jab tak woh apna aakhri muqaddar rizq na paa le, isliye talaash mein narmi aur miyaanaravi ikhtiyar karo, halal lo aur haram chhodo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Indeed, none of you will die until he completes his provision, so do not be hasty in seeking sustenance, and fear Allah, O people, and be excellent in your pursuit. Take what is permissible and leave what is forbidden." He also has a witness from Ibn Mas'ud with additional words following the conditions stated in Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi nahi marta jab tak woh apna rizq mukammal na kar le, isliye rizq mein dair mat samjho, aur Allah se daro, Aye logo, aur talaash mein narmi aur miyaanaravi ikhtiyar karo, jo halal hai use lo aur jo haram hai use chhodo." Iska aik shahid Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ki hadith mein bhi hai, kuch izaafi alfaaz ke sath. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no action that brings one closer to Paradise except that I have commanded you to do it, and there is no action that brings one closer to the Fire except that I have prohibited you from it. None of you should be hasty in seeking provisions, for Gabriel ﷺ  has impressed upon me that none of you will leave this world until he has completed his provision. So fear Allah, O people, and strive in seeking provisions. If any of you is delayed in receiving his provision, he should not seek it through disobedience to Allah, for verily Allah's favor cannot be obtained through disobedience."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi aisa amal nahi jo Jannat ke qareeb karta ho magar maine tumhein uska hukum diya hai, aur koi aisa amal nahi jo Jahannam ke qareeb karta ho magar maine tumhein usse mana kiya hai. Tum mein se koi apna rizq der se aata hua na samjhe, kyunke Jibra'il (AS) ne mere dil mein daala hai ke tum mein se koi bhi duniya se tab tak nahi jaayega jab tak woh apna rizq mukammal na kar le, isliye Allah se daro, Aye logo, aur talaash mein narmi aur miyaanaravi ikhtiyar karo, aur agar tum mein se kisi ka rizq der se aaye, to woh use Allah ki na-farmani se na dhoonde, kyunke Allah ka fazal na-farmani se haasil nahi hota."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The one who acquires wealth unlawfully or without its due right should not be envied. If they give charity, it will not be accepted from them and whatever remains will only increase their punishment in the Hellfire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh jo apni halaal se hatkar - ya kaha: apne haq se hatkar - maal jama karta hai, uspar rashk na karo, kyunke agar woh sadqa kare to woh qubool nahi hoga, aur jo baaqi bache woh uske liye Jahannam mein izafa banega."

e: "At the time of the Messenger of Allah we used to be called Samasir (brokers). The Messenger of Allah came to us when we were selling and called us by a name that was better than that. He said: 'O merchants (Tujjar), this selling involves lies and (false) oaths, so mix some charity with it.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3797)
hi: Hum aik qaum thay jinhein Samasira (dalaal) kaha jaata tha, aur hum Al-Baqi' mein bechte the, to Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas aaye aur humein humare naam se behtar naam diya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye tujjaar ke giroh, is khareed-o-farokht mein jhoot aur qasmein shaamil hoti hain, isliye ise sadqe se mila do."

e: “A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: ‘I intend to undertake a journey, so give me provision. He said: ‘May Allah grant you Taqwa as your provision (Zawwadak Allāhut-taqwā).’ He said: ‘Give me more.’ He said: ‘And may He forgive your sin (Wa ghafara dhanbak).’ He said: ‘Give me more, may my father be ransomed for you, and my mother.’ He said: ‘And may He make goodness easy for you wherever you are (Wa yassara lakal-khaira ḥaithu mā kunt).’” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3444)
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main safar karna chahta hoon, mujhe zaad-e-raah dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah tumhein taqwa ka zaad-e-raah de." Usne kaha: "Aur zyada dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur tumhare gunah maaf kare." Usne kaha: "Aur zyada dein, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur jahan bhi tum ho, tumhare liye bhalaai aasaan kare." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: When the Prophet ﷺ wanted to say farewell to an army, he would say: I entrust to Allah your religion, what you are responsible for, and your final deeds. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2601)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab kisi lashkar ko rukhsat karte to farmate: "Main tumhara deen, tumhari amaanat, aur tumhare aamaal ka anjaam Allah ke supurd karta hoon."

e: “For me to hive a good send-off to a warrior who is going to fight in the cause of Allah, and to guard his goods when he goes out in the morning or evening, is dearer to me than this world and everything in it.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2824)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main kisi mujahid ko Allah ki raah mein rukhsat karoon, aur subah ya shaam uski sawaari ki dekh-bhaal karoon, to yeh mujhe duniya aur jo kuch usme hai usse zyada mahboob hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ walked with them to the Baqi' al-Gharqad when he directed them, then he said, "Set forth in the name of Allah, O Allah help them." Al-Bukhari relied on Thawr ibn Yazid and 'Ikrimah, and Muslim relied on Muhammad ibn Ishaq, "And..."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) unke sath Baqi' Al-Gharqad tak paidal chale jab unhein rawaana kiya, phir farmaya: "Allah ke naam par jao, Aye Allah, inki madad kar."

e: [AI] "A man came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, advise me.' He said, 'I advise you to fear Allah and to recite the Takbeer upon every glory.' After the man left, the Prophet prayed, 'O Allah, grant him ease in his journey and make travel easy for him."
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jo safar karna chahta tha, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe nasihat dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein Allah ke taqwa aur har buland jagah par takbeer kehne ki nasihat karta hoon." Jab woh chala gaya to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, uske liye zameen samet de aur uska safar aasan kar de."

e: [AI] "He used to ride behind Ali, and when he placed his foot in the stirrup, he said: 'In the name of Allah.' And when he mounted the beast, he said: 'All praise is due to Allah,' three times, and 'Allah is the Greatest,' three times. Then he said: 'Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, and we could not have subdued it ourselves.' [Surah Az-Zukhruf, 43:13] Then he said: 'There is no deity except You; Exalted are You. Indeed, I have been wronging myself, so forgive me my sins. Indeed, no one forgives sins except You.' Then he turned to one side and laughed, so I asked him: 'O Amir al-Mu'minin, what makes you laugh?' He said: 'I was riding behind the Prophet ﷺ  and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did the same as I did. So I asked him the same as you asked me, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Indeed, Allah is pleased with His servant when he says: There is no deity except You; Indeed, I have been wronging myself, so forgive me my sins. Indeed, no one forgives sins except You.' My servant has known that he has a Lord who forgives and punishes."
hi: Ke woh Ali (RA) ke peechhe sawaar the, jab unhone apna pair rakaab mein rakha to kaha: "Bismillah," jab woh sawaari ki peeth par seedhe baithe to kaha: "Alhamdulillah" teen martaba, aur "Allahu Akbar" teen martaba, "{Paak hai woh Zaat jisne isse humare kaabu mein kiya, warna hum ise kaabu mein nahi kar sakte the}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 13) yeh ayat, phir kaha: "La ilaha illa anta, Subhanaka inni qad zalamtu nafsi, faghfir li dhunoobi, innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunooba illa anta," phir aik taraf jhuk kar hansne lage, maine poocha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aapko kis baat ne hansaaya?" Unhone kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke peechhe sawaar tha, Rasulullah (SAW) ne bhi waisa hi kiya jaisa maine kiya, aur maine unse waisa hi poocha jaisa tumne mujhse poocha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah apne bande se khush hota hai jab woh kahe: La ilaha illa anta, Subhanaka inni qad zalamtu nafsi, faghfir li dhunoobi, innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunooba illa anta,' Allah farmata hai: 'Mere bande ne jaan liya ke uska aik Rab hai jo maaf karta hai aur saza bhi deta hai.'"

e: [AI] I saw Ali being brought a creature, and he mentioned a hadith similar to it, equally valid "and his witness is the hadith of Abu Huraira", according to the condition of Muslim.
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko dekha ke unke paas sawaari laayi gayi, phir unhone hadith isi jaisi zikr ki, "aur iska shahid Abu Hurairah (RA) ki hadith hai." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "I take hold of the reins of the camel and accompany it until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  mounts it. He then says, "O Allah, You are our companion in travel and the successor to our families. O Allah, accompany us with companionship, facilitate our journey, O Allah, grant me the keys to the earth, and make our travel easy for us. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel and the distress of return." Abu Zur'ah (narrator of the hadith) said, "Abu Huraira was an Arab man, if he wanted to say 'hardships of travel' he would have said, 'O Allah, make our travel easy for us.'"
hi: Main oontni ki lagaam pakde huay tha yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) uspar seedhe baith gaye, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, tu hi safar mein saathi hai aur ghar walon mein khalifa (nigraan) hai. Aye Allah, humein saath de kar chal aur humein amaanat ke sath wapas laa. Aye Allah, mujhe zameen ki chaabi (aasaani) ata kar aur humare liye safar ko aasaan kar de. Aye Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon safar ki mushkilaat aur wapsi ke ghum se." Abu Zur'ah ne kaha: aur Abu Hurairah (RA) khaalis Arab the, agar woh 'wa'thaa-e-safar' kehna chaahte to yeh kehte: 'Allahummaqlibna bi-dhimmah, Allahummazwi lanal-arda wa sayyirna fiha.'

e: ‘Abd Allaah bin Jafar said “The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ seated me behind him(on his ride) one day, and told me secretly a thing asking me not to tell it to anyone. The place for easing dearer to the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ was a mound or host of palm trees by which he could conceal himself. He entered the garden of a man from the Ansar(Helpers). All of a sudden when a Camel saw the Prophet ﷺ it wept tenderly producing yearning sound and it eyes flowed. The Prophet ﷺ came to it and wiped the temple of its head. So it kept silence. He then said “Who is the master of this Camel? Whose Camel is this? A young man from the Ansar came and said “This is mine, Apostle of Allaah ﷺ.” He said “Don’t you fear Allaah about this beast which Allaah has given in your possession. It has complained to me that you keep it hungry and load it heavily which fatigues it.” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2549)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din mujhe apne peechhe sawaar kiya, aur mujhse aik raaz ki baat ki jo main kisi aur ko nahi bataaunga. Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko apni zaroorat ke liye sabse mahboob chhupne ki jagah koi tila ya khajoor ke darakhton ka jhund hota tha, to aap (SAW) Ansar ke aik shakhs ke baagh mein dakhil huay, achanak wahan aik oont tha, jab usne Nabi (SAW) ko dekha to woh tadapne laga aur uski aankhon se aansu behne lage, to Nabi (SAW) uske paas aaye aur uski gardan ke peechhe wale hisse par haath phera, to woh shaant ho gaya, phir aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Iss oont ka maalik kaun hai? Yeh oont kiska hai?" Unhone kaha: to Ansar ka aik jawaan aaya aur kaha: "Yeh mera hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum is jaanwar ke baare mein Allah se nahi darte jise Allah ne tumhare hawale kiya hai? Isne mujhse shikaayat ki hai ke tum ise bhooka rakhte ho aur ispar zyada bojh daalte ho."

e: [AI] Narrated Anas, who was one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , said, "Ride these animals safely and start using them safely, but do not make them your chairs."
hi: Anas (RA) se, jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, unhone kaha: "In sawaariyon par salaamati ke sath sawaar ho, aur salaamati ke sath inhein istemaal karo, aur inhein kursiyaan mat banaao."

e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was travelling and night came on, he said: O earth, my Lord and your Lord is Allah; I seek refuge in Allah from your evil, the evil of what you contain, the evil of what has been created in you, and the evil of what creeps upon you; I seek refuge in Allah from lions, from large black snakes, from other snakes, from scorpions, from the evil of jinn which inhabit a settlement, and from a parent and his offspring. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2603)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab jihad ya safar par hote aur raat ho jaati to farmate: "Aye zameen, mera aur tera Rab Allah hai, main Allah ki panah maangta hoon teri buraai se, aur us cheez ki buraai se jo tujhme hai, aur us cheez ki buraai se jo tujhme paida ki gayi hai, aur us cheez ki buraai se jo tujhpar chalti hai, main Allah ki panah maangta hoon har sher, kaale saanp, saanp, bicchoo, aur us basti mein rehne wale (jinnaat) ki buraai se, aur maa-baap aur unki aulaad ki buraai se."

e: [AI] "Suhaib, the companion of the Prophet ﷺ , narrated that the Prophet ﷺ  never saw a village that he intended to enter without saying, 'O Allah, Lord of the Seven Heavens and Lord of the Earth and all that they shade, Lord of the Devils and all that they lead astray, Lord of the Winds and all that they scatter, we ask You for the goodness of this village and the goodness of its inhabitants, and seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of its inhabitants and what is within it.'"
hi: Ke Suhaib (RA), Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi, ne unhein bataya ke Nabi (SAW) jab bhi kisi basti mein dakhil hone ka irada karte to use dekhte hi farmate: "Aye Allah, saat aasmano ke Rab aur jo unhone saaya diya hai uske Rab, saat zameeno ke Rab aur jo unhone uthaaya hai uske Rab, shayateen ke Rab aur jise unhone gumraah kiya hai uske Rab, hawaon ke Rab aur jise unhone udaaya hai uske Rab, hum tujhse is basti ki bhalaai aur iske logon ki bhalaai maangte hain, aur hum teri panah maangte hain iski buraai se, iske logon ki buraai se, aur jo kuch ismein hai uski buraai se."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best of companions are four, and the best of expeditions are four hundred, and the best of armies are four thousand, and twelve thousand will not be defeated due to their few numbers." This is an authentic chain of narration according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to Al-Bukhari and Muslim). They did not exclude it due to any dispute among the narrators concerning it from Az-Zuhri.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen saathiyon ka giroh chaar (log) hai, sabse behtareen dasta chaar sau hai, sabse behtareen lashkar chaar hazaar hai, aur baara hazaar kabhi kami ki wajah se maghloob nahi hoga." Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, kyunke naqilon ka Az-Zuhri se isme ikhtilaaf hai.

e: "The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1944)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek behtareen saathi woh hai jo apne saathi ke liye behtareen ho, aur Allah ke nazdeek behtareen padosi woh hai jo apne padosi ke liye behtareen ho."

e: [AI] People complained to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  about walking, so he called for them and said, "You should walk." So we walked and found him (the Prophet) moving ahead of us.
hi: Logon ne Nabi (SAW) se paidal chalne ki shikaayat ki, to aap (SAW) ne unhein bulaaya aur farmaya: "Halki daud (nasalaan) ikhtiyar karo." To humne halki daud lagaayi aur humein woh humare liye zyada aasaan lagi.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say, "When entering a house, he would not step in until he had offered two units of prayer."
hi: Nabi (SAW) "jab bhi kisi padaav se rukhsat hote to use do rak'aton ke sath vida karte."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "If people knew what lies in solitude, I would never travel alone at night."
hi: Nabi ullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar log wahi jaante jo main tanhaai (ke khatron) ke baare mein jaanta hoon, to koi sawaar kabhi tanha raat mein safar na kare."

e: [AI] A man went out from Khaybar, and two men followed him, and a man behind them reciting, saying, "Return until you catch up with them." So they turned around and then he said, "Indeed, these two are Shaytans. Recite upon the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and inform him that we are collecting our charity. If it was suitable for him, we would have sent it to him." He said, "When he arrived at the Prophet, peace be upon him, he informed him. At that, he prohibited him from seclusion."
hi: Aik shakhs Khaybar se nikla, do aadmi uske peechhe ho liye, aur aik shakhs unke peechhe chala aur kehta raha: "Wapas aa jao," yahan tak ke woh un tak pahuncha aur unhein wapas kar diya, phir kaha: "Yeh dono Shaitan hain, isliye Rasulullah (SAW) ko salaam kehna aur unhein bataana ke hum apne sadqe jama kar rahe hain, agar yeh unke liye munaasib ho to hum unhein bhej dengay." Unhone kaha: jab woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya to usne unhein bataya, "to aap (SAW) ne is par tanhaai (mein safar karne) se mana kiya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "Who have you accompanied?" He replied, "I have not accompanied anyone." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, "The person traveling alone is accompanied by a devil, and the two people traveling together are accompanied by two devils, while the three people traveling together are a group."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Tumhare sath kaun tha?" Unhone kaha: "Mere sath koi nahi tha." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Akela sawaar Shaitan hai, do sawaar do Shaitan hain, aur teen (sawaar) aik qaafila hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "One person is a devil, two people are two devils, and three people are a group (ride)." According to the condition of a believer.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik akela Shaitan hai, do Shaitan hain, aur teen aik qaafila hain." Muslim ki shart par.

e: "The Messenger of Allah forbade (eating) animals that had been taken as targets, the milk of Al-Jallalah (animals that eat dung), and drinking directly from water skins." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4448)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "mashk ke mun se (seedha) paani peene se, aur jallalah (napaak khaane wale jaanwar) aur mujaththamah (bandhkar nishana banaaye gaye jaanwar) par sawaari karne se mana kiya."

e: On the day of Khaybar the Messenger of Allah (may pease be upon him) forbade (eating) the flesh of domestic asses, and the animal which feeds on filth: riding it and eating its flesh. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3811)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "Khaybar ke din ghar palu gadhon ke gosht se, aur jallalah se - uspar sawaari karne aur uska gosht khane se - mana kiya."

e: When Allah, Most High, revealed the verses: "Come not nigh to the orphan's property except to improve it". And "Those who unjustly eat up the property of orphans", everyone who had an orphan with him went and separated his food from his (orphan's) food, and his drink from his drink, and began to detain the remaining food which he (the orphan) himself ate or spoiled. This fell heavy on them, and they mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. So Allah, Most High, revealed the verse: "They ask thee concerning orphans. Say: The best thing to do is what is for their good; if ye mix their affairs with yours, they are your brethren." Then they mixed their food with his food and their drink with his drink. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2871)
hi: Jab Allah Ta'ala ne "{Aur yateem ke maal ke qareeb mat jao siwaye us tareeqe ke jo sabse achha ho}" (Surah Al-An'aam 152) aur "{Beshak jo log yateemon ka maal zulm se khaate hain}" (Surah An-Nisa 10) unke farmaan "{...jahannam ki aag}" (Surah An-Nisa 10) tak nazil ki, to jiske paas yateem hota woh apna khana uske khane se alag rakhta aur apna pina uske pine se alag rakhta, kisi cheez ko apne khane se alag karke uske liye rok leta yahan tak ke woh use khaaye ya woh kharaab ho jaaye to use phenk deta, yeh unpar bohot bhaari padne laga, to unhone yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, to Allah Ta'ala ne "{Woh aapse yateemon ke baare mein poochte hain, kah dijiye: unke maamlaat ko sanwaarna behtar hai, aur agar tum unke sath mil jul kar rehte ho to woh tumhare bhai hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 220) unke farmaan "{...Azeez, Hakeem}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 220) tak nazil ki, phir unhone apna khana unke khane ke sath aur apna pina unke pine ke sath mila diya.

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, indeed we eat and do not feel satiated." He said, "Perhaps you separate from your food, come together upon it, and mention the name of Allah, so that He may bless it for you." We brought this narration as a witness.
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum khaate hain lekin hum bharte nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shayad tum apne khane par alag-alag baith jaate ho, isliye ispar jama ho jaao aur Allah ka naam lo, tumhare liye ismein barkat daali jaayegi." Humne ise shahid ke tor par nikaala hai.

e: A man emigrated to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the Yemen. He asked (him): Have you anyone (of your relatives) in the Yemen? He replied: My parents. He asked: Did they permit you? He replied: No. He said: Go back to them and ask for their permission. If they permit you, then fight (in the path of Allah), otherwise be devoted to them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2530)
hi: Aik shakhs Yemen se Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas hijrat karke aaya, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine hijrat ki hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Tumne shirk se hijrat ki hai, lekin yeh (jihad) alag baat hai, kya Yemen mein tumhara koi (rishtedar) hai?" Usne kaha: "Mere maa-baap." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya unhone tumhein ijaazat di hai?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To wapas jao aur unse ijaazat maango, agar woh tumhein ijaazat dein to jihad karo, warna unki khidmat karo."

e: [AI] That Jāhimah came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, I want to participate in a battle, so I came to seek your advice." He replied, "Do you still have a living mother?" He said, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Then stay with her, for paradise is beneath her feet."
hi: Ke Jahimah (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Main jihad karna chahta hoon, isliye aapse mashwara lene aaya hoon." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhari waalida zinda hain?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To jao aur unki khidmat mein raho, kyunke Jannat unke pairon ke neeche hai."

e: [AI] Abu Talhah read the Quran verse "March forth, whether light or heavy" [Surah At-Tawbah 9:41]. So he said, "I suggest that we gather both the elderly and the young for battle." They replied, "O our father, you have already fought alongside the Prophet ﷺ  until he passed away, and with Abu Bakr and Umar. We are fighting on your behalf." But he insisted, so he embarked on a ship until he passed away. They were unable to find an island to bury him on until after seven days. So, what changed?
hi: Abu Talha (RA) ne Quran padha: "{Halke ho ya bhaari, nikal khade ho}" (Surah At-Tawbah 41), to unhone kaha: "Mera khayal hai ke buzurgon aur jawaano dono ko bulaaya jaana chahiye." Unke bete ne kaha: "Aye humare abba, aapne Nabi (SAW) ke sath jihad kiya yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ka wisaal ho gaya, aur Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ke sath bhi, ab hum aapki taraf se jihad karte hain." Unhone inkaar kiya aur samundar mein sawaar ho gaye, yahan tak ke unka inteqaal ho gaya, unhein aik jazeere par dafan karne ke liye jagah nahi mil saki siwaye saat dinon ke baad, unhone kaha: to (unke jism mein) koi tabdeeli nahi aayi thi.

e: [AI] From the saying of Allah Almighty: "Unless you march forth, He will punish you with a painful torment." [Surah At-Tawbah 9:39], he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wanted to dispatch an army from the living Arabs to fight, but they hesitated. As a result, Allah prevented the rain from falling on them, and that became a punishment for them."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Agar tum nahi nikloge}" (Surah At-Tawbah 39) "to Allah tumhein dardnaak azab dega" ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Arab ke aik qabile ko (jihad ke liye) bulaawa bheja, unhone susti dikhaayi, to unse baarish rok li gayi, aur yehi unka azab tha."

e: When the Prophet ﷺ entered Mecca his banner was white. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2592)
hi: Jabir (RA) se marfoo' (Nabi tak pahunchne wali) riwayat hai ke "jab woh Makkah mein dakhil huay to unka jhanda safed tha."

e: [AI] The translation of the given sentence is: "The banner of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was black, and his flagbearer was white." There is also a mention of "Yazid" as weak, but that part is not clear without further context.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ka jhanda (liwa) safed tha aur unka parcham (raya) kaala tha." Yazid kamzor hain.

e: [AI] He told me, he said: While I was sitting in the cave, a man came to me and asked me about {the charging steeds, panting} [Quran 100:1], so I said to him, "The horses, when they change in the cause of Allah, then they return to their resting place at night and they make their food and kindle their fire." He turned away from me and went to Ali ibn Abi Talib, who was sitting beneath the Zamzam water fountain, and he asked him about the charging steeds. Ali said to him, "Did you ask anyone else before me?" He said, "Yes, I asked Ibn Abbas." He said, "It is the horses when they change in the cause of Allah." He said, "Then go and call him for me." When he stood in front of him, Ali said to him, "You give people religious verdicts without knowledge. By Allah, the first battle in Islam was the Battle of Badr, and there were only horsemen with us. There was a horse for Zubair and a horse for Al-Miqdad ibn Al-Aswad. So how can the charging steeds be wolves? Indeed, {the charging steeds, panting} [Quran 100:1] refers to the journey from Arafah to Muzdalifah, and from Muzdalifah to Mina, {thus they stamp therewith the different tracks} [Quran 100:4] when they step on it with their hooves and their edges." Ibn Abbas said, "So I retracted my statement and went back to the one who said Ali."
hi: Unhone bataya, kaha: main Hijr mein baitha tha ke aik shakhs mere paas aaya aur mujhse "{Al-Aadiyaati Dhabha}" (Surah Al-Adiyat 1) ke baare mein poocha, to maine unse kaha: "Yeh ghode hain jab woh Allah ki raah mein chadhaai karte hain, phir raat ko thehar jaate hain aur apna khana banaate hain aur aag jalaate hain." To woh mujhse mudkar Ali bin Abi Talib ke paas gaya jo Zamzam ke haudh ke neeche the, unse Al-Aadiyat ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Kya tumne mujhse pehle kisi aur se poocha hai?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan, maine Ibn Abbas se poocha tha, unhone kaha: 'Yeh ghode hain jab woh Allah ki raah mein chadhaai karte hain.'" Unhone kaha: "To jao aur unhein mere paas bulaao." Unhone kaha: jab woh unke sar par khade huay to unhone kaha: "Tum logon ko bagair ilm ke fatwa dete ho? Allah ki qasam, Islam ki pehli ghazwa Badr thi, aur humare sath sirf do ghode the, aik Zubair ke liye aur aik Miqdad bin Al-Aswad ke liye, to 'Al-Aadiyaati Dhabha' kaise ho sakta hai? Balke '{Al-Aadiyaati Dhabha}' (Surah Al-Adiyat 1) Arafat se Muzdalifah tak aur Muzdalifah se Mina tak (Hajj safar ki) chaal hai, '{Fa-atharna bihi naq'a}' (Surah Al-Adiyat 4) jab woh apne khuron aur pairon se zameen ko kuchalte hain." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: to maine apni baat wapas le li aur woh maan liya jo Ali ne kaha tha.

e: [AI] "I used to accompany Ammar on the day of the Battle of Camel, and he had a spear with a saddle on it, in which he would urinate when he needed to. When the battle approached, he said, 'O Muhariq! Get the banner of your people.' I replied, 'I am not capable of that, as I am in this condition today.' He then said, 'Rather, O Muhariq! Get the banner of your people, for I have seen the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'It is preferable for a man to fight under the banner of his people.'"
hi: Main Jang-e-Jamal ke din Ammar (RA) ke sath chal raha tha, unke paas unke zeen se bandha hua aik seeng (bartan) tha jismein woh peshaab kar liya karte the jab zaroorat hoti, jab jung shuru hone lagi to unhone kaha: "Aye Mukhariq, apni qaum ke jhande ke paas jao." Maine kaha: "Main jung karne wala nahi hoon, aur aaj main is haal mein hoon." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Aye Mukhariq, apni qaum ke jhande ke paas jao, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha hai ke unhein pasand tha ke aadmi apni qaum ke jhande ke neeche jung kare."

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Bring me the weak, for you only receive provision and Divine support by virtue of your weak ones.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3179)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe kamzoron mein dhoondo, kyunke tumhein rizq aur madad tumhare kamzoron ki wajah se hi milti hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  made the slogan of the Muhajireen on the Day of Badr to be "Abdul Rahman and Al-Aws bin Abdul Allah and Al-Khazraj bin Ubaid Allah".
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din Muhajireen ka pukaarne wala kalima 'Abdur Rahman' rakha, aur Aws Banu Abdullah ka, aur Khazraj Banu Ubaidullah ka.

e: [AI] "I heard Ibn Abbas say that a delegation of four hundred people from the tribe of Azd Shanu'ah came to the Prophet ﷺ. He greeted them by saying, 'Welcome, O Azd! You are the best of people in appearance, with the most pleasant speech, and the bravest for a meeting. You are trustworthy. O Mabrur, your motto is safety.'"
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Nabi (SAW) ke paas Azd Shanoo'ah ke chaar sau (400) ghar-baar ya chaar sau aadmiyon ka aik wafd aaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khush-aamdeed Azd ko, jo logon mein sabse achhe chehron wale, sabse achhi zubaan wale, muqaable mein sabse bahaadur, aur amaanat mein sabse zyada qaabil-e-etimaad hain, tumhara jung ka nishaan (shi'aar) hoga: 'Ya Mabroor' (Aye qubool kiya gaya)."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ was heard saying, "If you are attacked, let your slogan be 'They will not be victorious.'" This is narrated by Zuhair ibn Mu'awiya from Abu Ishaq. Zuhair ibn Mu'awiya followed this on the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Agar tumpar raat ko hamla ho jaaye, to tumhara jung ka nishaan 'Ha-Mim, la yunsaroon' (Ha-Mim, unhein madad nahi milegi) ho." Isse Zuhair bin Muawiyah ne bhi Abu Ishaq se isi tarah riwayat kiya hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said while he was afraid that Abu Sufyan might betray him, "If you spend the night, then my invitation to you will be Ham and they will not be able to defeat you."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya, jabke unhein khatra tha ke Abu Sufyan raat ko hamla kar sakte hain: "Agar tumpar raat ko hamla ho, aur main tumhein bulaaun, to tumhara jung ka nishaan 'Ha-Mim, la yunsaroon' hoga (unhein madad nahi milegi)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, you will encounter your enemy tomorrow, so let your motto be 'They will not be victorious.' It has been reported from Abu Ishaq from Al-Bara' that Ahmad ibn Muhammad Al-Anazi narrated to me, from Uthman ibn Sa'id, from Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Ibn Numair, from Al-Ajlah, from Abu Ishaq, from Al-Bara', from the Prophet ﷺ  who said, 'Indeed, you will encounter your enemy tomorrow'." Similar to it.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum kal apne dushman se milogay, isliye tumhara jung ka nishaan 'Ha-Mim, la yunsaroon' ho." Aur isse Abu Ishaq ki, Al-Bara' (RA) se, riwayat bhi mili hai - mujhe Ahmad bin Muhammad Al-Anazi ne bataya, unhein Uthman bin Sa'eed ne, unhein Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaybah ne, unhein Ibn Numair ne, Al-Ajlah se, unhone Abu Ishaq se, unhone Al-Bara' (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi riwayat ki hai ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum kal apne dushman se miloge."

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, he said, "Indeed, tomorrow you will encounter (the enemy), so let your slogan be 'Ham la yunṣarūna' which means 'We will not be defeated'."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum kal (dushman se) milogay, isliye tumhara jung ka nishaan 'Ha-Mim, la yunsaroon' ho" (ya'ni unhein madad nahi milegi).

e: [AI] "I participated in a raid with Abu Bakr during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and our slogan, meaning the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , was 'Ummati Ummati.' This narration is authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, and they did not exclude it. It also has a reliable witness according to the conditions of Muslim and Bukhari."
hi: Maine Abu Bakr (RA) ke sath Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein jihad kiya, aur humara - ya'ni Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba (RA) ka - jung ka nishaan tha: "Amit, Amit" (maar daalo, maar daalo). Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, "aur iska aik sahih shahid Muslim ki shart par bhi hai." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The slogan of the Prophet ﷺ  was "Save my nation, save my nation" on the condition of being a Muslim.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ka jung ka nishaan tha: 'Amit, Amit' (maar daalo, maar daalo)." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard a man calling out in his slogan: "O Haram, O Haram." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Halal, O Halal." This hadith is deemed authentic according to the conditions of both Al-Bukhari and Muslim (the two acknowledged scholars of hadith). It was narrated by a man named Muhammad ibn Kathir from Thawri, Abdullah ibn Mughaffal Al-Muzani.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik shakhs ko apna jung ka nishaan pukaarte suna: "Aye haraam, aye haraam," to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye halaal, aye halaal." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, mursal (bagair pooray sanad ke) tor par, "aur jis shakhs ka naam Muhammad bin Kathir ne Ath-Thawri se, Abdullah bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani se nahi liya."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , similar to him according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "Umar ibn al-Khattab went out in a gathering while he was in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and they were discussing a secret mission from the expeditions that perished in the cause of Allah. One of them said, 'They are the workers of Allah, they perished in His cause, and their reward has been obligated for them.' Another one said, 'Allah knows best about them, they will receive what they have intended.' When they saw Umar approaching, leaning on his staff, they fell silent. Umar approached them and greeted them, then he asked, 'What were you all talking about?' They replied, 'We were discussing this secret mission that perished in the cause of Allah.
