One of us said, 'They are the workers of Allah, they perished in His cause, and their reward has been obligated for them.' Another one said, 'Allah knows best about them, they will receive what they have intended.' Umar said, 'Indeed, Allah knows that among the people, there are those who fight for the sake of fighting, as it is their desire, and they are unable to fight for any other reason. And indeed, among the people, there are those who fight for the sake of showing off and seeking reputation. And indeed, among the people, there are those who fight seeking the face of Allah, and they are the martyrs. And every person will be resurrected upon what they died for. And by Allah, a soul does not know what is intended for it. This is not the man who made it clear to us that he has been forgiven for all his past and future sins.' ﷺ "
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein aik majlis se guzre jahan log Allah ki raah mein halaak hone wale aik dastay ka zikr kar rahe the, unme se aik ne kaha: "Woh Allah ke aamil (kaamgaar) hain, woh uski raah mein halaak huay hain, aur unka ajr unpar wajib ho chuka hai." Doosre ne kaha: "Allah unhein zyada jaanta hai, unke liye wahi hai jiski unhone ummeed rakhi." Jab unhone Umar (RA) ko apni chhadi par takiya lagaaye huay aate dekha to woh khamosh ho gaye, Umar (RA) aaye yahan tak ke unhein salaam kiya, phir poocha: "Tum kya baatein kar rahe the?" Unhone kaha: "Hum us dastay ka zikr kar rahe the jo Allah ki raah mein halaak hua, humme se aik ne kaha: 'Woh Allah ke aamil hain, woh uski raah mein halaak huay hain, aur unka ajr unpar wajib ho chuka hai,' aur doosre ne kaha: 'Allah unhein zyada jaanta hai, unke liye wahi hai jiski unhone ummeed rakhi.'" To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allah zyada jaanta hai, beshak logon mein aise log hain jo jung karte hain aur unki fikr sirf jung hi hoti hai, woh iske ilawa kuch aur nahi kar sakte, aur logon mein aise bhi hain jo riyakaari aur naam ke liye jung karte hain, aur logon mein aise bhi hain jo Allah ki raza chahte huay jung karte hain, wahi log shuhada hain, aur unme se har shakhs jis haal par mara, usi haal par uthaaya jayega. Allah ki qasam, koi jaan nahi jaanti ke uske sath kya kiya jayega, yeh woh shakhs nahi jiske baare mein humein saaf saaf bataaya gaya hai ke uske aage-peechhe ke sare gunah maaf kar diye gaye hain (SAW)."

e: [AI] "His departure was like gold or a piece of paper seeking trade. Do not say that it is yours, rather say as the Prophet ﷺ  said: 'Whoever is killed in the cause of Allah, or dies, they are in Paradise.'"
hi: Uski sawaari sona ya chandi thi, tijarat ki talaash mein, isliye yeh mat kaho, balke jaisa Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya waisa kaho: "Jo Allah ki raah mein qatl ho jaaye ya mar jaaye, woh Jannat mein hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever goes for battle without intending anything other than capturing the spoils of war, then he will have what he intended."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo jihad kare aur apni jung mein sirf itni si (maamooli) cheez ki niyat rakhe, to usse wahi milega jiski usne niyat ki."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to send me on his military expeditions. One day, he sent me and there was a man riding with me. I told him, "Leave." He said, "I'm not going anywhere with you unless you give me three dinars." I asked him, "Why?" He replied, "Until you give me three dinars." I said, "When did I say goodbye to the Prophet ﷺ ? I am not going back to him. Leave, and you can have three dinars." When I returned from my expedition, I mentioned this to the Prophet ﷺ , and he said, "Give it to him, as it is his share of the spoils."
hi: Nabi (SAW) mujhe apne dastay mein bhejte the, aik din unhone mujhe bheja, aur aik shakhs sawaar tha, maine usse kaha: "Rawaana ho jao." Usne kaha: "Main tumhare sath nahi jaaunga." Maine poocha: "Kyun?" Usne kaha: "Jab tak tum mere liye teen dinar muqarrar na karo." Maine kaha: "Ab, jabke maine Nabi (SAW) ko vida keh diya hai? Main unke paas wapas nahi jaaunga, rawaana ho jao, tumhein teen dinar milengay." Jab main apni jung se wapas laut aaya to maine yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh usse de do, kyunke yeh uski jung ka hissa hai."

e: People dispersed from around Abu Huraira, and Natil, who was from the Syrians. said to him: O Shaikh, relate (to us) a tradition you have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: Yes. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: The first of men (whose case) will be decided on the Day of Judgment will be a man who died as a martyr. He shall be brought (before the Judgment Seat). Allah will make him recount His blessings (i. e. the blessings which He had bestowed upon him) and he will recount them (and admit having enjoyed them in his life). (Then) will Allah say: What did you do (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I fought for Thee until I died as a martyr. Allah will say: You have told a lie. You fought that you might be called a" brave warrior". And you were called so. (Then) orders will be passed against him and he will be dragged with his face downward and cast into Hell. Then will be brought forward a man who acquired knowledge and imparted it (to others) and recited the Qur'an. He will be brought And Allah will make him recount His blessings and he will recount them (and admit having enjoyed them in his lifetime). Then will Allah ask: What did you do (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I acquired knowledge and disseminated it and recited the Qur'an seeking Thy pleasure. Allah will say: You have told a lie. You acquired knowledge so that you might be called" a scholar," and you recited the Qur'an so that it might be said:" He is a Qari" and such has been said. Then orders will be passed against him and he shall be dragged with his face downward and cast into the Fire. Then will be brought a man whom Allah had made abundantly rich and had granted every kind of wealth. He will be brought and Allah will make him recount His blessings and he will recount them and (admit having enjoyed them in his lifetime). Allah will (then) ask: What have you done (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I spent money in every cause in which Thou wished that it should be spent. Allah will say: You are lying. You did (so) that it might be said about (You):" He is a generous fellow" and so it was said. Then will Allah pass orders and he will be dragged with his face downward and thrown into Hell. (Using translation from Muslim 1905a)
hi: Shaam ke aik shakhs (bhai) ne unse kaha: "Aye Shaikh, humein koi hadith sunaayen jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho." Unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Sabse pehla shakhs jiska Qayamat ke din faisla kiya jayega, woh hoga jo shaheed hua tha, use laaya jayega, Allah use apni ne'matein yaad dilayega, woh unhein pehchaanega," Allah poochenge: "Tumne inme kya amal kiya?" Woh kahega: "Maine teri raah mein jung ki yahan tak ke main shaheed ho gaya." Allah farmayega: "Tumne jhoot bola, balke tumne isliye jung ki taake tumhein 'bahaadur' kaha jaaye, aur tumhein kaha jaa chuka hai." Phir uske baare mein hukum diya jayega aur use uske chehre par ghaseeta jayega yahan tak ke use aag mein daal diya jayega. Aur (doosra) woh shakhs jisne ilm seekha aur sikhaaya, aur Quran padha, use laaya jayega, Allah use apni ne'matein yaad dilayega, woh unhein pehchaanega, Allah poochenge: "Tumne inme kya amal kiya?" Woh kahega: "Maine teri raah mein ilm seekha aur sikhaya, aur teri raah mein Quran padha." Allah farmayega: "Tumne jhoot bola, balke tumne isliye ilm seekha taake tumhein 'aalim' kaha jaaye, aur tumne isliye Quran padha taake tumhein 'qaari' kaha jaaye, aur tumhein kaha jaa chuka hai." Phir uske baare mein hukum diya jayega aur use uske chehre par ghaseeta jayega yahan tak ke use aag mein daal diya jayega. Aur (teesra) woh shakhs jise Allah ne wasee' rizq diya aur usse har tarah ka maal ata kiya, use laaya jayega, Allah use apni ne'matein yaad dilayega, woh unhein pehchaanega, Allah poochenge: "Tumne inme kya amal kiya?" Woh kahega: "Maine koi aisi jagah nahi chhodi jahan tu kharch karna pasand karta ho magar maine wahan kharch kiya." Allah farmayega: "Tumne jhoot bola, balke tumne isliye aisa kiya taake tumhein 'sakhi' kaha jaaye, aur tumhein kaha jaa chuka hai." Phir uske baare mein hukum diya jayega aur use uske chehre par ghaseeta jayega yahan tak ke use aag mein daal diya jayega.

e: [AI] "To say that so-and-so was killed as a martyr, indeed the man fights for honor and fights to seek worldly gains. He fights with a brave heart. But let me inform you about what you have witnessed: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a secret mission one day, and it didn't take long for him to stand up and praise them. He said, 'Indeed, your brothers have encountered the polytheists and have defeated them, leaving none of them remaining. And they said, 'Our Lord, inform our people that we have accepted [Your command] and are pleased with You as our Lord, and that You are pleased with us.' So I am their messenger to you, and indeed they have accepted [the command] and are pleased with it, and He is pleased with them.'"
hi: Ke tum kaho: "Fulan shaheed hokar mara," kyunke aadmi ghairat mein bhi jung karta hai, duniya ki talaash mein bhi jung karta hai, aur seene ki dileri (jazbaati josh) mein bhi jung karta hai, lekin main tumhein wahi bataaunga jiski tum khud gawahi doge - beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din aik dasta bheja, thodi hi der guzri ke aap (SAW) khade huay, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir farmaya: "Beshak tumhare bhai mushrikeen se mile aur unse alag ho gaye, unme se koi bhi baaqi nahi bacha, aur unhone kaha: 'Aye humare Rab, humari qaum ko bata do ke hum raazi ho gaye hain aur humara Rab humse raazi ho gaya hai,' to main unka paighaam-bar tumhare paas hoon, beshak woh raazi ho gaye hain aur Allah unse raazi ho gaya hai."

e: [AI] Some people went out and were killed, so they said: So and so has been martyred. Abdullah said: Indeed, a man fights for worldly gains, and a man fights to be recognized. And indeed, a man may die on his bed and still be considered a martyr. Then he recited: "And those who believe in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the truthful and the martyrs with their Lord." [Surah Al Hadeed: 19]
hi: Kuch log nikle aur maare gaye, log kehne lage: "Fulan shaheed ho gaya." To Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Beshak aadmi duniya ke liye bhi jung karta hai aur pehchaane jaane ke liye bhi jung karta hai, aur beshak aadmi apne bistar par mar kar bhi shaheed ho sakta hai," phir unhone padha: "{Aur jo Allah aur uske Rasoolon par imaan laaye, wahi log Siddiqeen aur Shuhada hain apne Rab ke nazdeek}" (Surah Al-Hadeed 19).

e: [AI] "A man said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I find myself in a difficult situation. I desire to seek the pleasure of Allah and I also want to see my place in Paradise, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not respond to him until the verse was revealed, 'So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone." [Surah Al-Kahf 110]"
hi: Aik shakhs ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main woh maqaam (namaz/ibaadat ki jagah) khada hota hoon Allah ki raza chahte huay, aur main chahta hoon ke meri woh jagah (logon ko) dikhaayi jaaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne use koi jawaab nahi diya yahan tak ke yeh nazil hui: "{To jo bhi apne Rab se milne ki ummeed rakhta ho, use chahiye ke woh nek amal kare aur apne Rab ki ibaadat mein kisi ko shareek na kare}" (Surah Al-Kahf 110).

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "The first three people to enter the Fire on the Day of Resurrection will be a man who has been brought and it will be said to him: 'Did you not know the Book of Allah and recite it day and night, seeking its reward?' He will say: 'Yes, my Lord.' Then it will be said to him: 'You have lied, for you only wanted to be called a reader of the Quran, and that had already been said about you.' Then he will be ordered to be dragged on his face into the Fire. Then the second will be brought and it will be said to him: 'Did you not have wealth and trade with it, and were you not generous and gave charity?' He will say: 'Yes, my Lord.' Then it will be said to him: 'You have lied, for you only wanted to be called generous, and that had already been said about you.' Then he will be ordered to be dragged on his face into the Fire. Then the third will be brought and it will be said to him: 'Did you not go out for Jihad in the cause of Allah?' He will say: 'Yes, my Lord.' Then it will be said to him: 'You have lied, for you only wanted to be called brave, and that had already been said about you.' Then he will be ordered to be dragged on his face into the Fire."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Sabse pehle log Qayamat ke din Jahannam mein daakhil honge teen (log): aik aadmi ko laaya jayega, ya kaha: unme se aik ko, woh kahega: 'Aye Rab, tu ne mujhe Kitaab sikhaayi, to maine ise raat-din teri sawaab ki ummeed mein padha,' to kaha jayega: 'Tumne jhoot bola, tum sirf isliye namaz padhte the taake kaha jaaye "yeh qaari, namaazi hai," aur woh kaha ja chuka hai, isse aag ki taraf le jao.' Phir aik aur ko laaya jayega, woh kahega: 'Aye Rab, tu ne mujhe maal ata kiya, to maine usse rishtedaari joda aur miskeeno par sadqa kiya aur musafiron ki madad ki, teri sawaab aur teri Jannat ki ummeed mein,' to kaha jayega: 'Tumne jhoot bola, tum sirf isliye sadqa dete the aur rishtedaari jodte the taake kaha jaaye "tum farakh-dil, sakhi ho," aur woh kaha ja chuka hai, isse aag ki taraf le jao.' Phir teesre ko laaya jayega, woh kahega: 'Aye Rab, main teri raah mein nikla aur teri khaatir jung ki yahan tak ke main shaheed ho gaya, aage badhte huay peeth na dikhaate huay, teri sawaab aur teri Jannat ki ummeed mein,' to kaha jayega: 'Tumne jhoot bola, tum sirf isliye jung karte the taake kaha jaaye "tum bahaadur, jaanbaaz ho," aur woh kaha ja chuka hai, isse aag ki taraf le jao.'"

e: Messenger of Allah, tell me about jihad and fighting. He replied: Abdullah ibn Amr, if you fight with endurance seeking from Allah your reward, Allah will resurrect you showing endurance and seeking your reward from Him, but, if you fight for vain show seeking to acquire much, Allah will resurrect you making a vain show and seeking to acquire much. In whatever you fight or are killed, Abdullah ibn Amr, in that state Allah will resurrect you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2519)
hi: Ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe jihad aur jung ke baare mein bataaiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abdullah bin Amr, agar tum sabr aur sawaab ki niyat se jung karo, to Allah tumhein sabr aur sawaab ki niyat wale ke tor par uthaayega, aur agar tum riyakaari aur shohrat ki niyat se jung karo, to Allah tumhein riyakaari aur shohrat ki niyat wale ke tor par uthaayega, Aye Abdullah bin Amr, jis bhi haal mein tum jung karo ya maare jaao, Allah tumhein usi haal par uthaayega." Hadith sahih-ul-isnad hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ announced an expedition, and I was a very old man and I had no servant. I, therefore, sought a hireling who would serve instead of me, and I would give him his portion. So I found a man. When the time of departure arrived, he came to me and said: I do not know what would be the portions, and how much would be my portion. So offer something (as wages) to me, whether there would be any portion or not. I offered three dinars (as his wages) for him. When some booty arrived, I wanted to offer him his portion. But I remembered the dinars, so I went to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned the matter to him. He said: All I can find for him regarding this expedition of his in this world and the next is three dinars which were offered him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2527)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne jihad ki ijaazat di, aur main aik boodha shakhs tha, mera koi khaadim nahi tha, to maine aik ajeer (mazdoor) talaash kiya jo mere badle chala jaaye, aur main uska hissa use de dun. Maine aik aadmi dhoonda, jab rawaangi qareeb aayi to woh mere paas aaya aur kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata hisse kya honge aur mera hissa kitna hoga, isliye mere liye kuch muqarrar kar do, chahe hissa mile ya na mile." To maine uske liye teen dinar muqarrar kiye. Jab maal-e-ghaneemat aaya to maine chaha ke main uska hissa use de dun, phir mujhe dinar yaad aaye, to main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein uska maamla bataaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iski is jung mein duniya mein bhi mujhe iske liye sirf woh dinar hi milte hain jo iske liye muqarrar kiye gaye the."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Our Lord Most High is pleased with a man who fights in the path of Allah, the Exalted; then his companions fled away (i.e. retreated). But he knew that it was a sin (to flee away from the battlefield), so he returned, and his blood was shed. Thereupon Allah, the Exalted, says to His angels: Look at My servant; he returned seeking what I have for him (i.e. the reward), and fearing (the punishment) I have, until his blood was shed. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2536)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Humara Rab us shakhs se khush hota hai jo Allah ki raah mein jung kare, uske sathi bhaag jaayen, magar use pata ho ke (bhaagna) uspar gunah hai, to woh wapas laut aata hai yahan tak ke uska khoon baha diya jaata hai, to Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala apne farishton se farmata hai: 'Mere bande ko dekho, woh mere paas jo hai uski khwahish mein aur mere paas jo hai uske dar se wapas aaya, yahan tak ke uska khoon baha diya gaya.'"

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: "There are three whom Allah (SWT) loves: A man who comes to some people and asks (to be given something) for the sake of Allah and not for the sake of their relationship, but they do not give him, so a man stayed behind and gave it to him in secret, and no one knew of his giving except Allah (SWT) and the one to whom he gave it. People who travel all night until sleep becomes dearer to them than anything equated with it, so they lay down their heads (and slept), then a man among them got up and started praying to Me and beseeching Me, reciting My Verses. And a man who was on a campaign and met the enemy and they fled, but he went forward (pursuing them) until he was killed or victory was granted." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1615)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (log) hain jinhein Allah mohabbat karta hai, aur teen hain jinhein Allah napasand karta hai; rahi baat un logon ki jinhein Allah mohabbat karta hai, to woh hai woh aadmi jo kisi qaum ke paas aaya aur unse Allah ke naam par maanga, aur unse apni aur unki qaraabat ka waasta nahi diya, to unke peechhe se aik shakhs pichhe reh gaya aur chhupke se use de diya jise Allah aur jise diya gaya, uske ilawa koi nahi jaanta, aur woh qaum jo raat bhar chalti rahi yahan tak ke jab neend unhein har cheez se zyada mahboob lagne lagi to woh utre aur apne sar rakh diye, phir aik shakhs khada hokar mujhse iltija aur inkisaari se baat karne laga aur meri aayaton ki tilawat karne laga, aur woh aadmi jo aik dastay mein tha, dushman se mila, unhein shikast hui, magar woh apne seene ke sath aage badhta raha yahan tak ke woh maara gaya ya use fatah mil gayi. Aur woh teen jinhein Allah napasand karta hai: boodha zaani, ghamandi faqeer, aur zulm karne wala maal-daar."

e: Amr ibn Uqaysh had given usurious loans in pre-Islamic period; so he disliked to embrace Islam until he took them. He came on the day of Uhud and asked: Where are my cousins? They (the people) replied: At Uhud. He asked: Where is so-and-so? They said: At Uhud. He asked: Where is so-and-so? They said: At Uhud. He then put on his coat of mail and rode his horse; he then proceeded towards them. When the Muslims saw him, they said: Keep away, Amir. He said: I have become a believer. He fought until he was wounded. He was then taken to his family wounded. Sa'd ibn Mu'adh came to his sister: Ask him (whether he fought) out of partisanship, out of anger for them, or out of anger for Allah. He said: Out of anger of Allah and His Apostle. He then died and entered Paradise. He did not offer any prayer for Allah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2537)
hi: Woh Islam qubool karne se pehle riba (sood) le chuke the, isliye Islam qubool karne mein hichkichaate the jab tak ke woh (apne sood) le lein. Woh Uhud ke din aaye aur poocha: "Mere phupheron ke bete kahan hain?" Unhone kaha: "Uhud mein." Unhone poocha: "Fulan kahan hai?" Unhone kaha: "Uhud mein." Unhone poocha: "Fulan kahan hai?" Unhone kaha: "Uhud mein." To unhone apni zirah pehni, apne ghode par sawaar huay, phir unki taraf rawaana huay. Jab Musalmano ne unhein dekha to kaha: "Humse door raho, Aye Amr." Unhone kaha: "Main imaan laa chuka hoon." To woh jung karte rahe yahan tak ke zakhmi ho gaye, unhein zakhmi haalat mein unke ghar walon ke paas le jaaya gaya, Sa'd bin Muadh (RA) unke paas aaye aur unki behen se kaha: "Unse poocho ke kya woh apni qaum ki ghairat mein ya unke liye ghusse mein jung kar rahe the, ya Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye ghusse mein?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye ghusse mein," phir woh mar gaye aur Jannat mein dakhil ho gaye, jabke unhone Allah ke liye kabhi aik bhi namaz nahi padhi thi.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Two (prayers) are not rejected, or seldom rejected: Prayer at the time of the call to prayer, and (the prayer) at the time of fighting, when the people grapple with each other. Musa said: Rizq ibn Sa'id ibn AbdurRahman reported from AbuHazim on the authority of Sahl ibn Sa'd from the Prophet ﷺ as saying: And while it is raining. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2540)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do (duaein) kabhi rad nahi ki jaatin," ya farmaya: "Kam hi rad ki jaati hain - azaan ke waqt ki dua, aur jung ke shiddat ke waqt ki dua jab log aapas mein bhid jaate hain." Musa bin Ya'qub ne kaha: aur mujhe Rizq bin Sa'eed bin Abdur Rahman Al-Madani ne, Abu Hazim se, unhone Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se hadith bayan ki, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur baarish ke waqt bhi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "You should use the saddle, for indeed, the earth folds at night." I found in the book of rituals that I had dictated from this book a narration from Ruwaim ibn Yazid al-Muqri, from Al-Layth, from Aqil, from Az-Zuhri, from Anas. I made an effort at that time to find a witness for it but I did not find one. "And this is his witness, if it is confirmed by Khalid ibn Yazid al-Umari." If it is confirmed by Khalid, then it is reliable.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Raat ko safar karo, kyunke zameen raat mein simat jaati hai (aasaani se tay hoti hai)." Maine is kitaab ki Kitaab-ul-Manasik mein Ruwaim bin Yazid Al-Muqri ki hadith likhwaayi thi, Al-Laith se, unhone Aqeel se, unhone Az-Zuhri se, unhone Anas (RA) se, aur us waqt maine iske liye koi shahid dhoondne ki koshish ki thi lekin nahi mil saka. "Aur yeh iska shahid hai, agar Khalid bin Yazid Al-Umari se mehfooz ho."

e: “Whoever enters a horse (in a race) between two other horses, not knowing whether it will win, that is not gambling. But whoever enters a horse (in race) between two other horses, certain that it will win, that is gambling.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2876)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi do ghodon ke darmiyan aik (teesra) ghoda daakhil kare aur use yaqeen na ho ke woh peeche reh jaayega, to yeh juaa nahi hai, aur jo koi do ghodon ke darmiyan aik ghoda daakhil kare aur use yaqeen ho ke woh peeche nahi rahega, to yeh juaa hai." Sa'eed bin Bashir Ad-Dimashqi ne isse Az-Zuhri se mutaba'at ki hai aur iski sanad qaayam ki hai.

e: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 99)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: Ibn Juraij said “O ye who believe, Obey Allaah and obey the Apostle and those charged with authority amongst you.” This verse was revealed about ‘Abd Allaah bin Qais bin ‘Adi whom the Prophet ﷺ sent along with a detachment. Ya’la narrated it to me from Sa’id bin Jubair on the authority of Ibn ‘Abbas. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2624)
hi: Ibn Jurayj ne kaha: "{Aye imaan walo, Allah ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo aur apne mein se sahib-e-amr (zimmedaron) ki bhi}" (Surah An-Nisa 59) - yeh Abdullah bin Qais bin Adi (RA) ke baare mein nazil hui, jinhein Nabi (SAW) ne aik dastay mein bheja tha. Mujhe Ya'la bin Muslim ne, Sa'eed bin Jubair se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, yeh bataya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ sent a detachment. I gave a sword to a man from among them. When he came back, he said: Would that you saw us how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rebuked us, saying: When I sent out a man who does not fulfil my command, are you unable to appoint in his place one who will fulfil my command. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2627)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik dasta bheja, maine unme se aik shakhs ko talwaar di, jab hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas wapas aaye to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein daanta, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum aajiz ho gaye the ke jab maine aik aadmi ko bheja aur usne mere hukum ko poora nahi kiya, to tum uski jagah aisa shakhs muqarrar karte jo mere hukum ko poora karta?"

e: When the people encamped, (the narrator Amr ibn Uthman al-Himsi) said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ encamped, the people scattered in the glens and wadis. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Your scattering in these glens and wadis is only of the devil. They afterwards kept close together when they encamped to such an extent that it used to be said that if a cloth were spread over them, it would cover them all. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2628)
hi: Log jab kisi jagah padaav daalte to woh tangi wadiyon aur wadiyon mein bikhar jaate, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "In tangi wadiyon aur wadiyon mein tumhara bikharna sirf Shaitan ki taraf se hai." Iske baad unhone kisi bhi padaav mein bagair aapas mein mil-jul kar rahe kabhi padaav nahi daala, yahan tak ke kaha jaane laga ke agar unpar aik kapda phaila diya jaaye to woh sab ko dhaank le.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, used to lag behind during marches to accommodate the weak, and he repeated and prayed for them. This is a Sahih (authentic) report according to the condition of Muslim, and it has not been excluded according to the condition of Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "safar mein peechhe reh jaate taake kamzoron ko aage badhaayein aur unhein apni sawaari par bithaayein aur unke liye dua karein." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded to kill him: he was a spy of AbuSufyan and an ally of a man of the Ansar. He passed a circle of the Ansar and said: I am a Muslim. A man from the Ansar said, Messenger of Allah, he is saying that he is a Muslim. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There are people among you in whose faith we trust. Furat ibn Hayyan is one of them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2652)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne uske qatl ka hukum diya, aur woh Abu Sufyan ke liye jaasoos tha, woh Ansar ki aik majlis se guzra aur kaha: "Main Musalman hoon." To woh use Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas le gaye aur kaha: "Yeh keh raha hai ke woh Musalman hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se kuch aadmi hain jinke imaan ko hum unke apne (bataaye) par chhod dete hain, unme se Furat bin Hayyan (RA) hain."

e: The Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, disliked shouting while fighting. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2656)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba "jung ke waqt awaaz uthaana napasand karte the." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "This is an authentic narration according to the condition set by the two Sheikhs. They did not exclude it. The narration of Hisham Al-Dastuwa'i provides evidence for it, and it is more reliable."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jung ke waqt awaaz uthaana napasand karte the." Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur Hisham Ad-Dastuwai ki hadith iska shahid hai, aur yehi zyada mehfooz hai.

e: [AI] When the Prophet ﷺ  encountered the polytheists on the day of Hunayn, he dismounted from his camel. This narration is authentic according to the conditions set by both scholars (al-Bukhari and Muslim). They did not dispute it, and it is not valid to say that he ﷺ  dismounted and fought a man except for this incident, as mentioned by al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) Hunain ke din mushrikeen se mile, to "aap (SAW) apne khachhar (khacchar) se utre aur paidal ho gaye." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala, "aur yeh sahih nahi ke aap (SAW) ne kabhi paidal hokar jung ki ho siwaye is riwayat ke." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: I was present at fighting along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and when he did not fight at the beginning of the day, he waited till the sun had passed the meridian, the winds blew, and help came down. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2655)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath maujood tha, "jab woh subah se jung nahi karte to jung ko dair karte yahan tak ke suraj dhal jaata aur hawaen chalne lagti (aur madad utarti)."

e: [AI] Abu Talha used to shoot arrows on the day of Uhud, between the Prophet's ﷺ hand and the Prophet's ﷺ back. Abu Talha was a skilled archer, and when he shot, the Prophet ﷺ would raise his head to see where the arrow would land. Abu Talha would lift his chest and say, "O Messenger of Allah, I swear by my father, no arrow will harm you without harming me." Abu Talha would wish to be in front of the Prophet ﷺ and say, "O Messenger of Allah, I am your shield, so command me to do whatever you please."
hi: Abu Talha (RA) Uhud ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke aage teer chala rahe the aur Rasulullah (SAW) unke peechhe the, Abu Talha (RA) achha teer-andaaz the, aur jab woh teer chalaate to Nabi (SAW) apna sar oopar uthaate taake dekh sakein ke unka teer kahan gira, to Abu Talha (RA) apna seena uthaate aur kehte: "Aise, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), koi teer aapko na lage, mera seena aapki gardan se pehle aaye." Aur Abu Talha (RA) chahte the ke woh khud Rasulullah (SAW) ke aage aa jaayen, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main apni qaum mein sabse mazboot hoon, isliye aap jo chaahen mujhe hukum dein."

e: [AI] That which did actions to us.
hi: "Yehi hai jisne humare sath yeh afsoos-naak kaam kiye."

e: [AI] Ibn Mas'ud, I was with the Messenger of Allah on the day of Hunayn. The people turned away from him, but I remained with him along with eighty men from the Muhajireen and the Ansar. We were walking on our feet about eighty steps without turning back. They were the ones on whom Allah sent tranquility. The Messenger of Allah was on his riding animal, advancing forward. His riding animal swerved, and he turned away from the saddle, so his neck became cut. I said, "May Allah elevate you." He said, "Pass me a handful of dirt." So, I handed it to him and he struck their faces with it, and their eyes became filled with dust. He said, "Where are the Muhajireen and the Ansar?" I said, "They are here." He said, "Call out to them." So, they came, and their swords were still in their hands as if they were shooting meteors. The disbelievers turned away fleeing.
hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: main Hunain ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tha, jab log unse peeth pher kar bhaag gaye, to main unke sath aassi (80) aadmiyon, Muhajireen aur Ansar mein se, ke sath reh gaya, hum apne pairon par jame rahe taqreeban aassi qadam, aur humne unhein peeth nahi dikhaayi, aur yehi woh log the jinpar Allah ne sakoon nazil kiya. Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) apne khachhar (khacchar) par aage badh rahe the, achanak unka khacchar bhataka aur woh zeen se jhuk gaye, unka jism aage ki taraf jhuk gaya, maine kaha: "Uth jaayein, Allah aapko buland kare." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe aik mutthi mitti do." Maine unhein di, to unhone ise unke (dushmano ke) chehron par phenka, unki aankhein mitti se bhar gayin. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Muhajireen aur Ansar kahan hain?" Maine kaha: "Woh yahan hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein pukaaro." To woh aaye, unki talwaarein unke haathon mein aise thin jaise shooting stars, aur mushrikeen ne apni peeth pher li.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever says, 'I seek forgiveness from Allah, the One whom there is no deity worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence, and I repent to Him,' three times, his sins will be forgiven even if he was fleeing from the battlefield."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo 'Astaghfirullahal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilaih' teen martaba kahe, uske gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain, chahe woh jung se bhaagne wala hi kyun na ho."

e: [AI] I went to Al-Miqdad ibn Al-Aswad, the horseman of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , while he was sitting on a tomb made of "Sayyara" (a type of stone), and he was separating bones from it while intending to go for battle. I said, "May Allah forgive you." He replied, "Come to the Surah of Al-Buhuth." Allah Almighty said, "March forth lightly or heavily" [Surah At-Tawbah 9:41], meaning the Surah of At-Tawbah. "This is a correct narration, and they did not deny it."
hi: Main Miqdad bin Al-Aswad (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghude-sawaar, ke paas pahuncha jabke woh sarraafon ke sanduq jaisi aik sanduq par baithe the aur usme se aik haddi alag kar rahe the, aur woh jung ke liye jaana chahte the, maine kaha: "Allah ne aapko (buzurgi ke) uzr de diya hai." Unhone kaha: "Surah 'Al-Buhuth' ki taraf jao," Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Halke ho ya bhaari, nikal khade ho}" (Surah At-Tawbah 41) - ya'ni Surah At-Tawbah. "Yeh sahih-ul-isnad hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Sahih.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ became upset with the Arabs and they became slow, so (the verse) 'Unless you go forth, He will punish you with a painful punishment' [Surah At-Tawbah: 39] was revealed. He said their punishment was the withholding of rain from them."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Arab ke aik qabile ko bulaawa diya, unhone susti dikhaayi, to yeh nazil hui: "{Agar tum nahi nikloge to woh tumhein dardnaak azab dega}" (Surah At-Tawbah 39), unhone kaha: unka azab baarish ka rok liya jaana tha.

e:
[AI] The translation into English is:

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was in one of his expeditions and he passed by a group of women from Muzaynah. One of their male servants followed him. When they were on a certain road, the servant greeted him and asked, "Is that so-and-so?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "Yes." The servant asked, "What is your business?" He replied, "I fight alongside you." The servant then asked, "Did your mistress give you permission?" He replied, "No." The servant said, "Go back to her and inform her, for a person like you is like a servant who does not pray and dies before returning to his master. So, recite the greetings of peace upon her." The servant returned to her and conveyed the message. She said, "Did Allah command you to recite the greetings of peace upon me?" He replied, "Yes." She said, "Go back and strive alongside him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apne kisi ghazwe mein the, aap (SAW) Muzaynah qabile ke kuch logon ke paas se guzre, to unme se aik aurat ka ghulam unke peechhe ho liya, jab woh raaste mein kahin the to usne unhein salaam kiya, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Fulan?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhara kya maamla hai?" Usne kaha: "Main aapke sath jihad karna chahta hoon." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhari malika ne tumhein ijaazat di hai?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uske paas wapas jao aur use bata do, kyunke tumhari misaal us ghulam jaisi hai jo namaz nahi padhta agar tum uske paas wapas jaane se pehle mar jao, aur usse mera salaam kehna." To woh uske paas wapas gaya aur use khabar di, usne poocha: "Allah ki qasam, kya unhone hukum diya ke tum mujhe salaam kaho?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Usne kaha: "To wapas jao aur unke sath jihad karo."

e: All the sins of a Shahid (martyr) are forgiven except debt. (Using translation from Muslim 1886a)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shaheed ka har gunah maaf kar diya jaata hai siwaye qarz ke."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'Verily, the first drop of blood shed by a martyr forgives his sins.'"
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak shaheed ka jo pehla khoon bahaaya jaata hai, usi se uske gunah maaf ho jaate hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever meets the enemy and remains patient until he is killed or victorious, he will not be tested in his grave."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo dushman se mile aur sabr kare yahan tak ke woh maara jaaye ya fatah paaye, use qabar mein azmaaish (sawaal-jawaab) nahi hogi."

e: [AI] I heard Jabir bin Abdullah say that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, lost Hamza when the people turned away from the battle. A man said, "I saw him by those trees saying, 'I am the lion of Allah and the lion of His Messenger. O Allah, I disassociate myself from what these people have done, Abu Sufyan and his companions. I apologize to You for their defeat.' So, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, leaned towards him, and when he saw his side, he cried. And when he saw what he was wrapped in, he sobbed. Then he said, 'Isn't there a funeral shroud?' A man from the Ansar stood up and threw a garment on him, then another man stood up and threw a garment on him. Jabir said, 'O Messenger of Allah, this garment is for your father, and this one is for my uncle Hamza.' Then Hamza was brought and the Prophet, peace be upon him, prayed over him. Then the martyrs were brought and placed next to Hamza, and he prayed for them. Then they were lifted and Hamza was left behind until he prayed for all the martyrs. Jabir said, 'I returned while feeling heavy-hearted, for my father had left debts and family behind. When it was night time, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, sent for me and said, 'O Jabir, indeed Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has revived your father and made him speak.' I said, 'And he spoke?' He said, 'He asked for something.' I said, 'What did he ask for?' He said, 'He asked for his soul to be returned and for his enemies to be resurrected so that he may fight for the sake of Allah and be killed again.' Jabir said, 'I believed that they would not return.' The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'Hamza is the leader of the martyrs on the Day of Resurrection, according to an authentic chain of narrators, and Abu Hammad is the one who omitted it.'"
hi: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hamza (RA) ko na paaya jab log jung se palat aaye, to aik shakhs ne kaha: "Maine unhein un darakhton ke paas dekha tha, woh keh rahe the: 'Main Allah ka sher hoon aur uske Rasool ka sher hoon, Aye Allah, main tujhse un logon ki baat se bezaari zaahir karta hoon jo yeh log - Abu Sufyan aur uske saathi - le kar aaye hain, aur main tujhse maazrat chahta hoon un logon ke shikast khaane par jo unhone kiya.'" To Rasulullah (SAW) unki taraf jhuke, jab unka pehlu dekha to ro pade, aur jab unke sath jo kiya gaya woh dekha to hichki (bilakh) le kar rone lage, phir farmaya: "Kya koi kafan nahi?" To Ansar ka aik shakhs khada hua aur unpar aik kapda daala, phir doosra khada hua aur unpar aik aur kapda daala, to (Rasulullah SAW ne) farmaya: "Aye Jabir, yeh kapda tumhare waalid ke liye hai aur yeh mere chacha Hamza ke liye." Phir Hamza (RA) ko laaya gaya, aap (SAW) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, phir shuhada ko laaya jaata, unhein Hamza (RA) ke pehlu mein rakha jaata, aap (SAW) unki namaz padhte, phir unhein uthaaya jaata aur Hamza (RA) ko chhod diya jaata, yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ne sab shuhada ki namaz padhi. Unhone kaha: to main bhaari dil ke sath wapas laut aaya, mere waalid ne mujhpar qarz aur bacchon ki zimmedari chhodi thi, jab raat ho gayi to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bulaawa bheja aur farmaya: "Aye Jabir, Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne tumhare waalid ko zinda kiya aur unse kalaam kiya." Maine poocha: "Aur unse kalaam kiya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah ne unse kaha: "Kuch maango," to unhone kaha: "Main chahta hoon ke tu meri rooh wapas kar de aur mujhe waise hi paida kar jaisa main pehle tha, aur mujhe tere Nabi ki taraf wapas bhej de taake main Allah ki raah mein jung karoon aur dobara maara jaaun." Allah ne farmaya: "Maine faisla kar diya hai ke woh wapas nahi jaate." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qayamat ke din Allah ke nazdeek shuhada ke sardaar Hamza (RA) hain." Sahih-ul-isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Abu Hammad, jo Al-Mufaddal bin Sadaqah hain, ke baare mein An-Nasa'i ne kaha ke woh matrook (chhoda hua raawi) hain.

e: [AI] Hamza was wrapped in a shroud in a coffin, and whenever they stretched it over his head, his legs would stick out. And when they stretched it over his legs, his head would stick out. The Prophet ﷺ commanded them to stretch it over his head and put musk on his legs. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If it were not for Safiyyah's heartbreak, we would have left Hamza unburied until Hamza is resurrected from the bellies of birds and animals."
hi: Hamza (RA) ko aik chaadar mein kafan diya gaya, jab woh use unke sar par phailaate to unke pair khul jaate, aur jab pairon par phailaate to sar khul jaata, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh use sar par phailaayen aur pairon par idhkhir (khushbudaar ghaas) rakh dein, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar Safiyyah (RA) ko sadma na hota to hum Hamza (RA) ko chhod dete, unhein dafan na karte yahan tak ke Hamza (RA) parindon aur darindon ke pait se uthaaye jaate."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ opened Mecca, then went to Ta'if and surrounded them with eight or seven men. Then he stayed there for the morning or afternoon, then he descended and migrated. Then he said, "O people! I am your forbidding excess and I advise you to be good to my family. Your meeting place is the Pond (in Paradise). And by the One in Whose hand is my soul, you will establish prayer and give zakat, or else I will send a man from among myself, or like myself, who will strike the necks of the fighters among them, and take their children captive." The people thought that he meant Abu Bakr or Umar, so he took Ali by the hand and said, "This is this." This hadith has a sound chain of narrators and Talaq bin Ali did not include it in his book Al-Amadah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Makkah fatah ki, phir Ta'if ki taraf mudkar unhein ghera daala, aath ya saat (dinon tak), phir aik subah ya shaam gehre andar gaye, phir utre, phir dopahar ki garmi mein aaraam kiya, phir farmaya: "Aye logo, main tumse aage jaane wala hoon, aur main tumhein apni ahl-e-bait ke sath achha sulook karne ki wasiyat karta hoon, tumhara mera wada Haudh (Kausar) hai, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum zaroor namaz qaayam karogay aur zakat dogay, warna main tum par apni taraf se ya apne jaisa aik shakhs bhejunga jo tumhare jung karne walon ki gardanein maarega aur tumhari aulaad ko qaid karega." Unhone kaha: to logon ne khayal kiya ke aap (SAW) ka ishara Abu Bakr (RA) ya Umar (RA) ki taraf hai, to aap (SAW) ne Ali (RA) ka haath pakda aur farmaya: "Yehi hai, yehi hai." Hadith sahih-ul-isnad hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Talhah mo'tabar (bharosemand) nahi hain.

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever shoots an arrow in the cause of Allah and it hits the target, it will raise him one level in Paradise.' That day I shot sixteen arrows that hit their targets." He said: "And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever shoots an arrow in the cause of Allah, it is equal to the reward of freeing a slave.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3143)
hi: To maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein teer chalaaye, uske liye aik ghulam azaad karne ke barabar (sawaab) hai, aur jo koi Allah ki raah mein teer se (nishaana) pahunchaaye, uske liye Jannat mein aik darja hai." To maine aik din solah (16) teer nishaane par pahunchaaye.

e: [AI] "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in Ta'if during the battle of Hunayn. When we reached Ji'ranah, he distributed silver among the people."
hi: "Hum Ta'if mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain ki jung mein the, jab woh Al-Ji'ranah pahunche to unhone chandi logon mein taqseem ki."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to Hawazin with twelve thousand men, and on the day of Hunayn, the people of Taif were killed like those who were killed on the day of Badr. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took a handful of pebbles and threw them at our faces, and we were defeated."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) baara hazaar (12,000) ke sath Hawazin aaye, Hunain ke din Ta'if walon mein se utne hi maare gaye jitne Badr ke din maare gaye the, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik mutthi kankariyan uthaayin aur humare chehron par phenki, to hum shikast kha gaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out on one of his expeditions, and I and another man went to meet him before embracing Islam. We said, "We feel embarrassed to witness a scene where our people are being fought." He said, "Have you both embraced Islam?" We replied, "No." He said, "Then we do not seek the assistance of pagans against pagans." So we embraced Islam and witnessed alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . I killed a man, and the man struck me. I then married his daughter, who would say, "May you never be deprived of a husband who fought vigorously like this man." I would respond, "May you never be deprived of a husband who rushed your father to the Hellfire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apne kisi ghazwe mein nikle, main aur aik aur shakhs unke paas aaye Islam qubool karne se pehle, humne kaha: "Humein sharm aati hai ke humari qaum kisi maidaan mein maujood ho (aur hum na hon)." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum dono ne Islam qubool kiya hai?" Humne kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To hum mushrikeen ke khilaaf mushrikeen se madad nahi lete." To humne Islam qubool kiya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath maidaan mein maujood rahe, maine aik shakhs ko qatl kiya aur us shakhs ne mujhe aik zarb lagayi, phir maine uski beti se nikah kar liya, woh kaha karti thin: "Kaash tumhein aisa shakhs milta jo tumhein yeh nishaan de sake," to main kehta: "Kaash tumhein aisa shakhs na milta jisne tumhare waalid ko jaldi Jahannam mein pahunchaaya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, went out until he reached Thaniyyat al-Wada'. Suddenly, he found a group of people and asked, "Who are these?" They said, "The Banu Qaynuqa' tribe, and they are the followers of Abdullah ibn Salam." He asked, "Have they embraced Islam?" They replied, "No, they are still following their own religion." He then said, "Tell them to go back, as we do not seek help from the polytheists."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) nikle yahan tak ke jab woh Thaniyyat-ul-Wada' se guzre, achanak wahan aik dasta (fauj) tha, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Banu Qainuqa," jo Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ka qabila hai. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya woh Musalman ho gaye hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke woh apne (purane) deen par hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unse kaho ke woh wapas chale jaayen, kyunke hum mushrikeen se madad nahi lete."

e: [AI] He informed him that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, fought a battle in which Khalid bin Al-Walid was leading the vanguard. They passed by a dead woman who had been affected by the fighting in the vanguard, and they stopped to marvel at her features. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, then caught up with them and they made way for him until he saw her. He said, "This was the one who fought." Then he looked at the faces of the people and said to one of them, "The right of Khalid bin Al-Walid should not be taken away. He should not be killed nor subjected to any kind of punishment." This narration was reported by Al-Mughira bin Abd al-Rahman and Ibn Juraij from Abu al-Zinad. "This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of both sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim) and they did not exclude it." Reported by Ibn Juraij and others from Abu al-Zinad according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Unhein khabar di ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik jung ki jismein Khalid bin Al-Walid (RA) unke aage-aage dasta lekar chal rahe the, Rabah aur unke saathi aik maari gayi aurat ke paas se guzre jo aage waale dastay ki chapet mein aayi thi, woh uske paas khade hokar uski (jismani) banaawat par hairaan hone lage, yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas pahunche, unhone aap (SAW) ke liye raasta banaaya yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ne use dekha, phir farmaya: "Yeh to jung nahi kar rahi thi." Phir aap (SAW) ne logon ke chehron ki taraf dekha aur unme se aik se farmaya: "Khalid bin Al-Walid (RA) ke paas jao aur kaho ke woh kisi aulaad ko na maare aur na hi kisi khidmat-gaar ko." Isi tarah Al-Mughirah bin Abdur Rahman aur Ibn Jurayj ne, Abu Az-Zinad se, riwayat ki hai, "to yeh hadith Shaykhain ki shart par sahih ban gayi, dono ne ise nahi nikala."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a secret troop on the day of Khaybar to fight the polytheists. They continued fighting until they reached a village. When they arrived, the Prophet ﷺ  asked them, "What led you to kill the villagers?" They replied, "O Messenger of Allah, they were the children of the polytheists." He said, "And were your children any better than the children of the polytheists? By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, every child is born on the fitrah (natural inclination towards monotheism) until his tongue speaks for him."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khaybar ke din aik dasta bheja, unhone mushrikeen se jung ki, unka qatl-e-aam bachchon tak pahunch gaya, jab woh wapas aaye to Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein bachchon ko qatl karne par kis cheez ne ubhaara?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh to mushrikeen ki aulaad thi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhare sabse behtareen log bhi mushrikeen ki aulaad nahi hain? Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, koi bhi jaan aisi nahi jo paida ho magar fitrat (Islam ke fitri milne) par ho, yahan tak ke uski zubaan use zaahir kar de."

e: [AI] We were in a battle, and then he mentioned the narration in its similar form.
hi: "Hum apni aik jung mein thay," phir unhone hadith isi jaisi zikr ki. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "I was presented to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the Battle of Quraizah, and they complained about me. The Prophet ﷺ commanded them to look at me if I had pubic hair. They looked at me and did not find that I had pubic hair, so the Prophet ﷺ left me and included me among the prisoners." This hadith was narrated by a group of Muslim scholars from Abdul Malik ibn Umayr, but they did not mention it. It seems that they did not carefully consider the narration as Mujahid bin Jubair followed Abdul Malik in his narration according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne Banu Qurayzah ke din pesh kiya gaya, unhein mere baare mein shak hua, "to Nabi (SAW) ne hukum diya ke woh dekhein ke kya mujhme baaligh honay ki alaamat zaahir hui hai ya nahi, unhone dekha to unhein mujhme woh alaamat nazar nahi aayi, to unhone mujhe chhod diya aur qaidiyon mein shaamil kar diya." Yeh hadith Musalman imamon ke aik giroh ne Abdul Malik bin Umair se riwayat ki hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur aisa lagta hai ke unhone Mujahid bin Jubair ke Abdul Malik ki, Atiyyah Al-Qurazi se riwayat mein, mutaba'at par ghor nahi kiya. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] He informed him that the companions of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) undressed him on the day of Quraizah and saw the Moses affliction on his head meaning his head injury, so they left him from killing him. The hadith became authentic through the continuity of Mujahid's narration according to the condition of the two Shaykhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim) and they did not exclude it according to the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Unhein khabar di ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ne "Banu Qurayzah ke din unhein (jaanch ke liye) khada kiya, unhein baaligh honay ki alaamat nazar nahi aayi, to unhone unhein qatl se bacha liya." Mujahid ki mutaba'at ki wajah se yeh hadith "Shaykhain ki shart par sahih ban gayi, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "To kill all those upon whom the decree of Moses has fallen and to divide their wealth and progeny." The Prophet ﷺ  was then informed about this, so he said, "Indeed, today they have been judged by the judgment of Allah, with which He judges from above the heavens." Sahih
hi: Ke unme se har us shakhs ko qatl kiya jaaye jo baaligh ho chuka ho, aur unka maal aur unki aulaad taqseem ki jaaye, phir yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki gayi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aaj unke baare mein Allah ke usi faisle ke mutabiq faisla kiya gaya hai jo usne saat aasmano ke oopar se sunaaya tha." Sahih.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent Abdullah ibn Ghalib al-Laythi along with a detachment and I was also with them. He ordered them to attach Banu al-Mulawwih from all sides at al-Kadid. So we went out and when we reached al-Kadid we met al-Harith ibn al-Barsa al-Laythi, and seized him. He said: I came with the intention of embracing Islam, and I came out to go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. We said: If you are a Muslim, there is no harm if we keep you in chains for a day and night; and if you are not, we shall tie you with chains. So we tied him with chains. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2678)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Ghalib Al-Laythi (RA) ko aik dastay mein bheja, aur main unme shaamil tha, aap (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh Banu Al-Mulawwih par Al-Kadid mein chadhaai karein, hum nikle yahan tak ke jab hum Al-Kadid mein pahunche to humein Al-Harith bin Al-Barsa Al-Laythi mile, humne unhein pakad liya, unhone kaha: "Main to Islam qubool karne ki niyat se aaya hoon, aur main Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf nikla hoon." To humne kaha: "Agar tum Musalman ho to humara aik din raat ka bandhna tumhein nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayega, aur agar aisa nahi hai to hum tumhein mazboot bandh lengay," to humne unhein mazbooti se bandh diya.

e: Ibrahim said: Ad-Dahhak ibn Qays intended to appoint Masruq as governor. Thereupon Umarah ibn Uqbah said to him: Are you appointing a man from the remnants of the murderers of Uthman? Masruq said to him: Ibn Mas'ud narrated to us, and he was trustworthy in respect of traditions, that when the Prophet ﷺ intended to kill your father, he said: Who will look after my children? He replied: Fire. I also like for you what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ liked for you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2686)
hi: Ke jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne uske waalid ko qatl karne ka irada kiya, to usne poocha: "Bachchon ka kya hoga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aag." (Unhone kaha:) "Maine tumhare liye wahi pasand kiya hai jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne pasand kiya."

e: The Prophet ﷺ fixed the ransom of the people of pre-Islamic Arabia at four hundred dirhams per head on the day of the battle of Badr. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2691)
hi: Ke "Nabi (SAW) ne Badr ke din jaahiliyat waalon ka fidya (chhudaai ki raqam) chaar sau (400) muqarrar kiya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded me to sell two of the captives, so I sold them and then I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him about their sale. He said, "Did you separate them?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Return them, then sell them and do not separate them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main qaidiyon mein se do bhaiyon ko bechoon, maine unhein becha, phir main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein unki bikri ki khabar di, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumne unke darmiyan judaai daali?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unhein wapas le lo, phir unhein sath mein becho, aur unke darmiyan judaai mat daalo."

e: [AI] He separated a mother from her child, so the Prophet ﷺ  forbade that and prohibited the sale, according to the condition set by Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Ke unhone "aik laundi aur uske bachche ke darmiyan judaai daali, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein isse mana kiya aur soda mansookh kar diya." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: Some slaves (of the unbelievers) went out to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of al-Hudaybiyyah before treaty. Their masters wrote to him saying: O Muhammad, they have not gone out to you with an interest in your religion, but they have gone out to escape from slavery. Some people said: They have spoken the truth, Messenger of Allah, send them back to them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ became angry and said: I do not see your restraining yourself from this action), group of Quraysh, but that Allah send someone to you who strike your necks. He then refused to return them, and said: They are emancipated (slaves) of Allah, the Exalted. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2700)
hi: Do ghulam Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Hudaybiyyah ke din, sulah se pehle, aaye, to unke maalikon ne aap (SAW) ko likha aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, Allah ki qasam, woh aapki taraf apne deen mein raghbat ki wajah se nahi nikle, balke woh ghulami se bhaagne ke liye nikle hain." To kuch logon ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh sach keh rahe hain, unhein wapas kar dein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghussa aaya aur farmaya: "Aye Quraish ke giroh, mujhe nahi lagta tum log is se baaz aaogay yahan tak ke Allah tumpar aisa shakhs bhej de jo isi baat par tumhari gardanein maaray." Aur aap (SAW) ne unhein wapas karne se inkaar kar diya, aur farmaya: "Yeh Allah ke azaad kiye huay hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "No people have ever broken their covenant except that killing has become widespread among them, and no people have ever committed immorality except that Allah has caused them to suffer calamities and diseases that never befell their ancestors, and no people have ever withheld Zakah except that Allah made the rain fall withheld from them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi qaum kabhi ahd nahi todti magar unke darmiyan qatl-o-qital phail jaata hai, aur kisi qaum mein kabhi fahaashi (khulla gunah) zaahir nahi hoti magar Allah unpar maut musallat kar deta hai, aur koi qaum kabhi zakat rokti nahi magar Allah unse baarish rok leta hai."

e: Muhammad ibn AbulMujahid reported Abdullah ibn AbuAwfa as saying: I asked: Did you set aside the fifth of the food in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He replied: On the day of Khaybar we captured food and a man would come and take as much food of it as needed and then go away. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2704)
hi: Maine poocha: "Kya aap log Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein khaane ka paanchwa hissa nikaalte the?" Unhone kaha: "Humein Khaybar ke din khaana mila, aik aadmi aata aur usme se utna le leta jitna use kaafi hota, phir chala jaata."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The scent of Paradise can be found from a distance of a hundred years, and whoever kills a person under the protection of a treaty will not smell the fragrance of Paradise, even though its fragrance can be detected from a distance." Abu Bakr said, "May Allah make me deaf if I did not hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say this."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ki khushbu sau (100) saal ke faasle se paayi jaati hai, aur koi bandah kisi ahd wale (mu'ahid) shakhs ko qatl nahi karta magar Allah uspar Jannat aur uski khushbu, ke woh use paaye, haram kar deta hai." Abu Bakrah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah mere kaan bahra kar de agar maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate na suna ho."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever kills a person from among Ahl Adh-Dhimmah, he will not smell the fragrance of Paradise, and its fragrance may be detected from a distance of forty years." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4750)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi ahl-e-zimmah (mu'aahidon) mein se kisi ko qatl kare, woh Jannat ki khushbu nahi paayega, jabke uski khushbu itne-itne faasle se mehsoos ki jaati hai."

e: “Whoever kills a Mu'ahid who has the protection of Allah and the protection of his Messenger, will not smell the fragrance of Paradise, even though its fragrance may be detected from a distance of Seventy years.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2687)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khabardar! Jo koi kisi mu'aahid ko qatl kare jispar Allah aur uske Rasool ki zimmedari ho, usne Allah ki zimmedari tod di, aur woh Jannat ki khushbu nahi paayega, jabke uski khushbu sattar (70) saal ke faasle se mehsoos ki jaati hai." Muslim ki shart par.

e: A man from the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ died on the day of Khaybar. They mentioned the matter to the Messenger of Allah. He said: Offer prayer over your companion. When the faces of the people looked perplexed, he said: Your companion misappropriated booty in the path of Allah. We searched his belongings and found some Jewish beads not worth two dirhams. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2710)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik shakhs Hunain ke din wafat paa gaye, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr kiya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne saathi ki namaz padho." To logon ke chehre badal gaye is baat par, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhare saathi ne Allah ki raah mein khiyanat ki hai." To humne unka saaman talaash kiya, humein Yahoodiyon ki kuch mohren milin jinki qeemat do dirham bhi nahi thi.

e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gained booty he ordered Bilal to make a public announcement. He made a public announcement, and when the people brought their booty, he would take a fifth and divide it. Thereafter a man brought a halter of hair and said: Messenger of Allah, this is a part of the booty we got. He asked: Have you heard Bilal making announcement three times? He replied: Yes. He asked: What did prevent you from bringing it? He made some excuse, to which he said: Be (as you are), you may bring it on the Day of Judgment, for I shall not accept it from you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2712)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab maal-e-ghaneemat paate to Bilal (RA) ko hukum dete, woh logon mein aalaan karte, to log apna maal-e-ghaneemat le kar aate, aap (SAW) uska paanchwa hissa nikaalte aur baaqi taqseem karte. Iske baad aik shakhs aik baalon ki lagaam le kar aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh us maal-e-ghaneemat mein se hai jo humein mila tha." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumne Bilal (RA) ko teen martaba pukaarte suna?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "To tumhein isse laane se kis cheez ne roka?" Usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW)," aur maazrat karne laga. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum khud hi ise Qayamat ke din le aana, main ise tumse hargiz qubool nahi karunga."

e: [AI] Muslima entered the land of the Romans, and a man who had gone astray was brought to her. She asked Salim about him, and he said, "I heard my father narrating from Umar ibn al-Khattab, from the Prophet ﷺ , who said, 'If you find a man who has gone astray, burn his belongings and strike him.'" So they found a copy of the Quran among his belongings, and Salim was asked about it. He said, "Sell it and give the proceeds in charity."
hi: Maslamah Room ki zameen mein dakhil huay, unke paas aik shakhs laaya gaya jisne khiyanat ki thi, unhone Salim se uske baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Maine apne waalid ko Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, hadith bayan karte suna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum kisi aadmi ko khiyanat karte huay paao, to uska saaman jala do aur usse maaro.'" Unhone kaha: to humein uske saaman mein aik Mus-haf (Quran) mila, Salim se iske baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Ise bech do aur uski qeemat sadqa kar do."

e: “When the Prophet was expelled from Makkah, Abu Bakr said to him: ‘They have driven out their Prophet, verily to Allah we belong and to Him we return. They are surely doomed.’ Then it was revealed: ‘Permission to fight (against disbelievers) is given to those (believers) who are fought against, because they have been wronged; and surely, Allah is able to give them (believers) victory.’ Then I knew that there would be fighting.” Ibn Abbas said: “This is the first Verse that was revealed concerning fighting.” (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3085)
hi: Jab Makkah walon ne Nabi (SAW) ko nikaal diya, to Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne kaha: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon, unhone apne Nabi ko nikaal diya hai, yeh log zaroor halaak honge." Unhone kaha: to yeh nazil hui: "{Un logon ko jung ki ijaazat di gayi hai jinke khilaaf jung ki jaati hai kyunke unpar zulm hua hai, aur beshak Allah unki madad par zaroor qaadir hai}" (Surah Al-Hajj 39), aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ise 'Uzina' (ijaazat di gayi) padha karte the. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne kaha: "To mujhe pata chal gaya ke yeh jung ke baare mein hai." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur yehi jung ke baare mein sabse pehli nazil hone wali ayat hai."

e: that Abdur-Rahman bin Awf and some of his companions came to the Prophet in Makkah and said: “O Messenger of Allah! We were respected when we were idolaters and when we believed, we were humiliated.” He said: “I have been commanded to pardon, so do not fight.” Then, when Allah caused us to move to Al-Madinah, He commanded us to fight, but they refrained. Then Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, revealed: Have you not seen those who were told to hold back their hands (from fighting) and perform As-Salah” (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3086)
hi: Ke Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA) aur unke kuch saathi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, hum izzat mein the jab hum mushrik the, aur jab hum imaan laaye to hum zaleel ho gaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe darguzar karne ka hukum diya gaya hai, isliye qaum se jung mat karo." Jab Allah ne unhein Madinah ki taraf mudkar bheja to unhein jung ka hukum diya, to woh ruk gaye, phir Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Kya tumne un logon ko nahi dekha jinse kaha gaya tha ke apne haath rok lo aur namaz qaayam karo aur zakat do, phir jab unpar jung farz ki gayi to unme se aik giroh logon se aise darne laga}" (Surah An-Nisa 77).

e: [AI] About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered a sermon on the day of Tabuk and said: 'There is no person like the one who holds onto the reins and strives in the cause of Allah, avoiding the evil of people. And there is no person like the one who tends to his herd and fulfills the rights of his guest.'" I (the narrator) said, "Did he say it?" He (the narrator) said, "He said it three times, so I raised my voice in Takbir (saying Allahu Akbar), praised Allah, and expressed gratitude."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Tabuk ke din khutba diya aur farmaya: "Logon mein us aadmi jaisa koi nahi jo (ghode ki) lagaam thaame Allah ki raah mein jihad kare aur logon ki buraiyon se bacha rahe, aur na hi us aadmi jaisa koi hai jo apni bakriyon mein registaan mein rehta ho, apne mehmaan ki khaatirdaari kare, aur uska haq ada kare." Maine poocha: "Kya aap (SAW) ne yeh kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) ne isse teen martaba kaha," to maine takbeer kahi, hamd ki, aur shukr ada kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Shall I not tell you about the best of people in status?" They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "A man who takes the reins of his horse for the sake of Allah until he is killed or dies. And shall I not tell you about the one who comes after him? A man who isolates himself in a mountain, establishing prayer and giving charity, and he testifies that there is no god but Allah."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein logon mein sabse behtareen martaba wale ki khabar na doon?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh aadmi jo apne ghode ki lagaam Allah ki raah mein thaame rahe yahan tak ke woh maara jaaye ya mar jaaye. Kya main tumhein uske baad wale ki khabar na doon? Woh aadmi jo kisi ghaati mein alag-thalag ho, namaz qaayam kare, zakat de, aur gawahi de ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi."

e: "in the year of Tabuk, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed the people, while leaning against his mount. He said: 'Shall I not tell you of the best of the people and the worst of the people? Among the best of the people is a man who strives in the cause of Allah on the back of his horse, or on the back of his camel, or on his own two feet, until death comes to him. And among the worst of the people, is an immoral man (Fajir) who reads the Book of Allah but he does not refrain from doing anything bad because of it.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3106)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Tabuk ke saal khade huay aur logon ko khutba di jabke aap (SAW) ki peeth aik khajoor ke darakht se lagi hui thi, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein sabse behtareen logon aur sabse buray logon ki khabar na doon? Beshak sabse behtareen logon mein se woh aadmi hai jo Allah ki raah mein apne ghode ki peeth par, ya apne oont ki peeth par, ya apne pairon par amal karta rahe yahan tak ke uske paas maut aa jaaye, aur beshak sabse buray logon mein se woh gunahgaar, jasoor aadmi hai jo Allah ki Kitaab padhta hai magar usme se kisi cheez se ruktaa nahi."

e: [AI] "Narrated that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: 'A day in the way of Allah is better than a thousand days in what is other than it, so let everyone look to himself.'"
hi: Unhone humein bataya ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Allah ki raah mein aik din iske ilawa hazaar dino se behtar hai, isliye har aadmi apne liye khud dekhe."

e: A man from the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ passed by ravine containing a small spring of thirst quenching water, so he was amazed by how pleasant it was. So he said: 'I should leave the people and stay in this ravine. But I will not do it until I seek permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.' So he mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said: 'Do not do so. For indeed one of you standing in the cause of Allah is more virtuous that his Salat in his house for seventy years. Do you not love that Allah forgive your sins and admit you into Paradise ? Then fight in the cause of Allah, for whoever fights in Allah's cause for the time it takes for two milkings of a camel, then Paradise is obligatory for him.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1650)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik shakhs aik ghaati se guzre jismein meetha paani ka aik chashma tha, unhein uska pani aur khoobsurti pasand aayi, to unhone kaha: "Kaash main logon se alag hokar isi ghaati mein baithh jaata," phir kaha: "Nahi, main aisa nahi karunga jab tak Rasulullah (SAW) se ijaazat na le lun." To unhone yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aisa mat karo, kyunke tum mein se kisi ka Allah ki raah mein khade rehna uske apne ghar mein sattar (70) saal ki namaz se behtar hai. Kya tum yeh pasand nahi karte ke Allah tumhein maaf kar de aur Jannat mein daakhil kare? Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, jo koi Allah ki raah mein aik oontni ke doodh nikaalne jitni der bhi jung kare, uske liye Jannat wajib ho jaati hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The position of a man in a row in the way of Allah is better in the sight of Allah than the worship of a man for sixty years."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik aadmi ka Allah ki raah mein saf mein khada hona, Allah ke nazdeek, aik aadmi ki saath (60) saal ki ibaadat se behtar hai."

e: [AI] We were sitting with a group of companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and we said, "If only we knew which actions are most beloved to Allah, we would do them." So Allah, the Mighty and Wise, revealed {Glorify Allah, whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise} until the end of the Surah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited it to us. This is what Al-Awza'i said, and Yahya ibn Abi Kathir recited it to us in Makkah. Muhammad ibn Kathir also recited it to us, and Al-Awza'i recited it to us. This is what Abu al-Walid said, and Ibn Kathir recited it to us. This is what Abu al-Hasan ibn 'Uqbah said, and Abu al-Walid recited it to us.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke kuch sahaba baithe thay, humne kaha: "Kaash humein pata hota ke Allah ko kaunsa amal sabse zyada pasand hai to hum wahi karte," to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Allah ki tasbeeh karta hai jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai, aur woh Azeez, Hakeem hai}" Surah ke aakhir tak, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh humein padh kar sunayi." Isi tarah Al-Awza'i ne kaha, aur Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne ise Makkah mein humein padh kar sunayi. Muhammad bin Kathir ne kaha: aur Al-Awza'i ne ise humein isi tarah padh kar sunayi. Abu Al-Waleed ne kaha: aur Ibn Kathir ne ise humein isi tarah padh kar sunayi. Abu Al-Hasan bin Uqbah ne kaha: aur Abu Al-Waleed ne ise humein isi tarah padh kar sunayi.

e: [AI] We were sitting with the Prophet ﷺ , so we said, "If only we knew which actions are most beloved to Allah." Then he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner.
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas baithe thay, humne kaha: "Kaash humein pata hota ke Allah ko kaunsa amal sabse zyada pasand hai," phir unhone hadith isi jaisi zikr ki.

e: [AI] "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and we said, 'If only we knew which deeds are most beloved to Allah.' So the Prophet mentioned the Hadith, and this narration is not from the Hadith of Al-Walid ibn Muslim, for Al-Hiqal ibn Ziyad, even though he was trustworthy and reliable, he had doubts about its authenticity. And from the evidence indicating the authenticity of the chain of narration of Abu Salamah is that Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Muhammad Al-Fazari, the memorizer of the companions of Al-Awza'i, narrated it with an additional wording in the first chain according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: 'Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas the, humne kaha: kaash humein pata hota ke Allah ko kaunsa amal sabse zyada pasand hai,' phir unhone hadith zikr ki. Yeh nahi kaha jaata ke yeh Al-Waleed bin Muslim ki hadith hai, kyunke Al-Hiql bin Ziyad, agarche unka maqaam yaqeen aur pukhtagi ka hai, unhein isski sanad mein shak tha, aur Abu Salamah ki sanad ki sehat ki daleel yeh hai ke Abu Ishaq Ibrahim bin Muhammad Al-Fazari, jo Al-Awza'i ke sahaba mein sabse zyada yaad rakhne wale hain, ne isse izaafi alfaaz ke sath pehli sanad ke sath riwayat kiya hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "We gathered and discussed which one of us would go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and ask him about the most beloved actions to Allah. Then we separated, and we decided that one of us would go to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a messenger to us and we gathered. He recited to us the verse, 'Glorify Allah, whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth' until the end of the Surah. Abu Salamah recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Yahya ibn Abi Kathir recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Abu Is-haq recited it to us from the beginning to the end, meaning the Surah of As-Saff."
hi: Hum jama huay aur aapas mein baat ki: "Tum mein se kaun Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas jaakar unse poochega ke Allah ko kaunsa amal sabse zyada pasand hai?" Phir hum bikhar gaye aur humein darr laga ke koi unke paas jaaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein bulaawa bheja aur humein jama kiya, hum aapas mein aik doosre ki taraf ishara karne lage, "to aap (SAW) ne humein padh kar sunaayi: '{Allah ki tasbeeh karta hai jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai}'" Surah ke aakhir tak. Abu Salamah ne kaha: to Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ne ise humein aakhir tak padh kar sunaayi. Yahya bin Abi Kathir ne kaha: aur Abu Salamah ne ise humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaayi. Mahboob ne kaha: aur Abu Ishaq ne ise humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaayi - ya'ni Surah As-Saff.

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Verily, Paradise is under the shades of swords.'" So a young man who appeared disheveled asked, "Did you hear this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He replied, "Yes," and broke the blade of his sword with him, then he said peace be upon you to his companions and entered into battle."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak Jannat talwaaron ke saaye ke neeche hai." To aik boseeda-haal jawaan ne poocha: "Kya aapne yeh Rasulullah (SAW) se suna hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To usne apni talwaar ka ghilaaf apne sath tod diya, phir apne saathiyon se kaha: "Assalamu Alaikum," phir jung mein dakhil ho gaya.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  narrated, "Do you know who will be the first group from my nation to enter paradise?" Allah and His Messenger know best, I replied. The Prophet said, "The Emigrants (Muhajirun). They will come to the gate of paradise on the Day of Resurrection and seek permission to enter. The gatekeeper will ask them, 'Have you been accounted for?' They will reply, 'What will we be accounted for? Our swords were on our shoulders for the sake of Allah until we died on that path.' So, they will be granted entry and it will be said to them, 'Stay there for forty years before anyone else can enter.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai ke meri Ummat mein se sabse pehla giroh Jannat mein kaun dakhil hoga?" Maine kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Muhajireen, jo Qayamat ke din Jannat ke darwaze par aayenge aur khulwaana chahenge, to darban unse kahenge: 'Kya tumhara hisaab liya ja chuka hai?' Woh kahenge: 'Humara kis baat ka hisaab liya jaayega, jabke humari talwaarein humare kandhon par thin Allah ki raah mein yahan tak ke hum usi haal mein mar gaye.'" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unke liye darwaza khol diya jayega, aur woh isme chalees (40) saal aaraam karenge us se pehle ke aam log dakhil hon."

e: Abu Sa’id (Al Khudri) reported The Prophet ﷺ was asked “Which believers are most perfect in respect of faith? He replied “A man who strives in the path of Allaah with his life and property and a man who worships Allaah in a mountain valley where he protects the people from his evil.”” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2485)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Kaunsa momin sabse mukammal imaan wala hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh jo Allah ki raah mein apni jaan aur apne maal se jihad kare, aur woh aadmi jo kisi ghaati mein Allah ki ibaadat kare aur logon ko apni buraai se bacha le."

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'I am a Za'im - and the Za'im is the guarantor - for the one who believes in me and accepts Islam, and emigrates: A house on the outskirts of Paradise and a house in the middle of Paradise. And I am a guarantor, for the one who believes in me and accepts Islam, and strives in the cause of Allah: A house on the outskirts of Paradise and a house in the middle of Paradise and a house in the highest chambers of Paradise. Whoever does that and seeks goodness wherever it is, and avoids evil wherever it is, may die wherever he wants to die.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3133)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Main zaamin hoon, aur zaamin zimmedari uthaane wala hota hai, us shakhs ke liye jo imaan laaye, Islam qubool kare, aur hijrat kare - Jannat ke kinaare mein aik ghar aur Jannat ke wast mein aik ghar (ka wada), aur main zaamin hoon us shakhs ke liye jo imaan laaye - Jannat ke wast mein aik ghar (ka wada), aur main zaamin hoon us shakhs ke liye jo imaan laaye, Islam qubool kare, aur hijrat kare, aur Allah ki raah mein jihad kare - Jannat ke kinaare mein aik ghar, Jannat ke wast mein aik ghar, aur Jannat ke sabse buland hisse mein aik ghar (ka wada). Jo koi yeh sab kare, usne bhalaai chahne aur buraai se bachne mein kuch nahi chhoda, woh jahan chahe wahan mar sakta hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: A section of my community will continue to fight for the right and overcome their opponents till the last of them fights with the Antichrist. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2484)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat ka aik giroh hamesha haq par jung karta rahega, apne mukhaalifon par ghaalib rahega, yahan tak ke unme se aakhri shakhs Maseeh Dajjal se jung karega."
