e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: "Indeed, the first group to enter Paradise will be the poor among the emigrants whom Allah elevates their status through their patience when they are commanded and they listen and obey. Even if one of them has a need to be fulfilled by a ruler, it will not be fulfilled until he dies while he still has that need in his heart. Verily, on the Day of Resurrection, Allah will call for Paradise, and it will come with all its adornments and beauties, and He will say, 'Where are My servants who fought in My cause, were killed in My cause, were harmed in My cause, and strove in My cause? Enter Paradise without any reckoning or punishment!' So they will enter it without any reckoning or punishment. Then the angels will come and say, 'Our Lord, we are always praising You day and night, and sanctifying You. Who among these people is the one You have favored over us?' The Lord, glorified and exalted, will say, 'These are the ones who fought in My cause, were harmed in My cause, and entered upon them from every gate is peace. Peace be upon you, for what you have endured. And excellent is the final home.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Sabse pehla giroh jo Jannat mein dakhil hoga woh faqeer Muhajireen hain, jinke zariye museebatein taal di jaati hain, jab unhein hukum diya jaata hai to woh sunte hain aur farmaanbardaari karte hain, aur agar unme se kisi ko baadshah se koi zaroorat ho to woh poori nahi ki jaati yahan tak ke woh mar jaata hai aur woh zaroorat uske seene mein hi rehti hai. Aur beshak Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din Jannat ko bulaayega, to woh apni raunaq aur taazgi ke sath aayegi, to Allah farmayega: 'Mere woh bande kahan hain jinhone meri raah mein jung ki aur meri raah mein qatl huay aur meri raah mein takleef uthaayi aur meri raah mein jihad kiya? Jannat mein dakhil ho jao.' To woh isme bagair kisi hisaab ya azab ke dakhil ho jaayenge, phir farishte aayenge aur kahenge: 'Aye humare Rab, hum raat-din teri tasbeeh karte hain aur teri paakizgi bayan karte hain, yeh kaun hain jinhein tu ne hum par tarjeeh di hai?' To Rab Tabaraka wa Ta'ala farmayega: 'Yeh woh log hain jinhone meri raah mein jung ki aur meri raah mein takleef uthaayi,' to farishte har darwaze se unke paas dakhil honge: 'Salaam ho tumpar tumhare sabr ki wajah se, kitna achha hai anjaam ka ghar.'"

e: "Two will never be gathered together in the Fire: A Muslim who killed a disbeliever then tried his best and did not deviate. And two will never be gathered together in the lungs of a believer: Dust in the cause of Allah, and the odor of Hell. And two will never be gathered in the heart of a salve: Faith and envy." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3109)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dono aik sath jama nahi hote aag mein aise ke aik doosre ko nuqsaan pahunchaaye - Musalman jisne kaafir ko qatl kiya ho, phir Musalman seedha raha aur qareeb raha (haq par); aur dono aik sath kisi bande ke seene mein jama nahi hote - Allah ki raah ka gubaar aur Jahannam ka dhuaan; aur dono aik sath kisi bande ke dil mein jama nahi hote - imaan aur kanjoosi."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The dust in the cause of Allah and the smoke of Hell will never be combined in the lungs of a slave, and the stinginess and faith can never be combined in a slave's heart." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3110)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah ka gubaar aur Jahannam ka dhuaan kisi bande ke seene mein kabhi jama nahi hote, aur kanjoosi aur imaan kisi bande ke dil mein kabhi jama nahi hote."

e: “The dust (of Jihad) in the cause of Allah and the smoke of Hell will never be combined in the interior of a Muslim.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2774)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah ka gubaar aur Jahannam ka dhuaan kisi Musalman aadmi ke chehre mein kabhi jama nahi hote."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ sent a military expedition, and a woman came to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, you have sent this expedition, and my husband has joined it. I used to fast and perform prayer in accordance with his actions, and I worshiped Allah through his worship. Guide me to an action that can equal his actions." He said, "Continue to perform prayer, do not sit idle, fast without breaking it, and engage in remembrance without interruption." She asked, "Can I bear that, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Even if you can bear it, I swear by the One in whose hand my soul is, you will not reach the level of his actions even if you do so."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik dasta bheja, to aik aurat unke paas aayi aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne yeh dasta bheja hai aur mera shohar isme nikla hai, aur main uske roze ke sath roza rakhti thi, uski namaz ke sath namaz padhti thi, aur uski ibaadat ke sath ibaadat karti thi, mujhe koi aisa amal bataiye jisse main uske amal tak pahunch sakoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum namaz padho aur baitho mat, roza rakho aur iftaar mat karo, aur zikr karo aur susti mat karo." Unhone kaha: "Kya main isse nibha sakti hoon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum isse nibha bhi lo, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum uske amal ke dasve hisse tak bhi nahi pahunch sakogi."

e: A man said: Messenger of Allah, allow tourism for me. The Prophet ﷺ said: The tourism of my people is striving in the path of Allah, the Exalted. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2486)
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe (deeni) sayaahat (safar) ki ijaazat dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak meri Ummat ki sayaahat Allah ki raah mein jihad hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Returning home is like going on an expedition. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2487)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wapsi (safar se) bhi jung jaisi hi hai."

e: Abu Umamat Al Bahili reported the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ as saying “There are three persons who are in the security of Allaah, the Exalted.” “A man who goes out on an expedition to fight in the path of Allaah, the Exalted, is in the security of Allaah, until He takes him unto Him(i.e., he dies) and brings him into Paradise or brings him(alive) with reward and booty he obtains and a man who goes to the mosque is in the security of Allaah, until he takes him unto Him(i.e., he dies), and he brings him into Paradise or brings him with reward and spoils he obtains; and a man who enters his house after giving salutation is in the security of Allaah, the Exalted.” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2494)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (log) hain jinke zimmedar Allah khud hai: woh aadmi jo Allah ki raah mein jihad ke liye nikla, woh Allah ki zimmedari mein hai yahan tak ke Allah use maut de aur Jannat mein daakhil kare, ya use ajr ya maal-e-ghaneemat ke sath wapas laaye; aur woh aadmi jo masjid ki taraf gaya, woh Allah ki zimmedari mein hai yahan tak ke Allah use maut de aur Jannat mein daakhil kare, ya use ajr ya maal-e-ghaneemat ke sath wapas laaye; aur woh aadmi jo salaam ke sath apne ghar mein daakhil hua, woh (bhi) Allah ki zimmedari mein hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, ordered a secret mission to depart. They said, "O Messenger of Allah, shall we leave tonight or wait until morning?" He said, "Don't you want to spend the night in one of the gardens of Paradise?" And the garden is autumn.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik dastay ko nikalne ka hukum diya, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya hum aaj raat nikalein ya subah tak intezar karein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum yeh pasand nahi karte ke Jannat ke baaghon mein se aik baagh mein raat guzaaro?" - aur "khareef" (yahan) "baagh" ke ma'ne mein hai.

e: [AI] A man came to perform the prayer, and the Prophet ﷺ was praying with us. When he finished his prayer, he said, "O Allah, give me the best of what You give to Your righteous servants." After the Prophet ﷺ finished the prayer, he said, "Who was the one speaking earlier?" The man said, "It was me, O Messenger of Allah." The Prophet ﷺ then said, "In that case, your mount will stumble and you will be martyred in the path of Allah."
hi: Aik shakhs namaz ke liye aaya jabke Nabi (SAW) humein namaz padha rahe the, jab woh saf tak pahuncha to usne kaha: "Aye Allah, mujhe woh ata kar jo tu apne nek bandon ko sabse behtareen deta hai." Jab Nabi (SAW) ne namaz mukammal ki to farmaya: "Abhi kaun bol raha tha?" To us shakhs ne kaha: "Main tha, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "To ab tumhara jawaan ghoda gir jaayega aur tum Allah ki raah mein shaheed hoge."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The martyrs are with a bright river at the door of Paradise, in a green dome, where their sustenance comes to them morning and evening."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shuhada Jannat ke darwaze par aik chamakti hui nehr ke kinare, aik sabz gumbad mein hain, unka rizq subah-shaam unke paas aata hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You should engage in jihad for the sake of Allah, as it is a door among the doors of Paradise, through which Allah relieves anxiety and sorrow." Others added to it, "And strive in the cause of Allah, whether it is near or far, and establish the limits of Allah, both near and far, and do not let the blame of those who blame you in the way of Allah affect you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, kyunke yeh Jannat ke darwazon mein se aik darwaza hai, Allah ismein se fikr aur ghum door karta hai." Aur doosron ne ismein izaafa kiya: "Aur Allah ki raah mein qareeb aur door dono jagah jihad karo, aur Allah ki hudood ko qareeb aur door dono jagah qaayam karo, aur Allah ke maamle mein kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat tumhein na roke."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A man from the people of Paradise will be brought forward and Allah will say to him, 'O son of Adam, how did you find your dwelling place?' The man will say, 'O Lord, it is the best dwelling place.' Allah will say, 'Ask and wish for more.' The man will say, 'I ask You to return me to the world so that I may be killed in Your cause ten times for what I have seen of the virtue of martyrdom.' He said, 'Then a man from the people of Hellfire will be brought forward and Allah will say to him, 'O son of Adam, how did you find your dwelling place?' The man will say, 'O Lord, it is the worst dwelling place.' Allah will say, 'Did you not seek deliverance from it by any means possible, even if it was by giving away the entire world?' The man will say, 'Yes.' Allah will say, 'You lied. I asked you for something less significant than that, and you did not do it.'
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jannat waalon mein se aik aadmi ko laaya jayega, Allah usse farmayega: "Aye Ibn Adam, tumne apna ghar kaisa paaya?" Woh kahega: "Aye Rab, sabse behtareen ghar." Allah farmayega: "Maango aur tamanna karo." Woh kahega: "Main tujhse kya maangoon aur kya tamanna karoon? Main tujhse yeh maangta hoon ke mujhe duniya mein wapas kar de taake main teri raah mein das martaba qatl ho jaaun," shahaadat ki fazeelat dekhne ki wajah se. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Aur Jahannam waalon mein se aik aadmi ko laaya jayega, Allah usse farmayega: "Aye Ibn Adam, tumne apna ghar kaisa paaya?" Woh kahega: "Aye Rab, sabse bura ghar." Rab Tabaraka wa Ta'ala farmayega: "Kya tum isse bachne ke liye zameen bhar sona fidya de dete?" Woh kahega: "Ji haan." Allah farmayega: "Tumne jhoot bola, maine tumse isse kam cheez maangi thi lekin tumne nahi ki."

e: [AI] While the Prophet ﷺ  was in Rawha', a Bedouin from Sarrif came down to them and said, "Who are the people you are looking for?" They replied, "We are looking for Badr, with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." The Bedouin said, "Why do I see that you are poorly armed?" They replied, "We are waiting for one of the two good outcomes - either martyrdom, which leads to Paradise, or victory, where Allah will grant us triumph and Paradise." He then asked, "Where is your Prophet?" They pointed towards him and said, "There he is!" The Bedouin said to the Prophet ﷺ , "O Prophet of Allah, I have no personal interest to prioritize over your interest." The Prophet ﷺ  responded, "Go back to your family and take care of your personal affair." So, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  left for Badr, while the man went to his family to fulfil his needs. Then, he caught up with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in Badr, while he was organizing the people for battle. He joined the ranks with them, and engaged in the fighting. Among those whom Allah granted martyrdom was this very man. After Allah gave victory to the believers and defeated the polytheists, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by the martyrs, with Umar ibn Al-Khattab accompanying him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Umar, "O Umar, you love to hear stories, and indeed, among the martyrs are leaders, nobles, and kings. And this man, O Umar, is among them."
hi: Jabke Nabi (SAW) Rauha mein thay, achanak Sarif se aik badu unke paas utra aur poocha: "Yeh log kaun hain, tum kahan jaana chahte ho?" Kaha gaya: "Badr, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath." Usne kaha: "Kya baat hai, tum log itne bekaar-haal aur kam hathiyaron wale nazar aa rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: "Hum do achhi cheezon mein se aik ka intezar kar rahe hain - ya to hum maare jaayen to Jannat, ya hum ghaalib aayen to Allah humare liye fatah aur Jannat dono jama kar de." Usne poocha: "Tumhare Nabi kahan hain?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh rahe." Usne unse kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, mera koi maslaha nahi, main apna maslaha nipta kar aata hoon phir aapse aa milta hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne ghar walon ke paas jao aur apna maslaha nipta lo." To Rasulullah (SAW) Badr ki taraf rawaana huay, aur woh shakhs apne ghar walon ke paas gaya yahan tak ke apni zaroorat poori ki, phir Rasulullah (SAW) se Badr mein aa mila jabke aap (SAW) logon ko jung ke liye saf-bandi karwa rahe the, to woh unke sath saf mein shaamil ho gaya, jung shuru hui, to woh un logon mein shaamil tha jinhein Allah ne shaheed kiya. Jab Allah ne mushrikeen ko shikast di aur momino ko fatah di, to Rasulullah (SAW) shuhada ke darmiyan se guzre, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) unke sath the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dekho, Aye Umar, tumhein baatein pasand hain, aur shuhada ke bhi sardaar, buzurg, aur baadshah hote hain, aur yeh, Aye Umar, unme se hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "When the companions of Uhud are mentioned, I swear by Allah, I wish I was with my companions, taking refuge in the mountain fortress."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jab Uhud ke sahaba ka zikr kiya jaata hai, Allah ki qasam, mujhe pasand hota ke main bhi apne sathiyon ke sath pahaad ke qile mein chhoda jaata (shaheed hota)."

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the Battle of Tabuk when he said to me, "If you wish, I can inform you about the essence, pillar, and pinnacle of this matter." I said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "As for the essence, it is Islam; as for the pillar, it is prayer; and as for the pinnacle, it is jihad."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Tabuk ki jung mein the, aap (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Agar tum chaaho to main tumhein maamle ki asal, uska satoon, aur uske sabse ooncha hissa bataaun." Maine kaha: "Zaroor, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maamle ki asal Islam hai, uska satoon namaz hai, aur uska sabse ooncha hissa jihad hai."

e: [AI] On the day of Uhud, when they did not come, we called upon Allah, so they went off to a side. Sa'd called out and said, "O Lord, if we meet the people tomorrow, grant me a strong man with intense fierceness, whose wrath I fight for your sake and he fights me, then grant me victory over him until I kill him and take his spoils." Abdullah ibn Jahsh then stood up and said, "O Allah, grant me tomorrow a man with intense fierceness, whose wrath is intense and his strength is intense. I will fight him for your sake and he will fight me, then he will grab me and sever my nose and ears. And when I meet you tomorrow, I will say, 'O Abdullah, what happened to your nose and ears?' I will reply, 'It was for your sake and the sake of your messenger.' Then he will say, 'You have spoken the truth.'" Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas said, "O my son, the supplication of Abdullah ibn Jahsh was better than mine. I saw him at the end of the day, and indeed his ears and nose were hanging by a thread."
hi: Uhud ke din, "kya tum aakar Allah se dua nahi karte?" To woh aik taraf tanha ho gaye, Sa'd (RA) ne dua ki aur kaha: "Aye Rab, kal jab hum qaum se milein, to mujhe aisa aadmi mila de jiska hamla sakht ho aur ghussa sakht ho, taake main teri raah mein usse jung karoon aur woh mujhse jung kare, phir mujhe uspar fatah de taake main use qatl karoon aur uska saaman le loon." To Abdullah bin Jahsh (RA) khade huay aur kaha: "Aye Allah, kal mujhe aisa aadmi mila de jiska ghussa sakht ho, jiska hamla sakht ho, main teri raah mein usse jung karoon aur woh mujhse jung kare, phir woh mujhe pakad kar mera naak aur kaan kaat de, phir jab main kal tujhse milun to tu poochhe: 'Aye Abdullah, tumhara naak aur kaan kis liye kaate gaye?' To main kahoon: 'Teri raah mein aur tere Rasool ki raah mein,' to tu farmaaye: 'Tumne sach kaha.'" Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ne kaha: "Aye mere bete, Abdullah bin Jahsh (RA) ki dua meri dua se behtar thi, maine unhein din ke aakhir mein dekha, unka kaan aur naak dhaage se latak rahe the."

e: [AI] He heard the Messenger of Allah (Peace be upon him) say, "Whoever fights in the cause of Allah as a Muslim man and surpasses the endurance of a camel, Paradise is obligated for him. And whoever asks Allah for martyrdom sincerely and then dies or is killed, he will have the reward of a martyr."
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo koi Musalman Allah ki raah mein aik oontni ke doodh nikaalne jitni der jung kare, uske liye Jannat wajib ho jaati hai, aur jo koi Allah se apne dil se sacchi niyat se qatl (shahaadat) maange, phir mar jaaye ya qatl ho jaaye, uske liye shaheed ka ajr hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever sincerely asks Allah for martyrdom in His cause and then dies, Allah will grant him the reward of a martyr" according to the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein sacchi niyat se qatl (shahaadat) maange, phir mar jaaye, Allah use shaheed ka ajr deta hai." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: "Whoever asks Allah, the mighty and Sublime, sincerely for martyrdom, Allah will cause him to reach the status of the martyrs even of he dies in his bed." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3162)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah se sacchi niyat se shahaadat maange, Allah use shuhada ke darjaat tak pahuncha deta hai, chahe woh apne bistar par hi kyun na mare."

e: [AI] Abdullah bin Abi Awfa wrote to him at the time when he went to Al-Harrooriya a letter in which it was mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O people! Do not desire to meet the enemy, and seek the protection of Allah. But if you meet them, be patient and know that Paradise lies under the shade of swords."
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) ne unhein khat likha jab woh Haroori (Khawarij) ki taraf nikle, usme likha tha ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye logo, dushman se milne ki tamanna mat karo, aur Allah se aafiyat maango, aur jab tum unse milo to sabr karo, aur jaan lo ke Jannat talwaaron ke saaye ke neeche hai."

e: ‘Abd Allah bin Amr reported the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ as saying “No warlike party will go out to fight in Allaah’s path and gain booty without getting beforehand two-thirds of their rewards in the next world and one-third (of their reward) will remain. And if they do not gain booty, they will get their rewards in full. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2497)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi jung karne wala giroh Allah ki raah mein jihad karke maal-e-ghaneemat nahi paata magar unke ajr ka do-tihaai hissa jaldi mil jaata hai, aur tihaai hissa aakhirat ke liye baaqi rehta hai, aur agar woh maal-e-ghaneemat na paayen to unka poora ajr mehfooz rehta hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: (The reward of) prayer, fasting and remembrance of Allah is enhanced seven hundred times over (the reward of) spending in Allah's path. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2498)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak namaz, roza, aur zikr, Allah ki raah mein kharch karne par sat sau (700) guna zyada barha diye jaate hain."

e: AbuMalik heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: He who goes forth in Allah's path and dies or is killed is a martyr, or has his neck broken through being thrown by his horse or by his camel, or is stung by a poisonous creature, or dies on his bed by any kind of death Allah wishes is a martyr and will go to Paradise. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2499)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo Allah ki raah mein nikle aur mar jaaye ya qatl ho jaaye, woh shaheed hai, ya usse uske ghode ya oont ne gira kar uski gardan tod di ho, ya usse kisi zehreeli cheez ne dank maara ho, ya woh apne bistar par jis bhi tareeqe se Allah chaahe mar jaaye, to woh shaheed hai aur uske liye Jannat hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Everyone who dies will have fully complete his action, except one who is on the frontier (in Allah's path), for his deeds will be made to go on increasing till the Day of Resurrection, and he will be safe from the trial in the grave. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2500)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har mayyat ke amal par mohar lagayi jaati hai siwaye murabit (sarhad ki hifaazat karne wale) ke, kyunke uska amal Qayamat ke din tak barhta rehta hai, aur use qabar ke azmaish se mehfooz rakha jaata hai."

e: [AI] Abu Al-Muwajjah narrated that Abdan narrated that Abdullah narrated from Wuhayb ibn Al-Ward that Umar ibn Muhammad ibn Al-Munkadir narrated from Sumayy from Abu Salih from Abu Hurayrah from the Prophet ﷺ who said, "Whoever dies without fighting in the cause of Allah or without having the intention to do so, dies on a branch of hypocrisy." Muslim has argued with Wuhayb ibn Al-Ward about this narration.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi mar jaaye aur usne na to jihad kiya ho na apne dil mein jihad ka irada kiya ho, woh nifaaq ki aik shaakh par mara." Muslim ne Wuhaib bin Al-Ward ko hujjat maana hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever dies without taking part in Jihad and does not have the intention to participate, dies a death of hypocrisy."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi mar jaaye aur usne na to jihad kiya ho na uske dil mein jihad ka koi khayal ho, woh nifaaq ki aik shaakh par mara."

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever meets Allah without any traces from Jihad he meets Allah with a defect. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1666)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi jihad ke bagair Allah se mile, woh usse aisi haalat mein milega ke usme aik kami hogi."

e: [AI] I heard the son of al-Khassasa saying, "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to pledge allegiance to him upon Islam. So he stipulated for me, 'Bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger, perform the five daily prayers, fast during Ramadan, give Zakat, perform Hajj, and strive in the cause of Allah.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah! As for two of them, I cannot bear them. As for Zakat, I have nothing except ten camels, who are the messengers of my family and their burdens. As for Jihad, they claim that whoever turns away has earned the wrath of Allah. So when a battle is imminent, I dislike death and my soul becomes weak.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took hold of his hand, then shook it and said, 'There is no charity or Jihad, so how will you enter paradise?' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah! I pledge allegiance to you and will fulfill all of them.'"
hi: Maine Ibn Al-Khasasiyah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Islam par bay'at karne aaya, to aap (SAW) ne mujhpar shart rakhi: "Tum gawahi do ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad uske bandey aur Rasool hain, paanch waqt namaz padho, Ramzan ke roze rakho, zakat do, Baitullah ka Hajj karo, aur Allah ki raah mein jihad karo." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), do cheezon ki main taaqat nahi rakhta - zakat ki, kyunke mere paas sirf dus (10) oont hain jo mere ghar walon ki sawaari aur bojh uthaane wale hain; aur jihad ki, kyunke log kehte hain ke jo bhaage woh Allah ke ghusse mein wapas lauta, isliye mujhe darr hai ke jab jung mere saamne aayegi to main maut se nafrat karunga aur mera dil kamzor ho jaayega." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apna haath band kiya, phir use hilaaya, phir farmaya: "Na sadqa na jihad, phir tum Jannat mein kaise dakhil hoge?" Unhone kaha: phir maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aapse bay'at karta hoon," to unhone mujhse in sab par bay'at li.

e: "Whoever guards Ribat (the frontier) for one day and one night, will be given a reward like that for fasting and praying Qiyam for a month, and whoever dies at Ribat (guarding the frontier) will be rewarded, and he will be given provision, and he will be kept safe from Al-Fattan." [1] [1] According to As-Sindi, the preferred pronunciation is Al-Fattan, plural of Fatan refering to Al-Munkar and An-Nakir, while Al-Fattan would refer to Ash-Shaitan or the like, among the punishment of the grave, or, the angels of chastisement. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3167)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein aik din raat ki chowki (murabata) kare, uske liye aik mahine ke roze aur qiyaam ka ajr hai, aur jo koi chowki karte huay mar jaaye, uske liye wahi ajr jaari rehta hai, aur usse rizq bhi diya jaata hai, aur woh fitna (azmaish) se mehfooz rakha jaata hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters. (Using translation from Muslim 2653a)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Shall I not inform you of a night that is better than the Night of Decree? It is a guard in a land of fear, perhaps he would not return to his family.'"
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein Lailat-ul-Qadr se behtar aik raat ki khabar na doon? (Woh hai) aik pehredaar jo khauf-zada zameen mein pehra de, shayad woh apne ghar walon ke paas wapas na aa sake."

e: [AI] Thawr bin Yazid was praised for narrating a hadith with a chain of narration that is connected but has a break, on the condition of Al-Bukhari.
hi: Humein Thawr bin Yazid ne bataya, phir unhone ise mauqoof (raawi tak mahdood) sanad ke sath zikr kiya. Bukhari ki shart par.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "Guarding a night in the cause of Allah is better than a thousand nights in which the night is spent in prayers and the day is spent in fasting."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Allah ki raah mein aik raat ka pehra hazaar (1000) raaton se behtar hai jinki raatein qiyaam mein aur dino mein roza rakh kar guzaari jaayen."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Use your property, your persons any your tongues in striving against the polytheists. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2504)
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mushrikeen ke khilaaf apne maal, apni jaanon, aur apni zabaano se jihad karo."

e: Zaid bin Thabit said “I was beside the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ when the divinely-inspired calmness overtook him and the thigh of the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ fell on my thigh. I did not find any weightier than the thigh of the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ. He then regained his composure and said “Write down. I wrote on a shoulder. Not equal are thise believers who sit (at home), other than those who have a (disabling) hurt, and those who strive in the way of Allaah. When Ibn Umm Makhtum who was blind heard the excellence of the warriors. He stood up and said “Apostle of Allaah ﷺ how is it for those believers who are unable to fight (in the path of Allaah)? When he finished his question his divinely-inspired calmness overtook him, and his thigh fell on my thigh and I found its weight the second time as I found the first time.” When the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ regained his composure, he said “Apostle of Allaah ﷺ said “Other than those who have a (disabling hurt). Zaid said “Allaah, the exalted, revealed it alone and I appended it.” By Him in Whose hands is my life, I am seeing, as it were the place where I put it (i.e., the verse) at the crack in the shoulder.” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2507)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke pehlu mein tha ke unpar sakoon (wahi ki kaifiyat) chha gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ki raan meri raan par aa padi, maine kisi cheez ka wazan Rasulullah (SAW) ki raan se zyada bhaari nahi mehsoos kiya, phir unse yeh haalat door hui, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Likho," to maine aik haddi (kandhe ki haddi) par likha: "{Momino mein se woh log jo (jihad mein) baithe rehte hain, siwaye un logon ke jo takleef-daar hon, aur woh log jo Allah ki raah mein jihad karte hain, barabar nahi ho sakte}" (Surah An-Nisa 95) ayat ke aakhir tak. To Ibn Umm Maktum (RA) khade huay, jo aik nabeena shakhs the, jab unhone mujahideen ki fazeelat suni, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), un momino ka kya hoga jo jihad ki taaqat nahi rakhte?" Jab unhone apni baat mukammal ki to Rasulullah (SAW) par (dobara) sakoon chha gaya, unki raan meri raan par aa padi, maine doosri martaba bhi wahi wazan mehsoos kiya jo pehli martaba mehsoos kiya tha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) se yeh haalat door hui, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Padho, Aye Zaid." Maine padha: "{Momino mein se woh log jo (jihad mein) baithe rehte hain}" (Surah An-Nisa 95), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "{siwaye un logon ke jo takleef-daar hon}" (Surah An-Nisa 95) poori ayat. Zaid (RA) ne kaha: Allah ne isse alag nazil kiya aur maine ise jod diya, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe aisa lagta hai ke main uski jodne ki jagah haddi mein aik daraar ke paas dekh raha hoon.

e: Abu Sa’id Al Khudri said “The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ sent an expedition towards Banu Lihyan and said “One of the two persons should go forth. He then said to those who sat (at home), If any one of you looks after the family and property of a warrior, he will receive half the reward of the one who goes forth (in jihad).” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2510)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Banu Lihyan ki taraf (dasta) bheja aur farmaya: "Har do aadmiyon mein se aik nikle," phir baithe rehne wale se farmaya: "Tum mein se jo bhi nikalne wale ki jagah uske ghar aur maal ki achhi tarah dekh-bhaal kare, uske liye nikalne wale ke aadhe ajr ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Three eyes will not be touched by the fire: an eye that wept out of fear of Allah, an eye that stayed awake guarding for the sake of Allah, and an eye that was injured in the way of Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen aankhon ko aag nahi chhuayegi - woh aankh jo Allah ki raah mein nikaal di gayi ho, woh aankh jo Allah ki raah mein pehra de rahi ho, aur woh aankh jo Allah ke khauf se royi ho."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Hurairah say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "It is forbidden for two eyes to be touched by the Fire: an eye that shed tears out of fear of Allah, and an eye that stayed awake to guard Islam and its people from the people of disbelief in it."
hi: Maine Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte hue suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do aankhon par aag haram ki gayi hai - woh aankh jo Allah ke khauf se royi ho, aur woh aankh jo raat bhar Islam aur uske logon ki kufr walon se hifaazat karti rahi ho." Isme inqita (sanad ka toota hua hissa) hai.

e: [AI] From Abu Ali Al-Janbi from Abu Rayhanah who said: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on an expedition. We reached a high place, and severe cold overtook us. Each one of us dug a hole, then entered it and covered himself with his own garment. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw that from the people, he said: 'Is there not one among you to stand guard for us tonight, invoking Allah for him with a supplication through which he may attain favor?' So a man from the Ansar got up and said: 'I am, O Messenger of Allah.' So he supplicated for him. Abu Rayhanah said: 'I said: 'I am,' so he supplicated for me with a supplication less than the one he supplicated for the Ansari.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'The Fire is forbidden for an eye which tears due to fear of Allah, and the Fire is forbidden for an eye which stays awake in the cause of Allah.' Abu Rayhanah said: 'I forgot the third (type).' Abu Shurayh said: 'I heard afterward that he said: 'The Fire is forbidden for an eye which refrains from looking at what Allah has forbidden, or an eye which weeps in the cause of Allah.'"
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik jung mein nikle, hum aik buland jagah pahunche, humein sakht sardi lagi yahan tak ke humme se koi zameen mein gadha khodta aur usme dakhil hokar apni dhaal se apne aap ko dhaank leta. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne logon ki yeh haalat dekhi to farmaya: "Kya koi shakhs hai jo aaj raat humari pehra-daari kare, main uske liye aisi dua karunga jisse use fazeelat mile?" To Ansar ka aik shakhs khada hua aur kaha: "Main hoon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)," to aap (SAW) ne uske liye dua ki. Abu Rayhanah (RA) ne kaha: maine kaha: "Main hoon," to unhone mere liye bhi dua ki, lekin woh us dua se kam thi jo Ansari ke liye ki thi. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aag us aankh par haram hai jo Allah ke khauf se royi ho, aag us aankh par haram hai jo Allah ki raah mein raat bhar jaagi ho." Unhone kaha: aur main teesri baat bhool gaya. Abu Shuraih (RA) ne kaha: aur maine baad mein suna ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aag us aankh par haram hai jo Allah ki haraam cheezon se neechi rahi ho, ya woh aankh jo Allah ki raah mein nikaal di gayi ho."

e: On the day of Hunayn we travelled with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and we journeyed for a long time until the evening came. I attended the prayer along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. A horseman came and said: Messenger of Allah, I went before you and climbed a certain mountain where saw Hawazin all together with their women, cattle, and sheep, having gathered at Hunayn. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ smiled and said: That will be the booty of the Muslims tomorrow if Allah wills. He then asked: Who will be on guard tonight? Anas ibn AbuMarthad al-Ghanawi said: I shall , Messenger of Allah. He said: Then mount your horse. He then mounted his horse, and came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah said to him: Go forward to this ravine till you get to the top of it. We should not be exposed to danger from your side. In the morning the Apostle of of Allah ﷺ came out to his place of prayer, and offered two rak'ahs. He then said: Have you seen any sign of your horseman? They said: We have not, Messenger of Allah. The announcement of the time for prayer was then made, and while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was saying the prayer, he began to glance towards the ravine. When he finished his prayer and uttered salutation, he said: Cheer up, for your horseman has come. We therefore began to look between the trees in the ravine, and sure enough he had come. He stood beside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, saluted him and said: I continued till I reached the top of this ravine where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me, and in the morning I looked down into both ravines but saw no one. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him: Did you dismount during the night? He replied: No, except to pray or to relieve myself. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: You have ensured your entry to (Paradise). No blame will be attached to you supposing you do not work after it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2501)
hi: Ke unhone Sahl bin Al-Hanzaliyyah (RA) ko yeh bayan karte suna ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain ke din chale, unhone lambi masaafat tay ki yahan tak ke shaam ho gayi, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas namaz ka waqt aaya, to aik ghudsawaar aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aapke aage-aage gaya yahan tak ke main falan-falan pahaad par chadha, achanak maine Hawazin ko unke apne oonton, unki auraton, unke maweshiyon aur unke bakriyon ke sath dekha, woh Hunain mein jama huay hain." Rasulullah (SAW) muskuraaye aur farmaya: "Yeh Insha'Allah kal Musalmano ka maal-e-ghaneemat hoga." Phir farmaya: "Aaj raat hamari pehra-daari kaun karega?" To Anas bin Marthad Al-Ghanawi (RA) ne kaha: "Main, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sawaar ho jao," woh apne ghode par sawaar huay aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Is ghaati ka rukh karo yahan tak ke tum iske sabse ooncha hisse mein pahunch jao, aur aaj raat kisi surat mein apni taraf se hato mat." Jab subah hui, Rasulullah (SAW) apni namaz ki jagah nikle, do rak'atein padhi, phir farmaya: "Kya tumhein apna ghudsawaar (ka koi pata) mehsoos hua?" Aik shakhs ne kaha: "Humein koi pata nahi." Namaz ka waqt hua, Rasulullah (SAW) namaz padhte huay us ghaati ki taraf dekhte rahe yahan tak ke apni namaz mukammal ki, phir farmaya: "Khush-khabri ho, tumhara ghudsawaar aa gaya hai." Unhone kaha: to hum ghaati mein darakhton ke saaye ki taraf dekhne lage, achanak woh aaye aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas khade hue, salaam kiya, aur kaha: "Main gaya yahan tak ke main us ghaati ke sabse ooncha hisse mein tha jahan Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya tha, jab subah hui to maine dono ghaatiyon ko dekha, mujhe koi nazar nahi aaya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Kya tum raat ko utre?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, siwaye namaz padhne ya qaza-e-haajat ke liye." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne (Jannat) wajib kar li, ab tumhein iske baad koi (aur) amal karne ki zaroorat nahi." Yeh isnad shuru se aakhir tak Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, siwaye iske ke dono ne Sahl bin Al-Hanzaliyyah ke masaneed nahi nikaale, kyunke tabi'een ki unse riwayat kam hai, halaanke woh kibaar sahaba mein se hain, jaisa maine uske maqam par pehle bayan kiya.

e: AbuImran said: We went out on an expedition from Medina with the intention of (attacking) Constantinople. AbdurRahman ibn Khalid ibn al-Walid was the leader of the company. The Romans were just keeping their backs to the walls of the city. A man (suddenly) attacked the enemy. Thereupon the people said: Stop! Stop! There is no god but Allah. He is putting himself into danger. AbuAyyub said: This verse was revealed about us, the group of the Ansar (the Helpers). When Allah helped His Prophet ﷺ and gave Islam dominance, we said (i.e. thought): Come on! Let us stay in our property and improve it. Thereupon Allah, the Exalted, revealed, "And spend of your substance in the cause of Allah, and make not your hands contribute to (your destruction)". To put oneself into danger means that we stay in our property and commit ourselves to its improvement, and abandon fighting (i.e. jihad). AbuImran said: AbuAyyub continued to strive in the cause of Allah until he (died and) was buried in Constantinople. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2512)
hi: "Log kehne lage: 'Ruko, ruko, La ilaha illallah, yeh apne aap ko halaakat mein daal raha hai.'" To Abu Ayyub (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh ayat humare, Ansar ke giroh, baare mein nazil hui thi, jab Allah ne apne Nabi ki madad ki aur Islam ko ghaalib kiya, humne aapas mein kaha: 'Aao, humare maal mein reh jaayen aur unhein sanwaarein,' to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: '{Aur Allah ki raah mein kharch karo, aur apne haathon se apne aap ko halaakat mein na daalo}' (Surah Al-Baqarah 195), to apne haathon se apne aap ko halaakat mein daalna yehi hai ke hum apne maal mein reh jaayen, use sanwaarein, aur jihad chhod dein." Abu Imran ne kaha: to Abu Ayyub (RA) hamesha Allah ki raah mein jihad karte rahe yahan tak ke unhein Constantinople mein dafan kiya gaya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Fighting is of two kinds: The one who seeks Allah's favour, obeys the leader, gives the property he values, treats his associates gently and avoids doing mischief, will have the reward for all the time whether he is asleep or awake; but the one who fights in a boasting spirit, for the sake of display and to gain a reputation, who disobeys the leader and does mischief in the earth will not return credit or without blame. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2515)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jung do tarah ki hai: jo Allah ki raza chaahe, imaam ki itaa'at kare, apni sabse aziz cheez kharch kare, apne saathi ke sath narmi barte, aur fasaad se bache, uski neend aur jaagna sab ajr hai; aur jo faakhr, riyakaari, aur shohrat ke liye jung kare, imaam ki na-farmani kare, aur zameen mein fasaad phailaaye, woh barabar bhi wapas nahi aayega."

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, there is a man who wants to engage in jihad in the way of Allah while seeking worldly gain. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'He will not receive any reward.' He asked a second time and a third time, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  repeated, 'He will not receive any reward.'"
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aik aadmi Allah ki raah mein jihad karna chahta hai jabke woh duniya ka koi maal bhi chahta hai?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uske liye koi ajr nahi." Usne dobara aur teesri baar poocha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne (har baar) farmaya: "Uske liye koi ajr nahi."

e: Messenger of Allah, tell me about jihad and fighting. He replied: Abdullah ibn Amr, if you fight with endurance seeking from Allah your reward, Allah will resurrect you showing endurance and seeking your reward from Him, but, if you fight for vain show seeking to acquire much, Allah will resurrect you making a vain show and seeking to acquire much. In whatever you fight or are killed, Abdullah ibn Amr, in that state Allah will resurrect you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2519)
hi: Ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe jihad aur jung ke baare mein bataaiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abdullah bin Amr, agar tum sabr aur sawaab ki niyat se jung karo, to Allah tumhein sabr aur sawaab ki niyat wale ke tor par uthaayega, aur agar tum riyakaari aur shohrat ki niyat se jung karo, to Allah tumhein riyakaari aur shohrat ki niyat wale ke tor par uthaayega, Aye Abdullah bin Amr, jis bhi haal mein tum jung karo ya maare jaao, Allah tumhein usi haal par uthaayega."

e: “May Allah have mercy on the one who keeps watch over the troops.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2769)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah pehredaar ke pehredaar par reham kare."

e: "I met Abu Dharr and said: 'Tell me a Hadith.' He said. Yes, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There is no Muslim worshiper who spends from each type of his wealth on a pair (of things) in the cause of Allah, but the keepers of Paradise will welcome him, all of them calling him to what they have (of reward).' I said: "How is that?" He said: "If it is camels, he gives two, and if it is cows, he gives two.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3185)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bandah bhi apne har tarah ke maal se aik jodi Allah ki raah mein kharch nahi karta magar Jannat ke tamam darbaan uski taraf mutawajjeh hote hain, har aik use apne (darwaze ki) taraf bulaata hai." Maine poocha: "Woh kaise?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar woh aadmi (ghulam) hain to do aadmi, agar oont hain to do oont, aur agar gaayen hain to do gaayen."

e: [AI] "A man asked Abu Dharr, 'What is your wealth?' He replied, 'My wealth is my work.' Then, he started speaking at length, and the two sheikhs agreed on narrating the hadith of Al-Zuhri from Humaid ibn Abdul Rahman from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever spends for the sake of Allah on two (people) from his wealth...' and its context contradicts the context of the hadith of Sa'sa'ah. And in Sahihain, there is a similar hadith narrated by Abu Hurairah."
hi: Ke aik shakhs ne Abu Dharr (RA) se poocha: "Aapka maal kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mera maal mera amal hai," phir unhone poori hadith bayan ki. Shaykhain ne Az-Zuhri ki, Humaid bin Abdur Rahman se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, hadith nikaalne par ittifaq kiya hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apne maal se aik jodi Allah ki raah mein kharch kare," aur iska silsila Sa'sa'ah ki hadith ke silsile se mukhtalif hai.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Whoever spends a sum of money in the way of Allah, it will be recorded for them as having the reward of seven hundred times."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein kharch kare, woh sat sau (700) guna zyada likha jaata hai."

e: [AI] "From Abu Yahya Kuraim bin Fatik, may Allah be pleased with him."
hi: Abu Yahya Khuraim bin Fatik (RA) se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever recites one thousand verses in the way of Allah, Allah will write for him the reward of being with the Prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein hazaar (1000) ayaat padhe, Allah use Ambiya, Siddiqeen, Shuhada, aur Saaliheen ke sath likh deta hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When your brethren were smitten at the battle of Uhud, Allah put their spirits in the crops of green birds which go down to the rivers of Paradise, eat its fruit and nestle in lamps of gold in the shade of the Throne. Then when they experienced the sweetness of their food, drink and rest, they asked: Who will tell our brethren about us that we are alive in Paradise provided with provision, in order that they might not be disinterested in jihad and recoil in war? Allah Most High said: I shall tell them about you; so Allah sent down; "And do not consider those who have been killed in Allah's path." till the end of the verse. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2520)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jab tumhare bhai Uhud ke din maare gaye, Allah ne unki roohein sabz parindon ke seenon mein rakh di, jo Jannat ki nehron ka rukh karte hain, uske phalon se khaate hain, aur sone ke qandeelon mein panaah lete hain jo Arsh ke saaye mein latki hain. Jab unhone apne khaane, peene, aur aaraam ki khushbu paayi, to unhone kaha: "Kaun humare bhaiyon ko yeh khabar pahunchaayega ke hum Jannat mein zinda hain aur humein rizq milta hai, taake woh jihad se bezaar na hon aur jung se peechhe na hatein?" To Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Main unhein tumhari taraf se yeh khabar pahunchaaunga," aur Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur jo log Allah ki raah mein qatl huay unhein mardah mat samjho}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 169).

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever leaves his house to strive for the sake of Allah and says, 'Where are the warriors in the path of Allah?' and then he mounts his animal and dies, his reward will be on Allah. And if he is bitten by a creature and dies, his reward will be on Allah. And whoever dies while lying on his bed until his nose dies (meaning dies in a state of illness while lying on his bed), his reward will be on Allah. And indeed, this is a statement that I have not heard from anyone among the Arabs before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, meaning dying due to illness while lying on the bed, his reward will be on Allah. And whoever is killed unjustly, he has earned Paradise."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo koi apne ghar se Allah ki raah mein jihad ke liye nikle," - phir aap (SAW) ne apni teen ungliyan band kiin - "aur (kahe): 'Mujahideen Allah ki raah mein kahan hain?' phir apni sawaari se gir kar mar jaaye, to uska ajr Allah par wajib ho gaya. Aur agar use kisi jaanwar ne dank maara aur woh mar gaya, to uska ajr Allah par wajib ho gaya. Aur jo koi apni maut (haṭf anfihi - fitrati maut) se mar jaaye," - aur yeh aisa lafz tha jo maine kisi bhi Arab se Rasulullah (SAW) se pehle nahi suna tha, matlab apne bistar par apni fitrati maut - "to uska ajr Allah par wajib ho gaya. Aur jo koi achanak (qaza-e-fauri) qatl ho jaaye, uske liye Jannat wajib ho gayi."

e: [AI] "From Abu Dharr, a Hadith: I desired to meet him, so I met him and said, 'O Abu Dharr, I used to hear a Hadith about you, and I desired to meet you.' He said, 'To Allah be your father. For indeed, you have met me.' I said, 'Tell me; it has reached me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  narrated something to you.' He said, 'Indeed, Allah loves three and dislikes three.' I said, 'Do not lie to your friend.' He said, 'I speak the truth. The man who fights in the cause of Allah steadfastly and hoping for His reward, the one who fights until he is killed, and you find him among you in the Book of Allah, revealed, reads this verse, "Indeed, Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly" [Surah As-Saff: 4]. I said, 'Who else?' He said, 'The one who has a neighbor who harms him, yet he bears with patience and endures until Allah suffices him either with life or death.' I said, 'Who else?' He said, 'The man who travels with a group, and they suffer from severe hardship until, when they are afflicted by the darkness and drowsiness [of the night], they strike their heads [against the ground] for seeking the pleasure of Allah and hoping for what He has in store for them.' I said, 'Who are the three that Allah dislikes?' He said, 'The arrogant, conceited person, and you find him in the Book of Allah, revealed, reads this verse, "Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful" [Surah Luqman: 18].' I said, 'Who else?' He said, 'The miser who denies and withholds.' I said, 'Who else?' He said, 'The smooth-talker merchant or the persuasive salesman.'"
hi: Mujhe Abu Dharr (RA) ke baare mein aik hadith pahunchi thi, to main unse milna chahta tha, jab main unse mila to maine kaha: "Aye Abu Dharr, mujhe aapke baare mein aik hadith pahunchi thi, to main aapse milna chahta tha." Unhone kaha: "Allah tumhare waalid ko jaza de, tum mujhse mil hi liye." Maine kaha: "Mujhe bataaiye, mujhe pata chala hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne aapko kuch bataaya tha." Unhone kaha: "Beshak Allah teen logon se mohabbat karta hai aur teen ko napasand karta hai." Unhone kaha: "Main apne dost (Rasulullah) par jhoot nahi bolta." Maine kaha: "Woh kaun log hain jinse Allah mohabbat karta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Woh aadmi jo Allah ki raah mein sabr aur sawaab ki niyat se jihad kare, dushman se mile aur jung kare yahan tak ke qatl ho jaaye, aur tum ise Allah ki nazil ki hui Kitaab mein paate ho," phir unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Beshak Allah un logon se mohabbat karta hai jo uski raah mein aise saf bandh kar jung karte hain jaise woh mazboot imaarat hon}" (Surah As-Saff 4). Maine kaha: "Aur kaun?" Unhone kaha: "Woh aadmi jiska bura padosi ho jo use takleef de, aur woh uski takleef par sabr kare yahan tak ke Allah use us se kaafi ho jaaye, chahe zindagi mein ya maut mein." Maine kaha: "Aur kaun?" Unhone kaha: "Woh aadmi jo kisi qaum ke sath safar kare, woh raat bhar chalein yahan tak ke raat ke aakhri hisse mein unhein neend aur ooghn aa jaaye, to woh apne sar rakh dein, phir (woh shakhs) khada ho aur Allah ke khauf se aur uske paas jo hai uski khwahish mein paak ho jaaye." Maine poocha: "To woh teen kaun hain jinhein Allah napasand karta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ghamandi, faakhr karne wala, aur tum ise Allah ki nazil ki hui Kitaab mein paate ho: {Beshak Allah kisi bhi ghamandi, faakhr karne wale se mohabbat nahi karta}" (Surah Luqman 18). Maine poocha: "Aur kaun?" Unhone kaha: "Kanjoos, ehsaan jataane wala." Maine poocha: "Aur kaun?" Unhone kaha: "Woh tajir jo bohot qasmein khaaye, ya bechne wala jo bohot qasmein khaaye."

e: was narrated that ‘Umar bin al-Khattab ؓ said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever shades the head of a warrior, Allah will shade him on the Day of Resurrection; whoever equips a warrior until he is fully equipped, will have a reward like his; whoever builds a mosque in which the Name of Allah is mentioned. Allah will build for him a house in Paradise.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 376)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi mujahid ke sar ko saaya de, Allah use Qayamat ke din saaya dega, aur jo koi kisi mujahid ko is tarah taiyyar kare ke woh apne saaman se khud-mukhtaar ho jaaye, uske liye uske jaisa hi ajr hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever assists a warrior for the sake of Allah, or supports someone in financial difficulty, or helps to pay off someone's debt, Allah will provide shade for them on the Day when there is no shade except His shade." Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary on this topic.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein kisi mujahid ki, ya apni mushkil mein kisi qarzdaar ki, ya apni gardan (aazaadi) ke liye kisi mukatib (ghulam) ki madad kare, Allah use apne saaye mein saaya dega us din jab uske saaye ke siwa koi saaya nahi hoga." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: It is (offered) in the way of Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: For this you will have seven hundred she-camels on the Day of Judgment all of which will be muzzled. (Using translation from Muslim 1892a)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iske badle tumhein Qayamat ke din sat sau (700) oontniyaan milengi, sab lagaam-daar (achhi tarah sanwaari hui)."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Whoever strives in the cause of Allah, Allah will guarantee him (protection) and whoever enters upon an Imam who supports him, Allah will guarantee him (protection), and whoever sits in his home without speaking ill of anyone, Allah will guarantee him (protection)."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein jihad kare, woh Allah ka zimmedaar hai, aur jo koi kisi imaam ke paas jaaye jo use tanbeeh kare, woh (bhi) Allah ka zimmedaar hai, aur jo koi apne ghar mein baithe rahe aur kisi ki buraai na kare, woh (bhi) Allah ka zimmedaar hai."

e: Once the Messenger of Allah ﷺ intended to go on an expedition. He said: O group of the emigrants (Muhajirun) and the helpers (Ansar), among your brethren there are people who have neither property nor family. So one of you should take with him two or three persons; with me. I also rode on my camel by turns like one of them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2534)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne jihad ka irada kiya, to farmaya: "Aye Muhajireen aur Ansar ke giroh, tumhare kuch bhaai aise hain jinke paas na maal hai na qabila, isliye tum mein se koi apne sath do ya teen aadmiyon ko shaamil kar le, aur humme se kisi ke paas apni sawaari ki baari ke ilawa koi doosra saadhan nahi jaise unme se aik ki baari hoti hai." Unhone kaha: to maine apne sath do ya teen ko shaamil kar liya, mere paas bhi sirf unme se aik jaisi hi baari thi.

e: That he asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "Which charity is most virtuous?" He said, "The service of a worshipper in the cause of Allah, or providing the shade of tent, or mount in the cause of Allah." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1626)
hi: Ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Kaunsa sadqa sabse afzal hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi ghulam ki khidmat, ya khaimay ka saaya, ya Allah ki raah mein nar jaanwar ki nasal-kashi."

e: [AI] We were, on the day of Badr, three people taking turns riding on a camel. Ali and Abu Lubabah were companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . So, when the turn of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came, they would say to him, "Ride so that we can walk." He would respond, "I am not richer than you both, nor are you stronger in walking than me."
hi: Hum Badr ke din teen-teen aadmi aik oont par baari-baari sawaar hote the, Ali (RA) aur Abu Lubabah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke sathi thay, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki baari aati to woh dono unse kehte: "Sawaar ho jaayein taake hum chal sakein," to aap (SAW) farmate: "Main tum dono se zyada ajr ka be-niyaz nahi hoon, aur na hi tum dono mujhse zyada chalne mein taaqatwar ho."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said, "There is always goodness in horses." (Using translation from Bukhārī 3645)
hi: Ke unhone Abu Kabshah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi, ko Rasulullah (SAW) se yeh kehte suna: "Bhalaai ghodon ke maathon mein baandhi gayi hai, unke maalikon ki madad ki jaati hai, aur jo unpar kharch kare, woh sadqa dene ke liye apna haath phailaane wale jaisa hai."

e: [AI] My father was a companion of Abu Darda in Damascus, and there was a man in Damascus from the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  known as Ibn Hanthaliah al-Ansari. One day he passed by us and greeted us. Abu Darda said to him, "Give us a word that benefits us and does not harm you." He replied, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'The one who mounts a horse in the way of Allah, spreading his hands to give charity, will never end up without receiving it." We narrated this hadith as a witness.
hi: Mere waalid Abu Darda (RA) ke Dimashq mein hum-nishin the, aur Dimashq mein Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik shakhs the jinhein Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah Al-Ansari (RA) kaha jaata tha, aik din woh humare paas se guzre aur salaam kiya, to Abu Darda (RA) ne unse kaha: "Koi baat batayein jo humein faida de aur aapko nuqsaan na pahunchaaye." Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein ghodon par kharch karne wala, sadqa dene ke liye apna haath phailaane wale jaisa hai jo use band nahi karta." Humne ise shahid ke tor par nikaala hai.

e: "Whoever keeps a horse for the cause of Allah out of faith in Allah and believing the promise of Allah, its feed, water, urine and dung will all count as Hasanat in the balance of his deeds." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3582)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein Allah par imaan aur uske wade ki tasdeeq ke sath aik ghoda rakhe, uska pait bharna, pyaas bujhaana, uska gobar, aur uska peshaab, sab Qayamat ke din uske taraazu mein nekiyaan hongi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "There is no Arabian horse except that it is called to twice every day. It says, 'O Allah, just as You have made me beloved to the one who owns me, make me beloved to him as well as his family and wealth.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi Arabi ghoda aisa nahi jise har din do dua karne ki ijaazat na di jaaye, woh kehta hai: 'Aye Allah, jaise tu ne mujhe us shakhs ke supurd kiya jisne mujhe apna banaaya, mujhe uske sabse aziz maal aur uske ghar walon mein se bana de.'"

e: “The best of horses are those that are deep black, with a blaze on the forehead, white marks on the legs and white nose and upper lip, and with no whiteness on the right foreleg. If not deep-black, then reddish-brown, with these markings.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2789)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen ghoda kaale rang ka, peshaani par safed nishaan wala, pairon par safed nishaan wala, naak par safed nishaan wala, dayen agle paanv mein bagair safedi ke hota hai, aur agar kaala na ho to sunehri-surkh rang ka isi nishaan ke sath."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If you want to engage in battle, then buy a reddish-brown horse, with a unique marking on its forehead and white socks on its right legs, for surely you will conquer and succeed."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum jihad ka irada karo to aik kaala ghoda khareedo jiski peshaani par safedi ho, pairon par nishaan ho, dayen paanv mein khaali (bina nishaan ke) ho, to tum ghaneemat paaogay aur salaamat rahogay."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "You will be surrounded by trials like patches of dark night. The one who will save people from these trials will be a man from the tops of mountains who will eat from the flesh of his sheep or a man from behind the valleys who will hold onto the reins of his horse and eat from the inside of his sword."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Tumpar aisi azmaayishein saaya kareingi jaise andheri raat ke tukde, in se logon mein sabse zyada bachne wala woh shakhs hoga jo kisi buland pahaad par apni bakriyon ka doodh pi kar guzaara kare, ya woh aadmi jo raston se door apne ghode ki lagaam thaame ho aur apni talwaar ki ghaneemat khaata ho."

e: "O Abu Sa'eed! Whoever is content with Allah as Lord, Islam as his religion and Muhammad as Prophet, then he is guaranteed Paradise." Abu Sa'eed found this amazing and said: "Say it to me again, O Messenger of Allah." So he did that, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "And there is something else by means of which a person may be raised one hundred degrees in Paradise, each of which is like that which is between the Heaven and the Earth." He said: "What is it, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Jihad in the cause of Allah, Jihad in the cause of Allah." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3131)
hi: Ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo Allah ko Rab, Islam ko deen, aur Muhammad ko Rasool maankar raazi ho jaaye, uske liye Jannat wajib ho jaati hai." Abu Sa'eed (RA) ne kaha: to maine Allah ki hamd ki, takbeer kahi, aur ismein khush hua, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur aik aur (amal) hai jiske zariye Allah uske ahl ko Jannat mein sau (100) darje buland karta hai, har do darjon ke darmiyan itna faasla hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan, ya usse bhi zyada." Maine poocha: "Woh kya hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein jihad, Allah ki raah mein jihad."

e: [AI] The translation of the given sentence in English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: O Allah, make the demise of my Ummah (nation) be while being killed in Your path with stabbing and plague."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, meri Ummat ki maut teri raah mein qatl hone se, neze ki chot se ya taa'oon (mahaamaari) se bana de."

e:
A black man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am a black man with a foul odor and an ugly face, and I have no wealth. If I fight these people ˹in the path of Allah˺ until I am killed, where will I be?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "In Paradise." So he fought until he was killed.
Then the Prophet ﷺ came to him and said, "Allah has brightened your face, sweetened your fragrance, and increased your wealth." And he said to him or to someone else, "I have seen his wife from the beautiful black-eyed maidens stripping off her garment of silk to cover him.
hi: Aik kaale rang ke shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aik kaala aadmi hoon, meri boo buri hai, mera chehra bhaddaa hai, mere paas koi maal nahi, agar main in logon se jung karoon yahan tak ke main qatl ho jaaun, to main kahan hoonga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat mein." To woh jung karte rahe yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye, Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye aur farmaya: "Allah ne tumhara chehra roshan kar diya, tumhari khushbu paakeeza kar di, aur tumhara maal barha diya," aur inhi ke ya kisi aur ke baare mein farmaya: "Maine unki biwi ko Hooron mein se dekha, woh unse unki oon ki chaadar chheen kar unke aur uski apni chaadar ke darmiyan daal rahi thi."

e: “The Prophet ﷺ passed by some people who were shooting (arrows) and said: ‘Shoot, Banu Isma’il, for your father was an archer.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2815)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) kuch logon ke paas se guzre jo teer-andaazi kar rahe the, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teer chalaao, Aye Ismail (AS) ki aulaad, kyunke tumhare baap teer-andaaz the."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  went out with a group of Muslims and they came across some people throwing stones. He said, "Throw stones at the family of Ismail, for your father used to throw stones. Throw and I will be with the son of Adra'." The people hesitated and said, "O Messenger of Allah, who were you with that you were defeated?" He said, "Throw, and I am with all of you." This is based on the condition of being a Muslim.
hi: Nabi (SAW) baahar nikle jabke Aslam qabile ke kuch log teer-andaazi kar rahe the, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teer chalaao, Aye Ismail (AS) ki aulaad, kyunke tumhare baap teer-andaaz the, teer chalaao, aur main Ibn Al-Adra ke sath hoon." To un logon ne apne kamaan rok liye, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), jiske sath aap hongay woh jeet jaayega." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teer chalaao, main tum sab ke sath hoon." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by some people who were astray, so he said, "This is good. O Allah, passing by twice or thrice, throw and I will be with the son of Al-Adra." The people then held their hands and said, "By Allah, we will not throw with him while you are with him, O Messenger of Allah, lest we go astray." He said, "Throw, and I am with all of you." They said so, and he said, "Indeed, they all threw on that day, then they dispersed on equal terms. None of them went astray from the other."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) kuch logon ke paas se guzre jo teer-andaazi ka muqaabla kar rahe the, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Achha hai yeh, Aye Allah," do ya teen martaba, "teer chalaao, main Ibn Al-Adra ke sath hoon." To un logon ne apne haath rok liye, unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, hum uske sath teer nahi chalaayengay jabke aap uske sath hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), phir to woh humein haraa dega." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teer chalaao, main tum sab ke sath hoon." Unhone kaha: to woh us din zyada waqt teer-andaazi karte rahe, phir barabar ho kar alag ho gaye, kisi ne kisi ko nahi haraaya.

e: [AI] "O Khalid, come out with us so we can do some target practice. But I was slow in hitting it, so he said: 'O Khalid, come here, let me tell you something that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  told me, and I will tell you what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Indeed, Allah admits by only one arrow three people into Paradise: the maker who made it seeking good, the one who shoots it, and the one who says 'throw' and 'ride'. And if you throw it is dearer to me than you riding. And there are only three things from jesting: the discipline of a man through his horse, his playing with his wife, and throwing with his arrows away from his people. And whoever learns archery and then abandons it, it is a blessing that he has disowned.'"
hi: "Aye Khalid, humare sath chalo, hum teer-andaazi karengay," maine der kar di, to unhone kaha: "Aye Khalid, aao, main tumhein woh bataaun jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bataaya, aur main tumse waisa hi kehta hoon jaisa Rasulullah (SAW) ne kaha: 'Beshak Allah aik hi teer se teen logon ko Jannat mein daakhil karta hai - uska banaane wala jisne apni sanat mein bhalaai ki niyat rakhi, uske liye teer taiyyar karne wala, aur teer chalaane wala. Teer chalaao aur sawaar bhi ho jaao, aur tumhara teer chalaana mujhe tumhare sawaar honay se zyada pasand hai, aur khel-tamasha mein se sirf teen cheezein (jaayaz) hain: aadmi ka apne ghode ko sudhaarna, apni biwi ke sath khelna, aur apni qaum ke liye apne teer chalaana, aur jo koi teer-andaazi seekh kar phir chhod de, to yeh aik ne'mat hai jiski usne na-shukri ki.'"

e:
[AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Everything from the pleasures of this worldly life is void, except for three things: your practice with your bow, your training of your horse, and your play with your family, as these are from what is true.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  also said, 'Practice archery and ride horses, for indeed if you practice archery, Allah will admit three into Jannah (Paradise) for the work and intention put into it - the one who shoots, the one who prepares the arrow, and the one who carries the arrow.'"

This is a saying of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  mentioned in Sahih Muslim.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Duniya ke khel-tamashon mein se har cheez baatil hai siwaye teen ke: apni kamaan se teer-andaazi ka muqaabla, apne ghode ko sudhaarna, aur apne ghar walon ke sath khelna, kyunke yeh haq mein se hain." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teer-andaazi ka muqaabla karo aur sawaari bhi karo, aur agar tum teer-andaazi karo to yeh mujhe zyada pasand hai. Beshak Allah aik hi teer se teen logon ko Jannat mein daakhil karta hai - uska banaane wala jisne isme bhalaai ki niyat rakhi, teer taiyyar karne wala, aur teer chalaane wala." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "So I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'Whoever throws an arrow in the way of Allah, he will have the reward of a liberator.' He (the narrator) said, 'So on that day, I delivered sixteen arrows.'"
hi: To maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein teer chalaaye, uske liye aik ghulam azaad karne ke barabar (sawaab) hai." Unhone kaha: to maine us din solah (16) teer chalaaye.

e: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Whoever shoots an arrow at the enemy and his arrow reaches the enemy, whether it hits him or not, that is equivalent to him freeing a slave.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2812)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo koi dushman par teer chalaaye aur uska teer wahan pahunch jaaye, chahe woh nishaana chuke ya lage, to yeh aik ghulam azaad karne ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] Abu said: When we met the people on the day of Badr, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to us, "If they throw at you with stones, then throw with nobility and excel in your nobility."
hi: Apne waalid se, unhone kaha: jab hum aur qaum Badr ke din aamne-saamne huay, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: "Jab woh tumhare qareeb aa jaayen to teer chalaao, aur apne teer bacha kar rakho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to the Muslims on the day of Uhud, "Fight bravely, Sa'd, throw, O Sa'd, for Allah has thrown for you. May my father and mother be sacrificed for you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Uhud ke din Musalmano se farmaya: "Sa'd ko teer do, teer chalaao, Aye Sa'd, Allah ne tumhare liye teer chalaaya hai, teer chalaao, mere maa-baap tum par qurbaan."

e: [AI] He said, "Has the messenger of Allah arrived? I have protected my companions with my noble chest." This is a narrated authentic hadeeth and it has not been included in the authentic collections.
hi: Unhone kaha: "Kya Rasulullah (SAW) aa gaye? Maine apne saathiyon ki hifaazat apne teeron ki noken se ki hai." Yeh hadith sahih-ul-isnad hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] Abu Al-Muwajih narrated that Abdan narrated that Abdullah narrated that Al-Mas'oodi informed and Ali ibn Hamshath Al-Adl narrated that Al-Harith ibn Abi Usamah (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that Yazid bin Harun narrated that Al-Mas'oodi informed and Abu Sa'eed Amr ibn Muhammad ibn Mansoor Al-Adl narrated that Umar bin Hafs Al-Sadusi narrated that Aasim bin Ali narrated that Abdul Rahman bin Ubaidullah Al-Mas'oodi narrated from Abu Bakr bin Hafs from Abdullah bin Aamir bin Rabee'ah from his father (may Allah be pleased with him), who was present at the Battle of Badr. He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would send us on secret missions, and we would not have any provisions except dates, which we would divide handful by handful, until it became one date at a time." I asked, "O father, how is it possible that a date can sustain you?" He said, "Do not say that, O my son, for we did not count it as lost, so we relied on it when we needed it."
hi: Unhone Abdullah bin Aamir bin Rabee'ah se, unke waalid se, jo Badr mein maujood the, riwayat ki, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) humein kisi choti tukdi (jung ke dastay) mein bhejte the, humare paas khajoor ke ilawa koi zaad-e-raah nahi hota tha, humein use mutthi-mutthi taqseem kiya jaata yahan tak ke woh aik-aik khajoor tak pahunch jaata. Maine kaha: "Aye abba, aik khajoor aapke kya kaam aa sakti thi?" Unhone kaha: "Aisa mat kaho, aye mere bete, jab humein iski kami hui to humein iski zaroorat mehsoos hui."

e: [AI] "Abdullah, wait until I bid you farewell as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to bid us farewell, saying 'I entrust your religion, your trust, and the conclusion of your actions to Allah.'"
hi: "Aye Abdullah, thehro yahan tak ke main tumhein aise vida karoon jaise Rasulullah (SAW) humein vida karte the: 'Main tumhara deen, tumhari amaanat, aur tumhare aamaal ka anjaam Allah ke supurd karta hoon.'"

e: [AI] "To you, O son of 'Umar, I entrust you as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entrusted me, saying: 'I entrust Allah with your religion, your trust, and the end of your deeds.' And he has a witness in Anas ibn Malik and 'Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Ansari."
hi: "Aye Ibn Umar, main tumhein waise hi vida karta hoon jaise Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe vida kiya tha: 'Main tumhara deen, tumhari amaanat, aur tumhare aamaal ka anjaam Allah ke supurd karta hoon.'" Iska shahid Anas bin Malik (RA) aur Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari (RA) ki hadith mein milta hai.

e: " Iasked Al-Hasan bin Muhammad about the saying of Allah, the Might and Sublime: 'and know that whatever of spoils of war that you may gain, verily, one-fifth of it is assigned to Allah. He said: 'This is the key to the Speech of Allah. This world and the Hereafter belling to Allah. He said: 'They differed concerning these two shares after the death of the Messenger of Allah, the share of the Messenger and the share of the near relatives (of the Messenger of Allah). Some said that the share of the near relatives was for the relatives of the Messenger, and some said that the share of the near relatives was for the relatives of the Khalifah. Then they agreed that these two shares should be spent on horses and equipment in the cause of Allah, and they were allocated for this purpose during the Khalifah of Abu Bakr and' Umar."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4143)
hi: Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jaan lo ke jo kuch tum maal-e-ghaneemat paao, to uska paanchwan hissa Allah aur Rasool ke liye hai}" (Surah Al-Anfal 41) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Yeh Allah Ta'ala ke kalaam ki chaabi hai, jo kuch duniya aur aakhirat mein hai (uska)." Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ke baad logon ka in do hisson ke baare mein ikhtilaaf ho gaya, kuch ne kaha ke qaraabat-daari ka hissa Nabi (SAW) ke rishtedaaron ke liye hai, aur kuch ne kaha ke khalifa ke rishtedaaron ke liye hai, aur kuch ne kaha ke Nabi (SAW) ka hissa unke baad khalifa ke liye hai, to unki raay is baat par jama hui ke woh in dono hisson ko ghode aur samaan Allah ki raah mein (khareedne) mein lagaayen, to Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ki khilaafat mein yehi hota raha.

e: [AI] I heard Ali saying, "I have been appointed as the Messenger of Allah's representative in five areas, so I fulfilled his responsibilities during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah, as well as during the times of Abu Bakr and Umar."
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko kehte hue suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe khums ka paanchwan hissa (nigraan) muqarrar kiya, to maine ise uski sahi jagahon par rakha, Rasulullah (SAW), Abu Bakr (RA), aur Umar (RA) ki zindagi mein."

e: A’ishah said “Safiyyah was called after the word safi (a special portion of the Prophet).” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2994)
hi: "Safiyyah (RA) 'safi' (khaas hissa) se (naam) rakhi gayi thin."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, took up his sword, Dhul-Fiqar, on the day of Badr. Ibn Abbas said, and he was the one who witnessed the dream on the day of Uhud, that when the polytheists attacked the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, on the day of Uhud, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, intended to establish a base in Medina and fight them there. Some people who were not present at the Battle of Badr asked him, "O Messenger of Allah, may we go with you to fight them in Uhud, hoping to attain the same reward that the people of Badr attained?" So they continued to be with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, until he put on his armor, at which point they regretted their decision and said, "O Messenger of Allah, stay where you are, for your opinion is the best." The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "It is not appropriate for a prophet to take off his armor after putting it on until Allah judges between him and his enemy." Among the things that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to them on that day, before putting on his armor, was, "I saw that I was in a strong fortress, so I built it in Medina, and I saw that I was a ram, so I led the way as the leader of the cavalry, and I saw that my sword, Dhul-Fiqar, broke, so I sharpened it among you, and I saw a cow being slaughtered, so there is no doubt that a cow is better."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni talwaar Dhul-Fiqar Badr ke din nafl (khaas inaam) ke tor par li. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: aur yehi woh talwaar hai jiske baare mein unhone Uhud ke din khwaab dekha tha, aur yeh is tarah tha ke jab mushrikeen Uhud ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ki raay yeh thi ke woh Madinah mein hi rukein aur wahan unse jung karein, to jo log Badr mein maujood nahi thay unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap humein unke paas le jaayenge taake hum Uhud mein unse jung karein?" aur unhein ummeed thi ke unhein wahi fazeelat milegi jo Badr walon ko mili thi, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ko manaate rahe yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ne apna hathiyaar pehen liya, phir unhein pachhtaawa hua aur unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), rukiye, raay to aapki hi hai," to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Nabi ke liye munaasib nahi ke woh apna hathiyaar pehen ne ke baad utaare jab tak Allah uske aur uske dushman ke darmiyan faisla na kar de." Unhone kaha: aur us din Rasulullah (SAW) ne, hathiyaar pehen ne se pehle, unse yeh kaha: "Maine khwaab mein dekha ke main mazboot zirah mein hoon, maine ise Madinah maana, aur maine dekha ke main aik menda (bakri ka bachcha) apne peechhe sawaar kiye huay hoon, maine use lashkar ke sardaar ke tor par tabeer kiya, aur maine dekha ke meri talwaar Dhul-Fiqar toot gayi, maine ise tumhare mein kisi shikast ke tor par tabeer kiya, aur maine gaaye zibah hote dekhi, to gaaye, Allah ki qasam, behtar hai, gaaye, Allah ki qasam, behtar hai."

e: [AI] "I used to walk with my father when we passed by a group of people who were belittling Ali and speaking ill of him. My father stood up and said, 'I used to receive favors from Ali and I owe him a debt of gratitude. I was with Khalid Ibn al-Walid in an army, and they obtained spoils of war. Ali took a fifth of the spoils for himself, and there was an agreement between Ali and Khalid regarding this matter.' Khalid said to Ali, 'This is your chance.' Khalid knew that I had a preference for Ali over myself. He told me to go and inform the Prophet Muhammad about it. So I went to the Prophet Muhammad and recounted it to him. I was a timid person, so when I spoke, I spoke hesitantly and softly. I then raised my head and mentioned the matter of the army, and then I mentioned the matter of Ali. I raised my head even higher, and the Messenger of Allah's face turned red. He said, 'Whoever accepts me as their leader, Ali is also their leader. That which I have in my heart for Ali has been removed.'"
hi: Main apne waalid ke sath chal raha tha jab woh kuch logon ke paas se guzre jo Ali (RA) ki kami bataa rahe the, unke baare mein baat kar rahe the, to woh khade huay aur kaha: "Main Ali se kuch (paate) tha aur mere dil mein unke baare mein kuch tha, aur main Khalid bin Al-Walid (RA) ke sath aik lashkar mein tha, unhein maal-e-ghaneemat mila, to Ali (RA) ne khums mein se aik laundi li aur use apne liye rakh liya, aur Ali (RA) aur Khalid (RA) ke darmiyan kuch tha, to Khalid (RA) ne kaha: 'Yeh tumhara mauqa hai,' aur Khalid (RA) ko pata tha ke mere dil mein Ali (RA) ke baare mein kya hai, unhone kaha: 'To Nabi (SAW) ke paas jao aur unse yeh zikr karo.' To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein bataya, main aik jhukne wala aadmi tha, jab main koi baat bayan karta to jhuk jaata phir apna sar uthaata, to maine Nabi (SAW) se lashkar ki baat zikr ki, phir Ali (RA) ki baat zikr ki, phir apna sar uthaaya to Rasulullah (SAW) ki gardan ki nasein surkh ho chuki thin, unhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jiska main mawla (dost/sarparast) hoon, Ali uska mawla hai,' aur jo mere dil mein unke baare mein tha woh chala gaya."

e: [AI] He passed by a gathering, then he mentioned a long speech according to the criteria of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Ke woh aik majlis se guzre, phir unhone lambi hadith zikr ki. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] On the day of Hunayn, the spoils included women, children, camels, and sheep. They were lined up in rows to be distributed abundantly to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Muslims and the polytheists met and the Muslims turned their backs in retreat, as Allah the Almighty said.
