The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am the slave of Allah and His Messenger," and he said, "O Ansar, I am the slave of Allah and His Messenger." Then Allah vanquished the polytheists without thrusting a spear or striking with a sword. On that day, the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever kills a disbeliever, their belongings are theirs." Abu Qatadah killed twenty men on that day and took their spoils. Abu Qatadah said, "O Messenger of Allah, I hit a man who was wearing a chain mail and had a shield, and I hurried to take his spoils. Look at who he is, O Messenger of Allah." A man said, "O Messenger of Allah, I took it, so it belongs to me. Give it to me." The Prophet ﷺ  remained silent, as he would either grant a request or remain silent. 'Umar said, "No, by Allah, Allah will not give a lion from His lions to someone else." Then the Prophet ﷺ  smiled.
hi: Hawazin Hunain ke din auraton, bachchon, oonton, aur bakriyon ke sath aaye, unhone unhein safon mein khada kiya taake Rasulullah (SAW) par unki tadaad zyada dikhaayi jaaye, to Musalman aur mushrikeen aamne-saamne huay, Musalman peeth pher kar bhaagne lage jaisa Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Allah ka bandah aur uska Rasool hoon," aur farmaya: "Aye Ansar ke giroh, main Allah ka bandah aur uska Rasool hoon," to Allah ne mushrikeen ko shikast di, aur na koi neze se maara gaya na talwaar se, to Nabi (SAW) ne us din farmaya: "Jo koi kaafir ko qatl kare, uska saaman uska hai." To Abu Qatadah (RA) ne us din bees (20) aadmi qatl kiye aur unka saaman le liya. Abu Qatadah (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine aik aadmi ko gardan ke qareeb maara aur uspar zirah thi, to main jaldi mein uska saaman na le saka, isliye dekhiye woh kaun hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." To aik shakhs ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine woh le liya hai, to unhein isse raazi kar dijiye aur mujhe woh de dijiye." To Nabi (SAW) khamosh ho gaye, aur woh kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jaata to ya de dete ya khamosh ho jaate, to Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Allah apne sheron mein se kisi sher ko fatah nahi dega aur woh (uska haq) tumhein de de," to Rasulullah (SAW) muskuraaye.

e: [AI] I witnessed the battle of Hunayn with my companions, and they spoke to me about the Messenger of Allah. He then commanded me to wear a sword, and I was informed that I was a slave. He also commanded something for me from the spoils of war.
hi: Main apne sardaaron ke sath Hunain mein maujood tha, unhone mere baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) se baat ki, "to aap (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya, mujhe talwaar pehnayi gayi, phir bataaya gaya ke main ghulam hoon, to aap (SAW) ne mere liye maal-e-ghaneemat mein se kuch mamooli saaman ka hukum diya."

e: Mujammi' was one of the Qur'an-reciters (qaris), and he said: We were present with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at al-Hudaybiyyah. When we returned, the people were driving their camels quickly. The people said to one another: What is the matter with them? They said: Revelation has come down to the Prophet ﷺ. We also proceeded with the people, galloping (our camels). We found the Prophet ﷺ standing on his riding-animal at Kura' al-Ghamim. When the people gathered near him, he recited: "Verily We have granted thee a manifest victory. A man asked: Is this a victory, Messenger of Allah? He replied: Yes. By Him in Whose hands the soul of Muhammad is, this is a victory. Khaybar was divided among those who had been at al-Hudaybiyyah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ divided it into eighteen portions. The army consisted of one thousand five hundred men, of which three hundred were cavalry, and he gave two shares to a horseman and one to a foot-soldier. Abu Dawud said: Abu Mu'awiyah's tradition is sounder, and it is one which is followed. I think the error is in the tradition of Mujammi', because he said: "three hundred horsemen." when there were only two hundred. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2736)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hudaybiyyah mein maujood thay, jab hum wahan se wapas laute to log oonton ko tezi se hankne lage, to kuch logon ne aapas mein poocha: "Logon ko kya ho gaya hai?" Kaha gaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) par wahi nazil hui hai." To hum bhi logon ke sath tezi se chalne lage, humein Nabi (SAW) apni sawaari par Kura-ul-Ghameem ke qareeb khade mile, jab log unke paas jama huay to aap (SAW) ne unhein padh kar sunayi: "{Beshak humne tumhein khuli fatah di hai}" (Surah Al-Fath 1), to aik shakhs ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya yeh fatah hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, beshak yeh fatah hai." To Khaybar ko Hudaybiyyah waalon mein taqseem kiya gaya, Rasulullah (SAW) ne ise terah (13) hisson mein taqseem kiya, aur lashkar pandrah sau (1500) tha jinme teen sau (300) sawaar the, to aap (SAW) ne sawaar ko do hisse diye aur paidal ko aik hissa.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of Badr: He who does such-and-such, will have such-and such. The young men came forward and the old men remained standing near the banners, and they did not move from there. When Allah bestowed victory on them, the old men said: We were support for you. If you had been defeated, you would have returned to us. Do not take this booty alone and we remain (deprived of it). The young men refused (to give), and said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has given it to us. Then Allah sent down: "They ask thee concerning (things taken as) spoils of war, Say: (Such) spoils are at the disposal of Allah and the Apostle......Just as they Lord ordered thee out of thy house in truth, even though a party among the believers disliked it." This proved good for them. Similarly obey me. I know the consequence of this better than you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2737)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din farmaya: "Jo koi aisa-aisa kare, uske liye maal-e-ghaneemat mein se aisa-aisa hai." Unhone kaha: to jawaan aage badh gaye aur boodhe jhandon ke sath rukay rahe, woh wahan se nahi hate, jab Allah ne unhein fatah di to boodhon ne kaha: "Hum tumhare liye piche support the, agar tum shikast khaate to tum humari taraf hi laut aate, isliye tum maal-e-ghaneemat le kar mat jao aur hum bina kuch ke reh jaayen." To jawaan mukar gaye aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne ise humare liye muqarrar kiya hai," to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Woh aapse anfaal (maal-e-ghaneemat) ke baare mein poochte hain, kah dijiye: Anfaal Allah aur Rasool ke liye hain}" (Surah Al-Anfal 1) is farmaan tak: "{jaise tumhare Rab ne tumhein haq ke sath tumhare ghar se nikaala, jabke momino mein se aik giroh usse napasand karta tha}" (Surah Al-Anfal 5), farma raha hai: to yeh unke liye behtar sabit hua, isi tarah yeh bhi hai, isliye meri baat maano, kyunke main iske anjaam ko tumse zyada jaanta hoon.

e: Mus’ab bin Sa’d reported on the authority of his father (Sa’ad bin Abi Waqqas) “I brought a sword to the Prophet ﷺ on the day of the Badr and I said (to him) Apostle of Allaah ﷺ , Allaah has healed up my breast from the enemy today, so give me this sword. He said “This sword is neither mine nor yours. I then went away saying “today this will be given to a man who has not been put to trial like me. Meanwhile a messenger and came to me and said “Respond, I thought something was revealed about me owing to my speech. I came and the Prophet ﷺ said to me “You asked me for this sword, but this was neither mine nor yours. Now Allaah has given it to me, hence it is yours. He then recited “they ask thee concerning (things taken as) spoils of war. Say “(Such) spoils are at the disposal of Allaah and the Apostle. Abu Dawud said “According to the reading of the Qur’an of Ibn Mas’ud the verse goes. They ask thee concerning (things taken as ) spoils of war. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2740)
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas Badr ke din aik talwaar lekar aaya, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aaj mera seena dushman se shifa-yaab ho gaya hai, isliye mujhe yeh talwaar de dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh talwaar na mera hai na tumhara." Main chala gaya, aur keh raha tha: "Aaj yeh us shakhs ko diya jaayega jisne meri jaisi azmaaish nahi jhaeli." Ke ismein qaasid mere paas aaya aur kaha: "Jawaab do," to mujhe laga ke shayad meri baat ke baare mein koi baat nazil hui hai, main aaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne mujhse yeh talwaar maangi thi jabke yeh na meri hai na tumhari, aur Allah ne ise mujhe de diya hai, isliye ab yeh tumhari hai," phir aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Woh aapse anfaal (maal-e-ghaneemat) ke baare mein poochte hain, kah dijiye: Anfaal Allah aur Rasool ke liye hain}" (Surah Al-Anfal 1) ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out on the day of Badr along with three hundred and fifteen (men). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: O Allah, they are on foot, provide mount for them; O Allah , they are naked, clothe them; O Allah, they are hungry, provide food for them. Allah then bestowed victory on them. They returned when they were clothed. There was no man of them but he returned with one or two camels; they were clothed and ate to their fill. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2747)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Badr ke din teen sau pandrah (315) ke sath nikle, Rasulullah (SAW) ne dua ki: "Aye Allah, yeh nange paanv hain, inhein sawaari de, Aye Allah, yeh nangey hain, inhein kapda de, Aye Allah, yeh bhooke hain, inhein khilaao," to Allah ne unke liye Badr ke din fatah kholi, jab woh wapas laute to unme se har aadmi aik ya do oont ke sath wapas laute, unhone kapde pehne aur pait bhar khaaya.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to give to some of the detachments he sent out (something extra) for themselves in particular apart from the division made to the whole army. The fifth is necessary in all that. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2746)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) "kuch dastay bhejte huay unhein apne liye khaas hissa dete, jo poore lashkar ki taqseem se alag hota, aur khums ismein har haal mein wajib hota."

e: Makhul said: I was the slave of a woman of Banu Hudhayl; afterwards she emancipated me. I did not leave Egypt until I had acquired all the knowledge that seemed to me to exist there. I then came to al-Hijaz and I did not leave it until I had acquired all the knowledge that seemed to be available. Then I came to al-Iraq, and I did not leave it until I had acquired all the knowledge that seemed to be available. I then came to Syria, and besieged it. I asked everyone about giving rewards from the booty. I did not find anyone who could tell me anything about it. I then met an old man called Ziyad ibn Jariyah at-Tamimi. I asked him: Have you heard anything about giving rewards from the booty? He replied: Yes. I heard Maslamah al-Fihri say: I was present with the Prophet ﷺ. He gave a quarter of the spoils on the outward journey and a third on the return journey. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2750)
hi: Maine Makhool ko kehte hue suna: main Misr mein Hudhail qabile ki aik aurat ka ghulam tha, unhone mujhe azaad kar diya, main Misr se tab tak nahi nikla jab tak wahan jitna ilm tha maine woh haasil nahi kar liya, jitna mujhe lagta hai, phir main Sham aaya aur usse chhaan maara, main hamesha nafl (extra hissa) ke baare mein poochta raha lekin mujhe koi nahi mila jo mujhe kuch bataaye, yahan tak ke main aik boodhe se mila jinhein Ziyad bin Jariyah At-Tamimi kaha jaata tha, maine unse poocha: "Kya aapne nafl ke baare mein kuch suna hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, maine Habib bin Maslamah Al-Fihri ko kehte suna: main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath maujood tha, unhone jaate waqt chauthaai aur wapas aate waqt tihaai nafl diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would give a third of the spoils after he would keep off the fifth. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2748)
hi: Ke unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) "khums ke baad tihaai nafl dete the."

e: [AI] "The people of the mosque sent me to the son of Abu Awfa to ask him about what the Prophet ﷺ did in the food of Khaybar. So, I went to him and asked him about it. I said, 'Did he distribute it (amongst the people)?' He replied, 'No, it was less than that. Whenever any of us wanted something, he would take his need from it.'"
hi: Masjid walon ne mujhe Ibn Abi Awfa (RA) ke paas bheja ke main unse poochun ke Nabi (SAW) ne Khaybar ke khaane ka kya kiya, main unke paas gaya aur poocha, maine kaha: "Kya aap (SAW) ne uska paanchwan hissa nikaala?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, iske bhi kam tha, aur humme se koi bhi jab kisi cheez ki zaroorat mehsoos karta to usme se apni zaroorat le leta."

e: [AI] The Arabs used to say, "Whoever eats bread with ‘samn’ (a type of clarified butter), when Khaibar is conquered, we will be ‘jihidna’ (withheld) regarding his portion of bread." So, when we conquered Khaibar, I sat on some (bread) and ate from it until I was full. Then, I looked at my abdomen and wondered, "Did I gain weight?"
hi: Arab kaha karte the: "Jo roti khaata hai woh mota ho jaata hai," jab humne Khaybar fatah ki, to "humne unhein unki roti se hataaya, main uspar baith gaya aur khaaya yahan tak ke mera pait bhar gaya, phir main apni kokhon ko dekhne laga ke kya main mota ho gaya hoon?"

e: [AI] I witnessed the conquest of Khaybar with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When the people surrendered, we took possession of their belongings. The people found some sheep which Zaid said were their livestock, and there was nothing faster than the boiling pots being moved away. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw that, he ordered the pots to be brought and they were filled with the shares of each group, with ten sheep for each.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Khaybar ki fatah mein maujood tha, jab qaum ko shikast hui to hum unke saaman mein ja pade, log jo bhi maweshi (jaanwar) paate le lete. Zaid (RA) ne kaha: aur woh maweshi thay, to fauran hi degen ubalne lagin, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh dekha, "to aap (SAW) ne degon ke baare mein hukum diya, unhein ulat diya gaya, phir hamare darmiyan taqseem kiya, har dus (10) logon ko aik bakri di."

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Plundering is not permissible, so abstain from it.' Gundar and Ibn Abi 'Adi narrated this from Shu'bah, mentioning that Tha'laba heard it from the Prophet ﷺ . This hadith has a sound chain of narration and they did not exclude it because of the hadith of Simak ibn Harb, as it was narrated once, from Tha'laba ibn al-Hakam, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ ."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Loot jaayez nahi, isliye degen ulat do." Isi tarah Ghundar aur Ibn Abi Adi ne, Shu'bah se, riwayat ki hai, unhone Tha'labah ke Nabi (SAW) se sunne ka zikr kiya, "aur yeh hadith sahih-ul-isnad hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, Simak bin Harb ki hadith ki wajah se, kyunke unhone ise aik dafa riwayat kiya" Tha'labah bin Al-Hakam se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se.

e: [AI] "People captured a flock of sheep on the day of Khaybar, so they slaughtered them and started cooking them. Then the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) came and ordered for the pots. They were brought to him and he said, 'The spoils are not permissible.'"
hi: Logon ne Khaybar ke din bakriyan loot lin, unhein zibah kiya aur pakane lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) aaye aur degon ke baare mein hukum diya, unhein ulat diya gaya, aur farmaya: "Beshak loot durust nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "He is not one of us who steals, robs, or signals towards theft." Bukhari cited Abu Kudaynah Yahya ibn al-Muhallab as evidence.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh humme se nahi jo loot le, chheene, ya chheenne ka ishara kare." Bukhari ne Abu Kudainah Yahya bin Al-Muhallab ko hujjat maana hai.

e: [AI] The translation of the given sentence from Arabic to English is: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prohibited secret meetings, premeditated murder, and women being trodden on until they give birth."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "chhupke se churaane (khulsah), mujaththamah (bandhkar nishana banaaye gaye jaanwar), aur qaidiyon se sambhog karne se mana kiya jab tak woh apne pait ka bachcha na jan dein."

e: [AI] Narrated by Abu Umamah Al-Bahili, a companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , from Ubada bin As-Samit, who said: "I went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to the Battle of Badr, where we encountered the enemy. When we defeated them, a group of Muslims followed them and killed them. Another group surrounded the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , while yet another group controlled the army. When Allah had granted victory and those who were killed returned, they said to us: 'You took part in the battle and killed the enemy, but we were left behind by Allah and defeated.' Those who surrounded the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'You are not more deserving of him than us. He belongs to us, as we were the ones who surrounded the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and prevented the enemy from reaching him.' And those who controlled the army said to us: 'By Allah, you are not more deserving of him than us. We were the ones who controlled the army.' Then Allah revealed the verse: 'They ask you (O Muhammad) about the spoils of war. Say: "The spoils are for Allah and the Messenger. So fear Allah and amend your relationships."' (Quran 8:1) until His saying: 'If you are believers.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  distributed the spoils among them accordingly."
hi: Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi, ne Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) se riwayat ki, unhone kaha: main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr ki taraf nikla dushman se milne ke liye, jab humne unhein shikast di to Musalmano ka aik giroh unka peechha karte huay unhein qatl karne laga, aur aik giroh Rasulullah (SAW) ke ird-gird jama ho gaya, aur aik giroh lashkar (ke saaman) par qaabiz ho gaya. Jab Allah ne dushman se kaafi kar diya aur woh log wapas aaye jinhone unhein qatl kiya, unhone kaha: "Nafl (khaas hissa) humara hai, humne dushman ko qatl kiya aur humari hi wajah se Allah ne unhein bhagaya aur unhein shikast di." Aur jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghera hua tha unhone kaha: "Tum humse zyada haqdaar nahi ho, yeh humara hai, humne Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghera taake dushman ko unpar mauka na mile." Aur jinhone lashkar (ke saaman) par qaabu paaya unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tum humse zyada haqdaar nahi ho, hum hi the jinhone lashkar par qaabu paaya." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Woh aapse anfaal (maal-e-ghaneemat) ke baare mein poochte hain, kah dijiye: Anfaal Allah aur Rasool ke liye hain, isliye Allah se daro aur aapas ke maamlaat sudhaaro}" (Surah Al-Anfal 1) unke farmaan tak: "{agar tum momin ho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 91), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne ise unke darmiyan barabar-barabar taqseem kiya.

e: [AI] Among us are the companions of Badr. Then, he mentioned the hadith in its entirety. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Yeh humare, Badr ke sahaba ke, baare mein nazil hui," phir unhone poori hadith zikr ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the Battle of Khaybar. A group went out and captured a man who had sheep under his care. They brought him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he addressed him with words that Allah allowed him to speak. The man said to him, "I have believed in you and in what you have brought. But what about the sheep, O Messenger of Allah? They are entrusted to me and they belong to the people - ewes and rams and more than that." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Collect some branches and throw them in their faces, and they will return to their owners." So he took a handful of twigs or dirt and threw them in their faces. They scattered until each sheep returned to its owner. Then he advanced towards the formation and was hit by an arrow that killed him. He never performed a prostration for Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Take him to the hidden camp." So they took him to the hidden camp of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When the Prophet ﷺ  finished, he went in to see him then came out and said, "The Islam of your companion is good. I entered upon him, and he has two wives with him from the pure, fair-eyed maidens."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Khaybar ki jung mein thay, aik dasta nikla, unhone aik shakhs ko pakda jo bakriyan charaa raha tha, woh use Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaye, Nabi (SAW) ne usse jitni baat karni thi ki, to us shakhs ne unse kaha: "Main aap par aur jo aap laaye hain uspar imaan le aaya hoon, lekin in bakriyon ka kya hoga, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)? Yeh amaanat hain, aur yeh logon ki hain, aik bakri, do bakriyan, ya usse zyada?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Inke chehron par kankariyan phenko, yeh apne maalikon ke paas wapas chali jaayengi." To usne kankariyan ya mitti ki mutthi li aur unke chehron par phenki, woh tez chalti hui apne apne maalikon ke paas pahunch gayi, phir woh saf ki taraf aage badha, use aik teer laga aur woh qatl ho gaya, jabke usne kabhi Allah ke liye aik bhi sajda nahi ki thi. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise khaimay mein le jao." To use Rasulullah (SAW) ke khaimay mein le jaaya gaya, jab Rasulullah (SAW) faarigh huay to unke paas dakhil huay, phir bahar aakar farmaya: "Iske saathi ka Islam kitna achha raha, main iske paas gaya to iske sath dekha ke uski do biwiyan Hooron mein se hain."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is as follows: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  brought a deer with a necklace made from the spoils of war, and he divided it equally between the free women and the slave women."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) "ke paas aik chhoti thaili laayi gayi jismein maal-e-ghaneemat ke moti thay, to aap (SAW) ne use aazaad aur laundi auraton ke darmiyan barabar-barabar taqseem kiya."

e: "The Messenger of Allah forbade selling something from the spoils of war prior to its distribution, having intercourse with a pregnant woman until she gives birth, and (eating) the flesh of any predator that has fangs. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4645)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khaybar ke din maal-e-ghaneemat ko taqseem hone se pehle bechne se, aur haamila qaidiyon se sambhog karne se jab tak woh apne pait ka bachcha na jan dein, mana kiya, aur farmaya: "Kya tum kisi doosre ki khaiti ko seenchte ho?" Aur ghar palu gadhon ka gosht khaane se, aur har naab-daar darinde ke gosht khaane se (bhi mana kiya).

e:
[AI] "On the day of Khaybar, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prohibited the sale of spoils until they are distributed."

Some of this text has been narrated with a sound chain of narrators, according to the conditions set by the two sheikhs."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khaybar ke din maal-e-ghaneemat ko taqseem hone se pehle bechne se mana kiya." Isme se kuch mazmoon sahih sanad ke sath riwayat kiya gaya hai, Shaykhain ki shart par. Sahih.

e: On the day of Khaibar, Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the eating of donkey meat. (Using translation from Bukhārī 4217)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khaybar ke din ghar palu gadhon ke gosht se, aur haamila auraton se sambhog karne se jab tak woh apne pait ka bachcha na jan dein, aur har naab-daar darinde se, aur khums ko taqseem hone se pehle bechne se mana kiya." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  conquered Mecca, some people from the Quraysh came to him and said, 'O Muhammad, we are your allies and your people. Our messengers have caught up with you, who have no interest in Islam. They have only fled from work. So send them back to us.' Abu Bakr consulted with the Prophet about their matter. The Prophet asked Umar, 'What do you think?' He replied, 'The same as Abu Bakr.' The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'O people of Quraysh, Allah will soon send among you a man from among yourselves who will test the sincerity of your hearts towards faith. He will bring your necks in submission to the religion.' Abu Bakr asked, 'Is it me, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied, 'No.' Umar asked, 'Is it me, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied, 'No, but he is one who repairs sandals in the mosque.' He used to mend the Prophet's sandals and later gave them to Ali to mend. Then the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, I have heard him say, "Do not lie about me. Whoever lies about me will enter the Fire."'"
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Makkah fatah ki, to Quraish ke kuch log unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, hum aapke hulafa aur aapki qaum hain, aur humare ghulam aapke paas aa gaye hain, unhein Islam mein koi khaas raghbat nahi, woh sirf kaam se bhaage hain, isliye unhein hume wapas kar dijiye." To aap (SAW) ne unke maamle mein Abu Bakr (RA) se mashwara kiya, unhone kaha: "Yeh sach keh rahe hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." To aap (SAW) ne Umar (RA) se poocha: "Tumhari kya raay hai?" Unhone bhi Abu Bakr (RA) jaisi baat kahi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Quraish ke giroh, Allah zaroor tum par aik aisa shakhs khada karega jo tum mein se hoga, jiske dil ko Allah ne imaan ke liye aazmaaya hoga, aur woh deen ke maamle mein tumhari gardanein maaray ga." To Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Kya woh main hoon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Kya woh main hoon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke woh masjid mein juta seene wala hai," aur aap (SAW) ne apna juta Ali (RA) ki taraf uchaal diya tha ke woh use seedh dein. Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suno, maine unhein kehte suna hai: 'Mujh par jhoot mat bolo, kyunke jo mujhpar jhoot bole woh Jahannam mein dakhil hoga.'"

e: [AI] That the Prophet ﷺ  distributed two arrows to each of two hundred horsemen on the day of Khaybar.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "Khaybar ke din do sau (200) ghodon ke liye do-do hisse taqseem kiye."

e: from his father who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Blessed are the tribes of Al-Asad and Al-Ash'arun, they flee not from fighting nor do they pilfer the spoils of war. They are from me and I am from them.'" He ('Amir) said: "So I narrated that to Mu'awiyah, and he said: "This is not how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said it, he said: 'They are from me, and for me.' I said, this is not how my father narrated it to me, rather he narrated to me, saying: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "They are from me and I am from them.'" So he said: 'Then you are more knowledgeable of your father's Hadith.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3947)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kitni achhi qabila hai Al-Asad aur Ash'ariyyun, woh jung mein nahi bhaagte aur na hi apne aap ko mujhse alag rakhte hain, woh mujhse hain aur main unse hoon." Unhone kaha: to maine yeh baat Muawiyah (RA) ko bataayi, unhone kaha: "Aisa nahi hai, Rasulullah (SAW) ne kaha tha: 'Woh mujhse hain aur meri taraf hain.'" Maine kaha: "Aisa nahi hai, mere waalid ne mujhe yeh bataya tha, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Woh mujhse hain aur main unse hoon.'" Unhone kaha: "To tum apne waalid ki hadith ko zyada jaante ho."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to command Bilal to make a call when he received a booty. He would call three times, and then the people would raise whatever they had obtained. Then the Prophet ﷺ  would command that it be divided into fifths. A man came to him with a bridle made of hair, and the booty had already been divided. The Prophet ﷺ  asked him, "Have you heard Bilal making the call three times?" The man replied, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ  then asked, "What stopped you from bringing it?" The man apologized, and the Prophet ﷺ  said to him, "Be the one who would deal with it on the Day of Resurrection. I will not accept it from you."
hi: Nabi (SAW) jab maal-e-ghaneemat paate to Bilal (RA) ko hukum dete, woh teen martaba aalaan karte, to log apna maal-e-ghaneemat le kar aate, phir aap (SAW) uska hukum dete aur uska khums nikaala jaata. Aik shakhs aik baalon ki lagaam le kar aaya jabke maal-e-ghaneemat taqseem ho chuki thi, aap (SAW) ne usse poocha: "Kya tumne Bilal (RA) ko teen martaba pukaarte suna?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "To tumhein isse laane se kis cheez ne roka?" To usne maazrat karni shuru ki, aap (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Tum khud hi ise Qayamat ke din le aana, main ise tumse hargiz qubool nahi karunga."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Indeed, one of the prophets from the prophets fought against the people of a city until when he was about to conquer it, he feared that the sun would set. So he said to the sun, 'O sun, you are commanded and I am commanded with my sanctity upon you, do not set for a moment from the day.' Allah imprisoned it until he conquered the city. And whenever they obtained spoils, they would bring them close to the sacrificial offering. Then the fire would come and consume it. But when they placed the sacrificial offering, the fire did not come to consume it. So they said, 'O Prophet of Allah, why is our sacrificial offering not accepted?' He said, 'You have among you a thief.' They said, 'How can we know who has the thief?' He said, 'They are twelve tribes, let the head of each tribe come and give me his pledge.' So the head of each tribe pledged allegiance to him, and the Prophet's hand stuck to the hand of a man from among them. He said, 'You have the thief.' The man said, 'How can I know which tribe he is from?' He said, 'You should summon your tribe and have them pledge allegiance to you one by one.' So he did, and his hand stuck to the hand of the man holding the spoils. Then the fire came and consumed him.' Ka'ab said, 'Allah and His Messenger have spoken the truth.' He intends in the Book of Allah, meaning the Torah. Then he said, 'O Abu Hurairah, who do you think was the prophet?' He said, 'No.' He said, 'It was Joshua bin Noon.' He said, 'Which city was it?' He said, 'It was the city of Jericho.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak Ambiya mein se aik Nabi ne aik shehar walon se jung ki yahan tak ke jab woh use fatah karne ke qareeb pahuncha to unhein darr laga ke suraj ghurab (ghatam) ho jayega, to unhone suraj se kaha: 'Aye suraj, tu hukum ke taabe hai aur main bhi hukum ka taabe hoon, meri izzat ka waasta hai tujhpar, tu din ke aik ghante ke liye thehar jaa.'" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: to Allah ne use rok liya yahan tak ke usne (shehar) fatah kar liya. Aur woh jab maal-e-ghaneemat paate to use qurbaani mein pesh karte, to aag aa kar use khaa jaati, jab unhein maal-e-ghaneemat mila to unhone qurbaani rakhi lekin aag nahi aayi use khaane, to unhone kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, humein kya hua hai ke humari qurbaani qubool nahi ho rahi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein khiyanat (maal chhupaana) hai." Unhone poocha: "Humein kaise pata chale ke khiyanat kiske paas hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: - aur woh baara (12) qabile the - "Tum mein se har qabile ka sardaar mujhse bay'at kare," to har qabile ka sardaar unse bay'at karne laga, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: to Nabi ka haath unme se aik aadmi ke haath se chipak gaya, aap (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Tere paas khiyanat hai." Usne kaha: "Mujhe kaise pata chale ke yeh kis qabile mein se hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne qabile ko bulaao aur unse aik-aik karke bay'at lo." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: to usne aisa hi kiya, to uska haath khiyanat karne wale aadmi ke haath se chipak gaya, to aag aa kar usse khaa gayi." Ka'b ne kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool ne sach farmaya, Allah ki qasam, aisa hi Allah ki Kitaab mein hai," ya'ni Tauraat mein. Phir unhone kaha: "Aye Abu Hurairah, kya Nabi (SAW) ne tumhein bataaya ke woh Nabi kaun the?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Ka'b ne kaha: "Woh Yusha bin Nun the." Unhone poocha: "Kya unhone tumhein bataaya ke woh basti kaunsi thi?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "Woh Ariha shehar tha."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said about the prisoners of war on the day of Badr: "If you wish, you can kill them, and if you wish, you can redeem them. If you choose to redeem them, you should listen to the redemption price offered, and if any of you is martyred, their last will should be fulfilled." Thabit ibn Qais was the last one among seventy people who were martyred at the Battle of Yamama.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Badr ke qaidiyon ke baare mein farmaya: "Agar chaho to unhein qatl karo, aur agar chaho to unse fidya lo, aur fidya ke badle tum mein se utne hi shaheed honge jitne woh (qaidi) hain," to sattar (70) shaheed huay, aur unme aakhri Thabit bin Qais (RA) the jo Yamama mein shaheed huay.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ransomed four hundred captives from the people of Jahiliyyah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "jaahiliyat waalon ke qaidiyon ke fidya mein chaar sau (400) muqarrar kiya."

e: [AI] There were some prisoners on the day of Badr who had no ransom, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  made their ransom to be teaching the children of the Ansar how to write. A boy from the children of the Ansar came to his father and said, "What is your problem?" He said, "My teacher hit me." The evil (person) seeks to enter Badr's reward, and by Allah, it will never come to him.
hi: Badr ke din kuch qaidi aise the jinke paas fidya nahi tha, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka fidya yeh muqarrar kiya ke woh Ansar ke bachchon ko likhna sikhaayen." Unhone kaha: to Ansar ke bachchon mein se aik ladka apne waalid ke paas aaya, unhone poocha: "Tumhein kya hua?" Usne kaha: "Mere ustaad ne mujhe maara." Unhone kaha: "Yeh khabees (chaalak) Badr ke ajr ka talabgaar hai, Allah ki qasam, tum kabhi uske paas nahi jaaogay."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is:

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to distribute a portion of his day's income, giving two shares to the married and one share to the unmarried.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab bhi unke paas fai (maal-e-ghaneemat) aata, usi din taqseem kar dete, shaadi-shuda ko do hisse dete aur kuwaare ko aik hissa."

e: [AI] "I entered along with Al-Ishtr (Abu Bakr) to Ali ibn Abi Talib on the day of the Camel (battle). I asked him, 'Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  make a specific covenant with you, separate from the public?' He replied, 'No, he only made this covenant,' and he pulled out a piece of paper from his sheath, on which it was written, 'The believers are united in their blood, and their defense is sought by the weakest among them. They have a hand against anyone other than them; a believer should not be killed in retaliation for an unbeliever or someone who has a covenant with him.'"
hi: Main aur Al-Ashtar Ali bin Abi Talib ke paas Jang-e-Jamal ke din gaye, maine poocha: "Kya Rasulullah (SAW) ne aapko aam logon ke ilawa koi khaas ahd diya tha?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, siwaye is ke," aur unhone apni talwaar ke ghilaaf se (aik kaghaz) nikaala, jismein likha tha: "Momino ka khoon barabar hai, unme se sabse chhota bhi unki taraf se zimmedari nibha sakta hai, aur woh doosron ke muqaable mein aik haath (mutthahid) hain, kisi kaafir ke badle koi momin qatl nahi kiya jaayega, aur na hi koi ahd waala apne ahd ki muddat mein."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "He grants refuge to the weakest among my ummah."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat mein se sabse chhota bhi (kisi ko) panah de sakta hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say, "Muslims are equal in their blood."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Musalmano ka khoon barabar hai," hadith.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The protection of Muslims is one, so if they are eligible for a reward, do not withhold it from them, for every betrayer will have a flag known by him on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalmano ki zimmedari aik hai, agar unme se koi (kisi ko) amaan de, to usse mat todo, kyunke har dhoka-baaz ke liye aik jhanda hai jisse woh Qayamat ke din pehchaana jayega."

e: [AI] "On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said: 'Do not reside with the polytheists nor engage in intimate relations with them, for whoever resides with them or engages in intimate relations with them is not of us.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mushrikeen ke sath mat raho, aur unke sath (mil-jul kar) mat raho, jo unke sath rahe ya unke sath mil-jul jaaye, woh humme se nahi."

e: "A man from among the Ansar accepted Islam, then he apostatized and went back to Shirk. Then he regretted that, and sent word to his people (saying): 'Ask the Messenger of Allah [SAW], is there any repentance for me?' His people came to the Messenger of Allah [SAW] and said: 'So and so regrets (what he did), and he has told us to ask you if there is any repentance for him?' Then the Verses: 'How shall Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their Belief up to His saying: Verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful' was revealed. So he sent word to him, and he accepted Islam." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4068)
hi: Ansar ka aik shakhs Islam laaya, phir murtad ho gaya aur mushrikeen se ja mila, phir usse pachhtaawa hua, to usne apni qaum ko bheja ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) se poochein: "Kya mere liye tauba ka koi rasta hai?" Unhone kaha: to yeh nazil hui: "{Allah kaise us qaum ko hidayat de jinhone apne imaan ke baad kufr kiya}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 86) unke farmaan tak: "{siwaye un logon ke jinhone iske baad tauba ki aur (apne aap ko) sanwaara, to beshak Allah bakhshne wala, reham karne wala hai}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 89). Unhone kaha: to uski qaum ne usse yeh bheja, aur usne Islam qubool kar liya.

e: When the Prophet ﷺ feared a (group of) people, he would say: "O Allah, we make Thee our shield against them, and take refuge in Thee from their evils." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1537)
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) jab kisi qaum se darte to farmate: "Aye Allah, hum tujhe unke seenon mein rakhte hain, aur hum unki buraiyon se teri panah maangte hain."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic text is:

"That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to supplicate and say, 'O Allah, grant me enjoyment and benefit from my hearing and sight, and make them an inheritance for me. O Allah, help me against my enemies and show me my revenge in them.'"
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) yeh dua kiya karte the: "Aye Allah, mujhe mere kaan aur meri aankh se faida uthaane de aur unhein mera waaris bana de, Aye Allah, mujhe mere dushman par fatah de aur mujhe uske khilaaf mera badla dikha."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone kills a man whom he grants protection prematurely, Allah will forbid him to enter Paradise. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2760)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi mu'aahid (ahd waale) ko bagair sahih waje ke qatl kare, Allah uspar Jannat haraam kar deta hai."

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say when they (messengers sent by Musaylimah) read the letter of Musaylimah: What do you believe yourselves? They said: We believe as he believes. He said: I swear by Allah that were it not that messengers are not killed, I would cut off your heads. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2761)
hi: Musailimah (jhoote nabuwwat ke daawedaar) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko khat likha tha, aur mujhe Ibn Ishaq ne, Sa'd bin Tariq Al-Ashja'i se, unhone Salamah bin Nu'aim bin Mas'ood Al-Ashja'i se, unhone apne waalid Nu'aim se, hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Musailimah ke do qaasidon se, jab unhone Musailimah ka khat padha, yeh kehte suna: "Tum dono kya kehte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Hum wahi kehte hain jo usne kaha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar qaasidon ko qatl na karne ki paabandi na hoti, to main tum dono ki gardanein maar deta."

e: When the fighting intensified and the two sides met in battle, we sought shelter with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and no one was closer to the enemy than him. (Using translation from Aḥmad 1347)
hi: "Jab jung ki garmi tez hoti aur do fauj aamne-saamne hoti, to hum Rasulullah (SAW) ki panah mein aa jaate, to humme se koi bhi dushman ke itna qareeb nahi hota jitna woh khud hote."

e: [AI] "He (the speaker) said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'A battle in the sea is better than ten battles on land, and whoever conquers the sea, it is as if he has conquered all valleys and the table in it is like a (person) washing himself in his blood.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Samundar mein aik jung khushki ki das (10) jungon se behtar hai, aur jo samundar paar kare, goya usne sari wadiyaan paar kar lin, aur jise samundar mein chakkar (mitli) aaye woh apne khoon mein latpat zakhmi jaisa hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying: "One day spent in the cause of Allah is better than a thousand in other places." Sahih.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Allah ki raah mein aik din ka pehra iske ilawa hazaar (1000) dinon se behtar hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Guarding a frontier in the cause of Allah for a day is better than the world and whatever is in it. Have I conveyed this to you?" They said, "Yes." He said, "O Allah, bear witness to this."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Allah ki raah mein aik din ka pehra iske ilawa hazaar (1000) dinon se behtar hai, kya maine tumhein pahuncha diya?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, gawah rehna."

e: [AI] Abu al-Muwaajih narrated that Abdan narrated that Abdulah narrated to me that Haywah ibn Shurayh informed me that Abu Hani' narrated to me, Hamaad ibn Hani' al-Khawlani, from Amr ibn Malik al-Janbi. He said that he heard Fadalah ibn Ubayd narrating from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  who said, "Whoever dies in one of these ranks he will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection as a martyr, or a pilgrim, or something similar to that."
hi: Fadalah bin Ubaid (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat ki, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi in darjaat mein se kisi aik darje par mare, woh Qayamat ke din usi par uthaaya jayega - chahe woh ribat (sarhad ki pehra-daari) ho, Hajj ho, ya kuch aur."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "There is no Arabian horse except that it is called for with two invocations at every dawn. He says, 'O Allah, indeed You have made me beloved among the children of Adam, so make me beloved to his family and possessions."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: koi bhi Arabi ghoda aisa nahi jise har fajr do dua karne ki ijaazat na di jaaye, woh kehta hai: "Aye Allah, tu ne mujhe Bani Adam ke supurd kiya hai, isliye mujhe uske ghar walon aur uske maal mein sabse aziz bana de."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to name a mare a horse. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2546)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ghodi ko 'faras' (ghoda) kaha karte the."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are three sources of happiness for the son of Adam and three sources of misery for the son of Adam. From the sources of happiness for the son of Adam are a righteous spouse, a good home, and a good means of transportation. And from the sources of misery for the son of Adam are a cramped dwelling, an evil spouse, and a bad means of transportation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ibn Adam ki khush-naseebi teen cheezon mein hai, aur Ibn Adam ki bad-naseebi teen cheezon mein hai. Ibn Adam ki khush-naseebi mein se: nek biwi, achha ghar, aur achhi sawaari. Aur Ibn Adam ki bad-naseebi mein se: tang ghar, buri biwi, aur buri sawaari.

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Bring me the weak, for you only receive provision and Divine support by virtue of your weak ones.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3179)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Mujhe apne kamzoron mein dhoondo, kyunke tumhein rizq aur madad tumhare kamzoron ki wajah se hi milti hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out on the day of Badr along with three hundred and fifteen (men). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: O Allah, they are on foot, provide mount for them; O Allah , they are naked, clothe them; O Allah, they are hungry, provide food for them. Allah then bestowed victory on them. They returned when they were clothed. There was no man of them but he returned with one or two camels; they were clothed and ate to their fill. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2747)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Badr ke din teen sau pandrah (315) jung karne walon ke sath nikle, jaise Talut nikle the, Rasulullah (SAW) ne nikalte waqt unke liye dua ki, farmaya: "Aye Allah, yeh nange paanv hain, inhein sawaari de, Aye Allah, yeh nangey hain, inhein kapda de, Aye Allah, yeh bhooke hain, inhein khilaao," to Allah ne unke liye Badr ke din fatah kholi, woh wapas laute aur unme har aadmi aik ya do oont ke sath wapas laute, unhone kapde pehne aur pait bhar khaaya.

e: [AI] From Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said during a journey: "Indeed, we are going to travel tonight, if Allah wills. No one should accompany us who is weak or sickly." So, a man set out on his she-camel, which was difficult to control, and it stumbled, causing his neck to snap, and he died. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered for him to be buried, and then he ordered Bilal to call out, "Indeed, Paradise is not for those who disobey."
hi: Thawban (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke azaad kiye gaye ghulam, ne bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik safar mein farmaya: "Hum Insha'Allah aaj raat safar karengay, isliye koi kamzor ya bemaqool (jaanwar par) hamare sath na chale." To aik shakhs apni aisi oontni par sawaar hua jo sarkash thi, woh gir gaya aur uski gardan tut gayi, woh mar gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne hukum diya ke use dafan kar diya jaaye, phir Bilal (RA) ko hukum diya, unhone aalaan kiya: "Beshak Jannat kisi na-farmaan ke liye jaayaz nahi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  came across a man who was dividing dates on the day of the Battle of Khaybar. The man said, "O Muhammad, be fair." The Prophet replied, "Woe to you! Who will be fair to me if I am not fair? Who else can you seek justice from after me?" Then, the Prophet said, "Soon there will come a people who will recite the Qur'an but it will not go beyond their throats. They will leave Islam as quickly as the arrow pierces the target. Whenever you meet them, kill them."
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke aap (SAW) Khaybar ke din khajoor taqseem kar rahe the, usne kaha: "Aye Muhammad, insaaf karo." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Afsos tumpar, agar main insaaf na karoon to tumhare sath insaaf kaun karega? Ya mere baad tum kisse insaaf talaash karogay?" Phir farmaya: "Aisa waqt aayega ke is jaisa aik giroh aayega, woh Allah ki Kitaab padhenge jabke woh iske dushman honge, woh Allah ki Kitaab padhenge, unke sar munde honge, jab woh nikalein to unki gardanein maaro."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Indeed, there are some people from my nation whose tongues are more eloquent in reciting the Quran than their actions would indicate. They pass through the religion just as an arrow passes through its target. So when you encounter them, kill them, for the one who kills them will be rewarded."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak meri Ummat mein se kuch log aise honge jo sakht-mizaaj, teez-zubaan honge, Quran padhenge lekin woh unki gardan se aage nahi jaayega, woh deen se aise nikal jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se nikal jaata hai, jab tum unse milo to unhein qatl karo, kyunke jo unhein qatl kare use ajr milega."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying: "There will be a group among my Ummah (nation) who have swift tongues against the Quran. So, when you see them, refute them."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Meri Ummat mein aise log paida hongay jo dushman-mizaaj, teez-zubaan honge Quran mein, jab tum unhein dekho to unhein khamosh kar do (harkat se rok do)."

e: [AI] "To see a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and for him to speak to me about the Khawarij, I met Abu Barzah on the day of Arafah among a group of his companions, so I said: 'O Abu Barzah, tell us something you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  regarding the Khawarij.' He said: 'I will inform you of something that my ears heard and my eyes saw. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was given some dinars from a certain land and he used to distribute them. He had a man by his side who was dark-skinned with thick hair and was wearing two white garments with signs of prostration between his eyes. He came close to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from his front, but the Prophet did not give him anything. Then he approached him from his left side, but the Prophet did not give him anything. Then he approached him from his back, and he said: "By Allah, O Muhammad, you have not been fair in your distribution today." This made the Prophet ﷺ  angry, and he said: "You will not find any other person after me who is more just towards you." He repeated this statement three times, and then he said: "A group will emerge from the east, reciting the Quran, but it will not go beyond their throats. They will pass through the religion just as an arrow passes through its target, and then they will not return to it." The Prophet ﷺ  placed his hand on his chest and said: "They have the mark of a fork on their forehead; they will continue to emerge until the last of them appears. So when you see them, then kill them." Hammād repeated this statement three times, saying, "They are the worst of creation and creatures." Then he added, "They will not return to it."
hi: Ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik shakhs ko dekhein aur woh unhein Khawarij ke baare mein hadith bataayen, unhone kaha: to main Abu Barzah (RA) se Arafah ke din unke kuch saathiyon ke darmiyan mila, maine kaha: "Aye Abu Barzah, humein woh baat bataaiye jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se Khawarij ke baare mein suni ho." Unhone kaha: "Main tumhein wahi bataata hoon jo mere kaano ne suna aur meri aankhon ne dekha, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas kisi ilaqe se kuch dinar laaye gaye, aap (SAW) unhein taqseem kar rahe the, unke paas aik kaale rang ka shakhs tha, jiske baal munde huay the, uspar do safed kapde the, uski aankhon ke darmiyan sajde ka nishaan tha, woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne aaya, unke chehre ki taraf se, to aap (SAW) ne use kuch nahi diya, phir woh unki baayi taraf se aaya, aap (SAW) ne use phir bhi kuch nahi diya, phir woh unke peechhe se aaya aur kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, Aye Muhammad, aap aaj se insaaf nahi kar rahe taqseem mein.' Nabi (SAW) ko ghussa aaya aur farmaya: 'Mere baad tum mujhse zyada insaaf karne wala kisi ko nahi paaogay,' yeh baat teen martaba farmaayi, phir farmaya: 'Mashriq (poorab) ki taraf se aik qaum nikalegi, jaise unka hulya aisa ho, woh Quran padhenge lekin woh unki gardan se aage nahi jaayega, woh deen se aise nikal jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se nikal jaata hai, phir woh usme wapas nahi aayenge,' aur aap (SAW) ne apna haath apne seene par rakha, 'unki nishaani sar mundwaana hai, woh nikalte rahenge yahan tak ke unka aakhri shakhs nikal jaaye, jab tum unhein dekho to unhein qatl karo,' Hammad ne yeh teen martaba kaha, 'woh makhlooq aur takhleeq mein sabse buray hain,' Hammad ne yeh teen martaba kaha, aur kaha: unhone yeh bhi kaha: 'woh usme wapas nahi aayenge.'"

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "There will be disputes and divisions in my nation, and there will come a people who will please you and be pleased with themselves. They will appear to be more devoted to God than others, but they are not truly from God. They will speak eloquently but their actions will be evil. They will call people to God, yet they are not in any way connected with God. When you encounter them, kill them." The companions asked, "O Messenger of Allah, describe them to us." He replied, "They will have shaved heads and will remove hair from their bodies" which means they will shave their pubic hair.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat mein ikhtilaaf aur phoot paida hogi, aur aik qaum aayegi jo tumhein pasand aayegi aur woh khud apne aap se khush hongay, unhein qatl karne wale Allah ke zyada qareeb hongay unse, unki baat achhi hogi lekin amal bura, woh Allah ki taraf bulaayenge lekin unka Allah se koi taalluq nahi hoga, jab tum unse milo to unhein khamosh kar do (harkat se rok do)." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein unke baare mein bataaiye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unki nishaani sar mundwaana aur pooray tareeqe se baal saaf karna hai," ya'ni chhote karne ki bajaaye jad se saaf karna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: aur "tasbeet" baalon ko jad se saaf karne ke ma'ne mein hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Soon there will appear disagreement and dissension in my people; there will be people who will be good in speech and bad in work. They recite the Qur'an, but it does not pass their collar-bones. They will swerve from the religion as an animal goes through the animal shot at. They will not return to it till the arrow comes back to its notch. They are worst of the people and animals. Happy is the one who kills them and they kill him. They call to the book of Allah, but they have nothing to do with it. He who fights against them will be nearer to Allah than them (the rest of the people). The people asked: What is their sign? He replied: They shave the head. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4765)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat mein ikhtilaaf aur phoot paida hogi, aik qaum aisi hogi jinki baat achhi hogi lekin amal bura, woh Quran padhenge lekin woh unki gardan se aage nahi jaayega, tum mein se koi apni namaz ko unki namaz ke aage, aur apne roze ko unke roze ke aage, kam samjhega, woh deen se aise nikal jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se nikalta hai, aur woh (teer) tab tak wapas nahi aata jab tak use uske nishaane par wapas na kiya jaaye, woh makhlooq aur takhleeq mein sabse buray hain, khush-naseeb hai woh jo unhein qatl kare ya unke haathon qatl ho, woh Allah ki Kitaab ki taraf bulaate hain lekin unka usse koi taalluq nahi, jo unse jung kare woh Allah ke zyada qareeb hai unse." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), unki nishaani kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sar mundwaana." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Soon there will appear disagreement and dissension in my people; there will be people who will be good in speech and bad in work. They recite the Qur'an, but it does not pass their collar-bones. They will swerve from the religion as an animal goes through the animal shot at. They will not return to it till the arrow comes back to its notch. They are worst of the people and animals. Happy is the one who kills them and they kill him. They call to the book of Allah, but they have nothing to do with it. He who fights against them will be nearer to Allah than them (the rest of the people). The people asked: What is their sign? He replied: They shave the head. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4765)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat mein ikhtilaaf aur phoot paida hogi, aik qaum aisi hogi jinki baat achhi hogi lekin amal bura, woh Quran padhenge lekin woh unki gardan se aage nahi jaayega, woh deen se aise nikal jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se nikalta hai, woh wapas nahi aayenge jab tak (teer) uske nishaane par wapas na kiya jaaye, makhlooq aur takhleeq mein sabse buray, khush-naseeb hai woh jo unhein qatl kare ya unke haathon qatl ho, woh Allah ki Kitaab ki taraf bulaate hain lekin unka usse koi taalluq nahi, jo unse jung kare woh Allah ke zyada qareeb hai unse." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), unki nishaani kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sar mundwaana." Qatadah ne yeh hadith Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri se nahi suni, balke unhone ise Abu Al-Mutawakkil An-Naji se suna, jinhone Abu Sa'eed se suna.

e: [AI] From the Prophet is reported to have said, "Their example is like that of a man who shoots an arrow and then goes to seek it where it fell, he takes it and looks above it but sees no fat or blood on it. Then he looks at the feathers of the arrow but finds no fat or blood on them. He then looks at the tip of the arrow but finds no fat or blood on it, just as nothing of the fat and blood is attached to it. Likewise, these people have no connection to anything of Islam." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unki misaal aik aise aadmi ki hai jo teer chalaaye, phir teer ko dhoondh kar wahan jaaye jahan woh gira ho, use uthaaye aur uske nishaane ko dekhe, use koi charbi ya khoon na mile, phir uske paron ko dekhe, use koi charbi ya khoon na mile, phir uske phal (noke) ko dekhe, use koi charbi ya khoon na mile, jaise koi charbi ya khoon uske sath nahi laga, isi tarah yeh log Islam ki kisi cheez se juday huay nahi honge." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I and Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri went to Hudhaifah and said, "O Abu Abdullah! Talk to us about what you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding turmoil." Hudhaifah said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Stick to the Book of Allah wherever it takes you.'" We said, "But what if people differ among themselves?" He replied, "Follow the group of Muslims and their Imam (leader), and if a division occurs and you see a group aligning with Ibn Sumayyah, then align with them, for they will be adhering to the Book of Allah." I asked, "Who is Ibn Sumayyah?" He said, "Do you not know him?" I indicated that I did not, so he said, "He is Ammar ibn Yasir." I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying to Ammar, 'O Abu Al-Yaqzan, you will not die until the rebellious group kills you on the way.'"
hi: Main aur Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) Hudhaifah (RA) ke paas gaye, humne kaha: "Aye Abu Abdullah, humein woh baat bataaiye jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se fitne ke baare mein suni ho." Hudhaifah (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki Kitaab ke sath ghoomo jahan bhi woh ghoome." Humne poocha: "Agar log ikhtilaaf karein to hum kiske sath rahein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us giroh ko dekho jismein Ibn Sumayyah hain, unke sath raho, kyunke woh Allah ki Kitaab ke sath ghoomte hain." Maine poocha: "Ibn Sumayyah kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Tum unhein nahi jaante?" Maine kaha: "Mujhe wazeh kar dein." Unhone kaha: "Ammar bin Yasir (RA)." Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ammar (RA) se yeh kehte suna: "Aye Abul-Yaqzan, tum tab tak nahi maroge jab tak tumhein baaghi (sarkash) giroh raah se hatakar qatl na kar de."

e: [AI] "He said to him and his son Ali, 'Go to Abu Sa'id and listen to his words about the matter of the Khawarij.' So they went and found him fixing a wall. When he saw us, he took his cloak, covered himself with it, and then began to speak to us until he mentioned it in the mosque. He said, 'We used to carry one brick at a time, while the construction workers carried two bricks at a time.' The Prophet ﷺ  saw him and began to shake the dust off his head, saying, 'O Ammar, why don't you carry one brick at a time as your companions do?' Ammar replied, 'I seek reward from Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ  shook his head and said, 'Woe to Ammar, the opposing faction will kill him.' Ammar said, 'I seek refuge in Allah from trials and tribulations.'"
hi: Unhone unse aur unke bete Ali se kaha: "Abu Sa'eed ke paas jao aur unse Khawarij ke maamle mein unki hadith suno." To woh gaye, unhein aik baagh mein paaya jahan woh (kaam) theek kar rahe the, jab unhone humein dekha to apni chaadar uthaayi, phir baith gaye, phir humein hadith bayaan karne lage yahan tak ke masjid mein bhi unka zikr buland ho gaya, unhone kaha: "Hum aik-aik eent uthaate the, aur Ammar (RA) do-do eent uthaate the, Nabi (SAW) ne unhein dekha aur unke sar se mitti jhaadte huay farmaate: 'Aye Ammar, kya tum aik-aik eent nahi uthaate jaisa tumhare sathi uthaate hain?'" Unhone kaha: "Main Allah se ajr chahta hoon." Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) mitti jhaadte rahe aur farmaate rahe: "Afsos Ammar par, use baaghi giroh qatl karega." Unhone kaha: aur Ammar (RA) kehte: "Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon fitno se."

e: [AI] I witnessed Abu Umamah al-Bahili standing at the gate of Damascus, on top of the Haruriyah (a hill), saying, "The dogs of the people of Hellfire are those who say it (the phrase "Kilabu Ahli-Nar") three times. It is better for those who kill them." Tears came from his eyes, and a man said to him, "Abu Umamah, did you hear this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  or is it your opinion?" He replied, "If I had not heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  except once or twice or three times, then I would have been brave to say so. But he repeated it seven times. This is what I have informed you." The man said, "I see that your eyes have teared up." Abu Umamah replied, "When they were believers and then disbelieved after their faith." Then he recited the verse, "And do not be like those who became divided and differed after clear proofs had come to them." (Surah Al-Imran, 3:105) It happened to them twice."
hi: Maine Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (RA) ko dekha, woh Hauriyaan (Khawarij) ke sar par Dimashq ke darwaze par khade the aur keh rahe the: "Jahannam ke kutte," yeh teen martaba kaha, "sabse behtareen maqtool woh hai jise unhone qatl kiya," aur unki aankhon se aansu bahne lage. To aik shakhs ne unse kaha: "Aye Abu Umamah, aapka yeh kehna ke yeh log Jahannam ke kutte hain, kya yeh aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suna hai ya yeh aapki apni raay hai?" Unhone kaha: "Main itna dilair nahi ke agar maine ise Rasulullah (SAW) se aik ya do ya teen martaba nahi suna hota" - aur unhone saat martaba tak gina - "to main tumhein yeh nahi bataata." Us shakhs ne unse kaha: "Maine dekha aapki aankhon se aansu bahe." Unhone kaha: "Kyunke woh momin the phir apne imaan ke baad kaafir ho gaye," phir unhone padha: "{Aur un logon ki tarah mat ho jo phoot pad gaye aur ikhtilaaf karne lage baad is ke ke unke paas khuli daleelein aa chuki thin}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 105) yeh ayat, to yeh unpar do martaba ho chuki.

e: [AI] "I heard Abu Umamah while standing on the heads of the stones at the gate of Homs or the gate of Damascus, saying, 'The dogs of fire, the dogs of fire, the worst of those killed under the shadow of the sky is better than the one who killed him.' Then he continued the talk towards the saying of Abu Hudhayfah."
hi: Maine Abu Umamah (RA) ko suna, woh Hauriyaan ke sar par Hims ke darwaze ya Dimashq ke darwaze par khade the aur keh rahe the: "Aag ke kutte, aag ke kutte, aasman ke saaye ke neeche sabse bure maqtool, sabse behtareen maqtool woh hai jise unhone qatl kiya." Phir unhone hadith Abu Hudhaifah ki hadith jaisi zikr ki.

Jab Hauriyaan (Khawarij) nikle to woh aik ghar mein jama huay, aur woh chhah hazaar (6000) the, main Ali (RA) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, zohar ki namaz thodi der ke liye taal dein, shayad main in logon ke paas jaakar unse baat kar sakoon." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe tumhare baare mein darr hai." Maine kaha: "Hargiz nahi." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: to main unke paas nikla, aur maine sabse achhe Yemeni jode pehne, Abu Zumail ne kaha: Ibn Abbas (RA) khoobsurat aur buland-aawaaz the. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: to main unke paas gaya jabke woh apne ghar mein jama the, dopahar ka aaraam kar rahe the, maine unhein salaam kiya, unhone kaha: "Khush-aamdeed, Aye Ibn Abbas, yeh kaisa jodaa hai?" Maine kaha: "Tum mujh par kya aitraaz karte ho, maine to Rasulullah (SAW) par sabse achhe jode dekhe hain," aur yeh nazil hui: "{Kaho, kisne Allah ki us zeenat ko haraam kiya jo usne apne bandon ke liye nikaali, aur rizq ki paak cheezon ko}" (Surah Al-A'raf 32). Unhone poocha: "To tum kis liye aaye ho?" Maine kaha: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba, Muhajireen aur Ansar, ki taraf se tumhare paas aaya hoon taake tumhein woh baat pahunchaaun jo woh kehte hain, khabar dene wale hain jo yeh kehte hain, unhi par Quran nazil hua, aur woh wahi ko tumse zyada jaante hain, aur unhi mein yeh nazil hui, tum mein unme se koi nahi." Unme se kuch ne kaha: "Quraish se jhagda mat karo, kyunke Allah farmata hai: {Balke woh jhagadalu qaum hain}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 58). Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: aur main aise logon ke paas aaya jinse zyada mehnat karne wale log maine kabhi nahi dekhe, unke chehre neend na aane ki wajah se pheeke pad chuke the, jaise unke haath aur ghutne moode huay hon, phir jo maujood the woh chale gaye, unme se kuch ne kaha: "Hum zaroor unse baat karengay aur dekhenge woh kya kehte hain." Maine kaha: "Mujhe bataao, tumhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke chachere bhai, damaad, aur Muhajireen-o-Ansar par kya aitraaz hai?" Unhone kaha: "Teen cheezein." Maine poocha: "Woh kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Pehli yeh ke unhone Allah ke maamle mein aadmiyon ko faisla karne diya, jabke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: {Faisla sirf Allah ka hai}" (Surah Al-An'aam 57), "aadmiyon aur faisle ka kya kaam?" Maine kaha: "Yeh aik hai." Unhone kaha: "Aur doosri yeh ke unhone jung ki lekin na qaidi banaaye na maal-e-ghaneemat liya, agar woh jinse jung ki woh kaafir the to unke qaidi banaana aur unka maal-e-ghaneemat lena jaayez tha, aur agar woh momin the to unse jung karna jaayez nahi tha." Maine kaha: "Yeh do hain, teesri kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Unhone apne aap ko 'Ameer-ul-Momineen' (ke unwaan) se mita diya, to ab woh 'Ameer-ul-Kaafireen' hain." Maine poocha: "Kya iske ilawa aur bhi kuch hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yehi humein kaafi hai." To maine unse kaha: "Kya tum manoge agar main tumhein Allah ki Kitaab aur uske Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat se kuch aisa padh kar sunaaun jo tumhari baat ko rad kare?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To maine kaha: "Rahi baat tumhari yeh ke unhone Allah ke maamle mein aadmiyon ko faisla karne diya, to main tumhein padh kar sunaata hoon Allah ne khud apne faisle ko aadmiyon ke supurd kiya, aik khargosh ke chauthaai dirham ke barabar shikaar ke maamle mein, Allah ne farmaya: {Aye imaan walo, shikaar ko qatl mat karo jab tum ihraam mein ho}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 95) unke farmaan tak: "{jiska faisla tum mein se do insaaf-pasand log karein}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 95), to main tumhein Allah ki qasam dilaata hoon, khargosh jaise shikaar mein aadmiyon ka faisla behtar hai ya unke khoon aur aapas ke maamlaat sudharne mein unka faisla? Aur jaan lo ke agar Allah chahta to khud faisla kar deta aur ise aadmiyon ke supurd na karta, aur biwi-shohar ke maamle mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {Aur agar tumhein unke darmiyan judaai ka darr ho to uske ghar walon mein se aik faisla karne wala aur uske ghar walon mein se aik faisla karne wala bhejo, agar dono islaah chahenge to Allah unke darmiyan mel karwa dega}" (Surah An-Nisa 35), to Allah ne aadmiyon ke faisle ko aik mehfooz tareeqa banaya, kya main iss se nikal gaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Aur rahi baat tumhari yeh ke unhone jung ki lekin na qaidi banaaye na maal-e-ghaneemat liya, kya tum apni maa Aisha (RA) ko qaidi banaaoge, phir unke sath woh (harkatein) jaayez samjho ge jo doosron ke sath jaayez hain? Agar tum aisa karo to tum kaafir ho gaye, kyunke woh tumhari maa hain, aur agar tum kaho ke woh humari maa nahi hain, to bhi tum kaafir ho gaye, kyunke Allah farmata hai: {Nabi imaan walon par unki apni jaanon se zyada haq rakhte hain, aur unki biwiyaan unki (imaan walon ki) maayen hain}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 6), to tum do gumraahiyon ke darmiyan ghoom rahe ho, jis taraf bhi tum jaao gumraahi hi hai." Unme se kuch ne aik doosre ko dekha, maine kaha: "Kya main iss se nikal gaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Aur rahi baat tumhari yeh ke unhone apna naam 'Ameer-ul-Momineen' se mita diya, to main tumhare paas aisa shakhs laata hoon jise tum pasand karo aur tumhein dikhaaun, tumne suna hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Hudaybiyyah ke din Suhail bin Amr aur Abu Sufyan bin Harb ke sath likhat kiya tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ameer-ul-Momineen (Ali) se kaha: 'Likho, Aye Ali, yeh woh hai jispar Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne sulah ki,' to mushrikeen ne kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum nahi jaante ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain, agar humein pata hota ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain to hum aapse jung na karte,' to Rasulullah (SAW) ne kaha: 'Aye Allah, tu jaanta hai ke main tera Rasool hoon, likho, Aye Ali, yeh woh hai jispar Muhammad bin Abdullah ne sulah ki,' Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) Ali (RA) se behtar hain, aur isse unki nabuwwat mein koi kami nahi aayi jab unhone apna naam mita diya." Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne kaha: to unme se do hazaar (2000) log wapas laut aaye, aur baaqi gumraahi mein hi maare gaye.

e: ʿAbdullah bin Shaddad came and entered upon ʿAʿishah ؓ when we were sitting with her, as he was returning from Iraq during the time when ‘Ali ؓ was murdered. She said to him: O ʿAbdullah bin Shaddad, will you tell me the truth about what I am going to ask you? Tell me about these people whom ‘Ali ؓ killed. He said: Why shouldnʿt I tell you the truth? She said: Tell me about them. He said: When ʿAli ؓ corresponded with Muʿawiyah and the two arbitrators gave their verdict, eight thousand of the pious rebelled against him and camped in a land called Harooraʿ, near Koofah. They criticised him and said: You have taken off a chemise that Allah caused you to wear and a title that Allah gave to you, then you went ahead and asked people to issue a decree concerning the religion of Allah. There is no ruling except the ruling of Allah, may He be exalted. When ʿAli ؓ heard about their criticism of him and the reason why they had split from him, he told his caller not to admit anyone but those who had memorised the Qurʿan. When the house was filled with people who had memorised the Qurʿan, he called for a large Mushaf and put it front of him, and he started tapping it with his hand, saying: O Mushaf, tell the people. The people called out: O Ameer al-Muʿmineen, how could you ask it? It is only ink and paper, but we could speak on the basis of what we understand from it. What do you want? He said: These companions of yours who rebelled, between me and them is the Book of Allah, and Allah says in His Book concerning a woman and a man: ʿIf you fear a breach between them twain (the man and his wife), appoint (two) arbitrators, one from his family and the other from hers; if they both wish for peace, Allah will cause their reconciliation.ʿ [an-Nisa 4:35]. The ummah of Muhammad is more important with regard to life and sanctity than a woman and a man. They got angry with me when I wrote a document between me and Muʿawiyah and wrote ʿAli bin Abi Talib [without adding the title Ameer al-Muʿmineen]. But Suhail bin ʿAmr came to us when we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at al-Hudaibiyah, when he made a peace deal with Quraish, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote, ʿIn the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.ʿ Suhail said: Do not write, In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. He said: What should we write? He said: Write: ʿIn Your Name, O Allah.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Write ʿMuhammad the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.ʿ He [Suhail] said: If I knew that you were the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I would not have opposed you. So he wrote: This is what was agreed by Muhammad bin ʿAbdullah with Quraish. And Allah says in His Book: “Indeed in the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (Muhammad) you have a good example to follow for him who hopes for (the Meeting with) Allah and the Last Dayʿ [Al-Ahzab 33:21]. So ʿAli sent ʿAbdullah bin ʿAbbas ؓ to them and I went out with him until we reached the middle of their camp. Ibnul-Kawwaʿ stood up and addressed the people, saying: O bearers of the Qurʿan, this is ʿAbdullah bin ʿAbbas ؓ . Whoever does not know him, I know of the Book of Allah what can tell you about him, He is one of those concerning whom the words ʿthey are a quarrelsome peopleʿ [Az-Zukhruf 43:58] were revealed. Tell him to go back to the one who sent him and do not discuss the Book of Allah with him. Their spokesmen stood up and said: By Allah, we will discuss the Book of Allah. If he says something sound and true that we recognise we will follow him, and if he says something false we will reject his false argument. So they discussed the Book with ‘Abdullah for three days, and four thousand of them recanted and all of them repented, including Ibnul-Kawwaʿ. He took them to ʿAli in Koofah, and ʿAli sent word to the rest of them, saying: You know the turmoil between us and our opponents. Stay wherever you wish until the ummah of Muhammad ﷺ is united. The deal between us and you is that you should not shed any blood that it is forbidden to shed or commit acts of banditry on the roads or do wrong to any Non Muslim under Muslim protection. If you do that, we will declare war, for Allah does not love those who betray. ʿAʿishah ؓ said: O Ibn Shaddad, did he kill them? He said: By Allah, no sooner had he sent this message to them but they committed acts of banditry, shed blood and regarded it as permissible to harm Ahludh-Dhimmah (non-Muslims living under Muslim protection). She said: Do you swear by Allah? He said: I swear by Allah besides Whom there is no other god that this is what happened. She said: I have heard that the people of Iraq are talking and saying dhuth-thuda, dhuth-thuda [i.e., the one with a deformed arm that looks like a breast]. He said: I saw him and I was with ‘Ali ؓ when he was examining the slain. He called the people and said: Do you know this one? How many of them came and said: I saw him praying in the mosque of Banu So and so, and I saw him praying in the mosque of Banu So and so. And there was no proof of who he was except that. She said: What did ʿAli say when he stood over him, as the people of Iraq claim? He said: I heard him say: Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth. She said: Did you hear him say anything other than that? He said: No, by Allah. She said: Yes, Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth. May Allah have mercy on ʿAli ؓ : it was his habit, if he saw something he liked, to say: Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth. But the people of Iraq fabricated lies against him and added words to what he said. (Using translation from Aḥmad 656)
hi: Main Aisha (RA) ke paas aaya, hum unke paas baithe huay thay, woh Iraq se wapas aayi thin un raaton mein jab Ali (RA) qatl huay, tab unhone kaha: "Aye Abdullah bin Shaddad, kya tum mujhse jo main poochoongi uska sach batao ge? Mujhe un logon ke baare mein bataao jinhein Ali (RA) ne qatl kiya." Maine kaha: "Main aapse sach kyun na bataun?" Unhone kaha: "To mujhe unka qissa bataao." Maine kaha: jab Ali (RA) ne Muawiyah ko khat likha aur do faisla karne walon ko muqarrar kiya, to unke khilaaf ath hazaar (8000) Quran ke qaari log nikal khade huay, woh Kufa ke aik taraf Haroora naami zameen par utre, unhone unpar aitraaz kiya aur kaha: "Aapne woh kurta utaar diya jo Allah ne aapko pehnaaya aur aapko usse naam diya, phir aap gaye aur Allah ke deen mein (aadmiyon ko) faisla karne diya, jabke faisla sirf Allah ka hai." Jab Ali (RA) ko pata chala ke unhone unpar aitraaz kiya aur unse alag ho gaye, to unhone hukum diya aur munaadi ne aalaan kiya: "Ameer-ul-Momineen ke paas sirf woh shakhs aaye jisne Quran (haasil) kiya ho." Jab ghar Quran ke qaariyon se bhar gaya, to unhone aik bada Mushaf mangwaaya aur use apne saamne rakha, phir usse haath maarne lage aur kehne lage: "Aye Mushaf, logon ko bataao," to log unhein pukaarne lage aur kehne lage: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aap ise kya poochte hain? Yeh to sirf kaghaz aur syaahi hai, hum to isme jo dekhte hain usi ke mutabiq baat karte hain, aap kya chahte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Tumhare woh sathi jo mere aur unke darmiyan nikal gaye, humare darmiyan Allah ki Kitaab hai, Allah farmata hai aik aurat aur aadmi ke baare mein: 'Agar tumhein unke darmiyan judaai ka darr ho to uske ghar walon mein se aik faisla karne wala aur uske ghar walon mein se aik faisla karne wala bhejo,' to Muhammad (SAW) ki Ummat aik aurat aur aadmi se zyada izzat wali hai, aur unhone mujhpar aitraaz kiya ke maine Muawiyah ko khat likha aur Ali bin Abi Talib likha, jabke Suhail bin Amr aaye the aur hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hudaybiyyah mein the jab unhone apni qaum Quraish se sulah ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne likha: 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem,' to Suhail ne kaha: 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem mat likho.' Aap (SAW) ne poocha: 'To kaise likhoon?' Usne kaha: 'Likho: Bismika Allahumma.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Likho,' phir farmaya: 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ki taraf se likho.' Unhone kaha: 'Agar humein pata hota ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain to hum aapki mukhaalifat na karte,' to aap (SAW) ne likhwaaya: 'Yeh woh hai jispar Muhammad bin Abdullah ne Quraish se sulah ki,' Allah apni Kitaab mein farmata hai: 'Beshak tumhare liye Rasulullah mein aik behtareen namoona hai us shakhs ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat ka ummeedwar ho,' to Ali bin Abi Talib ne unhein Abdullah bin Abbas ki taraf bheja, main unke sath nikla yahan tak ke hum unke lashkar ke beech pahunche, Ibn Al-Kawwa khade huay aur logon ko khutba di, unhone kaha: 'Aye Quran ke bardaar logon, yeh Abdullah bin Abbas hain, jo unhein nahi jaanta, main unhein Allah ki Kitaab se pehchaanta hoon, yeh woh hain jo apni qaum ke baare mein nazil huay: \"Balke woh jhagadalu qaum hain,\" inhein wapas inke saathi ke paas bhej do aur inke sath Allah ki Kitaab par baat mat karo.' To unke khutba dene walon ne khade hokar kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum zaroor unke sath Allah ki Kitaab par baat karengay, agar woh haq laaye to hum use pehchaanenge aur qubool karenge, aur agar woh baatil laaye to hum unhein unke baatil ki wajah se sharminda karengay aur unhein unke saathi ke paas wapas bhej denge.' To unhone unse Allah ki Kitaab par teen din tak baat ki, unme se chaar hazaar (4000) wapas laut aaye, sab tauba karte huay, jinme Ibn Al-Kawwa bhi shaamil the, yahan tak ke unhein Ali (RA) ke paas le gaye. Ali (RA) ne unke baaqi maandah logon ke paas (paighaam) bheja aur kaha: 'Humare aur logon ke darmiyan jo hua woh tumne dekha hai, isliye jahan chaho ruko yahan tak ke Muhammad (SAW) ki Ummat jama ho jaaye, aur jahan chaho utro, humare aur tumhare darmiyan yeh hai ke hum tumhein apne neze se bachaaenge jab tak tum koi raasta na kaato ya khoon zyada na baha do, agar tum aisa karo to humne tumhare khilaaf jung ka aalaan barabar ke tor par kar diya hai, beshak Allah dhoka-baazon ko pasand nahi karta.' To Aisha (RA) ne unse kaha: 'Aye Ibn Shaddad, to kya unhone unhein qatl kiya?' Unhone kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, unhone unke paas (fauj) tab tak nahi bheji jab tak unhone raasta nahi kaata aur bagair haq ke khoon nahi bahaaya aur Ibn Khabbab ko qatl nahi kiya aur ahl-e-zimmah (mu'aahid) par ziyadti jaayez nahi samjhi.' Unhone kaha: 'Allah ki qasam?' Maine kaha: 'Allah ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi.' Unhone kaha: 'To mujhe Iraq walon se aik baat pahunchi hai jo woh bayan karte hain, woh kehte hain \"Dhul-Thudayyah, Dhul-Thudayyah.\"' Maine kaha: 'Maine use dekha hai, aur maine Ali (RA) ke sath maqtoolon mein khade hokar use dekha, unhone logon ko bulaaya aur kaha: \"Kya tum ise pehchaante ho?\" To aane wale zyada logon ne kaha: \"Maine use fulan qabile ki masjid mein namaz padhte dekha hai, aur maine use fulan qabile ki masjid mein namaz padhte dekha hai,\" koi pukhta pehchaan iske siwa nahi mili.' Unhone poocha: 'To Ali (RA) ne kya kaha jab woh uske paas khade huay, jaisa Iraq walon ka dawa hai?' Maine kaha: 'Maine unhein kehte suna: \"Allah aur uske Rasool ne sach farmaya.\"' Unhone poocha: 'Kya tumne khud usse aur kuch suna?' Maine kaha: 'Aye Allah, nahi.' Unhone kaha: 'Haan, Allah aur uske Rasool ne sach farmaya.'"

e: I witnessed Ali on the day of Nahrawan asking for the mukhaddaj (a man whose arm had a deformity who was foretold to ʿAlī by the Prophet ﷺ), but he was unable to find one. His forehead began to sweat and he became distressed. Eventually, he was able to find him and he fell down in prostration, saying, "By Allah, you have neither lied nor been lied to."
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko Jang-e-Nahrawan ke din Al-Mukhaddaj ko talaash karte dekha, unhein woh nahi mil raha tha, to unki peshaani se pasina behne laga aur unhein takleef mehsoos hui, phir unhein woh mil gaya, to woh sajde mein gir gaye aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, na maine jhoot bola aur na mujhse jhoot bola gaya."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  was approached by a man who appeared disheveled, with his clothes tattered and marks of prostration between his eyes. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  struck his hand, giving to his right and left until all the money was gone. When the money ran out, the man turned away and said, "By Allah, you have never been unjust since this day." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  turned his palm and said, "If I do not establish justice, then who will?
