I swear they will continue to corrupt and deviate from the religion like an arrow shot with no return until it hits its target. They will read the Quran and their recitation will not go beyond their throats. They will speak eloquently but act unjustly. Therefore, whoever meets them, let them fight against them. And whoever kills them, they will have the best reward. And whoever they kill, they will have the best martyrdom. They are the worst of creation and Allah is free from them. Killing them is closer to the truth than any other action."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas woh (shakhs) aaya, aap (SAW) apna haath usme daalte rahe, dayen aur baayen ata karte rahe, unme aik shakhs tha jiske kapde tange huay the, uski aankhon ke darmiyan sajde ka nishaan tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apna haath dayen aur baayen daalte rahe yahan tak ke maal khatam ho gaya, jab maal khatam ho gaya to woh peeth pher kar gaya aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tumne aaj se insaaf nahi kiya." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) apni hatheli palatne lage aur farmaate rahe: "Agar main insaaf na karoon to mere baad kaun insaaf karega? Khabardar, aik giroh nikalega jo deen se aise nikal jaayega jaise teer shikaar se nikal jaata hai, phir woh usme wapas nahi aayenge jab tak teer apne nishaane par wapas na aa jaaye, woh Quran padhenge lekin woh unki gardan se aage nahi jaayega, unki baat achhi hogi lekin amal bura, jo unse mile use unse jung karni chahiye, jo unhein qatl kare use behtareen ajr milega, aur jise woh qatl karein use behtareen shahaadat milegi, woh makhlooq mein sabse buray hain, Allah unse bezaar hai, unhein woh giroh qatl karega jo haq ke zyada qareeb ho."

e: [AI] "I witnessed the Battle of Siffin and they did not provide support for the wounded, nor kill hostages, nor plunder the killed."
hi: "Main Siffin mein maujood tha, woh zakhmi ko poora nahi karte the, na peeth pherne wale ko qatl karte the, na maqtool ka saaman chheenete the."

e: [AI] "A caller named 'Ammar' announced on the day of the camel race, and the people had already dispersed: 'Do not harm the wounded, nor kill a sanctuary, and whoever throws down their weapon is safe.' This was difficult for us, and a hadith from a reliable source was narrated on this topic."
hi: Ammar (RA) ke munaadi ne Jang-e-Jamal ke din, jab log peeth pher chuke thay, aalaan kiya: "Khabardar, zakhmi ko poora na kiya jaaye, aur peeth pherne wale ko qatl na kiya jaaye, aur jo apna hathiyaar phenk de woh amaan mein hai." Yeh humpar bhaari guzra, "aur is baab mein aik musnad hadith bhi riwayat ki gayi hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Abdullah bin Mas'ud, "O son of Mas'ud, do you know the ruling of Allah regarding those who transgress from this Ummah?" Ibn Mas'ud replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The ruling of Allah regarding them is that they should not be followed in their misguidance, their captives should not be killed, and their wounded should not be mutilated." (Kuthayr bin Hakim Matruuk)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Ibn Mas'ud, kya tumhein pata hai ke is Ummat mein se jo baghawat kare uske baare mein Allah ka kya hukum hai?" Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unke baare mein Allah ka hukum yeh hai ke unke bhaagne wale ka peechha na kiya jaaye, na unke qaidi ko qatl kiya jaaye, aur na hi unke zakhmi ko poora kiya jaaye." Kuthair bin Hakim matrook (chhoda hua raawi) hain.

e: [AI] When Ammar ibn Yasir was killed, Amr ibn Hazm went to Amr ibn al-As and said, "Ammar has been killed, and the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  said, 'The rebellious group will kill him.'" Amr ibn al-As stood up in alarm and went to Muawiyah. Muawiyah asked him, "What's the matter with you?" Amr replied, "Ammar has been killed." Muawiyah said, "So, Ammar has been killed, what about it?" Amr responded, "I heard the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  say, 'The rebellious group will kill him.'" Muawiyah then said to him, "Did your own urine delude you? Did we kill him? Ali and his companions are the ones who brought him here until they threw him amidst our spears." (or he said, "amidst our swords").
hi: Jab Ammar bin Yasir (RA) qatl huay, to Amr bin Hazm (RA) Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Ammar (RA) qatl ho gaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: 'Unhein baaghi (sarkash) giroh qatl karega.'" To Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ghabra kar khade huay yahan tak ke Muawiyah (RA) ke paas gaye, Muawiyah (RA) ne unse poocha: "Kya baat hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ammar (RA) qatl ho gaye." Muawiyah (RA) ne kaha: "Ammar (RA) qatl ho gaye, to kya?" Amr (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Unhein baaghi giroh qatl karega.'" To Muawiyah (RA) ne unse kaha: "Tum bhatak gaye ho, kya hamne unhein qatl kiya? Unhein to Ali aur uske saathiyon ne qatl kiya, woh use le kar aaye yahan tak ke unhone use humare neezon" - ya kaha: "humari talwaaron" - "ke darmiyan phenk diya."

e: I have not seen anything more desired/valued by this Ummah that is like the āyah: "And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah." (Ḥujurāt 49:9)[^1]
hi: "Maine kabhi aisi koi cheez nahi dekhi jaise is Ummat ne is ayat se munh mod liya ho: {Aur agar imaan walon ke do giroh aapas mein ladein to unke darmiyan sulah karwao, phir agar unme se aik doosre par zulm kare to us par jung karo jo zulm karta hai yahan tak ke woh Allah ke hukum ki taraf palat aaye}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 9).

e: "The Prophet [SAW] said: 'After me there will be many calamities and much evil behavior.' He raised his hands (and said): 'Whomever you see trying to create division among the Ummah of Muhammad [SAW] when they are all united, kill him, no matter who he is among the people.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4021)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad ho'na-ho'na (mushkilaat) hongi," aur aap (SAW) ne apne dono haath uthaaye, "to jo bhi tumhein Muhammad (SAW) ki Ummat ke maamle mein phoot daalne ki koshish karta nazar aaye jabke woh sab jama hon, to use qatl kar do, chahe woh koi bhi ho."

e: “What will you do, O Abu Dharr, when death overwhelms the people to such an extent that a grave will be equal in value to a slave?” I said: “Whatever Allah and His Messenger choose for me, or Allah and His Messenger know best.” He said “Be patient.” He said: ‘What will you do when famine strikes the people so that you will go to the place where you pray and will not be able to return to your bed, or you will not be able to get up from your bed to go to the place where you pray?” He said: “I said: ‘Allah and His Messenger know best, or whatever Allah and His Messenger choose for me.” He said: “You must refrain from forbidden things.” He said: “What will you do when killing befalls the people so that Hijaratuz-Zait*is covered with blood?” I said: “Whatever Allah and His Messenger choose for me.” He said: “Stay with those whom you belong to.” He said: “I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, should I not take my sword and strike those who do that?’” He said: “Then you will be just like the people. Rather enter your house.” I said: “O Messenger of Allah, what if they enter my house?” He said: “If you are afraid that the flashing of the sword will dazzle you, then put the edge of your garment over your face, and let him carry his own sin and your sin, and he will be one of the people of the Hellfire.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3958)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Dharr, tum kya karogay jab logon par aisi maut aayegi ke ghar (qabar) gulaam (ke barabar qeemat) mein milega?" - ya'ni qabar. Maine kaha: "Jo Allah aur uska Rasool mere liye behtar samjhein." Phir farmaya: "Tum kya karogay jab logon par bhook aayegi yahan tak ke tum apni masjid mein jaao lekin apne bistar tak wapas na ja sako, aur apne bistar se uthkar apni masjid tak na ja sako?" Maine kaha: "Jo Allah aur uska Rasool mere liye behtar samjhein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paakeezgi ikhtiyar karo." Phir farmaya: "Tum kya karogay jab logon par qatl-o-gharat aayegi yahan tak ke zaitoon ke pathar khoon mein doob jaayenge?" Maine kaha: "Jo Allah aur uska Rasool mere liye behtar samjhein," ya "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne ghar mein raho." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main apni talwaar uthaakar aisa karne wale par nahi maar sakta?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tab to tum bhi in logon mein shaamil ho jaogay." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar woh mere ghar mein dakhil ho jaayen?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumhein darr ho ke talwaar ki chamak tumhein andha kar degi, to apna kapda apne chehre par daal do, phir woh apna gunah aur tumhara gunah lekar jaayega aur Jahannam walon mein se ho jaayega."

e: [AI] Indeed, my father and uncle witnessed the Battle of Badr. And they both made a covenant to me that I will not fight anyone who says there is no god but Allah. If you come to me with immunity from the fire, I will fight with you. He said, "Then leave us." So he left while saying, "By the vast sea." And I am not the one who fights a man who prays for another ruler from Quraysh, who has his own authority. May Allah protect me from ignorance and recklessness. Shall I kill a Muslim without any crime? It is not beneficial for me to live this way.
hi: "Beshak mere waalid aur mere chacha ne Badr mein shirkat ki thi, aur unhone mujhse ahd liya tha ke main kisi aise shakhs se jung na karoon jo 'La ilaha illallah' kahe, isliye agar tum mere paas Jahannam se azaadi ka pukhta wada laao, to main tumhare sath jung karunga." Unhone kaha: "To humse door raho." Unhone kaha: to woh chala gaya, aur keh raha tha: "(Ash'aar): Main kisi aise aadmi ko qatl karne wala nahi jo kisi doosre baadshah ke liye namaz padhta ho, Quraish ke kisi aur ke paas uska ikhtiyaar hai aur mujh par mera gunah hai, Allah ki panah jahaalat aur jaldbaazi se, kya main kisi Musalman ko bagair kisi jurm ke qatl karoon? Aisa karna meri zindagi mein mere liye faidamand nahi."

e: [AI] "That these people return and no bloodshed occurs in it, and I did not know anything about it except for what I have informed and Muhammad, peace be upon him, is alive. He said, 'A person may become a believer in the morning and turn into a disbeliever in the evening, or he may become a disbeliever in the evening and turn into a believer in the morning. He may fight in the morning while having nothing with him, but in the evening, Allah will cause him to be killed. His heart will turn upside down and he will raise his voice.' I said, 'The lowest of it?' He replied, 'Rather, the highest of it.'"
hi: Ke yeh log wapas chale jaayen aur usme aik pyaale khoon bhi na bahe, aur mujhe iske baare mein kuch pata nahi tha siwaye us baat ke jo maine Muhammad (SAW) ki zindagi mein jaani thi: "Aadmi subah ko momin hota hai aur shaam ko kaafir ho jaata hai, aur shaam ko momin hota hai aur subah ko kaafir ho jaata hai, woh aaj fitne mein jung karta hai aur kal Allah use qatl karwa deta hai, uska dil ulat jaata hai aur uska neechla hissa oopar aa jaata hai." Maine poocha: "Uska neechla hissa?" Unhone kaha: "Balke uska neechla hissa hi."

e: [AI] He went to my father's room and informed Aisha of what the slave had done. Aisha said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Whoever points a metallic weapon towards a Muslim and intends to kill him, then his blood is liable to be shed.'" She said, "So my father left her sight and went to the master of the slave, from whom he had bought him, and he dismissed him. He returned to him, taking him by the collar, and killed him."
hi: ...to Baba Aisha (RA) ke paas dakhil huay aur unhein bataya jo ghulam ne kiya tha, to Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: 'Jo koi kisi Musalman ki taraf hathiyaar se ishara kare use qatl karne ke irade se, to uska khoon jaayez ho jaata hai.'" Unhone kaha: to Baba unke paas se nikle aur us ghulam ke maalik ke paas gaye jisse unhone use khareeda tha, unhone use wapas karne ki darkhwaast ki, usne wapas le liya aur use unhein de diya, to Baba ne use pakda aur qatl kar diya.

e: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "Whoever unsheathes his sword and starts to strike the people with it, it is permissible to shed his blood." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4097)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi apni talwaar nikaale (logon ke khilaaf) phir use rakh de, to uska khoon jaayez ho jaata hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: How will you do when that time will come? Or he said: A time will soon come when the people are sifted and only dregs of mankind survive and their covenants and guarantees have been impaired and they have disagreed among themselves and become thus, interwining his fingers. They asked: What do you order us to do, Messenger of Allah? He replied: Accept what you approve, abandon what you disapprove, attend to your own affairs and leave alone the affairs of the generality. Abu dawud said: A similar tradition has been transmitted by 'Abd Allah bin 'Amr from the Prophet ﷺ through different chain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4342)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aisa waqt zaroor aayega jab logon ko chhaan liya jayega, aur sirf logon ki tah-nashini (kachra) baaqi rahegi, jinke ahd aur amaanatein bigad chuki hongi, aur woh aapas mein ikhtilaaf karengay, aur woh aise ho jaayengay," aur aap (SAW) ne apni ungliyan aapas mein jod din. Unhone poocha: "To hum kya karein, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tum pehchaante ho use lo, aur jo tum napasand karte ho use chhod do, aur apne khaas maamlon ki taraf mutawajjeh raho, aur aam logon ke maamlon ko chhod do."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The marriage of a woman who marries without the consent of her guardians is void. (He said these words) three times. If there is cohabitation, she gets her dower for the intercourse her husband has had. If there is a dispute, the sultan (man in authority) is the guardian of one who has none. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2083)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi aurat ka nikah uske wali ki ijaazat ke bagair nahi hota, agar aisa kiya jaaye to uska nikah baatil hai," teen martaba (yeh farmaaya), "agar uske sath sambhog ho chuka ho to uska mehr uske sambhog ke badle mein hai, aur agar log ikhtilaaf karein to sultan (hakim) us shakhs ka wali hai jiska koi wali na ho."

e:
[AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Any woman who is married without the permission of her guardian, her marriage is invalid, and she is entitled to her dowry as long as she has received any part of it. If they dispute, the ruler is the guardian of one who has no guardian.' This has been confirmed through narrations from reliable sources, as the narrators have been documented to have heard each other's narrations. These narrations cannot be criticized based on the narration of Ibn 'Ulayyah and his questioning by Ibn Jurayj, as a trustworthy narrator may forget a hadith after narrating it, and this has been done by more than one memorizer of hadith. Al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Ayyub informed us, Abu Hatim Muhammad ibn Idris al-Razi said, "I heard Ahmad ibn Hanbal say, and it was mentioned in his presence that Ibn 'Ulayyah mentions a hadith from Ibn Jurayj regarding 'There is no marriage except with a guardian.' Ibn Jurayj said, 'I met al-Zuhri and asked him about it, but he did not know it well, and he praised Sulayman ibn Musa.' Ahmad ibn Hanbal said, 'Indeed, Ibn Jurayj has written books, and this is not mentioned in his books, meaning the narration of Ibn 'Ulayyah from Ibn Jurayj.' I heard Abu al-Abbas Muhammad ibn Ya'qub say, 'I heard al-Abbas ibn Muhammad al-Duri say, 'I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in say about the hadith 'There is no marriage except with a guardian,' which Ibn Jurayj narrates, so I said to him, 'Indeed, Ibn 'Ulayyah says this.' Ibn Jurayj said, 'I asked al-Zuhri about it, and he said, 'I do not remember it well.' Yahya ibn Ma'in said, 'No one says this except Ibn 'Ulayyah, and Ibn 'Ulayyah only presented the books of Ibn Jurayj to 'Abd al-Majid ibn 'Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Rawwad, who corrected them for him, but he did not exert himself to preserve the hadith.'"

Note: This translation is provided for informational purposes and may not capture the full essence of the original text.
hi: "Jo bhi aurat apne wali ki ijaazat ke bagair byaahi jaaye, to uska nikah baatil hai, aur uska mehr uske sambhog ke badle mein hai, aur agar log ikhtilaaf karein to sultan us shakhs ka wali hai jiska koi wali na ho," yeh hadith sahih hai aur pukhta imamon ki riwayaton se saabit hai ke raawiyon ne aik doosre se suna hai, isliye in riwayaton ko Ibn Ulayyah ki hadith aur unke Ibn Jurayj se sawaal, aur unke yeh kehne ke Az-Zuhri se maine iske baare mein poocha to unhone ise nahi pehchaana, ki wajah se aib-daar nahi thehraaya jaata, kyunke aik bharosemand haafiz hadith bayan karne ke baad use bhool bhi sakta hai, aur aisa hadith ke kayi haafizon ne kiya hai. Humein Al-Husain bin Al-Hasan bin Ayyub ne bataya, humein Abu Hatim Muhammad bin Idris Ar-Razi ne bataya, unhone kaha: maine Ahmad bin Hanbal ko kehte suna, unke saamne zikr kiya gaya ke Ibn Ulayyah Ibn Jurayj ki hadith 'La nikaha illa bi-waliyyin' (Wali ke bagair nikah nahi) ka zikr karte hain, Ibn Jurayj ne kaha: to main Az-Zuhri se mila aur unse poocha, unhone ise nahi pehchaana, aur Sulaiman bin Musa ki tareef ki. Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: 'Ibn Jurayj ki likhi hui kitaabein hain aur yeh unme nahi hai,' ya'ni Ibn Ulayyah ka Ibn Jurayj se yeh qissa. Maine Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad bin Ya'qub ko kehte suna, unhone Al-Abbas bin Muhammad Ad-Doori ko kehte suna, unhone Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna, 'La nikaha illa bi-waliyyin' ki hadith ke baare mein, jise Ibn Jurayj riwayat karte hain, maine unse kaha: 'Ibn Ulayyah kehte hain ke Ibn Jurayj ne kaha: maine iske baare mein Az-Zuhri se poocha, unhone kaha: mujhe yaad nahi.' Yahya bin Ma'een ne kaha: 'Yeh sirf Ibn Ulayyah hi kehte hain, aur Ibn Ulayyah ne to Ibn Jurayj ki kitaabein Abdul Majeed bin Abdul Aziz bin Abi Rawwad ke saamne pesh ki thin, unhone unhein durust kiya, lekin unhone khud hadith ke liye mehnat nahi ki.' Humein Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Abdullah ne bataya, humein Abu Bakr bin Raja ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Al-Musaffa ne bataya, humein Baqiyyah ne bataya, humein Shu'aib bin Abi Hamzah ne bataya, unhone kaha: Az-Zuhri ne mujhse kaha: 'Makhool humare paas aate hain aur Sulaiman bin Musa bhi, aur Allah ki qasam, Sulaiman bin Musa in dono mein zyada hifz rakhne wale hain.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no marriage except with a guardian." Al-Nu'man ibn 'Abd al-Salam collected this hadith, connecting it between al-Thawri and Shu'bah in its chain of narration, and he narrated it from both of them. Al-Nu'man ibn 'Abd al-Salam is trusted and reliable. Many trustworthy narrators have also transmitted this hadith from al-Thawri and from Shu'bah, each one separately. They have transmitted it and all of this is found in the chapter that they heard from me and my companions. Therefore, it is sufficient without needing to repeat it. As for Isra'il ibn Yunus ibn Abu Ishaq, he is a trustworthy and reliable authority in the hadith of his grandfather, Abu Ishaq. He does not differ from him in connecting this hadith.
hi: 'Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi."' An-Nu'man bin Abdus Salam ne is hadith ki sanad mein Ath-Thawri aur Shu'bah ko jama kiya aur inhein unse muttasil (jode) sanad diya, aur An-Nu'man bin Abdus Salam bharosemand aur mo'tabar hain, "aur bharosemand logon ke aik giroh ne bhi ise Ath-Thawri se alag aur Shu'bah se alag riwayat kiya hai, aur unhone bhi ise muttasil kiya, aur yeh sab us baab mein zikr kiya gaya hai jo mere sathiyon ne mujhse suna, isliye is se doosri baar zikr karne ki zaroorat nahi. Rahi baat Israil bin Yunus bin Abi Ishaq ki, jo apne dada Abu Ishaq ki hadith mein bharosemand aur hujjat hain, unhone is hadith ko muttasil karne mein kisi se ikhtilaaf nahi kiya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no marriage except with a guardian." All of these chains of narrations are authentic, and we have elevated them higher than those from Israel. The earlier Imams who narrated from Israel, such as Abdul Rahman ibn Mahdi, Waki, Yahya ibn Adam, Yahya ibn Zakaria ibn Abi Zaidah, and others, also considered this Hadith to be authentic. I heard Abu Nasr Ahmed ibn Sahl al-Faqih al-Bukhari saying, "I heard Salih ibn Muhammad ibn Habib al-Hafiz saying, 'I heard Ali ibn Abdullah al-Madinini saying, 'I heard Abdul Rahman ibn Mahdi saying, "Israel used to preserve the Hadith of Abu Ishaq as they preserved the praise." I heard Abu al-Hasan ibn Mansur saying, "I heard Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Ishaq saying, 'I heard Abu Musa saying, 'Abdul Rahman ibn Mahdi used to confirm the Hadith of Israel from Abu Ishaq, meaning in regards to marriage without a guardian.' Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Shaybani narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan from Hatim ibn Yunus al-Jurjani, who said, 'I asked Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi what he says about marriage without a guardian.' He said, 'It is not permissible.' I asked, 'What is the proof for that?' He said, 'Qays ibn al-Rabi from Abu Ishaq from Abu Burdah from his father.' I said, 'But al-Thawri and Shu'bah also narrate it.' He replied, 'Indeed, Israel followed Qays in this matter.'" Muhammad ibn Salih ibn Hane' narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Mundhir ibn Sa'id from Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ibn Jabalah, who said, 'I heard Ali ibn al-Madinini saying, 'The Hadith of Israel is authentic in the statement 'There is no marriage except with a guardian.'" I heard Abu al-Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Anzi saying, 'I heard Uthman ibn Sa'id al-Darimi saying, 'I asked Yahya ibn Ma'in, 'Which do you prefer, Yunus ibn Abu Ishaq or his son Israil ibn Yunus?' He replied, 'They are both trustworthy.'" Authentic.
hi: 'Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi."' Yeh sab sanadein sahih hain, aur hum ismein Israil se buland (qareeb) hain, aur pehle ke imamon ne bhi ise muttasil kiya hai jo apni riwayaton mein Israil se (nichli sanad mein) aate hain, jaise Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi, Waki', Yahya bin Adam, aur Yahya bin Zakariya bin Abi Za'idah, aur doosre, unhone is hadith ko sahih qaraar diya hai. Maine Abu Nasr Ahmad bin Sahl Al-Faqih ko Bukhara mein kehte suna, unhone Salih bin Muhammad bin Habib Al-Hafiz ko kehte suna, unhone Ali bin Abdullah Al-Madini ko kehte suna, unhone Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi ko kehte suna: 'Israil Abu Ishaq ki hadith isi tarah yaad rakhte the jaise koi "Alhamdulillah" yaad rakhta hai.' Maine Abu Al-Hasan bin Mansoor ko kehte suna, unhone Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Ishaq ko kehte suna, unhone Abu Musa ko kehte suna: 'Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi Israil ki hadith ko, Abu Ishaq se, sahih maante the, ya'ni "wali ke bagair nikah" ke silsile mein.' Mujhe Muhammad bin Abdullah Ash-Shaibani ne bataya, humein Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Al-Hasan ne bataya, humein Hatim bin Yunus Al-Jurjani ne bataya, unhone kaha: maine Abu Al-Waleed At-Tayalisi se poocha: 'Aap "wali ke bagair nikah" ke baare mein kya kehte hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Jaayaz nahi.' Maine poocha: 'Iski daleel kya hai?' Unhone kaha: humein Qais bin Ar-Rabee' ne, Abu Ishaq se, unhone Abu Burdah se, unke waalid se, hadith bayan ki. Maine kaha: 'Ath-Thawri aur Shu'bah to isse mursal (bagair pooray sanad ke) riwayat karte hain.' Unhone kaha: 'Israil ne Qais ki mutaba'at ki hai.' Mujhe Muhammad bin Salih bin Hani ne bataya, humein Muhammad bin Al-Mundhir bin Sa'eed ne bataya, humein Ishaq bin Ibrahim bin Jabalah ne bataya, maine Ali bin Al-Madini ko kehte suna: 'Israil ki hadith "wali ke bagair nikah" mein sahih hai.' Maine Abu Al-Hasan bin Mansoor ko kehte suna, unhone Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Ishaq Al-Imam ko kehte suna, unhone kaha: maine Muhammad bin Yahya se is baab ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: 'Israil ki hadith mere nazdeek sahih hai.' Maine unse kaha: 'Shareek ne bhi ise riwayat kiya hai.' Unhone poocha: 'Kisne riwayat kiya?' Maine kaha: humein Ali bin Hujr ne bataya, aur maine unhein Yunus ki, Abu Ishaq se, hadith bhi bataayi, aur maine unse kaha: 'Shu'bah aur Ath-Thawri ne bhi ise Abu Ishaq se, Abu Burdah se, Nabi (SAW) se, riwayat kiya hai.' Unhone kaha: 'Haan, unhone isi tarah riwayat ki, lekin woh hadith bayan karte the aur mursal chhod dete the yahan tak ke unse poocha jaata "kis se?" to woh muttasil kar dete the.' Maine Abu Al-Hasan Ahmad bin Muhammad Al-Anazi ko kehte suna, unhone Uthman bin Sa'eed Ad-Darimi ko kehte suna, unhone kaha: maine Yahya bin Ma'een se poocha: 'Yunus bin Abi Ishaq aapko zyada pasand hain ya unke bete Israil bin Yunus?' Unhone kaha: 'Dono bharosemand hain.' Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no marriage except with a guardian (wali)." This hadith has been narrated from Abu Ishaq after these two, Zuhayr bin Muawiyah al-Ju'fi and Abu Awana al-Wadah. And the people of narration have unanimously agreed on their precedence and accuracy. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi." Is hadith ko Abu Ishaq se, in (pehle zikr kiye gaye) logon ke baad, Zuhair bin Muawiyah Al-Ju'fi aur Abu Awana Al-Waddah ne bhi muttasil kiya hai, "aur riwayat karne wale (ulama) in dono ki pehchaan aur hifz par muttafiq hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no marriage without a guardian." Abu Sa'id Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Rumayh al-Nakha'i narrated to us, said Ibrahim ibn Nasr al-Kindi told me, he said: I heard Sa'id ibn Hashim al-Kaghazi saying: I heard Ahmad ibn Hanbal saying, "If you find a hadith from Zuhayr ibn Muawiyah, do not turn to anyone else, for he is one of the most reliable narrators."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi." Mujhe Abu Sa'eed Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Rumaih An-Nakha'i ne bataya, humein Ibrahim bin Nasr Al-Kindi ne bataya, unhone kaha: maine Sa'eed bin Hashim Al-Kaghazi ko kehte suna, unhone Ahmad bin Hanbal ko kehte suna: "Jab tumhein Zuhair bin Muawiyah ke tareeqe se hadith mile, to kisi aur ki taraf mat jao, kyunke woh sabse bharosemand raawiyon mein se hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no marriage without a guardian." This was narrated by Abdullah ibn Mahdi, Wakee', and others from Abu Awana. This hadith has also been transmitted by a group of Muslim scholars, including Abu Hanifah Nu'man ibn Thabit, Raqabah ibn Masqalah Al-Abdi, Mutarrif ibn Tareef Al-Harithi, Abdul-Hameed ibn Al-Hasan Al-Hilali, Zakaria ibn Abi Zaidah, and others. And we have mentioned them in this chapter. It has also been transmitted by a group of scholars, other than Abu Ishaq, through Abu Burdah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi." Isi tarah Abdur Rahman bin Mahdi, Waki', aur doosron ne Abu Awana se riwayat ki hai, aur is hadith ko Abu Ishaq se in ke ilawa Musalman imamon ke aik giroh ne bhi muttasil kiya hai, unme Abu Hanifah An-Nu'man bin Thabit, Raqabah bin Masqalah Al-Abdi, Mutarrif bin Tarif Al-Haarithi, Abdul Hameed bin Al-Hasan Al-Hilaali, Zakariya bin Abi Za'idah, aur doosre shaamil hain, "humne inka zikr is baab mein kiya hai, aur Abu Burdah se bhi Abu Ishaq ke ilawa aik giroh ne ise muttasil kiya hai."

e: the Messenger of Allah said: “There is no marriage except with a guardian.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1881)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "There is no marriage except with a guardian (wali)." Ibn 'Asakir said, "Qabeesa bin 'Uqbah came to me and Ali bin Al-Madinii asked me about this Hadith, so I narrated it to him. Ali bin Al-Madinii said, 'We have settled the disagreement regarding Abu Ishaq.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi." Ibn Asaakir ne kaha: to Qabeesah bin Uqbah ne mujhse kaha: "Ali bin Al-Madini mere paas aaye aur mujhse is hadith ke baare mein poocha, maine unhein yeh bataayi," to Ali bin Al-Madini ne kaha: "Ab humein Abu Ishaq ke ikhtilaaf se aaraam mil gaya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no marriage without a guardian." We have supported this with authentic narrations and the statements of knowledgeable scholars, affirming the authenticity of the hadith of Abu Musa which contains sufficient evidence for those who reflect upon it. And in this matter, there are also narrations from Ali ibn Abi Talib, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Muadh ibn Jabal, Abdullah ibn Umar, Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, Mikdad ibn Aswad, Abdullah ibn Mas'ood, Jabir ibn Abdullah, Abu Hurairah, Imran ibn Husain, Abdullah ibn Amr, Myswar ibn Makhramah, Anas ibn Malik, and others, and most of them are authentic. The narrations regarding this topic have been verified and confirmed from the wives of the Prophet, Aisha, Umm Salamah, and Zainab bint Jahsh, among others.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wali ke bagair nikah nahi." Humne sahih riwayaton aur ilm ke imamon ke aqwaal se Abu Musa ki hadith ki sehat par daleel di hai, jismein ghor karne wale ke liye kaafi hai, aur is baab mein Ali bin Abi Talib, Abdullah bin Abbas, Muadh bin Jabal, Abdullah bin Umar, Abu Dharr Al-Ghifari, Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad, Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Jabir bin Abdullah, Abu Hurairah, Imran bin Husain, Abdullah bin Amr, Al-Miswar bin Makhramah, aur Anas bin Malik se bhi (riwayaat) hain, aur unme zyada sahih hain, aur is baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) ki azwaaj - Aisha, Umm Salamah, aur Zainab bint Jahsh - sab se bhi sahih riwayaat mili hain.

e: [AI] I used to serve the Prophet ﷺ, then the Prophet ﷺ said to me, "O Rabi'ah! Why don't you get married?" I replied, "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, I don't want to get married. I don't have enough to provide for a wife, and I don't want anything to distract me from you." Then he turned away from me. After that, he asked me again, "O Rabi'ah! Why don't you get married?" I replied, "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, I don't want to get married. I don't have enough to provide for a wife, and I don't want anything to distract me from you." He turned away from me again. Then I revisited myself and said, "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, you know what is best for me in this life and the hereafter." He said, "And I say to myself, if he asks me for the third time, I will say yes." Then he asked me for the third time, "O Rabi'ah! Why don't you get married?" I said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah, do whatever you think is best for me or whatever you like." He said, "Go to the family of so and so in such and such place among the Ansar. Tell them that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sends his greetings to you and orders you to marry Rabi'ah the daughter of so and so." So I went to them and conveyed the message. They said, "Welcome to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the Messenger of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. By Allah, the Messenger of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ does not ask us for something without a reason." They honored me, married me to her, treated me kindly, and did not ask for any proof. I returned feeling sad, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked me, "What's wrong?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I went to a noble people, they honored and treated me kindly, and did not ask for any proof. But where will I get the dowry?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Buraidah Al-Aslami, "O Buraidah, collect the weight of a date seed in gold for him." So they collected the weight of a date seed in gold for me. Then the Prophet ﷺ said, "Take it to them and say, 'This is her dowry.'" So I took it to them and said, "This is her dowry." They said, "It's a lot, but we accept it." Then I asked, "Where should I stay?" They said, "O Buraidah, give him a sheep." So they gave me a fat sheep. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Go to Aishah and tell her to look at the dough in which the food is baked and send it to us." So I went to Aishah, told her about it, and she said, "Here it is, the dough in which the food is baked. By Allah, we don't have any other food in the morning." So I took it and the sheep to the Prophet ﷺ. They accepted the food and said, "You keep the sheep." Then some Muslims came, slaughtered, skinned, and cooked it. So we had bread and meat in the morning. I felt content and prayed for the blessings of the Muslims.
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat karta tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aye Rabee'ah, kya tum shaadi nahi karte?" Maine kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main shaadi nahi karna chahta, mere paas biwi ka intezaam karne ke liye kuch nahi hai, aur main nahi chahta ke koi cheez mujhe aapse door kare." Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) mujhse mudh gaye, phir mujhse baad mein farmaya: "Aye Rabee'ah, kya tum shaadi nahi karte?" Maine kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main shaadi nahi karna chahta, aur mere paas biwi ka intezaam karne ke liye kuch nahi hai, aur main nahi chahta ke koi cheez mujhe aapse door kare," to aap (SAW) mujhse mudh gaye. Unhone kaha: phir maine apne aap se dobara socha, maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap zyada jaante hain ke duniya aur aakhirat mein mere liye kya theek hai." Unhone kaha: aur main apne dil mein keh raha tha: agar unhone teesri baar mujhse poocha to main 'haan' kahunga. Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne mujhse teesri baar farmaya: "Aye Rabee'ah, kya tum shaadi nahi karte?" Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), jo aap chaahen ya jo aapko pasand ho mujhe hukum dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fulan ke ghar Ansar ke qabile mein jao, jinme aapse thodi doori hai, aur unse kaho ke Rasulullah (SAW) tumhein salaam kehte hain aur hukum dete hain ke tum Rabee'ah ki shaadi fulan aurat se kar do, jo unme se hai." Unhone kaha: to main unke paas gaya aur unhein yeh bataaya, unhone kaha: "Khush-aamdeed Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke paighaam-bar ka, Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) ka paighaam-bar apni zaroorat ke bagair wapas nahi jaayega." Unhone kaha: to unhone mera ikraam kiya, meri shaadi kar di, mujhpar meherbaani ki, aur mujhse koi saboot nahi maanga, to main udaas laut aaya, Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein kya hua?" Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aik izzat-daar qaum ke paas gaya, unhone meri shaadi ki, mera ikraam kiya, mujhpar meherbaani ki, aur mujhse koi saboot nahi maanga, to mujhe mehr kahan se milega?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Buraidah Al-Aslami (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Buraidah, iske liye khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona jama karo." Unhone kaha: to unhone iske liye khajoor ki guthli ke barabar sona jama kiya. Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse unke paas le jao aur kaho: yeh uska mehr hai." To main isse unke paas le gaya aur maine kaha: "Yeh uska mehr hai." Unhone kaha: to unhone kaha: "Bohot achha," aur qubool kar liya aur ispar raazi ho gaye. Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Main walima kahan se karoon?" Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Buraidah, iske liye bakri jama karo." Unhone kaha: to unhone iske liye aik mota mendha jama kiya. Unhone kaha: aur Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aisha (RA) ke paas jao aur kaho: dekho us tokri mein jo khana hai, use bhej do." Unhone kaha: to main Aisha (RA) ke paas aaya aur unhein yeh bataya, unhone kaha: "Yeh rahi woh tokri, isme saat sa' jau hai, Allah ki qasam, agar subah humare paas iske ilawa koi aur khana nahi hoga." Unhone kaha: to maine woh liya aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse unke paas le jao aur kaho: ise apne yahan roti bana lein." Unhone kaha: to main woh aur mendha le gaya, unhone kaha: to unhone khana qubool kiya aur kaha: "Tum mendha humare liye chhod do." Unhone kaha: aur Aslam qabile ke log aaye, unhone zibah kiya, chhilaka utaara, aur pakaaya. Unhone kaha: to humare paas subah roti aur gosht tha, main ne walima kiya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko bulaawa diya.

e: [AI] About Al-Hasan's statement about Allah's statement, "So do not prevent them from marrying their [former] husbands" [Quran 2:232], Ma'qil ibn Yasar al-Muzani said that this verse was revealed about him. He said, "I married my sister to a man who divorced her. When her waiting period ended, he came to propose to her again. I said to him, 'I married her to you, provided for you, and honored you, and yet you divorced her. Now you come to propose to her? By Allah, she will never go back to you.' He said, 'He was a good man, and the woman wanted to return to him.' Allah then revealed this verse, and I said, 'Now, O Messenger of Allah, I will marry her to him.' Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Ishaq said, 'In this hadith, there is clear evidence that Allah has given the authority of the marriage contract to the guardians, not the women, even if they are divorcees. There is no say for the women in the contract.'"
hi: Al-Hasan se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan ke baare mein "{To unhein apne shohron se nikah karne se mat roko}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 232), unhone kaha: Ma'qil bin Yasar Al-Muzani (RA) ne mujhe bataya ke yeh unke baare mein nazil hui, unhone kaha: "Maine apni behen ki shaadi aik aadmi se ki, usne use talaaq de di, jab uski iddat khatam hui to woh dobara shaadi ka payaam lekar aaya, maine usse kaha: 'Maine tumhari shaadi ki, tumhein bistar diya, tumhari izzat ki, phir tumne talaaq de di, ab tum dobara shaadi ka payaam lekar aa gaye? Nahi, Allah ki qasam, woh tumhare paas kabhi wapas nahi jaayegi.'" Unhone kaha: aur woh aik achha aadmi tha, aur aurat bhi uske paas wapas jaana chahti thi. Unhone kaha: to Allah ne yeh ayat nazil ki, maine kaha: "Ab main aisa karunga, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)," to maine uski shaadi usse kar di." Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Ishaq ne kaha: "Is hadith mein saaf daleel hai ke Allah ne nikah ka ikhtiyaar waliyon ko diya hai, auraton ko nahi, aur auraton ka, chahe woh talaaq-yaafta hi ho, nikah ke maamle mein koi ikhtiyaar nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whichever woman is married by two guardians, then she belongs to the first one, and whichever two men have a transaction, then it belongs to the first one among them." Sa'id bin Abu 'Aruba and Sa'id bin Bashir Al-Dimashqi narrated this on the terms of Al-Bukhari.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis bhi aurat ki shaadi do wali karein, to woh pehle ki hai, aur jo bhi do aadmi kisi cheez ki khareedari karein, to woh unme se pehle ki hai." Sa'eed bin Abi Aroobah aur Sa'eed bin Bashir Ad-Dimashqi ne bhi Qatadah se isi tarah riwayat ki hai. Bukhari ki shart par.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Any woman who is married by two guardians (to two different men) belongs to the first woman who is married by two guardians (to two different men) belongs to the first of them and anything sold by a man to two persons belongs to the first of them. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2088)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi aadmi do aadmiyon ko koi cheez beche, to woh unme se pehle ki hai, aur jis bhi aurat ki shaadi do wali karein, to woh pehle ki hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "When the guardians marry, they are for the first husband, and when the sellers sell, it is for the first buyer." Qatadah also followed up on his narration from Al-Hasan, Ashaath ibn Abd Al-Malik Al-Humrani.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab do wali nikah karein to woh pehle ki hai, aur jab do ijaazat dene wale bechein to woh pehle ke liye hai." Aur Qatadah ki, Al-Hasan se riwayat mein, Ash'ath bin Abdul Malik Al-Humrani ne unki mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "When two authorized persons get married, the first one has more right." These clear methods that I mentioned for this entire text are correct according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari, and they did not exclude it according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab do ijaazat dene wale nikah karein to pehla zyada haqdaar hai." Yeh saaf tareeqe jo maine is matan ke liye zikr kiye hain, sab Bukhari ki shart par sahih hain, aur dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari ki shart par.

e: "The dowry, when the Messenger of Allah was among us, was ten Awaq." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3348)
hi: "Jab humare darmiyan Rasulullah (SAW) maujood the to humara mehr das (10) auqiya hota tha."

e: [AI] Beware of undervaluing the friendship of women. Even if they are honored in this world or righteous in the eyes of Allah, Muhammad ﷺ  would be most worthy and deserving of that honor. He said: "No woman can be more truthful in fulfilling her obligations than twelve women combined." And indeed, one of you may become resentful towards his wife due to excessive dowry and say, "I have been burdened with the closeness of relationship."
hi: Khabardar, auraton ke mehr mein zyaadti mat karo, kyunke agar yeh duniya mein izzat ki cheez hoti ya Allah ke nazdeek taqwa ki, to Muhammad (SAW) is mein sabse zyada haqdaar aur zyada mustahiq hote, "Aap (SAW) ne apni kisi biwi ka mehr baara (12) auqiya se zyada nahi rakha," aur tum mein se koi apni biwi ke mehr mein zyaadti karta hai yahan tak ke uske dil mein uske liye dushmani paida ho jaati hai aur woh kehta hai: "Mujhe tere liye mashaqqat (mehnat) uthaani padi."

e: [AI] "O people, do not exaggerate in the dowry of women, for if it were an honor, no one among you would deserve it more than the Prophet ﷺ. He did not marry anyone nor did he have any daughters who received more than twelve 'uqiyahs, and each 'uqiyah is equivalent to forty dirhams. That is eighty-four hundred dirhams, which is the highest dowry that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ever gave. I do not know of anyone who gave more than four hundred dirhams. And it has been narrated in an authentic narration from Abdullah ibn Abbas, from Umar, in a valid manner."
hi: Aye logo, auraton ke mehr mein zyaadti mat karo, kyunke agar yeh izzat ki cheez hoti to tum mein se koi bhi is mein Nabi (SAW) se zyada haqdaar aur zyada mustahiq na hota, "Aap (SAW) ne apni kisi biwi ka mehr ya apni kisi beti ka mehr baara (12) auqiya se zyada nahi rakha, aur aik auqiya chaalis (40) dirham ke barabar hai, to yeh chaar sau assi (480) dirham banta hai, aur yeh sabse zyada mehr tha jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne kabhi diya, mujhe nahi pata ke kisi ne chaar sau (400) dirham se zyada diya ho." Aur yeh Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) se, Umar (RA) ki riwayat mein, aik sahih tareeqe se bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai.

e: [AI] About Umar
hi: Umar (RA) se.

e: [AI] Do not exaggerate in giving charity to women, for if it were a form of honor in this world or a means of righteousness with Allah, your Prophet ﷺ would have been the most honoring of you with it. No woman should receive more than twelve Uqiyyah (a measurement of weight) from her dowry, which is equivalent to four hundred and eighty dirhams, and that is forty-eight dirhams per Uqiyyah. The authentic narrations have confirmed the correctness of the sermon of Amir al-Mu'minin Umar ibn al-Khattab, and this topic has been gathered in a large volume and they did not exclude it.
hi: Khabardar, auraton ke mehr mein zyaadti mat karo, kyunke agar yeh duniya mein izzat ki cheez hoti ya Allah ke nazdeek taqwa ki, to tumhare Nabi (SAW) is mein sabse zyada haqdaar hote, "Unki kisi biwi ya beti ka mehr baara (12) auqiya se zyada nahi rakha gaya, aur yeh chaar sau assi (480) dirham hai, aik auqiya chaalis (40) dirham ke barabar hai." Sahih sanadon ne Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke khutbe ki sehat ko mutawaatir tor par saabit kiya hai, aur maine yeh baab aik bade juzw mein jama kiya hai, aur dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "I have married a woman from the Ansar on the promise of eight young she-camels as dowry. The Messenger of Allah grew concerned for her and said, 'It is as if you are carving silver from the side of this mountain. Have you seen any wealth in the eyes of the Ansar?' He replied, 'Yes, I have seen it.' The Messenger of Allah said, 'We have nothing, but we will send you with a mission and I hope that something good will come to you.' So he sent him with some people, to some people from the Bani Abs, and the Prophet commanded them to provide him with a camel loaded with their belongings. They did not harm him except a little and then they blessed him. They tired him with their negligence to send him off, and there was no one among the people younger than the one who had gotten married. So he came to the Prophet of Allah while the Prophet was lying down in the mosque. He stood by his head, hesitating to wake him up. The Prophet of Allah woke up and said to him, 'O Prophet of Allah, the one whom you had given to us, we have grown fond of sending him on a mission.' So the Prophet of Allah handed him over to him with his right hand and took his cloak with his left hand, laid it on his shoulder, and began to walk until he reached the woman. He struck her with the sole of his foot, and by the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Abu Huraira, after that, she would go before the leader. Indeed, they descended upon the enemy and had already lit the fires. So, he surrounded them, dispersed them, and they shouted the Takbeer of a single man. Indeed, Allah defeated them, and some of them were captured.
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Maine Ansar ki aik aurat se aath (8) auqiya (chandi) ke mehr par shaadi ki hai," to Rasulullah (SAW) ko uski fikr hui aur farmaya: "Goya tum is pahaad ke pehlu se chandi taraash rahe ho, kya tumne (itni raqam) dekhi hai? Ansar ki nazron mein to koi khaas cheez nahi hoti." Usne kaha: "Maine dekhi hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Humare paas kuch nahi hai, lekin hum tumhein aik dastay mein bhejenge, aur mujhe ummeed hai ke tumhein wahan koi bhalaai milegi." To aap (SAW) ne use kuch logon ke sath Banu Abs ke kuch logon ki taraf bheja, Nabi (SAW) ne unke liye aik oontni ka hukum diya, unhone usspar apna saaman lada, woh thodi hi door chali ke baith gayi aur unhein thaka diya ke woh use dobara khada na kar sake, us qaum mein us shakhs se choti umar ka koi nahi tha jisne shaadi ki thi, to woh Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke aap (SAW) masjid mein lete huay the, woh unke sar ke paas khada ho gaya taake unhein jagaana na pade, Allah ke Nabi (SAW) jag gaye aur farmaya: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, jo aapne humein diya tha, hum use wapas laana chahte the." To Nabi (SAW) ne apna dayan haath uska diya aur apni chaadar apne baayen haath se uthaakar apne kandhe par rakh li, aur paidal chalte huay yahan tak ke uske paas pahunche, aap (SAW) ne apni pair ke talwe se use maara, aur us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Abu Hurairah (RA) ki jaan hai, uske baad woh oontni sardaar se bhi aage nikal jaati thi, aur woh log dushman ke qareeb utre thay aur unhone aagein jala rakhi thin, to unhone unhein gher liya, log bikhar gaye, unhone aik hi aadmi ki tarah takbeer kahi, aur Allah ne unhein shikast di aur unme se kuch ko qaid kar liya.

e: [AI] He came to the Prophet ﷺ  seeking his assistance in obtaining the dowry for a woman. The Prophet ﷺ  asked, "How much did you marry her for?" He replied, "Two hundred dirhams." The Prophet ﷺ  then said, "If you were to scoop from the ocean, you would not increase."
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aik aurat ke mehr mein madad maangne aaye, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne uska mehr kitna rakha?" Unhone kaha: "Do sau (200) dirham." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum Buthan (wadi) se (paani) uthaate to bhi tum ismein izaafa na karte."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about the meaning of Allah's saying, "And the containers piled up" [Quran 3:14]. He replied, "The containers are a thousand uqiyyah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur dher lagaaye huay khazane}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 14) ke baare mein poocha gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qintaar do hazaar (2000) auqiya ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The greatest blessing from women is the easiest to please."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse zyada barkat wali aurat woh hai jiska mehr sabse aasaan ho."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ married a man and a woman with a ring made of iron, and its insert was silver.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik aadmi ki shaadi aik aurat se lohe ki aik anguthi par karwaayi jiska naginah chandi ka tha."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever is afflicted with a calamity, let him say: 'Indeed, we belong to Allah, and indeed, to Him we will return. O Allah, I seek reward and compensation from You for my calamity. Replace it with something better for me.' When Abu Salamah died, I said these words and kept saying them every time I experienced a calamity, saying to myself, 'Who is better than Abu Salamah?' I continued to say them until the prescribed period of mourning was completed. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then sent 'Umar ibn al-Khattab to propose to me on his behalf. I said to my son, 'O 'Umar, go and marry me to the Messenger of Allah.' He did, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would often come to visit me and be intimate with me. Whenever he came, I would give my daughter Zainab to him, and she would sleep in my bed. 'Ammar ibn Yasir, who was her foster brother, discovered this and came to me, saying, 'Where is that cursed woman who has annoyed the Messenger of Allah?' He took her and left. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came and entered, striking his thigh with the side of his hand, and said, 'What has Zainab done?' I said, 'Ammar came and took her away.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'Indeed, I have built a structure using her (i.e., metaphorical language meaning marital relationships) and have not taken anything away from you that you have given me, except for two young camels and a stuffed cushion that I will return to you.' He also said, 'Indeed, if I have married seven wives, I have married them for the sake of my wives.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jispar koi museebat aaye, use kehna chahiye: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon, Aye Allah, main teri hi taraf apni museebat ka hisaab rakhta hoon, isliye mujhe ismein ajr de aur mujhe iske badle behtar ata kar.'" Jab Abu Salamah (RA) ka inteqaal hua to maine yeh kaha, aur jab bhi main "mujhe iske badle behtar ata kar" tak pahunchti, main apne dil mein kehti: "Abu Salamah se behtar kaun hai?" Phir bhi main yeh kehti rahi. Jab unki iddat khatam hui to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke paas Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko unke liye payaam lekar bheja, to unhone apne bete se kaha: "Aye Umar, khade ho jao aur Rasulullah (SAW) se meri shaadi kar do," to unhone unki shaadi kar di. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas aaya karte, aur jab woh aap (SAW) ko dekhtin to apni beti Zainab ko lekar apni god mein bitha letin, to Rasulullah (SAW) laut jaate. Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ko iska pata chala, aur woh unke doodh-shareek bhai the, to woh unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Yeh badnaseeb, dutkaari hui (bachi) kahan hai jisne Rasulullah (SAW) ko takleef pahunchaayi hai?" To unhone use le liya aur le gaye. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) aaye aur unke paas dakhil huay, apni nazar ghar ke konon mein daudaate huay, phir farmaya: "Zainab ka kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Ammar aaye aur use le gaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse rukhsati ki (nikah mukammal kiya), aur farmaya: "Main tumhein usme kami nahi karunga jo maine fulan (biwi) ko diya - do chakkiyaan, do ghade, aur naariyal ke resha se bhara aik takiya," aur farmaya: "Agar main tumhare liye saat raatein karoon, to apni (baaqi) biwiyon ke liye bhi saat-saat raatein karunga."

e: [AI] "That your god whom we worship is a piece of wood that grew from the earth, carved by a Habashi, from the Bani Fulan tribe. If you convert, I do not want from you anything but friendship." He said, "Let me think about it." Then he left and came back saying, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." She said, "O Anas, marry Abu Talha."
hi: "Beshak tumhara ma'bood jiski tum ibaadat karte ho, aik lakdi hai jo zameen se ugi, use fulan qabile ke aik Habashi ne taraasha hai, agar tum Islam qubool karo to main tumse mehr mein iske siwa kuch nahi maangungi." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe apne maamle par ghor karne do." Unhone kaha: to woh gaye, phir wapas aaye aur kaha: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain." Unhone (Umm Sulaym RA) kaha: "Aye Anas, Abu Talha ki shaadi kar do."

e: [AI] "That Umm Salim married Abu Talha upon his acceptance of Islam" according to the conditions set by Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Umm Sulaym (RA) ne Abu Talha (RA) se unke Islam qubool karne ke badle mein shaadi ki." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: "A man among us married a woman, but he did not name a dowry for her, and he did not have intercourse with her before he died." 'Abdullah said: 'Since I left the Messenger of Allah I have never been asked a more difficult question than this. Go to someone else.' They kept coming to him for a month, then at the end of that they said: 'Who shall we ask if we do not ask you? You are one of the most prominent Companions of Muhammad in this land and we cannot find anyone else.' He said: 'I will say what I think, and if it is correct then it is from Allah alone, with no partner, and if it is wrong then it is from me and from the Shaitan, and Allah and His Messenger have nothing to do with it. I think she should be given a dowry like that of her peers and no less, with no injustice, and she may inherit from him, and she has to observe the 'Iddah, four months and ten days.'" He said: "And that was heard by some people from Ashja', who stood up and said: 'We bear witness that you have passed the same judgment as the Messenger of Allah did concerning a woman from among us who was called Birwa' bint Washiq.'" He said: "Abdullah was never seen looking so happy as he did on that day, except with having accepted Islam." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3358)
hi: ...Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA) ne kaha: "Jab se maine Rasulullah (SAW) se juda hua hoon, mujhse iss se zyada mushkil koi baat nahi poochi gayi, isliye kisi aur se poocho." Unhone kaha: to log aik mahine tak baar-baar unke paas aate rahe, phir aakhir mein unhone unse kaha: "Agar hum aapse na poochein to kisse poochein, jabke aap ne is shehar mein Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba mein bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, aur humein aapke siwa koi aur nahi milta." To unhone kaha: "Main ismein apni poori koshish se raay dunga, agar yeh theek hui to sirf Allah ki taraf se hai jiska koi shareek nahi, aur agar galat hui to mujhse hui, aur Allah aur uska Rasool ismein bezaar hain, main samajhta hoon ke usse uski jaisi auraton jaisa mehr dena chahiye, na kam na zyada, aur usse mirath milegi, aur uspar iddat hai - chaar mahine dus din." Unhone kaha: aur Ashja qabile ke kuch log yeh sun rahe the, woh khade huay aur kehne lage: "Hum gawahi dete hain ke aapne wahi faisla diya jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne humari aik aurat, jise Birwa bint Washiq kaha jaata tha, ke maamle mein diya tha." Unhone kaha: to Abdullah (RA) ko kabhi kisi cheez par itna khush nahi dekha gaya jitna us din, siwaye unke Islam qubool karne ke, phir unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, agar yeh theek hai to sirf teri taraf se hai jiska koi shareek nahi, aur agar galat hai to mujhse aur Shaitan se hai, aur Allah aur uska Rasool ismein bezaar hain."

e: Masruq said on the authority of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: Abdullah (ibn Mas'ud ) was asked about a man who had married a woman without cohabiting with her or fixing any dower for her till he died. Ibn Mas'ud said: She should receive the full dower (as given to women of her class), observe the waiting period ('Iddah), and have her share of inheritance. Thereupon Ma'qil ibn Sinan said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ giving the same decision regarding Birwa' daughter of Washiq (as the decision you have given). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2114)
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, aik aise aadmi ke baare mein jo kisi aurat se shaadi kare, phir mar jaaye, aur na uske sath sambhog kiya ho na uska mehr muqarrar kiya ho, to unhone kaha: "Usse poora mehr milega, aur uspar iddat hai, aur usse mirath bhi milegi." To Ma'qil bin Sinan (RA) khade huay aur kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yehi faisla dete dekha hai Birwa bint Washiq ke maamle mein," to yeh hadith Shaykhain ki shart par sahih ban gayi. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] She said, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "It is among the rights of a woman that her marriage proposal, dowry, and maintenance are made easy for her." Urwah said: "He means that her maintenance should be made easy for childbirth." Urwah said, "And I, based on my opinion, say that from the beginning of her pregnancy, her maintenance should increase."
hi: Ke unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat ki khush-naseebi mein se hai ke uska rishta aasaan ho, uska mehr aasaan ho, aur uska rehm aasaan ho." Urwah ne kaha: "Ya'ni uska rehm bachche ki paidaish ke liye aasaan ho." Urwah ne kaha: "Aur main apni taraf se yeh kehta hoon ke uski bad-naseebi ki shuru'aat yeh hai ke uska mehr zyada ho."

e: Abu Salamah said “I asked A’ishah about the dower given by the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ. She said “It was twelve Uqiyahs and a nashsh”. I asked “What is nashsh?” She said it is half an uqiyah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2105)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke mehr ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Baara (12) auqiya aur aik nash." Maine poocha: "Nash kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aadhi auqiya."

e: Hasanah is his mother. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2107)
hi: Woh Ubaidullah bin Jahsh ke nikah mein thin, unka Habsha ki zameen mein inteqaal ho gaya, "to Najashi ne unki shaadi Nabi (SAW) se karwa di aur unki taraf se chaar hazaar (4000) mehr diya, aur unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Shurahbil bin Hasanah (RA) ke sath bheja."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said to a man: Would you like me to marry you to so-and-so? He said: Yes. He also said to the woman: Would you like me to marry you to so-and-so? She said: Yes. He then married one to the other. The man had sexual intercourse with her, but he did not fix any dower for her, nor did he give anything to her. He was one of those who participated in the expedition to al-Hudaybiyyah. One part of the expedition to al-Hudaybiyyah had a share in Khaybar. When he was nearing his death, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ married me to so-and-so, and I did not fix a dower for her, nor did I give anything to her. I call upon you as witness that I have given my share in Khaybar as her dower. So she took the share and sold it for one lakh (of dirhams). Abu Dawud said: The version of 'Umar b. al-Khattab added in the beginning of this tradition, and his version is more perfect. He reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: The best marriage is the one that is most easy. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the man. The narrator then transmitted the rest of the tradition to the same effect. Abu Dawud said: I am afraid this tradition has been added later on, for the matter is otherwise. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2117)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik aadmi se poocha: "Kya tum raazi ho ke main tumhari shaadi fulan (aurat) se kar dun?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aur aurat se poocha: "Kya tum raazi ho ke main tumhari shaadi fulan (aadmi) se kar dun?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." To aap (SAW) ne dono ki shaadi karwa di, aur uske liye koi mehr muqarrar nahi kiya na use kuch diya, aur woh Hudaybiyyah mein maujood thay, aur jo Hudaybiyyah mein maujood tha uska Khaybar mein aik hissa hota tha. Jab unki maut qareeb aayi to unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne meri shaadi fulan aurat se ki, aur maine uske liye mehr muqarrar nahi kiya na use kuch diya, aur main tumhein gawah banaata hoon ke maine uska mehr apna Khaybar ka hissa de diya," to usne woh hissa liya aur ise aik lakh (100,000) mein becha. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen mehr woh hai jo sabse aasaan ho."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Verily, the greatest sins before Allah are: a man who marries a woman, consummates his desire with her, and then divorces her and takes back his dowry; a person who hires someone and then takes his wages without fulfilling his work; and a person who kills an animal for no purpose."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek sabse bade gunahon mein se hai: woh aadmi jo kisi aurat se shaadi kare, phir jab uski zaroorat poori ho jaaye to use talaaq de de aur uska mehr le le; aur woh aadmi jo kisi ko kaam par rakhe, phir uski mazdoori le le; aur woh jo bagair kisi zaroorat ke kisi jaanwar ko qatl kare."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught us the address in case of some need: Praise be to Allah from Whom we ask help and pardon, and in Whom we take refuge from the evils within ourselves. He whom Allah guides has no one who can lead him astray, and he whom He leads astray has no one to guide him. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Apostle. "You who believe,...fear Allah by Whom you ask your mutual rights, and reverence the wombs. Allah has been watching you." ..."you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and die only as Muslims" ...."you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and die only as Muslims"....."you who believe, fear Allah and say what is true. He will make your deeds sound, and forgive your sins. He who obeys Allah and His Apostle has achieved a mighty success." The narrator, Muhammad ibn Sulayman, did mention the word "inna" (verily). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2118)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke unhone humein zaroorat ki khutba sikhaayi: "Alhamdulillah, hum uski hamd karte hain, uski madad chahte hain, uski bakhshish chahte hain, aur hum Allah ki panah maangte hain apne nafs ki buraiyon se, jise Allah hidayat de use koi gumraah nahi kar sakta, aur jise woh gumraah kare use koi hidayat nahi de sakta, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad uske bandey aur Rasool hain," phir teen ayaat padhte: "{Aye imaan walo, Allah se aisa daro jaisa darne ka haq hai, aur Musalman honay ki halat ke ilawa hargiz na maro}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 102), "{Aye logo, apne Rab se daro jisne tumhein aik jaan se paida kiya, aur usi se uska jorra banaya, aur unse bohot se mard aur auratein phailaayin, aur Allah se daro jiske naam par tum aik doosre se sawaal karte ho, aur rishtedaari se (bhi daro), beshak Allah tumhein dekh raha hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 1), "{Aye imaan walo, Allah se daro aur seedhi baat karo, woh tumhare aamaal sudhaar dega aur tumhare gunah maaf kar dega, aur jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaa'at kare, usne bohot badi kamyaabi paayi}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 71), phir apni zaroorat ka zikr karte. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: When the Prophet ﷺ congratulated a man on his marriage, he said: May Allah bless for you, and may He bless on you, and combine both of you in good (works). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2130)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) jab kisi aadmi ki shaadi par mubarakbaad dete to farmate: 'Allah tumhein barkat de, aur tumpar barkat naazil kare, aur tum dono ko bhalaai mein jama rakhe.'"

e: [AI] From a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the Ansar, known as Basrah, he said: I married a virgin woman in her privacy, then I went to her and found her to be pregnant. The Prophet ﷺ  said to me, "She has the right to Mahr (dowry) for what you have exposed of her private parts, and the child is your slave. When she gives birth, then flog her."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se Ansar ke aik shakhs se, jinhein Basrah kaha jaata tha, unhone kaha: "Maine aik pardanashin kunwari aurat se shaadi ki, jab main uske paas gaya to woh haamila nikli." To Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Uska mehr uske sath jo tumne halal samjha uske badle mein hai, aur bachcha tumhara ghulam hoga, aur jab woh bachcha jan de to usse hadd (saza) lagao."

e: [AI] He married a virgin woman and had intercourse with her, but he found her to be not a virgin anymore. So the Prophet ﷺ  made her his slave and separated between them.
hi: Ke unhone aik kunwari aurat se nikah kiya aur uske paas gaye to unhein woh haamila mili, "to Nabi (SAW) ne uske bachche ko apna ghulam banaaya aur unke darmiyan judaai daal di."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "Announce the marriage."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nikah ka ailaan karo."

e: [AI] We transferred a woman from the Ansar to her husband, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Did you have any amusement with you? Verily, the Ansar love amusement."
hi: Humne Ansar ki aik aurat ko uske shohar ke paas pahunchaaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhare sath koi tafreeh (khel-tamasha) tha? Kyunke Ansar tafreeh pasand karte hain."

e: [AI] I said to Muhammad bin Hatib, "I married two women, and there was no sound in either of them," meaning the sound of a drum. So Muhammad said, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The distinction between what is permissible and what is forbidden is the sound of the drum."
hi: Maine Muhammad bin Hatib se kaha: "Maine do auraton se shaadi ki, aur unme se kisi mein bhi koi aawaz nahi thi," ya'ni daff (dafli) ki. To Muhammad ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Halal aur haram ke darmiyan farq daff ki aawaz hai."

e: [AI] From Abu Ishaq, summarizing according to the criteria of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Abu Ishaq se, tafseel ke sath, mukhtasar tor par. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] I entered upon Qaradah ibn Ka'b and Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari in a wedding, and I heard female singers. So I said, "You are companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and the people of Badr, and you allow this to happen among you?" They said, "If you wish, stay with us, and if you wish, go, for it has been permitted for us to engage in conversation at weddings and to cry at times of calamity." Sharik said, "I saw him (i.e., the Prophet) saying this without any prohibition."
hi: Main Qaradah bin Ka'b aur Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari (RA) ke paas aik shaadi mein dakhil hua, wahan kuch laundiyaan gaana ga rahi thin, maine kaha: "Aap log Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba aur Badr walon mein se hain, aur aapke yahan yeh ho raha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Agar chaho to humare sath baitho, aur agar chaho to jao, kyunke humein shaadi mein tafreeh ki aur museebat mein rone ki ijaazat di gayi hai." Shareek ne kaha: "Mera khayal hai unhone kaha: bina noha (maatam) ke." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  heard some people singing at a wedding, so he gave them a ram as a gift while they were dancing in a courtyard, and your love is in the heart. He knows what will happen tomorrow. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "No one knows what will happen tomorrow except Allah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne kuch logon ko unki shaadi mein gaate hue suna, aur unhein aik mendha tohfe mein diya, woh khaleej (aangan) mein tanhaai mein gungunaa rahi thin: "Teri mohabbat mehfil mein hai, aur woh jaanta hai kal kya hoga," Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kal kya hoga yeh Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  addressed me, so I apologized to him and he apologized to me. Then the verse {Indeed, We have made lawful to you your wives} [Surah Al-Ahzab 50] was revealed to him. So I said, "I was not permissible for him, nor did I migrate with him. Rather, I was with the divorcees."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe shaadi ka payaam diya, to maine unhein uzr pesh kiya, aur unhone mera uzr qubool kar liya, phir unpar yeh nazil hui: "{Beshak humne tumhare liye tumhari biwiyaan halal ki hain}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 50) yeh ayat. To unhone kaha: "Main unke liye halal nahi thi, na maine unke sath hijrat ki thi, aur main aazaad kiye gaye (Makkah walon) mein se thi."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave Fatimah a trousseau of a velvet garment, a waterskin and a leather pillow stuffed with idhkhir fibres. (Using translation from Aḥmad 643)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fatimah (RA) ko jahez diya jismein aik chaadar, aik mashk, aur chamde ki aik takiya thi jiski bharai naariyal ke resha se ki gayi thi."

e: My mother intended to make me gain weight to send me to the (house of) the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. But nothing which she desired benefited me till she gave me cucumber with fresh dates to eat. Then I gained as much weight (as she desired). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3903)
hi: "...taake tum mujhe mota kar do Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas jaane ke liye, lekin jo woh chahti thin usme se kuch bhi mujhpar asar nahi hua yahan tak ke unhone mujhe kheera aur taaza khajoor khilaayi, to main uspar behtareen tarah se mota ho gayi."

e: "When anyone of you buys a slave woman let him say: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha wa khaira ma jabaltaha alaihi, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma jabaltaha alaihi (O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that You have made her inclined towards, and I seek refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that You have made her inclined towards).' And he should pray for blessing. And if anyone of you buys a camel then he should take hold of its hump and pray for. blessing and say similar words." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2252)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi kisi laundi, aurat, ya jaanwar se faida uthaaye, to uski peshaani pakde aur barkat ki dua kare, aur kahe: 'Aye Allah, main tujhse iski bhalaai aur jis fitrat par yeh banaayi gayi hai uski bhalaai maangta hoon, aur main teri panah maangta hoon iski buraai se aur jis fitrat par yeh banaayi gayi hai uski buraai se,' aur agar woh oont ho to uske koohaan ke oopar wale hisse ko pakde (aur yehi dua kare)."

e: [AI] Ali invited a man and made food for him. Then he said, "Let us invite the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to eat with us." So they invited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he came and saw a bed that had been struck in one corner of the house. He went back and Fatima said to Ali, "Go and tell him why he turned back, O Messenger of Allah!" So he went and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "It is not befitting for a Prophet to enter a luxurious house."
hi: Ali (RA) ne aik shakhs ki mehmaan-nawaazi ki aur uske liye khana banaaya, unhone kaha: "Kaash hum Rasulullah (SAW) ko bulaate aur woh humare sath khaate." To unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko bulaawa diya, aap (SAW) aaye aur ghar ke aik kone mein bicha hua bistar dekha, to aap (SAW) wapas chale gaye. Fatimah (RA) ne kaha: "Wapas jao aur unse poocho, kis cheez ne aapko wapas bhej diya, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" To woh gaye, Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Nabi ke liye munaasib nahi ke woh kisi sajaaye gaye ghar mein dakhil ho."

e: The Messenger of Allah said: "When a man has two wives and he is not just between them, he will come on the Day of Judgment with one side drooping." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1141)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab kisi aadmi ki do biwiyaan hon aur woh unke darmiyan insaaf na kare, to woh Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke uska aik pehlu jhuka hua hoga."

e: On the authority of his father that 'Aishah said: O my nephew, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not prefer one of us to the other in respect of his division of the time of his staying with us. It was very rare that he did not visit us any day (i.e. he visited all of us every day). He would come near each of his wives without having intercourse with her until he reached the one who had her day and passed his night with her. When Saudah daughter of Zam'ah became old and feared that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would divorce her, she said: Messenger of Allah, I give to 'Aishah the day you visit me. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ accepted it from her. She said: We think that Allah, the Exalted, revealed about this or similar matter the Qur'anic verse: "If a wife fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part...." [4:128] (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2135)
hi: Unhone apne bhatije se kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas rehne mein humme se kisi ko doosri par tarjeeh nahi dete the, aur shaayad hi koi din hota jab woh humare paas na aate, aap (SAW) har biwi ke qareeb jaate bagair sambhog ke, yahan tak ke jiska din hota uske paas pahunchte aur uske paas raat guzaarte." Aur Sawdah bint Zam'ah (RA) ne jab woh boodhi ho gayin aur unhein darr hua ke Rasulullah (SAW) unhein talaaq de denge, kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mera din Aisha (RA) ke liye hai," to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse yeh qubool kar liya. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Isi silsile mein Allah Ta'ala ne unke aur unke jaise logon ke baare mein yeh nazil ki: {Aur agar kisi aurat ko apne shohar se bad-sulooki ya bezaari ka darr ho}" (Surah An-Nisa 128).

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to divide his time equally and said: O Allah, this is my division concerning what I control, so do not blame me concerning what You control and I do not. Abu Dawud said: By it meant the heart. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2134)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) taqseem karte to insaaf karte aur farmate: "Aye Allah, yeh meri taqseem hai jiska main maalik hoon, isliye mujhe us cheez mein malaamat na kar jiska maalik tu hai aur main nahi hoon." Ismail Al-Qadi ne kaha: "Ya'ni dil, aur yeh biwiyon ke darmiyan insaaf ke silsile mein hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to aske our permission on the day he had to stay with one of his wives (by turns) after the following Qur'anic verse was revealed: "You may distance those whom you like, and draw close to those whom you like" [33:51]. The narrator Mu'adhah said: I said to her: What did you say to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ? She said: I used to say: If had an option for that, I would not preferred anyone to myself. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2136)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab humme se kisi aurat ke din mein hote to ijaazat le lete, yeh us waqt tha jab yeh nazil hui: "{Tum jisse chaaho door rakho aur jisse chaaho apne paas rakho}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 51). Mu'adhah ne kaha: to maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Aap Rasulullah (SAW) se kya kehti thin?" Unhone kaha: "Main kehti thi, agar yeh mere ikhtiyaar mein hota, to main kisi ko apne aap par tarjeeh na deti."

e: I went to al-Hirah and saw them (the people) prostrating themselves before a satrap of theirs, so I said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has most right to have prostration made before him. When I came to the Prophet ﷺ, I said: I went to al-Hirah and saw them prostrating themselves before a satrap of theirs, but you have most right, Messenger of Allah, to have (people) prostrating themselves before you. He said: Tell me , if you were to pass my grave, would you prostrate yourself before it? I said: No. He then said: Do not do so. If I were to command anyone to make prostration before another I would command women to prostrate themselves before their husbands, because of the special right over them given to husbands by Allah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2140)
hi: Main Al-Hirah gaya, maine unhein aik marzubaan (Farsi hakim) ko sajda karte dekha, maine socha: "Rasulullah (SAW) sajda kiye jaane ke zyada haqdaar hain," to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Main Al-Hirah gaya, maine unhein aik marzubaan ko sajda karte dekha, to aap, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), sajde ke zyada haqdaar hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bataao, agar tum meri qabar se guzro, kya tum use sajda karoge?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To aisa mat karo, agar main kisi ko kisi ke liye sajda karne ka hukum deta, to main auraton ko unke shohron ke liye sajda karne ka hukum deta, us haq ki wajah se jo Allah ne unhein unpar diya hai."

e: [AI] I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what are the rights of a wife upon us?" He said, "To feed her when you eat, and to clothe her when you clothe yourself, and to avoid hitting her on the face, and to not insult her or abandon her except inside the house."
hi: Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humari biwi ka humpar kya haq hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum khaao to use bhi khilaao, jab tum kapda pehno to use bhi pehnao, uske chehre par mat maaro, use bura-bhala mat kaho, aur usse alagpan (ghar ke ilawa kahin) mat karo."

e: Do not beat Allah's handmaidens, but when Umar came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: Women have become emboldened towards their husbands, he (the Prophet) gave permission to beat them. Then many women came round the family of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complaining against their husbands. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Many women have gone round Muhammad's family complaining against their husbands. They are not the best among you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2146)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki laundiyon (auraton) ko mat maaro." To Umar (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), auraten apne shohron ke khilaaf sarkash ho gayi hain," to aap (SAW) ne unhein maarne ki ijaazat de di. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke gharaane ke paas bohot si auraten aayin apne shohron ki shikaayat lekar, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Muhammad (SAW) ke gharaane ke paas bohot si auraten apne shohron ki shikaayat lekar aayi hain, yeh log tum mein se behtareen nahi hain."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married Umm Salamah, he said to her, "I have presented to the Negus gifts of musk and jewelry, but I do not see him except that he has already passed away, and I do not see the gifts that were given to him except that they will be returned. So if they are returned to me, will they be yours or mine?" It happened just as he said. The Negus died, and when the gifts were returned to him, he gave each of his wives a piece of musk and gave the rest to Umm Salamah, along with the jewelry.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Umm Salamah (RA) se shaadi ki, to aap (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Maine Najashi ko kuch auqiya mushk aur aik jodaa tohfe mein bheja tha, aur mujhe lagta hai woh guzar chuke hain, aur mujhe lagta hai jo tohfa unhein bheja gaya tha woh wapas kar diya jayega, jab woh mere paas wapas aa jaaye to woh tumhare liye hoga ya tum sabke liye?" Unhone kaha: waisa hi hua jaisa aap (SAW) ne farmaya, Najashi ka inteqaal ho gaya, jab tohfa unke paas wapas aaya to unhone apni har biwi ko us mushk mein se aik auqiya diya, aur baaqi Umm Salamah (RA) ko diya, aur unhein woh jodaa bhi diya.

e: [AI] From the narration of Al-Abdiyy, who was one of the companions of Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, who said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with his daughter and said, "O Messenger of Allah, my daughter refuses to get married." The Prophet ﷺ said to her, "Obey your father." She said, "By the One who has sent you with the truth, I will not get married until you inform me of the rights of the husband over his wife." He said, "The right of the husband over his wife is that if he has a wound, she must lick it to fulfill his right."
hi: Naahar Al-Abdi se, jo Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ke saathiyon mein se the, unhone Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se riwayat ki, unhone kaha: aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas apni beti ko lekar aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh meri beti hai, shaadi karne se inkaar kar rahi hai." To Nabi (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Apne waalid ki baat maano." Usne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, main shaadi nahi karungi jab tak aap mujhe na bataayen ke shohar ka biwi par kya haq hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shohar ka biwi par haq yeh hai ke agar usse zakhm ho aur woh use chaat le, tab bhi woh uska haq poora nahi kar sakti."

e: [AI] A woman came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am Fulanah, daughter of Fulan." He said, "I know who you are, what do you need?" She said, "I need to marry my cousin Fulan Al-Abid." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am aware of him." She said, "He proposed to me, so tell me what are the rights of the husband upon the wife. If it is something I can handle, I will marry him, but if not, I will not marry him." He said, "One of the rights of the husband upon the wife is that if he were to pour pus, blood, or pus on his nostrils, she should lick it with her tongue.
