If it were appropriate for a human to prostrate to another human, I would order the wife to prostrate to her husband when he enters upon her due to the superiority Allah has bestowed upon him." She said, "By the One who has sent you with the truth, I will not marry for the rest of my life."
hi: Aik aurat Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main fulan binte fulan hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein pehchaanta hoon, tumhari kya zaroorat hai?" Usne kaha: "Meri zaroorat mere chachere bhai fulan aabid (ibaadat-guzaar) se hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main use bhi pehchaanta hoon." Usne kaha: "Woh mujhe shaadi ka payaam de raha hai, mujhe bataaiye shohar ka biwi par kya haq hai, agar woh aisi cheez hai jo main utha sakti hoon to main uski shaadi karungi, aur agar main na utha sakoon to shaadi nahi karungi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shohar ka biwi par yeh haq hai ke agar uske naak se khoon, peep, aur pasina bahe aur woh use apni zubaan se chaat le, tab bhi woh uska haq poora nahi kar sakti, agar kisi insaan ke liye kisi doosre insaan ko sajda karna jaayez hota, to main aurat ko hukum deta ke woh apne shohar ko sajda kare jab woh uske paas aaye, us fazeelat ki wajah se jo Allah ne usse usspar di hai." Usne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, main jab tak duniya mein hoon shaadi nahi karungi."

e: [AI] I went to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  with a certain need, and he said, "Are you the wife of so-and-so?" I answered, "Yes." He then asked, "How are you towards him?" I replied, "I only give him what I am capable of." The Prophet said, "But where are you in relation to him? Verily, he is either your Paradise or your Hellfire." This narration was reported by Malik ibn Anas, Hammad ibn Zaid, and Ad-Darawardi from Yahya ibn Sa'id, and it is authentic.
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas kisi zaroorat ke silsile mein aayi, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye yeh, kya tum shaadi-shuda ho?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum uske liye kaisi ho?" Maine kaha: "Main uski koi kami nahi chhodti siwaye us cheez ke jiski main taaqat nahi rakhti." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To dekho tum uske saath kahan ho, kyunke woh hi tumhari Jannat aur tumhari Jahannam hai." Isi tarah Malik bin Anas, Hammad bin Zaid, aur Ad-Darawardi ne, Yahya bin Sa'eed se, riwayat ki hai, aur yeh sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "It is not permissible for a believing woman to allow someone into her husband's home if he dislikes it, nor should she leave the house if he dislikes it. She should not obey anyone in that matter, nor should she show fear in her heart nor should she isolate herself from his bed, nor should she hit him. If he is at fault, she should come to him until she pleases him. If he accepts her, then it is good and Allah accepts her excuse, her argument will be successful and there will be no sin upon her. But if he is pleased with her separation from him, then she has fulfilled her duty with Allah and her excuse has been fulfilled in the sight of Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhti ho, jaayaz nahi ke woh apne shohar ke ghar mein kisi ko ijaazat de jabke woh napasand karta ho, aur na hi woh ghar se nikle jabke woh napasand karta ho, aur na hi ismein kisi aur ki farmaanbardaari kare, aur na hi uske sath sakhti ikhtiyar kare, aur na hi uske bistar se alag ho, aur na hi usse maare, aur agar woh (shohar) zyada zulm karne wala ho to woh uske paas jaaye yahan tak ke use raazi kar le, agar woh (shohar) qubool kare to bahut achha, aur uska uzr Allah ke nazdeek qubool ho gaya aur uski daleel kaamyaab hui, aur uspar koi gunah nahi, aur agar woh (shohar) uski raazi hone ke bagair inkaar kare, to bhi usne Allah ke nazdeek apna uzr pura kar diya."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Allah does not look at a woman who does not show gratitude to her husband while she is not independent of him.'"
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah us aurat ki taraf nahi dekhta jo apne shohar ka shukriya ada nahi karti jabke woh usse be-niyaz nahi ho sakti."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O women, give in charity, even from your jewelry, for indeed you comprise the majority of the inhabitants of Hell." A woman who was not among the elite women asked, "Why are we the majority of the inhabitants of Hell, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Because you curse frequently and show ingratitude towards your husbands. I have not seen anyone more deficient in intelligence and religious commitment than you. A wise man could be led astray by some of you." They asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the deficiency in our intelligence and religious commitment?" He said, "As for the deficiency in intelligence, the testimony of two women is equal to that of one man. As for the deficiency in religious commitment, one of you may stay without praying for many days and nights, not prostrating to Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye auraton ke giroh, sadqa do, chahe apne zewar mein se hi ho, kyunke tum Jahannam walon mein sabse zyada tadaad mein ho." To aik aurat jo khaas martabe ki nahi thi, ne kaha: "Kyun, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum Jahannam walon mein sabse zyada kyun hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum bohot laanat karti ho aur apne saathi (shohar) ki na-shukri karti ho, aur main ne deen aur aqal mein kami wale logon mein tum se zyada mard walon ki aqal par ghaalib aane wala kisi ko nahi dekha." Unhone poocha: "Aur humare deen aur aqal mein kya kami hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahi baat aqal ki kami ki, to do auraton ki gawahi aik mard ki gawahi ke barabar rakhi gayi hai, aur rahi baat deen ki kami ki, to unme se koi Allah ki chaahi hui muddat tak din-raat baithi rehti hai (haiz ki wajah se) aur Allah ke liye aik bhi sajda nahi karti."

e: [AI] I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "Indeed, the wicked are the residents of the Fire." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, who are the wicked?" He said, "The women." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, are they not our mothers, daughters, and sisters?" He said, "Yes, but when they are given, they do not express gratitude, and when they are afflicted, they do not show patience."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suna, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak faasiq (nafarmaan) log Jahannam walon mein hain." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), faasiq kaun hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Auraten." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya woh humari maayen, betiyaan, aur behnein nahi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kyun nahi, lekin jab unhein diya jaata hai to woh shukr nahi karti, aur jab unhein aazmaaya jaata hai to woh sabr nahi karti."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do not hit the female servants of Allah." Then Umar came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, women have become defiant towards their husbands." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  granted permission for them to be struck. He then went around the household of Muhammad ﷺ  and found seventy women, all of whom complained about their husbands. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Those are not the best among you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki laundiyon ko mat maaro." To Umar (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), auraten apne shohron ke khilaaf sarkash ho gayi hain," to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein maarne ki ijaazat de di. Unhone kaha: to Muhammad (SAW) ke gharaane ke paas sattar (70) auraten aayin, sab apne shohron ki shikaayat kar rahi thin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh log tum mein se behtareen nahi hain."

e: [AI] Regarding striking women, then complaining to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he ﷺ  put a separation between them and the act of striking. Then he said, "Indeed, the family of Muhammad ﷺ  has been surrounded by seventy women, all of whom have been struck." Yahya said, "And I thought that Al-Qasim said," Then they were told afterwards, "And your best men will not strike."
hi: ...auraton ko maarne ke baare mein, phir unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se unki shikaayat ki, to aap (SAW) ne unhein aur unke maarne ke darmiyan chhod diya, phir farmaya: "Aaj raat Muhammad (SAW) ke gharaane ke paas sattar (70) auraten aayin, sab ko maara gaya tha." Yahya ne kaha: aur mera khayal hai ke Al-Qasim ne kaha: phir unhein baad mein bataya gaya: "Aur tum mein se behtareen log kabhi nahi maarengay."

e: "I met my maternal uncle who was carrying a flag (for an expedition) and I said: 'Where are you going?' He said: 'The Messenger of Allah is sending me to a man who has married his father's wife after he died, to strike his neck or kill him.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3331)
hi: Main apne mamu se mila, unke sath jhanda tha, maine poocha: "Kahan jaana chahte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe aik aise aadmi ki taraf bheja hai jisne apne waalid ki wafaat ke baad unki biwi se shaadi kar li, aur mujhe hukum diya hai ke main uski gardan maaroon."

e: [AI] Some people passed by us and we asked them, "Where are you going?" They said, "We have been sent by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to a man who visits his father's wife to kill him."
hi: Kuch log humare paas se guzre jaa rahe the, humne unse poocha: "Kahan ja rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein bheja hai aise aadmi ki taraf jo apne waalid ki biwi ke paas jaata hai, taake hum use qatl karein."

e: [AI] "I wander on camels that have gone astray during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . While I was wandering in the valleys, suddenly a group of riders and horsemen approached, they circled around and took out a man. They neither asked him nor spoke to him, until they struck him and killed him. After they left, I inquired about him and they said he was married to his father's wife. Its chain of narration is sound."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein apne bhatke huay oonton ko dhoondh raha tha, jabke main kuch gharon mein ghoom raha tha, achanak mujhe kuch sawaar aur ghudsawaar mile jo aaye aur gher liya, unhone aik aadmi ko nikaala, na unhone usse kuch poocha na baat ki, yahan tak ke unhone uski gardan maar di. Jab woh chale gaye to maine uske baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Usne apne waalid ki biwi se shaadi kar li thi." Iski sanad achhi hai.

e: [AI] Ghaylan bin Salamah al-Thaqafi embraced Islam, and he had ten wives. "So the Prophet, peace be upon him, commanded him to keep four of them." This is narrated by the early companions of Sa'id bin Zurai' and Ismail bin 'Ulayyah and Ghundar and the Imams of the Hafiz from the people of Basrah. Imam Muslim bin al-Hajjaj ruled that "this hadith is one of the fabrications by Ma'mar in Basrah." However, if it is narrated from him by trustworthy individuals outside of Basrah, we consider it authentic. I found Sufyan al-Thawri and Abdul Rahman bin Muhammad al-Muharibi and Isa bin Yunus, all of them being from Kufa, narrating it from Ma'mar.
hi: Ghailan bin Salamah Ath-Thaqafi (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke unke paas das (10) biwiyaan thin, "to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh unme se chaar rakh lein." Isi tarah Sa'eed ke pehle ke sathiyon - Yazid bin Zurai', Ismail bin Ulayyah, Ghundar, aur Basra ke haafiz imamon - ne bhi riwayat ki hai, aur Imam Muslim bin Al-Hajjaj ne faisla diya hai ke "yeh hadith unme se hai jismein Ma'mar ne Basra mein galti ki thi," isliye agar koi bharosemand raawi Basra walon ke ilawa isse riwayat kare, to hum ise sahih maante hain, to maine Sufyan Ath-Thawri, Abdur Rahman bin Muhammad Al-Muharibi, aur Isa bin Yunus ko paaya, aur teenon Kufa se hain, unhone ise Ma'mar se riwayat kiya.

e: [AI] That Ghailan ibn Salama accepted Islam and had ten wives, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded him to choose four of them.
hi: Ghailan bin Salamah (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke unke paas das (10) biwiyaan thin, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh unme se chaar chun lein."

e: [AI] "Indeed, Ghaylan ibn Salamah embraced Islam and he had ten wives during the pre-Islamic era. They also embraced Islam along with him. So, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Choose four of them.'"
hi: Ghailan bin Salamah (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke unke paas jaahiliyat mein das (10) biwiyaan thin, aur woh unke sath Islam laayi thin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unme se chaar chun lo."

e: [AI] Ghaylan bin Salamah al-Thaqafi converted to Islam, and he had ten wives. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  instructed him to choose four of them and leave the rest. This is how I found the hadith reported by the people of Yamamah from Ma'mar.
hi: Ghailan bin Salamah Ath-Thaqafi (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke unki das (10) biwiyaan thin, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh unme se chaar chun lein aur baaqi ko chhod dein." Aur isi tarah maine yeh hadith Yamamah walon ke paas Ma'mar se paayi hai.

e: [AI] Qaylan ibn Salamah Al-Thaqafi embraced Islam and had eight wives. "Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded him to choose four of them." This is how I found the hadith documented by the Khorasani scholars from Ma'mar Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Kadhdhab.
hi: Ghailan bin Salamah Ath-Thaqafi (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke unki aath (8) biwiyaan thin, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh unme se chaar chun lein." Aur isi tarah maine yeh hadith Khurasan ke imamon ke paas Ma'mar se paayi hai. Ahmad bin Muhammad jhoote hain.

e: [AI] "That Ghailan ibn Salamah al-Thaqafi accepted Islam and he had ten wives. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded him to keep four of them and divorce the others. And based on my understanding, Mu'ammar ibn Rashid informed me about it through both transmission and connection. The evidence for this is that those who received this information from him in Basrah also transmitted it, and transmission is more reliable than connection. Indeed, an increase in trustworthiness is accepted, and Allah knows best."
hi: Ghailan bin Salamah Ath-Thaqafi (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke unke paas das (10) biwiyaan thin, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne hukum diya ke woh chaar rakh len aur baaqi ko alag kar dein." Aur meri koshish se jo nateeja nikalta hai woh yeh hai ke Ma'mar bin Rashid ne ise dono tareeqon se bayan kiya - kabhi mursal (bagair mukammal sanad ke) aur kabhi muttasil (mukammal sanad ke sath) - aur iski daleel yeh hai ke jinhone Basra walon mein se isse muttasil riwayat ki, unhone bhi ise mursal riwayat kiya hai, aur muttasil hona mursal se behtar hai, kyunke bharosemand raawi ki ziyaadti qubool ki jaati hai, aur Allah zyada jaanta hai.

e: [AI] Indeed, Al-Hasan said, "Verily, the one who commits adultery while being married shall only marry someone who is also married like them." Amr asked, "And what is pleasing to you?" Sa'id al-Maqburi narrated to us from Abu Hurayrah from the Prophet, peace be upon him, "And Abdullah ibn Amr used to proclaim this loudly."
hi: Al-Hasan kehte the: "Kode lagaaya gaya zaani sirf apne jaisi kode lagaayi gayi (aurat) se hi shaadi kare." To Amr ne poocha: "Aur tumhein kya pasand hai?" Humein Sa'eed Al-Maqburi ne, Abu Hurairah (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, hadith bayan ki, "aur Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ise bulund awaaz se ailaan kiya karte the."

e: [AI] A man from the Muslims sought permission from the Prophet of Allah ﷺ regarding a woman known as Ummu Muharwil who used to commit adultery and stipulate that he spend on her. The Prophet of Allah ﷺ granted permission and informed him about her situation. The Prophet of Allah ﷺ recited the verse, "The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist" [Quran 24:3]. And the verse was revealed, "The fornicatress does not marry except a fornicator or polytheist" [Quran 24:3].
hi: Musalmano mein se aik shakhs ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se aik aurat ke baare mein ijaazat maangi jise Umm Muharwil kaha jaata tha, jo zina karti thi aur shart lagaati thi ke woh uspar kharch kare, usne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein ijaazat maangi aur unhein uska maamla bataaya, to Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne yeh padha: "{Zaani (zina karne wala) sirf zaaniya ya mushrika se hi nikah karta hai}" (Surah An-Noor 3), aur yeh nazil hui: "{Zaaniya (zina karne wali) se sirf zaani ya mushrik hi nikah karta hai}" (Surah An-Noor 3).

e: [AI] Indeed, it is not marriage, but rather sexual intercourse. Only a person who commits adultery or practices polytheism engages in it.
hi: "Khabardar, yeh nikah ke baare mein nahi balke sambhog ke baare mein hai, sirf zaani ya mushrik hi uske sath zina karta hai."

e: that the Messenger of Allah said : "If a slave gets married without his master's permission, he is a fornicator." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1959)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab ghulam apne maalik ki ijaazat ke bagair shaadi kare, to woh zaani (nikah ke bagair sambhog karne wala) shumaar hota hai."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: to Ali: Do not give a second look, Ali, (because) while you are not to blame for the first, you have no right to the second. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2149)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Ali, pehli nazar ke baad doosri nazar mat dalo, kyunke pehli nazar maazoor hai lekin doosri tumhare liye nahi hai."

e: Abu Al Darda said “The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ was in a battle. He saw a woman who was nearing the time when she was to deliver a child. “He said “Perhaps the master has intercourse with her.”. They(the people) said “Yes”. He said “I am inclined to invoke a curse on him which will enter his grave with him. How can he make it (the child) an heir when it is not lawful for him? How can he take it into his service when that is not lawful for him?” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2156)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik ghazwe mein thay, unhone aik haamila aurat dekhi, farmaya: "Shayad uske maalik ne uske sath sohbat ki hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main iraada rakhta hoon ke main use aisi lanat karoon jo uski qabar tak uske sath jaaye, woh use waaris kaise banaayega jabke yeh uske liye jaayez nahi, aur woh use apni khidmat mein kaise rakhega jabke yeh uske liye jaayez nahi?"

e: Abu Sa’id Al Khudri traced to Prophet ﷺ the following statement regarding the captives taken at Atwas. There must be no intercourse with pregnant woman till she gives birth to her child or with the one who is not pregnant till she has had one menstrual period. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2157)
hi: "Awtas ke qaidiyon ke baare mein farmaya: 'Haamila (aurat) ke sath, jab tak woh bachcha jan na de, sohbat na ki jaaye, aur ghair-haamila ke sath, jab tak uski aik haiz na ho jaaye, sohbat na ki jaaye.'"

e: [AI] "Verily, Ibn Umar by Allah's will and intention indeed received forgiveness. Indeed, this neighborhood belonged to the Ansar, who were polytheists, and they were the people of polytheism, whereas this neighborhood belonged to the Jews, who were the people of the Book. They used to witness favors upon themselves and as a result, many people used to follow their actions. It was a custom of the people of the Book not to approach women except on a specific condition. This was to conceal the woman's status. Thus, this Ansari neighborhood adopted this practice from them. This neighborhood, however, belonged to the Quraish who used to unlawfully unveil women and take pleasure in them, whether they were facing them or their backs. When the migrants arrived in Medina, a man among them married a woman from the Ansar neighborhood and indulged in this practice with her. She refused it and said, 'We were accustomed to a specific condition, so follow it or keep away from me until their matter is settled.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was informed about this. So, Allah the Exalted revealed the following verse: "Your wives are a place of sowing of seed for you, so come to your place of cultivation however you wish" [Quran 2:223]. It means that whether they face you or turn their back to you, that is the site for procreation."
hi: Beshak Ibn Umar (RA), Allah unhein maaf kare, se galti hui, asal baat yeh thi ke Ansar ka yeh qabila - jo but-parast (mushrik) thay - Yahoodiyon ke is qabile ke sath rehte thay jo Ahl-e-Kitaab thay, aur woh unhein apne oopar fazeelat wala samajhte thay, isliye woh unke bohot se kaamon ki pairavi karte the. Aur Ahl-e-Kitaab ka tareeqa yeh tha ke woh auraton ke paas sirf aik hi tareeqe se jaate the, aur yeh aurat ke liye sabse zyada parda-daari wala tareeqa hota tha. To Ansar ke is qabile ne unka yeh tareeqa apna liya tha. Aur Quraish ka yeh qabila auraton ke sath be-adabi se paish aata tha, aur unse aage se, peechhe se, aur letkar lutf uthaate the. Jab Muhajireen Madinah aaye, to unme se aik shakhs ne Ansar ki aik aurat se shaadi ki aur usse waisa hi karne laga, to usne isse napasand kiya aur kaha: "Humare sath to sirf aik hi tareeqe se aaya jaata tha, isliye agar tum waisa hi karo (to theek hai), warna mujhse door raho," yahan tak ke unka maamla phail gaya aur Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahuncha, to Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Tumhari biwiyaan tumhari khaiti hain, isliye apni khaiti mein jis tarah chaaho aao}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 223) "ya'ni aage se, peechhe se, ya letkar, lekin murad wahi bachche ki jagah hai."

e: “No morning comes but two angels call out: ‘Woe to men from women, and woe to women from men.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3999)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi subah aisi nahi guzarti jab do munaadi na pukaarte hon: 'Afsos mardon par auraton ki wajah se, aur afsos auraton par mardon ki wajah se.'"

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Islam does not allow for failure to perform the hajj. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1729)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Islam mein (shaadi se) hamesha ke liye door rehna (jaayez) nahi."

e: [AI] "Marry, for the best of this nation, the nation of Muhammad ﷺ , are those who have the most women. And whatever is in your possession will be entrusted, as it will all come out before the Day of Resurrection."
hi: "Shaadi karo, kyunke is Ummat mein - Muhammad (SAW) ki Ummat - sabse behtareen woh log hain jinki auraten sabse zyada hon, aur jo bhi tumhari zaat mein amaanat rakhi gayi hai woh Qayamat ke din se pehle zaroor zaahir hogi."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas said, "O Sa'id, marry, for indeed the best of this nation are the ones with the most women." Sahih.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Sa'eed, shaadi karo, kyunke is Ummat mein sabse behtareen woh log hain jinki auraten sabse zyada hon." Sahih.

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Women and perfume have been made dear to me, but my comfort has been provided in prayer.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3940)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe auraton aur khushbu se mohabbat karaayi gayi hai, aur meri aankhon ki thandak namaz mein rakhi gayi hai."

e: the Messenger of Allah said: “There is nothing like marriage, for two who love one another.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1847)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do mohabbat karne walon ke liye shaadi jaisi koi cheez nahi dekhi gayi."

e: "There are three, all of whom have a promise of help from Allah: 'The Mujahid who strives in the cause of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime; the man who gets married, seeking to keep himself chaste; and the slave who has a contract of manumission and wants to buy his freedom.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3120)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (log) hain jinki madad Allah par haq hai: Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wala mujahid, paakeezgi chahte huay shaadi karne wala, aur ada karne ka irada rakhne wala mukatib (ghulam jo azaadi ka ahd kar chuka ho)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Marry women, for they bring wealth to you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Auraton se shaadi karo, kyunke woh tumhare paas maal lekar aati hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A woman is married for one of three reasons: for her beauty, for her wealth, or for her character. So marry the one who is religiously committed; may your hands be covered in dust."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aurat se teen khaslaton mein se kisi aik ki wajah se shaadi ki jaati hai: aurat se uski khoobsurati ki wajah se shaadi ki jaati hai, aur aurat se uske deen aur uske akhlaaq ki wajah se shaadi ki jaati hai, isliye tum deen wali ko ikhtiyar karo, tumhare haath khaak-aalood hon (agar aisa na karo)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever Allah provides with a righteous wife, has been helped by Him in half of his religion, so let him fear Allah in the second half."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise Allah nek biwi de, to Allah ne uski aadhi deen mein madad kar di, isliye woh baaqi aadhe mein Allah se daray."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was asked, "Which of the women is the best?" He replied, "The best of women is the one who pleases her husband when he looks at her, obeys him when he commands her, and does not oppose him regarding herself and her wealth."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Kaunsi aurat behtareen hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Behtareen aurat woh hai jo dekhne par khush kare, hukum dene par farmaanbardaari kare, aur apni zaat aur apne maal mein uski mukhaalifat na kare."

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, something like him."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "There are three aspects of happiness and three aspects of misery. From happiness is a woman whom you find pleasing and content with your presence, and she ensures your safety regarding yourself, wealth, and property. Also, a riding animal that is gentle and obedient, so it joins you with your companions. And a spacious house with many amenities. From misery is a woman whom you find disliking and she constantly speaks ill of you, and even if you are absent from her, she does not keep herself or your belongings safe. Also, a riding animal that produces hardships, for if you strike it, it exhausts you, and if you ride it, it does not keep up with your companions. And a narrow house with few amenities."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen cheezein khush-naseebi mein se hain, aur teen bad-naseebi mein se. Khush-naseebi mein se: aisi aurat jise dekho to khush ho, aur jab tum na ho to tumhein uski aur apne maal ki hifaazat ka yaqeen ho; aisa jaanwar jo aaraam-deh ho aur tumhein tumhare saathiyon tak pahuncha de; aur aisa ghar jo kushaada ho aur jismein sahooliyaten zyada hon. Aur bad-naseebi mein se: aisi aurat jise dekho to woh tumhein bura lage, aur woh tumpar apni zubaan chalaaye, aur jab tum uske paas na ho to tumhein uski aur apne maal ki hifaazat ka yaqeen na ho; aisa jaanwar jo sust ho, agar tum use maaro to woh tumhein thaka de, aur agar tum uspar sawaar ho to woh tumhein tumhare saathiyon tak na pahunchaaye; aur aisa ghar jo tang ho aur jismein sahooliyaten kam hon."

e: It was narrated that Ma'qil bin Yasar said: "A man came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'I have found a woman who is from a good family and of good status, but she does not bear children, should I marry her?' He told him not to. Then he came to him a second time and he told him not to (marry her). Then he came to him a third time and he told him not to (marry her), then he said: 'Marry the one who is fertile and loving, for I will boast of your great numbers.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3227)
hi: Aik shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe aisi aurat mili hai jo achhe khaandan aur martabe aur maal wali hai, lekin woh bachche nahi jan sakti, kya main uski shaadi karoon?" Aap (SAW) ne mana kiya. Phir woh dobara aaya aur wahi baat kahi, aap (SAW) ne phir mana kiya. Phir woh teesri baar aaya aur wahi baat kahi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mohabbat karne wali, bachche jannay wali se shaadi karo, kyunke main tumhari zariye doosri Ummaton par apni tadaad ka fakhr karunga."

e: the Prophet said to him: 'Ali! Three are not to be delayed: Salat when its time comes, a funeral whet it (a prepared body) is present, and the (marriage of a) single woman when there is an equal for her." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 171)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen cheezein hain, Aye Ali, jinhein taal mat do: namaz jab uska waqt ho jaaye, janaza jab hazir ho jaaye, aur baiwa/kuwaari aurat jab use koi munaasib rishta mil jaaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Choose the best partners for your offspring, and marry them to those who are suitable for them." This was followed by Ikrimah ibn Ibrahim quoting Hisham ibn Urwah.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni nasal ke liye achha intekhaab karo, isliye barabar walon se shaadi karo aur unse apni betiyon ki shaadi karo." Ikrimah bin Ibrahim ne Hisham bin Urwah se iski mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] About Hisham ibn Urwah, he mentioned it with his chain of narration similarly.
hi: Hisham bin Urwah se, unhone apni sanad ke sath isi jaisi zikr ki.

e: It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah that his father said: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The nobility of the people of this world, that which they (always) go to, is wealth.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3225)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Duniya walon ki izzat jiski taraf woh jaate hain, yeh maal hi hai."

e: “Being honorable is wealth and noble character is piety.’ (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4219)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Izzat maal hai, aur asal karam (bhalaai) taqwa hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The nobility of a believer lies in his religion, his modesty lies in his intellect, and his value lies in his character."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momin ki izzat uska deen hai, uski mardaangi uski aqal hai, aur uska nasab uska akhlaaq hai."

e: A’ishah wife of the Prophet ﷺ and Umm Salamah said “Abu Hudaifah bin ‘Utbah bin Rabi’ah bin ‘Abd Shams adopted Salim as his son and married him to his niece Hind, daughter of Al Walid bin ‘Utbah bin Rabi’ah. He (Salim) was the freed slave of a woman from the Ansar (the Helpers) as the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ adopted Zaid as his son. In pre Islamic days when anyone adopted a man as his son, the people called him by his name and he was given a share from his inheritance. Allaah, the Exalted, revealed about this matter “Call them by (the name of) their fathers, that is juster in the sight of Allaah. And if ye know not their fathers, then (they are) your brethren in the faith and your clients. They were then called by their names of their fathers. A man, whose father was not known, remained under the protection of someone and considered brother in faith. Sahlah daughter of Suhail bin Amr Al Quraishi then came and said Apostle of Allaah ﷺ, we used to consider Salim(our) son. He dwelled with me and Abu Hudhaifah in the same house, and he saw me in the short clothes, but Allaah the Exalted, has revealed about them what you know, then what is your opinion about him? The Prophet ﷺ said give him your breast feed. She gave him five breast feeds. He then became like her foster son. Hence, A’ishah(may Allaah be pleased with her) used to ask the daughters of her sisters and the daughters of her brethren to give him breast feed five times, whom A’ishah wanted to see and who wanted to visit her. Though he might be of age; he then visited her. But Umm Salamah and all other wives of the Prophet ﷺ refused to allow anyone to visit them on the basis of such breast feeding unless one was given breast feed during infancy. They told A’ishah by Allaah we do not know whether that was a special concession granted by the Prophet ﷺ to Salim exclusive of the people. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2061)
hi: Abu Hudhaifah bin Utbah bin Rabee'ah bin Abd Shams, jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein maujood the, unhone Salim ko gode liya aur unki shaadi apne bhatije ki beti Hind bint Al-Waleed bin Utbah bin Rabee'ah bin Abd Shams se kar di, aur Salim Ansar ki aik aurat ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam thay, unhone unhein gode liya jaise Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zaid ko gode liya tha. Aur jahiliyat mein jo kisi ko gode leta, log use usi ke naam se pukaarte aur woh uski mirath mein hissedaar hota, yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne is baare mein yeh nazil ki: "{Unhein unke asli baap ke naam se pukaaro, yehi Allah ke nazdeek zyada munsifana hai, aur agar tumhein unke baap maloom na hon to woh deen mein tumhare bhai aur tumhare rafeeq hain}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 5), to unhein unke asli baapon ki taraf lauta diya gaya, aur jiska baap maloom na hota woh uska rafeeq ya deen mein bhai shumaar hota. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: aur Sahlah bint Suhail bin Amr Al-Qurashi phir Al-Aamiri, jo Abu Hudhaifah bin Utbah bin Rabee'ah ke nikah mein thin, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi jab Allah ne yeh nazil ki, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum Salim ko apna beta samajhte the, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein panaah di thi, to woh unke aur Abu Hudhaifah ke sath aik hi ghar mein rehte the, aur woh mujhe khula-dula halaat mein dekhte the, aur Allah ne unke baare mein woh nazil kar diya hai jo aapko maloom hai, to Salim ke maamle mein aapki kya raay hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Unhein doodh pilao." To unhone unhein paanch martaba doodh pilaaya, to isse woh haraam (mehram) ho gaye, aur woh unke doodh-shareek bete ki manind ho gaye.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Banu Bayada, marry Abu Hind and marry to him." He said, and he was a barber.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Banu Bayadah, Abu Hind se shaadi karo aur unse (apni betiyon ki) shaadi karwao." Unhone kaha: aur woh hajjam (naai/pachne lagane wale) thay.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone loves for Allah's sake, hates for Allah's sake, gives for Allah's sake and withholds for Allah's sake, he will have perfect faith. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4681)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Allah ke liye de aur Allah ke liye roke, Allah ke liye mohabbat kare aur Allah ke liye napasand kare, aur Allah ke liye shaadi kare, usne imaan mukammal kar liya."

e: that the Messenger of Allah said: "If there comes to you one with whose character and religious commitment you are pleased, then marry (your daughter or female relative under your care) to him, for if you do not do that there will be Fitnah in the land and widespread corruption.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1967)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhare paas aisa shakhs (payaam lekar) aaye jiske akhlaaq aur deen se tum raazi ho, to uski shaadi karwao, agar tum aisa na karo to zameen mein fitna aur bohot bada fasaad phail jaayega."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When one of you asked a woman in marriage, if he is able to look at what will induce him to marry her, he should do so. He (Jabir) said: I asked a girl in marriage, I used to look at her secretly, until I looked at what induced me to marry her. I, therefore, married her. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2082)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi kisi aurat ko shaadi ka payaam de, to agar woh us cheez ko dekh sake jo use uski shaadi ki taraf mail dilaaye, to aisa kare." To maine Banu Sulaim ki aik aurat ko payaam diya, main khajoor ke darakhton ke peechhe chhup kar unhein dekhta raha yahan tak ke maine unme woh dekh liya jisne mujhe unki shaadi ki taraf mail dilaaya, to maine unse shaadi kar li.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Go and look at it, as it is more deserving to be preserved between you.' He went and looked at it and remembered the agreement between them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) (ne farmaya): "Jao aur usse dekho, kyunke isse tum dono ke darmiyan mohabbat qaayam rehne ka zyada imkaan hai." Unhone kaha: to woh gaye aur usse dekha, phir unke muwaafiq (mel khaate) honay ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Keep the sermon secret, then perform ablution and complete it perfectly. Then, offer the prayer that Allah the Almighty has prescribed for you. Afterwards, praise and glorify your Lord. Then say, 'O Allah, You have the power and I do not have it, You know and I do not know, and You are the Knower of the unseen. So if You see, in the case of so-and-so (mention the name of the person), better for me in my religion, worldly life, and hereafter, then decree it for me. But if You know that it is not good for me in my religion, worldly life, and hereafter, then keep it away from me and make me content with what You have decided for me."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Payaam ko chhupao, phir wudu karo aur achhi tarah wudu karo, phir jitni namaz Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare liye likhi hai woh padho, phir apne Rab ki hamd karo aur uski buzurgi bayan karo, phir kaho: 'Aye Allah, tu qudrat rakhta hai aur main nahi rakhta, tu jaanta hai aur main nahi jaanta, aur tu ghaib ki har baat jaanne wala hai, agar tu dekhe ke fulani (uska naam le) mere liye behtar hai mere deen, duniya, aur aakhirat mein, to use meri taqdeer mein likh de, aur agar koi aur (aurat) mere deen, duniya, aur aakhirat mein mere liye behtar ho, to use meri taqdeer mein likh de.'"

e: [AI] that the Prophet ﷺ wanted to marry a woman, so he sent a woman to look at her. He said, "Smell her perfume and look at her ankles." She came to them and they said, "Shall we offer you food, O mother of so-and-so?" She said, "I will not eat except from food that Fulanah brought." He said, "So I climbed up a shelf for them and she looked at her ankles, then she said, 'Rub oil on me, O my son.'" So he started rubbing oil on her while she smelled her perfume. He said, "Then she came and informed (the Prophet)."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne aik aurat se shaadi ka irada kiya, to unhone aik aurat ko usse dekhne ke liye bheja, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uske aage ke daanto ki khushbu soongho, aur uski aidiyon (paanv ke peechhe wale hisse) ko dekho." Unhone kaha: to woh unke paas aayi, unhone (log) kaha: "Kya hum aapko khana na khilaayen, Aye fulan ki maa?" Usne kaha: "Main sirf woh khaana khaaungi jo fulani (aik khaas aurat) laayi ho." Unhone kaha: to main unke liye taakhe (rakh) par chadh gayi aur maine uski aidiyon ko dekha, phir usne kaha: "Aye beti, mere baalon se jooen nikaal do." Unhone kaha: to woh unke baalon se jooen nikaalne lagi jabke woh uske aage ke daanton ki khushbu soongh rahi thi. Unhone kaha: to woh aayi aur bataya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the fornicator only marries someone like him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khabardar, kode lagaaya gaya zaani sirf apne jaisi (kode lagaayi gayi aurat) se hi shaadi kare."

e: [AI] "I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, can we marry slaves?' He remained silent, and then I recited the verse from the Quran: 'The adulterer does not marry except an adulteress or polytheist, and none marries her except an adulterer or a polytheist. And that has been made unlawful to the believers' (Quran 24:3). So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ read it to me and said, 'Do not marry her.'"
hi: To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main Anaq se shaadi karoon?" Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) mere baare mein khamosh rahe, phir yeh nazil hui: "{Zaani sirf zaaniya ya mushrika se hi nikah karta hai, aur zaaniya se sirf zaani ya mushrik hi nikah karta hai, aur yeh momino par haraam kar diya gaya hai}" (Surah An-Noor 3), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe yeh padh kar sunayi aur farmaya: "Uske sath shaadi mat karo."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ heard saying, "The orphan girl is consulted regarding herself. If she remains silent, it is her consent. And if she disagrees, no compulsion is on her."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: "Yateem larki se uske apne baare mein mashwara liya jaaye, agar woh khamosh rahe to yeh uski raza hai, aur agar woh napasand kare to uspar koi zabardasti nahi."

e: [AI] Her mother went to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "Indeed, my daughter hates him, I swear by Allah." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered him to separate from her, so he separated from her and said, "Do not marry women until you have sought their consent. And when they remain silent, it is their consent." So Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah married her after him.
hi: To uski maa Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi aur kaha: "Meri beti isse napasand karti hai, Allah ki qasam." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne use hukum diya ke woh usse alag ho jaaye, to usne alag kar diya, aur farmaya: "Auraton se shaadi mat karo jab tak unse mashwara na le lo, agar woh khamosh rahen to yehi unki ijaazat hai." Iske baad Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) ne unse shaadi ki.

e: [AI] Khawlah bint Hakim bin Umayyah bin Al-Aws ibn Muzh'un was the wife of Uthman bin Mazh'un and this was in Makkah. She asked the Messenger of Allah, "Why don't you get married?" He asked, "Who should I marry?" She said, "If you wish, a virgin, and if you wish, a widow." He asked, "Who is the virgin?" She said, "The daughter of your beloved creation, Aisha bint Abi Bakr." He asked, "Who is the widow?" She said, "Sauda bint Zam'ah bin Qays, who has believed in you and followed you in what you are upon." He said, "Go and mention both of them to me." So she went and entered the house of Abu Bakr and said, "O Abu Bakr, may Allah bestow upon you goodness and blessings. The Messenger of Allah has sent me to propose to Aisha on his behalf." He said, "Make the supplication for me to the Messenger of Allah." She made the supplication and he came and married her, and she was at that time six or seven years old.
hi: Khawlah bint Hakim bin Umayyah bin Al-Awqas, Uthman bin Maz'un (RA) ki biwi, aur yeh Makkah mein tha, (unhone kaha): "Aye Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap shaadi nahi karte?" Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kisse?" Unhone kaha: "Agar chaho to kunwari, aur agar chaho to bewa/shaadi-shuda rah chuki." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aur kaun kunwari hai?" Unhone kaha: "Us shakhs ki beti jo Allah ki makhlooq mein aapko sabse aziz hai - Aisha bint Abi Bakr." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aur woh doosri kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Sawdah bint Zam'ah bin Qais, jo aap par imaan laa chuki hain aur jis raah par aap hain uski pairavi kar rahi hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To jao aur unka zikr karo." Unhone kaha: to woh gayi aur Abu Bakr (RA) ke ghar dakhil hui, kaha: "Aye Abu Bakr, Allah ne aappar kya bhalaai aur barkat naazil ki hai, Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bheja hai ke main aapse Aisha (RA) ka payaam dun." Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko mere liye bulaao." Unhone unhein bulaawa diya, aap (SAW) aaye aur unki shaadi karwa di, aur woh us waqt saat (7) saal ki thin.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Indeed, she is young." So Ali proposed to her and married her.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh chhoti hai (umr mein)." To Ali (RA) ne unhein payaam diya aur unse shaadi kar li.

e: the Messenger of Allah said: “Any woman whose marriage is not arranged by her guardian, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid. If (the man) has had intercourse with her, then the Mahr belongs to her in return for his intimacy with her. And if there is any dispute then the ruler is the guardian of the one who does not have a guardian.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1879)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo bhi aurat apne wali ki ijaazat ke bagair byaahi jaaye, to uska nikah baatil hai, uska nikah baatil hai, uska nikah baatil hai, agar uske sath sambhog ho chuka ho to uska mehr uske sambhog ke badle mein hai, aur agar log ikhtilaaf karein to sultan us shakhs ka wali hai jiska koi wali na ho."

e: The same as No. 290. from the Prophet. (Using translation from Bukhārī 1199b)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever frees a slave, Allah will free from every limb of his body a limb from the Fire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi ghulam ko azaad kare, Allah uske har hisse ke badle uska (khud ka) aik hissa Jahannam se azaad kar deta hai."

e: [AI] My father told me about it. They said, "Yes, O my father, tell us." He said, "My father told me that he heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'Whoever emancipates a slave, his emancipation will be his ransom from the Hellfire, limb by limb.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Kya mere waalid ne mujhse yeh bayan kiya tha? Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, aye humare abba, humein bataaiye." Unhone kaha: mujhe mere waalid ne bataaya, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: "Jo koi kisi ghulam ya banda ko azaad kare, yeh uske liye aag se hissa-badar-hissa chhutkaara hoga." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: Al-Arif ibn ad-Daylami said: We went to Wathilah ibn al-Asqa and said to him: Tell us a tradition which has not addition or omission. He became angry and replied: One of you recites when his copy of a Qur'an is hung up in his house, and he makes additions and omissions. We said: All we mean is a tradition you have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: We went to the Prophet ﷺ about a friend of ours who deserved. Hell for murder. He said: Emancipate a slave on his behalf; Allah will set free from Hell a member of the body for every member of his. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3964)
hi: "Humein aisi hadith sunaayen jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho, jismein na koi izaafa ho na koi kami." To unhein ghussa aaya aur kaha: "Tum mein se kisi aik ka Mus-haf uske ghar mein latka hota hai, aur woh (padhte waqt) izaafa aur kami karta hai." Unhone kaha: to humne kaha: "Yeh humein nahi chahiye tha, hum chahte the ke aap humein aisi hadith sunaayen jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho." Unhone kaha: hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas apne aik saathi ke maamle mein aaye jo (Jahannam ka) mustahiq ho chuka tha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uski taraf se kisi ghulam ko azaad karo, Allah uske har hisse ke badle uska aik hissa Jahannam se azaad kar dega." "Areef" yeh Abdullah bin Ad-Daylami ka laqab hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] This sheikh told me, I mean, Wathilah, I said, "What did he tell you?" He said, "He told me that I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the Battle of Tabuk when some people from the Bani Sulaym came to him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, our companion has vowed to free a slave.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Free him, for Allah will free every limb of his from the Fire.' Thus, the narration of Wathilah became authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, and Muslim also recorded it in his narration of Abu Hurairah's words: 'The freeing of a Muslim slave will free a Muslim limb from the Fire.'"
hi: Isi buzurg ne mujhse bayan ki, ya'ni Wasilah, maine poocha: "Unhone aapko kya bataya?" Unhone kaha: unhone mujhse bayan ki: main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Tabuk ki jung mein baitha tha, ke Banu Sulaim ke kuch log unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humara saathi (Jahannam ka) mustahiq ho chuka hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uski taraf se kisi ko azaad karo, Allah uske har hisse ke badle uska aik hissa Jahannam se azaad kar dega." To Wasilah ki hadith in riwayaton ki wajah se Shaykhain ki shart par sahih ban gayi, aur Muslim ne Abu Hurairah (RA) ki hadith mein 'kisi Musalman ko kisi Musalman ke azaad karne' ke alfaaz nikaale hain. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard saying, "Whoever frees a Muslim, his emancipation from the fire will be by every organ, one organ for another." Abd al-A'la (this is also Abdullah ibn Dailami) is undoubtedly in agreement with what we have said in the report.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: "Jo koi kisi Musalman ko azaad kare, yeh uske har hisse ke badle uska aik hissa Jahannam se chhutkaara hoga." Abdul A'la yeh bhi Abdullah bin Ad-Daylami hi hain, bila shak, jaisa humne 'Areef' ke baare mein kaha.

e: "My brother willed a portion of his wealth to me. So I met Abu Ad-Darda and said: 'My brother has willed a portion of his wealth to me, so where do you suggest that I should give it- to the poor, the needy, or the Mujahidin in Allah's Cause?' He said: 'As for me, then I would not consider them equal to the Mujahidin. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "The parable of the one who frees a slave at the time of his death is that of the one who gives a gift when he is satisfied (fulfilled his needs)." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2123)
hi: Mere bhai ne apne maal ka aik hissa mere liye wasiyat kiya, to main Abu Ad-Darda (RA) se mila aur maine kaha: "Mere bhai ne apne maal ka aik hissa mere liye wasiyat kiya hai, main ise kahan rakhoon? Faqiron mein, ya masaakeen mein, ya Muhajireen mein?" To unhone kaha: "Rahi baat meri, to agar main hota to mujahideen ke barabar kisi ko na rakhta, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jo koi maut ke waqt (kisi ko) azaad kare, uski misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jo pait bhar jaane ke baad tohfa de.'" Yeh Ath-Thawri ki hadith ke alfaaz hain.

e: I had a slave girl and I set her free. When the Prophet ﷺ entered upon me, I informed him (of this). He said : May Allah give reward for it; if you had given her to your maternal uncles, it would have increased your reward (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1690)
hi: Maine apni aik laundi azaad ki, Nabi (SAW) mere paas dakhil huay, maine unhein uski aazaadi ki khabar di, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum use apne mamu ke ghar walon ko de deti, to yeh tumhare ajr ke liye zyada bada hota."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, and Saad was a slave to him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was pleased with his service. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "O Abu Bakr, free Saad." Abu Bakr replied, "O Messenger of Allah, we have no one but him." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Are men coming to you? Are men coming to you?"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) se farmaya - aur Sa'd unke ghulam thay, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko unki khidmat pasand thi - Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Bakr, Sa'd ko azaad kar do." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humare paas iske siwa aur koi nahi hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare paas (aur) log aa jaayengay, tumhare paas (aur) log aa jaayengay."

e: [AI] "To me, Umm Salamah, I set you free and I stipulate that you serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for as long as you live." I said, "If you hadn't stipulated on me, I wouldn't have left the service of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as long as I live." He said, "So, she freed me and stipulated on me to serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for as long as I live."
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Main tumhein azaad karti hoon aur tumpar shart lagaati hoon ke tum jab tak zinda raho Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat karo." Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Agar tum mujhpar shart na lagaati, tab bhi main Rasulullah (SAW) ko jab tak zinda rehta kabhi na chhodta." Unhone kaha: "To unhone mujhe azaad kar diya aur mujhpar shart lagaayi ke main jab tak zinda rahoon Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat karoon."

e: [AI] About my son, O Messenger of Allah? He said, "Yes."
hi: "Mere bete ke baare mein, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan."

e: “Whoever becomes the master of a Mahram relative, he becomes free.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2525)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi aise rishtedaar ka maalik ban jaaye jiske sath nikah haraam ho, to woh khud-ba-khud azaad ho jaata hai." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: "Whoever owns a related Mahram, then he is free." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1365)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi aise rishtedaar ka maalik ban jaaye jiske sath nikah haraam ho, to woh khud-ba-khud azaad ho jaata hai." Sahih.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The child of adultery is worst of the three. Abu Hurairah said: That I give a flog in the path of Allah (as a charity) is dearer to me than emancipating a child of adultery. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3963)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zina ki aulaad teenon (logon) mein sabse buri hai." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Agar main Allah ki raah mein aik koda khaaun, yeh mujhe zina ki aulaad ko azaad karne se zyada pasand hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "The child of adultery is the worst of the three."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zina ki aulaad teenon mein sabse buri hai."

e: [AI] "Narrated by Abu Hurairah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I love to be adorned with a whip in the cause of Allah more than to free the children of adulterers.' And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'The child of adultery is the worst of the three.' And the dead will be punished by the mourning of the living.' Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her, said, 'Abu Hurairah has misunderstood what he heard and has wrongly interpreted it. As for his saying, 'I love to be adorned with a whip in the cause of Allah more than to free the children of adulterers,' it was revealed when the verse was revealed, 'Then let him attempt the difficult,' (Al-Balad 90:13). It was said, 'O Messenger of Allah, we do not have anything to release except that one of us has a black slave girl who serves and works for him. If we command them, they would commit adultery and bring children, so we would set them free.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I love to be adorned with a whip in the cause of Allah more than to command adultery and then free the children.' Salamah did not confirm this hadith, and Ibn Rahawayh has authenticated and weakened it."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) kehte hain: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main Allah ki raah mein aik koda khaaun, yeh mujhe zina ki aulaad ko azaad karne se zyada pasand hai," aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zina ki aulaad teenon mein sabse buri hai," "aur murda ko zinda ke rone se azaab hota hai." To Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Allah Abu Hurairah (RA) par reham kare, unhone theek se suna nahi isliye theek se samajh nahi paaye. Rahi baat unke is kehne ki 'Agar main Allah ki raah mein aik koda khaaun, yeh mujhe zina ki aulaad ko azaad karne se zyada pasand hai,' to jab yeh nazil hui: '{To usne dushwaar rasta ikhtiyar nahi kiya, aur tumhein kya khabar ke dushwaar rasta kya hai}' (Surah Al-Balad 12), to kaha gaya: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humare paas azaad karne ke liye kuch nahi hai siwaye is ke ke humme se kisi ke paas aik kaali laundi ho jo uski khidmat kare aur uske liye mehnat kare, to agar hum unhein hukum dein aur woh zina karein aur bachche jan dein, phir hum unhein azaad kar dein (to?).' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Agar main Allah ki raah mein aik koda khaaun, yeh mujhe zina ka hukum dene aur phir bachche ko azaad karne se zyada pasand hai.'" Salamah ko Muslim ne hujjat nahi maana, unhein bharosemand bhi kaha gaya hai aur Ibn Rahwaih ne unhein kamzor bhi kaha hai.

e: [AI] Indeed, my master accused me and made me sit on fire until my genitals burned. Umar asked her, "Did you witness this happening to her?" She replied, "No." Umar asked, "Did you confess to it?" She said, "No." Umar said, "Then how did you accuse her?" When Umar saw the man, he said, "Are you being punished with the punishment of Allah?" The man replied, "O Commander of the Believers, I accused her in my own self." Umar asked, "Did you witness this happening to her?" The man replied, "No." Umar asked, "Did she confess to it?" He replied, "No." Umar swore by Allah and said, "If I had not heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'A slave should not be punished for the act of his master, nor a parent for the act of his child,' I would have punished you on her behalf." Then Umar ordered the man to be beaten with a hundred lashes and said to the slave girl, "Go, you are free for the sake of Allah. You belong to Allah and His Messenger." Abu Salih said, "Al-Layth said, 'This is the ruling that should be implemented.'"
hi: "Mere maalik ne mujhpar shak kiya aur mujhe aag par bithaya yahan tak ke mera sharm-gaah jal gaya." Umar (RA) ne unse poocha: "Kya usne yeh khud dekha tumhare baare mein?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Unhone poocha: "Kya tumne uske saamne kisi baat ka iqraar kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Use mere paas lao." Jab Umar (RA) ne us aadmi ko dekha to kaha: "Kya tum Allah ke azaab jaisi saza dete ho?" Usne kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, maine apne dil mein usspar shak kiya." Unhone poocha: "Kya tumne yeh khud dekha uske baare mein?" Us shakhs ne kaha: "Nahi." Unhone poocha: "Kya usne iska iqraar kiya?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate na suna hota: 'Kisi ghulam se uske maalik ke badle badla nahi liya jaata, aur na hi kisi waalid se uski aulaad ke badle,' to main tumse iska badla zaroor leta." Phir unhone use nikaal kar sau (100) kode maare, aur laundi se kaha: "Jao, tum Allah ke liye azaad ho, tum Allah aur uske Rasool ki (azaad kiya hua) ho." Abu Salih ne kaha: Al-Laith ne kaha: "Aur isi faisle par amal kiya jaata hai."

e: [AI] "A group of captives from Khawlan came and among them was a woman named Aisha who had a slave child from the descendants of Ismael. There was also a group of captives from Yemen who she wanted to set free. However, the Prophet ﷺ  forbade her from doing so. Then, a group of captives from Mudar came, and the Prophet believed them to be from the Banu Al-Anbar. He commanded her to set them free. This narration is authentic."
hi: Khawlan se kuch qaidi aaye, aur Aisha (RA) par Ismail (AS) ki aulaad mein se aik ghulam azaad karna wajib tha, to Yemen se qaidi aaye, unhone unme se azaad karna chaaha, "lekin Nabi (SAW) ne unhein mana kiya." Phir Mudar se qaidi aaye - mera khayal hai unhone kaha Banu Al-Anbar se - "to aap (SAW) ne unhein azaad karne ka hukum diya." Shu'bah ne Ubaid bin Al-Hasan se iski mutaba'at ki hai. Hadith sahih hai.

e: [AI] Aisha had a slave from the offspring of Ismail. So the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, came to her with captives from the Banu Al-Anbar tribe. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to her, "Set free a slave from the Banu Al-Anbar tribe, or from the Banu Lihyan tribe, but do not set free a slave from the Banu Khawlan tribe."
hi: Aisha (RA) par Ismail (AS) ki aulaad mein se aik ghulam azaad karna wajib tha, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Banu Al-Anbar ke kuch qaidi laaye gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Banu Al-Anbar mein se ya Banu Lihyan mein se azaad karo, aur Banu Khawlan mein se azaad na karo."

e: [AI] "There were three things that used to be repeated during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, until they became just one. He said, 'Yes'."
hi: Ke teen (talaqein) Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein wapas (aik hi) mein shumaar ki jaati thin. Unhone poocha: "Ji haan?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan."

e: Verily the people have begun to hasten in the matter in which they are required to observe respite. So if we had imposed this upon them, and he imposed it upon them. (Using translation from Muslim 1472a)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein, Abu Bakr (RA) ke zamane mein, aur Umar (RA) ki khilaafat ke pehle do saalon mein, teen talaaqein (aik sath di gayi) aik hi shumaar hoti thin." To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Logon ne us maamle mein jaldbaazi shuru kar di hai jismein unhein sochne-samajhne ka waqt diya gaya tha, isliye agar hum ise unpar (sakhti se) laagu kar dein (to behtar hoga)," to unhone ise unpar laagu kar diya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Allah did not make anything lawful more abominable to Him than divorce. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2177)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne koi jaayaz cheez halaal nahi ki jo usse talaaq se zyada napasand ho."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Anyone who incites a woman against her husband or a slave against his master is not one of us. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2175)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kisi aurat ko uske shohar ke khilaaf ya kisi ghulam ko uske maalik ke khilaaf bharkaaye, woh humme se nahi."

e: [AI] "When the Prophet ﷺ  divorced Hafsah, he was commanded to reconcile with her, so he reconciled with her."
hi: "Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Hafsah (RA) ko talaaq di, to unhein hukum diya gaya ke woh unse rujoo karein, to unhone rujoo kar liya."

e: The Prophet ﷺ divorced Hafsah, but he took her back in marriage. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2283)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hafsah (RA) ko talaaq di, phir unse rujoo kar liya."

e: A woman was my wife and I loved her, but Umar hated her. He said to me: Divorce her, but I refused. Umar then went to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him. The Prophet ﷺ said: Divorce her. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5138)
hi: Mere nikah mein aik aurat thi jinse main mohabbat karta tha, aur Umar (RA) unhein napasand karte the, to Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Unhein talaaq de do," maine inkaar kiya, to unhone yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne waalid ki baat maano aur unhein talaaq de do," to maine unhein talaaq de di.

e: [AI] Indeed, my mother has always stood by me until I got married. And she told me to divorce her, but she insisted on that alone. So, I said, "I am not the one who orders you to disobey your mother nor am I the one who orders you to divorce your wife, except that if you wish, I can inform you of what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'The parent is the middle gate of Paradise, so guard that gate if you wish or leave it.'"
hi: "Meri maa mere peechhe padi rahi yahan tak ke maine shaadi ki, aur ab woh mujhe hukum deti hai ke main unhein (biwi ko) talaaq de dun, aur woh iske siwa kuch aur maanti hi nahi." To unhone kaha: "Main tumhein yeh hukum dene wala nahi ke tum apni maa ki na-farmani karo, aur na hi main tumhein yeh hukum dene wala hoon ke tum apni biwi ko talaaq do, magar agar tum chaaho to main tumhein woh baat bataata hoon jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suni hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Waalid Jannat ke darwazon mein se beech waale darwaze ki manind hai, isliye agar tum chaaho to us darwaze ki hifaazat karo ya use zaya kar do.'"

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: There are three things which, whether undertaken seriously or in jest, are treated as serious: Marriage, divorce and taking back a wife (after a divorce which is not final) (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2194)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: "Teen cheezein hain jinki sanjeedgi bhi sanjeedgi hai aur jinka mazaaq bhi sanjeedgi hai - nikah, talaaq, aur rujoo (wapsi)."

e: Allah has forgiven for me my nation their mistakes and forgetfulness, and what they are forced to do." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2043)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne meri Ummat se galti, bhool-chook, aur jispar unhein majboor kiya jaaye, maaf kar diya hai."

e: "Aishah told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There is no divorce and no manumission at the time of coercion.' " (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2046)
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Zabardasti (majboori) mein na talaaq hai na azaadi."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ  it is narrated that he said, "There is no divorce or manumission in constraint." This is the statement of Naeem, the companion of Munaakir.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zabardasti (majboori) mein na talaaq hai na azaadi." Na'eem munkir riwaayaton wale hain.

e: that the Messenger of said: 'Shall I not tell you of a borrowed billy goat.” They said: “Yes, O Messenger of!” He said: “He is Muhallil. May curse the Muhallil and the Muhallal lahu.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1936)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein 'udhaar liye gaye bakre' ke baare mein na bataaun?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh muhallil (halaalah karne wala) hai, Allah muhallil aur jiske liye halaalah kiya jaaye dono par lanat kare," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah muhallil aur jiske liye halaalah kiya jaaye dono par lanat kare."

e: that the Messenger of said: 'Shall I not tell you of a borrowed billy goat.” They said: “Yes, O Messenger of!” He said: “He is Muhallil. May curse the Muhallil and the Muhallal lahu.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1936)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein 'udhaar liye gaye bakre' ke baare mein na bataaun?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh muhallil hai," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah muhallil aur jiske liye halaalah kiya jaaye dono par lanat kare."

e: [AI] About a man who divorced his wife three times, and then his brother married her without any conspiracy from him in order to make her permissible for his brother. Does she become permissible for the first husband? He said, "No, marriage is a desire. We used to consider this as a form of licentiousness during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ."
hi: Aik shakhs ke baare mein jisne apni biwi ko teen talaaqein di, phir uske bhai ne bagair kisi mashwara ke usse shaadi kar li taake woh apne bhai ke liye halaal ho jaaye, kya woh pehle (shohar) ke liye halaal hogi? Unhone kaha: "Nahi, nikah khwahish se hona chahiye, hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein ise (halaalah ko) zina shumaar karte the."

e: [AI] "He divorced his wife on the command of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . So I asked the Prophet ﷺ  about it, and he said, 'What did you intend by that?' I said, 'I intended to divorce her once.' He said, 'By Allah?'" I said, 'By Allah.' He said, 'Then it is as you intended.'"
hi: "Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein apni biwi ko 'al-battah' (mukammal) talaaq di." Unhone kaha: to maine Nabi (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhara iska kya irada tha?" Unhone kaha: "Meri niyat aik (talaaq) thi." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Allah ki qasam se?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam se." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To yeh wahi hai jo tumne irada kiya."

e: [AI] That Rukanah bin Abd Yazeed divorced his wife Suhaymah al-Batta, then he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "I have divorced my wife Suhaymah al-Batta, and by Allah, I only intended to divorce her once." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned her to him. Then he divorced her a second time during the time of Umar, and a third time during the time of Uthman. This narration has been verified as authentic because Imam Shafi'i has mastered and memorized it from the Ahl al-Bayt (family of the Prophet). As-Sa'ib bin Abd Yazeed, the father of Shafi'i bin As-Sa'ib, is the brother of Rukanah bin Abd Yazeed. Muhammad bin Ali bin Shafi'i, the uncle of Shafi'i, is the prominent scholar of the Quraysh tribe during his time. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rukanah bin Abd Yazeed (RA) ne apni biwi Suhaimah ko "al-battah" talaaq di, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Maine apni biwi Suhaimah ko 'al-battah' talaaq di hai, aur Allah ki qasam, meri niyat sirf aik (talaaq) thi." "To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein wapas kar diya," phir unhone unhein doosri talaaq Umar (RA) ke zamane mein di aur teesri talaaq Uthman (RA) ke zamane mein. "Yeh hadith is riwayat ke sath sahih saabit ho chuki hai, kyunke Imam Shafi'i ne ise apne ghar walon se poori tarah yaad rakha aur mehfooz kiya hai, aur As-Saib bin Abd Yazeed, Shafi' bin As-Saib ke waalid, Rukanah bin Abd Yazeed ke bhai hain, aur Muhammad bin Ali bin Shafi', Imam Shafi'i ke chacha, apne zamane mein Quraish ke buzurg the." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If any woman asks her husband for divorce without some strong reason, the odour of Paradise will be forbidden to her. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2226)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat apne shohar se bagair kisi sakht wajah ke talaaq maange, Allah uspar Jannat ki khushbu haraam kar deta hai."

e: A woman embraced Islam during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; she then married. Her (former) husband then came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: Messenger of Allah, I have already embraced Islam, and she had the knowledge about my Islam. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took her away from her latter husband and restored her to her former husband. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2239)
hi: Aik aurat ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein Islam qubool kiya, phir usne shaadi kar li, to uska (pehla) shohar Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Maine bhi uske sath Islam qubool kiya tha, aur usse mere Islam qubool karne ka pata tha," "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne use uske doosre shohar se le liya aur usse uske pehle shohar ko wapas kar diya."

e: "The Prophet returned his daughter Zainab to Abul-As bin Ar-Rabi after six years in the first marriage without renewing the marriage." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1143)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne apni beti Zainab ko unke shohar Abu Al-Aas bin Rabee' ke paas pehle hi nikah ke tehat wapas bhej diya, aur kisi naye (nikah) ki zaroorat nahi padi." Sahih.

e: [AI] Narrated Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ : When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived in Madinah, his daughter Zainab came out of Makkah with her maternal cousin, Kinanah bin Kinanah. They came in the course of her maternal uncle, Hibbar bin Aswad, stabbing her camel with his spear until he made it fall down and she had a miscarriage and shed the placenta. Banu Hashim and Banu Umayyah argued about her custody. Banu Umayyah said: We have more right to her, as she was under their guardianship, Habbar bin Aswad. She was with Hind bint Utbah bin Rabi'ah; she said to her: Hind, this is because of your father. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Zaid bin Harithah: Why don't you go and bring Zainab to me? He replied: Yes, O Messenger of Allah. He took the ring of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and went along. As the shepherd went along with it and then asked him: Whose sheep are these? He replied: They belong to Zainab bint Muhammad. He moved on for a while and then said to him: Do you allow me to give you something in return for her which you would not tell to anyone? He replied in the affirmative. He gave him the ring and then the shepherd realized who he was. When he reached there, she recognized him and said: Who gave you this? He said: A man. She said: Where did you leave him? He said: At such and such place. When it was night, she went to him, and when she came to him, he said: Mount behind me, and she replied: No, but you mount behind me. He mounted behind her and she came riding. The Prophet ﷺ  used to say to her: "She is the best of my daughters, but it is unfortunate that she has been afflicted with divorce." (Al-Asbahani said: Before the verse "Call them by [the names of] their fathers" [Quran 33:5] was revealed)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki biwi Aisha (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) jab Madinah aaye, to unki beti Zainab Makkah se Kinanah (ya Ibn Kinanah) ke sath nikli, log unke peechhe nikle, Habbar bin Al-Aswad unhein aa pakda, aur unki oontni ko apne neze se maarta raha yahan tak ke unhein gira diya, unka pait ka bachcha gir gaya aur khoon bahne laga, to Banu Hashim aur Banu Umayyah ke darmiyan unke baare mein jhagda ho gaya, Banu Umayyah ne kaha: "Hum unke zyada haqdaar hain," aur woh unke chachere bhai Abu Al-Aas ke nikah mein thin, woh Hind bint Utbah bin Rabee'ah ke paas thin, to Hind unse kehti: "Yeh tumhare abba ki wajah se hua hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zaid bin Harithah (RA) se farmaya: "Kya tum jaakar mere paas Zainab ko nahi laoge?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To meri anguthi le lo," aap (SAW) ne unhein woh de di, to Zaid (RA) rawaana huay aur apni oontni ko bithaya, woh chupke-chupke tareeqe se aage badhte rahe yahan tak ke unhein aik charwaha mila, unhone poocha: "Tum kiske liye charate ho?" Usne kaha: "Abu Al-Aas ke liye." Unhone poocha: "Aur yeh bakriyaan kiski hain?" Usne kaha: "Zainab bint Muhammad ki." To woh kuch der tak uske sath chalte rahe, phir unhone usse kaha: "Kya tum chaahte ho ke main tumhein kuch dun jo tum unhein de do, aur kisi se iska zikr na karo?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." To unhone use anguthi de di, charwaha wapas gaya, apni bakriyaan ander laayi aur unhein anguthi de di, unhone use pehchaan liya aur poocha: "Yeh tumhein kisne di?" Usne kaha: "Aik shakhs ne." Unhone poocha: "Tumne use kahan chhoda?" Usne kaha: "Fulan jagah par." Unhone kaha: to woh khamosh rahi yahan tak ke raat hui to woh unke paas gayi, jab woh unke paas aayi to unhone kaha: "Meri oontni par mere aage sawaar ho jao." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke tum mere aage sawaar ho jao." To woh sawaar huay aur woh unke peechhe sawaar hui yahan tak ke woh (Madinah) pahunch gayi. Rasulullah (SAW) unke baare mein farmaate: "Woh meri betiyon mein sabse afzal hai, use mere sabab se takleef pahunchi." Yeh baat Ali bin Al-Husain tak pahunchi, to woh Urwah ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Mujhe aapki taraf se aik aisi hadith pahunchi hai jo aap bayan karte hain jismein Fatimah (RA) ke haq mein kami zaahir hoti hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe mashriq aur maghrib ke darmiyan sab kuch mil jaaye aur main Fatimah (RA) ka koi haq kam karoon, yeh mujhe pasand nahi, lekin ab se aap chaahen to main isse kabhi bayan nahi karunga." Urwah ne kaha: aur yeh sirf ayat "{Unhein unke asli baap ke naam se pukaaro, yehi Allah ke nazdeek zyada munsifana hai}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 5) ke nazil hone se pehle ki baat thi.

e: [AI] When Hilal ibn Umayyah threw his wife, it was said to him, "By Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  will whip you with eighty lashes." He said, "Allah is more just than that, to strike me with eighty lashes. He knew that I saw until I became certain, and I heard until I became convinced. No, by Allah, he will never strike me." Then the verse of curse was revealed, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called for both of them when the verse was revealed and he said, "Allah knows that one of you is lying. Is there any repentance from either of you?" Hilal said, "By Allah, I am telling the truth." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Swear by Allah, the One who there is no god but Him, that you are telling the truth." He said that four times, and if he was lying, the curse of Allah would be upon him. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Stop at the fifth time, as it is binding." So, she swore and said it four times, "By Allah, the One who there is no god but Him, he is one of the liars." And if she was telling the truth, then the anger of Allah would be upon her. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Stop at the fifth time, as it is binding." Then she hesitated and was inclined to confess. Then she said, "I do not want to expose my people." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If she comes with it, it should be a black dye that darkens the eyes, with black pupils, thickly outlined, with lashes that curve upwards. Then it is for the one who was accused, Hilal ibn Umayyah. And if she comes with it in yellow color, then it should be cut with spots. Then it is for Hilal ibn Umayyah." So they brought it in the description of rebellion. Ayub said, and Muhammad ibn Sirin said, "The man who informed Hilal ibn Umayyah's wife was Shurayk ibn Sahma, who was the brother of Bara' ibn Malik, the brother of Anas ibn Malik from his mother. His mother was black. And Shurayk used to stay at Hilal's house and be with him."
hi: Jab Hilal bin Umayyah ne apni biwi par (zina ka) ilzaam lagaya, to unse kaha gaya: "Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) tumhein zaroor assi (80) kode maarengay." Unhone kaha: "Allah issse zyada munsif hai ke mujhe assi kode maare, jabke use maloom hai ke maine dekha yahan tak ke yaqeen kar liya, aur suna yahan tak ke pukhta ho gaya, nahi, Allah ki qasam, woh mujhe kabhi nahi maarengay." To li'aan (mutual qasam-khaani) ki ayat nazil hui, jab yeh nazil hui to Rasulullah (SAW) ne dono ko bulaawa diya, farmaya: "Allah jaanta hai ke tum dono mein se aik jhoota hai, to kya tum mein se koi tauba karega?" Hilal ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main sacha hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam khao jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi ke main sacha hoon," yeh chaar martaba kaha, "aur agar main jhoota hoon to mujhpar Allah ki lanat ho." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paanchwi baar unhein rok do, kyunke woh (lanat ko) laazim kar degi." Phir usne bhi qasam khaayi, chaar martaba kaha: "Allah ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, yeh zaroor jhooton mein se hai," "aur agar woh sacha hai to mujhpar Allah ka ghazab ho." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Paanchwi baar unhein rok do, kyunke woh (ghazab ko) laazim kar degi, woh ruk gayi aur iqraar karne ka irada karne lagi," phir usne kaha: "Main apni qaum ko ruswa nahi karungi." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar woh (bachcha) surmai aankhon, gehri kaali aankhon, mote hisson, motay ranon, aur patli pindliyon wala paida ho, to woh us shakhs ka hoga jispar ilzaam lagaya gaya, aur agar woh zard rang, patla, aur seedhe baalon wala paida ho, to woh Hilal bin Umayyah ka hoga." To bachcha usi surat mein paida hua jo napasandeeda batayi gayi thi. Ayyub ne kaha aur Muhammad bin Sireen ne kaha: "Woh shakhs jiska naam usne bataaya - Hilal bin Umayyah - Shareek bin Sahma the, jo Al-Bara' bin Malik ke, Anas bin Malik ke maa-shareek bhai, the, aur unki waalida kaali thin, aur Shareek Hilal ke ghar mein rehte the aur unke paas hi thay."

e: AbuHurayrah heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say when the verse about invoking curses came down: Any woman who brings to her family one who does not belong to it has nothing to do with Allah (i.e. expects no mercy from Allah), and Allah will not bring her into His Paradise. Allah, the Exalted, will veil Himself from any man who disowns his child when he looks at him, and disgrace him in the presence of all creatures, first and last. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2263)
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna jab li'aan ki ayat nazil hui, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat kisi aise (bachche) ko kisi qaum mein le aaye jo unme se nahi hai, to uska Allah se koi taalluq nahi, aur Allah use apni Jannat mein hargiz dakhil nahi karega, aur jo bhi aadmi apne bachche ka inkaar kare jabke woh use dekh raha ho, Allah uspar apna parda kar leta hai aur use awwaleen-o-aakhireen ke saamne ruswa karta hai."

e: “I was a man who had an issue with intercourse with a women that none other than me had. When (the month of) Ramadan entered, I pronounced Zihar upon my wife (to last) until the end of Ramadan, fearing that I might have an encounter with her during the night, and I would continue doing that until daylight came upon me, and I would not be able to stop. One night while she was serving me, something of her became exposed for me, so I rushed myself upon her. When the morning came I went to my people to inform them about what happened to me. I said: ‘Accompany me to the Messenger of Allah to inform him about my case.’ They said: ‘No by Allah! We shall not do that, we feat that something will be revealed about us in the Qur’an, or the Messenger of Allah might say something about us, the disgrace of which will remain upon us. But you do and do whatever you want.’” He said: “So I left and I went to the Messenger of Allah, and informed him of my case. He said: ‘You are the one who did that?” I said: ‘I am the one.’ He said: ‘You are the one who did that?” I said: ‘I am the one.’ He said: ‘You are the one who did that?” I said: ‘I am the one, it is before you, so give me Allah’s judgment, for I shall be patient with that.’ He said: ‘Free a slave.’” He said: “I struck the sides of my neck with me hands, and said: ‘No by the One Who sent you with the Truth! I possess nothing besides it.’ He said: ‘Then fast for two months’ I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah! Did this occur to me other than when I was fasting?’ He said: ‘Then feed sixty poor people.’ I said: ‘By the One Who sent you with the Truth! We have spent these nights of ours hungry without an evening meal.’ He said: ‘Go to the one with the charity from Banu Ruzaiq, tell him to give it to you, then feed a Wasq of it, on your behalf, to sixty poor people. Then help yourself and your dependants with the remainder of it.’” He said: “I returned to my people and said: ‘I found dejection and bad ideas with you, and I found liberalness and blessing with the Messenger of Allah. He ordered me to take your charity, so give it to me.’ So they gave it to me.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3299)
hi: Main aik aisa aadmi tha jise auraton ke maamle mein aisi cheez di gayi thi jo mere siwa kisi aur ko nahi di gayi.
