Jab Ramzan aaya, to maine apni biwi se zihar kar liya, is darr se ke main raat ke kisi hisse mein uske sath (rishta) qaayam karunga aur yeh silsila chalta rahega aur main subah tak khud ko roknay ki taaqat nahi rakhunga. Phir aik raat jab woh meri khidmat kar rahi thin, achanak mujhpar unka kuch hissa khul gaya, to main unpar toot pada. Jab subah hui to main apni qaum ke paas gaya aur unhein apna haal bataaya, maine kaha: "Mere sath Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas chalo." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum tumhare sath nahi jaayenge, humein darr hai ke humare baare mein koi Quran nazil ho jaaye ya Rasulullah (SAW) humare baare mein aisi baat kahein jiski sharmindagi humpar hamesha rahe, tum khud jao aur jo tumhein theek lage karo." To main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein apna haal bataya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum wahi ho?" Maine kaha: "Main hi hoon, isliye Allah ke hukum ke mutabiq faisla dijiye, main sabr karne wala aur ajr chahne wala hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi ghulam ko azaad karo." Maine apne haath se apni gardan ke aik hisse par maara aur kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, iske siwa mere paas kuch aur nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To lagataar do (2) mahine ke roze rakho." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhpar jo museebat aayi woh roze hi ki wajah se to aayi thi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To saath (60) miskeenon ko khaana khilaao." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, humne yeh raat is haal mein guzaari ke humare paas raat ka khaana bhi nahi tha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Banu Zuraiq ke sadqe ke zimmedaar ke paas jao, woh tumhein sadqa de dega, phir usme se saath miskeenon ko aik wasq khilaao, aur baaqi se apne ghar walon ki madad karo." To main apni qaum ke paas aaya aur maine kaha: "Maine tum mein tangi paayi (lekin Rasulullah SAW ke paas fraakh-dili aur barkat paayi)."

e: [AI] Salman ibn Sakhrah Al-Ansari made his wife on him like the back of his mother, then he mentioned the narration in the same way as him, "This is a valid chain according to the conditions of the two scholars, and they did not exclude it" according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Ke Salman bin Sakhr Al-Ansari ne apni biwi ko apne oopar apni maa ki peeth ki manind (zihar) qaraar diya," phir unhone isi jaisi hadith zikr ki. "Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ  while it was apparent that he had engaged in intimacy with his wife. The man confessed, saying, "O Messenger of Allah, I engaged in intimacy with my wife before performing the ritual purification." The Prophet ﷺ  asked, "What led you to do this? May Allah have mercy on you?" The man replied, "I saw her ankle bracelet in the moonlight." The Prophet ﷺ  then advised him, "Do not approach her until you have fulfilled the command of Allah, the Exalted." This hadith is witnessed by Isma'il bin Muslim from 'Amr bin Dinar, and the two prominent scholars, Isma'il bin Muslim and Al-Hakam bin Aban, have never been disputed except that Al-Hakam bin Aban is considered truthful while the authenticity of Isma'il bin Muslim is questioned by Al-'Adani.
hi: Aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jisne apni biwi se zihar kiya tha aur (expiation se pehle) unke sath (rishta) qaayam kar liya tha, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine apni biwi se zihar kiya tha, phir kaffaara ada karne se pehle unke sath (rishta) qaayam kar liya." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein isspar kis cheez ne ubhaara, Allah tum par reham kare?" Usne kaha: "Maine unki paayal chaandni mein dekhi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unke qareeb mat jao jab tak tum woh na karo jo Allah Ta'ala ne hukum diya hai."

e: [AI] A man appeared from his wife and saw her ankle bracelet in the moonlight, which amazed him. He then fell upon her and went to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned it to him. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said [to His angels] before they interacted with one another [sexually], "Hold back until they can be purified."' The man said, "That happened for us." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "Hold back until you are purified."
hi: Aik shakhs ne apni biwi se zihar kiya, phir unki paayal chaandni mein dekhi jo usse pasand aayi, to usne unke sath (rishta) qaayam kar liya, phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein yeh bataaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai: '{Iske pehle ke woh dono aik doosre ko chhuein}' (Surah Al-Mujadilah 3)." Usne kaha: "Woh ho chuka hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ruk jao yahan tak ke tum kaffaara ada karo."

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet (pbuh) saying, "There is no divorce for the one who does not possess and no emancipation for the one who does not possess."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jiska maalik nahi banaa uska talaaq nahi, aur jiska maalik nahi banaa uski azaadi nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no divorce before marriage." Saheeh.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nikah se pehle koi talaaq nahi." Sahih.

e: [AI] "Allah Almighty says, 'O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before having sexual relations with them'" [Surah Al-Ahzab 49]. And He did not say, 'when you divorce believing women and then marry them again.'"
hi: Allah Ta'ala (farmata hai): "{Aye imaan walo, jab tum momin auraton se nikah karo phir unhein talaaq de do}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 49), aur yeh nahi farmaaya: "Jab tum momin auraton ko talaaq do phir unse nikah karo."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "The divorce of a slave woman is two divorces, and the recitation of it is two menstruation periods." Abu Asim said, "So I mentioned it to Muzahir ibn Aslam, and I said to him, 'Tell me as Ibn Jurayj told you.' So Muzahir narrated to me from Al-Qasim, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said, 'The divorce of a slave woman is two divorces, and the recitation of it is two menstruation periods,' just as Muzahir ibn Aslam had narrated it. Sheikhs from the people of Basra have not mentioned it with any criticism. So the hadith is authentic, and no one from our earlier scholars has rejected it, although there is a contradictory narration from Ibn Abbas narrated."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Laundi ki talaaq do (talaaqein) hai, aur uska iddat do haiz hai." Abu Aasim ne kaha: to maine yeh baat Muzahir bin Aslam ko bataayi, maine kaha: "Mujhe waise hi bataao jaise tumne Ibn Jurayj ko bataaya." To Muzahir ne mujhe Al-Qasim se, unhone Aisha (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, yehi hadith bataayi jaise Muzahir bin Aslam ne unhein pehle bataayi thi. Muzahir Basra ke aik buzurg hain, humare pehle ke kisi ustaad ne unhein kisi kami se ta'na nahi diya, isliye hadith sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur Ibn Abbas (RA) se isse mukhaalif hadith bhi riwayat ki gayi hai. Sahih.

e: Abu Hasan, a client of Banu Nawfal asked Ibn Abbas: A slave had a wife who was a slave-girl. He divorced her by two pronouncements. Afterwards both of them were freed. Is it permissible for him to ask her in marriage again? He said: Yes. This is a decision given by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2187)
hi: "Ji haan, Rasulullah (SAW) ne isi tarah faisla diya tha." Isse Ali (RA) ki hadith mukhaalif hai.

e: I asked Ayyub: Do you know anyone who narrates the tradition narrated by Al-Hasan about uttering the words (addressing wife). "Your matter is in your hand"? He replied: No, except something similar transmitted by Qatadah from Kathir, the client of Samurah, from AbuSalamah on the authority of AbuHurayrah from the Prophet ﷺ. Ayyub said: Kathir then came to us; so I asked him (about this matter). He replied: I never narrated it. I mentioned it to Qatadah who said: Yes (he narrated it) but he forgot. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2204)
hi: Maine Ayyub se poocha: "Kya aap kisi aise shakhs ko jaante hain jo Al-Hasan ki is baat ka qaayal ho ke 'tumhara maamla tumhare haath mein hai' (kehna) teen (talaaqein) shumaar hoti hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, siwaye us baat ke jo Qatadah ne humein Kathir - Abdur Rahman bin Samurah ke azaad-kiye-huay - se, unhone Abu Salamah se, unhone Abu Hurairah se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, isi jaisi bataayi." Ayyub ne kaha: to Kathir humare paas aaye, unhone unse poocha, unhone kaha: "Maine yeh kabhi bayan nahi ki." Maine yeh baat Qatadah ko bataayi, unhone kaha: "Haan, lekin woh bhool gaye hain."

e: [AI] That a woman named Thabit ibn Qays divorced him, so the Prophet ﷺ  made her waiting period as her menstrual cycle.
hi: "Thabit bin Qais (RA) ki biwi ne unse khula (alag hone) ka mutaalba kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unki iddat aik haiz muqarrar ki."

e: [AI] That a woman named Thabit ibn Qays divorced him, "so the Prophet ﷺ  made her waiting period be her menstruation."
hi: "Thabit bin Qais (RA) ki biwi ne unse khula ka mutaalba kiya, to Nabi (SAW) ne unki iddat aik haiz muqarrar ki."

e: [AI] To free my slave, I asked the Prophet ﷺ , and he ordered me to free the man before the woman.
hi: ...ke woh do ghulam - mard aur biwi - ko azaad karein, to maine Nabi (SAW) se poocha, "to aap (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh pehle mard ko azaad karein, phir aurat ko."

e: My daughter; she is weaned or about to wean. Rafi' said: My daughter. The Prophet ﷺ said to him: Be seated on a side. And he said to her: Be seated on a side. He then seated the girl between them, and said to them: Call her. The girl inclined to her mother. The Prophet ﷺ said: O Allah! guide her. The daughter then inclined to her father, and he took her. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2244)
hi: ...ke woh Islam qubool kare, to woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Meri beti doodh chhod chuki hai (ya doodh chhodne ke qareeb hai)." Aur Rafi' ne kaha: "Meri beti." To Nabi (SAW) ne Rafi' se farmaya: "Aik taraf baith jao," aur unki biwi se farmaya: "Tum bhi aik taraf baith jao." Unhone kaha: aap (SAW) ne bachi ko dono ke darmiyan bithaya, phir farmaya: "Tum dono ise bulaao." To bachi apni maa ki taraf jhukne lagi, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, ise hidayat de." To woh apne waalid ki taraf jhuk gayi, aur unhone use le liya.

e: [AI] I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ  when a man from the people of Yemen came to him and said, "Indeed, three men from the people of Yemen came to 'Ali, disputing with him regarding a child. They agreed upon a woman in a state of purity, but both of them claimed it was their child." He said to both of them, "Is the child good for this one?" They both said, "No." Then he said to both of them, "Is the child good for this one?" They both said, "No." He repeated this question three times, and they both responded "No" each time. Then he said, "You are partners in disputing. I will decide between you. Whoever agrees, the child belongs to him, and the other party will pay two-thirds of the blood money." So, he decided between them and made it for the one who agreed. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  laughed until his molars were exposed, or he said, "His canines were exposed." The two elderly men agreed not to use the method of Al-Ajlh bin 'Abdullah Al-Kindi and they only had one narration from 'Abdullah bin Buraidah. Three trustworthy narrators also reported that same Hadith. Therefore, this Hadith is authentic and they did not exclude it." This is the authentic narration of this Hadith.
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas baitha tha ke Yemen ke ahl mein se aik shakhs unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Yemen ke teen log Ali (RA) ke paas aik bachche ke maamle mein jhagda lekar aaye, teenon ka aik hi paak-daur mein aik aurat se taalluq tha (jiski wajah se paitrutva ka jhagda tha). Unhone do se kaha: 'Tum dono is bachche ka haq is (teesre) ke liye chhod do.'" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Phir dobara do se kaha: "Tum dono is bachche ka haq is (doosre) ke liye chhod do." Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Phir dobara do se kaha: "Tum dono is bachche ka haq is (pehle) ke liye chhod do." Unhone kaha: "Nahi." To unhone kaha: "Tum sab barabar ke hissedaar aur ikhtilaaf karne wale ho, main tumhare darmiyan qura-andaazi karunga, jiska naam nikle usse bachcha milega aur usspar apne doosre do saathiyon ko diyat ka do-tihaai (hissa) dena hoga." To unhone qura-andaazi ki aur jiska naam nikla usse bachcha de diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) itna hanse ke unke daant zaahir ho gaye - ya kaha: unke dadhi ke daant. Shaykhain ne Al-Ajlah bin Abdullah Al-Kindi se hujjat na lene par ittifaq kiya hai, aur unhone sirf unki aik hadith - Abdullah bin Buraidah se - ko napasand kiya hai, lekin teen bharosemand raawiyon ne unki us hadith ki mutaba'at ki hai, isliye yeh hadith sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: A woman said: Messenger of Allah, my womb is a vessel to this son of mine, my breasts, a water-skin for him, and my lap a guard for him, yet his father has divorced me, and wants to take him away from me. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: You have more right to him as long as you do not marry. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2276)
hi: Aik aurat ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mera yeh beta, mera pait iske liye bartan tha, mera seena iske liye mashk tha, aur meri god iske liye panah-gaah thi, aur uske waalid ne mujhe talaaq de di hai aur mujhse ise chheenna chahte hain." Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Tum ise rakhne ki zyada haqdaar ho jab tak tum shaadi nahi karti."

e: Jabir said “My maternal aunt was divorced by three pronouncements and she went out to cut down fruit from her palm trees. A man met her and forbade her (to go out). So she went to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned it to him. He said “Go out, and cut down fruit from your palm trees for perhaps you may give alms (sadaqah) or do an act of kindness. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2297)
hi: Meri khaala ko teen talaaqein di gayin, to woh apne khajoor ke darakht kaatne nikli, aik aadmi ne unse mula-qaat ki aur unhein mana kiya, to woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhein yeh bataya, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nikalo aur kaato, shayad tum usme se sadqa do ya koi bhalaai karo."

e: "I came to the Prophet and mentioned moving to (join) my family." She told him about her situation. She said: "He allowed me, then, when I turned to leave, he called me back and said: 'Stay with your family until the term prescribed is fulfilled.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3530)
hi: Unke shohar apne kuch mazdooron ki talaash mein nikle, unhein Al-Qadoom ki seemah par qatl kar diya gaya. Hammad ne kaha: aur woh paani ki aik jagah hai. Unhone kaha: to main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhein apna haal bataaya, aur unhein apne bhaiyon ke paas ja kar rehne ki baat bhi bataayi. Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne mujhe ijaazat de di, jab main aage badh gayi to aap (SAW) ne mujhe pukaara aur farmaya: "Apne ghar mein raho yahan tak ke likha hua waqt poora ho jaaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] She heard Furay'ah bint Malik, the sister of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, say: "My husband went out in search of camels for him to graze, and while he was returning, they killed him. They came and informed me of his death while I was in a spacious house belonging to my family. I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'My husband's death was announced to me while I was in a spacious house belonging to my family, and he left no provision or wealth for me. I have no place to live, and if I were to go to my brothers and family, they would treat me kindly and support me in some matters.' He said: 'Stay in the house where you were informed of your husband's death until the appointed time.' So she stayed there for four months and ten nights. Then 'Uthman bin 'Affan sent for her and I went to him and spoke to him, and he took care of her."
hi: Unhone Furay'ah bint Malik, Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ki behen, ko yeh kehte suna: "Mere shohar apne kuch ghulaam dhoondne nikle, unhein Al-Qadoom ki seemah par pakad kar qatl kar diya gaya. Unki maut ki khabar mujhe pahunchi jabke main apne khaandaan ke gharon se kaafi door aik ghar mein thi. To main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur maine kaha: 'Mere shohar ki maut ki khabar mujhe mili hai jabke main apne khaandaan ke gharon se door aik ghar mein hoon, aur unhone mere liye na kharcha chhoda na maal, aur yeh makaan mera nahi hai, agar main apne bhaiyon aur apne khaandaan ke paas chali jaaun to yeh mere kisi kaam mein mujhe zyada aasaani degi.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Chali jaao.' Jab main masjid ya kamre ki taraf nikli, to unhone mujhe bulaawa diya - ya mere liye hukum diya aur mujhe bulaaya gaya - aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Usi ghar mein raho jahan tumhein tumhare shohar ki maut ki khabar mili, yahan tak ke likha hua waqt poora ho jaaye.' Unhone kaha: to maine wahan chaar mahine dus din ki iddat guzaari." Unhone kaha: to Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne mere paas (paighaam) bheja, main unke paas gayi aur unhein yeh bayaan kiya, to unhone isi par amal kiya.

e: [AI] She said: "I have been divorced by a woman who stayed for twenty-three nights, then she became pregnant and came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him. He said to her, 'Get married.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: aik aurat ko talaaq di gayi, woh teis (23) raatein rukein, phir unhone apna bachcha jan diya, phir woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhein yeh bataya, to aap (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Shaadi kar lo."

e: [AI] To Zubayr, O Abu Abdullah, take me back with a divorce", she said, and this was when she found out about the divorce. He said, "What good is it for me to divorce you with a single divorce, then take you back?" She said, "I find myself in need of that." He said, "So he divorced her with a single divorce, then he left and she said to her servant, "Close the doors." So she put a servant girl there. Then Zubayr came and he was given the good news. He said, "The daughter of my father, Mu'ayt, has plotted against me." Then he went out to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and informed him about it, so he made it clear to him."
hi: Zubair (RA) se: "Aye Abu Abdullah, mujhe aik talaaq de kar aaram dijiye." Unhone kaha: aur yeh us waqt tha jab unhein bachche ki peeda shuru hui thi. Unhone kaha: "Isse tumhein kya faida hoga ke main tumhein aik talaaq dun phir tumse rujoo kar loon?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai isse mujhe aaram milega." Unhone kaha: to unhone unhein aik talaaq de di, phir bahar chale gaye, to unhone apni laundi se kaha: "Darwaze band kar do." Unhone kaha: phir unhone aik bacchi ko paida kiya. Unhone kaha: to Zubair (RA) aaye aur unhein khush-khabri di gayi, unhone kaha: "Abu Mu'ayt ki beti ne mere sath chaal chali," phir woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhein yeh bataya, "to aap (SAW) ne unhein unse alag kar diya."

e: "Do not corrupt the Sunnah of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. The waiting period of an Umm Walad is four months and ten (days)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2083)
hi: "Humare Nabi Muhammad (SAW) ki sunnat ko humpar ghair-wazeh mat karo - umm walad (bachche ki maa) ke maamle mein, jab uske aaqa ka inteqaal ho jaaye, to uski iddat chaar mahine dus din hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "While I was sleeping, two men came to me and took me by the arm. They brought me to a rugged mountain and told me to climb. I said, "I cannot." They said, "We will make it easy for you." So, I climbed until I reached the top of the mountain. Then, I heard extremely loud voices. I asked, "What are these voices?" They said, "These are the cries of the people of Hellfire." Then, they took me further and I saw people hanging by their ankles, with their mouths torn and bleeding. I asked, "Who are these people?" They said, "These are the ones who break their fast before it is time." Then, they took me to a group of people who were bloated and disfigured, with the worst smell emanating from them. I asked, "Who are these people?" They said, "These are the adulterers and fornicators." Then, they took me to a group of women whose breasts were being torn apart by snakes. I asked, "What is wrong with these women?" They said, "These are the women who withhold milk from their children." Then, they took me to a place where young boys were playing between two rivers. I asked, "Who are these boys?" They said, "These are the young believers." Then, I was honored with another honor, and I saw three people drinking from a cup of wine. I asked, "Who are these people?" They said, "These are Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, Zaid ibn Harithah, and Abdullah ibn Rawahah." Then, I was honored with another honor, and I saw three more people. I asked, "Who are these people?" They said, "These are Ibrahim, Musa, and Isa (peace be upon them), they are waiting for you."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Main so raha tha ke do aadmi mere paas aaye aur mere bazu pakad kar mujhe aik dushwaar pahaad par le gaye, unhone mujhse kaha: 'Chadho.' Maine kaha: 'Main iski taaqat nahi rakhta.' Unhone kaha: 'Hum ise tumhare liye aasaan kar denge.' To main chadhta gaya yahan tak ke main pahaad ke beech mein pahuncha, achanak mujhe sakht aawazein sunayi din, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaisi aawazein hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh Jahannam walon ki cheekhein hain.' Phir mujhe aage le gaye, achanak wahan kuch log the jo apne takhno ke bal latke huay the, unke munh phaTe huay the aur unse khoon beh raha tha, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh woh log hain jo apna roza uski muddat poori hone se pehle todte hain.' Phir mujhe aage le gaye, achanak wahan aise log the jo sabse zyada phoole huay, sabse buri badbu wale, aur sabse bure manzar wale thay, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh zaani mard aur zaani auraten hain.' Phir mujhe aage le gaye, achanak wahan kuch auraten thin jinke seene saanp kaat rahe the, maine poocha: 'Inhein kya hua hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh woh auraten hain jo apni aulaad se apna doodh rokti hain.' Phir mujhe aage le gaye, achanak wahan kuch larke do nehron ke darmiyan khel rahe the, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh momino ki aulaad hai.' Phir mujhe aur ooncha uthaaya gaya, achanak wahan teen aadmi apni sharaab (Jannat ki khaas nemat) pi rahe the, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh Ja'far bin Abi Talib, Zaid bin Harithah, aur Abdullah bin Rawahah hain.' Phir mujhe aur ooncha uthaaya gaya, achanak wahan teen aur aadmi thay, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Ibrahim, Musa, aur Isa (alaihimus-salam), woh tumhara intezar kar rahe hain.'"

e: [AI] That he refused to breastfeed from her, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was called upon and he spat in it and moistened it with a date and named him Muhammad, and said, "Raise him, for Allah is his provider." So I came to him on the first, second, and third days, and there was an Arab woman asking about Thabit bin Qais, so I said, "What do you want from him? I am Thabit." She said, "I saw in my dream that I was breastfeeding a son for him, whose name is said to be Muhammad." So he said, "I am Thabit, and this is my son Muhammad." He said, "Indeed, his mother's shield gets filled with milk from him."
hi: ...ke woh use apna doodh na pilaaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne use bulaawa diya, aap (SAW) ne uske munh mein apni thook lagaayi, ajwa khajoor se uski tahneek ki, aur uska naam Muhammad rakha, aur farmaya: "Ise le jao, Allah hi uska rizq dene wala hai." To main pehle, doosre, aur teesre din unke paas gayi, achanak Arab ki aik aurat Thabit bin Qais ke baare mein poochti mili, maine kaha: "Tumhein unse kya chahiye? Main hi Thabit hoon." Usne kaha: "Maine apne khwaab mein dekha jaise main unke aik bete ko doodh pila rahi hoon jise Muhammad kaha jaata hai." Unhone kaha: to main Thabit hoon aur yeh mera beta Muhammad hai. Unhone kaha: aur unka seena unke doodh se bhar aaya.

e: Ibn ‘Abbas said “The following verse abrogated the rule of passing her waiting period with her people. A year’s maintenance and residence. She may pass her waiting period now anywhere she wishes. ‘Ata said “If she wishes she can pass her waiting period with the people of her husband and live in the house left by her husband by will. Or she may shift if she wishes according to the pronouncement of Allah the Exalted. But if they leave (the residence) there is no blame on you for what they do. Ata’ said “Then the verses regarding inheritance were revealed. The commandment for living in a house (for one year) was repealed. She may pass her waiting period wherever she wishes. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2301)
hi: Ata ne kaha: "Agar woh chaahe to apne ghar walon ke paas iddat guzaare aur (mrhoom shohar ki) wasiyat mein rahe, aur agar chaahe to nikal jaaye," Allah Ta'ala ke is farmaan ki wajah se: "{To tumpar koi gunah nahi jo woh apne baare mein karein}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 234). Ata ne kaha: "Phir mirath (wirasat) ka hukum aaya aur (aik saal ke) rehne (ke hukum) ko mansookh kar diya, ab woh jahan chaahe iddat guzaar sakti hai."

e: Musaykah, a slave-girl of some Ansari, came and said: My master forces me to commit fornication. Thereupon the following verse was revealed: "But force not your maids to prostitution (when they desire chastity)." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2311)
hi: "Mera maalik mujhe zina karne par majboor karta hai," to isi silsile mein yeh nazil hui: "{Aur apni laundiyon ko zina par majboor mat karo}" (Surah An-Noor 33).

e: "There are three, all of whom have a promise of help from Allah: 'The Mujahid who strives in the cause of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime; the man who gets married, seeking to keep himself chaste; and the slave who has a contract of manumission and wants to buy his freedom.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3120)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (log) hain jinki madad Allah par haq hai: ada karne ka irada rakhne wala mukatib (ghulam jo azaadi ka ahd kar chuka ho), Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wala mujahid, aur paakeezgi chahte huay shaadi karne wala."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever helps a fighter in the cause of Allah, or a warrior, or someone in debt, or a slave paying off his debt, Allah will shade him in His shade on the day when there is no shade except His shade."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein kisi mujahid ki, ya kisi jung karne wale ki, ya kisi mushkil mein pade qarzdaar ki, ya apni azaadi ke liye kisi mukatib ki madad kare, Allah use apne saaye mein saaya dega us din jab uske saaye ke siwa koi saaya nahi hoga."

e: [AI] An Arab man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, teach me something that will enter me into Paradise." He said, "If you shorten your speech, you have already fulfilled the request. Free the captive, help the oppressed, give charity to the poor and extend a hand to one in need." The man said, "Isn't there something more specific?" He said, "Indeed, to free a slave girl, to contribute towards her ransom, to offer a gift to a relative who does not treat you kindly, and to provide sustenance to the hungry. And enjoin what is good and forbid what is evil. And if you cannot endure that, then refrain from speaking anything except what is good."
hi: Aik badu Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe koi aisi cheez sikhaayen jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kare." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumne khutba mukhtasar rakha to sawaal bhi wasee' kar diya - kisi jaan ko azaad karo aur kisi gardan ko chhudaao." Usne poocha: "Kya yeh dono aik hi nahi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi jaan ko azaad karna yeh hai ke tum akele hi uski azaadi ka intezaam karo, aur gardan chhudaana yeh hai ke tum uski qeemat mein madad karo, aur mehfooz rakhi hui atiyaat (charity ke jaanwar), aur zulm karne wale rishtedaar ko bhi fai (maal) dena, aur agar tum yeh na kar sako to bhooke ko khilaao aur pyaase ko pilaao, achhai ka hukum do aur buraai se rok do, aur agar yeh bhi na kar sako, to apni zabaan ko bhalaai ke ilawa har cheez se rok lo."

e: [AI] "To plant five hundred saplings for them, and if they sprout, then I am free, so I went to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him, so he said, 'Plant them and stipulate for them, and when you want to plant, inform me.' So he came and started planting, except for one that I planted with my own hand, and all of them sprouted except for the one."
hi: ...ke woh unke liye paanch sau (500) khajoor ke paudhe lagaaun, agar woh jam jaayen to main azaad hoon. To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein yeh bataya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Lagao aur unke liye shart lagaao, aur jab tum lagana chaaho to mujhe bataana." Aap (SAW) aaye aur khud lagaane lage, siwaye aik ke jo maine apne haath se lagaayi, to sab jam gaye siwaye us aik ke.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever is obligated to pay a debt of one thousand ounces of silver and pays all of it except for ten, he is a slave. And whoever is obligated to pay a debt of one hundred golden coins and pays all of it except for ten silver coins, he is a slave."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis bhi mukatib (ghulam) ka aik hazaar (1000) auqiya ka ahd hua ho, aur usne das (10) auqiya ke siwa sab ada kar diya ho, woh (abhi bhi) ghulam hai, aur jis bhi mukatib ka sau (100) dinar ka ahd hua ho, aur usne das (10) dinar ke siwa sab ada kar diya ho, woh (abhi bhi) ghulam hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that in cases of manslaughter, the punishment should be given according to the amount of blood money paid." Yahya said: 'Ikrimah reported from Ibn Abbas: "The punishment for slaves is applied to him."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mukatib ke maamle mein faisla diya ke agar woh qatl ho jaaye, to uski diyat azaad aadmi ki diyat ke us hisse ke barabar hogi jitna usne ada kiya tha." Yahya ne kaha: Ikrimah ne Ibn Abbas (RA) se riwayat ki: "Usspar ghulam wali hadd (saza) laagu hogi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Mukatabs should be treated according to the amount they have freed themselves with, based on the calculation of a free person, and what they have left to be freed ought to be calculated as that of a slave."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mukatib jitna hissa azaad ho chuka hai usspar azaad aadmi ka hisaab lagaaya jaata hai, aur jitna hissa ghulam reh gaya hai usspar ghulam ka hisaab lagaaya jaata hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "When a slave is given a limit or inherits wealth, he inherits according to the amount that he has been freed, and he is held accountable according to the amount that he has been freed from."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab mukatib ko koi hadd (saza) lage ya usse mirath mile, to woh utni mirath paayega jitna woh azaad ho chuka hai, aur usspar utni hi hadd laagu hogi jitna woh azaad ho chuka hai."

e: [AI] "I drive it in the desert or in the plains," she said. "Who is this?" I said, "I am Nabhan." She then said, "I have left the remaining of your correspondence for my nephew Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Umaiyah. I have helped him with it in his marriage." I said, "No, by Allah, I will never hand it over to him." She said, "If your oath is to enter upon me or to see me, then by Allah, you will never see me. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'If there is anything to be delivered to a messenger, then take precautionary measures against it.'"
hi: Main Al-Baida ya Al-Abwa mein use (jaanwar ko) hanka raha tha, unhone poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Main Nabhan hoon." Unhone kaha: "Maine tumhari baaqi mukatabat (azaadi ki raqam) apne bhatije Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Abi Umayyah ke liye chhod di hai, taake main unhein unki shaadi mein madad kar sakoon." Unhone kaha: to maine kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main woh unhein kabhi nahi doonga." Unhone kaha: "Agar tumhari qasam yeh hai ke tum mere paas aao ya mujhe dekho, to Allah ki qasam, tum mujhe kabhi nahi dekhoge, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: 'Jab mukatib ke paas itna ho ke woh ada kar sake, to us se parda karo (hijab ikhtiyar karo).'"

e: [AI] "He said, 'O Messenger of Allah, a man from the polytheists has surrendered to the Muslim man.' He replied, 'He is more deserving of it in his life and in his death.'"
hi: Ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aik mushrik aadmi kisi Musalman aadmi ke haath par Islam qubool karta hai (uske zariye hidayat paata hai)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh uski zindagi aur maut dono mein uska zyada haqdaar hai."

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about a man who greets another man by shaking hands, so he said, "He is more deserving of his life and death."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se us aadmi ke baare mein poocha jo kisi (doosre) aadmi ke zariye Islam qubool karta hai, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh uski zindagi aur maut ka zyada haqdaar hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I witnessed a boy while with my companions, taking an oath with the leaders of the good-doers, and what makes me happy is that I have the reddish camels and that I will fulfill my oath."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine bachpan mein apne chachaon ke sath 'Hilf-ul-Mutayyabin' (khushbudaar logon ka ahd) dekha tha, aur mujhe yeh pasand nahi ke mere paas surkh oont ho aur main use tod dun."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: There is no alliance in Islam, and Islam strengthened the alliance made during pre-Islamic days. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2925)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Islam mein (naya) hilf (ahd/muaahida) nahi, aur jo bhi hilf jahiliyat mein ho chuka tha, Islam ne use aur mazboot hi kiya hai."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas said, "Ubayy recited to the Prophet ﷺ ." Al-Shafi'i said, "I recited to Ismail ibn Qustantin, and he used to say, 'The Quran is a name, not a proper noun. It was not taken from recitation. If it were taken from recitation, then every recitation would be Quran. However, it is a name for the Quran, like the Torah and the Gospel, they are proper nouns for the scripture, while the Quran is not.'"
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Ubayy (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ke saamne padha." Ash-Shafi'i ne kaha: "Aur maine Ismail bin Qustuntin ke saamne padha, aur woh kaha karte the: 'Quran aik naam hai, aur yeh hamza wala lafz nahi hai, aur na hi yeh "qara'tu" (maine padha) se liya gaya hai, agar yeh "qara'tu" se liya gaya hota to har padhi hui cheez Quran hoti, balke yeh Quran ka khaas naam hai, jaise Taurat aur Injeel, "qara'tu" mein hamza aata hai lekin "Quran" mein hamza nahi aata.'"

e: [AI] An Arab man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Prophet of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "I am not a prophet of Allah, but I am the Messenger of Allah."
hi: Aik badu Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi (hamza ke sath)!" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Allah ka 'Nabi (hamza ke sath)' nahi hoon, balke main Allah ka 'Nabi (bagair hamza ke)' hoon."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu Bakr, Umar, and the Caliphs did not engage in backbiting. However, backbiting is an innovation that emerged after them. I heard Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Shaybani al-Hafiz saying that he heard Abu Zakariya Yahya ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya saying that he heard Ahmad ibn Hanbal saying: 'I do not narrate the hadith of Musa ibn Ubaydah al-Rabathi and the hadith of Abdur Rahman ibn Ziyad al-Afriqi.'"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne, na Abu Bakr (RA) ne, na Umar (RA) ne, na khulafa ne, kabhi hamza nahi lagaaya, balke hamza lagaana aik bid'at (nayi baat) hai jo unke baad logon ne shuru ki." Maine Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Ya'qub Ash-Shaibani Al-Hafiz ko kehte suna, unhone Abu Zakariya Yahya bin Muhammad bin Yahya ko kehte suna, unhone Ahmad bin Hanbal ko kehte suna: "Main Musa bin Ubaidah Ar-Rabazi ki hadith nahi likhta, aur na hi Abdur Rahman bin Ziyad Al-Afriqi ki hadith."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The Qur'an was revealed with distinction, like the appearance of a bird" [Surah Al-Imran 49]. "Excuses, warnings, and the two shells, and behold, to Him belong creation and command" [Surah Al-A'raf 54], and similar to this in the Qur'an. This is an authentic narration and it was not rejected. No, by God, it is not weak. Al-Awfi is weak and Bukair is not an authority, and this hadith is denounced.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran tafkheem (bhaari uchaarna) ke sath nazil hua hai" - "{Parinde ki soorat ki tarah}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 49), "uzran wa nuzran," "sadafain," aur "{Khabardar, khalq aur hukum usi ka hai}" (Surah Al-A'raf 54), aur is jaisi aur misaalein Quran mein. "Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala," "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Al-Awfi apni kamzori ke bawajood, aur Bukair mo'tabar nahi, aur yeh hadith kamzor aur munkir hai."

e: [AI] Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to start his recitation with the verses: 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds. The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Master of the Day of Judgment.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki biwi Umm Salamah (RA) se riwayat hai, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) apni qiraat ko (aayat-aayat karke) todte the: 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen, Ar-Rahmanir-Raheem, Maaliki Yawmid-Deen.'"

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to recite his prayers verse by verse, starting with "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil 'alamin" (Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds) from Surah Al-Fatiha (Chapter 1, Verse 2). Then he would pause and recite "Ar-Rahmanir-Rahim" (The Most Merciful, The Ever-Merciful) from Surah Al-Fatiha (Chapter 1, Verse 1). Then he would pause again. Ibn Abi Mulayka said, "Umm Salamah used to recite it as 'Maliki yawmid-din' (The Master of the Day of Judgment)."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) apni qiraat ko aayat-aayat karke todte the: "{Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 2) phir thehar jaate, "{Ar-Rahmanir-Raheem}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 1) phir thehar jaate. Ibn Abi Mulaikah ne kaha: "Aur Umm Salamah (RA) ise 'Maaliki Yawmid-Deen' padha karti thin."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to recite "The Sovereign of the Day of Recompense".
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) 'Maaliki Yawmid-Deen' padha karte the.

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse: "Guide us to the Straight Path" [Al-Fatiha 6], with the letter "S" (Saad).
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Ihdinas-Siraatal-Mustaqeem}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 6) 'Saad' ke sath padha.

e: [AI] He prayed with the Prophet ﷺ when he said {not the path of those who have received Your anger or those who have gone astray}. He said "Ameen" quietly. The judge said "ghayri" [not] by lowering the sound of the "raa" because in the recitation of the people of Makkah, it is {ghayra} [not].
hi: Ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ke sath namaz padhi jab aap (SAW) ne "{Ghairil-Maghdoobi Alaihim Wa lad-Daalleen}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 7) padha, to aap (SAW) ne 'Ameen' kaha, apni aawaz aahista rakhte huay. Qaazi ne kaha: "{Ghairi}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 7) 'ra' ki zer ke sath, kyunke Makkah walon ki qiraat mein "{Ghaira-l-Maghdoobi Alaihim}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 7) hai.

e: [AI] I came to the Prophet ﷺ  with a companion of mine but we did not find him. Aisha then fed us dates and porridge. Then, the Prophet ﷺ  came, dragging his foot and tying his lower garment. He asked, "Did you feed them anything?" We said, "Yes." He said, "While we were like that, a shepherd came by with a sheep. The Prophet ﷺ  asked him, "Did she give birth?" He said, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ  asked, "What did she deliver?" He replied, "A healthy lamb." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Slaughter a sheep instead of her." Then, he turned to me and said, "Do not think that we slaughtered her only for your sake. We have a hundred sheep, and we do not want them to increase. So, whenever a shepherd is burdened with the sheep, we slaughter a sheep in its place." Ibn Juraij said, "The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Do not think' and did not say, 'Do not assume.'" This was narrated by Sufyan Ath-Thawri from Abu Hashim from Asim bin Laqit, but Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Main aur mera aik saathi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, humein woh nahi mile, to Aisha (RA) ne humein khajoor aur daliya khilaaya. Unhone kaha: to hum zyada der na thehre the ke Nabi (SAW) aaye, chalte huay aur (thakawat se) jhoomte huay, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum dono ko kuch khilaaya gaya?" Humne kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: to hum isi haal mein thay ke charwaha aaya, uske haath mein aik bakri ka bachcha tha, Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya usne bachcha diya?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya?" Usne kaha: "Aik bachhda." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uski jagah aik bakri zibah karo." Phir mujhe mudkar farmaya: "Yeh mat samajhna ke humne isse sirf tumhari wajah se zibah kiya, humare paas sau (100) bakriyaan hain, hum nahi chahte ke woh badhe, isliye jab charwaha (unki tadaad se) bojhil ho to hum uski jagah aik bakri zibah kar dete hain." Ibn Jurayj ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne kaha 'La tahsabanna' aur 'La yahsabanna' nahi kaha. Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne Abu Hashim se, unhone Aasim bin Laqeet se, isi riwayat ke sath naql ki hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "Do not assume (or think) but he did not say, 'do not assume.'"
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne 'La tahsabanna' kaha, aur 'La yahsabanna' nahi kaha.

e: [AI] "From no soul does it accept any intercession, and no compensation can be taken from it" [2:48]. Ubayy ibn Ka'b said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited to me: "No soul will be recompensed for any other, nor will intercession be accepted from it." [2:48] with تَاءْ (ta) and "no compensation can be taken from it" [2:48] with يَاء (ya).
hi: "{Koi jaan kisi doosri jaan ke kisi kaam nahi aayegi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 48) 'ta' ke sath, ('aur na uski koi sifarish qubool ki jayegi aur na uska koi badla liya jayega'). Ubayy (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe "{Laa tajzi nafsun an nafsin shai-a}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 48) 'ta' ke sath padhaya, '(wa laa tuqbalu minha shafa'atun)' 'ta' ke sath, aur "{wa laa yu'khazu minha adl}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 48) 'ya' ke sath.

e: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey when some of his Companions fell behind. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his voice reciting these two Ayat: "O mankind! Have Taqwa of your Lord! Verily the earthquake of the hour is a terrible thing..." up to His saying: but Allah's torment is severe (21:1 & 2)." When his Companions heard that, they hastened to catch up with him, since they knew that he had something to say. He ﷺ said: 'Do you know what Day this is? That is the Day when Adam will be called. His Lord will call him and say: O Adam, send forth those who are to be sent to the Fire. He will say: O Lord! How many are to be sent to the Fire? He will say: From every one-thousand there are nine-hundred and ninety-nine for the Fire and one for Paradise. So the people despaired as if they would not smile again. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw the state of his Companions, he said: 'Strive hard and receive the good news. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad, you will be counted with two creations who are immense in numbers; Ya'juj and Ma'juj, and those who have died among the progeny of Adam and the progeny of Iblis.'" He said: "So some of the people's grief went away, and he ﷺ said: 'Strive hard and receive the good news. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad! Among mankind, you are but like the mole on the flank of a camel, or a mark on the foreleg of a beast.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3169)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik safar mein thay, unke kuch sahaba safar mein peechhe reh gaye the, to aap (SAW) ne in do ayaton ke sath apni aawaz buland ki: "{Aye logo, apne Rab se daro, beshak Qayamat ka jhatka bohot badi cheez hai, jis din tum ise dekhoge, har doodh pilaane wali apne doodh-pite bachche ko bhool jaayegi, aur har haamila apna hamal gira degi, aur tum logon ko nashe mein dekhoge jabke woh nashe mein nahi honge, lekin Allah ka azaab sakht hoga}" (Surah Al-Hajj 2). Jab sahaba ne yeh suna to unhone apni sawaariyon ko tez kiya aur samajh gaye ke aap (SAW) ke paas koi khaas baat hai jo woh kahenge, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai woh kaunsa din hoga?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh din jab Aadam apne Rab ko pukaarenge, to Allah farmayega: 'Aye Aadam, aag ka giroh nikaalo.' Woh poochenge: 'Aye Rab, aag ka giroh kya hai?' Allah farmayega: 'Har hazaar mein se nau sau ninyanwe (999) aag mein, aur aik Jannat mein.'" To sahaba (yeh sun kar) sannaate mein aa gaye aur unke chehron par hansi ki koi jhalak baaqi na rahi, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba ki yeh haalat dekhi, to farmaya: "Jaan lo aur khush-khabri paao, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, tum do aisi makhlooqaton ke sath ho jo jis cheez ke sath bhi rahi hain use hamesha barhaaya hai - Yajooj-Majooj, aur Aadam (AS) ki aulaad mein se jo halaak huay, aur Iblees ki aulaad mein se (jo halaak huay)." To logon ko jo bechaini thi usme se kuch kami aayi, phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jaan lo aur khush-khabri paao, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, tum logon mein aise ho jaise oont ke pehlu mein til, ya jaanwar ke bazu par koi nishaan." Hisham Ad-Dastuwai ki hadith sahih hai, kyunke humare aksar pehle ustaad is baat par muttafiq hain ke Al-Hasan ne Imran bin Husain (RA) se suna hai, aur agar Hisham aur Al-Hakam bin Abdul Malik mein ikhtilaaf ho, to baat Hisham ki maani jaayegi. Al-Hakam bin Abdul Malik kamzor hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited {How can we give life to these bones} [Al-Baqarah 259] with a "Za" sound.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Kaise hum inhein uthaate hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 259) 'zay' ke sath padha.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made me read the verse "It is I who give (all) sustenance, Lord of power, steadfast (for ever). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3993)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe padhaaya: 'Beshak main hi Razzaq (rizq dene wala), Zul-Quwwat, Mateen hoon.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "A man from Banu Sulaim who had some sheep with him, passed by some of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He gave Salam to them and they said: 'He did not give Salam except to protect himself.' So they attacked him, killed him, and took his sheep. They went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with them, and Allah, Most High, revealed: O you who believe! When you go in the cause of Allah, verify and say not to anyone who greets you: "You are not a believer (4:94)." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3030)
hi: Banu Sulaim ka aik shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ke paas se guzra, uske paas kuch bakriyaan thin, usne unhein salaam kiya, unhone kaha: "Isne humein salaam sirf isliye kiya taake hum se bach sake," to unhone uska iraada kiya aur use qatl kar diya aur uski bakriyaan le lin, phir woh unhein lekar Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aye imaan walo, jab tum Allah ki raah mein nikalo to achhi tarah pehchaan lo, aur jo tumhein salaam kare use yeh mat kaho ke tum momin nahi ho}" (Surah An-Nisa 94) unke farmaan tak: "{Isi tarah tum pehle thay, phir Allah ne tumpar ehsaan kiya, isliye achhi tarah pehchaan lo}" (Surah An-Nisa 94).

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited, "And it is not for a prophet to be dishonest" [Quran 3:161] with the vowel kasrah on the letter ya.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Kisi Nabi ke liye jaayaz nahi ke woh khiyanat kare}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 161) 'ya' par zabar (fatha) ke sath padha.

e: [AI] The translation of the Arabic phrase "وَقَالَ أَقْرَأَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَرُهُنٌ مَقْبُوضَةٌ بِغَيْرِ أَلِفٍ»" into English is: "And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Fornication is held with anything other than marriage.'"
hi: Aur unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe padhaaya: 'To rehan (girvi) qabze mein rakha jaaye,' bagair alif ke."

e: [AI] I asked Aisha, the mother of the believers, how the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, used to recite this verse: "And those who give what they give" [Surah Al-Mu'minun 60]. She asked me, which one of them do you love more? I said, "I love one of them more than the red camels." She asked, which one? I said, "Those who give what they give." She said, "This is how I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, recite it."
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Aye Umm-ul-Momineen, Rasulullah (SAW) yeh harf kaise padhte the: '{Aur woh log jo dete hain jo unhone diya}' (Surah Al-Mu'minun 60)?" Unhone poocha: "In dono mein se tumhein kaunsa zyada pasand hai?" Maine kaha: "In dono mein se aik mujhe surkh oonton se bhi zyada aziz hai." Unhone poocha: "Kaunsa?" Maine kaha: "{Woh log jinhein diya jaata hai jo unhone diya}." Unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko isi tarah padhte suna hai."

e: [AI] She heard the Prophet ﷺ  reciting {Blessed be the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor} [Al-Waqi'ah 89].
hi: Ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko "{To (uske liye hai) aaraam aur khushbudaar rizq}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 89) padhte suna.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Huraira reciting this verse: "Indeed, Allah commands you to render trusts to whom they are due and when you judge between people to judge with justice. Excellent is that which Allah instructs you. Indeed, Allah is ever Hearing and Seeing." [Surah An-Nisa 4:58]
hi: Maine Abu Hurairah (RA) ko yeh ayat padhte suna: "{Beshak Allah tumhein hukum deta hai ke amaanatein unke haqdaaron ko wapas karo, aur jab tum logon ke darmiyan faisla karo to insaaf se faisla karo, beshak Allah tumhein kitni achhi naseehat karta hai, beshak Allah sunne wala, dekhne wala hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 58).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, sent to me, saying, "Take your clothes and arms and come to me." So I took my clothes and arms and went to him. I found him sitting, performing ablution. I looked at him intently and then bowed my head. He said, "O Amr, I want to send you on an army that Allah will enrich and grant you security, and I desire for you a righteous desire for wealth." So I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I did not embrace Islam for the sake of wealth, but rather I embraced it out of a desire for Islam and to be with you." He said, "O Amr, how excellent is righteous wealth for the righteous person." It means by opening the "noon" sound and shortening the "ayn." This is a sound hadith according to the conditions of Muslim through the narration of Musa bin Ali bin Rabah and according to the conditions of Bukhari through the narration of Abu Salih. Authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bulaawa bheja: "Apne kapde aur hathiyaar pehen kar mere paas aao." To maine apne kapde aur hathiyaar pehne, phir unke paas aaya, unhein wudu karte huay paaya, unhone meri taraf nazar uthaayi phir neechi ki, phir farmaya: "Aye Amr, main tumhein aik lashkar ka sardaar banaakar bhejna chahta hoon, taake Allah tumhein maal-e-ghaneemat de aur tumhein salaamati de, aur main tumhare liye maal mein se aik achhi khwahish rakhta hoon." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main maal ki khwahish mein Musalman nahi hua, balke main Islam ki khwahish mein aur aapke sath rehne ke liye Musalman hua." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Amr, kitna achha hai neek maal neek aadmi ke liye," ya'ni 'noon' par zabar aur 'ain' par zer ke sath. Yeh hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih hai Musa bin Ali bin Rabah ki riwayat ki wajah se, aur Bukhari ki shart par bhi Abu Salih ki riwayat ki wajah se. Sahih.

e:
[AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to recite the following in Arabic as follows:

"And We ordained for them therein a life for a life, an eye for an eye, a nose for a nose" (Al-Ma'idah 5:45) in the nominative case, "and a tooth for a tooth" (Al-Ma'idah 5:45) in the accusative case.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) "{Aur humne unpar Tauraat mein farz kiya ke jaan ke badle jaan}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 45) 'nasb' (zabar wali halat) ke sath, "{aur aankh ke badle aankh}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 45) 'raf'' (pesh wali halat) ke sath, padhte the.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  recited, "And We ordained for them in that (Torah): A life for a life, an eye for an eye, a nose for a nose, an ear for an ear, a tooth for a tooth, and for wounds is legal retribution." (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:45) "Muhammad bin Mu'awiyah is not among the conditions in this book."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Beshak jaan ke badle jaan, aur aankh ke badle aankh, aur naak ke badle naak, aur kaan ke badle kaan, aur daant ke badle daant, aur zakhmon ka badla barabar hai}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 45) padha. "Muhammad bin Muawiyah is kitaab ki shart par nahi hain."

e: [AI] According to the saying of Allah, exalted be He, "And We tested you with trials." [Quran 20:40] in a hadith that the Prophet ﷺ conveyed, "Two men among those who feared (Allah) said." [Quran 5:23] with the raising of the letter "yaa".
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur humne tumhein aazmaayishon se guzaara}" (Surah Ta-Ha 40) ke baare mein, aik hadith mein jo Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchti hai: "{Do aadmiyon ne kaha jo (Allah se) darte the}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 23) 'ya' par pesh (raf') ke sath.

e: [AI] "When the Surah (chapter) of As-Sajdah (Prostration) was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Every verse in it is found in the scriptures of Ibrahim (Abraham) and Musa (Moses).' When the Surah (chapter) of An-Najm (The Star) was revealed, and by the star when it descends, he reached the verse, 'And Ibrahim (Abraham) who fulfilled (or conveyed) the truth of the vision. Then he (Jibril) revealed to him (Muhammad): And (remember) when Ibrahim (Abraham) said to his father and his people: Verily, I am innocent of what you worship, except Him (i.e., Allah Alone), Who did create me; and verily, He will guide me.' (The Star 53:37), which weighed him down. And he said, 'I convey (the message).' 'That no burdened person (with sins) shall bear the burden (sins) of another. (The Star 53:38) Until His saying, 'This is a warner of the warners of old.' (The Star 53:56)"
hi: Jab "{Apne buland Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh karo}" (Surah Al-A'la) nazil hui, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh sab Ibrahim (AS) aur Musa (AS) ke sahifon mein hai." Jab "{Qasam hai taare ki jab woh doobta hai}" (Surah An-Najm) nazil hui, yahan tak ke "{Aur Ibrahim (AS) jinhone (ahad) poora kiya}" (Surah An-Najm 37) tak pahunche, to unhone ise bhaari (zor se) padha aur 'waffa' kaha, "{Ke koi bojh uthaane wala kisi doosre ka bojh nahi uthaayega}" (Surah An-Najm 38) unke farmaan tak: "{Yeh pehle ke daraane walon mein se aik daraane wala hai}" (Surah An-Najm 56).

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  reciting, "Indeed, My verses have come to you, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers." (Surah Az-Zumar 59)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko "{Kyun nahi, tumhare paas meri aayaten aayin thin, phir tumne unhein jhutlaaya aur takabbur kiya aur kaafiron mein se ho gaye}" (Surah Az-Zumar 59) padhte suna.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ recited, 'Among those who are deserving of the guardianship' [Al-Ma'idah 107]."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Un logon mein se jinke khilaaf haq saabit hua tha (do qareebi rishtedaar)}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 107) padha.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite the verse 'In a fortified city' [Quran 18:86]"
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) "{Aik kaali keechad wale chashme mein}" (Surah Al-Kahf 86) padha karte the.

e: [AI] "Abu Al-Aswad Al-Dili and Jubair bin Hayyah Al-Thaqafi were with Ibn Ziyad. They mentioned this verse, 'Indeed, there has been a division among you' (Quran, Al-An'am 94), until they put their swords down. Aslam bin Zur'ah said, 'I heard Abu Musa reciting this verse, 'Indeed, there has been a division among you' (Quran, Al-An'am 94). One of them said, 'Let the first person who enters between us be the mediator.' Yahya bin Yamar entered and they asked him. Yahya said, 'Indeed, there has been a division among you, which needs to be resolved.' Yahya also said, 'Abu Musa is not deceitful, and I do not accuse him of such.'"
hi: Ibn Ziyad ke paas Abu Al-Aswad Ad-Dili aur Jubair bin Hayyah Ath-Thaqafi baithe thay, unhone kaha: unhone is harf ka zikr kiya: "{Tumhare darmiyan (rishte) toot chuke}" (Surah Al-An'am 94), yahan tak ke unhone shart lagaa di, to Aslam bin Zur'ah ne kaha: "Maine Abu Musa (RA) ko '{Laqad taqatta'a bainakum}' (Surah Al-An'am 94) padhte suna," to unme se aik ne kaha: "Mere aur tumhare darmiyan faisla woh hoga jo pehle humare paas aaye," to Yahya bin Ya'mar humare paas aaye, unhone unse poocha, to Yahya ne kaha: "'Laqad taqatta'u bainakum' raf' ke sath," phir Yahya ne kaha: "Abu Musa (RA) dhoke baaz logon mein se nahi, aur main unpar ilzaam nahi lagaata."

e: [AI] "From the saying of the disciples, 'Can your Lord do it?' [Quran 5:112], or 'Can your Lord do it?' So he said, 'Read to me, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ.' Can you do it with the letter 'ta'?"
hi: Hawariyyon (Isa AS ke sathiyon) ke is kehne ke baare mein: "{Kya tumhare Rab mein taaqat hai}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 112) ya 'kya tum apne Rab se (yeh) kar sakte ho?' To unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe 'Hal tastati'u' ('ta' ke sath) padhaaya."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection Abraham will meet his father Azar whose face will be dark and covered with dust.(The Prophet ﷺ Abraham will say to him): 'Didn't I tell you not to disobey me?' His father will reply: 'Today I will not disobey you.' 'Abraham will say: 'O Lord! You promised me not to disgrace me on the Day of Resurrection; and what will be more disgraceful to me than cursing and dishonoring my father?' Then Allah will say (to him):' 'I have forbidden Paradise for the disbelievers." Then he will be addressed, 'O Abraham! Look! What is underneath your feet?' He will look and there he will see a Dhabh (an animal,) blood-stained, which will be caught by the legs and thrown in the (Hell) Fire." (Using translation from Bukhārī 3350)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ibrahim (AS) apne waalid Azar se Qayamat ke din milenge, Azar ke chehre par gard aur kaalapan hoga, to Ibrahim (AS) unse kahenge: 'Kya maine tumse nahi kaha tha ke meri na-farmani na karo?' Unke waalid kahenge: 'Aaj main teri na-farmani nahi karunga.'" Ibrahim (AS) kahenge: "Aye Rab, tu ne mujhse wada kiya tha ke tu mujhe us din ruswa nahi karega jab log uthaaye jaayenge, to us baap se zyada ruswaai kya hogi jo (mujhse) sabse door hai?" Allah farmayega: "Maine Jannat kaafiron par haraam kar di hai." Phir farmayega: "Aye Ibrahim, tumhare paaon ke neeche kya hai?" Woh dekhenge to achanak khoon-aalooda kuch (jaanwar jaisi cheez) hogi, jise pairon se pakad kar aag mein daal diya jayega.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ read to me "[And let them say: You have studied]" [Al-An'am 105], meaning with the emphasis on the letter "seen" and the case marker "ta".
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe padhaaya: '{Taake woh kahein tumne (yeh) padha hai}' (Surah Al-An'am 105), ya'ni 'seen' ko jazm aur 'ta' ko zabar ke sath."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew a line and drew lines to the right and left of that line. Then he said, "This is the straight path of your Lord, and these are the other paths, upon each of which there is a devil inviting to it." Then he recited, "And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way." [Surah Al-An'am 153]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik lakeer khaeenchi, phir uske dayen taraf aik lakeer aur baayen taraf aik lakeer kheenchi, phir farmaya: "Yeh tumhare Rab ka seedha raasta hai, aur yeh (doosre) raste hain, har raste par aik shaitan hai jo uski taraf bulaata hai," phir yeh padha: "{Aur beshak yeh mera seedha raasta hai, isliye ispar chalo, aur (doosre) raston par mat chalo, warna woh tumhein uski raah se juda kar denge}" (Surah Al-An'am 153).

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  reciting "The doors of heaven will not be opened for them" [Surah Al-A'raf, verse 40], abbreviated.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko "{Unke liye aasman ke darwaze nahi khole jaayenge}" (Surah Al-A'raf 40) halka (mukhaffaf) padhte suna.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  read "Dakka" (a portion) in a softened voice and did not elongate it.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Chknaa-choor}" (Surah Al-A'raf 143) tanween ke sath padha aur ise lamba nahi kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  recited: "Now Allah has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you there is weakness." [Surah At-Tawbah 66] and he raised.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Ab Allah ne tumpar aasaani ki hai aur jaan liya hai ke tum mein kamzori hai}" (Surah Al-Anfal 66) 'raf'' ke sath padha.

e: [AI] The translation of the given text into English is: "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ recited the verse, 'That he may have captives from among them' (Quran 8:67), authentic, authentic."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Ke uske paas qaidi hon}" (Surah Al-Anfal 67) padha. Sahih, sahih.

e: [AI] "He heard Abu Hurairah and Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  gave a sermon while he was on the pulpit and said, 'By the One in whose Hand is my soul,' three times, then he remained silent. Each one of us, men, started to cry sadly on the right side of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Then he said, 'There is no servant who performs the five daily prayers, fasts during Ramadan, and avoids major sins, except that the gates of Paradise will be opened for him on the Day of Resurrection, and they will be wide open.' Then he recited (interpretation of the meaning): 'If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins...' (Quran 4:31)."
hi: Unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) aur Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mimbar par khade hokar humein khutba di, farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai," teen martaba, phir khamosh ho gaye, to humme se har aadmi Rasulullah (SAW) ki qasam ki wajah se ghum se ro pada, phir farmaya: "Koi bhi bandah paanch waqt ki namaz ada kare, Ramzan ke roze rakhe, aur saat kabeera gunahon se bache, magar uske liye Qayamat ke din Jannat ke darwaze khol diye jaate hain, yahan tak ke woh khud-ba-khud khulte hain," phir yeh padha: "{Agar tum un bade gunahon se bacho jinse tumhein mana kiya gaya hai, to hum tumhare (chhote) gunah maaf kar denge}" (Surah An-Nisa 31).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The people of two different religions do not inherit from each other, and a Muslim does not inherit from a disbeliever, nor does a disbeliever inherit from a Muslim." Then he recited the verse, "And those who disbelieve are allies of one another. If you do not do so, there will be fitnah on earth and great corruption" (Quran 8: 73) with a ya.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do alag mazhab ke log aapas mein mirath nahi paate, na koi Musalman kaafir ki mirath paata hai na koi kaafir Musalman ki," phir yeh padha: "{Aur jo log kaafir hain, woh aik doosre ke madadgaar hain, agar tum aisa (mel-jol) na karo to zameen mein fitna aur bohot bada fasaad hoga}" (Surah Al-Anfal 73) 'ya' ke sath.

e: [AI] Narrated by Ibn Abbas and attributed to the Prophet ﷺ, he read out [Surah At-Tawbah 128]: "There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves." This means the greatest among you in rank. Adh-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchayi gayi riwayat mein, unhone "{Tumhare paas tum mein se aik Rasool aa chuka hai}" (Surah At-Tawbah 128) padha, ya'ni 'tum mein se sabse azeem martabe wala.' Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  reciting: "Say, 'In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate.'" [Yunus: 58]
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko "{Kaho: Allah ke fazl aur uski rehmat se, isi par unhein khush hona chahiye, yeh unke jama kiye huay maal se behtar hai}" (Surah Yunus 58) padhte suna.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic text is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to recite, 'Verily, he has done something wrong' with a weak chain of narration."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) 'Innahu amila ghaira saalih' (Beshak usne ghair-saleh amal kiya) padha karte the." Iski sanad mubham (unclear) hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet (pbuh) read, "So ask the women who cut their hands, what happened to them?" [Surah Yusuf 50]. He said, "If they had sent a message to me, I would have hurried to respond, and I wouldn't have sought an excuse."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne "{To unse (Yusuf se) poocho ke un auraton ka kya maamla tha jinhone apne haath kaat liye the}" (Surah Yusuf 50) padha, farmaya: "Agar mujhe bulaawa bheja jaata to main jaldi jawaab deta aur uzr talaash na karta."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say to Ali, "O Ali, people are like various trees, while you and I are from one tree." Then the Messenger of Allah recited, "And gardens of grapevines and crops and date-palms growing side by side and not side by side, all irrigated with the same water."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ali (RA) se farmate suna: "Aye Ali, log alag-alag darakhton se hain, aur main aur tum aik hi darakht se hain," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Aur angooron ke baagh, aur kheti, aur khajoor ke darakht, aik hi jad se aur alag jadon se, sabko aik hi paani se seencha jaata hai}" (Surah Ar-Ra'd 4).

e: [AI] About the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , it is narrated that he said, "And we prefer some foods over others in consumption." [Surah Ar-Ra'd: 4] with the letter "nun."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai: "{Aur hum unme se kuch ko phal mein kuch doosron se behtar banaate hain}" (Surah Ar-Ra'd 4) 'noon' ke sath.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Allah erases whatever He wills and establishes what He wills." [Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:39], abbreviated.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Allah jo chaahe mita deta hai aur jo chaahe qaayam rakhta hai}" (Surah Ar-Ra'd 39) halki (mukhaffaf) padhi.

e: [AI] I heard Sa'd reading "We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten." So I said, "Indeed, Sa'id recites it as 'or cause us to forget it'." He said, "Indeed, the Quran was not revealed to be difficult upon Musayyib or his son." I said, "And it is my understanding that he recited 'We will make you recite, so do not forget' and 'Remember your Lord when you forget'."
hi: Maine Sa'd ko "{Ma nansakh min aayatin aw nansaha}" (Jo bhi ayat hum mansookh karein ya bhula dein) padhte suna, maine kaha: "Sa'eed to ise '{aw nunsiha}' padhte hain." Unhone kaha: "Beshak Quran Musayyib par ya unke bete par (unki khaas pasand ke mutabiq) nazil nahi hua." Unhone kaha: aur mujhe yaad hai ke unhone "{Hum tumhein padhaayenge, phir tum nahi bhulogay}" (Surah Al-A'la 6) aur "{Aur apne Rab ko yaad karo jab tum bhool jaao}" (Surah Al-Kahf 24) padha.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'The Quran was revealed with the embellishment, likening it to the form of a bird' (Surah Al-Imran, 49), 'As an excuse or as a warning' (Surah Al-Mursilat, 6), and 'And the two shells' (Surah Al-A'raf, 54), 'Indeed, to Him belongs the creation and the command' (Surah Al-A'raf, 54), and its similitudes.'"
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran tafkheem (bhaari uchaarna) ke sath nazil hua hai" - "{Parinde ki soorat ki tarah}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 49), "{Uzran aw nuzran}" (Surah Al-Mursalat 6), aur 'sadafain,' "{Khabardar, khalq aur hukum usi ka hai}" (Surah Al-A'raf 54), aur is jaisi aur misaalein.

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ : "When the people of the Hellfire gather in the Hellfire, along with them are some people from the Muslims. They will say, 'What benefit did your Islam bring you while you ended up with us in the Hellfire?' They will reply, 'We had sins for which we were punished.' Allah heard what they said and commanded that those who belong to the Qibla (Muslims) be taken out of the Hellfire. At that point, the disbelievers say, 'If only we were Muslims and were also taken out as they were.' Then the Prophet ﷺ  recited the verse, 'Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the clear Book. Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers' [Quran 15:2-3]."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Jahannam waale Jahannam mein jama honge, aur unke sath ahl-e-qibla (Musalman) mein se jitne Allah chaahe honge, to (kaafir) kahenge: 'Tumhara Islam tumhein kya faida de saka jabke tum humare sath Jahannam mein aa gaye?' Woh kahenge: 'Humare gunah thay isliye humein pakda gaya.' To Allah ne unki yeh baat suni, phir jitne bhi ahl-e-qibla Jahannam mein thay, unhein nikaalne ka hukum diya, unhein nikaal liya gaya, to kaafir kahenge: 'Kaash hum Musalman hote, to hum bhi (yun) nikaale jaate jaise yeh nikaale gaye.'" Aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Alif-Laam-Ra, yeh Kitaab ki aayaten hain, aur wazeh Quran ki, aksar kaafir tamanna karenge ke kaash woh Musalman hote}" (Surah Al-Hijr 1-2) bhaari (mushaqqal) padh kar.

e: that regarding the saying of Allah, Most High: "The Day when We shall call together all human beings with their (respective) Imam (17:71)" the Prophet ﷺ said: "One of you will be called out to be given his record in his right hand, he will be grown in his body to sixty forearm-lengths, his face will be whitened, and a crown of sparkling pearls will be placed upon his head. So he will go to his companions, who can see him from afar, and they will say: 'O Allah! Bring this one to us, and let us be blessed by him.' Until he reaches them, and says to them: 'Receive the good news! For each man among you shall be the likes of this.'" [He ﷺ said:] "As for the disbeliever, then his face shall be blackened, he will be grown in his body to sixty forearm-lengths in the image of Adam, he will given a crown, and his companions will see him and say: 'We seek refuge in Allah from the evil of this one. O Allah! Do not bring this one to us.'" He said: "So when he reaches them, they say: 'O Allah! Take him away' so they will be told: 'May Allah cast you away! Indeed for each man among you is the likes of this.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3136)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jis din hum har giroh ko unke imaam ke sath bulaayenge}" (Surah Al-Isra 71) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unme se aik ko bulaaya jayega, use uski kitaab uske dayen haath mein di jayegi, aur uske jism ko saath (60) haath tak lamba kar diya jayega," farmaya: "aur uska chehra roshan kar diya jayega, aur uske sar par chamakta hua moti ka taaj rakha jayega," farmaya: "to woh apne saathiyon ki taraf jayega," farmaya: to woh use door se dekhenge aur kahenge: "Aye Allah, ise humare paas laa aur ismein hamare liye barkat rakh," yahan tak ke woh unke paas aayega, to kahega: "Khush-khabri paao, tum mein se har aadmi ke liye isi jaisa (inaam) hai." Aur rahi baat kaafir ki, to uska chehra kaala kar diya jayega, aur uske jism ko saath (60) haath tak Aadam (AS) ki soorat mein lamba kar diya jayega, uske saathi use dekhenge aur kahenge: "Hum Allah ki panah maangte hain is se, Aye Allah, ise humare paas mat laa," farmaya: to woh unke paas aayega, to woh kahenge: "Aye Allah, ise peeche kar de," to woh (jawaab dega): "Allah tumhein door kare, tum mein se har aik ke liye isi jaisa (anjaam) hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  stayed in Makkah as a prophet for thirteen years, then the verse "Adkhilni madkhal as-sidqi wa akhrijni makhraja as-sidqi" [Al-Israa 80] was revealed to him with the opening of the Meem, so he migrated.
hi: Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein Nabi ki haisiyat se terah (13) saal thehre, phir unpar yeh nazil hui: "{Mujhe sacchaai ke sath dakhil kar aur sacchaai ke sath nikaal}" (Surah Al-Isra 80) 'meem' par zabar ke sath, to unhone hijrat ki.

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited: "If I ask you anything after this" (Quran 18:76) with raised voice.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Agar main tumse iske baad kisi cheez ke baare mein poochun}" (Surah Al-Kahf 76) do hamzon ke sath padha.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  recited, "If you wish, you could have taken a wage for it" [Surah Al-Kahf 77], abbreviated.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Agar tum chaahte to iska ujrat le lete}" (Surah Al-Kahf 77) halki (mukhaffaf) padhi.

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  used to recite: "And before them was a king who would seize every [good] ship by force."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) padha karte the: "Aur unke aage aik baadshah tha jo har achhi kashti zabardasti le leta tha."

e: from Ubay bin Ka'b that the Prophet ﷺ recited: "Fi 'Ainin Hami'ah" (18:86) (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2934)
hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Aik kaali keechad wale chashme mein}" (Surah Al-Kahf 86) padha.

e: I was sitting behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was riding a donkey while the sun was setting. He asked: Do you know where this sets ? I replied: Allah and his Apostle know best. He said: It sets in a spring of warm water (Hamiyah). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4002)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe sawaar tha, aap (SAW) gadhe par thay, unhone suraj ko doobte huay dekha, to farmaya: "Aye Abu Dharr, yeh kahan doobta hai?" Maine kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh aik garam chashme mein doobta hai," bagair hamza ke.

e: [AI] "I do not know how the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon Him, read 'Aitiyyan' or 'Jithiyyan,' as both are with a dammah."
hi: "Mujhe nahi pata Rasulullah (SAW) ne 'Itiyya' padha ya 'Jithiyya', kyunke dono hi pesh (damma) ke sath hain."

e: [AI] 'Aisha used to send charity to the people of As-Suffah and she would say, "Do not give them from the idle and the lazy, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'They are the successors who will come after them, who have neglected their prayers.'" (Surah Maryam, 19:59)
hi: Aisha (RA) Ahl-e-Suffah ko sadqe mein cheezein bhejti thin aur kehti thin: "Unme se kisi Barbari mard ya Barbari aurat ko mat do, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Yeh woh baad mein aane wale log hain jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {Phir unke baad aisi nasal aayi jinhone namaz zaya ki}' (Surah Maryam 59)."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) recited, "The heavens almost break apart from it" with the letter Ya and Nun, and "And the mountains crumble" with the letter Ta. "That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son. And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should adopt a son" [Maryam 92] is recited, open after open.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Aasman phatne ke qareeb ho jaate hain}" (Surah Maryam 90) 'ya' aur 'noon' ke sath, "{Aur pahaad gir jaate hain}" (Surah Maryam 90) 'ta' ke sath, "{Ke unhone Rahman ke liye beta maana, jabke Rahman ke liye yeh munaasib nahi ke woh beta banaaye}" (Surah Maryam 92) dono lafzon ko zabar ke sath, padha.

e: [AI] A man read Surah Taha, verse 1 to Abdullah, who then recited it back to him but as a broken version. The man said to him, "You should say it as 'miftahatan' (meaning opened)." Abdullah replied, "This is how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited it and this is how Jibreel (Gabriel) revealed it to him."
hi: Aik shakhs ne Abdullah (RA) ke saamne "{Ta-Ha}" (Surah Ta-Ha 1) 'zabar' ke sath padha, to Abdullah (RA) ne unhein "{Ta-Ha}" 'zer' ke sath sikhaaya, us shakhs ne kaha: "Iska matlab to yeh hai: 'apna pair rakho' zabar ke sath." To Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne ise isi tarah padha tha, aur Jibra'il (AS) ne ise isi tarah unpar nazil kiya tha."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say, "The barrier of Yajuj and Majuj will be opened, as Allah, mighty and majestic, has said, 'From every hole they will emerge.' " (Quran 21:96). Ibn Ishaq said in the recitation of Abdullah, "From every grave they will emerge," using the letter "jeem" and "thaa," like His saying, 'From the graves they will emerge.' " (Quran 36:51). And they are the graves.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Yajooj-Majooj ka darwaza khola jayega jaisa Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {Har buland jagah se woh tezi se nikalte hain}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 96). Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: Abdullah (RA) ki qiraat mein 'Har qabar se woh tezi se nikalte hain,' 'jeem' aur 'sa' ke sath, jaise unke farmaan mein: "{Qabron se apne Rab ki taraf tezi se nikalte hain}" (Surah Ya-Sin 51), aur yeh qabrein hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited, "And you will see the people as drunk, while they are not drunk." [Al-Hajj, 2] Al-Bukhari narrated this Hadith from Umar ibn Hafs ibn Ghiyath from his father from Al-A'mash from Abu Salih from Abu Sa'id who said, Allah said, "O Adam, send out the Fire." The Hadith is long and at the end it says, "And you will see the people as drunk, while they are not drunk." [Al-Hajj, 2] And the most authentic of the two Hadiths is the Hadith narrated by Imam Al-Bukhari.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Aur tum logon ko nashe mein dekhoge jabke woh nashe mein nahi hongay}" (Surah Al-Hajj 2) padha. Bukhari ne yeh hadith Umar bin Hafs bin Ghiyath se, unhone apne waalid se, unhone Al-A'mash se, unhone Abu Salih se, unhone Abu Sa'eed se nikaali hai, jismein Allah farmata hai: 'Aye Aadam, aag ka giroh nikaalo,' aur poori hadith, aur uske aakhir mein: "{Aur tum logon ko nashe mein dekhoge jabke woh nashe mein nahi hongay}" (Surah Al-Hajj 2), aur in dono hadithon mein zyada sahih woh hadith hai jise Imam Bukhari ne nikaala hai.

e: “When the Prophet was expelled from Makkah, Abu Bakr said to him: ‘They have driven out their Prophet, verily to Allah we belong and to Him we return. They are surely doomed.’ Then it was revealed: ‘Permission to fight (against disbelievers) is given to those (believers) who are fought against, because they have been wronged; and surely, Allah is able to give them (believers) victory.’ Then I knew that there would be fighting.” Ibn Abbas said: “This is the first Verse that was revealed concerning fighting.” (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3085)
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ko Makkah se nikaala gaya, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Unhone apne Nabi ko nikaal diya, Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon, yeh log zaroor halaak honge," to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Un logon ko jung ki ijaazat di gayi hai jinke khilaaf jung ki jaati hai kyunke unpar zulm hua hai, aur beshak Allah unki madad par zaroor qaadir hai}" (Surah Al-Hajj 39), unhone kaha: "To mujhe pata chal gaya ke ab jung hogi." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur yehi jung ke baare mein sabse pehli nazil hone wali ayat hai."

e: [AI] I asked Aisha, the mother of the believers, how the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) used to recite this verse: "And those who give what they give." She said, "I bear witness that I heard the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) recite it as 'yutoonan'."
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Aye Umm-ul-Momineen, Rasulullah (SAW) yeh harf kaise padhte the: '{Aur woh log jo dete hain jo unhone diya}' (Surah Al-Mu'minun 60)?" Unhone kaha: "Main gawahi deti hoon ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko ise '{Yu'toona}' (dete hain) padhte suna hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to recite, "Is it that you disbelieve in Him Who created the earth in two Days? And do you join equals with Him? That is the Lord of all the worlds." (Surah Al-Fussilat, 41:9). He said, "The polytheists used to reject and turn away from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) "{Ghamand karte huay, raaton ko baaten karte huay, bekaar baatein karte huay}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 67) padha karte the. Unhone kaha: "Mushrikeen raat ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke khilaaf bekaar/bura-bhala kehte the."

e: "And therein they will grimace in displace lips. -He will be grilled by the Fire until his upper lip is folded up reaching the middle of his head, And his bottom lip pains down, until it hits his navel." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2587)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, "{Aur woh usme mun bigaadne wale honge}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 104) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aag unhein bigaad degi, unka oopar wala hoint sikud kar unke sar ke beech tak pahunch jayega, aur unka neechay wala hoint latak kar unki naaf tak pahunch jayega."

e: [AI] "According to the saying of Allah, the Almighty: 'It was not proper for us to take [anyone] as an ally' [Al-Furqan 18] or 'to take [anyone] as a protector' [Al-Furqan 18], I heard the Prophet ﷺ reciting [it] as 'to take [anyone] besides you' [Al-Furqan 18], with the accusative case of the letter 'nun'."
