hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Humein munaasib nahi tha ke hum lein}" (Surah Al-Furqan 18) ya 'natakhidh' ke baare mein, unhone kaha: maine Nabi (SAW) ko "{An nattakhidha min doonika}" (Surah Al-Furqan 18) 'noon' par zabar ke sath padhte suna.

e: [AI] According to the verse of Allah Almighty, "Alif Lam Meem. The Romans have been defeated" [Surah Ar-Rum, 30:2], did it say "Ghalabat" or "Ghulibat"? So the Prophet ﷺ said, "Read it for me, the Messenger of Allah, 'Alif Lam Meem. The Romans have been defeated'" [Surah Ar-Rum, 30:1]. "We did not write these two hadith except with this chain of narrators, except that Muhammad ibn Sa'id Ash-Shami is not from the condition of the book." Muhammad ibn Sa'id is the crucified and perished one, and Bakr ibn Khunays is abandoned.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Alif-Laam-Meem, Room walon ko shikast di gayi}" (Surah Ar-Room 2) 'ghulibat' ya 'ghalabat' ke baare mein, to unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe '{Alif-Laam-Meem, Ghulibat-ir-Room}' (Surah Ar-Room 1-2) padhaaya." "Humne yeh dono hadithein sirf isi sanad ke sath likhi hain, siwaye is ke ke Muhammad bin Sa'eed Ash-Shami is kitaab ki shart par nahi hain." Muhammad bin Sa'eed woh salb kiye gaye (crucified) halaak-shuda shakhs hain, aur Bakr bin Khunais matrook (chhoda hua raawi) hain.

e: [AI] Ibn Umar said, "I recited to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  just as you recited to me, and he corrected me just as I corrected you." Ata' al-Awfi narrated this Hadith, and he did not provide any argument for it. However, Muslim presented a debate with Fudayl ibn Marzooq and did not present a debate with Ata'.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA): "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne isi tarah padha jaise tumne mere saamne padha, to unhone mujhe usi tarah pakda jaise maine tumhein pakda." Isse sirf Atiyyah Al-Awfi ne riwayat kiya hai, aur dono ne unhein hujjat nahi maana, jabke Muslim ne Fudail bin Marzooq ko hujjat maana hai; dono ne Atiyyah ko hujjat nahi maana.

e: [AI] The Prophet peace be upon him recited, "So no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes" (Surah As-Sajdah, verse 17).
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{To koi jaan nahi jaanti jo unke liye chhupaaya gaya hai aankhon ki thandak}" (Surah As-Sajdah 17) padha.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , it is reported that he recited, "And the sea is set alight by a fire" [Al-Lukman 27], and he raised it.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Aur samundar (agar syaahi ho) isse aur bhi madad milti}" (Surah Luqman 27) 'raf'' ke sath padha.

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by Mus'ab ibn Umair while he was dead on his way back from Uhud. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood over him and prayed for him, then he recited this verse {Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah. Of them, some have fulfilled their obligations, and some of them are still waiting, but they have never changed their commitment} [Al-Ahzab 23]. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "I bear witness that these are the martyrs in the sight of Allah on the Day of Judgment. Visit them and send salutations upon them. By the One in whose hand is my soul, no one greets them until the Day of Judgment except that they return the greeting."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab Uhud se wapas laut rahe the, Mus'ab bin Umair ke paas se guzre jo unke raaste mein qatl huay paday the, Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas ruke aur unke liye dua ki, phir yeh ayat padhi: "{Momino mein aise mard hain jinhone Allah se kiya hua wada sach kar dikhaaya, unme se kisi ne apni zimmedari poori kar li, aur kisi ko intezaar hai, aur unhone (apne ahad mein) koi tabdeeli nahi ki}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 23), phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke yeh Allah ke nazdeek Qayamat ke din shuhada hain, isliye inke paas aao aur inki ziyarat karo, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, koi bhi Qayamat tak inhein salaam kare, uska salaam zaroor unhein jawaab diya jayega."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  read, "Indeed, the people of Saba had for their dwelling a sign. This is a copy that we have not written down supremely except by the insistence of Abu al-Abbas, and the two sheikhs did not rely on Ibn al-Baylmani." It is not valid.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Beshak Saba ke liye unke rehne ki jagahon mein (aik nishaani thi)}" (Surah Saba 15) padha. "Yeh nuskha humne sirf Abu Al-Abbas se hi ghaalib tor par likha hai, aur Shaykhain ne Ibn Al-Bailamani ko hujjat nahi maana." Sahih nahi.

e: [AI] That the Prophet of Allah ﷺ  recited, "Their hearts trembled," they said, "What did your Lord say?" [Surah Saba (34:23)].
hi: Ke Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Yahan tak ke jab unke dilon se dahshat door ho jaati hai, woh kehte hain: tumhare Rab ne kya farmaaya?}" (Surah Saba 23) padha.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  recited the verse: "And indeed he led astray numerous among you (O Mankind)" [Surah Ya Sin, verse 62], which is abbreviated. Its narrators are all trustworthy except for Isma'il ibn Rafi', as they did not rely on him.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Aur usne tum mein se bohot saari makhlooq (jibillan) ko gumraah kar diya tha}" (Surah Ya-Sin 62) halki (mukhaffaf) padhi. "Iske raawi sab bharosemand hain siwaye Ismail bin Rafi' ke, kyunke dono ne unhein hujjat nahi maana." Iski sanad mein Ismail bin Rafi' halaak-shuda hain.

e: When this surah was revealed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: ʿVerily, you (O Muhammad is) will die, and verily, they (too) will die. Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be disputing before your Lord” (az-Zumar [39:30,31]), az-Zubair said: “O Messenger of Allah, will we face again the disputes we had among us in this world in addition to other sins?” He said: “Yes, you will face these disputes again until everyone who has a right has been given his right.” AzZubair said: “By Allah, the matter is very serious.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1434)
hi: Jab "{Beshak tum bhi marne wale ho aur woh bhi marne wale hain, phir tum sab Qayamat ke din apne Rab ke huzoor mein jhagdo ge}" (Surah Az-Zumar 30-31) nazil hui, to Zubair (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya duniya mein humare darmiyan jo hua woh humpar dobara dohraaya jayega, khaas gunahon ke sath?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, yeh unpar dohraaya jayega yahan tak ke har haqdaar ko uska haq de diya jaaye." To Zubair (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh to bohot sakht baat hai."

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reciting: 'Say: "O My slaves who have transgressed against themselves! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, verily, Allah forgives all sins and I do not mind (referring to 39:53)." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3237)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko yeh padhte suna: "{Kaho: Aye mere bando jinhone apni jaanon par zulm kiya hai, Allah ki rehmat se mayoos mat ho, beshak Allah sare gunah maaf kar deta hai aur usse koi farq nahi padta}" (Surah Az-Zumar 53).

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made me read the verse "It is I who give (all) sustenance, Lord of power, steadfast (for ever). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3993)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe padhaaya: 'Beshak main hi Razzaq (rizq dene wala), Zul-Quwwat, Mateen hoon.'"

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  recited, "Indeed, those who have believed and whose descendants have followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants [in Paradise]" [Surah At-Tur: 21].
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Jo log imaan laaye aur unki aulaad ne imaan mein unki pairavi ki, hum unki aulaad ko unke sath (Jannat mein) mila denge}" (Surah At-Tur 21) padha.

e: [AI] I read to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "So is there any reminder for whoever wills to remember? (54:55) He replied, "So is there any reminder?" (54:15) with the letter 'daal'.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne "{To kya koi naseehat lene wala hai}" 'dhaal' ke sath padha, to Nabi (SAW) ne "{Fahal min muddakir}" (Surah Al-Qamar 15) 'daal' ke sath (durust) padha.

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  recited, "Reclining on green cushions and beautiful carpets." [Surah Ar-Rahman, verse 76]
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Hare gaddon aur khoobsurat qaleenon par takiya lagaaye huay}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 76) padha.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  recited, "Then drink from it [i.e., the spring of Tasneem]." [Surah Al-Waqi'ah, verse 55].
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Phir tum piyoge jaise pyaase oont peete hain}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 55) padha.

e: [AI] She was with her daughter, the daughter of Al-'Ajma', during the days of Hajj. Budayl ibn Warqa' came to them riding the mount of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and called out that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever is fasting should break his fast, for these are the days of eating and drinking." This hadith is not part of the collection of this book.
hi: Ke woh apni beti, Al-Ajma ki beti, ke sath Hajj ke dinon mein Mina mein thin, unhone kaha: to unke paas Budail bin Warqa Rasulullah (SAW) ki sawaari par unka saaman lekar aaye, aur aalaan kiya ke Rasulullah (SAW) farmaate hain: "Jo roze se ho woh iftaar kar le, kyunke yeh khaane-peene ke din hain." Yeh hadith is kitaab ke mazmoon mein shaamil nahi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to recite "It is [present in] fragrant plants and cold water" [Al-Waqi'ah 89].
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "{To (uske liye hai) aaraam aur khushbudaar rizq}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 89) padha karte the.

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  read, so divorce them before their waiting period ['iddat]. "A Muslim has reported this narration at length from Ibn Juraij from Ibn Zubair that he heard Abdur Rahman ibn Aiman asking about Abdullah ibn Umar regarding a man who divorced his wife while she was menstruating, and I presume he mentioned this wording." Muslim reported the narration longer than this.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{To unhein unki (durust) iddat ke shuru mein talaaq do}" padha. "Muslim ne yeh hadith Ibn Jurayj se, unhone Ibn Az-Zubair se, unhone Abdur Rahman bin Aiman se, jinhone Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se aik aise aadmi ke baare mein poocha jisne apni biwi ko haiz ki halat mein talaaq di thi, tafseel ke sath nikaali hai, aur mera khayal hai unhone yehi lafz zikr kiye." Muslim ne yeh hadith isse zyada tafseel ke sath nikaali hai.

e: [AI] "I was holding the hand of Al-A'mash and Yusuf As-Samti on the other side, so I asked him about the saying of Allah Almighty: 'And the blowers of falsehood [i.e., the angels]'" (Surah Al-Muddaththir, 74:25). He said, "Did you come to know about that?" Then he said, "I recited the Quran to Yahya ibn Waththab thirty times, and Yahya recited it to 'Alqamah, and 'Alqamah recited it to Abdullah. Abdullah recited it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , saying: 'And reject [all] the deniers' (with a kasrah on the ra')."
hi: Main Al-A'mash ka haath thaame huay tha aur Yusuf As-Samti doosri taraf thay, unhone unse Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur 'Rujz'}" (Surah Al-Muddaththir 5) ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Tumne yeh (mushkil sawaal) uthaaya hai," phir unhone kaha: "Maine Quran Yahya bin Wattab ke saamne teen (30) martaba padha, aur Yahya ne Alqamah ke saamne padha, aur Alqamah ne Abdullah (RA) ke saamne padha, aur Abdullah (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne '{Aur Rijz se door raho}' 'ra' par zer ke sath padha."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  reciting "And avoid the unclean idolatrous women" [Surah Al-Muddathir, verse 5] with the pronunciation of "r" as emphasized and he said, "They are the idols."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko "{Aur Rijz se door raho}" (Surah Al-Muddaththir 5) 'ra' par pesh ke sath padhte suna, aur farmaya: "Yeh but hain."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was talking about the period of revelation. He said, "So I said, 'Keep me company,' but they covered me up. Then Allah the Almighty revealed the verse {O you wrapped in garments} [Al-Muddathir 2]. Arise and warn, and your Lord glorify, and your clothing purify, and uncleanliness avoid." He said, "They are the idols."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko wahi ke waqfe ke baare mein bataate suna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To maine kaha: 'Mujhe lapet do,' to unhone mujhe chaadar odha di, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: {Aye chaadar odhne wale} (Surah Al-Muddaththir 1), khade ho jao aur daraao, aur apne Rab ki buzurgi bayan karo, aur apne kapde paak rakho, aur Rijz se door raho," farmaya: "Yeh but hain."

e: [AI] We were with the Prophet ﷺ  in a cave when the verse "By those [angels] sent forth with a clear animating word" (Quran, Surah Al-Mursalat, verse 1) was revealed. I memorized it immediately. And indeed, his mouth was wet with it so I do not know with which of these verses he sealed it: "So in what statement after it will they believe?" (Quran, Surah Al-Mursalat, verse 50) or "And when it is said to them, 'Bow [in prayer],' they do not bow." (Quran, Surah Al-Mursalat, verse 48)
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke sath aik ghaar mein thay, to "{Qasam hai bhejo gayi (hawaao) ki jo lagataar bheji jaati hain}" (Surah Al-Mursalat 1) nazil hui, to maine ise unke munh se seekha, aur unka munh usse taaza (geela) tha, mujhe nahi pata woh kis ayat par khatam huay - "{To iske baad kis baat par woh imaan layenge}" (Surah Al-Mursalat 50) ya "{Aur jab unse kaha jaaye ke ruku karo, to woh ruku nahi karte}" (Surah Al-Mursalat 48).

e: the Prophet said: “You will be gathered barefoot, naked and uncircumcised.” “A woman said: “Will we see” or “look at each other’s nakedness?” He said: “O so-and-so! Every man among them on that Day will have enough to make him careless of others.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3332)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum nange paanv, nange badan, aur bagair khatna kiye huay ikhattha kiye jaogay." To unki biwi ne poocha: "Kya hum aik doosre ki sharm-gaah ko dekhenge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye fulani, {Us din har aadmi ka apna maamla hoga jo use (doosron se) be-parwaah kar dega}" (Surah Abasa 37).

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he used to recite and what he was revealed with certainty, with clarity.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke baare mein, ke aap (SAW) "{Aur woh ghaib (ke ilm) ke baare mein kanjoos nahi hain}" 'za' ke sath padha karte the.

e: [AI] The translation of the given text is: "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, used to recite, 'So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up for Allah's worship. And to your Lord direct [your] longing.'"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) padha karte the:" "{Jisne tumhein banaaya, phir tumhein durust kiya}" (Surah Al-Infitar 7) 'bhaari (mushaqqal)' padhte huay.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recite: "Yes, certainly my signs have come to you, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were of the disbelievers." [Al-Zumar 59]
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko "{Kyun nahi, tumhare paas meri aayaten aayin thin, phir tumne unhein jhutlaaya aur takabbur kiya aur kaafiron mein se ho gaye}" (Surah Az-Zumar 59) padhte suna.

e:
[AI] "Yes, by Allah, you do not know that between the fat of their ear and their shoulder, there is a distance of seventy autumns, in which flow valleys of pus and blood." 
So I said, "Rivers?"
He said, "No, rather valleys."
hi: "Haan, Allah ki qasam, tumhein nahi pata ke unke kaan ki lo aur unke kandhe ke darmiyan sattar (70) saal ki masaafat hai, jismein peep aur khoon ki wadiyaan behti hain." Maine poocha: "Nehrein?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke wadiyaan." Sahih.

e: [AI] Abu Bakr and Uthman, the sons of Abu Shaybah, narrated from Abu Usamah, who narrated from Umar ibn Muhammad, who narrated from Zaid bin Aslam, who narrated from his father, who narrated from Abu Hurairah, who narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that he asked Jibril (Gabriel) about the following verse: "And the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth will fall dead, except whom Allah wills" [Quran 39:68]. He (Jibril) said, "They are the martyrs of Allah Almighty."
hi: Abu Bakr aur Uthman, Abi Shaybah ke bete, ne humein bataya, unhone Abu Usamah se, unhone Umar bin Muhammad se, unhone Zaid bin Aslam se, unhone apne waalid se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat ki ke unhone Jibra'il (AS) se is ayat ke baare mein poocha: "{Aur soor phoonka jayega, to jo aasmano mein hain aur jo zameen mein hain sab behosh ho jaayenge, siwaye un logon ke jinhein Allah chaahe}" (Surah Az-Zumar 68). (Aap (SAW) ne poocha:) "Woh kaun log hain jinhein Allah behosh nahi karna chahta?" Unhone (Jibra'il AS) kaha: "Woh Allah ke shuhada hain."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "No one can be better in their goodness to a Muslim or a non-Muslim except that Allah will reward them." We asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the reward for goodness to a non-Muslim?" He said, "If that person maintains family ties, gives in charity, or performs good deeds, then Allah will reward them with wealth, children, good health, and similar things." We asked, "What is their reward in the Hereafter?" He said, "Punishment less severe than the severe punishment." And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse, "Enter the family of Pharaoh in the worst of punishment" [Quran 40:46]. This is how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi Musalman ya kaafir kisi ke sath bhalaai nahi karta magar Allah use badla deta hai." Humne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah kaafir ko kaise badla deta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar usne sila-rahmi ki ho, ya sadqa diya ho, ya koi nek amal kiya ho, to Allah use maal, aulaad, sehat, aur is jaisi cheezon se nawaazta hai." Humne poocha: "Aakhirat mein uska badla kya hoga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sakht azaab se kam azaab." Aap (SAW) ne "{Firaun ke logon ko sakht azaab mein daakhil karo}" (Surah Ghafir 46) padha - isi tarah Rasulullah (SAW) ne "alif" ko kaatkar padha.

e: [AI] "O Muhammad, are you better or Abdullah?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  remained silent, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Have you completed?" He replied, "Yes." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Ha, Meem. A revelation from the Most Merciful, the Most Gracious. Until it reached, 'But if they turn away, then say, I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt that struck 'Ad and Thamud.'" Then 'Utbah said to him, "Is this enough for you, is this enough for you without anything else?" He replied, "No." So 'Utbah returned to the Quraysh and they said, "What is behind you?" He said, "I have not left anything. I see that you are talking to him, and I have spoken to him." They said, "Did he respond to you?" He said, "Yes, by the One who erected it with His Prophet, I did not understand anything from what he said, except that he warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt that struck 'Ad and Thamud." They said, "Woe to you! A man speaks to you in Arabic and you do not know what he said?" He said, "No, by Allah, I did not understand anything from what he said, except for mentioning the thunderbolt."
hi: "Aye Muhammad, tum behtar ho ya Abdullah (tumhare waalid)?" To Rasulullah (SAW) khamosh rahe, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Kya tum faarigh ho gaye?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne kaha: "Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, {Ha-Meem, yeh (Kitaab) Rahman, Raheem ki taraf se nazil ki gayi hai}" (Surah Fussilat 1-2) yahan tak ke pahunche: "{Phir agar woh mun mode to kaho: main tumhein aik kadakti bijli se daraata hoon jaisi Aad aur Thamud par giri thi}" (Surah Fussilat 13). To Utbah ne unse kaha: "Bas, bas, kya iske ilawa tumhare paas aur kuch nahi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." To Utbah Quraish ki taraf wapas laut aaya, unhone poocha: "Tumhare peechhe kya hua?" Usne kaha: "Maine koi baat nahi chhodi jo mera khayaal tha tum unse kahoge, siwaye is ke ke maine unse keh di." Unhone poocha: "To kya unhone tumhein jawaab diya?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan, us Zaat ki qasam jisne isse apne Nabi ke zariye khada kiya, main jo kuch unhone kaha usme se kuch nahi samjha, siwaye is ke ke unhone tumhein aik bijli se daraaya jaisi Aad aur Thamud par giri thi." Unhone kaha: "Afsos tumpar, aik shakhs tumse Arabi mein baat karta hai aur tumhein pata nahi woh kya keh raha?" Usne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, maine jo kuch usne kaha usme se bijli ke zikr ke ilawa kuch nahi samjha."

e: [AI] Concerning the Prophet, peace be upon him, {And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour,} [Az-Zukhruf 43:61]. He said, "The descent of Jesus will occur before the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, "{Aur beshak yeh Qayamat ki (aik) nishaani hai}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 61) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isa (AS) ka nuzool Qayamat ke din se pehle."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  used to say three takbirs (saying Allahu Akbar) when he would embark on his ride during travel. Then he would recite the following verse: 'Glory be to the One who has made this subservient to us, for we could not have controlled it ourselves, and surely to our Lord we are to return.' (Surah Az-Zukhruf, verse 14)"
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) jab safar karte aur apni sawaari par sawaar hote to teen martaba takbeer kehte, phir kehte: "{Paak hai woh Zaat jisne isse humare kaabu mein kiya, warna hum ise kaabu mein nahi kar sakte the, aur beshak hum apne Rab ki taraf laut kar jaane wale hain}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 14).

e: Verily Allah created the universe and when He had finished that, ties of relationship came forward and said This is the place for him who seeks refuge from severing (of blood-relationship). He said: Yes. Are you not satisfied that I should keep relationship with one who joins your ties of relationship and sever it with one who severs your (ties of relationship)? They (the ties of blood) said: Certainly so. Thereupon He said: Well, that is how things are for you. Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said: Recite if you like:" But if you turn away you are sure to make mischief in the land and cut off the ties of kinship. Those it is whom Allah has cursed, so He has made them deaf and blinded their eyes. Do they not reflect on the Qur'an? Or, are there locks on their hearts?". (Using translation from Muslim 2554)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai ke Allah ne makhlooq ko paida kiya, jab woh unse faarigh hua to Rahim (rishtedaari) khadi hui aur kehne lagi: "Yeh us shakhs ka maqaam hai jo tujhse (rishton ki) toot-phoot se panah maangta hai." Allah ne farmaya: "Ji haan, kya tum is baat par raazi nahi ke main us shakhs se jode jo tumhein jode, aur us shakhs se todon jo tumhein tode?" Usne kaha: "Kyun nahi." Allah ne farmaya: "To yeh tumhare liye hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne phir farmaya: "Agar tum chaaho to padho: {To kya agar tum (imaan se) mun mod lo to tumse yeh ummeed hai ke tum zameen mein fasaad phailaao aur apni rishtedaari torr do}" (Surah Muhammad 22) unke farmaan tak: "{Ya unke dilon par taale lage huay hain}" (Surah Muhammad 24).

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet (pbuh) recite, "So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth?" [Surah Muhammad, 22]. Al-Dhahabi remained silent on this summarization.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko "{To kya agar tum (imaan se) mun mod lo to tumse yeh ummeed hai ke tum zameen mein fasaad phailaao}" (Surah Muhammad 22) padhte suna. Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited, "So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder. You are not over them a controller." [Al-Ghashiyah 22] "Except whoever turns away and disbelieves" [Al-Ghashiyah 23].
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{To naseehat karo, tum sirf naseehat karne wale ho, tum unpar zabardasti karne wale nahi ho}" (Surah Al-Ghashiyah 21-22) 'saad' ke sath, "{Siwaye us shakhs ke jo mun mode aur kufr kare}" (Surah Al-Ghashiyah 23) padha.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  used to recite 'no, rather they do not honor the orphan, and they do not encourage the feeding of the poor' and he would pronounce 'ya' in all of these words."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) "{Hargiz nahi, balke woh yateem ki izzat nahi karte, aur miskeen ko khaana khilaane ki taraf aik doosre ko nahi ubhaarte, aur (mirath ka maal) khaate hain, aur (maal se) mohabbat karte hain}" sab 'ya' ke sath padha karte the.

e: [AI] "Abu Qilabah narrated from someone whom the Prophet ﷺ  had recited the verse: 'So on that Day, no one will punish [as severely] as His punishment, and no one will bind [as severely] as His binding' [Surah Al-Fajr, 26], the binding of no one."
hi: Abu Qilabah se, aik aise shakhs se jinhein Nabi (SAW) ne padhaaya tha: "{To us din uski (jaisi) saza koi nahi dega, aur uska (jaisa) bandhna koi nahi bandhega}" (Surah Al-Fajr 25-26).

e: [AI] I heard Anas ibn Malik saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by a hole and he said, "If adversity comes and he enters this hole, goodness would also come and enter upon him, and take him out." Then Allah, the Most High, revealed, "Verily, with hardship, there is relief. Verily, with hardship, there is relief." [Surah Al-Inshirah 6].
hi: Maine Anas bin Malik (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne aik gadha (chhota gaddha) tha, unhone farmaya: "Agar mushkil aaye aur is gadhe mein dakhil ho jaaye, to aasaani zaroor aayegi aur ismein dakhil ho kar isse nikaal degi." Unhone kaha: to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{To beshak mushkil ke sath aasaani hai, beshak mushkil ke sath aasaani hai}" (Surah Ash-Sharh 5-6).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to Ubayy, "Indeed, I will recite a Surah to you." Ubayy then asked him, "Were you commanded to do so by Allah?" He replied, "Yes." So he recited the verse, "{Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from disbelief] until there came to them clear evidence - a Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures}" (Surah Al-Bayyinah, verse 2).
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne Ubayy (RA) se farmaya: "Main tumhein aik Surah padhaaunga." Ubayy (RA) ne unse kaha: "Kya aapko iska hukum diya gaya hai, mere waalid aap par qurbaan?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan." To aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Ahl-e-Kitaab aur mushrikeen mein se jo log kaafir huay, woh (apne kufr se) alag honay wale na thay jab tak unke paas khuli daleel na aa jaaye - Allah ki taraf se aik Rasool jo paak sahifay padhta hai}" (Surah Al-Bayyinah 1-2).

e: “The Messenger of Allah recited this Ayah: ‘That Day it will declare its information.’ He said: “Do you know what its information is?” They said: “Allah and His Messenger know better.” He said: “That it testifies about what every male or female slave (of Allah) did upon its surface. It says: ‘He did this and that on this day.’ This is its information.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3353)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Us din woh (zameen) apni khabrein bataayegi}" (Surah Az-Zalzalah 4), farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai uski khabrein kya hongi?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To uski khabrein yeh hongi ke woh har banda aur bandi ke baare mein gawahi degi jo unhone uski peeth par kiya, woh kahegi: usne fulan din fulan kaam kiya, to yehi hain uski khabrein."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ read, "He thinks that his wealth has made him eternal" with the pronunciation of the letter "seen" being broken.
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Woh samajhta hai ke uska maal usse hamesha rakhega}" 'seen' par zer ke sath padha.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ recite, "For the protection of Quraysh - Their protection [during] the caravan of winter and summer" [Quraysh 2].
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko "{Quraish ke mel-jol ki khaatir, unke sardi aur garmi ke safar mein mel-jol ki khaatir}" (Surah Quraish 1-2) padhte suna.

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  recited, "Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar." [Surah al-Kawthar, verse 1].
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne "{Beshak humne tumhein Al-Kausar ata kiya}" (Surah Al-Kawthar 1) padha.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform Witr and recite: ‘Glorify the Name of your Lord the Most High.’, [Al-A’la (87)] ‘Say: O you disbelievers!” [Al-Kafirun (109)] and ‘Say: Allah is One.”. [Al-Ikhlas (112)] (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1171)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Witr mein 'Sabbihisma Rabbik-al-A'la,' 'Qul Ya Ayyuhal-Kaafiroon,' aur 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad' padha karte the."

e: [AI] "When this Surah (chapter) was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited it when the victory of Allah and the conquest had come. He recited it until he finished it, then he said, 'My companions and I are in a state of readiness, and the people are in a state of readiness. There will be no migration after the conquest.'"
hi: Jab yeh Surah nazil hui: "{Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aa jaaye}" (Surah An-Nasr 1), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne ise poori padhi yahan tak ke khatam kar di, phir farmaya: "Main aur mere sahaba aik giroh hain, aur (baaqi) log aik doosra giroh hain, fatah ke baad koi hijrat nahi."

e:
[AI] "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds." (Surah Al-Fatiha 1:2)

So, I said to my father, "Sa'eed informed you that Ibn Abbas said, 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful' is a verse." He replied, "Yes."
hi: "{Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 1-2), maine apne waalid se kaha: "Sa'eed ne aapko bataya tha ke Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' aik (mustaqil) ayat hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Shall I not teach you a surah that has not been revealed in the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, or the Criterion, like it?". I said, "Yes". He said, "I hope that you will not leave through this door until you have learned it." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up and I stood up with him, and he would speak to me while I would have my hand in his hand. I was hesitant to leave before he informed me about it, out of dislike for doing so. When I approached the door, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the surah that you promised me?" He said, "How will you recite it when you stand for the prayer?" So I recited Al-Fatiha, and he said, "It is it, and it is the seven oft-repeated and the glorious Qur'an that I have been given."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein aik aisi Surah na sikhaaun jaisi na Tauraat mein nazil hui, na Injeel mein, na Zaboor mein, na Furqan (Quran) mein?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe ummeed hai ke tum us darwaze se bahar nahi jaogay jab tak tumhein woh pata na chal jaaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay aur main unke sath khada hua, aap (SAW) mujhse baatein karte rahe aur mera haath unke haath mein tha, main jaan-boojh kar dheere chalne laga is darr se ke woh mujhe bataaye bagair bahar chale jaayen, jab main darwaze ke qareeb pahuncha to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh Surah jiska aapne wada kiya tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum namaz ke liye khade hote waqt kya padhte ho?" To maine Fatihat-ul-Kitaab padhi, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wahi hai, wahi hai, yehi hai Sab'-ul-Mathaani (saat baar-baar padhi jaane wali aayaten) aur Quran-e-Azeem jo mujhe diya gaya hai."

e: [AI] About the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, similar to him according to a Muslim condition.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se isi jaisi riwayat hai.

e: [AI] In His saying (praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds) [Al-Fatiha 2], He said: "The jinn and mankind."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-Aalameen}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jinn aur insaan."

e: [AI] "And from some of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , (the Angel of) Maliki Yaumid-Din said: 'It is the Day of Judgment.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaba se, "{Maaliki Yawmid-Deen}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 4) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh hisaab ka din hai."

e: [AI] From Abdullah in his statement "The Straight Path" [Surah Al-Fatiha, verse 6], he said, "It is the book of Allah."
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{As-Siraat-al-Mustaqeem}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Allah ki Kitaab hai."

e: [AI] "The Straight Path" [Al-Fatihah 6] "It is Islam, and it is the widest span between the heavens and the earth."
hi: "{As-Siraat-al-Mustaqeem}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 6) "Yeh Islam hai, aur yeh aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan sabse wasee' (kushaada) cheez hai."

e: [AI] "He is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his companions," I said. We mentioned this to Hassan, and he said, "By Allah, he is truthful and sincere. He is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Abu Bakr and Umar."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{As-Siraat-al-Mustaqeem}" (Surah Al-Fatiha 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke do saathi hain." Unhone kaha: to humne yeh baat Al-Hasan ko bataayi, unhone kaha: "Unhone sach kaha, Allah ki qasam, aur achhi naseehat ki, Allah ki qasam, yeh Rasulullah (SAW), Abu Bakr (RA), aur Umar (RA) hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "In Surah Al-Baqarah, there is a verse that is the leader of the Quran. It should not be recited in a house where there is a Shaytan, except that the verse of Al-Kursi will cause the Shaytan to leave." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Surah Al-Baqarah mein aik ayat hai jo Quran ki tamam aayaton ki sardaar hai, woh kisi aise ghar mein nahi padhi jaati jismein shaitan ho magar woh usse nikal jaata hai - Ayat-ul-Kursi." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, everything has a summit. And the summit of the Quran is Surah Al-Baqarah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har cheez ka aik kohaan (buland hissa) hota hai, aur Quran ka kohaan Surah Al-Baqarah hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I have been given Surah Al-Baqarah from the beginning of the remembrance."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe Surah Al-Baqarah pehle zikr (aasmaani sahifon) mein se di gayi hai."

e: [AI] Read Surah Al-Baqarah in your homes, for indeed Satan does not enter a house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited.
hi: "Apne gharon mein Surah Al-Baqarah padho, kyunke shaitan us ghar mein dakhil nahi hota jismein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi jaati hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The chief of the verses of the Quran is the Verse of the Throne."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ki aayaton ki sardaar Ayat-ul-Kursi hai."

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah wrote in a book two thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, and He sent down two Ayat from it to end Surat Al-Baqarah with. If they are recited for three nights in a home, no Shaitan shall come near it." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2882)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne aasman-o-zameen paida karne se do hazaar (2000) saal pehle aik kitaab likhi, aur usme se do aayaten nazil kin jin par Surah Al-Baqarah khatam hoti hai, agar yeh do aayaten kisi ghar mein teen raaton tak padhi jaayen, to shaitan uske qareeb nahi aata."

e: [AI] "This is the book" [Surah Al-Baqarah 2]. {Alif Lam Meem} [Surah Al-Baqarah 1] is an abbreviation for the name of Allah, and {Al-Kitab} [Surah Al-Baqarah 2] refers to the Quran. {There is no doubt in it} [Surah Al-Baqarah 2] It is undoubtedly true.
hi: "{Alif-Laam-Meem, Yeh Kitaab hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 1-2), unhone kaha: "{Alif-Laam-Meem}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 1) Allah ke naam ka harf hai, aur "{Al-Kitaab}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2) Quran hai, "{Ismein koi shak nahi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2) ismein koi shubha nahi.

e: [AI] They mentioned in the presence of Abdullah, the companions of Muhammad ﷺ  and their faith. Abdullah said, "Indeed, the matter of Muhammad was clear to anyone who saw him, and there is no god but Him. A believer who believes in the unseen is better than belief in the unseen. Then he recited, 'Alif, Lam, Meem. This is the Book in which there is no doubt.' (Quran, Al-Baqarah, 2) until His saying, 'They believe in the unseen.' (Quran, Al-Baqarah, 3)
hi: Abdullah (RA) ke saamne Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba aur unke imaan ka zikr hua, to Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Muhammad (SAW) ka maamla us shakhs ke liye saaf zaahir tha jisne unhein dekha, aur us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, kisi momin ne ghaib par imaan laane se behtar imaan nahi laaya," phir unhone padha: "{Alif-Laam-Meem, Yeh Kitaab hai, ismein koi shak nahi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 1-2) unke farmaan tak: "{Jo ghaib par imaan laate hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 3).

e: [AI] "Indeed, the stones that Allah mentioned in the Quran, their fuel is mankind. And the stones are stones made of petrified sulfur, created by Allah the Almighty as He willed and in the way He willed."
hi: "Beshak woh pathar jinka Allah ne Quran mein zikr kiya hai ke unka indhan (fuel) log hain, woh gandhak (kibrit) ke pathar hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne apne paas jaise chaaha ya jis tarah chaaha paida kiya."

e: [AI] Allah indeed expelled Adam from Paradise before anyone entered it. Allah, the Most High, said: "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a Khalifa." They said: "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds Blood?" [Quran 2:30] And indeed, before he [Adam] was created, there were already jinn made of smokeless fire. They caused corruption on the earth and shed blood. So when Allah, the Most High, said: "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a Khalifa." They said: "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds Blood?" [Quran 2:30], they meant the jinn, the sons of jinn. So when they caused corruption on the earth, Allah sent armies of angels upon them and fought them until they drove them to islands in the seas. Then the angels said: "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein?" [Quran 2:30], just as those jinn, the sons of jinn, did? So Allah said: "Indeed, I know that which you do not know." [Quran 2:30].
hi: Allah ne Aadam ko Jannat se nikaal diya isse pehle ke koi usme dakhil ho. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Main zameen mein aik khalifa banaane wala hoon,} unhone (farishton ne) kaha: {kya tu ismein aise ko banaayega jo ismein fasaad phailaaye aur khoon bahaaye?}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 30). Aur ismein Aadam ke paida honay se do hazaar (2000) saal pehle jinnaat - jaan ki aulaad - rehte thay, unhone zameen mein fasaad phailaaya aur khoon bahaaya, jab Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Main zameen mein aik khalifa banaane wala hoon,} unhone kaha: {kya tu ismein aise ko banaayega jo ismein fasaad phailaaye aur khoon bahaaye?}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 30), unki muraad jinnaat - jaan ki aulaad - se thi. Jab unhone zameen mein fasaad phailaaya, to Allah ne unpar farishton ki fauj bheji, unhone unhein maara yahan tak ke unhein samundari jazeeron mein pahuncha diya. Farishton ne kaha: "{Kya tu ismein aise ko banaayega jo ismein fasaad phailaaye}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 30) jaise un jinnaat - jaan ki aulaad - ne kiya tha? Allah ne farmaya: "{Beshak main woh jaanta hoon jo tum nahi jaante}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 30).

e: [AI] When Allah finished creating Adam and breathed the soul into him, Adam sneezed and said, "Alhamdulillah." So his Lord said to him, "May your Lord have mercy on you."
hi: Jab Allah Aadam ko banaane se faarigh hua aur unme rooh daali, to unhein chheenk aayi, unhone kaha: "Alhamdulillah." To unke Rab ne unse farmaya: "Tera Rab tujhpar reham kare."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ  it is narrated that he said, "Allah created Adam from the whole of the Earth, so his offspring came forth according to that. Among them are those who are white, black, brown, and red. And among them are those who are in between that. And among them are those who are good and those who are wicked."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne Aadam ko poori zameen ki mitti se paida kiya, isliye unki aulaad usi ke mutabiq nikli - unme safed, kaale, gehun-rang, aur surkh rang wale hain, aur unme darmiyaan wale bhi hain, aur unme aasaan-mizaaj, bad-akhlaaq, aur nek log bhi hain."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Indeed, Adam was a tall man, as if he were a date palm tree, with a lot of hair on his head. When he committed the sin, his nakedness was exposed to him, and he did not see it before that. So he went running in Paradise, and a tree clung to him. He said to it, 'Send me away.' It said, 'I am not under your command.' Then his Lord called him, 'O Adam, are you fleeing from Me?' He said, 'O Lord, I am ashamed of You.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadam (AS) aik lambe qad ke aadmi thay, jaise koi buland khajoor ka darakht, sar ke baal ghane thay, jab unhone khata ki to unki sharm-gaah unpar zaahir ho gayi, jabke isse pehle woh use nahi dekhte the, to woh Jannat mein bhaagne lage, aik darakht ne unhein pakad liya, unhone usse kaha: 'Mujhe chhod do,' usne kaha: 'Main tumhein nahi chhodungi.' Unhone kaha: unke Rab ne unhein pukaara: 'Aye Aadam, kya tum mujhse bhaag rahe ho?' Unhone kaha: 'Aye Rab, mujhe teri sharm aa rahi hai.'"

e: [AI] A man asked, "O Messenger of Allah, how many prophets were there before Adam?" He ﷺ  replied, "Yes, Adam was a prophet, a learned one and a speaker." The man asked, "How many generations were there between Adam and Noah?" He replied, "Ten generations." The man asked, "And how many generations were there between Noah and Ibrahim (Abraham)?" He replied, "Ten generations." They asked, "O Messenger of Allah, how many prophets were there in total?" He replied, "Three hundred and fifteen great ones."
hi: Aik shakhs ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya Aadam Nabi thay?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, sikhaaye gaye, baat-cheet kiye gaye." Usne poocha: "Unke aur Nuh (AS) ke darmiyan kitna faasla tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Das (10) qarn (nasal/daur)." Usne poocha: "Nuh (AS) aur Ibrahim (AS) ke darmiyan kitna faasla tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Das (10) qarn." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Rusul (Rasool) kitne thay?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen sau pandrah (315), aik bade giroh ke barabar."

e: [AI] They sought forgiveness, but they said a wrong thing and entered upon their inclinations. That is the saying of Allah, exalted is He, "[So He changed those who did wrong with a calamity as they did not listen to the advice that was said to them.]" [Al-Baqarah 2:59]
hi: "Maghfirah (bakhshish maango)" (kaha gaya tha), to unhone "hintah" (gehun) kaha aur apne peechhon ke bal (be-adabi se) dakhil huay, to yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{To jinhone zulm kiya unhone us baat ki jagah doosri baat badal di jo unse kahi gayi thi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 59).

e: [AI] How do you ask about something while you have the Book of Allah, which contains the latest news from Allah? Allah has informed you that they have written a book with their own hands, distorted and changed it, and they claim that it is from Allah. And they have sold it for a small price. But the Book of Allah is pure and has not been altered. By Allah, none of them will ask you about what has been revealed to you.
hi: "Tum kisi cheez ke baare mein (Ahl-e-Kitaab se) kyun poochte ho jabke tumhare paas Allah ki Kitaab hai jo Allah ki sabse taaza khabar hai, aur usne tumhein bata diya hai ke unhone apne haathon se kitaab likhi, use badla aur tahreef ki, aur kaha ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai, aur ismein thodi si qeemat kamayi, to tumhare paas to Allah ki khaalis Kitaab hai jismein koi milaawat nahi hui, Allah ki qasam, unme se koi bhi tumse woh nahi poochega jo tum par nazil hua hai."

e:
[AI] The Jews of Khaybar used to fight against the tribe of Ghatafan. And every time they clashed, the Jews of Khaybar would be defeated. So, the Jews sought help from Allah with this supplication: "O Allah, we ask You by the right of Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet whom You promised to send in the end of times, to grant us victory over them." Then, whenever they met the enemy, they would make this supplication and would defeat the tribe of Ghatafan.

But when the Prophet ﷺ  was sent, they disbelieved in him. So Allah revealed the verse: "But they used to seek victory over the disbelievers before, [for the sake] of Muhammad." (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:89).

The necessity led to the expulsion of the Prophet ﷺ  from their interpretation of this verse, although it is a strange interpretation from his hadith. There is no need for that, as Abdullah (ibn Abbas) said: it is canceled and has no effect on the Prophet ﷺ .
hi: Khaybar ke Yahoodi Ghatafan se jung karte the, jab bhi woh aamne-saamne hote to Khaybar ke Yahoodi shikast kha jaate, to Yahoodiyon ne is dua ki panah li: "Aye Allah, hum tujhse Muhammad, Nabi-e-Ummi, ke haq ka waasta dete hain jinka tu ne humse wada kiya hai ke tu unhein aakhri zamane mein humare liye nikaalega, hamare khilaaf humein madad de." Unhone kaha: to jab bhi woh aamne-saamne hote yeh dua karte, to Ghatafan ko shikast dete. Jab Nabi (SAW) ko bheja gaya to unhone unka inkaar kiya, to Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur isse pehle woh (isi) ke zariye kaafiron par fatah maangte the}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 89) - Aye Muhammad, tumhare (naam se). "Isse tafseer mein zikr karne ki zaroorat padi hai, aur yeh unki hadith se ajeeb hai, isme koi zaroorat nahi thi ke ise nikaala jaaye, kyunke Abdullah matrook (chhoda hua raawi), halaak-shuda hain."

e: [AI] "The Jews" {and among those who associate partners with Allah} [Al-Baqarah 96], "The non-Arabs" said, "The two scholars agreed on the chain of narration of the interpretation of the companion, and this chain is authentic according to their criteria, and they did not exclude it" according to the criteria of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Yahoodi." "{Aur un logon mein se jinhone shirk kiya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 96), unhone kaha: "Ajami (ghair-Arab) log." "Shaykhain ne sahabi ki tafseer ki sanad par ittifaq kiya hai, aur yeh sanad unki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] From Ibn Abbas concerning His statement, exalted is He, "with an increase of words"
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan ke baare mein, kuch izaafi alfaaz ke sath.

e: [AI] "They are the people of the Book." "And among those who associate partners with Allah, one of them wishes that if he could live a thousand years, he would not be freed from the torment. And Allah is seeing of what they do." [Al-Baqarah 96] He said, this is the statement of one of them to his companion. He sent joy and fragrance festival.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur tum unhein zindagi ka sabse zyada haris paaogay}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 96) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Ahl-e-Kitaab hain." "{Aur un logon mein se jinhone shirk kiya, unme se koi chahta hai ke use hazaar (1000) saal ki umar mil jaaye, jabke itni lambi umar bhi use azaab se door nahi kar sakti}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 96), unhone kaha: "Yeh unme se aik ka apne saathi se kehna hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "My ministers from the heavens are Gabriel and Mika'il, and from the people of the Earth are Abu Bakr and 'Umar."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere do waziron (madadgaaron) mein se aasman waale Jibra'il (AS) aur Mika'il (AS) hain, aur zameen waale Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I have two ministers from the people of the sky and two ministers from the people of the earth. As for my ministers from the people of the sky, they are Jibril (Gabriel) and Mikail (Michael). And as for my ministers from the people of the earth, they are Abu Bakr and Umar. Narrated by Abu Ubaid Al-Qasim ibn Salam, from Abu Muawiyah, from Atiya, with another wording."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere do wazir aasman waalon mein se hain aur do wazir zameen waalon mein se hain, rahi baat mere aasman waale waziron ki, to woh Jibra'il (AS) aur Mika'il (AS) hain, aur rahi baat mere zameen waale waziron ki, to woh Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) hain." Isse Abu Ubaid Al-Qasim bin Sallam ne, Abu Muawiyah se, unhone Atiyyah se, doosre alfaaz ke sath riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  mentioned the companion of images and said, "Jibril (Gabriel) is on his right and Mika'il (Michael) is on his left." Abu 'Ubaid said, "They are two angels that are mentioned frequently in the Hadith." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Soor (trumpet) waale farishte ka zikr kiya aur farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS) unke dayen aur Mika'il (AS) unke baayen hain." Abu Ubaid ne kaha: "Dono naam hadith mein hamza ke sath (aate) hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Gabriel is on his right side and Michael is on his left side, and he is the companion of the images." Dahabi did not provide a summary for this.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS) unke dayen aur Mika'il (AS) unke baayen hain, aur woh Soor waale hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "What you say does not affect us, even if we knew, we would not marry his wives nor divide his inheritance." Then he said, "I will tell you about it. Indeed, the devils used to listen stealthily, and one of them would bring me a true statement that he had heard. But then he would mix it with seventy lies, which the people would believe. So, Allah revealed this to Sulaiman bin Dawud, and he took it and buried it beneath the throne. When Sulaiman died, a devil appeared on the path and said, 'Shall I guide you to a treasure of Sulaiman that no one has a treasure like?' They said, 'Yes.' So, he brought it out, but it was just magic. The nations then followed it, and its remnants are still spoken of by the people of Iraq. So, Allah revealed an excuse for Sulaiman and said, 'And follow what the devils recited during the reign of Sulaiman. It was not Sulaiman who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved' [Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 102]."
hi: "Tum kya keh rahe ho, Allah tumhare baap ko rakhe? Agar humein yeh pata hota to na hum unki (Sulaiman ki) auraton se shaadi karte na unki mirath taqseem karte." Phir unhone kaha: "Main tumhein iske baare mein bataata hoon: Shayateen chori-chupke (aasman ki) baat sunte the, aur unme se koi haq ki koi baat le aata jo logon ne bhi suni hoti, phir uske sath sattar (70) jhoot mila deta, to yeh log dilon mein bas jaata. Allah ne yeh baat Sulaiman bin Dawud (AS) ko batayi, to unhone woh (baaten) le kar Kursi ke neeche dafan kar diin. Jab Sulaiman (AS) ka inteqaal hua, to aik shaitan raaste mein khada hua aur kehne laga: 'Kya main tumhein Sulaiman ke khazane ki taraf raahnumaai na karoon jaisa koi khazana kisi ke paas nahi?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan,' to unhone use nikaala, to woh jaadu tha, to Ummaton ne isse aage badhaaya, aur iski baaqiyaat Iraq walon mein charcha ka mauzu hain. To Allah ne Sulaiman (AS) ki safaai nazil ki aur farmaya: '{Aur unhone us cheez ki pairavi ki jo shayateen Sulaiman ki hukumat mein padhte the, aur Sulaiman ne kufr nahi kiya, balke shayateen ne kufr kiya}' (Surah Al-Baqarah 102) ayat."

e: [AI] I heard Ali informing the people.
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko logon ko bataate suna.

Humein Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Ya'qub Al-Hafiz ne bataya, humein Ibrahim bin Abdullah At-Tamimi ne bataya, humein Yazid bin Harun ne bataya, humein Sulaiman At-Taimi ne bataya, unhone Abu Uthman se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, unhone kaha: "Zuhrah (Venus) apni qaum mein aik aurat thi jinhein Baydakh kaha jaata tha." Al-Hakim ne kaha: "Dono sanadein Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hain, aur in do hadithon ko nikaalne ka maqsad Harut aur Marut ka zikr karna hai, aur woh faisla jo pehle unke aur Zuhrah ke baare mein Allah ki taraf se ho chuka tha." Sahih.

e: [AI] "{Wherever you turn, there is the face of Allah}" [Al-Baqarah 115]. "That you pray wherever your mount faces in voluntary prayer."
hi: "{To jis taraf bhi tum mun karo, wahi Allah ka rukh hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 115) nazil hui - "ke tum nafl namaz mein jis taraf bhi tumhari sawaari ka rukh ho, wahin namaz padho."

e: [AI] "In the saying of Allah Almighty, 'Those to whom We have given the book recite it with true recitation.' [Al-Baqarah 121] He said, 'They make permissible what is permissible and prohibit what is prohibited, and they do not distort it from its rightful place.'"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jinhein humne Kitaab di hai woh isse haq tilawat ke sath padhte hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 121) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh iske halaal ko halaal maante hain aur iske haraam ko haraam maante hain, aur ise uski jagahon se badalte nahi."

e: [AI] Regarding the saying of Ibn Abbas in regard to the statement of Allah the Almighty, "And [mention] when Abraham was tried by his Lord with commands" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:124).
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jab Ibrahim (AS) ko unke Rab ne kuch baaton se aazmaaya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 124) ke baare mein.

e: [AI] "Allah has commanded His Prophet ﷺ  to purify my house for the pilgrims, those who perform 'Itikaf (seclusion for worship), and those who perform the bowing and prostration. So, Tawaf (circumambulation) is performed before the prayer. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Tawaf around the House is like prayer, except that Allah has permitted speech during it. Therefore, whoever speaks should only do so with goodness.'
hi: Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) se farmaya: "Mera ghar tawaf karne walon, aitikaaf karne walon, aur ruku-sajda karne walon ke liye paak rakho," to tawaf namaz se pehle hai, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Baitullah ka tawaf namaz ki manind hai, siwaye is ke ke Allah ne ismein baat karna jaayez rakha hai, to jo baat kare use sirf achhi baat karni chahiye."

e: [AI] "Allah, the Almighty, said to His Prophet ﷺ, 'Purify My House for those who perform Tawaf, those who stay and worship, and those who bow and prostrate.' Therefore, performing Tawaf before Salah is following half of the narration, and the second half of the narration is from the hadith of Al-Qasim ibn Abi Ayub, which Al-Dhahabi omitted in his summarization."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (SAW) se farmaya: "Mera ghar tawaf karne walon, aitikaaf karne walon, aur ruku-sajda karne walon ke liye paak rakho," to tawaf namaz se pehle hai. Yeh mazmoon ke aadhe hisse ki mutaba'at karta hai, aur doosra aadha hissa Al-Qasim bin Abi Ayyub ki hadith se hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Circumambulating the House is a form of prayer, except that Allah allows speech during it. So whoever speaks during it should only speak of good." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Baitullah ka tawaf namaz hai, siwaye is ke ke Allah ne ismein baat karna jaayez rakha hai, to jo ismein baat kare use sirf achhi baat karni chahiye." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Ibrahim, the beloved of the Most Merciful, came from Armenia with tranquility as a guide for him to the location of the House, just as the spider takes its home. Then Ibrahim dug beneath the tranquility and revealed the foundations of what moves the foundation, except for thirty men. He said, "Then he said..." (The phrase "فقال" is incomplete and cannot be translated without further context)
hi: Ibrahim (AS), Rahman ke khaleel (dost), Armenia se aaye, unke sath Sakinah (khaas sakoon/hidayat) thi jo unhein us jagah ki taraf raahnumaai karti thi jahan ghar (Ka'bah) tha, jaise makdi apne ghar ka pata lagaati hai, phir Ibrahim (AS) ne Sakinah ke neeche khudaai ki, to bunyaadein zaahir hui jinhein teis (30) se kam aadmi bhi hila nahi sakte the. Unhone kaha: phir unhone kaha... (aage ka jumla nateeja tak nahi pahuncha).

e: [AI] The first thing that was abrogated from the Quran regarding the mention of the matter of the Qibla, Allah said, "{To Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the face of Allah.}" (Al-Baqarah 2:115). So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  turned towards the direction of Bait al-Maqdis (Jerusalem) and left the Ancient House (Kaaba), and then Allah, the Exalted, said, "{The foolish among the people will say, 'What has turned them away from their qiblah, which they used to face?'}" (Al-Baqarah 2:142). They meant Bait al-Maqdis, so Allah abrogated it and directed it to the Ancient House, and Allah, the Exalted, said, "{And from wherever you go out [for prayer], turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram. And wherever you [believers] may be, turn your faces toward it}" (Al-Baqarah 2:150).
hi: Humein jo bataaya gaya usme se sabse pehla mansookh hone wala hukum qiblah ka maamla tha. Allah ne farmaya: "{Aur mashriq aur maghrib Allah ke hi hain, isliye jis taraf bhi tum mun karo wahi Allah ka rukh hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 115), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf mun karke namaz padhi aur purane ghar (Ka'bah) ko chhod diya, to Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Jaldi hi kuch nasamajh log kahenge: 'Kis cheez ne unhein unke usse qiblah se pher diya jispar woh thay?'}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 142) - unki muraad Baitul-Maqdis se thi - to isne isse mansookh kar diya aur Allah ne ise purane ghar ki taraf mod diya, to Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur tum jahan se bhi nikalo, apna mun Masjid-e-Haram ki taraf karo, aur tum jahan bhi ho, apne mun uski taraf karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 150).

e: [AI] "I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  at a funeral in Bani Salamah, and I was walking beside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . A man said, 'Indeed, a person is good if we do not know whether he is chaste or a Muslim.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Are you the one saying that?' He replied, 'O Messenger of Allah, it seems that way to us, and Allah knows best about secrets.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, it is necessary.' And we were with him at the funeral of a man from Banu Harithah or Banu Abd al-Ashhal, and a man said, 'What a bad person he is if we do not know whether he uses harsh language or not.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Are you the one saying that?' He replied, 'O Messenger of Allah, Allah knows best about secrets. As for what is apparent to us, that is it.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, it is necessary.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited, 'And thus we have made you a just community that you will be witnesses over the people and the Messenger will be a witness over you.' [Quran 2:143]"
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Banu Salamah mein humare aik janaze mein tha, aur main Rasulullah (SAW) ke pehlu mein chal raha tha, to aik shakhs ne kaha: "Kitna achha shakhs tha, hum jaante the ke woh paakdaman aur Musalman tha, agar aisa tha." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum hi yeh keh rahe ho?" Usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yehi humein zaahir tha, aur Allah baatin ka behtar jaanne wala hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wajib ho gayi." Unhone kaha: aur hum unke sath Banu Harithah ya Banu Abdul-Ashhal ke aik shakhs ke janaze mein thay, to aik shakhs ne kaha: "Kitna bura shakhs tha, hum jaante the ke woh sakht-mizaaj aur ganwaar tha, agar aisa tha." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum hi yeh keh rahe ho?" Usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah baatin ka behtar jaanne wala hai, rahi baat jo humein zaahir hui, to woh yehi hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wajib ho gayi." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Aur isi tarah humne tumhein aik darmiyaani (mo'tadil) Ummat banaaya taake tum logon par gawah bano aur Rasool tum par gawah ho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 143).

e: [AI] From Abu Sa'eed: "And thus We have made you a just nation" (Surah Al-Baqarah 143). He said, "Just."
hi: Abu Sa'eed (RA) se, "{Aur isi tarah humne tumhein aik darmiyaani (wast) Ummat banaaya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 143) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Insaaf karne wali."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was directed towards the Kaaba, they said, "O Messenger of Allah, what about those who died while they were praying towards Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa?" So Allah sent down the verse {And Allah would not let your faith go to waste} [Quran 2:143] until the end of the verse. 'Ubaydullah ibn Musa said, "This hadith informs you that prayer is a part of faith."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka rukh Ka'bah ki taraf kar diya gaya, to logon ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), un logon ka kya hoga jo Baitul-Maqdis ki taraf namaz padhte huay mar gaye?" To Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur Allah aisa nahi ke tumhare imaan ko zaya kare}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 143) ayat ke aakhir tak. Ubaidullah bin Musa ne kaha: "Yeh hadith tumhein bataati hai ke namaz imaan mein se hai."

e:
[AI] "Turn your face towards the sacred Mosque, and wherever you may be, turn your faces towards it." [Surah Al-Baqarah 144]

He said, "Whichever direction you face, it is towards Him."
hi: "{To apna mun Masjid-e-Haram ki taraf karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 144), unhone kaha: "Iski taraf, iski simt."

e: [AI] "Towards the direction of the Kaaba."
hi: "Ka'bah ke paranaale (mizab) ki taraf."

e: [AI] About his mother, Umm Kulthum bint Uqba, she was one of the first emigrants. In relation to the saying of Allah Almighty, "Seek help through patience and prayer" (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:45), she said that Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf fell unconscious and they thought he had passed away, so his wife Umm Kulthum went to the mosque seeking help through what she was commanded, patience and prayer. When he regained consciousness, he asked, "Did I pass out?" They answered, "Yes." He said, "You spoke the truth, for two angels came to me and told me to go and meet the trustworthy dignitary." Another angel said, "Return him, for this is one of those whom you have written happiness for, and his descendants will enjoy him as long as Allah wills." After that, he lived for a month and then passed away.
hi: Apni waalida Umm Kulthum bint Uqbah se, jo pehle muhajir auraton mein se thin, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur sabr aur namaz se madad maango}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 45) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA) par behoshi taari hui, log samajhne lage ke unki jaan nikal gayi, to unki biwi Umm Kulthum masjid ki taraf nikali, sabr aur namaz se madad maangte huay jinka unhein hukum diya gaya tha. Jab unhein hosh aaya to unhone poocha: 'Kya abhi mujhpar behoshi taari hui thi?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Unhone kaha: 'Tumne sach kaha, mere paas do farishte aaye aur kaha: \"Chalo, hum tumhein Azeez, Ameen ke paas le chalein taake tumhara faisla ho.\" To aik doosre farishte ne kaha: \"Ise wapas le jao, kyunke yeh un logon mein se hai jinke liye tumne khush-naseebi likh di thi jabke woh apni maaon ke peton mein thay, aur unki aulaad Allah ki marzi tak inse faida uthaayegi.\"'" To woh iske baad aik mahine tak zinda rahe, phir inteqaal ho gaya.

e: [AI] He received news from some of his family while he was traveling, so he performed two units of prayer. Then he said, "We have done what Allah has commanded: seek help through patience and prayer." [Al-Baqarah 153]
hi: Unhein apne kisi ghar wale ki maut ki khabar mili jabke woh safar mein thay, to unhone do rak'aten padhin, phir kaha: "Humne wahi kiya jo Allah ne hukum diya: {Sabr aur namaz se madad maango}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 153).

e: [AI] "Indeed, excellent are the two companions of justice and excellent is Al-'Ilawa (the reward) for those who, when struck by a calamity, say, 'Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.' Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are [rightly] guided."
hi: Kitne achhe hain woh do barabar bojh (idlaan) aur kitni achhi hai woh izaafi barkat (ilaawah), jo log jab unpar museebat aaye to kahein: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon," unhi par unke Rab ki taraf se rehmatein aur rehm hai - kitne achhe hain woh do barabar bojh - aur wahi hidayat-yaafta hain - kitni achhi hai woh izaafi barkat.

e: [AI] This verse was revealed specifically to the Ansar, who were in the period of Ignorance (before Islam) when they performed the pilgrimage and were not allowed to perform the sa'i (the ritual of walking between Safa and Marwa). When we arrived (in Medina), we mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Allah revealed the following verse: "Indeed, Safa and Marwa are among the symbols of Allah" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:158) until the end of the verse.
hi: Yeh ayat Ansar ke baare mein hi nazil hui, jo jahiliyat mein ihraam baandhte to unke liye Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan tawaf (sa'i) karna jaayez nahi samjha jaata tha, jab hum aaye to unhone yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, to Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Beshak Safa aur Marwah Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 158) ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: "I asked Anas bin Malik about As-Safa and Al-Marwah, and he said: 'They were among the rites of Jahiliyyah.' He said: 'So during Islam, we refrained from them, then Allah, Blessed and Most High, revealed: Indeed As-Safa and Al-Marwah are of the symbols of Allah. So it is not a sin for those who perform Hajj or 'Umrah to the house to go between them. (2:158)' He said: 'So it is voluntarily then verily, Allah is the All-Recogniser, the All-Knowing. (2:158)'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2966)
hi: Yeh dono jahiliyat ke nishaan the, jab Islam aaya to humne inse parhez kiya, to Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Beshak Safa aur Marwah Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain, isliye jo Baitullah ka Hajj kare ya Umrah kare, uspar koi gunah nahi ke woh inke darmiyan tawaf kare, aur jo koi khushi se koi bhalaai kare}" ayat (Surah Al-Baqarah 158).

e: [AI] I begin with Safa before Marwa, or I begin with Marwa before Safa, and I pray before circumambulating (the Kaaba) or I circumambulate before praying, and I shave before slaughtering, or I slaughter before shaving? Ibn Abbas said: "Take this from the Book of Allah, for it is more deserving to be preserved." Allah the Almighty said: "Indeed, Safa and Marwa are among the symbols of Allah." (2:158) "So Safa is before Marwa." And He said: "Do not shave your heads until the sacrificial animal reaches its place of slaughter." (2:196) "So the sacrifice is before shaving." And He said: "Purify My house for those who perform Tawaf and those who stay in it for worship, and for those who bow and prostrate." (2:125) "So Tawaf is before prayer."
hi: "Kya main Safa se pehle shuru karoon ya Marwah se pehle? Aur kya main tawaf se pehle namaz padhoon ya namaz se pehle tawaf karoon? Aur kya main qurbani se pehle sar mundwaaun ya sar mundwaane se pehle qurbani karoon?" To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh Allah ki Kitaab se lo, kyunke woh yaad rakhne ke zyada laayaq hai." Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Beshak Safa aur Marwah Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 158) "to Safa Marwah se pehle hai," aur farmaya: "{Apne sar na mundwaao jab tak qurbani apni jagah na pahunch jaaye}" "to qurbani sar mundwaane se pehle hai," aur farmaya: "{Mera ghar tawaf karne walon, aitikaaf karne walon, aur ruku-sajda karne walon ke liye paak rakho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 125) "to tawaf namaz se pehle hai."

e: [AI] "He saw them walking back and forth between Safa and Marwa and said, 'This is from what I have inherited from you, O offspring of Isma'il.'"
hi: Ke unhone unhein Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan tawaf karte dekha, unhone kaha: "Yeh un cheezon mein se hai jo Isma'il (AS) ki maa ne tumhein mirath mein di hai."

e: [AI] In the pre-Islamic era, the devils used to play music all night long between Safa and Marwa. They had idols, which they worshipped. When Islam came, the Muslims said to the Prophet Muhammad, "O Messenger of Allah, we will no longer perform the rite of Sa'y (walking) between Safa and Marwa, as it is something we used to do in the pre-Islamic era." Then Allah revealed the verse, "Indeed, as for those who perform Hajj to the Ka'bah or 'umrah, there is no blame upon them for walking between them" (Quran 2:158). This means that there is no sin upon them, but they will be rewarded.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak Safa aur Marwah Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 158) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: jahiliyat mein shayateen Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan poori raat saaz bajaate the, aur wahan unke maabood-numa but (statues) thay, jab Islam aaya to Musalmano ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan tawaf nahi karengay, kyunke yeh woh cheez hai jo hum jahiliyat mein karte the," to Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{To jo Baitullah ka Hajj kare ya Umrah kare, uspar koi gunah nahi ke woh inke darmiyan tawaf kare}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 158), farma raha hai: uspar koi gunah nahi, balke uske liye ajr hai.

e: [AI] He said, "If it were not for a verse from the Book of Allah, I would not have informed anyone about anything." It was said, "What is it, O Abu Hurayrah?" He said, "The verse: 'Indeed, those who conceal what We sent down of clear proofs and guidance after We made it clear for the people in the Scripture - those are cursed by Allah and cursed by those who curse, except for those who repent and correct themselves and make evident [what they concealed].'" [Al-Baqarah 160]
hi: Unhone kaha: "Agar Allah ki Kitaab ki aik ayat na hoti, to main kisi ko kuch na bataata." Poocha gaya: "Aye Abu Hurairah, woh kaunsi ayat hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh ayat: {Beshak jo log un khuli daleelon aur hidayat ko chhupaate hain jo humne nazil kiya, iske baad ke humne unhein logon ke liye Kitaab mein wazeh kar diya, unhi par Allah lanat karta hai aur unpar lanat karne wale bhi lanat karte hain, siwaye un logon ke jinhone tauba ki, apne aap ko sanwaara, aur (haq) zaahir kiya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 159-160).

e: [AI] "Do not curse the wind, as it is from the breath of the Merciful. Allah says, 'And the altering of the winds and the clouds which are subjected between the heaven and the earth' [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:164]. Instead, say, 'O Allah, we ask You for the goodness of this wind, and the goodness within it, and the goodness it is sent with. And we seek refuge in You from its evil, and the evil within it, and the evil it is sent with.'"
hi: "Hawa ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunke yeh Rahman ke nafas (asar) mein se hai," Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan hai: "{Aur hawaon ke rukh badalne mein aur baadal jo aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan taabe hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 164), "lekin yeh kaho: 'Aye Allah, hum tujhse is hawa ki bhalaai, ismein jo hai uski bhalaai, aur ismein jo bhej kar aayi hai uski bhalaai maangte hain, aur hum teri panah maangte hain iski buraai se, ismein jo hai uski buraai se, aur ismein jo bhej kar aayi hai uski buraai se.'"

e: [AI] "Al-Mawaddah" translates to "love" or "affection" in English.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur unke darmiyan tamaam rishte-naate toot jaayenge}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 166) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Mohabbat (ke rishte)."

e: [AI] "He asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about faith and he recited this verse: 'Righteousness is not that you turn your faces toward the east or the west, but [true] righteousness is [in] one who believes in Allah, the Last Day...' [Quran 2:177]. When he finished reciting the verse, he asked him again and he recited it. Then he asked him again and he recited it. Then he asked him again and he said, 'When you do a good deed, love it with your heart, and when you commit a sin, hate it with your heart.'"
hi: Ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se imaan ke baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Neki yeh nahi ke tum apne chehre mashriq ya maghrib ki taraf phero, balke neki yeh hai ke jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan laaye}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 177) yahan tak ke ayat khatam ki. Unhone kaha: phir usne dobara poocha, aap (SAW) ne wahi padhi, phir usne dobara poocha, aap (SAW) ne wahi padhi, phir usne poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur jab tum koi neki karo to tumhara dil use pasand kare, aur jab tum koi buraai karo to tumhara dil use napasand kare."

e: [AI] "A healthy and stingy man hopes for a good living and fears poverty."
hi: "Aadmi tab de jab woh sehat-mand ho aur maal ki kadar karne wala ho, zindagi ki ummeed rakhta ho aur ghurbat se darta ho."

e: [AI] Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him) said, "Poverty and hardship are afflictions, illness is a trial, and in times of adversity, one should say, 'at the time of murder.'"
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "'Al-Ba'sa' ghurbat hai, aur 'Ad-Darra' bimaari hai, aur 'Heen-al-Ba's' ke waqt,' unhone kaha: 'Yeh jung ke waqt hai.'"

e: [AI] He is the main pillar in the satisfaction of his family.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Phir jise uske bhai ki taraf se kuch maaf kar diya jaaye}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 178) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh jaan-boojh kar (qatl) hai jo maqtool ke ghar walon ki raza se (maaf kiya jaaye)."

e: [AI] "He performs the required task with excellence."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur usse achhi tarah ada karna}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 178) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Talab kiya gaya haq achhe tareeqe se ada kare."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ enacted the law of retribution (qisas) according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to Abu Bakr and Umar), and did not implement it according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne qisas (barabar ka badla) ka faisla diya." Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] He stood up and delivered a speech to the people here in Basra. He recited Surah Al-Baqarah to them and explained its meaning. He then came upon this verse, "If you leave behind a good will for your parents..." [Al-Baqarah 180], and said, "This verse was abrogated, and what comes after it was mentioned."
hi: Ke woh khade huay aur yahan - ya'ni Basra mein - logon ko khutba di, unhein Surah Al-Baqarah padh kar sunaayi aur uska mazmoon wazeh kiya, jab woh is ayat par pahunche: "{Agar woh maal chhode to waalidain ke liye wasiyat}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 180), unhone kaha: "Yeh mansookh ho chuki hai," phir unhone iske baad wali baat ka zikr kiya.

e: [AI] Ali visited a man from the Banu Hashim tribe who was sick and wanted to give him some advice. However, the man refused and Ali told him that Allah says, "If you leave a good deed, it is better for you" (Surah Al-Baqarah, 180). So, he advised him to leave his wealth for his inheritors.
hi: Ke Ali (RA) Banu Hashim ke aik bimaar aadmi ki ayaadat (bimaar-pursi) ke liye unke paas gaye, woh wasiyat karna chahte the, to unhone unhein mana kiya aur kaha: "Allah farmata hai: {Agar woh maal chhode} (Surah Al-Baqarah 180) - maal - isliye apna maal apne waarison ke liye chhod do."

e: [AI] As for the conditions of fasting, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to Madinah and started fasting three days in every month, as well as observing the fast on the day of Ashura. Later, Allah made fasting obligatory and revealed the verse: "O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you" [Qur'an 2:183] until the verse "And upon those who are able [to fast], a ransom [as substitute] of feeding a poor person [each day]" [Qur'an 2:184]. Thus, whoever wished, fasted, and whoever wished, fed a poor person, and this was permissible. Then, Allah revealed another verse: "The month of Ramadhan [is that] in which was revealed the Qur'an" [Qur'an 2:185] until the verse "So whoever sights [the new moon of] the month, let him fast it" [Qur'an 2:185]. Allah made fasting obligatory for the resident who is capable and eased it for the sick and the traveler. He also made feeding required for the elderly who are unable to fast. These were the two options available, and they used to eat and drink during the night and have sexual relations until they slept. However, if they slept, they abstained from all that until dawn. Then, there was a man from the Ansar known as Sirmah who used to work while fasting until the evening, then he went to his family, performed the Isha prayer, and slept without eating or drinking until morning, thus remaining in the state of fasting. I (the narrator) also joined him once, so we slept and woke up while fasting. As for Umar, he had a sexual relationship with a slave girl or a free woman after sleeping, and he mentioned it to the Prophet ﷺ . Allah then revealed the verse: "It has been made lawful for you to approach your wives during the nights of the fast. They are clothing for you and you are clothing for them" [Qur'an 2:187] until the verse "Then complete the fast until the night" [Qur'an 2:187].
hi: Rahi baat roze ke ehkaam ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah tashreef laaye, aap (SAW) har mahine teen din roze rakhte the aur Ashura ke din ka roza bhi, phir Allah ne aap (SAW) par roza farz kiya, to Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aye imaan walo, tumpar roze farz kiye gaye hain jaise tumse pehle logon par farz kiye gaye the}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 183) is ayat tak: "{Aur jo iski taaqat rakhte hain unke liye fidyah hai - aik miskeen ko khaana khilaana}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 184), to jo chahta roza rakhta aur jo chahta kisi miskeen ko khaana khilaata, aur yeh uske liye kaafi ho jaata. Phir Allah ne doosri ayat nazil ki: "{Ramzan ka mahina jismein Quran nazil kiya gaya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 185) unke farmaan tak: "{To jo tum mein se is mahine ko paaye woh iska roza rakhe}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 185), to Allah ne muqeem aur sehat-mand par roza laazim kar diya aur bimaar aur musafir ko ismein chhoot di, aur us boodhe ke liye khaana khilaana laazim kiya jo roza rakhne ki taaqat nahi rakhta, to yeh do (ehkaam) thay. Aur woh khaate, peete, aur biwiyon ke paas jaate the jab tak so na jaayen, jab woh so jaate to (roze mein) yeh sab karne se ruk jaate. Phir Ansar ka aik shakhs jise Sirmah kaha jaata tha, roze ki halat mein shaam tak kaam karta raha, phir apne ghar aaya, Isha ki namaz padhi, phir so gaya, na khaaya na piya yahan tak ke subah ho gayi, to woh roze ki halat mein subah tak rahe. Maine bhi apne aap ko (usi halat mein) daala aur so gaya, aur main bhi roze ki halat mein subah tak raha. Aur Umar (RA) ne so jaane ke baad kisi laundi ya azaad aurat (apni biwi) ke sath sohbat kar li thi, to woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur yeh baat zikr ki, to Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Roze ki raaton mein tumhare liye apni biwiyon ke paas jaana halaal kar diya gaya hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 187) unke farmaan tak: "{Phir raat tak roza poora karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 187).

e: [AI] "Worship Me, I will respond to you."
hi: "Mujhse dua karo, main tumhein jawaab dunga."

e: [AI] "They are a dwelling for you and you are a dwelling for them."
hi: "Woh tumhare liye sukoon hain aur tum unke liye sukoon ho."

e: "We were in a Roman city, when a large column of Romans came out to us. So about the same number or more of the Muslims went towards them. The commander of the people of Egypt was 'Uqbah bin 'Amir, and the commenter of the (our) group was Fadalah bin 'Ubaid. One man among the Muslims reached the Roman line until he entered amidst them, so the people started screaming: 'Subhan Allah! He has thrown himself into destruction!' Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari said: 'O you people! You give this interpretation for this Ayah, while this Ayah was only revealed about us, the people among the Ansar, when Allah made Islam might, and increased its supporters. Some of us secretly said to each other, outside of the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Our wealth has been ruined, and Allah has strengthened Islam, and increased its supporters, so if we tend to our wealth then what we lost of it shall be revitalized for us." So Allah, Blessed and Most High, revealed to His Prophet ﷺ, rebuking what we said: 'And spend in the cause of Allah, and do not throw yourselves into destruction. (2:195)' So the destruction was tending to the wealth and maintaining it.' Abu Ayyub did not cease traveling in Allah's cause, until he was buried in the land of the Romans." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2972)
hi: Hum Constantinople mein thay, Misr walon par Uqbah bin Amir Al-Juhani (RA) sardaar the, aur Sham walon par Fadalah bin Ubaid Al-Ansari (RA) sardaar the, achanak Room ki aik badi saf nikli, humne bhi Musalmano ki aik badi saf unke muqaable mein banaayi, to Musalmano mein se aik shakhs Room ki saf par jhapat pada yahan tak ke unke darmiyan dakhil ho gaya, phir humari taraf mudkar wapas aaya, to logon mein cheekh uthi, unhone kaha: "Isne apne haath se apne aap ko halaakat mein daal diya."
