To Abu Ayyub, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi, ne kaha: "Aye logo, tum is ayat ki yeh tafseer kar rahe ho, jabke yeh humare, Ansar ke giroh, baare mein hi nazil hui thi - jab Allah ne apne deen ko izzat di aur uske madadgaar barh gaye, humme se kuch ne aapas mein Rasulullah (SAW) se chhup kar kaha: 'Humara maal zaya ho gaya hai, agar hum ismein reh kar isko sanwaarein (to behtar ho),' to Allah ne humein us baat se roka jiska humne iraada kiya tha," unhone kaha: to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur Allah ki raah mein kharch karo, aur apne haathon se apne aap ko halaakat mein na daalo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 195), to halaakat yeh thi ke hum apne maal mein reh jaate jo humne chaaha tha, to humein jihad ka hukum diya gaya. "Aur Abu Ayyub hamesha Allah ki raah mein jihad karte rahe yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein wafaat di."

e: [AI] There is a man, O Abu 'Umara, "and do not throw yourselves into destruction with your own hands" [Al-Baqarah 195]. Is he the man who encounters the enemy and fights until he is killed? He said, "No, but he is the man who commits a sin and says, 'Allah will not forgive me.'"
hi: Aik shakhs ne unse kaha: "Aye Abu Umarah, {Aur apne haathon se apne aap ko halaakat mein na daalo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 195), kya yeh woh aadmi hai jo dushman se mile aur jung kare yahan tak ke qatl ho jaaye?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke yeh woh aadmi hai jo gunah kare, phir kahe: 'Allah mujhe maaf nahi karega.'"

e: [AI] From the saying of Allah Almighty "And complete the Hajj and Umrah for Allah" [Al-Baqarah 196], He said, "That you may be prohibited from returning to your family's abode."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Allah ke liye Hajj aur Umrah poora karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 196) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Iska matlab hai ke tum apne ghar ke qareeb hi ihraam baandh lo."

e: [AI] He used to recite it as "So whoever does not find [the means for] fasting, then the fasting of three consecutive days [is required]."
hi: Ke woh ise "{To jise (qurbani) na mile, uske liye teen musalsal (lagataar) din ke roze}" padha karte the.

e: [AI] "Shawwal, Dhul-Qa'dah, and ten days of Dhul-Hijjah."
hi: "Shawwal, Zul-Qa'dah, aur Zul-Hijjah ke das (10) din."

e: [AI] "I was walking with Ibn Abbas, who was performing the Hajj and he was riding on a camel, and he was saying, 'And they (the women) walk with us side to side.' I said, 'Do you joke while you are performing the Hajj?' He said, 'Playfulness is only what is allowed for women.'"
hi: Main Ibn Abbas (RA) ke sath chal raha tha, jabke woh ihraam mein thay, woh oonton se rajaz (aik qism ki shairi) keh rahe the aur keh rahe the: "Aur woh humein aahista chaal se le ja rahi hain." Maine poocha: "Kya aap rafath (be-hudi baat) kar rahe hain jabke aap ihraam mein hain?" Unhone kaha: "Rafath to sirf woh hai jo auraton se khaas taur par kaha jaaye."

e: [AI] Adultery and immorality are sins committed against Allah, such as forbidden sexual acts and other transgressions. Quarreling, insulting, and disputes are also frowned upon.
hi: Rafath sambhog hai, aur fusuq Allah ki na-farmaani mein padna hai - jaise shikaar waghera - aur jidaal jhagda aur takraar hai.

e: [AI] They were in the early pilgrimage trading in Mina, such as Suq Al-Majaz and the seasons of the Hajj. When the Quran was revealed, they feared trading. So Allah, the Almighty, revealed: "There is no sin on you if you seek the bounty of your Lord." [Al-Baqarah 198] in the seasons of the Hajj.
hi: Woh Hajj ke shuru mein Mina mein Souq-al-Majaz aur Hajj ke mausamon mein baazaar ki tarah tijarat karte the, jab Quran nazil hua to unhein khareed-o-farokht se darr laga, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Tumpar koi gunah nahi ke tum apne Rab ka fazl talaash karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 198) Hajj ke mausamon mein.

e: [AI] "The Sacred Place of Worship" [Quran 2:198], "All of Muzdalifah"
hi: "{Al-Mash'ar-al-Haram}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 198) "Muzdalifah ka pura ilaqa."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us at Arafat. He praised and glorified Allah, then he said: 'As for what follows, indeed, the people of polytheism and idolatry used to push away from this place at sunset when the sun is over the mountain tops like men's head coverings on their heads. Our guidance is different from their guidance. They also used to push away from Al-Mash'ar Al-Haram at sunrise when the sun is over the mountain tops like men's head coverings on their heads. Our guidance is different from their guidance.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Arafah mein humein khutba di, Allah ki hamd ki aur uski tareef ki, phir farmaya: "Amma ba'd, beshak mushrik aur but-parast log yahan se suraj doobne ke waqt rawaana hote the jab suraj pahaadon ki chotiyon par mardon ki paggdiyon jaisa hota tha, to humari raah unki raah se mukhtalif hai, aur woh Al-Mash'ar-al-Haram se suraj tulu' honay ke waqt rawaana hote the jab suraj pahaadon ki chotiyon par mardon ki paggdiyon jaisa hota tha, to humari raah unki raah se mukhtalif hai."

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say between the two corners: O Allah, bring us a blessing in this world and a blessing in the next and guard us from punishment of Hell. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1892)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Rukn-e-Yamani aur Hajr-e-Aswad ke darmiyan yeh kehte suna: "{Aye humare Rab, humein duniya mein bhi bhalaai de aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalaai de, aur humein jahannam ke azaab se bacha}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 201).

e: [AI] "I have hired myself out from my people in return for them carrying me, and I have set aside from my wages for them in return for allowing me to perform Hajj with them. Will that be sufficient for them?" He said, "You are of those whom Allah, the Almighty, has said: 'For them is a share of what they have earned, and Allah is swift in account'" (Surah Al-Baqarah, 202).
hi: "Maine apne aap ko apni qaum ke liye is shart par kiraaye par diya ke woh mujhe (safar mein) le jaayen, aur maine apni ujrat mein se unhein yeh chhoot di ke woh mujhe unke sath Hajj karne den, kya yeh kaafi hoga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum unme se ho jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {Unke liye unke kiye hue ka hissa hai, aur Allah jald hisaab lene wala hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 202).

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The Hajj is 'Arafat, the Hajj is 'Arafat, the Hajj is 'Arafat. The days of Mina are three: But whoever hastens to leave in two days, there is no sin on him, and whoever stays on, there is no sin on him (2:203). And whoever sees (attends) the 'Arafah before the rising of Fajr, then he has performed the Hajj." Ibn Abi 'Umar said: "Sufyan bin 'Uyainah said: 'This is the best Hadith that Ath-Thawri reported.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2975)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hajj Arafah hai, jo koi Fajr ke tulu' hone se pehle Arafah paa le, uska Hajj mukammal ho gaya, aur Mina ke din teen hain, {To jo koi do din mein jaldi karle, uspar koi gunah nahi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 203), aur jo der kare uspar bhi koi gunah nahi.

e: [AI] The translation of "عُمَرُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ" into English is "May Allah be pleased with Umar."
hi: Umar (RA).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up and said, "O people of Madinah, certainly Allah has presented to me regarding alcohol in a way that I do not know if it may result in a prohibition to me. Then he stood up and said, "O people of Madinah, certainly Allah has revealed the prohibition of alcohol, so whoever has any of it, he should not drink it or sell it." They poured it out in the streets of Madinah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay aur farmaya: "Aye Madinah walo, beshak Allah sharaab ke baare mein mujhe ishaara de raha hai, mujhe nahi pata shayad woh ismein koi hukum nazil kare." Phir khade huay aur farmaya: "Aye Madinah walo, beshak Allah ne sharaab ki haraami nazil kar di hai, isliye jise yeh ayat mile aur uske paas ismein se kuch ho, to na woh ise piye na beche." Unhone kaha: to unhone use Madinah ki galiyon mein bahaa diya.

e: [AI] "When the verse 'And do not approach the property of the orphan, except in the way that is best' [Quran 6:152] was revealed, they separated their wealth from the wealth of the orphans. As a result, the food went bad and the meat became rotten. They complained about this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so Allah, the Exalted, revealed, 'Say, 'For them is reform, and if you associate with them, they are your brothers'" [Quran 2:220]. He said, 'So they associated with them.'"
hi: Jab "{Aur yateem ke maal ke qareeb mat jao siwaye us tareeqe ke jo sabse achha ho}" (Surah Al-An'am 152) nazil hui, to unhone apna maal yateemon ke maal se alag kar diya, to khaana kharaab hone laga aur gosht sadne laga, unhone yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se shikaayat ki, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Kaho: unke liye behtari ka intezaam karna behtar hai, aur agar tum unse mil-jul kar raho to woh tumhare bhai hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 220), unhone kaha: to unhone unke sath mil-julna shuru kar diya.

e: [AI] If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has something to say about it, then it is as he said. But if he did not say anything about it, then I say: "Your wives are a place of cultivation for you, so come to your place of cultivation however you please" [Al-Baqarah 223]. "If you want, separate, and if you want, do not separate."
hi: "Agar Rasulullah (SAW) ne ismein kuch farmaaya ho, to jaisa unhone farmaya waisa hi hai, aur agar unhone ismein kuch nahi farmaaya, to main kehta hoon: {Tumhari biwiyaan tumhari khaiti hain, isliye apni khaiti mein jis tarah chaaho aao}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 223), "to agar chaaho azl karo (bahar nikaal lo) aur agar na chaaho to na karo."

e: [AI] This neighborhood was made up of the migrants who would approach women in an inappropriate manner whenever they encountered them, whether they were walking towards them or walking away from them. When they arrived in the city, they married women from the inhabitants of Madinah (known as the Ansar). They wanted these women to agree to the same actions they used to do with the migrant women, but the Ansar women refused this. So they complained about it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed the following verse: "Your women are a plowed field for you, so approach your plowed field as you wish" [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:223]. This means that men can approach women from the front or the back, as long as it is done within the boundaries of Islam.
hi: Yeh qabila Muhajireen mein se auraton ke sath aik napasandeeda tareeqe se paish aata tha, unhein saamne ya peechhe se jahan bhi milte, jab woh Madinah aaye to unhone Ansar ki auraton se shaadi ki, aur unse wahi chaaha jo woh Muhajir auraton ke sath karte the, to unhone isse napasand kiya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) se iski shikaayat ki, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Tumhari biwiyaan tumhari khaiti hain, isliye apni khaiti mein jis tarah chaaho aao}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 223), farma raha hai: aage se ya peechhe se, peechhe ki taraf se, lekin (murad) hamesha wahi (fitri) jagah ho. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur (yeh) sirf peechhe ki taraf se, unke aage wale hisse mein hi tha." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The man used to divorce his wife whenever he pleased, and even if he divorced her a hundred times or more, if he took her back before her waiting period ended. Then the man said to his wife, "By Allah, I will not divorce you so reveal to me from yourself and do not come to me." She asked, "How can that be?" He said, "I will divorce you, and every time your waiting period is about to end, I will take you back and then divorce you again." The woman complained about this to Aisha, and Aisha mentioned it to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. He remained silent and did not say anything until the verse was revealed in the Quran, "Divorce is twice. Then, either keep [her] in an acceptable manner or release [her] with good treatment." [Quran 2:229]
hi: Aadmi apni biwi ko jitni baar chahe talaaq deta, aur agar woh use sau (100) baar ya usse zyada talaaq deta lekin uski iddat khatam honay se pehle usse rujoo kar leta (to yeh chalta rehta), yahan tak ke aik aadmi ne apni biwi se kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main tumhein na talaaq dunga ke tum mujhse alag ho jao, aur na hi tumhein apne paas rakhunga." Usne poocha: "Woh kaise?" Usne kaha: "Main tumhein talaaq dunga, aur jab bhi tumhari iddat khatam honay ke qareeb aayegi, main tumse rujoo kar lunga, phir tumhein talaaq de dunga, aur main aisa (bar-bar) karunga." To us aurat ne yeh baat Aisha (RA) se shikaayat ki, Aisha (RA) ne yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, to aap (SAW) khamosh rahe aur kuch nahi kaha, yahan tak ke Quran nazil hua: "{Talaaq do baar hai, phir ya to achhe tareeqe se rakh lena ya bhalaai ke sath chhod dena}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 229).

e: [AI] To return her, but if he prevents her, a place of refuge has been set up for her. And Allah the Exalted says, "And when you divorce women and they have fulfilled their term, do not prevent them from remarrying their [former] husbands if they agree among themselves on an acceptable basis." [Al-Baqarah 2:232]
hi: ...ke woh unse (dobara) shaadi kar le, to Ma'qil ne unhein rok diya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur jab tum auraton ko talaaq do aur woh apni muddat ko pahunch jaayen, to unhein apne shohron se shaadi karne se mat roko jab woh aapas mein achhe tareeqe se raazi ho jaayen}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 232).

e: [AI] "If she carried him (the child) for nine months, she breastfed him for one year and twenty months. And if she carried him for six months, she breastfed him for four years and twenty months." Then, he recited, "And his carrying and weaning is thirty months" [Quran 46:15].
hi: "Agar usne use nau (9) mahine pait mein rakha, to woh use ikkis (21) mahine doodh pilaayegi, aur agar usne use chhah (6) mahine pait mein rakha, to woh use chaubees (24) mahine doodh pilaayegi," phir unhone padha: "{Aur uska pait mein rehna aur doodh chhudaana teis (30) mahine hai}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 15).

e: [AI] This verse has been abrogated by its repetition in its people, so it counts wherever she wishes to the saying of Allah Almighty {except of evacuation} [Al-Baqarah 240]. Ata' said: If she wishes, she counts in her people, and if she wishes, she leaves, for the saying of Allah Almighty {So, if they leave, there is no blame upon you for what they do with themselves}.
hi: Is ayat ne uski iddat apne ghar walon mein guzaarne (ka hukum) mansookh kar diya, to ab woh jahan chaahe iddat guzaar sakti hai, Allah Ta'ala ke is farmaan ki wajah se: "{Bagair nikaale}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 240). Ata ne kaha: "Agar woh chaahe to apne ghar walon mein iddat guzaare, aur agar chaahe to nikal jaaye," Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan ki wajah se: "{Phir agar woh nikal jaayen to unke apne baare mein jo karein uspar tumpar koi gunah nahi}".

e: [AI] "He stood up and delivered a speech to the people here. Then he recited Surah Al-Baqarah to them and explained some parts of it. He came across this verse: 'If anyone leaves behind property, it is for parents and close relatives' [Al-Baqarah 180]. He said, 'This verse has been abrogated.' Then he continued reciting until he reached this verse: 'And those of you who die and leave behind wives' [Al-Baqarah 234] to the part where Allah says 'without evicting them' [Al-Baqarah 240]. He said, 'And this verse.'"
hi: Ke woh khade huay aur yahan logon ko khutba di, unhein Surah Al-Baqarah padh kar sunayi aur usme se unhein wazeh kiya, jab woh is ayat par pahunche: "{Agar woh maal chhode to waalidain aur qareebi rishtedaaron ke liye wasiyat}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 180), to unhone kaha: "Yeh mansookh ho chuki hai," phir padhte rahe yahan tak ke is ayat par pahunche: "{Aur jo tum mein se wafaat paate hain aur biwiyaan chhodte hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 234) unke farmaan tak: "{Bagair nikaale}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 240), to unhone kaha: "Aur yeh (bhi mansookh hai)."

e: [AI] "Her husband has the right to discipline her wherever he wishes." - As per the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Uska shohar (inteqaal kar jaaye), to woh jahan chaahe iddat guzaar sakti hai." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "When the verse 'Guard strictly the (five obligatory) prayers, especially the middle Salah (i.e., asr prayer)' (Al-Baqarah 2:238) was revealed, we recited it during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ as he wanted us to recite it. Then Allah replaced it with the verse mentioned above. A man asked him, 'Was the Asr prayer abrogated?' He replied, 'I informed you how it was revealed and how Allah abrogated it, and Allah knows best.'"
hi: Jab "{Namaazon ki hifaazat karo aur Asr ki namaz ki bhi}" nazil hui, to hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein ise jitna Allah ne chaaha padhte rahe, phir Allah ne isse mansookh kar diya aur nazil kiya: "{Namaazon ki hifaazat karo aur darmiyaani namaz ki bhi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 238), to aik shakhs ne unse poocha: "Kya yeh Asr ki namaz hai?" Unhone kaha: "Maine tumhein bataya ke yeh kaise nazil hui aur Allah ne isse kaise mansookh kiya, aur Allah zyada jaanta hai."

e: [AI] They were four thousand who escaped from the plague and said, "Let's go to a land where there is no death." Then Allah said to them, "Die!" and they died. Then a prophet passed by them and asked Allah to revive them, so He revived them. They are the ones whom Allah, the Almighty, said about, "And they are those who have passed away in Allah's cause." [Quran 2:243]
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Kya tumne un logon ko nahi dekha jo maut ke darr se apne gharon se hazaaron ki tadaad mein nikle}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 243) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: woh chaar hazaar (4000) log the jo taa'oon (mahaamaari) se bhaag kar nikle aur kaha: "Hum aisi zameen ki taraf jaate hain jahan maut nahi." To Allah ne unse farmaya: "Mar jao," to woh mar gaye. Phir unke paas se aik Nabi guzre, unhone Allah se dua ki ke unhein zinda kar de, to Allah ne unhein zinda kar diya, to yehi hain jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur woh hazaaron mein maut ke darr se the}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 243).

e: [AI] "To be the intimate companion for Ibrahim, the word spoken by Musa, and the vision for Muhammad ﷺ ."
hi: "Ke khullat (khaas dosti) Ibrahim (AS) ke liye hai, kalaam (Allah se seedhi guftagu) Musa (AS) ke liye hai, aur deedar (Allah ka deedar) Muhammad (SAW) ke liye hai."

e: [AI] "I approached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was in the mosque, and I sat beside him. He mentioned the virtues of prayer, fasting, and charity. I asked him, 'O Messenger of Allah, which verse that Allah revealed to you is the greatest?' He said, 'It is the verse: "Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence."' (Quran 2:255) And he continued to recite and explain the verse until he concluded."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahuncha jabke woh masjid mein thay, main unke paas baith gaya, unhone namaz, roze, aur sadqe ki fazeelat ka zikr kiya. Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ne aap par jo ayaten nazil ki hain unme se sabse azeem kaunsi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "{Allah, jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Hayy, Qayyum}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 255), aur ayat ka zikr kiya yahan tak ke usse khatam kiya.

e: [AI] "The chair is the place for His feet, and the throne's value cannot be measured."
hi: "Kursi unke qadmon ki jagah hai, aur Arsh ka andaza nahi lagaaya ja sakta."

e: [AI] About Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.
hi: Ali (RA) se.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked Bara'ah bin 'Azib, saying, 'O Bara'ah, how do you spend on your family?' He said, 'I am generous to my family.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'O Messenger of Allah, how should I consider it?' He said, 'Indeed, your spending on your family, children, and servant is a charity, so do not seek reward or harm for it.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Al-Bara' bin Azib (RA) se poocha, farmaya: "Aye Bara', tum apne ghar walon par kitna kharch karte ho?" Unhone kaha: aur woh apne ghar walon par khula-dula kharch karte the, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe iska andaza nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To beshak tumhara apne ghar walon, aulaad, aur khaadim par kharch sadqa hai, isliye ismein na ehsaan jataao na takleef pahunchaao."

e: [AI] "And the sprout springs forth from the earth."
hi: "Aur 'Ar-Rabwah' zameen ka ooncha (buland) hissa hai."

e: [AI] He heard him saying, Umar asked the companions of the Prophet, peace be upon him, "Do you know the meaning of the verse that says, 'Would any of you wish to have a garden with date-palms and vines...'" [Al-Baqarah 266]? They replied, "Allah knows best." Umar became angry and said, "Say, 'We know' or 'We do not know.'" Ibn Abbas said to himself, "I have some knowledge about it, O commander of the faithful." Umar said, "Say, 'O son of my brother, do not belittle yourself.'" Ibn Abbas gave an example of a certain action and Umar asked, "What kind of action?" Ibn Abbas replied, "A wealthy man who performs good deeds, then Allah sends devils to him, so he commits sins until his good deeds are completely destroyed."
hi: Unhein farmate suna: Umar (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba se poocha: "Tumhare khayal mein yeh kis baare mein nazil hui: {Kya tum mein se koi chahta hai ke uska aik baagh ho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 266)?" Unhone kaha: "Allah zyada jaanta hai." To Umar (RA) ko ghussa aaya aur kaha: "Kaho: hum jaante hain, ya hum nahi jaante." To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Mere dil mein iske baare mein kuch hai, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Kaho, mere bhatije, aur apne aap ko kam mat samjho." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh aik amal ke liye misaal di gayi hai." Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Kaunsa amal?" Unhone kaha: "Aik amal ke liye." To Umar (RA) ne (khud) kaha: "Aik maal-daar aadmi neik amal karta hai, phir Allah uspar shayateen bhej deta hai, to woh gunahon mein padta hai yahan tak ke uske sab amal ghark ho jaate hain."

e: [AI] "A strong, toxic wind."
hi: "Aisi hawa jismein sakht garmi (samoom) ho."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  ordered the Zakat al-Fitr to be given in the form of a saa' of dates. A man came with inferior quality dates, so the Prophet ﷺ  said to Abdullah ibn Rawaha, "Do not give these dates as zakat." Then the Quran was revealed: "O you who have believed, spend from the good things which you have earned and from that which We have produced for you from the earth. And do not aim toward the defective therefrom, spending [from that] while you would not take it [yourself] except with closed eyes" (Al-Baqarah 267).
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Zakat-ul-Fitr aik saa' khajoor ki soorat mein muqarrar ki, aik shakhs khraab khajoor le kar aaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Rawahah (RA) se farmaya: "In khajooron ka andaza (zakat ke liye) mat lagao." To Quran nazil hua: "{Aye imaan walo, apni kamaai ki paak cheezon mein se aur zameen se humne tumhare liye jo nikala hai usme se kharch karo, aur khraab cheezein chun kar dena mat chaaho jinhein tum khud aankhein band kiye bagair lena qubool na karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Indeed, your children are a gift from Allah. He bestows female children upon whom He wills, and He bestows male children upon whom He wills. They are a blessing and their wealth belongs to you when you are in need of it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhari aulaad tumhare liye Allah ki daat hai, jise chaahe betiyaan de, aur jise chaahe bete de, to woh aur unka maal tumhare liye hai jab tumhein iski zaroorat ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered for some charity to be given. A man from amongst the Sahal came and said, "Sufyan (meaning the one who sells salt or salt vendor)" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "Who brought this?" And no one used to bring anything except that it would be attributed to the one who brought it. So the verse was revealed: "And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it]. And do not touch the orphan's property except to improve it until he reaches maturity" [Quran 6:9]. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  also prohibited the use of two types of dates, the ones of a sort called "Ju'roor" and the type called "hubayq." Az-Zuhri said, "These two types of dates are from Madinah." Sulaiman ibn Kathir narrated this from Az-Zuhri.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne sadqe ka hukum diya, to aik shakhs is qism ki (khraab) khajoor lekar aaya - Sufyan ne kaha: ya'ni sheesh (khraab, kachhi-sukhi khajoor) - to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kaun laaya hai?" Aur koi bhi kuch nahi laata tha magar use laane wale ki taraf mansoob kiya jaata tha, to yeh nazil hui: "{Aur khraab cheezein chun kar dena mat chaaho jinhein tum khud aankhein band kiye bagair lena qubool na karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267). Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne khajoor ki do qismon ko sadqe mein lene se mana kiya - Ju'roor aur Hubaiq qism. Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Aur yeh dono qismein Madinah ki khajoor mein se hain." Sulaiman bin Kathir ne isse Az-Zuhri se mutaba'at ki.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade the two varieties of dates known as Ju'roor and Hubayq. Some people used to collect these fruits and give them out in charity, but they were prohibited from doing so because of these two varieties of dates. Then the following verse was revealed: 'Do not give from the impure of it that which you would not take [yourself] without averting your eyes' (Quran 2:267)."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne khajoor ki do qismon - Ju'roor aur Hubaiq - se mana kiya." Unhone kaha: aur log apni sabse khraab paidawaar chun kar sadqe mein nikaalte the, to unhein khajoor ki do qismon se mana kiya gaya, aur yeh nazil hui: "{Aur khraab cheezein chun kar dena mat chaaho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out with a staff, and there was a date palm branch hanging in the mosque, and a branch from it stabbed in his side. He said, "What harm can there be for the owner of this branch if he were to give in charity something better than this? Indeed, the owner of this branch will eat from it on the Day of Resurrection." Then he said, "By Allah, he will leave it fallen and humiliated for forty years for the birds and animals to eat from it." Then he said, "Do you know what the birds and animals are?" They said, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "They are birds and animals."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) nikle, unke haath mein aik chhadi thi, achanak masjid mein latki hui khajoor ki takhniyaan thin, unme se aik takhni mein khraab (chhilki-khushk) khajoor thi, aap (SAW) ne us takhni ko chhadi se chheda aur farmaya: "Iske maalik ko kya nuqsaan hota agar woh isse behtar cheez sadqa karta? Beshak iska maalik Qayamat ke din yehi khraab khajoor khaayega." Phir farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, main ise chalees (40) saal tak zaleel-o-khwaar chhod dunga, 'Al-Awafi' ke liye." Phir farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai 'Al-Awafi' kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Parinde aur darinde."

e: Bara bin Azib said concerning the Verse: “And of that which We have priduced from the earth for you, and don not aim at that which is bad to spend from it. ” [Al-Baqarah 2:267] “This was revealed concerning the Ansar. At the time of the new date-palm harvest, they would take a bunch of dates that were beginning to ripen and hang it on a rope between two of the pillars in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the poor emigrants would eat from it.” One of them deliberately mixed a bunch containing rotten and shriveled dates, and thought this was permissible because of the large number of dates that had been put there. So the following was revealed about the one who did that: '… and do not aim at that which is bad to spend from it'. Meaning do not seek out the rotten and shriveled dates to give in charity: '…(thought) you would not accept it save if you close your eyes and tolerate therein.' Meaning, if you were given this as a gift you would only accept it because you felt embarrassed, and you would get angry that he had sent something of which you have no need. And know that Allah has no need of your charity.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1822)
hi: Yeh Ansar ke baare mein nazil hui, Ansar jab khajoor ki toduaai hoti to apne baaghon se kachhi-pakki khajoor ke guthhe nikaalte aur unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein do sutoonon ke sar ke barabar latka dete, to faqeer Muhajireen isse khaate, to unme se koi aik khraab guthha bhi daal deta, yeh sochte huay ke jaayez hai kyunke guthhon ki tadaad zyada hoti thi, to aisa karne walon ke baare mein yeh nazil hui: "{Aur khraab cheezein chun kar dena mat chaaho jinhein tum khud aankhein band kiye bagair lena qubool na karo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267), farma raha hai: agar tumhein yeh tohfe mein di jaaye to tum ise sirf sharm ki wajah se, apne dene wale par gussa hote huay, ke usne tumhein aisi cheez bheji jiski use zaroorat nahi thi, lete, "{Aur jaan lo ke Allah be-niyaz hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267) tumhare sadqon se, "{Tareef ke qaabil}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 267).

e: [AI] "To submit to their lineages while they are polytheists, so the verse was revealed: 'It is not for you to guide them, but Allah guides whom He wills' [Quran 2:272] until He revealed: 'And you are not responsible for their guidance' [Quran 2:272]. He granted them permission."
hi: ...ke woh apne (polytheist) rishtedaaron ko kuch (maal) de dein jabke woh mushrik hon, to yeh nazil hui: "{Unhein hidayat dena tumpar farz nahi, balke Allah jise chaahe hidayat deta hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 272) yahan tak ke pahunche: "{Aur tumpar koi zulm nahi kiya jaayega}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 272), unhone kaha: to unhein iski ijaazat de di gayi.

e: [AI] "From Jaabir, may Allah be pleased with him."
hi: Jabir (RA) se.

e: [AI] Indeed, the debt with a specific term that Allah has set in the Book and allowed is called "Salaf". Allah, the Almighty, says: "O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down." [Al-Baqarah 282]
hi: Beshak muddat-e-muqarrar tak ka zamin salaf (udhaar) Allah ne Kitaab mein halaal kiya hai aur iski ijaazat di hai, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aye imaan walo, jab tum aapas mein kisi muqarrar muddat ke liye qarz ka len-den karo to use likh lo}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 282) ayat.

e:
[AI] Allah Almighty said: "And call as witnesses two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses - so that if one of the women errs, then the other can remind her. And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called upon. And do not be [too] weary to write it, whether it is small or large, for its [specified] term. That is more just in the sight of Allah and stronger as evidence and more likely to prevent doubt between you, except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves. For then there is no blame upon you if you do not write it. And take witnesses when you conclude a contract. Let no scribe be harmed or any witness. For if you do so, indeed, it is [grave] disobedience in you. And fear Allah. And Allah teaches you. And Allah is Knowing of all things." (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:282)

And they are not those whom We accept. (Surah Al-Qasas, 28:25)

He said, "So I sent to Ibn Zubayr to ask him, and he said, 'By the free will [of Allah].' When they were asked to testify, he said, 'I have not seen any judicial ruling except in accordance with what Ibn Zubayr said.'"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Un gawahon mein se jinhein tum pasand karte ho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 282), aur woh (kuch log) aise nahi thay jinhein hum pasand karte the. Unhone kaha: to maine Ibn Az-Zubair (RA) ke paas (paighaam) bheja unse poochne ke liye, unhone kaha: "Munaasib yeh hai ke agar unse poocha jaaye to woh sach bolein." Unhone kaha: to maine faisla wahi dekha jo Ibn Az-Zubair (RA) ne kaha tha.

e: [AI] "When this verse was revealed, 'If you disclose what is in your hearts or conceal it, Allah will call you to account for it,' (2:284) it became difficult for them. They felt overwhelmed by the weight of it, so the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to them, 'Say, "We hear and we obey."' Then Allah instilled faith in their hearts and they said, 'We hear and we obey.' Then Allah, the Almighty said, 'Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear...' (2:286) until the statement, 'or we have made a mistake.' (2:286) He said, 'I have done [what is required] until the end of Al-Baqarah.'"
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Agar tum apne dilon ki baat zaahir karo ya chhupaao, Allah tumse iska hisaab lega}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 284), to yeh unpar aisi bhaari padi jaisi unpar isse pehle koi cheez bhaari nahi padi thi. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kaho: humne suna aur maana." To Allah ne unke dilon mein imaan daal diya, unhone kaha: "Humne suna aur maana." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Allah kisi jaan par uski taaqat se zyada bojh nahi daalta, uske liye wahi hai jo usne kamaya aur usspar wahi hai jo usne kiya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 286) unke farmaan tak: "{Ya humse galti ho gayi ho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 286). Unhone kaha: "Maine (yeh maaf) kar diya," Surah Al-Baqarah ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] May Allah have mercy on Abu Abdullah, the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  indeed did something when this verse was revealed, and then it was abrogated by the verse that followed it: "It (soul) will have what it has earned, and it will bear what it has caused." (Surah Al-Baqarah, 286).
hi: "Allah Abu Abdur Rahman par reham kare, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ne jab yeh nazil hui to jo kiya woh kiya, phir isse baad wali ayat ne mansookh kar diya: {Uske liye wahi hai jo usne kamaya aur usspar wahi hai jo usne kiya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 286).

e: [AI] "When this verse was revealed to the Prophet, peace be upon him, {The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord} [Al-Baqarah 285], the Prophet, peace be upon him, said, 'And he is more deserving to believe.'"
hi: Jab yeh ayat Nabi (SAW) par nazil hui: "{Rasool imaan laaya us cheez par jo unke Rab ki taraf se unpar nazil ki gayi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 285), to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur woh iske sabse zyada haqdaar hain ke woh khud isspar imaan laayen."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Recite the two chapters Al-Baqarah and Al-Imran."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do chamakti hui (Surahon) - Al-Baqarah aur Aal-e-Imran - padho."

e: [AI] "He prayed with them, then recited, 'Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.' Abu Ubaid said, 'Regarding the different reciters after the people of the two holy cities, Mecca and Medina, and the people of the two Egyptian cities, Kufa and Basra, and the people of Syria and Egypt, and others among the reciters, they recite it as 'Al-Qayyum' [Surah Al Imran 2]. There is no disagreement among them in this. I know this to be the case, and this is also the recitation in our area, which aligns with the manuscript and what the Muslim nation agrees upon. Even though there are two ways of pronunciation in the Arabic language.'"
hi: Ke unhone unhein namaz padhayi, "to unhone padha: Alif-Laam-Meem, Allah, jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Hayy, Qayyaam." Abu Ubaid ne kaha: "Rahi baat baad ke qaariyon ki, Harmain (Makkah aur Madinah) walon, do bade shehron (Kufa aur Basra) walon, Sham aur Misr walon, aur baaqi qaariyon ki, to unhone ise 'Al-Qayyum' (Surah Aal-e-Imran 2) padha, mujhe pata hai ismein unke darmiyan koi ikhtilaaf nahi, aur isi tarah humare paas bhi qiraat hai, kitaab ki muwaafiqat aur Ummat ke amal ki wajah se, agarche Arabi zubaan mein donon soorton ki gunjaish hai."

e: [AI] We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Al-Bat'ha when a cloud passed by. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do you know what this is?" We replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "It is a cloud." We said, "Cloud!" He said, "And the Muzn." We said, "And the Muzn!" He said, "And the 'Anan." We said, "And the 'Anan!" Then he fell silent, and after a while, he said, "Do you know how much is between the sky and the earth?" We replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "Between them is a distance of five hundred years of traveling, and between each sky and the sky that follows it is a distance of five hundred years of traveling, and each sky is as thick as five hundred years of traveling. Above the seventh sky, there is an ocean between its upper and lower extremity, just as there is between the sky and the earth. Then, above that, there are eight layers as wide as the distance between a rider's knees and his ears, just as there is between the sky and the earth. And Allah, the Most High, is above that, and nothing of the deeds of the children of Adam is hidden from Him."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Al-Batha mein baithe thay, aik baadal guzra, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai yeh kya hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh saahaab (baadal) hai." Humne kaha: "Saahaab." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur muzn." Humne kaha: "Aur muzn." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur anaan." Humne kaha: "Aur anaan." Phir khamosh ho gaye, phir farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan kitna faasla hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke darmiyan paanch sau (500) saal ka safar hai, aur har aasman se uske agle aasman tak paanch sau (500) saal ka safar hai, aur har aasman ki moti paanch sau (500) saal ke safar jitni hai, aur saatwe aasman ke oopar aik samundar hai jiski oonchai aur neechai ke darmiyan utna hi faasla hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan, phir uske oopar aath (8) pahaadi bakre hain jinke ghutno aur khuron ke darmiyan utna hi faasla hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan, aur Allah Ta'ala isse bhi oopar hai, Bani Aadam ke kisi bhi amal ko woh chhupaa nahi hai."

e: [AI] "From Ibn Abbas, there are indeed decisive verses which are in Surah Al-An'am. Say, 'Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you. [He commands] that you not associate anything with Him, and to parents, good treatment, and do not kill your children out of poverty; We will provide for you and them. And do not approach immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed. And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed] except by [legal] right. This has He instructed you that you may use reason.'"
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, "Isme se kuch aayaten 'muhkam' (mustaqil, saaf) hain, woh Surah Al-An'am mein hain: 'Kaho, aao, main tumhein woh sunata hoon jo tumhare Rab ne tumpar haraam kiya hai - ke tum uske sath kisi ko shareek na karo' teen aayaton ke aakhir tak."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "One of the things that I fear for my ummah (community) is that wealth will become abundant among them to the point where they will compete with each other for it, and this will lead to fighting and killing. Another thing that I fear for my ummah is that the Qur'an will be opened to them and both the believer and the disbeliever and the hypocrite will read it. The believer will interpret it in his favor until the end of the verse."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak jin cheezon se main apni Ummat ke baare mein darta hoon unme se aik yeh hai ke unme maal itna barh jaaye ke woh ismein ek-doosre se muqaabla karne lagein aur ismein aapas mein larne lagein, aur beshak jin cheezon se main apni Ummat ke baare mein darta hoon unme se aik yeh hai ke unke liye Quran khol diya jaaye yahan tak ke momin, kaafir, aur munafiq sab ise padhein, to momin iski taaweel talaash karte huay uske halaal ko halaal samjhega," ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to frequently say, "O Turner of hearts, make our hearts firm in Your religion." We said, "O Messenger of Allah, are you afraid for us even though we believe in you?" He said, "Indeed, the hearts of the children of Adam are between two fingers of the Most Merciful, like one heart. He turns them as He wills."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aksar yeh kaha karte the: "Aye dilon ko palatne wale, humare dilon ko apne deen par jama rakh." Humne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aapko humare baare mein darr hai jabke hum aap par imaan laa chuke hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Bani Aadam ke dil Rahman ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan hain, jaise aik hi dil ho, woh usse jaise chaahe pherata hai."

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'There is no heart that is not between two of the Fingers of the Most Merciful. If He wills, He guides it and if He wills, He sends it astray.' The Messenger of Allah used to say: 'O You Who makes hearts steadfast make our hearts steadfast in adhering to Your religion.' And he said: 'The Scale is in the Hand of the Most Merciful; He will cause some peoples to rise and others to fall until the day of Resurrection.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 199)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Taraazu (scale) Rahman ke haath mein hai, woh kuch logon ko uthaata hai aur kuch ko neecha karta hai, aur Bani Aadam ka dil Rahman ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan hai, jab chaahe use qaayam rakhta hai aur jab chaahe use bhataka deta hai." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) yeh kaha karte the: "Aye dilon ko palatne wale, mere dil ko apne deen par jama rakh."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The heart of the son of Adam is more prone to change than a vessel can tip over when it boils."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Bani Aadam ka dil deg se bhi zyada palatne wala hai jab woh josh maar kar ubaalne lage."

e: [AI] I heard Ibn Abbas reciting, "{None knows its interpretation except Allah and those who are firmly grounded in knowledge.}" [Al 'Imran 7]. Regarding knowledge, they say, "We believe in it."
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko "{Aur iski tafseer Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta, aur ilm mein raasikh (mazboot) log}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 7) padhte suna, woh kehte hain: "Hum ismein imaan laaye."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  it is narrated that the first Book descended through one door and on one writing, and the Qur'an descended through seven doors and on seven recitations: a commandment, a prohibition, what is lawful, what is unlawful, what is decisive, what is allegorical, and parables. So make lawful what it permits, prohibit what it forbids, act upon its commands, and refrain from what it prohibits. Take lessons from its parables, apply its decisive verses, believe in its allegorical verses, and say, "We have believed in it, all of it is from our Lord." Only those with understanding will remember.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Pehli kitaab aik hi darwaze se aik hi tareeqe par nazil hui, aur Quran saat darwazon se saat tareeqon par nazil hua - roknay wala, hukum dene wala, halaal, haraam, mustaqil (saaf), mutashaabih (mushkil), aur misaalein. Isliye iske halaal ko halaal maano aur iske haraam ko haraam maano, aur jiska hukum diya gaya hai woh karo, aur jisse mana kiya gaya hai usse ruk jao, aur iski misaalon se ibrat lo, aur iske mustaqil ahkaam par amal karo, aur iske mutashaabih par imaan laao, aur kaho: 'Humne isspar imaan laaya, sab kuch humare Rab ki taraf se hai,' aur sirf aqal-mand log hi naseehat haasil karte hain."

e: [AI] "Umar has called us to believe in this; all of it is from our Lord."
hi: Umar (RA): "Isse humein chhod do, hum isspar imaan laaye, sab kuch humare Rab ki taraf se hai."

e:
regarding Allah's statement, "They kill the prophets unjustly and they kill those who enjoin justice among people" [Āl ʿImrān 3:21]. He said, ʿĪsá (Jesus), the son of Mary was sent with twelve men from the disciples who taught people. He used to ˹teach them to˺ prohibit them from marrying their nieces. There was a king (Herod Antipas) who had a niece ˹named Herodias˺ who was taken by him so he desired her. He used to fulfill her needs every day.
˹Herodias'˺ mother said to her, "If he asks you about your need, tell him to kill Yaḥyá (John), the son of Zakariyyah (Zachariah)." King ˹Herod˺ asked her, "˹What is˺ your need?" She replied, "My need is for Yaḥyá, the son of Zakariyyah, to be killed." The king said, "Ask for something else." She said, "I ask for nothing else." When ˹Yaḥyá ˺ came, he gave the order, and he was beheaded on a tray. 
A drop of his blood continued to boil until Allah sent Bukhtanaṣṣar (Nebuchadnezzar). An old man directed him ˹to the boiling blood˺, and it entered his mind that the killing should not stop until this blood settles down. So he killed seventy thousand people in one day in one stroke, and in one house.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Nabiyon ko na-haq qatl karte hain, aur un logon ko bhi qatl karte hain jo logon mein insaaf ka hukum dete hain}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 21) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Isa bin Maryam (AS) ko baara (12) Hawariyyon (khaas sathiyon) ke sath bheja gaya jo logon ko sikhaate the, aur woh unhein bhatiji se nikah karne se mana karte the. Aik baadshah tha jiski aik bhatiji thi jo use pasand thi, usne use chaaha, aur uski har roz koi zaroorat poori karta. Uski maa ne usse kaha: "Jab woh tumse tumhari zaroorat poochhe to usse kehna ke woh Yahya bin Zakariyya (AS) ko qatl kar de." To baadshah ne usse poocha: "Teri kya zaroorat hai?" Usne kaha: "Meri zaroorat yeh hai ke Yahya bin Zakariyya (AS) qatl kiye jaayen." Usne kaha: "Iske ilawa kuch aur maango." Usne kaha: "Main iske ilawa kuch nahi maangungi." Jab (Yahya AS) laaye gaye, to usne hukum diya, unhein aik taasht (bartan) mein zibah kar diya gaya. To unke khoon ki aik boond nikli aur woh ubalti rahi yahan tak ke Allah ne Bukhtnassar ko bheja, aik boodhi aurat ne unhein us (khoon) ki taraf raahnumaai ki, uske dil mein daala gaya ke qatl-o-gharat jaari rahegi jab tak yeh khoon shaant na ho jaaye, to usne aik hi din mein, aik hi zarb aur aik hi ghar mein, sattar hazaar (70,000) logon ko qatl kar diya.

e: [AI] "Allah has revealed to your prophet ﷺ, 'I have killed seventy thousand people with the killing of Yahya bin Zakariya, and I will kill seventy thousand people with the killing of your grandson's son, seventy thousand and seventy thousand.'"
hi: Allah ne tumhare Nabi (SAW) ki taraf wahi bheji: "Beshak maine Yahya bin Zakariyya (AS) ke (khoon) ke badle sattar hazaar (70,000) logon ko qatl karwaaya hai, aur main tumhare nawaase ke (khoon) ke badle sattar hazaar aur sattar hazaar logon ko qatl karwaaunga."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Polytheism is more hidden than the crawling of a black ant on a smooth rock in the dark night. And the least of it is that you love something out of injustice, and you hate something out of justice. And that is the religion except for love and hate." Allah, the Almighty, said: "Say, [O Muhammad], "If you should love Allah, then follow me, [so] Allah will love you." [Al-Imran 31].
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shirk kaali raat mein Safa par chalti chiyunti ke kadmon se bhi zyada chhupa hua hai, aur iska sabse kam darja yeh hai ke tum kisi zulm ki baat par mohabbat karo aur kisi insaaf ki baat par nafrat karo, aur (asal) deen yehi hai - mohabbat aur nafrat (Allah ke liye)." Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Kaho: agar tum Allah se mohabbat karte ho to meri pairavi karo, Allah tumse mohabbat karega}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 31).

e: [AI] "To fear them as one should fear God." [Surah Al Imran 28]. The pious ones are those who speak with the tongue and have a tranquil heart filled with faith. They do not stretch out their hands to kill anyone, nor do they commit any sins, for they have no excuse."
hi: "{Siwaye is ke ke tum unse (dushmano se) bachne ke liye ehtiyaat baraato}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 28), unhone kaha: "Taqaah (ehtiyaat) sirf zubaan se baat karna hai jabke dil imaan par mutma'in ho, isliye woh apna haath (kisi ko qatl karne ke liye) na badhaaye, aur na hi gunah ki taraf, kyunke iska koi uzr nahi."

e: [AI] Zakariyah took care of her, so he entered the sanctuary and found grapes with her out of season. Zakariyah said, "How did you come by this?" She replied, "It is from Allah. Indeed, Allah provides for whom He wills without account." Zakariyah said, "The One who provides you with grapes out of season is also capable of granting me a child, although I am old and my wife is barren." Thereupon, Zakariyah called upon his Lord. When he was given the glad tidings of Yahya (John), he said, "My Lord, grant me a sign." Allah replied, "Your sign is that you will not speak to people for three nights consecutively, except by gesture." Zakariyah said, "My tongue shall remain restrained from speech without having any illness, while I am in a sound state."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak maine apne pait ki cheez tere liye nazr ki, azaad (khidmat ke liye)}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 35) ke baare mein, unhone unke farmaan tak padha: "{Unke paas rizq paaya}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 37), unhone kaha: Zakariyya (AS) ne unki kifaalat li, woh mehraab mein unke paas gaye, to unhone unke paas angoor mikta (tokri) mein paaya jabke uska mausam nahi tha. Zakariyya (AS) ne poocha: "{Yeh tumhare paas kahan se aaya?} unhone kaha: {Yeh Allah ki taraf se hai, beshak Allah jise chaahe bagair hisaab ke rizq deta hai}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 37). Unhone kaha: "Woh Zaat jo tumhein be-mausam angoor de sakti hai, woh mujhe boodhi, bekaar, aur baanjh (biwi) se bhi aulaad dene par qaadir hai," "{Wahin Zakariyya (AS) ne apne Rab se dua ki}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 38), jab unhein Yahya (AS) ki khush-khabri di gayi, to unhone kaha: "{Aye Rab, mere liye koi nishaani banaa}" unhein kaha gaya: "{Teri nishaani yeh hai ke tum teen raaton tak logon se seedha (theek-thaak) baat nahi kar sakoge}" (Surah Maryam 10), matlab tumhari zubaan bagair kisi bimaari ke ruk jaayegi jabke tum sehat-mand hoge.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Every Prophet has appointed successors from amongst the prophets, and my successor and Wali (closest friend) among them is my father Ibrahim." Then he recited the verse, "Indeed, the most worthy of Ibrahim among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allah] and this Prophet [Muhammad] and those who have believed. And Allah is the Wali of the believers." (Surah Al-Imran 3:68)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har Nabi ke liye Ambiya mein se qareebi dost hote hain, aur mera qareebi dost unme se mere waalid Ibrahim (AS) hain," phir yeh padha: "{Ibrahim (AS) ke sabse zyada haqdaar log woh hain jinhone unki pairavi ki, aur yeh Nabi, aur woh log jo imaan laaye, aur Allah momino ka wali hai}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 68).

e: [AI] Indeed, the Israelites inherited it (the disease of leprosy) from the women of the tribe, so it would stay with them overnight and they would have sores. Allah (SWT) then made it that they should not eat flesh with veins in it. The Jews made it forbidden, so the verse was revealed: "All food was lawful to the children of Israel except what Israel made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say: 'So bring the Torah and recite it, if you are truthful.'" [Surah Al-Imran: 93]. Indeed, this was before the revelation of the Torah.
hi: Beshak Israel (Ya'qub AS) ko 'irq-un-nasa' (aik nas ki bimaari, sciatica) ho gayi thi, to woh raat guzaarte the aur unhein takleef hoti thi. Unhone niyat ki ke agar Allah unhein shifa de to woh aisa gosht na khaayen jisme nasein hon. Unhone kaha: to Yahoodiyon ne isse apne aap par haraam kar liya, to yeh nazil hui: "{Sara khaana Bani Israel ke liye halaal tha siwaye us cheez ke jo Israel ne khud par haraam kar li thi Tauraat nazil honay se pehle, kaho: Tauraat lao aur ise padho agar tum sacche ho}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 93), beshak yeh Tauraat se pehle ki baat thi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "In the veins of women, there is a drop of Arab sheep's blood, which is not the largest nor the smallest. It is cut into small pieces, then melted and mixed. It is divided into three parts, and every day a portion is drunk on an empty stomach." Anas ibn Sirin said, "I have commanded many people to do so, and all of them have been cured by the permission of Allah, the Exalted."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Irq-un-nasa (sciatica) ke liye, aik Arabi mendhe ki chikni charbi lo, jo na sabse badi ho na sabse choti, use choti-choti pattiyon mein kaato, phir pighlaao aur achhi tarah pighlaao, phir ise teen hisson mein baant lo, aur har din khaali pet aik hissa piyo." Anas bin Sireen ne kaha: "Maine yeh bohot se logon ko hukum diya hai, unhone gina kar aik badi tadaad bataayi, sab Allah Ta'ala ki ijaazat se theek ho gaye."

e: [AI] About the first house that was built for people, which is the blessed house in Makkah, is it the first house that was constructed on Earth? He said, "No, but it is the first house in which blessings, guidance, and the station of Ibrahim were placed. And whoever enters it will be safe. If you wish, I can tell you how Allah, the Almighty, commanded Ibrahim to build a house on Earth. Ibrahim was clueless about how to build it, so Allah sent tranquility to him in the form of a gentle wind, and it blew towards the place where the house should be built. The wind had a head, and one of them followed the direction of the wind's head until it settled in the location of the house, encircled by a snake. Ibrahim then initiated the construction, and every day he would build a leg until he reached the place of the black stone. He then said to his son, "Bring me a stone to use as a corner." So his son searched for a suitable stone until he found the black stone fixed in its place. He asked his father, "Where did you get this from?" Ibrahim replied, "Someone who did not rely on your construction brought it." The stone was brought by the angel Jibril (Gabriel) from the sky, and Ibrahim completed its placement.
hi: "{Sabse pehla ghar jo logon ke liye rakha gaya, woh Bakkah (Makkah) mein tha, barkat wala}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 96) - kya yeh zameen par sabse pehla bana ghar hai? Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke yeh sabse pehla ghar hai jismein barkat aur hidayat rakhi gayi, aur Maqam-e-Ibrahim, aur jo isme dakhil ho use amaan mili, aur agar tum chaaho to main tumhein bataata hoon ke Allah Ta'ala ne ise kaise banwaaya - beshak Allah ne Ibrahim (AS) ko wahi bheji ke woh zameen mein mere liye aik ghar banaayen, unhein iska tareeqa samajh nahi aaya, to Allah ne unki taraf Sakinah bheji, jo aik chakkar-daar hawa thi jiski aik simt thi, to unme se aik (Ibrahim ya Isma'il AS) doosre ki hawa ki pairavi karta raha yahan tak ke woh (jagah par) pahunch gayi, phir woh us ghar ki jagah ke ird-gird saanp ki tarah chakkar lagaane lagi, to Ibrahim (AS) ne banaana shuru kiya, woh har din aik hissa banaate rahe yahan tak ke jab Hajr-e-Aswad (kaale pathar) ki jagah tak pahunche to apne bete se kaha: 'Mujhe koi pathar la do,' to unhone wahan pathar dhoonda yahan tak ke usse le aaye, to unhone paaya ke Hajr-e-Aswad pehle hi rakh diya gaya hai, to bete ne poocha: 'Yeh aapko kahan se mila?' Unhone kaha: 'Isse woh laaya jo tumhare banaane par bharosa nahi rakhta, ise Jibra'il (AS) aasman se laaye,' to unhone ise mukammal kar diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us saying, "O people, Verily Allah has prescribed upon you the obligation of Hajj." Al-Aqra' bin Habis stood up and asked, "O Messenger of Allah, is it obligatory every year?" He replied, "If I say yes, it would become obligatory, and if it becomes obligatory, you would not be able to fulfill it every year. Therefore, whoever performs it in excess, it will be considered a voluntary act of worship."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein khutba di aur farmaya: "Aye logo, beshak Allah ne tumpar Hajj farz kiya hai." To Al-Aqra' bin Habis khade huay aur poocha: "Kya har saal, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main 'haan' kehta to woh wajib ho jaata, aur agar woh wajib ho jaata to tum ispar amal na kar paate, ya tum ispar amal karne ki taaqat na rakhte - Hajj aik baar hai, aur jo koi zyada kare woh nafl hai."

e: [AI] Al-Aqra bin Habis asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ : "Is Hajj to be performed every year?" He replied, "No, rather it is to be performed once a year. Whoever performs it more than that, it is considered voluntary." And in another narration by Ali bin Abi Talib, he explained and clarified the statement of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Al-Aqra' bin Habis ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha, kaha: "Kya Hajj har saal aik baar hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke sirf aik baar, aur jo zyada kare woh nafl hai." Iss baab mein Ali bin Abi Talib se bhi Rasulullah (SAW) se sharh aur bayaan ke sath riwayat hai.

e: When this verse ʿAnd Hajj (pilgrimage to Makkah) to the house (Kaʿbah) is a duty that mankind owes to Allah, those who can afford the expenses (for oneʿs conveyance, provision and residence)ʿ [Al-ʿImran 3:97] was revealed, they said: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, is it every year? He remained silent. Then they said: Is it every year? He remained silent, Then they said: Is it every year? He said: ʿNo, if I said yes, it would be obligatory.ʿ Then Allah revealed the words: ʿO you who believe! Ask not about things which, if made plain to you, may cause you troubleʿ [Al-Ma’idah 5:101] up to the end of the Αyah. (Using translation from Aḥmad 905)
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Aur Allah ke liye logon par ghar (Ka'bah) ka Hajj farz hai jo iski taraf raasta paa sake}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 97), unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya har saal?" To aap (SAW) khamosh rahe, phir unhone poocha: "Kya har saal?" To aap (SAW) khamosh rahe, phir unhone poocha: "Kya har saal?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, aur agar main 'haan' kehta to yeh wajib ho jaata." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aye imaan walo, aisi cheezon ke baare mein na poocho jo agar tumpar zaahir kar di jaayen to tumhein bura lagega}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 101).

e: [AI] It is reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the following verse: "O you who believe! Fear Allah as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims." [Al Imran 102] He ﷺ  then said, "By the One in whose hand is my soul, if a drop of Zamzam water was poured into the oceans of the Earth, it would not be corrupted." And in another narration by Wahb ibn Jarir, he ﷺ  said, "I have turned away the luxuries of this world, so how can I be concerned with its sustenance?"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Aye imaan walo, Allah se aisa daro jaisa darne ka haq hai, aur Musalman honay ki halat ke ilawa hargiz na maro}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 102), farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar Zaqqum (jahannam ke darakht) ki aik boond zameen ke samundron mein tapak jaaye, to woh (sara paani) kharab kar degi." Aur Wahb bin Jarir ki riwayat mein: "To yeh duniya walon ki zindagiyan bhi tulkh (kadwi) kar degi, to us shakhs ka kya haal hoga jiska khaana yehi ho?"

e: [AI] To be obeyed and not disobeyed, and to be remembered and not forgotten.
hi: "Uski itaa'at ki jaaye aur uski na-farmani na ki jaaye, aur usse yaad rakha jaaye aur bhula na jaaye."

e: [AI] "They are the ones who migrated with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from Mecca to Medina."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Tum sabse behtareen Ummat ho jo logon ke liye nikaali gayi}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 110) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh woh log hain jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Makkah se Madinah hijrat ki."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever wants to be honored with a building and elevated in ranks, then let him forgive those who wronged him, give to those who deprived him, and maintain relations with those who cut him off."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise yeh pasand ho ke uski imaarat oonchi ki jaaye aur uske darje buland kiye jaayen, to use chahiye ke woh us shakhs ko maaf kare jisne uspar zulm kiya, aur us shakhs ko de jisne usse rok liya, aur us shakhs se rishta jode jisne usse toda."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq entered the mosque, and Umar ibn al-Khattab was addressing the people. He went to the house where the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  had passed away, and he uncovered his face, which was covered with a cloth, and he kissed it. He said, "By Allah, Allah will not gather two deaths upon you after your death, which you will not die after." Then he went out to the mosque, and Umar continued addressing the people. Abu Bakr said to Umar, "Sit down, O Umar," but he refused. He spoke to him two or three times, but he refused. So Abu Bakr stood up, performed the funeral prayer, and when he had finished, he said, "As for what follows, whoever worshiped Muhammad, then Muhammad has died. And whoever worshiped Allah, then Allah is alive and does not die." Then he recited the verses, "And We did not grant to any man before you eternity." [Al-Anbiya 34] "Muhammad is not but a messenger. Other messengers have passed away before him." [Ali Imran 144] And he continued reciting until he reached the verse, "And [likewise] the grateful ones." [Ali Imran 144] And he recited that, and the people became convinced of the death of the Messenger Muhammad ﷺ  until someone said, "The people did not know that this verse was revealed until Abu Bakr recited it." Az-Zuhri said that Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib informed me that Umar ibn Al-Khattab said, "When Abu Bakr recited this verse, I was so weak that I fell to the ground, and I became certain that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had died."
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) masjid mein dakhil huay jabke Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) logon se baat kar rahe the, to woh us ghar mein gaye jahan Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat hui thi, unhone unke chehre se Hibrah ki chaadar hataayi jiske sath aap (SAW) ko dhaanpa gaya tha, phir unhein dekha, phir jhuk kar unke chehre ko bosa dene laga aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Allah aapko do maut nahi degaa, aapki (is pehli) maut ke baad jiske baad koi aur maut nahi hai." Phir woh masjid ki taraf nikle jabke Umar (RA) logon se baat kar rahe the, Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Baith jao, Aye Umar." Unhone inkaar kiya, to unhone unse do ya teen martaba baat ki, unhone inkaar kiya, to (Abu Bakr RA) khade huay aur tashahhud padha, jab woh apna tashahhud khatam kar chuke to kaha: "Amma ba'd, jo Muhammad (SAW) ki ibaadat karta tha, to Muhammad (SAW) inteqaal kar chuke hain, aur jo Allah ki ibaadat karta tha, to Allah zinda hai, kabhi nahi marta," phir unhone padha: "{Aur humne tumse pehle kisi bhi bashar ko hamesha rehne wala nahi banaya}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 34), "{Aur Muhammad sirf aik Rasool hain, unse pehle bhi Rasool guzar chuke hain}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 144), aur "{Shukr-guzaaron}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 144) tak padha, to jaise hi unhone yeh padha, logon ko Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ka yaqeen ho gaya, yahan tak ke aik kehne wale ne kaha ke logon ko nahi pata tha ke yeh ayat nazil ho chuki hai jab tak Abu Bakr (RA) ne isse padh kar na sunaaya. Az-Zuhri ne kaha: Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib ne mujhe bataya ke Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Jab Abu Bakr (RA) ne yeh padha, to main be-jaan si ho gaya yahan tak ke zameen par gir gaya, aur mujhe yaqeen ho gaya ke Rasulullah (SAW) inteqaal kar chuke hain."

e: [AI] He said, "The Prophet ﷺ was not supported in any place as he was on the day of Uhud." He said, "We denied that, so Ibn Abbas said, 'Between me and whoever denied that is the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.' Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, says about the day of Uhud, 'And Allah had certainly fulfilled His promise to you when you were killing the enemy by His permission.'" [Surah Al Imran, 152]. Ibn Abbas says that "killing" here means fighting. He also says, "Until when you lost courage and fell to disputing about the matter and disobeyed after He had shown you that which you love. Among you are some who desire this world, and among you are some who desire the Hereafter. Then He turned you back from them [defeated] that He might test you. And He has already forgiven you. And Allah is full of bounty to the believers." [Surah Al Imran, 152]. He meant by this the archers, for the Prophet ﷺ stationed them in a specific place and then said, 'Protect our backs. If you see us being killed, do not come to our aid, and if you see us gaining booty, do not partake in it.' So when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gained booty and made permissible the property of the polytheists, the archers uncovered themselves and entered into the booty, holding one another's fingers. They were surprised by the polytheists who began to attack the Muslims, resulting in the death of many Muslims. The Prophet ﷺ and his companions fought until seven or nine of the leaders of the polytheists were killed. The Muslims fought by the mountain and did not reach where people said the battle took place, as it was beneath the Hudaybiyya. Shaytan shouted, 'Muhammad is killed,' and they did not suspect that it was true until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ emerged among them, walking in a state of apprehension. When he saw him, they recognized him by the way he walked. This brought them great joy, as though nothing had befallen them. He then moved away from them, saying, 'The anger of Allah has increased upon a people who killed their Prophet.' He said again, 'O Allah, surely they cannot overpower us.' Then Abu Sufyan shouted from the bottom of the mountain, 'O Hubal, O Hubal, where is the son of Abu Kabsha, where is the son of Abu Quhafa, where is the son of Al-Khattab?' Umar said, 'O Messenger of Allah, should I answer him?' He said, 'Yes.' So when Abu Sufyan shouted, 'O Hubal,' Umar said, 'Allah is the Most High and the Most Great.' Abu Sufyan said, 'The day of Badr was a day of mutual hostility and fighting.' Umar said, 'It is not the same, our dead are in Paradise while your dead are in the Fire.' Abu Sufyan said, 'Indeed, you will find in your dead a similar number. However, that was not according to our plan.' Then he encountered the zeal of ignorance and said, 'If that is the case, then we did not like it.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ki kisi bhi jagah itni madad nahi hui jitni Uhud ke din hui." Humne isse inkaar kiya, to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Mere aur is baat ka inkaar karne wale ke darmiyan Allah ki Kitaab hai, beshak Allah Ta'ala Uhud ke din ke baare mein farmata hai: {Aur Allah ne tumse apna wada sach kar dikhaaya jab tum unhein uski ijaazat se qatl kar rahe the}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 152), Ibn Abbas (RA) kehte hain: aur 'Hiss' qatl hai, "{Yahan tak ke jab tum kamzor pad gaye aur maamle mein aapas mein jhagda karne lage aur na-farmani ki iske baad ke usne tumhein wahi dikha diya jo tum pasand karte the, tum mein se kuch duniya chahte the aur kuch aakhirat chahte the, phir usne tumhein unse hataaya taake tumhein aazmaaye, aur usne tumhein maaf kar diya, aur Allah momino par bohot fazl karne wala hai}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 152), aur ismein unki muraad teer-andaazon se thi, aur yeh isliye ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein aik jagah khada kiya, phir farmaya: "Humari peeth ki hifaazat karo, agar tum humein qatl hote dekho to humari madad ko mat aana, aur agar tum humein maal-e-ghaneemat lete dekho to humare sath shareek mat hona." Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ko maal-e-ghaneemat mila aur unhone mushrikeen ke lashkar ko halaal kar diya, to teer-andaaz sab ke sab (apni jagah se) hat gaye aur lashkar mein loot ke liye dakhil ho gaye, jabke Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba ki safein aapas mein mil chuki thin, to woh is tarah (ho gaye), aur unhone apni ungliyon ko aapas mein jod kar dikhaaya, aur woh gadd-mad ho gaye. Jab teer-andaazon ne woh khaali jagah chhod di jahan woh maujood the, to woh ghudsawaar us jagah se Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba par dakhil ho gaye, to woh aik doosre ko maarne lage aur gadd-mad ho gaye, aur Musalmano mein se bohot se log qatl ho gaye. Aur Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke sahaba ka din ke shuru mein aisa haal tha ke mushrikeen ke jhande waalon mein se saat ya nau (7 ya 9) log qatl ho chuke the, aur Musalman pahaad ki taraf aik chakkar mein chale gaye, aur woh us jagah tak nahi pahunche jise log "Al-Ghaab" kehte hain, balke woh "Al-Mihras" (paani ke ghaat) ke neeche the, aur shaitan ne cheekh maari: "Muhammad qatl ho gaye," to unhein isme koi shak nahi raha ke yeh sach hai, to hum aisi hi haalat mein rahe, humein shak tha ke woh qatl ho gaye hain, yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) do (pahaadiyon) - Saadain - ke darmiyan zaahir huay, humne unhein unke chalne ke andaaz se pehchaana, unhone kaha: to hum khush ho gaye jaise ke humpar kuch aaya hi na ho, unhone kaha: to woh humari taraf chadhe, aur farma rahe the: "Allah ka ghussa sakht hai us qaum par jinhone apne Nabi ka chehra khoon-aalooda kiya," aur aik aur martaba farmaate: "Aye Allah, unke liye jaayez nahi ke woh humpar ghaalib aayen," yahan tak ke humare paas pahunche. Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) thodi der thehre, achanak Abu Sufyan pahaad ke neeche cheekh raha tha: "Hubal ki jai ho, Hubal ki jai ho," ya'ni apne ma'boodon ka (naam le kar), "Ibn Abi Kabshah kahan hai? Ibn Abi Quhafah kahan hai? Ibn Al-Khattab kahan hai?" To Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main isse jawaab na doon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zaroor." Jab usne kaha: "Hubal ki jai ho," Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allah sabse buland aur azeem hai." Abu Sufyan ne kaha: "Aye Ibn Al-Khattab, aaj khamoshi ka din hai (baat na karo)," phir dobara kaha: "Ibn Abi Kabshah kahan hai? Ibn Abi Quhafah kahan hai? Ibn Al-Khattab kahan hai?" To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) hain, aur yeh Abu Bakr hain, aur main khud Umar hoon." Abu Sufyan ne kaha: "Aik din Badr ke din ke badle, jung mein baari-baari hoti hai." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Barabar nahi, humare maqtool Jannat mein hain aur tumhare maqtool Jahannam mein." Usne kaha: "Tum yeh gumaan karte ho, to phir hum ghaate mein rahe aur nuqsaan mein." Phir Abu Sufyan ne kaha: "Tum apne maqtoolon mein badsuluki paaogay, aur yeh humare buzurgon ki raay se nahi hua tha," phir usse jahiliyat ki ghairat aa gayi, to usne kaha: "Agar aisa hua hai to humein bura nahi lagta."

e: that Abu Talhah said: "I raised my head to look around on the Day of Uhud, and there was not one of them that day except that he was swaying under his shield due to drowsiness. Allah said about that: Then He sent down upon you - after the distress - a slumber of security (3:154). (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3007)
hi: Maine Uhud ke din apna sar uthaaya aur dekhne laga, aur unme se koi bhi aisa nahi tha jo apni dhaal ke neeche neend ki wajah se na jhoom raha ho, yehi Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan hai: "{Phir usne gham ke baad tumpar sukoon nazil kiya, aik neend jo tum mein se aik giroh ko dhaank rahi thi}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 154) ayat.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: When your brethren were smitten at the battle of Uhud, Allah put their spirits in the crops of green birds which go down to the rivers of Paradise, eat its fruit and nestle in lamps of gold in the shade of the Throne. Then when they experienced the sweetness of their food, drink and rest, they asked: Who will tell our brethren about us that we are alive in Paradise provided with provision, in order that they might not be disinterested in jihad and recoil in war? Allah Most High said: I shall tell them about you; so Allah sent down; "And do not consider those who have been killed in Allah's path." till the end of the verse. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2520)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tumhare bhai Uhud mein maare gaye, Allah ne unki roohein sabz parindon ke jism mein rakh din, jo Jannat ki nehron ka rukh karti hain, uske phalon se khaati hain, aur sone ke qandeelon mein panaah leti hain jo Arsh ke saaye mein latki hain. Jab unhone apne khaane, peene, aur aaraam ki khushbu paayi, to unhone kaha: 'Kaun humare bhaiyon ko yeh khabar pahunchaayega ke hum Jannat mein zinda hain aur humein rizq milta hai, taake woh jihad se bezaar na hon aur jung se peechhe na hatein?' To Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Main unhein tumhari taraf se yeh khabar pahunchaaunga,' to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur jo log Allah ki raah mein qatl huay unhein mardah mat samjho}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 169) ayat.

e: [AI] "Your father and your grandfather means Abu Bakr and Al-Zubair are among those whom Allah Almighty has mentioned in the verse: 'Those who responded to Allah and the Messenger after injury had struck them.' [Al-Imran: 172]."
hi: Ke tumhare waalid aur tumhare dada - ya'ni Abu Bakr (RA) aur Az-Zubair (RA) - un logon mein se hain jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Woh log jinhone Allah aur Rasool ki baat maani iske baad ke unhein zakhm lag chuka tha}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 172).

e: The last statement of Abraham when he was thrown into the fire was:--"Allah is Sufficient for us and He is the Best Disposer (of affairs for us)." (3.173) (Using translation from Bukhārī 4564)
hi: Ibrahim (AS) ke aakhri alfaaz jab unhein aag mein daala gaya, thay: 'Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-Wakeel' (Allah humare liye kaafi hai aur woh behtareen kaargusaar hai), aur tumhare Nabi (SAW) ne bhi wahi kaha: "{Jinhein logon ne kaha: 'Log tumhare khilaaf jama ho chuke hain, isliye unse daro,' to isne unke imaan ko aur barha diya, aur unhone kaha: 'Humare liye Allah kaafi hai aur woh behtareen kaargusaar hai'}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 173).

e: [AI] "And there is no deity except Him. There is not upon the earth any creature but that its provision is upon Allah. And He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register. And it is better for a soul to die while believing, if only she knew. But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah. But what is with Allah is better for the righteous. And indeed, if the wrongdoers had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account." (Surah Al 'Imran, 3: 198-199)
hi: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, zameen par koi jaan aisi nahi jiske liye maut behtar na ho agar woh momin ho, kyunke Allah farmata hai: "{Lekin jo apne Rab se darte hain, unke liye aise baaghaat hain jinke neeche nehrein bahti hain}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 198), aur agar woh faajir (gunahgaar) ho, to Allah farmata hai: "{Hum unhein sirf isliye mohlat dete hain taake unke gunah aur barh jaayen}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 178).

e: [AI] "Abdullah will be surrounded by what he was stingy with on the Day of Judgment," a snake will have two raisins that it will consume in his grave, and it will say, "I am your wealth that you were stingy with." I heard Yahya ibn Mansur say, "I heard Abu Amr Al-Mustamli say, 'I heard Abu Hisham Al-Rifai say, 'I heard Abu Bakr ibn Ayash say, 'By Allah, I never lied about Abu Ishaq, and I do not see Abu Ishaq lying about Abu Wail, and I do not see Abu Wail lying about Abdullah.'" Ath-Thawri narrated it from Abu Ishaq upon the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Woh log jo (Allah ki raah mein maal dene mein) kanjoosi karenge, Qayamat ke din unke gale mein woh (maal) tauq (halqa) bana kar daala jayega," unhone kaha: "Aik saanp jiski do siyaah-daagh wali aankhein hongi, woh use uski qabar mein kaatega aur kahega: 'Main tera woh maal hoon jismein tune kanjoosi ki.'" Maine Yahya bin Mansoor ko kehte suna, unhone Abu Amr Al-Mustamli ko kehte suna, unhone Abu Hisham Ar-Rifa'i ko kehte suna, unhone Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ko kehte suna: "Allah ki qasam, maine Abu Ishaq par jhoot nahi bola, aur na hi mujhe lagta hai ke Abu Ishaq ne Abu Wa'il par jhoot bola, aur na hi mujhe lagta hai ke Abu Wa'il ne Abdullah (RA) par jhoot bola." Isse Ath-Thawri ne Abu Ishaq se riwayat kiya hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the space in Paradise taken up by a whip, is better than the world and what is in it. Recite if you wish: 'And whoever is moved away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise, he indeed is successful. The life of this world is only the enjoyment of deception (3:185).'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3013)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat mein aik korday (chaabuk) jitni jagah bhi duniya aur jo kuch usme hai usse behtar hai, agar tum chaaho to padho: {To jo bhi aag se bacha liya jaaye aur Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaaye, woh kaamyaab ho gaya, aur duniya ki zindagi to sirf dhoke ka saamaan hai}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 185).

e: [AI] The verse was revealed concerning the people of the Book, when the Prophet ﷺ  asked them about something, and they concealed it. Then, they came to him and he asked them again, and they informed him about something else. So, they realized that they had already informed him about what he had asked them, and they praised themselves for their secrecy and rejoiced in what they had kept hidden from him of what he had asked them.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA): "Yeh ayat sirf Ahl-e-Kitaab ke baare mein nazil hui, Yahoodi unke paas aaye, to Nabi (SAW) ne unse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha, unhone use chhupaaya, phir unke paas aaye aur unhone unse (dobara) poocha, unhone unhein kuch aur bata diya, to woh nikle aur samjhe ke unhone aap (SAW) ke poochne wali baat bata di hai, aur unhone iski daad chaahi aur khush huay ke unhone jo poocha gaya tha usse chhupaakar (kuch aur) diya."

e: [AI] "It was hemorrhoid with him, so the Prophet ﷺ  ordered him to pray on his side."
hi: Ke unhein bawaseer (piles) thi, "to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh (bimaari ki wajah se) karwat lete huay namaz padhein."

e: [AI] "That they will come out of the Fire, but they are not to come out of it. [Quran 5:37] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  informed me that they are the disbelievers," Jaber said. I said to him, as stated in [Quran 3:192], "Indeed, whoever you admit to the Fire - you have disgraced him." Allah has indeed disgraced him when he burned him with fire, or with other disgraceful punishments in the deep ocean.
hi: "{Ke woh aag se nikal jaayen, jabke woh usse nikalne wale nahi}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 37), unhone kaha: mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne bataya ke yeh kaafir hain. Maine Jabir (RA) se poocha: "To phir yeh farmaan: {Beshak jise tu jahannam mein daakhil kare, use tu ne ruswa kar diya}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 192)?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ne use ruswa kar diya jab usse aag se jalaaya, ya usse kam ruswaai." Bahr As-Saqqa halaak-shuda (raawi) hain.

e: from a man among the children of Umm Salamah, from Umm Salamah that she said: "O Messenger of Allah! I have not heard Allah mentioning anything about women and emigration." So Allah, Blessed and Most High, revealed: "Never will I allow to be lost the work of any of you, be he male or female. You are members one of another (3:195)." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3023)
hi: Ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine Allah ko hijrat ke baare mein auraton ka zikr karte nahi suna," to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{To unke Rab ne unki dua qubool ki, ke main tum mein se kisi amal karne wale ka amal zaya nahi karta, chahe mard ho ya aurat, tum aik doosre se ho}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 195).

e: [AI] An enemy from their land came to the Najashi, so the emigrants went to him and said, "We would like to accompany you and fight alongside you so that you can witness our courage and reward us for what you have done with us." Najashi replied, "There is no medicine like the help of Allah rather than the help of people." He then recited the verse, "And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what has been revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allah." [Surah Al Imran 199]
hi: Najashi ki zameen par unke dushman ka aik hamla hua, to Muhajireen unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Hum chahte hain ke hum bhi unke khilaaf nikalein taake hum aapke sath jung karein aur aap humari dileri dekhein, aur aapne humare sath jo kiya uska badla dein." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki madad se ilaaj, logon ki madad se ilaaj se behtar hai." Unhone kaha: aur inhi ke baare mein yeh nazil hui: "{Aur beshak Ahl-e-Kitaab mein se kuch aise hain jo Allah par imaan laate hain aur us cheez par jo tumhari taraf nazil ki gayi aur jo unki taraf nazil ki gayi, Allah ke saamne aajizi karte huay}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 199).
