e: [AI] Abu Ubaidah was besieged in Syria and the people rebelled against him. Omar wrote to him: "Peace be upon you. Afterward, what comes down to a faithful servant from a state of severity, Allah will make relief for him thereafter. No difficulty overwhelms him who perseveres. O you who have believed, be patient and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful." [Al-Imran 200]. Abu Ubaidah replied to Omar: "Peace be upon you. Afterward, Allah says in his book: 'Know that the worldly life is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children.' [Al-Hadid 20] until its end." Omar then left with his letter and sat on the pulpit and read to the people of Medina. Then he said: "O people of Medina, Abu Ubaidah only wants you to be eager for jihad."
hi: Ke Abu Ubaidah (RA) Sham mein ghere mein aa gaye the, aur qaum unpar ikhatte ho gayi thi, to Umar (RA) ne unhein khat likha: "Aap par salaam ho, amma ba'd, kisi bhi momin bande par koi sakhti nahi aati magar Allah uske baad usse aasaani nikaal deta hai, aur koi bhi aik mushkil kabhi do aasaaniyon par ghaalib nahi aati, {Aye imaan walo, sabr karo aur aik doosre se sabr karwaao, aur murabata (sarhad ki pehra-daari) karo, aur Allah se daro taake tum kaamyaab ho jaao}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 200). Unhone kaha: to Abu Ubaidah (RA) ne unhein jawaab mein likha: "Aap par salaam ho, amma ba'd, beshak Allah apni Kitaab mein farmata hai: {Jaan lo ke duniya ki zindagi sirf khel, tamaasha, zeenat, aapas mein fakhr, aur maal-o-aulaad mein aik doosre se barhne ki koshish hai}" (Surah Al-Hadid 20) ayat ke aakhir tak. Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) unka khat lekar nikle, mimbar par baithe, Madinah walon ko padh kar sunaayi, phir farmaya: "Aye Madinah walo, Abu Ubaidah tumhein sirf yeh tanbeeh kar rahe hain ke tum jihad ki khwahish rakho."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Huraira say, "During the time of the Prophet ﷺ , there was no campaign in which the soldiers would stay in a particular place, but there was waiting for the prayer after the prayer."
hi: Maine Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte suna: "Nabi (SAW) ke zamane mein aisi koi jung nahi thi jismein murabata (sarhad ki pehra-daari) hoti ho, balke murabata namaz ke baad namaz ka intezaar karna tha."

e: [AI] Regarding Surah An-Nisa, I have indeed read the Quran while I was young.
hi: Surah An-Nisa ke baare mein: "Maine Quran us waqt padha jab main chhota tha."

e: [AI] "Verily, ties of kinship are severed, and verily, blessings are denied, and verily, when Allah brings hearts closer, nothing can ever separate them." Then he recited: "If you were to spend all that is on Earth, you could not have brought their hearts together." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Family ties are a branch of mercy from the Most Merciful, and it will come on the Day of Resurrection speaking with a fluent tongue. Whoever maintains it, Allah will maintain him, and whoever severs it, Allah will sever him."
hi: "Rishtedaari zaroor kaati jaati hai, aur ne'mat ki na-shukri ki jaati hai, aur jab Allah dilon ko aapas mein qareeb kar deta hai to koi cheez unhein kabhi door nahi kar sakti," phir yeh padha: "{Agar tum zameen ki sari cheezein bhi kharch kar deti to bhi tum unke dilon ko jod na sakti}" (Surah Al-Anfal 63). Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rishtedaari Rahman se juda hui aik shaakh hai, aur beshak yeh Qayamat ke din aayegi aur sunehri, saaf zubaan mein baat karegi, to jise woh judne ka ishara kare, Allah usse jode ga, aur jise woh todne ka ishara kare, Allah usse todega."

e: [AI] There was a conversation between Abu Talha and Umm Sulaim. Abu Talha intended to divorce Umm Sulaim. This matter reached the Prophet ﷺ , who said, "The divorce of Umm Sulaim is an act of disobedience."
hi: Abu Talha (RA) aur Umm Sulaym (RA) ke darmiyan kuch baat-cheet hui, to Abu Talha (RA) ne Umm Sulaym (RA) ko talaaq dene ka iraada kiya, yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Umm Sulaym (RA) ko talaaq dena zaroor aik bhaari gunah hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ  who said: "There are three people whose supplications are not answered by Allah: a man who has a wife with bad manners and does not divorce her, a man who possesses money owed to someone else and does not testify for him, and a person who gives his wealth to a fool, even though Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: 'And do not give the foolish your property.' [Quran 4:5]"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (log) Allah se dua karte hain lekin unki dua qubool nahi hoti - aik aadmi jiski biwi bad-akhlaq ho aur woh use talaaq na de, aur aik aadmi jiska kisi doosre par qarz ho aur woh isspar gawah muqarrar na kare, aur aik aadmi jo kisi nasamajh ko uska maal de de," jabke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai: "{Aur nasamajhon ko apna maal na do}" (Surah An-Nisa 5).

e: [AI] To suffice until he does not need the wealth of the orphan.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jo maal-daar ho use bachna chahiye}" (Surah An-Nisa 6), to woh yateem ke maal ka zaroorat-mand na ho, "{Aur jo gareeb ho use munaasib tareeqe se khaana chahiye}" (Surah An-Nisa 6), ya'ni woh uske maal se itna khaaye jitni uski zaroorat ho, taake use yateem ke maal ki zaroorat na pade.

e: [AI] They are appeased by them, so if there is any shortfall in money, apologize to them.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jab wirasat ki taqseem ke waqt qareebi rishtedaar, yateem, aur miskeen maujood hon, to unhein isme se kuch do aur unse achhi baat karo}" ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unhein kuch de diya jaaye, aur agar maal mein kami ho to unse maazrat kar li jaaye."

e: When Allah, Most High, revealed the verses: "Come not nigh to the orphan's property except to improve it". And "Those who unjustly eat up the property of orphans", everyone who had an orphan with him went and separated his food from his (orphan's) food, and his drink from his drink, and began to detain the remaining food which he (the orphan) himself ate or spoiled. This fell heavy on them, and they mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. So Allah, Most High, revealed the verse: "They ask thee concerning orphans. Say: The best thing to do is what is for their good; if ye mix their affairs with yours, they are your brethren." Then they mixed their food with his food and their drink with his drink. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2871)
hi: Jab Allah ne "{Aur yateem ke maal ke qareeb mat jao siwaye us tareeqe ke jo sabse achha ho}" (Surah Al-An'am 152), "{Beshak jo log yateemon ka maal zulm se khaate hain, woh apne peton mein sirf aag hi bhar rahe hain, aur woh zaroor bhadakti aag mein jhonke jaayenge}" (Surah An-Nisa 10) nazil ki, to jiske paas yateem hota woh apna khana uske khane se alag rakhta aur apna pina uske pine se alag rakhta, kisi cheez ko apne khane se alag karke uske liye rok leta yahan tak ke woh use khaaye ya woh kharaab ho jaaye, yeh unpar bohot bhaari padne laga, to unhone yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, to Allah ne "{Woh aapse yateemon ke baare mein poochte hain, kah dijiye: unke maamlaat ko sanwaarna behtar hai, aur agar tum unke sath mil jul kar rehte ho to woh tumhare bhai hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 220) nazil ki, phir unhone apna khana unke khane ke sath aur apna pina unke pine ke sath mila diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to visit me when I was sick in Bani Salamah, so I said, "O Messenger of Allah, how should I distribute my wealth among my children?" He did not respond to me, and then the verse was revealed: "Allah instructs you concerning your children" [Quran 4:11]. The two great scholars, Ash-Shafi'i and Malik, agreed on the authenticity of the narration of Shu'bah from Muhammad ibn Al-Munkadir on this matter, with different wording. And this is a reliable chain of narration, and they did not exclude it from its origin.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) meri ayaadat (bimaar-pursi) ke liye aate the jabke main Banu Salamah mein bimaar tha, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main apna maal apni aulaad ke darmiyan kaise taqseem karoon?" To aap (SAW) ne mujhe koi jawaab nahi diya, phir yeh nazil hui: "{Allah tumhein tumhari aulaad ke baare mein hukum deta hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 11). "Shaykhain ne is baab mein Shu'bah ki, Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir se, riwayat ko doosre alfaaz ke sath nikaalne par ittifaq kiya hai," aur yeh sanad sahih hai aur dono ne ise nahi nikala, dono ne iska mool nikaala hai.

e: [AI] "Because I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about three things that are dearer to me than red camels: who will be the caliph after him, and people who say that we do not have to pay zakat on our wealth and we will not give it to you, is it permissible to fight them? And about keffiyeh."
hi: "Agar main Rasulullah (SAW) se teen (baaton) ke baare mein poochta, to yeh mujhe surkh oonton se bhi zyada aziz hota - unke baad khalifa kaun hoga, aur us qaum ke baare mein jo kahe: 'Hum apne maal mein zakat maante hain lekin woh aapko ada nahi karengay,' kya unse jung karna jaayez hai?, aur kalalah (uske baare mein)."

e: [AI] I was the last person to make a deal with Omar, so I heard him saying: "The saying is what I said, and what did you say?" He replied, "I said, 'A barren woman is one who has no children.'" This is a sound Hadith according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim), but they did not include it in their collections.
hi: Main Umar (RA) ke saath waqt guzarne wala aakhri shakhs tha, maine unhein kehte suna: "Baat wahi hai jo maine kahi." Maine poocha: "Aapne kya kaha tha?" Unhone kaha: maine kaha tha: "Kalalah woh hai jiski koi aulaad na ho." Yeh sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: “There are three things, if the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had clarified them, that would have been dearer to me than the world and everything in it: a person who leaves behind no heir, usury, and the caliphate.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2727)
hi: Agar Nabi (SAW) humein in cheezon ko wazeh kar dete, to yeh mujhe duniya aur jo kuch usme hai usse zyada aziz hota - khilaafat, kalalah, aur sood (riba).

e: [AI] "Seven types of close relatives are prohibited in marriage: your mothers, daughters, sisters, aunts, nieces, daughters of brothers, and daughters of sisters. This is regarding lineage. And your nursing mothers, sisters through nursing, mothers of your wives, and stepdaughters who are fostered with you – but if you have not fostered them – there is no harm in marrying them. And also prohibited are the wives of your sons who are from your own loins, and to marry two sisters at the same time, except what has already occurred. And it is also forbidden to marry the wives of your fathers from among women." (Quran, Surah An-Nisa 4:23)
hi: "Nasab (khoon ke rishte) se saat (7) haraam hain, aur susraal (rishte-daari) se saat (7) haraam hain," phir yeh ayat padhi: "{Tumpar haraam hain tumhari maaen, tumhari betiyaan, tumhari behnein, tumhari phoophiyaan, tumhari khaalayen, bhatiji, aur bhaanji}" (Surah An-Nisa 23), yeh nasab se hai, "{Aur tumhari woh maaen jinhone tumhein doodh pilaaya, aur doodh-shareek behnein, aur tumhari saasein, aur tumhari woh saut-beti jo tumhari god mein palti hai un biwiyon se jinke sath tumne sohbat ki ho, agar tumne sohbat na ki ho to tumpar koi gunah nahi, aur tumhare apne betoon ki biwiyaan, aur do behnon ko aik sath jama karna, siwaye jo pehle guzar chuka, aur unse nikah mat karo jinse tumhare baap ne nikah kiya tha}".

e: [AI] "Seven lineages are prohibited from marrying, and seven are prohibited from marrying into." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Nasab se saat (7) aur susraal se saat (7) haraam hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He said, "This verse {And [also prohibited to you are all] married women except those your right hands possess} [Quran 4:24], he said: 'Every married woman who commits adultery, except those taken as captives.'"
hi: Ke unhone kaha: yeh ayat "{Aur shaadi-shuda auraten, siwaye jinke tumhare dayen haath maalik hon}" (Surah An-Nisa 24) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Har shaadi-shuda aurat se sambhog zina hai, siwaye us ke jo qaid ki gayi ho."

e: [AI] Abu Nadrah said, so I said, "We do not recite it like that." Then Ibn Abbas said, "By Allah, Allah revealed it like that."
hi: Abu Nadrah ne kaha: maine kaha: "Hum ise aisa nahi padhte." To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Allah ne isse isi tarah nazil kiya hai."

e: [AI] And she read this verse, "And those who guard their private parts, except from their spouses or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed - But whoever seeks beyond that" [Surah Al-Mu'minun 5]. Allah has not made them lawful for him.
hi: Aur unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur jo apni sharm-gaah ki hifaazat karte hain, siwaye apni biwiyon ya jinke unke dayen haath maalik hon, kyunke iske liye unpar koi malaamat nahi, phir jo iske ilawa (kuch) chaahe}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 5) jo Allah ne uske liye halaal na kiya ho ya jiska woh maalik na ho, to usne had se tajaawuz kiya.

e: [AI] In Surah An-Nisa, there are five verses that please me, as they grant me the world and everything in it. "Indeed, Allah does not wrong [anyone] even the weight of an atom, and if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward." (4:40) "If you avoid the major sins which you have been forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance [into Paradise]." (4:31) "Indeed, Allah does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills." (4:48) "And if, when they wronged themselves, they had come to you, [O Muhammad], and asked forgiveness of Allah and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah Accepting of repentance and Merciful." "And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allah will find Allah Forgiving and Merciful." (4:110) Abdullah said, "It pleases me that I receive the world and everything in it through these verses." It is an authentic chain, but if Abdullah heard it from his father, then there is some disagreement on that. (Sahih)
hi: "Surah An-Nisa mein paanch (5) aayaten hain jinke badle mujhe duniya aur jo kuch usme hai woh mujhe khush nahi karega: {Beshak Allah zarra barabar bhi zulm nahi karta, aur agar koi neki ho to use dugna kar deta hai aur apni taraf se bada ajr ata karta hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 40), "{Agar tum un bade gunahon se bacho jinse tumhein mana kiya gaya hai, to hum tumhare (chhote) gunah maaf kar denge aur tumhein izzat wali jagah daakhil karenge}" (Surah An-Nisa 31), "{Beshak Allah is baat ko maaf nahi karta ke uske sath shirk kiya jaaye, aur iske ilawa jise chaahe maaf kar deta hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 48), "{Aur agar woh, jab unhone apne aap par zulm kiya, tumhare paas aakar Allah se bakhshish maangte aur Rasool bhi unke liye bakhshish maangte, to woh zaroor Allah ko tauba qubool karne wala, reham karne wala paate}, {Aur jo koi buraai kare ya apne aap par zulm kare, phir Allah se bakhshish maange, woh Allah ko bakhshne wala, reham karne wala paayega}" (Surah An-Nisa 110). Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe duniya aur jo kuch usme hai woh isse zyada khush nahi karega."

e: [AI] She said, "O Messenger of Allah, do men go to war while we do not go, fight nor martyr ourselves, although we receive only half of the inheritance? Allah revealed, "And do not wish for that by which Allah has made some of you exceed others. For men is a share of what they have earned, and for women is a share of what they have earned" (Surah An-Nisa 4:32).
hi: Ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mard jung karte hain aur hum jung nahi karte aur na hi hum shaheed hote hain, jabke humein sirf aadhi mirath milti hai?" To Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur jo Allah ne tum mein se kuch ko doosron par fazeelat di hai, uski tamanna mat karo}" (Surah An-Nisa 32).

e: "To those also, to whom your right hand was pledged, give your portion." When the Emigrants came to Medina. they inherited from the Helpers without any blood-relationship with them for the brotherhood which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ established between them. When the following verse was revealed: "To (benefit) everyone we have appointed shares and heirs to property left by parent and relatives." it abrogated the verse: "To those also, to whom your right hand was pledged, give their due portion." This alliance was made for help, well wishing and cooperation. Now a legacy can be made for him. (The right to)inheritance was abolished. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2922)
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jinse tumne ahd kiya hai unhein unka hissa do}" (Surah An-Nisa 33) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Muhajireen jab Madinah aaye to woh Ansar ko unke qareebi rishtedaaron ke bagair mirath dete the, us bhai-chaare ki wajah se jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke darmiyan qaayam kiya tha, jab yeh nazil hui: "{Aur har aik ke liye humne waaris muqarrar kiye hain us maal se jo waalidain aur qareebi rishtedaar chhod jaayen}" (Surah An-Nisa 33), to isne isse mansookh kar diya, phir farmaya: "{Aur jinse tumne ahd kiya hai unhein unka hissa do}" (Surah An-Nisa 33) madad aur naseehat mein se.

e: [AI] Allah brought forth one of His servants whom He bestowed with wealth, and He asked him, "What have you done in the world?" The servant replied, "I did nothing, O Lord, except that You have provided me with wealth, so I used to engage in business transactions with people. It is part of my nature to be easy on those in debt and to show patience towards those in hardship." Allah, the Almighty, said, "I deserve that more than you. Forgive my servant." Ubay bin 'Amir al-Juhani and Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari reported that they heard this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his family.
hi: Allah apne bandon mein se aik bande ko laayega jise Allah ne maal diya tha, usse poochega: "Tumne duniya mein kya kiya?" - "{Aur woh Allah se koi baat nahi chhupaayenge}" (Surah An-Nisa 42) - woh kahega: "Aye Rab, maine kuch nahi kiya siwaye is ke ke tu ne mujhe maal diya, to main logon se len-den karta tha, aur mera aik khaslat yeh thi ke main khush-haal shakhs par narmi karta aur tangdast ko mohlat deta." Allah Ta'ala farmayega: "Main tumse zyada iska haqdaar hoon, mere bande ko maaf kar do." To Uqbah bin Amir Al-Juhani (RA) aur Abu Mas'ood Al-Ansari (RA) ne kaha: "Humne isi tarah Rasulullah (SAW) se suna hai."

e: [AI] "Concerning this verse, 'And Allah is our Lord, we were not of those who associate others with Him.' [Al-An'am 23] And He said in another verse, 'And they do not conceal from Allah [anything] of speech.' [An-Nisa' 42] Ibn Abbas said about His statement, 'And Allah is our Lord, we were not of those who associate others with Him.' [Al-An'am 23] that when they saw on the Day of Resurrection that no one enters Paradise except the Muslims, they said, 'Come, let's deny it.' So Allah sealed their mouths and their hands and feet spoke, 'And they do not conceal from Allah [anything] of speech.' [An-Nisa' 42]"
hi: Is ayat ke baare mein: "{Allah ki qasam, humare Rab, hum mushrik nahi thay}" (Surah Al-An'am 23), aur aik doosri ayat mein farmaya: "{Aur woh Allah se koi baat nahi chhupaayenge}" (Surah An-Nisa 42). To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: rahi baat unke is kehne ki "{Allah ki qasam, humare Rab, hum mushrik nahi thay}" (Surah Al-An'am 23), to jab unhone Qayamat ke din dekha ke sirf Musalman hi Jannat mein dakhil hote hain, to unhone kaha: "Aao, hum inkaar kar dein." To Allah ne unke munh par mohar lagaa di, aur unke haath aur pair bolne lage, "{Aur woh Allah se koi baat nahi chhupaayenge}" (Surah An-Nisa 42).

e: [AI] A man from the Ansar invited us before the prohibition of alcohol, so we attended the Maghrib prayer. A man came forward and recited the verse, "Say, O disbelievers" [Quran 109:1], but he got confused. Then the verse was revealed, "Do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying" [Quran 4:43].
hi: Ansar ka aik shakhs, sharaab ki mukammal haraami se pehle, humein bulaawa diya, Maghrib ki namaz ka waqt aaya, to aik shakhs aage badha aur "{Kaho: aye kaafiro}" padha, us se galti ho gayi, to yeh nazil hui: "{Namaz ke qareeb mat jao jab tum nashe mein ho yahan tak ke tumhein pata ho ke tum kya keh rahe ho}" (Surah An-Nisa 43) ayat.

e: that Abdur-Rahman bin Awf and some of his companions came to the Prophet in Makkah and said: “O Messenger of Allah! We were respected when we were idolaters and when we believed, we were humiliated.” He said: “I have been commanded to pardon, so do not fight.” Then, when Allah caused us to move to Al-Madinah, He commanded us to fight, but they refrained. Then Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, revealed: Have you not seen those who were told to hold back their hands (from fighting) and perform As-Salah” (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3086)
hi: Ke Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA) aur unke kuch saathi Nabi (SAW) ke paas Makkah mein aaye aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, hum izzat mein the jab hum mushrik the, aur jab hum imaan laaye to hum zaleel ho gaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe darguzar karne ka hukum diya gaya hai, isliye jung mat karo, apne haath rok lo." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Kya tumne un logon ko nahi dekha jinse kaha gaya tha: apne haath rok lo, namaz qaayam karo, aur zakat do, phir jab unpar jung farz ki gayi to unme se aik giroh logon se aise darne laga}" (Surah An-Nisa 77).

e: [AI] The man used to come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and greet him, then he would return to his people who were polytheists. If the Muslims made a mistake in a secret mission or in a battle, the man would set a slave free as an atonement. If the man had a contract with a group between themselves, he would pay the blood money to them and set free the slave who was taken as a captive. (Surah An-Nisa 92) The Prophet ﷺ  said: "The man should fulfill his covenant and his people should fulfill theirs, and he should set free the captive slave who has been taken by his people."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Phir agar woh kisi aisi qaum se ho jo tumhari dushman ho aur woh khud momin ho, to aik momin ghulam azaad karna}" (Surah An-Nisa 92) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: aadmi Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aata, Islam qubool karta, phir apni qaum ke paas wapas chala jaata jahan mushrikeen hote, to Musalman jung mein ya kisi dastay mein galti se use maar dete, to (qaatil) aadmi aik ghulam azaad karta, "{Aur agar woh aisi qaum se ho jinke aur tumhare darmiyan ahd ho, to uske ghar walon ko diyat pahunchaana aur aik momin ghulam azaad karna}" (Surah An-Nisa 92), unhone kaha: aadmi mu'aahid hota aur uski qaum bhi ahd wali hoti, to woh unhein uski diyat de deta aur jisne use maara tha woh aik ghulam azaad karta.

e: [AI] "It descended upon Abdullah bin Awf, who was wounded."
hi: "Yeh Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA) ke baare mein nazil hui, jo zakhmi thay."

e: [AI] I went to Aisha and asked her about this verse: "It is not in accordance with your desires, nor the desires of the People of the Scripture (Jews and Christians); whoever does evil will have the recompense thereof" [Quran 4:123]. She said: It means that whatever harm befalls you in this world, it is in accordance with the narration of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Main is ayat ke baare mein Aisha (RA) ke paas gaya: "{Yeh tumhari khwahishon par nahi, na Ahl-e-Kitaab ki khwahishon par, jo koi buraai kare use uska badla milega}" (Surah An-Nisa 123), unhone kaha: "Yeh woh museebatein hain jo duniya mein tumhein pahunchti hain." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] About Ibn Abbas in his saying, may He be glorified and exalted, "And whatever is recited to you in the Book concerning the orphans of women" [Surah An-Nisa' 127] in the beginning of the Surah of inheritance, they used to not give inheritance to a boy until he reaches the age of puberty.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jo tumhein Kitaab mein auraton ke yateemon ke baare mein padh kar sunaaya jaata hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 127) ke baare mein, Surah ke shuru mein mirath ke ahkaam mein, unhone kaha: "Woh kisi bhi ladke ko mirath nahi dete the jab tak woh baaligh na ho jaaye."

e: [AI] "He was married to a woman who was older than him, but he married a younger woman and favored her over the first wife. The first wife refused to accept this and so he divorced her temporarily until a short period remained. He said, 'If you wish, I will return to you and be patient on the harm, and if you wish, I will leave you until your waiting period is completed.' She said, 'No, reconcile with me and I will be patient on the harm.' So he reconciled with her, but then favored the younger wife over her again. She was unable to bear the harm, so he divorced her and favored the younger wife. He said, 'This is the reconciliation that we have been informed that Allah has revealed in the verse: 'And if a woman fears from her husband contempt or evasion, there is no sin upon them if they make terms of settlement between them - and settlement is best.' (Surah An-Nisa, 4:128)."
hi: Ke unke nikah mein aik aurat thi jo apni umr ka kaafi hissa guzaar chuki thi, unhone unke sath aik jawaan aurat se shaadi ki aur us kunwaari ko tarjeeh di, to unki pehli biwi ne isspar raazi honay se inkaar kiya, unhone unhein aik talaaq de di, jab unki iddat ka thoda hissa reh gaya to unhone kaha: "Agar tum chaaho to main tumse rujoo kar loon aur tum is tarjeeh par sabr karo, aur agar tum chaaho to main tumhein chhod dun yahan tak ke tumhari iddat khatam ho jaaye." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke mujhse rujoo kar lo, main is tarjeeh par sabr karungi." To unhone unse rujoo kar liya, phir unhone (jawaan biwi ko) tarjeeh di, to unhone (pehli biwi ne) is tarjeeh par sabr na kiya, to unhone unhein doosri martaba talaaq de di aur jawaan ko tarjeeh di. Unhone kaha: to yehi woh sulah hai jiske baare mein humein pata chala ke Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur agar kisi aurat ko apne shohar se bad-sulooki ya bezaari ka darr ho, to unpar koi gunah nahi ke woh aapas mein koi sulah kar len}" (Surah An-Nisa 128).

e: [AI] "O Amir al-Mu'minin, what do you think about the saying of Allah the Exalted, 'Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection, and Allah will never give the disbelievers over the believers a way [to overcome them]'" (Quran 4:141). And yet they fight and appear and kill them?" Ali said, "Lower your voice, lower your voice," then he said, "'Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection, and Allah will never give the disbelievers over the believers a way [to overcome them]'" (Quran 4:141).
hi: Aik shakhs ne poocha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai: {To Allah Qayamat ke din tumhare darmiyan faisla karega, aur Allah kaafiron ke liye momino par (ghalib aane ka) koi raasta nahi rakhega}" (Surah An-Nisa 141), jabke woh (kaafir) unse jung karte hain, unpar ghaalib aate hain, aur unhein qatl karte hain?" To Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Qareeb aao, qareeb aao," phir kaha: "{To Allah Qayamat ke din tumhare darmiyan faisla karega, aur Allah kaafiron ke liye momino par (ghalib aane ka) koi raasta nahi rakhega}" (Surah An-Nisa 141).

e: [AI] “And there is none of the People of the Book but will surely believe in him before his death” (An-Nisāʾ 4:159). He said: the coming forth (return) of Jesus, son of Mary—may God’s blessings be upon him.
hi: "{Aur Ahl-e-Kitaab mein koi bhi aisa nahi jo unki maut se pehle unpar zaroor imaan na laaye}" (Surah An-Nisa 159), unhone kaha: "Isa bin Maryam (AS) ka zahoor."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah (pbuh) ordered us to depart to the land of the Negus, so the Quraysh found out about it and they sent Amr ibn al-Aas and Ammarah ibn al-Waleed and they gathered gifts for the Negus. We arrived before them to the Negus and they came to him with gifts, and he accepted them and prostrated to Allah. Then Amr ibn al-Aas told him that there are people among us who have deviated from our religion while they are in your land. The Negus asked, "In my land?" Amr replied, "Yes." The Negus then sent for us, and Ja'far, may Allah be pleased with him, said, "No one among us will speak today, I will be your spokesperson." So we went to the Negus, while he was sitting in his council with Amr ibn al-Aas on his right and Ammarah on his left, and the priests were sitting, wearing white garments. Amr said to him, "They don't prostrate to you." So when we reached the Negus, we exposed those who were with him from the priests and monks, and they prostrated to the king. Ja'far said, "We only prostrate to Allah." The Negus asked, "And what is this?" Ja'far replied, "Indeed, Allah has sent among us His Messenger, who is the one Jesus foretold. He comes after him, and his name is Ahmad. He has commanded us to worship Allah alone, not associating anything with Him, to establish prayer, pay Zakat, and commanded us to do good and forbid evil." The people were amazed by his words. When Amr saw that, he said to the Negus, "May Allah rectify the king, for they differ with you regarding Jesus, the son of Mary." The Negus asked Ja'far, "What does your companion say about Jesus, the son of Mary?" He replied, "He says about him what is stated in the word of Allah, that he is the Spirit from Allah and His word that He sent down to the Virgin Mary, untouched by any man." The Negus picked up a stick from the ground and said, "O priests and monks, does what he says increase upon what you say about Jesus?" They replied, "This does not weigh as much as a goodbye from you. Welcome to you and to those who have come to you from him. I bear witness that he is the messenger of Allah and the one Jesus foretold. If it weren't for the fact that I am in his place of authority, I would go to him, even if that meant I had to crawl to him. Stay in my land as long as you wish, and I will provide you with food and clothing." Then he said, "Give them back their gifts."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ke hum Najashi ki zameen ki taraf jaayen, yeh baat Quraish tak pahunchi, to unhone Amr bin Al-Aas aur Umarah bin Al-Waleed ko bheja, aur Najashi ke liye tohfe jama kiye, hum unse pehle pahunche, phir woh Najashi ke paas aaye, tohfa lekar aaye, usne use qubool kiya aur unhone usse sajda kiya, phir Amr bin Al-Aas ne kaha: "Humare kuch log humare deen se hat gaye hain aur woh aapki zameen mein hain." Najashi ne unse poocha: "Meri zameen mein?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: to usne humein bulaawa bheja, Ja'far (RA) ne humse kaha: "Tum mein se koi baat na kare, aaj main tumhara khateeb (bolne wala) hoon." To hum Najashi ke paas pahunche jabke woh apni majlis mein baithe the, Amr bin Al-Aas unke dayen taraf aur Umarah unke baayen taraf, aur qissees (paadri) aur raahib do saf mein baithe the, to Amr aur Umarah ne kaha: "Yeh log aapko sajda nahi karte." Jab hum unke paas pahunche, to unke paas maujood qissees aur raahib humein daantne lage: "Baadshah ko sajda karo," to Ja'far (RA) ne kaha: "Hum sirf Allah ko sajda karte hain." Najashi ne poocha: "Woh kya baat hai?" Unhone kaha: "Beshak Allah ne humare darmiyan apna Rasool bheja hai, aur yehi woh Rasool hain jinki bishaarat Isa (AS) ne di thi ke unke baad aik Rasool aayega jiska naam Ahmad hoga, unhone humein hukum diya ke hum Allah ki ibaadat karein aur uske sath kisi ko shareek na karein, aur namaz qaayam karein aur zakat dein, aur humein achhai ka hukum diya aur buraai se mana kiya." Unhone kaha: to logon ko unki baat pasand aayi, jab Amr ne yeh dekha to usne (Najashi se) kaha: "Allah baadshah ko sudhaare, yeh log aapse Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke maamle mein ikhtilaaf rakhte hain." To Najashi ne Ja'far (RA) se poocha: "Tumhare saathi Ibn Maryam (AS) ke baare mein kya kehte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Woh unke baare mein wahi kehte hain jo Allah ne farmaya - woh Allah ki rooh aur uska kalima hai, jise usne Batool, kunwaari (Maryam AS) se paida kiya, jise kisi insaan ne chhua nahi." Unhone kaha: to Najashi ne zameen se aik lakdi uthaayi aur kaha: "Aye qissees aur raahib ke giroh, yeh log jo Ibn Maryam (AS) ke baare mein kehte hain usse zyada tum kya kehte ho? Iske barabar bhi kuch nahi. Khush-aamdeed tumhein aur us zaat ko jiski taraf se tum aaye ho, main gawahi deta hoon ke woh Allah ke Rasool hain, aur yehi woh hain jinki bishaarat Isa bin Maryam (AS) ne di thi, aur agar mere paas baadshahat na hoti to main unke paas jaata yahan tak ke unke jute uthaata, apni zameen mein jitna chaaho theharo," aur unke liye khana aur kapde ka hukum diya, aur kaha: "In dono ka tohfa inhein wapas kar do."

e: [AI] A man died and left behind a daughter and a sister from his father and mother. He said to his daughter, "Half is for you and there is nothing for the sister, whatever is left will be for his cousins." A man said to him, "Indeed, Umar ibn Al-Khattab ruled otherwise, and he gave half to the daughter and half to the sister." Ibn Abbas said, "Are you more knowledgeable or Allah?" Ma'mar said, "I did not know the reason for that until I met Ibn Tawus, and I mentioned to him the narration of Az-Zuhri. He said, 'My father informed me that he heard Ibn Abbas saying that Allah Almighty said, "If a man dies and has no child but has a sister, then she shall have half of what he left."' Ibn Abbas said, 'So you said that she will have half, even if he had children.'"
hi: Aik shakhs faut hua aur usne aik beti aur aik haqeeqi (sagi) behn chhodi, unhone (kisi ne) beti ke liye aadha (hissa) diya aur behn ke liye kuch nahi diya, baaqi (maal) uski asaba (mardana rishtedaaron) ka hoga. To aik shakhs ne unse kaha: "Lekin Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne iske ilawa faisla diya hai, unhone beti ke liye aadha aur behn ke liye aadha muqarrar kiya tha." To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Tum zyada jaante ho ya Allah?" Ma'mar ne kaha: to mujhe iska sabab nahi maloom tha yahan tak ke main Ibn Tawoos se mila, maine unhein Az-Zuhri ki hadith bataayi, unhone kaha: mujhe mere waalid ne bataya ke unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) ko kehte suna: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Agar koi aadmi wafaat paa jaaye jiski koi aulaad na ho aur uski aik behn ho, to uske liye us maal ka aadha hissa hai jo usne chhoda}" (Surah An-Nisa 176). Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "To tumne khud ye kaha ke usska aadha hissa hoga chahe uski koi aulaad ho ya na ho."

e: [AI] To me, O Jubeir, do you read the table? So I said, yes. She said, "Indeed, it is the last chapter that was revealed. So whatever you find in it as permissible, then consider it permissible, and whatever you find as forbidden, then consider it forbidden."
hi: "Aye Jubair, kya tum Surah Al-Ma'idah padhte ho?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Khabardar, yeh aakhri Surah hai jo nazil hui, isliye ismein jo halaal paao use halaal maano, aur jo haraam paao use haraam maano."

e: "The last Surah revealed was Surat Al-Ma'idah and Al-Fath." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3063)
hi: Ke "aakhri Surah jo nazil hui, woh Surah Al-Ma'idah thi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) commanded us to kill the dogs, so the people said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is permissible for us from this nation that you have commanded us to kill?" So Allah revealed, "They ask you, [O Muhammad], what has been made lawful for them. Say, 'Lawful for you are [all] good foods and [game caught by] what you have trained of hunting animals which you train as Allah has taught you.'" [Surah Al-Ma'idah: 4]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein kutton ko qatl karne ka hukum diya, log kehne lage: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), is Ummat mein se humare liye kya halaal hai jise aap ne qatl karne ka hukum diya hai?" To Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Woh aapse poochte hain unke liye kya halaal kiya gaya hai, kaho: tumhare liye paak cheezein halaal ki gayi hain, aur woh jaanwar jinhein tumne sikhaaya ho shikaar karne ke liye}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 4).

e: [AI] "Indeed, the meat of the Jews and Christians is permissible for you to consume because they believe in the Torah and the Gospel."
hi: "Yahoodiyon aur Nasaara ke zibah kiye huay jaanwar sirf isliye halaal hain kyunke woh Tauraat aur Injeel par imaan laate hain."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas said regarding His statement, the Exalted: "He made among you prophets" [Surah Al-Ma'idah, verse 20]. (He said) He made from among you prophets, and "made you kings" [Surah Al-Ma'idah, verse 20]. The woman and the servant said: "He gives you what He has not given to anyone among the worlds" [Surah Al-Ma'idah, verse 20]. Those, on that day, who are between their hands, said.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Usne tum mein Ambiya banaaye}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 20) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Usne tum mein se Ambiya banaaye," "{Aur tumhein baadshah banaaya}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 20), unhone kaha: "Biwi aur khaadim (rakhne wala)," "{Aur tumhein woh diya jo duniya walon mein se kisi ko nahi diya}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 20), unhone kaha: "Jo us waqt unke saath rehne wale (Bani Israel) the."

e: [AI] Regarding Ali, in his saying, Allah says, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us from among the jinn and mankind and we will put them under our feet." Shaytan (Satan) said, and so did the son of Adam who killed his brother.
hi: Ali (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aye humare Rab, humein woh dono dikha jinhone humein jinnaat aur insaano mein se gumraah kiya, hum unhein apne pairon ke neeche rakhein}" ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Iblees, aur Aadam (AS) ki aulaad mein se woh jisne apne bhai ko qatl kiya."

e: [AI] He heard a reader reciting, "O you who have believed, fear Allah and seek the means [of nearness] to Him." (Quran 5:35) He said, "The near ones know that the son of Umm Abd is closest to Allah as a means, according to the criteria of Bukhari and Muslim, among the companions of Muhammad peace be upon him."
hi: Ke unhone aik qaari ko "{Aye imaan walo, Allah se daro aur uski taraf waseela (qurb ka zariya) talaash karo}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 35) padhte suna, unhone kaha: "Waseela ka matlab hai qurb (nazdeeki)." Phir unhone kaha: "Muhammad (SAW) ke jaane-maane sahaba ko yeh pata tha ke Umm Abd ke bete (Abdullah bin Mas'ud RA) unme se Allah ke sabse zyada qareeb waseela rakhne wale hain." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Two abrogated verses from Surah Al-Ma'idah are: "So judge between them or turn away from them" [5:42], and Allah, Exalted and Majestic, revealed: "And judge between them by what Allah has revealed and do not follow their inclinations." [5:49] "The chain of transmission is authentic (sahih) and they have not withdrawn it."
hi: Surah Al-Ma'idah ki do mansookh aayaten: "{To unke darmiyan faisla karo ya unse mun mod lo}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 42), phir Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur unke darmiyan faisla karo jo Allah ne nazil kiya hai, aur unki khwahishon ki pairavi mat karo}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 49). "Isnad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Sahih.

e: We were with Ḥudhayfah, and they mentioned the verse, "And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed – then it is those who are the disbelievers." [Māʾidah 5:44] Then a man from the people said, "Indeed, this is concerning the Children of Israel." Ḥudhayfah responded ˹sarcastically˺, "What an excellent example are ʿyour˺ brothers in the Children of Israel: that all sweetness is for you and all bitterness is for them? Not at all! By the One in whose hand is my soul, until you follow the Sunnah (their legacy) with the Sunnah (as your legacy), step by step, just as you follow the Qudhah with the Qudhah."
hi: Hum Hudhaifah (RA) ke paas thay, unhone "{Aur jo koi Allah ke nazil kiye huay ke mutabiq faisla na kare, to yehi log kaafir hain}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 44) ka zikr kiya, to logon mein se aik shakhs ne kaha: "Yeh Bani Israel ke baare mein hai." Hudhaifah (RA) ne kaha: "Kitne achhe bhai hain Bani Israel, kya meethi cheez tumhari aur kadwi unki? Hargiz nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum bhi unki sunnat ki pairavi karogay jaise teer ke do baraabar par milte hain."

e: [AI] "Regarding the nation, those who do not rule by what Allah has revealed, they are the disbelievers." [Al-Ma'idah 44] This is kufr (disbelief) in addition to kufr (disbelief).
hi: Millat (poora deen chhodne) ke baare mein: "{Aur jo koi Allah ke nazil kiye huay ke mutabiq faisla na kare, to yehi log kaafir hain}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 44) - yeh kufr, kufr se kam (darje ka) hai.

e: [AI] I heard 'Ayyad al-Ash'ari say, when the verse {So Allah will bring a people whom He loves and who love Him} [Surah Al-Ma'idah, verse 54] was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "They are your people, O Abu Musa," and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  pointed with his hand towards Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari.
hi: Maine Iyad Al-Ash'ari ko kehte suna: jab yeh nazil hui: "{To Allah aisi qaum le aayega jinhein woh mohabbat karega aur jo usse mohabbat karengi}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 54), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhari qaum hain, Aye Abu Musa," aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne haath se Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was on guard until this verse was revealed, "And Allah protects you from the people." [Hadeeth from Al-Ma'idah 67] So, the Prophet ﷺ  removed his head from the dome and said to them, "O people, go away, for Allah has protected me."
hi: Nabi (SAW) pehra dete rahe yahan tak ke yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Aur Allah tumhein logon se bachaayega}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 67), to Nabi (SAW) ne apna sar khaimay se bahar nikaala aur unse farmaya: "Aye logo, chale jao, Allah ne mujhe (unki hifaazat se) bacha liya hai."

e: [AI] "With the nation of Muhammad ﷺ , both his nation and his people bear witness to his message and bear witness for the messengers that they have conveyed."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To humein gawahi dene walon ke sath likh}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 53) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Muhammad (SAW) ki Ummat ke sath, aur unki Ummat unke pigham pahunchaane ki gawahi degi, aur Rusul ke liye gawahi degi ke unhone (pigham) pahuncha diya."

e: [AI] "Approach the people and they started feeding him. There was a man among them in a corner. Abdullah said, 'Approach.' He said, 'I do not want to.' Abdullah asked, 'Why?' He said, 'Because I have prohibited breastfeeding.' Abdullah said, 'This is from the steps of Satan.' Abdullah said, 'O you who have believed, do not prohibit the good things which Allah has made lawful to you and do not transgress. Indeed, Allah does not like transgressors.' [Al-Ma'idah: 87] Approach, eat, and cleanse your right hand, for this is from the steps of Satan."
hi: Logon se kaha gaya: "Qareeb aao," to woh use khilaane lage, aur unme se aik shakhs aik konay mein tha, to Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Qareeb aao." Usne kaha: "Main iski khwahish nahi rakhta." Unhone poocha: "Kyun?" Usne kaha: "Kyunke maine doodh (peena) apne aap par haraam kar liya hai." To Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh shaitan ke qadmon mein se hai." Phir Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "{Aye imaan walo, Allah ki halaal ki hui paak cheezon ko haraam mat karo, aur had se tajaawuz mat karo, beshak Allah had se tajaawuz karne walon ko pasand nahi karta}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 87), "qareeb aao aur khaao, aur apni qasam ka kaffaara do, kyunke yeh shaitan ke qadmon mein se hai."

e: [AI] He witnessed two Christian men testify about the will of a Muslim man who died in their presence. He said, "The family of the deceased had doubts about the will, so they brought both of them to Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari. He then made both of them swear by Allah after the Asr prayer that they did not purchase it for a price nor hide the testimony of Allah. If they did, then they would be among the sinners." Aamir said, "Then Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari said, 'By Allah, this is a true story, certified by the condition of the two Shaykhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim), and they did not exclude it from their collections.'"
hi: Ke unke paas do Nasrani (Christian) aadmiyon ne aik Musalman aadmi ki wasiyat ke baare mein gawahi di jo unke yahan faut hua tha. Wasiyat ke waarison ko shak hua, to woh unhein Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) ke paas laaye, unhone Asr ki namaz ke baad unhein Allah ki qasam dilaayi ke unhone iske badle koi qeemat nahi khareedi na Allah ki gawahi chhupaayi, warna woh gunahgaaron mein se honge. Aamir ne kaha: phir Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh sach mein aik waaqia hai." "Yeh sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "Quraysh to the Prophet (pbuh): "Invoke Allah, your Lord, to make Safa into gold for us, and we will believe in you." The Prophet (pbuh) asked, "Will you really do so?" They replied, "Yes." So, he supplicated to Allah, and Jibril came to him and said, "Verily, your Lord greets you with peace and says, 'If you wish, I will make Safa into gold for them, and whoever among them disbelieves, I will punish them with a punishment that I will not inflict upon anyone from the worlds. And if you wish, I will open for them the doors of repentance and mercy.'" The Prophet (pbuh) said, "O Lord, the door of repentance and mercy.""
hi: Quraish ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Apne Rab Allah se dua kijiye ke woh Safa ko sona bana de, aur hum aap par imaan laayenge." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum aisa karoge?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To aap (SAW) ne Allah se dua ki, Jibra'il (AS) unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Aapka Rab aap par salaam bhejta hai aur farmata hai: agar tum chaaho to main unke liye Safa ko sona bana dun, phir jo unme se kufr kare, main use aisi saza dunga jaisi duniya walon mein se kisi ko nahi dunga, aur agar tum chaaho, to main unke liye tauba aur rehmat ke darwaze khol dun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Rab, tauba aur rehmat ka darwaza."

e: [AI] When Surah Al-An'am was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  glorified and then said, "This Surah has gathered a multitude of angels that fill the horizons."
hi: Jab Surah Al-An'am nazil hui, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne tasbeeh ki, phir farmaya: "Is Surah ke sath itne farishte aaye ke unhone ufaq (aasman ka kinara) bhar diya."

e: [AI] "They have two periods: the term of this worldly life and a term in the Hereafter, with a fixed time determined by Him alone. No one knows it except Allah. And His words: 'And even if We had sent down to you a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands' [Surah Al-An'am 6:7] - He said: They touched it and looked at it, but they did not believe in it."
hi: "Yeh do muddatein hain - duniya ki muddat aur aakhirat mein aik muqarrar muddat jise sirf Allah jaanta hai," aur unke farmaan "{Aur agar hum tumpar kaghaz mein likhi hui koi kitaab nazil karte aur woh isse apne haathon se choo lete}" (Surah Al-An'am 7) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh ise chhoote aur dekhte, phir bhi isspar imaan na laate."

e: [AI] She stayed in the house of Abu Talib, who used to forbid the polytheists from harming the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and kept himself away from what he had brought.
hi: Yeh Abu Talib ke baare mein nazil hui, jo mushrikeen ko Rasulullah (SAW) ko takleef pahunchaane se rokte the, aur jo (deen) aap (SAW) laaye the usse door rehte the. Sahih.

e: [AI] It descended upon Abu Talib, he was "Forbidding the polytheists from harming him and keeping away from him." The narration of Hamza bin Habib is authentic according to the criteria of the two Sheikhs, and they did not exclude it.
hi: Yeh Abu Talib ke baare mein nazil hui, jo "mushrikeen ko unhein takleef pahunchaane se rokte the aur khud unse door rehte the." Hamzah bin Habib ki hadith Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "O Muhammad, we know that you maintain family ties and speak the truth, and we do not consider you a liar. However, we reject the message that you have brought. So Allah, the Almighty, revealed: 'We know that what they say grieves you. Indeed, they do not deny you [Muhammad], but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers reject.'" [Surah Al-An'am, verse 33]
hi: Abu Jahl ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Aye Muhammad, humein pata hai ke aap rishtedaari nibhaate hain aur sach bolte hain, aur hum aapko jhoota nahi kehte, lekin hum us cheez ko jhutlaate hain jo aap laaye hain." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Humein pata hai ke jo woh kehte hain woh aapko ghum pahunchaata hai, beshak woh aapko jhoota nahi kehte, balke zalim log Allah ki aayaton ka inkaar karte hain}" (Surah Al-An'am 33).

e: [AI] Abu Huraira said about the saying of Allah Almighty {Nations like you} [Al-An'am: 38], "All creatures will be gathered on the Day of Judgment: animals, beasts, birds, and everything. Then, Allah's justice will extend to the extent that He will take vengeance for the horned animals from those who wronged them. Then He will say, 'Be dust.' That is what the disbeliever will say, 'I wish I was dust.' " Jafar al-Jizri is the son of Burqan, who was cited as evidence by a Muslim, and it is authentic according to his conditions, and it has not been rejected.
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ummat tumhare hi jaisi}" (Surah Al-An'am 38) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Qayamat ke din tamaam makhlooq ikattha ki jayegi - jaanwar, chaupaaye, parinde, aur har cheez, yahan tak ke Allah ka insaaf itna hoga ke woh bina seeng wale (jaanwar) ka haq seeng wale se dilaayega, phir kahega: 'Mitti ban jaao,' aur yehi hai jiske baare mein farmaya: {Kaafir kahega: kaash main mitti ho jaata}" (Surah An-Naba 40). Ja'far Al-Jidhri, yeh Ibn Burqaan hain, Muslim ne unse hujjat li hai, aur yeh Muslim ki shart par sahih hai magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "This is in Ibrahim and his companions, it is not in this Ummah."
hi: "Yeh Ibrahim (AS) aur unke saathiyon ke baare mein hai, is Ummat ke baare mein nahi."

e: [AI] "The settled (meaning a fetus) is what was in the womb, whether it is alive or has already died, and the entrusted is what is in the grave."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Woh uski qaraargaah aur amaanat-gaah jaanta hai}" (Surah Hud 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Qaraargaah woh hai jo rehm (maa ke pait) mein ho, chahe zinda ho ya faut ho chuka ho, aur amaanat-gaah woh hai jo (baap ki) pusht mein ho."

e: [AI] Oh, for your mother! That is his light, and he is his light. When he manifests with his light, nothing can reach him.
hi: Unse poocha gaya: "Kya Muhammad (SAW) ne apne Rab ko dekha?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, dekha, goya unke qadam sabz (roshan) cheez par thay, jiske aage moti ka aik parda tha." To maine poocha: "Aye Ibn Abbas, kya Allah nahi farmata: {Aankhein use nahi paa saktin, aur woh aankhon ko paa leta hai}" (Surah Al-An'am 103)?" Unhone kaha: "Tumhari maa na ho, yeh uska noor hai, aur woh khud uska noor hai, jab woh apne noor ke sath jhalak dikhaata hai to koi cheez use paa nahi sakti."

e: [AI] The cargo is what a camel and the small rugs carried.
hi: "Hamoola woh (jaanwar) hai jo oonton mein se bojh uthaate hain, aur farsh chhote (jaanwar) hain."

e: the Messenger of Allah forbade (the flesh of) domesticated donkeys on the Day of Khaibar. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4336)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne "Khaybar ke din ghar palu gadhon ka gosht khaane se mana kiya." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas, weakness, and stupidity are part of fate.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA): "Aajizi aur hoshiyaari (chaturaai) dono taqdeer mein se hain."

e: [AI] I heard Ibn Abbas saying, "Indeed, in the animals there are firm signs, which are the mother of the Book." Then he recited the verse, "{Say, 'Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you'}" [Al-An'am 151].
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko kehte suna: "Beshak Surah Al-An'am mein aisi aayaten hain jo mustaqil (saaf aur pukhta) hain, yehi Kitaab ki jad hain," phir unhone padha: "{Kaho: aao, main tumhein padh kar sunaaun jo tumhare Rab ne tumpar haraam kiya hai}" (Surah Al-An'am 151) ayat.

e: When Allah, Most High, revealed the verses: "Come not nigh to the orphan's property except to improve it". And "Those who unjustly eat up the property of orphans", everyone who had an orphan with him went and separated his food from his (orphan's) food, and his drink from his drink, and began to detain the remaining food which he (the orphan) himself ate or spoiled. This fell heavy on them, and they mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. So Allah, Most High, revealed the verse: "They ask thee concerning orphans. Say: The best thing to do is what is for their good; if ye mix their affairs with yours, they are your brethren." Then they mixed their food with his food and their drink with his drink. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2871)
hi: Jab Allah ne "{Aur yateem ke maal ke qareeb mat jao siwaye us tareeqe ke jo sabse achha ho}" (Surah Al-An'am 152), "{Beshak jo log yateemon ka maal zulm se khaate hain, woh apne peton mein sirf aag hi bhar rahe hain, aur woh zaroor bhadakti aag mein jhonke jaayenge}" (Surah An-Nisa 10) nazil ki, to jiske paas yateem hota woh apna khana uske khane se alag rakhta aur apna pina uske pine se alag rakhta, kisi cheez ko apne khane se alag karke uske liye rok leta yahan tak ke woh use khaaye ya woh kharaab ho jaaye, yeh unpar bohot bhaari padne laga, to unhone yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, to Allah ne "{Woh aapse yateemon ke baare mein poochte hain, kah dijiye: unke maamlaat ko sanwaarna behtar hai, aur agar tum unke sath mil jul kar rehte ho to woh tumhare bhai hain}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 220) nazil ki, phir unhone apna khana unke khane ke sath aur apna pina unke pine ke sath mila diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever pledges allegiance to me based on these verses," and then he recited: {Say: "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited for you"} [Al-An'am 151], until he finished reciting the three verses. "Whoever fulfills their pledge, their reward is upon Allah. Whoever falls short in anything, Allah will hold them accountable for it in this world. And whoever delays their accountability until the Hereafter, their matter is in the hands of Allah - if He wills, He will punish them, and if He wills, He will forgive them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaun mujhse in aayaton par bay'at karega?" Phir aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Kaho: aao, main tumhein padh kar sunaaun jo tumhare Rab ne tumpar haraam kiya hai}" (Surah Al-An'am 151) yahan tak ke teen aayaton ko mukammal kiya, "to jo poori kare uska ajr Allah par hai, aur jo koi kami kare aur Allah ise duniya mein hi pakad le, to yehi uski saza hogi, aur jo aakhirat tak (mamla) taal de, to uska maamla Allah ke supurd hai, chaahe to use azaab de aur chaahe to use maaf kar de."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew a line for us, then he drew lines on his right and left. Then he said, "This is the way of Allah, and these are different paths, on every path there is a devil calling towards it." [And, "This is My path, which is straight, so follow it, and do not follow other paths, for they will lead you away from His path."] (Surah Al-An'am, 153)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humare liye aik lakeer kheenchi, phir uske dayen aur baayen taraf (kai) lakeerein kheenchi, phir farmaya: "Yeh Allah ka raasta hai," "aur yeh (doosre) raste hain, har raste par aik shaitan hai jo uski taraf bulaata hai," "{Aur beshak yeh mera seedha raasta hai, isliye ispar chalo, aur (doosre) raston par mat chalo, warna woh tumhein uski raah se juda kar denge}" (Surah Al-An'am 153).

e: [AI] They were created in the loins of men and formed in the wombs of women.
hi: "Woh mardon ki pushton mein paida kiye jaate hain aur auraton ki kokhon mein shakl paate hain."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  it was said, "Do not make faces" and he mentioned the rest of the hadith.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chehron ko bigaado mat (na maaro)," aur baaqi hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] God created four things with His own hand: the Throne, the Gardens of Eden, Adam, and the Pen. He concealed himself from creation through four elements: fire, darkness, light, and darkness.
hi: "Allah ne chaar cheezein apne haath se banaayi - Arsh, Jannat-ul-Firdaus, Aadam (AS), aur Qalam, aur usne apne aap ko makhlooq se chaar cheezon se chhupaaya - aag, andhera, roshni, aur andhera."

e: [AI] "The clothing of Adam and Eve was like fingernails. When they tasted the tree, they started sewing for themselves from the leaves of paradise." He said, "It is the fig leaves."
hi: "Aadam (AS) aur Hawwa (AS) ka libaas nakhun jaisa tha, jab dono ne darakht ka maza chakha to woh apne oopar Jannat ke pattay silne lage." Unhone kaha: "Woh anjeer ke pattay the."

e: During the pre-Islamic days women circumambulated the Ka'ba nakedly, and said: Who would provide cloth to cover the one who is circumambulating the Ka'ba so that she would cover her private parts? And then she would say: Today will be exposed the whole or the part and what is exposed I shall not make it lawful. It was in this connection that the verse was revealed:" Adorn yourself at every place of worship" (vii. 31). (Using translation from Muslim 3028)
hi: Jahiliyat mein aurat baghair kapdon ke Ka'bah ka tawaf karti thi, aur uski sharm-gaah par sirf aik kapda hota, woh kehti: "Aaj kuch hissa ya poora zaahir hoga, jo zaahir ho jaaye main use halaal nahi maanti," to yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Kaho: kisne Allah ki zeenat ko haraam kiya}" (Surah Al-A'raf 32).

e: [AI] The people of the heights are a group whose good deeds have surpassed the fire, and their bad deeds have kept them away from paradise. When their eyes are turned towards the companions of the fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not make us among the unjust people." While they are in this state, their Lord will look upon them and say, "Rise, enter paradise, for I have forgiven you."
hi: Asaab-ul-A'raf (oonchai walon ke saathi) woh log hain jinki nekiyaan unhein Jahannam se bacha lein aur jinki buraiyan unhein Jannat mein daakhil honay se rok dein, jab unki nazrein Jahannam walon ki taraf jaayen, to woh kahenge: "Aye humare Rab, humein zaalim qaum ke sath mat rakh." Jab woh isi haal mein hongay, tera Rab unpar nazar karega aur farmayega: "Khade ho jao, Jannat mein dakhil ho jao, kyunke maine tumhein maaf kar diya hai."

e: [AI] When the Prophet passed by the rock, he said, "Do not ask for signs, as a righteous people had asked for signs before and they were given the miracle of a she-camel coming out of this rock and returning to it. But they disobeyed the order of their Lord and harmed the she-camel, so they were seized by a blast and all of them were destroyed except one man who was in the sanctuary of Allah." It was asked, "Who was he?" He replied, "Abu Rigal. When he left the sanctuary, he was afflicted with the same calamity that had befallen his people."
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) Al-Hijr se guzre, to farmaya: "Nishaaniyan mat maango, kyunke Salih (AS) ki qaum ne nishaaniyan maangi thin, to woh - ya'ni oontni - is raaste se aati aur is raaste se jaati thi, phir unhone apne Rab ke hukum se sarkashi ki aur usse maar dala, to unhein aik chingaar (aawaz) ne pakad liya, to Allah ne aasman ke neeche unme se sabko halaak kar diya siwaye aik shakhs ke jo Allah ki harmat waali zameen mein tha." Poocha gaya: "Woh kaun tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Righaal, jab woh harmat se bahar nikla to usspar wahi museebat aayi jo uski qaum par aayi thi."

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ in his statement, Almighty Allah says, "And when his Lord manifested His glory before the mountain, He made it crumble to dust." [Surah Al-A'raf 143]. Hamad said, "This is how it is," and he placed his thumb on the joint of the right pinky finger. Humeid bin Thabit asked, "Do you narrate using something like this?" Thabit then struck the chest of Humeid with his hand and said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated with it, and I do not narrate with it?"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Phir jab uske Rab ne pahaad par tajalli farmaayi to usse chknaa-choor kar diya}" (Surah Al-A'raf 143) ke baare mein, Hammad ne kaha: aise, aur unhone apna angootha apni dayen chhoti ungli ke jod par rakha. Unhone kaha: to Humaid bin Thabit ne poocha: "Aap aisi hadith bayan karte hain?" Unhone kaha: to Thabit ne Humaid ke seene par apne haath se aik dhakka maara aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) isse isi tarah bayan karte hain, aur main isse bayan na karoon?"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "News is not like seeing. Indeed, Allah informed Musa (Moses) about what his people did with the calf, but he did not throw down the tablets. When he saw what they had done, he threw down the tablets."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khabar dekhne ke barabar nahi, Allah ne Musa (AS) ko unki qaum ke bachhre (ki ibaadat) ke baare mein khabar di, to unhone (Tauraat ki) takhtiyaan nahi phenki, jab unhone khud dekha jo unhone kiya tha, to takhtiyaan phenk di."

e: [AI] Harun came to the Samiri while he was making the calf, so he said to him, "What are you doing?" He replied, "It does not benefit nor harm." So Harun said, "O Allah, grant him what he requested in himself." When he left, he said, "O Allah, I ask You that he remains dusty and whenever he prostrates, he remains dusty, and when he lifts his head, he remains dusty, and this is the supplication of Harun."
hi: Harun (AS) As-Samiri ke paas aaye jabke woh bachhra bana rahe the, unhone poocha: "Tum kya bana rahe ho?" Usne kaha: "Aisi cheez jo na faida de na nuqsaan pahunchaaye." Unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, jo usne apne dil mein maanga hai woh use de de," jab woh chala gaya to unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, main tujhse maangta hoon ke yeh aawaz kare," to usne aawaz ki, aur jab bhi woh sajda karta to aawaz karta, aur jab apna sar uthaata to aawaz karta, aur yeh Harun (AS) ki dua ki wajah se tha.

e: [AI] He said: "Indeed, the people of the calf said, 'This is a god with a singular form that is a strong, red wheat, with a black hair.' That is the saying of Allah Almighty: 'So We replaced the word which had been asserted upon them' [Quran 2:59]. When they refused to prostrate, Allah commanded the mountain to fall upon them, and they all perished. Then they looked at the other side of the mountain as Allah lifted it from them. They said, 'The prostration that is most beloved to Allah is the one that removes punishment from us.' So they prostrated on that part of the mountain. This is the saying of Allah Almighty: 'And [mention] when We raised the mountain above them as if it was a dark cloud' [Quran 7:171]."
hi: Beshak bachhray ki (ibaadat karne) walon ne kaha: "Hata Saqmatha Azbah Mazbah," jo Arabi mein hai: "surkh, mazboot gehun jismein aik kaala baal ho," aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{To jinhone zulm kiya unhone us baat ki jagah doosri baat badal di jo unse kahi gayi thi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 59). Jab unhone sajda karne se inkaar kiya, unhone kaha: Allah ne pahaad ko hukum diya ke woh unpar gir jaaye, unhone dekha ke woh unhein dhaanp raha hai, to woh sajde ki halat mein aik taraf gir gaye aur doosri taraf se (pahaad ko) dekhte rahe, to Allah ne unpar reham kiya aur ise unpar se hataa diya, to unhone kaha: "Koi sajda Allah Ta'ala ko itna pasand nahi jitna woh sajda jisse tumhein azaab se bachaaya gaya," to woh isi wajah se aik taraf jhuk kar sajda karte hain, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Aur jab humne pahaad ko unke oopar uthaaya jaise woh aik saaya ho}" (Surah Al-A'raf 171).

e: [AI] Moses called upon Allah, so Allah sent seventy and made his supplication when he called upon for those who believe in Muhammad and follow his words, "So forgive us, have mercy upon us, and You are the best of forgivers" [Al-A'raf: 155], "So I will record it for those who fear Me and give zakah" [Al-A'raf: 156], and those who follow Muhammad and his family and send blessings upon him.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Musa (AS) ne apni qaum mein se hamare wa'de ke liye sattar (70) aadmi chune}" (Surah Al-A'raf 155) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Musa (AS) ne dua ki, to Allah ne sattar (aadmi) bheje, aur jab unhone dua ki, to unki dua un logon ke liye rakhi jo Muhammad (SAW) par imaan laaye aur unki pairavi ki, unke farmaan mein: "{To humein maaf kar de aur hum par reham kar, aur tu sabse behtareen maaf karne wala hai}" (Surah Al-A'raf 155), "{To main ise un logon ke liye likh dunga jo (Allah se) darte hain aur zakat dete hain}" (Surah Al-A'raf 156), aur jo Muhammad (SAW) ki pairavi karte hain.

e: [AI] "Do you know the story of Ayyub (Job)? I said, what is the story of Ayyub? He said, there was a village where there were people from the Jews, so Allah forbade them from hunting whales on the Sabbath. Their whales used to come to them on their Sabbath, appearing white like pregnant women. But on days other than the Sabbath, they could not find them nor catch them except with great difficulty and hardship. So some of them said to others, or someone said among them, "If we take them on a day other than the Sabbath and eat them, let us do it." So a household among them did that. They took the whales and ate them, and then they roasted them. Their neighbors smelled the roasting and said, "By Allah, we do not see anything of the people of so-and-so." Others among them took more of the whales until this behavior spread among them and became widespread. They eventually separated into three groups: one that ate, one that forbade, and one that asked, 'Why do you advise a people whom Allah will destroy or punish with a severe punishment?' [Quran 7:164]. The group that forbade said, 'We warn you of Allah's anger and punishment that may hit you with sinking or stoning or some of the punishments that He has.' And by Allah, we do not hide anything from you while you are present.' They then left the city and stayed away until the next day, then they came and knocked on the door of the city, but no one answered them. So they brought a ladder and leaned it against the wall, and one from among them climbed over it. He called out, 'O servants of Allah, due to their sins, they were transformed into monkeys, with tails.' They knew their lineages were from human beings, while the human beings did not know that their lineage had become that of monkeys. The person would sniff at his male relative, sticking to him, and the human being would say to him, 'Are you so and so?' The monkey would point to his head, meaning yes, and would weep. The female monkey would go to her male relative, sticking to him, and the human being would say to her, 'Are you so-and-so?' She would point to her head, meaning yes, and would weep. The human beings then said to each other, 'Indeed, we warned you of Allah's punishment, that He would strike you with a crumbling or a transformation or some of the punishment that He has.' Ibn Abbas said, 'I do not know what the third group did.' Ibn Abbas also said, 'How many times have we seen an evil action and we did not forbid it?' Ikrimah said, 'I then said, what do you see that Allah made me do?' They had denied and disliked what they said when they asked, 'Why do you advise a people whom Allah will destroy or punish with a severe punishment?' So my statement amazed them, and Allah ordered me to wear two heavy coats, so they covered me with them."
hi: "Kya tumhein Aylah (jagah) ka pata hai?" Maine kaha: "Aylah kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aik basti thi jismein Yahoodi log rehte the, to Allah ne unpar Sanichar (Saturday/Sabbath) ke din machhliyan pakadna haraam kar diya, aur unki machhliyan Sabbath ke din unke paas khule aam, safed, mote-taze, garbhwati oontniyon jaisi, unke gharon aur imaraaton tak aa jaati thin, jab Sabbath ke ilawa koi aur din hota to unhein woh nahi milti thin siwaye sakht mushkil aur mehnat ke. Unme se kisi ne kaha: 'Shayad agar hum unhein Sanichar ke din pakad lein aur unhein kisi aur din khaayen (to koi harj nahi).' To unme se aik ghar walon ne aisa kiya, unhone pakda aur bhoona, unke padosiyon ko bhoonay hue ki khushbu aayi, unhone kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, humein fulan qabile ke logon mein kuch (ajeeb) nazar nahi aa raha,' to doosron ne bhi pakadna shuru kar diya yahan tak ke yeh unme phail gaya aur badh gaya, to woh teen giroh mein baant gaye - aik giroh ne khaaya, aik giroh ne mana kiya, aur aik giroh ne kaha: {Tum aisi qaum ko kyun naseehat karte ho jisse Allah halaak karne wala hai ya sakht azaab dene wala hai} (Surah Al-A'raf 164). To mana karne wale giroh ne kaha: 'Hum tumhein Allah ke ghusse aur uski saza se daraate hain, ke tumhein zameen mein dhansaa diya jaaye ya kisi cheez ki barsaat ho ya jo bhi azaab uske paas ho, Allah ki qasam, hum tumhare sath us jagah nahi rahenge jahan tum ho,' aur woh shehar-panah se bahar nikal gaye, agli subah wapas aaye, unhone shehar-panah ke darwaze par dastak di, koi jawaab nahi mila, to woh seedhi lekar aaye aur usse shehar-panah se laga diya, phir unme se aik chadhne wala chadha, usne kaha: 'Aye Allah ke bando, bandar, Allah ki qasam, unki dumein hain,' teen martaba cheekha, phir shehar-panah se utra, darwaza khola, log unke paas dakhil huay, to bandaron ne insaan mein se apne rishtedaaron ko pehchaana lekin insaan bandaron mein se apne rishtedaaron ko nahi pehchaan sake." Unhone kaha: to bandar apne rishtedaar aur qareebi ke paas jaata, uske sath ragadta aur chipakta, aur insaan poochta: "Kya tum fulan ho?" To woh apna sar hilaakar "haan" ka ishara karta aur rota, aur bandariya apne rishtedaar aur qareebi ke paas jaati, aur woh usse poochta: "Kya tum fulani ho?" To woh apna sar hilaakar "haan" ka ishara karti aur roti, to insaan unse kehte: "Kya humne tumhein Allah ke ghusse aur uski saza se nahi daraaya tha ke tumhein zameen mein dhansaa diya jaaye ya masakh (roop badalna) ho ya jo bhi azaab uske paas ho?" Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "To suno, Allah farmata hai: 'Phir humne un logon ko bacha liya jo buraai se mana karte the, aur zulm karne walon ko sakht azaab se pakad liya kyunke woh na-farmani karte the,' to mujhe nahi pata teesre giroh ka kya hua." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "To hum ne kitni buraai dekhi hai jisse humne mana nahi kiya." Ikrimah ne kaha: to maine kaha: "Aapki kya raay hai, Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare? Unhone (mana karne walon ne) inkaar aur napasandeedgi zaahir ki jab unhone kaha: 'Tum aisi qaum ko kyun naseehat karte ho jisse Allah halaak karne wala hai ya sakht azaab dene wala hai?'" To unhein (Ibn Abbas ko) meri yeh baat achhi lagi, aur unhone mere liye do mote jode ka hukum diya, to unhone mujhe woh pehnaaye.

e: [AI] He gathered them all that day, and it was nothing but existence until the Day of Resurrection. Then He made them souls, then formed them and gave them the power of speech. And He took from them the covenant and the pledge, and He made them testify upon themselves, "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we testify." [This] lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were unaware of this." Or [lest] you say, "It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?" [Allah] said, "I swear by Myself, and I bear witness on you all the heavens and the earths, and I bear witness upon your father Adam, 'Am I not your Lord?' They said, 'Yes, we testify.' [This] lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, 'Indeed, we were unaware of this.' Or lest you should say, 'It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?' He said, "Indeed, I bear witness over all of you that I am free from whatever you associate with Me. Indeed, the Messengers will come to you with My reminders and My covenant, and they will present My Books to you." They said, "We bear witness that You are our Lord and our God. You have no Lord besides You, and we have no god besides You." And their father Adam raised them, so He looked at them, and He saw richness and poverty, beauty and otherwise. He said, "My Lord, if You had balanced Your servants." He said, "I love to return the gratitude." And among them were seen prophets like bright lamps. They were given a separate covenant in regards to Prophet-hood and Messengership. This is the saying of Allah, the Exalted, "[And mention] when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah." (33:7) And His saying, "So direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fitrah of Allah upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allah." (30:30) And His saying, "This is a warner of the warners of old." (53:56) And His saying, "And We had not found for most of them any covenant, but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient." (7:102) And His saying, "Then We sent following their footsteps Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except that they did so seeking the approval of Allah." So they did not observe it with due observance. (57:27) He knew in His knowledge those who would deny what He would affirm and those who would affirm what He would deny. So the soul of 'Isa was among those souls to which the covenant was taken in the time of Adam. And that soul was then sent to Maryam when He said, "Settle in a place of worship wherein the sun does not rise, and you take a veil from them." So We sent to her Our soul, and it manifested to her in the form of a well-built man. (19:17) Until His saying, "A determined appointment." (19:21) She conceived. He, who spoke to her, was the soul of 'Isa, peace be upon him. Abu Ja'far narrated to me that Ar-Rabi' bin Anas narrated to him from Abu Al-'Aliyah from Ubayy bin Ka'b who said, "He entered it."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jab tumhare Rab ne Bani Aadam ki pushton se unki nasal nikaali aur unhein khud unke oopar gawah banaaya} unke farmaan tak {kya tu humein us cheez ki wajah se halaak karega jo baatil karne walon ne ki}" (Surah Al-A'raf 172-173) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Allah ne un sabko us din jama kiya jo Qayamat tak honay wale hain, unhein roohein banaaya, phir unhein soorat di aur unse baat karwaayi, to woh bole, aur unse ahd-o-paimaan liya, aur unhein khud unke oopar gawah banaaya: 'Kya main tumhara Rab nahi hoon?' Unhone kaha: 'Kyun nahi, hum gawah hain,' taake tum Qayamat ke din yeh na kaho ke 'hum to ismein ghaafil the,' ya yeh na kaho ke 'humare baap-dada ne hi pehle shirk kiya tha, aur hum unke baad ki nasal thay, kya tu humein us cheez ki wajah se halaak karega jo baatil karne walon ne ki?' Allah ne farmaya: 'To main tumpar saat aasmano aur saat zameeno ko gawah banaata hoon, aur tumpar tumhare baap Aadam (AS) ko gawah banaata hoon, taake tum Qayamat ke din yeh na kaho ke "humein pata nahi tha" ya "hum ismein ghaafil the," isliye mere sath kisi ko shareek mat karo, kyunke main tumhare paas apne Rasool bhejunga jo tumhein mera ahd aur paimaan yaad dilaayenge, aur tumpar apni kitaabein nazil karunga.' To unhone kaha: 'Hum gawahi dete hain ke tu humara Rab aur humara ma'bood hai, tere siwa humara koi Rab nahi aur tere siwa humara koi ma'bood nahi.' Aur unke baap Aadam (AS) ko unke liye buland kiya gaya, to unhone unhein dekha, unme maal-daar aur gareeb, achhi soorat wale aur doosre (kism ke log) paaye, to unhone kaha: 'Aye Rab, kaash tu apne bandon ke darmiyan barabari rakhta.' Allah ne farmaya: 'Mujhe pasand hai ke meri shukr-guzaari ki jaaye.' Aur unme Ambiya ko chiraaghon jaisa dekha, aur unhein Risaalat aur Nabuwwat ka aik alag ahd diya gaya, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: '{Aur jab humne Nabiyon se unka ahd liya, aur tumse aur Nuh (AS) se}' (Surah Al-Ahzab 7) ayat, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: '{To apna rukh deen ki taraf seedha rakho, Allah ki fitrat jispar usne logon ko banaaya, Allah ki khilqat mein koi tabdeeli nahi}' (Surah Ar-Room 30), aur yehi hai unka farmaan: '{Yeh pehle daraane walon mein se aik daraane wala hai}' (Surah An-Najm 56), aur unka farmaan: '{Aur humne unme se aksar ka koi ahd nahi paaya, aur humne unme se aksar ko na-farmaan hi paaya}' (Surah Al-A'raf 102), aur yehi hai unka farmaan: '{Phir humne unke baad Rasool bheje apni apni qaum ki taraf, woh unke paas khuli daleelein le kar aaye, to woh us cheez par imaan laane wale na thay jise unhone pehle jhutlaaya tha},' yeh Allah ke ilm mein tha ke jinhone iqraar kiya unme se kaun isse jhutlaayega aur kaun isse sach maanega, to Isa (AS) ki rooh un roohon mein se thi jinse Aadam (AS) ke zamane mein ahd liya gaya tha, to us rooh ko Maryam (AS) ki taraf bheja gaya jab '{woh apne ghar walon se alag hokar mashriqi jagah gayi, aur unse parda kar liya, to humne unke paas apni rooh bheji, jo unke saamne aik pooray insaan ki soorat mein zaahir hui} unke farmaan tak {yeh to tay-shuda amr hai}' (Surah Maryam 17-21), 'to unhone unhein hamal mein le liya,' unhone kaha: unhone us (rooh) ko hamal mein liya jisne unse baat ki, aur yeh Isa (AS) ki rooh thi. Abu Ja'far ne kaha: mujhe Ar-Rabee' bin Anas ne, Abu Al-Aaliyah se, unhone Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) se, hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: 'Woh unke munh se dakhil hui.'

e: that 'Umar bin Al-Khattab was asked about this Ayah: And when your Lord brought forth from the Children of Adam, from their loins, their seed and made them testify as to themselves: "Am I not your Lord?" They said: "Yes! We testify," lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection: 'Verily, we have been unaware of this (7:172).'" So 'Umar bin Al-Khattab said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ being asked about it. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Indeed Allah created Adam, then He wiped his back with His Right Hand, and his offspring came out of him. So he said: "I created these for Paradise, and they will do the deeds of the people of Paradise." Then He wiped his back, and his offspring came out of him. So He said: "I created these for the Fire, and they will do the deeds of the people of the Fire." A man said: 'Then of what good is doing deeds O Messenger of Allah!' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Verily, when Allah created a man for Paradise, He makes him perform the deeds of the people of Paradise, until he dies doing one of the deeds of the people of Paradise. So Allah will admit him into Paradise. And when He created a man for the Fire, He makes him perform the deeds of the people of the Fire until he dies doing the deeds of the people of the Fire. So Allah will enter him into the Fire.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3075)
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se is ayat ke baare mein poocha gaya: "{Aur jab tumhare Rab ne Bani Aadam ki pushton se unki nasal nikaali aur unhein khud unke oopar gawah banaaya: kya main tumhara Rab nahi hoon? Unhone kaha: kyun nahi, hum gawah hain, taake tum Qayamat ke din yeh na kaho ke hum to ismein ghaafil the}" (Surah Al-A'raf 172), to Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suna, unse iske baare mein poocha gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko paida kiya, phir apne dayen haath se unki pusht par haath phera aur usse aik nasal nikaali, phir farmaya: \"Maine inhein Jannat ke liye paida kiya hai, aur woh Jannat walon ke amal karenge,\" phir dobara unki pusht par haath phera aur usse aik nasal nikaali, phir farmaya: \"Maine inhein Jahannam ke liye paida kiya hai, aur woh Jahannam walon ke amal karenge.\"' Aik shakhs ne poocha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to phir amal ka kya faida?' Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab Allah kisi aadmi ko Jannat ke liye paida karta hai, to use Jannat walon ke amal mein lagaa deta hai.'" Yeh hadith sahih hai Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When Allah created Adam He wiped his back and every person that He created among his offspring until the Day of Resurrection fell out of his back. He placed a ray of light between the eyes of every person. Then He showed them to Adam and he said: 'O Lord! Who are these people?' He said: 'These are your offspring.'
