He saw one of them whose ray between his eyes amazed him, so he said: 'O Lord! Who is this?' He said: 'This is a man from the latter nations of your offspring called Dawud.' He said: 'Lord! How long did You make his lifespan?' He said: 'Sixty years.' He said: 'O Lord! Add forty years from my life to his.' So at the end of Adam's life, the Angel of death of came to him, and he said: 'Do I not have forty years remaining?' He said: 'Did you not give them to your son Dawud?'" He said: "Adam denied, so his offspring denied, and Adam forgot and his offspring forgot, and Adam sinned, so his offspring sinned." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3076)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko paida kiya, to unki pusht par haath phera, to unki pusht se Qayamat tak paida honay wali har jaan zarron jaisi gir padi, phir unme se har insaan ki aankhon ke darmiyan noor ki aik chamak rakh di, phir unhein Aadam (AS) ke saamne pesh kiya, to Aadam (AS) ne poocha: 'Yeh kaun hain, Aye Rab?' Farmaya: 'Yeh tumhari nasal hain.' Aadam (AS) ne unme se aik aadmi ko dekha jiski aankhon ke darmiyan ki chamak unhein pasand aayi, to unhone poocha: 'Aye Rab, yeh kaun hai?' Farmaya: 'Yeh tumhara beta Dawud (AS) hai, jo aakhri Ummaton mein hoga.' Aadam (AS) ne poocha: 'Tu ne uski umr kitni rakhi hai?' Farmaya: 'Saath (60) saal.' Aadam (AS) ne kaha: 'Aye Rab, meri umr mein se chaalees (40) saal aur us mein daal de yahan tak ke uski umr sau (100) saal ho jaaye.' Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Achha, to yeh likh diya jayega aur mohar lag jayegi, badla nahi jayega.' Jab Aadam (AS) ki umr khatam honay lagi to maut ka farishta unki rooh qabz karne aaya, Aadam (AS) ne kaha: 'Kya meri umr mein chaalees (40) saal baaki nahi bache?' Maut ke farishte ne unse kaha: 'Kya tumne woh apne bete Dawud ko nahi de diya tha?' Unhone kaha: to (Aadam ne) inkaar kiya to unki nasal ne bhi inkaar kiya, aur (Aadam) bhool gaye to unki nasal bhi bhool gayi, aur (Aadam) se galti hui to unki nasal se bhi galti hui."

e: [AI] He is Bal'am ibn Ba'ura'a according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur inhein us shakhs ki khabar sunaao jise humne apni nishaaniyan din, phir woh unse alag ho gaya}" (Surah Al-A'raf 175) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Bal'am bin Ba'ura hain."

e: [AI] On the day of Badr, people were divided into three groups: one third were fighting the enemy, one third were gathering spoils and taking prisoners, and one third were guarding the messenger of Allah. When they gathered the spoils, they disagreed among themselves. Those who gathered them and took them said, "The messenger of Allah has given each of us what we have acquired, so it belongs to us and not to you." Those who were fighting the enemy and seeking them said, "By Allah, if it wasn't for us, you wouldn't have acquired anything. We occupied the enemy, and the guards said, "By Allah, you are not more deserving of it than us. We saw that we should fight the enemy when Allah gave us their backs and take the spoils when no one was preventing us. But we feared the enemy's surprise attack on the messenger of Allah, so we stayed with him." Allah took the spoils from our hands and gave them to the messenger of Allah. He distributed them equally, and there was no fifth share on that day. It was a day of God-consciousness, obedience to Allah and His messenger, and reconciliation among people.
hi: Yeh humare baare mein, Badr ke din, nazil hui. Log teen darjon mein baante gaye the - aik-tihaai dushman se jung kar rahe the, aik-tihaai maal-e-ghaneemat jama kar rahe the aur qaidi pakad rahe the, aur aik-tihaai khaimay ke paas Rasulullah (SAW) ki pehra-daari kar rahe the. Jab maal-e-ghaneemat jama hua to unme ikhtilaaf ho gaya, jinhone use jama kiya aur liya unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humme se har aik ko woh diya jo usne paaya, isliye yeh humara hai, tumhara nahi." Aur jo dushman se jung kar rahe the aur unka peechha kar rahe the unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar hum na hote to tum use na paate, humne hi qaum ko rok rakha tha." Aur pehredaaron ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tum ismein humse zyada haqdaar nahi ho, humne bhi socha tha ke dushman se jung karein jab Allah ne humein unke kandhon par (fatah) di, aur maal le lein jab koi rokne wala na tha, lekin humein Rasulullah (SAW) par dushman ke dhoke ka darr tha, isliye hum unke sath rahe." Unhone kaha: to Allah ne isse humare haathon se le liya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke supurd kar diya, "phir unhone ise barabar-barabar taqseem kiya, us din ismein khums (paanchwan hissa) nahi tha, aur ismein Allah ka taqwa, uski aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki itaa'at, aur aapas ke maamlaat ki islaah thi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever does such and such or goes to such and such place, then he shall have such and such reward." So the young men rushed towards it, and the elders remained steadfast under the banners. When Allah granted them victory, the young men came seeking what was promised to them, and the elders said, "We were your support and stayed under the banners." So Allah, the Almighty, revealed, "They ask you about the spoils. Say, 'The spoils belong to Allah and the Messenger, so fear Allah and amend your relationship among yourselves.'" [Al-Anfal 1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi fulan-fulan kaam kare ya fulan-fulan jagah pahunche, uske liye fulan-fulan (inaam) hai." To jawaan log usski taraf tezi se badhe aur boodhe log jhandon ke neeche jame rahe. Jab Allah ne unhein fatah di, to jawaan aakar apna wada kiya hua (inaam) maangne lage, aur boodhon ne kaha: "Hum tumhare liye peeche support the aur jhandon ke neeche jame rahe." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Woh aapse anfaal (maal-e-ghaneemat) ke baare mein poochte hain, kah dijiye: anfaal Allah aur Rasool ke liye hain, isliye Allah se daro aur aapas ke maamlaat sudhaaro}" (Surah Al-Anfal 1).

e: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was finished at Badr, it was said to him: 'You have to get the caravan, you can not settle for less than that.' Al-'Abbas called out while he was bound up: 'There is no use.' He said: 'For Allah, Most High, has promised you one of the two parties, and He gave you what He promised you.' He said: 'He has said the truth.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3080)
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) maqtoolon se faarigh huay, to unse kaha gaya: "Tijarati qaafile ka peechha karna aapke liye behtar hai, ismein koi rukaawat nahi." To Abbas (RA) ne, jabke woh qaid mein the, unhein pukaara ke yeh unke liye munaasib nahi. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kyun?" Unhone kaha: "Kyunke Allah ne aapse do giroh mein se aik ka wada kiya tha, aur usne aapko woh de diya jiska wada kiya tha."

e: [AI] Abu Sa'id al-Khudri said regarding this verse "And whoever turns them on their backs [in flight] on that day" [Al-Anfal 16], he said: It was revealed about us on the Day of Badr.
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se, is ayat "{Aur jo koi us din unhein peeth dikhaaye}" (Surah Al-Anfal 16) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh humare baare mein, Badr ke din, nazil hui."

e: [AI] Ubayy ibn Khalaf came to the Prophet ﷺ  on the day of Uhud and some believers intercepted him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered them to let him go, so Mus`ab ibn `Umayr, the brother of Bani Abd Ad-Dar, intercepted him and saw a slit in Ubayy's throat between his wide neck and his white armor. Mus`ab stabbed him with his spear, causing Ubayy to fall off his horse, but no blood came out from his stab; instead, it broke one of his ribs. His companions approached him while he was writhing in pain, and they said to him, "This is just a scratch, what made you so weak?" He reminded them of the words of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that he said, "Rather, I have slain Ubayy!" Then he said, "By the One in Whose Hand is my soul! If it was not for my status before Allah, the inhabitants of Dhi Al-Majaz would have all been killed." Ubayy died in the fire, a wretched fate for the people of Sa`ir before he could reach Makkah. Allah then revealed the Ayah: "And you threw not when you did throw, but Allah threw" (8:17).
hi: Ubayy bin Khalaf Uhud ke din Nabi (SAW) ki taraf badha, unhein (qatl karne ka) irada rakhte huay, momino mein se kuch log uske aage aa gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh uska raasta chhod dein, phir Mus'ab bin Umair (RA), Banu Abd-ud-Daar ke bhai, uski taraf gaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ubayy ke haansli (turquwah) ko zirah aur khod ke darmiyan aik khaali jagah se dekha, to aap (SAW) ne apne barchhe se use maara, to Ubayy apne ghode se gir gaya, aur uski chot se koi khoon nahi bahaa, magar uski aik paslee toot gayi. Uske saathi uske paas aaye jabke woh bael ki tarah cheekh raha tha, unhone usse kaha: "Tumhein kya hua, yeh to sirf khraash hai." To usne unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ki yeh baat bataayi: "Balke main Ubayy ko qatl karunga." Phir usne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar mujhe jo hua hai woh Dhi-al-Majaz ke logon ko hota, to woh sab mar jaate." To Ubayy Makkah pahunchne se pehle aag ki taraf mar gaya, "to angaaron walon ke liye tabaahi ho." To Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur tumne nahi phenka jab tumne phenka, balke Allah ne phenka}" (Surah Al-Anfal 17) ayat.

e: [AI] When the people met, they said: "O Allah, who among us should cut off the ties of kinship and give us what we do not know of its blessings?!" So that became the prelude. Then Allah revealed (in the Quran): "If you (believers) make preparations for a victory, it is only fitting that you first make a firm decision in your own minds, and then ask Allah to bless your efforts. If you do this, Allah will grant you victory" (Quran 8:19), up to His saying: "And that Allah is with the believers." (Quran 8:19)
hi: Jab qaum aamne-saamne hui, unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, hum mein se jo rishtedaari ka zyada qaati (tornay wala) ho aur humare paas aisi cheez laaya ho jise hum nahi pehchaante, to use subah tak jhuka de," to yehi unka 'istiftah' (faisla/madad maangna) tha, to Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Agar tum faisla maangte ho to tumhare paas faisla aa chuka hai}" (Surah Al-Anfal 19) unke farmaan tak: "{Aur Allah momino ke sath hai}" (Surah Al-Anfal 19).

e: [AI] "It prevents the disbeliever from embracing faith, and it prevents the believer from committing sins."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Woh aadmi aur uske dil ke darmiyan hail ho jaata hai}" (Surah Al-Anfal 24) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh kaafir aur imaan ke darmiyan hail hota hai, aur momin aur gunahon ke darmiyan hail hota hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, gathered the Quraysh and said, "Is there anyone among you other than your own?" They said, "Among us is our nephew, and among us is our ally, and among us is our freed slave." He said, "Our ally is from us, and our nephew is from us, and our freed slave is from us. Indeed, my allies are the God-conscious among you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Quraish ko jama kiya aur poocha: "Kya tum mein se koi tumhari qaum se baahar ka hai?" Unhone kaha: "Humme hamare bhanje hain, humme humare hulafa (ahd waale) hain, aur humme humare mawaali (aazaad kiye huay ghulam) hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Humara hulafa humme se hai, aur humara bhanja humme se hai, aur humara mawla humme se hai, beshak mere waali (qareebi) tum mein se sirf mutaqi (Allah se darne wale) log hain."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Prepare for them whatever power you can muster" [Surah Al-Anfal 8:60]. Surely, power lies in archery.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko "{Aur unke liye jitni taaqat ho sako taiyyar rakho}" (Surah Al-Anfal 60) padhte suna, "khabardar, taaqat teer-andaazi hai."

e: [AI] The womb surely gets cut off, and the blessings are surely disbelieved, and surely when Allah brings hearts close, nothing can separate them, and then He recited, "If you had spent all that is on earth, you could not have brought their hearts together" [Al-Anfal: 63].
hi: "Rishtedaari zaroor kaati jaati hai, aur ne'mat ki na-shukri ki jaati hai, aur jab Allah dilon ko aapas mein qareeb kar deta hai to koi cheez unhein kabhi door nahi kar sakti," phir yeh padha: "{Agar tum zameen ki sari cheezein bhi kharch kar deti to bhi tum unke dilon ko jod na sakti}" (Surah Al-Anfal 63).

e: [AI] I met Aba Ishaq after he lost his sight, so I said to him, "Do you recognize me?" He replied, "Indeed, I know you and I love you." Then he said, "Abu Al-Ahwas narrated to me from Abdullah that he said, 'This verse was revealed about those who love for the sake of Allah,' {And if you should spend all that is in the earth, you could not have made affection between their hearts} [Al-Anfal 63]. The sentence 'This is the statement of Abu Hatim'."
hi: Main Abu Ishaq se unki nazar jaane ke baad mila, maine unse kaha: "Kya aap mujhe pehchaante hain?" Unhone kaha: "Main tumhein pehchaanta hoon aur tumse mohabbat karta hoon," phir unhone kaha: mujhe Abu Al-Ahwas ne, Abdullah (RA) se, hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: "Yeh ayat un logon ke baare mein nazil hui jo Allah ke liye aik doosre se mohabbat karte hain: {Agar tum zameen ki sari cheezein bhi kharch kar deti to bhi tum unke dilon ko jod na sakti}" (Surah Al-Anfal 63) ayat. "Yeh Abu Hatim ki hadith ke alfaaz hain."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ consulted Abu Bakr regarding the captives. Abu Bakr said, "Your people and tribe are worthier. Let them go." Then, the Prophet ﷺ sought consultation from Umar, who said, "Kill them." The Prophet ﷺ preferred Abu Bakr's opinion and Allah revealed the verse, "It is not for a Prophet to have captives of war until he has thoroughly subdued the land [from disbelief and polytheism]" (Quran 8:67) until the verse, "So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good" (Quran 8:69). The Prophet ﷺ then met Umar and said, "You almost caused us a great calamity with your opinion."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne qaidiyon ke maamle mein Abu Bakr (RA) se mashwara liya, unhone kaha: "Yeh aapki qaum aur aapke qabile ke hain, isliye unhein chhod dein." Phir aap (SAW) ne Umar (RA) se mashwara liya, unhone kaha: "Unhein qatl kar dein." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse fidya liya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Kisi Nabi ke liye jaayaz nahi ke uske qaidi hon jab tak woh zameen mein achhi tarah (dushman ko) kuchal na de}" (Surah Al-Anfal 67) unke farmaan tak: "{To jo maal-e-ghaneemat tumne paaya hai usme se halaal, paak khaao}" (Surah Al-Anfal 69). Unhone kaha: phir Nabi (SAW) Umar (RA) se mile, farmaya: "Aapki mukhaalifat mein humpar koi museebat aati-aati bachi."

e: [AI] About the companions of the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him), we indeed experienced the worldly life with the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him), so Allah Almighty revealed, "If there had not been a prescribed decree from Allah, the punishment would have come to you immediately for what you have taken. So expect it; surely, Allah’s promise will come true. And yet, some of them said to Sa'd: 'By Allah! He used to dislike you and call you Al-Akhnas.' Sa'd burst into laughter until his molars could be seen, and then he said: 'Does a person not find something in his brother's affairs that causes a strain between them, and he does not betray his trust nor hurt his feelings?'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba se: "Humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath duniya ka fayda uthaaya," to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Agar Allah ki taraf se pehle likha hua faisla na hota, to jo tumne liya usme tumhein sakht azaab pahunchta}" (Surah Al-Anfal 68), "to mujhe ummeed hai ke yeh Allah ki taraf se humare liye pehle se muqarrar rehmat hai." Unme se kisi ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, woh tumse nafrat karta tha aur tumhein 'Al-Akhnas' kehta tha." To Sa'd (RA) itne hanse ke hansi unpar ghaalib aa gayi, phir kaha: "Kya aadmi apne bhai se kisi maamle mein naaraazgi mehsoos nahi karta jo unke darmiyan ho, phir bhi yeh uski amaanat tak nahi pahunchti?" Aur unhone aik aur baat bhi kahi.

e: Ibn ‘Abbas ؓ said to us. I said to ‘Uthman bin ʿAffan: What made you take al-Anfal, which is one of al-Mathani (the seven long soorahs), and Baraʿah, which is one of al-Miʿeen (soorahs with one hundred verses or thereabouts), and put them next to one another and not write - Ibn Jaʿfar said: A line between them saying Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem - and you put them with the seven long ones? What made you do that? ʿUthman ؓ said: Sometimes many soorahs would be revealed (incomplete) to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and when something was revealed he would call one of the scribes to write it down for him and say: “Put this in the Soorah in which such and such is mentionedʿ; and verses would be revealed to him and he would say, ʿPut these verses in the soorah in which such and such is mentioned”; and a verse would be revealed to him and he would say: ʿPut this verse in the soorah in which such and such is mentioned.” Al-Anfal was one of the first soorahs to be revealed in Madinah and Baraʿah was one of the last soorahs of the Qurʿan, and the stories and content of the two soorahs were similar. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away without having stated clearly to us that it was part of it, but we thought that it was, hence I put them together and I did not put between them the line Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Ibn Jaʿfar said: I put it with the seven long ones. (Using translation from Aḥmad 399)
hi: Ke tumne Anfal ki taraf iraada kiya, jo Mathaani mein se hai, aur Bara'ah ki taraf, jo Mi'een mein se hai, to tumne dono ko jod diya aur 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' nahi likha, aur unhein Sab' Tiwaal (saat lambi Surahon) mein rakh diya, tumhein isspar kis cheez ne ubhaara? To Uthman ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) par aisa waqt aata tha ke unpar taadaad wali Surahon mein se koi (aayat) nazil hoti," unhone kaha: aur jab unpar koi cheez nazil hoti to woh apne kisi likhne wale ko bulaate aur farmaate: "Ise fulan-fulan Surah mein rakho jismein fulan-fulan (mazmoon) hai," aur Anfal Madinah mein sabse pehle nazil honay walon mein se thi, aur Bara'ah Quran ke aakhir mein se thi, aur uski kahani uski (Anfal ki) kahani se milti-julti thi, isliye mujhe laga ke yeh usi mein se hai, to Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal ho gaya aur unhone humein saaf nahi bataya ke yeh usi mein se hai, isliye maine dono ke darmiyan 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' ki satar nahi likhi.

e: [AI] Because "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful" is a verse of security and innocence which was revealed during warfare, and there is no security in it.
hi: Kyunke 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem amaan aur maafi hai, aur Bara'ah talwaar (jung) ke sath nazil hui, ismein koi amaan nahi.'

e: [AI] "What you recite of it means innocence, and indeed you call it Surah of Repentance while it is Surah of Punishment."
hi: "Tum jo iska chauthaai hissa padhte ho, uska matlab Bara'ah (bezaari) hai, aur tum ise 'Surah At-Tawbah' (Tauba ki Surah) kehte ho, jabke yeh 'Surah Al-Azab' (Azaab ki Surah) hai."

e: [AI] I was among those whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent with Ali to Makkah, so his son or another man asked him, "Why were you calling?" He said, "We used to say, 'None will enter Paradise except a believer, and no one will perform Hajj after the year except a polytheist, and no one will circumambulate the Kaaba while naked. And whoever had a covenant with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, his lifespan is four months, so I kept calling until my voice became hoarse."
hi: Main us dastay mein tha jise Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA) ke sath Bara'ah lekar Makkah bheja tha, to unke bete ya kisi aur aadmi ne unse poocha: "To tum kya pukaarte the?" Unhone kaha: "Hum kehte the: 'Jannat mein sirf momin dakhil hoga, is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi karega, aur koi bhi Baitullah ka nangi haalat mein tawaf nahi karega, aur jiska Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath ahd hai, uski muddat chaar mahine hai,' isliye main pukaarta raha yahan tak ke meri aawaz baith gayi."

e: “What day is this?” They said: “The day of sacrifice.” He said: “What land is this?” They said: “This is the sacred land of Allah.” He said: “What month is this?” They said: “The sacred month of Allah.” He said: “This is the day of the greatest Hajj, and your blood, your wealth and your honor are sacred to you, as sacred as this land, in this month, on this day.” Then he said: “Have I conveyed (the message)?” They said: “Yes.” Then the Prophet ﷺ started to say: “O Allah, bear witness.” Then he bade farewell to the people, and they said: “This is the Farewell Pilgrimage.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3058)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne Hajj ke Nahr (qurbani) ke din, jamaraat ke darmiyan thehar kar logon se poocha: "Yeh kaunsa din hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh Nahr ka din hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kaunsa shehar hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh haram waala shehar hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kaunsa mahina hai?" Unhone kaha: "Haram waala mahina." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Hajj-e-Akbar ka din hai, isliye tumhare khoon, tumhare maal, aur tumhari izzatein tum par haraam hain jaise is din, is mahine, is shehar ki hurmat haraam hai," phir farmaya: "Kya maine pahuncha diya?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To Rasulullah (SAW) kehne lage: "Aye Allah, gawah rehna," phir logon ko vida kiya, to unhone kaha: "Yeh Hajjat-ul-Wida (vida ka Hajj) hai."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Whoever leaves this world with sincerity to Allah alone, with no partner for Him, and establishes the prayer and gives the zakat, then Allah will be pleased with them. This is the religion of Allah that the messengers brought and conveyed from their Lord before the overwhelming abundance of traditions and the differences of desires. The confirmation of this is found in the Book of Allah, where He says, 'So if they repent, establish prayer, and give zakat, then they are your brothers in religion' (9:11)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi is duniya se sirf Allah ke liye khaalis ibaadat, uske sath kisi ko shareek na kar, namaz qaayam karke, aur zakat de kar rukhsat ho, to woh Allah ki khushi ke sath rukhsat hua, aur yehi Allah ka woh deen hai jise Rusul le kar aaye aur apne Rab ki taraf se pahunchaya, isse pehle ke baaton mein ikhtilaaf aur khwahishaat ka farq ho, aur iski tasdeeq Allah ki Kitaab mein hai: {To agar woh tauba karein, namaz qaayam karein, aur zakat dein, to unka raasta chhod do}" (Surah At-Tawbah 5), aur unka farmaan "{To agar woh tauba karein}" (Surah At-Tawbah 5), farma raha hai: butt aur unki ibaadat chhod dein, "{Aur namaz qaayam karein aur zakat dein, to woh deen mein tumhare bhai hain}" (Surah At-Tawbah 11).

e: [AI] From Hudhaifah regarding the saying of Allah Almighty, "So fight against the leaders of disbelief, for indeed, there are no oaths [sacred] to them." (Quran 9:12) Hudhaifah said, "They were not fought after [this verse was revealed]."
hi: Hudhaifah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To kufr ke imamon se jung karo, beshak unki qasmein (ahad) kuch nahi}" (Surah At-Tawbah 12) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unka koi ahd nahi." Hudhaifah (RA) ne kaha: "Unse (is farmaan ke baad) jung nahi ki gayi."

e: [AI] "Abu Jahl ibn Hisham, Umayyah ibn Khalaf, Utbah ibn Rabia, Abu Sufyan ibn Harb, and Suhayl ibn Amr were the ones who broke the covenant with Allah and plotted to expel the Messenger from Mecca."
hi: "{To kufr ke imamon se jung karo}" (Surah At-Tawbah 12) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Umayyah bin Khalaf, Utbah bin Rabee'ah, Abu Sufyan bin Harb, aur Suhail bin Amr, aur yehi woh log hain jinhone Allah ka ahd tod diya aur Rasool ko Makkah se nikaalne ka iraada kiya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "When you see a man regularly attending the mosque, do not hesitate to testify that he is a believer, for Allah says: 'Only those who believe in Allah frequent His mosques'." [Quran 9:18]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum kisi aadmi ko masjid ki paabandi karte dekho to yeh gawahi dene mein hichkichaao mat ke woh momin hai, kyunke Allah farmata hai: {Allah ki masjidon ko sirf woh aabaad karta hai jo Allah par imaan laaya ho}" (Surah At-Tawbah 18).

e: When this verse was revealed: "And those who hoard gold and silver," the Muslims were grieved about it. Umar said: I shall dispel your care. He, therefore, went and said: Prophet of Allah, your Companions were grieved by this verse. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah has made zakat obligatory simply to purify your remaining property, and He made inheritances obligatory that they might come to those who survive you. Umar then said: Allah is most great. He then said to him: Let me inform you about the best a man hoards; it is a virtuous woman who pleases him when he looks at her, obeys him when he gives her a command, and guards his interests when he is away from her. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1664)
hi: Jab "{Jo log sona aur chandi jama karte hain}" (Surah At-Tawbah 34) nazil hui aur unhein Allah ki raah mein kharch nahi karte, to yeh baat Musalmano par bhaari padi, unhone kaha: "Humme se koi apne bete ke liye aisa maal kaise chhod sake jo uske baad baaqi rahe?" To Umar ne kaha: "Main tumhari yeh pareshaani door karunga." Unhone kaha: to woh chal pade, aur Umar bhi chale, aur Thawban (RA) bhi unke peechhe chale, woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, to Umar ne kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, yeh ayat aapke sahaba par bhaari padi hai." To Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne zakat sirf isliye farz ki hai taake woh tumhare baaqi maandah maal ko paak kar de, aur usne mirath (wirasat ke qawaneen) sirf us maal ke liye farz ki hai jo tumhare baad baaqi rahe." Unhone kaha: to Umar ne takbeer kahi, phir Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kya main tumhein na bataaun ke aadmi jo sabse behtareen cheez sanjo kar rakhta hai woh kya hai? Woh nek biwi hai, jise woh dekhe to khush ho, jise woh hukum de to farmaanbardaari kare, aur jab woh na ho to uski hifaazat kare."

e: [AI] "The prophecy has come upon us, meaning Surah Al-Tawbah. Allah, Exalted and Mighty, said, 'March forth, whether you are light or heavy.' [Surah Al-Tawbah: 41]. And I find myself to be nothing but light."
hi: Humare paas 'Al-Bu'uth' (jung ke liye bulaawa) aaya, ya'ni Surah At-Tawbah. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Halke ho ya bhaari, nikal pado}" (Surah At-Tawbah 41), aur main apne aap ko sirf halka hi paata hoon.

e: [AI] From Abu Huraira, without this exact wording.
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, doosre alfaaz ke sath.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about the mosque that was established on piety, and he said, "It is my mosque, this one."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se us masjid ke baare mein poocha gaya jo taqwa par bunyaad ki gayi thi, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh yeh meri masjid hai."

e: [AI] He said, "The mosque that was founded upon righteousness is the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." It is authentic.
hi: Unhone kaha: "Woh masjid jo taqwa par bunyaad ki gayi hai, woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] Two men were discussing in the mosque that was founded on piety. One of them said it is the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the other said it is the mosque of Quba. They both went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and asked him about it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The mosque that was founded on piety is my mosque, this is it."
hi: Do aadmiyon ne us masjid ke baare mein jhagda kiya jo taqwa par bunyaad ki gayi thi, aik ne kaha: "Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid hai," aur doosre ne kaha: "Yeh Quba ki masjid hai," to woh dono Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unse iske baare mein poocha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh masjid jo taqwa par bunyaad ki gayi hai, woh yeh meri masjid hai."

e: "Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari, Jabir bin 'Abdullah, and Anas bin Malik told me that when this Verse: "In it (the mosque) are men who love to clean and to purify themselves. And Allah loves those who make themselves clean and pure." was revealed, the Messenger of Allah said: 'O Ansar! Allah has praised you for your cleanliness. What is the nature of your cleanliness?' They said: 'We perform ablution for prayer and we take bath to cleanse ourselves of impurity due to sexual activity, and we clean ourselves with water (after urinating). He said: 'This is what it is. So adhere to it.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 355)
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Ismein aise log hain jo paak rehna pasand karte hain}" (Surah At-Tawbah 108), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ansar ke giroh, Allah ne tumhari paakeezgi ki tareef ki hai, to tumhari yeh paakeezgi kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Hum namaz ke liye wudu karte hain, janabat se ghusl karte hain, aur paani se istinja karte hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Wahi hai, isliye isspar qaayam raho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about the travelers, and he said, "They are the ones who are fasting."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se 'sa'iheen' (safar/roze rakhne walon) ke baare mein poocha gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh roze rakhne wale hain."

e: I heard a man asking for forgiveness for his parents and they were mushrikeen. I said: Are you asking for forgiveness for your parents when they are mushrikeen? He said: Didnʿt Ibraheem (عليه السلام) ask for forgiveness for his father when he was a mushrik? I mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ and these verses were revealed: “It is not (proper) for the Prophet ﷺ and those who believe to ask Allahʿs forgiveness for the Mushrikeen” [At-Tawbah 9:113-114]. ‘Abdur-Rahman said: And Allah revealed [the words]. “And Ibraheemʿs (Abraham) invoking (of Allah) for his fatherʿs forgiveness was only because of a promise he [Ibraheem (Abraham)] had made to him (his father)ʿ. (Using translation from Aḥmad 1085)
hi: Maine aik shakhs ko apne walidain ke liye maghfirat ki dua karte suna jabke woh dono mushrik the, maine kaha: "Apne walidain ke liye maghfirat ki dua mat karo jabke woh dono mushrik hain." Usne kaha: "Kya Ibrahim (AS) ne apne baap ke liye maghfirat ki dua nahi ki thi jabke woh mushrik tha?" To maine yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, to yeh nazil hui: "{Nabi (SAW) aur imaan waalon ke liye jaayez nahi ke woh mushrikeen ke liye maghfirat ki dua karein, chahe woh qareebi rishtedaar hi kyun na hon, jab unhein yeh saaf ho jaaye ke woh Jahannami hain, aur Ibrahim (AS) ka apne baap ke liye maghfirat maangna sirf aik wa'de ki wajah se tha jo unhone unse kiya tha, phir jab unhein saaf ho gaya ke woh Allah ka dushman hai, to woh unse alag ho gaye, beshak Ibrahim (AS) bohot narm-dil, buradbaar the}" (Surah At-Tawbah 113-114).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "May Allah have mercy on you and forgive you, O uncle. I will continue to seek forgiveness for you until Allah forbids me from doing so." So the Muslims began seeking forgiveness for their deceased pagans. Then Allah Almighty revealed, "It is not for the Prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of Hellfire." [Quran 9:113]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah tujhpar reham kare aur tujhe bakhshe, Aye chacha, aur main tere liye maghfirat maangta rahunga yahan tak ke Allah mujhe isse mana kare." To Musalman apne un mardon ke liye maghfirat maangne lage jo mushrik hokar faut huay the, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Nabi (SAW) aur imaan waalon ke liye jaayez nahi ke woh mushrikeen ke liye maghfirat ki dua karein, chahe woh qareebi rishtedaar hi kyun na hon, jab unhein yeh saaf ho jaaye ke woh Jahannami hain}" (Surah At-Tawbah 113).

e: [AI] When the death of Abu Talib approached, the Prophet ﷺ  came to him while Abdullah ibn Abi Umeyah and Abu Jahl ibn Hisham were with him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "O uncle, indeed you are the greatest of them in rights upon me and the best of them in my eyes. And you have the greatest right upon me after my parents. So say a word that will benefit you with intercession for yourself on the Day of Resurrection. Say, "There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah." They said to him, "Are you trying to abandon the religion of Abd al-Muttalib?" He remained silent, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  repeated it to him. Abu Talib then said, "I adhere to the religion of Abd al-Muttalib." And he passed away. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "I will seek forgiveness for you as long as I have not been forbidden from it." Then Allah, the Almighty, revealed the verses {It is not for the Prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists} [9:113] until the end of the verse {And the request for forgiveness of Abraham for his father} [9:114].
hi: Jab Abu Talib ki maut ka waqt aaya, to Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye, aur unke paas Abdullah bin Abi Umayyah aur Abu Jahl bin Hisham maujood the, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye chacha, aap mujhpar sabse zyada haq rakhte hain, aur mere upar aapka sabse achha ehsaan hai, aur aap mere waalid se bhi zyada haqdaar hain, isliye aik aisi baat keh dein jiski wajah se Qayamat ke din mujhpar aapki shafa'at wajib ho jaaye - kaho: La ilaha illallah." Unhone dono ne unse kaha: "Kya aap Abdul Muttalib ke deen se hatna chahte hain?" To woh khamosh ho gaye, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse dobara yehi baat kahi, unhone kaha: "Main Abdul Muttalib ke deen par hoon." Phir unka inteqaal ho gaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main zaroor tumhare liye maghfirat maangunga jab tak mujhe mana na kiya jaaye." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Nabi (SAW) aur imaan waalon ke liye jaayez nahi ke woh mushrikeen ke liye maghfirat ki dua karein}" (Surah At-Tawbah 113) ayat, "{Aur Ibrahim (AS) ka apne baap ke liye maghfirat maangna}" (Surah At-Tawbah 114) ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out to visit the graves, and we went out with him. He commanded us to sit, and we sat. Then he passed by the graves until he reached a particular grave and he stood there for a long time, engaged in private conversation. Then the crying of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  intensified, and we cried along with him. He then turned to us, and 'Umar ibn al-Khattab met him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is it that makes you cry, when you have made us cry and startled us?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came and sat with us and said, "Does my crying alarm you?" We said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "The grave that you saw me speaking to is the grave of my mother, Aminah bint Wahb. I sought permission from my Lord to visit her grave, and He granted me permission. So I sought His permission to seek forgiveness for her, but He did not grant me permission. And the verse was revealed upon me: 'It is not (proper) for the Prophet and those who believe to ask Allah's forgiveness for the Mushrikun (polytheists).' (Quran 9:113) Until the end of the verse: 'And the request of forgiveness of Ibrahim (Abraham) for his father except for a promise he had made to him.' (Quran 9:114) Then, at that moment, I was seized with something that a child would be seized with from his father's compassion. And that is what made me cry." This hadith was narrated by Muslim through the narration of Yazid ibn Kaysan from Abu Hazim who heard it from Abu Hurairah, summarized by Ayyub bin Hani' from Ibn Ma'in.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) qabristan dekhne ke liye nikle, hum bhi unke sath nikle, aap (SAW) ne humein hukum diya to hum baith gaye, phir woh qabron ke darmiyan se guzarte huay aik qabr tak pahunche, us se lambi der tak khusar-phusar (chupke-chupke baat) ki, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ki hichki ubhri aur woh rone lage, hum bhi unke rone ki wajah se rone lage, phir woh humari taraf mudke aaye, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unka istiqbaal karte hue poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapko kis cheez ne rulaaya? Aapne humein bhi rula diya aur dara diya." To aap (SAW) aakar humare paas baith gaye aur farmaya: "Kya mera rona tumhein dara gaya?" Humne kaha: "Ji haan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak yeh qabr jismein tumne mujhe khusar-phusar karte dekha, woh meri walida Aminah bint Wahb ki qabr hai, aur maine apne Rab se unki ziyarat ki ijaazat maangi, to usne mujhe ijaazat de di, phir maine unke liye maghfirat maangne ki ijaazat maangi, to usne mujhe ijaazat nahi di, aur mujhpar yeh nazil hui: {Nabi (SAW) aur imaan waalon ke liye jaayez nahi ke woh mushrikeen ke liye maghfirat ki dua karein} (Surah At-Tawbah 113) yahan tak ke ayat khatam hui: {Aur Ibrahim (AS) ka apne baap ke liye maghfirat maangna sirf aik wa'de ki wajah se tha jo unhone unse kiya tha} (Surah At-Tawbah 114), to mujhe woh nazuk ehsaas hua jo aulaad ko apne waalid ke liye hota hai, aur yehi cheez thi jisne mujhe rulaaya." "Yeh dono ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne isse is siyaaq mein nahi nikala," Muslim ne sirf Yazid bin Kaisan ki Abu Hazim se, unhone Abu Hurairah se, hadith mukhtasar taur par nikaali hai. Ayyub bin Hani ko Ibn Ma'een ne kamzor kaha hai.

e: [AI] From His statement, Exalted is He, "And His throne had been upon the water" [Hud 11:7], upon what was the water? He said, "On the back of the wind."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur uska Arsh paani par tha}" (Surah Hud 7) ke baare mein, paani kis cheez par tha? Unhone kaha: "Hawa ki pusht par."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wanted to send a group of warriors, so he called Ja'far and commanded him to stay in Medina. Ja'far said, "I will never stay behind you, O Messenger of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then called me (Ali) and resolved to me, even before I spoke. I began to cry. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked me, "What makes you cry, O Ali?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, certain qualities make me cry. Quraish says, 'Tomorrow he will be quick to abandon his cousin and betray him.' Another quality that makes me cry is wanting to engage in jihad for the sake of Allah, because Allah says, 'They do not step forth to anger the disbelievers nor inflict any injury upon an enemy, but a righteous deed is recorded for them.' I wanted to experience the favor of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Regarding your statement about Quraish saying that you will be quick to abandon your cousin and betray him, you have a role model in me. They called me a sorcerer, soothsayer, and liar. Are you not pleased to be in the position of Harun (Aaron) to Musa (Moses), except that there is no prophet after me? And concerning your statement about wanting to experience the favor of Allah, there is a box of gifts from Yemen that has come to us. Sell it and enjoy it with Fatima, until Allah bestows His favor upon you. Indeed, Medina is only suitable with me or with you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik ghazwe ka iraada kiya, unhone Ja'far (RA) ko bulaaya aur unhein hukum diya ke woh Madinah mein reh jaayen, to unhone kaha: "Main aapke baad kabhi peeche nahi rahunga, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bulaaya, aur mere kuch kehne se pehle hi mujhe peeche rehne ka pakka hukum de diya, unhone kaha: to main ro pada, Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein kis baat ne rulaaya, Aye Ali?" Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe kai baaton ne rulaaya - Quraish kal kahegi ke 'kitni jaldi apne chachere bhai se peeche reh gaya aur usse chhod diya,' aur mujhe aik aur baat bhi rulaati hai - main Allah ki raah mein jihad ke liye khud ko pesh karna chahta tha, kyunke Allah farmata hai: {Aur woh kisi aisi jagah kadam nahi rakhte jo kaafiron ko ghussa dilaaye, aur na hi kisi dushman se koi cheez haasil karte} ayat ke aakhir tak, isliye main Allah ke fazl ke liye khud ko pesh karna chahta tha." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahi baat tumhari is baat ki ke Quraish kahegi 'kitni jaldi apne chachere bhai se peeche reh gaya aur usse chhod diya,' to tumhare liye mujhme aik namoona hai, mujhe (bhi) jaadugar, kaahin, aur jhoota kaha gaya tha, kya tum isspar raazi nahi ke tum mere liye waisi hi manzil rakho jaisi Harun (AS) ki Musa (AS) ke liye thi, siwaye is ke ke mere baad koi Nabi nahi? Aur rahi baat tumhari is baat ki ke tum Allah ke fazl ke liye khud ko pesh karna chahte ho, to yeh Yemen se aayi hui kaali mirch ki thailiyaan hain, isse bech do aur tum aur Fatimah (RA) isse faida uthaao yahan tak ke Allah tumhein apna fazl de, kyunke Madinah sirf mere ya tumhare hone se theek reh sakti hai."

e: [AI] "Oh Abu Al-Aliyah, do not say that you have turned away from prayer, but say that you have fulfilled the prayer. Indeed, Allah Almighty says, 'They have made a trade by which Allah has profited their hearts.' (Surah At-Tawbah, 9:127)"
hi: Aye Abu Al-Aaliyah, yeh mat kaho ke 'tum namaz se phir gaye,' balke kaho '{tumne namaz mukammal ki}' (Surah An-Nisa 103), kyunke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "{Woh phir gaye, Allah ne unke dilon ko pher diya}" (Surah At-Tawbah 127).

e: [AI] "The last revelation of the Quran: 'Certainly there has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is your suffering; [he is] concerned over you [i.e., your guidance] and to the believers is kind and merciful' [Quran 9:128]. The hadeeth is narrated by Shu'bah on the authority of Yunus ibn 'Ubaid as authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs [i.e., Bukhari and Muslim], but they did not include it [in their collections]."
hi: "Quran mein sabse aakhir mein jo nazil hua woh hai: {Beshak tumhare paas tum mein se aik Rasool aa chuka hai, jise tumhari takleef bhaari lagti hai, jo tumhare liye hirs rakhne wala hai, momino ke liye narm-dil, reham karne wala hai}." Yeh Shu'bah ki hadith hai, Yunus bin Ubaid se, "Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "They have a foot of truth with their Lord" [Yunus 2]. The predecessors have said so about their truth with their Lord.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur imaan walon ko khush-khabri do ke unke liye apne Rab ke paas sachcha maqaam hai}" (Surah Yunus 2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Apne Rab ke paas sachcha, pehle se tay-shuda maqaam."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do not transgress and do not be a transgressor, for Allah says, 'Your transgression is only against yourselves.' " (Quran 10:23)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zyaadti mat karo aur na hi zyaadti karne wale bano, kyunke Allah farmata hai: {Tumhari zyaadti sirf tumhare apne khilaaf hai}" (Surah Yunus 23).

e: that Jabir bin 'Abdullah Al-Ansari said: "One day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us and said: "While I was sleeping I had a vision as if Jibra'il was at my feet. One of them said to his companion: 'Make a parable for him' so he said: 'Listen so that your ears may hear. Hearken so that your heart may understand! The parable of you and your Ummah is but the parable of a king who conquers a land, then he constructs a house in it. Then he places a table-spread in it, then he sends a messenger to call the people to eat from it. Among them are those who answer the call of the messenger, and among them are those who forsake it. So Allah is the king and the land is Islam, and the house is Paradise, and you O Muhammad! You are the Messenger, so whoever responds to you he enters Islam, and whoever enters Islam he enters Paradise, and whoever enters Paradise, he shall eat of what is in it.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2860)
hi: Maine Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain ko suna, unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur Allah dar-us-salam (salaamati ke ghar) ki taraf bulaata hai, aur jise chaahe seedhi raah dikhaata hai}" (Surah Yunus 25), phir kaha: mujhe Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: aik din Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas nikle aur farmaya: "Maine khwaab mein dekha jaise Jibra'il (AS) mere sar ke paas hain aur Mika'il (AS) mere paaon ke paas, aik ne doosre se kaha: 'Iske liye aik misaal do,' to usne kaha: 'Suno, tumhare kaan sunein, aur samjho, tumhara dil samjhe, tumhari aur tumhari Ummat ki misaal us baadshah ki manind hai jisne aik ghar banaaya, phir usme aik makaan taamir kiya, phir usme aik dawat (khaana) rakhi, phir aik qaasid bheja jo logon ko unke khaane ki taraf bulaaye, to unme se kuch ne qaasid ki baat maani aur kuch ne chhod diya, to Allah hi woh baadshah hai, aur ghar Islam hai, aur makaan Jannat hai, aur tum, Aye Muhammad, woh Rasool ho, jo tumhari baat maane woh Islam mein dakhil hua, aur jo Islam mein dakhil hua woh Jannat mein dakhil hua, aur jo Jannat mein dakhil hua woh usme se khaayega.'"

e: [AI] Uthman bin Affan heard that a delegation from the people of Egypt had arrived, so he went to meet them. When they heard about his arrival, they came towards him. He said that he disliked them entering the city before him. They came to him and said, "Please recite from the Quran and start with Surah Yunus, which is the seventh chapter." Uthman began to recite from the Surah until he reached the verse: "Say, have you seen what Allah has sent down to you of provision, and you have made some of it lawful and some unlawful? Say, has Allah permitted you, or do you invent a lie about Allah?" [Quran 10:59]. They then said to him, "Stop! Do you think you have the authority to make something lawful or unlawful that Allah has already protected?" Uthman replied, "Keep listening. The verse was revealed in a specific context. As for the matter of making something lawful or unlawful, Umar had already determined what is lawful and unlawful in relation to the charity's camels. When I became the caliph and the number of charity's camels increased, I added to what Umar had determined, in accordance with the increase in the number of camels, it is confirmed according to the conditions of Muslim, and it has not been excluded by him." This is according to the conditions set by Muslim.
hi: Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne suna ke Misr walon ka aik wafd aa raha hai, to unhone unka istiqbaal kiya, jab unhone unka pata suna to woh unki taraf badhe. Unhone kaha: aur unhone napasand kiya ke woh Madinah unke pass aaye. Unhone kaha: to woh unke paas aaye aur unse kaha: "Mus-haf mangwaao aur saatwi (Surah) khol," aur woh Surah Yunus ko saatwi kehte the, to unhone use padha yahan tak ke is ayat par pahunche: "{Kaho: kya tumne dekha jo Allah ne tumhare liye rizq nazil kiya, phir tumne usme se haraam aur halaal banaaya, kaho: kya Allah ne tumhein ijaazat di hai ya tum Allah par jhoot bandte ho?}" (Surah Yunus 59), to unhone unse kaha: "Ruko, kya tumne dekha jo tumne (zameen) mehfooz ki, kya Allah ne tumhein ijaazat di ya tum Allah par jhoot bandte ho?" Unhone kaha: to unhone (Uthman ne) kaha: "Aage badho, yeh fulan-fulan (waqia) ke baare mein nazil hui, rahi baat mehfooz zameen ki, to Umar ne mujhse pehle sadqe ke oonton ke liye zameen mehfooz ki thi, jab main khalifa bana aur sadqe ke oonton ki tadaad barhi, to maine bhi zameen mein utna hi izaafa kiya jitna sadqe mein izaafa hua tha." "Sahih hai Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "Hajjaj prolonged the sermon, so Ibn Umar put his head on my shoulder. Hajjaj said, 'Indeed Ibn Zubair has changed the Book of Allah.' Ibn Umar sat down and said, 'You nor Ibn Zubair have the ability to do that, as it is said in the Quran, "There is no altering the words of Allah." [Surah Yunus 64].' Hajjaj said, 'Indeed, you have been given knowledge if it benefits you.'"
hi: Hajjaj ne khutba lambi ki, to Ibn Umar (RA) ne apna sar mere godh mein rakh diya, to Hajjaj ne kaha: "Ibn Az-Zubair ne Allah ki Kitaab badal di hai." To Ibn Umar (RA) baith gaye aur kaha: "Na tum aisa kar sakte ho na Ibn Az-Zubair, {Allah ke alfaaz mein koi tabdeeli nahi}" (Surah Yunus 64)." Hajjaj ne kaha: "Tumhein ilm diya gaya hai agar yeh tumhein faida de."

e: “I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the about the Saying of Allah, Glorious is He: ‘For them are glad tidings, in the life of the present world, and in the Hereafter.”[10:64] He said: ‘Those are good dreams that a Muslim sees or are seen about him.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3898)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Unke liye duniya ki zindagi mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi khush-khabri hai}" (Surah Yunus 64) ke baare mein poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh sachcha khwaab hai jo aadmi khud dekhe ya uske liye dekha jaaye."

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: "Gabriel put mud into Pharaoh's mouth, out of fear that he might say, 'There is no god but Allah.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS) Firaun ke munh mein mitti thoonste rahe, is darr se ke woh 'La ilaha illallah' na keh de."

e: [AI] When the messenger of Allah ﷺ  camped at Tabuk, he stood up and addressed the people saying, "O people, do not ask your Prophet about signs, for the people of a righteous community asked their Prophet to show them a sign, so Allah sent them a she-camel, and it used to come to them from a certain mountain and they would drink its water on the day of its turn, and they would drink from its milk as much as they wanted. But they transgressed the limits set by their Lord and killed it. So Allah promised them with a punishment for three days which was not seen before. Then the cry came upon them and Allah destroyed all those who were under the sky, from the east and the west, except for a man who was in the sanctuary of Allah and Allah protected him from His punishment." The people asked, "O Messenger of Allah, who was that man?" He replied, "Abu Righal."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein Al-Hijr mein utre, to khade hokar logon ko khutba di aur farmaya: "Aye logo, apne Nabi se nishaaniyan mat maango, kyunke Salih (AS) ki qaum ne apne Nabi se maanga ke woh unke liye aik nishaani bheje, to Allah ne unke liye oontni bheji, woh is ghaati se aati aur unke paani se piti thi jis din uski baari hoti, aur woh uske doodh se itna peete jitna woh apne paani se piya karte the, phir unhone apne Rab ke hukum se sarkashi ki aur usse maar dala, to Allah ne unhein teen din ka wada diya, aur yeh Allah ka aisa wada tha jo jhoota nahi hota, phir unpar aik chinghaad aayi, to Allah ne aasman ke mashriq-o-maghrib ke neeche unme se sabko halaak kar diya, siwaye aik shakhs ke jo Allah ki harmat waali zameen mein tha, to Allah ki harmat ne use Allah ke azaab se bachaa liya." Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh kaun tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Righaal."

e: [AI] Regarding the statement of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, "He knows its place of settlement and its repository" [Hud 6], Abdullah said: Its place of settlement is in the wombs and its repository is where it dies.
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Woh uski qaraargaah aur amaanat-gaah jaanta hai}" (Surah Hud 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Qaraargaah rehm (maa ke pait) mein hai, aur amaanat-gaah woh jagah hai jahan woh marta hai."

e: [AI] According to His Statement, Mighty and Majestic is He, "And His Throne was upon the water" [Hud 7], Upon what was the water? He ﷺ  said, "Upon the surface of the wind."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur uska Arsh paani par tha}" (Surah Hud 7) ke baare mein, paani kis cheez par tha? Unhone kaha: "Hawa ki pusht par."

e: [AI] A group entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and they began to ask him, saying, "Give us until it becomes burdensome for you." And then another group came to him and said, "We have come to greet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and to seek knowledge in religion and to ask him about the beginning of this matter." He ﷺ  said, "Allah existed and nothing else existed, and the Throne was above the water. He wrote in the Remembrance (the Preserved Tablet) everything, and then He created seven heavens." He ﷺ  said, "Then a person came to him and said, 'Indeed, your camel has gone away.' So he said, 'I wish I had left it.'"
hi: Kuch log Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay aur unse maangne lage, kehte huay: "Humein do," yahan tak ke yeh unhein bura laga, phir doosre log unke paas dakhil huay aur kaha: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ko salaam karne, deen ki samajh haasil karne, aur is (kaayanaat) ke shuru ke baare mein poochne aaye hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah tha aur uske siwa kuch na tha, aur Arsh paani par tha, aur usne 'Zikr' (Lauh-e-Mahfooz) mein har cheez likh di, phir saat aasman paida kiye." Unhone kaha: phir aik aane wale ne aakar kaha: "Aapki oontni chali gayi hai." Unhone kaha: to (aap SAW ne) farmaya: "Kaash main usse chhod deta."

e: [AI] "For a limited period of time."
hi: "Aik muqarrar muddat tak."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Anyone who hears about me from this nation, whether they be a Jew or a Christian, and does not believe in me, will enter the Fire." So I said, "Where is this mentioned in the Book of Allah?" Until I found this verse, "And whoever disbelieves in it from the factions - the Fire is his promised destination." [Hud 17] The factions refer to all religions.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is Ummat mein se koi bhi shakhs, chahe woh Yahoodi ho ya Nasrani, mere baare mein sunay aur mujhpar imaan na laaye, magar woh Jahannam mein dakhil hoga." To maine (khud se) kaha: "Iski tasdeeq Allah ki Kitaab mein kahan hai?" Yahan tak ke maine yeh ayat paayi: "{Aur jo koi giroh isse kufr kare, to aag hi uska wada-gaah hai}" (Surah Hud 17), unhone kaha: "Ahzaab (giroh) se muraad tamaam mazhab (millatein) hain."

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If Allah were to show Mercy to anyone from among the nation of Nūḥ, he would show Mercy to Umm al-Ṣabī (mother of the young boy)." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Nūḥ remained with his nation for a thousand years save fifty inviting them ˹to the Message˺ until the end of his time. He planted trees and they became plentiful/large and they ˹grew˺ in all different ways. Then he cut them and began to make his ship. ˹The people˺ used to pass by and ask him ˹wondering˺ and he would say, 'I am making a ship.', and they would say, 'You're making a ship on land, how would it sail?' He said, 'You will soon find out.' When he was finished and 'fār al-tannūr' (commonly interpreted as the bursting of springs from the ground) and the flooding started in the pathways. Umm al-Ṣabī feared for ˹her child˺ and she loved him intensely. She left toward the mountain until she reached a narrow tract. When the water reach it she left from there until she settled on the mountain. When the water reached up to her neck, she lifted him in her arms until the water washed her away. So if Allah were to show Mercy to anyone among them, he would show Mercy to Umm al-Ṣabī."[^1]
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar Allah Nuh (AS) ki qaum mein se kisi par reham karta, to woh Umm-us-Sabi (bachche ki maa) par reham karta." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nuh (AS) apni qaum mein hazaar (1000) saal mein se pachaas (50) saal kam thehre, unhein dawat dete rahe, yahan tak ke unke aakhri daur mein unhone aik darakht lagaaya, woh bada hua aur har taraf phaila, phir unhone use kaata aur usse kashti banaane lage, log guzarte aur unse poochte, to woh kehte: 'Main isse kashti banaa raha hoon,' to woh unka mazaaq udaate aur kehte: 'Tum khushki mein kashti banaate ho, yeh kaise chalegi?' Unhone kaha: 'Ankareeb tumhein pata chal jayega.' Jab woh isse faarigh huay, to tannur (chulha) ubalne laga aur galiyon mein paani barh gaya, Umm-us-Sabi ko apne bachche ki fikr hui, aur woh usse bohot mohabbat karti thi, to woh pahaad ki taraf nikli yahan tak ke aik jagah pahunchi, jab paani wahan tak pahuncha to woh usse le kar pahaad par chadh gayi, jab paani uski gardan tak pahuncha to usne bachche ko apne haathon se oopar utha liya, yahan tak ke paani usse bha le gaya. Agar Allah unme se kisi par reham karta, to Umm-us-Sabi par reham karta."

e: [AI] There were three hundred years between Noah and the destruction of his people. The furnace had already spread in India and Noah's ark circled around the Kaaba for a week.
hi: "Nuh (AS) aur unki qaum ki halaakat ke darmiyan teen sau (300) saal ka faasla tha, aur tannur (chulha) Hind (India) mein ubla tha, aur Nuh (AS) ki kashti ne Ka'bah ka aik hafte tawaf kiya."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Dhar saying while he was holding onto the door of the Kaaba, "O people, whoever knows me, then I am the one who you know. And whoever denies me, then I am Abu Dhar." I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The example of my household is like the ark of Noah. Whoever boards it will be saved, and whoever turns away from it will drown."
hi: Maine Abu Dharr (RA) ko Ka'bah ka darwaza pakde huay sunaa: "Aye logo, jo mujhe pehchaanta hai to main wahi hoon jise tum jaante ho, aur jo mujhe nahi pehchaanta, to main Abu Dharr hoon, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Meri ahle-bait ki misaal Nuh (AS) ki kashti jaisi hai, jo isme sawaar hua woh bach gaya, aur jo isse peeche reh gaya woh doob gaya.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to Wadi Al-Azraq and asked, "What is this?" They said, "This is Wadi Al-Azraq." He then said, "It is as if I am seeing Musa ibn Imran coming down from it, wearing a worn-out garment, heading towards Allah while reciting the Takbir." Then he came to Thaniyyah and asked, "What is this Thaniyyah?" They said, "It is Thaniyyah such and such." He then said, "It is as if I am seeing Yunus ibn Matta riding on a red, curly-haired camel with a braided rein, and he is supplicating while wearing a woolen cloak."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Wadi-al-Azraq (neeli ghaati) tak pahunche, to poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Wadi-al-Azraq." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Goya main Musa bin Imran (AS) ko dekh raha hoon, utar rahe hain, unke jaanwar ki aawaz aa rahi hai, takbeer kehte huay Allah ki taraf (badh rahe hain)." Phir aap (SAW) aik ghaati tak pahunche, poocha: "Yeh kaunsi ghaati hai?" Unhone kaha: "Fulan-fulan ghaati." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Goya main Yunus bin Matta (AS) ko dekh raha hoon, aik surkh, ghunghraale baalon wale oont par, jiski lagaam khajoor ke reshon ki hai, aur woh talbiya kehte hain, aur unke oopar oon ka jubba hai."

e: “Abu Bakr [may Allah be pleased with him] said: ‘O Messenger of Allah! You have become gray.’ He said: ‘I have gone gray from (Surat) Hud, Al-Waqiʿah, Al-Mursalat and ʿAmma Yatasa'alun and Idhash-Shamsu Kuwwirat.’” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3297)
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai aap boodhe ho gaye hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe Hud, Al-Waqi'ah, Amma Yatasa'aloon, aur Iza-ash-Shamsu-Kuwwirat ne boodha kar diya hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Ibrahim, the friend of Allah, was inspired with this Arabic language."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ibrahim Khaleel (AS) ko yeh Arabi zubaan wahi (ilhaam) ke zariye di gayi."

e: [AI] About the saying of Allah the Almighty {May Allah's mercy, blessings and forgiveness be upon you, O people of the household}, Ibn Abbas said: I was with Abdullah bin Abbas when a man came to him and greeted him. I said: "And upon you be peace, mercy and blessings of Allah, and His forgiveness." Ibn Abbas responded, "You have reached a level that even the angels have reached."
hi: Ata se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Allah ki rehmat aur uski barkatein tumpar hon, Aye ghar walo}" (Surah Hud 73) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Main Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ke paas tha ke aik shakhs unke paas aaya aur unhein salaam kiya, maine kaha: 'Wa alaikum-us-salam wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu wa maghfiratuhu,' to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: 'Wahin tak pahuncho jahan tak farishte pahunche.'"

e: [AI] "These are my daughters, they are purer for you, so fear Allah and do not disgrace me in my guests." [Hud 78] They said: "We have no right in your daughters, you know what we desire." [Hud 79] He said: "If only I had power over you or could take refuge in a strong support." [Hud 80] Then Gabriel turned towards him, saying: "We are messengers of your Lord; they shall not reach you." [Hud 81] He said: Then he suddenly blinded them. They turned back, calling and riding one another until they returned to their people at the door. They said: "We have come to you from those sorcerers and our sight has been bewitched." So, they continued to ride one another until they entered the city. [Hud 82-83] Then the lie was exposed before them, and the guilty ones were killed. Some of them came to Mount Sinai and some of them were struck by a falling stone. [Hud 84] He left with his daughters, who were three, until they reached a place in Sham (Syria), where his eldest daughter died. There was a well known spring near her known as Al-Wariyah. He continued on his journey according to the will of Allah, and then his youngest daughter died near a spring called Ar-Ru'unah. Only the middle daughter remained.
hi: "{Yeh meri betiyaan hain, yeh tumhare liye zyada paak hain, isliye Allah se daro aur mere mehmaano ke baare mein mujhe ruswa mat karo}" (Surah Hud 78), unhone kaha: "{Humein tumhari betiyon mein koi haq nahi, aur tumhein achhi tarah pata hai hum kya chahte hain}" (Surah Hud 79), "{Unhone kaha: kaash mujhme tumhare khilaaf taaqat hoti ya main kisi mazboot sahaare ki panah leta}" (Surah Hud 80), to Jibra'il (AS) unki taraf mudkar bole: "{Hum tere Rab ke Rasool hain, yeh tujhtak hargiz nahi pahunch sakenge}" (Surah Hud 81), unhone kaha: to unhone unki aankhein mitaa (andhi kar) din, to woh peeche ki taraf palte, aik doosre par gir-padte huay, yahan tak ke woh darwaze par khade logon ke paas nikal aaye, unhone kaha: "Hum aapke paas sabse bade jaadugar (Lut) ke yahan se aaye hain, usne humari nazrein mitaa di hain," to woh aik doosre par gir-padte huay chal pade yahan tak ke basti mein dakhil huay, phir raat ke kisi hisse mein woh basti (aasman ki taraf) uthaayi gayi yahan tak ke woh zameen aur aasman ke darmiyan aa gayi, yahan tak ke woh aasman ki fizaa mein parindon ki aawazein sunne lage, phir usse ulta diya gaya, aur unpar patharon ki barish barsi, to jise us patthar ne pakad liya woh mar gaya, aur jo bhi nikla, patthar ne uska peecha kiya jahan bhi woh tha, aur use maar diya. Unhone kaha: to woh apni betiyon ko lekar rawaana huay, jo teen thin, yahan tak ke jab woh Sham (Syria) ke aik makaam par pahunche to unki badi beti faut ho gayi, unke paas aik chashma nikla jise 'Al-Wariyah' kaha jaata hai, phir woh chalte rahe jahan Allah ne chaaha, to unki chhoti beti faut ho gayi, unke paas aik chashma nikla jise 'Ar-Ru'oonah' kaha jaata hai, to un teenon mein se sirf darmiyaani beti hi baaqi rahi."

e: The people saw fire (light) in the graveyard and they went there. They found that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in a grave and he was saying: Give me your companion. This was a man who used to raise his voice while mentioning the name of Allah. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3164)
hi: Logon ne qabristan mein aik roshni dekhi, to woh wahan aaye, achanak Rasulullah (SAW) qabr mein thay, aur farma rahe the: "Mujhe apna saathi de do," aur woh aisa aadmi tha jo zikr karte huay apni aawaz buland karta tha.

e: [AI] The Quran was revealed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he recited it to them (the people) over a period of time. They said, "O Messenger of Allah, if only you would narrate stories to us." So Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed the verse {Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the clear Book} [Surah Yusuf: 1]. He recited it to them until he reached the verse {We relate to you, [O Muhammad], the best of stories} [Surah Yusuf: 3]. Then they said, "O Messenger of Allah, if only you would tell us." So Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed the verse {Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration} [Surah Az-Zumar: 23]. All of this is commanded by the Quran.
hi: Quran Rasulullah (SAW) par nazil hua, aap (SAW) ne unhein kuch waqt tak isse padh kar sunaaya, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaash aap humein qissay sunaate." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Alif-Laam-Ra, yeh saaf-saaf Kitaab ki aayaten hain}" (Surah Yusuf 1), unhein padha yahan tak ke unke farmaan "{Hum tumhein sabse achha qissa sunaate hain}" (Surah Yusuf 3) tak pahunche, phir aap (SAW) ne unhein kuch waqt tak isse padh kar sunaaya, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaash aap humein baatein sunaate." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Allah ne sabse achhi baat nazil ki hai, aik aisi Kitaab jiske hisse aapas mein milte-julte hain}" (Surah Az-Zumar 23) ayat, yeh sab Quran ke zariye hi hukum diya gaya.

e: [AI] "O father, hire him, indeed the best among those you can hire is the strong and trustworthy." (Qur'an 28:26) And Abu Bakr, when he emerged in Umar's era.
hi: "{Aye mere baap, unhein naukar rakhiye, beshak sabse achha naukar woh hai jo taaqatwar aur amaanatdaar ho}" (Surah Al-Qasas 26), aur Abu Bakr (RA) ne jab Umar (RA) mein yeh (khaslatein) pehchaani (to unhein khalifa muqarrar karne ki sifarish ki).

e:
[AI] She said, "I am prepared for you." [Joseph 23]
So it was said to him, and he replied, "This is how we were taught."
hi: "{Aur usne kaha: aao, main taiyyar hoon}" (Surah Yusuf 23), to unse (iske matlab ke baare mein) poocha gaya, unhone kaha: "Humein isi tarah sikhaya gaya hai."

e: [AI] Jacob was portrayed to him, so he hit his chest and his desire flowed from his fingers.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Agar unhone apne Rab ki daleel na dekhi hoti}" (Surah Yusuf 24) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unhein Ya'qub (AS) ki soorat dikhaayi gayi, to unhone apni chhaati par (haath) maara, to unki khwahish unki ungliyon ke zariye nikal gayi."

e: [AI] Yusuf stumbled upon three incidents when he was accused of them and was imprisoned. His words to the man were, "Remember me before your master." (Yusuf 42) So, he remained in prison for a few years until the devil made him forget mentioning his Lord. His words to them were, "Indeed, you are thieves." (Yusuf 70)
hi: Yusuf (AS) se teen lagzishein (galtiyan) huin jab unhone uska iraada kiya, to unhein qaid kar diya gaya, aur unka us aadmi se kehna: "{Apne aaqa ke paas mera zikr karo}" (Surah Yusuf 42), to woh qaid mein kai saal reh gaye, shaitan ne unhein apne Rab ka zikr bhula diya, aur unka unse kehna: "{Beshak tum chor ho}" (Surah Yusuf 70).

e: [AI] When they both narrated what they had seen and interpreted it, Prophet Yusuf ﷺ  said, "One of you saw nothing, but as for the other, he said, 'Indeed, this is the interpretation of my dream.'"
hi: Jab dono ne apna khwaab bayaan kiya aur Yusuf (AS) ne uski taabeer di, to unme se aik ne kaha: "Humne kuch nahi dekha," to unhone (Yusuf ne) kaha: "{Woh maamla tay ho chuka hai jiske baare mein tum dono poochte ho}" (Surah Yusuf 41).

e: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The honorable, the son of the honorable the son of the honorable, i.e. Joseph, the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham." (Using translation from Bukhārī 4688)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak sakhi, sakhi ke bete, sakhi ke bete, sakhi ke bete, Yusuf bin Ya'qub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim (AS), Rahman ke khaleel (dost) hain, aur agar main utni der (qaid mein) rehta jitni der Yusuf (AS) rahe, phir mere paas bulaawa dene wala aata, to main foran jawaab deta," jab unke paas qaasid aaya, to unhone kaha: "{Apne aaqa ke paas wapas jao aur usse poocho un auraton ka kya haal hai jinhone apne haath kaat liye the, beshak mera Rab unki chaal ko khoob jaanne wala hai}" (Surah Yusuf 50).

e: [AI] "He made some men from the elite of the pre-Islamic era, and Omar said to him, 'Are you Joseph, the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham?' He said, 'No,' he said, 'That is the son of the noble ones, and you are the son of the wicked. You are only counting on me the men of the people of Hellfire.'"
hi: To woh jahiliyat ke sardaaron mein se kuch mardon ka zikr karne laga, to Umar (RA) ne unse poocha: "Kya tum Yusuf bin Ya'qub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim (AS) ho?" Usne kaha: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "Woh nekon ka beta hai, aur tum bado (buron) ke bete ho, tum mujhe sirf Jahannami logon ka zikr sunaa rahe ho."

e:
[AI] Umar said to me, “O enemy of God and enemy of Islam, you have betrayed God’s wealth.” He said: I said, “I am not an enemy of God nor an enemy of Islam; rather, I am an enemy of whoever is their enemy. I have not betrayed God’s wealth; rather, these are the prices of my camels and shares that have accumulated.” He said: So he repeated it to me, and I repeated these words to him. He said: So he fined me twelve thousand. He said: Then I stood in the dawn prayer and said, “O God, forgive the Commander of the Faithful.”

Then after that he wanted to appoint me to a post, but I refused him. He said, “And why, when Joseph asked for office and he was better than you?” I said, “Joseph is a prophet, the son of a prophet, the son of a prophet, the son of a prophet; and I am the son of Umaymah, and I fear three and two.” He said, “Will you not say five?” I said, “No.” He said, “Then what are they?” I said, “I fear that I will speak without knowledge, and that I will give legal opinions without knowledge, and that my back will be beaten, and that my honor will be insulted, and that my wealth will be taken by beating.”
hi: Umar (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Allah ke dushman, aur Islam ke dushman, tumne Allah ka maal khiyanat kiya hai." Maine kaha: "Main na Allah ka dushman hoon na Islam ka, balke main us shakhs ka dushman hoon jo un dono ka dushman ho, aur maine Allah ka maal khiyanat nahi kiya, balke yeh mere oonton ki qeematein aur (tijarat ke) hisse hain jo jama huay hain." Unhone kaha: to unhone yeh baat mujhpar dohraayi, aur maine bhi yeh baat unpar dohraayi. Unhone kaha: to unhone mujhpar barah hazaar (12,000) jurmaana laga diya. Unhone kaha: to main Fajr ki namaz mein khada hua aur kaha: "Aye Allah, Ameer-ul-Momineen ko maaf kar de." Iske baad jab unhone mujhe (kisi) kaam par mamoor karna chaaha to maine inkaar kiya, unhone poocha: "Kyun, jabke Yusuf (AS) ne khud kaam maanga tha aur woh tumse behtar the?" Maine kaha: "Yusuf (AS) Nabi, Nabi ke bete, Nabi ke bete, Nabi ke bete the, aur main Umaimah ka beta hoon, aur main teen aur do (baaton) se darta hoon." Unhone poocha: "Kya tum paanch nahi kehte?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." Unhone poocha: "To woh kya hain?" Maine kaha: "Mujhe darr hai ke main bagair ilm ke baat kahoon, ya bagair ilm ke fatwa dun, ya meri peeth par maara jaaye, ya meri izzat ko gaali di jaaye, ya mera maal maar-peet se chheena jaaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Jacob, the prophet, had a brother who was like a brother to me in Allah's sight. One day, he asked Jacob, 'What caused your vision to become weak and your back to arch?' Jacob said, 'As for the reason for my vision becoming weak, it is because of crying over Joseph, and as for the reason for my back arching, it is because of grieving over my son Benjamin.' Gabriel then came to him and said, 'Jacob, Allah sends His peace upon you and says, "Are you not ashamed to complain about Me to someone other than Me?"' Jacob said, 'I complain only to Allah about my anguish and sadness.' Gabriel said, 'I know what you complain about, Jacob.' Jacob said, 'My Lord, won't you have mercy on the elderly, as You have caused my vision to become weak and my back to arch? So send my fragrance back to me, so I may breathe it in before I die, and then do with me as You wish.' Then Gabriel came to him and said, 'Allah sends His peace upon you and tells you to be glad and to let your heart rejoice. By my honor, if both of them (Joseph and Benjamin) were dead, I would surely have revived them. So make food for the poor, for My beloved among my servants are the prophets and the poor. Do you not know why your vision became weak and your back arched, and why the brothers of Joseph did what they did? You had slaughtered a sheep while a poor orphan who was fasting was brought to you, and you did not feed him anything from it.' Jacob then, after that, whenever he wanted to have lunch, he would call out for someone to announce, 'Whoever wants lunch from the poor, let them eat with Jacob.' And when he would be fasting, he would call out for someone to announce, 'Whoever is fasting among the poor, let them break their fast with Jacob.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ya'qub Nabi (AS) ka aik deeni (Allah ke liye) bhai tha, aik din usne kaha: 'Aye Ya'qub, kis cheez ne aapki nazar cheeni aur aapki pusht ko jhukaaya?' Unhone kaha: 'Rahi baat meri nazar chheenne ki, to woh Yusuf par rone ki wajah se hai, aur rahi baat meri pusht jhukne ki, to woh mere bete Binyamin ke gham ki wajah se hai.' Unhone kaha: to unke paas Jibra'il (AS) aaye aur kaha: 'Aye Ya'qub, Allah aapko salaam kehta hai aur farmata hai: kya tumhein sharm nahi aati ke tum mujhe chhodkar kisi aur se shikayat karo?' Unhone kaha: to Ya'qub (AS) ne kaha: 'Main to sirf apni pareshaani aur gham ki shikayat Allah se hi karta hoon.' Unhone kaha: to Jibra'il (AS) ne kaha: 'Mujhe pata hai tum kis baat ki shikayat karte ho, Aye Ya'qub.' Unhone kaha: phir Ya'qub (AS) ne kaha: 'Aye Rab, kya tu is buzurg par reham nahi karega? Tu ne meri nazar cheen li aur meri pusht jhuka di, isliye meri khushbu (mera aziz beta) mujhe wapas kar de taake main maut se pehle usse aik baar soongh sakoon, phir mere sath jo chahe kar.' Unhone kaha: to unke paas Jibra'il (AS) aaye aur kaha: 'Beshak Allah aapko salaam kehta hai aur farmata hai: khush ho jao aur tumhara dil khush ho jaaye, meri izzat ki qasam, agar woh dono mar bhi chuke hote, to main unhein zinda kar deta, isliye miskeenon ke liye khaana banaao, kyunke mere sabse mahboob bande Ambiya aur miskeen hain, kya tumhein pata hai maine tumhari nazar kyun cheeni aur tumhari pusht kyun jhukaayi, aur Yusuf ke bhaiyon ne unke sath jo kuch kiya woh kyun hua? Tumne aik bakri zibah ki, to tumhare paas aik yateem miskeen aaya jo roze se tha, aur tumne usse usme se kuch nahi khilaaya.' Unhone kaha: to Ya'qub (AS) iske baad jab bhi khaane ka iraada karte, to munaadi karwaate ke 'jo bhi miskeenon mein se khaana chahe, woh Ya'qub ke sath khaaye,' aur jab roze se hote to munaadi karwaate ke 'jo bhi miskeenon mein se roze se ho, woh Ya'qub ke sath iftaar kare.'"

e: [AI] From the Prophet of Allah ﷺ , it was said, "Jacob had a foster brother." So he mentioned the hadeeth in a similar manner.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ya'qub (AS) ka aik deeni bhai tha," phir isi jaisi hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] I said to her the following quote from Allah Almighty: "Until when the messengers despaired and thought that they had been denied..." [Quran 12:110]. I said, "Did they really despair, thinking that they had been denied?" She replied, "I seek refuge in Allah from thinking such a thing about His messengers. They are only the followers of the messengers when victory is delayed and the affliction intensifies upon them. The messengers thought that their followers had been denied."
hi: Maine unse (poocha), Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Yahan tak ke jab Rusul mayoos ho gaye aur unhone samjha ke unse jhoot kaha gaya}" (Surah Yusuf 110) ke baare mein, maine poocha: "Kya woh sach mein is baat se mayoos ho gaye ke unse jhoot kaha gaya tha?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki panah ke Rusul apne Rab ke baare mein aisa gumaan karein, balke yeh Rusul ke pairokaar the, jab unhein madad mein deri hui aur museebat sakht ho gayi, to Rusul ko lagne laga ke unke pairokaaron ne unhein jhutlaa diya hai."

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: Indeed, your Lord, the Most High, says, 'If my servants were to obey me, I would surely have given them rain during the night, caused the sun to rise upon them during the day, and they would not have heard the sound of thunder.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhara Rab Ta'ala farmata hai: agar mere bande meri itaa'at karte, to main unhein raat ko baarish pilaata aur din ko unpar suraj chamkaata, aur unhein garaj ki aawaz na sunaata."

e: [AI] "From one of the two books, there are two books that Allah erases whatever He wills from one of them, and He confirms and keeps with Him the Mother of the Book. (Surah Ar-Ra'd 39) This means the whole sentence of the book. 'A Muslim argued with Hammam and Al-Bukhari argued with Ikrimah.' This is a strange and authentic Hadith from Sulaiman Al-Taymi, and they did not mention it as authentic or strange."
hi: Do kitaabein hain, Allah unme se aik se jo chaahe mita deta hai, "{aur qaayam rakhta hai, aur uske paas Umm-ul-Kitaab (Kitaab ki jad) hai}" (Surah Ar-Ra'd 39), ya'ni sari Kitaab. "Muslim ne Hammad se hujjat li hai aur Bukhari ne Ikrimah se hujjat li hai," aur yeh Sulaiman At-Taimi ki hadith se ajeeb-o-sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "Precaution is of no use against fate, but Allah erases through prayers what He wishes of fate."
hi: "Hoshiyaari (ehtiyaat) taqdeer ke khilaaf kaam nahi aati, lekin Allah dua ke zariye taqdeer se jo chaahe mita deta hai."

e: [AI] Ishaq narrated that Abdur-Razzaq informed Thawri, who reported from Talhah, who reported from Ata, who reported from Ibn Abbas, regarding the saying of Allah Almighty: "Do they not see that We are gradually reducing the land from its sides?" (Surah Ar-Rad 41). He said, "The death of its scholars and jurists."
hi: Ishaq ne humein hadith bayan ki, Abdur Razzaq ne humein khabar di, Ath-Thawri ne humein khabar di, Talhah se, unhone Ata se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Kya woh nahi dekhte ke hum zameen ko uske kinaron se kam karte jaate hain}" (Surah Ar-Ra'd 41) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Uske ulama aur fuqaha ki maut."

e:
[AI] "Allah the Almighty says: 'And whoever among them says, 'Indeed, I am a god besides Him,' then that person We will recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.' [Surah Al-Anbiya 29]

*And He said to Muhammad, peace be upon him: 'Indeed, We have granted you a clear conquest, that Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow...' [Surah Al-Fath 2]

They asked: What is the reason for Allah's preference of Muhammad over the people of the earth?

He replied: Indeed, Allah the Almighty says, 'And We have not sent any messenger except in the language of his people.' [Surah Ibrahim 4]

And He said to Muhammad, peace be upon him: 'And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner to all mankind.' [Surah Saba 28]

So He sent him to the jinn and mankind."
hi: Beshak Allah ne Muhammad (SAW) ko aasman waalon par fazeelat di aur unhein zameen waalon par bhi fazeelat di. Unhone poocha: "Aye Ibn Abbas, unhein aasman waalon par kis cheez se fazeelat di?" Unhone kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur jo unme se yeh kahe ke main uske siwa koi ma'bood hoon, to hum use Jahannam ki saza denge, hum zaalimon ko isi tarah saza dete hain}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 29), aur Muhammad (SAW) se farmaya: "{Beshak humne tumhein khuli fatah di, taake Allah tumhare agle aur pichhle gunah maaf kar de}" (Surah Al-Fath 2) ayat. Unhone poocha: "To unhein zameen waalon par kis cheez se fazeelat di?" Unhone kaha: "Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: {Aur humne koi Rasool nahi bheja magar uski qaum ki zubaan mein} (Surah Ibrahim 4) ayat, aur Muhammad (SAW) se farmaya: {Aur humne aapko sirf sare insaano ke liye khush-khabri dene wala aur daraane wala banaakar bheja hai} (Surah Saba 28)," to unhein jinnaat aur insaan dono ki taraf bheja.

e: [AI] He said about the saying of Allah, the Almighty: "Then they will bite their hands in regret" [Ibrahim 14:48]. He said, "They will fiercely bite their hands."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To unhone apne haath apne munh mein wapas kar liye}" (Surah Ibrahim 9) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unhone unhein kaata."

e: [AI] On the authority of Abdullah, regarding His saying, exalted be He, "So they put their hands in their mouths." [Ibrahim 9] Abdullah said that he replicated this by putting his hand in his mouth and biting it, and he said, "Bite onto your fingers in anger."
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To unhone apne haath apne munh mein wapas kar liye}" (Surah Ibrahim 9) ke baare mein, Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Isi tarah," aur unhone apna haath apne munh mein daala aur use kaata, aur kaha: "Ghusse se apni ungliyan kaato."

e: [AI] When Allah the Mighty and Majestic revealed to his Prophet, may peace be upon him, the verse: "O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire," [Al-Tahrim 6], the Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him, recited it to his companions one night or one day.
