A young man then fell unconscious. The Prophet, may peace be upon him, placed his hand on the young man's heart, and it started moving. The Prophet said, "O young man, say 'There is no god but Allah.'" He said it, and the Prophet gave him glad tidings of Paradise. His companions asked the Messenger of Allah, "Is he safe among us?" The Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him, said, "Did you not hear the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, 'That is for him who fears My station and fears My threat'?" [Ibrahim 14].
hi: Jab Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (SAW) par yeh nazil ki: "{Aye imaan walo, apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko us aag se bachaao}" (Surah At-Tahrim 6), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne ise apne sahaba ko aik raat ya din padh kar sunaayi, to aik jawaan behosh hokar gir pada, Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath uske dil par rakha, to woh harkat kar raha tha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye jawaan, kaho: La ilaha illallah." Usne yeh kaha, to aap (SAW) ne use Jannat ki khush-khabri di. Unke sahaba ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya woh humme se (khaas) hai?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumne Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan nahi suna: {Yeh us shakhs ke liye hai jo meri shaan ka darr rakhe aur mere waade se daray}" (Surah Ibrahim 14).

e: "He will be given water of Sadid to drink, he will swallow it..." that the Prophet ﷺ said: " It will be brought toward his mouth and he will dislike it, so whenever it is brought closer to him it will melt his face and the skin of his head will fall into it. Then whenever he drinks from it, his bowels will be severed until it comes out from his anus. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted says: "And they will be given water of Hamim to drink such that it cuts up their bowels..." and He says: "And if they call for drink they will be given water of Muhl which melts the faces, the worst of drinks..." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2583)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur use peep ka paani piya jayega, jise woh ghoont-ghoont kar peeyega}" (Surah Ibrahim 17) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh uske qareeb laaya jayega, to woh usse napasand karega, jab woh uske qareeb hoga to uska chehra jhulsa dega aur uske sar ki khaal gir jayegi, aur jab woh usse piyega to uski aanten katt jaayengi yahan tak ke woh uski peeth se bahar nikal aayengi." Allah farmata hai: "{Aur unhein garam paani pilaaya gaya, jisne unki aanten katt din}" (Surah Muhammad 15), aur Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "{Aur agar woh madad maangenge to unhein aise paani se madad di jayegi jo pighle huay tel jaisa hoga, jo chehron ko jhulsa dega, kitna bura mashroob hai}" (Surah Al-Kahf 29).

e: [AI] Ibn Hibban said it cannot be used as evidence.
hi: Ibn Hibban ne kaha: "Isse hujjat nahi li ja sakti."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was brought a mask made of musk. He recited the example of a good word like a good tree and said, "It is the date palm tree."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas kachhi khajoor (busr) ka aik thaal laaya gaya, aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Achhi baat ki misaal achhe darakht jaisi hai}" (Surah Ibrahim 24), aur farmaya: "Yeh khajoor ka darakht hai."

e: [AI] "Who are those who exchanged the blessings of Allah for disbelief and made their people dwell in the Abode of Destruction?" They said, "The hypocrites of the Quraysh." He said, "So who are those whose efforts have gone astray in worldly life, while they thought that they were acquiring good by their deeds?" He said, "Among them are the people of Harura."
hi: "Woh log kaun hain jinhone Allah ki ne'mat ko kufr se badla aur apni qaum ko halaakat ke ghar mein utaara?" Unhone kaha: "Quraish ke munafiqeen." Poocha gaya: "To woh log kaun hain jinki koshish duniya ki zindagi mein gum ho gayi jabke woh samajhte hain ke woh achha kaam kar rahe hain?" Unhone kaha: "Unme se Harura waale hain."

e: [AI] From Ali regarding His saying, Exalted and Majestic is He, "And they made their people dwell in the dwelling place of destruction" [Ibrahim 28]. He said, "They are the two wicked tribes from Quraysh, Banu Umayyah and Banu Mugheerah. As for Banu Mugheerah, Allah has destroyed their descendants on the day of Badr. And as for Banu Umayyah, they will be given respite for a certain period of time."
hi: Ali (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur apni qaum ko halaakat ke ghar mein utaara}" (Surah Ibrahim 28) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Quraish ke do fasaad-zada (giroh) hain - Banu Umayyah aur Banu Al-Mughirah, rahi baat Banu Al-Mughirah ki, to Allah ne Badr ke din unki jad kaat di, aur rahi baat Banu Umayyah ki, to unhein aik waqt tak faida uthaane diya gaya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, recited, "On the day when the earth will be changed to something other than the earth, and the heavens as well, and they will come forth to Allah, the One, the Subduer." I asked, "Where will the people be on that day?" He replied, "They will be on the Bridge."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Jis din zameen kisi doosri zameen se aur aasman (doosre aasman se) badal diye jayenge, aur woh Allah, Waahid, Qahhar ke saamne haazir ho jaayenge}," maine poocha: "Us din log kahan hongay?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sirat (pul) par."

e: [AI] "Allah continues to intercede, admit into paradise, have mercy, and intercede until He says, 'Whoever among the Muslims, let him enter paradise.' That is when He says, 'Perhaps those who disbelieved wish that they had been Muslims.' (Al-Hijr 2)"
hi: "Allah hamesha shafa'at karta rahega, Jannat mein daakhil karta rahega, aur reham karta rahega, aur shafa'at qubool ki jaati rahegi, yahan tak ke woh farmayega: 'Jo bhi Musalman ho woh Jannat mein daakhil ho jaaye,' aur yehi woh waqt hai jab woh farmata hai: {Kaafir kai baar tamanna karengay ke kaash woh Musalman hote}" (Surah Al-Hijr 2).

e: “A woman used to perform prayer behind the Prophet ﷺ, and she was one of the most beautiful of people. Some of the people used to go into the first row so that they would not see her, and some of them used to lag behind so that they would be in the last row, and when they bowed, they would do like this so that they could see her from beneath their armpits. Then Allah revealed: “And indeed, We know the first generations of you who had passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you (mankind), and also those who will some afterwards.” [15:24] concerning her matter. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1046)
hi: Aik khoobsurat aurat, sabse khoobsurat logon mein se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe namaz padhti thi, kuch log jaan-boojh kar pehli saf mein aage aa jaate taake use na dekhein, aur kuch log jaan-boojh kar peeche reh jaate yahan tak ke woh aakhri saf mein hote, jab woh ruku karte to apni baghal ke neeche se jhaank kar dekhte, is tarah, aur apne haath (jism se) door rakhte. To Allah Ta'ala ne unke baare mein yeh nazil ki: "{Aur beshak humein tum mein se aage badhne walon ka pata hai, aur beshak humein peeche rehne walon ka bhi pata hai}" (Surah Al-Hijr 24).

e: [AI] "The forward rows are for those who come early and the back rows are for those who come late." - Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary.
hi: "Al-Mustaqdimeen (aage badhne wale) se muraad aage ki safein hain, aur Al-Musta'khireen (peeche rehne wale) se muraad peechhe ki safein hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Do you welcome me, O Amir al-Mu'minin, even though you have killed my father and taken my wealth?" He replied, "As for your wealth, it is in the treasury, so go tomorrow and take it. As for your claim that you have killed my father, I hope that both you and your father are among those whom Allah, the Almighty, has mentioned in the verse: 'And We have removed whatever was in their breasts of resentment, [while] brothers, on thrones facing each other' (Surah Al-Hijr 47)." A man from Hamdan said, "Indeed, Allah is more just than that." Upon hearing this, Ali let out a cry that could be heard throughout the palace. He said, "Then who are we if we are not those mentioned in the verse?" This narration is authentic and has not been narrated by anyone else.
hi: "Aap mera istiqbaal kar rahe hain, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, jabke aapne mere baap ko qatl kiya aur mera maal le liya?" Unhone kaha: "Rahi baat tumhare maal ki, to woh Baitul-Maal mein alag rakha hai, kal jaakar le lo, aur rahi baat tumhare is kehne ki ke maine tumhare baap ko qatl kiya, to mujhe ummeed hai ke main aur tumhara baap dono unme se hongay jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {Aur humne unke dilon se kina nikaal diya hoga, woh bhai-bhai bankar takhton par aamne-saamne baithe hongay}" (Surah Al-Hijr 47). To Hamdan ke aik shakhs ne kaha: "Allah issse zyada munsif hai." To Ali (RA) ne uspar itni zor se cheekha ke uski goonj mahal mein sunayi di, unhone kaha: "To phir kaun honge, agar hum nahi?" Sahih ul-isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "When the believers are saved from the Fire, they will be detained on a bridge between the Fire and Paradise to settle their disputes that existed among them in the world. When they are purified and have their sins expiated, permission will be granted for them to enter Paradise. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, one of them will be more generous in giving a place for his fellow believer in Paradise than what anyone of you gives of his dwelling in the world."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab momin Jahannam se nijaat paa lein, to unhein Jahannam aur Jannat ke darmiyan aik pul par rok liya jayega, woh duniya mein aapas mein hue zulm ka hisaab chukaayenge, yahan tak ke jab woh paak aur saaf ho jaayenge, to unhein Jannat mein dakhil honay ki ijaazat di jayegi, aur us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, unme se koi Jannat mein apni jagah ki taraf raah dikhaane mein duniya mein apne ghar ki taraf raah dikhaane wale tum mein se kisi bhi shakhs se zyada mahir hoga."

e: [AI] "Don't you see the man sending his ring to his family, saying, 'Bring me this and that,' and when they see it, they recognize that it is true."
hi: "Kya tum us aadmi ko nahi dekhte jo apni angoothi apne ghar walon ke paas bheje aur kahe: 'fulan-fulan cheez lao,' to jab woh use dekhte hain to jaan jaate hain ke yeh haqiqi (asli) hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said, "The seven repeatedly-recited verses (Al-Fatiha) are the opening of the Book."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sab'-ul-Mathaani (saat baar-baar padhi jaane wali aayaten) Fatihat-ul-Kitaab hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was given seven mathānī (oft-repeated āyāt) and the long ones while Moses was given six."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko saat mathaani aur lambi (Surahon) mein se diya gaya, aur Musa (AS) ko chhah diye gaye."

e: In His saying, exalted be He, "And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an." [Al-Hijr: 87] Al-Baqarah, Ali 'Imran, An-Nisa', Al-Ma'idah, Al-An'am, Al-A'raf, and the Surah Al-Kahf.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur beshak humne tumhein saat mathaani aur azeem Quran diya}" (Surah Al-Hijr 87) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Al-Baqarah, Aal-e-Imran, An-Nisa, Al-Ma'idah, Al-An'am, Al-A'raf, aur Surah Al-Kahf."

e: [AI] "The Jews and the Christians are divided, and their saying, 'The Quran is false.' Allah says, 'They believe in some and disbelieve in some.'"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jaisa humne baantne walon par nazil kiya, jinhone Quran ke tukde-tukde kar diye}" (Surah Al-Hijr 91) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Baantne wale Yahoodi aur Nasaara hain," aur unke farmaan "{Unhone Quran ke tukde-tukde kar diye}" (Surah Al-Hijr 91) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unhone kuch par imaan laaya aur kuch ka inkaar kiya."

e: [AI] About this verse, "you take from it intoxication and good provision" [An-Nahl 67], Al-Sakar refers to what is forbidden from its fruits, and good provision refers to what is permissible from its fruits.
hi: Is ayat "{Tum usse nasha (sakar) aur achha rizq banaate ho}" (Surah An-Nahl 67) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Sakar woh hai jo uske phal se haraam kiya gaya, aur achha rizq woh hai jo uske phal se halaal hai."

e: [AI] Regarding Abdullah's statement, Allah says "sons and grandsons" [An-Nahl 72]. Al-Hafadah refers to two sisters.
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Bete aur damaad (hafadah)}" (Surah An-Nahl 72) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Hafadah se muraad damaad/sasural waale (ikhtaan) hain."

e: [AI] "Abdullah in the words of Allah, Almighty said: 'We have increased them in punishment above the punishment.' (Surah An-Nahl, 88) He said: 'The stingers of scorpions are like the long date palm branches.'"
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Humne unhein azaab par azaab barhaa diya}" (Surah An-Nahl 88) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Bicchoon ke dank lambi khajoor ke darakhton jaise honge."

e: [AI] I heard from Abdullah and I believe you or I'm telling you the truth. He said, "I heard Abdullah say that indeed in the Quran there is a verse in Surah An-Nahl that encompasses both good and evil. [It says]: 'Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.'" He [the narrator] said, "You spoke the truth."
hi: Maine Abdullah (RA) ko kehte suna: "Quran mein sabse jaame' ayat jo neki aur buraai dono ke baare mein hai, woh Surah An-Nahl mein hai: {Beshak Allah insaaf, ehsaan, aur qareebi rishtedaaron ko dene ka hukum deta hai, aur besharmi, buri baaton, aur zulm se mana karta hai, woh tumhein naseehat karta hai taake tum yaad rakho}" (Surah An-Nahl 90). Unhone kaha: "Tumne sach kaha."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: There is no sin more fitted to have punishment meted out by Allah to its perpetrator in advance in this world along with what He stores up for him in the next world than oppression and severing ties of relationship. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4902)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi gunah is baat ka zyada haqdaar nahi ke uske karne wale ke liye duniya mein jaldi saza di jaaye, uske sath uske liye jo aakhirat mein jama kiya jaata hai, siwaye zulm aur rishtedaari kaatne ke." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to supplicate and say, 'O Allah, suffice me with what You have provided me and bless it for me and replace every absent thing for me with something better.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) dua karte huay kehte the: "Aye Allah, jo tu ne mujhe rizq diya hai usspar mujhe qana'at ata kar aur usme mere liye barkat de, aur mujhse jo bhi cheez ghaayab ho uski jagah behtar cheez de."

e: [AI] "And He said in Surah An-Nahl, 'And when We substitute a verse in place of another verse' (16:101) and He said in His statement, glorified be He, 'Then indeed, your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allah] and were patient, indeed, your Lord, after that, is forgiving and merciful' (16:110). The verse means that it is Abdullah bin Sa'd or someone else who used to be the governor of Egypt and he used to write on behalf of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, but then he defected and joined the disbelievers. So the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, ordered that he be killed on the Day of the Conquest. Uthman bin Affan sought his protection for him from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, granted him protection."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jo bhi ayat hum mansookh karein}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 106) ke baare mein, aur Surah An-Nahl mein farmaya: "{Aur jab hum aik ayat ki jagah doosri ayat badal dete hain}" (Surah An-Nahl 101), aur Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Phir beshak tumhara Rab un logon ke liye jinhone azmaaishon ke baad hijrat ki}" (Surah An-Nahl 110) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Abdullah bin Sa'd ya koi aur hain, jo Misr mein waali the aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye likha karte the, phir woh phisal gaye aur kaafiron se jaa mile, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Fatah (Makkah) ke din qatl karne ka hukum diya, to Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne unke liye Rasulullah (SAW) se panaah maangi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein panaah de di."

e: The polytheists seized Ammar b. Yasir and would not release him until he reviled the Prophet ﷺ and spoke well of their gods. Then they released him. When he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said, *"What happened to you?"* He replied, “Something terrible, O Messenger of Allah. I was not released until I spoke ill of you and spoke well of their gods.” He said, *"How do you find your heart?"* He replied, “At peace with faith.” He said, *"If they do it again, then do the same."*[^1]
hi: Mushrikeen ne Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ko pakda, aur unhein tab tak nahi chhoda jab tak unhone Nabi (SAW) ko bura-bhala na kaha aur unke maaboodon ki tareef na ki, phir unhein chhod diya. Jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Peechhe kya chhoda?" Unhone kaha: "Bura haal, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe tab tak nahi chhoda gaya jab tak maine aapke baare mein bura-bhala na kaha aur unke maaboodon ki tareef na ki." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum apna dil kaisa paate ho?" Unhone kaha: "Imaan par mutma'in." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar woh dobara aisa karein, to tum bhi dobara aisa hi karna."

e: [AI] "Allah is the tongue to which the impenetrable speak, while this is a clear Arabic tongue. Indeed, those who do not believe in the signs of Allah fabricate lies."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Sirf aik insaan hi unhein sikhaata hai, jiski taraf woh (galat) ishara karte hain uski zubaan ajami (ghair-Arabi) hai, aur yeh saaf Arabi zubaan hai}" (Surah An-Nahl 103) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh kehte the ke Muhammad (SAW) ko sirf Abd bin Al-Hadhrami sikhaata hai, jo kitaabon ka maalik (jaankaar) tha," to Allah ne farmaya: "{Jiski taraf woh (galat) ishara karte hain uski zubaan ajami hai, aur yeh saaf Arabi zubaan hai, sirf woh log jhoot ghadte hain jo Allah ki aayaton par imaan nahi rakhte}".

e: [AI] "Verily, those who do not believe in the signs of Allah are the ones who fabricate lies." [Surah An-Nahl 105] I have never mentioned this before, and I do not know it. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "{Sirf woh log jhoot ghadte hain jo Allah ki aayaton par imaan nahi rakhte}" (Surah An-Nahl 105) - maine yeh baat kabhi bayan nahi ki aur na hi mujhe iska ilm hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Ali, indeed you will be presented before my captor, so curse me. And if my innocence is presented to you, do not disown me. For I am steadfast upon Islam, so let one of you extend his neck for me. Curse be upon his mother, for he shall have no worldly life nor afterlife after leaving Islam. Then recite (except for those who are compelled [by necessity], while his heart is at rest with faith). [An-Nahl 106] . The chain of transmission is correct and it has not been excluded."
hi: "Aye Ali, ankareeb tumhein mujhe bura-bhala kehne ke liye pesh kiya jayega, isliye mujhe bura-bhala keh dena, aur agar tumhein mujhse bezaari (izhaar) ka kaha jaaye, to mujhse bezaari mat izhaar karna, kyunke main Islam par hoon, isliye tum mein se koi (agar zaroorat pade to) apni gardan badha de, uski maa use kho de, kyunke Islam ke baad uske liye na duniya hai na aakhirat." Phir unhone yeh padha: "{Siwaye us shakhs ke jise majboor kiya gaya ho jabke uska dil imaan par mutma'in ho}" (Surah An-Nahl 106). "Isnad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Sahih.

e: [AI] "He (Ali) will have a day, O stone, where you will be erected after me and you will be commanded to curse me, so curse me and do not absolve me." Tawus said, "I saw the stone of the Madariyya and it was established by Ahmad ibn Ibrahim, the caliph of the Umayyads, in the mosque and he assigned it to curse Ali or to be killed." The stone said, "Indeed, the prince Ahmad ibn Ibrahim commanded me to curse Ali, so curse him, may Allah curse him." Tawus said, "Indeed, Allah has blinded their hearts to the extent that none of them stood against what he (the stone) said." Yahya al-Hamani is considered weak (in terms of reliability).
hi: Ali (RA) ne aik din unse (Hujr se) kaha: "Aye Hujr, tumhein mere baad khada kiya jayega aur mujhe bura-bhala kehne ka hukum diya jayega, isliye mujhe bura-bhala keh dena, lekin mujhse bezaari izhaar mat karna." Tawoos ne kaha: to maine Hujr Al-Madari ko dekha, Ahmad bin Ibrahim, Banu Umayyah ke khalifa, ne unhein masjid mein khada kiya aur unpar mamoor kiya ke woh Ali ko bura-bhala kahein warna qatl kar diye jaayenge, to Hujr ne kaha: "Sunlo, Ameer Ahmad bin Ibrahim ne mujhe hukum diya hai ke main Ali ko bura-bhala kahoon, to tum sab bhi unhein bura-bhala kaho, Allah unhein bura-bhala kahe." Tawoos ne kaha: "Allah ne unke dilon ko andha kar diya tha, yahan tak ke unme se kisi ne bhi jo unhone kaha usspar dhyaan nahi diya." Yahya Al-Hamani kamzor (raawi) hain.

e: [AI] Ishaq narrated from Abdur-Razzaq, who narrated from Thawri, who narrated from Firas, who narrated from Al-Sha'bi, who narrated from Masruq, who said, "I read with Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: 'Indeed, Ibrahim was an obedient nation to Allah' [16:120]. Ibn Mas'ud said, 'Mu'adh was an obedient nation.' They repeated this to him, and he repeated it. Then he said, 'Do you know what an obedient nation is? It is the one who teaches people goodness and is obedient to Allah and His Messenger.'"
hi: Ishaq ne humein hadith bayan ki, Abdur Razzaq ne humein khabar di, Ath-Thawri ne humein khabar di, Firas se, unhone Ash-Sha'bi se, unhone Masrooq se, unhone kaha: maine Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ke saamne padha: "{Beshak Ibrahim (AS) khud aik Ummat (poori jama'at) the, Allah ke aage jhukne wale}" (Surah An-Nahl 120), to Ibn Mas'ood (RA) ne kaha: "Mu'adh khud aik jhukne wali Ummat the." Unhone kaha: to unhone unse dobara poocha, to unhone dobara wahi kaha, phir kaha: "Kya tumhein pata hai Ummat kya hai? Woh hai jo logon ko bhalaai sikhaaye, aur 'qaanit' (jhukne wala) woh hai jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaa'at kare."

e: "On the Day of Uhud, sixty-four of the Ansar were killed, and six from the Muhajirin, one of whom was Hamzah, and they mutilated them, so the Ansar said: 'If, (in the future) we are able to kill them on a day like this, we would mutilate from among them as twice as they (mutilate from among us).'" He said: "So on the day of the Conquest of Makkah, Allah revealed: And if you punish them, then punish them with the like of that with which you were afflicted. But if you have patience, then it is better for those who are patient (16:126). So a man said: 'There shall be no Quraish after today.' But the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Leave the people, except for four.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3129)
hi: Jab Uhud ka din hua, to Ansar mein se chausath (64) aadmi aur Muhajireen mein se chhah (6) shaheed huay, unka jism mus-la (bigaada) gaya, jinme Hamzah bhi thay, to Ansar ne kaha: "Agar humein aisa din phir mila, to hum unse (badla lene mein) zyada karenge." Jab Fatah-e-Makkah ka din hua, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur agar tum saza do, to usi tarah do jaisi saza tumhein di gayi thi, aur agar tum sabr karo to yeh sabr karne walon ke liye behtar hai}" (Surah An-Nahl 126), to aik shakhs ne kaha: "Aaj ke baad Quraish nahi bachega." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qaum se ruk jao, chaar ke ilawa."

e: [AI] I was in a gathering where Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman was present. So, I said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was taken on a night journey, and he entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque." Hudhayfah responded, "How do you know that, O bald one? I recognize your face, but I do not know your name. What is your name?" So, I said to him, "I am Zirr ibn Hubaysh al-Asadi." He then asked, "How do you know that he entered the mosque?" I replied, "By the Quran." Hudhayfah said, "Whoever holds firmly to the Quran shall have success." I then recited the verse, "Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed." [Quran, 17:1] Hudhayfah asked, "Do you see him entering it?" I said, "Yes." He said, "By Allah, he did not enter it. If he had entered, it would have been prescribed for you to pray there." Then he added, "He did not leave the back of al-Buraq until he saw Paradise and Hellfire, and he was given the promise of the Hereafter." I said, "O Abu Abdullah, what is al-Buraq?" He replied, "It is an animal larger than a donkey, and smaller than a mule, with its step covering the range of its vision."
hi: Main aik majlis mein tha jismein Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (RA) maujood the, maine kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko jab isra (raat ka safar) karwaaya gaya, to woh Masjid-e-Aqsa mein dakhil huay." Unhone kaha: to Hudhaifah (RA) ne poocha: "Tumhein yeh kaise pata chala, Aye ganje? Main tumhara chehra pehchaanta hoon lekin tumhara naam nahi jaanta, tumhara naam kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Main Zirr bin Hubaish Al-Asadi hoon." Unhone kaha: phir unhone poocha: "Tumhein kaise pata chala ke woh masjid mein dakhil huay?" Maine kaha: "Quran se." To Hudhaifah (RA) ne kaha: "Jo Quran ko pakde woh kaamyaab hua." Unhone kaha: to maine padha: "{Paak hai woh Zaat jo apne bande ko raat ko Masjid-e-Haram se Masjid-e-Aqsa tak le gaya jiske ird-gird humne barkat rakhi hai}" (Surah Al-Isra 1). To Hudhaifah (RA) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein lagta hai woh usme dakhil huay?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, woh usme dakhil nahi huay, aur agar woh dakhil huay hote to tumpar usme namaz farz kar di jaati." Unhone kaha: phir unhone kaha: "Aur woh Buraq ki peeth se juda nahi huay yahan tak ke unhone Jannat aur Jahannam dono dekh liye, aur unhein poori Aakhirat ka wada diya gaya." Maine kaha: "Aye Abu Abdullah, Buraq kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aik jaanwar jo gadhe se bada aur khachhar se chhota hai, uska kadam wahan tak jaata hai jahan tak nazar jaati hai."

e: from his father that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: When we reached Bayt al-Maqdis (al-Aqsa), Jibril pointed with his finger causing a crack in the rock, and he tied Buraq to it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab hum Baitul-Maqdis (Al-Aqsa) tak pahunche, to Jibra'il (AS) ne apni ungli se ishara kiya, isse chatan mein aik shaq (nishaan) daala, aur Buraq ko usse baandh diya."

e: [AI] Noah, when he would eat food or wear a garment, would praise Allah and be named a grateful servant.
hi: "Nuh (AS) jab bhi khaana khaate ya kapda pehente, to Allah ki hamd karte, isliye unhein 'shukr-guzaar banda' kaha gaya."

e: [AI] "Is there anyone trustworthy among the people?" I said, "If there were, would you have done what you have done?" He said, "If there were any of them among them, I would have taken him by the head and recited to him such and such verse, 'And We decreed for the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, 'You would do mischief on the earth twice and you will become tyrants and extremely arrogant!'" (Quran 17:4), according to the criteria of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Kya un logon mein se koi (maujood) hai?" Maine kaha: "Agar hota to aap kya karte?" Unhone kaha: "Agar unme se koi hota, to main uska sar pakadta, phir usse yeh ayat padh kar sunaata: {Aur humne Bani Israel ko Kitaab mein yeh faisla suna diya ke tum zameen mein do baar fasaad phailaogay, aur bohot bada sarkash ban jaaogay}" (Surah Al-Isra 4).

e: [AI] "Uthman and this is the reading of Hamzah"
hi: Uthman (RA), aur yeh Hamzah ki qiraat hai.

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, I am a person with abundant wealth, family, and children. So how should I behave or spend it?" He (the Prophet) said, "Pay the obligatory Zakat as purification for yourself and give good treatment to your relatives. Also, recognize the rights of the beggars, neighbors, the destitute, and the traveler." He asked, "O Messenger of Allah, advice me to the minimum." The Prophet said, "Give the rightful share to your close relatives, the destitute, and those stranded on the road, and do not waste excessively." He asked, "O Messenger of Allah, if I pay the Zakat to the Messenger of the Messenger of Allah, have I paid it to Allah and His Messenger?" He said, "Yes, if you have paid it to His Messenger, then you have indeed paid it, and you will receive its reward, while the sin will be upon the one who substitutes it."
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere paas bohot maal hai aur ghar wale aur aulaad bhi, to mujhpar kya karna aur kharch karna wajib hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Farz zakat ada karo, yeh tumhein paak karegi, aur rishtedaari nibhaao, aur maangne wale, padosi, miskeen, aur musafir ka haq pehchaano." Usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mukhtasar bataayen." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To qareebi ko uska haq do, aur miskeen aur musafir ko bhi, aur be-jaa fuzool-kharchi na karo." Usne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar main zakat Rasulullah (SAW) ke qaasid ko dun, to kya main isse Allah aur uske Rasool tak pahuncha chuka?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, agar tum ise unke qaasid ko de do, to tumne ise ada kar diya, aur iska ajr tumhare liye hai, aur jo ise badal de uska gunah uspar hai."

e: [AI] Abu Al-'Ubaidain came to Abdullah and he was a blind man. So Abdullah was introduced to him and he said, "O Abu Abdur-Rahman, who do we ask if we do not ask you?". Abdullah replied, "What is your need?". He said, "What is righteousness?". Abdullah said, "It is to be kind and accommodating to people". He said, "And what is kindness?". Abdullah said, "To help people in their needs". He said, "And what is wastefulness?". Abdullah said, "To spend money in unnecessary things". He said, "And what is the ummah?". Abdullah said, "It is the one who teaches people good things".
hi: Abu Al-Ubaidain, Abdullah (RA) ke paas aaye, aur woh nabina (andhe) aadmi the, to Abdullah (RA) unhein pehchaan liye gaye, unhone kaha: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, agar hum aapse na poochein to kisse poochein?" Unhone kaha: "To tumhein kya zaroorat hai?" Usne poocha: "Al-Awwah (bohot aajiz/reham karne wala) kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Reham karne wala." Usne poocha: "Al-Maa'oon (rozmarra ki madad) kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Jismein log aapas mein aik doosre ki madad karein." Usne poocha: "At-Tabdheer (fuzool-kharchi) kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Maal ko uske haq ke bagair kharch karna." Usne poocha: "Al-Ummah kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Woh jo logon ko bhalaai sikhaaye."

e: [AI] When {May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined} [Al-Masad 1] was revealed, Al-Awarah, the mother of Jameel, the daughter of Harb, came forward. She had ornaments in her hand and she was saying in a disapproving manner, "We have denied our father and his religion, and we have disobeyed his command." The Prophet ﷺ was sitting in the mosque with Abu Bakr, and when Abu Bakr saw her, he said, "O Messenger of Allah, she has come, and I fear that she might see you." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "She will not see me." And he recited some verses from the Quran and sought refuge in Allah through them, as He said, "And when you recite the Quran, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition." [Al-Isra' 45] So she stood in front of Abu Bakr and did not see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She said, "O Abu Bakr, I have been informed that your companion has bewitched me." He replied, "No, by the Lord of this house, he has not bewitched you." So she turned away saying, "Quraysh has known that I am the daughter of its chief."
hi: Jab "{Abu Lahab ke haath tabaah hon}" (Surah Al-Masad 1) nazil hui, to Al-Awra Umm Jameel bint Harb aayi, cheekhti hui, uske haath mein aik patthar (fihr) tha, aur woh keh rahi thi: "Hum ne Muzammam (bura-bhala/tirskrit) ko na-manzoor kiya, uske deen ko napasand kiya, aur uske hukum ki na-farmani ki." Nabi (SAW) masjid mein baithe the aur Abu Bakr (RA) unke sath the, jab Abu Bakr (RA) ne use dekha to kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh aa rahi hai, mujhe darr hai ke woh aapko dekh legi." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh mujhe hargiz nahi dekhegi," aur Quran padha, to jaisa unhone kaha waisa hi ho gaya, aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Aur jab tum Quran padhte ho, to hum tumhare aur un logon ke darmiyan jo Aakhirat par imaan nahi rakhte, aik chhupa hua parda daal dete hain}" (Surah Al-Isra 45). To woh Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas ruki aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko nahi dekh saki, usne kaha: "Aye Abu Bakr, mujhe bataaya gaya hai ke tumhare saathi ne mujhpar (hajv/tanz ki) shairi kahi hai." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, is ghar ke Rab ki qasam, unhone tumpar (aisi) shairi nahi kahi." To woh mudkar chali gayi, keh rahi thi: "Quraish ko pata chal chuka hai ke main unke sardaar ki beti hoon."

e: [AI] According to the saying of Allah Almighty, "Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." (Holy Quran, Al-Isra 17:51). What does he mean by that? He said, "Death."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ya koi aisi makhlooq jo tumhare seenon mein bohot bada lage}" (Surah Al-Isra 51) ke baare mein, iska kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: "Maut."

e: [AI] There was a group of humans who were worshipping a group of jinn. Then the group of jinn accepted Islam and the humans continued to cling to their worship. So Allah, the Almighty, revealed, "Say, 'Call upon those whom you claim [as deities] besides Him; they have no power to remove affliction from you or to change it.' Those [whom they invoke] seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment." [Surah Al-Isra' 57] "Both groups with the letter 'ya'."
hi: Insaano mein se kuch log jinnaat mein se kuch ki ibaadat karte the, phir jinnaat mein se woh giroh Musalman ho gaya, jabke insaan apni ibaadat par qaayam rahe, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Kaho: unhein pukaaro jinhein tum uske siwa (ma'bood) samajhte the, woh na to tumse takleef door karne ki taaqat rakhte hain na tabdeeli ki, yeh log jinhein woh pukaarte hain, khud apne Rab ke qareeb honay ka zariya talaash karte hain}" (Surah Al-Isra 57). "Dono 'ya' ke sath hain."

e: [AI] The people of Mecca asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to make Safa golden for them and for the mountains to be moved away from them so that they could cultivate in it. Allah, the Exalted, said: "If you wish, We could grant them what they requested. However, if they disbelieve, they will be destroyed like those before them. And if you wish, I can give you authority over them so that perhaps you may be able to humble them." Allah then revealed this verse: "And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel as a visible sign." [Quran 17:59]
hi: Makkah walon ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha ke woh unke liye Safa ko sona bana den, aur pahaad unse hataa diye jaayen taake woh usme kheti kar sakein. To Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Agar tum chaaho to hum unhein woh de dein jo unhone maanga, phir agar woh kufr karein to unhein halaak kar diya jayega jaise humne unse pehle logon ko halaak kiya, aur agar tum chaaho ke hum unhein mohlat dein, shayad hum unpar (aakhir mein) reham kar sakein." To Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur humein nishaaniyan bhejne se sirf isliye roka gaya ke pehle logon ne unhein jhutlaaya, aur humne Thamud ko oontni di, jo saaf-saaf nishaani thi}" (Surah Al-Isra 59).

e: [AI] "It is the vision of an eye that I saw on the night of my ascension."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur humne jo khwaab tumhein dikhaaya, use sirf logon ke liye aazmaaish banaaya}" (Surah Al-Isra 60) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh aankh se dekha hua khwaab hai, jise unhone Isra ki raat dekha."

e: [AI] "It is the zaqqoom."
hi: "Yeh Zaqqum hai."

e: [AI] Abdullah used to pray the Maghrib prayer while we saw that the sun was still high. So, one day we looked at it, and he asked, "What are you looking at?" We said, "We are looking at the sun." Abdullah said, "By the One besides whom there is no deity, this is the time for this prayer." Then he recited the verse, "Establish prayer at the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night." So, this is the decline of the sun.
hi: Abdullah (RA) Maghrib ki namaz padhte the jabke humein lagta tha ke suraj abhi bhi chad raha hai. Unhone kaha: to aik din humne isse dekha, unhone poocha: "Tum kya dekh rahe ho?" Humne kaha: "Suraj ko." Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, yehi is namaz ka waqt hai," phir unhone padha: "{Namaz qaayam karo suraj dhalne se lekar raat ke andhere tak}" (Surah Al-Isra 78), "to yeh suraj ka dhalna hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "People will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment, and I will be with my ummah on a hill. My Lord will dress me in a green garment, and then permission will be granted to me to speak. I will say what Allah wills for me to say, and that will be the praised position."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Log Qayamat ke din uthaaye jaayenge, to main aur meri Ummat aik tile par honge, aur mera Rab mujhe sabz jubba pehnaayega, phir mujhe ijaazat di jayegi, to main woh kahunga jo Allah chaahega ke main kahoon, aur yehi Maqam-e-Mahmood (Praised Station) hai."

e: [AI] "That your Lord may raise you to a praised position." [Quran 17:79] He said, "The people will be gathered in one plain where the caller will make them hear and the sight will reach them barefooted, unclothed, as they were created, silently, not speaking except with His permission. Then Muhammad will be called and he will say, 'Here I am, at your service, and your happiness and righteousness are in your hands. Evil is not yours. The guided ones are those whom You have guided and Your servant is in Your presence, and to You is his return, and there is no refuge or escape from You except to You. Blessed and exalted are You, O Lord of the House.' That is the praised position mentioned by Allah, 'That your Lord may raise you to a praised position.' [Quran 17:79]"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ummeed hai tera Rab tujhe Maqam-e-Mahmood (Praised Station) par uthaayega}" (Surah Al-Isra 79) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Log aik hi maidaan mein jama kiye jaayenge, pukaarne wala unhein sunaayega aur nazar unhein dekh legi, nange paanv, nange badan, jaise woh paida huay the, khamosh, koi jaan uski ijaazat ke bagair baat nahi karegi." Unhone kaha: to Muhammad (SAW) ko pukaara jayega, woh kahenge: "Labbaik wa Sa'daik, bhalaai tere haathon mein hai aur buraai teri taraf mansoob nahi, hidayat-yaafta woh hai jise tu ne hidayat di, aur tera banda tere saamne hai, aur (sab kuch) tera hai aur teri hi taraf hai, teri panah ke siwa koi panaah aur nijaat nahi, tu barkat wala aur buland hai, paak hai Ghar ka Rab." To yehi woh Maqam-e-Mahmood hai jise Allah ne farmaya: "{Ummeed hai tera Rab tujhe Maqam-e-Mahmood par uthaayega}" (Surah Al-Isra 79).

e: [AI] The sons of Mulaykah, who were from the Ansar, came to the Messenger of Allah and said, "O Messenger of Allah, our mother is obedient to her husband, honors the guests, and fulfills her obligations from before Islam. So where is our mother?" He said, "Your mother is in Hell." They became very upset and the Messenger of Allah called them back and said, "Indeed, my mother and your mother are together." A hypocrite from the people said, "What benefit does this have for him except that the sons of Mulaykah are saved from their mother's fate, while we are following behind them?" A young man from the Ansar said, "I have never seen a man ask the Messenger of Allah more questions than him." He asked the Messenger of Allah, "I can see your parents in Hell." He said, "I have asked my Lord to grant them mercy." He will grant me the Praiseworthy Station. The hypocrite said to the young man from the Ansar, "Ask him what the Praiseworthy Station is." He said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the Praiseworthy Station?" He said, "It is the Day when Allah will descend to His Throne, and it will creak with measurement of what is between the heaven and the earth. You will be brought barefoot, uncircumcised, and naked. Then Ibrahim will be the first to be clothed. Allah will say, 'Clothe My friend with two garments of Paradise, then dress him in clothes after that.' And I will stand on the right side of Allah, and I will ask about its meaning. The Ansari said to the hypocrite, "Ask him what happens to the river." The hypocrite said, "I have never heard of a river without clay mud or dirt. Ask him about what flows in the river." He said, "It will flow with musk and saffron." He said, "I have never heard of a river in which a rod grew without it bearing fruit. Ask him if there are fruits on those rods." He said, "Yes, there will be pearls and gems." He said, "I have never heard of a river in which someone does not ask about its drink. Ask him about the drink of the river." The Ansari said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the drink of the river?" He said, "It is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. Whoever drinks from it will never be thirsty again, and whoever is deprived of it will never taste anything sweeter."
hi: Mulaikah ke do bete, jo Ansar mein se the, aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humari maa apne shohar ki hifaazat karti thi aur mehmaan ki izzat karti thi, lekin usne jahiliyat mein (apni beti ko) zinda dafan kiya tha, to humari maa kahan hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhari maa aag mein hai." Woh khade huay, aur yeh baat unpar bhaari padi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein bulaawa diya, woh wapas aaye, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri maa tumhari maa ke sath hai." To logon mein se aik munafiq ne mujhse kaha: "Ismein Mulaikah ke beton ke liye apni maa ke baare mein koi faida nahi, hum bhi unke naqsh-e-qadam par chal rahe hain." To Ansar ka aik jawaan, jo Rasulullah (SAW) se sabse zyada sawaal karta tha, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aapke waalidain ko aag mein dekh raha hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine unke baare mein apne Rab se nahi maanga ke woh mujhe unke baare mein (kuch) de, aur main us din Maqam-e-Mahmood mein khada honay wala hoon." Munafiq ne Ansari jawaan se kaha: "Unse poocho Maqam-e-Mahmood kya hai?" Usne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Maqam-e-Mahmood kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh din jab Allah apne Kursi par utrega, jo apni tangi ki wajah se aisi cheenkti hogi jaisi kaathi cheenkti hai, jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan faasla hai, aur tumhein nange paanv, nange badan, bagair khatna ke laaya jayega, sabse pehle Ibrahim (AS) ko kapda pehnaaya jayega, Allah Ta'ala farmayega: 'Mere khaleel ko Jannat ke do safed kapdon se pehnao,' phir mujhe uske baad kapda pehnaaya jayega, to main Allah ke dayen taraf aisi jagah khada hounga jispar aggle-pichhle log raashk (jalan) karenge, aur mere liye Kausar se hoz tak aik nehar nikaali jayegi." Munafiq ne kaha: "Maine aaj jaisi baat kabhi nahi suni, kam hi koi nehar behti hogi jo mitti ke bartan ya kankaron mein na ho, unse poocho nehar kis cheez mein behti hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kasturi aur kankaron ki jagah mein." Munafiq ne kaha: "Maine aaj jaisi baat kabhi nahi suni, kam hi koi nehar behti hogi jiske kinare koi paudha na ho." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan." Usne poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sone ki dandiyaan." Munafiq ne kaha: "Maine aaj jaisi baat kabhi nahi suni, Allah ki qasam, koi dandi nahi ugti magar uska koi phal hota hai, unse poocho kya un dandiyon ke phal hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, moti aur jawaahar." Munafiq ne kaha: "Maine aaj jaisi baat kabhi nahi suni, unse hoz ke mashroob ke baare mein poocho." Ansari ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hoz ka mashroob kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Doodh se zyada safed aur shehed se zyada meetha, jisse Allah kisi ko aik ghoont pilaaye, use uske baad kabhi pyaas nahi lagegi, aur jise mehroom kare, use uske baad kabhi sairaabi nahi milegi."

e: [AI] I have a friend of mine, and I am in Kufa. Do you have a man you are looking for? I said yes. He said, "This is his ranking, and indeed he is Oways Al-Qarani. I think he will pass by now." He said, so we sat for him, and he passed, and there was a mark on him. He said, "People tread on his heels." He said, "He approaches them and speaks to them about it, but they don't stop. We walked with the people until we entered the mosque in Kufa, and we entered with him. He went to a wall and prayed two Rak'ahs, then he turned his face towards us and said, 'O people, why do you tread on my heels in every way? I am a weak person, and I have needs that I cannot fulfill with you. Do not do that, may Allah have mercy on you. Whoever has any need from me, let him tell me here.'" The man said, and it was 'Umar ibn Al-Khattab who asked a delegation that came to him, "Did someone from his family visit you, like this and like that?" The man said, "People have mentioned you, O Amir al-Muminin, and they did not mention that, as is commonly said. That is not from his mention, what I have told you. The man said, "Oways has taken a covenant and a pledge from the man not to tell anyone else about it." Then he said, "Oways said, 'This majlis (gathering) is attended by three people - a knowledgeable believer, a believer who is not knowledgeable, and a hypocrite. This is like rain that falls from the sky to the earth; it reaches the good and fruitful tree and increases its beauty, freshness, and produce. And it reaches the weak and fruitless tree, and increases its rot and makes its leaves fall. And it reaches the thorns that break and destroy them.'" Then he recited the verse, "And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss." [Al-Isra 82] This Qur'an does not sit with anyone except that it either adds or decreases in him. This is the decree of Allah that He has decreed, healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss. O Allah, grant me a martyrdom that precedes its pain and its safety precedes its fear, which gives life and sustenance. Then he became silent. The man said, "I walked with him." He asked, "My friend, how do you see the man?" I said, "I have not increased in him except a desire, and I am not one who can leave him." We remained with him, and we did not stay except for a short while until he struck the people again. The commander of the faithful, Ali, was sent, and Oways Al-Qarani was among them. We went out with him and traveled with him, and we would stay with him and descend with him until we reached the presence of the enemy."
hi: Mera aik saathi tha jabke main Kufa mein tha, usne poocha: "Kya tum aik aise aadmi ko dekhna chahoge?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Usne kaha: "Yeh unka raasta hai, aur woh Uways Al-Qarni hain, mera khayal hai woh abhi guzarenge." Unhone kaha: to hum unke liye baith gaye, woh guzre, achanak aik aadmi jispar phati-purani chaadar thi, aur log unki eddi par chal rahe the (unhein tang kar rahe the), aur woh unki taraf mudkar unhein sakhti se roka karte aur is baare mein baat karte, lekin woh baaz nahi aate the. To hum logon ke sath chalte rahe yahan tak ke woh Kufa ki masjid mein dakhil huay, hum bhi unke sath dakhil huay, woh aik sutoon ki taraf hat gaye aur do rak'aten padhin, phir humari taraf mudke, aur farmaya: "Aye logo, mujhe kya hua hai ke tum har raaste mein meri eddi par chalte ho, jabke main aik kamzor insaan hoon, mujhe koi zaroorat hoti hai to tumhare sath usse poora nahi kar paata, aisa mat karo, Allah tum par reham kare, jisse mujhse kuch chaahiye woh mujhse yahan mile." Unhone kaha: aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unke paas aane wale aik wafd se poocha: "Kya tumhare paas Qarn (qabile) ka koi aadmi ussi tarah aaya jaisa (unhone khabar di thi)?" To us aadmi ne Uways se kaha: "Ameer-ul-Momineen ne aapka zikr kiya," aur us tarah zikr nahi kiya jaisa keh diya gaya, "yeh unke zikr mein se nahi tha jo main aap tak pahuncha raha hoon." Unhone kaha: aur Uways ne us aadmi se ahd aur wa'da liya tha ke woh kisi aur ko yeh nahi bataayega. Unhone kaha: phir Uways ne kaha: "Beshak is majlis mein teen qism ke log aate hain - momin faqeeh (aqal-mand), momin jo faqeeh nahi, aur munafiq, aur yeh duniya mein us baarish ki manind hai jo aasman se zameen par barasti hai, to yeh us barg-o-bar wale, phal-daar darakht ko lagti hai to uske pattay aur khoobsurat kar deti hai aur uski paidawaar barhaati hai, isi tarah uska phal bhi mazedaar banaati hai, aur yeh us barg-o-bar wale darakht ko bhi lagti hai jiska koi phal nahi to use aur (paani se) bhar deti hai aur uske pattay khoobsurat kar deti hai, lekin uska phal nahi hota, to woh apni sisters (doosre darakhton) jaisi ho jaati hai, aur yeh sookhi lakdi ko bhi lagti hai to use tod deti hai aur bahaa le jaati hai." Unhone kaha: phir unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur hum Quran mein se woh nazil karte hain jo momino ke liye shifa aur rehmat hai, aur zaalimon ko sirf nuqsaan mein hi barhaata hai}" (Surah Al-Isra 82), "yeh Quran kisi ke sath nahi baithta magar woh usse izaafa ya kami lekar uthta hai, to Allah ka faisla jo usne kiya - shifa aur rehmat momino ke liye, aur zaalimon ko sirf nuqsaan mein hi barhaata hai - Aye Allah, mujhe aisi shahaadat de jiska takleef uske dard se pehle guzar jaaye aur uska sukoon uske khauf se pehle aa jaaye, jo zindagi aur rizq ko wajib kare," phir woh khamosh ho gaye. Aseer ne kaha: to mere saathi ne mujhse kaha: "Tumne is aadmi ko kaisa paaya?" Maine kaha: "Mujhme unke liye sirf raghbat hi barhi hai, aur main aisa nahi ke unse alag ho jaaun." To hum unke sath rahe, aur zyada waqt nahi guzra ke Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali (RA) ne logon ke liye lashkar nikaala, to Qateefah waale, Uways, bhi usme nikle, hum bhi unke sath nikle, hum unke sath chalte aur unke sath thehrte rahe yahan tak ke hum dushman ke saamne pahunche.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took me by the hand and we went until we reached the Ka’bah. He said to me, "Sit down," so I sat down beside the Ka’bah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  climbed upon my shoulder, then he said to me, "Get up," so I got up. When he saw that I was weak beneath him, he said to me, "Sit down," so I descended and sat down. Then he said to me, "O Ali, climb upon my shoulders," so I climbed upon his shoulders. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up with me, and when he stood up with me, it seemed to me that I could reach the sky. I climbed up above the Ka’bah and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stepped to one side and said to me, "Throw down their biggest idol, the idol of the Quraysh." It was made of copper, supported by iron pegs driven into the ground. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to me, "Repair it," and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  kept repeating to me, "Yes, yes," until he said, "The truth has come, and falsehood has vanished. Indeed, falsehood is ever bound to vanish." [Quran 17:81] I continued to repair it until I gained strength from it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to me, "Throw it down," so I threw it down and it broke into pieces. I descended from above the Ka’bah and then I and the Prophet ﷺ  departed in haste, fearing that someone from the Quraysh or others might see us. Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said, "We did not come down until the hour was very close."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe lekar chale yahan tak ke woh mujhe Ka'bah ke paas laaye, phir mujhse farmaya: "Baitho," to main Ka'bah ke pehlu mein baith gaya, Rasulullah (SAW) mere kandhe par chadhe, phir mujhse farmaya: "Utho," to main utha, jab aap (SAW) ne mujhe apne neeche kamzor mehsoos kiya to farmaya: "Baitho," to main utra aur baith gaya, phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ali, mere kandhe par chadho," to main unke kandhon par chadha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) mere sath khade huay, jab woh khade huay to mujhe lagne laga ke agar main chaahun to aasman ke kinare tak pahunch jaaun, to main Ka'bah ke oopar chadh gaya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) hat gaye, aur mujhse farmaya: "Unka sabse bada but girao, Quraish ka but," aur woh taambe ka tha, loha ki kaeelein zameen mein garhi thin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Isse (hataane ki koshish) karo," aur Rasulullah (SAW) mujhse keh rahe the: "Aisa hi, aisa hi, {haq aa gaya aur baatil mit gaya, beshak baatil mitne wala hi hai}" (Surah Al-Isra 81), main isse hataane mein laga raha yahan tak ke mujhe uspar qaboo mil gaya, to unhone kaha: "Ise phenk do," to maine ise phenk diya, woh toot gaya, aur main Ka'bah ke oopar se utar gaya, phir main aur Nabi (SAW) daurte huay chale, aur humein darr tha ke Quraish ya doosron mein se koi humein dekh le. Ali (RA) ne kaha: "To ab tak yeh dobara oopar nahi chadhaya gaya."

e: [AI] Is-haq ibnu Ibrahim Al-Hanzhali narrated that Shababah ibnu Sawwar mentioned him with a similar narration.
hi: Ishaq bin Ibrahim Al-Hanzali ne humein hadith bayan ki, Shababah bin Sawwar ne humein khabar di, unhone isi jaisi zikr ki.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Dharr Al-Ghifari recite this verse: "And We will gather them together on the Day of Resurrection, [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf" [Surah Al-Isra, 17:97]. So Abu Dharr said, The trustworthy and truthful one (i.e., Prophet Muhammad ﷺ) told me: "Indeed, people will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection into three groups: those who walk and ride, those who crawl and those who are dragged by the angels on their faces." We said, we already know about the first two groups, what about those who crawl and are dragged? He said: "Allah will inflict a disease on their backs so severe that not a single spot on their backs will remain untouched. A person will even give away his beautiful garden for a hideous, blemished camel."
hi: Maine Abu Dharr Al-Ghifari (RA) ko yeh ayat padhte suna: "{Aur hum unhein Qayamat ke din unke chehron ke bal, andhe, gunge, aur bahre ikatha karenge}" (Surah Al-Isra 97), to Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe sacche, sach maane gaye (SAW) ne hadith bayan ki: 'Log Qayamat ke din teen giroh mein uthaaye jaayenge - khaate-peete, kapde pehne, sawaar log, aik giroh paidal chalta aur daurta hua, aur aik giroh jise farishte unke chehron ke bal ghaseet rahe hongay.' Humne kaha: 'Humne pehle do ko pehchaan liya, lekin woh log jo paidal chalte aur daurte hain woh kaun hain?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah zameen par aisi museebat daalega ke koi sawaari baaki nahi bachegi, yahan tak ke aadmi apna khoobsurat baagh aik aisi bhagi hui, kaathi-bandhi bad-soorat (sawaari) ke badle de dega.'"

e: [AI] The Quran was revealed in its entirety to the lower heaven, then it was revealed gradually over a period of twenty years. Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says: {And they do not come to you with an argument except that We come to you with the truth and the best explanation} [Al-Furqan 33]. He also says: {And [mention] the Qur'an, for We have made it distinct, that you may recite it to the people in intervals. And We have sent it down progressively} [Al-Isra 106].
hi: Quran poora aik sath duniya ke aasman par nazil hua, phir uske baad bees (20) saal mein (thoda-thoda) nazil hota raha, aur Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur woh tumhare paas koi misaal nahi laate magar hum tumhein haq aur behtareen tafseer de dete hain}" (Surah Al-Furqan 33), aur farmaya: "{Aur Quran, humne ise alag-alag kiya taake tum ise logon ko theher-theher kar padho, aur humne ise thoda-thoda karke nazil kiya}" (Surah Al-Isra 106).

e: If anyone learns by heart the first ten verses of the Surah al-Kahf, he will be protected from the Dajjal. (Using translation from Muslim 809a)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Surah Al-Kahf ki shuru ki das (10) aayaten yaad kare, woh Dajjal se mehfooz rahega."

e: [AI] The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "Whoever recites Surah Al-Kahf on Friday, he will be illuminated with light from between the two Fridays."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Jumu'ah ke din Surah Al-Kahf padhe, uske liye do Jumu'on ke darmiyan noor roshan kiya jayega."

e: "He will be given water of Sadid to drink, he will swallow it..." that the Prophet ﷺ said: " It will be brought toward his mouth and he will dislike it, so whenever it is brought closer to him it will melt his face and the skin of his head will fall into it. Then whenever he drinks from it, his bowels will be severed until it comes out from his anus. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted says: "And they will be given water of Hamim to drink such that it cuts up their bowels..." and He says: "And if they call for drink they will be given water of Muhl which melts the faces, the worst of drinks..." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2583)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur use peep ka paani piya jayega, jise woh ghoont-ghoont kar peeyega}" (Surah Ibrahim 17) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh uske qareeb laaya jayega, to woh usse napasand karega, jab woh uske qareeb hoga to uska chehra jhulsa dega aur uske sar ki khaal gir jayegi, aur jab woh usse piyega to uski aanten katt jaayengi yahan tak ke woh uski peeth se bahar nikal aayengi." Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "{Aur unhein garam paani pilaaya gaya, jisne unki aanten katt din}" (Surah Muhammad 15), aur Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "{Aur agar woh madad maangenge to unhein aise paani se madad di jayegi jo pighle huay tel jaisa hoga, jo chehron ko jhulsa dega, kitna bura mashroob hai}" (Surah Al-Kahf 29).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "When Moses met Al-Khidr (peace be upon them), a bird came and dipped its beak in the water. Al-Khidr said to Moses, 'Reflect on what this bird is saying.' Moses asked, 'And what is it saying?' Al-Khidr replied, 'It is saying: You have no knowledge, and Moses has no knowledge except what Allah has given him from my beak.'"
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Musa (AS) Khidr (AS) se mile, to aik parinda aaya aur apni chonch paani mein daali, Khidr (AS) ne Musa (AS) se kaha: 'Ghor karo yeh parinda kya keh raha hai.' Unhone poocha: 'Yeh kya keh raha hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh keh raha hai: tumhara aur Musa (AS) ka ilm, Allah ke ilm ke muqaable mein, sirf itna hai jitna meri chonch ne is paani mein se liya.'"

e: [AI] "In order to preserve the righteousness of their father and what was mentioned about them being righteous, [this narration] is considered authentic according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (referring to Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but it was not included based on the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: "Unke waalid ki neik-nami ki hifaazat ki wajah se, aur unke baare mein koi neki zikr nahi ki gayi." Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "It was neither gold nor silver; it was sheets of knowledge."
hi: "Woh na sona tha na chandi, balke ilm ke sahifay (kaghazaat) the."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ  regarding the saying of Allah Almighty: "And they possess a treasure from Him" [Al-Kahf 82]. He said, "It is gold and silver." But it is narrated by Yazid bin Yusuf Matruuk.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur uske neeche unke liye aik khazana tha}" (Surah Al-Kahf 82) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sona aur chandi." Yazid bin Yusuf matrook (chhoda hua raawi) hain.

e: [AI] "Enough for you is what Moses and al-Khidr debated."
hi: "Tumhare liye kaafi hai jo Musa (AS) aur Khidr (AS) ke darmiyan bahas hui."

e: [AI] The translation of the sentence is: "Indeed, the descendants of the believers will be taken care of and looked after in paradise by Prophet Ibrahim, peace be upon him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Momino ki aulaad Jannat mein Ibrahim (AS) ki nigraani mein hogi."

e: [AI] I said to my father, "Shall we inform you of the greatest losers in deeds, those whose efforts have been wasted in worldly life while they thought that they were doing well in their works?" [Surah Al-Kahf 104]. Who are the Harurites? He said, "No, but they are the people of towers and Harurites, a people who have deviated, so Allah caused their hearts to deviate."
hi: Maine Ubayy (RA) se poocha: "{Kya hum tumhein sabse zyada nuqsaan uthaane walon ke baare mein na bataayen, jinki koshish duniya ki zindagi mein gum ho gayi jabke woh samajhte hain ke woh achha kaam kar rahe hain}" (Surah Al-Kahf 104), kya yeh Haruriyah (Khawarij) hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke yeh khanqahon (ibaadat-gaahon) wale hain, aur Haruriyah aik aisi qaum hai jo bhatak gayi, to Allah ne unke dilon ko bhi bhatka diya."

e: [AI] I used to read to my father until I reached this verse: "Say, shall we inform you who will be the greatest losers in their deeds?" [Surah Al-Kahf: 103]. I said, "O my father, are they the Khawarij?" He replied, "No, my son, read the verse that comes after it: 'Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in their meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless, and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.'" [Surah Al-Kahf: 105]. He said, "They are the Christians who exert themselves to disbelieve in the signs of their Lord with Muhammad and to deny his meeting." And they said, "There is no food in Paradise, nor drink, but the Khawarij are the transgressors who break the covenant of Allah after its binding and cut off what Allah has commanded to be joined, and they cause corruption on the earth. Those are the losers."
hi: Main apne waalid ke saamne padhta tha yahan tak ke jab main is ayat par pahuncha: "{Kaho: kya hum tumhein sabse zyada nuqsaan uthaane walon ke baare mein bataayen}" (Surah Al-Kahf 103) ayat, maine kaha: "Aye abba, kya yeh Khawarij hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, mere bete, iske baad wali ayat padho: {Yeh woh log hain jinhone apne Rab ki aayaton aur uski mulaqaat ka inkaar kiya, to unke amal zaya ho gaye, aur hum Qayamat ke din unke liye koi wazan qaayam nahi karengay}" (Surah Al-Kahf 105)." Unhone kaha: "Yeh Nasaara mein se mehnat-kash log hain, unka kufr apne Rab ki aayaton mein Muhammad (SAW) aur unki mulaqaat ke saath tha," aur unhone kaha ke Jannat mein na khaana hai na peena, lekin Khawarij woh faasiq (na-farmaan) log hain jo Allah ka ahd uske paimaan ke baad tod dete hain, aur jise Allah ne jodne ka hukum diya use kaat dete hain, aur zameen mein fasaad phailaate hain, yehi log ghaate mein hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Ask Allah for Al-Firdaus as it is the highest place in Jannah (Paradise)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah se Firdaus maango, kyunke woh Jannat ka markaz (dil) hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Indeed, it has been revealed to me that whoever hopes to meet his Lord, then let him do good deeds and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord. He will have a light from his home to Mecca and the angels will surround him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhpar wahi ki gayi hai ke jo apne Rab se mulaqaat ki ummeed rakhe, use nek amal karna chahiye aur apne Rab ki ibaadat mein kisi ko shareek nahi karna chahiye, to uske liye Aabyan se Makkah tak noor hoga, farishte uske ird-gird jama honge."

e: [AI] "Oh Messenger of Allah, a man strives in the path of Allah while seeking worldly gains, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'He will have no reward.' This amazed the people, so the man returned and said, 'He will have no reward.'"
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aik aadmi Allah ki raah mein jihad karta hai lekin duniya ka koi faida chahta hai," to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uske liye koi ajr nahi." Logon ko yeh baat bhaari lagi, to us aadmi ne dobara poocha, to aap (SAW) ne (phir) farmaya: "Uske liye koi ajr nahi."

e: [AI] Abundance of generous, guidance from wise, insight from knowledgeable, and a friend who is sincere.
hi: "Kaf, Kareem (Buzurg/Sakhi) se; Ha, Haadi (Hidayat dene wale) se; Ya, Hakeem (Hikmat wale) se; Ain, Aleem (Sab jaanne wale) se; Sad, Sadiq (Sachche) se."

e: [AI] A trustworthy, dear, and sincere person.
hi: "Kaafi, Haadi, Ameen, Azeez, Sadiq."

e: [AI] "Yahya was not named before him."
hi: "Yahya se pehle kisi ka yeh naam nahi rakha gaya tha."

e: [AI] Tell me about the saying of Allah, the Almighty, "And I reached the age of old age" [Maryam: 8], what does "old age" mean? He said, "It is the hardship that comes with old age." The poet Al-Bahr Al-Khafif said, "The newborn is excused, but the one who is in old age is not excused." Ahmad Ibn Hanbal, Muhammad Ibn Ziyad Al-Yashkuri Al-Tahhan, a deceitful liar who fabricates Hadith, and Ibn Shuja, are weak narrators from the Murawwaza.
hi: "Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan {Aur main boodhepan ki intehaa ko pahunch chuka hoon} (Surah Maryam 8) ke baare mein bataayen, Al-Itiyy kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Boodhepan ki sakhti/museebat." Shaayar ne kaha: "Nau-mawlood ko maazoor samjha jaata hai, lekin jo zamane mein boodha ho chuka ho use maazoor nahi samjha jaata." Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: "Muhammad bin Ziyad Al-Yashkuri At-Tahhan aik jhoota, khabees, hadith ghadne wala hai, aur Ibn Shuja Marwazi ke kamzor raawiyon mein se hain."

e: [AI] "He used to command them to pray morning and evening."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To unhein wahi ki gayi ke woh subah aur shaam tasbeeh karein}" (Surah Maryam 11) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh unhein subah aur shaam namaz ka hukum dete the."

e: [AI] "Compassion with mercy"
hi: "Rehmat ke sath mohabbat aur shafqat."

e: [AI] He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: "Every son of Adam will come on the Day of Resurrection with sins, except for what is from Yahya bin Zakariya". He then gestured with his hand towards the ground and took a small stick, then he said: "And that is because he did not have what men have except for this stick. That is why Allah named him a leader, a hermit, and a Prophet among the righteous."
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Har Bani Aadam Qayamat ke din aayega aur uspar koi na koi gunah hoga, siwaye Yahya bin Zakariyya (AS) ke." Unhone kaha: phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne apna haath zameen ki taraf jhukaaya aur aik chhoti lakdi uthaayi, phir farmaya: "Aur yeh isliye ke unke paas mardon jaisi (khwahish) nahi thi, sirf itni jitni yeh lakdi hai, isi liye Allah ne unhein Sayyid (sardar), Hasoor (paakdaman), aur nekon mein se Nabi kaha."

e: [AI] "She said, 'How can I have a son when no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?' [Maryam 20] So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place."
hi: "{Unhone kaha: mere kaise beta ho sakta hai jabke mujhe kisi insaan ne chhua nahi aur main badchalan bhi nahi}" (Surah Maryam 20), to unse baat karne wala (jibril/rooh) unke andar hamal ban gaya, unhone kaha: "Woh unke munh se dakhil hua."

e: [AI] "He is the small river table."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Tere Rab ne tere neeche aik sariyy (chhoti nehar) banaayi hai}" (Surah Maryam 24) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh chhoti nehar/jhirna hai."

e: [AI] "He heard the sound of the pen as he wrote on the tablet."
hi: "{Aur humne unhein khaas guftagu ke liye qareeb kiya}" (Surah Maryam 52) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unhone Qalam ki cheekh (aawaz) suni jab woh Lauh (Mahfooz) par likh raha tha."

e: [AI] From Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him, his statement on the saying of Allah, exalted and glorified be He, "And mention in the Book, Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet." [Maryam 41]. He said, "The prophets among the Children of Israel were ten: Noah, Saleh, Hud, Lot, Shuayb, Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon them. There were no prophets who had two names except Israel and Jesus. Israel is Jacob, and Jesus is the Messiah."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Kitaab mein Ibrahim (AS) ka zikr karo, beshak woh sachche, Nabi thay}" (Surah Maryam 41) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Ambiya Bani Israel mein se the, siwaye das (10) ke - Nuh, Salih, Hud, Lut, Shu'aib, Ibrahim, Isma'il, Ishaq, Ya'qub, aur Muhammad (alaihimus-salam), aur kisi Nabi ke do naam nahi the siwaye Israel aur Isa ke, Israel Ya'qub hain, aur Isa Maseeh hain."

e: [AI] I heard the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, recite this verse: "Then there succeeded them a posterity who neglected prayers and followed after lusts. Soon, they will face ruin." (Al-A'raf 169). He, peace be upon him, then said, "After sixty years, there will be a generation who neglect prayer and indulge in desires. They will face misguidance. Then, there will be a generation who will recite the Quran, but their recitation will not go beyond their throats. There will be three types of individuals who recite the Quran: a believer, a hypocrite, and a wicked person." Bashir asked, "What are these three types?" The messenger of Allah replied, "The hypocrite is a disbeliever, the wicked person uses it for his own benefit, and the believer lives by it."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh ayat padhte suna: "{Phir unke baad aisi nasal aayi}" (Surah Al-A'raf 169), aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Saath (60) saal baad aisi nasal aayegi jo namaz zaya karegi aur khwahishaat ki pairavi karegi, to woh ankareeb ghumraahi paayegi, phir aisi nasal aayegi jo Quran padhegi lekin woh unke gale se neeche nahi jaayega, aur teen tarah ke log Quran padhengay - momin, munafiq, aur faajir." Basheer ne kaha: maine Al-Waleed se poocha: "Yeh teen kaun hain?" To unhone kaha: "Munafiq kaafir hai, faajir isse (duniyavi) faida uthaata hai, aur momin isspar imaan rakhta hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "My Ummah will perish because of the People of the Book and the People of Milk." Uqbah asked, "Who are the People of the Book, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "A group of people who learn the Book of Allah and then argue with the believers using it." Uqbah then asked, "Who are the People of Milk, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "A group of people who follow their desires and neglect their prayers."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Meri Ummat mein se Ahl-e-Kitaab (kitaab wale) aur Ahl-e-Laban (doodh wale) halaak hongay." Uqbah ne poocha: "Ahl-e-Kitaab kaun hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh log jo Allah ki Kitaab seekhte hain aur usse imaan walon se jhagda karte hain." Unhone kaha: maine poocha: "Ahl-e-Laban kaun hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh log jo khwahishaat ki pairavi karte hain aur namaazon ko zaya karte hain."

e: [AI] On the authority of Abdullah regarding His saying, exalted is He: "So they will [indeed] encounter ghee" [Maryam 59]. He said, "It is a river in hell, deep in its bottom, with a foul taste."
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To ankareeb woh ghumraahi (ghayy) paayenge}" (Surah Maryam 59) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jahannam mein aik nehar hai, gehri talhati, badbudaar zaayqe wali."

e: [AI] "What Allah has made permissible in his book is halal (lawful), and what he has forbidden is haram (forbidden), and what he has remained silent about is a blessing. So accept the blessings from Allah, for Allah does not forget." Then recite this verse: "And your Lord is not forgetful" [Maryam 64].
hi: "Jo Allah ne apni Kitaab mein halaal kiya woh halaal hai, aur jo haraam kiya woh haraam hai, aur jiske baare mein woh khamosh raha woh mu'aafi (chhoot) hai, isliye Allah ki taraf se yeh mu'aafi qubool karo, kyunke Allah kabhi bhoolne wala nahi," phir unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur tera Rab bhoolne wala nahi}" (Surah Maryam 64).

e: [AI] "No one has named the Merciful except Him."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Kya tum uska koi hum-naam jaante ho}" (Surah Maryam 65) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Uske siwa kisi ko 'Rahman' nahi kaha gaya."

e: "I asked Murrah Al-Hamdani about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Sublime is He: There is not one of you but will pass over it (19:71). So he narrated to me that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated to him saying: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The people will pass over the Fire, then they avert it based upon their deeds. The first of them (would pass over it) like a flash of lightening, then like the wind, then like a fleeing horse, then like a rider fleeing on a mount, then like a man fleeing, then like one walking." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3159)
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur tum mein se koi aisa nahi jo usse guzre na, yeh tere Rab par pakka faisla hai}" (Surah Maryam 71) ke baare mein, mujhe hadith bayan ki gayi ke Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ne unhein Rasulullah (SAW) se bataya, unhone farmaya: "Log Jahannam par se guzrenge, phir apne amaal ke mutabiq wapas aayenge, unme se pehla bijli ki chamak jaisa, phir hawa ke jhonke jaisa, phir ghode ki daud jaisa, phir sawaar jaisa, phir saazoo (baandhne wale) jaisi raftaar, phir unke chalne jaisa."

e: "The sign of the believers upon the Sirat is: O lord, protect (us), protect (us).'" [Abü 'Eisa said:] This Hadith is Gharib [as a narration of AlMughirah bin Shu'bah] we do not know of it except through the narration of 'Abdur-Rahmãn bin Ishaq [and there is something on this topic from Abu Hurairah]. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2432)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalmano ka nara Sirat (pul) par Qayamat ke din yeh hoga: Aye Allah, salaamati de, salaamati de."

e: [AI] "From Abdullah, and there is none of you except that he will come to it (Hellfire) [Maryam 71]. As-Sirāt (the Bridge over Hellfire) is said to be as sharp as the edge of a sword. The first group will pass over it as fast as lightning, the second group as fast as the wind, the third group as fast as the best horses, and the fourth group as fast as the best camels and animals. Then they will pass, and the angels will say, 'O Lord, grant peace, grant peace.'"
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, "{Aur tum mein se koi aisa nahi jo usse guzre na}" (Surah Maryam 71) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Sirat Jahannam par talwaar ki dhaar jaisa hai, pehla giroh bijli jaisa guzrega, doosra hawa jaisa, teesra behtareen ghodon jaisa, aur chautha behtareen oonton aur chaupaayon jaisa, phir woh guzrenge aur farishte kahenge: 'Rab, salaamati de, salaamati de.'"

e: [AI] A caller calls, "O people! Have you not been pleased with your Lord who created you, provided for you, and formed you in proportion? Does He not have the power to assign to each person among you the one whom he follows in this world?" They answer, "Yes indeed, but Satan has misled those who used to worship Uzayr (Ezra). He made them worship the tree, the wood, and the stones. The people of Islam will be left prostrating. They will be told, 'Why do you not go with the people?' They will reply, 'We have a Lord whom we have not seen.' It will be asked, 'Then how do you know your Lord if you have not seen Him?' They will say, 'Between us and Him is a sign. When we see it, we recognize Him.' They will be asked, 'And what is that sign?' They will answer, 'He will reveal a shin.' When it is revealed, a leg will also become visible. They will then be commanded to submit, but their backs will be straight like iron plates and they will not be able to bow down. They will be ordered to raise their heads and a light will be provided to them according to their deeds. Some of them will be given a light equivalent to a mountain in size, some will be given a light greater than that, and others will be given a light equivalent to a palm tree in size. Some will be given lesser light, and the last person who will be given light will have it shining from his big toe. It will flicker, and when it does, he will stop. They will pass over the bridge called as-Sirat. It will be sharp as a sword, having notches and hooks on its sides. It will be said to them, 'Cross over according to the brightness of your light.' Among them, some will pass like the blink of an eye, some like a shooting star, some like a gust of wind, and some like a fast-running man. They will pass according to their deeds until the last one whose light will be shining from his big toe passes. Some people's hands and feet will be tied and their sides will be struck by fire. They will be released and when they are, they will say, 'All praise is due to Allah who has saved us from you after showing us your true form. Indeed, Allah has granted us something that He has not granted to anyone else.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once laughed so much that his teeth became visible. A man asked him, 'O Abu Abdur-Rahman! You have narrated this Hadith repeatedly. Every time you reach this point, you laugh.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  narrating it repeatedly, and every time he reached this point, he laughed until his molars became visible. Thus, this hadith has become a plaything of mine.'"
hi: Aik pukaarne wala pukaarega: "Aye logo, kya tum apne Rab se raazi nahi ho jisne tumhein paida kiya, rizq diya, aur soorat di, ke woh tum mein se har insaan ko usi ki taraf mod de jiski woh duniya mein pairavi karta tha?" Unhone kaha: aur jo Uzair ki ibaadat karta tha usse Uzair ka shaitan mithaal ke taur par dikhaya jayega, yahan tak ke unhein darakht, lakdi, aur patthar bhi mithaal ke taur par dikhaye jaayenge, aur Ahl-e-Islam sajde mein pade rahenge, unse kaha jayega: "Tumhein kya hua ke tum doosron ki tarah nahi chalte?" Woh kahenge: "Humara aik Rab hai jise humne abhi tak nahi dekha." Kaha jayega: "Agar tum use dekho to kis cheez se pehchaanoge?" Woh kahenge: "Humare aur uske darmiyan aik nishaani hai, agar hum use dekhein to pehchaan lengay." Poocha gaya: "Woh kya hai?" Woh kahenge: "Woh paindli (pindli) se pardah uthaayega." Unhone kaha: to us waqt pindli se pardah uthaaya jayega, to jiski peeth seedhi/lachakdaar hogi woh sajde mein gir padega, aur aik qaum baaqi rahegi jinki peethein gaay ke seengon jaisi (sakht/mudi) hongi, woh sajda karna chahenge lekin nahi kar paayengay, phir unhein hukum diya jayega, to woh apne sar uthaayenge, unhein unke amal ke mutabiq noor diya jayega, unme se kisi ko pahaad jitna noor uske aage diya jayega, aur kisi ko usse zyada, aur kisi ko khajoor ke darakht jitna noor uske dayen haath mein diya jayega, aur kisi ko usse kam uske dayen haath mein, yahan tak ke aakhir mein aik shakhs hoga jise sirf uske pair ke angoothe par noor diya jayega, kabhi jalta kabhi bujhta, jab uska pair chamakta to woh chalta, aur jab bujhta to woh khada ho jaata, phir log Sirat par guzrenge, aur Sirat talwaar ki dhaar jaisa, phislan-daar hai, kaha jayega: "Apne noor ke mutabiq bacho," to unme se koi taare ke girne jaisa guzrega, aur koi palak jhapakne jaisa, aur koi hawa jaisa, aur koi tez daudte aadmi jaisa, tezi se bhaagta hua, woh apne amal ke mutabiq guzrenge yahan tak ke woh shakhs guzrega jiska noor uske pair ke angoothe par hoga, woh aik haath ghaseetega aur aik latkaayega, aur aik pair ghaseetega aur aik latkaayega, aur aag uske dono kinaron se lag rahi hogi, phir woh bach jaayenge, jab woh bach jaayenge to kahenge: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne humein tumse bachaaya iske baad ke usne humein tumhein dikhaaya, Allah ne humein aisi cheez di hai jo usne kisi aur ko nahi di." Masrooq ne kaha: to Abdullah (RA) is hadith ke is jagah tak nahi pahunchte magar hansi aa jaati, to aik aadmi ne unse kaha: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, aap yeh hadith kai baar bayan kar chuke hain, aur har baar is jagah pahunchte huay hans dete hain." To Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko isse kai baar bayan karte suna, aur woh bhi is jagah tak pahunchte huay hansay bagair na rehte, yahan tak ke unke daaton ke peechhe ka hissa nazar aata aur unka aakhri daant zaahir ho jaata, insaan ke is kehne par ke 'kya tu mera mazaaq udaata hai jabke tu saare jahaano ka Rab hai?' To Allah farmayega: 'Nahi, lekin main iski poori taaqat rakhta hoon, isliye mujhse (jo chaaho) maango.'"

e: We were sitting with ‘Ali ؓ and he recited this verse: “The Day We shall gather the Muttaqoon (the pious) unto the Most Gracious (Allah), like a delegation (presented before a king for honour)” [Maryam 19:85] He said: No, by Allah they will not be gathered on their feet, the delegation will never be gathered on their feet. Rather (they will be gathered) on she-camels the like of which mankind has never seen, on which are sadales of gold. They will ride them until they knock at the gates of Paradise. (Using translation from Aḥmad 1333)
