hi: Ali (RA) se, is ayat "{Jis din hum muttaqi (parhezgaar) logon ko Rahman ke huzoor mein aik wafd ki tarah jama karengay}" (Surah Maryam 85) ke baare mein, Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Khabardar, Allah ki qasam, wafd apne pairon par jama nahi kiya jayega, aur na unhein ghaseeta jayega, balke unhein aisi oontniyaan di jaayengi jaisi makhlooq ne kabhi nahi dekhin, jinpar sone ki zeen aur zabarjad (heere) ki lagaam hogi, woh unpar sawaar hongay yahan tak ke Jannat ke darwazon par dastak denge."

e: [AI] He read, "Except for those who take with their Lord a covenant" [Maryam 87]. So he said, "Take with the Merciful a covenant, for indeed Allah says on the Day of Resurrection, 'Whoever has a covenant with me, let him stand up.' So we said to him, 'O Abu Abdur Rahman, teach us.' He said, 'Say: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, indeed I make a covenant with You in this worldly life that I bear witness that there is no deity except You alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger. Indeed, if You entrust me to myself, You will bring me near to evil and distance me from good. And indeed, I rely not upon anyone but Your mercy. So make it for me a covenant with You and fulfill it to me on the Day of Resurrection, for surely You do not fail in fulfilling the promise.'"
hi: Unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Siwaye us shakhs ke jisne Rahman ke paas koi ahd le liya ho}" (Surah Maryam 87), phir kaha: "Rahman se ahd le lo, kyunke Allah Qayamat ke din farmayega: 'Jiska mere paas ahd ho woh khada ho jaaye.'" Unhone kaha: humne kaha: "To humein sikhaayen, Aye Abu Abdur Rahman." Unhone kaha: "Kaho: 'Aye Allah, aasman-o-zameen ke banaane wale, ghaib aur zaahir ke jaanne wale, main is duniya ki zindagi mein tujhse ahd karta hoon ke main gawahi deta hoon ke tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela, tera koi shareek nahi, aur beshak Muhammad tera banda aur Rasool hai, isliye agar tu mujhe mere haal par chhod de to tu mujhe buraai ke qareeb aur bhalaai se door kar dega, aur main sirf teri rehmat par bharosa karta hoon, isliye ise mere liye apne paas aisa ahd banaa jise tu mujhe Qayamat ke din poora karega, beshak tu wada khilaafi nahi karta.'"

e: [AI] He is similar to your saying, O Muhammad, in the language of Abyssinia.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ta-Ha}" (Surah Ta-Ha 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh aisa hai jaise tumhara kehna 'Aye Muhammad' Habash (Abyssinia) ki zubaan mein."

e: [AI] We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Al-Bat-ha. Then a cloud passed by, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do you know what this is?" We replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "It is a cloud." We said, "Yes, a cloud." He said, "And it is a thunderstorm." We said, "And a thunderstorm." He said, "And it is raining." Then he remained silent and later asked, "Do you know how much distance is there between the heaven and the earth?" We replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "Between them is a journey of five hundred years, and between every heaven to the next heaven is a journey of five hundred years, and the thickness of each heaven is a journey of five hundred years. And above the seventh heaven, there is a sea between its upper and lower boundaries, as much as between the heaven and the earth. And above that, there are eight Paradises in terms of height, with a distance between each one like that between the heaven and the earth. And Allah is above all of that, and nothing of the acts of the sons of Adam is hidden from Him."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Al-Batha mein baithe thay, aik baadal guzra, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai yeh kya hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Saahaab (baadal)." Humne kaha: "Saahaab." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur muzn." Humne kaha: "Aur muzn." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur anaan." Phir khamosh ho gaye, phir farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan kitna faasla hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke darmiyan paanch sau (500) saal ka safar hai, aur har aasman se uske agle aasman tak paanch sau (500) saal ka safar hai, aur har aasman ki moti paanch sau (500) saal ke safar jitni hai, aur saatwe aasman ke oopar aik samundar hai jiski oonchai aur neechai ke darmiyan utna hi faasla hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan, phir uske oopar aath (8) pahaadi bakre hain jinke ghutno aur khuron ke darmiyan utna hi faasla hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan, aur Allah Ta'ala isse bhi oopar hai, Bani Aadam ke kisi bhi amal ko woh chhupaa nahi hai."

e: [AI] About Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib's statement regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Glorious, "And He will carry the Throne of your Lord above them that Day, [i.e., the Day of Judgment], [the angels] on that Day will be eight [in number]" (Al-Haqqah 17), there are angels in the form of camels between the heavens and the earth, along with their riders, for a distance of thirty-six or fifty-six years.
hi: Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur tere Rab ka Arsh us din unke oopar aath (8) farishte uthaayenge}" (Surah Al-Haqqah 17) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh farishte pahaadi bakron (auwal) ki soorat mein hain, unke khuron aur ghutno ke darmiyan teraas (63) ya paisath (65) saal ka safar hai."

e: [AI] "The secret" [Taha 7] that you do not know, and "the hidden" [Taha 7] that Allah has cast into your heart of things which you did not know.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Woh raaz aur usse bhi zyada chhupi hui baat jaanta hai}" (Surah Ta-Ha 7) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "{Raaz} jo tumhein khud pata hai, {aur usse bhi zyada chhupi hui} jo Allah tumhare dil mein daalta hai us cheez mein se jo tumhein pata nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "On the day when Allah spoke to Moses, he was wearing a woollen cloak, a woollen garment, woollen trousers, a woollen turban, and his sandals were made of the skin of a non-intelligent donkey."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis din Allah ne Musa (AS) se baat ki, unpar oon ka jubba, oon ki chaadar, oon ka pajaama, aur oon ki aasteen thi, aur unke jute aise gadhe ki khaal se the jo (shara'i tareeqe se) zibah nahi hua tha."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to often talk to us about the people of Bani Israeel during his nights, saying that they would only wake up for a great prayer.
hi: Nabi (SAW) raat ke aksar hisse mein humein Bani Israel ke qissay sunaya karte the, "aur woh sirf kisi buzurg namaz ke liye khade hote."

e: [AI] When Umm Kulthum, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , was placed in the grave, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "From it (the earth) we created you, and to it we shall return you, and from it we shall bring you forth once again, in the name of Allah and for the cause of Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah." When the grave was built upon her, he patted the soil gently and said, "Cover it with moist clay." Then he said, "This is not anything, but it comforts the deceased." He did not speak about it (the soil), and it is a fabricated report because Ali ibn Yazid is an abandoned narrator.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Umm Kulthum qabr mein rakhi gayin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isi se humne tumhein paida kiya, aur isi mein humne tumhein wapas bhejna hai, aur isi se humne tumhein doosri baar nikaalna hai, Allah ke naam se, Allah ki raah mein, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke deen par." Jab unki lahad banaayi gayi, to aap (SAW) unke paas mitti daalne lage aur farmaate: "Ainton ke darmiyan ke khaali hisson ko band karo." Phir farmaya: "Yeh koi khaas cheez nahi, lekin isse zinda (dil ko) sukoon milta hai." Isspar koi tabsara nahi kiya gaya, aur yeh kamzor riwayat hai kyunke Ali bin Yazid matrook (chhoda hua raawi) hain.

e: [AI] When Moses rushed to his Lord, the Samaritan deliberately gathered the jewelry he could find from the children of Israel and made a calf from them. Then he struck it, and behold, it was a lowing calf. The Samaritan said to them, “This is your god and the god Moses.” Harun said to them, “O my people, did not your Lord promise you a good promise? But Samaritan had led them astray.” When Moses returned to the children of Israel and found that Samaritan had misled them, he took hold of his brother's head and said to him, “What did he say?” Moses said to the Samaritan, “What is your explanation?” The Samaritan said, “I seized a handful from the messenger's tracks and threw it away, and that is how my soul prompted me.” So Moses turned to the calf, infused it with his stick, and it became a cold corpse while he was on the shore of the river. No one drank from that water except those who used to worship the calf, and their faces turned yellow like gold. They said to Moses, “What is our repentance?” Moses said, “Some of you should kill others.” So they took their knives, and the man killed his father and his brother, caring not about who he killed, until seventy thousand were killed among them. Then Allah inspired Moses to instruct them to raise their hands, for He had forgiven those who were killed and repented of those who survived.
hi: Jab Musa (AS) apne Rab ki taraf jaldi gaye, to As-Samiri ne jitna ho saka Bani Israel ke zewar jama kiye, phir usne unhein bachhre ki shakl mein dhaal diya, phir usne (Jibra'il ke ghode ke nishaan se) aik mutthi (mitti) uske andar daal di, to woh aisa bachhra ban gaya jismein aawaz thi, to As-Samiri ne unse kaha: "Yeh tumhara aur Musa (AS) ka ma'bood hai." Harun (AS) ne unse kaha: "Aye meri qaum, kya tumhare Rab ne tumse achha wada nahi kiya?" Jab Musa (AS) Bani Israel ke paas wapas aaye aur unhein As-Samiri ne bhatka diya tha, to unhone apne bhai ka sar pakda, Harun (AS) ne unse woh kaha jo unhone kaha, Musa (AS) ne As-Samiri se poocha: "Tumhara kya maamla hai?" As-Samiri ne kaha: "Maine Rasool (Jibra'il) ke nishaan se aik mutthi (mitti) li aur usse daal diya, aur mere nafs ne mujhe yehi sujhaaya." Unhone kaha: to Musa (AS) ne bachhre ki taraf iraada kiya, usspar reti/reti waali cheez rakhi aur usse pees dala, aur woh nehar ke kinare par tha, to jo bhi us bachhre ki ibaadat karta tha aur usne us paani se piya, uska chehra sone ki tarah zard ho gaya. To unhone Musa (AS) se poocha: "Humari tauba kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Tum mein se kuch dusre ko qatl karein." To unhone chhuriyaan uthaayin, aik shakhs apne baap aur apne bhai ko qatl karne laga, use koi parwaah nahi thi ke woh kise qatl kar raha hai, yahan tak ke unme se sattar hazaar (70,000) qatl ho gaye. To Allah ne Musa (AS) ko wahi bheji: "Unhein hukum do ke apne haath rok len, main jo qatl huay unhein maaf kar chuka hoon, aur jo baaki reh gaye unki tauba qubool kar chuka hoon."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "May Allah have mercy on Moses. Seeing something firsthand is not like hearing about it from someone else. His Lord informed him that his people were being tempted after him, so he did not cast down the Tablets. When he saw them and witnessed their actions, he threw down the Tablets and said, 'May Allah have mercy on Moses, if he had not rushed, he would have heard something different from what he heard.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Musa (AS) par reham kare, jo khud dekhe woh us jaisa nahi jise khabar di jaaye, unke Rab ne unhein khabar di ke unki qaum unke baad fitne mein pad gayi hai, to unhone (Tauraat ki) takhtiyaan nahi phenki, phir jab unhone unhein dekha aur khud mushaahida kiya, to takhtiyaan phenk di." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Musa (AS) par reham kare, agar unhone jaldi na ki hoti, to unki (Tauraat ki) baat mein jo bataaya gaya usse alag kuch aur bataaya jaata."

e: [AI] "God created Adam from the dust of the entire earth, thus he was called Adam. Ibrahim ibn Nafi' narrated that he heard Sa'id ibn Jubayr saying: I asked Ibn Abbas, and he said: God created Adam and then forgot, so he named him the human. Allah, the Almighty, said: "And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination." [Surah Taha 115]."
hi: "Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko poori zameen ki mitti se paida kiya, isliye unhein 'Aadam' kaha gaya." Ibrahim bin Nafi' ne kaha: maine Sa'eed bin Jubair ko kehte suna: maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se poocha, unhone kaha: "Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko paida kiya, phir woh bhool gaye, isliye unhein 'insaan' kaha gaya," phir Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur humne Aadam (AS) se pehle ahd liya, to woh bhool gaye, aur humne unme koi pukhta iraada nahi paaya}" (Surah Ta-Ha 115).

e: [AI] "When Adam ate from the tree that he was forbidden from, Allah Almighty said, 'What led you to disobey Me?' Adam replied, 'My Lord, I was seduced by Eve.' Allah said, 'Then surely I will make it so that you both feel hatred towards each other. You will feel pain and discomfort in childbirth, and I will cause you to menstruate twice a month.' When Eve heard this, she felt remorse and Adam said to her, 'You will experience menstruation and your daughters will as well.'"
hi: Jab Aadam (AS) ne us darakht se khaya jiska unhein mana kiya gaya tha, to Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Tumhein meri na-farmani karne par kis cheez ne ubhaara?" Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, Hawwa ne isse mere liye sajaaya." Allah ne farmaya: "To main unhein yeh (halat) doonga ke woh sirf takleef ke sath hamal karengi aur takleef ke sath hi janam dengi, aur main unhein mahine mein do martaba khoon (haiz) doonga." Jab Hawwa ne yeh suna to unhein bohot ranj hua, to unse kaha gaya: "Yeh (haiz) tum par aur tumhari betiyon par (muqarrar) hai."

e: [AI] "Whoever reads the Quran and follows what is in it, Allah guides him away from misguidance and protects him on the Day of Judgment from a bad reckoning. This is because Allah Almighty has said: 'So whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].' [Surah Ta-Ha (20:123)]"
hi: "Jo koi Quran padhe aur usme jo hai uski pairavi kare, Allah use gumraahi se hidayat dega aur Qayamat ke din bure hisaab se bachaayega, aur yeh isliye ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {To jo meri hidayat ki pairavi kare, woh na bhatkega na museebat mein padega}" (Surah Ta-Ha 123).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A life of hardship." [Surah TaHa, verse 124]. He said, "The punishment of the grave."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Tang zindagi}" (Surah Ta-Ha 124) ke baare mein farmaya: "Qabr ka azaab."

e: [AI] "Umm Habiba, the daughter of Abu Sufyan. O Allah, bless me with my husband, the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and with Abu Sufyan and my brother Muawiyah." The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to her, "Indeed, you have called upon Allah for known periods, allotted provisions, and inevitable consequences. Nothing of them will be hastened before its time, nor delayed after its due. If you had called upon Allah to grant you good health or sought refuge in Him from the punishment of the Hellfire or the punishment of the grave, it would have been better or more virtuous."
hi: Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan (RA) ne dua ki: "Aye Allah, mujhe mere shohar Rasulullah (SAW) se, aur mere waalid Abu Sufyan se, aur mere bhai Muawiyah (RA) se faida uthwa." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Tumne Allah se muqarrar mudaton, taqseem shuda rizq, aur pahunche huay asaron ke liye dua ki hai, jinme se koi bhi cheez waqt se pehle jaldi nahi hoti aur na waqt ke baad der hoti hai, agar tum Allah se dua karti ke woh tumhein aafiyat de, ya Allah se maangti ke woh tumhein aag ke azaab ya qabr ke azaab se bachaaye, to yeh behtar ya zyada afzal hota."

e: [AI] She said, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The trial of the grave is real. So, when asked about me, do not complain."
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qabr ka fitna mere baare mein hai, isliye jab tumse mere baare mein poocha jaaye, to shak mat karna."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the saying of Allah Almighty: "And they do not intercede except for those whom He approves" [Al-Anbiya 28]. So he ﷺ  said: "Surely, my intercession is for the people who committed major sins from my nation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur woh sirf uski shafa'at karte hain jise woh pasand kare}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 28) ka zikr kiya, phir farmaya: "Beshak meri shafa'at meri Ummat ke kabeera gunahgaaron ke liye hai."

e: [AI] "The sky opened up with rain, and the earth burst forth with plants."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Kya kaafiron ne nahi dekha ke aasman aur zameen mile huay the, phir humne unhein juda kar diya}" ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Aasman baarish se khula, aur zameen paudhon se khuli."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The supplication of Dhu al-Nun (Prophet Yunus) when he called upon it while he was in the belly of the fish, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers,' no Muslim person has ever called upon it in any matter except that they were answered."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dhun-Nun (Yunus AS) ki dua jab unhone macchli ke pait mein kahi: 'Laa ilaha illa Anta, Subhanaka, Inni kuntu minaz-zaalimeen' (Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Paak hai Tu, Beshak main zaalimon mein se tha), koi bhi Musalman kisi bhi cheez ke liye yeh dua na kare magar uski dua qubool ki jaati hai."

e: [AI] From Abdullah bin Masud, in his explanation of the verse "Then he called out in the darkness" (Qur'an 21:87), he said: "The darkness of the night, the darkness of the belly of the whale, and the darkness of the sea."
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To unhone andheron mein pukaara}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 87) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Raat ka andhera, macchli ke pait ka andhera, aur samundar ka andhera."

e: [AI] Regarding the saying of Allah the Most High, "And We gave him (Zakariyya) his wife," Ibn Abbas said, "[The length] was on the tongue of Zakariyya's wife, and Allah the Most High corrected it."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur humne unki biwi ko unke liye theek kar diya}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 90) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Zakariyya (AS) ki biwi ki zubaan mein aik uljhan (dushwaari) thi, to Allah Ta'ala ne usse theek kar diya."

e:
[AI] Abu Bakr As-Siddiq delivered a speech, praising Allah and expressing gratitude towards him for the qualities he possesses. He advised us to fear Allah and to praise him for his qualities. He also urged us to balance desire with fear, as Allah praised Prophet Zakariya and his family, saying: "Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear. And they were, to Us, humbly submissive" (Quran 21:90).

He then reminded us, the servants of Allah, that Allah has entrusted us with our own selves and has taken covenants from us. Allah has given us the opportunity to exchange the ephemeral for the eternal, by acquiring His book. The light of His book cannot be extinguished, and its wonders will never come to an end. Therefore, he advised us to seek guidance and enlightenment from the book of Allah, especially during darkness.

He stressed that we have been created to worship Allah, and that Allah has entrusted us as noble and honorable scribes who know what we do. He reminded us that we will eventually depart from this world, as our knowledge of the appointed time has been concealed from us. If we have the ability to fulfill our obligations while in the service of Allah, we should strive to do so, but only with the help of Allah. He encouraged us to hasten in performing our duties before the appointed time expires, in order to avoid returning to a state of evil deeds. He warned against emulating those who extend their appointed times to others, but forget themselves, and advised us not to follow in their footsteps.

He concluded by emphasizing the need to seek salvation and to seek safety. He reminded us that a seeker will always remain diligent and quick to respond.
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne humein khutba di, Allah ki hamd ki aur uski waisi tareef ki jaisi woh haqdaar hai, phir kaha: "Main tumhein Allah ke taqwa ki wasiyat karta hoon, aur yeh ke tum uski waisi tareef karo jaisa woh haqdaar hai, aur khwahish ko khauf ke sath mila lo, kyunke Allah ne Zakariyya (AS) aur unke ghar walon ki tareef ki, farmaya: {Beshak woh neki mein jaldi karte the, aur humein ummeed aur darr ke sath pukaarte the, aur humare saamne aajiz rehte the} (Surah Al-Anbiya 90), phir jaan lo, Aye Allah ke bando, Allah ne apne haq ki wajah se tumhari jaanon ko rehen (girvi) rakha hai, aur usspar tumse ahd liya hai, aur usne tumse thodi si fani cheez ke badle bohot si baaqi rehne wali cheez khareedi hai, aur yeh Allah ki Kitaab tum mein hai, jiska noor kabhi bujhta nahi aur jiski ajaibaat kabhi khatam nahi hoti, isliye iske noor se roshni lo aur iski kitaab se naseehat lo, aur andheron ke din ke liye isse roshni haasil karo, kyunke usne tumhein sirf apni ibaadat ke liye paida kiya hai, aur tum par izzat waale likhne wale (farishte) muqarrar kiye hain jo jaante hain jo tum karte ho, phir jaan lo, Aye Allah ke bando, ke tum subah aur shaam aise waqt mein guzarte ho jiska ilm tumse chhupaaya gaya hai, isliye agar tum yeh kar sako ke tumhari mudatein khatam hon jabke tum Allah ke amal mein ho, to karo, aur tum yeh sirf Allah (ki madad) se kar sakoge, isliye apni mudaton ki mohlat mein sabqat lo isse pehle ke tumhari mudatein khatam ho jaayen aur woh tumhein tumhare bure amal ki taraf laut aayen, kyunke kuch logon ne apni mudatein doosron ke liye rakh din aur apne aap ko bhula diya, isliye main tumhein mana karta hoon ke tum unki misaal bano, isliye jaldi karo, jaldi karo, phir nijaat, nijaat, kyunke tumhare peechhe aik talaash karne wala hai jiski chaal tez hai."

e: "On the night on which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was taken on the Night Journey (Isra'), he met Ibrahim, Musa and 'Eisa, and they discussed the Hour. They started with Ibrahim, and asked him about it, but he did not have any knowledge of it. Then they asked Musa, and he did not have any knowledge of it. Then they asked 'Eisa bin Maryam, and he said: 'I have been assigned to some tasks before it happens.' As for as when it will take place, no one knows that except Allah. Then he mentioned Dajjal and said: 'I will descend and kill him, then the people will return to their own lands and will be confronted with Gog and Magog people, who will: "swoop down from every mound."[21:96] They will not pass by any water but they will drink it, (and they will not pass) by anything but they will spoil it. They (the people) will beseech Allah, and I will pray to Allah to kill them. The earth will be filled with their stench and (the people) will beseech Allah and I will pray to Allah, then the sky will send down rain that will carry them and throw them in the sea. Then the mountains will turn to dust and the earth will be stretched out like a hide. I have been promised that when that happens, the Hour will come upon the people, like a pregnant woman whose family does not know when she will suddenly give birth.'" (One of the narrators) 'Awwam said: "Confirmation of that is found in the Book of Allah, where Allah says: "Until, when Gog and Magog people are let loose (from their barrier), and they swoop down from every mound (21:96)." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4081)
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ko isra (raat ka safar) karwaaya gaya, to unki mulaqaat Ibrahim, Musa, aur Isa (alaihimus-salam) se hui, unhone Qayamat ki Ghadi (Hour) ka zikr kiya, sabse pehle Ibrahim (AS) se poocha, unke paas iska koi ilm na tha, phir Musa (AS) se, unke paas bhi iska koi ilm na tha, to baat Isa (AS) ki taraf lautaayi gayi, Isa (AS) ne kaha: "Allah ne mujhse iske aane se pehle ki cheezon ka ahd liya hai, rahi baat uske waqoo ka, to isse Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta." Unhone kaha: to unhone Dajjal ke nikalne ka zikr kiya, [Isa AS ne kaha:] "Main utrunga aur usse qatl karunga, log apne shehron ko lautenge, to unhein Yajooj-Majooj milengay, jo har buland jagah se tezi se nikal rahe hongay, woh jis paani se guzrenge use pi jaayengay, aur jis cheez se guzrenge use bigaad denge, to woh Allah se faryaad karengay, main Allah se dua karunga, to woh unhein maut de dega, to zameen unki badbu se Allah se faryaad karegi, aur woh mujhse faryaad karengay, to main Allah se dua karunga, woh aasman se paani bhejega, jo unke jismon ko utha kar samundar mein phenk dega, phir pahaadon ko udaaya jayega aur zameen ko chamde ki tarah phaila diya jayega, to Allah ne mujhse ahd liya hai ke jab aisa ho, to log ke liye Qayamat aisi hogi jaise mukammal haamila (aurat) jiske ghar wale nahi jaante ke woh kab achaanak raat ya din mein janam degi." Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ne kaha: "To maine iski tasdeeq Allah ki Kitaab mein paayi: {Yahan tak ke jab Yajooj-Majooj khol diye jaayen aur woh har buland jagah se tezi se nikal rahe hon, aur sacha wada qareeb aa jaaye}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 96-97) ayat." Unhone kaha: "Aur duniya bhar ke tamaam log Qayamat ke din jahan se aayenge, wahi buland jagah hai."

e: [AI] When the verse "Indeed, you and what you worship other than Allah are the fuel of Hell. You will come to it" [Al-Anbiya 98] was revealed, the polytheists asked, "Are the angels, Jesus, and Ezra being worshiped besides Allah?" He replied, "If these beings were worshiped as gods, they would not have ended up in Hell." Then the verse "Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from us - they are from it far removed" [Al-Anbiya 101] was revealed concerning Jesus, Ezra, and the angels.
hi: Jab "{Beshak tum aur jo tum Allah ke siwa ibaadat karte ho, Jahannam ka indhan hoge, tum sab usme jaane wale ho}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 98) nazil hui, to mushrikeen ne kaha: "Kya farishte, Isa (AS), aur Uzair ki bhi Allah ke siwa ibaadat ki jaati hai?" To (Nabi SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar yeh log jinki ibaadat ki jaati hai ma'bood hote, to woh usme na jaate." Unhone kaha: to yeh nazil hui: "{Beshak jinke liye humari taraf se bhalaai pehle se tay ho chuki hai, woh usse door rakhe jaayenge}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 101) - Isa (AS), Uzair, aur farishte.

e: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey when some of his Companions fell behind. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his voice reciting these two Ayat: "O mankind! Have Taqwa of your Lord! Verily the earthquake of the hour is a terrible thing..." up to His saying: but Allah's torment is severe (21:1 & 2)." When his Companions heard that, they hastened to catch up with him, since they knew that he had something to say. He ﷺ said: 'Do you know what Day this is? That is the Day when Adam will be called. His Lord will call him and say: O Adam, send forth those who are to be sent to the Fire. He will say: O Lord! How many are to be sent to the Fire? He will say: From every one-thousand there are nine-hundred and ninety-nine for the Fire and one for Paradise. So the people despaired as if they would not smile again. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw the state of his Companions, he said: 'Strive hard and receive the good news. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad, you will be counted with two creations who are immense in numbers; Ya'juj and Ma'juj, and those who have died among the progeny of Adam and the progeny of Iblis.'" He said: "So some of the people's grief went away, and he ﷺ said: 'Strive hard and receive the good news. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad! Among mankind, you are but like the mole on the flank of a camel, or a mark on the foreleg of a beast.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3169)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apne kisi safar mein thay, unke sahaba ke darmiyan chalne ki raftaar mein farq aa gaya, to aap (SAW) ne in do ayaton ke sath apni aawaz buland ki: "{Aye logo, apne Rab se daro, beshak Qayamat ka jhatka bohot badi cheez hai, jis din tum ise dekhoge, har doodh pilaane wali apne doodh-pite bachche ko bhool jaayegi, aur har haamila apna hamal gira degi, aur tum logon ko nashe mein dekhoge jabke woh nashe mein nahi honge, lekin Allah ka azaab sakht hoga}" (Surah Al-Hajj 2). Jab sahaba ne yeh suna to unhone apni sawaariyon ko tez kiya aur samajh gaye ke aap (SAW) ke paas koi khaas baat hai jo woh kahenge, jab woh aap (SAW) ke ird-gird jama ho gaye to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai woh kaunsa din hoga?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh din jab Aadam (AS) ko pukaara jayega, to unke Rab unhein pukaarenge aur farmayenge: 'Aye Aadam, aag ka giroh nikaalo.' Woh poochenge: 'Aye Rab, aag ka giroh kya hai?' Allah farmayega: 'Har hazaar mein se nau sau ninyanwe (999) aag mein, aur aik Jannat mein.'" Unhone kaha: to log (yeh sun kar) sannaate mein aa gaye yahan tak ke unke chehron par hansi ki koi jhalak baaqi na rahi, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh dekha, to farmaya: "Amal karo aur khush-khabri paao, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, tum do aisi makhlooqaton ke sath ho jo jis cheez ke sath bhi rahi hain use hamesha barhaaya hai - Yajooj-Majooj, aur Aadam (AS) ki aulaad mein se jo halaak huay, aur Iblees ki aulaad mein se (jo halaak huay)." Unhone kaha: to logon ko jo bechaini thi usme se kami aayi, phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Amal karo aur khush-khabri paao, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, tum logon mein aise ho jaise jaanwar ke bazu par koi nishaan, ya jaise oont ke pehlu mein til."

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase is:

"The Prophet ﷺ used to recite, 'And you see the people [engaged] in [drunken] stupor, while they are not drunk; but the punishment of Allah is severe.' [Surah Al-Hajj: verse 2]"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) padha karte the: "{Aur tum logon ko nashe mein dekhoge jabke woh nashe mein nahi honge, lekin Allah ka azaab sakht hoga}" (Surah Al-Hajj 2).

e: [AI] "The created things were not alive, and the uncreated things were not from a miscarriage."
hi: "Mukhallaqah (mukammal-taur banaayi hui) woh hai jo zinda thi, aur ghair-mukhallaqah (na-mukammal) woh hai jo miscarriage/saqt hui thi."

e: [AI] "That Allah will not support Muhammad (Peace be upon him)."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jo koi yeh gumaan kare ke Allah use (Muhammad ko) hargiz madad nahi dega}" (Surah Al-Hajj 15) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Ya'ni jo yeh gumaan kare ke Allah Muhammad (SAW) ki hargiz madad nahi karega."

e: [AI] He said, "These two rivals disputed about their Lord." [Al-Hajj 19] He said, "This verse was revealed about us and those who participated in the Battle of Badr; Utbah, Shaybah, and Walid."
hi: Unhone kaha: "{Yeh do fareeq hain jinhone apne Rab ke baare mein jhagda kiya}" (Surah Al-Hajj 19) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh humare baare mein aur Badr ke din aik-doosre se ladne walon ke baare mein nazil hui - Utbah, Shaybah, aur Al-Waleed."

e: this Āyah was revealed for these six folk on the day of Badr: (1) ʿAlī, (2) Ḥamzah, (3) ʿUbaydah, (4) Shaybah and (5) ʿUtbah, the two sons of Rabīʿah, and (6) Walīd b. ʿUtbah: "These are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord..." (Ḥajj 22:19) until the end of the statement of Allah, "... We will make him taste of a painful punishment." (Ḥajj 22:25).[^1]
hi: Yeh ayat un chhah (6) logon ke baare mein Badr ke din nazil hui - Ali (RA), Hamzah (RA), Ubaidah (RA), aur Shaybah aur Utbah, jo Rabee'ah ke do bete the, aur Al-Waleed bin Utbah: "{Yeh do fareeq hain jinhone apne Rab ke baare mein jhagda kiya}" (Surah Al-Hajj 19) unke farmaan "{Hum use dardnaak azaab chakhayenge}" (Surah Al-Hajj 25) tak.

e: [AI] "Ali and I are the first to kneel before the enemy on our knees, in front of Allah on the Day of Judgment. The hadith about Ali in these narrations is true, as it is true about Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, even if they did not mention it." Sahih.
hi: Ali (RA): "Aur main pehla shakhs hounga jo Qayamat ke din jhagde ke liye Allah ke saamne apne ghutnon par jhukega." "Yeh hadith Ali (RA) se in riwaayaton ke sath sahih saabit ho chuki hai, jaise Abu Dharr Al-Ghifari se sahih saabit hui, agarche dono ne ise nahi nikala." Sahih.

e: [AI] This verse was revealed about Hamza and his companions: "And do not think of those who have been killed in the cause of Allah as dead. Rather, they are alive with their Lord, receiving provision." [Quran 3:169]
hi: Yeh ayat Hamzah (RA) aur unke saathiyon ke baare mein nazil hui: "{Aur jo Allah ki raah mein qatl huay unhein mardah mat samjho, balke woh apne Rab ke paas zinda hain}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 169).

e: [AI] From Abu Hurayrah, and it was recited the saying of Allah, Almighty and Glorious: "So for those who disbelieve, cut garments of fire will be cut out for them." [Surah Al-Hajj 19]. He said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Indeed, boiling water will be poured upon their heads until it penetrates the skull and reaches their stomachs, and it will dissolve whatever is in their stomachs until it tears apart their legs, and this is the melting point. Then they will be restored as they were before.'"
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, unhone Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To jinhone kufr kiya, unke liye aag ke kapde kaate gaye hain}" (Surah Al-Hajj 19) padha, phir kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Beshak khaulta hua paani unke saron par dala jayega, to woh khopdi mein se guzar kar unke pait tak pahunch jayega, aur jo kuch unke pait mein hai use ghol dega yahan tak ke unke pairon ko phaad dega, aur yehi pighlaana hai, phir woh wapas usi tarah kar diye jaayenge jaise pehle the.'"

e: [AI] The fire is black, its flames and embers do not illuminate. Then he recited this verse, "Every time they wish to emerge from it [due to] anguish, they will be returned to it" [Surah Al-Hajj 22].
hi: "Aag kaali hai, iske sholay aur angaare roshni nahi dete," phir unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Jab bhi woh gham se usme se nikalna chahenge, unhein usme wapas laut diya jayega}" (Surah Al-Hajj 22).

e: [AI] "That a man will be concerned about a sin, meaning that if he does not commit it, it will not be written against him. Even if a man intends to kill another man at his home while he is far away, Allah will make him taste a painful punishment. And Shu'bah narrated it from Isma'il ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Suddi from Murrata on the condition of Muslim."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jo koi ismein na-insaafi ke sath rukh mode}" (Surah Al-Hajj 25) 'zulm ke sath, hum use dardnaak azaab chakhaayenge' ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Agar koi aadmi kisi gunah ka sirf iraada kare - ya'ni jab tak woh use kare nahi, to yeh uspar likha nahi jaata - lekin agar koi aadmi Baitullah ke paas kisi ko qatl karne ka iraada kare jabke woh khud Aden Abyan (door-daraaz jagah) mein ho, to Allah use dardnaak azaab chakhaayega." Isse Shu'bah ne Isma'il bin Abdur Rahman As-Suddi se, unhone Murrah se, marfoo' riwayat kiya hai. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "He who intends to commit injustice by apostasy, We shall let him taste a painful punishment." (Surah Al-Hajj 25) He said, "If a man harbors the intention of apostasy and does not manifest it, Allah will make him taste a painful punishment."
hi: Marfoo' riwayat mein, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jo koi ismein na-insaafi ke sath zulm ka rukh mode, hum use dardnaak azaab chakhaayenge}" (Surah Al-Hajj 25) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Agar koi aadmi ismein (deen se) hatne ka sirf iraada kare jabke woh khud Aden Abyan (door-daraaz jagah) mein ho, to Allah use zaroor dardnaak azaab chakhaayega."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Verily, a man from Quraysh will emerge who, if his sins were weighed against the sins of the two great nations, they would outweigh them."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Ankareeb Quraish mein se aik shakhs ismein (deen se) hategaa, agar uske gunah insaan aur jinnaat dono ke gunahon ke barabar tolein jaayen to woh bhaari padengay."

e: [AI] "A man named Tubba set out towards the Kaaba. When he reached the valley of Ghameem, Allah sent a wind upon him that was so strong that no one could stand, except with great difficulty. The man fell down and was overpowered by the wind. He experienced great discomfort, so he called for his scribes and asked them, 'What is this that has been sent upon me?' They replied, 'Do you seek safety?' He said, 'Are you safe?' They said, 'Yes, we are safe.' He asked them, 'What can rid me of this?' They said, 'Strip off your clothes, then say 'Labbaik, Labbaik,' enter and perform Tawaf around the Kaaba without causing any disturbance to its inhabitants.' He asked, 'If I agree to this, will the wind go away from me?' They said, 'Yes.' He stripped off his clothes, said 'Labbaik, Labbaik,' and entered. Ibn Abbas added, 'The wind subsided as if it were a dark night.'"
hi: "Tubba' Ka'bah ka iraada karte huay aage badha, jab woh Kura' Al-Ghameem tak pahuncha, to Allah ne uspar aisi hawa bheji ke khada hona bhi mushkil se ho paata, khada aadmi girta phir baithta aur gir jaata, aur unhein isse bohot takleef hui, Tubba ne apne do (Yahoodi) aalimon ko bulaawa diya aur unse poocha: 'Yeh kya hai jo mujhpar bheja gaya hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Kya tum humein amaan doge?' Usne kaha: 'Tumhein amaan hai.' Unhone kaha: 'To beshak tum aik aise ghar ka iraada rakhte ho jise Allah har us shakhs se bachaata hai jo isse (buri niyat se) chaahe.' Usne poocha: 'To yeh (hawa) mujhse kaise jaayegi?' Unhone kaha: 'Do kapdon mein bina silaai ke rehna ikhtiyar karo, phir kaho: Labbaik, Labbaik, phir dakhil ho kar us ghar ka tawaf karo, aur uske ahl-e-khaana mein se kisi ko takleef mat pahunchaao.' Usne poocha: 'Agar main isspar amal karoon, to kya yeh hawa mujhse chali jayegi?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' To usne kapde utaare, phir talbiya kahi. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: to hawa aisi pichhe hati jaise andheri raat ke tukde."

e: [AI] When Ibrahim finished constructing the house, he said, "My Lord, I have finished." Allah said, "Proclaim amongst the people for Hajj." Ibrahim asked, "My Lord, how will my voice reach the people?" Allah replied, "Proclaim, and it is upon Me to convey." Ibrahim asked, "My Lord, what should I say?" Allah said, "Say, 'O people, pilgrimage to the Ancient House has been prescribed upon you.' Hearing this, people will come from the farthest corners of the earth, responding to the call."
hi: Jab Ibrahim (AS) ghar (Ka'bah) ki tameer se faarigh huay, to unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, main faarigh ho gaya." Allah ne farmaya: "Logon ko Hajj ki azaan de do." Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, meri aawaz kahan tak pahunchegi?" Allah ne farmaya: "Azaan do, aur pahunchaana mera zimma hai." Unhone poocha: "Aye Rab, main kya kahoon?" Allah ne farmaya: "Kaho: Aye logo, tumpar Hajj farz kiya gaya hai, Baitullah-e-Ateeq (purane ghar) ka Hajj," to isse aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan har kisi ne suna, kya tum nahi dekhte ke woh zameen ke sabse door konon se talbiya kehte huay aate hain?

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is only called Al-Bait Al-'Atiq because it has not been conquered by a tyrant." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3170)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne isse 'Al-Bait-al-Ateeq' (Purana/Azaad Ghar) isliye kaha kyunke usne ise zaalimon se azaad rakha hai, kabhi koi zaalim isspar ghaalib nahi aaya."

e: [AI] "I said to him his saying: 'And the camels and cattle We have appointed them for you as among the symbols of Allah; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allah upon them, lined up for sacrifice' [Al-Hajj 36]. He said: 'When you intend to slaughter the animal, keep it still, then say 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allah is greater than you and for you', then say His name, and then slaughter it.' I said: 'And should I say that during the offering of Udhiyah?' He said: 'Yes, during the offering of Udhiyah.'"
hi: Maine unse Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur oont-gaay-bhains ko humne tumhare liye Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se rakha hai, tumhare liye ismein bhalaai hai, isliye jab woh khadi (safon mein) ho jaayen to unpar Allah ka naam lo}" (Surah Al-Hajj 36) ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Jab tum badanah (oont) zibah karna chaaho to use khada karo, phir kaho: 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, tu tujhse aur tere liye hai,' phir bismillah kaho, phir zibah karo." Maine poocha: "Kya main yehi qurbani mein bhi kahoon?" Unhone kaha: "Qurbani mein bhi."

e: “The Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, what are these sacrifices?’ He said: ‘The Sunnah of your father Ibrahim.’ They said: ‘What is there for us in them, O Messenger of Allah?’ He said: ‘For every hair, one merit.’ They said: ‘What about wool, O Messenger of Allah?’ He said: ‘For every hair of wool, one merit.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3127)
hi: Humne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh qurbaniyaan kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare baap Ibrahim (AS) ki sunnat." Humne poocha: "Isme humein kya milega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har baal ke badle aik neki." Humne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aur oon (ka kya)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Oon ke har baal ke badle bhi aik neki."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever is able to afford to sacrifice but does not do so, then he should not come near our prayer area." Ibn ‘Iyaash weakened it. Abu Dawood.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo qurbani ki gunjaish rakhta ho aur qurbani na kare, to woh humari namaz-gaah mein na aaye." Ibn Ayyash ko Abu Dawud ne kamzor kaha hai.

e: [AI] "He used to recite it: "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory." [Quran 22:39] He said, "This is the first verse revealed concerning fighting."
hi: Ke woh ise padha karte the: "{Un logon ko (jung ki) ijaazat di gayi hai jinke khilaaf jung ki jaati hai kyunke unpar zulm hua hai, aur beshak Allah unki madad par zaroor qaadir hai}" (Surah Al-Hajj 39), unhone kaha: "Yeh jung ke baare mein sabse pehli nazil honay wali ayat hai."

e: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Surah Al-Hajj has been esteemed by two prostrations?' He said: 'Yes, and whoever does not prostrate for them, he should not recite them.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 578)
hi: Maine Uqbah bin Aamir (RA) ko kehte suna: maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya Surah Al-Hajj ko do sajdon se fazeelat di gayi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, jo inn dono par sajda na kare, woh ise na padhe."

e: [AI] "He prayed with Umar in the morning and prostrated twice during the Hajj." As for the hadith of Ibn Abbas, it is authentic.
hi: "Unhone Umar (RA) ke sath Fajr ki namaz padhi, to woh Al-Hajj mein do sajde karte the." Rahi baat Ibn Abbas (RA) ki hadith ki, to woh sahih hai.

e: [AI] "In Surah Al-Hajj, there are two prostrations." And as for the narration of Ibn Umar, it adheres to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Surah Al-Hajj mein do sajde hain." Rahi baat Ibn Umar (RA) ki hadith ki, to yeh Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] He said, "He (Prophet Muhammad) performed two prostrations in the Hajj." And as for the hadith of Abdullah bin Masood and Ammar, it is authentic.
hi: Ke unhone 'Al-Hajj mein do sajde kiye.' Rahi baat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) aur Ammar (RA) ki hadith ki, to woh sahih hai.

e: [AI] About Abdullah ibn Mas'ud and Ammar ibn Yasir, they used to perform two prostrations during the Hajj. As for the hadith of Abu Musa
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) aur Ammar bin Yasir (RA) se, ke woh dono "Al-Hajj mein do sajde kiya karte the." Rahi baat Abu Musa (RA) ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] "That Abu Musa performed two prostrations in Surah Al-Hajj and recited the prostration of the last verse in Surah Al-Hajj, so he prostrated and we prostrated with him. As for the hadith of Abu Darda,"
hi: Ke Abu Musa (RA) ne "Surah Al-Hajj mein do sajde kiye, aur unhone Surah Al-Hajj ke aakhir wala sajda padha, to unhone sajda kiya aur humne bhi unke sath sajda kiya." Rahi baat Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] "I saw Abu Darda performing two prostrations during the Hajj."
hi: Maine Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ko "Al-Hajj mein do sajde karte" dekha.

e: [AI] She asked the Prophet ﷺ about this verse, "And He has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty" [Surah Al-Hajj: 78]. He said, "Hardship."
hi: Ke unhone Nabi (SAW) se is ayat "{Aur usne deen mein tum par koi tangi/dushwaari nahi rakhi}" (Surah Al-Hajj 78) ke baare mein poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tangi."

e: [AI] They are a slaughter, Suhail, the one with ambitions, and Ibn Aqeel, are not strong.
hi: "Zibah, woh isse zibah karne wale hain." Suhail munkir riwaayaton wale hain, aur Ibn Aqeel mazboot nahi hain.

e: l heard 'Umar bin al-Khattab say: When the Revelation came down to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a sound could be heard near his face like the buzzing of bees. We waited a while, then he turned to face the qiblah and raised his hands, then he said: “O Allah, give us more (blessing) and do not give us less; honour us and do not humiliate us, give to us and do not deprive us, give precedence to us and do not give others precedence over us; be pleased with us and make us pleased.” Then he said: “Ten verses have been revealed to me; whoever adheres to thern will enter Paradise.” Then he recited to us: “Successful indeed are the believers” [al-Mu'minoon 23:1] until he completed the ten verses. (Using translation from Aḥmad 223)
hi: Maine Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko kehte suna: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) par wahi nazil hoti, to unke paas shehad ki makhiyon ki gunjaan si aawaz sunayi deti, hum thodi der thehre rehte, phir aap (SAW) qiblah ki taraf mudte aur apne haath uthaate, phir farmate: 'Aye Allah, humein barha, humein kam mat kar, humein izzat de, humein zaleel mat kar, humein de, humein mehroom mat kar, humein tarjeeh de, humpar kisi aur ko tarjeeh mat de, humse raazi ho, aur humein raazi kar.'" Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhpar das (10) aayaten nazil hui hain, jo koi unhein qaayam rakhe woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga," phir aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Yaqeenan momin kaamyaab ho gaye, jo apni namaz mein khushu' karte hain}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 1-2) ayaten.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Allah created the Garden of Eden and planted its trees with His own hand. Then He said to it, 'Speak.' So it said, 'Indeed, the believers have succeeded.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne Jannat-e-Adan (hamesha rehne wali Jannat) ko paida kiya aur apne haath se uske darakht lagaaye, phir usse farmaya: 'Baat kar,' to usne kaha: 'Yaqeenan momin kaamyaab ho gaye.'"

e: [AI] We asked Aisha, the mother of the believers, "What was the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" She said, "His character was the Quran." Then she said, "Do you recite Surah Al-Mu'minun?" recite, "Certainly will the believers have succeeded." [Quran 23:1] until it reached ten. Then she said, "This is how the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was."
hi: Humne Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Aye Umm-ul-Momineen, Rasulullah (SAW) ka akhlaaq kaisa tha?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ka akhlaaq Quran tha," phir unhone poocha: "Kya tum Surah Al-Mu'minun padhte ho? Padho: {Yaqeenan momin kaamyaab ho gaye}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 1), yahan tak ke das (aayaton) tak pahunche, phir unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ka akhlaaq aisa hi tha."

e: [AI] Regarding His saying, Exalted be He, "Who are humble in their prayers" [Surah Al-Mu'minun, verse 2], He said: "Humility is in the heart, and that your shoulders soften for the Muslim, and that you do not turn around in your prayer."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jo apni namaz mein khushu' karte hain}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Khushu' dil mein hota hai, aur yeh ke tum apne kandhe Musalman bhai ke liye narm rakho, aur apni namaz mein idhar-udhar mat dekho."

e: [AI] The translation is as follows: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to raise his gaze towards the sky when he prayed, and then the verse would descend upon him: 'Those who are humble in their prayers' [Al-Mu'minun 2]. And he would lower his head."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) namaz mein apni nazar aasman ki taraf uthaate the, to yeh nazil hui: "{Jo apni namaz mein khushu' karte hain}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 2), to aap (SAW) ne apna sar jhuka liya.

e: [AI] And I have recited this verse: "And those who guard their private parts, except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed - But whoever seeks beyond that" [An-Nur 6]. Those whom Allah has not married nor given authority have certainly transgressed.
hi: Aur unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur jo apni sharm-gaah ki hifaazat karte hain, siwaye apni biwiyon ya jinke unke dayen haath maalik hon, kyunke iske liye unpar koi malaamat nahi, phir jo iske ilawa (kuch) chaahe}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 5-7) jo Allah ne uske liye halaal na kiya ho ya jiska woh maalik na ho, to usne had se tajaawuz kiya.

e: [AI] Ishaaq recited that 'Abdul-Razzaq narrated from Ma'mar, who narrated from Al-A'mash, who narrated from Abu Salih, who narrated from Abu Hurairah regarding the saying of Allah, "These [believers] are the inheritors." (Surah Al-Mu'minun, 23:10) He said, "They inherit their dwellings and the dwellings of their brothers that have been prepared for them if they obey Allah."
hi: Ishaq ne humein hadith bayan ki, Abdur Razzaq ne humein khabar di, Ma'mar ne humein khabar di, Al-A'mash se, unhone Abu Salih se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Yehi log waaris hain}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 10) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh apne rehne ki jagahein aur apne un bhaiyon ki jagahein bhi paayenge jo unke liye taiyaar ki gayi thin agar woh Allah ki itaa'at karte."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, is the person who commits adultery, steals, and drinks alcohol, but still fears Allah Almighty, considered righteous?" He said, "No, but the person who fasts, prays, and gives charity, and still fears Allah Almighty, is considered righteous."
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan {Jo dete hain jo unhone diya jabke unke dil dahshat-zada hote hain} (Surah Al-Mu'minun 60), kya yeh woh aadmi hai jo zina karta hai, chori karta hai, sharaab peeta hai, aur iske bawajood Allah Ta'ala se darta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke yeh woh aadmi hai jo roza rakhta hai, namaz padhta hai, aur sadqa deta hai, aur iske bawajood Allah Ta'ala se darta hai."

e: [AI] The black person disliked this verse when it was revealed: "The arrogant ones are making a move to abandon it." They said arrogantly, "We are its people, leaving it behind." He said: "They used to abandon it and not rebuild it." (Al-Mu'minun 67)
hi: 'Samar' (raat ki majlis) ko sirf isliye napasand kiya gaya jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Ghamand karte huay, raaton ko baaten karte huay, bekaar baatein karte huay}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 67), unhone kaha: "Ghar (Ka'bah) par ghamand karte huay yeh kehte the: 'Hum iske ahl (maalik) hain,' {tahjuroon} (bekaar baatein karte huay)," unhone kaha: "Woh isse door rehte the aur isse aabaad nahi karte the."

e: [AI] Abu Sufyan came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Muhammad, I swear by Allah and the kinship, we have eaten the 'Alhaz' which means wild animals and blood." So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed: "And indeed, We seized them with punishment, but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate" (Surah Al-Mu'minun, 76).
hi: Abu Sufyan Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, main tumhein Allah aur rishtedaari ka waasta deta hoon, humne 'alhaz' khaaya hai," ya'ni oon aur khoon, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur beshak humne unhein azaab se pakda, phir bhi woh apne Rab ke saamne jhuke nahi aur na hi gidgidaaye}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 76).

e: [AI] I hear Allah say in the Quran, "And Allah is over all things competent." (Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:27) This was a matter that has already happened, and He said, "On that Day, no close friends will avail each other, and no one will ask after another." (Surah Al-Mu'minun, 23:101) And He also said in another verse, "And they will approach one another, inquiring." (Surah As-Saffat, 37:27) Then He mentioned some things, and Ibn Abbas said, "As for His saying, 'And Allah is over all things competent' (Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:27), surely He has always been, and will always be, the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden. As for His saying, 'On that day, no close friends will avail each other, and no one will ask after another' (Surah Al-Mu'minun, 23:101), this is referring to the first blowing of the Trumpet when nothing will remain on the earth. As for His saying, 'And they will approach one another, inquiring' (Surah As-Saffat, 37:50), surely when they enter Paradise, they will approach one another, inquiring."
hi: Maine Allah ko yeh kehte suna: "{Aur Allah har cheez par qaadir tha}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 27), yeh aik aisi baat thi jo ho chuki thi, aur farmaya: "{To us din na koi rishta kaam aayega na koi aik doosre se poochega}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 101), aur aik doosri ayat mein farmaya: "{Aur woh aik doosre ki taraf mudkar poochenge}" (Surah As-Saffat 27), phir kuch aur cheezon ka zikr kiya, to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Rahi baat Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan {Aur Allah har cheez par qaadir tha} (Surah Al-Ahzab 27) ki, to woh hamesha se hai aur hamesha rahega, woh Awwal, Aakhir, Zaahir, aur Baatin hai, aur rahi baat Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan {To us din na koi rishta kaam aayega na koi aik doosre se poochega} (Surah Al-Mu'minun 101) ki, to yeh pehle Soor (Trumpet) ke waqt hai jab zameen par kuch baaqi nahi rahega, to us din na koi rishta hoga na koi poochega, aur rahi baat Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan {Phir woh aik doosre ki taraf mudkar poochenge} (Surah As-Saffat 50) ki, to jab woh Jannat mein dakhil honge to aik doosre ki taraf mudkar poochenge."

e: "And therein they will grimace in displace lips. -He will be grilled by the Fire until his upper lip is folded up reaching the middle of his head, And his bottom lip pains down, until it hits his navel." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2587)
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur woh usme mun bigaadne wale honge}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 104) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jaisa aik achhi tarah pake huay (jaanwar ke) sar ka mun bigadta hai."

e: [AI] "Like a fully matured bunch of grapes"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur woh usme mun bigaadne wale honge}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 104) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jaisa aik achhi tarah pake huay sar ka mun bigadta hai."

e: [AI] Verily, the people of the fire will call to Malik, but he will not answer them for forty days, then he will turn toward them and say, "Indeed, you are staying [here permanently]." They will say, "Our Lord, you have overcome us, and we have become a people astray." [Surah Al-Mu'minun 23:106] He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me."
hi: "Beshak Jahannami log Maalik (Jahannam ke daroga) ko pukaarengay, magar woh chaalis (40) din tak unhein jawaab nahi dega, phir woh unhein jawaab dega: 'Tum yahin thehre rehne wale ho.'" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, unki pukaar Maalik aur Maalik ke Rab ke saamne kitni tuchh ho gayi," woh kahenge: "{Aye humare Rab, humpar humari badnaseebi ghaalib aa gayi, aur hum gumraah log the}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 106), "{Farmaya jayega: Isme zaleel ho kar pade raho aur mujhse baat mat karo}".

e: [AI] He heard Umar ibn al-Khattab say, "Learn Surah Al-Baqarah, Surah An-Nisa, Surah Al-Maidah, Surah Al-Hajj, and Surah An-Nur because they contain obligatory duties."
hi: Unhone Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko kehte suna: "Surah Al-Baqarah, Surah An-Nisa, Surah Al-Ma'idah, Surah Al-Hajj, aur Surah An-Nur seekho, kyunke inme farz (ahkaam) hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not let women live in the upper rooms, nor teach them writing. Rather, teach them spinning and Surah al-Nur."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein (auraton ko) balaakhanon mein na rakho, aur na unhein likhna sikhaao, balke unhein katai/soot kaatna aur Surah An-Nur sikhaao."

e: [AI] "Women used to be entrepreneurs in the city, so Muslim men would marry women from among them so that they could support them financially. However, this practice was later prohibited."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Zaani sirf zaaniya ya mushrika se hi nikah karta hai}" (Surah An-Noor 3) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Madinah mein kuch aisi auraten thin jo zina karti thin, to Musalman aadmi unme se kisi aurat se shaadi kar leta taake woh uspar kharch kare, to unhein isse mana kar diya gaya."

e: [AI] In His saying, "Do not enter houses other than your own until you have sought permission" [Surah An-Nur 27], He said: The writer made a mistake, it should be "until you have sought permission" (instead of "until you have made yourself known").
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Apne gharon ke ilawa doosron ke gharon mein tab tak dakhil na ho jab tak (ijaazat) na le lo}" (Surah An-Noor 27) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Likhne wale se galti ho gayi, (durust lafz hai) 'jab tak ijaazat na maango.'"

e: "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: 'Any woman who puts on perfume then passes by people so that they can smell her fragrance then she is an adulteress.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5126)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bhi aurat khushbu lagaakar kisi qaum ke paas se guzre taake woh uski khushbu mehsoos karein, to woh zaaniya (badchalan) hai."

e: I asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the sudden glance (that is cast) on the face (of a non-Mahram). He commanded me that I should turn away my eyes. (Using translation from Muslim 2159a)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) se achaanak nazar (jo bagair iraade ke pad jaaye) ke baare mein poocha, to aap (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main apni nazar pher lun.

e: [AI] From Abdullah (from the verse): "And let them not display their adornment" [An-Nur 31]. He said, "No anklets, no bracelets, no necklaces, except what appears thereof" [An-Nur 31]. He said, "The clothing."
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, "{Aur apni zeenat zaahir na karein}" (Surah An-Noor 31) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Na payal, na kaan ki baali, na kundal, na haar," "{Siwaye jo khud zaahir ho jaaye}" (Surah An-Noor 31), unhone kaha: "Kapde."

e: [AI] "When this verse was revealed, 'And tell the believing women to reduce their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which appears thereof...' [Quran 24:31], the women of the Ansar (helpers) took their waist wrappers and tore them from the edges and covered their faces with them."
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Aur apni chaadaron ko apne seenon par daal lein}" (Surah An-Noor 31), to Ansar ki auraton ne apne tehband liye, unhein kinaron ki taraf se chhota kiya, aur unse pardah kiya.

e: [AI] From the Prophet, peace be upon him, it was narrated that he said, "And give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given you." [Surah An-Nur 33] He said, "A quarter is left for the legal heirs."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, unhone farmaya: "{Aur unhein Allah ke maal mein se do jo usne tumhein diya hai}" (Surah An-Noor 33) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mukatib (ghulam) ke liye chauthaai (hissa) chhod diya jaaye."

e: [AI] "He heard Jabir saying that there was a woman from the Ansar who said, 'My husband forces me to commit adultery.' Then the verse was revealed: 'And do not compel your maidens to prostitution, if they desire chastity.' [Surah An-Nur 33]."
hi: Unhone Jabir (RA) ko kehte suna: "Musaikah kisi Ansari ki (laundi) thi, usne kaha: 'Mera aaqa mujhe zina par majboor karta hai,' to yeh nazil hui: {Aur apni laundiyon ko zina par majboor mat karo agar woh paakdaman rehna chaahen}" (Surah An-Noor 33).

e: [AI] "And it is the grave, meaning the pit." The chain of narration is authentic and neither of them narrated it as authentic.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Allah aasman-o-zameen ka noor hai, uske noor ki misaal aik taaq (mishkat) ki tarah hai}" (Surah An-Noor 35) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh 'Al-Qubbarah' hai, ya'ni deewar ka taaq (khaali jagah)." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Eat olive and use its oil, for indeed it is a blessed tree." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1851)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zaitoon (olive) ka tel khaao aur usse lagaao, kyunke yeh barkat waale darakht se hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Eat olive oil and use it as a lotion, for it is beneficial and blessed." - Abdullah bin Sa'id and others.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zaitoon ka tel khaao aur usse lagaao, kyunke yeh paak aur barkat wala hai." Abdullah bin Sa'eed kamzor (raawi) hain.

e: [AI] That his name be raised and mentioned therein, the men glorify Him therein at morning and evenings. [He is] a light example - like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is within glass. [The niche is] as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things.
hi: "{Aise gharon mein jinhein Allah ne buland karne aur unme apna naam yaad karne ki ijaazat di hai, jinme subah-shaam uski tasbeeh ki jaati hai, aise log jinhein tijarat aur khareed-o-farokht Allah ke zikr se ghaafil nahi karti}" (Surah An-Noor 36-37) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Allah ne yeh misaal di," unke farmaan "{Uske noor ki misaal aik taaq jaisi hai jismein chiraag ho, chiraag shishe mein ho}" (Surah An-Noor 35) ke baare mein, "unhi logon ke liye jinhein tijarat aur khareed-o-farokht Allah ke zikr se ghaafil nahi karti, aur woh sab logon se zyada tijarat aur khareed-o-farokht karne wale the, lekin unki tijarat aur khareed-o-farokht unhein Allah ke zikr se ghaafil nahi karti thi."

e: [AI] "Indeed, mosques have pillars, and their pillars are the gathering places for the angels. If they are absent, they will be asked about. And if they are sick, they will be visited. And if they are in need, they will be supported."
hi: "Masjidon ke apne khambe (paabandi se aane wale) hote hain, unke sath farishton ke sathi hote hain, agar woh ghaib ho jaayen to unke baare mein poocha jaata hai, agar woh bimaar hon to unki ayaadat ki jaati hai, aur agar unhein kisi zaroorat ho to unki madad ki jaati hai."

e:
We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, and we used to take turns tending the animals. When it was my turn, I sent my camels out to graze and then returned. I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was addressing the people, and I heard him say: *"There is no Muslim who performs wudu and performs the wudu thoroughly, then stands in his prayer knowing what he is saying, except that he turns away from sins like the day his mother gave birth to him, with no sin upon him."* He said: I could not restrain myself at that point from saying, “Bakh, bakh!” Umar, while I was beside him, said: “Are you amazed at this? Before you came, he said something even better than it.” I said: “What is it? May my father and mother be your ransom.”

He said: He said: *"There is no man who performs wudu and performs the wudu thoroughly, then says when he finishes his wudu, ‘I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger,’ except that eight gates of Paradise are opened for him; he may enter through whichever of them he wishes."*

Then he said: *"The people will be gathered on one plain; sight will reach them all, and the caller will make them all hear. Then a caller will call out: The people of the gathering will surely know for whom honor is today."* Three times. Then he will say: *"Where are those whose sides used to forsake their beds?"* Then he will say: *"Where are those whom ‘neither trade nor sale distracted from the remembrance of Allah’ [al-Nur 37], to the end of the verse?"* Then a caller will call out: The gathering will surely know for whom honor is today. Then he will say: *"Where are the frequent praisers, those who used to praise their Lord?"*[^1]
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik safar mein thay, hum baari-baari jaanwaron ki nigraani karte, jab meri baari aayi to maine apne oont charne chhode, phir wapas aaya, main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke woh logon ko khutba de rahe the, to maine unhein farmate suna: "Koi bhi Musalman aisa nahi jo wudu kare aur mukammal wudu kare, phir apni namaz mein khada ho aur jaane jo woh keh raha hai, magar woh apni maa se paida honay wale din ki tarah gunahon se paak ho jaata hai, uspar koi gunah nahi hota." Unhone kaha: to us waqt main apne aap ko rok na saka aur maine kaha: "Wah, wah," to Umar (RA), jo mere pehlu mein the, ne kaha: "Isspar hairat karte ho? Aap (SAW) ne tumhare aane se pehle isse bhi achhi baat kahi hai." Maine kaha: "Woh kya hai, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan?" Unhone kaha: aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi aadmi aisa nahi jo wudu kare aur mukammal wudu kare, phir apne wudu se faarigh honay par kahe: 'Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluh,' magar uske liye Jannat ke aath (8) darwaze khol diye jaate hain, jis darwaze se chaahe dakhil ho." Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Log aik hi maidaan mein jama kiye jaayenge, nazar unhein dekh legi, aur pukaarne wala unhein sunaayega, to aik pukaarne wala pukaarega: 'Aaj jama'at ko pata chal jayega ke buzurgi kiske liye hai,' teen martaba, phir kahega: 'Kahan hain woh log jinke pehlu bistar se alag rehte the?' phir kahega: 'Kahan hain woh log jinhein tijarat aur khareed-o-farokht Allah ke zikr se ghaafil nahi karti thi?' ayat ke aakhir tak, phir aik pukaarne wala pukaarega: 'Jama'at ko pata chal jayega ke aaj buzurgi kiske liye hai,' phir kahega: 'Kahan hain Allah ki hamd karne wale jo apne Rab ki hamd karte the?'"

e: [AI] But I am not fasting, so he allowed him to drink, and then he said, "They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will turn about" [Quran 24:37].
hi: "Lekin main roze se nahi hoon," phir usne use pilaaya, phir kaha: "{Woh us din se darte hain jismein dil aur nazrein palat jaayengi}" (Surah An-Noor 37).

e:
Concerning the saying of Allah ﷻ, "Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth," he recited the verse, then said: "But those who disbelieve—their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland, which the thirsty one thinks is water, until, when he comes to it, he finds it to be nothing, and he finds Allah there, so He pays him his account in full; and Allah is swift in reckoning" [al-Nur 39]. He said: “Likewise, the disbeliever will come on the Day of Resurrection thinking that he has some good with Allah that he will find, but Allah will admit him into the Fire.”

He said: And He gave another parable for the disbeliever, saying: "Or like darknesses in a deep sea, covered by waves, above which are waves, above which are clouds—darknesses, one above another. When he puts out his hand, he can hardly see it. And whoever Allah does not grant light has no light" [al-Nur 40]. Thus He moves him through five kinds of darkness: his speech is darkness, his deed is darkness, his entrance is darkness, his departure is darkness, and his final destination is to the darknesses, to the Fire, on the Day of Resurrection.[^1]
hi: Allah ki is baat ke baare mein "{Allah aasman-o-zameen ka noor hai}," unhone yeh ayat padhi, phir kaha: "{Aur jinhone kufr kiya, unke amal us mrigmareechika jaisi hain jo maidaan mein hoti hai, jise pyaasa paani samajhta hai, yahan tak ke jab woh wahan pahunchta hai to usme kuch nahi paata, aur Allah ko apne paas paata hai, to woh uska poora hisaab chukaata hai, aur Allah jald hisaab lene wala hai}" (Surah An-Noor 39), unhone kaha: "Isi tarah kaafir Qayamat ke din aayega jabke woh samajhta hoga ke Allah ke paas uske liye achhi cheez hai jo woh paayega, lekin Allah use aag mein daakhil karega." Unhone kaha: aur unhone kaafir ke liye aik aur misaal bhi di, farmaya: "{Ya woh gehre samundar ke andheron jaisa hai jise lehr dhaanp rahi hai, uske oopar aik aur lehr, uske oopar baadal, andhere aik doosre par, jab woh apna haath nikale to use dekh na sake, aur jise Allah noor na de, uske liye koi noor nahi}" (Surah An-Noor 40), to woh use paanch qism ke andheron mein le jaata hai - uski baat andhera hai, uska amal andhera hai, uska dakhla andhera hai, uska nikaas andhera hai, aur uska anjaam Qayamat ke din aag ke andheron ki taraf hai.

e: [AI] We went to a funeral in the Bab Dimashq area, and with us was Abu Umamah al-Bahili. When he prayed upon the deceased and they began burying him, Abu Umamah said, "O people, you have entered a house in which you share in good deeds and bad deeds, and soon you will leave it for another abode. This indicates the grave, the house of solitude, darkness, worms, and narrowness, except for what Allah expands. Then you will move from it to the stations of the Day of Resurrection. You will be in some of these stations until a matter from the matters of Allah covers the people. Faces will turn bright and faces will turn dark, and then you will move to another house where intense darkness covers the people. Then the light will be divided, and the believer will receive light while the disbeliever and the hypocrite will not receive anything. This is a similitude that Allah, the Most High, has given in His Book, "Or like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, above which are waves, above which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand, he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allah has not granted light - for him there is no light." [Quran 24:40] And the disbeliever and the hypocrite will not be illuminated by the light of the believer, just as the blind person is not illuminated by the sight of the one who can see. The hypocrite says to those who believe, "Look at us and provide for us some of your light." But it is said to them, "Go back and seek light." And a wall is put up between them, with a door within it. Inside it is mercy, and outside of it is torment. They call to them, "Were we not with you?" They reply, "Yes, but you deceived yourselves and delayed, and you were deceived by false hopes until the decree of Allah came. And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah." [Quran 4:142] So they return to the place where the light was divided and they find nothing. They turn back to them, and there is a barrier between them. It has a door, inside of which is mercy, and from its front is punishment. They call out to them, "Weren't we with you? We used to pray with you and fight in battles alongside you." They reply, "Yes, but you caused confusion, you waited and hesitated, and false hopes deceived you, until the command of Allah came and you were deceived by Allah." [Quran 57:14] Then it recites, "And how terrible that result is!" [Quran 57:15]
hi: Hum Damishq ke darwaze par aik janaaze ke liye nikle, humare sath Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (RA) the, jab unhone janaaze ki namaz padhi aur log use dafnaane lage, to Abu Umamah (RA) ne kaha: "Aye logo, tum subah aur shaam aik aise ghar mein guzarte ho jismein tum neki aur badi ka baant lete ho, aur ankareeb tum yahan se doosre ghar ki taraf kooch karogay," - qabr ki taraf ishara karte huay - "akelapan ka ghar, andhere ka ghar, keeron ka ghar, tangi ka ghar, siwaye us ke jise Allah kushaada kar de, phir tum wahan se Qayamat ke din ke maqaamaat ki taraf muntaqil hoge, to tum un maqaamaat mein se kisi mein hoge yahan tak ke logon par Allah ka koi hukum chha jayega, to kuch chehre safed ho jaayengay aur kuch kaale, phir tum wahan se aik aur ghar ki taraf muntaqil hoge, to logon par sakht andhera chha jayega, phir noor taqseem kiya jayega, momin ko noor diya jayega, aur kaafir aur munafiq ko chhod diya jayega, unhein kuch nahi diya jayega, aur yehi woh misaal hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne apni Kitaab mein di: {Ya woh gehre samundar ke andheron jaisa hai jise lehr dhaanp rahi hai, uske oopar aik aur lehr, uske oopar baadal, andhere aik doosre par, jab woh apna haath nikale to use dekh na sake, aur jise Allah noor na de, uske liye koi noor nahi}" (Surah An-Noor 40), "aur kaafir aur munafiq momin ke noor se roshni nahi le sakenge jaise andha binaai wale ki nazar se roshni nahi le sakta, munafiq imaan walon se kahega: {Humein dekho, hum tumhare noor se kuch roshni le lein,} kaha jayega: {Apne peechhe wapas jao, aur noor talaash karo}" (Surah Al-Hadid 13), "aur yeh woh dhoka hai jissey munafiq ne dhoka diya tha, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: {Woh Allah ko dhoka dete hain jabke woh unhein dhoka de raha hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 142), "to woh us jagah ki taraf lautenge jahan noor taqseem kiya gaya tha, magar unhein kuch nahi milega, to woh unki taraf palatenge, aur unke darmiyan aik deewar khadi ki ja chuki hogi jismein aik darwaza hoga, jiske andar rehmat hogi aur jiske baahar azaab, woh unhein pukaarenge: 'Kya hum tumhare sath nahi the? Hum tumhare sath namaz padhte the aur tumhare sath jung karte the?' {Woh kahenge: kyun nahi, lekin tumne apne aap ko fitne mein daala, intezaar kiya, shak kiya, aur tumhein aarzuon ne dhoka diya yahan tak ke Allah ka hukum aa gaya, aur tumhein Allah ke baare mein dhoke baaz ne dhoka diya}" (Surah Al-Hadid 14), yahan tak ke padha: "{Aur kitna bura thikaana hai}" (Surah Al-Hadid 15).

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his companions arrived in Madinah, the Ansar welcomed them, and the Arabs were amazed at their unity. They would not spend a night or wake up except with their weapons, saying, "Do you think that we can live peacefully and securely, without fearing anyone except Allah?" So Allah revealed the following verses: "Allah has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security..." (Quran 24:55) until "...but whoever disbelieves after that, then those are the defiantly disobedient." (Quran 24:55), meaning those who deny His blessings, "So those are the defiantly disobedient." (Quran 3:82).
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke sahaba Madinah aaye aur Ansar ne unhein panaah di, to Arab unpar aik hi kamaan se teer chalaane lage, woh (Muhajireen/Ansar) hathiyaaron ke bagair na raat guzarte the na subah karte the, to unhone kaha: "Kya tumhein lagta hai hum kabhi itmenaan aur sukoon se raat guzaarengay, sirf Allah ke siwa kisi se na darte huay?" To yeh nazil hui: "{Allah ne un logon se wada kiya hai jo tum mein se imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye ke woh unhein zameen mein zaroor khalifa banaayega jaise usne unse pehle logon ko banaaya tha, aur unke liye unke us deen ko zaroor mazboot karega jise usne unke liye pasand kiya hai, aur unke khauf ke baad unhein zaroor amn se badal dega}" (Surah An-Noor 55) yahan tak ke "{Aur jo iske baad kufr kare}" (Surah An-Noor 55) - ya'ni ne'mat ke baad - "{To yehi log faasiq (na-farmaan) hain}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 82).

e: [AI] About Ali's statement, may Allah be exalted, "So that those whom your right hands possess may seek permission from you" [Surah An-Nur 58], he said, "It applies to women, as men should seek permission."
hi: Ali (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jinke tumhare dayen haath maalik hon woh tumse ijaazat lein}" (Surah An-Noor 58) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Auraton ke liye, kyunke mard to (khud hi) ijaazat maangte hain."

e: [AI] "He is the mosque; if you enter it, then say peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. It is authentic according to the condition of the two sheikhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim) and they did not discard it, according to the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To jab tum gharon mein dakhil ho to apne aap par salaam kaho}" (Surah An-Noor 61) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh masjid hai, jab tum ismein dakhil ho to kaho: 'As-salamu alaina wa ala ibadillahis-saliheen' (humpar aur Allah ke nek bandon par salaamati ho)." "Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "When you enter your homes, greet the people inside, and when you eat, mention the name of Allah. And when one of you enters their home and mentions the name of Allah, and the food has been provided, Satan says to his fellow companions, 'You will have no shelter, nor dinner.' And if one of you does not greet the people inside his home or mention the name of Allah, Satan says to his fellow companions, 'You have found shelter for the night and dinner.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum apne gharon mein dakhil ho to ghar walon ko salaam karo, aur jab khaao to Allah ka naam lo, aur jab tum mein se koi ghar mein dakhil hote waqt salaam kare aur khaane par Allah ka naam le, to shaitan apne saathiyon se kehta hai: 'Tumhare liye na rehne ki jagah hai na khaana,' aur agar tum mein se koi salaam na kare aur naam na le, to shaitan apne saathiyon se kehta hai: 'Tumhein rehne ki jagah bhi mil gayi aur khaana bhi.'"

e: [AI] "About Ibn Mas'ood, may Allah be pleased with him."
hi: Ibn Mas'ood (RA) se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked, "How will the people of hellfire be gathered with their faces on the ground?" He replied, "The same power that made them walk on their feet is capable of making them walk on their faces."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Jahannami log apne chehron ke bal kaise ikattha kiye jaayenge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne unhein unke pairon par chalaaya, woh unhein unke chehron par bhi chala sakta hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] A man said, "O Messenger of Allah, those who are resurrected on their faces, how will they be resurrected?" He replied, "Indeed, the One who made them walk on their feet is capable of making them be resurrected on their faces."
hi: Aik shakhs ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), jo apne chehron ke bal ikattha kiye jaayenge, woh kaise ikattha honge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne unhein unke pairon par chalaaya, woh unhein unke chehron par bhi ikattha kar sakta hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Ma'd bin Adnan bin Add bin Zind bin Al-Bara' bin A'raq Ath-Tharra." She said, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited, "He destroyed 'Ad and Thamud and the people of the well and many generations in between. Nobody knows them except Allah." Umm Salamah said, "The descendants of Ath-Tharra are Isma'il bin Ibrahim, Zind bin Hameisan, and Bara' bin Nabt."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Ma'ad bin Adnan bin Adad bin Zand bin Al-Baraa bin A'raaq Ath-Thara." Unhone kaha: phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Usne Aad, Thamud, aur Ashaab-ur-Rass ko halaak kiya, aur inke darmiyan bohot si nasalon ko bhi jinhein Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta}." Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Aur A'raaq Ath-Thara Isma'il bin Ibrahim (AS) hain, aur Zand Hameisa hain, aur Baraa Nabt hain."

e: [AI] "There is no year that is not rained upon by another year, but it is Allah who diverts it wherever He wills. And He recited the verse, 'And We have entirely diverted it from them.' [Surah Al-Furqan, verse 50]."
hi: "Koi saal doosre saal se zyada baarish nahi barsata, balke Allah use jahan chaahe phera deta hai," phir unhone padha: "{Aur humne isse unke darmiyan (badal-badal kar) taqseem kiya}" (Surah Al-Furqan 50) ayat.

e: [AI] Regarding these two verses, their command is concerning those in Surah Al-Furqan who do not invoke any deity besides Allah and do not kill a soul which Allah has forbidden except for a just cause, and also in Surah An-Nisa, "And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell." I asked Ibn Abbas about this, and he said, "When the verse in Surah Al-Furqan was revealed, the polytheists of Makkah said, 'We have killed the soul which Allah has forbidden, and we have associated partners with Allah, and we have committed indecent actions.' Then the verse was revealed, 'Except for those who repent, believe, and do righteous deeds.'" And he said, "This is referring to those people."
