As for the verse in Surah An-Nisa, "And whoever kills a believer intentionally," it refers to a man who embraced Islam, performed the deeds of Islam, and then intentionally killed a believer. His recompense is Hell, and there is no repentance for him. I mentioned this to Mujahid, and he said, "It is correct according to the condition of the two sheikhs (referring to Bukhari and Muslim), as long as he has not been expelled." (According to the condition of Bukhari and Muslim)
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abza ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Ibn Abbas (RA) se in do ayaton ke baare mein poochun ke inka mamla kya hai - jo Surah Al-Furqan mein hai: "{Aur jo Allah ke sath kisi doosre ma'bood ko nahi pukaarte, aur na haq ke siwa us jaan ko qatl karte hain jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai}" (Surah Al-Furqan 68), aur jo Surah An-Nisa mein hai: "{Aur jo koi jaan-boojh kar kisi momin ko qatl kare, uski saza Jahannam hai}" (Surah An-Nisa 93) ayat. Unhone kaha: to maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se iske baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Jab Surah Al-Furqan wali nazil hui, to Makkah ke mushrikeen ne kaha: 'Humne to woh jaan bhi na-haq qatl ki hai jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai, aur humne Allah ke sath doosre ma'bood ko bhi pukaara hai, aur humne besharmi ke kaam bhi kiye hain,' to yeh nazil hui: {Siwaye us shakhs ke jisne tauba ki, imaan laaya, aur nek amal kiya} (Surah Al-Furqan 70), unhone kaha: 'To yeh (ayat) unke liye hai.'" Unhone kaha: "Rahi baat Surah An-Nisa mein '{Aur jo koi jaan-boojh kar kisi momin ko qatl kare}' (Surah An-Nisa 93) wali ayat ki, to yeh woh aadmi hai jisne Islam pehchaan liya, Islam ke amal kiye, phir jaan-boojh kar kisi momin ko qatl kar diya, to uski saza Jahannam hai, uske liye koi tauba nahi." Unhone kaha: maine yeh baat Mujahid ko bataayi, to unhone kaha: "Siwaye us shakhs ke jise pachhtaawa ho."

e: [AI] "A man from the polytheists, O Messenger of Allah, and they have killed and expedited, and they have exceeded their limits. How wonderful what you invite us to if you informed us that what we have done is a form of atonement, and then Allah the Almighty revealed, 'And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity' [Al-Furqan 68] and 'Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah' [Az-Zumar 53].' It is authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to Bukhari and Muslim), and they did not exclude it."
hi: Aik mushrik aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humne to bohot qatl kiye hain aur bohot zina bhi kiya hai, kitni achhi baat hai jiski taraf aap humein bulaate hain, kaash aap humein bataayen ke jo humne kiya hai uska koi kaffaara hai." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur jo Allah ke sath kisi doosre ma'bood ko nahi pukaarte}" (Surah Al-Furqan 68) ayat, aur yeh nazil hui: "{Kaho: Aye mere bando jinhone apni jaanon par zulm kiya hai, Allah ki rehmat se mayoos mat ho}" (Surah Az-Zumar 53). "Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] It was narrated that Abu Burdah bin Abi Musa al-Ash'ari said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stayed with a Bedouin, so he honored him and said to him: "Give us some milk." So the Bedouin came to him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him: "What is your need?" He said: "My camel has exhausted me (with its milk) and my family is milking it." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Is this (camel) unable to produce milk like the old she-camel of the Children of Israel?" So his companions said to him: "O Messenger of Allah! Do the Children of Israel have an old she-camel?" He said: "When Musa (Moses) wanted to lead the Children of Israel out (of Egypt), he lost his way. So he said to the Children of Israel: 'What is this?' They said: 'The scholars of the Children of Israel do not know the location of his grave, except an old woman of the Children of Israel.' So Musa sent for her and he said to her: 'Guide us to the grave of Yusuf (Joseph).' She said: 'No, by Allah, not until you grant me my wish.' He said: 'What is your wish?' She said: 'My wish is to be with you in Paradise.' It was as if he disliked that. So it was said to him: 'Grant her wish.' So he granted her wish and they went with her to a pond of stagnant water. She said to them: 'Dry up this water.' So when they dried it up, she said to them: 'Dig.' So they dug and they took out the bones of Yusuf. When they finished, the path was illuminated like broad daylight." [Al-Shu'ara' 52]
hi: Unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Aur humne Musa (AS) ki taraf wahi bheji ke mere bandon ko raat mein le kar nikal jaao, beshak tumhara peecha kiya jayega}" (Surah Ash-Shu'ara 52) ayaten, to Abu Burdah bin Abi Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) ne apne waalid se riwayat karte huay kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) aik badu ke paas thehre, usne unki bohot izzat ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse kaha: "Humara khayal rakhna, humare paas aana." To woh badu unke paas aaya, Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse poocha: "Tumhein kya zaroorat hai?" Usne kaha: "Aik oontni apne saaman ke sath, aur mere ghar wale uska doodh nikaal lein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Bani Israel ki boodhi aurat jaisa nahi ban saka." Unke sahaba ne poocha: "Bani Israel ki boodhi aurat kya thi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Musa (AS) ne Bani Israel ko lekar chalna chaaha, to unhein raasta bhool gaya, unhone Bani Israel se poocha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Unhone kaha: Bani Israel ke aalimon ne unse kaha: 'Yusuf (AS) ne apni maut ke waqt humse Allah ka ahd liya tha ke hum Misr se tab tak na nikalein jab tak unki haddiyaan humare sath na le jaayen.' Musa (AS) ne poocha: 'Tum mein se kise pata hai Yusuf (AS) ki qabr kahan hai?' Bani Israel ke aalimon ne kaha: 'Uski jagah ka ilm sirf Bani Israel ki aik boodhi aurat ko hai.' To Musa (AS) ne uske paas paighaam bheja, kaha: 'Humein Yusuf (AS) ki qabr dikhao.' Usne kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, jab tak tum mujhe mera hukum na do.' Unhone poocha: 'Tumhara hukum kya hai?' Usne kaha: 'Mera hukum yeh hai ke main Jannat mein tumhare sath hoon.' Unhone kaha: to unhein yeh napasand hua. Unhone kaha: to unhein kaha gaya: 'Usse uska hukum de do.' To unhone usse uska hukum de diya, phir woh unhein aik jheel-numa jagah lekar gayi jahan paani jama tha, usne unse kaha: 'Yeh paani nikaalo.' Jab unhone nikaal liya, to usne kaha: 'Khudaai karo.' To unhone khudaai ki aur Yusuf (AS) ki haddiyaan nikaal lin, jab unhone unhein zameen se uthaaya, to raasta din ki roshni jaisa (saaf) ho gaya."

e: [AI] She said, "O Messenger of Allah, Abdullah bin Jud'an used to honor guests, maintain family ties, and do good deeds. Will that benefit him?" He replied, "No, for he never said on any day, 'My Lord, forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgment.'" (Authenticated by Al-Albani, not included in the citation)
hi: Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Abdullah bin Jud'an mehmaano ko khaana khilaata tha, rishtedaari nibhaata tha, aur (aisa hi bhala) karta tha, kya usse iska koi faida hoga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, usne kabhi bhi yeh nahi kaha: 'Aye Rab, Din ke Din mein meri khataa maaf kar.'" "Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Sahih.

e: [AI] "The hoopoe used to guide Solomon towards water. So I asked, how is that possible when the hoopoe is set up with a trap and dust is thrown on it? He said, 'May God make you as wise as your father. Was it not when death was approaching, did sight not go away?'"
hi: "Hudhud (hud-hud parinda) Sulaiman (AS) ko paani ki taraf raahnumaai karta tha." Maine poocha: "Yeh kaise mumkin hai jabke hudhud ke liye jaal bichaaya jaata hai aur uspar mitti daali jaati hai (aur woh pakda jaata hai)?" Unhone kaha: "Allah tujhe iski samajh de jaisi tere baap ko thi, kya jab taqdeer aati hai to nazar chali nahi jaati?"

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas said, "Indeed, fate comes when it is less than visible."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Main use zaroor sakht saza dunga}" (Surah An-Naml 21) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Main uske par nochunga." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Sulaiman bin Dawud (AS) ke liye chhah lakh (600,000) kursiyaan rakhi jaati thin, phir insaano ke ashraaf aakar unke qareeb baithte, phir jinnaat ke ashraaf aakar insaano ke qareeb baithte, phir woh parindon ko bulaate to woh unhein saaya karte, phir woh hawa ko bulaate to woh unhein uthaati, aik hi subah mein woh mahine bhar ka safar tay karte. Aik din woh maidaan mein safar kar rahe the ke unhein paani ki zaroorat hui, to hudhud aaya aur zameen kuredne laga, usne paani ki jagah paa li, to shayateen aaye aur us jagah ki khaal aise utaari jaise chamda utaara jaata hai, aur unhone paani nikaal liya." To Nafi' bin Al-Azraq ne poocha: "Aye Waqqaf, aapka kya khayal hai hudhud kaise aata hai aur zameen kuredkar paani ki jagah paa leta hai, jabke woh jaal ki taraf aata hai aur use dekh raha hota hai yahan tak ke woh uski gardan mein phans jaata hai?" To Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Beshak jab taqdeer aati hai to woh nazar ke aage hail ho jaati hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Verily, they now know that what I used to say to them in the world was the truth." And Allah Almighty said to His Prophet ﷺ, "Indeed, you do not make the dead hear, nor do you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs in retreat." [Surah An-Naml, verse 80]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein ab pata chal chuka hai ke jo main duniya mein unse kehta tha woh haq tha." Aur Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (SAW) se farmaya: "{Beshak tum murdon ko nahi sunaa sakte, aur na hi bahron ko apni pukaar sunaa sakte ho jab woh peeth pher kar chale jaayen}" (Surah An-Naml 80).

e: [AI] From Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him), who brought the good deed {Al-An'am 160}, he said: "Whoever comes with the testimony that there is no god but Allah" {and whoever comes with an evil deed} [Al-An'am 160], he said: "With polytheism." This is authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but they did not exclude it according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, "{Jo koi neki lekar aaye}" (Surah Al-An'am 160) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jo koi 'La ilaha illallah' lekar aaye," "{Aur jo koi buraai lekar aaye}" (Surah Al-An'am 160), unhone kaha: "Shirk ke sath." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e:
[AI] "Empty of everything except the mention of Musa. It almost revealed his secret." (Surah Al-Qasas 10)

He said, "O my son, do not disclose your affair to anyone." And she commanded her sister to observe him. (Surah Al-Qasas 11)

Seek his trace. And We had forbidden him from accepting any wet nurse before. (Surah Al-Qasas 12)

He said, "No one will breastfeed him except that I am around."
hi: "Musa (AS) ke zikr ke ilawa har cheez se khaali (dil)." "{Beshak woh iska raaz zaahir kar deti}," unhone kaha: "Yeh ke woh keh de: 'Aye mere bete.'" "{Aur unhone apni behn se kaha: uska peecha karo}" (Surah Al-Qasas 11), "uska nishaan talaash karo," "{Aur humne pehle hi unpar doodh pilaane waaliyan haraam kar di thin}" (Surah Al-Qasas 12), unhone kaha: "Koi doodh pilaane wali laayi nahi jaati thi jise woh qubool karte."

e:
[AI] "'Umar narrated: "Then one of them came to him walking modestly.'"
"Allah said, 'She was walking shyly, in modesty." (Surah Al-Qasas 25)
"He said, 'She used to come to me in obedience, respect, and modesty. She would put her hand on her face.'"
"Musa stood up with her and said, 'Walk behind me and guide me to the way. I will walk ahead of you, for we do not look at the backs of women.'"
"Then she said, 'O my father, hire him. Truly, the best you can hire is the strong, trustworthy one.' (Surah Al-Qasas 26)"
"When she saw his strength and what he said to her, her desire for him increased. So she added, 'Indeed, I want to marry one of your daughters on the condition that you work for me for eight years. If you complete ten, it will be from you, and I do not want to make things difficult for you. You will find me, God willing, one of the righteous.' (Surah Al-Qasas 27)"
"Meaning, in good companionship and fulfilling what I have asked." 
"Musa said, 'This is a deal between you and me. Whichever of the two terms I complete, there will be no injustice towards me.' (Surah Al-Qasas 28)"
"He said, 'Yes, Allah is a witness to what we say.' So Musa married her and stayed with her. She sufficed him and took care of his sheep and whatever he needed from her. Then he married Safura, her sister or her half-sister, who used to follow them diligently." 
"This narration is authentic according to the conditions set by Al-Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Umar (RA) se, "{To unme se aik sharm ke sath chalti hui unke paas aayi}" (Surah Al-Qasas 25) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh aati thi kabhi bahar, kabhi ander, apna haath apne chehre par rakhe huay," to Musa (AS) uske sath khade huay aur usse kaha: "Mere peechhe chalo aur mujhe raasta bataao, aur main tumhare aage chalunga, kyunke hum auraton ki peeth ki taraf nahi dekhte." Phir usne kaha: "{Aye mere waalid, ise mulazim rakh lein, sabse achha mulazim woh hai jo taaqatwar aur amaanatdaar ho}" (Surah Al-Qasas 26) - unki taaqat dekhkar aur unki yeh baat sunkar jo unhone kahi, to unke andar iski chaahat aur barh gayi, to unhone kaha: "{Main chahta hoon ke main apni in do betiyon mein se aik ki shaadi tumse kar dun, is shart par ke tum aath (8) saal mere paas kaam karo, aur agar tum das (10) saal poore karo to yeh tumhari taraf se hoga, aur main tumpar sakhti nahi karna chahta, Allah ne chaaha to tum mujhe nekon mein paaoge}" (Surah Al-Qasas 27) ya'ni achhi sohbat aur wafaadaari mein. Musa (AS) ne kaha: "{Yeh mere aur aapke darmiyan (ahd) hai, main in do muddaton mein se jo bhi poori karoon, mujhpar koi ilzaam nahi}" (Surah Al-Qasas 28). Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Allah is baat par jo hum keh rahe hain gawah hai." To unhone unki shaadi kar di, aur woh unke sath rahe, unki khidmat karte aur unki bakriyon ki dekh-bhaal karte, jo bhi zaroorat hoti woh poori karte, aur unhone unki shaadi Safoora ya unki behn Sharqa se ki, aur yehi dono thin jo (apni bakriyon ko) rok rahi thin. "Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) was asked, "Which of the two lives did Moses complete?" He replied, "The furthest and the sweetest."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Musa (AS) ne dono muddaton mein se konsi poori ki?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo zyada lambi aur behtareen thi." Hafs kamzor (raawi) hain.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  asked Gabriel, "Which of the two terms did Moses complete?" He replied, "He completed both of them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Jibra'il (AS) se poocha: "Musa (AS) ne dono muddaton mein se konsi poori ki?" Unhone kaha: "Dono mukammal (poori) ki."

e: [AI] "I have never performed a prayer without hoping that it would serve as an expiation for the one before it."
hi: "Maine koi bhi namaz nahi padhi magar mujhe ummeed rahi ke yeh usse pehle wali (namaz) ke liye kaffaara ban jaaye."

e: [AI] "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, 'Allah has never destroyed a people, a generation, a nation, or the people of a village since He revealed the Torah on the face of the earth with a punishment from the sky, except for the people of the village that were transformed into monkeys. Have you not seen His saying, {And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture after We had destroyed the former generations as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded} [Qasas: 43].' This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (Bukhari and Muslim) and they did not include it in their compilations."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab se Allah ne Tauraat zameen par nazil ki, Allah ne kisi qaum, kisi nasal, kisi Ummat, ya kisi basti walon ko aasman se azaab bhej kar halaak nahi kiya, siwaye us basti ke jinhein bandar bana diya gaya, kya tumne Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farmaan nahi dekha: {Aur beshak humne Musa (AS) ko Kitaab di, isse pehle ke humne pehli nasalon ko halaak kar diya tha, logon ke liye samajh, hidayat, aur rehmat, taake woh naseehat haasil karein}" (Surah Al-Qasas 43). "Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah said, "I was not with them at the Mount (Tur) when We called out to them (saying) 'O Muhammad, respond to (the call of) your nation!' I had already responded to you before you even called upon Me, and I had already granted you before you even asked from Me."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, "{Aur tum tur (pahaad) ke kinare mojood na the jab humne pukaara}" (Surah Al-Qasas 46) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Pukaara gaya: 'Aye Muhammad ki Ummat, maine tumhein iske pehle qubool kar liya ke tum mujhse dua karo, aur maine tumhein iske pehle de diya ke tum mujhse maango.'"

e: [AI] When Moses came to his people, he commanded them to pay zakat, so Qarun gathered them and said to them, "He has come to you with prayer, and he has come to you with things, so you bear the burden of giving him your wealth." They said, "We cannot bear to give him our wealth. What do you suggest?" He said, "I suggest that I be sent to the oppressor of the Children of Israel, and we send it to him, and he will be deceived by it as if he desired it for himself." So Moses invoked Allah against them and commanded the earth to obey him. Moses said to the earth, "Take them," and it took them by their ankles. They said, "O Moses, O Moses." Then he said to the earth, "Take them," and it took them by their knees. They said, "O Moses, O Moses." Then he said, "To the earth, take them," and it took them by their necks. They said, "O Moses, O Moses." Then he said to the earth, "Take them," and it seized them and disappeared them. Then Allah revealed to Moses, "O Moses, My servants have asked of you and entreated you, but you did not respond to them. By My honor, if they had called upon Me, I would have answered them." Ibn Abbas said, "That is the saying of Allah, 'So We caused the earth to swallow him and his dwelling place.'" (Quran 28:81) The earth swallowed him and brought him down to the lowest ground.
hi: Jab Musa (AS) apni qaum ke paas aaye, to unhein zakat ka hukum diya, to Qarun ne unhein jama kiya aur kaha: "Woh tumhare paas namaz lekar aaya, aur woh tumhare paas aur bhi cheezein lekar aaya jo tumne bardaasht kin, ab tum yeh bhi bardaasht karo ke tum use apna maal do." Unhone kaha: "Hum apna maal use dene ka bojh nahi utha sakte, tumhari kya raay hai?" Usne unse kaha: "Meri raay hai ke Bani Israel ki aik badchalan aurat ko bulaayen aur usse (Musa ki taraf) bhejein taake woh Musa par ilzaam lagaaye ke unhone uske sath ghalat (buri) niyat ki thi." To Musa (AS) ne unke khilaaf dua ki, Allah ne zameen ko hukum diya ke woh unki baat maane, Musa (AS) ne zameen se kaha: "Inhein pakad lo," to usne unhein takhno tak pakad liya, woh kehne lage: "Aye Musa, Aye Musa," phir unhone zameen se kaha: "Inhein pakad lo," to usne unhein ghutno tak pakad liya, woh kehne lage: "Aye Musa, Aye Musa," phir unhone zameen se kaha: "Inhein pakad lo," to usne unhein gardanon tak pakad liya, woh kehne lage: "Aye Musa, Aye Musa," to unhone zameen se kaha: "Inhein pakad lo," to usne unhein pakad kar chhupaa liya. To Allah ne Musa (AS) ki taraf wahi bheji: "Aye Musa, mere bandon ne tumse maanga aur tumhare saamne gidgidaaye, lekin tumne unhein jawaab nahi diya, meri izzat ki qasam, agar unhone mujhse dua ki hoti to main unhein zaroor jawaab deta." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: {To humne usse aur uske ghar ko zameen mein dhansa diya}" (Surah Al-Qasas 81), use zameen ke sabse neeche tabqe tak dhansaa diya gaya.

e: [AI] I asked the Prophet ﷺ  about the saying of Allah the Almighty: "And you all participate in manifest sin" [Surah Al-Ankabut 29]. He said, "They used to insult and mock the passersby, and this is the manifest sin that they used to commit." This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, but it was not narrated according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) se Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur tum apni majlison mein bura kaam karte ho}" (Surah Al-Ankabut 29) ke baare mein poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh raste chalne walon par kankariyan phenkte the aur unka mazaaq udaate the, to yehi woh bura kaam tha jo woh karte the." Sahih hai Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Regarding the saying of Allah Almighty, "And the remembrance of Allah is greater" [Surah Al-Ankabut 45], So I said, "The remembrance of Allah is through tasbih (glorification), tahleel (saying La ilaha illallah), and takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar)." Then He said, "No, the remembrance of Allah is greater than your remembrance of Him." This hadith has a sound chain of narration, but it was not included in Sahih Al-Bukhari.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Allah ka zikr sabse bada hai}" (Surah Al-Ankabut 45) ke baare mein, maine kaha: "Allah ka zikr tasbeeh, tahleel, aur takbeer ke sath." To unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ka zikr (Allah ka tumhein yaad karna) tumhare uske zikr karne se bada hai." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Darda' say that there will come a people who will recite the verse "Alif Lam Meem. The Romans have been defeated" [Surah Ar-Rum: 2], and it is only defeated "with sound chain of narrators, and they have not produced it" authentic.
hi: Maine Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ko kehte suna: "Ankareeb aisi qaum aayegi jo padhegi: 'Alif-Laam-Meem, Ghalabat-ir-Room,' jabke sahih 'Ghulibat' hai." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: from Ibn 'Abbas, regarding the saying of Allah, Most High: Alif Lam Mim. The Romans have been defeated. In the nearest land (30:1-3)" he said: "Ghulibat wa Ghalabat (defeated and then victorious)." He said: "The idolaters wanted the Persians to be victorious over the Romans because they too were people who worshiped idols, while the Muslims wanted the Romans to be victorious over the Persians because they were people of the Book. This was mentioned to Abu Bakr, so Abu Bakr mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said: 'They will certainly prevail.' Abu Bakr mentioned that to them, and they said: 'Make a wager between us and you; if we win, we shall get this and that, and if you win, you shall get this or that.' He made the term five years, but they (the Romans) were not victorious. They mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: "Why did you not make it less (than)" - He (one of the narrators said): I think he said: "ten?" He said: Sa'eed said: "Al-Bid' is what is less than then" - he said: "Afterwards the Romans have been victorious." He said: "That is what Allah Most High said: 'Alif Lam Mim. The Romans have been defeated' up to His saying: 'And on the day, the believers will rejoice - with the help of Allah. He helps whom He wills (30:1-5).' Sufyan said: "I heard that they were victorious over them on the Day of Badr." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3193)
hi: Ke Room (Byzantines) Faaris (Persians) par ghaalib aayen, kyunke woh Ahl-e-Kitaab the, aur mushrikeen chahte the ke Faaris Room par ghaalib aayen kyunke woh but-parast the, to Musalmano ne yeh baat Abu Bakr (RA) se zikr ki, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ne yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, to Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Khabardar, woh ankareeb ghaalib aayenge." To Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein yeh baat bataayi, unhone kaha: "Humare aur aapke darmiyan aik muddat muqarrar kar lein, agar woh ghaalib aaye to aapko fulan-fulan cheez milegi, aur agar hum ghaalib aaye to humein fulan-fulan cheez milegi." To unhone unke darmiyan paanch (5) saal ki muddat muqarrar ki, lekin woh (Room) ghaalib na aaye, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne yeh baat Nabi (SAW) se zikr ki, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumne isse kam (muddat) muqarrar nahi ki?" Unhone kaha: "Das (10) se kam." Unhone kaha: to iske baad Room ghaalib aa gaye, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Alif-Laam-Meem, Room walon ko sabse qareebi zameen mein shikast di gayi, aur woh apni shikast ke baad ankareeb ghaalib aayenge}" (Surah Ar-Room 1-3), unhone kaha: "To Room ko shikast bhi hui aur baad mein ghaalib bhi aaye, sab kuch Allah ke ikhtiyar mein hai, pehle bhi aur baad mein bhi, aur us din momin Allah ki madad se khush hongay." Sufyan ne kaha: "Aur maine suna hai ke unhein Badr ke din ghaalib aane ki khabar mili."

e:
[AI] Yes, he read, "So exalted is Allah when you reach evening." (Surah Ar-Rum, 17).

He said, the prayer of Maghrib, "And when you approach morning." (Surah Ar-Rum, 17).

The prayer of Fajr, "And (mention) the night and the day." (Surah Maryam, 11).

The prayer of Asr, "And when you appear (after being hidden)." (Surah Ar-Rum, 18).

The prayer of Dhuhr and he read, "And after the prayer at night there are three acts of indecency for you." (Surah An-Nur, 58).
hi: Ji haan, unhone padha: "{To Allah ki tasbeeh karo jab tum shaam karo}" (Surah Ar-Room 17), unhone kaha: "Maghrib ki namaz," "{Aur jab tum subah karo}" (Surah Ar-Room 17), "Fajr ki namaz," "{Aur shaam ke waqt}" (Surah Maryam 11), "Asr ki namaz," "{Aur jab tum Zuhr ke waqt (aaraam karo)}" (Surah Ar-Room 18), "Zuhr ki namaz," aur unhone padha: "{Aur Isha ki namaz ke baad, teen (waqt) tumhare liye parde ke hain}" (Surah An-Noor 58).

e: [AI] "And among the people, there are those who purchase idle talk to mislead others from the path of Allah." [Surah Luqman 6] He said, "Indeed, it is nonsense."
hi: "{Aur logon mein se kuch aise hain jo bekaar baaton ko khareedte hain taake Allah ki raah se bhataayen}" (Surah Luqman 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh, Allah ki qasam, gaana hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Luqman said to his son while advising him, 'O my son, beware of indulging in luxury and extravagance, for it is frightening during the night and humiliating during the day.' This is a text supported by a valid chain of narrators, and Allah knows best."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Luqman ne apne bete ko naseehat karte huay kaha: "Aye mere bete, doosron ke saamne haath phailaane (bheek maangne) se bacho, kyunke yeh raat ko khauf-zada karti hai aur din ko zaleel karti hai." Yeh matan (mazmoon) is sanad ke sath sahih hai, aur Allah zyada jaanta hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] From Nubayh Al-Azzy, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, he narrated that Luqman said to his son, "And be moderate in your walking and lower your voice." [Luqman 19]. He (Jabir ibn Abdullah) said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to walk with his companions and they would make way for the angels behind him."
hi: Nubaih Al-Anazi se, unhone Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se riwayat karte huay, unhone Luqman ki apne bete ko yeh naseehat padhi: "{Aur apni chaal mein miyaana-ravi ikhtiyar karo aur apni aawaz neechi rakho}" (Surah Luqman 19), unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) "jab bahar nikalte to log unke aage chalte aur unki peeth farishton ke liye khaali chhod dete."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  used to not sleep until he recited Alif Lam Meem Tanzeel As-Sajdah and Tabarakalladhee. Abu Zubair narrated this incident to me, from Safwan or Abu Safwan."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) "kabhi nahi sote the jab tak 'Alif-Laam-Meem Tanzeel As-Sajdah' aur 'Tabaarak Alladhi Biyadihil-Mulk' na padh len." Abu Az-Zubair ne kaha: "Mujhe Safwan ya Abu Safwan ne yeh bataayi."

e: [AI] "Of the six days in which Allah created the heavens and the earth, then He established Himself above them."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Woh aasman se zameen tak har maamle ka intezaam karta hai, phir yeh uski taraf oopar jaata hai, aik aise din mein jiski miqdaar tumhare hisaab se hazaar (1000) saal hai}" (Surah As-Sajdah 5) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Un chhah (6) dinon mein se jinme Allah ne aasman-o-zameen paida kiye, phir woh uski taraf oopar jaata hai."

e: [AI] We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, in Al-Bathaa when a cloud passed by. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Do you know what this is?" We said, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "It is a cloud." We said, "A cloud." He said, "And it is a rain cloud." We said, "And a rain cloud." He said, "And it is thunder." Then he remained silent for a while and said, "Do you know the distance between the heaven and the earth?" We said, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "The distance between them is a journey of five hundred years, and between every heaven and the heaven that follows it, there is a journey of five hundred years, and each heaven is as thick as a journey of five hundred years, and above the seventh heaven is an ocean, between its upper part and its lower part, just as there is between the heaven and the earth. And Allah is above all of that, and nothing from the deeds of the children of Adam is hidden from Him."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Al-Batha mein baithe thay, aik baadal guzra, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai yeh kya hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Saahaab (baadal)." Humne kaha: "Saahaab." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur muzn." Humne kaha: "Aur muzn." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur anaan." Phir khamosh ho gaye, phir farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan kitna faasla hai?" Humne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke darmiyan paanch sau (500) saal ka safar hai, aur har aasman se uske agle aasman tak paanch sau (500) saal ka safar hai, aur har aasman ki moti paanch sau (500) saal ke safar jitni hai, aur saatwe aasman ke oopar aik samundar hai jiski oonchai aur neechai ke darmiyan utna hi faasla hai jitna aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan, aur Allah Ta'ala isse bhi oopar hai, Bani Aadam ke kisi bhi amal ko woh chhupaa nahi hai."

e: [AI] "While we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the battle of Tabuk, the heat was intense and the people scattered. As I looked, I saw the closest person to me was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . So, I approached him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, tell me about an action that will admit me to Paradise and distance me from the Fire.' He said, 'You have asked about something great, yet it is easy for those to whom Allah makes it easy. Worship Allah and do not associate anything with Him, establish the obligatory prayers, give the obligatory charity, and fast in Ramadan.' He said, 'Shall I not inform you of the gates of Paradise?' I said, 'Certainly, O Messenger of Allah.' He said, 'Fasting is a shield, charity extinguishes sins like water extinguishes fire, and a person's standing in prayer at night seeking the pleasure of Allah.' Then he recited the verse: 'Their sides forsake their beds, calling upon their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.' [Qur'an 32:16] He said, 'Shall I inform you of the foundation, pillar, and peak of all this?' I said, 'Certainly, O Messenger of Allah.' He said, 'The foundation is Islam, the pillar is prayer, and the peak is Jihad in the cause of Allah. And shall I inform you of the controlling factor in all this?' I said, 'Certainly, O Messenger of Allah.' He pointed with his finger towards his mouth and said, 'Restrain this.' I asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, will we be held accountable for what we say with our tongues?' He said, 'May your mother lose you! Is there anything that causes people to fall into Hell on their faces except for the harvest of their tongues?' This is the wording of the Hadith of Jarir, and Abu Ishaq Al-Fazari did not mention the Hukm bin 'Utbah in his version of the Hadith."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein thay, garmi bohot thi, to log alag-alag ho gaye yahan tak ke maine dekha ke Rasulullah (SAW) mujhse sabse qareeb hain, to main unke qareeb hua aur maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe aisa amal bataayen jo mujhe Jannat mein daakhil kare aur mujhe aag se door kare." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne badi cheez ke baare mein poocha hai, lekin yeh us shakhs ke liye aasaan hai jise Allah aasaan kar de - Allah ki ibaadat karo aur uske sath kisi ko shareek na karo, farz namaz qaayam karo, farz zakat do, aur Ramzan ke roze rakho." Phir farmaya: "Aur agar tum chaaho to main tumhein Jannat ke darwazon ke baare mein bataaun?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Roza (gunahon se bachaane wali) dhaal hai, aur sadqa gunah ko mita deta hai, aur aadmi ka aadhi raat mein khada hona Allah ki raza chahte huay," phir aap (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Unke pehlu bistar se alag rehte hain, apne Rab ko khauf aur ummeed se pukaarte hain, aur humne jo unhein diya hai usme se kharch karte hain}" (Surah As-Sajdah 16), phir farmaya: "Aur agar tum chaaho to main tumhein is maamle ke sar, uske sutoon, aur uski choti ki oonchaai ke baare mein bataaun?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahi baat maamle ke sar ki, to woh Islam hai, aur rahi baat uske sutoon ki, to woh namaz hai, aur rahi baat uski choti ki oonchaai ki, to woh Allah ki raah mein jihad hai, aur agar tum chaaho to main tumhein in sab ki asal cheez ke baare mein bataaun?" To aap (SAW) khamosh ho gaye, achanak do sawaar humari taraf tez chal rahe the, mujhe darr hua ke woh aap (SAW) ko mere kaam se hataa lein, maine kaha: "Woh kya hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne apni ungli apne munh ki taraf ki. Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya humein humari zubaan se kahi hui baaton par pakda jayega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teri maa tujhe kho de, Aye Ibn Jabal, kya log Jahannam mein apni naakon ke bal, unki zubaano ki kamaai ke siwa kisi aur cheez ki wajah se giraaye jaate hain?" Yeh Jareer ki hadith ke alfaaz hain, aur Abu Ishaq Al-Fazari ne apni hadith mein Al-Hakam bin Utaibah ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: [AI] While we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he was describing Paradise until he finished and then said, "In it are things that no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no human heart can comprehend." Then he recited the verse, "Their sides forsake their beds" [Surah As-Sajdah 32:16] until the end of the verse. Abu Sakhir then mentioned it to Al-Qurazi, who said, "They have hidden their deeds for Allah and Allah has hidden their rewards for them. They have advanced towards Allah, and that is when those eyes were softened."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas thay, aap (SAW) Jannat ki tareef bayan kar rahe the yahan tak ke aap (SAW) khatam hue, phir farmaya: "Ismein woh cheezein hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhin, na kisi kaan ne suna, na kisi insaan ke dil mein khayaal aaya," phir aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Unke pehlu bistar se alag rehte hain}" (Surah As-Sajdah 16) ayat ke aakhir tak. Abu Sakhr ne kaha: to maine yeh baat Al-Qurazi ko bataayi, unhone kaha: "Unhone Allah ke liye apna amal chhupaaya, to Allah ne unke liye unka ajr chhupaaya, phir woh Allah ke huzoor mein aaye, to unki aankhein thandi ho gayin."

e: [AI] "It is written in the Torah, 'Indeed, Allah has prepared for those whose hearts recoil from evil acts - unseen [in this world] - what no eye has seen and no ear has heard and what has never occurred to the heart of a human being. Such is the reward for what they used to do.' [As-Sajdah 32:17]."
hi: Ke yeh Tauraat mein likha hai: "Allah ne un logon ke liye jinke pehlu bistar se alag rehte hain, aisi cheezein taiyaar ki hain jo na kisi aankh ne dekhin, na kisi kaan ne suna, na kisi insaan ke dil mein khayaal aaya, aur na hi isse koi Nabi jaanta hai na koi qareebi farishta." Unhone kaha: "Hum ise (Quran mein) yun padhte hain: {To koi jaan nahi jaanti jo unke liye chhupaaya gaya hai aankhon ki thandak, unke amaal ka badla}" (Surah As-Sajdah 17).

e: [AI] "From Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him): 'And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment.' [Quran 32:21] He (Prophet Muhammad) said, 'On the Day of Badr.'"
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, "{Aur hum unhein zaroor bade azaab se pehle chhote azaab ka bhi maza chakhaayenge}" (Surah As-Sajdah 21) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Badr ka din."

e: that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “A servant ˹of God˺ is not provided a thing better and more expansive for him than patience.”
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Kisi bande ko sabr se behtar aur wasee' (kushaada) koi cheez nahi di gayi."

e: [AI] "On the day of Badr, victory was granted to the Prophet ﷺ, and the faith of those who disbelieved did not avail them after death."
hi: "Badr ke din Nabi (SAW) ke liye fatah khol di gayi, to jinhone kufr kiya unka imaan maut ke baad unke kaam na aaya."

e: Sūrat al-Aḥzāb was equivalent ˹in size˺ to Sūrat al-Baqarah and there was ˹an Āyah˺ in it: "al-shaykhu wa-al-shaykhah idhā zanayā fārjumūhumā al-battata (The ˹married˺ man and a woman, if they commit adultery, then absolutely stone them.)"[^1]
hi: "Surah Al-Ahzab Surah Al-Baqarah ke barabar hoti thi, aur ismein yeh (ayat) thi: {Boodha mard aur boodhi aurat jab zina karein, to unhein zaroor sangsaar karo}."

e: "Qabus bin Abi Zabyan narrated to us, that his father narrated to him, he said: 'We said to Ibn 'Abbas: "What is the meaning of the saying of Allah the Mighty and Sublime: Allah has not made for any man two hears inside his body.? (33:4)" He said: "The Prophet of Allah ﷺ stood one day for Salat, then he was unsure (regarding how much he had prayed). The hypocrites who prayed with him said: 'Don't you see that he has two hearts, a heart with you and another with them?' So Allah revealed: 'Allah has not made for any man two hearts inside his body.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3199)
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se poocha: Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan "{Allah ne kisi aadmi ke seene mein do dil nahi rakhe}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 4), iska kya matlab hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) khade huay, unhein aik khayaal aaya (namaz mein), to unke sath namaz padhne wale munafiqeen ne kaha: "Kya tum nahi dekhte, unke do dil hain, aik dil unke (munafiqon ke) sath aur aik tumhare sath?" To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Allah ne kisi aadmi ke seene mein do dil nahi rakhe}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 4).

e: [AI] "He used to recite this verse, 'The Prophet is closer to the believers than their own selves, and his wives are their mothers.'"
hi: "Ke woh yeh ayat padha karte the:" "Nabi (SAW) momino ke liye unki apni jaanon se zyada haqdaar hain, aur woh unke liye baap ki manind hain, aur unki biwiyaan unki maaen hain."

e: [AI] While Aisha Bint Talha was speaking to her mother, Umm Kulthum Bint Abi Bakr, she said, "My father is better than yours." Aisha, the mother of the believers, responded, "Shall I decide between you two? Indeed, when Abu Bakr came to the Prophet ﷺ , he said, 'O Abu Bakr, you are saved from the Hellfire.'" I said, "From that day on, he was called 'Atiq,'" and Talha came to the Prophet ﷺ  and he said, "You, Talha, are one of those whose love has been fulfilled." This is a hadith with an authentic chain of narration, but it wasn't narrated by Ibn Yahya bin Talha; rather, it was narrated by Ishaq bin Yahya bin Talha, who was deemed unreliable by Ahmad.
hi: Jabke Aisha bint Talha apni maa Umm Kulthum bint Abi Bakr se keh rahi thin: "Mere waalid tumhare waalid se behtar hain," to Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Kya main tum dono ke darmiyan faisla na karoon? Beshak Abu Bakr Nabi (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Abu Bakr, tum Allah ki taraf se aag se azaad kiye huay ho.'" Maine kaha: to usi din se unhein "Ateeq" (azaad) kaha jaane laga. Aur Talha (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum, Aye Talha, un logon mein se ho jinhone apna ahad poora kar diya." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, balke Ishaq bin Yahya bin Talha matrook (chhoda hua raawi) hain, jaisa Ahmad ne kaha.

e: [AI] She said in my house that this verse was revealed: "Indeed, Allah intends to keep away the impurity from you, O people of the household" [Surah Al-Ahzab 33]. She said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent for Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husain, and said, "O Allah, these are the people of my household." Umm Salamah said, "O Messenger of Allah, am I not one of the people of the household?" He replied, "You are of my family, but the people of my household have more right to be considered as such."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Mere ghar mein yeh ayat nazil hui: {Allah to sirf yeh chahta hai ke tum se, Aye Ahl-e-Bait, har napaki door kare aur tumhein khoob paak kare}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33). Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA), Fatimah (RA), Hasan (RA), aur Husain (RA) sab ko bulaawa bheja, phir farmaya: "Aye Allah, yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain." Umm Salamah (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main Ahl-e-Bait mein se nahi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum meri ahliyat (khaandaan) mein achhi ho, aur yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain, Aye Allah, mera Ahl-e-Bait zyada haqdaar hai."

e: [AI] I came looking for Ali but did not find him. Fatimah said he went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to call him, so I sat down. Then Ali came with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and they entered, and I entered with them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ called Hasan and Husayn and seated each of them on his thigh. He brought Fatimah closer to him and her husband, then wrapped them with his cloak while I was present and said, "Indeed, Allah desires to remove impurity from you, O people of the household, and to purify you thoroughly." [Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:33] O Allah, these are the members of my household.
hi: Main Ali (RA) ko dhoondhne aaya lekin unhein na paaya, to Fatimah (RA) ne kaha: "Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ko bulaane gaye hain, thodi der baitho." To woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aaye, dakhil huay, aur main bhi unke sath dakhil hua, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA) ko bulaaya, har aik ko apni raan par bithaaya, Fatimah (RA) ko apni god ke qareeb kiya aur unke shohar ko bhi, phir apna kapda unpar lapet diya, aur main gawaah tha, phir farmaya: "{Allah to sirf yeh chahta hai ke tum se, Aye Ahl-e-Bait, har napaki door kare aur tumhein khoob paak kare}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33), "Aye Allah, yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, men are mentioned but women are not mentioned!" So Allah, the Almighty, revealed the verse: "Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women..." (Quran 33:35) and also revealed: "Indeed, I will not allow to be lost the work of any worker among you, whether male or female..." (Quran 3:195)
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mardon ka zikr hota hai lekin auraton ka zikr nahi hota." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Beshak Musalman mard aur Musalman auraten, momin mard aur momin auraten}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 35) ayat, aur yeh nazil ki: "{Beshak main tum mein se kisi amal karne wale ka amal zaya nahi karta, chahe mard ho ya aurat}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 195).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a man wakes up his wife at night, they should both pray two Rak'ahs, for they will be recorded among those who remember Allah frequently; and likewise, the same applies to women." This Hadith is not attributed to Abu Nuaim, and the Prophet ﷺ did not mention it in the chain of narrators. However, it is narrated by 'Isa bin Ja'far, who is trustworthy.
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab aadmi apni biwi ko raat mein jagaaye aur dono do rak'aten padhein, to unhein Allah ka bohot zyada zikr karne walon aur karne waaliyon mein likh diya jaata hai." Abu Nu'aim ne isse sanad ke sath riwayat nahi ki aur is sanad mein Nabi (SAW) ka zikr nahi kiya, aur Isa bin Ja'far ne isse sanad ke sath riwayat kiya hai, aur woh mo'tabar (thiqa) hain.

e:
I was in the Masjid then al-ʿAbbās and ʿAlī came to me and they both said, "O Usāmah, get permission for us from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." Then I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ and asked for his permission and told him that ʿAbbās and ʿAlī are seeking permission." He said, "Do you know what they need?" I said, "No, by Allah, I do not know." He said, "However, I know, allow them ˹to enter˺." 
Then they both entered upon him and both said, "We came to ask you which one of your family members you love the most?" He said, ‘The one I love the most from my family is Fāṭimah b. Muḥmammad.’ They both said, "We are not asking about Fāṭimah." He said, "Then, Usāmah son of Zayd, the one who ˹is˺ the one Allāh had favored upon and I had favored upon."[^1]
hi: Main masjid mein tha ke Abbas (RA) aur Ali (RA) mere paas aaye aur mujhse kaha: "Aye Usamah, humare liye Rasulullah (SAW) se ijaazat lo." To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas dakhil hua aur unse ijaazat maangi, maine unse kaha: "Abbas aur Ali ijaazat maang rahe hain." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai unhein kya zaroorat hai?" Maine kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Lekin mujhe pata hai, unhein ijaazat de do." To woh dono dakhil huay aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum aapse yeh poochne aaye hain ke aapke ghar walon mein se aapko sabse zyada aziz kaun hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe sabse zyada aziz meri ghar wali Fatimah bint Muhammad hain." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum aapse Fatimah ke baare mein nahi poochte." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To Usamah bin Zaid, jinpar Allah ne bhi ehsaan kiya aur maine bhi ehsaan kiya."

e: [AI] Zaid bin Harithah came to complain to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about Zainab bint Jahsh. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Hold on to your family." Then the verse "And you conceal within yourself what Allah is to disclose" [Quran 33:37] was revealed as stated in Sahih al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Zaid bin Harithah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Zainab bint Jahsh ke baare mein shikaayat lekar aaye, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni biwi ko apne paas rakho." To yeh nazil hui: "{Aur tum apne dil mein woh baat chhupaate ho jise Allah zaahir karne wala hai}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 37). Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] When the Prophet ﷺ married Zainab, Umm Sulaim was sent to him with a bowl of food made from stones. Anas said, "The Prophet ﷺ told me, 'Go and invite whoever you meet from the Muslims.'" So, I went and I did not see anyone except that I invited them. Anas said, "The Prophet ﷺ put his hand in the food, supplicated over it, and said, 'Whatever Allah wishes.'" He said, "So they started eating and taking (from the food), and a group remained in the house. The Prophet ﷺ felt shy to ask them to leave and they prolonged their conversation. So, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ left them in the house and Allah revealed, 'O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that (behavior) was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of (dismissing) you. But Allah is not shy of the truth. And when you ask (his wives) for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts.'"
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Zainab se shaadi ki, to Umm Sulaym (RA) ne aik pathhar ke bartan mein khajoor ka halwa bheja, Anas (RA) ne kaha: to Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: "Jao aur jo bhi Musalman tumhein mile use bulaao." To main gaya aur jo bhi mila usse bulaaya. Unhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath khaane mein rakha, uske liye dua ki, aur farmaya: "Jo Allah chaahe." Unhone kaha: to log khaate aur nikalte rahe, aik giroh ghar mein baaqi reh gaya, to Nabi (SAW) unse sharmaane lage aur unhone baaton ko lamba kar diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) khud nikal gaye aur unhein ghar mein chhod diya. To Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aye imaan walo, Nabi (SAW) ke gharon mein na dakhil ho jab tak khaane ke liye ijaazat na di jaaye, aur waqt se pehle (aane ka) intezaar na karo}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 53), ya'ni waqt na dekh rahe hon, yahan tak ke pahuncha: "{Yeh tumhare dilon aur unke dilon ke liye zyada paakeeza hai}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 53).

e: [AI] O Abu Umamah, I saw in my dream that the angels pray upon you every time you enter, every time you leave, every time you stand, and every time you sit. Abu Umamah said, "O Allah, forgive us, and if you wish, the angels will pray upon you." Then he recited, "O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance and exalt Him morning and afternoon. It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful." [Surah Al-Ahzab 33:42]
hi: Aye Abu Umamah, maine khwaab mein dekha ke farishte tumhare liye rehmat ki dua karte hain jab bhi tum dakhil hote ho, jab bhi nikalte ho, jab bhi khade hote ho, aur jab bhi baithte ho. Abu Umamah (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Allah, maghfirat de, humein chhodo, tum log agar chaaho to farishte tumpar bhi rehmat ki dua karengay," phir unhone padha: "{Aye imaan walo, Allah ka bohot zikr karo, aur subah-shaam uski tasbeeh karo, wahi hai jo tum par rehmat bhejta hai aur uske farishte bhi, taake tumhein andheron se roshni ki taraf nikaale, aur woh momino par bohot reham karne wala hai}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 41-42).

e: [AI] "Narrated by Urwah ibn Sariyah, the companion of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'I am the slave of Allah, and the seal of the prophets, and I am preceded by my father Ibrahim's prayer, and the good news of 'Isa, and the vision of my mother Aminah, which she saw.' And likewise, the mothers of the prophets also have visions. And the mother of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saw a light when she gave birth to him that illuminated the palaces of the Levant. Then, Allah recited, 'O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner and one inviting to Allah, by His permission, and as a lamp spreading light.' (Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:46)"
hi: Irbad bin Sariyah (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi, se, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Main Allah ka banda aur Nabiyon mein aakhri hoon, aur mere waalid apni mitti mein padey huay hain, aur main tumhein iske baare mein bataata hoon - main apne waalid Ibrahim (AS) ki dua, Isa (AS) ki bishaarat, aur meri waalida Aminah ke us khwaab ka nateeja hoon jo unhone dekha," aur isi tarah Ambiya ki maaen (khwaab) dekha karti thin, aur beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ki waalida ne dekha ke jab unhone unhein janam diya to aik noor nikla jisse Sham ke mahal roshan ho gaye, phir unhone padha: "{Aye Nabi, humne aapko gawah, khush-khabri dene wala, aur daraane wala banaakar bheja hai, aur Allah ki taraf uski ijaazat se bulaane wala, aur roshan chiraag}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 45-46).

e: [AI] He recited the words of Allah, the Most High: "O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them" [Surah Al-Ahzab 49]. He said, "So divorce is not valid until there is a marriage."
hi: Unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Aye imaan walo, jab tum momin auraton se nikah karo phir unhein chhoone se pehle talaaq de do}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 49), unhone kaha: "To talaaq tab tak nahi hoti jab tak nikah na ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no divorce except after marriage." As for the Hadith of Aisha...
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nikah ke baad hi talaaq hoti hai." Rahi baat Aisha (RA) ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no divorce except after marriage, and there is no manumission except after ownership." As for the narration of Ibn Abbas...
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nikah ke baad hi talaaq hoti hai, aur maalik banne ke baad hi azaadi hoti hai." Rahi baat Ibn Abbas (RA) ki riwayat ki...

e:
[AI] The translation of the given text is as follows:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'There is no divorce for the one who does not possess.'" And as for the hadith of Mu'adh bin Jabal
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiska maalik nahi hua uski talaaq nahi." Rahi baat Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no divorce without marriage, and there is no manumission without ownership." As for the Hadith of Jabir...
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nikah ke baad hi talaaq hoti hai, aur maalik banne ke baad hi azaadi hoti hai." Rahi baat Jabir (RA) ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] I am, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  informed me that Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "There is no divorce for someone who does not possess (anything), and no freeing of slaves for someone who does not possess (anything)."
hi: Main hoon, lekin Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bataaya, Jabir bin Abdullah Al-Ansari (RA) ne unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: "Jiska maalik nahi hua uski talaaq nahi, aur jiska maalik nahi hua uski azaadi nahi."

e: the Messenger of Allah said: “There is no marriage except with a guardian.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1881)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nikah se pehle koi talaaq nahi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ invited me, so I apologized to him, and he forgave me. Allah Almighty revealed [O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives] (Quran 33:50) until [Those [wives] who emigrated with you] (Quran 33:50). She [the wife] said, "So I was not permissible for him. I did not migrate with him. I was among the divorced."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse nikah ka payaam diya, to maine unse maazrat ki, aap (SAW) ne meri maazrat qubool ki, aur Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aye Nabi, humne aapke liye aapki biwiyaan halaal ki hain}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 50) yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Jinhone aapke sath hijrat ki}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 50). Unhone kaha: to main unke liye halaal na hui, kyunke maine unke sath hijrat nahi ki thi, main un logon mein se thi jo (Fatah-e-Makkah ke waqt) azaad kiye gaye the.

e: [AI] He recited the saying of Allah, exalted and glorified be He, "Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet and His angels. O you who have believed, ask [Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace" [Quran 33:56]. Thabit said, Sulayman, the servant of al-Hasan ibn Ali, came to us and narrated from Abdullah ibn Abi Talha al-Ansari, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to us on a certain day and there was a glow on his face. We said, "O Messenger of Allah, we see a glow on your face." He said, "Indeed, the angel came to me and said, 'O Muhammad, your Lord says, would you not be pleased that whenever anyone from your Ummah sends blessings upon you, I send blessings upon him tenfold? And whenever anyone from your Ummah sends salutations upon you, I send salutations back to him tenfold.'" He said, "Indeed, yes."
hi: Unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Beshak Allah aur uske farishte Nabi (SAW) par rehmat bhejte hain, Aye imaan walo, tum bhi unpar rehmat bhejo aur khoob salaam bhejo}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 56), to Thabit ne kaha: "Humare paas Sulaiman, Hasan bin Ali ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, aaye, unhone humein Abdullah bin Abi Talha Al-Ansari se, unke waalid se, hadith bayan ki ke Rasulullah (SAW) aik din khush-khabri unke chehre par zaahir hote huay aaye, humne kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum aapke chehre par khush-khabri dekh rahe hain.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mere paas farishta aaya aur kaha: Aye Muhammad, beshak aapka Rab kehta hai: kya tum isspar raazi nahi ke tumhari Ummat mein se koi bhi tumpar durood bheje magar main uspar das (10) baar rehmat bheju, aur tumhari Ummat mein se koi bhi tumhein salaam bheje magar main use das (10) martaba jawaab doon?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Kyun nahi.'"

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Verily, Allah has angels who travel about the earth, informing me about the greetings of my Ummah." This narration has an authentic chain of transmission, but it has not been narrated by anyone except Al-Thawri. It is well-known from him. As for the narration from Al-A'mash, from Abdullah ibn As-Sa'ib, we have not written it except with this chain of transmission.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ke kuch farishte zameen mein safar karte hain, jo meri Ummat ki taraf se mujhe salaam pahunchaate hain."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Increase your prayers upon me on the day of Friday, for indeed no one prays upon me on Friday except that his prayer is presented to me."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jum'ah ke din mujhpar zyada durood bhejo, kyunke koi bhi Jum'ah ke din mujhpar durood nahi bhejta magar uska durood mujhpar pesh kiya jaata hai."

e: "When a third of the night had passed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood and said: 'O you people! Remember Allah! Remember Allah! The Rajifah is coming, followed by the Radifah, death and what it brings is coming, death and what it brings is coming!'" Ubayy said: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Indeed I say very much Salat for you. How much of my Salat should I make for you?' He said: 'As you wish.'" [He said:] "I said: 'A fourth?' He said: 'As you wish. But if you add more it would be better for you.' I said: 'Then half?' He said: 'As you wish. And if you add more it would be better [for you].'" [He said:] "I said: 'Then two-thirds? 'He said: 'As you wish, but if you add more it would be better for you.' I said: 'Should I make all of my Salat for you?' He said: 'Then your problems would be solved and your sins would be forgiven.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2457)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab raat ka aik chauthaai hissa guzar jaata to khade hokar farmaate: "Aye logo, Allah ko yaad karo, Aye logo, Allah ko yaad karo, Aye logo, Allah ko yaad karo, 'Rajifah' (pehla jhatka) aa gaya, uske peechhe 'Radifah' (doosra jhatka) hai, maut apne sath jo hai le aayi, maut apne sath jo hai le aayi." To Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aap par bohot durood bhejta hoon, to main isme se aapke liye kitna hissa rakhoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jitna chaaho." Unhone kaha: "Chauthaai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jitna chaaho, aur agar tum barhaao to yeh tumhare liye behtar hai." Unhone kaha: "Aadha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jitna chaaho, aur agar tum barhaao to yeh tumhare liye behtar hai." Unhone kaha: "Do-tihaai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jitna chaaho, aur agar tum barhaao to yeh behtar hai." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main isme se sab kuch aapke liye rakh dun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tab tumhari pareshaani ke liye kaafi ho jaayega aur tumhare gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge."

e: [AI] His people had a well which dried up one day, so he went out to wash himself and placed his clothes on a rock. The rock then took hold of his clothes and Moses came out following it, naked, until it reached the gathering of the Children of Israel. They saw him, but no one rushed to cover him. That is what Allah, the Exalted, said: "So Allah cleared him of what they said, and he was honored in the sight of Allah." [Qur'an 33:69]
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Un logon ki tarah mat bano jinhone Musa (AS) ko takleef pahunchaayi}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 69) ayat ke baare mein, unhone kaha: unki qaum ne unke baare mein kaha ke unhein aik jismaani (badan ki) khaas takleef hai, to aik din woh ghusl karne nikle aur apne kapde aik chatan par rakh diye, to woh chatan unke kapdon ko lekar tezi se bhaagi, to Musa (AS) uske peechhe bagair kapdon ke bhaage yahan tak ke woh Bani Israel ki majlison tak pahunch gayi, to unhone unhein dekha aur woh (jismaani khaas takleef se) khaali paaye. Aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{To Allah ne unhein us baat se bari kar diya jo unhone kahi, aur woh Allah ke nazdeek izzat wale the}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 69).

e: [AI] "We offered the trust to the heavens, the earth, and the mountains, but they refused to carry it and were afraid of it. So, man carried it. It was then said to Adam, 'Will you take it and bear its responsibility? If you obey, I will forgive you, but if you disobey, then you shall be warned.' Adam accepted. It lasted no more than the time between the afternoon prayer and the setting of the sun until sin was committed."
hi: "{Beshak humne amaanat aasmano, zameen, aur pahaadon par pesh ki, to unhone use uthaane se inkaar kiya aur usse dar gaye}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 72), unhone kaha: Aadam (AS) se kaha gaya: "Kya tum ise uske sath (zimmedaari) qubool karoge? Agar tumne itaa'at ki to main maaf kar dunga, aur agar tumne na-farmani ki to maine tumhein khabardar kar diya." Unhone kaha: "Maine qubool kar liya." Unhone kaha: to yeh sirf Asr ki namaz se leke suraj doobne tak jitna waqt hota hai utna hi waqt guzra ke unse gunah sarzad ho gaya.

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak humne amaanat aasmano, zameen, aur pahaadon par pesh ki}" ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Amaanat mein se yeh bhi hai ke aurat ko uski sharm-gaah ki hifaazat ka ameen banaaya gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] On the authority of Anas, when Allah says, "We made iron soft and easy to shape" [Surah Saba, verse 11], Anas said, "Luqman was with Dawood (David) as he was hammering a shield. He grabbed it like this with his hand and started to twist it. Luqman was amazed and wanted to ask him but his wisdom prevented him from asking. When Dawood finished, he poured water on his hand and said, 'This is a true shield of war.' Luqman said, 'Silence is from wisdom, and few are those who practice it. I wanted to ask you, but you kept silent until you satisfied me.'" This hadith is reported by Muslim and Al-Bukhari did not report it.
hi: Anas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur humne unke liye loha narm kar diya, (hukum diya) ke mukammal zirahein banaao}" (Surah Saba 11) ke baare mein, Anas (RA) ne kaha: Luqman Dawud (AS) ke paas the jabke woh zirah bun rahe the, woh apne haath se aise moda rahe the, Luqman hairat mein pad gaye aur poochna chahte the, lekin unki hikmat unhein poochne se rokti thi, jab woh (Dawud) usse faarigh huay, to unhone use apne oopar daala aur kaha: "Yeh jung ki kitni achhi zirah hai." To Luqman ne kaha: "Khamoshi hikmat mein se hai, aur ise apnaane wale kam hain, main aapse poochna chahta tha, lekin main khamosh raha yahan tak ke aapne mujhe khud (jawaab) de diya." "Sahih hai Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] In His saying, Glorified and Exalted be He, "And set forth in detail the story of Sad" [Surah Saba, verse 11]. He said, "Do not strike the nails and widen, causing them to loosen, and do not thicken the nails and narrow the throat, causing it to break, but make it an appropriate measure." This is a strange statement in interpretation, and Abd al-Wahhab did not mention it due to its weakness.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur kadiyon ko andaaze se banao}" (Surah Saba 11) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Kelein baarik na rakho ke woh dheeli ho jaayen, aur na hi mote rakho ke kadiyaan tang ho kar toot jaayen, balke isse (durust) andaaze mein rakho." Yeh tafseer mein aik ajeeb (nadir) baat hai, aur Abdul Wahhab un mein se hain jinhein dono ne apni kamzori ki wajah se nahi nikala.

e: [AI] She informs him as Allah Almighty has informed {And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing} [Saba' 12]. When the pumpkin grew, he asked her for what purpose did it grow. She replied, "For the ruin of this mosque." He said, "Verily, the ruin of this mosque will only occur upon my death." So he got up to pray.
hi: To woh use bataayegi jaisa Allah Ta'ala ne khabar di: "{Aur Sulaiman (AS) ke liye hawa, jiski subah ki chaal aik mahine ki thi aur shaam ki chaal aik mahine ki, aur humne unke liye taambe ka chashma bahaaya}" (Surah Saba 12) sab ayaten, jab kharnoob (aik darakht) uga, to unhone usse poocha: "Tum kis liye ugi ho?" Usne kaha: "Is masjid ki barbaadi ke liye." Unhone kaha: "Is masjid ki barbaadi meri maut ke waqt hi hogi," to woh namaz padhne khade ho gaye.

e: [AI] I heard Ibn Abbas say that a man asked the Prophet ﷺ  about Saba', whether it is a man, a woman, or a land. The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "It is a man who had ten children, six of them were born in Yemen and four in Sham. As for the Yemeni people, they are Muz'hij, Kindah, Azd, Ash'ariyyun, Anmar, and Himyar, all of which are good. As for the people of Sham, they are Lakhm, Judham, 'Amilah, and Ghassan."
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko kehte suna: aik shakhs ne Nabi (SAW) se Saba ke baare mein poocha, kya yeh mard hai, aurat hai, ya zameen hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh aik mard hai jiski das (10) aulaad thi, chhah (6) Yemen mein aur chaar (4) Sham mein, rahi baat Yemen walon ki, to woh Madhhij, Kindah, Azd, Ash'ariyyoon, Anmar, aur Himyar hain, sab achhe hain, aur rahi baat Sham walon ki, to woh Lakhm, Judham, Aamilah, aur Ghassan hain."

e: [AI] He asked the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, about Saba, so he said, "O Messenger of Allah, is Saba a man, a mountain, or a valley?" The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "No, it is a man who had ten children. Four of them were Tamim, and six of them were Yamamah, Lakhm, Jadisam, Ghassan, Hamyar, Mudhij, Azd, Kindah, Ash'ariyun, and Anmar. Some descendents of the Anmar tribe are also included." Adh-Dhahabi did not discuss further in his summary.
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se Saba ke baare mein poocha, kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Saba kya hai, aik mard, aik pahaad, ya aik ghaati?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke aik mard jiski das (10) aulaad thi, chaar (4) Sham ki taraf gaye aur chhah (6) Yemen mein rahe, to Sham ki taraf jaane wale Lakhm, Judham, Aamilah, aur Ghassan thay, aur Yemen mein rehne wale Himyar, Madhhij, Azd, Kindah, Ash'ariyyoon, aur Anmar thay, jinme se Bajeelah hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] According to the saying of Allah, "[We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner to all mankind]." (Surah Saba, verse 28) Abu Dhar narrated that he sought the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  one night and found him standing in prayer. He prolonged his prayer, then said, "Tonight, I have been given five things that no Prophet before me was given. I have been aided with fear that strikes the enemy. The distance of a month's journey has been made a safe sanctuary for me. The earth has been made a place of worship and purification for me, and the spoils of war have been made lawful for me - something that was not made lawful for anyone before me. It was said to me, 'Ask, and it shall be given to you.' So, I have stored it up as an intercession for my Ummah. It will be granted to those who do not associate anything with Allah."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur humne aapko sirf sare insaano ke liye khush-khabri dene wala aur daraane wala banaakar bheja hai}" (Surah Saba 28) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: humein Al-A'mash ne, Mujahid se, unhone Ubaid bin Umair se, unhone Abu Dharr (RA) se, hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: "Main aik raat Rasulullah (SAW) ko dhoondhne nikla, to unhein namaz mein khada paaya, aap (SAW) ne namaz lambi ki, phir farmaya: 'Mujhe aaj raat paanch (5) aisi cheezein di gayin jo mujhse pehle kisi Nabi ko nahi di gayi thin - mujhe surkh aur kaale (logon) ki taraf bheja gaya,' Mujahid ne kaha: 'insaan aur jinn,' 'aur meri madad khauf ke zariye ki gayi hai, to dushman mahine bhar ki doori par bhi khauf-zada rehta hai, aur mere liye zameen ko masjid aur paak banaane ka zariya banaaya gaya hai, aur mere liye maal-e-ghaneemat halaal kiya gaya jo mujhse pehle kisi ke liye halaal nahi tha, aur mujhse kaha gaya: \"Maango, tumhein diya jayega,\" to maine ise apni Ummat ke liye shafa'at ke liye chhupaa liya, to yeh us shakhs ko milegi jisne Allah ke sath kisi cheez ko shareek nahi kiya.'" Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "They ask for a response, but it is not the time for a response."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur woh itni door jagah se (imaan ki taraf) kaise laut sakenge}" (Surah Saba 52) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh (dobara mauqe ki) darkhwaast karenge, jabke yeh laut-ne ka waqt nahi."

e: When we relate a report to you, we bring you confirmation of it in the Book of Allah: Indeed, when a servant says, “Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and there is no deity but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest, and blessed is Allah,” an angel takes hold of them, enfolds them beneath his wing, and ascends with them. He does not pass by any gathering of angels with them except that they seek forgiveness for the one who said them, until he brings them before the Face of the Most Merciful. Then ʿAbdullāh recited: “To Him ascends the good word, and the righteous deed raises it.” (Fāṭir 10)
hi: Jab hum tumhein koi hadith bayan karte hain, to hum tumhare paas Allah ki Kitaab mein uski tasdeeq bhi laate hain: beshak jab banda kehta hai: "Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wala ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa tabarakallah," to aik farishta unhein pakad leta hai aur apne par ke neeche samet leta hai, phir unhein lekar oopar jaata hai, jab bhi woh farishton ke kisi jama'at se guzarta hai to woh us kehne wale ke liye maghfirat maangte hain, yahan tak ke woh unhein Rahman ke huzoor mein le aata hai. Phir Abdullah (RA) ne padha: "{Uski taraf achhi baat chadhti hai, aur nek amal use buland karta hai}" (Surah Fatir 10).

e:
[AI] "I accompanied my father towards the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and my father greeted him and we sat for an hour and had a conversation. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked my father, 'Is this your son?' He replied, 'Yes, by the Lord of the Kaaba.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed.' He then said, 'I bear witness to him.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  smiled, delighted by the resemblance between me and my father and by my father's oath about it. Then he said, 'Indeed, your son will neither harm you nor be harmed by you.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse, 'No bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another' [Surah An-Najm: 38] until the end of the verse 'This is a warner of the warners of old' [Surah An-Najm: 56]. 'The chain of narrators is authentic, but they did not mention it in any of their books.'"

(Note: The translation provided is an interpretation of the given text, as it includes some cultural and religious references.)
hi: Main apne waalid ke sath Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf gaya, mere waalid ne unhein salaam kiya, hum thodi der baithe aur baatein kin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mere waalid se poocha: "Kya yeh tumhara beta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Ka'bah ke Rab ki qasam." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Sach mein?" Unhone kaha: "Main iski gawahi deta hoon." To Rasulullah (SAW) muskuraaye, khush hokar mere aur mere waalid ke chehre ki hoobahoo mushabihat aur mere waalid ki us par qasam dekh kar, phir farmaya: "Khabardar, tumhara yeh beta na tumhare khilaaf koi gunah karega aur na tum uske khilaaf." Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Koi bojh uthaane wala kisi doosre ka bojh nahi uthaayega}" (Surah An-Najm 38) yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Yeh pehle daraane walon mein se aik daraane wala hai}" (Surah An-Najm 56) tak. Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "When the Surah of "Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High" was revealed, the Prophet said, 'All of it is in the scriptures of Ibrahim.' Then, when the Surah of "By the star when it descends" was revealed, he continued reciting until he reached the verse "And Ibrahim, who fulfilled [his obligations]" (Surah An-Najm, 37). He then recited until [the verse] "No bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another" (Surah An-Najm, 38) until the verse "This is a warner of the warners of [former] times." (Surah An-Najm, 56)."
hi: Jab "{Apne buland Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh karo}" nazil hui, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh sab Ibrahim (AS) ke sahifon mein hai." Jab "{Qasam hai taare ki jab woh doobta hai}" nazil hui, yahan tak ke pahunche: "{Aur Ibrahim (AS) jinhone (ahad) poora kiya}" (Surah An-Najm 37), farmaya: aur "{Koi bojh uthaane wala kisi doosre ka bojh nahi uthaayega}" (Surah An-Najm 38) unke farmaan "{Yeh pehle daraane walon mein se aik daraane wala hai}" (Surah An-Najm 56) tak.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say regarding His statement, Exalted and Majestic is He, "So among them is one who wrongs himself, and among them is one who is balanced, and among them is one who outstrips in [good] deeds." [Quran 35:32] He said, "The one who outstrips and the one who is balanced will enter Paradise without being held to account, and the one who wrongs himself will be held to a slight account and then enter Paradise." Narrations differ from Al-A'mash in the chain of this hadith, it is narrated from Ath-Thawri from Al-A'mash from Abu Thabit from Abu Ad-Darda, and it is also said from Shu'bah from Al-A'mash from a man from Ta'if from Abu Ad-Darda, and it is also said from Ath-Thawri likewise from Al-A'mash. He said, Abu Thabit mentioned from Abu Ad-Darda, "And when the narrations become many in a hadith, it appears that the hadith has a basis."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To unme se kuch apni jaan par zulm karne wale hain, kuch darmiyaani chaal wale, aur kuch Allah ki ijaazat se neki mein aage badhne wale}" (Surah Fatir 32) ke baare mein farmate suna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aage badhne wala aur darmiyaani chaal wala dono bagair hisaab ke Jannat mein dakhil honge, aur apni jaan par zulm karne wale ka aasaan hisaab hoga, phir woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga." Is hadith ki sanad mein Al-A'mash se riwaayaton mein ikhtilaaf hai, kabhi Ath-Thawri se, Al-A'mash se, Abu Thabit se, Abu Ad-Darda (RA) se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur kabhi Shu'bah se, Al-A'mash se, Thaqeef ke aik shakhs se, Abu Ad-Darda (RA) se, aur kabhi Ath-Thawri se bhi, Al-A'mash se, ke unhone kaha: Abu Thabit ne Abu Ad-Darda (RA) se zikr kiya, "aur jab kisi hadith ki riwaayaten zyada ho jaayen to yeh zaahir hota hai ke hadith ki koi asal hai."

e:
[AI] I said to Aisha, "O mother of the believers, what do you think about the saying of Allah Almighty, 'Then We made those We chose from Our servants inherit the Book. Among them is he who wrongs himself, and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allah. That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty'." [Quran 35:32]

Aisha replied, "As for the one who is foremost, it is the one who lived during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and witnessed his life and provisions. As for the one who is moderate, it is the one who followed in their footsteps and acted upon their deeds until they catch up with them. And as for the one who wrongs himself, it is like me and you, and whoever follows our path, and all of them are in Paradise." This hadith has a sound chain of narration and was not mentioned by As-Salat. An-Nasai said, "He is not trustworthy." Ahmad said, "He is not strong."
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Aye Umm-ul-Momineen, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan {Phir humne Kitaab ka waaris unhein banaaya jinhein humne apne bandon mein se chun liya, to unme se kuch apni jaan par zulm karne wale hain, kuch darmiyaani chaal wale, aur kuch Allah ki ijaazat se neki mein aage badhne wale, yehi bada fazl hai} (Surah Fatir 32) ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai?" To Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Rahi baat aage badhne wale ki, to woh hai jo Rasulullah (SAW) ki zindagi mein guzar gaya, to unke liye zindagi aur rizq ki gawahi di gayi, aur rahi baat darmiyaani chaal wale ki, to woh hai jo unke naqsh-e-qadam par chala aur unke amal kiye yahan tak ke woh unse mil gaya, aur rahi baat apni jaan par zulm karne wale ki, to woh mere jaise aur tumhare jaise hain aur jo humari pairavi karein, aur sab Jannat mein hain." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. As-Salt ko An-Nasa'i ne mo'tabar nahi maana, aur Ahmad ne kaha unme taaqat nahi.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  recited the words of Allah, the Almighty: 'Gardens of Eternity, which they will enter, and where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls' (Quran 35:33). He then said, 'On them will be crowns, and the least of its pearls will illuminate what is between the east and the west.'"
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Hamesha rehne wale baaghaat jinme woh dakhil honge, unhein sone ke kangan pehnaaye jaayenge}" (Surah Fatir 33), phir farmaya: "Unpar taaj hongay, aur unme se sabse choti moti bhi mashriq aur maghrib ke darmiyan roshan kar degi."

e: [AI] "The sadness is fire."
hi: "Gham aag hai."

e: [AI] "Sixty years" with an authentic chain of narration, and it has not been classified as authentic.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Kya humne tumhein itni umr nahi di jismein naseehat haasil karne wala naseehat haasil kar sake}" (Surah Fatir 37) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Saath (60) saal." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "If a person from my Ummah (nation) reaches the age of sixty, then Allah has excused him in his lifespan." This hadith is authentic according to the condition of Imam Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab meri Ummat ka koi aadmi saath (60) saal ki umr ko pahunche, to Allah ne uski umr ke baare mein usse uzr poora kar diya hai." Sahih hai Bukhari ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: “The ages of (the people in) my nation will be between sixty and seventy, and few of them will exceed that.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4236)
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat ki umrein saath (60) se sattar (70) saal ke darmiyan hain, aur unme se kam hi log isse zyada jeete hain."

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Indeed, Allah has excused a servant of His who reaches sixty or seventy years of age. Allah has excused him for his life.'" Adh-Dhahabi remained silent regarding this summarization.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Allah ne us bande ke baare mein uzr poora kar diya jise usne saath (60) ya sattar (70) saal ki umr di, Allah ne uski umr ke baare mein uske liye uzr poora kar diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Indeed, Allah has made excuses for a servant who keeps his faith until the age of sixty or seventy. Allah has made excuses for him." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne us bande ke baare mein uzr poora kar diya jise usne zinda rakha yahan tak ke woh saath (60) ya sattar (70) saal ki umr ko pahuncha, Allah ne uske liye uzr poora kar diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever among my Ummah lives for seventy years, Allah will grant him excuse for his lifespan." It is authentic according to the conditions of both Imam Al-Bukhari and Imam Muslim, although they did not include it in their narrations.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise meri Ummat mein se sattar (70) saal ki umr di gayi, Allah ne uski umr ke baare mein uske liye uzr poora kar diya." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "The young camel was nearly punished in its burrow because of the sin of Adam's son." Authentic in its chain of narration.
hi: "Bill mein rehne wala gobar-bhungaa (dung beetle) Bani Aadam ke gunah ki wajah se apne bill mein azaab ke qareeb aa gaya tha." Sanad sahih hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] "Whoever finds hardness in his heart, let him write Yasin and the Quran with saffron in a goblet, then drink it." - Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "Jise apne dil mein sakhti mehsoos ho, woh 'Yasin' aur Quran (ki aayaten) zaafraan ke sath aik piyaale mein likhe, phir usse piye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.
