e: [AI] The Banu Salamah were in a neighborhood of the city and they wanted to move closer to the mosque. So Allah revealed, "Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind" (Quran 36:12). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called them and said, "Indeed, it is written your deeds." Then he recited the verse to them and they (Banu Salamah) left.
hi: Banu Salamah Madinah ke aik konay mein rehte the, unhone masjid ke qareeb muntaqil honay ka iraada kiya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Beshak hum hi murdon ko zinda karte hain aur unke aage bheje huay amal aur unke nishaan likhte hain}" (Surah Ya-Sin 12), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein bulaawa diya aur farmaya: "Beshak yeh tumhare nishaan (naqsh-e-qadam) likhta hai," phir unhein yeh ayat padh kar sunaayi, to unhone (muntaqil hone ka) iraada chhod diya.

e: [AI] Yasin's companion said, "Oh my people, follow the messengers!" They said, "They want to kill him until he dies." So he turned to the prophets and said, "Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me." (Surah Yasin 36:25) Meaning, bear witness for me.
hi: Yasin waale shakhs ne kaha: "Aye meri qaum, Rusul ki pairavi karo." Unhone kaha: to unhone unhein gala ghont kar maarne ka iraada kiya, to woh Ambiya ki taraf mudkar bole: "{Main tumhare Rab par imaan laaya, isliye meri gawahi sun lo}" (Surah Ya-Sin 25), ya'ni mere liye gawah ban jao.

e:
[AI] Al-Aas ibn Wa'il came to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) with a piece of bone and he broke it and said, "O Muhammad, will Allah resurrect this after it has turned to dust?"

The Prophet (pbuh) replied, "Yes, Allah will resurrect you, cause you to die, and then bring you back to life, and then enter you into the Fire of Hell."

Upon hearing this, the following verses were revealed: "Does man not see that We created him from a mere sperm-drop? Yet, lo! he (stands forth) as an open adversary." (Quran 36:77) until the end of the Surah.
hi: Al-'Aas bin Wa'il Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik purani haddi lekar aaya aur usse toda, phir kaha: "Aye Muhammad, kya Allah isse iske gal jaane ke baad zinda karega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, Allah isse zinda karega, phir tumhein maut degaa, phir tumhein zinda karega, phir tumhein Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil karega." To yeh ayaten nazil hui: "{Kya insaan ne nahi dekha ke humne isse nutfe se paida kiya, phir achaanak woh khula jhagda karne wala ban gaya}" (Surah Ya-Sin 77) Surah ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] "The Angels"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur qataar mein khade hone walon ki qasam}" (Surah As-Saffat 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Farishte," "{Phir sakhti se roknay walon ki (qasam)}" (Surah As-Saffat 2), unhone kaha: "Farishte," "{Phir zikr padhne walon ki (qasam)}" (Surah As-Saffat 3), unhone kaha: "Farishte."

e: [AI] "Abdullah read: 'Rather, you should be amazed, while they mock' [As-Saaffaat 12]. Shurayh said, 'Indeed, Allah is not amazed by anything. Rather, He amazes those who do not know.' Al-A'mash said, 'I narrated this to Ibrahim, and he said, 'Indeed, Shurayh used to be amazed by his own opinions. Abdullah was more knowledgeable than Shurayh, and Abdullah used to recite it as ‘Rather, you should be amazed' [As-Saaffaat 12].'"
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne padha: "{Balke tu ne taajub kiya, aur woh mazaaq udaate hain}" (Surah As-Saffat 12), Shuraih ne kaha: "Allah kisi cheez par taajub nahi karta, balke woh usspar taajub karta hai jo nahi jaanta." Al-A'mash ne kaha: to maine yeh baat Ibrahim ko bataayi, unhone kaha: "Shuraih apni raay se khush ho jaate the, beshak Abdullah (RA) Shuraih se zyada ilm rakhte the, aur Abdullah (RA) ise 'Balke tu ne taajub kiya' hi padhte the."

e: [AI] "Their example is like those who are similar to them."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jinhone zulm kiya unhein aur unke saathiyon ko jama karo}" (Surah As-Saffat 22) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unke misaal (jaisi) log jo unke jaise hain."

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "Whenever a person invites someone to something, he will be held accountable for it on the Day of Judgment. He will be tied to it and it will be brought together with him. Then he recited the verse, 'And they will not be questioned about their sins.' (Surah As-Saafat, 37:24)" This is how Al-Hasan bin Ahmad Al-Tustari narrated it from Ubaidullah bin Mu'adh. If it was permissible for us to accept it from him, we would have done so. However, we verify it based on the condition of the two scholars and we say that its correctness is established.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Koi bhi pukaarne wala kisi aadmi ko kisi cheez ki taraf nahi bulaata magar Qayamat ke din woh uske sath rok kar rakha jaayega, uske sath laazim hoga, uske sath ghaseeta jaayega," phir aap (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Inhein rok lo, beshak inse poocha jayega}" (Surah As-Saffat 24). Isi tarah Al-Hasan bin Ahmad At-Tustari ne isse Ubaidullah bin Mu'adh se riwayat kiya hai, aur agar humein isse qubool karna jaayez hota to hum ise Shaykhain ki shart par sahih maan lete, lekin hum kehte hain ke uska durust (rasta) yeh hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Whoever calls his Muslim brother to something, and even if a man calls another man, he will be held accountable for him on the Day of Resurrection and will be linked to him. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse, 'And prevent them, indeed they are to be questioned' (Quran 37:24)."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Jo apne Musalman bhai ko kisi cheez ki taraf bulaaye, aur agar aik aadmi doosre aadmi ko bulaaye, to woh Qayamat ke din uske sath rok kar rakha jaayega, uske sath laazim hoga, uske sath ghaseeta jaayega," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Inhein rok lo, beshak inse poocha jayega}" (Surah As-Saffat 24).

e: [AI] From the followers of Noah to Ibrahim, following his method and his Sunnah, he reached the age of maturity until his actions were comparable to the actions of Ibrahim. When they submitted to what they were commanded, Allah commanded Ibrahim to present his forehead and he placed his face towards the ground. Ibrahim said, "Do not slaughter me while you are looking at me. Perhaps you will have mercy on me, so do not prepare yourself to slaughter me. Tie my hands to my neck and then place my face on the ground." When he put his hand to slaughter him, the blade did not cut until the call came, "O Ibrahim, you have indeed fulfilled the vision." (Surah As-Saffat, 105) So he held his hand and raised his words, "And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice." (Surah As-Saffat,107) With a great ram that was accepted. Ibn 'Abbas claimed that the sacrificed one was Ismael.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur beshak unki (Nuh AS ki) pairavi karne walon mein se Ibrahim (AS) bhi hain}" (Surah As-Saffat 83) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Nuh (AS) ki pairavi karne walon mein se Ibrahim (AS) hain, unke tareeqe aur sunnat par. Jab woh (beta) unke sath (kaam mein) shareek honay ki umr ko pahuncha, badha yahan tak ke uska kaam Ibrahim (AS) ke kaam ki barabari karne laga, phir jab dono ne uski itaa'at ki jiska unhein hukum diya gaya, aur unhone (Ibrahim ne) unhein maathe ke bal lita diya, unhone (bete ne) apna chehra zameen ki taraf rakha aur kaha: 'Mujhe zibah mat kijiye jabke aap dekh rahe hon, shayad aapko mujhpar reham aa jaaye, isliye mujhpar (jaldi) faarigh na hon, mere haath meri gardan se baandh dein, phir mera chehra zameen par rakh dein.' Jab unhone apna haath unhein zibah karne ke liye daala, to chhuri ne kaat na kiya yahan tak ke pukaara gaya: {Aye Ibrahim, tumne (apna) khwaab sach kar dikhaaya} (Surah As-Saffat 105), to unhone apna haath rok liya, aur unka farmaan buland hua: {Aur humne aik bade zibah ke zariye unka fidya diya} (Surah As-Saffat 107), aik bade, qubool shuda mendhe ke zariye." "Aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ka khayaal tha ke jinhein zibah kiya jaana tha woh Isma'il (AS) the."

e: [AI] "The visions of the prophets are a revelation."
hi: "Ambiya ke khwaab wahi hote hain." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ used to say "His eyes sleep but his heart does not sleep."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) "ki aankhein sotin lekin unka dil nahi sota tha."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited surah Sad on the pulpit. When he reached the place of prostration (in the surah), he descended and prostrated himself and the people prostrated with him. When the next day came, he recited it. When he reached the place of prostration (in the surah), the people became ready for prostration. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: This is the repentance of a Prophet ; but I saw you being ready for prostration. So he descended and prostrated himself and the people prostrated along with him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1410)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne 'Sad' padhi jabke woh mimbar par thay, jab woh sajde tak pahunche to utre aur sajda kiya, aur log bhi unke sath sajda karne lage, jab agla din aaya to unhone use dobara padha, jab woh sajde tak pahunche to log sajda karne ki taiyaari karne lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh aik Nabi ki tauba hai, lekin maine dekha ke tum sajde ki taiyaari kar rahe ho," to woh utre aur sajda kiya, aur log bhi unke sath sajda karne lage.

e: [AI] "I saw in a dream as if I was reciting Surah Sajdah until I reached the Sajdah (prostration) and the inkwell, pen, and everything around it prostrated. So, I informed the Prophet ﷺ  about it, and he performed the prostration."
hi: Maine khwaab mein dekha jaise main Surah 'Sad' shuru kar raha hoon, yahan tak ke main sajde tak pahuncha, to dawaat (siyaahi ka bartan), qalam, aur uske ird-gird ki har cheez ne sajda kiya, to maine yeh baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi, "to aap (SAW) ne bhi ismein sajda kiya." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Abu Talib fell ill, so the Quraysh came. Then the Prophet (pbuh) came, and there was a man sitting at the head of Abu Talib. Abu Jahal stood up in order to prevent him from being near Abu Talib and complained to him. He said, "O cousin, what do you want from your people?" He said, "O uncle, I only want from them a word that the Arabs will be humiliated by, and by which they will pay tribute to the non-Arabs." He said, "One word?" He said, "One word." He said, "What is it?" He said, "There is no god but Allah." He said, "Will you make the gods one god? This is something strange!" So Allah revealed regarding them: "Saad. By the Quran of remembrance. But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the disbelievers say, 'This is a strange thing.'" (Quran 38:1-7)
hi: Abu Talib bimaar hue, to Quraish aayi, aur Nabi (SAW) bhi aaye, Abu Talib ke sar ke paas aik aadmi ki jagah thi, to Abu Jahl khada hua taake use rok sake, aur unhone Nabi (SAW) ki shikaayat Abu Talib se ki, unhone kaha: "Aye mere bhatije, tum apni qaum se kya chahte ho?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye chacha, main unse sirf aik kalima chahta hoon jiske zariye Arab unke taabe ho jaayen aur Ajam unhein jizya (khiraaj) ada karein." Unhone poocha: "Aik hi kalima?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik hi kalima." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "La ilaha illallah." Unhone kaha: to unhone kaha: "Kya inhone (sare) maaboodon ko aik hi ma'bood bana diya? Beshak yeh to badi ajeeb baat hai." Unhone kaha: aur unke baare mein yeh nazil hui: "{Sad, qasam hai naseehat wale Quran ki}" (Surah Sad 1) yahan tak ke pahuncha: "{Yeh sirf aik ghadi hui baat hai}" (Surah Sad 7).

e: [AI] "He descended with the Quran which is full of remembrance. [Surah As-Sa'd, verse 1] In them, referring to the companions of the Prophet Muhammad and their gathering, specifically the gathering of Abu Talib and Abu Jahl, along with the gathering of the people of Quraish when they disputed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "{Sad, qasam hai naseehat wale Quran ki}" (Surah Sad 1) unke baare mein aur unki us majlis ke baare mein nazil hui, ya'ni Abu Talib aur Abu Jahl ki majlis aur Quraish ka unke paas jama hona jab unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se jhagda kiya. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The translation into English for the given Arabic sentence is: "It is neither delusion nor escape, correct in its chain of narration and has not been mentioned in any authentic collection."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur ab bachne ka waqt nahi}" (Surah Sad 3) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh na kood-ne ka waqt hai na bhaagne ka." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] What afflicted Dawood what afflicted him after the decree, except out of wonderment with himself. For he said: "O Lord, there is not a single hour of the night or day except that there is a worshipper from the family of Dawood worshipping You, praying to You, glorifying You, and remembering You." Allah disliked that, so he said: "O Dawood, that was not for anyone other than Me. If it were not for My assistance, you would not have been able to handle it and I would have destroyed you in an instant." Dawood said: "O Lord, inform me of this." So, he was afflicted with the trial on that day.
hi: Dawud (AS) ko jo museebat pesh aayi, woh taqdeer ke baad sirf apne aap par khud-pasandi ki wajah se aayi, aur yeh isliye ke unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, raat ya din ka koi lamha aisa nahi jismein Dawud (AS) ke khaandaan mein se koi ibaadat-guzaar teri ibaadat na karta ho, tera namaz na padhta ho, tasbeeh na karta ho, ya takbeer na kehta ho," aur kuch aur cheezein bhi zikr kin, to Allah ko yeh napasand aaya, farmaya: "Aye Dawud, beshak yeh sab mere hi zariye se tha, agar meri madad na hoti to tum isspar qaadir na hote, aur meri izzat ki qasam, main aik din tumhein tumhare nafs ke hawale kar dunga." Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, isse mujhe khabar de dena." To unhein us din aazmaaish pesh aayi.

e: [AI] "On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: David ﷺ  asked his Lord, 'O Lord, I ask you for your love, the love of those who love you, and the action that will bring me closer to your love. O Lord, make your love dearer to me than myself, my family, and cold water.' The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Whenever David is mentioned and narrated about, it is said, he was the most devout among humans.' This hadith has an authentic chain of narration and was not mentioned by Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Damashqi. These words were said by Ahmad bin Hanbal, who considered them fabricated."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, Dawud (AS) ne kaha: "Aye Rab, main tujhse teri mohabbat, aur un logon ki mohabbat jo tujhse mohabbat karte hain, aur woh amal jo mujhe teri mohabbat tak pahunchaaye maangta hoon, Aye Rab, teri mohabbat ko mere liye mere apne nafs, mere ghar walon, aur thande paani se bhi zyada aziz bana de." Aur Nabi (SAW) jab bhi Dawud (AS) ka zikr karte aur unke baare mein bataate, to farmaate: "Woh insaano mein sabse zyada ibaadat-guzaar the." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Lekin Abdullah bin Yazid Ad-Dimashqi ke baare mein Ahmad ne kaha: "Iski hadithein gadhi hui (fabricated) hain."

e: [AI] "Prophet Dawud ﷺ  suddenly passed away on a Saturday while he used to observe fasting. The birds would gather and shade him." This is according to the narration of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Dawud (AS) Sanicher (Saturday) ke din achaanak faut ho gaye, aur woh Sanicher manaate the, to parinday unpar jama hokar unhein saaya dete rahe." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] He is the devil who used to rule from his throne for forty days, and Solomon had a servant called "Jaradah." There was a dispute between some of her people and his people, so he judged between them with justice, except that he wished for the truth to be in favor of her people. Allah then revealed to him that he would be afflicted with a test. He did not know whether it would come to him from the sky or from the earth.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur humne unke takht par aik jism daal diya}" (Surah Sad 34) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: yeh woh shaitan tha jo unke takht par baithkar chaalis (40) din tak logon ke darmiyan faisle kiya karta tha, aur Sulaiman (AS) ki aik laundi thi jiska naam Jaradah tha, uske kuch rishtedaaron aur uski qaum ke darmiyan jhagda hua, to unhone haq ke mutabiq unke darmiyan faisla kiya, magar unhein yeh khwaahish thi ke haq uski qaum ki taraf hota, to Allah ne unki taraf wahi bheji ke unhein aazmaaish pesh aayegi, aur unhein pata nahi tha ke yeh aasman se aayegi ya zameen se.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Indeed, Solomon, son of David, peace be upon both of them, asked Allah for three things and He gave him two, and I hope that He gave him the third. He asked for judgment that aligned with Allah's judgment and He granted it to him. He asked for a kingdom that no one would have after him, and He granted it to him. And he asked for anyone who leaves his house, desiring nothing but to pray in this mosque, meaning the Masjid al-Aqsa, to be forgiven of his sins as if he was born on the same day." The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "And we hope that Allah has granted him that." Abdullah is the son of Firuz, a trustworthy person.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate hue suna: "Beshak Sulaiman bin Dawud (AS) ne Allah se teen cheezein maangi thin, to usne unhein do di, aur mujhe ummeed hai ke usne unhein teesri bhi di - unhone aisa faisla maanga jo Allah ke faisle ke mutaabiq ho, to usne unhein woh de diya, aur unhone aisi baadshahat maangi jo unke baad kisi ke liye munaasib na ho, to usne unhein woh de di, aur unhone yeh maanga ke jo bhi aadmi apne ghar se sirf is masjid mein namaz padhne ke iraade se nikle," ya'ni Baitul-Maqdis, "to woh apne gunahon se aise saaf ho jaaye jaise us din jab uski maa ne use janam diya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur hum ummeed rakhte hain ke Allah ne unhein yeh bhi de di ho." Abdullah, jo Ibn Firoz hain, mo'tabar (thiqa) hain.

e: [AI] I heard Aisha say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to fast until we would say he would not break his fast, and he would break his fast until we would say he would not fast. And he would recite Surah Banu Israel and Surah Az-Zumar every night. Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) "roze itne rakhte ke hum kehte ke aap roza chhodna nahi chahte, aur roza chhodte itna ke hum kehte ke aap roza rakhna nahi chahte, aur aap har raat Surah Bani Israel aur Az-Zumar padha karte the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: When this surah was revealed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: ʿVerily, you (O Muhammad is) will die, and verily, they (too) will die. Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be disputing before your Lord” (az-Zumar [39:30,31]), az-Zubair said: “O Messenger of Allah, will we face again the disputes we had among us in this world in addition to other sins?” He said: “Yes, you will face these disputes again until everyone who has a right has been given his right.” AzZubair said: “By Allah, the matter is very serious.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1434)
hi: Jab yeh ayat Rasulullah (SAW) par nazil hui: "{Beshak tum maut ke haq mein ho aur beshak woh bhi maut ke haq mein hain, phir beshak tum Qayamat ke din apne Rab ke huzoor mein jhagda karoge}" (Surah Az-Zumar 30-31), maine poocha: "Kya humare darmiyan duniya mein jo hua woh, khaas gunaahon ke sath, humpar dohraaya jayega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, yeh zaroor tumpar dohraaya jayega yahan tak ke har haqdaar ko uska haq ada kiya jaaye." Az-Zubair (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh to bohot sakht maamla hai." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "When this verse was revealed, he mentioned the hadith but did not mention Zubayr in its chain of narration, as it is authentic according to the condition of Muslim and he did not exclude it."
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui, phir hadith zikr ki, aur apni sanad mein Az-Zubair ka zikr nahi kiya. "Sahih hai Muslim ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "We used to say that there is no repentance for the one who is in temptation, and that Allah will not accept anything from him. But when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived in Madinah, the following verse was revealed about them: 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.' (Quran 39:53). Omar then said, 'I wrote these verses and sat on my camel. Then I circled around Madinah, and later on the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  established himself in Makkah, waiting for the permission of Allah to migrate, along with his companions who were among the emigrants. Abu Bakr also waited for the permission to be granted to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  so that he could leave with him.'"
hi: Hum kaha karte the: "Fitne mein padne wale ke liye kaunsi tauba hai, aur Allah usse kuch bhi qubool nahi karega." Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah tashreef laaye, to unke baare mein yeh nazil hui: "{Aye mere bando jinhone apni jaanon par zulm kiya hai, Allah ki rehmat se mayoos mat ho, beshak Allah sare gunah maaf kar deta hai, beshak woh Ghafoor, Raheem hai}" (Surah Az-Zumar 53) aur uske baad ki ayaten. Umar (RA) ne kaha: to maine ise likh liya, phir apne oont par baitha, phir Madinah ka chakkar lagaaya, phir "Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah mein thehre huay Allah ki hijrat ki ijaazat ka intezaar kar rahe the, saath hi apne Muhajir sahaba bhi," aur Abu Bakr (RA) bhi rukey huay Rasulullah (SAW) ko ijaazat milne ka intezaar kar rahe the taake unke sath nikal sakein.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Every inhabitant of the Fire will see his place in Paradise and will say, 'If only Allah had guided me, I would have been among the people of Paradise.' And every inhabitant of Paradise will see his place in the Fire and will say, 'If only Allah had not guided me, I would have been among the people of the Fire.' Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited, '{That will be the time when the self will say, "Oh, how I regret my failure to side with God!"}' (Surah az-Zumar, 39:56)"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jahannam ka har banda apni Jannat ki jagah dekhega aur kahega: 'Kaash Allah ne mujhe hidayat di hoti,' to yeh uske liye afsos ka baais banega, aur Jannat ka har banda apni Jahannam ki jagah dekhega aur kahega: 'Agar Allah ne mujhe hidayat na di hoti (to main yahan hota),' to yeh uske liye shukr ka baais banega." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Kahin koi jaan yeh na kahe: haaye afsos us par jo maine Allah ke maamle mein kotaahi ki}" (Surah Az-Zumar 56).

e: [AI] Abu Al-Muwajjah praised it and Abdullah narrated to Anbasah ibn Sa'id, who narrated from Habib ibn Abi 'Amrah, who narrated from Mujahid, who said that Ibn Abbas told him, "Do you know the vastness of Hellfire?" I said, "No." He said, "By Allah, you do not know that the distance between the lobe of the ear and the shoulder of one of them is a journey of seventy autumns through valleys of pus and blood?" I said, "Are those rivers?" He said, "No, rather valleys." Then he said, "Do you know the vastness of Hellfire?" I said, "No." He said, "By Allah, you do not know. Aisha informed me that she asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the saying of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, 'And the earth altogether will be His handful on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand.' I said, 'Where will the people be on that day, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'On the bridge of Hellfire.'"
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne mujhse poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai Jahannam ki wus'at kitni hai?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "Haan, Allah ki qasam, tumhein nahi pata ke unme se kisi aik ke kaan ki lau aur uske shaane ke darmiyan sattar (70) khareef (saal) ka faasla hai, peep aur khoon ki ghaatiyaan." Maine poocha: "Kya woh nehrein hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke ghaatiyaan hain." Phir unhone kaha: "Kya tumhein pata hai Jahannam ki wus'at kitni hai?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "Haan, Allah ki qasam, tumhein nahi pata. Aisha (RA) ne mujhe bataaya ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan {Aur poori zameen Qayamat ke din uski musht mein hogi, aur aasman uske dayen haath mein lipte huay hongay} ke baare mein poocha, maine poocha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), us din log kahan hongay?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jahannam ke pul par.'"

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ  and his statement in which Allah Almighty said: "And the Horn will be blown." (Surah Az-Zumar 39:68), the Prophet ﷺ  said, "It is a horn that will be blown."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur soor (turahi) mein phoonka jayega}" (Surah Az-Zumar 68) ke baare mein, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh aik seeng hai jisme phoonka jayega."

e: [AI] "She (Aisha) used to say to the wives of the Prophet ﷺ, 'What prevents a woman from giving herself to you?' So Allah revealed this verse regarding the wives of the Prophet ﷺ, 'You can defer whom you will of them, and you may accept whom you will' [Quran 33:51]. Aisha said to the Prophet ﷺ, 'I see that your Lord hurries to fulfill your desires.'"
hi: Ke woh Nabi (SAW) ki biwiyon se kaha karti thin: "Aurat ko apni jaan (khud ko) hiba karne se sharm kyun aani chahiye?" To Allah ne yeh ayat Nabi (SAW) ki biwiyon ke baare mein nazil ki: "{Aap unme se jise chaahen taaqi kar dein aur jise chaahen apne paas rakhein}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 51). To Aisha (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Main dekhti hoon aapka Rab aapki khwahish ke liye jaldi karta hai."

e: [AI] In the words of Allah ﷻ {It is not lawful for you to marry other women after this, nor to replace them} [Al-Ahzab 52], Ibn Jurayj narrated to me from Ata, from Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Aisha, who said, "The Prophet ﷺ did not pass away until Allah made it lawful for him to marry."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Iske baad aapke liye auraten (nikah karna) halaal nahi, aur na hi unhein badalna}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 52) ke baare mein, Ibn Juraij ne kaha: mujhe Ata ne, unhone Ubaid bin Umair se, unhone Aisha (RA) se hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ka intiqaal us waqt tak nahi hua jab tak Allah ne unke liye nikah karna halaal nahi kar diya."

e: [AI] About it, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He passed by Abu Darda while he was building a mosque, so he asked, 'What is this?' Abu Darda replied, 'This is for the family of Hameem.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Ke woh Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ke paas se guzre jabke woh aik masjid taamir kar rahe the, unhone poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh Aal-e-Ha-Meem (Ha-Meem se shuru honay wali Surahon) ke liye hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: In His statement, Glory be to Him, "Our Lord, You caused us to die twice and You gave us life twice" [Surah Al-Ghafir: 11], He said, "It is similar to that which is in Surah Al-Baqarah, 'You were lifeless, then We gave you life; then We caused you to die; then We revived you' [Surah Al-Baqarah: 28]."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aye humare Rab, tu ne humein do baar maut di aur do baar zindagi di}" (Surah Ghafir 11) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh usi jaisa hai jo Surah Al-Baqarah mein hai: {Tum murda (bejaan) thay, phir usne tumhein zindagi di, phir woh tumhein maut degaa, phir zindagi degaa, phir tum usi ki taraf laut kar jaaogay}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 28).

e: [AI] A caller calls out, "O people, has the Hour come to you? The living will hear it and the dead as well. And Allah will descend to the lowest heaven and call out, 'Whose is the sovereignty today?' It belongs to Allah, the One, the Subduer."
hi: Qayamat se pehle aik pukaarne wala pukaarega: "Aye logo, tumhare paas Qayamat aa gayi hai," to isse zinda aur murda dono sunengay, aur Allah duniya ke aasman ki taraf utrega aur pukaarega: "Aaj baadshahat kiski hai?" Allah, Waahid, Qahhar ki.

e: [AI] From a man among the Prophet's companions ﷺ , who heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about retribution, and I didn't hear it. So, I sought a camel and prepared my gear on it, then I traveled for a month until I reached Egypt. I came to Abdullah bin Unais and said to the gatekeeper, "Tell him Jabir is at the gate." He said, "The son of Abdullah?" I said, "Yes." So, he went to him and informed him. He then started to tread on his garment until he came out to me, and I embraced him and he embraced me. I said to him, "There is a hadith that I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about retribution, but I didn't hear it." I feared that I would die or she would die before I heard it. Abdullah said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Allah will resurrect the people naked, barefoot and uncircumcised.' We asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, what does uncircumcised mean?' He replied, 'They will have nothing with them.' Then Allah will call them with a voice that will be heard by those far and near, 'I am the Sovereign, I am the Judge. It is not befitting for anyone from the people of Paradise to enter Paradise, nor for anyone from the people of Hell to enter Hell, and he has something due to him from Me, even to the extent of the strike of a falling leaf.' We asked, 'How is that possible when we come to Allah in a state of destitution and poverty?' He said, 'Through the good and bad deeds.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse, 'Today, every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today!'" [Surah Ghafir: 17]
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik shakhs ne Rasulullah (SAW) se qisaas ke baare mein aik hadith suni thi jo maine nahi suni thi, to maine aik oont khareeda, apni kaathi uspar kasi, phir mahine bhar safar karke Misr pahuncha, main Abdullah bin Unais (RA) ke paas gaya, maine darwaan se kaha: "Unse kaho Jabir darwaze par hai." Unhone poocha: "Ibn Abdullah?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." To woh unke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya, woh apna kapda ghaseethte huay khade huay yahan tak ke woh mere paas nikle, to unhone mujhe gale lagaaya aur maine unhein gale lagaaya, maine unse kaha: "Mujhe aapke baare mein aik hadith pahunchi hai jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se qisaas ke baare mein suni hai jo maine nahi suni, mujhe darr hua ke main ya aap ise sunne se pehle wafaat paa jaayen." To Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Allah bandon ko,' ya 'logon ko,' 'nange, bagair khatna ke, khaali-haath jama karega,' humne poocha: 'Khaali-haath kya hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Unke sath kuch bhi nahi hoga,' phir unhein aisi aawaz se pukaarega jise door wale bhi sunengay jaise qareeb wale sunte hain: 'Main Baadshah hoon, main Insaaf karne wala hoon, Jannat wale mein se kisi ke liye jaayez nahi ke woh Jannat mein dakhil ho jabke uspar Jahannam wale ka koi haq ho, aur Jahannam wale mein se kisi ke liye jaayez nahi ke woh Jahannam mein dakhil ho jabke uspar Jannat wale ka koi haq ho, yahan tak ke main us haq ka badla lekar doon, chahe woh sirf aik thappad hi kyun na ho.' Humne poocha: 'Yeh kaise hoga jabke hum Allah ke paas nange, khaali-haath aayenge?' Unhone kaha: 'Nekiyon aur buraiyon ke zariye,' aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: '{Aaj har jaan ko uske kiye ka badla diya jayega, aaj koi zulm nahi hoga}' (Surah Ghafir 17)." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "There is no god but Allah, so let it be said after it, praise be to Allah, the Lord of all worlds. He intends to say (this), exalted and majestic: 'So invoke Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all worlds.' [Surah Ghafir, Verse 65]"
hi: "La ilaha illallah" kahe, to iske turant baad "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen" kahe, iska ishara Allah Ta'ala ke is farmaan ki taraf hai: "{Isliye usi ko khaalis deen ke sath pukaaro, sab tareef Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke liye hai}" (Surah Ghafir 65).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If a bullet from the sky was sent to the earth, traveling for five hundred years, it would reach the earth before the night. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse {When the iron collars will be around their necks and the chains, they will be dragged In boiling water} [Surah Ghafir 72]."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar isi jaisa aik seesay ka golaa," aur khopdi jitna aik ishara kiya, "aasman se zameen ki taraf bheja jaaye, jo paanch sau (500) saal ka faasla hai, to woh raat honay se pehle hi zameen tak pahunch jaayega," aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Jab unke galon mein tauq honge aur zanjeerein, unhein khaulte paani mein ghaseeta jayega}" (Surah Ghafir 71-72) ayaten.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited an Arabic Quran for a people who understood [Arabic]. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Ismail has been inspired with this language."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Arabi zubaan ka Quran un logon ke liye jo samajhte hain}" (Surah Fussilat 3), phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isma'il (AS) ko yeh zubaan ilhaam ke zariye di gayi."

e: [AI] From his father, with a clear Arabic language, he said, "Speak to them in the language of their tribe." (Al-Shu'ara 195)
hi: Apne waalid se, "{Saaf Arabi zubaan mein}" (Surah Ash-Shu'ara 195) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jurhum ki zubaan mein."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ heard a man recite with a melodious voice, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Guide your brother." It is a sahih (authentic) chain of narration, but it was not recorded in a sahih hadeeth collection.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne aik aadmi ko sunaa jo (galat) padh raha tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne bhai ko raah dikhaao (sudhaaro)." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Learn the Arabic language properly and seek the eloquence of the Quran."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran ko sahih Arabi mein padho, aur uske ajeeb-o-ghareeb (khaas) alfaaz talaash karo."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet, peace be upon him, he said, "On the Day of Judgment, they will come with their lips sealed, and the first thing the person will speak is his foot and his palm."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Log Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayenge ke unke muhon par mohar lagi hogi, aur Bani Aadam mein se sabse pehle baat karne wala uska paut (raan) aur uska haath hoga."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "You will be gathered here, and he pointed with his hand towards Sham (Greater Syria), walking and riding, with your faces exposed and your deeds presented before Allah. And verily, the first one among you to be called upon will be taken by his forelock." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse, "{And you were not hiding yourselves that your ears and your eyes and your skins will testify against you}" [Fussilat 41:22]. (Narrated by Abu Qaz'a Swaid bin Hujayr, a trustworthy person)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhein yahan jama kiya jayega," aur apne haath se Sham ki taraf ishara kiya, "paidal aur sawaar, aur apne chehron ke bal, aur tumhein Allah ke saamne pesh kiya jayega jabke tumhare muhon par mohar lagi hogi, aur tum mein se sabse pehle jo saaf-saaf bolega woh uski raan hogi." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur tum yeh (soch kar) chhup nahi sakte the ke tumhare kaan, tumhari aankhein, aur tumhari khaalein tumhare khilaaf gawahi dengi}" (Surah Fussilat 22). Abu Qaz'ah Suwaid bin Hujair mo'tabar (thiqa) hain.

e: [AI] From the saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Our Lord, show us those who misled us among the jinn and mankind." [Surah Fussilat 41:29] He ﷺ  said, "It is the son of Adam who killed his brother and Iblis."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aye humare Rab, humein woh dono dikha jinhone humein bhatkaaya, jinn aur insaan mein se}" (Surah Fussilat 29) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadam (AS) ka woh beta jisne apne bhai ko qatl kiya, aur Iblees."

e: [AI] What do you say about the saying of Allah Almighty: "Indeed, those who say, 'Our Lord is Allah,' and then remain on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, saying, 'Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.'" [Fussilat 30] And His saying: "Those who believed and did not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided." [Al-An'am 82] Is their belief in injustice a sin? So those who say, 'Our Lord is Allah,' and then remain on a right course without wavering, and those who did not mix their belief with injustice by committing a sin, Abu Bakr said, "You have carried it (this statement) on a different side (other than intended) and then remained on a right course without wavering, and without turning towards any other deity, and without mixing their belief with injustice, meaning with polytheism."
hi: "Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan {Beshak jinhone kaha 'Humara Rab Allah hai,' phir woh sidhe rahe} (Surah Fussilat 30), aur farmaan {Jo imaan laaye aur unhone} (Surah Al-An'am 82) apna imaan zulm ke sath na mila hoga, ke baare mein tumhari kya raay hai?" To unhone kaha: "Jinhone kaha 'Humara Rab Allah hai,' phir sidhe rahe aur mudke na dekha, aur unke farmaan 'apna imaan zulm ke sath na mila hoga' ka matlab hai gunah ke sath." To Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Tumne isse iski asal manzil se hataa kar samjha hai, 'phir sidhe rahe' ka matlab hai unke siwa kisi aur ma'bood ki taraf mudke na dekha, aur 'apna imaan zulm ke sath na mila hoga' ka matlab hai shirk ke sath."

e: [AI] Two men approached the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , and one of them became very angry. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "I know a word that, if he says it, his anger will go away. I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan." The man said, "Do you think I am crazy?" Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse, "And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing." [Surah Fussilat, verse 36].
hi: Do aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke qareeb aik doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage, unme se aik ka ghussa sakht ho gaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main aik aisa kalima jaanta hoon ke agar woh kahe to uska ghussa jaata rahega - 'A'oozu billahi minash-shaitanir-rajeem' (main shaitan-e-mardood se Allah ki panah maangta hoon)." To us aadmi ne kaha: "Kya aap mujhe deewana samajhte hain?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur agar shaitan ki taraf se tumhein koi waswasa aaye, to Allah ki panah maango, beshak woh Sameeh, Aleem hai}" (Surah Fussilat 36).

e: [AI] He used to prostrate at the end of the two verses of Surah As-Sajdah, and Abu Abdur-Rahman, meaning Ibn Mas'ud, used to prostrate at the first of the two verses.
hi: Ke woh "Ha-Meem As-Sajdah ki do aayaton mein se aakhri par sajda karte the, aur Abu Abdur Rahman," ya'ni Ibn Mas'ood, "inme se pehli par sajda karte the."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited: 'Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message [i.e., the Quran] when it came to them. And indeed, it is a noble Book. Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy' [Surah Fussilat, 42]. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, you will not return to Allah with anything more beloved to Him than something that came out of Him,' meaning the Quran."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Beshak jinhone naseehat (Quran) ka inkaar kiya jab woh unke paas aayi, aur beshak yeh aik izzat wali Kitaab hai, isme kisi taraf se baatil nahi aata, na iske aage se na iske peechhe se, yeh Hakeem, Hameed ki taraf se nazil ki gayi hai}" (Surah Fussilat 42), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum Allah ki taraf kisi aisi cheez ke sath kabhi nahi lautoge jo usse zyada aziz ho us cheez se jo usse nikli," ya'ni Quran.

e: [AI] "O you who is in a state of well-being, draw near to Allah with whatever means you are capable of, for indeed, you will not draw near to Him with anything more beloved to Him than His speech."
hi: "Aye fulan, jitna ho sake Allah ke qareeb hone ki koshish karo, kyunke tum Allah ke qareeb kisi bhi aisi cheez se nahi ho sakte jo usse zyada aziz ho uske apne kalaam (Quran) se."

e: [AI] His saying, Almighty and Exalted is He, "The heavens almost break apart from above them," He said, "from the weight."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Qareeb hai ke aasman apne oopar se phat jaayen}" ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Bojh ki wajah se."

e: [AI] "Between Adam and Noah were ten centuries, all of them on the same divine law. But when they differed, Allah sent prophets and messengers and revealed His book, so they became one nation."
hi: "Aadam (AS) aur Nuh (AS) ke darmiyan das (10) nasalein guzrin, sab haq ki shari'at par thin, jab woh mukhtalif ho gaye, to Allah ne Nabiyon aur Rusul ko bheja aur apni Kitaab nazil ki, to woh (pehle) aik hi Ummat thay."

e: [AI] "People, after Adam, fell into polytheism, they took these idols and worshipped other than Allah. So the angels made supplication against them and said, 'Our Lord, You created Your servants and You perfected their creation and You provided for them and You provided them with good provisions. They disobeyed You and worshipped other than You, O Allah. O Allah, they make supplication against them.' So the Lord, the Exalted and Majestic, said to them, 'Indeed, they are in error, so they shall not be excused.' He said, 'Choose two from among you who will descend to the earth and I will order them and they will be forbidden. So they chose Harut and Marut. He said, and the narration mentions their trial and it says, 'So when they drank alcohol and became intoxicated and they fell into unlawful sexual intercourse and they killed a soul, the commotion increased between them and the angels. So they looked at what they were doing and in response to that, (the verse) was revealed, 'And the angels exalt ( Allah) with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth' (Surah Ash-Shura, 42:5). He said, 'So afterward the angels made excuses for the people of the earth and supplicated for them.'
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur us cheez ki jo Babil mein Harut aur Marut do farishton par nazil ki gayi}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 102) ayat ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Aadam (AS) ke baad log shirk mein pad gaye, unhone yeh but banaaye aur Allah ke siwa doosron ki ibaadat ki. Unhone kaha: to farishte unke khilaaf beddua karne lage aur kehte: "Aye humare Rab, tu ne apne bandon ko paida kiya aur unki paidaish achhi ki, aur unhein rizq diya aur unka rizq achha kiya, phir unhone teri na-farmani ki aur tere siwa doosron ki ibaadat ki, Aye Allah, Aye Allah," unke khilaaf beddua karte huay. To Rab Ta'ala ne unse farmaya: "Woh ghaib mein hain (unhein azmaaish nahi hui)," to woh unhein maazoor (excuse) nahi samajhte the, to usne farmaya: "Apne mein se do (farishte) chun lo, main unhein zameen par utaarunga, phir unhein hukum aur mumana'at (kuch aham cheezon se) doonga," to unhone Harut aur Marut ko chuna. Unhone kaha: aur is baare mein tafseel se hadith zikr ki, aur usme kaha: jab dono ne sharaab pi aur nashe mein aa gaye, to unse aik aurat ke sath ghalat kaam ho gaya aur unhone jaan bhi le li, to unke aur farishton ke darmiyan bohot shor macha, farishton ne unhein aur unke amal ko dekha, to isi silsile mein yeh nazil hui: "{Aur farishte apne Rab ki hamd ke sath tasbeeh karte hain aur zameen walon ke liye maghfirat maangte hain}" (Surah Ash-Shura 5). Unhone kaha: to iske baad farishte zameen walon ko maazoor samajhne lage aur unke liye dua karne lage.

e: [AI] "He stood in Arafat and looked at the sun as it was dropping like a shield at sunset. He cried and his weeping intensified. He recited the verse of Allah, the Almighty, from 'Allah is the One who revealed the Book with truth and the Balance. And what will make you perceive that perhaps the Hour is close' (Surah Ash-Shura, 42:17) to 'the Mighty, the Exalted' (Surah Hud, 11:66). His servant said to him, 'O Abu Abdullah, I have stood with you many times, but I have never seen you do this.' He replied, 'I remembered the Messenger of Allah ﷺ standing at this exact place and he said: 'O people, nothing from your worldly matters remains in this world except what remains from this day of yours.'"
hi: Ke woh Arafat mein khade the, unhone suraj ko sipar ki tarah doobta huay dekha, to rone lage aur unka rona sakht ho gaya, aur unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Allah wahi hai jisne Kitaab haq ke sath aur mizaan ke sath nazil ki, aur tumhein kya pata shayad Qayamat qareeb hi ho}" (Surah Ash-Shura 17) yahan tak ke "{Qawi, Azeez}" (Surah Hud 66) tak padha. Unke ghulam ne unse kaha: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, maine aapke sath kai baar (yahan) khada hokar dekha hai, aapne pehle kabhi aisa nahi kiya." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) yaad aa gaye jo isi jagah khade the, unhone farmaya: 'Aye logo, tumhari is duniya se guzre huay hisse mein se sirf itna hi baaqi bacha hai jitna aaj ke din mein se ab tak guzar chuka hai.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited: “Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter, We will increase for him his harvest; and whoever desires the harvest of this world, We will give him of it, but he will have no share in the Hereafter” [Ash-Shura 20]. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah, the Exalted, says: “Son of Adam, devote yourself to My worship; I will fill your chest with richness and I will alleviate your poverty. But if you do not do so, I will fill your chest with preoccupation and I will not alleviate your poverty.”
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Jo Aakhirat ki kheti chahe, hum uski kheti barhaate hain, aur jo duniya ki kheti chahe, hum usse usme se de dete hain, aur Aakhirat mein uska koi hissa nahi}" (Surah Ash-Shura 20), phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Aye Bani Aadam, meri ibaadat ke liye faarigh ho jao, main tera seena ghina se bhar dunga aur teri muflisi door kar dunga, aur agar tum aisa na karo, to main tera seena mashghooliyat se bhar dunga aur teri muflisi door nahi karunga."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whosoever makes all ˹his˺ concerns into one concern (meaning, the concern of the Hereafter), Allah will relieve him of ˹all˺ concerns of his world. And whosoever is indulged ˹only˺ in concerns ˹of this world˺, Allah will not care in which of the valleys of this world he dies."[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apni sari fikron ko aik hi fikr bana le, Allah usse uski duniya ki fikr se bacha lega, aur jiski fikrein bikhar jaayen, Allah use parwaah nahi karega ke woh duniya ki kis ghaati mein halaak ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I do not ask you for any reward for the proofs and guidance that I have come to you with, except that you love Allah and draw near to Him by obeying Him."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumse jo daleelein aur hidayat lekar aaya hoon uska koi ajr nahi maangta, siwaye is ke ke tum Allah se mohabbat karo aur uski itaa'at ke zariye uske qareeb ho jao."

e: [AI] Concerning that, Ibn Abbas wrote that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The most noble among the Quraysh is the one who has the most offspring in his lineage," Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, then said in the Quran, "Say, 'I ask of you for it no payment' (Al-An'am 90) regarding what I am calling you to except that you should love and support my relatives." Hushaim narrated to me and Husein informed me from Ikrimah who narrated it in a similar manner.
hi: Iske baare mein Ibn Abbas (RA) ne likha ke Rasulullah (SAW) "Quraish ke sabse darmiyaani (khaandaan) mein se the, aisa koi qabeela nahi tha jisme unka koi rishta na ho." To Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Kaho: main iske badle koi ajr nahi maangta}" (Surah Al-An'am 90) jis cheez ki taraf main tumhein bulaata hoon, siwaye is ke ke tum mujhse meri tumse rishtedaari ki wajah se mohabbat karo aur isi ki wajah se meri hifaazat karo. Husheim ne kaha: aur mujhe Husain ne, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas (RA) se, isi jaisi khabar di.

e: [AI] "You are the believers and you are the people of Paradise, and by Allah, I truly hope that the majority of those you encounter in Fares and Rome will be in Paradise. For when one of them does good, they will say, "You have done well, may Allah bless you." They will say, "You have done well, may Allah have mercy upon you." And Allah says, "And He answers those who believe and do righteous deeds, and increases them from His bounty." [Surah Ash-Shura 26]"
hi: "Tum momin ho aur tum Jannat wale ho, aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe ummeed hai ke Faaris aur Room mein jinse tumhara saabqa padega unme se aksar Jannat mein hongay, kyunke unme se koi neki karta hai to kaha jaata hai: 'Achha kiya, Allah tumhein barkat de,' 'Achha kiya, Allah tumpar reham kare,' aur Allah farmata hai: {Aur jo imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye, unki dua qubool karta hai aur unhein apne fazl se aur zyada deta hai}" (Surah Ash-Shura 26).

e: [AI] Qatadah praised and recited the words of Allah, the Almighty: "And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills." [Surah Ash-Shura, 27]. Khalid ibn Abdallah Al-Asari reported from Abu Ad-Darda' who narrated from the Prophet ﷺ  that no sun rises except with two angels being sent on either side. They make sure that what they announce can be heard by all the inhabitants of the earth, except the two heavy creatures. O people, come to your Lord, for what He has said and provided in restricted amounts is better than abundance that distracts and misleads. Also, no sun sets except that two angels are sent on either side, calling: "O Allah, bestow quick provision to one who spends generously, and hasten the perishing of one who hoards excessively."
hi: Qatadah ne humein hadith bayan ki, aur Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Aur agar Allah apne bandon ke liye rizq kushaada kar deta, to woh zameen mein sarkashi karte, lekin woh jitna chaahe andaaze se utaarta hai}" (Surah Ash-Shura 27), phir kaha: humein Khulaid bin Abdullah Al-Asari ne, Abu Ad-Darda (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se hadith bayan ki: "Koi suraj kabhi nahi nikalta magar uske dono taraf do farishte bheje jaate hain, woh zameen walon ko sunaate hain, siwaye do bhaari makhlooqon (insaan aur jinn) ke: 'Aye logo, apne Rab ki taraf aao, kyunke jo thoda ho aur kaafi ho woh us bohot se behtar hai jo ghaafil kar de,' aur koi suraj kabhi nahi doobta magar uske dono taraf do farishte pukaarte hain: 'Aye Allah, kharch karne wale ko jaldi badla de, aur rok kar rakhne wale ko jaldi nuqsaan de.'"

e: [AI] No one in Kufa woke up except for the one who is comfortable. Indeed, the lowest among them drinks from the water of the Euphrates and sits in the shade and eats from the land. This verse was revealed specifically about the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , "And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills." [Surah Ash-Shura, 27]. And that is because they said, "If only we had what they have, we would desire the worldly life."
hi: "Kufa mein koi bhi shakhs subah aisi nahi karta jo aaraam mein na ho, unme se sabse kam martaba wala bhi Furat ke paani se peeta hai, saaye mein baithta hai, aur gehun khaata hai, aur yeh ayat sirf Ashaab-e-Suffah ke baare mein nazil hui thi: {Aur agar Allah apne bandon ke liye rizq kushaada kar deta, to woh zameen mein sarkashi karte, lekin woh jitna chaahe andaaze se utaarta hai}" (Surah Ash-Shura 27), aur yeh isliye ke unhone kaha: "Kaash humare paas bhi hota," aur unhone duniya ki tamanna ki.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ʿWhoever commits a sin in this world and is punished therein. Allah is too generous to repeat His punishment of His slave [in the Hereafter], whoever commits a sin in this world and Allah conceals it and pardons him, Allah is too generous to retract His pardon when He has granted it.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 775)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo duniya mein gunah karke uski saza pa le, to Allah is baat se zyada insaaf-pasand hai ke woh apne bande ko dobara saza de, aur jo gunah kare aur Allah usse chhupaa le aur maaf kar de, to Allah is baat se zyada karam wala hai ke woh us cheez ki taraf lautey jise usne maaf kar diya."

e: [AI] Some of his companions entered upon him, and he had been afflicted in his body. So, some of them said to him, "We feel sorry for what has befallen you." He said to them, "Do not feel sorry for what you see, for it has befallen me due to a sin, and Allah forgives much." Then he recited the verse from Surah Ash-Shura (Chapter 42) from the verse "And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned, but He pardons much" until the end of the verse.
hi: Unke kuch sahaba unke paas dakhil huay jabke unke jism mein aazmaaish aayi hui thi, unme se kisi ne unse kaha: "Hum aapke sath jo hua uspar afsos karte hain." Unhone kaha: "Jo tum dekh rahe ho uspar afsos mat karo, kyunke yeh sirf gunah ki wajah se aayi hai, aur jise Allah maaf karta hai woh isse zyada hai." Unhone kaha: phir Imran ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur tumhein jo museebat pahunchti hai woh tumhare apne haathon ki kamaai ki wajah se hai, aur woh bohot kuch maaf kar deta hai}" (Surah Ash-Shura 30) ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] We used to display the Qur'an at Alqama's place, and he recited this verse, "Indeed, in that are signs for those who are certain". Abdullah said, "Certainty is the whole of faith". And he recited this verse, "Indeed, in that are signs for every patient and grateful person". Then Abdullah said, "Patience is half of faith". [Ibrahim 5]
hi: Hum Alqamah ke paas Mus-haf pesh kiya karte the, unhone yeh ayat padhi: "Beshak ismein yaqeen rakhne walon ke liye nishaaniyan hain," to Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Yaqeen poora imaan hai," aur unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Beshak ismein har sabr karne wale, shukr karne wale ke liye nishaaniyan hain}" (Surah Ibrahim 5), unhone kaha: to Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Sabr aadha imaan hai."

e: "On the Day of Uhud, sixty-four of the Ansar were killed, and six from the Muhajirin, one of whom was Hamzah, and they mutilated them, so the Ansar said: 'If, (in the future) we are able to kill them on a day like this, we would mutilate from among them as twice as they (mutilate from among us).'" He said: "So on the day of the Conquest of Makkah, Allah revealed: And if you punish them, then punish them with the like of that with which you were afflicted. But if you have patience, then it is better for those who are patient (16:126). So a man said: 'There shall be no Quraish after today.' But the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Leave the people, except for four.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3129)
hi: Uhud ke din Ansar mein se chausath (64) log aur unme se chhah (6) log, jinme Hamzah bhi thay, shaheed huay, aur unke jism bigaade gaye, to Ansar ne kaha: "Agar humein aisa din phir mila, to hum unse zyada karengay." Jab Fatah-e-Makkah ka din hua, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur agar tum saza do, to usi tarah do jaisi saza tumhein di gayi thi, aur agar tum sabr karo to yeh sabr karne walon ke liye behtar hai}" (Surah An-Nahl 126).

e: [AI] "The straight path is Islam and it is the widest range between the heavens and the earth."
hi: "Seedha raasta Islam hai, aur yeh aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan sabse kushaada cheez hai."

e: [AI] About Abdullah's statement, may Allah be exalted, "And indeed, you [O Muhammad] guide to a straight path" [Surah Ash-Shura, verse 52], he said, "The Book of Allah" on the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur beshak aap seedhe raaste ki taraf hidayat dete hain}" (Surah Ash-Shura 52) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Allah ki Kitaab." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] I said to Ibn Abbas, "Do they make the angels who are the servants of the Most Merciful or the Servant of the Most Merciful?" He replied, "The servants of the Most Merciful." I said, "It is written in my manuscript as the Servant of the Most Merciful." He said, "Erase it and write 'the servants of the Most Merciful'."
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se poocha: "Kya woh farishtay jo Rahman ke bande (jama') hain ya Rahman ka banda (wahid)?" Unhone kaha: "Rahman ke bande." Maine kaha: "Mere Mus-haf mein 'Abdur-Rahman' (Rahman ka banda) likha hai." Unhone kaha: "To usse mita do aur 'Ibaad-ur-Rahman' (Rahman ke bande) likho."

e: [AI] "On the authority of Abdullah, he said, 'They divide the mercy of your Lord.' (Surah Az-Zukhruf, 43:32) Abdullah then said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Indeed, Allah has divided your behaviors amongst you just as He has divided your provisions. Indeed, Allah gives the worldly goods to those whom He loves and those whom He does not love, but does not give the religion except to those whom He loves. So, whoever is given the religion by Allah has indeed been loved by Him."'"
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, "{Kya woh tumhare Rab ki rehmat baantte hain, hum ne unke darmiyan baanti hai}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 32) ayat ke baare mein, Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Beshak Allah ne tumhare akhlaaq ko tumhare darmiyan usi tarah baanta hai jaise usne tumhare rizq ko baanta hai, aur beshak Allah duniya ussey bhi deta hai jise woh pasand karta hai aur ussey bhi jise nahi karta, lekin woh deen sirf ussi ko deta hai jise woh pasand karta hai, isliye jisse Allah ne deen diya, usse usne mohabbat ki."

e: [AI] About Qatadah's saying, "So if We take you away, [O Muhammad], indeed, We will take retribution upon them." [Surah Az-Zukhruf 43:41], Anas narrated, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away, and the punishment remained. Allah did not dislike anything that His Prophet ﷺ  did to his nation until he passed away. There was no Prophet except that he witnessed punishment in his nation, except for your Prophet ﷺ ." [Hadith has a sound chain of narrators, but it was not mentioned in Sahih Al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.]
hi: Qatadah se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Phir agar hum aapko le jaayen to hum unse zaroor badla lengay}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 41) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Anas ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) chale gaye aur azaab baaqi reh gaya, aur Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko unki Ummat mein aisi koi cheez nahi dikhaayi jise woh napasand karein yahan tak ke unka intiqaal ho gaya, aur koi Nabi aisa nahi hua jisne apni Ummat mein saza na dekhi ho, siwaye tumhare Nabi (SAW) ke." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Some of my companions, those of the left, will be taken, and I will say, 'My companions, my companions.' It will be said, 'They have continued to apostatize after you.' So I will say as the righteous servant, 'Isa ibn Maryam, said, 'And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them; but when You took me up, You were the Observer over them.'" (Surah Al-Ma'idah, 117)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere sahaba mein se kuch logon ko baayen taraf le jaaya jayega, to main kahunga: 'Mere sahaba, mere sahaba,' to kaha jayega: 'Yeh log aapke baad hamesha apni eddiyon ke bal (deen se) phirte rahe,' to main waisa hi kahunga jaisa nek banda Isa bin Maryam (AS) ne kaha: {Aur main unpar gawah tha jab tak main unme raha, phir jab tu ne mujhe utha liya, to tu hi unpar nigraan tha}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 117).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "No people have gone astray after being guided except that they were given to argumentation." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited, "{They did not harm you except [for some] annoyance. But they have been disputing people}." [Surah Az-Zukhruf, 58]
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi qaum hidayat ke baad gumraah nahi hui magar unhein jhagda karne ki aadat de di gayi," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Unhone yeh misaal aapke saamne sirf jhagde ke liye rakhi, balke woh jhagdaalu log hain}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 58).

e: [AI] "The Departure of Jesus, the son of Mary"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur beshak yeh Qayamat ke liye aik ilm hai}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 61) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Isa bin Maryam (AS) ka (dobara) aana."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "And indeed, it is knowledge of the Hour" [Surah Az-Zukhruf 61]. Then he ﷺ  said, "The stars are a protection for the people of the heavens, so when they leave, what they were promised will come to them. And I am a protection for my companions, as long as I am with them, what they were promised will come to them. And my household is a protection for my Ummah (nation), so when my household departs, what they were promised will come to them." The chain of narration is authentic, and I believe it is a fabricated hadith.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Aur beshak yeh Qayamat ke liye aik ilm hai}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 61) padha, phir farmaya: "Sitaare aasman walon ke liye amn (ka zariya) hain, jab woh chale jaayenge to unpar woh cheez aa jayegi jiska unse wada kiya gaya, aur main apne sahaba ke liye amn hoon jab tak main hoon, jab main chala jaunga to unpar woh cheez aa jayegi jiska unse wada kiya gaya, aur mera Ahl-e-Bait meri Ummat ke liye amn hai, jab mera Ahl-e-Bait chala jayega to unpar woh cheez aa jayegi jiska unse wada kiya gaya." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala; mujhe lagta hai yeh gadhi hui (fabricated) hai.

e: [AI] You are staying.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur woh pukaarenge: Aye Maalik, tera Rab humara faisla kar de}" (Surah Az-Zukhruf 77) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh unhein hazaar (1000) saal tak jawaab nahi dega, phir kahega: 'Tumhein yahin thehrna hai.'"

e: [AI] "You see the man walking in the markets and his name has already been listed among the dead. Then he recited, 'Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind]. On that night is made distinct every precise matter' [Adh-Dhukhan 4], meaning the Night of Decree. On that night, the affairs of the world are determined for the following year. 'Authenticated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.'"
hi: "Beshak tum us aadmi ko baazaaron mein chalte huay dekhte ho jabke uska naam murdon mein likha ja chuka hota hai," phir unhone padha: "{Beshak humne isse barkat wali raat mein nazil kiya, beshak hum daraane wale thay, ismein har mohkam maamle ka faisla kiya jaata hai}" (Surah Ad-Dukhan 3-4), ya'ni Shab-e-Qadr, to usi raat mein duniya ka maamla agli aisi hi raat tak ke liye tay kiya jaata hai. Sahih ul-isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par sahih.

e: [AI] "The loss of a believer is mourned for forty mornings" - Authentic chain of narration and it has not been excluded from the authentic collection.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{To aasman aur zameen unpar nahi roye}" (Surah Ad-Dukhan 29) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Momin ke intiqaal par chaalis (40) subahon tak." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e:
[AI] The following is the translation of the provided text:

Jaareer (complete sea) the winds swept over their lands, as if they were at an appointed time. Ali asked me, "How did you say, O brother of Bani Tamim?" I replied with a poem and Ali said, "Did you not say, 'How many gardens, springs, crops, and noble places did you leave behind, where you were enjoying fruits? Likewise, we have made them inheritors for another people'" (Quran 44:26). Then he said, "So, my brother, they were inheritors and they became heirs. Indeed, these people denied the blessings, so they were afflicted with punishment. Then he said, 'Beware of denying blessings, lest punishment befall you.'" Abu Hatim said, I asked Muhammad ibn Yazid ibn Sinan, "Did your grandfather Sinan, who was old in age, witness Ali?" He replied, "Yes, he witnessed the events with him."
hi: Jareer (ne yeh shair padha): "Hawaon ne unke gharon ke nishaan mita diye, goya woh (pehle se) waqt muqarrar kar ke gaye thay." Unhone kaha: to Ali (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Banu Tameem ke bhai, tumne kya kaha?" Unhone kaha: to unhone yeh sher unhein dobara sunaaya, to Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Kya tumne yeh nahi kaha: {Woh kitne baagh, chashme, khetiyaan, aur izzat wali jagahein chhod gaye, aur woh ne'matein jinme woh maze le rahe the, isi tarah humne unhein doosri qaum ka waaris banaaya} (Surah Ad-Dukhan 25-28)?" Phir unhone kaha: "Aye mere bhai, yeh log waaris the, phir woh khud maal chhod jaane wale ban gaye, beshak inhone ne'maton ki na-shukri ki, to unpar azaab utar aaya," phir kaha: "Ne'maton ki na-shukri se bacho, warna tumpar bhi azaab aa jayega." Abu Haatim ne kaha: maine Muhammad bin Yazid bin Sinan se poocha: "Kya aapke dada Sinan boodhe the aur unhone Ali (RA) ko paaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, unhone unke sath (jung ke) manaazir dekhe."

e: [AI] She said, "There was Tubba, a righteous man. Don't you see that Allah, the Almighty, has condemned his people but not him?"
hi: Ke unhone kaha: "Tubba' aik neik aadmi tha, kya tum nahi dekhte ke Allah Ta'ala ne uski qaum ki mazammat ki lekin usse (khud) mazammat nahi ki?" Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I do not know if he (the person being followed) was a righteous person or not, and I do not know if Dhul-Qarnayn was a prophet or not, and I do not know if the prescribed punishments are an expiation for those who receive them or not."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata Tubba' la'nati tha ya nahi, aur mujhe nahi pata Dhul-Qarnain Nabi thay ya nahi, aur mujhe nahi pata hudood (shara'i sazayen) unke ahl ke liye kaffaara hain ya nahi."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas asked the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, "In how many days were the heavens and the earth created?" He replied, "Allah created the first day, and the earth was created on Sunday and Monday. The mountains were created, the rivers were split, and fruits were planted on the earth on Tuesday. The sustenance of every land was ordained on Tuesday and Wednesday. Then, Allah rose above the heavens while they were still smoke, and He said to them and to the earth, 'Come willingly or unwillingly.' They both said, 'We come willingly.' He completed them in seven heavens in two days, and He commanded each heaven in its affairs on Thursday and Friday. The last creation was in the latter part of the last hour of Friday. When Saturday came, there was no creation on it. The Jews said about it what they said, so Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to refute their claim, 'Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.'" (Surah Qaf, 50:38)
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Aasman-o-zameen kitne dinon mein paida kiye gaye?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne pehla din itwaar banaaya, aur zameen itwaar aur peer ke din paida ki gayi, aur pahaad paida kiye gaye, nehrein khodi gayin, zameen mein phal lagaaye gaye, aur har zameen ka rizq mangal aur budh ke din muqarrar kiya gaya, phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjeh hua jabke woh dhuaan tha, to usne usse aur zameen se farmaya: {Aao, khushi se ya na-khushi se}, dono ne kaha: {Hum khushi se aate hain} (Surah Fussilat 11), to unhein saat aasman do dinon mein mukammal kiya, aur har aasman ko uska maamla juma'raat aur jum'ah ke din wahi kiya, aur aakhri makhlooq jum'ah ke aakhri ghantoon mein banaayi gayi, jab sanicher (Saturday) ka din aaya to usme koi paidaish na hui, to Yahoodiyon ne isme jo kaha so kaha, to Allah Ta'ala ne unki takzeeb utaari: {Aur beshak humne aasmano aur zameen ko aur jo unke darmiyan hai chhah (6) dinon mein paida kiya, aur humein koi thakaan chhoo bhi nahi gayi}."

e: [AI] A man read near him, "{Indeed, the tree of Zaqqum is the food of the sinful} [Ad-Dukhan 44]." So Abu Darda' said, "Say 'the food of the sinful'." The man said, "The food of the rotten." So Abu Darda' said, "Say 'the food of the wicked.'"
hi: Aik aadmi ne unke saamne padha: "{Beshak Zaqqum ka darakht gunahgaar ka khaana hai}" (Surah Ad-Dukhan 44), to Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ne kaha: "Kaho: 'Ta'aamul-Atheem' (gunahgaar ka khaana)." To us aadmi ne kaha: "Ta'aamul-Yatheem" (yateem ka khaana). To Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ne kaha: kaho: "Ta'aamul-Faajir" (badkaar ka khaana).

e: [AI] Indeed, Allah has three robes: the robe of honor, the robe of mercy, and the robe of pride. Whoever seeks honor from other than what Allah has honored, then that is the one that is said to him, "Taste, indeed you are the mighty, the generous." [Ad-Dukhan 49] And whoever shows mercy to people with Allah's mercy, then that is the one that adorns himself with the garment that is fitting for him. And whoever challenges Allah in His attire that is fitting for Him, then indeed Allah says, "It is not fitting for the one who challenges Me that I admit him to Paradise."
hi: "Beshak Allah ke teen libaas hain - usne izzat ka tehband baandha, rehmat ka jubba pehna, aur kibriyaai ki chaadar odhi, to jo Allah ki di hui izzat ke siwa kisi aur cheez se izzat haasil kare, usi se kaha jaayega: {Chakh, beshak tu (apne khayaal mein) izzat wala, buzurg hai}" (Surah Ad-Dukhan 49), "aur jo Allah ki rehmat ke zariye logon par reham kare, to yehi woh hai jisne apne liye munaasib chaadar odhi hai, aur jo Allah se uski (khaas) chaadar chheenne ki koshish kare jo sirf usi ke liye munaasib hai, to Allah farmata hai: jo mujhse jhagde, uske liye munaasib nahi ke main use Jannat mein daakhil karoon."

e: “O you who believe! Have fear of Allah as is His due, and die not except as Muslims. [3:102] (Then he said): ‘If a drop of Zaqqum were to be dropped on the earth, it would ruin the livelihood of the people of this world, so how about those who have no food other than it (i.e. Zaqqum)?’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4325)
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Allah se aisa daro jaisa uska haq hai, aur maut ke siwa kabhi na aana magar Musalman honay ki haalat mein}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 102), "us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, agar Zaqqum ka aik qatra zameen par tapkaaya jaaye to woh duniya walon ki zindagi barbaad kar de, to us shakhs ka kya haal hoga jiska khaana hi yeh ho?"

e: [AI] "From water, light, darkness, wind, and dust," said the man. "Then from what were they created?" He replied, "I do not know." Then the man went to Abdullah ibn Zubayr and asked him the same question. He replied with the same words as Abdullah ibn Umar, saying, "They were created from water, light, darkness, wind, and dust." The man asked, "Then from what were they created?" So Abdullah ibn Abbas recited, "And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him." The man said, "We had only a person from the Prophet's household saying this."
hi: "Paani, noor, andhera, hawa, aur mitti se." Us aadmi ne poocha: "To yeh (cheezein khud) kis se paida hui hain?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata." Phir woh aadmi Abdullah bin Az-Zubair ke paas aaya aur unse poocha, to unhone Abdullah bin Amr jaisi hi baat kahi. Unhone kaha: phir woh aadmi Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ke paas aaya aur unse poocha: "Makhlooq kis se paida hui?" Unhone kaha: "Paani, noor, andhera, hawa, aur mitti se." Us aadmi ne poocha: "To yeh kis se paida hui hain?" To Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur usne tumhare liye aasmano aur zameen ki har cheez ko apni taraf se musakhkhar kar diya}," to us aadmi ne kaha: "Humein yeh baat sirf Nabi (SAW) ke Ahl-e-Bait mein se kisi aadmi se hi mil sakti thi."

e:
[AI] I heard Sufyan Ath-Thawri reciting the words of Allah Almighty: "Do those who commit evils think that We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge." (Surah Al-Jathiyah 45:21)

Then he said, "I heard Al-A'mash narrating from Abu Sufyan, who narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Every servant will be resurrected upon what he died upon.'"

This was informed to us by Abu Abdullah As-Saffar, who narrated from Ahmad ibn Mihran, who narrated from Abu Nuaim, who narrated from Sufyan, who narrated from Al-A'mash, and he mentioned it.
hi: Maine Sufyan Ath-Thawri ko yeh sunaa, unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Kya woh log jinhone buraiyan kamaayi hain yeh samajhte hain ke hum unhein un logon jaisa bana denge jo imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye, unki zindagi aur maut barabar ho jaaye? Kitna bura faisla hai jo woh karte hain}" (Surah Al-Jathiyah 21), phir kaha: maine Al-A'mash ko Abu Sufyan se riwayat karte suna, unhone Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se, ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har banda usi haalat par uthaaya jayega jispar uski maut hui."

e: [AI] The man from the Arabs used to worship the stone, so whenever he found a better one, he would take it and throw away the old one. Allah, the Almighty, revealed, "Have you seen the one who has taken his desire as his God?" [Surah Al-Jathiyah 45:23].
hi: Arab ka aik aadmi patthar ki ibaadat karta tha, jab usse achha patthar mil jaata to woh usse le leta aur doosra phenk deta, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Kya tumne dekha jisne apni khwahish ko apna ma'bood bana liya}" (Surah Al-Jathiyah 23).

e: [AI] The people of the time of ignorance used to say, "Indeed, time is what destroys us, it is what kills us and brings us to life." Allah responded to their statement, and Az-Zuhri reported from Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyab, who reported from Abu Hurairah, who reported from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, says, "The son of Adam abuses Me. He curses time, yet I am time, for I alter the day and the night. When I wish, I take them both away." Sufyan (another narrator) recited this verse (in response to their statement), "It is not but our worldly life; we die and live, but we will not be destroyed except by time." [Surah Al-Jathiyah 45:24] The two Shaykhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim) have agreed to include this narration without its context, and it is authentic according to their criteria.
hi: Jahiliyat ke log kaha karte the: "Zamana hi humein halaak karta hai, wahi humein maarta aur zinda karta hai," to Allah ne unki baat ka jawaab diya. Az-Zuhri ne, Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat ki, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Bani Aadam mujhe takleef deta hai, woh zamane ko bura-bhala kehta hai, jabke main hi Zamana hoon, main hi uski raat aur din ko badalta hoon, phir jab chaahun unhein khatam kar dun." Aur Sufyan ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Yeh sirf humari duniya ki zindagi hai, hum marte aur jeete hain, aur humein sirf zamana halaak karta hai}" (Surah Al-Jathiyah 24). Shaykhain (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne Az-Zuhri ki hadith ko dusre siyaaq mein nikaala hai, "aur yeh unki shart par sahih hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Allah the Almighty said, 'I borrowed from My servant, but he refused to lend to Me, and he cursed Me, and he does not know what he is saying when he says, 'Waa Dahrāhu, Waa Dahrāhu' and I am the Dahr (Time or Eternity)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Maine apne bande se qarz maanga, usne mujhe qarz dene se inkaar kiya, aur mere bande ne mujhe bura-bhala kaha aur usse pata nahi chala, woh kehta hai: 'Haaye zamana, haaye zamana,' jabke main hi Zamana hoon."

e: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: The son of Adam causes Me pain as he says: Woe be upon the Time. None of you should say this: Woe be upon the Time, as I am the Time (because) I alternate the day and the night, and when I wish I can finish them up. (Using translation from Muslim 2246c)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Bani Aadam mujhe takleef deta hai, kehta hai: 'Zamane ki naakaami,' to tum mein se koi bhi 'Zamane ki naakaami' na kahe, kyunke main hi Zamana hoon, main hi uski raat aur din ko badalta hoon, phir jab chaahun unhein khatam kar dun."

e: [AI] The first thing Allah created was the pen, He created it from light before the creation of the thousand and the letter "lam". The pen shaped itself into a form from light and it was said to it, "Write in the Preserved Tablet." The pen asked, "O Lord, what should I write?" He said, "Write everything that will happen until the Day of Judgment." So when Allah created the creation, He entrusted them to the keepers who would safeguard their actions. Then, on the Day of Judgment, their actions will be presented to them and it will be said, "This is our book that speaks about you with truth. Indeed, We used to record what you used to do." (Surah Al-Jathiyah, 45:29) The two books, the Preserved Tablet and the record of actions, will be presented equally. Ibn Abbas said, "Are you not Arabs? Could the copy (nuskha) be other than a book?"
hi: Sabse pehle Allah ne Qalam paida kiya, use noor se banaaya, jaise aik qalam ki soorat bani, to usse kaha gaya: "Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein chal," usne poocha: "Aye Rab, kya likhoon?" Allah ne farmaya: "Jo bhi Qayamat tak honay wala hai (woh likh de)." Jab Allah ne makhlooq paida ki, to makhlooq par nigraan (farishte) muqarrar kiye jo unke amal mehfooz rakhte hain, jab Qayamat qaayam hui, to unke amal unke saamne pesh kiye gaye aur kaha gaya: "{Yeh humari kitaab hai jo tumhare baare mein haq ke sath bolti hai, hum tumhare kaamon ki naql karte rahe hain}" (Surah Al-Jathiyah 29), dono kitaabein (Lauh aur amaal-naama) pesh ki gayin, to woh dono barabar niklin. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Kya tum Arab nahi ho? Kya 'nuskha' (naql) kisi kitaab ke bagair mumkin hai?"

e: [AI] He is the line.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ya ilm ki koi baaqi maanda cheez}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 4) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh likhaai hai." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] About him, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ya ilm ki koi baaqi maanda cheez}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 4) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Achhi likhaai." Yeh Ibn Abbas (RA) ke farmaan ki aik izaafi riwayat hai, aur is hadith mein ajeeb (nayi baat) hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About Umm Al-Alaa, the Ansari woman who gave her allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , she said: "Uthman ibn Mazh'un used to attend social gatherings with us when the Ansar and Muhajireen would meet. She said, "Then he fell sick, so we took care of him until he passed away. We shrouded him in his burial clothes. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered, and I said, "May Allah have mercy on you, Abu Saa'ib." I bear witness that Allah has honored you. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "What makes you say that?" She said, "I don't know, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "As for him, certainty has approached him, and I hope for him good from Allah." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse: "Say (O Muhammad): 'I am not a new thing (among the Messengers), and I do not know what will be done with me or with you..." (Quran 46:9). Umm Al-Alaa said, "By Allah, I will never praise anyone after him." Umm Al-Alaa said, "I saw a tear running from Uthman's eye while he was asleep. So I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and mentioned it to him. He said, "That is due to his action."
hi: Umm Al-Ala Al-Ansariyah (RA), jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat ki thi, se, unhone kaha: "Jab Ansar ne Muhajireen ki rehaish ke liye qura' (lottery) daala, to Uthman bin Maz'oon humare rehaishi hisse mein aaye." Unhone kaha: to woh bimaar pade, humne unki tabdaari ki yahan tak ke unka intiqaal ho gaya, humne unhein kafan diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) dakhil huay, maine kaha: "Allah aap par reham kare, Aye Abu As-Saib, meri gawahi hai ke Allah ne aapko izzat di." To Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein kaise pata?" Maine kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata, Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahi baat unki, to unke paas yaqeen (maut) aa chuka hai, aur mujhe unke liye Allah se khair ki ummeed hai," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Kaho: main koi naya Rasool nahi hoon, aur mujhe nahi pata mere sath ya tumhare sath kya kiya jayega}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 9). Umm Al-Ala ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, iske baad main kabhi kisi ko paak nahi karungi (bilaa-shak Jannat ka nahi kahungi)."
