Umm Al-Ala ne kaha: aur maine khwaab mein Uthman ke liye aik behta hua chashma dekha, to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur yeh baat unhein bataayi, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh unka amal hai jo unke liye jaari hai."

e: Sa'd sought permission from Ibn 'Amir, and underneath him was a servant made of silk. He commanded her to be lifted up, so I lifted her up and he entered upon him and underneath him was a bed made of straw. He said to him, "You have sought permission on me, and underneath me is a servant made of silk, so I commanded her to be lifted up." She was then lifted up, and he said to him, "Indeed, you are a noble man, O Ibn 'Amir, if you are not among those whom Allah Almighty has described in the Quran saying, 'Have you exchanged the good things of this worldly life for the Hereafter?' And by Allah, lying on hot embers is more beloved to me than lying on it."
hi: Sa'd ne Ibn Aamir se ijaazat maangi jabke unke neeche resham ke takiye the, to unhone unhein hataane ka hukum diya, main ne unhein uthaaya, to woh (Sa'd) unke paas dakhil huay jabke unpar khaz (resham) ka chaadar tha, unhone unse kaha: "Aapne mujhse ijaazat maangi jabke mere neeche resham ke takiye the, to maine unhein hataane ka hukum diya, unhein hataa diya gaya." To unhone (Sa'd ne) kaha: "Tum kitne achhe aadmi ho, Aye Ibn Aamir, agar tum un logon mein se na ho jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {Kya tumne apni duniya ki zindagi mein apni achhi cheezein khatam kar din}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 20), "Allah ki qasam, angaaron par lait jaana mujhe usspar lait ne se zyada pasand hai."

e: [AI] "To buy meat for my family with a dirham, so they threw it to him. Umar said, 'You have eaten what you desired, and you bought it. None of you wants his cousin and neighbor to be deprived of this verse: 'Have you taken your pleasures in the life of the world and forgotten the Hereafter?'" [Surah Al-A'raf (46:20), Qasim Wah].
hi: Apne ghar walon ke liye aik dirham ka gosht khareedna chaaha, to unhone use uski taraf phenk diya, to Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Kya jo bhi tumhein pasand aaye tum use khareed loge? Kya tum mein se koi apne chachere bhai ya padosi ke liye apna pait khaali nahi rakhna chahta, kahin tumse yeh ayat na chali jaaye: {Kya tumne apni duniya ki zindagi mein apni achhi cheezein khatam kar din aur unse faida uthaaya}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 20)?" Al-Qasim kamzor (raawi) hain.

e: [AI] "What Allah sent upon 'Ad from the wind was nothing but the predetermined punishment of my Lord." This hadith is narrated with an authentic chain according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (Bukhari and Muslim). They did not include it in their compilations, but Muslim singled out the narration of Mas'ud ibn Malik according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Allah ne Aad par sirf itni hawa bheji thi jitni meri is angoothi (ke chhed) ke barabar thi."

e: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) laugh fully to such an extent that I could see his uvula. He would only smile, and when he saw clouds or wind, his face showed signs (of fear). I asked him: Messenger of Allah! When the people see the cloud, they rejoice, hoping for that it may contain rain, and I notice that when you see it, (the signs of) abomination on your face. He replied: ‘A’ishah! What gives me safety from the fact that it might contain punishment? A people were punished by the wind. When those people saw the punishment, they said: this is a cloud which would give us rain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5098)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki biwi Aisha (RA) se, unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko kabhi bhi itni khulkar hansta nahi dekha ke unka halaq nazar aaye, woh sirf muskuraate the." Unhone kaha: aur jab woh badal ya hawa dekhte to unke chehre par (fikr) zaahir ho jaati, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), log jab badal dekhte hain to khush ho jaate hain ke shayad ismein baarish ho, aur main dekhti hoon ke jab aap ise dekhte hain to aapke chehre par napasandidagi zaahir ho jaati hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Aisha, mujhe kya yaqeen hai ke ismein azaab na ho, aik qaum hawa se azaab di ja chuki hai, aur (ek waqt) aik qaum ke paas (badal ki soorat mein) azaab aaya tha," aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Jab unhone use apni ghaatiyon ki taraf badhta dekha to kaha: yeh badal hai jo humpar baarish barsaayega}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 24) ayat.

e: [AI] They landed on the Prophet ﷺ  while he was reciting the Quran in the shade of a palm tree. When they heard him, they said, "Listen!" They said, "Silence!" They were nine, one of them was Zoba'ah. Allah (Glorified and Exalted be He) revealed: "And (remember) when We sent towards you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) a group (of the jinn) to listen to the Qur'an..."; until "...clear misguidance", Surah Al-Imran (3:164). It is an authentic Hadith with a sound chain of narrators and they have not reported it.
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas utre jabke aap (SAW) Batn Nakhlah mein Quran padh rahe the, jab unhone sun liya to kaha: "Khamosh raho," unhone kaha: "Chup," aur woh nau (9) thay, unme se aik Zaubaah tha, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur jab humne jinnaat mein se aik giroh ko aapki taraf mutawajjeh kiya jo Quran sun rahe the, jab woh wahan pahunche to unhone kaha: khamosh raho}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 29) ayat, yahan tak ke "{Khuli gumraahi}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 164) tak.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The jinn are of three types: (1) one type has wings and they fly in the air, (2) another type are snakes and dogs, and (3) another type camp ˹at a place˺ and then ˹later˺ move ˹away˺."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jinnaat ki teen qismein hain - aik qism jinke par hain jo hawa mein udte hain, doosri qism saanp aur kutte hain, aur teesri qism woh hai jo (kisi jagah) thehrte hain aur (phir) safar karte hain."

e: [AI] "Those who have gone astray from the path of Allah" [Surah Muhammad 1] He said, "Among them are the people of Mecca" [Surah Muhammad 1] And those who believe and do righteous deeds" [Surah Muhammad 2] He said, "They are the Ansar" [Surah Muhammad 2] He said, "He has corrected their condition" [Surah Muhammad 2] He said, "He has commanded them"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jinhone kufr kiya aur Allah ki raah se roka, Allah ne unke amal zaya kar diye}" (Surah Muhammad 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Inme se Makkah wale hain," "{Aur jo imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye}" (Surah Muhammad 2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Ansar hain," unke farmaan "{Aur unka haal durust kiya}" (Surah Muhammad 2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unka maamla (durust kiya)."

e: "He will be given water of Sadid to drink, he will swallow it..." that the Prophet ﷺ said: " It will be brought toward his mouth and he will dislike it, so whenever it is brought closer to him it will melt his face and the skin of his head will fall into it. Then whenever he drinks from it, his bowels will be severed until it comes out from his anus. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted says: "And they will be given water of Hamim to drink such that it cuts up their bowels..." and He says: "And if they call for drink they will be given water of Muhl which melts the faces, the worst of drinks..." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2583)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur use peep ka paani piya jayega, jise woh ghoont-ghoont kar peeyega}" (Surah Ibrahim 17) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh uske qareeb laaya jayega, to woh usse napasand karega, jab woh uske qareeb hoga to uska chehra jhulsa dega aur uske sar ki khaal gir jayegi, aur jab woh usse piyega to uski aanten katt jaayengi yahan tak ke woh uske peechhe se bahar nikal aayengi." Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "{Aur unhein garam paani pilaaya gaya, jisne unki aanten katt din}" (Surah Muhammad 15), aur Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "{Aur agar woh madad maangenge to unhein aise paani se madad di jayegi jo pighle huay tel jaisa hoga, jo chehron ko jhulsa dega, kitna bura mashroob hai}" (Surah Al-Kahf 29).

e: [AI] I was one of those who were being asked.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Yahan tak ke jab woh aapke paas se nikal jaayen to un logon se poochte hain jinhein ilm diya gaya hai: unhone abhi kya kaha?}" (Surah Muhammad 16) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Main un logon mein se tha jinse poocha jaata tha."

e: [AI] I heard Hudhaifah recite the saying of Allah Almighty: "So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin" [Muhammad 19]. He said, "I used to be a man who frequently insulted my family with my tongue, so I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I fear that my tongue will lead me to the Fire.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'So where are you from seeking forgiveness? Indeed, I seek forgiveness from Allah a hundred times each day.'"
hi: Maine Hudhaifah (RA) ko yeh sunaa, unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{To jaan lo ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur apne gunahon ki maghfirat maango}" (Surah Muhammad 19), unhone kaha: "Main apne ghar walon ke sath tez zubaan wala aadmi tha, to maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe darr hai ke meri zubaan mujhe Jahannam mein daakhil kar de.' To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'To tum maghfirat maangne se kahan ho? Main to Allah se din mein sau (100) baar maghfirat maangta hoon.'"

e: The Prophet [SAW] said: "The best of prayers for forgiveness is for a person to say: 'Allahumma, anta rabbi, la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abuw'u laka bidhanbi, wa abuw'u laka bini'matika 'alayya faghfirli, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta (O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You have created me and I am Your slave and I am keeping my promise and covenant to You as much as I can. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I do. I acknowledge Your blessing and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for there is none who can forgive sin except You.)' If he says this in the morning, believing in it firmly, and dies on that day before evening comes, he will enter Paradise, and if he says it in the evening, believing firmly in it, and dies before morning comes, he will enter Paradise." Al-Walid bin Tha'labah contradicted him. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5522)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maghfirat maangne ka sardaar (sabse behtareen tareeqa) yeh hai ke banda kahe: 'Aye Allah, Tu mera Rab hai, Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Tu ne mujhe paida kiya aur main Tera banda hoon, aur main jahan tak mumkin ho Tere ahad aur Tere wa'de par qaayam hoon, main Tere paas panaah maangta hoon us buraai se jo maine ki hai, main Tere saamne apne gunahon ka iqraar karta hoon, aur main Tere saamne Teri mujhpar ki gayi ne'mat ka iqraar karta hoon, isliye mujhe bakhsh de, kyunke Tere siwa koi gunah maaf karne wala nahi.'" Al-Waleed bin Sa'labah ne isse ikhtilaaf ke sath riwayat kiya hai.

e: I was sitting with Umar ibn Al-Khattab when he heard a scream. He said, "Oh Yarfaa, look, what is this sound?" He got up, looked, and then came back and said, "It is a girl from the Quraysh being sold by her mother." Umar said, "Pray for me, or he said, "Upon me are the Mujahideen (emigrants) and the Ansar." He did not wait more than an hour until the house and the room were filled. Umar praised and thanked Allah, then he said, "Do you know what this was? It was one of the things that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  forbade." They said, "No." He said, "Verily, it has become rampant among you." Then he recited, "Then do you think that if you turned away you could cause corruption on earth and break your ties of lineage?" [Muhammad 22]. Then he said, "And what kind of breaking off is worse than a mother being sold among you, while Allah has granted you a broader scope?" They said, "So do what you find necessary." He said, "He wrote in the horizons that a free woman should not be sold, for it is a breaking off and it is not permissible."
hi: Main Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke paas baitha tha, unhone aik cheekh suni, to unhone poocha: "Aye Yarfa, dekho yeh kaisi aawaz hai?" Woh gaye, dekha, phir wapas aakar bataya: "Quraish ki aik ladki hai jiski maa becha jaa raha hai." Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Mere liye Muhajireen aur Ansar ko bulaao." Unhone kaha: to sirf aik ghadi guzri thi ke ghar aur kamra bhar gaya. Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) ne Allah ki hamd ki aur uski tareef bayan ki, phir kaha: "Ammaa ba'd, kya tumhein pata hai jo Muhammad (SAW) lekar aaye the usme 'qatee'ah' (rishta todna) shaamil tha?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "Beshak yeh tum mein aam ho chuka hai," phir yeh padha: "{To kya tumse yeh ummeed hai ke agar tum hukmraan bano to zameen mein fasaad phailaao aur apni rishtedaariyaan kaat do}" (Surah Muhammad 22), phir kaha: "Aur is se badhkar kaunsa 'qatee'ah' hoga jab tum mein kisi aadmi ki maa becha jaaye jabke Allah ne tumhein wus'at di hai?" Unhone kaha: "To jo munaasib samajhein karein." Unhone kaha: to unhone tamaam ilaaqon mein likh diya ke koi bhi azaad aurat ki maa na bechi jaaye, kyunke yeh 'qatee'ah' hai aur yeh jaayez nahi.

e: [AI] "When the verse 'And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people' [Muhammad 38] was revealed, they asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, who are those people that will replace us if we turn away?' Salman stood beside him and said, 'They are the Persians and their people.'"
hi: Jab "{Aur agar tum mudh jaao to woh tumhare siwa doosri qaum ko tumhari jagah le aayega}" (Surah Muhammad 38) nazil hui, to unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), woh log kaun hain jo hum se mudne par humari jagah le liye jaayenge?" Salman (RA) unke pehlu mein baithe the, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Faaris (Iraani) hain, yeh aur inki qaum."

e: [AI] The Surah al-Fath was revealed between Mecca and Medina regarding the incident of Hudaybiyah, from the beginning to the end.
hi: "Surah Al-Fath Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan Hudaybiyah ke maamle mein, iske shuru se aakhir tak nazil hui."

e: [AI] I heard Mujamma' bin Jariyah saying, "We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from Al-Hudaybiyah until he reached Kuraa' Al-Ghamim. When people were marching towards the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , some of them said to others, 'What is happening with the people?' They said, 'It was revealed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' Then, some people said, 'Let us move until we find the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  standing at Kuraa' Al-Ghamim.' When people gathered around him, he recited to them, 'Indeed, We have granted you a clear conquest.' [Quran 48:1] Some people said, 'Is it a conquest?' He said, 'By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, it is indeed a conquest.'"
hi: Humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hudaybiyah se safar shuru kiya, yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) Kura' Al-Ghameem pahunche, log Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf tezi se badh rahe the, to kuch logon ne aapas mein kaha: "Logon ko kya hua hai?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) par wahi utri hai." To hum tez huay yahan tak ke humne Rasulullah (SAW) ko Kura' Al-Ghameem ke qareeb khada paaya, jab log unke ird-gird jama ho gaye to unhone unhein padh kar sunaaya: "{Beshak humne aapko khuli fatah di}" (Surah Al-Fath 1). To kuch logon ne poocha: "Kya yeh fatah hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh zaroor fatah hai."

e: [AI] Opening of Khaybar, so that Allah may forgive you for what preceded of your sin and what follows. (Surah Al-Fath, 48:2) So they said, "O Messenger of Allah, congratulations to you! But what is for us?" So Allah revealed, "So that He may admit the believing men and believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow." (Surah Al-Fath, 48:5)
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak humne aapko khuli fatah di}" (Surah Al-Fath 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Khaybar ki fatah," "{Taake Allah aapke agle-pichhle gunah maaf kar de}" (Surah Al-Fath 2), to unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapko mubarak ho, humein kya milega?" To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Taake momin mardon aur momin auraton ko aisi Jannaton mein daakhil kare jinke neeche nehrein behti hain}" (Surah Al-Fath 5).

e: [AI] When we returned from Hudaybiyah, the companions of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  were filled with sadness and sorrow as they had sacrificed their animals in their locations. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A verse has been revealed to me that is dearer to me than the entire world." We asked him, "What is it, O Messenger of Allah?" He recited, "Verily, We have given you a clear victory. That Allah may forgive you your sins of the past and the future, and complete His favor on you, and guide you on the Straight Path." (Quran 48:1-2) We said to him, "Congratulations to you, O Messenger of Allah! But what about us?" He recited, "That He may admit the believing men and believing women to Gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and remove from them their misdeeds, and that is, in the sight of Allah, the great success." (Quran 48:5) So, when we reached Khaybar, we saw the fortifications of the enemy, and the soldiers of the Prophet ﷺ  turned back in fear. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Khaybar is destroyed. When we descend upon a people's land, then wretched is the morning of those who have been warned." The narration of Al-Hakam ibn Malik is considered weak because it is only transmitted through martyrdom.
hi: Jab hum Hudaybiyah se lautey, aur Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba gham aur udaasi mein mubtala the kyunke unhone apni qurbaaniyaan apni hi jagahon par zibah ki thin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhpar aik aisi ayat nazil hui hai jo mujhe poori duniya se zyada aziz hai," teen martaba (yeh farmaya). Humne poocha: "Woh kya hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne yeh padha: "{Beshak humne aapko khuli fatah di, taake Allah aapke agle-pichhle gunah maaf kar de, aur aap par apni ne'mat poori kare, aur aapko seedhe raaste ki hidayat de}" (Surah Al-Fath 1-2) do ayaton ke aakhir tak. Humne kaha: "Aapko mubarak ho, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein kya milega?" To aap (SAW) ne padha: "{Taake momin mardon aur momin auraton ko aisi Jannaton mein daakhil kare jinke neeche nehrein behti hain, hamesha usme rehte huay, aur unki buraiyan un se door kare, aur yeh Allah ke nazdeek bohot badi kaamyaabi hai}" (Surah Al-Fath 5). Jab hum Khaybar pahunche, to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke lashkar ko dekha, to woh qile ki taraf bhaagne lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khaybar barbaad ho gaya, jab hum kisi qaum ke aangan mein utarte hain to daraaye gaye logon ki subah buri hoti hai." Al-Hakam bin Malik kamzor (raawi) hain, isse tasdeeqi (shahaadat) ke taur par nikaala gaya hai.

e: [AI] About Ali, who is the one who sent down tranquility in the hearts of the believers. [Al-Fath 4] He said, "Tranquility has a face like the face of a human, then it is a gentle breeze."
hi: "{Wahi hai jisne momino ke dilon mein sukoon (sakeenah) utaara}" (Surah Al-Fath 4) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Sakeenah ka aik chehra hai insaan ke chehre jaisa, phir woh uske baad aik halki, thandi hawa hai."

e: [AI] I asked Ibn Abbas, "What does Allah Almighty mean by 'and offer him aid' [Surah Al-Fath, verse 9]?" He replied, "It refers to striking with the sword in front of the Prophet ﷺ."
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se poocha: "Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan {Aur aap uski madad karein} (Surah Al-Fath 9) ka kya matlab hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ke saamne talwaar se ladna."

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in Hudaybiyah, near the roots of the tree that Allah Almighty mentioned in the Quran. There was a branch from that tree on the back of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so I lifted it off his back. Ali ibn Abi Talib and Suhail ibn Amr were sitting in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said to Ali, "Write." So he mentioned a few lines from the conversation with Suhail ibn Amr. Abdullah ibn Mugaffal said, "While we were like this, thirty young men came out towards us carrying weapons and anger appeared on their faces. The Prophet ﷺ  supplicated against them, and Allah took away their eyesight. We took hold of them and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked them, 'Did you come under the protection of anyone or did anyone give you security?' They said, 'O Allah's Messenger, No!' So he let them go and Allah revealed the verse, 'And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within the area of Mecca, after He caused you to overcome them. And Allah sees what you do.' (Surah Al-Fath, 48:24)"
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hudaybiyah mein us darakht ki jad ke paas thay jiska zikr Allah Ta'ala ne Quran mein kiya hai, aur us darakht ki aik shaakh Rasulullah (SAW) ki peeth par thi, to maine use unki peeth se hataaya, jabke Ali bin Abi Talib aur Suhail bin Amr Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne baithe huay the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali se farmaya: "Likho," phir hadith ke kuch satr zikr kiye jo dono kitaabon (Bukhari-Muslim) mein Suhail bin Amr ke zikr ke sath maujood hain. Abdullah bin Mughaffal (RA) ne kaha: hum isi haalat mein the ke achaanak teesi (30) jawaan hathiyaron ke sath humare saamne nikal aaye aur humare chehron ki taraf jhapatne lage, to Nabi (SAW) ne unke khilaaf dua ki, to Allah ne unki nazrein cheen lin, to hum unki taraf uthe aur unhein pakad liya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Kya tum kisi ke ahd (mansoobe) ke tehat aaye ho, ya kisi ne tumhein amaan di hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, nahi." To aap (SAW) ne unhein chhod diya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur wahi hai jisne Makkah ki wadi mein unke haath tumse aur tumhare haath unse rok diye, iske baad ke usne tumhein unpar ghaalib kar diya, aur Allah jo kuch tum karte ho use dekhne wala hai}" (Surah Al-Fath 24).

e: [AI] About Ali in his statement "And He made obligatory upon them the word of taqwa" (Surah Al-Fath, 26), he said, "There is no god but Allah and Allah is the Greatest."
hi: Ali (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur unhein taqwa ke kalime par qaayam rakha}" (Surah Al-Fath 26) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "La ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar."

e: [AI] "A man read Surah Al-Fath to Abdullah. When he reached the verse, 'Like the example of a seed which grows and produces its shoot, then it strengthens it so it becomes thick and stands upon its own stem,' [Quran 48:29] the man said, 'This is to provoke Allah against the disbelievers with the Prophet ﷺ  and his companions.' Abdullah then said, 'You are the seed, and its harvest is near.' This is a authentic hadith according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim, but they did not include it in their collection."
hi: Aik aadmi ne Abdullah (RA) ke saamne Surah Al-Fath padhi, jab woh is ayat par pahuncha: "{Jaise kisi kheti ki misaal jisne apni kopal nikaali, phir usse mazboot kiya, phir woh mota ho gaya, phir apne tane par seedha khada ho gaya, kisaanon ko khush karta hai taake kaafiron ko unki wajah se ghussa dilaaye}" (Surah Al-Fath 29), unhone kaha: "Taake Allah Nabi (SAW) aur unke sahaba ke zariye kaafiron ko ghussa dilaaye." Unhone kaha: phir Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Tum woh kheti ho, aur uski fasal qareeb aa chuki hai." Yeh hadith Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] About Aisha, Allah says in [Surah Al-Fath 29]: "so that He might infuriate the disbelievers with them." The companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "We were commanded to seek forgiveness for them, but they cursed them."
hi: Aisha (RA) se, "{Taake unke zariye kaafiron ko ghussa dilaaye}" (Surah Al-Fath 29) ke baare mein, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ke baare mein unhone kaha: "Unhein unke liye maghfirat maangne ka hukum diya gaya, to unhein bura-bhala kaha gaya."

e: [AI] "When the verse 'Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness' (Quran 49:3) was revealed, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said, 'By the one who revealed the Book to you, O Messenger of Allah, I will not speak to you except as a secret until I meet Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.' This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim, and he did not include it in his collection."
hi: Jab "{Beshak jo log Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne apni aawazein neechi rakhte hain}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 3) nazil hui, to Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aap par Kitaab nazil ki, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aapse ab sirf raazdaari bhai ki tarah baat karunga yahan tak ke main Allah Ta'ala se mil jaaun." "Yeh hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , it was narrated that he was asked, "O Messenger of Allah, do you see anything that we should do, either something that has been completed or something that we should resume?" He said, "Every person is predisposed to what he was created for." Then Yunus ibn Maisarah approached Sa'id ibn Abdul Aziz and said to him, "If this hadith is confirmed in the Book of Allah Almighty, then what do you say, O son of Halbas?" Sa'id replied to him, "Do you not hear Allah saying in His Book, 'And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided. [Al-Hujurat 8]' So tell me, O Sa'id, if these people were neglected as the fabricators claim, where would they have gone? Where would they go where they were favored and beautified for them, or where they were hated and despised?"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapka kya khayaal hai jo kaam hum karte hain, kya woh aisi cheez hai jo pehle se tay ho chuki hai, ya aisi cheez jo hum naye sire se shuru karte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har insaan usi cheez ke liye taiyaar kiya gaya hai jiske liye woh paida hua hai." Phir Yunus bin Maisarah Sa'eed bin Abdul Aziz ki taraf mutawajjeh huay aur unse kaha: "Is hadith ki tasdeeq Allah ki Kitaab mein hai." To Sa'eed ne unse kaha: "Kahan hai, Aye Ibn Halbas?" Unhone kaha: "Kya tum Allah ko apni Kitaab mein yeh farmate nahi sunte: {Aur jaan lo ke tum mein Rasulullah (SAW) maujood hain, agar woh bohot se maamlon mein tumhari baat maan lein to tum museebat mein pad jaao, lekin Allah ne tumhare liye imaan ko mahboob banaaya aur tumhare dilon mein isse sajaaya, aur tumhein kufr, badkaari, aur na-farmani se napasand karaaya, yehi log seedhi raah par hain, yeh Allah ka fazl aur ne'mat hai}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 8)? Batao, Aye Sa'eed, agar in logon ko yun hi chhod diya jaata jaisa buri-fitrat log kehte hain, to yeh kahan jaate - wahan jahan unhein mahboob banaya gaya aur unke liye sajaya gaya, ya wahan jahan unhein napasand karaaya gaya aur unse bughz dilaaya gaya?"

e: [AI] "O Abu Abdullah, I swear by Allah, I have come to seek your guidance and follow your example in dealing with division among people. I intend to distance myself from evil as much as I can and to ponder upon a specific verse from the Book of Allah that has deeply affected my heart. Please inform me about it. Have you heard the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.' (Quran, Al-Hujurat 49:9)? Tell me about this verse." Abdullah bin Umar replied, "What concern do you have with it? Leave me alone." The man then got up and left. As soon as he disappeared, Abdullah bin Umar came back to us and said, "I cannot find anything within myself that contradicts the meaning of this verse, other than the fact that I have not fought against these rebellious groups as Allah has commanded."
hi: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, Allah ki qasam, main isliye nikla hoon ke main aapki tarah chalun aur logon ke ikhtilaaf ke maamle mein aapki pairavi karun, aur jahan tak ho sake buraai se door rahun, aur main Allah ki Kitaab ki aik mohkam ayat padhna chahta hoon jisne mere dil ko pakad liya hai, isliye mujhe iske baare mein bataayen. Aapka Allah Ta'ala ke is farmaan ke baare mein kya khayaal hai: {Aur agar momino ke do giroh aapas mein larr padein to unke darmiyan sulah karaao, phir agar aik giroh doosre par zyaadti kare to us zyaadti karne wale se laro yahan tak ke woh Allah ke hukum ki taraf laut aaye, phir agar woh laut aaye to unke darmiyan insaaf ke sath sulah karaao, aur insaaf karo, beshak Allah insaaf karne walon ko pasand karta hai} (Surah Al-Hujurat 9), mujhe is ayat ke baare mein bataayen." To Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Tumhein iske sath kya lena-dena hai? Mujhse alag ho jao." To woh aadmi khada hua aur chala gaya, jab woh humari nazron se ojhal ho gaya, to Abdullah bin Umar (RA) humari taraf mudke aaye aur kaha: "Mujhe is ayat ke maamle mein apne dil mein koi khalish nahi hui, siwaye is ke ke maine (afsos se) mehsoos kiya ke maine is baaghi giroh se jung nahi ki jaisa Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe hukum diya tha."

e: [AI] "Some of you stab each other."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur apne aap ko ta'na na do}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 11) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Tum mein se koi doosre par ta'na na kase."

e: [AI] In English, it translates to: "In the pre-Islamic era, titles were used. The Prophet ﷺ called a man by his title from among them, and it was said to him, 'O Messenger of Allah, he dislikes it.' So, Allah, the Almighty, revealed: 'And do not insult one another by offensive nicknames.' (Quran 49:11)"
hi: Jahiliyat mein laqab (buray naam) rakhne ka riwaaj tha, Nabi (SAW) ne unme se aik aadmi ko uske laqab se pukaara, to aap (SAW) se kaha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), use yeh napasand hai." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur aik doosre ko bure laqab se mat pukaaro}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 11).

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Verily, on the Day of Resurrection, Allah Almighty will say, "I commanded you with something, but you abandoned it and I raised your lineages. Today, I will raise my lineage and reduce your lineages. Where are the righteous ones? Where are the pious ones? Verily, the most honorable among you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous among you."
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din farmayega: maine tumhein hukum diya, lekin tumne is baare mein mera diya hua ahad zaya kar diya, aur maine tumhare khaandaani rutbe buland kiye, aaj main apna khaandaan buland karunga aur tumhare khaandaan paste kar dunga, kahan hain muttaqi log, kahan hain muttaqi log, beshak Allah ke nazdeek tum mein sabse zyada izzat wala woh hai jo sabse zyada muttaqi hai."

e: [AI] He (Prophet Muhammad) recited Allah's saying, "Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you" [Al-Hujurat 13]. He then said, "Verily Allah says on the Day of Resurrection, 'O people, I have made lineages and you have made lineages, so I have made the most honorable among you the most righteous among you.' And you refuse to say 'So-and-so is the son of so-and-so and he is more honorable than so-and-so's son.' And indeed, today I elevate my lineage and lower your lineages. Where are the righteous? Where are the righteous?" Talhah said, "Ata' said to me, 'O Talhah, how many names will be called on the Day of Resurrection along with mine and yours?' So when he is called, no one will rise except those whom Allah wills." (The content was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his abridgement)
hi: Ke unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Beshak Allah ke nazdeek tum mein sabse zyada izzat wala woh hai jo sabse zyada muttaqi hai}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 13), phir kaha: "Beshak Allah Qayamat ke din farmayega: Aye logo, maine aik nasab (khaandaan) banaaya aur tumne aik nasab banaaya, to maine tum mein sabse zyada izzat wala usse banaaya jo sabse zyada muttaqi ho, lekin tumne yehi kaha ke fulan bin fulan, fulan bin fulan se zyada izzat wala hai, aur aaj main apna nasab buland karunga aur tumhare nasab paste kar dunga, kahan hain muttaqi log, kahan hain muttaqi log." Talha ne kaha: to Ata ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Talha, Qayamat ke din mere aur tumhare naam par kitne (aur) naam honge, jab pukaara jayega to sirf wahi khada hoga jise (khaas taur par) muraad liya gaya hoga." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "A mountain of emerald encircles the world, upon it lies the canopy of the sky."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Qaf, qasam hai buzurg Quran ki}" (Surah Qaf 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh zamurrad ka aik pahaad hai jo duniya ko ghere huay hai, jispar aasman ke kinare (tike huay) hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  recite in the morning prayer. When he reached this verse, "And by the date-palm trees, bearing clusters of dates" [Quran 50:10], Qutbah said, "I used to say to him, 'What does 'clusters' mean?' He replied, 'Its branches are long.' Muslim reported this hadith without mentioning the explanation of 'clusters' and it is authentic according to its conditions."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Fajr ki namaz mein 'Qaf' padhte suna, jab aap is ayat par pahunche: "{Aur oonchi khajoor ke darakht, jinke gucche taate huay hain}" (Surah Qaf 10), to Qutbah ne kaha: to maine unse poocha: "Iski oonchai kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Iski lambaai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Ma'd is the son of Adnan, son of Addad, son of Zand, son of Barri, son of A'raq Ath-Thara." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited, "He destroyed 'Ad and Thamud and the people of Ar-Rass and many generations in between. None knows them except Allah." Umm Salamah said, "And A'raq Ath-Thara is Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, and Zand is the son of Humaysa', and Barri is Nabt."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko kehte suna: "Ma'ad bin Adnan bin Adad bin Zand bin Al-Baraa bin A'raaq Ath-Thara." Unhone kaha: phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne padha: "{Usne Aad, Thamud, aur Ashaab-ur-Rass ko halaak kiya, aur inke darmiyan bohot si nasalon ko bhi jinhein Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta}." Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Aur A'raaq Ath-Thara Isma'il bin Ibrahim (AS) hain, aur Zand Hameisa hain, aur Baraa Nabt hain."

e: [AI] Regarding this verse: "Not a word does he utter but there is a watcher by him ready" [Quran 50:18], Ibn Abbas said: "Only the good and the evil are written. O boy, saddle the horse for me and O boy, give me water to drink. Only the good and the evil are written."
hi: Unse is ayat "{Woh koi baat munh se nahi nikaalta magar uske paas aik nigraan (farishta) taiyaar hai}" (Surah Qaf 18) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Sirf neki aur buraai likhi jaati hai, 'Aye ghulam, ghode par zeen kaso' ya 'Aye ghulam, mujhe paani pilaao' jaisi baatein nahi likhi jaatin, sirf neki aur buraai likhi jaati hai."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad narrating and reciting the words of Allah ﷻ: {And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.} [Qaf 19] Then he said, Aisha, the Mother of the Believers, told me: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was on his deathbed. He had a cup containing water, and he used to dip his hand into the cup and then wipe his face with the water, saying, "O Allah, help me with the throes of death."
hi: Maine Al-Qasim bin Muhammad ko yeh hadith bayan karte suna, unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Aur maut ki behoshi haq ke sath aa gayi, yehi woh cheez hai jisse tu bhaagta tha}" (Surah Qaf 19), phir kaha: mujhe Aisha (RA), Umm-ul-Momineen, ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko maut ke waqt dekha, unke paas paani se bhara aik pyaala tha, woh apna haath us pyaale mein daalte, phir apne chehre par paani pherte, phir kehte: 'Aye Allah, mujhe maut ki sakhtiyon mein madad de.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am the first from whom the Earth will split, then Abu Bakr, then Umar, then the people of Baqi' will be gathered with me, and then I will wait for the people of Makkah." Abdullah ibn Umar recited, "On the day the Earth will split open for them, it will be an easy gathering for us."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main sabse pehla hoon jiske liye zameen phategi, phir Abu Bakr, phir Umar, phir main Baqi' walon ke paas aaunga, to woh mere sath jama kiye jaayenge, phir main Makkah walon ka intezaar karunga." Aur Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne padha: "{Jis din zameen unke liye tezi se phategi, yeh hashr (jama'a) humare liye aasaan hai}".

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  came to a man whose facial features showed signs of worry. He said to him, "Relax, for I am the son of a woman from the Quraysh tribe who used to eat dried meat in this barren land." Then, Jareer ibn Abdullah al-Bajali recited the verse, "And you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat." (Quran 45:18)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas aik aadmi laaya gaya jiske jism ke hisse thar-thar kaanp rahe the, aap (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Aasaan lo, main sirf Quraish ki aik aisi aurat ka beta hoon jo is Batha (Makkah ki wadi) mein sookha gosht khaaya karti thi." Unhone kaha: phir Jareer bin Abdullah Al-Bajali (RA) ne yeh padha: "{Aur aap unpar zabardasti karne wale nahi hain, isliye Quran ke zariye us shakhs ko naseehat karein jo meri tambeeh se dare}" (Surah Qaf 45).

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to visit the sick, attend funerals, accept the invitations of slaves and ride donkeys. On the day (of the battle) of Quraizah and Nadir, he was riding a donkey. On the day of Khaibar he was riding a donkey that was bridled with palmfibers and beneath him was a packsaddle made of palmfibers.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4178)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "bimaar ki ayaadat karte, janaazon mein shaamil hote, ghulam ki dawat qubool karte, aur gadhe par sawaar hote, aur woh Khaybar aur Qurayzah ke din aisay gadhe par thay jiski lagaam khajoor ke reshon ki rassi thi aur jiske neeche khajoor ke reshon ka zeen (kaathi) tha."

e: [AI] The translation into English is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to visit and visit the weak Muslims, go to their sick and witness their funerals.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) "kamzor Musalmano ke paas jaate, unse milne jaate, unke bimaaron ki ayaadat karte, aur unke janaazon mein shaamil hote."

e: [AI] I saw the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib, standing on the pulpit. He said, "Ask me before you are unable to ask me, and you will not ask anyone like me after me." Then Ibn Al-Kawwa stood up and asked, "O Commander of the Faithful, what is {By those [winds] scattering [dust]} [Al-Dhariyat 1]?" He said, "The winds." He asked, "What is {And those [clouds] carrying a load}?" He said, "The clouds." He asked, "What is {And those [ships] sailing with ease}?" He said, "The ships." He asked, "What is {And those [angels] apportioning each matter}?" He said, "The angels." He then asked, "Who are {the ones who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people in the home of ruin, Hell} [Ibrahim 28]?" He said, "The hypocrites of Quraysh."
hi: Maine Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ko mimbar par khade huay dekha, unhone farmaya: "Mujhse poocho isse pehle ke tum mujhse na poochh sako, aur mere baad tum mujhse behtar kisi se nahi poochh sakoge." Unhone kaha: to Ibn Al-Kawwa khada hua aur poocha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, {Bikharne wali hawaon ki qasam} (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 1) kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Hawaen." Usne poocha: "To {bojh uthaane wale} kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Baadal." Usne poocha: "To {aasaani se chalne wale} kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Kashtiyaan." Usne poocha: "To {maamlon ko baantne wale} kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Farishte." Usne poocha: "To woh kaun hain {jinhone Allah ki ne'mat ko kufr se badla, aur apni qaum ko halaakat ke ghar mein utaara, Jahannam mein}" (Surah Ibrahim 28)? Unhone kaha: "Quraish ke munafiqeen."

e: [AI] Anas said regarding this verse: "They used to sleep very little during the night." [Adh-Dhariyat 17] He said, "They used to pray between 'Isha' (night prayer) and Maghrib (sunset prayer)."
hi: Anas se, is ayat "{Woh raat ka thoda hissa sote the}" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 17) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh Isha aur Maghrib ke darmiyan namaz padhte the."

e: [AI] In His saying ﷻ {They used to sleep but little of the night} [Al-Dhariyat 17], it is said: "Not a night passes by them without praying in it until morning comes."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Woh raat ka thoda hissa sote the}" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 17) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unpar koi raat nahi guzarti jismein woh sote hon, magar woh subah tak usme namaz padhte rehte the."

e: [AI] One of the prayers of the Prophet ﷺ  was: "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of the wind and from the evil that comes with the wind, and from the wind of the north, for it is the barren wind."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki dua'on mein se yeh bhi tha: "Aye Allah, main hawa ki buraai se, aur jo hawa lekar aaye uski buraai se, aur shimaal (uttar) ki hawa se Teri panaah maangta hoon, kyunke woh baanjh (be-asar) hawa hai."

e:
[AI] The passage translates to English as follows:
In His saying, Almighty Allah, {And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.} [Al-Dhariyat 41], it is said, "the one that does not fertilize anything."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Aad mein (nishaani hai) jab humne unpar baanjh (aqeem) hawa bheji}" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 41) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jo kisi cheez ko baar-aawar (barkat wala) nahi karti."

e: [AI] "Jabal" translates to "mountain" in English.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Toor ki qasam}" (Surah At-Tur 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Aik pahaad."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "The inhabited house in the seventh heaven is entered by seventy thousand angels every day, and they will never return to it until the Day of Judgment."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Bait-ul-Ma'moor saatwe aasman mein hai, isme har din sattar hazaar (70,000) farishte dakhil hote hain, aur woh Qayamat tak wapas nahi aate."

e: [AI] "The sky"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur buland chhat ki (qasam)}" (Surah At-Tur 5) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Aasman."

e: [AI] "Indeed, Allah raises the ranks of the believing offspring with Him in Paradise, even if they are lower in deeds than Him." Then He recited: "And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything." (Surah At-Tur, 21) He (Al-Dhahabi) did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Humne unki aulaad unse mila di, aur humne unka kuch bhi kam nahi kiya}" (Surah At-Tur 21) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Beshak Allah momin ki aulaad ko Jannat mein uske sath, uske darje mein hi uthaata hai, agarche woh amal mein usse kam hon," phir unhone padha: "{Aur jo imaan laaye, aur unki aulaad imaan ke sath unki pairavi ki, humne unki aulaad unse mila di, aur humne unka kuch bhi kam nahi kiya}" (Surah At-Tur 21), ya'ni "humne unhein kam nahi kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ prostrated in it, meaning the Night of Al-Qadr, and the Muslims prostrated in it, as well as the polytheists, humans, and jinn." This is confirmed as authentic according to Al-Bukhari's criteria, and it is not excluded by this context according to the criteria of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne "ismein sajda kiya," ya'ni Surah An-Najm mein, "aur ismein Musalmano aur mushrikeen, insaano aur jinnaat ne bhi sajda kiya." Sahih hai Bukhari ki shart par, dono ne ise is siyaaq mein nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] About Abdullah's statement, may Allah be exalted, {The heart did not lie about what it saw} [Surah An-Najm: 11], he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw Gabriel in a form with his wings that filled the space between the heavens and the earth." This statement is considered authentic according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but they didn't include it in their collections.
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Dil ne jhoot nahi kaha jo usne dekha}" (Surah An-Najm 11) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Jibra'il (AS) ko aik par-daar (rafraf) libaas mein dekha jo aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan ki jagah bhar chuka tha." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "To be the companion for Ibrahim, the speech for Musa, and the vision for Muhammad ﷺ , and the blessings of Allah be upon them all."
hi: "Ke khaleel (khaas dosti) Ibrahim (AS) ke liye ho, aur kalaam (seedhi baat-cheet) Musa (AS) ke liye, aur roo'yat (deedaar) Muhammad (SAW) ke liye," Allah ki rehmatein un sab par ho.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary is of colossal size where a traveler would need one hundred years to cross the shade of its branches. It provides shade for a hundred riders and it has bed of gold."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ka wasf bayan karte suna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sawaar iski aik shaakh mein sau (100) saal safar kare, uski aik shaakh ke saaye mein sau (100) sawaar bhi (samaa) sakein, ismein sone ke titliyan (jaisi cheezein) hain."

e: [AI] "He did not go right or left" {and he did not transgress} [Surah An-Najm 17] He said, "He did not exceed."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Nazar na to bhatki}" (Surah An-Najm 17) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Na dayen gayi na baayen," "{Aur na hadd se guzri}" (Surah An-Najm 17), unhone kaha: "Na tajaawuz kiya."

e: from Ibn 'Abbas (regarding this Ayah): Those who avoid great sins and Al-Fawahish except Al-Lamam (minor sins) (53:32). He said: "The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Your forgiveness, O Allah is so ample, and which of Your worshipers has not committed Al-Lamam (minor sins)!'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3284)
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jo bade gunahon aur besharmi ke kaamon se bachte hain, siwaye chhote-mote lagzishon (lamam) ke}" (Surah An-Najm 32) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh usme mubtala hota hai, phir usse tauba kar leta hai." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) kaha karte the: "Aye Allah, agar tu maaf kare to bohot maaf karega, aur tera koi bhi banda aisa nahi jisse (chhoti) lagzish na hui ho."

e: [AI] Ishaq narrated from Abdul Razzaq, who narrated from Ma'mar, who narrated from Al-A'mash, who narrated from Abu Ad-Duha, who narrated from Masruq, that Ibn Mas'ud said regarding the verse {except for the occasional glance} [An-Najm 32]. He said, "Adultery of the eyes is looking, adultery of the lips is kissing, adultery of the hands is touching, adultery of the legs is walking, and the private parts either confirm or deny it. If one proceeds with his private part, then he is committing adultery. Otherwise, it is 'the occasional glance'."
hi: Ishaq ne humein hadith bayan ki, Abdur Razzaq ne humein khabar di, Ma'mar ne, Al-A'mash se, unhone Abu Ad-Duha se, unhone Masrooq se, ke Ibn Mas'ood (RA) ne Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Siwaye lamam ke}" (Surah An-Najm 32) ke baare mein kaha: "Aankhon ka zina dekhna hai, honthon ka zina bosa lena hai, haathon ka zina pakadna (chhoona) hai, pairon ka zina chalna hai, aur sharm-gaah is baat ki tasdeeq ya takzeeb karti hai, agar woh apni sharm-gaah se aage badhe to woh zaani hai, warna yeh 'lamam' hai."

e: Abu Huraira reported Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying. Allah fixed the very portion of adultery which a man will indulge in. There would be no escape from it. The adultery of the eye is the lustful look and the adultery of the ears is listening to voluptuous (song or talk) and the adultery of the tongue is licentious speech and the adultery of the hand is the lustful grip (embrace) and the adultery of the feet is to walk (to the place) where he intends to commit adultery and the heart yearns and desires which he may or may not put into effect. (Using translation from Muslim 2658a)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har Bani Aadam ki jaan par zina ka aik hissa likh diya gaya hai jo usse zaroor pesh aayega, to aankh ka zina dekhna hai, pair ka zina chalna hai, kaan ka zina sunna hai, haath ka zina pakadna hai, zubaan ka zina baat karna hai, aur dil khwaahish aur aarzoo karta hai, aur sharm-gaah is baat ki tasdeeq ya takzeeb karti hai."

e: [AI] The thirty arrows of Islam have not been completed by anyone before Prophet Ibrahim, peace be upon him. Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: "And Ibrahim, who fulfilled [his obligations]"  [Surah an-Najm 37].
hi: "Islam ke tees (30) hissay hain jinhein Ibrahim (AS) se pehle kisi ne poora nahi kiya." Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur Ibrahim (AS) jinhone poora kiya}" (Surah An-Najm 37).

e: [AI] "When the verse 'Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High' was revealed, he said, 'They are all in the scriptures of Ibrahim.' Then when the verse 'And by the star when it descends' was revealed, he reached the statement 'And Ibrahim who fulfilled - that no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another' [An-Najm: 38] until his statement 'This is a warner of the warners of old' [An-Najm: 56]."
hi: Jab "{Apne buland Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh karo}" nazil hui, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh sab Ibrahim (AS) ke sahifon mein hai." Jab "{Qasam hai taare ki jab woh doobta hai}" nazil hui, yahan tak ke pahunche: "{Aur Ibrahim (AS) jinhone (ahad) poora kiya, koi bojh uthaane wala kisi doosre ka bojh nahi uthaayega}" (Surah An-Najm 37-38) unke farmaan "{Yeh pehle daraane walon mein se aik daraane wala hai}" (Surah An-Najm 56) tak.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ who said, "Verily, the deceased is punished by the weeping of the living. So, when his family and loved ones cry, wail, and lament over him, the deceased would wish for himself to be alive. It was asked, 'Are you referring to his family and loved ones who cry over him?' He replied, 'Yes, and his family and loved ones who console and support each other during this time.' I then said, 'Glory be to Allah!' Allah Almighty said, 'And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another.' (Surah Al-An'am 6:164).' He stated, 'Woe to you! Shall I narrate to you a statement from Abu Musa about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and you say this? Who among us is the liar? By Allah, I have never lied upon Abu Musa, nor has Abu Musa lied upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak murda zinda logon ke rone se azaab paata hai," jab woh (aurat) kahe: "Haaye mera sahaara, haaye mera hifaazat karne wala, haaye mera madadgaar, haaye mera kapda pehnaane wala," to murda ko pesh kiya jaata hai (aur poocha jaata hai): "Kya tum uski madadgaar thi? Kya tum uski hifaazat karne wali thi? Kya tum uska sahaara thi?" Unhone kaha: to maine kaha: "Subhanallah, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: {Koi bojh uthaane wala kisi doosre ka bojh nahi uthaayega}" (Surah Al-An'am 164). To unhone kaha: "Afsos tumpar, main tumhein Abu Musa se, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se hadith bayan karta hoon, aur tum yeh kehte ho? Ab humme se kaun jhoota hai? Allah ki qasam, na maine Abu Musa par jhoot bola aur na Abu Musa ne Rasulullah (SAW) par jhoot bola."

e: [AI] About Abdullah's statement in his words, may Allah be glorified and exalted: "And the moon split" [Surah Al-Qamar, verse 1]. He said, "I saw the moon split, and I saw the mountain between the two parts of the moon."
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur chaand phat gaya}" (Surah Al-Qamar 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Maine chaand ko phatte huay dekha, to maine chaand ke dono hisson ke darmiyan pahaad ko dekha."

e: [AI] "I saw the moon split into two halves twice in Makkah before the Prophet's ﷺ migration, with one half over Abu Qubays and the other half over the Suwayda." They said, "The moon is bewitched," then came the verse, "The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two]." (Quran 54:1) He said, "Just as you saw it split, what I have informed you about the approaching Hour is true."
hi: "Maine chaand ko Makkah mein Nabi (SAW) ki hijrat se pehle do baar phatte huay dekha, aik hissa Abu Qubais ke oopar aur aik hissa As-Suwaida ke oopar." To unhone kaha: "Chaand par jaadu kar diya gaya hai," to yeh nazil hui: "{Qayamat qareeb aa gayi aur chaand phat gaya}" (Surah Al-Qamar 1), aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jaise tumne ise phatte huay dekha, isi tarah jo maine tumhein Qayamat ke qareeb aane ke baare mein bataaya hai woh haq hai."

e: [AI] "The moon split during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. And as for the narration of Abdullah son of Amr, it is authentic."
hi: "Chaand Rasulullah (SAW) ke ahad mein phat gaya tha."

e: [AI] In the saying of Allah, the Exalted, "{The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.}" [Surah Al-Qamar 54:1], it is said that this occurred during the time of the Prophet ﷺ when the moon split into two halves: one half was on one side of the mountain and the other half was on the other side. The Prophet ﷺ then said, "O Allah, bear witness."[^1]
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Qayamat qareeb aa gayi aur chaand phat gaya}" (Surah Al-Qamar 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: yeh Nabi (SAW) ke ahad mein hua, chaand do hisson mein phat gaya, aik hissa pahaad ke is taraf aur aik hissa pahaad ke us taraf, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, gawah reh."

e: [AI] In His words, the Almighty (ﷻ), "{The Hour has come near, and the moon has split}" [Quran, Al-Qamar 54:1], it is said, "The moon split while we were in Mecca during the time of the Prophet  ﷺ ."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Qayamat qareeb aa gayi aur} chaand phat gaya" (Surah Al-Qamar 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Chaand phat gaya jabke hum Makkah mein Nabi (SAW) ke ahad mein thay."

e: [AI] The people of Mecca asked the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  for a sign, and the moon was split in Mecca twice. Allah (the Exalted) said, "The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split" [Al-Qamar 54:1].[^1]
hi: Makkah walon ne Rasulullah (SAW) se aik nishaani maangi, to chaand Makkah mein do baar phat gaya, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Qayamat qareeb aa gayi aur chaand phat gaya}" (Surah Al-Qamar 1). Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ka Shu'bah ki hadith par, Qatadah se, Anas se, ittefaaq hai: "chaand Rasulullah (SAW) ke ahad mein phat gaya."

e: [AI] He used to read (with humbled eyes) with the letter Alif.
hi: Ke woh "(Khaashi'an Absaaruhum)" alif ke sath padha karte the.

e: [AI] I heard Aban ibn Taghlib reciting "Their sights humbled" like Hamza.
hi: Maine Abaan bin Taghlib ko "(Khaashi'an Absaaruhum)" Hamzah ki tarah padhte suna.

e: [AI] There were three hundred years between the call of Noah and the destruction of Noah's people, and the oven persisted in India, and Noah's ark sailed for a week. The chain of narrators is authentic, and it was not included in the authentic collections.
hi: "Nuh (AS) ki dawat aur unki qaum ki halaakat ke darmiyan teen sau (300) saal ka faasla tha, aur tannur (chulha) Hind (India) mein ubla tha, aur Nuh (AS) ki kashti ne Ka'bah ka aik hafte tawaf kiya." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "He recited the saying of Allah, the Most High: 'Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness' (Surah Al-Qamar, 47) until 'in proportion' (Surah Al-Qamar, 49). Then Sa'id bin Al-Musayyib narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'The last word regarding destiny shall be for the worst of this Ummah (nation).' "
hi: Unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Beshak mujrim log gumraahi aur junoon mein hain}" (Surah Al-Qamar 47) ayat yahan tak ke "{andaaze se}" (Surah Al-Qamar 49), phir kaha: humein Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab ne, Abu Hurairah (RA) se hadith bayan ki ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Taqdeer ke baare mein aakhri baat is Ummat ke sabse bure logon ki hogi."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited Surah Ar-Rahman to his companions until he finished, he said, "Why do I see you silent, as if you were the jinn responding better than you? Every time I recited a verse to them saying, 'So which of the favors of your Lord do you deny?' [Quran 55:13], they would reply, 'We deny none of Your blessings, O our Lord, and to You is the thanks.' This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim, and they did not include it in their collections."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba ko Surah Ar-Rahman padh kar sunaayi yahan tak ke woh faarigh huay, to farmaya: "Mujhe kya hua ke main tumhein khamosh dekh raha hoon, jinnaat tumse behtar jawaab dene wale the, jab bhi maine unhein yeh padh kar sunaayi: {To tum dono apne Rab ki kaunsi ne'maton ko jhutlaaogay?} (Surah Ar-Rahman 13), to woh kehte: 'Aur humne teri kisi bhi ne'mat ko jhutlaaya nahi, Aye humare Rab, isliye teri hi tareef hai.'" Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] No one is named the Merciful except Him. This is an authentic chain of narration and it was not excluded from being authentic.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Kya tum uska koi hum-naam jaante ho}" (Surah Maryam 65) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Uske siwa kisi ko 'Rahman' nahi kaha gaya." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "Through a chain of correct narrations, and they didn't exclude it, correct."
hi: "Hisaab aur manzilon ke sath." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "The star does not shine like the earth, and the tree does not stand on a leg." Authentic narration, and it was not weakened by Ibn Ma'een."
hi: "Najm (taara/paudha) woh hai jo zameen se bagair tane ke ugta hai, aur shajar (darakht) woh hai jo tane par khada hota hai." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Minhaal bin Khaleefah ko Ibn Ma'een ne kamzor kaha hai.

e: [AI] "The poisons from which Allah created the jinn are a part of seventy parts of the fire of hell." It is an authentic narration according to the conditions of both Sheikhayn (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim), but they did not include it in their collections, according to the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Woh sakht loo (garmi) jisse Allah ne jinn ko paida kiya, Jahannam ki aag ke sattar (70) hisson mein se aik hissa hai." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Indeed, among what Allah has created is a preserved Tablet made of white pearl, its covers are made of red ruby, its pen is light, and its written words are light. Every day, it is looked upon three hundred and sixty times or more. In each look, Allah creates, provides, gives life, causes death, honors, humiliates, and does whatever He wills. This is the saying of the Most High: "Every day, He is upon a matter." [Surah ar-Rahman 29] "Authentic chain of narrators, and they did not exclude it." The name of Abu Hamzah Thabit is mentioned, and he erred once.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Har din woh kisi na kisi kaam mein hai}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 29) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Allah ne jo cheezein paida kiin unme se aik Lauh-e-Mahfooz hai, jo safed moti se bana hai, jiske dono takhtay laal yaqoot se hain, jiska qalam noor hai aur jiski likhaai noor hai, Allah har din usme teen sau saath (360) baar ya martaba nazar daalta hai, aur har nazar mein woh paida karta hai, rizq deta hai, zinda karta hai, maut deta hai, izzat deta hai, zaleel karta hai, aur jo chaahe karta hai, aur yehi hai uska farmaan: {Har din woh kisi na kisi kaam mein hai}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 29). Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Abu Hamzah ka naam Thabit hai, aur woh bohot kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "From his father, he said, 'Two gardens [in Paradise] for those who fear their Lord.' [Quran 55:46] He said, 'Two gardens of gold for the pioneers and two gardens of silver for the followers.'" According to the condition of a Muslim.
hi: Apne waalid se, "{Aur jo apne Rab ke saamne khade honay se dara, uske liye do baaghaat hain}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 46) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Do baaghaat sone ke hain aage badhne walon ke liye, aur do baaghaat chandi ke hain unki pairavi karne walon ke liye." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "You have been informed about the hidden matters, so how about the evident ones?" It is correct according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, but it has not been narrated based on the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jinki astar (bhitri parat) reshmi kapde se hain}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 54) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Tumhein bhitri parat ke baare mein bataaya gaya, to zaahiri (baahari) parat kaisi hogi?" Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ  regarding His saying, exalted and majestic, "As if they were rubies and coral" [Surah Rahman 58], he said, "He looks at her face, and her cheek is more beautiful than a mirror, and even the slightest pearl on it illuminates what is between the East and the West. And she wears seventy garments, her sight penetrates them until she sees her leg joint behind them." (Narrated by a reliable chain, but not included by Daraj Sahib in his collection of miracles.)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Goya woh yaqoot aur marjaan hain}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 58) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uska (jhalakta) chehra aaine se bhi zyada saaf uske gaal mein dekha jaayega, aur uspar sabse choti moti bhi mashriq aur maghrib ke darmiyan roshan karti hai, aur uspar sattar (70) kapde honge, phir bhi nazar unhein cheer kar us tak pahunchegi." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Darraj ajeeb-o-ghareeb riwaayaton wale hain.

e: [AI] "The throne of Allah was above the water, then He created a protective barrier for Himself, and then He created another one until He enclosed it with a single pearl. Allah, Exalted be He, says: 'And beneath them both [in meaning] are two gardens.' He also says: 'And it is the one that no creature knows what is hidden in it.' It is also the one that Allah, Exalted be He, says: 'No soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for the eyes as reward for what they used to do.' They will be given ornaments from it every day."
hi: "Allah ka Arsh paani par tha, phir usne apne liye aik chaadar (hifaazat) banaayi, phir uske neeche aik aur banaayi, yahan tak ke usne isse aik hi moti se dhaank diya." Phir Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur un dono ke ilawa (bhi) do baaghaat hain}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 62), unhone kaha: "Yeh woh hain jinme kya hai makhlooq nahi jaanti," unhone kaha: aur yehi woh hain jinke baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{To koi jaan nahi jaanti jo unke liye chhupaaya gaya hai aankhon ki thandak, unke amaal ka badla}" (Surah As-Sajdah 17), "har din unke paas isme se aik tohfa aata hai." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "The date palm of Paradise, its trunks are emerald green, and its branches are red gold, and its leaves are clothing for the people of Paradise among which their garments, necklaces, and their fruits are like pots or water pitchers, whiter than milk, sweeter than honey, and softer than butter, and it does not have thorns."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Un dono mein phal, khajoor, aur anaar hain}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 68) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jannat ke khajoor ke darakht, unke tane hare zamurrad ke hain, unke gaabhe surkh sone ke hain, aur unke pattay Jannat walon ke liye poshaak hain, isi se unke kapde aur libaas hote hain, aur unka phal ghade ya delvon jaisa hai, doodh se zyada safed, shehed se zyada meetha, aur makhan se zyada narm, aur isme koi gutli nahi."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr as-Siddiq asked the Prophet (pbuh), "What has made you gray?" The Prophet (pbuh) replied, "Surah Hud, Al-Waqi'ah, Al-Mursalat, and Amma Yatasa'aloon, and when the sun is wrapped up in darkness."
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA): "Maine Nabi (SAW) se poocha: aapko kis cheez ne boodha kar diya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Surah Hud, Al-Waqi'ah, Al-Mursalat, Amma Yatasa'aloon, aur Iza-ash-Shamsu-Kuwwirat."

e: [AI] The companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say, "Verily, Allah benefits us through the Arabs and their issues." An Arab Bedouin came forward one day and said, "O Messenger of Allah, indeed Allah mentions in the Quran a harmful tree, and I did not think that in Paradise there would be a tree that harms its owner." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "And what is it?" The Bedouin replied, "Al-Sidr (the lote tree), for it has thorns." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "{In a position which is neither ascendant nor descending} [Al-Waqi'ah 28]. Allah takes away its thorns and turns every thorn into a fruit. And indeed, it grows fruit that ripens with seventy-two different colors, and there is no color like the other." This hadith has a correct chain of narrators, but it has not been documented in a book.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba kaha karte the: "Allah humein badu logon aur unke sawaalon se faida deta hai." Aik din aik badu aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ne Quran mein aik takleef-deh darakht ka zikr kiya hai, aur mujhe khayal na tha ke Jannat mein koi aisa darakht ho sakta hai jo apne maalik ko takleef de." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Woh kaunsa hai?" Usne kaha: "Beri, kyunke usme kaante hote hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "{Bagair kaanton wali beri mein}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 28), Allah uske kaante nikaal dega, aur har kaante ki jagah aik phal rakh dega, to woh aisa phal ugaayegi jo bahattar (72) rangon mein khilega, jinme koi rang doosre jaisa nahi hoga." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "Min dukhanin aswad" translates to "From black smoke" in English.
hi: "Kaale dhuein se." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "But you, O Lord, are threefold." Then he recited, "Have you seen what you sow? Is it you who sows it, or are We the ones who sow?" (Al-Waqi'a 63) He said, "Nay, but you, O Lord, nay, but you, O Lord, nay, but you, O Lord." Then he recited, "Have you seen the water you drink? Is it you who send it down from the clouds, or are We the ones who send it down?" (Al-Waqi'a 68) He said, "Nay, but you, O Lord, nay, but you, O Lord, nay, but you, O Lord." Then he recited, "Have you seen the fire that you kindle? Is it you who cause its tree to grow, or are We the ones who cause it to grow?" He said, "Nay, but you, O Lord, nay, but you, O Lord, nay, but you, O Lord."
hi: "Balke Tu hi hai, Aye Rab," teen martaba, phir unhone padha: "{Kya tumne dekha jo tum boya karte ho, kya tum ise ugaate ho ya hum ugaane wale hain}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 63), unhone kaha: "Balke Tu hi hai, Aye Rab, balke Tu hi hai, Aye Rab, balke Tu hi hai, Aye Rab," phir unhone padha: "{Kya tumne woh paani dekha jo tum peete ho, kya tumne ise baadal se utaara ya hum utaarne wale hain}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 68), unhone kaha: "Balke Tu hi hai, Aye Rab," teen martaba, phir unhone padha: "{Kya tumne woh aag dekhi jo tum jalaate ho, kya tumne uska darakht paida kiya ya hum paida karne wale hain}," unhone kaha: "Balke Tu hi hai, Aye Rab," teen martaba.

e: [AI] The Quran was revealed in its entirety from the upper heaven to the lower heaven in one night, and then it was revealed gradually over the years. He (Prophet Muhammad) recited this verse: "So I swear by the positions of the stars" [Al-Waqi'ah 75]. He (Prophet Muhammad) said, "It was revealed in separate parts."
hi: Quran Shab-e-Qadr mein sabse buland aasman se duniya ke aasman tak aik sath nazil hua, phir saalon mein taqseem hokar (thoda-thoda) utra. Unhone kaha: aur yeh ayat padhi: "{To main sitaron ke thikaanon ki qasam khaata hoon}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 75), unhone kaha: "Yeh alag-alag hokar nazil hua." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] We were with Salman, then he left for a need and disappeared from us. Then he came back to us, and there was no water between us and him. We said to him, "O Abu Abdullah, if you perform ablution, we will ask you about some things from the Quran." He replied, "Ask me, for I am not in a state of impurity." He then recited, "Indeed, it is a noble Quran in a hidden Book. None touch it except the purified ones." [Surah Al-Waqi'ah, verse 78].
hi: Hum Salman (RA) ke sath thay, woh kisi zaroorat ke liye gaye, hum se ojhal huay, phir hamari taraf wapas aaye jabke humare aur unke darmiyan paani nahi tha. Unhone kaha: humne unse kaha: "Aye Abu Abdullah, kaash aap wudu kar lete to hum aapse Quran ke kuch masail poochte." Unhone kaha: to unhone kaha: "Poocho, kyunke main isse chhoo nahi raha," aur woh (Quran) sirf paak logon ko hi chhoona chaahiye, phir unhone padha: "{Beshak yeh izzat wala Quran hai, aik mehfooz kitaab mein, jise sirf paak log hi chhoo sakte hain}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 77-79).

e: When "Glorify the name of your mighty Lord" was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Use it when bowing, and when "Glorify the name of your most high Lord" was revealed, he said: Use it when prostrating yourself. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 869)
hi: Jab "{Apne buzurg Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh karo}" nazil hui, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein farmaya: "Ise apne ruku mein padho," jab "{Apne buland Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh karo}" (Surah Al-A'la 1) nazil hui, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise apne sajde mein padho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I will be the first to be given permission to prostrate on the Day of Resurrection and the first to be given permission to raise my head. So, I will raise my head and look in front of me to recognize my Ummah (community) among the nations. And I will look to my right to recognize my Ummah among the nations. And I will look to my left to recognize my Ummah among the nations." A man asked, "O Messenger of Allah, how will you recognize your Ummah among the nations from the time of Noah until your Ummah?" He said, "They will have bright faces from the traces of ablution. No one from the nations will have that except them. And I will recognize them by the marks of prostration on their faces, and I will recognize them by the light that is in front of them, to their right, to their left, and from their right sides."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main sabse pehla hoon jise Qayamat ke din sajde ki ijaazat di jayegi, aur sabse pehla hoon jise apna sar uthaane ki ijaazat di jayegi, to main apna sar uthaunga aur apne saamne dekhunga, to main apni Ummat ko doosri Ummaton mein se pehchaan lunga, aur main apni daayen taraf dekhunga to apni Ummat ko doosri Ummaton mein se pehchaan lunga, aur main apni baayen taraf dekhunga to apni Ummat ko doosri Ummaton mein se pehchaan lunga." Aik aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap apni Ummat ko doosri Ummaton mein se, Nuh (AS) se lekar aapki Ummat tak, kaise pehchaanenge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke chehre aur haath-pair wudu ke nishaan se chamakdaar honge, aur unke ilawa kisi doosri Ummat ke paas aisa nahi hoga, aur main unhein isse bhi pehchaanunga ke unhein unki kitaabein unke dayen haath mein di jaayengi, aur main unhein unke chehron par sajde ke nishaan se pehchaanunga, aur main unhein unke us noor se pehchaanunga jo unke aage, unke dayen, aur unke baayen hoga."

e: [AI] "Regarding the saying of Abdullah in the verse {Their light proceeds swiftly before them} [Al-Hadid 12], he said, 'They will be given their light according to their deeds. Among them are those whose light is like a mountain, and the lowest of them has a light that reaches up to his thumb, sometimes it flickers and other times it is lit.'"
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Unka noor unke aage-aage dauda karega}" (Surah Al-Hadid 12) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unhein unke amal ke mutabiq noor diya jayega, unme se kisi ka noor pahaad jitna hoga, aur sabse kam noor wale ka noor uske angoothe par hoga, kabhi jalta kabhi bujhta."

e: [AI] Here we see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  showing us Hell.
hi: "Yahin humein Rasulullah (SAW) ne Jahannam dikhaayi thi."

e: “Lest they become as those who received the Scripture before, and the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened? And many of them were rebellious.” [57:16] (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4192)
hi: Ke yeh ayat nazil hui, to Allah ne unhein sirf chaar (4) saal ke andar mala'mat ki: "{Aur tum un logon ki tarah mat bano jinhein isse pehle Kitaab di gayi thi, phir unpar lambi muddat guzar gayi to unke dil sakht ho gaye}" (Surah Al-Hadid 16) ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say, "The people of Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic period of ignorance) used to say that omens are only in women, animals, and houses." Then I recited, "{No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy}" [Surah Al-Hadid 22].
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) kaha karte the: "Jahiliyat ke log kehte the ke badshugoon (bura shagun) sirf aurat, jaanwar, aur ghar mein hota hai," phir unhone (Aisha ne) yeh padha: "{Koi museebat na to zameen mein aati hai aur na tumhari jaanon mein, magar iske paida karne se pehle hi woh aik kitaab mein likhi ja chuki hoti hai, beshak yeh Allah ke liye aasaan hai}" (Surah Al-Hadid 22).

e: [AI] "Is there not anyone who does not experience sadness and happiness? But it is those who make calamity a source of patience and make joy a reason for gratitude." It is a soundly-narrated Hadith, and it has not been excluded from being valid.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Taake tum us cheez par gham na karo jo tumse chhoot gayi, aur na us cheez par khush ho jo tumhein di gayi}" (Surah Al-Hadid 23) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Kya koi aisa hai jo gham na kare aur khush na ho? Lekin (asal baat yeh hai ke) jo museebat ko sabr banaaye aur khushi ko shukr banaaye (woh maqsood hai)." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e:
˹regarding the āyah:˺ 'And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allah. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.' (Ḥadīd 57:27), Ibn Masʿūd said that the Prophet ﷺ said to me, "O ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd!" So I said: At your service, O Messenger of Allah three time. He said, "Do you know which one of the holds of Īmān (Faith) is the strongest?" I said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He said, "The strongest ˹holds˺ of Īmān is wilāyah in ˹the name of˺ Allah whether in love in ˹His name˺ or and enmity in ˹His name.˺ O ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd!" So I said: At your service, O Messenger of Allah three time. He said, "Do you know which of the Believers are best?" I said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He said, "The best of people are the ones that have the best deeds if they have an understanding of the Religion. O ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd!" So I said: At your service, O Messenger of Allah three time. He said, "Do you know which of the people is the most knowledgable?" I said: Allah and His Messenger know best. He said, "The most knowledgeable of the people is the one most insightful for the truth when people differ even if he has been deficient in deed and even if he was crawling."
"The ones before us differed into seventy-two sects. The saved among them were three and the rest will be ruined: the sect that faced the ˹tyrant˺ kings and fought them for the sake of Religion of Allah and the Religion of Jesus, the son of Mary, until they were killed, and (2) and the sect that had no strength to face the ˹tyrant˺ kings nor in steadfastness in another one within their nation by they called to Allah and theto the Religion of Jesus, the son of Mary, and they poured into the mountains and observed monasticism there. They are the ones about whom Allah said, 'and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except ˹that they did so˺ seeking the approval of Allah. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.' (Ḥadīd 57:27) i.e. the Believers are the one who believe in Me and have certainty in Me and the disbelievers are the ones who reject Me and deny me."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aye Abdullah bin Mas'ood." Maine kaha: "Labbaik, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)," teen martaba. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai imaan ki sabse mazboot rassi kaunsi hai?" Maine kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Imaan ki sabse mazboot rassi Allah ke liye dosti rakhna hai, uske liye mohabbat aur uske liye adaawat ke sath, Aye Abdullah bin Mas'ood." Maine kaha: "Labbaik, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)," teen martaba. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai sabse afzal insaan kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse afzal insaan woh hai jiska amal sabse achha ho, jab woh apne deen ki samajh rakhte hon, Aye Abdullah bin Mas'ood." Maine kaha: "Labbaik wa Sa'daik," teen martaba. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai sabse zyada ilm wala kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse zyada ilm wala woh hai jo haq ko sabse zyada pehchaanta ho jab logon mein ikhtilaaf ho jaaye, chahe woh amal mein kotaahi karne wala ho, chahe woh apni sareen ke bal rengta ho. Humse pehle log bahattar (72) firqon mein bant gaye, unme se teen bach gaye aur baaqi halaak ho gaye - aik firqa jo baadshaahon ke muqaable mein khada hua aur Allah ke deen aur Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke deen ki khaatir unse laada yahan tak ke woh qatl kar diye gaye, aur aik firqa jinke paas baadshaahon ke muqaable ki taaqat nahi thi, to woh apni qaum ke darmiyan hi rahe, unhein Allah ke deen aur Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke deen ki taraf bulaate rahe, to baadshaahon ne unhein qatl kiya aur unhein aare se cheer diya, aur aik firqa jinke paas na baadshaahon ke muqaable ki taaqat thi na apni qaum ke darmiyan rehne ki, to unhone unhein Allah aur Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke deen ki taraf bulaaya, phir woh pahaadon mein nikal gaye aur wahan raahib bankar rehne lage, to yehi woh log hain jinke baare mein Allah ne farmaya: {Aur raahib-pana jo unhone khud ghadha, humne unpar farz nahi kiya tha, sirf Allah ki raza chahte huay (unhone khud ghadha), phir unhone iski haq ke sath riaayat na ki} (Surah Al-Hadid 27) '{faasiq}' (Surah Al-Hadid 27) ke farmaan tak, to momin woh hain jo mujh par imaan laaye aur meri tasdeeq ki, aur faasiq (na-farmaan) woh hain jinhone mera inkaar kiya aur mera juhood kiya."

e: "Blessed is the One Whose hearing encompasses all things. I heard some of the words of Khawlah bint Tha'labah, but some of her words were not clear to me, when she complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her husband, and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, ﷺ he has consumed my youth and I split my belly for him (i.e., bore him many children), but when I grew old and could no longer bear children he declared Zihar upon me; O Allah, I complain to You.' She continued to complain until Jibra'il brought down these Verses: 'Indeed Allah has heard the statement of she who pleads with you (O Muhammad) concerning her husband, and complains to Allah" (58:1) (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2063)
hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Barkat wali hai woh Zaat jiski sunwaai har cheez ko ghere huay hai, main Khawlah bint Tha'labah ki baat sun rahi thi, aur kuch mujhse chhupi rehti thi, jabke woh apne shohar ki shikaayat Rasulullah (SAW) se kar rahi thi, aur woh keh rahi thi: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), usne meri jawaani khaayi aur maine uske liye apna pait khaali kiya, yahan tak ke jab meri umr badhi aur mera bacha janam paana rukh gaya, usne mujhse zihar kar liya, Aye Allah, main teri shikaayat karti hoon.'
