Aisha (RA) ne kaha: to woh wahin thi ke Jibra'il (AS) yeh ayaten lekar utre: {Allah ne us aurat ki baat sun li jo aapse apne shohar ke baare mein jhagda kar rahi thi}" (Surah Al-Mujadilah 1). Unhone kaha: "Aur uska shohar Aws bin As-Samit (RA) tha."

e: Khawlah was the wife of Aws ibn as-Samit; he was a man immensely given to sexual intercourse. When his desire for intercourse was intensified, he made his wife like his mother's back. So Allah, the Exalted, sent down Qur'anic verses relating to expiation for zihar. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2219)
hi: "Jameelah, Aws bin As-Samit (RA) ki biwi thi, aur Aws (RA) aik aisa aadmi tha jise (waqt-waqt par) dimaaghi khalal (lamam) ho jaata tha, jab uska yeh khalal shiddat ikhtiyar karta to woh apni biwi se zihar kar leta, to Allah ne iske baare mein zihar ka kaffaara nazil kiya."

e: ˹regarding the ayah˺ “Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who have been given knowledge in ranks.” [Al-Mujādilah 11] He said: “Allah raises those believers who have been given knowledge above those who have not been given knowledge by ranks.”
hi: "{Allah tum mein se imaan walon ko, aur jinhein ilm diya gaya hai unhein, darjaat mein buland karega}" (Surah Al-Mujadilah 11) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Allah momino mein se un logon ko jinhein ilm diya gaya hai, un logon se buland karega jinhein ilm nahi diya gaya, kayi darje."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Verily, in the Book of Allah, there is a verse that no one acted upon before or after me, except for the verse of confidential talk. 'O you who have believed, when you converse privately with the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity.' [Al-Mujadila 58:12] The verse was truthful. I had a dinar, so I sold it for ten dirhams and I consulted with the Prophet, peace be upon him. So every time I consulted with the Prophet, peace be upon him, I would present a dirham before my confidential talk. Then the verse was abrogated and no one acted upon it. And then the verse was revealed 'Are you afraid to present before your consultation charities?' [Al-Mujadilah 58:13]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ki Kitaab mein aik aisi ayat hai jispar mujhse pehle kisi ne amal nahi kiya aur mere baad koi amal nahi karega - ayat-e-najwa ({Aye imaan walo, jab tum Rasool (SAW) se raazdaari mein baat karo, to apni raazdaari se pehle sadqa dedo}' (Surah Al-Mujadilah 12) ayat." Unhone kaha: mere paas aik dinaar tha, maine usse das (10) dirham mein becha, phir main Nabi (SAW) se raazdaari mein baat karta, jab bhi main Nabi (SAW) se raazdaari mein baat karta, main apni raazdaari se pehle aik dirham de deta, phir yeh mansookh (rad) ho gayi, to kisi ne isspar amal nahi kiya, to yeh nazil hui: "{Kya tum darr gaye ke apni raazdaari se pehle sadqa dedo}" (Surah Al-Mujadilah 13) ayat.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was in a room and the shade was about to disappear. So, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A man will come to you who will look at you with the eye of Satan, so when he comes to you, do not speak to him." It was not long before a man, blue-skinned and blind in one eye, appeared to them. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw him, he called him and said, "You and your companions curse me, so leave me to give them to you." So, he left and called them and they swore by what they said and did until they betrayed him. Then Allah, the Almighty, revealed, "On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and they swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. No! Indeed, they are liars." (Surah Al-Mujadila, 58:18)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik kamre ke saaye mein thay, aur saaya sikadta jaa raha tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ankareeb tumhare paas aik aisa insaan aayega jo tumhein shaitan ki nazar se dekhega, jab woh tumhare paas aaye to usse baat mat karna." Thodi hi der mein aik neeli aankhon wala, aik-aankh-wala aadmi unke saamne aa gaya, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne use dekha to bulaaya, phir farmaya: "Tum aur tumhare saathi mujhe kyun bura-bhala kehte ho?" Usne kaha: "Mujhe ijaazat den, main unhein aapke paas laata hoon." To woh gaya aur unhein bulaaya, unhone qasam khaayi ke unhone aisa na kaha na kiya, yahan tak ke unhein khaayan-baaz zaahir kar diya gaya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Jis din Allah unhein sabko utha dega, to woh uske saamne bhi qasam khaayenge jaise woh tumhare saamne khaate hain, aur samjhenge ke woh kisi cheez par hain, khabardar, woh jhoote hain}" (Surah Al-Mujadilah 18).

e: "Abu Ad-Darda said to me: 'Where do you live?' I said: 'In a town near Hims.' Abu Ad-Darda said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "There are no three people in a town or encampment among whom prayer is not established, but the Shaitan takes control of them. Therefore, stick to the congregation, for the wolf eats the sheep that strays off on its own." (One of the narrators (As Sa'ib) said: "The congregation means the congregational prayer." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 847)
hi: Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ne mujhse poocha: "Tum kahan rehte ho?" Maine kaha: "Hims se pehle aik gaon mein." Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Koi bhi teen aadmi kisi gaon ya bayaabaan mein aise nahi hote jinme namaz qaayam na ki jaati ho, magar shaitan unpar ghaalib aa jaata hai, isliye jama'at ko lazim pakdo, kyunke bheeriya sirf akele (bhatke huay) bhed ko khaata hai.'"

e: [AI] "About Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her"
hi: Aisha (RA) se.

e: He heard Ibn 'Umar and Ibn 'Abbas testify that the Messenger of Allah [SAW] forbade Ad-Dubba' (gourds), Al-Hantam, Al-Muzaffat, and An-Naqir. Then the Messenger of Allah [SAW] recited this Verse: "And whatsoever the Messenger (Muhammad) gives you, take it; and whatsoever he forbids you, abstain (from it)." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5643)
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) aur Ibn Abbas (RA), unhone dono ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein gawahi di ke aap (SAW) ne kaddu ke bartan, khokhle lakdi ke bartan, mitti ke lepe huay bartan, aur tar-lage bartan (mein nabeez rakhne) se mana kiya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Jo Rasool tumhein de use le lo, aur jisse mana kare usse ruk jao}" (Surah Al-Hashr 7).

e: [AI] "A head of a sheep was gifted to a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, 'Indeed, my brother Fulan and his family are more in need of this than us.' So he sent it to him. He continued to send it to him from one person to another until it reached seven households and then returned to the first person. Then the verse was revealed: 'And they give [from their wealth] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation.' (Surah Al-Hashr, 59:9) until the end of the verse."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik aadmi ko bakri ka sar tohfe mein diya gaya, to unhone kaha: "Mera fulan bhai aur uske ghar wale isse humse zyada zaroorat-mand hain." Unhone kaha: to unhone use unke paas bhej diya, aur yeh silsila aik se doosre tak chalta raha yahan tak ke saat (7) gharon mein yeh ghoomta raha, yahan tak ke woh pehle wale ke paas hi wapas aa gaya, to yeh nazil hui: "{Aur woh apni jaanon par doosron ko tarjeeh dete hain, agarche unhein khud zaroorat ho}" (Surah Al-Hashr 9) ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] The people are divided into three groups, and two of them have already passed while only one remains. The best thing for you to do is to be in the position that has remained, as described in the verse: "For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties" [Surah Al-Hashr 59:8]. Then he recited: "And those who had established their homes and faith before them" [Surah Al-Hashr 59:9]. Then he said: "These are the Ansar and this is their position, which has already passed." Then he recited: "And those who came after them say: 'Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith'" [Surah Al-Hashr 59:10]. He said: "So these two positions have already passed, and this remaining position is the best thing for you to be in."
hi: "Log teen martabon (manaazil) par hain, unme se do guzar chuki hain, aur aik baaqi hai, to sabse achhi baat jo tumhare liye ho sakti hai woh yeh hai ke tum us baaqi rehne wale martabe par ho," phir unhone padha: "{Un fuqara Muhajireen ke liye jo apne gharon aur apne maal se nikaale gaye}" (Surah Al-Hashr 8) ayat, phir kaha: "Yeh Muhajireen hain, aur yeh martaba guzar chuka hai," phir padha: "{Aur jinhone unse pehle (Madinah ke) ghar aur imaan mein jagah banaayi}" (Surah Al-Hashr 9) ayat, phir kaha: "Yeh Ansar hain, aur yeh martaba bhi guzar chuka hai," phir padha: "{Aur jo unke baad aaye, kehte hain: Aye humare Rab, humein aur humare un bhaiyon ko bakhsh de jo imaan mein humse aage badhe}" (Surah Al-Hashr 10) ayat, unhone kaha: to yeh dono martabe guzar chuke hain, aur yeh (teesra) martaba baaqi hai, to sabse achhi baat jo tumhare liye ho sakti hai woh yeh hai ke tum isi baaqi rehne wale martabe par ho.

e: [AI] Isḥāq narrated from 'Abd al-Razzāq, who narrated from al-Thawri, who narrated from Abī Isḥāq, who narrated from Ḥumayd ibn 'Abd Allāh al-Salūlī, who narrated from 'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib, who said: "There was a monk who worshipped in a hermitage, and a woman beautified herself for him and he had relations with her, and she became pregnant. Satan came to him and said, 'Kill her, for if they find out about you, you will be disgraced.' So he killed her and buried her. Then they came to him and took him and as they were walking, Satan came to him and said, 'It is I who beautified her for you, so prostrate to me in a prostration of gratitude and I will save you.' So he prostrated to him, and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed the verse: 'Like the example of the Devil when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you."' (Surah al-Hashr, 59:16)."
hi: Ishaq ne humein hadith bayan ki, Abdur Razzaq ne humein khabar di, Ath-Thawri ne, Abu Ishaq se, unhone Humaid bin Abdullah As-Saluli se, unhone Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) se, unhone kaha: aik raahib apni khaanqah mein ibaadat karta tha, aik aurat ne apne aap ko uske liye sajaaya, to usse uski ghalat sohbat ho gayi, woh haamila ho gayi, to shaitan uske paas aaya aur kaha: "Ise qatl kar do, kyunke agar logon ko pata chal gaya to tum ruswa ho jaaoge." To usne use qatl kar diya aur dafan kar diya, log aaye aur usse pakad liya, usse lekar chale, jab woh chal rahe the to shaitan uske paas aaya aur kaha: "Main hi hoon jisne tumhare liye isse sajaaya tha, isliye mujhe aik sajda karo, main tumhein bacha lunga." To usne usse sajda kiya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Shaitan ki misaal ki tarah jab woh insaan se kahta hai: kufr kar, phir jab woh kufr kar leta hai to kehta hai: main tujhse bezaar hoon}" (Surah Al-Hashr 16) ayat.

e: [AI] "To seek inspiration from the forgiveness of Ibrahim for his father, so that they may seek forgiveness for the polytheists. And His saying, "Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve," [Al-Mumtahanah 5], "Do not punish us with their hands, nor with a punishment from You," (Lord) they say, "If these (believers) were upon the truth, they would not have been afflicted."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aye imaan walo, mere aur apne dushman ko dost mat banao, unki taraf mohabbat bhejte huay}" (Surah Al-Mumtahinah 1) yahan tak ke farmaan "{Aur Allah jo tum karte ho use dekhne wala hai}" (Surah Al-Mumtahinah 3) ke baare mein, yeh Hatib bin Abi Balta'ah aur unke sathiyon ke Quraish ke kaafiron ko khabardaar karte huay khat likhne ke maamle mein nazil hui, aur Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan "{Siwaye Ibrahim (AS) ke apne baap se yeh kehne ke}" (Surah Al-Mumtahinah 4) ke baare mein, unhein mana kiya gaya ke woh Ibrahim (AS) ke apne baap ke liye maghfirat maangne ki misaal na pakdein aur mushrikeen ke liye maghfirat na maangein, aur Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan "{Aye humare Rab, humein kaafiron ke liye aazmaaish mat banaa}" (Surah Al-Mumtahinah 5), ya'ni humein unke haathon se ya apni taraf se azaab mat de, warna woh kahenge: agar yeh log haq par hote to unpar yeh museebat na aati.

e: [AI] "In the making of the idols of Ibrahim and those with him, except for seeking forgiveness for his father while he was still a polytheist."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak tumhare liye unme aik achha namoona hai}" (Surah Al-Mumtahinah 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Ibrahim (AS) aur unke saathiyon ke tareeqe mein, siwaye unke apne baap ke liye maghfirat maangne ke, jabke woh mushrik tha."

e: [AI] "To take from it, accept from it, and bring it to its destination, until it was sent to Aisha, asking her about the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) regarding this. So she informed him, and he commanded her to accept her gifts and bring them into her house. Then Allah revealed, 'Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them' (Al-Mumtahinah 8) until the end of the two verses."
hi: (Ke woh) usse (kuch) le lein, uski taraf se qubool karein, aur usse apne ghar mein dakhil karein, yahan tak ke unhone (kisi ne) Aisha (RA) ke paas paighaam bheja ke Rasulullah (SAW) se yeh poochein, to unhone unhein bataaya, "to aap (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh uske tohfe qubool karein aur usse apne ghar mein dakhil karein," to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Allah tumhein un logon se mana nahi karta jinhone tumse deen ke baare mein jung nahi ki aur tumhein tumhare gharon se nahi nikaala, ke tum unke sath achhaai karo}" (Surah Al-Mumtahinah 8) do ayaton ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] That Abu Hudhayfah ibn 'Utbah brought her and Hind bint 'Utbah to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to marry her off. She said, "He has taken a debt from us and imposed a condition on us." She said, "I said to him, 'O cousin, do you know if any of your people have any of these defects or handicaps?'" Abu Hudhayfah said, "Yes, so pledge to him. For it is by this that he agrees to the marriage." So Hind said, "I will not pledge to you regarding theft, for I steal from my husband's wealth." So the Prophet ﷺ  removed his hand and she removed hers until he sent for Abu Sufyan to annul their marriage. Abu Sufyan said, "As for fresh dates, they are good, but as for the dry ones, no, they are not a blessing." She said, "So we pledged to him." Then Fatimah said, "There was no other dome that I detested more than your dome, nor did I want Allah to make it permissible and bless it. And by Allah, there is no other dome that I desire more for Allah to rebuild and bless than your dome." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Also, by Allah, none of you truly believes until I become more beloved to him than his own child and his parents."
hi: Abu Hudhaifah bin Utbah unhein aur Hind bint Utbah ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaye taake woh baiyat karein, to unhone (Hind ne) kaha: "Unhone humse ahad liya aur humpar shart lagaayi." Unhone kaha: maine unse (Abu Hudhaifah se) kaha: "Aye chachere bhai, kya aap apni qaum mein kisi kamzori ya (aisi) baaton ke baare mein jaante hain?" Abu Hudhaifah ne kaha: "Haan, isi tarah unse baiyat karo, kyunke isi tarah baiyat li jaati hai aur isi tarah shart lagayi jaati hai." To Hind ne kaha: "Main chori na karne ki baiyat nahi karungi, kyunke main apne shohar ke maal mein se (kabhi bagair poochhe) leti hoon." To Nabi (SAW) ne apna haath rok liya aur usne apna haath rok liya, yahan tak ke Abu Sufyan ke paas paighaam bheja gaya, to unhone uske liye isse halaal kar diya, Abu Sufyan ne kaha: "Rahi baat taazi (khaane-peene ki) cheez ki, to haan, aur rahi baat sookhi (jama-shuda maal) ki, to nahi, aur na hi koi ne'mat (izaafi hissa)." Unhone kaha: to humne unse baiyat ki. Phir Fatimah (RA) ne kaha: "Koi qubba (khema/jagah) mujhe tumhare qubba se zyada napasand nahi tha, aur na hi mujhe yeh pasand tha ke Allah usse aur usme jo kuch hai halaal kare, aur Allah ki qasam, koi qubba mujhe isse zyada aziz nahi ke Allah usse aabaad kare aur usme barkat de, jitna tumhara qubba." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur isi tarah, Allah ki qasam, tum mein se koi imaan nahi laata jab tak main uske liye uski aulaad aur uske waalid se zyada mahboob na ho jaaun."

e: [AI] We gathered and discussed. Then we said, "Who among you will go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and ask him which deeds are most beloved to Allah?" Then we dispersed and agreed that one of us would go to him. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a messenger to us and gathered us. He then paired us up and recited to us the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Glorify Allah, whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. He is the Almighty, the Wise." Then he asked, "O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?" Until the end of the Surah. Abu Salamah narrated that Abdullah ibn Salam recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Yahya then recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Al-Awza'i recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Yahya ibn Abi Kathir then recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Abu Ishaq al-Fazari then recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Muawiya ibn Amr then recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn al-Nadr then recited it to us from the beginning to the end. Abu Bakr ibn Balawiyyah then recited it to us from the beginning to the end.
hi: Hum jama huay aur aapas mein baat ki, humne kaha: "Tum mein se kaun Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas jaakar poochega ke Allah ko sabse zyada pasandeeda amal kaunsa hai?" Phir hum bikhar gaye aur humme se koi unke paas jaane ki himmat na kar saka, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein bulaawa bheja aur humein jama kiya, hum aapas mein aik doosre ki taraf ishara karne lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein padh kar sunaayi: 'Aasmano aur zameen ki har cheez ne Allah ki tasbeeh ki, aur wahi Azeez, Hakeem hai, Aye imaan walo, tum woh baat kyun kehte ho jo karte nahi' Surah ke aakhir tak. Abu Salamah ne kaha: to Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ne isse humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaaya. Yahya ne kaha: to Abu Salamah ne isse humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaaya. Al-Awza'i ne kaha: to Yahya bin Abi Katheer ne isse humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaaya. Abu Ishaq Al-Fazari ne kaha: aur Al-Awza'i ne isse humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaaya. Muawiyah bin Amr ne kaha: aur Abu Ishaq Al-Fazari ne isse humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaaya. Muhammad bin Ahmad bin An-Nadr ne kaha: aur Muawiyah bin Amr ne isse humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaaya. Abu Bakr bin Balawiyah ne kaha: aur Muhammad bin Ahmad bin An-Nadr ne isse humein shuru se aakhir tak padh kar sunaaya.

e: [AI] "And Isa (Jesus), peace be upon him, promised his twelve companions in a house. He came out to them from a side of the house, shaking his head and mentioning a speech. He said in the end, 'So Allah supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became victorious.' [Surah As-Saff, verse 14]."
hi: Isa (AS) ne apne baarah (12) sahaba se aik ghar mein wada kiya, to woh unke paas ghar ke doosre kinare se nikle, apna sar jhaadte huay, phir aik hadith zikr ki, aur uske aakhir mein kaha: to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{To humne imaan walon ki unke dushman ke muqaable mein taeed ki, to woh ghaalib ho gaye}" (Surah As-Saff 14).

e: [AI] "This verse is written in the Torah with seven hundred verses: 'Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.' It is the first verse of Surah Al-Jumu'ah. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: "Yeh ayat Tauraat mein saat sau (700) aayaton mein likhi hui hai: {Allah ki tasbeeh karti hai har cheez jo aasmano mein hai aur jo zameen mein hai, Malik, Quddus, Azeez, Hakeem}," Surah Al-Jumu'ah ki pehli ayat. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Jahl passed by the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying and said, "Didn't I forbid you from praying, O Muhammad? You know that no one else has called people to prayer more than me." The Prophet ﷺ scolded him. Then Jibril, peace be upon him, said, "Let him make his call, we will call the Zabaniyah." By Allah, if he had made his call, the angels of punishment would have seized him.[^1]
hi: Abu Jahl Nabi (SAW) ke paas se guzra jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, usne kaha: "Kya maine tumhein namaz padhne se mana nahi kiya, Aye Muhammad? Tumhein pata hai ke koi mujhse zyada (yahan) majlis-daar nahi." To Nabi (SAW) ne usse sakhti se roka. To Jibra'il (AS) ne kaha: "{To woh apni majlis (madad karne walon) ko bulaaye, hum bhi Zabaaniyah (Jahannam ke farishton) ko bulaayenge}" (Surah Al-Alaq 18), Allah ki qasam, agar usne apni majlis ko bulaaya hota to azaab ke farishte usse foran pakad lete.

e: [AI] "Prolong this prayer and shorten this sermon, meaning the Friday prayer."
hi: "Namaz ko lamba karo aur khutba ko chhota karo," ya'ni Jumu'ah ki namaz.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever abandons Friday (prayer) three times, for no necessary reason, Allah will place a seal over his heart.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1126)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo bagair kisi zaroorat ke teen martaba Jumu'ah chhod de, Allah uske dil par mohar laga deta hai."

e: “We were participating in a battle along with the Messenger of Allah, and there were some people from the Bedouins with us. So we all rushed toward some water and the Bedouins raced us to it. One of the Bedouins beat his companions to it and he (tried to obstruct) the pond, he placed rocks around it and he put a leather sheet over it until his companions came.” He said: “A man among the Ansar reached the Bedouin and he dropped the reigns of his camel to drink, but the Bedouin would not allow him. So he started removing the barriers around the water, but the Bedouin raised a stick beating the Ansari man on the head, and smashed it. He went to Abdullah bin Ubayy, the head of the hypocrite, to inform him – he was in fact one of his companions. So Abdullah bin Ubayy became enraged, the he said: ‘Do not spend anything on whoever is with Muhammad until they depart.’ Meaning the Bedouins. They were preparing food for the Messenger of Allah. So Abdullah said: ‘When they depart from Muhammad, then bring Muhammad some food, and let him and whoever is with him eat it.’ Then he said to his companions: ‘If we return to Al-Madinah, indeed the more honorable will expel therefrom the meaner.’” Zaid said: “And I was riding behind the Messenger of Allah, and I had heard Abdullah bin Ubayy, so I informed my uncle who went to tell the Messenger of Allah. He sent a message to him (Abdullah) but he took an oath and denied it.” He said: “So the Messenger of Allah accepted what he said and did not believe me. So my uncle came to me and said: ‘You only wanted the Messenger of Allah to hate you, and the Muslims to say that you lied.’” He said: “I suffered such worry as has not been suffered by anyone else.” He said: “(Later) while I was on the move with the Messenger of Allah on a journey, my mind was relieved of worry, since the Messenger of Allah came to me and rubbed my ear and smiled in my face. I would never be happier than with that as long as the world remained. Then Abu Bakr caught up to me, and said: ‘What did the Messenger of Allah say to you?’ I said: ‘He did not say anything to me, he only rubbed my ear and smiled in my face.’ He said: ‘Receive the good news!’ Then Umar caught up with me and I said the same to him as I had said to Abu Bakr. In the morning the Messenger of Allah recited Surat Al-Munafiqin.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3313)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jung mein gaye, humare sath kuch badu log bhi thay, hum paani ki taraf jaldi karte, aur badu hum se aage nikal jaate, aik badu apne saathiyon se aage nikal kar hoz (talaab) bhar leta aur uske ird-gird patthar rakh deta, phir uspar chamda (parda) daal deta yahan tak ke uske saathi aa jaate. Ansar mein se aik aadmi us badu ke paas aaya aur apni oontni ki lagaam dheeli chhod di taake woh piye, to usne mana kiya usse chhodne se, to us Ansari ne aik patthar khainch liya, to paani bahne laga, to badu ne aik lakdi uthaayi aur Ansari ke sar par maari, use zakhmi kar diya. To woh Abdullah bin Ubayy, munafiqon ke sardaar, ke paas gaya aur usse bataya, aur woh (Ansari) uske saathiyon mein se tha, to Abdullah bin Ubayy ko ghussa aaya, phir usne kaha: "Un logon par kharch mat karo jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas hain yahan tak ke woh unke ird-gird se bikhar jaayen," ya'ni badu, aur woh khaane ke waqt Rasulullah (SAW) se baat kiya karte the, to Abdullah ne apne saathiyon se kaha: "Jab woh Muhammad (SAW) ke paas se bikhar jaayen, to Muhammad (SAW) ke paas khaana lekar aao, taake woh aur uske paas jo hain khaayen," phir apne saathiyon se kaha: "Jab tum Madinah wapas jao, to izzat wala zaleel (aadmi) ko wahan se nikaal dega." Zaid ne kaha: aur main apne chacha ke peechhe sawaar tha, maine Abdullah ko yeh (baat) sunaa, aur hum unke maamu the, to maine apne chacha ko bataya, unhone jaakar Rasulullah (SAW) ko bataya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse bulawa bheja, usne qasam khaayi, inkaar kiya, aur maazrat ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse sach maana aur mujhe jhutlaaya, to woh mere chacha ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Tum ne kya chaha, ke Rasulullah (SAW) tumse naaraaz ho jaayen, tumhein jhutlaayen, aur Musalman bhi tumhein jhoota maanein?" To mujhpar itni pareshaani chha gayi jitni kisi par kabhi nahi chhayi thi. Phir jabke main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik safar mein chal raha tha, aur main gham se apna sar jhukaaye huay tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas aaye, "unhone mera kaan pakad kar hilaaya aur mere chehre par muskuraaye," to mujhe is (khushi) se badhkar khushi kisi cheez se na hoti agarche mujhe hamesha ki zindagi ya poori duniya mil jaati. Phir Abu Bakr (RA) mujhse mile aur poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumse kya kaha?" Maine kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse kuch nahi kaha, siwaye is ke ke unhone mera kaan pakad kar hilaaya aur mere chehre par muskuraaye." Unhone kaha: "Khush ho jao." Phir Umar (RA) mujhse mile aur poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumse kya kaha?" To maine unhein bhi wahi kaha jo Abu Bakr (RA) se kaha tha. Jab humne subah ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Surah Al-Munafiqun padhi: "{Jab munafiq aapke paas aate hain to kehte hain: hum gawahi dete hain ke aap zaroor Allah ke Rasool hain}" (Surah Al-Munafiqun 1) yahan tak ke pahuncha: "{Jo kehte hain: un logon par kharch mat karo jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas hain yahan tak ke woh bikhar jaayen}" (Surah Al-Munafiqun 7) yahan tak ke pahuncha: "{Izzat wala zaroor zaleel ko wahan se nikaal dega}" (Surah Al-Munafiqun 8). Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ka is hadith ke kuch alfaaz nikaalne par ittefaaq hai, Abu Ishaq As-Sabee'ee ki hadith se, Zaid bin Arqam (RA) se, aur Bukhari ne Abu Ishaq ki mutaabi'at karte huay Shu'bah ki hadith se, Al-Hakam se, Muhammad bin Ka'b Al-Qurazi se, Zaid bin Arqam (RA) se nikaala hai, aur dono ne ise mukammal taur par nahi nikaala, aur sanad sahih hai.

e: [AI] According to the saying of Allah Almighty, "He is the one who created you, so among you, some are disbelievers and some are believers." [Surah Al-Taghabun, verse 2]. So Al-A'mash narrated to us from Abu Sufyan from Jabir, who said that the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Every servant will be resurrected according to what he died upon." Muslim has recorded this Hadith from Al-A'mash, but he did not include it in this context, according to the condition requested by Muslim, and he mentioned it from Jabir.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Wahi hai jisne tumhein paida kiya, to tum mein se koi kaafir hai aur koi momin}" (Surah At-Taghabun 2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: humein Al-A'mash ne, Abu Sufyan se, unhone Jabir (RA) se hadith bayan ki, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har banda usi haalat par uthaaya jayega jispar uski maut hui." Muslim ne Al-A'mash ki hadith nikaali hai, lekin isse is siyaaq mein nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] This verse {Indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them} [Al-Taghabun 14] was revealed in a group of people from the people of Mecca who embraced Islam and wanted to come to the Prophet ﷺ . However, their wives and children refused to let them go, so they came to Medina. When they arrived in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , they saw that they had attained knowledge, so they understood that they deserve punishment. Then Allah, the Almighty, revealed the verse {But if you pardon and overlook} [Al-Taghabun 14].
hi: Yeh ayat "{Beshak tumhari kuch biwiyon aur aulaad mein se tumhare dushman hain, isliye unse hoshiyaar raho}" (Surah At-Taghabun 14) Makkah walon ke aik giroh ke baare mein nazil hui jo Musalman ho gaye the aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas aana chahte the, magar unki biwiyon aur aulaad ne unhein jaane se roka, phir woh Madinah aa gaye, jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahunche aur dekha ke woh (biwi/aulaad) deen ki samajh rakhte hain, to unhone unhein saza dene ka iraada kiya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur agar tum maaf karo aur darguzar karo}" (Surah At-Taghabun 14) ayat.

e: [AI] Regarding this verse, "And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful." [Al-Hashr 9], and I, as a person, there is nothing that I have the power over, and nothing escapes my control. I fear that this verse has afflicted me. Abdullah said, "You have mentioned stinginess, and stinginess is a terrible thing. As for what Allah mentioned in the Quran, it is not like what you said, that you intentionally seek the wealth of others or the wealth of your brother and consume it."
hi: Is ayat "{Aur jo apne nafs ki hirs se bacha liya jaaye, to yehi log kaamyaab hain}" (Surah Al-Hashr 9) ke baare mein, (usne kaha:) "Aur main aisa aadmi hoon jo apne aap par qaboo nahi rakh paata, aur meri girift se koi cheez nikalti nahi, mujhe darr hai ke kahin yeh ayat mujhpar laagu na ho gayi ho." To Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Tumne kanjoosi ka zikr kiya, aur kanjoosi bohot buri cheez hai, lekin jo Allah ne Quran mein zikr kiya hai woh waisa nahi jaisa tumne kaha, balke woh yeh hai ke tum jaan-boojh kar kisi doosre ka maal ya apne bhai ka maal khaao."

e:
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Allah, the Almighty, says: 'I have borrowed from My servant and he refuses to lend to Me, and has cursed Me without knowing. He says: 'O time! O time! And I am the Time.' Then Abu Hurairah recited the following verse from Allah, the Almighty: 
'If you lend to Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you.' (Surah At-Taghabun, 64:17)"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Maine apne bande se qarz maanga, usne mujhe qarz dene se inkaar kiya, aur mere bande ne mujhe bura-bhala kaha aur usse pata nahi chala, woh kehta hai: 'Haaye zamana, haaye zamana,' jabke main hi Zamana hoon." Phir Abu Hurairah (RA) ne Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Agar tum Allah ko achha qarz do to woh tumhare liye usse barha dega}" (Surah At-Taghabun 17).

e: [AI] From Muhammad bin Ubaid bin Abi Rafe', the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, who said: "Abd Yazeed divorced the mother of Rukana, then he married a woman from Muzaynah. She came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, nothing can compensate for me except for this strand of hair, which she took from her head.' At that, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took hold of his outer garment, then he called Rukana and his brothers, and then he said to those seated with him, 'Do you see this from this?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Abdu Yazeed, 'Divorce her.' And he did so. Then he said to Abi Rukana, 'Take her back.' He said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have divorced her.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, I knew that, so take her back.' Then the verse was revealed: 'O Prophet, when you divorce women, divorce them for their prescribed waiting period.' (Quran 65:1)"
hi: Abd Yazid Abu Rukanah ne Umm Rukanah ko talaaq di, phir usne Muzainah qabile ki aik aurat se nikah kiya, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mera usse koi faida nahi jitna is baal ka faida hai," aur usne apne sar se aik baal liya (ke itni hi mere liye qeemat hai). To Rasulullah (SAW) ko isspar ghairat aayi, unhone Rukanah aur uske bhaiyon ko bulaawa diya, phir apni majlis walon se poocha: "Kya tum aisa dekhte ho, aisa?" Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abd Yazid se farmaya: "Isse talaaq de do." Usne aisa kiya. Phir aap (SAW) ne Abu Rukanah se farmaya: "Isse wapas le lo." Usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine to ise talaaq de di hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe yeh pata hai, isliye ise wapas le lo." To yeh nazil hui: "{Aye Nabi, jab tum auraton ko talaaq do to unhein unki iddat ke waqt talaaq do}" (Surah At-Talaq 1).

e: [AI] "Her coming out of her house is a clear disgrace."
hi: "Uska apne ghar se nikalna khuli besharmi hai."

e: [AI] Abu Dharr used to make the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recite this verse: "And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out and will provide for him from where he does not expect." [Surah At-Talaq 3]. Abu Dharr said, "So he would repeat it until I fell asleep, then he said, 'O Abu Dharr, if people were to adhere to this, it would suffice them.'"
hi: Abu Dharr (RA): Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhna shuru ki: "{Aur jo Allah se dare, Allah uske liye nikalne ka raasta banaata hai, aur usse aisi jagah se rizq deta hai jahan se usse gumaan bhi nahi hota}" (Surah At-Talaq 3), unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) isse baar-baar dohraate rahe yahan tak ke mujhe neend aane lagi, phir farmaya: "Aye Abu Dharr, agar log isspar amal karein, to yeh unhein kaafi ho jaaye."

e: [AI] This verse is revealed in a man who was brave but poor, with limited means and many dependents. He came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him for something, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Fear Allah and be patient." He returned to his companions and they asked him what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had given him, and he replied, "He did not give me anything, but he said to me, 'Fear Allah and be patient.'" He had not waited long until his son came to him with sheep that were captured from the enemy. He went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and informed him about them, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "Take all of them." And then the verse was revealed: "And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out and will provide for him from where he does not expect." [At-Talaq: 2-3]
hi: Yeh ayat "{Aur jo Allah se dare, Allah uske liye nikalne ka raasta banaata hai, aur usse aisi jagah se rizq deta hai jahan se usse gumaan bhi nahi hota}" (Surah At-Talaq 3) Ashja' qabile ke aik aadmi ke baare mein nazil hui jo bahaadur lekin gareeb tha, uske paas kam saamaan aur bohot se ghar wale the, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse maanga, to aap (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Allah se daro aur sabr karo." Woh apne saathiyon ke paas wapas gaya, unhone poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumhein kya diya?" Usne kaha: "Unhone mujhe kuch nahi diya, aur mujhse farmaya: 'Allah se daro aur sabr karo.'" Thodi hi der guzri thi ke uske bete uske paas bakriyaan lekar aaya jo dushman ne uske liye chhod di thin, woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, unse iske baare mein poocha aur inka waqia bataaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse khaao." To yeh nazil hui: "{Aur jo Allah se dare, Allah uske liye nikalne ka raasta banaata hai, aur usse aisi jagah se rizq deta hai jahan se usse gumaan bhi nahi hota}" (Surah At-Talaq 2-3).

e: [AI] When the verse in Surah Al-Baqarah was revealed, in a certain number among the number of women, they said, "A certain number of women remain unmentioned, including young and old women, as well as those who have ceased menstruation and pregnant women." So Allah, exalted and majestic, revealed the verse in Surah An-Nisa: "And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth." [Quran 65:4] "With an authentic chain of narration, and they did not mention an exception." Authentic.
hi: Jab Surah Al-Baqarah mein auraton ki iddat ke baare mein ayat nazil hui, to logon ne kaha: "Kuch aur auraten baaqi hain jinka zikr nahi hua - chhoti umr ki, boodhi, jinki haiz band ho chuki hai, aur haamila auraten." To Allah Ta'ala ne Surah At-Talaq mein yeh ayat nazil ki: "{Aur tumhari auraton mein se jo haiz se mayoos ho gayi hon, agar tumhein shak ho, to unki iddat teen mahine hai, aur jinhein abhi haiz nahi aaya, aur haamila auraton ki muddat unke hamal ki wilaadat hai}" (Surah At-Talaq 4). Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "He said, Allah is the One who created seven heavens and similar to them from the earth. He said, there are seven earths, and on each earth there is a prophet like your prophet, and Adam is like Adam, and Noah is like Noah, and Abraham is like Abraham, and Jesus is like Jesus." [At-Talaq 12]
hi: Ke unhone kaha: "{Allah wahi hai jisne saat aasman paida kiye, aur zameen se bhi unke barabar}" (Surah At-Talaq 12) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Saat zameenein hain, har zameen mein aik Nabi tumhare Nabi jaisa, aur Aadam tumhare Aadam jaisa, Nuh tumhare Nuh jaisa, Ibrahim tumhare Ibrahim jaisa, aur Isa tumhare Isa jaisa."

e: [AI] "In every land, towards Ibrahim."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Saat aasman aur zameen se unke barabar}" (Surah At-Talaq 12) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Har zameen mein Ibrahim (AS) jaisa (Nabi)."

e: "O Prophet! Why do you forbid (for yourself) that which Allah has allowed to you.' until the end of the Verse. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3959)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki aik laundi thi jiske sath unke taalluqaat the, to Aisha (RA) aur Hafsah (RA) ne unhein itna kaha ke unhone use apne oopar haraam kar liya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh ayat nazil ki: "{Aye Nabi, jo Allah ne aapke liye halaal kiya hai use aap kyun haraam karte hain, aap apni biwiyon ki raza chahte hain}" (Surah At-Tahrim 1) ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] You lied, it is not forbidden for you. Then, recite this verse: "O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives?" [Surah At-Tahrim, verse 1].
hi: "Tumne jhoot kaha, yeh tumpar haraam nahi," phir yeh ayat padhi: "{Aye Nabi, jo Allah ne aapke liye halaal kiya hai use aap kyun haraam karte hain, aap chahte hain}" (Surah At-Tahrim 1) ayat.

e: [AI] "Teach yourself and your family the good."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko aag se bachaao}" (Surah At-Tahrim 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko neki sikhaao."

e: [AI] "The stones that Allah described in the Quran as "their fuel is mankind and stones" (Surah At-Tahrim 6) are stones made of sulfur that Allah created as He willed or as He pleased."
hi: Beshak woh patthar jinka Allah ne Quran mein zikr kiya: "{Jiska indhan insaan aur patthar hain}" (Surah At-Tahrim 6), woh gandhak (sulphur) ke patthar hain jo Allah ne apne paas jaisa chaaha ya jis tarah chaaha paida kiye.

e: [AI] A young man from the Ansar was overcome by fear of the fire, so he would weep upon mentioning the fire. This continued until he confined himself to his house due to this fear. This was mentioned to the Prophet ﷺ , so he went to visit him at his house. When the Prophet entered upon him, the young man embraced him and fell dead. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Prepare your companion, for his liver has been ripped apart."
hi: Aik Ansari jawaan mein aag ka khauf itna aa gaya ke woh aag ka zikr sunkar rone lagta yahan tak ke usne khud ko ghar mein qaid kar liya, yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) uske ghar aaye, jab aap (SAW) uske paas dakhil huay to jawaan ne unhein gale lagaaya aur mar gaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne saathi ka janaaza taiyaar karo, kyunke khauf ne uska kaleja phaad diya."

e: [AI] "I performed a pilgrimage and then I descended from one of the roads of Kufa. I went out in a dark night when suddenly I heard a shout from the depth of the night. He was saying, 'O my Lord, by Your might and majesty, I did not intend to disobey You with my disobedience. Indeed, I disobeyed You when I disobeyed You, and I am not ignorant of that. However, it was a sin that my wretchedness and your covering have encouraged me to commit due to my ignorance. I disobeyed You out of my ignorance and I opposed You out of my ignorance. Now, who will rescue me from Your punishment, and to whose rope should I hold on? If You have severed Your rope from me, then to whose rope should I cling? When he finished speaking, I recited a verse from the Book of Allah, 'Save yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe.' (Quran 66:6). Then, I heard a loud noise and after that, I did not hear or perceive anything. So, I continued on my way and when morning came, I returned to my chamber. There, I found a funeral procession taking place, and an elderly woman. I asked her about the matter of the deceased, but she did not recognize me. She replied, 'A man passed by here yesterday and may Allah reward him, he recited a verse from the Book of Allah, after hearing which, my son died.' The Dhahabi remained silent on the summary."
hi: Main Hajj karne gaya, to Kufa ki galiyon mein se aik galee mein utra, main aik andheri raat mein nikla, achaanak raat ke bilkul beech mein aik cheekhne wala cheekh raha tha aur keh raha tha: "Aye mere Ma'bood, teri izzat aur teri buzurgi ki qasam, meri na-farmani se meri murad teri mukhaalifat nahi thi, aur maine teri na-farmani ki jab meri ki, jabke main isse anjaan nahi tha, balke aik khataa pesh aayi jismein meri badnaseebi ne meri madad ki, aur teri mujhpar chhodi hui pardah-poshi ne mujhe dhoka diya, aur maine apni na-samjhi se teri na-farmani ki aur apni na-samjhi se teri mukhaalifat ki, ab tere azaab se mujhe kaun bachaayega, aur agar tu ne mujhse apni rassi kaat di to main kiski rassi se juda hounga? Haaye jawaani, haaye jawaani." Jab woh apni baat se faarigh hua, to maine Allah ki Kitaab ki aik ayat padhi: "{Apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko us aag se bachaao jiska indhan insaan aur patthar hain, jispar sakht, taakatwar farishte muqarrar hain}" (Surah At-Tahrim 6) ayat. To maine aik sakht harkat suni, phir uske baad koi awaaz nahi suni, to main chala gaya, jab subah hui to main apne raaste par wapas gaya, achaanak wahan aik janaaza rakhi hui thi, aur aik boodhi aurat thi, maine unse marne wale ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone mujhe pehchaana nahi tha, unhone kaha: "Yahan se aik aadmi guzra, Allah usse waisa hi badla de jaisa usne mere bete ke sath kal raat kiya, jabke woh (mera beta) namaz mein khada tha, to usne Allah ki Kitaab ki aik ayat padhi, jab mere bete ne usse suna to uska jigar phat gaya aur woh mar gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Whenever a person commits a sin and then repents sincerely, the sin will no longer be held against him, and it will not be mentioned in the authentic chain of narrations, nor will it be recorded against him."
hi: Ke banda gunah kare, phir tauba kare, to phir usme wapas na jaaye. Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "To expiate your sins." [Surah At-Tahrim, verse 8]
hi: "{Ke woh tumhare gunah tumse door kar de}" (Surah At-Tahrim 8) ayat.

e: [AI] About Ibn Abbas regarding the saying of Allah, the Almighty: "On the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who have believed with him, their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light" [Surah At-Tahrim 8]. He said, "There is no one among the monotheists who will not be given light on the Day of Resurrection. As for the hypocrites, their light will be extinguished, and the believer will fear the extinguishing of the hypocrite's light, thus he will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jis din Allah Nabi (SAW) ko aur unke sath imaan laane walon ko zaleel nahi karega, unka noor unke aage aur unke dayen daudta hoga, woh kahenge: Aye humare Rab, humara noor humare liye poora kar de}" (Surah At-Tahrim 8) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Tauheed maanne walon mein se koi bhi nahi hoga jise Qayamat ke din noor na diya jaaye, rahi baat munafiq ki, to uska noor bujha diya jayega, aur momin munafiq ke noor ke bujhne ko dekhkar dara hua hoga, to woh kahega: {Aye humare Rab, humara noor humare liye poora kar de}" (Surah At-Tahrim 8).

e: [AI] "They both betrayed him." [Surah Al-Tahrim 10] He said, "Neither did the wife of Noah [enter Paradise] with the believers, for she was of them, but the wife of Lot was in Paradise [and] she betrayed them."
hi: "{To dono ne unki khiyanat ki}" (Surah At-Tahrim 10) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Dono ne zina nahi kiya, rahi baat Nuh (AS) ki biwi ki, to woh logon se kehti thi ke woh deewana hai, aur rahi baat Lut (AS) ki biwi ki, to woh mehmaano ka pata bataati thi, to yehi unki khiyanat thi."

e: The wife of Pharaoh was tortured under the sun. When they left, angels gave her shade with their wings and she saw her house in Jannah.
hi: Firaun ki biwi ko dhoop mein azaab diya jaata tha, jab woh (azaab dene wale) usse hat jaate, to farishte apne paron se usspar saaya kar dete, aur woh Jannat mein apna ghar dekha karti thi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "When I was taken on the Night Journey, I passed by a pleasant fragrance and asked: 'What is this fragrance?' They replied: 'This is the fragrance of the comb of the daughter of Pharaoh, and her children used to comb her hair. When the comb fell from her hand, she said: 'In the name of Allah!' Her daughter asked: 'Is it for my father?' She replied: 'No, not for your father, but for my Lord and your Lord, and the Lord of your father.' Her daughter said: 'I will inform my father about this.' So she told Pharaoh, who summoned her and her children, and asked her: 'What do you want?' She replied: 'Gather my bones and the bones of my children, and bury us all together.' He acknowledged the truth in her request and brought her children to throw them one by one into the grave, until the last one was her young breastfeeding son. He said to her: 'Be patient, O mother, for you are upon the truth.' Then she was thrown into the grave along with her son." The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Four people spoke while still children: this child (referring to the son of the woman of Pharaoh), the witness of Joseph, the companion of Jurayj, and Jesus son of Mary, peace be upon them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab mujhe isra (raat ka safar) karwaaya gaya, to mere paas se aik khushbudaar khushbu guzri, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaisi khushbu hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh Firaun ki beti ke baal banaane wali aur uske bachon ki khushbu hai.' Woh usske baal banaa rahi thi ke uske haath se kanghi gir gayi, to usne kaha: 'Bismillah.' To (Firaun ki) beti ne poocha: 'Mere baap ka (naam liya)?' Usne kaha: 'Nahi, balke mera Rab, tera Rab, aur tere baap ka Rab.' Usne kaha: 'Kya main apne baap ko yeh bataaun?' Usne kaha: 'Haan,' to usne (Firaun ko) bataaya, usne use aur uske bachon ko bulaawa diya, usne (haajimen ne) kaha: 'Mujhe aapse aik zaroorat hai.' Usne poocha: 'Woh kya hai?' Usne kaha: 'Aap mere haddiyon aur mere bachon ki haddiyon ko jama karke sab ko sath dafan karein.' Usne kaha: 'Yeh humare zimme tumhara haq hai.' To woh uske bachon ko laaya, aik-aik karke unhein (aag mein) daala, yahan tak ke uska aakhri bacha aaya, aur woh doodh peeta bacha tha, to usne kaha: 'Sabr karo, Aye meri maa, kyunke aap haq par hain,' phir use uske bacche ke sath daala gaya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chaar (log) chhoti umr mein bole - yeh (bacha), Yusuf (AS) ka gawah, Juraij ka saathi, aur Isa bin Maryam (AS)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  drew four lines and then said, "Do you know what this is?" They said, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "Indeed, the best women of the people of Paradise are Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, Maryam bint Imran, and Asiya bint Muzahim, the wife of Pharaoh, in addition to the mention of her in the Quran (she said: 'My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people')." [Al-Tahrim 11]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne chaar lakeerein khainchi, phir farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ki auraton mein sabse afzal Khadijah bint Khuwailid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, Maryam bint Imran, aur Aasiya bint Muzahim, Firaun ki biwi, hain, un baaton ke sath jo Allah ne humein Quran mein unke baare mein bataayi: {Usne kaha: Aye Rab, mere liye apne paas Jannat mein aik ghar bana, aur mujhe Firaun aur uske amal se bacha, aur mujhe zaalim qaum se bacha}" (Surah At-Tahrim 11).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of its women is Maryam bint Imran, and the best of its women is Khadijah." This hadith was narrated by Al-Bukhari in his Sahih from Sadaqah bin Muhammad, and it was also narrated by Muslim from Abu Khaythamah and Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaybah in this context. So why did you mention it?
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iski (Jannat ki) sabse behtareen aurat Maryam bint Imran hai, aur iski sabse behtareen aurat Khadijah hai." Bukhari ne isse Sahih mein Sadaqah bin Muhammad se riwayat kiya hai, aur Muslim ne isse Abu Khaithamah aur Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaybah se isi siyaaq mein riwayat kiya hai. Dono ne ise pehle hi nikaal chuke hain, isliye ise dobara zikr karne ki zaroorat na thi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, there is a Surah in the Book of Allah, Exalted and Glorious, that consists of nothing but thirty verses. It intercedes for a man until it takes him out of the Fire and admits him into Paradise."
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab mein aik Surah hai jo sirf tees (30) aayaton par mushtamil hai, usne aik aadmi ki shafa'at ki, to usse aag se nikaal kar Jannat mein daakhil kar diya."

e: [AI] A man is brought in his grave, and his legs are approached, and his legs say, “You have no way over what is on my side; he used to stand and recite Surah al-Mulk with me.” Then he is approached from the side of his chest—or he said, his belly—and it says, “You have no way over what is on my side; he used to recite Surah al-Mulk with me.” Then his head is approached, and it says, “You have no way over what is on my side; he used to recite Surah al-Mulk with me.” He said: “So it is the protector; it prevents the punishment of the grave. And in the Torah it is Surah al-Mulk. And whoever recites it in a night has done much and been extensive.”
hi: Aadmi ki qabr mein uske paas aaya jaata hai, to uske pairon ke paas aaya jaata hai, to uske pair kehte hain: "Tumhein mere qareeb koi raasta nahi, woh mere zariye Surah Al-Mulk padha karte the," phir uske seene ki taraf se ya usne kaha uske pait ki taraf se aaya jaata hai, to woh kehta hai: "Tumhein mere qareeb koi raasta nahi, woh mere zariye Surah Al-Mulk padha karte the," phir uske sar ki taraf aaya jaata hai, to woh kehta hai: "Tumhein mere qareeb koi raasta nahi, woh mere zariye Surah Al-Mulk padha karte the." Unhone kaha: to yehi (Surah) rok-thaam wali hai, yeh qabr ke azaab se bachaati hai, aur yeh Tauraat mein bhi Surah Al-Mulk hai, aur jo isse raat mein padhe usne bohot achha aur mukammal kaam kiya.

e: [AI] Indeed, the first thing that Allah created was the pen. He said to it, "Write." It asked, "What should I write?" He replied, "Write the destiny." From that day, everything that exists will continue until the Day of Judgment. It is said that His throne was over the water, and the steam from the water rose and the skies were created. Then He created the "Noon" and spread the earth upon it. The earth rested upon the back of the Noon and the Noon shuddered. The earth solidified and was established with mountains. Indeed, the mountains elevate on the surface of the earth.
hi: Sabse pehli cheez jo Allah ne paida ki woh Qalam thi, usse farmaya: "Likh." Usne poocha: "Kya likhun?" Farmaya: "Taqdeer," to usi din se woh sab kuch chalta rahega jo hone wala hai, yahan tak ke Qayamat qaayam ho. Unhone kaha: aur uska Arsh paani par tha, phir paani ki bhaap oopar uthi, usse aasman phate (paida huay), phir usne "Noon" (machhli) ko paida kiya, to zameen usspar phailaayi gayi, aur zameen Noon ki peeth par hai, to Noon harkat karta to zameen kaanpti, isliye ise pahaadon se mazboot kar diya gaya, isliye pahaad zameen par fakhr karte hain.

e: [AI] "And they do not document."
hi: "{Aur jo woh likhte hain}".

e: [AI] I asked Aisha, the mother of the believers, to tell me about the manners of the Messenger of Allah (SAW), and she said, "Do you recite the Quran?" And I said, "Yes." Then she said, "Indeed, the manners of the Messenger of Allah (SAW) were the Quran."
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Aye Umm-ul-Momineen, mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke akhlaaq ke baare mein bataayen." Unhone poocha: "Kya tum Quran padhte ho?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ka akhlaaq Quran tha."

e: [AI] "He is known for his evil deeds, just as a sheep is known by its wool."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Sakht-mizaaj, iske ilawa badnaam bhi}" (Surah Al-Qalam 13) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh burai se pehchaana jaata hai jaise bakri apne kaan ke nishaan (zanamah) se pehchaani jaati hai."

e: [AI] "He recited this verse: 'Preventing good, transgressing and sinful, [He is] crude, and a skeptic thereafter, wicked and arrogant.' So he said, 'I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "The people of Hellfire are every arrogant, obstinate braggart, while the people of Paradise are the weak, humble ones."'"
hi: Unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Neki se rokne wala, hadd se guzarne wala, gunahgaar} 'sakht-mizaaj, iske ilawa badnaam bhi'" (Surah Al-Qalam 12-13), phir kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jahannami woh har mota-taaza, bad-mizaaj, ghamandi, maal jama karne wala hai, aur Jannati kamzor, dabaaye huay log hain.'"

e:
that he (Ibn ʿAbbās) asked regarding ˹Allah's˺ statement ﷻ, 'The day the shin will be exposed' (Qalam 68:42), he said: 'If something is hidden from the Quran for you then seek it in poetry, for it is the dīwān (register) of the Arabs.' 
As you've heard the poet saying: [..poetry omitted..], Ibn ʿAbbās said: 'This is the day of distress and severity.'[^1]
hi: Unse Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jis din pindli se pardah uthaaya jayega}" (Surah Al-Qalam 42) ke baare mein poocha gaya, unhone kaha: "Agar tum par Quran ki koi baat chhupi rahe, to usse she'r (shairi) mein talaash karo, kyunke yeh Arabon ka register hai. Kya tumne shaayar ka yeh sher nahi suna: 'Sabr karo, Anaaq, beshak yeh baaqi shar hai, tumhari qaum ne gardanein maarna riwaaj bana diya hai; aur jang humare beech pindli tak khadi ho gayi hai.'" Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh takleef aur sakhti ka din hai."

e: [AI] "Mutatābi‘ātin" translates to "successive" in English.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Usne yeh hawa unpar saat raaton aur aath dinon tak musalsal chalaayi}" (Surah Al-Haqqah 7) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Lagataar."

e: [AI] “They will have upon them dust of humility and disgrace. This is their recompense, the words of Allah Almighty: 'On the Day the faces will be humbled, burdened by dust.'” [Surah Abasa, 41]
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur zameen aur pahaad uthaaye jaayenge, phir dono aik hi zarb se pees diye jaayenge}" (Surah Al-Haqqah 14) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Dono gard-o-ghubaar ban jaayenge, jo kaafiron ke chehron par hoga, momino ke chehron par nahi, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: {Us din kuch chehre aise honge jinpar gard-o-ghubaar hoga, unhein andhera dhaanp raha hoga}" (Surah Abasa 41).

e: [AI] "Eight angels in the form of wheels, with their rims reaching to their knees, journeyed for a distance of sixty-three years."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur us din aapke Rab ka Arsh unke oopar aath (8) farishte uthaayenge}" (Surah Al-Haqqah 17) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Aath (8) farishte, pahaadi bakron (auwal) ki soorat mein, jinke khuron aur ghutno ke darmiyan teraas (63) saal ka faasla hai."

e: [AI] We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Al-Bat'ha when a cloud passed by. He looked at it and asked them, "Do you know what this is called?" They said, "Yes, it is called a cloud." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "And it is called Al-Muzn." They said, "And it is called Al-Muzn." He then said, "Do you know what is between the heavens and the earth?" They said, "No." He said, "The distance between them is either one, two, or three seventy years. And above that is the sky, and Allah is above that. Nothing is hidden from Him regarding the actions of the children of Adam. In the seventh heaven, there are eight celestial dwellings, each with spaces between its ridges and joints like the distance between one sky and another."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Al-Batha mein baithe thay, aik baadal guzra, aap (SAW) ne usse dekha aur unse poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai iska naam kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, yeh baadal hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur muzn." Unhone kaha: "Aur muzn." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur anaanah." Phir farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke darmiyan faasla ya to aik ya do, ya phir teraas (73) saal ka hai, aur aasman uske oopar bhi isi tarah hai, aur Allah iske bhi oopar hai, Bani Aadam ke kisi bhi amal ko woh chhupaa nahi hai, aur saatwe aasman mein aath (8) pahaadi bakre hain, jinke khuron aur ghutno ke darmiyan utna hi faasla hai jitna aik aasman se doosre aasman tak."

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, in Surah Al-Kahf (29), it is narrated that he said, "Like a drop of water falling from a pitcher, when it is close to it, a portion of his face will fall. Even if a bucket of my washing water is poured onto the earth, it will be sufficient for the people of this world."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, "{Pighle huay tel jaisa paani}" (Surah Al-Kahf 29) ke baare mein, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tel ke tal-chhat jaisa, jab usse uske qareeb kiya jayega to uske chehre ki khaal gir jaayegi, aur agar ghisleen (Jahannamiyon ke ghaao ka paani) ka aik bartan duniya mein bahaaya jaaye to duniya walon ko badbudaar kar de."

e:
[AI] "Then We will cut from it the [life] artery." [Al-Haqqah 46]
He said, "The arteries of the heart."
hi: "{Phir humne uski shahrag (wateen) kaat di hoti}" (Surah Al-Haqqah 46) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Dil ki nas."

e: [AI] "He is the heartstring that resides in the back."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Phir humne uski shahrag (wateen) kaat di hoti}" (Surah Al-Haqqah 46) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh dil ki woh nas hai jo peeth mein hai."

e: [AI] "What are the khātūn? They are khāti'ūn (sinners). What are the ṣābūn? They are ṣābi'ūn."
hi: "'Al-Khaatoon' kya hai? Yeh to 'Al-Khaati'oon' (gunahgaar) hai, 'As-Saaboon' kya hai? Yeh to 'As-Saabi'oon' hai."

e: [AI] "O Allah, if this is the truth from You, then rain upon us stones from the sky."
hi: "Aye Allah, agar yeh (Muhammad SAW ka laaya hua) haq hai teri taraf se, to humpar aasman se patthar barsa de."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited this verse, "So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad], from the right and from the left, in groups? Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure? No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  spat onto his hand and said, "Allah says, 'O son of Adam, how can you disobey Me when I have created you like this, to the extent that when I have formed you and made you upright, you walked between the flesh and the bone, and for the Earth you are no more than a handful.' This means that you have complaints, so you gather and withhold until you reach the graves, saying, 'Will I give in charity now when the time for giving in charity has come?'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{To in kaafiron ko kya ho gaya hai ke woh aapki taraf daudte huay aa rahe hain, dayen aur baayen se, girohon mein bant kar, kya har aik unme se ummeed rakhta hai ke use na'mat wali Jannat mein daakhil kiya jayega? Hargiz nahi, hum ne unhein us cheez se paida kiya hai jo woh jaante hain}" phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni hatheli par thooka, phir farmaya: "Allah farmata hai: Aye Ibn Aadam, tum mujhe kaise aajiz kar sakte ho jabke maine tumhein aisi hi cheez se paida kiya, yahan tak ke jab maine tumhein durust kar diya aur seedha kar diya, to tum do chaadron mein chalte phirte the, aur zameen ko tumse takleef hoti (yani wazan mehsoos hota)," ya'ni shikaayat, "to tum ne jama kiya aur rok kar rakha, yahan tak ke jab (tumhari jaan) halq tak pahunch gayi, to kehte ho: 'Kya main ab sadqa dun, jabke sadqe ka waqt hi guzar gaya?'"

e: [AI] "His face is towards the throne, and his feet are on the ground."
hi: "Uska chehra Arsh ki taraf hai aur uski peeth zameen ki taraf."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not recite upon the jinn nor did he see them. However, he set out with a group of his companions, intentionally, to the market of `Ukaz, which was blocked off by the Shayateen (devils). The shooting stars were sent upon them, so they returned to their people and said, "What is wrong with you?" They replied, "There is a barrier between us and the news from the heavens, and shooting stars were sent upon us." They said, "This is nothing but something that has happened. So go forth to every corner of the earth and look at what has happened." So, they went forth in all directions, striking the eastern and western parts of the earth, seeking to find out what had happened between them and the news from the sky. When they returned to their people, they said, "Indeed, we have heard a wonderful Quran which guides to righteousness, so we have believed in it and will never associate anything with our Lord. Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, then revealed, "Say: It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard a wonderful Quran which guides to righteousness, so we have believed in it and will never associate anything with our Lord.'" (Quran, Surah Al-Jinn, ayah 2)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne na to jinnaat ko (khaas taur par) padh kar sunaaya aur na hi unhein dekha, balke woh apne sahaba ke aik giroh ke sath Souq-e-Ukaaz ki taraf jaa rahe the, aur shayateen ke darmiyan aur aasmani khabar ke darmiyan rukaawat daal di gayi thi, aur unpar shooting stars (angaare) bheje gaye the, to woh apni qaum ke paas wapas gaye aur poochha gaya: "Tumhein kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Humare aur aasmani khabar ke darmiyan rukaawat daal di gayi hai, aur humpar angaare bheje gaye hain." Unhone kaha: "Yeh sirf koi naya waqia hua hai, isliye zameen ke mashriq aur maghrib mein phailo aur dekho yeh kya waqia hua hai." To woh zameen ke mashriq aur maghrib mein phailne lage, yeh talaash karte huay ke unke aur aasmani khabar ke darmiyan kya rukaawat hui hai, wahin jab woh apni qaum ke paas laute, to kaha: "{Beshak humne aik ajeeb Quran suna, jo seedhi raah ki taraf hidayat deta hai}" (Surah Al-Jinn 2), "to hum isspar imaan laaye, aur hum apne Rab ke sath kisi ko shareek nahi karengay." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Kaho: mujh par wahi ki gayi hai ke jinnaat mein se aik giroh ne sun liya}," aur unhein sirf jinnaat ka qaul hi wahi kiya gaya.

e: [AI] He heard Abdullah bin Mas'ood saying: "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to his companions while he was in Makkah: 'Whoever of you wants to meet the emissaries of the jinn tonight, let him do so.' None of them (except me) came, so we set out until we reached the highest point in Makkah. He drew a line with his foot and commanded me to sit on it. Then he went on until he stood and began reciting the Quran. A cloud overshadowed him and covered him with so many dark layers that I could not hear his voice. Then they departed and dispersed like pieces of scattered clouds, going away. Only a few of them remained. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  finished praying before dawn and left. He appeared again and asked me, 'What happened to the emissaries?' I replied, 'They are there, O Messenger of Allah.' So he took bones and the dung and gave them to them as provisions. Then he forbade anyone of them to use bones or dung for personal use.'
hi: Maine Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Makkah mein apne sahaba se farmaya: "Jo tum mein se aaj raat jinnaat ke waqiye mein haazir hona chaahe, woh chala jaaye," to unme se mere siwa koi haazir na hua, hum chal pade yahan tak ke jab hum Makkah ke buland hisse mein pahunche, to unhone apne pair se mere liye aik lakeer khainchi, phir mujhe hukum diya ke main isme baith jaaun, phir woh chal pade yahan tak ke khade huay aur Quran shuru kiya, to unhein bohot se kaale saaye (jinnaat) ghere mein le liya, jinhone mere aur unke darmiyan aisi rukaawat daal di ke main unki awaaz na sun saka, phir woh chale gaye aur baadal ke tukdon ki tarah tuk-tukda hokar jaane lage, yahan tak ke unme se aik giroh baaqi reh gaya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) Fajr ke waqt faarigh huay, chal pade aur khule mein aaye, phir mere paas aaye aur poocha: "Us giroh ka kya hua?" Maine kaha: "Woh wahin hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." To unhone aik haddi aur aik gobar liya, aur unhein zaad (tohfa) ke taur par diya, phir mana kiya ke koi bhi haddi ya gobar se istinja (safaai) kare.

e: [AI] "Regarding the remembrance of his Lord, he (the disbeliever) will be subjected to an escalating torment." [Quran 17:47] He said, "A mountain in Hell."
hi: "{Apne Rab ke zikr se (mudta hai), to woh use sakht barhne wale azaab mein daakhil karega}" (Surah Al-Jinn 17) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Jahannam mein aik pahaad."

e: [AI] "They used to bow and prostrate in their prayer, meaning the jinn."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Qareeb tha ke woh unpar tooth pade}" (Surah Al-Jinn 19) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh (jinnaat) unke ruku ke sath ruku karte the aur unke sajde ke sath sajda karte the."

e: [AI] About the reading of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , she said, when the verse {O you who wraps himself [in clothing], arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -} [Al-Muzzammil 2] was revealed, they stood in prayer for a year until their feet swelled. So, Allah, the Exalted and Mighty, revealed {So recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He knew that there would be among you those who are ill.}
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki qiraat ke baare mein, unhone kaha: jab unpar yeh nazil hui: "{Aye chaadar odhne wale, raat ko khade raho, siwaye thodi der ke}" (Surah Al-Muzzammil 2), to woh (Musalman) aik saal tak (yun hi) khade rahe yahan tak ke unke pair soojh gaye, phir Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Isliye Quran mein se jitna aasaan ho padho, use pata hai ke tum mein se kuch bimaar honge}".

e: [AI] Regarding the standing of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , she said, "Don't you recite, O Muzammil?" I said, "Yes." She said, "That is his standing (in prayer)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke qiyaam (khade rehne) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Kya tum 'Aye Muzammil' nahi padhte?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "Yehi unka qiyaam hai."

e: [AI] "Collaborate on this matter and handle it."
hi: "Tumhein is zimmedaari mein lapeta gaya hai, isliye ise nibhaao."

e: When the opening verses of Surah Al-muzammil was revealed, the Companions would pray as long as they would pray during Ramadan until its last verses were revealed. The period between the revelation of its opening and the last verses was one year. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1305)
hi: Jab Surah Al-Muzzammil ki shuruaat nazil hui, to woh Ramzan ke mahine mein khade honay jaisa hi khade hote the, yahan tak ke iski aakhri (aayaten) nazil hui. Unhone kaha: aur iske pehle aur aakhri hisse ke darmiyan taqreeban aik saal ka faasla tha.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to be on his camel when revelation came down to him, and the camel would lower its back so it couldn't move. This is mentioned in the following verse of the Quran: "Indeed, We will throw upon you a heavy word." [Surah Al-Muzzammil, verse 5]
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) par wahi utarti aur woh apni oontni par sawaar hote, to woh (oontni) apni gardan zameen par tikaa deti aur harkat na kar paati, aur unhone Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan padha: "{Beshak hum ankareeb aap par aik bhaari baat daalenge}" (Surah Al-Muzzammil 5).

e: [AI] About Abdullah, he said, "It means in Habashiyyah, the standing of the night." [Al-Muzzammil 6]
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, "{Beshak raat ka uthna}" (Surah Al-Muzzammil 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Habashi zubaan mein raat ko khade honay ko kehte hain."

e: [AI] "A thorn that is stuck in the throat does not go in nor come out." Regarding His saying: "covered in a tattered garment," [Al-Muzzammil 14], it means "the tattered garment that when you take something from it, another part of it follows, and the thimble is from the sand."
hi: "Aik kaanta jo halq mein atak jaaye, na andar jaaye na baahar aaye." Aur Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Bikhri hui reti}" (Surah Al-Muzzammil 14) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Mahil woh hai jisme se agar tum kuch uthaao to uska baaqi hissa bhi tumhare peechhe aa jaaye, aur 'katheeb' reti ko kehte hain."

e: [AI] "You mentioned this matter, so please handle it."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aye chaadar odhne wale}" (Surah Al-Muddaththir 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Tumhein is zimmedaari mein lapeta gaya hai, isliye ise nibhaao."

e: [AI] "From sin."
hi: "Gunah se."

e: "A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'What is the Sur?' He said: 'A horn that will be blown into'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2430)
hi: Aik badu Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur poocha: "Soor kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik seeng jisme phoonka jaayega."

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Al-Walid ibn al-Mughira came to the Prophet ﷺ and he recited the Qur'an to him. It affected him deeply and Abu Jahl heard about it and came to him. He said, 'O uncle, your people think about gathering wealth for you.' He asked, 'Why?' Abu Jahl replied, 'So that they can give it to you, as you have come to Muhammad to seek his favor.' He said, 'The Quraysh already know that I am one of the wealthiest among them.' Abu Jahl said, 'Then say something that will alarm your people, that you reject it or that you dislike it.' He replied, 'By Allah, there is not a man among you who knows more poetry than I, nor do I know any man who knows more rhymes or verses than I do. By Allah, there is no similarity to what he says in anything else. By Allah, his words are sweeter, more eloquent, and more fruitful than any other. It humbles what is beneath it and rises above it, and nothing rises above it. It breaks what is beneath it.' Abu Jahl said, 'Your people will not be pleased with you until you say something about it.' He replied, 'Leave me until I think about it.' When he thought about it, he said, 'This is magic that is preferred and surpasses everything else.' So the verse was revealed, 'Leave Me with the one whom I created alone' (Qur'an 74:11)."
hi: Al-Waleed bin Al-Mughirah Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, aap (SAW) ne unhein Quran sunaaya, to goya woh unke liye narm pad gaya, yeh baat Abu Jahl tak pahunchi, to woh uske paas aaya aur kaha: "Aye chacha, aapki qaum aapke liye maal jama karna chahti hai." Usne poocha: "Kyun?" Usne kaha: "Taake woh aapko de sakein, kyunke aap Muhammad (SAW) ke paas isliye gaye ke unke paas jo hai usse haasil karein." Usne kaha: "Quraish ko pata hai ke main unme sabse zyada maal wala hoon." Usne kaha: "To aap koi aisi baat kahen jo aapki qaum tak pahunche ke aap ise mana karte hain ya napasand karte hain." Usne poocha: "Main kya kahoon? Allah ki qasam, tum mein koi bhi mujhse zyada shairi jaanne wala nahi, na rajaz na qaseeda mein, na jinnaat ki shairi mein, Allah ki qasam, jo yeh keh raha hai woh in mein se kisi cheez se milta-julta nahi, aur Allah ki qasam, jo baat yeh keh raha hai usme meethaas hai aur uspar aik khoobsurati (chhaap) hai, aur iska oopar wala hissa phal-daar hai, aur iska neeche wala hissa sarsabz hai, aur yeh buland ho jaata hai aur koi isse buland nahi kar sakta, aur yeh apne neeche ki har cheez ko toad deta hai." Usne kaha: "Aapki qaum aapse tab tak raazi nahi hogi jab tak aap iske baare mein kuch keh na dein." Usne kaha: "Mujhe chhod do taake main soch loon." Jab usne socha, to kaha: "Yeh to (purane) jaadu jaisa hai jo naql kiya jaata hai, jise usne kisi aur se liya hai." To yeh nazil hui: "{Mujhe us shakhs ke sath chhod do jise maine akela paida kiya}" (Surah Al-Muddaththir 11).

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ, "Woe to the [bottom of] a valley in Hell, where the disbeliever falls for forty autumns before reaching its depth. And the ascent is a mountain in the Fire, where one climbs for seventy autumns, and then falls, and it is the same."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Wail Jahannam mein aik ghaati hai jisme kaafir chaalis (40) saal tak girta rahega isse pehle ke woh uski gehraai tak pahunche, aur As-Sa'ood aag mein aik pahaad hai, jispar woh sattar (70) saal tak chadhega, phir girega, aur yeh isi tarah (hameshaa) chalta rahega."

e: [AI] From Ali in his saying, exalted is He (Allah), "Every soul, for what it has earned, will be held in pledge, except the companions of the right." [Al-Muddaththir 39]. He said, "They are the children of the Muslims."
hi: Ali (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Har jaan apni kamaai ke sath rehen hai, siwaye dayen wale saathiyon ke}" (Surah Al-Muddaththir 39) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh Musalmano ke bachche hain."

e: [AI] From Abu Musa, regarding His saying - exalted be He - "So they ran away from al-Qaswara" [Al-Muddaththir 51], he said, "Al-Qaswara refers to the men of hunting, the archers."
hi: Abu Musa (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Qaswarah se bhaagte huay}" (Surah Al-Muddaththir 51) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Qaswarah shikaari, teer-andaaz log hain."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recite, "And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise. He admits whom He wills into His mercy."[Quran 2:105] He said, "Your Lord says, 'I am worthy of being feared, that I should have another deity with Me, while I am worthy of being worshipped by those who fear Me, that I should have another deity with them, that I should forgive him.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh padhte suna: "{Aur tum kuch nahi chaahoge magar jo Allah chaahe, wahi taqwa ke laayak hai aur maghfirat ke laayak hai}," aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhara Rab Ta'ala farmata hai: main isse laayak hoon ke mujhse taqwa (darr) rakha jaaye ke koi mere sath kisi doosre ma'bood ko na banaaye, aur main us shakhs ke liye jo mere sath kisi doosre ma'bood na banaaye is baat ke laayak hoon ke main usse bakhsh doon."

e: [AI] "From whom?" I said, "From the Bani Asad tribe," he said. "From their noble lineage or from those whom Allah has blessed?" I said, "From those whom Allah has blessed." He said, "Ask." I said, "I swear by the Day of Resurrection." He said, "Your Lord swears by whatever He wills of His creations." I said, "And I swear by the reproachful soul." He said, "It is the soul that blames itself." I said, "Does man think that We will never assemble his bones? Yes, We are able to put together in perfect order the tips of his fingers." He said, "If He wills, He could make him (man) flat, then backward." I said, "Then it will be [the same for him] a resting place and a depository." He said, "The resting place is in the womb, and the depository is in the backbone."
hi: "Tum kis qabile se ho?" Maine kaha: "Banu Asad se." Unhone poocha: "Unke Haruriyah (Khawarij) mein se ho ya un logon mein se jinpar Allah ne ehsaan kiya?" Maine kaha: "Un logon mein se jinpar Allah ne ehsaan kiya." Unhone kaha: "Poocho." Maine kaha: "{Nahi, main Qayamat ke din ki qasam khaata hoon}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 1). Unhone kaha: "Tumhara Rab apni makhlooq mein se jiski chaahe qasam khaata hai." Maine kaha: "{Aur nahi, main malaamat karne wali jaan ki qasam khaata hoon}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 2). Unhone kaha: "Malamat ki jaane wali jaan (khud apne aap ko malamat karti hai)." Maine kaha: "{Kya insaan yeh samajhta hai ke hum uski haddiyaan jama nahi karenge, kyun nahi, hum to uski ungliyon ki noken tak durust karne par qaadir hain}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 4). Unhone kaha: "Agar woh chaahta to use khur ya sum wala bana deta." Maine kaha: "{To qaraargaah aur amaanat-gaah}" (Surah Al-An'am 98). Unhone kaha: "Qaraargaah rehm (maa ke pait) mein hai aur amaanat-gaah peeth mein."

e: [AI] "About Ibn Abbas, it is said: 'Rather, man desires to commit evil openly.' [Surah Al-Qiyamah, verse 5] He says: 'I will repent.' [Surah Al-Qiyamah, verse 6] 'He will ask, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"' [Surah Al-Qiyamah, verse 6] 'Then the vision will become clear to him when it dazzles the sight.' [Surah Al-Qiyamah, verse 7]"
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, "{Balke insaan chahta hai ke woh apne aage bhi gunah karta rahe}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 5) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh keh raha hai: main baad mein tauba kar lunga," aur "{Woh poochta hai: Qayamat ka din kab aayega}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "To jab nazar chondh jaayegi, to usspar (haqeeqat) saaf ho jaayegi."

e: [AI] On the authority of Abdullah, in his statement, Almighty Allah says: "On the day when some signs of your Lord come, faith will not benefit a soul that did not believe before." (Quran 6:158) He said, "The sunrise from its west." Then he recited this verse: "And the sun and moon are joined, the human being will say on that day: Where is the escape?" (Quran 75:10)
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jis din tumhare Rab ki kuch nishaaniyan aayengi, to kisi jaan ka imaan laana usse faida nahi degaa jo isse pehle imaan na laayi ho}" (Surah Al-An'am 158) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna," phir yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur suraj aur chaand jama kar diye jaayenge, us din insaan poochega: kahan bhaagoon?}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 9-10).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The lowest rank of the people of Paradise is for a man who looks at his kingdom for a thousand years, seeing its furthest reaches as he sees its closest parts. He looks at his wives, servants, and palaces. The highest rank of the people of Paradise is for the one who looks at the face of Allah Almighty twice every day." Israel ibn Yunus transmitted from Thawr from Ibn Umar, who said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'The lowest rank of the people of Paradise is for the one who looks at his kingdom for a thousand years, and the highest rank is for the one who looks at the face of Allah Almighty twice every day.' Then he recited: 'Faces that Day will be radiant, looking at their Lord' (Quran 75:22), and 'To their Lord, on that Day, the gazes will be cast' (Quran 75:23). He said, 'They will look at the face of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, every day.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat walon mein sabse kam martabe wale ka haal yeh hoga ke woh apni baadshaahat ko do hazaar (2000) saal tak dekhega, uske sabse door hisse ko waise hi dekhega jaise sabse qareeb hisse ko, apni biwiyon, khadimon, aur takhton mein dekhega, aur Jannat walon mein sabse afzal martabe wala woh hoga jo har din do martaba Allah Ta'ala ka deedaar karega."
