Israel bin Yunus ne Thuwair se, unhone Ibn Umar (RA) se, isi tarah riwayat ki, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat walon mein sabse kam martabe wale ka haal yeh hoga ke woh apni baadshaahat ko do hazaar (2000) saal tak dekhega, aur sabse afzal martabe wala woh hoga jo har din do martaba Allah Ta'ala ka deedaar karega," phir unhone padha: "{Us din kuch chehre taazgi bhare honge}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 22), unhone kaha: "Roshni aur saaf-safaai," "{Apne Rab ki taraf dekhte huay}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 23), unhone kaha: "Har din Allah Ta'ala ke chehre ko dekhega."

e: [AI] I said to Ibn Abbas, "Is it something that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said or something that Allah revealed?" He replied, "It is something that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, and then Allah revealed it."
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se poocha: "{Tere liye afsos hai, phir afsos}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 34), kya yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ne khud kaha, ya Allah ne isse nazil kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne khud kaha, phir Allah ne isse nazil kiya."

e: [AI] Indeed, when the Prophet ﷺ  read the verse "Is not He capable of reviving the dead?" (Qiyamah 40), he said "yes." And when he read the verse "Is not Allah the wisest of judges?" (At-Tin 8), he also said "yes."
hi: Ke Nabi (SAW) jab "{Kya woh murdon ko zinda karne par qaadir nahi}" (Surah Al-Qiyamah 40) padhte, to farmaate: "Kyun nahi," aur jab "{Kya Allah sabse achha faisla karne wala nahi}" (Surah At-Tin 8) padhte, to farmaate: "Kyun nahi."

e: “I see what you do not see, and I hear what you do not hear. The heaven is creaking and it should creak, for there is no space in it the width of four fingers but there is an angel there, prostrating to Allah. By Allah, if you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much, and you would never enjoy women in your beds, and you would go out in the streets, beseeching Allah.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4190)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne "{Kya insaan par aik aisa waqt guzra hai jab woh koi zikr karne ke laayak cheez nahi tha}" padha yahan tak ke Surah khatam ki, phir farmaya: "Main woh dekhta hoon jo tum nahi dekhte, aur woh sunta hoon jo tum nahi sunte, aasman charmaraata hai, aur usse aisa karne ka haq hai, isme chaar ungliyon jitni jagah bhi khaali nahi jahan koi farishta apni peshaani rakhkar Allah ke saamne sajda-rez na ho, Allah ki qasam, agar tumhein wahi maloom hota jo mujhe maloom hai, to tum kam hansty aur zyada rote, aur tum apne bistaron par auraton se lutf-andoz na hote, aur tum sadkon par nikal jaate, Allah Ta'ala ke saamne cheekh-cheekh kar (dua) karte, Allah ki qasam, main chahta hoon ke kaash main aik darakht hota jise kaat diya jaaye."

e: [AI] "They were humbled and they took from it however they wanted."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur uske phal jhukaaye gaye, poora jhukaana}" (Surah Al-Insan 14) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unke liye jhukaaye gaye, to woh jaisa chaahein waisa hi le sakte hain."

e: [AI] "He mentioned the boats of the people of paradise, and then recited, 'And when you look, then you will see bliss and a great kingdom.' [Surah Al-Insan 20]"
hi: Unhone Jannat walon ki sawaariyon ka zikr kiya, phir yeh padha: "{Aur jab tum wahan dekhoge to na'mat aur badi baadshahat dekhoge}" (Surah Al-Insan 20).

e: [AI] From Abu Huraira in regards to His saying, Exalted and Mighty is He, "By the ones sent forth with a known mission" [Al-Mursalat 1], He said, "They are the angels who are sent forth with a known purpose."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur bhalaai ke sath bheje huay (farishton) ki qasam}" (Surah Al-Mursalat 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh farishte hain jo bhalaai ke sath bheje gaye."

e: [AI] "The Winds"
hi: Aik aadmi Ali (RA) ke paas khada hua aur poocha: "{Al-Aasifaat asfan} kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Hawaen."

e: [AI] About this verse, "Indeed, it [the sky] casts [at the devils] sparks [as if they were tawny camels]." [Al-Mursalat 32], he said, "During the period of ignorance, we would make short wooden pieces about the length of two or three arms, and we would raise them in the winter and call them "qasr" (palaces)." He said, "I heard from Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them) and was asked about the verse, "Yellow spears." [Al-Mursalat 33], he said, "The ropes of ships are tied together until they become like the middles of the sails."
hi: Is ayat "{Beshak yeh aisi chingaariyan phenkti hai jaisi mahal (qasr)}" (Surah Al-Mursalat 32) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Hum jahiliyat mein lakdi ko do ya teen haath ki lambaai mein kaat lete the, aur sardiyon mein ise uthaa kar rakhte, aur ise 'qasr' kehte the." Unhone kaha: aur maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko suna, unse "{Peele oont (jimaalat sufr)}" (Surah Al-Mursalat 33) ke baare mein poocha gaya, unhone kaha: "Kashtiyon ki rassiyan, aik doosre ke sath jama ki jaati hain yahan tak ke woh saaman ke bandhon jaisi ho jaati hain."

e: [AI] To create creation, Allah sent the wind which swept away the water until it disappeared from the surface of the land, including the area beneath the Kaaba. Then Allah extended the earth until it reached the desired length and width. Ibn Abbas showed me with his hand that it extended like this and like that. He said, "Allah made the mountains as stabilizers and pillars." Abu Qubays was one of the first mountains placed on the earth.
hi: Makhlooq ko paida karne ke liye, Allah ne hawa bheji, jisne paani ko cheer kar aik reti waala tila zaahir kar diya, jo Ka'bah ke neeche hai, phir usne zameen ko phailaaya yahan tak ke woh Allah ki chaahat ke mutabiq lambaai aur chaudaai mein pahunch gayi. Unhone kaha: aur yeh isi tarah phailti rahi, aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ne mujhe apne haath se dikhaaya, yun aur yun, unhone kaha: "To Allah ne pahaadon ko mazboot khonton ki tarah banaaya," to Abu Qubais pehla pahaad tha jo zameen mein rakha gaya.

e: [AI] "The era is eighty years."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Isme muddaton (ahqaab) tak rahenge}" (Surah An-Naba 23) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Aik 'huqb' assi (80) saal ka hota hai."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Abbas say, "Give us the water and quench our thirst."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Bharaa hua pyaala (dihaaqa)}" (Surah An-Naba 34) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh musalsal, bharaa hua (pyaala) hai." Unhone kaha: aur maine Abbas ko kehte suna: "Humein paani pilaao aur humare liye lab-a-lab bharo."

e: [AI] Sufyan asked, "How is the hadith (narration) that you told me about Umm Salih?" He replied, "Umm Salih narrated to me from Safiyyah bint Shaybah, who narrated from Umm Habibah, who said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The speech of the son of Adam is only good (ordered by) with righteousness, or forbidding evil, or mentioning Allah."'" Muhammad ibn Yazid said, "I have never heard a more strict (severe) hadith than this." Sufyan replied, "And what is the severity of this hadith? It was only transmitted by one woman from another woman. This is in the Book of Allah, the Almighty, which your Prophet ﷺ  was sent with." Then he recited, "On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will speak the truth" [An-Naba' 38], and said, "And He said, 'By time, indeed, mankind is in loss, except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience'" [Al-'Asr 1-3], and he also said, "There is no good in much of their private conversation except for those who enjoin charity or that which is right or conciliation between people" [An-Nisa' 114]. Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this hadith in his summary.
hi: Sufyan se poocha gaya: "Woh hadith jo aapne mujhse Umm Salih ke baare mein bayan ki thi, woh kaisi hai?" Unhone kaha: mujhe Umm Salih ne, Safiyyah bint Shaybah se, unhone Umm Habibah (RA) se hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ibn Aadam ka kalaam uske khilaaf hai, uske haq mein nahi, siwaye achhi baat ka hukum dene, buri baat se rokne, ya Allah ke zikr ke." Muhammad bin Yazid ne kaha: maine kaha: "Yeh to bohot sakht baat hai." To Sufyan ne kaha: "Is hadith mein kya sakhti hai? Yeh sirf aik aurat ne doosri aurat se naqal ki hai, jabke yeh Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab mein bhi hai jise usne tumhare Nabi (SAW) ke sath bheja," phir unhone padha: "{Jis din Rooh aur farishte saf bandh kar khade honge, koi baat nahi karega siwaye us shakhs ke jise Rahman ijaazat de aur woh theek baat kahe}" (Surah An-Naba 38), aur farmaya: "{Zamane ki qasam, beshak insaan ghaate mein hai, siwaye un logon ke jo imaan laaye, nek amal kiye, haq ki naseehat ki, aur sabr ki naseehat ki}" (Surah Al-Asr 1-3), aur farmaya: "{Unki aksar khusar-phusar mein koi bhalaai nahi, siwaye is ke ke koi sadqa, bhalaai, ya logon ke darmiyan sulah karaane ka hukum de}" (Surah An-Nisa 114) ayat. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Al-Mawt" is valid according to the condition of the two sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but it does not meet the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Maut." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ, when a quarter of the night had passed, used to say, "O people, remember Allah's favor on you. O people, remember that the shaking (of the Hour) will come after which comes calmness. Then the second shaking comes after which comes calmness. Then a third shaking will come and it will be followed by a calamity whose magnitude is beyond description. Then the Hour will be established with its signs." Ubayy bin Ka'b said, "O Messenger of Allah, I invoke salutations upon you frequently. How much of my supplication should I devote to you?" He said, "As you like."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab raat ka aik chauthaai hissa guzar jaata to farmaate: "Aye logo, Allah ki ne'mat yaad karo, Aye logo, yaad karo, 'Rajifah' (pehla jhatka) aa gaya, uske peechhe 'Radifah' (doosra jhatka) hai, maut apne sath jo hai le aayi." To Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aap par bohot durood bhejta hoon, to main apne durood mein se aapke liye kitna hissa rakhoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jitna chaaho."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to be asked about the Hour (i.e., the Day of Judgment) until the following verse was revealed to him: "They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival? In what [position] are you that you should mention it? To your Lord is its finality" [An-Nazi'at 43]. He ﷺ  responded, "It has no knowledge, except with God."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se Qayamat ki Ghadi (Hour) ke baare mein poocha jaata tha, yahan tak ke unpar yeh nazil hui: "{Woh aapse Qayamat ke baare mein poochte hain ke uska waqt kab hai, aap ise bataane mein kahan tak hain, iska ilm to sirf aapke Rab ke paas hai}" (Surah An-Nazi'at 42-44), to (yeh sawaal karna) khatam ho gaya.

e: “He frowned and turned away” was revealed about Ibn Umm Maktum the blind man. He came to the Messenger of Allah saying: ‘O Messenger of Allah! Guide me.’ At that time, there was a revered man from the idolaters with the Messenger of Allah. So the Messenger of Allah turned away from him and faced the other man, saying: ‘Do you think that there is something wrong with what I am saying?’ He said: ‘No.’ So it was about that that it was revealed.” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3331)
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kehne laga: "Mujhe hidayat den." Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas mushrikeen ke kuch buzurg log baithe huay the. Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) usse mudkar doosre ki taraf mutawajjeh hone lage aur poochte: "Kya tum dekhte ho jo main keh raha hoon usme koi harj hai?" To woh (mushrik) kehta: "Nahi." To isi baare mein "{Abasa wa Tawalla}" (Woh tevri chadhaaya aur mudh gaya) nazil hui.

e: [AI] "So we have understood all of this, then what is the matter with the father who then broke a stick that was in his hand and said, "By Allah, this is an act of exaggeration, follow what has been made clear to you from this book."
hi: "Yeh sab humein maloom ho gaya, lekin 'Al-Abb' kya hai?" Phir unhone apni haath ki lakdi tod di aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh to takalluf hai, jo is Kitaab se tumhein saaf-saaf samajh aa jaaye usi ki pairavi karo."

e: [AI] From Sawdah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "People will be resurrected barefoot, naked, and uncircumcised, afflicted by sweat and their perspiration reaching the level of their ears." I said, "O Messenger of Allah, won't people look at each other?" He said, "People will be occupied with something else." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited the verse, "On the Day a man will flee from his brother, and his mother and his father, and his wife and his children. For every man, that Day will be a matter sufficient unto him." [Quran 80: 34-36]
hi: Sawdah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, se, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Log nange paanv, nange badan, aur bagair khatna ke uthaaye jaayenge, pasina unke munh tak pahunchega aur kaan ki lau tak bhi." Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), haaye sharm ki baat, hum aik doosre ko dekhenge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Log iske baare mein mashghool honge." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Jis din aadmi apne bhai se, apni maa aur apne baap se, apni biwi aur apni aulaad se bhaagega, us din har aadmi ka apna maamla usse (itna) mashghool rakhne ke liye kaafi hoga}" (Surah Abasa 34-37).

e: [AI] "They will be covered with dust on the faces of the disbelievers, not on the faces of the believers." And this is the saying of Allah Almighty, "On the Day the faces will be covered with dust, covered with darkness." [Surah 'Abasa, 41]
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur zameen aur pahaad uthaaye jaayenge, phir dono aik hi zarb se pees diye jaayenge}" (Surah Al-Haqqah 14) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Dono gard-o-ghubaar ban jaayenge, jo kaafiron ke chehron par hoga, momino ke chehron par nahi," aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Us din kuch chehre aise honge jinpar gard-o-ghubaar hoga, unhein andhera dhaanp raha hoga}" (Surah Abasa 41).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever wants to see the Day of Resurrection, let him recite 'When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up' (Surah At-Takwir)."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo Qayamat ke din ko dekhna chaahe, woh 'Iza-ash-Shamsu-Kuwwirat' padhe."

e: [AI] "The gathering of animals is their death, and the gathering of everything is death except for jinn and humans."
hi: "Jaanwaron ka hashr (jama honay) unki maut hai, aur har cheez ka hashr maut hai, siwaye jinnaat aur insaan ke."

e: [AI] "They are the two men who are doing the work that leads them to enter both Paradise and Hell. The wicked will be with the wicked, and the righteous will be with the righteous."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur jab jaanein jodi jaayengi}" (Surah At-Takwir 7) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh do aadmi hain jo aik jaisa amal karte hain, aik hi tarah Jannat ya Jahannam mein dakhil hote hain - badkaar badkaar ke sath, aur neik neik ke sath."

e: [AI] "She is the beast's cow."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Phir main qasam khaata hoon peeche hatne walon ki, chalte-chalte chhup jaane walon ki}" (Surah At-Takwir 16) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh jangli gaay (mirg/nilgaay) hain."

e: [AI] When Uthman was killed, I felt a great panic. So, I went to Ali. While I was with him, a man asked him about the verse "The casting out of the stars" [Quran 81:15]. He said, "The planets."
hi: Jab Uthman (RA) shaheed kiye gaye, to mujhe bohot sakht khauf ne aa liya, to main Ali (RA) ke paas gaya, main unke paas hi tha ke aik aadmi ne unse poocha: "{Chalte-chalte chhup jaane walon}" (Surah At-Takwir 16) kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Sitaare."

e: [AI] "Yes, this is the time of Witr prayer, then recite (And by the night when it passes away, and by the dawn when it breathes) [Al-Takweer, 18]. 'It is correct with the condition of a Muslim and they did not leave it.'"
hi: "Witr ki achhi ghadi yehi hai," phir unhone padha: "{Aur raat ki qasam jab woh guzarne lage, aur subah ki qasam jab woh saans le}," (Surah At-Takwir 17-18). Muslim ki shart par sahih, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] A questioner came during the time of the Prophet ﷺ and asked, so the people remained silent. Then a man gave him and then the people also gave him. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever seeks goodness and gives it to him, then he will have his reward and the rewards of those who followed him will not be decreased in anything. And whoever seeks evil and gives it to him, then he bears its burden and the burdens of those who followed him will not be decreased in anything." Huzaifah ibn Al-Yaman recited, "A soul will know what it has put forth and kept behind" [Al-Infitar 5].
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke ahad mein aik saail (maangne wala) khada hua aur maanga, log khamosh rahe, phir aik aadmi ne usse kuch diya, to logon ne bhi usse diya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi achha tareeqa qaayam kare aur uski pairavi ki jaaye, to usse uska ajr milega aur unke ajr ke barabar bhi jo uski pairavi karein, unke ajr mein kami kiye bagair, aur jo koi bura tareeqa qaayam kare aur uski pairavi ki jaaye, to usspar uska bojh hoga aur unke bojh ke barabar bhi jo uski pairavi karein, unke bojh mein kami kiye bagair." Unhone kaha: aur Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (RA) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Har jaan ko pata chal jayega jo usne aage bheja aur peechhe chhoda}" (Surah Al-Infitar 5).

e: [AI] "He is the man who hires the man or the laborer, and he knows that he cheats in his measurement, so his sin is upon him." - Ibrahim ibn Yazid Al-Wah
hi: "Woh aisa aadmi hai jo kisi ko naukar rakhe ya naapne wale ko naukar rakhe, jabke usse pata ho ke woh naapne mein ghapla karta hai, to uska gunah usspar hai." Ibrahim bin Yazid kamzor (raawi) hain.

e: “When the believer commits sin, a black spot appears on his heart. If he repents and gives up that sin and seeks forgiveness, his heart will be polished. But if (the sin) increases, (the black spot) increases. That is the Ran that Allah mentions in His Book: “Nay! But on their hearts is the Ran (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.” [83:14] (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4244)
hi: Ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak momin jab koi gunah karta hai, to uske dil mein aik kaala nishaan pad jaata hai, agar woh tauba kare, isse baaz aaye, aur maghfirat maange, to uska dil isse saaf kar diya jaata hai, aur agar woh (gunah) barhaaye, to woh (nishaan) barh jaata hai yahan tak ke uska dil isse ghir jaata hai, aur yehi woh 'rain' (parda) hai jiska zikr Allah ne apni Kitaab mein kiya: {Hargiz nahi, balke unke dilon par woh cheezein cha gayi hain jo woh kamaate rahe hain}" (Surah Al-Mutaffifin 14).

e: [AI] "A mixture, but not a seal that seals."
hi: "Aik milaawat, sealing (bandh karne wali) muhr nahi."

e: [AI] "On the Day of Judgment, it will cast forth all that is in it and empty itself." [Al-Inshiqaaq 4] He said, "It will spew forth all that is within it of the dead."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jab aasman phat jayega, aur apne Rab ka hukum sunega jo uspar farz hai}" (Surah Al-Inshiqaq 1-2) ke baare mein, maine suna: "{Aur jab zameen phailaa di jaayegi}" (Surah Al-Inshiqaq 3), unhone kaha: "Qayamat ke din," "{Aur jo kuch usme hai use nikaal degi aur khaali ho jaayegi}" (Surah Al-Inshiqaq 4), unhone kaha: "Jo murde usme hain unhein bahar nikaal degi."

e: [AI] The house existed before the earth by two thousand years, "then the earth was extended." He said, "It extended it from beneath it."
hi: "Ghar (Ka'bah) zameen se do hazaar (2000) saal pehle tha," "{To jab zameen phailaa di jaayegi}" ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Uske neeche se phailegi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are three characteristics that, if someone possesses them, Allah will account for them with a light reckoning and will admit them to Paradise by His mercy." They asked, "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "The one who gives to those who have deprived him, forgives those who have wronged him, and maintains ties with those who have cut him off." They asked, "What then, O Messenger of Allah, if we do all of that?" He said, "Allah will account for you with a light reckoning and admit you to Paradise by His mercy."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen (khoobiyaan) jinme jis mein bhi hon, Allah uska hisaab aasaan lega aur apni rehmat se use Jannat mein daakhil karega." Unhone poocha: "Woh kaun si hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum usse do jo tumhein mehroom kare, tum usse maaf karo jo tumpar zulm kare, aur tum usse joda jo tumse rishta kaate." Unhone poocha: "To agar main aisa karoon, to mera kya hoga, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhara hisaab aasaan liya jayega aur Allah apni rehmat se tumhein Jannat mein daakhil karega."

e: [AI] From Abdullah in his statement, "Indeed, you will surely ride on top of one another." [Quran 84:19], he said, "The sky."
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Tum zaroor stage-ba-stage sawaar hoge}" (Surah Al-Inshiqaq 19) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Aasman."

e: [AI] It means your prophet ﷺ  said, "One situation after another."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Tum zaroor stage-ba-stage sawaar hoge}" (Surah Al-Inshiqaq 19) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: ya'ni tumhare Nabi (SAW) kehte hain: "Aik haalat ke baad doosri haalat."

e: [AI] Narrated Abu Hurairah: As for Ali, he narrated it to the Prophet ﷺ . And as for Yunus, Abu Hurairah did not mention him in this verse: "And a witness and a witnessed" (Surah Al-Buruj, 3). He said, "The witness is the Day of Arafah and the Day of Jumu'ah, and the witnessed is the promised Day of Resurrection." This is a hadith narrated by Shu'bah from Yunus ibn 'Ubaid, considered authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim) but they did not include it in their collections.
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, rahi baat Ali (RA) ki, to unhone isse Nabi (SAW) ki taraf marfoo' (uthaaya) kiya, aur rahi baat Yunus ki, to unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) ka is ayat mein zikr nahi kiya: "{Aur gawaah aur jispar gawahi di jaaye}" (Surah Al-Buruj 3), unhone kaha: "Gawaah Arafat ka din aur Jumu'ah ka din hai, aur jispar gawahi di jaaye woh Qayamat ka wa'da kiya hua din hai." Shu'bah ki hadith Yunus bin Ubaid se, Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "By the sky, containing constellations, surely your Lord’s punishment is severe and relentless until its completion."
hi: Qasam: "{Aur burjon wale aasman ki qasam}" (Surah Al-Buruj 1) "{Beshak tumhare Rab ki pakad bohot sakht hai}" (Surah Al-Buruj 12) ayat ke aakhir tak.

e: [AI] Indeed, from what Allah has created is a preserved tablet made of a white pearl. Its covers are made of red ruby, and its pen is light, and its writings are light. Every day, it is looked upon 360 times, and in each look, He creates, provides sustenance, brings life, causes death, honors, humiliates, and does whatever He wills. So, this is His statement: "Every day He is upon a matter." [Ar-Rahman 29]
hi: Allah ne jo cheezein paida kiin unme se aik Lauh-e-Mahfooz hai, jo safed moti se bana hai, jiske dono takhtay laal yaqoot se hain, jiska qalam noor hai aur jiski likhaai noor hai, Allah har din usme teen sau saath (360) baar ya martaba nazar daalta hai, aur har nazar mein woh paida karta hai, rizq deta hai, zinda karta hai, maut deta hai, izzat deta hai, zaleel karta hai, aur jo chaahe karta hai, aur yehi hai uska farmaan: "{Har din woh kisi na kisi kaam mein hai}" (Surah Ar-Rahman 29).

e: [AI] "The crucifixion" [Al-Tariq 7] is the crucifixion, and "the bars" [Al-Tariq 7] are four sides beneath the ribs.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Jo peeth aur seene ki haddiyon ke darmiyan se nikalta hai}" (Surah At-Tariq 7) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "{As-Sulb} peeth (ki haddi) hai, {At-Taraaib} paslion ke neeche ke chaar (4) hisse hain, har taraf se."

e: [AI] "The rain and the cracked earth." [Al-Tariq 12] He said, "The vegetation there."
hi: "Baarish," "{Aur zameen jo phatti hai}" (Surah At-Tariq 12) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Paudhon wali (zameen)."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to recite in Witr prayer, in the first Rak'ah, "Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High." In the second Rak'ah, he would recite "Say: O disbelievers." In the third Rak'ah, he would recite "Say: He is Allah, the One" and "Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak." Lastly, he would recite "Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind."
hi: Nabi (SAW) Witr mein pehli rak'at mein "Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la," doosri mein "Qul Yaa Ayyuhal-Kaafiroon," aur teesri mein "Qul Huwallahu Ahad," "Qul A'oozu Bi-Rabbil-Falaq," aur "Qul A'oozu Bi-Rabbin-Naas" padhte the.

e: [AI] We asked Aisha, "What used to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recite during the Witr prayer?" She replied, "In the first Rak'ah, he used to recite Surah Al-A'la (the Most High), in the second Rak'ah, Surah Al-Kafirun (the Disbelievers), and in the third Rak'ah, Surah Al-Ikhlas (the Unity) along with Surah Al-Falaq (the Dawn) and Surah An-Nas (Mankind)." Sa'id ibn Kathir ibn 'Ufair, who is a narrating authority among the people of Egypt, mentioned this Hadith and narration. I requested it at the time when I was writing a book about Witr prayer, but I did not find it. Later, I found it after Adh-Dhahabi stopped commenting on it in his summary.
hi: Humne Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) Witr mein kya padha karte the?" Unhone kaha: "Woh pehli rak'at mein 'Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la,' doosri mein 'Qul Yaa Ayyuhal-Kaafiroon,' aur teesri mein 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad' aur Mu'awwidhatayn padha karte the." Sa'eed bin Katheer bin Ufair, jo Misr walon ke hadith aur riwaayat mein imaam hain, ne Yahya bin Ayyub se yeh riwayat ki hai. Maine ise Witr ki kitaab likhwaate waqt talaash kiya, to na paayi, phir baad mein paayi. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to perform two units of prayer, followed by Witr prayer wherein he would recite after them "Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High" and "Say: O disbelievers!" And in Witr prayer, he would recite "Say: He is Allah, the One" and "Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak" and "Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) un do rak'aton mein jinke baad woh Witr padhte, 'Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la' aur 'Qul Yaa Ayyuhal-Kaafiroon' padhte, aur Witr mein 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad,' 'Qul A'oozu Bi-Rabbil-Falaq,' aur 'Qul A'oozu Bi-Rabbin-Naas' padhte."

e: [AI] He used to say, when he recited, "Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High" [Al-A'la 1], he said, "Glory be to my Lord, the Most High, who created and proportioned." He said, and this is the recitation of Ubayy ibn Ka'b.
hi: Ke jab woh "{Apne buland Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh karo}" (Surah Al-A'la 1) padhte, to kehte: "Subhaana Rabbiyal-A'la, alladhi khalaqa fasawwaa" (Paak hai mera Rab, buland, jisne paida kiya aur durust kiya). Unhone kaha: aur yeh Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ki qiraat hai.

e: [AI] Saad, indeed the Quran did not come down upon Musayyib nor upon the family of Musayyib. Allah Almighty said, "We will make you recite, so you shall not forget" [Al-Quran, 87:6]. And He said, "And remember your Lord when you forget" [Surah Al-Kahf, 18:24].
hi: Aye Sa'eed, Quran na Musayyib par nazil hua na Musayyib ke khaandaan par, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Hum tumhein zaroor padhaayenge, phir tum bhoologe nahi}" (Surah Al-A'la 6), aur farmaya: "{Aur jab tum bhool jao to apne Rab ko yaad karo}" (Surah Al-Kahf 24).

e: [AI] "So he approached him, and Umar looked at him and began to cry. He was asked, 'O commander of the believers, what makes you cry for this?' He replied, 'I remembered the saying of Allah Almighty in His book, "A deed that will keep on benefiting others long after the doer has passed away, it will water a blazing fire, fed from a boiling spring." (Surah Al-Ghashiyah, 4). That is what made me cry.' 'This is a story in its own time, for Abu Imran Al-Jawni did not live long enough to witness the time of Umar.'"
hi: To woh (Umar) uske paas jhaanke, Umar (RA) usse dekhne lage aur rone lage, unse poocha gaya: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aapko is se kya rula raha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ka apni Kitaab mein yeh farmaan yaad aa gaya: {Mehnat karne wali, thaki hui, dahakti aag mein jalegi, ubalte hue chashme se pilaayi jaayegi}" (Surah Al-Ghashiyah 3-5), "yehi cheez hai jisne mujhe rulaaya." Yeh waaqia apne waqt ke mutabiq bayan kiya gaya hai, kyunke Abu Imran Al-Jauni ne Umar (RA) ka zamana nahi paaya, lekin yeh hikayat apni jagah (theek) hai.

e: “I have been commanded to fight the people until they say: La ilaha illallah. If they say: La ilaha illallah, then their blood and wealth are protected from me, except for a right that is due from it, and their reckoning will be with Allah.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3928)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se jung karoon yahan tak ke woh 'La ilaha illallah' kahein, jab woh yeh keh dein, to unke khoon aur maal mujhse mehfooz ho jaate hain, siwaye iske haq ke, aur unka hisaab Allah ke zimme hai," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Aap unpar hukumraan nahi hain, siwaye us shakhs ke jo mudh jaaye aur kufr kare, to Allah use sabse bada azaab dega}" (Surah Al-Ghashiyah 22-24).

e: [AI] "The dawn of the daylight" {And ten nights} [Al-Fajr 2] He said, "The ten of sacrifice."
hi: "Din ki subah," "{Aur das raaton ki qasam}" (Surah Al-Fajr 2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Zil-Hajjah ke das (10) din."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ was asked about "Ash-Shafi' and Al-Witr" [Al-Fajr 3], he said, "They are both parts of the prayer."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se "{Shaf'a aur Watr}" (Surah Al-Fajr 3) ke baare mein poocha gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh namaz hai, isme kuch juft (shaf'a) hain aur kuch taaq (watr)."

e: [AI] "And Pharaoh commanded his wife to be tied to four stakes, then he placed a massive millstone on her back until she died."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Kheenton wale (Firaun), jinhone shehron mein sarkashi ki}" (Surah Al-Fajr 10-11) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Firaun ne apni biwi ko chaar (4) kheenton se baandh diya, phir uski peeth par aik bada chakki-pat rakh diya yahan tak ke woh faut ho gayi."

e: [AI] "Indeed, your Lord is in observation" [Al-Fajr 14]. The passing of the path has three bridges: a bridge on which is trustworthiness, a bridge on which is mercy, and a bridge on which is the mighty and majestic Lord."
hi: Qasam: "{Beshak aapka Rab zaroor ghaat mein hai}" (Surah Al-Fajr 14). Pul (Sirat) se guzarne mein teen pul hain - aik pul jispar amaanat hai, aik pul jispar rishtedaari hai, aur aik pul jispar khud Allah Ta'ala hai.

e: [AI] "To create whatever he wishes in it."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Nahi, main is shehar ki qasam khaata hoon, aur aap is shehar mein halaal (jaayez) hain}" (Surah Al-Balad 1-2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Unhein ijaazat di gayi ke woh isme jo chaahen kar sakte hain."

e: [AI] "It means by the parent Adam and what he gave birth to his offspring."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur baap ki aur jo usne janam diya}" (Surah Al-Balad 3) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Iska matlab hai Aadam (AS) baap hain, aur 'jo usne janam diya' unki aulaad hain."

e: [AI] "In the intensity of his creation, in his birth, the growth of his teeth, his complexion, his sustenance, and his circumcision."
hi: "Uski paidaish, uske daanton ke ugnay, uski jawaani, uski roz-marra ki zindagi, aur uske khatna mein takleef."

e: [AI] From Abdullah (and We guided him to the two paths) [Al-Balad 10], he said, "Good and evil."
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, "{Aur humne usse do raaste dikhaaye}" (Surah Al-Balad 10) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Bhalaai aur buraai."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic text is: "According to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Majestic, 'Or the feeding on a day of severe hunger' [Al-Balad 14]. Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah who said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Feeding a hungry Muslim is one of the causes of forgiveness.'"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ya bhookh ke din khaana khilaana}" (Surah Al-Balad 14) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: humein Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir ne, Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maghfirat ke sababon mein se aik hai bhooke Musalman ko khaana khilaana."

e: [AI] "The homeless one who has no home."
hi: "Woh matrook (chhoda hua) jiska koi ghar nahi."

e: [AI] "The dust that nothing protects from dust."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ya kisi ghaseeb aur ranj-zada miskeen ko}" (Surah Al-Balad 16) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh mitti (mein padha) hai jisse koi cheez mitti se nahi bachaati."

e: [AI] "The light of it" (And the moon when it follows it) [The Sun 2] "It follows it" (And the daylight when it illuminates it) [The Sun 3] He said, "He lit it" (And the sky and He built it) [The Sun 5] He said, "Allah built the sky" (And the earth and what He spread) [The Sun 6] He said, "He spread it" He said, (And the soul and what He proportioned for it. Then He inspired it to its wickedness and righteousness) [The Sun 8] He said, "He knew its misery and happiness" (Indeed, successful is he who purifies it, and indeed, failed is he who corrupts it) [The Sun 9] He said, "He misled it"
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur suraj aur uski roshni ki qasam}" (Surah Ash-Shams 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Uski roshni," "{Aur chaand ki jab woh uski pairavi kare}" (Surah Ash-Shams 2), "uska peecha kare," "{Aur din ki jab woh usse roshan kare}" (Surah Ash-Shams 3), unhone kaha: "Usse roshan kiya," "{Aur aasman ki aur jisne usse banaaya}" (Surah Ash-Shams 5), unhone kaha: "Allah ne aasman banaaya," "{Aur zameen ki aur jisne usse phailaaya}" (Surah Ash-Shams 6), unhone kaha: "Phailaaya," phir farmaya: "{Aur jaan ki aur jisne usse durust banaaya, phir usme uski badkaari aur taqwa daali}" (Surah Ash-Shams 7-8), unhone kaha: "Usne uski badnaseebi aur khush-naseebi pehchaan di," "{Beshak woh kaamyaab hua jisne isse paak kiya, aur woh naakaam hua jisne isse (gunahon mein) dabaaya}" (Surah Ash-Shams 9-10), unhone kaha: "Bhatka diya."

e: [AI] She obliged her to her immorality and her piety.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Phir usme uski badkaari aur taqwa daali}" (Surah Ash-Shams 8) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Usne uspar uski badkaari aur taqwa ko laazim kar diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are six whom Allah has cursed, and all the prophets have cursed them. They are: the one who adds something to the Book of Allah, the one who denies the divine decree, the one who oppresses with authority to humiliate those whom Allah has honored and to honor those whom Allah has humiliated, the one who abandons my Sunnah, the one who permits what Allah has forbidden, and the one who forbids what Allah has permitted." Sufyan said, "Recite Surah Al-Layl when it falls: 'As for him who gives and fears on Allah, and believes in the best [reward], We will ease him toward ease. But as for him who withholds and considers himself free of need and denies the best [reward], We will ease him toward difficulty'" [Quran 92:5-10]. Abu Ali reported it with a sound chain of narrators that I fear I have mentioned it before. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing it in this context.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chhah (6) log hain jinpar maine la'nat ki hai aur Allah ne bhi unpar la'nat ki hai, aur har Nabi ki dua qubool ki jaati hai (unke khilaaf) - Allah ki Kitaab mein izaafa karne wala, Allah ki taqdeer ko jhutlaane wala, zulm ke sath ghalba paane wala taake jise Allah ne izzat di usse zaleel kare aur jise Allah ne zaleel kiya usse izzat de, meri sunnat chhodne wala, mere Ahl-e-Bait ke liye woh cheez halaal samajhne wala jise Allah ne haraam kiya, aur Allah ke haram ko halaal samajhne wala." Sufyan ne kaha: "Surah Wal-Layl Iza Yaghsha padho: {Rahi baat us shakhs ki jisne diya aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiya, aur achhi baat ki tasdeeq ki, to hum usse aasaani ke liye aasaan kar dengay, aur rahi baat us shakhs ki jisne kanjoosi ki aur be-parwaah bana, aur achhi baat ko jhutlaaya, to hum usse mushkil ke liye aasaan kar dengay}" (Surah Al-Layl 5-10). "Isi tarah humein Abu Ali ne hadith bayan ki hai, aur iski sanad sahih hai, mujhe darr hai ke maine ise pehle bhi zikr kiya ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him, said: "There are six people whom Allah has cursed, and every prophet is heard (in their supplication). They are: the one who adds to the Book of Allah, the one who denies the decree of Allah, the one who oppresses with tyranny to humiliate those whom Allah has honored and to honor those whom Allah has humiliated, the one who permits what Allah has forbidden, the one who permits what is forbidden of my family, and the one who abandons my Sunnah." Imam Bukhari has cited the arguments of Ishaq bin Muhammad al-Farwi and Abdul Rahman bin Abi al-Rijal in his book Sahih, and this is more correct than the first chain of narration.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chhah (6) log hain jinpar maine la'nat ki hai aur Allah ne bhi unpar la'nat ki hai, aur har Nabi ki dua qubool ki jaati hai - Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab mein izaafa karne wala, Allah ki taqdeeron ko jhutlaane wala, zulm ke sath ghalba paane wala taake jise Allah ne izzat di usse zaleel kare aur jise Allah ne zaleel kiya usse izzat de, Allah ke haram ko halaal samajhne wala, mere Ahl-e-Bait ke liye woh cheez halaal samajhne wala jise Allah ne haraam kiya, aur meri sunnat chhodne wala." Imam Bukhari ne Ishaq bin Muhammad Al-Farwi aur Abdur Rahman bin Abi Ar-Rijaal se Al-Jaami Al-Sahih mein hujjat li hai, aur yeh pehli sanad se zyada durust hai.

e: [AI] Abu Quhafa, to Abu Bakr, I see that you are freeing weak slaves. If only you had freed strong men who would defend and support you! Abu Bakr replied, "Oh father, I only desire what I desire because these verses were revealed about it: '[He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself. And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded. But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High. And he is going to be satisfied.'" [Al-Layl 6] until His saying, the Exalted: "And there is not for any person any blessing from his Lord but that it is accounted for him. But [even so], you will not be satisfied." [Al-Layl 19].
hi: Abu Quhafa ne Abu Bakr (RA) se kaha: "Main dekh raha hoon ke tum kamzor ghulamon ko azaad karte ho, kaash tum jo kar rahe ho karte huay taaqatwar mardon ko azaad karte jo tumhari hifaazat karte aur tumhare liye khade hote." To Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Aye mere abba, main to sirf woh chahta hoon jiske baare mein yeh ayaten nazil hui hain: {Rahi baat us shakhs ki jisne diya aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiya, aur achhi baat ki tasdeeq ki, to hum usse aasaani ke liye aasaan kar dengay} (Surah Al-Layl 5-7) yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: {Aur kisi ka bhi uspar (koi) ehsaan nahi jiska badla diya jaaye, siwaye apne buland Rab ki raza chahne ke, aur ankareeb woh raazi ho jayega} (Surah Al-Layl 19-21)."

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  being shown what would be given to his ummah after him, so he was pleased with that. Allah, the Exalted, then revealed: 'By the morning brightness and by the night when it covers with darkness...' until His saying: 'And your Lord will give you, and you will be satisfied' (Quran 93:1-5). The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'So Allah gave him a thousand palaces in Jannah (Paradise), made of pearl with dust of musk, and in each palace, there is what is suitable for him.'"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko dikhaaya gaya ke unki Ummat ke liye unke baad kya kholi jayegi (khush-khabri), to woh isse khush huay." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Chaadhte suraj ki qasam, aur raat ki jab woh chha jaaye}" yahan tak ke unke farmaan "{Aur zaroor tumhara Rab tumhein degaa aur tum raazi ho jaaogay}" (Surah Ad-Duha 5) tak, unhone kaha: "To usne unhein Jannat mein hazaar (1000) mahal diye, moti se bane, jinki mitti kasturi hai, har mahal mein woh sab kuch hai jo unke shaayan hai."

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said, "I asked Allah a question that I would have liked that I had not asked Him. I mentioned the Prophets of my Lord and I said: O my Lord, You subdued the wind for Sulaymān (Solmon), and You spoke to Mūsá (Moses). Then Allah ﷻ said, 'Did I not find you an orphan and I gave you refuge? And lost and I guided you? And poor and made you self-sufficient?'" He said: "I said: Yes. I would have liked that I had not asked."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine Allah se aik sawaal poocha, aur main chahta hoon ke kaash maine woh na poocha hota, maine apne Rab ke Rusul ko yaad kiya, to maine kaha: 'Aye Rab, tu ne Sulaiman (AS) ke liye hawa ko musakhkhar kiya aur Musa (AS) se baat ki.' To woh, buzurg aur buland, farmaaya: 'Kya maine tumhein yateem nahi paaya to tumhein panaah di? Aur gumraah nahi paaya to tumhein hidayat di? Aur zaroorat-mand nahi paaya to tumhein ghina bakhsha?'" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To maine kaha: 'Ji haan,' aur main chahta tha ke kaash maine woh sawaal na poocha hota."

e:
[AI] "When the revelation came down: 'Perish the hands of Abu Lahab (an enemy of Islam), and perish he! His wealth will avail him not, nor his gains. He will be in a flaming fire, and his wife, the wood-carrier, will have upon her neck a rope of twisted palm fiber.' (Surah Al-Masad, 111:1-5)
A rope of twisted palm fiber, he said. It was said to the wife of Abu Lahab, 'Indeed, Muhammad has insulted you.' So she went to the Messenger of Allah while he was sitting with a group of people, and she asked, 'O Muhammad, for what reason do you insult me?' He replied, 'I swear by Allah, I have not insulted you except that Allah has insulted you.' She then asked, 'Have you seen me carrying firewood, or have you seen a rope of twisted palm fiber around my neck?' Then she left. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not receive any revelation for several days, until she came to him and said, 'O Muhammad, I do not see your companion (referring to the angel Gabriel) anymore. He must have abandoned you.' Then Allah revealed: 'By the forenoon, and by the night when it covers with darkness' (Surah Ad-Duha, 93:1). Your Lord has neither forsaken you nor hates you."
hi: Jab "{Abu Lahab ke haath tabaah hon, aur woh khud bhi tabaah ho}" yahan tak ke "{Aur uski biwi, lakdi uthaane wali, jiske gale mein khajoor ke reshon ki rassi hai}" (Surah Al-Masad 4-5) nazil hui, to Abu Lahab ki biwi se kaha gaya: "Muhammad (SAW) ne tumhari hajv (tanz mein shairi) ki hai." To woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi jabke woh majlis mein baithe huay the, usne kaha: "Aye Muhammad, aap mujhpar kis baat par hajv (tanz) karte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, maine tumpar hajv nahi ki, tumpar to sirf Allah ne hajv ki hai." Usne kaha: "Kya tumne mujhe kabhi lakdi uthaate dekha, ya mere gale mein khajoor ke reshon ki rassi dekhi?" Phir woh chali gayi. Rasulullah (SAW) kai din tak rahe jab unpar wahi nazil nahi hui, to woh (aurat) unke paas aayi aur kaha: "Aye Muhammad, mujhe lagta hai tumhare saathi ne tumhein chhod diya aur tumse naaraaz ho gaya." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Subah ki roshni ki qasam, aur raat ki jab woh chha jaaye}" (Surah Ad-Duha 1-2), "tumhare Rab ne na to tumhein chhoda hai na hi naaraaz hua hai."

e: [AI] "When the chapter (Surah) of Tabat Yada Abi Lahab was revealed, the narration was mentioned in the same exact way, letter by letter. And the saying of Allah Almighty: 'And as for the favor of your Lord, then talk about it' (Ad-Duha 11), I did not find in it a letter attributed to it and no saying from the companions. So, I mentioned in it two letters from the followers. Al-Hakim said: Its chain of narration is authentic, except that I found a flaw in it."
hi: Jab "{Abu Lahab ke haath tabaah hon}" nazil hui, to hadith isi tarah harf-ba-harf zikr ki. Aur Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan "{Aur apne Rab ki ne'mat ka zikr karo}" (Surah Ad-Duha 11) ke baare mein, mujhe ismein koi sanad-shuda riwaayat ya sahaba ka koi qaul nahi mila, isliye maine ismein tabi'een ke do aqwaal zikr kiye. Al-Hakim ne kaha: "Iski sanad sahih hai, magar mujhe ismein aik illat (khaami) mili."

e: [AI] "O young people, take advantage of every night that passes by! For I recite a thousand verses in it. I recite Surah Al-Baqarah in one prayer unit (rak'ah). I fast the sacred months and three days of each month, as well as on Mondays and Thursdays. Then I recite, 'And as for the favor of your Lord, speak about it' [Surah Ad-Duha, verse 11]. Al-Dhahabi did not include it in the summary."
hi: Abu Ishaq: "Aye jawaano ke giroh, mauqe se faida uthaao, mujhpar shaayad hi koi raat guzarti hai jismein main hazaar (1000) aayaten na padhoon, aur main aik hi rak'at mein Surah Al-Baqarah padh leta hoon, aur main haraam mahino mein roze rakhta hoon, aur har mahine ke teen din, aur peer aur juma'raat ko," phir unhone padha: "{Aur apne Rab ki ne'mat ka zikr karo}" (Surah Ad-Duha 11). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Imam Al-Dhahabi in summarizing
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was visited by Gabriel while he was playing with some children. Gabriel held him and pressed him until he was short of breath and then removed a clot from his heart, saying, "This is the share of Satan from you." He then washed it in a golden basin with Zamzam water and put it back in its place. Anas said, "Then the boys came running to their mother meaning his heart, and they said, 'Verily Muhammad has been murdered.' His heart approached them while he was turning pale." Anas said, "We could see the marks of stitches on his chest." The narration has been reported as authentic with a correct chain of narration, and it has also been narrated by Umar ibn Al-Khattab and Ali ibn Abi Talib, 'Nothing can overcome two easiness.'"

Note: The translation might not be exact as the Arabic text includes some abbreviations and references that cannot be precisely translated into English.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Jibra'il (AS) aaye jabke woh bachchon ke sath khel rahe the, unhone unhein pakda aur lita diya, phir unka seena cheer diya aur usme se aik lothda nikaala, aur farmaya: "Yeh tum mein se shaitan ka hissa hai." Unhone kaha: phir unhone use sone ke tashtari mein Zamzam ke paani se dhoya, phir usse joda, phir use uski jagah wapas rakh diya. Unhone kaha: aur bachche daudte huay unki (Nabi ki) maa, ya'ni unki dhaai (doodh pilaane wali), ke paas gaye, aur kaha: "Muhammad (SAW) ko qatl kar diya gaya hai." To unki dhaai unhein dhoondhte huay aayi, to woh unhein wapas aate huay mile, unka rang faaq (faaka/zard) tha. Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur hum unke seene par silaai ka nishaan dekha karte the." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) aur Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) se yeh riwayat sahih saabit hui hai: "Aik mushkil kabhi do aasaaniyon par ghaalib nahi aayegi." Aur yeh Nabi (SAW) se mursal sanad ke sath bhi riwayat ki gayi hai. Sahih hai Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorified be He, “Indeed, with hardship there is ease” [Ash-Sharh 6], it is related that the Prophet ﷺ went out one day cheerful and happy, laughing, and saying: “One hardship will never overcome two eases: ‘So indeed, with hardship there is ease. Indeed, with hardship there is ease’” [Ash-Sharh 6].[^1]
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak mushkil ke sath aasaani hai}" (Surah Ash-Sharh 6) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) aik din khush, masroor, hansty huay nikle, aur farma rahe the: "Aik mushkil kabhi do aasaaniyon par ghaalib nahi aayegi, {Beshak mushkil ke sath aasaani hai, beshak mushkil ke sath aasaani hai}" (Surah Ash-Sharh 5-6).

e: [AI] "The fruit that people eat" {and the fig} [Surah At-Tin 2]. "The fig tree" [Surah Al-Baqarah 63] said, "The mountain and {Sinai}" [Surah At-Tin 2] said, "The blessed."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Anjeer aur zaitoon ki qasam}" (Surah At-Tin 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh phal hain jo log khaate hain," "{Aur Toor-e-Sineen ki (qasam)}" (Surah At-Tin 2), unhone kaha: "{Toor} pahaad hai, aur {Sineen} ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Barkat wala."

e: [AI] "Whoever reads the Quran will not be returned to the lowest stage of life, so that he may not know anything after knowledge. And this is the saying of Allah Almighty: 'Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low, except for those who believe' [At-Teen: 6]. He said: 'Except for those who recite the Quran.'"
hi: Jo Quran padhe use zindagi ki sabse buri umr (buddhape ki kamzori) tak wapas nahi bheja jayega taake woh ilm ke baad kuch na jaane, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Phir humne use sabse neechi haalat mein laut diya, siwaye un logon ke jo imaan laaye}" (Surah At-Tin 6), unhone kaha: "Siwaye un logon ke jinhone Quran padha."

e: [AI] "The first Surah to be revealed from the Quran is 'Read in the name of your Lord who created.' If Ibn Uyaynah did not hear it from Az-Zuhri on the condition of being a Muslim."
hi: "Quran mein sabse pehle jo Surah nazil hui woh {Iqra Bismi Rabbikal-lazi Khalaq} hai," to Ibn Uyainah ne ise Az-Zuhri se nahi suna tha. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase into English is: "The first Surah that was revealed from the Quran is 'Read, in the name of your Lord.'"
hi: "Quran mein sabse pehle jo Surah nazil hui woh {Iqra Bismi Rabbik} hai."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  was in the cave of Hira' when the angel came to him with a garment that had something written on it. The angel said to him, 'Read in the name of your Lord who created.' [Quran 96:1] I heard Abu Ali Al-Hafiz say that there is mention of Jabir in its chain of narrators, but it is a weak narration."
hi: Nabi (SAW) Hira mein thay jab farishta unke paas resham ke aik tukde ke sath aaya jismein likha tha: "Iqra Bismi Rabbikal-lazi Khalaq" yahan tak ke "{Jo usne nahi jaana tha}" (Surah Al-Alaq 5). Maine Abu Ali Al-Hafiz ko kehte suna: "Jabir ka iski sanad mein zikr galat-fehmi hai."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  was in Hira, and the first connected hadith mentioned him. All the narrators of this hadith are trustworthy. I have compiled this book based on the acceptance of adding trustworthy narrators. As for the prostration in "Read in the name of your Lord" (Al-Alaq 1), Muslim reported it from Abu Tahir, from Ibn Wahb, from Amr bin Al-Harith, from Ubaidullah bin Abi Ja'far, from Al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah.
hi: Nabi (SAW) Hira mein thay, phir pehli musalsal hadith zikr ki, iske sare raawi mo'tabar (thiqa) hain, aur maine yeh kitaab isi bunyaad par tarteeb di hai ke mo'tabar raawi ki izaafi baat qubool ki jaati hai. Rahi baat "{Iqra Bismi Rabbik}" (Surah Al-Alaq 1) mein sajda ki, to Muslim ne isse Abu At-Taahir se, unhone Ibn Wahb se, unhone Amr bin Al-Harith se, unhone Ubaidullah bin Abi Ja'far se, unhone Al-A'raj se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, mursal (munqata') sanad ke sath nikaala hai.

e: [AI] "The instances of prostration in the Quran are not a revelation, except for the prostration in Surah As-Sajdah (The Prostration) and Surah An-Najm (The Star). And recite with the name of your Lord, the One who created." And I am astonished by the one who tells me but does not prostrate in the appropriate places.
hi: "Quran mein sajde ki taakeed shuda ayaten hain - Alif-Laam-Meem Tanzeel, Ha-Meem As-Sajdah, An-Najm, aur Iqra Bismi Rabbikal-lazi Khalaq," aur mujhe hairat hai us shakhs par jisne mujhse hadith bayan ki lekin woh Mufassal (chhoti Surahon) mein sajda nahi karta. Sahih.

e: [AI] "The Quran was revealed in one complete sentence on the night of Al-Qadr to the sky of this world, which was in the position of the stars. Allah would reveal it to His Messenger ﷺ  bit by bit. Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: 'And those who disbelieved say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.' [Surah Al-Furqan: 32]."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak humne isse Shab-e-Qadr mein nazil kiya}" (Surah Al-Qadr 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Quran Shab-e-Qadr mein aik hi baar duniya ke aasman tak nazil hua, jahan sitaron ki jagah thi," phir Allah apne Rasool (SAW) par isse aik ke baad aik nazil karta raha, farmaya: "{Aur jinhone kufr kiya woh kehte hain: Quran unpar aik hi baar mein kyun nazil nahi kiya gaya? Isi tarah, taake hum ismein tumhare dil ko mazboot karein, aur humne isse tarteeb se, thoda-thoda karke padha}" (Surah Al-Furqan 32).

e: [AI] The Quran descended in its entirety from the highest heavens to the lower heavens in one night. Then it was revealed gradually over the years. He (Prophet Muhammad) said, and recited this verse: "So I swear by the positions of the stars - and indeed, that is a great oath, if you only knew." [Surah Al-Waqi'ah 76]
hi: Quran Shab-e-Qadr mein sabse buland aasman se duniya ke aasman tak aik sath nazil hua, phir saalon mein taqseem hokar (thoda-thoda) utra. Unhone kaha: aur yeh ayat padhi: "{To main sitaron ke thikaanon ki qasam khaata hoon, aur beshak yeh, agar tumhein pata hota, aik badi qasam hai}" (Surah Al-Waqi'ah 75-76).

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) mentioning the night of Al-Qadr. So, I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, tell me about the night of Al-Qadr. Is it in Ramadan or outside of Ramadan?" He replied, "Indeed, it is in Ramadan." I then asked, "O Messenger of Allah, is it among the nights of the prophets, during which they were elevated? Or is it until the Day of Resurrection?" He said, "No, it is until the Day of Resurrection." I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, tell me in which ten nights of Ramadan it is." He became extremely angry with me, more than he had ever been before or after. He said, "If Allah willed, He would have made it known to you. Seek it in the last ten nights of Ramadan. Do not ask me about anything after that." I then said, "I swear to you by my right upon you, O Messenger of Allah, in which ten nights is it?" He became very angry with me, angrier than he had ever been before or after. He said, "If Allah willed, He would have informed you. Seek it in the last seven nights of Ramadan. Do not ask me about anything after that."
hi: "Kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko Shab-e-Qadr ka zikr karte suna?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein bataayen, kya yeh Ramzan mein hai ya Ramzan ke ilawa?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke Ramzan mein." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe bataayen, kya yeh Ambiya ke sath thi jab tak woh rahe, aur jab Ambiya ka intiqaal ho gaya to yeh utha li gayi, ya yeh Qayamat tak hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke Qayamat tak hai." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe bataayen Ramzan ke kis hisse mein hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aakhri das (10) mein, iske baad mujhse kuch aur na poochna." Maine kaha: "Main aapko qasam deta hoon aapke oopar mere haq ki, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh kaunse das mein hai?" Unhone kaha: to unhein mujhpar itna sakht ghussa aaya jitna pehle ya baad mein kabhi nahi aaya, aur farmaya: "Agar Allah chahta to tumhein iske baare mein bataa deta, isse aakhri saat (7) mein talaash karo, iske baad mujhse kuch aur na poochna."

e: [AI] About the soul, say: the soul is from the affair of my Lord, and you have not been given of knowledge except a little. They said: "We have only been given a little knowledge, and indeed, we have been given the scripture in which is the judgement of Allah. And whoever is given the scripture has certainly been given much good." He said: "Then it was revealed: Say, 'If the sea were ink for (writing) the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."
hi: Rooh ke baare mein: "{Kaho: Rooh mere Rab ke hukum se hai, aur tumhein ilm mein se sirf thoda diya gaya hai}" (Surah Al-Isra 85), unhone (Yahoodiyon ne) kaha: "Humein ilm mein se sirf thoda hi diya gaya hai, jabke humein Tauraat di gayi hai jismein Allah ka hukum hai, aur jise Tauraat di gayi ho use bohot khair di gayi hai." Unhone kaha: to yeh nazil hui: "{Kaho: agar samundar mere Rab ke kalimaat (ke likhne) ke liye siyaahi ban jaaye, to mere Rab ke kalimaat khatam honay se pehle samundar khatam ho jayega, agarche hum isi jaisa aur samundar madad ke liye laayen}" (Surah Al-Kahf 109).

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  read it to him, and it was written in it that the true religion in the sight of Allah is Hanifiyyah, not Judaism, Christianity, or Zoroastrianism. And whoever does good shall not be denied (reward)."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unhein "{Lam Yakun}" padh kar sunaayi, aur ismein padha: "Beshak Allah ke nazdeek asal deen Hanafiyat (khaalis tauheed) hai, na Yahudiyat, na Nasraniyat, aur na Majoosiyat, aur jo koi neki kare uska badla kam nahi kiya jayega."

e: [AI] "I am a believer, so let him say that I am in paradise." So he said, "Yes." Then Al-Mughira said and Abu Wa'il, the brother of Salamah, recited, "Those who disbelieved from the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) did not settle until the evidence came to them (the Prophet Muhammad) until [tal] was read to [yat] "And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion" [Al-Bayyinah 5] until His saying, "And that is the correct religion" [Al-Bayyinah 5] He recited it while facing the Murji'ah."
hi: "Main momin hoon, isliye woh keh de: main Jannat mein hoon." To Al-Mughirah ne kaha: "Haan." Aur Abu Wa'il, Shaqeeq bin Salamah, ne "{Lam Yakun-illazina Kafaru}" padhi, yahan tak ke pahunche: "{Aur unhein sirf yeh hukum diya gaya tha ke woh khaalis deen ke sath Allah ki ibaadat karein}" (Surah Al-Bayyinah 5) yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Aur yehi seedha deen hai}" (Surah Al-Bayyinah 5), unhone yeh Murji'ah (aik firqa jo sirf zubaani imaan ko kaafi samajhta tha) ko tanz kasne ke liye padhi.

e: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: Teach me to read the Qur'an, Messenger of Allah. He said: Read three surahs which begin with A.L.R. He said: My age is advanced, my mind has become dull (i.e. memory has grown weak), and my tongue has grown heavy). So he said: Then read three surahs which begin with H.M. He repeated the same words. So he said: Read three surahs which begin with the "Glorification of Allah". But he repeated the same excuse. The man then said: Teach me a comprehensive surah, Messenger of Allah. The Prophet ﷺ taught him Surah (99). "When the Earth is shaken with her earthquake". When he finished it, the man said: By Him Who sent you with truth, I shall never add anything to it. Then man then went away. The Prophet ﷺ said twice: The man received salvation. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1399)
hi: Aik aadmi Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe Quran padhaayen." Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Alif-Laam-Ra se shuru honay wali teen Surahen padho." Us aadmi ne kaha: "Meri umr badh gayi hai, mera dil sakht ho gaya hai, aur meri zubaan bhaari ho gayi hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To Ha-Meem se shuru honay wali teen padho." Usne pehle jaisi baat dohraayi. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To 'Musabbihat' (tasbeeh se shuru honay wali) teen padho." Usne wahi baat dohraayi. To us aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe aik jaame (mukammal) Surah padhaayen." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne use "{Iza Zulzilat}" (Surah Az-Zalzalah 1) padhaayi yahan tak ke usse khatam kiya. To us aadmi ne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, main isse kabhi zyada nahi karunga." Phir woh aadmi chala gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh chhota aadmi kaamyaab ho gaya," phir unhone woh cheez zikr ki jo usse (deen par) qaayam rakhegi.

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited: That Day it will declare its information. And said: 'Do you know what its information is?' they said: 'Allah and His Messenger know best.' He said: 'Indeed its information is that it will testify against every servant, male and female, It will say that he did such and such, on such and such a day.' He said: 'With this it shall be ordered.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2429)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Us din woh apni khabarein bayan karegi}" (Surah Az-Zalzalah 4), aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai iski khabarein kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iski khabarein yeh hain ke woh har banda aur bandi ke khilaaf gawahi degi ke usne uski peeth par kya amal kiya, woh kahegi: usne fulan din yeh ya woh kiya, to yehi iski khabarein hain."

e: [AI] While Abu Bakr As-Siddiq was having lunch with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , this verse was revealed: "So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it." [Az-Zalzalah 8]. Abu Bakr held him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, will we be held accountable for the evil we have seen?" He said, "What you dislike is what you will be recompensed for. Goodness is delayed for its people in the Hereafter." The narration is authentic and it was not transmitted as a hadith marfu'.
hi: Aik baar Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath khaana kha rahe the ke yeh ayat nazil hui: "{To jo koi zarre barabar neki kare, woh use dekhega, aur jo koi zarre barabar buraai kare, woh use dekhega}" (Surah Az-Zalzalah 8), to Abu Bakr (RA) ruk gaye aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya jo bhi buraai humne ki hai woh humein dikhaayi jayegi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo kuch tumhein napasand cheezon se pesh aata hai, wahi tumhein badle mein diya jaa raha hai, achhaai iske ahl ke liye Aakhirat mein moakhkhar ki jaati hai." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala, mursal (munqata').

e: [AI] "She is the horse." (Al-Adiyat 2) He said, "When a man covers his horse." (Al-Adiyat 3) The horses charge at the enemy, leaving a mark. (Al-Adiyat 4) He said, "The dust." (Al-Adiyat 5) The enemy, indeed, is ungrateful to his Lord. (Al-Adiyat 6) He said, "Disbelief." According to the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur hanfte huay ghodon ki qasam}" (Surah Al-Adiyat 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh ghode hain," "{Phir chingaariyan nikaalne walon ki}" (Surah Al-Adiyat 2), unhone kaha: "Jab aadmi apni chakmak se aag jalaata hai," "{Phir subah hamla karne walon ki}" (Surah Al-Adiyat 3), "ghode subah dushman par hamla karte hain," "{To ismein gard-o-ghubaar uthaate hain}" (Surah Al-Adiyat 4), unhone kaha: "Mitti (ka ghubaar)," "{Phir usse (dushman ke) jama'a ke beech ghusenge}" (Surah Al-Adiyat 5), "dushman ke," "{Beshak insaan apne Rab ka bohot na-shukra hai}" (Surah Al-Adiyat 6), unhone kaha: "Na-shukra (kufr karne wala)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When a believing servant dies, his soul is received by the souls of the believers, and they ask him, 'What did so and so do?' If he says that he died, they say, 'He has been taken to his mother, Al-Hawiyah (one of the names of Hellfire)' and how evil this mother is and how evil this caretaker (Hellfire) is."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab momin banda faut hota hai, to momino ki rooh usse milti hain, aur unse poochti hain: 'Fulan ne kya kiya?' Agar woh kahe ke woh faut ho gaya, to woh kehte hain: 'Usse Umm-ul-Haaviya (Jahannam) ki taraf lejaaya gaya,' to kitni buri maa hai aur kitni buri palne wali hai."

e: I came to Allah's Apostle ﷺ as he was reciting:" Abundance diverts you" (cii. 1). He said: The son of Adam claims: My wealth, my wealth. And he (the Holy Prophet) said: O son of Adam. is there anything as your belonging except that which you consumed, which you utilised, or which you wore and then it was worn out or you gave as charity and sent it forward? (Using translation from Muslim 2958a)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahuncha jabke woh "{Alhaakumut-Takathur}" (Surah At-Takathur 1) padh rahe the, aur farma rahe the: "Ibn Aadam kehta hai: mera maal, mera maal, jabke tere maal mein se sirf woh tera hai jo tu ne khaaya aur khatam kar diya, ya pehna aur purana kar diya, ya sadqa diya aur aage bhej diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I do not fear poverty for you, but I fear that you will indulge in worldly possessions excessively. I do not fear you making mistakes unintentionally, but I fear you committing them deliberately."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe tum par gharibi ka darr nahi, balke mujhe darr hai ke tum maal jama karne mein pad jaao, aur mujhe tumhare khataa ka darr nahi, balke mujhe darr hai ke tum jaan-boojh kar (gunah) karo."

e: [AI] Indeed, he has recited Surah Al-Asr and the calamities of time. Indeed, mankind is in loss.
hi: Ke unhone padha: "{Waal-Asr, wa nawaa'ibid-dahr, innal-insaana lafi khusr}" (Zamane ki, aur zamane ki museebaton ki qasam, beshak insaan ghaate mein hai).

e: [AI] From Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri, he said: "Woe to every backbiter and slanderer." [Al-Hamzah 1] He said: "Woe is a valley in Hell, in which the disbeliever falls for forty autumns before he completes the reckoning of people."
hi: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) se, "{Har taana-zan, bura-bhala kehne wale ke liye khaabi (afsos) hai}" (Surah Al-Humazah 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Al-Wail Jahannam mein aik ghaati hai jisme kaafir chaalis (40) saal tak girta rahega isse pehle ke uska hisaab khatam ho."

e: [AI] "He mentioned the fire and magnified its matter, and remembered from it what Allah willed to remember. Then he said, 'Indeed, it will be closed upon them in extended columns.'"
hi: Unhone aag ka zikr kiya, uski buzurgi bayan ki, aur usme se jitna Allah ne chaaha zikr kiya, phir kaha: "Beshak yeh unpar band ki jayegi, lambi-lambi khambon mein."

e: [AI] "The owners of the elephant approached Mecca, and when they reached it, Abdul Muttalib greeted them and said to their king, 'Why have you come to us? What do you need, O our Lord? Shall we bring you anything you desire?' The king replied, 'I have been informed about this House that no one can enter except those who believe. So I have come to frighten its people.' Abdul Muttalib said, 'We will bring you whatever you desire, so go back.' But he refused to leave until he entered. He started to walk towards it, and Abdul Muttalib climbed a mountain and said, 'I do not witness the destruction of this House and its people.' Then he said, 'O Allah! Indeed, for every god there is a permissible act. So prevent their permissible acts from overpowering them, O Allah, forever. O Allah, if you do this, then command what seems good to you.' Then a cloud came from the direction of the sea, and it covered them until birds carrying stones came and pelted them. As Allah Almighty has said, 'It flung at them stones of baked clay.' (Surah Al-Fil, 4) The elephant was then turned into chewed stubble.'" (Surah Al-Fil, 5)
hi: Haathi walon (Abraha ke lashkar) ne aage badhna shuru kiya yahan tak ke jab woh Makkah ke qareeb aaye, to Abdul Muttalib unke saamne aaye aur unke baadshaah se kaha: "Aap humare paas kya lekar aaye hain, humein aapse kya chaahiye, Aye humare Rab? Kya aap ne koi paighaam nahi bheja taake hum jo bhi aap chahte hain woh de sakein?" Usne kaha: "Mujhe is ghar ke baare mein khabar di gayi hai jismein koi bhi dakhil hota hai to woh mehfooz ho jaata hai, isliye main aaya hoon taake iske ahl ko khauf-zada karoon." Unhone kaha: "Hum aapko jo bhi cheez chaahen la sakte hain, isliye wapas jaayen." Usne inkaar kar diya siwaye is ke ke woh isme dakhil ho, aur uski taraf chalna shuru kar diya, aur Abdul Muttalib peechhe reh gaye, aur aik pahaad par khade hokar kaha: "Main is ghar aur uske ahl ki halaakat ka gawah nahi banunga," phir kaha: "Aye Allah, har ma'bood ka apna (khaas) haq hota hai, isliye tu apna haq (ghar) bachaa, unki chaalein tere fanaa-shuda (banaaye) mansoobon par kabhi ghaalib na aayen, Aye Allah, agar tu ne yeh kiya, to jo tujhe munaasib lage woh hukum kar." To samundar ki taraf se baadal jaisi cheez aayi yahan tak ke unpar aisi parinde chha gaye jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne "{Abaabeel}" kaha - "{Jo unpar sang-e-gil ke patthar phenkte the}" (Surah Al-Fil 4), unhone kaha: to haathi cheekhne laga, "{To Allah ne unhein khaaye huay bhus jaisa bana diya}" (Surah Al-Fil 5).

e: [AI] From his grandmother, Umm Haneeth, daughter of Abu Talib, it is narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Allah has favored Quraysh with seven privileges: that I am among them, and that prophethood is among them, and that the veil is among them, and that sustenance is among them, and that Allah aided them against the people of the elephant, and that they worshiped Allah alone for ten years without worshipping anyone else, and that Allah revealed a Surah in the Qur'an about them." Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited the verse, "For the accustomed security of the Quraysh - Their accustomed security in the caravan of winter and summer - Let them worship the Lord of this House, Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear." [Quraysh 2]
hi: Apni daadi Umm Hani bint Abi Talib (RA) se, ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne Quraish ko saat (7) khoobiyon se fazeelat di - ke main unme se hoon, aur Nubuwwat unme hai, aur Hijaabat (Ka'bah ki dekhbhaal) unme hai, aur Siqaayat (Hajiyon ko paani pilaana) unme hai, aur Allah ne unhein haathi walon par madad di, aur unhone das (10) saal Allah ki ibaadat ki jabke koi aur unki ibaadat nahi karta tha, aur Allah ne unke baare mein Quran ki aik Surah nazil ki," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne isse padha: "Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, {Quraish ki ulfat (mohabbat) ki wajah se, unki sardi aur garmi ke safar mein ulfat ki wajah se, isliye unhein is Ghar ke Rab ki ibaadat karni chahiye, jisne unhein bhookh se khaana khilaaya aur khauf se aman diya}" (Surah Quraish 2).

e: [AI] The phrase "الْمَاعُونُ الْعَارِيَةُ" is correct according to the conditions of the two famous scholars (i.e., the two sheikhs), but it is not mentioned in the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Al-Maa'oon (rozmarra ki cheezein) udhaar dena." Shaykhain ki shart par sahih, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "This is the obligatory zakat that they see from their prayers and withhold their zakat." This is a correct and transmitted chain of narration, as Mujahid did not hear it directly from Ali.
hi: "Yeh farz zakat hai, woh apni namaz mein dikhaawa karte hain aur apni zakat rok lete hain." Yeh sanad sahih hai lekin mursal (munqata') hai, kyunke Mujahid ne Ali (RA) se nahi suna.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about Al-Kawthar, to which he replied, "It is a river that Allah has granted me in Paradise. Its soil is musk, its taste is sweeter than honey, and its birds have necks like the necks of camels." Abu Bakr said, "O Messenger of Allah, it is beautiful indeed." The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "Its drink is more beautiful than its appearance." This hadith was narrated by Muslim from the narration of Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad, from al-Mukhtar ibn Fulful, from Anas, when the verse "Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar" [Quran 108:1] was revealed. It is complete and longer than this, but I have narrated it in the chains of Asim ibn Ali, for Abu Uwais is trustworthy, and Az-Zuhri does not preserve a Mursal hadith from his brother Abdullah. The well-known version of this hadith is from the narration of Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Muslim, from his father. This hadith is authenticated by Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se Al-Kawthar ke baare mein poocha gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh aik nehar hai jo Allah ne mujhe Jannat mein di hai, iski mitti kasturi hai, doodh se zyada safed aur shehed se zyada meethi, isme parinde aate hain jinki gardanein oont ki gardanon jaisi hain." To Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh to bohot narm-o-nazuk hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iska khaana ismein bhi zyada narm hai." Muslim ne isse Abdul Waahid bin Ziyaad ki riwayat se, Al-Mukhtaar bin Fulful se, Anas (RA) se, riwayat kiya hai, jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Beshak humne aapko Kausar diya}" (Surah Al-Kawthar 1). Yeh hadith mukammal aur is se lambi hai, lekin maine ise Aasim bin Ali ki sanad mein zikr kiya hai, kyunke Abu Uwais mo'tabar (thiqa) hain, aur Az-Zuhri apne bhai Abdullah se mursal hadith mehfooz nahi rakhte. Is hadith ki mash-hoor riwayat Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Muslim se, unke waalid se, hai. Yeh hadith Muslim ki taraf se sahih maani gayi hai.

e: [AI] "Al-Kawthar, a great abundance that Allah has given to him." Abu Bashr said, "I said to Sa'id, some people claim that it is a river in Paradise." Sa'id replied, "And the river is from abundant goodness."
hi: "Al-Kawthar woh khair-e-kaseer (bohot zyada bhalaai) hai jo Allah ne use di." Abu Bishr ne kaha: maine Sa'eed se kaha: "Kuch log kehte hain ke yeh Jannat mein aik nehar hai." Unhone kaha: "Nehar bhi khair-e-kaseer mein se hai."

e: [AI] "From Ali, he said: 'Pray and sacrifice for your Lord.' [Al-Kawthar 2] He said, 'His placement is your right hand over your left hand during salah.' And the second narration, Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary."
hi: Ali (RA) se, "{To apne Rab ke liye namaz padho aur qurbani karo}" (Surah Al-Kawthar 2) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Yeh namaz mein tumhare dayen haath ko baaye haath par rakhna hai."

e:
[AI] "When this verse was revealed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , it says, 'Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar. So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].'" (Al-Kawthar 2)

The Prophet ﷺ  asked Gabriel, "O Gabriel, what is this 'nahirah' that my Lord has commanded me to do?" Gabriel replied, "It is not a 'nahirah,' but rather, it is a command that whenever you enter a state of ritual consecration for prayer, you should raise your hands when you say the takbir (saying "Allahu Akbar"), when you bow, and when you raise your head after bowing. This is our prayer and the prayer of the angels in the seven heavens."

The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Raising the hands from the 'istikana' position is what Allah, the Almighty, said, 'But they did not prostrate to Allah when they were able, and they did not do humility.'" (Al-Mu'minun 76)

As for Israel, he is the owner of wonders that should not be relied upon. And the term "asbigh" refers to a group of abandoned Shia individuals according to An-Nasai."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) par yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Beshak humne aapko Kausar diya, to apne Rab ke liye namaz padho aur qurbani karo}" (Surah Al-Kawthar 2), Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Jibra'il (AS), yeh 'nahirah' (qurbani) kya hai jiska mujhe mere Rab ne hukum diya?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh qurbani nahi, balke woh tumhein hukum deta hai ke jab tum namaz ke liye takbeer-e-tahreema kaho, to takbeer kehte waqt, ruku karte waqt, aur ruku se sar uthaate waqt apne haath uthaao, kyunke yeh humari namaz hai aur un farishton ki namaz jo saat aasmano mein hain." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haath uthaana us 'istikaanat' (aajizi) se hai jiske baare mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {To unhone apne Rab ke saamne na aajizi ki na gidgidaaye}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 76).

e: [AI] He said to the Prophet ﷺ , "Give me something to say." The Prophet replied, "When you go to your bed, recite [Surah Al-Kafirun] until its end, for it is a disavowal from polytheism."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Mujhe koi aisi baat sikhaayen jo main kahoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum apne bistar par jao, to {Qul Yaa Ayyuhal-Kaafiroon} (Surah Al-Kafiroon 1) uske aakhir tak padho, kyunke yeh shirk se bezaari (aazaad honay) ka elaan hai."

e: [AI] The translation is as follows: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to frequently say, "Subhanak Allahumma wa bihamdik" (Glory be to You, our Lord, and praise be to You). But when the victory from Allah (God) and the conquest came, he said, "Subhanak Allahumma wa bihamdik Allahumma, forgive me. Indeed, You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) bohot zyada yeh kaha karte the: "Subhanaka Rabbana wa bihamdik," jab "{Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aa jaaye}" (Surah An-Nasr 1) nazil hui, to farmaya: "Subhanaka Rabbana wa bihamdik, Allahumma-ghfir li, innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Raheem" (Paak hai Tu, humare Rab, aur tera hi shukr hai, Aye Allah, mujhe bakhsh de, beshak Tu bohot tauba qubool karne wala, reham karne wala hai).

e:
[AI] "Lahab ibn Abi Lahab used to insult the Prophet ﷺ , so the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'O Allah, send upon him your dog.'"

Then he went on a caravan intending to go to Sham. He stopped at a place and said, "I fear the supplication of Muhammad ﷺ ."

They said to him, "No, do not worry." So they set up their belongings around him and sat guarding him.

Then a lion came and snatched him and took him away. (This hadith has a sound chain of narration, but it was not included by the compilers of the hadith collections) - Sahih Al-Isnad."
hi: Lahab bin Abi Lahab Nabi (SAW) ko bura-bhala kaha karta tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, apna kutta (sher) usspar musallat kar de." To woh Sham (Syria) jaane ke iraade se aik qaafile mein nikla, aik jagah utra, to usne kaha: "Mujhe Muhammad (SAW) ki dua ka darr hai." Unhone kaha: "Hargiz nahi." To unhone apna saaman uske ird-gird rakh diya aur baithkar uski hifaazat karne lage, phir sher aaya aur usse pakad kar le gaya. Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] He heard it from Umar ibn Habib.
hi: Ke unhone isse Umar bin Habib se suna. Umar bin Habib kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "And he (Pharaoh) said, 'Take away from me the wretched gain, meaning his son, his wealth and what he has earned.'" [Surah Al-Masad (The Palm Fiber), verse 2] according to the condition mentioned by Al-Bukhari.
hi: Aur usne kaha: "Napaak kamaai mujhse door kar do," ya'ni uski aulaad. "{Uska maal aur jo usne kamaaya, usse koi faida na diya}" (Surah Al-Masad 2). Bukhari ki shart par.

e: “The idolaters were saying to the Messenger of Allah: ‘Name the lineage of your Lord for us.’ So Allah, Most High, revealed: Say: “He is Allah, the One. Allah As-Samad.” So As-Samad is ‘the One Who does not beget, nor is He begotten,’ because there is nothing born except it will die, and there is nothing that dies except that it will be inherited from, and verily. Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, does not die, nor is He inherited from. ‘And there is none comparable to Him.’ He said: ‘There is nothing similar to Him, nor equal to Him, nor is there anything like Him.’” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3364)
hi: Mushrikeen ne kaha: "Aye Muhammad, humein apne Rab ka nasab bataayen." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Kaho: Woh Allah, aik hai, Allah Samad hai}" (Surah Al-Ikhlas 1-2), unhone kaha: "Samad woh hai jo na kisi ko paida karta," "{aur na woh khud paida hua, aur uske jaisa koi nahi}" (Surah Al-Ikhlas 3-4), kyunke koi bhi cheez jo paida hoti hai woh zaroor marti hai, aur koi bhi cheez jo marti hai uska tarka baanta jaata hai, aur Allah na marta hai na uska tarka baanta jaata hai. "{Aur uske jaisa koi nahi}" (Surah Al-Ikhlas 4) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Uski koi misaal nahi, na barabar, aur uski manind koi cheez nahi."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, shall I recite from Surah Yusuf and Surah Hud?" He replied, "O 'Uqbah, recite! Seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak, for you will not recite a surah that is more beloved to Allah and more comprehensive in His sight than it. If you are able to not miss it, then do so."
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main Surah Yusuf aur Surah Hud padhoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Uqbah, {A'oozu bi-Rabbil-Falaq} padho, kyunke tum Allah ke nazdeek isse zyada aziz aur behtareen koi Surah nahi padhoge, isliye agar tum se ho sake ke yeh tumse na chhote, to aisa karo."
