e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ took her hand and pointed with it to the moon, and said, "Seek refuge in Allah from the evil of this, for it is the time of eclipse." This hadith has an authentic chain of narration and it has not been narrated in a Sahih hadith collection.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne uska haath pakda aur usse chaand ki taraf ishara kiya, phir farmaya: "Allah se iski buraai se panaah maango, kyunke yeh Al-Ghaasiq hai jab woh chha jaaye." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: “The Prophet ﷺ came to visit me (when I was sick), and said to me: ‘Shall I not recite for you a Ruqyah that Jibra’il brought to me?’ I said: ‘May my father and mother be ransomed for you! Yes, O Messenger of Allah!’ He said: Bismillah arqika, wallahu yashfika, min kulli da’in fika, min sharrin- naffathati fil-‘uqad, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad (In the Name of Allah I perform Ruqyah for you, from every disease that is in you, and from the evil of those who (practice witchcraft when they) blow in the knots, and from the evil of the envier when he envies), three times.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3524)
hi: Nabi (SAW) meri ayaadat ke liye aaye, aur farmaya: "Kya main tumhein aik ruqyah na padhaaun jo mujhe Jibra'il (AS) ne padhaayi thi?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Bismillahi arqeeka, wallahu yashfeeka, min kulli daa'in feeka, min sharrin-naffaathaati fil-uqad, wa min sharri haasidin izaa hasad" (Allah ke naam se main tumhein dam karta hoon, Allah tumhein shifa de, tumhare andar ki har bimaari se, gaanth mein phoonkne wali auraton ki buraai se, aur hasad karne wale ki buraai se jab woh hasad kare), to unhone yeh teen martaba padh kar dam kiya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Every newborn is born with whisperings in his heart. If he mentions Allah, these whisperings diminish, but if he is negligent, the whisperings increase. This is mentioned in the verse: "The persistent whisperer (devil) who withdraws (upon recitation of the Quran)" [Surah An-Nas: 4].
hi: Koi bhi paida honay wala aisa nahi jiske dil par waswasa (shaitani) na aata ho, agar woh Allah ko yaad kare to woh peeche hat jaata hai, aur agar woh ghaafil ho jaaye to woh waswasa daalta hai, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Waswasa daalne wala, peeche hatne wala}" (Surah An-Nas 4).

e: [AI] We learned the Quran in this mosque, which is known as the Basra Mosque. We used to sit in circles, as if I was watching it between two white garments. I took this Surah from it, "Read in the name of your Lord who created." [Al-Alaq 1] He said, and it was the first Surah revealed to Muhammad ﷺ.
hi: Humne is masjid mein, ya'ni Basra ki masjid mein, Quran seekha, hum halqon mein baitha karte the, aur mujhe aisa lagta hai jaise main unhein do safed kapdon ke darmiyan dekh raha hoon, aur unhi se maine yeh Surah li: "{Iqra Bismi Rabbikal-lazi Khalaq}" (Surah Al-Alaq 1). Unhone kaha: "Aur yeh Muhammad (SAW) par sabse pehle nazil honay wali Surah thi."

e: [AI] The first verse that was revealed is "Read in the name of your Lord, who created." [Al-Alaq 1]. According to a Muslim condition.
hi: "Sabse pehle jo Surah nazil hui woh {Iqra Bismi Rabbikal-lazi Khalaq}" (Surah Al-Alaq 1) hai. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The first thing that was revealed from the Quran, "Read in the name of your Lord Who created" (Al-Alaq 1), based on the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Quran mein se sabse pehle jo cheez nazil hui woh {Iqra Bismi Rabbikal-lazi Khalaq}" (Surah Al-Alaq 1) hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: Ibn ‘Abbas ؓ said to us. I said to ‘Uthman bin ʿAffan: What made you take al-Anfal, which is one of al-Mathani (the seven long soorahs), and Baraʿah, which is one of al-Miʿeen (soorahs with one hundred verses or thereabouts), and put them next to one another and not write - Ibn Jaʿfar said: A line between them saying Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem - and you put them with the seven long ones? What made you do that? ʿUthman ؓ said: Sometimes many soorahs would be revealed (incomplete) to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and when something was revealed he would call one of the scribes to write it down for him and say: “Put this in the Soorah in which such and such is mentionedʿ; and verses would be revealed to him and he would say, ʿPut these verses in the soorah in which such and such is mentioned”; and a verse would be revealed to him and he would say: ʿPut this verse in the soorah in which such and such is mentioned.” Al-Anfal was one of the first soorahs to be revealed in Madinah and Baraʿah was one of the last soorahs of the Qurʿan, and the stories and content of the two soorahs were similar. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away without having stated clearly to us that it was part of it, but we thought that it was, hence I put them together and I did not put between them the line Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Ibn Jaʿfar said: I put it with the seven long ones. (Using translation from Aḥmad 399)
hi: Maine Uthman bin Affan (RA) se poocha: "Aapne Al-Anfal, jo Mathaani mein se hai, aur Bara'ah, jo Ma'een (sau-sau ayaton wali Surahon) mein se hai, ko aapas mein joda, aur unke darmiyan Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem ki satar nahi likhi, aur unhein saat lambi Surahon mein rakh diya, isspar aapko kis cheez ne ubhaara?" To Uthman (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) par aisa waqt aata tha ke unpar kayi Surahen (thodi-thodi) nazil hoti thin, jab bhi unpar koi cheez nazil hoti to woh apne kisi likhne wale ko bulaate aur farmaate: 'Isse us Surah mein rakho jismein fulan-fulan ka zikr hai,' aur jab unpar ayat nazil hoti to farmaate: 'Isse us Surah mein rakho jismein fulan-fulan ka zikr hai.' Al-Anfal Madinah mein sabse pehle nazil honay wali Surahon mein se thi, aur Bara'ah Quran ke aakhir mein nazil hui, aur uska qissa uske (Al-Anfal ke) qisse jaisa tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal ho gaya aur unhone humein saaf saaf nahi bataya ke woh usi mein se hai, isliye maine unhein aapas mein joda aur unke darmiyan Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem ki satar nahi likhi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said on the day of Badr, "Whoever kills a warrior, he will have this and that reward." The elders stood firm under the banners, while the young men hastened towards fighting and gaining spoils. The elders said to the young men, "Include us with you, for we were a shield for you. If you had anything, you would have come to us." They refused, so they argued and went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Then the verse (They ask you about the spoils) [Quran 8:1] was revealed, and the spoils were distributed equally among them.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din farmaya: "Jo koi kisi ko qatl kare, uske liye yeh aur yeh (inaam) hai," to boodhe log jhandon ke neeche jame rahe, jabke jawaan qatl aur maal-e-ghaneemat ki taraf tezi se bhaage, to boodhon ne jawaano se kaha: "Humein bhi apne sath shareek karo, kyunke hum tumhare liye peeche se sahaara the, aur agar tumhein koi museebat pesh aati to tum humari taraf hi aate," to unhone inkaar kiya, to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas apna jhagda pesh kiya, unhone kaha: to yeh nazil hui: "{Woh aapse maal-e-ghaneemat ke baare mein poochte hain}" (Surah Al-Anfal 1), to maal-e-ghaneemat unke darmiyan barabar taqseem kiya gaya.

e: [AI] "Allah sent down the Quran to the lower heaven on the Night of Decree. Whenever Allah wills to reveal something from it or bring about something on the earth, He commands it to occur."
hi: "Allah ne Quran duniya ke aasman tak Shab-e-Qadr mein nazil kiya, phir jab Allah usme se koi cheez wahi karna chahta to karta, aur jab zameen mein koi naya waqia paida karna chahta to karta."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr and Uthman, the sons of Abu Shaybah, narrated that Jarir reported from Mansour, who reported from Sa'id ibn Jubair, who reported from Ibn Abbas regarding the saying of Allah, 'Verily, We have sent it down in the Night of Power.' (Quran 97:1) He said, "The Quran was revealed as a whole in one night of the Night of Power to the lower heaven, in the position of the stars. And Allah would reveal it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  part by part in succession." He also said, "They said, 'Why was the Quran not sent down to him all at once? Thus, we would strengthen your heart thereby. And We have revealed it to you in gradual stages.'" (Quran 25:32)
hi: Abu Bakr aur Uthman, Abi Shaybah ke dono betay, ne humein hadith bayan ki, Jareer ne, Mansoor se, unhone Sa'eed bin Jubair se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak humne isse Shab-e-Qadr mein nazil kiya}" (Surah Al-Qadr 1) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Quran Shab-e-Qadr mein aik hi baar duniya ke aasman tak nazil hua, jahan sitaron ki jagah thi, aur Allah usse Rasulullah (SAW) par aik ke baad aik nazil karta raha." Unhone kaha: aur unhone kaha: "{Jinhone kufr kiya woh kehte hain: Quran unpar aik hi baar mein kyun nazil nahi kiya gaya? Isi tarah, taake hum ismein tumhare dil ko mazboot karein, aur humne isse tarteeb se, thoda-thoda karke padha}" (Surah Al-Furqan 32).

e: [AI] The Quran was revealed in its entirety to the lower heaven on the Night of Decree, and then revealed after that over the course of twenty years. "And they bring you not an example but We bring you the truth and the best interpretation of it." [Al-Furqan 33] "And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively." [Al-Isra' 106]
hi: Quran Shab-e-Qadr mein aik hi baar duniya ke aasman tak nazil hua, phir uske baad bees (20) saal mein nazil hota raha. "{Aur woh tumhare paas koi misaal nahi laate magar hum tumhein haq aur behtareen tafseer de dete hain}" (Surah Al-Furqan 33), "{Aur Quran, humne ise alag-alag kiya taake tum ise logon ko theher-theher kar padho, aur humne ise thoda-thoda karke nazil kiya}" (Surah Al-Isra 106).

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  received a revelation, none of us could even raise their gaze towards him until the revelation had been completed."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab unpar wahi utarti, to hum mein se koi bhi apni nazar unki taraf uthaane ki himmat na kar paata yahan tak ke wahi khatam ho jaati."

e: [AI] "The Quran was separated from the remembrance and was placed in the House of Honor in the lowest heaven. Then Gabriel, peace be upon him, descended it upon the Prophet ﷺ  and recited it to him."
hi: "Quran ko Zikr (Lauh-e-Mahfooz) se alag kiya gaya, phir isse duniya ke aasman mein Bait-ul-Izzat (Izzat ke Ghar) mein rakha gaya, phir Jibra'il (AS) isse Nabi (SAW) par nazil karte aur tarteeb se padhte rahe."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Disputing in the Quran is disbelief." Umar ibn Abu Salamah then narrated this from his father, according to the conditions of Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran mein jhagda karna kufr hai." Umar bin Abi Salamah ne isse apne waalid se, isi tarah riwayat ki. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Debating about the Quran is disbelief." This is a narration from al-Mu'tamir from Muhammad ibn Amr, authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, but they did not include it. As for Umar ibn Abi Salamah, they did not use it as evidence.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran mein jhagda karna kufr hai." Al-Mu'tamir ki hadith, Muhammad bin Amr se, Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Rahi baat Umar bin Abi Salamah ki, to dono ne unse hujjat nahi li.

e: [AI] From the Prophet (pbuh) who said, "The Quran was revealed with three letters."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran teen harfon (tareeqon) par nazil kiya gaya."

e: [AI] "Read for me, O Messenger of Allah, Surah Ham. I went to the mosque in the evening and a group of people sat with me. I said to a man from the group, 'Read upon me.' So he started reciting letters which I could not recite. I asked him, 'Who taught you this recitation?' He replied, 'The Messenger of Allah taught me.' So we went to the Messenger of Allah and there was a man sitting with him. I said to him, 'We have a difference in our recitation.' When the Messenger of Allah turned his attention towards us, his facial expression changed and I saw in him that he found it strange when I mentioned the difference. He said, 'The differences have destroyed those who came before you.' Then he whispered to me, and Ali said, 'The Messenger of Allah commands you all to recite as you have been taught.' So we left, and each one of us recited letters that his companion could not recite."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe Surah Ha-Meem padhaayi, phir main shaam ko masjid gaya, kuch log mere paas baithe, maine unme se aik aadmi se kaha: "Mujhe padh kar sunaao," to woh aise harf padhne laga jo main nahi padhta tha, maine usse poocha: "Tumhein yeh kisne padhaayi?" Usne kaha: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne padhaayi." To hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye, waha unke paas aik aadmi (pehle se) tha, maine unse kaha: "Humari qiraat mein ikhtilaaf ho gaya hai," to Rasulullah (SAW) ka chehra badal gaya, aur jab maine unhein ikhtilaaf ka zikr kiya to unhein bura laga, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumse pehle logon ko sirf ikhtilaaf ne hi halaak kiya tha." Phir Ali (RA) ne mujhse chupke se kaha, aur Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) tumhein hukum dete hain ke tum mein se har aadmi jaisa jaanta hai waisa hi padhe." To hum chale gaye, aur hum mein se har aadmi aise harf padhta jo uska saathi nahi padhta tha.

e: [AI] We went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and found a man with him. He said, "Visit him, for they are appointing him as the successor, meaning Ali."
hi: Isme (yeh bhi hai) ke: hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye, waha unke paas aik aadmi tha, Zirr ne kaha: "Woh log unhein khaas taur par (rehnumaai ke liye) dekh rahe the," ya'ni Ali (RA) ko.

e: [AI] "Do not oppose people with your opinion in following."
hi: "Ke log apni raay se pairavi mein tumhari mukhalifat na karein."

e: [AI] "We have read the detailed Quran in Makkah as a pilgrimage, O believers."
hi: "Humne Makkah mein kayi saal Al-Mufassal (chhoti Surahen) padhi, jinme 'Aye imaan walo' (jaisi ayaten) nahi thin."

e: [AI] "To me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, Allah has commanded me to recite the Quran to you.' So he recited, 'Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists' [Al-Bayyinah, 1]. And from his description is that if the son of Adam asked for a valley full of wealth, then he would ask for a second, and if he were given a second, he would ask for a third, and nothing would fill the stomach of the son of Adam except dust. And Allah forgives those who repent. Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam. And whoever does righteousness will not be denied [his due reward].'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai ke main tumhein Quran padh kar sunaaun," to unhone "{Lam Yakun-illazina Kafaru min Ahlil-Kitaabi wal-Mushrikeen}" (Surah Al-Bayyinah 1) padhi, aur iske ausaaf mein se yeh bhi hai: "Agar Ibn Aadam maal ki aik poori ghaati maange aur main use de dun, to woh doosri maangega, aur agar main use doosri de dun to woh teesri maangega, aur Ibn Aadam ka pait sirf mitti hi bhar sakti hai, aur Allah us shakhs ki tauba qubool karta hai jo tauba kare, aur beshak Allah ke nazdeek asal deen Hanafiyat (khaalis tauheed) hai, na Yahudiyat na Nasraniyat, aur jo koi neki kare uska badla kam nahi kiya jayega."

e: [AI] From Nubayh Al-Anzi, from Ibn Abbas, who said: While I was reciting a verse from the Book of Allah Almighty and walking in one of the streets of Madinah, suddenly a man called out to me from behind, saying, "Follow Ibn Abbas." It turned out to be the Amir al-Mu'minin Umar. I said, "Shall I follow you to Ubayy ibn Ka'b and see if he recites it the same way?" He said, "Did he recite it to you the way you recited it?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Then send with me a messenger." He said, "Go with him to Ubayy ibn Ka'b, and see if he recites it the same way." So I set out with his messenger to Ubayy ibn Ka'b. I said, "O Ubayy, I recited a verse from the Book of Allah, and then Umar ibn al-Khattab called me after himself and said, 'Follow Ibn Abbas.' I said, 'Shall I follow you to Ubayy ibn Ka'b and see if he recites it the same way?' Then he sent his messenger with me, and did you recite it to him the way you recited it to me?" Ubayy said, "Yes." So the messenger returned to him, and I went about my business. Umar went to Ubayy, and I found him finishing washing his head, with his slave girl twisting his beard with a comb. Ubayy said, "Welcome, O Amir al-Mu'minin. Have you come as a visitor, or do you have a need?" Umar said, "I have a need." He sat down, and with him were two of his servants, until he finished his beard and she combed back the right side. Then she combed the left side. When he finished, he turned his face towards Umar and said, "What is the need of the Amir al-Mu'minin?" Umar said, "O Ubayy, how well the people are being deceived!" Ubayy said, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, I received the Qur'an directly from Jibreel while he was moist." Umar said, "By Allah, neither are you at fault, nor am I forbearing with you." He repeated this three times, then he got up and went away.
hi: Nubaih Al-Anzi se, Ibn Abbas (RA) se, unhone kaha: jabke main Madinah ke aik raaste mein chal raha tha aur Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab ki aik ayat padh raha tha, achaanak aik aadmi mere peechhe se mujhe pukaarne laga: "Ibn Abbas ki pairavi karo," to woh Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar (RA) the, maine kaha: "Main aapki is baat mein pairavi karta hoon jo Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ke baare mein hai?" Unhone poocha: "Kya unhone tumhein isse waise hi padhaaya jaise maine tumhein padhte suna?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "To mere sath aik qaasid bhej do." Unhone (Umar ne) kaha: "Iske sath Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ke paas jao aur dekho kya Ubayy isi tarah padhaate hain?" Unhone kaha: to main aur unka qaasid Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ke paas gaye, maine kaha: "Aye Ubayy, maine Allah ki Kitaab ki aik ayat padhi, to mere peechhe se Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne mujhe pukaara: 'Ibn Abbas ki pairavi karo,' maine kaha: 'Main aapki is baat mein pairavi karta hoon jo Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ke baare mein hai,' to unhone mere sath apna qaasid bheja, to kya aapne mujhe yeh waise hi padhaayi thi jaise aapne khud padhi thi?" Ubayy (RA) ne kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: to qaasid unke paas wapas laut gaya, aur main apne kaam ki taraf chala gaya. Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) Ubayy (RA) ke paas gaye, unhein apna sar dho kar faarigh paaya, aur unki laundi kanghi se unki daadhi sanwaar rahi thi, to Ubayy (RA) ne kaha: "Khush-aamdeed, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, kya aap milne aaye hain ya koi zaroorat lekar?" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Balke zaroorat hai." Unhone kaha: to woh baith gaye, unke sath unke do ghulam bhi the, yahan tak ke woh apni daadhi se faarigh huay aur unki laundi ne unke sar ka dayan hissa sanwaara, phir baayan hissa, jab woh faarigh huay to Umar (RA) ki taraf apna chehra kiya aur poocha: "Ameer-ul-Momineen ki kya zaroorat hai?" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Ubayy, tum kis (ayat ki tafseer) par logon ko mayoos karte ho?" Ubayy (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, maine Quran Jibra'il (AS) se seedhe taur par liya jabke woh (wahi) taaza thi." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tum baaz nahi aaoge aur main sabr nahi karunga," teen martaba (yeh farmaya), phir khade hokar chale gaye.

e: [AI] He used to recite, "When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance..." (Quran 48:26) "And if you could but see when they are made to stand at the (Hell) Fire and will say, 'Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers.'" (Quran 6:27) When Umar heard this, he became furious. Ubayy said to him, "Do you want to argue with me? I know that I used to enter upon the Prophet ﷺ  and he would recite to me, and you would be at the door. If you would like, I can recite to the people according to what he used to recite to me, but if not, then I will not recite a single letter." Umar replied, "Rather, recite to the people."
hi: Ke woh padhte the: "{Jab kaafiron ne apne dilon mein zid daali, jahiliyat ki zid}" (Surah Al-Fath 26) "aur agar tum bhi waisi hi zid dikhaate jaisi unhone dikhaayi, to Masjid-e-Haram tabaah ho jaata, {to Allah ne apna sukoon apne Rasool par nazil kiya}" (Surah Al-Fath 26)." Yeh baat Umar (RA) tak pahunchi to unhein bura laga, unhone unke paas paighaam bheja jabke woh apni oontni ki dawaai kar rahe the, to woh (Ubayy) unke paas gaye, unhone (Umar ne) apne kuch sahaba ko bulaaya jinme Zaid bin Thabit (RA) bhi the, unhone poocha: "Tum mein se kaun Surah Al-Fath padhega?" To Zaid (RA) ne humari aaj ki qiraat ke mutabiq padhi, to Umar (RA) ne unse sakhti se baat ki, to Ubayy (RA) ne unse kaha: "Kya main kuch keh sakta hoon?" Unhone kaha: "Kaho, tumhein maloom hai ke main Nabi (SAW) ke paas dakhil hota tha aur woh mujhe padhaate the jabke tum darwaze par hote the, agar tum chaaho ke main logon ko waise hi padhaaun jaise mujhe padhaaya gaya, to main padhaaunga, warna main zindagi bhar aik harf bhi na padhaaunga." Unhone kaha: "Balke logon ko padhaao."

e: [AI] "I came to the city to learn knowledge, so when I entered the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , I found the people sitting in circles and talking. I started to walk until I reached a circle where a pale man with two worn-out garments, as if he had just arrived from a journey, was speaking. I heard him saying, 'The people of intellect have perished, and by the Lord of the Kaaba, I have no grief for them.' He repeated this statement three times. I sat down next to him and he spoke about what had been decreed for him. Then he got up and I asked about him, and they said, 'This is the leader of the people, Ubayy ibn Ka'b.' I followed him until he reached his house, and it was dilapidated, his clothes were worn-out, and his appearance was neglected, as various aspects of his life resembled each other. I greeted him and he responded with greetings. Then he asked me, 'Who are you?' I replied, 'I am from the people of Iraq.' He said, 'Asking questions is what you mostly do.' And he became angry. He faced the direction of the Qibla, then knelt down on his knees, raised his hands, and extended his arms like this, and said, 'O Allah, we complain about them to You. We spend our money, exert ourselves, and move our mules seeking knowledge, but when we meet them, they scowl at us and say, 'Go away from us.' Ubayy then started to cry and express his dissatisfaction, saying, 'Woe to you, I did not go there for this purpose.' Then he said, 'I promise you, if you keep me until Friday, I will speak about what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  without fear of any reproach.' Then I left him and waited for Friday. When Thursday came, I went out for some of my needs, and I found the roads filled with people. I couldn't go anywhere without people facing me.' I asked, 'What's the matter with the people?' They said, 'We see you as a stranger.' I said, 'Indeed.' They said, 'The leader of the Muslims, Ubayy ibn Ka'b, has passed away.' I said, 'Then I met Abu Musa in Iraq and I spoke with him.' He said, 'Why didn't he stay until we heard from him?'
hi: "Main ilm haasil karne Madinah aaya, jab main Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein dakhil hua, to log usme halqa bana kar baithe baat-cheet kar rahe the." Unhone kaha: to main aage badhta gaya yahan tak ke aik halqe tak pahuncha jismein aik zard-rang, do kapdon wala aadmi tha, goya woh safar se aaya ho, maine unhein kehte suna: "Ahl-e-Aqd (ahd-o-paimaan ke ahl) halaak ho gaye, Ka'bah ke Rab ki qasam, aur mujhe unpar afsos nahi," teen martaba yeh keh rahe the. Unhone kaha: to main unke paas baith gaya, unhone jo unke muqaddar mein tha woh baat ki, phir khade ho gaye, maine unke baare mein poocha, to logon ne kaha: "Yeh log ke sardaar hain, Ubayy bin Ka'b." Unhone kaha: to main unke peechhe chala yahan tak ke woh apne ghar pahunche, to woh puraana ghar, purane kapde, aur puraana andaaz-e-zindagi tha, sab kuch aik doosre se milta-julta tha. Maine unhein salaam kiya, unhone mujhe salaam ka jawaab diya, phir mujhse poocha: "Tum kahan se ho?" Maine kaha: "Iraq walon mein se." Unhone kaha: "Sabse zyada sawaal karne wale," aur ghussa hua. Unhone kaha: to main Qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh hua, phir apne ghutno par baith gaya aur apne haath yun uthaaye, aur unhone apni baazuein phailaayin, maine kaha: "Aye Allah, hum unki tujhse shikaayat karte hain, hum apna maal kharch karte hain, apne badan thakaate hain, aur apni sawaariyon ko ilm ki talaash mein daudaate hain, jab hum unse milte hain to woh humse bura sulook karte hain aur humse (bura) kehte hain." Unhone kaha: to Ubayy (RA) rone lage aur mujhse raazi ho gaye aur kehne lage: "Afsos tumpar, main wahan nahi gaya tha." Phir Ubayy (RA) ne kaha: "Main tumse ahd karta hoon ke agar tu ne mujhe Jumu'ah tak zinda rakha, to main woh baat zaroor kahunga jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suni, mujhe iske baare mein kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat ka darr nahi." Unhone kaha: "Phir main unse mudkar chala gaya aur Jumu'ah ke din ka intezaar karne laga, jab jumeraat ka din hua, to main apni kisi zaroorat ke liye nikla, achaanak raaste log-bhare huay the, main jis bhi galee mein jaata, log mera saamna karte." Unhone kaha: to maine poocha: "Logon ko kya hua hai?" Unhone kaha: "Hum tumhein pardesi samajhte hain." Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Musalmano ke sardaar Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) faut ho gaye." Unhone kaha: "To main Iraq mein Abu Musa se mila aur unhein yeh bataaya," to unhone kaha: "Kaash woh zinda rehte yahan tak ke woh humein unki baat pahunchaate."

e: I have come from Koofah, O Ameer al-­Mu'mineen, and I left behind in it a man who dictates the Mushaf From memory. ‘Umar got exceedingly angry and said: Who is he, woe to you? He said: 'Abdullah bin Mas'ood. ‘Umar began to calm down, and went back to normal, then he said: Woe to you, I do not know of anyone who is more qualified to do that than him, and I will tell you about that. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to stay up at night talking with Abu Bakr ؓ discussing some affairs of the Muslims. He stayed up talking with him one night, and I was with him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out, and we went out with him, and we saw a man standing and praying in the mosque. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ listened to his recitation, and as soon as we recognised him the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ʿWhoever would like to recite the Qur'an fresh as it was revealed, let him recite it according to the recitation of Ibn Umm 'Abd.ʿ Then the same man sat and offered supplication (du'a') and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ started saying to him: ʿAsk, you will be given;ask, you will be given.” ‘Umar said: By Allah, I shall go to him tomorrow and tell hirm the glad tidings. I went to him the next morning to tell him the glad tidings, and I found that Abu Bakr had beaten me to it and given him the glad tidings. By Allah, I never competed with him to do good but he beat me to it. (Using translation from Aḥmad 175)
hi: Aik aadmi Umar (RA) ke paas aaya jabke woh Arafat mein the, aur kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, main Kufa se aaya hoon aur wahan aik aadmi ko chhod aaya hoon jo Mus-hafein apne zubaani ilm se likhwaata hai." Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) ko ghussa aaya aur woh phool gaye yahan tak ke aadmi ke do baazuon ke darmiyan ki jagah bhar gayi, phir unhone poocha: "Afsos tumpar, woh kaun hai?" Usne kaha: "Abdullah bin Mas'ood." To woh ghussa bujhne aur halka honay laga yahan tak ke woh apni pehli haalat mein wapas aa gaye, phir unhone kaha: "Afsos tumpar, Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi lagta ke Musalmano mein se koi aur bhi hai jo isse zyada is baat ka haqdaar ho, main tumhein iske baare mein bataata hoon - Rasulullah (SAW) Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas Musalmano ke maamlaat ke baare mein raat ko baaten kiya karte the, aik raat woh unke paas raat bhar baaten karte rahe aur main bhi unke sath tha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) baahar nikle aur hum unke sath chalne lage, achaanak aik aadmi masjid mein khada namaz padh raha tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) khade hokar uski qiraat sunne lage, jab humein us aadmi ko pehchaanna mushkil laga, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jise yeh pasand ho ke woh Quran waise padhe jaise nazil hua, to woh Ibn Umm Abd ki qiraat par padhe.' Phir woh aadmi baithkar dua karne laga, to Rasulullah (SAW) usse kehne lage: 'Maango, tumhein diya jaayega.'" Umar (RA) ne kaha: to maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main subah unke paas jaakar unhein khush-khabri dunga." Unhone kaha: "To main unhein khush-khabri dene subah unke paas gaya, to maine paaya ke Abu Bakr (RA) mujhse pehle jaa chuke the aur unhein khush-khabri de chuke the, Allah ki qasam, main kabhi bhi kisi bhalaai ki taraf unse aage nahi nikla magar woh mujhse pehle wahan pahunch gaye." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "Whoever wishes to recite the Quran as it was revealed, then let them recite it in the style of Ibn Umm Abd." This is the narration of Alqamah from Umar, and it is authentic according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim. However, they did not include it in their collections. Alqamah himself transmitted it from Umar, but its authenticity in their eyes is questionable. Allah knows best, and there is a witness who commented on it from the hadith of Ammar ibn Yasar.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise yeh pasand ho ke woh Quran taaza taur par waise padhe jaise woh nazil hua, to woh Ibn Umm Abd ki qiraat par padhe." Alqamah ki hadith, Umar (RA) se, sanad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar dono ne ise nahi nikala, aur mujhe shubha hai ke inke nazdeek Alqamah bin Qais ka Umar (RA) se sunna sahih saabit nahi hota, aur Allah zyada jaanta hai, aur iski tasdeeq Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ki hadith se bhi milti hai jo tafseeli hai.

e: [AI] The translation of the provided Arabic sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by Abdullah ibn Mas'ood while he was reciting letter by letter. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Whoever wishes to recite the Qur'an as it was revealed, then let him recite it according to the recitation of Ibn Mas'ood.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ke paas se guzre jabke woh harf-ba-harf padh rahe the, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise yeh pasand ho ke woh Quran waise padhe jaise woh nazil hua, to woh Ibn Mas'ood ki qiraat par padhe."

e: [AI] Your mother cursed you, saying, "May I not see you praying when the book of Allah has commanded that every torn page be torn apart." So I continued with my prayer, while sitting. Then I entered the house and did not sit. I recited some verses, and still, I did not sit. Suddenly, I found myself with Al-Ash'ari, Hudhayfah, and Ibn Mas'ud speaking to each other. Hudhayfah said to Ibn Mas'ud, "Pass this Quran to them." Ibn Mas'ud replied, "By Allah, I will not give it to them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited to me seventy-two Surahs, then I will pass it to them. By Allah, I will not give it to them."
hi: "Teri maa tujhe kho de, kya main tujhe namaz padhte nahi dekh raha, jabke Allah ki Kitaab ko cheer-phaad kar tabaah karne ka hukum diya gaya hai?" Unhone kaha: to maine apni namaz mukhtasar kar di, aur (aksar) baithta tha, to main ghar mein dakhil hua aur na baitha, phir main oopar gaya aur na baitha, achaanak main Al-Ash'ari, Hudhaifah (RA), aur Ibn Mas'ood (RA) ko aapas mein baat-cheet karte paaya, aur Hudhaifah (RA) Ibn Mas'ood (RA) se keh rahe the: "Yeh Mus-haf unhein de do." Unhone (Ibn Mas'ood ne) kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main isse unhein nahi dunga, mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne sattar (70) se zyada Surahen padhaayi hain, phir main isse unhein de dun? Allah ki qasam, main isse unhein nahi dunga."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Mas'ood said: 'I have read 70 chapters from the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ Quran.' And Zaid ibn Thabit, who had two weak calves, used to play with the children."
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke munh se sattar (70) Surahen padhi hain, jabke Zaid bin Thabit, do choti choti chotiyon wale, bachchon ke sath khela karte the."

e: [AI] I heard Abdullah ibn Mas'ood say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited to me seventy Surahs, which I had memorized before Zaid ibn Thabit embraced Islam." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Maine Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ko kehte suna: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne sattar (70) Surahen padhaayin jinhein maine mazboot kar liya isse pehle ke Zaid bin Thabit Musalman huay."

e: [AI] "We sat, a group from the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , and said, 'If we knew which actions are most beloved to Allah, we would perform them.' So Allah, the Most High, revealed: 'Glorify Allah, whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. He is the Almighty, the All-Wise. O you who believe! Why do you say that which you do not do? It is most hateful to Allah that you say that which you do not do. Indeed, Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a line as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.' He recited this until the end of the Surah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited it to us. Muhammad ibn Kathir added in his narration, 'And Al-Awza'i recited it to us in this way.' Muhammad ibn Kathir said, 'And Al-Awza'i recited it to us in this way.' Ibrahim said, 'And Muhammad ibn Kathir recited it to us until the end of the Surah in this way.' Abu Amr ibn As-Sammak said, 'And Ibrahim ibn Al-Haytham recited it to us until the end of the Surah in this way.'"
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se kuch log baithe, humne kaha: "Kaash humein pata hota ke Allah ko kaunsa amal sabse zyada pasand hai to hum woh amal karte." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aasmano aur zameen ki har cheez ne Allah ki tasbeeh ki, aur wahi Azeez, Hakeem hai, Aye imaan walo, tum woh baat kyun kehte ho jo karte nahi, Allah ke nazdeek yeh baat bohot napasandeeda hai ke tum woh kaho jo karte nahi, beshak Allah unhein pasand karta hai jo uski raah mein aisi saf mein jung karte hain jaise koi mazboot jori hui imaarat}" Surah ke aakhir tak, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne isse humein padh kar sunaaya. Muhammad bin Katheer ne apni hadith mein izaafa kiya aur humein Al-Awza'i ne kaha: "Yahya bin Abi Katheer ne isse humein isi tarah padh kar sunaaya." Muhammad bin Katheer ne kaha: "Aur Al-Awza'i ne isse humein isi tarah padh kar sunaaya." Ibrahim ne kaha: "Aur Muhammad bin Katheer ne isse humein Surah ke aakhir tak isi tarah padh kar sunaaya." Abu Amr bin As-Sammak ne kaha: "Aur Ibrahim bin Al-Haitham ne isse humein Surah ke aakhir tak isi tarah padh kar sunaaya."

e: [AI] We used to gather around the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  as he was compiling the Qur'an. He said, "Glad tidings to Syria." It was asked, "Why, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Because the angels of the Most Merciful are spreading their wings over it." This narration was reported by Jarir ibn Hazim from Yahya ibn Ayyub, on the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke ird-gird Quran jama kar rahe the ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sham ke liye khush-khabri hai." Unse poocha gaya: "Kyun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kyunke Rahman ke farishte apne par usspar phailaaye huay hain." Isse Jareer bin Hazim ne Yahya bin Ayyub se riwayat kiya hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ collecting the Qur'an on pieces of cloth, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Tuba is for Ash-Sham.' So we said: 'Why is that O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'Because the angels of Ar-Rahman spread their wings over it.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3954)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Quran ke tukdon se jama kar rahe the ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sham ke liye khush-khabri hai." Humne poocha: "Yeh kis liye?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kyunke Rahman ke farishte apne par usspar phailaaye huay hain."

e: [AI] He said, "I entered the mosque on Friday and the Prophet ﷺ was giving a sermon, so I sat close to Ubay ibn Ka'b. The Prophet ﷺ recited Surat Bara'ah (Chapter 9 of the Quran). So I asked Ubay, "When was this Surah revealed?" He frowned and did not respond to me. He said, "I have memorized this narration and found it in my book, and I searched for it in the codices but could not find it with its full length. The narration is authenticated through its chain of transmission."
hi: Unhone kaha: main Jumu'ah ke din masjid mein dakhil hua jabke Nabi (SAW) khutba de rahe the, main Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ke qareeb baith gaya, "to Nabi (SAW) ne Surah Bara'ah padhi," to maine Ubayy (RA) se poocha: "Yeh Surah kab nazil hui?" Unhone kaha: to unhone mujhse mun pher liya aur mujhse baat na ki. Unhone kaha: "Aur hadith zikr ki, isi tarah maine ise apni kitaab mein paaya, aur maine ise musanad kitaabon mein talaash kiya lekin mukammal shakl mein na paaya, hadith apni sanad ke sath sahih hai." Sahih.

e: [AI] Which of the two readings do you see as the last? They said, the reading of Zaid. He said, no. "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to present the Quran to Gabriel every year, and when it was the year in which he passed away, he presented it to him twice. So, the last one was the reading of Ibn Mas'ud."
hi: "Tum in do qiraaton mein se kaunsi ko aakhri qiraat samajhte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Zaid ki qiraat." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, beshak Rasulullah (SAW) har saal Jibra'il (AS) ke saamne Quran pesh kiya karte the, jis saal unka intiqaal hua us saal unhone unke saamne isse do baar pesh kiya, to Ibn Mas'ood ki qiraat sabse aakhri thi."

e: [AI] "The Quran was presented to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in multiple recitations, and they say, 'Indeed, our recitation is the final version.'"
hi: "Quran Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne kayi baar pesh kiya gaya," to woh kehte hain: "Yehi humari qiraat aakhri pesh-kash hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When Allah created Adam and formed him, He left him and made Iblis circle around him, observing him. When Iblis saw him hollow, he said, 'I have succeeded in capturing a being who cannot control himself.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko soorat di, to unhein chhod diya, Iblees uske ird-gird chakkar lagaane laga aur usse dekhne laga, jab usne dekha ke woh khoklaa hai, to kaha: 'Mujhe iske khilaaf faateh mil gayi, aisi makhlooq jo khud par qaaboo nahi rakh sakti.'"

e: [AI] Adam did not inhabit paradise except from the time of Asr prayer until sunset.
hi: "Aadam (AS) Jannat mein sirf Asr ki namaz se leke suraj doobne tak hi rahe."

e: [AI] "The first place that Allah sent Adam down to is the land of India."
hi: "Sabse pehle jahan Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko utaara woh Hind (India) ki zameen thi."

e: "The most pleasant smell on earth is found in India, where Prophet Adam, peace be upon him, descended. Its trees are made of the fragrance of paradise." This is an authentic Hadith according to the conditions of Muslim, and Al-Dhahabi did not mention anything about it in his summary.
hi: "Zameen par sabse achhi khushbu Hind (India) mein hai, jahan Aadam (AS) ko utaara gaya, to uske darakht Jannat ki khushbu se rachi-basi hain." Yeh hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Indeed, when God expelled Adam from Paradise, He provided him with fruits from Paradise and taught him the nature of all things. So, your fruits are from the fruits of Paradise, although these have changed, and those have not changed.” Authentic in the chain of narration, and it has been reported in Sahih (authentic) hadith."
hi: "Jab Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko Jannat se nikaala, to unhein Jannat ke phalon mein se saaman diya aur har cheez ki sana't (hunar) sikhaayi, to tumhare yeh phal Jannat ke phalon mein se hain, siwaye is ke ke yeh badalte hain aur woh nahi badalte." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Jews came to the Prophet ﷺ  and asked him about the creation of the heavens and the earth. He ﷺ  said, "Allah created the earth on Sunday and Monday, and He created the mountains on Tuesday, and whatever beneficial things are in them. He created the trees, the water, the mines, and the buildings on Wednesday. These are four days." Then Allah (ﷻ) said, "Are you really denying the One who created the earth in two days and make for Him partners? He is the Lord of the worlds. He placed on the earth firm mountains above it and bestowed blessings in it, and determined in it its provisions in four days, equally for those who ask." He created the heavens on Thursday and He created the stars, the sun, the moon, and the angels on Friday until the remaining three hours. In the first of these three hours, He decrees the death of those who died, in the second, He inflicts affliction upon everything from which people benefit, and in the third, He admitted Adam into Paradise, ordered Iblis to prostrate to him, and expelled him from Paradise in the last hour. Then the Jews said, "And what about Muhammad?" He ﷺ  said, "Then Allah established Himself above the Throne." They said, "You have spoken the truth, if you had completed it." He said, "Then He became angry with a severe anger." Then, the verse was revealed: "And certainly We created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days, and We were not touched with fatigue." So have patience over what they say.
hi: Yahoodiyon ne Nabi (SAW) ke paas aakar aasmano aur zameen ki paidaish ke baare mein poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne zameen itwaar aur peer ke din paida ki, aur pahaad mangal ke din paida kiye aur unme jo faide hain woh bhi, aur budh ke din darakht, paani, shehron, aabaadi, aur weeraan (jagahein) paida kin, to yeh chaar (din) hain." Phir Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Kya tum us Zaat ka inkaar karte ho jisne zameen ko do dinon mein paida kiya, aur uske liye hum-sar banaate ho? Woh saare jahaano ka Rab hai, aur usne isme upar se pahaad rakhe, aur isme barkat rakhi, aur isme ismein rehne walon ka rizq muqarrar kiya, chaar (4) dinon mein barabar, maangne walon ke liye}" aur juma'raat ke din aasman paida kiya, aur jum'ah ke din sitaare, suraj, chaand, aur farishte paida kiye, teen ghantay baaqi rehne tak, to in teen ghanton mein se pehle ghante mein maut ke waqt muqarrar kiye jab jo faut hona hai woh faut hota hai, aur doosre mein har us cheez par museebat daali jise log faida uthaate hain, aur teesre mein Aadam (AS) ko paida kiya, unhein Jannat mein basaaya, Iblees ko unhein sajda karne ka hukum diya, aur unhein aakhri ghante mein wahan se nikaala." Phir Yahoodiyon ne poocha: "Phir kya hua, Aye Muhammad?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Phir woh Arsh par mustawi hua." Unhone kaha: "Aapne theek kaha agar aap mukammal kar dete." Unhone kaha: "Phir usne aaraam kiya." Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) ko sakht ghussa aaya, to yeh nazil hui: "{Aur beshak humne aasmano aur zameen ko aur jo unke darmiyan hai chhah (6) dinon mein paida kiya, aur humein koi thakaan chhoo bhi nahi gayi, isliye woh jo kehte hain uspar sabr karo}".

e: [AI] Adam was a tall man with a lot of hair on his head, resembling a palm tree with abundant leaves.
hi: "Aadam (AS) aik lambe qad ke aadmi thay, sar ke ghane baalon wale, goya woh aik lambi khajoor ka darakht hon."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On this day, Adam was created and on this day he was descended to the earth."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse achha din jismein suraj nikla woh Jumu'ah ka din hai, isme Aadam (AS) paida kiye gaye aur isme unhein zameen ki taraf utaara gaya."

e: [AI] The Prophet  ﷺ  said, "Allah took the covenant from the back of Adam at 'Arafah, meaning by mentioning the mountain of 'Arafah. Then, He extracted from his loins all of the offspring that He would create and dispersed them before Him like seeds, and then He addressed them from all sides and said: 'Am I not your Lord?' They replied: 'Indeed, we bear witness to it.' [This] He did lest they should say on the Day of Resurrection: 'We were not aware of this.' [This is mentioned] in His saying: 'Or [lest] you say, 'It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] with Allah before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?' [Al-A'raf: 172-173] This is an authentic Hadith, and they did not exclude it from their collections."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne Nu'maan mein, ya'ni Arafat mein, Aadam (AS) ki peeth se ahd liya, to unki safl (peeth) se har us aulaad ko nikaala jise usne paida kiya, aur unhein apne saamne cheenti jaisa bikher diya, phir unse aamne-saamne guftagu ki aur farmaya: {Kya main tumhara Rab nahi?} Unhone kaha: {Kyun nahi, hum gawah hain}, taake tum Qayamat ke din yeh na kaho" (Surah Al-A'raf 172) unke farmaan "{Baatil karne walon ne kya kiya}" (Surah Al-A'raf 173) tak. Yeh hadith apni sanad mein sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] Omar ibn al-Khattab was asked about this verse, "And when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants." [Al-A'raf: 172]. Omar ibn al-Khattab said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  saying, 'Indeed, Allah created Adam, then He wiped his back with His right hand and brought forth from him his descendants. Then He said, "I have created these for Paradise and they will do the deeds of the people of Paradise." Then He wiped his back and brought forth from him his descendants. He said, "I have created these for Hellfire, and they will do the deeds of the people of Hellfire." Then a man said, "O Messenger of Allah, what about the actions?" He said, "When Allah creates a servant for Paradise, He employs him with the deeds of the people of Paradise until he dies upon the actions of the people of Paradise and enters Paradise. And when Allah creates a servant for the Hellfire, He employs him with the deeds of the people of Hellfire until he dies upon the actions of the people of Hellfire and enters the Hellfire."
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se is ayat "{Aur jab aapke Rab ne Bani Aadam ki peeth se unki aulaad nikaali}" (Surah Al-A'raf 172) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Beshak Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko paida kiya, phir unki peeth par apne dayen haath se maali (naram) sehlaayi, to unse aulaad nikaali, aur farmaya: main inhein Jannat ke liye paida karta hoon, aur yeh Jannat walon ka amal karengay, phir unki peeth par sehlaayi aur unse aulaad nikaali, aur farmaya: main inhein aag ke liye paida karta hoon, aur yeh Jahannami logon ka amal karengay.'" To aik aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to phir amal ka kya faida?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah kisi bande ko Jannat ke liye paida karta hai, to usse Jannat walon jaisa amal karwaata hai yahan tak ke woh Jannat walon ke amal par faut hota hai to Jannat mein dakhil ho jaata hai, aur jab Allah kisi bande ko aag ke liye paida karta hai, to usse Jahannami logon jaisa amal karwaata hai yahan tak ke woh Jahannami logon ke amal par faut hota hai to aag mein dakhil ho jaata hai."

e: [AI] "O Lord, did you not blow into me from Your soul?" He said, "Indeed, yes." He said, "O Lord, did You not make me dwell in Your paradise?" He said, "Indeed, yes." He said, "O Lord, did Your mercy not precede Your anger?" He said, "Indeed, yes." He said, "So if I repent and mend my ways, will I return to Paradise?" He said, "Indeed, yes." So His saying, "Then Adam received from his Lord words" [Quran 2:37].
hi: "{To Aadam (AS) ne apne Rab se kuch kalimaat seekhe, to usne unki tauba qubool ki}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 37) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Aadam (AS) ne kaha: "Aye Rab, kya tu ne mujhe apne haath se paida nahi kiya?" Farmaya: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, kya tu ne mujhme apni rooh se phoonk nahi maari?" Farmaya: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, kya tu ne mujhe apni Jannat mein na basaya?" Farmaya: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, kya teri rehmat tere ghusse se aage nahi barhi?" Farmaya: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "Batao, agar main tauba karoon aur sudhar jaaun, to kya tu mujhe wapas Jannat mein le jaayega?" Farmaya: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: to yehi hai uska farmaan: "{To Aadam (AS) ne apne Rab se kuch kalimaat seekhe}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 37).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Hawwa (Eve) had no children, so she vowed that if she had a child, she would name him 'Abdul Harith'. She then had a child and named him 'Abdul Harith'. This was only inspired by a revelation from Satan."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hawwa ka koi bacha zinda nahi rehta tha, to unhone nazar maani ke agar unka koi bacha zinda reh gaya to woh uska naam 'Abdul-Harith' (Al-Harith ka banda) rakhengi, to unka aik bacha zinda reh gaya, unhone uska naam 'Abdul-Harith' rakh diya, aur yeh sirf shaitan ki taraf se ilhaam ki wajah se hua."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ said, "When Adam passed away, the angels washed him with water mixed with camphor and shrouded him, and they offered their condolences saying, 'This is the tradition of Adam concerning his offspring.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Aadam (AS) faut huay, to farishton ne unhein taaq (odd) paani se ghusl diya aur unke liye lahad banaayi, aur kaha: yehi Aadam (AS) ki sunnat hai unki aulaad mein."

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah sent Nūḥ at ˹the age of˺ forty years, and he remained with his nation for a thousand years less fifty years inviting them ˹to Islam.˺ He then lived after the flood for sixty years when the number of people increased and they ˹started to˺ spread."[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne Nuh (AS) ko chaalis (40) saal ki umr mein Nabi banaakar bheja, aur woh apni qaum mein hazaar (1000) saal mein se pachaas (50) saal kam thehre, unhein dawat dete rahe, aur toofan ke baad saath (60) saal aur zinda rahe yahan tak ke log barh gaye aur phail gaye."

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said, "Nūḥ had three children: Sām (Sam), Ḥām (Ham), and Yāfith (Japeth) the father of Romans."[^1]
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nuh (AS) ki teen aulaad thi - Saam, Haam, aur Yaafith, jo Room (Romans) ke baap hain."

e: the leaders of the Prophets are five, and Muḥammad ﷺ is the leader of those five. The five are: Nūḥ, Ibrāhīm, Mūsá, ʿĪsá, and Muḥammad, peace and blessings of Allah be upon them all.
hi: "Ambiya ke sardaar paanch (5) hain, aur Muhammad (SAW) in paanchon ke sardaar hain - Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, aur Muhammad, Allah ki rehmatein aur salaam un sab par ho."

e: that he mentioned the statement of Allah ﷻ "We sent Nūḥ to his nation... (Nūḥ 71:1)" then mentioned that Nūḥ took a bath and saw his son looking at him. He then said, "You're looking at me while I'm taking a bath? May Allah discolor you." ˹Ibn Masʿūd˺ said: he was then darkened and he is the father of Sūdān (the African race).[^1]
hi: Unhone Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Beshak humne Nuh (AS) ko unki qaum ki taraf bheja}" (Surah Nuh 1) ka zikr kiya, phir zikr kiya ke Nuh (AS) ne ghusl kiya, to unhone apne bete ko apni taraf dekhte huay paaya, to unhone kaha: "Tum mujhe dekh rahe ho jabke main ghusl kar raha hoon? Allah tumhara rang badal de!" Unhone kaha: to woh kaala ho gaya, aur woh Sudan (African qaum) ke baap hain. Kamzor sanad.

e: There were ten qarn (generations) between Nūḥ and Ādam. They were all upon the True Shariʿah then they differed ˹thereafter.˺ Then Allah sent Prophets to give glad tidings and warnings. ˹Ibn ʿAbbās˺ said: this is how it is in the recitation of ʿAbdullāh ˹b. Masʿūd˺: "The people were all one ummah (nation) and they then differed..."[^1]
hi: "Nuh (AS) aur Aadam (AS) ke darmiyan das (10) nasalein guzrin, sab haq ki shari'at par thin, phir woh mukhtalif ho gaye, to Allah ne Nabiyon ko khush-khabri dene wala aur daraane wala banaakar bheja." Unhone kaha: aur isi tarah Abdullah (RA) ki qiraat mein hai: "Log aik hi Ummat the, phir mukhtalif ho gaye."

e:
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If Allah were to show Mercy to anyone from among the nation of Nūḥ, he would show Mercy to Umm al-Ṣabī (mother of the young boy)." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Nūḥ remained with his nation for a thousand years save fifty inviting them ˹to the Message˺ until the end of his time. He planted trees and they became plentiful/large and they ˹grew˺ in all different ways. Then he cut them and began to make his ship. ˹The people˺ used to pass by and say that he is making a ship on land, how would it sail?' The he would said, 'You will soon find out.' 
When he was finished with it and 'fār al-tannūr' (commonly interpreted as the bursting of springs from the ground) and the flooding started in the pathways. Umm al-Ṣabī feared for ˹her child˺ and she loved him intensely. She left toward the mountain until she reached a third of it. When the water reached it, she left from there until she settled on the two-thirds of the mountain. Then when the water reached it, she left from there until settled on ˹top˺ of the mountain. When the water reached up to her neck, she lifted him in her arms until the water washed him away. So if Allah were to show Mercy to anyone among them, he would show Mercy to Umm al-Ṣabī."[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar Allah Nuh (AS) ki qaum mein se kisi par reham karta, to woh bachche ki maa par reham karta." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nuh (AS) apni qaum mein hazaar (1000) saal mein se pachaas (50) saal kam thehre, unhein Allah ki taraf bulaate rahe, yahan tak ke unke aakhri daur mein unhone aik darakht lagaaya, woh bada hua aur har taraf phaila, phir unhone use kaata aur usse kashti banaane lage, log unke paas se guzarte aur unka mazaaq udaate, kehte: 'Lakdi ki kashti khushki mein banaate ho, yeh kaise chalegi?' To woh kehte: 'Ankareeb tumhein pata chal jaayega.' Jab woh kashti se faarigh huay, to tannur (chulha) ubalne laga aur galiyon mein paani barh gaya, bachche ki maa ko apne bachche ki fikr hui, aur woh usse bohot mohabbat karti thi, to woh pahaad ki taraf nikli yahan tak ke uski aik tihaai tak pahunchi, jab paani wahan tak pahuncha to woh usse le kar aage badhi yahan tak ke pahaad ki do-tihaai tak pahunchi, jab paani wahan tak pahuncha to woh nikli yahan tak ke pahaad ki choti par pahunch gayi, jab paani uski gardan tak pahuncha to usne bachche ko apne haathon se oopar utha liya, yahan tak ke paani usse bha le gaya. Agar Allah unme se kisi par reham karta, to bachche ki maa par reham karta."

e: Allah ﷻ gathered knowledge for all prior ˹nations˺ for Nūḥ and strengthened him with the Rūḥ (Holy Spirit). He then invited his nation ˹to Islam˺ privately and publically for nine hundred and fifty years. Any time a generation passed and ˹the next˺ generation followed them in their ˹corruption˺ and thus they increased in disbelief and transgression.[^1]
hi: Humare Rab Ta'ala ne Nuh (AS) ke liye pehle logon ka sara ilm jama kiya aur unhein apni taraf se aik rooh (khaas taaqat) se madad di, to unhone apni qaum ko chhupkar aur khule taur par nau sau pachaas (950) saal tak dawat di, jab bhi aik nasal guzarti, doosri nasal unke peechhe chalti, to unki kufr aur sarkashi barhti gayi.

e:
they all attributed this ḥadīth to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that Allah will call Nūḥ and nation on the Day of Resurrection as the first among the people, and He will say, "How did you respond to Nūḥ?" They will say, "He did not invite us ˹to Islam˺, nor he had conveyed ˹the Message˺, nor had commanded us to do ˹works˺, nor had prohibited us ˹to do other works.˺ Then Nūḥ will say, "O Lord, I called my people with an open Call to the first of them to the last of them, Ummah after Ummah until it reached the end with the seal of the Prophets, Aḥmad. He scribed ˹the Message˺, recited it, and believed in it.
Then Allah will say to the angels, call Aḥmad and his Ummah. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his Ummah will rush with light terminating in front of them. Then Nūḥ will say to Muḥammad and his Ummah, "Do you know that I conveyed the message to my nation and strove to give them counsel and tried my best that they be saved from the Hellfire ˹preaching˺ then privately and publically and 'they did nothing but increasingly avoid my call' (Nūḥ 71:6)?" Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his followers will testify, "We bear witness that you are indeed among the truthful in all that you have said." 
So, the nation of Nūḥ will ask, "O Aḥmad, how did you and you Ummah come to know this when you and your Ummah are the last of the nations?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ will respond, "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, 'Indeed, We sent Nūḥ to his people, ˹saying˺, warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment. (Nūḥ, 71:1).'" He will recite the entire Sūrah. When he finishes it, the nation of Nūḥ will say, "We bear witness 'that this is indeed the true account, and there is no deity except Allah, and Allah is indeed the All-Mighty, the All-Wise. (Āl ʿImrān 3:62)" Thereupon, Allah ﷻ will say, "But stand apart today, you criminals. (Yā Sīn 36:59)" and thus they will be the first to be separated ˹from the rest destined toward˺ the Hellfire.
hi: Sab ne is hadith ko Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf uthaaya hai: beshak Allah Qayamat ke din Nuh (AS) aur unki qaum ko sabse pehle bulaayega, to farmayega: "Tumne Nuh (AS) ko kya jawaab diya?" Woh kahenge: "Unhone humein na dawat di, na hukum pahunchaaya, na naseehat ki, na humein hukum diya, na roka." To Nuh (AS) kahenge: "Aye Rab, maine unhein pehlon aur pichhlon mein phailti hui dawat di, Ummat ke baad Ummat, yahan tak ke Nabiyon ke khaatam Ahmad (SAW) tak pahunchi, unhone ise likha, padha, isspar imaan laaya, aur iski tasdeeq ki." To Allah farishton se farmayega: "Ahmad aur unki Ummat ko bulaao." To Rasulullah (SAW) aur unki Ummat aayenge, unka noor unke aage daudta hoga. To Nuh (AS) Muhammad (SAW) aur unki Ummat se poochenge: "Kya tumhein pata hai ke maine apni qaum ko paighaam pahunchaaya, unke liye koshish ki, aur khule aur chhupe taur par unhein aag se bachaane ki koshish ki, {magar meri dawat ne unhein aur zyada bhagaane ke siwa kuch na diya}" (Surah Nuh 6)?" To Rasulullah (SAW) aur unki Ummat kahenge: "Hum gawahi dete hain jo aapne humein qasam de kar poocha, ke aap jo bhi kehte hain usme sachche hain." To Nuh (AS) ki qaum poochegi: "Aye Ahmad, aapko aur aapki Ummat ko yeh kahan se pata chala, jabke hum pehli Ummatein hain aur aap aur aapki Ummat aakhri Ummat ho?" To Rasulullah (SAW) farmaayenge: "Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem, {Beshak humne Nuh (AS) ko unki qaum ki taraf bheja ke apni qaum ko daraao isse pehle ke unpar dardnaak azaab aa jaaye}" (Surah Nuh 1), poori Surah padhenge yahan tak ke usse khatam karenge, jab woh khatam karenge to unki Ummat kahegi: "Hum gawahi dete hain ke {yehi sachcha qissa hai, aur Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur beshak Allah Azeez, Hakeem hai}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 62)." To Allah Ta'ala usi waqt farmayega: "{Aaj alag ho jao, Aye mujrimo}," to woh sabse pehle aag mein alag kiye jaane wale honge.

e: [AI] "He recited this verse, 'And do not display yourselves as was the display of the former times of ignorance.' (Quran 33:33). He said that between Noah and Idris, there were a thousand years and that there were two generations of Adam's children. One of them lived in the plains and the other lived in the mountains. The men of the mountains were fair-skinned in the mornings, while the women had menstruation. The women of the plains were fair-skinned in the mornings, while the men had menstruation. Indeed, Satan came to a man from the people of the plains in the form of a shepherd boy. He spoke in a voice that no one had ever heard, so they made an annual celebration to gather around him. However, a man from the people of the mountains attacked them while they were celebrating. He witnessed their women and their mornings, so he came to his companions and informed them about it. They turned towards them and went down with them, and immorality became apparent among them. That is the saying of Allah, the Almighty: 'And do not display yourselves as was the display of the former times of ignorance.' (Quran 33:33). Al-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing it."
hi: Unhone yeh ayat padhi: "{Aur pehli jahiliyat jaisa bhes-badal kar mat nikalo}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33), unhone kaha: Nuh (AS) aur Idris (AS) ke darmiyan hazaar (1000) saal ka faasla tha, aur Aadam (AS) ki aulaad ke do giroh the, aik maidaani ilaake mein rehta tha aur doosra pahaadi ilaake mein, pahaad walon ke mard khoobsurat the aur unki auraton mein kami thi, aur maidaan waali auraten khoobsurat thin aur unke mardon mein kami thi, aur Iblees aik maidaani shakhs ke paas charwaahon ke jawaan ki soorat mein aaya, wahan aisi awaaz nikaali jo logon ne pehle kabhi nahi suni thi, to unhone isse aik saalana jashn bana liya jismein woh jama hote the, aur aik pahaadi shakhs unpar hamla-aawar hua jab woh apne jashn mein the, to usne un (maidaani) auraton ko aur unki khoobsurati ko dekha, to woh apne saathiyon ke paas gaya aur unhein yeh bataaya, to woh unki taraf mudh gaye aur unke sath utar aaye, to unme besharmi zaahir ho gayi, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Aur pehli jahiliyat jaisa bhes-badal kar mat nikalo}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He was asked about who Idris is and in what time period he is. He said, "He is the grandfather of Noah, who is called Enoch, and he is alive in paradise." And Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Yasar said, "Idris was the first son of Adam to be given prophethood, and he is Akhnukh ibn Yazid ibn Ahlalil ibn Qinan ibn Nashir ibn Shith ibn Adam."
hi: Unse Idris (AS) ke baare mein poocha gaya ke woh kaun hain aur kis zamane mein thay? Unhone kaha: "Woh Nuh (AS) ke daada hain jinhein Khanukh kaha jaata hai, aur woh Jannat mein zinda hain." Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar ne kaha: "Idris (AS) Bani Aadam mein se sabse pehle the jinhein Nubuwwat di gayi, aur woh Akhnukh bin Yazid bin Ahlaleel bin Qeenan bin Nashir bin Sheeth bin Aadam hain."

e: [AI] Then the Prophet Idris, peace be upon him, was a tall, white man, with a large stomach and a broad chest. He had little hair on his body, but a lot of hair on his head. One of his eyes was larger than the other, and there were three spots of whiteness on his chest, without any blemishes. When Allah saw the oppression and disobedience of the people on earth, He elevated him to the sixth heaven, as it is mentioned in the verse, "And We raised him to a high station." [Maryam 57] The chain of narration for this hadith is weak and cannot be used as evidence.
hi: Allah ke Nabi Idris (AS) aik gore, lambe, bade pait wale, chaude seene wale, jism par kam baal aur sar par ghane baal wale aadmi thay, unki aik aankh doosri se badi thi, aur unke seene mein teen safed nishaan the jo koda (baras) nahi the, jab Allah ne zameen walon ka zulm aur Allah ke maamle mein unki zyaadti dekhi, to Allah ne unhein chhathe aasman tak uthaa liya, aur yehi hai jahan Allah farmata hai: "{Aur humne unhein buland maqaam par uthaaya}" (Surah Maryam 57). Iski sanad tareek (ghair-waazeh) hai, isse hujjat qaayam nahi ho sakti.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ placed his hand on my head and said, "This boy will live for a century." He lived for one hundred years. Al-Waqidi says that Allah, the Almighty, says, "And generations came after many generations" (Quran 25:38). So there were ten generations between Noah and Adam, and ten generations between him and Ibrahim. Ibrahim, the beloved of Allah, was born after two thousand years from the creation of Adam. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apna haath mere sar par rakha aur farmaya: "Yeh larka aik nasal ki umr jiyega." Unhone kaha: to woh sau (100) saal zinda rahe. Al-Waqidi ne kaha: Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "{Aur unke darmiyan bohot si nasalein bhi (halaak kin)}" (Surah Al-Furqan 38), to Nuh (AS) aur Aadam (AS) ke darmiyan das (10) nasalein thin, aur unke aur Ibrahim (AS) ke darmiyan bhi das (10) nasalein thin, to Ibrahim (AS), Khaleelullah, Aadam (AS) ki paidaish ke do hazaar (2000) saal baad paida huay. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "They say, 'O Ibrahim, you are the Khalil of the Most Merciful. The dwellers of the heavens and the dwellers of the earth have heard of your virtue.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "To woh kahenge: Aye Ibrahim, aap Rahman ke khaleel (khaas dost) hain, aasman aur zameen walon ne aapki dosti ke baare mein sun rakha hai."

e: [AI] He heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying before his death, "Indeed, Allah has taken me as a close friend just as He took Ibrahim as a close friend."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko apni wafaat se pehle farmate suna: "Beshak Allah ne mujhe khaleel banaaya hai jaise usne Ibrahim (AS) ko khaleel banaaya tha."

e: When the Prophet ﷺ saw pictures in the Kaʿba, he did not enter it till he ordered them to be erased. When he saw (the pictures of Abraham and Ishmael carrying the arrows of divination, he said, "May Allah curse them (i.e. the Quraish)! By Allah, neither Abraham nor Ishmael practiced divination by arrows." (Using translation from Bukhārī 3352)
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Ka'bah mein tasveerein dekhin, to woh dakhil na huay jab tak unhein hukum na diya (aur) unhein mitaa diya gaya, aur unhone Ibrahim (AS) aur Isma'il (AS) ko unke haathon mein azlaam (fal nikaalne wale teer) pakde huay dekha, to farmaya: "Allah unhein (Quraish ko) halaak kare, Allah ki qasam, na Ibrahim (AS) ne aur na hi Isma'il (AS) ne kabhi azlaam se fal nikaala."

e: [AI] "And Ibrahim, the friend of the Most Merciful, and His chosen one, and His Prophet ﷺ , the son of Azar, the son of Majoor, the son of Saaruh, the son of Ra'u, the son of Malih, the son of Aa'bir, the son of Salikh, the son of Arfakhshad, the son of Sam, the son of Nuh ﷺ , may Allah's blessings be upon him." Ibn al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in his summarization.
hi: "Aur Ibrahim (AS), Rahman ke khaleel, uske chune huay, aur uske Nabi, Aazar bin Maajoor bin Saarooh bin Raa'oo bin Maalih bin Aabir bin Saalikh bin Arfakhshaz bin Saam bin Nuh (AS) ke bete hain, Allah ki rehmatein unpar ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "A hand emerged from the sky between two of its fingers, with a single white hair. It approached the head of Ibrahim, and then dropped it on his head. It said, 'Ignite and shine bright.' Then Allah revealed to him to perform purification. He was the first to reach puberty and be circumcised, and Allah revealed to Ibrahim what He had revealed to Muhammad in the Quran. So he was among those whom Allah revealed to, (The repentant, worshippers, praisers, travelers, bowing and prostrating, enjoining good, forbidding evil, and keeping within the limits of Allah; and give glad tidings to the believers) [At-Tawbah 9:112]. And (Indeed, the believers have succeeded) [Al-Mu'minun 23:1], until the saying (Those who will inherit Paradise, they will abide therein eternally) [Al-Mu'minun 23:11]. And (Indeed, the Muslims, men and women) [Al-Ahzab 33:35], until the end of the verse. And the one in the question (Those who are constant in their prayer) [Al-Ma'arij 70:23], until the saying (Those who are standing in testimony) [Al-Ma'arij 70:33]. None were affected by these arrows except Ibrahim, the close friend of Allah, and Muhammad (peace be upon them) and their families. Az-Zahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: Aasman se aik haath nikla, uski do ungliyon ke darmiyan aik safed baal tha, woh Ibrahim (AS) ke sar ke qareeb aane laga, phir aur qareeb hua, aur usse unke sar mein daal diya aur kaha: "Waqar (izzat) ke sath jal utho," phir Allah ne unhein wahi ki ke woh paakeezgi ikhtiyar karein, aur woh sabse pehle boodhe honay aur khatna karwaane wale thay, aur Allah ne Ibrahim (AS) par usme se nazil kiya jo usne Quran mein Muhammad (SAW) par nazil kiya, to unpar jo nazil hua usme yeh bhi tha: "{Tauba karne wale, ibaadat karne wale, hamd karne wale, roze rakhne wale, ruku karne wale, sajda karne wale, achhi baat ka hukum dene wale, buri baat se rokne wale, aur Allah ki hudood ki hifaazat karne wale, aur momino ko khush-khabri do}" (Surah At-Tawbah 112), aur "{Beshak momin kaamyaab ho gaye}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 1) unke farmaan "{Jo Firdaus ke waaris hain, isme hamesha rahenge}" (Surah Al-Mu'minun 11) tak, aur woh (ayat) jo Surah Al-Ahzab mein hai: "{Beshak Musalman mard aur Musalman auraten}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 35) ayat ke aakhir tak, aur woh (ayat) jo Surah Al-Ma'arij mein hai: "{Jo apni namaz ki hamesha paabandi karte hain}" (Surah Al-Ma'arij 23) unke farmaan "{Aur jo apni gawahiyon par qaayam rahte hain}" (Surah Al-Ma'arij 33) tak, to in tamaam khoobiyon par sirf Ibrahim (AS), Khaleelullah, aur Muhammad (SAW) hi poore utray. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Ibrahim ﷺ  was circumcised twenty hundred years after his birth, according to the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Ibrahim (AS) ne aik sau bees (120) saal ki umr mein 'qadoom' (aik auzaar) se khatna karwaya, aur unka intiqaal do sau (200) saal ki umr mein hua." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Ibrahim was circumcised after twenty and one hundred years by birth and then lived for eighty years after that.
hi: "Ibrahim (AS) ne aik sau bees (120) saal ki umr mein 'qadoom' se khatna karwaya, phir uske baad assi (80) saal aur zinda rahe."

e: [AI] When Ibrahim ﷺ  was commanded to build the house, Ismail and Hajar went with him. When they arrived in Makkah, Ibrahim saw a cloud-like covering over the location of the house, resembling a head. He addressed it and said, "O Ibrahim! Establish my progeny in the shade or according to my will, and do not increase or decrease it." Upon finishing the construction, Ibrahim left and left Ismail and Hajar there. This is where Allah, Almighty, says, "And [mention, O Muhammad], when We designated for Ibrahim the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate." (Surah Al-Hajj, 26)
hi: Jab Ibrahim (AS) ko ghar (Ka'bah) banaane ka hukum diya gaya, to Isma'il (AS) aur Hajar (RA) unke sath nikle, jab woh Makkah pahunche, to unhone ghar ki jagah par apne sar ke oopar baadal jaisi cheez dekhi jismein sar jaisi shakl thi, usne unse baat ki aur kaha: "Aye Ibrahim, mere saaye par ya meri hadd tak imaarat banaao, aur na barhaao na kam karo." Jab unhone tameer kar li, to woh nikal gaye aur Isma'il (AS) aur Hajar (RA) ko wahin chhod diya, aur yehi hai jahan Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "{Aur jab humne Ibrahim (AS) ke liye ghar ki jagah muqarrar ki, ke mere sath kisi ko shareek na karo, aur mere ghar ko tawaf karne walon, khade honay walon, aur ruku-sajda karne walon ke liye paak rakho}" (Surah Al-Hajj 26).

e: [AI] Ibrahim ﷺ  came and found Ismail fixing a house behind Zamzam. Ibrahim said to him, "O Ismail, indeed, your Lord has commanded me to build a house." Ismail replied, "Obey your Lord's command and I will assist you." So they both began building it, with Ibrahim laying the bricks and Ismail bringing the stones while they said, "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." [Al-Baqarah 2:127]
hi: Ibrahim (AS) aaye aur Isma'il (AS) ko Zamzam ke peechhe aik ghar durust karte huay paaya, to Ibrahim (AS) ne unse kaha: "Aye Isma'il, tumhare Rab ne mujhe ghar banaane ka hukum diya hai." Isma'il (AS) ne unse kaha: "To apne Rab ki itaa'at karo jo usne aapko hukum diya." Unhone kaha: "To mujhe iske liye madad do." Unhone kaha: to woh unke sath khade huay, Ibrahim (AS) isse banaate rahe aur Isma'il (AS) unhein patthar dete rahe, aur dono kehte rahe: "{Aye humare Rab, humse (yeh khidmat) qubool farmaa, beshak Tu hi sunane wala, jaanne wala hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 127).

e: [AI] When Ibrahim (Abraham) built the house, Allah revealed to him to proclaim the pilgrimage to the people. Ibrahim said, "Behold, Allah has chosen this house as a place of worship and He has commanded you to perform pilgrimage to it." So, in response to his call, everything that could hear, be it stone, tree, or sand, responded, "Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik" (O Allah, here I am, answering Your call)."
hi: Jab Ibrahim (AS) ne ghar tameer kiya, to Allah ne unhein wahi ki ke woh logon ko Hajj ki azaan dein. Unhone kaha: to Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: "Khabardar, beshak tumhare Rab ne aik ghar banaaya hai aur tumhein hukum diya hai ke tum iska Hajj karo," to jis kisi ne bhi yeh suna - patthar, darakht, tila, ya mitti - sabne jawaab diya: "Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik."

e: [AI] "Islam is like a quiver of thirty arrows, and no one has adopted and established this religion except for Ibrahim (Abraham), peace be upon him. Allah the Exalted said, 'And [We bestowed upon him] Ibrahim (Abraham), who fulfilled [his obligations] ([Quran 53:3]).' So Allah wrote for him immunity from the Fire."
hi: "Islam ke tees (30) hissay hain, aur is deen ko koi bhi aazmaaya nahi gaya jisne isse poora kiya siwaye Ibrahim (AS) ke, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: {Aur Ibrahim (AS) jinhone poora kiya}" (Surah An-Najm 37), to Allah ne unke liye aag se azaadi likh di.

e: "I heard a man praying for forgiveness for his parents who were idolaters, and I said: 'Are you praying for forgiveness for them even though they are idolators?" He said: 'Didn't Ibrahim pray for forgiveness for his father?' I went to the Prophet and told him about that, then the following revealed: And Ibrahim's (Abraham) invoking (of Allah) for his father's forgiveness was only because of a promise he (Ibrahim) had made to him (his father)." (Daif) (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2036)
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko kehte suna: aik aadmi ne apne walidain ke liye maghfirat ki dua ki jabke woh dono mushrik the, to maine kaha: "Kya aap unke liye maghfirat ki dua karte hain jabke woh dono mushrik hain?" Usne kaha: "Kya Ibrahim (AS) ne apne baap ke liye maghfirat ki dua nahi ki jabke woh mushrik tha?" To maine yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se zikr ki, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur Ibrahim (AS) ka apne baap ke liye maghfirat maangna sirf aik wa'de ki wajah se tha jo unhone unse kiya tha}" (Surah At-Tawbah 114). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The first who spoke Arabic and the book was put down according to his expression and pronunciation, then a single book was made like 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful,' connected until his son Ismail bin Ibrahim was separated from him, may Allah's peace be upon them both."
hi: "Sabse pehle Arabi zubaan bolne wale, aur jinke alfaaz aur andaaz-e-bayaan par Kitaab likhi gayi, phir usse aik Kitaab banaaya gaya jaisa 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem' mila hua (aik lafz ki tarah) tha, yahan tak ke unke bete Isma'il bin Ibrahim (AS), Allah ki rehmatein un dono par, ne isse alag kiya."

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "Indeed, every prophet has successors from among the prophets, and indeed, my successor and friend is my father Ibrahim." Then he recited the verse, "Indeed, the most worthy of Ibrahim among the people are those who followed him" [3:68]. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak har Nabi ke Nabiyon mein se madadgaar hote hain, aur beshak mera madadgaar aur khaleel mere waalid Ibrahim (AS) hain," phir yeh padha: "{Beshak Ibrahim (AS) ke sabse zyada qareeb woh log hain jinhone unki pairavi ki}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 68). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ  said: "Every prophet has appointed leaders among the prophets, and indeed my leader and friend among them is my father Ibrahim." Then the Prophet ﷺ  recited the verse: "Indeed, the most worthy of Ibrahim among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allah]..." (Aal 'Imran 68), until the end of the verse. This is a narration from Abu Nuaim, when combined with the narration of Al-Waqidi, it is considered authentic, as it is necessary to have a stolen verse [to complete the narration].
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak har Nabi ke Nabiyon mein se madadgaar hote hain, aur beshak mera madadgaar aur khaleel unme se mere waalid Ibrahim (AS) hain," phir Nabi (SAW) ne yeh padhi: "{Beshak Ibrahim (AS) ke sabse zyada qareeb woh log hain}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 68) ayat ke aakhir tak. Abu Nu'aim ki hadith jab Al-Waqidi ki hadith ke sath jama ki jaaye to yeh sahih ho jaati hai, kyunke isme kuch kami zaroor hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you conquer Egypt, treat the Copts well, for they have a pact and a special relationship with us." Az-Zuhri said, "The special relationship means that the mother of Isma'il, Hajar, was from amongst them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum Misr fatah karo, to Qibtiyon (Copts) ke sath achha sulook karo, kyunke unka aik ahd aur rishta hai." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Rishta yeh hai ke Isma'il (AS) ki maa unhi mein se thin."

e: [AI] Ismail (son of Ibrahim) was a prophet of Allah, who was named "Sadiq al-Waad" (the truthful in promise). He was a man of strength who fought against the enemies of Allah, and Allah granted him victory over them. He was fierce in his war against the disbelievers, and he did not fear any blame from anyone when it came to fulfilling the commands of Allah. He had a small head, a thick neck, long arms and legs. He would strike his knees with his hands while standing, and he had small eyes, a long nose, broad shoulders, long fingers, and a prominent physique. He was strong, fierce, and harsh towards the disbelievers. He used to command his family to pray and give Zakaat, and he was pleasing to his Lord. It is said, "His Zakaat was his sacrifice to Allah from his wealth, and he would not promise anyone anything except that he would fulfill it, so Allah named him Sadiq al-Waad (the truthful in promise). He was a messenger and a prophet." The isnad (chain of narration) is weak.
hi: "Isma'il bin Ibrahim (AS), Allah ke Nabi, jinhein Allah ne 'Sadiq-ul-Wa'd' (wa'da poora karne wale) ka naam diya, sakhti wale aadmi thay, Allah ke dushmano se jihad karte, aur Allah unhein unpar madad aur fatah deta, kaafiron ke khilaaf jung mein sakht thay, Allah ke maamle mein kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat ka darr nahi rakhte, chhote sar wale, mote gardan wale, lambe haath-pair wale, khade hote to apne haathon se apne ghutnon ko chhoo lete, chhoti aankhon wale, lambi naak wale, chaude kandhon wale, lambi ungliyon wale, mazboot jism wale, taaqatwar, sakht, kaafiron par sakht thay, apne ghar walon ko namaz aur zakat ka hukum dete, aur apne Rab ke nazdeek raazi thay." Unhone kaha: "Aur unki zakat Allah ke liye apne maal se qurbani thi, aur woh kisi se koi wada na karte magar poora karte, to Allah ne unhein 'Sadiq-ul-Wa'd' ka naam diya, aur woh Rasool aur Nabi thay." Isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] "The sacrifice is Ismael."
hi: "Zabih (jinhein qurbaan karne ka hukum diya gaya tha) Isma'il (AS) hain."

e: [AI] Regarding "And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice" [al-Saffat 37:107], he said: "Isma'il, at the time when Abraham slaughtered the ram."[^1]
hi: "{Aur humne unhein aik bade zibah (qurbani) se badla diya}" (Surah As-Saffat 107) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Isma'il (AS), jab Ibrahim (AS) ne mendha zibah kiya."

e: [AI] Muawiyah, we fell upon the expert while we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Then a bedouin came to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I left behind dry lands and water disappeared. Wealth was destroyed and families were lost. Please pray to Allah for me, O son of Dhabyan." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  smiled and did not object to him. We said, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, who are the two Dhabyans?"
