He said, "When Abd al-Muttalib ordered to dig Zamzam, he made a vow to Allah that if He makes it easy for him, he will sacrifice some of his children. Then he brought them out and he used arrows to select between them. The arrow came out for Abdullah, and he intended to sacrifice him, but his uncles from the Banu Makhzum prevented him and said, 'Satisfy the Lord of your city and ransom your son.' So he ransomed him with one hundred camels. He is the one who was intended to be sacrificed, and Ismail is the second."
hi: Muawiyah (RA): hum jaankaar (mahir) ke paas aa pahunche - hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas thay ke aik badu aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main peeche zameen ko sookha aur paani ko khushk chhod aaya hoon, maal halaak ho gaya aur ahl-o-ayaal barbaad ho gaye, isliye Allah ne aapko jo diya hai usme se mujhe bhi dein, Aye Zabeehain (do qurbaan kiye jaane walon) ke bete." To Rasulullah (SAW) muskuraaye aur usse mana nahi kiya, to humne poocha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, 'Zabeehain' kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Jab Abdul Muttalib ne Zamzam khodne ka hukum diya, to unhone Allah se nazar maani ke agar Allah unka kaam aasaan kar de to woh apne kisi bete ko zibah karengay, to unhone unhein bulaaya aur unke darmiyan qura (fal) daala, to fal Abdullah ke naam nikla, unhone unhein zibah karne ka iraada kiya, to unke mamu, Banu Makhzoom, ne unhein roka aur kaha: 'Apne Rab ko raazi karo aur apne bete ke badle fidya do.' Unhone kaha: to unhone sau (100) oontniyon se unka fidya diya." Unhone kaha: "To yehi Zabeeh hain, aur Isma'il (AS) doosre hain." Isnad kamzor.

e: [AI] "It is [said] that it is Isaac and the Jews denied [him]." Ibn Wahb heard it from him, meaning from Umar ibn Qais, and he (Umar ibn Qais) was killed.
hi: "Ke yeh Ishaq (AS) hain, aur Yahoodiyon ne jhoot bola." Ibn Wahb ne isse unse suna, ya'ni Umar bin Qais se, aur woh (raawi ke taur par) halaak hai.

e: [AI] He said about the one whom Allah redeemed by a great sacrifice, he said, "He is Ismail."
hi: Us shakhs ke baare mein jinhein Allah ne bade zibah se badla diya, unhone kaha: "Woh Isma'il (AS) hain."

e: [AI] About Ibrahim and what he was commanded regarding the sacrifice of his son, that it was Isma'il. This is because Allah says, when He completed the story of the slaughtered sons of Ibrahim, He said, "And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishaq, a Prophet from the righteous." Then He says, "And We gave her the glad tidings of Ishaq, and after Ishaq, Yaqub." He says, "with a son and a son of a son," and he did not command the sacrifice of Ishaq, and He had a promise from Allah regarding him. The one who was commanded to be sacrificed was only Isma'il. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Ibrahim (AS) ke baare mein aur unhein apne bete ko zibah karne ka jo hukum diya gaya, ke woh Isma'il (AS) hain, aur iski wajah yeh hai ke Allah jab zibah kiye jaane wale Ibrahim (AS) ke bete ka qissa mukammal karta hai, to farmata hai: "{Aur humne unhein Ishaq (AS) ki khush-khabri di, aik Nabi, saaleheen mein se}" phir farmata hai: "{To humne use Ishaq (AS) ki khush-khabri di, aur Ishaq (AS) ke baad Yaqub (AS) ki}," ya'ni beta aur pota, to unhein Ishaq (AS) ko zibah karne ka hukum na tha, aur unke liye Allah ki taraf se pehle hi wa'da tha jo usne unse kiya tha, aur jise zibah karne ka hukum diya gaya woh sirf Isma'il (AS) thay. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] There has been a difference of opinion regarding Isma'il and Ishaq; which of them did Ibrahim intend to sacrifice, and where did he intend to sacrifice him, in Mina or in the House of the Sacred Mosque? Whenever I heard anything about this matter from narrations, I would ask Ibn Abi Sabrah, from Abu Malik, from the descendants of Malik Ad-Dar. He was a mawla (freed slave) of 'Uthman ibn 'Affan, about what they said about the sacrifice of Allah, which of them was it? He said: When Isma'il was seven years old, Ibrahim saw in a dream that he was slaughtering Isma'il. Ibrahim came to Isma'il's mother and told her about his dream. She said: Do what you have been commanded to do. Then Ibrahim went to present the matter to Isma'il. He said to him: O Isma'il, I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you. What do you think? Isma'il said: O my father, do as you have been commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, to be among the patient. When they had both submitted willingly to the command of Allah and Ibrahim had laid his son prostrate, ready to plainly fulfill the command of his Lord, the Shaytan (Satan) appeared to Haajar (Hagar), saying: Do you know what your husband is going to do? She said: Yes. He said: He is going to slaughter your son. She said: Has he been commanded to do so? He said: Yes. She said: Then Allah will not make him (Ibrahim) suffer any loss. As for Isma'il, while he was being laid down, he said: O my father! Tie my hands behind my back, so that I may not struggle against you, and turn my face away from you so that you will not see me suffering. When Ibrahim had laid him prostrate on his face (in order to sacrifice him), Isma'il heard a voice saying: O Ibrahim! You have fulfilled the dream. Thus do We reward those who do right. That indeed was a manifest trial. Then they ransomed Isma'il with a great sacrifice (a ram).
hi: Humare darmiyan Isma'il (AS) aur Ishaq (AS) ke baare mein ikhtilaaf raha ke Ibrahim (AS) ne kisse zibah karne ka iraada kiya tha aur kahan zibah karna chaaha - Mina mein ya Bait-ul-Maqdis mein? To jab bhi maine is baare mein koi hadith suni maine likh li. Ibn Abi Sabrah ne mujhse, Abu Malik se, Malik Ad-Daar ki aulaad mein se, jo Uthman bin Affan (RA) ke ghulam thay, Ata bin Yasar se hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: maine Khawwat bin Jubair Al-Ansari se poocha ke Allah ka zibah (qurbani) kaun thay? Unhone kaha: "Isma'il (AS). Jab Isma'il (AS) saat (7) saal ke huay, to Ibrahim (AS) ne Sham mein apne ghar mein khwaab dekha ke woh Isma'il (AS) ko zibah kar rahe hain, to woh Buraq par sawaar hokar unke paas gaye, unhein unki maa ke paas paaya, unka haath pakda aur unhein us hukum ke liye le gaye jo unhein diya gaya tha, aur shaitan unke paas aik pehchaane hue aadmi ki soorat mein aaya, usne kaha: 'Aye Ibrahim, kahan ja rahe ho?' Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: 'Apni zaroorat ke liye.' Usne kaha: 'Tum Isma'il (AS) ko zibah karna chahte ho?' Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: 'Kya tumne kabhi kisi baap ko apne bete ko zibah karte dekha hai?' Usne kaha: 'Haan, tum ho.' Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: 'Kyun?' Usne kaha: 'Tum samajhte ho ke Allah ne tumhein yeh hukum diya.' Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: 'Agar Allah ne mujhe hukum diya, to humne Allah ki itaa'at ki aur main behtareen (kaam) karunga.' To woh unse mudkar chala gaya aur Iblees Hajar (RA) ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Ibrahim (AS) tumhare bete ko kahan le gaye?' Unhone kaha: 'Apni zaroorat ke liye gaye.' Usne kaha: 'Woh use zibah karna chahte hain.' Unhone kaha: 'Kya tumne kabhi kisi baap ko apne bete ko zibah karte dekha hai?' Usne kaha: 'Woh samajhta hai ke Allah ne usse yeh hukum diya hai.' Unhone kaha: 'To usne behtareen (kaam) kiya ke usne Allah ki itaa'at ki.' Phir woh Isma'il (AS) ke paas pahuncha aur kaha: 'Aye Isma'il, tumhara baap tumhein kahan le ja raha hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Apni zaroorat ke liye.' Usne kaha: 'Woh tumhein zibah karne ke liye le ja raha hai.' Unhone kaha: 'Kya tumne kabhi kisi baap ko apne bete ko zibah karte dekha hai?' Usne kaha: 'Haan, woh hai.' Unhone kaha: 'Kyun?' Usne kaha: 'Woh samajhta hai ke Allah ne usse yeh hukum diya hai.' Isma'il (AS) ne kaha: 'To usne behtareen (kaam) kiya ke usne apne Rab ki itaa'at ki.' Unhone kaha: to woh unhein lekar Mina pahunche jahan hukum diya gaya tha, phir Aaj ke jaanwaron ke zibah-gaah tak pahunche, to unhone kaha: 'Aye mere bete, Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai ke main tumhein zibah karoon.' Isma'il (AS) ne kaha: 'To itaa'at karo, kyunke apne Rab ki itaa'at har bhalaai hai.' Phir Isma'il (AS) ne poocha: 'Kya aapne meri maa ko iske baare mein bataaya?' Unhone kaha: 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha: 'Theek kiya, mujhe darr hai ke woh gham-zada ho jaayegi, lekin jab aap chaaqu meri gardan ke qareeb laayen, to mujhse mun pher lein, kyunke yeh aapke liye sabr karna aasaan banaayega aur aap mujhe nahi dekhenge.' Ibrahim (AS) ne aisa hi kiya, aur unki gardan par kaatna shuru kiya, lekin kaate ka nishaan aise tha jaise taambe par ho, chaaqu ghisti hi nahi thi, unhone use do ya teen martaba patthar par tez kiya, har martaba woh kaat nahi paate. Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: 'Yeh maamla Allah ki taraf se hai,' to unhone apna sar uthaaya, achaanak aik pahaadi bakra (wo'l) unke saamne khada tha. To Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: 'Uth jao, aye mere bete, tumhara fidya utar aaya hai.' To unhone use wahin Mina mein zibah kiya."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said: "The Prophet of Allah, Dawud (David), said, 'Oh Lord, I hear people saying that Isaac has invoked You, but indeed, Isaac has invoked You for himself.'"
hi: Allah ke Nabi Dawud (AS) ne kaha: "Aye Rab, main logon ko kehte suna hoon: Rab-e-Ishaq (Ishaq ka Rab), (magar) beshak Ishaq ne mere liye apni jaan qurbaan karne ki koshish ki thi."

e: [AI] About Ibrahim ar-Ru'a, the glad tidings of Ishaq came to him and he felt safe from what he feared. He said, "Praise be to Allah who granted me Isma'il and Ishaq in my old age. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication." Then Jibril (Gabriel) came to Sarah with the glad tidings and said, "Rejoice in a son named Ishaq, and after Ishaq, there will be Ya'qub (Jacob)." She hit her forehead in amazement, and that is what Allah says in the Quran, "So she struck her face and exclaimed, 'A barren old woman!'" (Surah adh-Dhariyat, 51:29). She said, "Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is a strange thing." They said, "Do you wonder at the decree of Allah? The mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, O people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable." Bukhari narrated it with 'Ikrama, and Muslim narrated it with As-Suddi, and the hadith is authentic in its chain of narration, and they did not exclude it.
hi: Ibrahim (AS) ka khauf door hua, unhein Ishaq (AS) ki khush-khabri mili, aur woh us (mehmaan) se mehfooz ho gaye jinse woh darte the, unhone kaha: "Tamam tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe boodhi umr mein Isma'il (AS) aur Ishaq (AS) ata kiye, beshak mera Rab zaroor dua sunne wala hai." To Jibra'il (AS) khush-khabri lekar Sarah (RA) ke paas aaye, unhone kaha: "Khush ho jao aik bete ki jise Ishaq kaha jayega, aur Ishaq ke baad Yaqub hoga." Unhone kaha: to unhone hairat se apni peshaani par haath maara, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{To unhone apna chehra pita}" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 29), aur kaha: "Kya main bacha janam dungi jabke main boodhi hoon, aur yeh mera shohar boodha hai? Beshak yeh bohot ajeeb baat hai." Unhone kaha: "Kya tum Allah ke hukum par ta'ajjub karti ho? Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein tum ahl-e-bait par ho, beshak woh tareef ke laayak, buzurgi wala hai." Bukhari ne Ikramah se hujjat li hai, aur Muslim ne As-Suddi se hujjat li hai, aur yeh hadith apni sanad mein sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "Then there was Ishmael, son of Ibrahim, whom Allah made a light, a radiance, and a source of delight for his parents. He was among the best of people in appearance and most beautiful, and his speech was excellent. His hair and beard were curly and resembled the creation and character of Ibrahim. He was born to Ishmael who had two sons: Jacob and Essa. Jacob was better than both of them in appearance, speech, and beauty. Essa had abundant hair on his head, body, and face, and he resided in Rome." As narrated by Samurah ibn Jundub with this chain of narration.
hi: "Phir Ishaq bin Ibrahim (AS) thay, jinhein Allah ne apne waalidain ke liye noor, roshni, aur aankhon ki thandak banaaya, to woh logon mein sabse achhe chehre wale, sabse zyada khoobsurat, aur sabse behtareen guftagu karne wale thay, gore rang, ghunghraale sar aur daadhi wale, Ibrahim (AS) se shakl-o-surat aur akhlaaq mein milte-julte thay, aur Ishaq (AS) ke haan Yaqub aur Ees paida huay, to Yaqub dono mein zyada khoobsurat, zyada khush-guftaar, aur zyada husn wale thay, aur Ees ke sar, jism, aur chehre par ghane baal the, aur woh Room (Rome) mein rehte thay," jaisa Samurah bin Jundub ne bayan kiya. Isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] "Glad tidings of Prophethood were given twice, once at the time of his birth and once at the time of his appointment." The chain of narration is authentic and it was not mentioned in Sahih.
hi: "Nubuwwat ki khush-khabri unhein do martaba di gayi - jab woh paida huay aur jab unhein Nabi banaaya gaya." Sanad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala. Sahih.

e: [AI] About Ishaq bin Ibrahim the Prophet? Abu Hurayrah said, "Yes." Ka'b, when he saw Ibrahim about to sacrifice Ishaq, said, "By Allah! If Ibrahim does not disobey Allah during this, then I will never mislead any of them." So, Shaytan took the form of a man they knew and entered upon Sarah, Ibrahim's wife, and said to her, "Where is Ibrahim going with Ishaq?" Sarah said, "He went to fulfill some of his needs." Shaytan said, "No, by Allah! He did not go for that reason." Sarah said, "Then why did he go?" Shaytan said, "He went to sacrifice him." Sarah said, "But that cannot be! He would never sacrifice his own son." Shaytan said, "Indeed, he would, by Allah." Sarah said, "And why would he do that?" Shaytan said, "He claimed that Allah commanded him to do so." Sarah said, "Well, if Allah has commanded him, then he should obey Him." So Shaytan left Sarah's presence and went after Ibrahim. When he caught up to Ishaq as he was walking in the footsteps of his father, he said, "Where did your father go with you?" Ishaq said, "He went out for some of his needs." Shaytan said, "No, by Allah! He did not go with you for that reason. He went with you to sacrifice you." Ishaq said, "But my father would never sacrifice me." Shaytan said, "Indeed, he would, by Allah." Ishaq said, "But why would he sacrifice me?" Shaytan said, "He claimed that Allah commanded him to do so." Ishaq said, "By Allah! If Allah has commanded him, then he must obey Him." So Shaytan left Ishaq and hurried to Ibrahim. He asked him, "Where did you go with your son?" Ibrahim said, "I went out for some of my needs." Shaytan said, "No, by Allah! You did not go with him for that reason. You went with him to sacrifice him." Ibrahim said, "And why would I sacrifice him?" Shaytan said, "You claimed that Allah commanded you to do so." Ibrahim said, "By Allah! If Allah has commanded me, then I will do it." So when Ibrahim took Ishaq to sacrifice him, and Ishaq surrendered himself to Allah, Allah pardoned him and redeemed him with a great sacrifice. Ibrahim said to Ishaq, "My son, get up, for Allah has pardoned you." And Allah revealed to Ishaq, "I have granted you a supplication that I will answer for you." Ishaq said, "Then I supplicate to you that you answer the supplication of any of your servants who meets you, from the first to the last, and does not associate anything with you." So admit him to Paradise.
hi: Ishaq bin Ibrahim (AS), Nabi, ke baare mein poocha gaya, Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Kyun nahi." Ka'b ne kaha: jab Ibrahim (AS) ne khwaab dekha ke woh Ishaq (AS) ko zibah kar rahe hain, to shaitan ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar main isi mauqe par Ibrahim (AS) ke ghar walon ko gumraah na kar saka, to main unme se kabhi kisi ko gumraah nahi kar paaunga." To shaitan unke saamne aik pehchaane hue aadmi ki soorat mein aaya, unhone kaha: to woh aaya, jab Ibrahim (AS) Ishaq (AS) ko zibah karne ke liye lekar nikle, to woh Ibrahim (AS) ki biwi Sarah (RA) ke paas gaya aur unse poocha: "Ibrahim (AS) subah subah Ishaq (AS) ko kahan lekar gaye?" Sarah (RA) ne kaha: "Apni kisi zaroorat ke liye gaye." Shaitan ne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, woh isliye nahi gaye." Sarah (RA) ne kaha: "To kis liye le gaye?" Usne kaha: "Use zibah karne ke liye le gaye." Sarah (RA) ne kaha: "Aisi koi baat nahi, woh apne bete ko zibah nahi karengay." Shaitan ne kaha: "Kyun nahi, Allah ki qasam." Sarah (RA) ne kaha: "To kyun zibah karengay?" Usne kaha: "Unka khayal hai ke unke Rab ne unhein yeh hukum diya hai." To Sarah (RA) ne kaha: "To unhone achha kiya agar unhein unke Rab ne yeh hukum diya hai to unhein itaa'at karni chahiye." To shaitan Sarah (RA) ke paas se chala gaya yahan tak ke Ishaq (AS) ke paas pahuncha jo apne baap ke peechhe chal rahe thay, usne poocha: "Tumhare abba subah subah tumhein kahan le gaye?" Unhone kaha: "Apni kisi zaroorat ke liye le gaye." Shaitan ne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, woh tumhein kisi zaroorat ke liye nahi le gaye, balke tumhein zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain." Ishaq (AS) ne kaha: "Mere abba mujhe zibah nahi karenge." Usne kaha: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "Kyun?" Usne kaha: "Unka khayal hai ke Allah ne unhein yeh hukum diya hai." Ishaq (AS) ne kaha: "To Allah ki qasam, agar Allah ne unhein hukum diya hai to woh zaroor itaa'at karenge." To shaitan unhein chhod kar tezi se Ibrahim (AS) ke paas gaya aur poocha: "Tum subah subah apne bete ko kahan le gaye?" Unhone kaha: "Apni kisi zaroorat ke liye le gaya." Usne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, tum use zibah karne ke siwa kisi aur maqsad se nahi le gaye." Unhone kaha: "To main use kyun zibah karoon?" Usne kaha: "Tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ne tumhein yeh hukum diya hai." Unhone kaha: "To Allah ki qasam, agar Allah ne mujhe hukum diya hai to main zaroor karunga." Unhone kaha: jab Ibrahim (AS) ne Ishaq (AS) ko zibah karne ke liye pakda aur Ishaq (AS) ne (Allah ke hukum ke aage) sar jhukaaya, to Allah ne unhein bacha liya aur unka fidya aik bade zibah se diya. Ibrahim (AS) ne Ishaq (AS) se kaha: "Uth jao, aye mere bete, Allah ne tumhein maaf kar diya hai." Aur Allah ne Ishaq (AS) ki taraf wahi ki: "Maine tumhein aik dua di hai jo main tumhare liye qubool karunga." Ishaq (AS) ne kaha: "To main tujhse maangta hoon ke jo bhi banda, pehle ho ya baad ke, tujhse mile aur tere sath kisi ko shareek na kare, to usse Jannat mein dakhil kar."

e: [AI] "He is Isaac, meaning the sacrificial goat" Correct.
hi: "Woh Ishaq (AS) hain, ya'ni zibah kiye jaane wale." Sahih.

e: [AI] "The sacrifice of Isaac"
hi: "Zabih Ishaq (AS) hain."

e: [AI] Indeed, the rock at the root of Thabeer, on which Ibrahim slaughtered (his son) Ishaq, a white ram descended on it. It had a bleating from Thabeer, which bleating he remembered. So he narrated a lengthy story. Al-Waqidi said: Muhammad ibn Amr al-Uwaysi informed us on the authority of Abu al-Zubayr who narrated from Jabir, he said: When Ibrahim saw in a dream that he is slaughtering Ishaq, he took him by his hand and mentioned him regarding his length.
hi: "Beshak woh chattaan jo Thabeer pahaad ki jad mein hai, jispar Ibrahim (AS) ne Ishaq (AS) ko zibah kiya, uspar aik khaakistari (grey) mendha utra, jiski Thabeer se aik awaaz thi jo usse pukaar rahi thi." Phir aik lambi hadith zikr ki. Al-Waqidi ne kaha: aur humein Muhammad bin Amr Al-Uwaisi ne, Abu Az-Zubair se, unhone Jabir (RA) se hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: jab Ibrahim (AS) ne khwaab mein dekha ke woh Ishaq (AS) ko zibah kar rahe hain, to unhone unka haath pakda, phir puri tafseel se zikr ki.

e:
[AI] The story of Isaac when Allah commanded Abraham to sacrifice him, and Allah bestowed Isaac upon Abraham on the night the angels departed from him. When Isaac was seven years old, Allah revealed to Abraham to sacrifice him and make him a sacrificial offering. On that day, the offering was accepted and raised, so Abraham kept it a secret from Isaac and all the people and confided in his beloved friend. Al-Ghazir As-Siddiq, who was the first to believe in Abraham's words, said to him, "Indeed, Allah does not test anyone like He tested you. But He wants to test you and examine you. So do not have any doubts about Allah, for He will make you a leader among the people. There is no power or strength for Abraham and Isaac except through Allah, the Merciful."

Then Wahb recalled a long narration until he said, "And Wahb informed me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Isaac will precede the people in a supplication that no one before him had received. And he will intercede for the people on the Day of Resurrection, so that they may be forgiven. And Allah blessed Abraham in that situation, saying, 'Listen to me, O Abraham, the most truthful of the truthful ones.' And He said to Isaac, 'Listen to me, O Isaac, the most patient of the patient ones.' Indeed, I have tested you today with a great test. No one from my creation has been tested as you have been. O Abraham, I tested you with fire, and you showed great patience that no one from the worlds could match. And I tested you, O Isaac, with sacrifice, and you did not hesitate to offer yourself. And you did not consider it of great significance in obeying your father. And you saw that as a small favor from Allah, as you hoped for the best reward and an easy meeting with Him. And today, I make a covenant with both of you, a covenant that I will not break, and I entrust you with yourself. O Abraham, Paradise has become obligatory for you, as you are my friend among the people of the earth, surpassing the men of the worlds. This is a virtue that no one before you has attained, nor will anyone after you. Abraham bowed down in prostration, showing great respect for what he had heard from Allah, expressing gratitude to Him. And as for you, O Isaac, wish for whatever you desire and ask of me, and I will fulfill your request.' Isaac said, 'I ask you, O my God, to choose me for yourself and intercede for me among your monotheistic worshippers. And let no servant meet you who associates anything with you except that I will save him from the Fire.' His Lord said to him, 'I have granted you what you asked for, and I guarantee you my protection and promise you my sovereignty. I will not go back on my word, and I will not withhold any favor from you. You will receive abundant blessings that will not be withdrawn.'"

This is the end of the narration mentioned by Abdul Moneim Ibn Idris.
hi: Ishaq (AS) ki hadith, jab Allah ne Ibrahim (AS) ko unhein zibah karne ka hukum diya - Allah ne Ibrahim (AS) ko Ishaq (AS) us raat ata kiya jismein farishte unse juda huay, jab woh saat (7) saal ke huay, to Allah ne Ibrahim (AS) ki taraf wahi ki ke unhein zibah karein aur qurbani banaayein, aur us zamane mein qurbani qubool ki jaati aur uthaa li jaati thi, to Ibrahim (AS) ne yeh baat Ishaq (AS) aur sab logon se chhupaayi, aur sirf apne aik khaas dost ko bataayi, to Al-Ghaazir As-Siddiq ne, jo Ibrahim (AS) par sabse pehle imaan laane wale the, unse kaha: "Beshak Allah tumhare jaise (buzurg) ko aisi aazmaaish mein nahi daalta, balke woh tumhein parakhna aur aazmaana chaahta hai, isliye Allah ke baare mein apna gumaan bura mat karo, kyunke Allah tumhein logon ka imam banaayega, aur Ibrahim (AS) aur Ishaq (AS) ke paas Allah, Rahman, Raheem ke siwa koi taaqat aur qudrat nahi." Phir Wahb ne aik lambi hadith zikr ki, yahan tak ke Wahb ne kaha: "Aur mujhe pata chala ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ishaq (AS) logon se aage aik dua mein nikle jismein unse pehle kisi ne unhein pichhad nahi diya, aur Qayamat ke din khade hokar is dua walon ki shafa'at zaroor karenge." Aur Allah us maqaam par Ibrahim (AS) ki taraf mutawajjeh hua aur farmaya: "Mujhse suno, Aye Ibrahim, sabse sachche sachchon mein se," aur Ishaq (AS) se farmaya: "mujhse suno, Aye sabse sabr karne wale sabr karne walon mein se, beshak maine tum dono ko aaj aik bohot badi aazmaaish mein daala hai jo maine apni makhlooq mein se kisi ko nahi di - Maine tumhein, Aye Ibrahim, aag se aazmaaya, aur tumne aisa sabr kiya jaisa duniya walon mein se kisi ne nahi kiya, aur maine tumhein mere raaste mein jihad se aazmaaya jabke tum akele aur kamzor thay, to tumne aisi tasdeeq aur sabr kiya jaisa duniya walon mein se kisi ne nahi kiya, aur maine tumhein, Aye Ishaq, zibah se aazmaaya, aur tumne apni jaan mein kanjoosi nahi ki aur apne baap ki itaa'at mein isse bada nahi samjha, aur tumne ise Allah ke liye aasaan aur chhota samjha jaise tum uske behtareen sawaab ki ummeed rakhte ho, aur usne tumhare liye achhi mulaqaat ko aasaan kiya, aur main aaj tum dono se aik ahd karta hoon jisse main kabhi nahi rokunga - rahi baat tumhari, Aye Ibrahim, to Jannat tumhare liye mujhpar wajib ho gayi hai, kyunke tum zameen walon mein se mere khaleel ho, saare jahaan walon se alag, aur yeh aisi fazeelat hai jo tumse pehle kisi ko nahi mili aur tumhare baad kisi ko nahi milegi." To Ibrahim (AS) Allah ke is farmaan ki azmat mein sajde mein gir gaye, Allah ka shukr ada karte huay, "aur rahi baat tumhari, Aye Ishaq, to jo chaaho mujhse maango aur maangte raho, tumhein tumhari maang di jayegi." Unhone kaha: "Main tujhse maangta hoon, Aye mere Ma'bood, ke tu mujhe apne liye chun le aur mujhe apne muwahhid (tauheed maanne wale) bandon ki shafa'at kar de, taake koi bhi banda tujhse na mile jo tere sath kisi ko shareek na karta ho magar main use aag se bachaaun." Unke Rab ne unse farmaya: "Maine tumhari maangi hui cheez wajib kar di, aur maine tumhari wilaayat ki zimmedaari li hai, jo maine tum dono se apni zaat par wa'da kiya hai, aisa wa'da jise main nahi todunga, aisa ahd jisse main kabhi nahi rokunga, aur aisi khushgawar ata jo wapas nahi li jayegi." Abdul Mun'im bin Idris ki riwayat kuch bhi nahi (qeemat ki).

e: [AI] His saying, "And [mention] when Abraham was tried by his Lord with words and he fulfilled them." [Al-Baqarah 124] He said, "The rituals of Hajj."
hi: Uska farmaan "{Aur jab Ibrahim (AS) ko unke Rab ne kuch kalimaat se aazmaaya, to unhone unhein poora kiya}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 124) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Hajj ke manaasik (arkaan)."

e: [AI] When Sarah passed away, Ibrahim married a woman named Hajar, who gave birth to seven children for him: Ismail, Medyan, Kaysan, Lut, Sarakh, Umaymah, Na'shan. It is also mentioned in this book that Ibrahim was gifted by Medyan with ranks, and that Lut was among them. Ibn Al-Dhahabi did not mention anything about this in his summary.
hi: Jab Sarah (RA) faut huin, to Ibrahim (AS) ne aik aurat se nikah kiya jise Hajura kaha jaata tha, unhone unke liye saat (7) bete janam diye - Bafis, Madyan, Kaisan, Lut, Sarkh, Umaim, aur Na'shan. Wahb ne is kitaab mein yeh bhi zikr kiya ke Madyan Ibrahim (AS) ke darjaat (aulaad) mein se the, aur Lut bhi unme shaamil thay. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Prophet Lut ﷺ  was the nephew of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), the beloved friend of God. This is an authentic chain of narration."
hi: "Aur Nabi Lut (AS), Ibrahim Khaleel (AS) ke bhatije thay." Yeh sanad sahih hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] "Prophet Lut ﷺ  is Lut bin Fārān bin Āzar bin Bākhūr bin Akhī Ibrāhīm al-Khalīl, and the mu'ṭafikah (those destroyed with a mighty blast) were Lot's people."
hi: "Aur Nabi Lut (AS), Lut bin Faaraan bin Aazar bin Baakhoor, Ibrahim Khaleel ke bhatije, hain, aur 'Mu'tafikah' Lut (AS) ki qaum ko kehte hain."

e: [AI] On the authority of Abu Hurairah, in his saying of Allah the Almighty, "Or take refuge" [Hud 80], the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "May Allah have mercy on Lot. He used to take refuge in a severe pillar, and Allah did not send a prophet after him except in the midst of his people."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Ya kisi mazboot sahaare ki taraf panaah loon}" (Surah Hud 80) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Lut (AS) par reham kare, woh mazboot sahaare ki taraf panaah liya karte thay, aur Allah ne unke baad koi bhi Nabi bagair apni qaum mein taaqat ke nahi bheja."

e: [AI] "No prophet has been sent after Lot except among his own people."
hi: "Lut (AS) ke baad Allah ne koi Nabi nahi bheja magar apni qaum mein taaqat rakhte huay."

e: [AI] "Lot set forth and arrived among the people of Sodom, where he found them engaged in homosexual activities. He stayed with them and Allah sent him as a messenger to them. He called and advised them, and he knew about their actions as mentioned in the book of Allah. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: "Lut (AS) rawaana huay aur Sadum (Sodom) walon ke paas utre, unhein aik napasandeeda amal (fahisha) mein mubtala paaya, to unhone unke darmiyan qayaam kiya, Allah ne unhein unki taraf bheja, to unhone unhein dawat di aur naseehat ki, aur unke haalaat ka woh qissa hua jo Allah ne apni Kitaab mein bayan kiya hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Lot was a prophet of Allah, and he was the nephew of Ibrahim. He was a fair-skinned man with a beautiful face, a slender nose, small ears, and long fingers. He had good manners and was the best of people in making others laugh. He was kind, intelligent, wise, and he caused the least harm to his people. When he was informed about the great harm that his people intended for him, he said, "If only I had strength [to defend myself] or could take refuge in a strong support!" (Surah Hud, 11:80). Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in his summary.
hi: Lut (AS) Allah ke Nabi thay, aur woh Ibrahim (AS) ke bhatije thay, gore, khoobsurat chehre wale, patli naak wale, chhoti kaan wale, lambi ungliyon wale, achhe daanton wale, hansi mazaak mein sabse behtareen, sabse waqar wale, sabse mazboot iraade wale, aur apni qaum ko sabse kam takleef pahunchaane wale aadmi thay, aur jab unhein apni qaum ki taraf se woh bhaari takleef pahunchi jo woh unke sath karna chahte the, to unhone kaha: "{Kaash mere paas tumhare muqaable ki taaqat hoti ya main kisi mazboot sahaare ki taraf panaah le sakta}" (Surah Hud 80). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] That Ibrahim, when he migrated to the land of Sham and they expelled him from there, he departed and with him was Sarah. She said to him, "Indeed, I have gifted myself to you." Then Allah inspired to him to marry her, and it was the first revelation that was sent to him, and Lot believed in it, as did his people in his lineage. He said, "Indeed, I am migrating to my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise." So they expelled him from Babylonia to the sacred land until he reached Harran, and they expelled him from there until they brought him to the Jordan River, which contained a strong giant among the giants, but Allah destroyed him. Then Ibrahim returned to Sham, and with him was Lot. Allah informed Lot and sent him as a messenger and a caller to Allah in the cities known as the "mou'tafaqat", with Sodom being the greatest among them, followed by Amoud, Aram, Sa'our, and Sabour. The people of these cities numbered four thousand thousand men. Lot stayed in Sodom for twenty-five years, commanding them, forbidding them, and inviting them to Allah and to worship Him, and he left what they were engaged in of immorality and abominations. It was obligatory on Lot to offer hospitality to his guests, just as it was obligatory on Ibrahim and Ismael. But his people did not host anyone, rather, they only approached the men from the worlds and called the women. Allah denounced them for this through the tongue of their Prophet in the Quran, saying, "Do you approach men among the worlds and leave what your Lord has created for you as wives?" Then Wahb and Abdullah bin Abbas mentioned that which led them to have relations with men without women. They had gardens and fruits in their homes, as well as gardens and fruits on the outskirts of the road. Then they were afflicted with severe drought and hunger. So some of them said to others, "If you refrain from giving away your fruits to the travelers, you will have provisions for yourselves." They asked how they could do that, so some of them suggested to abduct any stranger they found in their land and marry him, claiming him as their own. They would take him and grab him. Thus, whenever people came upon them, they did this to them. This became their practice until Iblis went to those mountains in the form of a beautiful and radiant young boy. The people saw him and admired him, so they adored him, married him, took him, and grabbed him. Then he left. People would not come to them except that they would do the same to them. This became their practice until Allah sent Lot to them, forbidding them from doing this and warning them of punishment. They sought his forgiveness, and he said, "O my people, you have committed the obscenity that no one in the worlds has committed before you." Then the rest of the narration continues as narrated by Ibn Abbas, but it was not mentioned by Al-Dhahabi in his summary.
hi: Jab Ibrahim (AS) Sham (Syria) ki zameen ki taraf hijrat kar gaye aur unhein wahan se nikaal diya gaya, to woh nikle, unke sath Sarah (RA) thin, unhone kaha: "Maine apni jaan aap ko de di hai," to Allah ne unhein wahi ki ke woh unse nikah kar lein, to yeh unpar nazil honay wali pehli wahi thi, aur Lut (AS) apni qaum ke aik giroh ke sath unpar imaan laaye, aur kaha: "Main apne Rab ki taraf hijrat karne wala hoon, beshak wahi Azeez, Hakeem hai," to unhein Babil ki zameen se paak zameen ki taraf nikaal diya gaya, yahan tak ke Harran pahunche, wahan se bhi nikaal diya gaya, yahan tak ke unhein Urdun (Jordan) tak pahunchaaya gaya, wahan aik zaalim (jabbaar) tha, yahan tak ke Allah ne usse tabaah kar diya, phir Ibrahim (AS) Sham wapas laute, unke sath Lut (AS) bhi thay, to Allah ne Lut (AS) ko Nabuwwat di aur unhein "Mu'tafikaat" (ulti gayi bastiyon) ki taraf Rasool aur Allah ki taraf dawat dene wala banaakar bheja, aur yeh paanch (5) shehar thay, sabse bada Sadum (Sodom), phir Amood, phir Aroom, phir Sa'oor, phir Saaboor, aur in shehron ke bashinde chaar hazaar hazaar (4,000,000) insaan the. To Lut (AS) Sadum mein utre, unke sath bees se zyada saal rahe, unhein achhi baat ka hukum dete, buri baat se rokte, aur unhein Allah ki aur uski ibaadat ki taraf bulaate, aur jis napasandeeda amal aur ganditgi par woh thay usse chhodne ki taraf bulaate. Aur mehmaan-nawaazi Lut (AS) par bhi farz thi jaise Ibrahim (AS) aur Isma'il (AS) par thi, magar unki qaum kisi ko mehmaan nahi banaati thi, aur woh (ghair-fitri taur par) mardon ki taraf jaate aur auraton ko chhod dete, to Allah ne apne Nabi ki zubaan se Quran mein unhein isspar malamat ki, farmaya: "{Kya tum jahaan walon mein se sirf mardon ke paas jaate ho, aur jo tumhare Rab ne tumhare liye tumhari biwiyon mein se paida kiya use chhod dete ho}" (Surah Ash-Shu'ara 166). Wahb ne kaha, aur Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne zikr kiya ke unhein auraton ke bajaaye mardon ki taraf lejaane wali cheez yeh thi ke unke paas apne gharon mein baaghaat aur phal the, aur sadak ke kinare bhi baaghaat aur phal the, aur unhein sakht qaht aur bhook ne aa liya, to unme se kuch ne aapas mein kaha: "Agar tum apne yeh zaahiri phal musaafiron se rok do, to tumhe isme aik zaria-e-maa'ash mil jaayega." Unhone poocha: "Hum ise kaise roken?" To unme se kuch ne kaha: "Apna qaida yeh banaao ke tum apne mulk mein jo bhi ajnabi paao jise tum na pehchaante ho, usse chheen lo, uske sath (buri) harkat karo, aur usse ghaseeto, isse log tumhare mulk mein qadam nahi rakhengay." To Iblees un pahaadon par aik khoobsurat, roshan larke ki soorat mein aaya, aisa khoobsurat larka jo logon ne kabhi dekha nahi tha, aur usne unhein mutasir kiya, to unhone (uske sath) buraai ki, usse chheena, aur ghaseeta, phir woh chala gaya, aur jab bhi koi (musafir) unke paas aata woh unke sath yehi karte, to yeh unka qaida ban gaya yahan tak ke Allah ne unki taraf Lut (AS) ko bheja, Lut (AS) ne unhein isse roka aur unhein azaab se daraaya, aur unse maazrat ki, unhone kaha: "Aye meri qaum, tum aisi besharmi karte ho jo tumse pehle jahaan walon mein se kisi ne nahi ki," phir baaqi hadith Ibn Abbas (RA) se zikr ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And about some of the companions of the Prophet, peace be upon him, it is narrated: When the angels came out from Ibrahim, peace be upon him, towards the city of Lut and reached the river of Sodom, they met the daughter of Lut, who was fetching water for her family. Lut's daughters were two in number. They said to her, 'O girl, is there any house nearby? She replied, 'Yes, your place is not far, but do not enter until I bring you what you need.' Then she went to her father and said, 'O my father, there are young men standing at the gate of the city. I have never seen such beautiful faces before. Your people should not see them, as they may harm them. Your people have been forbidden from hosting anyone until they said, 'Give us your guests so that we can harass them.' Nobody here, except the household of Lut, knows where they are. His wife went out and informed her people, saying, 'Indeed, there are men inside Lut's house whose faces I have never seen before.' So, Lut's people hurried towards him. When they came to him, he said, 'O my people, fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a single reasonable man? These are my daughters, they are purer for you. So, fear Allah and do not humiliate me in front of my guests.' They said, 'You know that we have no right in your daughters, and indeed, you know what we want.' When they failed to persuade him, he said, 'If only I had power against you or could take refuge in a strong support.' Then Jibril extended his wings, covering the sight of their eyes, and they went out stumbling, unable to see one another. They were saying, 'This is their plan. Verily, in the house of Lut, there is magic.' This is the saying of Allah, the Almighty, 'And indeed, they sought to tempt him away from his guests, but We blinded their eyes.' And they said, 'O Lut, indeed, we are messengers of your Lord. They will never reach you, so travel with your family in the cover of the night, and let not any among you look back except your wife. Indeed, she will be struck by what strikes them. So, proceed as you are commanded.' Then Allah led them to safety towards the land of Shaam. Lut said, 'Destroying them will take only a moment.' They replied, 'We have not been commanded to destroy them except at the break of dawn. Is not the morning near?' When morning came, Lut and his family left, except for his wife. This is the saying of Allah, the Almighty, 'Except the family of Lut; We will save them all, except his wife, who will be among those who remain.'
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaba se, marfoo' (Nabi ki taraf uthaayi gayi) riwayat: jab farishte Ibrahim (AS) ke paas se Lut (AS) ki basti ki taraf nikle, aur dopahar ke waqt wahan pahunche, jab woh Sadum ki nehar tak pahunche, to unhein Lut (AS) ki beti mili jo apne ghar walon ke liye paani bhar rahi thi, aur unki do betiyaan thin, unhone unse poocha: "Aye ladki, kya koi rehne ki jagah hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, apni jagah rukiye, dakhil mat hoiye jab tak main aapke paas na aaun." To woh apne waalid ke paas gayi aur kaha: "Aye abba, shehar ke darwaze par kuch jawaanon ki khabar lein, maine kisi qaum ke chehre unse behtar nahi dekhe, aap ki qaum unhein na pakde warna unhein ruswa kar dengay." Aur unki qaum ne unhein pehle hi mana kar rakha tha ke woh kisi mard ko mehmaan na banaayein, yahan tak ke unhone kaha: "Humpar farz hai ke Lut (AS) mardon ko mehmaan na banaayein." To woh (mehmaan) unke paas aaye aur Lut (AS) ne siwaye apne ghar walon ke kisi ko khabar nahi di, to unki biwi baahar nikli aur apni qaum ko bataaya, kaha: "Lut (AS) ke ghar mein kuch mard hain jinke chehre jaise maine kabhi nahi dekhe." To unki qaum unki taraf daudti hui aayi, jab woh unke paas pahunche, to Lut (AS) ne unse kaha: "Aye meri qaum, Allah se daro aur mujhe mere mehmaano ke maamle mein ruswa mat karo, kya tum mein koi aqal-mand aadmi nahi? Yeh meri betiyaan hain, yeh tumhare liye zyada paak hain us cheez se jo tum chahte ho." Unhone unse kaha: "Kya humne tumhein mardon ko mehmaan banaane se mana nahi kiya tha? Tumhein pata hai ke humara tumhari betiyon mein koi haq nahi, aur tumhein pata hai hum kya chahte hain." Jab unhone unki pesh ki hui baat qubool na ki, to unhone kaha: "{Kaash mere paas tumhare muqaable ki taaqat hoti ya main kisi mazboot sahaare ki taraf panaah le sakta}" (Surah Hud 80), Allah ki rehmatein unpar ho, ya'ni: "Kaash mere madadgaar hote jo tumhare khilaaf meri madad karte, ya koi qabeela hota jo mujhe tumse bachaata, to woh tumhare aur mere mehmaano se tum jo chahte the uske darmiyan rukaawat ban jaata." Aur jab Lut (AS) ne yeh kaha, to us waqt Jibra'il (AS) ne apne par phailaaye aur unki aankhein andhi kar din, aur woh aik doosre ko roundte huay andhe hokar nikle, keh rahe the: "Bhaago, bhaago, kyunke Lut (AS) ke ghar mein zameen ke sabse bade jaadugar hain." Aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Aur unhone unse apne mehmaan ke baare mein dhoka-dahi ki koshish ki, to humne unki aankhein mita din}" (Surah Al-Qamar 37), aur unhone kaha: "Aye Lut, hum tumhare Rab ke Rasool hain, woh tum tak kabhi nahi pahunch sakenge, isliye raat ke kisi hisse mein apne ghar walon ko lekar nikal jao, aur tum mein se koi mudkar na dekhe siwaye tumhari biwi ke, aur apne ghar walon ke peechhe chalo," ya'ni: "Jahan tumhein hukum diya jaaye wahan chale jao, to Allah ne unhein Sham ki taraf nikaal diya." Aur Lut (AS) ne kaha: "Inhein abhi halaak kar do." Unhone kaha: "Humein sirf subah (ke waqt) ka hukum diya gaya hai, kya subah qareeb nahi?" Jab tak subah ka waqt hua, Lut (AS) aur unke ghar wale, unki biwi ke siwa, nikal gaye, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Siwaye Lut (AS) ke ghar walon ke, humne unhein sehri ke waqt bacha liya}" (Surah Al-Qamar 34).

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  was a lean man."
hi: "Hud (AS) Nabi aik mazboot jism wale aadmi thay."

e: [AI] "No nation is destroyed unless its prophet is present in Mecca and worships there until death, and indeed the grave of Hud is located between Al-Hijr and Zamzam." The summary is omitted by Al-Dhahabi.
hi: "Koi bhi Ummat halaak nahi hui magar uska Nabi Makkah pahunch gaya aur wahan ibaadat karta raha yahan tak ke faut ho gaya, aur beshak Hud (AS) ki qabr Hijr aur Zamzam ke darmiyan hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And by Allah, O Commander of the Faithful, you are being called by the title of a man who has seen him. He said, 'No, but I have been informed about him.' Al-Hadrami said, 'What is his connection, O Commander of the Faithful?' He said, 'He has the grave of Prophet Hud ﷺ .' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary."
hi: "Allah ki qasam, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aap unka aisa wasf bayan kar rahe hain jaise kisi aisay aadmi ka jisne unhein dekha ho." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke mujhe unke baare mein bataaya gaya hai." Al-Hadhrami ne poocha: "Aur unka kya maamla hai, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen?" Unhone kaha: "Usme Hud (AS) ki qabr hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Regarding Hud, was Abu Al-Yaman the one who was born to them?" So Wahb said, "No, but he is the brother of Al-Yaman, and in the Torah, he is attributed to Noah. When tribalism arose among the Arabs and Muzar claimed that Ismail was the father of Yemen, so that he could be considered among the prophets and his offspring among them, even though he was not their actual father but their brother, and he was only sent to Aad. Wahb did not consider Muzar to be from Aad nor did he attribute their tribes to him, nor did he command their poets. On Earth, there was no nation that exceeded them in number, size, or strength. So when they saw the approaching wind, they said to Hud, "You frighten us with the wind." So they gathered their children, wealth, and livestock in a valley and stood at the entrance of that valley to protect their belongings and families from the wind. But the wind entered under their feet and swept them away." Wahb said, "When Allah sent Hud, son of Abdullah, son of Rabah, son of Harith, son of Aad, son of Awas, son of Iram, son of Sam, son of Noah, Allah scattered every particle of their sand and made it a part of the land. The dwellings of Aad were in its sands, and the land of Aad was the most fertile and abundant with fields, rivers, and gardens among the lands of the Arabs. But when Allah became angry with them and they transgressed against Him, as they were worshipping idols besides Allah, Allah sent upon them the barren wind." The narration ends here according to Al-Dhahabi's summary.
hi: Hud (AS) ke baare mein poocha gaya: kya woh Abu Al-Yaman (Yemen ke baap) thay jinhone unhein janam diya? Wahb ne kaha: "Nahi, balke woh Yaman ke bhai hain, aur Tauraat mein unhein Nuh (AS) ki taraf mansoob kiya jaata hai, jab Arabon mein qabaili ghairat paida hui aur Mudhar ne apne baap Isma'il (AS) par fakhr kiya, to Yaman ne Hud (AS) ko apna baap qaraar diya taake woh bhi Ambiya mein se aik ki aulaad ho, jabke unki paidaish unme se hui thi lekin woh unke baap nahi balke bhai the, aur woh sirf Aad ki taraf bheje gaye the." Wahb Aad ka koi khaas naam nahi dete the, na unke haalaat batate, na unke qabeelon ka nasab bataate, na unke ash'aar bayan karte. Zameen par koi Ummat unse zyada tadaad mein na thi, na unse zyada jismaani taaqat wali, na unse sakht pakad rakhne wali. Jab unhone hawa ko apni taraf aate dekha, to unhone Hud (AS) se kaha: "Tum humein hawa se dara rahe ho." To unhone apni aulaad, apna maal, aur apne jaanwar aik wadi mein jama kiye, phir us wadi ke darwaze par khade ho gaye taake apne maal aur ahl-o-ayaal ko hawa se bacha sakein, to hawa unke pairon ke neeche se, unke aur zameen ke darmiyan se dakhil hui, yahan tak ke unhein ukhaad diya. Wahb ne kaha: aur jab Allah ne unki taraf Hud bin Abdullah bin Rabaah bin Al-Harith bin Aad bin Aws bin Iram bin Sam bin Nuh (AS) ko bheja, to har reti ka teela jo Allah ne kisi bhi shehar mein rakha tha, Aad ki basti unki retili zameen mein thi, aur Aad ki zameen Arab ki sabse zarkhez zameen thi, sabse zyada saabzah, nehrein, aur baaghaat wali, jab Allah unpar ghazab-naak hua aur unhone Allah ke saamne sarkashi ki, aur woh but-parast the jo Allah ke siwa buton ki ibaadat karte the, to Allah ne unpar 'baanjh' (be-asar) hawa bheji. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet of Allah, Hud, resembled Adam, peace be upon them both. Its Isnad is weak.
hi: "Allah ke Nabi Hud (AS), Aadam (AS) se sabse zyada milte-julte thay, Allah ka salaam un dono par ho." Isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] That the Prophet Saleh ﷺ , from the Arabs, after Allah destroyed 'Ad and their affairs ended, Thamud succeeded them and they populated the land. Then they spread and transgressed against Allah. When their corruption became apparent and they worshipped other than Allah, Allah sent Saleh to them. They were an Arab people, and he was among their middle in lineage and the best of them in position. Their dwellings were made of rocks, in a valley called Al-Qura, eighteen miles between Al-Hijr and Al-Hijaz. Allah sent a young boy to them, and Saleh called them to Allah until he became a grown man. Only a few of the weak-hearted among them followed him. 'Ad and Thamud and those who were from those nations were destroyed. They were from the offspring of Luwaih, the son of Sam, the son of Nuh, and there was no prophet between Nuh and Ibrahim, except for Hud and Saleh." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Beshak Saleh (AS) Nabi, Arabon mein se thay, jab Allah ne Aad ko halaak kiya aur unka maamla khatam hua, to Thamud ne unke baad zameen aabaad ki, unhein zameen mein khalifa banaaya gaya, to woh phail gaye, phir unhone Allah ke saamne sarkashi ki, jab unka fasaad zaahir hua aur unhone Allah ke siwa doosron ki ibaadat ki, to Allah ne unki taraf Saleh (AS) ko bheja, aur woh Arab qaum the, aur woh unme nasab ke lihaaz se darmiyaani aur maqaam mein sabse behtareen thay, unki basti Hijr se Qar'a tak thi, jo Wadi-ul-Qura hai, Hijr aur Hijaz ke darmiyan atthaaraa (18) meel. To Allah ne unhein aik jawaan larke ke roop mein bheja, unhein Allah ki taraf bulaate rahe yahan tak ke unke baal safed ho gaye aur woh boodhe ho gaye, aur unme se sirf thode kamzor log hi unki pairavi karte the. To Aad, Thamud, aur unme se jo bhi in Ummaton mein se thay halaak ho gaye, aur woh Laawaz bin Sam bin Nuh (AS) ki aulaad mein se the, aur Nuh (AS) aur Ibrahim (AS) ke darmiyan unse pehle koi Nabi na tha, ya'ni Ibrahim (AS) se pehle, siwaye Hud (AS) aur Saleh (AS) ke. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Then there was Prophet Saleh, peace be upon him, and he resembled Jesus son of Mary in complexion, being reddish until white, and he had lustrous hair.
hi: "Phir Saleh (AS), Allah ke Nabi, thay, aur woh Isa bin Maryam (AS) se milte-julte the, surkhi mile huay safed rang wale, seedhe baalon wale."

e: [AI] The camel was wounded and had a mark on her right hand. He stayed with them for forty years, calling them to Allah from the time he was a young boy until he became old. They did not increase in anything except tyranny." - Narrated by Wahb with a chain of narration.
hi: Ke oontni ko zakhmi kiya jayega, aur unke dayen haath par aik nishaan (til) tha, alaamat ke taur par, aur woh chaalis (40) saal tak unke darmiyan rahe, unhein Allah ki taraf bulaate, jawaani se lekar boodhepe tak, aur woh sarkashi ke siwa kisi cheez mein na barhte. Wahb se, kamzor sanad ke sath.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever has worked from this water to make food, let them throw it." So, some of them kneaded the dough, and some of them made porridge, so they threw it.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne bhi is paani se khaana banaaya ho, woh use phaink de." Unhone kaha: to unme se kisi ne aata guundha tha aur kisi ne khajoor ka halwa banaaya tha, to unhone use phaink diya.

Rasulullah (SAW) se, Thamud ke baare mein, jo Saleh (AS) ki qaum thi, Allah ne unhein duniya mein lambi umrein di, yahan tak ke unme se koi mitti se ghar banaata to woh gir jaata jabke woh aadmi zinda hota, jab unhone yeh dekha, to unhone pahaadon se ghar banaaye, unhein tarash kar, khoktha kar, andar se khaali karke banaaya, aur woh apni roz-marra ki zindagi mein khush-haal the, to unhone kaha: "Aye Saleh, apne Rab se dua karo ke woh humare liye koi nishaani zaahir kare taake humein pata chale ke tum Allah ke Rasool ho." To Saleh (AS) ne apne Rab se dua ki, to unke liye oontni nikaali, uska paani peene ka din alag tha aur unka din alag, muqarrar tareeqe se, jab uska din hota, to woh use aur paani ko chhod dete aur uska doodh nikaalte, sab bartan, zaruf, aur mashkein bhar lete. Allah ne Saleh (AS) ki taraf wahi ki ke tumhari qaum tumhari oontni ko zakhmi karengi, to unhone unhein bataaya, unhone kaha: "Hum aisa nahi karengay." Unhone kaha: "Agar tum khud isse zakhmi na karo, to ankareeb tum mein aik bacha paida hoga jo isse zakhmi karega." Unhone poocha: "Us bacche ki nishaani kya hai? Allah ki qasam, jab bhi hum use paayenge, hum use qatl kar dengay." Unhone kaha: "Woh aik gora, neeli aankhon wala, surkhi maayil baal wala larka hoga." Unhone kaha: aur shehar mein do izzat wale, taaqatwar boodhe log the, aik ke bete ki nikah mein raghbat na thi, aur doosre ki aik beti thi jiske liye unhein koi barabar (rishta) nahi mil raha tha, to aik majlis unhein aapas mein jama karti, to aik ne doosre se kaha: "Tumhein apne bete ki shaadi karne se kya rokta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe uske liye koi barabar (rishta) nahi milta." Unhone kaha: "To meri beti uske barabar hai, aur main tumhare bete se apni beti ka nikah karta hoon." To unhone unka nikah kar diya, aur unke ghar wahi bacha paida hua. Aur shehar mein aath (8) log the jo zameen mein fasaad phailaate aur islaah nahi karte, Saleh (AS) ne unse kaha: "Isse zaroor tum mein paida hone wala aik bacha hi zakhmi karega," to unhone shehar se aath dayan (dai) auraton ko chuna aur unke sath aik shart (qaida) rakha, to woh shehar mein ghoomti rehtin, jab kisi aurat ko dard-e-zeh mein paatin, to dekhtin uska bacha kya hai, agar larka hota to woh dekhne rukti ke woh kaisa hai, agar larki hoti to usse chhod deti. Jab unhone woh bacha paaya, to auraton ne cheekh maari, kaha: "Yehi hai jo Rasulullah Saleh (AS) chaahte hain," to un pahre daaron ne usse pakadne ka iraada kiya, magar uske dono naana-daada unke aur uske darmiyan aa gaye aur kaha: "Agar Saleh (AS) yehi chaahte hain to hum ise qatl kar dengay." Aur woh sabse bura bacha tha, aik din mein utna badhta jitna doosron ka aik hafte mein, aik hafte mein utna jitna doosron ka aik mahine mein, aik mahine mein utna jitna doosron ka aik saal mein. To woh aath log jo zameen mein fasaad phailaate the aur woh do boodhe jama huay, unhone kaha: "Hum is larke ko apna sardaar banaayenge uske maqaam aur uske naana-daada ki izzat ki wajah se," to woh nau (9) ho gaye, aur Saleh (AS) unke sath basti mein nahi sote the, balke woh khule maidaan mein aik masjid mein rehte the jise 'Masjid-e-Saleh' kaha jaata tha, wahan raat guzaarte, jab subah hoti to unke paas aate, unhein naseehat aur yaad-dihaani karte, aur jab shaam hoti to nikal jaate, wahi raat guzaarte, to woh usme raat guzaarte. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: jab unhone Saleh (AS) ke khilaaf saazish karne ka iraada kiya, to woh chal pade yahan tak ke Saleh (AS) ke raaste par aik jagah pahunche, jahan aath log chhup gaye aur kaha: "Jab woh humare paas se nikalein to hum unhein qatl kar dengay, phir unke ghar walon ke paas jaakar unhein raat mein maar dengay." To Allah ne zameen ko hukum diya, to woh unpar barabar ho gayi (unhein dhaans liya), phir woh (baaqi log) jama huay aur oontni ki taraf gaye jo apne hauz par khadi thi, to un badnaseebon mein se aik ne kisi se kaha: "Uske paas jao aur usse zakhmi karo." To woh uske paas gaya lekin yeh usse bohot bada laga, to usne aisa karne se inkaar kar diya, to unhone doosre ko bheja, use bhi yeh bohot bada laga, isi tarah jise bhi bheja jaata woh isse bohot bada samajhta yahan tak ke aakhirkaar aik uske paas chala aur usse tang aaya, uski aid (jang wali nas) par zarb lagaayi, to woh giri, bhaagne ki koshish karne lagi, to unme se aik aadmi Saleh (AS) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Oontni ko sambhaalo, use zakhmi kar diya gaya hai." To woh aage badhe, aur woh unse milne ke liye nikle, kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, isse to fulan ne zakhmi kiya hai, humara koi gunah nahi." Unhone kaha: "Dekho, kya tum uske bachche ko paa sakte ho, agar tum use paa lo, to shaayad Allah tumse azaab utha le." To woh use dhoondhne nikle, aur jab bachche ne apni maa ko tadapte dekha, to woh aik pahaad ki taraf gaya jise 'Al-Ghaarah' kaha jaata tha, chhota sa, aur uspar chadh gaya, woh use pakadne gaye, to Allah ne pahaad ki taraf wahi ki, aur woh aasman mein ud gaya yahan tak ke koi parinda bhi uss tak na pahunch sake. Unhone kaha: "Aur Saleh (AS) basti mein dakhil huay, jab bachche ne unhein dekha to rone laga yahan tak ke uske aansoo beh gaye, phir usne Saleh (AS) ki taraf rukh kiya aur aik aawaaz nikaali, phir doosri, phir teesri." To Saleh (AS) ne kaha: "Har aawaaz aik din ki muddat hai, apne gharon mein teen din mazaa lo, yeh aisa wa'da hai jo jhoota nahi, siwaye is ke ke azaab ki nishaani yeh hogi ke pehle din unke chehre pile ho jayenge, doosre din surkh, aur teesre din kaale." Jab subah hui to unke chehre aise the jaise unpar zafraan lipa hua ho, chhote-bade, mard-aurat sab, jab shaam hui to sab cheekh uthe: "Aik din muddat ka guzar gaya, aur azaab tumhare saamne aa gaya." Jab doosre din subah hui to unke chehre surkh the jaise khoon se rangay gaye hon, to woh cheekhe, chillaaye, roye, aur samajh gaye ke yeh azaab hai. Jab shaam hui to sab cheekh uthe: "Do din muddat ke guzar gaye, aur azaab tumhare saamne aa gaya." Jab teesre din subah hui to unke chehre kaale the jaise unpar tar lipi ho, to sab cheekh uthe: "Azaab tumhare saamne aa gaya hai." To unhone kafan pehna, apne aap ko khushbudaar kiya, unka khushbu sabr (aik kadwi cheez) aur mur (aik khushbu) thi, aur unke kafan chamde (khaal) the, phir unhone apne aap ko zameen par daala, aankhein kabhi aasman ki taraf, kabhi zameen ki taraf ghumaate, na jaante the ke azaab unpar oopar se aasman se aayega ya neeche se zameen se, dabe huay aur khauf-zada. Jab woh chaalisve din ki subah hui, to unpar aik cheekh aayi jisme har bijli ki aawaaz aur zameen ki har aawaaz-daar cheez ki aawaaz thi, to unke dil unke seenon mein phat gaye, aur woh apne gharon mein moonh ke bal pade huay reh gaye.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, when he arrived at Al-Hijr, he praised and glorified Allah. Then he said, "As for what follows, do not ask your Messenger for miracles. A righteous people requested a miracle from their messenger, so Allah sent them a she-camel. It used to come to them from this rock and would go out from that rock, and they would drink its water on the day it came." - According to Sahih Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya, jab woh Hijr pahunche, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir farmaya: "Ammaa ba'd, apne Rasool se nishaaniyan mat maango, yeh Saleh (AS) ki qaum thi, unhone apne Rasool se nishaani maangi, to Allah ne unke liye aik oontni bheji, woh is ghaati se aati aur us ghaati se jaati, aur apne peene ke din unka paani pee jaati." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "And Shu'ayb, the son of Mika'il the Prophet ﷺ , was sent by Allah as a prophet. He conveyed the message of Allah to his people and mentioned what Allah had revealed in the Quran. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say, "He is the eloquent speaker among the prophets" when mentioning him. Al-Dhahabi did not mention him in his summary."
hi: Shu'aib bin Mika'il, Nabi, ko Allah ne Nabi banaakar bheja, unka aur unki qaum ka jo qissa hua woh wahi hai jo Allah ne Quran mein zikr kiya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) jab unka zikr karte to farmaate: "Yeh Ambiya ke khateeb hain," apni qaum se unki mukalama karne ki wajah se. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Shuayb was blind.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur beshak hum aapko humare darmiyan kamzor dekhte hain}" (Surah Hud 91) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Shu'aib (AS) nabeena (andhe) thay."

e: [AI] Indeed, Allah sent Shuayb to the people of Madyan, who were the inhabitants of Al-Aika. Al-Aika was a tree-covered area, and they were a people who disbelieved in Allah and were dishonest in their dealings with others in terms of measuring and weighing, as well as corrupting their wealth. However, Allah provided for them abundantly in terms of sustenance and granted them a comfortable life, drawing them closer to Him despite their disbelief. Shuayb said to them, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the balance. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day." This was part of what Shuayb said to his people, and their response to him was not mentioned by Al-Dhahabi in his summary.
hi: Beshak Allah ne Shu'aib (AS) ko Madyan walon ki taraf bheja, aur woh 'Ashaab-ul-Aikah' (jhaadi wale log) thay, aur Aikah ghane, aapas mein julay huay darakhton se thi, aur woh Allah ka kufr karne wale, naap-tol mein logon ko dhoka dene wale, aur unke maal barbaad karne wale the, aur Allah Ta'ala ne unhein rizq mein wus'at di aur zindagi mein kushaadgi di, unke kufr ke bawajood unhein dhile chhod kar aazmaane ke liye, to Shu'aib (AS) ne unse kaha: "Aye meri qaum, Allah ki ibaadat karo, uske siwa tumhara koi ma'bood nahi, aur naap aur tol mein kami mat karo, main tumhein khush-haali mein dekh raha hoon, aur mujhe tumpar aik ghere lene wale din ke azaab ka darr hai." To Shu'aib (AS) ki apni qaum se yeh baat hui aur unki qaum ki jawaab hui jo Allah ne apni Kitaab mein zikr ki hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About the destruction of the people of Shuayb and the saying of Allah to them, "So the punishment seized them at sunrise. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day." Abdullah ibn Abbas said, "Allah sent upon them a scorching wind that took away their breaths and entered the cracks of their homes. Then, it entered the interior of their homes and took away their breaths again, so they fled from their houses towards the open area. Allah sent a cloud that provided shade from the sun, and they found it to be cold and pleasant. They called out to each other until they gathered under it, then Allah sent upon them fire." Abdullah ibn Abbas said, "That was the punishment of the day of darkness. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summarization.
hi: Shu'aib (AS) ki qaum ki halaakat aur Allah ke unhein farmaan ke baare mein: "{To unhein saaye wale din ke azaab ne pakad liya, beshak yeh aik bade din ka azaab tha}", Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ne unpar sakht garmi bheji jisne unki saansein rok din, to woh gharon ke andar dakhil ho gaye, garmi unke andar bhi dakhil hui aur unki saansein rok din, to woh gharon se bhaag kar khule maidaan mein nikle, to Allah ne aik baadal bheja jisne unhein suraj se saaya diya, unhone usme thandak aur lutf paayi, to unhone aik doosre ko bulaaya yahan tak ke sab uske neeche jama ho gaye, to Allah ne unpar aag bhej di." Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yehi hai saaye wale din ka azaab, beshak yeh aik bade din ka azaab tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He (Qatadah) heard that Allah sent the Prophet Shuayb ﷺ  to two tribes - the people of Madyan and the people of Aikah. Aikah was a valley with twisted trees. When Allah intended to punish them, He sent upon them a severe heat and raised over them a cloud of punishment, like a thundercloud. When it approached them, they came out, hoping for its coolness. However, when they were underneath it, it rained upon them. This is the saying of Allah Almighty: "So He seized them with punishment of the Day of the Overhanging Cloud" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara, 189]. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing this.
hi: Unhone Qatadah ko kehte suna: Allah ne Shu'aib (AS), Nabi, ko do Ummaton ki taraf bheja - unki qaum, Madyan walon, aur Ashaab-ul-Aikah ki taraf, aur Aikah ghane, julay huay darakhton se thi, jab Allah ne unhein azaab dene ka iraada kiya, to unpar sakht garmi bheji, aur unke liye azaab ko aik baadal ki tarah buland kiya, jab woh unke qareeb aaya, to woh uski thandak ki ummeed mein uski taraf nikle, jab woh uske neeche huay, to unpar (aag) barsi. Unhone kaha: aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{To unhein saaye wale din ke azaab ne pakad liya}" (Surah Ash-Shu'ara 189). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About Mujahid's statement, "The punishment of the Day of Shade" [Al-Shuara 189], he said, "The shadows of punishment." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary.
hi: Mujahid se, "{Saaye wale din ka azaab}" (Surah Ash-Shu'ara 189) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Azaab ke saaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "To do as we wish with our wealth" [Surah Hud 87]. He (Prophet Hud) said: It was one of the things they were forbidden from, which was withholding or cutting off coins. So they were punished on the day of the eclipse, for it was a great punishment. He said: Allah sent a shade from the cloud to them and Allah sent the Sun towards the Earth, so they all gathered under that shade. When they all gathered, Allah removed the shade and the Sun burned them, like how locusts burn in a fire. Goldziher remained silent on summarizing this.
hi: "{Ke hum apne maal mein jo chaahein karein}" (Surah Hud 87) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: unhein jin cheezon se roka jaata tha unme dirhamon ko katarna (ghatiya banaana) ya dirhamon ko kaatna shaamil tha, "to unhein saaye wale din ke azaab ne pakad liya, beshak yeh aik bade din ka azaab tha," unhone kaha: Allah ne unki taraf baadal ka aik saaya bheja, aur suraj ko bheja jisne zameen ko jala diya, to sab log us saaye ki taraf nikle, jab sab wahan jama ho gaye, to Allah ne saaya hataa diya aur suraj ko unpar tez kar diya, to woh isi tarah jal gaye jaise talwa (bhoonjne ki cheez) mein tiddi jalti hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu al-Muwajjah praised Abu Hamzah for narrating from Jabir who narrated from 'Amir who narrated from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: "Whoever informs you what the scholars say regarding the punishment on the Day of Judgment, then accuse him of lying". Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Abu Al-Muwajjih ne humein bataaya, Abdaan ne humein khabar di, Abu Hamzah ne, Jabir se, unhone Aamir se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, unhone kaha: "Jo bhi aalim tumhein 'saaye wale din ke azaab' ke baare mein (tafseeli) baat bataaye, to usse jhutlaao." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Regarding Al-Dhahabi in summary"
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein (yeh baat kahi).

e: [AI] "And as for the tribes, they are the sons of Jacob, Joseph and Benjamin, and Reuben and Judah, and Simeon and Levi, and Dan and Naphtali, and Gad and Asher, and Issachar and Zebulun. They were twelve men whom Allah multiplied into twelve tribes. Only Allah, the Almighty and Glorious, knows their lineage. Allah, the Most High, said, 'And We divided them into twelve tribes [as distinct] nations.' [Quran 7:160]"
hi: Rahi baat 'Asbaat' (qabeelon) ki, to woh Yaqub (AS) ke bete hain - Yusuf, Binyamin, Rubail, Yahuza, Sham'oon, Lawi, Daan, aur Fahaat, to woh baarah (12) mard the, jinse Allah ne baarah (12) qabeele phailaaye, jinke nasab sirf Allah Ta'ala hi jaanta hai. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{Aur humne unhein baarah (12) qabeelon, alag-alag giroh, mein taqseem kiya}" (Surah Al-A'raf 160).

e:
[AI] To put in context, this passage appears to be a sentence from a longer text or story. It seems to describe a situation involving two boys named Ya'qub and 'Isa (Jacob and Isaac), their mother, and possibly their father, named Ishaq (Isaac). Without additional information, it is challenging to provide a complete and accurate translation. However, based on the provided excerpt, a rough translation would be:

"She placed the two boys inside her stomach, and Ya'qub (Jacob) intended to come out before 'Isa (Isaac). 'Isa said, 'By Allah, if you come out before me, I will object in our mother's womb and I will kill her.' So, Ya'qub hesitated, and 'Isa came out before him. Then, Ya'qub took 'Isa's heel and came out, and 'Isa was named 'Isa because he was holding a staff, and Ya'qub was named Ya'qub because he came out holding 'Isa's heel. They were both in the womb, but 'Isa disobeyed and came out first. The two boys cried after their birth. 'Isa was more beloved to their father, and Ya'qub was more beloved to their mother. 'Isa was fond of hunting. When their uncle Ishaq grew older, he mentioned a long conversation or narration."

It's important to note that this translation might not be entirely accurate due to the possibility of misinterpretation or lack of context.
hi: Ke jab woh bacha dene lagi, to dono larke uske pait mein jhagadne lage, Yaqub (AS) ne Ees se pehle nikalne ka iraada kiya, to Ees ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar tum mujhse pehle nikle, to main apni maa ke pait mein hi (rukaawat daalunga) aur usse maar dunga." To Yaqub (AS) peeche hat gaye aur Ees unse pehle nikla, aur Yaqub (AS) ne Ees ki aid (aid = pair ki nas) pakad li, to woh nikle, isliye Ees ko Ees kaha gaya kyunke usne 'asa' (na-farmani) ki, aur Yaqub ko Yaqub kaha gaya kyunke woh Ees ki 'aqib' (aid/pair) pakad kar nikle, aur woh dono mein pait mein bada tha lekin usne na-farmani ki aur usse pehle nikla. Dono larke bade huay, aur Ees apne baap ko zyada aziz tha aur Yaqub (AS) apni maa ko zyada aziz thay, aur Ees shikaar karne wala tha, jab Ishaq (AS) boodhe huay to unki nazar chali gayi, aur aik lambi hadith zikr ki. Isnad bohot kamzor hai.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Joseph and his mother were given half of the beauty."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yusuf (AS) aur unki maa ko husn (khoobsurati) ka aadha hissa diya gaya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the honorable is the son of the honorable, who is the son of the honorable, who is the son of the honorable. Yusuf (Joseph) is the son of Yaqub (Jacob), who is the son of Ishaq (Isaac), who is the son of Ibrahim (Abraham), the Prophet of Allah. He is the son of the Prophet of Allah, who is the son of the Prophet of Allah, who is the son of the Khalil (friend) of Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak izzat wale, izzat wale ke bete, izzat wale ke bete, izzat wale ke bete, Yusuf bin Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim (AS), Allah ke Nabi, Allah ke Nabi ke bete, Allah ke Nabi ke bete, Allah ke Khaleel (khaas dost) ke bete hain."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Mas'ud said, 'That is Yusuf, the son of Ya'qub, the son of Ishaq, the son of Ibrahim.'"
hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA): "Yehi Yusuf bin Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim (AS) hain."

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summary.
hi: Unse, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "The beauty was divided, so Youssef and Sara were given half, and the rest of the people were given half."
hi: "Husn (khoobsurati) taqseem ki gayi, to Yusuf (AS) aur Sarah (RA) ke liye aadha rakha gaya, aur baaqi sab logon ke liye aadha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, while describing Yusuf (Joseph) when he saw him in the third heaven, "I saw a man whose image resembled that of the full moon on a moonlit night. So I asked Jibril (Gabriel), 'Who is this?' He replied, 'This is your brother Yusuf.' Ibn Ishaq said, 'Allah had granted Yusuf such beauty and dignity that no one before him or after him has been given. It is even said, and Allah knows best, that he was given half of all beauty, and the other half was divided among the people.'" (There is no mention of this narration by Al-Dhahabi in his summarization)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Yusuf (AS) ka wasf bayan karte suna jab unhone unhein teesre aasman mein dekha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine aik aadmi dekha jiski soorat chaudhvin (poornima) ki raat ke chaand jaisi thi." Maine poocha: "Aye Jibra'il, yeh kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh aapke bhai Yusuf (AS) hain." Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: aur Allah ne Yusuf (AS) ko itna husn aur waqar diya jitna usne unse pehle ya baad mein duniya walon mein se kisi ko nahi diya, yahan tak ke kaha jaata tha, aur Allah zyada jaanta hai, ke unhein husn ka aadha hissa diya gaya aur baaqi aadha hissa logon ke darmiyan taqseem kiya gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once encountered a Bedouin and treated him with respect. He said to him, "O Bedouin, ask for what you need." The Bedouin replied, "O Messenger of Allah, I want a female camel with her saddle, as my family relies on her for milk." The Prophet ﷺ  repeated this request twice, then he said to him, "Are you unable to be like the old man of the Children of Israel?" His companions asked, "O Messenger of Allah, who is the old man of the Children of Israel?" He replied, "When Moses wanted to escort the Children of Israel, they took with them the oath that Allah had taken from them, to not leave Egypt until they took Joseph's bones with them. Moses asked them, 'Who among you knows where Joseph's grave is?' They replied, 'None of us knows except the old man of the Children of Israel.' So he sent for him and said, 'Guide me to Joseph's grave.' The old man replied, 'I will not do so unless you promise me a place in Paradise.' The Messenger of Allah disliked what she said, so it was said to him, 'Grant her her request.' He granted her request and she brought a lake and said, 'Let this water drain.' When it drained, she said, 'Dig here.' When they dug, they found the bones of Joseph, and as they brought them up from the ground, the path was lit up like daylight."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik badu ke paas utre, unki izzat afzaai ki, phir unse farmaya: "Aye badu, apni zaroorat maango." Usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aik oontni uske kaathi ke sath, aur bakriyaan jinhein mere ghar wale doodh nikaal sakein," yeh baat usne do martaba kahi. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Kya tum Bani Isra'il ki boodhi aurat jaisa nahi ban sakte?" Unke sahaba ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Bani Isra'il ki boodhi aurat kaun thi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musa (AS) ne Bani Isra'il ko lekar chalna chaaha, to raasta bhatak gaya, to Bani Isra'il ke ulama ne unse kaha: 'Hum aapko bataate hain ke Yusuf (AS) ne humse Allah ka ahd liya tha ke hum Misr se tab tak na nikalein jab tak hum unki haddiyaan apne sath na le jaayen.' Unhone poocha: 'Tum mein se kaun jaanta hai Yusuf (AS) ki qabr kahan hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Yusuf (AS) ki qabr ka pata sirf Bani Isra'il ki boodhi aurat ko hai.' To unhone unki taraf paighaam bheja, unhone (Musa AS ne) unse kaha: 'Mujhe Yusuf (AS) ki qabr dikhaao.' Unhone kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main aisa nahi karungi jab tak main aapke sath Jannat mein na hoon.' Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko unki yeh baat napasand aayi, to unse kaha gaya: 'Unhein unka faisla de dein,' to unhone unhein unka faisla de diya. To woh aik jheel ke paas aayi aur kaha: 'Iska paani nikaalo.' Jab unhone paani nikaal diya, to unhone kaha: 'Yahan khodo.' Jab unhone khoda, to Yusuf (AS) ki haddiyaan mil gayi, jab unhone unhein zameen se uthaaya, to raasta din ki roshni jaisa (roshan) ho gaya.'"

e: [AI] The knowledge and wisdom of Allah were inherited by Ibrahim. At that time, Allah granted Yusuf, son of Ya’qub, dominion over the holy land. He ruled for seventy-two years. This is mentioned in His statement in His book, "My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams." [Surah Yusuf, verse 101].
hi: Allah ka ilm aur uski hikmat Ibrahim (AS) ke waarison mein thi, isi liye Allah ne Yusuf bin Yaqub (AS) ko paak zameen ki baadshaahat di, to unhone bahattar (72) saal hukumat ki, aur yehi hai unka farmaan jo unki Kitaab mein nazil hua: "{Aye Rab, tu ne mujhe baadshaahat di aur mujhe khwaabon ki ta'beer ka ilm sikhaaya}" (Surah Yusuf 101) ayat. Sahih saabit nahi hua.

e: [AI] "Between the separation of Yusuf and the grief of Yaqub, there was a period of eighty years until they reunite."
hi: "Yusuf (AS) ke Yaqub (AS) ki god se juda honay se lekar dono ki mulaqaat tak assi (80) saal ka faasla tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Indeed, Joseph was sold for twenty dirhams, and his family was in Egypt when they sent for him. At that time, they were three hundred and ninety-nine men, their men being prophets and their women being truthful. By Allah, they did not leave with Moses until they reached six hundred and seventy thousand."
hi: "Yusuf (AS) sirf bees (20) dirham mein khareede gaye the, aur jab unke ghar walon ko bulawa bheja gaya jabke woh Misr mein thay, to woh teen sau nabbe (390) log the, unke mard Ambiya the aur unki auraten sachchi (siddiqaat) thin, aur Allah ki qasam, woh Musa (AS) ke sath tab tak na nikle jab tak woh chhah sau sattar hazaar (670,000) tak na pahunch gaye."

e: [AI] Then was born to Ya'qub (Jacob) Yusuf (Joseph), the truthful one whom Allah chose, honored, and divided for him two-thirds of beauty, and divided between his servants one-third. He resembled Adam on the day Allah created him, formed him, and blew into him from His spirit before disobedience befell him. When Adam disobeyed, the light, radiance, and beauty were removed from him. Allah had given Adam beauty, radiance, and light on the day He created him, but when he committed what he did, that was removed from him. Then Allah bestowed upon Adam one-third of beauty along with repentance, which he repented for. Then Allah gave Yusuf beauty, radiance, and light, which He removed from Adam when he sinned. That is because Allah loved to show His servants that He is capable of whatever He wills. And Allah gave Yusuf beauty and radiance that He did not give to anyone else from the people. Then Allah granted him knowledge of interpreting dreams, and he would inform of the matter he saw in his dream before it happens. Allah taught him as He taught Adam all the names. And when he smiled, you could see the light in his molars, and when he spoke, you could see the radiance of light in his speech, and it would blaze with heat between his two lips. This is a summarized version of the stories of Yusuf (Joseph), peace be upon him, based on authentic narrations. If I were to include the marvels of Wahb bin Munabbih and Abu Abdullah Al-Waqidi, the translation would be prolonged, according to the narration of Samrah from Ka'ab and the chain of narration.
hi: "Phir Yaqub (AS) ke haan Yusuf As-Siddiq paida huay, jinhein Allah ne chun liya, pasand kiya, izzat di, aur unhein husn ka do-tihaai hissa diya, aur baaqi aik-tihaai apne bandon ke darmiyan taqseem kiya, aur woh Aadam (AS) se milte-julte thay us din jab Allah ne unhein paida kiya, unki soorat banaayi, aur unme apni rooh phoonki, isse pehle ke gunah unhein pesh aaye, jab Aadam (AS) ne na-farmani ki, to unse noor, roshni, aur husn cheen liya gaya, aur Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko unki paidaish ke din husn, khoobsurati, noor, aur roshni di thi, jab unhone jo kiya woh kiya aur gunah unhein pesh aaya, to woh unse cheen liya gaya, phir Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko us tauba ke sath jo unhone ki, husn ka aik-tihaai hissa ata kiya. Phir Allah ne Yusuf (AS) ko husn, khoobsurati, noor, aur roshni di jo Aadam (AS) se cheeni gayi thi jab unhein gunah pesh aaya, aur iski wajah yeh thi ke Allah chahta tha ke woh apne bandon ko dikhaaye ke woh jo chaahe kar sakta hai, aur Yusuf (AS) ko itna husn aur khoobsurati di jo usne kisi aur ko nahi di. Phir Allah ne unhein khwaabon ki ta'beer ka ilm diya, aur woh us baat ki khabar dete jo unhone khwaab mein dekhi thi ke woh hone wali hai, aur hone se pehle Allah ne unhein sikhaaya jaise usne Aadam (AS) ko sab naam sikhaaye the, aur jab woh muskuraate to unke daant mein noor dikhaai deta, aur jab woh baat karte to unki baaton mein noor ki kirnein dikhaai deti, aur unke honthon ke darmiyan (roshni) chamakti." Maine Yusuf (AS) ke haalaat mein se woh mukhtasar kiya hai jiska raasta sahih hai, aur agar main Wahb bin Munabbih aur Abu Abdullah Al-Waqidi ke ajeeb-o-ghareeb qissay lene lagta to tarjuma bohot lamba ho jaata, Samurah se, Ka'b se, aur sanad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] About him, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Unse, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Moses ibn Imran stood as a preacher amongst the Children of Israel." The hadith is long.
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Musa bin Imran (AS) Bani Isra'il mein khutba dene khade huay." Poori lambi hadith.

e:
[AI] And We wrote for him on the tablets concerning everything as a reminder and detailed explanation of everything. [Al-A'raf 145]

He (Moses) said, so Moses agreed that everything was confirmed to him, just as you see that your scholars have confirmed everything for you. So when Moses reached the shores of the sea, he met the scholar and asked him to let him learn from his knowledge. The scholar admitted to Moses that he had knowledge, and Moses desired to follow him in order to gain guidance from his teachings. However, the scholar realized that Moses could not tolerate his company nor bear the knowledge he possessed. The scholar said to Moses, "You cannot tolerate being patient with me, so how can you be patient with that which you are not aware of?" Moses said to him, while excusing himself, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient and obedient to your command." The scholar then realized that Moses could not tolerate his company nor bear his knowledge. He said to him, "If you are to follow me, then do not ask me about anything until I inform you of it."
