They both embarked on a ship, and the scholar made a hole in it, which pleased Allah but angered Moses. Then they encountered a young boy, and the scholar killed him, which pleased Allah. [The rest of the story is mentioned by Ibn Abbas.]
hi: "{Aur humne unke liye takhton (lauhon) mein har cheez ki naseehat aur har cheez ki tafseel likh di}" (Surah Al-A'raf 145) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: to Musa (AS) samajhte the ke unke liye sab kuch (waazeh taur par) saabit kar diya gaya hai, jaise tum samajhte ho ke tumhare ulama ne tumhare liye har cheez saabit kar di jaise unhone saabit ki. Jab Musa (AS) samundar ke kinare pahunche, to woh us aalim (Khidr) se mile, unhein baat karne par ubhaara, to unhone unke ilm ki fazeelat qubool ki aur unse hasad nahi kiya. Musa (AS) ne unse kaha, aur unse chaaha: "Kya main aapki pairavi karoon taake aap mujhe woh sikha den jo aapko sahi raah dikhaane ke liye sikhaaya gaya hai?" To us aalim ko pata chal gaya ke Musa (AS) unki sohbat bardaasht nahi kar payenge aur unke ilm par sabr nahi kar payenge, to us aalim ne unse kaha: "Aap mere sath sabr nahi kar sakenge, aur aap kaise sabr karenge us cheez par jiska aapko poora ilm nahi?" Musa (AS) ne unse maazrat karte huay kaha: "Aap mujhe, Allah chahe to, sabr karne wala paayenge, aur main aapke kisi hukum ki nafarmani nahi karunga." To unhein pata chal gaya ke Musa (AS) unki sohbat bardaasht nahi kar payenge aur unke ilm par sabr nahi kar payenge, to unhone unse kaha: "Agar aap meri pairavi karein, to mujhse kisi cheez ke baare mein na poochhein jab tak main khud aapse iska zikr na karoon." To dono kashti mein sawaar huay, us aalim ne usse chhed diya, aur unhone yeh Allah ki raza ke liye kiya aur Musa (AS) ki naraazgi ke bawajood, aur woh larke se mile aur usse qatl kar diya, Allah ki raza ke liye. Phir baaqi qissa aur baat-cheet zikr ki, aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ne isse aage nahi badhaya.

e: : When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, he began with himself and said: May the mercy of Allah be upon us and upon Moses. If he had patience, he would have seen marvels from his Companion. But he said: "(Moses) said: If ever I ask thee about anything after this, keep me not in they company: then wouldst thou have received (full) excuse from my side". Hamzah lengthened it. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3984)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki rehmat ho hum par aur Musa (AS) par," to aap (SAW) ne pehle apni zaat se shuru kiya, agar Musa (AS) sabr kar lete, to hum unke qissay se aur bhi kuch sunte, lekin unhone kaha: "Agar main iske baad aapse kisi cheez ke baare mein poochoon, to mujhse sohbat na rakhna, aap meri taraf se puri maazrat tak pahunch chuke hain."

Musa bin Imran bin Qaahit bin Lawi bin Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim (AS) ki paidaish ka zikr, aur Allah ke dushman Firaun ka qissa jab woh Bani Isra'il ko Misr mein apne kaamon mein ghulam banaata tha, aur Musa (AS) aur Khidr (AS) ka maamla. Wahb ne kaha: jab Musa (AS) ki maa unse haamila hui, to unhone apna haal sab logon se chhupaaya, to Allah ki kisi bhi makhlooq ko unke hamal ka ilm na hua, aur yeh aisi cheez thi jise Allah ne unke liye chhupaa liya jab usne Bani Isra'il par unke zariye ehsaan karne ka iraada kiya. Jab woh saal aaya jismein Musa bin Imran (AS) paida honay wale thay, to Firaun ne dayaan bhej din aur unhein pehle se aage bheja, auraton ki isse pehle kabhi na ki gayi jaanch ki, aur Musa (AS) ki maa Musa (AS) se haamila hui, na to unka pait phoola, na unka rang badla, na unka doodh kharaab hua, lekin dayaan unse baat na karti thin. Jab woh raat aayi jismein Musa (AS) paida huay, unki maa ne unhein janam diya jabke koi nigraan na tha, na koi dayan, aur unki behn Maryam ke siwa kisi ko pata na chala, aur Allah ne unki taraf wahi ki ke usse doodh pilaao, aur jab tumhein uske baare mein darr ho, to usse dariya mein daal do, aur mat darro, na gham karo, hum use tumhare paas wapas laayenge aur use Rusul mein se banaayenge. Unhone kaha: to unki maa ne teen mahine tak use chhupaaye rakha, apni god mein doodh pilaate huay, na woh rota tha na harkat karta tha, jab unhein apne aur uske liye darr laga, to unhone uske liye aik dhakkan wala sanduk banaaya, usme uske liye jagah banaayi, phir usse raat ko dariya mein daal diya jaise Allah ne hukum diya tha, aur sanduk kashti banaane ke andaaz mein banaaya gaya tha, paanch bitte lambaai aur paanch bitte chaudaai, aur usse tar (raal) se seal nahi kiya gaya tha, to sanduk paani par tairta hua chala, phir dariya ne sanduk ko raat ke andheray mein kinare par phenk diya. Jab Firaun ki subah hui, woh Neel ke kinare apni majlis mein baitha, to usne sanduk ko dekha, apne khadimon se kaha: "Yeh sanduk mere paas laao." To woh use lekar aaye, jab woh unke saamne rakha gaya, unhone use khola, to usme Musa (AS) ko paaya. Unhone kaha: jab Firaun ne unhein dekha, to usne kaha: "Yeh sirf dushmano mein se hai," to yeh usse bohot bada laga aur usse ghussa aaya, usne kaha: "Yeh larka zibah honay se kaise bach gaya, jabke maine dayaon ko hukum diya tha ke woh kisi bhi paida honay wale bachche ko na chhupaayen?" Unhone kaha: aur Firaun ne Bani Isra'il ki aik aurat se nikah kiya tha jise Aasiya bint Muzaahim kaha jaata tha, aur woh chuni hui achhi auraton mein se thi aur Ambiya ki betiyon mein se, aur woh Musalmano ki maa thi, unpar reham karti, unpar sadqa deti, aur unhein deti, aur woh unke paas aate the. Unhone Firaun se kaha, jabke woh uske paas baithi thi: "Yeh bacha aik saal ke bacche se bada hai, aur aapne to sirf isi saal ke bachchon ko zibah karne ka hukum diya tha, isliye ise chhod do ke yeh mere aur aapke liye aankhon ki thandak bane, ise qatl mat karo, shaayad yeh humein faida de, ya hum ise apna bacha bana lein," jabke unhein ilm na tha ke unki halaakat unhi ke haathon hogi. Aur Firaun ke sirf betiyaan hi paida hoti thin, isliye Firaun ne use zinda rehne diya, use uthaaya, aur Allah ne uske dil mein uske liye mohabbat, narmi, aur reham daal diya, usne apni biwi se kaha: "Shaayad yeh tumhare liye faidemand ho, rahi baat meri, to main iska faida nahi chaahta." Wahb ne kaha: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Agar Allah ka dushman Musa (AS) ke baare mein waisa hi kehta jaisa uski biwi ne kaha, 'shaayad yeh humein faida de,' to Allah use zaroor faida deta, lekin usne badnaseebi ki wajah se inkaar kiya jo Allah ne uske liye likh di thi." Aur Allah ne Musa (AS) par doodh pilaane wali auraton ko haraam kar diya aath din aur raaton tak, jab bhi koi doodh pilaane wali laayi jaati, woh uska doodh na peete, to Firaun ko unpar reham aaya, aur unke liye doodh pilaane waliyaan talaash ki gayin. Wahb ne Musa (AS) ki maa ke gham aur unke liye rone ka zikr kiya, yahan tak ke woh qareeb thi ke woh raaz zaahir kar deti, phir Allah ne apni rehmat se unki madad ki, unke dil ko mazboot kiya yahan tak ke unhein uski khabar mili, unhone apni beti se kaha: "Apna hulya badal lo aur logon ke sath jao, dekho woh uske sath kya karte hain." To unki behn dayaon ke sath Aasiya bint Muzaahim ke paas dakhil hui, jab unhone unhein Musa (AS) se lagaao, unse mohabbat, aur unpar narmi dekhi, to unhone kaha: "Kya main tumhein aisa ghar bataaun jo iski parvarish tumhare liye karein aur woh iske khair-khwaah hon?" yahan tak ke woh unki maa ke paas wapas kar diya gaya. To Musa (AS) apni maa ke paas rahe yahan tak ke unhone unhein doodh chhudwa diya, phir unhein wapas (Firaun ke paas) kar diya. To Musa (AS) Firaun aur uski biwi ki god mein pale-bade, dono apne haathon se unki parvarish karte the, aur unhone unhein apna bacha bana liya. Aik din jab woh Firaun ke saamne khel rahe the, unke haath mein aik halki, chhoti chhadi thi jisse woh khel rahe the, achaanak unhone chhadi uthaayi aur Firaun ke sar par maari, jisne unhein maara tha usse dekha, yahan tak ke usne unhein qatl karne ka iraada kiya, to Aasiya bint Muzaahim ne kaha: "Aye Baadshah, ghussa mat karo aur na hi aapko yeh bura lage, yeh to aik chhota bacha hai jise akal nahi, agar chaahen to azmaaish karein, is thaal mein aik angaara aur sona rakhein, dekhein woh kaunse ko pakadta hai." Firaun ne aisa hi hukum diya, jab Musa (AS) ne apna haath sone ko pakadne ke liye badhaya, to unpar muqarrar farishte ne unka haath pakad kar angaare ki taraf mor diya, to Musa (AS) ne usse pakad liya, use apne muh mein daal diya, phir jab unhein uski garmi mehsoos hui to usse phaink diya. Aasiya ne Firaun se kaha: "Kya maine aapko nahi kaha tha ke isse kuch akal nahi aur isse kuch ilm nahi?" To Firaun ne unhein chhod diya aur unki baat sach maani, jabke usne unhein qatl karne ka hukum diya tha. Aur kaha jaata hai ke Musa (AS) ki zubaan mein jo gira (band-pan) tha, woh usi angaare ka asar tha jise unhone muh mein liya tha. Wahb bin Munabbih ne kaha: jab Musa (AS) apni poori jawaani ko pahunche aur chaalis (40) saal ke huay, Allah ne unhein ilm, hikmat, aur samajh di, to woh baarah (12) saal tak Ibrahim (AS) ke deen aur uske shar'i ahkaam ki taraf, aur Ishaq (AS) aur Yaqub (AS) ke deen ki taraf dawat dete rahe, to Bani Isra'il ka aik giroh imaan laaya, phir poora qissa lamba zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, Allah chose Musa with His speech and Ibrahim with His close friendship."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne Musa (AS) ko (khaas) hum-kalaami (baat-cheet) se chuna, aur Ibrahim (AS) ko khulla-pan (khaas dosti) se."

e: [AI] Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, granted the vision and speech between Muhammad ﷺ  and Moses, so Muhammad saw him twice, and Moses spoke to him twice, according to the condition of a Muslim.
hi: Beshak Allah Ta'ala ne apna deedaar aur apna kalaam Muhammad (SAW) aur Musa (AS) ke darmiyan taqseem kiya, to Muhammad (SAW) ne unhein do martaba dekha, aur Musa (AS) se unhone do martaba baat ki. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Moses, son of Imran, is the chosen one of Allah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musa bin Imran (AS) Allah ke chune huay (Safiyy) hain."

e: [AI] "If Allah speaks to someone, he will die without anyone else witnessing it." - Its chain of narration is sound.
hi: "Ke Allah ne unse chaalis (40) din baat ki, koi bhi unhein na dekhta magar mar jaata." Isnad kamzor.

e: [AI] "You will not see me, but look at the mountain. If it remains firm in its place, then you will see me." So when his Lord manifested His glory to the mountain, He made it crumble to dust and Moses fell unconscious. When he recovered, he said, "Glory be to You! I turn to You in repentance and I am the first to believe." Meaning, the first among the Children of Israel to believe.
hi: "Tum mujhe hargiz nahi dekh sakoge, lekin pahaad ki taraf dekho, agar woh apni jagah qaayam reh gaya, to tum mujhe zaroor dekh loge." To pahaad ke ird-gird farishte jama huay, farishton ke ird-gird aag, aag ke ird-gird farishte, aur farishton ke ird-gird phir aag jama hui, phir tumhare Rab ne pahaad par apni tajalli (jalwa) dikhaayi, phir usme se itni si tajalli hui jitni chhoti ungli, to pahaad reza-reza ho gaya, aur Musa (AS) behosh hokar gir gaye, jitna Allah ne chaaha, phir jab unhein hosh aaya, to unhone kaha: "Tu paak hai, main teri taraf tauba karta hoon, aur main sabse pehla imaan laane wala hoon," ya'ni Bani Isra'il mein se sabse pehla imaan laane wala.

e: [AI] "The tree was mentioned to me that Moses, the Prophet of Allah ﷺ , sought refuge in. So, I walked towards it for two days and two nights, and then I reached it at dawn. Behold, it was lush and leafy, so I prayed upon the Prophet ﷺ , greeted him, and leaned my hungry camel towards it. It took a mouthful from it while it was still hungry, but it couldn't swallow it, so it spat it out. Then, I prayed upon the Prophet ﷺ  and turned away."
hi: "Mujhe us darakht ka zikr kiya gaya jismein Allah ke Nabi Musa (AS) ne panaah li thi, to main do din aur do raaton tak uski taraf chala, phir subah usse pahuncha, achaanak woh hari-bhari lehra rahi thi, to maine Nabi (SAW) par durood padha aur salaam bheja, phir mera oont, jo bhooka tha, uski taraf jhuk gaya, usne uska aik muh bhar hissa liya, jabke woh bhooka tha, use chabaaya, lekin nigal na saka, to usne use ugal diya, to maine Nabi (SAW) par durood padha aur wapas chala gaya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recited this verse, and then Hamad pointed and placed his thumb on the joint of his ring finger and said, "The mountain split."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh ayat padhi: "{Jab unke Rab ne pahaad par apni tajalli dikhaayi, to usne isse reza-reza kar diya}" (Surah Al-A'raf 143), Hammad ne ishara kiya aur apna angootha kaneesti ungli ke jode par rakha, unhone kaha: "To pahaad dhaans gaya."

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , if Allah wills, Abu Salama reported that Musa ibn Isma'il doubted and said, "When his Lord manifested Himself to the mountain, He made it crumble to dust." [Al-A'raf 143] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "It shook the mountain." Abu Ali Al-Hafiz narrated to us, informing that Al-Hasan ibn Sufyan, Imran ibn Musa Al-Jurjani, and Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Al-Muthanna reported and said that Hudbah ibn Khalid narrated from Hammad ibn Salama, resembling the narration of Al-Khuzai, and Hudbah did not have any doubts in it.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, agar Allah chaahe - Abu Salamah Musa bin Isma'il ko shak tha - "{Jab unke Rab ne pahaad par apni tajalli dikhaayi, to usne isse reza-reza kar diya}" (Surah Al-A'raf 143), unhone kaha: "Pahaad dhaans gaya." Humein Abu Ali Al-Hafiz ne bataaya, Al-Hasan bin Sufyan, Imran bin Musa Al-Jurjani, aur Ahmad bin Ali bin Al-Muthanna ne khabar di, unhone kaha: Hudbah bin Khalid ne humein hadith bayan ki, Hammad bin Salamah ne, Al-Khuza'i ki hadith ki tarah, aur Hudbah ko isme koi shak na tha.

e: [AI] "That He may show them of His signs. In response, He made the east and west of the earth their dominion and bestowed upon them a great kingdom, until they requested to see their Lord openly. They said, 'Show us Allah in plain sight.' This occurred when they witnessed Musa (Moses) being spoken to by his Lord and hearing Him. Thus, they requested to witness the same, and Musa chose some of his elite companions to be witnesses for him before the Children of Israel, that his Lord had spoken to him. They said, 'We will not believe in you until we see Allah openly.' Suddenly, the thunderbolt seized them while they were watching."
hi: Ke woh unhein isse mehroom na kare, to unhein zameen ke mashriq-o-maghrib ki hukumat di, aur unhein badi baadshaahat ata ki, yahan tak ke unhone apne Rab ko dekhne ki maang ki, unhone kaha: "Humein Allah khule taur par dikhaao," aur yeh tab hua jab unhone Musa (AS) ko dekha ke unke Rab ne unse baat ki aur unhone suna, to unhone deedaar ki maang ki, aur Musa (AS) ne unme se behtareen logon ko chuna taake woh Bani Isra'il ke saamne unke haq mein gawahi den ke unke Rab ne unse baat ki, to unhone kaha: "Hum tumhari gawahi nahi denge jab tak tum humein Allah khule taur par na dikha do," to unhein bijli ne pakad liya jabke woh dekh rahe the.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the Angel of Death used to approach people visibly. So, he came to Musa (Moses) son of Imran and Musa slapped him, thus causing his eye to pop out. As a result, the Angel of Death complained to Allah saying, 'O Lord, your slave Musa has done such and such to me. Had it not been for his honor in Your sight, I would have avenged myself on him.' Allah commanded, 'Go to My slave Musa and give him the choice between placing his hand on the back of a bull and for every hair that his hand covers, he will live for a year, or to die at that moment.' So, the Angel of Death came to Musa and presented him with the choice. Musa asked, 'What will happen after that?' The Angel of Death replied, 'Then, death will come.' Musa said, 'Then, now is better.' He took a deep breath and the Angel of Death seized his soul. Allah restored his sight to him. After this incident, the Angel of Death approached people in secret."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maut ka farishta logon ke paas khule taur par aata tha, to woh Musa bin Imran (AS) ke paas aaya, Musa (AS) ne usse thappad maara aur uski aankh phoad di, to maut ka farishta Allah ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Aye Rab, tere bande Musa (AS) ne mere sath aisa-aisa kiya, aur agar tere nazdeek unki izzat na hoti to main unhein sakhti se pesh aata.' To Allah ne farmaya: 'Mere bande Musa (AS) ke paas jao aur unhein ikhtiyar do ke woh apna haath aik bail ki peeth par rakhein, to har baal jise unki hatheli dhaanp le uske liye aik saal (zindagi mile), ya woh abhi maut chahein.' To woh unke paas aaye aur unhein ikhtiyar diya, Musa (AS) ne poocha: 'Iske baad kya hoga?' Unhone kaha: 'Maut.' Unhone kaha: 'To phir abhi (maut de do),' phir unhone (Musa AS ne farishte ko) aik saans khaincha (ya farishte ne unhein sunghaaya), to unhone unki rooh qabz kar li, aur Allah ne unhein unki nazar wapas kar di, aur uske baad woh (maut ka farishta) chhupkar logon ke paas aane laga."

e: [AI] And Allah mourned for Harun when Allah wanted to take him. So when Allah mourned for him, he was saddened. And when he passed away, he felt extreme grief and wept for a long time. When he returned from that, Allah came to console him and advise him. He said to him, "O Musa, it is not appropriate for you to grieve over something lost to me or seek companionship with anyone other than me. And you should not rely on anyone other than me. And your grief for Harun now should only be for my sake. How can you feel lonely for something from this world when you hear my words? Or how can you grieve for something lost in this world after I have chosen you with my messages and my words, and mentioned long conversations with you?" Musa said, "Harun passed away when he was 117 years old, three years before his time was due to end. And Harun passed away when he was 120 years old, while Musa remained for three more years until he reached the age of 120. And the children of Israel were scattered, coming together and then separating."
hi: Aur Allah ne Musa (AS) ko Harun (AS) ki maut ki khabar di jab Allah ne unhein wafaat dene ka iraada kiya, jab unhein khabar di to woh gham-zada huay, jab unka intiqaal hua to unhein sakht bechaini hui aur woh lambi der rote rahe, jab woh isi haal mein rahe, to Allah Ta'ala unki taraf mutawajjeh hua, unhein tasalli deta aur naseehat karta, unse farmaya: "Aye Musa, tumhein sazawaar nahi tha ke tum mere paas hote huay kisi cheez ke khonay par tadap uthte, na kisi aur se unsiyat pakadte, na apne ghutne kisi ke siwa mere aage jhukaate, na tumhara yeh gham Harun (AS) ke liye ho, siwaye mere liye ke, aur tum kisi cheez se kaise wehshat mehsoos kar sakte ho jabke tum meri baat sunte ho? Ya tum duniya ki kisi cheez ke khonay par kaise tadapte ho jabke maine tumhein apni risaalaton aur apni kalaam ke sath chun liya hai?" aur aik lambi munajaat zikr ki. Unhone kaha: aur Harun (AS) ki wafaat hui jabke Musa (AS) aik sau satraah (117) saal ke thay, sehra ki bhatakan khatam honay se teen saal pehle, aur Harun (AS) ki wafaat unki umr aik sau bees (120) saal ki thi, Musa (AS) unke baad teen saal aur zinda rahe yahan tak ke unki umr aik sau bees (120) saal poori hui, aur Bani Isra'il unpar mukhtalif thay, kabhi unpar jama hote kabhi bikhar jaate.

e: [AI] And from among the companions of the Prophet ﷺ, it is reported that Allah revealed to Musa ibn Imran, "Indeed, I shall cause Harun to die. So bring him to a specific mountain." So Musa and Harun set off towards that mountain, and suddenly they came across a tree resembling a well-built house. And within it, they found a bed with a comfortable mattress. And there was a pleasant scent in the air. When Harun saw the mountain, the house, and everything inside it, he was amazed and said, "O Musa! I would love to sleep on this bed." Musa replied, "Then go ahead and sleep on it." Harun expressed his fear, saying, "I fear that the Lord of this house may be angry with me." Musa assured him, saying, "Do not fear, I shall protect you from the Lord of this house. So go ahead and sleep." Harun then said, "O Musa, but rather you sleep with me, for if the Lord of this house comes, He will be angry with me and you as well." So when they both slept, Harun died. Upon waking up and finding his brother dead, Musa said, "O Harun, you deceived me!" Then, when Harun was taken, that house was lifted and that tree disappeared, and the bed was raised up to the heavens. When Musa returned to the Children of Israel without Harun, they accused him, saying, "Musa killed Harun out of envy, for the Children of Israel loved Harun more than Musa." Harun was known for his kindness and gentleness among them, while Musa had some harshness towards them. When Musa heard these accusations, he said to them, "Woe to you! Has my brother’s killing become an accusation against me?!" And when they persisted in their claim, he stood up and performed two units of prayer, then he supplicated to Allah. As a result, the bed was brought down from the heavens until it was visible to them between the sky and the earth, thus confirming Musa's truthfulness.
hi: Aur Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaba se, ke Allah ne Musa bin Imran (AS) ki taraf wahi ki: "Main Harun (AS) ko wafaat dene wala hoon, isliye unhein fulan fulan pahaad par lekar aao." To Musa (AS) aur Harun (AS) us pahaad ki taraf chal pade, achaanak unhein aik darakht mila jo aik bane huay ghar jaisa tha, andar aik takht tha jispar bistar bicha hua tha, aur usme khushbudaar khushbu thi. Jab Harun (AS) ne is pahaad, ghar, aur usme jo tha use dekha, to unhein achha laga aur unhone kaha: "Aye Musa, mujhe pasand hai ke main is takht par soun." Musa (AS) ne unse kaha: "To isspar so jao." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe darr hai ke is ghar ka maalik aa jaaye aur mujhpar ghussa ho." Musa (AS) ne unse kaha: "Mat daro, main tumhein is ghar ke maalik se bacha lunga, isliye so jao." Unhone kaha: "Aye Musa, balke tum bhi mere sath so jao, kyunke agar is ghar ka maalik aaya to woh mujh aur tum dono par ghussa hoga." Jab dono so gaye, to Harun (AS) ko maut ne pakad liya, jab unhein iska ehsaas hua to unhone kaha: "Aye Musa, tumne mujhe dhoka diya." Jab unka intiqaal hua, to woh ghar uthaa liya gaya, woh darakht chala gaya, aur takht aasman ki taraf uthaa liya gaya. Jab Musa (AS) Bani Isra'il ke paas Harun (AS) ke bagair laute, to unhone kaha: "Musa (AS) ne Harun (AS) ko qatl kiya aur Bani Isra'il ki unke liye mohabbat ki wajah se unse hasad kiya," aur Harun (AS) unke darmiyan unse zyada milansaar aur unke liye narm-mizaaj the, aur Musa (AS) mein unke liye kuch sakhti thi. Jab unhein yeh baat pahunchi, to unhone unse kaha: "Afsos tumpar, woh mera bhai tha, kya tum samajhte ho main use qatl karunga?" Jab unhone unpar isspar zyada zor daala, to woh khade huay, do rak'at namaz padhi, phir Allah se dua ki, to takht unke saamne utar aaya yahan tak ke unhone use aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan dekha, to unhone unhein sach maan liya.

e: [AI] From Ali, in his saying, exalted and noble: "O you who have believed, do not be like those who harmed Moses; then Allah cleared him of what they said." (Al-Ahzab 69) He said: Moses ascended the mountain and Aaron died. The children of Israel said to Moses, "You have killed him; he was more beloved to us than you and was gentler to us than you, so they harmed him in that." Then Allah commanded the angels and they carried him, passing him by the gatherings of the children of Israel until they learned of his death, then they buried him. No one except the angels knew his grave. And indeed, Allah made him deaf and dumb.
hi: Ali (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aye imaan walo, un logon jaisa mat bano jinhone Musa (AS) ko takleef pahunchaayi, to Allah ne unhein us baat se bari kar diya jo unhone kahi}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 69) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Musa (AS) aur Harun (AS) pahaad par chadhe, to Harun (AS) faut ho gaye, to Bani Isra'il ne Musa (AS) se kaha: "Tumne unhein qatl kiya, woh humse zyada tumse mohabbat karte the aur tumse zyada narm the," to unhone unhein isspar takleef di. To Allah ne farishton ko hukum diya, unhone unhein uthaaya, unhein Bani Isra'il ki majlison mein se guzaara yahan tak ke unhein unki maut ka ilm hua, phir unhein dafan kiya, aur unki qabr ka pata sirf gidh (parinda) ko tha, aur Allah ne use bahra aur gunga bana diya.

e: [AI] Musa, the chosen one of Allah, used to dislike death and considered it great. Then, when he developed hatred for it, Allah desired for him to love death and detest life. Thus, prophethood was transferred to Yusha bin Nun. Musa would visit him in the morning and evening, and Musa would ask him, "O Prophet of Allah, what revelations has Allah sent to you?" Yusha bin Nun would reply, "O Prophet of Allah, did I not accompany you for a certain number of years? Did I not ask you about anything that Allah revealed to you, so that I could be the one to initiate and remember it?" When Musa saw that, he started to dislike life and love death.
hi: Allah ke chune huay Musa (AS) ko maut napasand thi aur woh isse bada samajhte the, jab unhein yeh napasand hui, to Allah ne chaaha ke unhein maut pasandeeda lage aur zindagi napasand ho, to Nubuwwat Yusha bin Nun ki taraf mutawajjeh ho gayi, Musa (AS) unke paas subah-shaam jaate rehte, unse poochte: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, Allah ne aapki taraf kya nayi baat bhej di?" Yusha bin Nun kehte: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, kya main aapke sath itne-itne saal nahi raha? Kya maine kabhi aapse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jo Allah ne aapki taraf bheji, ke aap khud isse shuru karein aur zikr karein?" Jab Musa (AS) ne yeh dekha, to unhein zindagi napasand hui aur maut pasandeeda lagi.

e: [AI] It was part of the destiny of the death of the Prophet Moses ﷺ  that he used to seek shelter in an arish (kind of tree) and eat and drink from a stream of water from a rock, just as an animal would graze near that stream. This was his humility towards Allah, until Allah honored him with what He honored him through His words. It was part of his destiny that one day he left his arish for some of his needs, and no one from the creation of Allah knew about it. He passed by a group of angels who were digging a grave, and he recognized them, so he approached them until he stood near them. He found them digging a grave, and he had never seen anything better than what was in it, in terms of greenery, freshness, and beauty. He said to them, "O angels of Allah, for whom are you digging this grave?" They said, "We are digging it for a noble servant of his Lord." He said, "Indeed, this servant is of a station from Allah such that I have never seen anything like it, not as a sleeping place nor as an entrance. This is when he received what Allah had ordained for him in his passing away." The angels said to him, "O beloved of Allah, do you desire to be like this?" He said, "I wish." They said, "Then come down and lie in it, and turn towards your Lord, then take a breath that is the easiest breath you have ever taken." So he came down and lay in it, and turned towards his Lord, and then took a breath. Then Allah took his soul, and the angels prayed on him. The Prophet Moses ﷺ  was ascetic in the world and longing for the hereafter.
hi: Allah ke chune huay Musa (AS) ke intiqaal ka waqia yeh tha ke woh aik jhopdi mein saaya lete the, aur aik pathharili gaddhe mein khaate-peete the, jaise jaanwar us gaddhe mein muh maar kar peeta hai, Allah ke aage tawaadhu (aajizi) mein, yahan tak ke Allah ne unhein apne kalaam ki izzat di. Unki wafaat ka waqia yeh hua ke woh aik din apni jhopdi se apni kisi zaroorat ke liye nikle, aur Allah ki kisi makhlooq ko iska ilm na tha, to unka guzar farishton ke aik giroh se hua jo aik qabr khod rahe the, unhone unhein pehchaan liya, unki taraf gaye yahan tak ke unke paas khade ho gaye, to woh aik qabr khod rahe the, aur unhone isse behtar koi cheez kabhi nahi dekhi thi, sabzi, tazgi, aur khoobsurati mein, unhone unse poocha: "Aye Allah ke farishto, yeh qabr tum kiske liye khod rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: "Hum ise Allah ki qasam, aik aise banda ke liye khod rahe hain jo apne Rab ke nazdeek izzat wala hai." Unhone kaha: "Beshak yeh banda Allah ke nazdeek aisa martaba rakhta hai ke maine kabhi aaj jaisa aaram-gaah ya dakhil-hone-ki-jagah nahi dekhi," aur yeh us waqt hua jab Allah ki taraf se woh cheez aa pahunchi jo unki rooh qabz karne mein aani thi. To farishton ne unse kaha: "Aye Allah ke chune huay, kya aap chaahte hain ke woh (jagah) aapki ho?" Unhone kaha: "Main chahta hoon." Unhone kaha: "To utar kar isme let jaayen aur apne Rab ki taraf mutawajjeh hon, phir saans lein, sabse aasaan saans jo aapne kabhi li ho." To woh utre, usme let gaye, apne Rab ki taraf mutawajjeh huay, phir saans li, to Allah ne unki rooh qabz kar li, phir farishton ne unpar janaaza ki namaz padhi. Aur Allah ke chune huay Musa (AS) duniya se be-raghbat aur Aakhirat ke shaidaai thay.

e: [AI] Ayoub ibn Amoos was the messenger of Allah who was tested by Iblis, the enemy of Allah, with his troops, horses, and men to tempt him and distract him from the remembrance of Allah. But Allah protected him and Iblis found no way to reach him. So Allah bestowed tranquility and patience upon Ayoub to endure the affliction that he was tested with. And Allah called him "a servant who always turns to Allah" (Quran 38:44). Ayoub was a tall man with curly hair and wide eyes, and he had a handsome appearance. On his forehead was written "the patient one who endures affliction." He had a short neck, broad chest, sturdy legs, and strong arms. He would give to widows and support them earnestly, advising them for the sake of Allah, the Almighty.
hi: Ayyub bin Amoos, Allah ke sabr karne wale Nabi, thay, jinke khilaaf Allah ke dushman Iblees ne apni fauj, ghode, aur paidal (lashkar) laaye taake use fitne mein daalein aur Allah ke zikr se hataayein, to Allah ne unhein mehfooz rakha aur Iblees ko unki taraf koi raasta na mila, to Allah ne Ayyub (AS) par sukoon aur unhein di gayi aazmaaish par sabr daala, to Allah ne unhein "{behtareen banda, beshak woh bohot rujoo karne wala hai}" (Surah Saad 44) ka naam diya. Ayyub (AS) lambe qad ke, ghunghraale baalon wale, chaudi aankhon wale, achhi soorat wale thay, aur unki peshaani par 'aazmaaish-zada sabr karne wala' likha hua tha, aur woh chhoti gardan, chaude seene, mote pindliyon aur baazuon wale thay, aur woh bewaaon ko diya karte the aur unhein kapde pehnaate, Allah ke liye koshish aur khulus se.

e: [AI] By Allah, I have endured hardship and poverty that my people have never sent someone with a loaf of bread to feed you. So, invoke Allah to cure you." He said, "Woe to you! We were in blessings for seventy years and now we are in affliction for seven years."
hi: "Allah ki qasam, mujhpar itni takleef aur zaroorat aa chuki hai ke meri qaum ne mujhe aik roti bhej di jise maine aapko khilaaya, isliye Allah se dua karo ke woh aapko shifa de." Unhone kaha: "Afsos tumpar, hum sattar (70) saal khush-haali mein rahe, to hum saat (7) saal museebat mein hi (sabr kyun na karein)?"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, the Prophet Ayyub (Job), peace be upon him, endured his affliction for fifteen years, during which his close relatives and distant relatives abandoned him, except for two of his brothers who were among his closest brothers. They used to visit him in the morning and evening. One day, one of them said to the other, 'By Allah, Ayyub has committed a sin that no one among the world's inhabitants has committed.' His companion asked, 'What is that?' He replied, 'For eighteen years, Allah has not shown him any mercy, so He has removed whatever he had.' When they went to Ayyub, the man could not bear it until he mentioned it to him. Ayyub said to him, 'I do not know what you are saying, other than that Allah knows that I used to command the two men who disputed with each other to mention Allah, so return to my home and I will purify them out of dislike for mentioning Allah except in the truth.' He used to go out for his needs, and when he fulfilled his need, his wife would hold his hand until he came back. One day, he took longer than usual, so Allah revealed to Ayyub in the place where he was, 'Strike the ground with your foot: This is to wash yourself with cold water and for a drink.' His wife scooped it up, and he went to her, and Allah removed his affliction completely. He was better than ever before. When she saw him, she said, 'May Allah bless you! Did you see the Prophet of Allah, this afflicted man? By Allah, I have never seen anyone resemble him more than you, when he was healthy.' He replied, 'Indeed, I am that person.' He had two plots of land: one for wheat and the other for barley. Allah sent two clouds, one over each field. The cloud over the wheat field rained gold until it was full. The cloud over the barley field rained silver until it was full."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ke Nabi Ayyub (AS) ki aazmaaish pandrah (15) saal tak rahi, unhein qareebi aur door ke rishtedaaron ne chhod diya, siwaye unke do bhaiyon ke jo unke khaas-tareen bhai the, woh unke paas subah-shaam aate the, aik din unme se aik ne apne saathi se kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, humein pata hai ke Ayyub (AS) ne aisa gunah kiya hai jo duniya walon mein se kisi ne nahi kiya.' Unke saathi ne poocha: 'Woh kya hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Atthaaraah (18) saal se Allah ne unpar reham nahi kiya.' To yeh baat unse chhupi na rahi, jab woh Ayyub (AS) ke paas gaye, to unme se aik aadmi sabr na kar saka yahan tak ke usne yeh baat unse zikr ki. Ayyub (AS) ne unse kaha: 'Mujhe nahi pata tum kya keh rahe ho, siwaye is ke ke Allah jaanta hai ke main do aadmiyon ke paas se guzarta jo jhagad rahe hote aur Allah ka zikr karte, to main apne ghar wapas jaakar unke liye kaffaara ada karta, is baat se napasand ke Allah ka naam ba-haq ke siwa liya jaaye.' Aur woh apni zaroorat ke liye nikalte, jab woh apni zaroorat poori kar lete, to unki biwi unka haath thaam leti yahan tak ke woh pahunch jaate. Aik din unhein unke paas pahunchne mein der hui, to Allah ne Ayyub (AS) ki taraf unhi ki jagah wahi ki ke apna pair maaro, yeh thanda ghusl aur peene ki cheez hai. Unki biwi ko unke aane mein der lagi to woh unse milne aayi, aur woh unki taraf badhe jabke Allah ne unse jo museebat thi door kar di thi, aur woh pehle se behtar the. Jab unhone unhein dekha to kaha: 'Allah tumme barkat de, kya tumne Allah ke us aazmaish-zada Nabi ko dekha? Allah ki qasam, jab tum sehat-mand the tab bhi maine tumse zyada unse milta-julta koi shakhs nahi dekha.' Unhone kaha: 'To main hi woh hoon.' Unhone kaha: aur unke do khalihaan the, gehun ka aik aur jau ka aik, to Allah ne do baadal bheje, jab unme se aik gehun ke khalihaan par pahuncha, to usne usme sona itna bhar diya ke woh chhalak gaya, aur doosre ne jau ke khalihaan mein chandi bhar di yahan tak ke woh bhi chhalak gayi.'"

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ , he said: When Allah cured Job (Ayoub), He showered him with a hail of golden locusts. Job started grabbing them with his hand and placing them in his garment. It was said to him, 'O Job, don't you have enough?' He replied, 'Who can ever have enough of Your mercy?'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Allah ne Ayyub (AS) ko shifa di, to unpar sone ki tiddiyaan barsaayi, to woh unhein apne haath se pakadkar apne kapde mein daalne lage, to unse kaha gaya: 'Aye Ayyub, kya tum seer nahi hote?' Unhone kaha: 'Aur teri rehmat se kaun seer ho sakta hai?'"

e: [AI] "Job was afflicted for seven years thrown on the dung heap of the holy house." The Golden did not mention it in the summary.
hi: "Ayyub (AS) ki aazmaaish saat (7) saal tak rahi, jabke woh Bait-ul-Maqdis ke kooda-daan par pade rahe." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The translation into English is as follows: "The age of Job was ninety-three years when he made a will before his death, leaving it to his son Hawmal. Allah then sent his son Bashr bin Ayyub as a prophet and named him Dhul Kifl. He was commanded to call people to the worship of Allah. Job lived in Sham (Syria) until he passed away at the age of seventy-five. Bashr then left his will to his son Abdan. After them, Allah sent Shuayb as a prophet. This narration is narrated by Abdul Mannan bin Idris, who has been proven to be a liar."
hi: "Ayyub (AS) ki umr terah nabbe (93) saal thi, unhone apni maut ke waqt apne bete Haumal ko wasiyat ki, aur Allah ne unke baad unke bete Bishr bin Ayyub ko Nabi banaakar bheja aur unka naam Zul-Kifl rakha, unhein tauheed ki taraf dawat dene ka hukum diya, aur woh Sham (Syria) mein apni zindagi bhar rahe yahan tak ke unka intiqaal hua, unki umr pachattar (75) saal thi, aur Bishr ne apne bete Abdaan ko wasiyat ki, phir Allah ne unke baad Shu'aib (AS) ko bheja." Iski sanad mein Abdul Mun'im bin Idris hain aur woh jhoote saabit huay hain.

e: [AI] Then Elijah, the Prophet of Allah, was a companion of mountains and deserts in which he secluded himself to worship his Lord. He had a large head, wide chest, thin calves, and there was a red mole on his head. Allah raised him to the land of Sham (Syria), but he did not ascend to the heavens. He left behind him the prophethood to be inherited by Al-Yasa' (Elisha) after him.
hi: "Phir Ilyas (AS), Allah ke Nabi, pahaadon aur bayaabaano mein rehte the, unme akele apne Rab ki ibaadat karte, unka sar bada tha, pait patla, pindliyan patli, aur unke sar mein aik surkh til tha, aur Allah ne unhein Sham (Syria) ki zameen tak uthaaya, unhein aasman tak nahi le gaya, to unke baad Al-Yasa (AS) ko Nubuwwat ka waaris banaaya."

e: [AI] "And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers. And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, 'My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors.' So We responded to him and honored him with John and caused his wife to bear for him, and they in haste to good deeds and supplicated Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive. And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds. Indeed, this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me. And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return." [Surah Al-Anbiya, 87-93] So Allah responded to him and saved him from the people of darkness, the darkness of the night, the darkness of the sea and the darkness of the belly of the whale, and he stayed with his people and Allah sent him to a hundred thousand or more, and they believed, so Allah granted them enjoyment until their appointed time.
hi: "{Aur Dhun-Nun (machhli waale) ko yaad karo, jab woh ghussa hokar chale gaye, aur samjha ke hum unhein kabhi tang nahi karenge, phir unhone andheron mein pukaara: koi ma'bood nahi siwaye tere, tu paak hai, beshak main zaalimon mein se tha}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 87), to Allah ne unhein qubool kiya aur unhein gham se, teen andheron se - raat ke andhere, samundar ke andhere, aur machhli ke pait ke andhere se - nijaat di, aur woh apni qaum par (Nabi) rahe, aur unhein aik lakh ya usse zyada (logon) ki taraf bheja gaya, to woh imaan laaye, to Allah ne unhein unki muqarrar muddat tak faida diya aur unhein azaab se halaak nahi kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Prophet Jonah) which he made while in the belly of the fish was this: 'There is no deity worthy of worship but You, glorified are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.'" No Muslim person sincerely asks Allah for something in distress, except that Allah grants their request.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dhun-Nun (Yunus) ki dua jo unhone machhli ke pait mein ki: 'La ilaha illa Anta, Subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen' (Koi ma'bood nahi siwaye Tere, Tu paak hai, beshak main zaalimon mein se tha), koi bhi Musalman kisi museebat mein isse na maange magar Allah usse qubool kare."

e: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever says that I am better than Jonah bin Matta, is a liar." (Using translation from Bukhārī 4604)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kahe ke main Yunus bin Matta (AS) se behtar hoon, usne jhoot bola."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a group of people and asked, 'What is this?' They said, 'This is Thaniyyah.' He said, 'It is as if I am seeing Yunus ibn Matta riding on a camel with a bridle, wearing a cloak made of wool, and saying, 'Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik'."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik chadhaai se guzre, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Fulan-fulan chadhaai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Goya main Yunus bin Matta (AS) ko dekh raha hoon aik oontni par jiski lagaam khajoor ke reshon ki thi, aur unpar oon ka jubbah tha, aur woh keh rahe the: 'Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik.'"

e: [AI] "Yunus stayed inside the belly of the whale for forty days." The golden one (Ibn Hajar) remained silent about it in summary.
hi: "Yunus (AS) machhli ke pait mein chaalis (40) din rahe." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He used to frequently pray during the night." This was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summarizing.
hi: "Woh andheri raaton mein zyada namaz padhte the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Yunus bin Matta was swallowed by the whale in the morning and it spit him out in the evening."
hi: "Yunus bin Matta (AS) ko machhli ne subah nigla aur shaam ko ugla."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever supplicates with the supplication of Yunus (Jonah) that he supplicated with in the belly of the whale, his supplication will be answered." This is a witness to what has been mentioned before.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Yunus (AS) ki dua ke sath dua kare jo unhone machhli ke pait mein ki, uski dua qubool ki jayegi." Yeh pehle zikr ki gayi baat ka gawah hai.

e: Yunus bin Matta was a righteous servant, but he was of narrow character. When the burdens of prophethood were placed upon him and they were burdens that only a few could bear, he cracked under their weight, just as a single straw breaks under the burden. He expelled them from his body and fled from them, saying to his Prophet Muhammad  ﷺ , "Therefore be patient, as the messengers endowed with determination were patient." "So be patient with the decree of your Lord and do not be like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed." [Quran 68:48] It means, do not throw in another burden as you have thrown it away. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Beshak Yunus bin Matta (AS) aik neik banda thay, lekin unke mizaaj mein tangi thi, jab unpar Nubuwwat ka bojh daala gaya, aur uska bojh aisa tha jise sirf thode log hi uthaa sakte hain, to woh iske neeche dab gaye jaise koi kamzor (jaanwar) bojh ke neeche dab jaata hai, to unhone use apne badan se phaink diya aur usse bhaagte huay nikal gaye, Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi Muhammad (SAW) se farmata hai: "{To sabr karo jaise buland himmat Rusul ne sabr kiya}" "{To apne Rab ke faisle par sabr karo, aur machhli waale ki tarah mat bano jab unhone pukaara jabke woh gham mein dabe huay the}" (Surah Al-Qalam 48), ya'ni: "Doosri baar aisa mat karo jaisa unhone kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When Yunus (Jonah) was swallowed by the whale, he thought it was his death, so he moved his legs and found movement within it. Then he prostrated and said, "O Lord, I have made for You a mosque in a place where no one has prostrated before." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary.
hi: Jab Yunus (AS) machhli ke pait mein gire, to unhone samjha ke yeh maut hai, to unhone apne pair hilaaye, dekha ke woh harkat kar rahe hain, to unhone sajda kiya aur kaha: "Aye Rab, maine teri khaatir aik aisi jagah mein masjid banaayi jismein kabhi kisi ne sajda nahi kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And the Prophet of Allah, Dawud son of Isha son of Awbad son of Ba'ir son of Salmoon son of Yahsun son of Yarib son of Ram son of Hadaron son of Faris son of Yehuda son of Yaqub son of Ishaq son of Ibrahim the Khalil (beloved friend of Allah). He was a short man with a light complexion, little hair, and a pure heart. He was also a knowledgeable scholar." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in his summary.
hi: "Aur Allah ke Nabi Dawud bin Ishaa bin Aubad bin Baa'ir bin Salmoon bin Yahsun bin Yaarib bin Raam bin Hazroon bin Faaris bin Yahuda bin Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim Khaleel (AS) thay, aur woh aik chhote qad, neeli aankhon wale, kam baalon wale, paak dil wale, fiqh (ilm-e-deen) rakhne wale aadmi thay." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] From his father, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: "{Have you not seen those who left their homes in great numbers, fearing death?}" [Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 243] to His saying: "{And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers}" [Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 95]. He (the narrator) said: Allah the Exalted revealed to their prophet that in the son of So-and-So there is a man who Allah will be killed by with Goliath (Jalut). Among his signs is this horn that he places on his head, and whatever he missed in the past will be returned to him. So he came to him and said, "Indeed, Allah has revealed to me that a man in your lineage will kill Goliath." He said, "Yes, O Prophet of Allah." He said, "So he brought out for him twelve men in rows, resembling the saviors, and among them is a skilled man. He made them pass by the horn, but he could not see anything." He said, "Then he said, 'You have other children besides those.' He said, 'Yes, O Prophet of Allah. I have a short son whom I am shy for people to see.' So I placed him among the sheep." He said, "And where is he?" He said, "He is in the group of such and such." He said, "So he went to him and said, 'This is him, no doubt about it.' And he placed the horn on his head, and he stood up." 

(Translation may vary, this is a rough translation)
hi: Apne waalid se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Kya aapne un logon ko nahi dekha jo apne gharon se nikle, hazaron ki tadaad mein, maut ke darr se}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 243) unke farmaan "{Aur Allah zaalimon ko khoob jaanta hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 95) tak ke baare mein, unhone kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne unke Nabi ki taraf wahi ki ke fulan ki aulaad mein aik aadmi hai jiske zariye Allah Jalut ko qatl karega, aur uski nishaani yeh hai ke yeh singh (taaj) uske sar par rakhoge to jo bhi usse chhoota reh gaya woh poora ho jayega, to woh (Nabi) uske paas gaye aur kaha: "Allah ne mujhe wahi ki hai ke tumhari aulaad mein aik aadmi hai jiske zariye Allah Jalut ko qatl karega." Usne kaha: "Ji haan, Aye Allah ke Nabi." Unhone kaha: to usne unke saamne baarah (12) aadmi nikaale jo lambe khambon jaise the, aur unme aik nihaayat khoobsurat aadmi tha, to unhone unhein singh (taaj) par pesh kiya, magar kuch na dikha. Unhone poocha: "Kya tumhare inke ilawa aur bhi aulaad hai?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan, Aye Allah ke Nabi, mera aik chhota beta hai jise dekhne se mujhe sharm aati thi, isliye maine use bakriyon ke paas rakha hua hai." Unhone poocha: "Woh kahan hai?" Usne kaha: "Woh fulan-fulan waadi mein hai." Unhone kaha: to woh uski taraf nikle aur kaha: "Yehi hai, ismein koi shak nahi." Unhone kaha: phir unhone singh (taaj) uske sar par rakha, to woh khada ho gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When Allah created Adam He wiped his back and every person that He created among his offspring until the Day of Resurrection fell out of his back. He placed a ray of light between the eyes of every person. Then He showed them to Adam and he said: 'O Lord! Who are these people?' He said: 'These are your offspring.' He saw one of them whose ray between his eyes amazed him, so he said: 'O Lord! Who is this?' He said: 'This is a man from the latter nations of your offspring called Dawud.' He said: 'Lord! How long did You make his lifespan?' He said: 'Sixty years.' He said: 'O Lord! Add forty years from my life to his.' So at the end of Adam's life, the Angel of death of came to him, and he said: 'Do I not have forty years remaining?' He said: 'Did you not give them to your son Dawud?'" He said: "Adam denied, so his offspring denied, and Adam forgot and his offspring forgot, and Adam sinned, so his offspring sinned." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3076)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: jab Allah ne Aadam (AS) ko paida kiya, to unki peeth par haath phera, to unki peeth se har wo jaan nikli jise usne Qayamat tak unki aulaad mein se paida karna tha, aur unme se har insaan ki do aankhon ke darmiyan unke noor ki aik chamak rakh di, phir unhein Aadam (AS) ke saamne pesh kiya, to unhone poocha: "Aye Rab, yeh kaun hain?" Farmaya: "Yeh tumhari aulaad hai." Unhone kaha: to unhone unme se aik aadmi ko dekha jiski do aankhon ke darmiyan ki chamak ne unhein hairat mein daal diya, unhone poocha: "Aye Rab, yeh kaun hai?" Farmaya: "Yeh tumhari aulaad mein se aakhri Ummaton ka aik aadmi hai jise Dawud kaha jaayega." Unhone poocha: "Aye Rab, tu ne iski umr kitni rakhi hai?" Farmaya: "Saath (60) saal." Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, to meri umr mein se chalis (40) saal isse de de." Farmaya: "Achha, to (yeh) likh diya jayega, muhr lag jayegi, aur badla nahi jayega." Jab Aadam (AS) ki umr poori honay lagi, to maut ka farishta unke paas aaya, unhone poocha: "Kya meri umr mein se chaalis (40) saal baaqi nahi?" Unhone kaha: "Kya tumne woh apne bete Dawud ko nahi de diya?" Unhone kaha: to unhone inkaar kiya, to unki aulaad ne bhi inkaar kiya, aur woh bhool gaye, to unki aulaad bhi bhool gayi, aur unse khataa hui, to unki aulaad se bhi khataa hoti hai.

e: [AI] "And between Moses and David were five hundred and sixty-nine years." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: "Aur Musa (AS) aur Dawud (AS) ke darmiyan paanch sau unhattar (569) saal ka faasla tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] About As-Suddi in his saying, Almighty Allah says, "And We strengthened his kingdom." [Surah Saba, Verse 20]
As-Suddi said, "He used to protect it every day and night with four thousand four thousand." As-Suddi also said, "David had divided his time into three days; a day for spending time with people, a day for solitude in worship, and a day for solitude with his wives. He had ninety-nine wives. He read in the scriptures about the virtue of Ibrahim, Ishaq, and Ya'qub, and when he found this, he said, 'O Lord, I see that all the good has been taken away from my forefathers who preceded me, so give me the same as You gave them, and treat me as You treated them.' Allah inspired him, saying, 'Your forefathers were tested with tribulations that you have not been tested with. Ibrahim was tested with the sacrifice of his son, Ishaq was tested with his sight, and Ya'qub was tested with the sorrow of losing Yusuf. But you have not been tested with any of that.' David said, 'O Lord, test me with similar tests to what You tested them with, and give me what You gave them.' Allah revealed to him, 'Verily, you will be tested, so be cautious.' After that, he remained as long as Allah willed for him to remain. Then, Shaytan came to him in the form of a golden pigeon and landed between his feet while he was standing in prayer. David reached out his hand to take it, but it flew away. He looked to see where it had gone, and he sent someone in its tracks. He said, 'The person saw a woman bathing on a rooftop, and he saw that she was one of the most beautiful women, and he desired her. So, she saw him looking at her, and she revealed her hair, and he became even more attracted to her.' He asked about her and was informed that she was married, and her husband was absent on military duty. He sent a message to her husband instructing him to be sent to his enemy in a certain position. He sent him, and he was killed in the third battle. Then, David married his wife. When he went to her, he did not stay with her for long before Allah sent two angels in human form to visit him. They asked to see him, but the guards prevented them from entering. They encircled him as he was praying. He did not notice them until they said, 'Do not fear. We are only two opponents who disputed with each other. So judge between us with justice and do not be biased.' He mentioned the entire Hadith in its entirety, acknowledging his mistake. Al-Dhahabi did not include its summarization.
hi: As-Suddi se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur humne uski baadshaahat mazboot ki}" (Surah Saad 20) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Har din aur raat char hazaar, char hazaar (log) uski hifaazat karte the." As-Suddi ne kaha: aur Dawud (AS) ne apna waqt teen dinon mein taqseem kiya tha - aik din jismein woh logon ke darmiyan faisle karte, aik din jismein woh apni ibaadat ke liye khaali hote, aur aik din jismein woh apni biwiyon ke liye khaali hote, aur unki ninyaanwe (99) biwiyaan thin, aur unhone jo kitaabein padhi thin unme se unhein Ibrahim (AS), Ishaq (AS), aur Yaqub (AS) ki fazeelat ka ilm hua, jab unhone yeh apni padhi hui kitaabon mein paaya, to unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, main dekh raha hoon ke saari bhalaai mere pehle ke baap-daada le gaye, isliye mujhe bhi wohi de jo tu ne unhein diya, aur mere sath waisa hi kar jaisa tu ne unke sath kiya." Unhone kaha: to Allah ne unki taraf wahi ki ke tumhare baap-daada ko aisi aazmaaishon se aazmaaya gaya jinse tumhein nahi aazmaaya gaya, Ibrahim (AS) ko apne bete ke zibah se aazmaaya gaya, Ishaq (AS) ko apni nazar khonay se aazmaaya gaya, Yaqub (AS) ko Yusuf (AS) par gham se aazmaaya gaya, aur tumhein isme se kuch bhi pesh nahi aaya. Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, mujhe waisi hi aazmaaish de jaisi unhein di, aur mujhe wohi de jo unhein diya." Unhone kaha: to Allah ne unki taraf wahi ki ke tum aazmaaye jaaoge, isliye hoshiyaar raho. Unhone kaha: phir jitna Allah ne chaaha woh isi tarah rahe, ke aik din shaitan unke paas sone ke kabootar ki soorat mein aaya yahan tak ke woh unke pairon ke darmiyan aa gira jabke woh khade namaz padh rahe the. Unhone kaha: to unhone apna haath usse pakadne ke liye badhaya, woh kholi (roshan-daan) se ud gaya, unhone dekha woh kahan jaata hai, to unhone uske peeche (nazar) bheji. Unhone kaha: to unhone aik aurat ko apni chhat par ghusl karte huay dekha, unhone aik nihaayat khoobsurat aurat dekhi, itne mein usne aik nazar dali aur unhein dekh liya, to usne apne baal (aage) daal liye taake khud ko chhupa sake, isse unki taraf unki khwaahish aur barh gayi. Unhone kaha: to unhone uske baare mein poocha, unhein bataaya gaya ke uska aik shohar hai aur uska shohar fulan-fulan jagah (jung mein) mahaaz par gaya hua hai. Unhone kaha: to unhone us mahaaz ke sardaar ki taraf paighaam bheja, unhein hukum diya ke woh usse fulan-fulan dushman ki taraf bhej dein. Unhone kaha: to unhone use bheja, wahan (fatah) khul gayi, phir woh isi tarah usse bhejte rahe yahan tak ke woh teesri baar mein maara gaya, to unhone uski biwi se nikah kar liya. Jab woh uske paas dakhil huay, to thodi hi der guzri thi ke Allah ne unke paas do farishte insaano ki soorat mein bheje, unhone unke paas dakhil honay ki darkhwaast ki, unhein unke ibaadat ke din mein paaya, pahre daaron ne unhein unke paas jaane se roka, to woh mehraab (deewaar) chadh kar unke paas aa gaye. Unhone kaha: to unhein pata hi na chala, jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, achaanak woh dono unke saamne baithe huay the. Unhone kaha: to woh unse dahal gaye, unhone kaha: "Mat daro, hum sirf do jhagadne wale hain jinme se aik ne doosre par zulm kiya hai, isliye humare darmiyan haq ke sath faisla karo aur nainsaafi mat karo," ya'ni: "Mat daro," phir apne (Dawud ke) gunah ka iqrar karne ke qissa ko poora lamba zikr kiya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summary.
hi: Unse, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] Regarding the people's saying in the verse {And indeed We have written in Zabur (Psalms) after the Reminder (Torah) that My righteous servants shall inherit the earth} [Al-Anbiya' 105], it is mentioned in the Zabur of Dawud (David) after the mention of Musa (Moses) that "indeed, My righteous servants shall inherit the earth" [Al-Anbiya' 105]. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about the interpretation of this.
hi: Ash-Sha'bi se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur humne Zaboor mein, Zikr (Tauraat) ke baad, likh diya}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 105) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Dawud (AS) ke Zaboor mein, Musa (AS) ke zikr ke baad: {Ke zameen ke waaris mere neik bande honge}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 105)." Unhone kaha: "Jannat." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That He bestows upon him a kingdom that is not befitting for anyone after him, and that it is the twentieth (year). He (the Prophet Muhammad) said, 'I do not know what people are saying, but my father Ali ibn Hussain narrated to me from his father from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) from the Prophet ﷺ  that he said, 'Allah did not bless any king in the nation of a prophet who came before him with the lifespan that prophet reached in his nation.' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization."
hi: Ke usse aisi baadshaahat de jo uske baad kisi ke liye munaasib na ho, aur woh baees (ya bees) saal ki thi. To unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi maloom logon ki baaton ka kya hai, lekin mujhse mere waalid Ali bin Al-Husain ne, unke waalid se, unhone Ali (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se hadith bayan ki, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ne kisi Nabi ki Ummat mein kisi baadshaah ki umr, jo usse pehle guzar chuke Nabi ki apni Ummat mein umr tak, nahi pahunchayi.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] A vineyard had produced its grapes, but the sheep ruined it. Dawood (David) decided to grant the vineyard to the owner of the sheep. Sulaiman (Solomon) said, "This is not fair, O Prophet of Allah." Dawood asked, "Why?" Sulaiman replied, "You should transfer the vineyard to its owner, and the sheep to its owner, until the vineyard returns to its previous state." Allah, the Almighty, says, "So We made Sulaiman understand it, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge." (Quran 21:79). Adh-Dhahabi remained silent regarding the summary.
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur Dawud (AS) aur Sulaiman (AS), jab woh khet ke maamle mein faisla kar rahe the jab usme kisi qaum ki bakriyaan raat ko phail gayin}" ke baare mein, unhone kaha: yeh angoor ka aik baagh tha jismein guchhe aa chuke the, to bakriyon ne use kharaab kar diya. Unhone kaha: to Dawud (AS) ne baagh ke maalik ke haq mein bakriyon ka faisla diya. To Sulaiman (AS) ne kaha: "Iske ilawa (bhi kuch hai), Aye Allah ke Nabi." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aap baagh bakriyon ke maalik ko de dein, woh isspar mehnat karega yahan tak ke woh phir se pehle jaisa ho jaaye, aur bakriyaan baagh ke maalik ko de dein, woh unse faida uthaayega yahan tak ke jab baagh phir se pehle jaisa ho jaaye, to aap baagh uske maalik ko wapas kar dein aur bakriyaan unke maalik ko wapas kar dein." Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "{To humne yeh (samajh) Sulaiman (AS) ko samjha di, aur humne dono ko faisla aur ilm diya}" (Surah Al-Anbiya 79). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] People heard about it and mocked him, but he continued to manage his affairs in accordance with the command, light, and wisdom of Allah. Until Allah wanted to take him back, he revealed to him to entrust the knowledge and wisdom of Allah to his brother and to the offsprings of David. They were four hundred and eighty-four men without a message. This is false.
hi: "Log unke baare mein sunte the aur woh unke liye musakhkhar (taabey) kar diya gaya tha, aur woh musalsal Allah ke hukum, uske noor, aur uski hikmat se intezaam karte rahe, yahan tak ke jab Allah ne unhein wafaat dene ka iraada kiya, unki taraf wahi ki ke Allah ka ilm aur uski hikmat apne bhai aur Dawud (AS) ki aulaad ke supurd kar dein, aur woh char sau assi (480) mard the, bagair kisi risaalat ke." Yeh baatil (jhoot) hai.

e: [AI] To give him a kingdom that no one else should have after him, so the jinn, humans, birds, and wind were made subservient to him. Al-Dhahabi remained silent in summarizing it.
hi: Ke usse aisi baadshaahat de jo uske baad kisi ke liye munaasib na ho, to usne jinnaat, insaano, parindon, aur hawa ko uske liye musakhkhar (taabey) kar diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That no one from the creatures speaks about anything except when the wind comes and informs you." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "Ke koi bhi makhlooq kuch bhi baat na kare magar hawa aayegi aur tumhein khabar de degi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] In English, the translation is: "He walks a distance of one month in one morning."
hi: "To woh aik hi subah mein aik mahine ka safar tay karte." Sahih.

e: [AI] "From him, Adh-Dhahabi, the summary."
hi: Unse, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] Abdullah said, "The last of the prophets of the Children of Israel was Zachariah, son of Adnan bin Muslim, and he was from the descendants of Jacob. He said, 'My kingdom will be inherited by me, and prophethood will be inherited from the family of Jacob.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, unhone kaha: "Bani Isra'il ke aakhri Nabi Zakariya bin Adan bin Muslim thay, aur woh Yaqub (AS) ki aulaad mein se the." Unhone kaha: "Mera mulk mera waaris banega, aur Aal-e-Yaqub se Nubuwwat waaris banegi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Zakariya was a carpenter."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zakariya (AS) najjar (badhai) thay."

e:
[AI] "O Lord, indeed my bones have weakened and my head has turned gray with age, and I have never been deprived in my supplication to You, O Lord. And indeed, I fear my kinsmen after me, and my wife has been barren, so grant me from Yourself an heir who will inherit from me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing to You."

(And the angels called to him) while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allah and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous." He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?" [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'"

(Reference: Quran 19:4-9)
hi: "Aye Rab, meri haddiyaan kamzor ho gayi hain, aur mera sar boodhepe se safed ho gaya hai, aur main aapse dua karke kabhi mehroom nahi raha, Aye Rab, aur beshak main apne peechhe apne rishtedaaron se darta hoon, aur woh (mere) qareebi log hain, aur meri biwi baanjh hai, isliye mujhe apne paas se aik waaris ata kar jo mera aur mere Nubuwwat ka waaris ho, aur Aal-e-Yaqub ki Nubuwwat ka waaris ho, aur usse, Aye Rab, apni raza par chalne wala bana." Unka farmaan "mujhe apne paas se aik paak aulaad de" iske manaazil bataata hai ke "beshak tu dua sunne wala hai." Aur unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, mujhe akela na chhod, aur tu sabse behtareen waaris hai." To farishton ne unhein pukaara, aur woh Jibra'il (AS) the, jabke woh mehraab mein khade namaz padh rahe the: "Allah tumhein aik larke ki khush-khabri deta hai jiska naam Yahya hoga, humne isse pehle iska koi hum-naam nahi banaaya," iske pehle kisi ka yeh naam nahi rakha gaya, "Yahya," aur farishton ne kaha: "Beshak Allah tumhein Yahya ki khush-khabri deta hai, Allah ki taraf se aik kalima (Isa) ki tasdeeq karne wala, Isa (AS) ki tasdeeq karega, aur 'Hasoor' (bhalaai wala, apni khwaahishon par qaaboo rakhne wala)," aur "Hasoor" woh hai jo auraton ki khwaahish nahi rakhta. Jab unhone yeh awaaz suni, to shaitan unke paas aaya aur unse kaha: "Aye Zakariya, jo awaaz tumne suni woh Allah ki taraf se nahi, balke shaitan ki taraf se hai jisne tumhara mazaaq udaaya, aur agar yeh Allah ki taraf se hoti to woh isse tumhari taraf wahi karta jaise woh aur maamlaat tumhari taraf wahi karta hai." To unhein wahin shak hua aur unhone kaha: "Mujhe kaise larka ho sakta hai," ya'ni: "Yeh kahan se ho sakta hai jabke mujhe boodhaapa aa chuka hai aur meri biwi baanjh hai?" Farmaya: "Isi tarah, Allah jo chaahe karta hai, aur maine tumhein isse pehle paida kiya jab tum kuch bhi na thay."

e: [AI] "O Lord, grant me from Your presence a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication." [Quran 3:38] "Indeed, my bones have weakened, and my head has become white with age." [Quran 19:4] Then the verses continue saying, "He said, 'My Lord, how will I have a boy while my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?'" [Quran 19:9] He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'" [Quran 19:9] He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound." So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon. [Quran 19:11] "And [mention, O Muhammad], as Abraham said to his father Azar, "Take the Book with determination." And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous." [Quran 19:15] The summary does not mention the last part of the verse.
hi: "{Aye Rab, mujhe apne paas se aik paak aulaad de, beshak tu dua sunne wala hai}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 38) "{Beshak meri haddiyaan kamzor ho gayi hain aur mera sar boodhepe se safed ho gaya hai}" (Surah Maryam 4) ayaton tak, phir unhone kaha: "{Mujhe kaise larka ho sakta hai jabke meri biwi baanjh hai aur main boodhepe ki hadd ko pahunch chuka hoon}" (Surah Maryam 9). Farmaya: "Isi tarah tumhare Rab ne farmaya hai, yeh mere liye aasaan hai, aur maine tumhein isse pehle paida kiya jab tum kuch bhi na thay." Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, mere liye koi nishaani muqarrar kar." Farmaya: "Tumhari nishaani yeh hai ke tum teen raaton tak logon se baat na kar sakoge, jabke tum theek-thaak (sehat-mand) rahoge." Unhone kaha: to unki zubaan par teen din aur raaton ki muhr lag gayi, jabke woh sehat-mand the aur baat nahi kar pa rahe the, "{To woh mehraab se apni qaum ke saamne nikle aur unhein ishaare se hukum diya ke subah-shaam Allah ki tasbeeh karo}" (Surah Maryam 11), "Aye Yahya, Kitaab ko mazbooti se pakdo," aur humne unhein bachpan mein hi hukumat (samajh) di ayaton se lekar "{use zinda uthaaya jayega}" (Surah Maryam 15) tak. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Zakariya and Imran both married two sisters, so Zakariya's wife was the mother of Yahya (John), and Imran's wife was the mother of Maryam (Mary). However, Imran passed away while Maryam was still in her mother's womb. People were amazed that Allah prevented Maryam from giving birth until she despaired. They belonged to a family that Allah highly regarded in a specific place." As for the mention of Al-Dhahabi not summarizing this, there is no information available for that.
hi: "Zakariya (AS) aur Imran ne do behnon se nikah kiya, to Yahya (AS) ki maa Zakariya (AS) ke nikah mein thin, aur Maryam (AS) ki maa Imran ke nikah mein thin, phir Imran faut ho gaye jabke Maryam (AS) ki maa Maryam (AS) se haamila thin aur woh unke pet mein jann (bhroon) thin, aur unka khayal hai ke Allah ne unse aulaad rok li thi yahan tak ke woh mayoos ho gayi thin, aur woh Allah ke nazdeek aik khaas martabe wale ghar wale thay." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , from Ali ibn Zaid, from Yusuf ibn Mihran, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ  who said, "There is no human being except that they have made a mistake or have thought about committing a sin or have committed it, except for Yahya ibn Zakariya who did not think about a sin nor commit it." The chain of narration is good.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aur Ali bin Zaid se, unhone Yusuf bin Mihran se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi Aadmi ki aulaad aisi nahi jisne khataa na ki ho, ya kisi khataa ka iraada na kiya ho, ya use kiya na ho, siwaye Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ke, unhone kisi khataa ka iraada nahi kiya aur na hi use kiya." Sanad achhi hai.

e: [AI] "Yahya, the son of Zakaria, was a noble and chaste man. He would not come near women nor desire them. He was a young man with a handsome face and appearance, his wings were delicate, his hair was short, his fingers were long, and he had a prominent nose and thick eyebrows. His voice was gentle, he worshipped Allah abundantly, and he was strong in his obedience to God."
hi: "Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) sardaar aur 'Hasoor' (khwaahishon par qaaboo rakhne wale) thay, woh auraton ke qareeb nahi jaate the na unki khwaahish rakhte the, aur woh khoobsurat chehre aur soorat wale jawaan thay, narm-mizaaj, kam baalon wale, chhoti ungliyon wale, lambi naak wale, ghani bhaunwon wale, narm awaaz wale, bohot zyada ibaadat karne wale, aur Allah ki itaa'at mein mazboot thay."

e:
Jesus, the son of Mary, and John, the son of Zachariah, were sent with twelve thousand disciples to teach people. It is said that they prohibited the marriage of the niece of their king, ˹Herodias˺, who was fond of her and intended to marry her. She had a daily request which he fulfilled for her. When her mother learned of this, she advised her daughter ˹Herodias˺ to ask King ˹Herod˺ for a favor when she visited him. She said, "Ask him to have John, the son of Zachariah, beheaded for me." When she went in to see King ˹Herod˺, he asked her what she wanted, and she said that she wanted John, the son of Zachariah to be beheaded. However, King ˹Herod˺ asked her to request something else, but she that she did not want anything other than this. 
When she persisted, the king called for John, the son of Zachariah, and ordered him to be beheaded. A drop of his blood fell on the ground, and it continued to boil until Allah sent a Nebuchadnezzar upon them. An old man from the Children of Israel guided him to that blood, and God placed in his heart the idea that they should be killed in revenge for that blood. As a result, seventy thousand of them were killed in a single day, and then the violence ceased.
hi: Isa bin Maryam (AS) aur Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ko baarah hazaar (12,000) haawariyon (shaagirdon) ke sath bheja gaya, jo logon ko sikhaate the. Unhone kaha: aur jin cheezon se woh unhein mana karte the unme bhatije ki beti se nikah shaamil tha. Unhone kaha: aur unke baadshaah ki aik bhatiji thi jo usse pasand thi, woh usse nikah karna chahta tha, uski har din koi na koi zaroorat hoti jise woh poora karta, jab yeh baat uski maa tak pahunchi, to unhone usse kaha: "Jab tum baadshaah ke paas jao aur woh tumhari zaroorat pooche, to kehna: meri zaroorat yeh hai ke aap Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ko qatl kar dein." Jab woh uske paas gayi to usne uski zaroorat poochi, usne kaha: "Meri zaroorat yeh hai ke aap Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ko qatl karein." Usne kaha: "Mujhse iske ilawa kuch aur maango." Usne kaha: "Main aapse iske siwa kuch nahi maangti." Unhone kaha: jab usne (nikah karne wale ne) uski baat na maani, to usne Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ko bulaaya, aik thaal mangwaayi, aur unhein shaheed kar diya, to unke khoon ka aik qatra zameen par gira aur woh khaulta hi raha yahan tak ke Allah ne unpar Bukht-Nassar ko bheja. To Bani Isra'il ki aik boodhi aurat uske paas aayi aur usse us khoon ke baare mein bataaya, to Allah ne uske dil mein daala ke woh us khoon ke badle unme se logon ko qatl kare jab tak woh khaulna band na ho, to usne unme se sattar hazaar (70,000) logon ko aik hi umr ke logon mein se qatl kiya yahan tak ke woh (khoon) tham gaya.

e: [AI] From Abu Nuaim.
hi: Abu Nu'aim se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am the closest of all people to Jesus son of Mary in this world and the Hereafter. The prophets are brothers, their mothers are different but their religion is one. There is no prophet between me and Jesus son of Mary."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main duniya aur Aakhirat mein Isa bin Maryam (AS) se sabse zyada qareeb hoon, Ambiya sautele bhai hain, unki maayen mukhtalif hain lekin unka deen aik hai, aur mere aur Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke darmiyan koi Nabi nahi."

e: [AI] "Hannah gave birth to Mary and Mary gave birth to Jesus." The golden (scholar) remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Hannah ne Maryam (AS) ko janam diya, aur Maryam (AS) ne Isa (AS) ko janam diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Jesus, the son of Mary, was born on the day of Ashura." Its reference is weak.
hi: "Isa bin Maryam (AS) Ashura ke din paida huay." Sanad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] Abdullah said, "Mary went out to the side of the mihrab while she was menstruating. When she became clean, she was with a man, and it was said, 'So We sent to her Our Angel and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.' (Quran 19:17). And he was Gabriel, peace be upon him. So she became frightened of him and said, 'Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you if you should be fearing of Allah.' (Quran 19:18) He said, 'I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy.' (Quran 19:19) And the sign is that she will come wearing her veil and he will take hold of her and blow into her garment, and it will be creased. And she will conceive and bring forth a child, and she will come to her people, carrying him. They said, 'O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented. O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste.' (Quran 19:27-28) So she pointed to him. They said, 'How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?' (Quran 19:29) [Jesus] said, 'Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet. And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive. And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant. And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive.' (Quran 19:30-33)
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, unhone kaha: Maryam (AS) mehraab ke aik taraf haiz ki wajah se nikli thin, jab woh paak huin to unhone aik aadmi ko apne saath paaya, aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{To humne unki taraf apni Rooh (Jibra'il) ko bheja, to woh unke saamne aik poore insaan ki soorat mein zaahir huay}" (Surah Maryam 17), aur woh Jibra'il (AS) the, to woh unse dahal gayin aur kaha: "{Main Rahman se teri panaah maangti hoon agar tu (Allah se) darta hai}" (Surah Maryam 18). Unhone kaha: "{Main to sirf tere Rab ka Rasool hoon taake main tujhe aik paak larka ata karoon}" (Surah Maryam 19) ayat. To woh nikli jabke unpar unki chaadar thi, unhone unki aasteen pakadi, phir unke qamees ke gareban mein phoonka, jo unke aage se khula tha, to woh phoonk unke seene mein dakhil hui, to woh haamila ho gayin. Aik raat unki behn, Zakariya (AS) ki biwi, unse milne aayi, jab unhone unke liye darwaaza khola, to unhone unhein gale lagaaya, to Zakariya (AS) ki biwi ne kaha: "Aye Maryam, kya tumhein pata hai ke main haamila hoon?" Maryam (AS) ne bhi kaha: "Kya tumhein pata hai ke main bhi haamila hoon?" To Zakariya (AS) ki biwi ne kaha: "To maine paaya ke jo mere pet mein hai woh us cheez ko sajda kar raha hai jo tumhare pet mein hai," aur yehi hai Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan: "{Allah ki taraf se aik kalima ki tasdeeq karne wala}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 39). To Zakariya (AS) ki biwi ne Yahya (AS) ko janam diya, aur jab Maryam (AS) ki wilaadat ka waqt aaya, to woh mehraab ke aik taraf nikli, to unhein dard-e-zeh aik khajoor ke tane ki taraf le gaya, unhone logon se sharmate huay kaha: "{Kaash main isse pehle mar jaati aur bilkul bhula di gayi hoti}" (Surah Maryam 23). To Jibra'il (AS) ne unhein neeche se pukaara: "{Gham mat karo, tumhare Rab ne tumhare neeche aik chashma jaari kar diya hai, aur khajoor ke tane ko apni taraf hilaao, tumpar taaza pakki khajoor girengi}" (Surah Maryam 25). To unhone use hilaaya, to unke liye mehraab mein aik nehar jaari ho gayi, aur 'sari' nehar ko kehte hain, to khajoor ka tana taaza pakki khajoorein girane laga. Jab unhone use janam diya, to shaitan gaya aur Bani Isra'il ko bataaya ke Maryam (AS) ne bacha janam diya hai, jab unhone unhein baat karne ka kaha, to unhone Isa (AS) ki taraf ishara kiya, to Isa (AS) ne baat ki aur kaha: "Main Allah ka banda hoon, usne mujhe Kitaab di aur mujhe Nabi banaaya, aur mujhe barkat wala banaaya." Jab Isa (AS) paida huay, to zameen mein koi bhi but (jiski Allah ke siwa parastish ki jaati thi) nahi bacha jo unke chehre ki taraf sajda-rez na ho gaya ho.

e: [AI] The delegation from Najran came to the Prophet ﷺ  and asked him, "What do you say about Jesus, the son of Mary?" He replied, "He is the spirit of Allah and His word, and a servant and Messenger of Allah." They said to him, "Do you mind if we curse him as he is not in that way?" He asked them, "Is that what you prefer?" They answered, "Yes." He said, "If you wish," and then the Prophet ﷺ  gathered his sons, Al-Hasan and Al-Hussein, and said to the delegation leader, "Do not curse this man. By Allah, if you do, one of the two groups (either Najran or the Muslims) will be destroyed." They came and said to him, "O Abul-Qasim, our fools wanted to curse you, but we love it if you pardon us." He replied, "I have already pardoned you." Then he said, "Indeed, the punishment has overshadowed Najran."
hi: Najran ka wafd Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur poocha: "Aap Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke baare mein kya kehte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh Allah ki Rooh, uska Kalima, Allah ka banda, aur uska Rasool hain." Unhone unse kaha: "Kya aap chahte hain ke hum aapke sath mubahala (aapas mein la'nat) karein, ke yeh baat aisi nahi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya yeh tumhein zyada pasand hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To jab tum chaaho." To Nabi (SAW) aaye aur apni aulaad, Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA), ko jama kiya, to unke sardaar ne kaha: "Is aadmi se mubahala mat karo, Allah ki qasam, agar tumne unse mubahala kiya to dono giroh mein se aik zameen mein dhaans jaayega." To woh (wafd) aaye aur kaha: "Aye Abul-Qasim, humare bewaqoofon ne hi aapse mubahala karna chaaha, aur hum chahte hain ke aap humein maaf kar dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein maaf kar diya." Phir farmaya: "Beshak azaab Najran par saaya kar chuka tha."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Every child of Adam is afflicted with a touch from Satan at the time of birth, except for Maryam and her son. Verily, when his mother gave birth to him (i.e. Maryam), she said: 'I seek refuge for her and her offspring in You (Allah) from Satan, the accursed.' So Allah protected her and accepted her with an excellent acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner. And her mother died, so her aunt took care of her and was the mother of Yahya."
