hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadam (AS) ki har aulaad ko shaitan chhoo leta hai, wahi chubhan, aur usi wajah se har paida honay wala chillaate huay paida hota hai, siwaye Maryam (AS) aur unke bete ke, kyunke unki maa (Maryam ki naani) ne jab unhein janam diya, unhone kaha: 'Main isse aur iski aulaad ko mardood shaitan se teri panaah mein deti hoon,' to unke liye aik parda daal diya gaya, to shaitan usme chubh gaya lekin usme dakhil na ho saka, to unke Rab ne unhein aik achhi qubooliyat ke sath qubool kiya aur unhein achhe andaaz mein parwaan chadhaaya, aur unki maa faut ho gayin, to unhein unki khaala, Yahya (AS) ki maa, ne apne paas rakh liya."

e: [AI] The translation of the given text into English is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "They will bring Jesus for intercession and he will say, ‘Do you know of anyone who is the Word of Allah and His Spirit and who can cure the blind and the leper and bring the dead to life, besides me?' They will reply, ‘No.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya, phir woh log Isa (AS) ke paas shafa'at ke liye aayenge, to woh kahenge: "Kya tum kisi aise shakhs ko jaante ho jo Allah ka Kalima aur uski Rooh ho, aur andhon aur koda-zada (jazaam) ko theek kare, aur murdon ko zinda kare, mere ilawa?" To woh kahenge: "Nahi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best women of the world are Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, Maryam bint Imran, and Asiyah bint Muzahim, the wife of Pharaoh."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jahaan walon ki afzal auraten Khadijah bint Khuwailid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, Maryam bint Imran, aur Aasiya bint Muzahim, Firaun ki biwi, hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Only three individuals spoke in the cradle: Jesus, son of Mary, and the Witness of Joseph, and the Companion of Jurayj, and the son of Mashita, daughter of Pharaoh."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Godh mein sirf teen logon ne baat ki - Isa bin Maryam (AS), aur Yusuf (AS) ke gawaah, aur Juraij ke saathi, aur Firaun ki beti ke baal banaane wali ka beta."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Jesus Christ, son of Mary, will descend as a just ruler and an upright Imam. He will break the cross, kill the pigs, and abolish the Jizyah. He will perform Hajj or Umrah, or both, and will greet my tomb.' Abu Huraira said, 'O children of my brother, if you see him, then say that Abu Huraira sends his greetings to you.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isa bin Maryam (AS) zaroor aik insaaf-pasand hakam aur adal karne wale imam ki hesiyat se utrenge, aur zaroor Hajj ya Umrah ke iraade se, ya dono ki niyat se, aik raasta tay karenge, aur zaroor meri qabr par aakar mujhe salaam karenge, aur main unhein zaroor jawaab dunga." Abu Hurairah (RA) kehte the: "Aye mere bhatijo, agar tum unhein dekho, to kehna: Abu Hurairah tumhein salaam kehta hai."

e: [AI] That the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the spirit of Allah, Jesus son of Mary, will descend among you. When you see him, recognize him as a man with a reddish and white complexion, wearing two garments that are pressed. It will appear as if water is dripping from his head, even though he does not become wet. He will break the cross, kill the swine, abolish the jizyah tax, and call people to Islam. Allah will destroy the false messiah during his time, and trust will be placed on the people of the earth to the extent that the lion will graze with camels and the tiger with cows, and the wolf will live peacefully with sheep. Children will play with snakes and they will not harm them. He will remain among you for forty years and then pass away, and the Muslims will offer prayers upon him."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ki Rooh, Isa bin Maryam (AS), tum mein utarne wale hain, jab tum unhein dekho to unhein pehchaan lena - aik darmiyani qad ke, surkhi maayil safed rangat wale aadmi, unpar do halke zafraani (peele) kapde honge, goya unke sar se paani tapak raha ho jabke unhein koi geelapan nahi lagega, to woh sleeb (cross) todenge, sua'r (khinzeer) ko qatl karenge, jizya (mahsool) khatam karenge, aur logon ko Islam ki taraf bulaayenge, to Allah unke zamane mein Maseeh Dajjal ko halaak karega, aur zameen walon par itni aman qaayam hogi ke sheron oont ke sath charenge, aur cheete gaayon ke sath, aur bhediye bakriyon ke sath, aur bachche saanpon ke sath khelenge, unhein koi nuqsaan na hoga, to woh chaalis (40) saal (zameen par) thehrenge, phir wafaat paayenge, aur Musalman unpar janaaza ki namaz padhenge."

e: [AI] "He passed away seven hours after noon, then he was brought back to life," Wahb said. "The Christians claim that Mary gave birth to Jesus 363 years and 66 days after the birth of Alexander. They also claim that the birth of John the Baptist was six months before the birth of Jesus. They claim that Mary was pregnant with Jesus for thirteen years, and that Jesus lived until he was 32 years old and Mary lived for six years after his ascension, so her entire lifespan was 56 years. Zakariah son of Barakhya, the father of Yahya son of Zakariah, they claim him to be 200 years old and Mary's mother was pregnant with Mary. When Mary was born, Zakariah took care of her after her mother died because her aunt, the sister of her mother, was with him. And the name of Mary's mother is Hana bint Faqoud bin Qeela."
hi: Ke Allah ne unhein saat ghantay din ke liye wafaat di, phir unhein zinda kiya. Wahb ne kaha: aur Nasaara (Christians) ka daawa hai ke Maryam (AS) ne Isa (AS) ko Sikandar (Alexander) ki paidaish se teen sau terasath (363) saal baad janam diya, aur unka daawa hai ke Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ki paidaish Isa (AS) ki paidaish se chhah mahine pehle hui, aur unka daawa hai ke Maryam (AS) Isa (AS) se terah (13) saal ki umr mein haamila huin, aur Isa (AS) battees (32) saal ki umr tak zinda rahe jab unhein uthaaya gaya, aur Maryam (AS) unke uthaaye jaane ke baad chhah (6) saal aur zinda rahin, to unki poori umr chhappan (56) saal thi, aur Zakariya bin Barkhiya, Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ke waalid, unka daawa hai ke do sau (200) saal ke thay jab Maryam (AS) ki maa Maryam (AS) se haamila thin, jab Maryam (AS) paida huin to Zakariya (AS) ne unki maa ki wafaat ke baad unki parvarish ki, kyunke unki khaala, unki maa ki behn, unke (Zakariya ke) nikah mein thin, aur Maryam (AS) ki maa ka naam Hannah bint Faqooz bin Qeel tha.

e: [AI] He said to a man sitting with him, while he was talking to his companions, "Come closer to me." So the man said to him, "May Allah keep you, I cannot ask you what those people have asked you." He said, "Come closer to me and I will tell you about the mentioned prophets in the book of Allah. I will tell you about Adam, he was a farmer. I will tell you about Noah, he was a carpenter. I will tell you about Idris, he was a tailor. I will tell you about Dawud, he was a metalworker. I will tell you about Musa, he was a shepherd. I will tell you about Ibrahim, he was a farmer. I will tell you about Salih, he was a merchant. I will tell you about Sulaiman, Allah granted him kingship and he used to fast six days in the beginning of the month, three days in the middle of the month, and three days at the end of the month. He had nine hundred horses and three hundred mules. And I will tell you about the son of the virgin, Isa, son of Maryam, that he would not save anything for the next day and he would say, 'The One who keeps me alive until tonight will also give me food tonight, and the One who feeds me tonight will also keep me alive tomorrow.' He used to worship Allah the entire night until morning, and he used to travel during the day. He used to fast the entire year and stand in prayer the entire night. And I will tell you about the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , that he used to tend to the sheep of his family with excellence. He used to fast, so we would say he does not break his fast, and he would break his fast, so we would say he does not fast. And we have never seen him not fasting for an entire month. He used to fast three days every month. He was the gentlest among people, with the best character and the most knowledge. And I inform you about Hawwa (Eve) that she used to weave poetry and turn it around with her hand, and she used to clothe herself and her children. And Maryam, the daughter of 'Imran, used to do that as well."
hi: Unhone kisi aadmi se kaha jo unke paas baitha tha jabke woh apne sahaba se baat kar rahe the: "Mere qareeb aa jao." To us aadmi ne kaha: "Allah aapko zinda rakhe, Allah ki qasam, mujhe aapse aisa sawaal karna nahi aata jaisa in logon ne kiya." To unhone kaha: "Mere qareeb aa jao, main tumhein Allah ki Kitaab mein zikr kiye gaye Ambiya ke baare mein bataata hoon - main tumhein Aadam (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh aik kisaan (khaiti karne wale) banda thay, aur main tumhein Nuh (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh aik badhai banda thay, aur main tumhein Idris (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh aik darzi banda thay, aur main tumhein Dawud (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh aik zirah (kavach) banaane wale banda thay, aur main tumhein Musa (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh aik charwaaha banda thay, aur main tumhein Ibrahim (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh aik kisaan banda thay, aur main tumhein Saleh (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh aik tijaarat karne wale banda thay, aur main tumhein Sulaiman (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh aik banda thay jise Allah ne baadshaahat di, aur woh mahine ki shuruaat mein chhah (6) din, darmiyan mein teen (3) din, aur aakhir mein teen (3) din roze rakhte the, aur unki nau sau (900) khaas (biwiyaan) aur teen sau (300) (laundiyaan) thin, aur main tumhein Batool (paakeeza) Kanwaari ke bete Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh kal ke liye kuch bhi chhupa kar nahi rakhte the, aur kehte the: 'Jisne mujhe subah khilaaya woh mujhe shaam ko khilaayega, aur jisne mujhe shaam khilaaya woh mujhe subah khilaayega,' woh poori raat Allah ki ibaadat karte, subah tak namaz padhte, aur din mein safar karte, aur poori zindagi roze rakhte aur poori raat qiyaam karte, aur main tumhein chune huay Nabi (SAW) ke baare mein bataata hoon, ke woh Ajyaad mein apne ghar walon ki bakriyaan charaate the, aur woh roza rakhte, to hum kehte woh iftaar nahi karenge, aur iftaar karte to hum kehte woh roza nahi rakhenge, aur hum unhein kabhi lagataar roze rakhte nahi dekhte, aur woh har mahine teen (3) din roza rakhte, aur woh sabse narm-mizaaj, sabse achhi khabar dene wale, aur sabse zyada ilm wale insaan thay, aur main tumhein Hawwa ke baare mein bataata hoon, woh oon katti thin aur use apne haath se badalti thin, isse apne aur apni aulaad ke liye kapde banaati thin, aur Maryam bint Imran (AS) bhi aisa hi karti thin."

e:
[AI] I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was in the mosque, and I seized the opportunity to have a private conversation with him. He said to me, "O Abu Dharr, the mosque has a greeting." I asked him, "What is its greeting, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Two units of prayer." So, I performed the two units of prayer, then he turned towards me and I said, "O Messenger of Allah, you have commanded me to pray, so what is prayer?" He said, "It is a prescribed act of worship. Whoever wishes may perform it in lesser or greater quantity." I asked him, "O Messenger of Allah, which actions are most beloved to Allah?" He said, "Belief in Allah." Then, he mentioned the hadith until he said, "O Messenger of Allah, how many prophets are there?" He said, "One hundred and twenty-four thousand prophets." I asked, "How many of them are messengers?" He said, "Three hundred and thirteen." And he mentioned the rest of the hadith.

Note: The accuracy of the translation has been maintained, including the mention of the author's opinion at the end.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil hua jabke woh masjid mein thay, maine unki khilwat (tanhaai) ka faida uthaaya, to unhone mujhse farmaya: "Aye Abu Dharr, masjid ka bhi aik tohfa (tahiyya) hota hai." Maine kaha: "Uska tohfa kya hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do rak'atein." To maine woh padhi, phir aap (SAW) meri taraf mutawajjeh huay, to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne mujhe namaz ka hukum diya, to namaz kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Achhi cheez rakhi gayi hai, jo chaahe kam kare aur jo chaahe zyada kare." Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ko sabse zyada kaunsa amal pasand hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah par imaan." Phir hadith zikr ki yahan tak ke maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Nabi kitne hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik lakh chauwis hazaar (124,000) Nabi." Maine poocha: "Unme se Rusul kitne hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teen sau terah (313)." Aur baaqi hadith zikr ki. As-Sa'di mo'tabar (thiqa) nahi hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sent after eight thousand prophets, among them four thousand from the Children of Israel: Ibrahim, Wazid, and Ahyan.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) aath hazaar (8,000) Ambiya ke baad bheje gaye, jinme se chaar hazaar (4,000) Bani Isra'il mein se the." Ibrahim aur Yazid kamzor hain.

e: [AI] The Prophet, peace be upon him, said, "I am the last of a thousand prophets, or even more." It is a weak narration.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main hazaar (1,000) ya usse zyada Nabiyon ka khaatam (aakhri) hoon." Mujaalid kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "He said, 'Indeed, there were seventy prophets who traveled the path of righteousness through the Fajj Al-Rawha' and performed Hajj wearing garments made of wool. And indeed, seventy prophets prayed in the Mosque of Khayf.'" Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Fajj Ar-Rawha ke raaste se sattar (70) Nabi Hajj karne wale, oon ke kapde pehne huay, guzre hain, aur Masjid-e-Khaif mein sattar (70) Nabiyon ne namaz padhi hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Among my brothers in the line of Prophets, there were eight thousand prophets. Then came Isa (Jesus), the son of Maryam (Mary), and after him, it is me." This is its chain of narrators, and it is authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhse pehle mere Ambiya bhaiyon mein se aath hazaar (8,000) Nabi guzar chuke, phir Isa bin Maryam (AS) aaye, phir main unke baad aaya." Iski sanad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet peace be upon him arrived in Medina and the Jews say, "Indeed, this world is only for seven thousand years." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah tashreef laaye jabke Yahoodi keh rahe the: "Yeh duniya sirf saat hazaar (7,000) saal ki hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "The age of Adam was one thousand years." Ibn Abbas said, "Between Adam and Noah there were one thousand years, between Noah and Abraham there were one thousand years, between Abraham and Moses there were seven hundred years, between Moses and Jesus there were five hundred years, and between Jesus and Muhammad ﷺ there were six hundred years."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadam (AS) ki umr hazaar (1,000) saal thi." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur Aadam (AS) aur Nuh (AS) ke darmiyan hazaar (1,000) saal ka faasla tha, aur Nuh (AS) aur Ibrahim (AS) ke darmiyan hazaar (1,000) saal, aur Ibrahim (AS) aur Musa (AS) ke darmiyan saat sau (700) saal, aur Musa (AS) aur Isa (AS) ke darmiyan paanch sau (500) saal, aur Isa (AS) aur Muhammad (SAW) ke darmiyan chhah sau (600) saal ka faasla tha."

e: [AI] "To his people, I extinguish the fire of discord from you," Khalid said. Umarah bin Ziyad, a man from his people, said to him, "By Allah, Khalid, you have never spoken to us except with the truth. What is your concern with the fire of discord claiming that you can extinguish it?" Khalid departed and Umarah bin Ziyad went with him, along with thirty men from his people, until they reached it. It was coming out of a split in a mountain from a region called Harrah Ashja.' Khalid drew a line for them and made them sit in it. Then he said, "If I am too slow for you, do not call me by my name." The fire came out as if they were light-colored camels following one another. Khalid faced it and struck it with his staff, saying, "Disappear, disappear, disappear, every guidance claimed by the son of Ra`iya Al-Mi'zzi." Khalid claimed that he would not leave it until the fire had gone out. He held it by his hand until he entered it with the fire. Then he slowed down with them. Umarah bin Ziyad said, "By Allah, if your leader was still alive, he would have come out to you later." They said, "Call him by his name." They said, "Indeed, he has forbidden us from calling him by his name." "Call him by his name," they said. So he came out to them, holding his head, and said, "Did I not forbid you from calling me by my name? By Allah, you killed me. Bury me. When the red camels pass by you, there will be a blind donkey. Kick it, for you will find me alive." So they buried him. When the red camels passed by them, there was a blind donkey, so they dug him up. Umarah bin Ziyad said, "Don't tell Mu'dhar that we dug up our dead. By Allah, we will never dig him up again." He informed them that his wife had two scrolls. If something difficult comes upon you, look at them, for you will find what you are asking about. He said, "No menstrual blood will touch them." When they returned to his wife, they asked her about them, and she brought them out while she was menstruating. He took whatever knowledge was in them and said, "Abu Yunus said that Samaak bin Harb was asked about him (Khalid). He said, 'That is a Prophet whom his people abandoned.'" Abu Yunus said that Samaak bin Harb said, "When the son of Khalid bin Sinan came to the Prophet, he said, 'Welcome to the son of my cousin.'" Al-Hakim narrated this.
hi: Apni qaum se: "Main tumse Al-Hadthaan ki aag bujha dunga." Unhone kaha: to Umarah bin Ziyad ne, jo unki qaum ka aik aadmi tha, unse kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Aye Khalid, aapne humse kabhi haq ke siwa kuch nahi kaha, to Al-Hadthaan ki aag se aapka kya taalluq hai ke aap samajhte hain ke aap ise bujha denge?" Unhone kaha: to woh chal pade, aur Umarah bin Ziyad unke sath apni qaum ke tees (30) aadmiyon mein chale, yahan tak ke woh wahan pahunche jahan woh (aag) aik pahaad ki dararon se, aik hara jise Harrah Ashja' kaha jaata hai, se nikal rahi thi. Khalid ne unke liye aik lakeer khainchi aur unhein usme bithaaya, phir kaha: "Agar mujhe der ho jaaye, to mujhe naam se mat pukaarna." To woh (aag) surkhi maayil ghodon ki tarah aik doosre ke peechhe nikli. Unhone kaha: to Khalid usse saamne aaye aur apni chhadi se usse maara, keh rahe the: "Zaahir ho, zaahir ho, zaahir ho, har hidayat, Ibn Ra'iyat-ul-Mi'zi ka daawa hai ke main isse baahar nahi nikalunga jab tak mera daanton wala haath (mere haath mein) na ho," yahan tak ke woh usi (aag) ke sath dararon mein dakhil ho gaye. Unhone kaha: to unhein der ho gayi. Umarah bin Ziyad ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar tumhara saathi zinda hota to woh ab tak tumhare paas nikal aata." Unhone kaha: "Unhein naam se pukaaro." Unhone kaha: to unhone kaha: "Unhone humein mana kiya tha ke hum unhein naam se pukaarein," phir unhone unhein naam se pukaara. Unhone kaha: to woh unke paas nikle jabke unhone apna sar pakda hua tha, aur kaha: "Kya maine tumhein naam se pukaarne se mana nahi kiya tha? Allah ki qasam, tumne mujhe (waqt se pehle) maar diya, isliye mujhe dafan kar do, jab gadhe tumhare paas se guzrein aur unme aik dum-kata gadha ho, to mujhe khod kar nikaal lena, tum mujhe zinda paaoge." Unhone kaha: to unhone unhein dafan kar diya, phir gadhe unke paas se guzre jinme aik dum-kata gadha tha, to humne kaha: "Unhein khod kar nikaalo, unhone humein hukum diya tha ke hum unhein khodein." Umarah bin Ziyad ne kaha: "Mudhar mein yeh baat mashhoor na ho ke hum apne murdon ko khodte hain, Allah ki qasam, hum unhein kabhi nahi khodenge." Unhone kaha: aur unhone unhein bataya tha ke unki biwi ke saaman mein do lauhein hain, "jab tumhein koi maamla mushkil lage to unme dekho, tum apna jawaab paa loge," aur kaha: "Koi haiz waali unhein na chhuye." Unhone kaha: jab woh unki biwi ke paas laute, to unhone unse un lauhon ke baare mein poocha, unhone unhein nikaala jabke woh haiz mein thi. Unhone kaha: to unme jo bhi ilm tha woh chala gaya. Unhone kaha: Abu Yunus ne kaha: Simaak bin Harb ne kaha: Nabi (SAW) se unke baare mein poocha gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh aik Nabi thay jinhein unki qaum ne zaya kar diya." Aur Abu Yunus ne kaha: Simaak bin Harb ne kaha: Khalid bin Sinan ke bete Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khush-aamdeed, mere bhatije." Al-Hakim ne kaha.

e: [AI] From the companions of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, they said, "O Messenger of Allah, tell us about yourself." He said, "The prayer of my father Ibrahim, the good news of Isa, and my mother saw when she carried me, that a light came out from her that illuminated the castles of Syria."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba se, unhone kaha: Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein apne baare mein bataayen. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri waalid Ibrahim (AS) ki dua, aur Isa (AS) ki khush-khabri, aur meri maa ne dekha ke jab woh mujhse haamila thin, unse aik noor nikla jisne Sham (Syria) ke qile roshan kar diye, aur Busra Sham ki zameen mein hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet (pbuh) say, "I am, among the prophets, in the highest rank in the eyes of Allah, and Adam was created while I was the final prophet. I will inform you about the interpretation of this; it is the supplication of my father Ibrahim and the good news given to the people of Jesus, and also the dream of my mother who saw that a light came out of her that illuminated the palaces of Sham." He (the listener) said, "Yes."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Main Allah ke nazdeek Kitaab ke aaghaaz mein hi Nabiyon ka khaatam (aakhri) hoon, jabke Aadam (AS) abhi apni mitti mein padi hui thi, aur main tumhein iski ta'weel bataata hoon - meri waalid Ibrahim (AS) ki dua, Isa (AS) ki apni qaum ko khush-khabri, aur meri maa ka khwaab jismein unhone dekha ke unse aik noor nikla jisne Sham (Syria) ke mahal roshan kar diye." Unhone kaha: "Ji haan."

e: [AI] We, the sons of Abd al-Muttalib, arrived in Yemen during the winter journey. We settled near a group of Jewish people who invited me, a man from the people of the Zabur, and said, "O Abd al-Muttalib, may I have permission to look at your body where there is no shame?" So, I opened one of my sleeves, and he looked at it, then he looked at the other sleeve and said, "I bear witness that in one of your hands, there is kingship, and in the other, prophethood. And I see this among the Banu Zahrah. How is that?" I replied, "I do not know." He asked, "Do you have any lineage?" I said, "What is lineage?" He said, "A wife." I said, "As for today, no." He said, "When you return, marry among them." So, Abd al-Muttalib returned to Mecca and married Hala, the daughter of Wahb bin 'Abd Manaf. She bore him Hamza and Safiyyah. Abdullah bin 'Abd al-Muttalib married Amina, the daughter of Wahb. She bore the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. Quraysh said, when Abdullah married Amina, that Abdullah resembles his father, Ya'qub, and his brother is weak.
hi: Abdul Muttalib: hum Yemen sardiyon ke safar mein pahunche, hum Yahoodiyon ke aik aalim ke paas utre, to Zaboor walon mein se aik aadmi ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Abdul Muttalib, kya aap mujhe ijaazat dete hain ke main aapke jism ko dekhoon, jahan koi sharm ki baat na ho?" Unhone kaha: to unhone meri aik naak khol kar dekhi, phir doosri mein dekha, phir kaha: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke tumhare aik haath mein baadshaahat hai aur doosre mein Nubuwwat, aur main isse Banu Zuhrah mein dekh raha hoon, to yeh kaise hoga?" Maine kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata." Usne poocha: "Kya tumhari koi shaa'aat hai?" Maine poocha: "Shaa'aat kya hai?" Usne kaha: "Biwi." Maine kaha: "Aaj to nahi." Usne kaha: "Jab tum wapas jao, to unme se nikah karo." To Abdul Muttalib Makkah wapas gaye aur Halah bint Wahb bin Abd Manaf se nikah kiya, unhone unke liye Hamzah aur Safiyyah ko janam diya, aur Abdullah bin Abdul Muttalib ne Aaminah bint Wahb se nikah kiya, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko janam diya. To Quraish ne kaha jab Abdullah ne Aaminah se nikah kiya: "Abdullah apne baap ke naqsh-e-qadam par chala." Yaqub aur unke shaykh dono kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "Once, there was a Jewish man who lived in Makkah and engaged in trade there. On the night when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was born, he said in a gathering of Quraysh: 'O people of Quraysh, was a child born among you tonight?' They replied, 'By Allah, we do not know.' He said, 'Allah is the Greatest. If he is born to you, there is no harm. Look and remember what I am saying to you: The Prophet of this last Ummah was born this night. Between his shoulders, there is a sign that looks like parallel lines of hair, as if they are connected. It looks like a mark of a horse that does not suckle for two nights, because a jinn entered his mouth and prevented him from nursing. The people were left astounded by his words and speech. When they returned to their homes, they informed their families, saying, 'Surely Abdullah bin Abd al-Muttalib has been blessed with a boy, and they named him Muhammad.' The people gathered and said, 'Have you heard the story of the Jew? Has news of the birth of this boy reached you?' They then went to the Jew and informed him of the news. He said, 'Come with me so that I may see him.' They went with him until he entered upon Amina, and he said, 'Bring your child out to us.' She brought him out, and they uncovered his back, and he saw the mark. The Jew then fell unconscious. When he woke up, they said to him, 'What is wrong with you?' He said, 'By Allah, Prophethood has departed from the children of Israel. O people of Quraysh, you rejoice with him. By Allah, people will come from the east and the west, and his message will spread among them. On that day, there were people, including Hisham bin Al-Walid bin Al-Mughira, Musa'ab bin Abi 'Amr, 'Ubaydah bin Al-Harith bin Abd al-Muttalib, and 'Utba bin Rabiah, among others from the Quraysh, who were above the age of puberty."
hi: Aik Yahoodi Makkah mein rehta tha aur tijaarat karta tha, jab woh raat aayi jismein Rasulullah (SAW) paida huay, to usne Quraish ki aik majlis mein kaha: "Aye Quraish ke logo, kya aaj raat tum mein koi bacha paida hua?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, humein nahi pata." Usne kaha: "Allah sabse bada hai, agar yeh baat tum se chhut gayi, to koi baat nahi, dekho aur yaad rakho jo main tumhein kehta hoon - is raat is aakhri Ummat ke Nabi paida huay hain, unke dono kandhon ke darmiyan aik nishaan hai jisme lagataar baal hain, goya woh ghode ki gardan ke baal hon, woh do raatein doodh nahi peete, aur iski wajah yeh hai ke jinnaat mein se aik badmaash ne apni do ungliyan unke mun mein daal din, isse unhein doodh peene se roka." To log apni majlis se muta'ajjib hokar bikhar gaye unki baat aur khabar par ta'ajjub karte huay. Jab woh apne gharon pahunche, to unme se har aik ne apne ghar walon ko bataya, unhone kaha: "Abdullah bin Abdul Muttalib ke haan aik larka paida hua hai, unhone uska naam Muhammad rakha hai." To log mile aur kaha: "Kya tumne us Yahoodi ki baat suni, aur kya tumhein is larke ki paidaish ki khabar pahunchi?" To woh Yahoodi ke paas gaye aur usse khabar bataayi, usne kaha: "Mere sath chalo taake main use dekhoon." To woh nikle yahan tak ke usse Aaminah ke paas le gaye, usne kaha: "Apne bete ko humare paas nikalo." Unhone unhein nikaala aur uske liye unki peeth khol di, usne woh nishaan dekha, to Yahoodi behosh hokar gir gaya. Jab usse hosh aaya, to unhone kaha: "Afsos tumpar, tumhein kya hua?" Usne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Nubuwwat Bani Isra'il se chali gayi, aur tum khush ho gaye, Aye Quraish ke logo, khabardaar, Allah ki qasam, tumpar aisi zabardast pakad hogi jiski khabar mashriq-o-maghrib se nikalegi." Aur us waqt jin logon ko Yahoodi ne yeh baat kahi thi unme Hisham bin Al-Walid bin Al-Mughirah, Musaafir bin Abi Amr, Ubaidah bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib, aur Utbah bin Rabi'ah, jo balooghat se badi umr ke jawaan the, Banu Manaf aur doosre Quraish ke kuch logon mein shaamil thay.

e: [AI] He said, "O Messenger of Allah, do you descend to your house in Mecca?" He said, "Has anyone left for us any land or property?" And Aqeel inherited from Abu Talib and neither Ali nor Jafar have inherited him because they were both Muslims. "The two sheikhs used this hadith as evidence." It is narrated by them.
hi: Ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap Makkah mein apne ghar mein utrenge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya Aqeel ne humare liye koi zameen ya ghar chhoda hai?" Aur Aqeel ne Abu Talib ka waaris paaya tha, aur Ali (RA) aur Ja'far (RA) ne unka waarisan nahi paaya kyunke woh dono Musalman ho gaye the. Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ne is hadith se hujjat li hai. Dono ne ise nikala.

e: [AI] "A Bedouin asked the Prophet ﷺ  about fasting on Mondays. The Prophet ﷺ  replied, 'That is the day I was born and the day on which revelation was brought to me.' This hadith is considered authentic according to the conditions set by both Sheikh Al-Bukhari and Sheikh Muslim. They did not include it in their collections, but instead, Muslim cited a hadith from Shu'bah, as narrated by Qatadah, with this chain of narration, stating that fasting on the day of Arafah expiates sins of the previous year and the year to come, based on the conditions set by both Al-Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Aik badu ne Nabi (SAW) se Peer (Monday) ke roze ke baare mein poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh woh din hai jismein main paida hua, aur jismein mujh par (wahi) nazil hui." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala, sirf Muslim ne Shu'bah ki hadith, Qatadah se, isi sanad ke sath hujjat li hai: "Arafah ke din ka roza aik saal aur usse pehle ke gunahon ka kaffaara banta hai." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  was born in the Year of the Elephant.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) Haathi wale saal mein paida huay."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was born on the Day of the Elephant. Humaid ibn Rabee' Al-Jahani was the only one who mention this phrase in this narration, and it was not repeated by others.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) Haathi wale din paida huay." Humaid bin Ar-Rabi' is hadith mein isi lafz ke sath akele hain, aur unki kisi ne pairavi nahi ki.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was born on the twelfth night of the month of Rabi' al-Awwal."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Rabi-ul-Awwal ke mahine ki baarah (12) raatein guzarne ke baad paida huay."

e: [AI] "I and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  were both born in the Year of the Elephant, just like twin mothers." Ibn Ishaq said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was 20 years old in the Year of 'Ukaz."
hi: "Main aur Rasulullah (SAW) Haathi wale saal mein, jaise do hum-umr sathi, paida huay." Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) Ukaz ke saal mein bees (20) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] And he said, "Oh my son, I have truly become distressed for you with a distress that I have never experienced for anything before. By Allah, I will never send you on an errand again, and you will never part from me after this."
hi: Aur unhone kaha: "Aye mere bete, mujhe tumhare liye aisi bechaini hui jaisi maine kabhi kisi cheez ke liye nahi hui, Allah ki qasam, main tumhein kabhi kisi zaroorat mein nahi bhejunga, aur tum iske baad kabhi mujhse juda nahi hoge."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named himself with various names, some of which we have memorized and some we have forgotten. He said, "I am Muhammad and I am Ahmad, I am Al-Muqaffa and Al-Hashir, I am the Prophet of Repentance and the Prophet of Battle."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein apne kayi naam bataaye, unme se kuch humein yaad hain aur kuch bhool gaye, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Muhammad hoon, aur main Ahmad hoon, aur Al-Muqaffa, aur Al-Haashir, aur Nabi-ut-Tauba, aur Al-Malhama."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "I am Muhammad, Ahmad, the one who is called upon, the gatherer of people, the final seal, and the ultimate successor."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Main Muhammad, Ahmad, Al-Muqaffa, Al-Haashir, Al-Khaatam, aur Al-Aaqib hoon."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I am the father of Qasim; Allah gives and I divide.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Abul-Qasim hoon, Allah ata karta hai aur main taqseem karta hoon."

e: [AI] When Ibrahim, the son of the Prophet ﷺ, was born, Jibrail came to him and said, "Peace be upon you, O Aba Ibrahim." At this point, Al-Dhahabi stopped summarizing.
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ke bete Ibrahim paida huay, to Jibra'il (AS) unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Aapko salaam ho, Aye Abu Ibrahim." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  ascended the pulpit and praised and glorified Allah. Then he asked, "Who am I?" We replied, "You are the Messenger of Allah." He said, "Yes, but who am I?" We said, "You are Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Abdul-Muttalib ibn Hashim ibn Abd Manaf." He said, "I am the master of the children of Adam and I do not boast."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mimbar par chadhe, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir poocha: "Main kaun hoon?" Humne kaha: "Allah ke Rasool." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, lekin main kaun hoon?" Humne kaha: "Aap Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim bin Abd Manaf hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Aadam (AS) ki aulaad ka sardaar hoon, aur isme koi fakhr nahi."

e: [AI] Rabeebah, the companion of the Prophet ﷺ, told me, and I said to her, "Tell me about the Prophet ﷺ, who was he from?" She said, "He was from the descendants of Mudar, the son of Nadr ibn Kinanah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki paali hui beti (rabeebah) Zainab ne mujhse hadith bayan ki, maine unse poocha: "Mujhe bataayen Nabi (SAW) kis se the, kya woh Mudhar se the?" Unhone kaha: "Woh Mudhar se hi the, An-Nadr bin Kinanah ki aulaad se."

e: [AI] "He mentioned the birth of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) and said, 'His father and mother passed away during his delivery.'"
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ki paidaish ka zikr kiya aur kaha: "Unke waalid faut ho gaye jabke unki waalida unse haamila thin."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  visited the grave of his mother in a thousand veils, and he was seen crying more than any other day."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne apni maa ki qabr ki ziyarat ki, hazaar (1,000) chehre-dhaanpe huay logon ke sath, aur us din se zyada koi bhi rota huay nahi dekha gaya."

e: [AI] I heard Ka'ab ibn Malik say, "When I greeted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he replied while his face was illuminating. The face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to shine like a piece of the moon, and this was recognisable in him."
hi: Maine Ka'b bin Malik ko kehte suna: "Jab maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko salaam kiya, to aap (SAW) ne jawaab diya jabke unka chehra chamak raha tha, aur Rasulullah (SAW) jab khush hote to unka chehra chamak uthta, goya woh chaand ka tukda ho, aur yeh unme (khaas) pehchaana jaata tha."

e: "The Prophet ﷺ was not tall nor was he short, his hands and feet were thick, his head was large, he was big-boned, he had a long Masrubah (the line of hair from the chest to the navel), and whenever he walked, he leaned forward as if he was going down a decline. I have not seen anyone before him nor after him that resembled him ﷺ." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3637)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) na to lambe the na chhote, mote haathon aur pairon wale, bade sar aur daadhi wale, surkhi maayil rangat wale, mazboot jodon wale, lambi seene-se-naaf tak ki lakeer wale, jab chalte to jhukte huay chalte, goya woh dhalaan se utar rahe hon, na maine unse pehle na unke baad koi unke jaisa dekha (SAW)."

e: [AI] The translation of the given statement is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had deep-set eyes and full lips." The response to the question "What are deep-set eyes?" was "O Adam, they are a sign of wisdom."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) badi-badi aankhon wale, chaude mun wale thay." Maine poocha: "Badi aankh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aadam bin Hutham (ke jaisi)."

e: "The two shins of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were thin, and he would not laugh except as a smile, and whenever I looked at him I would say: "He put kohl on his eyes,' but he ﷺ did not use kohl." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3645)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) sirf muskuraahat ke sath hansty the, aur unki pindliyon mein patlaapan tha," aur jab main unhein dekhta to kehta: "Aankh mein surma laga hai," jabke unhone surma nahi lagaaya hota tha.

e: [AI] "I saw the seal of prophethood on the back of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  resembling the size of a pigeon's egg."
hi: "Maine Nubuwwat ki muhr Rasulullah (SAW) ki peeth par dekhi, kabootar ke ande jaisi."

e: [AI] "To me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O Abu Zaid, come closer and wipe my back.' So, I approached him and wiped his back, and I placed my fingers on the ring, then he winked at me. It was said to him, 'What is the ring?' He replied, 'It is a tuft of hair gathered near his shoulders.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Abu Zaid, qareeb aao aur meri peeth par haath phero." Unhone kaha: to main unke qareeb gaya aur unki peeth par haath phera, aur apni ungliyan muhr par rakh kar unhein dabaaya. Unse poocha gaya: "Muhr kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Unke kandhon ke paas jama huay baal."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  lowered his head, and Allah willed for it, and then he separated afterwards."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni peshaani ke baal jitna Allah ne chaaha, latka kar rakhe, phir baad mein unhein alag kar liya."

e: [AI] San'a Hariz ibn Uthman, I said to Abdullah ibn Busr al-Sulami, "Did you see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was old?" He said, "He had some white hairs in his beard."
hi: Hariz bin Uthman ne humein hadith bayan ki, maine Abdullah bin Busr As-Sulami (RA) se poocha: "Aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, kya woh boodhe the?" Unhone kaha: "Unki thodi ke neeche kuch safed baal the."

e: [AI] "And he said to the Messenger, 'Ask him, has the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dyed his hair?' For I have seen a strand of his hair colored.' Anas said, 'Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to be pleased with using black dye. If I were to count the white hairs that appeared in his head and beard, I wouldn't find more than eleven white hairs. And this that you see colored is from the scent that used to be applied to the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.'"
hi: Aur unhone Rasool (Prophet SAW) se poocha: "Unse poocho, kya Rasulullah (SAW) ne baal rangwaaye the? Kyunke maine unke baalon mein se aik baal rangeen dekha hai." To Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko kaali rangat se nawaaza gaya tha, aur agar main unke sar aur daadhi mein jo safed baal aaye the unhein gin loon, to woh gyarah (11) safed baalon se zyada na hote, aur yeh jo rangeen dikhaai deta hai woh us khushbu se hai jo Rasulullah (SAW) apne baalon mein lagaaya karte the."

e: [AI] There was nothing on the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ except white hairs at the parting of his head, when he would apply oil and they would be visible.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sar mein sirf sar ke maang mein kuch safed baal the, jab woh tel lagaate to woh chhup jaate."

e: [AI] "I came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and he had two green blankets, and his hair was touched by grayness, and his gray hair was dyed with henna."
hi: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke unpar do hare chaadar the, unke baal safed ho chuke the, aur unka safed baal mehndi se surkh rangaa hua tha."

e: [AI] I asked Aisha, "Was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  young?" And she replied, "What does it matter to you? Allah did not focus on his appearance."
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Kya Rasulullah (SAW) ke baal safed huay the?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ne unhein zyada safed baalon se napasand-deeda (khraab) nahi kiya."

e: [AI] It was said to Anas, "What was the gray hair of the Prophet ﷺ like?" He said, "Allah never made him gray-haired except for about seventeen or eighteen (strands) on his head."
hi: Anas (RA) se poocha gaya: "Nabi (SAW) ke safed baal kaise the?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ne unhein zyada safed baalon se napasand-deeda nahi kiya, unke sar mein sattarah (17) ya atharah (18) se zyada safed baal na the."

e: "'Aishah brought a patched woolen Kisa' (cloak), and a thick Izar, She said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ died in these.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1733)
hi: Aisha (RA) ne humein aik moti (dhabbedaar) chaadar aur aik mota tehband nikaal kar dikhaaya, aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat inhi dono mein hui."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  had a horse named Al-Murtajiz."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ke paas aik ghoda tha jise Al-Murtajiz kaha jaata tha."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had a horse called Al-Murtajiz. His mule was named Al-Qaswa, and his she-camel was called Al-Wahshiya. His donkey was named Ufair, and his shield was called Al-Fasul. His sword was called Dhul-Fiqar." Habban bin Ali mentioned his weakness.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik ghoda tha jise Al-Murtajiz kehte the, unki oontni Al-Qaswa, unki khachar Dulda'l, unka gadha Ufair, unki zirah Al-Fadhool, aur unki talwaar Dhul-Fiqar thi." Habban bin Ali ko kamzor kaha gaya hai.

e: [AI] I said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "When were you made a prophet?" He replied, "Adam was between the soul and the body."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Aap kab se Nabi thay?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Aadam (AS) rooh aur jism ke darmiyan thay."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "When did Prophethood become obligatory for you?" He replied, "Between the creation of Adam and the blowing of the soul into him."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Aapke liye Nubuwwat kab wajib hui?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aadam (AS) ki paidaish aur unme rooh phoonkne ke darmiyan."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said: “Do not insult Waraqah, for I have seen that he will have a garden, or two gardens.”
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Waraqah ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunke maine unke liye aik ya do Jannat dekhi hain."

e:
[AI] The following is the translation of the provided text:

"The paper of Bin Nawfal bin Asad bin Abdul Azza about what Khadijah mentioned to him about the matters of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a poem:

'O men, fate runs its course, and nothing is determined except by Allah, no matter the circumstances. Khadijah calls me to inform her of matters, yet she has no knowledge of hidden information. She comes to ask me about it, so that I may inform her of an affair that I see coming for the people from afar. She informed me of a matter that I had heard about in the past, from the ancient times and eras, that Ahmad ﷺ  will come to him to inform him of his prophethood. Gabriel came and told him that you are sent to mankind. So I said, 'May God fulfill what you hope for. Await and send him to us, so that we may question him about his affairs, what he sees in dreams and in wakefulness.' He said, 'When he came to us, he spoke marvelously, causing my skin and hair to stand. I saw the trustworthy of Allah appearing to me in a form that surpasses all other forms. Then, he continued, and fear overwhelmed me due to the intensity of the surroundings and the trees. I thought to myself, 'How can I know if he believes me or not, that you will be resurrected and recite the revealed verses?' I will come to you, if you proclaim their call to Jihad with sincerity and without wavering.'"
hi: Waraqah bin Nawfal bin Asad bin Abdul-Uzza ne, jo baaton ka Khadijah (RA) ne unse Rasulullah (SAW) ke maamlaat ke baare mein zikr kiya, shairi mein kaha: "Aye mardo, aur zamane aur taqdeer ke phaave, aur koi bhi cheez jo Allah ne muqarrar ki hai usme koi tabdeeli nahi, yahan tak ke Khadijah (RA) mujhe bulaati hain taake main unhein bataaun, jabke unhein ghaib ki khabar ka koi ilm nahi, woh mujhse iske baare mein poochne aayi hain taake main unhein aik aisi baat bataaun jo mujhe lagta hai ke logon tak doosron se aayegi, to unhone mujhe aisi baat bataayi jo maine zamane aur asr ke purane waqt mein pehle bhi suni thi, ke Ahmad ke paas (kuch) aayega, to Jibra'il (AS) unhein bataayenge ke aap logon ki taraf bheje gaye hain, to maine kaha: shaayad jiski aap ummeed rakhti hain woh Allah aapke liye poora karega, isliye bhalaai ki ummeed rakho aur intezaar karo, aur unhein humare paas bhejo taake hum unse unke maamle ke baare mein poochein, jo woh neend aur jaagte mein dekhte hain. To jab woh humare paas aaye, to unhone aisi ajeeb baat ki ke usse jism aur baal khade ho gaye, unhone kaha: maine Allah ka Ameen dekha jo mere saamne aik aisi soorat mein aaya jo sabse haibat-naak soorat mein poori thi, phir woh (waqia) jaari raha, aur khauf mujhe daraata tha us cheez se jo mere ird-gird darakhton se salaam karta tha, to maine kaha: mera gumaan hai, aur mujhe nahi pata kya woh sach bata rahe hain, ke ankareeb aap ko Nabi banaakar bheja jaayega, aap nazil hone wali Surahon ki tilawat karenge, aur main aapke paas zaroor aaunga agar aap unki dawat ko ailaan kar dein, koi ehsaan jataaye bagair aur koi takleef diye bagair, jihad ke zariye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  foretold the future of forty elephants.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko Haathi wale (waaqiye) ke chalis (40) saal poore honay par Nabi banaaya gaya."

e: [AI] The translation into English is: "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the revelation caused him extreme distress. I said, 'I have observed your extreme distress. Your Lord has not abandoned you nor does He hate you.'" [Quran 93:3]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, wahi (kuch waqt ke liye) ruk gayi, to aap (SAW) ko iski wajah se sakht bechaini hui. Unhone kaha: to maine, jo unki bechaini dekhi thi usse, kaha: "Aapke Rab ne aapko napasand kar diya hai, iski wajah aapki yeh bechaini hai." To Allah ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aapke Rab ne aapko na to chhoda hai aur na hi napasand kiya}" (Surah Ad-Duha 3).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Jibril: "What prevents you from visiting us more often than you do?" So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: "And We do not descend except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is between that. And your Lord is never forgetful." (Surah Maryam, verse 64)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Jibra'il (AS) se kaha: "Aapko humse zyada milne se kya rokta hai?" To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil ki: "{Aur hum sirf aapke Rab ke hukum se hi utarte hain}" (Surah Maryam 64) unke farmaan "{Aur aapka Rab kabhi bhoolne wala nahi}" (Surah Maryam 64) tak.

e: [AI] The Quran was revealed as a separate entity from the reminder and it was placed in the House of Honor in the lower heaven. Then Jibril (Gabriel), peace be upon him, brought it down to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and Allah says in the Quran, "And We have indeed made it articulate in order that you may understand" (Surah Al-Quran, 25:32). Sufyan said, "There are five verses and their likes."
hi: Quran ko Zikr (Lauh-e-Mahfooz) se alag kiya gaya, aur isse duniya ke aasman mein 'Bait-ul-Izzat' mein rakha gaya, phir Jibra'il (AS) isse Nabi (SAW) par nazil karte rahe, "{Aur humne isse tarteeb se, thoda-thoda karke padha}" (Surah Al-Furqan 32). Sufyan ne kaha: "Paanch (5) ayaton ya usse kareeb."

e: [AI] "We used to compile the Quran from parchment in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Quran ko chithiyon (tukdon) se jama kar rahe the."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  used to say "Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim" (In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful) when Jibril (Gabriel) ﷺ  revealed to him a surah.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) jab Jibra'il (AS) unpar nazil hote aur "Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem" kehte, to unhein pata chal jaata ke yeh aik (nayi) Surah hai.

e: [AI] I saw the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, passing by the market of Thul-Majaz while I was in a shop of mine. He passed by wearing a red garment, and I heard him saying, "O people, say there is no god but Allah, you will be successful." A man was following him and throwing stones at him, causing his ankle to bleed. The man was saying, "O people, do not listen to him, for he is a liar." I asked, "Who is this?" It was said, "A young boy from the Banu Abd al-Muttalib." When Allah revealed Islam, we left our retreat with our possessions, including a red camel, until we reached close to Madinah. As we were sitting, a man approached us wearing two white garments and greeted us. He asked, "Where are you from?" We replied, "From the retreat, and we have a red camel with us." He asked, "Are you selling me this camel?" We answered, "Yes." He then asked, "For how much?" We replied, "For such and such an amount of dates." He took them without counting, and grabbed the reins of the camel, riding away until he disappeared within the walls of Madinah. At that moment, some of us asked each other, "Do you know this man?" No one knew him. So, some people from the group said, "You are giving your camel to someone you do not know?" The camel's owner said, "Do not worry, for I have seen a man who would never betray us, and I have not seen anything more resembling the moon, next to him, on the night of the full moon." In the evening, a man came to us and greeted us, saying, "Peace be upon you, and may the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you. Are you the ones who came from the retreat?" We said, "Yes." He said, "I am the Messenger of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and he commands you to eat from these dates until you are satisfied and take (some) with you until you are full." We ate from the dates until we were full and took some with us until we were full. The next day, we arrived in Madinah and found the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, standing and delivering a sermon to the people from the pulpit. I heard him saying, "The hand that gives is better than the hand that takes, and you should start with those whom you support, your mother, your father, your sister, your brother, and the one who is nearest to you." Then, a man from the Ansar stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, these are the sons of Tha'laba bin Yarbua who killed so-and-so during the Jahiliyyah, so grant us revenge for our killed." The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, lifted his hands until I saw the whiteness of his armpits and said, "A mother should not be made to suffer for her child, nor a child made to suffer for his mother."
hi: Maine dekha Rasulullah (SAW) ko Souq Dhil-Majaaz se guzarte huay jabke main apni dukaan mein tha, aap (SAW) guzre, unpar aik surkh chaadar thi, maine unhein farmate suna: "Aye logo, 'La ilaha illallah' kaho, kaamyaab ho jaaoge," aur aik aadmi unke peechhe unhein patthar maarte huay tha, jisne unki aid (ediyon) ko lahoo-luhaan kar diya tha, woh keh raha tha: "Aye logo, is shakhs ki itaa'at mat karo, yeh jhoota hai." Maine poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Kaha gaya: "Banu Abdul Muttalib ka aik larka." Jab Allah ne Islam ko zaahir kiya, to hum Rabza se nikle, humare sath aik sawaari (aurat) thi, yahan tak ke hum Madinah ke qareeb utre, hum baithe huay the ke aik aadmi hamare paas aaya jispar do kapde the, usne humein salaam kiya, phir poocha: "Log kahan se hain?" Humne kaha: "Rabza se," aur humare paas aik surkh oont tha. Usne poocha: "Kya tum mujhe yeh oont bechoge?" Humne kaha: "Ji haan." Usne poocha: "Kitne mein?" Humne kaha: "Itni-itni saa (naap) khajoor mein." Usne kaha: "Le liya," aur usne poora hisaab bhi nahi kiya, phir usne oont ki lagaam pakdi aur usse lekar chala gaya yahan tak ke woh Madinah ki deewaron mein chhup gaya. Humne aapas mein kaha: "Kya tum us aadmi ko jaante ho?" To kisi ko bhi woh nahi pata thi, log aapas mein aik doosre ko malamat karne lage, kaha: "Tum apna oont aise shakhs ko de dete ho jise tum nahi jaante?" To us sawaari (aurat) ne kaha: "Malamat mat karo, humne aik aisa aadmi dekha hai jo tumhare sath dhoka nahi karega, maine unke chehre se zyada chaudhvin ki raat ke chaand se milta-julta kuch nahi dekha." Jab shaam hui, to aik aadmi humare paas aaya aur kaha: "Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakaatuh, kya tum wahi log ho jo Rabza se aaye ho?" Humne kaha: "Ji haan." Usne kaha: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf se tumhare paas Rasool hoon, aur woh tumhein hukum dete hain ke tum is khajoor mein se khaao yahan tak ke seer ho jao, aur naapo yahan tak ke poora hisaab le lo." To humne khajoor mein se khaaya yahan tak ke seer ho gaye, aur humne naapa yahan tak ke poora hisaab le liya, phir agli subah hum Madinah pahunche, achaanak Rasulullah (SAW) mimbar par khade logon ko khutba de rahe the, maine unhein farmate suna: "Dene wale ka haath oopar wala haath hai, aur (kharch mein) unse shuru karo jinki tum kifaalat karte ho, apni maa, apne baap, apni behn, apne bhai, aur jo tumse qareeb ho usse pehle." Wahan Ansar mein se aik aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh Banu Thalaba bin Yarbo' hain jinhone jahiliyat mein fulan ko qatl kiya tha, isliye humara badla dilwayen." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne haath uthaaye yahan tak ke maine unki bagalon ki safedi dekh li, aur farmaya: "Koi maa apni aulaad ke gunah ki wajah se sazaa na paaye, koi maa apni aulaad ke gunah ki wajah se sazaa na paaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to present himself to the people in a certain situation and say, "Is there anyone who can take me to his people? The Quraysh have prevented me from conveying the words of my Lord." So a man from the Bani Hamdan came to him and said, "I can." He asked, "Are there any restrictions among your people?" The man replied, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then asked, "Where are you from?" He said, "From Hamdan." Then the man from Hamdan feared that his people might harm him, so he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "I will go to my people and inform them, and then I will meet you in 'Aam Qabil." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "Yes." So he set off and the delegation of the Ansar came in the month of Rajab.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Arafat ke maidaan mein khud ko logon ke saamne pesh kiya karte the aur farmaate: "Kya koi aisa aadmi hai jo mujhe apni qaum ke paas le jaaye, kyunke Quraish ne mujhe apne Rab ki baat pahunchaane se roka hai?" Unhone kaha: to Banu Hamdan ka aik aadmi unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Main (le jaaunga)." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhari qaum mein taaqat hai?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan," aur unhone poocha: "Woh kahan ke hain?" Usne kaha: "Hamdan se." Phir Hamdani aadmi ko darr laga ke uski qaum uski hifaazat na kar sake, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Main apni qaum ke paas jaakar unhein bataaunga, phir agle saal aapse milunga." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Theek hai." To woh chala gaya, phir Ansar ka wafd Rajab mein aaya.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'I was sent to complete righteous character.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe achhe akhlaaq ko mukammal karne ke liye bheja gaya hai."

e: [AI] About the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , she said, "Don't you read the Quran?" He said, "Indeed, yes." She said, "Verily, the character of the Prophet of Allah ﷺ  is the Quran."
hi: Woh Hakeem bin Aflah ke sath Aisha (RA) ke paas dakhil huay, unhone unse poocha aur kaha: "Aye Umm-ul-Momineen, mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke akhlaaq ke baare mein bataayen." Unhone kaha: "Kya tum Quran nahi padhte?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "To Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ka akhlaaq Quran hi hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad cursed a Muslim with a curse that is mentioned neither in terms of severity nor did he ever hit anything with his hand except in the cause of Allah. He was never refused when asked for something, except if he was prevented from committing a sin. He was the furthest among people from retaliating for himself unless the sanctities of Allah were violated, then he would take revenge on behalf of Allah. He was never given a choice between two matters without choosing the easier one. When the covenant was made between him and Gabriel, he would study it with him and he was more generous in doing good than the swiftly blowing wind.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne kisi Musalman ko kabhi zikr ki jaane wali la'nat se la'nat nahi ki, aur na hi kabhi apne haath se kisi cheez ko maara siwaye Allah ki raah mein, aur unse kabhi kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya to unhone use mana nahi kiya siwaye is ke ke unse gunah ka sawaal kiya jaaye, aur woh log mein se usse sabse door thay, aur unhone kabhi apni jaan ke liye kisi cheez ka badla nahi liya jo unke sath ki gayi ho, siwaye is ke ke Allah ki hurmaton ko todh diya jaaye, to woh Allah ke liye badla lete, aur unhein kabhi do cheezon mein se choose karne ka mauqa nahi diya gaya magar unhone unme se aasaan wali cheez chuni, aur jab Jibra'il (AS) se ahd taaza karte, unke sath (Quran ka) dars lete, to woh khair (bhalaai) mein khuli hui hawa se bhi zyada saakhi (fayyaaz) ho jaate.

e: [AI] Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is described in the Gospel as neither rude nor harsh, nor does he shout in the markets. He does not respond to evil with evil, but instead forgives and pardons.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) Injeel mein likhe huay hain: "Na sakht-mizaaj, na tund-khoo, na baazaaron mein shor macha kar chillaane wale, aur burai ka badla burai se nahi dete, balke maaf karte aur darguzar karte hain."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite a great deal of remembrance, engage little in idle talk, make the prayer long and keep the khutbah short, and he would not refrain from walking with a widow or poor person and tending to their needs." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1414)
hi: Maine Abdullah bin Abi Aufa (RA) ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) zyada zikr karte, kam fuzool baaten karte, apni namaz lambi karte aur khutba mukhtasar rakhte, aur ghulam aur bewa ke sath chalne mein sharm mehsoos nahi karte the yahan tak ke unki zaroorat poori kar dete."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to frequently remember Allah and refrain from idle talk. He would prolong his prayers and shorten his sermons. He would not hesitate to walk with a servant or a widow until he fulfilled their needs."
hi: Maine Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) zyada zikr karte, kam fuzool baaten karte, apni namaz lambi karte aur khutba mukhtasar rakhte, aur ghulam aur bewa ke sath chalne mein sharm mehsoos nahi karte the yahan tak ke unki zaroorat poori kar dete."

e: [AI] "Allah revealed to Jesus ﷺ , 'O Jesus, believe in Muhammad and instruct those from your nation who will meet him to believe in him. If it were not for Muhammad, I would not have created Adam, and if it were not for Muhammad, I would not have created Paradise and Hell. Indeed, I created the Throne upon water, and it shook. So I wrote on it: There is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and it became still.'"
hi: "Allah ne Isa (AS) ki taraf wahi ki: Aye Isa, Muhammad (SAW) par imaan lao, aur apni Ummat mein se jo unhein paaye unhein hukum do ke woh unpar imaan laayen, agar Muhammad (SAW) na hote to main Aadam (AS) ko paida na karta, aur agar Muhammad (SAW) na hote to main na Jannat banaata na Jahannam, aur maine Arsh ko paani par banaaya, to woh larzne laga, isliye maine uspar likh diya: 'La ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasoolullah,' to woh thaher gaya." Fabrication ka shubha.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When Adam committed the sin, he said, 'O Lord, I ask You by the right of Muhammad that You forgive me.' Allah said, 'O Adam, how do you know about Muhammad when I have not created him?' Adam said, 'O Lord, when You created me with Your hand and blew into me from Your soul, I raised my head and saw written on the pillars of the Throne: There is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. So I knew that You did not add any name to Yours except the beloved of creation to You.' Allah said, 'You have spoken the truth, O Adam. Indeed, he (Muhammad) is the beloved of creation to Me. Invoke Me by his right, for I have forgiven you, and if it were not for Muhammad, I would not have created you.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: jab Aadam (AS) se khataa hui, to unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, main tujhse Muhammad (SAW) ke haq ka waasta dekar poochta hoon ke tu mujhe bakhsh de." To Allah ne farmaya: "Aye Aadam, tumhein Muhammad (SAW) ka kaise pata chala jabke maine unhein abhi paida nahi kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Aye Rab, jab tu ne mujhe apne haath se paida kiya aur mujhme apni rooh phoonki, to maine apna sar uthaaya aur Arsh ke paayon par likha dekha: 'La ilaha illallah, Muhammadur Rasoolullah,' to mujhe pata chal gaya ke tu ne apne naam ke sath sirf apni sabse aziz makhlooq ka hi naam joda hoga." Allah ne farmaya: "Tumne sach kaha, Aye Aadam, beshak woh mujhe sabse aziz makhlooq hain, mujhse unke haq ka waasta dekar dua karo, maine tumhein bakhsh diya, aur agar Muhammad (SAW) na hote to maine tumhein paida na kiya." Fabricated (gadha hua).

e: "Abu Talib departed to Ash-Sham, and the Prophet ﷺ left with him, along with some older men from the Quraish. When they came across the monk they stopped there and began setting up their camp, and the monk came out to them. Before that they used to pass by him and he wouldn't come out nor pay attention to them." He said: "They were setting up their camp when the monk was walking amidst them, until he came and took the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then he said: 'This is the master of the men and jinn, this is the Messenger of the Lord of the worlds. Allah will raise him as a mercy to the men and jinn.' So some of the older people from the Quraish said: 'What do you know?' He said: 'When you people came along from the road, not a rock nor a tree was left, except that it prostrated, and they do not prostrate except for a Prophet. And I can recognize him by the seal of the Prophethood which is below his shoulder blade, like an apple.' Then he went back, and made them some food, and when he brought it to them, he [the Prophet ﷺ] was tending to the camels. So he said: 'Send for him.' So he came, and there was a cloud over him that was shading him. When he came close to the people, he found that they had beaten him to the tree's shade. So when he sat down, the shade of the tree leaned towards him. He (the monk) said: 'Look at the shade of the tree leaning towards him.'" He said: "So while he was standing over them, telling them not to take him to Rome with him - because if the Romans were to see him, they would recognize him by his description, and they would kill him - he turned, and there were seven people who had come from Rome. So he faced them and said: 'Why have you come?' They said: 'We came because this Prophet is going to appear during this month, and there isn't a road left except that people have been sent to it, and we have been informed of him, and we have been send to this road of yours.' So he said: 'Is there anyone better than you behind you?' They said: 'We only have news of him from this road of yours.' He said: 'Do you think that if there is a matter which Allah wishes to bring about, there is anyone among the people who can turn it away?' They said: 'No.'" He said: "So they gave him their pledge, and they stayed with him. And he said: 'I ask you by Allah, which of you is his guardian?' They said: 'Abu Talib.' So he kept adjuring him until Abu Talib returned him (back to Makkah) and he sent Abu Bakr and Bilal with him. And the monk gave him provisions of Ka'k (a type of bread) and olive oil." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3620)
hi: Abu Talib Sham (Syria) ki taraf nikle, aur Rasulullah (SAW) unke sath, Quraish ke kuch buzurgon mein, nikle. Jab woh raahib (Bahira) ke qareeb pahunche, to utre aur apna saaman utaara, to raahib unke paas nikla, aur woh pehle bhi unke paas se guzarte the, magar woh na nikalta tha na dhyaan deta tha. Unhone kaha: aur jab woh apna saaman utaar rahe the, to woh unke darmiyan guzarne laga yahan tak ke aaya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka haath pakad liya aur kaha: "Yeh jahaan walon ka sardaar hai, yeh jahaan walon ke Rab ka Rasool hai, isse Allah jahaan walon ke liye rehmat banaakar bhejega." To Quraish ke kuch buzurgon ne usse kaha: "Aapko iska kya ilm hai?" Usne kaha: "Jab tum aqabah se buland huay, to koi darakht na koi patthar na bacha jo sajda mein na gira ho, aur sajda sirf Nabi ke liye hota hai, aur main isse Nubuwwat ki muhr se pehchaanta hoon, unke kandhe ki haddi ke neeche, saib jaisi." Phir woh wapas gaya aur unke liye khaana banaaya, phir unke paas laaya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) us waqt oonton ki chaupaani mein the. Usne kaha: "Unke paas kisi ko bhejo." To woh aaye jabke unpar aik baadal saaya kiye huay tha. Usne kaha: "Dekho, unpar aik baadal saaya kiye huay hai." Jab woh log ke qareeb pahunche, to unhein dekha ke log darakht ke saaye tak pehle hi pahunch chuke the, jab woh baithe to darakht ka saaya unki taraf jhuk gaya. Usne kaha: "Dekho, darakht ka saaya unki taraf jhuk gaya." Jabke woh unke paas khade the aur unhein qasam de rahe the ke unhein Room (Rome) na le jaayen, kyunke agar Roomi unhein dekhein to unhein unke wasf se pehchaan lenge aur unhein qatl kar denge. To woh mudkar dekhi, achaanak saat (7) log Room se aaye huay the. Unhone unka saamna kiya aur poocha: "Tum kyun aaye ho?" Unhone kaha: "Hum is Nabi ki khabar sunkar aaye hain ke woh is mahine mein zaahir hone wale hain, koi bhi raasta nahi bacha jismein log na bheje gaye hon, aur humein tumhare is raaste par bheja gaya hai." To raahib ne unse kaha: "Kya tumne peechhe koi aisa aadmi chhoda hai jo tumse behtar ho?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "Humein sirf unki khabar di gayi thi, isliye humein tumhare is raaste par bheja gaya." Usne kaha: "Kya tum yeh samajhte ho, jo maamla Allah karna chaahta hai, kya koi bhi insaan usse rok sakta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Usne kaha: "To unse baiyat karo." To unhone unse baiyat ki aur unke sath qayaam kiya. Unhone kaha: to raahib unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, tum mein se unka waali (sarparast) kaun hai?" Abu Talib ne kaha. To woh unse qasam dete rahe yahan tak ke unhein (wapas) bhej diya, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ne unke sath Bilal (RA) ko bheja, aur raahib ne unhein sattoo aur zaitoon ke tel ka zaad-e-raah diya.

e: [AI] A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "How was the beginning of your affair, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "My foster mother was from Bani Sa'd bin Bakr, and I and her son went to graze sheep in Bahm. We did not take any provisions with us, so I told my brother, 'Go and bring us some provisions from our mother's house.' My brother set off and I stayed with the sheep. Two white birds flew towards me like eagles, and one of them said to the other, 'Is it him?' The other replied, 'Yes.' They approached me and captured me, placing me on the ground. They then split open my chest and took out my heart, removing two black clots from it. One of them said to the other, 'Weigh his share and then seal him with the seal of prophethood.' One of them said to the other, 'Put it in one scale and put a thousand from his nation in the other scale.' When I look up at the thousand above me, I fear they will overpower me.' They said, 'If his nation were to be weighed with it, it would have outweighed them.' Then they departed and left me, and I woke up in a severe state of fear. I then went to my mother and told her what I had seen. She was scared that something had happened to me, so she took a camel, placed me on its back, and mounted behind me until we reached my mother. She said, 'Have you fulfilled your trust and duty?' and I informed her about what had happened to me. This did not disturb her. She said, 'I saw a light emanating from me that illuminated the palaces of Syria.'"
hi: Aik aadmi ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapka pehla waaqia kaisa tha?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri dhaai (doodh pilaane wali) Banu Sa'd bin Bakr se thin, main aur unka aik beta humari bakriyon ke sath nikle, aur hum apne sath zaad-e-raah (khaana) nahi le gaye the, maine kaha: 'Aye bhai, jaao aur humari maa se humare liye khaana lekar aao.' Mera bhai chala gaya aur main bakriyon ke paas raha. Achaanak do safed parinde aaye, goya woh baaz (uqaab) hon, unme se aik ne doosre se poocha: 'Kya yehi hai?' Doosre ne kaha: 'Ji haan.' To woh dono meri taraf jaldi se aaye, unhone mujhe pakda aur peeth ke bal lita diya, mera seena cheer diya, phir mera dil nikaala aur usse cheer kar usme se do kaali chizein (aloqas) nikaalin, phir unme se aik ne doosre se kaha: 'Isse muhr lagao,' ya'ni 'isspar khainch do, aur isse Nubuwwat ki muhr se bandh do.' Phir unme se aik ne doosre se kaha: 'Isse aik pallay mein rakho, aur uski Ummat mein se hazaar (1000) ko doosre pallay mein rakho,' to jab main hazaar (1000) ko apne oopar dekh raha tha, mujhe darr laga ke kahin woh mujhpar gir na padein. To unhone kaha: 'Agar unki Ummat ko unke sath tola jaaye, to woh unke muqaable mein jhuk jaayegi.' Phir woh chale gaye aur mujhe chhod diya, mujhe sakht dahshat hui, phir main apni maa ke paas gaya aur unhein jo dekha tha usse bataaya, unhein darr laga ke kahin mujhpar koi asar to nahi ho gaya, unhone kaha: 'Main tumhein Allah ki panaah mein deti hoon.' To unhone apni oontni pe kaathi kasi aur mujhe kaathi par bithaaya aur mere peechhe sawaar hui yahan tak ke hum apni (asal) maa (dhaai) tak pahunche, unhone kaha: 'Maine apni amaanat aur zimmedaari poori ki,' aur unhein maine jo pesh aaya woh bataaya, isse woh dari nahi, unhone kaha: 'Main hi hoon jinse aik noor nikla tha jisne Sham (Syria) ke mahal roshan kar diye the.'"

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on a journey, and we stopped at a place. Suddenly, a man in the valley called out, saying: "O Allah, make me from the Ummah (nation) of Muhammad, the deceased, the forgiven, and the rewarded." I then approached the valley, and there was a man whose height was more than three hundred arms. He asked me, "Who are you?" I said, "Anas ibn Malik, servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He asked, "Where is he?" I said, "He is over there, listening to your words." He said, "Approach him and deliver my greetings to him, and tell him that your brother Ilyas conveys the greetings to you." So, I went to the Prophet ﷺ  and informed him. He came until he met him, embraced him, and greeted him. Then, they both sat down and started conversing. The man said to the Prophet ﷺ , "O Messenger of Allah, I only eat one day in every year, and today is my day of breaking the fast. So, I am going to eat, and you can eat with me." Then, a table from heaven descended, containing bread, fish, and celery. They both ate and fed me too. After that, we performed the Asr prayer, and then the man departed, and I saw him ascending to the sky on a cloud.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik safar mein thay, hum aik jagah utre, achaanak aik aadmi wadi mein keh raha tha: "Aye Allah, mujhe Muhammad (SAW) ki rehm-kardah, bakhshi hui, aur sawaab paayi hui Ummat mein se banaa." Unhone kaha: to main wadi ki taraf jhaanka, achaanak aik aadmi tha jiski lambaai teen sau (300) haath se zyada thi. Usne mujhse poocha: "Tum kaun ho?" Maine kaha: "Anas bin Malik, Rasulullah (SAW) ka khadim." Usne poocha: "Woh kahan hain?" Maine kaha: "Woh yahin hain, aapki baat sun rahe hain." Usne kaha: "To unke paas jao aur unhein mera salaam pahunchao, aur unse kaho: aapka bhai Ilyas aapko salaam kehte hain." To main Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya, to woh aaye yahan tak ke unse mile, unhein gale lagaaya aur salaam kiya, phir dono baith kar baaten karne lage. Usne unse kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main saal mein sirf aik din khaata hoon, aur aaj mera iftaar (roze khatam karne) ka din hai, isliye main aur aap khaayenge." To unpar aasman se aik dastarkhwaan utra jispar roti, machhli, aur ajwain (karafas) thi, dono ne khaaya aur mujhe bhi khilaaya, humne Asr ki namaz padhi, phir usne unse rukhsat li, phir maine dekha usse baadal par aasman ki taraf jaate huay.

e: [AI] I traveled with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I saw something amazing from him. We came across two trees, and he said, "Go to these two trees and say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  orders you to come together." So I went and said that to them, and each one of them was uprooted from its place. Then each one of them went back to its companion, and they all reunited. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  completed his need behind them and then said, "Go and tell them to return to their places." So I went to them and said that to them, and each one of them went back to its place.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath safar mein tha, maine unse aik ajeeb baat dekhi. Hum aik jagah utre, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "In do darakhton ki taraf jao aur kaho: Rasulullah (SAW) tum dono se kehte hain ke tum aapas mein jama ho jao." Main gaya aur unse yeh kaha, to har aik apni jad se ukhad gaya, phir har aik doosre ki taraf gaya, dono aapas mein mil gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke peechhe apni zaroorat poori ki, phir farmaya: "Jao aur unse kaho ke har aik apni jagah wapas chala jaaye." To main unke paas gaya aur unse yeh kaha, to har aik apni jagah wapas chala gaya. Sahih.

e: [AI] He told him that there was a bowl with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the people started eating from it. Whenever a group became full, they would leave their place for another group. A man said, "Is it being replenished with something?" So Samurah said, "It is only replenished from the sky."
hi: Unhone bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik tashtari thi, log usme se khaate the, jab bhi log seer ho jaate to unki jagah aur log baith jaate. Unhone kaha: isi tarah pehli namaz tak chalta raha. Aik aadmi ne poocha: "Kya isme kuch milaaya jaata tha?" Samurah (RA) ne kaha: "Isme sirf aasman se hi milaaya jaata tha."

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a battle when the people suffered from hunger. So the people asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  for permission to slaughter some of their camels, saying, "Allah will suffice us with them." When Umar ibn al-Khattab saw that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was inclined to give them permission to slaughter their camels, he said, "O Messenger of Allah, what will happen to us when we meet the enemy tomorrow while we are hungry men? But if you see, O Messenger of Allah, that you call the people to bring the remaining food that they have, so the people brought a handful of food each, and above that, the best among them brought a sa' of dates. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up and prayed for whatever Allah willed him to pray for, then he called the army to bring their vessels, and ordered them to fill whatever was left of the army. So they did not leave any vessel empty, but filled it, and there was an equal amount remaining. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  laughed until his back teeth became visible.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik ghazwe (jung) mein thay, logon ko bhook ne aa liya, to logon ne Rasulullah (SAW) se apne kuch sawaari jaanwaron ko zibah karne ki ijaazat maangi aur kaha: "Allah unse humein faida degaa." Jab Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne dekha ke Rasulullah (SAW) unhein apne sawaari jaanwaron ko zibah karne ki ijaazat dene ka iraada kar chuke hain, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar hum kal bhooke halaat mein dushman se milein to humara kya hoga? Lekin agar aap munaasib samjhen, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to logon ko unke baaqi zaad (khaane) se bulaayen." To log khaane ki mutthi bhar aur usse zyada laane lage, to unme sabse zyada laane wala woh tha jo aik saa (naap) khajoor laaya, to unhein jama kiya, "phir khade huay aur jitni dua karna Allah ne chaaha ki, phir lashkar ko apne bartano ke sath bulaaya, phir unhein hukum diya ke jitni baaqi lashkar hai use bhar lein, to unhone koi bhi bartan khaali nahi chhoda balke usse bhar liya, aur utna hi baaqi bhi bach gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) itna hansty ke unke daanton ki jad zaahir ho gayi." Sahih.

e: [AI] I sailed the sea on a ship, and it broke apart, so I rode upon a plank from it, and it cast me onto a thicket in which there was a lion. Nothing frightened me except it, so I said, “O Abu al-Harith, I am a client of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.” Then it lowered its head and nudged my side with its shoulder, and it kept nudging me and guiding me to the road until it set me upon the road. When it set me down, it murmured, and I thought that it was bidding me farewell.
hi: Main samundar mein aik kashti mein sawaar hua, woh toot gayi, to main uska aik takhta pakad kar sawaar ho gaya, usne mujhe aik jangal mein phenk diya jismein aik sher tha, mujhe sirf usne hi dara diya, to maine kaha: "Aye Abu Al-Harith, main Rasulullah (SAW) ka ghulam hoon." To usne apna sar jhukaaya aur apne kandhe se mera aik taraf ka hissa dhakel diya, aur woh mujhe dhakel-dhakel kar raaste ki taraf le jaata raha yahan tak ke usne mujhe raaste par utaar diya, jab usne mujhe utaara to usne halki aawaaz ki, to maine samjha woh mujhse rukhsat le raha hai.

e:
[AI] We were sitting around the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when a desert Arab—an eloquent Bedouin from Yemen—entered on a red she-camel. He made it kneel at the door of the mosque, then came in, greeted us, and sat down. When he had finished, they said, “O Messenger of Allah, the she-camel under the Bedouin is stolen.” He said, “Is there proof?” They said, “Yes, O Messenger of Allah.” He said, “O ʿAlī, take Allah’s due from the Bedouin if the proof is established against him; and if it is not established, then return him to me.”

The Bedouin lowered his head for a while. Then the Prophet ﷺ said to him, “Stand, O Bedouin, for Allah’s matter; otherwise present your argument.” Whereupon the she-camel spoke from behind the door: “By Him who sent you with honor, O Messenger of Allah, this man did not steal me, and no one has owned me other than he.” The Prophet ﷺ said to him, “O Bedouin, by Him who made her speak in your defense—what was it that you said?” He replied, “I said: O Allah, You are not a Lord whom we have newly invented, nor is there with You a god who aided You in creating us, nor is there with You any lord such that we would doubt Your lordship. You are our Lord as we say, and above what those who speak can say. I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and to clear me by my innocence.”

The Prophet ﷺ said to him, “By Him who sent me with honor, O Bedouin, I have indeed seen the angels racing to the mouths of the alleys, writing down your words—so increase your prayers for blessings upon me.”[^1]
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke ird-gird baithe huay the ke aik boodhi awaaz wala, badu, Yamani aadmi surkh oontni par dakhil hua, usne masjid ke darwaze par usse baithaaya, phir dakhil hua, salaam kiya, phir baith gaya. Jab woh apni zaroorat se faarigh hua, to logon ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), badu ke neeche jo oontni hai woh chori ki hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya isme koi gawaahi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ali, badu se Allah ka haq lo agar usspar gawaahi qaayam ho, aur agar qaayam na ho to use mujhe wapas kar do." Unhone kaha: to badu thodi der khamosh reha, to Nabi (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Uth jao, Aye badu, Allah ke maamle ke liye, warna apni daleel pesh karo." To oontni ne darwaze ke peechhe se kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko izzat de kar bheja, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), isne mujhe nahi churaya, aur iske siwa kisi ne mujhe maalik nahi banaaya." To Nabi (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Aye badu, us Zaat ki qasam jisne usse tumhari maazrat mein baat karwaayi, tumne kya kaha tha?" Usne kaha: "Maine kaha: Aye Allah, tu aisa Rab nahi jise humne khud gadha ho, na tere sath koi ma'bood hai jisne humein paida karne mein teri madad ki ho, na tere sath koi Rab hai ke hum teri Rabubiyat mein shak karein, tu humara Rab hai jaisa hum kehte hain, aur jaisa kehne wale kehte hain usse bhi zyada, main tujhse maangta hoon ke tu Muhammad (SAW) par rehmat bhej, aur mujhe meri bezaari (be-qusoori) ke sath saabit kar de."
