To Nabi (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne mujhe izzat ke sath bheja, Aye badu, maine farishton ko galiyon ke muhaane par daudte huay dekha, woh tumhari baat likh rahe the, isliye mujhpar zyada durood bhejo." Repudiated.

e: [AI] An Arab man came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "How can I know that you are the Messenger of Allah?" The Prophet ﷺ  said, "What if I called this branch from this palm tree and it bore witness that I am the Messenger of Allah?" The man replied, "Yes." So, the Prophet ﷺ  called the branch and it descended from the palm tree until it fell to the ground. Then, it started jumping until it reached the Prophet ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ  said to the branch, "Go back." So, it returned to its place.
hi: Aik badu Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur poocha: "Main kis se pehchaanoon ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum dekhoge ke agar main is khajoor ke tane se yeh guchha (edq) bulaaun, kya tum gawahi doge ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne guchhe ko bulaaya, to guchha khajoor ke tane se utarne laga yahan tak ke zameen par gira, phir udakte huay Nabi (SAW) tak pahuncha. Unhone kaha: phir aap (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Wapas jao." To woh wapas apni jagah chala gaya.

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in Makkah. He went out to some of its outskirts, and every tree and mountain he passed by he would say, "Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Makkah mein thay, aap (SAW) uske kisi kinare mein nikle, jo bhi darakht ya pahaad unke saamne aata, woh kehta: "Assalamu Alaika, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)."

e: [AI] I was sick, so the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم came to me while I was saying: "O Allah, if my time has come, then grant me ease. And if it is delayed, then raise me up. And if it is a test, then grant me patience." He asked, "What did you say?" So, I repeated it. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم said, "O Allah, cure him. O Allah, heal him." Then, he said, "Stand up." So, I stood up and I never experienced that pain again afterwards.
hi: Main bimaar hua, to Nabi (SAW) mere paas tashreef laaye jabke main keh raha tha: "Aye Allah, agar meri ajal aa chuki hai to mujhe aaraam de, aur agar der hai to mujhe uthaa de, aur agar yeh aazmaaish hai to mujhe sabr de." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne kya kaha?" Maine dohraaya. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, isse shifa de, Aye Allah, isse aafiyat de." Phir farmaya: "Utho." To main utha, aur uske baad mujhe woh dard kabhi wapas nahi aaya.

e: I invited my mother, who was a polytlieist, to Islam. I invited her one day and she said to me something about Messenger of Allah ﷺ which I hated. I came to Messenger of Allah ﷺ weeping and said: Messenger of Allah, I invited my mother to Islam but she did not accept (my invitation). I invited her today but she said to me something which I did not like. (Kindly) supplicate Allah that He may set the mother of Abu Huraira right. Thereupon Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: O Allah, set the mother of Abu Huraira on the right path. I came out quite pleased with the supplication of Allah's Apostle ﷺ and when I came near the door it was closed from within. My mother heard the noise of my footsteps and she said: Abu Huraira, just wait. And I heard the noise of falling of water. She took a bath and put on the shirt and quickly covered her head with a headdress and opened the door and then said: Abu Huraira, I bear witness to the fact that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His bondsman and His Messenger. He (Abu Huraira) said: I went back to Messenger of Allah ﷺ and (this time) I was shedding the tears of joy. I said: Messenger of Allah, be happy, for Allah has responded to your supplication and He has set on the right path the mother of Abu Huraira. He (the Holy Prophet) praised Allah, and extolled Him and uttered good words. I said: Messenger of Allah, supplicate to Allah so that He may instill love of mine and that of my mother too in the believing servants and let our hearts be filled with their love, whereupon Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: O Allah, let there be love of these servants of yours, i.e. Abu Huraira and his mother, in the hearts of the believing servants and let their hearts be filled with the love of the believing servants. (Abu Huraira said: This prayer) was so well granted by Allah that no believer was ever born who heard of me and who saw me but did not love me. (Using translation from Muslim 2491)
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA): "Zameen par koi momin mard ya momina aurat nahi jo mujhse mohabbat na kare." Maine poocha: "Aapko iska kya ilm hai, Aye Abu Hurairah?" Unhone kaha: "Main apni maa ko Islam ki taraf bulaata tha, magar woh inkaar karti thin, aik din maine unhein bulaaya, to unhone mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein aisi baat sunayi jo mujhe napasand thi, to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main apni maa ko Islam ki taraf bulaata hoon, magar woh mujhse inkaar karti hain, aur aik din maine unhein bulaaya to unhone mujhe aapke baare mein aisi baat sunayi jo mujhe napasand thi, isliye Allah se dua karein, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), ke woh Abu Hurairah ki maa ko Islam ki hidayat de.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke liye dua ki, main apni maa ke paas wapas gaya taake unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ki dua ki khush-khabri dun, jab main darwaze par pahuncha to darwaza band tha, maine darwaza khatkaya, unhone meri aahat suni, to unhone apne kapde pehne aur apne sar par apna dupatta rakha, aur kaha: 'Thehro zara, Aye Abu Hurairah,' phir unhone mere liye darwaza khola, jab main dakhil hua to unhone kaha: 'Main gawahi deti hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad (SAW) Allah ke Rasool hain.' Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas khushi se rota hua wapas gaya jaise pehle gham se rota tha, aur main kehne laga: 'Khush ho jayen, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ne aapki dua qubool kar li aur Abu Hurairah ki maa ko Islam ki hidayat de di.' Maine kaha: 'Allah se dua karein ke woh mujhe aur meri maa ko apne momin bandon ka mehboob banaaye, aur unhein humara mehboob banaaye.' Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Allah, apne is banda aur uski maa ko apne momin bandon ka mehboob banaa, aur unhein inka mehboob banaa.' To zameen par koi momin mard ya momina aurat nahi jo mujhse mohabbat na kare aur main usse mohabbat na karoon."

e: [AI] Fulan used to sit with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and whenever the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ spoke about something, Fulan's face would turn red. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said to him, "Be like that." He continued to feel agitated until he died.
hi: Fulan Nabi (SAW) ke paas baitha karta tha, jab Nabi (SAW) kuch farmaate to uska chehra khinch jaata, to Nabi (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Aise hi raho." To woh khinchta hi raha yahan tak ke uski wafaat ho gayi.

e:
[AI] It is said that a man called Jurayjara had some gold coins that belonged to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so the Prophet ﷺ  asked him for them. Jurayjara said, "Oh Jew, I don't have anything to give you." The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "If that's the case, then sit with me." So he sat with him. The Prophet ﷺ  prayed the Duha (forenoon) prayer, Asr (afternoon) prayer, Maghrib (evening) prayer, Isha (night) prayer, Fajr (dawn) prayer, and the next day's Dhuhr (midday) prayer at that spot.

The companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  threatened and warned Jurayjara, but the Prophet ﷺ  was smart and asked them, "What are you doing to him?" They replied, "Oh Messenger of Allah, a Jew is holding you captive." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "My Lord has forbidden me from betraying a covenant, regardless of who it is with." When the day ended, Jurayjara testified, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger." He also said, "Half of my wealth is for the sake of Allah. By Allah, I did what I did only to know about your description in the Torah, O Muhammad, son of Abdullah, born in Makkah, migrated to Taybah, and ruled in Sham. You are not ill-mannered, harsh, or rude in the markets, nor do you engage in lewd behavior or speak falsehood. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that you are the Messenger of Allah. This wealth is now yours, so judge with it as Allah has shown you."

Note: The authenticity of this narration is disputed.
hi: Jise Zuhair kaha jaata tha, uska Rasulullah (SAW) par kuch dinaar (rupaye) tha, usne Nabi (SAW) se apna qarz maanga, to aap (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Aye Yahoodi, mere paas woh nahi hai jo main tumhein doon." Usne kaha: "To main aapse alag nahi hounga, Aye Muhammad, jab tak aap mujhe (mera haq) na de dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To main tumhare sath baithta hoon." To woh uske sath baith gaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne us jagah Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, aur subah (Fajr) ki namaz padhi. Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba usse daraane aur dhamki dene lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) ko iska pata chala aur unhone poocha: "Tum log uske sath kya kar rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aik Yahoodi aapko rok kar rakh raha hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere Rab ne mujhe kisi ahd-waale ya kisi aur par zulm karne se mana kiya hai." Jab din dhal gaya, to Yahoodi ne kaha: "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad (SAW) uske banda aur Rasool hain," aur kaha: "Mera aadha maal Allah ki raah mein hai, Allah ki qasam, maine aapke sath jo kiya woh sirf isliye kiya taake main Tauraat mein aapka wasf dekh sakoon - Muhammad bin Abdullah, jinki paidaish Makkah mein hai, jinki hijrat Taibah (Madinah) mein hai, jinki hukumat Sham mein hai, na sakht-mizaaj, na tund-khoo, na baazaaron mein shor macha kar chillaane wale, na besharmi ka libaas pehne wale na fahaash baat karne wale, main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur aap Allah ke Rasool hain, yeh raha mera maal, isme jo Allah aapko sahi lage waisa faisla karein." Aur Yahoodi bohot maal wala tha. Yeh hadith bohot hi mardood (radd kiya hua) hai.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ said, "The Quraysh continued to be united until the death of Abu Talib."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quraish hamesha (ikhtilaaf se) daba-dabaa rahi yahan tak ke Abu Talib faut ho gaye."

e: [AI] "The name of Al-Najashi was Masahamah in Arabic, and only Al-Najashi is the name of the king, just like Khusrow and Heraclius."
hi: "Najashi ka naam Mashamah tha, aur Arabi mein iska matlab 'Atiyyah' hai, aur 'Najashi' to baadshaah ka lakab hai, jaisa tum 'Kisra' aur 'Hirqal' kehte ho."

e: [AI] "We sent the messenger of Allah ﷺ  to Negus and we were a group of about eighty men. He mentioned the narration in its entirety as I have narrated it in the interpretation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein An-Najashi ke paas bheja, aur hum taqreeban aath (80) log the, phir poori hadith apni tafseer wali kitaab mein jaisi nikaali hai waisi zikr ki.

e: [AI] Uthman ibn Affan and his wife Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , migrated from Makkah to Abyssinia and then they arrived in Makkah before migrating to Madinah. The two notable scholars, Sheikhain, agreed to narrate a hadith from Ibn Abi Shaybah and others from Az-Zuhri from Urwah from Ubaydullah ibn 'Adi from Al-Miswar ibn Makhramah about Uthman ibn Affan's journey to Abyssinia. This hadith is narrated at length, so I have summarized it in the narration of Musa ibn Uqbah from Ibn Ishaq. It is mentioned in the Maghazi (battles) that Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , as mentioned by them, has not been seen in the Arab world or in Abyssinia better than her. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summarization.
hi: "Uthman bin Affan (RA) aur unki biwi Ruqayyah bint Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah se pehli hijrat mein Habsha (Abyssinia) ki taraf hijrat karte huay nikle, phir woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Makkah wapas aaye, phir woh Madinah ki taraf hijrat kar gaye." Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ka Ibn Abi Shaybah aur doosron ki hadith, Az-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Ubaidullah bin Adi se, Al-Miswar bin Makhramah se, Uthman bin Affan (RA) ke Habsha ki zameen ki taraf nikalne ke baare mein, nikaalne par ittefaaq hai, aur dono ne hadith ko poori lambaai se bayan kiya hai, isliye maine Musa bin Uqbah ki riwayat par, Ibn Ishaq se, mukhtasar kiya, aur Maghazi mein zikr kiya ke Ruqayyah bint Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein unhone kaha ke Arab mein na Habsha mein unse zyada khoobsurat koi nahi dekhi gayi. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Talib, verses by Al-Najashi, urging them to be good neighbors to each other and defend him. [Long Sea] so that the best of people know that Muhammad is a minister to Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary. He brought us a gift just like they brought him. And everyone, by the command of Allah, guides and protects. And you recite it in your book with the truth of a story, not a translation. And indeed, whenever a group comes to you with hostility, except by your favor, they are returned with generosity."
hi: Abu Talib ke, An-Najashi ke liye, kuch ash'aar, unhein achhi mehmaan-nawaazi aur unki hifaazat par ubhaarne ke liye: "Taake behtareen log jaan lein ke Muhammad (SAW) Musa (AS) aur Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke waziir (madadgaar) hain, humare paas woh hidayat lekar aaye hain jaisi woh dono laaye the, aur har aik Allah ke hukum se hidayat deta aur bachaata hai, aur tum ise apni Kitaab mein sachhi khabar ki tarah padhte ho, na koi jhooti baat, aur beshak tumhare paas jo bhi giroh aapki fazeelat se aata hai, use izzat ke sath hi wapas kiya jaata hai."

e: When I came from Ethiopia (to Medina), I was a young girl. Messenger of Allah ﷺ made me wear a sheet having marks on it. Messenger of Allah ﷺ was rubbing those marks with his hands saying, "Sanah! Sanah!" (i.e. good, good). (Using translation from Bukhārī 3874)
hi: Main Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen se aayi jabke main aik chhoti bachi thi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe aik khamisa (chaadar) pehnaayi jispar nishaan the, to Rasulullah (SAW) apne haath se un nishaanon ko sehlaate aur kehte: "Sanah, Sanah," ya'ni achha, achha.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I do not know which one I am happier with, the victory of Khaibar or the arrival of Ja'far."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata in dono mein se kis par zyada khush hoon - Khaibar ki fatah par ya Ja'far (RA) ke aane par."

e: [AI] "We were eleven individuals in the first al-Aqaba pledge of the upcoming year, and we pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with the pledge of women before he imposed war upon us."
hi: "Hum agle saal ki pehli Aqabah mein gyarah (11) the, humne Rasulullah (SAW) se auraton wali baiyat ki, isse pehle ke unpar jung farz ki jaaye."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  spent ten years following people in their homes during the season of Manazil, Muzdalifah, and 'Ukaz. He would ask, "Who will shelter me? Who will support me until I convey the messages of my Lord, and for him is Paradise?" Yet, he would find no one to support him or shelter him. And there would be a man who would leave from Egypt or Yemen to bring him back to his people, and they would warn him, "Beware of the young Quraishi boy who will tempt you." He would walk among their tents, calling them to Allah Almighty, and they would point at him with their fingers. Then Allah sent us from Yathrib (Medina), and the man from among us would meet him, believe in him, and teach him the Quran. He would then return to his people, and they would embrace Islam until there was not a single house among the houses of the Ansar without Muslims in it. We sent a message to Allah, and He allowed us to gather and meet. We said, "How long will the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  be expelled in the mountains of Makkah and live in fear?" So we set out until we reached him in Muzdalifah during the pilgrimage season. We made an agreement with him at 'Aqabah, and his uncle, al-'Abbas, said to him, "O son of my brother, I do not know who these people who have come to you are. I have knowledge of the people of Yathrib, so we gathered with a man, and when al-'Abbas looked at our faces, he said, 'These are people we do not know. They are young men.' So we said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what do we pledge allegiance to you on?' He said, 'Pledge allegiance to me on hearing and obeying, in times of energy and times of laziness, on spending in times of ease and times of hardship, on commanding good and forbidding evil, and on not blaming us for what we do in the name of Allah. Pledge allegiance to me on supporting me when I come to you, and withholding from what you withhold from yourselves, your wives, and your children. And for you is Paradise.' So we pledged allegiance to him, and Sa'd bin Zurarah, the youngest among the seventy, took his hand and said, 'O people of Yathrib, none of us withholds his hand from this pledge, and we will never quit it.' So we went to him, each man one by one, and he took our pledge to grant us Paradise."
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) das (10) saal logon ka mausam, Majannah, aur Ukaz mein, aur Mina mein unki manzilon mein peecha karte rahe: "Kaun hai jo mujhe panaah de, kaun hai jo meri madad kare yahan tak ke main apne Rab ke paighaam pahunchaaun, aur uske liye Jannat hai?" To unhein koi bhi aisa na milta jo unki madad kare ya unhein panaah de, yahan tak ke aik aadmi Misr ya Yemen se apne rishtedaar ki taraf safar karta, to uske paas uski qaum aati aur usse kehti: "Quraish ke larke se hoshiyaar raho, kahin woh tumhein fitne mein na daal de," aur woh unke khaimon ke darmiyan chalte huay unhein Allah ki taraf bulaate, to log unhein ungliyon se ishara karte, yahan tak ke Allah ne humein Yasrib (Madinah) se bheja, to humme se aik aadmi unke paas jaata aur unpar imaan laata, aur unhein Quran padhaate, phir woh apne ghar walon ke paas wapas jaata, to woh uske Islam qubool karne se Musalman ho jaate, yahan tak ke Ansar ka koi bhi ghar aisa na bacha jismein Musalmano ka aik giroh na ho jo Islam ko zaahir karte. Aur Allah ne humein unki taraf bheja, humne aapas mein mashwara kiya aur jama huay, humne kaha: "Kab tak Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah ke pahaadon mein dhakele jaayenge aur khauf mein rahenge?" To hum chal pade yahan tak ke unke paas mausam mein pahunche, unhone humse Aqabah ki baiyat ka wa'da kiya. To unke chacha Abbas (RA) ne unse kaha: "Aye mere bhatije, mujhe nahi pata yeh log kaun hain jo aapke paas aaye hain, main Yasrib walon ko jaanta hoon." To hum unke paas aik-aik, do-do karke jama huay, jab Abbas (RA) ne hamare chehron ko dekha, to kaha: "Yeh log jinhein hum nahi jaante, yeh naujawaan hain." Humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum aapse kis baat par baiyat karein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mujhse baiyat karo sunne aur maanne par, khush-dili aur susti dono mein, aur maal kharch karne par, mushkil aur aasaani dono mein, aur achhi baat ka hukum dene aur buri baat se rokne par, aur Allah ke maamle mein tum aisi baat kaho ke koi malaamat karne wala tumhein na roke, aur is baat par ke jab main tumhare paas aaun to tum meri madad karo aur mujhe usse bachaao jisse tum apni jaano, apni biwiyon, aur apni aulaad ko bachaate ho, aur tumhare liye Jannat hai." To hum khade huay unse baiyat karne ke liye, aur Sa'd bin Zurarah (RA) ne unka haath pakda, jabke woh sattar (70) mein sabse chhote the, unhone kaha: "Zara sabr karo, Aye Yasrib walo, humne apni sawaariyon ke jigar unki taraf nahi phaade magar iski jaankaari mein ke woh Allah ke Rasool hain, aur aaj unhein nikaalna (yahan lekar aana) puri Arab qaum se juda hona hai, aur tumhare behtareen logon ka qatl, aur talwaar tumhein chubhegi, isliye ya to tum aise log ho jo isspar sabr karoge jab yeh tumhein pesh aaye, aur apne behtareen logon ke qatl aur puri Arab qaum se judaai par, to isse le lo, aur tumhara ajr Allah par hai, ya phir tumhein apni jaanon ka khauf hai, to isse chhod do, yeh Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek (bhi) uzr hai." To unhone kaha: "Aye Sa'd, apna haath humse hataao, Allah ki qasam, hum yeh baiyat nahi chhodenge aur na hi isse wapas mangenge." Unhone kaha: to hum unke paas aik-aik aadmi ke roop mein gaye, unhone humse ahd liya taake usse humein Jannat mile.

e: [AI] "Between the night of al-Aqaba and the migration of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, there were three months or close to it. The allegiance of the Ansar to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took place on the night of al-Aqaba in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived in Medina in the month of Rabi al-Awwal."
hi: "Laylat-ul-Aqabah aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki hijrat ke darmiyan teen (3) mahine ka faasla tha, ya iske qareeb, aur Ansar ki Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat Laylat-ul-Aqabah, Zil-Hajjah mein hui, aur Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah Rabi-ul-Awwal ke mahine mein tashreef laaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to the leaders of the Ansar, "Do you shelter and prevent me?". They replied, "Yes, then what is our reward?" He said, "Paradise."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ansar ke naqeebon (sardaaron) se poocha: "Kya tum mujhe panaah doge aur meri hifaazat karoge?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, to humein kya milega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat."

e: [AI] "He said: The first of those who came to us from the emigrants to Madinah were Mus'ab ibn 'Umair and Ibn Umm Maktum. They would recite the Quran to us. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived, and I had already recited Surah al-Ala and a portion of Surah al-Mufassal. Then Sa'd ibn Malik and 'Amr ibn Yasir arrived, and then 'Umar ibn al-Khattab arrived after twenty. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived, and we were overjoyed by nothing but the arrival of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The women and children started rushing, saying, 'This is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .'"
hi: Unhone kaha: sabse pehle jo hum tak Madinah aaye Muhajireen mein se woh Mus'ab bin Umair (RA) aur Ibn Umm Maktoom (RA) the, woh humein Quran padhaate the. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) tashreef laaye, aur maine 'Sabbih Isma Rabbikal-A'la' aur Mufassal ki kuch Surahen pehle hi padh li thin, phir Sa'd bin Malik aur Ammar bin Yasir (RA) aaye, phir Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) bees (20) logon ke sath aaye, phir Rasulullah (SAW) tashreef laaye, to humein Rasulullah (SAW) ke aane jitni khushi kisi cheez se nahi hui, auraten aur bachche daudte huay kehte the: "Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) hain, yeh Rasulullah (SAW) hain."

e: [AI] I asked Urwah bin Zubair: "How long did the Prophet ﷺ  stay in Makkah?" He replied, "For ten years." I said, "But Ibn Abbas says that he stayed for thirteen years." He said, "Ibn Abbas took that from the saying of a poet." Sufyan bin Uyaynah said that Yahya bin Sa'id narrated, "I heard an old woman from the Ansar saying, 'I saw Ibn Abbas seeking knowledge from Surmah bin Qais and learning these verses.' 'He stayed in Quraysh for thirteen years, reminding people about the truth, but he did not find any followers or supporters. When he came to us, and the news spread about him, he became happy and content. He did not fear the darkness of any oppressor, nor did he fear any evildoers among the people. We expended our wealth and our own selves in support of him during times of strife and calamity. We opposed everyone who opposed him with the truth, even if they were our loved ones. We know that there is nothing else besides Allah, and that the Book of Allah has become a guide.'"
hi: Maine Urwah bin Zubair se poocha: "Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein kitne saal rahe?" Unhone kaha: "Das (10) saal." Maine kaha: "Ibn Abbas (RA) kehte hain: 'Woh terah (13) saal se kuch zyada rahe.'" Unhone kaha: "Unhone yeh baat aik shaayar ke qaul se li hai." Sufyan bin Uyainah ne kaha: Yahya bin Sa'eed ne humein bataaya, unhone kaha: maine Ansar ki aik boodhi aurat ko kehte suna: "Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko Sirmah bin Qais ke paas aate-jaate dekha, unse yeh ash'aar seekhte huay: 'Woh Quraish mein terah (13) saal se kuch zyada thehre, doston ko yaad dilaate huay agar unhein koi wafaadaar dost mil jaaye, aur mausamon ke logon ke saamne apni jaan pesh karte, magar unhein koi panaah dene wala ya bulaane wala na mila. Jab woh humare paas aaye aur unka thikaana ban gaya, aur woh Taibah (Madinah) mein khush aur raazi ho gaye, aur woh kisi door ke zaalim ke zulm se na darte aur na kisi sarkash insaan se, humne unhein apne bohot se maal mein se diya aur apni jaanein jung aur museebaton mein pesh ki, hum unse dushmani karte hain jo sab logon mein se unse dushmani karein, chahe woh humara mohabbat karne wala dost hi kyun na ho, aur hum jaante hain ke Allah ke siwa koi cheez nahi, aur Allah ki Kitaab hidayat dene wali ban chuki hai.'"

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ stayed in Makkah for fifteen years, seven of which he could see the light and hear the sound. He stayed in Madinah for ten years.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein pandrah (15) saal rahe, saat (7) ya aath (8) saal wahi ki roshni dekhte aur aawaaz sunte rahe, aur Madinah mein das (10) saal rahe." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "That Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, allowed His Prophet ﷺ  to reside in Makkah for thirteen years."
hi: "Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko Makkah mein terah (13) saal ki umr ata ki."

e: [AI] "The Prophet said, 'Indeed, Allah, the Almighty, revealed to me that one of these three lands is your destination of migration: either Madinah, or Bahrain, or Qinnasrin.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala ne meri taraf wahi ki hai ke in teen shehron mein se jismein bhi tum utroge, wahi tumhari hijrat ka ghar hoga - Madinah, ya Bahrain, ya Qinnasreen."

e: "The Prophet ﷺ was in Makkah, then Hijrah was ordered, so the following was revealed to him: Say: 'My Lord! Let my entry be good, and likewise my exit be good. And grant me from You a helping authority (17:80).'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3139)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah mein thay, to unhein hijrat ka hukum diya gaya, aur unpar yeh nazil hui: "{Aur kaho: Aye mere Rab, mujhe achhe tareeqe se dakhil kar aur achhe tareeqe se nikaal, aur apne paas se meri madad ke liye aik ghalib taaqat ata kar}" (Surah Al-Isra 80).

e: [AI] Regarding the statement of Qatadah, may Allah exalt him, "And say: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit. And grant me from Yourself a supporting authority" (Quran 17:80), Allah brought him out of Makkah to Madinah, a sound exit, and He caused him to enter Madinah through a sound entrance. Qatadah said, "The Prophet ﷺ knew that he would not have any power over this matter except through authority, so he asked for a supporting authority to the Book of Allah, the limits set by Allah, the obligations of Allah, and the establishment of the Book of Allah. And the Sultan, the authority, is a glory from Allah that He placed among His creatures. If not for that, some would envy others, and the strong among them would oppress the weak."
hi: Qatadah se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Aur kaho: Aye mere Rab, mujhe achhe tareeqe se dakhil kar aur achhe tareeqe se nikaal}" (Surah Al-Isra 80) ke baare mein, "to Allah ne unhein Makkah se achhe tareeqe se nikaala aur Madinah mein achhe tareeqe se dakhil kiya." Unhone kaha: "Aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko yeh pata tha ke unke paas is maamle ki taaqat nahi hai siwaye kisi ghalib iqtidaar ke, isliye unhone Allah ki Kitaab, Allah ki hudood, aur Allah ke faraaiz ke liye, aur Allah ki Kitaab qaayam karne ke liye aik madadgaar taaqat maangi, aur beshak iqtidaar Allah ki taraf se aik izzat hai jo usne apne bandon ke darmiyan rakhi hai, aur agar aisa na hota to unme se kuch doosron par hamla-aawar hote aur unke taaqatwar unke kamzoron ko khaa jaate."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Allah, You have taken me out of the dearest of places to me, so make the dearest of places to You for me." So Allah made him reside in the city of Madinah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, tu ne mujhe us shehar se nikaala hai jo mujhe sabse zyada aziz tha, isliye mujhe us shehar mein basaa jo tujhe sabse zyada aziz ho," to Allah ne unhein Madinah mein basaaya. Fabricated.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said to the Muslims, "I have seen the place of your migration; I saw a barren land with two date palm trees."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Musalmano se farmaya: "Mujhe tumhari hijrat ki jagah dikhaayi gayi hai, mujhe do (kaali patthar wale) tibbon ke darmiyan khajooron wali aik shor (numak-zada) zameen dikhaayi gayi hai," aur yeh do Harratein hain.

e: [AI] Shara Ali bought himself a garment similar to the Prophet's ﷺ  and then went to sleep in his place. The idolaters used to throw insults at the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and at that time, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was wearing a cloak. The Quraysh wanted to kill the Prophet ﷺ , so they started throwing stones at Ali, thinking it was the Prophet ﷺ . When they saw that it was Ali wearing the cloak and that the Prophet ﷺ  was not present, they said to Ali, "You are a lowly person! You wear the cloak and yet your friend (the Prophet) does not wear it. We are disappointed in you."
hi: Ali (RA) ne apni jaan qurbaan ki aur Nabi (SAW) ka kapda pehna, phir unki jagah so gaye, aur mushrikeen Rasulullah (SAW) par patthar phenk rahe the, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein aik chaadar pehnaayi thi, aur Quraish Nabi (SAW) ko qatl karna chahte the, to woh Ali (RA) par patthar phenkte rahe yeh samajh kar ke woh Nabi (SAW) hain, jinhone chaadar pehni thi, aur Ali (RA) taklif se karvaten badalte rahe, to (aakhirkaar) unhein pata chala ke yeh Ali (RA) hain. To unhone kaha: "Tum bohot neech (aadmi) ho, tum takleef se karvaten badal rahe ho, jabke tumhara saathi karvaten nahi badalta tha, aur humein tumse yeh baat napasand lagi."

e: [AI] "And Ali said by the side of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on his bed, long poem, 'I protected myself better than the one who walks on rocks and the one who circumambulates the ancient house, the Messenger of Allah who was afraid that they would plot against him, so the One with long wiliness saved him from the plot, and the Messenger of Allah spent the night in the cave safely protected by Allah and concealed. I stayed guarding them, and they did not accuse me, and I had prepared myself for killing and imprisonment.'" (This is a translation of the provided text)
hi: Aur Ali (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke bistar par sote waqt shairi mein kaha: "Maine apni jaan se bachaaya us behtareen shakhs ko jisne kankar par qadam rakha, aur jisne purane ghar (Ka'bah) aur Hajr-e-Aswad ka tawaf kiya, Allah ke Rasool ko, jinhein darr tha ke woh unke sath makr karengay, to Allah, buland martabe wale, ne unhein makr se bachaaya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne ghaar mein mehfooz, bacha-bachaaya, aur Allah ki hifaazat aur parde mein raat guzaari, aur maine unhein (mushriko ko) dekhte huay raat guzaari, unhone mujhpar shak nahi kiya, jabke maine apne aap ko qatl aur qaid ke liye taiyaar kar liya tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When it was the night that the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) commanded me to sleep on his bed and he left Makkah as an emigrant, the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) set off with me to the idols and said, "Sit." So I sat by the side of the Ka'bah. Then the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) climbed on my shoulders and said, "Stand up." So I stood up with him. When he saw my weakness beneath him, he said, "Sit." So I sat down and he descended from me and sat beside me. Then he said to me, "O Ali, climb on my shoulders." So I climbed on his shoulders, then the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) stood up with me and it was suggested to me that if I wanted, I could reach the sky and climb to the Ka'bah. The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) moved aside and I threw down their biggest idol. It was made of copper and mounted on iron pegs to the ground. Then the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said to me, "Treat it." So I treated it and I continued treating it while the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) was saying, "Yes, yes." I kept treating it until I overpowered it. Then the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Strike it." So I struck it and broke it, then I descended.
hi: Jab woh raat aayi jismein Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ke main unke bistar par soun aur woh Makkah se hijrat karke nikle, to Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe buton ke paas le gaye aur farmaya: "Baith jao," to main Ka'bah ke pehlu mein baith gaya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) mere kandhon par chadhe, phir farmaya: "Uth jao," to main unhein lekar utha, jab unhone dekha ke main unke neeche kamzor pad raha hoon, to farmaya: "Baith jao," to main baith gaya aur unhein apne oopar se utaara, aur Rasulullah (SAW) mere liye baith gaye, phir mujhse farmaya: "Aye Ali, mere kandhon par chadho," to main unke kandhon par chadha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe lekar uthe, aur mujhe aisa lagne laga jaise agar main chaahoon to aasman ko chhoo loon, aur main Ka'bah par chadh gaya, Rasulullah (SAW) alag ho gaye, to maine unka sabse bada but zameen par phenk diya, jo taambe ka tha aur zameen mein loha ke khootnon se gaada hua tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Isse hilaao," to maine ise hilaana shuru kiya, aur main isse hilaata raha jabke Rasulullah (SAW) kehte jaate: "Eeh, eeh," to main isse hilaata raha yahan tak ke mujhe isspar qaaboo mil gaya, phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse tod do," to maine isse tod diya aur usse tukde-tukde kar diya, phir main neeche utra.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to Gabriel ﷺ , "Who will migrate with me?" He replied, "Abu Bakr as-Siddiq."
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Jibra'il (AS) se poocha: "Kaun mere sath hijrat karega?" Unhone kaha: "Abu Bakr As-Siddiq."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  set out from Mecca to Medina and Abu Bakr was with him, Abu Bakr carried all his wealth, which was five or six thousand dirhams. Then my grandfather, Abu Qhafa, came to me, although he had lost his sight, and he said, "By Allah, he has saddened you with his wealth, taking it with him." I said, "No, father, he has left us with plenty of goodness." I went to some rocks and placed them in a corner of the house, and Abu Bakr used to store his wealth there. I covered the rocks with a cloth and then I took my grandfather by the hand and placed it on the cloth. He said, "Indeed, if he has left all this, then it is good." She said, "By Allah, he did not leave a little or a lot."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah se Madinah ki taraf mutawajjeh huay aur unke sath Abu Bakr (RA) thay, to Abu Bakr (RA) apna poora maal apne sath le gaye, paanch ya chhah hazaar dirham, to mere daada Abu Quhaafa mere paas aaye, jinki nazar ja chuki thi, unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, isne tumhein apna maal apne sath lekar takleef dedi hai." Maine kaha: "Hargiz nahi, Aye abba, unhone humare liye bohot khair chhodi hai." To maine kuch patthar liye aur unhein ghar ke roshan-daan mein rakh diya, aur Abu Bakr (RA) apna maal usme rakha karte the, aur maine patharon par aik kapda daal diya, phir main aayi aur unka haath pakad kar kapde par rakh diya, unhone kaha: "Agar unhone yeh chhod diya hai, to theek hai." Unhone kaha: "Aur Allah ki qasam, unhone thoda ya zyada, kuch bhi (waqai) nahi chhoda tha."

e: [AI] Men mentioned the time of Umar, as if they preferred Umar over Abu Bakr. Umar heard that and said, "By Allah, a night from Abu Bakr is better than the family of Umar, and a day from Abu Bakr is better than the family of Umar. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once went to the Cave, and with him was Abu Bakr. He started walking ahead for an hour, and then walked behind for an hour until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  noticed and asked, 'O Abu Bakr, why are you walking ahead and then behind?' Abu Bakr replied, 'O Messenger of Allah, I think about seeking and then I follow you. Then I think about being cautious, so I walk ahead of you.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, 'O Abu Bakr, if there was something you would prefer to have without me?' Abu Bakr said, 'Yes, by the One who sent you with the truth, I would not wish to be a leader without you.' When they arrived at the Cave, Abu Bakr said, 'Stay in your place, O Messenger of Allah, so I can search the Cave and make sure it is safe for you.' Abu Bakr entered and searched until he reached the top, but he did not search the chamber. He said, 'Stay in your place, O Messenger of Allah, so I can search the chamber.' Abu Bakr entered and searched, and then he said, 'Descend, O Messenger of Allah.' The Prophet descended, and Umar said, 'By the One who holds my soul in His hand, that night was indeed better than the family of Umar.'"
hi: Umar (RA) ke zamane mein kuch logon ne baat ki, goya unhone Umar (RA) ko Abu Bakr (RA) par fazeelat di, unhone kaha: to yeh baat Umar (RA) tak pahunchi, unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Abu Bakr (RA) ki aik raat Aal-e-Umar se behtar hai, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ka aik din Aal-e-Umar se behtar hai, Rasulullah (SAW) ghaar ki taraf nikle jabke unke sath Abu Bakr (RA) thay, to woh kabhi unke aage aur kabhi unke peechhe chalte rahe, yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ko iska ehsaas hua aur poocha: 'Aye Abu Bakr, tumhein kya hua ke tum kabhi mere aage aur kabhi mere peechhe chalte ho?' Unhone kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe (pichhe se) taaqub ka khayal aata hai, to main aapke peechhe chalta hoon, phir mujhe (aage se) taak-jhaank ka khayal aata hai, to main aapke aage chalta hoon.' Aap (SAW) ne poocha: 'Aye Abu Bakr, kya tum chahte ke agar koi museebat aaye to woh mujhe chhod kar tumhein pesh aaye?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan, us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, koi bhi museebat aisi na hoti jo mujhpar aati, siwaye is ke ke woh aap ke bajaaye mujhpar hi aati.' Jab dono ghaar tak pahunche, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: 'Yahin theheriye, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), jab tak main aapke liye ghaar ko theek se dekh loon.' To woh dakhil huay aur usse jaanch li, jab woh uske upar tak pahunche to unhein yaad aaya ke unhone kamre (hujra) ko theek se nahi dekha, to unhone kaha: 'Yahin theheriye, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), jab tak main kamre ko theek se dekh loon,' to woh dakhil huay aur usse jaanch liya, phir kaha: 'Utar aayen, Ya Rasulullah (SAW),' to woh utre." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, woh raat Aal-e-Umar se behtar hai."

e: [AI] He informed him that he heard Suarqa bin Ju'shum saying: "Messengers of the disbelievers of Quraysh came to us and made a bounty for every one of them who kills or captures the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Abu Bakr. While I was sitting in a gathering of my people from the Banu Mudad, a man from them approached us and stood before us and said, 'O Suarqa! I saw something dark like a moth on the shore, and I saw it being Muhammad and his companions.' Suarqa replied, 'I recognized that it was them,' so I said to them, 'It is not them, but I saw so and so and so and so heading towards you as bandits.' Then, I did not sit in the gathering for more than an hour until I got up and entered my house, and I ordered my maidservant to bring my horse to me, which was behind a wall. So, she kept it confined for me. I took my spear and came out of the back of the house and started dragging its end on the ground and raising its tip. I came to my horse and mounted it and it started bringing me closer to them. When I approached them and heard their recitation of the Qur'an while not looking at me, my horse stumbled and I fell off it. Then, I stood up and dusted my hands and started pulling my spear out of its sheath. The two men [i.e., Muhammad and Abu Bakr] were somewhat hasty, so they started their horses and my hands recoiled [from the spear], and I had barely finished withdrawing my hands when their horses’ reins came off of their hands [and they fell to the ground]. When they were standing on their own again, I came close to them, but it occurred to me (when I met their captives) that it would be disgraceful for me to betray them. So, I said: 'I think that your people have made a bounty for you, and I have informed them of their travel and what people intend to do with them. I have even offered them your provisions and belongings, but they were not interested in them nor did they ask me anything except to conceal the matter.’ So, I requested the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to write a document of protection for me that I would rely on.' So, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded 'Amir bin Fuhayrah, the servant of Abu Bakr, to write a document of protection for me on a piece of parchment made of leather."
hi: Suraqah bin Ju'shum (RA) ko kehte suna: Quraish ke kaafiron ke qaasid humare paas aaye, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) ko qatl ya qaid karne wale ke liye har aik par diyat (inaam) muqarrar ki, to jabke main apni qaum, Banu Mudlij, ki aik majlis mein baitha tha, unme se aik aadmi hamari taraf aaya, hum par khada hua aur kaha: "Aye Suraqah, maine abhi saahil par kuch saaye dekhe hain, mujhe lagta hai Muhammad (SAW) aur unke saathi hain." Suraqah ne kaha: to mujhe pata chal gaya ke yeh woh hi hain, maine unse kaha: "Yeh woh nahi hain, balke maine fulan aur fulan ko dekha hai, woh (kisi zaroorat mein) nikle huay hain." Unhone kaha: phir main majlis mein sirf thodi der hi tha ke main khada hua aur apne ghar mein dakhil hua, maine apni laundi ko hukum diya ke woh mera ghoda nikaale, jo aik tibbe ke peechhe tha, aur usse mere liye rok kar rakhe, aur maine apna neza (bhala) liya aur ghar ke peechhe se nikla, maine iski nok se zameen par lakeer khainchi aur neze ke oopari hisse ko jhukaaya, yahan tak ke main apne ghode tak pahuncha, main uspar sawaar hua, aur usse tez dauraaya jo mujhe unke qareeb le jaaye, yahan tak ke maine unke saaye dekh liye, jab main unke itne qareeb hua ke woh meri awaaz sun sakein, mera ghoda mujhe lekar thokar khaa gaya aur main uspar se gir gaya, main utha aur apna haath apne teer-daan (kinaanah) ki taraf badhaaya, azlaam (fal nikaalne wale teer) nikaale aur unse fal nikaala, to woh (fal) nikla jo mujhe napasand tha - ke main unhein nuqsaan na pahunchaaun, to maine azlaam ki na-farmani ki aur apne ghode par sawaar hua, usse tez dauraaya jo mujhe unke qareeb le jaaye, yahan tak ke jab main unke qareeb hua, "maine Nabi (SAW) ki qiraat suni, aur woh mudkar nahi dekh rahe the," aur Abu Bakr (RA) baar-baar mudkar dekh rahe the, mere ghode ke dono haath zameen mein dhaans gaye yahan tak ke ghutnon tak pahunche, main uspar se gira, phir maine use daanta, to woh utha, magar apne haath mushkil se nikaal saka, jab woh seedha khada hua to uske haathon ke nishaan se aik dhuaan aasman mein buland hota huan dikha. Abdullah ne kaha, ya'ni woh dhuaan jo bagair aag ke hota hai. Phir maine azlaam nikaale aur unse fal nikaala, to woh (fal) nikla jo mujhe napasand tha - ke main unhein dono ko nuqsaan na pahunchaaun, to maine unhein aman ki pukaar lagaayi, woh ruk gaye, maine apna ghoda sawaar kiya yahan tak ke unke paas pahuncha, jab main unhein rok kar unse mila to mere dil mein aa gaya ke ankareeb Rasulullah (SAW) ka maamla ghaalib aayega, maine unse kaha: "Aapki qaum ne aapke liye diyat muqarrar ki hai," aur maine unhein unke safar ki khabrein bataayin aur log unke sath kya karna chahte hain, aur maine unhein zaad-e-raah aur saaman pesh kiya, unhone mujhse kuch bhi nahi liya aur mujhse kuch nahi maanga, siwaye is ke ke unhone kaha: "Humein chhupaaye rakhna." To maine Rasulullah (SAW) se darkhwaast ki ke woh mere liye aik amaan-naama likh den jispar main bharosa kar sakoon, "to unhone Aamir bin Fuhairah (RA) ko, jo Abu Bakr (RA) ke ghulam thay, hukum diya," unhone mere liye chamde ke aik tukde par likh diya, phir dono chal pade.

e: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he was on his she-camel, standing in Al-Hazwarah* saying: ‘By Allah, you are the best land of Allah, and the dearest of the land of Allah to me. By Allah, had I not been expelled from you I would never have left.’” *A place in Makkah. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3108)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha jabke woh apni sawaari par Al-Hazwarah mein farma rahe the: "Allah ki qasam, tu Allah ki zameen mein sabse behtareen zameen hai, aur mujhe Allah ki zameen mein tu sabse aziz hai, aur agar mujhe tujhse na nikaala gaya hota to main na nikalta."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  left Makkah, Abu Bakr said, "Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return." [Quran 2:156] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was expelled to be destroyed, so this verse was revealed, "Permission [to fight] has been granted to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory. Those who have been expelled from their homes unjustly" [Quran 22:39-40]. Abu Bakr realized that there would be a battle.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah se nikle, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "{Beshak hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf hume lautna hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 156), Rasulullah (SAW) ko nikaala gaya hai, woh zaroor halaak ho jaayenge. Unhone kaha: to yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Un logon ko ijaazat di gayi jinke khilaaf jung ki jaati hai kyunke unpar zulm kiya gaya, aur beshak Allah unki madad par qaadir hai, woh log jinhein unke gharon se na-haq nikaala gaya}" (Surah Al-Hajj 39-40), Abu Bakr (RA) ko pata chal gaya ke ab jung hogi.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  left the cave, emigrating, and Abu Bakr and 'Amir ibn Fuhayrah accompanied him, Abu Bakr followeed him and Abdullah ibn Urayqit al-Laythi followed behind Abu Bakr. He took them below Makkah and continued with them until he descended with them onto the coast below 'Usfan. Then he guided them to descend below 'Amaj, and then he crossed the path after passing Qudayd. Then he took them through al-Hijaz, and then he crossed them through Thaniyyat al-Mirar. Then he guided them through al-Hafya, and then he crossed them through Mudlijah Liqf, and then he concealed himself with them in Mudlijah Majah, and then he guided them through Madhij, and then through the belly of Dhi al-Ghushn, and then through the belly of Dhi Kashd. Then he took the jubbajibah, and then he passed through the path of Sulm from the upper belly of Mudlijah. Then he took the pathway, and then he descended into al-'Arj, and then he guided them through Thaniyyat al-Gha'ir on his right side. Then he descended in Batn Rima, and arrived in Quba' upon the Bani 'Amr ibn 'Awf."
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ghaar se hijrat karte huay nikle, unke sath Abu Bakr (RA) aur Aamir bin Fuhairah (RA) thay, Abu Bakr (RA) unke peechhe sawaar the aur unke peechhe Abdullah bin Uraiqit Al-Laithi (raasta dikhaane wala) tha, to woh unhein lekar Makkah ke neechle hisse se guzre, phir unhein lekar aage badhe yahan tak ke Usfaan se neechle saahil par utre, phir unhein Amaj ke neechle hisse se guzaara, phir Qudayd guzarne ke baad raaste ko baayen mudk gaye, phir unhein Hijaz se guzaara, phir unhein Saniyyah Al-Mirar se guzaara, phir unhein Al-Hafya se guzaara, phir unhein Mudlijah Liqf se guzaara, phir unhein Mudlijah Majaah ke andar se le gaye, phir unhein Madhaj se guzaara, phir Zi Al-Ghusn ki taraf Madhaj ke andarooni hisse se, phir Zi Kashd ke andarooni hisse se, phir Al-Jubaajib ka raasta liya, phir Mudlijah ke upari andarooni hisse se Zi Salam ka raasta liya, phir Al-Qaahah ka raasta liya, phir Al-Arj mein utre, phir apni sawaari ke dayen taraf Saniyyah Al-Ghaair se guzre, phir Batn Reem mein utre, phir Quba pahunch gaye, Banu Amr bin Awf ke paas."

e: [AI] When the Prophet ﷺ  and Abu Bakr set out, disguised, they passed by a shepherd tending to his sheep. They asked him for some milk, but he said that he did not have any sheep that could be milked, except for a pregnant ewe that was carrying the first of winter, and it had already dried up and had no milk left. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Bring it here." So he called for it, and the Prophet ﷺ  touched its udder and prayed until its udder filled with milk. Then Abu Bakr brought a vessel and milked it, and he gave some milk to the shepherd who then drank. The shepherd said, "By Allah, I have never seen anyone like you before." The Prophet ﷺ  asked him, "Do you recognise me, or did someone inform you about me in secret?" The shepherd replied, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ  then said, "Then I am Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah." The shepherd said, "You are the one whom the Quraysh claim is a sorcerer." The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "They indeed say that." The shepherd said, "I bear witness that you are a prophet, and I bear witness that what you have brought is the truth, and no one does what you do except a prophet. I am your follower." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "You will not be able to come on this day. But when you hear that I have appeared, come to us."
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) chhupte huay chal rahe the, to woh aik ghulam ke paas se guzre jo bakriyaan charaa raha tha, unhone usse doodh maanga, usne kaha: "Mere paas koi doodh dene wali bakri nahi hai, siwaye is ke ke yahan aik bacchi (aanaaq) hai jise sardiyon ki shuruaat mein hamal hua tha, aur woh kamzor hai, uska koi doodh baaqi nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse bulaao." To usne use bulaaya, Nabi (SAW) ne usse pakda aur uska thaan sehlaaya aur dua ki yahan tak ke usne doodh diya. Unhone kaha: aur Abu Bakr (RA) aik bartan lekar aaye, to unhone (khud) doodh nikaala, phir doodh nikaala aur charwaahe ko pilaaya, phir doodh nikaala aur (khud) piya. Charwaahe ne poocha: "Allah ki qasam, aap kaun hain? Allah ki qasam, maine aapke jaisa kabhi nahi dekha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum sochte ho ke tum mera raaz rakhoge agar main tumhein bataaun?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To main Muhammad, Allah ka Rasool hoon." Usne poocha: "Kya aap wohi hain jinke baare mein Quraish kehti hai ke woh (deen se) mudh gaye hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh yehi kehte hain." Usne kaha: "To main gawahi deta hoon ke aap Nabi hain, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke jo aap laaye hain woh haq hai, aur jo aapne kiya woh sirf koi Nabi hi kar sakta hai, aur main aapki pairavi karta hoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aaj tum aisa nahi kar sakoge, jab tumhein khabar mile ke main zaahir ho chuka hoon to humare paas aa jaana."

e: [AI] From his father Hisham ibn Hubaysh ibn Khuwaylid, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ left Makkah as an emigrant to Madinah, and Abu Bakr and the slave of Abu Bakr, 'Amir ibn Fuhayrah, and their guide, Laysiyyu 'Abdullah ibn Urayqit, passed by the tent of Umm Ma'bad Al-Khuzaiyyah. She was a widow who lived in a dilapidated tent, and she would milk and feed the people, but when they asked her for meat and dates to buy from her, they found nothing with her. And the people were stingy and miserly. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a sheep in the corner of the tent and asked, "What is this sheep, O Umm Ma'bad?" She said, "It is a sheep that has been left behind by the flock." He asked, "Does it produce any milk?" She said, "It is weaker than that." He said, "May I milk it?
hi: Apne waalid, Hisham bin Hubaish bin Khuwailid (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi, se, ke Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah se Madinah ki taraf hijrat karte huay nikle, unke sath Abu Bakr (RA), Abu Bakr (RA) ke ghulam Aamir bin Fuhairah (RA), aur unka raasta dikhaane wala Abdullah bin Uraiqit Al-Laithi the, woh Umm Ma'bad Al-Khuza'iyah ke do khaimon (tambuu) ke paas se guzre, aur woh aik baahar niklne wali, hoshiyaar aurat thin jo khaime ke saamne baithkar (musaafiron ko) paani pilaati aur khaana khilaati thin, unhone unse gosht aur khajoor maangi taake woh unse khareed sakein, magar unhein unke paas usme se kuch na mila, aur log qaht-zada, tang-dast the. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne khaime ke aik kone mein aik bakri dekhi, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Umm Ma'bad, yeh bakri kaisi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh aik aisi bakri hai jo kamzori ki wajah se rewad se peeche reh gayi." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya isme doodh hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh to isse bhi zyada kamzor hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya aap mujhe ijaazat deti hain ke main isse doodh nikaalun?" Unhone kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan, agar aap isme doodh dekhein to zaroor doodh nikaalen." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse bulaaya, apne haath se uska thaan sehlaaya, Allah Ta'ala ka naam liya, aur uski bakri ke liye dua ki, to woh unke liye apne pair phailaane lagi aur usne doodh diya, phir usne pageer (jugali) ki, to aap (SAW) ne aik bartan mangwaaya jo aik giroh ko seer kar sake, usme itni tez dhaar se doodh nikaala ke uspar jhaag chha gayi, phir unhone Umm Ma'bad ko pilaaya yahan tak ke woh seer ho gayin, aur apne saathiyon ko pilaaya yahan tak ke woh seer ho gaye, aur sabse aakhir mein khud piya yahan tak ke sab aaraam se ho gaye, phir doosri baar usme se dhaar se doodh nikaala yahan tak ke bartan bhar diya, phir usse unke paas chhod diya, phir unse baiyat li aur unke paas se rukhsat huay. Kuch hi der baad unke shohar Abu Ma'bad aaye, kamzor bakriyon ko hankte huay, jo dubli-patli thin, jinme kam gooda tha, jab Abu Ma'bad ne doodh dekha to unhein achha laga, unhone poocha: "Yeh tumhare paas kahan se aaya, Aye Umm Ma'bad, jabke bakriyaan bahar chuki hain, koi doodh nahi de rahin, aur ghar mein bhi koi doodh dene wali nahi?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, siwaye is ke ke humare paas se aik barkat wala aadmi guzra tha, uska haal aisa-aisa tha." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe unka wasf bataao, Aye Umm Ma'bad." Unhone kaha: "Maine aik aisa aadmi dekha jinke chehre par saaf-safaai zaahir thi, roshan chehre wale, achhe akhlaaq wale, na unme kisi (moti) pait ki kami thi na sar ki chhoti kami unhein bad-numa banaati thi, khoobsurat, khush-numa, unki aankhon mein siyaahi thi, aur unki palkein lambi thin, unki awaaz mein narmi thi, unki gardan lambi thi, unki daadhi ghani thi, unke bhaunwein kamaan jaisi milau thi, jab khamosh rehte to unpar waqar hota, aur jab baat karte to unki baat sab par chha jaati aur unhein noor aur khoobsurati se buland karti, sabse khoobsurat aur door se sabse zyada roshan, aur qareeb se sabse achha aur khoobsurat, meethi, faisla-kun baat karne wale, na kam boltay na fuzool, goya unki baat moti pirovi hui ho jo lagataar utarti ho, darmiyani qad ke, na lambaai unhein khraab karti na chhotaapan unhein kam karta, do shaakhon ke beech ki aik shaakh (yani do saathiyon ke beech), jo teenon mein sabse taaza aur behtareen the, unke sathi unke ird-gird ghere rehte, jab woh baat karte to sunte, jab hukum dete to jaldi karte, khidmat ki jaati, koi tursh-mizaaji na koi tanqeed." Abu Ma'bad ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yehi Quraish ka woh saathi hai jiske baare mein humein bataaya gaya tha jo bataaya gaya, aur maine socha ke main unke sath jaaun, aur zaroor karunga agar mujhe koi raasta mila." Aur subah Makkah mein aik buland aawaaz aayi, log aawaaz sunte magar samajhte nahi kaun keh raha hai, woh keh raha tha: "Allah, logon ka Rab, apne behtareen badle se un do saathiyon ko badla de jo Umm Ma'bad ke do khaimon mein utre, woh unme hidayat lekar utre, aur unhone hidayat paayi, kaamyaab hua woh jo Muhammad (SAW) ka saathi bana, aye Qusay ke logo, Allah ne tumse kaisa (bhalaai ka amal) roka jiska koi badla aur izzat na ho, Abu Bakr (RA) ko unki sohbat ke sadqe unke daada ki khush-naseebi mubarak ho, jise Allah khush-naseeb kare woh khush-naseeb ho jaata hai, Banu Ka'b ko unki jawaan ladki ki jagah aur uski baithak mubarak ho, jo momino ke liye khaas jagah par hai, apni behn se uski bakri aur bartan ke baare mein poocho, agar tum bakri se poochoge to woh khud gawahi degi, unhone usse aik doodh na dene wali bakri se bulaaya, to usne kholi hui dhaar se doodh diya us bakri ke thaan se jo jhaag-daar thi, phir usne isse aik dhoodh nikaalne wale ke liye rehan chhod diya jo isse mansha ke baad mansha tak wapas laata rahega." Jab Hassan (RA) ne ghaib se aawaaz karne wale (haatif) ki yeh baat suni, to unhone jawaab mein shairi kahi: "Yaqinan woh log naakaam ho gaye jinse unke Nabi hat gaye, aur woh paak-baaz hai jo unke paas raat aur din chalkar aata hai, woh un logon se rawaana huay jinki aqal gumraah ho gayi thi, aur aik nayi roshni ke sath aik doosri qaum par utara, unke Rab ne unhein gumraahi ke baad hidayat di isi (Nabi) ke zariye, to usne unhein sahi raah dikhaayi, aur jo haq ki pairavi kare woh sahi raah paata hai, kya kabhi barabar ho sakte hain gumraah log jo andhepan mein bewaqoof bane rahe aur hidayat yaafta log jo hidayat paane wale ke zariye hidayat paate hain, aur unse Yasrib walon par hidayat ki sawaariyaan utar chuki hain jo unpar sabse khush-naseeb tareeqe se utri hain, aik Nabi jo woh dekhta hai jo uske ird-gird log nahi dekhte, aur woh har jagah Allah ki Kitaab tilawat karta hai, aur agar woh kisi din kisi ghaib ki baat kahe, to uski tasdeeq usi din ya agli subah ho jaati hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out one night migrating, and he mentioned the hadith at length, similar to the hadith of Sulaiman ibn Al-Hakam. As for the well-known hadith of Al-Khaymatayn (the two tents), its narrators have already mentioned it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik raat hijrat karte huay nikle, phir hadith poori tafseel se zikr ki, Sulaiman bin Al-Hakam ki hadith ki tarah, aur rahi baat 'Do Khaimon' wali mash-hoor hadith ki, jo iske raawiyon mein maroof hai, to woh pehle hi zikr ho chuki hai.

e: [AI] About his father, they mentioned the hadith in great detail, similar to the narration of Abi Ma'bad. So I asked our Sheikh Abi Bakr al-Qatti'i: Did he hear it from Mukram? He said: Yes, by Allah, my father performed Hajj and I was only seven years old, so he took me to Mukram ibn Muhriz and there was nothing in these routes on the condition of authenticity.
hi: Apne waalid se, unhone poori hadith isi tarah zikr ki jaise Abu Ma'bad ki hadith mein hai. Maine apne shaykh, Abu Bakr Al-Qati'i, se poocha: "Kya aapne yeh Mukram se suni?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Allah ki qasam, mere waalid mujhe Hajj par le gaye jab main saat (7) saal ka tha, unhone mujhe Mukram bin Muhriz ke paas dakhil kiya." In tareeqon mein Sahih ki shart par koi cheez nahi.

e: [AI] He met the caravan of Muslims who were traders from Sham (Syria), leaving from Makkah. They encountered the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Abu Bakr wearing white garments when they heard about their departure. When the Muslims in Madinah heard about the arrival of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , they used to go every morning to the outskirts, waiting for him until the heat of noon harmed them. One day, after waiting for a long time, they returned to their homes. Then, a blind Jewish man from the tribe of Banu Adh-Dhakwān said that he would go and see who it was. When he looked at the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his companions dressed in white, the mirage disappeared from him. The Jewish man could not hold back and shouted in a loud voice, "O people of the Arabs, this is your awaited companion!" The Muslims then rushed to gather their weapons and received the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  at the outskirts.
hi: Ke woh Musalmano ke us qaafile se mila jo Sham (Syria) mein tijaarat karte the, Makkah se wapas aa rahe the, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) ka safed kapdon mein saamna kiya jab unhone unke nikalne ki khabar suni. Jab Madinah ke Musalmano ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke nikalne ki khabar suni, to woh har subah Harrah ki taraf jaate aur unka intezaar karte yahan tak ke dopahar ki garmi unhein takleef deti, aik din woh der tak intezaar karne ke baad wapas laut aaye, jab woh apne gharon mein pahunche, to Yahoodiyon mein se aik aadmi apne kilon mein se aik kile par chadha taake dekh sake, usne Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke saathiyon ko safed kapdon mein dekha jinhein saraab hilaa raha tha, to woh Yahoodi apni buland awaaz se keh uthta: "Aye Arab logo, yehi hai tumhara saathi jiska tum intezaar kar rahe ho." To Musalman hathiyaaron ki taraf daude aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka Harrah ke peechhe se istiqbaal kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered the Masjid of Bani Amr ibn Auf while it was the Quba Mosque where he used to pray. Then some men from the Ansar entered and greeted him. Ibn Umar said, "Suhaib also entered with them, so I asked him, 'How did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  respond when greeted while he was in prayer?' He said, 'He used to gesture with his hand.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Banu Amr bin Awf ki masjid, jo Masjid-e-Quba hai, mein dakhil huay, aap (SAW) usme namaz padh rahe the, to Ansar ke kuch log unke paas dakhil huay unhein salaam karne, Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: aur unke sath Suhaib (RA) bhi dakhil huay, maine unse poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) kya karte the jab unhein namaz mein salaam kiya jaata?" Unhone kaha: "Woh apne haath se ishara karte."

e: "My father said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever goes out to his Masjid - the Masjid of Quba' and prays therein, that will be equivalent to 'Umrah.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 699)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi nikle yahan tak ke is masjid mein aaye," ya'ni Masjid-e-Quba, "aur usme namaz padhe, to yeh aik Umrah ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] Because praying in the Quba Mosque is dearer to me than praying in the Al-Masjid al-Aqsa.
hi: "Masjid-e-Quba mein namaz padhna mujhe Bait-ul-Maqdis ki masjid mein namaz padhne se zyada aziz hai."

e: [AI] He said, "I witnessed the day when the Prophet ﷺ  entered the city of Medina, and I have never seen a day better or brighter than that day."
hi: Unse, unhone kaha: "Main us din maujood tha jab Nabi (SAW) Madinah mein dakhil huay, maine kabhi koi din isse zyada khoobsurat aur roshan nahi dekha."

e: [AI] "And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ continued until he reached Medina, and the people came out until we entered the road, and the women, servants, and young boys were shouting, "Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, Allah is the Greatest! Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah!" When he woke up in the morning, he set out and stopped where he was commanded."
hi: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) chalte rahe yahan tak ke Madinah pahunch gaye, aur log baahar nikal aaye yahan tak ke hum raaste mein dakhil ho gaye, aur auraten, khadim, aur bachche cheekh uthe: 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool aa gaye, Allahu Akbar, Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool aa gaye,' jab subah hui to woh chal pade aur jahan hukum diya gaya wahan utre."

e: “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Al-Madinah, the people rushed towards him and it was said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has come!’ I came along with the people to see him, and when I looked at the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I realized that his face was not the face of a liar. The first thing he said was: “O people, spread (the greeting of) Salam, offer food to people and pray at night when people are sleeping, you will enter Paradise in peace.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1334)
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah pahunche, to log unki taraf daude, kaha gaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) aa gaye." Unhone kaha: to main logon mein shaamil hokar dekhne aaya, jab maine unka chehra dekha, to mujhe pata chal gaya ke yeh chehra kisi jhoote ka chehra nahi hai, aur pehli baat jo maine unhein kehte suna woh yeh thi: "Aye logo, salaam phailaao, khaana khilaao, sila-e-rahmi (rishtedaari ke rishte) qaayam rakho, aur raat ko namaz padho jabke log so rahe hon, tum salaamati ke sath Jannat mein dakhil hoge."

e: [AI] From the ship of the master of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , it is narrated that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  built the mosque, Abu Bakr came with a stone and placed it, then Umar came with a stone and placed it, then Uthman came with a stone and placed it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "These are the leaders after me." This is an authentic Hadith with a sound chain of narration, and it was not narrated by Sahih.
hi: Safinah (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghulam, se, unhone kaha: jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne masjid banaayi, to Abu Bakr (RA) aik patthar lekar aaye aur usse rakha, phir Umar (RA) aik patthar lekar aaye aur usse rakha, phir Uthman (RA) aik patthar lekar aaye aur usse rakha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh mere baad Ummat ke wali (hukmaraan) hain." Yeh hadith sahih isnad wali hai, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "People made a mistake in counting, not in his allegiance or his death, but rather in counting from the beginning of the city."
hi: "Logon ne ginti mein ghalti ki, unhone na baiyat se ginti ki na wafaat se, balke unhone unke Madinah pahunchne se ginti ki."

e:
[AI] The translation of the Arabic sentence "كَانَ التَّارِيخُ فِي السَّنَةِ الَّتِي قَدِمَ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ وَفِيهَا وُلِدَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ" into English is:

"The history was in the year in which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived in Medina and in which Abdullah ibn Zubair was born."
hi: "Taareekh (calendar) us saal se shuru ki gayi jismein Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah tashreef laaye, aur isi saal Abdullah bin Zubair (RA) paida huay."

e: [AI] "Ali ibn Abi Talib, from the day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  emigrated and left the land of paganism, Omar did the same."
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (RA): "Us din se jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne hijrat ki aur shirk ki zameen ko chhoda," to Umar (RA) ne aisa hi kiya.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made bonds of brotherhood among his Companions. So 'Ali came crying saying: "O Messenger of Allah! You have made a bond of brotherhood among your Companions, but you have not made a bond of brotherhood with me and anyone." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "I am your brother, in this life and the next." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3720)
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah tashreef laaye, to unhone apne sahaba ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, to Ali (RA) aankhon mein aansoo liye aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne apne sahaba ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, lekin mere aur kisi ke darmiyan nahi kiya." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ali, tum duniya aur Aakhirat mein mere bhai ho." Salim bin Abi Hafsah ne Jumai' se, siyaaq mein izaafe ke sath, unki mutaabi'at ki.

e: [AI] Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ fostered brotherhood between his companions, fostering brotherhood between Abu Bakr and Umar, between Talhah and Zubayr, and between Uthman bin Affan and Abdul Rahman bin Awf. Then Ali said, "O Messenger of Allah, you have fostered brotherhood between your companions, so who is my brother?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do you not agree, O Ali, that I should be your brother?" Ali, who was a courageous and strong man, said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "You are my brother in this world and the Hereafter."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, to unhone Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ke darmiyan, Talhah (RA) aur Zubair (RA) ke darmiyan, aur Uthman bin Affan (RA) aur Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA) ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, to Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne apne sahaba ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, to mera bhai kaun hai?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum raazi nahi, Aye Ali, ke main tumhara bhai banoon?" Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: aur Ali (RA) taaqatwar, bahaadur thay, to Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum duniya aur Aakhirat mein mere bhai ho." Jumai' bin Umair par ilzaam hai aur Ishaq bin Bishr Al-Kaahili halaak (matrook) hain.

e: [AI] The man from among us, when he arrived in the city, would have a guide who would take him to his accommodation. And if he did not have a guide in the city, he would stay in a spot designated for travelers. When I arrived, I stayed in the designated spot and the Prophet ﷺ  used to pass by us every day, distributing a whole date to each person that passed between two of us. He would also provide us with blankets to cover ourselves. The Prophet ﷺ  led some of the daytime prayers with us. After he finished, the people of the designated spot called out to him saying, "O Messenger of Allah, the dates are burning our stomachs and the blankets are wearing thin." The Prophet ﷺ  went to his pulpit, praised Allah and spoke about the difficulties he and his companions faced until he said, "It has come to me and my companion (referring to Abu Bakr) only a few dates, and nothing to eat except barley bread." I asked my father, Abu Harb, what "al-Bareer" (mentioned by the Prophet) was, and he said, "It is the food of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , the dates of the date palms." We then came to our brothers from the Ansar, and their food was mainly dates. They shared their dates with us, saying, "By Allah, if I had bread and meat, I would make you full with it. But perhaps you will have a time when you have only a handful to eat and feel full, and another time when you have something to rest upon." They asked the Prophet, "O Messenger of Allah, are we better today or were they (the Ansar) better that day?" The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "Nay, rather you are better today. You are today a people who love one another, while they (the Ansar) were a people who were aloof from one another." Uraha said, "I think he said, 'who used to detest one another." This is the wording of the hadith narrated by Abu Sahl Al-Qattan and the wording of the hadith narrated by Yahya bin Yahya in abbreviated form.
hi: Humme se jab koi Madinah aata, agar uska koi jaanne wala hota to woh uske paas thehar jaata, aur agar koi jaanne wala na hota to woh Suffah mein thehar jaata, to main aaya aur Suffah mein thehar gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf se roz humein aik mudd (naap) khajoor do logon ke darmiyan milti, aur woh humein khokhle (khardaar chappal) pehnaate the. Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein din ki kuch namaz padhaayi, jab woh salaam pher chuke, to Suffah walon ne dayen-baayen se unhein pukaara: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), khajoor ne humara pait jala diya hai aur khokhle humse phat gaye hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) apne mimbar ki taraf muda, uspar chadhe, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir apni qaum se pesh aayi sakhti ka zikr kiya yahan tak ke farmaya: "Aur beshak mujhpar aur mere saathi (Abu Bakr) par das se zyada (din) guzar chuke, aur mere paas aur unke paas khaane ko sirf beri ke patte the." Unhone kaha: maine (raawi ne) Abu Harb se poocha: "Beri ke patte kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ka khaana, jangli beri ki khajoor." "To hum apne in Ansar bhaiyon ke paas aaye, aur unka zyaadatar khaana khajoor thi, unhone humein isme sath diya, Allah ki qasam, agar mere paas tumhare liye roti aur gosht hota to main tumhein isse seer kar deta, lekin shaayad tum aisa zamana paao jismein tum mein se kisi ke paas subah aik thaali laayi jaaye aur shaam ko doosri." Unhone kaha: to unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aaj hum behtar hain ya woh din?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balke aaj tum behtar ho, aaj tum aapas mein mohabbat karne wale ho, aur us din tum mein se kuch doosron ki gardanein maarte the," mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha: "Aapas mein nafrat karne wale." Yeh Abu Sahl Al-Qattan ki hadith ke alfaaz hain, aur Yahya bin Yahya ki hadith mukhtasar hai.

e: "The people of As-Suffah were the guests of the people of Islam,they had nothing of people nor wealth to rely upon. And By Allah, the One Whom there is none worthy of worship besides Him – I would lay on the ground on my liver (side) due to hunger, And I would fasten a stone to my stomach out of hunger. One day I sat by the way that they (the Companions) use to come out through. Abu Bakr passed and so I asked him about an Ayah from Allah's Book, not asking him except that he might tell me to follow him (for something to eat). But he passed on without doing so. Then ʿUmar passed, so I asked him about an Ayah from Allah's Book, not asking him except that he might tell me to follow him. But he passed on without doing so. Then Abul-Qasim ﷺ passed, and he smiled when he saw me, and said: 'Abu Hurairah?' I said: 'I am here O Messenger of Allah!' He said: 'Come along.' He continued and I followed him, he entered his house, so I sought permission to enter, and he permitted me. He found a bowl of milk and said: 'Where did this milk come from?' It was said: 'It was a gift to us from so – and – so.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'O Abu Hurairah' I said: 'I am here O Messenger of Allah!' He said: 'Go to the people of As-Suffah to invite them.' - Now, they were the guests of the people of Islam, they had nothing of people nor wealth to rely upon. Whenever some charity was brought to him, he would send it to them without using any of it. And when a gift was given to him ﷺ, he would send for them to participate and share with him in it. I became upset about that, and I said (to myself): 'What good will this bowl be among the people of As-Suffah and I am the one bringing it to them?' Then he ordered me to circulate it among them (So I wondered) what of it would reach me from it, and I hoped that I would get from it what would satisfy me. But I would certainly not neglect to obey Allah and obey His Messenger, so I went to them and invited them. When they entered upon him they sat down. He said: 'Abu Hurairah, take the bowl and give it to them.' So I gave it to a man who drank his fill, then he gave it to another one, until it ended up with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and all of the people had drank their fill. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the bowl, put it on his hand,then raised his head. He smiled and said: 'Abu Hurairah, drink.' So I drank, then he said: 'Drink.' I kept drinking and he kept on saying, 'Drink.' Then I said: 'By the One Who sent you with the truth! I have no more space for it.' So he took the bowl and praised Allah, mentioned His Name and drank.'” (Sahih) (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2477)
hi: Suffah wale Islam ke mehmaan the, unka koi ghar wala na maal tha, aur us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, main bhook se apna jigar zameen par tikaa deta tha, aur bhook ki wajah se apne pait par patthar bandhta tha, aik din main un logon ke raaste par baitha jinse woh guzarte the, to Abu Bakr (RA) mere paas se guzre, maine unse Allah ki Kitaab ki aik ayat ke baare mein poocha, sirf isliye ke woh mujhe apne sath le jaayen, magar woh guzar gaye aur aisa na kiya. Phir Umar (RA) guzre, maine unse Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab ki aik ayat ke baare mein poocha, sirf isliye ke woh mujhe apne sath le jaayen, magar woh bhi guzar gaye aur aisa na kiya. Phir Abul-Qasim (SAW) guzre, jab unhone mujhe dekha to muskuraaye aur poocha: "Abu Hurairah?" Maine kaha: "Labbaik, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Chalo," aur aage badh gaye, main unke peechhe chala, woh apne ghar mein dakhil huay, maine ijaazat maangi, unhone ijaazat de di, unhein aik pyaale mein doodh mila, unhone poocha: "Yeh doodh tumhare paas kahan se aaya?" Kaha gaya: "Fulan ne hume tohfe mein diya hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Hurairah," maine kaha: "Labbaik." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suffah walon ke paas jaao aur unhein bulaao, kyunke woh Islam ke mehmaan hain, unka koi ghar wala na maal hai." Jab unke paas sadqa aata, to woh use unhi ki taraf bhej dete aur khud usme se kuch na lete, aur jab unke paas tohfa aata, to woh unke paas bhejte, khud usme se kuch lete aur unhein bhi shaamil karte, to yeh mujhe bura laga aur maine (dil mein) socha: "Yeh pyaala Suffah walon ke beech mein kya cheez hai, aur main unke paas iske paighaam-bar (bhejne wale) ke roop mein jaaunga, aur mujhe hukum diya jaayega ke main isse unke darmiyan ghumaaun, to mujhe isme se kya milega, jabke main ummeed rakh raha tha ke mujhe isme se itna mile jo mujhe kaafi ho jaaye? Aur Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaa'at ke ilawa koi chaara na tha, isliye main unke paas gaya, unhein bulaaya, jab woh dakhil huay aur apni jagah baithe, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Abu Hirr, pyaala lo aur unhein do.' Maine pyaala liya aur aik aadmi ko dene laga, woh peeta yahan tak ke seer ho jaata, phir wapas kar deta, aur doosre ko deta woh peeta, yahan tak ke main isse Rasulullah (SAW) tak le aaya jabke sab log seer ho chuke the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne pyaala liya, apne haathon par rakha, phir apna sar meri taraf uthaaya, muskuraaye aur farmaya: 'Aye Abu Hirr,' maine kaha: 'Labbaik, Ya Rasulullah (SAW).' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Baitho aur piyo,' to maine piya, phir farmaya: 'Piyo,' to maine piya, phir farmaya: 'Piyo,' to maine piya, main pita raha aur aap kehte rahe: 'Piyo,' yahan tak ke maine kaha: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, ab isme jagah nahi,' to unhone pyaala liya, Allah ki hamd ki, Allah ka naam liya, phir piya." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise is siyaaq mein nahi nikala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "The people of the attribute were indeed seventy men who do not have robes."
hi: "Ashab-e-Suffah sattar (70) aadmi the, unke paas koi chaadar (rida) na thi."

e: [AI] I heard Sahl bin Abdullah Al-Tustari say, when Allah, the Almighty, sent the Prophet ﷺ , there were seven types of people in the world: kings, farmers, livestock owners, merchants, craftsmen, employees, and the weak and the poor. He did not command any of them to leave what they were doing, but he commanded them to seek knowledge, certainty, righteousness, and to rely on Him in all that they were in. Sahl (may Allah have mercy on him) said, "It is appropriate for a wise person to say, what is expected of me after my knowledge is that I am Your servant, hoping and relying on no one other than You, and not seeking help from anyone besides You since it is You who created me and fashioned me to be Your servant, so entrust me to myself or take charge of my affairs other than You."
hi: Maine Sahl bin Abdullah At-Tustari ko kehte suna: jab Allah Ta'ala ne Nabi (SAW) ko bheja, to duniya mein log saat (7) tarah ke the - baadshah, kisaan, jaanwar palne wale, tijaarat karne wale, hunar-mand, ujrat par kaam karne wale, aur kamzor-gareeb log, unme se kisi ko bhi Allah ne yeh hukum nahi diya ke woh apni haalat badle, balke unhein ilm, yaqeen, taqwa, aur tawakkul ka hukum diya jismein bhi woh thay. Sahl (Allah unpar reham kare) ne kaha: "Aur aql-mand ko yeh kehna chahiye: mujhe apne banda honay ke ilm ke baad kya sazaawaar hai ke main tere siwa kisi doosre se ummeed aur khwaahish rakhun, aur tere baare mein yeh gumaan na karun, jabke tu ne mujhe apna banda banaakar paida kiya aur meri soorat banaayi, ke tu mujhe mere haal par chhod de ya mere maamlaat kisi doosre ke supurd kar de."

e:
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 

"The best of my Ummah (people) are those whom the noble angels informed me about. They are a people who laugh openly due to the abundance of their Lord's mercy, and they weep secretly out of fear of the severity of their Lord's punishment. They remember their Lord in the mornings and evenings in their pure homes, mosques. They supplicate to Him willingly and fearfully with their tongues, and they seek His protection with their hands, humbling themselves and raising them. They approach Him with their hearts, turning to Him completely. Their dealing with people is light and easy, but with themselves, it is serious and heavy. They tread upon the earth barefoot, humble like ants, without arrogance or pride. They walk with tranquility and draw near to Allah through means of obedience. They recite the Quran and bring themselves closer to Allah through sacrifice. They adorn themselves with the two characteristics granted by Allah, that is, presence to witness and observing eyes. They take lessons from their fellow creatures, and they contemplate upon the conditions of lands and the souls in this world, while their hearts are set on the Hereafter. They have no concern except their Imam (leader). They prepare their provisions for their graves, make arrangements for their journey, and get ready for their destination." 

Then the Messenger of Allah recited the verse, 

"That is [giving] to those who fear My position and fear the threat [of punishment]." [Surah Ibrahim: 14]
