hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat ke behtareen log, jinke baare mein mujhe buland ma'la (farishton ke aala tabqe) ne khabar di, aisi qaum hai jo apne Rab, buzurg aur buland, ki wus'at-e-rehmat mein khule taur par hansti hai, aur apne Rab ki azaab ki shiddat ke darr se chhup kar roti hai, apne Rab ko subah-shaam achhe, paak gharon - masjidon - mein yaad karte hain, aur apni zubaanon se usse pukarte hain khwaahish aur khauf ke sath, aur apne haathon se usse maangte hain neeche kar ke aur upar utha kar, aur apne dilon se usse mutawajjeh hote hain baar-baar, to unka bojh logon par halka hai aur unpar khud par bhaari, woh zameen par nange pair chalte hain jaise chiontiyon ka chalna, bagair kisi khushi-farmaani ya ghuroor ke, sukoon ke sath chalte hain, aur waseela (Allah ke qareeb honay ka zariya) ke zariye qareeb hote hain, aur Quran padhte hain aur qurbani (namaz mein pesh hone wali cheezein) qareeb karte hain, aur purane kapde pehante hain, unpar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hazir shahadaten aur hifaazat karne wali nazar hai, woh bandon ko pehchaante hain aur shehron mein sochte hain, unki roohein duniya mein hain aur unke dil Aakhirat mein, unhein apne imam (Allah) ke siwa koi fikr nahi, unhone apni qabron ke liye saaman aur apne raaste ke liye zaad-e-raah taiyaar kar liya hai, aur apne maqaam ke liye taiyaari kar li hai," phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh padhi: "{Yeh us shakhs ke liye hai jo mere saamne khade honay se dara, aur meri dhamki se dara}" (Surah Ibrahim 14).

e: [AI] "What was revealed in Medina, O you who have believed, and what was revealed, O people, in Mecca, about which Al-Dhahabi remained silent in summarizing."
hi: Jo bhi "{Aye imaan walo}" (ayat) hai, woh Madinah mein nazil hui, aur jo bhi "{Aye logo}" (ayat) hai, woh Makkah mein nazil hui. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "We read the detailed (chapter) and we performed the pilgrimage in Mecca, O believers."
hi: "Humne Mufassal (chhoti Surahen) kuch waqt padhi, aur humne Makkah mein Hajj kiya, isme 'Aye imaan walo' (jaisi ayaten) nahi thin."

e:
[AI] Atika, the daughter of Abdul Muttalib, saw a dream that alarmed her. It was about a man named Dammam bin Amr Al-Ghifari. He appeared to be a terrifying figure to the Quraysh in Makkah for three consecutive nights. Atika became greatly disturbed by this dream and sent a message to her brother, Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib, informing him about it. 
She said, "Oh, my brother, I had a dream last night that frightened me. It indicated that your people will face harm and calamity. The man in the dream approached on a camel and stopped at Aabtah. He then called out, 'O deceitful family of Ghadr, prepare yourselves in three.' I saw people gathering around him, and then he entered the mosque with his camel. The people gathered around him again. Suddenly, he reached the top of the Kāba and called out, 'O deceitful family of Ghadr, prepare yourselves in three.' Then his camel appeared on top of Abi Qubays, and he called out once again, 'O deceitful family of Ghadr, prepare yourselves in three.' He then picked up a rock and sent it rolling down the mountain. It kept rolling until it reached the bottom, destroying every house and building of your people. 
Al-Abbas said, "By Allah, this is indeed a vision. Conceal it." She said, "And you, conceal it. If this reaches the people of Quraysh, they will harm us." So Al-Abbas left her and met Walid ibn Utbah, who was his friend. He mentioned it to him and entrusted him with it. Walid mentioned it to his father, and the news spread. Al-Abbas said, "By Allah, I will go to the Kāba to circumambulate it." When I entered the mosque, there was Abu Jahl with a group from Quraysh talking about Aatikah's vision. 
Abu Jahl said, "O Abu al-Fadl, when did this prophetess say this to you?" I replied, "And what is that?" He said, "A vision seen by Atika, the daughter of Abdul-Muttalib. Have you, sons of Abdul-Muttalib, consented that your men should prophesy until even your women prophesy? We will wait for these three that Atika mentioned. If it is true, it will happen, and if not, we will write a document against you, for you are the most lying household in the Arab land. By Allah, there is no significant matter except that I have denied what she said. I said, 'She saw nothing, and I heard nothing like this.'"
By evening, every woman from the Banu Abdul Muttalib came to me, blaming me for not preventing this corrupted man from causing harm to our men and approaching our women. They said, "Didn't you have any sense of honor?" I replied, "By Allah, you speak the truth. I had doubts, but if he repeats this, I will handle him."

I sat there, waiting for the third day to confront him and make him say something. I cursed him in my heart, thinking that it was better to confront him than to curse him. Suddenly, I heard Ḍamḍam bin Amr reciting verses while standing on his camel at Aabtah. He had unraveled his turban and torn his shirt. He referred to the people of Mecca, saying, "Oh, deceitful and sinful Quraysh, your wealth is with Abu Sufyan, and your trade has been taken by Muhammad and his companions. Seek help from the devil." He then continued to recite for some time. This distracted me, and I only had my device until we left the city. 
Quraish suffered a great loss that day, as they had in the Battle of Badr. They lost many noble people and their best warriors. Atika, the daughter of Abdul Muttalib, said, "Wasn't the dream true and did it not warn you? You said that it wasn't true, and I didn't lie. Whoever denies the truth is indeed a liar."
hi: Atikah (RA) bint Abdul Muttalib ne Damdam bin Ghifari ke Quraish ke paas Makkah mein aane se teen raat pehle, khwaab mein aik sapna dekha, to Atikah ki subah hui aur woh usse bohot bada samajhne lagin, unhone apne bhai Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ko bulawa bheja, unse kaha: "Aye mere bhai, maine raat aik aisa khwaab dekha jisne mujhe daraa diya, isse tumhari qaum par zaroor koi buraai aur museebat aayegi." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Maine khwaab mein dekha ke aik aadmi apne oont par aa raha tha, woh Al-Abtah mein khada hua aur kaha: 'Aye dhoke-baaz khaandan walo, teen (dinon) mein apni maut ki jagah ki taraf nikal jao,' to maine log usse jama hote dekhe, phir maine dekha uska oont use lekar masjid mein dakhil hua, log usse jama huay, phir uska oont usse le kar Ka'bah ke sar tak chadha, usne kaha: 'Aye dhoke-baaz khaandan walo, teen (dinon) mein apni maut ki jagah ki taraf nikal jao,' phir uska oont usse Abu Qubais pahaad ki chooti par le gaya, usne kaha: 'Aye dhoke-baaz khaandan walo, teen (dinon) mein apni maut ki jagah ki taraf nikal jao,' phir usne aik chattaan liya aur usse pahaad ki choti se chhod diya, woh giri, yahan tak ke jab woh pahaad ke neechle hisse mein pahunchi, to woh tukde-tukde ho gayi, to tumhari qaum ka koi ghar ya makaan aisa na bacha jismein uska koi tukda dakhil na hua ho." Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh to zaroor koi khwaab hai, isse chhupaao." Unhone kaha: "Aur tum bhi isse chhupaana, agar yeh Quraish tak pahunch gaya to woh humein takleef denge." To Abbas (RA) unke paas se nikle aur Walid bin Utbah se mile, jo unke dost the, unhone unhein yeh baat bataayi aur unse isse chhupaane ko kaha, to Walid ne yeh apne baap ko bataayi, usne isse aur logon se zikr ki, to baat phail gayi. Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main subah Ka'bah ka tawaf karne gaya, jab main masjid mein dakhil hua to achaanak Abu Jahl Quraish ke kuch logon ke sath Atikah ke khwaab ke baare mein baat kar raha tha. Abu Jahl ne poocha: 'Aye Abu Al-Fadl, yeh nabiyya (peshangoi karne wali) tum mein kab se paida hui?' Maine poocha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Usne kaha: 'Aik khwaab jo Atikah bint Abdul Muttalib ne dekha hai, kya tum, Aye Banu Abdul Muttalib, ismein raazi nahi ke tumhare mard nabuwwat ka daawa karein yahan tak ke ab tumhari auraten bhi nabuwwat ka daawa karti hain? Hum tumhare in teen dinon ka intezaar karengay jinka Atikah ne zikr kiya, agar yeh sach hua to theek, warna hum tum par yeh likh denge ke tum Arab mein sabse zyada jhoote khaandaan ho.' Allah ki qasam, mujhe isme koi badi baat nahi lagi siwaye is ke ke maine unki baat ka inkaar kiya, aur maine kaha: 'Unhone kuch nahi dekha aur maine yeh kuch suna nahi.' Jab shaam hui, to Banu Abdul Muttalib ki har aurat mere paas aayi aur kehne lagi: 'Kya tumne sabr kiya is buraai wale fasiq ke liye jo tumhare mardon par baat karta hai, phir auraton ki taraf mudk aata hai jabke tum sunte ho, tumhein isme koi ghairat nahi thi?' Maine kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, tumne sach kaha, mujhe isme koi ghairat nahi thi siwaye is ke ke maine uski baat ka inkaar kiya, agar woh dobara aisi baat kare to main usse zaroor sambhaal lunga.' To teesre din main baith gaya taake use kuch kehne ka mauqa milta hi main usse jawaab dun, Allah ki qasam, main uski taraf badh hi raha tha, aur woh sakht chehre, sakht nazar, sakht zubaan wala aadmi tha, ke woh masjid ke darwaze ki taraf tezi se mudh gaya, maine apne dil mein kaha: 'Aye Allah, ise la'nat de,' yeh sab is darr se ke main use bura-bhala kahoon, achaanak usne kuch aisa suna tha jo maine nahi suna tha - Damdam bin Amr ki awaaz, jo apne oont par Al-Abtah mein khada hokar, apna kaathi ulta karke, apni qamees phaad kar, aur apne oont ki naak kaat kar keh raha tha: 'Aye Quraish ke logo, tumhara qaafila, tumhara qaafila, tumhara maal Abu Sufyan ke sath hai, aur tumhari tijaarat par Muhammad (SAW) aur unke saathiyon ne hamla kar diya hai, madad ko aao.' To yeh use mujhse hataane mein masroof kar gaya, phir kuch aur na hua siwaye is ke ke saaman baandha gaya aur hum nikal pade, to Quraish ko woh museebat pahunchi jo unhein Badr ke din pahunchi thi - unke buzurgon ka qatl aur unke behtareen logon ki qaidi banaana." Atikah (RA) bint Abdul Muttalib ne kaha: "Kya khwaab sach nahi tha, aur uski tasdeeq ne tumhein aib-daar kiya, log mein se kam hi bhaagne wale bache, aur tum kehte the 'maine jhoot nahi bola,' (magar) tumne jhoot bola, aur sirf jhoota hi sach ko jhutlaata hai," aur aik lambi kahani zikr ki. Weak.

e: [AI] He (Zubayr) had with us only two horses, a horse for Zubayr and a horse for Miqdad bin Aswad, this means on the day of Badr.
hi: "Humare paas sirf do ghode the, aik ghoda Zubair (RA) ka aur aik ghoda Miqdad bin Al-Aswad (RA) ka," ya'ni Badr ke din.

e: [AI] We used to go on a camel every three days to Badr. Ali and Abu Lubabah, the acquaintances of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , were with us. When it was the turn of someone else to ride the camel, we would say, "Ride so that we may walk." And he would respond, "You are not stronger than me, and I am not more in need of the reward than you."
hi: Hum Badr ke din har teen aadmi aik oont par (baari-baari sawaar hote), unhone kaha: aur Ali (RA) aur Abu Lubabah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath baari lene wale the, unhone kaha: aur jab unki (sawaari ki) baari aati, to hum kehte: "Aap sawaar ho jayen, hum chalte hain," to aap (SAW) farmaate: "Tum dono mujhse zyada taaqatwar nahi ho, aur main sawaab (ajr) se tumse zyada be-niyaaz nahi hoon."

e: [AI] "They strived for it until the eleventh day remains their morning of the full moon."
hi: "Isse gyarahvin (11) raat ke liye talaash karo jiski subah Badr ka din hai."

e: [AI] "Seek the Night of Decree for the 19th morning of the day of Badr, the day of the Criterion, the day of the meeting of the two groups."
hi: "Laylatul-Qadr ko unnisvin (19) raat ke liye talaash karo, Badr ke din ki subah, Faisla-Kun din, jab do giroh aapas mein mile."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Bara' ibn 'Azib say, "The number of the immigrants (Muhajirun) on the Day of Badr was ninety-eight, and the number of the supporters (Ansar) was two hundred and forty-four."
hi: Maine Al-Bara bin Aazib (RA) ko kehte suna: "Muhajireen Badr ke din assi (80) se kuch zyada the, aur Ansar do sau chaalis (240) se kuch zyada the."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said on the day of Badr, when we lined up for battle against the Quraysh and they lined up against us, "When they overpower you, throw at them with stones."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din farmaya, jab hum Quraish se jung ke liye saf-bandh huay aur woh hamare saamne saf-bandh huay: "Jab woh tumhare qareeb aa jaayen, to unpar teer chalaao."

e: [AI] They said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "What do you say about these prisoners?" So Abd Allah bin Rawaha said, "Come into a valley with a lot of firewood, then set a fire and throw them into it." Al-Abbas said, "May Allah have mercy on you! O Messenger of Allah!" Umar said, "Their leaders and chiefs fought against you and denied you, so strike their necks." Abu Bakr said, "These are your relatives and people." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered to fulfill one of his needs, so a group of people said, "What did Umar say?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out and said, "What do you say about them? Indeed, the example of these people is like the example of a group of brothers before them. (Allah) said, '[Noah said], 'My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.'" (Quran 26) And (Moses) said, 'Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts.' (Quran 10) And (Abraham) said, 'Then whoever follows me - he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.'" (Quran 14) And (Jesus) said, 'If You should punish them - indeed they are Your servants; but if You forgive them - indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.'" (Quran 5) And you are a people who have a weakness, so no one among you will be spared except by a ransom or by a blow to the neck." Abd Allah said, "Except Suhail bin Bayda, as he should not be killed, and I have heard him speaking about Islam." So he kept silent. That day was the most fearful day for me, when I feared that stones would rain down on me from the sky, until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Except Suhail bin Bayda."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Tum in qaidiyon ke baare mein kya kehte ho?" To Abdullah bin Rawaha (RA) ne kaha: "Aik lakdi-bhari wadi mein jaayen, wahan aag jalayen, phir unhein usme phenk dein." To Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah aapki rishtedaari kaate!" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh unke sardaar aur peshwa hain, unhone aapse jung ki aur aapko jhutlaaya, isliye unki gardanein maar dein." Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh aapke rishtedaar aur qaum hain." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) apni kisi zaroorat ke liye andar gaye, to aik giroh ne kaha: "Baat wahi hai jo Umar (RA) ne kahi." To Rasulullah (SAW) bahar aaye aur poocha: "Tum inke baare mein kya kehte ho? Beshak inki misaal unke un bhaiyon jaisi hai jo unse pehle guzar chuke - Nuh (AS) ne kaha: {Aye Rab, zameen par kaafiron mein se aik bhi rehne wala mat chhod}," Musa (AS) ne kaha: "{Aye humare Rab, unke maal mita de aur unke dilon ko sakht kar de}" (Surah Yunus 88) ayat, aur Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: "{To jo koi meri pairavi kare woh mujhse hai, aur jo mujhse na-farmani kare to beshak tu bakhshne wala, reham karne wala hai}" (Surah Ibrahim 36), aur Isa (AS) ne kaha: "{Agar tu unhein azaab de to woh tere hi bande hain, aur agar tu unhein bakhsh de to beshak tu hi Azeez, Hakeem hai}" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 118), "aur tum aisi qaum ho jismein narmi hai, isliye tum mein se koi bhi na lautey siwaye fidya dekar ya gardan maar kar." Abdullah ne kaha: to maine kaha: "Siwaye Suhail bin Baidha ke, kyunke usse qatl nahi kiya jayega, maine usse Islam ki baat karte suna hai." To aap (SAW) khamosh ho gaye, aur mujhpar us din se zyada khauf-naak koi din na tha ke mujhpar aasman se patthar giren, yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Siwaye Suhail bin Baidha ke."

e: [AI] "When he arrived in Al-Madina with the prisoners, Sawda bint Zam'a, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , was with the family of the Banu 'Afrah in their camp in A'wuf and Mu'awwadh, the sons of 'Afrah. This was before the veil was prescribed for them. Sawda said, 'By Allah, I was with them when we were brought [to Al-Madina], and it was said, "These are the prisoners who have been brought." So I returned to my house, where the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  was present. Suddenly, Abu Yazid Suhail bin 'Amr was seen in the corner of the room, with his hands tied together around his neck with a rope. By Allah, I have never experienced fear like the moment I saw Abu Yazid like that. I asked, "Abu Yazid, have you given them your own hands? So would you not die as a noble person?" I did not calm down until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  spoke from the house, saying, "O Sawda, may Allah and His Messenger protect you." Upon hearing this, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I swear by the One who sent you with the truth, I was frightened when I saw Abu Yazid with his hands tied around his neck with a rope, so I said what I said.""
hi: Woh (Quraish) qaidiyon ko lekar aaye jab unhein Madinah laaya gaya, aur Sawdah (RA) bint Zam'ah, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, Aal-e-Afra ke paas, unke matam mein, Awf aur Mu'awwidh, Afra ke betay, ki maut par thin, aur yeh unpar parda farz karne se pehle ki baat hai. Sawdah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main unke paas hi thi ke humein khabar di gayi aur kaha gaya: yeh qaidi le aaye gaye hain. To main apne ghar wapas gayi jabke Rasulullah (SAW) usme the, achaanak Abu Yazid Suhail bin Amr kamre ke aik kone mein tha, uske dono haath rassi se uski gardan tak bandh diye gaye the, Allah ki qasam, jab maine Abu Yazid ko is haal mein dekha to main apne aap par qaaboo na rakh saki, maine kaha: 'Abu Yazid, tumne khud ko haathon ke hawaale kar diya, kyun na izzat se mar gaye?' Mujhe hosh tab aaya jab main Rasulullah (SAW) ki gharsi se yeh aawaaz suni: 'Aye Sawdah, Allah aur uske Rasool ke khilaaf?' To maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, main apne aap par qaaboo na rakh saki jab maine Abu Yazid ko rassi se bandhe huay dekha ke maine woh kaha jo maine kaha.'"

e: When the people of Mecca sent about ransoming their prisoners Zaynab sent some property to ransom Abul'As, sending among it a necklace of hers which Khadijah had had, and (which she) had given to her when she married Abul'As. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw it, he felt great tenderness about it and said: If you consider that you should free her prisoner for her and return to her what belongs to her, (it will be well). They said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made an agreement with him that he should let Zaynab come to him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent Zayd ibn Harithah and a man of the Ansar (the Helpers) and said: Wait in the valley of Yajij till Zaynab passes you, then you should accompany her and bring her back. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2692)
hi: Jab Makkah walon ne apne qaidiyon ke fidye ke liye (paighaam) bheja, to Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Zainab (RA) ne Abu Al-Aas ke fidye ke liye kuch maal bheja jisme aik haar tha jo Khadijah (RA) ne unhein di thi jab unhone Abu Al-Aas se nikah kiya tha. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne isse dekha, to unhein bohot narmi mahsoos hui, aur farmaya: "Agar tum theek samjho to iske qaidi ko chhod do aur iska (haq) usse wapas kar do." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse (Abu Al-Aas se) waada liya tha aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se wa'da kiya tha ke woh Zainab (RA) ko unki taraf aane dega.

e: [AI] Regarding the saying of Ibn Abbas about the verse of Allah Almighty: "If you have believed in Allah and what We sent down upon Our servant on the day of criterion," [Surah Al-Anfal 41]. He means by "the day of criterion" the day of Badr, the day when Allah distinguished between the truth and falsehood.
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Agar tum Allah par aur us cheez par imaan laaye ho jo humne Faisla-Kun din apne banda par nazil ki}" (Surah Al-Anfal 41) ke baare mein, "Faisla-Kun din" se murad Badr ka din hai, jis din Allah ne haq aur baatil ke darmiyan faisla kar diya.

e: [AI] "When it was the day of Uhud, the pagans retreated. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Stand still so that I may praise and glorify my Lord, the Almighty.' So they lined up behind him in rows, and he said, 'O Allah, to You is all praise. O Allah, there is no withholder for what You have provided, nor is there any provider for what You have withheld. There is no guide for the one You have led astray, nor is there any led astray for the one You have guided. There is no giver for the one You have prevented, nor is there any preventer for the one You have given. There is no one closer for the one You have distanced, nor is there any one farther for the one You have brought near. O Allah, bestow upon us the blessings, mercy, favor, and provision from You. O Allah, I ask You for everlasting bliss that does not fade or vanish. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You have given us and the evil of what You have withheld from us. O Allah, make faith beloved to us and embellish it in our hearts. Make disbelief, transgression, and disobedience hateful to us and make us among the righteous. O Allah, let us die as Muslims and let us live as Muslims. And join us with the righteous, without disgrace or trial. O Allah, fight against the disbelievers who deny Your messengers and turn people away from Your path. And impose upon them Your torment and punishment, O Lord of Truth. Amen."
hi: Jab Uhud ka din hua, to mushrikeen peeche hat gaye, Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Seedhe khade ho jao taake main apne Rab, buzurg aur buland, ki tareef karoon." To woh unke peechhe saf-bandh ho gaye, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, teri hi hamd hai puri ki puri, Aye Allah, koi rokne wala nahi jo tu phailaaye, aur koi phailaane wala nahi jo tu roke, aur koi hidayat dene wala nahi jise tu gumraah kare, aur koi gumraah karne wala nahi jise tu hidayat de, aur koi dene wala nahi jise tu roke, aur koi rokne wala nahi jise tu de, aur koi qareeb karne wala nahi jise tu door kare, aur koi door karne wala nahi jise tu qareeb kare, Aye Allah, hum par apni barkatein, apni rehmat, apna fazl, aur apna rizq phaila de, Aye Allah, main tujhse hamesha rehne wali ne'mat maangta hoon jo na palti na khatam ho, Aye Allah, main tujhse khauf ke din aman maangta hoon, Aye Allah, main us cheez ki buraai se panaah maangta hoon jo tu ne humein di hai aur us cheez ki buraai se jo tu ne humein rok di hai, Aye Allah, humein imaan aziz kar aur usse humare dilon mein sajaa de, aur kufr, fisq, aur na-farmani ko humein napasand karwaa de, aur humein hidayat-yaafta logon mein se bana, Aye Allah, humein Musalman hone ki haalat mein wafaat de aur Musalman rakh kar zinda rakh, aur humein saaleheen mein shaamil kar, na zaleel na fitne mein daale huay, Aye Allah, un kaafiron se jung kar jo tere Rusul ko jhutlaate hain aur tere raaste se rokte hain, aur unpar apna azaab aur apna ghazab utaar, Aye haq ke Ma'bood, Ameen."

e: [AI] Ali came with his sword on the day of Uhud, he had bent it. So he said to Fatimah, "Grasp the sword beautifully, for it has hurt me." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, "If you wish to learn how to wield the sword, Sahl bin Hunayf, Abu Dujanah, Asim bin Thabit, Al-Harith bin As-Simah have excelled in it."
hi: Ali (RA) apni talwaar lekar aaye jo Uhud ke din mud gayi thi, unhone Fatimah (RA) se kaha: "Yeh talwaar lo, Humaid, isne meri shifaa ki hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumne apni talwaar se achha vaar kiya, to Sahl bin Hunaif (RA), Abu Dujanah (RA), Aasim bin Thabit Al-Aflaha (RA), aur Al-Harith bin As-Simmah (RA) ne bhi achha vaar kiya."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned, he gave his daughter Fatimah her sword and said, "O my daughter, clean this blood off." Ali then gave her his sword and said, "And clean off the blood from this one." By Allah, I have never witnessed a truer battle than today. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If you were truthful in battle today, then the battle adhered to the truth alongside you today: Sahal bin Hunayf and Usamah bin Haritha Abu Dujanah." Ibn Ishaq said, and Ali bin Abi Talib said when he handed Fatimah (may peace be upon her) the sword, "O Fatimah, hold the sword firmly without hesitation. I am not afraid nor weak. By my life, I have truly excelled in aiding Ahmad and seeking the pleasure of my Lord, who is merciful towards His servants." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) wapas laute, to unhone apni beti Fatimah (RA) ko apni talwaar di aur farmaya: "Aye meri beti, isse khoon se saaf karo." To Ali (RA) ne unhein apni talwaar di aur kaha: "Aur yeh (bhi), iska khoon saaf karo, Allah ki qasam, aaj is jung ne mujhe sacha (sabit) kiya hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum ne aaj jung mein sacha (sabit) hone ka saabit kiya, to tumhare sath Sahl bin Hunaif (RA) aur Simaak bin Kharshah Abu Dujanah (RA) ne bhi jung mein sachaai dikhaayi." Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: aur Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ne, jab unhone Fatimah (RA), Alayha As-Salam, ko talwaar di, kaha: "Aye Fatimah, yeh talwaar lo, bagair kisi burai ke, main na dara hua hoon na kanjoos, mujhe apni jaan ki qasam, maine Ahmad (SAW) ki madad mein aur us Rab ki raza mein jo apne bandon par reham karne wala hai, poori koshish ki." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "On the day of Uhud, this poem [al-Bahr al-Rajz] was revealed: We are the defenders of the victorious and the owner (leader) of the congregation. We strike with our swords today in battles, striking like the clanging of iron from al-Kawm with the Blessing of our Messenger, distancing harm from him. When the Prophet ﷺ  left on the day of Uhud, he said to Hassan, 'Recite about Talhah.' So Hassan started and said [al-Bahr al-Tawil], 'Talhah on the day of Sha'b, his spear pierced Muhammad, causing grief to the Beloved who was constricted and injured by swords. His courage was tested beneath the swords, but he did not fail. Muhammad was the leader of the people. He established the mill of Islam until it became independent.' The Dahabi did not mention it in his summary."
hi: Jab Uhud ka din hua, to unhone (aik aurat ne) yeh shairi (rajaz) padhi: "Hum Ghalib aur Malik ke hifaazat karne wale hain, hum apne barkat-wale Rasool ke liye jung karte hain, hum aaj maidan-e-jung mein unki taraf se hamla-aawar hote hain, jaise oonton ke chehre ki maar aaram-gaahon mein." Jab Nabi (SAW) Uhud ke din wahan se hate, to unhone Hassan (RA) se kaha: "Talhah ke baare mein kuch kaho." To Hassan (RA) ne yeh shairi banaayi: "Talhah ne ghati ke din Muhammad (SAW) ki madad ki, aik aise raaste par jo unpar tang aur mushkil ho gaya tha, apne dono haathon se unhein neze se bachaaya, aur unki ungliyaan talwaaron ke neeche laqwe-zada ho gayin, aur woh logon ke imam the, siwaye Muhammad (SAW) ke, unhone Islam ki chakki qaayam ki yahan tak ke woh khud-mukhtaar ho gayi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "So I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when he went to ascend to the rock, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  appeared between two shields, but he was unable to climb up to it. So Talhah ibn Ubaidullah sat beneath it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  got up until he reached it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Talhah has made it obligatory.'"
hi: To maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha jab woh chattaan ki taraf uthne lage, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne do zirahein pehni hui thin, to woh uski taraf uth na sake, to Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA) unke neeche baith gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) uthe yahan tak ke woh usspar seedhe khade ho gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Talhah ne (Jannat) laazim kar li."

e: [AI] "Tarha returned with thirty-seven or thirty-five strikes, stabs, and throws, his forehead was dotted and his index finger was cut off and the finger following it was paralyzed."
hi: "Talhah (RA) sattatees (37) ya paintees (35) zakhmon ke sath wapas aaye, maar, neze ki chot, aur teer ke daramiyaan, unki peshaani zakhmi hui, unki shahaadat wali ungli kaat di gayi, aur uske bagal wali ungli maflooj ho gayi."

e: [AI] About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , on the day of Uhud, I retreated and said to myself, "I will defend myself, either I will be martyred or I will be saved until I meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . While I was thinking this, a man with a covered face appeared, and I didn't know who he was. The pagans approached, and I said, "They have caught up with me." He filled his hand with pebbles and threw them at their faces, causing them to fall on their backs. This happened repeatedly, and I still didn't know who he was. Between me and him was Miqdad ibn Aswad, and while I wanted to ask Miqdad about him, Miqdad said, "O Sa'd! This is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  calling you." I asked, "Where is he?" Miqdad pointed towards him, so I stood up, as if I had not been harmed at all. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Where were you, O Sa'd?" I replied, "I was wherever I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He then made me sit in front of him, and I began to throw stones while saying, "O Allah, let Your arrow reach your enemy." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Allah, answer the supplication of Sa'd. O Allah, make his aim accurate." Sa'd said, "I swear by my parents, I did not throw a single arrow without the Prophet ﷺ  saying, 'O Allah, make his aim accurate and answer his supplication, O Sa'd.'" When I finished my quiver, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  scattered everything in his quiver towards me, and I was hit by a sharp arrow. The arrow was the most severe of all. Az-Zuhri said, "The arrows thrown by Sa'd that day numbered a thousand."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, Uhud ke us hangaame ke baare mein, maine alag hokar apne aap se kaha: main apni jaan bachaaunga, ya to main shaheed hounga ya bach jaaunga yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) se milun, isi haal mein tha ke aik parda-posh chehre wala aadmi tha, mujhe nahi pata woh kaun tha, mushrikeen aage badhe yahan tak ke maine kaha ke unhone use ghera hua hai, usne apni mutthi kankariyon se bhari, phir unhein unke chehron par phenka, to woh apni ediyon ke bal peeche mudte hue pahaad ki taraf bhaagne lage, unhone yeh kayi baar kiya, aur mujhe nahi pata woh kaun tha, aur mere aur uske darmiyan Miqdad bin Al-Aswad (RA) the, jab main Miqdad se uske baare mein poochne wala tha, to Miqdad ne kaha: "Aye Sa'd, yeh Rasulullah (SAW) hain, tumhein bula rahe hain." Maine poocha: "Woh kahan hain?" Miqdad ne mujhe unki taraf ishara kiya, to main utha, aur mujhe koi takleef mehsoos nahi hui, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Sa'd, aaj kahan the?" Maine kaha: "Jahan Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha." To unhone mujhe apne saamne bithaaya, main teer chalaane laga aur kehta: "Aye Allah, apna teer, isse apne dushman par chalaa," aur Rasulullah (SAW) kehte: "Aye Allah, Sa'd ki dua qubool kar, Aye Allah, Sa'd ke teer ko sahi nishaana banaa, laga do, Sa'd, mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan." To jab bhi main koi teer chalaata, Rasulullah (SAW) kehte: "Aye Allah, uske teer ko sahi nishaana banaa aur uski dua qubool kar, laga do, Sa'd," yahan tak ke jab meri teer-daan khaali ho gayi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni teer-daan se jitne teer nikaale woh mujhe de diye, aur unme se aik tez, achhi tarah pankh-daar teer bhi tha jo doosron se zyada tez tha. Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Sa'd ne us din jo teer chalaaye woh hazaar (1000) teer the."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq, when people gathered around the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on the Day of Uhud, I was the first to come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . I looked at him again, and there was a man who embraced me from behind like a bird seeking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . It turned out to be Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah. Then I saw a man lifting him up and putting him down again. So, I said to myself, "When he makes a mistake, I will be there with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Then Talhah came, and that was me. We both approached him and Talhah lifted him up and put him down. Then Talhah had sixty-six wounds, and one of them was on his eye, which had turned black. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was hit on his cheeks, two rings from the rings of forgiveness stuck to his cheeks. When Abu Ubaidah saw what happened to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he asked me to be able to switch places with me. He took one of them and used his teeth to remove it, and then he looked at the other one and said to me, "May Allah reward you for your sacrifice between me and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He then snatched it with his teeth and pulled his cheeks apart, and the ring fell and bounced. Then he looked at the other one and said to me, "May Allah reward you for your sacrifice between me and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He seized it with his teeth and pulled his cheeks apart, and the ring fell and bounced. Therefore, Abu Ubaidah's cheeks carried the marks of the rings.
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA): jab log Uhud ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas se bikhar gaye, to main sabse pehla tha jo Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf laut aaya, phir maine unhein baad mein dekha, achaanak aik aadmi ne mujhe peechhe se gale lagaaya, parinde ki tarah, Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf jaana chahta tha, to woh Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (RA) the, aur achaanak aik aadmi tha jo unhein kabhi uthaata kabhi bithaata, to maine kaha: "Agar main usse na pahuncha, to (behtar hai) ke main hi Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath houn, aur Talhah (RA) aayenge, to woh main houn," aur main guzra, to hum unke paas pahunche, achaanak Talhah (RA) unhein kabhi uthaate kabhi bithaate the, aur Talhah (RA) ko chhiyaasath (66) zakhm the, jinme se aik ne unki nabz (kahni ki rag) kaat di thi, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke gaalon par zarb lagi thi, to khoud (helmet) ki do kadiyaan unke gaalon mein pyoos gayi thin. Jab Abu Ubaidah (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ka yeh haal dekha, to unhone mujhe Allah ki qasam de kar kaha: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchne do," to unhone apne aage ke daant se aik kadi ko pakda aur usse khainch nikaala, to woh (kadi) nikal aayi aur unka daant bhi tut gaya, phir unhone doosri kadi ki taraf dekha, unhone mujhe Allah ki qasam de kar kaha: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchne do," to unhone use apne doosre daant se pakda, khainch kar nikaala, to woh (kadi) nikal aayi aur unka doosra daant bhi tut gaya, to Abu Ubaidah (RA) aage se daant-toota ho gaye.

e: [AI] "And by Allah, indeed I saw myself looking at Hind, the daughter of Umayah, and her companions with their hair loose, fleeing from their captors, whether they were few or many. The archers turned their attention towards the army, so we were able to reveal ourselves, and a screamer yelled, except that Muhammad was killed. So we retreated, and the people retreated after we captured the banner, to the point that none of the people approached it."
hi: "Allah ki qasam, maine khud ko dekha ke main Hind bint Utbah aur uski saathiyon ki taraf dekh raha hoon, jo kapde uthaaye bhaag rahi thin, unhein pakadna mushkil na tha, chahe kam ho ya zyada, jab tak ke teer-andaazon ne (apni jagah chhod kar) lashkar ki taraf jhukav dikhaaya yahan tak ke humne unpar se qaum (dushman) ko khol diya, woh maal-e-ghaneemat chahte the aur unhone humari peeth ghudsawaron ke liye khaali chhod di, to humein peeche se aaya gaya, aur aik cheekhne wala cheekha: 'Muhammad qatl ho gaye hain,' to hum peeche hat gaye, aur log bhi peeche hat gaye is baad ke ke humne parcham cheen liya tha yahan tak ke qaum ka koi bhi aadmi uske qareeb nahi aa raha tha."

e: [AI] Amr ibn Qais had a pre-Islamic idol that prevented him from embracing Islam. One day, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his companions came to him during the Battle of Uhud and asked about Sa'd ibn Muadh. They said he was at Uhud. He asked about his brother's sons. They said they were at Uhud. He then asked about his people and they said they were at Uhud. He took his sword, spear, and armor, and wore his hooded cloak, then went to Uhud. When the Muslims saw him, they said to him, "Welcome, O Amr! We have become Muslims." He responded, "I have indeed embraced Islam." He fought and was injured, then was brought to his family. Sa'd ibn Muadh came to him and asked, "Did you come out of anger for the sake of Allah and His Messenger, or to protect your people?" He replied, "No, I came out of anger for the sake of Allah and His Messenger." Abu Hurairah reported, "He entered Jannah, and he did not perform a prayer except for the Muslims."
hi: Amr bin Qais ka jahiliyat mein aik ma'bood (rab) tha, aur woh ma'bood unhein Islam qubool karne se rokta tha jab tak woh use apne qaboo mein na le le. Aik din woh Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke sahaba ke paas aaye jabke woh Uhud mein the, unhone poocha: "Sa'd bin Mu'az (RA) kahan hain?" Kaha gaya: "Uhud mein." Unhone poocha: "Unke bhatije kahan hain?" Kaha gaya: "Uhud mein." Unhone apni qaum ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Uhud mein." To unhone apni talwaar aur neza liya, apni zirah pehni, phir Uhud ki taraf chal pade. Jab Musalmano ne unhein dekha, to unhone kaha: "Hamse door raho, Aye Amr." Unhone kaha: "Main to imaan laa chuka hoon," to unhone hamla kiya aur jung ki, phir unhein zakhmi haalat mein unke ghar walon ke paas laaya gaya, Sa'd bin Mu'az (RA) unke paas dakhil huay aur unse poocha: "Kya tum Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye ghusse mein aaye ho, ya apni qaum ki ghairat mein?" Unhone kaha: "Balke main Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye ghusse mein aaya." To Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "To woh Jannat mein dakhil huay jabke unhone Allah ke liye kabhi aik bhi namaz nahi padhi thi." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) when he mentioned the companions of Uhud, saying, "By Allah, I wish I had been martyrized along with my companions, in the embrace of the mountain." He said, "I was martyred with them."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko suna, jab woh Uhud ke sahaba ka zikr karte, farmaate: "Allah ki qasam, main chahta ke kaash mujhe apne saathiyon ke sath pahaad ki god mein chhod diya jaata," ya'ni: "Main unke sath shaheed kar diya jaata."

e: [AI] "That Fatimah, the daughter of the Prophet ﷺ, used to visit the grave of her uncle Hamzah ibn Abdul-Muttalib during the days, and she would pray and cry at his grave."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ki beti Fatimah (RA) apne chacha Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ki qabr ki ziyarat kayi dinon mein karti thin, wahan namaz padhti aur unke paas roti thin."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  visited the graves of the martyrs in Uhud and said, "O Allah, indeed your servant and your Prophet bear witness that these are martyrs and that whoever visits them and sends blessings upon them until the Day of Resurrection, they will return the greetings." Al-Attaf narrated to me that her aunt visited the graves of the martyrs and said, "I had only two young boys with me who were taking care of my animal. I greeted them and heard the response of the greetings. They said, 'By Allah, we know you just as we know each other.' I was amazed, so I said, 'O boy, loosen my mount,' and I rode it. This is a correct Isnad, and it has not been narrated by anyone else." (Mursal)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Uhud ke shuhada ki qabron ki ziyarat ki aur farmaya: "Aye Allah, beshak tera banda aur tera Nabi gawahi deta hai ke yeh log shaheed hain, aur jo koi Qayamat ke din tak inki ziyarat kare aur inhein salaam kahe, yeh log unhein jawaab dete hain." Al-Attaaf ne kaha: mujhe meri khaala ne hadith bayan ki ke unhone shuhada ki qabron ki ziyarat ki, unhone kaha: aur mere sath sirf do ghulam the jo meri sawaari ki hifaazat kar rahe the, unhone kaha: to maine unhein salaam kaha, to maine salaam ka jawaab suna, unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, hum tumhein waise hi pehchaante hain jaise hum aik doosre ko pehchaante hain." Unhone kaha: to mujhpar rongtay khade ho gaye, maine kaha: "Aye ghulam, mere khachar ko qareeb lao," to main sawaar ho gayi. "Yeh isnad Madani, sahih hai, aur dono ne ise nahi nikala." Mursal.

e: [AI] "Allah, the Almighty, is the One who responded to those who answered Allah and the Messenger, after they had suffered injuries." [Surah Al-Imran 172]
hi: Allah, buzurg aur buland: "{Jinhone Allah aur Rasool ki baat maani zakhm khaane ke baad}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 172).

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was killed by an enemy. They noticed a group of Muslims and one man from them approached, known as Ghawrath bin al-Harith, until he stood over the head of the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, with a sword. The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, asked, "Who can prevent you from me?" He replied, "Allah." The sword then fell from his hand, and the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, took it and asked, "Who can prevent you?" He replied, "I testify that there is no god but Allah, and that I am the messenger of Allah." The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "I will make a covenant with you that I will not fight you and I will not be with a people who fight against you." The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, then let him go. He returned to his people and said, "I have come to you from the best of people." When the time for prayer came, the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, performed the prayer of fear. The people were divided into two groups: one group facing the enemy, and another group praying with the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. He prayed two units of prayer with those who were with him, then they left and took their positions against the enemy. The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, then prayed two units of prayer with the other group. So the people prayed two units of prayer, while the prophet, peace be upon him, prayed four units of prayer.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Muharib Khasafah se Nakhl mein jung ki, unhone Musalmano mein aik gaflat (moqa) dekhi, to unme se aik aadmi jise Ghawrath bin Al-Harith kaha jaata tha aaya yahan tak ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sar par talwaar liye khada ho gaya, usne poocha: "Mujhse tumhein kaun bachaayega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah." Unhone kaha: to talwaar uske haath se gir gayi, Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse uthaaya aur poocha: "Ab tumhein kaun bachaayega?" Usne kaha: "Aap sabse behtareen pakadne wale bano (mujhe maaf kar dein)." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum gawahi doge ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" Usne kaha: "Main aapse ahd karta hoon ke main aapse jung nahi karunga aur na hi kisi aisi qaum ke sath rahunga jo aapse jung kare." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse chhod diya, to woh apni qaum ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Main tumhare paas behtareen insaan ke paas se aa raha hoon." Jab namaz ka waqt aaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khauf ki namaz padhi, aur log do giroh the, aik giroh dushman ke saamne khada tha aur aik giroh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath namaz padh raha tha, to unhone apne sath walon ko do rak'aten padhaayi, phir woh mudh gaye aur woh un logon ki jagah aa gaye jo dushman ke saamne the, aur woh (doosra giroh) aaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein do rak'aten padhaayi, to logon ki do-do rak'aten hui aur Nabi (SAW) ki chaar rak'aten.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out on expeditions and encountered the polytheists at Usfan. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed Dhuhr prayer, they saw him bowing and prostrating, as well as his companions. Some of them said to others, "This is an opportunity for you to deceive them so they do not know who you are until you attack them." One of them said, "They have another prayer that is more beloved to them than their families and wealth. Prepare yourselves until you attack them during that prayer." So Allah, the Almighty and Glorious, revealed to His Prophet ﷺ  from {And when you are among them and lead them in prayer} until the end of the verse, and He informed him of what the polytheists planned. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed Asr prayer and the Muslims were facing him in the direction of the Qibla, the Prophet ﷺ  placed the Muslims behind him in two rows, and he said the takbeer, so they also said it with him. He mentioned the prayer during times of fear and at the end of it, when the polytheists looked at him, some of them prostrated while others stood and looked at them. They said, "They have been informed of what we intended."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik ghazwe mein nikle, Usfan mein mushrikeen se mile, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zuhr padhi, to unhone unhein aur unke sahaba ko ruku aur sajda karte dekha, to unme se kuch ne aapas mein kaha: "Yeh tumhare liye aik mauqa hai, agar tum unpar hamla karo to unhein tumhara pata nahi chalega jab tak tum unhein takraa na do." To unme se aik ne kaha: "Unki aik aur namaz hai jo unhein unke ghar walon aur maal se zyada aziz hai, isliye taiyaar raho yahan tak ke tum unpar us (namaz) mein hamla karo." To Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (SAW) par yeh nazil ki: "{Aur jab tum unke darmiyan ho aur unhein namaz padhaao}" (Surah An-Nisa 102) ayat ke aakhir tak, aur unhein bataaya jo mushrikeen ne saazish ki thi. "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Asr padhi, aur woh Qibla mein unke saamne the, to Musalmano ko unke peechhe do safon mein khada kiya, Rasulullah (SAW) ne takbeer kahi, unhone bhi unke sath takbeer kahi," phir Khauf ki namaz zikr ki, aur aakhir mein kaha: jab mushrikeen ne unhein dekha ke unme se kuch sajda kar rahe hain aur kuch khade unhein dekh rahe hain, to unhone kaha: "Unhein humare iraade ki khabar de di gayi hai."

e: When the ditch was dug, I saw Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) feeling very hungry. I came to my wife and said to her: Is there anything with you? I have seen Messenger of Allah ﷺ feeling extremely hungry. She brought out a bag of provisions which contained a sa', of barley. We had also with us a lamb. I slaughtered it. She ground the flour. She finished (this work) along with me. I cut it into pieces and put it in the earthen pot and then returned to Allah's Apostle ﷺ (for inviting him). She said: Do not humiliate me in the presence of Messenger of Allah ﷺ and those who are with him. When I came to him I whispered to him saying: Messenger of Allah, we have slaughtered a lamb for you and she has ground a sa' of barley which we had with us. So you come along with a group of people with you. Thereupon Messenger of Allah ﷺ said loudly: O people of the ditch, Jabir has arranged a feast for you, so (come along). Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Do not remove your earthen pot from the hearth and do not bake the bread from the kneaded flour until I come. So I came and Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and he was ahead of the people; and I came to my wife and she said (to me): You will be humbled. I said: I did what you had asked me to do. She (his wife) said: I brought out the kneaded flour and Messenger of Allah ﷺ put some saliva of his in that and blessed It. He then put saliva in the earthen pot and blessed it and then said. Call another baker who can bake with you. and bring out the soup from it, but do not remove it from the hearth, and the guests were one thousand. (Jabir said): I take an oath by Allah that all of them ate (the food to their fill) until they left it and went away and our earthen pot was brimming over as before, and so was the case with our flour, or as Dahhak (another narrator) said: It (the flour) was in the same condition and loaves had been prepared from that. (Using translation from Muslim 2039)
hi: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko kehte suna: jab khandaq khodi gayi, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko sakht bhookh ki haalat mein dekha, unhone kaha: to main apni biwi ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko sakht bhookh mein dekha," to unhone mere liye aik thaila nikaala jismein aik saa (naap) jau tha, aur humare paas aik paalti hui bakri thi, unhone kaha: to unhone use zibah kiya aur aik saa jau peesa, phir main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unse mashwara kiya, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humne apni aik bakri zibah ki hai aur humare paas jo aik saa jau tha woh peesa hai, isliye aap aur aapke sath kuch log aa jaayen." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne pukaara: "Aye khandaq walo, Jabir ne aik dawat taiyaar ki hai, jaldi aao." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni haandi neeche mat utaarna aur apna guundha aata mat pakaana jab tak main na aa jaaun." Unhone kaha: to main aaya aur Rasulullah (SAW) bhi aaye, aur woh logon se aage nikal gaye yahan tak ke main apni biwi ke paas pahuncha, unhone unke liye guundha aata nikaala, to unhone usme thooka aur barkat ki dua ki, phir farmaya: "Mere liye kisi roti pakaane wali ko bulaao, woh tumhare sath roti pakaaye, aur apni haandi mein se nikaalo lekin usse neeche mat utaaro," aur woh (log) hazaar (1000) the, to Jabir (RA) ne Allah Ta'ala ki qasam khaayi ke unhone khaaya yahan tak ke chhod diya aur chale gaye, aur humari haandi wesi hi ubalti rahi jaisi pehle thi, aur humara guundha aata waise hi pak raha tha jaise pehle tha. Yeh Abu Amr ki hadith ke alfaaz hain, aur Abu Al-Abbas ke alfaaz mein mukhtasar hai.

e: [AI] On the night of the Confederates, there were only twelve men left with the Prophet ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to me while I was sitting in the cold and he said, "O son of Yemen, get up and go to the camp of the Confederates and see their situation." I said, "O Messenger of Allah, by the One who sent you with the truth, I only came to you out of shyness from you because of the cold." He said, "Go forward with determination, O son of Yemen, and the morning cold will not harm you until you come back to me." So I went to their camp and I found Abu Sufyan kindling a fire among a group of people who had separated from the Confederates. He continued, "When I sat among them, Abu Sufyan thought that someone had entered their camp who did not belong to them. So he told everyone to hold the hand of the person sitting next to them." I struck the hand of the person on my right with my hand and held his hand, then I struck the hand of the person on my left with my hand and held his hand. I remained with them for a while, then I stood up and went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was standing in prayer. He motioned to me with his hand to come closer, so I approached. Then he motioned to me again to come closer, so I approached until he poured some of the cloth he was wearing on me while he was praying. When he finished his prayer, he said, "O son of Yemen, sit down. What is the news?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, the people have separated from Abu Sufyan, and only a group remains who are kindling the fire. Allah has poured on them the like of the cold that He poured on us, but we hope for from Allah what they do not hope for."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, Ahzab (Khandaq) ki raat ke baare mein, unke sath sirf baarah (12) aadmi bache the, to Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas aaye jabke main sardi se sukud raha tha, aur farmaya: "Aye Ibn Al-Yaman, uth aur Ahzab ke lashkar ki taraf jao, unka haal dekho." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, main sirf sardi ki wajah se aapse sharma raha tha, warna main na uthta." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To subah ki thandak mein nikal jao, Aye Ibn Al-Yaman, tumhein garmi ya sardi ka koi darr nahi jab tak tum mere paas wapas na aao." Unhone kaha: to main unke lashkar ki taraf gaya, maine Abu Sufyan ko dekha jo apne ird-gird aik giroh ke sath aag jala raha tha, aur Ahzab uske paas se bikhar chuke the. Unhone kaha: jab main unme baith gaya, to Abu Sufyan ne socha ke koi ajnabi unme dakhil ho gaya hai, usne kaha: "Tum mein se har aadmi apne sath baithe wale ka haath pakad le." Unhone kaha: to maine apna haath apne dayen wale par rakha aur uska haath pakad liya, phir maine apna haath apne baayen wale par rakha aur uska haath pakad liya, main unme thodi der raha, phir main utha aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke woh khade namaz padh rahe the, unhone mujhe apne haath se ishara kiya ke qareeb aao, to main qareeb gaya, phir mujhe dobara ishara kiya ke qareeb aao, to main qareeb gaya yahan tak ke unhone apna kapda mujhpar daal diya jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, jab woh namaz se faarigh huay, to farmaya: "Aye Ibn Al-Yaman, baitho, khabar kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), log Abu Sufyan se bikhar gaye hain, sirf aik giroh baaqi hai jo aag jala rahe hain, Allah ne unpar bhi utni hi sardi daal di hai jitni humpar daali hai, lekin hum Allah se woh ummeed rakhte hain jo unhein nahi."

e: [AI] "A man from the polytheists was killed on the day of the trench, and they requested to bury him. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  refused until they paid the blood money. And from the Bani 'Amir ibn Lu'ayy, 'Amr ibn 'Abd killed Wud, whom 'Ali ibn Abi Talib fought and killed in a duel."
hi: Khandaq ke din mushrikeen mein se aik aadmi qatl kiya gaya, unhone unhein dafan karne ki darkhwaast ki, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne inkaar kiya jab tak unhone diyat (fidya) na di." Aur Banu Aamir bin Lu'ayy mein se Amr bin Abd Wudd qatl kiya gaya, Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ne unhein aik-doosre ke muqaable mein (mubaraza) qatl kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The duel between Ali ibn Abi Talib and Amr ibn Abd Wudd on the day of the trench is better than the deeds of my ummah (followers) until the Day of Judgment." May Allah curse the one who fabricated it, the Rafidi.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khandaq ke din Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ka Amr bin Abd Wudd se mubaraza karna Qayamat tak meri Ummat ke aamaal se afzal hai." Allah kisi Rafidi par la'nat kare jisne yeh gadha.

e: [AI] "Amr ibn Abdud was killed among the polytheists on the Day of the Trench. Ali ibn Abi Talib killed him. The chain of transmission of this battle is considered authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs."
hi: "Khandaq ke din mushrikeen mein se Amr bin Abd Wudd qatl kiya gaya, Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ne unhein qatl kiya." Is Maghazi ki isnad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai.

e: [AI] "He, Ali, O Amr, you had made a pact with Allah on behalf of Quraysh that no man should invite another man except for one of the two shall be accepted. And so, Amr said, 'Yes.' Then Ali said to him, 'Verily, I invite you to Allah, the Almighty, and to His Messenger ﷺ and to Islam.' Amr replied, 'I have no need for that.' Ali then said, 'Indeed, I invite you to combat.' Amr said, 'O my nephew, why?' Ali replied, 'By Allah, I do not wish to kill you, but I wish for you to kill me.' So Amr became furious and charged at Ali with his horse, but Ali struck the horse and killed it. Amr then approached Ali and said, 'Who will duel with me?' Ali stood up, with his face covered in armor, and said, 'I am the one, O Prophet of Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ allowed him and Ali went towards him saying, 'Do not rush, for there has come to you an answer. Your voice is not weak, and you are knowledgeable and perceptive. And truth is the salvation for every victor. I do hope to avenge upon you a blow that would remain remembered. Amr asked, 'Who are you?' Ali replied, 'I am Ali.' Amr asked, 'The son of whom?' Ali said, 'I am Ali ibn Abi Talib.' Amr then said, 'You have with you, O my nephew, some of your maternal uncles who are better than you. Leave and I do not wish to shed your blood.' Ali replied, 'By Allah, I do not mind shedding your blood.' So Amr became angry, dismounted from his horse, and drew his sword as if it were a flaming torch. He approached Ali in anger, while Ali faced him with his shield. Amr struck at Ali's shield but it fell and remained stuck with his sword. He struck at Ali's head, cutting through it, and Ali struck him on the neck, causing him to fall down. The infidels then made a commotion and the Prophet ﷺ heard the takbeer (Allahu Akbar) and knew that Ali had killed him. Ali then said, 'I am certain that the cavalry will attack in the same manner as I and they will delay my companions today. I am determined and vigilant in my resolve, with no other comrade but Ibn Abd. When I approached him, I swore and summoned them to listen to my recitation from the Book. I am indeed truthful, for I affirm those who exclaim righteousness, two men who strike all opponents. I have with me, a stick between branches, an uncomplaining trunk, tainted by his thoughtlessness. And I worship the Lord of Muhammad, with correctness. Ali then turned towards the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a beaming face. Umar ibn Khattab said to him, 'Why don't you take his armor? For there is no better armor for the Arabs than that.' Ali replied, 'I struck him, fearing him and being shy of my cousin, to take his armor. I left his horses defeated until they were thrown into the trench.'
hi: Ali (RA) ne unse (Amr se) kaha: "Aye Amr, tumne Quraish ke liye Allah se ahd kiya tha ke koi bhi aadmi tumhein do baaton ki taraf bulaaye, to tum unme se aik zaroor qubool karoge." Amr ne kaha: "Haan." Ali (RA) ne unse kaha: "To main tumhein Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki taraf, uske Rasool (SAW) ki taraf, aur Islam ki taraf bulaata hoon." Usne kaha: "Mujhe iski koi zaroorat nahi." Unhone kaha: "To main tumhein mubaraza (aik-doosre se jung) ki taraf bulaata hoon." Usne kaha: "Aye mere bhatije, kyun? Allah ki qasam, main tumhein qatl karna napasand karta hoon." To Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Lekin main tumhein qatl karna pasand karta hoon." To Amr ko ghussa aaya, apne ghode se utar kar usse maar dala, phir aage badha aur Ali (RA) ke paas aaya aur poocha: "Kaun mubaraza karega?" To Ali (RA) khade huay, jo loha (zirah) mein dhake huay the, aur kaha: "Main hazir hoon, Aye Allah ke Nabi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Amr bin Abd Wudd hai, baith jao." To Amr ne pukaara: "Kya koi aadmi nahi?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein ijaazat di, Ali (RA) uski taraf chalte huay bole: "Jaldi mat karo, tumhari awaaz ka jawaab dene wala aa gaya hai, kamzor nahi, aqal-mand aur bineen wala, aur sachaai har kaamyaab shakhs ke liye nijaat hai, main ummeed rakhta hoon ke main tumpar aisi zarb lagaaun jo maatam ki lambi awaaz laaye, aik gehri chot jiska zikr har khalbali mein baaqi rahega." Amr ne unse poocha: "Tum kaun ho?" Unhone kaha: "Main Ali hoon." Usne poocha: "Kiske bete?" Unhone kaha: "Abd Manaf ke bete, main Ali bin Abi Talib hoon." Usne kaha: "Tumhare chachaon mein se, Aye mere bhatije, koi aisa hai jo tumse zyada umr wala ho, isliye laut jao, kyunke mujhe tumhara khoon bahaana napasand hai." Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Lekin main, Allah ki qasam, tumhara khoon bahaana napasand nahi karta." To use ghussa aaya, woh utra, apni talwaar khainchi goya woh aag ka shola ho, phir ghusse mein Ali (RA) ki taraf badha, Ali (RA) ne apni dhaal se uska saamna kiya, Amr ne dhaal par zarb lagaayi, use cheer dala aur talwaar usme gaad di, aur unke sar ko lagi, usse zakhmi kar diya, aur Ali (RA) ne unhein gardan ki nas par maara, to woh gir gaye, aur gard-o-ghubaar udh gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Takbeer suni to unhein pata chal gaya ke Ali (RA) ne use qatl kar diya hai. To Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Kya sawaar mujhpar aise hamla-aawar hote hain, mujhse aur unse door raho, mere saathiyon, aaj mujhe bhaagne se meri hifaazat ki bhawna rokti hai, aur sar mein aik dhamke daar (zarb), Abd (Amr) ke siwa kisi ke qareeb aane par, jab woh mujhpar hamla-aawar hua, maine qasam khaayi, sun lo Kitaab se, main us shakhs ko sacha maanta hoon jo taqwa ka a'lan kare, do log jo har vaar-karne wale ko maar sakte hain, to main laut aaya jab maine unhein zameen par gira huay chhod diya, tane ki tarah teele aur pahaadi ke darmiyan, aur maine unke kapdon se parhez kiya, agarche main woh insaan hota jo mere kapdon ka wazan karta, unhone apni na-samajhi ki wajah se patthar ki ibaadat ki, aur maine Muhammad (SAW) ke Rab ki sahih ibaadat ki." Phir Ali (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf mudhe, unka chehra khushi se chamak raha tha, to Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne poocha: "Kya tumne uski zirah nahi utaari? Arabo ke paas isse behtar koi zirah nahi." Unhone kaha: "Maine unhein maara, to unhone apni sharm-gaah (uryaani) se apne aap ko bachaaya, aur mujhe apne chachere bhai se yeh sharam aayi ke unhein loot loon," aur unke ghode bhaag gaye yahan tak ke Khandaq mein gir gaye.

e: [AI] "If the killer of Amr was someone other than himself, I would cry for him. For my soul would not have been able to remain in my body. However, his killer is someone who is not blamed for it, and who was previously known as the white pearl of the city. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in the summarization."
hi: "Agar Amr ka qaatil koi aur hota, to main uspar rota jab tak meri rooh mere jism mein rehti, lekin uska qaatil aisa hai jispar koi ilzaam nahi, aur woh pehle 'Baida-e-Al-Balad' (shehar ka gohar) kaha jaata tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About one of the companions and the followers, and how this is permissible, and Ali says "We have not reached the point where I relinquished the rights of my cousin, so I left him." And this is his response to the commander of the faithful, Umar bin Al-Khattab, in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Sahaba aur Tabi'een mein se kisi se, aur yeh kaise jaayez ho sakta hai jabke Ali (RA) khud kehte hain: "Humein yeh khabar nahi pahunchi ke maine apne chachere bhai ke maal-e-ghaneemat lene se inkaar kiya ho aur usse chhod diya ho," aur yeh unka jawaab hai Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko, Rasulullah (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein.

e: [AI] Narrated by Aisha, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was with her when a man from the household greeted us while we were in the house. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, stood up abruptly and I followed him. Then, I saw the dog's barking and the Prophet, peace be upon him, said, "This is Gabriel who has commanded me to go to the Banu Qurayzah tribe." He said, "You have put down your weapons, but we have not sought the idolaters until we reached the "asad al-Hamra" (a specific place)." This happened when the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, returned from the Battle of the Trench. The Prophet, peace be upon him, stood up abruptly and said to his companions, "I have determined that you should not pray the Asr prayer until you have reached the Banu Qurayzah tribe." The sun had set before they could reach them. Some of the Muslims said, "The Prophet did not intend to abandon the prayer, so let us pray it." Some of the Muslims said, "We are determined to follow the Prophet, peace be upon him, and we are free from sin." Some of them prayed with faith and seeking reward, while others refrained. The Prophet, peace be upon him, did not blame anyone from the two groups. Then, the Prophet, peace be upon him, went out and passed by their gathering place to the Banu Qurayzah tribe and asked them, "Has anyone passed by you?" They said, "A dog's barking passed by us on a grayish mule with a saddle made of wool." He said, "That was not a dog's barking, but it was Gabriel who was sent to the Banu Qurayzah tribe to disturb and instill fear in their hearts." The Prophet, peace be upon him, besieged them and ordered his companions to hide behind the rocks until they could hear his words. He called them, "O brothers of monkeys and pigs." They responded, "O Abal-Qasim, was it necessary to use this harsh term?" He besieged them until they surrendered to the judgment of Sa’d bin Mu’adh. They were ordered to be killed and their wealth, children, and women were taken as captives.
hi: Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, se, Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas the, to aik aadmi ghar walon mein se humein salaam karne aaya jabke hum ghar mein the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ghabraa kar khade huay, main unke peechhe khadi hui, achaanak woh Dihyah Al-Kalbi (RA) the, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Jibra'il (AS) hain, mujhe hukum de rahe hain ke main Banu Qurayzah ki taraf jaaun," phir farmaya: "Tumne hathiyaar rakh diye lekin humne nahi rakhe, humne mushrikeen ka peecha kiya yahan tak ke hum Hamra-ul-Asad tak pahunche," aur yeh us waqt hua jab Rasulullah (SAW) khandaq se wapas laute. Nabi (SAW) ghabraa kar khade huay aur apne sahaba se farmaya: "Main tumhein hukum deta hoon ke tum Asr ki namaz na padho jab tak tum Banu Qurayzah tak na pahunch jao." To suraj doobne se pehle woh wahan na pahunch sake, kuch Musalmano ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ka iraada namaz chhodne ka nahi tha," to unhone namaz padh li, aur kuch ne kaha: "Hum to Nabi (SAW) ke hukum par hain, humpar koi gunah nahi," to aik giroh ne imaan aur sawaab ki neeyat se namaz padhi aur aik giroh ne imaan aur sawaab ki neeyat se chhod di, aur Nabi (SAW) ne kisi bhi giroh par malaamat nahi ki. Nabi (SAW) nikle aur unke aur Qurayzah ke darmiyan majlison se guzre, unhone poocha: "Kya tum mein se koi guzra?" Unhone kaha: "Dihyah Al-Kalbi (RA) safed khachar par guzre, uske neeche resham ki chaadar thi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh Dihyah nahi the, balke Jibra'il (AS) the, jinhein Banu Qurayzah ki taraf bheja gaya taake unhein hilaayen aur unke dilon mein khauf daalein." To Nabi (SAW) ne unka ghera daala aur apne sahaba ko hukum diya ke woh dhaalon (hajaf) mein chhupein taake woh unhein unki baat sunwa saken, unhein pukaara: "Aye bandaron aur soaron ke bhaiyo," unhone kaha: "Aye Abul-Qasim, aap gaali dene wale nahi the." Aap (SAW) ne unka ghera qaayam rakha yahan tak ke woh Sa'd bin Mu'az (RA) ke faisle par utar aaye, aur woh unke halif (mutahid) the, to unhone unke baare mein faisla diya ke unke jangju qatl kiye jaayen aur unki aulaad aur auraten qaidi banaayi jaayen.

e: [AI] "We presented ourselves to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during the time of the Quraish tribe. Whoever among us had a blemish or a mark, they were killed. They looked at me, but I did not have any blemish or mark, so I was spared."
hi: "Humein Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne pesh kiya gaya Qurayzah ke waqt, to humme se jo bhi baaligh ho chuka hota ya jiski sharm-gaah ke baal ug aaye hote, use qatl kiya jaata, to unhone mujhe dekha, meri sharm-gaah ke baal nahi uge the, to mujhe chhod diya gaya."

e: [AI] She said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not kill any woman from the tribe of Quraizah except one. By Allah, she was laughing so much that her stomach was shaking. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had ordered the killing of their men with swords, while asking, 'Where is so-and-so?' She said, 'By Allah, I said, what is wrong with you?' She said, 'I will be killed.' I asked her, 'Why did you speak?' Then he took her and struck her neck. I cannot forget her calmness and the abundance of her laughter, knowing that she was going to be killed."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Banu Qurayzah ki koi bhi aurat kabhi qatl nahi ki siwaye aik aurat ke, aur Allah ki qasam, woh mere paas hi thi, khush hokar hansti hui, jabke Rasulullah (SAW) unke mardon ko talwaaron se qatl kar rahe the, ke aik pukarne wala uska naam lekar poochta: 'Fulani kahan hai?' To usne kaha: 'Main hi hoon, Allah ki qasam.' Maine poocha: 'Afsos tumpar, tumhein kya hua?' Usne kaha: 'Mujhe qatl kiya jayega, Allah ki qasam.' Maine poocha: 'Kyun?' Usne kaha: 'Kisi naye kaam ki wajah se jo maine kiya tha.' To use lekar gaye aur uski gardan maar di, to main hairaan hoon uske itmenaan aur uski hansi ki kasrat par, jabke usse pata tha ke usse qatl kiya jayega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded Abu Bakr, so we fought against some people from the Banu Fazara tribe. When we approached a well, Abu Bakr commanded us to water the horses, so we did. After we performed the Fajr prayer, Abu Bakr ordered us to launch a surprise attack. We killed those whom we had to, and some of them ran away. Among them were children and women who were trying to seek refuge in the mountains. We shot arrows between them and the mountains, and when they saw the arrows, they stopped. I then brought them, including a woman from the Banu Fazara tribe who had a daughter with her, to Abu Bakr. The woman had reddish hair and was considered one of the most beautiful Arab women. Abu Bakr said to me, "O Salamah, give me that woman." I replied, "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, I did not expose her to anything while she belonged to you." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent her to Makkah as a ransom for some Muslim prisoners who were in the hands of the polytheists. "A Muslim prisoner took her out of Makkah in a different context." (This hadith is narrated by Muslim in his collection.)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humpar Abu Bakr (RA) ko ameer banaaya, to hum Banu Fazarah ke kuch logon par jung ke liye nikle, jab hum paani ke qareeb pahunche, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne hukum diya, to humne raat wahin guzaari, jab humne Fajr padhi, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne hukum diya to humne achaanak hamla kiya, hum paani par pahunche aur usme se jise qatl karna tha use qatl kiya. Unhone kaha: to logon ka aik giroh nikla jisme aulaad aur auraten thin, woh pahaad ki taraf phaandne hi wale the ke humne unke aur pahaad ke darmiyan teer phenka, jab unhone teer dekha to woh ruk gaye, to main unhein le kar Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas aaya, unme Banu Fazarah ki aik aurat thi jispar chamdha (adam) ka poshaak tha, aur uske sath uski beti thi jo Arab ki khoobsurat tareen ladkiyon mein se thi. Unhone kaha: to Abu Bakr (RA) ne mujhe uski beti (maal-e-ghaneemat ke hisse ke ilawa izaafi hisse ke taur par) di. Unhone kaha: to main Madinah pahuncha, Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe bazaar mein mile aur farmaya: "Aye Salamah, Allah ke liye, tumhare abba ke sadqe, wo aurat mujhe de do." Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine uska koi kapda bhi nahi khola, aur woh aapki hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse Makkah bheja, aur usse un Musalman qaidiyon ke badle mein fidya diya jo mushrikeen ke haathon mein the. Muslim ne isse doosre andaaz mein nikaala hai.

e: [AI] He informed him that the Messenger of Allah was in Hudaybiyah, so he said, "Do not light a fire at night." Then after that, he said, "Light a fire and prepare something, for there may be a group that will not reach your measure or your length (distance)."
hi: Unhein khabar di ke Rasulullah (SAW) Hudaybiyah mein the, unhone farmaya: "Raat ko aag na jalaao." Phir uske baad farmaya: "Aag jalaao aur khaana taiyaar karo, kyunke tumhare baad koi qaum tumhare saa (naap) aur mudd tak nahi pahunch sakegi."

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out to Khaibar, he employed Siba' bin 'Urfutah al-Ghifari in Medina."
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Khaibar ki taraf nikle, to unhone Siba' bin Urfutah Al-Ghifari (RA) ko Madinah mein (ameer) muqarrar kiya." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ sent Abu Bakr to some forts of Khaybar, he fought and exerted effort but there was no victory.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) ko Khaibar ke kuch qilon ki taraf bheja, unhone jung ki aur koshish ki, magar fatah na hui."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sometimes got a terrible headache, so he would stay indoors for a day or two. When he descended to Khaybar, he got a terrible headache and did not go out to the people. Meanwhile, Abu Bakr took the flag of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and then stood up and engaged in a fierce battle, then he returned."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko kabhi kabhi migraine (aadhe sar ka dard) ho jaata, aur woh aik ya do din ke liye bahar nahi nikalte the, jab woh Khaibar mein utre, to unhein migraine ho gaya, to woh logon ke paas na nikle, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ka jhanda liya, phir uthe aur sakht jung ki, phir wapas aa gaye."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  proceeded towards Khaybar. When he arrived there, Umar was sent along with the people to their respective residences or forts. They fought against them, but they were soon defeated by Umar and his companions. They came back with their tails between their legs, while Umar and his companions were victorious. Then, the Prophet ﷺ  set forth.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) Khaibar ki taraf chal pade, jab woh wahan pahunche, to unhone Umar (RA) ko bheja aur unke sath logon ko unke shehar ya unke qile ki taraf bheja, unhone unse jung ki, magar jaldi hi unhone Umar (RA) aur unke saathiyon ko haraa diya, to woh Umar (RA) ko bugda kehte huay wapas aaye aur unhein bhi bugda kehte huay, to Nabi (SAW) khud chal pade," hadith aage jaari hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  handed over the flag on the day of Khaybar to Umar, then he set off and returned while his companions and Umar kept close to him.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din Umar (RA) ko jhanda diya, to woh gaye aur wapas aa gaye, apne saathiyon ko bugda kehte huay aur woh unhein bugda kehte huay."

e: [AI] When it was the day of Khaybar, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a man, but he returned unsuccessful. Then Muhammad ibn Maslamah came and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have never seen a day like today. Mahmoud ibn Maslamah has been killed." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not wish to meet the enemy, and ask Allah for safety, for you do not know what difficulties you will face with them. When you meet them, say, 'O Allah, You are our Lord and their Lord, our Leader and their Leader. We ask You to protect us from them and to protect them from our evil. You only kill them by Your command. Then sit on the ground and when they advance towards you, get up and say 'Allahu Akbar'." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Tomorrow I will send a man who loves Allah and His Messenger, and Allah and His Messenger love him. He does not retreat, and Allah will grant him victory with his own hands." The people were honored by this, and Ali stood up that day as a soldier. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "Keep it a secret." Ali said, "O Messenger of Allah, I cannot see any place to put it." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spat into his eyes and tied it for him, then gave him the banner. Ali asked, "O Messenger of Allah, why shall I fight them?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "So that they witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah. If they do so, they have protected themselves from shedding their blood and losing their wealth, except for what is rightfully due, and their account is with Allah." Ali met them and Allah granted him victory. The two sheikhs agreed upon the narration of the banner but did not mention it in this context.
hi: Jab Khaibar ka din hua, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik aadmi bheja, to woh bugda ho gaya, phir Muhammad bin Maslamah (RA) aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine aisa din kabhi nahi dekha, Mahmood bin Maslamah (RA) qatl kar diye gaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dushman se milne ki tamanna mat karo, aur Allah se aafiyat maango, kyunke tumhein nahi pata ke tum unke sath kya aazmaaish mein daale jaaoge, aur jab tum unse milo to kaho: 'Aye Allah, tu humara Rab aur unka Rab hai, aur humari peshaani aur unki peshaani tere haath mein hai, aur unhein sirf tu hi qatl karta hai,' phir zameen par baithe raho, jab woh tumhein ghere lein to uth khade ho aur takbeer kaho." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main kal zaroor aisa aadmi bhejunga jo Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hai, aur woh dono usse mohabbat karte hain, jo peeth nahi phereta, Allah uske haathon fatah dega." To log iske liye taiyaar ho gaye, aur Ali (RA) us din aankhon ki bimaari (ramad) mein mubtala the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Chalo." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe koi jagah dikhaai nahi deti." To unhone unki aankhon mein thooka aur unke liye (jhanda) baandha aur unhein jhanda diya. Ali (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main kis baat par unse jung karoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse ke woh gawahi den ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon, jab woh aisa kar lein to unke khoon aur maal mujhse mehfooz ho jaate hain siwaye unke haq ke, aur unka hisaab Allah par hai." Unhone kaha: to woh unse mile aur Allah ne unhein fatah di. Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ka jhande wali hadith nikaalne par ittefaaq hai, lekin dono ne ise is siyaaq mein nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "We witnessed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  the Battle of Khaybar, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  spat in the eyes of Ali, and he was then healed and given the flag. Marhab greeted and said, 'The sea of Rajz has known that I am Marhab, the complaining hero with tested weapons. When wars begin, they blaze.' Ali then confronted him and said, 'I am the one whom my mother named Haider, like a ferocious lion, with fearful appearance. I will fulfill for you the measure of sand like the weight of thunder.' Marhab struck at him, but Ali split his head and killed him, and the victory was."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Khaibar mein maujood the jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA) ki aankhon mein thooka, to woh theek ho gayin, aur unhein jhanda diya." To Marhab saamne aaya aur keh raha tha: "Khaibar ko pata hai ke main Marhab hoon, hathiyaaron se lais, tajurbekaar pehlwaan, jab jungein bhadak uthein." Unhone kaha: to Ali (RA) uske saamne aaye aur keh rahe the: "Main woh hoon jise meri maa ne Haidar naam diya, jangalon ke sher jaisa, khaufnaak soorat wala, main tumhein poora naap dunga, Sandarah ke naap ki tarah." Unhone kaha: to unhone Marhab ko maara aur uska sar phaad diya, usse qatl kar diya, aur fatah ho gayi.

e: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ acquired his sword Dhulfiqar, from the spoils of war on the Day of badr. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2808)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni talwaar Dhul-Fiqar Badr ke din maal-e-ghaneemat mein se li."

e: A’ishah said “Safiyyah was called after the word safi (a special portion of the Prophet).” (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2994)
hi: "Safiyyah (RA) ka naam 'Safi' (khaas hissa) se liya gaya hai."

e: [AI] I heard Ali saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  instructed us to divide the fifth of the spoils of war. Therefore, I distributed it according to the guidelines set by the Prophet ﷺ  during his life, as well as during the lives of Abu Bakr and Umar."
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe khums (paanchwaan hissa) ke khums ki zimmedaari di, to maine ise uski jagahon par rakha, Rasulullah (SAW) ki zindagi mein bhi, aur Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ki (khilafat) mein bhi."

e: [AI] "We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from Khaibar to Wadi Al-Qura, and with him was a young boy he had received as a gift from Rifa'ah bin Zaid Al-Hizami. While he was taking off the saddle of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with the setting sun in the background, an arrow from the west came to him and killed him. It was the arrow that no one knew who shot it. We said to him, 'Congratulations to him for Paradise.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'No, by the One in Whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, if it struck him now, he would be burned by it in the fire, its heat being equivalent to the expiation of Muslims on the day of Khaibar.' Then a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came in haste when he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying that. He said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I suffered the pain of two thorns in my shoes.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The same will be done to you in the Hellfire.'"
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Khaibar se Wadi-ul-Qura ki taraf wapas laute, unke sath unka aik ghulam tha jo unhein Rifa'ah bin Zaid Al-Hizami ne tohfe mein diya tha, jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ka saaman utaar rahe tha suraj doobne ke waqt, aik anjaan teer aaya aur usse qatl kar diya, aur yeh woh teer tha jiske baare mein pata nahi chalta kisne chalaaya, to humne unse kaha: "Mubarak ho use Jannat." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hargiz nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (SAW) ki jaan hai, beshak uski chaadar abhi aag mein usspar jal rahi hai, jo usne Khaibar ke din Musalmano ke maal-e-ghaneemat mein se chura li thi." To Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se aik aadmi dahal kar aaya jab usne Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh kehte suna, usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine apne jootoon ke liye do fite liye the." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare liye usi jaisa aag mein kaata jayega."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came, the martyrdom of Ja'far was evident. Jibril (Gabriel) then came to him and said, "Verily, Allah the Exalted has granted Ja'far two wings stained with blood, with which he flies along with the angels."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Ja'far (RA) ki shahaadat ki khabar aayi, to unhein sakht gham hua, phir Jibra'il (AS) unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Beshak Allah Ta'ala ne Ja'far (RA) ke liye khoon se rangay huay do par diye hain, jinke sath woh farishton ke sath udte hain."
