e: [AI] "When the news of the death of Ja'far reached him, we saw sadness in the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Then a man entered and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, we have been tested or overwhelmed by the women.' He said, 'Go back to them and silence them.' So he left and returned to him three times, and he said, 'Go back to them, and if they are still acting insolently, then admonish them with harsh words.' Aisha said, 'I said to myself about this man, may Allah keep him far away from us, I know that you are obedient to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and that you did not leave yourself until you knew that you cannot restrain them with harsh words.'"
hi: Jab unke paas Ja'far (RA) ki wafaat ki khabar aayi, humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre par gham dekha, to aik aadmi dakhil hua aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), auraten humein fitne mein daal chuki hain ya humpar ghaalib aa gayi hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unki taraf wapas jao aur unhein khamosh karo." Woh gaya, phir unke paas wapas aaya, aap (SAW) ne usse teen martaba wapas bheja. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unki taraf wapas jao, agar woh na maanein to unke mun mein mitti daal do." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: to maine apne aap se kaha: "Us aadmi ke liye, Allah tumhein door kare, mujhe pata hai ke tum Rasulullah (SAW) ki itaa'at karne wale nahi ho, aur tumne apne aap ko tab tak nahi chhoda jab tak tumhein yeh maloom na ho gaya ke tum unke mun mein mitti daalne ki taaqat nahi rakhte."

e: "None has put on sandals - nor worn them, nor ridden a mount, nor a Kur, after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ - better than Ja'far [bin Abi Talib]." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3764)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad kisi ne joote nahi pehne, na joote pehnaaye, aur na hi sawaariyon par sawaar hua, jo Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) se behtar ho."

e: [AI] "When the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ became extremely saddened by the killing that took place on the Day of Mu'tah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The Dajjal (Antichrist) will face a nation similar to you, or better than you, three times, and Allah will not humiliate a nation in which I am the first and 'Isa ibn Maryam (Jesus, son of Mary) is the last.'"
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ka Mu'tah ke din shaheed honay walon par gham shiddat ikhtiyar kar gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dajjal zaroor tum jaisi ya tumse behtar qaum ko paayega," teen martaba, "aur Allah kabhi bhi aisi Ummat ko zaleel nahi karega jiska main pehla hoon aur Isa bin Maryam (AS) aakhri." Repudiated.

e: Whenever Ibn ʿUmar greeted Ibn Jafar, he used to say: "As-salamu-'Alaika (i.e. Peace be on you) O son of Dhu-l-Janahain (son of the two-winged person). (Using translation from Bukhārī 3709)
hi: "Aapko salaam ho, Aye do-par walon ke bete."

e: [AI] "Abdullah bin Rawahah fainted, and his sister Ummrah started crying and saying, 'Oh my brothers, and so on and so forth, multiple insults towards him.' When he woke up, he said, 'I didn't say anything, but I was told that you are like this.'"
hi: Abdullah bin Rawaha (RA) behosh ho gaye, to unki behn Amrah rone lagi: "Haaye mere bhai, haaye yeh, haaye woh," unke khoobiyaan ginwaate huay, to jab unhein hosh aaya to unhone kaha: "Tumne jo bhi baat kahi, mujhse kaha gaya: kya tum waise hi ho?"

e: [AI] I heard Khalid ibn al-Walid say, "I have swung in my hand on the day of Mu'tah nine swords, and only a Yemeni dagger remained in my hand."
hi: Maine Khalid bin Al-Walid (RA) ko kehte suna: "Mu'tah ke din mere haath mein nau (9) talwaarein tut gayin, to mere haath mein sirf aik Yamani talwaar hi baaqi bachi."

e: [AI] She said to Salama bint Hisham ibn al-Mughira, "Why don't I see Salama attending the prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and the Muslims?" She replied, "By Allah, he cannot leave his house without people calling out 'O fugitive, have you fled for the sake of Allah, the Exalted?' until he sits in his house. He does not leave it, and he was in the Battle of Mu'tah with Khalid ibn al-Walid."
hi: Unhone Salamah bin Hisham bin Al-Mughirah (RA) ki biwi se poocha: "Mujhe kya hua hai ke main Salamah ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aur Musalmano ke sath namaz mein maujood nahi dekhti?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, woh nikal nahi paate, jab bhi woh nikalte log unpar cheekhte: 'Aye bhaagne wale, kya tumne Allah ki raah mein bhaagna ikhtiyar kiya?' yahan tak ke woh apne ghar mein baith gaye aur nikalna chhod diya, aur woh Mu'tah ke ghazve mein Khalid bin Al-Walid (RA) ke sath the."

e: [AI] Except for your escape on the day of the Battle of Mu'tah, I didn't know what I should say to him.
hi: "...siwaye tumhare Mu'tah ke din bhaagne ke, to mujhe nahi pata mujhe unse kya kehna chahiye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent 'Amr ibn al-'As in the Battle of Dhat al-Salasil, and with him were Abu Bakr and 'Umar. When they reached the location of the battle, 'Amr ordered them not to light a fire. 'Umar became angry and wanted to harm him, but Abu Bakr stopped him and informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  never used 'Amr against him except for his knowledge of war. So 'Umar calmed down.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ko Ghazwa Dhat-us-Salasil mein bheja, aur unme Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) bhi the, jab woh jung ki jagah pahunche, to Amr (RA) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh aag na jalaayen, to Umar (RA) ko ghussa aaya aur unhone unhein kuch kehne ka iraada kiya, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein roka aur bataaya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein tumpar sirf isliye ameer banaaya kyunke unhein jung ka ilm hai, to Umar (RA) shaant ho gaye.

e: [AI] "The conquest occurred on the thirteenth night of Ramadan." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: "Fatah Ramzan ki terah (13) raatein guzarne par hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his companions continued on the year of the conquest until they reached Marr Al-Zuhra with ten thousand Muslims. Sulaym and Muzaynah were there, and in every tribe there was a number of people who had embraced Islam. The Muhajirun (emigrants) and the Ansar (helpers) were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and none of them stayed behind. The news about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  became unknown to the Quraysh, and they did not receive any information about what he was doing. Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith and Abdullah ibn Abi Umayyah ibn al-Mughirah met the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  at Thaniyyat al-Aqabah on the way from Makkah to Madinah, and they sought permission to enter. Umm Salamah spoke to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, this is your cousin, the son of your aunt, and your son-in-law." He replied, "I have no need for them. As for my cousin, he has violated my honour, and as for my aunt's son and my son-in-law, he was the one who said to me in Makkah what he said." When the news reached them, Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith had a son who said, "By Allah, the Messenger of Allah will either give permission for me, or I will take his son by the hand, and we will go away and die of thirst or hunger." When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  heard about this, he sent for them, and they entered upon him. Abu Sufyan began reciting poetry about his Islam and his apology for what had happened in the past. He said, "By your life, on the day I carry a flag, the horses of al-Lat will defeat the horses of Muhammad, even if the dark night lasts long. This is the time for truth to guide and direct me. So tell Ta'if that I do not seek to fight them, and tell Ta'if that I am ready for them, guided by someone other than myself, who has guided me to Allah. I will flee quickly and strive to fight against Muhammad, even if I am not related to him. They are a group of people who do not follow their desires, even if they are intelligent and logical." He continued, "I desire for them to be pleased with me, and I will not leave them until I have been guided in every sitting. I was not in the army that gained victory, nor did my tongue bring any good, nor did my hands touch any tribe that came from distant lands, with arrows and swords. Indeed, the one you expelled and insulted will strive hard to seek revenge, not restrained by custom." When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  heard Abu Sufyan recite poetry about himself, he struck him in the chest and said, "You are the one who expelled and insulted me." Ibn Ishaq mentioned, "The mother of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  died while she was visiting her relatives from the Banu Najjar tribe."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aur unke sahaba Fatah ke saal chal pade yahan tak ke Marr-uz-Zahran mein dus hazaar (10,000) Musalmano ke sath utre, Sulaim qabile ne saat sau (700) diye, Muzainah ne izaafi (madad) di, aur har qabile mein tadaad aur Islam tha, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Muhajireen aur Ansar sab jama huay the, unme se koi bhi peeche na raha, aur Quraish tak koi khabar na pahunch pa rahi thi, na unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ki koi khabar mil rahi thi na unhein pata tha woh kya kar rahe hain. Aur Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith aur Abdullah bin Abi Umayyah bin Al-Mughirah, Rasulullah (SAW) se Saniyyat-ul-Uqaab par mile, Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan, unhone unke paas dakhil hone ki darkhwaast ki, to Umm Salamah (RA) ne unse baat ki aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapke chachere bhai aur phupi ke bete, aur aapke damaad (sahri)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe unki koi zaroorat nahi, rahi baat mere chachere bhai ki, to usne meri izzat ko takleef pahunchaayi, aur rahi baat mere phupi ke bete aur damaad ki, to usne Makkah mein mujhse jo kaha woh kaha." Jab unhein yeh khabar pahunchi, aur Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith ke sath unka aik beta tha, to unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, ya to Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe ijaazat denge ya main apne is bete ka haath pakad kar zameen mein nikal jaaunga yahan tak ke hum pyaas ya bhook se mar jaayen." Jab yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi, to unhein unpar rehm aaya, to woh unke paas dakhil huay, Abu Sufyan ne unhein apni shairi sunaayi jo unhone apne Islam qubool karne aur apni pichli ghalti par maazrat ke baare mein kahi thi, unhone kaha: "Meri jaan ki qasam, jis din main aik jhanda utha raha tha taake Laat ke ghode Muhammad (SAW) ke ghodon par ghaalib aa jaayen, main andheri raat mein bhatke huay musaafir ki tarah tha, ab yeh haq ka waqt hai, main hidayat deta hoon aur hidayat paata hoon, isliye Thaqeef se kaho main tumse jung nahi chahta, aur Thaqeef se kaho yeh mere paas hai to intezaar karo, mujhe kisi doosre ne nahi, khud Allah ne hidayat di aur mujhe raah dikhaayi, jab main har bhagaane wale se bhaaga, main tezi se Muhammad (SAW) se koshish karke bhaaga, aur main daawa karta houn agarche main Muhammad (SAW) se mansoob na hota, yeh aik jamaat hai jo apni khwaahish ke mutaabiq baat nahi karti, agarche unme koi raay wala ho jo (kuch) samjhe aur samjhaaye, main chahta hoon ke unhein khush karoon, aur main un logon ke sath kuch kehne wala nahi jab tak mujhe har majlis mein hidayat na mil jaaye, main us lashkar mein na tha jisne Aamir ko nuqsaan pahunchaaya, aur na meri zubaan na mera haath kisi bhalaai se thakaa, qabile door ke ilaaqon se aaye, taabey (madadgaar) jo Siham aur Sardad se aaye, aur beshak jinhein tumne nikaala aur bura-bhala kaha, woh tumhare liye aik aise insaan ki koshish karega jo baithne wala nahi." Unhone kaha: to jab unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh sunaaya: "Allah ki taraf, jinse main har bhagaane wale se bhaaga," Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke seene par haath maara aur farmaya: "Tumne mujhe har bhagaane se bhagaaya." Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki waalida Al-Abwa mein wafaat paayin, jabke woh Banu An-Najjar mein apne mamon se milne gayi thin."

e: On the day of the conquest of Mecca, Abdullah ibn Sa'd ibn AbuSarh hid himself with Uthman ibn Affan. He brought him and made him stand before the Prophet ﷺ, and said: Accept the allegiance of Abdullah, Messenger of Allah! He raised his head and looked at him three times, refusing him each time, but accepted his allegiance after the third time. Then turning to his companions, he said: Was not there a wise man among you who would stand up to him when he saw that I had withheld my hand from accepting his allegiance, and kill him? They said: We did not know what you had in your heart, Messenger of Allah! Why did you not give us a signal with your eye? He said: It is not advisable for a Prophet to play deceptive tricks with the eyes. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4359)
hi: Jab Makkah fatah ka din hua, to Abdullah bin Sa'd bin Abi Sarh Uthman bin Affan (RA) ke paas chhup gaya, unhein lekar aaye yahan tak ke unhein Nabi (SAW) ke saamne khada kiya, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Abdullah se baiyat lein." Aap (SAW) ne apna sar uthaaya aur unhein teen martaba dekha, phir apne sahaba ki taraf mudkar farmaya: "Kya tum mein koi aqal-mand aadmi na tha jo iske paas khada ho jaata jab usne dekha ke maine baiyat se apna haath rok liya hai, aur usse qatl kar deta?" Unhone kaha: "Humein nahi pata tha Ya Rasulullah (SAW) aapke dil mein kya hai, aapne humein apni aankh se ishara kyun nahi kiya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi Nabi ke liye yeh munaasib nahi ke uski aankhon mein khiyanat ho."

e: Abdullah ibn AbuSarh used to write (the revelation) for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Satan made him slip, and he joined the infidels. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded to kill him on the day of Conquest (of Mecca). Uthman ibn Affan sought protection for him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave him protection. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4358)
hi: "Abdullah bin Abi Sarh Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye (wahi) likha karta tha, phir kaafiron se jaa mila, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne hukum diya ke usse qatl kiya jaaye, to Uthman (RA) ne uske liye panaah maangi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse panaah de di." Sahih hai Bukhari ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "It was revealed to me, and nothing was revealed to him, and whoever says, 'I will reveal what Allah has revealed' [Al-Anam: 93], then when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered Makkah, he sought refuge with Uthman ibn Affan, his foster brother. He hid him with him until the people of Makkah were reassured. Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came and granted him protection."
hi: "Mujhpar wahi ki gayi hai jabke usse kuch bhi wahi nahi ki gayi thi, aur jo koi kahe: main bhi wahi jaisa nazil karunga jaisa Allah ne nazil kiya}" (Surah Al-An'am 93), jab "Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah mein dakhil huay, to woh Uthman bin Affan (RA) ke paas bhaaga, jo unka doodh-sharik bhai tha, unhone use apne paas chhupaaya yahan tak ke Makkah walon ka dil sukoon mein aa gaya, phir woh usse Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaye, to unhone amaan maangi."

e: [AI] When it was the year of conquest, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ settled in Dhua Tuwa, Abu Quhafa said to his youngest daughter, who was his most precious child to me above Abu Qubays, that his sight had become weak, so I was taking care of him. He said, "O my daughter, what do you see?" She said, "I see a gathering of blackness, and I see a man running in front of that blackness." He said, "Those are the horses, O my daughter." Then he said, "What else do you see?" She said, "I see the blackness spreading." He said, "In that case, by Allah, the horses have been pushed back. So hurry with me to my house." So I quickly took him until we reached the bottom of the valley. There was a collar made of leaves around its neck, and a person cut it from its neck. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the mosque, Abu Bakr came out until he brought his father to him. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw him, he said, "Why didn't you leave the old man in his house until I came to him?" He said, "He insists on coming to you, O Messenger of Allah. He walks towards you, and he has more right to do so than for you to walk towards him." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat him down in front of him, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiped his chest and said, "Submit, you will be safe." So he embraced Islam, then Abu Bakr stood up and took his sister by the hand and said, "I swear by Allah, I bear witness, by Allah and Islam, to the collar of my sister. By Allah, no one has come with anything like it." Then he said a second time, "I swear by Allah, I bear witness, by Allah and Islam, to the collar of my sister. By Allah, no one has come with anything like it." Then he said, "O my sister, count your collar." By Allah, truly, trustworthiness among people is rare.
hi: Jab Fatah ka saal hua aur Rasulullah (SAW) Zi-Tuwa mein utre, to Abu Quhafa ne apni beti se kaha, jo unki sabse chhoti aulaad thi: "Aye meri beti, mujhe Abu Qubais par le chalo," aur unki nazar ja chuki thi, to main unhein wahan le gayi, unhone poocha: "Aye meri beti, tum kya dekh rahi ho?" Unhone kaha: "Main aik jama hui kaali cheez dekh rahi hoon, aur aik aadmi ko dekh rahi hoon jo us kaali cheez ke aage tezi se badh raha hai." Unhone kaha: "Yeh ghode hain, Aye meri beti." Phir unhone poocha: "Ab tum kya dekh rahi ho?" Unhone kaha: "Main dekh rahi houn ke kaali cheez phail gayi hai." Unhone kaha: "To Allah ki qasam, ghode aage badh diye gaye hain, isliye jaldi se mujhe mere ghar le chalo." To main jaldi se nikli yahan tak ke jab main unhein le kar Al-Abtah mein utri, unke gale mein chandi ka aik haar tha, kisi ne unke gale se woh kaat liya. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) masjid mein dakhil huay, to Abu Bakr (RA) nikle yahan tak ke apne waalid ko lekar aaye, unhein raasta dikhaate huay. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein dekha, to farmaya: "Tumne is boodhe ko unke ghar mein kyun na chhoda taake main khud unke paas aata?" Unhone kaha: "Woh khud aapke paas chal kar aayen, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh isse zyada munaasib hai ke aap unke paas chalein." To unhone unhein apne saamne bithaaya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke seene par haath phera aur farmaya: "Islam qubool karo, salaamat rahoge." To unhone Islam qubool kar liya. Phir Abu Bakr (RA) khade huay aur apni behn ka haath pakda, unhone kaha: "Main tumhein Allah aur Islam ki qasam deta hoon, meri behn ka haar," Allah ki qasam, koi bhi ise nahi laaya. Phir dobara kaha: "Main tumhein Allah aur Islam ki qasam deta hoon, meri behn ka haar," koi bhi ise nahi laaya. To unhone kaha: "Aye meri behn, apne haar ka sawaab Allah se maang lo, Allah ki qasam, logon mein amaanat bohot kam hai."

e: [AI] "My father, Abu Qilabah, is still alive. Have you not met him to hear from him? So, I met Umar and he narrated to me. He said, we were in the gathering of the people, and the travelers used to pass by us. We would ask them about this matter and what it meant for the people. They would say, there is a prophet who claims that Allah has sent him and that Allah has revealed to him such and such. The Arabs blamed themselves for not embracing Islam earlier and they said, let us wait until he appears, and if he does, then he is a prophet, so believe in him. After the conquest of Mecca, every group quickly embraced Islam and rushed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . They came to him and stayed with him. Then he came to us and we met him. He said, 'I have come to you from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with the truth, and indeed he "commands you to do such and such, and when the prayer is due, let one of you call the Adhan and lead you in prayer, the one among you who has the most knowledge of the Quran.' So, they looked and could not find anyone among them who had more knowledge of the Quran than me, so they made me their Imam, and I was seven or six years old. I used to perform Salah and when I would prostrate, my garment would become tight on me. A woman from our neighborhood would say, 'Cover your reciter for us.' He said, 'So I would scrunch up my garment, from the scrunching of the people of Yemen, for six or seven Dirhams, and nothing would make me happier than that, just as being happy with that.' Al-Bukhari has narrated this Hadith from Sulayman bin Harb in a shortened form, so I have mentioned it in its complete form."
hi: Mujhse Abu Qilabah ne kaha: "Woh zinda hain, kya tum unse milkar unse (khud) nahi sunte?" To main Amr se mila, unhone mujhe hadith bataayi, unhone kaha: "Hum logon ke raaste par thay, sawaar humein baaten sunaate, hum unse poochte: yeh kya maamla hai aur logon ko kya hua hai? To woh kehte: aik Nabi hain jo daawa karte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein bheja hai aur Allah ne unpar aisa-aisa wahi ki hai, aur Arab apne Islam qubool karne ko Fatah tak taalte the, aur kehte the: usse dekho, agar woh ghaalib aaya to woh Nabi hai to usse sach maan lo, jab Fatah ke waqiye ke baad hua, to har qaum ne apne Islam ke sath Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf jaldi ki, to (mera qabila) aaya aur unke paas itne-itne din theher gaya, phir unke paas se aaya, hum unse mile, unhone kaha: main tumhare paas Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas se sach lekar aaya hoon, aur woh 'tumhein aisa-aisa hukum dete hain, aur jab namaz ka waqt aaye to tum mein se koi azaan de, aur woh tumhein imamat kare jo tum mein sabse zyada Quran jaanta ho,' to unhone dekha, unhein mujhse zyada Quran jaanne wala koi na mila, to unhone mujhe aage kiya, jabke main saat ya chhah saal ka tha, main namaz padhta, jab main sajda karta to meri chaadar mujhpar sikud jaati." Unhone kaha: qabile ki aik aurat kehti: "Humare qaari ka satar humse dhaanp do." Unhone kaha: "To mujhe Yemen ke banaaye huay kapdon mein se aik kapda pehnaaya gaya, chhah ya saat dirhamon mein, aur mujhe kisi cheez se itni khushi nahi hui jitni usse hui." Bukhari ne yeh hadith Sulaiman bin Harb se mukhtasar rivayat ki hai, isliye maine ise poori tafseel se nikaala.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Mecca on the day of victory, and his beard was touching his saddle while in a state of humility."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Fatah ke din Makkah mein dakhil huay, unki thodi unke kaathi par thi, inkisaari ke sath."

e: [AI] "A man spoke to the Prophet ﷺ on the day of the conquest, but then he was struck by lightning. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Ease up on him, as I am the son of a woman from the Quraysh tribe who used to eat dried meat.'"
hi: Aik aadmi ne Fatah ke din Nabi (SAW) se baat ki, to usse kaanpna shuru ho gaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne aap par aasaani karo, main to sirf Quraish ki aik aisi aurat ka beta hoon jo sookha gosht khaaya karti thi."

e: [AI] On the day of Hunayn, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, called out to the Ansar and said, "O people of the Ansar!" They responded, "We are at your service, O Messenger of Allah, by our fathers and our mothers." He said, "Turn your faces towards Allah and His Messenger, and He will admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow." So they turned and there they were in the valley of Hunayn, fighting fiercely until Allah granted them victory over the disbelievers.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hunain ke din Ansar ko bulaawa diya aur kaha: "Aye Ansar ke logo," unhone jawaab diya: "Hazir hain, humare maa-baap aap par qurbaan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne chehre Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf phera do, woh tumhein Jannaton mein dakhil karega jinke neeche nehrein bahti hain." To woh mud gaye, aur Hunain ka maidaan unke saamne tha, yahan tak ke unhone use aise ghera jaise buland kandhon wali fauj, aapas mein milte huay, jung karte rahe yahan tak ke Allah ne mushrikeen ko haraa diya.

e: [AI] On the day of Hunayn, the people of Makkah and the people of Madinah met and the battle became intense. They turned their backs and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ summoned the ansar. He said, "Oh Muslims, I am the Messenger of Allah." They replied, "We are with you by Allah." They then lowered their heads and fought until Allah granted them victory.
hi: Hunain ke din Makkah walon aur Madinah walon ka saamna hua aur jung shiddat ikhtiyar kar gayi, to woh peeth pher kar bhaagne lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ansar ko bulaawa diya aur kaha: "Aye Musalmano ke giroh, main Allah ka Rasool hoon." To unhone kaha: "Aapki taraf hi, Allah ki qasam, hum aa rahe hain," to unhone apne sar jhukaaye, phir jung ki yahan tak ke Allah ne unhein fatah di.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went to Hunain after he had finished conquering Makkah. He gathered the wealth of Malik ibn Awf al-Nasri from the Banu Nasr, and Jusham and Sa'd ibn Bakr and Awza' from the Banu Hilal, and some people from the Banu 'Amr ibn 'Awf. He also gathered the Ahlaf from the Thaqif and the Banu Malik. Then he went with them to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , along with the wealth, women, and children. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  heard about them, he sent 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hadrad al-Aslami and said, "Go and enter among the people to learn about their knowledge for us." So he entered and stayed among them for a day or two, then he came back and informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about the matter. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to 'Umar ibn al-Khattab, "Do you not hear what Ibn Abi Hadrad is saying?" 'Umar replied, "Ibn Abi Hadrad is lying." Ibn Abi Hadrad then said, "If you accuse me of lying, perhaps you accuse someone better than me of lying." 'Umar said, "O Messenger of Allah, do you not hear what Ibn Abi Hadrad is saying?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O 'Umar, you were indeed lost, and Allah, the Almighty, guided you." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent to Safwan ibn Umayyah and asked him for a hundred suits of armor and everything that is useful about them. Safwan asked, "By force, O Muhammad?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No, it is a loan until we return it to you." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out, and this hadith is authentic and they did not mention it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Hunain ki taraf chal pade jab woh Makkah ki fatah se faarigh huay, Malik bin Awf An-Nasri ne Banu Nasr aur Jusham aur Sa'd bin Bakr se logon ko jama kiya, aur Banu Hilal se giroh, aur Banu Amr bin Aasim bin Awf bin Aamir se kuch log, aur unke sath Thaqeef ke halif (mutahid) aur Banu Malik bhi jama huay. Phir woh unhein lekar Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf chal pade, aur woh maal, auraten, aur bachche bhi sath lekar chale. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke baare mein suna, to unhone Abdur Rahman bin Abi Hadrad Al-Aslami (RA) ko bheja aur farmaya: "Jao aur qaum mein dakhil ho jao yahan tak ke tum humein unki khabar de sako." To woh dakhil huay aur unme aik ya do din reha, phir wapas aaye aur unhein khabar bataayi. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se poocha: "Kya tum sun nahi rahe Ibn Abi Hadrad kya keh rahe hain?" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ibn Abi Hadrad ne jhoot bola." To Ibn Abi Hadrad ne kaha: "Agar aapne mujhe jhoota kaha, to kayi baar aapne mujhse behtar shakhs ko bhi jhoota kaha hai." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap sun nahi rahe Ibn Abi Hadrad kya keh raha hai?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum gumraah the, Aye Umar, to Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein hidayat di." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne Safwan bin Umayyah ki taraf paighaam bheja aur unse sau (100) zirahein aur unke zaroori saaman maange. Usne poocha: "Zabardasti se, Aye Muhammad?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke aariyat (udhaar) hai, zimmedaari ke sath, jab tak hum tumhein wapas na kar den." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) safar par nikal pade. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] From Abu Salamah al-Bahili, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , from Ubada bin As-Samit who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took on the day of Hunayn a share and a portion of the booty from a camel. Then he said, "O people, indeed it is not permissible for me to take from what Allah has bestowed upon you to the extent of this except the fifth, and the fifth is to be returned to you. So pay the thread and the needle, and beware of belittling even though it may be a rope. Indeed, it will be a burden on its people on the Day of Resurrection. And upon you is to strive in the cause of Allah, for it is a door among the doors of Paradise through which Allah removes distress and grief."
hi: Abu Sallam Al-Baahili se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi, unhone Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) se, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hunain ke din aik oont ke pehlu se aik baal liya, phir farmaya: "Aye logo, jo maal Allah ne tumhein diya hai usme se mujhe isse zyada koi cheez halaal nahi siwaye khums (paanchwaan hissa) ke, aur khums bhi tumhein wapas kar diya jaata hai, isliye dhaaga aur sui bhi (jo tumhare paas ho) wapas kar do, aur khiyaanat (maal-e-ghaneemat mein chori) se bacho, kyunke yeh Qayamat ke din uske ahl par sharm ki baat hai, aur Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, kyunke yeh Jannat ke darwazon mein se aik darwaza hai jiske zariye Allah pareshaani aur gham door karta hai."

e: [AI] "We surrounded the palace of Ta'if with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Whoever reaches (the enemy) with an arrow will have a degree in Paradise.' On that day, I reached sixteen arrows successfully."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Ta'if ke qile ka mohaasira kar rahe the, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jo koi teer se (dushman tak) pahunche, uske liye Jannat mein aik darja hai.' To us din maine solah (16) teer pahunchaaye." Sahih.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ‘Umrah four times: The ‘Umrah of Hudaibiyah, the ‘Umrah to make up for (the one not completed previously), the third from Ji’ranah and the fourth that he did with his Hajj.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3003)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne chaar (4) Umrahen kin - Umrah Hudaybiyah, agle saal Umrah-e-Qaza, teesri Ji'ranah se, aur chauthi woh jo unke Hajj ke sath thi."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went to Tabuk, he would frequently stay behind, and the people would say, "O Messenger of Allah, so and so has stayed behind." He would reply, "Leave him, if there is any good in him, Allah will bring him to you, and if there is no good in him, then Allah has saved you from him." This continued until it was said, "O Messenger of Allah, Abu Dharr has stayed behind and his camel is slow." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Leave him, if there is any good in him, Allah will bring him to you, and if there is no good in him, then Allah has saved you from him." Abu Dharr blamed his camel for being slow, so he took his belongings and placed them on its back and started walking to catch up with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stayed in one of his houses and a Muslim saw a man walking on the road and said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "O Messenger of Allah, there is a man walking on the road." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "He is Abu Dharr." When the people recognized him, they said, "By Allah, it is indeed Abu Dharr!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "May Allah have mercy on Abu Dharr. He walks alone, dies alone, and will be resurrected alone." Time went on and Abu Dharr reached Rabadhah, and when death approached him, he advised his wife and slave, "When I die, wash me, shroud me, then carry me and place me on the side of the road. The first caravan that passes by, say, 'This is Abu Dharr.' When I die, do as I have instructed." When Abu Dharr passed away, they did as they were told. A group of people passed by, unaware of Abu Dharr's death, and their rides nearly trampled his body. Then Ibn Mas'ud came in a group from the people of Kufa and they asked, "What is this?" They were told, "It is the funeral of Abu Dharr." Ibn Mas'ud started to cry and said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  spoke the truth, may Allah have mercy on Abu Dharr. He walks alone, dies alone, and will be resurrected alone." Then he descended from his camel until he reached him and his group covered him with dirt. When they reached Madinah, Uthman mentioned what Abdullah said
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Tabuk ki taraf chal pade, to koi na koi aadmi peeche reh jaata, log kehte: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), fulan peeche reh gaya hai." Aap (SAW) farmaate: "Usse chhod do, agar usme khair hai to Allah usse tumse mila dega, aur agar aisa nahi hai to Allah ne tumhein usse aaraam de diya." Yahan tak ke kaha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Abu Dharr (RA) peeche reh gaye hain, unka oont unhein der se chala raha hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usse chhod do, agar usme khair hai to Allah usse tumse mila dega, aur agar aisa nahi hai to Allah ne tumhein usse aaraam de diya." To Abu Dharr (RA) apne oont par intezaar karte rahe, jab woh der karne laga, to unhone apna saaman uthaaya aur apni peeth par rakh liya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe paidal chalne lage. Rasulullah (SAW) apne kisi padaav par utre, Musalmano mein se aik dekhne wale ne dekha aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh aik aadmi raaste par chal raha hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ho jaao Abu Dharr." Jab logon ne unhein gaur se dekha, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ki qasam, yehi Abu Dharr hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Abu Dharr par reham kare, woh akele chalte hain, akele marenge, aur akele uthaaye jaayenge." Phir zamana guzarta gaya, aur Abu Dharr (RA) ko Rabza ki taraf bheja gaya, jab unhein maut aayi, to unhone apni biwi aur apne ghulam ko wasiyat ki: "Jab main mar jaaun, to mujhe ghusl do, kafan pehnaao, phir mujhe uthaakar raaste ke kinare rakh do, jo bhi pehla qaafila tumhare paas se guzre, to kehna: yeh Abu Dharr hain." Jab unka intiqaal hua, to unhone waise hi kiya, aik qaafila aaya, magar unhein unki khabar na hui yahan tak ke unki sawaariyon ke ediyaan unke takht ko rondne hi wali thin, achaanak Ibn Mas'ood (RA) Kufa walon ke aik giroh mein the, unhone poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Kaha gaya: "Abu Dharr (RA) ka janaaza hai." To Ibn Mas'ood (RA) rone lage aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne sach farmaaya: 'Allah Abu Dharr par reham kare, woh akele chalte hain, akele marenge, aur akele uthaaye jaayenge.'" To woh utre aur khud unki dekhbhaal ki yahan tak ke unhein dafan kar diya. Jab woh Madinah pahunche, to Uthman (RA) ko Abdullah (Ibn Mas'ood) ki baat aur unke us mein kya kirdaar tha, iska zikr kiya gaya.

e: [AI] "About Ali? This is the house of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the mosque, and this is the house of Ali. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent Abu Bakr and Umar with a letter of pardon to the people of Mecca. They set out and suddenly they saw someone riding. They asked, 'Who is this?' He replied, 'I am Ali, O Abu Bakr, give me the book that you have.' Abu Bakr asked, 'What do I have to do with it?' Ali said, 'By Allah, I only know goodness from it.' So Ali took the book and went with it, while Abu Bakr and Umar returned to the city of Medina. They asked the Prophet, 'What do we have, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'You have nothing but goodness, but it was said to me that no one should convey from you except you or a man from you.'"
hi: Ali (RA) ke baare mein poocha gaya: "Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ka ghar masjid mein hai, aur yeh Ali (RA) ka ghar hai." Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ko Makkah walon ki taraf "Bara'ah" (disavowal ka ailaan) lekar bheja, dono chal pade, achaanak unhein aik sawaar mila, unhone poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Usne kaha: "Main Ali hoon, Aye Abu Bakr, mujhe woh kitaab dijiye jo aapke paas hai." Unhone poocha: "Mera kya (kasoor) hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe iske siwa kuch nahi pata ke isme bhalaai hi hai." To Ali (RA) ne kitaab li aur usse lekar chale gaye, aur Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) Madinah wapas laut aaye, unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein kya (kasoor) hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhein bhalaai ke siwa kuch nahi, lekin mujhse kaha gaya hai ke sirf tum khud, ya tumhare khaandaan ka koi aadmi hi tumhari taraf se yeh pahunchaaye."

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ dispatched Abu Bakr ordering him to announce these statements. Then 'Ali followed him. When Abu Bakr was at a particular road, he heard the heavy breathing of Al-Qiswa, the she camel of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so Abu Bakr appeared frightened because he thought that it was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When he saw that it was 'Ali, he gave him the letter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and told 'Ali to announce the statements. So he left to perform Hajj. During the day of At-Tashriq 'Ali stood to announce: 'The protection of Allah and His Messenger is removed from every idolater. So travel in the land for four months. There is to be no idolater performing Hajj after this year, nor may anyone perform Tawaf around the House while naked. None shall enter Paradise but a believer.' 'Ali was making the announcement, so when he became exhausted Abu Bakr would announce it." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3091)
hi: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) ko bheja aur unhein hukum diya ke woh yeh baaten pukaarein," to Ali (RA) unke peechhe chale, jab Abu Bakr (RA) raaste mein the, to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ki oontni ki aawaaz suni, Abu Bakr (RA) dahal kar nikle, unhone socha ke woh khud Rasulullah (SAW) hain, achaanak Ali (RA) the, to unhone unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ki kitaab de di jo unhein mausam (Hajj) ka ameer banaate huay Ali (RA) ko yeh baaten pukaarne ka hukum deti thi. To Ali (RA) ne Tashreeq ke dinon mein khade hokar pukaara: "Beshak Allah mushrikeen se bezaar hai, aur uska Rasool bhi, isliye chaar mahine zameen mein ghoom lo, is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj na kare, aur na koi nangi haalat mein Ghar (Ka'bah) ka tawaf kare, aur Jannat mein sirf momin hi dakhil hoga." Ali (RA) yeh pukaarte rahe, jab unki awaaz bhaari ho gayi to Abu Hurairah (RA) khade hokar pukaarne lage. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur is nidaa ki sharh ke sath Ali (RA) se riwayat sahih saabit hui hai.

e: "We asked 'Ali what he had been dispatched with during the Hajj. He said: 'I was sent with four: That there shall be no Tawaf around the House while naked, that if there is a treaty between someone and the Prophet ﷺ, then the treaty remains until its expiration, and whoever does not have a treaty, then he has the span of four months, none shall enter Paradise except a believer, and the idolaters and Muslims shall not congregate (for Hajj) after this year.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3092)
hi: Humne Ali (RA) se poocha: "Aap Hajj mein kya lekar bheje gaye?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe chaar baaton ke sath bheja gaya - Jannat mein sirf momin jaan hi dakhil hogi, koi nangi haalat mein Ghar ka tawaf na kare, momin aur kaafir is saal ke baad Masjid-e-Haraam mein aik sath jama na hon, aur jiska Nabi (SAW) ke sath koi ahd hai, to uska ahd uski muqarrar muddat tak hai, aur jiska koi ahd nahi, to uski muddat chaar mahine hai." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying when the messenger of Musaylimah al-Kadhdhab came to him with his book, and the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to both of them, "So you both say what he says?" They said, "Yes." So the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "By Allah, if it were not that messengers are not killed, I would strike your necks."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna, jab unke paas Musaylimah Kazzab ke do qaasid uski kitaab lekar aaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne dono se poocha: "Kya tum dono bhi wahi kehte ho jo woh kehta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, agar yeh na hota ke qaasid qatl nahi kiye jaate, to main tum dono ki gardanein zaroor maar deta."

e: [AI] "O Abu Abdurrahman, there are people here who are reciting from the recitation of Musaylimah." Abdullah said, "Is there a book other than the Book of Allah or a Messenger other than the Messenger of Allah after the Prophet of Islam?" He then brought him after him and said, "O Abdullah, by the One besides whom there is no god, they are in the house reciting from the recitation of Musaylimah, and they have with them a Quran that has the recitation of Musaylimah. This occurred during the time of Uthman. Abdullah said to the group of horsemen, "Go until you surround the house and capture everyone inside." They did so and brought him eighty men. Abdullah said to them, "Woe to you, is there a book other than the Book of Allah or a Messenger other than the Messenger of Allah?" They replied, "We repent to Allah, for we have indeed wronged." Abdullah left without fighting them and marched them towards Sham (Syria) under the leadership of Ibn An-Nawwaha. He refused to repent, so Abdullah said to the horseman, "Go and strike his neck and throw his head near his mother's grave, for I see that she knows of his actions." So he did as Abdullah commanded. This narration is authentic.
hi: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, yahan kuch log hain jo Musaylimah ki tilaawat se padhte hain." To Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Kya Allah ki Kitaab ke siwa koi doosri kitaab, ya Allah ke Rasool ke siwa koi doosra Rasool, Islam phailne ke baad?" To unhone use wapas bheja, phir woh dobara aaya aur kaha: "Aye Abdullah, us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh us ghar mein Musaylimah ki tilaawat se padh rahe hain, aur unke paas aik mus-haf bhi hai jismein Musaylimah ki tilaawat hai," aur yeh Uthman (RA) ke zamane mein tha. To Abdullah (RA) ne Qarazah se, jo ghudsawaron ka saathi tha, kaha: "Jao aur ghar ko ghero, phir jo bhi usme hain unhein pakdo." Usne aisa kiya aur assi (80) aadmi lekar aaya, Abdullah (RA) ne unse kaha: "Afsos tumpar, kya Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab ke siwa koi doosri kitaab, ya Allah ke Rasool ke siwa koi doosra Rasool?" Unhone kaha: "Hum Allah ki taraf tauba karte hain, humne zulm kiya hai." To Abdullah (RA) ne unhein chhod diya, unse jung nahi ki, aur unhein Sham (Syria) ki taraf bhej diya, siwaye unke sardaar Ibn An-Nawwahah ke, jisne tauba karne se inkaar kiya. To Abdullah (RA) ne Qarazah se kaha: "Jao aur uski gardan maaro, aur uska sar uski maa ki god mein daal do, kyunke mujhe lagta hai unhein uske kaam ka ilm tha," to usne aisa hi kiya. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to Musaylimah and Musaylimah said to him, "Do you bear witness that I am the messenger of Allah?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I believe in Allah and His messengers." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, this is a man who is leading his people to destruction."
hi: Musaylimah Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, usne unse kaha: "Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Allah aur uske Rusul par imaan laata hoon." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak yeh aadmi apni qaum ki halaakat ke liye der se aaya hai."

e: [AI] The sons of Saad ibn Bakr, Dimam ibn Tha'laba, were sent to the Messenger of Allah. They came to us and I tied their camel at the gate of the mosque. Then they entered upon the Messenger of Allah, who was sitting in the mosque with his companions. He asked them, "Which one of you is the son of Abdul-Muttalib?" The Messenger of Allah replied, "I am the son of Abdul-Muttalib." He said, "Muhammad?" The Messenger of Allah replied, "Yes." He said, "O Muhammad, I have a question for you, and I am persistent in it. Do not find me offensive. For I do not find it in myself." He said, "Ask about what you have in mind." He said, "I ask you by Allah, your God, the God of those before you, and the God of those who will come after you: Did Allah send you to us as a messenger?" The Messenger of Allah replied, "By Allah, yes." He said, "I ask you by Allah, your God, the God of those before you, and the God of those who will come after you: Did Allah command you that we worship Him alone and not associate anything with Him, and that we reject these idols and false gods that our forefathers used to worship?" The Messenger of Allah replied, "By Allah, yes." Then he began mentioning the obligations of Islam, one by one, starting with prayer, then zakah, fasting, and Hajj, reciting them after each obligation, just as he recited them before. When he finished, he said, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that you are His servant and messenger. I will fulfill these obligations and avoid what you have prohibited me from doing. I will not increase or decrease in them." Then he turned around and returned to his camel. The Messenger of Allah said as he was leaving, "If the two idols are truthful, he will enter Paradise." Dimam was a tall, hairy man with prominent shoulders. He came with his camel and released its reins until he came to his people. They gathered around him and the first thing he said was cursing Lat and Uzza. They said, "What is wrong with you, O Dimam? Beware of leprosy, madness, and insanity!" He said, "Woe to you! By Allah, neither of them can harm or benefit. Allah has sent a messenger and revealed a book to you, which has saved you from what you were in. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. I have come to you from him with what he has commanded you and what he has forbidden you. By Allah, not a single man or woman in the city today is not a Muslim." Ibn Abbas said, "We have not heard of a group coming that was better than Dimam ibn Tha'laba. Both the two sheikhs agreed to remove from their book the story of Dimam entering the city, and neither of them narrated the complete hadith. This is authentic." Authentic.
hi: Banu Sa'd bin Bakr ne Dimam bin Tha'labah ko Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf bheja, to woh humare paas aaya, apna oont masjid ke darwaze par bithaaya aur baandh diya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil hua jabke woh masjid mein apne sahaba ke sath baithe huay the, usne poocha: "Tum mein se kaun Abdul Muttalib ka pota hai?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Abdul Muttalib ka pota hoon." Usne poocha: "Muhammad?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan." Usne kaha: "Aye Muhammad, main aapse sawaal karunga aur sawaal mein sakhti karunga, isliye mere baare mein apne dil mein kuch mat rakhna, kyunke main apne dil mein kuch nahi rakhta." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo pooch-na chaaho poocho." Usne kaha: "Main aapko Allah, aapke Ma'bood, aapse pehlon ke Ma'bood, aur aapke baad honay walon ke Ma'bood ki qasam deta hoon: kya Allah ne aapko humari taraf Rasool banaakar bheja?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, ji haan." Usne kaha: "Main aapko Allah, aapke Ma'bood, aapse pehlon ke Ma'bood, aur aapke baad honay walon ke Ma'bood ki qasam deta hoon: kya Allah ne aapko hukum diya ke hum uski ibaadat karein aur uske sath kisi ko shareek na karein, aur unhein but aur shareek chhod dein jinki humare baap-daada ibaadat karte the?" To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, ji haan." Phir usne Islam ke faraaiz ginwaane shuru kiye, aik-aik farz, namaz, zakat, roza, aur Hajj, aur Islam ke tamaam faraaiz, har farz par woh isi tarah qasam deta jaise usse pehle wale par di thi, yahan tak ke jab woh faarigh hua, to usne kaha: "To main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur aap uske banda aur Rasool hain, aur main in faraaiz ko poora karunga aur jin cheezon se aapne mujhe mana kiya hai unse bachunga, na zyada karunga na kam." Phir woh apne oont ki taraf wapas gaya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne jab woh mudh gaya to farmaya: "Agar do jodi baalon wala (yeh aadmi) sacha nikla, to woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga," aur Dimam aik mazboot, baalon wala, do choti-choti chotiyon wala aadmi tha. Phir woh apne oont ke paas aaya, uski rassi khol di yahan tak ke apni qaum ke paas pahuncha, woh usse jama huay, to sabse pehle usne jo baat ki woh Laat aur Uzza ko bura-bhala kehna tha. Unhone kaha: "Ruko, Aye Dimam, koda, jazaam, aur junoon se bacho." Usne kaha: "Afsos tumpar, Allah ki qasam, yeh dono na nuqsaan pahunchate hain na faida, beshak Allah ne aik Rasool bheja hai aur unpar aik Kitaab nazil ki hai jisse usne tumhein us se nijaat di jismein tum thay, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad (SAW) uske banda aur Rasool hain, aur main tumhare paas unki taraf se woh lekar aaya hoon jo unhone tumhein hukum diya aur jisse mana kiya." To Allah ki qasam, us din uski basti mein koi mard ya aurat aisi na thi jo Musalman na ho gayi ho. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Humne kisi qaum ke wafd ke baare mein nahi suna jo Dimam bin Tha'labah se behtar ho." Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ka Dimam ke Madinah aane ka zikr nikaalne par ittefaaq hai, lekin dono ne poori hadith is tafseel se nahi nikaali, aur yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed Hajj in the tenth year after the migration to Medina and performed the Hajj on its own." (Al-Dhahabi did not comment on it in his summary.)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni Madinah hijrat ke dasvein saal Hajj kiya, aur unhone sirf Hajj kiya (Ifraad)." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Prophet (pbuh) performed Hajj before migrating with rituals, and he performed Hajj after the farewell pilgrimage. Everything he did during the Hajj contained one hundred camels, one of which had a silver she-camel in its nose. The Prophet (pbuh) slaughtered sixty-three of them with his own hand, and Ali slaughtered the rest." When asked who mentioned this, Thawri said, Jafar ibn Muhammad narrated it from his father, from Jabir, and Ibn Abi Layla from Muqsim, from Ibn Abbas.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne hijrat se pehle bhi kayi Hajj kiye, aur hijrat ke baad Hajjat-ul-Wida (Vida Hajj) kiya, aur woh jo laaye the woh sau (100) sawaari jaanwar the, jinme aik oont bhi tha jiski naak mein chandi ki nath thi, Nabi (SAW) ne apne haath se terasath (63) zibah kiye, aur Ali (RA) ne baaqi zibah kiye." Sufyan Ath-Thawri se poocha gaya: "Ise kisne bataaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ja'far bin Muhammad ne apne waalid se, unhone Jabir (RA) se, aur Ibn Abi Laila ne Miqsam se, unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) se."

e: [AI] Narrated Abu Muayhibah, who was a guardian of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke me up one night and said, 'O Abu Muayhibah, go and seek forgiveness, for I have been commanded to seek forgiveness for the people of Baqi' (the graveyard in Medina).' So I went with him. When we reached Baqi', he said, 'Peace be upon you, O people of Baqi', may what you are in this morning be good for you. If you knew what Allah has saved you from, the trials would have approached you like thick darkness following after darkness. Then he said, 'O Abu Muayhibah, Allah has chosen for me to be given the treasures of the earth, eternal life in it, and then Paradise, and the meeting with my Lord Almighty.' I said, 'May I be your sacrifice, both my parents are offered to you. Take the keys of the treasures of this earth, and eternal life in it, then Paradise.' He said, 'No, O Abu Muayhibah, I have chosen to meet my Lord Almighty.' Then he sought forgiveness for the people of Baqi' and left. When he began the prayer in the morning, he would begin his prayer by complaining about that day when he was taken (from this world)." (Source: Al-Bukhari)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik raat mere paas raat ko aaye aur farmaya: "Aye Abu Muwaihibah, chalo maghfirat maango, kyunke mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main is Baqi' walon ke liye maghfirat maangoon." To main unke sath chala, jab woh Baqi' pahunche to farmaya: "Assalamu Alaikum, Aye Baqi' walo, mubarak ho tumhein jo tum ismein subah kar chuke ho, agar tumhein pata hota ke Allah ne tumhein isse kaise bacha liya, fitne aise aayenge jaise andheri raat ke tukde, aik ke baad doosra chalta rahega." Phir farmaya: "Aye Abu Muwaihibah, beshak Allah ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya hai ke woh mujhe zameen ke khazane de aur usme hamesha rehne ka mauqa de, phir Jannat, ya apne Rab, buzurg aur buland, se milaap." Maine kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan, aap zameen ke khazane, usme hamesha rehna, aur phir Jannat qubool kar lein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hargiz nahi, Aye Abu Muwaihibah, maine apne Rab, buzurg aur buland, se milaap ko hi chuna hai." Phir unhone Baqi' walon ke liye maghfirat maangi, phir wapas laute, jab subah hui to unhein woh bimaari shuru ho gayi jisme unka intiqaal hua.

e: similarly is reported from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ[^1]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se isi jaise andaaz mein.

e: [AI] "Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , narrated that the Prophet ﷺ  began to experience the illness from which he eventually passed away in the house of Maymunah. He came out leaning on the shoulders of two men, with his head wrapped. He entered upon me, dragging his feet on the ground, with Al-Abbas on his right side and a man on his left side." Ubaidullah said: "Ibn Abbas informed me that the man on his left side was Ali."
hi: Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, se, "Rasulullah (SAW) ki woh bimaari jismein unka intiqaal hua, woh Maimunah (RA) ke ghar mein shuru hui, to woh apna sar bandhe huay nikle, do aadmiyon ke darmiyan, unke pair zameen par ghisatte huay, mere paas dakhil huay, unke dayen taraf Abbas (RA) the aur unke baayen taraf aik aadmi." Ubaidullah ne kaha: mujhe Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bataaya "ke unke baayen taraf jo the woh Ali (RA) the."

e: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was dying, and there was a bowl of water next to him. He put his hand in the vessel and wiped his face with the water, and said: ‘O Allah, help me to bear the agonies of death.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1623)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko intiqaal karte dekha, unke paas paani se bhara aik pyaala tha, woh apna haath us pyaale mein daalte, phir apne chehre par paani pherte, phir kehte: "Aye Allah, mujhe maut ki sakhtiyon mein madad de."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said his last words were: 'Glorious is the majesty of my Lord, the most Exalted, I have conveyed the message.' Then he passed away ﷺ ."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke aakhri alfaaz thay: 'Meri buzurg Rab ki azmat, maine paighaam pahunchaa diya,'" phir aap (SAW) ka intiqaal ho gaya.

e: [AI] The last testament of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when death approached him was "Prayer, prayer" (meaning, to emphasize the importance of prayer). He repeated it twice, and continued to mention it in his chest and express it with his tongue. He said, "They both agreed to include this statement in the collection of Hadith, and to include the last statement spoken by Aisha." The higher companion.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki aakhri wasiyat, jab maut unke qareeb aayi, "Namaz, namaz," do martaba, "aur jo tumhare zer-e-nigraan hain (ghulam, aur jo bhi tumhari zimmedaari mein hon)," aur woh isse apne seene mein baar-baar kehte rahe, aur unki zubaan usse achhi tarah ada nahi kar pa rahi thi. Dono ne is hadith ko nikaalne par ittefaaq kiya hai, aur Aisha (RA) ki hadith bhi nikaalne par jo unke aakhri alfaaz the: "Rafiq-e-A'la" (buland saathi).

e: [AI] "When the day on which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, it became darker than everything in Medina."
hi: "Jis din Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, Madinah ki har cheez andheri ho gayi."

e: [AI] "I witnessed the day on which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away, and I have never seen a day uglier than it."
hi: "Main us din maujood tha jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, maine kabhi koi din isse zyada tareek nahi dekha."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away, the angels, who were able to hear but not see, offered their condolences saying, "Peace be upon you, O people of the house, and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you. Surely, there is comfort in Allah for every hardship and there is a substitute for every loss. So have faith in Allah and rely on Him. Have hope, for the ones who are deprived are the ones who are deprived of rewards. Peace be upon you, and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to farishton ne unhein taaziyat di, log unki aawaaz sunte magar unki shakl nahi dekhte, to kaha gaya: "Assalamu Alaikum, Aye ghar walo, aur Allah ki rehmat aur uski barkatein, beshak Allah mein har museebat ka sahaara hai aur har chhoot jaane wali cheez ka badla hai, isliye Allah par bharosa karo aur usi se ummeed rakho, kyunke mehroom woh hai jo sawaab se mehroom kiya jaaye, aur Assalamu Alaikum aur Allah ki rehmat aur uski barkatein."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away, his companions surrounded him and cried. They gathered together and a man with a prominent beard and a broad chest came in. He stood over them and cried, then turned to the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "Verily, in Allah, there is consolation for every calamity, compensation for every loss, and a successor for every deceased. So turn to Allah and seek His help, and look at you in times of difficulty. For indeed, the true affliction is the one who is not patient and does not seek refuge." Some of them asked each other, "Do you know this man?" Abu Bakr and Ali said, "Yes, this is the brother of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , Al-Khidr, peace be upon him. He is a witness to what has happened, even though 'Abbad ibn Abdus-Samad is not a condition for this book." This is a witness to what has been mentioned before.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to unke sahaba ne unhein gher liya, unke ird-gird roye aur jama huay, to aik surkhi maayil daadhi wala, mote badan, khoobsurat chehre wala aadmi dakhil hua, unki gardanon ke oopar se guzarta hua, woh roya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ki taraf mudkar kaha: "Beshak Allah mein har museebat ka sahaara hai, har chhoot jaane wali cheez ka badla hai, aur har halaak honay wale ka khalaf (jaanasheen) hai, isliye Allah ki taraf rujoo karo aur usi se ummeed rakho, aur tumhari azmaaish mein tumhari taraf aik nazar hai to isse dekho, kyunke musibat-zada woh hai jo (sawaab se) mehroom raha," phir woh chala gaya. To kuch ne aapas mein poocha: "Kya tum us aadmi ko jaante ho?" To Abu Bakr (RA) aur Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Ji haan, yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ke bhai, Khidr (AS), hain." Yeh gawaah hai us baat ka jo pehle guzar chuki, agarche Abbad bin Abdus-Samad is kitaab ki shart par nahi hain.

e: [AI] Aisha used to say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say during the illness in which he passed away, 'O Aisha, I feel the pain of the food that I ate at Khaybar. This is the time when the aorta will be severed from that poison.'"
hi: Urwah se, Aisha (RA) kaha karti thin: Rasulullah (SAW) apni us bimaari mein jismein unka intiqaal hua, kehte the: "Aye Aisha, main abhi tak Khaibar mein khaaye huay khaane ka dard mehsoos karta hoon, yehi waqt hai jab woh zeher meri rag (abhar) kaat degi."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was killed is more beloved to me than taking a single oath, because he was not killed. That is because Allah, the Almighty and Glorious, made him a prophet and made him a witness.
hi: "Ke Rasulullah (SAW) qatl kiye gaye, yeh mujhe zyada aziz hai is baat se ke main aik martaba qasam khaaun ke unhein qatl nahi kiya gaya, aur iski wajah yeh hai ke Allah ne unhein Nabi aur shaheed dono banaaya."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Sha'abi say, "By Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was poisoned, and Abu Bakr al-Siddiq was also poisoned. Umar ibn al-Khattab was murdered with patience, and Uthman ibn Affan was murdered with patience. Ali ibn Abi Talib was also murdered with patience. Al-Hasan ibn Ali was poisoned, and Al-Hussein ibn Ali was also murdered with patience. So what do we expect after them?" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine Ash-Sha'bi ko kehte suna: "Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) ko zeher diya gaya, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ko bhi zeher diya gaya, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) sabr ke sath shaheed kiye gaye, Uthman bin Affan (RA) sabr ke sath shaheed kiye gaye, Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) sabr ke sath shaheed kiye gaye, Hasan bin Ali (RA) ko zeher diya gaya, aur Husain bin Ali (RA) sabr ke sath shaheed kiye gaye, to inke baad hum kya ummeed rakhein?" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "O my father, how close he is now to his Lord! O my father, we announce the news (of his death) to Jibril! O my father, Jannat Al-Firdawas is now his abode!" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1844)
hi: Beshak Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW) Rasulullah (SAW) par roeen aur kaha: "Haaye mere abba, apne Rab ke kitne qareeb, haaye mere abba, Jibra'il (AS) unki khabar deta hai, haaye mere abba, Firdaus ki Jannat unka thikaana hai."

e: [AI] "I washed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and then I started looking at what might indicate signs of death, but I did not see anything. He ﷺ  looked fresh and alive, yet he had passed away."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghusl diya, to main dekhne lagi ke murdon mein kya (tabdeeliyan) hoti hain, magar mujhe kuch nazar na aaya, aur woh zindagi aur maut dono mein khushbudaar the (SAW)."

e: [AI] "We wanted to wash the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , but the people had a disagreement regarding it. Some of them said, 'We should strip the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  as we strip our dead or wash him while his clothes are on.' So Allah revealed the Sunnah upon them until every single one of them had fallen asleep with his chin on his chest. Then someone from the direction of the Ka'bah said, 'Don't you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is to be washed with his clothes on?' So they washed him while his shirt was on, pouring water over it and rubbing it gently over him. Aisha said, 'By Allah, if I did not know that it was from the order of Allah, I would not have washed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  except for his garments.'"
hi: Humne Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghusl dene ka iraada kiya, to logon mein ikhtilaaf hua, kuch ne kaha: "Kya hum Rasulullah (SAW) ko waise hi nanga karein jaise hum apne murdon ko karte hain, ya hum unhein unke kapdon ke sath ghusl dein?" To Allah ne unpar neend taari kar di, yahan tak ke unme koi bhi aisa na tha jo apni thodi apne seene par rakhe sota na ho. To ghar ke kisi kone se aik kehne wale ne kaha: "Kya tumhein nahi pata ke Rasulullah (SAW) ko unke kapdon ke sath ghusl diya jaata hai?" To unhone unhein unka qamees pehne huay hi ghusl diya, paani daalte huay aur oopar se malte huay. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar main apne baad ka jaanti jo pehle nahi jaanti thi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ko unki biwiyon ke siwa koi ghusl na deta."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  became heavy, we said, "Who will offer prayer upon you, O Messenger of Allah?" So he cried, and we cried as well. He said, "Wait, may Allah forgive you and reward you for your Prophet. When you wash me, shroud me, and place me on the edge of my grave, then leave me for a while. The first one to offer prayer upon me will be my close friend and companion Gabriel, then Michael, then Israfil, then the Angel of Death with a group of angels. Then let the men of my household offer prayer upon me, followed by their women. After that, let the groups come in, one after another, and the individuals. And do not harm me with your weeping, wailing, or shouting. And whoever among my companions is absent, inform him of my salutations. For I bear witness that I have conveyed my greetings to everyone who entered Islam and followed my religion from this day until the Day of Judgment." 'Abdul Malik bin 'Abdul Rahman in this chain is unknown to us, and we do not know his trustworthiness or reliability. As for the others, all of them are trustworthy.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) sakht bimaar ho gaye, humne kaha: "Aapki namaz-e-janaza kaun padhaayega, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" To aap (SAW) roye aur hum bhi roye, aur farmaya: "Thehro, Allah tumhein bakhshe aur tumhare Nabi ki taraf se tumhein achha badla de, jab tum mujhe ghusl de chuko, hunoot laga chuko, aur kafan pehna chuko, to mujhe meri qabr ke kinare rakh do, phir kuch der ke liye mere paas se nikal jao, kyunke sabse pehle jo mujhpar namaz padhega woh mera khaleel aur mera hum-nashin, Jibra'il (AS) hai, phir Mikaeel (AS), phir Israfeel (AS), phir Malak-ul-Maut, farishton ke lashkar ke sath, phir mere Ahl-e-Bait ke mard sabse pehle mujhpar namaz padhein, phir unki auraten, phir tum giroh-dar-giroh aur akele-akele dakhil ho, aur mujhe kisi rone wali, cheekhne wali, ya chillaane wali ki wajah se takleef mat do, aur mere sahaba mein se jo ghair-hazir ho, unhein mera salaam pahunchaao, kyunke main tumhein gawah banaata hoon ke maine har us shakhs ko salaam kaha hai jo Islam mein dakhil hua aur jisne mere is deen ki pairavi ki, aaj se leke Qayamat ke din tak." Abdul Malik bin Abdur Rahman, jo is isnad mein hain, majhool (anjaan) hain, hum unhein na adaalat se jaante hain na jarah se, aur baaqi sab thiqa (bharosemand) hain.

e: [AI] "It was as if three moons fell into my room, so I asked Abu Bakr. He said, 'O Aisha, if your dream is true, then the best people on earth will be buried in your house.' When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away and was buried, Abu Bakr said to me, 'O Aisha, this is the best of your moons, and he is one of them.'"
hi: "Goya teen chaand mere kamre mein gir gaye," to maine Abu Bakr (RA) se poocha, unhone kaha: "Aye Aisha, agar tumhara khwaab sach hua, to zameen ke behtareen teen log tumhare ghar mein dafan honge." Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua aur unhein dafan kiya gaya, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Aisha, yeh tumhare chaandon mein sabse behtar hai, aur yeh unme se aik hai."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  liked dreams. He asked, "Did anyone of you see a dream last night?" Aisha replied, "I saw as if three moons fell down in my chamber." The Prophet ﷺ  said to her, "If your dream is true, it means that three are the best or most honorable women on Earth." When the Prophet ﷺ  died, he was buried in her chamber. Abu Bakr then said to her, "This is one of your moons, and he is the best of them." Then Abu Bakr died and was buried in her chamber, followed by Umar.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ko khwaab pasand tha, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum mein se kisi ne aaj koi khwaab dekha hai?" Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Maine dekha goya teen chaand mere kamre mein gir gaye." To Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Agar tumhara khwaab sach hua, to tumhare ghar mein teen log dafan honge jo zameen walon mein sabse afzal ya behtareen honge." Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intiqaal hua aur unhein unke ghar mein dafan kiya gaya, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne unse kaha: "Yeh tumhare chaandon mein se aik hai, aur yeh unme sabse behtar hai." Phir Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ka intiqaal hua, dono unke ghar mein hi dafan huay.

e: [AI] I used to enter my house, where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is, and I would take off my garment and say, "He is my husband and my father." But when Umar was buried with them, by Allah, I did not enter except that my garments were tightened out of shyness from Umar.
hi: Main apne us ghar mein dakhil hoti jismein Rasulullah (SAW) (dafan) the, to main apna kapda (aaraam se) rakh deti aur kehti: "Yeh to mera shohar aur mera abba hain." Jab Umar (RA) unke sath dafan huay, to Allah ki qasam, main sirf apne kapdon ko khud par kas kar hi dakhil hoti thi, Umar (RA) se sharm ki wajah se.

e: [AI] Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq, his name is Abdullah son of Uthman son of Amr son of Kaab son of Saad son of Taim son of Murrah son of Kaab son of Luay son of Ghalib son of Fihr.
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ka naam Abdullah bin Uthman bin Aamir bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Taim bin Murrah bin Ka'b bin Lu'ayy bin Ghalib bin Fihr hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever desires to see a person from the those saved from the Hellfire, let him look at Abu Bakr. And indeed, his name, which his family named him, is Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Amr ibn Amr where he was born. But the name 'Atiq overwhelmed him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise khushi ho ke woh aag se aazaad kiye gaye kisi shakhs ko dekhe, to woh Abu Bakr (RA) ko dekhe, aur beshak unka naam jo unke ghar walon ne unhein diya, woh Abdullah bin Uthman bin Aamir bin Amr tha jab woh paida huay, phir 'Atiq' (aazaad kiya gaya) ka naam unpar ghaalib aa gaya."

e:
[AI] The passage translates to:

"Ali heard someone swear, 'By Allah, the Exalted has sent down the name of Abu Bakr from the heavens as 'Siddiq' (the truthful).' If it were not for the ignorance of Muhammad ibn Sulaiman al-Saeedi, I would have judged this chain of narration as authentic. There is also supporting evidence in the hadith of al-Nazzal ibn Sabra from Ali. If it were not for the ignorance of Muhammad ibn Sulaiman al-Saeedi, the teacher of Ishaq al-Sululi, I would have judged it as authentic."
hi: Unhone Ali (RA) ko qasam khaate suna: "Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Bakr (RA) ka naam aasman se 'Siddiq' utaara." Agar Muhammad bin Sulaiman As-Sa'idi ki majhoolatiyat (anjaan honay) na hoti, to main is isnad ko sahih qaraar deta, aur iska aik gawaah bhi hai, An-Nazzal bin Sabrah ki hadith se, Ali (RA) se.

e: [AI] "We agreed with Ali, who had a good soul and was joking, so we said to him, tell us about your companions. He said, 'All the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  are my companions.' We then said, tell us about Abu Bakr. He said, 'That is a man whom Allah called "Siddiq" (the truthful) on the tongue of Jibril and Muhammad (peace be upon them).' Halal bin Al-`A'laa denies the hadith."
hi: Humne Ali (RA) ko khush-mizaaj paaya, jabke woh mazaaq kar rahe the, humne kaha: "Humein apne sahaba ke baare mein bataayen." Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke tamaam sahaba mere sahaba hain." Humne kaha: "Humein Abu Bakr (RA) ke baare mein bataayen." Unhone kaha: "Woh aise insaan hain jinhein Allah ne Jibra'il (AS) aur Muhammad (SAW), unpar Allah ki rehmatein hon, ki zubaan se 'Siddiq' ka naam diya." Hilal bin Al-Ala hadith ko munkir (radd) karte hain. Repudiated.

e: [AI] When the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) was taken on the Night Journey to the Al-Aqsa Mosque, people began talking about it. Some people turned away from believing it, but those who believed and confirmed it went to Abu Bakr and asked him, "Does your friend claim that he was taken on this journey to Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa last night?" Abu Bakr asked, "Did he say that?" They replied, "Yes." Abu Bakr said, "If he said that, then he has spoken the truth." They asked him, "Do you believe him when he says that he went to Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa last night and returned before morning?" Abu Bakr replied, "Yes, I believe him even in something far greater than that. I believe him when he receives revelation from the heavens, either during the morning or while at rest." That is why Abu Bakr was given the title "As-Siddiq" (the Truthful).
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ko Masjid-e-Aqsa ki taraf isra (raat ka safar) karaaya gaya, to subah log iske baare mein baaten karne lage, kuch log murtad ho gaye, aur jo log imaan laa chuke the aur unhone tasdeeq ki thi, unhone yeh sunkar Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas jaakar kaha: "Kya aap apne saathi ke baare mein sunenge jo daawa karte hain ke unhein raat ko Bait-ul-Maqdis tak safar karaaya gaya?" Unhone poocha: "Kya unhone yeh kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Agar unhone yeh kaha hai, to unhone sach kaha." Unhone poocha: "Kya aap unki tasdeeq karte hain ke woh raat ko Bait-ul-Maqdis gaye aur subah hone se pehle wapas aa gaye?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, main to unki tasdeeq usse bhi door ki baat mein karta hoon, main unki tasdeeq aasman ki khabar ki karta hoon, subah ya shaam mein." Isi wajah se Abu Bakr (RA) ko "As-Siddiq" (sachai wale) ka naam diya gaya.

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him, was a trusted companion of the Prophet ﷺ . He held a position similar to that of a minister, and the Prophet used to consult him in all matters. Abu Bakr was the second to embrace Islam, the second in the cave during the migration to Madinah, and the second in the Battle of Badr. He was also buried next to the Prophet ﷺ , and no one was considered superior to him by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke liye waziir (madadgaar) ki jagah the, aap unse apne tamaam maamlaat mein mashwara karte, aur woh Islam mein doosre the, ghaar mein doosre the, Badr ke din chhappar mein doosre the, aur qabr mein doosre the, aur Rasulullah (SAW) unpar kisi ko aage nahi rakhte the." Iske raawiyon mein aik majhool hain.

e: [AI] "It was the day when it was cold, so he took a bath. He had been absent from attending the prayer for fifteen nights. Umar used to pray with the people while he was in his house, which was assigned to him by the Prophet ﷺ, and he faced the house of Uthman on that day. Umar instructed Asma' bint Umayis, his wife, to wash him after his death. However, she was weak, so she sought help from Abdur Rahman. He was shrouded in two garments, one of which was used for washing, and it is said that he was shrouded in three garments. He was carried on the bed of the Prophet ﷺ, which was Aisha's bed that she used to sleep on. Abu Bakr carried him on it, and Umar prayed for him in the mosque between the grave and the pulpit. He was buried in the house alongside the Prophet ﷺ during the night, and his head was placed between the shoulders of the Prophet ﷺ." The narration has been summarized by Al-Dhahabi.
hi: Ke unhone aik thande din ghusl kiya, to unhein pandrah (15) raaton tak bukhaar chadha raha, woh namaz ke liye bahar nahi nikal sake, to Umar (RA) logon ko namaz padhaate rahe, aur woh apne us ghar mein the jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Uthman (RA) ke ghar ke saamne kaat kar diya tha, aur unhone wasiyat ki thi ke Asma bint Umais (RA), unki biwi, unhein ghusl dein, aur woh kamzor thin, to unhone Abdur Rahman (RA) se madad li, unhein do kapdon mein kafan diya gaya, aik dhula hua tha, aur kaha jaata hai teen kapdon mein, aur unhein Nabi (SAW) ke takht par uthaaya gaya, jo Aisha (RA) ka takht tha jispar woh sotin thin, Abu Bakr (RA) ko usspar uthaaya gaya, Umar (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza masjid mein qabr aur mimbar ke darmiyan padhaayi, aur unhein raat ko ghar mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath dafan kiya gaya, aur unka sar Nabi (SAW) ke dono kandhon ke darmiyan rakha gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The cause of the death of Abu Bakr was the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . His body continued to deteriorate until he died. Its chain of narration is weak.
hi: "Abu Bakr (RA) ki maut ka sabab Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat thi, unka jism kamzor hota chala gaya yahan tak ke unka intiqaal ho gaya." Isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] "A man once presented Abu Bakr with a dish of poisoned meat. With him was a man called Al-Harith bin Kalada, who had knowledge (about the dish). When they ate from it, Ibn Kalada mentioned that it contained poison that would take effect after a year. By the One in whose hand is my soul, they did not live past that year and died on the same day, the first day of the year."
hi: "Aik aadmi ne aik din Abu Bakr (RA) ko khazeerah (gosht-shorba) ki aik thaali tohfe mein di, aur unke paas aik aadmi tha jise Al-Harith bin Kaladah kaha jaata tha, jise (dawaai ka) ilm tha, jab dono ne usme se khaaya, to Ibn Kaladah ne kaha: 'Isme aik saal ka zeher hai,' to us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, saal poora hone se pehle dono aik hi din, saal ke shuru mein, faut ho gaye." Yeh mursal hai.

e: [AI] "He said, 'What can be expected from this worldly life, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was poisoned, as well as Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, Umar ibn al-Khattab was killed by a blow to his nose, and the same happened to Uthman and Ali. Hasan was poisoned and Husayn was killed by a blow to his nose.' The secret is left."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Is neech duniya se kya ummeed rakhi jaaye, jabke Rasulullah (SAW) ko zeher diya gaya, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ko zeher diya gaya, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) qatl kiye gaye, isi tarah Uthman (RA) aur Ali (RA) bhi qatl kiye gaye, Hasan (RA) ko zeher diya gaya, aur Husain (RA) qatl kiye gaye." As-Sirri matrook (chhoda hua/kamzor) hain. Weak, Rejected.

e: [AI] I witnessed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying to Hassaan ibn Thabit, "Did you say something about Abu Bakr?" He replied, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Say it so I can hear." Hassaan ibn Thabit then said, "Two out of two in the Manif Cave, while the enemy encircled it, when the two ascended the mountains. And the love of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  for them was known by all creatures, for he did not substitute them in any way." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  smiled, and 'Amr ibn Ziyad wrote down the narration.
hi: Main maujood tha jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hassan bin Thabit (RA) se poocha: "Kya tumne Abu Bakr (RA) ke baare mein kuch kaha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho, taake main sunoon." Unhone kaha, maine kaha: "Aur do mein se doosre, buland ghaar mein, jabke dushman ne unhein ghera dala jab woh pahaad par chadhe, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke mehboob thay, makhlooq ko yeh maloom tha, unhone unhein kisi doosre se badla nahi." To Rasulullah (SAW) muskuraaye. Amr bin Ziyad hadith gadhte hain.

e: [AI] You heard the saying of Hassaan [the simple sea], "If you remember a yearning from your brother with trust, then remember your brother Abu Bakr for what they did, the best of creations, the most pious, the most just after the Prophet. They fulfilled it with what they carried, the second successor, the praised one. His scene is the first of the people, from them he believed in the messengers." Remove it by Al-Dhahabi from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: Kya tumne Hassan (RA) ka yeh qaul suna: "Jab tum kisi bharosemand bhai ki yaad mein gham mehsoos karo, to apne bhai Abu Bakr (RA) ko yaad karo, jo unhone kiya usse, makhlooq mein sabse behtar, sabse zyada muttaqi, aur Nabi (SAW) ke baad sabse insaaf-pasand, aur unhein jo emaanat di gayi usme sabse zyada wafaadaar, doosre, jinki pairavi ki gayi, jinka maqaam qaabil-e-tareef hai, aur logon mein sabse pehle jinhone Rusul ki tasdeeq ki." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se iski kamzori ki wajah se hata diya.

e: [AI] She said, "Abu Bakr asked me how many shrouds did you wrap the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in?" So I said, "In three garments." He said, "Wrap me in the same."
hi: Unhone kaha: Abu Bakr (RA) ne mujhse poocha: "Aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko kitne kapdon mein kafan diya?" Maine kaha: "Teen kapdon mein." Unhone kaha: "To mujhe bhi usi mein kafan dena."

e: [AI] "In how many white Yemeni garments did you shroud the Prophet ﷺ?" I said, "In three new white Yemeni garments, without a shirt or a turban." He said, "Wash my garment, it has saffron stain and a defect, and place it with two new garments." I said, "Indeed, it is worn out." He said, "The living deserves new clothes more than the dead, for surely he will wear them longer." - Reported by Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Aapne Nabi (SAW) ko kitne kapdon mein kafan diya?" Maine kaha: "Teen safed, naye, Yemeni kapdon mein, jisme na qamees thi na amaamah." Unhone kaha: "Mera yeh kapda dho lo jisme za'fraan ka nishaan aur rangat hai, aur isse do naye kapdon ke sath rakh do." Maine kaha: "Yeh to purana ho chuka hai." Unhone kaha: "Zinda insaan naye kapde ka murda se zyada haqdaar hai, murda to sirf gal-sad jaayega." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "And Abu Bakr's caliphate lasted for two years and seven months." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary.
hi: "Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat do (2) saal aur saat (7) mahine rahi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the beginning of his prophethood while he was in Makkah and at that time he was in disguise, so I asked him, "Who are you?" He said, "I am a Prophet." I asked, "What is a Prophet?" He said, "A Messenger of Allah." I asked, "Did Allah send you?" He said, "Yes." I asked, "What did Allah send you with?" He said, "To worship Allah alone, break the idols, and maintain family ties." I said, "Yes, I believe in that which Allah has sent you. So who has followed you in this?" He said, "A slave and a free man," meaning Abu Bakr and Bilal. 'Umar used to say, "I remember that I was a quarter of Islam." Then I became Muslim and said, "Shall I follow you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "No, rather convey the truth to your people. When you hear that I have left Makkah, then follow me."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas unki Nubuwwat ke shuru mein aaya, jabke woh Makkah mein chhupe huay the, maine poocha: "Aap kya hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Nabi hoon." Maine poocha: "Nabi kya hota hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ka Rasool." Maine poocha: "Kya Allah ne aapko bheja?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan." Maine poocha: "Kis cheez ke liye aapko bheja?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isliye ke tum Allah ki ibaadat karo, buton ko todo, aur sila-e-rahmi (rishtedaari ke rishte) qaayam rakho."
