Maine kaha: "Kitni achhi baat hai jiske sath aapko bheja gaya hai, to isspar aapki pairavi kaun karta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik ghulam aur aik aazaad," matlab Abu Bakr (RA) aur Bilal (RA). Aur Amr (RA) kaha karte the: "Maine khud ko dekha ke main Islam ka chauthaai hissa tha." Unhone kaha: to main Musalman ho gaya aur maine kaha: "Kya main aapki pairavi karoon, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke apni qaum ke paas jao, jab tumhein khabar mile ke main nikal chuka hoon, to meri pairavi karna."

e: [AI] I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was descending in 'Ukaz. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, who follows you in this matter?" He said, "Two free men and a slave: Abu Bakr and Bilal." I embraced Islam at that moment. As for the narration of Abu 'Amr
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke woh Ukaz mein utre huay the, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), is maamle mein aapki pairavi kaun karta hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do aadmi isspar meri pairavi karte hain, aik aazaad aur aik ghulam, Abu Bakr (RA) aur Bilal (RA)." Unhone kaha: to main usi waqt Musalman ho gaya. Aur rahi baat Abu Ammar ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] Thana Shaddad ibn Abdullah, Abu Ammar, and he had met a group of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Abu Umarah said to Amr ibn Abasa, "O Amr ibn Abasa, by what do you claim that you possess one-fourth of Islam?" So he mentioned the Hadith in its entirety.
hi: Humein Shaddad bin Abdullah Abu Ammar ne hadith bayan ki, jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se kuch logon ko paaya tha, unhone kaha: Abu Umamah (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Amr bin Abasah, tum kis buniyaad par daawa karte ho ke tum Islam ka chauthaai hissa ho?" Phir poori hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr was our leader, our best and most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he adhered to their conditions and did not contradict them according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: "Abu Bakr (RA) humare sardaar, humare behtareen, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko humme se sabse zyada aziz thay." Sahih hai Shaykhain ki shart par, dono ne ise nahi nikala.

e: [AI] "And he said, by Allah, I have never been eager for leadership, neither day nor night, nor have I desired it. I have never asked Allah, Almighty and Glorious, for it, neither secretly nor openly. But I feared Fitnah (trials and tribulations), and I am not at ease with leadership. However, I have been entrusted with a great task, for which I have no strength or capability except by relying on the strength and might of Allah, Almighty and Glorious. If I had wished, the Muslims would have accepted my leadership today. The Muhajirun (those who migrated from Mecca to Medina), accepted what I said and did not object to it. Ali and Zubair also did not express anger, except because we were deprived of participating in the consultation. We believe that after the Prophet ﷺ, Abu Bakr is the most deserving of leadership. He was the companion of the cave and the second of the two, and we are well aware of his nobility and greatness. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ instructed him to lead the people in prayer while he was alive."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main kisi din ya raat khilafat ka khwahishmand nahi raha, aur na hi mujhe iski chaah thi, na maine Allah, buzurg aur buland, se ise chhupkar maanga na khule taur par, lekin mujhe fitne ka darr tha, aur khilafat mein mere liye koi aaraam nahi, balke mujhe aik bada kaam supurd kiya gaya hai jiski mujhme taaqat ya samajh nahi siwaye Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki madad ke, aur main chahta ke aaj is (zimmedaari) par mujhse zyada taaqatwar koi aur hota." To Muhajireen ne unki baat qubool ki aur unki maazrat qubool ki. Ali (RA) aur Zubair (RA) ne kaha: "Humein sirf isliye ghussa aaya kyunke humein mashware se peeche rakha gaya, aur hum samajhte hain ke Abu Bakr (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad iske sabse zyada haqdaar hain, woh ghaar walon mein se hain aur do mein se doosre hain, aur hum unki izzat aur unki umr ko jaante hain," "aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein logon ko namaz padhaane ka hukum diya tha jabke woh khud zinda the."

e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, the Ansar said: A leader from among us and a leader from among you. ‘Umar went to them and said: O Ansar, do you not know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer? Which of you would like himself to be given precedence over Abu Bakr? The Ansar said: We seek refuge with Allah from being given precedence over Abu Bakr. (Using translation from Aḥmad 133)
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to Ansar ne kaha: "Humme se aik ameer aur tumme se aik ameer." To Umar (RA) unke paas gaye aur kaha: "Aye Ansar ke logo, kya tumhein nahi pata ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) ko logon ki imamat karne ka hukum diya tha? To tum mein se kaun apne dil se raazi hoga ke woh Abu Bakr (RA) se aage badhe?" To Ansar ne kaha: "Hum Allah ki panaah maangte hain ke hum Abu Bakr (RA) se aage badhein."

e: [AI] "They indeed struck the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until he fainted. Abu Bakr stood up and started calling out, saying, 'Woe to you! Are you killing a man just because he says, 'My Lord is Allah?' They asked, 'Who is this?' He said, 'He is the son of Abu Quhafa, the madman.'"
hi: "Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko itna maara ke woh behosh ho gaye, to Abu Bakr (RA) khade huay aur pukaarne lage: 'Afsos tumpar, kya tum aik aadmi ko isliye qatl karoge ke woh kehta hai mera Rab Allah hai?' Unhone poocha: 'Yeh kaun hai?' Kaha gaya: 'Yeh Ibn Abi Quhafah hai, deewaana.'"

e: [AI] He informed him that he heard Suraqah ibn Ju'shum say, "The messengers of the disbelieving Quraysh came to us, attributing a debt to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Abu Bakr. They said that whoever kills either of them, the murderer will be demanded a compensation, and whoever captures them alive, they will be demanded a ransom."
hi: Unhone Suraqah bin Ju'shum (RA) ko kehte suna: "Quraish ke kaafiron ke qaasid humare paas aaye, Rasulullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) ke liye diyat (inaam) muqarrar kar rahe the, aur jo unhein qatl kare, har aik par diyat, ya unhein qaidi banaaye."

e: [AI] I heard Ali say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  preceded and surpassed Abu Bakr and Umar by three. Then he said, 'Then we faced a trial, and Allah forgives whom He wills.'"
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) sabqat le gaye, phir Abu Bakr (RA) doosre the, phir Umar (RA) teesre, phir aik fitna humein khutba deta raha, aur Allah jise chaahe maaf karta hai."

e: When ʿUmar bin al Khattab ؓ was placed on his bier, the people gathered around him, praying and invoking blessings upon him before [the bier] was lifted up, and I was among them. No one alarmed me except a man who seized me by the shoulder from behind. I turned and saw that it was ‘Ali bin Abi Talib ؓ . He prayed for mercy for ‘Umar ؓ , then he said: You have not left behind anyone more dear to me, with the like of whose deeds I would hope to meet Allah, than you. By Allah, I think that Allah will most certainly join you to your two companions, and that is because I often heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, ʿAbu Bakr, ʿUmar and I went; Abu Bakr, ʿUmar and I came in; Abu Bakr, ‘Umar and I went out.” So I think that Allah will most certainly join you to them. (Using translation from Aḥmad 898)
hi: "ke Allah Ta'ala tumhein apne dono saathiyon ke sath rakhe," aur iski wajah yeh thi ke main aksar Rasulullah (SAW) ko kehte sunta: "Main aur Abu Bakr aur Umar gaye, main aur Abu Bakr aur Umar dakhil huay, main aur Abu Bakr aur Umar nikle," aur main gumaan karta tha ke Allah tumhein bhi unke sath shaamil karega.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered the mosque with one hand on Abu Bakr and the other on Umar, saying, "This is how we will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment." Sa'id bin Muslimah al-Qurashi is a weak narrator.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) masjid mein dakhil huay, aik haath Abu Bakr (RA) par aur doosra Umar (RA) par tha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isi tarah humein Qayamat ke din uthaaya jayega." Sa'eed bin Muslimah Al-Qurashi kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The first person from whom the earth will split open is me, then Abu Bakr, then Umar, then I will come to the people of Baqi, and the earth will split open for them, and I will be sent between them.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse pehle jiske liye zameen phategi woh main hoon, phir Abu Bakr (RA), phir Umar (RA), phir main Baqi' walon ke paas aaunga, unke liye bhi zameen phatega, aur mujhe unke darmiyan uthaaya jaayega."

e: It was narrated from Abu Salih al-Hanafi that It was said to ‘Ali and Abu Bakr ؓ on the day of Badr. Jibreel is with one of you and Mikaʿeel is with the other, and Israfeel, a mighty angel, is present at the fight - or he said, is present in the ranks. (Using translation from Aḥmad 1257)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse aur Abu Bakr (RA) se farmaya: "Tum dono mein se aik ke sath Jibra'il (AS) hain aur doosre ke sath Mikaeel (AS), aur Israfeel (AS) aik azeem farishta hain jo jung mein maujood hote hain," ya farmaya: "saf mein maujood hote hain."

e: [AI] "While I was at Badr, a strong wind blew and I had never seen anything like it before. Then it stopped, and another strong wind blew that I had never seen before except for the one that came before it. Then it stopped, and another strong wind blew that I had never seen before except for the one that came before it. The first wind was Gabriel, who came down with a thousand angels accompanying the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The second wind was Michael, who came down with a thousand angels on the right of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, with Abu Bakr on his right. The third wind was Israfil, who came down with a thousand angels from the left of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I was with him on the left. When Allah Almighty defeated His enemies, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ carried me on his horse and it shot off, causing me to fall on my back. I called upon Allah, and He held me. When I regained my posture, I struck with my hand at the people, until this wound of mine started to bleed." And he pointed towards his armpit.
hi: "Jabke main Badr ke kuye se paani nikaal raha tha, achaanak aik tez hawa aayi jaisi maine kabhi nahi dekhi thi, phir woh chali gayi, phir aik tez hawa aayi jaisi maine kabhi nahi dekhi thi siwaye us pehli ke, phir woh chali gayi, phir aik tez hawa aayi jaisi maine kabhi nahi dekhi thi siwaye us pehli ke. To pehli hawa Jibra'il (AS) thi, jo aik hazaar (1000) farishton ke sath Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath utre, aur doosri hawa Mikaeel (AS) thi, jo aik hazaar farishton ke sath Rasulullah (SAW) ke daayen taraf utre, aur Abu Bakr (RA) unke daayen taraf the, aur teesri hawa Israfeel (AS) thi, jo aik hazaar farishton ke sath Rasulullah (SAW) ke baayen taraf utre, aur main baayen taraf tha. Jab Allah Ta'ala ne apne dushmanon ko haraaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe apne ghode par bithaaya, woh mujhe lekar daudi, to main apni ediyon ke bal gir gaya, maine Allah, buzurg aur buland, ko pukaara, to usne mujhe sambhaal liya, jab main uspar seedha ho gaya, to maine apne is haath se qaum par vaar kiya yahan tak ke yeh khoon se rang gaya," aur unhone apni bagal ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: [AI] I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he looked towards Abu Bakr and Umar and said, "These are the hearing and sight."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tha, to unhone Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ki taraf dekha aur farmaya: "Yeh dono kaan aur aankh hain."

e: [AI] From the words of Allah, Exalted and Glorified be He: "Indeed, Allah is his Protector and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers." (Surah At-Tahrim, 4). Abu Umaamah narrated to me that just as Allah said, "Allah is his Protector and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers," Abu Bakr and Umar (may Allah be pleased with them) are also so. This hadith has a sound chain of narration and Musa bin Umayr did not exclude them.
hi: Allah, buzurg aur buland, ke farmaan "{To beshak Allah hi uska waali hai, aur Jibra'il, aur momino mein se neik log}" (Surah At-Tahrim 4) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: mujhse Abu Umamah (RA) ne hadith bayan ki ke jaisa unhone kaha: "Allah uska waali hai, aur Jibra'il (AS), aur momino mein se neik log - Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA)." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Musa bin Umair kamzor hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "If you follow Abu Bakr, you will find him ascetic in this worldly life and eager for the Hereafter. If you follow Umar, you will find him strong and trustworthy, and he will not lead you astray in matters concerning Allah, the Most High. And if you follow Ali, you will find him a guide and a rightly guided leader, who will lead you on the right path."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum Abu Bakr (RA) ko ameer banaao, to unhein duniya se be-raghbat aur Aakhirat ka khwahishmand paaoge, aur agar tum Umar (RA) ko ameer banaao, to unhein mazboot, amaanatdaar paaoge, jinhein Allah ke maamle mein kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat nahi rokti, aur agar tum Ali (RA) ko ameer banaao, to unhein hidayat-yaafta, hidayat dene wala paaoge, jo tumhein sahi raah par chalaayenge." Weak.

e: [AI] They said, "O Messenger of Allah, if you appoint a successor over us?" He said, "If I appoint a caliph over you and you disobey him, you will be afflicted with punishment." They said, "If you appoint Abu Bakr as a successor over us?" He said, "If I appoint him as a successor over you, you will find him strong in the matter of Allah but weak in his body." They said, "If you appoint Umar as a successor over us?" He said, "If I appoint him as a successor over you, you will find him strong and trustworthy, and you will hold no blame against him in matters related to Allah." They said, "If you appoint Ali as a successor over us?" He said, "Indeed, if you do not do what he commands, then if you do, you will find him as a guide and guided one who follows the straight path with you." This is Uthman bin Umair, he is also known as Abu al-Yaqdhan. Weakness diminished him.
hi: Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar aap humpar koi khalifa muqarrar kar dein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main tumpar koi khalifa muqarrar karoon aur tum uski na-farmani karo, to tumpar azaab nazil hoga." Unhone kaha: "Agar aap humpar Abu Bakr (RA) ko khalifa muqarrar karein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main unhein tumpar khalifa banaaun, to tum unhein Allah ke maamle mein mazboot, apne jism mein kamzor paaoge." Unhone kaha: "Agar aap humpar Umar (RA) ko khalifa muqarrar karein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main unhein tumpar khalifa banaaun, to tum unhein mazboot, amaanatdaar paaoge, jinhein Allah ke maamle mein kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat nahi rokti." Unhone kaha: "Agar aap humpar Ali (RA) ko khalifa muqarrar karein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum aisa nahi karoge, lekin agar tum aisa karo, to unhein hidayat-yaafta, hidayat dene wala paaoge jo tumhein seedhi raah par chalaayenge." Uthman bin Umair, yehi Abu Al-Yaqzaan hain, inhein kamzor kaha gaya hai. Weak.

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr and Umar."
hi: Allah, buzurg aur buland, ke farmaan "{Aur unse maamle mein mashwara karo}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 159) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA)."

e: One day the Prophet ﷺ said: Which of you had dream? A man said: It is I. I saw as though a scale descended from the sky. You and AbuBakr were weighed and you were heavier; AbuBakr and Umar were weighed and AbuBakr was heavier: Umar and Uthman were weighed and Umar was heavier; than the scale was taken up. we saw signs of dislike on the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4634)
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum mein se kisi ne khwaab dekha?" To aik aadmi ne kaha: "Main ne dekha, goya aik taraazu aasman se utri, to aapko aur Abu Bakr (RA) ko taula gaya, to aap Abu Bakr (RA) se bhaari the, aur Umar (RA) aur Abu Bakr (RA) ko taula gaya, to Abu Bakr (RA) bhaari the, aur Umar (RA) aur Uthman (RA) ko taula gaya, to Umar (RA) bhaari the, phir taraazu utha li gayi." To humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre par napasandeedgi dekhi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to pray Fajr and then turn towards his companions and say, "Who among you had a dream last night?" One day, he prayed and then asked, "Who among you saw a dream?" A man replied, "O Messenger of Allah, I saw as if there was a scale from the sky, and you were placed in one side, while Abu Bakr was placed in the other side. You outweighed Abu Bakr, then you were lifted and Abu Bakr was left in his place." Then, Umar bin Khattab was brought and placed in the other side of the scale. Umar outweighed Abu Bakr, so Abu Bakr was lifted and Umar was left in his place. Then, Uthman was brought and placed in the other side of the scale. Umar outweighed Uthman, so Uthman was lifted and Umar was left in his place. Then, the scale changed and the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  turned serious. He said, "The Caliphate after prophethood will last for thirty years, then it will become a monarchy." Sa'id bin Jumhan said to me, Sufaynah, "Hold onto my years, which are the years of Abu Bakr and the ten years of Umar, and the twelve years of Uthman, and the six years of Ali, all of them." And these narrations have been authentically attributed to the Prophet ﷺ . Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Fajr padhte, phir apne sahaba ki taraf mudte aur poochte: "Tum mein se kisne raat koi khwaab dekha?" Unhone kaha: aik din unhone namaz padhi, phir poocha: "Tum mein se kisne khwaab dekha?" To aik aadmi ne kaha: "Main ne, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine dekha goya aik taraazu aasman se latki hui thi, to aapko aik pallay mein rakha gaya aur Abu Bakr (RA) ko doosre pallay mein, to aap Abu Bakr (RA) se bhaari nikle, to aapko utha liya gaya aur Abu Bakr (RA) apni jagah reh gaye, phir Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko laaya gaya aur doosre pallay mein rakha gaya, to Abu Bakr (RA) Umar (RA) se bhaari nikle, to Abu Bakr (RA) ko utha liya gaya, phir Uthman (RA) ko laaya gaya aur doosre pallay mein rakha gaya, to Umar (RA) Uthman (RA) se bhaari nikle, phir Umar (RA) aur Uthman (RA) donon ko utha liya gaya, aur taraazu bhi utha li gayi." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ka chehra badal gaya, phir farmaya: "Nubuwwat ki khilafat tees (30) saal chalegi, phir woh baadshaahat ban jaayegi." Sa'eed bin Jumhaan ne kaha: to mujhse Safinah (RA) ne kaha: "Yaad rakho - Abu Bakr (RA) ke do (2) saal, Umar (RA) ke das (10) saal, Uthman (RA) ke baarah (12) saal, aur Ali (RA) ke chhah (6) saal, sab milaakar." Aur yeh riwayaten sahih isnad ke sath Nabi (SAW) tak marfoo' saabit hui hain. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: Last night a good man had a vision in which Abu Bakr seemed to be joined to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. ‘Umar to Abu Bakr, and ‘Uthman to ‘Umar. Jabir said: When we got up and left the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we said: The good man is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and that their being joined together means that they are the rulers over this matter with which Allah has sent His Prophet ﷺ. Abu Dawud said: It has been transmitted by Yunus and Shu’aib, but they did not mention ‘Amr b. Aban. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4636)
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aaj raat aik neik aadmi ko dikhaaya gaya ke Abu Bakr (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) se joda gaya hai, aur Umar (RA) Abu Bakr (RA) se joda gaya hai, aur Uthman (RA) Umar (RA) se joda gaya hai." Jabir (RA) ne kaha: jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas se uthe, to humne kaha: "Neik aadmi Nabi (SAW) khud hain, aur unme se kuch ka kuch se joda jaana, yeh isliye hai ke woh is maamle ke wali (hukmaraan) hain jise lekar Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko bheja, aur iske anjaam ke liye." Is hadith ki isnad sahih hai, Abu Hurairah (RA) se, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "The caliphate is in Medina, and the kingdom is in Sham (Syria)." Authenticated by Sulaiman ibn Abi Sulaiman, and his father is unknown.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khilafat Madinah mein hogi, aur baadshaahat Sham (Syria) mein." Sahih. Sulaiman bin Abi Sulaiman aur unke waalid majhool (anjaan) hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "May Allah have mercy on Abu Bakr, who married me to his daughter and carried me to the place of emigration."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Abu Bakr (RA) par reham kare, unhone apni beti ka nikah mujhse kiya, aur mujhe hijrat ke ghar tak pahunchaaya."

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered the year of the conquest, he saw women hitting the faces of horses with their veils. He smiled at Abu Bakr and asked, 'Oh Abu Bakr, what did Hassaan ibn Thabit say?' So Abu Bakr recited: 'I have lost my sense of satisfaction in my daughter unless they see her arousing the interest of neck muscles as if they were arguing in haste. Women hitting them with their veils.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Enter from where Hassaan said to enter.'"
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Fatah ke saal dakhil huay, to unhone auraton ko dupattoon se ghodon ke chehre peette huay dekha, to woh Abu Bakr (RA) ki taraf muskuraaye aur poocha: "Aye Abu Bakr, Hassan bin Thabit (RA) ne kya kaha tha?" To Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein sunaaya: "Meri beti se mehroom ho jaaun agar tum unhein na dekho, Kada ke dono kandhon se gard uthaate huay, lagaamein khainchti huay, jaldi mein, jinhein auraten dupattoon se peetti hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jahan se Hassan ne kaha, wahin se dakhil ho jao."

e: [AI] We were with the Prophet ﷺ  and the Prophet ﷺ  said, "A man from the people of Paradise will come to you." Then Abu Bakr came and greeted us, then he sat down.
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas the, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ab tumhare saamne Jannat walon mein se aik aadmi zaahir hoga." To Abu Bakr (RA) zaahir huay, salaam kiya, phir baith gaye.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Gabriel came and taking me by the hand showed the gate of Paradise by which my people will enter. AbuBakr then said: Messenger of Allah! I wish I had been with you so that I might have looked at it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said: You, AbuBakr, will be the first of my people to enter Paradise. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4652)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS) ne mera haath pakda aur mujhe Jannat ka woh darwaaza dikhaaya jisse meri Ummat dakhil hogi." To Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kaash main aapke sath hota taake main ise dekh sakta." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sun lo, tum meri Ummat mein se sabse pehle isme dakhil hone wale ho."

e: [AI] When Aisha's death approached, Khawlah bint Hakim came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "Why don't you get married?" He asked, "Who?" She replied, "If you wish, a young virgin and if you wish, a widow." He asked, "Who is the young virgin? And who is the widow?" She said, "The young virgin is Aisha bint Abu Bakr, the most beloved creature of Allah to you. And the widow is Sauda bint Zam'ah."
hi: Aisha (RA): jab Khadijah (RA) ka intiqaal hua, to Khaulah bint Hakim Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur poocha: "Kya aap nikah nahi karenge?" Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kis se?" Unhone kaha: "Agar aap chaahen to aik kanwaari, aur agar aap chaahen to aik biwah." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kanwaari kaun hai, aur biwah kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Kanwaari to Allah ki makhlooq mein aapko sabse aziz (shakhs) ki beti hai, Aisha bint Abi Bakr, aur biwah Sawdah bint Zam'ah hai."

e: [AI] I asked Aisha, "Who were the most beloved people to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him?" She replied, "Abu Bakr, then Umar, then Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah."
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) se poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko sabse zyada kaun aziz tha?" Unhone kaha: "Abu Bakr (RA), phir Umar (RA), phir Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (RA)."

e: [AI] I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ , and then Abu Bakr and Umar entered. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Praise be to Allah who supported me with both of you."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas baitha tha, to Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) zaahir huay, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe tum dono se taaqat di."

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'I have intended to send men to different regions to teach people the Sunnahs and obligations, just as 'Isa bin Maryam sent his disciples.' It was said to him, 'What about Abu Bakr and 'Umar?' He replied, 'I cannot do without them, as they are part of the religion, like hearing and sight are.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Maine iraada kiya tha ke duniya ke kinaron mein aise log bhejun jo logon ko Sunnaten aur faraaiz sikhaayen, jaise Isa bin Maryam (AS) ne apne haawariyon ko bheja tha." Unse poocha gaya: "To aap Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ke baare mein kya (sochte hain)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe unse be-niyaazi nahi ho sakti, woh deen mein kaan aur aankh ki tarah hain."

e: [AI] "When the verse (Surah Al-Hujurat, 49:3) was revealed to the Prophet ﷺ : 'Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness,' Abu Bakr said, 'I wish for myself to speak to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  only in secret like a dear brother.'"
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) par yeh nazil hui: "{Beshak jo log Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne apni aawazein pest rakhte hain, wahi log hain jinke dilon ko Allah ne taqwa ke liye aazmaaya hai}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 3), to Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Maine apne aap par yeh la-zim kar liya hai ke main Rasulullah (SAW) se sirf khufiya baat karne wale bhai ki tarah baat karunga."

e: I was told that Abu Bakr said: O Messenger of Allah, how could we be in a good state after this verse: “It will not be in accordance with your desires (Muslims), nor those of the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians), whosoever works evil, will have the recompense thereofʿ fan-Nisa' 4:123]? Will we be punished for every bad deed we do? There Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ʿMay Allah forgive you, O Abu Bakr, do you not fall sick? Do you not get exhausted? Do you not feel sad? Don't calamities befall you?ʿ He said: Of course. He said: ʿThat is the recompense you are given.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 68)
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), is ayat ke baad neki kaise mumkin hai: {Jo koi burai kare, usse uska badla diya jayega}" (Surah An-Nisa 123), to jo bhi burai humne ki, humein uska badla diya jayega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah tumhein maaf kare, Aye Abu Bakr," teen martaba yeh farmaya, "Aye Abu Bakr, kya tum bimaar nahi hote? Kya tumhein gham nahi hota? Kya tum thakte nahi? Kya tumhein museebaten nahi pahunchtin?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To yehi hai jiska badla tumhein duniya mein diya jaata hai."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Follow those who come after me: Abu Bakr and Umar, and seek guidance from the path of Ammar, and hold fast to the covenant of the son of the mother of Abdullah." Sahih.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Mere baad in dono ki pairavi karo, Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA), aur Ammar (RA) ki hidayat se hidayat lo, aur Ibn Umm Abd (Abdullah bin Mas'ood RA) ke ahd ko mazbooti se thaamo." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Follow the footsteps of those who come after me, Abu Bakr and Umar, and seek guidance from the teachings of Ammar, and hold tight to the covenant of Ibn Umm Abd."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad in dono ki pairavi karo, Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA), aur Ammar (RA) ki hidayat se hidayat lo, aur Ibn Umm Abd (RA) ke ahd ko mazbooti se thaamo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Follow those after me, Abu Bakr and Umar, and seek guidance from the teachings of Ammar. And when Ibn Umm Abd speaks to you, believe him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad in dono ki pairavi karo, Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA), aur Ammar (RA) ki hidayat se hidayat lo, aur jab Ibn Umm Abd tumse koi baat kahe, to uski tasdeeq karo."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Follow the footsteps of those who come after me; Abu Bakr and Umar."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad in dono ki pairavi karo, Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA), aur..."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Follow in the footsteps of those who came after me, namely Abu Bakr and Umar, and seek guidance from the teachings of Ammar. Hold onto the covenant of Ibn Umme Abd. This is a hadith for the sake of narrating the virtues of the two honorable companions, and this chain of narration has been established from Ath-Thawri and Mas'ar Yahya al-Himmani. It has also been established from Mas'ar and Wakie', as well as Hafs ibn Umar al-Ayli. Then, [this hadith] was summarized in its narration from Ibn Uyaynah al-Humaidi and others. This chain of narration was established from Ibn Uyaynah to Ishaq bin Isa bin At-Tabbaa'. Thus, the authenticity of this hadith has been confirmed even though they did not mention it specifically, and we have found a supporting witness for it through a reliable chain of narration from Abdullah ibn Mas'ood."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad in dono ki pairavi karo, Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA), aur Ammar (RA) ki hidayat se hidayat lo, aur Ibn Umm Abd ke ahd ko mazbooti se thaamo." Yeh hadith Shaykhain (Bukhari-Muslim) ke fazaail mein riwayat ki gayi behtareen hadithon mein se hai, aur is isnad ko Ath-Thawri aur Mis'ar se Yahya Al-Himmani ne qaayam kiya hai, aur isse Mis'ar aur Waki' aur Hafs bin Umar Al-Aili se bhi qaayam kiya, phir Ibn Uyainah Al-Humaidi aur doosron se unki riwayat mukhtasar rahi, aur is isnad ko Ibn Uyainah se Ishaq bin Isa bin At-Tabbaa' ne qaayam kiya, to jo humne zikr kiya usse is hadith ki sihat saabit ho gayi, agarche dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur humein iska aik gawaah bhi mila hai sahih isnad ke sath, Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) se.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Follow the path of those who come after me, Abu Bakr and Umar, and seek guidance from the teachings of Ammar, and hold fast to the covenant of Ibn Masood."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad in dono ki pairavi karo, Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA), aur Ammar (RA) ki hidayat se hidayat lo, aur Ibn Mas'ood (RA) ke ahd ko mazbooti se thaamo." Iski sanad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away, the preachers of the Ansar (the residents of Madinah) stood up. One of them said, "O migrants! Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to appoint a companion from among you along with a companion from amongst us, so we would see that in this matter, two men should be appointed, one from among you and the other from among us." The preachers of the Ansar continued to discuss this matter until Zaid bin Thabit stood up and said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was one of the migrants, and the Imam (leader) should also be from the migrants. As for us, we are his supporters, just as we were the supporters of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Abu Bakr then stood up and said, "May Allah reward you all, O people of Ansar, and may He make your words firm." Then he said, "If you had done otherwise, we would not have accepted your allegiance." Zaid bin Thabit then took Abu Bakr's hand and said, "This is your companion, so pledge your allegiance to him." They all pledged their allegiance to Abu Bakr and then left. When Abu Bakr sat on the pulpit, he looked at the faces of the people and did not see Ali. He asked about him, and some people from the Ansar brought Ali to him. Abu Bakr said, "O cousin of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , did you intend to cause a fitnah (discord) among the Muslims?" Ali replied, "There should not be any blame on you, O successor of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He then pledged his allegiance to him. Then Abu Bakr did not see Zubair ibn Al-Awam, so he asked about him until they brought him. Abu Bakr said, "O cousin of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his companion, did you also intend to cause a fitnah among the Muslims?" Zubair replied, "There should not be any blame on you, O successor of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He then pledged his allegiance to him.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to Ansar ke khutba dene wale khade huay, unme se aik aadmi kehne laga: "Aye Muhajireen ke logo, Rasulullah (SAW) jab tum mein se kisi aadmi ko kisi kaam par muqarrar karte the, to unke sath humme se bhi aik aadmi shaamil karte the, isliye hum samajhte hain ke is maamle ki zimmedaari do aadmi lein, aik tum mein se aur aik humme se." Unhone kaha: to Ansar ke khutba dene wale isi baat par aik ke baad aik khade hote rahe, phir Zaid bin Thabit (RA) khade huay aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) Muhajireen mein se the, aur imam bhi Muhajireen mein se hoga, aur hum uske ansaar (madadgaar) hain jaise hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke ansaar the." To Abu Bakr (RA) khade huay aur kaha: "Allah tumhein achha badla de, Aye Ansar ke logo, aur tumhare kehne wale ko mazbooti de." Phir farmaya: "Agar tum iske ilawa kuch aur karte, to hum tumse mel-milaap nahi karte." Phir Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ne Abu Bakr (RA) ka haath pakda aur kaha: "Yeh tumhara saathi hai, isse baiyat karo." Phir woh chal pade. Jab Abu Bakr (RA) mimbar par baithe, to unhone logon ke chehron ko dekha, unhein Ali (RA) nazar nahi aaye, to unhone unke baare mein poocha, to Ansar mein se kuch logon ne unhein le aane ki baat ki, to woh unhein lekar aaye. Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke chachere bhai aur unke damaad, kya tum Musalmano ki lakdi (ittehad) todna chahte the?" Unhone kaha: "Koi malaamat nahi, Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke khalifa." To unhone unse baiyat li. Phir unhein Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) nazar nahi aaye, to unhone unke baare mein poocha, yahan tak ke woh unhein le aaye. Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki phupi ke bete aur unke haawari (khaas saathi), kya tum Musalmano ki lakdi todna chahte the?" To unhone bhi wahi kaha jo Ali (RA) ne kaha tha: "Koi malaamat nahi, Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke khalifa." To dono ne unse baiyat li.

e: [AI] When the Prophet ﷺ  was taken on the Night Journey to Al-Aqsa Mosque, people started talking about it. Some people who used to believe in him and trust him turned away, while men from the polytheists went to Abu Bakr and asked him, "Does your companion claim that he was taken on a journey to Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa last night?" Abu Bakr asked them, "Did he say that?" They replied, "Yes." Abu Bakr then said, "If he indeed said that, then he has spoken the truth." They asked him, "Do you believe him when he claims that he went to Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa and came back before morning?" Abu Bakr answered, "Yes, I believe him in something even more miraculous than that. I believe him in the news of the heavens in the early morning or evening. That is why he is called Abu Bakr As-Siddiq."
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ko Masjid-e-Aqsa ki taraf isra (raat ka safar) karaaya gaya, to subah log iske baare mein baaten karne lage, unme se kuch log jo imaan laa chuke the aur unhone tasdeeq ki thi, murtad ho gaye, aur mushrikeen mein se kuch aadmi daudte huay Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Kya aap apne saathi ke baare mein sunenge jo daawa karte hain ke unhein raat ko Bait-ul-Maqdis tak safar karaaya gaya?" Unhone poocha: "Kya unhone yeh kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Agar unhone yeh kaha hai, to unhone sach kaha." Unhone poocha: "Kya aap unki tasdeeq karte hain ke woh raat ko Bait-ul-Maqdis gaye aur subah hone se pehle wapas aa gaye?" To unhone kaha: "Ji haan, main to unki tasdeeq usse bhi door ki baat mein karta hoon, main unki tasdeeq aasman ki khabar ki karta hoon, subah ya shaam mein." Isi wajah se unhein Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (sachai wale) ka naam diya gaya.

e: [AI] "It became a harm between them until they threw stones at each other, then the Prophet ﷺ  came to them and said, 'O Abu Bakr, if the prayer is established, go ahead and lead the people in prayer.' He replied, 'Yes.'"
hi: Ke unke darmiyan aik jhagda ho gaya yahan tak ke woh aik doosre par patthar phenkne lage, to Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye aur farmaya: "Aye Abu Bakr, agar namaz qaayam ki jaaye, to aap aage badhein aur logon ko namaz padhayen." Unhone kaha: "Ji haan."

e: [AI] The sons of Al-Mustaliq sent me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and they said, "Ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to whom should we give our charity after you?" So I went to him and asked him, and he said, "To Abu Bakr." So I went to them and informed them, and they said, "Go back to him and ask him, if Abu Bakr is not available, then to whom?" So I went to him and asked him, and he said, "To Umar." So I went to them and informed them, and they said, "Go back to him and ask him, if Umar is not available, then to whom?" So I went to him and asked him, and he said, "To Uthman." So I went to them and informed them, and they said, "Go back to him and ask him, if Uthman is not available, then to whom?" So I went to him and asked him, and he said, "If it happens with Uthman, then it will be a great loss for you indeed, throughout your lifetime."
hi: Banu Mustaliq ne mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas bheja, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) se poocho ke aapke baad hum apne sadqaat kise dein?" Unhone kaha: to main unke paas gaya aur poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Bakr (RA) ko." To main unke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya, unhone kaha: "Unke paas wapas jao aur poocho, agar Abu Bakr (RA) ko kuch ho jaaye, to kise?" To main unke paas gaya aur poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Umar (RA) ko." To main unke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya, unhone kaha: "Unke paas wapas jao aur poocho, agar Umar (RA) ko kuch ho jaaye, to kise?" To main unke paas gaya aur poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uthman (RA) ko." To main unke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya, unhone kaha: "Unke paas wapas jao aur poocho, agar Uthman (RA) ko kuch ho jaaye, to kise?" To main unke paas gaya aur poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar Uthman (RA) ko kuch ho jaaye, to tumpar hamesha ke liye tabaahi ho, tabaahi."

e: [AI] I witnessed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he said to Hassan bin Thabit, "Did you say anything about Abu Bakr?" He replied, "Yes." He said, "Say it so I can hear." He said, "I said, 'The second of two in the cave of Mawnaif, and the enemy surrounded them when they ascended the mountain. And the love of the Messenger of Allah for Abu Bakr, the creation of Allah, was known to them all, and no one equaled him in that.'" (Al-Bahr Al-Basit) [Al-Dhahabi omitted it from his summary due to its weakness.]
hi: Main maujood tha jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hassan bin Thabit (RA) se poocha: "Kya tumne Abu Bakr (RA) ke baare mein kuch kaha hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho, taake main sunoon." Unhone kaha, maine kaha (Al-Baseet bahr mein): "Aur do mein se doosre, buland ghaar mein, jabke dushman ne unhein ghera dala jab woh pahaad par chadhe, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke mehboob thay, makhlooq ko yeh maloom tha, kisi ne bhi unhein kisi doosre se badla nahi." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] What is the matter with this affair in the least of the Quraysh, in terms of fewness and degradation? Does it mean Abu Bakr? By Allah, if you wish, I will fill it with horses and men against him. Ali said, "You have always opposed Islam and its people, O Abu Sufyan, yet it did not harm you. We found Abu Bakr suitable for it in every way." Its chain of narration is authentic.
hi: "Yeh maamla Quraish ke sabse kam-tar aur sabse zaleel khaandaan mein kaise chala gaya?" - yani Abu Bakr (RA) ke baare mein - "Allah ki qasam, agar main chaahoon, to isse ghudsawaron aur paidal fauj se bhar dun." To Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Abu Sufyan, tumne bohot dinon tak Islam aur uske ahl se dushmani ki, magar isse kuch nuqsaan nahi hua, humne Abu Bakr (RA) ko is (zimmedaari) ke qaabil paaya." Iski sanad sahih hai.

e: [AI] "We were with the Prophet ﷺ  when the delegation of Banu Qays came to him. Some of them spoke in an eloquent manner. The Prophet ﷺ  turned to Abu Bakr and said, "O Abu Bakr, did you hear what they said?" He replied, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah, I heard and understood it." He said, "Then respond to them." Abu Bakr responded with an excellent answer, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Abu Bakr, Allah has granted you the greatest contentment." Some people asked, "And what is the greatest contentment, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Allah will manifest Himself to His servants in the Hereafter in general, and He will manifest Himself to Abu Bakr in particular.""
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas the ke Abdul Qais ka wafd unke paas aaya, unme se kisi ne aisi baat ki jo fuzool (behooda) thi, to Nabi (SAW) Abu Bakr (RA) ki taraf mudkar poocha: "Aye Abu Bakr, kya tumne suna unhone kya kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aur maine ise samjha bhi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unhein jawaab do." Unhone kaha: to Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein jawaab diya aur behtareen jawaab diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Bakr, Allah ne tumhein sabse buland raza (khushnoodi) di hai." To logon mein se kisi ne poocha: "Sabse buland raza kya hai, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Aakhirat mein apne bandon par aam taur par jalwaagar hoga, aur Abu Bakr (RA) par khaas taur par jalwaagar hoga."

e: [AI] "If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had appointed a successor, he would have chosen Abu Bakr and Umar."
hi: "Agar Rasulullah (SAW) kisi ko khalifa muqarrar karne wale hote, to woh Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ko khalifa muqarrar karte."

e: [AI] "What Muslims see as good, it is considered good in the eyes of Allah. And what Muslims see as bad, it is considered bad in the eyes of Allah. The companions unanimously agreed to appoint Abu Bakr as the successor."
hi: "Jo Musalman achha samjhein, woh Allah ke nazdeek bhi achha hai, aur jo Musalman bura samjhein, woh Allah ke nazdeek bhi bura hai, aur tamaam sahaba ne yehi munaasib samjha ke woh Abu Bakr (RA) ko khalifa muqarrar karein."

e: [AI] When the Prophet ﷺ passed away, the Muhajirun and the Ansar gathered at the courtyard of Banu Sa'idah to pledge allegiance to Abu Bakr. I went to Umm Salamah and told her, "The people have pledged allegiance to Abu Bakr." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing it.
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to Muhajireen aur Ansar Saqifah Banu Sa'idah mein Abu Bakr (RA) ki baiyat ke liye jama huay, to main Umm Salamah (RA) ke paas gayi aur unse kaha: "Logon ne Abu Bakr (RA) se baiyat kar li." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "What the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not appoint, I will appoint, but if Allah wants good for the people, He will gather them after me on what is best for them, just as He gathered them after their Prophet on what is best for them."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne kisi ko khalifa muqarrar nahi kiya, isliye main bhi kisi ko khalifa muqarrar nahi karunga, lekin agar Allah logon ke liye bhalaai chahega, to woh mere baad unhein unke behtareen shakhs par jama karega, jaise usne unhein unke Nabi (SAW) ke baad unke behtareen shakhs par jama kiya."

e: [AI] "And for us, Abu Bakr was the best successor of Allah, and he was the most merciful to us and the most compassionate towards us."
hi: "Humpar Abu Bakr (RA) waali (hukmaraan) banaaye gaye, aur woh Allah ke behtareen khalifa the, aur humpar sabse zyada rehm karne wale aur humpar sabse zyada shafqat karne wale the."

e: [AI] We entered a room where Abu Bakr was, when he was afflicted with the pain that he passed away in. He looked at us and said, "Are you not pleased with what I am doing?" We replied, "Yes, O successor of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Hum aik kamre mein gaye jismein Abu Bakr (RA) the, jab unhein woh dard hua jismein unka intiqaal hua, to unhone hum par jhaank kar dekha aur poocha: "Kya tum log usse raazi nahi jo main kar raha hoon?" Humne kaha: "Kyun nahi, Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke khalifa."

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, when he sent the troops towards Ash-Sham (Syria), Yazid ibn Abi Sufyan, Amr ibn al-Aas, and Shurahbil ibn Hasanah walked with them until they reached Thaniyyat al-Wada'. They said, 'O successor of the Messenger of Allah, you are walking while we are riding!'"
hi: Ke Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne jab Sham (Syria) ki taraf lashkar bheje, Yazid bin Abi Sufyan (RA), Amr bin Al-Aas (RA), aur Shurahbil bin Hasanah (RA), to woh unke sath paidal chale yahan tak ke woh Saniyyat-ul-Wida par pahunche, to unhone kaha: "Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke khalifa, aap paidal chal rahe hain aur hum sawaar hain!"

e: [AI] "I entered upon Abu Bakr during his caliphate."
hi: "Main Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas unki khilafat mein gaya."

e: [AI] "The wealth of Bahrain came to us during the caliphate of Abu Bakr."
hi: "Bahrain ka maal Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat mein humare paas aaya."

e: [AI] Uyaina bin Hisn and Al-Aqr bin Habib came to Abu Bakr and said, "O successor of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in the summarization.
hi: Uyainah bin Hisn aur Al-Aqra' bin Habis Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke khalifa." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and fought during the caliphate of Abu Bakr." This hadith was excluded by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness in summarization.
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat mein jihad kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] We were with Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq when he began to cry. So, we said, "O successor of the Messenger of Allah, why this crying?" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Hum Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ke sath the, to woh rone lage, humne poocha: "Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke khalifa, yeh rona kyun?" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "All the companions of the Prophet ﷺ agreed and appointed Abu Bakr as his successor, as mentioned by Al-Dhahabi in his summary of his weakness."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba sab jama huay aur unhone Abu Bakr (RA) ko khalifa muqarrar kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Mus'ab ibn Abdullah al-Zubayri narrated to me, he said: "Umar ibn Al-Khattab ibn Nufail ibn Abdul-Uzza ibn Riayah ibn Abdullah ibn Qurt ibn Razzah ibn Adi ibn Ka'b ibn Lu'ayy ibn Ghalib ibn Fhir, they all said: His mother was Hantamah bint Hashim ibn Al-Mughirah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Makhzum. And her mother was Ash-Shifa bint Abdul Qais ibn Adi ibn Saad ibn Taym, she was known as Abu Hafs." He was appointed as the successor on the day Abu Bakr died, which was on a Tuesday, eight days remained in the month of Jumada Al-Akhirah.
hi: Mujhse Mus'ab bin Abdullah Az-Zubairi ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: "Umar bin Al-Khattab bin Nufail bin Abdul-Uzza bin Riyah bin Abdullah bin Qurt bin Razaah bin Adi bin Ka'b bin Lu'ayy bin Ghalib bin Fihr," aur unki maa Hantamah bint Hashim bin Al-Mughirah bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Makhzoom thin, aur unki (Hantamah ki) maa Ash-Shifa bint Abd Qais bin Adi bin Sa'd bin Taim thin. Unki kunniyat Abu Hafs thi. Woh us din khalifa muqarrar huay jis din Abu Bakr (RA) ka intiqaal hua, aur woh Mangalvaar ka din tha, Jumada-al-Aakhirah ke aath (8) din baaqi rehte.

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr passed away, and Umar was appointed as the leader after two years, three months, and twenty-two days from the passing of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him."
hi: "Abu Bakr (RA) ka intiqaal hua aur Umar (RA) khalifa muqarrar huay, Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ke do (2) saal, teen (3) mahine, aur baais (22) din baad." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "As if he is on a camel under a cold drizzle, saying, 'O servants of Allah, migrate and do not abandon (your homes), and let anyone among you fear (lit. guard against) the rabbit, as it may scare it away with pebbles or throw stones at it, so that it eats it, but swords and spears are to remind you of chastity and nobility.'"
hi: Goya woh aik jaanwar par, Qatari chaadar odhe huay, keh rahe the: "Aye Allah ke bando, hijrat karo aur (deen se) hijrat mat karo (yani chhodo mat), aur tum mein se koi khargosh ka khayal rakhe, agar woh usse kankariyon se maare ya patthar phenke aur phir usse khaaye, balke tumhare liye neze aur teer hi zibah ka kaam den (yani halaal tareeqe se zibah karein)."

e: [AI] Omar ibn Abdul Aziz asked Abu Bakr ibn Sulaiman ibn Abi Hathma about what was written during the time of the caliphate of the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him. Abu Bakr ibn Sulaiman replied that Omar ibn Khattab wrote first during the caliphate of Abu Bakr. Omar then asked who was the first person to write among the Amir al-Mu'minin (commander of the faithful)? Abu Bakr ibn Sulaiman said, "Ash-Shifa' informed me that Omar ibn Al-Khattab wrote a letter to the governor of Iraq instructing him to send two men to ask about Iraq and its people. The governor of Iraq sent Labid ibn Rabiah and Adi ibn Hatim. when they arrived in Madinah, they parked their camels in the mosque courtyard and entered the mosque. There they saw Amr ibn Al-Aas and said to him, 'Seek permission for us from Amr al-Mu'minin.' Amr al-Mu'minin replied, 'By Allah, you have hit the mark. His name is the Amir and we are the believers.' Amr al-Mu'minin then stood up, entered and said the salaam to Omar ibn Al-Khattab, 'Peace be upon you, O Amir al-Mu'minin.' Omar said, 'What do you think of this name, O son of Al-Aas? My Lord knows. You need to take back what you just said.' They replied, 'Indeed, Labid ibn Rabiah and Adi ibn Hatim have arrived. They parked their camels in the mosque courtyard and have come to speak with you.' So, the book began from that moment on." Ash-Shifa' is the paternal aunt of Abu Bakr ibn Sulaiman.
hi: Ke Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne Abu Bakr bin Sulaiman bin Abi Hathmah se poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke khalifa ki taraf se Abu Bakr (RA) ke ahd mein kya likha jaata tha, phir Umar (RA) ne Abu Bakr (RA) ke khalifa ki taraf se likhna shuru kiya, to sabse pehle 'Ameer-ul-Momineen' (Momino ke Ameer) kisne likha?" Unhone kaha: mujhe Ash-Shifa (RA) ne hadith bayan ki, aur woh pehli Muhajir auraton mein se thin, ke Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne Iraq ke aamil (waali) ko likha ke woh unhein do mazboot aadmi bheje jinse woh Iraq aur uske ahl ke baare mein poochein, to Iraq ke aamil ne Labid bin Rabi'ah (RA) aur Adi bin Haatim (RA) ko bheja, jab woh dono Madinah pahunche, to unhone apni sawaariyaan masjid ke sehan mein bithaayin, phir masjid mein dakhil huay, achaanak unhein Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) mile, unhone kaha: "Aye Amr, humare liye Ameer-ul-Momineen se ijaazat lo." To Amr (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tum dono ne uska naam sahi rakh diya, woh Ameer hain aur hum Momin hain." To Amr (RA) khade huay aur Umar (RA), Ameer-ul-Momineen, ke paas dakhil huay aur kaha: "Assalamu Alaikum, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen." Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Yeh naam tumhein kahan se sujha, Aye Ibn Al-Aas? Mera Rab jaanta hai, tumhein yeh baat wapas leni hogi." Unhone kaha: "Labid bin Rabi'ah aur Adi bin Haatim aaye, unhone apni sawaariyaan masjid ke sehan mein bithaayin, phir mere paas dakhil huay aur mujhse kaha: 'Humare liye Ameer-ul-Momineen se ijaazat lo, Aye Amr,' to unhone Allah ki qasam, tumhara naam sahi rakh diya, hum Momin hain aur tum humare Ameer ho." Unhone kaha: to isi din se yeh likhawat chal padi. Aur Ash-Shifa (RA) Abu Bakr bin Sulaiman ki dadi thin. Sahih.

e: [AI] When Umar arrived in Sham, he encountered a woman in labor. Umar dismounted his camel, took off his sandals or shoes, and took hold of the reins of his mount. He then attended to the woman in labor. Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah said to Umar, "You have done a great act, O Amir al-Mu'minin (Commander of the Faithful). You took off your footwear and offered your mount, and attended to the woman in labor." Umar then struck Abu Ubaidah on the chest with his hand and said, "Oh, if anyone other than you were to say this, O Abu Ubaidah, you were the least among people, and Allah honored you through Islam. So, whatever honor you seek from anyone other than Allah, He will humiliate you." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Jab Umar (RA) Sham (Syria) pahunche, to unke saamne aik nadi ka ghaat (mukhadah) aaya, to Umar (RA) apne oont se utre aur apne moze (khuff) ya kaha maujay utaare, phir apni sawaari ki lagaam pakdi aur ghaat mein utar gaye. To Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (RA) ne unse kaha: "Aap ne yeh aisa kaam kiya hai, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, jo zameen walon ke nazdeek aik bada (ajeeb) kaam hai - aapne apne moze utaare, apni sawaari ko aage kiya, aur ghaat mein utar gaye." Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) ne apna haath Abu Ubaidah (RA) ke seene par maara aur farmaya: "Haaye, kaash koi aur yeh baat kehta, Aye Abu Ubaidah, tum log logon mein sabse kam-tar the, to Allah ne tumhein Islam se izzat di, isliye jab bhi tum izzat kisi doosri cheez mein talaash karoge, Allah Ta'ala tumhein zaleel kar dega." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I accompanied Umar to Sham (Syria) and we stayed in a place. Then a sharecropper came and guided us to Amir al-Mu'minin (Umar) until he approached him. When the sharecropper saw Umar, he prostrated and Umar said, "What is this prostration?" The sharecropper replied, "This is how we treat kings." Umar said, "Prostrate to your Lord who created you." The sharecropper then said, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, I have prepared food for you, so come to me." Umar asked, "Do you have any idols or pictures of non-Arabs in your house?" The sharecropper said, "Yes." Umar said, "We have no need for anything in your house, but go and send us a loaf of bread without adding anything to it." He went and sent the bread. Umar ate from it and then said to his servant, "Do you have any of that wine (nabidh)?" The servant said, "Yes." Umar said, "Send it to us." He brought it and poured it into a container, then smelled it and found it to have a foul smell. He poured water onto it and smelled it again but found it to have a foul smell. He repeated this process three times, then drank it. After drinking, Umar said, "If there is anything harmful in your drink, do this with it (referring to pouring water onto it)." Muslim al-A'war left it.
hi: Main Umar (RA) ke sath Sham (Syria) ki jung mein gaya, hum aik jagah utre, to aik dihqan (mahalli zameendaar) aaya jo Ameer-ul-Momineen ka pata poochta hua unke paas pahuncha. Jab dihqan ne Umar (RA) ko dekha, to woh sajda mein gir gaya, Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Yeh sajda kya hai?" Usne kaha: "Hum baadshahon ke sath aisa hi karte hain." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Apne Rab ko sajda karo jisne tumhein paida kiya." Usne kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, maine aapke liye khaana taiyaar kiya hai, mere paas aayen." Unhone kaha: to Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Kya tumhare ghar mein Ajam (ghair-Arab) ki tasveeren hain?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Humein tumhare ghar ki koi zaroorat nahi, lekin jao aur humare liye aik hi rang ka khaana bhej do, usme zyada kuch mat milaana." Unhone kaha: to woh gaya aur unhein khaana bheja, unhone usme se khaaya, phir Umar (RA) ne apne ghulam se poocha: "Kya tumhare mashke mein us nabeez (khajoor ya angoor ka sharbat) mein se kuch hai?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "To humare liye bhejo." Woh laaya aur usse aik bartan mein daala, phir usse soonga, usme buri boo paayi, to usme paani daala, phir soonga, phir usme buri boo paayi, to usme teen martaba paani daala, phir usse piya, phir farmaya: "Jab tumhare peene ki cheez mein tumhein koi shubha ho, to isi tarah karo." Muslim Al-A'war ko chhod diya gaya hai (kamzor).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "O Allah, support the religion through 'Umar ibn al-Khattab." This is authentic.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, deen ko Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke zariye taqwiyat de." Sahih.

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ , that he said: 'O Allah, honor Islam by 'Umar.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, Islam ko Umar (RA) ke zariye izzat de."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'O Allah! Strengthen Islam with 'Umar bin Khattab in particular.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 105)
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, Islam ko khaas taur par Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke zariye izzat de."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Allah, honor Islam with Umar ibn Al-Khattab or with Abu Jahl ibn Hisham." So Allah answered the supplication of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for Umar, and he built upon him the kingdom of Islam and destroyed the idols with it. (This part is missing in the original question, it seems to be a note from the questioner about Al-Dhahabi's silence on the summary).
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, Islam ko Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke zariye ya Abu Jahl bin Hisham ke zariye izzat de." To Allah ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki dua Umar (RA) ke liye qubool ki, to unke zariye Islam ki hukumat qaayam hui aur unke zariye buton ko dhaaya gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "To pray at the Kaaba openly until Umar converts."
hi: "...ke hum Ka'bah ke paas khule taur par namaz padhein, yahan tak ke Umar (RA) Musalman ho gaye."

e: [AI] "Islam during the time of Umar was like a man who continually approaches, seeking closeness. But when Umar was assassinated, it became like a man who only moves further away, seeking distance."
hi: "Umar (RA) ke zamane mein Islam aise tha jaise aik aage badhne wala aadmi jo sirf qareeb hi hota jaaye, jab Umar (RA) shaheed kiye gaye, to woh aise ho gaya jaise aik peeche hatne wala aadmi jo sirf door hi hota jaaye."

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "The first person to be embraced by the truth on the Day of Resurrection is Umar. And the first person to shake hands with the truth on the Day of Resurrection is Umar. And the first person to be taken by the hand and led to Paradise is Umar ibn Al-Khattab."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Qayamat ke din sabse pehle jise haq gale lagaayega woh Umar (RA) hain, aur sabse pehle jisse haq musafah (haath milaana) karega woh Umar (RA) hain, aur sabse pehle jiska haath pakadkar Jannat ki taraf le jaaya jayega woh Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) hain." Fabricated.

e: We have been powerful since ʿUmar embraced Islam. (Using translation from Bukhārī 3863)
hi: "Hum hamesha izzat-daar rahe jab se Umar (RA) Musalman huay."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When Umar embraced Islam, Jibril came to me and said, 'The people of heaven are delighted by the Islam of Umar.' Abdullah bin Khurash narrated this hadith as weak in his book, Ad-Daraqutni."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Umar (RA) Musalman huay, to Jibra'il (AS) mere paas aaye aur kaha: 'Aasman walon ne Umar (RA) ke Musalman honay par khushi manaayi hai.'" Sahih. Abdullah bin Khiraash ko Ad-Daraqutni ne kamzor kaha hai.

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  struck the chest of Umar ibn Al-Khattab with his hand three times when he accepted Islam, while saying, "O Allah, remove the hostility from his heart and replace it with faith." He said that three times.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke seene par apne haath se teen martaba maara jab woh Musalman huay, aur farmaate the: "Aye Allah, unke seene mein jo kina (dushmani) hai use nikaal de aur usse imaan se badal de," yeh teen martaba kaha.

e: [AI] Umar fought the polytheists in Masjid al-Makkah and he continued to fight them from dawn until the sun was directly above his head. He then said, "I have become blind." He sat down, and a man wearing a red cloak and a Qumissiyya shirt with a handsome face came to him and uncovered his eyes. He asked them, "What do you want from this man?" They said, "No, by Allah, except that he has been affected." He said, "What an excellent man he is, who has chosen a religion for himself. Leave him, for what he has chosen for himself. Do you think the Banu 'Adi tribe would be pleased if Umar was killed? No, by Allah, the Banu 'Adi tribe would not be pleased." Umar said that day, "O enemies of Allah, by Allah, if we had found three hundred, we would have driven you out from here." I asked my father afterwards, "Who was that man who defended you that day?" He said, "That was Al-Aas ibn Wa'il, the father of Amr ibn Al-Aas."
hi: Umar (RA) ne Makkah ki masjid mein mushrikeen se jung ki, woh subah se lekar suraj sar ke oopar aane tak unse jung karte rahe. Unhone kaha: "Woh thak gaye aur baith gaye," to aik aadmi unke paas dakhil hua jispar surkh chaadar aur qumsi qamees thi, khoobsurat chehre wala, woh aaya yahan tak ke unhein bikhera diya, aur poocha: "Tum is aadmi se kya chahte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, kuch nahi, siwaye is ke ke yeh (apne deen se) hat gaya hai." Usne kaha: "To kitna achha aadmi hai jisne apne liye aik deen chuna, isse chhod do aur jo usne apne liye chuna hai (usse rehne do), kya tumhein lagta hai Banu Adi raazi ho jaayenge ke Umar (RA) qatl kar diya jaaye? Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Banu Adi kabhi raazi nahi honge." Unhone kaha: aur Umar (RA) ne us din kaha: "Aye Allah ke dushmano, Allah ki qasam, agar hum teen sau (300) tak pahunch jaayen, to hum tumhein isse nikaal denge." Maine baad mein apne waalid se poocha: "Woh aadmi kaun tha jisne us din unhein aapse hataaya?" Unhone kaha: "Woh Al-Aas bin Waa'il the, Amr bin Al-Aas ke waalid."

e: [AI] The idolaters today said, "The majority of our people have abandoned us," with a sound chain of narration, yet they did not exclude it.
hi: Aaj mushrikeen (ne kaha): "Qaum ne humse barabari le li." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "If there were to be a prophet after me, it would have been Umar ibn Al-Khattab."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Agar mere baad koi Nabi hota, to woh Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) hote."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Indeed, I saw in a dream that I was given a cup filled with milk, and I drank from it until I was satisfied and filled. Then I saw it in my veins, between the skin and the flesh, and it was favoring a superior favor. So I gave it to Umar ibn Al-Khattab." They said, "O Prophet of Allah, this is knowledge that Allah has given you, and you have filled from it and there was a superior favor, and you gave it to Umar ibn Al-Khattab." He said, "You are right."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine khwaab mein dekha ke mujhe doodh se bhara aik bada pyaala diya gaya, maine usse itna piya ke main seer ho gaya, yahan tak ke maine ise apni khaal aur gosht ke darmiyan aik rag mein dekha, phir usme se kuch bach gaya, to maine woh Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko de diya." Unhone kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, yeh woh ilm hai jo Allah ne aapko diya, aap usse seer huay aur kuch bach gaya, aapne woh Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko de diya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne sach kaha."

e: [AI] "If the knowledge of Umar was placed in one scale of a balance and the knowledge of all people in another scale, the knowledge of Umar would outweigh the knowledge of all people."
hi: "Agar Umar (RA) ka ilm taraazu ke aik pallay mein rakha jaaye, aur logon ka ilm doosre pallay mein rakha jaaye, to Umar (RA) ka ilm bhaari hoga."

e: [AI] "Regarding him, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing"
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Among the nations, there used to be Muhaddathun (those who were given understanding), and if there were one in my nation, it would be 'Umar bin Al-Khattab." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3693)
hi: Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, se, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Pehli Ummaton mein Muhaddathoon (ilhaam-yaafta log) hote the, agar meri Ummat mein koi hai, to woh Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered a light speech. When he finished his sermon, he said, "O Abu Bakr, stand up and deliver a sermon." So Abu Bakr stood up and delivered a sermon, but it was shorter than the Prophet's ﷺ . When Abu Bakr finished his sermon, he said, "O Umar, stand up and deliver a sermon." So Umar stood up and delivered a sermon, but it was shorter than the Prophet's ﷺ  and shorter than Abu Bakr's.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik chhota khutba diya, jab woh khutba se faarigh huay, to farmaya: "Aye Abu Bakr, khade ho kar khutba do." To Abu Bakr (RA) khade huay aur khutba diya, aur Nabi (SAW) se bhi mukhtasar tha. Jab Abu Bakr (RA) apne khutba se faarigh huay, to farmaya: "Aye Umar, khade ho kar khutba do." To Umar (RA) khade huay aur khutba diya, aur Nabi (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) dono se bhi mukhtasar tha.

e: [AI] "O Abu Dharr, I seek forgiveness for you while you are the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." Abu Dharr said, "Seek forgiveness for me or inform me [of what you mean]." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, you passed by Umar and he said, 'What a brave man!' and indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Verily, Allah has put the truth on the tongue and in the heart of Umar.'"
hi: "Aye Abu Dharr, main aapke liye maghfirat maangta hoon jabke aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain?" Unhone kaha: "Mere liye maghfirat maango." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, jab tak aap mujhe bataayen (kya baat hai)." Unhone kaha: "Aap Umar (RA) ke paas se guzre, to unhone kaha 'kitna achha jawaan hai,' aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Beshak Allah ne haq ko Umar (RA) ki zubaan aur unke dil par rakh diya hai.'"

e: [AI] Get up and pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Two men stood up, but Abu Jahl refused to stand. Umar said to him, "Pray, O Abu Jahl, with the Prophet ﷺ ." He said, "I will not stand until a man comes who is stronger than me in physical strength and more powerful than me in wrestling, so that he can overpower me and put my face in the dirt." Umar said, "So I stood up and I was stronger than him in physical strength and more powerful than him in wrestling, so I overpowered him and put his face in the dirt." Uthman came and detained me, then Umar ibn al-Khattab left angrily until he reached the Prophet ﷺ . When the Prophet ﷺ  saw him and saw the anger on his face, he said, "What's wrong with you, O Abu Hafs?" He said, "O Messenger of Allah, I came to a group sitting at the door of the mosque and the prayer had already been established. Among them was Abu Jahl al-Laithi. The two men stood up and repeated the conversation, then Umar said, 'By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, Uthman did not help him except by letting him spend the night with his wife, so he wants to thank him for it.' Uthman heard him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, don't you hear what Umar is saying in front of you?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, the mercy of Allah is with Umar. If you had brought me the head of the wicked one, I would have preferred that.'" Umar stood up, then the Prophet ﷺ  called him when he was far away and said, "Come, O Umar, where did you intend to go?" He said, "I intended to bring you the head of the wicked one." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Sit down until I inform you about the sufficiency of the Lord from the prayer of Abu Jahl al-Laithi. Indeed, Allah has angels in the sky of this world who are in constant humility, not lifting their heads until the Hour is established. When the Hour is established, they lift their heads and say, 'Our Lord, we have not worshiped You as You deserve to be worshiped.' 'Umar bin Al-Khattab asked, "What do they say, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "As for the inhabitants of the lower heaven, they say, 'Glory be to the King, the Sovereign,' and as for the inhabitants of the second heaven, they say, 'Glory be to the Ever-Living, who never dies.' Say it, O Umar, in your prayer." 'Umar said, "O Messenger of Allah, what about the one you taught me and commanded me to say in my prayer?" He said, "Say it once and say it at another time." The one he commanded me to say was, "I seek refuge in Your forgiveness from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your wrath, and I seek refuge in You from You, the majesty of Your face."
hi: "Utho aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath namaz padho." To do log khade huay aur Abu Jahsh ne khade honay se inkaar kiya, to Umar (RA) ne unse kaha: "Namaz padho, Aye Abu Jahsh, Nabi (SAW) ke sath." Unhone kaha: "Main tab tak nahi uthunga jab tak koi aadmi mere paas na aaye jo mujhse zyada mazboot bazu wala aur mujhse zyada taaqatwar ho, jo mujhe pachaad de, phir mera chehra mitti mein rage." Umar (RA) ne kaha: to main unke paas gaya, aur main unse zyada mazboot bazu wala aur unse zyada taaqatwar tha, to maine unhein pachaad diya, phir unka chehra mitti mein raga. Phir Uthman (RA) mere paas aaye aur mujhe rok diya (jhagde se), to Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ghusse mein nikle yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) tak pahunche. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne unhein dekha aur unke chehre par ghussa dekha, to poocha: "Aye Abu Hafs, tumhein kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main kuch logon ke paas se guzra jo masjid ke darwaze par baithe the, namaz qaayam ho chuki thi, aur unme Abu Jahsh Al-Laithi bhi tha," phir dono aadmi khade huay aur poori baat dohraayi, phir Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Uthman (RA) ne uski madad sirf isliye ki kyunke usne aik raat unki mehmaan-nawaazi ki thi, isliye woh iska shukriya ada karna chahte the." To Uthman (RA) ne yeh sun liya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap sun nahi rahe Umar (RA) hamare baare mein aapke saamne kya keh rahe hain?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Umar (RA) Allah ki rehmat se raazi ho gaye, main to chahta ke tum mere paas us khabees (bure aadmi) ka sar lekar aate." To Umar (RA) khade huay, jab woh door chale gaye to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein pukaara aur farmaya: "Aao, Aye Umar, kahan jaana chahte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Main chahta tha ke aapke paas us khabees ka sar lekar aaun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Baith jao, taake main tumhein Rab ki Abu Jahsh Al-Laithi ki namaz se be-niyaazi ke baare mein bataaun, beshak Allah ke duniya ke aasman mein aise farishte hain jo aajiz-o-inkisaar mein hain, apne sar nahi uthaate yahan tak ke Qayamat qaayam ho jaaye, jab Qayamat qaayam hogi, to woh apne sar uthaayenge aur kahenge: 'Aye humare Rab, humne teri ibaadat ka haq ada nahi kiya.'" Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne poocha: "Aur woh kya kehte hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Duniya ke pehle aasman walon ke baare mein to woh kehte hain: 'Paak hai woh Zaat jo Baadshaahat aur Malakoot ka Maalik hai,' aur doosre aasman walon ke baare mein to woh kehte hain: 'Paak hai woh Zinda Zaat jo kabhi nahi marta,' isliye ise apni namaz mein kaho, Aye Umar." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to us dua ka kya jise aapne mujhe sikhaaya aur mujhe hukum diya ke main ise apni namaz mein kahoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh aik martaba kaho aur woh aik martaba," aur jiska unhein hukum diya gaya tha woh yeh tha: "Main teri panaah mein aata hoon teri maafi ke sath teri sazaa se, aur teri raza ke sath tere ghusse se, aur teri hi panaah maangta hoon tujhse, Tera chehra buzurg hai."

e: [AI] He (Umar) said: "It is possible that you have made a mistake in assuming, or you are still following your previous religion of the Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic era). I remember that you used to be their soothsayer." He replied: "I have not seen anything like what happened today, where a Muslim man is being welcomed with such honor." Umar said: "I swear that I will not ask you again if you were their soothsayer in the Jahiliyyah." He said: "So what is so astonishing about what has brought you here?" Then he narrated a lengthy Hadith without any reference. The Hadith is recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari by this chain of narrators.
hi: "...unke liye: main galat samajh raha hoon ya aap jahiliyat ke apne (purane) deen par hain, aur aap to unke kaahin (ghaib-goo) the." Unhone kaha: "Maine aaj jaisa din kabhi nahi dekha jismein aik Musalman aadmi ka aisa istaqbaal kiya jaaye." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "To main aapse zid karta hoon ke aap mujhe bataayen." Unhone kaha: "Kya main jahiliyat mein unka kaahin tha?" Unhone kaha: "To sabse ajeeb baat kya thi jo aapke paas aayi?" Phir aik lambi hadith zikr ki jiski koi sanad nahi. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari mein isi isnad ke sath poori tafseel se mojood hai.

e: [AI] "Indeed, there is a plague in it. So it was said to him, 'O Amir al-Mu'minin, it is not appropriate for you to attack it, as if it were to occur while you are there, you should not leave it.' So he turned back, heading towards the city. While we were traveling at night, he said to me, 'Turn away from the road.' So I turned away and he dismounted from his camel and put his head on its arm and slept, while I could not sleep. Then he said to me, 'What is it with me and them? They turned me away from Sham (Syria).' Then he mounted and I did not ask him anything until I thought I was mixing with the people. I said to him, 'Why did you say what you said when you woke up?' He said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'There will be sent forth from between Hims and the Olive trees seventy thousand, without any accountability upon them.' If Allah brings me back from this journey, I will surely bear my family, my people, and my wealth until he lowers Hims.' That is when Ridaan (a companion) was killed."
hi: Ke wahan taa'oon (mahamari) thi, to unse kaha gaya: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aapko isspar hamla-aawar (dakhil) nahi hona chahiye, jaise agar yeh (mahamari) waqai ho aur aap wahan hon, to aapke liye wahan se nikalna munaasib nahi hoga." To woh Madinah ki taraf wapas mudh gaye. Unhone kaha: hum raat ko safar kar rahe the ke unhone mujhse kaha: "Raaste se hat jao," to woh hat gaye aur main hat gaya, unhone apni sawaari se utarkar apna sar apne oont ke baazoo par rakha aur so gaye, aur main so na saka, phir woh uthe aur mujhse kehne lage: "Mujhe unse (aage jaane se) kya (rok raha hai), mujhe Sham (Syria) se wapas bhej do." Phir woh sawaar huay, maine unse kuch nahi poocha yahan tak ke jab mujhe laga ke hum logon mein mil rahe hain, maine unse poocha: "Aapne apni neend se jaagte hi jo kaha, woh kyun kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Hims ki deewaar aur zaitoon ke darmiyan surkh mitti mein sattar hazaar (70,000) uthaaye jaayenge, jinpar koi hisaab nahi hoga,' agar Allah mujhe is safar se wapas kar de, to main apne bal-bacchon, apne ghar walon, aur apne maal ko lekar Hims mein basoonga." To woh apne is safar se wapas laut aaye, aur unhein shaheed kar diya gaya, Allah ki raza (khushnoodi) unpar ho. Repudiated.

e: [AI] "That the Muslims should establish a place for migration (Hijrah) and a residence for jihad." So Saad sent a man from the Ansar called Al-Harith bin Salama to scout a location in Al-Kufa that day. Saad went there with the people and drew the outline of our mosque and marked it with lines. Al-Sha'bi said, "In Al-Kufa, the tribes of Al-Khuzami, Ash-Shihi, Al-Uqhuwan, and Shaqa'iq Al-Nu'man resided. The Arabs used to call it 'Khadd Al-'Adhra' in the pre-Islamic era." So they returned and wrote to Umar ibn Al-Khattab, who responded, "Leave it." As a result, people moved to Al-Kufa. Al-Haytham bin Adi fell (died).
hi: "Musalmano ke liye hijrat ka ghar aur jihad ka thikaana banaao." To Sa'd (RA) ne Ansar mein se aik aadmi ko bheja jise Al-Harith bin Salamah (RA) kaha jaata tha, usne unke liye aaj ki Kufa ki jagah talaash ki, to Sa'd (RA) ne logon ke sath wahan padaav dala, humari masjid ki lakeer khainchi aur usme takseemein banaayin. Ash-Sha'bi ne kaha: "Aur Kufa mein khuzaami, sheeh, uqhuwaan, aur shaqaaiq-un-nu'man (jangli phool aur boute) ugte the, to Arab jahiliyat mein isse 'Khadd Al-Adhra' (kanwaari ka gaal) kehte the." To unhone yahan padaav dala aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko likha, to unhone likha: "Isse chhod do," to log Kufa ki taraf mudh gaye. Al-Haitham bin Adi kamzor (saqit) hain.

e: [AI] "Al-Kufa is the dome of Islam and the land of trials." Al-Dhahabi did not speak further about it in the summary.
hi: "Kufa Islam ka gumbad hai aur aazmaaish ki zameen hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] His mistress proposed to dye his beard, so he said, "I can only see you extinguishing my light, just as so-and-so extinguishes his light." Al-Dhahabi remained silent in summarizing this.
hi: Ke unki laundi (ghulam aurat) ne unki daadhi rangne ki peshkash ki, to unhone kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai tum sirf mera noor bujhaana chahti ho jaise fulan apna noor bujha chuka hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: that 'Umar said to Abu Bakr: "O best of people after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ!" So Abu Bakr said: "If you say that, then I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'The sun has not risen upon a man better than 'Umar.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3684)
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne aik din Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) se kaha: "Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad logon mein sabse behtareen shakhs." To Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Agar tum yeh kehte ho, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Suraj kabhi Umar (RA) se behtar kisi aadmi par nahi nikla.'" Fabricated.

e: [AI] Abdullah, indeed, the most intelligent of people are three: Al-Azeez when he observed Yusuf and said to his wife, "Honor his accommodation." And the woman who saw Musa, peace be upon him, said to her father, "Oh my father, hire him." And Abu Bakr when he appointed Umar as his successor.
hi: Abdullah (RA): "Sabse zyada faraasat (hikmat) rakhne wale teen log hain - Al-Azeez, jab unhone Yusuf (AS) ke baare mein faraasat ki aur apni biwi se kaha: 'Inhein izzat se rakho,' aur woh aurat jisne Musa (AS) ko dekha aur apne waalid se kaha: 'Aye mere abba, inhein naukri par rakh lein,' aur Abu Bakr (RA), jab unhone Umar (RA) ko khalifa muqarrar kiya."

e: [AI] "Umar was struck on Wednesday for four more nights from the month of Dhu al-Hijjah." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Umar (RA) ko Budhwaar ke din zakhmi kiya gaya, Zil-Hijjah ki chaar (4) raatein baaqi rehte." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He ﷺ  said on the pulpit, 'Indeed, I saw in a dream as if a rooster had pecked me three times. So I said, 'I am a foreigner' and I have entrusted my affairs to these six people whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away while being pleased with – Uthman, Ali, Talhah, Zubair, Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf, and Saad ibn Abi Waqqas. So whoever is chosen from them, he is the caliph.' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about him in the summary."
hi: Unhone kaha ke unhone mimbar par farmaya: "Maine khwaab mein dekha goya aik murgha ne mujhe teen chonchein maarin, to maine kaha (yeh) Ajami (ghair-Arab) hai, aur maine apna maamla in chhah logon ke supurd kar diya hai jinse Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua jabke woh unse raazi the - Uthman (RA), Ali (RA), Talhah (RA), Zubair (RA), Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA), aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA), to jo bhi khalifa muqarrar kiya jaaye woh khalifa hoga." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Oh Amir al-Mu'minin, Mu'awiyah has been too harsh on me, so please ask him to ease up on me." 'Umar said to him, "Fear Allah and be kind to your leader." Mu'awiyah said, "Is it 'Umar's intention to meet me and speak to me about easing up on him?" Abu Lu'luah became angry. His name was Fayroz and he was a Christian. He said, "Everyone's fairness is mine alone?" He became angrier and decided to kill him. He made a dagger with two heads, sharpened it, and poisoned it. 'Umar raised his voice, something he would not normally do during prayer time, and said, "Straighten your rows." He came and stood in the row right behind 'Umar during Fajr prayer. When the prayer was established, he spoke and said, "Straighten your rows." Then he raised his voice and let out a loud cry. He struck 'Umar on his shoulder, then on another spot, and finally in his abdomen. 'Umar fell. He struck thirteen men with him, and seven of them scattered.
