Six of them died, and 'Umar was carried away. The people did not move until the sun was about to rise. 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf called out, "O people, prayer, prayer!" The people rushed to pray. 'Abd al-Rahman went forward and led them in prayer. He recited the shortest two Surahs in the Quran. When he finished, people turned to 'Umar ibn al-Khattab. He called for a drink to examine the wound. They brought him wine, and he drank it. He came out, and no one realized if it was blood or wine. He called for milk, and they brought it to him. He drank it, and the milk flowed out of his wound. They said, "You're fine, O Amir al-Mu'minin." He said, "If death is pain, then I have already died." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this incident in his summary.
hi: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, Al-Mughirah (RA) mujhpar bohot sakhti karte hain, isliye unse baat karein ke woh mujhpar narmi karein." To Umar (RA) ne usse kaha: "Allah se daro aur apne maalik ke sath achha bartaav karo." Unhone kaha: aur Umar (RA) ka iraada tha ke woh Al-Mughirah (RA) se milein aur unse uspar narmi karne ki baat karein. Unhone kaha: to Abu Lu'lu'ah, jiska naam Fairooz tha aur woh Nasraani (Christian) tha, ko ghussa aaya, usne kaha: "Unka insaaf sab logon ko samaata hai, mere siwa?" Unhone kaha: to usse ghussa aaya aur usne unhein qatl karne ka iraada kar liya, to usne aik do-dhaari khanjar banaaya, unhone kaha: usne isse tez kiya aur zeher laga diya. Unhone kaha: aur Umar (RA) ne takbeer kahi, aur Umar (RA) namaz qaayam honay par takbeer nahi kehte the jab tak baat na kar lete aur kehte: "Apni safein seedhi karo," to woh (Abu Lu'lu'ah) aaya aur saf mein khada ho gaya, unke saamne, subah ki namaz mein. Jab namaz qaayam ki gayi, to Umar (RA) ne baat ki aur kaha: "Apni safein seedhi karo," phir takbeer kahi, jab unhone takbeer kahi, to usne unhein unke kandhe par waar kiya, aur aik doosri jagah bhi waar kiya, aur unke pehlu mein bhi waar kiya, to Umar (RA) gir gaye. Unhone kaha: aur usne unke sath teirah (13) aadmiyon ko bhi waar kiya, unme se saat (7) bach gaye aur chhah (6) ka intiqaal ho gaya, aur Umar (RA) ko uthaaya gaya aur le jaaya gaya, aur log ghabraa gaye yahan tak ke suraj nikalne hi wala tha. Unhone kaha: to Abdur Rahman bin Awf (RA) ne pukaara: "Aye logo, namaz, namaz," to log namaz ki taraf daude. Unhone kaha: to Abdur Rahman (RA) aage badhe aur unhein namaz padhaayi, Quran ki do sabse chhoti Surahen padhin. Unhone kaha: jab woh faarigh huay, to log Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ki taraf mudh gaye. Unhone kaha: to unhone (dekhne ke liye ke unka zakhm kitna gehra hai) sharaab (khaas taur par nabeez) mangwaayi, to unhein nabeez laayi gayi, unhone use piya, unhone kaha: to woh (zakhm se) nikli, aur pata nahi chala ke woh khoon hai ya nabeez, unhone kaha: to unhone doodh mangwaaya, woh laaya gaya, unhone use piya, to woh unke zakhm se nikla, to unhone kaha: "Koi baat nahi, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen." Unhone kaha: "Agar qatl mein koi khataraa hai, to mujhe qatl kiya jaa chuka hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About Mina in the last pilgrimage, I went to Al-Bathaa and piled up a mound there. Then I threw his garment on it and lied down, stretching his hands towards the sky and said, "O Allah, my old age has increased, my strength has weakened, and my followers have multiplied, so take me to You without being lost or misguided." Then he came in the month of Dhul-Hijjah and addressed the people, saying, "O people, I have established Sunnah for you and imposed obligations on you, and left you on a clear path." He then struck one hand against the other, except if you turn to people right or left." I was not far from Dhul-Hijjah until Umar was killed, and I heard Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab saying, "Abu Lulu'ah, who killed Umar, stabbed him twelve times. Six of them died and six were injured, and he had a knife with two edges, so he stabbed himself and killed himself."
hi: Mina se, apne aakhri Hajj mein, unhone (Umar RA ne) Al-Bat'haa mein apni sawaari bithaayi, phir Bat'haa mein aik dher banaaya, phir usspar apni chaadar ka aik hissa bichaaya, phir peeth ke bal let gaye aur apne dono haath aasman ki taraf phaila diye, phir farmaya: "Aye Allah, meri umar bad chuki hai, meri taaqat kamzor pad gayi hai, aur meri ra'iyat phail chuki hai, isliye mujhe apni taraf uthaa le, bagair kisi kotahi ya zaya honay ke." Phir woh Zil-Hijjah mein wapas aaye aur logon ko khutba diya, farmaya: "Aye logo, maine tumhare liye Sunnaten qaayam ki hain, tumhare liye faraaiz muqarrar kiye hain, aur tumhein saaf raah par chhoda hai," aur unhone apna aik haath doosre par maara, "siwaye is ke ke tum logon ko dayen-baayen bahka do." To Zil-Hijjah khatm hone se pehle hi Umar (RA) qatl kar diye gaye. Aur maine Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyab ko kehte suna: "Abu Lu'lu'ah, jisne Umar (RA) ko qatl kiya, ne Umar (RA) ke sath baarah (12) aadmiyon ko chaaqu maara, unme se chhah (6) ka intiqaal ho gaya aur chhah (6) bach gaye, aur uske paas aik chaaqu tha jiski do dhaarein thin, to usne khud ko usse chaaqu maara aur khud ko qatl kar liya."

e: [AI] "That he was stabbed and then died, so he was washed and shrouded."
hi: "Ke unhein chaaqu maara gaya, phir unka intiqaal hua, unhein ghusl diya gaya aur kafan pehnaaya gaya."

e: [AI] He was stabbed, so I said, "Rejoice in Paradise, O Commander of the Faithful. You embraced Islam when people disbelieved and you fought alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when people abandoned him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away while he was pleased with you, and there was no disagreement regarding your caliphate. You were martyred, and he said, 'Prepare a response for me' and I prepared it for him. He said, 'By Allah, besides whom there is no deity, if I had all the wealth on earth in exchange for avoiding the hardship of Day of Resurrection, I would do it."
hi: Unhein chaaqu maara gaya, to maine kaha: "Khush ho jayen Jannat se, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aap Musalman huay jab log kaafir the, aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jihad mein rahe jab log unhein chhod chuke the, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal huay jabke woh aapse raazi the, aur aapki khilafat mein kisi do logon ne ikhtilaaf nahi kiya, aur aap shaheed hokar qatl kiye gaye." To unhone kaha: "Yeh baat mujhpar dohraao," to maine unpar dohraayi. To unhone kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, agar zameen ki saari sona-chandi meri hoti, to main woh sab is muqaam-e-hisaab ke khauf se fidye mein de deta."

e: that the funeral prayer for Umar was held in the mosque, and Suhayb ؓ   led the prayer.
hi: "Umar (RA) ki namaz-e-janaza masjid mein padhi gayi, Suhaib (RA) ne unhein namaz padhaayi."

e: [AI] When Umar was killed, Ali and Uthman both prepared to offer their prayers for him. So Suhaib said to them, "I greet you on behalf of myself, as I have been entrusted with more of your matters than offering prayers for Umar. And while I pray the obligatory prayers with you, Suhaib offered prayers for him."
hi: Jab Umar (RA) qatl kiye gaye, to Ali (RA) aur Uthman (RA) donon unhein namaz padhaane ke liye jaldi karne lage, to Suhaib (RA) ne unse kaha: "Mujhe chhod do, mujhe tum dono ke maamlaat mein Umar (RA) ki namaz padhaane se zyada zimmedaariyan di gayi hain, aur main tumhein farz namaz padhaunga," to Suhaib (RA) ne unhein namaz padhaayi.

e: [AI] "Umar performed the Hajj pilgrimage ten times consecutively, including one during the caliphate of Abu Bakr and nine during his own caliphate. He was buried beside Abu Bakr in Aisha's house. His caliphate lasted for ten years, five months, and twenty-nine days."
hi: "Umar (RA) ne logon ke sath das (10) Hajj lagataar kiye, unme se aik Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat mein tha aur nau (9) unki apni khilafat mein, aur unhein Abu Bakr (RA) ke pehlu mein, Aisha (RA) ke ghar mein dafan kiya gaya, aur unki khilafat das (10) saal, paanch (5) mahine, aur unatees (29) din rahi."

e: [AI] He was stabbed. He said to Abdullah, "Go to Aisha and convey my greetings to her, and say to her, 'Verily, Umar says to you, if it does not harm you nor make things difficult for you, then I would love to be buried with my two companions. But if it harms you or makes things difficult for you, then by Allah, I have been buried in this graveyard with the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and the mothers of the believers. Who is better than Umar?' " The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to her and she said, "It does not harm me nor make things difficult for me." He said, "Then bury me with them."
hi: Unhein chaaqu maara gaya, unhone Abdullah (RA) se kaha: "Aisha (RA) ke paas jao, unhein salaam kaho, aur kaho ke Umar kehte hain: agar isse aapko koi nuqsaan ya takleef na ho, to mujhe apne dono saathiyon ke sath dafan hona pasand hai, aur agar isse aapko nuqsaan aur takleef hoti hai, to mujhe apni jaan ki qasam, is Baqi' mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba aur Ummat-ul-Mumineen mein se woh log bhi dafan huay hain jo Umar se behtar hain." To qaasid unke paas gaya, unhone kaha: "Isse mujhe koi nuqsaan ya takleef nahi." Unhone kaha: "To mujhe dono ke sath dafan kar do."

e: [AI] "I looked into the grave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and also the graves of Abu Bakr and Umar, from Aisha's chamber, and I saw red pebbles on them."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW), Abu Bakr (RA), aur Umar (RA) ki qabron ko Aisha (RA) ke hujre se jhaanka, maine unpar surkh kankariyaan dekhin."

e: [AI] "Omar passed away at the age of sixty-three."
hi: "Umar (RA) tirsath (63) saal ki umr mein faut huay."

e: [AI] "If Umar was a strong fortress in which Islam entered and did not leave, then when Umar was affected, the fortress collapsed and Islam left it and did not enter it. When the believers were mentioned, Umar said, 'Salutations to Umar.'"
hi: "Umar (RA) aik mazboot qila the jisme Islam dakhil hota tha lekin usse nikalta nahi tha, jab Umar (RA) zakhmi huay, to qile mein darar aa gayi, to Islam usse nikalne laga aur usme dakhil hona band ho gaya, jab neik logon ka zikr ho, to Umar (RA) ka bhi zikr karo."

e: [AI] Ali entered upon Umar while he was praying and said, "May peace be upon you." Then he said, "There is no one whom I love more than to meet Allah with what is in this prayer mat of his."
hi: Ali (RA) Umar (RA) ke paas dakhil huay jabke woh chaadar mein dhake huay the, unhone kaha: "Allah ki rehmat ho aap par," phir farmaya: "Logon mein se koi bhi aisa nahi jise main Allah se yeh chaadar mein dhaka jo kuch bhi likha hai use lekar milna zyada pasand karta houn."

e: [AI] "A voice was heard in the mountain of Tabalah when Umar ibn Al-Khattab was killed. It was a long poem to mourn for Islam. Those who were weeping were on the verge of destruction. The covenant was not fulfilled, the world turned away, and its best turned away. Those who believed in the promise were disappointed. They looked, but saw nothing."
hi: Jab Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) qatl kiye gaye, to Jabal Tabalah mein aik aawaaz suni gayi, shairi (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Jo bhi rone wala hai woh Islam par roye, kyunke halaakat qareeb aa chuki hai jabke ahd purana nahi hua, duniya peeth pher chuki hai aur uski bhalaai peeth pher chuki hai, aur usse woh log ubb chuke hain jo wa'da par yaqeen rakhte the." To unhone dekha magar kuch nazar na aaya.

e:
[AI] (Poem) [The Gentle Sea]

The tears of Joudi are a sign and a lament that never ends
Upon the Imam, the cross, she never ceases to weep
Sorrow has overwhelmed me with the knight, the protector,
On the day of turmoil and reproach
It is the safeguard of religion and the helper
Against the passing of time, the rain of the distressed
And the grieving heart
Tell the people in distress and misery, "Die
When sorrow poured upon us like cups of nations"
And Atika also said [The Long Sea]
Fairooz has startled me with a pearl whose like
Could not be found in any pure white book
For he is tender to the lowest but harsh to the enemy
My brother, a trustworthy support in response to supplication
Whenever he says, "My words do not lie,"
His actions quickly move towards goodness,
Unlike those who turn away from it knowingly
This hadith of Thawri is narrated in Sahihain,
But I have mentioned it here with correct letters,
A beneficial and rare chain of narration.
hi: (Shairi, bahr Al-Khafeef mein): "Aye aankh, aansuon aur sisakiyon ke sath sakhaawat karo, seedhe, mazboot imam par thakna mat, mujhe maut ne us mash-hoor sawaar se gham diya hai jung aur malaamat ke din, deen ki hifaazat karne wala aur zamane mein madad karne wala, pareshaan aur ghamzada ka baarish jaisa sahaara, museebat-zada aur museebat-zadagi wale logon se kaho: mar jao, jabke maut ne humein qaumon ka pyaala pilaaya." Aur Atikah (RA) ne bhi kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Fairooz ne mujhe gham diya, uska haath kabhi barkat na paaye, aik saaf, seedhe kitaab (Quran) ki taraf loutne wale ke zariye, qareebiyon par narm, dushmano par sakht, museebaton mein bharosemand bhai, jawaab-dene wala, jab woh kuch kahta to uska amal uski baat ko jhutlaata nahi, bhalaiyon ki taraf jaldi karta, kabhi tursh-mizaaj nahi." Ath-Thawri ki hadith Sahihain mein nikaali gayi hai, lekin maine yahan sahih isnad ke sath kuch alfaaz zikr kiye hain jo faaydemand aur ghareeb (kam-yaab) hain.

e: [AI] Omar to his companions of Shura: "Their true value is in God, even if they try to abandon it. How can they uphold the truth if they are burdened by it at the point of a sword?" I said, "Do you know this about them and yet do not prevent it?" He said, "If I appoint my successor, I have appointed someone better than me. And if I do not, I have left someone better than me."
hi: Umar (RA) ne Shura (mashware) walon se kaha: "Allah unhein achha badla de, agar woh isse Usailay' (choti taskali/gunj-sar wale) ko de dete, to woh unhein haq par kaise chalaate, chahe uski gardan par talwaar hi kyun na rakhi jaaye." Unhone kaha: to maine poocha: "Aapko unke baare mein yeh maloom hai aur aap unhein khalifa nahi banaate?" Unhone kaha: "Agar main khalifa muqarrar karoon, to (mujhse pehle) khalifa muqarrar karne wale ne bhi mujhse behtar shakhs ko khalifa banaaya tha (Abu Bakr RA ne mujhe), aur agar main chhod doon, to (mujhse pehle) chhodne wale ne bhi mujhse behtar shakhs ko chhoda tha (Rasulullah SAW ne khud kisi ko muqarrar nahi kiya)."

e: [AI] I heard Ali, on the Day of the Camel, saying, "O Allah, I declare to You my innocence from the blood of Uthman. Indeed, my mind was clouded on the day Uthman was killed, and I disapproved of it. They came to me for allegiance, and I said, 'By Allah, I am too shy before Allah to pledge allegiance to a group who have killed a man.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, 'Are you shy of whom the angels are shy?.' And I am indeed shy before Allah to pledge allegiance when Uthman is dead, and his body has not yet been buried.' So they left, and when he was buried, the people returned and asked me for allegiance. I said, 'O Allah, I am apprehensive of what I will do.' Then resolve came to me, and I pledged allegiance. Indeed, they said, 'O Amir al-Mu'minin, it felt as if my heart was splitting.' I said, 'O Allah, take from me for Uthman until You are pleased.'"
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko Jamal ke din kehte suna: "Aye Allah, main tere saamne Uthman (RA) ke khoon se bezaari zaahir karta houn, aur beshak jis din Uthman (RA) qatl kiye gaye, meri aqal ghum ho gayi thi aur main apne aap ko na-pasand karne laga tha, aur log baiyat ke liye mere paas aaye, to maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe Allah se sharam aati hai ke main un logon se baiyat karoon jinhone aise shakhs ko qatl kiya jiske baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya tha: 'Kya main us shakhs se sharam na karoon jisse farishte sharm karte hain?' aur mujhe Allah se sharam aati hai ke main baiyat karoon jabke Uthman (RA) zameen par qatl pade hain, abhi tak dafan nahi huay." To woh wapas chale gaye, jab unhein dafan kar diya gaya, to log wapas aaye aur mujhse baiyat maangi, maine kaha: "Aye Allah, main is baare mein jo mein karne ja raha houn usse dara hua houn," phir mere dil mein aik pukka iraada aaya, to maine baiyat kar li. To unhone kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen," to goya mera dil phat gaya, aur maine kaha: "Aye Allah, Uthman (RA) ke haq mein mujhse le le yahan tak ke tu raazi ho jaaye."

e: [AI] Uthman bin Affan bin Abi Al-Aas bin Umayah bin Abdul Shams bin Abdul Manaf bin Qusay bin Kilab and Umm Uthman Arwa bint Kareez and Umm Arwa Umm Hakim, and she is Al-Bayda'a, the paternal aunt of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . They differed regarding the kunyah (agnomen) of Uthman. It was said, "Abu Abdullah" and it was said, "Abu Amr". Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: Uthman bin Affan bin Abi Al-Aas bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams bin Abd Manaf bin Qusay bin Kilaab hain, aur Uthman (RA) ki maa Arwa bint Kuraiz thin, aur Arwa ki maa Umm Hakeem thin jo "Al-Baida" (safed) kehlaati thin, Rasulullah (SAW) ki phupi. Uthman (RA) ki kunniyat mein ikhtilaaf hai, kaha jaata hai Abu Abdullah, aur kaha jaata hai Abu Amr. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah saying, "Uthman ibn Affan was nicknamed Abu Amr and Abu Abdullah. He was killed in the month of Dhul-Hijjah in the year thirty-five."
hi: Maine Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaibah ko kehte suna: "Uthman bin Affan (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Amr aur Abu Abdullah thi, unhein Zil-Hijjah mein pachattar (35) hijri mein qatl kiya gaya."

e: [AI] Uthman ibn Affan was killed when he was either ninety or eighty-eight years old.
hi: "Uthman bin Affan (RA) nabbe (90) ya assi-aath (88) saal ki umr mein qatl kiye gaye."

e: ʿUthman ؓ was killed on the eighteenth of Dhul-Hijjah 35 AH, His caliphate lasted twelve years less twelve days. (Using translation from Aḥmad 545)
hi: Uthman bin Affan (RA) Jumme ke din, Zil-Hijjah ki baarah (12) raatein baaqi rehte, pachattar (35) hijri mein qatl kiye gaye, aur unki khilafat baarah (12) saal rahi.

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  carried the first stone to build the mosque, then Abu Bakr carried another stone, and then Uthman carried another stone. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, do you not see how they are assisting you?" He said, "O Aisha, these are the caliphs after me."
hi: Sabse pehla patthar jo Nabi (SAW) ne masjid banaane ke liye uthaaya, phir Abu Bakr (RA) ne doosra patthar uthaaya, phir Uthman (RA) ne doosra patthar uthaaya, to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap dekh nahi rahe yeh log aapki kaise madad kar rahe hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Aisha, yeh log mere baad ke khulafa hain."

e: [AI] "And the allegiance of Uthman was on Monday, the twelfth day of Muharram, in the year four and twenty." This was deleted by Al-Dhahabi in the abridged version.
hi: "Uthman (RA) ki baiyat Peer ke din, Muharram ki barah (12) tareekh, chaubees (24) hijri mein hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] From it, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Let every one of you rise to his true measure." So, the Prophet ﷺ  went to Uthman, embraced him, and said, "You are my guardian in this world and the Hereafter."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se har aadmi apne (barabar/hamsar) ki taraf uthe." To Nabi (SAW) khud Uthman (RA) ki taraf uthe, unhein gale lagaaya, aur farmaya: "Tum duniya aur Aakhirat mein mere waali (madadgaar) ho." Weak.

e: [AI] I witnessed Uthman on the day he was besieged in the burial site, and he said to me, "I swear to you by Allah, O Talha, do you remember the day when I and you were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  at such and such a place, and there were no companions with him except me and you?" He said to you, "O Talha, indeed, there is no prophet except that he has a companion from his Ummah with him in paradise, and Uthman is my companion and he is with me in paradise." Talha said, "O Allah, yes." Then Talha left.
hi: Maine Uthman (RA) ko dekha jab woh ghere mein the, janaazon ki jagah par, unhone kaha: "Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta hoon, Aye Talhah, kya tumhein yaad hai jab main aur tum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath fulan-fulan jagah the, aur unke sahaba mein se sirf main aur tum unke sath the, aap (SAW) ne tumse farmaya: 'Aye Talhah, har Nabi ka apni Ummat mein se aik saathi hota hai jo Jannat mein unke sath hoga, aur Uthman mera saathi hai, Jannat mein mere sath.'" To Talhah (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Allah, ji haan." Unhone kaha: phir Talhah (RA) wapas chale gaye.

e: [AI] Some of the people said: "Now he claims that you betrayed 'Uthman." He replied: "That is what he says." They told the man to respond to him, so he said: "Did you not understand what I said?" He said: "Yes, I asked you if 'Uthman witnessed the pledge of Ridwan, and you said no. I also asked you if he participated in the Battle of Badr, and you said no. I asked you if he was amongst those whom Satan deceived, and you said yes." He said: "As for the pledge of Ridwan, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up and said, 'Indeed, 'Uthman went forth for the sake of Allah and for the sake of His Messenger's need.' He struck him with an arrow that did not harm anyone else. As for those who turned away on the Day the two armies met, it was only Satan who made them slip because of [some of] what they had earned. But Allah has already forgiven them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing."
hi: Kuch logon ne unse kaha: "Yeh aadmi ab daawa karta hai ke aap ne Uthman (RA) par ilzaam lagaaya." Unhone kaha: "Woh yehi kehta hai." Unhone kaha: "Us aadmi ko mere paas wapas lao." Unhone poocha: "Kya tumhein yaad hai maine tumse kya kaha tha?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, maine aapse poocha tha: kya Uthman (RA) ne Bay'atur-Ridwan mein shirkat ki thi? Aapne kaha: nahi. Aur maine aapse poocha tha: kya woh Badr mein maujood the? To maine (khud) kaha: nahi. Aur maine aapse poocha tha: kya woh un logon mein se the jinhein shaitan ne bahkaaya? To aapne kaha: haan." To unhone kaha: "Rahi baat Bay'atur-Ridwan ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay aur farmaya: 'Beshak Uthman Allah aur uske Rasool ke kaam se gaye hain,' aur unke liye aik hissa muqarrar kiya, aur kisi aur ghair-hazir shakhs ke liye aisa nahi kiya. Aur rahi baat un logon ki jo un dono lashkaron ke milne ke din peeth pher gaye, to shaitan ne unhein sirf unke kuch kiye huay aamaal ki wajah se bahkaaya, aur Allah ne unhein maaf kar diya, beshak Allah bakhshne wala, bardaasht karne wala hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "One day, you will attack a man wearing a cloak who is giving allegiance to the people of Jannah." So, I attacked Uthman, who was wearing a cloak made of fine wool and giving allegiance to the people.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik din tum aik aise aadmi par hamla-aawar hoge jo aik chaadar odhe huay hoga, logon se Jannat waalon ki taraf se baiyat le raha hoga." To maine Uthman (RA) par hamla kiya, jabke woh dhaari-daar (mulawwan) chaadar odhe huay the aur logon se baiyat le rahe the.

e: [AI] A man asked the Prophet ﷺ , "Is there lightning in Paradise?" He replied, "Yes, by the One in whose hand is my soul, Uthman will move from one house to another and the paradise will lightning for him." If Husayn ibn Ubaydullah has preserved this from Abdul-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim, then it is correct according to the conditions set by the two sheikhs and it is not a fabricated narration.
hi: Aik aadmi ne Nabi (SAW) se poocha: "Kya Jannat mein bijli chamakti hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, Uthman aik ghar se doosre ghar ki taraf jaayenge, to Jannat unke liye chamak uthegi." Agar Husain bin Ubaidullah ne ise Abdul Aziz bin Abi Hazim se sahih taur par yaad rakha hai, to yeh Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Fabricated.

e: [AI] Musa, Muhammad, and Ibrahim, the sons of Uqbah, said, "Our father Abu Ummi said that Abu Hasana said, 'I witnessed Abu Hurairah and Uthman confined in the house, so I sought permission to talk to him. Abu Hurairah said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'Indeed, there will be turmoil and disagreements, or disagreements and turmoil." We said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what do you command us to do?' He said, 'Obey the ruler and his companions,' and he pointed towards Uthman."
hi: Humein Musa, Muhammad, aur Ibrahim, Uqbah ke betay, ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: humein humare abba Abu Hasanah ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: main Abu Hurairah (RA) ke paas maujood tha jabke Uthman (RA) ghar mein ghere mein the, maine unse baat karne ki ijaazat maangi, to Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Ankareeb fitna aur ikhtilaaf hoga, ya ikhtilaaf aur fitna.'" Humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap humein kya hukum dete hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ameer aur uske saathiyon ka saath do," aur unhone Uthman (RA) ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: [AI] "People wished that Uthman would cause discord. So I said to them, 'May Allah rectify you,' and then they asked me to inform them. I refused to repeat what people were saying. But then I said, 'I saw the Messenger of Allah in my dream last night, and he said, 'You will be witnessing with us on Friday.'"
hi: Ke log kehte hain Uthman (RA) ne fitna ki tamanna ki, to main tumhein bataata. Unhone kaha: humne kaha: "Allah aapki islaah kare, to humein bataayen, hum woh nahi kehte jo log kehte hain." To unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko is raat khwaab mein dekha, unhone farmaya: 'Tum humare sath Jumma ko gawah hoge.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "Pray for me, or bring me one of my companions." I said, "Abu Bakr?" He said, "No." I said, "Umar?" He said, "No." I said, "Your cousin Ali?" He said, "No." I said, "So, Uthman?" He said, "Yes." Uthman came and the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Get up." Then the Prophet ﷺ  went to Uthman and his color changed. When it was the Day of the Battle of Ad-Dar, we said, "Won't you fight?" He said, "No, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entrusted me with a matter and I will be patient with it."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere liye bulaao ya kaash mere paas mere sahaba mein se koi aadmi hota." Unhone (Aisha RA) kaha: maine poocha: "Abu Bakr (RA)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." Maine poocha: "Umar (RA)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." Maine poocha: "Aapke chachere bhai Ali (RA)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." Maine poocha: "To Uthman (RA)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: to Uthman (RA) aaye, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Utho." Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) Uthman (RA) se khufiya baat karne lage, aur Uthman (RA) ki rangat badalti gayi. Unhone kaha: jab "Yaum-ud-Daar" (Ghar ka Din) hua, humne poocha: "Kya aap jung nahi karenge?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse aik ahd liya tha, isliye main iske liye sabr karta houn."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Uthman, "Indeed, Allah is dressing you in a garment. If the hypocrites want you to remove it, then do not remove it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Uthman (RA) se farmaya: "Beshak Allah tumhein aik qamees (khilafat) pehnaayega, agar munafiqeen tumhein isse utarne par majboor karein, to isse mat utaarna."

Humein Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Ahmad Al-Asbahani ne hadith bayan ki, humein Al-Hasan bin Al-Jahm ne hadith bayan ki, humein Al-Husain bin Al-Faraj ne hadith bayan ki, humein Muhammad bin Umar ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: "Abu Sarh ka naam Al-Husaam bin Al-Harith bin Habib bin Khuzaimah tha." Al-Hakim ne kaha: "Jab Abdullah bin Sa'd Misr par qaabiz huay, to unki aulaad chali, unme se Amr bin Sawwad As-Sarhi bhi thay, jo Abdullah bin Wahb ke saathi thay. Rahi baat Al-Waleed bin Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ayt ki, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki zindagi mein paida huay aur unke paas laaye gaye, magar unhein aap (SAW) ki barkat naseeb nahi hui."

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  conquered Mecca, the people of Mecca would bring their children to him, and he would wipe his hands over their heads and pray for them. My father took me to him, and I was very handsome in appearance. However, he did not wipe his hands on my head or touch me. The only reason for that was that my mother had created me in a different way. Ahmad ibn Hanbal said, 'It has been narrated that he embraced Islam on that day, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not touch or pray for him. The appearance does not prevent prayer, and this is certainly true for a child in the action of someone else. However, he was prevented by the blessing of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  due to the previous knowledge that Allah the Almighty had regarding him. And Allah knows best.'"
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Makkah fatah ki, to Makkah wale apne bachchon ko lekar aane lage, Rasulullah (SAW) unke saron par haath pherte aur unke liye dua karte, mujhe mere waalid mere sath unke paas le gaye, jabke main khaluq (khushbudaar lep) laga hua tha, to unhone mere sar par haath nahi phera aur na hi mujhe chhua, aur unhein isse rokne wali cheez sirf yeh thi ke meri maa ne mujhpar khaluq lagaaya tha, isliye khaluq ki wajah se unhone mujhe nahi chhua." Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: "Aur yeh bhi riwayat hai ke usne us din Islam qubool kiya tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse napasand samjha, isliye unhone use na chhua na uske liye dua ki, aur khaluq dua se rokne wali cheez nahi hai, aur na hi kisi bachche par kisi doosre ke amal ka koi ilzaam hai, lekin Allah Ta'ala ke pehle se ilm ki wajah se usse Rasulullah (SAW) ki barkat se mehroom rakha gaya, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai."

e: [AI] "And I swear by Allah, I do not know if I dressed appropriately after you or have I become foolish after you? He said, "By Allah, I did not dress inappropriately after you nor did I become foolish after you, but the people have asserted their authority over you." He said, "You have spoken the truth." (This excerpt has been omitted by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness.)
hi: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata tumhare baad mein aql-mand ho gaya houn ya tumhare baad mein bewaqoof ho gaya houn?" To unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, na mein tumhare baad aql-mand hua na tum mere baad bewaqoof huay, lekin logon ne apni hukumat se tumpar khud ko tarjeeh de di." To unhone kaha: "Tumne sach kaha." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: "Whoever survives three things, then they have achieved salvation." They asked, "What are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "My death, the killing of a just ruler who defends the truth, and the appearance of the Antichrist." This hadith has a sound chain of narration and it was not reported in a Sahih collection.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo teen cheezon se bach gaya, woh bach gaya." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri maut, aise sabr karne wale khalifa ka qatl jo haq ada karta ho, aur Dajjal se." Sahih ul-isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, the lifespan of Islam will be for thirty-five years, or (sixty-five years), or (seventy-seven years). If they are destroyed, then the way of those who were destroyed will prevail. And if they remain, their religion will remain for seventy years (after the completion of those years)." Umar asked, "O Prophet of Allah, by what has passed or by what remains?" He ﷺ  said, "No, rather by what remains."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Islam ki chakki paintees (35) ya chattis (36) ya saintees (37) saal ke baad ghoomegi, agar woh halaak ho gaye, to woh unka raasta hoga jo halaak huay, aur agar unka deen baaqi raha, to woh sattar (70) saal tak qaayam rahega." Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, jo guzar chuka usse ya jo baaqi hai usse?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke jo baaqi hai usse."

e: [AI] "Al-Walid ibn Uqbah ibn Abi Muayt ibn Amr ibn Umayyah ibn Abd Shams was the brother of Uthman through their mother. Their mother was Arwa bint Kariz ibn Rabiah ibn Abd Shams, and her mother was Umm Hakim al-Bayda bint Abd al-Muttalib ibn Abd Manaf, the paternal aunt of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ  ordered the killing of Uqbah ibn Abi Muayt upon his return. During the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , Al-Walid was a man who was known as Abu Wahb."
hi: "Al-Waleed bin Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ayt bin Amr bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams, Uthman (RA) ke maa ki taraf se bhai the, aur unki maa Arwa bint Kuraiz bin Rabi'ah bin Abd Shams thin, aur unki (Arwa ki) maa Umm Hakeem Al-Baida bint Abdul Muttalib bin Abd Manaf thin, Rasulullah (SAW) ki phupi. Nabi (SAW) ne Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ayt ko (Badr se) wapasi mein qatl kar diya, aur Al-Waleed Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein aik jawaan aadmi thay, unki kunniyat Abu Wahb thi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I saw a righteous man last night, that Abu Bakr holds onto the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Umar holds onto the hand of Abu Bakr, and Uthman holds onto the hand of Umar." When we stood up from being near the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we said, "As for the righteous man, it is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. And as for what was mentioned of them holding onto each other's hand, they are the leaders of this matter that Allah sent His Prophet with." Ad-Darimi said, "I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in saying that Muhammad ibn Harb narrated this hadith with its chain of transmission, and people narrate it from Az-Zuhri as Mursal. It is actually Amr ibn Aban and Aban ibn Uthman's son called Amr."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aaj raat aik neik aadmi ko dikhaaya gaya ke Abu Bakr (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) se joda gaya hai, aur Umar (RA) Abu Bakr (RA) se joda gaya hai, aur Uthman (RA) Umar (RA) se joda gaya hai." Jab hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas se uthe, to humne kaha: "Neik aadmi to Rasulullah (SAW) khud hain, aur unme se kuch ka kuch se joda jaana, yeh isliye hai ke woh is maamle ke wali (hukmaraan) hain jise lekar Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko bheja." Ad-Darimi ne kaha: maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Muhammad bin Harb ne is hadith ki isnad ke sath riwayat ki, aur log ise Az-Zuhri se mursal riwayat karte hain, yeh dar-asal Amr bin Abaan hai, aur Abaan bin Uthman ke koi beta nahi tha jise Amr kaha jaata ho."

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  mentioning a trial that would cause poverty. Then, a masked man dressed in a garment passed by him. The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'This person today is on the right guidance.' I approached him and behold, it was Uthman ibn Affan. I turned towards him and asked, 'Is it you?' He replied, 'Yes.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko aik fitna ka zikr karte suna, to yeh unpar bhaari guzra, ke aik dhaka-chhupa aadmi unke paas se guzra, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh us din hidayat par hoga." To main unke paas gaya, achaanak woh Uthman bin Affan (RA) the, main unke chehre ki taraf mudha aur poocha: "Yehi hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan."

e: [AI] Uthman came to the Prophet ﷺ  with a thousand dinars when he prepared the army of Al-Usrah. Uthman emptied it in the Prophet's chamber. The Prophet ﷺ  kept flipping the coins and saying, "Uthman's actions after this day will not harm him." He repeated this several times.
hi: Uthman (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas hazaar (1000) dinaar lekar aaye jab unhone Lashkar-e-Usrah (mushkil lashkar, Tabuk expedition) taiyaar kiya, Uthman (RA) ne unhein Nabi (SAW) ki god mein khaali kar diya, to Nabi (SAW) unhein ulat-pulat karne lage aur kehte: "Uthman ko is din ke baad kya kiya usse koi nuqsaan nahi hoga," yeh unhone kayi baar kaha.

e: [AI] "I saw the Prophet ﷺ in a dream last night, and he said, 'O Uthman, break your fast with us.' So Uthman woke up fasting and was martyred on that day."
hi: "Maine is raat Nabi (SAW) ko khwaab mein dekha, unhone farmaya: 'Aye Uthman, humare sath iftaar karo.'" To Uthman (RA) ki subah roze ki haalat mein hui, aur usi din woh shaheed kar diye gaye.

e: [AI] I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when Uthman ibn Affan approached. When he neared, the Prophet said, "O Uthman, you will be killed while reciting Surah Al-Baqarah, and your blood will spill on the verse, 'And Allah is sufficient for you against them. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.'" (Quran 2:137). And on the Day of Resurrection, you will be raised as a leader over every oppressor. The people of the East and the West will envy you, and you will intercede for the number of Rabia and Mudar.
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas baitha tha ke Uthman bin Affan (RA) aaye, jab woh unke qareeb huay, to farmaya: "Aye Uthman, tum qatl kiye jaaoge jabke tum Surah Al-Baqarah padh rahe hoge, tumhara khoon is ayat par giregaa: 'To Allah tumhein unse bachaane ke liye kaafi hoga, aur woh sunne wala, jaanne wala hai' (Al-Baqarah 137), aur tumhein Qayamat ke din har mazloom ka ameer banaakar uthaaya jaayega, mashriq aur maghrib wale tumpar raashk karenge, aur tum Rabi'ah aur Mudhar ki tadaad mein shafa'at karoge."

e: [AI] "I witnessed Ali on the Day of the Camel saying, 'O Allah, I declare my innocence to You from the blood of Uthman. My mind went astray on the day Uthman was killed, and I condemned myself. They wanted me to pledge allegiance, but I said, 'I swear by Allah, I feel ashamed before Allah to pledge allegiance to people who have killed a man.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, 'Do you not feel ashamed before the angels from whom you feel ashamed?' And I swear by Allah, I feel ashamed before Allah to pledge allegiance while Uthman, a murdered man, lies on the ground without being buried yet.' So they left me alone. When Uthman was buried and people came back to me, they asked me for allegiance. I said, 'O Allah, I am apprehensive about what I am about to do.' Then determination came, and I pledged allegiance. They said, 'O Amir al-Mu'minin, it was as if my heart had been split open.' I said, 'O Allah, take from me for Uthman until You are pleased.'"
hi: Main Ali (RA) ko Jamal ke din yeh kehte huay dekha: "Aye Allah, main tere saamne Uthman (RA) ke khoon se bezaari zaahir karta houn, aur beshak jis din Uthman (RA) qatl kiye gaye, meri aqal ghum ho gayi thi aur main apne aap ko na-pasand karne laga tha, aur logon ne mujhse baiyat ki darkhwaast ki, to maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe Allah se sharam aati hai ke main un logon se baiyat karoon jinhone aise shakhs ko qatl kiya jiske baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya tha: 'Kya main us shakhs se sharam na karoon jisse farishte sharm karte hain?' aur mujhe Allah se sharam aati hai ke main baiyat karoon jabke Uthman (RA) zameen par qatl pade hain, abhi tak dafan nahi huay." To woh wapas chale gaye, jab unhein dafan kar diya gaya, to log mere paas wapas aaye aur mujhse baiyat maangi, maine kaha: "Aye Allah, main is baare mein jo mein karne ja raha houn usse dara hua houn," phir mere dil mein aik pukka iraada aaya, to maine baiyat kar li. To unhone kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen," to goya mera dil phat gaya, aur maine kaha: "Aye Allah, Uthman (RA) ke haq mein mujhse le le yahan tak ke tu raazi ho jaaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "On the day of Al-Jamal (Battle of the Camel), I went out to see the corpses. Ali ibn Abi Talib, Al-Hasan ibn Ali, Ammar ibn Yasir, Muhammad ibn Abu Bakr, and Zaid ibn Suhana were walking amongst the corpses. Al-Hasan ibn Ali noticed a dead body with his face covered. He turned it over and screamed, then said, 'Indeed, we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.' Quraish rejoiced and Abu Bakr's father asked him, 'Who is it, my son?' He replied, 'It is Muhammad ibn Talha ibn Ubaydullah.' His father said, 'Indeed, by Allah, he was a righteous young man, then he became sad and sorrowful.' Al-Hasan said to him, 'O father, I used to dissuade you from going on this journey, but so-and-so and so-and-so convinced you against my advice.' He replied, 'That is true, my son, and if I could have chosen, I would have preferred to die twenty years before this.' Muhammad ibn Hattab said, 'I stood up and said, O Amir al-Mu'minin (Commander of the Faithful), we are coming to Medina, and the people are asking us about Uthman, what should we say about him?' Ali ibn Abi Talib said to Ammar ibn Yasir and Muhammad ibn Abu Bakr, 'You both speak.' They spoke and Ali ibn Abi Talib said, 'O Ammar and Muhammad ibn Abu Bakr, you both claim that Uthman seized power and mismanaged the caliphate, and by Allah, you have also done wrong and will be held accountable for it. You will present yourselves before a fair judge who will pass judgment between you.' Then he said to Muhammad ibn Hattab, 'When you arrive in Medina and people ask you about Uthman, say, 'By Allah, he was among those who believed and did righteous deeds, then became cautious and believed, then became cautious and did good deeds. And Allah loves those who do good. So let the believers put their trust in Allah.'"
hi: Jab Jamal ka din hua, to main baahar nikla ke maqtoolon (halaak logon) ko dekhoon. Unhone kaha: to Ali (RA), Hasan bin Ali (RA), Ammar bin Yasir (RA), Muhammad bin Abi Bakr (RA), aur Zaid bin Suhaan maqtoolon mein ghoomte huay. Unhone kaha: to Hasan bin Ali (RA) ne aik maqtool ko unke chehre ke bal gira huay dekha, unhone use unki peeth par ulat diya, phir cheekh utthe aur kaha: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'oon, Quraish khush hongi, Allah ki qasam." To unke waalid (Ali RA) ne unse poocha: "Yeh kaun hai, mere bete?" Unhone kaha: "Muhammad bin Talhah bin Ubaidullah." To unhone kaha: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'oon, Allah ki qasam, yeh aik neik jawaan tha." Phir woh udaas aur ghamzada baith gaye. To Hasan (RA) ne unse kaha: "Aye abba, main aapko is safar se mana karta tha, magar fulan aur fulan ne aapki raay par ghalba paa liya." Unhone kaha: "Yeh sach hai, mere bete, aur kaash main isse bees (20) saal pehle mar jaata." Muhammad bin Hatib (RA) ne kaha: main khada hua aur kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, hum Madinah pahunchne wale hain, aur log humse Uthman (RA) ke baare mein poochenge, to hum unke baare mein kya kahein?" Unhone kaha: to Ammar bin Yasir (RA) aur Muhammad bin Abi Bakr (RA) ne baat ki aur (Uthman RA ke baare mein tanqeed) ki, to Ali (RA) ne unse kaha: "Aye Ammar aur Aye Muhammad, tum kehte ho ke Uthman (RA) ne khud-garzi ki aur khilafat mein burai ki, aur tumne (unhein) sazaa di, Allah ki qasam, tumne bhi sazaa mein zulm kiya, aur tum aik aise munsif faisla-kun ke paas jaaoge jo tumhare darmiyan faisla karega." Phir unhone kaha: "Aye Muhammad bin Hatib, jab tum Madinah pahuncho aur tumse Uthman (RA) ke baare mein poocha jaaye, to kehna: Allah ki qasam, woh un logon mein se the jo imaan laaye aur neik amal kiye, phir taqwa ikhtiyar kiya aur imaan laaye, phir taqwa ikhtiyar kiya aur achha kaam kiya, aur Allah achha karne walon se mohabbat karta hai, aur Allah hi par momino ko bharosa karna chahiye." Bashaar bin Musa Al-Khaffaaf kamzor (waah) hain.

e: [AI] "Afterwards, we found that this leadership was not given to us by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a specific succession that would be followed. However, we saw it being handed over to Abu Bakr, who established and maintained it. Then it was handed over to Umar, who also established and maintained it. Then time began to take its toll." This is an excerpt from Al-Dhahabi's summary.
hi: "Ammaa ba'd, is imaarat (hukumat) ke baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein koi khaas ahd nahi diya jiski pairavi ki jaaye, lekin humne isse apni raay se dekha, Abu Bakr (RA) khalifa muqarrar huay, to unhone (deen) qaayam rakha aur seedha rakha, phir Umar (RA) khalifa muqarrar huay, to unhone (deen) qaayam rakha aur seedha rakha, phir zamane ne apna paav jamaaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "[He] was with Ali at the Battle of Siffin, which witnessed the participation of 80 veterans of Badr and 250 individuals who pledged allegiance under the tree." This was deleted by Al-Dhahabi from the summary.
hi: "Ali (RA) ke sath Siffin mein assi (80) Badr walon aur do sau pachaas (250) un logon ne shirkat ki jinhone darakht ke neeche baiyat ki thi." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "The battle of Siffin witnessed alongside Ali" - The Gold eliminarion by Al Dhahabi from summarization.
hi: "Ali (RA) ke sath Siffin mein shirkat ki..." aakhir tak. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "Whoever separates themselves from them and follows this man, I will consider him one of those who have separated themselves. He said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: 'Whoever forsakes the community and seeks to establish his own authority, he will meet Allah and there will be no excuse for him.'" This statement was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summary."
hi: Unme se jo bhi is aadmi ki taraf nikal jaaye, main usse un logon mein giinta houn jo nikal gaye, unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jo jama'at se alag ho aur (apni alag) hukumat chaahe, woh Allah se milega aur uske paas koi hujjat nahi hogi." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "I would be delighted if I took my sword to kill Uthman, and indeed the world and everything in it is mine." - Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Mujhe khush nahi karega agar main apni talwaar Uthman (RA) ke qatl mein istemaal karta, chaahe mujhe poori duniya aur usme jo kuch hai woh mil jaaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Allah, the Exalted and Most High, has said: 'And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers on thrones facing each other.' (Al-Hijr 47)"- Al-Dhahabi remained silent and did not comment on this summarization.
hi: Allah, buzurg aur buland: "{Aur humne unke seenon mein jo kina tha usse nikaal diya, woh bhai-bhai bankar takhton par aamne-saamne baithe honge}" (Surah Al-Hijr 47). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan, the wife of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , sent a message to Abdullah ibn Abi Rabiah, the brother of Ayash ibn Abi Rabiah, informing him of the killing of Uthman. She sent him the shirt in which he was killed, and his clothes were stained with his blood. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  received the news, he went out to the people, ascended the pulpit, informed them of his killing, and spread his shirt over the pulpit. He wept, and the people wept with him. He began saying, 'A matter has come to me that brings distress to the people, brings tears to the eyes, and brings humility to life. It brings tears to the noble noses. The leader of the believers has suffered this calamity, and this calamity is like the breaking of mountains. It has caused a commotion among the people of Medina, a group of whom are murderers, and others who have abandoned him. I will mourn for Abu Amr with every lamentation and eulogy known to me, with tears flowing down my cheeks. I will not sleep until these people are arrested and the guilty ones are brought to justice.' He further said, 'I am not settled wherever I reside in a town while you are killed,' He then proceeded with those who were with him. When he approached Makkah, he fell from his riding animal and died."
hi: Ke Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ki biwi, ne Abdullah bin Abi Rabi'ah (RA), Ayyash bin Abi Rabi'ah (RA) ke bhai, ki taraf aik qaasid bheja taake unhein Uthman (RA) ke qatl ki khabar de, aur unhone unhein woh qamees bhi bheji jisme woh qatl huay the, aur unke kapde unke khoon se rangaye huay the. Jab qaasid unke paas pahuncha, to woh logon ke paas nikle aur mimbar par chadhe, unhein unki shahaadat ki khabar di, mimbar par unki qamees phailaayi, aur roye, aur log unke sath roye. Unhone (bahr At-Taweel mein) yeh shairi banaayi: "Mujhe aik aisi baat aayi jisme logon ke liye gham hai, aur jisme aankhon ke liye lamba rona hai, aur jisme zillat ke sath zindagi ka saaman hai, aur jisme naaqon ki jad kaatne wala amal hai, Ameer-ul-Momineen par museebat, aur is (waaqiye) se buland pahaad bhi hil jaate hain, Madinah mein aik giroh unpar tut pada, unme se aik giroh qaatil tha aur aik khaamosh raha, main Abu Amr par har talwaar aur har hathiyaar ke sath roungi jo zirah-poshon mein maujood hai, aur neend nahi jab tak qaum ko neze se qaid na kar diya jaaye aur gumraah logon se badla na le liya jaaye, aur main zinda rehte huay kisi bhi shehar mein nahi rahunga jahan main apna daaman kheenchoon jabke tum qatl ho chuke ho." Unhone kaha: to woh apne sath walon ke sath nikle, jab woh Makkah ke qareeb pahunche, to apni sawaari se gir kar faut ho gaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] And he said to the people of the house, "Do not kill them. May Allah forgive every person who did not fight. So how did you see Allah pour animosity and hatred upon them after communication? And how did you see good turn away from people like the wind turns away the caravans?" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Aur unhone ghar walon se kaha: "Unhein qatl mat karo, Allah har us shakhs ko maaf kare jisne jung nahi ki. To tumne kaise dekha ke Allah ne unpar dushmani aur nafrat daal di ba'ad is ke ke woh aapas mein jude huay the, aur tumne kaise dekha ke bhalaai unke baad logon se aise peeth pher gayi jaise tez hawaayen peeth pherti hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Concerning Uthman, what was written on the seal of his ring? He said, "Surely, written on the seal of his ring was a sincere intent, 'O Allah, grant me a blessed life and make my death as a martyr.' By Allah, he indeed lived a blessed life and died as a martyr." Al-Dhahabi excluded it from his summary due to its weakness.
hi: Uthman (RA) ke baare mein poocha gaya: "Unki mohar ke nagine par kya likha tha?" Unhone kaha: "Unki mohar ke nagine par unke sachhe iraade se likha tha: 'Aye Allah, mujhe khush-naseeb zinda rakh aur shaheed hokar wafaat de,' aur Allah ki qasam, woh khush-naseebi se jiye aur shahaadat se faut huay." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "Ali said, 'Live with me or be silent, for by Allah, you will not ask me about anything except that I will inform you.' So Zaid said, 'I adjure you by Allah, did you kill Uthman?' So Ali remained silent for a while, then he said, 'By the One who split the seed and created the breeze, I did not kill him nor did I command his killing.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Khaamosh raho ya sukoon rakho, Allah ki qasam, tum mujhse jo bhi poochoge main tumhein bataaunga." To Zaid (RA) ne kaha: "Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta houn, kya tumne Uthman (RA) ko qatl kiya?" To Ali (RA) thodi der khamosh rahe, phir farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne daane ko phaada aur jaan banaayi, na maine unhein qatl kiya na maine unke qatl ka hukum diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And Al-Walid ibn Uqbah [Al-Bahr Al-Tawil] said: Indeed, the best of people after their Prophet is the killer of Al-Tujibi, who came from Egypt. By Al-Tujibi, he meant the killer of Uthman, as Al-Dhahabi stated in summarizing it."
hi: Aur Al-Waleed bin Uqbah ne (bahr At-Taweel mein) kaha: "Khabardaar, logon mein sabse behtareen unke Nabi ke baad, us Tujeebi ka qaatil hai jo Misr se aaya" - unka matlab At-Tujeebi se Uthman (RA) ke qaatil se tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] “He proposed to his daughter, but she rejected him. He informed the Prophet ﷺ about this. When Umar went to the Prophet ﷺ, he said, 'O Umar, should I guide you towards a marriage that is better for you than with Uthman, and I guide Uthman towards a marriage that is better for him than with you?' Umar said, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Marry my daughter and I will marry your daughter to Uthman.'"
hi: Ke unhone Umar (RA) ki beti se nikah ka paighaam bheja, unhone unhein mana kar diya, yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi. Jab Umar (RA) unke paas gaye, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Umar, kya main tumhein aik aisa damaad na bataaun jo Uthman (RA) se tumhare liye behtar ho, aur Uthman (RA) ko aik aisa (sasural) na bataaun jo tumse unke liye behtar ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni beti ka nikah mujhse kar do, aur main apni beti ka nikah Uthman (RA) se kar dunga."

e: [AI] Uthman bin Affan bought the garden from the Prophet peace be upon him, twice the price of its value, where he dug the well of Maunah and where he prepared the army of Usrah. This narration is authentic and was not mentioned by Isa bin Musa, Abu Dawood and others weakened it.
hi: Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se Jannat do martaba haq ka sauda karke khareedi - jab unhone Bi'r Ma'oonah khodi aur jab unhone Lashkar-e-Usrah taiyaar kiya. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Isa bin Al-Musayyab ko Abu Dawud aur doosron ne kamzor kaha hai.

e: [AI] "To travel to Sham (Syria) towards Siffin and the palm trees gathered until they entered upon Ashtr's house. He said, 'Is there anything in this house except for my palm trees?' They replied, 'No.' He said, 'Indeed, this nation has inclined towards the goodness of its people, and they killed him' meaning Uthman. 'And we fought the people of Basra due to a pledge that we interpreted differently. And you are heading towards a people who do not have a pledge with us, so let every man consider where he places his sword.'"
hi: Ke woh Sham (Syria) ki taraf, Siffin, chalein, aur Nakha' qabile ke log jama huay yahan tak ke woh Al-Ashtar ke ghar mein dakhil huay, unhone poocha: "Kya ghar mein sirf Nakha'i (log) hain?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Beshak is Ummat ne apne behtareen ahl ki taraf iraada kiya aur unhein qatl kar diya," yani Uthman (RA), "aur humne Basrah walon se aik baiyat ki bina par jung ki jiski humne ta'weel ki, aur tum aik aisi qaum ki taraf ja rahe ho jinpar humari koi baiyat nahi, isliye har aadmi dekhe woh apni talwaar kahan rakhta hai."

e: [AI] I heard Ahmad bin Hanbal saying, "None of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  received the virtues that Ali bin Abi Talib received." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: Maine Ahmad bin Hanbal ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke kisi sahabi ke liye itni fazaail nahi aayi hain jitni Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke liye aayi hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Fatimah, the daughter of Asad son of Hashim, was the first Hashemite born from Hashim's family. She held a high position among the people during the time of the Prophet ﷺ. She passed away during the lifetime of the Prophet ﷺ, and he prayed for her. Her name was Ali, Asad, and because of that, the poem [Al-Bahr Ar-Rajz] says, "I am the one whom my mother called Haydar."
hi: Fatimah (RA) bint Asad bin Hashim pehli Hashmi khaatoon thin jo aik Hashmi se paida hui, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein buzurgon mein aik buland martaba rakhti thin, aur unka intiqaal Rasulullah (SAW) ki zindagi mein hua, aap (SAW) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi. Aur Ali (RA) ka naam "Asad" (sher) tha, isi liye woh kehte hain (bahr Ar-Rajz mein): "Main woh houn jise meri maa ne Haidar naam diya."

e: [AI] I heard Amir al-Mu'minin, Ali ibn Abi Talib, saying that when Fatimah bint Asad ibn Hashim died, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, shrouded her in his shirt, prayed upon her, and made seventy takbirat over her. He entered her grave and made his space in the grave seem as though it was spacious and level with her. He came out of her grave with his eyes shedding tears and his cheeks wet. When he returned, Umar ibn al-Khattab said, "O Messenger of Allah, I saw you do something for this woman that you did not do for anyone else." He said, "O Umar, this woman was my mother who gave birth to me. Abu Talib used to arrange banquets and invite people to his gatherings, and we would gather around his food. This woman would prefer me over everyone else and would give me a bigger portion. So, I reciprocate her favor. Indeed, Jibril, peace be upon him, informed me on behalf of my Lord, the Exalted and Mighty, that she is among the people of Paradise. And Jibril, peace be upon him, also informed me that Allah Almighty has commanded seventy thousand angels to pray upon her."
hi: Maine Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ko kehte suna: jab Fatimah (RA) bint Asad bin Hashim ka intiqaal hua, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein apni qamees mein kafan diya, unki namaz padhi, aur unpar sattar (70) takbeerein kahin, aur unki qabr mein utre, unhone qabr ke kinaron ko is tarah theek kiya jaise usse chaudha kar rahe hon aur usse hamwaar kar rahe hon, aur unki qabr se nikle jabke unki aankhein aansoo baha rahi thin, aur unki qabr mein mitti daali. Jab woh jaane lage, to Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unse kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine dekha aapne is aurat ke sath aisa kuch kiya jo aapne kisi aur ke sath nahi kiya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Umar, yeh aurat meri woh maa thi jisne mujhe paala, Abu Talib khaana banaate aur unke paas dawat hoti, aur woh humein apne khaane par jama karte, to yeh aurat usme se sabse zyada hissa mujhe deti, isliye main iske badle mein aisa kar raha houn, aur Jibra'il (AS), unpar salaam ho, ne mujhe mere Rab, buzurg aur buland, ki taraf se khabar di ke woh Jannat waalon mein se hain, aur Jibra'il (AS) ne mujhe bataaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne sattar hazaar (70,000) farishton ko hukum diya ke woh unpar namaz padhein." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Muawiya said to Saad bin Abi Waqqas, "What prevents you from insulting Ibn Abi Talib?" Saad replied, "I do not insult what I mentioned three times, which the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said. It is more beloved to me than the red camels." Muawiya asked, "What are they, O Abu Ishaq?" Saad replied, "I do not insult him what I mentioned when the revelation came down upon him, and he took Ali and his two sons and Fatimah and hid them under his garment, then said, 'O Lord, these are the people of my household.' And I do not insult him what I mentioned when he left me behind in the Battle of Tabuk, which the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, led. Ali said to him, 'You left me with the children and women.' He replied, 'Do you not like to be to me like Aaron was to Moses, except that there is no prophethood after me?' And I do not insult him what I mentioned on the day of Khaybar, when the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'I will give this banner to a man who loves Allah and His Messenger, and whom Allah will grant victory through his hands.' So, we rushed towards the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and he asked, 'Where is Ali?' They told him that he had sore eyes. He said, 'Call him.' When Ali came, the Prophet spat in his face and then gave him the banner. Allah granted him victory. I swear by Allah, Muawiya did not mention anything correctly until he left the city."
hi: Mu'awiyah (RA) ne Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) se kaha: "Tumhein Ibn Abi Talib ko bura-bhala kehne se kya rokta hai?" To unhone kaha: "Main use bura-bhala nahi kahunga jab tak mujhe teen baaten yaad hain jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke baare mein kahin, kyunke agar unme se aik bhi mujhe mil jaaye to mujhe surkh oonton se zyada aziz ho." Mu'awiyah (RA) ne unse poocha: "Woh kya hain, Aye Abu Ishaq?" Unhone kaha: "Main use bura-bhala nahi kahunga jab mujhe yaad hai ke jab unpar wahi nazil hui, to unhone Ali (RA), unke dono betay, aur Fatimah (RA) ko liya aur unhein apne kapde ke neeche kar liya, phir farmaya: 'Aye Rab, yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain.' Aur main use bura-bhala nahi kahunga jab mujhe yaad hai ke unhone Ghazwa Tabuk mein unhein peeche chhoda jise Rasulullah (SAW) ne khud lada, to Ali (RA) ne unse kaha: 'Aap ne mujhe auraton aur bachchon ke sath peeche chhod diya?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Kya tum raazi nahi ke tum mujhse waisi hi manzil par ho jaisi Harun (AS) Musa (AS) se the, siwaye is ke ke mere baad koi Nubuwwat nahi?' Aur main use bura-bhala nahi kahunga jab mujhe Khaibar ke din yaad hai, Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Main zaroor yeh jhanda aise aadmi ko dunga jo Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hai, aur Allah uske haathon fatah dega.' To humne Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf gardanein utha kar dekha, aap (SAW) ne poocha: 'Ali (RA) kahan hain?' Kaha gaya: 'Unki aankhein dukh rahi hain.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Unhein bulaao.' To unhein bulaaya gaya, aap (SAW) ne unke chehre par thooka, phir unhein jhanda diya, to Allah ne unke haathon fatah di." Unhone kaha: to Allah ki qasam, Mu'awiyah (RA) ne unka naam (Ali RA ka) aik lafz bhi nahi liya yahan tak ke woh Madinah se nikal gaye.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned from the Farewell Pilgrimage and camped at Ghadir Khumm, he ordered for a pulpit to be set up. Then he said, 'It seems that I have been called, and I have responded. I have left among you two weighty things: the Book of Allah, the Almighty and my progeny. Look carefully at how you will treat them after me, for they will never separate until they meet me at the Pool.' The narration is abbreviated by Al-Dhahabi."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Hajjat-ul-Wida se wapas laute aur Ghadeer Khumm mein utre, to unhone bade darakhton (ki safaai) ka hukum diya, unhein saaf kiya gaya, phir farmaya: "Goya mujhe bulaaya gaya hai aur maine jawaab de diya hai, main tum mein do bhaari cheezein chhod raha houn, jinme se aik doosri se badi hai - Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab, aur meri itrat (Ahl-e-Bait), isliye dekho tum mere baad in dono ke sath kaisa sulook karte ho, kyunke woh dono kabhi juda nahi honge yahan tak ke Hauz (Kauthar) par mujhse aa milein." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein ise mukhtasar kiya.

e: [AI] "He (Zaid ibn Arqam) heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  camped between Makkah and Madinah near five planted palm trees on the day when the bones are disintegrated. The people swept the area under the trees, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  offered the evening prayer, stood up to deliver a sermon, praised Allah, glorified Him, and delivered a sermon. He said, 'Whatever Allah willed I uttered, and he continued, 'O people! I am leaving behind two things, and you will never go astray as long as you hold fast to them: the Book of Allah and my family, the people of my household.' Muhammad ibn Salamah ibn Kuhayl narrated this, and As-Sa'di further explained it."
hi: Ke unhone Zaid bin Arqam (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan, paanch bade darakhton ke paas utre, log unke neeche ki jagah saaf karne lage, phir Rasulullah (SAW) shaam ko nikle, namaz padhi, phir khutba dene khade huay, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, zikr kiya aur naseehat ki, jitna Allah ne chaaha kaha, phir farmaya: "Aye logo, main tum mein do cheezein chhod raha houn, agar tum unki pairavi karo to kabhi gumraah nahi hoge, aur woh hain Allah ki Kitaab aur mere Ahl-e-Bait, meri itrat." Muhammad bin Salamah bin Kuhail ke liye dono ne nahi nikaala, aur As-Sa'di ne isse kamzor kaha hai.

e: I fought along with ʿAlī to Yemen and I sensed estrangement from him. Then I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and mentioned ʿAlī and talked down about him. I then saw the ˹color˺ on the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ change and he said, "O Buraydah, am I not more prefered to the believers than themselves?" I said, "Yes O Messenger of Allah." He then said, "For whomever I am his mawlá (leader), then ʿAlī is his mawlá." and he mentioned the ḥadīth.[^1]
hi: Main Ali (RA) ke sath Yemen ki jung mein gaya, maine unme aik sakhti (tursh-mizaaji) mahsoos ki, to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur Ali (RA) ka zikr kiya aur unki kami bayaan ki, to maine dekha Rasulullah (SAW) ka chehra badal gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Buraidah, kya main momino ke apne aap se zyada haqdaar nahi houn?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiska main mawla (wali/madadgaar) houn, uska Ali bhi mawla hai," aur hadith zikr ki.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dispatched an army and he put 'Ali bin Abi Talib in charge of it. He left on the expedition and he entered upon a female slave. So four of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ scolded him, and they made a pact saying: "[If] we meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we will inform him of what 'Ali did." When the Muslims returned from the journey, they would begin with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and give him Salam, then they would go to their homes. So when the expedition arrived, they gave Salam to the Prophet ﷺ, and one of the four stood saying: "O Messenger of Allah! Do you see that 'Ali bin Abi Talib did such and such." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from him. Then the second one stood and said as he said, and he turned away from him. Then the third stood before him, and said as he said, and he turned away from him. Then the fourth stood and said as they had said. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ faced him, and the anger was visible on his face, he said: "What do you want from 'Ali?! What do you want from 'Ali?! What do you want from 'Ali?! Indeed 'Ali is from me, and I am from him, and he is the ally of every believer after me." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3712)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik lashkar (dasta) bheja, aur unpar Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ko ameer banaaya, to Ali (RA) us lashkar mein gaye, unhone aik laundi haasil ki, to logon ne unpar isse aitraaz kiya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se chaar logon ne aapas mein ahd kiya: "Jab hum Nabi (SAW) se milein, to hum unhein bataayenge Ali (RA) ne kya kiya." Imran (RA) ne kaha: aur Musalman jab kisi safar se aate, to sabse pehle Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas jaate, unhein dekhte aur unhein salaam karte, phir apne khaimon ki taraf laut jaate. Jab lashkar aaya, to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko salaam kiya, to chaar mein se aik khada hua aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aapko pata nahi ke Ali (RA) ne aisa-aisa kiya?" Aap (SAW) ne unse mun pher liya. Phir doosra khada hua aur wohi baat kahi, to aap (SAW) ne unse bhi mun pher liya. Phir teesra khada hua aur wohi baat kahi, to aap (SAW) ne unse bhi mun pher liya. Phir chautha khada hua aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aapko pata nahi ke Ali (RA) ne aisa-aisa kiya?" To Rasulullah (SAW) unki taraf mudhe, unke chehre par ghussa tha, farmaya: "Tum Ali (RA) se kya chahte ho? Beshak Ali mujhse hai aur main unse houn, aur woh har momin ka wali hai."

e: [AI] "Regarding him, Al-Dhahabi in summary."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "Ali converted to Islam when he was either ten years old or sixteen years old. This chain of narration is more reliable than the previous one, and I have mentioned it because it was overlooked by Al-Dhahabi in his summarization."
hi: "Ali (RA) Musalman huay jabke woh das (10) ya solah (16) saal ke thay." Yeh isnad pehle wale se behtar hai, aur maine isse isliye pehle rakha hai kyunke isme maine aik uchi sanad paayi hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Ali has four qualities that no one else possesses. He is the first Arab and non-Arab to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He is the one whose flag was with him in every battle, and the one who showed patience with him on the day of Mihraj. He is the one who washed him and buried him in his grave. In it, Zakaria son of Yahya al-Waqar testifies against him, and he is accused.
hi: Ali (RA) ke liye chaar khoobiyaan hain jo kisi aur ke paas nahi - woh pehle Arab aur ghair-Arab hain jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath namaz padhi, aur unka jhanda har jung mein unke sath tha, aur woh Al-Mihras ke din unke sath sabr karte rahe, aur woh hain jinhone unhein ghusl diya aur unki qabr mein dakhil kiya. Isme Zakariya bin Yahya Al-Waqqar hain aur unpar shubha hai.

e: [AI] "On the day of Badr, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, entrusted the flag to Ali, who was twenty years old."
hi: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din Ali (RA) ko jhanda diya jabke woh bees (20) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] "I am Abdullah, the slave of Allah, and the brother of His Messenger. I am the greatest Siddiq (truthful one). No one can say this after me except as a liar. I prayed before the people for seven years before anyone of this Ummah worshiped Allah." This is a false Hadith, so reflect upon it.
hi: "Main Allah ka banda aur uske Rasool ka bhai houn, aur main sabse bada Siddiq houn, mere baad koi jhoota hi yeh kahega, maine logon se saat (7) saal pehle namaz padhi, is Ummat ke kisi bhi shakhs ke Allah ki ibaadat karne se pehle." Yeh hadith baatil (jhoot) hai, isspar ghaur karo.

e: [AI] I worshipped Allah with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  for seven years before anyone from this nation worshipped him. And this is false.
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath saat (7) saal Allah ki ibaadat ki, is Ummat ke kisi bhi shakhs ke Allah ki ibaadat karne se pehle." Yeh baatil hai.

e: [AI] Abu Dhar and Nuaim ibn Amr ibn Abu Dhar and I set out together in search of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  who was in the valley (of Mecca). Abu Dhar said to him: O Messenger of Allah, we have come to listen to what you say and to respond to your call. Upon hearing this, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and I am the Messenger of Allah." Abu Dhar and his companion believed in him and I too believed in him. Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) was in need of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  so he sent him (to the valley). On that day, the revelation was sent down to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Ali prayed on Tuesday. This is an authentic narration and it has not been narrated by anyone else.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA), unke chachere bhai Nu'aim (RA), aur main unke sath, hum Rasulullah (SAW) ko dhoond rahe the, jabke woh pahaad mein chhupe huay the, Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Muhammad, hum aapke paas aaye hain taake sunein aap kya kehte hain aur kis taraf bulaate hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main kehta houn: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main Allah ka Rasool houn." To Abu Dharr (RA) aur unka saathi unpar imaan laaye, aur main bhi unpar imaan laaya. Aur Ali (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki kisi zaroorat mein the jise unhone unhein bheja tha, aur Rasulullah (SAW) par Peer ke din wahi nazil hui, aur Ali (RA) ne Mangalvaar ke din namaz padhi. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ prophesied on Monday and Ali converted to Islam on Tuesday. Az-Zahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ko Peer ke din Nabi banaakar bheja gaya, aur Ali (RA) ne Mangalvaar ke din Islam qubool kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Ali was killed on Friday, the seventeenth night of the past month of Ramadan in the year forty (AH). His caliphate lasted five years except for three months. He was killed by Abdurrahman ibn Muljam al-Muradi on the same day Ibn Thalathin (Uthman) was killed, at the age of sixty-three or sixty-four."
hi: "Ali (RA) Jumme ke din qatl kiye gaye, Ramzan ki satrah (17) raatein guzarne par, chaalis (40) hijri mein, aur unki khilafat paanch (5) saal se teen (3) mahine kam thi. Unhein Abdur Rahman bin Muljam Al-Muraadi ne qatl kiya, aur woh us din tirsath (63) ya chausath (64) saal ke thay." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "I heard Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah say, 'Ali ibn Abi Talib was my guardian for five years. He was martyred in the year forty of the Hijra of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the age of sixty-three. He was killed on a Friday, the twenty-first day of Ramadan, and he passed away on a Sunday. He was buried in Kufa.'" (This part has been omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summary due to its weakness)
hi: Maine Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaibah ko kehte suna: "Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ne paanch (5) saal hukumat ki, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki hijrat ke chaalis (40) saal baad qatl kiye gaye, jabke woh tirsath (63) saal ke thay, unhein Jumme ke din, Ramzan ki ikkis (21) tareekh ko qatl kiya gaya, aur unka intiqaal Itwaar ke din hua, aur unhein Kufa mein dafan kiya gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] He returned with complaints that were bothering him. I said to him, "We were concerned for you, O Amir al-Mu'minin, regarding your complaint." He replied, "But I swear by Allah, I was not concerned for myself because I heard the truthful and trusted Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'You will be struck with a blow here and a blow there,' pointing to his temples, 'and blood will flow from them until it stains your beard, and the one who causes it will be more miserable than the barren she-camel of Thamud.'"
hi: Ke woh Ali (RA) ki tabiyat kharabi mein unse milne gaye, unhone kaha: to maine unse kaha: "Humein aapki is bimaari mein aapke liye darr tha, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen." To unhone kaha: "Lekin mujhe, Allah ki qasam, khud apni jaan ka koi darr nahi tha, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW), sachhe aur tasdeeq-shuda, ko farmate suna: 'Tumhein yahan aik zarb lagegi aur yahan aik zarb lagegi,' aur unhone apni dono kanpatiyon ki taraf ishara kiya, 'to iska khoon bahega yahan tak ke tumhari daadhi rang jaayegi, aur iska maartay wala sabse badnaseeb hoga, jaise oontni ko maarne wala Thamud ka sabse badnaseeb tha.'"

e: [AI] "I arrived in Damascus wanting to conquer, so I went to greet Abd al-Malik to convert to Islam. I found him in a dome, on a bed near the Qa'im, with two mats underneath. I greeted him and then I sat down. He said to me, 'O son of Shihab, do you know what happened in the morning at the Al-Aqsa Mosque where Ali ibn Abi Talib was killed?' I replied, 'Yes.' He then said, 'Come with me.' I stood up from behind the people and followed him behind the dome. He turned his face towards me and leaned towards me and asked, 'What happened?' I replied, 'Not a stone was lifted at the Al-Aqsa Mosque without finding blood underneath it.' He said, 'No one besides me and you knows this, and no one should hear it from you.' So, I did not speak of it until he passed away."
hi: Main Dimashq (Damascus) pahuncha jabke main jung mein jaane ka iraada rakhta tha, to main Abdul Malik ke paas salaam karne gaya, maine unhein aik gumbad mein bistar par paaya, khambe ke qareeb, aur unke neeche do dastarkhwaan the, maine salaam kiya, phir baith gaya, to unhone mujhse poocha: "Aye Ibn Shihaab, kya tumhein pata hai us subah Bait-ul-Maqdis mein kya hua jab Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) qatl kiye gaye?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Aao." To main logon ke peechhe se uthkar gumbad ke peechhe pahuncha, unhone apna chehra meri taraf mudka aur mere qareeb jhuk gaye, poocha: "Kya hua tha?" Maine kaha: "Bait-ul-Maqdis se koi bhi patthar nahi uthaaya gaya jiske neeche khoon na paaya gaya ho." Unhone kaha: "Mere aur tumhare siwa koi aur yeh nahi jaanta, koi tumse yeh na sune." To maine yeh baat kisi se nahi ki yahan tak ke unka intiqaal ho gaya. Yeh riwayat mursal hai.

Mujhe Abu Sa'eed Ahmad bin Muhammad Al-Ahmasi ne khabar di, humein Al-Husain bin Hameed bin Ar-Rabi' ne hadith bayan ki, humein Al-Husain bin Ali As-Sulami ne hadith bayan ki, mujhse mere chacha Muhammad bin Hassaan ne hadith bayan ki, humein Al-Hasan bin Ziyad ne hadith bayan ki, Abu Ma'shar se, unhone Shurahbil bin Sa'd Al-Qurashi se, unhone kaha: "Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) pantees (35) hijri mein khalifa muqarrar huay jabke woh athaawan (58) saal aur kuch mahine ke thay, jab pantees (35) hijri ka mausam (Hajj) aaya, to unhone Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ko mausam par (ameer) bheja, pantees (35), saintees (37), aur aththaisis (38) hijri mein, aur mausam mein khud maujood the, aur Ali (RA) jung mein masroof rahe, to logon ne Shaibah bin Uthman Al-Hajabi par ittefaaq kiya, unhone logon ke sath (Hajj mein) shirkat ki. Jab chaalis (40) hijri aayi, to Ali (RA) Jumme ke din, Ramzan ki satrah (17) raatein guzarne par, qatl kiye gaye, jabke woh tirsath (63) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The lifespan of Islam is based on thirty-five or thirty-six years. If they are destroyed, then the way of those who perished remains as a guidance. But if their religion remains, it will last for seventy years." Umar asked, "O Messenger of Allah, by what is left or what has passed?" He replied, "By what is left."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Islam ki chakki paintees (35) ya chattis (36) saal ke baad ghoomegi, agar woh halaak ho gaye, to woh unka raasta hoga jo halaak huay, aur agar unka deen baaqi raha, to sattar (70) saal tak." Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), jo baaqi hai usse ya jo guzar chuka usse?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo baaqi hai usse."

e: [AI] Uthman was buried and then he was pledged allegiance on the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  openly. Talhah was the first to pledge allegiance to him, he said, "This allegiance will not be broken."
hi: Ke Uthman (RA) ko dafan kiya gaya, phir unse Rasulullah (SAW) ke mimbar par khule taur par baiyat li gayi, aur sabse pehle jinhone unse baiyat ki woh Talhah (RA) the, unhone kaha: "Yeh aik aisi baiyat hai jo todi jayegi."

e: [AI] When Ali ibn Abi Talib was given the oath of allegiance on the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , Khuzaymah ibn Thabit, who was standing in front of the pulpit, said, "When we pledged allegiance to Ali, we considered Abu Hasan sufficient for us to protect us from turmoil. We found him to be the most deserving of the people with the people, as he was the most knowledgeable about the Book and the traditions. Indeed, Quraysh does not suffer from any harm when it follows its own path, and in Ali, there is all the good that is among them and none of the bad." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in summary.
hi: Jab Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) se Rasulullah (SAW) ke mimbar par baiyat li gayi, to Khuzaimah bin Thabit (RA), jo mimbar ke saamne khade the, ne kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Jab humne Ali (RA) se baiyat ki, to humein Abu Hasan hi kaafi hain un fitno se jinka humein darr hai, humne unhein logon mein logon ke liye sabse haqdaar paaya, kyunke woh Kitaab aur Sunnaton mein Quraish se sabse zyada mahir hain, aur beshak Quraish unki gard bhi nahi udaa sakti jab woh kisi din mazboot jism ke sath daudein, aur unme woh sab bhalaai hai jo unme (Quraish mein) hai, aur unme jo bhalaai hai woh sab kuch unme (Quraish mein) nahi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When the Bay'ah (pledge of allegiance) of Ali came to Hudayfah, he said, "I will not pledge allegiance to anyone after him except As'ar or Abtar."
hi: Jab Ali (RA) ki baiyat Hudhaifah (RA) tak pahunchi, to unhone kaha: "Unke baad main sirf aise (aadmi) se baiyat karunga jo ya to Asa'r (tiraaha) ho ya Abtar (be-aulaad/kata hua)."

e: [AI] "I saw Ali riding on a worn-out camel with a cloak wrapped around him, and he was saying to Hasan and Husain, 'Why do you not yearn for the call of a young girl? By Allah, I have never encountered a situation that required fighting against people or rejecting what was revealed to Muhammad ﷺ.' Al-Dhahabi excluded this narration from his summary due to its weakness."
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko Rabza mein aik phate-purane kaathe par dekha, woh Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA) se keh rahe the: "Tumhein kya hua ke tum aik laundi ki tarah aaha-bhari kar rahe ho? Allah ki qasam, maine is maamle ko har taraf se parkha, magar mujhe is qaum se jung karne ke ilawa koi chaara na mila, warna Muhammad (SAW) par jo nazil kiya gaya usse kufr karna padta." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e:
[AI] "O Abu Abdurrahman, I swear by Allah that I have always wanted to imitate your smile and follow your actions in dealing with people. I distance myself from evil as much as I can. There is a verse from the Book of Allah that has deeply affected my heart. Please tell me your thoughts on it.
