It is the verse of Allah Almighty that says: 'And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.' (Quran 49:9)

Abdullah replied, "What do you want from me regarding this?" So, I left him and he departed until he was out of sight. Abdullah bin Umar came to us and said, "I have found something within myself concerning this verse. I felt that I should not fight against this rebellious faction, as Allah Almighty commanded." This is a significant narrative narrated from Abdullah bin Umar by a group of prominent Tabi'een. I have presented the hadith of Shu'ayb bin Abi Hamza, narrated by Az-Zuhri, and I have focused on it because it meets the conditions of both Al-Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, main, Allah ki qasam, chahta houn ke main aapke tareeqe par chaloon aur logon ke ikhtilaaf ke maamle mein aapki pairavi karoon aur jitna mumkin ho buraai se bachoon, aur main Allah ki Kitaab ki aik mohkam ayat padhta houn jisne mere dil ko pakad liya hai, isliye mujhe iske baare mein bataayen. Kya aapne Allah, buzurg aur buland, ka yeh farmaan dekha: '{Aur agar momino ke do giroh aapas mein ladein, to unke darmiyan sulah karo, phir agar aik giroh doosre par zulm kare, to us zulm karne wale giroh se jung karo yahan tak ke woh Allah ke hukum ki taraf laut aaye, phir agar woh laut aaye to unke darmiyan insaaf ke sath sulah karo aur adal karo, beshak Allah insaaf karne walon ko pasand karta hai}' (Surah Al-Hujurat 9), mujhe is ayat ke baare mein bataayen." To Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: "Tumhein isse kya lena-dena hai? Mujhse door raho." To woh chala gaya yahan tak ke uska saayah humse chhup gaya. To Abdullah bin Umar (RA) humari taraf mudhe aur kaha: "Mujhe is ayat ke maamle mein apne dil mein utni koi baat nahi mili jitni yeh baat mili ke maine is zulm karne wale giroh se jung nahi ki jaise Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne mujhe hukum diya tha." Yeh aik bada baab hai jise Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se Tabi'een ke buzurgon ke giroh ne riwayat kiya hai, aur maine Shu'aib bin Abi Hamzah ki Az-Zuhri se riwayat ko is liye pehle rakha hai kyunke yeh Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me on a military expedition with a group of his companions. I competed with a man from the Ansar in hastening towards the enemy. I mounted my horse and as I approached the enemy, the man raised his voice in takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar, meaning "Allah is the Greatest"). I attacked him and killed him. Later, I realized that he only said takbeer to protect himself, but it did not stop me from killing him. When we returned, I went ahead to the Prophet ﷺ  and he asked me, "What did you do today, O Usama?" I replied, "I attacked a man who raised his voice in takbeer, thinking he did so to protect himself." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "How can you bear to kill him after he said 'Allahu Akbar'? Did you not separate his heart from his body?" I said, "What he said did not deter me." After that day, the Prophet ﷺ  kept repeating to me, "I will not fight against a person who says 'Allahu Akbar' more than anything else he says until I meet him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe aik lashkar mein bheja, unke kuch sahaba ke sath, humne aur Ansar ke aik aadmi ne dushman ki taraf daud lagaayi, maine aik aadmi par hamla kiya, jab main uske qareeb pahuncha, to usne takbeer kahi, maine use bhaala maara aur qatl kar diya, aur maine socha ke usne yeh sirf apna khoon bachaane ke liye kiya, jab hum wapas laute, to (Ansar ka aadmi) Nabi (SAW) ke paas mujhse pehle pahuncha aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), koi bhi sawaar aapke sawaar se behtar nahi, humne aik aadmi ko rok liya, to woh mujhse pehle uske paas pahuncha, usne takbeer kahi, magar isne usse rokne ki koi wajah nahi banayi aur usse qatl kar diya." To Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Usamah, tumne aaj kya kiya?" Maine kaha: "Maine aik aadmi par hamla kiya, usne takbeer kahi, maine socha usne yeh sirf apna khoon bachaane ke liye kiya, to maine usse qatl kar diya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "'La ilaha illallah' kehne ke baad kaise (qatl kiya)? Kya tumne uska dil cheer kar dekha tha ke usne sach kaha ya jhoot?" Aap (SAW) yeh baat us din mujhse baar-baar kehte rahe, isliye main us aadmi se kabhi jung nahi karunga jo "Allahu Akbar" kahe, is baat ki wajah se jisse aap (SAW) ne mujhe mana kiya, yahan tak ke main unse (Aakhirat mein) milun (SAW).

e: [AI] "About Al-Dhahabi in summarization."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "And a man said to him, 'Indeed, Ali is being neglected by you, while you have turned away from him.' So Saad said, 'By Allah, I have seen a view, and my opinion is that Ali ibn Abi Talib should be given three things. For me to be given one of them is dearer to me than the world and all that is in it.' The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said to him on the Day of Ghadeer Khumm after praising and glorifying Allah, 'Do you not know that I have more authority over the believers?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'O Allah, whomever I am their master, Ali is his master. O Allah, be a friend to his friends and an enemy to his enemies.' And he was brought on the day of Khaybar, while his eyes were ailing and he said, 'O Messenger of Allah, indeed my eyes are ailing.' The Prophet placed his spittle into his eyes and prayed for him, and his eyes were healed. Then he was martyred and Khaybar was conquered. The Prophet ﷺ brought out his uncle, Abbas, and others from the mosque and Abbas said to him, 'Are you expelling us while we are your family and your supporters, and you are leaving Ali behind?' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'I am not expelling you and leaving Ali behind, but it is Allah who has expelled you and brought Ali forth.' The ruler remained silent regarding its correction."
hi: Aik aadmi ne unse (Sa'd RA se) kaha: "Ali (RA) aapke baare mein bura kehte hain kyunke aap unse peeche reh gaye." To Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh aik raay thi jo maine banaayi, aur meri raay ghalat ho sakti hai, beshak Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ko teen (khoobiyaan) di gayin, agar unme se aik bhi mujhe di jaati, to mujhe woh duniya aur usme jo kuch hai usse zyada aziz hoti - Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ghadeer Khumm ke din, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ke baad, unse farmaya: 'Kya tumhein pata hai ke main momino ke apne aap se zyada haqdaar houn?' Humne kaha: 'Ji haan.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Allah, jiska main mawla houn, uska Ali bhi mawla hai, unse mohabbat karne wale se mohabbat kar, aur unse dushmani karne wale se dushmani kar.' Aur unhein Khaibar ke din laaya gaya jabke unki aankhein dukh rahi thin aur unhein kuch dikhaai nahi de raha tha, unhone kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), meri aankhein dukh rahi hain,' to aap (SAW) ne unki aankhon mein thooka aur unke liye dua ki, to unki aankhein kabhi nahi dukhin yahan tak ke unka intiqaal hua, aur unke haathon Khaibar fatah hui. Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne chacha Abbas (RA) aur doosron ko masjid se nikaal diya, to Abbas (RA) ne unse kaha: 'Aap humein nikalte hain jabke hum aapke qabile aur aapke chacha hain, aur Ali (RA) ko wahin rehne dete hain?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Maine nahi tumhein nikaala aur na hi maine unhein wahan rakha, balke Allah ne tumhein nikaala aur unhein wahan rakha.'" Al-Hakim ne iski sihat ke baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] "When Uthman was killed and Ali was elected, Abu Musa delivered a sermon while he was in Kufa, advising people against fighting and getting involved in strife. Ali then removed him from Kufa and sent Ammar ibn Yasir and Hasan ibn Ali to him. They also removed him and appointed Qarzah ibn Kaab as the governor. He continued to serve as the governor until Ali arrived from Basra several months later. Ali then removed him from his position upon his arrival. When Ali marched towards Siffin, he appointed Uqbah ibn Amr Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari as his deputy, upon his arrival from Siffin."

Note: The sentence at the end seems to be a separate line unrelated to the rest of the text and is attributed to Hitham ibn Adi, and it is not clear for this sentence to be included in the translation.
hi: "Jab Uthman (RA) qatl kiye gaye aur Ali (RA) se baiyat li gayi, to Abu Musa (RA), jo Kufa mein ameer thay, ne khutba diya aur logon ko jung aur fitne mein dakhil hone se mana kiya, to Ali (RA) ne unhein Kufa se Zi-Qaar se mauzool (bartaraf) kar diya, aur Ammar bin Yasir (RA) aur Hasan bin Ali (RA) ko unke paas bheja, to unhone unhein mauzool kar diya aur Qarazah bin Ka'b ko ameer muqarrar kiya, woh ameer rahe yahan tak ke Ali (RA) Basrah se kayi mahine baad wapas aaye, to woh (Ali RA) jab wapas aaye to unhein mauzool kar diya. Jab woh Siffin ki taraf gaye, to unhone Uqbah bin Amr Abu Mas'ood Al-Ansari (RA) ko apni jagah khalifa muqarrar kiya, jab woh Siffin se wapas aaye." Al-Haitham bin Adi matrook (chhoda hua) hain. Weak, Rejected.

e: [AI] "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari and Abu Masood Al-Badri entered upon Ammar while he was agitating the people. They said to him, 'We have not seen anything from you since you embraced Islam that we disliked more than your hastiness in this matter.' Ammar replied, 'I have not witnessed anything from the two of you since you embraced Islam that I disliked more than your delay in this matter.' Ammar then covered them with clothes and went out to perform the Friday prayer."
hi: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) aur Abu Mas'ood Al-Badri (RA) Ammar (RA) ke paas dakhil huay jabke woh logon ko (jung ke liye) uksaa rahe the, unhone unse kaha: "Jab se tumne Islam qubool kiya hai, humne is maamle mein jaldi karne se zyada napasand koi cheez tumse nahi dekhi." To Ammar (RA) ne kaha: "Jab se tum dono ne Islam qubool kiya hai, mujhe is maamle mein tumhare der karne se zyada napasand koi cheez tum dono se nahi dekhi." Unhone kaha: to Ammar (RA) ne unhein aik-aik joda kapda pehnaaya, aur Jumme ki namaz ke liye nikal gaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what should I do if the worshippers disagree?" He said, "Go out with your sword to the open area and strike it with it, then go back to your house until death or a wrongful hand reaches you."
hi: Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), namaz padhne walon mein ikhtilaaf ho jaaye to main kya karoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni talwaar lekar Harrah (patthareeli zameen) ki taraf nikal jaao aur usse (patthar par) maar do, phir apne ghar mein dakhil ho jaao yahan tak ke tumhein muqarrar maut aaye ya koi khaata-kaar haath (tumhein maar de)." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "He gifted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a sword from Najran. When he presented it to him, Muhammad ibn Maslamah gave it to him and said, 'Fight with this in the cause of Allah. When people start arguing, strike with it the stone, then enter your home and be a peaceful guardian until you are killed by the wrong hand or death comes to you as a judgment.'"
hi: Ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko Najran se aik talwaar tohfe mein di, jab woh unke paas pahunchi, to unhone woh Muhammad bin Maslamah (RA) ko de di aur farmaya: "Isse Allah ki raah mein jihad karo, phir jab logon ki gardanein ikhtilaaf mein aa jaayen, to isse patthar par maaro, phir apne ghar mein dakhil ho jaao aur pade rehne wale kambal ki tarah raho, yahan tak ke tumhein koi khaata-kaar haath qatl kar de ya tumhein muqarrar maut aaye."

e: [AI] "I heard Hassan saying: Talhah and Zubayr came to Basra, and the people asked them, 'Why did you come?' They replied, 'We are seeking revenge for the blood of Uthman.' Hassan said, 'Oh, glory be to Allah! Don't people have any common sense? Can't they say, 'By Allah, no one killed Uthman except you?' So when Ali came to Kufa, and people, who also lacked common sense, said to him, 'We swear by Allah, we did not assure your safety.'" (This is an excerpt from a conversation, and some details were omitted in the summarization by Al-Zuhri.)
hi: Maine Al-Hasan ko kehte suna: Talhah (RA) aur Zubair (RA) Basrah aaye, to logon ne unse poocha: "Aap kis liye aaye hain?" Unhone kaha: "Hum Uthman (RA) ke khoon ka mutaalba karte hain." Al-Hasan ne kaha: "Subhanallah, kya in logon ke paas aqal nahi thi ke woh kehte: Allah ki qasam, tumhare siwa kisi ne Uthman (RA) ko qatl nahi kiya?" Unhone kaha: aur jab Ali (RA) Kufa aaye, to kya un logon ke paas bhi aqal nahi thi ke woh kehte: Aye shakhs, hum, Allah ki qasam, tumhein zimmedaar nahi thehraate. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And I saw Talha, and he loved the gatherings the most, so he would excel in them. He would stroke his beard against his chest. I said to him, 'O Abu Muhammad, I see that you love the gatherings the most and you stroke your beard against your chest. If you dislike this matter, then leave it, as no one forces you to do it.' He said, 'O Alqamah bin Waqqas, do not blame me. We were once united like one hand against our enemies, but now we have become like two mighty mountains of iron, and one of us reaches out to his companion.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: Maine Talhah (RA) ko dekha, aur unhein sabse zyada aziz majlis woh thi jo khaali ho, aur woh apni daadhi apne seene par maar rahe the. Maine unse kaha: "Aye Abu Muhammad, main aapko dekh raha houn ke aapko sabse zyada aziz majlis woh hai jo khaali ho, aur aap apni daadhi apne seene par maar rahe hain, agar aap is maamle ko napasand karte hain to isse chhod dein, koi aapko isspar majboor nahi karta." Unhone kaha: "Aye Alqamah bin Waqqas, mujhe malaamat mat karo, hum kal aik dusre ke khilaaf aik haath the, aaj hum loha ke do pahaad ban gaye hain, jinme se har aik apne saathi ki taraf ghisatte huay chal raha hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "Allah restrained me with something that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When Kisra was destroyed, he said: 'Who did they have to succeed him?' They said: 'His daughter.' So the Prophet ﷺ said: 'A people will never succeed who give their leadership to a woman.'" He said: "So when 'Aishah arrived - meaning in Al-Basrah - I remembered the saying of Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so Allah restrained me by it." Abu Eisa said: This Hadith is [Hasan] Sahih. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2262)
hi: "Allah ne mujhe aik baat se bachaaya jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suni thi. Jab Kisra (Persia ka baadshah) faut hua, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: 'Unhone kisko khalifa banaaya?' Unhone kaha: 'Unki beti ko.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Woh qaum kabhi kaamyaab nahi hogi jinhone apna maamla aik aurat ke supurd kar diya.'" Unhone kaha: jab Aisha (RA) (Basrah) pahunchin, to mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ka yeh farmaan yaad aaya, to Allah ne mujhe isi ke zariye bachaaya. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "Regarding him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  mentioned the exit of some of the believing mothers, and Aisha laughed. He said, "Look, Hamiraa, that it may not be you." Then he turned to Ali and said, "If you are given any authority over her, be kind to her." Abdul Jabbar did not leave for him.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Ummahat-ul-Momineen mein se kisi aik ke (ghar se) nikalne ka zikr kiya, to Aisha (RA) hansne lagin, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Dekho, Aye Humairaa (mere aziz laal-si), kahin tum hi na ho." Phir Ali (RA) ki taraf mudhe aur farmaya: "Agar tumhein unke kisi maamle ka ikhtiyaar mile, to unke sath narmi karna." Abdul Jabbar ke liye dono ne nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] When Ali traveled to Basra, he visited Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , to bid her farewell. She said, "Keep the secret of Allah and seek His protection. By Allah, you are upon the truth, and the truth is with you. If it were not for the fact that I dislike disobeying Allah and His Messenger, he ﷺ  advised us to be in our houses, I would have accompanied you. However, I swear by Allah that I will send with you someone who is dearer to me and more precious to me than myself, my son Umar." "These three hadiths are all authentic according to the conditions of both Al-Bukhari and Muslim, and they did not exclude it."
hi: Jab Ali (RA) Basrah ki taraf chal pade, to woh Umm Salamah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ke paas unse vida lene gaye, unhone kaha: "Allah ki hifaazat aur uski panaah mein chaliye, Allah ki qasam, aap haq par hain aur haq aapke sath hai, aur agar mujhe Allah aur uske Rasool ki na-farmani karna napasand na hota, kyunke aap (SAW) ne humein apne gharon mein qaraar rehne ka hukum diya tha, to main aapke sath chalti, lekin Allah ki qasam, main aapke sath apna beta bhejungi, jo mujhe apni jaan se zyada aziz hai - mera beta Umar." Yeh teenon hadithen Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hain, dono ne inhein nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "Umar said, 'Stay in your home, for indeed you have joined the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in battle.' He repeated this to him, so Umar said to him for the third time or after it, 'Sit in your home. By Allah, I find that you and your companions will leave from the outskirts of Madinah and cause corruption among the companions of Muhammad ﷺ .'" (Authentic)
hi: Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Apne ghar mein baitho, kyunke tum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jung kar chuke ho." Unhone kaha: to unhone yeh baat dohraayi, to Umar (RA) ne teesri martaba ya uske baad unse kaha: "Apne ghar mein baitho, Allah ki qasam, mujhe Madinah ke kinare tumse aur tumhare saathiyon se yeh mehsoos ho raha hai ke tum nikal kar Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba par fasaad phailaoge." Sahih.

e: [AI] When Aisha reached some of the houses of the Bani 'Amir, the dogs barked at her. She asked, "What water is this?" They said, "It is Al-Hawab." Aisha said, "I think I should go back." Az-Zubair said, "No, do not turn back, and the people would see you and Allah will correct the matter between them." Aisha said, "I think I should go back." I heard Allah's Messenger ﷺ  saying, "How (regrettable) is the situation of one of you who is startled by the barking of a dog belonging to Al-Hawab (tribe)." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about a conclusion to this narration.
hi: Jab Aisha (RA) Banu Aamir ke kisi ilaaqe mein pahunchin, to kutte unpar bhaunkne lage, unhone poocha: "Yeh kaunsa paani hai?" Unhone kaha: "Al-Hawab." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai mujhe wapas jaana chahiye." To Zubair (RA) ne kaha: "Nahi, aage badhein, log aapko dekhenge aur Allah unke darmiyan sulah kara dega." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai mujhe wapas jaana chahiye, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Tum mein se kisi (biwi) ka kya haal hoga jab Al-Hawab ke kutte usspar bhaunkein?'" Adh-Dhahabi ne is riwayat ke natije ke baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: When we left Makkah, the daughter of Hamzah followed us, crying: O uncle, O uncle. I took her by the hand and gave her to Fatimah and said: Here is your cousin. When we came to Madinah, Jaʿfar, Zaid bin Harithah and I disputed concerning her, Jaʿfar said: She is the daughter of my paternal uncle and her maternal aunt is married to me - meaning Asma’ bint ʿUmais, Zaid said. She is the daughter of my brother. I said: I took her and she is the daughter of my paternal uncle. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “As for you, O Jaʿfar, you resemble me in appearance and attitude. As for you, O Ali, you are of me and I am of you. As for you, O Zaid, you are our brother and our freed slave. The girl should be with her maternal aunt, for the maternal aunt is [like] a mother.” I said: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, why donʿt you marry her? He said: ʿShe is the daughter of my brother through breastfeeding.“ (Using translation from Aḥmad 770)
hi: Jab hum Makkah se nikle, to Hamzah (RA) ki beti humare peechhe aayi, pukaarti huay: "Aye chacha, Aye chacha," to maine unka haath pakda aur unhein Fatimah (RA) ke supurd kiya, maine kaha: "Apni chachazaad behn ko sambhalo." Jab hum Madinah pahunche, to main, Zaid (RA), aur Ja'far (RA) unke baare mein jhagadne lage, maine kaha: "Maine unhein liya, aur woh meri chachazaad behn hain." Zaid (RA) ne kaha: "Woh meri bhatiji hain." Ja'far (RA) ne kaha: "Woh meri chachazaad behn hain, aur unki khaala meri biwi hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ja'far (RA) se farmaya: "Tum shakl aur akhlaaq mein mere jaisi ho," aur Zaid (RA) se farmaya: "Tum humare bhai aur humare aazaad kiye huay ho," aur mujhse farmaya: "Tum mujhse ho aur main tumse houn, isse iski khaala ke hawaale kar do, kyunke khaala bhi maa hoti hai." Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap unse nikah nahi karenge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh meri doodh-shareek bhatiji hain."

e: [AI] What will make me curse the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  among you? So I said, "I seek refuge in Allah or glory be to Allah or a similar word." She said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Whoever curses Ali has indeed cursed me.'"
hi: "Kya Rasulullah (SAW) ko tum mein bura-bhala kaha jaata hai?" To maine kaha: "Allah ki panaah," ya "Subhanallah," ya isi tarah ka koi lafz. To unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jisne Ali (RA) ko bura-bhala kaha, usne mujhe bura-bhala kaha.'"

e: [AI] I heard Abu Abdullah Al-Jadali say, "I performed Hajj when I was young, so I passed by the city and saw the people gathered in one place. I followed them and they entered the house of Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ . I heard her say, 'O Shabib ibn Rib'i, a man with a sharp and dry tongue answered her, 'Here I am, O my mother.' She said, 'Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  curse in your gathering?' He said, 'How is that?' She said, 'Ali ibn Abi Talib said, 'We say things that we desire worldly gain.' She continued, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Whoever curses Ali has cursed me, and whoever curses me has cursed Allah the Exalted.'"
hi: Maine Abu Abdullah Al-Jadali ko kehte suna: main Hajj karne gaya jabke main aik larka tha, main Madinah se guzra, achaanak log aik giroh mein the, main unke peechhe chala, woh Umm Salamah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ke paas dakhil huay, maine unhein kehte suna: "Aye Shabib bin Rib'i," to aik sakht-mizaaj aadmi ne unhein jawaab diya: "Labbaik, Aye Ammi (maa)." Unhone poocha: "Kya tumhari majlis mein Rasulullah (SAW) ko bura-bhala kaha jaata hai?" Usne poocha: "Woh kaise?" Unhone kaha: "Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ko." Usne kaha: "Hum kuch baaten kehte hain duniya ki khaatir." Unhone kaha: "To maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jisne Ali (RA) ko bura-bhala kaha, usne mujhe bura-bhala kaha, aur jisne mujhe bura-bhala kaha, usne Allah Ta'ala ko bura-bhala kaha.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: “Whoever obeys me, obeys Allah, And whoever disobeys me, disobeys Allah. Whoever obeys the ruler, obeys me, and whoever disobeys the ruler, disobeys me.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2859)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne meri itaa'at ki, usne Allah ki itaa'at ki, aur jisne meri na-farmani ki, usne Allah ki na-farmani ki, aur jisne Ali (RA) ki itaa'at ki, usne meri itaa'at ki, aur jisne Ali (RA) ki na-farmani ki, usne meri na-farmani ki."

e: [AI] "O enemy of Allah, you have harmed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Indeed, those who harm Allah and His Messenger, Allah curses them in this world and the Hereafter and has prepared for them a humiliating punishment." [Al-Ahzab 57] If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  were alive, you would harm him.
hi: "Aye Allah ke dushman, tumne Rasulullah (SAW) ko takleef pahunchaayi, {Beshak jo log Allah aur uske Rasool ko takleef pahunchaate hain, Allah unpar duniya aur Aakhirat mein la'nat karta hai, aur unke liye zaleel karne wala azaab taiyaar kar rakha hai} (Surah Al-Ahzab 57), agar Rasulullah (SAW) zinda hote, to tum unhein bhi takleef dete."

e: [AI] "We went with Ali to Yemen, and his long journey tired me until I found it in myself. When I arrived, I expressed my complaint to him in the mosque until the messenger of Allah ﷺ  was informed. I entered the mosque one morning and the messenger of Allah ﷺ  was with some of his companions. When he saw me, he fixed his gaze on me and said, 'He says he has a complaint against me.' So I sought refuge in Allah from causing harm to you, O Messenger of Allah. He said, 'Indeed, whoever harms Ali has harmed me.'"
hi: Hum Ali (RA) ke sath Yemen ki taraf nikle, unhone us safar mein mujhpar sakhti ki yahan tak ke mujhe apne dil mein bura laga, jab main wapas aaya, to maine masjid mein unki shikaayat zaahir ki yahan tak ke yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi. Unhone kaha: to main aik subah masjid mein dakhil hua jabke Rasulullah (SAW) apne kuch sahaba mein maujood the, jab unhone mujhe dekha, to unhone apni aankhein mujhpar gaadh din, unhone kaha: yeh keh rahe the ke unhone mujhpar apni nazar tez kar li, yahan tak ke jab main baitha, to unhone farmaya: "Aye Amr, Allah ki qasam, tumne mujhe takleef pahunchaayi hai." Maine kaha: "Main Allah ki panaah maangta houn ke main aapko takleef pahunchaaun, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kyun nahi, jisne Ali (RA) ko takleef di, usne mujhe takleef di."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said to Ali, "You will clarify for my nation what they differed about after me."
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (RA) se farmaya: "Tum meri Ummat ke liye woh cheezein saaf karoge jinme woh mere baad ikhtilaaf karengay." Fabricated.

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when his sandal broke, so Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) stayed behind to fix it. He walked a little and then said, "There are among you those who fight for the interpretation of the Quran as I fought for its revelation." The people eagerly asked who it was, including Abu Bakr and Umar. Abu Bakr said, "It is me." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "No." Umar said, "It is me." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "No, but it is the one who is fixing the sandal," referring to Ali. We went to him and gave him the glad tidings, but he did not raise his head, as if he had heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath the, to unki jooti tut gayi, Ali (RA) usse theek karne ke liye peechhe reh gaye, aap (SAW) thodi door chale, phir farmaya: "Tum mein se koi Quran ki ta'weel (tafseer) par jung karega jaise maine iske nuzool par jung ki." To log iske liye ummeedwar hokar dekhne lage, aur unme Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) bhi the, Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Kya woh main houn?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Kya woh main houn?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke jooti theek karne wala," matlab Ali (RA), to hum unke paas gaye aur unhein khush-khabri di, unhone apna sar nahi uthaaya, goya unhone yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) se pehle hi sun li thi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, called me and said, "O Ali, indeed in you is a resemblance to Jesus, peace be upon him, that the Jews will despise him to the extent that they will slander his mother, and the Christians will love him to the extent that they will exalt him to a status not befitting of him." Ali said, "Verily, he will be destroyed by excessive love for him, as he will be neglected by what is not in him. And he will be hated by false claims against him, although I am not a prophet and no revelation comes to me, but I follow the Book of Allah and the Sunnah of His Prophet, peace be upon him, as much as I am able. So whatever I command you with in obedience to Allah, it is upon you to obey me in what you love or hate. And whatever I command you with disobedience, neither I nor anyone else is to be obeyed in disobedience to Allah, the Almighty. Indeed, obedience is only in what is good." [Sahih Isnad, not reported by al-Hakam bin Abdul-Malik and here is Ibn Mu'in.]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe bulaaya aur farmaya: "Aye Ali, tum mein Isa (AS), unpar durood-o-salaam ho, ki misaal hai - Yahoodiyon ne unse itni dushmani ki ke unhone unki maa par ilzaam lagaaya, aur Nasaara (Christians) ne unse itni mohabbat ki ke unhone unhein aisi manzil par pahunchaaya jo unke liye nahi thi." Unhone kaha: aur Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Khabardaar, beshak mera nuqsaan hoga aik aisi mohabbat karne wale se jo had se tajaawuz kare, jo mujhe wohi kehta hai jo mujhme nahi, aur aik aisi dushmani karne wale se jo iftra kare, jiski dushmani usse mujhpar ilzaam lagaane par majboor kare, khabardaar, main Nabi nahi houn, aur na hi mujhpar wahi nazil hoti hai, lekin main Allah ki Kitaab aur uske Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat par amal karta houn jitni mujhme taaqat hai, isliye jo cheez maine tumhein Allah Ta'ala ki itaa'at ka hukum diya hai, usme meri itaa'at tumpar farz hai chahe tum pasand karo ya napasand, aur jo maine ya kisi doosre ne tumhein gunah ka hukum diya ho, to Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki na-farmani mein kisi ki bhi itaa'at nahi, itaa'at sirf achhai mein hai." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Al-Hakam bin Abdul Malik ko Ibn Ma'een ne kamzor kaha hai.

e: “O ʿAli, you have a treasure in Paradise and you are with two harns of this ummah. Do not follow one glance with another; you may be allowed the first but not the second.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1373)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aye Ali, beshak tumhare liye Jannat mein aik khazana hai, aur tum iske do sironn (buzurgi) wale ho, isliye aik nazar ke baad doosri nazar mat karo, kyunke pehli nazar tumhare liye (maaf) hai, doosri tumhare liye nahi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "O Ali, whoever separates from me has indeed separated from Allah, and whoever separates from you O Ali, has indeed separated from me." This hadith has a authentic chain of narration, even though it was rejected by some individuals.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ali, jo mujhse alag hua usne Allah se alag hua, aur jo tumse alag hua, Aye Ali, usne mujhse alag hua." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala, balke yeh munkir (radd kiya hua) hai. Repudiated.

e: [AI] The Prophet (pbuh) said, "I am the leader of the descendants of Adam, and Ali is the leader of the Arabs."
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Aadam (AS) ki aulaad ka sardaar houn, aur Ali Arab ke sardaar hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Pray for me, the leader of the Arabs." So I said, "O Messenger of Allah, aren't you the leader of the Arabs?" He said, "I am the leader of the offspring of Adam, and Ali is the leader of the Arabs."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Arab ke sardaar ko mere paas bulaao." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap Arab ke sardaar nahi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Aadam (AS) ki aulaad ka sardaar houn, aur Ali Arab ke sardaar hain." Fabricated.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Pray for me, the leader of the Arabs." Aisha replied, "Are you not the leader of the Arabs, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "I am the leader of the children of Adam, and Ali is the leader of the Arabs." This was narrated by Ibn 'Awf.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Arab ke sardaar ko mere paas bulaao." To Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Kya aap Arab ke sardaar nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Aadam (AS) ki aulaad ka sardaar houn, aur Ali Arab ke sardaar hain." Ibn Alwaan ne ise gadha (fabricate kiya). Fabricated.

e: [AI] "I was with Ali on the Day of Camel, and when I saw Aisha standing, I felt a sense of unease. Allah then revealed to me the reason for that during the Dhuhr prayer. I fought alongside the Commander of the Believers, and when it was over, I went to the city and visited Umm Salamah. I said to her, 'By Allah, I did not come to ask for food or drink, but I am a supporter of Abu Dhar.' She welcomed me and I narrated my story to her. She asked, 'Where were you when hearts flew like birds?' I replied, 'I went to the place where Allah revealed to me the reason for that when the sun had set.' She said, 'Well done! I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Ali is with the Quran, and the Quran is with Ali. They will never separate until they return to me at the Pond.'"
hi: Main Jamal ke din Ali (RA) ke sath tha, jab maine Aisha (RA) ko khadi dekha, to mujhe wohi kuch mehsoos hua jo doosre logon ko hota hai, to Allah ne Zuhr ki namaz ke waqt yeh mujhse door kar diya, to maine Ameer-ul-Momineen ke sath jung ki, jab woh faarigh huay, to main Madinah gaya aur Umm Salamah (RA) ke paas aaya, maine kaha: "Main, Allah ki qasam, na khaana maangne aaya houn na paani, balke main Abu Dharr (RA) ka mawla (aazaad kiya hua ghulam) houn." Unhone kaha: "Khush-aamdeed." To maine unhein apna qissa sunaaya, unhone poocha: "Tum kahan the jab dil apne apne raaste udd gaye the?" Maine kaha: "Wahin, jahan Allah ne suraj ki dhalne (zawaal) ke waqt yeh mujhse door kiya." Unhone kaha: "Tumne achha kiya, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Ali Quran ke sath hai aur Quran Ali ke sath hai, woh dono kabhi juda nahi honge yahan tak ke Hauz (Kauthar) par mujhse aa milein.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "May Allah have mercy on Ali. O Allah, guide the truth with him wherever he goes."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Ali par reham kare, Aye Allah, haq ko unke sath ghuma jahan bhi woh jaayen."

e: "When I would ask the Messenger of Allah SAW he would give me, and when I would be silent, he would initiate (speech or giving) with me." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3729)
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko kehte suna: "Jab main Rasulullah (SAW) se maangta, to woh mujhe dete, aur jab main khaamosh rehta, to woh khud shuru karte (dete)."

e: [AI] One of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had several doors in the mosque. So one day, he said, "Close all these doors except for Ali's door." Some people spoke about this, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and praised and glorified Allah. Then he said, "After that, I have been commanded to close these doors except for Ali's door." He (the companion) said, "By Allah, I did not close or open anything, but I followed what I was commanded to do."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ke gharon ke darwaze masjid mein khulte the, aik din aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "In darwazon ko band kar do, siwaye Ali (RA) ke darwaze ke." Unhone kaha: to iske baare mein logon ne baat ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir farmaya: "Ammaa ba'd, mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main in darwazon ko band karoon, siwaye Ali (RA) ke darwaze ke," to tum mein se koi is baare mein kuch kahe to (jaan lo): Allah ki qasam, maine kuch band nahi kiya na khola, lekin mujhe hukum diya gaya to maine uski pairavi ki.

e: [AI] "To have a characteristic from her is more beloved to me than being given the red camels," it was said, "And what are they, O Amir al-Mu'minin?" He said, "For Fatimah, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, to marry him (Ali) and for them to live in the mosque along with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, where he can have whatever he wishes, and the flag of victory on the day of Khaibar."
hi: "Isme se aik khoobi mujhe di jaati to woh mujhe surkh oonton milne se zyada aziz hoti." Unse poocha gaya: "Woh kya hain, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen?" Unhone kaha: "Unka Fatimah (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti, se nikah karna, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath masjid mein rehna, jismein unke liye woh sab kuch halaal hai jo unke (Rasulullah SAW) liye halaal hai, aur Khaibar ke din jhanda."

e: [AI] I asked Qutham ibn al-Abbas, "How did Ali inherit the Messenger of Allah ﷺ instead of you?" He said, "Because he was the foremost among us in knowledge and the most intense among us in dedication."
hi: Maine Qutham bin Al-Abbas (RA) se poocha: "Ali (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ka waaris kaise banaya, tum logon ke bagair?" Unhone kaha: "Kyunke woh humme se sabse pehle unke sath jude aur unse sabse zyada qareeb the."

e: [AI] "The heir inherits by lineage or loyalty, and there is no disagreement among the people of knowledge that the cousin does not inherit alongside the paternal uncle. It has been established by consensus that Ali inherited knowledge from the Prophet ﷺ more than they did, in accordance with what the judge mentioned." Imam al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: "Waaris sirf nasab (khoon ke rishte) ya wala (aazaadi ke rishte) se waaris banta hai, aur ahl-e-ilm ke darmiyan ismein koi ikhtilaaf nahi ke chachere bhai chacha ke sath waaris nahi banta, to is ijma' se yeh zaahir hota hai ke Ali (RA) ne unhein chhod kar Nabi (SAW) se ilm ka waaris banaya, aur qazi ke bayan ki sihat ke sath." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Ali used to say about the life of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ : "Indeed, Allah says, 'So if he dies or is killed, would you turn back on your heels?' [Surah Al-Imran 3:144]. By Allah, we would not turn back on our heels after Allah has guided us. And by Allah, if he dies or is killed, I will fight for what he fought for until I die. By Allah, I am his brother, his deputy, his cousin, and the inheritor of his knowledge. So who is more deserving of it than me?" Al-Dhahabi remains silent about summarizing it.
hi: Ali (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki zindagi mein kaha karte the: "Allah farmata hai: {Kya agar woh faut ho jaayen ya qatl kiye jaayen, to tum apne ediyon ke bal palat jaaoge} (Surah Aal-e-Imran 144), Allah ki qasam, hum apni ediyon ke bal nahi palatenge is ke baad ke Allah ne humein hidayat di, Allah ki qasam, agar woh faut ho jaayen ya qatl kiye jaayen, to main zaroor unhi cheezon par jung karunga jinpar unhone jung ki, yahan tak ke main mar jaaun, Allah ki qasam, main hi unka bhai, unka wali, unka chachera bhai, aur unke ilm ka waaris houn, to mujhse zyada is (ilm) ka haqdaar kaun hai?" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said in a sermon he delivered during the Farewell Hajj, "I will kill the giants in the battalion." Then Gabriel, peace be upon him, said to him, "Or Ali, or Ali ibn Abi Talib." Ismail bin Yahya bin Salamah bin Khiyal and his father were present.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Hajjat-ul-Wida ke khutba mein farmaya: "Main zaroor Amaaliqah (aik purani qaum) ko aik lashkar mein qatl karunga." To Jibra'il (AS), unpar salaam ho, ne unse poocha, ya Ali (RA) ne poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ya Ali bin Abi Talib (RA)." Ismail bin Yahya bin Salamah bin Kuhail aur unke waalid dono matrook (chhode huay) hain. Fabricated.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its gate, so whoever desires the city, let him come to its gate."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main ilm ka shehar houn, aur Ali uska darwaza hai, isliye jo shehar chahe, use darwaze ki taraf aana chahiye." Fabricated.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its gate. Whoever seeks the city should come to its gate." Al-Husayn ibn Fahm reported that Abu As-Salt al-Harawi narrated it on the authority of Abu Muawiyah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main ilm ka shehar houn, aur Ali uska darwaza hai, isliye jo shehar chahe, use darwaze ki taraf aana chahiye." Al-Husain bin Fahm ne kaha: humein Abu As-Salt Al-Harawi ne Abu Mu'awiyah se hadith bayan ki.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "I am the city of knowledge, and Ali is its gate. Whoever seeks knowledge should come to its gate."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Main ilm ka shehar houn, aur Ali uska darwaza hai, isliye jo ilm chahe, use darwaze ki taraf aana chahiye." Fabricated.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ looked at me and said, "O Ali, you are a master in this world and a master in the Hereafter. You are my beloved and the beloved of Allah. Whoever is your enemy is also my enemy and the enemy of Allah. Woe to those who hate you after me."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne meri taraf dekha aur farmaya: "Aye Ali, tum duniya mein sardaar ho aur Aakhirat mein bhi sardaar ho, tumhara mohabbat karne wala mera mohabbat karne wala hai, aur mera mohabbat karne wala Allah ka mohabbat karne wala hai, aur tumhara dushman mera dushman hai, aur mera dushman Allah ka dushman hai, aur haalaakat ho us par jo mere baad tumse dushmani kare." Fabrication ka shubha.

e: “Whoever obeys me, obeys Allah, And whoever disobeys me, disobeys Allah. Whoever obeys the ruler, obeys me, and whoever disobeys the ruler, disobeys me.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2859)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) se farmaya: "Jisne meri itaa'at ki, usne Allah ki itaa'at ki, aur jisne meri na-farmani ki, usne Allah ki na-farmani ki, aur jisne tumhari itaa'at ki, usne meri itaa'at ki, aur jisne tumhari na-farmani ki, usne meri na-farmani ki."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever wishes to live my life and die my death and dwell in the everlasting Paradise that my Lord has promised me, then let him be a follower of Ali bin Abi Talib, for he will never lead you astray and will never misguide you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo meri zindagi jeena chahe, meri maut marna chahe, aur us hamesha rehne wali Jannat mein rehna chahe jiska mere Rab ne mujhse wa'da kiya hai, to use Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ka wali bana lena chahiye, kyunke woh tumhein kabhi hidayat se nahi nikaalenge aur na hi tumhein gumraahi mein daalenge."

e: [AI] "We used to know the hypocrites only by their lies against Allah and His Messenger, and their negligence in performing prayers and their hostility towards Ali ibn Abi Talib."
hi: "Hum munafiqeen ko sirf unke Allah aur uske Rasool ko jhutlaane, namazon se ghair-hazir rehne, aur Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) se dushmani karne se pehchaante the."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was holding the finger of Ali ibn Abi Talib and saying, "This is the prince of virtue, the killer of the enemy, the victorious one whom whoever supports him is successful and whoever betrays him is doomed." Then he raised his voice with it.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ka baazoo pakde huay suna, farmate huay: "Yeh neik logon ka ameer hai, buraai karne walon ka qaatil, jisne uski madad ki woh madad-yaafta hai, jisne usse rusva kiya woh rusva hai," phir unhone apni aawaaz buland ki. Fabricated.

e: [AI] Fatima married me from a family that had no money
hi: "Fatimah (RA), tumne mera nikah aik aise (aadmi) se karwaaya jiske paas koi maal nahi." Fabricated.

e: [AI] Regarding Ali, "Indeed, you are but a warner, and for every people, there is a guide." [Surah Ar-Ra'd 7] Ali said, "I am the Messenger of Allah, the warner, and I am the guide."
hi: Ali (RA) se, Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{Tum to sirf aik dar-dene wale ho, aur har qaum ke liye aik hidayat dene wala hai}" (Surah Ar-Ra'd 7) ke baare mein, Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) dar-dene wale hain, aur main hidayat dene wala houn." Fabricated.

e: [AI] "When the Prophet ﷺ  got angry, none of us dared to speak to him except Ali ibn Abi Talib."
hi: "Jab Nabi (SAW) ghussa hote, to humme se koi bhi unse baat karne ki himmat nahi karta tha, siwaye Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke." Repudiated.

e: [AI] "A man said to Salman, 'How strong is your love for Ali?' He replied, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Whoever loves Ali, loves me and whoever hates Ali, hates me.'"
hi: Aik aadmi ne Salman (RA) se poocha: "Aapki Ali (RA) se itni mohabbat kyun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jisne Ali (RA) se mohabbat ki, usne mujhse mohabbat ki, aur jisne Ali (RA) se dushmani ki, usne mujhse dushmani ki.'"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Verily, Allah has commanded me to love four of my companions and informed me that He loves them." We asked, "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah? We all want to be among them." He said, "Indeed, Ali is one of them," and then he remained silent. Then he said, "As for Ali, he is one of them," and then he remained silent.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah ne mujhe apne sahaba mein se chaar logon se mohabbat karne ka hukum diya hai, aur mujhe bataaya hai ke woh unse mohabbat karta hai." Humne poocha: "Woh kaun hain, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aur hum sab chahte the ke hum unme se hon. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khabardaar, beshak Ali unme se hain," phir khamosh ho gaye, phir farmaya: "Sun lo, Ali unme se hain," phir khamosh ho gaye.

e: [AI] I used to serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he was presented with a roasted bird. He said, "O Allah, bring to me one of Your beloved creatures who will eat with me from this bird." So I said, "O Allah, make him a man from the Ansar (helpers)." Then Ali came, and I said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is in need." Then he came again, and I said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is in need." Then he came again, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Open it." So he entered, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "What kept you from me?" He said, "These were the last three mouthfuls that Anas insisted on returning me, thinking that you were in need." He (the Prophet) said, "What made you do what you did?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I heard your supplication and I wished to be a man from my people." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, a man may love his people."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat karta tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik bhuna hua parinda pesh kiya gaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, apni sabse aziz makhlooq ko mere paas bhej, jo mere sath is parinde ko khaaye." Unhone kaha: to maine kaha: "Aye Allah, isse Ansar mein se aik aadmi banaa." To Ali (RA) aaye, maine kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) kisi zaroorat mein hain." Phir woh dobara aaye, maine kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) kisi zaroorat mein hain." Phir woh dobara aaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khol do." To woh dakhil huay, Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein mujhse kis cheez ne roka?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh teesri martaba hai jo Anas mujhe wapas kar raha hai, uska khayal hai ke aap kisi zaroorat mein hain." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne aisa kyun kiya?" Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine aapki dua suni, to main chahta tha ke woh mere qabile ka koi aadmi ho." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak aadmi apni qaum se mohabbat karta hai."

e: [AI] O son of al-Hajjaj, don't you see that you belittle Ali ibn Abi Talib, whom Muhammad ﷺ  sent with truth? I used to be the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and every day I used to serve a young boy from the Ansar in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . That day happened to be my daily routine when Umm Ayman, the foster mother of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , came with a bird. I placed it in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he asked, "O Umm Ayman, what is this bird?" She said, "I found this bird and made it for you." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Allah, bring to me the dearest of Your creation to you and me, so that he may eat with me from this bird." He knocked on the door and said, "O Anas, see who is at the door." I said, "O Allah, make him a man from the Ansar." I went, and there was Ali at the door. I said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is in need." I came near and stood in my place, but I had barely stood when he knocked on the door and said, "O Anas, see who is at the door." I said, "O Allah, make him a man from the Ansar." I went, and there was Ali at the door. I said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is in need." I came near and stood in my place, but I had barely stood when he knocked on the door and said, "O Anas, go and let him in, for you are not the first to love his people, but he is not from the Ansar." So I went and let him in. He said, "O Anas, bring the bird near him." I placed it in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and they both ate. Muhammad ibn al-Hajjaj said, "O Anas, was this arranged by you?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "I swear by Allah, I have given you a pledge not to belittle Ali after this incident, and I don't know anyone who belittles him except that I will break his nose." Ibrahim ibn Thabit, you are incorrect.
hi: "Aye Ibn Al-Hajjaj, kya main tumhein dekh nahi raha ke tum Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ki tanqees (kami) karte ho, us Zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad (SAW) ko haq ke sath bheja, main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat unke saamne kiya karta tha, aur har din Ansar ke bachchon mein se aik ghulam Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat karta, to woh din mera din tha, to Umm Aiman (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ki aazaad ki hui laundi, aik parinda lekar aayin, maine usse Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne rakha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: 'Aye Umm Aiman, yeh kya parinda hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh parinda mujhe mila, maine ise aapke liye banaaya.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Allah, apni sabse aziz makhlooq mujhe aur apne nazdeek bhej, jo mere sath is parinde ko khaaye,' aur darwaza khatkaya gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Anas, dekho darwaze par kaun hai.' Maine kaha: 'Aye Allah, isse Ansar mein se aik aadmi banaa.' To main gaya, achaanak Ali (RA) darwaze par the, maine kaha: 'Rasulullah (SAW) kisi zaroorat mein hain.' To main aaya yahan tak ke main apni jagah khada hua, thodi hi der guzri thi ke darwaza dobara khatkaya gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Anas, dekho darwaze par kaun hai.' Maine kaha: 'Aye Allah, isse Ansar mein se aik aadmi banaa.' To main gaya, achaanak Ali (RA) darwaze par the, maine kaha: 'Rasulullah (SAW) kisi zaroorat mein hain.' To main aaya yahan tak ke main apni jagah khada hua, thodi hi der guzri thi ke darwaza dobara khatkaya gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Anas, jao aur unhein dakhil karo, tum pehle aadmi nahi ho jisne apni qaum se mohabbat ki ho, woh Ansar mein se nahi hain.' To main gaya aur unhein dakhil kiya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aye Anas, parinda unke qareeb karo.' Unhone kaha: to maine woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne rakha, dono ne mil kar khaaya. Muhammad bin Al-Hajjaj ne poocha: 'Aye Anas, kya yeh tumhari maujoodgi mein hua?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Unhone kaha: 'Main Allah se ahd karta houn ke main is majlis ke baad Ali (RA) ki koi kami nahi karunga, aur main aisa koi nahi jaanta jo unki kami kare magar main uska chehra napasand karunga.'" Ibrahim bin Thabit saaqit (chhoda hua) hain.

e: [AI] So they began and started speaking, and we do not know what they said. He said, then he came shaking his garment and saying, "Alas and woe to them!" They fell into a man who possessed more than ten virtues that no one else had. They fell into a man whom the Prophet ﷺ  said, "I will send a man who will never be humiliated by Allah. He loves Allah and His Messenger, and Allah and His Messenger love him." So he became ambitious for her, and he said, "Where is Ali?" They said, "He is at the grinding mill." He said, "No one of them can grind." He came while he was blind, barely able to see, and he blew into his eyes, and then he shook the flag three times and gave it to him. Ali came with Safiya bint Huyay, and Ibn Abbas said, "Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a man with Surah Al-Tawbah, and then he sent Ali after him. He took it from him and said, 'No one should take it except a man who is like me, and I am like him.' Ibn Abbas said, "The Prophet ﷺ  asked his cousins, 'Who among you would be loyal to me in this life and the Hereafter?' Ali was sitting with them, and he said, 'Oh, Messenger of Allah, I will be loyal to you in this life and the Hereafter.' He said, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  approached a man from among them and said, 'Who among you would be loyal to me in this life and the Hereafter?' They refused, so he said to Ali, 'You are my ally in this life and the Hereafter.' Ibn Abbas said, 'Ali was the first person to believe after Khadijah.' He said, 'Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took off his robe and put it on Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husain, and said, 'Indeed, Allah wants to remove impurity from you, O people of the household, and purify you completely.' Ibn Abbas said, 'And Ali sold himself, so he wore the robe of the Prophet ﷺ  and then slept in his place.' Ibn Abbas said, 'And the polytheists used to throw stones at the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Abu Bakr and Ali came, and Ali was sleeping. He said, 'And Abu Bakr thought that he was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' He said, 'O Messenger of Allah!' Ali said to him, 'Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has gone towards the Ma'oon well, so he followed him.' He said, 'Then Abu Bakr left, and Ali entered the cave with him.' He said, 'And Ali started throwing stones just as the Prophet ﷺ  used to do while he was relieving himself, with his head wrapped in a cloth that he would not remove until morning. Then he uncovered his head, and they said, 'You are lowly.' And your companion did not uncover his head while we were throwing stones at him, and you uncover your head even though we object to it.' Ibn Abbas said, 'And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out in the battle of Tabuk with the people. Ali said to him, 'Shall I go out with you?' He said, 'No.' So Ali wept, and he said to him, 'Are you not satisfied with being in the position of Aaron to Moses, except that no prophet will come after me?' Ibn Abbas said, 'And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Umar when he said, 'Allow me to kill him,' he said, 'And you were doing that. And who knows, perhaps Allah has looked upon the people of Badr and said, 'Do whatever you want.
hi: To unhone baat shuru ki aur baaten karne lage, humein nahi pata unhone kya kaha. Unhone kaha: to woh apna kapda jhaadte huay aaye aur keh rahe the: "Uff aur Tuff, unhone aise aadmi ke baare mein baat ki jinke das se zyada fazaail hain jo kisi aur ke paas nahi. Unhone aise aadmi ke baare mein baat ki jinse Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya tha: 'Main zaroor aise aadmi ko bhejunga jise Allah kabhi zaleel nahi karega, woh Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hai, aur Allah aur uska Rasool usse mohabbat karte hain.' To log iske liye ummeedwar hokar dekhne lage, aap (SAW) ne poocha: 'Ali kahan hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Woh chakki mein aata pees rahe hain.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Unme se koi bhi (khud) aata peeste huay nahi ho sakta tha.' Unhone kaha: to woh aaye jabke unki aankhein dukh rahi thin, unhein kuch dikhaai nahi de raha tha, unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne unki aankhon mein thooka, phir jhanda teen martaba hilaaya, phir woh unhein de diya, to Ali (RA) Safiyyah (RA) bint Huyay ko lekar aaye." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne fulan ko Surah At-Tawbah ke sath bheja, phir Ali (RA) ko unke peechhe bheja, unhone unse woh le li aur farmaya: 'Isse sirf woh aadmi le jaayega jo mujhse hai aur main jisse houn.'" Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: aur Nabi (SAW) ne apne chachazaad bhaiyon se poocha: "Tum mein se kaun mujhse duniya aur Aakhirat mein wilayat (dosti/madad) karega?" Unhone kaha: aur Ali (RA) unke sath baithe huay the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unme se aik aadmi ki taraf mudkar poocha: "Tum mein se kaun mujhse duniya aur Aakhirat mein wilayat karega?" To unhone inkaar kiya, to unhone Ali (RA) se farmaya: "Tum duniya aur Aakhirat mein mere wali (dost/madadgaar) ho." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur Ali (RA) logon mein se Khadijah (RA) ke baad sabse pehle imaan laane wale the." Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne apna kapda liya aur Ali (RA), Fatimah (RA), Hasan (RA), aur Husain (RA) par daala aur farmaya: "{Allah to bas yehi chahta hai ke tum se, Ahl-e-Bait, gandagi door kare aur tumhein khoob paak kar de}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33). Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur Ali (RA) ne apni jaan bechi (qurbaan ki), unhone Nabi (SAW) ka kapda pehna, phir unki jagah so gaye." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: aur mushrikeen Rasulullah (SAW) par patthar phenkte the, to Abu Bakr (RA) aaye jabke Ali (RA) so rahe the, unhone kaha: aur Abu Bakr (RA) samajhte the ke yeh Rasulullah (SAW) hain, unhone kaha: to unhone kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi." To Ali (RA) ne unse kaha: "Beshak Allah ke Nabi (SAW) Bi'r Maimoon ki taraf ja chuke hain, unhein jaa milen." Unhone kaha: to Abu Bakr (RA) gaye aur unke sath ghaar mein dakhil huay. Unhone kaha: aur Ali (RA) patthar phenkna sehte rahe jaise Nabi (SAW) ka sehna tha, aur woh takleef se tadapte hue apna sar kapde mein lapete huay the, use nahi nikaalte the yahan tak ke subah hui, phir apne sar se (kapda) hataaya, to unhone kaha: "Tum bohot neech ho, tumhara saathi taklif se nahi tadapta tha jabke hum use patthar maar rahe the, aur tum taklif se tadap rahe ho," aur humein yeh baat ajeeb lagi." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) Ghazwa Tabuk mein nikle aur logon ko apne sath lekar nikle, unhone kaha: to Ali (RA) ne unse poocha: "Kya main aapke sath nikloon?" Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." To Ali (RA) rone lage, to aap (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kya tum raazi nahi ke tum mujhse waisi hi manzil par ho jaisi Harun (AS) Musa (AS) se the, siwaye is ke ke mere baad koi Nabi nahi, beshak yeh munaasib nahi ke main jaaun magar tum mere khalifa ho." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Tum mere baad har momin mard aur momina aurat ke wali ho." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne masjid ke darwaze band kar diye, siwaye Ali (RA) ke darwaze ke, to woh janaabat ki haalat mein bhi masjid mein dakhil hote, aur yehi unka raasta tha, iske ilawa unka koi doosra raasta nahi tha." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jiska main mawla houn, uska mawla Ali hai." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Aur Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne humein Quran mein bataaya hai ke woh darakht walon se raazi hua, aur usne unke dilon mein jo tha usse jaana, to kya usne humein bataaya ke woh iske baad unse naaraaz hua?" Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne Umar (RA) se farmaya jab unhone kaha: "Mujhe ijaazat dein, main uski gardan maar doon," aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum aisa karte? Aur tumhein kya khabar, shaayad Allah ne Badr walon par nazar daali ho," phir farmaya: "Jo chaaho karo."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of Badr to me and Abu Bakr, "On the right of one of you, there is Jibril, and on the right of the other, there is Mikail, and Israfil is a great angel who witnesses the fight and is in the front line."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din mujhse aur Abu Bakr (RA) se farmaya: "Tum dono mein se aik ke daayen taraf Jibra'il (AS) hain aur doosre ke (daayen taraf) Mikaeel (AS), aur Israfeel (AS) aik azeem farishta hain jo jung mein maujood hote hain aur saf mein hote hain."

e: [AI] Ali ibn Abi Talib complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he stood among us as a speaker and I heard him say, "O people, do not complain about Ali, for by Allah, he is the most fearful in the presence of Allah and in the way of Allah."
hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke baare mein logon ne Rasulullah (SAW) se shikaayat ki, to aap (SAW) khade huay aur humein khutba di, maine unhein farmate suna: "Aye logo, Ali (RA) ki shikaayat mat karo, Allah ki qasam, woh Allah ke maamle mein aur Allah ki raah mein sakht (uncompromising) hain."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Which one of you will be my deputy in this world and the Hereafter?" Each of them replied, "Will you be my deputy in this world and the Hereafter?" Until it came to Ali, who said, "I will be your deputy in this world and the Hereafter." The Prophet ﷺ  then said, "You are my deputy in this world and the Hereafter."
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum mein se kaun duniya aur Aakhirat mein mera wali banega?" To aap (SAW) ne unme se har aik se poocha: "Kya tum duniya aur Aakhirat mein mera wali banoge?" To unhone kaha: "Nahi," yahan tak ke aksar se poochne ke baad, Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Main duniya aur Aakhirat mein aapka wali banunga." To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum duniya aur Aakhirat mein mere wali ho."

e: [AI] "Regarding it, Al-Dhahabi in summary."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying to Ali: "O Ali, blessed is he who loves you, believes in you, and woe to he who hates you and denies you."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ali (RA) se yeh kehte suna: "Aye Ali, khush-naseeb hai woh jo tumse mohabbat kare aur tumhare baare mein sach maane, aur haalaakat ho us par jo tumse dushmani kare aur tumhein jhutlaaye." Weak, Rejected.

e: [AI] "Ali, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me to Yemen. So, I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I am a young man and I receive judgments that I do not have knowledge about.' He placed his hand on my chest and said, 'O Allah, make his tongue firm and guide his heart.' After that, I never doubted any judgment or any decree."
hi: Ali (RA): Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe Yemen bheja, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aik jawaan aadmi houn, aur mere paas aise faisle aate hain jinka mujhe ilm nahi." Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne apna haath mere seene par rakha aur farmaya: "Aye Allah, iski zubaan ko mazboot kar aur iske dil ko hidayat de." To mujhe kabhi kisi faisle mein shak nahi hua uske baad.

e: [AI] While I was with the Messenger of Allah (Peace be upon him), a man from Yemen came and started talking to the Prophet (Peace be upon him) and informing him. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, three men came to Ali and they are quarreling over a child. They agreed on one woman when she was in her purity. He (Ali) said to them: 'Both of you have good intentions regarding this child.' Then he said: 'You are partners in dispute. I will resolve the matter between you. Whoever I decide for, the child will be his, and he will pay two-thirds of the blood money to the other. So he resolved the matter between them and decided for one of them, and he gave him the child." The Prophet (Peace be upon him) laughed until his molars were visible.
hi: Jabke main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas tha, ke Yemen ke ahl mein se aik aadmi aaya aur Nabi (SAW) ko baatein karne aur khabar dene laga, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Ali (RA) ke paas teen aadmi jhagadte huay aaye, aik bacche ke baare mein, unhone aik hi tuhr (paak dinon) mein aik aurat se sambhog kiya tha, to unhone do se kaha: 'Tum dono is bacche ke baare mein khush-dili dikhaao,' phir kaha: 'Tum sab jhagadne wale saathi ho, main tum mein qura (lottery) daalunga, jiske naam qura nikle, bacha usi ka hoga, aur uspar apne dono saathiyon ko diyat ka do-tihaai dena hoga,' to unhone unke darmiyan qura daala, aik ke naam qura nikla, to unhein bacha de diya gaya." To Nabi (SAW) itna hanse ke unke daant zaahir ho gaye," ya kaha: unke azraas (peechhe ke daant).

e: [AI] The Prophet (pbuh) said, "I do not know about it except for what Ali said."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe iske baare mein kuch nahi maloom siwaye is ke jo Ali (RA) ne kaha."

e: [AI] "I walked with the Prophet ﷺ  to a woman who slaughtered a sheep for us. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'A man from the people of Jannah (Paradise) will enter.' Then Abu Bakr entered, and then the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'A man from the people of Jannah will enter.' Then Umar entered, and then the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'A man from the people of Jannah will enter.' O Allah, if You will, make him Ali bin Abi Talib.' Then Ali bin Abi Talib entered."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke sath aik aurat ke paas gaya, unhone humare liye aik bakri zibah ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat walon mein se aik aadmi zaroor dakhil hoga." To Abu Bakr (RA) dakhil huay. Phir farmaya: "Jannat walon mein se aik aadmi zaroor dakhil hoga." To Umar (RA) dakhil huay. Phir farmaya: "Jannat walon mein se aik aadmi zaroor dakhil hoga, Aye Allah, agar tu chaahe to isse Ali banaa de." To Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) dakhil huay.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The first among you to enter Paradise is the first among you who embraced Islam, Ali ibn Abi Talib." Adh-Dhahabi did not include this in his summarization.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se sabse pehle Hauz (Kauthar) par pahunchne wala tum mein se sabse pehle Islam laane wala hai, Ali bin Abi Talib (RA)." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The first person to embrace Islam along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was Ali bin Abi Talib."
hi: "Beshak sabse pehle jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Musalman huay woh Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) the."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  entered upon Fatimah and said, "Indeed, me, you, and this sleeper, meaning Ali, and these two, meaning Hasan and Husayn, will be in the same place on the Day of Judgment."
hi: Nabi (SAW) Fatimah (RA) ke paas dakhil huay aur farmaya: "Beshak main, tum, aur yeh sone wale," matlab Ali (RA), "aur woh dono," matlab Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA), "Qayamat ke din aik hi jagah mein honge."

e: [AI] I asked Sa'id ibn Jubayr and said, "O Abu Abdullah, who carried the flag of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He looked at me and said, "You seem to be in a state of confusion." I became angry and complained about him to his brothers from the Qur'ra (reciters). I said to them, "Are you not amazed by Sa'id? I asked him who carried the flag of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he looked at me and said, 'You seem to be in a state of confusion.'" They said, "You asked him while he was afraid of Al-Hajjaj and had sought refuge in the Ka'bah, so ask him now." So, I asked him and he said, "Ali carried it. This is what I heard from Abdullah ibn Abbas."
hi: Maine Sa'eed bin Jubair se poocha: "Aye Abu Abdullah, Rasulullah (SAW) ke jhande ka bardaar kaun tha?" Unhone kaha: to unhone meri taraf dekha aur kaha: "Tum aaraam-tabiyat lagte ho." To mujhe ghussa aaya aur maine qariyon mein se unke bhaiyon se unki shikaayat ki, maine kaha: "Kya tumhein Sa'eed par ta'ajjub nahi hota? Maine unse poocha Rasulullah (SAW) ke jhande ka bardaar kaun tha, to unhone meri taraf dekha aur kaha: tum aaraam-tabiyat ho." Unhone kaha: "Tumne unse tab poocha jab woh Al-Hajjaj se khaufzada the, aur unhone Ghar (Ka'bah) mein panaah li hui thi, ab unse poocho." To maine unse poocha, unhone kaha: "Isse Ali (RA) uthaate the, maine yeh Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) se suna hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Paradise longs for three: Ali, Al-Ammar, and Salman."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ne teen (logon) ka shauq kiya - Ali, Ammar, aur Salman."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I asked my Lord, the Exalted and Glorious, that I should not marry anyone from my Ummah unless they are with me in Paradise, and He granted me this."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine apne Rab, buzurg aur buland, se maanga ke main apni Ummat mein se kisi ka nikah na karaaun aur na khud nikah karoon magar woh Jannat mein mere sath ho, to usne mujhe (yeh) de diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: It has been revealed to me regarding Ali three things, that he is the leader of the Muslims, the Imam of the righteous, and the commander of the brave warriors.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ali (RA) ke baare mein mujhpar teen (baatein) wahi ki gayin - ke woh Musalmano ke sardaar, muttaqiyon ke imam, aur 'Ghurr-ul-Muhajjaleen' (roshan chehre-haath-pair wale, wuzu ke asar wale) ke rehnuma hain."

e: [AI] And by Allah, if I meet him, I do not expect you to find him on the Day of Judgment standing by the pool of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, warding off the hypocrites with a staff made of 'Ausaj'. This was narrated to me by the trustworthy and truthful one, peace be upon him. Woe to the one who fabricates such lies!
hi: "Allah ki qasam, agar main unse milun, aur mujhe nahi lagta tum unse Qayamat ke din milo ge, tum unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke Hauz (Kauthar) par khada paaoge, munafiqeen ke jhandon ko apne haath mein Awsaj (kaante-daar jhaadi) ki lakdi se hataate huay." Mujhse yeh Saadiq-o-Masdooq (sachai wale, tasdeeq-shuda), (SAW), ne bayan ki, aur naakaam hua jisne iftra (jhoot) baandha.

e: The Messenger of Allah ؓ said: ʿShall I not teach you some words which, if you say them you will be forgiven, even though you are already forgiven: There is no god but Allah, Most High, the Almighty; there is no god but Him, the most Forbearing the Most Generous; glory be to Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne; praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 1363)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aye Ali, kya main tumhein kuch alfaaz na sikhaaun, agar tum unhein kaho to Allah tumhein bakhsh dega, isse pehle ke tum pehle se hi bakhshe huay ho - 'La ilaha illallahu Al-Aliyy-ul-Azeem, La ilaha illallahu Al-Haleem-ul-Kareem, Subhanallahi Rabbil-Arshil-Azeem, Walhamdu lillahi Rabbil-Aalameen.'"

e: [AI] "And I swear by the One whom I have taken an oath of allegiance to, if Ali were to make a covenant with the people, he would be the closest to the Prophet ﷺ. We returned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the morning, and he was saying, 'Has Ali come? Has Ali come?' repeatedly. Fatimah said, 'It is as if you have sent him on an errand.' She then said, 'He came afterwards.' Abi Salamah said, 'I thought he had some urgent need for him.' So we left the house and sat by the door, and I was closest to the door. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and poured his left hand on him and spoke to him privately. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away that day. So Ali was the closest to the people in commitment."
hi: Us Zaat ki qasam jiski main qasam khaata houn, Ali (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) se sabse zyada aakhri waqt ka ahd rakhne wale the, hum aik subah Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas mareez-daari ke liye gaye, aap (SAW) keh rahe the: "Ali aaye? Ali aaye?" baar-baar. Fatimah (RA) ne kaha: "Goya aapne unhein kisi zaroorat mein bheja hua hai." Unhone kaha: to woh baad mein aaye. Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: to maine socha unhein unse koi zaroorat hai, to hum ghar se nikle aur darwaze ke paas baith gaye, aur main unme se darwaze ke sabse qareeb thi, to Rasulullah (SAW) unke qareeb jhuk gaye aur unse khufiya baatein karne lage, phir usi din Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal ho gaya, to Ali (RA) logon mein sabse zyada aakhri waqt ka ahd rakhne wale nikle.

e: [AI] While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was holding my hand as we were walking in the streets of Madinah, we passed by a garden. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, how beautiful this garden is!" He replied, "You will have something much better than this in Paradise."
hi: Jabke Rasulullah (SAW) mera haath pakde huay the aur hum Madinah ki galiyon mein the, ke humara guzar aik baagh se hua, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh baagh kitna khoobsurat hai!" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare liye Jannat mein isse behtar hai."

e: [AI] I entered with the Prophet ﷺ  to visit Ali ibn Abi Talib while he was sick. Abu Bakr and Umar were also present. They both changed their positions until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sat down. One of them said to his companion, "I see nothing except his destruction." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, "He will not die except as a martyr and he will not die until he is filled with anger."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke sath Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ki iyaadat (mareez-puchhi) ke liye unke paas dakhil hua jabke woh bimaar the, aur unke paas Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) the, dono hat gaye yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) baith gaye, to unme se aik ne apne saathi se kaha: "Mujhe to yeh halaak hote nazar aa rahe hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh sirf shaheed hokar hi marenge, aur yeh tab tak nahi marenge jab tak yeh ghusse se bhar na jaayen." Isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] The following translation is not authentic: "The Prophet ﷺ ordered Ali bin Abi Talib to fight adulterers, oppressors, and rebels."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ko hukum diya ke woh 'Naakitheen' (ahd todne walon - Jamal ke ahl), 'Qaasiteen' (zulm karne walon - Siffin ke ahl), aur 'Maariqeen' (deen se nikal jaane walon - Nahrawan ke ahl) se jung karein." Sahih saabit nahi hui.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying to Ali ibn Abi Talib, "You will fight against the traitors, the oppressors, and the rebels with swords, arrows, and spears." Abu Ayyub said, "O Messenger of Allah, with whom will you fight these people?" He said, "With Ali ibn Abi Talib."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) se yeh farmate suna: "Tum 'Naakitheen,' 'Qaasiteen,' aur 'Maariqeen' se raaston par, Nahrawaan ke maidanon mein, aur pahaadi chotiyon par jung karoge." Abu Ayyub (RA) ne kaha: maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), in qaumo se kiske sath jung hogi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke sath."

e: [AI] Indeed, one of the things that the Prophet ﷺ entrusted to me is that the nation will betray me after him.
hi: "Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse jo ahd liya usme se yeh bhi hai ke Ummat unke baad mere sath dhoka karegi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to Ali, "Verily, you will face challenges after me." Ali asked, "Will I be safe in my religion?" The Prophet replied, "You will be safe in your religion."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (RA) se farmaya: "Khabardaar, tum mere baad sakhti (museebat) ka saamna karoge." Unhone poocha: "Apne deen ki salaamati ke sath?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne deen ki salaamati ke sath."

e: [AI] "Do not come to Iraq, for if you do, you will be struck by the sword's flies." Ali said, "By Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said this to me before you." Abu Al-Aswad said, "I said to myself, 'O Allah, I have never seen a warrior speaking to people like this today.'"
hi: "Iraq mat jaana, kyunke agar tum wahan gaye, to tumhein talwaar ki nok tumhein zakhmi karegi." Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhse yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) ne bhi tumse pehle kahi thi." Abu Al-Aswad ne kaha: to maine apne dil mein kaha: "Aye Allah, maine aaj jaisa koi din nahi dekha, aik jung karne wala aadmi logon ko is tarah ki baat sunaa raha hai."

e: [AI] I and Ali were companions in the Battle of Dhi Al-'Ashirah. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived at the place and stayed there, we saw some people from the tribe of Mudlij working in a date palm grove. Ali said to me, "O Abu Al-Yaqzhan, would you like to go and see what they are doing?" So we went to them and watched their work for a while. Then we felt sleepy and laid down on some palm tree trunks covered with soil. By Allah, only the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke us up by gently moving us with his foot. We had become dirty with that soil. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to me, "O Abu Turab, for the dust that is seen on you." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Shall I inform you about the most wretched men?" We said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Al-Ohaymir, the Thamudite who hamstrung the she-camel, and the one who will harm you, O Ali, with this," and he pointed to his head, meaning the horn, "until blood will come out from it," meaning his beard.
hi: Main aur Ali (RA) Ghazwa Dhil-Ashirah mein saathi the, jab Rasulullah (SAW) wahan utre aur waheen theher gaye, humne Banu Mudlij ke kuch logon ko khajoor ke aik chashme mein kaam karte dekha, to Ali (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Aye Abul-Yaqzan, kya tum in logon ke paas chalo taake hum dekhein woh kaise kaam karte hain?" To hum unke paas gaye aur thodi der unka kaam dekha, phir hum par neend chha gayi, to main aur Ali (RA) chal pade aur khajoor ke tanon ke beech, dhool bhari zameen par let gaye, hum so gaye, Allah ki qasam, humein sirf Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne pair se hilaakar jagaaya, aur hum us dhool se mitti mein latte huay the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Turab (dhool ke baap)," unpar lagi mitti ki wajah se, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tum dono ko sabse badnaseeb do aadmiyon ke baare mein na bataaun?" Humne kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uhaimir Thamud, jisne oontni ki kaanch kaati, aur woh (aadmi) jo tumhein yahan (sar ki taraf ishara) nuqsaan pahunchaayega, Aye Ali, yahan tak ke yeh (daadhi) khoon se tar ho jaaye."

e: [AI] "When Ali went to Siffin and I disliked fighting, so I came to the city and entered upon Maymuna bint Al-Harith. She asked, "Who are you?" I said, "I am from the people of Kufa." She asked, "Which group of them?" I said, "From the Banu 'Amir." She said, "Welcome, you are among generous people and close kin. What has brought you here?" I said, "Ali went to Siffin, and I disliked fighting, so we came here." She asked, "Did you pledge allegiance to him?" I said, "Yes." She said, "Then go back to him and be with him, for by Allah, he will not deviate nor lead others astray.""
hi: Jab Ali (RA) Siffin ki taraf chale, to mujhe jung napasand thi, to main Madinah aaya aur Maymunah (RA) bint Al-Harith ke paas dakhil hua, unhone poocha: "Tum kahan se ho?" Maine kaha: "Kufa se." Unhone poocha: "Unme se kahan se?" Maine kaha: "Banu Aamir se." Unhone kaha: "Khush-aamdeed, qareebi rishtedaar, kya laaya tumhein?" Maine kaha: "Ali (RA) Siffin ki taraf gaye, aur mujhe jung napasand thi, isliye hum yahan aa gaye." Unhone poocha: "Kya tumne unse baiyat ki thi?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "To unke paas wapas jao aur unke sath raho, Allah ki qasam, na woh gumraah huay hain na unse koi gumraah hua hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Looking at Ali is an act of worship."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ali (RA) ki taraf dekhna ibaadat hai." Fabricated.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Looking at the face of Ali is an act of worship." This statement was transmitted by Amr ibn Murrah from Ibrahim al-Nakha'i.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ali (RA) ke chehre ki taraf dekhna ibaadat hai." Amr bin Murrah ne Ibrahim An-Nakha'i se iski mutaabi'at ki hai, aur yeh gadha hua hai. Fabricated.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Looking at the face of Ali is an act of worship."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ali (RA) ke chehre ki taraf dekhna ibaadat hai." Fabricated.

e: [AI] "Omar proposed to her, and by Allah, no one can match what I have matched her with. So Ali married her, and then Omar went to the Muhajireen and said, 'Will you not congratulate me?' They asked, 'Who, O Amir al-Mu'minin?' He replied, 'With Umm Kulthum bint Ali, the daughter of Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Every relationship and alliance will be severed on the Day of Judgment, except for what is from me and my lineage. So I wanted there to be a relationship and alliance between me and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Unse mera nikah karwaao, Allah ki qasam, koi bhi aadmi unke maamle ki jitni dekhbhaal karega utni koi aur nahi karega." To Ali (RA) ne unka nikah unse karwaya. Phir Umar (RA) Muhajireen ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Kya tum mujhe mubarakbaad nahi doge?" Unhone poocha: "Kis par, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen?" Unhone kaha: "Umm Kulthum (RA) bint Ali, aur Fatimah (RA) bint Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti, se, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Har nasab aur sabab Qayamat ke din khatam ho jaayega siwaye mere nasab aur sabab ke,' isliye main chahta tha ke mere aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke darmiyan nasab aur sabab ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If you appoint Abu Bakr as a leader, he will be ascetic in worldly affairs, desiring the Hereafter, and he will have physical weakness. And if you appoint Umar, he will be strong and trustworthy, unafraid of blaming in Allah's cause. And if you appoint Ali, he will guide and lead you upon a straight path."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum Abu Bakr (RA) ko ameer banaao, to woh duniya se be-raghbat, Aakhirat ka khwahishmand hai, aur unke jism mein kamzori hai, aur agar tum Umar (RA) ko ameer banaao, to woh mazboot, amaanatdaar hai, Allah ke maamle mein kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat se nahi darta, aur agar tum Ali (RA) ko ameer banaao, to woh hidayat-yaafta, hidayat dene wala hai, jo tumhein seedhi raah par chalaayega."

e: [AI] To the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I say: "Indeed, the Ummah will betray you after me, while you live according to my path and are killed upon my Sunnah. Whoever loves you, loves me, and whoever hates you, hates me. Indeed, this (beard) will be dyed with (henna) from this (head)." This is from the book "Sahih."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Beshak Ummat mere baad tumse dhoka karegi, jabke tum meri millat par jeete ho aur meri Sunnat par qatl kiye jaaoge, jisne tumse mohabbat ki usne mujhse mohabbat ki, aur jisne tumse dushmani ki usne mujhse dushmani ki, aur beshak yeh (daadhi) is (sar) se rangi jaayegi." Sahih.
