e: [AI] A delegation from the people of Basra arrived to Ali, and among them was a man from the Khawarij known as Al-Jaad bin Na'jah. He praised and thanked Allah and sent blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , then he said, "Fear Allah, O Ali, for indeed you are going to die." Ali replied, "No, but I am going to be killed by a blow on this head that will stain this turban." Ali pointed towards his head and beard with his hand and said, "It is a predestined fate and a promised covenant, and whoever claims otherwise is mistaken." Then he criticized Ali's clothing, to which Ali replied, "If I had worn clothing better than this, it would have made me more distant from humility, and I am more deserving that Muslims follow my example." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this incident in his summary.
hi: Basrah walon ka aik wafd Ali (RA) ke paas aaya, unme Khawarij ka aik aadmi tha jise Al-Ja'd bin Na'jah kaha jaata tha, usne Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, aur Nabi (SAW) par durood bheja, phir kaha: "Allah se daro, Aye Ali, kyunke tum marne wale ho." To Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Nahi, balke main qatl kiya jaaunga, aik zarb se, is (sar) par, jo is (daadhi) ko rang degi," aur Ali (RA) ne apne haath se apne sar aur daadhi ki taraf ishara kiya, "yeh muqarrar faisla hai aur wa'da kiya hua ahd hai, aur naakaam hua jisne jhoot baandha." Phir usne Ali (RA) ke libaas par aitraaz kiya aur kaha: "Kaash aap isse behtar libaas pehnte." To unhone kaha: "Yeh mera libaas ghuroor se mujhe zyada door rakhta hai, aur zyada munaasib hai ke Musalman meri pairavi karein." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Ali was killed on the morning of the twenty-first day of Ramadan. Then I heard Hasan ibn Ali say while delivering a sermon and mentioning the virtues of Ali, he said, "He was killed on the night when the Quran was revealed, and on the night when Jesus was ascended, and on the night when Moses passed away." Hasan ibn Ali then prayed for peace upon them.
hi: Ali (RA) Ramzan ki ikkis (21) tareekh ki subah qatl kiye gaye. Unhone kaha: maine Hasan bin Ali (RA) ko khutba dete suna, unhone Ali (RA) ke manaqib (fazaail) ka zikr kiya, unhone kaha: "Woh us raat qatl kiye gaye jis raat Quran nazil hui, aur jis raat Isa (AS) ko uthaaya gaya, aur jis raat Musa (AS) ki rooh qabz hui." Unhone kaha: aur Hasan bin Ali (RA), unpar salaam ho, ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi.

e: [AI] "That Al-Hasan offered his blessings and gave four takbeer for Ali."
hi: "Beshak Al-Hasan (RA) ne Ali (RA) ki namaz-e-janaza padhi aur unpar chaar (4) takbeerein kahin."

e: [AI] It is said that she was called Qatam. She was married and divorced, and her dowry was 3,000 dirhams. Ali was killed. In this regard, Al-Farazdaq said in Al-Bahr Al-Taweel, "I have never seen a dowry carried by a commendable person like the dowry of Qatam, which was three thousand dirhams, a slave, a freed slave, and Ali was killed with a designated sword." So there is no dowry more valuable than Ali, even if it becomes expensive. And there is no killing except by the killing of Ibn Muljam."
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Muljam Al-Muraadi Khawarij ki aik aurat, Taim Ar-Rabaab qabile se, jise Qatam kaha jaata tha, uske ishq mein tha, to usne uski shart par nikah kiya aur maher (dowry) mein teen hazaar (3000) dirham diye (uski shart Ali RA ka qatl thi), aur Ali (RA) qatl kar diye gaye. Isspar Al-Farazdaq ne (bahr At-Taweel mein) kaha: "Maine kabhi koi maher nahi dekha jo kisi saakhi aadmi ne diya ho, Qatam ke maher jaisa, bagair kisi shak ke, teen hazaar, aik ghulam, aur aik gaane wali laundi, aur Ali (RA) par mazboot talwaar ka waar, isliye Ali (RA) se zyada mehenga koi maher nahi, chahe woh kitna bhi mehenga ho, aur koi qatl Ibn Muljam ke qatl se kam hi hoga."

e: [AI] "He has struck me, so treat him kindly and soften his bedding for him. If I live, it will be reconciliation or punishment, and if I die, treat him kindly and seek justice for him, for I have made him my plaintiff before my Lord, the Exalted and Majestic." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in the summary.
hi: "Usne mujhe maara hai, isliye uske sath achha sulook karo aur uska bistar naram karo, agar main zinda rahoon to (mera faisla) maafi ya qisaas hoga, aur agar main mar jaaun to uska ilaaj karo, kyunke main uske khilaaf apne Rab, buzurg aur buland, ke saamne mudda'i (fariyaadi) houn." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When they brought the son of Muljam to Ali, he said, "Do to him what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did to a man who was given permission to kill him, so he ordered that he be killed and burned with fire." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Jab woh Ibn Muljam ko Ali (RA) ke paas laaye, to unhone kaha: "Uske sath waisa hi karo jaisa Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik aisi aadmi ke sath kiya tha jise unhein qatl karne ki koshish ke liye chhoda gaya tha, unhone hukum diya ke usse qatl kiya jaaye aur aag mein jalaaya jaaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I saw the killer of Ali ibn Abi Talib being burned by fire among the companions of spears."
hi: "Maine Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke qaatil ko neze walon ke darmiyan aag mein jalte huay dekha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "No stone was ever lifted in Al-Iliya on the night of Ali's murder without finding foolish blood underneath it."
hi: "Ali (RA) ke qatl ki raat Iliya (Jerusalem) mein koi patthar aisa nahi uthaaya gaya jiske neeche taaza (surkh) khoon na paaya gaya ho."

e: [AI] Regarding Al-Dhahabi in summarization
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

Aur humein Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Battah Al-Asbahani ne hadith bayan ki, humein Al-Hasan bin Al-Jahm ne hadith bayan ki, humein Al-Husain bin Al-Faraj ne hadith bayan ki, humein Muhammad bin Umar ne hadith bayan ki, mujhse Ali bin Umar bin Ali bin Al-Husain bin Ali bin Abi Talib ne hadith bayan ki, humein Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqeel ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: maine Ibn Al-Hanafiyyah ko us saal mein, jismein unka intiqaal hua, jab main iksyaasi (81) hijri mein dakhil hua, kehte suna: unhone kaha: "Yeh mere paintees (65) saal hain, maine apne waalid ki umr paar kar li, mere waalid tirsath (63) saal ki umr mein faut huay," aur Ibn Al-Hanafiyyah ka intiqaal usi saal hua.

e: [AI] From the ship of Abu Abd al-Rahman, the slave of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , it is narrated that the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "The caliphate of prophethood will last for thirty years." Said Sa'id, "Abu Bakr's caliphate lasted for two years, Umar ibn al-Khattab's lasted for ten years, Uthman ibn Affan's lasted for twelve years, and Ali's lasted for six years." Al-Dhahabi removed it from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: Safinah (RA), Abu Abdur Rahman, Nabi (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, se, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nubuwwat ki khilafat tees (30) saal hai." Sa'eed ne kaha: "Abu Bakr (RA) ne do (2) saal, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne das (10) saal, Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne baarah (12) saal, aur Ali (RA) ne chhah (6) saal (khilafat) rakhi." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "I leave you as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ left us." We said, "O Messenger of Allah, appoint a successor over us." He said, "If Allah knows any good in you, He will guide you to the best among you." 'Ali said, "So Allah guided us to the best among us, and he appointed Abu Bakr as our leader." (This hadith is extracted from Al-Talkhis by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness.)
hi: "Main tumhein waise hi chhod raha houn jaise humein Rasulullah (SAW) ne chhoda." Humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humpar kisi ko khalifa muqarrar kar dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar Allah ko tum mein bhalaai ka ilm hoga, to woh tumhare behtareen shakhs ko tumpar wali banaayega." Ali (RA) ne kaha: "To Allah ne humme bhalaai jaani, isliye usne humpar Abu Bakr (RA) ko wali banaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "O Amir al-Mu'minin, who will succeed us?" He said, "If Allah knows goodness in your hearts, He will appoint the best among you as your successor." Sa'sa'a said, "But Allah knows evil in our hearts, so He appointed us as successors." Al-Dhahabi deleted it from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aap humpar kise khalifa muqarrar karenge?" Unhone kaha: "Agar Allah ko tumhare dilon mein bhalaai ka ilm hoga, to woh tumhare behtareen shakhs ko tumpar khalifa banaayega." Sa'sa'ah ne kaha: "To Allah ne humare dilon mein burai jaani, isliye usne humpar (waise hi) khalifa muqarrar kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "They lied, by Allah, these are not his Shia followers. If we knew he was a prophet, we would not have married his wives or divided his wealth." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Unhone jhoot bola, Allah ki qasam, yeh unke Shia (pairukaar) nahi hain, agar humein pata hota ke woh (Nabi ke roop mein) bheje gaye hote, to hum na unki biwiyon se nikah karte na unka maal taqseem karte." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] They said to my father, "Peace be upon you, O Mahdi." He replied, "Glory be to Allah! Did I not prevent you from this? The Mahdi is only those whom Allah, the Almighty, guides."
hi: Unhone mere waalid se kaha: "Aye Mahdi, aapko salaam ho." Unhone kaha: "Subhanallah, kya maine tumhein isse mana nahi kiya? Mahdi to sirf woh hai jise Allah, buzurg aur buland, hidayat de." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] That Abdullah ibn al-Kawwa' and Shabib ibn Rib'i and others with them separated from Ali after he left Siffin for Kufa, due to their disagreement about the derogatory comments made by Abu Bakr and Umar towards them. Therefore, anyone who came after them from the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  opposed Ali and went against him. Ali and his supporters confronted them without fighting. In a hadith narrated by Abu Ishaq al-Fazari from Shu'ba from Salamah ibn Kuhayl from Abu Juhaifah Ziyadah, there are words of Ali's faith: "Verily, I do not reside with you in a land until I meet Allah, the Almighty." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Beshak Abdullah bin Al-Kawwa aur Shabib bin Rib'i, aur unke sath kuch log, "Ali (RA) se alag ho gaye jab woh Siffin se Kufa wapas laute, is wajah se ke unhone unhein Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) ko bura-bhala kehne se roka, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke un dono ke baad ke sahaba ko bhi, to unhone unki mukhaalifat ki aur unke khilaaf nikal gaye, to Ali (RA) unki taraf nikle aur unse hujjat ki, aur bagair jung kiye wapas laute." Aur Abu Ishaq Al-Fazari ki hadith mein, Shu'bah se, Salamah bin Kuhail se, Abu Juhaifah (RA) se, kuch aur alfaaz ka izaafa hai, unme Ali (RA) ka yeh imaan bhi shaamil hai: "Main kisi shehar mein tum logon ke sath nahi rahunga yahan tak ke main Allah, buzurg aur buland, se milun." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Ali, "Whoever has separated from me has indeed separated from Allah, and whoever has separated from you has indeed separated from me." This statement was removed by Al-Dhahabi from his summary due to its weakness.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA) se farmaya: "Jo mujhse alag hua usne Allah se alag hua, aur jo tumse alag hua usne mujhse alag hua." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] A man called Ali from the believers while he was praying the Fajr prayer, and he recited the verse: "And it has already been revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers" [Al-Zumar 65]. Ali answered him while he was praying: "So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let not those who have no certainty [of faith] discourage you" [Al-Rum 60]. "These are authentic Hadiths with sound chains of narration, and they are not Mursal (i.e. missing a link in the chain of narration). I have verified their authenticity based on the standard procedure" - Al-Dhahabi deleted it from his summary due to its weakness.
hi: Ghulu (had se tajaawuz) karne walon mein se aik aadmi ne Ali (RA) ko pukaara jabke woh Fajr ki namaz mein the, usne kaha: "{Aur beshak tumhari taraf aur tumse pehlon ki taraf wahi ki gayi hai ke agar tumne shirk kiya, to zaroor tumhara amal zaya ho jaayega, aur zaroor tum nuqsaan uthaane walon mein se hoge}" (Surah Az-Zumar 65). To Ali (RA) ne unhein jawaab diya, jabke woh namaz mein the: "{To sabr karo, beshak Allah ka wa'da haq hai, aur woh log jo yaqeen nahi rakhte tumhein halka na samajhein}" (Surah Ar-Rum 60). 'Yeh sahih isnad wali hadithen hain, lekin musnad nahi, isliye main inpar usi tareeqe se hukum lagaata houn jo raayej hai.' Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "In my house, the verse 'Indeed, Allah desires to repel from you filth, O People of the Household' [33:33] was revealed. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, 'Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husayn are the People of my Household.'"
hi: "Meri ghar mein yeh nazil hui: {Allah to bas yehi chahta hai ke tumse, Ahl-e-Bait, gandagi door kare}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33). Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA), Fatimah (RA), Hasan (RA), aur Husain (RA) ki taraf paighaam bheja, phir farmaya: "Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain."

e: [AI] I went to Ali and did not find him, so Fatima said to me, "Go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and call him." So he came with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and they entered, and I entered with them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ called Hasan and Husayn and seated each of them on his thighs, brought Fatima closer to him, along with her husband, then wrapped them with a cloak and said, "Indeed, Allah only desires to remove impurities from you, O people of the household, and to purify you thoroughly." [Quran 33:33] Then he said, "These are my household. O Allah, they are more deserving."
hi: Main Ali (RA) ke paas aaya, magar unhein na paaya, to Fatimah (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas jao aur unhein bulaao." To woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aaye, dono dakhil huay aur main unke sath dakhil hua, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA) ko bulaaya, har aik ko apni raanon par bithaaya, aur Fatimah (RA) ko apni god ke qareeb kiya aur unke shohar ko bhi, phir unpar aik kapda lapeta aur kaha: "{Allah to bas yehi chahta hai ke tumse, Ahl-e-Bait, gandagi door kare}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33), "aur tumhein khoob paak kar de," phir farmaya: "Yeh mere Ahl-e-Bait hain, Aye Allah, mere Ahl-e-Bait sabse zyada haqdaar hain."

e: Allah only desires to take away any uncleanliness from you, O people of the household, and purify you (thorough purifying) (Using translation from Muslim 2424)
hi: Nabi (SAW) aik subah nikle jabke unpar kaale baalon ki bani hui, khoobsurat tarah-daar chaadar thi, to Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA) aaye, unhein apne sath dakhil kiya, phir Fatimah (RA) aayin, unhein bhi unke sath dakhil kiya, phir Ali (RA) aaye, unhein bhi unke sath dakhil kiya, phir farmaya: "{Allah to bas yehi chahta hai ke tumse, Ahl-e-Bait, gandagi door kare, aur tumhein khoob paak kar de}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33).

e: [AI] Saad received the revelation from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Then, he brought Ali, Fatimah, and their two sons under his robe. He said, "O Allah, these are my family and the people of my household" - Ali and Al-Bakir - and spoke about them.
hi: Sa'd (RA): Rasulullah (SAW) par wahi nazil hui, to unhone Ali (RA), Fatimah (RA), aur unke dono betay apne kapde ke neeche kar liya, phir farmaya: "Aye Allah, yeh mere ghar wale aur mere Ahl-e-Bait hain." Ali aur Bukair (naam ke raawiyon) ke baare mein baat ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw the descending mercy, he said, "Pray for me, pray for me." Safiyah asked, "Who should we pray for, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Pray for the people of my household, Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husayn." They were brought to him, and he placed his cloak over them. Then he raised his hands and said, "O Allah, these are my family, so bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad." Allah the Exalted then revealed, "Indeed, Allah wants to repel impurity from you, O people of the household, and purify you with thorough purification." [Surah Al-Ahzab 33]
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne rehmat ko nazil hote dekha, to farmaya: "Mere liye bulaao, mere liye bulaao." Safiyyah (RA) ne poocha: "Kise, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere Ahl-e-Bait ko - Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, aur Husain." To unhein laaya gaya, Nabi (SAW) ne unpar apni chaadar daali, phir apne dono haath uthaaye aur farmaya: "Aye Allah, yeh mere ghar wale hain, isliye Muhammad (SAW) aur Muhammad (SAW) ke ghar walon par durood bhej." Aur Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne yeh nazil ki: "{Allah to bas yehi chahta hai ke tumse, Ahl-e-Bait, gandagi door kare, aur tumhein khoob paak kar de}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33).

e: [AI] Ka'b ibn 'Ujrah met me and said, "Should I not give you a gift that I heard from the Prophet ﷺ?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Say, 'O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You have sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are commendable and glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are praiseworthy and glorious.'" This hadith has been narrated by Imam Muhammad ibn Ismail al-Bukhari from Musa ibn Ismail in his authentic compilation. I have mentioned it so that the beneficiary may know that all the Ahl al-Bayt (Family of the Prophet) and the descendants, as well as Abu Farwah and Urwah ibn al-Harith al-Hamdani, are among the reliable companions in Kufa.
hi: Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) mujhse mila aur kaha: "Kya main tumhein aik tohfa na doon jo maine Nabi (SAW) se suna?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "To woh mujhe (bhi) tohfe mein do." Unhone kaha: humne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha, humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap Ahl-e-Bait par durood kaise bhejein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammadin kama sallaita ala Ibrahima wa ala aali Ibrahima innaka Hameedun Majeed, Allahumma barik ala Muhammadin wa ala aali Muhammadin kama barakta ala Ibrahima wa ala aali Ibrahima innaka Hameedun Majeed (Aye Allah, Muhammad aur Muhammad ke ghar walon par rehmat bhej jaisa tu ne Ibrahim (AS) aur Ibrahim (AS) ke ghar walon par bheji, beshak tu tareef ke qaabil, buzurg hai, Aye Allah, Muhammad aur Muhammad ke ghar walon par barkat bhej jaisa tu ne Ibrahim (AS) aur Ibrahim (AS) ke ghar walon par bheji, beshak tu tareef ke qaabil, buzurg hai)." Imam Muhammad bin Ismail Al-Bukhari ne yeh hadith apni isnad aur alfaaz ke sath, lafz-ba-lafz, Musa bin Ismail se, Al-Jami' As-Sahih mein riwayat ki hai, aur maine ise isliye nikaala taake faayda uthaane wale ko pata chale ke Ahl-e-Bait aur Aal dono aik hi hain, aur Abu Farwah aur Urwah bin Al-Harith Al-Hamdani Kufa ke sabse bharosemand Tabi'een mein se hain.

e: [AI] Narrated by him, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am leaving behind among you two weighty things, the Book of Allah and my family, and these two will never be separated until they meet me at the Pond (of Kawthar)."
hi: Unse, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tum mein do bhaari cheezein chhod raha houn - Allah ki Kitaab, aur mere Ahl-e-Bait, aur woh dono kabhi juda nahi honge yahan tak ke Hauz (Kauthar) par mujhse aa milein."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O children of Abd al-Muttalib, indeed I have asked Allah for three things for you: that He strengthens your leader, guides your misguided ones, and teaches knowledge to your ignorant ones. And I have also asked Allah to make you generous, noble, and compassionate. So, if a man stands in prayer and in fasting and then meets Allah while harboring hatred towards the family of Muhammad, he shall enter the fire."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Banu Abdul Muttalib, maine tumhare liye Allah se teen (baaten) maangi hain - ke woh tumhare khade honay wale ko mazbooti de, tumhare gumraah ko hidayat de, aur tumhare jaahil ko sikhaaye, aur maine Allah se maanga ke woh tumhein saakhi, bahaadur, aur reham karne wala banaaye, to agar koi aadmi Rukn aur Maqaam ke darmiyan khada ho, namaz padhe, roza rakhe, phir Allah se ismein mile ke woh Muhammad (SAW) ke Ahl-e-Bait se dushmani rakhta ho, to woh Jahannam mein dakhil hoga."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ looked at Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husain and said, "I am at war with whoever wages war against you, and I am at peace with whoever makes peace with you."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (RA), Fatimah (RA), Hasan (RA), aur Husain (RA) ki taraf dekha aur farmaya: "Main uske sath jung karunga jo tumse jung kare, aur uske sath sulah karunga jo tumse sulah kare."

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ , that he said to Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Hussein: 'I am a war for those who wage war against you, and a peace for those who make peace with you.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, unhone Ali (RA), Fatimah (RA), Hasan (RA), aur Husain (RA) se farmaya: "Main uske sath jung karunga jisse tum jung karo, aur uske sath sulah karunga jisse tum sulah karo." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The stars are a source of safety for the people of the Earth from drowning, and the people of my household are a source of safety for my Ummah (nation) from division. So if a tribe among the Arabs opposes them, they will become the party of Satan."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sitare zameen walon ke liye doobne (halaakat) se aman hain, aur mere Ahl-e-Bait meri Ummat ke liye ikhtilaaf se aman hain, isliye agar Arab ka koi qabila unki mukhaalifat kare, to woh ikhtilaaf mein pad jaayenge aur Iblees ke giroh ban jaayenge." Fabricated.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Love Allah for what He nourishes you with of His Blessings, love me due to the love of Allah, and love the people of my house due to love of me." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3789)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah se mohabbat karo uski ne'maton ki wajah se jinse woh tumhein khilaata hai, aur mujhse mohabbat karo Allah ki mohabbat ki wajah se, aur mere Ahl-e-Bait se mohabbat karo meri mohabbat ki wajah se."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "By the One in whose hand is my soul, none from the people of the household dislikes us except that Allah will admit them into the Fire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, humse, Ahl-e-Bait se, koi bhi dushmani nahi rakhta magar Allah usse aag mein dakhil karega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "My Lord has promised me that anyone among my family who affirms the Oneness of Allah and supports me in conveying the message will not be punished." Omar bin Sa'id Al-Ahha narrated, and Sa'id bin Abi 'Arubah died on Thursday, and he had narrated this hadith on Friday. He died seven days later in the mosque. Some people said, "May Allah reward you, O companion of rejection and calamity." And some people said, "May Allah reward you, O companion of the Sunnah and the community. You have fulfilled what you have heard."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere Rab ne mujhse mere Ahl-e-Bait ke baare mein wa'da kiya hai ke unme se jo Tawheed ka iqrar kare, aur mera paighaam pahunchaane ka haq ada kare, use azaab nahi dega." Umar bin Sa'eed Al-Abah ne kaha, aur Sa'eed bin Abi Arubah Jumeraat ke din faut huay, aur unhone yeh hadith Jumme ke din bayan ki thi, unka intiqaal usse saat din baad masjid mein hua, to kuch logon ne kaha: "Allah tumhein achha badla na de, rafd (inkaar/Shia-mail) aur museebat wale sathi," aur kuch logon ne kaha: "Allah tumhein achha badla de, Sunnat aur jama'at wale sathi, tumne jo suna woh ada kar diya."

e: from his father who said: "When this Ayah was revealed: 'Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women... (3:61)' the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called 'Ali, Fatimah, Hasan and Husain and said: 'O Allah! This is my family.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2999)
hi: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "{Aao hum apne betay aur tumhare betay bulaayen, aur apni auraten aur tumhari auraten, aur apni jaanein aur tumhari jaanein}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 61), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA), Fatimah (RA), Hasan (RA), aur Husain (RA) ko bulaaya, phir farmaya: "Aye Allah, yeh mere ghar wale hain."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Dharr saying while holding onto the door of the Kaaba, "Whoever knows me, I am the one who knows myself, and whoever denies me, I am Abu Dharr. I heard the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ saying, 'Surely the example of my Ahlul Bayt (family) among you is like the ark of Noah among his people. Whoever boards it will be saved, and whoever stays behind will drown.'" - Mufaddal ibn Salih Al-Wah.
hi: Maine Abu Dharr (RA) ko kehte suna jabke woh Ka'bah ke darwaze ko thaame huay the: "Jo mujhe pehchaanta hai to woh (jaanta hai) main kaun houn, aur jo mujhe inkaar kare to main Abu Dharr houn, maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Khabardaar, tum mein mere Ahl-e-Bait ki misaal Nooh (AS) ki kashti jaisi hai unki qaum mein, jo usme sawaar hua woh bach gaya, aur jo peechhe reh gaya woh doob gaya.'" Mufaddal bin Salih waah (kamzor) hain. Repudiated.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "An angel descended from the heavens and sought permission from Allah to greet me. No angel had ever descended before that. The angel gave me glad tidings that Fatimah is the leader of the women of the people of Paradise." This narration was transmitted by Abu Maryam al-Ansari from al-Minhaal, and it is authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik farishta aasman se utra, usne Allah se ijaazat maangi ke woh mujhe salaam kare, isse pehle woh kabhi nahi utra tha, usne mujhe khush-khabri di ke Fatimah Jannat ki auraton ki sardaar hain." Abu Maryam (RA) Al-Ansari ne Al-Minhaal se iski mutaabi'at ki hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, he said, "An angel descended from heaven and sought permission from Allah to greet me. No angel had descended before him. He gave me the glad tidings that Fatimah is the leader of the women of Paradise."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik farishta aasman se utra, usne Allah se ijaazat maangi ke woh mujhe salaam kare, isse pehle woh kabhi nahi utra tha, usne mujhe khush-khabri di ke Fatimah Jannat ki auraton ki sardaar hain."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  told me: "The first people to enter paradise are me, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husain." I asked, "O messenger of Allah, what about our lovers?" He replied, "They are behind you." This hadith has a authentic chain of narration and it has not been classified as rejected.
hi: Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne bataya: "Sabse pehle Jannat mein dakhil honay wale main, Fatimah, Hasan, aur Husain honge." Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to humse mohabbat karne wale?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare peechhe." Isnad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikaala, (lekin) yeh hadith munkar (radd-shuda) hai. Extremely Weak.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to us and placed his leg between me and Fatimah. He taught us what to say when we go to our bed. He said, "O Fatimah, when both of you are in your place, then say 'SubhanAllah' (Glory be to Allah) thirty-three times, 'Alhamdulillah' (Praise be to Allah) thirty-three times, and 'Allahu Akbar' (Allah is the Greatest) thirty-four times." Ali said, "By Allah, I have never left it since." Then, a man who had something on his mind or was doubtful said, "And not even on the night of Siffin?" Ali replied, "Not even on the night of Siffin." It is Sahih (authentic) according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but they did not include it in their collections.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas aaye aur apna pair mere aur Fatimah (RA) ke darmiyan rakha, humein sikhaaya ke jab hum apne bistar par jaayen to kya kahein, farmaya: "Aye Fatimah, jab tum dono apni jagah par ho, to Allah ki tasbeeh (Subhanallah) tetees (33) baar, hamd (Alhamdulillah) tetees (33) baar, aur takbeer (Allahu Akbar) chauntees (34) baar kaho." Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maine isse kabhi nahi chhoda." To aik aadmi ne, jiske dil mein unke khilaaf kuch tha, poocha: "Siffin ki raat bhi nahi?" Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Siffin ki raat bhi nahi." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered upon Fatimah and I was with him. She had taken a golden necklace from her neck, and she said, "Abu Hassan gave this as a gift to me." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Fatimah, would it please you if people said, 'Fatimah, daughter of Muhammad,' while you have a necklace of fire in your hand?" Then he left without sitting. Fatimah then hurried to the necklace, sold it, and bought a slave whom she freed. When the Prophet ﷺ  was informed about this, he said, "All praise is due to Allah, who saved Fatimah from the Fire." This hadith is considered authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim), but it is not mentioned in their collections.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Fatimah (RA) ke paas dakhil huay, aur main unke sath tha, unhone apni gardan se sone ki aik zanjeer utaari thi, unhone kaha: "Yeh mujhe Abu Hasan (Ali RA) ne tohfe mein di hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Fatimah, kya tumhein yeh pasand hai ke log kahein: Fatimah bint Muhammad (SAW), jabke tumhare haath mein aag ki zanjeer hai?" Phir woh baghair baithe chale gaye, to Fatimah (RA) us zanjeer ki taraf gayin, usse aik ghulam khareeda aur usse aazaad kar diya, yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to unhone farmaya: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne Fatimah ko aag se bachaaya." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Fatimah safeguarded her chastity, so Allah has made her descendants forbidden from the Hellfire."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Fatimah ne apni sharm-gaah ki hifaazat ki, to Allah ne unki aulaad ko aag par haraam kar diya." Weak.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The prophets will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment riding on animals, in order to meet and gather the believers from their communities in the gathering place. Prophet Saleh will be resurrected on his camel, and I will be resurrected on Al-Buraq, the step of which reaches the farthest point, and Fatimah will be resurrected in front of me."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nabi Qayamat ke din apne jaanwaron par uthaaye jaayenge taake apni qaum ke momino ke sath maidan-e-hashar mein pahunchein, aur Saleh (AS) apni oontni par uthaaye jaayenge, aur main Buraq par uthaaya jaaunga, jiska qadam uski nazar ki aakhri had tak hoga, aur Fatimah mere aage uthaayi jaayengi." Weak, Rejected.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying: "On the Day of Resurrection, a caller will call from behind the veil, 'O people in the gathering, lower your gazes from Fatimah, the daughter of Muhammad ﷺ , until she passes by.'"
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jab Qayamat ka din hoga, to aik pukarne wala parde ke peechhe se pukaarega: Aye jama'at walo, apni nigahein Fatimah bint Muhammad (SAW) se neechi karo, yahan tak ke woh guzar jaayen." Fabricated.

e: "Fatimah bint Hubairah came to the Messenger of Allah [SAW] with a big ring on her hand." He (the narrator) said: "This is what I found in the book of my father, a huge ring."- "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] started hitting her hand, so she entered upon Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah [SAW], and complained to her about what the Messenger of Allah [SAW] had done. Fatimah took off a gold chain from her neck and said: 'This was given to me by Abu Hasan.' The Messenger of Allah [SAW] came in and ﷺ the chain in her hand. He said: 'O Fatimah, would you like the people to say that the daughter of the Messenger of Allah [SAW] has a chain of fire in her hand?' Then he went out, without sitting down. Fatimah sent the chain to the market and sold it, and she bought a slave with the money, and set him free. He was told of that and he said: 'Praise be to Allah, Who has saved Fatimah from the Fire.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5140)
hi: Thawban (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, se, unhone kaha: Hubairah ki beti Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi jabke uske haath mein sone ki anguthiyaan ya challe the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne uska haath maarna shuru kiya, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Fatimah (RA) ke paas gayi aur unse Rasulullah (SAW) ke is sulook ki shikaayat ki. Thawban (RA) ne kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) Fatimah (RA) ke paas dakhil huay, aur main unke sath tha, unhone apni gardan se sone ki aik zanjeer utaari thi, unhone kaha: "Yeh mujhe Abu Hasan ne tohfe mein di hai," aur zanjeer unke haath mein thi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Fatimah, kya tumhein yeh pasand hai ke log kahein: Fatimah bint Muhammad (SAW), jabke tumhare haath mein aag ki zanjeer hai?" Phir Rasulullah (SAW) baghair baithe chale gaye, to Fatimah (RA) us zanjeer ki taraf gayin, usse bech kar aik ghulam khareeda aur usse aazaad kar diya, yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to unhone farmaya: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne Fatimah ko aag se bachaaya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Fatimah, "Indeed, Allah becomes angry when you become angry, and He becomes pleased when you are pleased."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fatimah (RA) se farmaya: "Beshak Allah tumhare ghusse par ghussa hota hai, aur tumhari raza par raazi hota hai." Repudiated.

e: [AI] "I entered with my mother to Aisha, and I heard her from behind the veil asking her about Ali. She said, 'You ask me about a man, by Allah, I do not know a man who was more beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ than Ali, nor a woman on earth who was more beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ than his wife.'"
hi: Main apni maa ke sath Aisha (RA) ke paas dakhil hua, maine unhein parde ke peechhe se suna, woh unse Ali (RA) ke baare mein poochh rahi thin, to unhone kaha: "Tum mujhse aik aise aadmi ke baare mein poochti ho, Allah ki qasam, main kisi aise aadmi ko nahi jaanti jo Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ali (RA) se zyada aziz ho, aur na hi zameen par koi aisi aurat hai jo Rasulullah (SAW) ko unki biwi (Fatimah RA) se zyada aziz ho."

e: [AI] She said, "I have never seen anyone speak and converse more closely to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  than Fatimah. Whenever she entered upon him, he would receive her warmly, stand up to greet her, take her hand, and kiss her, then he would make her sit with him in his gathering."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Maine kisi ko baat aur guftagu mein Fatimah (RA) se zyada Rasulullah (SAW) se milta-julta nahi dekha, aur jab woh unke paas dakhil hotin, to woh unka khair-maqdam karte, unki taraf khade hote, unka haath pakadte, unhein bosa dete, aur unhein apni majlis mein bithaate."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Fatimah is the leader of the women of Paradise, except for Maryam bint Imran."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fatimah Jannat ki auraton ki sardaar hain, siwaye Maryam bint Imran (AS) ke."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, "Indeed, Fatimah is a part of me. She gives me joy when she is happy, and she brings me sorrow when she is sad."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fatimah mujhse aik tukda hain, jo unhein khush kare woh mujhe khush karta hai, aur jo unhein pareshaan kare woh mujhe pareshaan karta hai."

e: [AI] "Fatimah was the beloved of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  among women, and Ali was among the men."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko auraton mein sabse zyada aziz Fatimah thin, aur mardon mein Ali."

e: [AI] He entered upon Fatima, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Fatima, by Allah, I have not seen anyone more beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  than you. And by Allah, no one among the people after your father ﷺ  is more beloved to me than you."
hi: Ke woh Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay aur kaha: "Aye Fatimah, Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi kisi ko Rasulullah (SAW) ko aapse zyada aziz nahi dekha, aur Allah ki qasam, aapke waalid (SAW) ke baad koi bhi shakhs mujhe aapse zyada aziz nahi." Weak, Rejected.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani saying that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) would enter the mosque after returning from a battle or a journey, and he would pray two units of prayer. Then he would bow in front of Fatimah and then visit his wives. When he returned home, Fatimah met him at the door of the house, and she covered her mouth with her cloak and her eyes were shedding tears. He said to her, "O my daughter, what makes you cry?" She said, "O Messenger of Allah, don't I see you tired and your clothes are dusty?" He said, "So don't cry, for Allah has sent your father for a matter that will not leave any house or hair on the face of the earth, except that Allah will bring honor or humiliation through it, until it reaches where the night reaches."
hi: Maine Abu Tha'labah Al-Khushani (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) jab kisi jung ya safar se wapas aate, to masjid mein aate aur usme do rak'atein padhte, phir Fatimah (RA) se milte, phir apni biwiyon ke paas jaate. Jab woh wapas aaye, masjid se nikle, Fatimah (RA) ne unka istaqbaal ghar ke darwaze par kiya, unka mun choomti, aur unki aankhein ro rahi thin, to aap (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye meri beti, tumhein kis baat ne rulaaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main aapko pareshaan aur thaka huay nahi dekh rahi, aapke kapde phate huay hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To mat ro, kyunke Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne tumhare waalid ko aise maqsad ke liye bheja hai ke zameen ki satah par koi mitti ka ghar na koi baal (khaimon) ka ghar nahi bachega magar Allah usse izzat ya zillat mein dakhil kar dega, yahan tak ke woh wahan tak pahunche jahan tak raat pahunchti hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Jibril (Gabriel) came to me with a handful of Jannah (Paradise) and I ate it on the night of my Mi'raj (Ascension). Khadijah caught the scent of it on Fatimah and whenever I longed for the scent of Jannah, I would smell the neck of Fatimah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS), unpar salaam ho, mere paas Jannat se aik 'Safarjalah' (bihi/quince phal) laaye, maine ise raat ko khaaya jab mujhe isra karaaya gaya, to Khadijah (RA) Fatimah (RA) se haamila hui, isliye jab bhi mujhe Jannat ki khushbu ki khwahish hoti, main Fatimah (RA) ki gardan soonghta."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  used to be the last person to bid farewell to Fatimah when he traveled and the first person to greet her when he returned from a journey."
hi: "Beshak Nabi (SAW) jab safar par jaate, to logon mein se sabse aakhri jisse woh milte woh Fatimah (RA) hoti thin, aur jab safar se wapas aate, to logon mein se sabse pehli jisse woh milte woh Fatimah (RA) hoti thin," unpar salaam ho.

e: [AI] "From Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her."
hi: Aisha (RA) se, Allah unse raazi ho.

e: "Fatimah came to the Prophet (saas) to ask him for a servant, and he said: 'I do not have anything to give you.' So she went back, but after that he came to her and said: 'Is what you asked for dearer to you, or something better than that?' 'Ali said to her: 'Say: something better than that.' So she said it. He said: 'Say: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-Sab'i wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azim, Rabbana wa Rabba Kulli shay'in, munzil at-Tawrati wal-Injili wal-Qur'anil-'Azim. Antal-Awwalu fa laysa qablaka shay', wa Antal-Akiru fa laysa ba'daka shay', Antaz-Zahiru fa laysa fawqaka shay', wa Antal-Batinu fa laysa dunaka shay', Iqdi 'annad-daina wa aghnina minal-faqr (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Mighty Throne, Our Lord, and the Lord of Everything, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injil and the Magnificent Qur'an. You are the First and there is nothing after You; You are the Last and there is nothing after You. You are the Most High, and there is nothing above You, and You are the Most Near and there is nothing nearer than You. Settle our debts and make us free of want).'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3831)
hi: Fatimah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayin, unse aik khadim (naukar) maang rahi thin, to aap (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Jo tum maangne aayi ho, kya woh tumhein zyada aziz hai ya usse behtar cheez?" Unhone kaha: to mera gumaan hai ke unhone Ali (RA) se (sawaal) poocha, unhone kaha: kaho: "Aye Allah, Rab aasmaano ka aur Rab Arsh-e-Azeem ka, humare Rab aur har cheez ke Rab, Taurat, Injeel, aur Quran nazil karne wale, daane aur ginthli phaadne wale, main teri panaah maangta houn har us cheez ki buraai se jiski peshaani tere qabze mein hai, Tu Awwal (pehla) hai, tujhse pehle kuch nahi, aur Tu Aakhir (aakhri) hai, tere baad kuch nahi, aur Tu Zaahir hai, tujhse oopar kuch nahi, aur Tu Baatin hai, tujhse zyada qareeb kuch nahi, humara qarz ada kar de aur humein faqr se be-niyaaz kar de."

e: [AI] The Prophet of Allah ﷺ  said, "O my daughter, go and live." Then he went out and entered the mosque, and they lifted their heads and then covered them. Then he took a handful of dust and threw it towards them, and then he said, "The faces have been changed. None of them was affected except that he was killed on the Day of Badr."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) (ne farmaya): "Aye meri beti, sukoon rakho." Phir woh nikle aur masjid mein unke paas dakhil huay, unhone apne sar uthaaye, phir jhuka liye, to unhone mitti ki aik mutthi li aur unki taraf phenki, phir farmaya: "Yeh chehre bad-numa (badnaseeb) hon," to unme se koi bhi aisa nahi tha jo Badr ke din qatl na hua ho.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) married his daughter Fatima to Ali ibn Abi Talib and ordered him not to enter upon Fatima until he permits him." This hadith was mentioned with a sound chain of narration and it was not mentioned by Imam Ibn Majah.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni beti Fatimah (RA) ka nikah Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) se kiya, aur unhein hukum diya ke woh Fatimah (RA) ke paas na jaayen jab tak unke paas (ijaazat lekar) na aayen," aur hadith zikr ki. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Mursal.

e: [AI] I entered with my aunt to Aisha, and she was asked which person was the most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? She said, "Fatimah." It was then asked, "And among the men?" She said, "Her husband, if what I know of him is true, he was a strong and devoted worshipper."
hi: Main apni phupi ke sath Aisha (RA) ke paas dakhil hua, unse poocha gaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko sabse zyada kaun aziz tha?" Unhone kaha: "Fatimah." Poocha gaya: "To mardon mein se?" Unhone kaha: "Unke shohar, agar jo mujhe unke baare mein pata hai woh sach hai, woh bohot roza rakhne wale, bohot namaz padhne wale the."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Among the women of the world, four are sufficient for you: Mary, the daughter of Imran; Asiya, the wife of Pharaoh; Khadijah, the daughter of Khuwaylid; and Fatimah, the daughter of Muhammad." This hadith is found in the Musnad of Abu Abdullah Ahmad ibn Hanbal. The mention of it was omitted by Adh-Dhahabi from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jahaan walon ki auraton mein tumhare liye chaar kaafi hain - Maryam bint Imran (AS), Aasiya, Firaun ki biwi, Khadijah bint Khuwailid (RA), aur Fatimah bint Muhammad (SAW)." Yeh hadith Abu Abdullah Ahmad bin Hanbal ki Musnad mein isi tarah hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Sufficient for you among the women of mankind are Mariam bint 'Imran, Khadijah bint Khuwailid, Fatimah bint Muhammad and Asiyah the wife of Fir'awn." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3878)
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jahaan walon ki auraton mein tumhare liye Maryam bint Imran (AS), Aasiya, Firaun ki biwi, Khadijah bint Khuwailid (RA), aur Fatimah bint Muhammad (SAW) kaafi hain."

e: [AI] "He said to him, 'Let him come to me in the darkness.' So, he went to him and praised Allah and spoke highly of him. Then he said, 'After that, by Allah, there is no lineage, nor reason, nor in-law that I love more than your lineage, your reason, and your in-law. However, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Fatimah is a part of me; whoever hurts her, hurts me, and whoever pleases her, pleases me. On the Day of Resurrection, lineages will be cut off except for my lineage, reason, and in-laws.' And you have his daughter, and if I were to marry you to her, that would be acceptable. So, go, you are excused.'"
hi: Unse kaha gaya: "Unhein kaho ke woh Isha ke waqt mujhse milein." Unhone kaha: to woh unse mile, Al-Miswar (RA) ne Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir kaha: "Ammaa ba'd, Allah ki qasam, koi nasab, sabab, ya sasural aisa nahi jo mujhe tumhare nasab, sabab, aur sasural se zyada aziz ho, lekin Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Fatimah mujhse aik tukda hain, jo unhein pareshaan kare woh mujhe pareshaan karta hai, aur jo unhein khush kare woh mujhe khush karta hai, aur Qayamat ke din har nasab khatam ho jaayega siwaye mere nasab, sabab, aur sasural ke,' aur tumhare paas unki beti hai, agar main tumhara nikah karvaata to yeh (baat) unhein pareshaan karti." To woh maazrat qubool karte huay chale gaye.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to pass by the door of Fatimah for six months when he went out for the Fajr prayer. He would say, "O people of the household, prayer! Indeed, Allah desires to remove impurity from you, O people of the household, and purify you with a thorough purification." [Al-Ahzab 33]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) chhah (6) mahine tak Fatimah (RA) ke darwaze se guzarte the jab woh Fajr ki namaz ke liye nikalte, kehte: "Namaz, Aye Ahl-e-Bait, {Allah to bas yehi chahta hai ke tumse, Ahl-e-Bait, gandagi door kare, aur tumhein khoob paak kar de}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 33).

e: [AI] Ali, the son of Abu Jahl, spoke to his uncle Al-Harith ibn Hisham, seeking advice from the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . Ali asked, "Should I marry her, even though I know her social status?" The Prophet replied, "Fatimah (the daughter of the Prophet) is a piece of me. I cannot bear to see her sad or distressed." Ali then said, "I will not do anything that she dislikes."
hi: Ali (RA) ne Abu Jahl ki beti ke liye uske chacha Al-Harith bin Hisham se paighaam bheja, to unhone Nabi (SAW) se mashwara kiya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum mujhse uske hasab (khaandaani martaba) ke baare mein poochte ho?" Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe uska hasab pata hai, lekin kya aap mujhe iski ijaazat dete hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, Fatimah mera aik hissa hain, aur mujhe lagta hai isse unhein gham ya bechaini hogi." To Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Main koi aisi cheez nahi karunga jo aapko napasand ho."

e: [AI] From Abu Hanthalah, a man from the people of Makkah, it is reported that Ali proposed to the daughter of Abu Jahl. Her family said to him, "We will not marry you to the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  heard about this, he said, "Indeed, Fatimah is a part of me. Whoever harms her has harmed me."
hi: Abu Hanzalah, Makkah ke ahl mein se aik aadmi, se, Ali (RA) ne Abu Jahl ki beti ke liye paighaam bheja, to uske ghar walon ne unse kaha: "Hum aapki shaadi Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti par nahi karwaayenge." Yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fatimah mujhse aik tukda hain, isliye jisne unhein takleef di usne mujhe takleef di."

e: that 'Ali mentioned the daughter of Abu Jahl (for marriage), and that reached the Prophet ﷺ so he said: "Indeed Fatimah is but a part of me, I am harmed by what harms her and I am uncomfortable by what makes her uncomfortable." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3869)
hi: Ali (RA) ne Abu Jahl ki beti ka zikr kiya, yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fatimah mujhse aik tukda hain, jo unhein takleef de mujhe takleef deta hai, aur jo unhein pareshaan kare mujhe pareshaan karta hai."

e: [AI] "I was at the wedding of Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When we woke up in the morning, the Prophet ﷺ  came to the door and said, 'O Umm Ayman, pray for my brother.' She replied, 'He is your brother and you are marrying him.' He said, 'Yes, O Umm Ayman.' Then Ali came and the Prophet ﷺ  poured water on him and prayed for him. Then he said, 'Pray for Fatimah for me.' She hesitated due to shyness, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  told her, 'Stay, for I have married you to the most beloved of my family to me.' She said, and the Prophet ﷺ  poured water on her. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned and saw someone with a black color in front of him, so he asked, 'Who is this?' I said, 'I am Asma bint Umayz.' He asked, 'Did you come to the wedding of the daughter of the Messenger of Allah?' I answered, 'Yes.' Then he prayed for me." (The last sentence seems to be incorrectly translated)
hi: Main Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW) ki rukhsati mein maujood tha, jab subah hui, to Nabi (SAW) darwaze par aaye aur kaha: "Aye Umm Aiman (RA), mere bhai ko bulaao." Unhone kaha: "Woh aapka bhai hai aur aap unki shaadi karwaate hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, Aye Umm Aiman." To Ali (RA) aaye, Nabi (SAW) ne unpar paani chhidka aur unke liye dua ki, phir farmaya: "Fatimah ko mere liye bulaao." Unhone kaha: to woh sharm se lagzish khaati hui aayin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Sukoon rakho, maine tumhara nikah apne Ahl-e-Bait mein sabse zyada aziz shakhs se karwaaya hai." Unhone kaha: aur Nabi (SAW) ne unpar bhi paani chhidka, phir Rasulullah (SAW) wapas mudhe, unhone apne saamne aik saaya dekha, poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Main Asma (RA) bint Umais houn." Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti ki rukhsati mein aayi ho?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan," to unhone mere liye dua ki. Hadith mein ghalti hai.

e: [AI] She said, "I have never seen anyone who spoke and conversed more closely to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  than Fatimah. Whenever she entered upon him, he would stand up for her, kiss her, welcome her, take her hand, and seat her in his gathering. And when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered upon her, she would stand up to receive him and kiss his hand."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Maine kisi ko baat aur guftagu mein Fatimah se zyada Rasulullah (SAW) se milta-julta nahi dekha, aur jab woh unke paas dakhil hotin, to woh unki taraf khade hote, unhein bosa dete, unka khair-maqdam karte, unka haath pakadte, aur unhein apni majlis mein bithaate, aur jab Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas dakhil hote, to woh unhein aage badh kar milti aur unka haath choomti."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  drew four lines on the ground, and then he said, "Do you know what this is?" They replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best women of the people of Paradise are four: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, and two others."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne zameen par chaar lakeerein khainchi, phir farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai yeh kya hain?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ki behtareen auraten chaar hain - Khadijah bint Khuwailid (RA), aur Fatimah bint Muhammad (SAW)," hadith.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah say, "I am the tree, and Fatimah is its branch, and Ali is its sap, and Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are its fruits, and our Shi'a are its leaves, and the root of the tree is in the Garden of Eden, and the rest of it is in the rest of Paradise." This is an unusual text, and even if that is the case, Isaac Al-Dabari is reliable, and Abdul Razzaq and his father and grandfather are truthful, and the port of the servant of Abdul Rahman ibn Auf has met the Prophet and heard from him, and Allah knows best. This statement was made by a human being other than the ruler, and it is only the opinion of a misguided follower.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Main woh darakht houn, aur Fatimah uski shaakh hain, aur Ali uska baar-aawar (phal denay wala hissa) hai, aur Hasan aur Husain uske phal hain, aur humare pairukaar uske patte hain, aur darakht ki jad Jannat-ul-Adan mein hai, aur baaqi sab Jannat ke doosre hisson mein hain." Yeh aik anokha (shaaz) matan hai, aur agar aisa hai, to Ishaq Ad-Dabari sachhe hain, aur Abdur Razzaq, unke waalid, aur unke daada sab bharosemand hain, aur Mina, Abdur Rahman bin Awf ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, ne Nabi (SAW) ko paaya tha aur unse suna tha, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai. Al-Hakim ke siwa kisi ne yeh baat nahi kahi, aur yeh sirf aik gira hua (matrook) Tabi'i ki riwayat hai.

e: [AI] "When Fatimah, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, was mentioned, she said, "I have not seen anyone who had a more truthful speech than her, except for the one who gave birth to her."
hi: Ke jab bhi Fatimah bint Nabi (SAW) ka zikr hota, woh kehtin: "Maine unse zyada sach-goo aur kisi ko nahi dekha, siwaye us Zaat ke jisne unhein janam diya."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "On the Day of Judgment, it will be said, 'O people of the gathering, lower your gaze so that Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , will pass by.' So she will pass by wearing two green garments." Abu Muslim said, Abu Qilabah told me, and Abd al-Hamid was with us, that he said, 'Wearing red garments.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Qayamat ka din hoga, to kaha jaayega: Aye jama'at walo, apni nigahein neechi karo taake Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW) guzar jaayen." To woh guzregi jabke unpar do sabz (hare) reshmi kapde honge." Abu Muslim ne kaha: mujhse Abu Qilabah ne kaha, aur humare sath Abdul Hameed the, ke unhone kaha: "Surkh (laal)."

e: [AI] Khadijah, the wife of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, gave birth to two boys and four girls. The boys' names were Qasim and Abdullah, and the girls' names were Fatimah, Umm Kulthum, Ruqayyah, and Zainab.
hi: "Khadijah (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye do larke aur chaar auraten janam din - Al-Qasim, Abdullah, aur Fatimah, Umm Kulthum, Ruqayyah, aur Zainab."

e: [AI] About Fatimah bint Rasul Allah ﷺ , she said: "She was like the moon on the night of the full moon or like the sun when the clouds disperse, with a complexion as white as snow and a blush as red as blood. She had black hair that was the blackest of all people in resemblance to Rasul Allah ﷺ . By Allah, as the poet said: 'White, which drags its hair over it, and it disappears in it.' And he was a body that is very dark, as if it were a bright day for her and as if it were a dark night upon her."
hi: Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh chaudhvin ki raat ke chaand jaisi thin, ya suraj jaisi jab woh baadal se nikalta hai, safed rangat lekin surkhi maayil, unke kaale baal the, log mein Rasulullah (SAW) se sabse zyada milti-julti thin." Allah ki qasam, jaisa shaayar ne kaha (bahr Al-Kaamil mein): "Safed rangat, jab khadi ho to uske baal usse gher lete hain, aur woh unme chhup jaati hai jabke woh ghane aur siyaah hain, goya unme woh chamakta hua din hai, aur goya woh (baal) usspar andheri raat hai." Fabricated.

e: [AI] Fatima was born in the year forty-one after the birth of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
hi: "Fatimah Rasulullah (SAW) ki paidaish ke iktalees (41) saal baad paida hui."

e: [AI] "Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad, ﷺ , passed away during an illness that lasted three nights in a month other than Ramadan when she was around twenty-nine years old. There are different accounts regarding the exact time of her death. Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali reported that Fatima passed away three months after the Prophet ﷺ . Aisha, on the other hand, stated that Fatima passed away six months after the Prophet ﷺ . Abdullah ibn Al-Harith claimed that Fatima passed away eight months after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Fatimah bint Muhammad (SAW) ka intiqaal Ramzan ki teen (3) raatein guzarne par hua, jabke unki umr untees (29) saal ya usske qareeb thi." Aur unki wafaat ke waqt mein ikhtilaaf hai, Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali se riwayat hai ke unhone kaha: "Fatimah Nabi (SAW) ke baad teen (3) mahine mein faut huin." Aur rahi baat Aisha (RA) ki, to unhone jo unse riwayat hai usme kaha: "Woh Nabi (SAW) ke baad chhah (6) mahine mein faut huin." Aur rahi baat Abdullah bin Al-Harith ki, to unhone jo Yazid bin Abi Ziyad ne unse riwayat ki usme kaha: "Fatimah Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad aath (8) mahine mein faut huin."

e: [AI] "Fatimah stayed for six months after the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . She was followed by Salih ibn Kaysan, 'Uqayl, Ibn 'Uyaynah, Al-Waqidi, and Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Akhi Al-Zuhri, and Ibn Jurayj. All of them followed her."
hi: "Fatimah Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ke baad chhah (6) mahine zinda rahin." Salih bin Kaisan, Uqail, Ibn Uyainah, Al-Waqidi, Muhammad bin Abdullah Ibn Akhi Az-Zuhri, aur Ibn Jurayj, sab ne inki mutaabi'at ki (isi tarah riwayat ki).

e: [AI] "For Asma bint Umayz, do you not see that I have reached a point where I cannot even carry myself openly on the bed?" So Asma said, "By my oath, but I will make a coffin for you as I have seen being made in Abyssinia." She said, "Then show it to me." So Asma sent for moist palm leaves, and they were cut from the tops of the palm trees and made into a coffin. It was placed on the bed, and it was the first time she smiled since her father's death. Then we carried her and buried her at night."
hi: Asma (RA) bint Umais se: "Kya tum nahi dekhti main kis haal ko pahunch gayi houn, khule takht par uthaayi jaaungi?" To Asma (RA) ne kaha: "Kyun nahi, mujhe apni jaan ki qasam, lekin main aapke liye aik janaaza (dhaanp-dar takht) banaati houn, jaisa maine Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen mein banate dekha hai." Unhone kaha: "To mujhe woh dikhaao." Unhone kaha: to Asma (RA) ne taaza khajoor ki taaniyaan mangwaayin, unhein Aswaaf se kaata gaya, aur unhein takht par janaaza (dhaanpne wale sanchay) ke roop mein rakha gaya, aur yeh pehli martaba tha ke janaaza (yeh design) banaaya gaya, to Fatimah (RA) muskuraayin, aur maine unhein apne waalid ke baad kabhi muskuraate nahi dekha siwaye us din ke, phir humne unhein uthaaya aur raat ko dafan kiya.

e: [AI] "Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, was buried at night. Ali buried her and Abu Bakr did not know about it until she was buried. Ali ibn Abi Talib prayed over her."
hi: "Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW) ko raat mein dafan kiya gaya, Ali (RA) ne unhein dafan kiya, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ko unke dafan honay tak khabar nahi hui, aur Ali bin Abi Talib (RA), unpar salaam ho, ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi."

e: [AI] "Fatima died at the age of twenty-one, and she was born on the beginning of the forty-first year after the birth of the Prophet ﷺ."
hi: "Fatimah ikkis (21) saal ki umr mein faut huin, aur woh Nabi (SAW) ki paidaish ke iktalees (41) saal ke shuru mein paida hui thin."

e: [AI] There were two months between the Prophet ﷺ  and Fatimah.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) aur Fatimah (RA) ke darmiyan do (2) mahine ka faasla tha."

e: [AI] "That Fatima did not remain after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ except for two months."
hi: "Fatimah Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad sirf do (2) mahine zinda rahin."

e: [AI] "When Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger (pbuh), passed away, she used to say, 'Oh my father, how near is he to his Lord? Oh my father, Paradise is his abode! Oh my father, his Lord honors him when he meets Him! Oh my father, the Lord and His messengers greet him upon his arrival!' When Fatimah passed away, Ali ibn Abi Talib said, 'For every gathering of two beloved ones, there is a separation, and everything below separation is insignificant. And indeed, my longing for one after another is evidence that companionship does not last.'"
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to Fatimah (RA) kehti thin: "Haaye mere abba, apne Rab ke kitne qareeb, haaye mere abba, hamesha rehne wali Jannaten unka thikaana hain, haaye mere abba, unka Rab unhein izzat deta hai jab woh unke paas aate hain, haaye mere abba, Rab aur uske Rusul unhein salaam karte hain jab woh unse milte hain." Jab Fatimah (RA) ka intiqaal hua, to Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ne kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Har do dosto ke milan ka aik judaai hota hai, aur judaai ke ilawa sab kuch thoda hai, aur mera aik ke baad doosre ko khona is baat ki daleel hai ke koi dost hamesha nahi rehta."

e: [AI] "I and Ali washed Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Maine aur Ali (RA) ne Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghusl diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Every child of a tribe belongs to that tribe, except for the two sons of Fatimah; I am their guardian and part of their tribe."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har maa ke betay (aik qabile ke) asaba (rishtedaar) hote hain jinki taraf woh mansoob hote hain, siwaye Fatimah ke dono betay ke, main hi unka wali aur unka asaba houn."

e: [AI] Al-Hasan and Al-Husain came running to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he embraced them and said, "Indeed, children are treasures, cowards, and sources of sorrow."
hi: Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA) daudte huay Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf aaye, aap (SAW) ne unhein apne sath lipta liya, phir farmaya: "Beshak aulaad (kanjoosi ki wajah), (buzdili ki wajah), aur (gham ki wajah) hoti hai."

e: [AI] Al-Hajjaj was not from the lineage of the Prophet peace be upon him. And with him was Yahya ibn Ya'mar, so he said to him, "O Amir, you have lied." So he said, "Come to me with clear evidence and conclusive proof from the Book of Allah, Almighty, or I will kill you." So he said, "And from his descendants are Dawud, Sulayman, Ayyub, Yusuf, and Musa, to the saying of Allah, Almighty, 'And Zakariyya, Yahya, 'Isa, and Ilyas'" [Al-An'am 85]. So Allah, Almighty, informed that 'Isa is from the descendants of Adam through his mother, and Al-Husayn ibn Ali is from the descendants of Muhammad peace be upon him through his mother. He said, "You spoke the truth, so what led you to deny me in this matter?" He said, "Allah has taken a covenant from the prophets to proclaim it to the people and not conceal it." He said, "So they rejected it behind their backs and exchanged it for a small price" [Al Imran 187]. He said, "So he banished him to Khurasan."
hi: "Al-Hajjaj Nabi (SAW) ki aulaad mein se nahi tha," aur unke paas Yahya bin Ya'mar the, to unhone unse kaha: "Tum jhoote ho, Aye Ameer." To usne kaha: "Tum zaroor apni baat ke liye koi saboot aur Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki Kitaab se koi tasdeeq laao, warna main tumhein qatl kar dunga." Unhone kaha: "{Aur unki aulaad mein se Dawud (AS), Sulaiman (AS), Ayyub (AS), Yusuf (AS), aur Musa (AS)}" Allah Ta'ala ke farmaan "{aur Zakariya (AS), Yahya (AS), Isa (AS), aur Ilyas (AS)}" (Surah Al-An'am 85) tak, to Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne bataaya ke Isa (AS) apni maa ke zariye Aadam (AS) ki aulaad mein se hain, aur Husain bin Ali (RA) apni maa ke zariye Muhammad (SAW) ki aulaad mein se hain. Usne kaha: "Tumne sach kaha, to tumhein mere saamne jhutlaane par kis cheez ne majboor kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Woh (ahd) jo Allah ne Ambiya se liya ke woh log ko yeh (haqeeqat) zaroor bataayenge aur usse chhupaayenge nahi, Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne farmaya: {To unhone isse apni peeth ke peechhe phenk diya aur isse thodi qeemat par bech diya}" (Surah Aal-e-Imran 187). Unhone kaha: to usne (Yahya bin Ya'mar ko) Khurasan ki taraf jila-watan (nikaal) kar diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: When al-Hasan was born, I named him Harb [which means war], then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and said: ʿShow me my son; what did you name him?ʿ We said: Harb. He said: ʿRather he is Hasan.” When al-Husain was born, I named him Harb, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and said: “Show me my son; what did you name him?” We said; Harb. He said: “Rather he is Husain.” When the third one was born, I named him Harb. The Prophet ﷺ came and said: “Show me my son, what did you name him?” I said. Harb. He said: ʿRather, he is Muhassin.ʿ Then he said: ʿI have named them after the fashion of the sons of Haroon, Shabbar and Shabeer and Mushabbir.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 769)
hi: Jab Fatimah (RA) ne Hasan (RA) ko janam diya, to Nabi (SAW) aaye aur farmaya: "Mujhe mera beta dikhaao, tumne uska naam kya rakha?" Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Maine uska naam Harb (jung) rakha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, woh Hasan hai." Jab unhone Husain (RA) ko janam diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) aaye aur farmaya: "Mujhe mera beta dikhaao, tumne uska naam kya rakha?" Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Maine uska naam Harb rakha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, woh Husain hai." Phir jab teesra beta paida hua, to Rasulullah (SAW) aaye, farmaya: "Mujhe mera beta dikhaao, tumne uska naam kya rakha?" Maine kaha: "Maine uska naam Harb rakha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, woh Muhsin hai." Phir farmaya: "Maine unka naam Harun (AS) ke betay Shabar, Shubair, aur Mushbir ke naam par rakha hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ once came to her and said, "Where are my sons?" She replied, "Ali has taken them." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went and found them playing in a well with some dates in their hands. He said to Ali, "O Ali, why did you not turn my sons around before the heat?" He then mentioned the rest of the narration, "Muhammad bin Musa, this is the son of Mashmool, a trustworthy Medinan, and Awn, this is the son of Muhammad bin Ubaid-Allah bin Abi Rafi, both of them are trustworthy. And their mother is Ja'far's daughter, Asma bint Abi Bakr. I found her as Asma bint Abi Bakr. They are all noble trustworthy people." But Muhammad (ibn Musa) weakened it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik din unke (Fatimah RA ke) paas aaye aur poocha: "Mere dono betay kahan hain?" Unhone kaha: "Ali (RA) unhein le gaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) chal pade, unhein aik kamre (mashrubah) mein khelte huay paaya, unke saamne kuch khajoorein padi thin, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ali, kya tum mere bete ko garmi se pehle palat nahi dete?" aur baaqi hadith zikr ki. Muhammad bin Musa, yeh Ibn Mashmool hain, Madinah wale, bharosemand, aur Aun, yeh Muhammad bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Raafi' ke bete hain, woh aur unke waalid dono bharosemand hain, aur Umm Ja'far, Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bin Abi Bakr As-Siddiq ki beti hain, jinki daadi Asma bint Abi Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) hain, aur yeh sab izzat-daar, bharosemand log hain. Balke Muhammad ko kamzor kaha gaya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out with us in one of the evening prayers of Dhuhr or Asr while carrying one of his sons, either Al-Hasan or Al-Husayn. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then went forward and placed him at his right foot, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prostrated for a long time. My father said, "I raised my head among the people, and behold, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was prostrating, and the boy was riding on his back. So I went back and prostrated. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  finished, the people said, 'O Messenger of Allah, you prostrated in this prayer, a prostration we have not seen you do before. Were you commanded to do so, or did something specific inspire you?'" He said, "All of that was not the case, but my son rode on me, so I disliked to hurry him until he had satisfied his need."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas shaam ki namazon mein se aik mein, Zuhr ya Asr, nikle, jabke woh apne dono betay Hasan (RA) ya Husain (RA) mein se aik ko uthaaye huay the, to Rasulullah (SAW) aage badhe aur unhein apne dayen pair ke qareeb rakha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik lambi sajda ki. Mere waalid ne kaha: to maine logon ke darmiyan apna sar uthaaya, achaanak Rasulullah (SAW) sajda mein the aur bacha unki peeth par sawaar tha, to main dobara sajda mein chala gaya, jab Rasulullah (SAW) faarigh huay, to logon ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne apni is namaz mein aisi sajda ki jaisi aap pehle nahi karte the, kya aapko kisi baat ka hukum diya gaya, ya aap par kuch wahi hui?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh sab kuch nahi hua, lekin mera beta mujhpar sawaar ho gaya, to mujhe napasand hua ke main use jaldi utaaroon yahan tak ke woh apni zaroorat poori kar le."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Hasan and Husain are my sons. Whoever loves them, loves me. And whoever loves me, Allah loves him. And whoever Allah loves, He will admit him to Paradise. And whoever dislikes them, dislikes me. And whoever dislikes me, dislikes Allah. And whoever dislikes Allah, He will admit him to the Hellfire."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Hasan aur Husain mere betay hain, jisne unse mohabbat ki usne mujhse mohabbat ki, aur jisne mujhse mohabbat ki Allah ne usse mohabbat ki, aur jisse Allah mohabbat kare usse Jannat mein dakhil karta hai, aur jisne unse dushmani ki usne mujhse dushmani ki, aur jisne mujhse dushmani ki Allah ne usse dushmani ki, aur jisse Allah dushmani kare usse Jahannam mein dakhil karta hai." Repudiated.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out to us, and with him were Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn. He had Al-Hasan on his shoulder and Al-Husayn on his other shoulder. He was kissing Al-Hasan and then Al-Husayn, alternately. He came to us and a man said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, do you love them?" He said, "Yes, whoever loves them, loves me, and whoever dislikes them, dislikes me."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas nikle jabke Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA) unke sath the, aik unke aik kandhe par aur doosra doosre kandhe par, woh kabhi isse aur kabhi usse bosa dete, yahan tak ke woh humare paas pahunche, to aik aadmi ne unse poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap unse mohabbat karte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, jisne unse mohabbat ki usne mujhse mohabbat ki, aur jisne unse dushmani ki usne mujhse dushmani ki."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ  that he said, "Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are the leaders of the youth of the people of Paradise, except for the sons of the paternal aunt."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hasan aur Husain Jannat ke jawaanon ke sardaar hain, siwaye khaala ke betay (Isa AS aur Yahya AS) ke."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Hasan and Husain will be the leaders of the youth of Paradise, and their father is better than them." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 118)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hasan aur Husain Jannat ke jawaanon ke sardaar hain, aur unke waalid unse behtar hain."

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Hasan and Husain will be the leaders of the youth of Paradise, and their father is better than them." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 118)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hasan aur Husain Jannat ke jawaanon ke sardaar hain, aur unke waalid unse behtar hain." Mu'alla bin Abdur Rahman matrook (chhoda hua) hain. Weak, Rejected.

e: “The Prophet ﷺ used to seek refuge for Hasan and Husain and say: A’udhu bi kalimatil-lahil- tammati, min kulli shaitanin wa hammah, wa min kulli ‘aynin lammah (I seek refuge for you both in the Perfect Words of Allah, from every devil and every poisonous reptile, and from every evil eye).’ And he would say: ‘Thus Ibrahim used to seek refuge with Allah for Isma’il and Ishaq,’ or he said: ‘for Isma’il and Ya’qub.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3525)
hi: Nabi (SAW) Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA) ke liye ta'weez (panaah ki dua) karte, kehte: "Main tum dono ko Allah ke mukammal kalimaat ki panaah mein deta houn, har shaitan aur zehreeli cheez se, aur har buri nazar se," phir farmate: "Isi tarah Ibrahim (AS) apne dono betay Ismail (AS) aur Ishaq (AS) ke liye panaah maangte the."

e: [AI] "We used to pray the evening prayer with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When he would prostrate, Al-Hasan and Al-Husain would climb onto his back, and when he raised his head, he would take them and place them gently beside him. When he finished, he made one sit here and the other sit there. So I approached him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, shall I not take them to their mother?' He replied, 'No.' Then he smiled and said, 'Indeed, their mother's right is upon them.' So they continued to walk in its light until they entered."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Isha padhte the, aap (SAW) namaz padhte, jab sajda karte, to Hasan (RA) aur Husain (RA) unki peeth par chadh jaate, aur jab apna sar uthaate, to unhein nazakat se pakad kar rakh dete, jab woh dobara (sajda) karte to woh dobara (chadh jaate), jab woh namaz se faarigh huay, to unhone aik ko yahan aur aik ko wahan bithaaya, main unke paas gaya aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya main inhein unki maa ke paas na le jaaun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." To bijli chamki, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni maa ke paas jaao." To woh uski roshni mein chalte rahe yahan tak ke andar chale gaye.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to me, "What have you named your son?" I said, "Harb." He said, "He is Al-Hasan." So, when Al-Hussein was born, I named him Harb, and the Prophet ﷺ  said, "What have you named your son?" I said, "Harb." He said, "He is Al-Hussein." Then, when Muhsin was born, he asked, "What have you named your son?" I said, "Harb." He said, "He is Muhsin." Then, the Prophet ﷺ  said, "I have named my sons with the names of the sons of Harun, Shabar, Shubayr, and Mushbir."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse poocha: "Tumne mere bete ka naam kya rakha?" Maine kaha: "Harb." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh Hasan hai." Jab Husain paida huay, maine unka naam Harb rakha, to Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne mere bete ka naam kya rakha?" Maine kaha: "Harb." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh Husain hai." Jab Muhsin paida huay, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne mere bete ka naam kya rakha?" Maine kaha: "Harb." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh Muhsin hai." Phir Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine in betay ka naam Harun (AS) ke betay Shabar, Shubair, aur Mushbir ke naam par rakha hai."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq met Al-Hasan ibn Ali, embraced him, and said, "He resembles the Prophet, not resembling Ali." And Ali laughed.
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) Hasan bin Ali (RA) se mile, unhein apne sath lipta liya aur kaha: "Mere waalid tumpar qurbaan, tum Nabi (SAW) se milte-julte ho, Ali (RA) se nahi," aur Ali (RA) hans rahe the.

e: [AI] He met Hasan ibn Ali and said, "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ kiss your stomach." So he asked Hasan to reveal the spot that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissed so that he could kiss it too. Hasan revealed it to him, and he kissed it.
hi: Unki mulaqaat Hasan bin Ali (RA) se hui, unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko tumhare pait ko chumte dekha," to woh jagah dikhaao jahan Rasulullah (SAW) ne chuma taake main bhi wahan chumun. Unhone kaha: to Hasan (RA) ne unhein woh jagah dikhaayi, unhone use chuma.

e: [AI] I heard Wahb Ibn Abi Juhaifa saying, "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Al-Hasan Ibn Ali resembled him."
hi: Maine Wahb Abu Juhaifah (RA) ko kehte suna: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, aur Hasan bin Ali (RA) unse milte-julte the."

e: [AI] "There was none among the children of Ali resembling the Messenger of Allah ﷺ more than Al-Hasan." Sahih.
hi: "Ali (RA) ki aulaad mein Hasan (RA) se zyada Rasulullah (SAW) se milta-julta koi nahi tha." Sahih.

e: [AI] The passage translates to: "Al-Hasan ibn Ali performed Hajj twenty-five times on foot, and indeed the camels were led alongside him."
hi: "Hasan bin Ali (RA) ne pachees (25) Hajj paidal kiye, jabke behtareen sawaari jaanwar unke sath lekar chale jaate the."

e: [AI] "Fatima gave birth to Hassan two and a half years after Uhud, and Hassan gave birth four years and six months from that date." Al-Dhahabi remained silent on it in the summary.
hi: "Fatimah (RA) ne Hasan (RA) ko Uhud ke ba'd dhaai (2.5) saal mein janam diya, aur Hasan (RA) ka naam unki paidaish ke chaar (4) saal chhah (6) mahine baad (calendar mein) rakha gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib passed away in Rabi' al-Awwal in the year forty-nine, and Sa'id ibn al-As prayed over him.
hi: "Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan bin Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) Rabi-ul-Awwal, unchaas (49) hijri mein faut huay, aur Sa'eed bin Al-Aas (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi."

e: [AI] "I still love this man after seeing the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  doing what he was doing. I saw Al-Hasan come to the Prophet's room ﷺ  while he was putting his fingers in the Prophet's beard ﷺ  and the Prophet ﷺ  was putting his tongue in his mouth, then he said, 'O Allah, I love him, so you should love him.'"
hi: Main hamesha is aadmi (Hasan RA) se mohabbat karta rahunga is baad ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko woh karte dekha jo unhone kiya, maine Hasan (RA) ko Nabi (SAW) ki god mein dekha, woh apni ungliyaan Nabi (SAW) ki daadhi mein daal rahe the, aur Nabi (SAW) apni zubaan unke mun mein daal rahe the, phir farmaya: "Aye Allah, main isse mohabbat karta houn, isliye tu bhi isse mohabbat kar."

e: [AI] We were with Abu Hurairah when Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib came to us and greeted us with peace. We returned the greeting, but Abu Hurairah did not notice him. So we said to him, "O Abu Hurairah, Hasan ibn Ali greeted us with peace." He followed him and said, "And peace be upon you, my master." Then he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'He is a master.'"
hi: Hum Abu Hurairah (RA) ke sath the, ke Hasan bin Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) humare paas aaye aur salaam kiya, humne unhein salaam ka jawaab diya, magar Abu Hurairah (RA) ko pata nahi chala, humne unse kaha: "Aye Abu Hurairah, yeh Hasan bin Ali hain jinhone humein salaam kiya hai." To woh unke peechhe gaye aur kaha: "Wa alaikas-salaam, Aye mere sardaar." Phir kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Beshak woh sardaar hain.'"

e: [AI] The prophet Mohammed ﷺ  kissed his grandson Hasan and embraced him, and placed him on his lap. There was a man from the Ansar (helpers) present, and he said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have a son who is old enough, but I have never kissed him." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "What can I do if Allah has deprived your heart of mercy?"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hasan (RA) ko bosa diya aur unhein apne sath lipta liya, unhein soonghte rahe, aur unke paas Ansar ka aik aadmi tha, us Ansari ne kaha: "Mera aik beta hai jo bade honay ki umr ko pahunch chuka hai, maine kabhi usse bosa nahi diya." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumne dekha, agar Allah ne tumhare dil se rehm nikaal liya hai, to isme mera kya gunaah hai?"

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ came carrying Hassan ibn Ali on his neck. A man met him and said, "What a good passenger you have O young boy!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "And what a good carrier he is."
hi: Nabi (SAW) tashreef laaye jabke woh Hasan bin Ali (RA) ko apni gardan par uthaaye huay the, aik aadmi ne unhein dekha aur kaha: "Kaisi behtareen sawaari hai jispar tum sawaar ho, Aye ladke!" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur kaisa behtareen sawaar hai yeh!"

e:
[AI] I said to Al-Hasan ibn Ali that people are saying you want the caliphate. He replied, "The leaders of the Arabs were in my hands; they would fight whoever I fought and make peace with whoever I made peace with. I abandoned it seeking the pleasure of Allah Almighty and to spare the blood of the nation of Muhammad  ﷺ . Then it was taken from me by the deceit of the people of Hijaz."

This is a sound chain of narration according to the criteria of the two Sheikhs (al-Bukhari and Muslim), but they did not include it.
hi: Maine Hasan bin Ali (RA) se kaha: "Log kehte hain aap khilafat chahte hain." Unhone kaha: "Arab ke sardaar mere haath mein the, jinse main jung karta woh unse jung karte, aur jinse main sulah karta woh unse sulah karte, maine isse Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki raza ke liye aur Muhammad (SAW) ki Ummat ka khoon bachaane ke liye chhod diya, phir yeh (khilafat) mujhse Hijaaz walon ki be-himmati/haar-maan lene ki wajah se cheen li gayi." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] A man approached Hasan ibn Ali and said, "O you who have blackened the face of the believers!" Hasan replied, "Do not rebuke me, may Allah have mercy on you.
