The Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  saw the Umayyads delivering sermons on his pulpit, one man after another, and it displeased him. Then the verse 'Indeed, We have granted you al-Kawthar'—a river in Paradise—was revealed. And the Surah 'Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree. And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree? The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months' was revealed, over which the Umayyads would rule. This is sufficient for us, and it neither increases nor decreases." This is a sound chain of narration, and the one who said this to Hasan ibn Ali was Sufyan ibn al-Layl, a companion of his father.
hi: Aik aadmi Hasan bin Ali (RA) ke paas khada hua aur kaha: "Aye momino ke chehre kaale karne wale!" To Hasan (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe malaamat mat karo, Allah tumpar reham kare, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Banu Umayyah ko apne mimbar par aik-aik aadmi karke khutba dete dekha tha, to yeh unhein bura laga, phir yeh nazil hua: {Beshak humne tumhein Kauthar diya}, aik nehar Jannat mein, aur yeh nazil hua: {Beshak humne ise Laylatul-Qadr mein nazil kiya, aur tumhein kya khabar Laylatul-Qadr kya hai, Laylatul-Qadr hazaar mahine se behtar hai}, jinpar Banu Umayyah hukumat karenge, to yeh humein kaafi hai, aur woh (hukumat) na barhti hai na ghatti hai."

e: [AI] I went to Al-Hasan ibn Ali when he pledged allegiance to Muawiyah, and I said, "Oh, the one who darkens the face of the believers." Then, the secret was mentioned by him, (reference to the secret conversation between Al-Hasan and Muawiyah).
hi: Main Hasan bin Ali (RA) ke paas gaya jab unhone Mu'awiyah (RA) se baiyat ki, maine kaha: "Aye momino ke chehre kaale karne wale," phir isi tarah zikr kiya. Weak Chain.

e: [AI] When the matter between Hasan ibn Ali and Mu'awiya occurred, I came to him in Medina while he was sitting with his companions. He mentioned the hadith at length. We then discussed the adhan (call to prayer) in his presence. Some of us said that the adhan began as a vision experienced by Abdullah ibn Zayd ibn Asim. Hasan ibn Ali replied, "The matter of the adhan is greater than that. Gabriel,  ﷺ , called the adhan in the heavens two by two and taught it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and in one instance he called the iqama (second call to prayer) one by one and taught it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Hasan called the adhan when he was appointed."
hi: Jab Hasan bin Ali (RA) aur Mu'awiyah (RA) ke maamle ka jo hua so hua, to main unke paas Madinah aaya jabke woh apne sahaba mein baithe huay the, phir poori hadith zikr ki, unhone kaha: humne unke paas Azaan ka zikr kiya, humme se kisi ne kaha: "Azaan ki shuru'aat to Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aasim ka khwaab thi." To Hasan bin Ali (RA) ne unse kaha: "Azaan ka maamla usse bhi bada hai, Jibra'il (AS), unpar salaam ho, ne aasman mein do-do karke azaan di aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko sikhaayi, aur ikaame-ikaame karke iqaamat di, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein sikhaaya, to Hasan (RA) ne azaan di jab woh (ameer) muqarrar huay." Weak, Rejected.

e: [AI] I was a witness on the day Hasan ibn Ali died, and I saw Husayn ibn Ali saying to Sa'id ibn al-As, while gesturing at his neck, "Step forward. If it were not a tradition, I would not have asked you to precede." There was an issue among them, and Abu Hurairah said, "Are you begrudging the son of your Prophet ﷺ a grave to bury him in? I heard the Messenger of Allah say, 'Whoever loves them has loved me, and whoever despises them has despised me.'"
hi: Main us din maujood tha jab Hasan bin Ali (RA) faut huay, maine dekha Husain bin Ali (RA) Sa'eed bin Al-Aas (RA) se keh rahe the, unki gardan ki taraf ishara karte huay: "Aage badho, agar yeh Sunnat na hoti to main tumhein aage na badhaata," aur unke darmiyan kuch (tanaav) tha, to Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Kya tum apne Nabi (SAW) ke bete ki khaatir aik qabr par (jhagda) karte ho jismein tum unhein dafan karoge, jabke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jisne un dono se mohabbat ki usne mujhse mohabbat ki, aur jisne un dono se dushmani ki usne mujhse dushmani ki.'"

e: “My grandfather, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, taught me some words to say in Qunut of Witr: Allahumma ‘afini fiman ‘afait, wa tawallani fiman tawallait, wahdini fiman hadait, wa qini sharra ma qadait, wa barik li fima a’tait. Innaka taqdi wa la yuqda ‘alaik, innahu la yudhillu man walait. Subhanaka rabbana tabarakta wa ta’alait (O Allah, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to, guide me along with those whom You have guided, protect me from the evil that You have decreed, and bless for me that which You have bestowed. For verily You decree and none can decree over You. He whom You support can never be humiliated. Glory is to You, our Lord, You are Blessed and Exalted).” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1178)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe mere Witr mein sikhaaya, jab main apna sar uthaaun aur sirf sajda baaqi ho: "Aye Allah, mujhe hidayat de un logon mein jinhein tu ne hidayat di, aur mujhe aafiyat de un logon mein jinhein tu ne aafiyat di, aur mujhe wali bana un logon mein jinhein tu ne wali banaya, aur mujhe jo diya usme barkat de, aur mujhe us cheez ki buraai se bacha jo tu ne muqarrar ki, beshak tu faisla karta hai aur tujhpar koi faisla nahi kiya jaata, beshak jise tu wali banaaye woh zaleel nahi hota, tu barkat wala hai, humare Rab, aur buland hai." Weak.

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me these words in witr. He said: Say: Allahumma ihdini fiman hadayta wa 'afini fiman afayta wa tawallani fiman tawallayta wa barik li fima a'tayta, wa qini sharra ma qadayta, fa innaka taqdi wa la yuqda 'alayk, wa innahu la yadhilluman walayta, tabarakta Rabbana wa at'alayt. Wa salla Allahu ala al-Nabi Muhammad (O Allah, guide me among those whom You have guided, pardon me among those You have pardoned, turn to me in friendship among those on whom You have turned in friendship, and bless me in what You have bestowed, and save me from the evil of what You have decreed. For verily You decree and none can influence You; and he is not humiliated whom You have befriended. Blessed are You, O Lord, and Exalted. And may Allah (SWT) send salah upon the Prophet Muhammad)'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1746)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe Witr mein yeh alfaaz sikhaaye: "Aye Allah, mujhe hidayat de un logon mein jinhein tu ne hidayat di, aur mujhe jo diya usme barkat de, aur mujhe us cheez ki buraai se bacha jo tu ne muqarrar ki, beshak tu faisla karta hai aur tujhpar koi faisla nahi kiya jaata, aur beshak jise tu wali banaaye woh zaleel nahi hota, tu barkat wala hai, humare Rab, aur buland hai." Weak.

e:
[AI] "A man has been taken away tonight, whom the first and the last cannot surpass in deeds and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to give him his banner and he would fight while Jibril stood on his right and Mika'il on his left. He does not turn back until Allah grants him victory, and he does not leave anything on the people of the earth, whether it be yellow or white, except for seven hundred dirhams from his gifts. He wanted to buy a servant for his family with them."

"Then he said, 'O people, whoever knows me has known me, and whoever does not know me, I am Al-Hasan ibn Ali, I am the son of the Prophet, I am the son of the appointed successor, I am the son of the bearer of glad tidings, I am the son of the warner, I am the son of the caller to Allah by His permission, I am the son of the shining lamp, and I am from the people of the household to whom Jibril used to descend and ascend from among us. I am from the people of the household whom Allah has removed impurity from and purified an absolute purification. I am from the people of the household whom Allah has made their love obligatory upon every Muslim.' And Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, said to His Prophet ﷺ, 'Say: I do not ask you for any reward for it except love of the near relatives.' And whoever does a good deed, We will increase for him in good over it.' [42:23] So, the doing of a good deed is love for us, the people of the household, is not correct."
hi: Hasan bin Ali (RA) ne, jab Ali (RA) qatl kiye gaye, logon ko khutba di, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir kaha: "Is raat aik aisa aadmi qabz kiya gaya jise pehle log kisi amal mein sabqat nahi le sakte the aur na baad wale unhein paa sakte hain, aur Rasulullah (SAW) unhein apna jhanda dete, to woh jung karte, Jibra'il (AS) unke daayen taraf hote aur Mikaeel (AS) unke baayen taraf, woh wapas nahi aate the jab tak Allah unhein fatah na deta, aur unhone zameen walon par koi sona ya chandi nahi chhoda siwaye saat sau (700) dirham ke jo unke atiyaat se bach gaye the, unka iraada tha ke woh isse apne ghar walon ke liye aik khadim khareedein." Phir kaha: "Aye logo, jo mujhe pehchaanta hai to woh (jaanta hai) main kaun houn, aur jo mujhe nahi pehchaanta, to main Hasan bin Ali houn, main Nabi (SAW) ka beta houn, main wasi (jaanasheen) ka beta houn, main basheer (khush-khabri dene wale) ka beta houn, main nazeer (dar-dene wale) ka beta houn, main Allah ki taraf uski ijaazat se bulaane wale ka beta houn, main roshan chiraagh ka beta houn, aur main us Ahl-e-Bait mein se houn jinke paas Jibra'il (AS) utarte aur unke paas se chadte the, aur main us Ahl-e-Bait mein se houn jinse Allah ne gandagi door ki aur unhein khoob paak kiya, aur main us Ahl-e-Bait mein se houn jinki mohabbat Allah ne har Musalman par farz ki hai, Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne apne Nabi (SAW) se farmaya: {Kaho: main tumse iske badle koi ujrat nahi maangta siwaye qareebiyon se mohabbat ke, aur jo koi neki kamaaye, hum uske liye usme neki barhaayenge} (Surah Ash-Shura 23), to neki kamaana humari, Ahl-e-Bait ki, mohabbat hai." Not Accepted.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ named Al-Hasan ibn Ali on his seventh day, and he derived the name Husayn from his name. It is mentioned that there was nothing between them except affection.
hi: "Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Hasan bin Ali (RA) ka naam unke saatvein din rakha, aur unke naam se Husain (RA) ka naam nikaala," aur zikr kiya ke unke darmiyan sirf hamal (dono ka aik hi hamal ke qareeb honay ka faasla) tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Al-Hasan ibn Ali was poisoned several times, each time surviving until the last time when he died. His liver was affected, and when he died, the women of Banu Hashim mourned him for a month.
hi: "Hasan bin Ali (RA) ko kayi baar zeher diya gaya, har baar woh bach jaate, yahan tak ke aakhri martaba aayi jismein unka intiqaal hua, unka jigar ulat-palat ho gaya tha, jab unka intiqaal hua, to Banu Hashim ki auraton ne aik mahine tak unpar maatam kiya."

e: [AI] "Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib was pledged allegiance to in Kufa shortly after the killing of the Commander of the Faithful, Ali. He received the pledge from his companions. Haritha ibn Mudarrib narrated to me, saying, 'I heard al-Hasan ibn Ali say, "By God, I will not pledge allegiance to you except on what I tell you."' They asked, 'What is it?' He replied, 'You will make peace with whomever I make peace, and you will fight whomever I fight.' And when the pledge was completed, he addressed them."
hi: Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan bin Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) se Kufa mein Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali (RA) ke qatl ke turant baad baiyat li gayi, unhone apne sahaba se baiyat li, mujhse Haritha bin Mudarrib ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: maine Hasan bin Ali (RA) ko kehte suna: "Allah ki qasam, main tumse baiyat sirf usi baat par lunga jo main tumhein kehta houn." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Tum unse sulah karoge jinse main sulah karoon, aur tum unse jung karoge jinse main jung karoon." Jab baiyat mukammal ho gayi, to unhone unhein khutba di.

e: [AI] When Ali was killed, Hasan stood up to address the people. A man from the tribe of Azd Ash-Shanu'ah stood up and said, "I bear witness that I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  holding him (Hasan) in his lap and saying, 'Whoever loves me, let him love him and inform the absent ones.' If it were not for the honor of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , I would never have mentioned it."
hi: Jab Ali (RA) qatl kiye gaye, to Hasan (RA) khade hokar logon ko khutba dene lage, to Azd Shanu'ah qabile ka aik aadmi khada hua aur kaha: "Main gawahi deta houn ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko unhein apni god mein rakhte huay dekha, aur woh farma rahe the: 'Jo mujhse mohabbat kare woh isse mohabbat kare, aur maujood log ghair-hazir logon tak pahunchayen,' aur agar Rasulullah (SAW) ki izzat na hoti to main yeh baat kabhi na bataata."

e: [AI] After the allegiance was pledged to Hasan ibn Ali, he seriously confronted Mu'awiya and advanced towards him, appointing Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Tayyar at the front with ten thousand men. He then followed him with Qays ibn Sa'd leading a great army. Mu'awiya corresponded with Abdullah ibn Ja'far, promising him a million dirhams if he came to Hijaz, to which he agreed, abandoned his course, and went to Mu'awiya, who fulfilled his promise. The army dispersed, and Qays ibn Sa'd remained separate with many joining him. Those who were with Abdullah ibn Ja'far were also approached by Mu'awiya and enticed, but they did not comply until Hasan made peace with Mu'awiya, relinquishing authority to him. Hasan and his companions proceeded to meet Mu'awiya, and Hasan was treacherously wounded in the Sabat Pass by Sinan ibn al-Jarrahi al-Asadi, an ally of Banu Nasr, who stabbed him in the thigh with an abhorrent strike. Sinan held the views of the Khawarij. Hasan clutched him and fell to the ground with him. Abdullah ibn Zubyan ibn Amarah al-Tamimi leapt upon Sinan, biting his face until he severed his nose and crushed his head with a stone, killing him instantly. Thus, away with the companions of the Blaze. Hasan was carried on a stretcher to Mada'in and was hosted by Sa'd ibn Mas'ud al-Thaqafi, the uncle of al-Mukhtar, who was Ali's governor in Mada'in. He brought a doctor to treat Hasan until he recovered.
hi: Jab Hasan bin Ali (RA) ke liye baiyat qaayam hui, to unhone Mu'awiyah (RA) se muqaabla karne aur unki taraf mutawajjeh honay ka pukhta iraada kiya, unhone apne muqaddama (agli safon) mein Abdullah bin Ja'far At-Tayyar (RA) ko das hazaar (10,000) ke sath rakha, phir unke peechhe Qais bin Sa'd (RA) ko aik bade lashkar ke sath bheja. To Mu'awiyah (RA) ne Abdullah bin Ja'far (RA) ko paighaam bheja aur unhein das lakh (10,00,000) dirham ka zimma diya agar woh Hijaaz ki taraf chale jaayen, to unhone yeh qubool kar liya aur apna raasta chhod diya, Mu'awiyah (RA) ki taraf mutawajjeh huay, unhone unke sath wafa ki, to lashkar bikhar gaya, aur Qais bin Sa'd (RA) alag khade rahe, unke sath bohot log jud gaye, to jo log Abdullah bin Ja'far (RA) ke sath the unhein Mu'awiyah (RA) ne paighaam bheja aur unhein raaghib kiya, magar yeh (paighaam) kaargar sabit na hua yahan tak ke Hasan (RA) ne Mu'awiyah (RA) se sulah kar li aur maamla unke supurd kar diya, aur Hasan (RA) aur unke sahaba Mu'awiyah (RA) se milne ke liye rawaana huay, aur Hasan (RA) ko Saabaat (Ctesiphon) ke daakhle par dhoke se zakhmi kiya gaya, Sinaan bin Al-Jarrah Al-Asadi, Banu Nasr ke bhai, ne unhein zakhmi kiya, unhein unki raan mein aik kudaal se aik bhayaanak zakhm diya, aur woh Khawarij ki raay rakhta tha, to Hasan (RA) ne apne haath se usse pakad liya aur zameen par usske sath gir gaye, to Abdullah bin Zabyaan bin Umarah At-Tameemi usspar (Sinaan par) toot pada, uska chehra kaata yahan tak ke uski naak kaat di, aur uska sar patthar se kuchal diya, to woh usi waqt mar gaya, Jahannam walon ke liye halaakat ho. Hasan (RA) ko takht par Mada'in ki taraf le jaaya gaya, woh Sa'd bin Mas'ood Ath-Thaqafi (RA), Al-Mukhtar ke chacha, ke paas utre, jo Ali (RA) ke Mada'in mein aamil (ameer) the, unhone unke liye aik tabeeb bulaaya, jisne unka ilaaj kiya yahan tak ke woh theek ho gaye, unpar salaam ho.

e: [AI] Al-Hasan ibn Ali received Muawiya with battalions like mountains. Amr ibn al-As said, "By God, I see battalions that will not retreat unless their peers are killed." Muawiya, being the better man of the two, replied, "What if these kill those? Who will be responsible for their blood? Who will handle their affairs? Who will take care of their women?" So Muawiya sent Abd al-Rahman ibn Samura ibn Habeeb ibn Abd Shams. Sufyan said he was a companion. Al-Hasan agreed to peace with Muawiya, surrendered leadership to him, and pledged allegiance to him on conditions and covenants. Muawiya sent a great sum of money to Al-Hasan, reportedly five hundred thousand dirhams, in Jumada al-Awwal of the year forty-one. Al-Hasan had led before surrendering leadership to Muawiya for seven months and eleven days. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in "Al-Talkhis."
hi: Hasan bin Ali (RA) ne Mu'awiyah (RA) ka istaqbaal pahaadon jaise lashkaron se kiya, to Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main aise lashkar dekh raha houn jo peeche nahi hatenge jab tak unke muqaabil qatl na ho jaayen." To Mu'awiyah (RA) ne, jo dono mardon mein behtar the, kaha: "Tumhein kya lagta hai agar yeh in logon ko qatl kar dein? Unke khoon ka zimmedaar kaun hoga? Unke maamlaat ka zimmedaar kaun hoga? Unki auraton ka zimmedaar kaun hoga?" Unhone kaha: to Mu'awiyah (RA) ne Abdur Rahman bin Samurah bin Habib bin Abd Shams (RA) ko bheja, Sufyan ne kaha: aur woh sahabi the, to Hasan (RA) ne Mu'awiyah (RA) se sulah kar li aur maamla unhein saup diya, aur khilafat par unse shurut aur ahdon ke sath baiyat ki, aur Mu'awiyah (RA) ne Hasan (RA) ko bohot bada maal bheja, kaha jaata hai paanch lakh hazaar (50,00,000) dirham, aur yeh Jumada-al-Oola, iktalees (41) hijri mein hua, aur unhone Mu'awiyah (RA) ko maamla saupne se pehle saat (7) mahine aur gyarah (11) din hukumat ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to al-Hasan ibn Ali. This son of mine is a Sayyid (chief), and I hope Allah may reconcile two parties of my community by means of him. Hammad's version has: And perhaps Allah may reconcile two large parties of Muslims by means of him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4662)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hasan bin Ali (RA) se farmaya: "Beshak mera yeh beta sardaar hai, aur shaayad Allah iske zariye Musalmano ke do bade giroh ke darmiyan sulah kara de."

e: [AI] While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was delivering a sermon to the people, Hassan ibn Ali came to him and climbed onto his lap. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  embraced him and said, "Indeed, this son of mine is a master and indeed, Allah the Almighty may use him to reconcile between two great factions of Muslims." Both of these narrations were reported by Al-Bukhari through the route of Abu Musa Israil from Al-Hasan.
hi: Jabke Rasulullah (SAW) logon ko khutba de rahe the, ke Hasan bin Ali (RA) aaye, unke paas chadhe, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein apne sath lipta liya aur farmaya: "Khabardaar, mera yeh beta sardaar hai, aur shaayad Allah, buzurg aur buland, iske zariye Musalmano ke do bade giroh ke darmiyan sulah kara de." Bukhari ne dono ko Abu Musa Israel se, Al-Hasan se, riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] A man criticized Hasan ibn Ali when he pledged allegiance to Muawiya, saying that Hasan had brought shame to the believers and had done this and that. Hasan replied, "Do not blame me, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw the Umayyads taking turns on his pulpit, one after another, and it distressed him and concerned him, so Allah Almighty revealed: 'Indeed, We have granted you Al-Kawthar,' a river in Paradise. And He also revealed: 'Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree. And what will make you know what the Night of Decree is? The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months' during which they will rule after you.” This was omitted by Al-Dhahabi from his summary due to its weakness.
hi: Aik aadmi ne Hasan bin Ali (RA) ka saamna kiya jab unhone Mu'awiyah (RA) se baiyat ki, usne unhein malaamat ki aur kaha: "Tumne momino ke chehre kaale kar diye, aur tumne yeh kiya aur woh kiya." To unhone kaha: "Mujhe malaamat mat karo, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Banu Umayyah ko apne mimbar par aik-aik aadmi karke uchhalte dekha, to yeh unhein bura laga aur unhein pareshaan kiya, to Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne yeh nazil ki: {Beshak humne tumhein Kauthar diya}, aik nehar Jannat mein, aur {Beshak humne ise Laylatul-Qadr mein nazil kiya, aur tumhein kya khabar Laylatul-Qadr kya hai, Laylatul-Qadr hazaar mahine se behtar hai} jinpar woh tumhare baad hukumat karengay." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] We were at the forefront with Hasan ibn Ali, numbering twelve thousand, with our swords dripping with sharpness ready to fight the people of Sham, led by Abu al-Umr Taha. When the peace agreement between Hasan ibn Ali and Muawiya reached us, it was as if our backs were broken from anger and rage. When Hasan ibn Ali arrived in Kufa, a man from among us, known as Abu Amir Sufyan ibn al-Layl, stood up and said, "Peace be upon you, O debaser of the believers." Hasan replied, "Do not say that, O Abu Amir. I have not debased the believers, but I disliked killing them in pursuit of power." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in the summary.
hi: Hum Hasan bin Ali (RA) ke muqaddama (agli safon) mein baarah hazaar (12,000) the, humari talwaarein tezi se tapak rahi thin Sham walon se jung karne ke liye, aur humpar Abu Al-Umar Taha (ameer) the, jab Hasan bin Ali (RA) aur Mu'awiyah (RA) ki sulah ki khabar humein pahunchi, to goya humari peethein ghusse aur ranj se toot gayin, jab Hasan bin Ali (RA) Kufa pahunche, to humme se aik aadmi jise Abu Aamir Sufyan bin Al-Layl kaha jaata tha unke paas khada hua aur kaha: "Aapko salaam ho, Aye momino ko zaleel karne wale." To Hasan (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh mat kaho, Aye Abu Aamir, maine momino ko zaleel nahi kiya, lekin mujhe napasand tha ke main hukumat ki talaash mein unhein qatl karoon." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The wisest among the wise is the pious, and the weakest among the weak is immorality. As for this matter in which Muawiya and I differed, it is a rightful matter for each of us. However, Muawiya had more right to it than me, so I left it for him to decide, to seek the satisfaction of the Muslims and preserve their lives. Though I do not know, it may be a trial for you and a temporary enjoyment. I say this and seek forgiveness from Allah for me and for you." - This was omitted by Al-Dhahabi from his summary due to its weakness.
hi: Hasan bin Ali (RA) ne Nakhlah mein humein khutba di jab unhone Mu'awiyah (RA) se sulah ki, khade huay, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir kaha: "Beshak sabse zyada hoshiyaari taqwa hai, aur sabse zyada bebasi gunaah hai, aur yeh maamla jispar main aur Mu'awiyah ikhtilaaf rakhte the, yeh kisi aadmi ka haq tha, jo mujhse zyada uska haqdaar tha, ya mera haq tha jo maine Mu'awiyah ke liye chhod diya, Musalmano ki mazbooti aur unke khoon ke tahaffuz ke iraade se, aur mujhe nahi pata shaayad yeh tum logon ke liye aik fitna aur aik muddat tak faayda ho, main yehi kehta houn, aur apne aur tumhare liye Allah se maghfirat maangta houn." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] The passage translates to: "Ali used to say to Al-Hasan, 'He is taking off his robe.'"
hi: "Ali (RA) Hasan (RA) se kaha karte the: 'Woh apna jaama (kapda) utaarne wala hai.'"

e: "The daughter of Al-Ash'ath bin Qays, Al-Hasan bin Ali, was named, and wealth was bestowed upon her."
hi: "Al-Ash'ath bin Qais (RA) ki beti ne Hasan bin Ali (RA) ko zeher diya, jinke woh nikah mein thin, aur isspar usse maal ki riswat di gayi."

e: [AI] "I have been exhausted a lot, and I have been given poison repeatedly, and I have never been given such as this." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Maine apne jigar ka aik hissa peshaab mein nikaala hai, aur mujhe kayi baar zeher pilaaya gaya hai, magar mujhe kabhi is jaisa (zeher) nahi pilaaya gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Hasan ibn Ali saw in a dream a vision with the words "{Say, He is Allah, [who is] One}" [Al-Ikhlas 1] written between his eyes. He shared this vision with Said ibn al-Musayyib, who said, "If your vision is true, then your time has come." He was poisoned that year and passed away, may Allah have mercy on him. Al-Dhahabi omitted it from his summary due to its weakness.
hi: Hasan bin Ali (RA) ne khwaab mein dekha ke unki dono aankhon ke darmiyan "{Kaho: Woh Allah, aik hai}" (Surah Al-Ikhlas 1) likha hua hai, unhone yeh Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib ko sunaaya, unhone kaha: "Agar tumhara khwaab sach hai, to tumhara waqt aa gaya hai." Unhone kaha: to usi saal unhein zeher diya gaya aur unka intiqaal ho gaya, Allah ki rehmat ho unpar. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] She entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I had a distressing dream last night." He asked, "What was it?" She replied, "It was severe." He asked again, "What was it?" She said, "I saw as if a piece of your body was cut off and placed in my lap." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "You have seen a good dream. Fatimah will give birth to a son, if Allah wills, and he will be placed in your lap." Fatimah then gave birth to Al-Husayn, and he was indeed placed in her lap as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had said. One day, I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and placed Al-Husayn in his lap. Then, I noticed that the Prophet's eyes were shedding tears. So, I said, "O Prophet of Allah, may my father and mother be sacrificed for you, what is the matter?" He replied, "Gabriel came to me and informed me that my Ummah will kill this son of mine." I asked, "This one?" He replied, "Yes, and he brought me a handful of his red soil."
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil hui aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine aaj raat aik bura khwaab dekha." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Woh kya tha?" Unhone kaha: "Woh sakht tha." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Woh kya tha?" Unhone kaha: "Maine dekha goya aapke jism ka aik tukda kaata gaya aur mere god mein rakha gaya." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne achhai dekhi, Fatimah, Allah chaahe to, aik larka janam degi jo tumhari god mein hoga." To Fatimah (RA) ne Husain (RA) ko janam diya, aur woh mere god mein huay jaisa Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha. Aik din main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unhein unki god mein rakha, phir mujhe mudne ka mauka mila, achaanak Rasulullah (SAW) ki aankhon se aansoo beh rahe the, maine kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, mere waalid aur maa aap par qurbaan, aapko kya hua?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jibra'il (AS), unpar durood-o-salaam ho, mere paas aaye aur mujhe bataaya ke meri Ummat mere is bete ko qatl karegi." Maine poocha: "Yeh?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, aur woh mere paas uski surkh mitti bhi laaye."

e: [AI] "Fatima gave birth to Hussein after Hassan, for a period of one year and ten months. She gave birth to him at the age of six years, five months, and a half from the date. Hussein was killed on Friday, the day of Ashura, in the tenth month of Muharram in the year sixty-one, at the age of forty-four and fifty years. I mentioned these events and explained them in the book "The Killing of Hussein," which is sufficient for those who hear it and understand it."
hi: "Fatimah (RA) ne Husain (RA) ko Hasan (RA) ke aik saal das (10) mahine baad janam diya, to unhone unhein chhah (6) saal paanch (5) mahine aadhe (calendar mein) janam diya, aur Husain Jumme ke din, Ashura ke din, Muharram ki das (10) raatein guzarne par, iksath (61) hijri mein qatl kiye gaye, jabke woh chauwan (54) saal ke thay." Aur maine yeh khabren apni kitaab "Maqtal-e-Husain" mein tafseel se zikr ki hain, jismein sunne aur samajhne wale ke liye kaafi hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] He went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to a gathering where he was invited. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ faced the crowd and Husain played with the children. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wanted to take him, so the child ran away from him, running here and there. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made him laugh until he caught him. Then he placed one of his hands under his chin and the other under his cheek, and he placed his mouth on his mouth and kissed him. He said, "Husain is from me, and I am from Husain. May Allah love those who love Husain. Husain is a noble descendant."
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aik khaane ki dawat par gaye jiske liye unhein bulaaya gaya tha, unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ka saamna qaum ke imam se hua, aur Husain bachchon ke sath khel rahe the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein pakadne ka iraada kiya, to bacha kabhi idhar bhaagne laga kabhi udhar, to Rasulullah (SAW) unhein hansaate rahe yahan tak ke unhein pakad liya, unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne apna aik haath unki gardan ke peechhe aur doosra unki thodi ke neeche rakha, phir apna mun unke mun par rakha aur unhein bosa diya, phir farmaya: "Husain mujhse hai aur main Husain se houn, Allah usse mohabbat kare jo Husain se mohabbat kare, Husain aik sibt (nawaasa) hai in nawaason mein se."

e: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with Al-Hasan b. 'Ali placed upon his shoulders and he was saying: O Allah, I love him, and love him Thou. (Using translation from Muslim 2422b)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha jabke woh Husain bin Ali (RA) ko uthaaye huay the, aur woh farma rahe the: "Aye Allah, main isse mohabbat karta houn, isliye tu bhi isse mohabbat kar."

e: [AI] “Allah, the Most High, revealed to Muhammad ﷺ  that I have killed seventy thousand through Yahya bin Zakariyya and I will kill seventy thousand through the son of your granddaughter. This is the wording of the narration of Ash-Shafi'i. And in the narration of Al-Qadi Abu Bakr bin Kamal, I have killed in revenge for the blood of Yahya bin Zakariyya, and I will kill in revenge for the blood of the son of your granddaughter.”
hi: Allah Ta'ala ne Muhammad (SAW) ki taraf wahi ki: "Maine Yahya bin Zakariya (AS) ke (khoon ke) badle mein sattar hazaar (70,000) qatl kiye, aur main tumhari nawaasi ke bete ke (khoon ke) badle mein sattar hazaar aur sattar hazaar (70,000+70,000) qatl karunga."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once went out and found me in the mosque. He took my hand and leaned on me, and I accompanied him until we reached the marketplace of Bani Qaynuqa. He said, 'What will you say to me?' He circled around and looked, then he returned and I returned with him. He sat in the mosque and covered himself with a garment and said to me, 'Ask me for anything.' So, Husayn came and started to climb until he fell on his lap. Then he put his hand inside the beard of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  opened the mouth of Husayn and put his finger in it, saying, 'O Allah, I love him, so love him.'"
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) aik din nikle aur mujhe masjid mein paaya, unhone mera haath pakda aur mujhpar takiya kiya, main unke sath chala yahan tak ke woh Banu Qainuqa ke bazaar mein pahunche, unhone kaha: aap (SAW) ne mujhse koi baat nahi ki, ghoome aur nazar daali, phir wapas laute aur main unke sath wapas aaya, to woh masjid mein baithe aur apne kapde mein lipat gaye, aur mujhse kaha: "Us laalach karne wale (bacche) ko bulaao." To Husain daudte huay aaye yahan tak ke unki god mein gir gaye, phir unhone apna haath Rasulullah (SAW) ki daadhi mein daala, to Rasulullah (SAW) Husain ka mun kholte aur apna mun uske mun mein rakhte, kehte: "Aye Allah, main isse mohabbat karta houn, isliye tu bhi isse mohabbat kar."

e: [AI] I am the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Al-Hussein is in his chamber. Indeed, Gabriel, peace be upon him, informed me that my Ummah will kill Al-Hussein. Ibn Abi Saminah summarized this hadith and it was narrated by others from Muhammad ibn Mus'ab in its entirety." Al-Dhahabi deleted it from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya, jabke Husain unki god mein the: "Beshak Jibra'il (AS), unpar durood-o-salaam ho, ne mujhe bataaya ke meri Ummat Husain ko qatl karegi." Ibn Abi Saminah ne is hadith ko mukhtasar kiya, aur doosron ne ise Muhammad bin Mus'ab se mukammal riwayat kiya hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Ali, O people of Iraq, love us with the love of Islam. I heard my father say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O people, do not elevate me above my rank, for Allah has made me a servant before making me a Prophet." So I mentioned it to Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib, and he said, "And after he was made a Prophet."
hi: Ali (RA): "Aye Iraq walo, humse Islam ki mohabbat rakho." Maine apne waalid ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye logo, mujhe meri had se zyada mat uthaao, kyunke Allah ne mujhe Nabi banaane se pehle banda banaya tha." To maine yeh baat Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib ko sunaayi, unhone kaha: "Aur unhein Nabi banaane ke baad bhi (banda hi rahe)."

e: [AI] "We and the people of the house had no doubt that Hussein ibn Ali would be killed at Karbala."
hi: "Humein koi shak nahi tha, jabke Ahl-e-Bait kasrat mein maujood the, ke Husain bin Ali (RA) At-Taff (Karbala) mein qatl kiye jaayenge." Weak, Rejected.

e: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ uttering the call to prayer (Adhan) in the ear of al-Hasan ibn Ali when Fatimah gave birth to him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5105)
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, jab Fatimah (RA) ne Husain (RA) ko janam diya, to unhone unke kaan mein azaan di."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded Fatimah and said, "Adorn the hair of Al-Hussein and give as charity its weight in silver, and give the midwife a gift of a sheep for the newborn's 'Aqiqah."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fatimah (RA) ko hukum diya aur farmaya: "Husain ke baal tolo aur unke wazan ke barabar chandi sadqa karo, aur daai (hospitalwali khaatoon) ko aqiqah (qurbani ke jaanwar) ki taang do." Not Accepted.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered upon me while I was breastfeeding Al-Hussein bin Ali with the milk of a child named Qutham. He said, "Give him to me." So I gave him to him, and he held him on his lap. Then Al-Hussein urinated on him. I took him back from his hand and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do not cause harm to my son." Then he ordered for some water to be poured on the urine. Ibn Abbas said, "The urine of a baby who has not yet started eating solid food should be sprinkled, and the urine of a girl should be washed."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas dakhil huay jabke main Husain bin Ali (RA) ko aik bete ke doodh se doodh pila rahi thi jinhein Qutham kaha jaata tha, unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein le liya, maine unhein de diya, to unhone aap (SAW) par peshaab kar diya, unhone kaha: to maine apna haath unki taraf badhaaya (hataane ke liye), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere bete ko jaldi mat hataao (uska kaam poora honay do)." Unhone kaha: phir unhone usspar paani chhidka. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Us ladke ka peshaab jisne abhi tak khaana khaana shuru nahi kiya, chhidka jaata hai, aur ladki ka peshaab dhoya jaata hai."

e:
[AI] "Al-Husayn was killed on the day of Ashura, on Friday."
Hakim said, "We will explain this news in the Book of the Killing of Al-Husayn, and it is sufficient for those who hear it." 
Hakim said, "This is the last that has been reached through diligence concerning mentioning the virtues of the family of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with authentic chains of narration that have not been compiled by the two esteemed Imams (Bukhari and Muslim). I have dictated what my diligence has led to regarding the virtues of the four caliphs and the family of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, authenticated by chains of narration. Then I saw that it was better to organize this book chronologically after them for all the companions, from the beginning of Islam to the last one who died among them, and Allah is the one who aids in that with His mercy."
hi: "Husain Ashura ke din, Jumme ke din, qatl kiye gaye." Al-Hakim ne kaha: "Yeh khabrein hum apni kitaab 'Maqtal-e-Husain' mein tafseel se bayan karenge, jismein sunne wale ke liye kaafi hai." Al-Hakim ne kaha: "Yeh woh aakhri baat hai jispar meri mehnat ne mujhe pahunchaaya, Rasulullah (SAW) ke Ahl-e-Bait ke manaqib (fazaail) ka zikr sahih asnaad ke sath, jinhein dono Imam (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne nahi nikaala, aur maine chaar Khulafa aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke Ahl-e-Bait ke fazaail mein se woh likhwaaya jo meri mehnat ne mujhe pahunchaaya, jo asnaad ke sath sahih hai, phir maine dekha ke is kitaab ki tarteeb ke liye behtar yeh hai ke unke baad tamaam sahaba ko unki taareekhon ke mutaabiq tarteeb dun, Islam ki shuru'aat se lekar unme se aakhri faut honay wale tak, aur Allah hi apni rehmat se ismein madad karne wala hai."

e: [AI] "So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  heard about them and went to meet them. He sat with them and said, 'Do you have anything better than what I have come to invite you to?' They asked, 'What is it?' He said, 'I am the Messenger of Allah, sent by Allah to call people to worship Him alone without associating anything with Him, and to reveal the Book to me.' Then he mentioned Islam to them and recited the Quran to them. Iyas ibn Mu'adh, who was then a young boy, asked, 'Who are these people?' By Allah, they are better than what you have come with.' Abu Al-Haysar took a handful of dirt and hit Iyas ibn Mu'adh in the face and said, 'Leave us alone, for by my life, we did not come for this.' So Iyas fell silent and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  got up and they went back to Al-Madinah. This incident took place near the Bua'th between the Aws and Khazraj tribes. Iyas ibn Mu'adh did not survive for long after that." Mahmud ibn Labid said, "Someone who was present with him at the time of his death informed me that they kept hearing him saying 'Allahu Akbar' (Allah is the Greatest), praising and glorifying Allah until he died. They did not doubt that he died as a Muslim. He had truly embraced Islam in that gathering when he heard what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said."
hi: To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke baare mein suna, unke paas gaye aur unke sath baith gaye, farmaya: "Kya tumhein us cheez se behtar cheez mein dilchaspi hai jiske liye tum aaye ho?" Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Allah ka Rasool houn, Allah ne mujhe bandon ki taraf bheja hai taake main unhein Allah ki ibaadat karne aur usske sath kisi ko shareek na karne ki dawat doon, aur mujhpar Kitaab nazil ki gayi hai." Phir unhein Islam ka zikr kiya aur unhein Quran padha, to Iyas bin Mu'adh, jo aik jawaan ladka tha, ne kaha: "Kaisi qaum hai yeh! Allah ki qasam, yeh us cheez se behtar hai jiske liye tum aaye ho." Unhone kaha: to Abu Al-Haisar ne Bat'haa ki mitti ki aik mutthi li aur Iyas bin Mu'adh ke chehre par maari aur kaha: "Humein tumse chhod do, meri jaan ki qasam, hum kisi aur maqsad ke liye aaye hain." To Iyas khaamosh ho gaye, Rasulullah (SAW) khade huay aur woh Madinah ki taraf wapas chale gaye, to Bu'ath ki jung Aus aur Khazraj ke darmiyan hui. Unhone kaha: phir Iyas bin Mu'adh zyada der na rukay ke woh halaak ho gaye. Mahmood bin Labeed (RA) ne kaha: mujhe mere qabile ke un logon ne bataaya jo unki maut ke waqt maujood the ke woh unhein hamesha Allah ki tahleel, takbeer, hamd, aur tasbeeh karte suna karte the yahan tak ke unka intiqaal ho gaya. Unhone kaha: to unhein koi shak na tha ke woh Musalman honay ki haalat mein faut huay, unhone us majlis mein Islam mehsoos kar liya tha jab unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se woh suna jo unhone suna.

e: [AI] The death of Bara'ah bin Ma'rur occurred in the month of Safar, before the arrival of the Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him, and he was the first to speak among the leaders.
hi: "Al-Bara bin Ma'rur (RA) ka intiqaal Safar mein Nabi (SAW) ki (Madinah) aamad se aik mahine pehle hua, aur woh Naqibon (numaindon) mein se sabse pehle baat karne wale the."

e: [AI] Al-Bara' bin Ma'rur was the first to pledge allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the night of Al-'Aqabah among the seventy from the Ansar. Al-Bara' bin Ma'rur stood up and praised Allah and glorified Him. Then he said, "Praise be to Allah who honored us with Muhammad ﷺ and brought him to us. He was the first to respond and the last to invite, so we answered Allah and obeyed Him, O people of Aws and Khazraj, Allah has honored you with His religion. If you accept hearing, obedience, and support with gratitude, then obey Allah and His Messenger."
hi: Al-Bara bin Ma'rur (RA) sabse pehle the jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke haath par Aqabah ki raat, Ansar ke sattar (70) logon mein, baiyat ki, to Al-Bara bin Ma'rur (RA) khade huay, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir kaha: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne humein Muhammad (SAW) se izzat di aur unhein humare paas laaya," aur woh sabse pehle jawaab dene wale aur sabse aakhri bulaane wale the, "to humne Allah, buzurg aur buland, ko jawaab diya, humne suna aur itaa'at ki, Aye Aus aur Khazraj ke giroh, Allah ne tumhein apne deen se izzat di hai, agar tum sunna, itaa'at karna, aur shukar ke sath madad karna qubool karo, to Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaa'at karo," phir baith gaye.

e: [AI] Khadijah, may Allah be pleased with her, hired the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for two trips to Jarash, each trip for a fee of Qalush.
hi: "Khadijah (RA), Allah unse raazi ho, ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko Jurash ke do safaron ke liye ujrat par rakha, har safar ke liye aik jawaan oontni."

e: [AI] "The first woman that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ married was Khadijah bint Khuwaylid bin Asad bin Abd al-Uzza. He married her in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance, and her father, Khuwaylid bin Asad, performed the marriage."
hi: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ki pehli biwi jinse unhone nikah kiya woh Khadijah bint Khuwailid bin Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza thin, unhone unse Jaahiliyat (Islam se pehle ke daur) mein nikah kiya, aur unke waalid Khuwailid bin Asad ne unka nikah karvaaya."

e: [AI] "Khadijah passed away before the migration in a year."
hi: "Khadijah ka intiqaal Hijrat se aik saal pehle hua."

e: [AI] "Abu Talib and Khadijah bint Khuwaylid died in the same year, three years before the Prophet ﷺ  migrated to Medina. Khadijah was buried in Hujun, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stayed in her grave. She was married to him for twenty-eight years." Muhammad said, "The kunyah of Khadijah is Umm Hind, and she had a son and a daughter when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married her. The mother of Khadijah is Fatimah bint Zaydah bin Al-Asamm, and her mother is Hala bint 'Abd Manaf."
hi: "Beshak Abu Talib aur Khadijah bint Khuwailid dono aik hi saal mein faut huay, aur yeh Nabi (SAW) ki Madinah hijrat se teen (3) saal pehle hua, aur Khadijah ko Hajun mein dafan kiya gaya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) unki qabr mein utre, aur jab unhone unse nikah kiya to unki umr atthaais (28) saal thi." Muhammad ne kaha: "Aur Khadijah ki kunniyat Umm Hind thi, aur unke aik beta aur aik beti thi jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse nikah kiya, aur Khadijah ki maa Fatimah bint Zaidah bin Al-Asamm thin, aur unki (Fatimah ki) maa Haalah bint Abd Manaf thin."

e: [AI] "Khadijah bint Khuwaylid passed away at the age of sixty-five. This statement is incorrect, because I believe she did not reach the age of sixty."
hi: "Khadijah bint Khuwailid ka intiqaal jabke woh painsath (65) saal ki thin." Yeh aik anokhi (shaaz) raay hai, kyunke mere nazdeek woh saath (60) saal tak nahi pahunchi thin.

e: [AI] Khadijah, the wife of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, gave birth to two boys and four girls: Al-Qasim, Abdullah, Fatimah, Zaynab, Ruqayyah, and Umm Kulthum.
hi: Khadijah ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye do larke aur chaar auraten janam din - Al-Qasim, Abdullah, Fatimah, Zainab, Ruqayyah, aur Umm Kulthum.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Praise be to Allah who has given me bread (food) and dressed me in silk and married me to Khadijah, whom I love."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne mujhe khameer wali roti khilaayi, mujhe resham pehnaaya, aur mera nikah Khadijah se karwaaya, aur main unse dilo-jaan se mohabbat karta tha."

e:
[AI] On Monday, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prayed, and Khadijah prayed with him. It was mentioned that he offered Ali to pray on Tuesday, so he accepted Islam and said, "Let me decide, or should I command Abu Talib to pray?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "It is an Amanah (trust)."
Ali then said, "In that case, I will pray," and he prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on Tuesday.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Peer ke din namaz padhi, aur Khadijah (RA) ne unke sath namaz padhi, aur unhone Mangalvaar ke din Ali (RA) ko namaz (ki dawat) pesh ki, to woh Musalman ho gaye aur kaha: "Mujhe (khud faisla karne) do, ya main Abu Talib ko namaz ke baare mein hukum doon." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh to sirf aik amaanat hai." Unhone kaha: to Ali (RA) ne kaha: "To main namaz padhunga," to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Mangalvaar ke din namaz padhi.

e: [AI] "He is a prophet, and no one obeyed him in his command except for this woman and this boy. This woman is Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, his wife, and this boy is Ali ibn Abi Talib, his cousin. Afeef al-Kindi said, 'He became a Muslim, and his Islam was excellent. I wish I had become a Muslim on that day so that I would have a quarter of his Islam.'"
hi: Ke woh Nabi hain, aur unke maamle mein unki pairavi is aurat aur is ladke ke siwa kisi ne nahi ki - yeh aurat Khadijah bint Khuwailid, unki biwi, hain, aur yeh ladka unke chachazaad Ali bin Abi Talib hain. Afeef Al-Kindi ne kaha: "Woh Musalman huay, aur unka Islam behtareen tha, kaash main us din Musalman ho gaya hota, to mujhe Islam ka chautha hissa milta."

e: [AI] Narrated Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , said that the first thing that Allah's Messenger ﷺ  started receiving from Allah was true dreams during his sleep. And he would not see any dream but it would come true like bright daylight. Then solitude was made dear to him and he used to go in seclusion in the cave of Hira where he used to worship (Allah alone) continuously for many nights before coming back to his wife Khadija. She informed him of her conviction of his Prophethood and supported him through her wealth and efforts. Then Allah's Messenger ﷺ  returned with that experience of true inspiration, his heart was beating violently, and then he went to Khadija and said, "Cover me! Cover me!" They covered him until his fear was over and then he told Khadija everything that had happened and said, "I fear that something may happen to me." Khadija replied, "Never! But have the glad tidings, for by Allah, Allah shall never disgrace you as you keep good relations with your kith and kin, speak the truth, help the poor and the destitute, serve your guests generously, and assist the deserving calamity-afflicted ones." Then Khadija went along with him to her cousin Waraqa bin Naufal bin Asad bin 'Abdul 'Uzza bin Qusai. Waraqa was the son of her paternal uncle, i.e., her father's brother, who during the Pre-Islamic Period became a Christian and used to write the writing with Hebrew letters. He would write from the Gospel in Hebrew as much as Allah wished him to write. He was an old man and had lost his eyesight. Khadija said to him, "O my cousin! Listen to the story of your nephew." Waraqa asked, "O my nephew! What have you seen?" The Prophet ﷺ  described whatever he had seen. Waraqa said, "This is the same Namus (i.e., Gabriel, the Angel who keeps the secrets of Allah) whom Allah had sent to Moses ﷺ . I wish I were young and could live till the time when your people would turn you out." Allah's Messenger ﷺ  asked, "Will they drive me out?" Waraqa replied in the affirmative and said, "Anyone (man) who came with something similar to what you have brought was treated with hostility; and if I should remain alive till the day when you will be turned out then I would support you strongly." But after a few days of Waraqa's death, Allah's Messenger ﷺ  received the Divine Inspiration and the Verse of Al-Qur'an, 2.286 (Surat Al-Baqarah) was revealed to him.
hi: Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, se, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) par wahi ka aaghaaz sachhe khwaabon se hua, unhein neend mein koi khwaab nahi aata magar woh subah ki roshni ki tarah (sach) hoke aata, phir unhein tanhaai aziz lagne lagi, to woh Ghar-e-Hira jaate aur wahan (raaton ko) ibaadat karte, yahan tak ke haq (achaanak) unke paas aa gaya jabke woh Ghar-e-Hira mein the, to farishta unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Padho." Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Main padhne wala nahi houn." Unhone kaha: to usne mujhe pakda aur mujhe dabaya yahan tak ke mujhpar takleef ki intihaa ho gayi, phir usne mujhe chhoda aur kaha: "{Padho apne Rab ke naam se jisne (sab kuch) paida kiya, Insaan ko jame huay khoon se paida kiya, Padho, aur tumhara Rab sabse zyada karam wala hai, jisne qalam se sikhaya, Insaan ko woh sikhaya jo woh nahi jaanta tha}" (Surah Al-Alaq 2). Unhone kaha: to woh isse wapas aaye jabke unke kandhe kaanp rahe the, yahan tak ke Khadijah ke paas dakhil huay, to farmaya: "Mujhe lapeto, mujhe lapeto." To unhone unhein lapeta yahan tak ke unka khauf door hua, to farmaya: "Aye Khadijah, mujhe kya ho gaya?" To unhein poori baat batayi, aur farmaya: "Mujhe apne baare mein darr laga." To unhone kaha: "Hargiz nahi, khush ho jaayen, Allah ki qasam, Allah aapko kabhi rusva nahi karega, beshak aap sila-e-rehmi karte hain, sach bolte hain, kamzoron ka bojh uthaate hain, mehmaan ki mehmaan-nawaazi karte hain, aur haq ki museebaton mein madad karte hain." Phir Khadijah unhein lekar Waraqah bin Naufal bin Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza bin Qusay ke paas gayin, jo Khadijah ke chacha, unke waalid ke bhai, the, aur woh aik shakhs the jinhone Jaahiliyat mein Nasraaniyat (Christianity) ikhtiyar ki thi, aur woh Arabic likhte the aur Injeel se jitna Allah chaahta, Arabic mein likhte, aur woh aik buzurg shaikh the jo andhe ho chuke the. Khadijah ne kaha: "Aye chacha, apne bhatije se suno." Waraqah bin Naufal ne kaha: "Aye mere bhatije, tum kya dekhte ho?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein woh khabar di jo unhone dekhi, to Waraqah ne kaha: "Yeh woh Naamoos (raazdaar farishta) hai jo Musa (AS) par nazil kiya gaya tha."

e: [AI] "Khadijah was the first woman to believe in the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." It was omitted by Al-Dhahabi from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: "Khadijah Rasulullah (SAW) par imaan laane wali auraton mein sabse pehli thin." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "Khadijah was the first person to believe in Allah and believe in His Messenger ﷺ, before prayer was obligatory." This statement was deleted by Al-Dhahabi from the summary [of narrators] due to its weakness.
hi: "Khadijah Allah par imaan laane aur uske Rasool (SAW) ki tasdeeq karne wali sabse pehli thin, namaz farz honay se pehle." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] I came to Hudhayfah bin Al-Yaman while he was in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I heard him saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say, 'Khadijah bint Khuwaylid was the foremost among the women of the world in embracing faith in Allah and in me ﷺ.'" Adh-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Main Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (RA) ke paas aaya jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein the, maine unhein kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Khadijah bint Khuwailid duniya ki auraton mein Allah aur Muhammad (SAW) par imaan laane mein sabse aage thin." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The best women (of her time) was Maryam bint ‘Imran, and the best woman (of her time) is Khadeejah.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 640)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Uski (apne zamane ki) behtareen aurat Maryam bint Imran (AS) hain, aur uski (apne zamane ki) behtareen aurat Khadijah hain." Dono Imamon (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne ise nikaalne par ittefaaq kiya hai, aur maine ise isliye zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "I have been commanded to give glad tidings to Khadijah of a house in Paradise made of reeds, without any noise or fatigue." This is based on the condition set by Muslim.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main Khadijah ko Jannat mein aik aise ghar ki khush-khabri doon jo naigal (khokhle bans) se bana ho, jismein na koi shor ho na koi mehnat." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I have been commanded to give glad tidings to Khadijah of a house in Jannah (Paradise) made of reeds, with no noise or tiredness in it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main Khadijah ko Jannat mein aik aise ghar ki khush-khabri doon jo naigal se bana ho, jismein na koi shor ho na koi mehnat."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'I have been commanded to bring good news to Khadijah of a house in Paradise made of reeds.' Abu Abdul Rahman said, 'I said to my father, indeed Yahya ibn Ma'in criticizes Aamir ibn Salih.' He said, 'What does he say?' I said, 'He claims that he heard from Hajjaj.' He said, 'I have observed that Hajjaj hears from unreliable sources, and this is a flaw for a person to hear from someone who is younger or older than him according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.'"
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main Khadijah ko Jannat mein aik ghar ki khush-khabri doon jo naigal se bana ho." Abu Abdur Rahman ne kaha: maine apne waalid se kaha: "Yahya bin Ma'een is Aamir bin Salih par tanqeed karte hain." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya kehte hain?" Maine kaha: "Unhone dekha ke inhone Al-Hajjaj se suna." Unhone kaha: "Maine bhi dekha hai ke Al-Hajjaj Husheim se sunte hain, aur yeh koi aib nahi ke koi aadmi apne se chhote ya bade se sune." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: Gabriel came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! This is Khadija coming to you with a dish having meat soup (or some food or drink). When she reaches you, greet her on behalf of her Lord (i.e. Allah) and on my behalf, and give her the glad tidings of having a Qasab palace in Paradise wherein there will be neither any noise nor any fatigue (trouble) . " (Using translation from Bukhārī 3820)
hi: Maine Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte suna: Jibra'il (AS) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh Khadijah aapke paas aa rahi hain, unke sath aik bartan hai jismein khaana ya khaane-peene ki cheez hai, jab woh aapke paas aayen, to unhein unke Rab ki taraf se salaam kahiyega, aur unhein Jannat mein aik naigal se bane ghar ki khush-khabri dijiyega, jismein na koi shor ho na koi mehnat."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  drew four lines on the ground and said, "Do you know what this is?" They replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The most virtuous women of the people of Paradise are Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, and Maryam bint Imran." And I believe he said, "And the wife of Pharaoh."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne zameen par chaar lakeerein khainchi aur farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ki behtareen auraten Khadijah bint Khuwailid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, aur Maryam bint Imran (AS) hain," aur mera khayaal hai unhone yeh bhi kaha: "aur Firaun ki biwi."

e: [AI] "I found in my father's book, written in his own handwriting, that Saad bin Ibrahim bin Saad and Ya'qub bin Ibrahim said that my father narrated to me from Salih who narrated from Ibn Shihab who narrated from Urwah who said: Aisha said to Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , 'Shall I not give you good news? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: The noblest ladies of the people of Paradise are four: Maryam, the daughter of Imran; Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah; Khadijah, the daughter of Khuwaylid; and Asiyah, wife of Fir'aun (Pharaoh), on the condition mentioned in Sahih al-Bukhari and Muslim.'"
hi: Maine apne waalid ki kitaab mein unke apne haath ki likhaai mein paaya: humein Sa'd bin Ibrahim bin Sa'd aur Ya'qub bin Ibrahim ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: humein humare waalid ne Salih se, unhone Ibn Shihab se, unhone Urwah se hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: Aisha (RA) ne Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW) se kaha: "Kya main tumhein khush-khabri na doon ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Jannat waalon ki sardaar auraten chaar hain - Maryam bint Imran (AS), Fatimah bint Rasulullah (SAW), Khadijah bint Khuwailid, aur Aasiya." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: "I did not envy any woman as I envied Khadijah - and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not marry me except after she had died - that was because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave her glad tidings of a house in Paradise made of Qasab, without clamoring nor discomforts in it." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3876)
hi: "Maine kisi aurat se itni jalan mehsoos nahi ki jitni Khadijah se ki, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse nikah sirf unki wafaat ke baad kiya, aur yeh isliye tha ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Jannat mein aik naigal se bane ghar ki khush-khabri di thi, jismein na koi shor ho na koi mehnat."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  did not marry anyone else while Khadijah was alive." Aisha said, "I have never seen anyone more jealous of his wives than me over Khadijah, because of how often he would mention her."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Khadijah ke intiqaal tak unke sath koi doosra nikah nahi kiya." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Khadijah ko kabhi nahi dekha, aur na hi maine unke kisi biwi se itni jalan mehsoos ki jitni Khadijah se ki, aur yeh isliye ke aap unka zikr bohot zyada karte the."

e: [AI] Jibril (Gabriel), peace be upon him, came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, while Khadijah was with him. He said, "Indeed, Allah sends His greetings to Khadijah." She replied, "Indeed, Allah Himself is the source of peace, and upon you be peace and the mercy of Allah."
hi: Jibra'il (AS), unpar durood-o-salaam ho, Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye jabke Khadijah unke paas thin, unhone kaha: "Beshak Allah Khadijah ko salaam kehta hai." Unhone kaha: "Beshak Allah hi As-Salaam (salaamati wala) hai, aur aap par bhi salaam ho aur Allah ki rehmat."

e: [AI] As'ad ibn Zurarah died in the month of Shawwal, nine months after the Hijrah. On that day, the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was being built, and this was before the Battle of Badr. The Banu Najjar came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and told him that their leader had died, and they asked him to appoint a new leader for them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am your leader." The Goldsmith remained silent about the incident in his summary.
hi: As'ad bin Zurarah (RA) ka intiqaal Shawwal mein, Hijrat ke nau (9) mahine ki shuru'aat mein hua, aur us waqt Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid banayi ja rahi thi, aur yeh Badr se pehle hua. To Banu Najjar Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Humara Naqeeb (numainda) faut ho gaya, isliye humpar humara naqeeb muqarrar karein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhara naqeeb houn." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He informed me that he said, "I was the leader after my father lost his sight. He could not hear the call to prayer on Fridays except that he said, 'May the mercy of Allah be upon As'ad ibn Zurara.' So I said after a while, 'If I ask my father what his situation is when he hears the call to prayer, he says, 'May the mercy of Allah be upon As'ad ibn Zurara.' So I said, 'Oh father, I am amazed by your prayer upon Abu Umamah every time you hear the call to prayer on Fridays.' He said, 'Oh my son, he was the first to gather us for Friday prayer in Madinah after the defeat of the Hawazim tribe of Bani Bayadah in the area known as Al-Khadimah.' I asked, 'And how many of you were there that day?' He said, 'Forty men.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarized version."
hi: Unhone unhein bataya, unhone kaha: main apne waalid ka raasta dikhaane wala tha unki nazar jaane ke baad, jab bhi woh Jumme ki azaan sunte, kehte: "Allah ki rehmat ho As'ad bin Zurarah par." To kuch waqt baad maine socha agar main apne waalid se poochoon unhein kya hota hai jab woh azaan sunte hain, unhone kaha: "Allah ki rehmat ho As'ad bin Zurarah par?" Maine kaha: "Aye abba, mujhe hairat hoti hai aapki Abu Umamah ke liye dua par jab bhi aap Jumme ki azaan sunte hain." Unhone kaha: "Aye mere bete, woh sabse pehle the jinhone humein Madinah mein, Banu Bayadhah ki Harrah (patthareeli zameen) ke aik gaddhe mein, Baqee' mein, jise Al-Khadimaat kaha jaata tha, Jumme ki namaz jama karke padhaayi." Maine poocha: "Us din tum kitne the?" Unhone kaha: "Chalees (40) aadmi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "The Prophet ﷺ cauterized As'ad bin Zurarah for Shawkah." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2050)
hi: "Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne As'ad bin Zurarah (RA) ko kaante (shawkah - phunsi/zakhm) ke liye daagh diya."

e: [AI] Zainab bint Nubayt said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  adorned his mother and his aunt." Their father was Abu Umamah As'ad ibn Zurarah, and he entrusted them to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who adorned them with bracelets made of pure gold with pearls. Zainab said, "And I have some of the jewelry." The chain of narration is authentic, and it has not been reported in Sahih Bukhari.
hi: Zainab bint Nubait se: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne unki maa aur unki khaala ko zewar pehnaaya." Aur unke waalid Abu Umamah As'ad bin Zurarah (RA) ne unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke supurd kiya tha, "to unhone unhein sone ki dhaali hui baaliyaan pehnaayin jinmein moti thay." Zainab ne kaha: "Aur maine woh zewar ya uska kuch hissa paaya." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "The first brigade established by the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was led by Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib, then the brigade of Ubaydah ibn al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib was established, to approach Rabigh between al-Juhfah and Qadeed."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne sabse pehla jhanda Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ke liye baandha, phir Ubaidah bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ka jhanda Raabigh, Al-Juhfah aur Qadeed ke darmiyan, ke liye baandha."

e: [AI] And that 'Utba ibn Rabi'ah killed 'Ubaidah ibn al-Harith in a duel. 'Utba struck him on his leg and cut it off. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ carried him and he died from yellow fever during his return journey from Badr. He buried him there.
hi: Aur beshak Utbah bin Rabee'ah ne Ubaidah bin Al-Harith (RA) ko mubaaraze (aik-doosre se jung) mein qatl kiya, Utbah ne unki pindli par waar kiya aur usse kaat diya, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein uthaaya, woh Badr se wapasi mein Safraa mein faut huay, to unhein wahin dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] Utbah and Ubaydah had a disagreement, each one of them struck the other twice. Both of them sought the help of their companions, and Hamzah and Ali supported Utbah and killed Ubaydah. They then carried Ubaydah, whose leg had been severed and his brain was leaking, to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . When they brought Ubaydah to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he asked him, "Aren't you a witness, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Yes." Ubaydah then said, "If Abu Talib were alive, he would know that we are more deserving of what he said about us in Al-Bahr Al-Thuyl. We handed him over until he was killed in his vicinity, and we were left helpless regarding our children and properties." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: Utbah aur Ubaidah ke darmiyan do-do waar huay, dono ne aik-doosre ko zameen par gira diya, to Hamzah (RA) aur Ali (RA) Utbah par jhapte aur usse qatl kar diya, aur apne saathi Ubaidah ko uthaaya, unhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaye jabke unki taang kaati ja chuki thi aur uska maghz beh raha tha. Jab woh Ubaidah ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaye, to unhone poocha: "Kya main shaheed nahi houn, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kyun nahi." To Ubaidah ne kaha: "Agar Abu Talib zinda hote, to unhein pata chalta ke hum unki us baat ke zyada haqdaar hain jo unhone kahi thi (bahr At-Taweel mein): 'Aur hum unhein taslim karte hain yahan tak ke hum unke ird-gird gir jaayen, aur hum apne betoon aur biwiyon se ghaafil ho jaayen.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "An offer was presented to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to join the army of Badr, and Umayr ibn Abi Waqqaṣ refused. Umayr then wept, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  granted him permission. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then tied the scabbard of his sword to Umayr."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne Badr ka lashkar pesh kiya gaya, to aap (SAW) ne Umayr bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ko wapas kar diya (kam-umri ki wajah se), to Umayr ro pade, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein ijaazat de di aur unhein apni talwaar ka patta khud baandha."

e: [AI] "We are the smallest with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, me and Sa'd bin Khaythama."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein, mujhe aur Sa'd bin Khaithamah (RA) ko, kam-umr samjha (Badr ke liye)." Repudiated.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out to Badr, Sa'd ibn Khaythama and his father wanted to go out with him. They mentioned this to the Prophet ﷺ , so he ordered one of them to go out. They both competed for it. Khaythama ibn Al-Harith said to his son Sa'd, 'One of us must stay back, so you should stay with your wives.' Sa'd replied, 'If it were not for Paradise, I would give preference to you, as I hope for martyrdom for the sake of Allah's pleasure.' So they competed, and Sa'd went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to Badr, where he was killed by Amr ibn Abd Wadd." (This narration is weak in its chain of transmission)
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Badr ki taraf nikle, to Sa'd bin Khaithamah (RA) aur unke waalid dono unke sath nikalna chahte the, unhone yeh baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi, to aap (SAW) ne hukum diya ke unme se sirf aik nikle, to unhone qura (lottery) daala." To Khaithamah bin Al-Harith ne apne bete Sa'd se kaha: "Humme se aik ko zaroor ruknay hoga, isliye tum apni auraton ke sath ruk jaao." Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: "Agar yeh Jannat na hoti, to main aapko tarjeeh deta, lekin mujhe is mere raaste mein shahaadat ki ummeed hai." To unhone qura daala, Sa'd (RA) ka qura nikla, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr ki taraf nikle, unhein Amr bin Abd Wudd ne qatl kar diya. Mursal, aur isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, used to visit a cemetery where his companions were buried. He would explore the outskirts of the city of Medina and its surroundings, then he would say, "I have been instructed about this place," referring to Al-Baqi cemetery, which used to be called Al-Khabkhaba. The most prominent plant there was the Gharkad tree. The first person to be buried there was Uthman ibn Madh'un. The Prophet placed a stone at his head and said, "This is the grave where we will be resurrected." When a migrant companion died after him, the Prophet was asked, "O Messenger of Allah, where shall we bury him?" He would answer, "Beside the grave of Uthman ibn Madh'un."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) apne sahaba ke liye aik qabristan dhoondte the jismein unhein dafan kiya jaaye, unhone Madinah ke ird-gird aur kinaron ki talaash ki, phir farmaya: "Mujhe iss jagah ka hukum diya gaya hai," matlab Baqee', jise Baqee' Al-Khabkhabah kaha jaata tha, aur wahan sabse zyada Gharqad (kaante-daar jhaadi) ki paidaawaar thi. Wahan sabse pehle jinhein dafan kiya gaya woh Uthman bin Madh'oon the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke sar ke paas aik patthar rakha aur farmaya: "Yeh humare aage jaane wale (fart) ki qabr hai." Jab bhi koi Muhajir unke baad faut hota, kaha jaata: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein use kahan dafan karein?" To aap (SAW) farmate: "Humare aage jaane wale Uthman bin Madh'oon ke paas." Isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  kissed Uthman ibn Mazh'un after his death."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Uthman bin Madh'oon ko unki maut ke baad bosa diya."

e: [AI] His wife said to him, "Congratulations to you, O Uthman bin Mazh'un, for Paradise." The Messenger of Allah looked at her and said, "What makes you say that?" She replied, "O Messenger of Allah, your horseman and companion." The Messenger of Allah said, "I am the Messenger of Allah, and I do not know what will be done with me." The people felt pity for Uthman. When Zainab bint the Messenger of Allah died, the Messenger of Allah said, "Join her with our virtuous predecessors, Uthman bin Mazh'un." The women cried, so Umar began striking them with his whip. The Messenger of Allah took his hand and said, "Wait, O Umar."
hi: Unki biwi ne kaha: "Aapko Jannat mubarak ho, Aye Uthman bin Madh'oon." Rasulullah (SAW) ne unki taraf dekha aur farmaya: "Tumhein kaise pata?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapke sawaar aur saathi (the woh)." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak main Allah ka Rasool houn, aur mujhe khud nahi pata mere sath kya kiya jaayega." To log Uthman ke baare mein pareshaan ho gaye. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Zainab (RA) faut huin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein humare neik pehle jaane wale Uthman bin Madh'oon se milaao." To auraten rone lagin, to Umar (RA) unhein apne kode se maarne lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka haath pakda aur farmaya: "Aahista, Aye Umar."

e: [AI] "Mus'ab, the one who says [The Long Sea], and who is this one who refuses me in marriage, my paternal uncle and my maternal uncle? It is Ali, the one with dew and thick hair. Mu'awiyah said: Mus'ab died while still a polytheist in Najran. As for Ja'dah, he indeed married the daughter of his paternal uncle, Umm Al-Hasan bint Ali, and she gave birth to Abdullah bin Ja'dah bin Hubayrah. It is said that this child was born in Khurasan [The Simple Sea]. If it were not for Ibn Ja'dah, Khurasan and Quhuz would not have been conquered until the blowing of the trumpets. Mus'ab said, 'Ali entrusted Khurasan to Ja'dah bin Hubayrah Al-Makhzumi and he went to Iraq, then he performed Hajj and passed away in Al-Madinah.' Mus'ab narrates a hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the authenticity of which has been mentioned."
hi: Mus'ab aur Ja'dah, jo kehte hain (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Aur kaun hai jo mera apne maamu se inkaar kare, jabke mera maamu Ali hain, sakhaawat wale, aur Aqeel (RA)." Mus'ab ne kaha: aur Hubairah Najran mein mushrik haalat mein faut huay, aur rahi baat Ja'dah ki, to unhone apne maamu ki beti, Umm Al-Hasan bint Ali, se nikah kiya, aur unhone unke liye Abdullah bin Ja'dah bin Hubairah ko janam diya, jinke baare mein Khurasan mein kaha gaya (bahr Al-Baseet mein): "Agar Ibn Ja'dah na hote, to tumhara Quhandiz (qila) na khulta, aur na Khurasan, yahan tak ke Soor phoonka jaata." Mus'ab ne kaha: "Aur Ali (RA) ne Khurasan par Ja'dah bin Hubairah Al-Makhzumi ko ameer muqarrar kiya, aur woh Iraq laut aaye, phir Hajj kiya aur Madinah mein faut huay." Aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se aik hadith bhi riwayat ki hai jo Mus'ab ne jo zikr kiya uski sihat ki tasdeeq karti hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "The best of people are my generation, then those who come after them, then those who come after them. Then there will come a people who will be deceitful."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Behtareen log mera zamana hai, phir jo unke baad aayenge, phir jo unke baad aayenge, phir doosre (baad ke) sabse buray honge."

e: [AI] I said to Ali, "O uncle, did you kill Uthman?" He said, "No, by Allah, I did not kill him nor did I order it, but I was overpowered." Ja'dah bin Hubairah passed away after the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Ali only suspected the death of his father, Hubairah bin Abi Hubairah.
hi: Maine Ali (RA) se kaha: "Aye maamu, kya aapne Uthman (RA) ko qatl kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, na maine unhein qatl kiya na maine iska hukum diya, lekin mujhpar ghalba paa liya gaya." Ja'dah bin Hubairah ka intiqaal Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ke baad hua, aur Ali (RA) ko sirf apne waalid Hubairah bin Abi Hubairah ki wafaat ka ishtibaah hua.

e: [AI] Saad ibn Malik prepared to go out to Badr, but he fell ill and died. His burial place is near the house of Ibn Qaridh. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ struck him with his arrow and paid him his reward.
hi: "Sa'd bin Malik (RA) ne Badr ki taraf nikalne ki taiyaari ki, magar woh bimaar ho gaye aur unka intiqaal ho gaya, unki qabr ki jagah Ibn Qaaridh ke ghar ke paas hai, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke liye unka hissa aur unka ajr muqarrar kiya."

e: [AI] "Shahida Badran from the Banu Hashim, the son of Abdul Manaf, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , along with Hamza ibn Abdul Muttalib, Ali ibn Abi Talib, Zaid ibn Harithah, Ansa Mawla Rasul Allah ﷺ , Abu Kabsha, Abu Marthad, and his son Marthad."
hi: "Banu Hashim bin Abd Manaf mein se Badr mein shirkat karne wale Rasulullah (SAW), Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA), Ali bin Abi Talib (RA), Zaid bin Harithah (RA), Anasah, Rasulullah (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, Abu Kabshah (RA), Abu Marthad (RA), aur unke bete Marthad (RA) the."

e: [AI] Hamza was fighting alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with two swords and saying, "I am the lion of Allah."
hi: Hamzah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne do talwaaron se jung karte the aur kehte: "Main Allah ka sher houn."

e: [AI] "The best of creation on the day when Allah gathers the messengers, and the best of people after the messengers are the martyrs, and the best of martyrs is Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib."
hi: "Beshak makhlooqaat mein sabse behtareen, jis din Allah unhein jama karega, Rusul (payghambar) hain, aur Rusul ke baad logon mein sabse behtareen shuhada (shaheed) hain, aur beshak shuhada mein sabse behtareen Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) hain."

e: [AI] "Indeed Amina bint Wahb, the mother of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , was in the chamber of her uncle Ahyaab ibn Abdul Manaf ibn Zuhrah. And indeed Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim brought his son Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muttalib, the father of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Abdullah married Amina bint Wahb. And Abd al-Muttalib married Hala bint Ahyaab ibn Abdul Manaf ibn Zuhrah, who was the mother of Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib, in the same gathering. And he (Abd al-Muttalib) was close in age to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his foster brother."
hi: "Beshak Aaminah bint Wahb, Rasulullah (SAW) ki maa, apne chacha Ahyab bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah ke zair-nigraani mein thin, aur beshak Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim apne bete Abdullah bin Abdul Muttalib, Rasulullah (SAW) ke waalid, ko laaye, to Abdullah ne Aaminah bint Wahb se nikah kiya, aur Abdul Muttalib ne Haalah bint Ahyab bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah se nikah kiya, jo Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ki maa hain, aik hi majlis mein, aur woh (Hamzah) Rasulullah (SAW) ki umar ke qareeb the aur unke doodh-shareek bhai the."

e: [AI] Abu Jahl confronted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  at As-Safa. He insulted him and said things that were detestable to his religion and demeaning towards him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not respond to him. Abdullah bin Judda'an At-Taymi's wife witnessed this incident from her house, which was located above As-Safa. Afterward, Abu Jahl went to the gathering of the Quraysh at the Kaaba and sat with them. Hamza bin Abdul-Muttalib, with his bow on his shoulder, returned from hunting and normally when he returned in this manner, he would not pass by the gathering of the Quraysh without expressing his strength. On this day, he was still a pagan. The lady who witnessed the incident approached him and informed him about what had transpired between Abu Jahl and Muhammad, and how Abu Jahl had insulted and abused him. Then, she told him that Muhammad had not responded to him. Thus, Hamza became angry for the sake of the honor of Allah's Messenger ﷺ . He hurried, looking for Abu Jahl, in order to avenge the harm that had befallen Allah's Messenger ﷺ . When he entered the Masjid, he saw Abu Jahl sitting among people and went towards him. When he reached Abu Jahl, he drew his bow with all his strength and struck Abu Jahl's head with the bow, causing a severe wound. Men from Quraysh's Banu Makhzum tribe stood to support Abu Jahl, but they did not find Hamza, as he rushed out of the Masjid. He did not stop to speak to anyone as he normally did. He went straight towards the Kaaba to perform Tawaf (circumambulation) while giving Abu Jahl the opportunity to take revenge, had he wanted to. When he entered the Masjid, he saw Abu Jahl sitting among people and went towards him. When he reached Abu Jahl, he drew his bow with all his strength and struck Abu Jahl's head with the bow, causing a severe wound. Men from Quraysh's Banu Makhzum tribe stood to support Abu Jahl, but they did not find Hamza, as he rushed out of the Masjid. He did not stop to speak to anyone as he normally did. He went straight towards the Kaaba to perform Tawaf (circumambulation) while giving Abu Jahl the opportunity to take revenge, had he wanted to. But Abu Jahl restrained himself, not retaliating for the harm he had received. He did not think that Hamza's action was the cause of his forgiveness, but rather his intention was to fulfill the command of Allah. After this incident, Hamza entered his house, and Satan came to him saying, "You are the chief of the Quraysh! You have followed this new religion and abandoned the religion of your ancestors. Death is better for you than what you have done." Hamza was affected by this whisper. He went to Hamza with a doubt in his heart, unsure of the way out of the situation he found himself in. He went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  the next morning and said, "O my nephew! I find myself in a situation and I do not know how to find a way out. I have placed myself in a situation where I cannot retreat or advance. Tell me, is it right for me to continue in the path I have chosen, or should I choose another path?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  advised him, reminded him, admonished him, and gave him glad tidings. As a result, faith entered Hamza's heart, as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had said. Hamza then said, "I bear witness that you are truthful in your testimony, the one who confirms truth and identifies falsehood. Show me, O my nephew, the path to follow, and by Allah, there is nothing I would love more than to have a reputation that would outshine the sun. And I am now embracing my original religion." So it was, that Hamza was one of those whom Allah honored and helped through the religion.
hi: Beshak Abu Jahl ne Rasulullah (SAW) ka Safa ke paas raasta roka, unhein takleef di aur bura-bhala kaha, aur unke deen ki aisi buraai aur kamzori ki baat ki jo napasand thi, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse koi baat nahi ki." Aur Abdullah bin Jud'aan At-Taymi ki aik aazaad ki hui laundi apne ghar mein, jo Safa ke oopar tha, yeh sun rahi thi. Phir Abu Jahl unse alag hokar Ka'bah ke paas Quraish ki majlis mein gaye aur unke sath baith gaye. Thodi hi der guzri thi ke Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib apni kamaan lataka kar shikaar se wapas aaye, aur jab woh aisa karte, to Quraish ki majlis se guzarte, aur woh sabse sakht mizaaj the, aur us waqt woh apni qaum ke deen par mushrik the. To wahi aazaad ki hui laundi unke paas aayi, jabke Rasulullah (SAW) uth kar apne ghar ki taraf ja rahe the, unhone kaha: "Aye Umaarah, kaash aap dekhte apne bhatije Muhammad (SAW) ke sath Abu Al-Hakam ne abhi kya kiya, unhein yahan paaya, unhein takleef di aur bura-bhala kaha, aur woh napasand baat kahi, phir unse alag hokar Ka'bah ke paas Quraish ki majlis mein chale gaye aur unke sath baith gaye, aur Muhammad (SAW) se koi baat nahi ki." To Hamzah ne, Allah ke iraade se jo unki izzat chahta tha, ghussa bardaasht kiya, woh tezi se nikle, kisi ke paas rukay bina jaisa woh aksar karte, unka iraada Ka'bah ka tawaaf karna tha, aur unhone qasdan Abu Jahl ko paane ka iraada kiya taake unse muqaabla karein.
