Jab woh masjid mein dakhil huay, to unhone unhein qaum mein baithe dekha, to unki taraf badhe, jab woh unke sar ke paas khade huay, to kamaan uthaayi aur unke sar par aik zoardaar zarb maari. Quraish ke Banu Makhzoom se kuch mard Hamzah ke khilaaf Abu Jahl ki madad ke liye khade huay, unhone kaha: "Hum tumhein sirf sabaa (deen badalne wala) hi samajhte hain, Aye Hamzah." Hamzah ne kaha: "Mujhe kya rok sakta hai, jabke mujhpar yeh baat wazeh ho chuki hai unki taraf se, main gawahi deta houn ke woh Allah ke Rasool hain, aur jo woh kehte hain haq hai, Allah ki qasam, main peeche nahi hataunga, isliye mujhe roko agar tum sachhe ho." To Abu Jahl ne kaha: "Abu Umaarah ko chhod do, maine unke bhatije ko bohot bura bura-bhala kaha hai." Aur Hamzah apne Islam par qaayam rahe aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki himayat (madad) karte rahe. Jab Hamzah Musalman huay, to Quraish ko pata chala ke Rasulullah (SAW) izzat waale aur mahfooz ho gaye hain, aur Hamzah unki hifaazat karenge, to unhone kuch woh takleefein dena chhod din jo woh dete the. Iske baare mein Sa'd ne, jab unhone Abu Jahl ko maara, aik rajaz (jung ka sheir) kaha jo yaad nahi raha, uska pehla misra tha: "Chakh lo, Abu Jahl, jo tumne kiya uska anjaam." Unhone kaha: phir Hamzah apne ghar wapas gaye, to shaitan unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Tum Quraish ke sardaar ho, tumne is deen-badalne wale ki pairavi ki aur apne baap-dada ka deen chhod diya, tumhare kiye se to maut behtar hoti." To Hamzah ko aik tarah ka shak-o-shubha mehsoos hua, unhone kaha: "Maine kya kiya?" (Phir dua ki:) "Aye Allah, agar yeh hidayat hai, to iski tasdeeq mere dil mein daal de, warna mujhe is se jo main girftaar houn nikalne ka raasta de." To unhone aisi raat guzaari jaisi unhone shaitan ke waswase se pehle kabhi nahi guzari thi, yahan tak ke subah hui, subah woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Aye mere bhatije, main aik aise maamle mein pad gaya houn jiska mujhe raasta nahi sujhta, aur mujhe is haalat mein rakha gaya hai ke mujhe nahi pata yeh sahih raah hai ya nahi, isliye mujhse baat karo, Aye mere bhatije, mujhe khwahish hai ke tum mujhse baat karo." To Rasulullah (SAW) unki taraf mutawajjeh huay, unhein yaad dilaaya, naseehat ki, dara-aaya aur khush-khabri di. To Allah ne unke dil mein imaan daal diya jaisa Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha, unhone kaha: "Main gawahi deta houn ke aap sachche hain, tasdeeq karne wale aur pehchanne wale ki gawahi, isliye Aye mere bhatije, apna deen zaahir karo, Allah ki qasam, mujhe woh sab kuch bhi jispar suraj chamakta hai pasand nahi hai jitna main apne pehle deen par houn, ab main apne (naye) deen par houn." Unhone kaha: to Hamzah unme se the jinke zariye Allah ne deen ko izzat di.

e: [AI] "Ali and Hamza came to the Prophet ﷺ  having already performed ablution. The Prophet ﷺ  asked them, 'How did you both perform ablution?' One of them replied, 'O Messenger of Allah, I covered it with a cloth.' And the other said, 'I did the same.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'If you both had done otherwise, I would have covered you.'"
hi: Ali (RA) aur Hamzah (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye jabke woh ghusl kar chuke the, Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum dono ne kaisa kiya?" Aik ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine usse kapde se dhaanp liya." Doosre ne kaha: "Maine bhi aisa hi kiya." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum dono kuch aur karte, to main tum dono ko (bhi) dhaanp deta."

e: [AI] Hamzah ibn Abdul-Muttalib was fighting on the day of Uhud, in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would say, "I am the Lion of Allah, as agreed upon by the two Shaykhs, and they did not invalidate it." (authentic)
hi: Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) Uhud ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne jung karte the aur kehte: "Main Allah ka sher houn." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "Regarding his sheikhs, they said, when Hamza was martyred, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I will never be afflicted with anyone like you.' Then he said to Fatimah and her aunt Safiyyah, 'Rejoice, Gabriel came to me and informed me that Hamza is written in the heavens as 'Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib, the Lion of Allah and the Lion of His Messenger.' This has been omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summary."
hi: Unke buzurgon se, unhone kaha: jab Hamzah shaheed huay, to Rasulullah (SAW) kehne lage: "Mujhe kabhi tumhare jaise (kisi) ka gham nahi hoga." Phir Fatimah (RA) aur unki phupi Safiyyah (RA) se farmaya: "Khush ho jao, Jibra'il (AS), unpar durood-o-salaam ho, mere paas aaye aur mujhe bataaya ke Hamzah aasman waalon mein likhe gaye hain: 'Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib, Allah ka sher aur uske Rasool ka sher.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "For me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called out to Hamzah, who was closer to the polytheists than the red camel's owner. He said to me, 'Hamzah is Utbah ibn Rabee'ah, who forbids fighting and says, 'O people, I see a group that you do not associate with, yet among you there is good. Join me today and say that Utbah ibn Rabee'ah is a coward. And you know that I am not one of your cowards.' Abu Jahl heard this and said, 'You say this if not for yourself.' I said, 'You have filled with fear.' Abu Jahl said, 'Are you saying this, O Musaffar?' I said, 'Indeed, me.' Then Utbah and his brother Shaybah and his son Walid appeared and said, 'Who will fight us?' So, young men from the Ansar went out. Utbah said, 'We do not want them, but who will fight us from the uncles of Banu Abd al-Muttalib?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Stand up, Hamzah. Stand up, Ubaydah. Stand up, Ali.' So, Hamzah went to fight Utbah, Ubaydah went to fight Shaybah, and Ali went to fight Walid. Hamzah killed Utbah, Ali killed Walid, and Ubaydah killed Shaybah. Shaybah hit Ubaydah's leg, and Hamzah and Ali defended him until he was taken back to Madinah. He died from his injuries in Sawfarah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Hamzah ko pukaaro," to woh mushrikeen mein sabse qareeb the, us surkh oont wale ke paas se. To Hamzah ne mujhse kaha: yeh Utbah bin Rabee'ah hai, aur woh jung se rok raha hai, woh keh raha hai: "Aye meri qaum, main aik aisi qaum dekh raha houn jinhein tum nahi pahunch sakte, aur tum mein bhalaai hai, Aye meri qaum, aaj yeh baat mere zimme daal do aur kaho: Utbah bin Rabee'ah dar gaya, aur tumhein pata hai main tum mein sabse zyada darpok nahi houn." To Abu Jahl ne yeh suna aur kaha: "Tum yeh baat kehte ho, agar koi aur kehta." Usne kaha: "Tum khauf se bhar gaye ho." Usne kaha: "Kya tum mujhe kehte ho, Aye peela peechhe wale?" Unhone kaha: to Utbah, unke bhai Shaybah, aur unke bete Al-Waleed saamne aaye aur kaha: "Kaun muqaabla karega?" To Ansar ke kuch jawaan nikle, to Utbah ne kaha: "Humein inki zaroorat nahi, lekin Banu Abdul Muttalib ke chachon mein se kaun humse muqaabla karega?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Utho, Aye Hamzah, utho, Aye Ubaidah, utho, Aye Ali." To Hamzah Utbah ke saamne aaye, Ubaidah Shaybah ke saamne, aur Ali Al-Waleed ke saamne, Hamzah ne Utbah ko qatl kiya, Ali ne Al-Waleed ko qatl kiya, aur Ubaidah ne Shaybah ko qatl kiya, aur Shaybah ne Ubaidah ki taang par waar kiya aur usse kaat diya, to Hamzah aur Ali ne unhein bachaaya, yahan tak ke woh Safraa mein faut huay. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Dono ne Haaritha ke liye nahi nikaala, aur Ibn Al-Madini ne unhein kamzor kaha hai.

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, returned on the day of Uhud and heard the women of Bani Abdul-Ashhal crying over their deceased. He said, "However, Hamza has no one mourning over him." Then the women of the Ansar came and cried over Hamza in his presence, and he lay down. When he woke up and found them crying, he said, "Oh, woe to them! Those women have mourned over him until now. Let them go back and not cry over the deceased after this day." This is authentic according to the condition of Muslim, and he did not exclude them.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Uhud ke din wapas aaye, unhone Banu Abdul Ashhal ki auraton ko apne maqtoolon par rote suna, to farmaya: "Lekin Hamzah ke liye koi rone wali nahi." To Ansar ki auraten aayin aur Hamzah par unke paas roin, aur woh so gaye, jab woh jaage to woh ro rahi thin, to unhone farmaya: "Inpar afsos, yeh ab tak yahan hain, unhein kaho wapas jaayen, aur aaj ke baad kisi mare huay par na royen." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The master of martyrs is Hamza bin Abdul-Muttalib and a man said to an unjust ruler, commanding and forbidding him, and he killed him." Authenticated by the chain of narrators and Al-Saffar did not exclude him. It is not known who he is.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shuhada ke sardaar Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib hain, aur woh aadmi jo aik zaalim hukmaraan ke paas jaaye, usse achhai ka hukum de aur buraai se roke, to woh usse qatl kar de." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. As-Saffaar ka pata nahi kaun hai.

e: [AI] Hamza ibn Abdullah ibn al-Muttalib, the uncle of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , was killed while in a state of Janabah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The angels washed him." This narration is authentic, but Ma'ili ibn 'Abd al-Rahman did not mention it.
hi: Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib, Rasulullah (SAW) ke chacha, janaabat ki haalat mein qatl kiye gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Farishton ne unhein ghusl diya." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Mu'alla bin Abdur Rahman haalik (barbaad/na-qaabil-e-e'temaad) hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out intending to visit the daughter of Hamza, named Qabisa, until he stood at the door and said, "Peace be upon you, is Abu Umamah guilty?" She replied, "No, by Allah, I swear by my father and mother that he went out deliberately towards you, so I think he made a mistake in some alleys of Bani Najjar. Will you not enter, O Messenger of Allah, with my father and mother?" He said, "Do you have something?" She said, "Yes." So he entered and she brought him a bowl of meat, and she said, "This is from my father and mother, congratulations to you and blessings upon you. I came here while desiring to come to you and congratulate you. Abu Umamah informed me that you have been given a river in Paradise called Al-Kawthar, and its vessels are more numerous than the stars of the sky. And the thing that I like the most about it is that it will be frequented by your people." This is a correct narration with a sound chain of narration, and it has not been repeated.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Hamzah ki beti Qabisah ko milne nikle, yahan tak ke darwaze par khade ho gaye, farmaya: "As-salamu alaikum, kya Abu Umaarah hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, mere waalid aur maa aap par qurbaan, woh aapki taraf hi nikle the, mera khayaal hai unhein Banu Najjar ki kisi galiy mein aap se milne mein chook ho gayi, kya aap andar nahi aayenge, mere waalid aur maa aap par qurbaan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhare paas kuch hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To aap (SAW) andar aaye, unhone unke saamne haisa (khajoor-ghee ka mixture) rakha, unhone kaha: "Khaiye, mere waalid aur maa aap par qurbaan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapko mubarak ho aur pasand aaye, main to aapke paas aana aur aapko mubarakbaad dena chahti thi, Abu Umaarah ne mujhe bataaya ke aapko Jannat mein aik nehar di gayi hai jise Al-Kauthar kaha jaata hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur uske bartan aasman ke sitaron ki tadaad se zyada hain, aur uspar aane walon mein mujhe sabse zyada aziz tumhari qaum hai." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, passed by Hamzah on the day of Uhud, and he was wounded and disfigured. He said, "If it weren't for Safiyyah, I would have left him until Allah resurrects him from the bellies of birds and beasts." So he shrouded him in a piece of cloth. This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim, and he did not include it in his book.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) Uhud ke din Hamzah ke paas se guzre jabke unke naak-kaan kaat diye gaye the aur unke sath mithla (jism ko bigaadna) kiya gaya tha, farmaya: "Agar Safiyyah ko takleef na hoti, to main unhein chhod deta yahan tak ke Allah unhein parindon aur darindon ke peton se uthaata." To unhone unhein aik chaadar mein kafan diya. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] A boy was born to one of us, so they asked, "What should we name him?" The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  replied, "Name him after the most beloved names to me, Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib." This hadith has a sound chain of narration, but it was not narrated by Ya'qub ibn Kasb, who is considered weak.
hi: Humme se aik aadmi ke ghar aik ladka paida hua, to unhone poocha: "Humein iska naam kya rakhna chahiye?" Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usse mere sabse aziz naam se pukaaro, Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Ya'qub bin Kaasib kamzor hain.

e: [AI] A man in the city heard someone saying, "My father brought me to the Messenger of Allah and asked, 'This is my son, what should I name him?' The Messenger of Allah replied, 'Name him Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib, for he is the most beloved person to me.'" This unknown narrator has shortened the narration about Ibn Uyaynah, and the statement in it is from Ya'qub ibn Humaid. Abu Ahmad al-Hafiz used to argue with me that al-Bukhari has narrated from him in his authentic collection, but I refused to accept it, and al-Dhahabi excluded it from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: Unhone Madinah mein aik aadmi ko kehte suna: "Mere daada mere waalid ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaye aur kaha: yeh mera beta hai, ismein main kya naam rakhoon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise logon mein mujhe sabse zyada aziz naam se pukaaro, Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib." Is majhool (na-maloom) raawi ne is hadith ko Ibn Uyainah se mukhtasar riwayat ki hai, aur ismein baat Ya'qub bin Humaid ki hai, aur Abu Ahmad Al-Hafiz mujhse behas karte the ke Bukhari ne inse Jaami' Sahih mein riwayat ki hai, aur main unse inkaar karta tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I entered Paradise last night and I saw that Ja'far was flying with the angels, and Hamza was lying on a couch." The Hadith has a Sahih (authentic) chain of narration and Salamah ibn Wahram did not consider it weak according to Abu Dawud.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine kal raat Jannat mein dakhil huay, mainen usme dekha, achaanak Ja'far (RA) farishton ke sath ud rahe the, aur achaanak Hamzah aik takht par takiya lagaaye baithe the." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Salamah bin Wahram ko Abu Dawud ne kamzor kaha hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned on the day of Uhud and heard the women of Banī Abdul Ashhal crying over their deceased loved ones. He said, "But as for Hamzah, he has no one to cry for him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Uhud ke din wapas aaye, unhone Banu Abdul Ashhal ki auraton ko apne maqtoolon par rote suna, to farmaya: "Lekin Hamzah ke liye koi rone wali nahi," hadith.

e: [AI] Regarding 'Urwah's statement about the naming of those who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he mentioned that Hamzah ibn 'Abdul-Muttalib was killed on the day of Uhud when he was fifty-four years old. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Urwah se: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib the, aur unhein Uhud ke din qatl kiya gaya jabke woh chauwan (54) saal ke thay." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prepared the body of Hamza, he cried. But when he saw his likeness, he sobbed." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hamzah ko (kafan ke liye) nanga kiya, to aap (SAW) roye, jab unhone unki haalat dekhi to aap (SAW) sisak pade." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] On the day of Uhud, the Prophet ﷺ looked at Hamzah, who had been killed and mutilated, and saw a sight that he had never seen before, which caused great pain and distress to his heart. He said, "May the mercy of Allah be upon you. You were a means of connection among relatives and a means of good deeds. If it weren't for the grief that I feel for you after your departure, I would have been pleased to leave you until various mouths spread reports about you." Then, while standing in his place, he swore, "By Allah, I will surely avenge seventy of them in your place." The Qur'an was revealed to him while he was standing in his place and did not move until the end of the verse: "And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient." [Surah An-Nahl, 126] Then the Prophet ﷺ removed his hand from his right side and refrained from punishing those he had intended to.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Uhud ke din Hamzah ki taraf dekha jabke woh qatl kiye ja chuke the aur unke sath mithla kiya gaya tha, to unhone aisa manzar dekha jaisa manzar unhone kabhi nahi dekha tha jo unke dil ko itna dukhaaye ya dara de, to unhone farmaya: "Allah ki rehmat ho tumpar, tum sila-e-rehmi karne wale the, bhalaai ke kaam karne wale, aur agar tumhare baad gham na hota, to mujhe khushi hoti ke main tumhein aise hi chhod doon yahan tak ke tum mukhtalif munh (jaanwaron) se (uthaaye jaao)," phir unhone apni jagah khade huay qasam khaayi: "Allah ki qasam, main zaroor tumhari jagah unme se sattar (70) ka mithla karunga." To Quran nazil hua jabke woh apni jagah khade the, harkat nahi ki: "{Aur agar tum badla lo, to utna hi badla lo jitna tumhein diya gaya, aur agar tum sabr karo, to yeh sabr karne walon ke liye behtar hai}" (Surah An-Nahl 126), yahan tak ke Surah khatam hui, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni qasam ka kaffara ada kiya aur jo iraada kiya tha usse ruk gaye. Saalih waah (kamzor) hain.

e: [AI] When Hamza was killed, Safiyyah came looking for him, not knowing what had happened. She met Ali and Zubayr, and Ali said to Zubayr, "Tell your mother." Zubayr replied, "You tell your aunt." She asked, "What happened to Hamza?" They both said they did not know. She then went to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "I am afraid for her mind." He placed his hand on her chest and prayed for her. She regained consciousness and cried. Then the Prophet ﷺ  came and stood by her, and she saw Hamza being carried in a stretcher. He said, "If it were not for the grief of the women, I would have left him until birds and wild animals took from him." Then he ordered for the dead to be prayed upon. He performed the funeral prayer on nine of them, with seven takbirs for each, and then Hamza was left. Then nine more were brought and he prayed upon them with seven takbirs for each, and again Hamza was left. Then another nine were brought and he prayed upon them with seven takbirs for each, until he had finished with them. Abu Bakr ibn 'Ayyash narrated this from Yazid, and I said they are not reliable narrators.
hi: Jab Hamzah qatl kiye gaye, to Safiyyah (RA) unhein dhoondti aayin, unhein nahi pata tha kya hua, to unki mulaqaat Ali (RA) aur Zubair (RA) se hui, to Ali (RA) ne Zubair (RA) se kaha: "Apni maa ko bata do." Zubair (RA) ne Ali (RA) se kaha: "Nahi, tum apni phupi ko bataao." Unhone poocha: "Hamzah ka kya hua?" To dono ne unhein dikhaaya ke unhein nahi pata. To woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayin, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe unki aqal ke baare mein darr hai." To aap (SAW) ne apna haath unke seene par rakha aur dua ki, to unhone "Inna lillah" padha aur royin. Phir woh aayin aur unke paas khadi hui jabke unke sath mithla kiya ja chuka tha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar auraton ka ghabranaa na hota, to main unhein chhod deta yahan tak ke parindon ke peton aur darindon ke shikamon mein jama ho jaate." Phir aap (SAW) ne maqtoolon ke baare mein hukum diya, to unpar namaz padhne lage, nau (9) rakhte aur Hamzah ko bhi, unpar saat (7) takbeerein kehte, phir unhein uthaaya jaata aur Hamzah ko chhod diya jaata, phir nau (9) laaye jaate, unpar saat (7) takbeerein kehte, phir unhein uthaaya jaata aur Hamzah ko chhod diya jaata, phir nau (9) laaye jaate, unpar saat (7) takbeerein kehte, yahan tak ke woh sab se faarigh ho gaye. Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ne isse Yazid se suna, maine kaha: yeh dono bharosemand nahi hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw in his dream and said, "I saw as if I was a ram being sacrificed and as if the hilt of my sword was broken, so I interpreted it that I shall kill the leader of the people's ram (referring to Hamzah) and that a man from my family will break the hilt of my sword (referring to Talhah)." Hamzah was killed and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  killed Talhah, who was the flag bearer of the polytheists.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne khwaab mein dekha, farmaya: "Maine dekha goya main aik mendhe par sawaar houn, aur goya meri talwaar ki mutthi toot gayi, to maine iski ta'weel yeh ki ke main qaum ke mendhe (sardaar) ko qatl karunga, aur maine iski ta'weel yeh ki ke meri talwaar ki mutthi (ka tootna) mere khaandaan ka aik aadmi (hoga jise nuqsaan pahunchega)." To Hamzah qatl kiye gaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Talhah ko qatl kiya, jo mushrikeen ka jhanda uthaane wala tha.

e: [AI] Abdul Muttalib married Hala, the daughter of Ahyaab bin Abdul Manaf bin Zuhrah, and she gave birth to Hamza and Safiyyah.
hi: "Abdul Muttalib ne Haalah bint Ahyab bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah se nikah kiya, to unhone Hamzah aur Safiyyah ko janam diya."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'By the One in whose hand my soul is, Hamza bin Abdul-Muttalib is written with Him in the seventh heaven as the lion of Allah and the lion of His Messenger.'" - Yahya ibn Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Libba and Wahb ibn Kaysan
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, beshak yeh saatvein aasman mein Allah ke paas likha hua hai: Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib, Allah ka sher aur uske Rasool (SAW) ka sher." Yahya bin Abdur Rahman bin Abi Labeebah waah (kamzor) hain.

e: [AI] Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib was nicknamed Abu Umamah.
hi: "Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib ki kunniyat Abu Umaarah thi."

e: [AI] I heard Jabir bin Abdullah say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  witnessed the day of Uhud when the people retreated from the fight. A man said, 'I saw him by that tree, saying, "I am the lion of Allah and the lion of His Messenger. O Allah, I distance myself from what these people have done for the sake of Abu Sufyan and his companions, and I apologize to you for their defeat."' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then went towards him. When he saw his face, he wept, and when he saw what had been done to him, he sobbed. Then he said, 'Shouldn't he be shrouded?' A man from the Ansar stood up and threw a garment, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Hamza is the chief of martyrs in the sight of Allah on the Day of Judgment.'"
hi: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Uhud ke din Hamzah ko na paaya jab log jung se palat aaye, unhone kaha: to aik aadmi ne kaha: "Maine unhein us darakht ke paas dekha, woh keh rahe the: Main Allah ka sher aur uske Rasool ka sher houn, Aye Allah, main tere saamne is se bezaari zaahir karta houn jo yeh log Abu Sufyan aur uske saathiyon ke liye laaye hain, aur main tujhse maazrat chahta houn is baat ki jo inhone bhaagne mein ki." To Rasulullah (SAW) unki taraf chale, jab unhone unka chehra dekha to roye, aur jab unhone dekha ke unke sath kya kiya gaya, to sisak pade, phir farmaya: "Kya unhein kafan nahi diya jaayega?" To Ansar ka aik aadmi khada hua aur aik kapda phenka." Jabir ne kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek Qayamat ke din shuhada ke sardaar Hamzah hain."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Every prophet is granted seven companions, and I have been granted fourteen." Ali was asked, "Who are they?" He said, "It's me, Hamza, and my two sons," then he mentioned their names.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har Nabi ko saat saathi diye gaye, aur mujhe das se zyada diye gaye." To Ali (RA) se poocha gaya: "Woh kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Main aur Hamzah aur mere dono betay," phir unhein zikr kiya.

e: [AI] That the enemy will attack me tomorrow, killing me, then they will cut open my stomach and rip out my nose and ear. Then they will ask me why. And I will say about you. Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib said, "I hope that Allah will treat the last part of his life as well as He treated the first part."
hi: "Kal main dushman se milunga, woh mujhe qatl karenge, phir mera pait cheerenge aur meri naak aur kaan kaat denge, phir tum mujhse poochoge yeh kis liye hua? To main kahunga: tumhari khaatir." Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib ne kaha: "Mujhe ummeed hai ke Allah unki aakhri qasam ko bhi utna hi sach karega jitna unki pehli qasam ko kiya."

e: [AI] "The first flag pledged in Islam was by Abdullah ibn Jash."
hi: "Islam mein bandha jaane wala pehla jhanda Abdullah bin Jahsh (RA) ka tha."

e: [AI] Mus‘ab ibn ‘Umayr was the youth of Mecca in his prime and beauty. His parents loved him, and his mother dressed him in the finest and most delicate of clothes. He was the most fragrant among the people of Mecca. The Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  mentioned him and said, "I have not seen in Mecca anyone with a more beautiful hair, more elegant outfit, or greater comfort than Mus‘ab ibn ‘Umayr."[^1]
hi: Mus'ab bin Umair (RA) Makkah ke naujawaano mein jawaani aur khoobsoorati mein sabse aage the, unke waalidain unse mohabbat karte the, unki maa unhein sabse achhe aur sabse nafees kapde pehnaati thin, aur woh Makkah ke sabse zyada khushbudaar shakhs the, aur Rasulullah (SAW) unka zikr karte aur farmate: "Maine Makkah mein Mus'ab bin Umair se zyada achhe baalon wala, zyada nafees jame wala, aur zyada aaraam-dah zindagi wala koi nahi dekha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished [the Battle of] Uhud, he passed by Mus'ab Al-Ansari, who had been killed on his path, and recited: "Among the believers are men who have been true to what they promised Allah" [Al-Ahzab 33:23].
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Uhud ke din faarigh huay, to unka guzar Mus'ab Al-Ansari (RA) ke paas se hua jo apne raaste mein qatl kiye ja chuke the, to aap (SAW) ne yeh padha: "{Momino mein aise mard hain jinhone Allah se kiye huay wa'de ko sach kar dikhaya}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 23).

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me on the day of Uhud to look for Sa'd ibn ar-Rabi' and he said to me, "If you see him, give him my greetings and tell him that the messenger of Allah asks: How do you find yourself?" So I circled among the martyrs and found him in his last breath, with seventy strikes on him, including thrusts with a spear, strikes with a sword, and arrows shot at him. I said to him, "O Sa'd, the messenger of Allah sends his greetings to you and asks: Inform me of your condition." He replied, "May peace be upon the messenger of Allah and upon you. Tell him, O messenger of Allah, I find myself smelling the scent of Paradise. And tell my people, the Ansar, that they have no excuse before Allah if they do not strive to join the messenger of Allah, while you have a leader among you." And then his soul departed, may Allah have mercy upon him.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe Uhud ke din Sa'd bin Al-Rabee' (RA) ko dhoondhne bheja, aur mujhse farmaya: "Agar tum unhein dekho, to mujhse unhein salaam kehna, aur unse kehna ke Rasulullah (SAW) poochte hain: tum apne aap ko kaisa paate ho?" Unhone kaha: to main maqtoolon ke darmiyan ghoomne laga, maine unhein paaya jabke unki aakhri saanse chal rahi thin, unpar sattar (70) zakhm the, neze ke waar, talwaar ke waar, aur teer ke lagne ke darmiyan. Maine unse kaha: "Aye Sa'd, beshak Rasulullah (SAW) aapko salaam kehte hain aur poochte hain: mujhe bataao tum apne aap ko kaisa paate ho?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) par salaam ho, aur aap par bhi salaam ho, unhein kaho: Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main Jannat ki khushbu mehsoos kar raha houn, aur mere qabile Ansar se kaho: Allah ke nazdeek tumhare paas koi uzr nahi agar Rasulullah (SAW) tak (dushman) pahunch jaaye jabke tum mein se koi bhi zinda ho (jitni der aankh jhapak sake)." Unhone kaha: aur unki jaan nikal gayi, Allah unpar reham kare.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Who will tell me what Saad bin Rabi'a did?" He mentioned the story in a similar way and said, "Saad informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that I am among the deceased and I send my greetings to him and tell him that Saad says, 'May Allah reward you on behalf of us and all of the Ummah.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi mere liye dekhega Sa'd bin Al-Rabee' ka kya hua?" Phir isi tarah hadith zikr ki, aur kaha: to Sa'd ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko bataao ke main faut honay walon mein houn, unhein salaam kaho, aur unse kaho Sa'd kehte hain: Allah aapko humari aur puri Ummat ki taraf se achha badla de." Mursal.

e: [AI] We witnessed Badr, except that my father and I wanted to meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so the polytheists of Quraysh attacked us and said, "You want Muhammad!" We replied, "We don't want him, we only want to go to Medina." They made us swear by Allah and make a covenant that we would go back to Medina and not fight with Muhammad ﷺ . When we passed by them, we went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and told him what they had said and what we had said. What is your opinion? He said, "We seek Allah's help against them and nullify their covenant." Then we headed towards Medina. That is what prevented us from witnessing the Battle of Badr.
hi: "(Humein rok diya gaya) ke hum Badr mein shirkat karein, siwaye is ke ke main aur mere waalid Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas jaane ka iraada karke nikle, to Quraish ke kaafiron ne humein pakad liya, unhone kaha: tum Muhammad (SAW) ke paas jaana chahte ho, humne kaha: humein unke paas nahi jaana, humein sirf Madinah jaana hai, to unhone humse Allah ka ahd aur mithaaq liya ke hum Madinah ki taraf hi jaayenge aur Muhammad (SAW) ke sath jung nahi karenge, jab hum unse aage nikal gaye, to hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, humne unhein bataaya jo unhone kaha aur jo humne unse kaha, humne poocha: aap kya farmaate hain? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: unke khilaaf Allah se madad maango aur unke ahd ko poora karo, to hum Madinah ki taraf chal pade, isi wajah se hum Badr mein shirkat nahi kar sake."

e: [AI] When the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  went out to Uhud, Yemen bin Jabir, the father of Hudhaifa, and Thabit bin Waqsh bin Za'ura fell behind with the women and children. One of them said to his companion, who were both elderly men: "Why are we waiting? By Allah, there is not much time left in our lives except for the thirst of a donkey. We are the bravest of the people. Let us take our swords and catch up with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." So they entered among the Muslims without anyone knowing them. As for Thabit bin Waqsh, the polytheists killed him, and as for Hudhaifa's father, the Muslim swords clashed with him, not recognizing him. Hudhaifa said, "My father, my father." They replied, "By Allah, we did not know it was him." Hudhaifa said, "May Allah forgive you, for He is the most merciful of the merciful." The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  intended to reward Hudhaifa for this, so he gave him what he wanted, and this pleased the Prophet ﷺ .
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Uhud ki taraf nikle, to Al-Yaman bin Jabir (RA), Hudhaifah (RA) ke waalid, aur Thabit bin Waqsh bin Za'oora (RA) aurton aur bachon ke sath qile mein reh gaye, to unme se aik ne apne saathi se kaha, jabke woh dono buzurg the: "Tumhara koi baap nahi, hum kis cheez ka intezaar kar rahe hain, Allah ki qasam, humme se kisi ki umar mein sirf itna baaqi bacha hai jitna aik gadhe ki pyaas, hum to bas qaum ke buzurg-faanuus (aakhri, kamzor baaqi bache log) hain, kyun na hum apni talwaarein uthaayen aur Rasulullah (SAW) se aa milen?" To woh dono Musalmano mein dakhil ho gaye, aur unhein kisi ko pata nahi tha. Thabit bin Waqsh (RA) ko mushrikeen ne qatl kiya, aur Hudhaifah (RA) ke waalid par Musalmano ki talwaarein galat andaaz mein pad gayin, unhone unhein pehchaane bagair qatl kar diya. Hudhaifah (RA) ne pukaara: "Mere waalid, mere waalid!" To unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, humein pata nahi tha." Aur woh sach kehte the. To Hudhaifah (RA) ne kaha: "Allah tumhein maaf kare, aur woh sabse zyada reham karne wala hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka khoon-bahaa dena chaaha, to Hudhaifah (RA) ne woh Musalmano ko sadqa kar diya, isse unka Rasulullah (SAW) ke nazdeek martaba aur badh gaya.

e: [AI] My father woke up, by Allah, on the day of Uhud drunk, then he fought until he was martyred with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  at Uhud.
hi: "Allah ki qasam, mere waalid ne Uhud ke din subah sharaab pi, phir subah nikle aur jung karte rahe yahan tak ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Uhud mein shaheed ho gaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Jabir, "O Jabir, shall I not give you glad tidings?" He said, "Yes, give me glad tidings. May Allah bless you with goodness." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Did you not feel that Allah, the Almighty, has revived your father and made him sit before Him?" He said, "Yes, my Lord, I wish for whatever You will give me." He said, "O Lord, I have not worshiped You as You deserve to be worshiped. Do You wish to return me to the worldly life so that I may be killed again along with the Prophet ﷺ ?" He said, "You have gained precedence over me. Indeed, you will return to it and you will not be sent back from it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Jabir (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Jabir, kya main tumhein khush-khabri na doon?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, Allah aapko khush-khabri de." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein pata hai ke Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne tumhare waalid ko zinda kiya, unhein apne saamne bithaaya, phir farmaya: mujhse jo chaaho maango, main tumhein doonga. Unhone kaha: Aye Rab, maine teri jaisi ibaadat nahi ki jaisi tera haq tha, main chahta houn tu mujhe duniya mein wapas bhej de taake main Nabi (SAW) ke sath dobara qatl ho jaaun. To Allah ne farmaya: mere paas se yeh baat pehle hi tay ho chuki hai ke tum ismein wapas nahi jaaoge."

e: [AI] "My son, I do not know if I will be one of the first to be affected tomorrow, which is Sunday. I advise you to take care of Abdullah's daughters well." So, they met and that day happened."
hi: Mere waalid ne mujhse kaha: "Aye mere bete, mujhe nahi pata shaayad main kal sabse pehle zakhmi honay walon mein houn," aur yeh Uhud ka din tha, "isliye main tumhein Abdullah ki betiyon ke sath achha sulook karne ki wasiyat karta houn." To woh jung mein utre aur usi din woh maare gaye.

e: [AI] When the Battle of Uhud occurred, my father called me in the night and said, "I can only see myself being killed in the first of those who are killed from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . By Allah, I have never favored anyone over you after the Prophet's life. I have a debt, so settle my debt and take care of your sisters." Then we woke up, and he became the first martyr. I buried him with the others in a grave. But I couldn't bear to leave him with the others in the grave, so I extracted him after six months, and his body was intact, just like the day I buried him, except for his ear.
hi: Jab Uhud ki jung shuru honay wali thi, to mere waalid ne mujhe raat ko bulaaya aur kaha: "Mujhe nahi lagta ke main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se sabse pehle qatl honay walon mein se na houn, aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe tumse zyada koi aziz nahi, Rasulullah (SAW) ki jaan ke baad, aur mujhpar aik qarz hai, isliye mera qarz ada karna, aur apni behnon ke sath achha sulook karna." Unhone kaha: to subah hui, aur woh sabse pehle shaheed honay wale the, maine unhein aik doosre ke sath aik hi qabr mein dafan kiya, phir mera dil raazi na hua ke main unhein kisi doosre ke sath qabr mein chhodoon, to maine unhein chhah (6) mahine baad nikala, achaanak woh waisi hi thi jaisi unhein rakhne ke din thi, siwaye unke kaan ke.

e: [AI] To me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Indeed, Allah the Almighty does not speak to anyone except from behind a veil, and He once spoke to your father, Kifah, and he whispered to me, 'And I remembered the conversation.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Beshak Allah Ta'ala kisi se bhi bina parde ke baat nahi karta, magar unhone tumhare waalid se aamne-saamne baat ki," unhone farmaya: "mujhse maango," aur hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] In Paradise, we wander however we please. I said to him, "Were you not killed on the day of Badr?" He said, "Yes, but then I was revived." He mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "This is your testimony, O Abu Jabir."
hi: "Jannat mein hum jahan chaahen ghoomte hain." Maine unse poocha: "Kya aap Badr ke din qatl nahi kiye gaye the?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, phir mujhe zinda kiya gaya." To yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) ko batayi gayi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yehi to shahaadat hai, Aye Abu Jabir."

e: [AI] "It caught up with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , its chain is weak."
hi: "Ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) se aa milay." Isnad mubham (na-saaf/andhera) hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say when Hanzala ibn Abi 'Amir was killed after he met with Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith, and then Shaddad ibn al-Aswad killed him with a sword, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the angels are washing your companion." They asked his wife, and she said, "He went out when he heard the calling and he was in a state of sexual impurity. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'That is why the angels washed him.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Hanzalah bin Abi Aamir (RA) ke qatl ke waqt farmate suna, jab unki mulaqaat Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith se hui, tab Shaddad bin Al-Aswad ne unpar chadh kar talwaar se unhein qatl kar diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhare saathi ko farishte ghusl de rahe hain." To unhone unki biwi se poocha, unhone kaha: "Woh (jung ki) pukaar sunte hi nikal gaye the jabke woh janaabat ki haalat mein the." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isi liye farishton ne unhein ghusl diya."

e: [AI] Yes, because I saw his father on the day of Uhud he was unsheathing his sword just like a camel unsheathes. Al-Dhahabi removed it due to its weakness from the summary.
hi: "Ji haan, kyunke maine unke waalid ko Uhud ke din apni talwaar (jaanch) rakhte dekha jaise oont dhaar tez karta hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Muhammad ibn Umar praised.
hi: Humein Muhammad bin Umar ne hadith bayan ki.

e: [AI] "About his old men"
hi: Unke buzurgon se.

e: [AI] Sad (name of a person) was a man whom Allah made his face shine in the fire, then Sad lived after being struck by an arrow for about a month until he ruled over the tribe of Qurayzah by the order of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He then returned to the city of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but his speech erupted and he died during the night. Gabriel, peace be upon him, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him, "Who is the one for whom the doors of heaven have been opened and the throne of the Most Merciful has shaken?" So the Prophet ﷺ went out to Sad and found that he had died. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about him in the summary.
hi: "Sa'd, Allah tera chehra aag mein pasine se bhar de," (yeh aik dushman ka bad-dua tha). Phir Sa'd (RA) teer lagne ke baad taqreeban aik mahine zinda rahe, yahan tak ke unhone Banu Quraizah ke baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke hukum se faisla diya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke shehar (Madinah) wapas aaye, phir unka zakhm phoot gaya aur woh raat ko faut ho gaye. To Jibra'il (AS), unpar durood-o-salaam ho, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur poocha: "Yeh kaun hai jiske liye aasman ke darwaze khole gaye aur jiske liye Rahman ka Arsh (takht) hila?" To Nabi (SAW) Sa'd ki taraf nikle aur unhein faut paaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The throne trembled for the death of Saad ibn Muadh."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) ki maut par Arsh (takht) hila."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Saad as he was being buried, "Verily, the Throne moved for this righteous servant and the gates of heaven were opened for him." (Authentic)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Sa'd (RA) se, jabke unhein dafan kiya ja raha tha, farmaya: "Beshak is neik bande ke liye Arsh (takht) hila, aur uske liye aasman ke darwaze khole gaye." Sahih.

e: [AI] Shook by the love for meeting Allah, the Throne implies the bed. He said, "And his parents were raised onto the Throne. Its wood was decayed." He said, "And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered his grave and it became narrow. When he came out, it was said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what confined you?' He said, 'Sa'd was pressed into the grave as a confinement, so I supplicated to Allah to release him.'"
hi: "Arsh (takht) Allah se milne ki mohabbat mein hil gaya," matlab sareer (takht/bistar). Aur Rasulullah (SAW) unki qabr mein utre, to der ho gayi, jab woh nikle, to poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapko kis cheez ne rokaa?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sa'd ko qabr mein aik dabaav diya gaya, to maine Allah se dua ki ke woh unse yeh utha le."

e: [AI] "Let not your tears flow and your sorrow depart, for verily your son is the first whom Allah will make laugh, and the Throne will shake for him." (Sahih Isnad, not mentioned in Sahih)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kya aapke aansoo nahi thamenge aur aapka gham door nahi hoga, kyunke aapka beta pehla shakhs hai jispar Allah muskuraaya aur jiske liye Arsh (takht) hila." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: "When the funeral of Sa'd bin Mu'adh was carried, the hypocrites said: 'How light his funeral is.' And this was due to his judgment concerning Banu Quraizah. So this reached the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: 'Indeed, the angels were carrying him.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3849)
hi: Munafiqeen ne kaha: "Unka janaaza kitna halka hai!" Aur yeh sirf Banu Quraizah ke baare mein unke faisle ki wajah se tha, to yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke farishte unhein uthaa rahe the."

e: [AI] So I said to him, "Glory be to Allah! You are one of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and you have experienced something in the past that made you cry for a woman?!" He then uncovered his head and said, "You are right, by the oath of Allah. I have the right not to cry for anyone after the death of Saad bin Muadh, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stated something that no one else has ever said. She asked him, "And what did he say?" He replied, "He said, 'The Throne of Allah shook at the death of Saad bin Muadh.'" She said, "And he (Saad bin Muadh) used to walk between me and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
hi: To maine unse kaha: "Subhanallah, aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se hain, aur aapko pehle jaane ka sharaf haasil hai, aapko kya hua ke aap aik aurat par rote hain?" To unhone apne sar se (kapda) hataaya aur kaha: "Tumne sach kaha, Allah ki qasam, mujhe haq hai ke main Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) ke baad kisi par na roun, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne aisi baat kahi jo unhone kahi." Unhone poocha: "Unhone kya kaha?" Unhone kaha: unhone farmaya: "Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) ki wafaat par Arsh (takht) hila." Unhone kaha: aur woh mere aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke darmiyan chalte the.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "The Throne of the Most Merciful shook for the death of Saad ibn Muadh." A man said to Jabir, "But Al-Bara says, 'The bed shook'." Jabir replied, "Between these two pillars, Al-Aws and Al-Khazraj, there were strong vibrations." I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "The Throne of the Most Merciful shook for the death of Saad ibn Muadh."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Rahman ka Arsh (takht) Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) ki maut par hila." Unhone kaha: to aik aadmi ne Jabir se kaha: "Al-Bara (RA) kehte hain: takht (sareer) hila." Unhone kaha: "Beshak in dono qabeelon, Aus aur Khazraj, ke darmiyan purani kudurten (rinjishen) thin," maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Rahman ka Arsh (takht) Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) ki maut par hila."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said, 'I entered paradise and heard recitation in it, so I said, 'Who is this?' They said, 'Harithah ibn Nu'man.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'That is righteousness, that is righteousness.'"
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main Jannat mein dakhil hua, to maine usme tilawat suni, maine poocha: yeh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Haaritha bin An-Nu'man." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aisi hi hoti hai neki, aisi hi hoti hai neki."

e: [AI] Haritha, my cousin's son, departed on the day of Badr wearing armor to engage in battle. He was struck by an arrow and killed. My aunt came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, my son Haritha, if he is in paradise, I will have patience and hope for reward. Otherwise, you will see what I will do." The Messenger of Allah replied, "O mother of Haritha, there are many gardens in paradise, and Haritha is in the highest level of paradise, Al-Firdaus."
hi: Meri phupi ke bete Haaritha Badr ke din sirf dekhne ke liye nikle, jung ke liye nahi nikle the, to unhein aik teer laga jisne unhein qatl kar diya, to meri phupi Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mera beta Haaritha, agar woh Jannat mein hai, to main sabr karungi aur ajr ki ummeed rakhungi, warna aap dekhenge main kya karti houn." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Umm Haaritha, beshak Jannaten bohot hain, aur Haaritha Firdaus-e-A'la (sabse buland Jannat) mein hai."

e: [AI] Ja'far ibn Abi Talib struck a man from the Romans and cut him into two halves. One of his halves fell into a vineyard. In his half, thirty or thirty-one wounds were found. Ja'far migrated to the land of Abyssinia in the second migration, and with him was his wife Asma bint Umais. He remained in the land of Abyssinia until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  migrated to Al-Madinah. Then Ja'far migrated to Al-Madinah and he was in Khaybar. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I don't know which of the two events to be more joyful about, the conquest of Khaybar or the arrival of Ja'far." He said, "Ja'far was called Abu Abdullah."
hi: Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ko Room (Byzantine) ke aik aadmi ne maara, usne unhein do hisson mein kaat diya, unke aik hisse aik angoor ke baagh mein gira, to unke us hisse mein tees (30) ya tees se zyada zakhm paaye gaye. Aur unhone doosri hijrat mein Habsha (Abyssinia) ki taraf hijrat ki, unke sath unki biwi Asma bint Umais (RA) thin, aur woh Habsha mein rahe yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Madinah ki taraf hijrat ki, phir woh (Ja'far) unki taraf hijrat kar ke aaye jabke aap (SAW) Khaibar mein the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe nahi pata mein kis baat se zyada khush houn, Khaibar ki fatah se ya Ja'far ki wapasi se." Unhone kaha: "Aur Ja'far ki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi."

e: [AI] My father, who breastfed me from the Banu Murrah tribe, informed me, "It is as if I am seeing Ja'far ibn Abi Talib on the day of the Battle of Mu'tah. He dismounted from his horse, looked back at it, and then fought until he was killed."
hi: Mujhe mere waalid ne, jinhone mujhe Banu Murrah se doodh pilaaya tha, bataaya, unhone kaha: "Goya main Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ko Mu'tah ke din dekh raha houn, woh apne ghode se utre, phir uske paav ki nas kaat di (taake woh peeche na hat sakein), phir aage badhe aur jung karte rahe yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "I entered Paradise yesterday and I looked around. I saw Ja'far flying with the angels and I saw Hamza reclining on a couch."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine kal raat Jannat mein dakhil huay, mainen usme dekha, achaanak Ja'far farishton ke sath ud rahe the, aur achaanak Hamzah aik takht par takiya lagaaye baithe the."

e: "None has put on sandals - nor worn them, nor ridden a mount, nor a Kur, after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ - better than Ja'far [bin Abi Talib]." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3764)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad kisi ne bhi jooti nahi pehni, na sawaari par sawaar hua, na oont par bethha, jo Ja'far bin Abi Talib se behtar ho."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I saw Ja'far ibn Abi Talib as a king flying with the angels with two wings."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine Ja'far bin Abi Talib ko aik farishta dekha, do paron ke sath farishton ke sath ud rahe the."

e: [AI] Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , said, "When the news of Ja'far's death reached us, we saw grief in the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, se, unhone kaha: "Jab Ja'far ki maut ki khabar aayi, to humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre par gham pehchaana."

e: [AI] While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was sitting, Asma bint 'Umay
hi: Jabke Rasulullah (SAW) baithe huay the aur Asma bint Umais (RA) unke qareeb thin, ke unhone salaam ka jawaab diya, phir farmaya: "Aye Asma, yeh Ja'far bin Abi Talib hain, Jibra'il (AS), Mikaeel (AS), aur Israfeel (AS) ke sath, unhone humein salaam kiya hai, isliye unhein salaam ka jawaab do." Aur unhone (Ja'far ne) mujhe bataaya tha ke unki mulaqaat mushrikeen se fulan-fulan din hui thi, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas se guzarne se teen ya chaar din pehle, unhone kaha tha: "Main mushrikeen se mila, to mere jism ke aage ke hisse mein tetees (73) zakhm lage, teer, neze, aur talwaar ke waaron ke darmiyan, phir maine jhanda apne dayen haath mein liya, woh kaat diya gaya, phir maine baaye haath se liya, woh bhi kaat diya gaya, to Allah ne mere dono haathon ke badle mujhe do par diye jinse main Jibra'il aur Mikaeel ke sath udta houn, main Jannat mein jahan chaahoon utar sakta houn, aur uske phal jitne chaahoon kha sakta houn." To Asma (RA) ne kaha: "Mubaarak ho Ja'far ko jo bhalaai Allah ne unhein di," lekin mujhe darr hai ke log tasdeeq nahi karenge, isliye mimbar par chadho aur logon ko bataao. To woh mimbar par chadhe, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir farmaya: "Aye logo, beshak Ja'far, Jibra'il aur Mikaeel ke sath hain, unke do par hain jo Allah ne unke haathon ke badle unhein diye, unhone mujhe salaam kaha." Phir unhein bataaya unka waaqiya kaise hua jab woh mushrikeen se mile, to logon ko is din ke baad wazeh ho gaya jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne bataaya ke Ja'far unse mile the, isliye unhein Jannat mein "At-Tayyar" (udne wala) kaha gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I saw as if I entered paradise, and I saw that Ja'far had a rank above Zaid. I said, 'I did not think Zaid surpassed anyone.' It was said to me, 'O Muhammad, do you know for what reason Ja'far's rank was elevated?' I said, 'No.' It was said, 'For the close relationship between you and him.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine dekha goya main Jannat mein dakhil hua, maine dekha Ja'far ka darja Zaid ke darje se oopar hai, maine kaha: mujhe nahi lagta tha ke Zaid kisi se peeche hon. To mujhse kaha gaya: Aye Muhammad, kya tumhein pata hai Ja'far ka darja kis wajah se buland kiya gaya?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." Kaha gaya: "Us qaraabat (rishtedaari) ki wajah se jo tumhare aur unke darmiyan hai."

e: [AI] "Ja'far, I feel more entitled to her, for her aunt is with me," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "As for you, O Ja'far, you resemble my appearance and character, and you are from the same lineage as me." Ja'far replied, "I have accepted that, O Messenger of Allah." As for the slave girl, I will give her to Ja'far, for her aunt is with him. And indeed, this aunt is his mother. Abu Hurairah used to say, "No one has ever shadowed my heart more beloved to me after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  than Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, due to the saying of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ : 'You resemble my appearance and character.'"
hi: Ja'far ne kaha: "Main uska zyada haqdaar houn, kyunke uski khaala mere paas hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahi baat tumhari, Aye Ja'far, to tum shakl aur akhlaaq mein mujhse milte ho, aur tum us darakht se ho jisse main houn." Unhone kaha: "Main isse raazi houn, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aur rahi baat laundi ki, to main iska faisla Ja'far ke haq mein karta houn, kyunke uski khaala unke paas hai, aur khaala bhi maa hoti hai." To Abu Hurairah (RA) kaha karte the: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad, aasman ke saaye tale mujhe kisi ka chehra Ja'far bin Abi Talib se zyada aziz nahi laga, Rasulullah (SAW) ke is farmaan ki wajah se: tum shakl aur akhlaaq mein mujhse milte ho."

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'We, the sons of 'Abdul-Muttalib, will be leaders of the people of Paradise: Myself, Hamzah. 'Ali, Ja'far, Hasan, Husain and Mahdi." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4087)
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hum Banu Abdul Muttalib Jannat waalon ke sardaar hain - main, Ali, Ja'far, Hamzah, Hasan, Husain, aur Al-Mahdi." Fabricated.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came back from Khaybar, Jafar came from Abyssinia and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  met him and kissed his forehead. Then he said, "By Allah, I do not know if I am happier with the conquest of Khaybar or the arrival of Jafar." Ismail ibn Abi Khalid and Zakariyya ibn Abi Zayd sent this message. They narrated to us through Ali ibn Isa al-Hiri, who narrated through Ibrahim ibn Abi Talib, who narrated through Ibn Abi 'Umar, who narrated through Sufyan from Ibn Abi Khalid and Zakariyya from al-Sha'bi, who said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned from Khaybar and mentioned the incident."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Khaibar se aaye, to Ja'far Habsha se aaye, Rasulullah (SAW) unse milne gaye, unki peshaani choomi, phir farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata mein kis baat se zyada khush houn, Khaibar ki fatah se ya Ja'far ki wapasi se." Ismail bin Abi Khalid aur Zakariya bin Abi Zaidah ne isse mursal riwayat kiya hai, jaisa Ali bin Isa Al-Heeri ne humein bataaya, humein Ibrahim bin Abi Talib ne hadith bayan ki, humein Ibn Abi Umar ne hadith bayan ki, humein Sufyan ne Ibn Abi Khalid aur Zakariya se, unhone Ash-Sha'bi se hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) Khaibar se aaye, phir hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] "You are indeed a great people, if only you hadn't preceded us in migration. We were superior to you, as we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , carrying your burden and teaching your ignorant ones. So we fled for the sake of our religion. She said, 'I will not reconsider until I meet with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' So I entered upon him, and she said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I met with Umar and he said such and such.' He replied, 'Yes, you have two migrations. One is your migration to Abyssinia (Ethiopia) and the other is your migration to Medina.'"
hi: "Tum bhi behtareen qaum ho, agar tumne hijrat mein humse sabqat na li hoti, to hum tumse behtar hote, hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath the, tumhare paidal chalne walon ko uthaate the aur tumhare jaahil ko sikhaate the, aur humne apne deen ki khaatir hijrat ki." (Asma RA ne yeh Umar RA se suna aur) kaha: "Main wapas nahi jaungi jab tak main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas na jaaun." To main unke paas gayi, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe Umar (RA) mile, unhone yeh aur yeh kaha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke tumhare liye do hijraten hain - tumhari Habsha ki hijrat, aur tumhari Madinah ki hijrat."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Jafar passed by me tonight in the company of a group of angels, with both his wings stained with blood and his heart pure white."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aaj raat Ja'far mere paas se farishton ke aik giroh mein guzre, unke dono par khoon se rangeen the, aur unka dil safed tha."

e: [AI] "We were with Ja'far ibn Abi Talib in Mu'tah, and we found him among the casualties. We found seventy-two injuries on him."
hi: "Hum Mu'tah mein Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ke sath the, humne unhein maqtoolon mein paaya, humne unpar sattar se zyada zakhm paaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was sitting, Asma bint Umais, who was close to him, returned the greetings. He signaled with his hand and said, "O Asma, this is Ja'far ibn Abi Talib with Jibril (Gabriel) and Mikail (Michael), who greeted us. So return the greeting to them." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  informed me that he had encountered the polytheists on a certain day before his arrival. He said, "I met the polytheists and was injured in my body with seventy-three wounds from stabbing and throwing. I took the banner in my right hand and it was cut off. Then I took it with my left hand and it was also cut off. Allah compensated me by giving me wings with which I fly in Paradise along with Jibril and Mikail (peace be upon them). I eat from its fruits whatever I wish." Asma said, "Congratulations to Ja'far for what Allah has blessed him with." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ascended the pulpit and informed the people about it. He said, "After that, no one in the world knew what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had informed them, so Ja'far al-Tayyar (the flyer) was named."
hi: Jabke Rasulullah (SAW) baithe huay the aur Asma bint Umais (RA) unke qareeb thin, ke unhone salaam ka jawaab diya, apne haath se ishara kiya, phir farmaya: "Aye Asma, yeh Ja'far bin Abi Talib hain, Jibra'il (AS), unpar durood-o-salaam ho, aur Mikaeel (AS) ke sath, woh guzre aur humein salaam kaha, isliye unhein salaam ka jawaab do." Aur unhone mujhe bataaya tha ke unki mulaqaat mushrikeen se fulan-fulan din hui thi, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas se guzarne se teen ya chaar din pehle, unhone kaha tha: "Main mushrikeen se mila, to mere jism ke aage ke hisse mein tetees (73) zakhm lage, neze aur teer ke waaron ke darmiyan, to maine jhanda apne dayen haath mein liya, woh kaat diya gaya, phir maine ise apne baaye haath se liya, woh bhi kaat diya gaya, to Allah ne mere dono haathon ke badle mujhe do par diye jinse main Jannat mein Jibra'il aur Mikaeel ke sath udta houn, Allah unpar durood bheje, aur uske phal jitne chaahoon kha sakta houn." To Asma (RA) ne kaha: "Mubaarak ho Ja'far ko jo bhalaai Allah ne unhein di." Unhone kaha: phir Rasulullah (SAW) mimbar par chadhe aur logon ko bataaya. Unhone kaha: to log samajh gaye is baad jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne bataaya tha, isliye Ja'far ko "At-Tayyar" (udne wala) kaha gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] What we have is better for them, so they agreed until they carried Jabalah and Asma and left Zaid. Then a group of horses from Tihamah, from the Banu Fazara, attacked Tayyi and captured Zaid, and they took him to the market of Ukaz. The Prophet ﷺ saw him before he was sent and said to Khadijah, "O Khadijah, I saw a boy in the market with qualities like Kit and Kait; he has intelligence, good manners, and beauty. If I had wealth, I would buy him." So Khadijah commanded Waraqah bin Nawfal to buy him from her wealth. She said, "O Muhammad, give me this boy as a gift from yourself." The Prophet ﷺ said, "O Khadijah, I only want to adopt him." She agreed, and she raised and adopted him. He was called Zaid bin Muhammad. Then a man from the tribe of Hayy saw Zaid and recognized him, and he said, "Are you Zaid bin Harithah?" Zaid said, "No, I am Zaid bin Muhammad." The man said, "No, you are Zaid bin Harithah, from the lineage of your father and your uncles, Kit and Kait. They have exhausted themselves and spent their wealth for your sake." Then Zaid recited a poem expressing his love for his people. Harithah wept and did not know what to do, whether Zaid was still alive or not. Oh, by Allah, I do not know, but I ask, O Sahl, is the plain easier for you or the mountain? Oh, I wish I knew if you would return to me one day. My sorrow for you is so long, and I wonder, will you ever come back to me? I will strive and never tire of walking the mountains, and I will not tire of making tawaf or the camels. Perhaps death will visit me before you do. Every soul will taste death, so may Allah bless me with a good family and a prosperous offspring. Harithah came to him when he was with his brothers and family in Makkah. He went to the Prophet ﷺ and found him sitting in the courtyard of the Kaaba with a group of his companions, including Zaid bin Harithah. When they saw Zaid, they recognized him, and he recognized them. However, they did not rise in reverence for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. They said, "O Zaid!" But he did not respond. The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Who are these, O Zaid?" He replied, "O Messenger of Allah, this is my father, my uncle, my brother, and these are my relatives." The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Go and greet them, O Zaid." So Zaid stood and greeted them, and they greeted him. Then they said to him, "Come with us, O Zaid." He replied, "I only desire the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; I do not desire anyone else in return." They said, "O Muhammad, we will give you this boy as compensation, so name your price." The Prophet ﷺ said, "I ask you to bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that I am the final Prophet and Messenger, and that you accept Islam. They agreed and accepted Islam. Then they said, "What
hi: "Jo humare paas hai woh unke liye behtar hai," to woh raazi ho gaye yahan tak ke woh Jabalah aur Asma ko le gaye aur Zaid ko chhod diya, phir Tihaamah se Banu Fazaarah ke kuch sawaar aaye, unhone Tayy qabile par hamla kiya, Zaid ko qaid kar liya, unhein Uqaaz ke bazaar mein le gaye, Nabi (SAW) ne unhein unki Nabuwwat se pehle dekha, to unhone Khadijah (RA) se kaha: "Aye Khadijah, maine bazaar mein aik ladka dekha jiski sifat aisi-aisi hai," unki aqal, adab, aur khoobsoorati ka zikr kiya, "agar mere paas maal hota, to main use khareed leta." To unhone Waraqah bin Naufal ko hukum diya, unhone apne maal se use khareed liya, to unhone (Nabi SAW ne) kaha: "Aye Khadijah, mujhe yeh ladka apni khushi se de do." Unhone kaha: "Aye Muhammad, main aik roshan chehre wala ladka dekh rahi houn, aur mujhe darr hai ke aap ise bech dein ya de dein." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye tawfeeq wali, maine isliye nahi maanga siwaye is ke ke main ise apna beta banaana chahta houn." Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Aye Muhammad." To unhone use paala aur apna beta banaaya, to use Zaid bin Muhammad kaha jaata tha. Phir qabile ka aik aadmi aaya, usne Zaid ko dekha aur pehchaan liya, usne kaha: "Tum Zaid bin Haarithah ho." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, main Zaid bin Muhammad houn." Usne kaha: "Nahi, balke tum Zaid bin Haarithah ho, tumhare waalid, tumhare chachon, aur tumhare maamuon ki sifat aisi-aisi hai, unhone apne jismon ko thaka diya hai aur maal tumhari khaatir kharch kiya hai." To Zaid ne (bahr At-Taweel mein) kaha: "Main apni qaum ko yaad karta houn agarche main door houn, kyunke main mashaa'ir ke paas ghar ka rehne wala houn, aur us baat se ruk jaao jisne tumhein takleef di hai, aur zameen mein oonton jaisa kaam mat karo, kyunke main, Allah ki hamd ke sath, sabse behtar khaandaan mein houn, Ma'ad ke behtareen, aik ke baad aik." To Haarithah ne, jab yeh unhein pahunchi (bahr At-Taweel mein) kaha: "Main Zaid par roya aur mujhe nahi pata usne kya kiya, kya woh zinda hai ke ummeed rakhi jaaye ya usse pehle uska waqt aa gaya, Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata, aur main poochta houn: kya tumhein zameen ke maidano ne nigal liya ya pahaad ne? Kaash mujhe pata hota agar zamana tumhein wapas laaye, to duniya se mujhe bas itna kaafi hai ke tum mere paas wapas aa jaao, suraj tulu' honay par mujhe uski yaad dilaata hai, aur uski yaad shaam dhalne par mere saamne aati hai, aur jab hawaayen chalti hain to woh uski yaad ko ubhaarti hain, to mera kitna lamba gham hai uspar aur kitna khauf, main zameen mein oonton ko chalaate huay koshish karunga, aur main ghoomne se nahi thakunga ya oont thak jaayenge, phir meri maut aaye ya main uski taraf pahunch jaaun, aur har insaan faani hai chaahe ummeed use dhoka de." To Haarithah bin Sharaaheel Makkah mein apne bhaiyon aur ghar walon ke sath aaye, unhone Nabi (SAW) ko Ka'bah ke aangan mein apne kuch sahaba ke sath paaya, unme Zaid bin Haarithah bhi the, jab unhone Zaid ko dekha to unhein pehchaana aur Zaid ne bhi unhein pehchaana, magar Rasulullah (SAW) ki izzat ki wajah se unki taraf khade nahi huay. Unhone unse kaha: "Aye Zaid," to unhone jawaab nahi diya. To Nabi (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Yeh kaun hain, Aye Zaid?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh mere waalid hain, yeh mere chacha hain, yeh mera bhai hai, aur yeh mera qabila hai." To Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Utho aur unhein salaam karo, Aye Zaid." To woh uthe aur unhein salaam kiya, unhone bhi unhein salaam kiya, phir unhone unse kaha: "Humare sath chalo, Aye Zaid." Unhone kaha: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke badle koi aur nahi chahta." To unhone kaha: "Aye Muhammad, hum tumhein is ladke ke badle diyat denge, jo chaaho naam lo, hum tumhare paas le aayenge." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumse yeh gawahi maangta houn ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main uske Ambiya aur Rusul ka aakhri (khatam) houn, aur main isse tumhare sath bhej dunga." To woh muddi hue aur der karne lage aur atak-atak ke baat karne lage, phir kaha: "Kya aap humse woh dinaar qubool karenge jo humne pesh kiye?" Aap (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Yahan aik aur khoobi hai jo iske alawa hai, maine maamla usspar chhoda hai, agar woh chaahe to khada ho jaaye, agar chaahe to (mere sath) rahe." Unhone kaha: "Kya kuch aur baaqi nahi bacha?" Unhone kaha: "Aye Zaid, Muhammad (SAW) ne ab tumhein ijaazat de di hai, humare sath chalo." Unhone kaha: "Hargiz nahi, hargiz nahi, main Rasulullah (SAW) ke badle koi aur nahi chahta, aur na hi main unpar kisi waalid ya bete ko tarjeeh doonga." To unhone unhein ghumaaya, unhein manaane ki koshish ki, unhein narmi se pesh aane ki koshish ki, aur unke peeche se unhein apni pareshaani bataayi, magar unhone inkaar kar diya aur qasam khaayi ke woh unke sath nahi jaayenge. To Haarithah ne kaha: "Rahi baat meri, to main tumhari apni jaan se hifaazat karta houn, main gawahi deta houn ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain," aur baaqi log inkaar karte rahe.

e: [AI] Harithah ibn Sharahil was crying over the loss of his son Zaid, and he said, "I cried over Zaid, but I do not know what happened to him." Then he recited the long poem, which was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summary due to its weakness.
hi: Haarithah bin Sharaaheel jab apne bete Zaid ko khote the, to unpar roya karte aur kehte: "Main Zaid par roya aur mujhe nahi pata usne kya kiya," phir poori qaseeda (nazm) zikr ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] I went to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, send my brother Zaid with me." He said, "He is here. If he wishes, I will not prevent him." Zaid then said, "No, by Allah, I will not choose anyone over you." Jabalah said, "I said, 'Indeed, my brother's opinion is better than mine,' (this hadith is authentic with an unbroken chain of narrators and it is a witness to the previous narration)."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere bhai Zaid ko mere sath bhej dein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh yahan hai, agar woh chaahe to main use nahi rokta." To Zaid ne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main aapke badle kisi ko nahi chahunga." Jabalah (RA) ne kaha: to maine kaha: "Mere bhai ki raay meri raay se behtar hai." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur yeh pichhli hadith ki gawahi deta hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] About Ibn Ishaq, "Among those who participated in the Battle of Badr with the Prophet peace be upon him was Zaid ibn Harithah ibn Sharahil Al-Kalbi, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him." Al-Dhahabi excluded this from the summary.
hi: Ibn Ishaq se: "Nabi (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein Zaid bin Haarithah bin Sharaaheel Al-Kalbi, Rasulullah (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, the." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "The first person to embrace Islam was Zaid bin Harithah."
hi: "Sabse pehle Islam qubool karne wale Zaid bin Haarithah the."

e: [AI] I heard Aisha say, "When Zaid ibn Harithah, Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, and Abdullah ibn Rawahah were killed, the Prophet ﷺ sat and cried for them, and sadness was evident in him."
hi: Maine Aisha (RA) ko kehte suna: "Jab Zaid bin Haarithah, Ja'far bin Abi Talib, aur Abdullah bin Rawaahah qatl kiye gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) baithe unpar roye, aur unme gham pehchaana ja sakta tha."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a military expedition to Mu'tah, and Zaid bin Haritha fought under the banner of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the month of Jumada al-Ula in the year eight. He fought until he fell in the battlefield, and then Ja'far bin Abi Talib took the banner from him."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Mu'tah ki taraf aik lashkar bheja, to Zaid bin Haarithah ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke jhande ke sath, Jumada-al-Oola, aath (8) hijri mein, jung ki, yahan tak ke woh qaum ke nezon mein chheda-phaada gaye, phir Ja'far bin Abi Talib ne jhanda uthaaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Aisha used to say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  never sent Zaid bin Harithah to an army without giving him command over it. Even if the Prophet ﷺ  had stayed alive after him, he would have appointed him as his successor." Authentic Chain of Narration. They did not exclude him.
hi: Aisha (RA) kaha karti thin: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zaid bin Haarithah ko kabhi kisi lashkar mein nahi bheja magar unhein ameer banaaya, aur agar woh (Zaid) unke (Rasulullah SAW ke) baad zinda rehte, to unhein apna khalifa muqarrar karte." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do not blame us for our love for Zaid," meaning, ibn Harithah. This is what Al-Dhahabi refrained from summarizing.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Humein Zaid ki mohabbat par malaamat mat karo," matlab Ibn Haarithah. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "The best of the leaders of the armies is Zaid bin Harithah; he is fair and just with his subjects." This is in his narration from Al-Waqidi.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Lashkaron ke sardaaron mein sabse behtareen Zaid bin Haarithah hain, sabse zyada barabar taqseem karne wale aur apni ra'iyat ke sath sabse zyada insaaf karne wale." Isnad mein Al-Waqidi hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out while having a companion. They went to a certain idol from the idols, so they slaughtered a sheep for it and placed it in the oven until it was cooked. When it was cooked, they took it out and placed it in their bags. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then proceeded, while walking slowly, during the hot days of Mecca until they reached the highest part of the valley. There, they met Zaid bin Amr bin Nufayl, who greeted one of them with the pre-Islamic greeting. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked him, "Why do I see your people abandoning you?" He replied, "By Allah, it is not that they have abandoned me, but rather, it is because I see them deviating from the right path." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I went out in search of this religion until I reached the tribes of Yathrib, and I found them worshipping Allah alone, but associating partners with Him. I said, 'What kind of religion is this that I am seeking?' Then, I traveled to the tribes of Ayla and found them worshipping Allah alone, but associating partners with Him. I said, 'What kind of religion is this that I am seeking?' A scholar from the scholars of Sham said to me, 'Indeed, you are asking about a religion that no one knows except a respected old man in the peninsula.' So, I traveled until I reached him and informed him of my purpose. He said to me, 'Indeed, all those who you have seen in misguidance, asking about a religion that is the religion of Allah and His angels. There has come out in your land a Prophet or a Prophet-like person calling to this religion. Return to him, believe in him, and follow him.' So, I returned, and I did not do anything good afterwards. I carried the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on the camel he was riding, and we presented to him the cooked sheep that we had. He asked, 'What is this?' We replied, 'This is a sheep we slaughtered for the idol of such and such.' He said, 'Indeed, I do not eat anything that was slaughtered for other than Allah.' This idol was made of copper, called Asaf, and its handle was made of neem tree branches. The polytheists would anoint themselves with it when they circumambulated the Ka'bah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then circumambulated it, and I also did, touching it as I passed by. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Do not touch it.' Zaid said, 'We completed the Tawaf, and I said to myself that I would touch it again to see what he says.' So, I touched it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Did I not forbid you from doing so?' Zaid said, 'By the One who has honored him and revealed the Book to him, I have not touched an idol until Allah honored him with what He has honored him and revealed the Book to him.' Zaid bin Amr bin Nufayl died before the Prophet's message was revealed. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'A nation will come on the Day of Judgment, but he will be alone.' This Hadith is Sahih according to the conditions of Muslim, but they did not include it in his collection. Whoever ponders over this Hadith will understand the virtue of Zaid and his early acceptance of Islam before the invitation to it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) nikle jabke main unke peechhe sawaar tha, aik but ki taraf, buton mein se aik ke paas, humne uske liye aik bakri zibah ki aur usse tandoor mein rakha, jab woh pak gayi, to humne usse nikala aur apne dastarkhwaan mein rakha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) chalte rahe, jabke main unke peechhe sawaar tha, Makkah ke garmi ke dinon mein, yahan tak ke jab hum wadi ke oopar pahunche, to unki mulaqaat Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail se hui, dono ne aik-doosre ko Jaahiliyat ke tareeqe se salaam kiya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Mujhe kya hua hai ke main dekh raha houn tumhari qaum ne tumse dushmani rakhi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh unke sath mere aik purane jhagde ki wajah se hai, lekin main unhein gumraahi mein dekhta houn." Unhone kaha: to main is deen ki talaash mein nikla, yahan tak ke main Yathrib (Madinah) ke aalimon ke paas pahuncha, maine unhein Allah ki ibaadat karte aur usske sath shirk karte paaya, maine kaha: yeh woh deen nahi jiski mujhe talaash hai. To main nikla yahan tak ke main Aylah ke aalimon ke paas pahuncha, maine unhein bhi Allah ki ibaadat karte aur usske sath shirk karte paaya, maine kaha: yeh bhi woh deen nahi jiski mujhe talaash hai. To Sham ke aik aalim ne mujhse kaha: "Tum us deen ke baare mein poochte ho jiske baare mein humein nahi pata koi bhi usse Allah ki ibaadat karta ho siwaye aik buzurg ke jo Jazeera (Arab) mein hai." To main nikla yahan tak ke main unke paas pahuncha, maine unhein bataaya ke main kis liye nikla houn, unhone kaha: "Jinhein tumne gumraahi mein dekha hai, tum jis deen ke baare mein poochte ho woh Allah ka deen hai aur uske farishton ka deen hai, aur tumhari zameen mein aik Nabi nikal chuke hain ya nikalne wale hain, jo isi taraf bulaate hain, unki taraf wapas jaao, unki tasdeeq karo, unki pairavi karo, aur jo woh laaye hain usspar imaan lao." Unhone kaha: to main wapas aaya aur iske baad kuch bhi achha na kar saka." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne oont ko bithaaya jispar woh sawaar the, phir humne unke saamne dastarkhwaan pesh kiya jismein bhuna hua gosht tha, to unhone poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Humne kaha: "Yeh aik bakri hai jo humne fulan-fulan but ke liye zibah ki hai." To unhone farmaya: "Main Allah ke siwa kisi aur ke liye zibah ki gayi cheez nahi khaata." Aur woh aik taambe ka but tha jise Isaaf aur Naa'ilah kaha jaata tha, jisse mushrikeen apna haath phertay the jab woh tawaaf karte. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne tawaaf kiya aur main bhi unke sath tawaaf karta raha, jab main guzra to maine usse haath phera, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise mat chuo." Zaid ne kaha: to humne tawaaf kiya, maine apne dil mein socha main isse zaroor chhuunga taake dekhoon woh kya kehte hain, to maine usse chhuwa, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein mana nahi kiya gaya tha?" Zaid ne kaha: to us Zaat ki qasam jisne unhein izzat di aur unpar Kitaab nazil ki, maine kabhi kisi but ko haath nahi lagaaya, jab tak Allah ne unhein izzat na di aur unpar Kitaab nazil ki. Aur Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail unke Nabi banaaye jaane se pehle faut ho gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh Qayamat ke din akela aik Ummat bankar aayenge." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Aur jo koi is hadith par ghaur kare, use Zaid ki fazeelat aur Islam mein unki sabqat (dawat se pehle hi) ka pata chal jaayega. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Jafar said, "I love you all for the sake of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Ali said, "I love you all for the sake of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Zaid said, "I love you all for the sake of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." They said, "So come with us to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." I then went out and returned and said, "This is Jafar, Ali, and Zaid bin Harithah seeking permission." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Give them permission." So they entered and said, "O Messenger of Allah, we have come to ask you, who do you love the most among people?" He said, "Fatimah." They asked, "We are asking you about men." He said, "As for you, O Jafar, you resemble my appearance and my manners. And as for you, O Ali, you are my brother and father to my children, and you are from me and I am from you. And as for you, O Zaid, you are my mawla (close friend or loyalist) and from me and I am from you, and you are the most beloved to me among people."
hi: Ja'far ne kaha: "Main tum sab mein Rasulullah (SAW) ko sabse zyada aziz houn." Ali ne kaha: "Main tum sab mein Rasulullah (SAW) ko sabse zyada aziz houn." Zaid ne kaha: "Main tum sab mein Rasulullah (SAW) ko sabse zyada aziz houn." Unhone kaha: "To chalo hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas chalein." Unhone kaha: to main nikla, phir wapas aaya aur kaha: "Yeh Ja'far, Ali, aur Zaid bin Haarithah ijaazat maang rahe hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein ijaazat do." To woh dakhil huay aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum aapke paas yeh poochne aaye hain ke logon mein aapko sabse zyada aziz kaun hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Fatimah." Unhone kaha: "Hum aapse mardon ke baare mein poochte hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahi baat tumhari, Aye Ja'far, to tumhari shakl meri shakl se milti hai aur tumhare akhlaaq mere akhlaaq se milte hain, aur tum mujhse ho aur mere darakht se ho, aur rahi baat tumhari, Aye Ali, to tum mere bhai ho aur mere dono betoon ke waalid ho, tum mujhse ho aur mere paas ho, aur rahi baat tumhari, Aye Zaid, to tum mere mawla ho, mujhse ho aur mere paas ho, aur logon mein sabse zyada mujhe aziz ho."

e: [AI] From the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , it is narrated that, "In the early stages of revelation, he was taught the methods of ablution, prayer, and the principles of Islam." Al-Dhahabi excluded this from his summary due to its weakness.
hi: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se, ke "unke paas jab pehli wahi aayi, to unhein wudu aur namaz dikhaayi gayi, aur unhein Islam sikhaaya gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  finished the Battle of Badr, he sent two announcers to the people of Madinah. He sent Zaid bin Harithah to the people of the lower part and he sent Abdullah bin Rawahah to the people of the upper part, informing them of the victory of Allah for His Prophet ﷺ . Zaid bin Harithah agreed with his son Usamah when they were burying Rukayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and it was said to him, "This is your father when he just arrived."
