Usamah replied, "I came while he was standing with the people, saying, 'Utbah bin Rabiah, Shaybah bin Rabiah, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Nabih and Munabbih, and Umayyah bin Khalaf have been killed.' So I asked, 'O my father, is this more deserving?' He said, 'Yes, by Allah, O my son.'"
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Badr se faarigh huay, to unhone Madinah walon ke paas do khush-khabri dene walon ko bheja, Zaid bin Haarithah ko neeche wale ilaaqe walon ke paas, aur Abdullah bin Rawaahah (RA) ko oopar wale ilaaqe walon ke paas, unhein Allah ki apne Nabi (SAW) par ata ki hui fatah ki khush-khabri sunaane. To Zaid bin Haarithah apne bete Usaamah (RA) se us waqt milay jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Ruqayyah par mitti barabar kar rahe the, to unse kaha gaya: "Yeh aapke waalid hain jab woh (Badr se) aaye." Usaamah (RA) ne kaha: to main aaya jabke woh logon ke saamne khade keh rahe the: "Utbah bin Rabee'ah, Shaybah bin Rabee'ah, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Nabih aur Munabbih, aur Umayyah bin Khalaf qatl kiye gaye," to maine kaha: "Aye abba, kya yeh sach hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Allah ki qasam, Aye mere bete."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would only give his weapon to Ali or Zaid if he did not participate in the battle."
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) jung mein nahi jaate, to woh apna hathiyaar sirf Ali ya Zaid ko dete."

e: [AI] "I participated in seven battles with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I participated in nine battles with Zaid ibn Harithah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to assign him to lead us." This is an authentic hadith according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs, and they did not include it. It is mentioned in Bukhari's Thulathiyaat.
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath saat (7) ghazwe (jungein) kiye, aur Zaid bin Haarithah ke sath nau (9) ghazwe, Rasulullah (SAW) unhein humpar ameer banaate." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Yeh Bukhari ki Thulaathiyaat mein hai.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ did not appoint Zaid as a commander of any expedition except after ordering him to do so." This is authentic based on the condition of the two sheikhs, and they did not reject it.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Zaid ko kabhi kisi dasty (chhoti fauj) mein nahi bheja magar unhein unpar ameer banaaya." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "Two garments were presented to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , so he took one of them and gave the other one to Zaid. This narration is considered authentic according to the conditions set by the two Sheikhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim), but it was not included in their collections."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ko do jode (kapdon ke) tohfe mein diye gaye, unhone aik apne liye liya aur doosra Zaid ko de diya." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Yunus ibn Bukair was praised.
hi: Humein Yunus bin Bukair ne hadith bayan ki.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "Who is your leader, O Bani Salamah?" They replied, "Al-Jadd ibn Qays, except that he is stingy." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "What disease is worse than stinginess? Rather, your leader should be Bashir ibn Al-Bara' ibn Ma'rur." This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, but he (Muslim) did not include it in his book.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Banu Salamah, tumhara sardaar kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Al-Jadd bin Qais, magar unme kanjoosi hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kanjoosi se zyada khatarnaak koi bimaari nahi, balke tumhara sardaar Bishr bin Al-Bara bin Ma'roor hai." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was suffering from the illness in which he later passed away. I said, "By my father, O Messenger of Allah, what do you accuse yourself of? For I do not accuse my son except for the food he ate with you in Khaybar." His son was Bishr bin Al-Bara' bin Ma'roor, and he died before the Prophet ﷺ . So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "And I do not accuse anyone besides her. This is the time of the cutting off of my jugular vein." This narration is authentic according to the criteria of the two Shaykhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but they did not include it in their collections.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil hui unki bimaari mein jismein unka intiqaal hua, maine kaha: "Mere waalid aap par qurbaan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap khud ko kis cheez ka zimmedaar samajhte hain? Kyunke main apne bete ko sirf us khaane ka zimmedaar samajhti houn jo usne aapke sath Khaibar mein khaaya tha." Unke bete Bishr bin Al-Bara bin Ma'roor Nabi (SAW) se pehle faut ho gaye the. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur main bhi usske siwa kisi aur ko zimmedaar nahi samajhta, yeh mere is (rag ke) katne ka waqt hai." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] A Jewish woman invited the Prophet ﷺ  and his companions to a meal that included a poisonous sheep. When they sat down to eat, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took a bite of the food and then said to them, "Stop, for this sheep is poisoned." The Jewish woman asked him, "What harmed you? I wanted to see if you were a true prophet. This poison would not harm you, but if you were not a prophet, I would save people from you." However, Shirah, the son of Al-Baraa, ate from it and died. Therefore, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered for the Jewish woman to be killed. This incident is mentioned in Sahih Muslim and it has not been contradicted. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Aik Yahoodi aurat ne Nabi (SAW) aur unke kuch sahaba ko bhuni hui bakri ki dawat di, jab woh khaane baithe, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik lukma liya, phir usse rakh diya, phir unse kaha: "Ruk jao, yeh bakri zeher-aalood hai." To Yahoodi aurat se poocha: "Afsos ho tujhpar, tumne mujhe kis liye zeher diya?" Usne kaha: "Main jaanna chahti thi agar aap Nabi hain, to yeh aapko nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayega, aur agar aap kuch aur hote, to main logon ko aapse najaat dilaati." Bishr bin Al-Bara ne isme se khaaya tha, to woh faut ho gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse qatl karne ka hukum diya. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] And another person said, "He was killed in battle."
hi: Aur kisi aur ne kaha: "Woh Ajnadain (ki jung) mein qatl kiye gaye."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Do not sit on graves nor pray towards them." This hadith was omitted by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Qabron par mat baitho aur na hi unki taraf mun karke namaz padho." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se hata diya.

e: [AI] About Urwah, "In the naming of someone who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi, the ally of Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib"
hi: Urwah se: "Nabi (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi the, jo Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ke ahd-waale saathi (hulaif) the."

e: [AI] I heard Mus'ab ibn Abdullah Al-Zubayri saying, "Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi died in the twelfth year of Hijrah at the age of sixty-six."
hi: Maine Mus'ab bin Abdullah Az-Zubairi ko kehte suna: "Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi ka intiqaal Hijrat ke baarah (12) saal mein hua, jabke woh chhiyaasath (66) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] "Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi, his name is Kannaz ibn Husayn ibn Yarbu ibn Amr ibn Yarbu ibn Kharashah ibn Saad ibn Tareef ibn Jallan ibn Ghanm ibn A'sar ibn Saad ibn Qays Aylan."
hi: "Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi ka naam Kannaaz bin Husain bin Yarbu' bin Amr bin Yarbu' bin Kharashah bin Sa'd bin Tareef bin Jallaan bin Ghanm bin A'sar bin Sa'd bin Qais Aylaan tha."

e: [AI] "Abu Marthadin Al-Ghanawi, the ally of Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib, died and was buried in Madinah during the caliphate of Abu Bakr in the twelfth year."
hi: "Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi, Kannaaz bin Al-Husain, Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ke ahd-waale saathi, ka intiqaal hua, unhein Madinah mein, Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat mein, baarah (12) saal mein dafan kiya gaya."

e: Do not pray facing towards the graves, and do not sit on them. (Using translation from Muslim 972b)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Qabron par mat baitho aur na hi unki taraf mun karke namaz padho." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur Abdullah bin Al-Mubarak akele hain jinhone ismein Abu Idris Al-Khawlani ka zikr Bishr bin Ubaidullah aur Waathilah ke darmiyan kiya hai, "kyunke Bishr bin Bakr aur Al-Waleed bin Yazeed ne Bishr se riwayat ki, 'maine Waathilah bin Al-Asqa' ko suna,'" rahi baat Bishr ki hadith ki.

e: [AI] I heard Wasilah ibn Al-Asqa', the companion of the Prophet ﷺ , saying, "Do not sit on graves or pray to them." Sadaqah ibn Khalid then added, "Upon him be peace."
hi: Maine Waathilah bin Al-Asqa' (RA), Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi, ko kehte suna: "Qabron par mat baitho aur na hi unki taraf mun karke namaz padho." Aur Sadaqah bin Khalid ne isme unki mutaabi'at ki hai.

e: Do not sit on the graves and do not pray facing towards them. (Using translation from Muslim 972a)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Qabron par mat baitho aur na hi unki taraf mun karke namaz padho."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  sent him as a guard until the break of dawn. Then, the Prophet ﷺ  said, "This is your companion, who has been keeping watch over you." The Prophet ﷺ  then came to him and asked, "Have you prayed the night prayer?" He replied, "No, by Allah, O Prophet of Allah, except for fulfilling a need." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Do not worry, you will not have to work after this." Yahya ibn Hamzah mentioned this narration to Abu Amr Al-Awza'i, who then narrated it to me. Al-Awza'i informed me that Hassan ibn Atiyyah would relate this narration as a special virtue for Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi, which was transmitted solely by the children of Yahya ibn Hamzah Al-Dimashqi from their fathers, who all were reliable narrators.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne unhein pehredaar bana kar bheja, yahan tak ke jab subah ka mun hua, to woh wapas aaye, Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhara saathi hai, tumhare paas se guzarte huay aaya hai." Phir woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, aap (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Kya tum raat ko apne ghode se utre?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Nabi, sirf zaroorat poori karne ke liye." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Iske baad (kisi bhi nafl ibaadat ke chhoot jaane ki) koi fikr mat karo." Yahya bin Hamzah ne kaha: to maine yeh hadith Abu Amr Al-Auza'i ko sunaayi, to Al-Auza'i ne mujhe bataaya ke Hassaan bin Atiyyah yeh hadith bayan kiya karte the, yeh Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi ke liye aik buland fazeelat hai, isse sirf Yahya bin Hamzah Ad-Dimashqi ke bete apne buzurgon se, Al-Auza'i se, akele riwayat karte hain, aur woh sab bharosemand hain.

e: [AI] He was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on the Day of Badr, and one of the horsemen belonged to Marthad ibn Abi Marthad, and the other belonged to Zubair. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr ke din do ghode the, aik Marthad bin Abi Marthad ka aur doosra Zubair (RA) ka. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Some people from the tribe of Adal and Qara'a, who were considered the emissaries of Jadila, came to the Prophet ﷺ  after the Battle of Uhud and said, "We have accepted Islam in our land, so please send some of your companions to teach us the Quran and educate us about Islam." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent six people with them, including Marthad ibn Abi Marthad, the ally of Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib, who was their leader, Khalid ibn Al-Bukayr Al-Laithi, the ally of Bani Adi, Abdullah ibn Tarik Al-Zafri , Zaid ibn Dathina, Hubayb ibn Adi, and Asim ibn Thabit ibn Abi Al-Aflah. They left with their leader, Marthad ibn Abi Marthad, and when they were returning, they were attacked by a group led by Hudhail. The people had swords in their hands, so Hudhail tried to deceive them, but the people took out their swords and prepared to fight. They said, "O Allah, we don't want to kill you, but we want to take some of the people of Makkah as captives." They reminded them of the covenant and agreement they had made with Allah. So Asim, Marthad, and Khalid fought until they were killed, and they said, "By Allah, we will never accept a treaty or contract with a polytheist."
hi: Adhal aur Al-Qaarah ke kuch log, jo Jadeelah ke do qabile the, Uhud ke baad Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Humari zameen mein Islam phail chuka hai, isliye apne sahaba mein se kuch logon ko humare sath bhejein jo humein Quran padhaayen aur humein Islam ki samajh dein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke sath chhah (6) aadmi bheje, unme Marthad bin Abi Marthad, Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ke ahd-waale saathi, the, jo unke ameer the, Khalid bin Al-Bukair Al-Laithi, Banu Adi ke ahd-waale saathi, Abdullah bin Taariq Az-Zafari, Zaid bin Ad-Dathinah, Khubaib bin Adi, aur Aasim bin Thaabit bin Abi Al-Aflah. Woh nikle aur unke ameer Marthad bin Abi Marthad the, yahan tak ke jab woh Ar-Raji' mein pahunche, to Huzail unke paas aaye, log ne apne saamaan mein sirf woh mard dekhe jo apne haathon mein talwaarein liye unhein ghere huay the. To un logon ne apni talwaarein uthaayin jung karne ke liye, to unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, humein tumhein qatl karne ki khwahish nahi, balke hum Makkah walon mein se kuch (maal ya fidya) haasil karna chahte hain, isliye tumhare liye Allah ka ahd aur uska mithaaq hai." To Aasim, Marthad, aur Khalid ne jung ki yahan tak ke woh shaheed ho gaye, aur unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, hum kisi mushrik se koi ahd ya samjhauta kabhi qubool nahi karenge." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] That Marthad was martyred before his father, my grand father Marthad, at the age of eight years. Indeed, my grandfather Marthad died on his bed in Medina during the caliphate of Abu Bakr in the year twelve. I made an effort to seek a hadith narrated by Marthad from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , but I only found the hadith
hi: Beshak Marthad apne waalid Abu Marthad se aath (8) saal pehle shaheed huay, aur Abu Marthad Madinah mein apne bistar par, Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat mein, baarah (12) saal mein faut huay. Maine Marthad se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke hawaale se, koi hadith dhoondne ki bohot koshish ki, magar mujhe sirf yeh hadith mili jo:

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If you want your prayers to be accepted, then your best individuals should lead the prayer, for they are your representatives between you and your Lord Almighty."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumhein pasand hai ke tumhari namazein qubool ki jaayen, to tumhare behtareen log tumhari imaamat karein, kyunke woh tumhare aur tumhare Rab, buzurg aur buland, ke darmiyan tumhare numainde hain."

e: [AI] About Uruwah, "In the identification of those who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , Jubayr ibn Sakhrah ibn Umayyah ibn Khansa ibn Sinan."
hi: Urwah se: "Nabi (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein Jubaar bin Sakhr bin Umayyah bin Khansa bin Sinaan the."

e: [AI] Jubair bin Sakhr passed away in Madinah in the year thirty, at the age of sixty-two.
hi: "Jubaar bin Sakhr ka intiqaal Madinah mein tees (30) hijri mein hua, jabke woh baasath (62) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say, "Indeed, we are prohibited from exposing our private parts." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Humein hukum diya gaya hai ke hum apni sharam-gaahein na dekhein." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Islam of Abu Hudhayfah existed before the Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) entered the home of Arqam. He was one of those who migrated twice. This narration was deleted by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness.
hi: "Abu Hudhaifah (RA) ka Islam Rasulullah (SAW) ke Daar-e-Arqam mein dakhil honay se pehle ka tha, aur woh un logon mein se the jinhone dono hijraten (Habsha aur Madinah) ki." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se hata diya.

e: [AI] "And Abu Hudhayfah ibn Utbah was a tall man, handsome in appearance, and his mother was Umm Safwan."
hi: "Aur Abu Hudhaifah bin Utbah aik lambe, khoobsurat chehre wale aadmi the, aur unki maa Umm Safwan thin."

e: [AI] "Abu Hudhayfah bin Utbah bin Rabiah was killed as a martyr on the day of the Battle of Yamama."
hi: "Abu Hudhaifah bin Utbah bin Rabee'ah Yamamah ke din shaheed kiye gaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said on the day of Badr: "Whoever encounters Abbas among you, let him refrain from attacking him, for he has been forced to come." Abu Hudhaifah ibn Utbah said: "Shall we kill our fathers, brothers, and clans while leaving Abbas? By Allah, I will strike him with a sword." When the Prophet ﷺ  heard about this, he said to Umar ibn Al-Khattab: "O Abu Hafs! Umar said: "Indeed, it is the first day when Umar is causing me distress. I will strike the face of the uncle of the Messenger of Allah with a sword." Umar said: "Leave it to me, I will strike his neck, for he has become a hypocrite." Abu Hudhaifah used to say: "I will never feel safe from the consequences of that statement I made, and I will remain fearful until Allah clears me of it through martyrdom." He was indeed martyred on the day of Yamamah. This Hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim and it has not been abrogated."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din farmaya: "Tum mein se jo bhi Abbas se mile, use na chhede, kyunke woh majboori mein nikle hain." To Abu Hudhaifah bin Utbah ne kaha: "Kya hum apne baap-daadon, bhaiyon, aur qabeelon ko qatl karein aur Abbas ko chhod dein? Allah ki qasam, main unhein talwaar se maarunga." Yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) ne Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Abu Hafs." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh pehla din tha jab aap (SAW) ne mujhe 'Abu Hafs' ki kunniyat se pukaara, (jabke) Rasulullah (SAW) ke chacha ka chehra talwaar se maara jaa raha tha." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe ijaazat dein, main iski gardan maar doon, kyunke yeh munafiq ho chuka hai." Aur Abu Hudhaifah kaha karte the: "Main us baat se mahfooz nahi jo maine kahi, aur main tab tak khaufzada rahunga jab tak Allah usse shahaadat ke zariye mujhse door na kar de." Unhone kaha: to woh Yamamah ke din shaheed kiye gaye. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "What makes you cry? Is it pain or attachment to the worldly life?" He replied, "No, I heard the Messenger of Allah - peace be upon him - entrust me with a trust. I asked, 'What is it?' He said, 'The Messenger of Allah - peace be upon him - said, 'Perhaps you will live to see a time when people will gather together and you will be among them.'" And indeed, I have witnessed that, just as the Prophet - peace be upon him - said, 'In the narration, they are wicked, and it is that Abu Hudhaifa Utba ibn Rabia was martyred before Muawiyah embraced Islam. And indeed, Muawiyah said this statement to his uncle Abu Hashim ibn Utba ibn Rabia on the day of Siffin.''
hi: "Tumhein kis cheez ne rulaaya? Kya koi takleef hai ya duniya ki khwahish?" To unhone kaha: "Hargiz nahi, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko mujhse aik ahd lete suna." Maine poocha: "Woh kya tha?" Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shaayad tum aik aisa zamana paao jismein log jama honge aur tum bhi unme se hoge," aur maine woh dekh liya jaisa unhone farmaya tha. (Is hadith mein aik saaf ghalti hai - Abu Hudhaifah Utbah bin Rabee'ah Mu'awiyah (RA) ke Musalman honay se pehle hi shaheed ho chuke the, aur yeh baat Mu'awiyah (RA) ne apne chacha Abu Hashim bin Utbah bin Rabee'ah se Siffin ke din kahi thi.)

e: [AI] His name is Husham.
hi: Unka naam Husheim tha.

e: [AI] Abu Hudhayfah ibn Utbah ibn Rabiah's name is Hushaym, and it is said that his father's name is Abu Hudhayfah Hisl.
hi: "Abu Hudhaifah bin Utbah bin Rabee'ah ka naam Husheim tha, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke Abu Hudhaifah ka naam Hisl tha."

e: [AI] "He was deceived by it, for indeed Al-Yaman, the father of Hudhayfah, is nicknamed Hisl, and it is said that his name is 'Asal'."
hi: "Yeh iska ghalat fehmi hai, kyunke Al-Yaman, Hudhaifah ke waalid, ko Hisl ka laqab diya jaata tha, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke unka naam Isl tha."

e: [AI] He is called Hesl or 'Asl, and it is said that his name is Miqsam.
hi: "Unhein Hisl ya Isl kaha jaata hai, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke unka naam Miqsam tha."

e: [AI] "And it is said, 'a division.'"
hi: "Aur Miqsam bhi kaha jaata hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered for the prisoners to be thrown into Al-Qalib. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then stood over them and said, "O people of Al-Qalib, have you found what your Lord promised you to be true? For indeed, I have found what my Lord promised me to be true." His companions said, "O Messenger of Allah, are you speaking to dead people?" He replied, "Indeed, they know that what their Lord promised them is true." When the prisoners were ordered, they were dragged while there was a mark on the face of Abu Hudhaifah ibn Utbah Al-Karakiyah and his father was being dragged towards Al-Qalib. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "O Abu Hudhaifah, by Allah, it seems as though what was in your father has befallen you." He replied, "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, I never doubted Allah and His Messenger. However, if he was calm and sincere, and had insight, I hoped that he would not die until Allah guided him to Islam. But when I saw that it had passed and ended up where it did, it made me sad." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then supplicated for him with good, "May he be correct upon the condition of a Muslim, and not be excluded."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne qaleeb (kuye) ke baare mein hukum diya, to unhein (maqtool mushrikeen ko) usme daala gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) unpar khade huay aur farmaya: "Aye qaleeb walo, kya tumne paaya jo tumhare Rab ne wa'da kiya tha, sach? Kyunke maine woh paaya jo mere Rab ne mujhse wa'da kiya tha, sach." To unke sahaba ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap murda logon se baat karte hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh jaan chuke hain ke jo tumhare Rab ne tumse wa'da kiya woh sach hai." Jab unhein hukum diya gaya aur unhein ghaseeta gaya, to Abu Hudhaifah bin Utbah ke chehre par na-pasandeedgi pehchaani gayi, jabke unke waalid ko qaleeb ki taraf ghaseeta ja raha tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye Abu Hudhaifah, Allah ki qasam, goya jo aapke waalid ke sath hua usne aapko bura laga." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe Allah aur uske Rasool ke baare mein koi shak nahi, lekin unke haleem (baradbaar), theek raasta pakadne wale, aur hikmat wale hone ki wajah se mujhe ummeed thi ke woh na marein jab tak Allah, buzurg aur buland, unhein Islam ki hidayat na de, jab maine dekha ke yeh mauqa haath se nikal gaya aur jo hua so hua, to isne mujhe udaas kiya." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke liye bhalaai ki dua ki. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] And Qutbah ibn 'Amir ibn Hadiidah witnessed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the Battle of Badr, and it was the battle in which the verse {It is not righteousness that you enter houses from the back} [Al-Baqarah 189] was revealed. And his brother is Yazid ibn 'Amir ibn Hadiidah, and Yazid is also known as Abu al-Mundhir.
hi: Aur Qutbah bin Aamir bin Hadeedah ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki, aur unhi ke baare mein yeh nazil hua: "{Neki yeh nahi ke tum gharon mein unki peeth ki taraf se dakhil ho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 189), aur unke bhai Yazid bin Aamir bin Hadeedah the, aur Yazid ki kunniyat Abu Al-Mundhir thi.

e: [AI] "Some of his people's companions said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out during the season in which he met a group of the Ansar, and he presented himself to the Arab tribes. Then they turned away from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and returned to their lands, having believed and confirmed the faith of Qutbah ibn Amir ibn Hadeedah among them.'"
hi: Unke qabile ke kuch buzurgon se, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) us mausam mein nikle jismein unki mulaqaat Ansar ke wafd se hui, unhone apne aap ko Arab ke qabeelon ke saamne pesh kiya, phir woh Rasulullah (SAW) se wapas apne watan chale gaye, unme se Qutbah bin Aamir bin Hadeedah imaan laaye aur tasdeeq ki thi."

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent Qutbah bin 'Amir bin Hadeedah with twenty men to a neighborhood from Khath'am during the month of Safar in the year seven.
hi: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Qutbah bin Aamir bin Hadeedah ko bees (20) aadmiyon ke sath Khath'am qabile ke aik giroh ki taraf Safar, saat (7) hijri mein bheja."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Take the Qur'an from four individuals: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, Mu'adh, Ubayy, and Salim, the mawla of Abu Hudhayfah. It has a sound chain of narration, although they did not compile it into a book." It is considered weak.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran chaar logon se seekho - Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Mu'adh, Ubayy, aur Salim, Abu Hudhaifah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, se." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Weak.

e: [AI] And Moses ibn Utbah said, "He is Salim ibn Maqil from the people of Isṭakhara." Al-Dhahabi deleted him from the summary due to his weakness.
hi: Musa bin Utbah ne kaha: "Woh Salim bin Ma'qil hain, Istakhr ke ahl mein se." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , after the night prayer, then I came to him and he said to me, 'Where were you?' I said, 'We were listening to the recitation of a man from your companions in the mosque. I have never heard a voice or recitation like his from any of your companions.' He stood up and I stood with him until he listened to him. Then he turned to me and said, 'This is Sālim, the freed slave of Abu Hudhayfah. All praise is due to Allah who has placed such [recitation] in my Ummah.' This is an authentic hadith according to the conditions of the two Shaykhs [referring to Al-Bukhari and Muslim], and they did not include it in their collections exactly in this content."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, Isha ke baad, phir main aaya, to unhone mujhse poocha: "Tum kahan the?" Maine kaha: "Hum masjid mein aapke aik sahabi ki tilawat sun rahe the, maine unki jaisi aawaaz aur tilawat aapke kisi bhi sahabi mein nahi suni." To aap (SAW) khade huay aur main bhi unke sath khada hua yahan tak ke unhone unhein sun liya, phir mere taraf mudhe aur farmaya: "Yeh Salim, Abu Hudhaifah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, hain, sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne meri Ummat mein aisa (shakhs) rakha." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala isi tarah. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Once, the wife of Abu Hudhaifa mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about the inclusion of Salim, the slave of Abu Hudhaifa, in her home. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  told her, "Breastfeed him." So she breastfed him after he had witnessed the Battle of Badr. Since then, Salim used to enter her home based on the condition set by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and they did not separate him from her.
hi: Beshak Abu Hudhaifah ki biwi ne Rasulullah (SAW) se Salim, Abu Hudhaifah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, ke unke paas aane-jaane ka zikr kiya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Unhein doodh pilaao." To unhone Badr mein shirkat karne ke baad unhein doodh pilaaya, to woh unke paas aana-jaana karte rahe. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] He said: Salim, the Ansari woman, had made Abu Hudhayfa's slave Sa'iba a gift to Allah. And he was killed on the day of Yamama, leaving behind weapons and horses. Umar ibn al-Khattab sent a message to her, saying, "Take him, as you are the most deserving of him." She replied, "I have no need for him, as I had dedicated him to Allah the Almighty when I freed him." So Umar took him and enlisted him in the cause of Allah, but the authenticity of this account is not confirmed.
hi: Ke unhone kaha: Umm Salim Al-Ansariyah ne Salim, Abu Hudhaifah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, ko Allah ke liye "Saa'ibah" (bilkul aazaad, kisi wirasat ke bandhan se mukt) banaaya tha, aur woh Yamamah ke din qatl kiye gaye, unhone hathiyaar aur aik ghoda wirasat mein chhoda, to Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unhein paighaam bheja: "Isse le lo, tum is par sabse zyada haqdaar ho." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe iski koi zaroorat nahi, maine isse Allah Ta'ala ke liye waqf kar diya tha jab maine ise aazaad kiya tha." To Umar (RA) ne usse liya aur Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki raah mein laga diya. Yeh sahih saabit nahi hui.

e: [AI] When Salim, the slave of Abu Hudhayfah, was killed, they said, "One-fourth of the Quran is lost, as he had not memorized it completely according to the condition of the two Sheikhs, and they did not write it down."
hi: Jab Salim, Abu Hudhaifah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, qatl kiye gaye, to logon ne kaha: "Quran ka chauthaai hissa chala gaya." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "That this house is filled with gold, which I will spend in the way of Allah and in charity." And a man said, "I wish it was filled with sapphires and precious gems, so that I could spend it in the way of Allah and in charity." Then Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) said, "Wish for it to be filled with men like Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah, Muadh ibn Jabal, Sallam, the freed slave of Abu Hudhayfah, and Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman." As narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Beshak yeh ghar sone se bhara ho, main use Allah ki raah mein kharch karoon aur sadqa karoon. Aik aadmi ne kaha: "Mujhe khwahish hai kaash yeh zabarjad (heera) aur jawaahar se bhara ho, to main use Allah ki raah mein kharch karta aur sadqa karta." Phir Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Khwahish karo." Unhone kaha: "Humein nahi pata, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen." To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe khwahish hai kaash yeh Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah, Mu'adh bin Jabal, Salim (Abu Hudhaifah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam), aur Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman jaise mardon se bhara ho." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Zaid ibn Al-Khattab carried the banner of the Muslims on the day of Yamamah, and the Muslims were exposed until Hanifah became visible among the men. Then Zaid ibn Al-Khattab began to say, "As for the men, there are no more men, and as for the men, there are no more men." He then shouted at the top of his voice, "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the flight of my companions, and I disassociate myself from what Musaylimah and Muhkam ibn At-Tufayl have brought." He held onto the banner and advanced with it to confront the enemy, and he struck with his sword until Rahmah ibn Al-Khattab, may Allah have mercy on him, was killed. The banner fell, and it was taken by Salim, the servant of Abu Hudhayfah. The Muslims said, "O Salim, we fear that we will be betrayed by you." He replied, "Woe to the one carrying the Quran, if you are given to me." Zaid ibn Al-Khattab was killed in the twelfth year of Hijrah.
hi: Zaid bin Al-Khattab (RA) Yamamah ke din Musalmano ka jhanda uthaaye huay the, jab Musalman peeche hat gaye yahan tak ke Hanifah qabile ka pallada bhaari ho gaya, to Zaid bin Al-Khattab (RA) kehne lage: "Rahi baat mardon ki, to koi (asli) mard nahi, rahi baat mardon ki, to koi (asli) mard nahi," phir apni buland aawaaz se pukaarne lage: "Aye Allah, main tere saamne apne sathiyon ke bhaagne se maazrat chahta houn, aur jo Musailamah aur Muhkam bin At-Tufail laaye hain usse main tere saamne bezaari zaahir karta houn," aur jhande ko sakhti se pakad kar dushman ki taraf aage badhne lage, phir apni talwaar se jung karte rahe yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye, Allah ki rehmat ho unpar, aur jhanda gir gaya, to Salim, Abu Hudhaifah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, ne usse uthaa liya, to Musalmano ne kaha: "Aye Salim, humein darr hai ke tumhari taraf se humpar (dushman ka) hamla na ho jaaye." Unhone kaha: "Main kaisa Quran-daar (Quran uthaane wala) houn agar tum mujhse (mera zimmedaari nibhaane mein natakaami se) haar jaate ho!" Aur Zaid bin Al-Khattab (RA) Hijrat ke baarah (12) saal mein qatl kiye gaye.

e: [AI] Ibn Umar had five companions with him in the battles against Musaylimah. They killed someone other than him. It is said that they were Zaid bin Al-Khattab, Abdullah bin Makhrama, and two others. This information was omitted by Al-Dhahabi from the summary.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) Musailamah ke ghazwe mein paanch saathiyon mein se paanchwe the, to unke ilawa sab qatl kiye gaye, kaha jaata hai: Zaid bin Al-Khattab, Abdullah bin Makhramah, aur do aur. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "He said, 'Woe to you! You have killed my brother, and whenever the cool breeze blows, I always remember him.' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary."
hi: Unse: "Afsos ho tumpar, tumne mera aik bhai qatl kar diya, jab bhi purvai (Saba) hawaa chalti hai, mujhe unki yaad aati hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, and 'Ukkasha bin Arbain was forty years old. He was then killed a year later in the battle of Buza'ah, during the caliphate of Abu Bakr, in the twelfth year. 'Ukkasha was one of the most handsome people."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua jabke Ukkashah chaalis (40) saal ke thay, aur unhein iske aik saal baad Buzaakhah mein, Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat mein, baarah (12) saal mein qatl kiya gaya, aur Ukkashah logon mein sabse khoobsoorat the."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The first group to enter Paradise will have faces shining like the full moon on a night of a lunar eclipse. Then those who follow them will have faces as bright as the brightest star in the sky." Ukasha ibn Muhsin stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me one of them." He said, "O Allah, make him one of them." Another person stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me one of them." He said, "Ukasha has already reached that position."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse pehla giroh jo Jannat mein dakhil hoga, unke chehre chaudhvin ki raat ke chaand ki roshni ki tarah honge, phir unke baad aane wale sabse khoobsurat chamakte hue sitare ki tarah honge jo aasman mein chamakta hai." To Ukkashah bin Mihsan khade huay aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se banaaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, isse unme se bana de." Phir aik aur khada hua aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unme se banaaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ukkashah ne is baare mein tumse sabqat le li."

e: [AI] About him, Al-Dhahabi wrote in the summary.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "And Ma'n ibn Adi ibn al-Jadd ibn al-'Ajlan al-Haleef, from the Banu 'Amr ibn 'Awf, witnessed the 'Aqaba pledge, and witnessed the battles of Badr, Uhud, and the Trench, and witnessed the scenes of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he was martyred on the day of Yamamah during the caliphate of Abu Bakr al-Siddiq."
hi: "Aur Ma'n bin Adi bin Al-Jadd bin Al-Ajlaan, Banu Amr bin Auf ke ahd-waale saathi, ne Aqabah mein shirkat ki, aur Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki dusri jangon mein shirkat ki, aur Yamamah ke din, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ki khilafat mein, shaheed kiye gaye."

e: [AI] "Ma'n ibn 'Adiyyin in Yamamah on the day of Musaylimah al-Kadhdhab."
hi: Ma'n bin Adi Yamamah mein, Musailamah Al-Kazzab (jhoote) ke din (shaheed huay).

e: [AI] "And it is said, 'Father of spring.'"
hi: Aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai: Abu Ar-Rabee'.

e: [AI] "And Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Bishr ibn Umara said, 'He was called Abu al-Rabi' at the time of his embracing Islam in Medina, by the hands of Mus'ab ibn Umair, that was before Saad ibn Mu'adh embraced Islam. Abbad ibn Bishr also witnessed the Battle of Badr and he was among those who killed Ka'b bin Ashraf. He witnessed the Battle of Uhud, and the Battle of the Trench, and the other major battles with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He also witnessed the Battle of Yamamah, where he faced hardship and exhaustion, and actively participated in the fighting until he was martyred on that day. This was in the year twelve, when he was forty-five years old.' Al-Dhahabi omitted his name from the summary due to his weakness."
hi: Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Bishr bin Umaarah ne kaha: "Unki kunniyat Abu Ar-Rabee' thi, unhone Madinah mein Mus'ab bin Umair (RA) ke haath par Islam qubool kiya, aur yeh Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) ke Islam qubool karne se pehle tha, aur Abbad bin Bishr ne Badr mein shirkat ki, aur woh un logon mein se the jinhone Ka'b bin Al-Ashraf ko qatl kiya, aur unhone Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath doosri jangon mein bhi shirkat ki, aur unhone Yamamah ke din bhi shirkat ki, jismein unhein bohot museebat aur mehnat uthaani padi aur unhone jung mein khud shaamil hokar ladai ki, yahan tak ke woh usi din shaheed kar diye gaye, aur yeh baarah (12) hijri mein hua, jabke woh paintalees (45) saal ke thay." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "By Allah, my father only named me 'Abbad' because of 'Abbad bin Abdullah bin Zubair."
hi: Abbad bin Abdullah bin Zubair (kehte the): "Allah ki qasam, mere waalid ne mera naam Abbad sirf iske (Abbad bin Bishr RA ke) naam par rakha."

e: [AI] "About his elders, they said, 'The name of Abu Dujana is Simak bin Kharasha bin Lawdhan bin Abd Wadd bin Zaid bin Tha'labah bin Al-Khazraj. He is the brother of the Messenger of Allah Muhammad ﷺ through breastfeeding. He witnessed the battles of Badr and Uhud and remained steadfast with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He pledged his allegiance to him until death. He also witnessed the Battle of Yamama. He was among those who participated in the killing of Musaylimah. Abu Dujana was martyred on that day.'"
hi: Unke buzurgon se, unhone kaha: "Abu Dujanah ka naam Simaak bin Kharashah bin Lawdhan bin Abd Wadd bin Zaid bin Tha'labah bin Al-Khazraj tha, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke aur Utbah bin Ghazwan ke darmiyan (Islami) bhai-chaara (rishta) qaayam kiya, aur Abu Dujanah ne Badr aur Uhud mein shirkat ki, aur usi din Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath ache tarah dhang qaayam rahe, aur maut tak unki baiyat ki, aur unhone Yamamah mein bhi shirkat ki, aur woh un logon mein se the jinhone Musailamah ke qatl mein hissa liya, aur Abu Dujanah usi din shaheed kar diye gaye."

e: [AI] On the day of Uhud, the Prophet ﷺ  took a sword and his companions gathered around him. He said, "Who will take this sword?" They extended their hands, saying, "This is me" and "This is me." He then said, "Who will take it rightfully?" The people hesitated and remained silent. Then, Simak bin Kharasha Abu Dujana stepped forward and said, "I will take it rightfully." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  handed it to him, and that day, it was used effectively against the pagans.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Uhud ke din aik talwaar li, jabke unke sahaba unke ird-gird the, farmaya: "Yeh talwaar kaun lega?" To unhone apne haath phailaaye, koi kehta: "Yeh main houn," aur koi kehta: "Yeh main houn," to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise iske haq ke sath kaun lega?" To qaum ruk gayi, phir Simaak Abu Dujanah ne kaha: "Main ise iske haq ke sath lunga." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein woh de di, aur usi din unhone isse mushrikeen ke saron ko chaak kar diya. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "During the Battle of Uhud, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  presented a sword and asked, 'Who will take this sword in its right?' I stood up and said, 'I will, O Messenger of Allah.' But he turned away from me. Then he asked again, 'Who will take this sword in its right?' And again, I said, 'I will, O Messenger of Allah.' But he turned away from me once more. This happened for a third time. Then Abu Dujanah, also known as Simak ibn Kharsha, stood up and said, 'I will take it, O Messenger of Allah, in its right.' He asked him, 'What is its right?' Abu Dujanah replied, 'To not use it to kill a Muslim or to flee from a disbeliever.' So the Prophet handed the sword to him. Whenever he prepared for battle, he had a distinguishing mark on his arm. I said to myself, 'Let me observe him today and see how he behaves.' He would strike with the sword and it would not spare anything in its way until he reached a group of women on a mountain slope. Among them was a woman, who said, 'We are the daughters of Tariq, we walk on embers. If you accept, we embrace, and if you turn away, we part with separation.' Abu Dujanah then turned with the sword towards a woman to strike her, but he stopped himself. As the battle became fierce, I said to him, 'I have witnessed all your actions up until now. When you raised the sword over the woman, you did not strike her.' He replied, 'By Allah, I honored the sword of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and did not want to use it to kill a woman.' This hadith has a sound chain of narrators, but it has not been formally published."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Uhud ke din aik talwaar pesh ki, farmaya: "Ise iske haq ke sath kaun lega?" Main khada hua aur kaha: "Main, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." To aap (SAW) ne mujhse mun pher liya, phir farmaya: "Ise iske haq ke sath kaun lega?" Maine kaha: "Main, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." To aap (SAW) ne mujhse mun pher liya, phir farmaya: "Ise iske haq ke sath kaun lega?" To Abu Dujanah Simaak bin Kharashah khade huay aur kaha: "Main ise iske haq ke sath lunga, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to iska haq kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh ke tum ise kisi Musalman ko qatl karne mein istemaal na karo, aur na hi tum ise lekar kaafir se bhaago." Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne woh unhein de di, aur woh jab jung ka iraada karte, to aik patti (pagdi ka pattaa) se apni pehchaan zaahir karte. Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Main zaroor aaj dekhunga yeh kya karte hain?" Unhone kaha: to jo bhi cheez unke saamne buland hoti, woh usse phaad daalte aur cheer daalte, yahan tak ke woh pahaad ki dhaal par kuch auraton tak pahunche jinke paas daf (khanjariyaan) thi, unme se aik aurat keh rahi thi (bahr Ar-Rajz mein): "Hum Taariq ki betiyan hain, hum masnadon (naram bistaron) par chalti hain, agar tum aage badho to hum galay lagayenge, aur hum masnadein bichaayenge, ya agar tum peeth pher jao to hum juda ho jaayenge, aisi judaai jaisi kisi ghair-mohabbat karne wale se hoti hai." Unhone kaha: to unhone talwaar aik aurat ki taraf uthaayi taake use maarein, phir usse ruk gaye. Jab unpar jung khatm ho gayi, to maine unse kaha: "Maine aapka poora amal dekha siwaye is ke ke aapne aurat par talwaar uthaayi aur usse nahi maara." Unhone kaha: "Main, Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) ki talwaar ki izzat se bacha ke main isse kisi aurat ko qatl karoon." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] About Uruwah, in the designation of those who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the Bani Adiy, Tha'laba ibn Anamah ibn Adiy was martyred on the day of the Trench.
hi: Urwah se: "Nabi (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein, Banu Adi se, Tha'labah bin Anamah bin Adi the, aur woh Khandaq ke din shaheed kiye gaye."

e: [AI] Once, Tha'laba ibn 'Anama, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , came to him while he was sitting. He greeted the Prophet, and on his finger, he had a gold ring. The Prophet did not respond to his greeting. Tha'laba greeted him again, but the Prophet still did not respond. Then someone said to the Prophet, "O Messenger of Allah, Tha'laba has greeted you three times, but you did not respond." The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "Did you not see me averting my face from him as if a spark of fire was in his hand?" Afterward, the Prophet threw Tha'laba's ring away, declaring it unlawful.
hi: Beshak Tha'labah bin Anamah Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye jabke woh baithe huay the, unhone salaam kiya, aur unki ungli mein sone ki aik anguthi thi, aap (SAW) ne unhein salaam ka jawaab nahi diya, phir dobara salaam kiya, aap (SAW) ne unhein jawaab nahi diya, to unse kaha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Tha'labah aapko teen martaba salaam kar rahe hain, aap unhein jawaab nahi de rahe." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum nahi dekhte woh mere chehre par aag ka aik angaara chhidak rahe hain jo unke haath mein hai?" To Tha'labah ne anguthi phenk di. Haraam bin Uthman haalik (barbaad/na-qaabil-e-e'temaad) hain.

e: [AI] "Regarding Ibn Ishaq's mentioning of the name of the one who witnessed Badr alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the tribe of Bani Zurayq bin 'Amir, then from the tribe of Bani Al-Ajlan, Rafa' bin Malik bin Al-Ajlan Al-Zurqi."
hi: Ibn Ishaq se: "Nabi (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein, Banu Zuraiq bin Aamir, phir Banu Al-Ajlaan se, Raafi' bin Malik bin Al-Ajlaan Az-Zuraqi the."

e: His father said: "I prayed behind the Prophet ﷺ and I sneezed and said: 'Al-hamdu lillahi, hamdan kathiran tayiban mubarakan fih, mubarakan'alaihi, kama yuhibbu rabbuna wa yarda (Praise be to Allah, much good and blessed praise as our Lord loves and is pleased with.)' When he finished praying, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Who is the one who spoke during the prayer?' But no one said anything. Then he said it a second time: 'Who is the one who spoke during the prayer?' So Rifa'ah bin Rafi bin Afrah said: 'It was me, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'I said: "Praise be to Allah, much good and blessed praise as our Lord loves and is pleased with.'" The Prophet ﷺ said: 'By the One in Whose hand is my soul, thirty-odd angels hastened to see which of them would take it up.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 931)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke peechhe namaz padhi, mujhe cheenk aayi, to maine kaha: "Alhamdulillah, hamdan kaseeran tayyiban mubaarakan feehi mubaarakan alaihi, kama yuhibbu Rabbuna wa yardha (Allah ki bohot, achhi, barkat wali tareef, jaisi humara Rab pasand kare aur raazi ho)." Jab Rasulullah (SAW) namaz se faarigh huay, to farmaya: "Namaz mein kis ne baat ki?" Maine kaha: "Main, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne kya kaha?" Maine kaha: "Maine kaha: Alhamdulillah, hamdan kaseeran tayyiban mubaarakan feehi mubaarakan alaihi, kama yuhibbu Rabbuna wa yardha." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tees se zyada farishton ne isse pehle lene ki koshish ki ke kaun ise uthaakar (Allah tak) le jaaye." Humein Muhammad bin Salih bin Haani' ne hadith bayan ki, humein Ahmad bin Salamah ne hadith bayan ki, humein Muhammad bin Yahya ne hadith bayan ki, humein Qutaibah bin Sa'eed ne hadith bayan ki, aur humne isse sirf unse likha, phir isi tarah hadith zikr ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "So I stabbed him with a sword, inflicting a fatal wound, and then I was struck by an arrow during the Battle of Badr. My eye was injured, and the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) spat on it and prayed for me, and it did not cause me any harm." (The authenticity of this narration has been confirmed, but Abdul Aziz bin Imran weakened it.)
hi: "To maine usse talwaar se aik waar kiya aur qatl kar diya, aur Badr ke din mujhe teer laga jisne meri aankh phod di, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usme thooka aur mere liye dua ki, to mujhe usse koi takleef nahi hui." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Abdul Aziz bin Imran ko kamzor kaha gaya hai.

e: [AI] "I arrived on the day of Badr, but we had lost the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. So the companions called out to each other asking, 'Is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ among you?' They all stood still until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came, accompanied by Ali ibn Abi Talib. They said, 'O Messenger of Allah, we have missed you.' He replied, 'Verily, Abu Hassan (referring to himself) experienced discomfort in his stomach, so I stayed behind with him.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: Main Badr ke din aaya, humne Rasulullah (SAW) ko na paaya, to saathiyon ne aik doosre ko pukaara: "Kya tumhare paas Rasulullah (SAW) hain?" To woh ruk gaye yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) aaye, unke sath Ali bin Abi Talib the, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humne aapko na paaya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Hasan (Ali) ko pait mein dard hua, to main unke sath rukh gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Urwah bin Rafi bin Rafa'a bin Malik bin Al-Ajlan bin Zurayq, from the Anṣār tribe of Banī Zurayq, who was a Naqīb, mentioned him also in relation to those who witnessed the Battle of Badr.
hi: Humein Urwah ne hadith bayan ki: "Ansar mein se Banu Zuraiq se Aqabah mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Rifa'ah bin Raafi' bin Malik bin Al-Ajlaan bin Zuraiq the, aur woh Naqeeb the," aur unhone unhein Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein bhi zikr kiya.

e: [AI] "Rifa'at son of Rafi' son of Malik son of Al-Ajlan son of Amr son of 'Amir son of Zurayq son of Abd Harithah. His mother is the mother of his brother's Khalad son of Rafi'. His mother is Malik daughter of Ubayy son of Salul. Rifa'at son of Rafi' died during the rule of Muawiyah."
hi: "Rifa'ah bin Raafi' bin Malik bin Al-Ajlaan bin Amr bin Aamir bin Zuraiq bin Abd Haarithah, unki maa aur unke bhai Khallaad bin Raafi' ki maa Umm Malik bint Ubayy bin Salool thin, aur Rifa'ah bin Raafi' ka intiqaal Mu'awiyah (RA) ke ameer banne ke waqt hua."

e: [AI] "Thabit ibn Qais ibn Shammash ibn Imri' al-Qais ibn Malik, the orator of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , witnessed the battles of Uhud, Al-Khandaq, and all other significant events alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He was martyred on the day of Yamama."
hi: "Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas bin Imri-ul-Qais bin Malik, Rasulullah (SAW) ke khateeb (mimbar par baat karne wale numainde), ne Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur woh Yamamah ke din shaheed kiye gaye."

e: [AI] "Thabit ibn Qais ibn Shammass was martyred on the day of Yamama, and Abu Bakr had sent him ahead of the Ansar with Khalid ibn al-Walid."
hi: "Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas Yamamah ke din shaheed kiye gaye, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ke sath Ansar ka ameer muqarrar kiya tha."

e: [AI] I heard Ahmed bin Sayyar saying, "Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas, the father of Abdul Rahman, uses the nickname Abu Abdur Rahman."
hi: Maine Ahmad bin Sayyaar ko kehte suna: "Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas ki kunniyat Abu Abdur Rahman thi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "What a good man Abu Bakr is, what a good man Umar is, what a good man Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah is, what a good man Thabit ibn Qais ibn Shammas is, what a good man Muadh ibn Jabal is, what a good man Muadh ibn Amr ibn Jamuh is. How wretched are so-and-so and so-and-so." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ mentioned these seven men but did not mention Suhayl for us. It is authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, but he did not include it.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Abu Bakr, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Umar, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Mu'adh bin Jabal, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamooh, kaisa bura aadmi hai fulan aur fulan." Saat aadmiyon ka naam Rasulullah (SAW) ne liya, aur Suhail ne humein unke naam nahi bataaye. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "When the battle of Yamamah took place, I went to Thabit ibn Qays ibn Shammas while he was dyeing his hair. I said, 'O uncle, don't you see what people are going through?' He quickly put on his robes and approached, saying, 'Now, now.' He repeated this phrase with great enthusiasm and pointed with his finger to the faces of the people, mimicking their actions. He said, 'How terrible that you have become like this! This is not how we used to fight alongside the Prophet ﷺ .' Then he fought until he was killed." (This narration is considered authentic according to the criteria of the two sheikhs, referring to Imam al-Bukhari and Muslim.)
hi: Jab Yamamah ka din hua, to main Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas ke paas gaya, jabke woh apne aap par mushk-kaafoor (jaanaza ki khushbu) lagaa rahe the, maine kaha: "Aye chacha, kya aap nahi dekh rahe log kya kar rahe hain?" To unhone apna kafan pehna, phir aage badhe kehte huay: "Ab, ab," aur khushbu (kaafoor) is tarah lagaate rahe, aur Ansari ne apni pindli par isharaa kiya, log ki taraf mudke, jung mein aage badhte huay: "Bura kiya tumne apne saathiyon ko yeh sikhaake, hum aisi tarah Nabi (SAW) ke sath jung nahi karte the," phir jung karte rahe yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Thabit bin Qais gave a sermon at the house of the Prophet in Medina and said, "We will prevent you from what we prevent ourselves and our children from. What is there for us?" The Prophet said, "Paradise." They replied, "We are satisfied with this on the condition of the two sheikhs (referring to Bukhari and Muslim) and they did not reject it."
hi: Thabit bin Qais ne Nabi (SAW) ki Madinah aamad ke waqt khutba di, kaha: "Hum aapki hifaazat waisi hi karenge jaisi hum apni jaanon aur apni aulaad ki karte hain, to humein kya milega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat." Unhone kaha: "Hum raazi hain." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, I feared that I might have been destroyed," said the individual. The Prophet (pbuh) asked, "Why?" He replied, "Allah has forbidden us from praising ourselves for what we have not done, and I find myself loving praise. Allah has forbidden us from false pride, and I find myself loving beauty. Allah has forbidden us from raising our voices above yours, and yet I have a loud voice." The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) asked, "Thabit, would you not be pleased to live a praiseworthy life, be killed as a martyr, and enter Paradise?" He replied, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." The Prophet (pbuh) said, "Then live a praiseworthy life and be killed as a martyr on the day of Musaylimah al-Kadhdhab." This hadith is reported by Muslim alone on the authority of Hammam ibn Salamah and Sulayman ibn al-Mughira from Thabit, on the condition mentioned by the two Sheikhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Muslim). They did not report it in this context. Thabit ibn Qays narrated the hadith briefly according to the conditions set by Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe darr hai ke main halaak ho gaya houn." Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kyun?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ne humein mana kiya hai ke hum us cheez ki tareef pasand karein jo humne nahi ki, aur main dekhta houn ke mujhe tareef pasand hai, aur usne humein ghuroor se mana kiya hai, aur main dekhta houn ke mujhe khoobsurati pasand hai, aur usne humein mana kiya hai ke hum apni aawaazein aapki aawaaz se buland karein, aur meri aawaaz buland hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Thabit, kya tumhein pasand nahi ke tum tareef ke sath jeeyo aur shaheed hokar qatl kiye jao aur Jannat mein dakhil ho?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." To woh tareef ke sath jiye aur Musailamah Al-Kazzab ke din shaheed hokar qatl kiye gaye. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise isi tarah nahi nikaala. Sirf Muslim ne akele Hammad bin Salamah aur Sulaiman bin Al-Mugheerah ki hadith Thabit se, unhone Anas se riwayat ki, unhone kaha: jab yeh nazil hui: "{Apni aawaazein Nabi ki aawaaz se buland mat karo}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 2), to Thabit bin Qais aaye, aur hadith mukhtasar zikr ki. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "And Allah said, 'O Allah, I declare my innocence to You from what these people have brought, and I apologize to You for what these people have done. How evil are the friends you have accustomed us to! Leave us and our companions alone for a while, and then he carried and fought for a while and was killed. His armor had been stolen, and a man saw it while he was asleep. He said, 'My armor is in a sack under such and such location.' He left behind his will and testament. They searched for the armor and found it where he had indicated. They carried out his instructions. 'It is authentic according to the condition of Muslim, and it has not been mentioned that they disobeyed it. The story of his will and testament is amazing.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, main tere saamne is se bezaari zaahir karta houn jo yeh log laaye hain, aur main tujhse maazrat chahta houn is baat ki jo inhone ki hai, bura kiya tumne apne saathiyon ko yeh sikhaake, humare aur humare saathiyon ke darmiyan aik lamha ke liye rasta chhod do." Phir woh aage badhe aur thodi der jung karte rahe, phir shaheed kar diye gaye, aur unki zirah chori ho gayi thi. To aik aadmi ne unhein khwaab mein dekha, unhone kaha: "Meri zirah aik haandi mein hai, aik kaathi ke neeche, fulan-fulan jagah, mere kuch wasiyaten hain." To unhone zirah talaash ki, use wahin paaya jahan unhone bataaya tha, to unhone unki wasiyat poori ki. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur unki wasiyaton ki hadith mein aik ajeeb-o-ghareeb qissa hai. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] When Allah revealed to His Messenger ﷺ , "Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet" [Al-Hujurat 2], and the verse “And Allah does not like everyone who is self-deluded and boastful” [Al-Hadid 23], my father sat in his house crying because the Messenger of Allah was no longer with us. He asked him about his affairs, and he said, "I am a loud-voiced person and I fear that my deeds may be in vain." The Messenger of Allah replied, "No, you will live a praiseworthy life, die as a martyr, and Allah will admit you into paradise in peace." On the day of Yamamah, my father was martyred while fighting alongside Khalid ibn Al-Walid. A Muslim man saw him in a dream and said, "When I was killed, a Muslim man took my shield and hid it in the farthest corner of the camp. He covered it with a sheet and placed a saddle on top. Go and inform the Amir, but be careful not to say it was a dream and dismiss it. When you reach Madinah, go to the Khalifa of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and inform him that I have a debt of so and so, and that my son is a slave named so and so." My father followed this advice and went to the Amir, who verified the information. He also went to Abu Bakr and informed him, and he acted according to his instructions. We do not know of anyone who followed the instructions of his will after his death except for Thabit ibn Qays ibn Shammas. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this incident in his summary.
hi: Jab Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) par yeh nazil ki: "{Apni aawaazein Nabi ki aawaaz se buland mat karo}" (Surah Al-Hujurat 2) yeh ayat, aur ayat "{Aur Allah kisi ghuroor karne wale, fakhr karne wale ko pasand nahi karta}" (Surah Al-Hadeed 23), to mere waalid apne ghar mein baith kar rone lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein na paaya, to unse unke haal ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Main aik buland aawaaz wala aadmi houn, aur mujhe darr hai ke mera amal zaaya ho gaya ho." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, balke tum tareef ke sath jiyoge aur shaheed hokar maroge, aur Allah tumhein salaamati ke sath Jannat mein dakhil karega." Jab Yamamah ka din aaya, Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ke sath, woh shaheed kiye gaye, to Musalmano mein se aik aadmi ne unhein khwaab mein dekha, unhone kaha: "Jab main qatl kiya gaya, to aik Musalman ne meri zirah cheen li aur usse lashkar ke aakhri hisse mein chhupaaya, aur woh uske paas hai, unhone zirah par aik haandi rakh di hai aur haandi par aik kaathi rakh di hai, ameer ke paas jao aur unhein bataao, aur khabardaar aisa mat kehna ke yeh khwaab hai isliye ise zaaya kar dena, aur jab tum Madinah pahuncho, to jaao aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke khalifa se kaho: mujhpar itna-itna qarz hai, aur mera ghulam fulan mere ghulaamon mein se aazaad hai, aur khabardaar aisa mat kehna ke yeh khwaab hai isliye ise zaaya kar dena." Unhone kaha: to woh unke paas gaye aur unhein khabar batayi, to maamla waisa hi paaya jaisa unhone bataaya tha, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas gaye aur unhein bataaya, to unhone unki wasiyat poori ki, to humein Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas ke ilawa kisi aur ke baare mein pata nahi ke unki maut ke baad unki wasiyat poori ki gayi ho. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And Abu Al-Aas ibn Al-Rabee ibn Abd Al-Azza ibn Abd Shams ibn Abd Manaf ibn Qusay, and the name of his father is Mikhsam, and his mother is Hala bint Khweild ibn Asad ibn Abd Al-Azza ibn Qusay, and his aunt is Khadijah bint Khweild, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ married Abu Al-Aas' daughter, Zainab, before Islam, and she bore him Ali and Umamah. Ali died at a young age, and Umamah remained until Ali ibn Abi Talib married her after Fatimah's death. Abu Al-Aas was among those who participated in the Battle of Badr with the polytheists, and he was captured by Abdullah ibn Jubayr ibn Al-Nu'man Al-Ansari. When the people of Makkah sent a ransom for their captives, his brother Amr ibn Al-Rabee arrived with ransom money paid by Zainab. As I mentioned before, I narrated what happened between him and Zainab bint the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until Zainab was martyred. So, now listen to the good outcome of Abu Al-Aas, his good Islam, and his relocation to Madinah, until he passed away in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
hi: "Aur Abu Al-Aas bin Ar-Rabee' bin Abd Al-Uzza bin Abd Shams bin Abd Manaf bin Qusay, Abu Al-Aas ka naam Miqsam tha, aur unki maa Haalah bint Khuwailid bin Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza bin Qusay thin, aur unki khaala Khadijah (RA) bint Khuwailid, Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, thin, aur Nabi (SAW) ne Islam se pehle apni beti Zainab (RA) ka nikah unse karvaaya tha, to unhone unke liye Ali aur Umaamah ko janam diya, Ali chhote hi mein faut ho gaye, aur Umaamah zinda rahin yahan tak ke unse Ali bin Abi Talib ne, Fatimah (RA) ke intiqaal ke baad, nikah kiya. Aur Abu Al-Aas un logon mein se the jinhone Badr mushrikeen ke sath shirkat ki, to unhein Abdullah bin Jubair bin An-Nu'maan Al-Ansari ne qaid kar liya, jab Makkah walon ne apne qaidiyon ke fidye ke liye bheja, to Abu Al-Aas ke fidye ke liye unke bhai Amr bin Ar-Rabee' aik maal lekar aaye jo Zainab (RA) ne unhein diya tha." Aur maine pehle zikr kiya hai jo unke aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Zainab (RA) ke darmiyan hua yahan tak ke Zainab (RA) shaheed hui, ab suno Abu Al-Aas ke achhe anjaam aur unke achhe Islam aur Madinah ki taraf unki hijrat ke baare mein, yahan tak ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein faut huay.

e: [AI] Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , said, "When the people of Makkah sent their prisoners as ransom, Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , was sent as ransom for Abu Al-'Ass with wealth. She also sent a necklace in which Khadijah had put her trust when she married Abu Al-'Ass. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw that necklace, he was deeply moved and said, 'If you all see fit to release the prisoner and return what belongs to her, then do so.' They replied, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' So they set him free and returned what belonged to her. Abu Al-'Ass continued to live with his association with idolatry until just before the conquest of Makkah. He then set out on a trading journey to Syria with wealth from the people of Quraysh, some of which was given to him. When he finished his trade and was returning in a caravan, a secret detachment sent by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  apprehended him. It was said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was the one who ordered the detachment for the caravan in which Abu Al-'Ass was, consisting of seventy to a hundred riders with their leader being Zaid bin Harithah. This incident occurred in Jumada al-Ula in the sixth year after Hijrah. The detachment took all the possessions from the caravan and captured several people, but Abu Al-'Ass managed to escape. When the secret detachment returned with their spoils, Abu Al-'Ass came at night searching for his wealth until he entered the presence of Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He sought her protection and she granted it to him. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out for the Fajr prayer and made the Takbir, the people also made the Takbir with him."
hi: Aisha (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, se, unhone kaha: "Jab Makkah walon ne apne qaidiyon ke fidye ke liye bheja, to Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Zainab (RA) ne Abu Al-Aas ke fidye ke liye maal bheja, aur usme aik haar bhi bheja jo Khadijah (RA) ne unhein Abu Al-Aas ke ghar bhejte waqt diya tha jab unhone unse shaadi ki thi. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne woh haar dekha, to unhein bohot narmi mehsoos hui, aur farmaya: 'Agar tum theek samjho ke unke qaidi ko chhod do aur unhein unka maal wapas kar do, to aisa karo.' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW).' To unhone use aazaad kar diya aur unka maal unhein wapas kar diya. Aur Abu Al-Aas apne shirk par qaayam rahe yahan tak ke Fatah-e-Makkah se thodi der pehle, woh Quraish ke logon ka maal lekar Sham (Syria) ki taraf tijarat ke liye nikle jo unhone unke sath diya tha, jab woh apni tijarat se faarigh hokar wapas aa rahe the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ka aik dasta (chhoti fauj) unse mila, aur kaha jaata hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne khud us qaafle ki taraf dasta bheja tha jismein Abu Al-Aas the, Sham se aik qaafla, aur woh aik sau sattar (170) sawaar the, unke ameer Zaid bin Haarithah the, aur yeh Jumada-al-Oola, chhah (6) hijri mein hua, unhone us qaafle ka saamaan le liya aur qaafle ke kuch logon ko qaid kar liya, magar Abu Al-Aas bhaag kar unse bach gaye. Jab dasta jo unhone haasil kiya woh lekar aaya, to Abu Al-Aas raat ko apna maal talaash karte huay aaye yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Zainab (RA) ke paas dakhil huay aur unse panaah maangi, to unhone unhein panaah di. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Fajr ki namaz ke liye nikle, to takbeer kahi aur log unke sath takbeer kehne lage."

e: [AI] "Dhirar ibn Al-Azwar, the poet, whose full name is Al-Azwar Malik ibn Aws ibn Jadhimah ibn Rabi'ah ibn Malik ibn Tha'labah ibn Asad ibn Khuzaymah, was a Persian poet and warrior who participated in the Battle of Yamamah. He fought with great bravery until both his legs were amputated, yet he continued to fight while kneeling until he was overwhelmed by death."
hi: Beshak "Dirar bin Al-Azwar, shaayar, Al-Azwar ka naam Malik bin Aws bin Jadheemah bin Rabee'ah bin Malik bin Tha'labah bin Asad bin Khuzaimah tha, aur Dirar aik ghudsawaar shaayar the, unhone Yamamah ke din shirkat ki, aur sakht jung ki yahan tak ke unki dono tangein kaat di gayin, to woh apne ghutnon ke bal baith gaye aur jung karte rahe, aur ghode unhein rondte rahe yahan tak ke unhein maut ne ghalib kar liya." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Dhirar bin Al-Azwar Al-Asadi was killed on the day of "Ajnadain."
hi: Dirar bin Al-Azwar Al-Asadi Ajnadain ke din qatl kiye gaye.

e: [AI] I brought the Prophet ﷺ a young camel from my family, and he told me "milk it." So I went to milk it, and he said "don't strain it, leave it for the caller of the milk." The chain of narration is sahih (authentic), and nothing other than this has been preserved about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Dhirar. As for his virtues, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed for him when he recited his poem.
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas apne ghar walon ki taraf se aik dooh dene wali oontni laaya, aap (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Ise doodh nikaalo." To main usse zyada doodh nikaalne ki koshish karne laga, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise mushkil mat karo, doodh ke bulane wale (thodi matra) ko chhod do." Sahih isnad, aur Dirar (RA) se Rasulullah (SAW) ke hawaale se iske siwa kuch aur mehfooz nahi, rahi baat unki fazeelat ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke liye dua ki jab unhone unhein apni woh qaseeda (nazm) sunaayi jo unhone kahi thi:

e:
[AI] That Dhirar ibn al-Azwar, when he accepted Islam, he went to the Prophet ﷺ and began to say: [Al-Bahr al-Mutaqarib] "I have left gambling and the playing of the stringed instrument, and wine as a form of worship and entreaty. I have also forsaken writing my beloved in the darkness of ink, and exerting effort in fighting against the Muslims." Jamilah then said: "O Lord, do not let my bargain go to waste, as you have caused me to lose my family and wealth in return." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said: "Your bargain has not been in vain, O Dhirar."

Note: The translation provided is not an official or certified translation, but only a general interpretation of the text.
hi: Beshak Dirar bin Al-Azwar (RA) ne, jab woh Musalman huay, Nabi (SAW) ke paas aakar yeh (bahr Al-Mutaqaarib mein) kaha: "Maine juwe ke teer aur gaane wali laundiyon ki aawaaz chhod di, aur sharaab ko bhi chhod diya, aur ibaadat aur dua ki taraf mutawajjeh hua, aur main apne khoobsurat ghode par sakht jung mein daudta, aur meri koshish Musalmano ke khilaaf jung karna thi, aur Jameelah (meri biwi) ne kaha: tumne humein bikhera diya aur apne ghar walon ko chhod diya, alag-alag simton mein, isliye Aye Rab, mujhe apne is sauda mein khasaara mat pahunchana, kyunke maine apne ghar walon aur apna maal is (deen) ke badle bech diya hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare sauda mein koi khasaara nahi hua, Aye Dirar."

e: [AI] "Abu Kabshah, the slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , died in the year thirteen."
hi: "Abu Kabshah, Rasulullah (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, ka intiqaal terah (13) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] About his elders, they said, "Abu Kabsha, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , his name was Sulaym and he was from the land of Daws. Abu Kabsha witnessed Badr and Uhud and all the major battles. He passed away on the first day he was appointed by Umar ibn Al-Khattab. This happened on a Tuesday, in the eight remaining nights of Jumada al-Ula, in the thirteenth year of Hijrah." Al-Dhahabi removed this narration from the abridged version due to its weakness.
hi: Unke buzurgon se, unhone kaha: "Abu Kabshah, Rasulullah (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, ka naam Suleim tha, aur woh zameen-e-Daws ke aslee baashindon mein se the, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr, Uhud, aur tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur unka intiqaal usi pehle din hua jismein Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) khalifa muqarrar huay, aur yeh Mangalvaar ke din, Jumada-al-Oola ki aath (8) raatein baaqi rehte, terah (13) hijri mein hua." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] He was one of those who witnessed the Battle of Badr from the Banu Hashim tribe, son of Abdul Manaf, Abu Kabshah, a servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: "Aur Banu Hashim bin Abd Manaf mein se Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein, Abu Kabshah, Rasulullah (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, the."

e: [AI] Muhammad ibn Umar praised.
hi: Humein Muhammad bin Umar ne hadith bayan ki.

e: [AI] I followed Muhammad and I submitted to Allah, the Lord of the worlds, may His mention be glorious. Then his mother said: "Indeed, no one has more right to be supported and helped by you than your cousin, Ibn Khalik. By Allah, if we were capable of doing what men can do, we would have followed him and protected him." So I said, "Oh my mother, what prevents you from submitting and following him? Indeed, your brother Hamza has already submitted." She said, "I will see what my sisters do, then I will decide whether to join them." I said, "I ask you by Allah, won't you go to him, greet him and believe in him, and testify that there is no god except Allah?" She said, "Indeed, I testify that there is no god except Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." After that, she pledged her allegiance to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  verbally and encouraged her son to support him and follow his orders. This statement is reported to be authentic but not compiled in the collection of Sahih Al-Bukhari.
hi: Tulaib bin Umair (RA) ne Daar-e-Arqam mein Islam qubool kiya, phir dakhil huay aur apni maa Arwa bint Abdul Muttalib ke paas gaye, unhone kaha: "Maine Muhammad (SAW) ki pairavi ki hai aur Allah, jahaan ke Rab, jiska zikr buland hai, ke liye Musalman ho gaya houn." To unki maa ne kaha: "Sabse zyada haqdaar jiski tum madad karo aur jiske sath khade ho, tumhare maamu ke bete hain, Allah ki qasam, agar hum mardon jaisi taaqat rakhte, to hum unki pairavi karte aur unka difaa karte." Unhone kaha: to maine kaha: "Aye ammi, aapko Musalman honay aur unki pairavi karne se kya rokta hai? Aapke bhai Hamzah (RA) to Musalman ho chuke hain." Unhone kaha: "Main dekhungi meri behnein kya karti hain, phir main bhi unme se aik banungi." Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta houn, kya aap unke paas nahi jaayengi, unhein salaam karengi, unki tasdeeq karengi, aur gawahi denge ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi?" Unhone kaha: "To main gawahi deti houn ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deti houn ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain." Aur woh iske baad Nabi (SAW) ki apni zubaan se madad karti rahin aur apne bete ko unki nusrat aur unke kaam ko qaayam rakhne ki taraqeeb dilaati rahin. Sahih, gharib (kam-yaab), Bukhari ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] He adhered to his religion and followed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and his son 'Amr ibn Sa'id also followed his religion. When 'Amr embraced Islam, he joined his brother Khalid in the land of Abyssinia (Ethiopia), and with him was his wife Fatimah bint Safwan ibn Umayyah."
hi: apne deen par (qaayam rahe) aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath rahe, aur unka beta Amr bin Sa'eed unke deen par tha, jab Amr Musalman huay, to woh apne bhai Khalid ke sath Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen mein jaa milay, unke sath unki biwi Fatimah bint Safwan bin Umayyah bhi thin.

e: [AI] Khalid bin Saeed, Aban bin Saeed, and Amr bin Saeed were among the early Muslims who participated in battles. Uhayhah and Al-Aas, the sons of Saeed bin Al-Aas, were killed in the Battle of Badr as disbelievers. They were all killed by Ali bin Abi Talib, as I mentioned when I talked about Khalid bin Saeed.
hi: "Khalid bin Sa'eed, Abaan bin Sa'eed, aur Amr bin Sa'eed Islam ke shuru'aati logon mein se the, aur Uhaihah aur Al-Aas, Sa'eed bin Al-Aas ke betay, dono kaafir haalat mein Badr ke din qatl kiye gaye, aur inhein dono ko Ali bin Abi Talib ne qatl kiya, jaisa maine Khalid bin Sa'eed ke zikr mein bataaya."

e: [AI] Hisham ibn Al-Aas, his mother is Harmala bint Hisham ibn Al-Mughira ibn Abdul Rahman ibn Umar ibn Makhzum.
hi: "Hisham bin Al-Aas ki maa Harmalah bint Hisham bin Al-Mugheerah bin Abdur Rahman bin Umar bin Makhzoom thin."

e: [AI] About his elders, they said, "Hisham ibn Al-Aas ibn Wail ibn Hashim ibn Saeed ibn Sahm, and his mother's name was Harmalah bint Hisham ibn Al-Mughira. Hisham embraced Islam early in Mecca before his brother Amr. He migrated to the land of Habasha and then returned to Mecca when he was informed that the Prophet ﷺ  had migrated to Al-Madinah. He wanted to join him, but his father and his people detained him in Mecca until he arrived in Al-Madinah after the Battle of Trench. He witnessed all the events that occurred afterward, yet he was younger than his brother Amr ibn Al-Aas."
hi: Unke buzurgon se, unhone kaha: "Hisham bin Al-Aas bin Waail bin Hashim bin Sa'eed bin Sahm, aur unki maa ka naam Harmalah bint Hisham bin Al-Mugheerah tha, aur Hisham ne Makkah mein apne bhai Amr se pehle Islam qubool kiya, aur Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen ki taraf hijrat ki, phir jab unhein Nabi (SAW) ki Madinah hijrat ki khabar mili, to woh Makkah wapas aaye, unka iraada tha ke woh unse jaa milen, magar unke waalid aur qaum ne unhein Makkah mein rok liya, yahan tak ke woh Khandaq ke baad Nabi (SAW) ke paas Madinah aaye, phir unhone iske baad ki tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur woh apne bhai Amr bin Al-Aas se umr mein chhote the."

e: [AI] "O congregation of Muslims, indeed these two armies have no patience against the sword, so do as I do." He then entered into their midst and started killing some of them. He moved forward and attacked the enemies, shouting, "O congregation of Muslims, come to me! I am Hisham bin Al-Aas bin Wael, the one who guarantees paradise. Run until death overtakes you." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing this.
hi: "Aye Musalmano ki jama'at, beshak yeh na-khatna kiye huay log (Al-Ghalfaan) talwaar ke saamne sabr nahi kar sakte, isliye jaisa main karta houn waisa karo." Unhone kaha: to woh unke beech mein dakhil hone lage aur unme se kai logon ko qatl karte rahe, aur dushman ki gardan ki taraf aage badhte rahe, pukaarte huay: "Mere paas aao, Aye Musalmano ki jama'at, mere paas aao, main Hisham bin Al-Aas bin Waail houn, kya tum Jannat se bhaag rahe ho?" Yahan tak ke woh qatl kar diye gaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "The sons of Al-Aas are believers, Hisham and Amr." This narration is authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, and it was not omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Aas ke dono betay momin hain, Hisham aur Amr." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] We used to say that there is no repentance for anyone who abandons their religion after embracing Islam and having knowledge of it. Then Allah revealed in them [the Qur'an]: "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah." [Az-Zumar 53]. So I wrote it with my own hand and sent it to Hisham ibn al-Aas ibn Wael. He read it out loudly and then mounted his camel and followed Abdur Rahman bin Bashir, who denied the hadith, to the city.
hi: Hum kaha karte the: "Kisi bhi shakhs ke liye tauba nahi agar woh apna Islam qubool karne aur usse pehchaanne ke baad apna deen chhod de," to Allah ne unke baare mein yeh nazil ki: "{Aye mere bandon jinhone apne aap par zulm kiya hai, Allah ki rehmat se maayoos na ho}" (Surah Az-Zumar 53). To maine ise apne haath se likha, phir usse Hisham bin Al-Aas bin Waail ki taraf bheja, to unhone usse zor se padha, phir apne oont par baithe aur Madinah ki taraf chal pade. Abdur Rahman bin Bashir munkar-al-hadith (jinki riwayat munkar/gair-ma'nool hoti hai) hain.

e: [AI] When the day of the conquest of Mecca came, 'Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl fled. His wife, Umm Hakim bint Al-Harith ibn Hisham, a wise and intelligent woman, had embraced Islam and asked the Prophet ﷺ for protection for her husband. The Prophet commanded her to send him back, so she went in search of him and said to him, "I have come to you from the best and most noble of people, and I have given you my protection." He accepted her protection and returned with her. When they approached Mecca, the Prophet ﷺ said to his companions, "Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl will come to you as a believing emigrant, so do not insult his father. Insulting the dead hurts the living and does not reach the dead." When he reached the door of the Prophet ﷺ, the Prophet became delighted and stood up, showing joy for his arrival.
hi: Jab Fatah-e-Makkah ka din hua, to Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl bhaag gaye, aur unki biwi Umm Hakim bint Al-Harith bin Hisham aik hikmat wali aurat thin, unhone Islam qubool kar liya tha, phir unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se apne shohar ke liye amaan maangi, to aap (SAW) ne unhein usse wapas laane ka hukum diya, to woh unhein dhoondne nikli aur unse kaha: "Main aapke paas sabse zyada sila-e-rehmi karne wale, sabse nek, aur sabse behtareen shakhs ki taraf se aayi houn, maine aapke liye amaan maangi hai aur unhone aapko amaan de di hai."
