To woh unke sath wapas aaye, jab woh Makkah ke qareeb pahunche, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba se farmaya: "Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl imaan waale, hijrat karte huay tumhare paas aa rahe hain, isliye unke waalid ko bura-bhala mat kehna, kyunke murda ko bura-bhala kehna zinda ko takleef pahunchaata hai, aur murda tak nahi pahunchta." Jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke darwaze tak pahunche, to woh khush ho gaye aur Rasulullah (SAW) unke liye khade ho gaye, unki aamad par khush hokar. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "During the conquest, Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl fled purposely to Yemen. On that day, Umm Hakim bint al-Harith ibn Hisham, who had embraced Islam by then and was under the protection of Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl, sought permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to request her husband's hand in marriage. He granted her permission and ensured her safety. She departed with a guide towards Rome, who tried to provoke her affection for him. However, she remained faithful and drawn to her husband until they arrived at a group of people from Makkah. She sought their help and they protected her. Her husband had already reached the region of Tihamah, where he had embarked on a ship. When he boarded, he called upon Lat and al-Uzza (two idols) and the people on the ship told him it was not permissible for anyone to make any invocation except to Allah alone, sincerely. Ikrimah vowed that if he were to be saved even at sea, he would return to Muhammad ﷺ . Thus, Ikrimah returned with his wife and went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , pledged allegiance to him, and was accepted by him. Another man from among the Quraysh entered when the Bani Bakr defeated him, fleeing from his wife, whom he mistreated and insulted for running away. Urwah said, 'He was martyred on the day of Ajnadayn among the Muslims, and then among the Quraysh, and then among the Bani Makhzum. This man was Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl.'" (Translation provided by Translation Services)
hi: Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl Fatah-e-Makkah ke din Yemen ki taraf bhaag gaye, aur Umm Hakim bint Al-Harith bin Hisham, jo us waqt Musalman ho chuki thin aur Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl ke nikah mein thin, aayin, "to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se apne shohar ko dhoondhne ki ijaazat maangi, to aap (SAW) ne unhein ijaazat di aur unhein amaan di." To woh apne aik Rumi (Roman) ghulam ke sath nikli, usne unse (galat) mansha rakhi, magar woh usse behlaati aur qareeb rehti rahin yahan tak ke woh Makkah ke kuch logon ke paas pahunchi, unse madad maangi, to unhone usse (ghulam ko) bandh diya. Unhone apne shohar ko Tihaamah ke aik hisse mein pa liya, jabke woh aik kashti par sawaar ho chuke the, jab woh usme baithe, to unhone Laat aur Uzza ko pukaara, to kashti walon ne kaha: "Yahan koi bhi Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko khaalis niyat se na pukaare." To Ikrimah ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar samandar mein akele hone se bachne ka koi raasta hai to woh khushki mein akele honay se hai, main Allah ki qasam khaata houn ke main zaroor Muhammad (SAW) ki taraf wapas jaunga." To Ikrimah apni biwi ke sath wapas aaye, "phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay, unse baiyat ki, to aap (SAW) ne unse (baiyat) qubool ki." Aur Huzail qabile ka aik aadmi, jab Banu Bakr shikast khaa gaye, apni biwi ke paas bhaagta hua aaya, to usne uski malaamat ki aur usse kamzor kaha aur bhaagne par usse taana diya, to usne (bahr Ar-Rajz mein) kaha: "Kaash tum humein Al-Khandamah mein dekhti, jab Safwan bhaage aur Ikrimah bhaage, aur humein sacchi talwaaron se maara gaya, jo har baazoo aur khopdi ko kaat rahi thin, tum malaamat mein aik lafz bhi na kehti." Urwah ne kaha: "Aur Ajnadain ke din, Musalmano mein se, phir Quraish mein se, phir Banu Makhzoom mein se, Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl shaheed kiye gaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] 'Akrama ibn Abi Jahl, when I reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I said, "O Muhammad, this person informed me that you have granted me safety." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You are indeed safe." So, I said, "I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, with no partner, and that you are the servant and Messenger of Allah. You are the most righteous, truthful, and faithful among the people." 'Akrama said, "I said this while bowing my head in humility. Then, I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, seek forgiveness for me from every enmity that I have shown towards anyone, or any assembly in which I have exhibited polytheism.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O Allah, forgive 'Akrama for every enmity that he has shown towards me or any assembly he has joined, seeking to oppose Your path.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, guide me to the best of what you know so that I may learn it.' He said, 'Say, "I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I strive in His cause." Then 'Akrama said, 'By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, not a single coin did I leave that I would have spent in opposing the path of Allah, except that I spent double of it in the way of Allah. And I did not engage in any battle in opposition to the path of Allah, except that I received double of it in the way of Allah. Then I endeavored in fighting until I was martyred on the day of Ajnadeen during the caliphate of Abu Bakr, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had used me during his last pilgrimage to verify the weights used on the scales. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away, and on that day, 'Akrama died with great honor.'
hi: Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl: "Jab main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahuncha, maine kaha: Aye Muhammad, is (aurat) ne mujhe bataaya ke aapne mujhe amaan di hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mahfooz ho." Maine kaha: "Main gawahi deta houn ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, aur aap Allah ke banda aur uske Rasool hain, aur aap logon mein sabse zyada sila-e-rehmi karne wale, sabse sachhe, aur sabse wafaadaar hain." Ikrimah ne kaha: "Main yeh kehta houn jabke main sharm se apna sar jhukaaye huay houn," phir maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), har us dushmani ke liye jo maine aapse ki, aur har us safar ke liye jo maine shirk ko zaahir karne ke liye kiya, mere liye maghfirat maangein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, Ikrimah ki har dushmani jo unhone mujhse ki, aur har safar jo unhone iske liye kiya taake tere raaste se rokein, use maaf kar de." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe woh behtareen cheez sikhaayen jo aap jaante hain, taake main woh seekhoon." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho: main gawahi deta houn ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain, aur uski raah mein jihad karo." Phir Ikrimah ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main koi kharch jo maine Allah ki raah se rokne mein kiya use nahi chhodunga jab tak main iska dogna Allah ki raah mein kharch na kar doon, aur main koi jung jo maine Allah ki raah se rokne mein ladi use nahi chhodunga jab tak main iska dogna Allah ki raah mein na ladoon." Phir unhone jung mein poori koshish ki yahan tak ke woh Ajnadain ke din, Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat mein, shaheed hokar qatl kiye gaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein apne Hajj ke saal Hawaazin par zakat wasool karne ke liye muqarrar kiya tha, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal us waqt hua jab Ikrimah Tabaalah mein the. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "Akrimah paid it to 'Ayyash, but it did not reach 'Ayyash or any of them until they died, and they did not taste it. This is a summary of its weakness according to Al-Dhahabi."
hi: "Ikrimah, isse Ayyaash ko de do," magar woh na Ayyaash tak pahuncha na unme se kisi tak, yahan tak ke woh sab faut ho gaye, aur unhone usse chakha bhi nahi. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] On the day I arrived as an immigrant, the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Welcome to the traveler who migrated, welcome to the traveler who migrated, welcome to the traveler who migrated." I said, "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, I have not left any expense that I have not spent its equivalent in the sake of Allah Almighty." "The chain is authentic, but they did not include this narration," he replied. It is correct, but incomplete.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya jis din main hijrat karte huay aaya: "Khush-aamdeed hijrat karne wale sawaar ko, khush-aamdeed hijrat karne wale sawaar ko, khush-aamdeed hijrat karne wale sawaar ko." Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main koi kharch jo maine kiya use nahi chhodunga jab tak main uske jaisa Allah ki raah mein kharch na karoon." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih, lekin munqata' (isnad mein khaali jagah wala) hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I saw in a dream that Abu Jahl came to me and pledged allegiance." When Khalid ibn al-Walid embraced Islam, it was said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that Allah had made your dream come true, O Messenger of Allah. This is Khalid embracing Islam. He said, "There will be others besides him." This continued until Ikrimah ibn Abu Jahl embraced Islam, and this was the fulfillment of his dream. "This Hadith is authentic according to the conditions of both Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine khwaab mein dekha goya Abu Jahl mere paas aaye aur mujhse baiyat ki." Jab Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) Musalman huay, to Rasulullah (SAW) se kaha gaya: "Allah ne aapka khwaab sach kar diya, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh Khalid ka Islam hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zaroor koi aur bhi hoga," yahan tak ke Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl Musalman huay, aur yehi unke khwaab ki tasdeeq thi. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I saw a clog in Paradise for my father-in-law Abu Jahl." When Ikrimah ibn Abu Jahl embraced Islam, he said, "O Umm Salamah, this is him." There are no weak narrators in it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine Abu Jahl ke liye Jannat mein aik khajoor ki shaakh dekhi." Jab Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl Musalman huay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Umm Salamah, yehi woh hain." Nahi, ismein do kamzor raawi hain.

e: [AI] Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl used to take the Quran and place it on his face and cry, saying "The words of my Lord, the book of my Lord."
hi: Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl Mus-haf (Quran) ko liya karte, apne chehre par rakhte, aur rote huay kehte: "Mere Rab ka kalaam, mere Rab ki Kitaab." Mursal.

e: [AI] As for Abu Quhafa Al-Taymi, he is Uthman ibn Amr ibn Amr ibn Kaab ibn Saad ibn Taym ibn Murrah. He embraced Islam on the day of the conquest of Mecca and passed away in Mecca in the month of Muharram, in the fourteenth year of the Hijra. He was ninety-seven years old.
hi: "Aur rahi baat Abu Quhaafah At-Taimi ki, to woh Uthman bin Aamir bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Taim bin Murrah hain, unhone Fatah-e-Makkah ke din Islam qubool kiya, aur unka intiqaal Makkah mein Muharram, hijrat ke chaudah (14) saal mein hua, jabke woh sattaanave (97) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr came on the day of the conquest of Mecca with his father Abu Quhafa to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If you have settled the sheikh in his house, we would have come to visit him." This is authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to the scholars Al-Bukhari and Muslim) and they did not mention it according to the condition of Al-Bukhari.
hi: Abu Bakr (RA) Fatah-e-Makkah ke din apne waalid Abu Quhaafah ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum buzurg ko unke ghar mein rehne dete, to hum khud unke paas aa jaate." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari ki shart par.

e: [AI] "I brought my father Quhafah to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, 'Why didn't you leave the old man until I come to him?' I said, 'He is more deserving that you should visit him.' He (the Prophet) said, 'We will keep him safe in our hands for his son's service.' This hadith has a strong chain of narration, and Abdullah ibn Abdullah ibn Abdul-Malik al-Fahri did not declare it as fabricated."
hi: Main apne waalid Abu Quhaafah ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne buzurg ko kyun na chhod diya yahan tak ke main unke paas aata?" Maine kaha: "Balke woh iske zyada haqdaar hain ke woh aapke paas aayen." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hum unki izzat unke bete ki humpar ki gayi ehsaanaat ki wajah se karte hain." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Abdullah bin Abdul Malik Al-Fahri munkar-al-hadith hain.

e: [AI] The name of my father is Quhafa, Othman son of Amer son of Amr son of Kaab son of Saad son of Taym son of Murrah son of Kaab son of Luay son of Ghalib son of Fehr. He embraced Islam on the day of the conquest (of Mecca) and passed away in the month of Muharram in the fourteenth year (of the Islamic calendar) at the age of ninety-seven years.
hi: "Abu Quhaafah ka naam Uthman bin Aamir bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Taim bin Murrah bin Ka'b bin Luway bin Ghaalib bin Fihr tha, unhone Fatah ke din Islam qubool kiya, aur unka intiqaal Muharram, hijrat ke chaudah (14) saal mein hua, jabke woh sattaanave (97) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] Abu Quhafa, the father of Abu Bakr, passed away in the year seventeen and he was one hundred and four years old.
hi: "Abu Quhaafah, Abu Bakr (RA) ke waalid, ka intiqaal satrah (17) hijri mein hua, jabke woh aik sau chaar (104) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] Omar ibn al-Khattab took the hand of Abu Quhafa and brought him to the Prophet ﷺ. When he stood in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the Prophet ﷺ said, "Change him and do not bring him close in (his current attire) of black." On the condition of being a Muslim.
hi: Beshak Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne Abu Quhaafah ka haath pakda aur unhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaye, jab woh unhein lekar Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne khade huay, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse (baalon ka rang) badal do, aur ise kaale rang ke qareeb mat le jaao." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] On the day of the conquest, the Prophet ﷺ brought Abu Quhafa, and his head and beard were gray. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Dye his beard." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas Fatah ke din Abu Quhaafah laaye gaye, jabke unke sar aur daadhi safed ho chuke the, jaise Thaghaamah (aik safed phool wala paudha), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unki daadhi rangwa do." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] As if I am looking at the beard of my father Abu Quhafa, as if it is a bunch of thorny plants due to its intense redness. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Abu Bakr, "If you establish a sheikh in his house, we will visit him as an honor for Abu Bakr." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Goya main Abu Quhaafah ki daadhi ko dekh raha houn, jaise Arfaj (jhaadi) ki jalti hui aag ho, uski surkhi ki shiddat se." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Bakr se farmaya: "Agar tum buzurg ko unke ghar mein rehne dete, to hum khud unke paas aa jaate, Abu Bakr ki izzat ke liye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When the Prophet ﷺ passed away, the news reached the people of Makkah. Abu Quhafa al-Ha'iata heard the news and asked, "What is this?" They said, "The Prophet ﷺ has passed away." He said, "Who will take charge after him?" They said, "Your son." He said, "May the sons of Makhzum and the sons of Muqira suffice." They said, "Yes." He said, "O Allah, there is no replacement for what You have taken away, and no substitute for what You have given. When Abu Bakr passed away at the beginning of the year, the news reached the people of Makkah. Abu Quhafa al-Ha'iata heard the news and asked, "What is this?" They said, "Your son has passed away." He said, "A great matter, and the one who came before him had a shorter life than him." He said, "Who will take charge after him?" They said, "Umar ibn al-Khattab." He said, "He is his companion. This is correct according to the condition of the two Shaykhs [Abu Bakr and Umar], and they did not expel him." They did not expel anything for 'Amr ibn Abdullah ibn Sayad.
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to yeh khabar Makkah walon tak pahunchi. Unhone kaha: to Abu Quhaafah ne shor-o-gul suna, unhone poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ka intiqaal ho gaya." Unhone kaha: "Yeh aik azeem maamla hai, to unke baad is maamle ka zimmedaar kaun bana?" Unhone kaha: "Aapka beta." Unhone poocha: "Aur Banu Makhzoom aur Banu Al-Mugheerah raazi ho gaye?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, koi bhi us cheez ko neecha nahi kar sakta jo tune buland ki, aur koi bhi us cheez ko buland nahi kar sakta jo tune neecha kiya." Jab saal ke shuru mein Abu Bakr ka intiqaal hua, to yeh khabar Makkah walon tak pahunchi, Abu Quhaafah ne shor-o-gul suna, unhone poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aapke bete ka intiqaal ho gaya." Unhone kaha: "Yeh aik azeem maamla hai, aur jo iske pehle hua tha woh iske se bhi azeem tha." Unhone poocha: "To unke baad is maamle ka zimmedaar kaun bana?" Unhone kaha: "Umar bin Al-Khattab." Unhone kaha: "Woh unke saathi hain." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Dono ne Umaarah bin Abdullah bin Sayyaad ke liye kuch bhi nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] Umar ibn Al-Khattab was entrusted with the caliphate for a year and three months. Umar then led the funeral prayer for him and walked with him to Al-Baqi Cemetery where he was buried there."
hi: "Ke Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) khalifa muqarrar huay (Abu Bakr RA ki khilafat ke) aik saal aur teen mahine baad, to Umar (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, phir unke sath Baqee' tak paidal chale, yahan tak ke unhein wahan dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] "Nu'fal ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib passed away, and he was also known as Abu al-Harith. This was two years after the caliphate of Umar ibn al-Khattab in Medina."
hi: "Naufal bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib, jinki kunniyat Abu Al-Harith thi, ka intiqaal Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ki khilafat ke do saal guzarne par, Madinah mein hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to him, "Sacrifice yourself, O Nawfal." He said, "I have nothing to sacrifice, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Sacrifice yourself with your spear that you use in battle." He said, "By Allah, no one knows that I have a spear to sacrifice except Allah. I bear witness that you are the Messenger of Allah." So he sacrificed himself with it, and it was worth one thousand spears. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, made a pact of brotherhood between Nawfal and Al-Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib, who were previously partners in ignorance, dealing with wealth, and loving each other. Nawfal witnessed with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, the conquest of Makkah, Hunayn, and Taif, and he remained steadfast with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, during the Battle of Hunayn. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "It is as if I see your spear penetrating the chests of the polytheists."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Apni jaan ka fidya do, Aye Naufal." Unhone kaha: "Mere paas fidya dene ke liye kuch nahi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni jaan ka fidya un neezon se do jo Juddah mein hain." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Allah ke siwa kisi ko nahi pata tha ke mere paas Juddah mein neze hain, siwaye mere, main gawahi deta houn ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain." To unhone unse apni jaan ka fidya diya, aur woh hazaar (1000) neze the. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Naufal aur Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ke darmiyan (Islami) bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, aur woh dono Jaahiliyat mein bhi saathi the, apna maal aapas mein mila lete the, aur aik doosre se mohabbat karte the. Aur Naufal ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Fatah-e-Makkah, Hunain, aur Taaif mein shirkat ki, aur Hunain ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jame rahe, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Goya main dekh raha houn tumhare neze mushrikeen ki reedh ki haddiyon mein toot rahe hain."

e: [AI] It is mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sought assistance in getting married, so he got him married to a woman. He then sought something but could not find it, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent Abu Rafi' and Abu Ayyub with his armor and they pawned it with a Jewish man for thirty sa'a of barley. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then gave it to me, and we ate from it for half a year. Then we consumed it, and we found it the same as when we first received it. Nufal mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, "If you did not trust him, you would have eaten from it as long as you lived." As for Rabi'ah ibn al-Harith and 'Ubaidah ibn al-Harith, they were killed in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during the Battle of Badr.
hi: Beshak unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se nikah mein madad maangi, to aap (SAW) ne unka nikah aik aurat se karwaaya, phir unhone (mehr ke liye) kuch talaash kiya magar na paaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Raafi' (RA) aur Abu Ayyub (RA) ko apni zirah dekar bheja, unhone usse aik Yahoodi ke paas tees (30) saa' (paimana) jau ke badle girvi rakh diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne woh mujhe de diya, humne usme se aadha saal khaana khaaya, phir humne usse naapa, to humne use waisa hi paaya jaisa humne dakhil kiya tha. Naufal ne kaha: to maine yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ko bataaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum ise na naapte, to tum umr bhar usme se khaate rehte." Aur rahi baat Rabee'ah bin Al-Harith (RA) aur Ubaidah bin Al-Harith (RA) ki, to woh Badr mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne qatl kiye gaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "In the Battle of Badr, there were three hundred and thirteen men from the Quraysh and the Ansar who accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Among them were from the Bani Abdul Muttalib Ibn Abd Manaf, Ubaydah, At-Tufayl, and Husayn, the sons of Harith Ibn Abdul Muttalib. There was a disagreement regarding Rabiah Ibn Al-Harith, as some said that he lived after that and witnessed the days of Umar Ibn Al-Khattab. He also narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Az-Zahabi remained silent about him in his summary."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein, Quraish aur Ansar se, teen sau terah (313) mard the." Unhone kaha: "Aur Banu Abdul Muttalib bin Abd Manaf se, Ubaidah (RA), At-Tufail (RA), aur Husain (RA), Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib ke betay the, aur Rabee'ah bin Al-Harith ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kaha jaata hai ke woh iske baad zinda rahe aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke daur tak pahunche, aur Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat ki." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  received news that a group of people had criticized him and said to him, "The example of Muhammad is like that of a palm tree growing in a garbage heap." This angered the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he said, "O people, indeed Allah created His creation and divided them into two groups, and He made me part of the best of the two groups. Then He divided them into tribes, and He made me part of the best of the tribes. Then He made them into households, and He made me part of the best of the households." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am the best among you in lineage and the best among you in household." At this point, Al-Dhahabi remained silent in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) tak yeh baat pahunchi ke kuch log unke baare mein bura kehte hain, unhone kaha: "Muhammad ki misaal aik khajoor ke darakht jaisi hai jo kachre ke dher mein ugta hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghussa aaya, phir farmaya: "Aye logo, Allah ne apni makhlooq banaayi, unhein do giroh banaaya, mujhe unme se behtar giroh mein rakha, phir unhein qabeelon mein banaaya, mujhe unme se behtareen qabile mein rakha, phir unhein gharon mein banaaya, mujhe unme se behtareen ghar mein rakha." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tum mein qabeele ke aitbaar se aur ghar ke aitbaar se sabse behtar houn." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About Hisham ibn Al-Kalbi's narration that the Prophet ﷺ  said, "The first blood I shed in Islam is the blood of Rabi'ah ibn Al-Harith, who was being fostered by Bani Layth, and Hudhayl killed him." Hisham said, "Rabi'ah was not killed, as he lived after the Prophet's ﷺ  time until the caliphate of Umar. The one that Hudhayl killed was someone else." Al-Dhahabi excluded this narration from his summarization due to its weakness.
hi: Hisham bin Al-Kalbi se, Nabi (SAW) ke is farmaan ke baare mein: "Aur beshak sabse pehla khoon jo main (jaahiliyat ke daur ka) khatam karta houn woh Rabee'ah bin Al-Harith ka khoon hai, jo Banu Laith mein doodh pilaaye gaye the, unhein Huzail ne qatl kiya." Hisham ne kaha: "Rabee'ah qatl nahi huay, kyunke woh Nabi (SAW) ke baad Umar ki khilafat tak zinda rahe, aur jinhein Huzail ne qatl kiya woh koi aur the." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] He informed him that he had arrived in Sham during the time of Muawiyah, so some people from the people of Sham met him and said to him, "Aren't you a relative of Muadh?" He said, "I am his cousin." They said, "Shall we not inform you of a hadith that he narrated to us before his death but did not narrate to us before that?" So I said, "Yes." They said, "He narrated to us before his death that he heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'Whoever meets Allah without associating anything with Him will enter Paradise.'" Musa ibn Jubayr said, "So I narrated this hadith to Salman al-Farisi, and he said, 'I testify that Sa'id ibn al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib narrated to me a similar hadith from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, just as the people of Sham narrated from Muadh.'"
hi: Unhein bataya ke woh Mu'awiyah (RA) ke daur mein Sham gaye, to Sham ke kuch logon ne unse mulaqaat ki, unhone poocha: "Kya tumhari aur Mu'adh ki koi rishtedaari hai?" Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Chachazaad bhai." Unhone kaha: "Kya hum tumhein aik hadith na sunayen jo unhone apni maut se pehle humein sunayi, aur isse pehle humein nahi sunayi thi?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi." To unhone kaha: unhone apni maut se pehle humein bataya ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jo koi Allah se mile, usse shareek na theharaaye, woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga." Musa bin Jubair ne kaha: to maine Salman Al-Aghar ko Abu Umaamah (RA) ki yeh hadith sunayi, to unhone kaha: "Main gawahi deta houn ke mujhe Sa'eed bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib ne Rasulullah (SAW) se, waisi hi hadith sunayi thi jaisi Sham walon ne Mu'adh se sunayi."

e: [AI] "And among those who migrated from the people of Mecca to the land of Abyssinia (Ethiopia) from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-'As ibn Umayyah ibn 'Abd Shams ibn Umayyah ibn 'Abd Manaf, and with him his wife, who gave birth to his son Sa'id ibn Khalid in the land of Abyssinia."
hi: "Aur Makkah walon mein se Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se jo Habsha (Abyssinia) ki taraf hijrat karke nikle, unme Banu Umayyah bin Abd Shams se, Khalid bin Sa'eed bin Al-Aas bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams bin Abd Manaf the, unke sath unki biwi bhi thin, unhone Habsha ki zameen mein unke bete Sa'eed bin Khalid ko janam diya."

e: [AI] "The mother of Khalid ibn Said ibn Al-Aas, Lubaynah, commonly known as the mother of Khalid bint Hubab ibn Abd Yalil ibn Nusheeb ibn Ghayrah ibn Saad ibn Laith ibn Bakr ibn Abd Manat ibn Ali ibn Kinanah ibn Khuzaymah."
hi: "Khalid bin Sa'eed bin Al-Aas ki maa Lubainah thin, jo Umm Khalid bint Hubaab bin Abd Yaleel bin Naashib bin Ghairah bin Sa'd bin Laith bin Bakr bin Abd Manaat bin Ali bin Kinaanah bin Khuzaimah ke naam se maroof thin."

e: [AI] "Islam, the son of Khalid, was a long-time Muslim, and his first brother who accepted Islam was Aslam. The beginning of his Islam was that he saw in a dream that he was standing on the edge of the Fire, as if his father was pushing him away from it. He also saw that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was holding onto his waist, preventing him from falling. So he woke up in a panic and said, 'I swear by Allah, this is a true vision.' He then met Abu Bakr ibn Abi Quhafa and mentioned it to him. Abu Bakr said, 'I wish good for you. This is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Follow him, for you will surely follow him and enter Islam with him. Islam will protect you from entering it, and your father is already in it.' So Khalid met the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was in Ajyad, and he said to him, 'O Muhammad, why do you call people?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'I invite them to worship Allah alone, without associating partners with Him, and to testify that Muhammad is His slave and messenger. And I call them to abandon the worship of stones that neither harm nor benefit, and whose true nature is unknown to those who worship them.' Khalid said, 'Indeed, I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah.' He then sent his father to seek out his remaining children who had not yet embraced Islam, and he brought them to his father, Abu Uhayha. When Abu Uhayha saw them, he woke up and started crying, and he struck Khalid with a whip in his hand until he broke it on his head. Then he said, 'You have followed Muhammad while you see the opposition of his people and the disgrace of their previous gods.' Khalid said, 'By Allah, I have spoken the truth.' Abu Uhayha became angry and insulted him, and then he said, 'Go, Luka', wherever you like, and I swear by Allah, I will prevent you from your sustenance.' Khalid said, 'If you prevent me, then Allah will provide me with what I need to live.' So Abu Uhayha expelled him and said to his sons, 'Do not speak to him, and if any of you do, I will do to him what I did to him.' Khalid then went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who honored him and allowed him to stay with him."
hi: Khalid ka Islam bohot pehle ka tha, aur woh apne bhaiyon mein sabse pehle Musalman honay wale the, aur unke Islam ka aaghaaz yeh tha ke unhone khwaab mein dekha ke woh aag ke kinare khade hain, goya unke waalid unhein usme dhakel rahe hain, aur unhone dekha ke Rasulullah (SAW) unki kamar pakde huay hain, unhein girne nahi de rahe, to woh apni neend se ghabra kar uthe, unhone kaha: "Main Allah ki qasam khaata houn ke yeh khwaab zaroor sach hai." To unki mulaqaat Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhaafah se hui, unhone yeh unhein bataaya, to Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Main tumhare liye bhalaai chahta houn, yeh Rasulullah (SAW) hain, unki pairavi karo, kyunke tum zaroor unki pairavi karoge aur unke sath Islam mein dakhil hoge, aur Islam tumhein usme (aag mein) dakhil honay se rokega, jabke tumhare waalid usme pade honge." To unki mulaqaat Rasulullah (SAW) se hui, jabke woh Ajyaad mein the, unhone poocha: "Aye Muhammad, aap kis taraf bulaate hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main sirf Allah ki taraf bulaata houn, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, aur Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain, aur tum us patthar ki ibaadat chhod do jo na nuqsaan pahunchaa sakta hai na faayda, aur usse yeh bhi pata nahi kaun uski ibaadat karta hai aur kaun nahi karta." Khalid ne kaha: "To main gawahi deta houn ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta houn ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain," aur woh Musalman ho gaye. Unke waalid ne unhein dhoondne ke liye apne baaqi betay bheje jo abhi Musalman nahi huay the, aur unka aazaad kiya hua ghulam Raafi', unhone unhein paa liya, to woh unhein unke waalid Abu Uhaihah ke paas laaye, unhone unhein sakhti se dhataka aur unki malaamat ki, aur apne haath mein aik chaabuk se unhein maara yahan tak ke woh unke sar par toot gaya, phir kaha: "Tumne Muhammad ki pairavi ki jabke tum apni qaum ki mukhaalifat dekh rahe ho aur unhone unke devi-devton (buton) ki aur unke pehle guzre baap-daadon ki jo buraai ki hai?" To Khalid ne kaha: "Unhone sach kaha, Allah ki qasam, aur maine unki pairavi ki." To unke waalid Abu Uhaihah ko ghussa aaya, unhone unhein bura-bhala kaha aur gaali di, phir kaha: "Jao, Aye buddhu, jahan chaaho, Allah ki qasam, main zaroor tumhein khaana denay se rokunga." Khalid ne kaha: "Agar aap mujhe rokein, to Allah, buzurg aur buland, mujhe woh dega jisse main zinda rehunga." To unhone unhein nikaal diya aur apne betoon se kaha: "Tum mein se koi bhi unse baat na kare, warna main uske sath wohi karunga jo maine iske sath kiya." To Khalid Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf mudh gaye, to aap (SAW) unki izzat karte aur woh unke sath rehte. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] From him, al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "The successor, who was in the thirteenth year, said, 'The messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away while he was dealing with Yemen.'"
hi: Khaleefah ne kaha: "Yeh terah (13) hijri mein hua," unhone kaha: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal us waqt hua jab woh Yemen mein unke aamil (ameer) the."

e: [AI] "When the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  reached them, Abu Bakr said, 'No one is more worthy of carrying out the work than the workers of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Go back to your work.' They replied, 'We will not carry out any work after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  for anyone,' and they went out to the Levant and were killed, one after another."
hi: Unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ki khabar mili to unke kaamon ke baare mein, to Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke ameeron se zyada is kaam ka koi haqdaar nahi, apne kaamon ki taraf wapas jao." To unhone kaha: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad kisi aur ke liye kaam nahi karenge," to woh Sham (Syria) ki taraf nikle aur sab shaheed kiye gaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] That Abu Bakr is the one who invited him to Islam until he embraced it.
hi: Beshak Abu Bakr hi the jinhone unhein Islam ki dawat di, yahan tak ke woh Musalman ho gaye.

e: [AI] That Khaled Ibn Saeed, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent him to Yemen, he arrived after the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and waited for two months to pledge allegiance to Khaled Ibn Saeed. He said, "The Prophet ﷺ commanded me, but did not dismiss me until Allah Almighty took him. I met Ali Ibn Abi Talib and Othman Ibn Abd Manaf and said, "O sons of Abd Manaf, you have left yourselves out of your affairs, leaving it to others." Omar conveyed this to Abu Bakr, but Abu Bakr did not take it upon himself. However, Omar did and he sent troops to Sham (Greater Syria). The first person to lead one fourth of the troops was Khaled Ibn Saeed. Omar said, "Should I give instructions to him when he has already done what he did and said what he said?" Abu Bakr remained in power until he dismissed him and ordered Yazid Ibn Abi Sufyan, "Authentic according to the stipulations of Muslim, and he did not exclude it." This is the end of the quote.
hi: Beshak Khalid bin Sa'eed, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Yemen ka ameer banaaya, Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ke baad wapas aaye, aur do mahine tak apni baiyat dene mein intezaar karte rahe, kehte: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe ameer banaaya tha, phir unhone mujhe bartaraf nahi kiya yahan tak ke Allah ne unhein apni taraf bula liya." Unki mulaqaat Ali bin Abi Talib aur Uthman bin Abd Manaf se hui, unhone kaha: "Aye Banu Abd Manaf, tum apna maamla apni khwushi se doosron ko sonp doge?" To Umar (RA) ne yeh baat Abu Bakr (RA) tak pahunchaayi, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne isse unpar zimmedaari nahi thehraayi, magar Umar (RA) ne isse unpar zimmedaari thehraayi. Phir Abu Bakr (RA) ne Sham ki taraf fauj bheji, to unme se pehla shakhs jisse aik hisse par ameer banaaya gaya woh Khalid bin Sa'eed the, to Umar (RA) kehne lage: "Kya tum unhein ameer banaate ho jabke unhone yeh kiya aur yeh kaha?" To woh Abu Bakr (RA) ko manaate rahe yahan tak ke unhone unhein bartaraf kar diya aur Yazid bin Abi Sufyan (RA) ko ameer banaaya. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Yeh munqata' (isnad mein khaali jagah wala) hai.

e: [AI] I heard Ahmed ibn Sayyar saying, "Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-'As was born to his father Sa'id twenty sons and twenty daughters. As for Khalid ibn Sa'id, he was killed on the day of Marj al-Suffar in the month of Muharram in the year fourteen, during the Caliphate of Umar ibn al-Khattab."
hi: Maine Ahmad bin Sayyaar ko kehte suna: "Khalid bin Sa'eed bin Al-Aas, unke waalid Sa'eed ke bees (20) betay aur bees (20) betiyaan paida huay, aur rahi baat Khalid bin Sa'eed ki, to woh Marj As-Suffar ke din, Muharram, chaudah (14) hijri mein, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ki khilafat mein, qatl kiye gaye."

e: [AI] "He (someone) came to the Prophet ﷺ holding a ring in his hand. The Prophet ﷺ asked him, 'What is this ring?' He replied, 'It is a ring that I have obtained.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Throw it away.' So, I threw it towards him, and then it turned out to be an iron ring. The Prophet ﷺ asked, 'What did you engrave on it?' I replied, 'Muhammad, Rasul Allah (Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah).' The Prophet ﷺ took it and used it as his seal until he passed away. It was the ring that was in his hand. (Narrated by Yahya al-Hamani, considered weak)"
hi: Beshak woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, unke haath mein aik anguthi thi, to Nabi (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Yeh anguthi kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aik anguthi jo maine banwaayi hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isse phenk do." To maine woh unke taraf phenki, achaanak woh loha ki aik anguthi thi, to Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne isspar kya khodwaaya?" Maine kaha: "Muhammad Rasoolullah." To Nabi (SAW) ne usse le liya aur usse pehnte rahe yahan tak ke unka intiqaal hua, aur yehi woh anguthi thi jo unke haath mein thi. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Yahya Al-Himmaani kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "He came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he came from the land of Abyssinia, and with him was his daughter Umm Khalid. He brought her to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and she was wearing a yellow shirt that the girl liked because she understood some Abyssinian language. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ smiled at her using Abyssinian words and then said, 'Speak and create, speak and create.' She spoke, by Allah, and then she created. She then went to the back of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and placed her hand on the place of the Prophet's ring. Her father took it and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Leave her.' The chain of this narration is authentic. The two Shaykhs (Bukhari and Muslim) agreed to exclude the hadiths of Ishaq bin Sa'id bin Amr bin Sa'id from his father and ancestors in general. This is Umm Khalid bint Khalid bin Sa'id bin Al-'As, whom her father carried when she was a child to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She later became a companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and she narrated hadiths from him, although her narrations are discontinuous."
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye jab woh Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen se laute, unke sath unki beti Umm Khalid thin, unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaye, unpar aik peela qamees tha, ladki ko apna qamees bohot pasand tha, aur usne Habsha ki kuch baaten samajh li thin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse Habsha ki zubaan mein baat ki: "Sanah, sanah," jo Habsha ki zubaan mein 'achha, achha' ke maani rakhta hai, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: "Isse pehno aur ghisao, isse pehno aur ghisao." Unhone kaha: to Allah ki qasam, usne (kapda) pehna, phir ghisa, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ki peeth ki taraf jhuki aur apna haath Nabuwwat ki mohar ki jagah par rakh diya, to uske waalid ne usse pakad liya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise chhod do." Sahih isnad, dono Imamon (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne Ishaq bin Sa'eed bin Amr bin Sa'eed ki hadithein unke waalidain aur chachon se nikaalne par ittefaaq kiya hai, aur yeh Umm Khalid bint Khalid bin Sa'eed bin Al-Aas hain, jinhein unke waalid bachpan mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas lekar aaye, phir woh iske baad Rasulullah (SAW) ki sohbat mein rahin, aur unhone unse riwayat ki hai. Lekin yeh munqata' (isnad mein khaali jagah wala) hai.

e: [AI] "From the tribe of Zuhair, Safwan bin Makhrama bin Nawfal; his agnomen is Makhrama. He is the brother of Miswar bin Makhrama, and his mother is Atika bint Awf, the sister of Abdul Rahman bin Awf."
hi: "Aur Banu Zuhair se, Safwan bin Makhramah bin Naufal, jinke naam se Makhramah ki kunniyat rakhi jaati hai, aur woh Miswar bin Makhramah ke bhai hain, aur unki maa Aatikah bint Auf, Abdur Rahman bin Auf ki behn, thin."

e: The Messenger of Allah said: "When it is very hot, then wait for it to cool down before you pray, for intense heat is from the flaring up of the Hell-fire." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 678)
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zuhr ki namaz mein thandak ka intezaar karo, kyunke shadeed garmi Jahannam ki lapat se hai."

e: [AI] "About Al-Waqidi"
hi: Al-Waqidi se.

e: [AI] Then, Salama ibn Hisham escaped after that and caught up with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Madinah, and this was after the Battle of the Trench. His mother, Duba'ah bintu 'Amir ibn Qarazh ibn Salama ibn Qushair ibn Ka'ab ibn 'Amir ibn Rabee'ah [Al-Bahr Ar-Rajz], said, "They are the lords of the sanctified Kaaba, he shows his hand to every enemy, his hand that provides punishment for ambiguous matters and his hand that bestows favors." He continued to be with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then he went out with the Muslims to the Levant when Abu Bakr sent the armies for the jihad against the Romans. Salama was then martyred in Marj As-Suffar in the month of Muharram in the fourteenth year of the caliphate of 'Umar.
hi: Phir Salamah bin Hisham iske baad bach nikle, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Madinah aa milay, aur yeh Khandaq ke baad hua, to unki maa Dubaa'ah bint Aamir bin Qaraz bin Salamah bin Qushair bin Ka'b bin Aamir bin Rabee'ah ne (bahr Ar-Rajz mein) kaha: "Aye Ka'bah-e-Muhtaram ke Rab, Salamah ko har dushman par ghalba de, unke paas har mushkil maamle mein do haath hain, aik haath jo ata karta hai aur aik haath jo ehsaan karta hai." Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath rahe yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, phir woh Musalmano ke sath Sham (Syria) ki taraf nikle jab Abu Bakr ne Roomiyon se jihad ke liye lashkar bheje, to Salamah Marj As-Suffar mein, Muharram, chaudah (14) hijri mein, Umar (RA) ki khilafat mein, shaheed kiye gaye.

e: [AI] About 'Urwah, in the naming of the one who witnessed Al-'Aqabah from the Ansar of Banu Sa'dah ibn Ka'b ibn Al-Khazraj, Sa'd ibn 'Ubadah ibn Dulaim ibn Harithah ibn 'Ubaydah ibn Huzaymah, who was a Naqib (delegation leader) and participated in the Battle of Badr, Adh-Dhahabi excluded him due to his weakness in his summarization.
hi: Urwah se: "Ansar mein se Banu Sa'idah bin Ka'b bin Al-Khazraj se Aqabah mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Sa'd bin Ubadah bin Duleim bin Haarithah bin Ubaidah bin Huzaimah the, woh Naqeeb the, aur unhone Badr mein bhi shirkat ki." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Regarding Uruwah, in naming those who witnessed the Battle of Uhud, among the Banu Sa'ida bin Ka'b bin Al-Khazraj, Sa'd bin 'Ubadah (may Allah be pleased with him) carried the flag of the Ansar with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on the Day of Badr and other occasions. This was omitted by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness in the summarization.
hi: Urwah se: "Aqabah mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, aur Banu Sa'idah bin Ka'b bin Al-Khazraj se, Sa'd bin Ubadah, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr aur doosri jangon ke din Ansar ka jhanda uthaane wale the." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "That Saad ibn Ubadah ibn Duleim ibn Harithah ibn Al-Nu'man ibn Umm Huzaymah ibn Tha'labah ibn Tareef ibn Al-Khazraj ibn Sa'idah ibn Ka'b ibn Al-Khazraj." Al-Dhahabi removed it from his summary due to its weakness.
hi: "Beshak Sa'd bin Ubadah bin Duleim bin Haarithah bin An-Nu'man bin Abi Huzaimah bin Tha'labah bin Tareef bin Al-Khazraj bin Sa'idah bin Ka'b bin Al-Khazraj." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Sad ibn Ubada passed away, and he was also known as Abu Thabit from Hauran in the land of Sham (Syria) for two and a half years during the caliphate of Umar, and this was during the last fifteen years.
hi: "Sa'd bin Ubadah ka intiqaal hua, unki kunniyat Abu Thaabit thi, Hauraan mein, Sham ki zameen mein, Umar (RA) ki khilafat ke dhaai (2.5) saal baad, aur yeh pandrah (15) hijri ke aakhir mein hua."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Abdullah bin Bukair saying, "Saad bin Ubada died in Huran in the year sixteen."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Abdullah bin Bukair ko kehte suna: "Sa'd bin Ubadah ka intiqaal Hauraan mein solah (16) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] To me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Send to me twelve commanders." So, we sent to him Sa'd bin Ubada bin Dulaim bin Haritha bin Huzaima bin Tha'laba bin Tariif bin al-Khazraj bin Sa'da, who was a commander of the Banu Sa'dah. Al-Dhahabi excluded him from summarizing his weakness.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Mere paas baarah (12) Naqeeb (numainde) laao." To humne unhein Sa'd bin Ubadah bin Duleim bin Haarithah bin Huzaimah bin Tha'labah bin Tareef bin Al-Khazraj bin Sa'idah ko pesh kiya, aur woh Banu Sa'idah ke Naqeeb the. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] The Quraysh heard someone saying at night about Abu Qubays, "If Sa'dan (referring to two individuals) accepts Islam, Muhammad will be safe in Mecca and will not fear any opposing adversary." Quraysh thought that those two Sa'dans referred to were Sa'd ibn Mu'adh and Sa'd ibn 'Ubadah. When it was the second night, they heard him saying, "O Sa'd! O Sa'd of Aws! Be a supporter and O Sa'd! O Sa'd of Khazraj Al-Ghatarif! Respond to the caller of guidance and make dua to Allah for the paradise of the knowledgeable one in Firdaus. Indeed, the reward of Allah for the seeker of guidance is gardens of Firdaus with branches. When they woke up in the morning, Sufyan said, "I swear by Allah, it was Sa'd ibn Mu'adh and Sa'd ibn 'Ubadah." This was removed by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness in the summarization.
hi: Quraish ne aik pukaarne wale ki aawaaz suni, raat ko, Abu Qubais (pahaad) par, kehte huay (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Agar dono Sa'd Musalman ho jaayen, to Muhammad (SAW) subah Makkah mein hongay, kisi mukhaalif ke mukhaalfat se na darte huay." To Quraish ne samjha ke woh Sa'd Tameem aur Sa'd Huzaim honge. Jab doosri raat aayi, to unhone use kehte suna: "Aye Sa'd, Sa'd-e-Aus, tum madadgaar bano, aur Aye Sa'd, Sa'd-e-Khazraj ke izzat-daar sardaar, hidayat ki taraf bulaane wale ki dawat qubool karo, aur Allah se Firdaus mein waaqif ki tamanna maango, kyunke hidayat talaash karne wale ke liye Allah ka sawaab Firdaus ki Jannaten hain, jo saayadaar hain." Jab subah hui, to Sufyan ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) aur Sa'd bin Ubadah hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] The jinn [the fast sea] said, "We killed Saad bin Ubada, the leader of the Khazraj, and we struck him with two arrows, but it did not affect his heart."
hi: To jinnaat ne kaha (bahr As-Saree' mein): "Humne Khazraj ke sardaar, Sa'd bin Ubadah, ko qatl kiya, aur humne unhein do teeron se maara, jo unke dil se nahi chuke." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "I find something in my back, but it didn't take long for it to die, and the jinn wailed, saying, '[The Fast Camel]: We killed the leader of the Khazraj, Saad ibn Ubada, and we threw him with two arrows, but it did not pierce his heart." (Note: The last part of the sentence seems to be incorrect and is unclear, possibly due to a typing error or incomplete translation.)
hi: "Mujhe apni peeth mein kuch mehsoos ho raha hai," to unka intiqaal honay mein zyada der na lagi, to jinnaat ne maatam kiya aur kaha (bahr As-Saree' mein): "Humne Khazraj ke sardaar, Sa'd bin Ubadah, ko qatl kiya, aur humne unhein do teeron se maara, jo unke dil se nahi chuke." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] That when Abu Sufyan approached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , Abu Bakr spoke to him, but he turned away from him. Then Umar spoke to him, but he turned away from him as well. Sa'd bin 'Ubadah said, "O Messenger of Allah, I swear by the One in whose hand is my soul, if you command us to enter the sea, we will enter it and if you command us to strike the mountains, we will do so." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  requested the people, and they set out until they reached Badr. This narration is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim, but he did not include it in his collection. Al-Dhahabi omitted mentioning it in his summary.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ko jab Abu Sufyan ki aamad ki khabar mili, to Abu Bakr (RA) ne baat ki, aap (SAW) ne unse mun pher liya, phir Umar (RA) ne baat ki, aap (SAW) ne unse bhi mun pher liya, to Sa'd bin Ubadah ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar aap humein samandar mein utarne ka hukum dein, to hum utrenge, aur agar aap humein hukum dein ke hum in (jaanwaron) ke peeth ko Birk-ul-Ghimaad tak maaren, to hum aisa karenge." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne logon ko amaada kiya, to woh chal pade yahan tak ke Badr mein utre. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Sa'd ibn 'Ubadah used to say, "O Allah, grant me honor and glory, for there is no glory except through actions, and there are no actions except through wealth. O Allah, being insignificant does not benefit me, and I do not benefit others even if I were to call out upon deaf ears. Whoever desires fat and meat, let him come to Sa'd." (This narration was excluded by Al-Dhahabi from the summary due to its weakness.)
hi: Sa'd bin Ubadah kaha karte the: "Aye Allah, mujhe izzat de, aur izzat sirf amal se hoti hai, aur amal sirf maal se hota hai, Aye Allah, thodi cheez mujhe theek nahi rakhti, aur na main usspar theek rehta houn, agar koi buland jagah se pukaarne wala pukaare: jo koi chikni (ghee) aur gosht chaahe, woh Sa'd ke paas aaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "The polytheists took Saad bin Ubada and tied his hands to his neck, then they entered him into Mecca, hitting him and dragging him by his beard. He was a man with a long, thick beard." His deletion was mentioned by Al-Dhahabi in the summary due to his weakness.
hi: "Mushrikeen ne Sa'd bin Ubadah ko pakda, unka haath unki gardan se baandha, aur unhein Makkah mein dakhil kiya, unhein maarte aur unke baalon se ghaseetate huay, aur woh lambe baalon wale the." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] I asked the Prophet ﷺ, and he commanded me to fulfill it for her. It is agreed upon by the two sheikhs that this hadith should be excluded. Um Saad ibn Ubada passed away and they did not reach out to him regarding it, and this is considered authentic according to their condition.
hi: To maine Nabi (SAW) se poocha, "to unhone mujhe hukum diya ke main unki taraf se woh (nazar) poora karoon." Dono Imamon (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne is hadith ko nikaalne par ittefaaq kiya hai ke Sa'd bin Ubadah ki maa ka intiqaal hua tha aur unhone unki taraf se (nazar) poori nahi ki thi, aur yeh dono ki shart par sahih hai. Al-Madaaini kamzor hain.

e: [AI] Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim was the brother of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ through breastfeeding, and his cousin nursed him. Halimah nursed him for a few days, and he became familiar with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sent as a Prophet, Abu Sufyan opposed him and criticized him, and his companions did the same. He remained angry with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for twenty years, never leaving a place where the Quraysh went to fight against the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. However, in the year of the Conquest, Allah instilled Islam in his heart when the qualities of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were mentioned to him in Makkah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ accepted him as a Muslim before he descended from Abu Awa. Abu Sufyan, his son Ja'far, and he accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and witnessed the Conquest of Makkah and the Battle of Hunayn. Abu Sufyan said, "When we encountered the enemy at Hunayn, I charged on my horse with my sword in my hand, swearing by Allah that I desired death except for him, while he was looking at me. Abbas called out, 'O Messenger of Allah, this is your brother and your cousin, Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith. Accept his apology.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'I have forgiven him; may Allah forgive him for all the enmity he showed towards me.' Then, he turned towards me and said, 'O my brother, by my life,' and I kissed his foot in the stirrup." It is said that Abu Sufyan passed away in Madinah after his brother Nawfal ibn al-Harith, four months and thirteen nights after him. Others say he passed away in the twentieth year. Umar ibn al-Khattab led the funeral prayer for him, and he was buried in the cemetery of al-Baqi in the grave that Aqil ibn Abi Talib had dug for himself three days before he died. "I have mentioned the Islam of my father Sufyan in the Conquest of Makkah, as previously mentioned." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in his summary.
hi: Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim, Rasulullah (SAW) ke doodh-shareek bhai aur chachazaad bhai the, unhein Haleemah ne kuch dinon tak doodh pilaaya tha, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) se ghul-mil gaye the. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ko Nabi banaya gaya, to unhone unse dushmani ki, unki hijw (bura-bhala kehne wali shairi) kahi, aur unke sahaba ki bhi hijw kahi, to woh bees (20) saal tak Rasulullah (SAW) se naaraaz rahe, koi bhi aisi jagah nahi chhodi jahan Quraish Rasulullah (SAW) se jung ke liye jaate. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki Makkah ki taraf Fatah ke saal rawaangi ka zikr hua, to Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne unke dil mein Islam daal diya, to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se Al-Abwaa mein utarne se pehle mulaqaat ki, to woh aur unke bete Ja'far Musalman ho gaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath nikle, to unhone Fatah-e-Makkah aur Hunain mein shirkat ki. Abu Sufyan ne kaha: "Jab hum Hunain mein dushman se mile, to main apne ghode se utra, mere haath mein nangi talwaar thi, aur Allah jaanta hai ke main uske aage marna chahta tha, jabke woh mujhe dekh rahe the." To Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh aapke bhai aur aapke chachazaad hain, Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith, unse raazi ho jaayen." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine kar diya, Allah unhein har us dushmani ke liye maaf kare jo unhone mujhse ki." Phir mere taraf mudhe aur farmaya: "Mere bhai, meri jaan ki qasam." To maine unka pair rakaab mein choom liya. Unhone kaha: "Aur Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith ka intiqaal Madinah mein, apne bhai Naufal bin Al-Harith ke chaar (4) mahine kam terah (13) raatein baad hua, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke unka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein hua, aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur unhein Aqeel bin Abi Talib (RA) ke ghar mein, Baqee' mein, dafan kiya gaya, aur woh khud the jinhone apni qabr apni maut se teen (3) din pehle khudi thi." "Maine Abu Sufyan ke Islam ka zikr Fatah-e-Makkah mein pehle kiya hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir say, "Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib, whose name was al-Mughirah, passed away in the year twenty. Umar ibn al-Khattab performed the funeral prayer for him."
hi: Maine Ibrahim bin Al-Mundhir ko kehte suna: "Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib ka naam Al-Mugheerah tha, unka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein hua, aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi."

e: [AI] "Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib was the most beloved person to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the Quraysh, and he was harsh with him. But when he embraced Islam, he became the most beloved person to the people."
hi: "Beshak Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib Quraish mein Rasulullah (SAW) ko sabse zyada aziz the, aur unpar sakht the, jab woh Musalman huay, to woh logon mein unhein sabse zyada aziz ban gaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith is the best among my family." It is authentic according to the condition of Muslim and al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith mere ghar walon mein sabse behtareen hain." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "The chief of the boys of Paradise is Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib." He said, "He got his hair trimmed in Mina, and there were lice in his head, so he cut it off and died. It is believed that he is a martyr." Adh-Dhahabi did not mention it in the abridgment.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat ke jawaanon ke sardaar Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib hain." Unhone kaha: "Hajjaam ne unke baal Mina mein katey, unke sar par aik masse (thulool) tha, usne usse kaat diya, to unka intiqaal ho gaya, to log samajhte hain ke woh shaheed hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I witnessed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on the day of Hunayn. I saw him with no one except me and Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib. He was holding the reins of the Messenger of Allah's mule while he was riding it, and Abu Sufyan was eager to rush towards the polytheists." This hadith is authentic according to the criteria of the two Shaykhs (i.e., Abu Bakr and Umar), but it has not been included in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain ke din maujood tha, maine unhein dekha, aur unke sath sirf main aur Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib the, woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke khachchar ki lagaam pakde huay the jabke aap (SAW) usspar sawaar the, aur Abu Sufyan mushrikeen ki taraf tezi se badhne mein koi kasar nahi chhodte the." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] A man had some dates with him and he brought them to the Prophet ﷺ to sell them. The Prophet ﷺ borrowed some dates from Bint Hakeem and gave them to the man. Then he said, "I had some dates with me, but they were dry". Then he said, "This is how the believing servants of Allah are, and Allah does not have mercy on a nation in which the strong do not give the weak their rights without being harsh". Abu Sufyan did not narrate anything from the Prophet ﷺ except this one hadith, and he did not establish its chain of narration except from Shu'ba, other than Ghundar. Abu Al-Abbas As-Sayyari informed us, Abu Al-Muwajih informed me, and I am Abdan. My father narrated to me from Shu'ba, from Samaak, who said, "We were with Mudrik ibn Al-Muhallab in Sijistan, and I heard an elderly man narrating from Abu Sufyan ibn Al-Harith, from the Prophet ﷺ, so he mentioned him and did not hear Abdullah ibn Abu Sufyan narrating anything from his father".
hi: Aik aadmi ka Nabi (SAW) par khajoor ka qarz tha, woh unse taqaaza karne aaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne Khaulah bint Hakeem se khajoor udhaar li, unhein woh de di, aur farmaya: "Beshak mere paas khajoorein thin, lekin woh Atharee (aik khaas qism, kachi/kamzor) thin." Phir farmaya: "Isi tarah Allah ke momin banday karte hain, aur beshak Allah kisi aisi Ummat par reham nahi karta jismein kamzor apna haq mazboot se, bina kisi ruk-aawat ke, na le sake." Abu Sufyan ne Nabi (SAW) se is aik hadith ke siwa aur kuch riwayat nahi ki, aur Shu'bah se Ghundar ke siwa kisi aur ne iski isnad qaayam nahi ki, humein Abu Al-Abbas As-Sayyaari ne bataya, humein Abu Al-Muwajjih ne bataya, humein Abdaan ne bataya, mujhe mere waalid ne Shu'bah se, unhone Simaak se hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: hum Sijistaan mein Mudrik bin Al-Muhallab ke sath the, maine aik buzurg ko Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith se, Nabi (SAW) ke hawaale se, hadith bayan karte suna, unhone zikr ki, aur Abdullah bin Abi Sufyan ne apne waalid se (yeh) nahi suni.

e: [AI] "And from the offspring of Al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib was Abu Sufyan ibn Al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib who accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, 'Indeed, he is among the best of my family.' And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, he is the leader of the young men of the people of Paradise.' He showed patience with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during the battle of Hunayn. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw him in the darkness of the morning and said, 'Who is this?' He replied, 'I am the son of your mother, O Messenger of Allah.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'He had his hair cut by the barber, and he only cut a tuft of hair from his head, and no blood came out. He continued like that until he passed away, and this was in the year twenty. Umar ibn Al-Khattab prayed the funeral prayer for him, and he used to meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on a certain route, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was going out to Makkah for the conquest. He embraced Islam before the conquest."
hi: Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki sohbat ikhtiyar karne walon mein, Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib ki aulaad se, Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib the, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Beshak woh mere ghar walon mein se behtareen hain," aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak woh Jannat ke ahl ke jawaanon ke sardaar hain," aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain ke din sabr kiya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein subah ke dhundhle andhere mein dekha, poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aapki maa ka beta, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Unhone kaha: "Hajjaam ne unke baal katey, unke sar se aik masse ko kaata, to khoon nahi ruka yahan tak ke unka intiqaal ho gaya, aur yeh bees (20) hijri mein hua, aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se rasty mein mulaqaat ki thi jabke Rasulullah (SAW) Fatah ke liye Makkah ki taraf nikal rahe the, to unhone Fatah se pehle Islam qubool kar liya tha."

e: [AI] "Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib, his name is al-Mughira, died in the year twenty and was prayed upon by Umar ibn al-Khattab."
hi: "Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib ka naam Al-Mugheerah tha, unka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein hua, aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah does not bless a nation in which the weak are not able to claim their rights from the strong, and the strong are not just and fair." So, the old man whom Uthman bin Jabala did not mention, but Shu'bah mentioned him from Simak, named him Ghundar, except that he did not mention Abu Sufyan in the chain.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah kisi aisi Ummat ko paak nahi karta jismein kamzor apna haq mazboot se, bina kisi ruk-aawat ke, na le sake." To woh buzurg jinka naam Uthman bin Jabalah ne Shu'bah se, unhone Simaak se, nahi liya, Ghundar ne unka naam liya, magar unhone isnad mein Abu Sufyan ka zikr nahi kiya.

e: [AI] A man had some dates with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he came to him to offer them to him. The Prophet ﷺ borrowed some dates from Khawlah bint Hakim and gave them to him, saying, "I used to have some dates with me, but they were not good. This is how the believing servants of Allah behave. Indeed, Allah does not show mercy to a nation where the weak are not given their right without justice being tampered with."
hi: Aik aadmi ka Rasulullah (SAW) par khajoor ka qarz tha, woh unse taqaaza karne aaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne Khaulah bint Hakeem se khajoor udhaar li, unhein woh de di, aur farmaya: "Beshak mere paas khajoorein thin, lekin woh Atharee (kachi/kamzor) thin." Phir farmaya: "Isi tarah Allah ke momin banday karte hain, beshak Allah kisi aisi Ummat par reham nahi karta jismein kamzor apna haq bina kisi ruk-aawat ke na le sake."

e: [AI] "I was lifted to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while I was still a child, and I had a torn garment and my private parts were exposed. He said, 'Cover the private parts of the small boy, for the sanctity of the private parts of a small boy is like that of a grown-up. And Allah does not look at the one who exposes their private parts.' The chain of narration for this hadith is weak, and its content is rejected."
hi: "Mujhe bachpan mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas uthaakar laaya gaya, mujhpar aik phata-purana kapda tha, aur meri sharam-gaah khuli hui thi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: iski sharam-gaah ki hurmat dhaanpo, kyunke chhote bacche ki sharam-gaah ki hurmat bade ki sharam-gaah ki hurmat jaisi hai, aur Allah kisi bhi sharam-gaah khol dene wale ki taraf nazar-e-rehmat nahi daalta." Isnad mubham (na-saaf) hai aur matan (mazmoon) munkar hai.

e: [AI] About Urwah, "Among those who migrated to the land of Habasha (Ethiopia) along with Ja'far, from the tribe of Bani Zuhrah ibn Kilab, was 'Utbah ibn Mas'ud and his brother 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud."
hi: Urwah se: "Jinhone Ja'far ke sath Habsha (Abyssinia) ki taraf hijrat ki, unme Banu Zuhrah bin Kilaab se, Utbah bin Mas'ood (RA) aur unke bhai Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) the."

e: [AI] "My brother and companion is with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the third is the most beloved person to me, except for Umar ibn Al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, whose chain of narration is authentic."
hi: "Mera bhai aur saathi Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath hain, aur teesra, aur logon mein mujhe sabse zyada aziz, siwaye Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke." Isnad sahih hai.

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Mas'ud is not higher in rank with us than his brother ibn Mas'ud, but he died quickly.
hi: "Abdullah bin Mas'ood humare nazdeek apne bhai Utbah bin Mas'ood se buland nahi, lekin woh (Utbah) jaldi faut ho gaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed the Fajr prayer, then he leaned on his hand in front of him. A man from the people asked him after he finished the prayer, so he said, "The Shaytan came and I seized him, and if I had taken him, I would have tied him to a pillar of the mosque until the children of Madinah circled around him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Fajr ki namaz padhne khade huay, unhone apna haath apne saamne badhaaya, to qaum mein se aik aadmi ne unse namaz khatm honay par poocha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shaitan aaya, maine usse dhataka, aur agar main usse pakad leta, to main use masjid ke sutoonon mein se aik sutoon se baandh deta yahan tak ke Madinah ke bachche uske ird-gird ghoomte."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya ibn Bukair saying, "Utba ibn Mas'ud passed away in the year forty-four." And he has one hadith.
hi: Maine Yahya bin Bukair ko kehte suna: "Utbah bin Mas'ood ka intiqaal chauwalees (44) hijri mein hua," aur unki sirf aik hadith hai.

e: [AI] A woman came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with a black slave. She said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have a believing slave. Should I free her?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "Who is your Lord?" She replied, "My Lord is Allah." He asked, "What is your religion?" She said, "Islam." He then asked, "Who am I?" She replied, "You are the Messenger of Allah." He said, "Then free her." Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Mas'ud witnessed this incident and heard it from the Prophet ﷺ . Al-Dhahabi omitted mentioning it in his summarization.
hi: Aik aurat Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik kaali laundi lekar aayi, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhpar aik momin gardan (ghulam aazaad karne ka nazar) hai, kya yeh mere liye kaafi hogi?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Tera Rab kaun hai?" Usne kaha: "Mera Rab Allah hai." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tera deen kya hai?" Usne kaha: "Islam." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Main kaun houn?" Usne kaha: "Aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tu paanch (waqt ki) namaz padhti hai aur usse maanti hai jo main Allah ki taraf se lekar aaya houn?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." To aap (SAW) ne uski peeth par haath maara aur farmaya: "Isse aazaad kar do." Aur Abdullah bin Utbah bin Mas'ood (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ko paaya aur unse suna. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard my father Hamza ibn Abdullah saying, "I asked my father Abdullah ibn Uthba ibn Masood, 'What do you remember from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?' He replied, 'I remember that he took me when I was five or six years old and made me sit in his lap. Then he wiped my head and prayed for me and my descendants with blessings.'" Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Maine mere waalid Hamzah bin Abdullah ko kehte suna: maine apne waalid Abdullah bin Utbah bin Mas'ood se poocha: "Aapko Rasulullah (SAW) se kya yaad hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe yaad hai ke unhone mujhe liya jabke main paanch (5) ya chhah (6) saal ka tha, mujhe apni god mein bithaaya, mera sar sahlaaya, aur mere aur meri aulaad ke liye barkat ki dua ki." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He is called Al-Nahham, and he is called that because the Prophet ﷺ  said, "I heard a voice of joy in Paradise." And Al-Nahham means the voice.
hi: Unhein An-Nahhaam kaha jaata hai, aur unhein isliye yeh kaha gaya kyunke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine Jannat mein Nu'aim (RA) ki nahmah (khush-o-khurram aawaaz) suni." Aur Nahmah ka matlab aawaaz hai.

e: [AI] "And that is the year thirteen "
hi: "Aur yeh terah (13) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] The caller of the Prophet ﷺ  called for prayer on a night that was cold, while I was under my blanket. I wished that Allah Almighty would cast it on his tongue without any difficulty or hardship. When he finished, he said, "Without any difficulty or hardship." The chain of narration is authentic, and it has not been reported in a Sahih Hadith.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke muazzin ne aik raat azaan di jismein sardi thi, jabke main apne lihaaf ke neeche tha, to maine tamanna ki ke Allah Ta'ala unki zubaan par 'wa la haraj' (aur koi harj/mushkil nahi) daal de, jab woh faarigh huay, to unhone kaha: "wa la haraj." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "At-Tufayl ibn Amr embraced Islam and followed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in Makkah. Then he returned to his people in the land of Daws and remained there until he migrated to Madinah after the battles of Badr, Uhud, and the Battle of the Trench, when he came with those who embraced Islam from his people. He caught up with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the Battle of Khaybar and contributed with the Muslims."
hi: "At-Tufail bin Amr (RA) Musalman huay aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki pairavi Makkah mein ki, phir apni qaum ke paas, Daws ki zameen mein, wapas gaye, aur wahin muqeem rahe yahan tak ke Badr, Uhud, aur Khandaq ke baad Madinah ki taraf hijrat ki, jab woh apni qaum mein se Musalman honay walon ke sath aaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) Khaibar mein the, phir woh Rasulullah (SAW) se Khaibar mein aa milay, to aap (SAW) ne unhein Musalmano ke sath hissa diya."

e: [AI] We said, "O Messenger of Allah, make us on your right side and make our banner, O preferred one." So he did, and until this day, the banner of the lions, all of them, O preferred one. Authentic chain of narration, and it was not mentioned that it is fabricated, as 'Amr ibn al-Tufayl ibn 'Amr had witnessed the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, correctly being a messenger.
hi: Humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein apna dayan hissa (maimanah) banaayen, aur humara nishaan 'Ya Mabroor' rakhein." To aap (SAW) ne aisa hi kiya, aur aaj tak sab sheron (Asad qabile) ka nishaan "Ya Mabroor" hai. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala agar yeh mursal na ho, aur Amr bin At-Tufail bin Amr (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko paaya. Sahih, Mursal.

e: [AI] "And Amr bin Tufayl bin Amr bin Tarif bin Al-Aas bin Tha'labah Al-Azdi, and his father was Tufayl bin Amr. He was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  until he passed away. When the Arabs apostatized, he went out and fought until the Muslims were successful in the battle of Tulayha and the land of Najd. Then he accompanied the Muslims to the Battle of Yamamah, and his son Amr bin Tufayl went out and was wounded and his hand was cut off. Then his hand healed and he went to Umar ibn al-Khattab while he was with him. When food was brought, Umar moved away from it, so he asked, "Why did you move away from where your hand is?" He replied, "Yes, indeed. By Allah, I will not taste it until it is beaten with your hand." Umar said, "No, by Allah, no one from among the people except you will take pleasure in Paradise." Then he went out in the year of Yarmouk during the reign of Umar, with the Muslims, and he was martyred."
hi: Aur Amr bin At-Tufail bin Amr bin Tareef bin Al-Aas bin Tha'labah Al-Azdi, unke waalid At-Tufail bin Amr Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath rahe yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, jab Arab murtad huay, to woh nikle aur jihad karte rahe yahan tak ke Musalmano ne Tulaihah aur poore Najd ki zameen se faarigh ho liye, phir Musalmano ke sath Yamamah ki taraf gaye, unke sath unka beta Amr bin At-Tufail bhi tha, to Amr bin At-Tufail nikle, zakhmi huay, aur unka haath kaat diya gaya, phir woh theek ho gaye aur unka haath saheeh ho gaya. Aik din woh Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke paas the ke khaana laaya gaya, to woh usse hat gaye, Umar (RA) ne poocha: "Tumhein kya hua tum apne haath ki jagah se hat gaye?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main ise nahi chakhunga jab tak tum apna haath usme na daalo, Allah ki qasam, qaum mein koi bhi aisa nahi jiska kuch hissa Jannat mein ho siwaye tumhare." Phir woh Yarmook ke saal, Umar (RA) ke daur mein, Musalmano ke sath nikle aur shaheed hokar qatl kiye gaye, unpar Allah ki rehmat ho.

e: [AI] He is called Saad al-Qari, and his nickname is Abu Zaid. He is one of the six companions who memorized the Quran during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He witnessed the battles of Badr, Uhud, the Trench, and all other battles along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He was martyred on the day of Qadisiyah in the year sixteen, at the age of sixty-four.
hi: Unhein Sa'd Al-Qaari kaha jaata hai, aur unki kunniyat Abu Zaid hai, aur woh un chhah (6) logon mein se aik hain jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke daur mein Quran jama kiya, unhone Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur woh Qaadisiyyah ke din, solah (16) hijri mein, shaheed hokar qatl kiye gaye, jabke woh chausath (64) saal ke thay.

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic text is as follows:

"Utba bin Ghazwan bin Jabir bin Wuhayb bin Nasib bin Malik bin Al-Harith bin Mazen bin Mansour bin Ikrima bin Khasafa bin Qays Aylan bin Mudar bin Nizar."
hi: "Utbah bin Ghazwan bin Jaabir bin Wuhaib bin Naseeb bin Malik bin Al-Harith bin Maazin bin Mansoor bin Ikrimah bin Khasafah bin Qais Aylaan bin Mudar bin Nizaar."

e: [AI] About his elders mentioning Umar ibn Ghazwan, they said, "His nickname was Abu Abdullah, and it was also said Abu Ghazwan. He was mentioned as a tall, handsome man and he was a Muslim since early times. He migrated to the land of Abyssinia during the second migration. He was among the known archers and among the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He was the one who conquered Basra. He died during the caliphate of Umar ibn al-Khattab in Bani Salim mines while he was heading towards Basra as its governor, appointed by Umar ibn al-Khattab. His servant Sued presented Umar with his possessions and left." Ibn Umar said, "Umar ibn Ghazwan died in the fifteenth or seventeenth year. It is said he was fifty-seven years old."
hi: Unke buzurgon se, Utbah bin Ghazwan ke zikr mein, unhone kaha: "Unki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai Abu Ghazwan, aur zikr kiya gaya hai ke woh aik lambe, khoobsurat aadmi the, unka Islam bohot pehle ka tha, aur unhone Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen ki taraf doosri hijrat ki, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se maroof teer-andaazon mein se the, aur woh hi the jinhone Basrah ko basaaya (basaayaa - shehar ki bunyaad rakhi), aur unka intiqaal Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ki khilafat mein, Banu Sulaim ki khaan mein hua, jabke woh Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ki taraf se Basrah ke wali (ameer) banke wahan ja rahe the, to unka ghulam Suwaid unka saamaan aur unka tarikah (chhoda hua maal) lekar Umar (RA) ke paas aaya." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Aur Utbah bin Ghazwan ka intiqaal pandrah (15) hijri mein hua, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai satrah (17), jabke woh sattaawan (57) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] "That Uthba bin Ghazwan witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Beshak Utbah bin Ghazwan ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki."

e: [AI] "Utbah bin Ghazwan died in the year seventeen and he was seventy-five years old."
hi: "Utbah bin Ghazwan ka intiqaal satrah (17) hijri mein hua, aur unka intiqaal us waqt hua jab woh sattaawan (57) saal ke thay."

e: 'Utba b. Ghazwan delivered us a sermon and he praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: Now coming to the point, verily the world has been given the news of its end and that too quite early. Nothing would be left out of it but only water left in the utensil which its owner leaves, and you are going to shift to an abode which knows no end, and you should shift with the good before you, for we have been told that a stone would be thrown at one side of the Hell and it would go down even for seventy years but would not be able to reach its bottom. By Allah, it would be fully packed. Do you find it something strange, and it has been mentioned that there yawns a distance which one would be able to cover in forty years from one end to another of Paradise, and a day would come when it would be fully packed and you must be knowing that I was the seventh amongst seven who had been with Messenger of Allah ﷺ and we had nothing to eat but the leaves of the tree until the corners of the mouth were injured. We found a sheet which we tore in two and divided between myself and Sa'd b. Malik. I made the lower garment with halt of it and so did Sa'd make the lower garment with half of it and today there is none amongst us who has not become the governor of a city from amongst the cities (of the Islamic Commonwealth) and I seek refuge with Allah that I should consider myself great whereas I am insignificant in the eye of Allah. Prophethood does not remain for ever and its impact fades with the result that it changes eventually into kingship, and you would soon come to know and experience those rulers who would come after us and see (how far they are from religion). (Using translation from Muslim 2967a)
hi: Utbah bin Ghazwan ne humein khutba di, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir kaha: "Ammaa ba'd, beshak duniya ne apni khatam honay ki khabar de di hai, aur woh peeth phair kar chali gayi hai, aur usme se sirf itna baaqi bacha hai jitna aik bartan mein tali hui matra jise uska maalik ulta deta hai, aur beshak tum ismein se aik aise ghar ki taraf mun karne wale ho jise kabhi zawaal nahi, isliye ismein se apne sath behtareen cheez lekar mun karo, kyunke humein bataya gaya hai ke aik patthar Jahannam ke kinare se giraaya jaata hai, to woh sattar (70) saal tak girta rehta hai aur uski tah tak nahi pahunchta, aur Allah ki qasam, woh (Jahannam) zaroor bhar jaayegi, kya tumhein ta'ajjub hua? Aur humein bataya gaya hai ke Jannat ke do darwazon ke beech chaalis (40) saal (ki masaafat) hai, aur zaroor aik din aisa aayega jab woh bheed ki wajah se bhar jaayegi.
