Aur maine khud ko dekha hai, main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath saat (7) mein se saatvaan tha, humare paas khaane ke liye siwaye darakhton ke patton ke kuch nahi tha, yahan tak ke humare mun zakhmi ho gaye, aur maine aik chaadar uthaayi, usse apne aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA), Islam ke ghudsawaar, ke darmiyan phaad diya, main uske aadhe hisse ka tehband baandhta aur Sa'd (RA) uske aadhe hisse ka, aur aaj humme se koi bhi zinda nahi bacha jo kisi shehar ka ameer na bana ho, aur main Allah ki panaah maangta houn ke main apni nazar mein bada aur Allah ki nazar mein chhota houn, aur kabhi koi Nubuwwat aisi nahi hui jo kam na hui ho yahan tak ke uska anjaam badshaahat mein badal jaaye, aur tum ankareeb humare baad ameeron ko azma-oge ya perakh-oge." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to the people of Quraysh one day, "Is there anyone among you besides yourselves?" They said, "Our cousin, Utbah ibn Ghazwan." He said, "The cousin of a people is considered one of them." Mentioning Utbah ibn Ghazwan in this hadith is very unusual and it has many virtues. This is why his virtues and narrations from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  are abundant. We have written a hadith about it that we found very surprising. Although it is not a condition for its inclusion in this book, its chain has some obscurities.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din Quraish se poocha: "Kya tum mein tumhare siwa koi aur hai?" Unhone kaha: "Humari behn ka beta, Utbah bin Ghazwan." To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qaum ki behn ka beta unme se hi hota hai." Is hadith mein Utbah bin Ghazwan ka zikr bohot ajeeb-o-ghareeb hai, aur unke fazaail bohot hain, aur yeh unke bade fazaail mein se hai, aur Utbah bin Ghazwan ki Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayten kam-yaab hain, aur humne ismein se aik hadith likhi hai jo humein bohot ajeeb lagi, isliye main isse zikr kar rahi houn, agarche Al-Ghalaabi is kitaab ki shart mein na ho. Isnad andhera/na-saaf hai.

e: ‘Whoever lies upon me intentionally, then let him take his seat in the Fire’. (Using translation from Muslim 3)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jisne mere baare mein jaan-boojh kar jhoot bola, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le."

e: [AI] "Abu Ubaidah Amer bin Abdullah bin Al-Jarrah bin Hilal bin Ahya bin Dabbah bin Al-Harith bin Fihr bin Malik bin Al-Nadr bin Kinanah, and his mother is Umm Ghanim bint Jabir bin Al-Adl bin Amer bin Umairah bin Wari'ah bin Al-Harith bin Fihr."
hi: "Abu Ubaidah Aamir bin Abdullah bin Al-Jarraah bin Hilaal bin Ahyab bin Dabbah bin Al-Harith bin Fihr bin Malik bin An-Nadr bin Kinaanah, aur unki maa Umm Ghanam bint Jaabir bin Al-Adl bin Aamir bin Umairah bin Wari'ah bin Al-Harith bin Fihr thin."

e: [AI] It could be translated as: "Khalifa ibn Khayyat praised this lineage."
hi: Khaleefah bin Khayyaat ne humein hadith bayan ki, phir yeh nasab (khaandaan) zikr kiya.

e: [AI] Omar said to his companions, "Wish for something." So every man among them wished for something, and Omar said, "But I wish for a house filled with men like Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah." They said to him, "Why didn't you ask for something better for Islam?" He replied, "That is what I wanted."
hi: Umar (RA) ne apne sahaba se kaha: "Tamanna karo." To har aadmi kisi cheez ki tamanna karne laga, unhone kaha: "Lekin main aik ghar ki tamanna karta houn jo Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah jaise mardon se bhara ho." To unhone unse kaha: "Aapne Islam ke liye kuch kam nahi chaha." Unhone kaha: "Yehi mera iraada tha."

e: [AI] Abdullah used to say that my close friends among the companions of the Prophet were three, but not Abu Bakr, Umar, and Abu Ubaidah.
hi: Abdullah kaha karte the: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se mere teen khaas dost the, aur maine unme koshish mein koi kami nahi ki - Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Abu Ubaidah."

e: [AI] Omar's book came to us when the pandemic occurred in Sham (Syria), so Omar wrote to Abu Ubaidah that there is a need that cannot be fulfilled by anyone but him. Abu Ubaidah replied, "May Allah have mercy on the Amir (leader) of the believers, he wants to keep a people who are not remaining." He then wrote back to him saying, "I am in one of the Muslim armies, and I do not prioritize myself over those who are affected by the pandemic." When he read the book, he reconsidered and said, "Abu Ubaidah has passed away." He said, "No, he wrote to him with determination to come from the land of Jordan, as it is deep and fertile, to the land of Al-Jabiya, as it is a fresh and beautiful place." When the book arrived with determination, he ordered his caller to announce to the people to depart. When he arrived to ride his mount, he placed his leg in the stirrup, then he pulled it back and said, "I see your disease only afflicting me." He said, "Abu Ubaidah passed away and the pandemic receded from the people. All the narrators of this Hadith are trustworthy, and it is a strange incident."
hi: Jab Sham mein wabaa (plague) phaili, to humare paas Umar (RA) ka khat aaya, Umar (RA) ne Abu Ubaidah ko likha: "Mujhe tumhare paas aik kaam pesh aaya hai jiske bina main tumhare bagair nahi reh sakta." To Abu Ubaidah ne kaha: "Allah Ameer-ul-Momineen par reham kare, woh un logon ki zindagi chahte hain jo baaqi nahi rehne wale." Unhone kaha: phir Abu Ubaidah ne unhein likha: "Main Musalmano ke aik lashkar mein houn, main apni jaan ko unpar tarjeeh nahi dena chahta jo unpar aayi hai." Jab Umar (RA) ne khat padha, to unhone "Inna lillah" padha, log kehne lage: "Abu Ubaidah faut ho gaye?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Aur unhone unhein pukhta hukum ke sath likha tha: "Jordan ki zameen se nikal aao, kyunke woh neechi aur bimaar-daar hai, Al-Jaabiyah ki zameen ki taraf, kyunke woh khush-manzar, taazgi-bhari hai." Jab pukhta hukum wala khat unke paas pahuncha, to unhone apne mun-aadi ko hukum diya, unhone logon mein rawaana honay ka elaan kiya. Jab unki sawaari laayi gayi taake woh usspar sawaar hon, unhone apna pair rikaab mein rakha, apna pair mudka aur kaha: "Mujhe nahi lagta tumhari bimaari mujhpar bhi asar-andaaz ho chuki hai." Unhone kaha: aur Abu Ubaidah faut ho gaye, aur wabaa logon se hat gayi. Is hadith ke tamaam raawi bharosemand hain, aur yeh bohot ajeeb-o-ghareeb hai. Shaykhain ki shart par.

e: [AI] He was stabbed, so Abu Ubaydah showed him the wound in his hand. I tended to his wound and part of it came out when he saw it. Abu Ubaydah then swore to him by Allah that he would give him a place like it in paradise. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Unhein neze se zakhmi kiya gaya, to Abu Ubaidah ne unhein woh zakhm dikhaya jo unki hatheli mein tha, main usse chheda, unhein dekh kar dukh hua aur woh (khoon dekhkar) khaufzada huay, to Abu Ubaidah ne unse Allah ki qasam khaayi ke woh isse behtar samajhte hain (yeh zakhm) surkh oonton (behtareen maal-o-daulat) se badalne se. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] "O people, repent to Allah from your sins with a sincere repentance. Indeed, Allah's servant does not meet Allah while repenting from his sins except that it is obligatory upon Allah to forgive him." Then he said, "Verily, you O people, have been struck by the death of a man. By Allah, I do not claim that I have seen among the servants of Allah a slave who had less pride, who had a more open heart, who was less arrogant, who had a stronger love for the Hereafter, and who gave better advice to the general public than him. So have mercy upon him, may Allah have mercy on him, and then raise your voices in sending blessings upon him. By Allah, there will never be anyone better than him amongst you."
The people gathered, Abu Ubaidah came out, and Mu'adh advanced and prayed upon him until when they brought him to his grave, Mu'adh bin Jabal, Amr bin al-Aas, and Dhahhak bin Qais entered his grave. When they had lowered him into his grave and came out, they covered him with dirt. Mu'adh bin Jabal said, "O Abu Ubaidah, I only praise you and I do not say anything false. I fear that Allah may cause me to be held accountable for it. By Allah, I did not know of those who remember Allah frequently and those who walk humbly upon the earth, and when the ignorant address them, they say Peace. And I did not know of those who spend without extravagance or stinginess, and they maintain a balance between the two. And I swear by Allah, you were among the supplicators, the humble ones, those who have mercy on orphans and the poor, and those who despise the treacherous and the arrogant." Adh-Dhahabi stopped mentioning it in his summary.
hi: "Aye logo, Allah ki taraf apne gunahon se sacchi tauba karo, kyunke Allah ka banda kabhi Allah se apne gunah se tauba karte huay nahi milta magar Allah par yeh haq hai ke woh usse maaf kare." Phir kaha: "Aye logo, tumhein aik aise aadmi ki maut ka gham pahuncha hai, Allah ki qasam, main dawa nahi karta ke maine Allah ke bandon mein se kabhi bhi koi aisa banda dekha ho jiski (dushmani mein) kami itni kam, dil itna neik, buraai se itna door, aur anjaam se itni zyada mohabbat, aur aam logon ke liye itni khair-khwahi rakhne wala, ho jitna yeh the, isliye unpar reham karo, Allah unpar reham kare, phir unki namaz-e-janaza ke liye khuli jagah nikal aao, kyunke Allah ki qasam, tumpar unke jaisa koi kabhi ameer nahi banega." To log jama ho gaye, Abu Ubaidah ko nikaala gaya, aur Mu'adh (RA) aage badhe aur unki namaz padhayi, yahan tak ke jab unhein unki qabr tak laaya gaya, to Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA), Amr bin Al-Aas (RA), aur Adh-Dhahhaak bin Qais (RA) unki qabr mein utre, jab unhone unhein lahad (qabr ke andar aik jagah) mein rakha aur nikle, to unhone unpar mitti daali, to Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) ne kaha: "Aye Abu Ubaidah, main zaroor aapki tareef karunga aur koi baatil baat nahi kahunga, mujhe darr hai ke Allah ki taraf se mujhpar iski wajah se koi naaraazgi na aa jaaye, aap, Allah ki qasam, jahan tak mujhe pata hai, un logon mein se the jo Allah ko bohot yaad karte, aur un logon mein se the jo zameen par narmi se chalte hain, aur jab jaahil unse mukhaatib hote to woh 'Salaam' kehte, aur un logon mein se the jo kharch karte to na fizool-kharchi karte na kanjoosi, aur unke darmiyan aik mautadil raah rakhte the, aap, Allah ki qasam, un logon mein se the jo Allah ke saamne aajizi karte the, farotan (inkasar wale), jo yateem aur miskeen par reham karte aur dhoke-baaz, ghuroor karne walon se nafrat karte." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] A thin man with veined face, a light beard, long and slightly hunched, Skat stopped him from summarizing.
hi: "Aik dubla-patla aadmi, chehre par rag-en dikhti huay, halki daadhi, lamba, thoda jhuka hua, aur unke aage ke do daant toote huay the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Ubaida ibn al-Jarrah passed away in the year eighteen in a Battle in Jordan."
hi: "Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah ka intiqaal Fahl, Jordan mein, atharah (18) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "And among those who participated in the Battle of Badr from the Banu al-Harith ibn Fihr was Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah, who was forty-one years old."
hi: "Aur Banu Al-Harith bin Fihr mein se Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein, Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah the, jabke woh iktaalees (41) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] About him, when the wounds increased, Abu 'Ubaidah sought him and killed him. Therefore, Allah revealed this verse regarding him when he killed his father: "You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day loving those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons." (Surah Al-Mujadila, verse 22). Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in summarizing.
hi: Unke baare mein, jab woh (dushman) zakhmon se bhar gaya, to Abu Ubaidah ne uska qasd kiya aur usse qatl kar diya, to Allah Ta'ala ne unke baare mein yeh ayat nazil ki, jab unhone apne waalid ko qatl kiya: "{Tum aisi qaum nahi paaoge jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhti ho, jo un logon se mohabbat karti ho jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki mukhaalifat ki, chaahe woh unke baap ho ya bete}" (Surah Al-Mujadilah 22). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Do you not ask me about what I said? So we said, 'We liked what you said, so we ask you about it.' He said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Whoever spends in the path of Allah, it will be multiplied by seven hundred. And whoever spends on himself, his family, or a sick person or anything that increases, the reward of that will be tenfold. And fasting is a shield as long as it is not violated. And whoever Allah afflicts with a calamity in his body, he will have his sins forgiven."' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: "Kya tum mujhse nahi poochte main ne kya kaha?" To humne kaha: "Humein aapki baat achhi lagi, isliye hum aapse iske baare mein poochte hain." To unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Jo koi Allah ki raah mein kharch kare, to (uska ajr) saat sau (700) guna hoga, aur jo koi apne aap par aur apne ghar walon par kharch kare, ya kisi bimaar ki mizaaj-purs karne jaaye, ya isse zyada (bhalaai) kare, to neki uski das (10) misaalon ke barabar hai, aur roza aik dhaal (bachaav) hai jab tak use phaad na diya jaaye, aur jise Allah apne jism mein kisi museebat mein daale, to woh uske (gunahon ke) hataane ka zariya hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard Yahia bin Sa'id say, "Abu Ubaidah died at the age of fifty-eight."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Sa'eed ko kehte suna: "Abu Ubaidah ka intiqaal hua jabke woh atthaawan (58) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] Abu 'Ubaidah al-Jarrah died in Jordan in the year eighteen and Mouadh Ibn Jabal performed his funeral prayer.
hi: "Abu Ubaidah Al-Jarraah ka intiqaal Jordan mein, atharah (18) hijri mein hua, aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi."

e: [AI] "I did not aspire for leadership, nor did I desire it, except that some people from the people of Najran came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and complained about their governor. So he said, 'I will send a trustworthy person over you.' Omar said, 'I was hoping that he would appoint me for this task, but he sent Abu Ubaidah instead.' This hadith is considered authentic according to the criteria of both Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: "Main ne kabhi khilafat/ameeri ki khwahish nahi ki aur na hi mujhe woh pasand thi, siwaye is ke ke Najran ke kuch log Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, unhone apne aamil (ameer) ki shikaayat ki, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: main zaroor tumhare paas aik amaanatdaar aadmi bhejunga. Umar (RA) ne kaha: to main un logon mein se tha jinhone gardan lambi ki is ummeed mein ke shaayad aap (SAW) mujhe bhejein, magar aap (SAW) ne Abu Ubaidah ko bheja." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is none of my companions except that if I wanted to, I would have taken from him some of his good character, except for Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah." This is a strange narration, and its narrators are trustworthy.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere sahaba mein koi bhi aisa nahi jispar, agar main chaahta, to unke akhlaaq mein se kisi cheez par unhein tanqeed kar sakta, siwaye Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah ke." Yeh mursal, ajeeb-o-ghareeb hai, aur iske raawi bharosemand hain. Mursal.

e: [AI] Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq said to Abu Ubaidah when he was sending him to Sham: "I want you to know your high status and position in my eyes. By the One in Whose hand is my soul, there is no one on earth, from the Muhajireen or others, who I consider more just than you. This does not mean that Umar is not esteemed by me, but he is beneath you in status according to me." The source of this narration is unclear.
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne Abu Ubaidah se, jab unhein Sham (Syria) ki taraf bheja, kaha: "Main chahta houn tum jaano ke mere nazdeek tumhari kya izzat aur martaba hai, aur us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, zameen par Muhajireen ya doosron mein se koi aisa aadmi nahi jise main tumhare barabar samjhoon, aur na hi yeh," matlab Umar, "jinka mere nazdeek martaba tumse kam hai." Isnad andhera/na-saaf hai.

e: [AI] I was among the first ones who fought on the day of Uhud, and I was standing in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when a man came and fought against me. I could see him saying, "Woe to him, may Allah protect him." So I said, "Be like Talhah, wherever he goes, I will follow even if I miss what I had missed." He replied, "Between me and the east, there is a man whom I do not know. I am closer to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  than him, and he is snatching the prey aggressively, which I cannot snatch." Suddenly, it was Abu 'Ubaidah bin al-Jarrah, so we all pushed towards the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . His ribs were broken and his face was injured. Two pieces from the cheek of Maghfar (a type of tree used to clean teeth) had entered his jaw. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to us, "Take care of your companion," referring to Talhah who was bleeding. He did not even look at him. So we went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I wanted what Abu 'Ubaidah wanted and he asked me about it, and he did not leave me until I left him. His cheek wound had festered and he did not want to disturb it with his hand, for fear of hurting the Prophet ﷺ . He held it with his finger and pulled it out, and his cheek wound worsened. He asked me again, and did not leave me until I left him. Then he moved to the other side and did the same, pulling it out and worsening his cheek wound. Abu 'Ubaidah was meticulous about his wounds.
hi: Main un logon mein se pehla tha jo Uhud ke din palte, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne aik aadmi jung kar raha tha, unki hifaazat kar raha tha, aur mera khayaal hai unhone kaha unki hifaazat bhi kar raha tha. Unhone kaha: to maine kaha: "Kaash yeh Talhah (RA) ho, jabke mujhse jo chhoot gaya woh chhoot gaya." Unhone kaha: aur mere aur mashriq (poorab) ke darmiyan aik aadmi tha jise main nahi pehchaanta tha, aur main Rasulullah (SAW) ke unse zyada qareeb tha, aur woh (dushman ki taraf) aisi tezi se badh raha tha jaisi tezi mujhme na thi, to achaanak woh Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah nikle, humne dono ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf rukh kiya, unka aage ka daant toot chuka tha aur unke chehre par zakhm laga tha, aur unke gaalon mein khod (helmet) ki zanjeer ki do kadiyaan (rings) ghus gayi thin, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: "Apne saathi ka khayaal rakho," unka matlab Talhah (RA) se tha, jinka khoon zyada beh raha tha, aur aap (SAW) ne unki taraf dhyaan nahi diya. Unhone kaha: to hum Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf mutawajjeh huay, aur main woh chahta tha jo Abu Ubaidah chahte the, unhone mujhse ilteja ki, magar woh baaz nahi aaye yahan tak ke maine unhein (yeh kaam karne diya), unki aik kadi (ring) atak gayi thi, aur unhein napasand tha ke woh isse apne haath se hilaayen aur Nabi (SAW) ko takleef pahunchaayen, to unhone use apne daant se pakda, uthe aur usse nikaala, to unka daant bhi (usske sath) nikal gaya, unhone mujhse ilteja ki aur mujhe (rukne) nahi diya yahan tak ke maine unhein (aisa karne diya), phir doosri (kadi) par jhuke, waisa hi kiya, usse bhi nikaala, aur unka (doosra) daant bhi nikal gaya, to Abu Ubaidah aage ke daanton se toothe (khaali) ho gaye.

e: [AI] "Abu Ubaidah Amr bin al-Jarrah embraced Islam along with Uthman bin Mazh'un, Abdul Rahman bin Awf and their companions before the arrival of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the house of Arqam. Abu Ubaidah migrated to the land of Abyssinia for the second migration. He participated in the Battle of Badr and Uhud, and remained steadfast with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of Uhud when the people were defeated. Abu Ubaidah removed the two rings from his fingers, which were given to him by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as a sign of forgiveness for his sins. Both rings fell off his fingers and were lost. Abu Ubaidah was the most sincere among the believers in this regard."
hi: "Abu Ubaidah Aamir bin Al-Jarraah ne Uthman bin Maz'oon (RA), Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA), aur unke saathiyon ke sath, Rasulullah (SAW) ke Daar-e-Arqam mein dakhil honay se pehle, Islam qubool kiya. Abu Ubaidah ne Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen ki taraf doosri hijrat ki, aur unhone Badr aur Uhud mein shirkat ki, aur Uhud ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jame rahe jab log shikast khaa gaye, aur woh hi the jinhone apne do daanton se Rasulullah (SAW) ke khod (helmet) ki zanjeer ki woh do kadiyaan (rings) nikaali jo unke gaalon mein ghus gayi thin, to Abu Ubaidah ke daant unhein nikalne ki koshish mein gir gaye, isliye Abu Ubaidah aage ke daanton se toothe (khaali) the." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] I heard Abdullah ibn Wahb saying, "The inscription on the ring of Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah is 'Al-Wafa' is dear'."
hi: Maine Abdullah bin Wahb ko kehte suna: "Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah ki mohar ke nagine par 'Al-Wafa Aziz' (wafaadari qeemti hai) khoda hua tha."

e: [AI] "The chief and the nobleman from Najran came to the Prophet ﷺ , intending to curse him. One of them said to his companion, 'Don't do it. By Allah, if he is indeed a Prophet, we will be cursed and will not succeed in this life or the hereafter.' They responded, 'Rather, we will give you what you asked for and will send a trustworthy man with you.' They sought the opinion of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, 'Stand up, Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah.' When he stood up, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'This is the trustworthy one of this nation.' The two sheikhs agreed to include this narration, in a summarised form, in the Sahihain (i.e. Sahih Al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim), from the narration of Al-Thawri and Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from Silla bin Zufar, from Hudhaifah. However, Israel narrated differently, from Silla bin Zufar, from Abdullah, and he transmitted the narration in a more complete form according to what is found with Al-Thawri and Shu'bah. I included it because it fulfills their conditions, making it authentic according to Al-Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Al-Aaqib aur As-Sayyid, Najran ke dono saathi, Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, unka iraada tha ke woh unse mubaahalah (aik doosre par la'nat bhejne ki dua) karein, to unme se aik ne apne saathi se kaha: "Aisa mat karo, Allah ki qasam, agar yeh Nabi hain aur humpar la'nat bheji, to na hum aur na humari nasal kamyaab hongi." To unhone kaha: "Balke hum aapko woh de dete hain jo aapne maanga hai, aur humare sath aik amaanatdaar aadmi bhejein, sacchi amaanat wala." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba iske liye ummeedwar hokar dekhne lage, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uthiye, Aye Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah." Jab woh peeche mudhe, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh is Ummat ke amaanatdaar hain." Dono Imamon (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne mukhtasar shakl mein Sahihain mein Sufyaan Ath-Thawri aur Shu'bah ki Abu Ishaq se, unhone Silah bin Zufar se, unhone Hudhaifah (RA) se, riwayat ke zariye nikaalne par ittefaaq kiya hai, aur Israel ne inse ikhtilaaf kiya hai, unhone Silah bin Zufar se, unhone Abdullah (RA) se, hadith zikr ki, aur unhone hadith ko Ath-Thawri aur Shu'bah ke muqable mein zyada mukammal riwayat kiya, isliye maine ise nikaala kyunke yeh unki shart par sahih hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The people of Yemen came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "Send along with us a man who can teach us the Quran." So he took the hand of Abu Ubaidah and sent him with them, saying, "This is a trustworthy person of this Ummah." This narration is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim, and they did not mention the Quran according to the conditions of Imam Muslim.
hi: Yemen ke ahl Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, unhone kaha: "Humare sath aik aadmi bhejein jo humein Quran sikhaaye." To aap (SAW) ne Abu Ubaidah ka haath pakda aur unhein unke sath bheja, aur farmaya: "Yeh is Ummat ke amaanatdaar hain." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise Quran ke zikr ke sath nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq said to Abu Ubaydah: 'Shall I give you my pledge of allegiance? For I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Indeed, you are the guardian of this Ummah (nation).' Abu Ubaydah replied, 'How can I lead the prayer in front of a man whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  ordered to lead us when he was alive?' 'It is a Sahih (authentic) chain of narration, and they did not mention it,' [meaning the scholars did not mention the authenticity of the chain].'"
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne Abu Ubaidah se poocha: "Kya main aapse baiyat karoon? Kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: beshak aap is Ummat ke amaanatdaar hain." To Abu Ubaidah ne kaha: "Main aik aise aadmi ke saamne namaz kaise padhaaun jinhein Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein imaamat karwaane ka hukum diya tha jab unka intiqaal ho raha tha?" Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Munqata' (isnad mein khaali jagah wala) hai.

e: [AI] I said about him, "I appointed him as the trustee of Allah and the trustee of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in the summary.
hi: Unke baare mein, maine kaha: "Maine Allah ke amaanatdaar aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke amaanatdaar ko khalifa muqarrar kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What an excellent man is Abu Bakr, what an excellent man is 'Umar, what an excellent man is Abu 'Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah, what an excellent man is Usaid bin Hudair, what an excellent man is Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas, what an excellent man is Mua'dh bin Jabal, and what an excellent man is Mu'adh bin 'Amr bin Al-Jamuh." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3795)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Abu Bakr, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Umar, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Usaid bin Hudhair, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Mu'adh bin Jabal, kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamooh." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "I am a brother between Abu Talha and Abu Ubaida." This hadith is authentic according to Muslim's condition, and Fahd bin Awf did not exclude it.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Talhah (RA) aur Abu Ubaidah ke darmiyan (Islami) bhai-chaara qaayam kiya. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Fahd bin Auf ko (raawiyon ne) chhod diya (matrook). Weak, Rejected.

e: [AI] About Ibn Ishaq, he said: "In the naming of those who witnessed the Battle of Uhud, Mu'adh bin Jabal bin Amr bin Aws bin A'idh bin 'Adi bin Ka'b bin Ghanm bin Sa'd bin 'Ali bin Asad bin Yazid bin Jusham, he was from the tribe of Banu Salamah. He witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and all other battles. He died in the year of the plague, during the caliphate of Umar bin Khattab. The Banu Salamah claimed him as their kin because he was a brother to one of them."
hi: Ibn Ishaq se: "Aqabah mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Mu'adh bin Jabal bin Amr bin Aws bin Aa'idh bin Adi bin Ka'b bin Ghanm bin Sa'd bin Ali bin Asad bin Saaridah bin Yazid bin Jusham, woh Banu Salamah mein se the, unhone Badr mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath aur tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur woh Umwaas (Amwas) mein taa'oon (plague) ke saal, Umar bin Al-Khattab ki khilafat mein, faut huay, aur Banu Salamah ne unpar apna daawa isliye kiya kyunke unhone unme se aik aadmi ke sath bhai-chaara qaayam kiya tha."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in saying, "The kunya of Mu'adh ibn Jabal is Abu Abdurrahman."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Mu'adh bin Jabal ki kunniyat Abu Abdur Rahman thi."

e: [AI] I heard Malik ibn Anas say, "Indeed Mu'adh ibn Jabal died while he was twenty-eight years old, and he was the leader of the scholars in Riwah." This is incorrect.
hi: Maine Malik bin Anas ko kehte suna: "Beshak Mu'adh bin Jabal ka intiqaal hua jabke woh atthaais (28) saal ke thay, aur woh ulama ke imam the, kaafi buland darje se." Yeh ghalat hai.

e: [AI] Mu'adh ibn Jabal ibn 'Amr ibn 'Aadhi ibn Ka'ab ibn 'Amr ibn Adda ibn Sa'd ibn 'Ali ibn Asad ibn Saridah ibn Yazid ibn Jusham. He witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Al-Dhahabi deleted him from the summary due to his weakness.
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal bin Amr bin Aa'idh bin Adi bin Ka'b bin Amr bin Adda bin Sa'd bin Ali bin Asad bin Saaridah bin Yazid bin Jusham, "unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Mu'adh bin Jabal bin 'Amr, one of the Banu Salamah bin Al-Khazraj, known as Abu 'Abdul Rahman, died in the year eighteen during the plague of 'Amawas, at the age of thirty-eight.
hi: "Mu'adh bin Jabal bin Amr, Banu Salamah bin Al-Khazraj mein se aik, jinki kunniyat Abu Abdur Rahman thi, unka intiqaal Umwaas ke taa'oon mein, atharah (18) hijri mein hua, jabke woh atthais (38) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] Regarding it, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "It is the son of thirty-two years." It was deleted by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness.
hi: "Beshak woh battees (32) saal ke thay." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se hata diya.

e: [AI] I heard Malik ibn Anas saying, "Indeed, Muadh ibn Jabal has passed away while he was twenty-eight years old, and he was the Imam of the scholars of Basra."
hi: Maine Malik bin Anas ko kehte suna: "Beshak Mu'adh bin Jabal ka intiqaal hua jabke woh atthaais (28) saal ke thay, aur woh ulama ke imam the, kaafi buland darje se."

e: [AI] "Muadh bin Jabal was captured at the age of thirty-three or thirty-four." This statement is closer to accuracy from Yahya bin Sa'id than the previous one.
hi: "Mu'adh bin Jabal ka intiqaal hua jabke woh tetees (33) ya chauntees (34) saal ke thay." Yeh Yahya bin Sa'eed ki baat pehle wali baat se sihat ke zyada qareeb hai.

e: [AI] I entered the mosque of Damascus and behold, I saw a man adorned with eloquence, tall in stature and quiet in nature. Whenever people disagreed on something, they would defer to him and relinquish their own opinions. I inquired about him and was told that he was Muadh ibn Jabal. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in the summary.
hi: Main Dimashq (Damascus) ki masjid mein dakhil hua, achaanak main ne aik aise aadmi ko dekha jinke daant chamak rahe the, khamoshi se rehne wale, aur log unke sath the, jab woh kisi baat mein ikhtilaaf karte, to woh unki taraf rujoo karte aur unki raay ko maante. Maine unke baare mein poocha, to kaha gaya: "Mu'adh bin Jabal." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Muadh bin Jabal was buried in Qasr Khalid.
hi: "Mu'adh bin Jabal ko Qasr Khaalid mein dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi, in summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] Abdullah said, "What's wrong with you, Abu Abdurrahman? It seems like you are talking to yourself?"
hi: Abdullah ne unse kaha: "Aapko kya hua, Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, aap goya khud se baaten kar rahe hain?"

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  appointed Mu'adh ibn Jabal as a governor over the people of Makkah when he went out to Hunayn. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded Mu'adh ibn Jabal to teach the people the Quran and to educate them in matters of religion. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , leaving for Madinah, left Mu'adh ibn Jabal in charge of the people of Makkah." Majed ad-Dīn al-Hifnī (ad-Dhahabi) did not mention this in his summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Mu'adh bin Jabal ko Makkah walon par khalifa (naib) muqarrar kiya jab woh Hunain ki taraf nikle, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukum diya ke woh logon ko Quran sikhaayen aur unhein deen ki samajh dein, phir Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah ki taraf rawaana huay aur Mu'adh bin Jabal ko Makkah walon par chhod diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] The following translation is a saying I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ :

"Verily, the slightest form of showing off is a form of polytheism (shirk). And the most beloved of Allah's servants are the most pious ones who hide their good deeds and qualities. They are those who, when absent, are not missed, and when present, are not acknowledged. They are the leaders of guidance and the torchbearers of knowledge."

This hadith has a sahih (authentic) chain of narration and wasn't narrated by Abu Qahtham. Abu Hatim said his hadith should not be written down, and Al-Nasa'i considered his trustworthiness doubtful.
hi: Aik hadith jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suni: "Beshak dikhaawe ka sabse kam darja bhi shirk hai, aur Allah, buzurg aur buland, ko sabse zyada aziz banday woh muttaqi, chhupe huay (log) hain, jo ghair-hazir hon to unhein dhoonda na jaaye, aur jab maujood hon to unhein pehchaana na jaaye, yehi hidayat ke imam aur ilm ke chiragh hain." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Abu Qahdham (is chain mein hain), Abu Haatim ne kaha unki hadith na likhi jaaye, aur An-Nasa'i ne kaha woh bharosemand nahi.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "He is among the ten in Paradise." Sahih (authentic).
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Beshak woh das (10) mein se daswaan Jannat mein honge." Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Mu'adh bin Jabal is the most knowledgeable of the people of the past and the future after the Prophets and the messengers, and indeed Allah boasts about him to the angels." I consider it a fabricated statement.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mu'adh bin Jabal Ambiya aur Rusul ke baad, pehlon aur baad walon mein sabse zyada ilm rakhne wale hain, aur beshak Allah unke zariye farishton ke saamne fakhr karta hai." Mujhe lagta hai yeh gadha hua (fabricated) hai.

e: [AI] "I haven't done this since I embraced Islam and became a companion of the Prophet ﷺ."
hi: "Maine yeh (kaam) nahi kiya jab se main Musalman hua aur Nabi (SAW) ka saathi bana."

e: [AI] "O people, this is the mercy of your Lord, the call of your prophet, and the departure of the righteous before you." Then Mu'adh said while giving a sermon, "O Allah, grant the family of Mu'adh their fullest share of this mercy." While he was still speaking, a man came and said, "Your son, Abdulrahman, has been stabbed." When Mu'adh saw his father, he said, "Abdulrahman says, 'The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters.'" (Al-Baqarah 147) Mu'adh said, "You will find me, by the will of Allah, among the patient." (As-Saffat 102) From Friday to Friday, all the family of Mu'adh died, and he was the last of them.
hi: "Aye logo, yeh tumhare Rab ki rehmat, tumhare Nabi ki dua, aur tumse pehle neik logon ki wafaat hai." Phir Mu'adh ne, khutba dete huay, kaha: "Aye Allah, Aal-e-Mu'adh (Mu'adh ke ghar walon) ko is rehmat mein se unka poora hissa de." Jabke woh isi mein the ke koi aaya aur kaha: "Aapke bete Abdur Rahman ko neze se zakhmi kiya gaya hai." Jab Abdur Rahman ne apne waalid Mu'adh ko dekha, to unhone kaha (Abdur Rahman ne apne waalid se): "Aye abba, {Haq tere Rab ki taraf se hai, isliye shak karne walon mein se mat ho}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 147). Mu'adh ne kaha: "{Ankareeb tum mujhe, Allah chaahe to, sabr karne walon mein se paaoge}" (Surah As-Saffat 102). To Jumme se Jumme tak, Aal-e-Mu'adh (Mu'adh ke sab ghar wale) faut ho gaye, aur phir woh khud unme sabse aakhir mein faut huay.

e: [AI] "Regarding money, let it come to me, for Allah, the Almighty, has made me a treasurer."
hi: "maal (paise) ke baare mein, to woh mere paas aaye, kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe iska khaazin (khazaanchi) banaya hai."

e: [AI] "Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, says: 'Indeed, Ibrahim was an obedient nation to Allah." [Surah An-Nahl, 120] Ibn Abbas said: "Do you know what a nation is? And who is the obedient? So I said, 'Allah knows best.' He said, 'A nation is the one who knows good, and the obedient is the one who obeys Allah and His Messenger, peace be upon him.' Similarly, Mu'adh ibn Jabal was a teacher of good and obedient to Allah and His Messenger, peace be upon him." Shu'bah narrated it from Firas from Ash-Sha'bi from Masruq from Abdullah, and he attributed it at the end. Adh-Dhahabi stopped discussing it further in the summary.
hi: Allah, buzurg aur buland, (farmata hai): "{Beshak Ibrahim (AS) aik Ummat (jama'at ke barabar) the, Allah ke aage jhukne wale}" (Surah An-Nahl 120), (Ibn Mas'ood ne) poocha: "Kya tumhein pata hai 'Ummat' kya hai, aur 'Qaanit' kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Allah behtar jaanta hai." Unhone kaha: "'Ummat' woh hai jo bhalaai sikhaata hai, aur 'Qaanit' woh hai jo Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ka farmaanbardaar ho, aur isi tarah Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) the, woh bhalaai ke muallim (sikhaane wale) the aur Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ke farmaanbardaar the." Isi tarah Shu'bah ne Firaas se, unhone Ash-Sha'bi se, unhone Masrooq se, unhone Abdullah se riwayat ki, aur unhone iske aakhir mein isnad qaayam ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdullah said, 'He who forgets, has forgotten. Indeed, we used to liken him to Ibrahim.' Abdullah was asked about the community, and he said, 'The teacher of goodness, the obedient and submissive to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ .' Abdullah then said, 'He who forgets, has forgotten. Indeed, we used to liken him to Ibrahim.' Abdullah was asked about the community, and he said, 'The teacher of goodness, the obedient and submissive to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ .' This hadith is authentic according to the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim, but they didn't include it in their collections."
hi: Abdullah (ne kaha): "Bhool gaya jo bhool gaya, hum unhein Ibrahim (AS) se milaate the." Aur Abdullah se "Ummat" ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Bhalaai ka sikhaane wala, aur Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ka farmaanbardaar." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] When the Prophet ﷺ  passed away and Abu Bakr was appointed as his successor, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent Muadh to Yemen and Abu Bakr appointed Umar to be in charge of Makkah during the pilgrimage season. Umar met Muadh in Makkah and saw that he had slaves with him, so he asked, "Who are these?" Muadh replied, "They are gifts for me, and these are gifts for Abu Bakr." Umar suggested that he bring them to Abu Bakr, so he met him the next day and said, "O Ibn Al-Khattab! I saw myself last night being dragged towards the Hellfire, while you were holding onto my reins, and I did not see anything except that I was obedient to you." Abu Bakr then brought them and said, "These are gifts for me, and these are for you." Abu Bakr replied, "We have already handed over your gifts to you." Muadh then went to perform the prayer, and to his surprise, he found the people praying behind him. He asked, "Who are you praying to?" They replied, "To Allah, the Almighty." Muadh exclaimed, "If you are praying to Allah, then you should set them free." This narration is considered authentic based on the conditions of both Al-Bukhari and Muslim, and it is not narrated according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ka intiqaal hua aur Abu Bakr ko khalifa muqarrar kiya gaya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko Yemen bheja tha, to Abu Bakr ne Umar ko Hajj ke mausam par ameer banaaya, unki mulaqaat Makkah mein Mu'adh se hui, unke sath kuch ghulam the, unhone poocha: "Yeh kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh mujhe tohfe mein diye gaye hain, aur yeh Abu Bakr ke liye hain." To Umar ne unse kaha: "Mera khayaal hai tumhein yeh Abu Bakr ke paas lekar jaana chahiye." Unhone kaha: to unki mulaqaat agle din unse hui, unhone kaha: "Aye Ibn Al-Khattab, maine raat khwaab dekha goya main aag ki taraf udd raha houn aur tum mera daaman pakde huay ho, aur main apne aap ko sirf tumhari itaa'at karta paata houn." Unhone kaha: to woh unhein Abu Bakr ke paas laaye, unhone kaha: "Yeh mujhe tohfe mein diye gaye hain, aur yeh aapke liye hain." To Abu Bakr ne kaha: "To humne tumhara tohfa (dono hisse) tumhein wapas kar diya." To Mu'adh namaz ke liye nikle, achaanak woh unke peeche namaz padh rahe the, to Mu'adh ne poocha: "Tum kiske liye namaz padh rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: "Allah, buzurg aur buland, ke liye." To unhone kaha: "To tum uske ho," aur unhein aazaad kar diya. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] 'Umar ibn Al-Khattab addressed the people and said, "Whoever wants to ask about the Quran, let him come to Ubayy ibn Ka'b. And whoever wants to ask about what is permissible and what is forbidden, let him come to Mu'adh ibn Jabal. And whoever wants to ask about Islamic legal obligations, let him come to Zaid ibn Thabit. And whoever wants to ask about wealth, let him come to me, for I am its treasurer."
hi: Beshak Umar bin Al-Khattab ne logon ko khutba di, farmaya: "Jo koi Quran ke baare mein poochna chaahe, woh Ubayy bin Ka'b ke paas jaaye, aur jo koi halaal-haraam ke baare mein poochna chaahe, woh Mu'adh bin Jabal ke paas jaaye, aur jo koi wirasat ke ahkaam ke baare mein poochna chaahe, woh Zaid bin Thaabit ke paas jaaye, aur jo koi maal (paise) ke baare mein poochna chaahe, woh mere paas aaye, kyunke main iska khaazin (khazaanchi) houn."

e: [AI] Mu'adh ibn Jabal was a young, gentle, and kind man, one of the best among his people's youth. He did not hold onto anything, and his hands were always open to give until he drowned all his wealth in charity. "So his creditors came to the Prophet ﷺ." If they had left anyone for the sake of anyone, they would have left Mu'adh for the sake of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. "So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sold his belongings to them until Mu'adh was left with nothing."
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal aik jawaan, baradbaar, saakhi aadmi the, apni qaum ke jawaano mein sabse behtareen, aur woh kuch bhi (apne paas) roke rakhna pasand nahi karte the, isliye woh (doosron ko) qarz dete rehte yahan tak ke unka poora maal qarz mein doob gaya, "to Nabi (SAW) ke paas unke qarz-khwah aaye," agar woh kisi ke liye kisi (aur) ko chhodte, to woh Mu'adh ko Rasulullah (SAW) ki khaatir chhod dete, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke liye unka maal becha yahan tak ke Mu'adh bagair kuch ke reh gaye."

e: [AI] He received news that his son had died, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to him to offer condolences. The message said: "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. From Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, to Muadh ibn Jabal: Peace be upon you. I praise Allah to you, there is no deity except Him. After that, may Allah grant you great reward, inspire you with patience, and provide us and you with gratitude. Indeed, our lives, wealth, families, and children are gifts from Allah, the Exalted. Enjoy them with happiness and pleasure, and when the time comes, may you receive great reward for it. May Allah bless you with prayers, mercy, and guidance if you seek it. Be patient, and do not let your grief undermine your reward, causing you to regret. Know that grief does not repel anything or alleviate sadness. That is all, peace be upon you." This is a strange, good narration, except that the inclusion of Mujashi' ibn 'Amr is not a condition for this letter.
hi: Ke unke aik bete ka intiqaal hua, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein tasalli dene ke liye likha: "Bismillah-hir-Rahman-nir-Raheem, Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ki taraf se Mu'adh bin Jabal ke naam, aap par salaam ho, beshak main aapke saamne Allah ki tareef karta houn jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, ammaa ba'd, Allah aapke liye ajr ko azeem kare aur aapko sabr ka ilhaam de aur humein aur aapko shukar naseeb kare, kyunke humari jaanein, humara maal, humare ghar wale, aur humari aulaad, Allah Ta'ala ki khush-guwaar ataayen aur amaanat mein rakhi hui cheezein hain, usne aapko unse khush-o-khurram farogh diya, phir aik bade ajr, namaz, rehmat, aur hidayat ke sath unhein aapse le liya, agar aap isse waisa hi samajhein, to sabr karein, aur aapki betaabi aapke ajr ko zaaya na kare taake aap pachtaayen, aur jaan lein ke betaabi kuch bhi wapas nahi laati aur na hi gham ko door karti, aur jo hona tha woh ho chuka, wassalam." Yeh ajeeb-o-ghareeb, achha hai, siwaye is ke ke Mujaashi' bin Amr is kitaab ki shart mein nahi. Yeh Mujaashi' bin Amr ki gadhi hui hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took my hand one day and said, "O Mu'adh, by Allah, I truly love you." So, I replied, "By my father and mother, O Messenger of Allah, I swear that I love you too." He then advised me, saying, "O Mu'adh, I advise you not to leave after every prayer without saying, 'O Allah, help me in remembering You, in thanking You, and in worshipping You excellently.' And Mu'adh advised al-Sun abi al-Shibihi, and al-Sunabihi advised Abu Abdur-Rahman al-Hubuli, and he advised Uqbah ibn Muslim." This is an authentic narration, but it has not been mentioned in Sahih (al-Bukhari or Muslim).
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne aik din mera haath pakda, phir farmaya: "Aye Mu'adh, Allah ki qasam, main tumse mohabbat karta houn." Maine unse kaha: "Mere waalid aur maa aap par qurbaan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aur main bhi, Allah ki qasam, aapse mohabbat karta houn." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur main tumhein wasiyat karta houn, Aye Mu'adh, har namaz ke baad yeh kehna mat chhodna: Aye Allah, mujhe apne zikr, apne shukar, aur teri behtareen ibaadat par madad de." Aur Mu'adh ne yeh wasiyat As-Sunaabihi ko ki, aur As-Sunaabihi ne Abu Abdur Rahman Al-Hubuli ko ki, aur Abu Abdur Rahman ne Uqbah bin Muslim ko ki. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] Mu'adh ibn Jabal was among the best people in appearance, best in manners, and most forgiving. He was very religious, so his debts became heavy on him until he secluded himself from people for several days in his house. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wanted to pay off his debts, so he sent a messenger to Mu'adh to summon him. Mu'adh came with his creditors and they said, "O Messenger of Allah, take our rights from him." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "May Allah have mercy on those who give charity to others." Some people gave their rights up, while others refused. They said, "O Messenger of Allah, take our rights from him." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Be patient with them, O Mu'adh, and you have no other option." Mu'adh then went to Banu Salamah, and someone said to him, "O Abu Abdur Rahman, if you had asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , you would not have become destitute today." Mu'adh replied, "I would not have asked him." He remained there for some time until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called him and sent him to Yemen, saying, "Perhaps Allah will relieve you of your debt and fulfill it for you." Mu'adh went to Yemen and remained there until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away. During the year in which Umar ibn al-Khattab performed Hajj, he assigned Mu'adh as his deputy for Hajj. They met on the day of Tarwiyah and embraced Islam. Each of them comforted the other with the companionship of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Then they went to the ground and conversed. Umar saw young boys with Mu'adh and asked, "Who are these?" Then he mentioned the words that have been omitted from the summary due to their weakness.
hi: Mu'adh bin Jabal logon mein sabse achhe chehre wale, sabse achhe akhlaaq wale, aur sabse zyada khush-dili se maafi dene wale the, unhone bohot qarz liya, to unke qarz-khwah unke peeche pad gaye yahan tak ke woh kayi dinon tak apne ghar mein unse chhupte rahe, yahan tak ke unke qarz-khwahon ne Rasulullah (SAW) se madad maangi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Mu'adh ko bulaane ke liye kisi ko bheja, woh apne qarz-khwahon ke sath aaye, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein hamara haq dilwaayen." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah unpar reham kare jo unhein maaf kar de." To kuch logon ne unhein maaf kar diya aur kuch ne inkaar kiya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein hamara haq dilwaayen unse." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabr karo unke liye, Aye Mu'adh." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka maal unse le liya aur unke qarz-khwahon ko de diya, unhone use aapas mein taqseem kiya, unhein apne haq ka paanch-saatvaan hissa mila, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), unhein humare liye bech dein." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein chhod do, tumhara unpar koi raasta nahi." To Mu'adh Banu Salamah ki taraf mudh gaye, koi kehne wala unse kehne laga: "Aye Abu Abdur Rahman, kaash aap Rasulullah (SAW) se maangte, kyunke aaj aap muflis ho chuke hain." Unhone kaha: "Main unse maangunga nahi." Unhone kaha: to woh kuch dinon tak ruke rahe, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein bulaaya aur Yemen ki taraf bheja, aur farmaya: "Shaayad Allah tumhein sambhal de aur tumhari taraf se tumhara qarz ada kare." Unhone kaha: to Mu'adh Yemen ki taraf nikle, wahin rahe yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, phir woh us saal aa milay jismein Umar bin Al-Khattab ne Makkah Hajj kiya, to Abu Bakr ne unhein Hajj ka zimmedaar banaya, dono ki mulaqaat Tarwiyah ke din wahan hui, dono aik doosre se milay aur har aik ne doosre ko Rasulullah (SAW) (ke intiqaal) par tasalli di, phir dono zameen par baith kar baaten karne lage, to Umar ne Mu'adh ke paas kuch larke dekhe, poocha: "Yeh kaun hain?" Phir woh wohi baaten zikr karte hain jo maine pehle zikr ki hain. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "And Fadl, the son of Al-Abbas, the son of Abdul-Muttalib, the son of Hashim, also known as Abu Muhammad, fought with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, in Makkah and Hunayn. He remained steadfast with him when people turned away defeated. He witnessed the Farewell Pilgrimage with him and was among those who washed the Messenger of Allah's body and participated in his burial. Then he went out to Sham (Syria) to engage in jihad in the area of Jordan during the Amwas plague, in the year eighteen after the Hijrah, during the caliphate of Umar ibn al-Khattab."
hi: "Aur Al-Fadl bin Al-Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim, jinki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Makkah aur Hunain mein jung ki, aur jab log shikast khaakar peeche hate, to unke sath jame rahe, aur unhone unke sath Hajjat-ul-Wida mein shirkat ki, aur woh un logon mein se the jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghusl diya aur unke dafan ki zimmedaari li, phir Sham (Syria) ki taraf jihad ke liye, Jordan ke ilaaqe mein, nikle, Umwaas ke taa'oon mein, hijrat ke atharah (18) saal, Umar bin Al-Khattab ki khilafat mein."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Ma'in saying, "Al-Fadl bin Abbas was killed on the Day of Yarmouk during the era of Abu Bakr As-Siddiq."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Al-Fadl bin Abbas Yarmook ke din, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ke daur mein, qatl kiye gaye."

e: [AI] Regarding Al-Fadl bin Abbas.
hi: Al-Fadl bin Abbas ke baare mein.

e: [AI] About Al-Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib
hi: Al-Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ke baare mein.

e: [AI] Indeed, favor was akin to the level of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the night he gathered, and when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away, he said, "O people, upon you is tranquility, for righteousness is not in the excessive waste of horses and camels." Al-Dhahabi removed it from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: Beshak Al-Fadl, Jam' (Muzdalifah) ki raat, Rasulullah (SAW) ke peeche sawaar the, jab Rasulullah (SAW) wahan se rawaana huay (afaadah), to farmaya: "Aye logo, sukoon ikhtiyar karo, kyunke neki ghodon aur oonton ko tez daudaane mein nahi." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] It is said about Jameel, who has two hearts, that from his intelligence, Allah said, "Allah has not made for any man two hearts in his interior" (Quran 33:4). He witnessed the battle of Hunayn with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Shurahbil ibn Hasanah died on the Day of Yarmouk during the caliphate of Umar, in the year eighteen.
hi: Jameel (Shurahbil) ko unki aqal ki wajah se 'do dilon wala' kaha jaata tha, yahan tak ke Allah ne farmaya: "{Allah ne kisi aadmi ke seene mein do dil nahi banaaye}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 4), aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain mein shirkat ki, aur Shurahbil bin Hasanah Yarmook ke din, Umar ki khilafat mein, atharah (18) hijri mein, faut huay.

e: [AI] "Shurahbil, the son of Hassanah and his mother Hassanah, who was from the Adwaliyah tribe. And Abu Shurahbil, Abdullah ibn al-Muta' ibn Amr from the Kindah tribe, an ally of the Banu Zahrah, known as Abu Abdullah. He was one of the second wave of emigrants from Abyssinia."
hi: "Aur Shurahbil bin Hasanah, aur Hasanah unki maa thin, woh Adwaliyah (qabile ki) thin, aur Shurahbil ke waalid Abdullah bin Al-Mutaa' bin Amr, Kindah se, Banu Zuhrah ke ahd-waale saathi the, unki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, aur woh Habsha (Abyssinia) ki doosri hijrat ke muhaajir the."

e: [AI] About Muhammad ibn Ishaq: "Regarding the naming of the one who immigrated to Abyssinia, Shurahbil ibn Hasanah, his mother, Hassana, immigrated to the land of Abyssinia with her husband, Sufyan ibn Ma'mar ibn Habib ibn Hudhaifah ibn Jumah."
hi: Muhammad bin Ishaq se: "Habsha ki taraf hijrat karne walon ke naamon mein, Shurahbil bin Hasanah the, unki maa Hasanah ne apne shohar Sufyan bin Ma'mar bin Habib bin Wahb bin Hudhaafah bin Jumah ke sath Habsha ki zameen ki taraf hijrat ki."

e: [AI] "Shurahbil ibn Abdullah ibn al-Mutaa ibn Amr ibn Abdul Aziz and his mother Hassana, and their alliance is with Uthman ibn Habib. Shurahbil ibn Hassana passed away during the Amwas plague in the year 18, at the age of seventy-six."
hi: "Shurahbil bin Abdullah bin Al-Mutaa' bin Amr bin Abdul Aziz, aur unki maa Hasanah thin, aur unki wala'a (aazaadi ka rishta) Uthman bin Habib ke sath thi, aur Shurahbil bin Hasanah Umwaas ke taa'oon mein, atharah (18) hijri mein, faut huay, jabke woh sattar (67) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] That Al-Najashi sent Umm Habibah to the Prophet ﷺ along with Shurahbil ibn Hasannah.
hi: Beshak Najashi ne Umm Habibah (RA) ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas Shurahbil bin Hasanah ke sath bheja.

e: [AI] "Shurahbil ibn Hasana was one of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He participated in battles with him, and he was one of the leaders appointed by Abu Bakr As-Siddiq to lead military expeditions in the Sham region."
hi: "Shurahbil bin Hasanah Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, unhone unke sath jangon mein shirkat ki, aur woh un ameeron mein se aik the jinhein Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne Sham (Syria) par muqarrar kiya tha."

e: [AI] "Amr lied when he claimed that he accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Amr is more misguided than a stray camel from its people. However, he is a mercy from your Lord and a call from your Prophet ﷺ , and the departure of the righteous before you." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Amr ne jhoot bola, main Rasulullah (SAW) ka saathi raha houn, aur Amr apne khaandaan ke oont se zyada gumraah hai, lekin yeh (jo bhi hua) tumhare Rab ki rehmat, tumhare Nabi (SAW) ki dua, aur tumse pehle neik logon ki wafaat hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Jandal ibn Suhail ibn Amr, his name is Abdullah ibn Suhail ibn Amr ibn Abd Shams ibn Nadar ibn Malik ibn Hisl ibn Amir ibn Lu'ay, and his mother is the sister of Abu Jandal, from the Banu Nawfal ibn Abd Manaf. He participated in the Battle of Badr and was originally with the polytheists. However, when the battle of Badr took place, he fled to the Messenger of Allah and was martyred on the day of Yamamah. "This is how I found his death in the history of Shabab, and I think he was delirious at the time of his death."
hi: Abu Jandal bin Suhail bin Amr, jinka naam Abdullah bin Suhail bin Amr bin Abd Shams bin Nadr bin Malik bin Hisl bin Aamir bin Luway tha, aur Abu Jandal ki maa Faakhitah, Banu Naufal bin Abd Manaf se thin, unhone Badr mein shirkat ki aur mushrikeen ke sath the, jab Badr mein utre, to Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf bhaag aaye, aur woh Yamamah ke din shaheed kiye gaye. "Maine unki wafaat isi tarah Shabbaab ki Taareekh mein paayi, aur mujhe lagta hai unhein wafaat ke waqt ke baare mein ghalat-fehmi hui hai."

e:
[AI] "Abu Jandal bin Suhail bin Amr embraced Islam in Mecca a long time ago, but his father, Suhail bin Amr, imprisoned him and kept him chained. He prohibited him from migrating. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  established the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, Suhail bin Amr came to him and the Messenger of Allah agreed to what Suhail desired. Abu Jandal, who was still in chains, approached the Messenger of Allah in protest. The Messenger of Allah returned him to his father due to the agreement between them.

However, Abu Jandal managed to escape later on and caught up with Abu Basir, who was in Al-'Ays with a group of Muslims. Whenever a trade caravan from Quraysh passed by them, they would intercept it and kill those whom they were able to overpower, taking their belongings. Abu Jandal remained with Abu Basir until the death of Abu Basir. Abu Jandal then went ahead and joined the Muslims who were in Madinah under the leadership of the Messenger of Allah. He continued to participate in battles and fought in the path of Allah after the death of the Messenger of Allah until he died due to a plague called Amawas in the 18th year of the caliphate of Umar ibn al-Khattab."
hi: "Abu Jandal bin Suhail bin Amr ne Makkah mein bohot pehle Islam qubool kiya, to unke waalid Suhail bin Amr ne unhein qaid kiya aur loha (zanjeeron) mein jakad diya, aur unhein hijrat karne se roka. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Hudaibiyah mein utre, aur Suhail bin Amr unke paas aaye aur jis baat par faisla hua uspar faisla kiya, to Abu Jandal apni zanjeeron mein latakte huay Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf aaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein unke waalid ki taraf wapas kar diya, kyunke sulah unke darmiyan ho chuki thi. Phir iske baad woh nikal bhaage aur Abu Baseer ke sath jaa milay, jo Al-Ees mein the, aur unke sath Musalmano ki aik jama'at jama ho chuki thi, aur jab bhi unke paas se Quraish ka koi qaafla guzarta, to woh usse rok lete, unme se jinhein qaboo kar sakte unhein qatl kar dete, aur unka jo saamaan haasil kar sakte woh le lete. Abu Jandal Abu Baseer ke sath rahe yahan tak ke Abu Baseer ka intiqaal hua, phir Abu Jandal aur unke sath Musalman, Rasulullah (SAW) ke daur mein, Madinah aaye, aur woh unke sath aur unke baad Allah ki raah mein jihad karte rahe yahan tak ke Sham (Syria) mein, Umwaas ke taa'oon mein, hijrat ke atharah (18) saal, Umar bin Al-Khattab ki khilafat mein, faut huay."

e: [AI] She said, "What are you doing to me in front of people, announcing our relationship before both of them?" He said, "Are you renting me to the polytheists?" So he left and she said, "O mother of Hanin, I went to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have never seen anything from my son that I could barely escape from him. I hired him for protection against the polytheists, and he started to chase them to kill them.' The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'That was not for him. I have already granted rewards to those who deserve them and granted safety to those who deserve it.' So I went back to them and informed them, and they went back to their homes. It was said to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, that Al-Harith bin Hisham and Abdullah bin Abi Rabee'ah were sitting among their friends, whispering in the midst of a dark gathering. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'There is no way to them. We have granted them safety.' Al-Harith bin Hisham said, 'I felt shy for the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, to see me and to mention my vision in every place among the polytheists. Then I mentioned his kindness and mercy, so I met him while he was entering the mosque. He greeted me with glad tidings and waited until I approached him to greet him and bear witness to the truth. He said, 'Praise be to Allah who guided you. There was no one like you who was ignorant of Islam.'" Al-Harith said, "By Allah, I have never seen anything like Islam being unknown."
hi: Aur unhone (Ali RA ne) kaha: "Tum yeh mere sath sab logon se pehle karti ho?" Unhone kaha: "Kya tum mushrikeen ko panaah deti ho?" To woh nikal gaye. Umm Hani (RA) ne kaha: to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayi, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), meri maa ke bete Ali (RA) se mujhe jo pareshaani hui uska mujhe andaaza nahi tha, main unse mushkil se bach saki, maine apne do damaadon ko mushrikeen mein se panaah di thi, to woh unpar toot pade unhein qatl karne ke liye." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein aisa karne ka koi haq nahi, humne jise tumne panaah di usse panaah di, aur jise tumne amaan di usse amaan di." To main unke paas wapas gayi aur unhein bataaya, to woh apne gharon ki taraf wapas chale gaye. Rasulullah (SAW) se kaha gaya ke Al-Harith bin Hisham aur Abdullah bin Abi Rabee'ah apni majlis mein baithe teer-andaazi ka muqaabla kar rahe hain, zaafraani rangi kapdon mein, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke khilaaf koi raasta nahi, humne unhein amaan de di hai." Al-Harith bin Hisham ne kaha: "Aur main sharm mehsoos karta tha ke Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe dekhein, aur mujhe har jagah unki mujhe mushrikeen ke sath dekhne ki yaad aati, phir mujhe unki mehrbaani aur rehmat yaad aati, to maine unhein masjid mein dakhil hote hue paaya, unhone mujhse khush-dili se mulaqaat ki aur ruk gaye yahan tak ke main unke paas aaya, maine unhein salaam kiya aur haq ki gawahi di, to unhone farmaya: 'Sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne tumhein hidayat di, tum jaise (hikmat wale) shakhs ke liye munaasib nahi ke woh Islam se anjaan rahe.'" Al-Harith ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi Islam jaisi koi cheez anjaan (nahi maana) nahi dekhi."

e: [AI] "O people, I did not come out of my own desire from among you, nor did I choose one place over another for myself. Rather, this matter had already been decided and certain men from the Quraysh were chosen by Allah to carry out this task. Those men were not from the tooth or homes of Mecca. By Allah, if the mountains of Mecca were made of gold and we spent it all in the way of Allah, we would not have reached one day of their days. And I swear by Allah, if they were to miss out on worldly gains, we would seek to match them in the Hereafter. So fear Allah, for a man who goes out as a warrior has gone out (for the sake of Allah)." And he went out as a warrior toward Sham (Syria) and was martyred. The narration ends here.
hi: "Aye logo, main apni khwahish se tum logon ko chhod kar nahi nikla, aur na hi maine apne watan par kisi doosre watan ko tarjeeh di, lekin yeh maamla ho chuka hai, aur ismein Quraish ke kuch log nikle, Allah ki qasam, woh na unke buzurgon mein se the na unke khaas gharon mein se, phir bhi main subah utha, Allah ki qasam, agar Makkah ke pahaad sona ho jaayen aur hum unhein Allah ki raah mein kharch kar dein, to hum unke aik din ka bhi muqaabla nahi kar sakte, aur Allah ki qasam, agar woh humein duniya mein peeche chhod gaye hain, to hum zaroor koshish karenge ke hum Aakhirat mein unke shareek ho sakein, isliye jo bhi jung ke liye nikle woh Allah se daray." To woh Sham (Syria) ki taraf jihad ke liye nikle aur shaheed hokar qatl kiye gaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He fought alongside them and escaped with his head intact. Tamra and Lujam were the reins of his horse. Al-Harith ibn Hisham apologized for running away that day. Allah knows what I left behind in their fight until they threw my horse down to the ground. It was covered in foam and I realized that if I tried to fight one, I would be killed and my enemy would not be harmed by my attack. So, I turned away from them and my loved ones among them desired punishment for them on the day of the ambush. Then, I joined a battle with the polytheists, but I continued to hold onto polytheism until I embraced Islam on the day of the conquest of Mecca. Aisha narrated this story about Al-Harith."
hi: unke saamne jung karne se, aur woh sirf apne ghode ke sar aur lagaam ke sahaare bach nikle, to Al-Harith bin Hisham ne, us din apni bhaagne ki maazrat karte huay, kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Allah jaanta hai maine unse jung nahi chhodi jab tak unhone mere surkh, jhaag-daar ghode par teer nahi phenke, to mujhe pata chal gaya ke agar main aik se bhi jung karunga, to main qatl ho jaaunga, aur mera dushman meri maujoodgi se koi nuqsaan nahi uthaayega, isliye main unse mudh gaya jabke mere aziz unke darmiyan the, is ummeed mein ke unhein aik dekhne wale din saza mile." Phir woh mushrikeen ke sath Uhud ki jung mein gaye, aur shirk par jame rahe yahan tak ke woh Fatah-e-Makkah ke din Musalman huay. Aisha (RA) ne Al-Harith se riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] He asked the Prophet ﷺ , "How does inspiration come to you?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "It comes to me like the ringing of a bell, and it breaks off from me, and I remember what is said. Sometimes the angel comes to me in the form of a man and speaks to me, and I remember what he says." I do not know of anyone who narrated this hadeeth from Aisha except Al-Harith Ibn Salim. This hadeeth has been narrated by the companions of Hishaam from his father, from Aisha, regarding Al-Harith Ibn Hishaam asking about this hadeeth.
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) se poocha: "Aap par wahi kaise aati hai?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kabhi ghanti ki jhankaar jaisi aawaaz mein aati hai, phir mujhse chhut jaati hai, aur mujhe woh yaad rehta hai jo usne kaha, aur yeh mere liye sabse sakht hoti hai, aur kabhi farishta mere paas insaan ki shakl mein aata hai, phir mujhse baat karta hai, to mujhe woh yaad rehta hai jo woh kehta hai." Mujhe kisi aur ka pata nahi jisne Aisha se, Al-Harith bin Hisham ke hawaale se, yeh hadith riwayat ki ho siwaye Aamir bin Salih ke, aur Hisham ke sahaba ne unke waalid se, unhone Aisha se, riwayat ki hai ke Al-Harith bin Hisham ne yeh hadith poochi.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up as a preacher and ordered the charity of Fitr, a saa' (measurement) of dates or a saa' of barley, for everyone be it an individual or for each person in the family, both young and old, a saa' of dates or a saa' of wheat or a saa' of raisins."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) khutba dene khade huay aur Sadaqat-ul-Fitr ka hukum diya, har aik ki taraf se aik saa' (paimana) khajoor ya aik saa' jau, ya har sar (aadmi), chhota ho ya bada, ki taraf se aik saa' khajoor ya do mudd (chhota paimana) gehun."

e: [AI] "And Abdullah ibn Tha'labah ibn Suayr ibn Abi Suayr al-Adawi was born four years before the Hijrah. He was carried to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who wiped his face and blessed him during the year of the conquest. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away when Abdullah ibn Tha'labah was fourteen years old. Abdullah ibn Tha'labah, also known as Abu Muhammad, passed away in the year ninety-nine at the age of ninety-three."
hi: "Aur Abdullah bin Tha'labah bin Su'air bin Abi Su'air Al-Adawi, unki paidaish Hijrat se chaar (4) saal pehle hui, unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, aap (SAW) ne unke chehre par haath phera aur Fatah ke saal unke liye barkat ki dua ki, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka intiqaal us waqt hua jab woh chaudah (14) saal ke thay, aur Abdullah bin Tha'labah, jinki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi, unka intiqaal navvai (89) hijri mein hua, jabke woh terah-navvai (93) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ wiped his head.
hi: "Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne unke sar par haath phera."

e: [AI] "On the authority of Abdullah ibn Tha'labah ibn Suayr al-'Udhri, he said: 'I was born in the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to me and wiped his face and blessed me.'"
hi: Abdullah bin Tha'labah bin Su'air Al-Udhri se, "unki paidaish Fatah ke saal hui, to unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, aap (SAW) ne unke chehre par haath phera aur unke liye barkat ki dua ki."

e: [AI] "And among the allies of Quraysh was Abdullah son of Adi son of Al-Hamra Al-Zuhri, and his mother is the daughter of Sharik son of Amr son of Wahb son of Sharik, and the patronym of Abdullah son of Adi is Abu Amr."
hi: Aur Quraish ke ahd-waale saathiyon mein se, Abdullah bin Adi bin Al-Hamra Az-Zuhri the, unki maa Shareeq bin Amr bin Wahb bin Shareeq ki beti thin, aur Abdullah bin Adi ki kunniyat Abu Amr thi.

e: [AI] Ibn Umar said, "Abdullah bin 'Adi passed away during the caliphate of Umar bin Khattab."
hi: Ibn Umar (ne kaha): "Abdullah bin Adi ka intiqaal Umar bin Al-Khattab ki khilafat mein hua."

e: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he was on his she-camel, standing in Al-Hazwarah* saying: ‘By Allah, you are the best land of Allah, and the dearest of the land of Allah to me. By Allah, had I not been expelled from you I would never have left.’” *A place in Makkah. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3108)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Al-Hazwarah par khade huay aur farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, main jaanta houn ke tu Allah ki behtareen zameen hai, aur Allah ki zameen mein mujhe sabse zyada aziz, aur agar mujhe tujhse nikaala na jaata, to main na nikalta."

e: [AI] Khalid ibn Urfa'tah ibn Abrahah ibn Shayban ibn Hisl ibn Hind ibn Abdullah ibn Ghaylan ibn Aslam ibn Udhrah Hali'f ibn Zuhrah, and Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas was his governor of Qadisiyyah.
hi: "Aur Khalid bin Urfutah bin Abrahah bin Shaiban bin Hisl bin Hind bin Abdullah bin Ghailaan bin Aslam bin Uzrah, Banu Zuhrah ke ahd-waale saathi, aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne unhein Qaadisiyyah ka ameer banaya tha."

e: ‘Whoever lies upon me intentionally, then let him take his seat in the Fire’. (Using translation from Muslim 3)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jisne mere baare mein jaan-boojh kar jhoot bola, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "There will be trials, tribulations, divisions, and disagreements. So, if you can be the one who is killed and not the one who kills, then do so." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Naye maamlaat, fitna, tafarqa, aur ikhtilaaf honge, jab aisa ho, to agar tum se ho sake ke tum qatl hone wale bano, qatl karne wale nahi, to aisa karo." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Suhail bin Amr is also known as Abu Yazid"
hi: "Suhail bin Amr ki kunniyat Abu Yazid thi."

e:
[AI] "The Close Sea"

I yearned for Suhail and desired nothing but him among all nations. A bright star knows that when the young Suhail's arrow is steady, I struck with my sharp blade until he bends. I hated myself for such blessings. He said, "Who is his father? Abdullah is his father, and he is from the early emigrants. He witnessed Badr and was a companion to the Prophet ﷺ, and Uthba Al-Asghar." This is what Al-Dhahabi omitted from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: (Bahr Al-Mutaqaarib mein): "Maine Suhail ko qaid kiya, aur mujhe sab qaumon mein se usske siwa kisi ki khwahish nahi thi, aur Khindif jaanta hai ke jawaan Suhail uska (Khindif ka) jawaan hai jab woh saf mein khada hota hai, maine tez talwaar se waar kiya yahan tak ke woh jhuk gaya, aur maine apne aap ko maal-daar (dushman) par majboor kiya." Unhone kaha: "Aur unki aulaad mein Abdullah hain, jo pehle Muhajireen mein se hain aur Badr mein shirkat ki, aur Abu Jandal, jo Nabi (SAW) ke saathi rahe, aur Utbah Al-Asghar (chhote)." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The status of one in the path of Allah for an hour is better for him than his entire life with his family." Suhail said, "And I will remain stationed (in the battlefield) until I die and never return to Mecca." So, he remained stationed in the Levant until he died from the plague of ‘Amawas. Indeed, this plague occurred in the Levant in the year eighteen after the Hijrah." Al-Dhahabi excluded it from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Tum mein se kisi aik ka Allah ki raah mein aik ghadi khada rehna uski poori zindagi apne ghar walon ke sath kaam karne se behtar hai." Suhail ne kaha: "Aur main ribaat (sarhad ki nigraani) karta rahunga yahan tak ke main mar jaaun, aur main Makkah kabhi wapas nahi jaaunga." To woh Sham mein ribaat karte rahe yahan tak ke wahin Umwaas ke taa'oon mein unka intiqaal hua, aur yeh taa'oon Sham mein hijrat ke atharah (18) saal mein hua. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "And by Allah, he was well-peaked (referring to the physical appearance of the Prophet Muhammad) and he loved them (referring to his Companions). He had advised them, so Abu Sufyan said, 'I have never seen a day like this before, where slaves are given precedence and we, who are sitting here, are not even looked at.' So Suhayl ibn Amr said, 'Oh, what a wise man he is! O people, I swear by Allah, I can see what is on your faces, so if you are angry, be angry with yourselves. The people have been called and they have responded quickly, while you have lagged behind. By Allah, what they have gone ahead with in terms of virtue in what they see, is harder for you to attain than a gap from your doorway to the goal you are competing for.' Then he said, 'Indeed, these people have surpassed you in what they see, and there is no way for you to catch up with them by Allah. Look at this jihad, and cling to it, perhaps Allah Almighty will bless you with it. Then he shook his garment, got up, and joined the army going to Sham (Greater Syria).' Al-Hasan said, 'By Allah, he spoke the truth. Allah does not make a servant faster in pursuing something than another servant who is slower in reaching it.'" The summarize of this statement was omitted by Al-Dhahabi.
hi: Aur Allah ki qasam, woh (Bilal RA) Badr mein shirkat karne wale the, aur (Rasulullah SAW) unse mohabbat karte the, aur unhone unke baare mein wasiyat ki thi. To Abu Sufyan ne kaha: "Maine aaj jaisa din kabhi nahi dekha, ke in ghulaamon ko ijaazat di jaaye jabke hum baithe hain aur humari taraf tawajjo nahi di jaati." To Suhail bin Amr ne kaha, aur kaisa hikmat wale aadmi the woh: "Aye qaum, Allah ki qasam, main tumhare chehron par jo hai woh dekh raha houn, agar tum ghusse mein ho, to apne aap par ghussa karo, qaum ko bulaaya gaya aur tumhein bhi bulaaya gaya, unhone jaldi ki aur tumne der ki, khabardaar, Allah ki qasam, jo bhalaai unhone tumse pehle haasil ki, unke nazdeek, tumhare liye is darwaze se zyada bada nuqsaan hai jispar tum muqaabla kar rahe ho." Phir kaha: "Beshak yeh qaum tumse jo tum dekhte ho usme aage nikal gayi hai, aur Allah ki qasam, tumhare liye koi raasta nahi jispar unhone tumse pehle qadam rakha hai, isliye is jihad ki taraf dekho aur isse jame raho, shaayad Allah, buzurg aur buland, tumhein jihad aur shahaadat ka rizq de." Phir apna kapda jhaadaa, khade huay, aur Sham (Syria) ki taraf chal pade. Al-Hasan ne kaha: "Unhone sach kaha, Allah ki qasam, Allah kisi bande ko, jo uski taraf jaldi aaya, aisa nahi banaata jaisa woh bande ko banaata hai jo derr se aaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, allow me to remove my two braids, Suhaib ibn 'Amr should never stand as a preacher in his people." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Leave him, perhaps it will please you one day." Sufyan said, when the Prophet ﷺ died, the people of Makkah dispersed, and Suhaib ibn 'Amr stood by the Kaaba and said, "Whoever used to worship Muhammad ﷺ, know that Muhammad has died, but Allah is ever-living and never dies."
hi: Umar (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe ijaazat dein main Suhail bin Amr ke aage ke do daant nikaal doon, taake woh kabhi apni qaum mein khateeb (mimbar par baat karne wale) bankar na khade ho sakein." To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein chhod do, shaayad woh aik din tumhein khush karein." Sufyan ne kaha: jab Nabi (SAW) ka intiqaal hua, to Makkah walon mein bhagdad macha (murtad honay ka khadsha hua), to Suhail bin Amr Ka'bah ke paas khade huay aur kaha: "Jiska ma'bood Muhammad (SAW) tha, to Muhammad (SAW) ka intiqaal ho chuka hai, aur Allah zinda hai, kabhi nahi marta." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Bilal ibn Rabah, the freed slave of Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, known as Abu Abdullah, was born in Surat and died in Damascus in the year twenty. He was buried near the Small Gate in the cemetery of Damascus, at the age of sixty-six."
hi: "Bilal bin Rabaah, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, jinki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, aur woh As-Suraat (pahaadi qabeelon) mein se paida huay the, unka intiqaal Dimashq (Damascus) mein bees (20) hijri mein hua, unhein Al-Baab As-Sagheer (chhota darwaza) ke paas, Dimashq ke qabristan mein dafan kiya gaya, jabke unki umr saath se zyada (chhaasath ke qareeb) thi."

e: [AI] I heard Shu'ayb ibn Talhah saying, "Bilal was the servant of Abu Bakr, and Shu'ayb was more knowledgeable about Bilal's birth."
hi: Maine Shu'aib bin Talhah ko kehte suna: "Bilal Abu Bakr (RA) ke hum-umr (peer) the, aur Shu'aib Bilal ki paidaish ke baare mein zyada jaante the."

e: [AI] Someone told me that whoever saw Bilal would describe him as a man who was very dark-skinned, thin and tall. He had abundant light hair, with fine eyebrows. He had a lot of freckles and his face never changed. Bilal witnessed Badr, Uhud, the trench, and all the other important events alongside the Messenger of Allah, and he was as close to the Messenger of Allah as Ubaydah ibn al-Harith ibn Abdul-Muttalib.
hi: Mujhe aik aise shakhs ne bataya jinhone Bilal ko dekha tha: "Woh aik sakht saanwla, dubla-patla, lamba aadmi the, thode jhuke huay, unke bohot baal the, halke gaal ke baal (dadhi), unme kaafi safedi (baalon mein) thi, aur woh (rangte) nahi the, aur Bilal ne Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke aur Ubaidah bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib ke darmiyan (Islami) bhai-chaara qaayam kiya."

e: [AI] "Bilal ibn Rabah, nicknamed Abu Amr, and Umm Bilal, known as Hamama, reached the age of sixty-seven. They were buried near the small gate in the cemetery of Damascus."
hi: "Bilal bin Rabaah, Abu Amr, aur Bilal ki maa Hamaamah thin, woh sattaasath (67) saal tak pahunche, aur unhein Al-Baab As-Sagheer ke paas, Dimashq ke qabristan mein dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] "And indeed, he witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He was a black man by birth, whom Abu Bakr bought from Umayyah ibn Khalaf. Abu Bakr gave him as a gift, and in return, he took Bilal. His mother's name was Hamamah. Both he and his mother became Muslim. He was known as Abu Abdullah. He passed away in Damascus in the year twenty (AH) or it is said eighteen."
hi: Aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki, aur woh aik kaale, ghulaam-paida hue the, Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein Umayyah bin Khalaf se khareeda, Abu Bakr (RA) ne (Umayyah ko) aik ghulam diya aur uske badle Bilal ko liya, aur unki maa ka naam Hamaamah tha, dono ne aik sath Islam qubool kiya, aur unki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, unka intiqaal Dimashq mein bees (20) hijri mein hua, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai atharah (18).

e: [AI] I passed by Bilal while he was in the mosque, so I said, "O Abu Abdullah, what keeps you seated?" He replied, "I am waiting for the sunrise."
hi: Main Bilal ke paas se guzra jabke woh masjid mein the, maine kaha: "Aye Abu Abdullah, aapko kis cheez ne baithaaya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Main suraj ke tulu' honay ka intezaar kar raha houn."

e: [AI] It is said that Abu Amr is the slave of Abu Bakr.
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai Abu Amr, Abu Bakr (RA) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam.
