e: [AI] It is said that Umar ibn Abdullah al-Madani is a mawla of Ufrata.
hi: Kaha jaata hai Umar bin Abdullah Al-Madani, Ufrah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam.

e: [AI] "Bilal had a brother who belonged to the Arabs and claimed to be one of them. He proposed to marry a woman from the Arab tribe, and they said, 'If Bilal approves, we will marry you to her.' Bilal attended and said, 'I am Bilal ibn Rabah, and this is my brother. He has a bad character and religion. If you want to marry him, go ahead, and if you want to reject, feel free to do so.' They said, 'Whoever his brother is, we will marry him.' They married him and it is a valid narration, without any contradiction. This is the story of Bilal's brother."
hi: Bilal ke aik bhai the jo Arab se apna nasab jodte the aur dawa karte the ke woh unme se hain, unhone Arab ki aik aurat se nikah ka paighaam bheja, unhone kaha: "Agar Bilal maujood ho to hum aapka nikah karwaayenge." Unhone kaha: to Bilal aaye aur kaha: "Main Bilal bin Rabaah (RA) houn, aur yeh mera bhai hai, aur yeh burre akhlaaq aur deen wala aadmi hai, agar tum chaaho to iska nikah karwaao, aur agar tum chaaho to chhod do." To unhone kaha: "Jo bhi inka bhai ho hum uska nikah karwaayenge," to unhone unka nikah karwaya. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur Bilal ke is bhai ki aik riwayat bhi hai. Sahih.

e: "The first people to declare their Islam publicly were seven: The Messenger of Allah, Abu Bakr, 'Ammar and his mother Sumayyah, Suhaib, Bilal and Miqdad. With regard to the Messenger of Allah, Allah protected him through his paternal uncle Abu Talib. With regard to Abu Bakr, Allah protected him through his people. As for the rest, the idolators seized them and made them wear coats of chain-mail and exposed them to the intense heat of the sun. There was none of them who did not do what they wanted them to do, except for Bilal. He did not care what happened to him for the sake of Allah, and his people did not care what happened to him. Then they gave him to the children who took him around in the streets of Makkah while he was saying, 'Ahad, Ahad (One, One).'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 150)
hi: Beshak sabse pehle jinhone apna Islam zaahir kiya woh saat (7) the - Rasulullah (SAW), to Allah ne unhein unke chacha Abu Talib ke zariye bachaaya, aur Abu Bakr, to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein unki qaum ke zariye bachaaya, aur baaqi sab ko mushrikeen ne pakad liya, unhein loha ki zirahen pehnaayin aur suraj mein khada kiya, to koi bhi aisa nahi tha jisne unhein jo woh chaahte the woh na de diya ho, siwaye Bilal (RA) ke, kyunke unke liye apni jaan Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki khaatir haqeer thi, aur unki qaum ke nazdeek bhi woh haqeer the, to unhein bacchon ke hawaale kar diya gaya, woh unhein Makkah ki galiyon mein ghumaate rahe, aur woh kehte rahe: "Aik, aik." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The age of "Abu Bakr our master and our master set him free," meaning that Bilal is true and it has not been rejected.
hi: Umar (RA) (ne kaha): "Abu Bakr (RA) humare sardaar hain, aur unhone humare sardaar (Bilal) ko aazaad kiya." Sahih, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] Umar mentioned the virtue of Abu Bakr and started describing his qualities. Then he said, "And this is our master Bilal, a good deed from the good deeds of Abu Bakr." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Umar (RA) ne Abu Bakr (RA) ki fazeelat ka zikr kiya, unki khoobiyon ka bayan karne lage, phir kaha: "Aur yeh humare sardaar Bilal (RA), Abu Bakr (RA) ki neekiyon mein se aik neeki hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr freed seven people who were being tortured for the sake of Allah Almighty, including Bilal and Amr ibn Fuhayrah." This hadeeth is authenticated according to the conditions of both the Shaykhs (referring to Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but they did not include it in their collections.
hi: "Abu Bakr (RA) ne saat (7) logon ko aazaad kiya jinhein Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki khaatir azaab diya jaata tha, unme Bilal (RA) aur Aamir bin Fuhairah (RA) bhi the." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of the Sudaan are three: Luqman, Bilal, and Mihja, the slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. They possess a sound chain of narration and have never fabricated anything.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sudan (kaale) logon mein sabse behtareen teen hain - Luqman, Bilal (RA), aur Mihja' (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are four foremost individuals: I am foremost among the Arabs, Salman is foremost among the Persians, Bilal is foremost among the Ethiopians, and Suhaib is foremost among the Romans. Imarah ibn Zayd is also regarded as foremost by virtue of his distinction from Thabit." This hadith was omitted by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabqat (sabse pehle) chaar hain - main Arab mein sabqat rakhta houn, aur Salman (RA) Farsiyon mein sabqat rakhte hain, aur Bilal (RA) Habshiyon mein sabqat rakhte hain, aur Suhaib (RA) Roomiyon mein sabqat rakhte hain." Umaarah bin Zaadhan akele hi ise Thaabit se riwayat karte hain. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "What a good man Bilal is; he is the leader of the Mu'adhdhins (those who call for prayer). No one follows him except for the Mu'adhdhins. And the Mu'adhdhins will be the tallest people on the Day of Resurrection." This statement was specifically mentioned by Husam and deleted by al-Dhahabi due to its weakness in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Bilal (RA), woh muezzino ke sardaar hain, aur unki koi pairavi nahi karta siwaye muezzin ke, aur muezzin Qayamat ke din logon mein sabse lambi gardan wale honge." Husaam akele hi ise riwayat karte hain. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] One day, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  woke up and called Bilal. He said, "O Bilal, how did you surpass me to Paradise last night? I heard the rustling of your footsteps in front of me, so I followed it until I reached a square-golden palace surrounded by a balcony. I asked, 'Whose palace is this?' They replied, 'It belongs to a man from the Quraysh.' I asked, 'Am I from the Quraysh?' They said, 'No, it belongs to Umar ibn Al-Khattab.' Then Bilal said, 'O Messenger of Allah, whenever I hear the call to prayer, I never fail to perform two Rak'ahs (units of prayer). And whenever any impurity comes upon me, I always perform ablution.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'By following this practice, you have fulfilled the conditions of both Bukhari and Muslim.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) aik din subah utthe aur Bilal (RA) ko bulaaya, farmaya: "Aye Bilal (RA), kal raat tum kis (amal) ki wajah se Jannat mein mujhse aage nikal gaye? Maine apne aage tumhare qadmon ki aawaaz suni, main aik chaukor, buland, sone ke mahal ke paas pahuncha, maine poocha: yeh mahal kiska hai? Unhone kaha: aik Quraishi aadmi ka. Maine kaha: main bhi Quraishi houn, yeh mahal kiska hai? Unhone kaha: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ka." To Bilal (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine kabhi azaan nahi di magar do rak'atein padhi hain, aur mujhe kabhi koi hadath (wudu tootne wali cheez) nahi hui magar maine usi waqt wudu kiya." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Isi wajah se." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "I saw the Prophet ﷺ  when he arrived in 'Ukaz, so I asked him, 'Who is with you in this matter?' He replied, 'Two men, Abu Bakr and Bilal.' So I embraced Islam, and indeed I saw myself in the quarter of Islam." (Authentic chain of narration, but not included by Al-Dhahabi in his summary due to its weakness)
hi: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha jabke woh Ukaaz mein utre huay the, maine poocha: is maamle mein aapke sath kaun hai? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: do aadmi, Abu Bakr (RA) aur Bilal (RA). To main Musalman ho gaya, aur maine apne aap ko dekha ke main Islam ka chautha hissa houn." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "Bilal died in the year twenty."
hi: "Bilal (RA) ka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "Abu al-Haytham ibn al-Tayhan, whose name is Malik, witnessed the First and Second Aqabah pledges from the Ansar and then from the Banu Abd al-Ashhal. He was their ally and leader, and he participated in the Battle of Badr with no aftermath for him."
hi: "Aur Ansar mein se, phir Banu Abdul Ashhal mein se, pehle aur doosre Aqabah mein shirkat karne walon mein, Abu Al-Haitham bin At-Taihaan (RA) the, jinka naam Malik tha, unke ahd-waale saathi, aur woh Naqeeb the, unhone Badr mein shirkat ki, aur unki koi aulaad na thi."

e: [AI] "And Abu Al-Haytham ibn Al-Tayhan and As'ad ibn Zurarah said: We were among the first to embrace Islam from the Ansar in Makkah and among the first to meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before their people, and we arrived in Madinah because of that. Abu Al-Haytham witnessed Al-Aqabah along with the Muslims from the Ansar, and he was one of the twelve leaders, and there was no disagreement among them in that. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ fostered a brotherhood between Abu Al-Haytham ibn Al-Tayhan and Uthman ibn Mazh'un. Abu Al-Haytham also participated in the battles of Badr, Uhud, Al-Khandaq, and all other battles along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Aur Abu Al-Haitham bin At-Taihaan (RA) aur As'ad bin Zurarah (RA) Makkah mein Ansar ke sabse pehle Musalman honay walon mein se the, aur apni qaum se pehle Rasulullah (SAW) se milne walon mein se, aur woh isi wajah se Madinah aaye. Abu Al-Haitham ne Aqabah mein Musalmano ke sath, Ansar mein se, shirkat ki, aur woh baarah (12) Naqeebon mein se aik the, ismein koi ikhtilaaf nahi. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Al-Haitham bin At-Taihaan (RA) aur Uthman bin Maz'oon (RA) ke darmiyan (Islami) bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, aur Abu Al-Haitham ne Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki."

e: [AI] "Abu al-Haytham ibn al-Tayhaan passed away during the caliphate of Umar ibn al-Khattab in Madinah."
hi: "Abu Al-Haitham bin At-Taihaan (RA) ka intiqaal Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ki khilafat mein, Madinah mein, hua."

e: [AI] I heard the elderly people of the house, meaning the descendants of Banī 'Abd al-Ashhal, saying, "Abū al-Haytham ibn al-Tayhān passed away in the year twenty in Madinah."
hi: Maine Daar (Banu Abdul Ashhal) ke buzurgon ko kehte suna: "Abu Al-Haitham bin At-Taihaan (RA) ka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein, Madinah mein, hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  one day came out of his house during noon and saw Abu Bakr sitting in the mosque. He asked him, "What brought you out, O Abu Bakr, at this hour?" Abu Bakr replied, "The same thing that brought you out, O Messenger of Allah." Then Umar came and asked, "What brought you out, O Ibn Al-Khattab?" He replied, "The same thing that brought you both out, O Messenger of Allah." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sat with them and talked to them. He then said, "Do you have the strength to go to this palm tree?" And he pointed with his hand towards the homes of the Ansar. He said, "You will find food, drink, and shade, if Allah wills." We said, "Yes." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went and we went along with him. Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) aik din dopahar ke waqt apne ghar se nikle, unhone Abu Bakr (RA) ko masjid mein baithe dekha, farmaya: "Aye Abu Bakr (RA), is waqt tumhein kya bahar laaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe wohi laaya jo aapko laaya." Phir Umar (RA) aaye, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aye Ibn Al-Khattab, tumhein kya bahar laaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), wohi jo aap dono ko laaya." To Rasulullah (SAW) unke sath baith kar baaten karne lage, phir farmaya: "Kya tum dono mein taaqat hai ke tum is khajoor ke darakht tak jaao," aur Ansar ke gharon ki taraf apne haath se ishara kiya, "khaana, paani, aur saaya paane ke liye, Allah chaahe to?" Humne kaha: "Ji haan." To Rasulullah (SAW) chal pade aur woh dono unke sath chal pade, aur hadith zikr ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Saeed bin Amir bin Hizyam bin Salaman bin Rabia bin Saad bin Jumah, and Umar appointed him as a leader of some troops in Syria. He died while still performing his duties in Syria in the year twenty."
hi: "Sa'eed bin Aamir bin Hidyam bin Salaamaan bin Rabee'ah bin Sa'd bin Jumah (RA), Umar (RA) ne unhein Sham ke kuch lashkaron ka ameer banaya, unka intiqaal us waqt hua jab woh Sham mein apne kaam par the, bees (20) hijri mein."

e: [AI] ʿUmar said to Saʿid ibn ʿAmir ibn Hidhyam, “Why do the people of Syria love you?” He replied, “I look after them and I console them.” So he gave him ten thousand, but he returned it and said, “I have servants and horses, and I am well off, and I want my work to be charity for the Muslims.” ʿUmar said, “Do not do that. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me wealth less than that, and I said something like what you have said. He said to me: ‘If Allah gives you wealth that you did not ask for and you did not set your heart upon, then take it, for it is only Allah’s provision He has given you.’”
hi: Beshak Umar (RA) ne Sa'eed bin Aamir bin Hidyam (RA) se kaha: "Sham walon ko kya hai ke woh tumse mohabbat karte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Main unka khayaal rakhta houn aur unse humdardi karta houn." To unhone unhein das hazaar (10,000) diye, unhone unhein wapas kar diya aur kaha: "Mere paas ghulam aur ghode hain, aur main achhi haalat mein houn, main chahta houn mera kaam Musalmano ke liye sadqa ho." To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Aisa mat karo, Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe isse kam maal diya tha, maine bhi tumhari tarah kuch kaha tha, to unhone mujhse farmaya: 'Jab Allah tumhein maal de jo tumne maanga na ho aur na hi apni jaan ko usspar lalchaaya ho, to use le lo, kyunke yeh Allah ka rizq hai jo usne tumhein diya hai.'"

e: [AI] "And Anas ibn Marthad ibn Abi Marthad al-Ghanawi, also known as Abu Yazid, was a companion of Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib. He passed away in the year twenty, in the month of Rabi al-Awwal. He had a twenty-one-year age difference with his father, as I mentioned before when talking about Abu Marthad al-Ghanawi. After him, his son Marthad came, and this is his grandson. All of them are from the companions, as Al-Dhahabi mentioned in his summary of their weakness."
hi: "Aur Anas bin Marthad bin Abi Marthad Al-Ghanawi (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Yazid thi, Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ke ahd-waale saathi, unka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein, Rabi-ul-Awwal mein hua, aur unke aur unke waalid ke darmiyan umr mein ikkis (21) saal ka faasla tha, maine pehle Abu Marthad Al-Ghanawi ka zikr kiya, aur unke baad unke bete Marthad ka, aur yeh unke pote hain, aur yeh sab Sahaba mein se hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "And the leader is Said, son of Hudayr, son of Simak, son of Atiq, son of Rafi, son of Imru' al-Qays, son of Zaid, son of Abdul Ashhal. He is also called Abu Yahya and he passed away in the year twenty."
hi: "Aur Usaid bin Hudhair bin Simaak bin Ateek bin Raafi' bin Imri-ul-Qais bin Zaid bin Abdul Ashhal (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Yahya thi, unka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "Abu Yahya Usaid ibn Hudayr died in the year twenty. He had witnessed the Battle of Uhud and was appointed as a military commander by Umar ibn al-Khattab in Medina. He was buried in al-Baqi Cemetery. He had two nicknames, Abu Yahya and Abu Hudayr. His father was Hudayr al-Katib. Usaid did not have any offspring."
hi: "Abu Yahya Usaid bin Hudhair (RA) ka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein hua, unhone Aqabah mein shirkat ki thi, phir woh Naqeeb bane, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza Madinah mein padhi, aur unhein Baqee' mein dafan kiya gaya, unki do kunniyaten thin, Abu Yahya aur Abu Hudhair, aur unke waalid Hudhair Al-Kaatib the, aur Usaid ki koi aulaad na thi."

e: [AI] It is said that Abu Bahir was a noble and respected person among his people during the pre-Islamic era and in Islam. He was considered one of their intellectuals and had his own opinions. He was also a scribe, just like his father Al-Hudhayr al-Katib before him. Al-Hudhayr was the leader of the Aws tribe on the day of Bu'ath (a battle) and he was killed on that day. Usaid bin Hudhayr was one of the seventy Ansar (helpers) who pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on the night of Al-Aqaba according to the narrations of all narrators. He was also one of the twelve leaders and was a brother to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  between Usaid bin Hudhayr and Zayd bin Haritha. Usaid did not actually participate in the Battle of Badr, nor did he or others from among the great companions participate in Badr itself, because they did not anticipate that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would engage in a battle or fight. However, Usaid did participate in the Battle of Uhud and on that day he received seven wounds. He remained steadfast with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when the people fled. He also witnessed the Battle of the Trench and all the other events with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . (This information was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summarization due to its weakness.)
hi: Aur unhein Abu Bahr bhi kaha jaata hai, aur Usaid Jaahiliyat aur Islam mein apni qaum mein sharif the, unhein unke hikmat walon aur raay walon mein shumaar kiya jaata tha, aur woh likhne walon mein se the, aur unke waalid Hudhair Al-Kaatib bhi aisa hi the, aur unse pehle bhi (likhne wale), aur woh Bu'ath ke din Aus ke sardaar the, aur Hudhair usi din qatl kiye gaye, aur Usaid bin Hudhair (RA) Ansar ke un sattar (70) logon mein se aik hain jinhone Aqabah ki raat Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat ki, aik riwayat mein sab (Ansar) ke sath, aur woh baarah (12) Naqeebon mein se aik hain, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Usaid bin Hudhair (RA) aur Zaid bin Haarithah (RA) ke darmiyan (Islami) bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, aur Usaid Badr mein shirkat nahi kar sake, woh aur Sahaba ke doosre bade log, Naqeebon aur doosron mein se, Badr se peeche reh gaye, kyunke unhein gumaan nahi tha ke Rasulullah (SAW) ko jung ya ladai ka saamna karna padega, aur Usaid ne Uhud mein shirkat ki, us din saat (7) zakhm khaaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jame rahe jab log bikhar gaye, aur unhone Khandaq aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] He used to recite on the back of his house and he had a beautiful voice. He said, "While I was reciting, something like a cloud covered me. The woman in the house and the horse in the stable scared me, thinking that the woman might fall. So, I became afraid and went to relieve her of her fear. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Continue your recitation, for it was an Angel who was listening to your recitation."
hi: Beshak woh apne ghar ki chhat par tilawat kiya karte the, aur unki aawaaz achhi thi, unhone kaha: to jab main padh raha tha ke mujhpar aik cheez chhaa gayi jaise baadal, aur ghar mein aik aurat thi aur ghode aangan mein tha, to mujhe darr hua ke woh (aurat/bacha ghode ki wajah se) gir na jaaye, isliye main ruk gaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Padho, kyunke yeh sirf aik farishta hai jisne Quran suna."

e: [AI] I have heard the sermon of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and whenever I witness a funeral, I have never witnessed a funeral like it before. So, I talk to myself about what has happened and what will happen to it.
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ki khutba suni, aur jab main kisi janaaze mein shaamil hota, to maine kabhi koi janaaza (aisi) nahi dekhi (jisse mujhe itna khayaal aaya ho), to maine apne aap se baat ki, siwaye is ke jo uske sath kiya jaata hai aur jispar woh (aakhirkar) pahunchti hai."

e: [AI] "Usaid ibn Hudair and Abbad ibn Bishr were with the Prophet ﷺ  on a dark night in Hindis. When they left, one of them's staff illuminated and they walked in its light. When they separated, the other's staff also illuminated." This hadith is authentic according to the criteria of Imam Muslim, and he did not exclude it in his collection of hadiths.
hi: "Usaid bin Hudhair (RA) aur Abbad bin Bishr (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aik andheri, ghani raat mein the, jab woh dono wapas gaye, to unme se aik ki lakdi (chhadi) chamakne lagi, woh dono uski roshni mein chalte rahe, jab woh alag huay, to doosre ki lakdi bhi chamakne lagi." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Usaid ibn Hudayr was a righteous, cheerful, and handsome man. While he was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he was talking to the people and making them laugh. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then stabbed him in his side. Usaid said, "You hurt me." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "Take revenge." Usaid said, "O Messenger of Allah, you have a shirt on, but I don't." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  lifted his shirt and embraced Usaid, then he kissed his wound. Usaid said, "By my father and mother, O Messenger of Allah, I wanted this." This is the wording of the hadith narrated by Jarir from Husayn. The hadith in Waraqaa is shorter with a sound chain of narration, but they did not mention it. Authentic.
hi: Usaid bin Hudhair (RA) aik neik, khush-mizaaj, khoobsurat aadmi the, jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas log se baaten kar rahe the aur unhein hansaa rahe the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke pehlu mein (khel se) chhed diya, unhone kaha: "Aapne mujhe dard diya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Badla le lo." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap qamees pehne huay hain, aur mere paas qamees nahi." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni qamees uthaayi, to unhone aap (SAW) ko gale lagaaya, phir aap (SAW) ke pehlu ko chumne lage, kehne lage: "Mere waalid aur maa aap par qurbaan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine yehi chaaha tha." Yeh Jareer ki hadith ka lafz hai, unhone Husain se riwayat ki, aur Warqaa ki hadith mukhtasar hai. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "What a noble man is Usayd ibn Hudayr."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Usaid bin Hudhair (RA)."

e: [AI] "He sighed and prayed with us while seated. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned and they said, 'O Messenger of Allah, Ussayd is our imam, but he is sick and he prayed with us while seated.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Then pray behind him while seated, for the imam should be followed. When he prays while seated, then pray behind him while seated.' This hadith has a sound chain of narration and it has not been excluded from Sahih."
hi: Beshak woh (Usaid RA) aah bharte the, aur woh humein namaz padhaate the, to unhone humein baithkar namaz padhayi, phir Rasulullah (SAW) unki mizaaj-purs karne aaye, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Usaid humare imam hain, aur woh bimaar hain, aur unhone humein baithkar namaz padhayi hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unke peechhe baithkar namaz padho, kyunke imam ki iqtida ki jaati hai, jab woh baithkar padhe to unke peechhe baithkar padho." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] So I said to him, "Glory to Allah! You are one of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and you have precedence. Why are you crying over a woman?" Then he uncovered his head and said, "You spoke the truth, by the oath of Allah. I swear, I will not cry over anyone after Saad ibn Muadh." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had said something that no one else had said. So I asked him, "What did he say?" He replied, "Indeed, the Throne has shaken because of the death of Saad ibn Muadh." Aisha said, "O Usaid ibn Hudayr, it is correct on the terms of a Muslim condition that he did not lie." Adh-Dhahabi deleted it from his summarized version due to its weakness.
hi: To maine unse kaha: "Subhan Allah, aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se hain, aur aapko sabqat (pehle honay ka sharaf) haasil hai, aapko kya hua aap aik aurat par ro rahe hain?" To unhone apna sar khola, phir kaha: "Tumne sach kaha, Allah ki umar ki qasam, Allah ki qasam, mujhe haq hai ke main Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) ke baad kisi par na roun, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne woh kaha jo unhone kaha." Maine poocha: "Unhone kya kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) ki wafaat par Arsh (Takht) hil gaya." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: aur Usaid bin Hudhair (RA) meri aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki darmiyan chal rahe the." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "The light sea: 'Ayyad, and 'Ayyad ibn Ghannam, was among the best of what women gave birth to. He was the first to journey to Rome."
hi: (Bahr Al-Khafif mein): "Iyad, aur kya cheez hai Iyad bin Ghanm! Woh un behtareen logon mein se the jinhein auraton ne janam diya, woh sabse pehle the jinhone Rome ki taraf ghaati (darb) paar ki."

e: [AI] From his elders, they said, "Ayyad ibn Ghannam ibn Zuhair ibn Abi Shaddad ibn Rabia ibn Hilal ibn Ahayb ibn Dabbah ibn Al-Harith ibn Fehr accepted Islam before the Battle of Hudaybiyyah and witnessed the Battle of Hudaybiyyah with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He had with him Umm al-Hakam bint Abi Sufyan ibn Harb. When Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah passed away, he appointed Ayyad to succeed him, and Ayyad was a righteous man. When the news of his death reached Umar ibn al-Khattab, he expressed great sorrow and mercy towards him, and he said, 'No one can take your place. Who was appointed to take care of his affairs?' They said, 'Ayyad ibn Ghannam.' Umar confirmed it and wrote to him, 'Indeed, I have appointed you to the position that Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah held, so work according to what is right for Allah upon you.' Ayyad died the day he died, and he had no wealth, nor did he owe anyone. He was buried in Sham (Greater Syria) in the year twenty at the age of sixty."
hi: Unke buzurgon se, unhone kaha: "Iyad bin Ghanm bin Zuhair bin Abi Shaddaad bin Rabee'ah bin Hilaal bin Ahyab bin Dabbah bin Al-Harith bin Fihr (RA), unhone Hudaibiyah se pehle Islam qubool kiya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hudaibiyah mein shirkat ki, aur unke nikah mein Umm Al-Hakam bint Abi Sufyan bin Harb (RA) thin. Jab Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah (RA) ki wafaat ka waqt aaya, to unhone Iyad ko apne kaam par khalifa (naib) muqarrar kiya, aur Iyad aik neik aadmi the. Jab Umar (RA) ko Abu Ubaidah ki wafaat ki khabar mili, to woh bohot 'Inna lillah' padhne aur unke liye rehmat ki dua karne lage, aur kaha: 'Koi bhi tumhari tarah mazboot nahi hoga.' Unhone poocha ke unke kaam par kise khalifa banaya gaya hai, to unhone kaha: 'Iyad bin Ghanm (RA).' To unhone unhein barqaraar rakha aur unhein likha: 'Maine tumhein wahi zimmedaari di hai jo Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah (RA) ke paas thi, isliye jo Allah ka haq tumpar hai uspar amal karo.' Iyad jis din faut huay, unke paas na koi maal tha aur na hi unpar kisi ka qarz tha, aur unka intiqaal Sham mein bees (20) hijri mein hua, jabke woh saath (60) saal ke thay." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] "Aiyaadh ibn Ghanm died at the age of twenty."
hi: "Iyad bin Ghanm (RA) ka intiqaal bees (20) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, the severest punishment for people on the Day of Judgment is the severest punishment for people in the world." Ayyad said to him, "O Hisham, we have indeed heard what you have heard and seen what you have seen, and we have accompanied those whom you have accompanied, Ibn Zariq and others."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qayamat ke din logon mein sabse sakht azaab woh honge jo duniya mein logon ko sabse sakht azaab dete the." To Iyad ne unse kaha: "Aye Hisham, humne bhi wohi suna jo aapne suna, aur humne bhi wohi dekha jo aapne dekha, aur hum bhi unke sath rahe jinke sath aap rahe."" Ibn Zurayq kamzor hain.

e: [AI] One day, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to me, "O 'Ayyad, do not marry an old woman or a barren woman, for I need you."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse aik din farmaya: "Aye Iyad, na kisi budhi aurat se nikah karo aur na hi kisi baanjh (aulaad na paida karne wali) se, kyunke main (Qayamat ke din) tumhari taadaad (Ummat ki kasrat) par fakhr karunga."

e: [AI] Al-Bara' bin Malik bin Al-Nadr bin Dammad bin Zaid bin Haram bin Jundub bin 'Amir bin Ghanm bin 'Adi bin Al-Najjar, and his mother is Umm Sulaim bint Milhan. He is the brother of Anas bin Malik from his father's side. His mother witnessed the battles of Uhud, Al-Khandaq, and all other events with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He had a valorous position in war.
hi: Al-Bara' bin Malik bin An-Nadr bin Damdam bin Zaid bin Haraam bin Jundub bin Aamir bin Ghanm bin Adi bin An-Najjaar (RA), aur unki maa Umm Sulaim bint Milhaan (RA) thin, aur woh Anas bin Malik (RA) ke waalid aur waalida donon taraf se bhai the, unhone Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur woh jung mein bahaadur the, unki khaas maqaam thi.

e: [AI] He entered upon his brother Al-Bara' while he was lying down, placing one of his legs on top of the other, and he was singing. So he prohibited him and said, "Are you afraid that I will die on my bed while you have distinguished yourself by killing one hundred disbelievers, apart from those who have shared with me in it among the people?"
hi: Beshak unhone apne bhai Al-Bara' (RA) ke paas jaakar dekha ke woh lete huay hain, aik pair doosre par rakhe, gaana ga rahe hain, to unhone unhein roka, unhone kaha: "Kya tumhein darr hai ke main apne bistar par maroonga, jabke maine akele hi (jung mein) sau (100) kaafiron ko qatl kiya hai, un logon ke ilawa jo mere sath is kaam mein shareek the?"

e: [AI] I heard Anas ibn Malik saying that Al-Bara' ibn Malik was a man with a beautiful voice So he used to recite poetry for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during some of his journeys. While he was reciting, he approached the women, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Beware of the tents." He then stopped. Muhammad said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  disliked that the women should hear his voice."
hi: Maine Anas bin Malik (RA) ko kehte suna: Al-Bara' bin Malik (RA) achhi aawaaz wale aadmi the, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke kuch safaron mein unke liye rajz (jung ke ashaar) padhe, jabke woh rajz padh rahe the, to woh auraton ke qareeb pahunch gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Qawareer (nazuk sheeshe jaisi, yaani auraton) ka khayaal rakho." To unhone (aawaaz) rok li. Muhammad ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh na-pasand tha ke auraten unki aawaaz sunen."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "How many weak, oppressed individuals with two cloths would have fulfilled their oath if they had sworn by Allah? From them, Bara' bin Malik is an exception, for Bara' encountered a group of polytheists and they caused great harm to the Muslims." So they said to Bara': "O Bara', the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to you, 'If you had sworn an oath by Allah, I would have fulfilled it. So swear by your Lord.'" Bara' said: "I swear by you, O my Lord, for what you have bestowed upon us through their shoulders." Then they gathered on the bridge of As-Sus and caused harm to the Muslims. They said to him, "O Bara', swear by your Lord." He said: "I swear by you, O my Lord, for what you have bestowed upon us through their shoulders and for connecting me with your Prophet ﷺ ." So they granted them their shoulders and Bara' was martyred.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kitne kamzor, haqeer samjhe jaane wale, phate-purane do kapde pehne huay log hain, agar woh Allah par qasam khaayen, to Allah unki qasam poori kare, unme se aik Al-Bara' bin Malik (RA) hain, kyunke Al-Bara' (RA) mushrikeen ke aik lashkar se mile, aur mushrikeen ne Musalmano ko sakht museebat mein daal diya tha." To unhone kaha: "Aye Bara' (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya hai ke agar tum Allah par qasam khaao, to woh tumhari qasam poori karega, isliye apne Rab par qasam khao." To unhone kaha: "Aye mere Rab, mujhe tujhpar qasam hai, humein unki peeth (fatah) ata kar." Phir woh As-Soos ke pul par mile, aur unhone (mushrikeen ne) Musalmano ko phir sakht museebat mein daala, to unhone unse kaha: "Aye Bara' (RA), apne Rab par qasam khao." To unhone kaha: "Aye mere Rab, mujhe tujhpar qasam hai, humein unki peeth (fatah) ata kar, aur mujhe apne Nabi (SAW) se mila de." To unhein (Musalmano ko) unki peeth (fatah) mil gayi, aur Al-Bara' (RA) shaheed hokar qatl kiye gaye.

e: [AI] "To his companions, 'How evil is what you have accustomed your peers to do to you!' So, he attacked the enemy, and Allah granted victory to the Muslims, and Al-Bara' was martyred that day. Abu Imran Musa ibn Harun said, 'Indeed, Al-Bara' was martyred on the day of the battle of Tustar, which took place in the twenty-first year of the Hijrah.' Al-Dhahabi did not mention him in his summary."
hi: apne saathiyon se: "Bura kiya tumne apne hum-umron ko apne khilaaf yeh aadat daalwa ke," phir dushman par hamla kar diya, to Allah ne Musalmano ko fatah di, aur Al-Bara' (RA) usi din shaheed ho gaye. Abu Imran Musa bin Haroon ne kaha: "Al-Bara' (RA) Tustar (jung) ke din shaheed huay, jo Faaris (Persia) mein hai, aur Al-Bara' bin Malik (RA) hijrat ke ikkis (21) saal mein shaheed huay." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Al-Nu'man ibn Amr ibn Muqarrin ibn 'Amir ibn Bakr ibn Hajin ibn Nasr al-Muzani.
hi: "An-Nu'man bin Amr bin Muqarrin bin Aamir bin Bakr bin Hajin bin Nasr Al-Muzani."

e: [AI] "Nouman bin Muqarrin Al-Muzani was killed while he was the ruler of the people in the year twenty-one."
hi: "Beshak An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin Al-Muzani (RA), jabke woh logon ke ameer the, ikkis (21) hijri mein shaheed hokar qatl kiye gaye."

e: [AI] The son of Muqarrin ibn A'idh ibn Mejja ibn Hijjir ibn Nasr ibn Habashiyyah ibn Ka'b ibn 'Abd ibn Thawr ibn Hadmah ibn Latim ibn 'Uthman ibn Muzaynah, also known as Abu 'Amr. He and six of his brothers were present in the Battle of the Trench with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Nu'man was one of the carriers of one of the weapons of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Ibn Muqarrin bin Aa'idh bin Meeja bin Hijjeer bin Nasr bin Habashiyyah bin Ka'b bin Abd bin Thaur bin Hadmah bin Laatim bin Uthman bin Muzainah, jinki kunniyat Abu Amr thi, "aur woh aur unke chhah (6) bhai Khandaq mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath shareek huay, aur An-Nu'man (RA) un logon mein se aik the jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke jhandon mein se aik jhanda uthaya."

Beshak Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne Al-Hurmuzan se Isfahan, Fars, aur Azerbaijan ke baare mein mashwara kiya, to unhone kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, Isfahan sar hai, aur Fars aur Azerbaijan dono par hain, agar aap aik par kaat dein, to sar doosre par ke sath rahega, aur agar aap sar kaat dein, to dono par gir jaayenge, isliye Isfahan se shuru karein." To Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) masjid mein dakhil huay, achaanak unhone An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin (RA) ko namaz padhte dekha, to unka intezaar kiya yahan tak ke unhone apni namaz mukammal ki, phir unse kaha: "Main tumhein kaam par lagaane wala houn." Unhone kaha: "Khazaanchi/wasooli-kartaa nahi, magar jung karne wala, ji haan?" Unhone kaha: "To tum jung karne wale ho," phir unhein rawaana kiya, aur Kufa walon ko bheja ke woh unki madad karein aur unse aa milein, unme Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (RA), Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA), Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA), Al-Ash'ath bin Qais (RA), Amr bin Ma'di Karib (RA), aur Abdullah bin Amr (RA) the. To An-Nu'man (RA) unke paas pahunche, aur unke aur unke darmiyan aik nahar (darya) tha, to unhone Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) ko unke paas qaasid banakar bheja, aur unka badshah Dhul-Haajibain (do bhaunwon wala) tha. Usne apne saathiyon se mashwara kiya, kaha: "Tumhara kya khayaal hai, main unke saamne jung ke libaas mein baithoon ya badshahi ki shaan-o-shaukat mein?" To woh apne takht par badshahi ki shaan-o-shaukat mein baitha, sar par taaj rakha, aur uske ird-gird do qataaren khadi thin jinpar resham ke kapde, kanwal ke bali, aur kangan the. To Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) aaye, unhein bazuon se pakda gaya, unke haath mein neza aur dhaal thi, aur log unke ird-gird uski galeeche par do qataaron mein the, to (Al-Mughirah (RA)) apne neze se usse chhedne lage, use phaad diya taake woh ise bad-shugooni samjhein. To Dhul-Haajibain ne unse kaha: "Aye Arabon ki jama'at, tumhein sakht bhook aur mushkil ne pareshaan kiya hai isliye tum nikle ho, agar tum chaaho to hum tumhein khila-pila dein aur tum apne mulk wapas chale jaao." To Al-Mughirah (RA) ne baat ki, Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir kaha: "Hum Arab jama'at murda jaanwar aur murdaar khaate the, aur log humein rondte the aur hum unhein nahi rond sakte the, to Allah ne humme se aik Rasool bheja, humme se sharif, humme mein sabse mautadil (mu'tabar), aur humme mein sabse sachcha. Aur unhone humein wa'da diya ke yahan (yeh jagah) humpar fatah hogi, aur humne unka har wa'da sach paaya. Aur main yahan aisi shaan-o-shaukat dekh raha houn ke mera khayaal nahi ke mere saathi jayenge jab tak isse le na lein." Al-Mughirah (RA) ne kaha: to mere dil ne mujhse kaha: agar tum apni taaqat jama karo aur aik chhalaang lagaao, to main uske sath takht par baith jaaunga, jab mujhe mauqa mila, (to maine aisa kiya), to unhone mujhe daanta aur usse (badshah ko) jaldi lekar jaane lage. To maine kaha: "Kya tum dekhte ho, agar maine bewakoofi ki, to yeh (aisa saluk) qaasidon ke sath nahi kiya jaata, aur hum bhi tumhare qaasidon ke sath aisa nahi karte jab woh humare paas aate hain." To usne kaha: "Agar tum chaaho to tum humari taraf paar karo, aur agar tum chaaho to hum tumhari taraf paar karein." Maine kaha: "Balke hum tumhari taraf paar karenge." To hum unki taraf paar huay aur unke saamne saf bandi ki. To woh zanjeeron mein bandh gaye, har saat (7) aik zanjeer mein aur paanch (5) aik zanjeer mein, taake woh bhaag na sakein. Unhone humpar teer chalaaye yahan tak ke humpar bohot bhaari pad gaye, to Al-Mughirah (RA) ne An-Nu'man (RA) se kaha: "Yeh log humpar bohot bhaari pad rahe hain, isliye hamla karo." Unhone kaha: "Tum sharafat wale ho, aur tum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath maujood rahe ho, lekin main ne khud Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha hai ke jab woh din ke shuru mein jung nahi karte the, to jung ko taakhir dete the yahan tak ke suraj dhal jaata aur hawaen chalne lagtin aur nusrat utarti." To An-Nu'man (RA) ne kaha: "Aye logo, main (jhanda) teen martaba hilaaunga, pehli baar mein har aadmi apni zaroorat poori kar le, doosri baar mein har aadmi apne hathiyaar aur talwaar ko dekh le, aur teesri baar mein main hamla karunga, to tum bhi hamla karna. Agar koi qatl ho jaaye, to koi kisi ke liye na ruke, aur agar main qatl ho jaaun, to mere liye na ruko, aur main Allah se aik dua maangunga, isliye main tum sab se kehta houn ke jab main dua maangu to tum 'Ameen' kaho." To unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, aaj An-Nu'man (RA) ko aisi shahaadat naseeb kar jo Musalmano ki madad kare, aur unhein fatah de." To sab logon ne 'Ameen' kaha, aur unhone apna jhanda teen martaba hilaaya, phir hamla kiya, aur woh sabse pehle shaheed huay. Maine unki wasiyat yaad ki aur unke liye nahi ruka, aur unki jagah yaad rakhi. Hum jab bhi unme se kisi ko qatl karte, to uske saathi usse ghaseetne mein masroof ho jaate. Aur Dhul-Haajibain apni khaakstari khachchar se gir gaya, to uska pet phat gaya, aur Allah ne Musalmano ko fatah di. Main An-Nu'man (RA) ke paas aaya, unme thodi jaan baaqi thi, main unke liye paani laaya, unke chehre par dhaalne laga, unke chehre se mitti dho raha tha, unhone poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Ma'qil bin Yasaar (RA)." Unhone poocha: "Logon ka kya hua?" Maine kaha: "Allah ne unhein fatah di." Unhone kaha: "Alhamdulillah, isse Umar (RA) ko likh do," aur unki jaan nikal gayi. To log Al-Ash'ath bin Qais (RA) ke paas jama ho gaye. Unhone kaha: to hum unki (bacche ki maa) ke paas aaye aur poocha: "Kya unhone aapko koi wasiyat ki?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, siwaye aik chhoti sandook ke jisme aik khat tha," maine usse padha, to usme likha tha: "Agar fulan qatl ho jaaye to fulan (uski jagah le), aur agar fulan qatl ho jaaye to fulan." Hammaad ne kaha: mujhe Ali bin Zaid (RA) ne hadith bayan ki, humein Abu Uthman An-Nahdi (RA) ne hadith bayan ki, ke woh Umar (RA) ke paas aaye, unhone poocha: "An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin (RA) ka kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Woh shaheed kiye gaye." Unhone kaha: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raaji'oon." Phir poocha: "Fulan ka kya hua?" Maine kaha: "Woh bhi shaheed kiye gaye, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aur kuch aur bhi jinhein hum nahi jaante." Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Hum unhein nahi jaante, lekin Allah unhein jaanta hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] We were seven people from the Banu Muqarrin tribe during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . We had a servant, and one of us slapped him. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Set him free." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Hum Banu Muqarrin ke saat (7) log the Rasulullah (SAW) ke daur mein, humara aik khadim tha, to humme se aik ne usse thappad maara, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ise aazaad kar do." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] And Qatada bin Al-Nu'man bin Yazid bin Amr bin Sawwad bin Dhafar, and the name of Dhufur, Ka'ab bin Al-Khazraj bin Amr, and he is the grandson of Malik bin Aws, and Qatada was also known as Abu Amr and he was the grandfather of Aasim and Ya'qub bin 'Umar bin Qatada. And Aasim bin 'Umar was one of the scholars in the field of biography and other matters.
hi: Aur Qatadah bin An-Nu'man bin Yazid bin Amr bin Sawwad bin Zafar (RA), aur Zafar ka (asli) naam Ka'b bin Al-Khazraj bin Amr tha, aur yeh (khaandaan) An-Nabeet bin Malik bin Aus kehlaata hai, aur Qatadah (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Amr thi, aur woh Aasim aur Ya'qub, Umar bin Qatadah (RA) ke dono betoon, ke dada the, aur Aasim bin Umar seerat aur doosre ilmon ke aalim the.

e: [AI] Because he came from Hadhramaut and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used him on Bahrain, then Umar also used him on Bahrain and died there, so Abu Huraira Al-Dawsi used him in his place. And it was only Al-Ala' bin Al-Hadhrami who died in Bahrain in the year twenty-one.
hi: kyunke woh Hadhramaut se aaye the, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Bahrain par muqarrar kiya, phir Umar (RA) ne bhi unhein Bahrain par muqarrar kiya, to unka intiqaal wahin hua, phir unki jagah Abu Hurairah Ad-Dawsi (RA) ko muqarrar kiya gaya, aur Al-Alaa bin Al-Hadhrami (RA) ka intiqaal Bahrain mein ikkis (21) hijri mein hua.

e: [AI] He saw the Prophet ﷺ giving allegiance to the people on the day of victory. He said that he sat near the house of Samurah. Al-Aswad said, "I saw the Prophet ﷺ sitting, and the young and old people and women came to him and pledged allegiance to Islam and bearing witness to the oneness of Allah and the prophethood of Muhammad. So, I asked, 'What is Islam?' He said, 'To believe in Allah.' And I asked, 'What is the testimony?' He said, 'The testimony that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.' At this point, Al-Dhahabi remained silent in his summary."
hi: Beshak unhone Nabi (SAW) ko Fatah ke din logon se baiyat lete dekha, unhone kaha: to woh Samurah ke ghar ke qareeb baithe. Al-Aswad (RA) ne kaha: maine Nabi (SAW) ko baithe dekha, to chhote aur bade log aur auratein unke paas aayin aur unse Islam aur Shahadat par baiyat ki, to maine poocha: "Islam kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah par imaan laana." Maine poocha: "Aur Shahadat kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Gawahi dena ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ  took Hussain and kissed him. Then, he approached them (the people) and said, 'Verily, this child is a source of stinginess, cowardice, ignorance, and sadness.'
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Husain (RA) ko liya aur unhein bosa diya, phir logon ki taraf mudhe aur farmaya: "Beshak aulaad kanjoosi, buzdili, jahaalat, aur gham ka sabab ban sakti hai."

e: [AI] "Mohammed, the son of Al-Aswad, the son of Khalaf, the son of Abd Yaghoth Al-Qurashi, his ancestry traces back to the people of Makkah."
hi: "Muhammad bin Al-Aswad bin Khalaf bin Abd Yaghooth Al-Qurashi, Makkah walon mein shumaar kiye jaate hain."

e: [AI] Khalid ibn Al-Walid died in the year twenty-one in Homs.
hi: "Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ka intiqaal ikkis (21) hijri mein, Hims (Homs) mein hua."

e: [AI] Khalid bin Al-Walid bin Al-Mughira bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Makhzum and his mother Lubbaba bint Al-Harith bin Hazn Al-Hilaliyah, the sister of Maymuna bint Al-Harith, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . Khalid was given the nickname Abu Sulaiman. Umar bin Al-Khattab appointed him to oversee the affairs of the cities of Rouha, Hurran, and Ar-Rabba. Khalid stayed there for a year and then he sought permission to resign from his position, which Umar granted. Khalid then went to Al-Madinah and settled there in his own house until he passed away in Al-Madinah in the twentieth-two year.
hi: Khalid bin Al-Waleed bin Al-Mugheerah bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Makhzoom (RA), aur unki maa Lubaabah bint Al-Harith bin Hazn Al-Hilaaliyah thin, jo Maimoonah bint Al-Harith (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki biwi, ki behn thin, aur Khalid ki kunniyat Abu Sulaiman thi, Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unhein Ar-Ruha, Hurraan, Ar-Rabbah, aur Aamid ka ameer banaya, woh aik saal wahan rahe aur (kaam se) chhuti maangi, to unhein chhuti de di gayi, to woh Madinah aaye aur apne ghar mein rahe yahan tak ke Madinah mein hi baais (22) hijri mein unka intiqaal hua.

e: [AI] I heard Yahya ibn Bukayr saying, "Khalid ibn al-Walid is also known as Abu Suleiman."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Bukair ko kehte suna: "Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Sulaiman thi."

e: [AI] "To shed tears, to the extent of leaving a stain or two, without sobbing or shrieking." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: "...ke woh apne aansuon se aik ya do bartan (matra) bahaa den, jab tak thappad maarna aur cheekhna-chillaana na ho." Laq'a se muraad thappad maarna hai, aur laqlaqah se muraad cheekhna-chillaana hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "When the Prophet ﷺ  finished with the armies, Khalid ibn al-Walid stayed in the camp of the armies and sent a message to the Prophet ﷺ  regarding his conversion to Islam." The mentioned event has been narrated to us with authenticity by Zubaydi about the conversion of Khalid ibn al-Walid before the Battle of Khaybar.
hi: "Jab Nabi (SAW) Ahzaab (Khandaq ki jung) se wapas huay, to Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) Ahzaab ki jagah par ruke rahe aur Nabi (SAW) ko apne Islam ki khabar bheji." Humein Az-Zubaidi ke zikr ki sihat batayi gayi hai ke Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ka Islam Khaibar se pehle hua.

e: [AI] "We were with the Prophet ﷺ  on the day of Khaybar. He sent me to announce that the congregational prayer is obligatory, and that no one enters Paradise except a Muslim soul." (Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary)
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke sath Khaibar ke din the, to unhone mujhe bheja ke main pukaaroon: "Namaz jama'at ke sath hogi, Jannat mein koi bhi dakhil nahi hoga siwaye us jaan ke jo Musalman (farmaanbardaar) ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The translation of the provided Arabic sentence into English is: "The conquest of Khaybar took place in the year six. As for the narration, it contradicts this."
hi: "Khaibar ki fatah chhah (6) hijri mein hui," lekin (kisi doosri) riwayat mein iske khilaaf hai.

e: [AI] "I went intentionally to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and I met Khalid ibn Al-Walid before the conquest of Mecca. He was coming from Mecca. So I said, 'Where are you going, O Abu Sulaiman?' He said, 'By Allah, the one who is called Al-Meessam has been guided, and indeed the man is a Prophet. I intend to go and accept Islam. How long will it go on like this?' He said, 'We arrived in Medina before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Khalid ibn Al-Walid arrived before us and accepted Islam and gave his pledge (to the Prophet). Then I approached and gave my pledge and left.'"
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf iraada karke nikla, to meri mulaqaat Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) se hui, aur yeh Fatah se thodi pehle ki baat hai, jabke woh Makkah se aa rahe the, maine poocha: "Aye Abu Sulaiman, kahan ka iraada hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maamla saaf ho chuka hai, aur yeh shakhs zaroor Nabi hain, main jaakar Musalman ho jaunga, ab aur kab tak?" Unhone kaha: "To hum Madinah mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahunche, Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) aage badhe aur Musalman huay aur baiyat ki, phir main qareeb aaya aur maine baiyat ki, aur main wapas chala gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  mentioning Khalid ibn Al-Walid and he said, 'Yes, Abdullah is a brother of the family and a sword from the swords of Allah.' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Aur unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko suna, unhone Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ka zikr kiya, to farmaya: "Haan, Allah ke banda, qabile ke bhai, aur Allah ki talwaaron mein se aik talwaar." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "When the Prophet, peace be upon him, announced the news of the people of Mu'ta, he said, 'Then Khalid ibn Al-Walid took the flag, a sword from the swords of Allah, and Allah granted him victory.'"
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne jab Mu'tah walon ki wafaat ki khabar di, to farmaya: "Phir jhanda Allah ki talwaaron mein se aik talwaar, Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA), ne uthaaya, to Allah ne unpar fatah ata ki."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  mourned the people of Muta from the pulpit and then said, "Then Khalid ibn Al-Walid took the command, and he is a sword from the swords of Allah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mimbar par Mu'tah walon ki wafaat ki khabar di, phir farmaya: "To Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ne jhanda uthaaya, aur woh Allah ki talwaaron mein se aik talwaar hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do not harm Khālid, for he is a sword from the swords of Allah, who pours upon the disbelievers."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khalid (RA) ko takleef mat do, kyunke woh Allah ki talwaaron mein se aik talwaar hain jise usne kaafiron par barsaaya hai."

e: [AI] The Golden one mentioned in the summary.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] " They asked for it but did not find it, and then they asked for it and found it, and behold, it was a wrinkle-free garment. Khalid said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performed Umrah and shaved his head, and people started grabbing his hair from the sides. I got ahead of them all and placed it in this garment. And whenever I carried it in battle, I would always achieve victory.'"
hi: Log usse dhoondte magar na paate, phir usse dhoonda aur paaya, achaanak woh aik purani (phati-purani) topi thi, to Khalid (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Umrah kiya aur apna sar mundwaya, log unke baalon ki taraf toot pade, to main unse pehle unki peshaani (agle baalon) tak pahuncha, maine woh is topi mein rakh li, main kabhi kisi jung mein shaamil nahi hua jabke yeh mere paas thi magar mujhe fatah naseeb hui." Munqata' (isnad mein khaali jagah wala) hai.

e: [AI] Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] Khalid ibn al-Walid passed away in the city in the year twenty-two.
hi: "Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah mein baais (22) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] Yahya bin Bukair died in the city in the year seventeen or eighteen.
hi: Yahya bin Bukair: "Madinah mein satrah (17) ya atharah (18) hijri mein faut huay."

e: [AI] About Urwah, in the naming of someone who witnessed the Battle of Badr, from Asad ibn Abd al-Uzza, Hatib ibn Abi Balta'ah, their confidant.
hi: Urwah se: "Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza se Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Haatib bin Abi Balta'ah (RA), unke ahd-waale saathi, the."

e:
[AI] "Kan Haatib ibn Abi Balta'ah yukannaa Aba Muhammad." 

Translation: "Haatib ibn Abi Balta'ah used to be referred to as Abu Muhammad."
hi: "Haatib bin Abi Balta'ah (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi."

e: [AI] "Hatib Ibn Abi Belta'ah was nicknamed Abu Muhammad, and he was involved in the incident known as "Lakhm". He was one of the sons of Rashidah who participated in the battles of Badr, the Trench, and all the other campaigns with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent him to the ruler of Alexandria, Muqawqis. He was mentioned among the skilled archers who were companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He passed away in Al-Madinah at the age of sixty-five. Uthman Ibn Affan performed his funeral prayer. Hatib was a merchant who sold food, and he had a good physique with a light beard, and his body leaned towards slimness."
hi: "Haatib bin Abi Balta'ah ki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi, aur kaha jaata hai ke woh Lakham (qabile) se the, phir Banu Raashidah mein se aik the, unhone Badr, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Iskandariya (Alexandria) ke hukmraan Muqawqis ke paas bheja, aur unka shumaar Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein maroof teer-andaazon mein hota tha, unka intiqaal Madinah mein hua jabke woh painsath (65) saal ke thay, aur Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur woh khaana bechne wale tajir the, unka jism achha tha, halki daadhi thi, thode jhuke huay aur qad mein chhote thay, aur unki ungliyaan mote thin."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya ibn Bukayr saying, "Hattib ibn Abi Balta'ah passed away in the year thirty, and Uthman ibn Affan prayed the funeral prayer for him. He was also known as Abu Muhammad."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Bukair ko kehte suna: "Haatib bin Abi Balta'ah ka intiqaal tees (30) hijri mein hua, aur Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur unki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi."

e: [AI] He saw the Prophet ﷺ  at the battle of Uhud while he was heavily engaged in fighting. Ali ibn Abi Talib was holding a shield with water in it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was washing his face with that water. A companion named Hatib asked Ali, "Who did this to you?" Ali replied, "Utbah ibn Abu Waqqas attacked me, smashed my face, and broke my four incisors with a thrown stone." Hatib said, "I heard someone shouting on the mountain that Muhammad has been killed, so I came to you, and my soul had almost left me. I asked, 'Where did Utbah go?' and Ali pointed in the direction he went. I chased after him until I caught up with him, struck him with my sword, and beheaded him. Then I descended from the mountain and took his head, his armor, and his horse. I brought them to the Prophet ﷺ , who accepted them from me and prayed for me, saying, 'May Allah be pleased with you.'" The mention ends here in the summarized version by Al-Dhahabi.
hi: Beshak unhone Nabi (SAW) ko Uhud mein dekha jabke woh sakht museebat mein the, aur Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke haath mein dhaal thi jisme paani tha, aur Rasulullah (SAW) usi paani se apna chehra dho rahe the, to Haatib ne unse (Ali se) poocha: "Aapke sath yeh kisne kiya?" Unhone (Ali ne) kaha: "Utbah bin Abi Waqqas ne mera chehra zakhmi kiya aur pathar maar kar meri chaar (agle) daant tod diye." Maine kaha: "Main ne pahaad par aik pukaarne wale ko yeh pukaarte suna: Muhammad qatl ho gaye, to main aapke paas aaya, jabke meri jaan (khauf se) nikal chuki thi." Maine poocha: "Utbah kahan gaya?" To unhone (Ali ne) uski taraf ishara kiya jahan woh gaya tha, to main chal pada yahan tak ke main usse mil gaya, maine usse talwaar se maara, aur uska sar utaar diya, phir neeche utra, uska sar, uska saamaan, aur uska ghoda le liya, aur maine yeh Nabi (SAW) ke paas laakar diya, to aap (SAW) ne mujhse yeh qubool kiya aur mere liye dua ki, farmaya: "Allah tumse raazi ho," do martaba. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: Hatib will definitely go to Hell. (But) Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: You tell a lie; he would not get into that for he had taken part in Badr and in (the expedition of) Hudaibiya. (Using translation from Muslim 2495)
hi: Beshak Haatib ke aik ghulam ne Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aakar Haatib ki shikayat ki aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, Haatib zaroor Jahannam mein dakhil hoga." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne jhoot bola, woh kabhi usme dakhil nahi hoga, unhone Badr aur Hudaibiyah mein shirkat ki hai."

e: [AI] He narrated that his father wrote a letter to the disbelievers of Quraish while he was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who had witnessed the Battle of Badr. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called Ali and Zubair and said, "Go and catch a woman who has a book and bring it to me." So they went until they reached her and said, "Give us the book that you have and inform her that we will not leave until we remove every garment from her." So she said, "Are you two Muslim men?" They replied, "Yes, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has informed us that you have a book." When she was sure that they were not deceiving her, she untied the book from her head and handed it to them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called for a scribe and asked him to read from the book. He said, "Do you recognize this book?" He replied, "Yes." He asked, "What prompted you to do this?" He answered, "I had my child and relatives with me, and I was a Bedouin among the people of Quraish." Umar asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  for permission to kill Hattib, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No, for he has witnessed the Battle of Badr, and you do not know, perhaps Allah has looked favorably upon the people of Badr." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do as you please, for I have forgiven you." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this incident in his summary.
hi: Ke unke waalid ne Quraish ke kaafiron ko aik khat likha, jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat kar chuke the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA) aur Zubair (RA) ko bulaaya aur farmaya: "Jaao yahan tak ke tum aik aurat tak pahuncho jiske paas khat hai, usse mujhe lekar aao." To woh gaye yahan tak ke unke paas pahunche, unhone kaha: "Woh khat de do jo aapke paas hai," aur unhein bataya ke woh wapas nahi jaayenge jab tak uske har kapde ko na utaar lein. Usne kaha: "Kya tum dono Musalman mard nahi ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, lekin Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein bataya hai ke aapke paas khat hai." Jab usse yaqeen ho gaya ke woh unse bach nahi sakti, to usne khat apne sar se khola aur unhein de diya. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Haatib ko bulaaya aur unhein khat padhkar sunaaya, farmaya: "Kya tum is khat ko pehchaante ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "To tumhein is par kis cheez ne uksaya?" Unhone kaha: "Wahan mere bete aur mere rishtedaar the, aur main tum Quraish mein aik Bedouin (bahar se aane wala) aadmi tha." To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe Haatib ko qatl karne ki ijaazat dein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, unhone Badr mein shirkat ki hai, aur tumhein nahi pata, shaayad Allah ne Badr walon par nazar-e-inaayat daal di ho." Phir farmaya: "Jo chaaho karo, main tumhein maaf kar chuka houn." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Ubayy ibn Ka'b ibn Qays ibn 'Ubayd ibn Zaid ibn Mu'awiya ibn 'Amr ibn Malik ibn al-Najjar witnessed the Battle of Badr."
hi: "Ubayy bin Ka'b bin Qais bin Ubaid bin Zaid bin Mu'awiyah bin Amr bin Malik bin An-Najjaar (RA) ne Badr mein shirkat ki."

e: [AI] Khalifa ibn Khayyat said, "He mentioned this lineage and added to it, 'and the mother of Umm Ubayy ibn Ka'b was Suhaylah bint Al-Aswad ibn Haram ibn 'Amr ibn Zaid Manat ibn 'Adi ibn 'Amr ibn Malik ibn An-Najjar, and she was the aunt of Abu Talha.'"
hi: Humein Khaleefah bin Khayyaat ne hadith bayan ki: "Unhone yeh nasab zikr kiya aur ismein izaafa kiya ke Ubayy bin Ka'b ki maa Suhailah bint Al-Aswad bin Haraam bin Amr bin Zaid Manaat bin Adi bin Amr bin Malik bin An-Najjaar thin, aur woh Abu Talhah (RA) ki phupi (paternal aunt) thin."

e: [AI] "Ubayy ibn Ka'b died during the caliphate of Umar ibn al-Khattab in the year twenty-two."
hi: "Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ka intiqaal Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ki khilafat mein, baais (22) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] Muhammad ibn Umar narrated and mentioned the lineage in his manner and added that he witnessed the Battle of Uhud with the seventy Ansar. He used to write down the revelations for the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. There was a difference of opinion regarding the time of his death. It was said that he died during the caliphate of Umar in the year twenty-two, while others said he died during the caliphate of Uthman in the year thirty. This confirms the statements that Uthman ordered the compilation of the Quran.
hi: Humein Muhammad bin Umar ne hadith bayan ki, unhone isi tarah nasab zikr kiya aur izaafa kiya ke unhone Ansar ke sattar (70) logon mein Aqabah mein shirkat ki, "aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye wahi likha karte the, aur unki wafaat ke waqt ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai, kaha jaata hai ke unka intiqaal Umar ki khilafat mein, baais (22) hijri mein hua, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke unka intiqaal Uthman ki khilafat mein, tees (30) hijri mein hua, aur yehi baat sabse zyada saabit-shuda hai, kyunke Uthman ne unhein Quran jama karne ka hukum diya tha."

e: [AI] "I saw Ubayy ibn Ka'b with white hair and a beard that was not dyed."
hi: "Maine Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ko dekha, unke sar aur daadhi safed thay, aur woh (unhein) rangte nahi the."

e: [AI] "The judges among the companions of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) were six: Umar, Ali, Abdullah, Ubayy, Zaid, and Abu Musa. This is how we have been narrated in most of the reports, and the most authentic of them is narrated by Muadh bin Jabal instead of Abu Musa."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se fatwa/qazaa dene walon mein chhah (6) the - Umar, Ali, Abdullah, Ubayy, Zaid, aur Abu Musa," isi tarah humein hadith bayan ki gayi, aur aksar riwayaton mein, jo sabse sahih bhi hain, Mu'adh bin Jabal ka naam Abu Musa ki jagah hai.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Mus'hir saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named Ubayy ibn Ka'b as the leader of the Ansar, and he did not pass away until they called him the leader of the Muslims."
hi: Maine Abu Mus-hir ko kehte suna: "Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ansar ka sardaar naam diya, aur woh faut nahi huay jab tak log unhein Musalmano ka sardaar nahi kehne lage."

e: [AI] And Ubayy died during the caliphate of Umar in the twenty-second year.
hi: "Aur Ubayy (RA) Umar ki khilafat mein, baais (22) hijri mein, faut huay."

e: [AI] Ubayy ibn Ka'b died during the caliphate of Uthman in the year 32 of the caliphate.
hi: "Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ka intiqaal Uthman ki khilafat mein, battees (32) hijri mein hua, Ubayy bin Ka'b ki wafaat ke waqt ke baare mein ikhtilaaf saaf zaahir hai."

e: [AI] He died during the Caliphate of Uthman in the year thirty. It was mentioned that he was nicknamed Abu al-Tufail and he had two nicknames. His death occurred in the city of the Prophet ﷺ  after the accusation was made against Uthman.
hi: "Unka intiqaal Uthman ki khilafat mein, tees (30) hijri mein hua, aur zikr kiya gaya hai ke unki kunniyat Abu At-Tufail thi, aur unki do kunniyaten thin, aur unki wafaat Madinah mein us waqt hui jab Uthman par ilzaam lagne shuru ho chuke the."

e: [AI] She had fierceness in her character.
hi: "Ubayy (RA) mein sakhti (mizaaj ki tundi) thi."

e: [AI] "The book of Allah and the Sunnah of His Prophet is what has been made clear to you, so act upon it. And what has been ambiguous to you, then refer it to the knowledgeable ones." (Sahih)
hi: "Allah ki Kitaab aur uske Nabi (SAW) ki Sunnat, jo tumhare liye saaf ho jaaye uspar amal karo, aur jo tumhein mushkil lage usse uske jaanne wale ke supurd kar do." Sahih.

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made a brotherhood between his companions. He made a brotherhood between Ubayy ibn Ka'b and Sa'id ibn Zaid ibn Amr ibn Nufayl.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, to Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) aur Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail (RA) ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya.

e: [AI] "It does not harm you or make you sad that it is difficult for me that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'None should stand in the first row except the Muhajirun (emigrants) and the Ansar.' So I asked, 'Who is this?' They said, 'It is Ubayy ibn Ka'b.'"
hi: "Tumhein bura na lage aur na hi gham ho ke main tumpar bhaari maloom houn (yeh baat kehne mein), maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: pehli saf mein sirf Muhajireen aur Ansar hi khade ho sakte hain." Maine poocha: "Yeh kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A surah was revealed to me, and I was commanded to recite it to you." I asked, "Shall I name it after you?" He said, "Yes." I then asked my father, "Are you happy with this, O Abu al-Mundhir?" He replied, "What would prevent me? By Allah, the Most High and Most Blessed, says, 'Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy, in that let them rejoice.' [Surah Yunus: 58]"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhpar aik Surah nazil hui, aur mujhe hukum diya gaya ke main tumhein woh padhaaun." Unhone kaha: maine poocha: "Kya mera naam aapko diya gaya?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan." Maine Ubayy (RA) se kaha: "Kya aap iss par khush huay, Aye Abu Al-Mundhir?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe kis cheez ne rokna chahiye, jabke Allah Ta'ala, buzurg aur buland, farmata hai: {Kaho: Allah ke fazl aur uski rehmat se, isi par unhein khush honay chahiye} (Surah Yunus 58)."

e: [AI] I heard Ikrimah bin Sulaiman saying, "I read upon Ismail bin Abdullah bin Qustantini. When I reached the verse of Ad-Duha, he said to me, 'Say Allahu Akbar at the end of every chapter until you finish.' Abdullah bin Kathir informed him that Mujahid had read upon him and commanded him to do so. Mujahid informed him that Ibn Abbas had commanded him to do so. Ibn Abbas informed him that Ubayy bin Ka'b had commanded him to do so. And Ubayy bin Ka'b informed him that the Prophet ﷺ  had commanded him to do so."
hi: Maine Ikrimah bin Sulaiman ko kehte suna: maine Ismail bin Abdullah bin Qustantini ke saamne padha, jab main Surah Ad-Duha tak pahuncha, to unhone mujhse kaha: "Har surah ke khatm honay par Takbeer kaho yahan tak ke tum poora Quran khatm kar lo." Aur Abdullah bin Kathir ne unhein bataya ke unhone Mujahid ke saamne padha, to unhone unhein isi ka hukum diya, aur Mujahid ne unhein bataya ke Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unhein isi ka hukum diya, aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unhein bataya ke Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne unhein isi ka hukum diya, aur Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne unhein bataya ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein isi ka hukum diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Abu Mundhir, which verse in the Book of Allah do you see as the greatest?" Abu Mundhir replied, "I said, 'Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.'" The Prophet then struck his chest and said, "May knowledge bring you joy, Abu Mundhir."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Al-Mundhir, Allah ki Kitaab mein tumhare nazdeek sabse azeem aayat kaun si hai?" Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "{Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh zinda, sab ka sambhalne wala hai} (Surah Al-Baqarah 255)." Unhone kaha: to unhone mera seena thapthapaya aur farmaya: "Ilm tumhein mubaarak ho, Aye Abu Al-Mundhir."

e: [AI] "If you delay me until Friday, I will speak of what I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  without fearing the blame of any blamer." So when Thursday came, I set out and found the roads full of people. I asked, 'What's the matter with people today?' They said, 'It's as if you are a stranger.' I said, 'Indeed.' They said, 'The leader of the Muslims, Ubayy ibn Ka'b, has passed away.'"
hi: "Agar tum mujhe Jum'a ke din tak muakhkhar karo, to main zaroor woh bayan karunga jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suna, isme kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat se main nahi daroonga." Jab Jumeraat (Thursday) ka din aaya, to main subah nikla, achaanak raaste log se bhare huay the, maine poocha: "Aaj logon ko kya hua hai?" Unhone kaha: "Goya tum ajnabi ho." Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Musalmano ke sardaar, Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA), ka intiqaal ho gaya."

e: [AI] "Umar Ali taught us, and Ubayy recited for us, and indeed we used to leave some of what Ubayy says and Ubayy says, 'I have taken it from the messenger of Allah ﷺ and I do not abandon it,' and Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said, 'We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten' [Quran 2:106]. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Umar (RA) (ne kaha): "Ali (RA) humare sabse behtareen faisla-kun (qazi) hain, aur Ubayy (RA) humare sabse behtareen Quran padhne wale hain, aur humme se kuch woh baaten chhod dete hain jo Ubayy (RA) kehte hain, jabke Ubayy (RA) kehte hain: maine Rasulullah (SAW) se liya hai aur ise nahi chhodta," jabke Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne farmaya: "{Hum jo bhi aayat mansookh (mauqoof) karte hain ya usse bhula dete hain} (Surah Al-Baqarah 106)." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Who is the one who recited this verse to you? He said, "I recited it to me, Ubayy ibn Ka'b." They said, "Come with us to him," so they went to him. When they arrived, they found him reclining on a cushion, resting his head. They greeted him and he returned the greeting. They said, "O Abu Al-Mundhir, he informed me that you recited this verse." He said, "Yes, I received it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Umar said, "You received it from the Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Yes, I received it from the Messenger of Allah." He repeated this three times, and in the third time, he was angry and said, "Yes, by Allah, Allah revealed it to Jibril and Jibril revealed it to Muhammad, and neither my son nor I had any part in its composition." Umar left while raising his hands and saying, "Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar." This narration has been omitted by Al-Dhahabi due to its weakness.
hi: Umar (RA) ne unse (poocha): "Tumhein yeh aayat kisne padhaayi?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne yeh padhaayi." To unhone kaha: "Chalo hum unke paas chalein." To woh unke paas gaye, achaanak woh takiye par takki lagaaye, apne baal sanwaar rahe the, unhone unhein salaam kiya, to unhone salaam ka jawaab diya, phir kaha: "Aye Abu Al-Mundhir." Unhone kaha: "Labbaik (Haazir houn)." Unhone kaha: "Ise ne mujhe bataya hai ke aapne unhein yeh aayat padhaayi." Unhone kaha: "Sach kaha, maine ise Rasulullah (SAW) se seekha hai." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Aapne ise Rasulullah (SAW) se seekha?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, maine ise Rasulullah (SAW) se seekha," teen martaba, har baar yehi kehte rahe, aur teesri baar, ghusse mein aakar, kaha: "Ji haan, Allah ki qasam, isse Allah ne Jibreel par nazil kiya, aur Jibreel ne Muhammad (SAW) par nazil kiya, isme na Al-Khattab se mashwara liya gaya aur na hi unke bete se." To Umar (RA) bahar nikle, apne haath uthaaye huay, kehte huay: "Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] To him, O Amir al-Mu'minin, that polytheism is as Luqman said to his son, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with Him] is a great injustice." (Luqman 13) Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Unse (kaha): "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, yeh to sirf shirk hai, kya aapne Luqman ka apne bete se kaha yeh nahi suna: {Aye mere bete, Allah ke sath shareek na thehrao, beshak shirk bohot bada zulm hai} (Surah Luqman 13)." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdul Rahman ibn Awf ibn Abdul Rahman ibn Abd ibn Al-Harith ibn Zuhrah ibn Kilab ibn Murrah ibn Kaab ibn Luayy ibn Ghalib ibn Fihri ibn Malik" translates to "Abdul Rahman, the son of Awf, the son of Abdul Rahman, the son of Abd, the son of Al-Harith, the son of Zuhrah, the son of Kilab, the son of Murrah, the son of Kaab, the son of Luayy, the son of Ghalib, the son of Fihri, the son of Malik."
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Auf bin Abdur Rahman bin Abd bin Al-Harith bin Zuhrah bin Kilaab bin Murrah bin Ka'b bin Luway bin Ghaalib bin Fihr bin Malik."

e: [AI] Abdul Rahman ibn Awf ibn Abdul Rahman ibn Al-Harith ibn Zuhra and his mother and the mother of his brother Aswad ibn Awf, Ash-Shifa bint Awf ibn Abdul ibn Al-Harith ibn Zuhra ibn Kilab. She had migrated before the conquest. Abdul Rahman's name was Abdul Amr, but the Prophet ﷺ  named him Abdul Rahman.
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Auf bin Abdur Rahman bin Al-Harith bin Zuhrah, unki maa aur unke bhai Al-Aswad bin Auf (RA) ki maa Ash-Shifa bint Auf bin Abd bin Al-Harith bin Zuhrah bin Kilaab (RA) thin, aur unhone Fatah se pehle hijrat ki thi, aur Abdur Rahman ka naam Abd Amr tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Abdur Rahman naam diya.

e: [AI] Abdul Rahman ibn Auf died at the age of ninety during the reign of Uthman. Uthman performed the funeral prayer for him. Abdul Rahman ibn Auf had reached the age of seventy-five.
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) ka intiqaal Uthman (RA) ke (khilafat ke) navvein (9th) saal mein hua, aur Uthman (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur woh pachattar (75) saal ki umr ko pahunch chuke the."

e: [AI] Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] Khalifa ibn Khayyat narrated, mentioning this lineage and added, "Abdul Rahman was called Abu Muhammad, and his name during the pre-Islamic era was Abdul Ka'bah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named him Abdul Rahman." According to the criteria of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Humein Khaleefah bin Khayyaat ne hadith bayan ki, unhone yeh nasab zikr kiya aur izaafa kiya: "Abdur Rahman ki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi, aur Jaahiliyat mein unka naam Abd Al-Ka'bah tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Abdur Rahman naam diya." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "My name during the era of ignorance was 'Abd Amr, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  renamed me 'Abd al-Rahman'."
hi: "Jaahiliyat mein mera naam Abd Amr tha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe Abdur Rahman naam diya."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Abdullah ibn al-Rahman, "What did you do, O Abu Muhammad, when receiving the corner?" meaning the Black Stone. Abdullah ibn al-Rahman replied, "I touched it and then left it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "You have done right."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abdur Rahman (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Abu Muhammad, aapne rukn (kone) ko chhoote waqt kya kiya?" Yaani Hajr-e-Aswad. To Abdur Rahman (RA) ne kaha: "Maine chhua aur chhod diya." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aapne theek kiya."

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi on summarization.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to Abdurrahman, "How did you handle the receiving of the stone, O Abu Muhammad?" Abdurrahman replied, "I received it and then I left it." The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "You have done well, O Abu Muhammad." Al-Dhahabi omitted this narration from the summary due to its weakness.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur Rahman (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Abu Muhammad, aapne Hajr (patthar) ko chhoote waqt kya kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Maine chhua aur chhod diya." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aapne theek kiya, Aye Abu Muhammad." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] Abdul Rahman ibn Awf died and was also known as Abu Muhammad in the year 32 and he was 75 years old.
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi, unka intiqaal battees (32) hijri mein hua, jabke woh pachattar (75) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] "She had poured her soul into it until they all stood up and glorified him. Then Umm Kulthum, the daughter of Uqba, his wife, came out of the mosque seeking assistance in what she was commanded to do of patience and prayer. They waited for an hour while he was in a state of unconsciousness. Then he regained consciousness and the first thing he spoke was to say takbeer (Allahu Akbar). The people of the household and those following them also said takbeer. Then he asked them, 'Did I become unconscious suddenly?' They replied, 'Yes.' He said, 'You have spoken the truth.' He said, 'Surely, two men rushed towards me while I was unconscious. One of them was harsh and rude. They told me to go with them to the Almighty, the All-Knowing. He told them to send me back, for surely he is among those whom Allah has written happiness and forgiveness for in the wombs of their mothers, and that his son will enjoy him as long as Allah wills.' After that, he lived for a month and then passed away. Uthman established the Hajj pilgrimage during his reign." (Narrated by Al-Dhahabi in Al-Talkhis)
hi: Ke unki jaan usme (aik ghashi/behoshi mein) nikal gayi thi yahan tak ke log unke paas se utthe aur unhein aik kapde se dhaank diya (murda samajh kar), aur unki biwi Umm Kulthum bint Uqbah (RA) masjid ki taraf nikli, us sabr aur namaz ki madad talaash karte huay jiska unhein hukum diya gaya tha. Woh (log) aik ghadi rahe jabke woh behoshi mein the, phir unhein hosh aaya, to sabse pehle unhone kaha: "Takbeer kaho," to ghar walon aur unke qareeb walon ne takbeer kahi. Phir unhone unse poocha: "Kya mujhpar abhi behoshi taari hui thi?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Tumne sach kaha." Unhone kaha: "Beshak mujhe meri behoshi mein do aadmi le gaye, unme se aik sakht aur tund-mizaaj tha, unhone kaha: chalo, hum tumhein Al-Azeez Al-Aleem (Ghalib, Sab Jaanne Wale) ke paas faisla karwaane le chalte hain." (Kisi ne) kaha: "Unhein wapas le jaao, kyunke woh un logon mein se hain jinke liye Allah ne khushi aur maghfirat unki maaon ke peton mein likh di thi, aur unke betay unse (unki maujoodgi se) fayda uthaayenge jab tak Allah chaahe." Unhone kaha: to woh iske baad aik mahina zinda rahe, phir unka intiqaal ho gaya, aur us saal Uthman (RA) ne Hajj ki zimmedaari sambhali. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi on summarizing.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] Al-Dhahabi's explanation.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] "Regarding Al-Dhahabi's summarization"
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] I heard Anas ibn Malik saying, "Abdul Rahman ibn Auf migrated to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  formed a brotherhood between him and Sa'd ibn Ar-Rabi'."
hi: Maine Anas bin Malik ko kehte suna: "Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf hijrat karke aaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabee' (RA) ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya."

e: [AI] I heard Ali saying to Abdul Rahman bin Auf on the day of his death, "Go, O son of Auf, for you have reached its purity and surpassed its impurities."
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) se, unki wafaat ke din, kehte suna: "Jaao, Aye Ibn Auf, tumne iski (duniya ki) safaai paa li hai aur iski gandlaahat se pehle nikal gaye ho."

e: [AI] That Abdul Rahman ibn Awf freed thirty thousand homes.
hi: "Beshak Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) ne tees hazaar (30,000) ghar (ghulaam) aazaad kiye."

e: [AI] About Abu Al-Aswad in the naming of those who participated in the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, from the Banu Zuhrah bin Kilab bin Murrah, Abdul Rahman bin Awf bin Zuhair.
hi: Abu Al-Aswad se: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Banu Zuhrah bin Kilaab bin Murrah se, Abdur Rahman bin Auf bin Zuhair (RA) the."

e:
