[AI] The passage translates to:

“’Abdur-Rahman ibn 'Awf left behind a thousand camels and three thousand sheep in Naqee', and one hundred horses grazing in Naqee'. He used to farm in Al-Jurf with twenty irrigating camels, and he would reserve a year's worth of provisions for his household from that. 'Abdur-Rahman ibn 'Awf had embraced Islam before the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  entered the house of Al-Arqam or called therein. He witnessed with the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  the battles of Badr, Uhud, and Al-Khandaq, and all the other battles, and he remained steadfast with the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  when others fled.’ Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.”
hi: Unhone kaha: "Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) ne hazaar (1000) oont, teen hazaar (3000) bhed An-Naqee' mein, aur sau (100) ghode jo An-Naqee' mein charte the, chhode, aur woh Al-Jurf mein bees (20) paani khinchne wale oonton se kheti karte the, aur usme se apne ghar walon ke liye aik saal ki khoraak jama karte the. Abdur Rahman bin Auf ne Islam qubool kiya isse pehle ke Rasulullah (SAW) Daar-e-Arqam mein dakhil huay aur isse pehle ke woh wahan dawat dein, aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jame rahe jab log peeche hate." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He is called the disciple of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ka Hawari (khaas qareebi saathi) kaha jaata hai.

e: [AI] "Othman said: 'Here, oh Miswar! Who claimed to be better than your uncle Abdul Rahman in the first migration has indeed lied.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summarization."
hi: Uthman (RA) (ne kaha): "Suno, Aye Miswar, jo bhi dawa kare ke woh pehli hijrat mein tumhare maamu Abdur Rahman (RA) se behtar hai, usne jhoot bola." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered upon Busrah while she was combing Aisha's hair, and he said, "O Busrah, who is proposing to Umm Kulthum?" She replied, "I heard a man or two men say, 'Where are you all in regards to the leader of the Muslims, Abdur Rahman ibn Awf?'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Busrah ke paas dakhil huay jabke woh Aisha (RA) ke baal sanwaar rahi thin, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Busrah, Umm Kulthum ka rishta kaun maang raha hai?" Unhone kaha: to maine aik ya do aadmiyon ko kehte suna. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To tum Musalmano ke sardaar, Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA), ke baare mein kahan ho?"

e: [AI] "Ali, I am the first one who was pleased, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying to you, 'You are trustworthy among the people of the heavens, trustworthy among the people of the earth.'" Abu Al-Ma'aly is Farat ibn Al-Sa'ib, they abandoned him."
hi: Ali (RA) (ne kaha): "Main sabse pehle raazi honay wala houn, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko tumse kehte suna: tum aasman walon mein amaanatdaar ho, zameen walon mein amaanatdaar ho." Abu Al-Mu'alla, jo Furaat bin As-Saa'ib hain, unhein raawiyon ne chhod diya.

e: [AI] "To slaughter a sheep, and when we finished from it, the owner said to me, 'Indeed, the commander of the faithful did not act properly by issuing a fatwa for you until he asked the man.' Umar heard some of his words, so Umar hit him with a stone and then he came towards me to hit me. So I said, 'O commander of the faithful, I did not say anything, it was he who said it.' He then left me and said, 'You wanted to kill Haram and commit audacity in fatwa.' Then the commander of the faithful said, 'Indeed, in a person there are ten qualities, nine of them are good and one is bad, and that bad qualities ruins them.' Then he said, 'Beware of the stumbling of youth.'"
hi: ...aik bhed zibah karna, jab hum unke paas se uthe, to mere aik saathi ne kaha: "Ameer-ul-Momineen ne aapke liye achha fatwa nahi diya, unhein pehle us aadmi se poochna chahiye tha," to Umar (RA) ne unki kuch baaten sun li, to Umar (RA) ne unhein durrah (chaabuk) se maara, phir mere taraf mudhe mujhe maarne ke liye, maine kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, maine kuch nahi kaha, yeh unhone kaha hai." Unhone kaha: to unhone mujhe chhod diya, phir kaha: "Tum haraam (mana) cheez ke zariye (kisi ko) qatl karna chahte the aur fatwe mein zyaadti karna chahte the." Phir Ameer-ul-Momineen ne kaha: "Insaan mein das (10) khasoosiyaat hoti hain, nau (9) achhi aur aik buri, aur wahi aik buri unhein bigaad deti hai." Phir kaha: "Jawaani ki lagzish se bacho."

e: [AI] Abdul Rahman ibn Awf sold a piece of land that he owned for forty thousand dinars. He divided the money among the Banu Zuhrah, the poor Muslims, the immigrants, and the wives of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . He sent some of that money to Aisha, and she asked, "Who sent this money?" I said, "Abdul Rahman ibn Awf." She then quoted the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  and said, "Only the patient ones will succeed you after me. May Allah quench the thirst of Abdul Rahman ibn Awf from the Salsabil fountain in Paradise."
hi: Beshak Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) ne apni zameen chalis hazaar (40,000) dinar mein bechi, to unhone usse Banu Zuhrah, Musalmano ke gareebon, Muhajireen, aur Nabi (SAW) ki biwiyon mein taqseem kiya. To unhone Aisha (RA) ki taraf usme se kuch maal bheja, unhone poocha: "Yeh maal kisne bheja?" Maine kaha: "Abdur Rahman bin Auf." Unhone poora qissa bataya, kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: "Mere baad tumpar sirf sabr karne wale hi mehrbaan honge, Allah Ibn Auf ko Jannat ke Salsabeel se sairaab kare."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say to his wives, "Verily, the one who shows kindness to you after me is the truthful and righteous. O Allah, bless Abdul Rahman Ibn Awf and provide him with a drink from the rivers of Jannah (Paradise)." The hadith is authenticated by Aisha and Umm Salamah, narrated by Aisha and Umm Salamah.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko apni biwiyon se kehte suna: "Beshak jo mere baad tumpar mehrbaan hoga woh sachcha, nek hai, Aye Allah, Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) ko Jannat ke Salsabeel se sairaab kar." Yeh hadith Aisha (RA) aur Umm Salamah (RA) se sahih saabit hai.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , that he said, "O Ibn Awf, indeed you are among the rich people, and you will not enter Paradise except with difficulty. So lend to Allah and He will release your feet." He said, "How can I lend to Allah?" He said, "Discharge yourself from what you are in." He said, "O Messenger of Allah, from all of it?" He said, "Yes." So Ibn Awf left while he was preoccupied with that, and then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent to him and said, "Gabriel came to me and said, 'Order Ibn Awf to host guests, feed the poor, give charity to the beggars, and start with those who depend on him. For when he does that, it will be a means of purification for him.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ibn Auf, tum daulatmandon mein se ho, aur tum Jannat mein sirf ghisatte huay hi dakhil hoge, isliye Allah ko qarz do, woh tumhare paaon aazaad kar dega." Unhone poocha: "Main Allah ko kaise qarz doon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jis cheez mein tum ho usse bezaar (aazaad) ho jaao." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), sab se poori tarah?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan." To Ibn Auf iska iraada karke nikle, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein bulwaaya aur farmaya: "Mere paas Jibreel aaye, unhone kaha: Ibn Auf ko hukum do ke woh mehmaan ki mehmaan-nawaazi kare, miskeen ko khilaaye, maangne wale ko de, aur apne zair-e-kafaalat logon se shuru kare, kyunke jab woh yeh karega, to yeh unke haal (maal ki paakizgi) ka zariya banega."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best of you is the best to your family after me." Quraysh said, Muhammad ibn Amr narrated to me from Abu Salama ibn Abdur Rahman that his father left a will to the wives of the believers and left them a garden worth forty thousand dinars.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein sabse behtareen woh hai jo mere baad mere ghar walon ke sath sabse behtareen sulook kare."

e: [AI] The translation is as follows: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to me, 'Your matter is of concern to me after my death and only the patient ones will be able to endure it.' Then she (Aisha, the Prophet's wife) said, 'May Allah quench your thirst with water from the Salisabil of Paradise.' Abdul Rahman bin Awf had already given them (Aisha and Hafsa) a portion of his wealth, so they sold it for forty thousand (dirhams). Neither Aisha nor Hafsa needed to go to him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mujhse kaha karte the: "Tumhara maamla mere baad mujhe fikr mein daalta hai, aur tumpar sirf sabr karne wale hi sabr kar sakenge." Phir unhone kaha: "Allah tumhare waalid ko Jannat ke Salsabeel se sairaab kare." Aur Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) ne unhein maal se nawaaza tha, to woh chalis hazaar (40,000) mein becha gaya. Sakhr bin Abdullah sachche hain, dono ne unse kuch nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] I narrate on the authority of Musa ibn Awn ibn Abdullah ibn Awn, who narrated from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ibn Kahil ibn Habib ibn Tamir ibn Makhzum ibn Sahilah ibn Kahil ibn Al-Harith ibn Taym ibn Saad ibn Hudhayl ibn Mudrikah ibn Ilyas ibn Mudar ibn Nizar.
hi: Musa bin Aun bin Abdullah bin Aun ne mujhe (yeh nasab) likhwaaya: "Abdullah bin Mas'ood bin Kaahil bin Habeeb bin Taamir bin Makhzoom bin Saahilah bin Kaahil bin Al-Harith bin Taim bin Sa'd bin Huzail bin Mudrikah bin Ilyas bin Mudar bin Nizaar."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ibn al-Harith ibn Shamkh ibn Makhzum ibn Kahil ibn al-Harith ibn Saad ibn Hudhayl from the allies of Bani Zuhrah." Al-Waqidi has disagreed with them regarding this lineage.
hi: "Abdullah bin Mas'ood bin Al-Harith bin Shamkh bin Makhzoom bin Kaahil bin Al-Harith bin Sa'd bin Huzail, Banu Zuhrah ke ahd-waale saathiyon mein se," Al-Waqidi ne is nasab mein in dono se ikhtilaaf kiya hai.

e: [AI] Ammar ibn Yasir, may Allah send blessings upon him, was buried in Al-Baqi' at night. He was sixty-two years old.
hi: "Ammaar bin Yasir (RA) ki namaz padhi gayi aur unhein raat ko Baqee' mein dafan kiya gaya, jabke woh saath se kuch zyada (saal ke) thay."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet (pbuh) called him Abu Abdullah but he did not have any children."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Abu Abdur Rahman ki kunniyat di, aur unhein koi aulaad naseeb nahi hui."

e: [AI] The mother of Abdullah ibn Mas'ood is Umm Abd, the daughter of Abd ibn Al-Harith ibn Zuhrah.
hi: "Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ki maa Umm Abd bint Abd bin Al-Harith bin Zuhrah thin."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Ma'in saying: The kunya of Abdullah bin Masud is Abu Abdul Rahman.
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Abdur Rahman thi."

e: [AI] And it is said that she was from the continent.
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai ke woh Al-Qaarah (qabile) se thin.

e: [AI] "I have seen myself as the sixth of sixty [Muslims] on earth, none of whom are other than us." It is a sound chain of transmission and it hasn't been reported correctly.
hi: "Maine apne aap ko chhah (6) mein se chhata dekha, zameen par humare siwa koi Musalman na tha." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e:
[AI] The translation of the given text in Arabic into English is: 

"And among those who migrated to Abyssinia before the departure of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib and Abdullah ibn Mas'ud was Urwah."
hi: Urwah (ne kaha): "Aur jinhone Habsha (Abyssinia) ki pehli hijrat ki, Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ke nikalne se pehle, unme Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) the."

e: [AI] "Regarding Al-Dhahabi in summarizing"
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] Abdullah bin Mas'ood died in the city, and Zubayr bin Al-Awwam prayed on him.
hi: "Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah mein hua, aur Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi."

e: [AI] "Between Zubayr ibn al-Awwam and Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, the reliable chain of narration of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and it has been authenticated."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) aur Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] Abdullah used to visit him every year, but he would not speak about the Prophet ﷺ. So one day he narrated a hadith from the Prophet ﷺ, and it saddened him, causing sweat to trickle down his forehead, and he said, "Something similar to this or close to it."
hi: Abdullah (RA) par aik saal guzar jaata aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) se kuch riwayat nahi karte, phir aik din unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se aik hadith bayan ki, to unpar udaasi chha gayi aur unki peshaani par paseena bahne laga, woh kehte: "Isi tarah ya iske qareeb."

e: "My brother and I arrived from Yemen, and we did not see a period except that we thought 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud was a man from the people of the house of the Prophet ﷺ, due to what we would see of him entering, and his mother's entering, upon the Prophet ﷺ." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3806)
hi: Beshak unhone Abu Musa (RA) ko kehte suna: "Main aur mera bhai Yemen se aaye, humne kuch der tak yehi samjha ke Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghar walon mein se aik hain, kyunke hum unhein aur unki maa ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghar aata-jaata dekhte the."

e: [AI] "That the son of the mother of Abd is among the closest to them and a means to Allah on the Day of Judgment."
hi: "Beshak Ibn Umm Abd (Abdullah bin Mas'ood), Qayamat ke din, Allah ke nazdeek unke sabse zyada qareebi zariya (waseela) rakhne walon mein se hain."

e: [AI] "When Abdullah rested his eyes, I would hear a sound from him, like the buzzing sound of bees, until dawn." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: "Jab (logon ki) aankhein so jaatin, to Abdullah (bin Mas'ood) (RA) se aik gunjan jaisi aawaaz sunayi deti, jaisi shehad ki makkhiyon ki gunjan, subah tak." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdullah used to give us a sermon every Thursday standing on his feet, and he would speak with words that we eagerly desired to hear." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing it.
hi: "Abdullah (RA) har Jumeraat (Thursday) humein khada hokar khutba dete, aur woh kuch kalmaat kehte, aur hum chahte the ke woh (aur) zyada kahen." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I read in the book of 'Umar to the people of Yemen and Kufa, 'Afterwards, you are the head of the Arabs and its skull, and you are my arrow that I shoot if anything comes from here and here. I have sent to you Abdullah, chosen him for you and preferred you over myself.'" Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary."
hi: Maine Umar (RA) ka Yemen aur Kufa walon ke naam khat padha: "Ammaa ba'd, tum Arab ka sar aur khopdi ho, aur tum mera woh teer ho jisse main chalaata houn agar kahin se bhi koi cheez aaye, aur maine tumhare paas Abdullah ko bheja hai, unhein tumhare liye chuna hai, aur unhein tumhare liye apne aap par tarjeeh di hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I say about him what they have said, that he is the best of those who have recited the Quran and has permitted what is lawful and forbidden what is forbidden. He is a scholar in religion and knowledgeable about the Sunnah." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in the summary.
hi: "Main unke baare mein wahi kehta houn jo unhone kaha, aur woh Quran padhne walon mein sabse behtareen, uska halaal halaal karne wale aur haraam haraam karne wale, deen mein faqeeh, Sunnat ke aalim hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Musa said, "If you say that, then indeed he used to hear when we did not hear and enter when we did not enter." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Abu Musa (RA): "Agar tum yeh kaho, to (jaan lo ke) woh sunte the jab hum nahi sunte the, aur (kahin) dakhil hote the jab hum dakhil nahi hote the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Indeed, Allah has forgiven me one of my sins, and I have been called as Abdullah bin Rawthah. Alla of it is authentic.
hi: "Beshak Allah ne mere gunahon mein se aik gunah maaf kar diya, aur mujhe Abdullah bin Rawthah pukaara gaya." Sab sahih hain.

e: [AI] "I traveled to Sham (Levant) and performed two units of prayer, then I said: "O Allah, facilitate for me a righteous companion." I met a group of people, so I sat down, and suddenly, someone came and sat beside me. I asked, 'Who is this?' He replied, 'Abu Darda.' I said, 'Verily, I prayed to Allah to facilitate for me a righteous companion, and He facilitated for me.' He asked, 'Where are you from?' I said, 'From the people of Kufa.' He said, 'Do you not have with you the son of Umm Abdu, the companion of the two sandals, the pillow, and the pitcher, and among you the one whom Allah protected from Satan on the tongue of His Prophet ﷺ , and among you is the companion of the secret of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that no one else knows?'"
hi: Main Sham pahuncha, do rak'atein padhin, phir kaha: "Aye Allah, mujhe aik neik saathi de." Meri mulaqaat kuch logon se hui, to main baith gaya, achaanak aik aadmi aaya aur mere paas baith gaya, maine poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Abu Darda." Maine kaha: "Maine Allah se dua ki thi ke mujhe aik neik saathi de, to usne mujhe de diya." Unhone poocha: "Tum kahan se ho?" Maine kaha: "Kufa se." Unhone kaha: "Kya tumhare paas Ibn Umm Abd, jute, takki, aur wuzu ke bartan ke maalik, nahi hain, aur tum mein woh hain jinhein Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ki zubaan se Shaitan se mahfooz rakha, aur tum mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke us raaz ke maalik hain jise unke siwa koi nahi jaanta?"

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said: "There are ten in Paradise," and he mentioned Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Talha, Zubair, Abdur Rahman ibn Awf, Saad ibn Abi Waqqas, Saeed ibn Zaid, and Abdullah ibn Masood.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Das (10) Jannat mein hain," to unhone Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Talhah, Zubair, Abdur Rahman bin Auf, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas, Sa'eed bin Zaid, aur Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ka zikr kiya.

e:
[AI] The translation of the given phrase in English is:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'By the One in whose hand is my soul, they both are heavier in the scale than Uhud.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW): "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh dono taraazu mein Uhud se bhi bhaari hain."

e: [AI] I was with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and with him was Abu Bakr and whoever Allah willed from his companions. We passed by Abdullah bin Mas'ud while he was praying. The Prophet ﷺ asked, "Who is this?" It was said, "It is Abdullah bin Mas'ud." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, Abdullah recites the Quran with attentiveness as it was revealed." Abdullah praised and glorified his Lord and performed the best praise for his Lord. Then, he asked the Prophet ﷺ and presented the most excellent question, a question asked by a servant to his Lord. Then, he said, "O Allah, I ask You for a faith that does not falter and a bliss that never ends, and to accompany Muhammad ﷺ in the highest ranks of Paradise, in Your Gardens of everlasting bliss." The Prophet ﷺ used to say, "Ask, and you shall be granted. Ask, and you shall be granted" twice. I quickly ran to give him the good news, but I found that Abu Bakr had already informed him, as he was always ahead in doing good.
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke sath tha, aur unke sath Abu Bakr aur jinhein Allah ne chaaha unke sahaba mein se the, humara guzar Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) par hua jabke woh namaz padh rahe the, Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Kaha gaya: "Abdullah bin Mas'ood." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Abdullah Quran taaza (jaisa nazil hua tha) padhta hai." To Abdullah ne apne Rab ki tareef ki aur uski hamd ki, aur apne Rab ki hamd achhe tarike se ki, phir unse sawaal kiya, aur khoobsurat andaaz mein sawaal kiya, jaisa kisi bande ne apne Rab se behtareen sawaal kiya ho, phir kaha: "Aye Allah, main tujhse aisa imaan maangta houn jo palta na khaaye, aur aisi ne'mat maangta houn jo khatam na ho, aur Muhammad (SAW) ki sohbat Illiyeen ki buland manzilon mein, teri hamesha rehne wali Jannaton mein." Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte the: "Maango, tumhein diya jaayega, maango, tumhein diya jaayega," do martaba. To main unhein khushkhabri dene ke liye chal pada, achaanak Abu Bakr mujhse pehle pahunch chuke the, aur woh bhalaai mein hamesha sabqat rakhte the.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I am pleased for my ummah (community) with what the son of Umm Abd is pleased with." This is an authentic chain according to the conditions of the two scholars, and they did not exclude it, but it has a weakness in the narration of Sufyan Ath-Thawri. So Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Imran Al-Faqih informed us, narrating from Ibrahim ibn Abi Talib, who narrated from Abu Kurayb, who narrated from Waki', who narrated from Sufyan. As for the hadith of Israel, it is a fabricated one.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main apni Ummat ke liye usi cheez se raazi houn jispar Ibn Umm Abd raazi hain." Yeh isnad sahih hai, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur ismein Sufyan Ath-Thawri ki riwayat se aik illat (khaamiyaan) hai. Humein Muhammad bin Musa bin Imran Al-Faqih ne bataya, humein Ibrahim bin Abi Talib ne hadith bayan ki, humein Abu Kuraib ne hadith bayan ki, humein Waki' ne Sufyan se hadith bayan ki, aur rahi baat Isra'eel ki riwayat ki, to woh Mursal (isnad mein sahabi ka naam chhoota hua) hai.

e: [AI] The translation of the given phrase is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I am pleased for my Ummah (followers) with what the son of a slave woman is pleased for her.'"
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main apni Ummat ke liye usi cheez se raazi houn jispar Ibn Umm Abd raazi hain."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If I were to appoint anyone to a position of authority without consulting (the believers), I would have appointed Ibn Umm ʿAbd (ʿAbdullah bin Masʿood).ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 739)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar main bagair mashware ke kisi ko khalifa banaata, to zaroor Ibn Umm Abd (Abdullah bin Mas'ood) ko unpar khalifa banaata."

e: Abu Bakr and 'Umar gave him the glad tidings that the Messenger of Allah had said: "Whoever would like to recite the Qur'an as fresh as when it was revealed, let him recite it like Ibn Umm 'Abd.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 138)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Quran taaza (jaisa nazil hua) padhna chaahe, woh Ibn Umm Abd ki qiraat (tarz) par padhe."

e: [AI] I was sitting with Umar when a thin man came to him. Umar looked at him and his face lit up, then he said, "How filled with knowledge he is! How filled with knowledge he is!" referring to Abdullah ibn Mas'ood.
hi: Main Umar (RA) ke paas baitha tha ke unke paas aik dubla-patla aadmi aaya, unhone unhein dekhna shuru kiya aur unka chehra khil utha, phir kaha: "Yeh kitne ilm se bhare huay hain? Yeh kitne ilm se bhare huay hain?" Unka ishara Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ki taraf tha.

e: [AI] Inform us about the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said, "Tell us about Abdullah ibn Mas'ud." He said, "He had knowledge of the Quran and Sunnah, then he stopped and considered that sufficient." He mentioned the rest of the hadith, "It is authentic according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (referring to Imam al-Bukhari and Imam Muslim) and they did not exclude it." According to the conditions of al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Humein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ke baare mein bataayen." Unhone poocha: "Kiske baare mein?" Unhone kaha: "Humein Abdullah bin Mas'ood ke baare mein bataayen." Unhone kaha: "Unhone Kitaab aur Sunnat ka ilm haasil kiya, phir usi par ruk gaye, aur wahi unke liye kaafi tha." Baaqi hadith ka zikr: "Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "I and Ibn Masood stayed in five quarters of the Quraysh. Quraysh said to the Prophet ﷺ , 'If you expelled these people from you, we would sit with you and keep these people away from us.' Then Allah revealed, 'Do not expel those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His countenance. Not upon you is anything of their account, and not upon them is anything of your account. So were you to expel them, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers.' [Al-An'am: 52] Until His saying, 'so be grateful to Me and to your parents.' [Al-An'am: 53]."
hi: Yeh (ayat) paanch (5) logon ke baare mein nazil hui, Quraish se, jinme main aur Ibn Mas'ood bhi the, to Quraish ne Nabi (SAW) se kaha: "Agar aap inhein apne se dur kar dein, to hum aapke sath baithenge, aap inhein humse zyada qareeb rakhte hain." To yeh nazil hui: "{Un logon ko dur na karo jo apne Rab ko subah aur shaam pukaarte hain, uska chehra chahte huay}" (Surah Al-An'am 52) is aayat tak: "{shukar-guzaaron ke sath}" (Surah Al-An'am 53).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to Abdullah ibn Mas'ood, "Read." Abdullah replied, "I can only recite what has been revealed to me." The Prophet said, "I want to hear it from someone else." So Abdullah started reciting Surah An-Nisa' until he reached the verse, "So how [will it be] when We bring from every nation a witness and we bring you, [O Muhammad] against these [people] as a witness?" (Quran 4:41) At this point, the Prophet started pondering and stopped Abdullah. The Prophet said to him, "Continue." Abdullah praised Allah in his first words, thanked and glorified Him, and sent blessings upon the Prophet. He then gave testimony to the truth and said, "We are content with Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion, and with what pleases Allah and His Messenger." The Prophet replied, "I am content with what pleases you, O son of Umm Abd."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) se farmaya: "Padho." Unhone kaha: "Main padhoon jabke yeh aapke hi upar nazil hua hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe pasand hai ke main ise kisi aur se sunoon." Unhone kaha: to unhone Surah An-Nisa shuru ki yahan tak ke woh yahan pahunche: "{To kaisa hoga jab hum har Ummat se aik gawaah laayenge, aur aapko in sab par gawaah bana kar laayenge}" (Surah An-Nisa 41), to Rasulullah (SAW) ki aankhon mein aansoo aa gaye, aur Abdullah ruk gaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Baat karo." To unhone apni baat ki shuru mein Allah ki hamd ki aur uski tareef ki, aur Nabi (SAW) par durood bheja, aur haq ki gawahi di, aur kaha: "Hum Allah ko Rab maankar, Islam ko deen maankar raazi ho gaye," aur main tumhare liye wahi pasand karta houn jo Allah aur uske Rasool ne pasand kiya. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhare liye wahi pasand karta houn jo Ibn Umm Abd ne tumhare liye pasand kiya."

e: [AI] "He was a brother who mentioned the Companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, but he did not mention Ibn Mas'ood. So I said to him, 'I see that you do not mention Ibn Mas'ood.' He said, 'That man is someone whom I do not prefer anyone over.'"
hi: Shaqeeq Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba ka zikr kiya karte the, magar unhone Ibn Mas'ood (RA) ka zikr nahi kiya, to maine unse kaha: "Main dekh raha houn aap Ibn Mas'ood ka zikr nahi karte." Unhone kaha: "Woh aik aisa aadmi hai jispar main kisi ko tarjeeh nahi deta."

e: [AI] "Abdullah used to resemble the Prophet ﷺ  in his guidance, behavior, and appearance." Ibrahim said, "Alqamah used to resemble Abdullah."
hi: "Abdullah (RA) apne tareeke, andaaz, aur waqar mein Nabi (SAW) se milte-julte the." Ibrahim ne kaha: "Aur Alqamah Abdullah se milte-julte the."

e: [AI] "The day seemed long to me, so I remembered who I was speaking to. He said, 'And then he started telling me about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I was telling him too. He then began telling me and said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'The one who is asleep during a time of turmoil is better than the one who lies down, and the one who lies down is better than the one who sits, and the one who sits is better than the one who stands, and the one who stands is better than the one who walks, and the one who walks is better than the one who rides; their killings are all in the fire.'' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, when will that be?' He said, 'That will be during the times of turmoil.' I said, 'And when are the times of turmoil?' He said, 'When a person cannot trust their companion.' I said, 'So, what do you command me to do if I live to see that time?' He said, 'Restrain yourself, your hands, and enter your home.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what if someone enters my home?' He said, 'Then enter your masjid and perform prayers in this manner,' or he clutched his right hand onto his left forearm and said, 'My Lord is Allah,' until you die on that.' Al-Dhahabi did not mention what followed this in his summary."
hi: Din mujhpar lamba ho gaya, to maine socha kis se baat karoon, unhone kaha: to woh mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein bataane lage, aur main unhein bataane laga, phir unhone mujhe (yeh) hadith bayan ki, kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Aik fitna hogi jisme sone wala letne wale se behtar hoga, aur letne wala baithne wale se behtar hoga, aur baithne wala khade honay wale se behtar hoga, aur khade honay wala chalne wale se behtar hoga, aur chalne wala sawaar se behtar hoga, uske maqtool sab Jahannam mein honge." Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh kab hoga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Harj (fasaad, khoon-kharaabi) ke dinon mein hoga." Maine poocha: "Harj ke din kab honge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab aadmi apne sath baithne wale par bharosa na kar sake." Maine poocha: "To agar main woh zamana paaun, to aap mujhe kya hukum dete hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne aap aur apne haath ko rok lo, aur apne ghar mein dakhil ho jaao." Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), agar koi mere ghar mein aa jaaye to?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To apne kamre mein dakhil ho jaao." Maine poocha: "Agar koi mere kamre mein aa jaaye to?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To apni masjid mein dakhil ho jaao aur aisa karo," ya unhone apni daayen haath se apni kalai pakdi, "aur kaho: mera Rab Allah hai, yahan tak ke tum isi par mar jaao." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] It was said to Al-Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib, "Which one of you is older, you or the Prophet ﷺ?" He replied, "He is older than me, and I was born before him."
hi: Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) se poocha gaya: "Aap dono mein bada kaun hai, aap ya Nabi (SAW)?" To unhone kaha: "Woh mujhse bade hain, aur main unse pehle paida hua."

e: [AI] "Al-Abbas was three years younger than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He came to my mother and was told that Amina had given birth to a boy. She took me out by the hand in the morning, and we entered upon her. It was as if I were looking at him sucking on his toes in his cradle. The women started telling me and saying, 'Kiss your brother.' Al-Abbas passed away at the age of forty-four, when he was eighty-eight years old."
hi: "Abbas (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) se teen (3) saal bade the." (Kisi ko) meri maa ke paas laaya gaya, unse kaha gaya ke Aminah ne aik ladka janam diya, to unhone mujhe subah lekar nikli, mera haath pakde huay, yahan tak ke hum unke paas gaye, to goya main unhein dekh raha houn apni jagah par apne paaon hilaate huay, aur auraten mujhse baaten karne lagin aur kehne lagin: "Apne bhai ko choom lo." Unhone kaha: aur Abbas ka intiqaal chauwtees (34) hijri mein hua, jabke woh atthaasi (88) saal ke thay.

e: [AI] That Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib bin Hashim bin Abd Manaf is a cousin of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. His mother is Nuteila bint Khabbab bin Kulayb bin Malik bin Amr bin Amr bin Zaid bin Manat bin Amir Al-Khazrajiya. Abbas was also known as Abu Al-Fadl. Al-Fadl was his eldest son. Abbas was three years older than Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Abbas witnessed the conquests of Mecca, Hunayn, Taif, and Tabuk with Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. He stayed with him on the day of Hunayn with his family when people abandoned him.
hi: Beshak Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib bin Hashim bin Abd Manaf, Rasulullah (SAW) ke chacha, unki maa Nutailah bint Khabbaab bin Kulaib bin Malik bin Amr bin Aamir bin Zaid Manaat bin Aamir Al-Khazrajiyyah thin, aur Abbas ki kunniyat Abu Al-Fadl thi, aur Al-Fadl unki aulaad mein sabse bade the, aur Abbas Rasulullah (SAW) se teen (3) saal bade the, aur Abbas ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Fatah-e-Makkah, Hunain, Taaif, aur Tabook mein shirkat ki, aur Hunain ke din unke sath, unke ghar walon mein, jame rahe jab log unse bhaag gaye.

e: [AI] "Umm al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib is Nuteila, the daughter of Khabbab ibn Kulayb ibn Malik ibn Amr ibn Amer ibn al-Namir ibn Qasit. Abbas was born three years before the Year of the Elephant."
hi: "Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ki maa Nutailah bint Khabbaab bin Kulaib bin Malik bin Amr bin Aamir bin An-Namir bin Qaasit thin, Abbas Feel (haathi) waale saal se teen (3) saal pehle paida huay."

e: [AI] Al-Abbas freed seventy slaves upon his death.
hi: "Abbas (RA) ne apni maut ke waqt sattar (70) ghulam aazaad kiye."

e: [AI] From Abu Rafi, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: I was a young boy under the guardianship of Al-Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib, and I had embraced Islam, and so had the mother of Al-Fadl and Al-Abbas. Al-Abbas had concealed his Islam out of fear from his people, and Abu Lahab had withdrawn from the battle of Badr and sent Al-'As bin Hisham in his place. Al-'As had a debt to Al-Abbas, so he said to him, "Settle my debt for me and I will fight in this battle on your behalf." So Al-Abbas agreed and settled his debt. When the news of the battle reached us, Allah disgraced Abu Lahab. I was a weak man who used to carve arrowheads in a room, and by Allah, I was sitting in that room carving arrowheads while Umm Al-Fadl was with me. Suddenly, I saw Abu Lahab dragging his feet near the door of the room, and his back was towards me. The people said, "This is Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith." Abu Lahab said to him, "Come here, O son of my brother." So Abu Sufyan went and sat with him. When the people saw them, they gathered around them. Abu Lahab asked Abu Sufyan, "How did things go with the people?" Abu Sufyan replied, "Nothing, By Allah, if we had met them and they attacked us, they would have killed us as they pleased and captured us as they pleased. By Allah, I have not seen people with white garments on fast horses like them. By Allah, no one could stand against them." Then, I lifted up the door of the room and said, "By Allah, those were angels." Abu Lahab raised his hand and struck me on the face, causing my nose to bleed. He then threw me to the ground, hitting me until I fell down. Umm Al-Fadl stood up and seized him, taking hold of a pillar in the room and struck him with it, causing him to bleed from the head, and she said, "O enemy of Allah, you have weakened him. If you have seen his master absent, he would have stood up humiliated. By Allah, he did not live for more than seven nights until Allah struck him with a swelling, and he died. He left his two sons for two or three nights without burying him until you (Quraysh) did." Then a man from Quraysh said to his two sons, "Are you not ashamed that your father's body is in his house?" They replied, "We fear this wound." Quraysh used to fear this swelling just as they feared the plague. The man said, "I will go with you." They said, "By Allah, they did not wash him except by pouring water on him from a distance. Then they carried him to the highest point in Makkah and threw him over the wall, and then they stoned him." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Abu Rafi' (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, se, unhone kaha: main Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ka ghulam tha, aur maine Islam qubool kiya tha, aur Umm Al-Fadl (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya tha, aur Abbas (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya tha, magar woh apni qaum ke darr se apna Islam chhupaaye rakhte the. Aur Abu Lahab Badr se peeche reh gaya tha, aur usne apni jagah Al-Aas bin Hisham ko bheja, aur uspar uska qarz tha, to usne usse kaha: "Iss jung (mein jaane) se mujhe bacha lo, aur main tumhara qarz maaf kar dunga," to usne aisa kiya. Jab khabar aayi, aur Allah ne Abu Lahab ko zaleel kiya, aur main aik kamzor aadmi tha, main aik kamre mein yeh peele (teer) tarashta tha. Allah ki qasam, main kamre mein baitha apne teer tarash raha tha, aur mere paas Umm Al-Fadl thi, ke achaanak woh fasiq (badkaar) Abu Lahab apne paaon ghaseetta hua aaya, mera khayaal hai unhone kaha kamre ki rassi ke paas, aur uski peeth meri peeth ki taraf thi, to logon ne kaha: "Yeh Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith hai." To Abu Lahab ne kaha: "Idhar aao, Aye mere bhatije." To Abu Sufyan aaya aur uske paas baith gaya, log aaye aur unke ird-gird khade ho gaye, to usne poocha: "Aye mere bhatije, logon ka kya haal raha?" Usne kaha: "Kuch khaas nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum unse mile, humne unhein apni peeth de di, unhone humein jaisa chaaha qatl kiya aur jaisa chaaha qaid kiya, aur Allah ki qasam, maine logon ko malaamat nahi ki." Usne poocha: "Kyun?" Usne kaha: "Maine safed mard, dabbe/chitte ghodon par, dekhe, Allah ki qasam, koi cheez unke saamne tik nahi sakti thi aur koi cheez unhein rok nahi sakti thi." Unhone kaha: to maine kamre ki rassi uthaayi aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh farishtay the!" To Abu Lahab ne apna haath uthaya aur mere chehre par maara, aur main uspar toota, to usne mujhe uthaaya aur zameen par patka yahan tak ke woh mere seene par baith gaya. To Umm Al-Fadl khadi hui, unhone apna aanchal sambhaala, aur kamre ke khambon mein se aik khamba uthaaya aur usse maara, to unhone uske sar par aik bhayanak zakhm laga diya, aur kaha: "Aye Allah ke dushman, tune isse kamzor samjha kyunke tune iska maalik (Abbas) gair-haazir dekha?" To woh zaleel hokar utha. Allah ki qasam, woh saat (7) raaton se zyada zinda na raha, yahan tak ke Allah ne usse 'adasah' (aik bimari ka daana) se maara, jisne usse maar diya. Uske dono beton ne usse do ya teen raaton tak nahi dafnaaya yahan tak ke woh badboo-daar ho gaya, to Quraish ke aik aadmi ne uske beton se kaha: "Kya tumhein sharm nahi aati, tumhare waalid ka jism ghar mein sadh raha hai?" To unhone kaha: "Humein is bimari se darr lagta hai," aur Quraish is (bimari) 'adasah' se aisi hi ehtiyaat karte the jaisi taa'oon (plague) se karte hain. To aik aadmi ne kaha: "Chalo, main tumhare sath houn." Allah ki qasam, unhone usse sirf door se paani phenk kar nehlaaya, phir usse uthaaya aur Makkah ke oonche hisse mein aik deewar ke paas phenk diya, aur uspar patthar phenk diye. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Golden in summarization by Al-Dhahabi.
hi: Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein unke baare mein.

e: [AI] "To throw a stone at the seventy riders from the Ansar who came to visit the Prophet ﷺ , and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out to us with his paternal uncle, Abbas, and said, 'O uncle, take revenge for me from your relatives.' Abbas said, 'O Muhammad, ask your Lord and ask for yourself whatever you want.' The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'As for what I am asking you for myself, you refrain from giving it to me while refraining from it in regards to your wealth and yourselves.' They asked, 'What will we lose if we do so?' He replied, 'Paradise.' All these narrations are with the same wording, and in the narration of Musa ibn Imran, no one heard it except from him."
hi: ...pathar maarne ka (irada tha) un sattar (70) sawaaron mein se jo Ansar mein se Nabi (SAW) ke paas wafd banakar aaye the, to Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas nikle, unke sath unke chacha Abbas (RA) the, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye chacha, mere liye apne maamu (Ansar) se ahd-o-paimaan lein." Unhone kaha: "Aye Muhammad, apne Rab ke liye aur apne liye jo chaaho maango." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Rahi baat jo main apne liye tumse maangta houn, to tum mujhe usse usi tarah roko jaise tum apna maal aur apni jaan uski hifaazat karte ho." Unhone poocha: "To agar hum aisa karein, to humein kya milega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat." Yeh sab riwayaten aik hi alfaaz mein hain, aur Musa bin Imran ki hadith mein, unhone sirf unse hi suna.

e: [AI] We, the family of Al-Abbas, embraced Islam and kept our Islam hidden. I was a servant to Al-Abbas, carving cups and utensils. When the Quraysh marched towards the Messenger of Allah on the day of Badr, we anticipated news. The messenger of Allah came and gave us the guarantee of safety through the Khazai'i. We found strength within ourselves and were delighted by the news of the appearance of the Messenger of Allah. By Allah, I was sitting near Zamzam carving cups, and with me was Umm al-Fadl, and we were pleased with the news that came to us about the appearance of the Messenger of Allah. We were informed about the messenger of Allah when the wicked Abu Lahab approached, dragging his legs. Allah humiliated and disgraced him for what he received of the news. He sat on the doorstep and the people gathered around him. Abu Lahab said to him, "Come to me, O son of my brother," and he sat between his hands. He asked him about people and he replied, "Yes, by Allah, if we meet people and give them our support, they put their weapons wherever they wished. But the people we met were men riding on fast horses. By Allah, nothing remained." I raised the doorstep and said, "Those are the angels, by Allah." Abu Lahab raised his hand and struck my face, delivering a blow that blemished me. Umm al-Fadl approached a tent pole from the columns of the tent, grabbed it, said, "You humiliated him, even if his master is absent," and struck him on the head, causing him pain and leaving a mark. He then dragged his legs and was afflicted by an ophthalmia that Allah cast upon him. By Allah, he did not live for more than seven days until he died. His sons left him in his house for three days until he began to decompose. Quraysh feared that ophthalmia and avoided touching his body. A man from Quraysh said to them, "Shame on you, don't you feel ashamed? Your father has decomposed in his house, and you don't bury him." They replied, "We fear the contagion of this wound." The man said, "Go, I will help you." By Allah, they did not wash him except by throwing water from a distance, never approaching him. Then they carried him to the top of Makkah and leaned him against a wall, then stoned him.
hi: Hum Aal-e-Abbas Islam mein dakhil ho chuke the, aur hum apna Islam chhupaate the, aur main Abbas (RA) ka ghulam tha, peele (teer) tarashta tha, jab Quraish Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf Badr ke din nikle, to hum khabar ka intezaar karne lage, to hum tak Ad-Damaan Al-Khuza'i khabar lekar aaye, to humme apne andar taaqat mehsoos hui aur woh khabar jo humein Rasulullah (SAW) ki fatah ki mili usse hum khush huay, Allah ki qasam, main Zamzam ke chabootre par baitha peele tarash raha tha, aur mere paas Umm Al-Fadl (RA) baithi thin, aur humein Rasulullah (SAW) ki fatah ki khabar se khushi hui thi, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf se yeh baat humein pahunchi thi, ke achaanak woh khabees Abu Lahab apne paaon ghaseetta hua aaya, Allah ne usse zaleel aur ruswaa kiya tha us khabar ki wajah se jo usse pahunchi thi, yahan tak ke woh kamre ki rassi par baith gaya, log kehne lage: "Yeh Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith hai jo aaya hai," aur log uske ird-gird jama ho gaye, to Abu Lahab ne usse kaha: "Idhar aao, mere bhatije," to woh uske saamne baith gaya, usne poocha: "Mujhe logon ke baare mein bataao." Usne kaha: "Ji haan, Allah ki qasam, yeh (kuch) nahi, agar hum qaum se mile, to humne unhein apni peeth de di, woh humpar jahan chaahen hathiyaar rakhte hain, Allah ki qasam, iske baawajood main logon ko malaamat nahi karta, hum safed mard, dabbe/chitte ghodon par, mile, Allah ki qasam, kuch bhi baaqi na bacha." Unhone kaha: to maine kamre ki rassi uthaayi aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh farishtay the!" Unhone kaha: to Abu Lahab ne apna haath uthaya aur mere chehre par aik sakht zarb lagayi, aur main uspar toota, aur main aik kamzor aadmi tha, to usne mujhe uthaaya aur zameen par patka aur mere seene par baith gaya aur mujhe maara, to Umm Al-Fadl khaime ke khambon mein se aik khambe ki taraf khadi hui, use uthaaya, aur woh keh rahi thi: "Tune isse kamzor samjha jabke uska maalik gair-haazir hai," aur usse khambe se uske sar par maara, aur usme aik bhayanak zakhm daal diya, to woh apne paaon ghaseetta hua zaleel hokar utha, aur Allah ne usse 'adasah' (aik daana-dar bimari) se maara, Allah ki qasam, woh saat (7) din se zyada nahi raha yahan tak ke mar gaya, aur uske dono beton ne usse teen (3) din tak apne ghar mein chhoda, usse nahi dafnaaya yahan tak ke woh badboo-daar ho gaya, aur Quraish is 'adasah' se aisi hi ehtiyaat karte the jaisi taa'oon se karte hain, yahan tak ke Quraish ke aik aadmi ne un dono se kaha: "Afsos tum dono par, kya tumhein sharm nahi aati, tumhare waalid tumhare ghar mein badboo-daar ho rahe hain, tum unhein nahi dafnaate?" To unhone kaha: "Humein is zakhm ki chhoot (sirayat) ka darr hai." Usne kaha: "Chalo, main tumhari madad karta houn." Allah ki qasam, unhone usse sirf door se paani phenk kar nehlaaya, uske qareeb nahi gaye, phir usse uthaaya aur Makkah ke oonche hisse mein le gaye, usse deewar se tikaaya, phir uspar patthar dhakel diye. Husain bin Abdullah bin Ubaidullah kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "Now listen to the one whom Husayn ibn Abdullah opposes."
hi: Aur ab suno woh (riwayat) jo iske khilaaf hai. Husain bin Abdullah kamzor hain.

e: Some men of the Ansar requested Messenger of Allah ﷺ to allow them to see him, they said, "Allow us to forgive the ransom of our sister's son, ʿAbbas." The Prophet ﷺ said, "By Allah, you will not leave a single Dirham of it!" (Using translation from Bukhārī 4018)
hi: Beshak Ansar mein se kuch log Rasulullah (SAW) se ijaazat maangne aaye, unhone kaha: "Humein ijaazat dein ke hum apne bhaanje Abbas (RA) ka fidya maaf kar dein." To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, tum aik dirham bhi nahi chhodoge!"

e: [AI] When the people of Mecca came to redeem their captive family members, Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, was sent to redeem Abu Al-'As. She had a necklace that Khadijah, may Allah be pleased with her, gave to her by which she had entered upon Abu Al-'As when they were married. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw her, he felt immense tenderness towards her and said, "If you agree to give her captive to her and return what belongs to her, then do so." They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah," and returned what belonged to her, based on the condition of a Muslim.
hi: Jab Makkah walon ne apne qaidiyon ke fidye ke liye aaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Zainab (RA) ne Abu Al-Aas ke fidye ke liye bheja, aur usme aik haar bheja jo Khadijah (RA) ne unhein Abu Al-Aas ke ghar bhejte waqt diya tha jab unka nikah hua tha. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne woh dekha, to unhein bohot narmi mehsoos hui, aur farmaya: "Agar tum theek samjho ke unke qaidi ko chhod do aur unka haq unhein wapas kar do, to aisa karo." Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)," aur unka haq unhein wapas kar diya. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to show special respect to Al-Abbas, as Allah specifically bestowed this status upon him among the people.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Abbas (RA) ki khaas izzat karte the, jaisi aulaad apne waalid ki karti hai, aur yeh aik khaas khoobi thi jo Allah ne Abbas ko logon mein se khaas di."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "Al-Abbas is from me and I am from him." The chain of narration is authentic and it has not been recorded in Sahih.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abbas mujhse hain aur main unse houn." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Abu Al-Fadl, you have from Allah until you are pleased."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Al-Fadl, aapko Allah ki taraf se (itna milega) yahan tak ke aap raazi ho jaayen."

e:
[AI] I was once in the mosque when Abu Jahl approached me and said, "By Allah, if I see Muhammad in prostration, I will step on his neck." So, I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him of Abu Jahl's words. He became visibly angry and went towards the mosque. I hurried to follow him. He entered the mosque while reciting, "Read in the name of your Lord who created," until he reached the verse, "No! Indeed, man transgresses because he sees himself self-sufficient." (Surah Al-Alaq, verse 7).

A man said to Abu Jahl, "O Abu Hakam, this is Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah." Abu Jahl replied, "Don't you see what I see? By Allah, he has blinded the entire sky for me." When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  reached the end of the surah, he prostrated.
hi: Main aik din masjid mein tha ke Abu Jahl aaya aur kaha: "Allah ke liye mujhpar farz hai ke agar maine Muhammad ko sajde mein dekha, to main uski gardan par paaon rakhunga." To main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaya yahan tak ke unke paas dakhil hua, aur unhein Abu Jahl ki baat bataayi, to woh ghusse mein nikle yahan tak ke masjid aaye, unhone jaldi ki darwaze se dakhil honay se pehle, to deewar phaand kar andar aaye, maine socha yeh bura din hai, to maine apna tehband baandha, phir unke peeche chala, to Rasulullah (SAW) dakhil huay aur padh rahe the: "Padho apne Rab ke naam se jisne banaaya, banaaya insaan ko jame huay khoon se," jab woh Abu Jahl ke maamle tak pahunche: "{Hargiz nahi, beshak insaan sarkashi karta hai jab woh apne aap ko be-niyaaz samajhta hai}" (Surah Al-Alaq 7), aik aadmi ne Abu Jahl se kaha: "Aye Abu Al-Hakam, yeh Muhammad Rasulullah (SAW) hain." Abu Jahl ne kaha: "Kya tum wahi nahi dekhte jo main dekh raha houn? Allah ki qasam, usne mere liye aasman ka ufaq band kar diya hai." Jab Rasulullah (SAW) surah ke aakhir tak pahunche, to sajda kiya.

e: [AI] I heard Al-Abbas saying, "I was with the Prophet ﷺ one night, and he said to me, 'Look at the sky.' So I looked, and he asked, 'Do you see anything in the sky?' I replied, 'Yes.' He asked, 'What do you see?' I said, 'The Pleiades (a cluster of stars).' He said, 'Verily, He owns this Ummah (nation) by its number from your descendants.'"
hi: Maine Abbas (RA) ko kehte suna: main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aik raat tha, aap (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aasman mein dekho." Maine dekha, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumhein aasman mein kuch dikh raha hai?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein kya dikh raha hai?" Maine kaha: "Thurayya (Pleiades sitaare)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suno, yeh Ummat tumhari nasal se, iski taadaad ke barabar, hukumat karegi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) went out during the time of extreme heat and stayed in a place. The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) got up to perform ablution (washing for prayer). Abbas ibn Abd Al-Muttalib covered him with a woolen garment. Sahl said: "So, I looked at the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) from the side of his garment while he was raising his head towards the sky and saying, 'O Allah, protect Abbas and his offspring from the fire.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) sakht garmi ke mausam mein nikle aur aik jagah rukhe, Rasulullah (SAW) ghusl karne khade huay, to Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) khade huay aur unhein oon ki chaadar se dhaank diya. Sahl ne kaha: to maine chaadar ki taraf se Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, woh apna sar aasman ki taraf uthaaye huay farma rahe the: "Aye Allah, Abbas aur unki aulaad ko aag se mahfooz rakh."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Abu Wahb, to whom have you descended?" He said, "I have descended upon Al-Abbas." He said, "I have descended upon the most intense of Quraish in their love for Quraish."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye Abu Wahb, tum kiske paas utre?" Unhone kaha: "Abbas (RA) ke paas." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum Quraish mein Quraish se sabse zyada mohabbat karne wale ke paas utre."

e: [AI] I heard my grandfather Khuraym bin Aws bin Harithah bin Lam saying, "I migrated to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when he was returning from Tabuk, and I embraced Islam. Then I heard Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib saying, 'O Messenger of Allah, I want to praise you.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'May Allah not make you vain, so say what you have to say.' Abbas then said, 'Before you, I found myself in the shades and in a place where the leaves are sewn. Then the lands descended, and you are neither a human being, nor a chewed piece of meat, nor a clot of blood, but a sperm which rides the ships while the eagle tries to seize it, and its people drown. It is moved from one container to another until it settles in the womb. When a scholar passed by, he saw a layer, and your secure house was included in it. Hindif (the mother of the Messenger) was beneath it, speaking. And when you were born, the earth shone and illuminated with your light, and the horizons became bright with it. So we are in that light, in that brightness, and we penetrate the ways of righteousness.'"
hi: Maine apne dada Khuraim bin Aws bin Haarithah bin Laam (RA) ko kehte suna: main Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf, unke Tabook se laut'ne par, hijrat karke aaya, aur Musalman ho gaya, to maine Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ko kehte suna: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aapki madh (tareef) karna chahta houn." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaho, Allah tumhare mun ko khoobsurat rakhe (achhi baat kehne ki tofeeq de)." Unhone kaha: to Abbas ne kaha (bahr Al-Munsarih mein): "Isse pehle tum saayon mein aur aik mehfooz jagah mein khoobsurat the, jahan patte pankh phailaate hain, phir tum zameen par utre, na tum insaan the na goshte ka lotha na khoon ka thakka, balke aik nutfah (boond) jo kashti par sawaar hui, jab Nasr (aik but/idol) aur uske log ghark ho gaye, tumhein aik pusht se doosre rahem tak muntaqil kiya gaya, jab aik zamana guzarta, aik naya tabqa zaahir hota, yahan tak ke tumhara ghar Khindif ki buland shaakh mein aa gaya jiske neeche izzat aur martaba tha, aur jab tum paida huay, to zameen roshan ho gayi aur ufaq tumhare noor se chamak utha, to hum us roshni mein, us noor mein, aur hidayat ki raahon mein safar karte hain."

e: I was in the company of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the Day of Hunain. I and Abd Sufyan b. Harith b. 'Abd al-Muttalib stuck to the Messenaer of Allah ﷺ and we did not separate from him. And the Messenger of Allah (may place be upon him) was riding on his white mule which had been presented to him by Farwa b. Nufitha al-Judhami. When the Muslims had an encounter with the disbelievers, the Muslims fled, falling back, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ began to spur his mule towards the disbelievers. I was holding the bridle of the mule of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ checking it from going very fast, and Abu Sufyan was holding the stirrup of the (mule of the) Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: Abbas, call out to the people of al-Samura. Abbas (who was a man with a loud voice) called out at the top of the voice: Where are the people of Samura? (Abbas said: ) And by God, when they heard my voice, they came back (to us) as cows come back to their calves, and said: We are present, we are present! 'Abbas said: They began to fight the infidels. Then there was a call to The Ansar. Those (who called out to them) shouted: O ye party of the Ansar! O party of the Ansar! Banu al-Harith b. al-Khazraj were the last to be called. Those (who called out to them) shouted: O Banu Al-Harith b. al-Khazraj! O BanU Harith b. al-Khazraj! And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was riding on his mule looked at their fight with his neck stretched forward and he said: This is the time when the fight is raging hot. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took (some) pebbles and threw them in the face of the infidels. Then he said: By the Lord of Muhammad, the infidels are defeated. 'Abbas said: I went round and saw that the battle was in the same condition in which I had seen it. By Allah, it remained in the same condition until he threw the pebbles. I continued to watch until I found that their force had been spent out and they began to retreat. (Using translation from Muslim 1775a)
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain ke din tha, main aur Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib Rasulullah (SAW) se chipke rahe, humne unhein nahi chhoda, aur Rasulullah (SAW) apni safed khachchari par the jo unhein Farwah bin Nu'amah Al-Juzami ne tohfe mein di thi. Jab Musalman aur kaafir aamne-saamne huay, to Musalman peeth pher kar bhaagne lage, to Rasulullah (SAW) apni khachchari ko kaafiron ki taraf daudaane lage. Abbas ne kaha: aur main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khachchari ki lagaam pakde huay tha, use rokne ki koshish kar raha tha ke woh tez na bhage, aur Abu Sufyan Rasulullah (SAW) ki rikaab pakde huay the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abbas, samurah walon ko pukaaro." To maine unhein pukaara, unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, jab unhone meri aawaaz suni, to goya main unhein gaayon ki tarah unke bachchon ki taraf mudka raha houn, to unhone kaha: "Labbaik, Labbaik." Unhone kaha: to woh aur kaafir jung karne lage, aur pukaar Ansar mein thi, kehte huay: "Aye Ansar ki jama'at, Aye Ansar ki jama'at," phir pukaar Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj tak mehdood ho gayi, unhone kaha: "Aye Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, Aye Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni khachchari par unki jung ki taraf gardan lamba kar ke dekha, aur farmaya: "Yeh waqt hai jab jung tez ho gayi hai." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne kuch kankariyaan uthaayin aur unhein kaafiron ke chehron par phenka, phir farmaya: "Woh haar gaye, Muhammad ke Rab ki qasam." To main dekhne gaya, achaanak jung waisi hi thi jaisi maine dekhi thi, Allah ki qasam, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein kankariyaan maarin, to main unki koshish ko dhila hota aur unka maamla peeche hatta dekhta rahaa.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to prepare or present an army in the plain of Buhayr al-Khayl. Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib came forward and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "This is Abbas, the paternal uncle of your Prophet, the most generous of the Quraysh in terms of hand (ability to help) and the most affectionate towards them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) lashkar taiyar kar rahe the ya Baqee Al-Khail mein lashkar pesh kar rahe the, to Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) zaahir huay, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Abbas hain, tumhare Nabi ke chacha, Quraish mein sabse zyada sakhawat wale haath, aur unpar sabse zyada mehrbaan."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  prepared an army, and Al-Abbas looked and said, "This is Al-Abbas, the uncle of the Prophet ﷺ , the most generous of the Quraish in giving and helping."
hi: Nabi (SAW) lashkar taiyar kar rahe the ke unhone Abbas (RA) ko dekha, farmaya: "Yeh Abbas hain, Nabi (SAW) ke chacha, Quraish mein sabse zyada sakhawat wale haath aur sabse zyada rishta joone wale."

e: [AI] A man mentioned Abu Al-Abbas, so Al-Abbas slapped him. They gathered and said, "By Allah, we will also slap Al-Abbas as he slapped him." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was informed of this, so he delivered a sermon and said, "Who is the most honorable person in the sight of Allah?" They replied, "You, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Indeed, Al-Abbas is from me, and I am from him. Do not insult our dead, for it hurts our living."
hi: Beshak aik aadmi ne Abbas (RA) ke waalid ka zikr kiya aur unhein bura-bhala kaha, to Abbas ne usse thappad maara, to log jama ho gaye aur kehne lage: "Allah ki qasam, hum bhi Abbas ko waisa hi thappad maarenge jaisa unhone maara." Yeh baat Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) ne khutba di aur farmaya: "Allah ke nazdeek logon mein sabse zyada mu'azziz kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aap, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To beshak Abbas mujhse hain aur main unse houn, humare murdon ko bura-bhala na kaho warna zinda logon ko takleef dogi."

e: [AI] May Allah bestow His mercy upon Abu Al-Fadl. By Allah, he was a brother of the Prophet Muhammad, and the apple of the eye of the Messenger of Allah. He is the master of the uncles and the cheeks, the ancestor of the ancestors, and the great-grandfather of the descendants. He possesses knowledge of matters, adorned with forbearance, and understanding has elevated him. He earned the support of every supporter and gained followers for his opinion, with his thunderous footsteps. The cheeks unite when his nobility is mentioned, and the lineages diverge when his tribe is mentioned. He is the companion of the household, the cupbearer, the lineage, and the kinship. Why should it not be so? And how could it not be so? The orchestrator of his policies is more honorable than any other orchestrator, and he is wiser than anyone who has risen from the Quraysh.
hi: "Allah Abu Al-Fadl (RA) par reham kare, Allah ki qasam, woh Allah ke Nabi ke chacha the, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki aankhon ki thandak, chachon ke sardaar aur saathiyon ke, dadon ke dada, unke baap-dada saakhi the, aur unke dada bahaadur (mazboot) the, unhein maamlaat ka ilm tha jise baradbaari ne sanwaara, aur samajh ne unhein buland kiya, har talwaar unke sath tha, aur har mukhaalif unke raay ke saamne dilr-hala ho jaata, unki fazeelat ka zikr aate hi saathi (bhi) unke aage phike pad jaate, aur unke khaandaan ka zikr aate hi doosre nasab door hote nazar aate, woh ghar, sikaayat (Hajj ki paani-pilai), nasab, aur rishtedaari ke maalik the, aur kyun na ho? Aur kaise na ho? Jabke unki tadbeer ka intezaam karne wala sabse mu'azziz tadbeer-kaar tha, aur Quraish mein sabse zyada hikmat wala aur savaari karne wala tha."

e: [AI] Indeed, Al-Ala ibn Al-Hadrami sent to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from Bahrain with eighty thousand. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not receive any wealth greater than it before or after it. He commanded that it be spread out on a mat, and the call to prayer was made. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came leaning towards the wealth, and the people came and he began to give them from it. There was no count or weight for it on that day, and it was nothing but a taking. Then Al-Abbas came and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I gave my ransom and the ransom of 'Aqil on the day of Badr, and 'Aqil did not have any wealth. Give me from this wealth." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Take." He gathered it in a garment that was on him, then he went away, but was unable to carry it. So he raised his head towards the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said: "O Messenger of Allah, raise it for me." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  smiled while saying: "Indeed, anyone whom Allah has promised something has fulfilled it for me. I do not know about the other promise. Say to whomever among the captives you have in your hands: 'If Allah knows any good in your hearts, He will give you better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you. And this forgiveness is better for me than what was taken from me. And I do not know what will be done with the forgiveness.'" It was narrated to me by Abu Ali Al-Husayn ibn Ali Al-Hafiz, who narrated to us Abdan Al-Ahwazi, who narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Harith Al-Ahwazi, who narrated from Hashim ibn Al-Qasim, who narrated from Sulayman ibn Al-Mughira, from Humaid ibn Hilal, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, that Al-Ala ibn Al-Hadrami sent to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with wealth from Bahrain, and he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner.
hi: Beshak Al-Ala bin Al-Hadhrami (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf Bahrain se aisi (raqam) bheji, assi hazaar (80,000), aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas isse zyada maal na pehle aaya na baad mein, to aap (SAW) ne hukum diya, aur woh aik chataai par bikher diya gaya, aur namaz ka elaan kiya gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) khade hokar maal ki taraf jhuk gaye, log aaye aur aap (SAW) unhein dete gaye, us din koi ginti na wazan tha, sirf mutthi bhar diya jaata. To Abbas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine Badr ke din apna fidya bhi diya aur Aqeel ka fidya bhi diya, jabke Aqeel ke paas koi maal na tha, mujhe is maal mein se kuch dein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Lo." To unhone apni khameesah (chaadar) mein bhar liya, phir jaane laga, magar utha na saka, to apna sar Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf uthaaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere liye uthaa dein." To Rasulullah (SAW) muskuraaye aur farmaya: "Kisi ne bhi jo Allah ne wa'da kiya use poora nahi paaya jaisa mujhe pura kiya, aur mujhe doosre (wa'de) ke baare mein nahi pata, un qaidiyon se kaho jo tumhare haath mein hain: agar Allah tumhare dilon mein bhalaai dekhe, to woh tumhein usse behtar dega jo tumse liya gaya, aur tumhein maaf kar dega, yeh mujhse liya gaya usse behtar hai, aur mujhe nahi pata maghfirat ke sath kya kiya jaayega."

e: [AI] Al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib approached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wearing a dress and with two braids, and he was wearing white. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw him, he smiled. Al-Abbas said, "O Messenger of Allah, what made you smile? May Allah make your teeth laugh!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "I admired the beauty of the uncle of the Prophet." Al-Abbas then asked, "What beauty is there in men?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  answered, "The tongue."
hi: Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, unpar aik jodi (kapdon ki) thi aur unki do choti (baalon ki) thin, aur woh safed the, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein dekha, to muskuraaye, to Abbas ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapko kis cheez ne hansaaya, Allah aapki umr ko hansaaye?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe Nabi ke chacha ki khoobsurati achhi lagi." To Abbas ne poocha: "Mardon mein khoobsurati kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Zubaan." Mursal.

e: [AI] Jabir, and Abbas was a captive of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of Badr, and he was only released unwillingly, so he was taken to Medina where Abdullah ibn Ubayy covered him with his shirt. For that reason, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ shrouded him in his own shirt as a reward for what he had done for Abbas.
hi: Jabir (RA) (ne kaha): "Aur Abbas Badr ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke qaidi the, aur woh sirf majboori mein nikaale gaye the, to unhein Madinah lekar aaya gaya, to Abdullah bin Ubayy ne unhein apni qamees pehnaayi, isi liye Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein (Abdullah bin Ubayy ko) unki apni qamees mein kafan diya, Abbas ke sath jo kiya uska badla dene ke liye."

e: [AI] When Abbas was captured, he did not have a suitable shirt except for the shirt of Ibn Ubayy.
hi: "Jab Abbas qaid kiye gaye, to unhein pehnaane ke liye koi qamees nahi mili siwaye Ibn Ubayy ki qamees ke."

e: [AI] I heard my father saying, "I entered upon my father Ja'far al-Mansur and saw that he had a beautiful cloak. I started admiring its beauty, and he said, 'This cloak used to belong to my father Muhammad ibn Ali.' He also informed me that his father Ali ibn Abdullah had a cloak, and his father Abdullah ibn Abbas had a cloak, and Abbas also had a cloak. He further mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ  had a cloak, and Hashim ibn Abd Manaf had a cloak." I said to my father, "I am amazed by its beauty." He replied, "That is the radiance of the caliphate." My father narrated to me from his father, who narrated from his grandfather, who said, "When Allah intended to create the creation for the caliphate, He wiped His hand over Adam's back, and all those who came after loved him." The narrators of this hadith, all of them, are known as Hashemite and reliable, although they are not considered reliable.
hi: Maine apne waalid ko kehte suna: main Abu Ja'far Al-Mansoor ke paas dakhil hua, maine unke baal (jumma - lambay ghungrale baal) dekhe, main unki khoobsurati ko dekhne laga, to unhone kaha: "Mere waalid Muhammad bin Ali ke bhi lambay baal the," aur unhone mujhe bataya ke unke waalid Ali bin Abdullah ke bhi lambay baal the, aur unhone mujhe bataya ke unke waalid Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ke bhi lambay baal the, aur Abbas (RA) ke bhi lambay baal the, aur unhone mujhe bataya ke Nabi (SAW) ke bhi lambay baal the, aur Hashim bin Abd Manaf ke bhi lambay baal the. Maine apne waalid se kaha: "Mujhe iski khoobsurati par ta'ajjub hai." Unhone kaha: "Yeh khilafat ka noor hai." Unhone kaha: mujhe mere waalid ne, unke waalid se, unke dada se, hadith bayan ki, kaha: "Jab Allah ne khilafat ke liye kisi ko paida karne ka iraada kiya, to usne apna haath uski peshaani par phera, to jo bhi usse dekhta, usse mohabbat karta." Is hadith ke tamaam raawi, aakhir tak, Hashimi hain aur nasab ki izzat ke liye jaane jaate hain, magar (yeh) Hashimi raawi mo'tabar (bharosemand) nahi hain.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "We will expand the mosque." And your house is near the mosque, so give it to us and we will expand it in the mosque, and I will give you a larger house in return." He said, "I will not do that." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "In that case, I will defeat you in it." He said, "That is not for you, so let there be someone who will settle between us according to the truth." He said, "Who is that?" He said, "Hudayfa bin al-Yaman." So they went to Hudayfa and explained the matter to him. Hudayfa said, "I have a report on this." They asked, "What is it?" He said, "Indeed, the Prophet David, may Allah's prayers be upon him, wanted to expand the House of the Sacred Black Stone, which was near the mosque, for an orphan. He requested it from him, but he refused. So David wanted to take it from him, but Allah revealed to him, 'Indeed, the noblest houses are free from injustice to My house.' So he left it. Abbas said to him, 'Is there anything left?' He said, 'No.' Abbas entered the mosque and found a waterway in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , through which the rainwater would flow in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Umar took it with his own hands and removed the waterway. Umar said, 'This waterway should not flow in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' Abbas said to him, 'By the One who sent Muhammad with the truth, it was he who placed the waterway in this place, and it was you, O Umar, who removed it.' Umar said to him, 'Put your feet on my neck to return it to its previous state.' Abbas did so, and then Abbas said, 'I have given you the house to expand it in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so Umar expanded it in the mosque, and then he gave Abbas a house larger than it in Az-Zawra'a."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Hum masjid mein izaafa karenge," aur aapka ghar masjid ke qareeb hai, isliye humein de dein, hum use masjid mein shaamil karenge, aur hum aapko iski jagah isse zyada wasee (badi) jagah denge. Unhone (Abbas ne) kaha: "Main aisa nahi karunga." (Rasulullah SAW ne) kaha: "To main tumpar ghalib aa jaunga (le lunga)." Unhone kaha: "Yeh aapka haq nahi, isliye mere aur aapke darmiyan kisi ko faisla karne do jo haq ke sath faisla kare." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Aur woh kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (RA)." To woh Hudhaifah ke paas gaye aur unhein qissa bataya, to Hudhaifah ne kaha: "Mere paas iske baare mein aik khabar hai." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Beshak Dawood (AS) Nabi, Allah ki rehmatein unpar, ne Bait Al-Maqdis (Jerusalem ka muqaddas ghar) mein izaafa karna chaaha, aur masjid ke qareeb aik yateem ka ghar tha, to unhone usse maanga, magar usne inkaar kar diya, to Dawood (AS) ne usse zabardasti lena chaaha, to Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne unhein wahi ki: 'Beshak sabse paak ghar zulm se woh hai jo mere ghar ke liye ho.' To unhone usse chhod diya." To Abbas ne (Rasulullah SAW se) poocha: "To kya kuch aur baaqi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." (Yahan se maamla Umar ke daur ka hai:) To woh (Abbas) masjid mein dakhil huay, achaanak Abbas ka aik paani ka nikaas (mizaab) Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein khul raha tha, jisse baarish ka paani Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein behta tha, to Umar (RA) ne apne haath se woh nikaas ukhaad diya, aur kaha: "Yeh nikaas Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein nahi behega." To Abbas ne unse kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad (SAW) ko haq ke sath bheja, yehi (Rasulullah SAW) hain jinhone yeh nikaas is jagah lagaaya tha, aur tumne, Aye Umar, usse ukhaad diya." To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Apne paaon meri gardan par rakho taake tum ise wapas usi haal mein le aao jaisa yeh pehle tha." Abbas ne aisa hi kiya, phir Abbas ne kaha: "Maine aapko ghar de diya, ise Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein shaamil kar lein." To Umar (RA) ne usse masjid mein shaamil kiya, phir Abbas ko iske badle Az-Zawra mein isse zyada wasee (badi) jagah di.

e: [AI] "The dispute over the house of Al-Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib happened when they wanted to expand the Prophet's mosque ﷺ, so a discussion arose about the house."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid mein izaafa karne ke liye, Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ke ghar par jhagda hua, to (raawi ne) isi tarah hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] I said to Al-Abbas, ask the Prophet ﷺ  to appoint you for charity. So, he asked him and the Prophet ﷺ  said, "I am not supposed to appoint you for washing away people's sins."
hi: Maine Abbas (RA) se kaha: "Nabi (SAW) se poochiye ke woh aapko Zakat par (aamil/kaarkun) muqarrar karein." To unhone poocha, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein logon ke gunahon ki dhulaai (Zakat) par muqarrar nahi karunga." Sahih.

e: It was narrated from ‘Ali that Al-ʿAbbas bin ʿAbdul-Muttalib asked the Prophet ﷺ about paying zakah in advance and he gave him a concession allowing him to do that. (Using translation from Aḥmad 822)
hi: Beshak Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se apni Zakat waqt se pehle dene ke baare mein poocha, "to aap (SAW) ne unhein iski ijaazat de di."

e: [AI] Al-Abbas came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was angry, and he said, "What is the matter with you?" He replied, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the matter with us and the Quraysh?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "What is the matter with you and them?" He said, "Some of them meet each other with shining faces, but when they meet us, they meet us with the opposite." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ became angry until a vein stood out between his eyes. When he calmed down, he said, "By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, faith does not enter the heart of a person until he judges for the sake of Allah and His Messenger." Then he said, "What is wrong with people who harm me in the person of al-Abbas, the uncle of the man who raised me?"
hi: Abbas (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas ghusse mein aaye, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein kya hua hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humara aur Quraish ka kya maamla hai?" Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein unse kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Woh aapas mein khushi bhare chehron se milte hain, magar jab humse milte hain, to aisa nahi karte." Unhone kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghussa aaya yahan tak ke unki aankhon ke darmiyan aik rag ubhar aayi, jab woh (ghussa) chhat gaya, to farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, kisi bande ke dil mein imaan dakhil nahi hota jab tak woh Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye faisla na kare." Phir farmaya: "Un logon ko kya hua jo mujhe Abbas ke maamle mein takleef pahunchaate hain, jo is aadmi (mujhe) ke chacha hain, unke waalid ke barabar (unse aise hi qareeb jaise sagay bhai)?"

e: [AI] I said, O Messenger of Allah, indeed when the Quraysh meet each other, they receive each other with a good greeting, but when they meet us, they meet us with unfamiliar faces. The Messenger of Allah became extremely angry and said, "By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, the heart of a man does not enter the state of true faith until he loves you for the sake of Allah and His Messenger." I have mentioned in the virtues of Ahlul-Bayt of the Messenger of Allah, and I have explained the reasons for this hadith by mentioning Al-Muttalib ibn Rabee'ah and those who dropped it from the chain of narration, which suffices in this context.
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Quraish jab aapas mein milte hain, to khushi bhare andaaz mein milte hain, aur jab humse milte hain, to hum unhein pehchaan nahi paate (aise ajnabi chehron se milte hain)." To Rasulullah (SAW) ko sakht ghussa aaya aur farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, kisi aadmi ke dil mein imaan dakhil nahi hota jab tak woh tumse Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye mohabbat na kare." Maine Al-Hasan aur Al-Husain ke manaqib mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke Ahl al-Bayt ki fazeelaton ka aik hissa zikr kiya hai, aur maine Al-Muttalib bin Rabee'ah ka zikr karke aur unhein isnad se hataane walon ka zikr karke is hadith ki khaamiyaan bayan ki hain, isliye yahan dobara zikr karne ki zaroorat nahi.

e: [AI] "He said to Al-Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib, 'The best of this nation and the inheritor of the Prophet and his uncle.'"
hi: Beshak unhone Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) se farmaya: "Is Ummat ke behtareen aur Nabi ke waaris aur unke chacha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That your messenger came to me while I was having dinner, so I offered them dinner, then I let them leave." (The Golden did not summarize it.)
hi: ...ke aapka qaasid mere paas aaya jabke main khaana kha raha tha, to maine unhein khaana khilaaya, phir main aaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Indeed, his father was a chief of the Quraish tribe. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Suno, unke waalid Quraish ke sardaar the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "Allah advised me to be kind to my relatives and commanded me to start with Al-Abbas." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in summarizing.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ne mujhe rishtedaaron ke baare mein wasiyat ki, aur mujhe hukum diya ke main Abbas (RA) se shuru karoon." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "O Allah, this is the uncle of your Prophet, Al-Abbas. We turn to you through him, so quench our thirst. They did not relent until Allah gave them water." Umar addressed the people saying, "O people, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, used to have a special regard for his uncle Al-Abbas, just as a child has for his father. He would honor him, exalt his status, and be generous to him. So, O people, follow the example of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, in his uncle Al-Abbas and consider him a means to Allah Almighty in what he has bestowed upon you."
hi: "Aye Allah, yeh aapke Nabi ke chacha Abbas (RA) hain, hum aapki taraf unke zariye mutawajjeh hote hain, isliye humein paani pilaa," to woh (dua se) na hate yahan tak ke Allah ne unhein paani pilaaya. Unhone kaha: phir Umar (RA) ne logon ko khutba di aur farmaya: "Aye logo, beshak Rasulullah (SAW) Abbas (RA) ke liye wohi izzat rakhte the jo aulaad apne waalid ke liye rakhti hai, unhein buzurg samajhte, unhein azmat dete, aur unki qasam poori karte, isliye Aye logo, Rasulullah (SAW) ki pairavi karo apne chacha Abbas (RA) ke maamle mein, aur unhein Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki taraf zariya banaao jab bhi tumpar koi museebat aaye."

e: [AI] Abdullah, the son of Al-Arqam, the son of Abd Yaguth, the son of Ahayb, the son of Abdimanaf, the son of Zuhrah. His mother was Amrah, the daughter of Al-Arqam, the son of Hashim, the son of Abdimanaf. He became blind before his death and passed away in the year thirty-five.
hi: Abdullah bin Al-Arqam bin Abd Yaghooth bin Ahyab bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah, unki maa Amrah bint Al-Arqam bin Hashim bin Abd Manaf thin, aur woh apni wafaat se pehle andhe ho gaye the, unka intiqaal paintees (35) hijri mein hua.

e: [AI] "And he was a scribe for the Prophet ﷺ, as well as Abu Bakr and Umar."
hi: "Aur woh Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr (RA), aur Umar (RA) ke katib (likhne wale) the."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  received a letter from a man, so he said to Abdullah ibn Arqam, "Answer me." He wrote his response and then read it to him. He said, "You are right, and you did well. O Allah, grant him success." When Umar became the Caliph, he used to consult him.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas aik aadmi ka khat aaya, to aap (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Al-Arqam (RA) se farmaya: "Mere taraf se jawaab do."
