To unhone jawaab likha, phir aap (SAW) ko padh kar sunaaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne durust kiya aur achha kiya, Aye Allah, unhein tofeeq de." Jab Umar (RA) khalifa bane, to woh unse mashwara karte the.

e: [AI] The translation of the passage is: "In charge of the treasury during the time of Umar and the early part of Uthman's rule until he passed away, and he had companionship."
hi: Umar ke daur mein aur Uthman ki khilafat ke shuru'aati hisse mein Bait-ul-Maal (khazaane) ke zimmedaar rahe, yahan tak ke unka intiqaal hua, aur unhein sohbat (Nabi SAW ki) haasil thi.

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'If anyone of you needs to defecate and the immediate call to prayer (Iqamah) is given, let him start with (relieving himself).'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 616)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab namaz khadi ki jaaye aur tum mein se kisi ko qaza-e-hajat (rafa-e-hajat) ki zaroorat ho, to woh pehle qaza-e-hajat se shuru kare."

e: [AI] Regarding Ibn Ishaq, "In the names of those who witnessed Badr and Al-Aqaba from the tribe of Jusham bin Al-Harith, and Zaid bin Al-Harith, both of whom were twins. Abdullah bin Zaid bin Abd Rabih bin Tha'alaba, who was the one who heard the call to prayer and brought it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he commanded him with it."
hi: Ibn Ishaq se: "Badr aur Aqabah mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Banu Jusham bin Al-Harith aur Zaid bin Al-Harith se, jo dono jud'wa (twins) the, Abdullah bin Zaid bin Abd Rabbih bin Tha'labah (RA) the, aur woh hi hain jinhein azaan (khwaab mein) dikhaayi gayi, to woh use lekar Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, to aap (SAW) ne unhein iska hukum diya."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Zaid, the caller, is known as Abu Muhammad."
hi: "Abdullah bin Zaid, azaan wale, ki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi."

e: [AI] Regarding Uruwah, "Regarding those who witnessed the Battle of Badr and the 'Aqaba from the Banu Jusham ibn Al-Harith and Zaid ibn Al-Harith, who were twins, Abdallah ibn Zaid ibn Abd Rabbih ibn Tha'laba ibn Zaid ibn Al-Harith ibn Al-Khazraj, and his brother Harith ibn Zaid, and Abdallah ibn Zaid is the one who was shown the call to prayer."
hi: Urwah se: "Un logon mein jinhone Badr aur Aqabah mein shirkat ki, Banu Jusham bin Al-Harith aur Zaid bin Al-Harith se, jo dono jud'wa the, Abdullah bin Zaid bin Abd Rabbih bin Tha'labah bin Zaid bin Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj (RA), aur unke bhai Haarith bin Zaid (RA), aur Abdullah bin Zaid hi hain jinhein azaan (khwaab mein) dikhaayi gayi."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Zaid ibn Abd Rabih ibn Tha'labah ibn Zaid ibn Al-Harith, who was also known as Abu Muhammad, witnessed Abdullah ibn Zaid among the Ansar, seventy people, on the night of Al-Aqaba in the narration of all of them. He also witnessed the battles of Badr, Uhud, the Trench, and all other events with the Messenger of Allah. He carried the flag of Bani Al-Harith ibn Al-Khazraj in the Battle of Al-Fath. The call to prayer that is accepted by the scholars of Islam was recited by him. It is not mentioned in the authentic books due to the disagreement of the narrators in its chains. The most reliable narration is that of Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib. Some of our imams assumed that Sa'id did not live long enough to be a contemporary of Abdullah ibn Zaid, but that is not correct. Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib mediated between Ali and Uthman. Abdullah ibn Zaid died at the end of Uthman's caliphate. The narration of Al-Zuhri through Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib is well-known and it was narrated by Yunus ibn Yazid, Ma'mar ibn Rashid, Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamza, Muhammad ibn Ishaq, and others. As for the reports from the people of Kufa in this matter, they are based on the narration of Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Layla. Some of them attributed it to Mu'adh ibn Jabal or Abdullah ibn Zaid. As for the descendants of Abdullah ibn Zaid narrating from their fathers about him, their chains are not considered strong. Abdullah ibn Zaid has transmitted this hadith from the Messenger of Allah."
hi: "Abdullah bin Zaid bin Abd Rabbih bin Tha'labah bin Zaid bin Al-Harith (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi, unhone Ansar ke sattar (70) logon mein Aqabah ki raat shirkat ki, sab ki riwayat mein, aur unhone Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur Fatah ki jung mein unke paas Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj ka jhanda tha, aur woh hi hain jinhein woh azaan dikhaayi gayi jise Islam ke fuqaha ne qubool karte huay apnaaya." Yeh Sahihain mein nahi nikli, kyunke isnad mein naqal karne walon mein ikhtilaaf hai, "aur ismein sabse behtar riwayat Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib (RA) ki hai, aur humare kuch a'immah ne yeh ghalat-fehmi ki ke Sa'eed, Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) ko nahi mile, jabke aisa nahi hai, kyunke Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib (RA) un logon mein se the jo Ali (RA) aur Uthman (RA) ke darmiyan sulah karwaane walon mein shaamil the, aur Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) ka intiqaal Uthman (RA) ki khilafat ke aakhiri hisse mein hua." Aur Az-Zuhri ki Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib (RA) se riwayat mash-hoor hai, ise Yunus bin Yazid, Ma'mar bin Raashid, Shu'aib bin Abi Hamzah, Muhammad bin Ishaq, aur doosron ne riwayat kiya hai, aur rahi baat Kufa walon ki iss baab mein khabaron ki, to unka madaar Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila ki hadith par hai, unme se kuch ne kaha 'Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) se' ya 'Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) se,' aur unme se kuch ne kaha 'Abdur Rahman ne Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) se,' aur rahi baat Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) ki aulaad ki unke baap-dada se unke hawaale se riwayaton ki, to woh mazboot isnad wali nahi hain, aur Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se yeh hadith khud isnad ke sath bayan ki hai.

e: [AI] "He came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, this wall of mine is a charity for the sake of Allah and His Messenger.' Then his parents came and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, it has been our source of livelihood.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned it to them. Then they both died and their son inherited it."
hi: Beshak woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mera yeh baagh sadqa hai, aur yeh Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye hai." To unke waalidain aaye aur kehne lage: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh humari zindagi ka sahaara tha." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne woh unhein wapas kar diya, phir woh dono faut ho gaye, to unka beta unka waaris bana. Ismein Irsaal hai.

e: [AI] About Islam, when he saw that he had left his house, he opposed him. So he entered his house and urged his wife, as she was combing her hair, and he said, "Where is Abu Darda?" She said, "Your brother left suddenly and entered his house where the idol was, and with him was the qudm. He brought it down and began consecrating it repeatedly, secretly reciting names of all the devils, knowing that everything worshipped beside Allah is false. Then he left, and I heard his wife hear the sound of the qudm while he was striking that idol. She said, "You have ruined me, O son of Rawaha!" So he went out without anything until Abu Darda returned to his house. He entered and found the woman sitting, shedding tears of pity for him. He said, "What is your matter?" She said, "Your brother Abdullah bin Rawaha came to me and did what you see, so you became extremely angry." He then thought to himself, "If he had any good in him, he would have defended himself." So he set out until he reached the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and Abdullah bin Rawaha was with him. He embraced Islam, and it is said that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, looked at Abu Darda, and the people were defeated, each face on the day of Uhud. He said, "What a great knight Umayr is," except that he meant through other than what is transmitted. Ibn Umar said, "I heard someone mention that Abu Darda did not witness Uhud, although he was one of the companions of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and he witnessed many scenes with him." Ibn Umar said, "Abu Darda died in Damascus in the year thirty-two during the caliphate of Uthman bin Affan."
hi: ...Islam ke baare mein, jab usne dekha ke woh (Abdullah bin Rawahah (RA)) apne ghar se nikal chuke hain, to woh unke (Abu Darda (RA) ke) ghar dakhil hua, aur unki biwi se jaldi ki, jabke woh apne baal sanwaar rahi thi, to usne poocha: "Abu Darda (RA) kahan hain?" Usne kaha: "Aapke bhai abhi nikle hain." To woh us ghar mein dakhil hua jahan but tha, unke sath basoola (aik auzaar) tha, usse neeche utaara aur use tukda tukda kaatne laga, jabke woh chhupkar shaitanon ke sab naamon ko rajz (nazm) mein pukaar raha tha: "Khabardaar, jo bhi Allah ke sath pukaara jaata hai woh baatil hai," phir woh nikal gaye. Unki (Abu Darda (RA) ki) biwi ne basoole ki aawaaz suni jabke woh us but ko maar rahe the, to usne kaha: "Tumne mujhe barbaad kar diya, Aye Ibn Rawahah (RA)!" To woh isi haal mein nikle, phir kuch na hua yahan tak ke Abu Darda (RA) apne ghar aaye, dakhil huay, to unhone apni biwi ko baithi rota paaya, unke darr se, unhone poocha: "Tumhein kya hua?" Usne kaha: "Aapke bhai Abdullah bin Rawahah (RA) mere paas dakhil huay aur woh kiya jo aap dekh rahe hain." To unhein sakht ghussa aaya, phir unhone apne dil mein socha, aur kaha: "Agar iss (but) mein koi bhalaai hoti, to yeh apni hifaazat khud kar leta." To woh chal pade yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahunche, unke sath Ibn Rawahah (RA) the, to woh Musalman ho gaye. Aur kaha jaata hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Darda (RA) ki taraf dekha jabke log Uhud ke din har taraf shikast khaakar bhaag rahe the, to farmaya: "Kaisa behtareen sawaar hain Uwaimir," yaani na-mulawwath (paak, bhaagne walon mein se nahi). Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: aur maine kisi ko yeh kehte suna ke Abu Darda (RA) ne Uhud mein shirkat nahi ki, jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the aur unke sath bohot si jangon mein shaamil rahe. Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: aur Abu Darda (RA) ka intiqaal Dimashq mein, battees (32) hijri mein, Uthman bin Affan (RA) ki khilafat mein hua. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse iski kamzori ki wajah se Talkhees se hata diya.

e: [AI] He is called Abu Ishaq al-Ajrab, a servant of the Banu Habbar branch of the Quraysh tribe. He said, "I saw Abu Al-Darda Uwaymir ibn Qays ibn Khunasa, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, with dyed reddish-yellow hair. I saw him wearing a small patched garment and he had a folded turban on his shoulders." Al-Abbas said, "I heard a man who was with me say to him, 'How long have you known him?' He replied, 'I have known him for over 100 years.' He said, 'He used to wear two socks and sandals.' He said, 'He came to Abu Ishaq about twenty to one hundred years ago.'"
hi: Unhein Abu Ishaq Al-Ajrab kaha jaata hai, Banu Habbaar Al-Qurashi ke ghulam, unhone kaha: "Maine Abu Darda Uwaimir bin Qais bin Khunaasah (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi, ko dekha, unki aankhein halki bhoori aur naaqi thin, woh zard rang se khizaab lagaate the, aur maine unpar aik chhoti dhaari-daar topi dekhi, aur maine unpar aik pagdi dekhi jo unhone apne kandhon par daal rakhi thi." Abbas ne kaha: to maine mere sath aik aadmi ko kehte suna: "Aapne unhein kabse dekha hai?" Usne kaha: "Maine unhein sau (100) saal se zyada waqt se dekha hai." Unhone kaha: aur unpar do mozey aur do jute the. Unhone kaha: "Aur Abu Ishaq ki umar taqreeban aik sau bees (120) saal ho chuki thi."

e: [AI] Abu Dhar Jundub ibn Junadah, and it is said Yazid ibn Junadah, passed away in Arrabadah in the year twenty-two and thirty. They had a disagreement about who prayed upon him, and it was said Abdullah ibn Mas'ud and it was also said Jarir ibn Abdullah Al-Bajali.
hi: Abu Dharr Jundub bin Junaadah, aur kaha jaata hai Yazid bin Junaadah, ka intiqaal Ar-Rabazah mein battees (32) hijri mein hua, aur is baat mein ikhtilaaf hai ke unki namaz-e-janaza kisne padhayi, kaha jaata hai Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA), aur kaha jaata hai Jareer bin Abdullah Al-Bajali (RA).

e: [AI] Abu Dhar had with him a group of people. He said, "Indeed, I have experienced everything that you see of death, and if I had a garment that could shroud me or my companion, I would not be shrouded in anything other than that. And I swear to you, none of you should shroud me, whether he is a noble, a chief, a prince, or a messenger." The people were of high rank, among them was Hudhur and Malik Al-Ishtaru, and in this group there was a man from the Ansar. Everyone in the group had reached a certain position except the Ansari man. He said, "I will shroud you in my two cloaks, which I have kept as a trust from my mother, who wove them for me until she died. Abu Dhar said, "That is enough for me." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summarization.
hi: Abu Dharr ne apne paas maujood kuch logon se kaha: "Beshak mujhpar woh maut aa chuki hai jo tum dekh rahe ho, aur agar mere paas itna kapda hota jo mujhe ya mere saathi ko kafan de sake, to mujhe usi mein kafan diya jaata, aur main tumhein qasam deta houn ke tum mein se koi Areef (numainda), Naqeeb, Ameer, ya Bareed (qaasid) tha, woh mujhe kafan na de." Aur woh log sharif the, Hujr Al-Mudri (RA) aur Malik Al-Ashtar aik giroh mein the, jisme aik Ansari aadmi bhi tha, aur sab logon ko is (kafan dene ki) manzilat mil chuki thi siwaye Ansari ke, to usne kaha: "Main aapko apni yeh chaadar aur do kapdon mein kafan dunga jo meri jhaadi (sandook) mein hain, meri maa ke bunay huay, jo unhone mere liye buni thin taake main unme Ihraam bandhoon." To Abu Dharr ne kaha: "Yeh mere liye kaafi hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] His name is said to be Yazid.
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai unka naam Yazid tha.

e: [AI] The Prophet, peace be upon him, named him by it.
hi: "Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne unhein isi naam se pukaara."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Dharr, "How are you, O Yazid?" in a long Hadith.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Dharr se farmaya: "Tum kaise ho, Aye Yazid," aik lambi hadith mein.

e: Ibn ʿAbbas said to us, "Shall I tell you the story of Abu Dhar's conversion to Islam?" We said, "Yes." He said, "Abu Dhar said: I was a man from the tribe of Ghifar. We heard that a man had appeared in Mecca, claiming to be a Prophet. ! said to my brother, 'Go to that man and talk to him and bring me his news.' He set out, met him and returned. I asked him, 'What is the news with you?' He said, 'By Allah, I saw a man enjoining what is good and forbidding what is evil.' I said to him, 'You have not satisfied me with this little information.' So, I took a waterskin and a stick and proceeded towards Mecca. Neither did I know him (i.e. the Prophet ﷺ ), nor did I like to ask anyone about him. I Kept on drinking Zam zam water and staying in the Mosque. Then ʿAli passed by me and said, 'It seems you are a stranger?' I said, 'Yes.' He proceeded to his house and I accompanied him. Neither did he ask me anything, nor did I tell him anything. Next morning I went to the Mosque to ask about the Prophet but no-one told me anything about him. ʿAli passed by me again and asked, 'Hasn't the man recognized his dwelling place yet' I said, 'No.' He said, 'Come along with me.' He asked me, 'What is your business? What has brought you to this town?' I said to him, 'If you keep my secret, I will tell you.' He said, 'I will do,' I said to him, 'We have heard that a person has appeared here, claiming to be a Prophet. I sent my brother to speak to him and when he returned, he did not bring a satisfactory report; so I thought of meeting him personally.' ʿAli said (to Abu Dhar), 'You have reached your goal; I am going to him just now, so follow me, and wherever I enter, enter after me. If I should see someone who may cause you trouble, I will stand near a wall pretending to mend my shoes (as a warning), and you should go away then.' ʿAli proceeded and I accompanied him till he entered a place, and I entered with him to the Prophet ﷺ to whom I said, 'Present (the principles of) Islam to me.' When he did, I embraced Islam 'immediately. He said to me, 'O Abu Dhar! Keep your conversion as a secret and return to your town; and when you hear of our victory, return to us. ' I said, 'By H him Who has sent you with the Truth, I will announce my conversion to Islam publicly amongst them (i.e. the infidels),' Abu Dhar went to the Mosque, where some people from Quraish were present, and said, 'O folk of Quraish ! I testify that None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and I (also) testify that Muhammad is Allah's Slave and His Apostle.' (Hearing that) the Quraishi men said, 'Get at this Sabi (i.e. Muslim) !' They got up and beat me nearly to death. Al ʿAbbas saw me and threw himself over me to protect me. He then faced them and said, 'Woe to you! You want to kill a man from the tribe of Ghifar, although your trade and your communications are through the territory of Ghifar?' They therefore left me. The next morning I returned (to the Mosque) and said the same as I have said on the previous day. They again said, 'Get at this Sabi!' I was treated in the same way as on the previous day, and again Al-Abbas found me and threw himself over me to protect me and told them the same as he had said the day before.' So, that was the conversion of Abu Dhar (may Allah be Merciful to him) to Islam." (Using translation from Bukhārī 3522)
hi: Abu Dharr: main Ghifar qabile ka aik aadmi tha, humein khabar mili ke Makkah mein aik aadmi nikla hai jo dawa karta hai ke woh Nabi hai, to maine apne bhai se kaha: "Us aadmi ke paas jaao, unse baat karo, aur unki khabar mere paas lao." To woh gaye, unse mile, phir wapas aaye, maine poocha: "Tumhare paas kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maine aik aisa aadmi dekha jo bhalaai ka hukum deta hai aur buraai se rokta hai." Maine kaha: is khabar ne mujhe tasalli nahi di. Unhone kaha: to maine aik thaila aur laathi li, phir Makkah ki taraf nikla, main unhein pehchaanta na tha aur unke baare mein poochna bura samajhta tha, aur main Zamzam ka paani peeta aur masjid mein rehta. Unhone kaha: to Ali (RA) mere paas se guzre, kaha: 'Goya yeh aadmi ajnabi hai?' Maine kaha: 'Ji haan.' Unhone kaha: to woh apne ghar chale gaye, main unke sath gaya, unhone mujhse kuch na poocha aur maine unhein kuch na bataaya. Unhone kaha: phir jab subah hui, to main masjid ki taraf gaya unke baare mein poochne, koi bhi mujhe unke baare mein kuch na bataata. Unhone kaha: to Ali (RA) mere paas se guzre aur kaha: 'Ab to us aadmi ko apni manzil pehchaan lena chahiye?' Unhone kaha: maine kaha: 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha: 'Mere sath chalo.' Phir poocha: 'Tumhein is shehar mein kya laaya?' Maine unse kaha: 'Agar tum meri baat chhupaao, to main tumhein bataata houn.' Unhone kaha: 'Main aisa karunga.' Maine unse kaha: 'Humein khabar mili hai ke yahan se aik aadmi nikla hai jo dawa karta hai ke woh Nabi hai, to maine apne bhai ko unse baat karne bheja, woh wapas aaye magar mujhe tasalli nahi di, isliye main unse khud milna chahta houn.' Unhone kaha: 'Beshak tum theek raaste par ho, yeh mera raasta hai, mere peeche chalo, aur jahan main dakhil houn wahan dakhil ho jaana, agar mujhe koi aisa nazar aaye jisse mujhe tumhare liye khauf ho, to main deewar ke paas khada ho jaunga apna joota theek karne ke bahaane, aur tum aage badh jaana.' Unhone kaha: to woh chale aur main unke sath chala yahan tak ke woh dakhil huay aur main bhi unke sath Nabi (SAW) ke paas dakhil hua, maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhpar Islam pesh karein.' To aap (SAW) ne mujhpar Islam pesh kiya, aur main waheen Musalman ho gaya. Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: 'Aye Abu Dharr, iss baat ko chhupaao aur apne shehar wapas chale jaao, jab tumhein humari kaamyaabi ki khabar mile, to aa jaana.' Maine kaha: 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke sath bheja, main zaroor iska elaan unke darmiyan karunga.' To woh masjid mein aaye jahan Quraish maujood the, kaha: 'Aye Quraish ki jama'at, main gawahi deta houn ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta houn ke Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain.' To unhone kaha: 'Uttho is Saabi ki taraf.' Woh utthe aur mujhe maara yahan tak ke main marne ke qareeb tha, to Abbas ne mujhe paaya, mujhpar jhuk gaye, phir unki taraf mudhe aur kaha: 'Tumhara bura ho, tum Banu Ghifar ke aik aadmi ko qatl karoge jabke tumhari tijaarat aur guzar-gaah Ghifar se hokar hai?' To unhone mujhse haath rok liya. Jab agli subah hui, to main wapas aaya aur wahi kaha jo maine kal kaha tha, unhone kaha: 'Uttho is Saabi ki taraf,' to Abbas ne mujhe paaya, mujhpar jhuke, aur waisi hi baat kahi jaisi kal kahi thi, to yeh Abu Dharr ka pehla Islam tha." (Bukhari 3522 se tarjuma)

Beshak sabse pehle jis cheez ne mujhe Islam ki taraf bulaya, woh yeh thi ke hum ajnabi log the, to humpar (khushksaali ka) saal aaya, to main apni maa aur apne bhai ko, jinka naam Unais (RA) tha, apne kuch sasuraal walon ke paas Najd ke bala'i ilaaqe mein le gaya. Jab hum unke paas utre, to unhone humari izzat ki. Jab qabile ke aik aadmi ne yeh dekha, to woh mere maamu ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Kya tumhein pata hai ke Unais (RA) tumhare peeche tumhare ghar walon ke paas aata hai (galat maqsad se)?" Unhone kaha: to unke dil mein yeh baat dhadki, main apne oonton ki charwaahi se wapas aaya, to maine unhein udaas, ghamgeen, rota hua paaya, maine poocha: "Aap kyun ro rahe hain, Aye maamu?" To unhone mujhe khabar bataayi, maine kaha: "Allah aisi baat se bacha'e, humein badkaari (bad-akhlaaqi) ka darr hai, agarche zamaane ne humein tang kar diya ho, aapne jo shuruaat ki thi uski safaai (khushi) humpar gandi kar di hai, aur ab ikatthe rehne ka koi raasta nahi." To main apni maa aur bhai ko lekar Makkah ke qareeb utra. Mere bhai ne kaha: "Main aik aadmi houn jo apne shi'r (shairi) se paani ke haq ka difaa karta houn," aur woh shaayar the, maine kaha: "Aisa mat karo," magar zid unhein le gayi yahan tak ke unhone Juraij bin As-Simmah se unke oonton ke (haq ke) muqable mein muqaabla kiya, Allah ki qasam, us din Juraij mere bhai se behtar shaayar the, to donon aik khaime ke paas faisla karwaane gaye, to usne mere bhai ko Juraij par fazeelat di, iski wajah yeh thi ke Juraij ne uski (khaime wali aurat ki) beti ka rishta uske waalid se maanga tha, to usne kaha: "Aik boodha shaikh, mujhe iski koi zaroorat nahi," to usne (Juraij ne) uspar kina rakha. To humne uske oonton ko apne oonton ke sath mila liya, to humare paas aik acchi khaasi tadad ho gayi. Phir main Makkah aaya, aur Safa se shuru kiya, achaanak wahan Quraish ke kuch mard the, aur mujhe khabar mili thi ke wahan aik Sabi (deen badalne wala) ya deewaana ya shaayar ya jaadugar hai, to maine poocha: "Yeh (shakhs) jiska tum dawa karte ho, kahan hai?" Unhone kaha: "Woh wahan hai jahan tum dekh rahe ho." To main uski taraf mudka, Allah ki qasam, main unse aik patthar ki doori bhi na tay kar saka ke unhone mujhpar har haddi, patthar, aur mitti ka dhela phenkna shuru kar diya, yahan tak ke unhone mujhe khoon se lathpath kar diya. Main Baitullah aaya aur pardon aur imaarat ke darmiyan dakhil hua, aur usme teen (30) din roza rakha, kuch na khaaya na piya siwaye Zamzam ke paani ke, yahan tak ke aik chaandni raat aayi, jismein Khuza'ah qabile ki do auraten aayin, unhone Baitullah ka tawaaf kiya, phir Isaaf aur Naa'ilah ka zikr kiya, jo do but the jinki woh ibaadat karti thin, to maine apna sar pardon ke neeche se nikaala aur kaha: "Unme se aik ko doosre par sawaar kar do (yaani unhein aapas mein mila do, unki behsoodgi zaahir karte huay)," to woh dono ghussa ho gayin, phir kehne lagin: "Allah ki qasam, agar humare mard yahan haazir hote, to tum yeh baat na kehte." Phir woh mud gayin, to main unke naqsh-e-qadam par nikla yahan tak ke unki mulaqaat Rasulullah (SAW) se hui, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum dono kaun ho, aur kahan se ho, aur kahan se aayi ho, aur tumhein kya laaya?" To unhone aap (SAW) ko khabar batayi, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne Saabi ko kahan chhoda?" Unhone kaha: "Humne unhein pardon aur imaarat ke darmiyan chhoda." Aap (SAW) ne unse poocha: "Kya usne tumse kuch kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aur main aaya yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahuncha, phir maine usi waqt unhein salaam kiya, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum kaun ho? Aur kis (qabile) se ho? Aur kahan se ho? Aur kahan se aaye ho? Aur tumhein kya laaya?" To maine unhein khabar batayi, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum kahan se khaate-peete the?" Maine kaha: "Zamzam ke paani se." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak yeh sacchi khuraak hai," aur unke sath Abu Bakr (RA) the, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe ijaazat dein main unhein raat ka khaana khilaaun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) chalte huay nikle, aur Abu Bakr (RA) ne mera haath pakda yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) Abu Bakr (RA) ke darwaze par ruke, phir Abu Bakr (RA) apne ghar mein dakhil huay, phir Taif ki kishmish laaye, aur humein mutthi bhar bhar kar dete gaye, aur hum usme se khaate rahe yahan tak ke hum ser ho gaye. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aye Abu Dharr." Maine kaha: "Labbaik." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere liye aik zameen uthaayi gayi hai jo maal-daar hai, aur mera khayaal hai ke woh Tihaamah hai, isliye apni qaum ke paas jaao aur unhein us cheez ki taraf bulaao jismein tum dakhil huay ho." Maine kaha: to main nikla yahan tak ke apni maa aur bhai ke paas pahuncha, aur unhein khabar batayi, unhone kaha: "Humein us deen se koi na-pasandeedgi nahi jismein tum dakhil huay ho," to woh dono Musalman ho gaye. Phir hum nikle yahan tak ke Madinah pahunche, to maine apni qaum ko khabar di, unhone kaha: "Humne tumhein sach maana, aur shaayad hum Muhammad (SAW) se milen." Jab Rasulullah (SAW) humare paas aaye, to humne unse mulaqaat ki, to Ghifar ne aap (SAW) se kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Abu Dharr ne humein wohi khabar di jo aapne unhein di, aur humne Islam qubool kiya aur gawahi di ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Phir Aslam aur Khuza'ah aage badhin aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humne Islam qubool kiya aur usi mein dakhil huay jisme humare bhai aur ahd-waale dakhil huay." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aslam, Allah unhein salaamat rakhe, aur Ghifar, Allah unhein maaf kare." Phir Abu Bakr (RA) ne mera haath pakda aur kaha: "Aye Abu Dharr." Maine kaha: "Labbaik, Aye Abu Bakr (RA)." Unhone poocha: "Kya tum apni Jaahiliyat mein ibaadat kiya karte the?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan, maine khud ko suraj ke saamne khada hote dekha hai, to main namaz padhta rehta yahan tak ke uski garmi mujhe takleef deti aur main gir jaata jaise koi chaadar (bekaar) ho." Unhone mujhse poocha: "To tum kis taraf rukh karte the?" Maine kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata, siwaye jidhar Allah ne mera rukh kar diya, yahan tak ke Allah ne mujhpar Islam daal diya." Isnad saalih (theek) hai.

e: [AI] Abu Dharr used to say, "I indeed have witnessed that a quarter of Islam had embraced Islam before me, and they were none other than the Prophet ﷺ, Abu Bakr, and Bilal."
hi: Abu Dharr kaha karte the: "Maine khud ko Islam ka chautha hissa dekha, mujhse pehle sirf Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Bilal Musalman huay the."

e: [AI] "I was a quarter of Islam, three people had embraced Islam before me and I was the fourth. I came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, 'Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.' Then I saw the Prophet's face brighten up with happiness as a condition of a Muslim."
hi: Main Islam ka chautha hissa tha, mujhse pehle teen (3) log Musalman huay, aur main chautha tha, main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "As-Salaamu Alaikum, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main gawahi deta houn ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta houn ke Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain," to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre par khushi dekhi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Neither the sand-colored nor the verdant will be lessened by someone who speaks more truthfully and more faithfully than Abu Dharr, the companion resembling Jesus son of Mary." Then, Umar ibn al-Khattab stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, shall we recognize this for him?" He said, "Yes, recognize it for him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Na khaakstari zameen kisi ko uthaati hai aur na hi sabz aasman kisi par saaya karta hai, jo zubaan mein Abu Dharr se zyada sachcha aur wafaadaar ho, woh Isa bin Maryam se milte-julte hain." To Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) khade huay aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to kya hum yeh (baat) unke liye jaanein (maanein)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan, isse unke liye maano."

e: [AI] "I heard the Prophet ﷺ say, 'The greenery has not shaded or the dust lessened upon a man with more truthful speech than Abu Dharr.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Na hari zameen ne kisi ko saaya diya aur na hi khaakstari zameen ne kisi ko uthaaya jo apni baat mein Abu Dharr (RA) se zyada sachcha ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Nothing darkens the greenery nor reduces the dust more than the truthful tongue of Abu Dharr." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Na hari zameen ne kisi ko saaya diya aur na hi khaakstari zameen ne kisi ko uthaaya jo zubaan mein Abu Dharr (RA) se zyada sachcha ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said: "The toughest trials are for the prophets, then the scholars, then those who resemble them (in knowledge or righteousness), then those who resemble them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Logon mein sabse sakht aazmaish Ambiya ki hoti hai, phir Ulama ki, phir jo unse mushabeh (milte-julte) hon, aik ke baad aik."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Abu Dharr, how do you act when you are among the common folk?" He then intertwined his fingers and I said, "O messenger of Allah, what do you order me to do?" He said, "Be patient, be patient, be patient. Deal with people according to their manners and go against them in their actions."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Dharr, jab tum ghatiya (kamtar) logon mein ho, to kaisa mehsoos karoge?" Aur aap (SAW) ne apni ungliyaan aapas mein pirodi. Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), to aap mujhe kya hukum dete hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabr karo, sabr karo, sabr karo, logon se unke akhlaaq ke mutaabiq pesh aao, lekin unke (bure) amal mein unki mukhaalifat karo."

e: [AI] Narrated from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, he said: "As the end of time approaches, the wearing of the Ta'alisah will increase, trade will increase, wealth will increase, and people will greatly value money. Immorality will become widespread, the rule of youngsters will prevail, women will increase, and the neighbors of the ruler will become oppressive. Measures and scales will be tampered with, and a person will find more benefit in raising a dog rather than raising his own child. The elderly will not be respected, and the young will not be shown mercy. The children of adultery will increase to the extent that a man will have relations with a woman on the side of the road, and the most appropriate description for them at that time is that if you were to distance yourselves from their path and wear the skins of sheep, their hearts would still resemble those of wolves."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab woh waqt qareeb aayega, to Tayaalisah (khaas chaadar) pehnne walon ki tadaad badh jaayegi, tijaarat badh jaayegi, maal badh jaayega, aur maal ka maalik apne maal ki wajah se buzurg samjha jaayega, badkaari badh jaayegi, kam-umr logon ko hukoomat mili jaayegi, auraton ki tadaad badh jaayegi, hukumraan zulm karega, naap aur tol mein kami ki jaayegi, aur aadmi apne kutte ke pillay ko paalna apni aulaad ko paalne se behtar samjhega, na kisi buzurg ki izzat ki jaayegi na kisi chhote par reham kiya jaayega, aur zina se paida honay walon ki tadaad itni badh jaayegi ke aadmi raaste ke bich mein aurat ke sath (badkaari) karega, to unme sabse behtar shakhs kahega: kaash tum dono raaste se hat jaate! Aur woh bhed ki khaalein pehnenge, jabke unke dil bhediyon jaise honge, us waqt unme sabse behtar shakhs khushaamdi (Al-Mudaahin) hoga."

e: [AI] I came to Abu Dhar and found him hiding in the mosque under a black blanket alone. So, I said, "O Abu Dhar, what is this solitude?" He replied, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Solitude is better than bad companionship, and good companionship is better than solitude. Dictating good is better than silence, and silence is better than dictating evil.'"
hi: Main Abu Dharr (RA) ke paas aaya, unhein masjid mein aik kaale kambal mein lipta akela paaya, maine kaha: "Aye Abu Dharr, yeh akela pan kya hai?" Unhone kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Akela pan bure saathi se behtar hai, aur neik saathi akele pan se behtar hai, aur bhalaai bataana khaamoshi se behtar hai, aur khaamoshi buraai bataane se behtar hai." Yeh sahih saabit nahi hui.

e: [AI] I was with Abu Darda when a man from the outskirts of the city came to him and asked him. Abu Darda informed him that Abu Dhar was heading towards Ar-Rabadhah. So Abu Darda said, “We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. If Abu Dhar had cut a limb or a hand from me, I would not have slandered him after I heard the Prophet ﷺ say, 'The green plants have not shaded anyone or the barren land has not been made fertile by anyone who speaks more truthfully than Abu Dhar.'" Strong chain of narration.
hi: Main Abu Darda (RA) ke sath tha ke Madinah ki taraf se aik aadmi aaya, unhone usse poocha, to usne bataya ke Abu Dharr (RA) Ar-Rabazah ki taraf ja rahe hain, to Abu Darda ne kaha: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon, agar Abu Dharr mera koi ang ya haath kaat dete, to bhi main unhein bura na kehta, iske baad ke maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: na hari zameen ne kisi ko saaya diya aur na hi khaakstari zameen ne kisi ko uthaaya jo zubaan mein Abu Dharr se zyada sachcha ho." Isnad achha hai.

e: [AI] "By Allah, the mother of Thar did not wander with Abu Thar, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'When the prices increase in a town, leave it.' Abu Thar said, when the prices increased, he left the town with his goods and went to Al-Sham (Syria), mentioning the rest of the Hadith in its entirety."
hi: Umm Dharr (ne kaha): "Allah ki qasam, Uthman (RA) ne Abu Dharr (RA) ko jila-watan nahi kiya, balke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: jab imaarat (tameer) Sil'a (pahaad) tak pahunche, to tum wahan se nikal jaana." Abu Dharr ne kaha: jab imaarat Sil'a tak pahunchi aur usse aage badh gayi, to Abu Dharr Sham (Syria) ki taraf nikal gaye," aur baaqi hadith lambi tafseel ke sath zikr ki.

e: [AI] "He was among the group of people from Kufa who stood up to offer prayers for him."
hi: Beshak woh Kufa walon ke us giroh mein the jo unki namaz-e-janaza ke liye khade huay.

e: [AI] When Abu Dharr was near death, I cried. He asked me, "What makes you cry?" I replied, "Why shouldn't I cry, when you are dying on a patch of earth? I don't have a shroud that fits you or me, and it is necessary for your funeral." He said, "Rejoice and do not cry, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Two Muslim parents do not experience the death of two children or three, without them considering it and seeing the Hellfire forever.' " Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Jab Abu Dharr (RA) ki wafaat ka waqt aaya, to main royi, to unhone mujhse poocha: "Tumhein kis cheez ne rulaaya?" Maine kaha: "Main kyun na roun, jabke aap zameen ke aik viraan hisse mein wafaat paa rahe hain, aur mere paas koi kapda nahi jo aapko ya mujhe kafan de sake, aur aapke taboot ke liye bhi kuch chaahiye." Unhone kaha: "To khush ho jaao aur mat ro, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: do Musalman miyaan-biwi ke do ya teen bacche faut nahi hote, aur woh sabr karte huay (Allah se) ajr chahte hain, magar Allah unhein kabhi Jahannam nahi dikhaayega." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He heard from the Prophet ﷺ , who was known as the beloved of the Romans due to his frequent visits to them. He said, and Shurayh ibn Al-Harith (Al-Bahr Al-Taweel) said: "Everyone who claims to be a beloved, even if his features are tender, cannot match the beloved ones of Bani Fihar. Hamam leads the horses as if he is treading on the gravel, taming the raging fire." Al-Dhahabi did not comment on it in his summarization.
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) se suna, aur unhein 'Habib Ar-Rum' (Rome ke aziz) kaha jaata tha unke Rome mein baar-baar jaane ki wajah se, unhone kaha: aur unke baare mein Shuraih bin Al-Harith ne kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Khabardaar, jo bhi koi 'Habib' (aziz) honay ka dawa kare, aur agarche uski shaan zaahir ho jaaye, woh Banu Fihr ke Habib ka fidya kar de, jo aik buland-himmat aadmi hai, ghodon ki agwaai karta hai, goya woh kankariyon ko is tarah rondte hain jaise woh angaaron ko jalaate hue rondte hon." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "To include them in the spoils of war, they said 'We have granted you provisions.' The people of Sham said, 'You have not witnessed the battle, you have no share with us.' Habib refused to share with them and he and his companions claimed their share of the spoils. The people of Sham and the people of Iraq began to dispute over this until it almost escalated between them. Some people from Iraq said, 'If you kill Salman, we will kill your beloved ones. And if you leave towards Ibn Affan, we will leave.' Abu Bakr Al-Ghassani said, 'I have heard that this was the first animosity that occurred between the people of Sham and the people of Iraq.' Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary."
hi: ...ke unhein maal-e-ghanimat mein shareek kiya jaaye, aur unhone (Iraq walon ne) kaha: "Humne tumhari madad ki hai." Aur Sham walon ne kaha: "Tumne jung mein shirkat nahi ki, tumhara humare sath kuch haq nahi." To Habib ne unhein shareek karne se inkaar kar diya, aur woh aur unke saathi apne maal-e-ghanimat par qaabiz ho gaye, to Sham walon aur Iraq walon mein iss baat par jhagda hua yahan tak ke unke darmiyan (jung ki) naubat aane wali thi, to Iraq walon mein se kisi ne kaha: "Agar tum Salman (RA) ko qatl karoge, to hum tumhare Habib ko qatl karenge, aur agar tum Ibn Affan (Uthman RA) ki taraf kooch karoge, to hum bhi kooch karenge." Abu Bakr Al-Ghassani ne kaha: "Aur maine suna hai ke yeh pehli dushmani thi jo Sham walon aur Iraq walon ke darmiyan hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard my father saying the pseudonym of Habib ibn Muslimah is Abu Abdurrahman.
hi: Maine apne waalid ko kehte suna: "Habib bin Muslimah (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Abdur Rahman thi."

e: [AI] "I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ  performing the optional prayer of the third part (of the night)."
hi: "Main Nabi (SAW) ke sath maujood tha jab aap (SAW) ne aik tihaai (maal-e-ghanimat mein se) inaam ke taur par diya."

e: [AI] "That Abu Dharr al-Ghifari and the people used to call Habib ibn Muslimah Habib al-Rum because of his great struggle against the Romans."
hi: "Beshak Abu Dharr Al-Ghifari (RA) aur log, Habib bin Muslimah ko Habib Ar-Rum (Rome ka aziz) kehte the, Rome ke khilaaf unke bohot zyada jihad ki wajah se."

e: [AI] Habib bin Muslama passed away in Armenia in the year forty-two while he was fifty years old.
hi: "Habib bin Muslimah (RA) ka intiqaal Armenia mein, baais (42) hijri mein hua, jabke woh pachaas (50) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Visit those who are sick to increase in love."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kabhi-kabhaar milaa karo, mohabbat badh jaayegi."

e: [AI] "He was commanded over an army, so he took the paths. When he reached the enemy, he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'No group gathers and one of them supplicates while the rest feel safe, except that Allah will answer them.'" Then, he praised Allah and praised Him, and then he said, "O Allah, protect our lives and make our rewards the rewards of martyrs." While they were on that, the leader of the enemy, Hunbath, descended and entered the tent of Habib."
hi: Beshak unhein aik lashkar ka ameer banaaya gaya, unhone raaston par safar kiya, jab dushman ke paas pahunche, to unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: koi jama'at jama nahi hoti jismein aik dua maange aur baaqi 'Ameen' kahein, magar Allah unki dua qubool karta hai." Phir unhone Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir kaha: "Aye Allah, humara khoon bacha, aur humara ajr shuhada ka ajr banaa de." Woh isi haal mein the ke Hunbaat, dushman ka sardaar, utra aur Habib ke khaime mein dakhil hua. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And among those who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the Banu Zuhrah and their allies was Miqdad ibn Amr ibn Thaʿlabah ibn Malik ibn Zamʿah ibn Thumamah ibn Matruud ibn Amr ibn Rabee'ah ibn Zuhayr ibn Namir ibn Thaʿlabah ibn Malik."
hi: "Aur Banu Zuhrah aur unke ahd-waale saathiyon mein se, jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki, Al-Miqdad bin Amr bin Tha'labah bin Malik bin Zam'ah bin Thumaamah bin Matrood bin Amr bin Rabee'ah bin Zuhair bin Namir bin Tha'labah bin Malik (RA) the."

e: [AI] About Urwah: "Regarding the naming of those who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the tribe of Bani Zuhrah and their allies, Muqaddad ibn 'Amr."
hi: Urwah se: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Banu Zuhrah aur unke ahd-waale saathiyon mein se, Al-Miqdad bin Amr (RA) the."

e: [AI] "And it is said that it is al-Aswad ibn Abi Qays ibn 'Abd Manaf."
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai ke unka nisbat Al-Aswad bin Abi Qais bin Abd Manaf ki taraf hai.

e: [AI] "I used to be a friend of Al-Miqdad ibn Al-Aswad during the pre-Islamic era. He was involved in fighting, so he escaped to Kindah and swore allegiance to them. Then he got into a fight with them and fled to Makkah, where he swore allegiance to Al-Aswad ibn Abdul Yaghouth. That is why he is attributed to them."
hi: "Jaahiliyat mein main Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad ka saathi tha, unhone unke darmiyan khoon bahaaya (kisi ko qatl kiya), to woh Kindah ki taraf bhaage aur unse ahd (hilf) kar liya, phir unme se bhi khoon bahaaya, to woh Makkah ki taraf bhaage aur Al-Aswad bin Abd Yaghooth se ahd kar liya, isi liye unki nisbat unki taraf ki gayi."

e: [AI] Al-Miqdad ibn al-Aswad, also known as Abu Ma'bad, died in the year thirty after reaching around seventy years old. He used to dye his beard. He died falling off a cliff, and his body was carried on the shoulders of men. Uthman ibn Affan prayed over him, and he was buried in al-Baqi'.
hi: "Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Ma'bad thi, unka intiqaal tees (30) hijri mein hua, jabke woh taqreeban sattar (70) saal ke thay, aur woh apni daadhi zard rang se rangte the, unka intiqaal Al-Jurf mein hua, to unhein mardon ke kandhon par uthaaya gaya, aur Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur unhein Baqee' mein dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] He is called Al-Miqdad bin Aswad. When the Quran revealed the verse "Call them by their fathers' names" (33:5), he was referred to as Al-Miqdad bin Amr. Al-Miqdad migrated to the land of Abyssinia in the second migration according to the narration of Ibn Ishaq. Al-Miqdad participated in the battles of Badr, Uhud, Al-Khandaq, and all other major battles with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He was one of the skilled archers among the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Adh-Dhahabi did not mention him in the summary.
hi: Unhein Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad kaha jaata tha, jab Quran nazil hua: "{Unhein unke apne baap-daadon ke naam se pukaaro}" (Surah Al-Ahzab 5), to unhein Al-Miqdad bin Amr kaha jaane laga. Al-Miqdad ne Habsha (Abyssinia) ki taraf doosri hijrat ki, Ibn Ishaq ki riwayat mein, aur Al-Miqdad ne Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein maroof teer-andaazon mein se the. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I swear by the honor of its people." Then Al-Aswad bin 'Abd Yaghooth swore. It was said to him, "You are Mikdad bin Al-Aswad." He said, "No, I am Mikdad bin 'Amr Al-Bahrawi and not the son of Al-Aswad Al-Kindi."
hi: "Main zaroor uske ahle mein sabse mu'azziz se ahd karunga," to unhone Al-Aswad bin Abd Yaghooth se ahd kiya, isliye unhein Miqdad bin Al-Aswad kaha jaane laga, jabke asal mein woh Miqdad bin Amr Al-Bahraawi hain, aur woh Al-Aswad Al-Kindi ke bete nahi hain."

e: [AI] To be his companion is dearer to me than anything else, because he (referring to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him) came while invoking upon the polytheists, and said: "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, we do not say what the people of Moses said to Moses: 'Go, you and your Lord, and fight, we are here sitting' but we fight on your right, on your left, in front of you, and behind you." So I saw the Prophet, peace be upon him, pleased with that.
hi: "Unka saathi honay ki khwahish mujhe kisi aur cheez se zyada mehboob hai, kyunke woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye jabke aap (SAW) mushrikeen ke khilaaf beddua kar rahe the, to unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), hum woh baat nahi kahenge jo Musa (AS) ki qaum ne Musa se kahi thi: {Tum aur tumhara Rab jaao aur jung karo, hum yahan baithe hain}, balke hum aapke daayen, baayen, aage, aur peeche (khade ho kar) jung karenge." To maine Nabi (SAW) ko iss par khush aur roshan chehra dekha.

e: [AI] I saw Al-Miqdad ibn Al-Aswad, the Guardian of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , sitting on a coffin from the coffins of Sufah in Hims. The coffin was superior to him in size, and he wanted to join in the battle. So, I said to him, "May Allah forgive you." He replied, "Allah has excused us with the verse of Enlistment: 'March forth, whether light or heavy' (Qur'an 9:41)." Then he said, "The rest of the verse is from Surah At-Tawbah."
hi: Maine Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad (RA) ko, jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke pehredaar the, dekha, Hims mein aik saraaf (paisa badalne wale) ki sandook par baithe huay the, unki jismaani jussaamat sandook se bhi zyada thi, woh jung mein shaamil honay ka iraada rakhte the, to maine unse kaha: "Allah ne aapko (iss zimmedaari se) maazoor rakha hai (chhoot di hai)." Unhone kaha: "Sooratul-Bu'oos (mubaligoon bhejne wali surah) ne humein aisa karne se inkaar karne nahi diya: {Halke ho ya bhaari, nikal khade ho jaao} (Surah At-Tawbah 41)." Baqiyyah ne kaha: "Sooratul-Bu'oos, Surah At-Tawbah hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me on a mission, and when I returned, he said to me, "How do you find yourself?" I said, "I am still as I was, until I thought that those who were with me had turned away from me. By Allah, I do not work on two paths after them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe aik kaam ke liye bheja, jab main wapas aaya, to aap (SAW) ne mujhse poocha: "Tum apne aap ko kaisa paate ho?" Maine kaha: "Main tab tak (aisi haalat mein) raha yahan tak ke mujhe laga jaise mere sath wale mere ghulam hain, aur Allah ki qasam, main un dono (afraad) ke baad kisi (aisi mushtarka zimmedaari) par kaam nahi karunga."

e: [AI] About Ibn Ishaq, "Regarding those who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the Banu Al-Harith ibn Al-Khazraj ibn Amr ibn Malik ibn Aws, Abu Abs ibn Jabr ibn Amr ibn Zaid ibn Jusham ibn Haritha ibn Al-Harith."
hi: Ibn Ishaq se: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein, Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj bin Amr bin Malik bin Aws se, Abu Abs bin Jabr bin Amr bin Zaid bin Jusham bin Haarithah bin Al-Harith (RA) the."

e: [AI] "Abu 'Abs ibn Jabr ibn 'Amr ibn Zaid ibn Jusham ibn Haritha witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Abu Abs bin Jabr bin Amr bin Zaid bin Jusham bin Haarithah (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki."

e: [AI] I read upon Ya'qub regarding someone who witnessed the Battle of Badr, Abu 'Absi ibn Jabr, and his name was 'Abdul Rahman ibn Jabr.
hi: Maine Ya'qub ke saamne padha, Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein, Abu Abs bin Jabr, jinka naam Abdur Rahman bin Jabr tha.

e: [AI] "Abu Abbas Abdullah bin Jabr bin Amr bin Zaid Al-Ansari passed away in the thirty-third year."
hi: "Abu Abs Abdullah bin Jabr bin Amr bin Zaid Al-Ansari (RA) ka intiqaal terah-tees (33) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] Abu Abis Abdul Rahman ibn Jabr died in the year forty-three while he was seventy years old.
hi: "Abu Abs Abdur Rahman bin Jabr (RA) ka intiqaal chauwtees (34) hijri mein hua, jabke woh sattar (70) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] "Abu Abis ibn Jabr and Khunays ibn Hudhaafah al-Sahmi were among the noble companions. Abu Abis witnessed the battles of Badr, Uhud, the Battle of the Trench, and all other major events along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He was also among those who participated in the killing of Ka'b ibn Ashraf."
hi: "Abu Abs bin Jabr aur Khunais bin Hudhaafah As-Sahmi (RA) buzurg Sahaba mein se the, aur Abu Abs ne Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur woh un logon mein se the jinhone Ka'b bin Al-Ashraf ko qatl kiya."

e: [AI] It was narrated that Abdullah bin Abi Abs Al-Ansari, from the descendants of Abi Abs, said, "He used to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , then he would go out to the tribe of Banu Harithah. One dark, stormy night, he illuminated his way with his staff until he entered the home of Banu Harithah."
hi: Humein Abdul Majeed bin Abi Abs Al-Ansari ne, Abu Abs ki aulaad mein se, hadith bayan ki: "Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath namazein padhte, phir Banu Haarithah ki taraf nikal jaate, aik andheri, baarish wali raat unhone (aisa hi) nikla, to unki laathi mein unke liye roshni ho gayi yahan tak ke woh Banu Haarithah ke ghar mein dakhil ho gaye." Mursal.

e: [AI] Abu 'Abbas ibn Jabr al-Ansari invited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for a meal that he had prepared for them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Take off your shoes at the table, for it is a beautiful Sunnah." Yahya and his teacher, Matrukan.
hi: Abu Abs bin Jabr Al-Ansari (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko khaane ki dawat di jo unhone unke liye taiyaar kiya tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khaane ke waqt apne juute utaar do, kyunke yeh aik khoobsurat Sunnat hai." Yahya aur unke ustaad, dono matrook (rad-shuda raawi) hain.

e: [AI] "A part of the narration was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summary: There were two men who lived farthest from the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . One was Abu Lubabah ibn Abdul-Mundhir and his family, who resided in Quba. The other was Abu Abs ibn Jabr, whose dwelling was in the Banu Harithah tribe. Both of them used to pray the Asr (afternoon) prayer with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , and then would go to their respective people and perform the prayer to hasten the arrival of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with his prayer."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghar se sabse door do aadmi the, Abu Lubabah bin Abdul Munzir (RA) aur unke ghar wale, Quba mein, aur Abu Abs bin Jabr (RA), jinka ghar Banu Haarithah mein tha, aur woh dono Nabi (SAW) ke sath Asr ki namaz padhte, phir apni qaum ke paas jaate, aur woh (waqt par) namaz padh chuke hote is se pehle ke Rasulullah (SAW) apni namaz jaldi (khatam) karte." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Talhah Zaid bin Sahl bin Al-Aswad bin Haram bin Zaid Manat bin Adi bin Malik bin Al-Najjar. He participated in the Battle of Badr and was one of the mentioned archers among the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . It is said that he was a well-built man and he died in Medina in the year thirty-four. Uthman bin Affan led the funeral prayer for him, and at that time, Uthman was seventy years old."
hi: "Abu Talhah Zaid bin Sahl bin Al-Aswad bin Haraam bin Zaid Manaat bin Adi bin Malik bin An-Najjaar (RA) ne Badr mein shirkat ki, aur unki aulaad hai, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein maroof teer-andaazon mein se the, aur kaha jaata hai ke woh saanwle, mautadil qad ke aadmi the, unka intiqaal Madinah mein chauwtees (34) hijri mein hua, aur Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, jabke woh (Abu Talhah) us waqt sattar (70) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] About Uruwah, "Regarding the identification of the person who witnessed the pledge of allegiance at Al-Aqabah and then witnessed the Battle of Badr from the Banu Amro bin Malik bin Al-Najjar, his name is Abu Talhah, and he is Zaid, the son of Sahl, son of Al-Aswad, son of Haram, son of Amro, son of Zaid, son of Manah."
hi: Urwah se: "Aqabah ki baiyat mein shirkat karne walon mein, phir Badr mein bhi shirkat karne walon mein, Banu Amr bin Malik bin An-Najjaar se, Abu Talhah (RA), jinka naam Zaid bin Sahl bin Al-Aswad bin Haraam bin Amr bin Zaid Manaat tha."

e: [AI] "Abu Talhah, Zaid ibn Sahl, used to dig in."
hi: "Abu Talhah Zaid bin Sahl (RA) khudaai (khandaq/gaddha khodne ka kaam) karte the."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Ma'in saying, "Abu Talha Al-Ansari, Zaid bin Sahl."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Abu Talhah Al-Ansari, Zaid bin Sahl."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "This is my cousin, so whoever among you wishes to marry him, let him marry him." He was referring to Abu Talha, the husband of Umm Sulaim. He said it during the incident of "Al-Karam", and I heard it from Abu Ishaq Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Yahya, who said: "I heard Abu Al-Abbas Ad-Duguli saying: 'I heard Al-Hafiz Salah Jazra saying: 'Fadl Al-Razi told me when you enter Nishapur, a man with a good face, good clothes, good mount, and good manners will greet you. Know that he is Muhammad bin Yahya Adh-Dhuhli. May the first thing you ask him about be the Hadith from Shu'bah about Yahya bin Subayh, and mention the Hadith to him.'" He said: "So, I resolved that the first thing I did when I entered Nishapur was that a man greeted me with these qualities, so I asked about him and they said, 'He is Muhammad bin Yahya.' So, I greeted him and he returned the greeting. Then, I followed him until he settled. I said to him, 'The Sheikh has asked me for his books.' So, he brought out some volumes and said to me, 'Wait for me until I finish praying Dhuhr.' When he finished, he called the Adhan, prepared himself to pray, sat in his designated place, and I recited to him what I had written. Then, I asked him what Hadith Fadl Al-Razi mentioned to me about the Sheikh. He said, 'Tell me.' So, I said, 'Sa'id bin 'Amir narrated to us from Shu'bah, and I mentioned the Hadith to him.' He smiled and said to me, 'O young man, who would choose someone like this for a candidate and recite something like what you have recited, unless he knows that Sa'id bin 'Amir does not narrate something like this?' I said, 'Yes, Sa'id bin 'Amir narrated it to us from Wa'il.' He said, 'Yes, Sa'id bin Wa'il narrated it to us.'" Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh mera maamu (khaal) hai, isliye tum mein se jo bhi chaahe apna maamu pesh kare (dikhaaye)" - matlab Abu Talhah, Umm Sulaim (RA) ke shohar. Unhone "Al-Karam" (kitaab) mein kaha: yeh maine Abu Ishaq Ibrahim bin Muhammad bin Yahya se suna, unhone kaha maine Abu Al-Abbas Ad-Dughuli ko kehte suna, unhone kaha maine Haafiz Saalih Jazrah ko kehte suna, unhone kaha mujhse Fadlak Ar-Razi ne kaha: "Jab tum Naisapur mein dakhil ho, to tumhein aik khoobsurat chehre wala, achhe kapdon wala, achhi savaari wala, achhi baat karne wala buzurg milega, to jaan lo ke woh Muhammad bin Yahya Adh-Dhuhli hain, isliye sabse pehle unse Shu'bah ki hadith, Yahya bin Subaih ke hawaale se, poochna," aur hadith zikr ki. Unhone kaha: to aisa hi hua ke jab main Naisapur mein pehli baar dakhil hua, to aik aadmi mujhse aisi hi soorat mein mila, maine unke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha yeh Muhammad bin Yahya hain, to maine unhein salaam kiya, unhone jawaab diya, to main unke peeche chala yahan tak ke woh (kahin) utre, maine kaha: "Shaikh apni kitaaben mujhe dikhaayein," to unhone kuch juzz nikaale aur kaha: "Zuhr ki namaz ke liye mere nikalne tak mera intezaar karo," jab woh nikle, to azaan di, iqaamat ki, namaz padhi, aur apne mehraab mein baith gaye, to maine unke saamne woh padha jo maine likha tha, phir maine unse kaha: "Fadlak Ar-Razi ne mujhe shaikh se koi hadith faayda-mand batayi thi?" Unhone kaha: "Sunao." Maine kaha: "Aapko Sa'eed bin Aamir ne hadith bayan ki, humein Shu'bah ne hadith bayan ki," aur hadith zikr ki, to woh muskuraaye, phir mujhse kaha: "Aye jawaan, jo koi aisa intekhaab kare jaisa tumne kiya, aur aisa padhe jaisa tumne padha, kya woh jaanta hai ke Sa'eed bin Aamir aisi hadith bayan nahi karte?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan, aapko Sa'eed bin Waasil ne hadith bayan ki." Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, humein Sa'eed bin Waasil ne hi hadith bayan ki thi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The voice of Abu Talha in the army is better than a thousand men." This narration is not found with this chain of transmission, but its narrators from the last among them are reliable. Rather, this text is known from the hadith of Ali ibn Zaid ibn Jud'an narrated by Anas, and its narrators are reliable according to the conditions of Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Talhah ki aawaaz lashkar mein hazaar (1000) aadmiyon se behtar hai." Yeh isi isnad se likhi nahi gayi hai, aur iske aakhiri raawi bharosemand hain, aur yeh matan sirf Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'aan ki hadith se maroof hai, Anas ke hawaale se. Iske raawi bharosemand hain, Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The voice of Abu Talhah in the army is better than a group." This is on the condition of being a Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Talhah ki aawaaz lashkar mein aik giroh se behtar hai." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said on the day of Uhud, "Whoever kills a disbeliever, his belongings are his spoils of war." Abu Talha killed twenty men that day.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Uhud ke din farmaya: "Jo koi kaafir ko qatl kare, uska saamaan uska ho jaayega," to Abu Talhah ne us din bees (20) aadmi qatl kiye.

e: [AI] Abu Talhah used to fast for forty years after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, except for the day of Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha.
hi: "Beshak Abu Talhah ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad chalis (40) saal roza rakha, sirf Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha ke din chhodkar."

e: [AI] "I do not command two persons nor do I blame them both."
hi: "Main do (logon) par ameer nahi banunga aur na hi unhein bura kahunga."

e: [AI] Abu Talha read this verse, "March forth, whether light or heavy" [At-Tawbah 41]. He said, "Allah has commanded us to go out and has ordered us to go out. We went out in our youth and in our old age. Prepare me." His sons said to him, "May Allah have mercy on you, you have already fought during the time of the Prophet ﷺ , Abu Bakr, and Umar, and now we are fighting for you." He fought in a battle and died. They sought an island to bury him, but they were unable to do so until seven days had passed, and his body did not decompose.
hi: Beshak Abu Talhah ne yeh aayat padhi: "{Halke ho ya bhaari, nikal khade ho jaao}" (Surah At-Tawbah 41), to unhone kaha: "Allah ne humein mobilize kiya aur humein hukum diya, aur humne budhon aur jawaano ko mobilize kiya, mujhe (safar ke liye) taiyaar karo." To unke betoon ne kaha: "Allah aap par reham kare, aapne to Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, aur Umar ke daur mein jung ki hai, ab hum aapki taraf se jung karenge." To woh samandar mein gaye aur wafaat paa gaye, unhone (unke sath waalon ne) aik jazeera (island) dhoonda jahan unhein dafna sakein, magar saat (7) din baad hi woh mil paaya, aur unka jism kharaab nahi hua tha.

e: [AI] Abu Talha used to throw himself in front of the Prophet ﷺ, while the Prophet ﷺ would raise his back to see where his arrows would land. Abu Talha would protect the Prophet ﷺ with his chest and say, "O Prophet of Allah, may my life be sacrificed for you, may my neck be cut instead of yours."
hi: Beshak Abu Talhah Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne teer chalaate the, aur Nabi (SAW) apni peeth (Abu Talhah ke) peechhe se uthaate taake dekhein unka teer kahan girta hai, to Abu Talhah apna seena aage badhaate huay Rasulullah (SAW) ki hifaazat karte aur kehte: "Aise, Aye Allah ke Nabi, Allah mujhe aap par qurbaan kare, meri gardan aapki gardan ke badle."

e: [AI] And from the descendants of Salim ibn Awf ibn Amr ibn Awf ibn Al-Khazraj, Ubada ibn As-Samit ibn Qais ibn Asram ibn Bahz ibn Tha'laba ibn Ghanm ibn Salim, a leader who participated in the Battle of Badr and witnessed all the events with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Aur Banu Salim bin Auf bin Amr bin Auf bin Al-Khazraj se, Ubaadah bin As-Saamit bin Qais bin Asram bin Bahz bin Tha'labah bin Ghanm bin Salim (RA), Naqeeb, ne Badr aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki.

e: [AI] I heard Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah saying, "'Ubadah ibn As-Samit is Badri, Uhudi, 'Aqibi and Shajari, and he is a leader."
hi: Maine Sufyan bin Uyainah ko kehte suna: "Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) Badri, Uhudi, Aqabi, Shajari hain, aur woh Naqeeb hain."

e: [AI] I heard Ahmad bin Hanbal say, "Ubada bin As-Samit is a Badri, an Uhdi, a Shajari, an Aqibi, and a Naqib."
hi: Maine Ahmad bin Hanbal ko kehte suna: "Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) Badri, Uhudi, Shajari, Aqabi, Naqeeb hain."

e: [AI] Concerning Uruwah, he said: "Regarding the naming of those who witnessed Al-Aqaba and pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, among them were from the tribe of Bani Awf, and then from the tribe of Bani Salim ibn Ja'far, Ubadah ibn As-Samit, who was a sergeant and had witnessed the Battle of Badr."
hi: Urwah se: "Aqabah mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat ki: aur Banu Auf se, phir Banu Salim bin Ja'far se, Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA), jo Naqeeb the aur Badr mein bhi shirkat ki thi."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent him for the charity, and he said, 'O Abu Al-Walid'"
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein sadqaat (Zakat) par bheja aur farmaya: "Aye Abu Al-Waleed."

e: [AI] It was said to Ubada ibn al-Samit, "O Abu al-Walid!"
hi: Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) se kaha gaya: "Aye Abu Al-Waleed."

e: [AI] "Ubada bin Samit and Shaddad bin Aws used to live in Bayt al-Maqdis, and Ubada was nicknamed Abu al-Walid."
hi: "Ubaadah bin As-Saamit aur Shaddad bin Aws (RA), Bait Al-Maqdis (Jerusalem) mein rehte the, aur Ubaadah ki kunniyat Abu Al-Waleed thi."

e: [AI] "We went out during the month of Hajj in which we pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Al-Aqaba. The leader of Banu Auf bin Al-Harith was Ubada bin As-Samit."
hi: "Hum us Hajj mein nikle jismein humne Rasulullah (SAW) se Aqabah mein baiyat ki, to Banu Auf bin Al-Harith ke Naqeeb Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) the."

e: [AI] "O people of the Ansar, why do you not come to me with your brothers from the Quraysh?" 'Ubadah said, "Because of a matter of necessity." He said, "Then why not in public?" He said, "We fought it on the Day of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: ...unse (poocha): "Aye Ansar ki jama'at, tumhein kya hua ke tum apne Quraish bhaiyon ke sath mere paas nahi aate?" Ubaadah (RA) ne kaha: "Zaroorat (majboori) thi." Unhone poocha: "To paani laane wale oonton (an-nawaadih) par kyun nahi aaye?" Unhone kaha: "Humne unhein Badr ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath istemaal kar liya tha."

e: [AI] "The graves of Ubada ibn as-Samit and Umar ibn Abdullah are in the Holy Mosque."
hi: "Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) aur Umar bin Abdullah ki qabrein Bait Al-Maqdis (Jerusalem) mein hain."

e: [AI] "When I used to come to the House of the Holy, 'Ubada bin As-Samit would greet me."
hi: "Jab main Bait Al-Maqdis (Jerusalem) aata, to main Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) ke paas thehra karta tha."

e: [AI] Ubadah ibn Al-Samit died in Sham in the land of Palestine in the town of Al-Ramlah in the thirty-fourth year. He was seventy-two years old.
hi: "Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) ka intiqaal Sham mein, Filistine ki zameen mein, Ar-Ramlah mein, chauwtees (34) hijri mein hua, jabke woh bahattar (72) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic text is: "Uwafa ibn Al-Samit died in Jerusalem and was buried there in the year forty-three when he was seventy-two years old."
hi: "Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) ka intiqaal Bait Al-Maqdis mein hua aur wahin dafan kiye gaye, chauwtees (34) hijri mein, jabke woh bahattar (72) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] He said to him, "I will not reside with you in this land." So he traveled to the city and 'Umar said to him, "What brought you to me? Allah does not open up a land that you are not in, and those like you." So he left, may Mu'awiya not govern over you.
hi: ...unse (kaha): "Main tumhare sath (Mu'awiyah ki) zameen mein nahi rahunga," to woh Madinah ki taraf kooch kar gaye, to Umar (RA) ne unse kaha: "Tumhein mere paas kis cheez ne laaya? Allah kisi zameen ki fatah nahi degi jismein tum aur tumhare jaise log na hon." Phir (Umar ne kaha): "Wapas jaao, Mu'awiyah (RA) ka tumpar koi ikhtiyaar nahi."

e: [AI] "And he had participated in six expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
hi: "Aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath chhah (6) ghazwe kiye."

e: [AI] "I entered upon Ubada bin Sāmit and he had become well-versed in the religion of Allah."
hi: "Main Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) ke paas dakhil hua, aur woh Allah ke deen mein faqeeh (samajh rakhne wale) ho chuke the."

e: [AI] "We pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, that we will not fear the blame of the blamers in Allah's cause."
hi: "Humne Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat ki is baat par ke hum Allah ke maamle mein kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat se nahi darenge."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was busy, and when a man came and embraced Islam at the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he assigned him to one of us to teach him the Quran. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  assigned a man to me who was with me in the house, and I used to recite the Quran to him. He saw that I had a right over him, so he gave me a bow that I had never seen anything better or finer than, and I have never seen anything better or finer than its handle. So I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said: "What do you think, O Messenger of Allah, about it?" He said: "It is like a blaze between your shoulders, either you inherited it or acquired it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) masroof rehte the, jab koi aadmi aata aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke haath par Islam qubool karta, to aap (SAW) usse humme se aik aadmi ke supurd karte taake woh use Quran sikhaaye, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mere supurd aik aadmi kiya jo mere sath ghar mein rehta tha, aur main use Quran padhaata tha, to usne mehsoos kiya ke uspar mera haq hai, isliye usne mujhe tohfe mein aik kamaan (teer-andaazi ki) di jiske jaisi khoobsurat aur achhi kamaan maine kabhi nahi dekhi thi, to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh aik jalta hua angaara hai jo tumne apne kandhon ke darmiyan pehna hai, khwah tum isse zanjeer ki tarah gale mein pehno ya isse latkaao."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "After me, there will come rulers who will inform you of what you do not know and deny you what you know. So, whoever among you witnesses that, then there is no obedience to the one who disobeys Allah."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Mere baad tumpar aise hukmraan honge jo tumhein woh cheez pehchaanwaayenge jise tum galat samajhte ho, aur jo tum sahi samajhte ho usse ghalat theharaayenge, to jo bhi tum mein se yeh (zamana) paaye, to jo Allah ki nafarmaani kare uski itaa'at nahi."

e: [AI] "Regarding Isma'il ibn 'Ubaid ibnahu, as for the hadith of Muslim ibn Khalid, it was narrated exclusively by 'Abdullah ibn Waqid, and he is weak."
hi: Ismail bin Ubaid se, isi jaisi (mafhoom mein), aur rahi baat Muslim bin Khalid ki hadith ki, to isse sirf Abdullah bin Waqid ne akele riwayat kiya hai, aur woh kamzor hain.

e: [AI] That Ubadah ibn al-Samit stood up in the middle of the house of the Commander of the Believers, Uthman ibn Affan, and said, "Indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, Muhammad, also known as Abu Al-Qasim, say, 'After me, there will be individuals who will make you recognize what you denied and deny what you recognized. So, there is no obedience for those who disobey Allah. Therefore, do not blame yourselves. By the One in whose hand my soul is, Muawiya is one of those individuals.'" Uthman did not change any part of it. And this hadith has been narrated with a sound chain of narrators, according to the condition set by the two sheikhs, concerning the transmission of Ubadah ibn al-Samit's words to Uthman ibn Affan, abbreviatedly.
hi: Beshak Ubaadah bin As-Saamit (RA) Ameer-ul-Momineen Uthman bin Affan (RA) ke ghar ke bich mein khade huay aur kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW), Muhammad Abul Qasim, ko farmate suna: mere baad tumhare maamlaat aise log sambhaalenge jo tumhein woh cheez pehchaanwaayenge jise tum galat samajhte ho, aur jo tum sahi samajhte ho usse ghalat theharaayenge, to jo Allah ki nafarmaani kare uski itaa'at nahi, isliye apne aap ko malaamat na karna, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, Mu'awiyah (RA) unme se hain." To Uthman (RA) ne unhein aik lafz ka bhi jawaab na diya. Aur yeh hadith Sahih isnad se, Shaykhain ki shart par, mukhtasar matan ke sath riwayat hui hai, ke Ubaadah bin As-Saamit Uthman bin Affan ke paas shikayat karte huay aaye.

e: [AI] About him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] According to Ibn Ishaq, "Abu Salama was the first of the immigrants to arrive in Medina. After him, the first person to arrive was Aamir ibn Rabia."
hi: Ibn Ishaq se: "Muhajireen mein se sabse pehle Madinah aane wale Abu Salamah (RA) the, aur Abu Salamah ke baad sabse pehle aane wale Aamir bin Rabee'ah (RA) the."

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] My father woke up in the night to criticize and condemn Uthman. Then he prayed and supplicated, saying, "O Allah, protect me from trials and tribulations by preserving the righteous among Your servants. May I not go out or wake up except for his funeral." Sahih.
hi: Uthman (RA) par jo tanqeed ho rahi thi (uske daur mein), mere waalid raat ko uthe, phir namaz padhi aur dua maangi, kaha: "Aye Allah, mujhe fitne se bacha, jaisa tune apne neik bandon ko bachaaya," to woh subah tak zinda na rahe magar unki (Uthman ki) janaza mein hi shaamil huay. Sahih.

e: [AI] "Amer ibn Rabia Al-Adawi died in the year thirty-three, and it is said in the year thirty-two."
hi: "Aamir bin Rabee'ah Al-Adawi (RA) ka intiqaal tettees (33) hijri mein hua, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai battees (32) hijri."

e: [AI] About 'Urwah bin Az-Zubair, "Among those who migrated to Abyssinia, those who had migrated before Ja'far and his companions from the tribe of Bani Adi bin Ka'b, 'Amir bin Rabiah from the people of Yemen witnessed the Battle of Badr."
hi: Urwah se: "Habsha (Abyssinia) ki taraf hijrat karne walon mein se, jo Ja'far (RA) aur unke saathiyon se pehle pehli baar nikle, Banu Adi bin Ka'b se, Aamir bin Rabee'ah, Yemen ke rehne wale, ne Badr mein shirkat ki."

e: [AI] "The full moon of the sixteenth morning of Ramadan."
hi: "Badr Ramadan ki satrahvi (17) subah ko hui."

e: [AI] "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when a funeral procession passed by. A Jewish man said, 'O Muhammad, this funeral speaks.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  remained silent. The Jew said, 'I bear witness that it speaks.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'When the people of the Book inform you of something, say, "We believe in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers".'"
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath the, to aik janaaza guzri, to aik Yahoodi aadmi ne kaha: "Aye Muhammad, yeh janaaza baat karti hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) khaamosh rahe. Yahoodi ne kaha: "Main gawahi deta houn ke yeh baat karti hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Ahl-e-Kitaab tumhein koi baat bataayen, to kaho: hum Allah, uske farishton, uski kitaabon, aur uske Rusul par imaan laaye."

e: [AI] When the funeral of Rafei bin Khadeej was held, the hadith was mentioned.
hi: Jab Raafi' bin Khadeej (RA) ki janaaza rakhi gayi, aur hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] Abu Al-Aswad Muhammad son of Abdul Rahman son of Nawfal son of Urwah son of Zubair.
hi: Humein Abu Al-Aswad Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman bin Naufal bin Urwah bin Zubair ne hadith bayan ki.

e: "Yahya bin Adam narrated to us, he said: "Malik narrated to us from Zubaid, from Dharr, from Ibn Abza.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1738)
hi: Apne waalid se.

e: [AI] The mother of Zubair is Safiyyah bint Abdul-Muttalib. Her mother is Hala bint Ahib bin Abdul-Manaf bin Zuhrah. Her mother is Aaliyah bint Abdul-Muttalib bin Abdul-Manaf.
hi: Zubair (RA) ki maa Safiyyah bint Abdul Muttalib (RA) thin, aur unki maa Haalah bint Ahyab bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah thin, aur unki maa Aaliyah bint Abdul Muttalib bin Abd Manaf thin.

e: [AI] Az-Zubayr embraced Islam when he was sixteen years old and was killed when he was sixty-two years old.
hi: "Zubair (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke woh solah (16) saal ke thay, aur woh saath se kuch zyada (umr) mein shaheed kiye gaye."

e: [AI] "That Talha and Zubayr both reached the age of sixty-four."
hi: "Beshak Talhah (RA) aur Zubair (RA) dono chausath (64) saal tak pahunche."

e: [AI] Al-Zubayr was killed at the age of seventy-six and was known as Abu Al-Tahir.
hi: "Zubair (RA) shaheed kiye gaye jabke woh sattaasath (67) saal ke thay, aur unki kunniyat Abu At-Taahir thi."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Abbas saying to Al-Zubair, "O Abdullah, here is the command of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that you hold the flag."
hi: Maine Abbas (RA) ko Zubair (RA) se kehte suna: "Aye Abdullah, yahan Rasulullah (SAW) ne aapko hukum diya hai ke jhanda gaad dein."

e: [AI] Al-Zubayr ibn Al-Awwam embraced Islam when he was eight years old, then he migrated when he was eighteen years old. Al-Zubayr's uncle used to tie him up with a mat and smoke him with fire, saying, "Go back to disbelief." Al-Zubayr would respond, "I will never disbelieve."
hi: Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke woh aath (8) saal ke thay, aur unhone hijrat ki jabke woh atharah (18) saal ke thay, aur Zubair (RA) ke chacha Zubair (RA) ko aik chataai mein latka dete aur unpar dhuaan karte aur kehte: 'Kufr ki taraf laut jaao,' to Zubair (RA) kehte: "Main kabhi kufr nahi karunga."

e: [AI] Al-Zubayr embraced Islam and migrated to the land of Abyssinia (Ethiopia) for both migrations together, and he did not fail to participate in the battle fought by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  considered him a brother to him and Ibn Mas'ood. He was a man of average height, neither tall nor short, with a light beard and dark complexion, and he had long hair.
hi: Zubair (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya aur Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen ki taraf dono hijraton mein shirkat ki, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki kisi bhi jung se peeche nahi rahe, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke aur Ibn Mas'ood (RA) ke darmiyan (Islami) bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, aur woh aik aisa aadmi the jo na lamba tha na chhota, halki daadhi wale, saanwle rang wale, ghunghraale baal wale.

e: [AI] Concerning his blood, Ali and his companions, and it was indeed Amr ibn Jurmuz who killed him in the month of Rajab in the year thirty-six. The Banu Mujashi were led by the Arabs in their efforts to hide Zubayr, and that is why Jareer says [in Al-Bahr Al-Taweel]. After Zubayr, Mujashi wore the clothes that were stained with blood and did not wash them.
hi: ...unka khoon Ali (RA) aur unke saathiyon par (jhoot mut) daala jaata hai, jabke unhein sirf Amr bin Jurmooz ne, Rajab, chhattees (36) hijri mein, qatl kiya, aur Banu Mujaashi' ko Arab logon ne Zubair (RA) ko chhupaane (aur unke qaatil ko panaah dene) ki wajah se boycott kiya, isi liye Jareer ne kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Zubair (RA) ke baad Mujaashi' ne woh kapde pehne hain jo haiz (mahwaari) mein aalooda ho chuke hon aur khoon dhoya na gaya ho."

e: [AI] "I covered him (or her) when he (or she) asked to be covered, then I turned my attention towards him (or her) and saw him (or her) covered in wounds from swords. I said, 'By Allah, I have never seen such wounds on anyone before.' He (or she) asked, 'And have you seen that?' I replied, 'By Allah, there is no wound except for one incurred by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the cause of Allah.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this incident in his summary."
hi: "Mujhe dhaank do," to maine unhein dhaanka, phir achaanak meri nazar unki taraf gayi, to maine unhein talwaaron se zakhmi paaya, maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maine kisi bhi aadmi mein aise nishaan kabhi nahi dekhe." To unhone poocha: "Kya tumne yeh dekha?" Phir kaha: "Allah ki qasam, inme se koi bhi zakhm aisa nahi jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Allah ki raah mein na laga ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] Fasama'a bidhalika al-Zubayru wahua ibnu ihdatashara sana, fakharaja bilsayfi maslulan hatta waqafa 'ala al-Nabiyyi صلى الله عليه وسلم, faqala "Ma shanuka?" faqala "Aradtu an adriba man akhadhak, fa da'ahu al-Nabiyyu صلى الله عليه وسلم wa lisayfihi, wa kana awwala sayfin sullafa fisabeelillahi 'azza wa jall.

Translation: So Zubayr heard about that (incident) while he was eleven years old, so he went out carrying a sword and approached the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم. The Prophet asked, "What is your intention?" Zubayr replied, "I wanted to strike the one who took you (hostage)." The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم invoked blessings upon him and his sword, and it was the first sword to be consecrated in the way of Allah Almighty.
hi: To Zubair (RA) ne yeh (jhooti khabar) suni jabke woh gyaarah (11) saal ke the, to woh nangi talwaar liye nikle yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) ke saamne khade huay, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Mera iraada tha ke jisne bhi aapko pakda hai usse maaroon." To Nabi (SAW) ne unke aur unki talwaar ke liye dua ki, aur yeh Allah, buzurg aur buland, ki raah mein khinchi jaane wali pehli talwaar thi.

e: [AI] On the authority of Abu Mu'awiya al-Bajali, who is Ammar al-Duhani, on the authority of Sa'id ibn Jubair, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, on the authority of Ali, who said: "The first battle in Islam was the Battle of Badr. We only had two horses with us, one for Zubayr and one for al-Miqdad." As stipulated by al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Islam ki pehli jung Badr thi, humare paas sirf do ghode the, aik Zubair (RA) ka aur aik Miqdad (RA) ka." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] By Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  never participated in a battle or expedition without me being present.
hi: "Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) kabhi kisi jung ya dasty (chhoti fauj) ke liye nahi nikle magar main usme shaamil hota tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] On the day of Badr, Zubayr ibn al-Awam had a yellow turban wrapped around his head, which he wore proudly. The angels came down upon them wearing yellow turbans as well.
hi: "Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) par Badr ke din aik peela pagdi thi jo unhone lapet rakhi thi, to farishtay bhi peeli pagdiyaan pehnkar utre."

e: [AI] The inheritance of Zubair ibn Al-Awwam was divided into forty thousand million dirhams.
hi: "Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) ki miraas chalis hazaar hazaar (40 million) dirham par taqseem ki gayi."

e: [AI] "The inheritance of Zubair was divided into forty million dirhams."
hi: "Zubair (RA) ki miraas chalis hazaar hazaar (40 million) dirham par taqseem ki gayi."

e: [AI] Tell me about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  until I can speak about you, for every companion's son speaks about his father.
