He said: "O my son, there is no one who accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with companionship except that I have also accompanied him with the same or better companionship. And you should know that your mother, Asma' bint Abi Bakr, used to serve me. And your aunt, Aishah bint Abi Bakr, is also your aunt. And you should know that my mother is Safiyyah bint 'Abd al-Muttalib, and my uncles are Hamzah ibn 'Abd al-Muttalib, Abu Talib, and 'Abbas. And that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is the son of my aunt. And you should know that my paternal aunt, Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, used to serve her. And her daughter, Fatimah, is the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . And you should know that Khadijah is the mother of her mother, Habeedah bint Asad ibn 'Abd al-'Uzza. And you should know that the mother of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is Aminah bint Wahb ibn 'Abd Manaf ibn Zuhrah. And I have accompanied him with the best companionship, and praise be to Allah. And I heard him say, 'Whoever attributes to me what I did not say should take his place in hellfire.' " The Dhahabi remained silent about this summary.
hi: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein bataayen taake main aapke baare mein baat kar sakoon, kyunke har sahabi ka beta apne waalid ke baare mein baat karta hai." Unhone kaha: "Aye mere bete, koi bhi shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jaisi sohbat rakhta tha, maine bhi waisi hi ya usse behtar sohbat rakhi hai, aur tumhein maloom hai ke tumhari maa Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) meri biwi thin, aur tumhari khaala Aisha bint Abi Bakr (RA) hain, aur tumhein maloom hai ke meri maa Safiyyah bint Abdul Muttalib (RA) thin, aur mere maamu Hamzah bin Abdul Muttalib (RA), Abu Talib, aur Abbas (RA) hain, aur Rasulullah (SAW) mere maamu ke bete hain, aur tumhein maloom hai ke meri phupi Khadijah bint Khuwailid (RA) unki (Rasulullah SAW ki) biwi thin, aur unki beti Fatimah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti hain, aur tumhein maloom hai ke Khadijah (RA) ki naani Habeebah bint Asad thin, aur tumhein maloom hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ki waalida Aminah bint Wahb bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah thin, aur maine unki sath se sath behtareen sohbat rakhi hai, aur sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, aur maine unhein farmate suna: 'Jo koi mere baare mein woh baat kahe jo maine nahi kahi, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, every prophet has a disciple, and my disciple is Al-Zubair." It was said to him, "O Abu Abdullah, do you know if the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said this to someone other than you?" He replied, "No, by Allah, I do not know. It is authentic according to the criteria of the two Sheikhs (referring to Bukhari and Muslim) and they did not mention it in this context."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak har Nabi ka aik Hawari (khaas qareebi saathi) hota hai, aur mera Hawari Zubair hai." To unse (Zubair se) poocha gaya: "Aye Abu Abdullah, kya aap jaante hain ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh baat aapke siwa kisi aur ke liye bhi kahi?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise isi tarah nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Zubayr ibn al-Awwam passed by a gathering of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Hassaan recited poetry to them while they were not paying much attention. Zubayr sat with them and said, "Why do I see you not giving more attention to the poetry of Ibn al-Furai'ah? The Prophet ﷺ  used to appreciate it, listen to it carefully, and generously reward him for it. He would not be distracted from it by anything." Hassaan replied, "He stood by the Prophet's covenant and his guidance. His words matched his actions. He was a loyal advocate for the truth, the most famous knight and warrior who would lead battles. Even if he was from a noble lineage and his mother was Safiyyah, he would not be protected from the Messenger of Allah's nearness. He was also a supporter of Islam, a source of honor and glory. How many hardships did Zubayr endure and how many battles did he fight for the sake of the chosen one? Allah rewards abundantly when hardships are revealed. He hastens towards death with noble and courageous readiness. There is no match for him among them, nor was there before him. As long as you continue to praise him, it is better than any worldly gain. Your actions, O son of Hashim, are superior."
hi: Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ki aik majlis se guzre jabke Hassaan (RA) unhein apna shi'r suna rahe the, aur woh log usse sunne mein khaas dilchaspi nahi le rahe the, to Zubair (RA) unke sath baith gaye aur kaha: "Mujhe kya hua ke main tumhein dekh raha houn ke Ibn Al-Furai'ah (Hassaan) ka shi'r sunne mein tumhari ijaazat nahi hai, jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne isse pesh karte the, aur aap (SAW) usse achhi tarah sunte, uspar bhaari sawaab dete, aur kisi cheez ki wajah se usse mashghool nahi hote the." To Hassaan (RA) ne kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Nabi (SAW) ke ahd aur unki hidayat par qaayam rahe unke Hawari, aur baat amal ke barabar hoti hai, unke raaste aur tareeke par qaayam rahe, madad karte hain, aur haq mera doost hai, aur haq sabse mautadil hai, woh maroof ghudsawaar aur bahaadur hain jo tootnay wale din mein hamla karte hain, agar kisi aadmi ki maa Safiyyah ho aur uske ghar mein Asad (qabile) se koi khoobsurat ho, to unhein Rasulullah (SAW) se qareebi rishta hai aur Islam ki nusrat mein azeem izzat hai, kitni museebaton se Zubair (RA) ne apni talwaar se Mustafa (SAW) ki hifaazat ki, aur Allah deta hai to bharpoor deta hai, jab jung apni pindli khol deti hai, to woh usse safed (chamakti) talwaar se bhar dete hain jo maut ki taraf sabqat rakhti hai aur shaan se chalti hai, unme koi unke jaisa nahi tha aur na unse pehle koi tha, aur na zamana aisa laayega jab tak Zhabl (pahaad) qaayam hai, aapki tareef kayi logon ke amal se behtar hai, aur aapka amal, Aye Hashimi khaandaan ke bete, sabse behtareen hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: Appoint a successor. He said: Are they suggesting that? He said: Yes. He said: Who are they suggesting? The man kept quiet. Then another man entered upon him and said something similar to what the first man said, and he gave the same response. Then ʿUthman ؓ said: Are they suggesting az-Zubair? He said: Yes. He said. By the One in whose hand is my soul, indeed he is the best among them as far as I know, and the most beloved of them to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . ‘Abdullah told us: Suwaid told us: ʿ Ali bin Mus-hir told us similar report, with his isnad. (Using translation from Aḥmad 455)
hi: Uthman (RA) ko naak se khoon aane ki bimari lagi, us saal jise 'Sana-tur-Ru'aaf' (naak-khoon ka saal) kaha jaata hai, yahan tak ke unhone wasiyat ki aur Hajj se peeche reh gaye. To Quraish ka aik aadmi humare paas dakhil hua aur kaha: "Apna khalifa muqarrar kar dein." Unhone poocha: "Kya logon ne yeh kaha hai?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone poocha: "Aur woh kaun hai?" To woh khaamosh ho gaya. Phir aik aur unke paas dakhil hua aur kaha: "Apna khalifa muqarrar kar dein," aur waisi hi baat ki jaisi pehle wale ne ki, to Uthman (RA) ne poocha: "Zubair?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." To Uthman (RA) ne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, jahan tak mujhe pata hai, woh unme se behtareen aur Rasulullah (SAW) ko sabse zyada aziz hain."

e: 'Aisha said to me: Your fathers (Zubair and Abu Bakr) were amongst those about whom (it has been revealed):" Those who responded to the call of Allah and His Messenger after the misfortune had fallen upon them." (Using translation from Muslim 2418c)
hi: Aisha (RA) ne mujhse kaha: "Aye mere bete, tumhare waalid un logon mein se hain jinhone zakhmi honay ke baad bhi Allah aur Rasool ki pukaar ka jawaab diya."

e: [AI] I heard with my ears from the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  saying, "Talha and Zubair are my neighbors in Paradise."
hi: Meri kaan ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke mun se suna, aap (SAW) farma rahe the: "Talhah aur Zubair Jannat mein mere padosi hain."

e: [AI] From Nu'aym Al-Aziz, from Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri, that he said: "Do not curse the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , for their expiation is to be killed."
hi: Nubaih Al-Anazi se, Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri (RA) ke hawaale se, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke Hawariyeen ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunke unki gustaakhi ka kaffaarah sirf qatl hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, sent me on a cold morning. So I came to him and he was with some of his wives under his blanket. He admitted me into the blanket, and we became three."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe aik thandi subah bheja, main unke paas aaya, to woh apni kisi biwi ke sath apni chaadar mein the, unhone mujhe bhi chaadar mein le liya, to hum teen ho gaye."

e: A man disputed with az-Zubayr about streamlets in the lava plain which was irrigated by them. The Ansari said: Release the water and let it run, but az-Zubayr refused. The Holy Prophet ﷺ said to az-Zubayr: Water (your ground), Zubayr, then let the water run to your neighbour. The Ansari then became angry and said: Messenger of Allah! it is because he is your cousin! Thereupon the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed colour and he said: Water (your ground), then keep back the water till it returns to the embankment. Az-Zubayr said: By Allah! I think this verse came down about that: "But no , by thy Lord! they can have no (real) faith, until they make thee judge....." (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3637)
hi: Ansar ke aik aadmi ne Harrah ki nehron ke maamle mein mujhpar (Zubair par) Rasulullah (SAW) se shikayat ki, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Zubair, paani do, phir apne padosi ki taraf chhod do." To Ansari ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kyunke yeh aapke chachazaad hain?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ka chehra badal gaya aur farmaya: "Aye Zubair, paani do, phir rok kar rakho yahan tak ke woh deewar tak pahunch jaaye, phir apne padosi ki taraf chhodo." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zubair ko unka poora haq dilwaaya, to Zubair ne kaha: "Mera khayaal hai ke yeh aayat mere jhagde ke baare mein nazil hui: {Nahi, aapke Rab ki qasam, woh imaan nahi laate jab tak woh aapko apne jhagdon mein faisla-kun na maan lein} (Surah An-Nisa 65)."

e: [AI] When it was the day of the Battle of Camel, Zubayr called his son Abdullah, and advised him, saying, "O my son, indeed, this is a day in which either an oppressor or an oppressed person will be killed. By Allah, if I kill someone, it will be an oppressed person. By Allah, I have never done anything like this before. O my son, consider my religion, for I never prioritize anything over it. It is worth more than a thousand thousand and two hundred thousand." Adh-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Jab Jamal (Camel) ki jung ka din hua, to Zubair (RA) ne apne bete Abdullah ko bulaaya aur unhein wasiyat ki, farmaya: "Aye mere bete, yeh aisa din hai jismein zaroor koi zaalim ya mazloom qatl kiya jaayega, Allah ki qasam, agar main kisi ko qatl karunga, to woh mazloom ko qatl karunga, Allah ki qasam, maine yeh (fitna wali harkat) nahi ki, aur na maine woh kiya, Aye mere bete, mere deen ka khayaal rakhna, kyunke main iske siwa kisi aur cheez ki zyada fikr nahi karta, aur woh (mera qarz) hazaar hazaar aur do sau hazaar (12,00,000) hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Zubayr retreated on the Day of the Battle of the Camel in defeat, and then Ibn Jurmooz, a man from the tribe of Banu Tamim, caught up with him and killed him."
hi: "Zubair (RA) Jamal ke din shikast khaakar mudh gaye, to Ibn Jurmooz, Banu Tameem ka aik aadmi, unhein aa pahuncha aur unhein qatl kar diya."

e: [AI] When Zubayr left on the day of the Battle of the Camel, he said, "I know if my knowledge were of any benefit, life would be close to death." Then it did not occur to him that he would be killed by Ibn Jurumuz.
hi: Jab Zubair (RA) Jamal ke din wapas mudhe, to woh kehne lage (bahr Al-Kaamil mein): "Beshak mujhe pata hai, agar mera ilm mujhe faayda deta, ke zindagi maut se qareeb hai." Phir thodi hi der baad Ibn Jurmooz ne unhein qatl kar diya.

e: [AI] I heard Al-Fadl ibn Dakin saying, "Talha and Zubair ibn Al-Awam were killed in the month of Rajab in the year sixty-three."
hi: "Talhah (RA) aur Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) Rajab, chhattees (36) hijri mein, qatl kiye gaye."

e: [AI] From his elders, they said that Al-Zubayr went out on the day of Al-Jamal, which was on Thursday, of the tenth of Jumada Al-Akhirah of this year, after the incident (the Battle of Basra), riding a horse called Dhul-Khimar, heading towards Al-Madinah. He was killed in the valley of As-Siba' and buried there. It is mentioned by Urwah bin Al-Zubayr who said, "My father was killed on the day of Al-Jamal, and he was over sixty-four years old."
hi: Unke buzurgon se, unhone kaha: "Zubair (RA) Jamal ke din nikle, aur yeh Jumeraat (Thursday) ka din tha, us saal ki Jumada-al-Aakhirah ki das (10) taareekh, jung ke baad, aik ghode par jise Zul-Khimaar kaha jaata tha, Madinah ki taraf ja rahe the, to woh Wadi As-Sibaa' mein qatl kiye gaye aur wahin dafan kiye gaye," aur Urwah bin Zubair (RA) se zikr kiya gaya, unhone kaha: "Mere waalid Jamal ke din qatl kiye gaye, jabke unki umr saath (60) se chaar (4) saal zyada thi."

e: [AI] "Zubair approached his attacker while having overcome him and said, 'I remind you of Allah.' Zubair then refrained from harming him, repeatedly reminding him of Allah. However, when the attacker betrayed Zubair and struck him, Zubair said, 'May Allah fight against you. You remind me of Allah and then forget about Him.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this incident in his summary."
hi: Zubair (RA) apne qaatil ki taraf mudhe jabke unhone usse qaaboo mein kar liya tha, to usne kaha: "Main tumhein Allah ki qasam dilaata houn." To Zubair (RA) ne usse chhod diya, yahan tak ke usne yeh kayi baar kiya, jab usne dhoka diya aur Zubair (RA) ko maara, to Zubair (RA) ne kaha: "Allah tumhein maare, tum mujhe Allah ki qasam dilaate ho, phir usse bhool jaate ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Al-Dhahabi in summarization."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "Ali, do you remember the day when you and I were in the gathering of a group of Ansar in the courtyard? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked you, 'Do you love him?' You replied, 'What prevents me from loving him?' He said, 'Verily, you will fight against him and be unjust to him.' The narration from Al-Zubayr ends here and it has multiple meanings."
hi: Ali (RA) ne Zubair (RA) se kaha: "Kya tumhein yaad hai jab main aur tum Ansar ke kisi qabile ke chhaajje (saqeefah) mein baithe the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumse poocha: kya tum ise (Ali ko) pasand karte ho? Tumne kaha: mujhe kis cheez ne rokna chahiye? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: khabardaar, tum iske khilaaf nikaloge aur isse jung karoge, jabke tum zaalim (na-insaaf karne wale) hoge." Unhone kaha: to Zubair (RA) wapas mudh gaye. Is hadith mein ghor karne ki zaroorat hai (iski sihat par sawaal hai).

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "You fight against him while you are the oppressor." Then, he said, "I don't remember." Then, Al-Zubair departed.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Tum isse jung karoge jabke tum iske haq mein zaalim (na-insaaf karne wale) hoge." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe yaad nahi." Phir Zubair (RA) wapas mudh gaye.

e: [AI] I witnessed Ali and Zubair when Zubair returned riding his mount and splitting the ranks. His son Abdullah approached him and said, "What's wrong with you?" He replied, "Ali reminded me of something I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that you will fight him while being unjust to him. So I will not fight him." Abdullah asked, "But did you come here to fight? You only came to reconcile the people, and Allah will reconcile this matter through you." Zubair said, "I swore not to fight." Abdullah said, "Then free your servant Girgis and wait until you reconcile the people." Zubair freed his servant Girgis and remained standing. The people disagreed, so he left on his horse. It has been narrated that Zubair acknowledged this to Ali, without these details and narrations.
hi: Maine Ali (RA) aur Zubair (RA) ko dekha, jab Zubair (RA) apni sawaari par safon ko cheerte huay wapas mudhe, to unke bete Abdullah unke saamne aaye aur poocha: "Aapko kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Ali ne mujhe aik hadith yaad dilaayi jo maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suni thi, aap (SAW) farmate the: tum zaroor isse jung karoge jabke tum iske haq mein zaalim hoge, isliye main isse jung nahi karunga." Unhone (Abdullah ne) poocha: "Kya aap jung ke liye aaye the? Aap to logon mein sulah karwaane aaye the, aur Allah aapke zariye yeh maamla theek karega." Unhone (Zubair ne) kaha: "Maine qasam khaayi hai ke main jung nahi karunga." Unhone (Abdullah ne) kaha: "To apne ghulam Jirjis ko aazaad kar dein aur ruk jaayein yahan tak ke aap logon mein sulah karwaayein." Unhone kaha: to unhone apne ghulam Jirjis ko aazaad kiya aur ruk gaye, phir logon ke maamlaat mein ikhtilaaf ho gaya, to woh apne ghode par (wahan se) chale gaye. Aur Zubair (RA) ka Ali (RA) ke saamne isi baat ka iqraar doosri suraton aur riwayaton se bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai.

e: [AI] I heard Ali and Zubayr, and Ali said to him, "I am going to recite to you by Allah, O Zubayr, have you not heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'You fight against me while you are unjust to me?" He replied, "Yes, but I forgot."
hi: Maine Ali (RA) aur Zubair (RA) ko suna, Ali unse keh rahe the: "Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta houn, Aye Zubair, kya tumne Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate nahi suna: beshak tum mujhse jung karoge jabke tum mere haq mein zaalim hoge?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, lekin main bhool gaya tha."

e: [AI] I heard Ali while he was admonishing Zubayr, saying to him, "I adjure you by Allah, O Zubayr! Haven't you heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'You are fighting against me while you are [acting as] unjust [towards me]'?" He replied, "Yes, but I forgot."
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko suna jabke woh Zubair (RA) ko qasam de rahe the, keh rahe the: "Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta houn, Aye Zubair, kya tumne Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate nahi suna: beshak tum mujhse jung karoge jabke tum mere haq mein zaalim ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, lekin main bhool gaya."

e: [AI] We were with Ali when Ibn Jurmuz came to seek permission from him. Ali said, "Do you intend to kill the son of Safiyyah to show off?" Grant him permission and give him glad tidings of Hell. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Every prophet has a disciple, and indeed Zubair is my disciple, and the son of my cousin."
hi: Hum Ali (RA) ke paas the ke Ibn Jurmooz aaya unse ijaazat maangne, to Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Kya tum Safiyyah (RA) ke bete ko fakhr ke taur par qatl karoge? Unhein ijaazat do aur unhein Jahannam ki khush-khabri suna do." Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Har Nabi ka aik Hawari (khaas qareebi saathi) hota hai, aur Zubair mera Hawari aur meri phupi ka beta hai."

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Every prophet has a disciple, and my disciple is Al-Zubayr.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Har Nabi ka aik Hawari hota hai, aur mera Hawari Zubair hai."

e: [AI] I was sitting with Ali when the head of Zubayr was brought to him, along with his killer. Ali said to the executioner, "Inform the killer of Ibn Safiyyah that he will be punished by fire. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Every prophet has a disciple, and for sure, the disciple of the Prophet is Zubayr.'" These narrations are authentic from the Commander of the Believers, Ali, even if they are not traced back to these chains of narrators. These are sound narrations.
hi: Main Ali (RA) ke paas baitha tha ke Zubair (RA) ka sar unke paas laaya gaya, unke sath unka qaatil bhi tha, to Ali (RA) ne darwaaze par khade shakhs se kaha: "Safiyyah (RA) ke bete ke qaatil ko Jahannam ki khush-khabri suna do, maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: har Nabi ka aik Hawari hota hai, aur mera Hawari Zubair hai." Yeh ahadith Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali (RA) se sahih hain, agarche dono ne inhein isi isnad ke sath nahi nikaala, yeh sahih ahadith hain.

e: [AI] Ibrahim remained silent about the statement "because they were born in the same year" in Golden’s summary.
hi: Ibrahim (ne kaha): "Kyunke woh dono aik hi saal mein paida huay the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "About him, Al-Dhahabi in summary."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] Talhah ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Uthman ibn Amr ibn Ka'b ibn Sa'd ibn Taym ibn Murrah was in Sham and spoke to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about his arrow. The Messenger ﷺ  struck it with his own arrow, and Talhah asked, "And my reward, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "And your reward is like that of the Day of Badr."
hi: Talhah bin Ubaidullah bin Uthman bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Taim bin Murrah (RA) Sham mein the, to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se apne hisse (sahm) ke baare mein baat ki, to aap (SAW) ne unke liye unka hissa muqarrar kiya, to unhone poocha: "Aur mera ajr, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur tumhara ajr Badr ke din ke barabar hai."

e: [AI] "Umm Abi Bakr, Umm Uthman, Umm Talha, Umm Ammar bin Yasir, Umm Abdul Rahman bin Auf, Umm Zubair accepted Islam, as well as Saad and his mother while they were alive."
hi: "Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ki maa, Uthman (RA) ki maa, Talhah (RA) ki maa, Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ki maa, Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) ki maa, aur Zubair (RA) ki maa ne Islam qubool kiya, aur Sa'd (RA) aur unki maa dono zinda rehte huay Islam qubool kiya."

e: [AI] Talha bin Ubaidullah bin Uthman bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Saad bin Tamim bin Murrah came from Sham (Syria) after the Prophet peace be upon him returned from the Battle of Badr. He spoke to the Prophet peace be upon him about his arrow, and the Prophet peace be upon him said to him, "You have your arrow." He said, "And what about your reward, O Messenger of Allah?" The Prophet peace be upon him said, "And you have your reward."
hi: Talhah bin Ubaidullah bin Uthman bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Tameem bin Murrah (RA) Sham se aaye jab Nabi (SAW) Badr se wapas aa chuke the, to unhone Nabi (SAW) se apne hisse ke baare mein baat ki, to Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Tumhara hissa tumhara hai." Unhone poocha: "Aur mera ajr, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur tumhara ajr tumhara hai."

e:
[AI] The translation is as follows:

"This is the month when the son of Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib, Muhammad, the last of the prophets, would leave the sanctuary, migrate to a cluster of palm trees, a valley, and swim. Beware of going ahead of him," Talha said. When he said this, it hit my heart, so I hurriedly left until I reached Makkah. I asked, "Has anything happened?" They said, "Yes, Muhammad ibn Abdullah, the trustworthy, has prophesied, and Ibn Abi Quhafa has followed him." I left until I entered upon Abu Bakr and asked, "Have you followed this man?" He replied, "Yes, so set out to meet him and join him, for he calls to the truth." Talha informed him of what the hermit had said. Abu Bakr came with Talha and entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and then Talha accepted Islam and informed the Prophet of what the hermit had said. The Prophet explained it to him. When Abu Bakr and Talha embraced Islam, Nawfal ibn Khuwaylid ibn Al-Adawiyyah took hold of them with one rope, and the sons of Taim did not prevent him. Nawfal ibn Khuwaylid was called Ashadd Quraish (the harshest of the Quraish) because of this incident, and that is why Abu Bakr and Talha were known as Al-Qariniyin (the two Caravan Leaders). Talha did not participate in the Battle of Badr because he was with the Prophet and Sa'id ibn Zaid, spying on the movements of the caravan. When they returned, the Prophet had already finished fighting the polytheists. They met him in a shaded area, Munthah, near the valley of Badr, while he was returning from the battle. However, he witnessed Uhud and other events with the Prophet. He was one of those who stood firm with the Prophet on the Day of Uhud, when the people left him and pledged allegiance to him even until death. Malik ibn Zuhayr threw a spear at the Prophet that day, and Talha protected him with his hand. His little finger was injured, so he said, "Ouch, ouch," when he was struck by the spear. Talha mentioned that the Prophet had said, "If he had said 'Bismillah', he would have entered Paradise while people were watching." On that day, Talha was struck on the head with a severe blow by a polytheist. The blow was delivered twice while Talha was facing him, and one blow while he turned his back. Dhirar ibn Al-Khattab Al-Fihri used to say, 'By Allah, I struck him that day.'"
hi: ...Abdullah bin Abdul Muttalib ke bete (Muhammad SAW) ka, yeh unka woh mahina hai jismein woh (Makkah se) nikalenge, aur woh Ambiya ke aakhri hain, unka nikalna Haram se hoga, aur unki hijrat kisi khajoor waale, patthareeli zameen waale, aur tairne waale ilaaqe ki taraf hogi, isliye khabardaar tum kisi se peeche na reh jaana (unse pehle na pahunchne diya jaana)." Talhah ne kaha: to yeh baat meri dil mein baith gayi, main jaldi nikla yahan tak ke Makkah pahuncha, maine poocha: "Kya koi naya waaqia hua hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, Muhammad bin Abdullah, Al-Ameen (amaanatdaar), ne Nabuwwat ka dawa kiya hai, aur Ibn Abi Quhaafah unki pairavi kar rahe hain." Unhone kaha: to main gaya yahan tak ke Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas dakhil hua, maine poocha: "Kya aap is aadmi ki pairavi karte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, jaao aur unke paas dakhil ho jaao aur unki pairavi karo, kyunke woh haq ki taraf bulaate hain." To Talhah ne unhein woh bataya jo raahib ne kaha tha, phir Abu Bakr (RA) Talhah ko lekar nikle aur unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas lekar gaye, to Talhah ne Islam qubool kiya, aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko raahib ki baat bataayi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein iski tafseer batayi. Jab Abu Bakr (RA) aur Talhah ne Islam qubool kiya, to Naufal bin Khuwailid Al-Adawiyah ne unhein pakda aur unhein aik hi rassi mein baandh diya, aur Banu Taim ne unhein nahi bachaaya, aur Naufal bin Khuwailid ko 'Quraish ka sabse sakht (aadmi)' kaha jaata tha, isi liye Abu Bakr (RA) aur Talhah ko 'Al-Qareenain' (do bandhe huay saathi) kaha gaya. Talhah bin Ubaidullah ne Badr mein shirkat nahi ki, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein aur Sa'eed bin Zaid (RA) ko qaafile ki khabar jaasoosi ke liye bheja tha, to woh dono wapas aaye jabke Rasulullah (SAW) mushrikeen se jung se faarigh ho chuke the jinse unki mulaqaat hui thi, unhone unse Zulal aur Sabaalah ke darmiyan, Al-Mahjabah mein, mulaqaat ki, jabke aap (SAW) Badr se wapas aa rahe the, lekin unhone Uhud aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath doosre maidaanon mein shirkat ki, aur woh un logon mein se the jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath jame rahe Uhud ke din jab log peeth pher gaye, aur unhone maut tak baiyat ki, aur Malik bin Zuhair ne Rasulullah (SAW) par us din teer/nezaa chalaaya, to Talhah ne apne haath se Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre ki hifaazat ki, to unki chhoti ungli (khinsir) zakhmi ho gayi aur bekaar ho gayi, to unhone 'Hass, Hass' (dard ki aawaaz) kaha jab woh cheez unhein lagi, to zikr kiya gaya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar unhone Bismillah kaha hota, to log dekhte huay woh Jannat mein dakhil ho jaate." Aur Talhah ko us din unke sakht sar (khopdi) par zakhm laga, aik mushrik aadmi ne unhein do zarben lagaayin, aik zarab jab woh saamne the aur aik jab unhone mun pher liya, aur Dirar bin Al-Khattab Al-Fihri kehte the: "Allah ki qasam, maine hi unhein us din maara tha."

e: [AI] "Talha bin Ubaid Allah was killed, and in his possession were one million dirhams and two hundred thousand dirhams. His assets and properties were estimated to be worth thirty million dirhams. He was known to be generous with his wealth, clothing, and food. He was killed at the age of sixty-two."
hi: "Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA) qatl kiye gaye jabke unke khazaanchi ke haath mein dus laakh (1,200,000) dirham the, aur unke asal maal aur jaidaad ki qeemat tees hazaar hazaar (30 million) dirham lagaayi gayi, aur woh apne zikr ke mutaabiq, maal, kapde, aur khaane mein bohot saakhi the, aur woh jis din qatl kiye gaye, us waqt woh baasath (62) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] Al-Dhahabi on summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "We were fighting alongside Ali and Talha, and Marwan was with us. He said, 'We were defeated.' Marwan then said, 'I will not seek revenge on Talha any longer after today.' He shot him with an arrow and killed him." The Goldsmith remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Hum Ali (RA) ke sath the, Talhah (RA) ke khilaaf jung kar rahe the, aur humare sath Marwan the, hum shikast khaa gaye, to Marwan ne kaha: "Aaj ke baad main Talhah se apna badla nahi le paunga." Phir unhone unhein aik teer maara aur unhein qatl kar diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Naafi'un - Talhah ibn Ubaid Allah, Marwan ibn al-Hakam killed him."
hi: Naafi' (ne kaha): "Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA) ko Marwan bin Al-Hakam ne qatl kiya."

e: [AI] "He died."
hi: ...ke unka intiqaal ho gaya. Sahih.

e: [AI] "I entered upon the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and in his hand was a small pouch. He threw it towards me or he said, 'He tossed it to me' and said, 'Keep it, O Abu Muhammad, for it soothes the heart.'"
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil hua, aur unke haath mein aik saferjal (aik phal, quince) tha, unhone use mere taraf phenka, ya kaha unhone use mere taraf daala, aur farmaya: "Isse lo, Aye Abu Muhammad, kyunke yeh dil ko sukoon deta hai."

e: [AI] On the day of Al-Jamal, Ali called out to the people, saying, "Do not throw arrows at anyone, do not stab with spears, do not strike with swords, and do not seek out people, for the one who succeeds in this will indeed succeed on the Day of Resurrection." We agreed with him. Then the people said, "O Tharatis (referring to Ali), the son of Hanafiyyah is our leader in Rabwah, and he has the banner with him." Ali called out to him, saying, "O Commander of the Faithful!" He approached us, showing his face, and said, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, they call me Tharatis (referring to Ali). So Ali extended his hands and said, "O Allah, expose the killers of Uthman today with their faces." Then Zubayr said to the Asharis (his followers) who were with him, "Attack them with stones!" It seemed as if he wanted the fighting to break out. But when his companions saw this, they did not wait and they charged forward. Allah defeated them and Marwan bin Hakam shot an arrow at Talhah bin Ubaidullah, which grazed his leg and struck his horse. The horse held onto the arrow until it caught up to him, and then it slaughtered him. Then Marwan turned to Aban bin Uthman, who was with him, and said, "I have avenged one of your father's killers." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this incident in his summary.
hi: Jab Jamal ka din hua, to Ali (RA) ne logon mein pukaara: "Kisi par teer mat chalaao, kisi ko neze se mat chhedo, kisi par talwaar mat maaro, aur qaum ko peecha mat karo, kyunke yeh woh maqaam hai ke jo isme kaamyaab hoga woh Qayamat ke din bhi kaamyaab hoga." Unhone kaha: to humne aik doosre ka saamna kiya, phir qaum sab mil kar pukaarne lagi: "Aye Uthman (RA) ke khoon ka badla lene walo!" Unhone kaha: aur Ibn Al-Hanafiyyah (Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiyyah RA) humara jhandaa-bardaar tha, aik buland jagah par, jhanda unke paas tha, to Ali (RA) ne unhein pukaara, to woh humari taraf apna chehra dikhaate huay aaye, aur kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, yeh log Uthman (RA) ke khoon ka badla lene ki pukaar laga rahe hain." To Ali (RA) ne apne dono haath phailaaye aur kaha: "Aye Allah, Uthman ke qaatilon ko aaj unke apne chehron ke bal gira de." Phir Zubair (RA) ne apne sath waale Al-Asaawirah (aik khaas fauji dasty) se kaha: "Unpar teeron ki barsaat karo," aur goya unka iraada tha ke jung shuru ho jaaye, to jab unke saathiyon ne yeh dekha, to woh intezaar na kar sake aur hamla kar diya, to Allah ne unhein shikast di, aur Marwan bin Al-Hakam ne Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA) ko aik teer maara jisne unki pindli ko unke ghode ke pehlu ke sath chheda, to ghoda unhein lekar bhaaga yahan tak ke Marwan unhein pakad kar unhein zibah (qatl) kar diya, phir Marwan Abaan bin Uthman (RA) ki taraf mudhe, jo unke sath the, aur kaha: "Maine tumhare liye tumhare waalid ke aik qaatil se badla le liya hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Did you hear the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Whoever I am his master, then Ali is his master. O Allah, be a supporter of whoever supports him and an enemy of whoever opposes him"? He said, "Yes." He said, "Then why did you fight against me?" He said, "I did not remember." So Talha Al-Hasan, who is Al-Arni and is not trustworthy, turned away.
hi: "Kya tumne Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: jiska bhi main mawla (madadgaar/sarparast) houn, Ali uska mawla hai, Aye Allah, jo unse mohabbat kare usse mohabbat kar, aur jo unse dushmani kare usse dushman samajh?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone poocha: "To tum mujhse jung kyun karte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe yaad nahi tha." Phir Talhah (RA) wapas mudh gaye. Al-Hasan Al-Arni bharosemand nahi hain.

e: [AI] "And I saw him and he loved gatherings, filling them with his presence, and he was stroking his beard with his hand. So I said to him, 'O Abu Muhammad, I see you and I love gatherings, especially when you are present, and you are stroking your beard. Would you dislike this today, so let it go, for no one would object to it?' He said, 'O Alqamah bin Waqqas, do not blame me. We used to be united against anyone other than us, but today they have divided into two opposing groups, and one of us attacks the other. However, I was with Uthman in a matter that I do not see its expiation except through shedding my blood in seeking his blood.' I asked, 'Then why don't you leave him, especially since you have young children? Leave him, for if it becomes a matter of inheritance, it will be your responsibility.' He said, 'He knows better. I dislike seeing anyone have ill intention in this matter, so I defend him.' So I spoke to Muhammad bin Talha about his negligence, and he said, 'I dislike asking the messenger of Allah about Abi Sinan's chain of narration.'"
hi: Aur maine unhein dekha, aur unhein sabse pasandeeda woh majlis lagti thi jo khaali ho, aur woh apni daadhi apne seene par maar rahe the, to maine unse kaha: "Aye Abu Muhammad, main dekh raha houn aapko sabse pasandeeda woh majlis lagti hai jo khaali ho, aur aap apni daadhi apne seene par maar rahe hain, kya aap aaj ke din ko napasand karte hain? To ise chhod dein, koi aapko iske liye majboor nahi karta." Unhone kaha: "Aye Alqamah bin Waqqas, mujhe malaamat mat karo, hum sab aik hi haath the un logon ke khilaaf jo humare siwa the, phir aaj woh do pahaad ban gaye hain, aik doosre ki taraf ghisatte huay, lekin mujhse Uthman (RA) ke maamle mein aisi baat hui hai jiska kaffaarah (badla) mujhe sirf yeh lagta hai ke unke khoon ke badle mein mera khoon bhi bahaaya jaaye." Maine kaha: "To Muhammad bin Talhah ko kyun nahi bhejte, aapke paas to choti aulaad hai, ise (jung ko) chhod dein, agar koi baat aapke peeche aapke waaris ke liye reh jaaye to?" Unhone kaha: "Woh behtar jaanta hai, mujhe napasand hai ke main kisi ko is maamle mein niyat rakhte dekhoon aur usse rok doon." To maine Muhammad bin Talhah (RA) se peeche reh jaane ke baare mein baat ki, unhone kaha: "Mujhe napasand hai ke main apne waalid ke baare mein (aisi) baat poochoon." Isnad achha hai.

e:
[AI] Talhah was one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . He had four sons, who were present with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ : Zakariyya, Yusuf, Aisha, and Zaynab. Aisha was the daughter of Abu Bakr, and her sister, Umm Kulthum, was married to Talhah. Talhah's wife, Hamnah bint Jahsh, gave birth to his son Muhammad, who was killed on the Day of Camel along with his father. 
There were other women who were closely related to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  and were also under the guardianship of Talhah. These women were: Habiba bint Abu Sufyan, her sister Rufayrah bint Abu Sufyan, and Umm Salamah bint Abu Umamah. Talhah's sister, Quraibah bint Abu Umamah, also lived under his guardianship. Talhah's wife, Mariam bint Talhah, was also present but the narration does not provide any further details on her. This information was not included in the summary by Adh-Dhahabi.
hi: Talhah Nabi (SAW) ke chaar (rishton) mein 'Salaf' (behnon se shaadi karne wale saathi) the: Aisha (RA) bint Abi Bakr Nabi (SAW) ke nikah mein thin, aur unki behn Umm Kulthum bint Abi Bakr (RA) Talhah ke nikah mein thin, unhone unke liye Zakariyya, Yusuf, aur Aisha ko janam diya. Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke nikah mein thin, aur Hamnah bint Jahsh (RA) Talhah bin Ubaidullah ke nikah mein thin, unhone unke liye Muhammad ko janam diya, jo Jamal ke din apne waalid ke sath qatl kiye gaye. Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke nikah mein thin, aur unki behn Ar-Rafee'ah bint Abi Sufyan (RA) Talhah bin Ubaidullah ke nikah mein thin. Umm Salamah bint Abi Umayyah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke nikah mein thin, aur unki behn Qareebah bint Abi Umayyah (RA) Talhah bin Ubaidullah ke nikah mein thin, unhone unke liye Maryam bint Talhah ko janam diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Ali sat on Talhah's (camel) on the day of the Battle of the Camel, and wiped the dust off his head. Then, he turned to Al-Hasan ibn Ali and said, 'I wish that I had died thirty years before this.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: Ali (RA) ne Jamal ke din Talhah (RA) ko apni god mein liya, unke sar se mitti saaf ki, phir Hasan bin Ali (RA) ki taraf mudhe aur kaha: "Kaash main iske tees (30) saal pehle mar jaata." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] On the day of the camels, when he saw the dead bodies and the severed heads, he exclaimed, "O Hasan, what good can be expected after this?" He replied, "I forbade you from engaging in this before we entered it." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Jamal ke din, jab unhone maqtoolon aur girte huay saron ko dekha, (Ali ne kaha): "Aye Hasan, iske baad kaunsi bhalaai ki ummeed rakhi ja sakti hai?" Unhone (Hasan ne) kaha: "Maine aapko isse pehle hi rok diya tha, isme dakhil honay se pehle." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Al-Dhahabi on summarizing.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] The poet [Al-Bahr al-Tawil] was a young man who used to bring him wealth from his friend whenever he became impoverished, and poverty would distance itself from him as if riches were attached to his forehead and his cheeks were adorned with poetry, and at the end, there was the full moon.
hi: Shaayar ne kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Aik jawaan jise maal-daari apne dost ke qareeb laati jab woh khushaal hota, aur ghurbat use door kar deti, goya Thurayya (Pleiades) unki peshaani mein latki ho, aur unke gaal mein Shi'ra (sitara), aur doosre gaal mein poora chaand."

e: [AI] It was as if the moon was asking, "Who are you?" So I said, "I am from the companions of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali." Then he said, "Extend your hand so that I may pledge allegiance to you." So I extended my hand and he pledged allegiance to me. His soul overflowed with joy, so I went to Ali and informed him of Talhah's statement. Ali said, "Allah is greater! Allah is greater! The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, spoke the truth. Allah refuses that Talhah enters paradise except with my pledge of allegiance on his neck." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Jaise chaand ho, tum kiske ho? Maine kaha: 'Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali (RA) ke sahaba mein se.' Unhone kaha: 'Apna haath phailaao, main tumse baiyat karunga.' To maine apna haath phailaaya aur unhone mujhse baiyat ki, phir unki jaan nikal gayi. Main Ali (RA) ke paas aaya aur unhein Talhah (RA) ki baat bataayi, to unhone kaha: "Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Rasulullah (SAW) ne sach farmaaya, Allah ne inkaar kiya hai ke Talhah Jannat mein dakhil ho magar meri baiyat unki gardan mein ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "On the Day of Uhud, the Prophet ﷺ wore two coats of mail. He tried to get up on a boulder but was not able to, so Talhah squatted under him, lifting the Prophet ﷺ upon it such that he could sit on the boulder. So he said: (Paradise) "It is obligated from Talhah.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1692)
hi: Nabi (SAW) par Uhud ke din do zirahein thin, to aap (SAW) chattaan ki taraf uthne lage magar na uth sake, to Talhah (RA) unke neeche baith gaye yahan tak ke aap (SAW) chattaan par theek se baith gaye. Zubair (RA) ne kaha: to maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Talhah ne (Jannat) waajib kar li." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Talhah has become obligated.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Talhah ne (Jannat) waajib kar li."

e: [AI] That Talhah slaughtered a sheep and dug a well on the day of Qarad, then fed and gave them water. The Prophet peace be upon him then said, "O Talhah Al-Fayyadh." Talhah was named Al-Fayyadh, a narration with a sound chain of transmission, but it was not mentioned in his collection.
hi: Beshak Talhah (RA) ne Dhi Qarad ke din aik oontni zibah ki aur aik kuaan khoda, phir unhein khilaaya aur pilaaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Talhah Al-Fayyaz (bakshish karne wale)." To Talhah Al-Fayyaz naam padh gaya. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named me on the day of Uhud as Talhah al-Khair, and in the Battle of al-Ashira as Talhah al-Fayyad, and on the day of Hunayn as Talhah al-Jawwad." Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe Uhud ke din Talhah Al-Khair (behtareen) naam diya, aur ghazwa-e-Ashirah mein Talhah Al-Fayyaz, aur Hunain ke din Talhah Al-Jawwaad (saakhi)." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When Muhammad ibn Talhah was born, the Prophet ﷺ came to us and said, "What have you named him?" We replied, "Muhammad." He said, "This is my name, and his nickname is Abu Al-Qasim."
hi: Jab Muhammad bin Talhah (RA) paida huay, to humne unhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya, aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumne unka naam kya rakha?" Humne kaha: 'Muhammad.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh mera naam hai, aur unki kunniyat Abu Al-Qasim hai." Abu Shaibah kamzor hain.

e: [AI] I heard Mus'ab Al-Zubayri saying that Muhammad ibn Talha ibn Ubaid Allah, his mother is Hamna bint Jahsh.
hi: Maine Mus'ab Az-Zubairi ko kehte suna: "Muhammad bin Talhah bin Ubaidullah ki maa Hamnah bint Jahsh (RA) thin."

e: [AI] "We surely belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. The offspring of Quraysh, by Allah." His father said to him, "What is it, O my son?" He replied, "Muhammad ibn Talhah." His father then said, "We surely belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. If what I have known is true, it is the loss of a righteous young man." Then he sat down, saddened and grieving.
hi: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon, Quraish ka bachcha, Allah ki qasam." To unke waalid ne unse poocha: 'Kya baat hai, Aye mere bete?' Unhone kaha: "Muhammad bin Talhah." Unhone (waalid ne) kaha: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon, agar jo maine jaana woh theek tha, to yeh aik neik jawaan tha." Phir woh gham aur udaasi mein baith gaye.

e: [AI] "And he said, 'Whoever sees the man with the black robe, do not kill him, meaning Muhammad.' So Muhammad said to Aisha that day, 'O mother, what do you command me?' She said, 'I think it is best for you, O son of Adam, to withhold your hand.' So he withheld his hand, and a man from the Banu Asad ibn Khuzaymah named Talhah ibn Mudlij from the Banu Munqidh ibn Tarif killed him. Some say Shaddad ibn Mu'awiya al-Abasi killed him, and others say it was Isam ibn Mis'ar al-Basri. There is much discussion about this, and it is the one who says in his killing [Al-Bahr Al-Tawil] and 'Ashath Qawwamin with the verses of his Lord are few in harms that people see as a Muslim. I aimed the spear at his back under his cloak, and he fell to the ground, lifeless, with both hands and mouth. I touched him with my teeth, and his shirt resisted me from the back of his stained clothes. You stood solidly against him in the rush of horses, an animal like a she-camel. I remember Hamma when I stabbed him, so why don't you recite Hamma before advancing against a non-follower, a sin other than that, except that he does not follow Ali, and one who does not follow the truth is unjust.' Then Ali said when he saw him lifeless, 'This blow was made by his head.'"
hi: Aur farmaya: "Jo bhi kaale burnus (topi) wale ko dekhe usse qatl na kare," matlab Muhammad. To Muhammad ne us din Aisha (RA) se poocha: 'Aye ammi, aap mujhe kya hukum deti hain?' Unhone kaha: "Mera khayaal hai ke tum Aadam ke behtareen bete ki tarah bano, ke tum apna haath rok lo." To unhone apna haath rok liya, phir Banu Asad bin Khuzaimah ke aik aadmi ne, jise Talhah bin Mudlij, Banu Munqidh bin Tareef se, kaha jaata tha, unhein qatl kar diya, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke Shaddad bin Mu'awiyah Al-Absi ne unhein qatl kiya, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai balke Isaam bin Mis'ar Al-Basri ne unhein qatl kiya, aur isi par sabse zyada riwayaten hain, aur wahi hain jo unke qatl ke baare mein kehte hain (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Aur (kitna) ghair-tarteeb-shuda (baal wala), Allah ki aayaton par qaayam rehne wala, logon ki nazar mein bahut kam taklif dene wala, Musalman tha, maine unhein apni chaadar ke neeche se neze se chheda, to woh gir pade, haathon aur mun ke bal, maine apne neze ki nok se unki qamees phaad di, aur unhein mudhle hue kinare se dhakel diya, maine unhein ghodon ki bhaagam-bhaag mein unki peeth seedhi rakhi, jaise kisi jaanwar ki peeth phaili hui, jab maine unhein maara to mujhe 'Ha-Meem' yaad dilaata hai, to kyun nahi unhone 'Ha-Meem' padha kisi aur par aage badhne se pehle, koi gunaah nahi siwaye is ke ke woh Ali ki pairavi nahi karte the, aur jo haq ki pairavi nahi karta woh zulm karta hai." Unhone kaha: to jab Ali ne unhein gira hua dekha, to kaha: "Isne unhein apni raay (sochi-samjhi marzi) se gira diya."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, I was the first to respond to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , along with Talha ibn Ubayd Allah. When the cold became intense and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was the most affected by it, he said to us, "Take care of your companion" referring to him. So we left him and approached him, and there was a napkin hanging from his cheek, and between it and the eastern direction was a man. I was the closest to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . It was Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah. I went to remove the napkin, but Abu Ubaydah said, "I swear to you by Allah, O Abu Bakr, don't abandon me." So I left it and he pulled it off. Then I went to remove the other ring, but Abu Ubaydah said to me the same thing, so he removed the other ring and the other napkin. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, your companion has attracted the attention or the demand of Talha." It is a sound saying according to the condition of Muslim, and they did not expel him, no, by Allah.
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) (ne kaha): main sabse pehla tha jo Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf palta, aur mere sath Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA) the, aur achaanak Talhah ko sardi ne itna pakda hua tha, jabke Rasulullah (SAW) unse zyada bheege huay the (paseene se ya khoon se), to Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: "Apne saathi ka khayaal rakho." To humne unhein chhod diya aur aap (SAW) ki taraf mutawajjeh huay, achaanak (aap ke) gaalon mein aik khod (helmet) atki hui thi, aur unke aur mashriq (poorab) ke darmiyan aik aadmi tha, main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sabse qareeb tha, achaanak woh Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah the, to main woh khod (ki kadi) nikaalne gaya, to Abu Ubaidah ne kaha: "Main tumhein Allah ki qasam deta houn, Aye Abu Bakr, kya aap mujhe chhod denge?" To maine unhein chhod diya, unhone use kheencha, to Abu Ubaidah ka aage ka daant nikal gaya. Unhone kaha: phir main doosri kadi nikaalne gaya, to Abu Ubaidah ne mujhse waisi hi baat kahi, to unhone doosri kadi bhi kheenchi, aur Abu Ubaidah ka doosra daant bhi nikal gaya. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhare saathi ne Talhah ki tarah (Jannat) waajib kar li hai ya haqdaar bana liya hai." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "I entered upon the Mother of the Believers, Aisha bint Talha, while she was saying to her mother Asma, 'I am better than you, and my father is better than your father.' So her mother started scolding her and saying, 'You are better than me?' Then the Mother of the Believers, Aisha, said, 'Should I not settle between you two?' Asma said, 'Yes.' She said, 'Indeed, Abu Bakr came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said, "O Abu Bakr, you are an emancipated slave of Allah from the Fire."' So since that day, he was called 'the emancipated one' and he was not called that before. Then Talhah ibn Ubaydullah entered and said, 'You, O Talhah, are one who settled his debt.'" (This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim, and it was not included in his compilation).
hi: Main Umm-ul-Momineen (Aisha RA) ke paas dakhil hui, aur Aisha bint Talhah apni maa Asma (RA) se keh rahi thin: 'Main aapse behtar houn, aur mere waalid aapke waalid se behtar hain.' To unki maa unhein daantne lagi aur kehne lagi: 'Tum mujhse behtar ho?' To Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha (RA) ne kaha: 'Kya main tum dono ke darmiyan faisla na karoon?' Unhone kaha: 'Zaroor.' Unhone kaha: 'Beshak Abu Bakr (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Aye Abu Bakr, tum Allah ki taraf se Jahannam se aazaad kiye huay ho.' Unhone kaha: to usi din se unhein 'Ateeq' (aazaad kiya hua) kaha jaane laga, aur isse pehle unhein 'Ateeq' nahi kaha jaata tha. Unhone kaha: phir Talhah bin Ubaidullah dakhil huay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum, Aye Talhah, un logon mein se ho jinhone apni zimmedaari poori kar li.'" Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever wants to see a walking martyr on the face of the earth, let him look at Talhah ibn Ubayd Allah." This is the narration attributed to Salat ibn Dinar, and it is not a requirement of this book (referring to the book in question) to establish the authenticity of this narration.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi zameen par chalte huay shaheed ko dekhna chaahe, woh Talhah bin Ubaidullah ko dekh le." Isse sirf As-Salt bin Dinar ne akele riwayat kiya hai, aur yeh is kitaab ki shart mein nahi hai. As-Salt kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says: 'And We have removed whatever malice may be in their hearts, [and we have made them] brothers on thrones facing each other.' (Surah Al-Hijr, verse 47) So he (the Prophet) said, 'O son of my brother, how is so-and-so? How is so-and-so?' He asked him about the mothers of his father's children. He said, 'We have not taken your lands this year except to prevent people from plundering them. O so-and-so, go with him to Banu Qurayzah and let him give you his share of this year's harvest, and let him give you back his land.' Then two men sitting on one side (said), one of them being Harith the blind, 'Allah is more just than that we should kill them and they become our brothers in Paradise.' He (the Prophet) said, 'A people who are farthest from the land of Allah, how could it be? If you have a need, come to us.'"
hi: Allah, buzurg aur buland, (farmata hai): "{Aur humne unke seenon mein se kina (dushmani) nikaal di, bhai bhai ban gaye, takhton par aamne-saamne baithe huay}" (Surah Al-Hijr 47). To unhone kaha: "Aye mere bhatije, fulaani kaisi hai? Fulaani kaisi hai?" Unhone kaha: aur unse apne waalid ki laundiyon (ma-e-abnaa) ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: phir kaha: "Humne is saal tumhari zameenein sirf iss darr se nahi li ke log unhein loot lein, Aye fulaan, unke sath Banu Quraizah jaao, unhein hukum do ke woh is saal ki paidaawar unhein den aur unki zameen unhein wapas karen." To aik taraf baithe do aadmiyon mein se aik, Al-Harith Al-A'war (aik aankh wale), ne kaha: 'Allah isse zyada insaaf-pasand hai ke hum unhein qatl karein aur woh Jannat mein humare bhai bhi hon.' Unhone kaha: "Aisi qaum jo Allah ki zameen se sabse door aur sabse alag ho, to woh kaun honge phir? Main aur Talhah nahi the, Aye mere bhatije, jab kabhi tumhein zaroorat ho, to humare paas aana."

e: [AI] "If he enters, he enters with strength, and if he exits, he exits with strength. The affairs of the hereafter have bewildered him, distancing him from his worldly affairs. It is as if he looks upon his Lord with his own eyes. Then, Az-Zubair ibn Al-Awwam proposed to her, but she refused. It was said to her, "Why?" She replied, "His wife does not point at him with her finger in her cloak." Then, Ali proposed to her, but she refused. It was said to her, "Why?" She replied, "His wife has no need of him for anything, she only fulfills her desires." Then, Talhah proposed to her and she said, "My husband has rights on me." They asked, "And how is that?" She replied, "I know his qualities. If he enters, he enters smiling, and if he exits, he exits laughing. If I ask, he gives, and if I am silent, he begins the conversation, and if I do something, he thanks me, and if I make a mistake, he forgives me." When he constructed the house, Ali said, "O Abu Muhammad, may I speak to Umm Aban?" He said, "Speak to her." So, he took her hand and said, "Peace be upon you, O noble soul." She replied, "And peace be upon you." He said, "The Commander of the Faithful proposed to you, but you refused." She said, "That is true." He said, "And Az-Zubair ibn Al-Awwam, the cousin of the Messenger of Allah, proposed to you, but you refused." She said, "That is true." He said, "And I proposed to you, and my close relatives from the Messenger of Allah, but you refused." She said, "That is true." He said, "By Allah, I have married you with the most handsome face and the most generous hands, who gives like this and like that."
hi: Agar woh dakhil hota, to takatwar hokar dakhil hota, aur agar nikalta, to takatwar hokar nikalta, unhein Aakhirat ki fikr ne duniya ki fikr se ghaafil kar diya tha, goya woh apni aankhon se apne Rab ko dekh rahe hon. Phir Zubair bin Al-Awwam (RA) ne unse (aik aurat se) nikah ka paighaam bheja, magar usne inkaar kiya, to usse poocha gaya: 'Kyun?' Usne kaha: 'Unki biwi ko unse apni zulfon mein bhi koi ishara karne ka haq nahi hai.' Phir Ali (RA) ne paighaam bheja, magar usne inkaar kiya, usse poocha gaya: 'Kyun?' Usne kaha: 'Unki biwi ko unse sirf apni zaroorat poori karne ka haq hai, aur woh kehte rehte hain aisa-waisa aur ho chuka.' Phir Talhah (RA) ne paighaam bheja, to usne kaha: 'Yeh sach mein mera shohar hai.' Log ne poocha: 'Woh kaise?' Usne kaha: 'Main unke akhlaaq ko jaanti houn, agar woh dakhil hote hain to hanste huay dakhil hote hain, aur agar nikalte hain to muskuraate huay nikalte hain, agar main maangoon to dete hain, agar main khaamosh rahoon to khud baat shuru karte hain, agar main kuch karoon to shukriya adaa karte hain, aur agar main koi gunaah karoon to maaf kar dete hain.' Jab unhone shaadi mukammal ki, to Ali (RA) ne kaha: 'Aye Abu Muhammad, agar aap ijaazat dein to main Umm Abaan se baat karoon?' Unhone kaha: 'Unse baat karein.' Unhone parde ka kinara pakda, phir kaha: 'Assalaamu Alaikum, Aye apni jaan ki aziz.' Usne kaha: 'Wa alaikumus salaam.' Unhone kaha: 'Ameer-ul-Momineen ne aapko rishta bheja tha, aapne inkaar kiya.' Usne kaha: 'Yeh hua tha.' Unhone kaha: 'Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki phupi ke bete aur unke aik Hawari, Zubair, ne aapko rishta bheja, aapne inkaar kiya.' Usne kaha: 'Yeh bhi hua tha.' Unhone kaha: 'Aur maine aapko rishta bheja, mera Rasulullah (SAW) se rishta hai, aapne inkaar kiya.' Usne kaha: 'Yeh bhi hua tha.' Unhone kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, aapne humme sabse achhe chehre wale aur sabse saakhi haath wale se shaadi ki hai, jo aise aur aise dete hain.'

e: [AI] Talha came to me, and I found him sad. So I said, "Why do I see you with a gloomy face? Is there something bothering you about our matter?" He said, "No, by Allah, nothing about your matter bothers me. And you are indeed a good companion. But I have gathered some wealth." She said, "Send to your family and people and distribute it among them." He did as she suggested. Then I asked the treasurer, "How much did he distribute?" He said, "Four hundred thousand, and its value was a thousand dirhams per day." They used to call Talha "Al-Fayyad". Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Talhah (RA) mere paas dakhil huay, maine unhein udaas paaya, to maine kaha: "Aapko kya hua, main aapko udaas chehre ke sath dekh rahi houn, kya humare kisi maamle ne aapko pareshaan kiya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, tumhare kisi maamle ne mujhe pareshaan nahi kiya, aur tum aik behtareen saathi ho, lekin mere paas maal jama ho gaya hai." Unhone kaha: "To apne ghar walon aur apni qaum ko bulaao aur unme taqseem kar do." Unhone kaha: to unhone aisa kiya, to maine khazaanchi se poocha: 'Kitna taqseem kiya?' Unhone kaha: 'Chaar sau hazaar (400,000), aur unki roz ki aamdani hazaar (1000) dirham thi.' Unhone kaha: aur unhein Talhah Al-Fayyaz kaha jaata tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When the war prepared for battle, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , Talhah, and Simak ibn Kharashah (Abu Dujanah) remained silent and did not speak. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, "I saw myself on the day of Uhud, and there was no creature on the earth closer to me than Jibril on my right and Talhah on my left." It was mentioned in a poem about that incident (Bahr Al-Taweel). On the day of Shu'ayb, Talhah felt sorrow for Muhammad during a difficult hour when things were tight for him. He protected him with his hands against spears, and his fingers were cut by the blades, but he did not fail. Talhah was the leader of the people after Muhammad, and he upheld the principles of Islam until they were firmly established.
hi: Jab jung khatam hui, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne fakhr se (Uhud ka waaqia) zikr kiya, jabke Talhah khaamosh the aur Simaak bin Kharashah, Abu Dujanah, bhi khaamosh the, kuch nahi bolte the, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine apne aap ko Uhud ke din dekha, zameen par mere qareeb koi makhlooq na thi siwaye Jibreel ke, jo mere daayen the, aur Talhah, jo mere baayen the." Iske baare mein aik shi'r kaha gaya (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Aur Talhah, Ash-Shi'b (ghaati) ke din, Muhammad ki madad ki, aik aisi ghadi mein jab unpar tangi aayi aur woh sakht ho gayi, unhone apne dono haathon se nezon ko roka, to unki ungliyaan nezon ke neeche kaat di gayin aur bekaar ho gayin, aur woh Muhammad ke baad logon ke imaam bane, Islam ki chakki qaayam rakhi yahan tak ke woh sthir ho gayi."

e: [AI] Hassan ibn Thabit stayed in Talahta, and he did not leave anyone. He stayed when the Prophet greeted, and when all the people left and they disappeared, protecting the Prophet's dwelling. The enemy approached him and he rejected them, covered in blood, fearing that they would say he sought revenge, they refrained.
hi: Hassaan bin Thabit (RA) ne Talhah (RA) ke baare mein shi'r kaha, aur kisi ko baahar nahi rakha (bahr Al-Munsarih mein): "Woh qaayam rahe jab Nabi (SAW) ne salaam kiya aur jab sab log peeth pherkar bhaage aur bikhar gaye, Nabi (SAW) ki jaan ki hifaazat karte rahe jabke dushman unke qareeb aa gaya tha aur unpar chadha, apni jaan ko khoon mein latpat karte rahe, is darr se ke kaha jaaye woh unka badla lene se mudh gaye."

e: [AI] I heard my father say, "I was wounded on the day of Uhud in every part of my body, even in my private parts."
hi: Maine apne waalid ko kehte suna: "Main Uhud ke din apne poore jism mein zakhmi hua, yahan tak ke apni sharam-gaah mein bhi." Isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] Regarding it, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "Qudamah bin Mazhun passed away in the year 36, at the age of 68, and he did not have any gray hair."
hi: "Qudamah bin Maz'oon (RA) ka intiqaal chhattees (36) hijri mein hua, jabke woh atthaasath (68) saal ke thay, aur woh apne safed baal nahi badalte the."

e: [AI] Hudayfah and his father were taken by the polytheists before the Battle of Badr, and they wanted to kill them. So, they swore an oath by Allah and made a pact that they would not assist the Muslims against them. They both swore to them, and they sent them. They came to the Prophet ﷺ  and informed him. He said, "We have already sworn to them. If you wish, you can fight alongside us." He replied, "We will fulfill our oath to them, and we will seek the help of Allah against them."
hi: Mushrikeen ne Hudhaifah (RA) aur unke waalid ko Badr se pehle pakda, aur unhein qatl karna chaahte the, to unhone unse Allah ka ahd aur mithaaq liya ke woh unke khilaaf koi madad nahi karenge, to dono ne unse qasam khaayi, to unhone unhein chhod diya. Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein bataaya, unhone kaha: "Humne unse qasam khaayi hai, isliye agar aap chaahein to hum aapke sath jung karenge." To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, hum unse kiya wa'da poora karenge, aur unke khilaaf Allah se madad maangenge."

e: [AI] Urwah, indeed Hudhayfah bin Al-Yaman was one of the Banu Abs and he was an ally among the Ansar. His father was killed alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of Uhud. The Muslims mistakenly took him for a polytheist, so Hudhayfah woke up and said, "My father, my father." They did not understand him until they killed him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then ordered that he be shrouded.
hi: Urwah (ne kaha): "Beshak Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman Banu Abs mein se aik the, aur woh Ansar mein ahd-waale the, unke waalid Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Uhud ke din qatl kiye gaye, Musalmano ne unhein pehchaanne mein ghalti ki us din aur unhein mushrikeen mein se samjha, to Hudhaifah pukaarte rahe: mere waalid, mere waalid, magar unhone samjha nahi yahan tak ke unhein qatl kar diya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne hukum diya, aur unki diyat (khoon-baha) ada ki gayi."

e: [AI] Because he was attacked by his people and spilled blood, he fled to the city and swore allegiance to the Bani Abd al-Ashhal, so his people called him al-Yaman because he swore allegiance to the Yemenis. Hudhayfah witnessed it along with his father Husayl and his brother Safwan at the Battle of Uhud. As for his father, he was killed by some Muslims that day, thinking he was one of the polytheists, so Hudhayfah gave his blood money to the Muslims. As for Hudhayfah, he witnessed the events with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  after the Battle of Badr and lived until the beginning of the caliphate of Ali for a period of thirty-six years. Some claim that he was in the cities for forty-five years after the assassination of Uthman for forty nights.
hi: Kyunke unhone apni qaum mein khoon bahaaya (kisi ko qatl kiya) tha, to woh Madinah bhaage aur Banu Abdul Ashhal se ahd kiya, to unki qaum ne unhein 'Al-Yaman' naam diya kyunke unhone Yemen walon se ahd kiya tha. Hudhaifah, unke waalid Husail, aur unke bhai Safwan (RA) ne Uhud mein shirkat ki, aur unke waalid ko kuch Musalmano ne us din qatl kar diya, unhein mushrik samajh kar, to Hudhaifah ne unki diyat Musalmano ko sadqa kar di. Aur rahi baat Hudhaifah ki, to unhone Badr ke baad Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam maidaanon mein shirkat ki, aur woh Ali (RA) ki khilafat ke shuru, chhattees (36) hijri, tak zinda rahe, aur kuch logon ne dawa kiya hai ke woh Uthman (RA) ke qatl ke chalis (40) raaton baad Al-Madaa'in (shehron ka joda, Iraq mein) mein the.

e: [AI] Hudhayfah died in the year thirty-six, and it is said that he died forty days after Uthman.
hi: Hudhaifah (RA) ka intiqaal chhattees (36) hijri mein hua, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke unka intiqaal Uthman (RA) ke chalis (40) din baad hua.

e: [AI] This statement is incorrect, and I believe its owner either did not know the time in which Uthman was killed, or did not accurately calculate it. This is because there is no dispute among all the people of knowledge that Uthman was killed in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah in the year thirty-five after the Hijrah. A group of them said he was killed on the twelfth night remaining from that month. If Uthman's killing happened in Dhu al-Hijjah and Hudhayfah lived for forty nights after him, then that refers to the year after it.
hi: Yeh baat ghalat hai, aur mera khayaal hai iske kehne wale ko ya to woh waqt maloom nahi tha jismein Uthman (RA) qatl kiye gaye, ya usne theek se hisaab nahi lagaaya, kyunke seerat ke tamaam ulama ke darmiyan iss baat mein koi ikhtilaaf nahi ke Uthman Dhul-Hijjah, hijrat ke paintees (35) saal mein, qatl kiye gaye, aur unme se kuch ka kehna hai ke woh us mahine ki baarah (12) raaten baaqi rehte huay qatl kiye gaye, to agar Uthman ka qatl Dhul-Hijjah mein hua aur Hudhaifah unke baad chalis (40) raaten zinda rahe, to yeh agle saal mein hoga.

e: [AI] When Hudhayfah faced death, having lived for forty nights after Uthman, he said to us, "I advise you to fear Allah and obey the Commander of the Believers, Ali ibn Abi Talib." At this point, Adh-Dhahabi remained silent in his summary.
hi: Jab Hudhaifah (RA) ki maut ka waqt aaya, aur woh Uthman (RA) ke baad chalis (40) raaten zinda rah chuke the, to unhone humse kaha: "Main tumhein Allah se darne aur Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ki itaa'at karne ki wasiyat karta houn." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "O father of Abdullah"
hi: "Aye Abu Abdullah."

e: [AI] "What are you doing with this (thing) if your friend is righteous, Allah will replace it for him, and if he is not, Allah will hit him in the face with it on the Day of Judgment." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "Tum log iske sath kya kar rahe ho? Agar tumhara saathi neik hai, to Allah zaroor usse uska badla (bihtar) de dega, aur agar aisa nahi hai, to Allah zaroor Qayamat ke din usse uske chehre par maarega." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Hudhayfah fainted at the beginning of the night, then woke up and said, 'What night is this?' I said, 'It is the highest level of magic.' He said, 'I seek refuge in Allah from the Hellfire.' This happened two or three times, then he said, 'Buy two shrouds for me and wrap me in them, but do not be excessive with me. If your companion is pleased with it, he will wear something better than them, but if not, he will take them quickly.' Al-Dhahabi was silent about summarizing this."
hi: Hudhaifah (RA) raat ke shuru mein behosh ho gaye, phir hosh mein aaye aur poocha: "Yeh raat ka kaunsa waqt hai?" Maine kaha: 'Aakhri seher (subah se pehle ka waqt).' Unhone kaha: "Main Jahannam se Allah ki panaah maangta houn," do ya teen martaba. Phir kaha: "Mere liye do kapde khareedo aur mujhe unme kafan do, aur mera maal mujhpar (kafan ke naam par zyaada) mat lagana, kyunke tumhara saathi agar (Allah se) raazi hoga, to isse behtar (kapda) pehnega, warna yeh (kapda) bhi usse jald hi chheen liya jaayega." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Gabriel, peace be upon him, came to me and said, "Indeed, Al-Hasan and Al-Husain are the leaders of the youth of the people of Paradise."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere paas Jibreel (AS) aaye aur kaha: beshak Hasan aur Husain Jannat ke jawaano ke sardaar hain." Sahih.

e: [AI] "He read the Quran, then he paused at its doubts (unclear verses) and made what is halal (permissible) for him, and what is haram (prohibited) forbidden for him." When he was asked about Ammar, he said, "He is a believer who forgets, and when reminded, he remembers." When he was asked about Hudhayfah, he said, "He was the most knowledgeable among the people about the hypocrites." And he mentioned the rest of the hadith.
hi: "Unhone Quran padha, phir uske mushtabah (shuba wale) hisson par ruke, uska halaal halaal kiya aur haraam haraam kiya." Aur Ammar (RA) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Aik momin jo bhool jaata hai, aur jab yaad dilaaya jaaye to yaad kar leta hai." Aur Hudhaifah (RA) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Woh logon mein munafiqon ke baare mein sabse zyada jaanne wale the." Aur baaqi hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] "It is a slave of the Banu Zuhrah tribe."
hi: "Ke woh Banu Zuhrah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam the."

e: [AI] Khabbab bin al-Aratt was a servant of the Banu Zuhrah, and it is also said that he was a servant of Thabit bin Umm Anmar.
hi: Khabbab bin Al-Aratt (RA) Banu Zuhrah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam the, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke woh Thabit bin Umm Anmar ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam the.

e: [AI] Khabbab ibn Al-Arat was the freed slave of Thabit ibn Um Ammar and Thabit was the freed slave of Al-Akhnas ibn Sharik Al-Thaqafi. It is also said that Khabbab was the freed slave of Uthbah ibn Ghazwan.
hi: Khabbab bin Al-Aratt Thabit bin Umm Anmar ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam the, aur Thabit Al-Akhnas bin Shariq Ath-Thaqafi ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam the, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke Khabbab Utbah bin Ghazwan ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam the.

e: [AI] "Khabbab ibn Al-Arat, a freedman of Uthman ibn Ghazwan." "And the most authentic of these sayings is the statement of Al-Zuhri, for the narration to him is correct."
hi: "Khabbab bin Al-Aratt, Utbah bin Ghazwan ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam." "Aur in tamaam baaton mein sabse sahih Az-Zuhri ki baat hai, kyunke unki riwayat sahih hai."

e: [AI] I heard Kurdus say, "Indeed, Khabbab ibn al-Aratt embraced Islam in the sixth year, so he was one-sixth of Islam."
hi: Maine Kurdoos ko kehte suna: "Beshak Khabbab bin Al-Aratt (RA) chhah (6) mein se chhata Musalman huay, to woh Islam ka chhata hissa the."

e: [AI] "Khabbab ibn al-Aratt is also known as Abu Abdullah."
hi: "Khabbab bin Al-Aratt (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi."

e: [AI] About 'Urwah, in naming those who witnessed the Battle of Badr, he said, "Khabbab ibn al-Aratt."
hi: Urwah se, Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, unhone kaha: "Khabbab bin Al-Aratt (RA)."

e: [AI] Khabbab bin al-Arat died in the year thirty-seven, and he was the first person to be buried by Ali in Kufa among the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . He was also the first person to be prayed upon after the return of the Commander of the Faithful from the Battle of Siffin. Adh-Dhahabi did not mention him in the summary.
hi: Khabbab bin Al-Aratt (RA) ka intiqaal saintees (37) hijri mein hua, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se pehle the jinhein Ali (RA) ne Kufa mein dafan kiya, aur pehle the jinki namaz-e-janaza Ameer-ul-Momineen (Ali) ke Siffin se wapas aane ke baad padhi gayi. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Kabab, a slave of the Bani Zuhrah tribe, who had witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , narrated..." (The rest of the translation is missing as the information is not provided in the question)
hi: "Apne waalid Khabbab, Banu Zuhrah ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, se, jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "People used to bury their dead in al-Kufah until Khubbab came to them. When he became sick, he said to me, 'My son, bury me at the back (of the graveyard).' If you bury me at the back, it will be said that a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has been buried there.' So when Khubbab died, he was buried at the back, and he was the first to be buried there. After that, people started burying their dead at the back."
hi: Log Kufa mein apne murdon ko dafan karte the yahan tak ke Khabbab (RA) unke paas aaye, jab woh bimaar ho gaye, to unhone mujhse (apne bete se) kaha: "Aye mere bete, mujhe Az-Zuhr (aik khaas jagah) mein dafan karna, kyunke agar tum mujhe Az-Zuhr mein dafan karoge, to kaha jaayega ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke aik sahabi ko yahan dafan kiya gaya hai." Jab Khabbab (RA) faut huay, to unhein Az-Zuhr mein dafan kiya gaya, aur woh Az-Zuhr mein dafan honay wale pehle shakhs the, phir log apne murdon ko Az-Zuhr mein dafan karne lage.

e: [AI] "He was captured in Mecca, and Umm Anmar bint Siba', from the tribe of Khuzaiyah, bought him. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, established a brotherhood between Khabbab and Jabir ibn 'Atik. Khabbab witnessed the battles of Badr, Uhud, the Trench, and all other major events with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. Khabbab passed away in the year thirty-seven, at the age of seventy-three."
hi: Woh Makkah mein qaid kiye gaye the, to Umm Anmar bint Siba' Al-Khuza'iyyah ne unhein khareeda, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khabbab (RA) aur Jabir bin Ateek (RA) ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, aur Khabbab ne Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam jangon mein shirkat ki, aur Khabbab ka intiqaal saintees (37) hijri mein hua, jabke woh us waqt tihattar (73) saal ke thay.

e: [AI] I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was lying down under a tree, placing his hand under his head. So, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, don't you pray to Allah against those people who made us fear that they would turn us away from our religion?" He turned his face away from me three times, each time I said that, he turned his face away from me. Then he sat up on the third time and said, "O people, fear Allah and be patient. By Allah, if a man from the believers before you was placed with a saw placed on his head and he was split into two, he would not turn away from his religion. Fear Allah, for Allah provides a way out and is the Maker."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke woh aik darakht ke neeche lete huay the, apna haath apne sar ke neeche rakhe huay, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap in logon ke khilaaf Allah se dua nahi maangte, jinse humein darr hai ke woh humein humare deen se hata denge?" To aap (SAW) ne mujhse apna chehra teen martaba pher liya, har baar main yehi kehta aur aap (SAW) mujhse apna chehra pher lete, phir teesri baar aap (SAW) baith gaye aur farmaya: "Aye logo, Allah se dro aur sabr karo, Allah ki qasam, tumse pehle jo momin the, unke sar par aara rakh diya jaata, to woh do tukdon mein chir diya jaata, magar woh apne deen se peeche nahi hatte the, Allah se dro, kyunke Allah tumhare liye zaroor (fatah ka rasta) khol dega aur (bhalaai) karega."

e: [AI] "To take our rewards with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for all that we have achieved in this worldly life afterwards."
hi: "Ke humara duniya se jo kuch bhi Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad milega, woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath humare ajr ko na le jaaye."

e: [AI] I heard Mus'ab ibn Abdullah Al-Zubayri saying, "Ammar ibn Yasir ibn Amir ibn Malik ibn Kinanah ibn Qais ibn Al-Husayn ibn Al-Wathim ibn Tha'laba ibn Amr ibn Harithah ibn Malik ibn Anas ibn Zaid."
hi: Maine Mus'ab bin Abdullah Az-Zubairi ko kehte suna: "Ammar bin Yasir bin Aamir bin Malik bin Kinaanah bin Qais bin Al-Husain bin Al-Wadhim bin Tha'labah bin Amr bin Haarithah bin Malik bin Anas bin Zaid."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Have patience, O family of Yasir, for your appointment is Paradise." He said, "And the name of the mother of Ammar ibn Yasir was Sumayyah bint Muslim ibn Lakhm." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW): "Sabr karo, Aye Aal-e-Yasir, kyunke tumhara wa'da Jannat hai." Unhone kaha: "Aur Ammar bin Yasir ki maa ka naam Sumayyah bint Muslim bin Lakhm tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Ali for Ammar: 'Oh Abu Al-Yaqtan'"
hi: Ali (RA) ne Ammar se kaha: "Aye Abu Al-Yaqzan."

e: [AI] "He entered upon Uthman and a tall, bald man with some hair in the front of his head came in. I said, 'Who is this?' They said, 'Ammaar ibn Yaasir.'"
hi: Beshak woh Uthman (RA) ke paas dakhil huay, to aik lamba, gunjaa aadmi aaya jiske sar ke aage kuch baal the, maine poocha: 'Yeh kaun hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Ammar bin Yasir.'

e: [AI] "I saw Ammar ibn Yasir on the day of Siffin with a sword in his hand, continuously fighting."
hi: "Maine Ammar bin Yasir ko Siffin ke din dekha, saanwle, lambe, unke haath mein neza tha."

e: [AI] That He created you from dust, then suddenly you are human beings scattered [Quran 30:20]. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: ...ke usne tumhein mitti se paida kiya, phir achaanak tum insaan ho, phailte huay (Surah Ar-Rum 20). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And by the One in whose hand is my soul, I fought three times with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with this, and this is the fourth." Then he said, "And by the One in whose hand is my soul, if they were to beat us until they reached Sa'afat Hijar, I would know that we are on the truth and they are on falsehood." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, maine isi (hathiyaar) se Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath teen martaba jung ki hai, aur yeh chauthi baar hai." Phir kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar woh humein maarte huay Hajar ke khajoor ke jhundon tak pahuncha dein, to bhi main jaan lunga ke hum haq par hain aur woh baatil par hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Regarding the naming of those from the allies of Banu Makhzum who witnessed the Battle of Badr, 'Amr ibn Yasir.
hi: Urwah se: "Banu Makhzoom ke ahd-waale saathiyon mein se, jinhone Badr mein shirkat ki, Ammar bin Yasir the."

e: [AI] Abu Salamah and Umm Salamah migrated and Ammar ibn Yasir went out with them, and he was their ally.
hi: "Abu Salamah aur Umm Salamah ne hijrat ki, aur unke sath Ammar bin Yasir bhi nikle, aur woh unke ahd-waale saathi the."

e: [AI] "I used to be a soil to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and no one was closer to him in age than me."
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ka hum-umr tha, mujhse zyada koi umr mein unke qareeb nahi tha."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived in Madinah as the first thing he did when he arrived, 'Ammar ibn Yasir said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  should have a place for him to rest in and pray when he wakes up from his sleep." So, 'Ammar gathered stones and built the Quba Mosque, which was the first mosque to be built, and 'Ammar was the one who built it.
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah mein pehli baar pahunche, to Ammar bin Yasir ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye zaroori hai ke hum unke liye aik jagah banaayen jahan woh apni dopahar ki neend se jaagne par saaya le sakein aur namaz padh sakein." To Ammar ne patthar jama kiye aur Quba ki masjid ko theek kiya, to yeh pehli masjid thi jo banaayi gayi, aur Ammar ne isse banaaya.

e: [AI] The first person to build a mosque and pray in it was Ammar ibn Yasir.
hi: "Sabse pehle jinhone masjid banaayi aur usme namaz padhi, woh Ammar bin Yasir the."

e: [AI] From Asim ibn Umar regarding the naming of those whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made brothers between the Muhajirin and the Ansar, they said: "He made brothers between 'Ammar ibn Yasir and Hudayfa ibn Al-Yaman."
hi: Asim bin Umar se, un logon ke naamon mein jinke darmiyan Rasulullah (SAW) ne Muhajireen aur Ansar mein bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ammar bin Yasir (RA) aur Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (RA) ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya."
