e: [AI] The permission of Abu Ghadiyah Al-Juhani was sought and Abd al-A'la said, "Let him in." So he was admitted and he had wounds on him. Then a man of tall stature struck him as if he does not belong to this Ummah. When he sat down, he said, "We used to consider Ammar ibn Yasir as one of our best." He said, "By Allah, I was in the Mosque of Quba when he said a word that if I had any helpers, I would have killed him." He said, "On the day of Siffin, he walked ahead of the troop on foot until he stabbed a man with a spear between the two sides, and he killed him. The crowd turned away from him, and the Divine Forgiveness repelled him. Then he struck him, and it was the head of Ammar ibn Yasir." He said, "Our servant says, 'I have never seen a man openly more misguided than him.'" Ibn Hajar remained silent about summarizing it.
hi: Darwaaze par khade shakhs ne kaha: 'Yeh Abu Ghaadiyah Al-Juhani hain, ijaazat maang rahe hain.' To Abdul A'la ne kaha: 'Unhein andar aane do.' To woh andar aaye, unpar rang-birange kapde the, achaanak aik lamba, mazboot aadmi tha, goya woh is Ummat mein se nahi tha. Jab woh baith gaye, to unhone kaha: "Hum Ammar bin Yasir ko apne behtareen logon mein shumaar karte the." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main Quba ki masjid mein tha jab unhone (Ammar ne) aisi baat kahi ke agar mujhe uspar madadgaar milte, to main unhein kuchal kar qatl kar deta." Unhone kaha: "Phir jab Siffin ka din hua, to woh lashkar ke aage paidal chalte huay aaye, yahan tak ke jab woh dono safon ke darmiyan pahunche, to unhone aik aadmi ko neze se chheda aur usse gira diya, to unke sar se khod (helmet) hat gaya, to unhone unhein maara, achaanak woh Ammar bin Yasir ka sar tha." Unhone kaha: humare aik aazaad kiye huay ghulam ne kaha: 'Maine kisi aadmi ko isse zyada saaf gumraahi mein nahi dekha.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "He will be killed by the rebellious group." So 'Amr stood up in alarm and went to Mu'awiyah and said to him, "What is the matter with you?" Mu'awiyah said, "Just now 'Ammar ibn Yasir has been killed." 'Amr said, "Has 'Ammar been killed?' Mu'awiyah replied, "Yes, he has been killed, but by 'Ali and his companions." They brought him until they threw him among our spears or swords, according to their agreement, and did not kill him by this method (i.e. crucifixion), as stated in the conditions of both Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Jab Ammar bin Yasin (RA) qatl kiye gaye, to Amr bin Hazm, Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ke paas dakhil huay aur kaha: "Ammar qatl kar diye gaye, aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: unhein zaalim (baaghi) giroh qatl karega." To Amr (RA) ghabraaye huay khade huay yahan tak ke Mu'awiyah (RA) ke paas dakhil huay, Mu'awiyah ne unse poocha: 'Aapko kya hua?' Unhone kaha: 'Ammar bin Yasir qatl kar diye gaye.' Unhone poocha: 'Ammar qatl ho gaye, to?' Amr (RA) ne kaha: 'Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: unhein zaalim giroh qatl karega.' To Mu'awiyah (RA) ne unse kaha: 'Kya humne unhein qatl kiya? Unhein to sirf Ali aur unke saathiyon ne qatl kiya, woh unhein laaye yahan tak ke unhein humare nezon ya (kaha) talwaaron ke darmiyan phenk diya.' Sahih, dono ki shart par, magar dono ne ise isi tarah nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Who is this man?" They said, "It is 'Ammaar ibn Yaasir." He said, "Do you remember the day when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was building the mosque, and we were carrying bricks one by one, and 'Ammaar was carrying two bricks at a time? And then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by while 'Ammaar was carrying two bricks, and you were there as well. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, 'Verily, the rebellious group will kill you, while you will be among the people of Paradise.' Then 'Umar went to Mu'aawiyah and said, 'We have killed this man, although the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said something about him that we shouldn't have ignored.' Mu'aawiyah told him to be quiet and said, 'By Allah, you'll keep boasting about it until you die, but we were the ones who killed him. It was only 'Ali and his companions who brought him until they handed him over to us.'" And this is how you see the mistake.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke baare mein farmaya jo farmaya. Poocha gaya: 'Kaunsa aadmi?' Kaha gaya: 'Ammar bin Yasir.' 'Kya tumhein yaad nahi jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne masjid banaayi, to hum aik-aik eent uthaate the, aur Ammar do-do eentein uthaate the, to Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas se guzre jabke woh do-do eentein uthaa rahe the, aur tum bhi wahan maujood the?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khabardaar, tumhein zaalim giroh qatl karega, aur tum Jannat ke ahl mein se ho." To Amr (RA) Mu'awiyah ke paas dakhil huay aur kaha: 'Humne is aadmi ko qatl kar diya, jabke Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke baare mein woh kaha jo kaha.' Unhone kaha: 'Chup raho, Allah ki qasam, tum hamesha (bekaar) pareshaan rehte ho, kya humne unhein qatl kiya? Unhein to sirf Ali aur unke saathiyon ne qatl kiya, woh unhein laaye yahan tak ke unhein humare darmiyan phenk diya.'" Yeh, jaisa tum dekh rahe ho, ghalat hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "O Allah, ignite the Quraysh with 'Ammar. Indeed, the killer of 'Ammar and the one who takes his belongings will be in the Fire." 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Mubarak, who is trustworthy and reliable, narrated this incident from Mu'tamir, from his father, from Abu Bakr. If this narration is preserved, then it is authentic according to the conditions of the two scholars (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), and they did not include it in their collections. But people have only narrated it from Mu'tamir, from Layth, from Mujahid, based on the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Aye Allah, Quraish Ammar ke khilaaf laalchi ho gaye hain, beshak Ammar ka qaatil aur unka saamaan cheenne wala Jahannam mein hai." Isse sirf Abdur Rahman bin Al-Mubarak ne riwayat kiya hai, jo bharosemand, mo'tabar hain, Mu'tamir se, unke waalid se. Agar yeh mehfooz hai, to yeh Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur log isse sirf Mu'tamir se, Laith se, Mujahid se riwayat karte hain.

e: [AI] Ammaar bin Yaasir sought permission from the Prophet ﷺ  while I was with him. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Grant him permission." When Ammaar entered, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Welcome, O good and pure one."
hi: Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se ijaazat maangi jabke main unke paas tha, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unhein ijaazat do." Jab woh dakhil huay, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khush-aamdeed, paak aur khushbu-daar shakhs."

e: [AI] Omar ibn al-Khattab wrote to us, "I have appointed Ammar ibn Yasir as a leader and Abdullah ibn Mas'ud as a teacher and minister to you. They are both from the elite companions of Muhammad ﷺ and among the people of Badr. Listen to them and know that I have appointed Ibn Mas'ud in charge of your treasury. So, listen to them, learn from them, and follow their example. I have preferred Abdullah over myself." This narration is authentic according to the conditions set by both Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne humein likha: "Maine tumhare paas Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ko ameer bana kar aur Abdullah bin Mas'ood (RA) ko muallim aur wazeer bana kar bheja hai, aur woh dono Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba mein se Ahle-Badr ke chune huay logon mein se hain, isliye unki baat suno. Aur maine Ibn Mas'ood ko tumhare Bait-ul-Maal (khazaane) ka zimmedaar banaya hai, isliye unki baat suno, unse seekho, aur unki pairavi karo. Maine Abdullah ko apne upar tumhare liye tarjeeh di hai." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Ibn Sumayyah was not presented with any matter except that he took the more guided of the two options." This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs, if Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd heard it from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud and they did not exclude it. He also has a continuous narration from the Hadith of Aisha.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ibn Sumayyah ko kabhi bhi do maamlon mein se koi pesh nahi kiya gaya magar unhone unme se zyada hidayat wale ko chuna." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, agar Salim bin Abi Al-Ja'd ne Abdullah bin Mas'ood se suna ho, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur iska Aisha ki hadith se aik taaeedi (muttabi') bhi hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Amr (a companion) was never given the choice between two matters except that he would choose the one that was more virtuous." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ammar ko kabhi do maamlon mein ikhtiyaar nahi diya gaya magar unhone unme se zyada hidayat wale ko chuna." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The translation is as follows: "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, passed by Ammar and his family while they were being tortured, so he said, 'Give glad tidings to the family of Ammar and the family of Yasir, for indeed your meeting place is Paradise.' This narration is authentic according to the conditions of Muslim, but he did not include it in his compilation."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) Ammar aur unke ghar walon ke paas se guzre jabke unhein azaab diya jaa raha tha, to farmaya: "Khush-khabri ho, Aye Aal-e-Ammar aur Aal-e-Yasir, kyunke tumhara wa'da Jannat hai." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] There was something between me and Ammar, so I complained about it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever insults Ammar, Allah will insult him, and whoever harms Ammar, Allah will harm him." This hadith has an authentic chain of narrators, and it was not mentioned in Sahih Al-Bukhari or Sahih Muslim.
hi: Mere aur Ammar ke darmiyan kuch (jhagda) hua, to maine iski shikayat Rasulullah (SAW) se ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Ammar ko bura-bhala kahega, Allah usse bura-bhala kahega, aur jo koi Ammar se dushmani karega, Allah usse dushman samjhega." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the last provision that you have from this world is a small amount of milk." It is an authentic hadith according to their conditions, but it has not been mentioned in the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "...ke aapka duniya se aakhri rizq (khuraak) doodh ka aik peela sa gilaas hoga." Sahih, dono ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'The last drink I will have is this one when I die.'"
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab main marunga, to jo aakhri peene ki cheez main piyunga woh yehi hai."

e: [AI] I heard Khalid bin Al-Walid saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me on a military expedition, and with me was Ammar bin Yasir. We encountered a group of people, some of whom were from a household that had embraced Islam. Ammar said, 'These people have embraced monotheism.' I did not pay attention to his words, and as a result, they suffered the same fate as others. Ammar then began blaming me, saying that if I had informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about this situation, he would have come to their aid. So, I went to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him about what had happened. When the Prophet ﷺ saw me, he did not show any support and turned away with tears in his eyes. He called me and said, 'O Khalid, do not insult Ammar. Whoever insults Ammar, Allah insults him, and whoever hates Ammar, Allah hates him. And whoever belittles Ammar, Allah belittles him.' Khalid said, 'O Messenger of Allah, forgive me, by Allah, nothing prevented me from responding to him except my belittlement of him on that day.' Khalid added, 'And there is nothing that I fear more than my belittlement of Ammar bin Yasir on that day.' This hadith has an authentic chain of narration according to the scholars of hadith. Mas'ud bin Sa'd, Mas'ood bin Sa'd, Sa'di, Sa'di, Mas'ood bin Sa'd, Sa'di. Muhammad bin Fudail bin Ghazwan, and Al-Hasan bin Ubaidullah an-Nakha'i have reported this hadith in a similar way."
hi: Maine Khalid bin Al-Waleed ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe aik dasty (chhoti fauj) mein bheja, aur mere sath Ammar bin Yasir the, to humne kuch logon ko pakda jinme aik ghar wale the jinhone Islam ka zikr kiya tha, to Ammar ne kaha: 'Beshak yeh log tauheed maante hain.' Maine unki baat par tawajjo nahi di, to unke sath wahi hua jo (doosre) logon ke sath hua (yaani unhein nuqsaan pahuncha). Unhone kaha: to Ammar mujhe dhamki dene lage ke agar unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha to unhein bataayenge, to woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhein bataaya, jab Ammar ne dekha ke aap (SAW) unki madad nahi kar rahe, to woh mudh gaye, unki aankhon se aansoo beh rahe the. Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne mujhe bulaaya aur farmaya: "Aye Khalid, Ammar ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunke jo koi Ammar ko bura-bhala kahega, Allah usse bura-bhala kahega, aur jo koi Ammar se nafrat karega, Allah usse nafrat karega, aur jo koi Ammar ko haqeer samjhega, Allah usse haqeer samjhega." Khalid ne kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere liye maghfirat maangein,' Allah ki qasam, mujhe unhein jawaab dene se sirf iss baat ne roka ke maine unhein haqeer samjha tha. Khalid ne kaha: "Aur mujhe usdin Ammar bin Yasir ko haqeer samajhne se zyada koi cheez khauf mein nahi daalti thi." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala, aur isi tarah Mas'ood bin Sa'd Al-Ju'fi aur Muhammad bin Fudail bin Ghazwan ne Al-Hasan bin Ubaidullah An-Nakha'i se riwayat ki hai, rahi baat Mas'ood bin Sa'd ki hadith ki, to...

e: [AI] Narrated Mas'ud ibn Sa'd: As for the narration of Muhammad ibn Fudayl...
hi: Humein Mas'ood bin Sa'd ne hadith bayan ki, aur rahi baat Muhammad bin Fudail ki hadith ki...

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me on raids, and we encountered them. Al-Ammar ibn Yasir said, "They have taken refuge from us with the belief in the oneness of Allah." I did not pay attention to what he said and he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe aik ghazwe mein bheja, humne unhein pakda, to Ammar bin Yasir ne kaha: "Beshak unhone tauheed ke zariye humse (apni hifaazat ki) panaah maangi hai." Maine unki baat par tawajjo nahi di, aur baaqi hadith isi tarah zikr ki.

e: [AI] There was an argument between me and Ammar ibn Yasir, so I complained about it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Khalid, whoever insults Ammar, Allah will insult him, and whoever harms Ammar, Allah will harm him, and whoever belittles Ammar, Allah will belittle him." This was narrated by Al-Awam ibn Hawshab from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, and Shu'bah disagrees with its chain of narration. He said it was narrated by Salamah from Alqamah from Khalid ibn Walid.
hi: Mere aur Ammar bin Yasir ke darmiyan baat-cheet (jhagda) hua, to maine iski shikayat Rasulullah (SAW) se ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Khalid, jo koi Ammar ko bura-bhala kahega, Allah usse bura-bhala kahega, aur jo koi Ammar se dushmani karega, Allah usse dushman samjhega, aur jo koi Ammar ko haqeer samjhega, Allah usse haqeer samjhega." Isse Al-Awwaam bin Hawshab ne, Salamah bin Kuhail se, riwayat kiya hai, aur Shu'bah ne isnad mein ikhtilaaf kiya hai, unhone Salamah se, Alqamah se, Khalid bin Al-Waleed se, riwayat ki.

e: [AI] There was a conversation between me and 'Amr ibn Yasir, and I showed harshness towards him. So 'Amr went to complain about me to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . Then Khalid came and he also complained about me. Khalid kept intensifying the complaints against me without any increase except harshness. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  remained silent. 'Amr cried and said, "O Messenger of Allah, don't you see him?" The Prophet ﷺ  raised his head and said, "Whoever harms 'Amr, Allah will harm him, and whoever dislikes 'Amr, Allah will dislike him." Khalid said, "So I left and there was nothing more beloved to me than the satisfaction of 'Amr, and I met him and he was satisfied." This is the hadith of Al-Awam ibn Al-Hawshab.
hi: Mere aur Ammar bin Yasir ke darmiyan baat-cheet hui, maine unse sakhti se baat ki, to Ammar Nabi (SAW) se meri shikayat karne chale gaye, phir Khalid aaye jabke woh (Ammar) unki shikayat kar rahe the, to unhone bhi sakhti se baat ki, aur (Khalid ki) sakhti sirf badhti gayi, aur Nabi (SAW) khaamosh the, to Ammar rone lage aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap unhein nahi dekh rahe?' Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) ne apna sar uthaaya aur farmaya: "Jo koi Ammar se dushmani karega, Allah usse dushman samjhega, aur jo koi Ammar se nafrat karega, Allah usse nafrat karega." Khalid ne kaha: "To main nikal gaya, aur mujhe Ammar ki raazi-mandi se zyada koi cheez aziz na thi, to main unse mila aur woh raazi ho gaye." Yeh Al-Awwaam bin Al-Hawshab ki hadith hai.

e: [AI] Never has a day come upon me that was more difficult for me than the day when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me with some of his companions and ordered me regarding them. Among the people was 'Ammaar, and we encountered a group of people, among whom were Muslim families. 'Ammaar spoke to me about them, and some of the Muslims said, "Leave them alone." I said, "No, by Allah, I will not do so until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sees them and gives his opinion about them." This angered 'Ammaar, and when I reached the Prophet ﷺ , I sought permission to speak to him while 'Ammaar sought permission as well. Permission was granted to him, and 'Ammaar entered and said, "O Messenger of Allah, did you not see what Khalid did and what he did?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, by Allah, if it was not for your gathering, Ibn Sumayyah would not have insulted me." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said to me, "Did you not answer the man?" I said, "There was nothing preventing me from answering him except that it would have belittled him." This angered the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, "Whoever hates 'Ammaar, Allah hates him, and whoever insults 'Ammaar, Allah insults him, and whoever belittles 'Ammaar, Allah belittles him." I then left the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and did not stop seeking forgiveness for myself from 'Ammaar.
hi: Mere upar kabhi koi din itna sakht nahi guzra jitna Ammar ke maamle ka din guzra, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe unke kuch sahaba ke sath bheja aur mujhe unpar ameer banaya, aur Ammar bhi us jama'at mein the, to humne kuch logon ko pakda jinme aik ghar wale Musalman the, to Ammar aur kuch Musalmano ne unke baare mein mujhse baat ki, unhone kaha: 'Inhein chhod do.' Maine kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main aisa nahi karunga jab tak Rasulullah (SAW) unhein na dekh lein aur unke baare mein apni raay na dein.' To Ammar mujhse naaraaz ho gaye. Jab main wapas pahuncha, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) se ijaazat maangi, aap (SAW) mujhse (waaqia ke baare mein) poochte the aur main unhein bataa raha tha, ke Ammar ne bhi ijaazat maangi, to unhein ijaazat mil gayi, Ammar dakhil huay aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aapne Khalid ko yeh aur yeh karte nahi dekha?' To maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Allah ki qasam, agar aapki majlis na hoti, to Ibn Sumayyah mujhe bura-bhala na kehte.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Ammar, nikal jaao." To Ammar rote huay nikle, keh rahe the: 'Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khalid ke khilaaf meri madad nahi ki.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Kya tumne is aadmi ko jawaab nahi diya?" Maine kaha: 'Mujhe jawaab dene se sirf iss baat ne roka ke main unhein haqeer samajhta tha.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ko ghussa aaya aur farmaya: "Beshak jo koi Ammar se nafrat karega, Allah usse nafrat karega, aur jo koi Ammar ko bura-bhala kahega, Allah usse bura-bhala kahega, aur jo koi Ammar ko haqeer samjhega, Allah usse haqeer samjhega." To main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas se nikla, aur main hamesha Ammar se (maafi) maangta raha yahan tak ke unhone mere liye maghfirat ki dua ki.

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say to him, 'You will not die until the rebellious group kills you, taking a sip of a poisoned drink which will be your last provision from this world.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko unse farmate suna: "Tum nahi maroge yahan tak ke tumhein zaalim giroh qatl kare, tum doodh ke aik peele sa gilaas peeyoge, jo duniya se tumhara aakhri rizq hoga."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not die until the day he died while he loved for a man to enter the Hellfire forever." They said, "We used to see him loving you and seeking help from you and entrusting you with tasks." He said, "Allah knows best about my love for him, but it is sufficient that we used to see him loving a man." They asked, "Who is that?" He said, "Ammaar ibn Yaasir." They said, "So, he is your killer on the day of Siffeen."
hi: "...ke Rasulullah (SAW) us din faut nahi huay jab woh faut huay jabke woh kisi aadmi se yeh mohabbat rakhte hon ke woh kabhi Jahannam mein dakhil ho." Unhone kaha: 'Hum dekhte the ke woh aapse mohabbat karte the, aapse madad maangte the, aur aapko kaam sonpte the.' To unhone kaha: "Allah mere unse mohabbat ke baare mein behtar jaanta hai, lekin yeh kaafi hai ke hum dekhte the woh aik aadmi se mohabbat karte the." Unhone poocha: 'Kaun?' Unhone kaha: "Ammar bin Yasir." Unhone kaha: 'To yehi hain jinhein tumne Siffin ke din qatl kiya.'

e: [AI] "And by the One in whose hand is my life, I have fought with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ three times and this is the fourth time. And by the One in whose hand is my life, if they were to hit us until they reached the sa'afat (a type of cloth), we would know that our best interest lies in following the truth and that they are on misguidance." This is reported as authentic according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim and they did not exclude it.
hi: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, maine isi (hathiyaar) se Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath teen martaba jung ki hai, aur yeh chauthi baar hai." "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar woh humein maarte huay Hajar ke khajoor ke jhundon (sa'afaat) tak pahuncha dein, to bhi humein pata chal jaayega ke humara sulah-karne-wala haq par hai aur woh gumraahi par hain." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: "I came to Al-Madinah, so I asked Allah to make it easy for me to sit with one who is righteous. He made Abu Hurairah accessible to me, so I sat with him and said to him: 'Indeed, I asked Allah to make it easy for me to sit with one who is righteous, and it is to you that I was guided.' So he said to me: 'From where are you?' I said: 'From the people of Al-Kufah, I came to search out good and to seek it.' So he said: 'Is there not among you Sa'd bin Malik whose supplication is answered, Ibn Mas'ud, the one who used to carry the water for purification and the sandals of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Hudhaifah, the keeper of the secrets of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and 'Ammar whom Allah has guarded from Shaitan upon the tongue of His Prophet, and Salman the companion of the Two Books?'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3811)
hi: Ke usse aik neik saathi mil jaaye, to unhein Abu Hurairah mil gaye, unhone mujhse poocha: "Tum kahan se ho?" Maine kaha: 'Kufa ki zameen se, main ilm aur bhalaai talaash karne aaya houn.' Unhone kaha: "Kya tum mein Sa'd bin Malik nahi jinki dua qubool hoti hai, aur Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Rasulullah (SAW) ke wudu aur unke jooton ke saathi, aur Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman, Rasulullah (SAW) ke raaz ke saathi, aur Ammar bin Yasir, jinhein Allah ne apne Nabi (SAW) ki zubaan se Shaitan se mahfooz rakha, aur Salman, do Kitaabon ke saathi?" Qataadah ne kaha: "Aur dono Kitaaben Injeel aur Furqan hain." Isnad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Amr will be filled with faith until it reaches his ankles.'"
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ammar imaan se apni haddiyon ke jodon tak bhar diye gaye."

e:
that he (ʿAmmar b. Yāsir) entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ seeking advice. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, “Should I not teach you a healing that Jibrīl used to heal me?” I said, “Of course.”
He then taught him: “bismillāhi arqīk, wa-allāhu yashfīk, min kulli dāʾin yuʾdhīk (In the name of Allah I ˹attempt to˺ heal you, and may Allah cure you, from all ailments that harm you.) Take this ˹ruqyah˺ and be blessed.”
hi: Beshak woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay jabke unhein bukhaar tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Kya main tumhein woh dua na sikhaaun jo Jibreel (AS) ne mujhe sikhaayi?" Maine kaha: 'Zaroor, Ya Rasulullah (SAW).' Unhone kaha: to aap (SAW) ne unhein sikhaaya: "Bismillahi arqeek, wallahu yashfeek, min kulli daa'in yu'zeek (Allah ke naam se main tumhein dam karta houn, aur Allah tumhein shifa de, har us bimari se jo tumhein takleef deti hai). Isse lo, yeh tumhare liye mubaarak ho."

e: [AI] I saw the Prophet ﷺ and there were only five servants with him, along with two women and Abu Bakr. "Authentic according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, aur unke sath sirf paanch ghulam, do auratein, aur Abu Bakr (RA) the. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Indeed, prolonging the prayer and shortening the sermon are signs of a person's understanding (of religion), so prolong the prayer and shorten the sermon." This hadith is authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but they did not mention it in this wording according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Beshak namaz ki lambaai aur khutba ki chhotai aadmi ke deeni samajh ki alaamat hai, isliye namaz lambi karo aur khutba chhoti karo." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise isi andaaz mein nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] A man insulted Aisha in front of Ali, so Ammar ibn Yasir told him, "Shut up, you wretched and disgraceful individual! Are you trying to hurt the beloved of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ?" This narration is authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, but it was not included in Bukhari and Muslim's collections.
hi: Beshak aik aadmi ne Ali (RA) ke paas Aisha (RA) ke baare mein bura-bhala kaha, to Ammar bin Yasir ne usse kaha: "Chup ho ja, zaleel, dhutkaare huay, kya tu Rasulullah (SAW) ki mehboob ko takleef pahunchaata hai?" Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: "Look at Ammar bin Yasir, for he dies upon fitrah (natural disposition), unless a slip of old age overtakes him."
hi: "Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ko dekho, kyunke woh fitrat (paak deen) par marenge, siwaye is ke ke buddhaape ki koi lagzish unhein pakad le."

e: [AI] "Abdullah said: I do not know of anyone who actively participated in turmoil seeking the pleasure of Allah the Exalted and the hereafter except Ammar ibn Yasir. This hadith has a sound chain of narration according to the condition of Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ood RA) (ne kaha): "Main kisi ko nahi jaanta jo fitne mein isliye nikla ho ke woh Allah Ta'ala ki raza aur Aakhirat ka ghar chaahta ho, siwaye Ammar bin Yasir ke." Sahih isnad, Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] We witnessed the battle of Siffin with Ali and we entrusted two men to them. When there was negligence among the people, he attacked them and would not return until he dyed his sword with their blood. He said, "Excuse me, by Allah, I did not return until I announce my sword. And I saw Ammar and Hashim bin Uthba running between the two ranks, and Ammar said, 'O Hashim, I swear by Allah, he will betray his command and abandon his soldiers.' Then he said, 'O Hashim, Paradise is under the shades today. Beloved Muhammad and his party, O Hashim, I am blind, and there is no good in being blind. He cannot endure adversity.' Hashim shook the banner and said, 'The blind one seeks a place for his people. He has treated life until he is full. He must either fall or cause others to fall.' He then entered a valley in the midst of the valleys of Siffin. Abu Abdur Rahman said, 'And I saw the companions of Muhammad ﷺ  following Ammar as if he had knowledge.' (Al-Bahr Ar-Rajaz, the Golden Ocean, did not summarize it)
hi: Hum Ali (RA) ke sath Siffin mein maujood the, aur humne do aadmiyon ko (khaas zimmedaari) di thi, jab qaum mein ghaflat hoti, to woh unpar hamla karta aur tab tak wapas nahi aata jab tak apni talwaar khoon se rang na le, unhone kaha: 'Mujhe maaf karo, Allah ki qasam, main tab tak wapas nahi aaya jab tak meri talwaar mujh se (kund hokar) thak nahi gayi.' Unhone kaha: aur maine Ammar aur Hashim bin Utbah ko dekha, jabke woh dono safon ke darmiyan daud rahe the, to Ammar ne kaha: "Aye Hashim, Allah ki qasam, yeh (dushman ka sardaar) zaroor apni baat se mukregi aur apni fauj ko zaleel karegi." Phir kaha: "Aye Hashim," Jannat talwaaron ke saaye ke neeche hai, aaj main apne mehboobon, Muhammad aur unki jama'at, se milunga, Aye Hashim, main aik-aankh wala houn, aur aik-aankh wale mein koi bhalaai nahi jo museebat ka saamna na kare." Unhone kaha: to Hashim ne jhanda hilaaya aur kaha (bahr Ar-Rajaz mein): "Aik-aankh wala apni qaum ke liye jagah chahta hai, usne zindagi ka bohot tajurba kiya yahan tak ke thak gaya, ya to woh (dushman ko) tez karega ya khud tez kiya jaayega." Unhone kaha: phir woh Siffin ki aik ghaati mein chale gaye. Abu Abdur Rahman (Ibn Mas'ood) ne kaha: "Aur maine Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba ko Ammar ke peeche chalte dekha, goya woh unke liye aik (rehnuma) jhanda the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Budayl ibn Warqa'a ibn Abdul'Uzza ibn Rabia'a ibn Jazi ibn Amir ibn Mazen ibn Adiy ibn Amr ibn Rabia'a witnessed with the Prophet ﷺ  the conquest of Mecca, Hunayn, Tabuk, and was martyred alongside Ali on the Day of Siffin.
hi: Abdullah bin Budail bin Warqa bin Abdul Uzza bin Rabee'ah bin Jazi bin Aamir bin Maazin bin Adi bin Amr bin Rabee'ah (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ke sath Fatah-e-Makkah, Hunain, aur Tabook mein shirkat ki, aur Ali (RA) ke sath Siffin ke din shaheed kiye gaye.

e: [AI] I saw Abu 'Amrah al-Ansari on the day of Siffin. He participated in the battles of Badr, Uhud, and he was fasting. He was feeling extremely thirsty and he said to his servant, "Oh you there, give me water." Then he shot an arrow and he barely managed to remove it, so he shot three more arrows. Then he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Whoever shoots an arrow for the sake of Allah, whether it reaches its target or not, will have a light from that arrow on the Day of Judgment.'" He was killed before sunset.
hi: Maine Abu Amrah Al-Ansari (RA) ko Siffin ke din dekha, woh Badri, Aqabi, aur Uhudi the, aur roza rakhe huay the, pyaas ki wajah se taab kha rahe the, apne ghulam se keh rahe the: "Afsos ho tujhpar, mujhpar paani chhidko," to ghulam ne unpar (paani) chhidka, phir unhone teer chalaaya, kamzori se kamaan kheenchi, yahan tak ke teen (3) teer chalaaye, phir kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jo koi Allah ki raah mein teer chalaaye, chaahe woh nishaane tak pahunche ya kam pade, to woh teer uske liye Qayamat ke din noor banega." Phir woh suraj doobne se pehle shaheed kar diye gaye.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Muslims will emerge in Arabia, Muslims will emerge in Persia, Muslims will emerge in the Romans, and Muslims will emerge in the area of the one-eyed Antichrist." Al-Dhahabi did not comment on this hadith in his summary.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Musalman Jazeeratul-Arab par ghalib aayenge, aur Musalman Faaris (Persia) par ghalib aayenge, aur Musalman Rome par ghalib aayenge, aur Musalman aik-aankh wale Dajjal par ghalib aayenge." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] To be forced or to be made to act unfairly.
hi: Ya to woh (dushman ko) tez karega ya khud tez kiya jaayega.

e: [AI] I was a messenger from Muawiyah to Aisha in the Battle of Siffin. Aisha asked, "Who among the people was killed?" I said, "Amr ibn Yasir." Aisha said, "The people follow his religion because of his strong determination." She asked, "And who else?" I said, "Hashim ibn Utebah, son of Abi Waqqas, the blind man." She said, "He was a man who never faltered in his resolve." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Main Siffin ki jung mein Mu'awiyah (RA) ki taraf se Aisha (RA) ke paas qaasid tha, to Aisha (RA) ne poocha: "Logon mein se kaun qatl kiya gaya?" Maine kaha: 'Ammar bin Yasir.' To Aisha (RA) ne kaha: "Yehi woh sardaar hain jinki log unke deen ki wajah se pairavi karte hain." Unhone poocha: 'Aur kaun?' Maine kaha: 'Hashim bin Utbah bin Abi Waqqas, aik-aankh wale.' Unhone kaha: "Yeh aik aisa aadmi hai jiska ghoda kabhi mushkil se hi ladkhadaaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And as for Hashim Al-Awar, he is the son of Uthba ibn Abu Waqqas who embraced Islam on the day of the conquest of Mecca. He was one-eyed due to an injury sustained during the Battle of Yarmouk. He is the nephew of Saad ibn Abu Waqqas, and he participated in the Battle of Siffin alongside Ali ibn Abi Talib. He was known for his bravery at that time."
hi: Aur rahi baat "Hashim Al-A'war" (aik-aankh wale) ki, to woh Utbah bin Abi Waqqas ke bete hain, unhone Fatah-e-Makkah ke din Islam qubool kiya, aur woh aik-aankh wale the, unki aankh Yarmook ke din phoot gayi thi, aur woh Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ke bhatije hain, unhone Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke sath Siffin mein shirkat ki, aur us din woh paidal fauj ke ameer the.

e: [AI] "Wakhuzaymatu ibnu Thabit ibni al-Fakih ibni Tha'laba ibni Sa'idah ibni 'Amir ibni Ghayyan ibni 'Amir ibni Khatmah ibni Jusham, and he is known as Abu 'Umamah, the companion of the flag of Khatmah on the day of victory."
hi: Khuzaimah bin Thabit bin Al-Fakih bin Tha'labah bin Saa'idah bin Aamir bin Ghayyaan bin Aamir bin Khatmah bin Jusham (RA), aur woh Dhush-Shahadatain (do gawahiyon wale) hain, unki kunniyat Abu Umaarah thi, Fatah ke din Khatmah (qabile) ke jhande ke saathi.

e: [AI] "Khuzaimah bin Thabit bin Al-Fakih bin Tha'labah bin Sa'idah bin 'Amir bin Ghayyan bin 'Amir bin Khatmah, who is known as the witness of two testimonies, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  made his testimony equal to the testimony of two men." The Prophet ﷺ  informed that he saw in a dream as if he prostrated on the forehead of the Prophet ﷺ , so the Prophet ﷺ  laid down for him until he prostrated on his forehead. Ibn Ishaq said, "He was killed with Ali in the battle of Siffin after the killing of Ammar bin Yasir."
hi: Khuzaimah bin Thabit bin Al-Fakih bin Tha'labah bin Saa'idah bin Aamir bin Ghayyaan bin Aamir bin Khatmah (RA), aur woh Dhush-Shahadatain hain, Rasulullah (SAW) ne unki gawahi ko do aadmiyon ki gawahi ke barabar rakha. Aur unhone Nabi (SAW) ko bataaya ke unhone khwaab mein dekha goya woh Nabi (SAW) ki peshaani par sajda kar rahe hain, to Nabi (SAW) ne unke liye letkar unhein apni peshaani par sajda karne diya. Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: "Woh Ali (RA) ke sath Siffin mein, Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ki shahaadat ke baad, qatl kiye gaye."

e: [AI] One of them is called Dahraj, and the other is called Abdullah.
hi: Unme se aik ko Dahraj kaha jaata hai aur doosre ko Abdullah.

e: [AI] "I heard the Prophet of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'The rebellious group will kill 'Ammaar.'" He asked for his sword and fought until he was killed." Al-Dhahabi remained silent in summarizing this.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Ammar ko zaalim (baaghi) giroh qatl karega." Unhone kaha: to unhone apni talwaar nikaali aur jung karte rahe yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] His uncle, [the poet] Al-Bahr Al-Rajz, praised the young man named Namari, who was captured by the Romans, while my family is loyal to the Prophet. He said, "And the Prophet is the name of the village where its people were. Suhaib was brought up among the Romans and he owned a slave dog from them. Then he came to Makkah and Abdullah ibn Jud'an Al-Tamimi bought him and freed him. Suhaib stayed with him in Makkah until Abdullah ibn Jud'an passed away. Then the Prophet ﷺ was sent."
hi: Unke chacha ne (bahr Ar-Rajaz mein) kaha: "Main Allah ki qasam deta houn us jawaan An-Namari (Namir qabile ke) ko, jise Rome le gaya, jabke mera khaandaan An-Nabi (gaanv) mein hai." Unhone kaha: aur 'An-Nabi' us basti ka naam tha jahan unke ghar wale rehte the. To Suhaib Rome mein pale-badhe, phir Banu Kalb ne unhein unse khareed liya, phir woh unhein lekar Makkah aaye, to Abdullah bin Jud'an At-Taimi ne unhein khareeda aur aazaad kar diya, to woh Makkah mein unke sath rahe yahan tak ke Abdullah bin Jud'an ka intiqaal ho gaya, aur Nabi (SAW) ko Nabuwwat mili.

e: [AI] "Suhayb, also known as Abu Yahya, was Suhayb ibn Sinan al-Namari from the tribe of Namir ibn Qasit. He was captured and taken as a prisoner and ended up in the land of the Romans. It is said that Suhayb al-Rum (Suhayb of the Romans) reached the age of seventy years. He used to dye his hair with henna. He passed away in Madinah in the month of Shawwal in the thirty-eighth year and was buried in Al-Baqi' cemetery."
hi: "Suhaib (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Yahya thi, aur woh Suhaib bin Sinaan An-Namari, An-Namir bin Qasit (qabile) se the, unhein qaid kiya gaya tha aur woh Rome ki zameen mein pahunch gaye," to unhein 'Suhaib Ar-Rumi' (Rome wale Suhaib) kaha jaane laga, woh sattar (70) saal tak pahunche, aur woh apne baal mehndi se rangte the, unka intiqaal Madinah mein, Shawwal, atthees (38) hijri mein hua, aur unhein Baqee' mein dafan kiya gaya.

e: [AI] When Suhaib (may Allah be pleased with him) migrated, the people of Makkah followed him and confiscated his belongings. So, he took out forty arrows from his possessions and said, "You are not allowed to approach me until I have put an arrow in each of you. Then, I will turn to my sword, and you will know that I am a man who left behind two valuable assets in Makkah, which are now yours." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this incident in his summary.
hi: Jab Suhaib (RA) hijrat karte huay nikle, to Makkah walon ne unka peecha kiya, to unhone apna teerdaan phaila diya aur usme se chalis (40) teer nikale, phir kaha: "Tum mujhtak nahi pahunch sakte jab tak main tum mein se har aadmi ko aik-aik teer na maar loon, phir talwaar ki taraf palat jaaunga, tab tumhein pata chalega ke main aik (bahaadur) aadmi houn, aur maine Makkah mein do laundiyaan chhodi hain, woh tumhari hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] "And Allah, Exalted and Mighty, said, 'We did not make for him before this a name.' (Surah Maryam, 19:7)

He (Prophet Muhammad) said, 'Certainly, He (Allah) said, 'And indeed, you do not withhold [superfluously] anything but that you spent it, and He also said, 'Indeed, you are called to the collector of sadaqah (zakah), and you are among the emigrants from whom Allah has favored.' (Surah At-Tawbah, 9:75)

So, Suhaib said, 'Regarding the statement, 'Indeed, I used to go by the name Abu Yahya, for surely Allah's Messenger ﷺ  used to call me Abu Yahya. As for the statement, 'I do not withhold anything but that I spend it,' indeed Allah the Exalted says, 'And whatever you spend of anything, He will replace it. And He is the best of providers.' (Surah Saba, 34:39) And as for the statement, 'Indeed, I am called to the collector of sadaqah (zakah),' surely among the Arabs, they curse each other. So a group of Arabs cursed me after I had known my family and upbringing. They sold me for a black slave in Kufa (Iraq). So, I took their language, and if I were to belong to a lowly family, I would not be associated with anything except them.' He (the narrator) said, 'You have spoken the truth.'"
hi: Aur Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne farmaya: "{Humne unse pehle kisi ka humnaam nahi rakha}" (Surah Maryam 7). Unhone kaha: unse kaha gaya: 'Tum kuch bhi apne paas nahi rakhte magar kharch kar dete ho.' Unhone kaha: unse kaha gaya: 'Aur tumhein An-Namir bin Qasit (qabile) ki taraf pukaara jaata hai, jabke tum un Muhajireen mein se ho jinpar Allah ne inaam kiya.' To Suhaib ne kaha: "Rahi baat is baat ki ke maine apni kunniyat Abu Yahya rakhi hai, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne khud mujhe Abu Yahya ki kunniyat di thi. Aur rahi baat is baat ki ke main kuch bhi apne paas nahi rakhta magar kharch kar deta houn, to Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: {Aur jo kuch tum kharch karoge, woh uska badla dega, aur woh behtareen rizq dene wala hai} (Surah Saba 39). Aur rahi baat is baat ki ke mujhe An-Namir bin Qasit ki taraf pukaara jaata hai, to Arab aapas mein aik doosre ko qaid karte the, to Arab ke aik giroh ne mujhe qaid kar liya iske baad ke main apne ghar walon aur apni paidaish ko jaanta tha, to unhone mujhe Sawaad-e-Kufa (Kufa ke zarkhez ilaaqe) mein bech diya, to maine unki zubaan seekh li, aur agar main kisi kamtar khaandaan se hota, to main sirf usi ki taraf nisbat karta." Unhone kaha: 'Tumne sach kaha.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I was never made a messenger of Allah ﷺ  between myself and the enemy, and I was never positioned to his right, left, or front." The narration is authentic, but it was not mentioned in Sahih Bukhari.
hi: "Maine kabhi Rasulullah (SAW) ko apne aur dushman ke darmiyan nahi rakha, aur main hamesha unke daayen, unke aage, ya unke baayen raha." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during the time of migration while he was eating dates. So, I approached and started eating from the dates with an afflicted eye. He said, 'Are you eating dates while having an afflicted eye?' I replied, 'I am only eating from the healthy side of my face, which is not afflicted.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  laughed and said, 'The chain of narration is sound and they did not mention this incident.'"
hi: Main hijrat karte huay Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahuncha jabke woh khajoor kha rahe the, to main bhi khajoor khaane laga, aur meri aankh mein ramad (sujan) thi, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum khajoor khaa rahe ho jabke tumhari aankh mein ramad hai?" Maine kaha: 'Main to apni sahi taraf se kha raha houn jisme ramad nahi hai.' To Rasulullah (SAW) hanse. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e:
[AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say about the early emigrants, "They are the forerunners, the intercessors and those who are guided by their Lord, Most Blessed and Exalted. By the One in whose hand my soul is, they will come on the Day of Resurrection with weapons on their shoulders, knocking on the door of Paradise. The treasurer will ask them, 'Who are you?' They will reply, 'We are the emigrants.' The treasurer will ask them, 'Have you been accounted for?' They will prostrate on their knees, scatter what is in their pockets, and raise their hands towards the sky, saying, 'O Lord, and what will be our accountability? We left our families, wealth, and children.' Allah will present them with wings made of gold adorned with emerald and ruby, and they will fly until they enter Paradise.' This is what Allah, the Exalted, said: 'And they will say, 'Praise be to Allah, who has removed sorrow from us'.' (Quran 35:34) until 'Away from grief.' (Quran 35:35)"

Abu Hudhayfah said, "Hudhayfah said, 'Saify said, 'Suhayb said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'They will have in Paradise ranks higher than those they had in the world.' The chain of narration is unknown, and the content is strange.' Abu Hurayrah mentioned this in the virtues of Suhayb because he was one of the early emigrants. The narrator of the hadith is Abu 'Amr, our ascetic sheikh, may Allah have mercy on him." On the contrary, the narration and its chain of narration are authentic.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko pehle Muhajireen ke baare mein farmate suna: woh sabqat rakhne wale, sifaarish karne wale, apne Rab, buzurg aur buland, ke saamne (apna amal) pesh karne wale hain, aur us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, woh Qayamat ke din is haal mein aayenge ke unke kandhon par hathiyaar honge, woh Jannat ka darwaaza khatkhataayenge, to khazaanchi farishte unse poochenge: tum kaun ho? To woh kahenge: hum Muhajireen hain. To khazaanchi farishte poochenge: kya tumhara hisaab liya gaya? To woh apne ghutnon ke bal baith jaayenge, apne teerdaanon mein jo kuch hai woh bikher denge, aur apne haath aasman ki taraf uthaayenge, kahenge: Aye Rab, aur humse kis cheez ka hisaab liya jaaye? Hum to nikle aur humne apne ghar wale, maal, aur aulaad chhod diye. To Allah unke liye sone ke par banaayega jo zabarjad aur yaqoot se jade huay honge, to woh urenge yahan tak ke Jannat mein dakhil ho jaayenge, to yehi hai Allah ka farmaan: "{Aur unhone kaha: sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne humse gham door kiya}" (Surah Fatir 34) is aayat tak "{thakaan}" (Surah Fatir 35). Abu Hudhaifah ne kaha: Hudhaifah ne kaha: Saifi ne kaha: Suhaib ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "To unhein Jannat mein apni manzilon ka utna hi pata hoga jitna duniya mein apni manzilon ka pata tha." Isnad aur matan ajeeb-o-ghareeb hai. "Maine ise Suhaib ki fazeelaton mein zikr kiya hai kyunke woh pehle Muhajireen mein se hain, aur is hadith ke raawi unki aulaad hain, aur hadith unke saathiyon ke liye hai, aur humne ise sirf apne ustaad, zaahid Abu Amr, Allah unpar reham kare, se hi likha hai." Balke yeh jhoot hai aur iski isnad andheri (na-mo'tabar) hai.

e: [AI] "I accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before the revelation was sent to him. The chain of narration is authentic and it was not mentioned in Sahih."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ki sohbat ikhtiyar ki isse pehle ke unpar wahi nazil hoti." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I have been shown the land of your migration as a fertile land between two lava fields. It can either be a land of migration or it can be called Yathrib." He ﷺ then left for Madinah, Abu Bakr accompanied him and I had wanted to go with him. However, two young boys from the tribe of Quraish stopped me, so I spent that night standing and not sitting. They said, "Allah has kept him away from you with his belly." I did not complain, and they left. Some people from them caught up with me after I had walked for a while to confront me. I said to them, "Can I give you some bags of gold and you let me go on my way and not bother me?" So I followed them to Makkah and said to them, "Dig under the doorsteps, as the bags will be under them." They went to a certain woman and took the two bags and then I continued on until I reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before he entered Quba. When he saw me he said, "O Abu Yahya, the transaction has been profitable." He said this three times. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, no one preceded me in coming to you, and no one has informed you except Jibreel, peace be upon him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe tumhari hijrat ki jagah dikhaayi gayi hai, aik khaari (namkeen) zameen jo do harron (kaale patthar wali zameen) ke darmiyan hai, ya to woh Hajar hogi ya Yathrib." Unhone kaha: aur Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah ki taraf nikle, aur unke sath Abu Bakr (RA) nikle, aur main bhi unke sath nikalne ka iraada rakhta tha, to Quraish ke kuch jawaanon ne mujhe roka, to main us raat khada rehta aur baitha nahi, unhone kaha: 'Allah ne isse (Suhaib ko) apne pait (bimaari) ki wajah se hum se alag rakha,' jabke main bimaar nahi tha, to woh khade ho gaye, phir unme se kuch log mere peeche aa gaye jab main aik manzil (safar ki doori) tak ja chuka tha, taake mujhe wapas le jaayein, to maine unse kaha: 'Kya tum chaahte ho ke main tumhein sone ki kuch auqiyaan doon aur tum mera raasta chhod do aur mujhse ahd karo?' To main unke sath Makkah gaya, maine unse kaha: 'Darwaaze ki dehleez ke neeche khodo, kyunke uske neeche auqiyaan hain, aur fulani ke paas jaao aur do jode (kapdon ke) le lo.' Aur main nikla yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahuncha isse pehle ke woh wahan se (Quba se) mudte, jab unhone mujhe dekha, to farmaya: "Aye Abu Yahya, sauda faayde mein raha," teen martaba. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhse pehle koi aapke paas nahi pahuncha, aur aapko Jibreel (AS) ke siwa kisi ne nahi bataaya.'

e: [AI] "Suhayb redeemed his family from Mecca with his wealth, then he left as a migrant. They caught up with him on the way, and he gave them what remained of his wealth."
hi: Beshak Suhaib (RA) ne Makkah se apne ghar walon ko apne maal se chhudaaya, phir hijrat karte huay nikle, to unhone unhein raaste mein pakad liya, to unhone unhein apna baqi maal bhi nikaal kar de diya.

e: [AI] The translation is as follows: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say: 'O Allah, You are not a god that we invented, nor a Lord that we created, and there was no one for us to turn to before You, and we do not seek help or support from anyone besides You, and we do not associate anyone with You in worship. Blessed and exalted are You.' Ka'b al-Ahbar said: 'The Prophet ﷺ  used to supplicate with this.' This hadith has a sound chain of narration, but it has not been included in any of the hadith collections."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) dua kiya karte the: "Aye Allah, beshak Tu na koi aisa ma'bood hai jo humne khud banaaya ho, aur na koi aisa Rab hai jo humne khud ghadaa ho, aur na Tujhse pehle humara koi tha jiski taraf hum panaah lete aur Tujhe chhod dete, aur na kisi ne humein banaane mein Teri madad ki jismein hum usse Tera shareek theharaayein, Tu barkat wala aur buland hai." Ka'b Al-Ahbar ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) isi se dua kiya karte the." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not hate Suhaib." It is a saheeh (authentic) narration and it has not been excluded.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suhaib se dushmani mat rakho." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Love Suhaib with the love a mother has for her child.' The chain of narration is reliable."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Suhaib se mohabbat karo jaisi maa apni aulaad se karti hai." Isnad kamzor hai.

e: [AI] Suhayb used to say to us, "Come, let me tell you about our expeditions." As for us saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No."
hi: Suhaib (RA) humse kaha karte the: "Aao, hum tumhein apne ghazwon (jangon) ke baare mein bataayen, lekin rahi baat yeh kehna ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya, to nahi (aisa nahi karunga)."

e: [AI] I said to Abu Suhayb, "Why don't you talk about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as your companions do?" He said, "My son, I have heard just as they have heard, but what prevents me from talking is that I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'Whoever intentionally lies about me will surely be destined to tie two barley stalks together, and he will never be able to do it.'" Amru is weak.
hi: Maine Abu Suhaib se kaha: 'Aapko kya hua aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein waisi hadithein bayan nahi karte jaisi aapke saathi karte hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Aye mere bete, maine bhi wohi suna hai jo unhone suna, lekin mujhe hadith bayan karne se sirf yeh cheez rokti hai ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: jo koi jaan-boojh kar mujhpar jhoot bole, use Qayamat ke din juhein ke do sirey baandhne ka hukum diya jaayega, aur woh kabhi unhein nahi baandh paayega.' Amr kamzor hain.

e: [AI] Umar ordered Suhaib, the slave of Bani Jadaan, to lead the people in prayer. Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in the summary.
hi: Jab Umar (RA) ko zakhmi kiya gaya, to unhone Suhaib (RA), Banu Jud'an ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam, ko hukum diya ke woh logon ki imaamat karein. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Suhaib ibn Sinan is an ally of Abdullah ibn Jud'an Al-Taymi."
hi: "Suhaib bin Sinan (RA), Abdullah bin Jud'an At-Taimi ke ahd-waale saathi."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are four who excelled. I am the foremost among the Arabs, Suhaib is the foremost among the Romans, Salman is the foremost among the Persians, and Bilal is the foremost among the Abyssinians." [Sources: [Jami` al-Tirmidhi]]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabqat rakhne wale chaar hain: main Arabon mein sabqat rakhta houn, Suhaib Romiyon mein sabqat rakhta hai, Salman Farsiyon mein sabqat rakhta hai, aur Bilal Habshiyon mein sabqat rakhta hai." Ammarah bin Zaadhaan kamzor hain.

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Ma'in say that Uwais Al-Qarani was killed in front of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali bin Abi Talib on the day of Siffin.
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna ke Uwais Al-Qarani, Ameer-ul-Momineen Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke saamne, Siffin ke din, qatl kiye gaye.

e: [AI] "When it was the day of Siffin, a caller from the companions of Muawiyah called out to the companions of Ali, 'Is Uwais al-Qarni among you?' They replied, 'Yes.' He then struck his mount until he reached them, and then said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The best of the followers is Uwais al-Qarni."' The Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: Jab Siffin ka din hua, to Mu'awiyah (RA) ke saathiyon mein se aik pukaarne wale ne Ali (RA) ke saathiyon se pukaara: "Kya tum mein Uwais Al-Qarani hain?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." To usne apni sawaari maari yahan tak ke unke sath aa milaa, phir kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: behtareen Taabi'een mein Uwais Al-Qarani hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I witnessed Ali on the day of Siffin while he was saying, "Who will pledge allegiance to me for death?" or he said, "For fighting?" So ninety-nine people pledged allegiance to him. He then said, "Where is Tammam? Where is the one I was promised?" A man then came to him wearing a turban made of sheep's wool, and pledged allegiance to him for death and killing. It was said that this man was Uwais al-Qarani. He continued to fight until he was killed.
hi: Maine Ali (RA) ko Siffin ke din dekha, woh keh rahe the: "Kaun mujhse maut par baiyat karega?" ya kaha: "Jung par?" To ninnyanawe (99) logon ne unse baiyat ki. Unhone kaha: to unhone poocha: "Takmeel (poora karne wala) kahan hai? Jiska mujhse wa'da kiya gaya tha, woh kahan hai?" Unhone kaha: to aik aadmi aaya jispar oon ke phate-purane kapde the, sar mundwaaya hua, to usne maut aur qatl honay par unse baiyat ki. Unhone kaha: kaha gaya ke yeh Uwais Al-Qarani hain, aur woh unke saamne jung karte rahe yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye.

e: Is there amongst you Uwais b. 'Amir? (He continued finding him out) until he met Uwais. He said: Are you Uwais b., Amir? He said: Yes. He said: Are you from the tribe of Qaran? He said: Yes. He (Hadrat) 'Umar (again) said: Did you suffer from leprosy and then you were cured from it but for the space of a dirham? He said: Yes. He ('Umar) said: Is your mother (living)? He said: Yes. He ('Umar) said: I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: There would come to you Uwais b. Amir with the reinforcement from the people of Yemen. (He would be) from Qaran, (the branch) of Murid. He had been suffering from leprosy from which he was cured but for a spot of a dirham. His treatment with his mother would have been excellent. If he were to take an oath in the name of Allah, He would honour that. And if it is possible for you, then do ask him to beg forgiveness for you (from your Lord). So he (Uwais) begged forgiveness for him. Umar said: Where do you intend to go? He said: To Kufa. He ('Umar) said: Let me write a letter for you to its governor, whereupon he (Uwais) said: I love to live amongst the poor people. When it was the next year, a person from among the elite (of Kufa) performed Hajj and he met Umar. He asked him about Uwais. He said: I left him in a state with meagre means of sustenance. (Thereupon) Umar said: I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: There would come to you Uwais b. 'Amir, of Qaran, a branch (of the tribe) of Murid, along with the reinforcement of the people of Yemen. He had been suffering from leprosy which would have been cured but for the space of a dirham. His treatment with his mother would have been very kind. If he would take an oath in the name of Allah (for something) He would honour it. Ask him to beg forgiveness for you (from Allah) in case it is possible for you. So he came to Uwais and said.: Beg forgiveness (from Allah) for me. He (Uwais) said: You have just come from a sacred journey (Hajj) ; you, therefore, ask forgiveness for me. He (the person who had performed Hajj) said: Ask forgiveness for me (from Allah). He (Uwais again) said: You have just come from the sacred journey, so you ask forgiveness for me. (Uwais further) said: Did you meet Umar? He said: Yes. He (Uwais) then begged forgiveness for him (from Allah). So the people came to know about (the status of religious piety) of Uwais. He went away (from that place). Usair said: His clothing consisted of a mantle, and whosoever saw him said: From where did Uwais get this mantle? (Using translation from Muslim 2542c)
hi: Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) jab unke paas Yemen ki madad (afwaaj) aati, to woh unse poochte: 'Kya tum mein Uwais bin Aamir hain?' yahan tak ke Uwais unke paas aaye, to unhone poocha: 'Tum Uwais bin Aamir ho?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Unhone poocha: 'Murad se, phir Qaran se?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Unhone poocha: 'Tumhein safed daag (bimaari) thi, to woh theek ho gayi siwaye aik dirham ki jagah ke?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Unhone poocha: 'Kya tumhari maa hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Umar (RA) ne kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Tumhare paas Uwais bin Aamir aayenge, Yemen ki afwaaj ke sath, Murad se, phir Qaran se, unhein safed daag tha jo theek ho gaya siwaye aik dirham ki jagah ke, unki aik maa hai jinke sath woh bohot neik hain, agar woh Allah ki qasam khaayein, to Allah unki qasam poori kar de, isliye agar tum unse apne liye maghfirat ki dua karwa sako, to karwaana." To Uwais ne kaha: "Mere liye maghfirat ki dua karein." To Umar (RA) ne unke liye dua ki. Phir Umar (RA) ne poocha: 'Kahan jaana chaahte ho?' Unhone kaha: 'Kufa.' Umar (RA) ne kaha: 'Kya main tumhare liye wahan ke ameeron ko khat na likh doon taake woh tumhara khayaal rakhein?' Unhone kaha: 'Nahi, mujhe aam logon mein rehna zyada pasand hai.' Jab agla saal aaya, to unke sharifon mein se aik aadmi Hajj ke liye aaya, to Umar (RA) ne Uwais ke baare mein poocha: 'Tumne unhein kaisa chhoda?' Usne kaha: 'Maine unhein purane ghar aur kam saamaan mein chhoda.' Umar (RA) ne kaha: maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Tumhare paas Uwais bin Aamir aayenge, Yemen walon ki afwaaj ke sath, Murad se, phir Qaran se, unhein safed daag tha jo theek ho gaya siwaye aik dirham ki jagah ke, unki aik maa hai jinke sath woh bohot neik hain, agar woh Allah ki qasam khaayein, to Allah unki qasam poori kar de, isliye agar tum unse apne liye maghfirat ki dua karwa sako, to karwaana." Jab woh aadmi wapas pahuncha, to Uwais ke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Mere liye maghfirat ki dua karein.' Unhone kaha: 'Aap abhi-abhi aik neik safar (Hajj) se aaye hain, aap hi mere liye dua karein.' Usne poocha: 'Kya aap Umar bin Al-Khattab se mile the?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' To unhone uske liye dua ki. Unhone kaha: to log unhein pehchaanne lage, to woh apne raaste par nikal gaye. Usair ne kaha: maine unhein aik chaadar pehnaayi, to jab bhi koi unhein isme dekhta, to poochta: 'Uwais ko yeh kahan se mili?'

e: [AI] As the people of Yemen approached, Umar began to gather companions and asked them, "Is there anyone among you from Qaran?" Until a man from Qaran came to him and Umar asked, "Who are you?" They replied, "I am Qaran." Umar then held him by the collar and recognized him by his distinctive appearance. Umar asked him, "What is your name?" He replied, "My name is Uwais." Umar asked him, "Do you have a mother?" He said, "Yes." Umar asked, "Do you have any white spots on your body?" He replied, "Yes, I prayed to Allah to remove it from my body except for the size of a dirham, so that I may remember my Lord with it." Umar said to him, "Ask forgiveness for me." He replied, "You are more deserving to ask forgiveness for me. You are the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Umar said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'The best follower is a man named Uwais Al-Qarni. He has a mother and he has white spots on his body. He supplicated to his Lord, and he was cured except for the size of a dirham on his shin, which he uses to remember his Lord with.'" Umar then requested forgiveness from him. Uwais went among the people, but Umar did not know where he went. Uwais arrived in Kufa and we used to gather in a circle to remember Allah, and he would sit among us. When he mentioned something, it remained fixed in our hearts, and no other speech could take its place. One day, I lost him, so I asked my companion, "What happened to the man who used to join us?" He said, "Who are you referring to?" I asked, "Who is that?" He said, "That is Uwais Al-Qarni." I then found out where he was staying and I went to see him. I said to him, "May Allah have mercy on you, where have you been and why did you leave us?" He replied, "I did not have a garment, so it prevented me from coming to you." I then took off my own garment and threw it to him. He threw it back to me saying, "I delayed wearing it for an hour." Then he said, "If I had taken this garment from you and worn it, my people would have seen me in it, and they would have thought, 'This is the one they accuse of being a self-indulgent.' So I took off my own garment and threw it back to him and said, "Leave until I hear what they say." So he wore the garment and we left together. When he passed by his people's gathering, they said, "Look at this self-indulgent one, he has not stopped with anyone until he deceived him and took his garment." I said to him, "Are you not ashamed? Why did you harm him?" By Allah, I presented it to him and he refused to accept it." Uwais replied, "Delegations from various Arab tribes came to Umar and their leader said to him, 'O Umar bin Khattab, is there anyone among you from Qaran?' Umar asked him, 'Are you their leader?' He replied, 'Yes, I am.' Umar then asked him, 'Do you know a man from Qaran named Uwais who has such and such characteristics?' The leader of the delegation said, 'O Amir-ul-Mu'minin, why do you mention this person and his matters?' Umar said to him, 'May your mother be bereaved of you! I encountered him two or three times.' Then Umar said, 'When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  mentioned him to us, he said, 'A man named Uwais bin 'Amir from Qaran will come to you, and he has such and such characteristics.' When the man came, he did not start with anyone before Umar, so he went to him and asked for forgiveness. Umar asked him, 'What prayer have you made for me?' He replied, 'Umar said such and such to me.' Umar said, 'I am not asking for forgiveness for you until you make three promises.' Uwais asked, 'What are they?' Umar said, 'Do not afflict me with what remains for you, and do not inform anyone about what Umar said to you, and forget the third one.'"
hi: Jab Yemen wale aaye, to Umar (RA) qaafile se qaafile poochte the: 'Kya tum mein Qaran se koi hai?' yahan tak ke Qaran (qabile) unke paas aaya, to unhone poocha: 'Tum kaun ho?' Unhone kaha: 'Qaran.' To Umar (RA) ne kisi ki lagaam ya Uwais ki lagaam uthaayi, to Umar (RA) ne unhein pehchaan liya nishaani se, aur unse poocha: 'Tumhara naam kya hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Main Uwais houn.' Unhone poocha: 'Kya tumhari maa hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Unhone poocha: 'Kya tumhein koi safedi hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan, maine Allah Ta'ala se dua ki, to usne mujhse usse door kar diya siwaye naabhi ke paas aik dirham ki jagah ke, taake main usse apne Rab ko yaad karoon.' To Umar (RA) ne unse kaha: 'Mere liye maghfirat ki dua karein.' Unhone kaha: 'Aap zyada haqdaar hain ke mere liye maghfirat ki dua karein, aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain.' To Umar (RA) ne kaha: 'Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: behtareen Taabi'een mein aik aadmi hai jise Uwais Al-Qarani kaha jaata hai, unki aik maa hai, aur unhein safedi thi, to unhone apne Rab se dua ki, to usne unse door kar di siwaye naabhi ke paas aik dirham ki jagah ke.' Unhone kaha: to unhone uske liye dua ki. Unhone kaha: phir woh logon ki bheed mein chale gaye, to pata na chala ke woh kahan gaye. Unhone kaha: phir woh Kufa aaye, to hum aik halqe mein jama hote the aur Allah ka zikr karte the, aur woh humare sath baithte, aur jab woh humein yaad dilaate, to unki baat humare dilon mein aisi jagah banaati jo doosri kisi baat ki nahi banti thi. Aik din maine unhein na paaya, to maine apne aik sathi se poocha: 'Us aadmi ka kya hua jo humare sath baithta tha? Shaayad woh bimaar ho gaye?' Aik aadmi ne poocha: 'Kaun?' Maine kaha: 'Kaun?' Usne kaha: 'Woh Uwais Al-Qarani hain.' To mujhe unke ghar ka pata bataaya gaya, main unke paas gaya, maine kaha: 'Allah aap par reham kare, aap kahan the? Aapne humein kyun chhod diya?' Unhone kaha: 'Mere paas koi chaadar nahi thi, isi ne mujhe tumhare paas aane se roka.' Unhone kaha: to maine apni chaadar unke taraf daali, unhone woh mujhe wapas phenk di. Unhone kaha: main aik lamhe ke liye khaali reh gaya, phir unhone kaha: 'Agar main tumhari yeh chaadar le loon aur ise pehnoon, to mere log mujhe isme dekhenge, kahenge: is dikhaawe wale ko dekho, yeh is aadmi ke sath laga raha yahan tak ke usse dhoka diya aur uski chaadar le li.' Unhone kaha: to main unhein raazi karta raha yahan tak ke unhone ise le liya. Maine kaha: 'Chalein, taake main sunoon woh kya kehte hain.' To unhone chaadar pehni, hum nikle, to woh apni qaum ki majlis se guzre, unhone kaha: 'Is dikhaawe wale ko dekho, yeh is aadmi ke sath laga raha yahan tak ke usse dhoka diya aur uski chaadar le li.' Maine unki taraf mudhkar kaha: 'Kya tumhein sharm nahi aati, tum unhein kyun takleef dete ho? Allah ki qasam, maine yeh unhein pesh ki thi, unhone lene se inkaar kiya tha.' Unhone kaha: Arab qabaail ke wafd Umar ke paas aaye, unme unki qaum ka sardaar bhi aaya, to Umar bin Al-Khattab ne unse poocha: 'Kya tum mein Qaran se koi hai?' To unke sardaar ne kaha: 'Ji haan, main houn.' Unhone unse poocha: 'Kya tum Qaran ke rehne wale aik aadmi ko jaante ho jise Uwais kehte hain, uska yeh aur yeh haal hai?' Usne kaha: 'Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aap unka zikr kyun kar rahe hain?' To Umar (RA) ne unse kaha: 'Teri maa tujhe kho de, unhein do ya teen baar (dhoondo) pao.' Phir kaha: 'Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse farmaya: aik aadmi jise Uwais kehte hain, Qaran se, uska yeh aur yeh haal hai.' Jab woh aadmi wapas aaya, to usne (Uwais ko dhoondne se pehle) kisi se baat nahi ki, seedha unke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Mere liye maghfirat ki dua karein.' Unhone poocha: 'Tumhein kya hua?' Usne kaha: 'Umar ne mujhse yeh aur yeh kaha.' Unhone kaha: 'Main tumhare liye maghfirat ki dua nahi karunga jab tak tum mujhse teen (waade) na karo.' Usne poocha: 'Woh kya hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Baaqi zindagi mujhe takleef mat dena, aur jo kuch Umar ne tumse kaha, kisi ko mat batana,' aur teesri baat bhool gaye.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A man from my Ummah will enter Paradise with the intercession of a man named Rabiahah and Mudar, more than them." Hisham narrated to me from Hawshab, from Al-Hasan, that he was Uwais Al-Qarni. Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash said, "So I said to a man from his people, Uwais, 'By what means did he achieve this?' He said, 'It is the favor of Allah, He gives it to whom He wills.'" Al-Dhahabi did not comment on this in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jannat mein meri Ummat ke aik aadmi ki sifaarish se Rabee'ah aur Mudar (do bade qabeele) se zyada log dakhil honge." Hisham ne kaha: mujhe Hawshab ne Al-Hasan se bataaya ke woh (aadmi) Uwais Al-Qarani hain. Abu Bakr bin Ayyash ne kaha: to maine unki qaum ke aik aadmi se poocha: "Uwais yeh martaba kaise paayi?" Usne kaha: "Allah ka fazl hai, jise chaahe deta hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Awais Al-Qarni used to have a cloak, when he sat it touched the ground. He used to say, "O Allah, I seek your forgiveness from every hungry liver and naked body. I have nothing except what is on my back and in my stomach."
hi: Uwais Al-Qarani ke paas aik chaadar thi jo jab woh baithte to zameen ko chhoo leti, aur woh kaha karte the: "Aye Allah, main Teri baaragaah mein har bhooke pet aur nange badan ke liye maafi maangta houn, aur mere paas sirf woh hai jo mere kandhon par hai aur mere pait mein hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Awais Al-Qarni said, "Be in the command of Allah as if you have killed all the people." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it when summarizing.
hi: Uwais Al-Qarani (ne kaha): "Allah ke maamle mein aise raho jaise tumne sab logon ko qatl kar diya ho (yaani hisaab ka poora ehsaas rakho)." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "A man from Murad came to Uwais Al-Qarani and greeted him saying, 'Peace be upon you.' Uwais replied, 'And upon you.' The man asked, 'How are you, Uwais?' Uwais replied, 'Praise be to Allah.' The man asked, 'How is the time treating you?' Uwais replied, 'Do not ask a man who has not experienced the evening if it has become morning, and do not ask a man who has not experienced the morning if it has become evening. O brother of Murad, there is no joy remaining for a believer in death. O brother of Murad, the recognition of a believer with the rights of Allah does not leave him with any silver or gold. O brother of Murad, if a believer fulfills the command of Allah, he will have no companion left. By Allah, we command them to do good and forbid them from evil, but they consider us enemies. And verily, among the evildoers, they find support. By Allah, they accuse us of great sins, but that will not prevent me from speaking the truth.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: Murad qabile ka aik aadmi Uwais Al-Qarani ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Assalaamu Alaikum." Unhone kaha: "Wa Alaikum." Usne poocha: "Aap kaise hain, Aye Uwais?" Unhone kaha: "Alhamdulillah." Usne poocha: "Zamaana aap par kaisa hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aadmi se mat poocho, jab shaam hoti hai to usse yaqeen nahi hota ke woh subah dekhega, aur jab subah hoti hai to usse yaqeen nahi hota ke woh shaam dekhega, Aye Murad ke bhai, maut ne kisi momin ke liye (duniya mein) koi lambi khushi baaqi nahi rehne di, Aye Murad ke bhai, momin ka Allah ke haqooq ka ehsaas usse chaandi ya sona baaqi nahi rehne deta, Aye Murad ke bhai, momin ka Allah ke hukum par qaayam rehna usse koi dost baaqi nahi rehne deta, Allah ki qasam, hum unhein neki ka hukum dete hain aur buraai se rokte hain, to woh humein dushman samajhte hain, aur fasiqon mein isi par madadgaar paate hain, yahan tak ke Allah ki qasam, woh humpar bade ilzaam lagaate hain, aur Allah ki qasam, yeh mujhe haq baat kehne se nahi rokta." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] They mentioned Hajj and asked Uwais Al-Qarani, "Did you perform Hajj?" He replied, "No." They asked him, "Why?" He remained silent. Then, one of them said, "I have a riding animal," another said, "I have provisions," and another said, "I have equipment." So, he accepted from them and performed Hajj with it. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this incident in the summary.
hi: Unhone Hajj ka zikr kiya, to Uwais Al-Qarani se poocha: "Kya aapne Hajj kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi." Unhone poocha: "Kyun?" Unhone khamoshi ikhtiyar ki. To unme se aik ne kaha: 'Mere paas savaari hai,' aur doosre ne kaha: 'Mere paas kharcha hai,' aur teesre ne kaha: 'Mere paas saamaan hai.' To unhone unse yeh qubool kiya aur usi se Hajj kiya.

e:
[AI] I came to Kufa, and I had no concern there except Uways al-Qarani: I searched for him and asked about him until I happened upon him sitting alone on the bank of the Euphrates at midday, performing ablution and washing his garment. I recognized him by the description. There he was: a fleshy man, dark-complexioned, intensely so; hairy, with a shaved head—meaning he had no forelock—thick-bearded, wearing a woolen waist-wrapper and a woolen cloak, without shoes; large-faced, and very awe-inspiring in appearance. I greeted him, and he returned my greeting and looked at me and said, “May God give you life—who are you?” I extended my hand to him to shake his, but he refused to shake my hand and said, “And you—may God give you life.” I said, “May God have mercy on you, O Uways, and forgive you. How are you—may God have mercy on you?” Then jealousy choked me, from my love for him and my tenderness toward him because of what I saw of his condition, until I wept and he wept. Then he said, “And you—may God have mercy on you, O Harim ibn Hayyan. How are you, my brother? Who guided you to me?” I said, “God.” He said, “There is no god but God. Glory be to our Lord: surely the promise of our Lord is to be fulfilled,” when he named me. By God, he had never seen me, nor had I seen him. Then I said, “How did you recognize me, and know my name and my father’s name? For by God I had never seen you before this day.” He said, “The All-Knowing, the All-Aware informed me. My spirit recognized your spirit when my soul spoke to your soul: spirits have breaths like the breaths of the living. The believers recognize one another and converse by God’s Spirit even if they have not met, and even if they have not spoken; they come to know one another, even if lands are distant from them and homes separate them.”

He said: I said, “Tell me a hadith from the Messenger of God ﷺ that I may memorize from you.” He said, “I did not meet the Messenger of God ﷺ, nor did I have companionship with him. I have seen men who saw him, and what has reached me of his hadith is as what has reached you. I do not like to open this door upon myself—so that I become one who relates traditions, or a judge, or one who gives legal opinions; a person has enough to occupy him, O Harim ibn Hayyan.” He said: I said, “My brother, recite to me verses from the Book of God so I may hear them from you, for I love you for God with a strong love. And supplicate with prayers and give counsel with an admonition that I may preserve from you.” He said: he took my hand on the bank of the Euphrates and said, “I seek refuge in God, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan the accursed. In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.” He gasped once, then wept in his place, then said: “My Lord—exalted be His mention—has said, and most rightful of speech is His speech, most truthful of discourse is His discourse, and best of words is His word: {And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them in play; We created them only in truth} [al-Dukhan 39],” until he reached, “{except whom God has mercy upon; indeed He is the Mighty, the Merciful} [al-Dukhan 42].” Then he gasped again and fell silent. I looked at him, thinking he had fainted. Then he said, “O Harim ibn Hayyan, your father has died, and you are soon to die; and Abu Hayyan has died—either to Paradise or to the Fire. Adam has died, and Eve has died, O son of Hayyan; and Noah has died, and Abraham, the intimate friend of the Most Merciful, O son of Hayyan; and Moses, the one spoken to by the Most Merciful, has died, O son of Hayyan; and David, the vicegerent of the Most Merciful, has died, O son of Hayyan; and Muhammad, the Messenger of the Most Merciful, has died, and Abu Bakr, the caliph of the Muslims, has died, O son of Hayyan; and my brother, my chosen one, and my friend, ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab, has died.” Then he said, “Oh ‘Umar!” May God have mercy on ‘Umar—while ‘Umar at that time was still alive, and that was at the end of his caliphate. He said: I said to him, “May God have mercy on you—‘Umar ibn al-Khattab is still alive.” He said, “Yes, if you understand: you have already understood what I said— I and you are among the dead; it has already been.” Then he invoked blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ and made brief supplications. Then he said, “This is my counsel to you, O Harim ibn Hayyan: the Book of God; keeping company with the righteous among the Muslims; and prayer and peace upon the Prophet ﷺ. I have announced death to myself and announced it to you; so keep remembrance of death—do not let it leave you even for a moment. Warn your people when you return to them, and advise all the people of your religion. Strive for your own soul, and beware, beware of separating from the جماعت (the community), lest you separate from your religion without realizing and enter the Fire on the Day of Resurrection.”

Then he said, “O God, this man claims that he loves me for Your sake and has visited me for Your sake. O God, show me his face in Paradise, and admit him to me as a visitor in Your abode, the Abode of Peace. Preserve him so long as he remains in the world, wherever he may be; gather up for him what he has lost; make him content in this world with little; and whatever You give him of this world, make it easy for him; and make him, for what You give him of Your blessing, among the grateful; and reward him with the best reward. I entrust you to God, O Harim ibn Hayyan. Peace be upon you and the mercy of God.”

Then he said to me, “You will not see me after today—may God have mercy on you—for I dislike fame, and solitude is dearer to me, because I am deeply sorrowful and heavily burdened with care so long as I remain alive in this world among these people. Do not ask about me, and do not seek me. Know that you are in my mind even if I do not see you and you do not see me; remember me and pray for me, for I will remember you and pray for you, God willing, exalted is He. Go—here,” until he took this way. He said: I was eager to walk with him for an hour, but he refused, so I parted from him—he weeping and I weeping. He said: I kept looking at his back until he entered one of the alleys. How often I sought him after that and asked about him, yet I found no one who could tell me anything about him. May God have mercy on him and forgive him. No week passed over me except that I saw him in my sleep once or twice—or as he said.
hi: Main Kufa aaya, aur wahan mera koi maqsad nahi tha siwaye Uwais Al-Qarani ki talaash ke, main unhein dhoondta aur unke baare mein poochta raha yahan tak ke main unpar aa gira jabke woh akele, Furat (nadi) ke kinare, dopahar ke waqt, wudu kar rahe the aur apna kapda dho rahe the, to maine unhein unke husn (nishaani) se pehchaan liya, achaanak aik gosht-waala, saanwla, sakht saanwla, baal wala, sar mundwaaya hua aadmi tha - yaani unki koi lat nahi thi - ghani daadhi wala, unpar oon ka tehmad aur oon ki chaadar thi, bina joote ke, bade chehre wale, dekhne mein bohot heybat-daar. Maine unhein salaam kiya, to unhone jawaab diya aur meri taraf dekha, phir kaha: "Allah tumhein zinda rakhe, tum kaun ho?" To maine musafaha ke liye apna haath badhaaya, magar unhone musafaha karne se inkaar kiya aur kaha: "Aur tumhein bhi Allah zinda rakhe." Maine kaha: 'Allah aap par reham kare, Aye Uwais, aur aapko maaf kare, aap kaise hain, Allah aap par reham kare?' Phir mujhe unse mohabbat aur unke liye narmi ki wajah se, unki haalat dekh kar, aisi ghairat ne jakad liya ke main rone laga, aur woh bhi roye. Phir unhone kaha: "Aur Allah aap par reham kare, Aye Harim bin Hayyan, aap kaise hain, mere bhai? Aapko mere paas kisne bheja?" Maine kaha: 'Allah.' Unhone kaha: "Laa ilaaha illallah, humare Rab ki pakeezgi ho, humare Rab ka wa'da zaroor poora hone wala tha, jab usne mera naam liya, Allah ki qasam, maine aapko kabhi nahi dekha tha aur na aapne mujhe." Phir maine kaha: 'Aapne mujhe kaise pehchaana, aur mera naam aur mere waalid ka naam kaise jaana, jabke Allah ki qasam, maine aapko kabhi is din se pehle nahi dekha?'
