Unhone kaha: "Mujhe Aleem, Khabeer ne bataaya, meri rooh ne aapki rooh ko pehchaana jab meri jaan ne aapki jaan se baat ki, beshak roohon ke bhi (apne) jaan hoti hain jaisi zinda logon ki jaan hoti hai, beshak momin aik doosre ko pehchaanate hain aur Allah ki rooh se baat karte hain, agarche woh na milein aur na baat karein aur na aapas mein pehchaanein, agarche unke darmiyan ghar door ho jaayein aur manzilein alag ho jaayein." Maine kaha: 'Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ki koi hadith bataayen jo main aapse yaad rakhoon.' Unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko nahi paaya aur na meri unke sath sohbat thi, aur maine un logon ko dekha hai jinhone unhein dekha, aur mujhe unki hadith utni hi pahunchi hai jitni tumhein pahunchi hai, aur mujhe yeh pasand nahi ke main apne aap par yeh darwaaza kholoon ke main muhaddis ya qaazi ya mufti banoon, apni jaan ke liye kaafi mashghooliyat hai, Aye Harim bin Hayyan." Maine kaha: 'Aye mere bhai, mujhe Allah ki kitaab se kuch aayaten padh kar sunaayen taake main unhein aapse sunoon, kyunke main aapse Allah ke liye bohot mohabbat karta houn, aur kuch dua'en maangein aur mujhe koi naseehat karein jo main aapse yaad rakhoon.' Unhone kaha: to unhone Furat ke kinare mera haath pakda aur kaha: "Main Allah, Sami', Aleem, ki panaah maangta houn shaitan-e-rajeem se, Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem." Unhone kaha: phir unhone aik cheekh maari, phir wahin ro pade, phir kaha: mere Rab ne, uska zikr buland ho, farmaya, aur sabse haq baat uski baat hai, aur sabse sachi hadith uski hadith hai, aur sabse achhi baat uski baat hai: "{Aur humne aasmaanon aur zameen ko aur jo unke darmiyan hai, khel ke taur par nahi banaaya, humne unhein sirf haq ke sath banaaya}" (Surah Ad-Dukhaan 39) yahan tak ke "{Siwaye us ke jispar Allah reham kare, beshak woh Ghaalib, Reham karne wala hai}" (Surah Ad-Dukhaan 42). Phir unhone aik cheekh maari, phir khamosh ho gaye, to main unhein dekhne laga, mujhe laga ke unpar behoshi taari ho gayi hai. Phir unhone kaha: "Aye Harim bin Hayyan, tumhare waalid faut ho gaye, aur tum jald hi marne wale ho, aur Abu Hayyan faut ho gaye, ya to Jannat mein ya Jahannam mein, aur Aadam faut huay aur Hawwa faut hui, Aye Ibn Hayyan, aur Nooh faut huay aur Ibraheem, Rahman ke khaleel, faut huay, Aye Ibn Hayyan, aur Musa, Rahman ke hum-kalaam, faut huay, Aye Ibn Hayyan, aur Dawood, Rahman ke khalifa, faut huay, Aye Ibn Hayyan, aur Muhammad, Rahman ke Rasool, faut huay, aur Abu Bakr, Musalmano ke khalifa, faut huay, Aye Ibn Hayyan, aur mere bhai, mere khaas dost, mere saathi, Umar bin Al-Khattab, faut ho gaye." Phir kaha: "Haaye Umar, Allah Umar par reham kare," jabke Umar us waqt zinda the, aur yeh unki khilafat ke aakhri hisse mein tha. Maine unse kaha: 'Allah aap par reham kare, Umar bin Al-Khattab to abhi zinda hain.' Unhone kaha: "Haan, agar tum samjho, to jo maine kaha woh tumhein maloom ho chuka, main aur tum dono murdon mein shumaar hain, aur jo hona tha woh ho chuka." Phir unhone Nabi (SAW) par durood padha aur halki dua'en maangi, phir kaha: "Yeh meri wasiyat hai tumhare liye, Aye Harim bin Hayyan: Allah ki Kitaab, Musalmano mein se neik logon ki sohbat, aur Nabi (SAW) par durood-o-salaam, aur maine apni maut ka elaan kiya hai aur tumhari bhi maut ka elaan kiya hai, isliye maut ki yaad ko apne se aik pal ke liye bhi alag mat honay do, aur jab apni qaum ke paas laut'o to unhein khabardaar karna, aur apne poore deen ke logon ko naseehat karna, aur apni jaan ke liye mehnat karo, aur khabardaar, khabardaar, jama'at se alag mat hono, warna tumhein pata bhi nahi chalega aur tum apne deen se alag ho jaaoge, aur Qayamat ke din Jahannam mein dakhil ho jaaoge." Phir unhone kaha: "Aye Allah, yeh gumaan karta hai ke woh mujhse Teri khaatir mohabbat karta hai, aur woh mujhse Teri khaatir milne aaya hai, Aye Allah, mujhe Jannat mein uska chehra pehchanwaa, aur usse apne Daar-us-Salaam mein mere paas mehmaan bana kar bhej, aur jahan kahin woh duniya mein rahe, uski hifaazat kar, aur uske kaam-kaaj ko sambhaal, aur usse duniya ke thode se hisse par raazi kar, aur jo kuch tu usse duniya se de, usse aasaan bana de, aur jo kuch tu usse apni ne'mat se de, uspar usse shukr guzaaron mein shaamil kar, aur usse behtareen badla de, main tumhein Allah ke supurd karta houn, Aye Harim bin Hayyan, aur tumpar salaam aur Allah ki rehmat ho." Phir mujhse kaha: "Aaj ke baad tum mujhe nahi dekhoge, Allah tumpar reham kare, kyunke mujhe shohrat napasand hai, aur tanhaai mujhe zyada pasand hai kyunke main bohot gham aur fikr mein rehta houn jab tak main in logon ke sath duniya mein zinda houn, aur mere baare mein mat poochna aur mujhe mat dhoondhna, aur jaan lo ke tum mere zehan mein ho, agarche maine tumhein na dekha ho aur tumne mujhe na dekha ho, isliye mujhe yaad rakhna aur mere liye dua karna, kyunke main bhi tumhein yaad rakhunga aur tumhare liye dua karunga, Agar Allah ne chaaha, to udhar jaao," yahan tak ke woh udhar chale gaye. Unhone kaha: to maine chaaha ke unke sath thodi der aur chaloon, magar unhone inkaar kiya, to main unse juda hua, woh ro rahe the aur main ro raha tha. Unhone kaha: main unki peeth dekhta raha yahan tak ke woh kisi galli mein chale gaye, phir maine unhein iske baad kitni baar dhoonda aur unke baare mein poocha, magar mujhe koi bhi nahi mila jo mujhe unke baare mein kuch bataata, to Allah unpar reham kare aur unhein maaf kare, aur mujhpar koi Jumma nahi guzarta jab main unhein apne khwaab mein aik ya do baar nahi dekhta, ya jaisa unhone kaha.

e: [AI] He said: They mentioned Uways al-Qarani in his gathering, and he said, “He was killed with Ali ibn Abi Talib among the foot soldiers.”
hi: Unhone kaha: unki majlis mein Uwais Al-Qarani ka zikr kiya gaya, to unhone kaha: "Woh Ali bin Abi Talib ke sath, paidal fauj mein, qatl kiye gaye."

e: [AI] "I saw a woman in the mosque of Uwais Al-Qarni, and she said, 'He used to gather with his companions in their mosque, where they prayed and recited from their scriptures. Then I would bring them their lunch and dinner here until they finished their prayers.' She said, 'This was their habit whenever they were present, until they participated in a war and Uwais and a group of his companions were martyred before Ali ibn Abi Talib.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Maine Uwais Al-Qarani ki masjid mein aik aurat ko dekha, usne kaha: "Woh aur unke saathi is masjid mein jama hote, namaz padhte aur apne Quran ke nuskhon mein padhte, to main unka naashta aur khaana yahan laati yahan tak ke woh namazein padh lete." Usne kaha: "Aur yehi unka mamool tha jab tak woh maujood the, yahan tak ke jung mein gaye, aur Uwais aur unke saathiyon ka aik giroh, paidal fauj mein, Ali bin Abi Talib ke saamne, sab shaheed ho gaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "A man from my nation will enter Jannah (Paradise) through the intercession of a man from the tribe of Banu Tamim more than the tribe of Banu Tamim themselves." Al-Thaqafi said, Hisham said, "I heard Al-Hasan saying, 'Indeed, he is Uwais al-Qarni.' It has a Sahih Isnad (authentic chain of narration), but they did not mention it." Al-Dhahabi said in his summary, it is Sahih (authentic).
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jannat mein meri Ummat ke aik aadmi ki sifaarish se Banu Tameem se zyada log dakhil honge." Ath-Thaqafi ne kaha: Hisham ne kaha: maine Al-Hasan ko kehte suna: "Woh Uwais Al-Qarani hain." Isnad sahih hai, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] From Ibn Ishaq regarding the identification of those who participated in the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the Banu Dhubay'ah tribe, Sahl bin Hunayf bin Wahib bin Ghanim bin Tha'labah bin Mujadda'ah bin Al-Harith bin 'Amr, and Aamr who is also known as Bakhrajj.
hi: Ibn Ishaq se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Banu Dhubai'ah se, Sahl bin Hunaif bin Wahib bin Ghanim bin Tha'labah bin Mujadda'ah bin Al-Harith bin Amr, aur Amr jise Bakhraj kaha jaata tha.

e: [AI] It is said that he is brave.
hi: Ke unhein Bajda' kaha jaata tha.

e: [AI] "Sahl bin Hunayf bin Wahib bin Uka'im bin Tha'labah, known as Abu Thabit, died in Kufa in the year thirty-eight. Ali bin Abi Talib prayed upon him."
hi: "Sahl bin Hunaif bin Wahib bin Ukaim bin Tha'labah (RA), Abu Thabit, ka intiqaal Kufa mein atthees (38) hijri mein hua, aur Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi."

e: [AI] I passed by a stream, so I entered and bathed in it, and then I came out heated. That was conveyed to the Prophet ﷺ , and he said, "Tell Abu Thabit to give charity." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Main aik naale ke paas se guzra, to main usme utra aur nahaaya, phir main bukhaar mein nikla, yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Thabit ko kaho ke sadqa karein." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About Asim ibn Umar, he said, "Regarding the brotherhood between the Muhajireen and the Ansar from the Banu Hashim tribe, Ali ibn Abi Talib and Sahl bin Hunayf were paired."
hi: Asim bin Umar se: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke Muhajireen aur Ansar ke darmiyan bhai-chaare mein, Banu Hashim se, Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) aur Sahl bin Hunaif (RA) (jode gaye)."

e: [AI] About the Golden Summary
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] "I saw us on the day of Badr, and indeed one of us gestured with his sword towards the head of the polytheist, and his head would fall off his body before he could reach it. This narration is authentic with a trustworthy chain of narrators, although Bukhari did not include it in his collection."
hi: Mere waalid ne mujhse kaha: "Aye mere bete, humne khud ko Badr ke din dekha ke humme se koi apni talwaar se mushrik ke sar ki taraf ishaara karta, to uska sar uske jism se alag gir jaata isse pehle ke woh usse pahunche." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih, Bukhari ki shart par.

e: [AI] Ali entered with his sword on Fatima while she was washing the blood from the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, "Take it, for indeed I have excelled in its use." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, "If you have excelled in combat today, Sahl ibn Hunaif, Aasim ibn Thabit, Harith ibn As-Simma, and Abu Dujanah have certainly excelled as well."
hi: Ali apni talwaar ke sath Fatimah (RA) ke paas dakhil huay jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre se khoon dho rahi thin, unhone kaha: 'Isse le lo, maine isse achhi tarah jung ki hai.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumne aaj achhi jung ki hai, to Sahl bin Hunaif, Aasim bin Thabit, Al-Harith bin As-Simmah, aur Abu Dujanah ne bhi achhi jung ki hai."

e: [AI] Ali entered upon Fatimah while she was washing the blood off the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He then mentioned the hadith as I dictated it. I heard Abu Ali Al-Haafiz saying, "We did not write it connected except with the chain of narration of Abu Ya'qub. And the famous narration is from the hadith of Ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ikrimah, as a mursal transmission." And this wording is only known from the hadith of Abu Mashar, from Ayyub ibn Abi Umamah ibn Sahl, from his father, from his grandfather.
hi: Ali Fatimah (RA) ke paas dakhil huay jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre se khoon dho rahi thin, aur baaqi hadith waise hi zikr ki jaisi maine likhwaayi. Maine Abu Ali Al-Haafiz ko kehte suna: "Humne ise sirf Abu Ya'qoob ki isnad se muttasil likha hai, aur Ibn Uyainah ki hadith se, Amr bin Dinar se, Ikrimah se, mash-hoor riwayat mursal hai." Aur yeh matan sirf Abu Ma'shar ki hadith se maroof hai, Ayyub bin Abi Umamah bin Sahl se, unke waalid se, unke dada se.

e: [AI] "Ali came to Fatimah on the day of Uhud and said, 'Hold on to my sword, for I have wielded it well in battle today.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'If you have wielded it well in battle, then Asim ibn Thabit, Sahal ibn Hunayf, and Harith ibn Simmah have wielded it even better.'"
hi: Ali, Uhud ke din, Fatimah (RA) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Meri yeh talwaar sambhaal lo, aaj maine isse achhi tarah waar kiye hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tumne isse achhi jung ki hai, to Aasim bin Thabit, Sahl bin Hunaif, aur Al-Harith bin As-Simmah ne bhi achhi jung ki hai."

e: [AI] Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf informed me, and he was one of the prominent Ansar who participated in the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "It is authentic according to the conditions of the two scholars (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim), and they did not exclude it." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Mujhe Abu Umamah bin Sahl bin Hunaif ne bataaya, aur woh Ansar ke buzurgon mein se the jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Amir ibn Rabee'ah, a man from the Banu Adiy ibn Ka'b, saw Sahl ibn Hunayf with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , performing ablution with Kharar. He said, "By Allah, I have never seen a better day or a clean skin." Sahl slipped and fell. It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, do you have anything against Sahl ibn Hunayf?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called for Amir ibn Rabee'ah, got angry with him, and said, "Why would any of you kill his brother or companion? Did you not ask Allah for blessings for him? Then perform ablution for him." So Amir performed ablution for him and Sahl went away unharmed. "And ablution is to bring a container with water and immerse both hands in it, pouring water on the face from the container. Then wash the right hand, perform ablution again from the container, immerse the hand and wash the back. Then take the left hand and do the same. Then wash the chest from the container, wash the right knee and the tips of the fingers. Repeat the same for the left leg and enter the container within the waist. Then cover the container before putting it on the ground, blow from it, rinse the mouth, pour water on the face, pour water on the head, and then throw the container from behind. "
hi: Aamir bin Rabee'ah (RA), Banu Adi bin Ka'b ke aik aadmi, ne Sahl bin Hunaif (RA) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Al-Kharraar mein ghusl karte dekha, to usne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi aisa nahi dekha jaisa aaj dekha, aur na kisi parde mein rehne wali (aurat) ki khoobsurat khaal!" To Sahl gir pade aur behosh ho gaye, to kaha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Sahl bin Hunaif ke liye kuch karein?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Aamir bin Rabee'ah ko bulaaya aur unpar naaraaz huay, farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne bhai ya saathi ko kyun qatl karta hai? Kya usne barkat ki dua nahi maangi? Unke liye ghusl karo." To Aamir ne unke liye ghusl kiya, to Sahl chalne-phirne lage aur unhein koi takleef na rahi. "Ghusl (yeh) hai ke aik pyaale mein paani laaya jaaye, phir woh (ghusl karne wala) apne dono haath pyaale mein daale, phir apne chehre par pyaale se paani bahaaye, phir usme apna daayan haath dhoye aur pyaale mein se apna mun ghusl kare, phir haath andar daal kar apni peeth dhoye, phir baayen haath se waisa hi kare, phir apna seena pyaale mein dhoye, phir apna daayan ghutna aur ungliyon ke sire pyaale mein dhoye, aur waisa hi baayen pair se kare, aur apni tehmad ke andar (bhi paani) daale, phir pyaale ko zameen par rakhne se pehle dhaank de, phir usme se kulli kare aur apne chehre par bahaaye, phir apne sar par daale, phir pyaale ko apni peeth ke peeche phenk de."

e: [AI] And there was an easy man who was white and of good character. 'Amir ibn Rabiah said to him, "I have never seen anyone like you before." He looked at him and was amazed by his beauty when he removed his turban. 'Amir said, "Or a slave girl under her veil with a better body than that of Sahl ibn Hunaif?" Sahl was shocked by this, and his condition worsened. He went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him that Sahl ibn Hunaif was in a bad condition and that his smell had changed. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to him and they informed him about what 'Amir had done. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "How can any of you kill his brother? Indeed, the evil eye is a reality, so wash yourself for it." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When one of you sees something that he likes, let him seek blessings, for the evil eye is real." And these are the additional narrations in both of these hadiths that Al-Dhahabi did not mention in his shortened version.
hi: Aur Sahl aik gora, khoobsurat jism wala aadmi tha, to Aamir bin Rabee'ah ne unse kaha: "Maine kabhi aisa nahi dekha jaisa aaj dekha," aur unki taraf dekha, to jab unhone apni jubba utaari, to unki khoobsurati usse acchi lagi, phir kaha: "Aur na kisi parde mein rehne wali laundi ka jism Sahl bin Hunaif ke jism se zyada khoobsurat hai." To Sahl waheen bukhaar mein aa gaye, aur unka bukhaar badh gaya, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhein bataaya ke Sahl bin Hunaif ko bukhaar aa gaya hai aur woh aapke sath nahi ja sakenge. To Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas aaye, unhone aap (SAW) ko Aamir ke maamle ke baare mein bataaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne bhai ko kyun qatl karta hai? Kya tumne barkat ki dua nahi maangi? Beshak nazar (bad-nazar) haq hai, unke liye wudu karo." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi aisi cheez dekhe jo usse achhi lage, to woh barkat ki dua maange, kyunke nazar haq hai." Yeh dono hadithon mein woh izaafe hain jo dono ne nahi nikaale. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  narrated to me, he said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to me, "You are my messenger to Makkah. Convey to them my greetings of peace and say to them that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  orders you with three things: Do not swear by your fathers, and when you are alone, do not face the Qiblah (direction of prayer), and do not turn your back towards it, and do not perform Istinja (purification after relieving oneself) with a bone or dung."' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in summarizing."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse baat ki, unhone kaha: mujhse Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mera qaasid Makkah ki taraf ho, unhein mera salaam pahunchaana, aur unse kehna ke Rasulullah (SAW) tumhein teen baaton ka hukum dete hain: apne baap-daada ki qasam mat khaao, aur jab akele ho to Qiblah ki taraf mun karke ya peeth karke qaza-e-hajat mat karo, aur haddi ya laid se istinja mat karo." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Khawwat bin Jubair bin Al-Nu'man bin Amr ibn Al-Qais, he is Al-Burak bin Tha`labah bin Amr bin Awf, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  rewarded him for his arrow striking on the day of Badr."
hi: "Khawwat bin Jubair bin An-Nu'man bin Amr bin Al-Qais (RA), jo Al-Burak bin Tha'labah bin Amr bin Auf hain, unke liye Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka hissa aur unka ajr muqarrar kiya, Badr ke din."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to him, "O Abu Abdullah."
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Aye Abu Abdullah."

e: [AI] "Khawwat ibn Jubayr ibn al-Nu'man ibn Umayyah ibn al-Barak ibn Amr ibn Tha'laba ibn Amr ibn Awf ibn Malik died in Medina in the year forty. He was seventy-four years old."
hi: "Khawwat bin Jubair bin An-Nu'man bin Umayyah bin Al-Barak bin Amr-il-Qais bin Tha'labah bin Amr bin Auf bin Malik (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah mein chalis (40) hijri mein hua, jabke woh chauhattar (74) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  sent Khawwat Ibn Jubair to the tribe of Quraizah on his horse called Al-Janah. It is said that this hadith is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Al-Bukhari, but Abdu Al-Aziz Ibn Yahya considers it weak.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Khawwat bin Jubair (RA) ko unke ghode par, jise Al-Janaah kaha jaata tha, Banu Quraizah ki taraf bheja. Sahih, Bukhari ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Abdul Aziz bin Yahya kamzor hain.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ he said, "Whatever intoxicates in large quantities, a small quantity of it is forbidden." Abdullah bin Salih bin Ishaq narrated from his fathers that Khuwattan bin Jubayr died in year forty.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo cheez zyada maqdaar mein nasha karti hai, uski thodi maqdaar bhi haraam hai." Abdullah bin Salih bin Ishaq ne apne baap-dada se kaha: "Beshak Khawwat bin Jubair (RA) ka intiqaal chalis (40) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] Khawwat ibn Jubayr was among those who went with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to the Battle of Badr. When they reached Rawhaa', he was struck by a stone projectile that broke his leg. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent him back to Madinah and rewarded him with a camel as compensation. It was as if he had witnessed all the battles. They said that Khawwat also witnessed the Battles of Uhud, the Trench, and all the other major events with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Beshak Khawwat bin Jubair (RA) un logon mein se the jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr ki taraf nikle, jab woh Ar-Rawhaa mein pahunche, to unhein aik patthar ke tukde ne zakhmi kiya aur unki pindli toot gayi, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Madinah wapas bheja aur unke liye unka hissa aur unka ajr muqarrar kiya, to woh aisay ho gaye jaise unhone (jung mein) shirkat ki ho." Unhone kaha: aur Khawwat ne Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam maidaanon mein shirkat ki.

e: [AI] "My father Khawwat ibn Jubayr became ill, so the Prophet ﷺ  visited me. When I recovered, he said, 'Your body is now healthy, O Khawwat. Fulfill your promise to Allah.' I asked, 'What promise did I make to Allah?' He replied, 'Whenever a person falls sick, they make a vow or intention. So fulfill your promise to Allah the Almighty.' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this in the summary."
hi: Mere waalid Khawwat bin Jubair (bimaar huay), main bimaar hua, to Nabi (SAW) ne meri ayaadat ki, jab main theek ho gaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhara jism theek ho gaya, Aye Khawwat, to Allah Ta'ala se jo wa'da kiya tha usse poora karo." Maine kaha: 'Maine Allah se koi wa'da nahi kiya tha.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Koi bhi bimaar aisa nahi hota jo bimaar pade magar usne koi mannat maani ho ya niyat ki ho, isliye Allah, buzurg aur buland, se jo wa'da kiya usse poora karo." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in saying, "The name of Abdullah ibn Salam al-Husayn was before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named him Abdullah."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ka naam pehle Al-Husain tha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Abdullah rakh diya.

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Salam was known as Abu Yusuf. His name before Islam was Husein. When he embraced Islam, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named him Abdullah. He was from the Banu Isra'il, from the descendants of Yusuf ibn Ya'qub, may peace be upon them. He was an ally of the Qawwalah tribe from the Banu Awf ibn Al-Khazraj. Abdullah ibn Salam passed away in Madinah in the year 43 AH during the caliphate of Muawiyah.
hi: Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Yusuf thi, aur Islam se pehle unka naam Al-Husain tha, jab unhone Islam qubool kiya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Abdullah rakh diya, aur woh Bani Israel mein se, Yusuf bin Ya'qoob (AS) ki aulaad mein se the, aur Banu Auf bin Al-Khazraj ke Qawaaqilah qabile ke ahd-waale saathi the, aur Abdullah bin Salam ka intiqaal Madinah mein, sab riwayaton ke mutaabiq, tettalees (43) hijri mein, Mu'awiyah (RA) ki khilafat mein hua.

e: [AI] The translation of the given text is: "Wala' ibn Abdullah ibn Salam was loyal to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he died in the year forty-three."
hi: "Abdullah bin Salam (RA) ki wilayat (ahd) Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath thi, aur unka intiqaal tettalees (43) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] About Dhahak's saying about Allah's statement: "And a witness from the Children of Israel testified to its like" [Surah Al-Ahqaf 10], he said, "The witness is Abdullah ibn Salam, and he was one of the virtuous scholars from the Children of Israel."
hi: Ad-Dahhaak se, Allah, buzurg aur buland, ke is farmaan ke baare mein: "{Aur Bani Israel mein se aik gawaah ne isi jaisi baat ki gawahi di}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 10), unhone kaha: "Woh gawaah Abdullah bin Salam hain, aur woh Bani Israel ke ulama mein se neik logon mein se the."

e: I was sitting in a circle in the mosque of Medina and there was an old man, quite handsome. He was 'Abdullah b. Salim. He was telling good things to them (to the people sitting in that company). As he stood up (to depart) the people said: He who is desirous of looking at a person from amongst the people of Paradise should see him. I said: By Allah, I will follow him, and would try to know his residence. So I followed him and he walked on until he reached the outskirts of Medina. He then entered his house. I sought permission from him to get in, and he granted me the permission, saying: My nephew, what is the need (that has brought you here)? I said to him: As you stood up, I heard people say about you: He who is desirous of seeing a person from among the people of Paradise should look at him. So I became desirous of accompanying you. He ('Abdullah b. Salim) said: It is Allah Who knows best about the people of Paradise. I would, however, narrate to you as to why they said like it. (The story is) that while I was asleep (one night) there came to me a person (in the dream) who asked me to stand up. (So I stood up) and he caught hold of my hand and I walked along with him, and, lo, I found some paths on my left and I was about to set out upon them. Thereupon he said to me Do not set yourself on (them) for these are the paths of the leftists (denizens of Hell-fire). Then there were paths leading to the right side, whereupon he said: Set yourself on these paths. We came across a hill and he said to me: Climb up, and I attempted to climb up that I fell upon my buttocks. I made several attempts (but failed to succeed). He led until he came to a pillar (so high) that its upper end touched the sky and its base was in the earth. And there was a handhold at its upper end. He said to me Climb over it. I said: How can I climb upon it, as its upper end touches the sky? He cought hold of my hand and pushed me up and I found myself suspended with the handhold. He then struck the pillar and it fell down, but I remained attached to that handhold until it was morning (and the dream was thus over). I came to Allah's Apostle ﷺ and narrated it to him. He said: So far as the paths which you saw on your left are concerned, these are paths of the leftists (denizens of Hell) and the paths which you saw on your right, these are the paths of the rightists (the dwellers of Paradise) and the mountain represents the destination of the martyrs which you would not be able to attain. The pillar implies the pillar of Islam. and so far as the handhold is concerned, it implies the handhold of Islam, and you would hold to it fastly until you would meet death. (Using translation from Muslim 2484c)
hi: Phir unhone unhein achhi hadith bayan karni shuru ki, jab woh khade huay, to logon ne kaha: 'Jo koi Jannat ke ahl mein se aik aadmi ko dekhna chaahe, woh isse dekh le.' Maine kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, main zaroor iski pairavi karunga aur zaroor iske ghar ki jagah jaanunga.' To main unke peeche chala, woh chalte gaye yahan tak ke Madinah se nikalne ke qareeb pahunch gaye, phir apne ghar mein dakhil huay, to maine unse ijaazat maangi, unhone ijaazat de di, unhone poocha: 'Tumhein kya zaroorat hai, mere bhatije?' Maine unse kaha: 'Maine logon ko aisa aisa kehte suna, to mujhe pasand aaya ke main aapke sath rahoon.' Unhone kaha: 'Allah Jannat ke ahl ko behtar jaanta hai, aur main tumhein bataata houn ke unhone yeh kyun kaha: main aik raat so raha tha ke aik aadmi mere paas aaya aur mujhse kaha: uttho, phir usne mera haath pakda, main uske sath chala, achaanak mere baayen taraf aik chauda raasta tha, maine usme jaane ka iraada kiya, to usne mujhse kaha: isme mat jaao, yeh ahl-e-shimaal (bayen waalon) ka raasta hai, phir mere daayen taraf aik khula raasta tha, usne mujhse kaha: idhar chalo, phir achaanak mere saamne aik pahaad tha, usne mujhse kaha: chadho, to jab bhi main chadhna chaahta, main apni sarin ke bal gir jaata, yahan tak ke maine yeh kayi baar kiya, phir woh mujhe lekar aik satoon tak pahuncha jiska sar aasman mein tha aur neechla hissa zameen mein, uske oopar aik kadi thi, usne mujhse kaha: iske oopar chadho, maine kaha: main kaise chadhoon jabke iska sar aasman mein hai? Usne mera haath pakda aur mujhe uchaal diya, to main us kadi se latka hua tha yahan tak ke subah ho gayi, to main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhein yeh sunaaya, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Rahi baat us raaste ki jo tumne apne baayen dekha, woh ahl-e-shimaal ka raasta hai, aur rahi baat us raaste ki jo tumhare daayen thi, woh ahl-e-yaman (ya raast-baazon) ka raasta hai, aur (pahaad) shohadaa ka maqaam hai jo tum hasil nahi kar sakte, aur satoon Islam ka satoon hai, aur woh kadi Islam ki mazboot kadi hai, tum isse hamesha pakde rahoge yahan tak ke tum mar jaao.'"

e: [AI] The Prophet (pbuh) and I entered a Jewish synagogue. He said, "O people of Jews, show me twelve men who bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and Allah will remove the anger from any Jew that they are beneath the sky." None of them responded to him, so he said, "Have you denied? By Allah, I am the last, the final, and the chosen Prophet. Have you believed in me, or have you rejected me?" Then we left, and as we were about to exit, a man from behind us said, "O Muhammad, just as you are, how do I know you, O people of Jews?" They replied, "By Allah, we do not know of anyone among us who is more knowledgeable of the Book of Allah than you, nor do we know of anyone who understands it better than you, your father before you, or your grandfather before your father." He said, "Indeed, I bear witness for him with Allah that he is the Prophet of Allah whom you find mentioned in the Torah." They said, "You have lied!" Then they accused him of evil. The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "You have lied, and your word will not be accepted. If you praise him when he deserves it, and then deny him when he believes, your word will not be accepted." Then we left, and there were three of us; the Messenger of Allah (pbuh), Abdullah ibn Salam, and myself. Allah revealed in reference to this incident, "Say, 'Have you considered: if it is from Allah and you disbelieved in it?" [Surah Al-Ahqaf: 10]. This hadith is recorded in the collections of Al-Bukhari and Muslim, based on the conditions of both scholars, and they did not exclude it. It is agreed upon that it is a summarized narration from Anas, and Abdullah ibn Salam was mentioned briefly.
hi: Nabi (SAW) nikle, aur main unke sath tha, yahan tak ke hum Yahoodiyon ke ibaadat-khaane mein dakhil huay, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Yahoodiyon ki jama'at, mujhe baarah (12) aadmi dikhaao jo gawahi dein ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, Allah har Yahoodi se, jo aasman ke neeche hai, us ghusse ko hata dega jo usne unpar utaara hai." Unhone kaha: to sab khaamosh ho gaye, unme se kisi ne bhi jawaab nahi diya, phir aap (SAW) ne dobara pucha, phir bhi kisi ne jawaab nahi diya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne inkaar kiya, Allah ki qasam, main hi Al-Haashir houn, aur main hi Al-Aaqib houn, aur main hi chuna hua Nabi houn, chaahe tum imaan lao ya jhutlaao." Phir aap (SAW) wapas mudhe, aur main unke sath tha, yahan tak ke hum bahar nikalne ke qareeb the, ke humare peeche se aik aadmi ne kaha: 'Jaise ho waise hi raho, Aye Muhammad.' To us aadmi ne poocha: 'Tum log mujhe apne mein kaisa aadmi jaante ho, Aye Yahoodiyon ki jama'at?' Unhone kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, humein nahi pata ke humme koi tumse zyada Allah ki kitaab jaanne wala tha aur na tumse zyada hikmat wala, na tumse pehle tumhare waalid se, na tumhare dada se, jo tumhare waalid se pehle the.' Usne kaha: 'To main Allah ki qasam khaakar gawahi deta houn ke yeh Allah ke Nabi hain jinhein tum Tawrat mein paate ho.' To unhone kaha: 'Tum jhoote ho,' phir unhone uski baat ko rad kiya aur uske baare mein bura kaha. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum jhoote ho, tumhari baat kabhi qubool nahi hogi, abhi-abhi to tum uski tareef kar rahe the jo tumne ki, lekin jab woh imaan laaya, to tumne usse jhutlaaya aur uske baare mein woh kaha jo kaha, to ab tumhari baat kabhi qubool nahi hogi." Unhone kaha: to hum nikle, hum teen the, Rasulullah (SAW), main, aur Abdullah bin Salam, aur Allah Ta'ala ne uske baare mein yeh nazil farmaya: "{Kaho, kya tumne socha hai agar yeh Allah ki taraf se ho aur tum ismein kufr karo}" (Surah Al-Ahqaf 10), poori aayat. Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala, dono ne sirf Humaid ki hadith par ittefaaq kiya hai, Anas ke hawaale se, ke Abdullah bin Salam tum mein kaisa aadmi hai, mukhtasar taur par. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "He who has an atom's weight of arrogance in his heart will not enter Paradise." This hadith is authentic in its chain of narration and has not been mentioned in relation to Abdullah ibn Salam.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jiske dil mein rai ke daane ke barabar bhi takabbur (ghuroor) ho, woh Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise Abdullah bin Salam ke zikr mein nahi nikaala. Saalim bin Ibraheem kamzor hain.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Verily, he is one of the ten (people) in Paradise." The chain of narration is authentic, and it has not been excluded from being authentic.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Beshak woh Jannat mein das (10) mein se dasva hain." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was presented with a bowl, so he ate from it and then took out a piece and said, "A man from this valley, from the people of Paradise, will come and eat this." Sa'd said, "I had left 'Umair, my brother, performing ablution, and I said, 'He is 'Umair.' Then 'Abdullah bin Salam came and ate it." This hadith has a authentic chain of narration and has not been rejected.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aik pyaala laaya gaya, aap (SAW) ne usme se khaaya, to usme se kuch bacha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is ghaati se Jannat ke ahl mein se aik aadmi aayega aur yeh khaayega." Sa'd (RA) ne kaha: aur maine apne bhai Umair ko wudu karte chhoda tha, to maine kaha: 'Yeh Umair honge.' To Abdullah bin Salam aaye aur unhone woh khaaya. Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] Salama bin Salama bin Waqsh bin Zughbah bin Zaa'urah bin Abdul Ashhal bin Jumah bin Jusham bin Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj bin Amr bin Malik bin Aws.
hi: "Salamah bin Salamah bin Waqsh bin Zughbah bin Za'oora bin Abdul Ashhal bin Jumah bin Jusham bin Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj bin Amr bin Malik bin Aws (RA)."

e: [AI] Concerning the naming of those who witnessed the Battle of al-Aqaba from the Ansar, then from the Aws, then from the Banu Abd al-Ashhal, "Salama ibn Waqsh witnessed the Battle of Badr."
hi: Urwah se, Ansar mein se, phir Aws mein se, phir Banu Abdul Ashhal mein se, Aqabah mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein: "Salamah bin Waqsh ne Badr mein shirkat ki."

e: [AI] And Salamah witnessed all of Badr, Uhud, the Trench, and all the other battles alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He passed away in the year forty-five at the age of seventy, and he was buried in Madinah.
hi: Aur unhone sab ittefaaq se kaha: "Salamah ne Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam maidaanon mein shirkat ki, aur unka intiqaal paintalees (45) hijri mein hua, jabke woh sattar (70) saal ke thay, aur unhein Madinah mein dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] Abu Awf passed away. Salamah ibn Salamah ibn Waqsh died in the year forty-five and was buried in Al-Madinah.
hi: "Abu Auf, Salamah bin Salamah bin Waqsh (RA), ka intiqaal paintalees (45) hijri mein hua, aur unhein Madinah mein dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] We had a Jewish neighbor among the Bani Abdul Ashhal tribe. One day, he came out of his house and stopped in front of the Bani Abdul Ashhal tribe. Salamah said, "That day, I had a blanket with me that I was lying on in my family's courtyard. He mentioned the Day of Resurrection, the Afterlife, the Reckoning, the Scale, Paradise, and Hellfire." He said this to the people of Yathrib (before it became known as Madinah) who were pagans and did not believe in the resurrection after death. They said to him, "Woe to you! Do you think this will happen, O So-and-so?" He said, "Yes, by the One whom I swear by." They asked him, "What is the evidence for that?" He said, "There is a Prophet who will be sent from this region," and he pointed with his hand towards Makkah. They asked, "When will we see him?" He looked at me, being the youngest among them, and said, "This young boy will live until he meets him." Salamah said, "By Allah, night and day did not pass until Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sent His Messenger ﷺ  while he was alive amongst us, and we believed in him and rejected disbelief and envy." So we said to him, "Woe to you! Didn't you say something to us?" He said, "Yes, but it is not as authentic as the condition of a Muslim and it has not been mentioned in their books."
hi: Humara aik Yahoodi padosi tha Banu Abdul Ashhal mein, aik din woh apne ghar se humare paas nikla yahan tak ke Banu Abdul Ashhal ke paas khada ho gaya. Salamah ne kaha: "Aur main us din chhota tha, apni chaadar mein lapta apne ghar ke aangan mein leta hua tha," to usne Qayamat, dobaara uthna, hisaab, tarazu, Jannat, aur Jahannam ka zikr kiya. Unhone kaha: usne yeh baat Yathrib walon se kahi, jabke woh but-parast the aur maut ke baad kisi dobaara uthne ko nahi maante the, to unhone usse kaha: 'Afsos hai tumpar, kya tum samajhte ho ke yeh (sach) hoga, Aye fulan? Beshak log apni maut ke baad Jannat aur Jahannam ki taraf uthaaye jaayenge aur unme apne amal ka badla payenge?' Usne kaha: 'Haan, us Zaat ki qasam jiski woh qasam khaata hai.' Unhone kaha: 'Aye fulan, afsos hai tumpar, iski kya nishaani hai?' Usne kaha: 'Aik Nabi jo inhi ilaaqon se bheja jaayega,' aur usne apne haath se Makkah ki taraf ishaara kiya. Unhone poocha: 'Aur hum unhein kab dekhenge?' Usne mujhe dekha, jabke main unme sabse chhota tha, aur kaha: 'Agar yeh ladka apni poori umr paaye, to woh usse zaroor paayega.' Salamah ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, raat aur din zyada nahi guzre the ke Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko bheja jabke woh (Yahoodi) humare darmiyan zinda tha, to humne unpar imaan laaya aur usne sarkashi aur hasad ki wajah se kufr kiya." To humne usse kaha: 'Afsos hai tumpar, Aye fulan, kya tum wahi nahi ho jisne humein unke baare mein yeh baat kahi thi jo tumne kahi?' Usne kaha: 'Haan, lekin yeh (Nabi) woh nahi hai.'" Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] From Salamah ibn Salamah ibn Waqsh, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who said that he entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was in a state of ablution, so they ate and then they went out. Then Salamah performed ablution and Jabirah said to him, "Were you not already in a state of ablution?" Salamah replied, "Yes, but I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and we left an invitation that we were invited to, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was in a state of ablution, so he ate and then performed ablution." So I said to him, "Were you not already in a state of ablution, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Yes, but it is a matter that may occur, and this is from what has occurred before." Al-Layth ibn Sa'ad said, Zaid ibn Jabirah narrated to me from his father, Jabirah ibn Mahmoud, that his grandfather, Salamah, was one of the last companions of the Prophet ﷺ  to pass away, except for Anas ibn Malik, as he remained after him according to the stipulation of Muslim.
hi: Salamah bin Salamah bin Waqsh (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi, se, beshak woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas wudu ki haalat mein dakhil huay, phir unhone khaana khaaya, phir woh nikle, to Salamah ne wudu kiya, to Jabeerah ne unse poocha: 'Kya aap wudu mein nahi the?' Unhone kaha: 'Kyun nahi, lekin maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, aur hum aik dawat se nikle jismein humein bulaaya gaya tha, aur Rasulullah (SAW) wudu mein the, to unhone khaana khaaya, phir wudu kiya, to maine unse poocha: kya aap wudu mein nahi the, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: kyun nahi, lekin (kabhi kabhi aisi) baat ho jaati hai, aur yeh usi mein se hai jo ho chuka hai.' Al-Laith bin Sa'd ne kaha: mujhe Zaid bin Jabeerah ne apne waalid Jabeerah bin Mahmood se hadith bayan ki ke unke dada Salamah Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein sabse aakhir mein wafaat paane wale the, siwaye Anas bin Malik ke, kyunke woh unke baad zinda rahe. Muslim ki shart par.

e: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Allah forgive the Ansar and the children of the Ansar, and the children of the children of the Ansar, and the women of the Ansar." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3909)
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Allah, Ansar ko, Ansar ki aulaad ko, aur Ansar ke ahd-waale saathiyon ko maaf kar de."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ met a man from the people of the desert who was heading towards Badr. He met him at Rawhaa and the people asked him about the news of the people, but he did not have any news. So they said to him, "Give our greetings to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." He said, "Is there a Messenger of Allah among you?" They replied, "Yes." The Bedouin man said, "If you are the Messenger of Allah, then tell me what is in the belly of my camel?" Salamah bin Salamah bin Waqsh, who was a young boy, answered, "Do not ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I will inform you. You have defecated in her belly." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You have embarrassed the man, O Salamah." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from the man and did not speak to him until they left. When the Muslims reached them at Rawhaa, they congratulated them. Salamah bin Salamah said, "O Messenger of Allah, what are they congratulating you for?" He said, "Indeed, every nation has intelligence and it is only recognized by the nobility." This Hadith has a sound chain of narrators even though it is Mursal, and it contains a noble quality of Salamah bin Salamah.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Badr ki taraf ja rahe the ke unki mulaqaat gaanv ke aik aadmi se Ar-Rawhaa mein hui, to logon ne usse logon ki khabar poochi, magar unhein uske paas koi khabar na mili, to unhone usse kaha: 'Rasulullah (SAW) ko salaam karo.' Usne poocha: 'Kya tum mein Rasulullah (SAW) hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Us dehaati ne kaha: 'Agar aap Allah ke Rasool hain, to mujhe bataayen meri is oontni ke pait mein kya hai?' To Salamah bin Salamah bin Waqsh, jo aik jawaan ladka tha, ne usse kaha: 'Rasulullah (SAW) se mat poocho, main tumhein bataata houn, tumne usse (jinsi taur par) chadha tha, to uske pait mein tumhara bachcha hai.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne is aadmi ke saamne buri baat ki, Aye Salamah." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne us aadmi se mun pher liya aur usse aik lafz bhi nahi kaha yahan tak ke woh wapas laut aaye, aur Ar-Rawhaa mein Musalmano ne unhein mubaarakbaad dete huay istaqbaal kiya, to Salamah bin Salamah ne kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh log aapko kis baat ki mubaarakbaad de rahe hain? Allah ki qasam, humne to bas kuch ganje, boodhe (dushman) latki hui oontniyon jaise dekhe, humne unhein zibah kar diya.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har qaum ki apni samajh-boojh hoti hai, aur usse sharif log hi pehchaante hain." Sahih isnad, agarche mursal hai, aur ismein Salamah bin Salamah ke liye aik sharif manqabat (fazeelat) hai. Sahih, mursal.

e: [AI] Asim ibn Adi ibn al-Jadd ibn Ajlani went out on the day of Badr. "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned him and struck him with an arrow along with the companions of Badr."
hi: Aasim bin Adi bin Al-Jadd bin Ajlaan (RA), Badr ke din nikle, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein wapas bheja aur unke liye Badr walon ke sath unka hissa muqarrar kiya."

e: [AI] Wasim bin Adi bin Al-Jadd bin Ajlan bin Dhubiyyah, who was from the tribe of Bani Abd bin Zaid bin Malik bin Auf bin Amr bin Auf bin Malik bin Al-Aws, went out to the Battle of Badr. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  assigned him a mission and struck him with his arrow.
hi: Aasim bin Adi bin Al-Jadd bin Ajlaan bin Dhubai'ah (RA), jo Balee (qabile) se the, Banu Abd bin Zaid bin Malik bin Auf bin Amr bin Auf bin Malik bin Al-Aws ke ahd-waale saathi, Badr ke din nikle, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein wapas bheja aur unke liye unka hissa muqarrar kiya."

e: [AI] And it is said "Abu Abdullah."
hi: Aur unhein Abu Abdullah kaha jaata tha.

e: [AI] I and my brother bought a hundred arrows from the arrows of Hunayn. The Prophet ﷺ  was informed about this and he said, "O Asim, what are two corrupt wolves after they have taken prey that their owner has lost due to the corruption found in it from the love of wealth and honor in his eyes?" This Hadith is famous from Asim, narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . It is the one that Al-Dhahabi remained silent about in his summary.
hi: Maine aur mere bhai ne Hunain (ki jung) ke maal-e-ghanimat mein se sau (100) hisse khareede, yeh baat Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchi, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Aasim, do lootne wale bhediye jo bhed ke rewad par hamla karein jinka maalik unhein chhod chuka ho, woh (rewad) ke liye maal aur izzat ki mohabbat se zyada nuqsaan-daayak nahi jo uske paas hai." Yeh hadith Aasim ki, Rasulullah (SAW) se, mash-hoor hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  permitted the owners of camels to let them roam freely around the Bayt al-Maqdis on the day of sacrifice, then on the following day, and then on the day of dispersal." This hadith was authenticated by Malik ibn Anas and some others praised it, while Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne oont charwaahon ko Mina mein raat guzarne (baytootah) mein chhoot di, woh Qurbani ke din kankariyan maarein, phir agle din maarein, phir kooch ke din maarein." Sahih isnad, Malik bin Anas ne ise achha kiya, aur doosron ne ismein ghalti ki, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted the shepherds to graze their flocks for a day and keep them confined for another day." Yahya said, "This is an error. It is actually as Malik said." Yahya also said, "Whenever Sufyan narrated this hadith to us, he said: 'There is a problem with this hadith.'"
hi: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne charwaahon ko chhoot di ke woh aik din kankariyan maarein aur aik din charaayein." Yahya ne kaha: "Yeh ghalati hai, asal mein woh wahi hai jo Malik ne kaha." Yahya ne kaha: "Aur Sufyan jab humein yeh hadith bayan karte, to kehte: is hadith mein mujhse koi cheez chhoot gayi hai."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived in Medina on Monday, twelve nights passed from the month of Rabi' al-Awwal. He stayed in Medina for ten years."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah mein Somwaar ke din pahunche, jab Rabi-ul-Awwal ki baarah (12) raaten guzar chuki thin, phir aap (SAW) Madinah mein das (10) saal thehre." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] According to Ibn Ishaq, Zaid bin Thabit bin Ad-Dhahhak bin Lawdhan bin Amr bin Abdi Awf bin Ghanm bin Malik bin An-Najjar was amongst those who witnessed the Battle of the Trench and he was among those who carried the soil alongside the Muslims.
hi: Ibn Ishaq se: "Khandaq mein shirkat karne walon mein, Zaid bin Thabit bin Adh-Dhahhaak bin Lauzaan bin Amr bin Abd Auf bin Ghanm bin Malik bin An-Najjaar (RA), aur woh un logon mein se the jo us din Musalmano ke sath mitti dhote the."

e: [AI] "And it is said: Abu Kharajah is Zaid son of Thabit son of Dahhak son of Zaid son of Lawthan son of Amr son of Abd Awf son of Ghanem son of Malik son of Najar al-Ansari, he died in the year forty-five."
hi: "Aur unhein Abu Kharijah, Zaid bin Thabit bin Adh-Dhahhaak bin Zaid bin Lauzaan bin Amr bin Abd Auf bin Ghanm bin Malik bin An-Najjaar Al-Ansari (RA), kaha jaata hai, unka intiqaal paintalees (45) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "And Abu Sa'id Zaid ibn Thabit ibn Aldhahak died in the year forty-five."
hi: "Aur Abu Sa'eed Zaid bin Thabit bin Adh-Dhahhaak (RA) ka intiqaal paintalees (45) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] Zaid ibn Thabit witnessed the Battle of Bu'ath when I was only six years old. This happened five years before the migration of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, arrived in Medina when I was eleven years old. I was brought to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and they said, "This is a young boy from the Khazraj tribe who has memorized sixteen surahs." However, I was not allowed to participate in the Battle of Badr or Uhud. But I was allowed to participate in the Battle of the Trench.
hi: Zaid bin Thabit (RA): "Jung-e-Bu'aath hui jabke main chhah (6) saal ka tha, aur yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ki hijrat se paanch (5) saal pehle hui thi, phir Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah pahunche jabke main gyaarah (11) saal ka tha, aur mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya, to logon ne kaha: 'Khazraj ka aik ladka hai jisne solah (16) Surahtein padhi hain,' to mujhe Badr aur Uhud mein shirkat ki ijaazat nahi mili, aur mujhe Khandaq mein ijaazat mil gayi."

e: [AI] "Zaid son of Thabit son of Dihhak son of Zaid son of Lu'dhan son of Amr son of Abd Awf son of Ghanim son of Malik son of Najjar died in the year forty-four or forty-five."
hi: "Zaid bin Thabit bin Adh-Dhahhaak bin Zaid bin Lauzaan bin Amr bin Abd Auf bin Ghanm bin Malik bin An-Najjaar (RA) ka intiqaal chauwtalees (44) ya paintalees (45) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "To bury him before sunrise became my opinion while the sun was turning yellow. Then the Ansar came and said, 'He should not be buried except during daylight so that people can gather for him.' Marwan heard the voices and came walking until he entered upon me. He said, 'It is my determination that he should not be buried until morning.' When we became morning, we washed him three times: the first with water, the second with water and sidr, and the third with water and camphor. And we shrouded him in three garments, one of which was a white cloth that Muawiya had sent for him. We prayed over him after sunrise. Marwan ibn al-Hakam prayed over him and Marwan sent for Jazur, and it was slaughtered, and the people and the women were fed, and they cried three times."
hi: (Shuru mein) meri raay yeh thi ke unhein (usi din) daf'na diya jaaye is se pehle ke suraj peela ho jaaye, magar Ansar aaye aur kaha: 'Unhein sirf din mein daf'naaya jaayega taake log unke liye jama ho sakein.' Marwan ne aawaazein suni, to woh chalte huay aaye yahan tak ke mere paas dakhil huay, aur kaha: "Mera pakka iraada hai ke unhein subah tak daf'na nahi jaayega." Jab subah hui, to humne unhein teen baar ghusl diya, pehli baar paani se, doosri baar paani aur beri ke patton se, teesri baar paani aur kaafoor se, aur humne unhein teen kapdon mein kafan diya, jinme se aik burd (chaadar) thi jo Mu'awiyah ne unhein pehnaayi thi, aur humne unki namaz-e-janaza suraj nikalne ke baad padhi, aur Marwan bin Al-Hakam ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur Marwan ne unke liye aik jazoor (oont) bheja, to usse zibah kiya gaya aur logon ko khilaaya gaya, aur auraten teen din royin.

e: [AI] There was a Sahabi called Thabit ibn Ubaid who asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "Do you speak Syriac?" I said, "No." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Learn it, for it brings us books." So, within seventeen days, I learned it. Al-A'mash said, "Books used to come to him and no one could read them except those who trusted him." This Hadith is considered Sahih if it is proven that Thabit ibn Ubaid heard it from Zaid ibn Thabit without any interruption.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Kya tumhein Suryaani (zabaan) aati hai?" Maine kaha: 'Nahi.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To isse seekho, kyunke humare paas (isme) khat aate hain." To maine isse satrah (17) dinon mein seekh liya. Al-A'mash ne kaha: "Unke paas aise khat aate the jinhein woh sirf usi ko dikhaana pasand karte the jispar unhein bharosa ho." Sahih hai agar Thabit bin Ubaid ne ise Zaid bin Thabit se suna ho, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih agar Thabit ne Zaid se suna ho.

e: [AI] "I said to Zaid ibn Thabit, O Abu Kharijah"
hi: "Maine Zaid bin Thabit se kaha: 'Aye Abu Kharijah.'"

e: [AI] "I attended the funeral of Zaid ibn Thabit, and when he was buried in his grave." And he mentioned the hadith.
hi: "Main Zaid bin Thabit ki janaaza mein shaamil tha, jab unhein unki qabr mein dafan kiya gaya," aur hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The most merciful among my Ummah (nation) towards my Ummah is Abu Bakr, and the strongest of them in the matter of Allah is Umar, and the most modest among them is Uthman, and the most knowledgeable about the Book of Allah is Ubayy bin Ka'b, and the most qualified to distinguish between lawful and unlawful matters is Mu'adh, except that every Ummah has a trustworthy person, and the trustworthy person of this Ummah is Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah." This is an authentic chain, according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim), and they did not exclude it using this version. They only agreed on mentioning Abu Ubaidah in the chain, and I have mentioned its reason in the book of Al-Talkhis according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri Ummat mein Ummat ke liye sabse zyada reham karne wale Abu Bakr hain, aur Allah ke maamle mein sabse sakht Umar hain, aur sabse zyada sachi haya rakhne wale Uthman hain, aur Allah ki Kitaab ko sabse zyada padhne wale Ubayy bin Ka'b hain, aur miraas (faraaiz) ke sabse zyada jaankaar Zaid bin Thabit hain, aur halaal-haraam ke sabse zyada jaankaar Mu'adh hain, magar har Ummat ka aik amanat-daar hota hai, aur is Ummat ke amanat-daar Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah hain." Yeh isnad Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar dono ne ise is andaaz mein nahi nikaala, dono ne sirf isi isnad se Abu Ubaidah ka zikr karne par ittefaaq kiya hai, aur maine iski wajah Kitaab At-Talkhees mein zikr ki hai. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] He turned to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, and said, "This is how we treat our elders and our scholars." The narration is authentic according to the conditions of Imam Muslim, but he did not include it. It is part of the virtues of Zaid bin Thabit that I began with a hadith about collecting the Quran because he has many virtues. However, the two sheikhs (Imam Muslim and Imam Bukhari) agreed not to include it, so I left it. Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Unse kaha gaya: 'Hato, Aye Rasulullah (SAW) ke chachazaad!' To unhone (Zaid ne) kaha: "Hum apne buzurgon aur ulama ke sath aisa hi karte hain." Sahih isnad, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Zaid bin Thabit ke manaqib mein munaasib tha ke main Quran jama karne ki hadith se shuru karoon, kyunke unke bohot se manaqib hain, lekin Shaykhain ne ise nikaalne par ittefaaq kiya hai, isi liye maine ise chhod diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And among the allies of the Bani Nawfal bin 'Abd Manaf is Ya'la bin Munyah, and Munyah, his mother, is the daughter of Ghazwan bin Jabir from the Bani Mazin tribe. His father is Umayyah bin Abu 'Ubaid bin Hammam bin Al-Harith bin Bakr."
hi: "Aur Banu Naufal bin Abd Manaf ke ahd-waale saathiyon mein se, Ya'la bin Munyah, aur Munyah unki maa thin, aur woh Munyah bint Ghazwan bin Jabir, Banu Maazin se thin, aur unke waalid Umayyah bin Abi Ubaid bin Hammaam bin Al-Harith bin Bakr the."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Ma'in say, "Ya'la ibn Umayya is praised by his father Umayya and his mother's wish."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Ya'la bin Umayyah, Umayyah unke waalid hain aur Munyah unki maa hain."

e: [AI] Ya'la ibn Umayyah had three sons; Safwan, Uthman, and Abdul Rahman.
hi: Ya'la bin Umayyah (RA) ki teen aulaad thin: Safwan, Uthman, aur Abdur Rahman.

e: "I came to the Messenger of Allah with my father Umayyah on the Day of the Conquest (of Makkah) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, accept my father's pledge for emigration (Al-Hijrah).' The Messenger of Allah said: 'I will accept his pledge to fight in Jihad, for the emigration (Al-Hijrah) has ceased."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4160)
hi: Maine Fatah ke din apne waalid Abu Umayyah ke baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) se baat ki, maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere waalid se hijrat par baiyat lein.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main unse jihad par baiyat lunga, kyunke hijrat khatam ho chuki hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The first person who recorded the books is Ya'la ibn Umayyah, and he was in Yemen. The Prophet ﷺ arrived in Madinah in the month of Rabi al-Awwal. People recorded the first year, and they only recorded it because of the Prophet's ﷺ arrival.
hi: Sabse pehle jinhone khaton par taareekh (tarikh) likhna shuru kiya, woh Ya'la bin Umayyah the, jabke woh Yemen mein the, kyunke Nabi (SAW) "Rabi-ul-Awwal mein Madinah pahunche," aur logon ne saal ki shuru'aat se taareekh likhna shuru ki, aur logon ne sirf Nabi (SAW) ke aane ki wajah se taareekh likhna shuru kiya.

e: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah on the campaign of Tabuk, and there was a friend of ours with us, who fought with a man from among the Muslims. The man bit him on the forearm, so he pulled it away from his mouth and a tooth fell out. The man came to the Prophet, seeking blood money, but his brother and bite him like a stallion bites, then come and demand blood money? There is no blood money for that." And the Messenger of Allah juddgedit to be invalid. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4765)
hi: Apne do chachon, Ya'la aur Salamah, Umayyah ke dono betoon, se: unhone kaha: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath ghazwa-e-Tabook mein nikle, aur humare sath humara aik saathi tha, to aik aadmi ne usse jung ki, to usne uska bazu chaba liya, to usne apna bazu uske mun se kheencha, jisse uske aage ke do daant tut gaye, to woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas diyat maangne gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum mein se koi apne bhai ke paas jaata hai aur usse aise chabaata hai jaise koi jaanwar chabaata hai, phir uske baad diyat maangne aata hai? Jaao, tumhare liye koi diyat nahi.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne isse baatil kar diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And from the descendants of Jusham bin Al-Khazraj, then from the descendants of Salimah bin Saad bin Saridah bin Yazid bin Jusham, there were Mu'adh, Mu'awwadh, and Khallad, the sons of Amr bin Al-Jamuh bin Zaid bin Haram bin Ka'b. They witnessed the Battle of Badr, and Mu'adh killed Abu Jahl, and Ikrimah bin Abu Jahl cut off his hand, but he survived until the time of Uthman. His mother was Hind bint Amr bin Tha'alabah bin Haram, and his uncle was Jabir bin Abdullah Al-Ansari. He was a follower of the Battle of Badr."
hi: "Aur Banu Jusham bin Al-Khazraj se, phir Banu Salimah bin Sa'd bin Saaridah bin Yazid bin Jusham se: Mu'adh, Mu'awwidh, aur Khallaad, Amr bin Al-Jamuh bin Zaid bin Haraam bin Ka'b ke bete (RA), Aqabi, Badri, ne Badr mein shirkat ki, aur Mu'adh ne Abu Jahl ko qatl kiya, aur Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl ne unka haath kaat diya, phir woh Uthman ke daur tak zinda rahe, aur unki maa Hind bint Amr bin Tha'labah bin Haraam (RA) thin, aur unke chacha Jabir bin Abdullah Al-Ansari (RA), Aqabi, Badri, the."

e: [AI] "And Mu'adh bin Amr bin al-Jamuh experienced a tragedy on the Day of Badr, and he remained ill until the time of Uthman, then he passed away in Medina in the year fourteen. Uthman bin Affan performed the funeral prayer for him, and he was buried in al-Baqi'."
hi: "Aur Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh (RA) ko Badr ke din aik chot lagi, to woh Uthman ke daur tak bimaar rahe, phir Madinah mein chaudah (14) hijri mein wafaat paayi, aur Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi, aur unhein Baqee' mein dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] From Urwah ibn Al Zubayr, "Regarding the names of those who gave allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Al Aqabah from Banu Haram ibn Kaab, Muadh ibn Amr ibn Al Jamuh."
hi: Urwah bin Az-Zubair se, Aqabah mein Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat karne walon ke naamon mein, Banu Haraam bin Ka'b se: "Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh (RA)."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "What a noble man Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh is." It is a authentic statement according to the condition of Muslim, and it has not been excluded according to the condition of Muslim.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaisa behtareen aadmi hain Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh." Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "While I was standing in line on the day of Badr, I looked to my right and left and saw two young boys from the Ansar. Their teeth were new, and I wished to be among them, so one of them nudged me and said, 'Do you know Abu Jahl?' I replied, 'Yes, and what do you need him for, O son of my cousin?' He said, 'I have been informed that he insults the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and by the One in Whose Hand is my soul, if I see him, he will not leave my sight until he dies.' I was amazed by this, so the other one also nudged me and said the same thing. Before I could respond, I saw Abu Jahl moving among the people, so I told them, 'Behold, this is your companion whom you are asking about.' They immediately drew their swords and struck him until they killed him. Then they went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him. He asked, 'Which one of you killed him?' Each of them said, 'I killed him.' He then asked, 'Did you both wipe your swords?' They replied, 'No.' So he looked at their swords and said, 'Both of you killed him, and the spoils have been rightfully decided for Mu'adh ibn 'Amr ibn Al-Jamuh.'" (This hadith has been summarized by Adh-Dhahabi.)
hi: Main Badr ke din safon mein khada tha, maine apne daayen aur baayen dekha, to achaanak main Ansar ke do naujawaan ladkon ke darmiyan tha, jinke naye daant the, maine tamanna ki ke main unse behtar (mazboot) logon ke darmiyan hota, to unme se aik ne mujhe kohni maari aur kaha: 'Aye chacha, kya aap Abu Jahl ko pehchaante hain?' Maine kaha: 'Ji haan, aur tumhein uski kya zaroorat hai, Aye mere bhatije?' Usne kaha: 'Mujhe bataaya gaya hai ke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ko bura-bhala kehta hai, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar main usse dekhoon, to mera saaya uske saaye se tab tak nahi hatega jab tak woh mar na jaaye, chaahe humme se koi bhi pehle mare.' To mujhe iss par ta'ajjub hua, to doosre ne bhi mujhe kohni maari aur waisi hi baat kahi. To zyada waqt nahi guzra ke maine Abu Jahl ko logon mein ghoomte dekha, to maine un dono se kaha: 'Yeh raha tumhara saathi jiske baare mein tum poochte the.' To woh dono apni talwaaron ke sath uski taraf lapke aur usse maara yahan tak ke usse qatl kar diya, phir woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas wapas gaye aur unhein bataaya, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum mein se kisne usse qatl kiya?" To har aik ne kaha: 'Maine usse qatl kiya.' Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum dono ne apni talwaaren saaf ki hain?" Unhone kaha: 'Nahi.' To aap (SAW) ne dono talwaaron ko dekha aur farmaya: "Tum dono ne usse qatl kiya, aur uska saamaan Mu'adh bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh ke liye faisla kiya," aur doosra Mu'adh bin Afraa the. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Umair bin Al-Hammam, from the tribe of Bani Salimah, then from the tribe of Bani Haram bin Kaab bin Ghanm bin Salamah, was one of the companions who participated in the Battle of Badr with the messenger of Allah."
hi: "Umair bin Al-Hammam (RA), Banu Salimah se, phir Banu Haraam bin Ka'b bin Ghanm bin Salamah se, un logon mein se the jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said on the day of Badr, "Rise to a paradise as wide as the heavens and the earth." Umayr ibn al-Hamam al-Ansari said, "O Messenger of Allah, a paradise as wide as the heavens and the earth, filled with ripe dates! By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, I must be one of its people." The Prophet replied, "Indeed, you are one of its people." Umayr then took out some dates and began to eat them, saying, "I will not die until I have eaten my dates. Indeed, they are a long-lasting sustenance." He then threw what he had left of the dates and fought until he was killed. This hadith is considered authentic according to the conditions of Sahih Muslim, but it was never narrated by him (Sahih Muslim).
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din farmaya: "Uttho us Jannat ki taraf jiski chaudaai aasmaanon aur zameen ke barabar hai." Umair bin Al-Hammam Al-Ansari ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), jiski chaudaai aasmaanon aur zameen ke barabar hai?" (Ta'ajjub se) "Bakh bakh!" "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe zaroor uske ahl mein se hona hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To tum uske ahl mein se ho." To unhone kuch khajoorein nikaalin aur khaane lage, phir kaha: "Agar main itni der zinda rahoon ke apni khajoorein khaa loon, to yeh (bhi) aik lambi zindagi hai." Unhone kaha: to unhone apne paas jo khajoorein thin unhein phenk diya, phir unse jung ki yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye. Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] From Ibn Ishaq regarding the naming of the person who witnessed the battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the tribe of Bani Jusham bin Al-Khazraj, it was Khirash bin As-Simah bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh.
hi: Ibn Ishaq se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Banu Jusham bin Al-Khazraj se: "Khiraash bin As-Simmah bin Amr bin Al-Jamuh (RA)."

e: [AI] "About Uruwah, who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , from the Banu Haram ibn Ka'b al-Huhab ibn al-Mundhir ibn al-Jamuah ibn Zaid ibn Haram."
hi: Urwah se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon mein, Banu Haraam bin Ka'b se: "Al-Hubab bin Al-Mundhir bin Al-Jamuh bin Zaid bin Haraam (RA)."

e: [AI] I advised the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, on the day of Badr with two suggestions, and he accepted them from me. I accompanied the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, in the Battle of Badr, and the camp was set up behind the water. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, did you do this based on divine inspiration or your own opinion?" He replied, "Based on my own opinion, O beloved one." I said, "In my opinion, you should place the water behind you, so if you are forced to retreat, you can retreat towards it." He accepted my suggestion. This hadith is considered weak in its chain of narrators.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Badr ke din do baaton ki salaah di, to aap (SAW) ne mujhse dono qubool kar lin, main Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr ki jung mein nikla, to aap (SAW) ne paani ke peechhe lashkar utaara, maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aapne yeh wahi ki wajah se kiya ya apni raay se?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni raay se, Aye Hubab." Maine kaha: "To raay yeh hai ke aap paani ko apne peechhe rakhein, taake agar aapko panaah lene ki zaroorat pade, to aap uski taraf panaah le sakein." To aap (SAW) ne yeh baat mujhse qubool kar li. Munkar (Repudiated - rad-shuda) hadith, iski isnad bhi aisi hi hai.

e: [AI] Gabriel ﷺ  came down to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and said, "Opinion is what the pebbles pointed to." The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, "O Habab, you have referred to opinion." This narration is considered weak and its chain of transmission is questionable.
hi: Jibreel (AS) Rasulullah (SAW) par nazil huay aur kaha: "Sahih raay wahi hai jo Al-Hubab ne di." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Hubab, tumne sahi raay di." Munkar (Repudiated - rad-shuda) hadith, iski isnad bhi aisi hi hai.

e:
[AI] "And Jibreel (Gabriel) peace and blessings be upon him, descended to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  and said, 'Which of the two things do you prefer: to remain in the world with your companions or to return to your Lord with what He has promised you of the gardens of bliss with the wide-eyed maidens and the eternal bliss, and whatever your soul desires and your eyes find pleasure in?' So he consulted his companions and they said, 'O Messenger of Allah, it is dearer to us that you are with us, informing us about the plans of our enemies, supplicating to Allah to grant us victory over them, and informing us about news from the heavens.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Why do you not speak, O beloved?' So I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, choose whatever your Lord has chosen for you.' So he accepted that from me."

Note: This translation has been provided based on the given text. Please note that there may be variations in the translation depending on the interpretation of certain terms and phrases.
hi: Aur Jibreel (AS) Muhammad (SAW) par nazil huay aur poocha: "Do baaton mein se aapko kaunsi zyada pasand hai: aap apni duniya mein apne saathiyon ke sath rahein, ya aap apne Rab ki taraf wapas laut jaayein jismein usne aapse wa'da kiya hai, Jannat ki ne'maton, hooron, aur hamesha ki ne'maton ka, aur jo bhi aapki jaan chaahe aur jispar aapki aankhein thandi hon?" To aap (SAW) ne apne saathiyon se mashwara kiya, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), humein aapka humare sath rehna zyada pasand hai, aap humein humare dushman ki kamzoriyon ki khabar dete hain, aur Allah se dua karte hain ke woh humein unpar fatah de, aur humein aasman ki khabren bataate hain." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhein kya hua, tum kuch bolte nahi, Aye Hubab?" To maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap wahi chunein jo aapka Rab aapke liye chune." To aap (SAW) ne yeh baat mujhse qubool kar li. Munkar (Repudiated - rad-shuda) hadith, iski isnad bhi aisi hi hai.

e: [AI] On the day of the Saqifah, a man from Banu Salimah known as Al-Hubab bin Al-Mundhir said, "I am its arbitrator." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in his summary.
hi: Saqeefah ke din: "Main iska tajurbekaar (bharosemand rehnuma) houn." Banu Salimah ka aik aadmi jise Al-Hubab bin Al-Mundhir kaha jaata tha (ne yeh kaha). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah said, "Today the ink of this ummah (nation) has dried up, and perhaps Allah will make from the son of Ibn Abbas a successor from it."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA): "Aaj is Ummat ke aalim ka intiqaal ho gaya, aur shaayad Allah Ibn Abbas mein unka jaanasheen (badal) rakh de."

e: [AI] About six of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  were Omar, Abdullah, and Zaid, whose knowledge was similar to one another. They would take some knowledge from each other. I asked Ash-Sha'bi and Al-Ash'ari, who were they? He said, "They were one of the jurists."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke chhah (6) sahaba ke baare mein: Umar, Abdullah, aur Zaid, inka ilm aapas mein milta-julta tha, aur woh aik doosre se seekhte the. Unhone kaha: maine Ash-Sha'bi se poocha: 'Kya Al-Ash'ari bhi in mein shaamil the?' Unhone kaha: "Woh fuqaha mein se aik the."

e: [AI] "And he said, 'This is how knowledge disappears.'"
hi: Aur unhone kaha: "Isi tarah ilm chala jaata hai."

e: [AI] "This is how it is done by scientists."
hi: "Isi tarah ulama ke sath (unki maut par) kiya jaata hai."

e: [AI] "This is how knowledge is buried."
hi: "Isi tarah ilm dafan ho jaata hai."

e: [AI] "Such is the disappearance of knowledge. Today, much knowledge has been buried."
hi: "Isi tarah ilm chala jaata hai, aaj bohot saara ilm dafan ho gaya."

e: [AI] "And Abu Ahyaab Safwan ibn Umayyah ibn Khalaf ibn Wahb ibn Hudhayfah ibn Jumah passed away, and he embraced Islam at the time of the conquest. He died in the year forty-three."
hi: "Abu Ahyab Safwan bin Umayyah bin Khalaf bin Wahb bin Hudhaafah bin Jumah (RA) ka intiqaal hua, unhone Fatah ke waqt Islam qubool kiya tha, unka intiqaal tettalees (43) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "Uthman bin Talha bin Abi Talha bin Abdul-Azza bin Uthman bin Abdul-Dar and his mother, the daughter of Saeed bin Sumayyah from the Banu Amr bin Auf of the people of Quba. He embraced Islam at the same time as Amr bin Al-Aas and Khalid bin Al-Walid. He passed away in Makkah in the year forty-three."
hi: "Uthman bin Talhah bin Abi Talhah bin Abdul Uzza bin Uthman bin Abd Ad-Daar (RA), unki maa Sa'eed bin Sumayyah ki beti thin, Banu Amr bin Auf se, Quba walon mein se, aur unka Islam qubool karna Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) aur Khalid bin Al-Waleed (RA) ke Islam qubool karne ke sath aik hi waqt mein hua, aur unka intiqaal Makkah mein tettalees (43) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "And from the descendants of Banī ʿAbd al-Dār ibn Qusayy, he mentioned this lineage and his mother was Sallāmah bint Saʿīd from Banī ʿAmr ibn ʿAwf, from the people of Qubāʾ. He embraced Islam before the conquest along with ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ and Khālid ibn al-Walīd, and he arrived in Medina in the month of Ṣafar, the eighth year of the Hijrah. He died in Makkah two years and forty days after the reign of Muʿāwiya."
hi: "Aur Banu Abd Ad-Daar bin Qusayy se," aur yehi nasab zikr kiya, "aur unki maa Sallaamah bint Sa'eed thin, Banu Amr bin Auf se, Quba walon mein se, aur unhone Fatah se pehle Amr bin Al-Aas aur Khalid bin Al-Waleed ke sath Islam qubool kiya, aur Madinah Safar, aath (8) hijri mein pahunche, aur unka intiqaal Makkah mein baais (42) hijri mein hua, jab Mu'awiyah khilafat mein aaye."

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  enter the Kaaba along with Usama bin Zaid, Bilal, and Uthman bin Talha, and no one else entered it with them." Bilal informed me that he had asked Uthman bin Talha where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had prayed. He replied, "Between the two Yemeni pillars." It has also been narrated by Shu'bah bin Uthman from his uncle Uthman bin Talha."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha, aap (SAW) Ka'bah mein dakhil huay, aap (SAW) ke sath Usamah bin Zaid (RA), Bilal (RA), aur Uthman bin Talhah (RA) the, koi aur unke sath dakhil nahi hua." To Bilal ne mujhe bataya ke unhone Uthman bin Talhah se poocha: 'Rasulullah (SAW) ne kahan namaz padhi?' Unhone kaha: "Do Yemeni satoonon ke darmiyan." Aur Shaibah bin Uthman ne apne chacha Uthman bin Talhah se riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] "It was narrated that Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'There are three qualities that will make your love for your brother sincere: greeting him when you meet him, giving him space in the gathering, and calling him by his beloved names. Abu al-Mutarrif Muhammad ibn Abi al-Wazir, from the trustworthy people of Basra and their predecessors, I do not know that I have relied on him in any narration other than this. Abu Mutarrif's reliability was doubted by Abu Hatim.'"
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Teen cheezein tumhare bhai ki mohabbat ko khaalis banaati hain: jab tum usse milo to usse salaam karo, majlis mein usse jagah do, aur usse uske sabse pasandeeda naam se pukaaro." Abu Al-Mutarrif Muhammad bin Abi Al-Wazir, Basra ke bharosemand aur purane raawiyon mein se the, mujhe nahi pata ke maine unse iske siwa kisi aur hadith mein bharosa kiya ho. Abu Al-Mutarrif ko Abu Haatim ne kamzor qaraar diya.

e: [AI] About the Prophet, peace be upon him, it is said, "Indeed, Abdullah was only the servant of Allah who saw the Prophet, peace be upon him, and his mother's womb was illuminated."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se: "Beshak Abdullah wahi hain jinhone Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, aur unki maa Buhainah thin."

e: [AI] "On his side". The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had his beard trimmed with a pair of scissors. Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Husayn al-Baqir and Muhammad ibn Abdul Rahman ibn Thawban narrated from Abdullah ibn Malik ibn Buhayna.
hi: ...unke pehlu se. Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne oont ke jabde ki haddi se hijamah (pachhna/cupping) karaayi. Aur Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain Al-Baaqir aur Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman bin Thauban ne Abdullah bin Malik bin Buhainah se riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out to perform the Fajr prayer, and Bilal was with him. He led the prayer and passed by me, saying, "You should pray four (rak'ahs) for Fajr." Sheikh Abu Bakr ibn Ishaq narrated that I am Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Ziyad, reporting from Abu Hummah, who reported from Abu Qura, who reported from Ibn Juraij and Sufyan Ath-Thawri, who reported from Ja'far ibn Muhammad. They mentioned the hadith in a similar manner.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Fajr ki namaz ke liye nikle, unke sath Bilal the, to unhone namaz ki iqaamat ki, phir woh (Rasulullah SAW) mere paas se guzre aur poocha: "Kya tum Fajr chaar (rakat) padh rahe ho?" Shaikh Abu Bakr bin Ishaq ne humein bataya, humein Al-Hasan bin Ali bin Ziyaad ne bataya, humse Abu Hummah ne bayan ki, humse Abu Qurrah ne, Ibn Juraij se aur Sufyan Ath-Thawri se, Ja'far bin Muhammad se, aur unhone isi tarah hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by him while he was standing and praying the morning prayer in front of him. The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Do not perform this prayer before noon and after it, and make a separation between them.'" Imam Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas se guzre jabke woh khade hokar mere saamne Fajr ki namaz padh rahe the," to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh namaz Zuhr se pehle aur baad mein mat rakho, aur donon ke darmiyan faasla rakho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Nafi' ibn 'Utbah ibn Malik ibn Ahya ibn 'Abd Manaf ibn Zuhrah, and his mother is from Kinanah, and her name is Zaynab bint Jabir."
hi: "Naafi' bin Utbah bin Malik bin Ahyab bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah (RA), aur unki maa Kinaanah se thin, unka naam Zainab bint Jaabir tha."

e: [AI] "And it is said that his mother is Aatikah bint Awf, the sister of Abdur Rahman ibn Awf."
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai unki maa Aatikah bint Auf thin, Abdur Rahman bin Auf (RA) ki behn.

e: [AI] Some people from the Arabs came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to greet him, and they were wearing wool. So I stood up and said, "I will sit between these people and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Then I said to myself, "He is the savior of the people." Then my soul refused anything other than going to him. He said, "I heard him saying, 'They will wage war against the Arabian Peninsula and Allah will conquer it. Then they will wage war against Persia and Allah will conquer it. Then they will wage war against the Dajjal (Antichrist) and Allah will conquer him.'"
hi: Arab ke kuch log Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas salaam karne aaye, unpar oon (ke kapde) the, to main khada hua aur socha: 'Main zaroor in logon aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke darmiyan aa jaunga.' Phir maine apne dil mein socha: 'Woh (in) logon se khaas guftagu kar rahe hain.' Phir mera dil nahi maana aur main unki taraf khada hua, to maine unhein farmate suna: "Woh Jazeeratul-Arab par jung karenge, to Allah usse fatah dega, phir woh Faaris (Persia) par jung karenge, to Allah usse fatah dega, phir woh Dajjal par jung karenge, to Allah usse fatah dega." Musa bin Abdul Malik kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "Abdul Rahman, son of Azhar, son of Awf, son of Abdul Harith, son of Zuhrah, son of Kilab, and he is also known as Abu Zubair. His mother is Bukayrah, daughter of Abdul Yazid, son of Hashim, son of Muttalib, son of Abdul Manaf. He witnessed the Battle of Hunayn with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Azhar bin Auf bin Abdul Harith bin Zuhrah bin Kilaab (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Zubair thi, aur unki maa Bukairah bint Abd Yazid bin Hashim bin Al-Muttalib bin Abd Manaf thin, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain mein shirkat ki."
