e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, the example of a servant when he is afflicted with adversity or fever is like a piece of iron that is put into the fire; its impurities are removed and its goodness remains." Al-Dhahabi did not comment on it in the summary.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak bande ki misaal jab usse bukhaar ya taap lage, aisi hai jaise loha jo aag mein daala jaaye, to uska mail-kuchail nikal jaata hai aur uski achhaai baaqi rehti hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And Abdullah bin Adi bin Al-Hamra bin Rabia bin Abi Amro bin Ahayb bin Ilaaj bin Abdullah Az-Za'ira, and his mother is the daughter of Shareeq bin Amro bin Ahayb, the sister of Akhnas bin Shareeq."
hi: "Aur Abdullah bin Adi bin Al-Hamra bin Rabee'ah bin Abi Amr bin Ahyab bin Ilaaj bin Abdul Uzza (RA), aur unki maa Shareeq bin Amr bin Ahyab ki beti thin, Al-Akhnas bin Shareeq ki behn."

e: [AI] "And Abdullah bin Adi bin Al-Hamra As-Saqqafi, also known as Abu Amr."
hi: "Aur Abdullah bin Adi bin Al-Hamra Ath-Thaqafi (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Amr thi."

e: [AI] "He informed him that he heard the Prophet ﷺ while he was standing in Al-Hazwara in Mecca, saying: 'By Allah, you are the best land of Allah and the dearest land to Allah. If I had not been expelled from you, I would not have left.'"
hi: Unhone unhein bataya ke unhone Nabi (SAW) ko suna, jabke aap (SAW) Makkah mein Al-Hazwarah (bazaar) mein khade the: "Allah ki qasam, tum Allah ki behtareen zameen ho, aur Allah ke nazdeek sabse aziz zameen ho, aur agar mujhe tumse na nikaala jaata, to main na nikalta."

e: [AI] "And Abu Abdur-Rahman, Habib ibn Muslima ibn Malik ibn Wahb ibn Tha'labah ibn Wathilah ibn Amr ibn Sinan al-Fihri."
hi: "Aur Abu Abdur Rahman, Habib bin Muslimah bin Malik bin Wahb bin Tha'labah bin Waathilah bin Amr bin Sinaan Al-Fihri (RA)."

e: [AI] I heard Habib ibn Muslimah saying, "I witnessed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  performing the voluntary prayer of Witr."
hi: Maine Habib bin Muslimah (RA) ko kehte suna: "Maine dekha, Rasulullah (SAW) ne (maal-e-ghanimat mein se) aik tihaai inaam ke taur par diya."

e: [AI] When Abdul Rahman ibn Samura ibn Habib opened Sistan, he was accompanied by Abu Rifa'a Abdullah ibn Al-Harith ibn Asad ibn Adi ibn Malik ibn Tameem ibn Adi ibn Abdul Manat ibn Udd ibn Tabikha. He had companions with him. He marched with the army, and when night came, he stood up to pray, then lay down at the end of the night. His companions forgot about him, and a group of the enemy came and killed him.
hi: Jab Abdur Rahman bin Samurah bin Habib ne Sijistaan fatah kiya, to unke sath Abu Rifa'ah Abdullah bin Al-Harith bin Asad bin Adi bin Malik bin Tameem bin Ad-Dul bin Jabal bin Adi bin Abd Manaat bin Udd bin Tabikhah (RA) the, jinhein sohbat (Nabi SAW ki) haasil thi, "to woh lashkar mein chale, jab raat hui, to woh namaz padhne khade huay, phir raat ke aakhri hisse mein so gaye, aur unke saathi unhein bhool gaye, to dushman ka aik giroh unke paas aaya aur unhein zibah kar diya (shaheed kar diya)."

e: [AI] He heard from him Abdullah bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Muleikah.
hi: Unse Abdullah bin Ubaidullah bin Abi Mulaikah ne suna.

e: [AI] He got married to Umm Yahya, the daughter of Abi Ihab. Umm Thawiba, his mother, came and said, "I breastfed both of you." So I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and mentioned that, along with the rest of the conversation.
hi: Beshak unhone Umm Yahya bint Abi Ihaab se nikah kiya, to unki dhaai maa Thuwaibah (jinhone unhein doodh pilaaya tha) aayi aur kaha: "Maine tum dono ko doodh pilaaya hai," to main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur unhein yeh bataaya, aur baaqi hadith zikr ki.

e: [AI] Regarding the narration of 'Urwah about the naming of those who participated in the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the Banu Za'urah bin 'Abdul Ashhal, Muhammad bin Muslimah bin Khalid bin 'Adiy bin Mujadda'ah bin Harithah bin Al-Harith.
hi: Urwah se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein, Banu Za'oora bin Abdul Ashhal se: "Muhammad bin Maslamah bin Khalid bin Adi bin Mujadda'ah bin Haarithah bin Al-Harith (RA)."

e: [AI] "Regarding him, Al-Dhahabi on summarization."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Muhammad ibn Maslamah al-Ansari died in the year forty-three."
hi: "Muhammad bin Maslamah Al-Ansari (RA) ka intiqaal tettalees (43) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "Muhammad ibn Maslamah died in the city in the year forty-six. At that time, he was seventy-seven years old and was tall and bald."
hi: "Muhammad bin Maslamah (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah mein chhiyaalees (46) hijri mein hua, jabke woh us waqt sattattar (77) saal ke thay, aur woh lambe, gunjaa the."

e: [AI] "I will not settle in Egypt until this turmoil is resolved among the Muslim community."
hi: "Main unke shehron mein se kisi bhi shehar mein nahi thehrunga jab tak yeh fitna Musalmano ki jama'at se saaf na ho jaaye." Sahih.

e: [AI] "We do not include any evil from their territories until the matter is clarified as it has been clarified. This is a great virtue with a strong chain of narration."
hi: "Hum unke shehron ke kisi bhi buraai mein shaamil nahi honge jab tak maamla waise saaf na ho jaaye jaise (pehle) saaf hua." "Yeh sahih isnad ke sath aik bohot badi fazeelat hai."

e: [AI] I was sitting with Muhammad ibn Muslama, when the daughter of Dahak ibn Khalifa passed by. Muhammad began to look at her intently, so I said, "Glory be to Allah! You are the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and yet you do this?!" He replied, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'If Allah places the speech of a woman in a man's heart, it is not a sin for him to look at her.'"
hi: Main Muhammad bin Maslamah (RA) ke sath baitha tha ke Ad-Dahhaak bin Khaleefah ki beti guzri, to woh unhein apni nazron se dekhne lage, maine kaha: 'Subhaanallah, aap yeh kar rahe hain jabke aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain?' Unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: jab Allah kisi aadmi ke dil mein kisi aurat se nikah ka khayaal daale, to usse dekhne mein koi harj nahi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ, when he looked at them, said, "The faces have succeeded." It has a sound chain of narration, and it was not narrated by two sound narrators.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne, jab unki taraf dekha, farmaya: "Chehre kaamyaab ho gaye." Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, it is narrated that he went out to Ghatafan and said, "Who is with the son of Al-Asraf? He has harmed Allah and His Messenger." Muhammad bin Maslamah Al-Harithi said, "O Messenger of Allah, do you want me to kill him?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained silent for a while and then said, "Go to Sa'd bin Mu'adh and consult him." So, I went to Sa'd bin Mu'adh and mentioned the matter to him. He said, "Go on the guidance of Allah, and take with you the son of my brother Harith bin Aws, and Ubada bin Bishr Al-Ashhali, and Abu 'Abs bin Jabr Al-Harithi, and Abi Nailan Salkan bin Qays Al-Ashhali." So, I met them and told them the story. They all came with me except Salkan, and he said, "O nephew, I trust you, but I do not want to do anything until I consult the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." So, I told the Prophet ﷺ about it, and he said, "Go with your companions." We went to him at night, and we found him in a fortress. 'Abbad bin Bishr recited a poem describing their killing and capturing, and he said, "I shouted to him, but he did not respond to my voice. Then, a person came down from above the wall, and I returned to him. He asked, "Who is calling?" I said, "Your brother 'Abbad bin Bishr, and here is our shield as a pledge for two months or a half. They have taken them for two months and have never been deprived of luxury without poverty." Then, he came towards us swiftly and said, "You have come for a matter, and in our oaths, we have white iron and black iron by which we punish and destroy. I said to my companion when the swords began to flash, "This is a false kill!" And Ibn Maslamah Al-Muradi attacked him, screaming at him like a lion on the prey. Abu 'Abs bin Jabr tightened his sword on him, and Abu 'Abis bin Jabr struck him with his sword, and Allah was our support and ally, bestowing upon us His favor and granting us victory. A group of generous people joined us, and a Hud came to them with truth and righteousness."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se: aur (Ka'b bin Al-Ashraf) Ghatafan mein nikal jaata, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kaun hai jo Ibn Al-Ashraf ka intezaam kare? Usne Allah aur uske Rasool ko takleef pahunchayi hai." To Muhammad bin Maslamah Al-Haarithi ne kaha: 'Main, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap chaahte hain ke main usse qatl karoon?' To Rasulullah (SAW) khaamosh rahe, phir farmaya: "Sa'd bin Mu'aadh ke paas jaao aur unse mashwara lo." Unhone kaha: to main Sa'd bin Mu'aadh ke paas aaya aur unhein yeh bataaya, to unhone kaha: 'Allah ki barkat se jaao, aur apne sath mere bhatije Al-Harith bin Aws bin Mu'aadh, Abbad bin Bishr Al-Ashhali, Abu Abs bin Jabr Al-Haarithi, aur Abu Naa'ilah Silkan bin Qais Al-Ashhali ko lekar jaao.' Unhone kaha: to main unse mila aur unhein yeh bataaya, to sab mere paas aaye siwaye Silkan ke, jinhone kaha: 'Aye bhatije, main tumhein sachcha maanta houn, lekin main isme se kuch bhi karna pasand nahi karta jab tak main Rasulullah (SAW) se khud baat na kar loon.' To yeh baat Nabi (SAW) ko bataayi gayi, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne saathiyon ke sath jaao." Unhone kaha: to hum raat ko unki taraf nikle yahan tak ke hum unke qile mein unke paas aaye, to Abbad bin Bishr ne is baare mein aik shi'r kaha, jisme unhone unke qatl aur unke tareeqe ko bayan kiya, kaha (bahr Al-Waafir mein): "Maine usse pukaara, magar usne meri aawaaz ka jawaab na diya, phir woh deewar ke oopar se numaayan hua, to main dobaara pukaara, usne poocha: kaun pukaar raha hai? Maine kaha: tumhara bhai Abbad bin Bishr, aur yeh humari zirah rehan hai, isse do mahine ya aadhe mahine ke liye le lo, to usne kaha: (kuch) log bhooke the aur unhein bhook lagi thi, lekin woh ghareebi ke baghair maal-daari se mehroom nahi rahe, phir woh humari taraf tezi se badha aur kaha: tum log zaroor kisi kaam ke liye aaye ho, aur humare haathon mein tez, aazmaaye huay safed (talwaaren) hain jinse hum daagh dete hain aur (dushman ko) door karte hain, to maine apne saathi se kaha jab woh mere saamne aaya: talwaaren usse chhu rahi thin jaise kisi jaanwar ko zibah kiya jaa raha ho, aur Ibn Maslamah ne usse jhapatta jabke woh sher ki tarah garaj raha tha, aur unhone apni khinchi hui talwaar se uspar zor se waar kiya, to Abu Abs bin Jabr ne usse tapkaaya (gira diya), aur Allah humara chhatha (saathi) tha, madadgaar, sabse bharpoor ne'mat aur sabse azeem nusrat ke sath, aur kuch izzat-daar log uska sar lekar aaye, unhein sachi hidayat aur nekii ne raasta dikhaaya tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "To strike with this upon what is in this," Muhammad ibn Muslimah said to him, "Sit down, for we have struck with this upon what is in this before you were born." He continued to speak to him until he returned, "With a sound chain of narration according to the conditions of the two famous sheikhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim) and they did not exclude it." According to the condition of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: ...ke hum ise ispar (jamaa) karein, to Muhammad bin Maslamah ne usse kaha: "Baith jaao, humne isse ispar tumhare paida honay se pehle hi jamaa kar diya tha," phir woh usse baat karte rahe yahan tak ke woh wapas mudh gaya. Sahih isnad, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Who will deal with this wicked person?" Muhammad ibn Maslamah said, "I will, O Messenger of Allah." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Go to him, O Allah, assist him." So Muhammad ibn Maslamah stood up. Jabir said, "By Allah, I have never witnessed a fight between two men like I witnessed between them. When one of them approached the other, a tree came between them. One of them sought refuge behind it from his companion. When he hid behind it with something, his companion found what was behind it until he reached him. They kept maneuvering their swords. Muhammad ibn Maslamah struck him with his sword, and it penetrated him. However, Marhab was unable to remove his sword. Muhammad hit him and killed him."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is khabees Marhab ka intezaam kaun karega?" To Muhammad bin Maslamah ne kaha: 'Main, Ya Rasulullah (SAW).' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uski taraf uttho, Aye Allah, uski madad kar." To Muhammad bin Maslamah utthe. Jabir ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi do aadmiyon ke darmiyan aisi jung nahi dekhi jaisi maine in dono ke darmiyan dekhi, jab unme se aik doosre ke qareeb aaya, to unke darmiyan aik darakht aa gaya, to unme se aik uski aad lene laga doosre se, jab woh usse kisi cheez se chhup jaata, to uska saathi usse woh hissa dhoondh leta jo uske qareeb hota yahan tak ke woh usse pahunch jaata, woh dono apni talwaaron se usse (darakht ko) katarte rahe, to Muhammad bin Maslamah ne apni talwaar dhaal par maari, to unki talwaar usme phans gayi, aur Marhab apni talwaar nikaal na saka, to Muhammad ne usse maara aur usse qatl kar diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said when he arrived at Khaybar: "Tomorrow, I will give the flag to a man whom Allah and His Messenger love, and he loves Allah and His Messenger." When the next day came, a group of his companions competed for it. He called upon Ali, who had an eye infection, and put saliva in his eyes, then gave him the flag while the people stood up with him. They encountered the people of Khaybar, and whenever he entered a battle, he would recite, "By the sea complied with its limit; indeed, Khaybar knew that I am Harb, the brave champion, when swords are ready to burn, sometimes I stab, and sometimes I strike." He fought with Ali, and they both struck each other twice. Ali struck him on the head until the sword bit into it with its teeth, and the people of the army heard the sound of his strike, so they killed him. He was not the last of the people who were defeated, as the first of them doors were opened, and he said, "This is a major gate that I have brought out among the gates."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) jab Khaibar ke qareeb utre, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kal main jhanda aik aise aadmi ko dunga jo Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hai, aur Allah aur uska Rasool usse mohabbat karte hain." Jab agli subah hui, to unke kuch sahaba ne isse haasil karne ki tamanna ki, "to aap (SAW) ne Ali ko bulaaya, jabke woh aankh ki takleef mein the, aap (SAW) ne unki aankhon mein apna thook lagaaya aur unhein jhanda diya, aur log unke sath utthe." To unhone Khaibar walon se mulaqaat ki, achaanak Marhab unke saamne rajz (jung ka nara) padh raha tha, aur keh raha tha (bahr Ar-Rajaz mein): "Khaibar ko maloom hai ke main Marhab houn, hathiyaaron se lais, aazmooda pehalwaan, jab talwaaren aage badhti hain jalte huay, to kabhi main neze se waar karta houn aur kabhi talwaar se." To unka aur Ali ka do zarbon ka muqaabla hua, Ali ne unke sar par aisi zarab maari ke talwaar unke jabdon tak ghus gayi, aur lashkar ne unki zarab ki aawaaz suni, to usse qatl kar diya, aur baaqi log abhi pahunche bhi nahi the ke pehlon ke liye fatah ho chuki thi. "Yeh aik bada baab hai jo maine (kitaab ke) abwaab mein zikr kiya hai."

e: [AI] “Amr ibn Nufayl and Al-Khattab ibn Nufayl are the two brothers of the father of Umar.”
hi: "Amr bin Nufail aur Al-Khattab bin Nufail, Umar ke waalid, aik hi baap ke do bhai the."

e: [AI] Sa'id ibn Zaid ibn 'Amr ibn Nufayl came from Sham after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned from Badr. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke to him and shot an arrow for him. He said, "And what is my reward, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "And your reward is [to be] with me."
hi: Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail Sham se aaye jab Rasulullah (SAW) Badr se wapas aa chuke the, to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se baat ki, to aap (SAW) ne unke liye unka hissa muqarrar kiya. Unhone poocha: 'Aur mera ajr, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur tumhara ajr."

e: [AI] About Ibn Ishaq's narration about the name of the person who witnessed the Battle of Badr among the Muslims with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, from the Bani Adi bin Ka'b bin Fahr bin Malik, he said, "Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufayl bin Abd al-Uzza bin Rabah bin Qurt bin Raza bin Adi bin Ka'b bin Lu'ay bin Ghalib bin Fahr bin Malik and his mother was Fatimah bint Bajjah from the tribe of Khuzay'ah."
hi: Ibn Ishaq se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat karne wale Musalmano ke naamon mein, Banu Adi bin Ka'b bin Fihr bin Malik se, unhone kaha: "Aur Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail bin Abdul Uzza bin Rabaah bin Qurt bin Razaah bin Adi bin Ka'b bin Lu'ay bin Ghalib bin Fihr bin Malik, aur unki maa Fatimah bint Ba'jah, Khuza'ah se thin."

e: [AI] "That Sa'id son of Zaid son of 'Amr son of Nufayl is known as Abu al-A'war."
hi: "Beshak Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ki kunniyat Abu Al-A'war thi."

e: [AI] "Sa'id ibn Zaid ibn Amr ibn Nufayl had long curly hair and he was known by the nickname Abu al-A'war."
hi: "Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail saanwle rang wale, lambe, ghunghraale baal wale the, aur unki kunniyat Abu Al-A'war thi."

e: [AI] The golden one about summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] It was revealed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that a nation would be raised for five years. It is reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Sa'id ibn Zaid ibn 'Amr will embrace Islam before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  enters the house of Al-Arqam and before he calls people to Islam." Sa'id ibn Zaid witnessed the battles of Uhud, Al-Khandaq (the Trench), and all the other scenes with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , but he did not witness the Battle of Badr.
hi: ...ke Rasulullah (SAW) par paanch (5) saal ke liye wahi nazil hoti rahegi, aur Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat kiya gaya hai ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: yeh Ummat aik hi (jama'at) ke taur par uthaayi jaayegi. Aur Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr ne Islam qubool kiya isse pehle ke Rasulullah (SAW) Daar-e-Arqam mein dakhil hon aur isse pehle ke aap (SAW) wahan logon ko Islam ki taraf bulaayein, aur Sa'eed bin Zaid ne Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam maidaanon mein shirkat ki, lekin Badr mein shirkat nahi ki.

e: [AI] That Saad bin Abi Waqqas washed Sa'eed bin Zaid with a tree.
hi: "Beshak Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ne Sa'eed bin Zaid ko Ash-Shajarah (aik khaas jagah) mein ghusl diya."

e: [AI] "A man from the people of Sham (Syria) asked Marwan, 'What is keeping you here?' He replied, 'Until Sa'id ibn Zaid comes, for he is one of the elders of Madinah. When he pledges allegiance (to me), then the people will pledge allegiance.' The man said, 'So Sa'id ibn Zaid delayed (his arrival), until Marwan pledged allegiance and Sa'id refrained from doing so.' Al-Dhahabi did not comment on it in his summarization."
hi: Sham ke aik aadmi ne Marwan se poocha: "Aapko kis cheez ne roka hai?" Unhone kaha: "Jab tak Sa'eed bin Zaid na aayein, kyunke woh Madinah walon ke buzurg hain, jab woh baiyat karenge, to log bhi baiyat karenge." Unhone kaha: "To Sa'eed bin Zaid der se aaye, yahan tak ke Marwan ne baiyat le li, aur Sa'eed baiyat se ruk gaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Indeed, I did not wash myself from my own impurity, but I washed myself from the heat." Ibn Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "Suno, maine apna ghusl unse (bad-boo ya kisi cheez se) ghusl nahi kiya, balke maine garmi se ghusl kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] His grandfather, Sa'id ibn Zaid, asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about his father, Zaid. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, my father, Zaid ibn 'Amr ibn Nufayl, was as you have seen him and as he reached you. If he had lived to see you, he would have believed in you. So, ask forgiveness for him." The Messenger of Allah said, "Yes, I will ask forgiveness for him." He then asked forgiveness for him and said, "Verily, he will come on the Day of Resurrection as a single nation." It is mentioned that he was seeking the truth and he died while in his quest. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in his summary.
hi: Beshak unke dada Sa'eed bin Zaid ne Rasulullah (SAW) se apne waalid Zaid ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mere waalid Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail aisay the jaisa aapne dekha ya jaisa aapko pahuncha, aur agar woh aapko paate, to zaroor aap par imaan laate, isliye unke liye maghfirat maangein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan," to unhone unke liye maghfirat maangi, aur farmaya: "Beshak woh Qayamat ke din aik akeli Ummat bankar aayenge." Aur jaisa logon ne zikr kiya, woh (sachche) deen ki talaash mein the, aur isi talaash mein unka intiqaal hua. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] 'Omar ibn al-Khattab and Sa'id ibn Zaid said, "O Messenger of Allah, would you seek forgiveness for Zaid?" He replied, "Yes." So they sought forgiveness for him. He also said, "Indeed, he will be raised as a single nation."
hi: Beshak Umar bin Al-Khattab aur Sa'eed bin Zaid ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), kya aap Zaid ke liye maghfirat maangenge?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ji haan," to unhone dono ne unke liye maghfirat maangi, aur farmaya: "Beshak woh aik akeli Ummat bankar uthaaye jaayenge."

e: [AI] "If someone refused or rejected, then it would be true in what you have done to Uthman according to the condition of the two sheikhs (referring to Abu Bakr and Umar), and they did not expel him according to the condition of Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: "Agar koi (giroh) bikhar jaaye ya toot jaaye, to yeh usi ke laayaq hoga jo tumne Uthman ke sath kiya." Sahih, Shaykhain (Bukhari aur Muslim) ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "In Paradise, there are ten: Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Zubayr, Talhah, Abdul Rahman, Saad, Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah, and the tenth is Abu al-Awar in Paradise." The narrator then stopped, and they said to him, "We ask you by Allah, who is the tenth?" He said, "You have asked me by Allah, the tenth is Abu al-Awar in Paradise." This statement by al-Dhahabi is excluded in the summarization.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Das (10) Jannat mein hain: Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Zubair, Talhah, Abdur Rahman, Sa'd, aur Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarraah, aur yeh nau (9) hain." Phir aap (SAW) khaamosh ho gaye, to unhone kaha: 'Hum aapko Allah ki qasam dete hain, kya aap humein nahi bataayenge ke dasva kaun hai?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne mujhe Allah ki qasam di hai, to Abu Al-A'war Jannat mein hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "To kill his daughter? Wait, do not kill her, I will bear her responsibility." So he takes her, and when she grows up, he says to her father, "If you wish, I will return her to you, and if you wish, I will provide for her." It is valid according to the condition of the two sheikhs, and they did not exclude it."
hi: ...apni beti ko qatl karna (chaahta tha), "(Zaid ne kaha:) ruko, usse qatl mat karo, main iska poora kharcha uthaata houn," to woh usse le lete, jab woh badi ho jaati, to woh uske waalid se kehte: "Agar tum chaaho, to main tumhein wapas de dun, aur agar chaaho, to main iska kharcha uthaata rahoon." Sahih, Shaykhain (Bukhari aur Muslim) ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] About Urwah ibn Zubayr's mention of "those who were left behind from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the Battle of Tabuk, Ka'b ibn Malik ibn al-Qayn ibn Ka'b ibn Sawwad ibn Ghanm ibn Sa'd narrated to us from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: Urwah bin Az-Zubair se, un logon ka zikr karte huay jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se Tabook mein peeche reh gaye the: "Ka'b bin Malik bin Al-Qain bin Ka'b bin Sawwaad bin Ghanm bin Sa'd, unhone humein Rasulullah (SAW) se hadith bayan ki."

e: [AI] And Ka'b ibn Malik ibn Abi Ka'b ibn al-Qayn ibn Ka'b ibn Sawwad ibn Ghanm ibn Ka'b ibn Salamah, he was a poet of the Messenger of Allah. He was known as Abu Abdullah, and he witnessed the Battle of Uhud. He was wounded with twelve wounds and received honorable mention. He did not participate in the Battle of Badr, but he witnessed the Battle of the Trench and all other battles with the Messenger of Allah, except for the Battle of Tabuk. He missed it, being one of the three who stayed behind during the Battle of Tabuk. He then repented and was pardoned. Ka'b ibn Malik died in the year fifty during the caliphate of Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan. He was then seventy-seven years old.
hi: Aur Ka'b bin Malik bin Abi Ka'b bin Al-Qain bin Ka'b bin Sawwaad bin Ghanm bin Ka'b bin Salamah (RA), aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke shaayar the, aur kaha jaata hai unki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, aur Ka'b ne Uhud mein shirkat ki, to unhein wahan das se zyada zakhm lage aur woh (badly injured hokar) gir pade, aur unhone Badr mein shirkat nahi ki, magar unhone Khandaq aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam maidaanon mein shirkat ki, siwaye Tabook ke, kyunke woh usse peeche reh gaye the, aur woh un teen (logon) mein se aik the jo ghazwa-e-Tabook mein peeche reh gaye, phir unki tauba qubool ki gayi, aur Ka'b bin Malik ka intiqaal pachaas (50) hijri mein, Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan ki hukumat mein, hua, jabke woh us waqt sattattar (77) saal ke thay.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ commanded Ka'b ibn Malik when he came to him and to his companions to pray two rak'ahs or two prostrations. Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne "Ka'b bin Malik ko, jab unki aur unke saathiyon ki tauba qubool hui, hukum diya ke woh do rak'aat ya do sajde (shukrana namaz) padhein." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] And Ka'b ibn Malik witnessed the Battle of Al-Aqaba and pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah SAW in it. He said, "We went as pilgrims from Medina, and Bara' ibn Ma'rur said to us, 'O people, I have had a dream, and by Allah, I do not know whether you agree with me on it or not.' We asked, 'What is it?' He said, 'I have seen that I should not leave this well-constructed building of mine at the back.' And he mentioned the hadith in its entirety, and I think I have already mentioned it in the mention of Bara' ibn Ma'rur."
hi: Aur Ka'b bin Malik ne Aqabah mein shirkat ki aur wahan Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat ki, unhone kaha: "Hum Madinah se Hajj karne walon mein nikle, to Al-Bara bin Ma'roor ne humse kaha: 'Aye logo, maine aik khwaab dekha hai, Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata tum ismein mera saath doge ya nahi.' Humne kaha: 'Woh kya hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Maine dekha hai ke main (namaz mein) is imaarat (Ka'bah) ko apni peeth ki taraf na rakhoon,'" aur poori hadith zikr ki, "aur mera khayaal hai ke maine yeh Al-Bara bin Ma'roor (RA) ke zikr mein pehle bhi nikaali hai."

e:
[AI] The name listed is a long chain of names. However, it appears to be a combination of Arabic personal and tribal names. Here is the translation:

"Al-Hakam, son of Amr, son of Mujadda, son of Hithym, son of Al-Harith, son of Nuaiala, son of Mulayk, son of Damarah, son of Bakr, son of Abd Manata, son of Kinana."
hi: "Al-Hakam bin Amr bin Mujadda' bin Hidhyam bin Al-Harith bin Nu'ailah bin Mulaik bin Damrah bin Bakr bin Abd Manaat bin Kinaanah (RA)."

e: [AI] Al-Hakam bin Amr bin Mujadda bin Hithaym bin Hulwan bin Al-Harith bin Nu'ayla bin Mulayk bin Damarah, and his mother is Umamah bint Malik bin Al-Ashhal bin Abdullah bin Ghifarin. He died in Khorasan while he was the ruler there in the year 51.
hi: "Al-Hakam bin Amr bin Mujadda' bin Hidhyam bin Hulwaan bin Al-Harith bin Nu'ailah bin Mulaik bin Damrah (RA), aur unki maa Umaamah bint Malik bin Al-Ashhal bin Abdullah bin Ghifaar thin, unka intiqaal Khurasan mein hua jabke woh wahan ke gawarnar the, ikyaawan (51) hijri mein."

e: [AI] "And Al-Hakam bin Amr bin Mujadda bin Hizyam bin Al-Harith bin Nuayla bin Mulayk bin Dhamrah bin Bakr bin Abd Manat bin Kinana, and Nuayla, the brother of Ghifar bin Mulayk, was a companion of the Prophet ﷺ  until he passed away. Then he moved to Basra and settled there. Ziyad bin Abi Sufyan appointed him as a governor of Khorasan until he died there in the year fifty."
hi: "Aur Al-Hakam bin Amr bin Mujadda' bin Hidhyam bin Al-Harith bin Nu'ailah bin Mulaik bin Damrah bin Bakr bin Abd Manaat bin Kinaanah (RA), aur Nu'ailah, Ghifar bin Mulaik ke bhai the, unhein Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat haasil thi yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ka wisaal hua, phir woh Basra ki taraf chale gaye aur wahan rehne lage, to Ziyad bin Abi Sufyan ne unhein Khurasan ka gawarnar banaya, yahan tak ke unka intiqaal wahan pachaas (50) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] I was with Hakam ibn Amr al-Ghifari when Ali ibn Abi Talib's messenger came to him. Ali ibn Abi Talib said to him, "Indeed, the commander of the faithful says to you that you are the most deserving of those who have assisted us in this matter." Hakam ibn Amr al-Ghifari replied, "I heard my intimate friend, your cousin, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'When the situation is like this or similar to this, take a sword made of wood.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Main Al-Hakam bin Amr Al-Ghifari (RA) ke paas tha ke Ali bin Abi Talib ka qaasid unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ameer-ul-Momineen aapse kehte hain ke aap sabse haqdaar hain ke humari is maamle mein madad karein." To unhone kaha: "Maine apne khaas dost, tumhare chachazaad, Rasulullah (SAW), ko yeh farmate suna: jab aisa ya isi jaisa maamla ho, to lakdi ki talwaar ikhtiyar karo." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard Ahmad ibn Shayban saying, "Al-Hakam ibn 'Amr, Rifa'a ibn 'Amr, and 'Ali ibn 'Amr accompanied the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . Then Ziyad succeeded as the ruler of Khorasan, and the reason for his death was that he cursed himself while he was sick. He had a book read to him, and Ziyad and Muawiya responded to it. His prayer was answered, and he died while he was sick. Before him, Buraydah al-Aslami died, and we all buried them in the graveyard of Huseyn in Marw, opposite Abu Hamza al-Sukkari's bathhouse. I have visited their graves." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine Ahmad bin Shaiban ko kehte suna: "Al-Hakam bin Amr, Raafi' bin Amr, aur Ulayyah bin Amr, in teenon ne Nabi (SAW) ki sohbat ikhtiyar ki, phir Ziyad Khurasan ka gawarnar bana, aur unki (Al-Hakam ki) maut ki wajah yeh thi ke unhone Marw mein apne liye (khud ke khilaaf) dua maangi, jab unhein aik khat padh kar sunaaya gaya jo Ziyad ki taraf se aaya tha aur doosra Mu'awiyah ki taraf se, to unki dua qubool ho gayi aur unka Marw mein intiqaal ho gaya, aur unse pehle Buraidah Al-Aslami ka intiqaal ho chuka tha, to unhein dono ko Marw mein Husain ki qabristaan mein, Abu Hamzah As-Sukkari ke hamaam ke saamne, dafan kiya gaya, maine dono ki qabrein ziyarat ki hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That white and yellow be chosen for him, and not to divide gold and silver among the Muslims." The ruler wrote to him, "After you have written a mention of the book of the Commander of the Faithful, and indeed I found the book of Allah before the book of the Commander of the Faithful. And I swear by Allah, if the heavens and the earth were sewn together for a servant, and he feared Allah, He would make a way out for him from among them. And peace." The ruler ordered a caller to call out, so he called out that they should come forward to receive their shares. And when Mu'awiyah saw what the ruler had done in dividing the spoils, he turned to the one who had imprisoned and restricted him and said, "Indeed, I am a disputant." The gold was not mentioned in the summary by Al-Dhahabi.
hi: ...ke woh (sirf raajaa ke liye) safed (chaandi) aur peela (sona) chun le, aur woh Musalmano mein sona ya chaandi taqseem na kare. To Al-Hakam ne unhein likha: "Amma ba'd, aapne Ameer-ul-Momineen ki chitthi ka zikr karte huay mujhe likha, aur maine Allah ki kitaab ko Ameer-ul-Momineen ki chitthi se pehle paaya, aur main Allah ki qasam khaata houn, agar aasmaan aur zameen kisi banday par band ho jaayein aur woh Allah se dre, to Allah zaroor uske liye unme se koi raasta bana dega, wassalaam." Al-Hakam ne aik munaadi ko hukum diya, to usne pukaara ke apne maal-e-ghanimat ki taraf subah aa jaao, phir unhone woh unke darmiyan taqseem kar diya. Jab Al-Hakam ne maal-e-ghanimat ki taqseem mein yeh kiya jo kiya, to Mu'awiyah ne unki taraf aik aadmi bheja jisne unhein zanjeeron mein jakad diya aur qaid mein daal diya, to woh apni zanjeeron mein hi wafaat paa gaye aur unhi mein dafan kiye gaye, aur (unhone marte waqt) kaha: "Main zaroor (Qayamat ke din apne mukhaalifon se) jhagda karunga." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Do you not know why I came to you? Do you not remember that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  received the command from his commander to stand and then fall into the fire, the man was about to fall into it but he managed to grab hold of him? Then the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'If he had fallen into it, he would have entered the Hellfire. There is no obedience in the disobedience of Allah.' Al-Hakam said, 'Yes.' 'Imran said, 'I only wanted to remind you of this hadith.'"
hi: Unhone unse kaha: "Kya aap jaante hain main aapke paas kis liye aaya houn? Kya aapko yaad nahi ke jab Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh baat pahunchi ke aik ameer ne apne aadmi se kaha: uttho aur aag mein gir jaao, to woh aadmi ussme girne ke liye khada hua, magar usse rok liya gaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: agar woh ussme gir jaata, to woh Jahannam mein dakhil ho jaata, Allah ki nafarmaani mein koi itaa'at nahi." Al-Hakam ne kaha: "Ji haan (mujhe yaad hai)." Imraan ne kaha: "Mera iraada bas itna tha ke main aapko yeh hadith yaad dilaa dun."

e: [AI] There was a man from the people, why do you say this? And you have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "None of you should wish for death due to a hardship that has befallen him." He said, "I have heard what you have heard, but I rush to sell wisdom, abundant conditions, leadership of young boys, shedding of blood, severing family ties, and a growing trend that will occur at the end of time, where they take the Quran as songs." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this summary.
hi: Qaum mein se aik aadmi ne unse kaha: "Aap aisa kyun kehte hain, jabke aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: tum mein se koi bhi apne aane wale kisi museebat ki wajah se maut ki tamanna na kare?" Unhone kaha: "Maine bhi wahi suna hai jo tumne suna, lekin main chhah (6) cheezon se pehle (marna chaahta houn): faisle (qazaawat) ki khareed-o-farokht, zyada shurtiyon (pehredaaron) ka hona, bachon ki hukumat, khoon-khraabi, rishte-daari tor dena, aur aik aisi naslen jo aakhri zamaane mein aayengi jo Quran ko gaane-bajaane (mazameer) ki tarah istemaal karengi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Warāfiʿ ibn ʿAmr ibn Mujaddaʿ ibn Ḥidhyam ibn al-Ḥārith al-Ghifāri, died in Basra in the year fifty."
hi: "Aur Raafi' bin Amr bin Mujadda' bin Hidhyam bin Al-Harith Al-Ghifari (RA), unka intiqaal Basra mein pachaas (50) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There will be a group of people from my Ummah who will recite the Quran, but their recitation will not surpass their throats. They will leave the religion just as an arrow leaves its target, and they will not return to it. They will have the characteristic of moving swiftly." Abdullah bin As-Samit said, "I met Rafi bin Amr, the brother of Hakam bin Amr Al-Ghifari, and I asked him about a Hadith that I heard from Abu Dharr. I mentioned the Hadith to him and he said, 'What is strange about this? I heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  himself. It is authentic according to the criteria of Muslim, and they did not exclude it.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad meri Ummat mein aise log aayenge jo Quran padhenge, magar (woh) unke halq se neeche nahi utrega, woh deen se aise nikal jaayenge jaise teer shikaar se nikal jaata hai, phir woh usme wapas nahi aayenge, unki nishaani sar mundwaana hai." Abdullah bin As-Saamit ne kaha: to meri mulaqaat Raafi' bin Amr, Al-Hakam bin Amr Al-Ghifari ke bhai, se hui, maine unse kaha: 'Woh kaunsi hadith hai jo aapne Abu Dharr se suni, aisi aisi?' Maine unhein woh hadith bataayi, to unhone kaha: 'Isme tumhein kya ta'ajjub hai, maine ise khud Rasulullah (SAW) se suna hai.'" Sahih, Muslim ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Muslim ki shart par.

e: I was a boy. I used to throw stones at the palm-trees of the Ansar. So I was brought to the Prophet ﷺ who said: O boy, why do you throw stones at the palm-trees? I said: eat (dates). He said: Do not throw stones at the palm trees, but eat what falls beneath them. He then wiped his head and said: O Allah, fill his belly. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2622)
hi: Main Ansar ki khajooren giraane ke liye unpar patthar phenka karta tha, aur main aik ladka tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe dekha aur poocha: "Aye ladke, khajooron ko kyun patthar maarte ho?" Maine kaha: 'Khaane ke liye.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Khajooron ko patthar mat maaro, jo neeche gir jaaye usse khaao." Phir aap (SAW) ne mera sar sehlaaya aur farmaya: "Aye Allah, iska pait bhar de." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I was throwing dates at the Ansar, so they grabbed me and took me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. They said, "He is throwing our dates." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Rafi', why are you throwing their dates?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, because of hunger." He said, "May Allah satisfy and quench your hunger with whatever falls." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this incident in his summary.
hi: Main Ansar ki khajooron ko patthar maarta tha, to unhone mujhe pakad liya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas le gaye, unhone kaha: 'Yeh humari khajooron ko patthar maarta hai.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Raafi', tum unki khajooron ko patthar kyun maarte ho?" Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), bhook ki wajah se.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To jo gir jaaye usse khaao, Allah tumhein ser kare aur tumhari pyaas bujhaaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Sa'id Abdul Rahman ibn Samura ibn Habib ibn Abd Shams and his mother Arwa bint Abi al-Fara'ah ibn Kaab ibn Amr ibn Tarif ibn Khuzaymah ibn Alqamah ibn Khidash ibn Ghanm ibn Malik ibn Kinanah passed away in Basra in the year fifty. Ziyad offered the funeral prayer and walked in his funeral procession."
hi: "Abu Sa'eed Abdur Rahman bin Samurah bin Habib bin Abd Shams (RA), aur unki maa Arwa bint Abi Al-Fara'ah bin Ka'b bin Amr bin Tareef bin Khuzaimah bin Alqamah bin Khidaash bin Ghanm bin Malik bin Kinaanah thin, unka intiqaal Basra mein pachaas (50) hijri mein hua, aur Ziyad ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhi aur unki janaza mein paidal chale."

e: [AI] So we met Abu Bakrah on part of the road to Murbad. When he saw those people and what they were doing, he fought against them with force and inclined towards them with the whip. He said, "Let them go, by the One who has honored the face of my father Al-Qasim ﷺ , I have seen us with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and we were almost buried in its sand."
hi: To Abu Bakrah Al-Mirbad ke kisi raaste mein humse aa milay, jab unhone un logon ko aur unki harkatein dekhein, to unhone unhein zabardasti roka aur unki taraf apna korda badhaaya, aur kaha: "Chhod do, us Zaat ki qasam jisne Abu Al-Qasim (SAW) ke chehre ko izzat di, maine humein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath (aisi haalat mein) dekha hai ke hum (garmi/museebat mein) qareeb the ke reit mein dhans jaayein."

e: (empty)
hi: Humein Ali bin Hamshaadh aur Abu Bakr bin Ishaq ne hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: humein Bishr bin Musa ne hadith bayan ki, humse Al-Humaidi ne bayan ki, humse Sufyan ne, Abu Musa se, unhone Al-Hasan ko kehte suna, humse Abdur Rahman bin Samurah bin Habib bin Abd Shams ne hadith bayan ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdul Rahman ibn Uthman ibn Amr ibn Kaab ibn Saad ibn Taim ibn Muraah, he is the son of my cousin Talha ibn Ubaidullah, and his mother is Amirah bint Judan ibn Amr ibn Kaab ibn Saad ibn Taim ibn Muraah, she is the sister of Abdullah ibn Judan al-Qurashi."
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Uthman bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Taim bin Murrah (RA), woh Talhah bin Ubaidullah (RA) ke bhatije hain, aur unki maa Amirah bint Jud'an bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Taim bin Murrah thin, woh Abdullah bin Jud'an Al-Qurashi ki bhaanji thin."

e: [AI] I embraced Islam on the day of conquest, "So I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Maine Fatah ke din Islam qubool kiya, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat ki."

e: [AI] From Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  mentioned that the fragrance of medicine was present around him, and that the frog's mention is for its medicinal properties. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade killing it." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke saamne aik achhi dawa ka zikr kiya gaya, aur mendak (dawa mein istemaal honay) ka zikr kiya gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne usse qatl karne se mana farma diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Uthman bin Abi al-As bin Abd Rahman bin Abdullah bin Hammam al-Thaqafi, nicknamed Abu Abdullah, passed away in the year fifty."
hi: "Uthman bin Abi Al-Aas bin Bishr bin Abdullah bin Hammam Ath-Thaqafi (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, unka intiqaal pachaas (50) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] And he said, "Indeed, I saw us, with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , sifting sand." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Aur unhone kaha: "Maine humein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tez chaal (raml) karte dekha hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Mus'ab al-Ghamidiyyu, from the people of Homs, was a companion of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. He was known for his bravery, assistance, and generosity. He was the one who defended Hayt and Al-Anbar during the days of Ali by killing and capturing the enemies. He was among those who killed Hassan ibn Hassan al-Bakri, the brother of Harith ibn Hassan al-Wafidah, who came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, with Qaylah bint Makhramah. Ali proposed to her, saying in his proposal, "Indeed, the brother of Ghamid has defended Hayt and Al-Anbar when he was in the army during the days of Mu'awiyah. Mu'awiyah used to boast about his army, claiming that he had one thousand strong warriors with him." After Mu'awiyah, Ibn Mas'ud al-Fazarah was then chosen for this task. It was said, 'Establish, O Ibn Mas'ud, a canal like the one that Sufyan ibn Awf used to establish.' And smear, O Ibn Mas'ud, the walls of Madain Qaysar as Sufyan ibn Awf used to do. Sufyan is a nobleman from the Qurum tribe of the Taym people, and no one from among the people can match him in his generosity."
hi: Aur Sufyan bin Auf Al-Ghamidi (RA), Hims ke rehne wale, ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki sohbat ikhtiyar ki, aur unme himmat, bahaaduri, aur saakhaawat thi, aur woh wahi the jinhone Ali (RA) ke daur mein Haith aur Al-Anbaar par hamla kiya, qatl aur qaidi banaaye, aur woh un logon mein se the jinhone Hassaan bin Hassaan Al-Bakri (RA), Al-Harith bin Hassaan (RA) ke bhai jo Qailah bint Makhramah (RA) ke sath Nabi (SAW) ke paas wafd banakar aaye the, ko qatl kiya. To Ali (RA) ne khutba diya aur apne khutbe mein kaha: "Beshak Ghamid ka bhai (Sufyan) ne Haith aur Al-Anbaar par hamla kiya hai." Aur Sufyan Mu'awiyah (RA) ke daur mein garmi ki (fauji) mohimon par mamoor the, aur Mu'awiyah unke kaam ki azmat karte the aur kehte the ke woh aik hi majlis mein hazaar jawaan oonton ko sambhaal sakte the. Mu'awiyah ne unke baad Ibn Mas'ood Al-Fazari ko in mohimon par mamoor kiya, to kaha gaya (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Aye Ibn Mas'ood, mazboot neza ko qaayam rakho jaisa Sufyan bin Auf ise qaayam rakhte the, aur Aye Ibn Mas'ood, Qaisar ke shehron ka jaaiza lo jaisa Sufyan bin Auf inka jaaiza liya karte the, aur Sufyan aik qabile ke sardaaron mein se aik sardaar hain jisme Taim (qabila) bhi shaamil hai, aur logon mein koi qabila nahi jo unpar zulm kar sake."

e: [AI] Al-Mugheerah ibn Shu'bah was also known as Abu Abdullah, the governor of Kufa, and he died there in the year fifty.
hi: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, Kufa ke gawarnar bane aur wahin unka intiqaal pachaas (50) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] The name in English is: Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ibn Abi 'Amir ibn Mas'ud ibn Mu'attib ibn Malik ibn 'Amr ibn Sa'd ibn 'Amr ibn Qays ibn Shaybah ibn Bakr ibn Hawazin ibn Mansur ibn 'Ikrimah ibn Khasafah ibn Qays.
hi: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah bin Abi Aamir bin Mas'ood bin Mu'attib bin Malik bin Amr bin Sa'd bin Amr bin Qais bin Shaibah bin Bakr bin Hawaazin bin Mansoor bin Ikrimah bin Khasafah bin Qais (RA)."

e: [AI] "The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, described me as Abu Isa."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe 'Abu Isa' ki kunniyat di."

e: [AI] He is known as the changer of opinion and he was a skilled person who would not find but one of two options in his heart and he would find a solution in one of them. He came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and stayed with him until he performed the Umrah Al-Hudaybiyah in the month of Dhu al-Qadah in the sixth year of the Hijrah. Al-Mughirah said, "That was the first journey I went out with him in. I used to be with Abu Bakr As-Siddiq and I would adhere to whoever the Prophet ﷺ adhered to." Al-Mughirah witnessed many scenes with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and a delegation from Thaqif came, so the Prophet ﷺ hosted them and honored them, and he sent the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Abu Sufyan bin Harb to Ta'if, and they defeated the Banu Al-Waylah.
hi: Unhein Mughirah Ar-Raay (sahi raay wale) kaha jaata tha, aur woh aise hoshiyaar the ke jab bhi unke saamne do mushkil maamle aate, to woh unme se aik ka koi hal zaroor nikaal lete. Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unke sath rahe yahan tak ke unhone Hudaibiyah ki umrah ki, Zul-Qa'dah, hijrat ke chhattay (6) saal mein. Al-Mughirah ne kaha: "Yeh pehla safar tha jismein main unke sath nikla, aur main Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ke sath rehta tha aur Nabi (SAW) ke sath us jama'at mein rehta jo unke sath rehti thi." Al-Mughirah ne iske baad Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath baaki maidaanon mein bhi shirkat ki, aur Thaqeef ka wafd aaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Al-Mughirah ke paas thehraaya aur unki izzat ki, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein aur Abu Sufyan bin Harb ko Taif bheja, to unhone (Laat ke) parcham (parastish ke nishaanaat) todh diye.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away, Abu Bakr As-Siddiq sent me to the people of Al-Buhaira. Then I witnessed the Battle of Yamama, and then I witnessed the Muslim conquests in Sham (Greater Syria). After that, I witnessed the Battle of Yarmouk, where I was injured in my eye. Then I witnessed the Battle of Qadisiyyah, and I was appointed as a messenger for Sa'd bin Rustom, and I was appointed as a governor for Umar Ibn Al-Khattab in conquests. I conquered Hamazan, and I was in control of Maysarah, the son of Nu'man, on the day of Nahavand. Umar had written that if Nu'man dies, then the prince would be Hudhayfah, and if Hudhayfah dies, then the prince would be Al-Mughirah. I was the first to establish the Diwan of Basrah (administrative office), and I gathered people to distribute wealth. I was appointed as a governor for Kufah for Umar Ibn Al-Khattab. Umar was killed while I was there, and then I was appointed as a governor for Muawiyah. Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal hua, to Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne mujhe Al-Buhairah walon ki taraf bheja, phir main Yamamah mein shaamil hua, phir main Musalmano ke sath Sham ki fatah mein shaamil hua, phir main Yarmook mein shaamil hua, to Yarmook ke din meri aankh mein chot lagi, phir main Qaadisiyyah mein shaamil hua, aur main Sa'd (bin Abi Waqqas) ka Rustum ki taraf qaasid tha, aur mujhe Umar bin Al-Khattab ne fatah-shuda ilaaqon par gawarnar banaya, aur maine Hamadan ko fatah kiya, aur main Naha'wand ke din An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin ke bayen paksh (maisarah) par tha, aur Umar ne likha tha: agar Nu'man shaheed ho jaayen, to ameer Hudhaifah honge, aur agar Hudhaifah shaheed ho jaayen, to ameer Al-Mughirah honge, aur main sabse pehla tha jisne Basra ka diwaan (register) qaayam kiya aur logon ko unka hissa dene ke liye jama kiya, aur mujhe Umar bin Al-Khattab ne Kufa ka gawarnar banaya, aur Umar shaheed kiye gaye jabke main wahan gawarnar tha, phir mujhe Mu'awiyah ne wahan gawarnar banaaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "When Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba threw his ring into the Prophet's ﷺ grave, people should not mention that you descended into the Prophet's ﷺ grave, and you should not inform people that your ring is in his grave. So Ali descended and saw the place, so he took it and returned it to him." Gold has remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Jab Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ne apni angoothi Nabi (SAW) ki qabr mein gira di, (Ali ne unse kaha): "Log yeh baat na karein ke tum Nabi (SAW) ki qabr mein utre, aur na tum logon ko yeh baat batao ke tumhari angoothi unki qabr mein hai," to Ali khud utre, aur unhone uski jagah dekhi thi, to unhone usse uthaaya aur unhein wapas de diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Bakrah said, "O Amir, what caused you to leave the seat of power?" He said, "I wanted to speak to you." Abu Bakrah replied, "That is not for you, O Amir. The Amir sits in his house and sends messengers to whoever he wants to talk to." He said, "O Abu Bakrah, there is no harm in what I am doing." So he entered through the smaller door until he reached the door of Umm Jamil, a woman from the Banu Qays tribe. Abu Bakrah said, "I cannot bear this anymore." So he sent a youth to him and told him to climb up to my room and see from the window. The youth went and came back and said, "I found them under the blanket." Abu Bakrah said to the people, "Come with me." So they all got up and followed him. Abu Bakrah started looking and then turned back and said to his brother, "Look." His brother looked and he asked, "What did you see?" His brother replied, "I saw them committing adultery." He asked, "What about you?" His brother looked and said, "I saw them committing adultery while married." Abu Bakrah said, "I bear witness before Allah that you saw it." They all replied, "Yes." Then they returned to their families and Abu Bakrah wrote to Umar ibn al-Khattab describing what he had seen. Umar sent Abu Musa al-Ash'ari as the governor of Basrah, who sent word to al-Mughirah to stay with him for three days as he was the governor of his own self. On the fourth day, they set out together, Abu Bakrah and his witnesses. Umar said, "Show me what you have, Abu Bakrah." Abu Bakrah said, "I bear witness that I saw them committing adultery while married." Then they presented Abu Abdullah, his brother, who said, "I bear witness that I saw them committing adultery while married." Then they presented Shibl ibn Ma'bad al-Bajali and asked him, and he also gave the same testimony. Then they presented Ziyad and Umar asked him, "What did you see?" He replied, "I saw them under the blanket and I heard a loud noise, but I do not know what happened after that." Umar praised Allah and was pleased that al-Mughirah had been saved, and he ordered that the people be punished except for Ziyad. Umar then sent Uthman ibn Affan to Basrah, and he arrived there in the sixteenth year. Uthman died in the nineteenth year, and Uthman had disliked his appointment and used to pray to Allah to save him from it. He fell from his mount and died, may Allah have mercy on him. And what happened with al-Mughirah was from the affairs of al-Mughirah.
hi: Abu Bakrah ne unse kaha: "Aye Ameer, aapko darbaar se kis cheez ne nikaala?" Unhone kaha: "Main tumse baat karne aaya houn." To Abu Bakrah ne unse kaha: "Aapko yeh haq nahi, ameer apne ghar mein baithta hai aur jise chaahe bulaata hai, phir uske sath baat karta hai." Unhone kaha: "Aye Abu Bakrah, jo main kar raha houn usme koi harj nahi." Phir woh chhote darwaze se dakhil huay yahan tak ke Umm Jameel, Qais (qabile) ki aik aurat, ke darwaze tak pahunche. Unhone kaha: aur Abu Abdullah (Al-Mughirah) ke ghar aur us aurat ke ghar ke darmiyan aik raasta tha, to woh uske paas dakhil huay. Abu Bakrah ne kaha: "Mujhse yeh bardaasht nahi hoga," to unhone apne aik ghulam ko bheja aur usse kaha: "Meri kothri se chadho aur roshan-daan se dekho." To woh gaya, dekha, phir thodi der mein wapas aakar kaha: "Maine unhein aik hi chaadar mein paaya." To unhone log se kaha: "Mere sath chalo," to woh utthe, to Abu Bakrah ne pehle dekha, phir 'Inna lillahi' padha, phir apne bhai se kaha: "Dekho," to unhone dekha, poocha: "Tumne kya dekha?" Unhone kaha: "Maine zina dekha." Phir poocha: "Tumhein kya shak hai? Dekho," to unhone dekha, poocha: "Tumne kya dekha?" Unhone kaha: "Maine mohsanah (shaadi-shuda) zina dekha." Unhone kaha: "Main tum sab par Allah ko gawaah rakhta houn." Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' To woh apne ghar walon ki taraf laut gaye aur Umar bin Al-Khattab ko likha jo unhone dekha tha, to unhein aik bhayanak khabar mili, ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke aik sahabi (aise fe'l mein shaamil hain), to unhone jaldi Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari ko Basra ka ameer bana kar bheja, to Abu Musa ne Al-Mughirah ko paighaam bheja ke: teen din tak thehro, tum apne aap ke ameer rahoge, phir jab chautha din ho, to tum aur Abu Bakrah aur unke gawaah kooch karo, to mubaarak ho tumhein agar tumpar jhoot bola gaya ho, aur afsos ho tumpar agar sach bola gaya ho. To sab log kooch kar gaye - Abu Bakrah, unke gawaah, aur Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah - yahan tak ke woh Madinah mein Ameer-ul-Momineen ke paas pahunche, to unhone kaha: "Jo tumhare paas hai woh pesh karo, Aye Abu Bakrah." Unhone kaha: "Main gawahi deta houn ke maine mohsanah zina dekha." Phir unhone unke bhai Abu Abdullah ko aage kiya, to unhone bhi gawahi di aur kaha: "Main gawahi deta houn ke maine mohsanah zina dekha." Phir unhone Shibl bin Ma'bad Al-Bajali ko aage kiya, unse poocha, unhone bhi waisi hi gawahi di. Phir unhone Ziyad ko aage kiya, unse poocha: "Tumne kya dekha?" Unhone kaha: "Maine unhein aik chaadar mein paaya, aur maine tez saans suni, magar mujhe nahi pata iske aage kya hua." To Umar ne Allahu Akbar kaha aur khush huay ke Al-Mughirah bach gaye, aur unhone gawaahon ko sazaa di (jhooti gawahi ki hadd) siwaye Ziyad ke." (Unhone kaha:) Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar bin Al-Khattab ne Utbah bin Ghazwan ko Basra ka gawarnar banaya tha, to woh solah (16) hijri mein wahan pahunche, aur unka intiqaal unnees (19) hijri mein hua, aur Utbah is (zimmedaari) ko napasand karte the aur Allah se dua karte the ke woh unhein isse chhutkaara de, to woh raaste mein apni sawaari se gir gaye aur wafaat paa gaye, Allah unpar reham kare, phir Al-Mughirah ka maamla jo hua so hua.

e: [AI] Egypt was conquered in the year twenty, and in it, the conquest of the Euphrates forcibly took place. It was said that it was opened by Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba, and he was succeeded by Utbah bin Ghazwan. He then went to Umar and commanded Umar to appoint Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba over Basra, and he wrote to him afterwards. So, he was under his command, as well as the command of Umm Jamil al-Qaisiyyah, for as long as he was in power.
hi: Misr baees (20) hijri mein fatah hua, aur usi saal mein Euphrates (darya) ka ilaaqa bhi zabardasti fatah hua, aur kaha jaata hai ke Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ne isse fatah kiya, aur unhein Utbah bin Ghazwan ne apna naib banaaya tha, phir woh (Utbah) Umar ke paas gaye, to Umar ne Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ko Basra ka ameer banaaya, aur unhein baad mein bhi likh kar (gawarnar) rakha, phir unka aur Umm Jameel Al-Qaisiyyah ka jo maamla hua so hua.

e: [AI] The following translation is into English: If Al-Bahr al-Taweel said, "I draw dwellings with Mu'ghira, which the people of jinn and mankind recognize, so if you have kept Haman and Pharaoh after us, then know that the owner of the throne will be fair." They approached him and insulted him, and by Allah, I do not know which path he took. The rule of Mu'ghira ibn Shu'ba in al-Kufa was for seven years.
hi: Unhone kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Kya Al-Mughirah se mansoob ghar ke nishaan pehchaane jaate hain jinhein jinnaat aur insaan dono pehchaante hain? To agar tumne humare baad Haaman aur Fir'aun ko baaqi rakha hai, to jaan lo ke Arsh ka Maalik insaaf karta hai." Unhone kaha: to log unpar bura-bhala kehne lage, Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata woh kaunsa raasta le gaya. Aur Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah ki Kufa ki hukumat saat (7) saal rahi.

e: [AI] "Regarding him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "A man came and called out, seeking permission from Abu Isa to see the Commander of the Faithful, Umar. Umar asked, 'Who is Abu Isa?' The man replied, 'Al-Mughira bin Shu'bah is Abu Isa.' Umar said, 'Does Isa have a father? In the nicknames of the Arabs, we do not conceal the names of Abu Abdullah and Abu Abdul Rahman.' A man said, 'I bear witness that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  giving him the nickname Al-Mughira.' Umar said, 'Verily, the Prophet ﷺ  has forgiven him for his past and future sins, and we are in a state of uncertainty about what will become of us. So, we nickname him after Abu Abdullah.'"
hi: Beshak aik aadmi aaya aur pukaarne laga, ijaazat maang raha tha ke Abu Isa Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar ke paas aayen. To Umar ne poocha: "Aur Abu Isa kaun hain?" Usne kaha: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah, main houn." To Umar ne kaha: "Kya Isa ka koi waalid hai? Kya Arabon ki kunniyaton mein 'Abu Abdullah' aur 'Abu Abdur Rahman' jaisi kunniyaten nahi jinse tum apni kunniyat rakh sako?" To aik aadmi ne kaha: "Main gawahi deta houn ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Al-Mughirah ko isi kunniyat se pukaarte suna hai." To Umar ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) ke to agle aur pichhle gunaah maaf kar diye gaye hain, aur hum aisi haalat mein hain ke humein nahi pata humare sath kya kiya jaayega." To unhone unki kunniyat 'Abu Abdullah' rakh di. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Mugheerah became the governor of Kufa in the year forty-one and died in the year fifty."
hi: Beshak Al-Mughirah iktalees (41) hijri mein Kufa ke gawarnar banay aur pachaas (50) hijri mein unka intiqaal hua.

e: [AI] "Mughira bin Shu'ba used to include Ali in his sermons, and he appointed orators who also included Ali in their sermons. While he was delivering a sermon and praising Ali, Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufayl al-'Adawi, who was sitting next to me, punched me with his hand and said, 'Do you not see what he is saying? Or should I say, these are my witnesses, the nine who are assured of paradise. And if I were to testify about the tenth, I would be truthful. We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Hira, myself, Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Talha, Zubayr, Sa'd, and Abdul Rahman bin Awf when the mountain shook.' The Prophet ﷺ then said, 'Hold on to Hira, for you will have nothing but a prophet, a truthful one, or a martyr.'"
hi: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah apne khutbe mein Ali par bura-bhala kehte the, aur unhone aise khateeb muqarrar kiye the jo Ali par bura-bhala kehte, to aik baar woh khutba de rahe the aur Ali par bura-bhala keh rahe the, aur mere paas Sa'eed bin Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail Al-Adawi khade the, unhone kaha: to unhone mujhe apne haath se maara aur kaha: "Kya tum nahi dekhte yeh kya keh raha hai?" ya kaha: 'Yeh log kya keh rahe hain?' "Main nau (9) logon ke baare mein gawahi deta houn ke woh Jannat mein hain, aur agar main dasve ke baare mein qasam khaaun, to sach kahunga: hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hira (pahaad) par the, main, Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali, Talhah, Zubair, Sa'd, aur Abdur Rahman bin Auf, to pahaad hilne laga." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Thehar ja, Aye Hira, tujhpar sirf Nabi, Siddiq, ya Shaheed hi (khada) hai."

e: [AI] We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  one night, and he struck his hand on the neck of my riding animal and said, "Do you have any water?" I said, "Yes, I have a container of water with me." He dismounted and fulfilled his need, then he came to me and asked, "Do you need to fulfill your need?" I said, "No." He washed his hands three times, rinsed his mouth three times, sniffed water into his nose three times, washed his face three times, and then he wanted to take out his arms, but he was wearing a tight woolen garment, so he couldn't take out his arms from it. He took out his hands from under the garment and then washed his arms three times, wiped over his head, and wiped over his slippers. Then we continued on and caught up with the group, and Abdullah bin Awf led them in prayer. I wanted to call the adhan for him in the place of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , but he prevented me. So we joined the prayer, and then we performed the second prayer." This narration is a strange and authentic narration due to the weakness found in its context, as stated by Al-Dhahabi in his summary.
hi: Hum aik raat Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath safar kar rahe the, to aap (SAW) ne apna haath meri sawaari ki gardan par maara, phir farmaya: "Tumhare paas paani hai?" Maine kaha: 'Ji haan, meri sath yeh paani ki mashk hai.' To aap (SAW) neeche utre aur qaza-e-hajat ki, phir mere paas aaye aur poocha: "Kya tumhein qaza-e-hajat ki zaroorat hai?" Maine kaha: 'Nahi,' "To aap (SAW) ne apne dono haath teen baar dhoye, teen baar kulli ki, teen baar naak mein paani daala, apna chehra teen baar dhoya, phir apne bazu nikaalna chaahe, aur aap par aik tang ooni jubba tha, to aap apne bazu ussme se na nikaal sake, to aap ne apne haath jubbay ke neeche se nikaale, phir apne bazu teen-teen baar dhoye, phir apne sar ka masah kiya aur mozon par masah kiya." Phir hum chal pade aur qaum ko jaa milay, to Abdur Rahman bin Auf ne unhein namaz padhaayi, aur main chaahta tha ke unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ki maujoodgi ki khabar doon, magar unhone mujhe roka, to humne (unke sath) namaz padhi, phir humne doosri (namaz alag se) padhi. Ghareeb, Sahih isnad, magar dono ne ise isi andaaz mein nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se iski kamzori ki wajah se hataaya.

e: [AI] Al-Mughirah said: "We were lost, so Allah sent us a prophet who guided us to His religion and blessed us with provisions. Among the provisions was a seed that would grow in your lands. When we ate from it and fed our families, they said, 'We will not be satisfied until you let us enter your lands.' We replied, 'If you kill us, we will enter Paradise, and if we kill you, you will enter Hell.'"
hi: Al-Mughirah (ne kaha): "Hum gumraah the, to Allah ne humme aik Nabi bheja, usne humein apne deen ki taraf hidayat di aur humein rizq diya, to jo kuch humein rizq mila usme aik daana bhi tha jo tumhare in shehron mein hota hai, jab humne usme se khaaya aur apne ghar walon ko khilaaya," (to unhone kaha:) 'Humein sabr nahi hoga jab tak tum humein in shehron mein na basaao.' (Unhone kaha:) 'To hum tumhein qatl karenge.' (Unhone kaha:) 'Agar tum humein qatl karoge, to hum Jannat mein dakhil honge, aur agar hum tumhein qatl karenge, to tum Jahannam mein dakhil hoge.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se iski kamzori ki wajah se hataaya.

e: [AI] "They sent with me ten (people), so they were given clothes to wear and then they took a camel and set off until they reached me." He said, "Throw me a shield." So he sat on it and said, "You Arabs have known the reason that made you come to us, that you are a people who do not find enough food in your own lands to satisfy yourselves. So take from our food what you need, for we are a people who follow the Zoroastrian religion and we abhor killing you. You have defiled our land. Al-Mughirah said, 'By Allah, that is not why we have come. But we used to be a people who worshipped stones and idols, and whenever we saw a stone that was better than the one we had, we would throw our stone and take the better one. We did not know Allah until Allah sent a Messenger to us from among ourselves, calling us to Islam, so we followed him. We did not come for food, but we came to fight against your fighters and take your children captive. As for the food that you have mentioned, we swear by Allah that we do not find enough food to satisfy ourselves, and sometimes we do not find a drop of water. So we came to your land and we found plenty of food and plenty of water. By Allah, we will never leave it as long as we live or as long as you live.' Al-Ilaaj spoke in Persian and said, 'He is telling the truth.' He said, 'And may your eye be restored to health.' Then his eye was healed from that day. This is a strange and Sahih hadith that has not been narrated by anyone else." Sahih.
hi: "Unhone mere sath das (10) log bheje, to woh nikle, unhone apne kapde theek kiye, phir aik dhaal li, phir chale yahan tak ke unke paas pahunche." To unhone (Al-Mughirah ne) kaha: "Mere liye aik dhaal daalo." To woh usme baith gaye, to ghair-Arab (Persian afsar) ne kaha: "Tum Arabon ki jama'at, tum jaante ho ke tumhein humare paas aane par kis cheez ne majboor kiya, tum aise log ho jo apne shehron mein itna khaana nahi paate jissay tum ser ho sako, to lo, hum tumhein tumhari zaroorat ka khaana denge, kyunke hum Majoos (aatish-parast) log hain aur hum tumhein qatl karna napasand karte hain, tum humari zameen ko humare liye napaak kar dete ho." To Al-Mughirah ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh cheez humein nahi laayi, balke hum aik aisi qaum the jo patthar aur but ki parastish karte the, jab humein koi patthar behtar milta, to humein usse phenk kar doosra le lete, aur humein koi Rab maloom na tha yahan tak ke Allah ne humme aik Rasool humme se hi bheja, to usne humein Islam ki taraf bulaya, to humne uski pairavi ki, aur hum khaane ke liye nahi aaye, humein hukum diya gaya hai apne dushman se jung karne ka jinhone Islam chhod diya hai, aur hum khaane ke liye nahi aaye, balke hum tumhare jangjuon ko qatl karne aur tumhari aulaad ko qaid karne aaye hain, aur rahi baat jo tumne khaane ke baare mein kahi, to Allah ki qasam, humein aisa khaana nahi milta jisse hum ser ho sakein, aur kabhi kabhi humein paani bhi nahi milta jisse hum apni pyaas bujha sakein, to hum tumhari is zameen par aaye, humein yahan bohot khaana aur bohot paani mila, Allah ki qasam, hum yahan se nahi hatenge jab tak yeh hamari na ho jaaye ya tumhari." To us ghair-Arab ne Farsi mein kaha: "Yeh sach kehta hai." (Al-Mughirah ne kaha:) "Aur teri aankh phood di jaayegi." To agli subah unki aankh, teer lagne se, phood gayi. Ghareeb, Sahih isnad, dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Sahih.

e: [AI] "Rukana bint Abd Yazeed bin Hashim bin Muttalib bin Abd Manaf died in the city during the beginning of the reign of Muawiyah in the year forty."
hi: "Rukanah bin Abd Yazeed bin Hashim bin Al-Muttalib bin Abd Manaf (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah mein, Mu'awiyah ki hukumat ke shuru mein, chalis (40) hijri mein hua."

e: Ali quoting his father said: Rukanah wrestled with the Prophet ﷺ and the Prophet ﷺ threw him on the ground. Rukanah said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: The difference between us and the polytheists is that we wear turbans over caps. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4078)
hi: Beshak unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se kushti ladi, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein pachaad diya, aur Rukanah ne kaha: maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Humare aur mushrikeen ke darmiyan farq pagdiyon ka topiyon par (bandhna) hai."

e: [AI] Amr Ibn Al-Aas passed away in the year fifty-one, Allah knows best.
hi: Beshak Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ka intiqaal ikyaawan (51) hijri mein hua, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The two sons of Al-Aas are believers, Hisham and Amr." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about them in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Al-Aas ke dono bete momin hain: Hishaam aur Amr." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "To my son Abdullah: If I die, wash me, shroud me, and tie my waistcloth or waistband tightly around me, for I am a debtor. When you wash me, hasten with my funeral procession. When you place me in the prayer area on the day of celebration, whether it is Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha, look at the paths. If there is no one left and the people have gathered, begin with the funeral prayer for me, then offer the Eid prayer. When you place me in my grave, bury me with soil, and know that my right side is not more deserving of soil than my left side. After you have leveled the soil on my grave, sit by it facing towards the direction of a slaughtered animal's throat and its dismemberment, for I will find solace in your company." This is what Adh-Dhahabi omitted in his summary.
hi: Apne bete Abdullah se (kaha): "Jab main mar jaaun, to mujhe ghusl do, kafan do, aur mera tehband ya kapda mujhpar kaska baandho, kyunke main (Allah ke saamne apne aamaal ka) jhagda karne wala houn, jab tum mujhe ghusl de chuko, to jaldi se mujhe le chalo, jab tum mujhe eidgah mein rakh doge, aur woh Eid ka din hoga, chaahe Fitr ho ya Adha, to raaston ke mukhon ko dekhna, jab wahan koi baaqi na rahe aur log jama ho jaayein, to sabse pehle meri namaz-e-janaza padho, phir Eid ki namaz padho, jab tum mujhe meri qabr mein rakh doge, to mujhpar mitti daal dena, kyunke mera daayan pehlu mitti ka usse zyada haqdaar nahi jitna mera baayan pehlu, jab tum mujhpar mitti barabar kar chuko, to mere paas oont zibah karne aur usse kaatne jitne waqt tak baitho, taake main tumhare (sath honay) se sukoon mehsoos karoon." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Kilo Malii" They weighed it and found it to be 52 mudds. He said, "Who will take it for its value? Oh, how I wish it was a camel." He said, and the mudd was sixteen Uqiyas, each Uqiya of it is equivalent to the weight of two Askiya gold coins. The summary does not mention what the goldsmith said.
hi: "Mera maal naapo," to unhone naapa, to unhein baawan (52) mudd mila, to unhone kaha: "Kaun ise iske saath le lega? Kaash yeh oont ki laid hoti." Unhone kaha: aur aik mudd solah (16) uqiyah ka hota tha, aur aik uqiyah do makook ke barabar hoti thi. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Amr, son of Al-Aas, son of Wail, son of Hashim, son of Sa'id, son of Sahm. He is also known as Abu Abdullah. His mother is Al-Nabigha, daughter of Harmala, from the tribe of Anaza. His brothers through his mother are Amr, son of Uthatha, son of Abbadd, son of Abdul-Muttalib, son of Abd Manaf, son of Qusay, and Unayf, son of Abi Al-Aas, son of Umayyah, son of Abd Shams. There are different opinions regarding the timing of his death."
hi: "Amr bin Al-Aas bin Waa'il bin Hashim bin Sa'eed bin Sahm (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, aur unki maa An-Naabighah bint Harmalah, Anazah (qabile) se qaid ki gayi thin, aur unke maa ki taraf se bhai Amr bin Athaathah bin Abbaad bin Abdul Muttalib bin Abd Manaf bin Qusayy aur Unaif bin Abi Al-Aas bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams the, aur unki maut ke waqt ke baare mein ikhtilaaf hai."

e: [AI] "He passed away in the year fifty-one, and the most accurate information I heard at the time of the death of Amr ibn Al-Aas."
hi: "Unka intiqaal ikyaawan (51) hijri mein hua," aur Amr bin Al-Aas ki wafaat ke waqt ke baare mein maine jo sabse sahih baat suni hai (woh yehi hai).

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Ma'in say, "Amr bin Al-Aas died in the year forty-three and was buried in Egypt."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Amr bin Al-Aas ka intiqaal tettalees (43) hijri mein hua, aur unhein Misr mein dafan kiya gaya."

e: [AI] "Amr ibn al-Aas ibn Wa'il came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the year eight. He was known as Abu Abdullah and he passed away in Egypt on the day of Eid in the year forty-two, and he was seventy years old."
hi: "Amr bin Al-Aas bin Waa'il (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aath (8) hijri mein aaye, unki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, aur unka intiqaal Misr mein Eid-ul-Fitr ke din, baais (42) hijri mein hua, jabke woh wahan ke gawarnar the."

e: [AI] "I went intentionally to meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to convert (to Islam). I encountered Khalid ibn Al-Walid before the conquest (of Mecca), while he was approaching from Mecca. I asked, 'Where are you heading, O Abu Sulayman?' He replied, 'By Allah, the landmark (Meesam) has been established, and indeed, the man is a Prophet. I will go and, by Allah, I will convert.' I asked him, 'Until when?' He said, 'And I, by Allah, have come only to convert.' So we proceeded to meet the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Khalid ibn Al-Walid took the lead and accepted Islam and pledged his allegiance. Then I approached and pledged allegiance to him, and then I left."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf Islam qubool karne ke iraade se nikla, to raaste mein Khalid bin Al-Waleed se mulaqaat hui, yeh Fatah se pehle ki baat hai, aur woh Makkah se aa rahe the, to maine poocha: "Aye Abu Sulaiman, kahan ka iraada hai?" Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, baat wazeh ho chuki hai, aur yeh aadmi zaroor Nabi hain, Allah ki qasam, main jaa raha houn Islam qubool karne, aur ab kab tak (rukoon)?" Maine kaha: "Aur main bhi, Allah ki qasam, sirf Islam qubool karne ke liye aaya houn." To hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahunche, Khalid bin Al-Waleed aage badhe, Islam qubool kiya aur baiyat ki, phir main qareeb aaya aur unse baiyat ki, phir main wapas chala gaya.

e: [AI] "Amr ibn Al-Aas was short, stout."
hi: "Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) chhote qad ke, mote/thike-thake the."

e: [AI] "What is this, O Abu Abdullah?" So the Commander of the Believers said, "I would like you to see from me what remains." Umar did not forbid him from doing that and did not blame him for it. Umar ibn Al-Khattab died at the age of around one hundred years. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing it.
hi: "Yeh kya hai, Aye Abu Abdullah?" To unhone (Amr bin Al-Aas ne) kaha: "Ameer-ul-Momineen, mujhe pasand hai ke aap mujhme kuch (jawaani ki) baaqi cheez dekhein." To Umar ne unhein isse mana nahi kiya aur na hi unpar isko lekar aitraaz kiya. Aur Amr bin Al-Aas ka intiqaal hua jabke unki umr taqreeban sau (100) saal ke qareeb thi. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] His son Abdullah said to him: "Describe death to us, and may your mind be with you." He replied, "O my son, death is more inevitable than being described. However, I will describe to you a part of it. I feel as if mountains of radiance are on my neck, and I feel as if the thorns of weapons are in my chest, and I feel as if my soul is coming out of the eye of a needle." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Unke bete Abdullah ne unse kaha: "Humein maut ka haal bataayen jabke aapki aqal (hosh) aapke sath hai." To unhone kaha: "Aye mere bete, maut itni azeem hai ke usse bayan nahi kiya ja sakta, lekin main tumhein iska kuch hissa bataata houn: mujhe mehsoos ho raha hai jaise Radwa (pahaad) ke pahaad mere gardan par hon, aur mujhe mehsoos ho raha hai jaise mere andar hathiyaaron ke kaante hon, aur mujhe mehsoos ho raha hai jaise meri jaan aik sui ke chhed se nikal rahi ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent Amr ibn Al-Aas to Bahrain. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out on a military expedition and we went with him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took a nap and then woke up and said, 'May Allah have mercy on 'Amr.' We mentioned every person named 'Amr' and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  fell asleep again. He woke up and said, 'May Allah have mercy on 'Amr.' Then he fell asleep for the third time and woke up saying, 'May Allah have mercy on 'Amr.' So we asked, 'Who is 'Amr, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'Amr ibn Al-Aas.' We asked, 'What is his state?' He said, 'I remember that whenever I would encourage the people to give charity, he would bring a lot of charity and I would ask him, 'From where did you get this?' and he would say, 'From Allah.' And 'Amr was indeed a pious person.' Zuhayr said, 'When the tribulation arose, I said, 'I will follow the one whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has spoken highly of and I will never abandon him.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Amr bin Al-Aas ko Bahrain bheja, phir Rasulullah (SAW) aik chhoti fauj mein nikle, aur hum unke sath nikle, to Rasulullah (SAW) ko oonghi aayi, phir jaage aur farmaya: "Allah Amr par reham kare." Unhone kaha: to humne aapas mein har us aadmi ka zikr kiya jiska naam Amr tha, phir aap (SAW) ko doosri baar oongh aayi, jaage aur farmaya: "Allah Amr par reham kare." Phir teesri baar oongh aayi, jaage aur farmaya: "Allah Amr par reham kare." To humne poocha: 'Kaun hain Amr, Ya Rasulullah (SAW)?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Amr bin Al-Aas." Unhone poocha: 'Unhein kya hua hai?' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe unki yaad aayi, main jab logon ko sadqe ki taraf bulaata, to woh sadqa lekar aate aur bohot zyada dete, to main unse poochta: yeh tumhein kahan se mila? To woh kehte: Allah ki taraf se, aur Amr ne sach kaha, beshak Amr mein bohot bhalaai hai." Zuhair ne kaha: jab Fitna hui, to maine kaha: "Main uski pairavi karunga jiske baare mein Rasulullah (SAW) ne yeh farmaya jo farmaya, isliye main unse juda nahi hua."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Khalid bin Al-Walid treated me equally as one of his companions in his wars since I embraced Islam."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni jung mein mujhe aur Khalid bin Al-Waleed ko, jab se humne Islam qubool kiya, apne kisi bhi sahabi par tarjeeh nahi di." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The translation in English is: "The son of Banu Muttalib, the son of Abd Manaf, Qais ibn Makhrama ibn Muttalib ibn Abd Manaf, and his mother is Asma bint Amr, a woman from the Ansar."
hi: "Banu Al-Muttalib bin Abd Manaf mein se, Qais bin Makhramah bin Al-Muttalib bin Abd Manaf (RA), aur unki maa Asma bint Aamir, Ansar ki aik aurat, thin."

e: [AI] "I and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were born in the Year of the Elephant, so we are the same age."
hi: "Main aur Rasulullah (SAW) donon 'Aam-ul-Feel' (Haathi wale saal) mein paida huay, isliye hum hum-umr hain."

e: [AI] "Abdullah son of Hisham son of Zuhrah son of Uthman son of Amr son of Ka'b son of Saad son of Taym son of Murrah and his mother is a woman from the tribe of Bani Asad bin Khuzaymah son of Saad son of Laith son of Bakr son of Abd Manat. His mother brought him to the Prophet ﷺ  when he was young, and the Prophet ﷺ  wiped his head but did not pledge allegiance to him."
hi: Abdullah bin Hishaam bin Zuhrah bin Uthman bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Taim bin Murrah (RA), aur unki maa Banu Asad bin Khuzaimah bin Sa'd bin Laith bin Bakr bin Abd Manaat se aik aurat thin, "unki maa unhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gayin jabke woh chhote the, to aap (SAW) ne unka sar sehlaaya magar unse baiyat nahi li (kyunke woh bohot chhote the)."

e: [AI] Translation: Abdullah ibn Hisham narrated that the Prophet ﷺ discovered that his mother brought him to him, so he wiped his head and prayed for him. As a result, he would sacrifice one sheep for the sake of his entire family.
