hi: Abdullah bin Hishaam se, jinhone Nabi (SAW) ko paaya (dekha): "Unki maa unhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas laayin, to aap (SAW) ne unka sar sehlaaya aur unke liye dua ki," to woh apne poore ghar walon ki taraf se sirf aik hi bakri ki qurbani diya karte the.

e: We were with the Prophet ﷺ while he was holding ʿUmar bin Al-Khattab by the hand. (Using translation from Bukhārī 3694)
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath the, jabke aap (SAW) Umar bin Al-Khattab ka haath pakde huay the, to Umar ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap mujhe har cheez se zyada aziz hain siwaye meri apni jaan ke." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi, (aisa nahi ho sakta) jab tak main tumhein tumhari apni jaan se bhi zyada aziz na ho jaaun." To Umar ne kaha: "Ab, Allah ki qasam, aap mujhe meri apni jaan se bhi zyada aziz hain." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ab (theek hai), Aye Umar." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se iski kamzori ki wajah se hataaya.

e: [AI] "Al-Munkadir ibn Abdullah ibn Al-Hudair ibn Muhriz ibn Abdullah ibn Al-Uzza ibn Aamir ibn Al-Harith ibn Haritha ibn Saad ibn Taym ibn Murrah met the Prophet ﷺ  and heard from him."
hi: "Al-Munkadir bin Abdullah bin Al-Hudair bin Muhriz bin Abdul Uzza bin Aamir bin Al-Harith bin Haarithah bin Sa'd bin Taim bin Murrah (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ko paaya (dekha) aur unse suna."

e: [AI] "The first thing that comes to me, I will send to you." So, ten thousand dirhams came to her, and she sent them to him. He took some of it and a servant girl gave birth to his sons Muhammad, Abu Bakr, and Umar, and all of them were known for their righteousness, and the talk about them was spread."
hi: "Sabse pehli cheez jo mere paas aayegi, main woh tumhare paas bhej dunga." To unke paas das hazaar (10,000) dirham aaye, to unhone woh unke paas bhej diye, to unhone usme se aik laundi khareedi, jisne unke liye unke bete Muhammad, Abu Bakr, aur Umar ko janam diya, aur yeh sab neik-o-saalih ke taur par mash-hoor huay, aur inse hadith riwayat ki gayi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever performs the tawaf around the Kaaba for a week without engaging in worldly activities, it is as if he has freed a slave." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo koi Baitullah ka saat (7) chakkar (tawaf) lagaaye aur usme koi lagho (bekaar) baat na kare, to yeh aik ghulam aazaad karne ke barabar hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ  that he once delayed the Isha prayer until a short while past midnight, and the people were waiting in the mosque. He asked, "What are you waiting for?" They replied, "We are waiting for the prayer." He said, "You will remain in prayer as long as you wait for it." Then he added, "Verily, this is a prayer that none of the previous nations have performed."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, beshak aap (SAW) aik raat (ghar se) nikle jabke aap (SAW) ne Isha ki namaz ko der karwaayi thi, yahan tak ke raat ka kuch hissa ya aik ghanta guzar gaya, aur log masjid mein intezaar kar rahe the, to aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tum kis cheez ka intezaar kar rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: 'Hum namaz ka intezaar kar rahe hain.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum hamesha namaz mein hi rahoge jab tak tum uska intezaar karte raho." Phir farmaya: "Suno, beshak yeh aisi namaz hai jo tumse pehle kisi bhi Ummat ne kabhi nahi padhi."

e: [AI] "Indeed, among the Sahaba (companions) of the As-hab al-'Aqaba who gave bay'ah (pledge of allegiance) to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ from the tribe of Bani Ghanm bin Malik bin al-Najjar is Abu Ayyub. He is Khalid bin Zaid bin Kulayb bin Tha'laba."
hi: "Aqabah ke saathiyon mein se jinhone Nabi (SAW) se baiyat ki, unme se Banu Ghanm bin Malik bin An-Najjaar se, Abu Ayyub, jinka naam Khalid bin Zaid bin Kulaib bin Tha'labah tha."

e: [AI] We invaded Constantinople, and with us was Abu Ayub al-Ansari. We formed two rows, and I have never seen two rows longer than them. Abu Ayub al-Ansari died during this expedition and he left a will to be buried at the foot of the walls of Constantinople and for his debt to be paid, and that was carried out.
hi: Humne Constantinople par hamla kiya, aur humare sath Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari the, to humne do safein banaayin, maine kabhi in donon se lambi safein nahi dekhin, aur Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari is ghazwe mein wafaat paa gaye, aur "unhone wasiyat ki thi ke unhein Constantinople ki deewaron ki jad mein dafan kiya jaaye, aur unpar jo qarz tha woh ada kiya jaaye, to aisa hi kiya gaya."

e: [AI] "My brother, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , stood between Abu Ayyub and Mus'ab bin Umair. Abu Ayyub witnessed the battles of Badr, Uhud, Al-Khandaq, and all the other expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He passed away during the reign of his father Muawiyah, in the year 52 AH. His grave is located in the original fortress of Constantinople, in the land of Rome. It is mentioned that people take care of his grave, visit it, and seek rain from it when they suffer from drought."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Ayyub aur Mus'ab bin Umair ke darmiyan bhai-chaara qaayam kiya, aur Abu Ayyub ne Badr, Uhud, Khandaq, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath tamaam maidaanon mein shirkat ki, aur unka intiqaal usi saal hua jab Yazid bin Mu'awiyah ne apne waalid Mu'awiyah ki khilafat mein Constantinople par hamla kiya, battees (52) hijri mein, aur unki qabr Constantinople ke qile ki jad mein, Rome ki zameen mein hai, jaisa zikr kiya gaya hai, log unki qabr ki dekhbhaal karte hain, uski ziyarat karte hain, aur jab khushksaali (qaht) hoti hai to uske zariye baarish maangte hain."

e: [AI] Abu Ayub witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he did not miss any of the Muslim military expeditions except for one year. He was appointed as a young man in the army that year, so he stayed back. After that, he became eager and would say, "I do not want to be left behind when I am called upon." Then he fell ill while Yazid ibn Muawiya was leading the army. He went to visit him and asked, "What do you need?" Abu Ayub replied, "If I die, put me on a mount and continue to advance into the enemy's land until you find a suitable place. If you do not find a suitable place, bury me and then return." Abu Ayub used to say that Allah Almighty stated in the Quran, "March forth, whether light or heavy." (Surah At-Tawbah, 9:41) Al-Dhahabi did not mention this narration in his summarized version.
hi: Abu Ayyub ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Badr mein shirkat ki, phir woh Musalmano ke kisi bhi ghazwe se peeche nahi rahe siwaye aik saal ke, kyunke us saal lashkar par aik jawaan aadmi ko ameer banaya gaya tha, to woh us saal ghar baithe rahe, phir iske baad woh afsos karte rahe aur kehte the: "Mujhe kya farq padta hai ke kaun ameer banaya gaya," phir woh bimaar hue, aur us waqt lashkar par Yazid bin Mu'awiyah the, to woh unki ayaadat ko aaye, aur poocha: "Aapko kya zaroorat hai?" To unhone kaha: "Meri zaroorat yeh hai ke jab main mar jaaun, to mujhe (apni sawaari par) sawaar karo, phir dushman ki zameen mein jitna aage badh sako badho, jab tum aur aage na badh sako, to mujhe wahin dafan kar do, phir wapas laut aao." Unhone kaha: aur Abu Ayyub kaha karte the: Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne farmaya: "{Halke ho ya bhaari, nikal khade ho jaao}" (Surah At-Tawbah 41), "to main apne aap ko sirf halka ya bhaari hi paata houn (yaani hamesha nikalne ke liye tayyar rehta houn)." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He witnessed with him the day of Harura."
hi: "Unhone unke sath Harura ke din shirkat ki."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, used to visit Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari in a room. His food was in a basket in the alcove. It used to come from the upper part of the house until it took the food from the basket. Abu Ayyub complained about this to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "That is a jinn. When it comes, tell it that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, has commanded you not to come back." So when it came, Abu Ayyub said to it, "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, has commanded you not to come back." It said, "O Abu Ayyub, let me go this time, and I swear by Allah, I will not return." Abu Ayyub left it. Then he came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and informed him about it. The jinn said the same thing twice, and then it asked him, "Would you like me to teach you some words that if you say them, Satan will not come near your house tonight, tomorrow, and the next day?" He said, "Yes." She said, "Recite Ayat al-Kursi: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence." [Quran 2:255]. He came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and informed him. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "She has told the truth, even though she is a liar."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari ke ghar mein aik kamre mein thehre huay the, aur aap (SAW) ka khaana aik tokri mein, kothri mein, rakha hota tha, to aik ghoul (sehraayi chhal-kapat wala jaanwar) roshan-daan se aakar tokri se khaana le jaata, to Abu Ayyub ne iski shikayat Rasulullah (SAW) se ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh ghoul hai, jab woh aaye to usse kehna: Rasulullah (SAW) tumhein pakka hukum dete hain ke tum wapas na aao." Unhone kaha: to woh aayi, to Abu Ayyub ne usse kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) tumhein pakka hukum dete hain ke tum wapas na aao." To usne kaha: "Aye Abu Ayyub, mujhe is baar chhod do, Allah ki qasam, main dobaara nahi aaungi." To unhone usse chhod diya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhein bataaya, usne (ghoul ne) yeh baat do baar kahi, phir usne kaha: "Kya main tumhein kuch alfaaz sikhaaun jo agar tum kaho to us raat, us din, aur agle din tumhare ghar ke paas koi shaitaan na aaye?" Unhone kaha: 'Ji haan.' Usne kaha: "Aayat-ul-Kursi padho: {Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh hamesha zinda, hamesha qaayam rehne wala hai}" (Surah Al-Baqarah 255). Unhone kaha: phir woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhein bataaya, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usne sach kaha, jabke woh jhooti hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari had a palm tree plantation in his garden at his home, where he used to cultivate dates. He mentioned this Hadith, in a similar manner to how Al-Dhahabi omitted it in his summary.
hi: Beshak Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari ke ghar ke baagh mein khajoor rakhne ki aik jagah (mirbad) thi, aur hadith isi tarah zikr ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He had a lapse, so the ghoul would come and take from him. He mentioned the hadith in a way similar to it, 'These chains, when combined, become a famous hadith, and Allah knows best.' This is one of the most accurate methods of narration."
hi: Beshak unke paas aik chhota taaq (sahwah) tha, to ghoul aakar usme se le jaati thi, aur hadith isi tarah zikr ki. "Yeh dono isnaad jab aapas mein milaayi jaayein, to aik mash-hoor hadith ban jaati hain, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai." Yeh hadith ki sabse behtareen sanad hai.

e: [AI] "Abu Ayyub came to Muawiyah and mentioned a need to him. Muawiyah said, 'Are you not a companion of Uthman?' Abu Ayyub said, 'Indeed, the Messenger of Allah [peace be upon him] informed us that we will face tribulations after him.' Muawiyah asked, 'What did he command you?' Abu Ayyub replied, 'He commanded us to have patience until we meet him at the Pond.' Muawiyah said, 'So be patient.' Abu Ayyub became angry and swore not to speak to him ever again. Then Abu Ayyub came to Abdullah bin Abbas and mentioned the incident to him, and he came out of his house for him just as Abu Ayyub came out for the Messenger of Allah [peace be upon him] from his house. Abdullah bin Abbas asked, 'What do you want?' Abu Ayyub said, 'I have four young men who are in need.' Abdullah bin Abbas said, 'I have twenty boys with me.'"
hi: Beshak Abu Ayyub Mu'awiyah ke paas aaye aur unse apni zaroorat ka zikr kiya, unhone poocha: 'Kya aap Uthman ke saathi nahi?' Unhone kaha: "Suno, Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein bataaya tha ke unke baad humein tarjeeh (na-insaafi) ka saamna karna padega." Unhone poocha: 'Aur unhone aapko kya hukum diya tha?' Unhone kaha: "Humein hukum diya tha ke hum sabr karein yahan tak ke hum unse Hauz (Kausar) par milein." Unhone kaha: 'To sabr karo.' Unhone kaha: to Abu Ayyub ko ghussa aaya aur unhone qasam khaayi ke woh kabhi unse baat nahi karenge, phir Abu Ayyub Abdullah bin Abbas ke paas gaye aur unhein yeh baat bataayi, to unhone unke liye apna ghar khaali kar diya jaise Abu Ayyub ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye apna ghar khaali kiya tha, aur poocha: 'Aapko kya chaahiye?' Unhone kaha: 'Chaar ghulam jo mere ghar mein kaam karein.' Unhone kaha: 'Mere paas aapke liye bees (20) ghulam hain.'

e: [AI] "And he said, 'I will treat you as I treated the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.' And he said, 'How much do you owe?' He said, 'Twenty thousand.' He gave him forty thousand and twenty slaves and said, 'You have everything in the house.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Aur unhone kaha: "Main aapke sath waisa hi karunga jaisa maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath kiya tha." Aur poocha: "Aappar kitna qarz hai?" Unhone kaha: 'Bees hazaar (20,000).' To unhone unhein chaalis hazaar (40,000) aur bees (20) ghulam diye, aur kaha: "Ghar mein jo kuch hai, woh sab aapka hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Ayyub was in a gathering, saying, "Can't any of you recite one-third of the Quran?" Then the Prophet ﷺ  came to them and heard Abu Ayyub. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Abu Ayyub has spoken the truth."
hi: Abu Ayyub aik majlis mein baithe huay keh rahe the: "Kya tum mein se koi Quran ka aik tihaai nahi padh sakta?" Unhone kaha: to Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye aur Abu Ayyub ki baat suni, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Ayyub ne sach kaha."

e: [AI] I heard Jabir ibn Samurah say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  once visited Abu Ayyub. Whenever Abu Ayyub would eat food, he would send some of it to the Prophet ﷺ , who would eat from the place where his hand had touched. One day, Abu Ayyub made a dish that had garlic in it, and he sent it to the Prophet ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ  returned it and came to him, and Abu Ayyub said, "O Messenger of Allah, I did not see any traces of your fingers on it." The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "There was garlic in it." Shu'bah asked in his narration, "Is it forbidden?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No." Hammaad mentioned in his narration, "O Messenger of Allah, you sent me something that you did not eat." The Prophet ﷺ  replied, "You are not like me, as the angels come to me."
hi: Maine Jabir bin Samurah (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) Abu Ayyub ke ghar mein thehre the, aur jab woh (Abu Ayyub) khaana khaate, to jo bach jaata woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf bhej dete, to woh (Rasulullah SAW) us jagah ko dekhte jahan Rasulullah (SAW) ka apna haath laga hota, aur usi jagah se khaate the. Aik din unhone aisa khaana banaya jisme lehsan tha, to unhone woh unke paas bheja, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne woh wapas kar diya. To Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), maine aapki ungliyon ka nishaan nahi dekha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usme lehsan tha." Shu'bah ne apni riwayat mein kaha: (Abu Ayyub ne) poocha: 'Kya yeh haraam hai?' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." Aur Hammad ne apni riwayat mein kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aapne mere paas woh bheja jo aapne khud nahi khaya.' To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mere jaise nahi ho, mere paas farishta aata hai."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  visited me, I said, "I prefer to be below you and you above me, by my father and mother." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "I am more considerate to myself to be in a lower position because of what people may assume." Then, I saw a jug that broke and spilled its water. So, my mother and I rushed to dry the water with a cloth we had. We had no other blanket except for that one. We wanted to prevent anything harmful from reaching the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas thehre, to maine kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, mujhe napasand hai ke main aapse oopar rahoon aur aap mujhse neeche rahein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere liye aur humare paas aane walon ke liye yehi behtar hai ke main neechle hisse mein rahoon." Unhone kaha: to maine dekha ke humara aik ghada toot gaya aur uska paani bikhar gaya, to main aur Umm Ayyub, apni aik razaai jo humare paas iske siwa aur koi kambal na thi, lekar (paani sukhane) khade ho gaye, kyunke humein darr tha ke kahin Rasulullah (SAW) tak koi cheez pahunch kar unhein takleef na de.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stayed with me for a month, and I observed his every action. I saw him, when the sun set or moved away, reject worldly possessions if they were in his hands, and if he was sleeping, he would be awakened and stand up to perform ablution and pray. Then he would perform four units of prayer, perfecting and beautifying them. When he intended to depart, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, you stayed with me for a month, and I wished that you stayed longer. So, I observed your every action, and I saw you, when the sun set or moved away, reject worldly possessions if they were in your hands and focus on prayer." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the gates of heaven are opened at that hour. So, do not miss the opportunity to have the gates of heaven and the gates of Paradise opened for you until you perform this prayer." He then said, "I loved to ascend to my Lord in those hours, as it is better and my actions would be raised at the beginning of the actions of the worshippers." [This hadith has been narrated by Al-Dhahabi, who excluded it from the summarization as it is considered weak.]
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas aik mahina thehre, main aap (SAW) ke poore amal ko dhyaan se dekhta raha, to maine dekha ke "jab suraj dhalta ya (dopahar se) hat'na shuru karta, to agar aap (SAW) ke haath mein duniyaawi kaam hota to usse chhod dete, aur agar aap (SAW) so rahe hote to goya unhein jagaaya jaata, to woh utthte, ghusl ya wudu karte, phir namaz padhte, phir chaar (4) rakat padhte, unhein poora karte, achhi tarah padhte, aur unme dher rehte." Jab aap (SAW) ne jaane ka iraada kiya, to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aap mere paas aik mahina rahe, aur main chaahta tha ke aap isse zyada thehrein, maine aapke poore amal ko dhyaan se dekha, to maine aapko dekha, jab suraj dhalta ya hat'na shuru karta, to agar aapke haath mein duniyaawi kaam hota to usse chhod dete aur namaz mein lag jaate." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak aasman ke darwaaze us ghadi mein khulte hain, isliye chaaho ke aasman aur Jannat ke darwaaze band na ho jaayein jab tak yeh namaz na padh li jaaye, isliye mujhe pasand hai ke un ghadiyon mein mera amal apne Rab ki taraf jaaye jabke woh behtar ho, aur mera amal ibaadat-guzaaron ke amal mein sabse pehle uthaaya jaaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se iski kamzori ki wajah se hataaya.

e: [AI] That Abu Ayyub Khalid bin Zaid, who was a messenger of Allah ﷺ , stayed in his house when he went to invade the land of the Romans. He passed by Muawiyah, and Muawiyah ignored him. Then he returned from his campaign, and Muawiyah ignored him again and did not offer his greetings. Abu Ayyub said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  informed us that we would witness hardships after him." Muawiyah asked, "What did he command you to do?" Abu Ayyub said, "He commanded us to be patient." Muawiyah replied, "Then be patient." Abdullah bin Abbas came to Basrah, and Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) gave him orders to do so. Abbas said, "O Abu Ayyub, I want to let you leave my house just as you left the house of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He ordered his family to leave, and they left, giving him everything they had in the house. When it was time for him to depart, Ali asked him, "What is your need?" Abu Ayyub replied, "My need is my provision and eight servants to work on my land." His provision was originally four thousand, and Ali doubled it five times for him and gave him twenty thousand and forty servants. "This hadith has been transmitted with a continuous and authentic chain, and I have prepared it for the additional narrations in it with this chain.
hi: Beshak Abu Ayyub, Khalid bin Zaid, jinke ghar mein Rasulullah (SAW) thehre the, Rome ki zameen ki taraf jihad ke liye gaye, raaste mein Mu'awiyah se mulaqaat hui, to Mu'awiyah ne unse be-rukhi dikhaayi, phir jab woh apni jung se wapas aaye, to Mu'awiyah ne phir unse be-rukhi dikhaayi aur unki koi qadar na ki. Abu Ayyub ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein bataaya tha ke unke baad humein tarjeeh (na-insaafi) ka saamna karna padega." Mu'awiyah ne poocha: 'To unhone tumhein kya hukum diya tha?' Unhone kaha: "Humein hukum diya tha ke hum sabr karein." Unhone kaha: 'To sabr karo.' To Abdullah bin Abbas Basra mein aaye, jinhein Ali, Allah unse raazi ho, ne wahan ka gawarnar banaya tha, unhone kaha: "Aye Abu Ayyub, main chaahta houn ke main aapke liye apna ghar khaali kar doon jaise aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye apna ghar khaali kiya tha." To unhone apne ghar walon ko hukum diya, woh nikal gaye, aur unhone Abu Ayyub ko ghar mein jo kuch tha sab de diya. Jab unke jaane ka waqt aaya, to Ibn Abbas ne poocha: 'Aapki kya zaroorat hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Meri zaroorat mera ata (wazifa) hai aur aath (8) ghulam jo meri zameen par kaam karein.' Aur unka ata chaar hazaar (4000) tha, to Ibn Abbas ne usse paanch guna badha diya aur unhein bees hazaar (20,000) aur chaalis (40) ghulam diye. "Yeh hadith pehle bhi mutasil, sahih isnad ke sath guzri hai, aur maine ise isi isnad ke sath izaafi tafseelaat ke liye dobaara zikr kiya hai."

e: [AI] "I have never prayed behind your Prophet ﷺ  except that I have heard him saying when he finishes his prayer, 'O Allah, forgive all my mistakes and sins. Bless me, give me life, provide for me, guide me to good deeds and good character, for no one can guide to them except You, and no one can turn away from them except You.'" - Al-Dhahabi removed it from the summary.
hi: Main tumhare Nabi (SAW) ke peeche kabhi namaz nahi padhta magar jab woh namaz se palte to unhein yeh kehte suna: "Aye Allah, meri saari khataayen aur gunaah maaf kar de, mujhe ne'mat de, mujhe zindagi de, mujhe rizq de, aur mujhe neik amal aur achhe akhlaaq ki taraf hidayat de, kyunke unke behtareen (roop) ki taraf sirf Tu hi hidayat deta hai, aur unke bure (roop) se sirf Tu hi door karta hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se hataaya.

e: [AI] "He took something from the beard of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, 'May there be no harm to you, O Abu Ayyub.'"
hi: Beshak unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ki daadhi se kuch (baal) liye, to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhein koi bura na ho, Aye Abu Ayyub."

e: [AI] "Regarding that," he mentioned the lengthy narration. This is the virtue of Abu Ayyub, that Ibn Abbas and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama came to him to ask him, and I think that the two scholars have mentioned it, or one of them, in the book of purification, Sahih.
hi: ...iske baare mein, aur hadith poori tafseel se zikr ki, yeh Abu Ayyub ki fazeelat hai ke Ibn Abbas aur Al-Miswar bin Makhramah is sawaal mein unki taraf ruju karte the. Aur mera khayaal hai ke Shaykhain ne ise ya unme se aik ne Kitaab At-Tahaarah (Paakizgi) mein nikaala hai. Sahih.

e: [AI] "And you are the people, if you did not say, 'What Allah wills and what Muhammad wills,' he said: Then he met some of the Jews and said, 'You are the people, if you did not claim that Uzair is the son of Allah.' He said: And you are the people, if you did not say, 'What Allah wills and what Muhammad wills.' So he came to the Prophet ﷺ  and told him. The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Did you narrate this hadith to anyone?' He said, 'Yes.' The Prophet ﷺ  then praised and thanked Allah, and said, 'Indeed, your brother has seen what you have reported, so do not say, 'What Allah wills and what Muhammad wills,' but say 'What Allah wills alone, without any partner.' " Hamad bin Salamah reported from Abdullah bin Umair, who disagreed with him."
hi: ...aur tum log woh qaum ho, agar tum yeh na kehte 'jo Allah chaahe aur jo Muhammad chaahe.' Unhone kaha: phir unki Yahoodiyon ke kuch logon se mulaqaat hui, to unhone kaha: "Tum woh qaum ho, agar tum yeh dawa na karte ke Uzair Allah ka beta hai." To usne kaha: "Aur tum woh qaum ho, agar tum yeh na kehte 'jo Allah chaahe aur jo Muhammad chaahe.'" To woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhein bataaya, to Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tumne yeh baat kisi ko bataayi hai?" Usne kaha: 'Ji haan,' to aap (SAW) ne Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki, phir farmaya: "Beshak tumhare bhai ne woh dekha jo tumhein pahuncha, isliye 'jo Allah chaahe aur jo Muhammad chaahe' mat kaho, balke kaho 'jo akela Allah chaahe, uska koi shareek nahi.'" Hammad bin Salamah ne isme Abdul Malik bin Umair se ikhtilaaf kiya hai.

e: [AI] I saw in what the sleeper sees, so I mentioned the saying with its equivalent, "This is more deserving of preservation than the former."
hi: "Maine khwaab mein dekha," aur unhone hadith isi tarah bilkul waisi zikr ki, "yeh pehli hadith se zyada mehfooz (bharosemand) hai."

e: [AI] "Nūbayshah, son of ʿAbdullah, son of Shaybān, son of ʿAttab, son of al-Hārith, son of Ḥusayn, son of al-Hārith, son of ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā. He is Nūbayshah al-Khayr, known as Abū Ṭarīf, and he settled in Baṣrah."
hi: "Nubaishah bin Abdullah bin Shaibaan bin Attaab bin Al-Harith bin Husain bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Uzza (RA), aur woh Nubaishah Al-Khair (bhalaai wale) hain, jinki kunniyat Abu Tareef thi, Basra mein aa basay."

e: [AI] Nu'baysah came to us and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named him Nu'baysah al-Khayr. He entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he had prisoners with him. Nu'baysah said, "O Messenger of Allah, either show them favor or let me deal with them." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said, "After that, you are Nu'baysah al-Khayr."
hi: Humare paas Nubaishah aaye, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Nubaishah Al-Khair rakha tha, woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas dakhil huay jabke unke paas qaidi the, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), ya to inpar ehsaan karein (bina badle chhod dein) ya inka fidya lein." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne bhalaai ka mashwara diya, ab se tum 'Nubaishah Al-Khair' ho."

e: [AI] "And Abu Ayyub Khalid ibn Zaid ibn Kulayb ibn Tha'laba ibn 'Abd 'Awf from the Banu Tamim ibn Malik ibn al-Najjar, witnessed Al-'Aqabah, Badr, and all the battles and conquests of Iraq, and witnessed alongside Ali the Battle of Siffin. Then he went to Sham (Syria) and entered the land of the Romans (Byzantines) as a conqueror, and he settled in Constantinople (Istanbul)."
hi: "Aur Abu Ayyub Khalid bin Zaid bin Kulaib bin Tha'labah bin Abd Auf (RA), Banu Tameem bin Malik bin An-Najjaar se, unhone Aqabah, Badr, aur tamaam maidaanon mein aur Iraq ki fatah mein shirkat ki, aur unhone Ali ke sath Siffin mein shirkat ki, phir woh Sham gaye aur Rome ki zameen mein jihad ke liye dakhil huay aur Constantinople mein pahunche."

e: [AI] Abu Ayyub al-Azdi passed by Muawiyah and mentioned the lengthy hadith that was previously narrated to Abu Ayyub al-Ansari.
hi: Beshak Abu Ayyub Al-Azdi Mu'awiyah ke paas se guzre, aur unhone woh poori hadith zikr ki jo pehle Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari ke baare mein guzri hai.

e:
[AI] "Wajīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Mālik ibn Naṣr ibn Thaʿlabah ibn Jusham ibn ʿAwf ibn Shulayl ibn Khuzaymah ibn Sakin ibn ʿAlī ibn Mālik ibn Zayd ibn Qays ibn ʿAbqar ibn Anmār kāna qad aqāma fil-fitnati bi-Qirqisā' thumma intaqala minha ilā al-Kūfah wa bihā tuwuffiya sanat ihdā wa khamsīn."

English translation: "Wajir, the son of Abdullah, who is the son of Malik, who is the son of Nasr, who is the son of Tha'labah, who is the son of Jusham, who is the son of Awf, who is the son of Shulayl, who is the son of Khuzaymah, who is the son of Sakin, who is the son of Ali, who is the son of Malik, who is the son of Zaid, who is the son of Qays, who is the son of Abqar, who is the son of Anmar, had resided in Qirqisaa during the turmoil, then he moved from there to Kufa, where he passed away in the year fifty-one."
hi: "Aur Jareer bin Abdullah bin Malik bin Nasr bin Tha'labah bin Jusham bin Auf bin Shulail bin Khuzaimah bin Sakan bin Ali bin Malik bin Zaid bin Qais bin Abqar bin Anmaar (RA), woh Fitna ke daur mein Qirqisiya mein thehre, phir wahan se Kufa chale gaye, aur wahin unka intiqaal ikyaawan (51) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari, Abdullah ibn Qais, ally of the Al-Utbah ibn Rabiah ibn Abd Shams."
hi: "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA), Abdullah bin Qais, Aal-e-Utbah bin Rabee'ah bin Abd Shams ke ahd-waale saathi."

e: [AI] "Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, his name is Abdullah bin Qays bin Sulaim bin Haddar bin Huraith bin Amir bin Bakr bin Amir bin Udhrah bin Wa'il bin Najiyah bin al-Muhajir bin al-Ash'ari. He is a descendant of Udad bin Yashjub bin Ya'rub bin Qahtan. His mother is Tayyiba bintu Wahb bin Atik, and she embraced Islam and died in Madinah. Abu Musa arrived in Makkah and took an oath of allegiance with Abu Uhayha Sa'id bin al-'As, embraced Islam in Makkah, and then migrated to the land of Habasha. After that, he came with the people of the two ships and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to Khaybar."
hi: "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) ka naam Abdullah bin Qais bin Sulaim bin Haddaar bin Huraith bin Aamir bin Bakr bin Aamir bin Udhr bin Waa'il bin Naajiyah bin Al-Muhaajir bin Al-Ash'ar tha, aur woh Nabt bin Udad bin Yashjub bin Ya'rub bin Qahtaan (ki nasl) se the, aur Abu Musa ki maa Taybah bint Wahb bin Ateek thin, jinhone Islam qubool kiya aur Madinah mein wafaat paayi, aur Abu Musa Makkah aaye, to unhone Abu Uhaihah Sa'eed bin Al-Aas se ahd (hilf) kiya, Makkah mein Islam qubool kiya, Habsha (Abyssinia) ki zameen ki taraf hijrat ki, phir do kishtiyon walon ke sath aaye jabke Rasulullah (SAW) Khaibar mein the."

e: [AI] "Abu Musa al-Ash'ari was one of those who migrated to the land of Abyssinia and settled there until the Prophet ﷺ sent them to the Negus, Amr ibn Umaya al-Damri. He carried them in two ships and brought them to him at Khaybar after Hudaybiyyah."
hi: "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (RA) un logon mein se the jinhone Habsha ki zameen ki taraf hijrat ki aur wahan thehre rahe, yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) ne Najashi ki taraf Amr bin Umayyah Adh-Dhamri ko bheja, to unhone unhein do kishtiyon mein sawaar kiya, aur unhein lekar Khaibar mein aap (SAW) ke paas pahunche, Hudaibiyah ke baad."

e: [AI] "A man who is slender and short."
hi: "Aik aadmi, halke jism wale, kaafi chhote."

e: [AI] Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari died in the year fifty-two when he was sixty-three years old.
hi: "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari ka intiqaal battees (52) hijri mein hua, jabke woh terh-saath (63) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Ma'een saying, "The name of my father, Musa al-Ash'ari, is Abdullah bin Qais."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari ka naam Abdullah bin Qais hai."

e: [AI] "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari came to the Prophet ﷺ  and the Prophet ﷺ  called for the eldest and youngest members of the ship's crew." Abu Amer Al-Ash'ari said, "I am the eldest member of the ship's crew and my son is the youngest." Saeed said, "Among them were Abu Amer, Abu Malik, Abu Musa, and Ka'b bin Asim. I believe they embarked on the expedition."
hi: "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, to Nabi (SAW) ne kishti walon mein sabse buzurg aur sabse chhote ke liye dua ki." Abu Aamir Al-Ash'ari ne kaha: "Main kishti walon mein sabse buzurg houn, aur mera beta unme sabse chhota hai." Sa'eed ne kaha: "Aur unme Abu Aamir, Abu Malik, Abu Musa, aur Ka'b bin Aasim shaamil the, mera khayaal hai ke woh Al-Abwaa' (jagah) mein nikle the."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Sha'bi saying, "The judges among the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  were six individuals; three in Al-Madinah and three in Al-Kufa. In Al-Madinah, they were Umar, Ubay ibn Ka'b, and Zaid ibn Thabit. In Al-Kufa, they were Ali, Abdullah, and Abu Musa." Al-Shaybani said, "So I asked Al-Sha'bi, 'Is Abu Musa included with them?' He said, 'He was one of the scholars.' Then Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Abbas ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Asim al-Shahidi narrated it to me."
hi: Maine Ash-Sha'bi ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se chhah (6) logon mein qazaa (nyaay) ki zimmedaari thi, teen Madinah mein aur teen Kufa mein, Madinah mein Umar, Ubayy, aur Zaid bin Thabit, aur Kufa mein Ali, Abdullah, aur Abu Musa." Ash-Shaibani ne kaha: to maine Ash-Sha'bi se poocha: 'Kya Abu Musa bhi inme shumaar kiye jaate hain?' Unhone kaha: "Woh fuqaha mein se aik the." Mujhse Abu Abdullah Muhammad bin Al-Abbas bin Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Aasim Ash-Shaheed (RA) ne yeh bataaya.

e: [AI] The knowledge of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  extended to the following individuals: Umar ibn al-Khattab, Ali ibn Abi Talib, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, Ubay ibn Ka'b, Mu'adh ibn Jabal, Zaid ibn Thabit, Abu Darda, and Abu Musa al-Ash'ari. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about them in his summary.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba ka ilm inhi giroh tak pahuncha: Umar bin Al-Khattab, Ali bin Abi Talib, Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Ubayy bin Ka'b, Mu'adh bin Jabal, Zaid bin Thabit, Abu Darda, aur Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "By Allah, if you obey Allah and Abdullah bin Qais on the right path, I will guide you on the way."
hi: "Allah ki qasam, agar tum pehle Allah ki itaa'at karo aur phir Abdullah bin Qais ki, to main zaroor tumhein sahi raaste par le jaunga."

e: [AI] I heard Al-Hassan saying, "No rider has ever come to Basra who is better for its people than Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari," according to the condition of Muslim.
hi: Maine Al-Hasan ko kehte suna: "Basra mein Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari se behtar koi savaar wahan ke logon ke liye nahi aaya." Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari said, 'Indeed, Ali was the first to embrace Islam with the Messenger of Allah.'"
hi: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (ne kaha): "Beshak Ali Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath sabse pehle Islam qubool karne wale the."

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ , Ibn Abbas wrote to him asking about it. Al-Ash'ari wrote to him, "Indeed, you are a man of your time, and I have not heard anything from the Prophet ﷺ  about it except that I was with the Prophet ﷺ  when he wanted to urinate. He stood up and urinated against a wall there and said, 'Indeed, the Children of Israel used to collect their urine with a qarad (vessel). So, when one of you wants to urinate, let him turn away from his urine.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, to Ibn Abbas ne unhein khat likha aur unse iske baare mein poocha, to Al-Ash'ari ne unhein likha: "Aap apne zamaane ke aik (buzurg) aadmi hain, aur maine iske baare mein Nabi (SAW) se koi hadith nahi sunayi siwaye iske ke main Nabi (SAW) ke sath tha, aap (SAW) ne peshaab karna chaaha, to aap (SAW) wahan aik naram (mulaayam) deewar ki jagah ki taraf gaye, aur farmaya: 'Bani Israel mein jab kisi ke (kapde ya jism ko) peshaab lag jaata, to woh use qainchi se kaat dete, isliye jab tum mein se koi peshaab karna chaahe, to woh (naram zameen) talaash kare.'"

e: [AI] "So, I heard Abu Musa and Abu Mas'ud say to Ammar, 'We have not seen from you in Islam a matter that we dislike more than your hastiness in this matter.' Ammar replied, 'And since the two of you embraced Islam, I have not seen a matter that I dislike more than your delay in it.' Then, they all went out to the mosque together."
hi: To maine Abu Musa aur Abu Mas'ood ko Ammar se yeh kehte suna: "Humne Islam mein tumse aisi koi baat napasand nahi ki jitni is maamle mein tumhari jaldi ko napasand kiya." Ammar ne kaha: "Aur maine bhi jab se tum dono ne Islam qubool kiya, tumhari is maamle mein sustee se zyada koi baat napasand nahi ki." Phir woh sab mil kar masjid ki taraf nikle.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  passed by Abu Musa one night, with Aisha accompanying him. Abu Musa was reciting, so they both stopped and listened to his recitation. After that, they proceeded and when morning came, Abu Musa went to the Prophet ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ  said to him, "I passed by you, O Abu Musa, last night while you were reciting, and we listened to your recitation." Abu Musa said, "O Prophet of Allah, if I had known that it was you, I would have performed a better recitation for you."
hi: Nabi (SAW) aik raat Abu Musa ke paas se guzre, aur unke sath Aisha thin, Abu Musa (Quran) padh rahe the, to woh dono ruk gaye aur unki tilaawat sunne lage, phir aage badh gaye. Jab subah hui, to Abu Musa Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aye Abu Musa, main kal raat tumhare paas se guzra jabke tum padh rahe the, to humne tumhari tilaawat suni." To Abu Musa ne kaha: "Aye Allah ke Nabi, agar mujhe pata hota ke aap wahan hain, to main aapke liye aur behtar tarteeb se padhta."

e: [AI] "That our Islam with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , our migration with him, our struggle with him, and our actions with him will be rewarded to us? And that every action we performed after him, we will be saved from it altogether?" Abu said to his father, "No? By Allah, we have indeed strived after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , we prayed, fasted, and performed many good deeds, and we hope for that (reward)." Abu said to his father, "By the One in whose hand is my soul, I wish that it be rewarded to me, and that everything after that we will be saved from it altogether." I said, "Indeed, your father is better than my father."
hi: Kya humara Islam Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath, aur humari hijrat unke sath, aur humara jihad unke sath, aur humara amal unke sath, humein wapas mil jaayega? Aur jo bhi amal humne unke baad kiya, kya hum usse (na sawaab na azaab) barabar-barabar bach jaayenge?" Mere waalid ne tumhare waalid se kaha: "Kyun nahi? Allah ki qasam, humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad bhi jihad kiya, namaz padhi, roza rakha, aur bohot saari bhalaai ki, aur hum isi ki ummeed rakhte hain." Unhone kaha: to tumhare waalid ne mere waalid se kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main chaahta houn ke woh (pehla amal) mujhe wapas mil jaaye, aur uske baad ki har cheez se hum barabar-barabar bach jaayein." Unhone kaha: maine kaha: "Beshak tumhare waalid mere waalid se behtar hain."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  appointed Abu Musa on a naval expedition. While they were sailing in the sea at night, a caller above them called out to them, 'Shall I inform you about a decree that Allah has ordained for Himself? Whoever is thirsty for the sake of Allah on a hot day, indeed it is the right of Allah to quench his thirst on the Day of Great Thirst.'"
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Musa ko samundari dasty (fauj) par mamoor kiya, to jab woh raat ko samundar mein safar kar rahe the, to unke oopar se aik pukaarne wale ne unhein pukaara: "Kya main tumhein aik aisa faisla na bataun jo Allah ne apni zaat par khud lagoo kiya hai, ke jo koi Allah ke liye kisi garmi ke din pyaasa rahe, to Allah par haq hai ke woh usse sabse badi pyaas ke din pilaaye."

e: [AI] After the death of his brother Uthman ibn Abi Sufyan, Muawiyah used Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani to govern Egypt. This happened in the forty-fourth year. Muawiyah then established the Hajj pilgrimage there.
hi: Beshak Mu'awiyah ne apne bhai Utbah bin Abi Sufyan ki wafaat ke baad, Uqbah bin Aamir Al-Juhani ko Misr ka gawarnar banaya, yeh chauwtalees (44) hijri mein hua, aur us saal Mu'awiyah ne Hajj ka intezaam kiya.

e: [AI] "Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani, also known as Abu Amr, passed away in the year fifty-two."
hi: "Uqbah bin Aamir Al-Juhani, jinki kunniyat Abu Amr thi, unka intiqaal battees (52) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] I passed by a group of people who had gathered around a sheikh while he was speaking. They made way for me, and I saw that the sheikh was saying, "O people, indeed there are three trusts that you hold. Whoever fulfills them is a believer, and whoever does not fulfill them is not a believer, even if they claim to have prayed, fasted, and purified themselves from impurity. And also, who is to my right?" Ubay ibn 'Amir al-Juhani, the companion of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said.
hi: Main kuch logon ke paas se guzra jo aik buzurg ke ird-gird jama the jo hadith bayan kar rahe the, to unhone mere liye jagah bana di, to maine dekha aik buzurg hadith bayan kar rahe the, keh rahe the: "Aye logo, teen (cheezein) tumhare paas amaanat hain, jo inki hifaazat kare woh momin hai, aur jo hifaazat na kare woh momin nahi: agar woh kahe 'maine namaz padhi' aur na padhi ho, ya 'maine roza rakha' aur na rakha ho, ya 'maine janaabat ka ghusl kiya' aur na kiya ho." Unhone kaha: to maine apne daayen wale se poocha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Usne kaha: "Uqbah bin Aamir Al-Juhani, Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi."

e: [AI] Ziyad sent me to Hujr bin 'Adi, and it is said [that he was known as] Ibn al-Adbar. He refused to come to him. Then he sent me again a second time, and he still refused to come to him. He [Ziyad] said, so he sent to him: "I warn you not to embark on the ends of affairs, for those who embarked on their beginnings have perished."[^1]
hi: Ziyad ne mujhe Hujr bin Adi ke paas bheja, jinhein Ibn Al-Adbar bhi kaha jaata hai, to unhone unke paas aane se inkaar kiya, phir unhone mujhe dobaara bheja, to unhone phir aane se inkaar kiya. Unhone kaha: to Ziyad ne unhein pukaara: "Main tumhein khabardaar karta houn ke tum aise maamlon ke aakhri hisson par mat chadho, kyunke jo unke shuru'aati hisson par chadhe woh halaak ho gaye."

e: [AI] About it, Al-Dhahabi wrote in the summary.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Hujr bin Adi Al-Kindi, also known as Abu Abdurrahman, was a companion of the Prophet ﷺ . He participated in the battles of Qadisiyyah and Jamal, and was also present alongside Ali. He was later killed by Muawiyah bin Abu Sufyan in a place called Marj Adhra. Hujr had two sons, Abdullah and Abdulrahman, both of whom were killed by Mus'ab bin Zubair. Hujr lived until the age of 53, and Al-Dhahabi did not mention him in his summary."
hi: Hujr bin Adi Al-Kindi, jinki kunniyat Abu Abdur Rahman thi, unhone Nabi (SAW) ke paas wafd banakar aana kiya tha, aur unhone Qaadisiyyah, Jamal, aur Siffin mein Ali ke sath shirkat ki, unhein Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan ne Marj Adhraa mein qatl kiya, aur unke do bete the, Abdullah aur Abdur Rahman, jinhein Mus'ab bin Az-Zubair ne sabr se (bandi banaakar) qatl kiya, aur Hujr, terh-pachaas (53) hijri mein qatl kiye gaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi on summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Al-Dhahabi in summary.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He is said to have been called a virgin, and then he consulted the people about it. He said, "They keep saying 'kill, kill'." So Abdullah ibn Zaid ibn Asad al-Bajali stood up and said, "O Commander of the Believers, you are our shepherd and we are your flock, and you are our pillar and we are your support. If you punish, we say you are just, and if you forgive, we say you are kind. And forgiveness is closer to piety. And every shepherd is responsible for his flock." So the people dispersed after his statement.
hi: Jise Marj Adhraa kaha jaata hai, phir unhone (Mu'awiyah ne) logon se iske baare mein mashwara maanga, unhone kaha: to log kehne lage: "Qatl karo, qatl karo." Unhone kaha: to Abdullah bin Zaid bin Asad Al-Bajali khade huay aur kaha: "Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen, aap humare charwaahe hain aur hum aapki ra'iyat hain, aap humara sutoon hain aur hum aapka sahaara hain, agar aap sazaa dein, to hum kahenge aapne theek kiya, aur agar aap maaf kar dein, to hum kahenge aapne achha kiya, aur maafi taqwa ke zyada qareeb hai, aur har charwaaha apni ra'iyat ke baare mein poocha jaayega." Unhone kaha: to log unki baat sunkar bikhar gaye.

e:
[AI] "Oh stone, did you not claim that you do not fear death? So we leave you alone." He replied, "Why should I not fear when I see a dug grave, a spread shroud, and a famous sword? By Allah, I will not say what angers the Lord." He was then killed, and this occurred in the month of Sha'ban in the year fifty-one."

Note: The statement regarding Al-Dhahabi remaining silent about this incident in his summary is not completely clear and may require further context.
hi: "Aye Hujr, kya tumne yeh dawa nahi kiya tha ke tum maut se nahi ghabraaoge, isliye hum tumhein (yun hi) chhod dete hain?" To unhone kaha: "Mujhe kyun na ghabraahat ho jabke main aik khudi hui qabr, phailaaya hua kafan, aur nangi talwaar dekh raha houn, aur Allah ki qasam, main aisi koi baat nahi kahunga jo Rab ko naaraaz kare." Unhone kaha: to unhein qatl kar diya gaya, aur yeh Sha'baan, ikyaawan (51) hijri mein hua. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Golden one about summarizing it."
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He prayed and struck the ground with his hand. The people also struck the ground with their hands. Then he descended and prayed, then he wrote to Muawiyah. Muawiyah wrote back asking to release him to him and he released him to him. When he arrived, he said, "Peace be upon you, O Amir al-Mu'minin." He said, "Amir al-Mu'minin, am I? I will not dismiss you nor will I resign you." So he ordered his killing. When they took him away, he asked them to allow him to pray two units of prayer, so they allowed him and he prayed two units of prayer. Then he said, "Do not uncover my body with an iron tool, do not wash my blood off of me, and bury me in my clothes, for I am a claimant." Hisham said that Muhammad ibn Sirin used to mention the hadith of the stone when asked about the martyr.
hi: ...namaz (ka waqt hua), aur unhone apna haath kankariyon ki taraf badhaaya, aur logon ne bhi apne haath kankariyon ki taraf badhaaye, to woh (sawaari se) utre aur namaz padhi, phir isme (is maamle mein) Mu'awiyah ko likha, to Mu'awiyah ne likha ke usse mere paas bhej do, to unhone usse unke paas bhej diya. Jab woh unke paas pahuncha, to usne kaha: "Aap par salaam ho, Aye Ameer-ul-Momineen." Unhone kaha: "Kya main Ameer-ul-Momineen houn? Main na tumhein maaf karunga aur na tumse maafi maangunga." To unhone usse qatl karne ka hukum diya. Jab woh usse lekar chale, to usne unse ijaazat maangi ke woh do rakat namaz padh le, to unhone ijaazat de di, usne do rakat namaz padhi, phir kaha: "Mera lohu (bediyaan) mat kholna, aur mera khoon mat dhona, aur mujhe mere kapdon mein hi dafan karna, kyunke main (Allah ke saamne) jhagda karne wala houn." Unhone kaha: to usse qatl kar diya gaya. Hishaam ne kaha: Muhammad bin Sireen jab bhi shaheed ke baare mein poochte, to Hujr ki hadith zikr karte.

e: [AI] The Prophet صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ addressed them and said, "Which day is this?" They replied, "It is a sacred day." He said, "Which city is this?" They replied, "It is the sacred city." He said, "Which month is it?" They replied, "It is a sacred month." He said, "Verily, your lives, your wealth, and your honor are sacred upon you, just as the sanctity of this day, this month, and this city. The witness shall convey it to the absent one. Do not revert to disbelief after me, striking the necks of one another."
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne unhein khutba di aur farmaya: "Yeh kaunsa din hai?" Unhone kaha: 'Haraam (izzat wala) din.' Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kaunsa shehar hai?" Unhone kaha: 'Haraam shehar.' Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kaunsa mahina hai?" Unhone kaha: 'Haraam mahina.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To beshak tumhara khoon, tumhara maal, aur tumhari izzat tumpar utni hi haraam hai jitni is din ki izzat, is mahine ki izzat, aur is shehar ki izzat, taake haazir gair-haazir tak yeh baat pahunchaaye, mere baad kaafir na bann jaana ke tum aik doosre ki gardanein maarne lago."

e: [AI] I heard Ibrahim ibn Ya'qub saying, "Hudhur ibn 'Adiyy lived during the era of ignorance (pre-Islamic era) and he consumed blood while doing so. Then he accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and heard from him, and witnessed battles alongside 'Ali ibn Abi Talib; such as the battles of Jamala and Siffin. He was killed in the allegiance to Ali."
hi: Maine Ibraheem bin Ya'qoob ko kehte suna: "Hujr bin Adi ne Jaahiliyat ka zamaana paaya, aur usme khoon (khaana ya iska maza chakhna) kiya, phir woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi bane aur unse suna, aur unhone Ali bin Abi Talib ke sath Jamal aur Siffin mein shirkat ki, aur woh Ali se wafaadaari ki wajah se qatl kiye gaye."

e: [AI] "I entered with Muawiyah to the Mother of the Believers, Aisha, and she said, 'O Muawiyah, you killed someone and his companions, and you did what you did.' And she mentioned the whole incident in detail."
hi: Main Mu'awiyah ke sath Umm-ul-Momineen Aisha ke paas dakhil hua, to unhone kaha: "Aye Mu'awiyah, tumne Hujr aur unke saathiyon ko qatl kiya, aur tumne woh kiya jo kiya," aur poora waaqia zikr kiya.

e: [AI] "Ziyad to Imran ibn Husein, 'Oh Abu Nujayd.'"
hi: Ziyad ne Imran bin Husain se kaha: "Aye Abu Nujaid."

e: [AI] "Imran bin Husein bin Ubaid bin Khalaf bin Abd Nahem bin Huzmata bin Jahmata bin Ghadirah, also known by the nickname Abu Nujaid, embraced Islam early on along with his father, his sister, and he fought alongside the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, in numerous battles. He stayed in his homeland and then migrated to Basra, where he resided until his death. His son was born and he, Imran bin Husein, also passed away in Basra. Imran bin Husein passed away in Basra one year before Ziyad, and Ziyad passed away in the fifty-fifth year."
hi: "Aur Imran bin Husain bin Ubaid bin Khalaf bin Abd Nahm bin Huzmah bin Jahmah bin Ghaadirah (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Nujaid thi, unhone bohot pehle Islam qubool kiya, woh, unke waalid, aur unki behn ne, aur unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath kayi ghazwe kiye, aur woh apni qaum ke ilaaqe mein hi rahe, phir Basra chale gaye aur wahin thehre yahan tak ke wahin unka intiqaal hua, aur unki aulaad bhi wahin rahi, aur Imran bin Husain ka intiqaal Basra mein Ziyad se aik saal pehle hua, aur Ziyad ka intiqaal pachpan (55) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "Abu Nujaid Imran, the son of Al-Husayn, the son of Khalaf, the son of Abd Nahim Al-Khuzai, died in Basra in the year fifty-two."
hi: "Abu Nujaid Imran bin Husain bin Khalaf bin Abd Nahm Al-Khuzaa'i ka intiqaal Basra mein battees (52) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "I went to Basra and entered the mosque, where I saw an old man leaning on a staff, talking. He said, 'The best of people are my generation, then those who follow them, then those who follow them. Then there will be people who will give testimony before they are asked.' So I asked, 'Who is this old man?' They replied, 'Imran ibn Husein.'"
hi: Main Basra gaya aur masjid mein dakhil hua, to achaanak aik buzurg aik satoon ke sahaare tak'ye lagaaye hadith bayan kar rahe the, keh rahe the: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Sabse behtareen log mera zamaana hain, phir woh jo unke baad aayenge, phir woh jo unke baad aayenge, phir aise log aayenge jo gawahi maangne se pehle hi de denge." Maine poocha: 'Yeh buzurg kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Imran bin Husain.' Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par, magar dono ne ise nahi nikaala. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: Ziyad, or some other governor, sent Imran ibn Husayn to collect sadaqah (i.e. zakat). When he returned, he asked Imran: Where is the property? He replied: Did you send me to bring the property? We collected it from where we used to collect in the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we spent it where we used to spend during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1625)
hi: Unhone Imran bin Husain ko zakat wasool karne bheja, jab woh wapas aaye to unke sath koi dirham na tha, to unhone unse poocha: 'Maal kahan hai?' Unhone kaha: "Kya aapne mujhe maal ke liye bheja tha? Humne ise usi tarah liya jaisa hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke daur mein liya karte the, aur humne ise usi jagah rakha jahan hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke daur mein rakha karte the."

e: [AI] "Imran ibn al-Husayn was one of the most diligent companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in worship." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about him in his summarization.
hi: Imran bin Husain "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se ibaadat mein sabse zyada mehnat karne walon mein se the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] No one from the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  is reported to have taken precedence over Imran ibn Husain in coming to Basra. Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se Basra mein koi bhi Imran bin Husain se behtar nahi aaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Al-Dhahabi on summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "So Imran cursed her (the camel). Then Nujayd came out fetching and recovering, and his camel amazed him. So he was asked, 'What happened to you?' He said, 'Abu Nujayd cursed my camel, and shortly after that her neck was severed.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary."
hi: To Imran ne uspar (oontni par) laanat ki, to Nujaid 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon' kehte huay nikle, aur unki oontni unhein bohot aziz thi, to unse poocha gaya: 'Aapko kya hua?' Unhone kaha: "Abu Nujaid ne meri oontni par laanat ki, to thodi hi der guzri thi ke uski gardan tut gayi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The angels used to greet me at my head, at the house, and at the door of the chamber. But when I fell sick, that stopped. When I recovered, he spoke to me saying, "Know, O Mu'tarrif, that the one I used to long for has returned to me. Keep this secret until I die." Ibn Athir remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Beshak farishtay mere sar ke qareeb, Baitullah ke paas, aur Hijr ke darwaaze par mujhe salaam karte the, jab maine (ilaaj ke taur par) daagh lagwaaya, to yeh silsila khatam ho gaya, jab main theek hua, to (kisi ne) unse baat ki, unhone kaha: "Jaan lo, Aye Mutarrif, ke jo (khaasiyat) mujhse chhoot gayi thi woh wapas aa gayi hai, isse chhupaaye rakhna, Aye Mutarrif, jab tak main mar na jaaun." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I have not touched my private part with my right hand since I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Jab se maine Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat ki hai, maine apni sharam-gaah ko apne daaye haath se nahi choova."

e: [AI] "A man divorced his wife while he was in a gathering with three people. He said, 'A sin has befallen him, and his wife has become forbidden for him.' He then left and mentioned this to Abu Musa, intending to criticize him. Abu Musa replied, 'May Allah bless us with more (virtues) like Abu Nujaed.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: Aik aadmi ne majlis mein baithe huay apni biwi ko teen talaaqen di, to (Imran ne) kaha: "Isse gunaah lazim ho gaya aur uski biwi uspar haraam ho gayi." To woh gaya aur yeh baat Abu Musa se, unhein aitraaz karne ke iraade se, bataayi, to Abu Musa ne kaha: "Allah humme Abu Nujaid jaise aur log zyada karein." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And it is said afterwards by a year."
hi: Aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai iske aik saal baad.

e: [AI] "[Simple Sea] The God prayed upon a grave and purified it at dawn. Water from the sea was poured over him while the Quraysh carried the shroud of their leader. Today, generosity and determination are buried in it, O Abu al-Mughira, with the world mourning. Among the deceptions of this ephemeral world is one that deceives. You had knowledge of what is right and proper, and you were dismissive of those who are of no importance. You used to give and donate generously when your door was open, and now it is closed. And people after you have become indifferent, as if their dreams have been woven with birds."
hi: "Allah ki rehmat is qabr par ho aur ise paak rakhe, Ath-Thawiyah ke paas, iske oopar shabnam (khushbu) barsaayi jaaye, Quraish is (qabr) mein apne sardaar ka janaaza le aayi, sakhaawat aur firaasat aaj isme dafan hai, Aye Abu Al-Mughirah, aur duniya sadme mein hai, aur beshak duniya ke fareb mein aik dhoka khaya hua bhi hai, aapke paas ma'roof (achhai) ki pehchaan thi, aur aapke paas buraai ke liye nakaaraatmak (mana karne wali) soch thi, aap khula-dila (maal) dete the jab aapka darwaaza khula hota, ab woh band hai, aur aapke baad log itne kamzor-dil ho gaye hain goya unke andar chidiya ke ghonsle bun diye gaye hon."

e: [AI] The name of Abdurrahman ibn Abi Bakr As-Siddiq during the pre-Islamic period was Abd Al-Uzza. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named him Abdurrahman.
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr As-Siddiq ka naam Jaahiliyat mein Abd Al-Uzza tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Abdur Rahman rakh diya."

e: [AI] "Abdul Rahman ibn Abu Bakr was known as Abu Abdullah, and it was also said Abu Muhammad. His mother was Umm Aisha, Umm Roman bint Amr ibn Uwaimir ibn Abd Shams ibn Abdimanaf. Umm Roman accepted Islam and her Islam was good."
hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr ki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai Abu Muhammad, aur unki maa, Aisha ki maa, Umm Rumaan bint Aamir bin Uwaimir bin Abd Shams bin Abd Manaf thin, Umm Rumaan ne Islam qubool kiya aur unka Islam achha (khaalis) tha.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah say, "The name of Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Bakr was Abdul Uzza. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  renamed him Abdul Rahman and he was also known as Abu Muhammad. He witnessed the conquest of Damascus and Umar ibn al-Khattab gave him Layla bint al-Juday as a wife when Damascus was conquered. And he had a lover."
hi: Maine Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaibah ko kehte suna: "Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr ka naam Abd Al-Uzza tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Abdur Rahman rakh diya, aur unki kunniyat Abu Muhammad thi, aur unhone Damascus ki fatah mein shirkat ki, to Umar ne, jab Damascus fatah hua, unhein Laila bint Al-Judi (maal-e-ghanimat mein se) khaas taur par inaam ke taur par di, aur uska aik pehla chaahne wala unke apne log mein se tha."

e: [AI] Regarding it, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That Abdulrahman ibn Abu Bakr, along with a group of young men from the Quraysh, migrated to the Prophet ﷺ before the conquest." The mention of it was omitted by al-Dhahabi in the summary.
hi: "Beshak Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr Quraish ke kuch jawaano ke sath, Fatah se pehle, Nabi (SAW) ki taraf hijrat kar aaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Bakr, "Delight us with your presence."
hi: Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Bakr se farmaya: "Humein apni zaat se faayda uthaane do (yaani lambi zindagi ki dua)."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr said, "But if I had seen you, I would not have forgiven you." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Abu Bakr (ne kaha): "Lekin agar maine tumhein dekha hota, to main tumhein maaf na karta." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdul Rahman ibn Abu Bakr died suddenly, his nickname was Abu Abdullah. He died in the year fifty-three."
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr achaanak (faujee) intiqaal kar gaye, unki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, unka intiqaal terh-pachaas (53) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "May Allah have mercy on my brother. Most of what I find in myself is that he was not buried where he died." She said, and her brother had passed away in Abyssinia. So a group of Quraysh went out to him and carried him to the highest point in Mecca." (The mention of this incident is omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summary.)
hi: "Allah mere bhai par reham kare, sabse zyada jo baat mujhe apne dil mein khatakti hai woh yeh hai ke unhein wahan dafan nahi kiya gaya jahan woh faut huay." Unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: aur unke bhai ka intiqaal Habshah mein hua tha, to Quraish ka aik giroh unki taraf nikla aur unhein Makkah ke bala'i hisse mein le aaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] In Islam, there are four people who the Prophet ﷺ  acknowledged as both fathers and sons, except for Abu Quhafah, Abu Bakr, Abdur Rahman ibn Abu Bakr, and his son Abu Atiq, Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Abdul Rahman ibn Abu Bakr. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about him in the summary.
hi: Humein Islam mein aise chaar (log) maloom nahi jinhone Nabi (SAW) ko paaya, baap bhi aur bete bhi, siwaye Abu Quhafah, Abu Bakr, Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr, aur unke bete Abu Ateeq Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr ke. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Bakr as-Siddiq died suddenly."
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr As-Siddiq achaanak (faujee) intiqaal kar gaye."

e: [AI] Abdul Rahman ibn Abu Bakr did not engage in any falsehood in Islam.
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr par Islam mein kabhi kisi jhoot ka ilzaam nahi laga."

e: [AI] A woman entered Aisha's house, prayed beside the Prophet's house while she was in good health, prostrated, and did not lift her head until she died. Aisha said, "Praise be to Allah who gives life and causes death. Indeed, in this is a lesson for me regarding Abdurrahman ibn Abu Bakr who lay in his bed, and they went to wake him up but found that he had died." Aisha's soul was then falsely accused of being involved in causing harm to him, and they buried him while he was still alive. Aisha saw this incident as a lesson for herself and any negative thoughts she had about it disappeared. However, Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this incident in his summary.
hi: Beshak aik aurat Aisha ke ghar mein dakhil hui aur Nabi (SAW) ke ghar ke paas namaz padhi, jabke woh sehatmand thi, usne sajda kiya aur apna sar tab tak na uthaaya jab tak woh mar nahi gayi. To Aisha ne kaha: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye jo zinda karta aur marta hai, beshak ismein mere liye Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr ke maamle mein aik naseehat hai, woh apne aaraam-gaah mein leta hua tha, jab log unhein jagaane gaye, to unhone unhein wafaat paaya hua paaya." To Aisha ke dil mein yeh shak dakhil hua ke shaayad unke sath koi bura maamla hua ho aur jaldi mein unhein dafan kar diya gaya ho jabke woh zinda the, to unhein laga ke yeh (aurat ka waaqia) unke liye aik naseehat (dilaasa) hai, aur unke dil se woh khayaal chala gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Bakr died in the year fifty-three and witnessed the battle of Al-Jamal with his sister Aisha. He traveled to Ibn Aamir in Basra."
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr ka intiqaal terh-pachaas (53) hijri mein hua, aur unhone apni behn Aisha ke sath Jamal ki jung mein shirkat ki, aur woh Ibn Aamir ke paas Basra aaye the."

e: "Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr died in Al-Hubshi" He said: "He was carried to Makkah to be buried there. So when Aishah arrived she went to the grave of Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr and she said: "We were like two drinking companions of Jadhimah for such a long time that they would say: 'They will never part.' So when we were separated it was as if I and Malik - due to the length of unity - never spent a night together." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1055)
hi: Aur unhone (Aisha ne) kaha (bahr At-Taweel mein): "Aur hum aik lambe arse tak Jadhimah ke do saathiyon jaise the, yahan tak ke kaha jaane laga ke hum kabhi juda nahi honge, phir jab hum juda ho gaye, to goya main aur Malik, itni lambi rifaaqat ke baad, kabhi aik raat bhi sath nahi rahe." Phir Aisha Makkah wapas aayin aur kaha: "Suno, Allah ki qasam, agar main tumhare (marte waqt) sath hoti, to main tumhein wahin dafan karti jahan tum mare."

e: [AI] Abdur Rahman ibn Abu Bakr did not get involved in a lie in Islam.
hi: "Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr par Islam mein kabhi kisi jhoot ka ilzaam nahi laga."

e: [AI] "And he said, 'I will sell my religion for the sake of my worldly desires' and he went out to Mecca until he died," al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Aur (usne) kaha: "Main apna deen apni duniya ke badle bechta houn," aur woh Makkah ki taraf nikla yahan tak ke wahin uska intiqaal hua. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Bring me a writing board and a shoulder, and I will write a book for you that you will never go astray after." Then, he turned away from us and Allah and the believers do not accept anyone but Abu Bakr." Its chain of narrators is authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere paas dawaat aur (likhne ke liye) aik haddi laao, main tumhare liye aik aisi tahreer likh dun jiske baad tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge." Phir aap (SAW) ne humse apna mun pher liya, phir humari taraf mutawajjeh huay aur farmaya: "Allah aur momin sirf Abu Bakr ko (khalifa maanne se) inkaar nahi karenge (yaani sabko yahi manzoor hoga)." Isnad sahih hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to him, "Marry your sister Aisha, and treat her with kindness and generosity. When her menstrual cycle comes, let her refrain from intimate relations. Indeed, it will be a accepted form of worship." Its chain of narrators is strong.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Apni behn Aisha ko apni sawaari par peeche bithao, aur unhein At-Tan'eem se Umrah karwaao, jab woh Al-Akamah (jagah) se neeche utrein, to unhein hukum do ke woh ihraam baandh lein, kyunke yeh Umrah qubool ki jaayegi." Isnad mazboot hai.

e: [AI] "And on the day of the Battle of Ta'if, among the Muslims who were killed were some from the tribe of Taym ibn Murrah, including Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr. He was struck by an arrow and died fifty days later."
hi: "Aur Taif ke din Musalmano mein se Banu Taim bin Murrah se Abdullah bin Abi Bakr qatl kiye gaye, unhein teer laga, to woh iske pachaas (50) din baad wafaat paa gaye."

e: [AI] The one who brought food to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Abu Bakr in the cave was Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr.
hi: "Jo shakhs Rasulullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr ke paas ghaar mein khaana pahunchaata tha, woh Abdullah bin Abi Bakr the."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr passed away in the same year that Fatima passed away after the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
hi: "Abdullah bin Abi Bakr ka intiqaal usi saal hua jismein Fatimah ka, Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ke baad, intiqaal hua."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr was struck by an arrow during the Battle of Ta'if, and the arrow remained in his body for forty nights after the death of the Messenger of Allah. He eventually passed away, and Abu Bakr entered upon Aisha and said, 'Oh my daughter, by Allah, it feels as if my liver has been seized and taken away from our home.' She responded, 'Praise be to Allah who has fastened it to your heart and strengthened your resolve.' He left and then returned, saying, 'Oh my daughter, are you afraid that we have buried Abdullah while he is still alive?' She replied, 'Verily, we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return, oh father.' He then sought refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan, and said, 'Oh my daughter, there is no one except that he is drawn towards one of the two companions: an angel or a devil.' He came forward to a delegation from Thaqif, and the arrow was still in his hand. He showed it to them and asked, 'Does anyone among you recognize this arrow?' Sa'd ibn 'Ubaid, the brother of Banu Al-'Ajlan, said, 'This is an arrow that I manufactured, polished, and fletched, and with which I shot.' Abu Bakr said, 'Verily, this is the arrow that killed Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr. Praise be to Allah who honored him with your hand and did not disgrace him with his own hand. Indeed, He is the expansive in protection.'"
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Bakr (RA) ko Taif ke din aik teer laga, to Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat ke chaalis (40) raaton baad woh (zakhm) phir se khul gaya, to woh wafaat paa gaye. To Abu Bakr (RA) Aisha (RA) ke paas dakhil huay aur kaha: "Aye meri beti, Allah ki qasam, aisa lagta hai jaise kisi bhed ka kaan pakda gaya ho aur usse humare ghar se nikaal diya gaya ho." To unhone kaha: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne aapke dil ko mazboot kiya aur aapki hidayat par aapko azm ata kiya." Phir woh nikle, phir wapas aaye aur kaha: "Aye meri beti, kya tumhein darr hai ke tumne Abdullah ko dafna diya ho jabke woh zinda ho?" To unhone kaha: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'oon, Aye Abba jaan." To unhone kaha: "Main Allah, Sami', Aleem, ki panaah maangta houn shaitan-e-rajeem se, Aye meri beti, koi bhi shakhs aisa nahi jiske do khayaal na hon, aik farishte ki taraf se aur aik shaitan ki taraf se." Unhone kaha: to unke paas Thaqeef ka wafd aaya, aur woh teer unhein bardaasht se zyada takleef de raha tha, to unhone woh unke saamne nikaala aur poocha: "Kya tum mein se koi is teer ko pehchaanta hai?" To Sa'd bin Ubaid (RA), Banu Al-Ajlaan ke bhai, ne kaha: "Yeh teer main hi taraashta tha, isme par lagaaye the, aur isse mazboot kiya tha, aur main hi ne yeh chalaaya tha." To Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "To yehi woh teer hai jisne Abdullah bin Abi Bakr (RA) ko qatl kiya, to sab tareef Allah ke liye jisne unhein tumhare haath se izzat di, aur unke apne haath se zaleel nahi kiya, beshak woh wasee' hifaazat wala hai."

e: [AI] "The messenger of Allah ﷺ  was shrouded in two pieces of cloth that belonged to Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr. He was wrapped in them and then they were removed from him. So Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr held onto those garments for himself until he would be shrouded in them when he died. After holding onto them, he said that he would not hold onto anything for himself that Allah prevented His messenger ﷺ  from being shrouded in. So Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr gave them as a charity."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko do hibarah (Yemeni) chaadron mein kafan diya gaya jo Abdullah bin Abi Bakr (RA) ki thin, unhein unme lapeta gaya, phir unhein unse utaar liya gaya." To Abdullah bin Abi Bakr (RA) ne woh jodaa apne liye rakh liya taake jab woh mar jaayein to usme kafan diye jaayein, phir isse rakhne ke baad unhone kaha: "Main apne liye koi aisi cheez kyun rakhoon jisse Allah ne apne Rasool (SAW) ko kafan dene se roka?" To Abdullah ne isse sadqa kar diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "When a Muslim reaches the age of forty, Allah will protect him from three types of afflictions: insanity, leprosy, and vitiligo. And when he reaches the age of fifty, his past and future sins will be forgiven, and he will be among Allah's captives on earth and an intercessor for his household on the Day of Judgment." These are the summarized words of Al-Dhahabi about its weakness.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab Musalman aadmi chalis (40) saal ki umr ko pahunchta hai, to Allah usse teen tarah ki museebaton se bachaata hai: paagalpan, korh (kushtha rog), aur baras (safed daag); aur jab woh pachaas (50) saal ki umr ko pahunchta hai, to Allah uske pehle aur baad ke gunaah maaf kar deta hai, aur woh zameen mein Allah ka qaidi ban jaata hai, aur Qayamat ke din apne ghar walon ke liye sifaarish karne wala hoga." Adh-Dhahabi ne isse Talkhees se iski kamzori ki wajah se hataaya.

e: [AI] "We do not know of four people in Islam who met the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ with both their fathers and their sons except Abu Quhafa, Abu Bakr, Abdul Rahman ibn Abu Bakr, and Abu Atiq Muhammad ibn Abdur Rahman."
hi: "Humein Islam mein aise chaar (log) maloom nahi jinhone Nabi (SAW) ko paaya, baap bhi aur bete bhi, siwaye Abu Quhafah (RA), Abu Bakr (RA), Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr (RA), aur Abu Ateeq Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman (RA) ke."

e: [AI] He is called the drinker of gold. His mother is Hind bint Al-Harith from the tribe of Bani Ghanim bin Malik bin 'Abd Manat bin 'Ali bin Lubanah. He came as an immigrant to Basra and died there.
hi: Unhein 'Shaarib Adh-Dhahab' (sone ka peene wala) kaha jaata hai, unki maa Hind bint Al-Harith thin, Banu Ghanm bin Malik bin Abd Manaat bin Ali bin Lubaanah se, woh muhaajir bankar Basra aaye aur wahin unka intiqaal hua.

e: [AI] "I passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was performing ablution, so I greeted him, but he did not respond to me. When he finished, he responded to me and apologized, saying, 'It was not that I did not want to respond to you, but I disliked mentioning Allah, the Almighty, while I was not in a state of ritual purity.'"
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas se guzra jabke woh wudu kar rahe the, to maine unhein salaam kiya, unhone mujhe jawaab nahi diya." Jab aap (SAW) faarigh huay, to unhone mujhe jawaab diya aur mujhse maazrat ki aur farmaya: "Mujhe tumhein jawaab dene se sirf isliye roka kyunke mujhe napasand tha ke main Allah, buzurg aur buland, ka zikr karoon jabke main taharat mein na houn."

e: [AI] "And it was said to his parents, 'Al-Qawaqil'. He was in a state of ihram (ritual consecration) from Sham (Damascus) when the Prophet ﷺ  set out for his Umrah (lesser pilgrimage). He went to Al-Hudaybiyah, intending to perform the Umrah. His arrival coincided with the departure of the Prophet ﷺ . So he went out with him, and Ka'b ibn 'Ujrah, the ally of Banu 'Auf ibn Al-Harith ibn Al-Khazraj, also went out with them."
hi: Aur unke baap-dada ko 'Al-Qawaaqil' kaha jaata hai, aur woh Sham se ihraam bandh chuke the jab Nabi (SAW) Hudaibiyah ki taraf Umrah ke iraade se nikle, to unka aana Nabi (SAW) ke nikalne ke sath mil gaya, to woh unke sath nikle, aur Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA), Banu Auf bin Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj ke ahd-waale saathi, bhi (sath the).

e: [AI] From his father, I asked him, "O Abu Muhammad, what did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  command you to do during your ihram in Hudaibiyah?" He replied, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  told me, 'Shave, shave.'"
hi: Apne waalid se, maine poocha: "Aye Abu Muhammad, Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hudaibiyah ke waqt aapke ihraam ke baare mein aapko kya hukum diya tha?" To unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Sar mundwaao, sar mundwaao."

e: [AI] Ka'b ibn Ujrah died in the city in the year fifty-two, and at that time he was seventy-five years old.
hi: "Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah mein battees (52) hijri mein hua, jabke woh us waqt pachattar (75) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Ka'b ibn 'Ujrah, "O Ka'b ibn Ujrah, I seek refuge with Allah for you from the governance of fools." Ka'b asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the governance of fools?" He said, "It is to have rulers who will come after me, those who will enter upon them and believe their lies, and assist them in their oppression. They are not from me, and I am not from them, and they will not meet me by the Pool." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA) se farmaya: "Aye Ka'b bin Ujrah (RA), main tumhein Allah ki panaah mein deta houn behuda/na-samajh hukmraanon ki hukoomat se." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), aur behuda hukmraanon ki hukoomat kya hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere baad aise hukmraan aayenge, jo unke paas jaayega aur unke jhoot ki tasdeeq karega aur unke zulm mein unki madad karega, woh mujhse nahi aur na main usse houn, aur woh kabhi Hauz (Kausar) par mere paas nahi aayega." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] And some of them said, 'Amr ibn Rabee witnessed the Battle of Uhud, the Trench, and all the other scenes with the Messenger of Allah.
hi: Aur kuch logon ne kaha: 'Amr bin Rabee'' ne Uhud, Khandaq, aur iske baad ke tamaam maidaanon mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath shirkat ki.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  encountered me on the day of Dhi Qard and he looked at me and said, 'O Allah, bless him in his hair and complexion.' He also said, 'May your face be successful.' I said, 'And may your face be successful, O Messenger of Allah?' He asked, 'Did Mas'ada get killed?' I said, 'Yes.' He then asked, 'What is this on your face?' I said, 'An arrow that was shot at me, O Messenger of Allah.' He said, 'Remove it.' So, I came close to him, and he spat on it and it did not cause me any pain or inflammation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Zi Qarad ke din mujhse mile, to unhone mujhe dekha aur farmaya: "Aye Allah, iske baalon aur iski jild mein barkat de." Aur farmaya: "Tumhara chehra kaamyaab hua." Maine kaha: 'Aur aapka chehra bhi, Ya Rasulullah (SAW).' Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya Mas'adah maara gaya?" Maine kaha: 'Ji haan.' Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "To yeh tumhare chehre par kya hai?" Maine kaha: 'Aik teer jo mujhe laga, Ya Rasulullah (SAW).' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qareeb aao." To main unke qareeb gaya, aap (SAW) ne usspar thook lagaayi, to woh kabhi na dukhi aur na hi usme paip pada.

e: [AI] "Abu Qatada ibn Rib'iyy, one of the Bani Salamah, passed away in Medina at the age of 54, while he was 70 years old."
hi: "Abu Qatadah bin Rabee' (RA), Banu Salamah mein se aik, ka intiqaal Madinah mein chauwan (54) hijri mein hua, jabke woh us waqt sattar (70) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya ibn Ma'een say, "The two garments of the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  are Abu Abdullah."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Thawban (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghulam, unki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi."

e: [AI] "Two garments belonged to the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Its origin was from Yemen. It was taken as booty, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gifted it to him. He became known as Abu Abdullah. He died in Hims in the year fifty-four."
hi: "Thawban (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghulam, asal mein Yemen se the, unhein qaid kar liya gaya tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unpar ehsaan kiya (unhein aazaad kiya), unki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, unka intiqaal Hims mein chauwan (54) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "And from what reached us regarding the news of Hims, and from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and from the allies of Quraysh, Thawban ibn Budjdud, who was also known as Abu Abdullah, was a man from the Alhân tribe. He was captured as a prisoner, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  set him free and said to him: 'Oh Thawban, if you wish to join those whom you were with, then you are one of them. And if you wish to remain with us, the household of the Messenger of Allah, upon the allegiance to the Messenger of Allah.' Thawban responded: 'Rather, I will remain on the allegiance to the Messenger of Allah.' He then passed away in Hims during the reign of Abdullah ibn Qurt."
hi: Aur Hims aur wahan basne walon mein se Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba aur Quraish ke ahd-waale saathiyon ki jo khabar humein pahunchi hai, unme se Thawban bin Bujdud (RA) hain, jinki kunniyat Abu Abdullah thi, Al-Alhaan qabile ke aik aadmi, unhein qaid kar liya gaya tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein aazaad kiya aur unse farmaya: "Aye Thawban (RA), agar tum chaaho ke apni asli qaum se jaa milo, to tum unme se ho, aur agar tum chaaho ke sthir raho aur humare ahle-bait ke sath, Rasulullah (SAW) ki wilayat mein, raho, to raho." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, main Rasulullah (SAW) ki wilayat mein hi sthir rahunga." To unka intiqaal Hims mein Abdullah bin Qurt ke gawarnar honay ke daur mein, chauwan (54) hijri mein hua.

e: [AI] To me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If you take an oath to commit a sin, leave it and throw the remnants of ignorance under your feet. Beware of drinking alcohol, for Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has not sanctified its drinker." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
