hi: Mujhse Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum kisi gunaah ki qasam khaao, to usse chhod do, aur Jaahiliyat ki dushmaniyon ko apne paaon ke neeche daal do, aur sharaab peene se bacho, kyunke Allah, buzurg aur buland, ne uske peene wale ko paak nahi kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, supplication repels destiny, and indeed, righteousness increases in provision. Indeed, a person may be deprived of provision due to sin that befalls him." Ibn Qarin is a liar.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak dua taqdeer ko badal deti hai, aur neki rizq mein izaafa karti hai, aur banda apne gunaah ki wajah se rizq se mehroom ho jaata hai." Ibn Qareen jhoota (kadhaab) hai.

e: [AI] "Thawban, the slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  narrated: I was standing in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when a Jew passed by us and said, 'Peace be upon you, O Muhammad.' I pushed him away forcefully, almost causing harm to him. He asked, 'Why did you push me?' I replied, 'Don't you say 'O Messenger of Allah?' The Jew said, 'Indeed, we call him by the name his family gave him.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Indeed, my name that my family gave me is Muhammad.' The Jew said, 'I came to ask you,' and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, 'How can I benefit you if I speak to you?' The Jew replied, 'I will listen with my ears.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  picked up a stick and said, 'Ask.' The Jew asked, 'Where will people be on the day when the earth and heavens are changed except for the earth and the heavens?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'They will be in darkness before the resurrection.' The Jew asked, 'Who will be the first to be granted permission?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'The poor emigrants.' The Jew asked, 'What will be their appearance when they enter Paradise?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'It will be an increase in the livers like that of the fish (the Prophet Yunus).' The Jew asked, 'What will be their sustenance in the shadow (of Paradise)?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'The slaughtered animals from Paradise, which they used to eat from its edges.' The Jew asked, 'What will be their drink?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'A river called Salsabil.' The Jew said, 'You have spoken the truth.'" Similar narration can be found in Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Beshak Thawban (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghulam, ne unhein hadith bayan ki, unhone kaha: main Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne khada tha, ke aik Yahoodi ulama mein se aik unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Aapko salaam ho, Aye Muhammad." To maine usse zor se dhakka diya, jisse woh girte-girte bacha. Usne poocha: "Tum mujhe kyun dhakka de rahe ho?" Maine kaha: 'Kya tum yeh nahi kehte, Aye Allah ke Rasool?' To Yahoodi ne kaha: "Hum toh unhein usi naam se pukaarte hain jo unke ghar walon ne unhein diya." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak mera naam jo mere ghar walon ne rakha, Muhammad hai." Yahoodi ne kaha: "Main aapse poochne aaya houn." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein faayda hoga agar main tumhein bataaun?" Usne kaha: 'Main apne kaanon se sununga.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne sath ki chhadi se (zameen par) nishaan banaaya aur farmaya: "Poocho." Yahoodi ne poocha: "Log kahan honge jab zameen kisi aur zameen se aur aasman badal diye jaayenge?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Andhere mein, hashr se pehle." Usne poocha: "To sabse pehle kaun (Jannat mein dakhil honay ki) ijaazat paayega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Muhajireen ke ghareeb log." Usne poocha: "To Jannat mein dakhil honay ke din unka tohfa kya hoga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Machhli ke jigar ka izaafa hissa." Usne poocha: "To iske baad unki khuraak kya hogi?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke liye Jannat ka woh bael zibah kiya jaayega jo uske kinaron se chartaa tha." Usne poocha: "To iske upar unka mashroob kya hoga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aik nehar jise Salsabeel kaha jaata hai." Usne kaha: "Aapne sach kaha." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] I heard Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir al-Hizami say, "Hakim ibn Hizam ibn Khulaid ibn Asad ibn Abdul-Aziz ibn Qusay, nicknamed Abu Khalid, died in the year 63 at the age of 125. He was born 13 years before the Elephant incident and died in Madinah."
hi: Maine Ibraheem bin Al-Mundhir Al-Hizaami ko kehte suna: "Hakeem bin Hizaam bin Khuwailid bin Asad bin Abdul Uzza bin Qusayy (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Khaalid thi, unka intiqaal chauwan (54) hijri mein hua, jabke woh aik sau bees (120) saal ke thay, unki paidaish 'Aam-ul-Feel' se terah (13) saal pehle hui, aur unka intiqaal Madinah mein hua."

e: [AI] I heard Ali ibn Ghannam al-Amiri say, "Hakim ibn Hizam was born inside the Kaaba. His mother entered the Kaaba and went into labor, and she gave birth inside the house."
hi: Maine Ali bin Ghannaam Al-Aamiri ko kehte suna: "Hakeem bin Hizaam (RA) Ka'bah ke andar paida huay, unki maa Ka'bah mein dakhil huin, unhein wahan dard-e-zeh shuru hua, to unhone Baitullah ke andar hi unhein janam diya."

e: [AI] Abu Khalid, Hakim ibn Hizam, died at the age of sixty when he was one hundred and twenty years old.
hi: "Abu Khaalid Hakeem bin Hizaam (RA) ka intiqaal saath (60) hijri mein hua, jabke woh aik sau bees (120) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] "To sacrifice his son Abdullah, and this was before the birth of the Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him by five years." Al-Dhahabi remained silent regarding this summary.
hi: ...ke woh apne bete Abdullah ko zibah kar den, aur yeh Nabi (SAW) ki paidaish se paanch (5) saal pehle hua. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

Humein Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Baalawaih ne bataya, humse Ibraheem bin Ishaq Al-Harbi ne bayan ki, humse Mus'ab bin Abdullah ne, unhone Hakeem bin Hizaam (RA) ka nasab zikr kiya, aur usme izaafa kiya: "Aur unki maa Faakhitah bint Zuhair bin Asad bin Abdul Uzza thin, unhone Hakeem ko Ka'bah mein janam diya jabke woh hamila thin, unhein dard-e-zeh Ka'bah ke andar hi shuru hua, to unhone wahin unhein janam diya, to unhein aik chataai mein utha kar le jaaya gaya, aur unke neeche jo kapda tha usse Zamzam ke hauz ke paas dhoya gaya, aur unse pehle na baad mein Ka'bah mein kisi ne janam nahi liya."

e: [AI] The translation of the passage is: "Hakim bin Hizam did not accept anything from Abu Bakr until he passed away, nor from Umar until he passed away, nor from Uthman, nor from Muawiyah until he died."
hi: Beshak Hakeem bin Hizaam (RA) ne "Abu Bakr (RA) se kuch bhi nahi liya yahan tak ke unka intiqaal ho gaya, aur na hi Umar (RA) se yahan tak ke unka intiqaal ho gaya, aur na hi Uthman (RA) se, aur na hi Mu'awiyah (RA) se yahan tak ke woh faut ho gaye."

e: [AI] "I emancipated forty slaves during the pre-Islamic era (ignorance). So, I asked the Prophet ﷺ if I would receive any reward for it. He replied, 'You have already done a good deed by embracing Islam.'" This is an authentic narration according to the conditions set by both Sheikhain (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim).
hi: Maine Jaahiliyat mein chalis (40) ghulam aazaad kiye the, to maine Nabi (SAW) se poocha ke kya mujhe inke liye koi ajr milega? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne apni pehle ki (nekiyon) par Islam qubool kiya." Sahih, Shaykhain ki shart par. Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] "To the Messenger of Allah, have you seen something that I used to do during the time of ignorance and want to be rewarded for it? The Messenger of Allah replied, "You have embraced Islam, and you will be rewarded for what you have done before." Ibn Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se poochha: "Aap kya farmaate hain us cheez ke baare mein jo main Jaahiliyat mein karta tha, sawaab ki niyat se, kya mujhe iska ajr milega?" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne apne pehle (kiye huay neik amal) ke ajr ke sath Islam qubool kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he gave me, but I insisted. He said, "I do not deny your request, O wise one. However, this wealth is green and sweet, but it is also the dirt of people's hands. And the hand of Allah is above the hand of the giver, and the hand of the giver is above the hand of the asker, and the hand of the asker is at the bottom of the hands."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se maanga, to aap (SAW) ne mujhe diya, phir maine israar kiya (zyada maanga), to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tumhari maang ko bura nahi samajhta, Aye Hakeem (RA), lekin yeh maal hara-bhara, meetha hai, aur yeh bas logon ke haathon ki maili hai, aur Allah ka haath dene wale ke haath ke oopar hai, aur dene wale ka haath maangne wale ke haath ke oopar hai, aur maangne wale ka haath sabse neeche ke haathon mein se hai."

e: [AI] "I saw myself on the day of Badr, and a vapor descended from the sky, covering the horizon. Then, the valley began to flow with water. It occurred to me that this is a sign from heaven supporting Muhammad ﷺ. However, it turned out to be nothing but defeat. The angels were there."
hi: "Maine khud ko Badr ke din dekha, ke wadi mein aasman se aik bukhaar (dhund/baadal) utra jisne ufaq ko bhar diya, achaanak wadi paani se behne lagi, to mere dil mein yeh baat aayi ke yeh aasman se koi cheez hai jisse Muhammad (SAW) ki madad ki ja rahi hai, to (dushman ki) shikast ke siwa kuch na hua, aur farishtay (wahan) the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Muhammad, the Prophet ﷺ , was the most beloved person to me in the pre-Islamic period. When he received the divine revelation and migrated to Medina, Hakim ibn Hizam went out to Al-Madisem and found a necklace that was being sold for fifty dirhams. He bought it to give it as a gift to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He presented it to him and intended to gift it to him, but the Prophet refused to accept it. Abdullah ibn Ubaid said, "I thought he refused it because he did not accept anything from the polytheists, but he accepted it as a purchase." So I gave it to him until he reached Medina and wore it. I saw him wearing it on the pulpit, and I never saw anything more beautiful than him wearing it that day. Then he gave it to Usamah ibn Zaid, and Hakim saw it on Usamah and said, "Usamah, are you wearing the necklace of Dhi Yazan?" Usamah replied, "Yes, for I am better than Dhi Yazan, and my father is better than his father, and my mother is better than his mother." Hakim said, "I then went to Makkah and marveled them with the words of Usamah."
hi: Jaahiliyat mein Muhammad Nabi (SAW) mere liye logon mein sabse zyada mehboob the, jab unhein Nabuwwat mili aur woh Madinah ki taraf nikle, to Hakeem bin Hizaam (RA) Hajj ke mausam mein nikle, to unhein Dhi Yazan ki aik hullah (jodaa) mili jo pachaas (50) dirham mein bik rahi thi, to unhone woh khareedi taake Rasulullah (SAW) ko tohfe mein dein, to woh isse lekar unke paas pahunche aur chaaha ke aap (SAW) isse qubool karein, magar aap (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Ubaidullah ne kaha: mera khayaal hai ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Hum mushrikeen se kuch nahi lete, lekin humne isse qeemat de kar le liya." To maine woh unhein de di, yahan tak ke woh Madinah pahunche aur isse pehna, maine unhein mimbar par ispar dekha, aur maine usdin unme usse zyada khoobsurat kisi ko nahi dekha, phir aap (SAW) ne woh Usamah bin Zaid (RA) ko de di, to Hakeem ne woh Usamah par dekhi aur kaha: "Aye Usamah, tum Dhi Yazan ki hullah pehen rahe ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, main Dhi Yazan se behtar houn, aur mera waalid uske waalid se behtar hai, aur meri maa uski maa se behtar hai." Hakeem ne kaha: to main Makkah gaya, Usamah ki is baat se unhein khush karte huay.

e: [AI] "When the Prophet ﷺ sent him as a governor to Yemen, he said, 'Do not touch the Quran unless you are in a state of purity.'"
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Yemen ka gawarnar bana kar bheja, to farmaya: "Quran ko tab tak mat chhuo jab tak tum paak na ho."

e: [AI] Concerning Dawud ibn al-Husayn regarding the one who migrated to the land of Habasha for the second migration, Khalid ibn Hizam, he was bitten by a snake on the way and died.
hi: Dawud bin Al-Husain se, un logon mein se jinhone Habshah ki zameen ki taraf doosri hijrat ki: "Khalid bin Hizaam (RA), unhein raaste mein aik saanp ne kaata aur woh wafaat paa gaye."

e: [AI] Urwah and Abdur Rahman bin Abdi Al-Qari reported that they heard Umar bin Al-Khattab saying, "I passed by Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam while he was reciting Surah Al-Baqarah during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The hadith was long. Umar said, "According to the arrangement of this Book, the mention of Khalid bin Hizam should come before Hakim, and the mention of Hisham bin Hakim should come after them. However, I have gathered them together in this place when mentioning Hakim, so that it may be easier to understand for the one benefiting."
hi: Urwah aur Abdur Rahman bin Abd Al-Qari se, unhone Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ko kehte suna: main Hisham bin Hakeem bin Hizaam (RA) ke paas se guzra jabke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki zindagi mein Surah Al-Baqarah padh rahe the, hadith poori tafseel se. Unhone kaha: "Is kitaab ki tarteeb ke usool ke mutaabiq, Khalid bin Hizaam ka zikr Hakeem se pehle aana chahiye tha, aur Hisham bin Hakeem ka zikr dono ke baad, lekin maine inhein is jagah, Hakeem ke zikr mein, ikatthe kar diya hai, taake faayda uthaane wale ko samajhne mein aasaani ho."

e: [AI] Hassan ibn Thabit lived for sixty years during the pre-Islamic period and was known as Abu al-Walid. In Islam, he also lived for sixty years and he was Hassan ibn Thabit ibn al-Mundhir ibn Haram ibn Amr ibn Zaid Manah ibn Adi ibn Amr ibn Malik ibn al-Najjar. He was the poet of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his mother was Hassana al-Furai'ah bint Khalid ibn Khunays ibn Lawzan ibn Abd Wad. It is said that he passed away before the age of forty and it is also said that he passed away in the year fifty-five.
hi: "Hassaan bin Thabit Jaahiliyat mein saath (60) saal zinda rahe, aur unki kunniyat Abu Al-Waleed thi, aur Islam mein bhi saath (60) saal zinda rahe, aur woh Hassaan bin Thabit bin Al-Mundhir bin Haraam bin Amr bin Zaid Manaat bin Adi bin Amr bin Malik bin An-Najjaar (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke shaayar, the, aur Hassaan ki maa Al-Furai'ah bint Khalid bin Khunais bin Lauzaan bin Abd Wudd thin, kaha jaata hai ke unka intiqaal chalis (40) se pehle hua, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai ke unka intiqaal pachpan (55) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] "I came to Hassan, so I said, 'O father of Husam.'"
hi: "Main Hassaan (RA) ke paas aaya," to maine kaha: 'Aye Abu Al-Husaam.'

e: [AI] "I heard a Jew who was standing on the outskirts of Yathrib shouting, 'O people of the Jews!'. When they gathered around him, they said, 'What is wrong with you?' He replied, 'The star that is appointed to be sent tonight has risen.'"
hi: Maine aik Yahoodi ko suna jo Yathrib ke aik qile par khada ho kar chilla raha tha: "Aye Yahoodiyon ki jama'at." Jab woh jama ho gaye, to unhone kaha: "Tujhe kya hua?" Usne kaha: "Us (Nabi ke) bheje jaane ka sitara aaj raat nikal aaya hai."

e: [AI] "The Long Sea, and if a person seeks his worldly desires, he clings to it with the rope of arrogance."
hi: "Aur agar koi aadmi apni duniya ko chaahte huay talaash kare, to woh dhoke ki rassi se chimtne wale ki tarah hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to setup a pulpit in the mosque for Hassan who would stand on it and satirise those who spoke against the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say: The spirit of holiness (i.e. Gabriel) is with Hassan so long as he speaks in defence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5015)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Hassaan (RA) ke liye masjid mein aik mimbar rakhte, woh ispar khade hokar Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf se fakhr/jawaab dete." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) farmate the: "Beshak Allah Hassaan (RA) ki Roohul-Qudus (Jibreel) se madad karta hai jab tak woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf se jawaab dete ya fakhr karte rahen."

e: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 99)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se, isi tarah ki riwayat.

e: [AI] "The abundant sea, my father, mother, and my honor are offered for the honor of Muhammad from you and meeting." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "To beshak mera waalid, meri waalida, aur meri izzat Muhammad ki izzat ki hifaazat ke liye tumse dhaal hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] From it, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Hassaan ibn Thabit, "Indeed, the Holy Spirit is with you whenever you confront them."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Hassaan bin Thabit (RA) se farmaya: "Beshak Roohul-Qudus (Jibreel) tumhare sath hai jab tak tum unki hajw (bura-bhala) karte raho."

e: [AI] Hassan ibn Thabit sought permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to verbally attack the polytheists. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "But what about my relation with them?" Hassan replied, "I will ask you questions about them just as a strand of hair is separated from dough." (This narration is according to the stipulation of al-Bukhari and Muslim)
hi: Hassaan bin Thabit (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se mushrikeen ki hajw (bura-bhala) karne ki ijaazat maangi, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Phir mera nasab unme kaisa (bachega)?" To Hassaan (RA) ne kaha: "Main aapko unme se yun nikaal lunga jaise aata se baal nikaala jaata hai." Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Rawaha and Hassaan ibn Thabit came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when the verse "Ta Seen Meem" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara, verse 1] was revealed. When the Prophet ﷺ  recited the verses "And the poets, [only] the deviators follow them" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara, verse 224], Abdullah ibn Rawaha and Hassaan ibn Thabit wept. They continued crying until the verse "And they have done righteous deeds" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara, verse 227] was revealed. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "You are [mentioned] in it." Then the verse "And remember Allah often" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara, verse 227] was revealed. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "You are [mentioned] in it." Then the verse "And they supported them after they were wronged" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara, verse 227] was revealed. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "You are [mentioned] in it." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Beshak Abdullah bin Rawahah (RA) aur Hassaan bin Thabit (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye jab {Taa Seen Meem} [Surah Ash-Shu'ara 1] nazil hui, Ash-Shu'ara (shaayar), to woh rone lage, jabke aap (SAW) unhein padh kar sunaa rahe the: "{Aur shaayaron ki pairavi gumraah log karte hain}" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara 224], yahan tak ke aap (SAW) is tak pahunche: "{aur jo imaan laaye aur neik amal kiye}" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara 227], aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum (ismein shaamil ho)." "{aur Allah ko bohot yaad kiya}" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara 227], aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum." "{aur apne saath zulm honay ke baad badla liya}" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara 227], aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic text into English is as follows:

"It is reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was approached and told, 'O Messenger of Allah, Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith ibn 'Abdul-Muttalib is insulting you.' Then Ibn Rawaha stood up and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, allow me to deal with him.' The Prophet ﷺ  asked, 'Are you the one who says, "May Allah keep you firm"?' He replied, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.' Then the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'May Allah keep you firm in what He has granted you of goodness, just as He kept Musa firm and supported him, similar to how they were supported.' Ibn Rawaha replied, 'And may Allah do goodness to you in return.' [Sahih Al-Bukhari]"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya gaya, aap (SAW) se kaha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Abdul Muttalib aapki hajw karta hai." To Ibn Rawahah (RA) khade huay aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), mujhe ijaazat dein uske khilaaf." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya tum hi ho jo kehte ho 'Allah ne mazboot kiya'?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, maine kaha, Ya Rasulullah (SAW): {Allah ne wohi mazboot kiya jo usne aapko diya hai neki mein, jaisi Musa ki himmat ko mazboot kiya aur unhein waisi hi madad di jaisi unhein madad di gayi}." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur tumhein, Allah tumhare sath aisi hi bhalaai kare." Sahih.

e: [AI] "The spaciousness of the son of Nawfal ibn Ahyaab ibn Abd Manaf, and their hearts were connected."
hi: "Makhramah bin Nawfal bin Ahyab bin Abd Manaf (RA), aur woh 'Al-Mu'allafah Quloobuhum' (jinke dil Islam ki taraf jeete gaye) mein se the."

e: [AI] "Al-Makhrama bin Nawfal embraced Islam upon the conquest of Makkah. He was knowledgeable about the lineage and traditions of the Quraysh and had knowledge about the noble ancestry of the Holy Sanctuary. Makhrama had a son named Safwan, who was also known as Safwan al-Akbar, meaning Safwan the elder, as he was the eldest among his siblings."
hi: "Makhramah bin Nawfal (RA) ne Fatah-e-Makkah ke din Islam qubool kiya, aur woh Quraish ke nasab aur unke qisson ka bohot ilm rakhte the, aur unhein Haram ki hudood ki nishaaniyon ka bhi ilm tha, aur Makhramah ke bete Safwan (RA) the, aur unhi se unki kunniyat thi, aur woh unki sab aulaad mein sabse bade the."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Abdullah bin Bukayr saying: "Makhrama bin Nawfal is nicknamed Abu al-Miswar."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Abdullah bin Bukair ko kehte suna: "Makhramah bin Nawfal (RA) ki kunniyat Abu Al-Miswar thi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said to Abu, "O Abu Safwan."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mere waalid se farmaya: "Aye Abu Safwan."

e: [AI] "Makhrama bin Nawfal witnessed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  the day of Hunayn. So the Prophet gave him fifty camels from the spoils of Hunayn. Makhrama passed away in Medina in the year forty-five, and he died on the day when he was one hundred and fifteen years old."
hi: "Makhramah bin Nawfal (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain ke din shirkat ki, to aap (SAW) ne unhein Hunain ke maal-e-ghanimat mein se pachaas (50) oont diye, aur Makhramah (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah mein chauwan (54) hijri mein hua, aur jis din unka intiqaal hua, woh aik sau pandrah (115) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] I heard Sa'id ibn 'Uqbah say, "Makhrama ibn Nawfal al-Qurashi passed away at the age of 115. He embraced Islam on the day of the conquest, and he was among those whose hearts were united."
hi: Maine Sa'eed bin Uqbah ko kehte suna: "Makhramah bin Nawfal Al-Qurashi (RA) ka intiqaal hua jabke woh aik sau pandrah (115) saal ke thay, aur unhone Fatah ke din Islam qubool kiya tha, aur woh 'Al-Mu'allafah Quloobuhum' mein se the."

e: [AI] "He made me an orphan in his room, claiming that his strength is enough for him and that he doesn't need me. So Ibn al-Barssai al-Laythi said to him, "He is Abdur Rahman ibn Azhar," and he raised a stick in his hand and struck him, causing his cheek to bruise, and said, 'You have been hostile to us in the time of ignorance and envy us in Islam, and you have come between me and Ibn Azhar.'"
hi: "Abdur Rahman ne mujhe apni dekh-bhaal mein aik yateem jaisa bana diya, dawa karta hai ke uska apna rizq hi mere liye kaafi hai." To Ibn Al-Barsaa Al-Laithi ne usse kaha: "Yeh Abdur Rahman bin Azhar (RA) hain," to usne apne haath mein aik laathi uthaayi aur unhein maara, jisse unka sar zakhmi ho gaya, aur kaha: "Kya tum Jaahiliyat mein humare dushman the, aur Islam mein humse hasad karte ho, aur mere aur Ibn Al-Azhar ke darmiyan dakhil hote ho?"

e: [AI] This is not how it is recommended, like me saying and yee, it was a striking arrow, a strong father.
hi: "Mere jaise ke liye aise naseehat/nauha nahi hona chahiye, kaho: 'Haaye mere Abba!' Woh aik seedha nishaane par lagne wala teer the, woh aik mazboot hifaazat karne wale waalid the."

e: [AI] I visited the Prophet ﷺ  with some gifts, and he distributed them among his companions. Then my father said to me, "Come with me to him, for some gifts have reached him." My father spoke to the Prophet ﷺ  at the door, and the Prophet ﷺ  recognized his voice. So he came out with a garment, and repeating, he said, "I have stored this for you, I have stored this for you."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, aapke paas kuch qabaa (jubbe) the, to aap (SAW) ne unhein apne sahaba mein taqseem kiya, to mere waalid ne mujhse kaha: "Chalo humein unke paas, kyunke unke paas qabaa aaye hain." To mere waalid darwaze par bole, Nabi (SAW) ne unki aawaaz pehchaani, to aap (SAW) baahar nikle, unke sath aik qaba tha, aur farma rahe the: "Maine yeh tumhare liye chhupaa kar rakha tha, maine yeh tumhare liye chhupaa kar rakha tha."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  made Islam public, all the people of Makkah embraced Islam before the obligation of performing the prayer was revealed. They would recite the prostration verses but were unable to prostrate, until the leaders of the Quraysh, such as Al-Walid ibn Al-Mughirah and Abu Jahl ibn Hisham, arrived. They were in Ta'if, their territory. They said, "You are leaving the religion of your fathers and becoming disbelievers." Ya'qub ibn Sufyan said, "And we do not know any other narration from Makhrama ibn Nawfal except this one."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Islam zaahir kiya, to Makkah wale sab Musalman ho gaye, yeh namaz farz honay se pehle ki baat hai, yahan tak ke jab Sajdah wali aayat padhi jaati to woh sajda nahi kar paate, yahan tak ke Quraish ke sardaar, Al-Waleed bin Al-Mughirah, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, aur doosre, jo Taif mein apni zameenon mein the, wahan se aaye aur kehne lage: "Tum apne baap-dada ka deen chhod rahe ho," to logon ne kufr kiya. Ya'qoob bin Sufyan ne kaha: "Aur humein Makhramah bin Nawfal ki koi musnad hadith iske siwa maloom nahi."

e: [AI] Sa'id bin Yarbou' bin 'Unkatha bin 'Amir bin Makhzoum, also known as Abu Hood, embraced Islam on the day of the conquest of Mecca and witnessed the Battle of Hunayn alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  granted him fifty camels from the spoils of Hunayn.
hi: Sa'eed bin Yarbou' bin Ankathah bin Aamir bin Makhzoom (RA), jinki kunniyat Abu Hood thi, unhone Fatah-e-Makkah ke din Islam qubool kiya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath Hunain mein shirkat ki, "aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Hunain ke maal-e-ghanimat mein se pachaas (50) oont diye."

e: [AI] "Sa'eed, the son of Yarbo'a, the son of Aankathah, the son of Aamir, Al-Makhzumi, died in the year fifty-five, at the age of one hundred and eighteen years."
hi: "Sa'eed bin Yarbou' bin Ankathah bin Aamir Al-Makhzoomi (RA) ka intiqaal pachpan (55) hijri mein hua, jabke woh aik sau atthaarah (118) saal ke thay."

e: [AI] About Uruwah, who pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  at Al-Aqabah from the tribe of Banu Amr ibn Awadh, Abu Al-Yasar Ka'b ibn Amr ibn Abbad ibn Amr ibn Tameem ibn Sawwad ibn Ghanim ibn Ka'b ibn Salamah from the people of Badr. He witnessed the pledge of Al-Aqabah and he was the one who hid Al-Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib.
hi: Urwah se, un logon mein jinhone Aqabah mein Rasulullah (SAW) se baiyat ki, Banu Amr bin Sawaadah se: "Abu Al-Yasar Ka'b bin Amr bin Abbaad bin Amr bin Tameem bin Sawwaad bin Ghanm bin Ka'b bin Salamah (RA), Ahl-e-Badr mein se, unhone Aqabah mein shirkat ki, aur yehi hain jinhone Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) ko Badr mein qaidi banaaya."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya bin Ma'in say, "Abu Al-Yasar Ka'ab ibn Amr passed away in the year fifty-five in Medina, and he was the last survivor of the Battle of Badr."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'een ko kehte suna: "Abu Al-Yasar Ka'b bin Amr (RA) ka intiqaal pachpan (55) hijri mein Madinah mein hua, aur woh Ahl-e-Badr mein se sabse aakhir mein wafaat paane wale the."

e: [AI] "Abu Al-Yasar, Ka'ab bin Amr bin Abbadi bin Amr bin Sawwad bin Ghanim bin Ka'ab bin Salamah bin Sa'd bin Ghanim bin Asad bin Jusham bin Al-Khazraj died in the year fifty-five in Medina."
hi: "Abu Al-Yasar Ka'b bin Amr bin Abbaad bin Amr bin Sawwaad bin Ghanm bin Ka'b bin Salamah bin Sa'd bin Ghanm bin Asad bin Jusham bin Al-Khazraj (RA) ka intiqaal pachpan (55) hijri mein Madinah mein hua."

e: [AI] Abu Al-Yasar Ka'ab bin Amr bin Abbadi bin Amr bin Sawwad bin Ghanim bin Ka'b bin Salamah bin Ghanim bin Asad bin Jusham bin Al-Khazraj.
hi: "Abu Al-Yasar Ka'b bin Amr bin Abbaad bin Amr bin Sawwaad bin Ghanm bin Ka'b bin Salamah bin Ghanm bin Asad bin Jusham bin Al-Khazraj (RA)."

e: [AI] And forty thousand dinars for a man who has four children.
hi: Aur chalis hazaar (40,000) dinar aise aadmi ke liye kya hain jiske chaar afraad ka kunba ho?

e: [AI] "We were sitting one day in the courtyard of the Kaaba during the pre-Islamic era, when a woman came seeking refuge at the Kaaba from her husband. Her husband arrived and reached out his hand towards her, but his hand became paralyzed. I witnessed this incident during the time of Islam, and indeed he was handicapped." (Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in summarizing)
hi: "Hum Jaahiliyat mein aik din Ka'bah ke sehn mein baithe the ke aik aurat apne shohar se Ka'bah ki panaah maangti hui aayi, to uska shohar aaya aur usne apna haath uski taraf badhaaya, to uska haath sookh gaya, aur maine use Islam ke daur mein dekha ke woh sach mein falij (sookhe haath wala) tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "So Marwan informed him and said to him, 'Your conversion to Islam has been delayed, O Sheikh, until events have surpassed you.' Huwaytib replied, 'By Allah, I have been determined to convert to Islam more than once, but your father prevents me and dissuades me. He says that it would bring shame to your people and the religion of your forefathers to follow a new religion and become a follower. So Marwan remained silent and regretted what he had said to him, and then Huwaytib said, 'Didn't Uthman inform you about what your father encountered when he converted?' Marwan became even more distressed, and Huwaytib said, 'There was no one in Quraysh from their prominent figures who remained steadfast in their religion until Mecca was conquered. I disliked what happened to me with its conquest, but it was predestined. I witnessed the Battle of Badr with the polytheists and saw the angels killing and capturing between the heavens and the earth. So I said, 'This is a prohibited man.' And when what I witnessed was mentioned, we were defeated and returned to Mecca. We settled in Mecca, and Quraysh used to surrender one man after another to Muhammad. And when the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was written, I was the last witness, and I said, 'You will not see anything from Quraysh except what is displeasing. I have accepted it if they defend it with their weapons.' And when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived for 'Umrah al-Qada' and Quraysh left Mecca, I stayed behind in Mecca with Suhayl ibn 'Amr, so that we could prevent the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from leaving when the time comes. And when the three days were completed, I approached Suhayl ibn 'Amr and said, 'Your condition has been fulfilled, so leave our city.' He shouted, 'O Bilal, do not let the sun set while there is still one Muslim in Mecca who came with us.'"
hi: To usne (Huwaitib ne) use bataya, to Marwan ne unse kaha: "Aye shaikh, aapka Islam der se hua yahan tak ke naujawaan aapse aage nikal gaye." Huwaitib (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maine kayi baar Islam ka iraada kiya, har baar aapke waalid ne mujhe usse roka aur mana kiya, aur kehte: kya tum apni qaum ki izzat aur apne baap-dada ka deen aik naye deen ke liye chhod doge aur uske pairokaar ban jaaoge?" Unhone kaha: to Marwan khaamosh ho gaye aur jo unse kaha tha uspar sharminda huay. Phir Huwaitib (RA) ne kaha: "Kya Uthman (RA) ne aapko nahi bataaya ke jab unhone Islam qubool kiya to aapke waalid se unhein kya kuch jhelna pada?" To Marwan ka gham aur badh gaya. Phir Huwaitib ne kaha: "Quraish ke un buzurgon mein se jo apni qaum ke deen par Makkah ki fatah tak qaayam rahe, mujhse zyada kisi ko us fatah se napasandeedgi nahi thi, lekin taqdeeren (aisi hi hoti hain). Maine Badr mein mushrikeen ke sath shirkat ki, to maine hairat-angez baat dekhi, maine farishton ko aasman aur zameen ke darmiyan qatl aur qaid karte dekha, to maine kaha: yeh aadmi (Muhammad SAW) mahfooz hai. Phir jab (jo maine dekha tha) uska zikr hua, to Uhud (ka waaqia hua) aur hum shikast khaakar Makkah laut aaye, hum Makkah mein thehre rahe aur Quraish aik-aik karke Islam laati rahi. Phir jab Hudaibiyah ka din aaya, to main haazir tha, maine sulah ka mushahida kiya aur uske liye chala yahan tak ke woh mukammal ho gaya, aur is sab se Islam badhta jaata tha, aur Allah, buzurg aur buland, wohi chaahta hai jo woh chaahe. Jab humne Sulah-e-Hudaibiyah likha, to main uske gawaahon mein sabse aakhir mein tha, aur maine kaha: Quraish ko Muhammad se sirf woh cheez milegi jo unhein bure lage, woh to is baat se raazi hain agar unhein nezon se door kar dein. Aur jab Rasulullah (SAW) Umrat-ul-Qazaa ke liye aaye aur Quraish Makkah se nikal gaye, to main unme tha jo Makkah mein peeche rahe, main aur Suhail bin Amr (RA), taake jab muddat khatam ho to Rasulullah (SAW) ko (Makkah se) nikaal dein. Jab teen din poore huay, to main aur Suhail bin Amr aaye aur humne kaha: aapki shart poori ho gayi, humare shehar se nikal jaayein. To aap (SAW) ne pukaara: 'Aye Bilal, suraj doobne na paaye jabke humare sath aaye huay koi Musalman Makkah mein ho.'"

e: [AI] "Abu Shajara, Yazid bin Shajara al-Rahawi, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , died in the year fifty-eight in Rome."
hi: "Abu Shajarah Yazid bin Shajarah Ar-Rahaawi (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi, ka intiqaal Rome ki zameen mein atthaavan (58) hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Swords are the keys to Paradise." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Talwaaren Jannat ki kunjiyaan hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] O people, remember the blessings of Allah upon you. If you could see what I see - colors of black, red, green, and white, and in the horizons, things that, when prayers are established, the doors of the heavens, gates of Paradise, and gates of hell are opened, and the houris beautify themselves and come forth. Then, when someone advances towards battle, they say, "O Allah, make him steadfast!" And when he retreats, they say, "O Allah, forgive him, O Allah, have mercy on him." So, they strike the faces of people for your sake, O my father and mother, for when one advances, the first drop of his blood erases his sins as the leaves of a tree shed. Two houris descend to him, wipe away the dust from his face, and say to him, "We belong to you." He is then clothed in a hundred robes, which, if it were to be cut in half, could cover the distance between his index and middle finger. It is not woven by the offspring of Adam, but rather from the apparel of Paradise. Indeed, you are written with Allah in your names, appearances, adornments, intimate thoughts, and gatherings. So, on the Day of Resurrection, it will be said, "O so-and-so, this is your light." And to another, "You have no light." And indeed, Hell has a bank like the bank of the sea, filled with serpents, creatures like palm trees, and scorpions like mules. When the people of Hell seek relief, they will be told, "Go to the bank." They will come out, and the serpents will grab their lips and faces. Then, Allah will unveil them and they will seek refuge by escaping from it to the Fire. Then, scabies will be unleashed upon them, causing a person's skin to peel until their bones are exposed. One of them will ask, "O so-and-so, does this hurt you?" He will answer, "Yes." Then it will be said, "This is because of how you used to harm the believers."
hi: "Aye logo, Allah ki ne'mat ko yaad karo jo tumpar hai, agar tum woh dekh sakte jo main dekh raha houn, kaale, laal, hare aur safed (libaas), aur kajaawon mein jo kuch hai, beshak jab namaz ki iqaamat hoti hai, to aasman ke darwaaze, Jannat ke darwaaze aur Jahannam ke darwaaze khol diye jaate hain, hoorein sajaayi jaati hain aur jhaankti hain, to jab unme se koi (mujahid) apna chehra jung ki taraf karta hai, to woh kehti hain: Aye Allah, ise saabit-qadam rakh, Aye Allah, iski madad kar, aur jab woh peeth pherta hai to woh usse parda kar leti hain aur kehti hain: Aye Allah, ise maaf kar, Aye Allah, ispar reham kar. To qaum ke chehron par zor se hamla karo, mere maa-baap tum par qurbaan hon, kyunke jab tum mein se koi aage badhta hai, to uske khoon ka pehla qatra uske gunaahon ko aise jhaad deta hai jaise darakht ke patte jhadte hain, aur do badi aankhon wali hoorein uske paas utarti hain, uske chehre se gard poonchti hain, to woh unse kehta hai: main tumhara houn, aur woh kehti hain: hum tumhari hain, aur use sau (100) joden pehnaayi jaati hain, agar unhein meri in do ungliyon, shahaadat ki ungli aur beech ki ungli, ke darmiyan ghumaaya jaaye to woh unme sama jaayein, woh Aadam ki aulaad ki bunaai hui nahi hain balke Jannat ke kapde hain. Beshak tum Allah ke paas apne naamon, apni nishaaniyon, apni sajaawat, apni sarghoshiyon aur apni majlison ke sath likhe huay ho, to jab Qayamat ka din hoga, to kaha jaayega: Aye fulaan, yeh tumhara noor hai, aur Aye fulaan, tumhare liye koi noor nahi. Aur Jahannam ka aik saahil hai samandar ke saahil ki tarah, usme keede-makode aur khajoor ke darakhton jaise saanp aur khachchron jaise bichhoo hain, jab Jahannam walay faryaad karenge ke unka azaab halka kiya jaaye, to kaha jaayega: saahil ki taraf niklo, to woh niklenge, to keede-makode unke honton aur chehron ko pakad lenge aur jo Allah chaahe, phir (Allah) unhein hata dega, to woh unse bhaag kar phir Aag ki taraf faryaad karenge, aur unpar khujli musallat ki jaayegi, to aik apni khaal itni khujaayega ke haddi zaahir ho jaayegi, to unme se koi kahega: Aye fulaan, kya yeh tumhein takleef deti hai? Woh kahega: haan. To kaha jaayega: yeh isliye ke tum momineen ko takleef diya karte the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] It is believed that he died in Egypt, while others say he died in the city, in the year sixty. He witnessed the Battle of Uhud and all its scenes. In it, Hassaan ibn Thabit says, "Look! This is my maternal uncle, I brag about him. Let every man show me his maternal uncle."
hi: Ma'n, kaha jaata hai unka intiqaal Misr mein hua, aur yeh bhi kaha jaata hai Madinah mein saath (60) hijri mein, unhone Uhud aur tamaam maidaanon mein shirkat ki, aur unke baare mein Hassaan bin Thabit (RA) ne kaha (bahr Al-Mutaqaarib mein): "Dekho, yeh mere maamu hain, main inpar fakhr karta houn, to har aadmi mujhe apna maamu dikhaaye."

e: [AI] I heard Mujahid say, "I have prayed behind Maslamah ibn Makhlad in Egypt and he recited Al-Baqarah, not omitting a single letter."
hi: Maine Mujahid ko kehte suna: maine Maslamah bin Makhlad (RA) ke peeche Misr mein namaz padhi, to unhone Surah Al-Baqarah padhi aur usme se aik waaw ya alif bhi nahi chhoda.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  was born when he was ten years old."
hi: "Beshak Nabi (SAW) paida huay jabke woh das (10) saal ke the" (yeh jumla matan mein is tarah adhoora/mushtabah hai).

e: [AI] "He came to the Prophet ﷺ  and asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, who am I?' The Prophet replied, 'You are Sa'd ibn Malik ibn Ahya ibn Abd Manaf ibn Zuhrah.' The person asked, 'What about the others?' The Prophet said, 'As for them, Allah's curse be upon them.'"
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main kaun houn?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum Sa'd bin Malik bin Uhaib bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah (RA) ho." Phir (kisi ne) poocha: "Aur jo iske siwa (kuch aur) kahe?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uspar Allah ki laanat ho."

e: [AI] "Saad bin Abi Waqqas was entrusted by Umar and Uthman in Kufa. His mother was Hamna bint Abi Sufyan, daughter of Umayyah bin Abdd Shams bin Abd Manaf."
hi: "Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ko Umar aur Uthman ne Kufa ka gawarnar banaya, unki maa Hamnah bint Abi Sufyan bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams bin Abd Manaf thin."

e: [AI] "The age of Saad, "O Abu Ishaq""
hi: Umar (RA) ne Sa'd se kaha: "Aye Abu Ishaq."

e: [AI] "I heard that Saad bin Abi Waqas, Umair, Aamir, Uqbah, are brothers and Abu Waqas is the son of Malik bin Ahyyab bin Abdul Manaf bin Al-Harith bin Zuhrah."
hi: "Maine suna hai ke Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA), Umair (RA), Aamir (RA) aur Uqbah (RA) bhai the, aur Abu Waqqas, Malik bin Uhaib bin Abd Manaf bin Al-Harith bin Zuhrah the."

e: [AI] Saad bin Abi Waqas passed away during the time of Muawiyah after his first pilgrimage, when he was eighty-three years old.
hi: "Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ka intiqaal Mu'awiyah ke daur mein, unke pehle Hajj ke baad, hua, jabke woh tirasi (83) saal ke the."

e: [AI] "Abu Ishaq Saad bin Abi Waqas died at the age of seventy five in Medina, and Marwan bin Al-Hakam, the governor of Medina at the time, led the funeral prayer for him."
hi: "Abu Ishaq Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah mein pachattar (75) saal ki umr mein hua, aur unki namaz-e-janaza Marwan bin Al-Hakam ne padhayi jo us waqt wahan ke gawarnar the."

e: [AI] "My father was the last of the immigrants to pass away."
hi: "Mere waalid Muhajireen mein sabse aakhir mein wafaat paane wale the."

e: [AI] "My father was a short, stout, and stern man with thick eyebrows and was nicknamed Abu Ishaq. He passed away in his palace in Al-Aqiq, ten miles away from the city. He was carried to the city on the backs of men."
hi: "Mere waalid chhote qad ke, motay, bhaari-bharkam, bade sar wale, mote ungliyon wale aadmi the, aur unki kunniyat Abu Ishaq thi, unka intiqaal Al-Aqeeq mein apne mahal mein hua jo Madinah se das (10) meel ke faasle par tha, to unhein mardon ki gardanon par Madinah laaya gaya."

e: [AI] Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib narrated that Sa'd used to dye his beard with black.
hi: Sa'eed bin Al-Musayyib se: Sa'd (RA) "kaale rang se khizaab lagaate the." Iski sanad bohot kamzor hai.

e: [AI] "Bury me in it, for indeed I met the polytheists in it on the day of Badr, and I only kept it hidden for this day."
hi: "Mujhe isi (chogha/chaadar) mein kafan dena, kyunke maine Badr ke din mushrikeen se isi mein muqaabla kiya tha, aur maine ise isi din ke liye chhupa kar rakha tha."

e: [AI] Saad ibn Abi Waqqas was the last of the emigrants to pass away.
hi: "Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) Muhajireen mein sabse aakhir mein wafaat paane wale the."

e: [AI] Saad ibn Abi Waqqas, one of the last immigrants, died.
hi: "Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) Muhajireen mein sabse aakhir mein wafaat paane wale the."

e: [AI] "Abu Abdullah said, 'Saad embraced Islam when he was nineteen years old.'"
hi: Abu Abdullah ne kaha: "Sa'd (RA) ne Islam qubool kiya jabke woh unnees (19) saal ke the."

e: [AI] "Um Saad and the mother of his brothers, Umair and Aamir, were Hamna bint Abi Sufyan bin Umayya bin Abd Shams. Umair was martyred in the Battle of Badr, while Aamir was among the immigrants to Abyssinia. Aamir used to dye himself black, meaning he dyed his hair with black color, like Saad."
hi: "Sa'd (RA) ki maa aur unke do bhaiyon Umair (RA) aur Aamir (RA) ki maa Hamnah bint Abi Sufyan bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams (RA) thin, Umair Badr mein shaheed huay, aur Aamir Habsha ki taraf hijrat karne walon mein se the, aur Sa'd (RA) kaale rang ka khizaab lagaate the."

e: [AI] "My father, Saad, passed away ten miles away from the city, so he was carried on the backs of men to the city. And Marwan was the governor of the city at that time."
hi: Mere waalid Sa'd (RA) ka intiqaal Madinah se das (10) meel ke faasle par hua, to unhein mardon ki gardanon par Madinah laaya gaya, aur us din Marwan wahan ka gawarnar tha.

e: [AI] Saad ibn Abi Waqqas had a son named Omar ibn Saad, who was killed by Mukhtar ibn Abi Ubaid and Muhammad ibn Saad, who was killed by Hajjaj ibn Yusuf. They were among the captured companions of Abdul Rahman ibn Muhammad ibn al-Ash'ath. Their mother is Mariyah bint Qais ibn Madi Karb from Kindah. Other sons of Saad are Amer ibn Saad and his mother is Bahra'a, and Salih ibn Saad. He stayed in Hira for some time and conflicts arose between him and his brother Omar ibn Saad. His mother is Khawla bint Umayr ibn Taghlib ibn Wail. Ibrahim ibn Saad, Ishaq ibn Saad, Yahya ibn Saad, and Aisha bint Saad are also his children.
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ki aulaad: Umar bin Sa'd, jinhein Al-Mukhtaar bin Abi Ubaid ne qatl kiya, aur Muhammad bin Sa'd, jinhein Al-Hajjaj bin Yusuf ne qatl kiya, aur woh Abdur Rahman bin Muhammad bin Al-Ash'ath ke saathiyon mein se the jo qaid kiye gaye the, aur dono ki maa Maariyah bint Qais bin Ma'dikarib, Kindah se, thin. Aur Aamir bin Sa'd, jinki maa Bahraa thin. Aur Saalih bin Sa'd, jo Al-Hirah mein is wajah se jaa kar thehre ke unke aur unke bhai Umar bin Sa'd ke darmiyan koi baat ho gayi thi, aur unki maa Khaulah bint Umair bin Taghlib bin Waa'il thin. Aur Ibrahim bin Sa'd, Ishaq bin Sa'd, Yahya bin Sa'd, aur Aisha bint Sa'd.

e: [AI] Ibrahim "They were born in the same year."
hi: Ibrahim ne kaha: "Woh sab aik hi saal mein paida huay the."

e: [AI] "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Al-Dhahabi remained silent when summarizing."
hi: ...Rasulullah (SAW) se. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "To tell you a story that will increase you by a hundred."
hi: ...ke main tumhein aisi hadith bayan karoon jismein tum sau (100) ka izaafa karo.

e: [AI] About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , except for one hadith, Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing it.
hi: ...Rasulullah (SAW) se, siwaye aik hadith ke. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I embraced Islam the day I embraced it, and Allah did not make prayer obligatory."
hi: "Maine Islam us din qubool kiya jis din kiya, aur Allah ne abhi namaz farz nahi ki thi."

e: [AI] "He said, 'O abundant sea! Should I not inform the Messenger of Allah that I have protected my companions with my noble chest, I repel their enemies with it, and defend them with every grievous incident and every gentle breeze? No attacker can approach them with an arrow before it reaches the Messenger of Allah through me.'"
hi: Unhone kaha (bahr Al-Waafir mein): "Suno, Rasulullah (SAW) ko khabar de do ke maine apne saathiyon ki hifaazat apne teeron ki nokon se ki hai, main usse unke dushman ko har sakht aur har naram zameen par door haankta houn, to Ma'ad ka koi teer-andaaz Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath teer chalane mein mujhse pehle nahi ginaa jaata."

e: [AI] We were sitting with the Prophet ﷺ , then Saad ibn Abi Waqqas approached and the Prophet ﷺ  said, "This is my maternal uncle, so let a man show me his maternal uncle"
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas baithe the ke Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) aaye, to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh mere maamu hain, to har aadmi mujhe apna maamu dikhaaye."

e: [AI] "That Saad ibn Abi Waqqas was the first to shed blood in the cause of Allah."
hi: "Beshak Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) sabse pehle shakhs the jinhone Allah ki raah mein khoon bahaaya."

e: [AI] "The first one to throw an arrow in the path of Allah is Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas."
hi: "Allah ki raah mein sabse pehle teer chalane wale Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) hain."

e: [AI] I have seen myself as one-third of Islam.
hi: "Maine khud ko dekha ke main Islam ka tihaai hissa tha."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  sat in the mosque for three nights saying, "O Allah, admit through this door a servant who loves You and whom You love." Then, Saad entered from that door.
hi: Beshak Nabi (SAW) teen raatein masjid mein baithe, farmate rahe: "Aye Allah, is darwaaze se aisay bande ko dakhil kar jo tujhse mohabbat karta ho aur tu usse mohabbat karta ho," to is (darwaaze) se Sa'd (RA) dakhil huay.

e: [AI] To me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Allah, respond to him when he calls upon You."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aye Allah, jab yeh tujhse dua kare to uski dua qubool kar."

e: [AI] Saad ibn Abi Waqqas said, "I am the son of Mustajab ad-Du'a (one whose supplications are answered) and the leader of the Thalmah tribe among the Arabs. I am entrusted with the flag for the Prophet Muhammad, and with it, I march in his honor. Allah has favored me with this position over all others. The people differed among themselves, but I refused to fight against the people of Tawhid (belief in the oneness of Allah) and the books (scriptures). Allah protected me, and not a single person from them was harmed by an arrow, nor were they harmed."
hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ne kaha (bahr Al-Kaamil mein): "Main mustajaab-ud-dua (jiski dua qubool hoti hai) ka beta houn, aur Arab mein se Mustafa (SAW) ke liye (hifazat ki) daraar ko bharne wala, jo Nabi (SAW) ke liye ajr ki niyat se uski nigahbaani karta raha, aur is sharaf mein sab ajr talab karne walon mein se akela khaas kiya gaya. Aur logon ne aapas mein ikhtilaaf kiya, to usne ahl-e-tauheed aur ahl-e-kitaab se qitaal karne se inkaar kiya, Allah ne use salaamat rakha, to unme se kisi ko us waqt teer nahi laga aur na hi (usse kisi ko) laga."

e: [AI] From it (or him) Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: Unke baare mein, Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein (khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya).

e: [AI] "Why do you insult Ali ibn Abi Talib? Wasn't he the first to embrace Islam? Wasn't he the first to pray with the Messenger of Allah? Wasn't he the most ascetic of people? Wasn't he the most knowledgeable of people?" He continued, saying, "Wasn't he the one whom the Messenger of Allah circumcised his daughter? Wasn't he the companion of the Messenger of Allah in his expeditions?" Then he turned towards the Qibla and raised his hands and said, "O Allah, this person insults one of Your close allies, so do not disperse this gathering until You show them Your power." Qays said, "By Allah, we did not disperse until his beast screamed and threw him upon his forehead in those rocks, and his brain split and he died."
hi: "Aye shakhs, tum Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ko kyun bura-bhala kehte ho? Kya woh sabse pehle Islam laane wale nahi the? Kya woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke sath sabse pehle namaz padhne wale nahi the? Kya woh logon mein sabse zyada zaahid nahi the? Kya woh logon mein sabse zyada ilm wale nahi the?" Aur (isi tarah) zikr karte rahe yahan tak ke kaha: "Kya woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke damaad nahi the unki beti ke zariye? Kya woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki jangon mein unke jhande ke saath wale nahi the?" Phir qibla ki taraf rukh kiya, apne haath uthaaye aur kaha: "Aye Allah, yeh shakhs tere dostoon mein se aik dost ko bura-bhala kehta hai, to is jama'at ko tab tak mutafarriq na kar jab tak inhein apni qudrat na dikha de." Qais ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, hum bikhre bhi nahi the ke uski sawaari usko lekar zameen mein dhans gayi, to usne use uske sar ke bal in patthron par phenk diya, uska dimagh phat gaya aur woh mar gaya."

e: [AI] To me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Allah, guide his aim and answer his supplication."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Aye Allah, iske teer ko nishane par laga aur iski dua qubool kar."

e: [AI] I was sitting with Saad when a man named Al-Harith ibn Barssaa came to him in the market. Saad said to him, "O Abu Ishaq, I was present with Marwan and I heard him saying, 'This wealth is ours to give as we please.'" Saad then raised his hand and said, "Shall I call him?" Marwan got up from his bed and embraced Saad, saying, "I urge you, O Abu Ishaq, to make supplication, for this is indeed Allah's wealth."
hi: Main Sa'd (RA) ke paas baitha tha ke aik aadmi, jise Al-Harith bin Barsaa kaha jaata tha, baazaar mein unke paas aaya aur unse kaha: "Aye Abu Ishaq, main abhi Marwan ke paas tha, maine unhein yeh kehte suna ke yeh maal humara hai, hum jise chahen dein." Unhone kaha: to Sa'd ne apna haath uthaaya aur kaha: "To kya main dua karoon?" To Marwan apne takht par se kood kar uthe aur unse lipat gaye aur kaha: "Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta houn, Aye Abu Ishaq, ke aap dua na karein, yeh to Allah ka maal hai."

e: [AI] Indeed, the wealth of Allah is His, He gives it to whom He wills and withholds it from whom He wills. So he said to him, "Did you hear him say that?" He replied, "Yes." Sa'id then took the hands of Sa'd and Al-Harith and they went to Marwan. Sa'id said, "O Marwan, you claim that the wealth of Allah is yours, and you give it to whomever you wish and withold it from whomever you wish?" Marwan replied, "Yes." Sa'id then said, "Then I call upon Allah" and raised his hands. Marwan quickly approached him and said, "I adjure you by Allah to not call upon Him. His wealth is His, He gives it to whom He wills and withholds it from whom He wills."
hi: ...ke Allah ka maal usi ka hai, jise chaahe de aur jise chaahe na de. To Sa'd (RA) ne usse kaha: "Kya tumne unhein yeh kehte suna?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Sa'eed ne kaha: to Sa'd ne mera haath pakda aur Al-Harith ka haath pakda yahan tak ke Marwan ke paas dakhil huay, to kaha: "Aye Marwan, tum yeh dawa karte ho ke Allah ka maal tumhara hai, jise chaaho do aur jise chaaho na do?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Sa'd ne kaha: "To main dua karta houn," aur apne dono haath uthaaye, to Marwan unki taraf lapke aur kaha: "Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta houn ke aap dua na karein, yeh Allah ka maal hai, jise chaahe de aur jise chaahe na de."

e: Were there a pious person from amongst my companions who should keep a watch for me during the nightt? She said: We heard the noise of arms, whereupon Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Who is it? And Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas said: Allah's MesseDger. I have come to serve as your sentinel. 'A'isha said: Allah' s Messenger ﷺ slept (such a sound sleep) that I heard the noise of his snoring. (Using translation from Muslim 2410a)
hi: Aik raat Rasulullah (SAW) ko neend na aayi, to farmaya: "Kaash mere sahaba mein se koi aadmi aaj raat meri pehredaari kare." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: to humne hathiyaaron ki aawaaz suni, Rasulullah (SAW) ne poocha: "Kaun hai?" To Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ne kaha: "Main hun, Ya Rasulullah (SAW), main aapki pehredaari ke liye aaya houn." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: to Rasulullah (SAW) so gaye yahan tak ke maine unke khurraate ki aawaaz suni.

e: [AI] "When the first trials came upon me, they appeared confusing to me, so I said, 'O Allah, show me the truth and guide me to cling onto it.' Then I saw in a vision what a sleeping person sees, both the worldly life and the hereafter, with a wall that was not tall between them. So I said, 'If only I could climb this wall to see my brave martyrs and ask them.' They replied, 'We are the angels.' I asked, 'Where are the martyrs?' They replied, 'Go up the steps.' So I ascended a step, and Allah knows best about its beauty and vastness. Then I saw Muhammad ﷺ  and Ibrahim ﷺ , who said to Ibrahim, 'Seek forgiveness for my ummah,' and Ibrahim replied, 'You do not know what they have done after you, how they spilled their own blood and killed their imam. Why don't they do as Sa'd (ibn Abi Waqqas) has done?' So I said, 'By Allah, I have seen a dream that Allah may benefit me with it. I will go and see Sa'd and be with him.' So I went to Sa'd and narrated the story to him. He said, 'How delighted I am with this! Indeed, those who are not like Ibrahim have failed.' I asked, 'Which of the two groups are you with?' He replied, 'I am not with either of them.' I asked, 'What do you command me?' He said, 'Do you have any sheep?' I replied, 'No.' He said, 'Then buy a sheep and stay with it until your situation becomes clear."
hi: Jab pehli fitna aayi, to mujh par maamla mushtabah ho gaya, to maine kaha: "Aye Allah, mujhe haq ka koi aisa maamla dikha jise main thaam loon." To mujhe khwaab mein, jaisa sone wala dekhta hai, duniya aur aakhirat dikhaayi gayi, aur dono ke darmiyan aik zyada oonchi nahi deewar thi aur main uske neeche tha, to maine kaha: "Agar main is deewar par chadh jaun taake Ashja' ke maqtoolon ko dekhoon to woh mujhe (haal) bata denge." Unhone kaha: to mujhe aik darakhton wali zameen par utaara gaya, wahan kuch log baithe the, maine kaha: "Kya tum shuhada ho?" Unhone kaha: "Hum farishtay hain." Maine poocha: "To shuhada kahan hain?" Unhone kaha: "Darajaat ki taraf aage badho." To main aik darje par chadha jiski khoobsurati aur wus'at Allah hi behtar jaanta hai, achaanak main Muhammad (SAW) ke paas tha aur Ibrahim (AS), jo buzurg the, (wahan the), aur aap (SAW) Ibrahim (AS) se keh rahe the: "Meri Ummat ke liye maghfirat maango," aur Ibrahim (AS) keh rahe the: "Aap nahi jaante ke unhone aapke baad kya naye kaam kiye, unhone apna khoon bahaaya aur apne imam ko qatl kiya, to unhone Sa'd (RA), mere khaleel, jaisa kyun nahi kiya?" To maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maine aisa khwaab dekha hai jisse shayad Allah mujhe faayda de, main jaakar Sa'd (RA) ki jagah dekhta houn aur unke sath rahunga." To main Sa'd ke paas aaya aur unhein poora qissa sunaaya, unhone kaha: to woh isse bohot khush huay aur kaha: "Yaqeenan woh nakaam hua jiska khaleel Ibrahim (AS) na ho." Maine poocha: "Aap in dono giroho mein se kiske sath hain?" Unhone kaha: "Main in dono mein se kisi ke sath nahi houn." Maine poocha: "To aap mujhe kya hukum dete hain?" Unhone kaha: "Kya tumhare paas bakriyaan hain?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "To bakriyaan khareedo aur unhi mein rahoo yahan tak ke maamla saaf ho jaaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About Uruwah ibn al-Zubayr in naming those who participated in the Battle of Badr from the Quraysh then from the Banu Makhzum, Al-Arqam ibn Abi al-Arqam.
hi: Urwah bin Az-Zubair se, Quraish mein se phir Banu Makhzoom mein se Badr mein shirkat karne walon ke naamon mein: "Al-Arqam bin Abi Al-Arqam (RA)."

e: [AI] "And the makhzumites said, 'Umm Al-Arqam Ibn Abi Al-Arqam joined in marriage with Bint Hizyam from the descendants of Sahm Ibn 'Amr Ibn Hushaysh.'"
hi: Aur Banu Makhzoom ne kaha: "Al-Arqam bin Abi Al-Arqam (RA) ki maa Tumaazir bint Hidhyam thin, Banu Sahm bin Amr bin Husais se."

e: [AI] "He used to say, 'I am the son of Subu' al-Islam. My father embraced Islam on the seventh day, and his house was on As-Safa, which was the house where the Prophet ﷺ used to be in during the early days of Islam. He invited people to Islam there, and many embraced Islam in that house. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the night of Monday while there, 'O Allah, give honor to Islam through the two dearest men to You, either Umar ibn al-Khattab or Amr ibn Hisham.' The following morning, Umar ibn al-Khattab embraced Islam in the house of Arqam, and they left from there, glorifying and circumambulating the Kaaba openly. The house of Arqam was then known as the house of Islam, and Arqam gave it as charity to his son. I read a copy of the charity document in the house of Arqam, which began with 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. This is what Arqam decreed, his share of the Sadaqah. It was his right to have a portion of Safa, and it is a charity in its place in the Haram that cannot be sold or inherited.' Hisham ibn al-Aas and Fulan ibn Hisham's client testified to this. This house continued to function as a standing charity, with his children residing in it, leasing it, and benefitting from it, until the time of my father Ja'far bin Muhammad."
hi: Woh kaha karte the: "Main Islam ke saatven (hisse) ka beta houn, mere waalid saat (7) mein se saatven Musalman huay, aur unka ghar Safa par tha, aur yeh wohi ghar hai jismein Nabi (SAW) Islam ke shuru'aati daur mein rehte the, aur isi mein logon ko Islam ki taraf bulaate the, to isme bohot se log Musalman huay, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne isi ghar mein Somwaar ki raat farmaya: 'Aye Allah, Islam ko un do mehboob tareen aadmiyon ke zariye izzat de jo tujhe sabse zyada pasand hain, Umar bin Al-Khattab ya Amr bin Hisham.' To agli subah Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) subah-subah aaye aur Daar-e-Arqam mein Islam qubool kiya, aur woh sab wahan se nikle, takbeer kahi aur khulle-aam Baitullah ka tawaaf kiya, aur Daar-e-Arqam ko 'Daar-ul-Islam' kaha jaane laga, aur Al-Arqam (RA) ne use apni aulaad par sadqa kar diya. Maine Al-Arqam ke sadqe ki naql padhi: 'Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem, yeh woh hai jiska Al-Arqam ne apne ghar ke baare mein faisla kiya, jo Safa ke paas hai, ke yeh Haram mein apni jagah par sadqa hai, na bechi jaayegi na wirsa mein jaayegi, gawaah Hisham bin Al-Aas (RA) aur fulaan, Hisham bin Al-Aas ke aazaad kiye huay ghulam.' Unhone kaha: to yeh ghar sadqe ke taur par qaayam raha, unki aulaad usme rehti rahi, kiraye par deti rahi aur uski aamdani leti rahi yahan tak ke Abu Ja'far ka zamaana aaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] "About his grandfather Al-Arqam, who was from the Badriyyun (early Muslims) and was a companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He bestowed his house in the vicinity of As-Safa as a shelter for the Muslims until they reached a count of forty Muslim men, with the last of them to embrace Islam being Umar ibn Al-Khattab.

When they reached forty, they went out to the polytheists, and Al-Arqam said, 'I went to bid farewell to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and I intended to go to Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem).' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked me, 'Where do you intend to go?' I replied, 'Bayt al-Maqdis.' He then asked, 'Are you going there for trade?' I replied, 'No, but to pray there.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'A prayer there is equivalent to a thousand prayers elsewhere.'
hi: Apne dada Al-Arqam (RA) se, jo Badri the: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne ghar mein, Safa ke paas, panaah li yahan tak ke chalis (40) Musalman aadmi poore ho gaye, aur sabse aakhir mein Islam laane wale Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) the, jab woh chalis ho gaye, to woh mushrikeen ke saamne nikle. Al-Arqam ne kaha: main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas alvida kehne aaya, aur main Bait Al-Maqdis jaana chahta tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse poocha: "Kahan ka iraada hai?" Maine kaha: "Bait Al-Maqdis." Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Tumhein wahan kis cheez ne nikaala? Kya tijaarat ke liye?" Maine kaha: "Nahi, balke main usme namaz padhna chahta houn." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yahan aik namaz wahan ki hazaar namazon se behtar hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of Badr, "Put down whatever heavy objects you have with you." Abu Usayd Al-Saidi raised the sword of Ibn Aaith Al-Marzubani and Arqam ibn Abi Arqam recognized it and said, "Give it to me, O Messenger of Allah." So he gave it to him.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din farmaya: "Jo bojh/saamaan tumhare paas hai woh rakh do." To Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi (RA) ne Ibn Aa'idh Al-Marzubaan ki talwaar utha li, to Al-Arqam bin Abi Al-Arqam (RA) ne use pehchaan liya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah (SAW), yeh mujhe de dein," to aap (SAW) ne woh unhein de di.

e: [AI] On the authority of his father, Al-Arqam, who was one of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Verily, the one who breaks the line of people on the day of Jumu'ah (Friday) and creates divisions among them is like one who has kindled a fire." (Reported by Hisham bin Ziyad)
hi: Apne waalid Al-Arqam (RA) se, jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak jo Jumu'a ke din logon ki gardanein phalaangta hai aur unke darmiyan juda karta hai, woh aise hai jaise Aag mein apni aanten ghaseet raha ho." Hisham bin Ziyad bohot kamzor hain.

e: [AI] I heard Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali say, "Abu al-Yasar al-Ansari, his name is Ka'ab ibn Amr ibn Abbād ibn Amr ibn Tameem ibn Shaddad ibn Uthman ibn Ka'ab ibn Salamah, from the people of Badr. He witnessed the Battle of Aqaba and he is the one who hid Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib."
hi: Maine Ishaq bin Ibrahim Al-Hanzali ko kehte suna: "Abu Al-Yasar Al-Ansari (RA) ka naam Ka'b bin Amr bin Abbad bin Amr bin Tamim bin Shaddad bin Uthman bin Ka'b bin Salamah (RA) hai, Ahl-e-Badr mein se hain, Aqabah mein haazir hue, aur wahi hain jinhone Abbas bin Abd al-Muttalib (RA) ko qaidi banaya tha."

e: [AI] About Uruwah in the identification of the Ansari who witnessed the Battle of Badr, Abu Al-Yasar Ka'b ibn 'Amr.
hi: Urwah se, Ansaar mein se Badr mein shareek hone waalon ke naam ginwate hue: Abu Al-Yasar Ka'b bin Amr (RA).

e: [AI] "Abu Al-Yasar, his name is Ka'ab Ibn Amr, the brother of Bani Salimah. He died in the year fifty-five in Al-Madinah. He was a short, sturdy man with a round belly."
hi: "Abu Al-Yasar (RA) ka naam Ka'b bin Amr hai, Bani Salimah ke bhai. Unki wafaat 55 Hijri mein Madinah mein hui. Woh kam qad, pust-qad aur bade pet waale aadmi the."

e: [AI] "Abu Al-Yasar, his name is Ka'b bin Amr bin Abbad bin Amr bin Ghaziyyah bin Sawwad. Abu Al-Yasar witnessed the 'Aqabah pledge in all its narrations, and he witnessed the Battle of Badr when he was twenty years old. He also witnessed the Battle of Uhud, the Trench, and all other significant events alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He was a short man with a protruding belly, and he passed away in Medina in the year fifty-five."
hi: "Abu Al-Yasar (RA) ka naam Ka'b bin Amr bin Abbad bin Amr bin Ghaziyyah bin Sawwad hai. Abu Al-Yasar (RA) tamam riwayaat ke mutabiq Aqabah mein haazir hue, aur Badr mein bees saal ki umr mein shareek hue, aur Uhud, Khandaq aur tamam ghazwaat mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath shareek rahe. Woh kam qad, pust-qad aur bade pet waale aadmi the, aur 55 Hijri mein Madinah mein unki wafaat hui."

e: "I came to the Prophet when he was accepting (the people's) pledge, and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, extend you hand so that I may give you my pledge, and state your terms, for you know best.' He said: 'I accept you pledge that you will worship Allah, establish Salah, pay the Zakah, be sincere toward the Muslims, and forsake the idolaters." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4177)
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, aur aap logon se bay'ah le rahe the. Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, apna haath badhaiye taake main aapse bay'ah karun, aur mujh par shart lagaiye, kyunki aap shart ko behtar jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main tujhse is baat par bay'ah leta hun ke tu Allah ki ibadat karega, namaz qaayam karega, zakat ada karega, musalman ka khair-khwah rahega, aur mushrik se alag rahega." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About 'Urwah in the naming of those who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah (pbuh), Mu'attib ibn 'Awf ibn 'Amir ibn Al-Fadl ibn 'Afif.
hi: Urwah se, Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath Badr mein shareek hone waalon ke naam ginwate hue: Mu'attib bin Auf bin Aamir bin Al-Fadl bin Afif (RA).

e: [AI] Shaddad bin Aus bin Thabit bin al-Mundhir bin Haram, also known as Abu Yala, lived in Palestine and died in the year fifty-eight. He was seventy-five years old.
hi: "Shaddad bin Aws bin Thabit bin Al-Mundhir bin Haram (RA), kunyat Abu Ya'la. Unhone Filasteen mein sukoonat ikhtiyar ki, aur 58 Hijri mein, pachhattar (75) saal ki umr mein wafaat paayi."

e: [AI] Abu Mashar said, "Abu Hurayrah and Shaddad ibn Aws died in the year fifty-eight."
hi: Abu Mashar ne kaha: "Abu Hurairah (RA) aur Shaddad bin Aws (RA) dono 58 Hijri mein wafaat paa gaye."

e: [AI] To be one of them.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke woh unmein se ho."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to call me Abu Hurairah, and the people used to call me Abu Hurairah." This information was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in the summary.
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe 'Abu Hirr' (billi ke bachche ka baap) kehkar bulaate the, aur log mujhe 'Abu Hurairah' kehkar bulaate hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to call me Abu Hurairah, and the people also used to call me Abu Hurairah."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) mujhe 'Abu Hirr' kehkar bulaate the, aur log mujhe 'Abu Hurairah' kehkar bulaate hain."

e: [AI] From it, Al-Dhahabi's abridgment.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...is se." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] The name of my father was Abu Abd Amr ibn Abd Ghannam.
hi: "Mere waalid ka naam Abd Amr bin Abd Ghanm tha."

e: [AI] My name in the pre-Islamic era was Abd Shams ibn Sakhr. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named me Abd al-Rahman.
hi: "Jahiliyyat mein mera naam Abd Shams bin Sakhr tha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne mera naam Abd ar-Rahman rakha."

e: [AI] The name of my father was Huraira, son of Ghanim.
hi: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ka naam Abd Ghanim tha."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Mus'hir saying, "Abu Huraira, his name is Ali ibn Abd Shams."
hi: Maine Abu Mushir ko kehte suna: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ka naam Ali bin Abd Shams hai."

e: [AI] The name of my father is Hurayrah, and his full name is Abdun Nahim ibn Amir.
hi: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ka naam Abd Nahim bin Aamir hai."

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah died in Al-Aqiq and his name was Abdullah ibn Amr. Some people say: "Ibn Abi Al-Azzi".
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ki wafaat Aqiq mein hui, aur unka naam Abdullah bin Amr tha. Aur kuch log kehte hain: Ibn Abd al-Uzza.

e: [AI] "And it is said, 'knife'."
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai: Sikkin.

e: [AI] "My father's name is Hurayrah. The nickname 'Sikkin' was attributed to him, which was settled in the name of Abu Hurayrah in nine ways, the most authentic one according to me in the Pre-Islamic era was 'Abd Shams,' and in Islam, it was 'Abd al-Rahman.' Likewise, there is a discrepancy regarding the year of his death."
hi: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ka naam Sikkin tha." Is tarah Abu Hurairah (RA) ke naam mein ikhtilaf nau (9) aqwaal par thehra. Mere nazdeek sabse sahih yeh hai ke jahiliyyat mein Abd Shams aur Islam mein Abd ar-Rahman. Isi tarah unki wafaat ke saal mein bhi ikhtilaf hai.

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah died during the reign of Muawiyah in the year fifty-eight. In that same year, Sa'id ibn al-'Aas, Aisha, and Sa'd ibn Malik also passed away.
hi: "Abu Hurairah (RA) Mu'awiyah (RA) ki imaarat mein 58 Hijri mein wafaat paa gaye, aur usi saal Sa'eed bin Al-Aas (RA), Aisha (RA) aur Sa'd bin Malik (RA) ka bhi inteqal hua."

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah died in the year fifty-eight. It is also said that he died in the year fifty-nine, when he was seventy-eight years old.
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ki wafaat 58 Hijri mein hui, aur kaha jaata hai ke 59 Hijri mein hui, aur unki umr atthattar (78) saal thi.

e: [AI] "Abu Huraira died in the year fifty-seven."
hi: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ki wafaat 57 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] "Abu Hurairah died in the year fifty-five."
hi: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ki wafaat 55 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] "About the work of the city."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...Ahl-e-Madinah ke amal se."

e: [AI] Zaid has a story about you from Abu Hurairah, that one day we, Abu Hurairah, Fulan, and I were in the mosque praying to Allah and remembering our Lord, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to us and sat with us. He said, "Continue on as you were." Zaid said, "I and my companion supplicated before Abu Hurairah did, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  granted protection to our supplications." Then Abu Hurairah made a supplication and said, "O Allah, I ask You for the same thing that my two companions asked You, and I ask You for knowledge that is not forgotten." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Ameen." We said, "O Messenger of Allah, we also ask Allah for knowledge that is not forgotten." He said, "The Dosayi (a narrator of Hadith) has already surpassed both of you in it." Note: The authenticity of this narration is weak, as it wasn't mentioned by Hammad bin Shuaib.
hi: Zaid (RA) ne unse kaha: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ko lazim pakdo, kyunki ek din main, Abu Hurairah (RA) aur ek aur sahabi masjid mein Allah Ta'ala se dua kar rahe the aur apne Rab ka zikr kar rahe the ke Rasulullah (SAW) hamare paas tashreef laaye aur hamare saath baith gaye. Hum khamosh ho gaye to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis kaam mein tum lage the, usi mein lag jao.' Zaid (RA) kehte hain: Phir maine aur mere saathi ne Abu Hurairah (RA) se pehle dua ki, aur Rasulullah (SAW) hamari dua par 'Ameen' kehte rahe. Phir Abu Hurairah (RA) ne dua ki: 'Ae Allah, main tujhse wahi maangta hun jo mere in dono saathiyon ne tujhse maanga, aur main tujhse aisa ilm maangta hun jo bhoola na jaye.' Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ameen.' Hum ne arz kiya: 'Ya Rasulullah, hum bhi Allah se aisa ilm maangte hain jo bhoola na jaye.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ad-Dawsi (Abu Hurairah) tum dono se is mein aage nikal gaya.'" Yeh hadith sahih ul-isnad hai, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala. Hammad bin Shu'aib kamzor hain.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Abu Hurairah is the vessel of knowledge." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ilm ka bartan (zarf) hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] He said, "O Abu Hurairah, what are these narrations that we hear about you speaking about the Prophet ﷺ? Did you hear anything other than what we heard? Did you see anything other than what we saw?"

He replied, "O mother, indeed it was the mirror, kohl, and adornment that used to occupy you from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. But I swear by Allah, nothing else ever occupied me from him."
hi: Aisha (RA) ne Abu Hurairah (RA) se kaha: "Ae Abu Hurairah, yeh kaisi ahadees hain jo hum tak pahunchti hain ke tum Nabi (SAW) se bayan karte ho? Kya tumne wahi suna jo hamne suna? Aur kya tumne wahi dekha jo hamne dekha?" Unhone kaha: "Ammi jaan, aapko to Rasulullah (SAW) se aaina, surme-dani aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye aarasta hona mashgool rakhta tha, aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe unse koi cheez mashgool nahi karti thi."

e: [AI] Abu Hurairah was one of the most knowledgeable companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
hi: "Abu Hurairah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein sabse zyada hifz karne waalon mein se the."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Hurairah saying, "I have memorized from the sayings of the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him, Hadiths that I have narrated to you, and if I were to narrate a Hadith from them, you would stone me with stones."
hi: Maine Abu Hurairah (RA) ko kehte suna: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ki ahadees mein se kuch aisi ahadees yaad ki hain jo maine tumhein bayan nahi ki, aur agar main unmein se ek hadith bhi tumhein bayan kar doon to tum mujhe patthron se sangsaar kar do."

e: [AI] No one among the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  narrated more hadith than Abu Huraira. Marwan sent him to Medina and wanted to hear his hadith. He said, "Write it down as we have narrated it." When Abu Huraira refused, he neglected it and sat down to write it himself. Abu Huraira began narrating and the writer wrote until he finished all of his hadith. Then Marwan said, "Do you know that we have written down your entire hadith?" Abu Huraira replied, "Have you done so, and if you obey me, will you erase it?" Marwan remained silent.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein koi bhi Abu Hurairah (RA) se zyada hadith bayan karne waala nahi tha. Marwan ne unhe Madinah par bheja aur unki ahadees sunna chahin. Marwan ne kaha: "Wohi riwayat karo jo hum karte hain." Jab unhone inkaar kiya to Marwan ne unhe ghaafil pakadne ki tadbeer ki, aur ek kaatib ko unke liye (parde ke peeche) bitha diya. Abu Hurairah (RA) hadith bayan karte rahe aur kaatib likhta raha, yahan tak ke unki saari ahadees likh li gayin. Phir Marwan ne kaha: "Kya aap jaante hain ke humne aapki tamam ahadees likh li hain?" Unhone kaha: "Kya waqai tumne aisa kar liya? Agar tum meri baat maano to ise mita do." Raawi kehte hain: Phir Marwan ne ise mita diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Marwan invited Abu Huraira and made me sit behind the bed. He started asking him questions while I began writing. When the call of prayer approached, he called for him again and made him sit behind the curtain. He continued asking him about that, but there was no addition or subtraction, neither in the beginning nor the end.
hi: Marwan ne Abu Hurairah (RA) ko bulaya aur mujhe (kaatib ko) palang ke peeche bitha diya. Woh unse sawaal karte rahe aur main likhta raha. Phir jab saal poora hone ke qareeb hua to Marwan ne unhe dobara bulaya aur parde ke peeche bitha diya, aur unse wahi baatein poochne lage, to unhone na kuch badhaya, na ghataya, na aage kiya, na peeche.

e: [AI] "A man said to Ibn Umar, 'Verily, Abu Huraira narrates many hadiths from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' Ibn Umar responded, 'I seek refuge with Allah from being doubtful about what he reports, but he was outspoken while we were shy.' Al-Dhahabi refrained from mentioning it in his summary."
hi: Ek aadmi ne Ibn Umar (RA) se kaha: "Abu Hurairah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) se bohot hadith bayan karte hain." Ibn Umar (RA) ne farmaya: "Main tumhein Allah ki panah mein deta hun ke tum unki bayan ki hui baaton mein shak karo. Haan, woh dilair the aur hum jhijhakne waale." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Huraira used to be bold in asking the Prophet ﷺ about things that we do not ask him about."
hi: "Abu Hurairah (RA) Nabi (SAW) se aisi cheezon ke baare mein poochne mein dilair the jinke baare mein hum aap (SAW) se nahi poochte the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ: "Whoever follows a funeral procession will have a Qirat, and if he witnesses its burial, he will have two Qirats, which are greater in value than the mountain of Uhud." Ibn Umar said to Abu Hurairah, "O Abu Hurairah, look at what you are narrating from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." So Abu Hurairah went to Aisha and said to her, "O Mother of the Believers, I swear to you by Allah, did you hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever follows a funeral procession and prays for it will have a Qirat, and if he witnesses its burial, he will have two Qirats'?" She said, "O Allah, yes." Abu Hurairah then said, "We were never too preoccupied with weddings or market transactions to be distracted from the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ teachings. I was only seeking from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a word to teach me or a morsel of food to feed me." Ibn Umar said to Abu Hurairah, "O Abu Hurairah, you used to keep us close to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and inform us of his sayings."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se riwayat kiya: "Jo janaze ke peeche chale uske liye ek qirat hai, aur agar dafn mein haazir rahe to uske liye do qirat hain, jo Uhud (pahaad) se bhi bade hain." To Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ae Abu Hurairah, dekho Rasulullah (SAW) se kya bayan kar rahe ho." Abu Hurairah (RA) uth kar Aisha (RA) ke paas gaye aur unse kaha: "Ae Ummul Mu'mineen, main aapko Allah ka waasta deta hun, kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jo janaze ke peeche chale, uski namaz padhe, to uske liye ek qirat hai, aur agar dafn mein haazir rahe to uske liye do qirat hain'?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Allah, haan." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Hamein Rasulullah (SAW) se na koi shaadi ki mehfil mashgool rakhti thi, na bazaaron mein saudebazi. Main to bas Rasulullah (SAW) se koi kalimah maangta tha jo woh mujhe sikha dein, ya koi niwala jo woh mujhe khila dein." Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ae Abu Hurairah, aap hum sab se zyada Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath rehne waale aur aap (SAW) ki ahadees ko hum sab se zyada jaanne waale the."

e: [AI] "The ink in the scholar's garment is like beauty in the maiden's first garment." - Its source is unknown.
hi: "Talib-e-ilm ke kapde mein siyahi aisi hai jaise kunwari ladki ke kapde mein khaluq (zafraani khushbu)." Iski sanad nihayat kamzor (waahi) hai.

e: [AI] From Abu Hurayrah, in a narration that he denied, so I said, "I have heard it from you." He said, "If you have heard it from me, then indeed it is written with me." He took me by the hand to his house and showed me a book from his collection, which contained the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He found that hadith and said, "I have informed you that if I had narrated it to you, then it is written with me." This hadith is rejected and not authentic.
