hi: Maine Abu Hurairah (RA) se ek hadith ka zikr kiya to unhone use na-pasand kiya (pehchanne se inkaar kiya). Maine kaha: "Maine to yeh aapse suni hai." Unhone kaha: "Agar tumne mujhse suni hai to woh mere paas likhi hui hogi." Phir mera haath pakad kar apne ghar le gaye, aur mujhe apni kitaabon mein se Rasulullah (SAW) ki ahadees ki ek kitaab dikhayi, to woh hadith us mein mil gayi. Unhone kaha: "Maine tumhein bataya tha ke agar maine tumhein yeh bayan ki hai to woh mere paas likhi hui hogi." Yeh hadith munkar hai, sahih nahi.

e: [AI] I heard in the narration/ hadith that he used to say, "He is the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "Maine hadith mein suna, woh kehte the: woh to Rasulullah (SAW) hain."

e: [AI] "He sat in a gathering where Abu Huraira was narrating to them about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Some of them were denying what he was saying, while others acknowledged it. This happened repeatedly until that day when I realized that Abu Huraira was the most knowledgeable among the people about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: "Woh ek majlis mein baithe jismein Abu Hurairah (RA) logon ko Rasulullah (SAW) se ahadees sunate the. Kuch log inkaar karte aur kuch pehchaan lete, aur aisa kai baar hua. Us din maine jaan liya ke Abu Hurairah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki ahadees ko sab logon se zyada yaad rakhne waale hain."

e: [AI] "Oh Abu Muhammad, by Allah, we do not know if this Yemeni man knows more about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  than you, or if it is you. Talha turned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, 'By Allah, he never mentioned something that we did not hear or knew. We were a wealthy people, with houses and families. We used to come to the Prophet ﷺ  during the day and then return. Abu Huraira, on the other hand, was poor, without wealth, family, or children. His hand was always with the hand of the Prophet ﷺ , and he accompanied him wherever he went. No one among us accused him of narrating something the Prophet ﷺ  did not say."
hi: "Ae Abu Muhammad! Allah ki qasam, hum nahi jaante ke yeh Yamani (Abu Hurairah) Rasulullah (SAW) ko zyada jaanta hai ya aap log? Usne Rasulullah (SAW) par woh baat gadh di jo aap (SAW) ne kahi hi nahi." Yani Abu Hurairah (RA) ke baare mein. To Talha (RA) ne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, is mein koi shak nahi ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se woh suna jo hamne nahi suna aur woh jaana jo hamne nahi jaana. Hum maaldaar log the, hamare ghar aur ahl-o-ayaal the, hum din ke dono siron par Nabi (SAW) ke paas aate aur phir laut jaate. Aur Abu Hurairah (RA) miskeen the, na unke paas maal tha, na ahl, na aulaad. Unka haath bas Nabi (SAW) ke haath ke saath tha, aur aap (SAW) jahan jaate woh saath ghoomte. Is mein koi shak nahi ke unhone woh jaana jo hamne nahi jaana aur woh suna jo hamne nahi suna. Hum mein se kisi ne bhi unpar yeh ilzaam nahi lagaya ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) par woh baat gadh di jo aap (SAW) ne kahi na ho." Yeh hadith Muslim ki shart par sahih sanad rakhti hai.

e: [AI] I saw Abu Huraira going out on Friday, and he would hold onto both minbar pillars, standing, and would say, "Abu Al-Qasim, Rasulullah, the truthful and trusted, informed us." He would continue speaking until he heard the opening of the enclosed area for the Imam to go out for prayer, then he would sit down.
hi: Maine Abu Hurairah (RA) ko dekha, Jumu'a ke din nikalte, aur woh minbar ke dono gole (kundon) ko pakad kar khade hote aur kehte: "Hamse Abul Qasim, sachche aur jinki tasdeeq ki gayi, Rasulullah (SAW) ne bayan farmaya." Woh bayan karte rehte, yahan tak ke jab imam ke namaz ke liye nikalne par maqsoorah ka darwaza khulne ki awaaz sunte to baith jaate.

e: [AI] "He has narrated from him in what has been narrated about him and the narration of others from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  with correct pronunciations." Abu Bakr said, "And Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari has narrated from him with his great status and the descent of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to him."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...unse riwayat, un riwayaton mein jo phail chuki hain, unki aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke dusre sahaba ki, sahih turuq ke saath." Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Aur unse Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari (RA) ne bhi riwayat ki, halanke unka martaba bohot buland tha aur Rasulullah (SAW) unke yahan thehre the."

e: [AI] "I arrived at the city, and there Abu Ayyub was talking about Abu Hurairah. So I said, 'You talk about Abu Hurairah, and you are a companion with a high status in the eyes of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' He replied, 'Because narrating from Abu Hurairah is dearer to me than narrating from the Prophet ﷺ .' Imam Abu Bakr said, 'From Abu Hurairah's keenness for knowledge, he would narrate from anyone who had even the slightest narration from the Prophet ﷺ . Therefore, he narrated from Sahl ibn Sa'd as-Sa'idi.'"
hi: Main Madinah aaya to dekha ke Abu Ayyub (RA) Abu Hurairah (RA) se hadith bayan kar rahe hain. Maine kaha: "Aap Abu Hurairah (RA) se bayan karte hain, jabke aap Rasulullah (SAW) ke nazdeek martabe waale hain?" Unhone kaha: "Mere liye Abu Hurairah (RA) se bayan karna Nabi (SAW) se bayan karne se zyada mehboob hai." Imam Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Abu Hurairah (RA) ke ilm ke shauq mein se yeh bhi hai ke woh unse bhi riwayat karte the jo Nabi (SAW) se unse kam riwayat karte the, chunanche unhone Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi (RA) se bhi riwayat ki."

e:
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "None of you should openly show a sword to his brother, for perhaps Satan will take it and he will fall into one of the pits of Hellfire."

Abu Hurairah said, "I heard this from Sahl bin Saad As-Sa'idi, who heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."

Abu Bakr said, "His eagerness for knowledge led him to listen to news that he had not heard from the Prophet ﷺ . He only spoke about Abu Hurairah to refute the claims of those whose hearts Allah had blinded, so they did not understand the meanings of the news. Either they were obstinate Jahmiyyun who heard his news, which contradicted their beliefs, and they would curse Abu Hurairah and accuse him of what Allah, the Exalted, had cleared him of. They did this to deceive the common people and the lowly ones, claiming that his news was not credible. Or it was an outsider who saw the sword over the Ummah of Muhammad ﷺ , but did not see obedience to the Khalifah or Imam when he heard Abu Hurairah's news about the Prophet ﷺ , which contradicted his beliefs. He was unable to find any way to refute his news with evidence, and the issue disturbed him. Either he was deceived by Abu Hurairah or he abandoned Islam and its people and declared the people of Islam who followed predestined events, which Allah decreed before His servants earned their portion. If such a person looked at Abu Hurairah's news, which he narrated from the Prophet ﷺ , affirming predestination, he would not find any argument to prove the authenticity of his claim, which is disbelief and polytheism. In this situation, Abu Hurairah thought that his news was not appropriate to be used as evidence. The ignorant person, who deals with jurisprudence and seeks it from other than its masters, when he hears Abu Hurairah's news in contradiction to the school of thought he has chosen and depends on, he cannot find any solution except to oppose Abu Hurairah's news without any evidence or justification. He would refute his news and use Abu Hurairah's own news as an argument against him if his news agreed with his school of thought. Some of the sects have criticized Abu Hurairah for some of his narrations that they did not understand. I, by the will of Allah, mention some of them here."

Abu Bakr Al-Ajurri (may Allah have mercy on him) mentioned in this context the Hadith of Aisha, which I have already mentioned, the Hadith of Abu Hurairah about a woman being punished in a cat, and the Hadith of Ibn Umar about ablution with what the fire has touched. He mentioned them, and talking about them is lengthy.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne bhai par talwar na tane, shayad shaitan uske haath se ise jhatka de aur woh jahannam ke gaddhon mein se ek gaddhe mein gir jaye." Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine ise Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi (RA) se suna, unhone ise Rasulullah (SAW) se suna." Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Unka ilm ka shauq unhe aisi khabar sunne par aamada karta tha jo unhone khud Nabi (SAW) se nahi suni hoti. Aur Abu Hurairah (RA) par kalaam sirf wohi log karte hain jinke dilon ko Allah ne andha kar diya hai, to woh khabron ke maani nahi samajhte, taake unki ahadees ko radd kar dein. Ya to koi mu'attil Jahmi hota hai jo unki woh ahadees sunta hai jinhe woh apne mazhab ke khilaf paata hai, jo kufr hai, to woh Abu Hurairah (RA) ko gaaliyan deta hai aur unpar woh ilzaam lagata hai jis se Allah Ta'ala ne unhe paak rakha hai, charwahon aur kamtar logon ko dhoka dene ke liye ke unki ahadees se hujjat qaayam nahi hoti. Ya koi Khariji hota hai jo Ummat-e-Muhammad (SAW) par talwar ko jaayiz samajhta hai aur kisi khalifa ya imam ki itaa'at ko nahi maanta; jab woh Abu Hurairah (RA) ki Nabi (SAW) se ahadees apne gumrah mazhab ke khilaf sunta hai aur dalil aur burhan se unhe radd karne ki koi tadbeer nahi paata to uski panaah Abu Hurairah (RA) ki burai karna hota hai. Ya koi Qadari hota hai jo Islam aur ahl-e-Islam se alag ho gaya aur un musalmanon ko kafir kehta hai jo un guzri hui taqdeeron ki pairwi karte hain jo Allah Ta'ala ne bandon ke unhe kamane se pehle muqarrar kar di aur faisla farma di; jab woh Abu Hurairah (RA) ki woh ahadees dekhta hai jo unhone Nabi (SAW) se taqdeer ke isbaat mein riwayat ki hain to apni baat ki durustgi ke liye, jo kufr aur shirk hai, koi dalil nahi paata, to uski apne nazdeek dalil yeh hoti hai ke Abu Hurairah (RA) ki ahadees se istidlal jaayiz nahi. Ya koi jaahil hota hai jo fiqh mein dakhal deta hai aur use uski sahi jagahon ke bajaye doosri jagah se talaash karta hai; jab woh Abu Hurairah (RA) ki aisi ahadees sunta hai jo us shakhs ke mazhab ke khilaf hain jiska mazhab aur ahadees usne bina dalil aur burhan ke taqleed mein chun rakhi hain, to woh Abu Hurairah (RA) par kalaam karta hai aur unki khilaf-e-mazhab ahadees ko radd kar deta hai, aur jab unki ahadees uske mazhab ke mutabiq hon to unhi se apne mukhalif ke khilaf istidlal karta hai. In firqon mein se baaz ne Abu Hurairah (RA) ki kuch aisi ahadees ka inkaar kiya hai jinke maani unhone nahi samjhe; Allah ki mashiyat se main unmein se kuch zikr karunga." Imam Abu Bakr (rahimahullah) ne is maqam par Aisha (RA) ki woh hadith zikr ki jo pehle guzri, aur Abu Hurairah (RA) ki hadith "ek aurat ko billi ke maamle mein azaab diya gaya", aur "jo Jumu'a ke baad namaz padhe", aur iske muqabil Ibn Umar (RA) ki hadith, aur aag par pake khane se wudu karne ki hadith bhi zikr ki, aur in par kalaam taweel hai.

e: [AI] "We were promised by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  the conquest of India. If I am martyred, then I will be among the best of martyrs. And if I return, then I am Abu Huraira, the freed one."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne humse Hind (Hindustan) ke ghazwe ka wada farmaya tha. Agar main shaheed ho gaya to behtareen shuhada mein se hunga, aur agar laut aaya to main Abu Hurairah Al-Muharrar (aazad kiya hua) hun."

e: [AI] Mus'ab Al-Zubairi, also known as Samurah bin Mi'yar.
hi: Mus'ab Az-Zubairi ne kaha: aur unka naam Samurah bin Mi'yar bhi bataya gaya hai.

e: [AI] "And it is said his name is Samurah ibn Mua'yyar."
hi: "Aur kaha jaata hai ke unka naam Samurah bin Mi'yar hai."

e: [AI] "Mu'ayyir ibn Muhaīriz"
hi: "Mi'yar bin Muhairiz."

e: [AI] "Abu Mahdhurah had a story at the front of his head. Whenever he sat, he would send it to reach the earth. They said to him, 'Why don't you remove it?' He said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wiped his hand over it, so I did not remove it until I die.' He did not remove it until he died." (Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary)
hi: Abu Mahdhurah (RA) ke sar ke agle hisse mein baalon ki ek lat thi, jab woh baithte to use chhod dete aur woh zameen tak pahunch jaati. Logon ne unse kaha: "Kya aap ise mundwa nahi dete?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne ispar apna haath phera tha, isliye main ise marte dam tak nahi mundwaunga." Chunanche unhone ise wafaat tak nahi mundwaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  assigned the Banu Abd al-Muttalib with the responsibility of providing water, and the Banu Abd al-Dar with the task of being our guards, and he appointed the Adhan for us and our followers.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bani Abd al-Muttalib ke liye siqaya (hajiyon ko paani pilane ki zimmedari) muqarrar ki, aur Bani Abd ad-Dar ke liye hijabah (Kaaba ki nigahbani/kunji), aur azaan hamare aur hamare mawali ke liye muqarrar ki."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Abu Mahdhurah to give the call to prayer and to perform the Iqamah. The mention of this was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Mahdhurah (RA) ko hukm diya ke azaan ke kalimaat do-do baar kahein aur iqamah ke kalimaat ek-ek baar. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He informed him, "He was an orphan in the guardianship of Abu Mahdhoora bin Mi'yar until he prepared him to go to Damascus."
hi: Unhone khabar di: "Woh yateem the aur Abu Mahdhurah bin Mi'yar (RA) ki parwarish mein the, yahan tak ke unhone unhe Shaam ke safar ke liye taiyaar kiya."

e: [AI] "Muawiyah's mu'adhin announced the call to prayer, so Abu Mahdhura carried him and threw him into the Zamzam well." Al-Dhahabi did not comment on it in the summary.
hi: Mu'awiyah (RA) ke muazzin ne azaan di, to Abu Mahdhurah (RA) ne use utha liya aur Zamzam mein daal diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The name of my father is Usaid Al-Saadi, Malik ibn Rabiah.
hi: "Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi (RA) ka naam Malik bin Rabi'ah hai."

e: [AI] "Abu Usaid, Malik ibn Rabiah ibn al-Badani ibn Amr ibn Awf ibn Haritha ibn Amr ibn al-Khazraj ibn Sa'dah."
hi: "Abu Usaid Malik bin Rabi'ah bin Al-Badan bin Aamir bin Amr bin Auf bin Harithah bin Amr bin Al-Khazraj bin Sa'idah (RA)."

e: [AI] From Abu Usayd Malik ibn Rabiah, who had witnessed the Battle of Badr and then lost his sight afterwards.
hi: Abu Usaid Malik bin Rabi'ah (RA) se, jo Badr mein shareek hue the, phir baad mein unki beenai chali gayi.

e: [AI] Abu Usayd Al-Saadiyy was blinded before the murder of Uthman. He said, "Praise be to Allah who has blessed me with eyesight during the Prophet's life. When Allah intended to test His servants, He took away my eyesight from it." Al-Dhahabi does not mention this in his summary.
hi: Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi (RA) ki beenai Uthman (RA) ke qatl se pehle chali gayi. Unhone kaha: "Allah ka shukr hai jisne mujhe Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi mein meri beenai se faida diya, aur jab Allah ne apne bandon mein fitna chaha to meri nazar ko usse rok liya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] There is an error in the given Arabic text.
hi: "Jama'ah ke saal, yaani 40 Hijri mein, Abu Usaid Malik bin Rabi'ah bin Aamir bin Auf bin Al-Khazraj bin Sa'idah (RA) ki wafaat hui. Woh Ahl-e-Badr mein sabse aakhir mein wafaat paane waale the, aur un logon mein se the jinhone Badr ke din farishton ko dekha tha. Phir unki beenai chali gayi, aur woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki azwaj par aap (SAW) ke amaanatdaar rahe." Yeh ghalat hai.

e: [AI] "Abu Usayd Al-Sa'idi passed away at the age of 62, being the son of two and ninety years."
hi: "Abu Usaid As-Sa'idi (RA) ki wafaat 60 Hijri mein hui aur unki umr bayanwe (92) saal thi."

e: [AI] "From him, Al-Dhahabi regarding summarization."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...is se." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] "Abu Usaid Al-Ansari arrived with a group of captives from Bahrain. They were lined up, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  stood up and looked at them. He noticed a woman crying, so he asked her, 'What makes you cry?' She replied, 'My son has been sold to the Banu Abs tribe.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Abu Usaid, 'You will have to ride and bring him back.' So Abu Usaid rode and brought him back."
hi: Abu Usaid Al-Ansari (RA) Bahrain se kuch qaidi (ghulam) laaye. Unhe saf mein khada kiya gaya, to Rasulullah (SAW) uth kar unhe dekhne lage. Ek aurat ro rahi thi. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tujhe kya cheez rula rahi hai?" Usne kaha: "Mera beta Bani Abs mein bech diya gaya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Usaid (RA) se farmaya: "Tum sawaar ho kar jao aur use le aao." Chunanche Abu Usaid (RA) sawaar hue aur use le aaye.

e: [AI] On the occasion of the Prophet Muhammad's choosing the Ansar, he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying: 'The best of the Ansar tribes are the Daws tribe, then the Banu Abd al-Ashhal tribe, then the Banu Harith bin Khazraj tribe, then the Banu Sa'idah tribe. And in every tribe of the Ansar, there is goodness.' Abu Usaid said, 'If I had to meet someone other than the truth, I would begin with the Banu Sa'idah tribe by my thigh.'"
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) Rasulullah (SAW) ke Ansaar mein fazilat ki tarteeb batane ke baare mein. Unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Ansaar ke qabilon mein sabse behtar Bani An-Najjar ke gharane hain, phir Bani Abd al-Ashhal, phir Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, phir Bani Sa'idah. Aur Ansaar ke har gharane mein khair hai." Abu Usaid (RA) ne kaha: "Agar main haq ke siwa kuch maanne waala hota to apne qabile Bani Sa'idah se shuru karta."

e: [AI] "Bilal Al-Muzani, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , is Bilal ibn Al-Harith ibn Mazen ibn Subayh ibn Khalawata ibn Tha'labah ibn Thawr ibn Hadmih ibn Latim ibn Amr ibn Muzaynah."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahabi Bilal Al-Muzani (RA), yaani Bilal bin Al-Harith bin Mazin bin Subaih bin Khalawah bin Tha'labah bin Thaur bin Hadmah bin Latim bin Amr bin Muzaynah (RA)."

e: [AI] I heard Harun ibn Abdullah say, "Bilal ibn al-Harith al-Muzani is nicknamed Abu Abdurrahman."
hi: Maine Harun bin Abdullah ko kehte suna: "Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani (RA) ki kunyat Abu Abd ar-Rahman hai."

e: [AI] Bilal ibn al-Harith al-Muzanni died in the year sixty.
hi: "Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani (RA) ki wafaat 60 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani was one of the people who carried a flag from the three flags that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, assigned to them on the day of the conquest of Mecca. Bilal was also known as Abu Abdurrahman and he lived in the mountains of Muzaynah, specifically in Ash'ar and Ajrad. He used to frequently visit Medina. He passed away in the year sixty, at the age of eighty at that time.
hi: Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani (RA) un teen jhandon mein se ek jhanda uthane waalon mein the jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fath-e-Makkah ke din unke liye baandhe the. Bilal (RA) ki kunyat Abu Abd ar-Rahman thi. Woh Muzaynah ke do pahaadon Al-Ash'ar aur Al-Ajrad mein rehte the aur Madinah bohot aate the. Unki wafaat 60 Hijri mein hui, aur us waqt unki umr assi (80) saal thi.

e: [AI] Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  cut off the boundaries and wrote for him the following: Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , gave him the mines of the Quraish, their water sources (the wells and springs), and the pastures (for grazing livestock), and the land of Al-Jashaymah, and the land of Al-Nusub, and wherever the crop is irrigated from the Quds (Jerusalem) if it is damaged. Muawiyah also wrote this.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhe jagir ata ki aur unke liye likhwa diya: "Yeh woh hai jo Muhammad Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bilal bin Al-Harith ko diya: unhe Qabaliyyah ki kanein dein, uska Ghauri aur Jalsi hissa, Al-Jasheemah aur Dhat an-Nusub, aur jahan kheti munasib ho Quds (Madinah ke qareeb ek pahaad) se, agar woh (zameen) sakht ho." Aur Mu'awiyah (RA) ne likha.

e: [AI] Narrated Al-Qa'nabiyyu, who narrated from 'Abdul 'Aziz, who narrated from Muhammad bin 'Amr, who narrated from his father, who narrated from his grandfather, who narrated from Bilal bin Al-Harith, who narrated from the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  who said, "A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hands other Muslims are safe."
hi: Hamse Al-Qa'nabi ne bayan kiya, unse Abd al-Aziz ne, unhone Muhammad bin Amr se, unhone apne walid se, unhone apne daada se, unhone Bilal bin Al-Harith (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Musalman woh hai jiski zubaan aur haath se doosre musalman mehfooz rahein."

e: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, is this annulment of Hajj just for us or is it for all the people?' He said: 'No, it is just for us." (Daif) (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2808)
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah, Hajj (ke iraade) ko tod kar umrah mein badal dena (fasakh-e-Hajj) kya sirf humare liye khaas hai ya tamam logon ke liye aam?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balki sirf humare liye khaas hai."

e: [AI] "Safwan, the son of Al-Muattal, the son of Rahadah, the son of Khuzai, the son of Muharib, the son of Murrah, the son of Hilal, the son of Falij, the son of Thaqwan, the son of Tha'alabah, the son of Bahtah, the son of Sulaiman, who had a home in Basra on the Mirbad road, passed away in the Jazirah region, in the vicinity of Shimshat, and his grave is there."
hi: "Safwan bin Al-Mu'attal bin Rahadah bin Khuza'i bin Muharib bin Murrah bin Hilal bin Falij bin Dhakwan bin Tha'labah bin Bahtah bin Sulaim (RA). Basrah mein Sikkat al-Mirbad mein unka ghar tha. Unki wafaat Al-Jazirah mein Shimshat ke ilaqe mein hui aur unki qabr wahin hai."

e: [AI] "And Safwan ibn al-Mu'attal was known as Abu Amr, and he embraced Islam before the battle of Al-Muraysi'a and witnessed it with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He also witnessed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  after that the Battle of the Trench and all other major events. He was with Kurz ibn Jabir al-Fihri seeking out the Qurayshi polytheists who had attacked the camel of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the Battle of Dhi al-Jadir. Safwan ibn al-Mu'attal died in Shamshat in the year sixty."
hi: "Safwan bin Al-Mu'attal (RA) ki kunyat Abu Amr thi. Woh Ghazwa-e-Muraisi' se pehle Islam laaye aur usmein Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath shareek hue, phir uske baad Khandaq aur tamam ghazwaat mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath shareek rahe. Woh Kurz bin Jabir Al-Fihri (RA) ke saath un Uraniyyeen ki talaash mein the jinhone Dhi al-Jadr mein Rasulullah (SAW) ki unthniyon par chhapa mara tha. Safwan bin Al-Mu'attal (RA) ki wafaat Shimshat mein 60 Hijri mein hui."

e: “Safwan bin Mu’attal asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: ‘O Messenger of Allah, I want to ask you about something of which you have knowledge and I know nothing.’ He said: ‘What is it?’ He said: ‘Is there any time of the night or day when it is disliked to perform prayer? He said: ‘Yes, when you have prayed the Subh, then do not pray until the sun has risen, for it rises between the two horns of Satan. Then pray, for the prayer is attended (by the angels) and is acceptable (to Allah) until the sun is right overhead like a spear. For at that time Hell is heated up and its gates are opened. (Then refrain from prayer) until the sun passes the zenith. Then when it has passed the zenith, the prayer is attended (by the angels) and is acceptable (to Allah) until you pray the ‘Asr. Then stop praying until the sun has set.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1252)
hi: Safwan (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha: "Ae Allah ke Nabi, main aapse ek aisi baat poochna chahta hun jise aap jaante hain aur main nahi jaanta." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Kya raat aur din ke auqaat mein koi aisa waqt hai jismein namaz padhna makrooh hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum Fajr padh lo to namaz chhod do yahan tak ke sooraj nikal aaye, kyunki woh shaitan ke do singhon ke darmiyan nikalta hai. Phir namaz padho, kyunki namaz (farishton ke zariye) haazir ki jaati hai aur qubool hoti hai, yahan tak ke sooraj tumhare sar par neze ki tarah seedha ho jaye. Jab woh sar par neze ki tarah ho to namaz chhod do, kyunki yeh wohi waqt hai jismein jahannam dahkayi jaati hai aur uske darwaaze khole jaate hain, yahan tak ke sooraj dhal jaye. Jab dhal jaye to namaz haazir ki jaati hai aur qubool hoti hai, yahan tak ke tum Asr padh lo. Phir namaz chhod do yahan tak ke sooraj ghuroob ho jaye." Yeh hadith sahih ul-isnad hai, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me to announce: 'Do not take refuge in the jar.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe yeh elaan karne bheja ke matkon (jarrah) mein nabidh na banao." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And Safwan said when he struck him [Al-Bahr Al-Taweel]: 'Take the sword's flies from me, for I am just a young boy. When I engage in combat, I am not a poet, but I protect my family and seek vengeance from the one who shoots aimlessly, the innocent and pure.' Aisha said: Safwan escaped, and Hassan came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, preparing himself. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him to give him a strike from Safwan. So he gave it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then compensated him with a great palm tree wall and a Roman well called "Sireen". Hassan sold the wall to Muawiya ibn Abi Sufyan during his governorship, for a great amount of money."
hi: Aur Safwan (RA) ne, jab unhone Hassaan (RA) par waar kiya, kaha [Bahr At-Tawil, shayri ka ek wazan]: "Meri talwar ki dhaar ka maza chakh, kyunki main aisa jawan hun ke jab meri hajv ki jaye to main shaayar nahi hun, magar main apni hurmat ki hifazat karta hun, aur us bohtaan lagane waale se badla leta hun jo paak-daaman auraton par tohmat lagata hai." Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Safwan (RA) bhaag gaye, aur Hassaan (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas shikayat lekar aaye. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse darkhwast ki ke Safwan (RA) ka waar unhe hiba (maaf) kar dein, to unhone woh Rasulullah (SAW) ko hiba kar diya. "Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhe iske badle khajoor ka ek bada baagh aur Sireen naam ki ek Roomi laundi ata ki." Phir Hassaan (RA) ne woh baagh Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan (RA) ko unki hukoomat ke daur mein badi raqam mein bech diya.

e: [AI] "We went out as pilgrims, and when we were in the valley, suddenly a snake appeared and began to agitate. It did not take long before it died. One of us took a piece of his garment, wrapped the snake in it, and buried it in the ground. Then we proceeded to Makkah. While we were in the Sacred Mosque (Al-Masjid al-Haram), a person approached us and asked, 'Which one of you is the companion of Amr ibn Jabir?' We replied, 'We do not know Amr ibn Jabir.' He then asked, 'Which one of you is the companion of the jinn?' We said, 'This is the one.' He said, 'May Allah reward you well. He was the last of the nine who have come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to listen to the Quran.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization."
hi: Hum Hajj ke liye nikle. Jab hum Al-Arj mein the to hamne ek saanp dekha jo tadap raha tha, aur thodi hi der mein mar gaya. Humare ek aadmi ne apne thaile se kapde ka tukda nikala, usmein use lapeta aur zameen mein chhupa kar dafn kar diya. Phir hum Makkah aaye. Hum Masjid-e-Haram mein the ke ek shakhs hamare paas aa kar khada hua aur bola: "Tum mein se Amr bin Jabir ka saathi kaun hai?" Humne kaha: "Hum Amr bin Jabir ko nahi jaante." Usne kaha: "Tum mein se jinn ka saathi kaun hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh." Usne kaha: "Allah tumhein jazaa-e-khair de. Woh un nau (jinnon) mein sabse aakhir mein wafaat paane waala tha jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Quran sunne aaye the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The beginning of the meal of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was in the hands of his companions this night and this night. So, it went around to me and I prepared the meal for the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I took it to him. Sufyan bin Hamza said, "Hamza bin Amr Al-Aslami, nicknamed Abu Muhammad, died in the year sixty-one, at the age of seventy-one."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke ashaab (Ahl-e-Suffa) ke khane ki baari unke saathiyon ke zimme thi, aaj raat is ki aur aaj raat us ki. Raawi kehte hain: Phir meri baari aayi, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke ashaab ka khana banaya aur aap (SAW) ke paas le gaya. Sufyan bin Hamzah ne kaha: "Hamzah bin Amr Al-Aslami (RA) ki kunyat Abu Muhammad thi. Unki wafaat 61 Hijri mein hui aur unki umr ikahattar (71) saal thi."

e: [AI] That Hamza was also known as Abu Muhammad and he died in the year 161.
hi: "Hamzah (RA) ki kunyat Abu Muhammad thi aur unki wafaat 61 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Zaid ibn Asim was killed on the Day of Al-Harra
hi: "Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aasim (RA) Harrah ke din shaheed kiye gaye."

e: [AI] "Abdullah bin Zaid bin Asim bin Amr bin Awf bin Mabdhul bin Amr bin Ghunaim bin Mazin bin Al-Najjar, and his mother was Ummaratu and her name was Nusaybah bint Ka'ab bin Amr bin Awf bin Mabdhul. He witnessed the Battle of Uhud, the Battle of the Trench, and all other battles with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He was the uncle of Abbad bin Tamim. Abdullah bin Zaid was among those who killed Musaylimah Al-Kadhdhab on the day of Yamamah, and he was killed on the day of Harrah. This occurred on the last day of Dhul-Hijjah, in the year sixty-three, during the reign of Yazid bin Muawiyah."
hi: "Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aasim bin Amr bin Auf bin Mabdhul bin Amr bin Ghunaim bin Mazin bin An-Najjar (RA). Unki walida Umm Umarah thin, jinka naam Nusaybah bint Ka'b bin Amr bin Auf bin Mabdhul (RA) hai. Woh Uhud, Khandaq aur tamam ghazwaat mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath shareek hue. Woh Abbad bin Tamim (RA) ke chacha hain. Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) un logon mein se the jinhone Yamamah ke din Musaylimah Kazzab ko qatl kiya, aur woh Harrah ke din shaheed hue, jo 63 Hijri ke aakhir Dhul-Hijjah mein Yazid bin Mu'awiyah ki hukoomat mein hua."

e: [AI] "He was a witness of the Battle of Badr. This is a mistake."
hi: (Kaha gaya ke) "woh Badr mein shareek hue the." Yeh ghalat hai.

e: [AI] "Abdullah bin Zaid bin Asim is a Khazrajite from the tribe of Bani Mazin bin an-Najjar, and he is the killer of Musaylimah."
hi: "Abdullah bin Zaid bin Aasim (RA) Khazraji hain, Bani Mazin bin An-Najjar se, aur woh Musaylimah ke qaatil hain."

e: [AI] I heard my father say, "Abdullah ibn Zaid is nicknamed Abu Muhammad."
hi: Maine apne walid ko kehte suna: "Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) ki kunyat Abu Muhammad hai."

e: A person came to him and said: Here is Ibn Hanzala who is making people swear allegiance to him. He (, Abdullah) asked: To what effect? He replied: To the effect that they will die for him. 'Abdullah said: I will never swear allegiance to this effect after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Muslim 1861)
hi: Ek aadmi unke paas aaya aur bola: "Yeh Ibn Hanzalah hain jo logon se (maut par) bay'ah le rahe hain." Unhone poocha: "Kis baat par?" Usne kaha: "Is par ke woh uske saath marenge." Unhone farmaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad main is baat par kisi se bay'ah nahi karunga."

e: [AI] "Rabi'ah bin Ka'b al-Aslami embraced Islam and was a companion of the Prophet ﷺ from the early days, belonging to the As-Suffah (a group of poor companions who lived in the Mosque of the Prophet). He used to serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and remained in his company in Madinah, participating in battles with him until he passed away. After his death, Rabi'ah left Madinah and settled near a well in the lands of Aslam, which was close to Madinah. He remained there until the days of Harrah, where he perished. The Harrah occurred in the month of Dhul-Hijjah of the year sixty-three."
hi: "Rabi'ah bin Ka'b Al-Aslami (RA) Islam laaye aur bohot pehle se Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi rahe, Ahl-e-Suffa mein se the aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat karte the. Rabi'ah bin Ka'b (RA) Madinah mein Nabi (SAW) ke saath lage rahe aur aap (SAW) ke saath ghazwaat mein shareek hote rahe, yahan tak ke aap (SAW) ka wisaal ho gaya. Phir Rabi'ah (RA) Madinah se nikle aur Bani Aslam ke ilaqe ke ek kunwen par thehar gaye, jo Madinah se ek barid (taqreeban 12 meel) ke fasle par hai. Woh Harrah ke dino tak zinda rahe aur usmein shaheed hue. Harrah 63 Hijri ke Dhul-Hijjah mein hui."

e: [AI] I used to serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said to me, "O Rabee'ah, why don't you get married?" I replied, "No, by Allah, I do not want to get married." Al-Dhahabi remained silent on this issue in the summary.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki khidmat kiya karta tha. Aap (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Ae Rabi'ah, kya tum nikah nahi karoge?" Maine kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main nikah nahi karna chahta." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Mu'adh bin Al-Harith Al-Qari from the Banu Najjar clan, known as Abu Al-Harith bin Al-Hubab bin Al-Arqam bin Awf bin Malik bin Al-Najjar. He was Mu'adh Al-Qari, known as Abu Al-Harith. He was killed on the Day of Harrah in the month of Dhul-Hijjah in the year sixty-three [Hijri]."
hi: "Mu'adh bin Al-Harith Al-Qari Bani An-Najjar mein se, kunyat Abu Al-Harith, bin Al-Hubab bin Al-Arqam bin Auf bin Malik bin An-Najjar (RA). Wahi Mu'adh Al-Qari hain, kunyat Abu Al-Harith. Woh Harrah ke din 63 Hijri ke Dhul-Hijjah mein shaheed hue."

e: [AI] "I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in say, 'Maqil ibn Sinan al-Ashja'i witnessed the conquest with the Prophet ﷺ and was killed on the Day of Harrah in the year sixty-three.'"
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'in ko kehte suna: "Ma'qil bin Sinan Al-Ashja'i (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke saath Fath-e-Makkah mein shareek hue aur Harrah ke din 63 Hijri mein shaheed hue."

e: [AI] Maqil ibn Sinan ibn Muzahhir ibn Araqi ibn Fatyan ibn Subay ibn Bakr ibn Ashja'a witnessed the conquest with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him.
hi: "Ma'qil bin Sinan bin Muzahhir bin Araki bin Fityan bin Subai' bin Bakr bin Ashja' (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath Fath-e-Makkah mein shareek hue."

e: [AI] Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated: "Abu Muhammad al-Asha'ath ibn Qays al-Kindi, from the Banu Harith ibn Muawiyah, died in Kufa. After the peace treaty with Muawiyah, Hasan ibn Ali prayed the funeral prayer for him."
hi: Hamse Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaybah aur Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Numair ne bayan kiya, dono ne kaha: "Abu Muhammad Al-Ash'ath bin Qais Al-Kindi, Bani Al-Harith bin Mu'awiyah mein se (RA), Kufa mein faut hue. Al-Hasan bin Ali (RA) us waqt wahin the, Mu'awiyah (RA) ki unse sulh ke baad. Chunanche Al-Hasan bin Ali (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janazah padhayi."

e: [AI] So he was brought with it. So he called for a basin of water. Then he washed his hands, face, and feet with it. Then he said, "Enter."
hi: Phir unke paas hunoot (khushbu) laayi gayi, unhone use mangwa kar uske saath apne dono haath, chehra aur dono paaon dhoye, phir kaha: "Ise (kafan mein) lapet do."

e: [AI] "Al-Miswar, son of Makhrama, son of Nawfal, son of Ahyab, son of Abd Manaf, son of Zuhrah. His mother is Atika bint Awf, the sister of Abdul Rahman ibn Awf."
hi: "Al-Miswar bin Makhramah bin Naufal bin Uhaib bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah (RA). Unki walida Atikah bint Auf thin, jo Abd ar-Rahman bin Auf (RA) ki behen thin."

e: [AI] "I heard the Prophet ﷺ  delivering a sermon from his pulpit while I was veiled that day."
hi: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko apne minbar par khutba dete suna, aur us din main baligh ho chuka tha."

e: [AI] It is said that he died from the injuries caused by the catapult stone while he was in Makkah. He stayed there for five days and then died. Abdullah ibn Zubayr, who was sixty-eight years old at the time, performed the funeral prayer for him.
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai ke unki wafaat Al-Hajun mein hui; unhe manjaniq ka patthar laga jabke woh Makkah mein Hijr mein the. Woh paanch din rahe phir wafaat paa gaye. Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janazah padhayi, aur unki umr arsath (68) saal thi.

e: [AI] "He (referring to someone) said, 'Al-Miswar ibn Makhrama died in the year seventy-three.' And this statement is incorrect."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) unke baare mein kehte hue: "Al-Miswar bin Makhramah (RA) ki wafaat 73 Hijri mein hui." Aur yeh baat ghalat hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  fed me a date in a dish that is not from your pottery. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away while I was eleven years old."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe ek thaal mein khajoor khilayi, jo tumhari is barni (qism ki khajoor) mein se nahi thi." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal hua to meri umr gyarah (11) saal thi.

e: [AI] "A group of gifts was brought to the Prophet ﷺ , so he divided them among his companions. My father said to me, 'Come with us to him, as gifts have been brought to him.' My father spoke at the door, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  recognized his voice. He came out with a garment and kept saying, 'I kept this for you, I kept this for you.' This hadith is mentioned in the book of Sahih Muslim, 'I prepared it so that he would know that he used to come with his father, the Prophet ﷺ , and he had memorized the sermons of the Prophet ﷺ .' "
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas kuch qabaayein (lambe kot) aayin, to aap (SAW) ne unhe apne ashaab mein taqseem kar diya. Mere walid ne mujhse kaha: "Chalo hamare saath aap (SAW) ke paas, kyunke aap (SAW) ke paas qabaayein aayi hain." Mere walid ne darwaze par baat ki, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unki awaaz pehchaan li aur ek qaba lekar bahar tashreef laaye, aur farmate rahe: "Maine yeh tumhare liye chhupa kar rakhi thi, maine yeh tumhare liye chhupa kar rakhi thi." Yeh hadith Sahih Muslim mein maujood hai. Hakim ne kaha: "Maine ise dobara isliye zikr kiya taake maloom ho ke Al-Miswar (RA) apne walid ke saath Nabi (SAW) ke paas aate the, aur unhone Nabi (SAW) ke khutbe yaad kiye the."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered a sermon to us in Arafat, praising and glorifying Allah. Then he said, "As for what comes next, the people of polytheism and idols used to repel from this place when the sun was on top of the mountains, as if it were turbans on the heads of men. And indeed, we repel after it sets. And they used to repel from Al-Masha'ar Al-Haram when the sun was shining directly upon it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Arafaat mein khutba diya, Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki, phir farmaya: "Amma ba'd! Mushrikeen aur butparast is jagah se us waqt ravana hote the jab sooraj pahaadon ki chotiyon par hota, goya mardon ke chehron par pagdiyan hon. Aur hum sooraj ke ghuroob ke baad ravana hote hain. Aur woh Al-Mash'ar Al-Haram se us waqt ravana hote the jab sooraj phail chuka hota."

e: [AI] "Dhahhak bin Qais bin Khalid bin Wahb bin Tha'laba bin Wathila bin Amro bin Sinan bin Muharib bin Fihr and his mother is Ummayma bint Rabia from the Kinanah tribe, and she is also the mother of his sister Fatima bint Qais, the sister of Dhahhak bin Qais. They share the same father and mother."
hi: "Ad-Dahhak bin Qais bin Khalid bin Wahb bin Tha'labah bin Wa'ilah bin Amr bin Sinan bin Muharib bin Fihr (RA). Unki walida Umaymah bint Rabi'ah, Kinanah se thin, aur wahi unki behen Fatimah bint Qais (RA) ki bhi walida hain. Fatimah (RA) Ad-Dahhak bin Qais ki behen hain; dono sage (ek maan baap ke) bhai behen hain."

e: [AI] From it, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...is se." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] "Dhahak ibn Qais al-Akbar was known as Abu Unays, he passed away during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and Dhahak was a young boy who had not yet reached puberty."
hi: "Ad-Dahhak bin Qais Al-Akbar (RA) ki kunyat Abu Unais thi. Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal hua to Ad-Dahhak abhi bachche the, baligh nahi hue the."

e: [AI] He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "A guardian (ruler) will always be from the Quraysh." And this was mentioned by Al-Dhahabi in his summary.
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Quraish mein se hamesha koi waali (hukmran) rahega." Aur isi (silsile) mein se. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying: "Indeed, before the Hour there will be trials like pieces of dark smoke. The heart of a person will die from it, just as his body dies. In the morning, a person will be a believer, and in the evening, he will be a disbeliever. Similarly, a person will be a believer in the evening, and in the morning, he will be a disbeliever. People will sell their religion for a small worldly gain."

And that you should consider him dead while you are his brothers and his companions amongst those trials.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Qiyamat se pehle aise fitne honge jaise siyah dhuen ke tukde; unse aadmi ka dil aise mar jaayega jaise uska badan marta hai. Aadmi subah ko momin hoga to shaam ko kafir, aur shaam ko momin hoga to subah ko kafir. Kuch log dunya ke thode se saaz-o-saman ke badle apna deen bech denge." Aur yeh ke Yazid wafaat paa chuka hai, aur tum hamare bhai aur sage rishtedar ho. Aur isi mein se.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When a person enters a community and they say welcome to him, he will be welcomed on the day he meets his Lord. And when a person enters a community and they say curse upon him, he will be cursed on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jab koi aadmi kisi qaum ke paas aaye aur woh kahein 'marhaba', to us din bhi use 'marhaba' ho jis din woh apne Rab se milega. Aur jab koi aadmi kisi qaum ke paas aaye aur woh use 'qahtan' (tujh par qahat/barbadi ho) kahein, to qiyamat ke din bhi uske liye 'qahtan' ho." Aur isi mein se. Yeh hadith Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to her, "Lower your voice and do not burden him because it is more pleasing to the face and better for the husband." Al-Dhahabi remains silent about it in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne us (khatna karne waali aurat) se farmaya: "Halka karo aur mubalagha na karo, kyunke yeh chehre ko zyada tarotaza rakhta hai aur shauhar ke nazdeek zyada pasandida hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-‘As ibn Wa’il ibn Hashim ibn Sa’id ibn Sahm ibn Amr ibn Husaysh ibn Ka'b embraced Islam before his father. He was a man who was mentioned with a long body, red complexion, with great calves, a white head, and beard. He became blind in his old age. Abdullah ibn Amr passed away in Sham (Syria) in the year sixty-five, at that time he was seventy-two years old. He was also known as Abu Muhammad."
hi: "Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas bin Wa'il bin Hashim bin Sa'id bin Sahm bin Amr bin Husais bin Ka'b (RA). Abdullah bin Amr (RA) apne walid se pehle Islam laaye. Jaisa ke zikr kiya gaya, woh lambe qad, surkh rang, mote pindliyon waale, sar aur darhi safed rakhne waale the. Aakhri umr mein unki beenai chali gayi thi. Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ki wafaat Shaam mein 65 Hijri mein hui, aur us waqt unki umr bahattar (72) saal thi. Unki kunyat Abu Muhammad thi."

e: [AI] And the death of my father, Muhammad Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas, and his mother Raita bint Munabbih bin Al-Hajjaj bin Aamir bin Hudhaifah bin Saad bin Sahm, occurred in the year sixty-five. He used to dye his hair black, and Amr bin Al-Aas was twelve years older than his son.
hi: "Abu Muhammad Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) ki wafaat 65 Hijri mein hui. Unki walida Raitah bint Munabbih bin Al-Hajjaj bin Aamir bin Hudhaifah bin Sa'd bin Sahm thin. Woh siyah khizab lagate the. Aur Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) apne bete se barah (12) saal bade the."

e: [AI] Yes, I know you as a sheikh, but today you are a young man. I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: "Yellow is the dye of the believer, red is the dye of the Muslim, and black is the dye of the disbeliever." This is a Hadith with a questionable narrator.
hi: (Unhone kaha:) "Haan, main aapko buzurg ke taur par jaanta hun, aur aaj aap jawaan hain. Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Peela rang momin ka khizab hai, surkh rang musalman ka khizab hai, aur siyah rang kafir ka khizab hai.'" Yeh hadith munkar hai.

e: [AI] He heard Abu 'Abdullah Al-Hubuli saying: "Three people came to 'Abdullah bin 'Amr and they said, 'O Abu Muhammad,
hi: Unhone Abu Abd ar-Rahman Al-Hubuli ko kehte suna: Teen aadmi Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ae Abu Muhammad," (adhoora jumla).

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Al-Aas, his mother is Rayta bint Munabbih ibn Al-Hajjaj ibn Amir ibn Hudhayfah ibn Sa'd ibn Sahm ibn Amr ibn Husayt ibn Ka'b ibn Lu'ayy."
hi: "Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas (RA). Unki walida Raitah bint Munabbih bin Al-Hajjaj bin Aamir bin Hudhaifah bin Sa'd bin Sahm bin Amr bin Husais bin Ka'b bin Lu'ayy (RA)."

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ who said, "Take the Quran from four individuals: two from the Muhajireen and two from the Ansar. They are Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Salim, the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubay bin Ka'b, and Mu'adh bin Jabal." And he specifically singled out Abdullah bin Mas'ud with a word.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Quran chaar se lo: do Muhajireen mein se aur do Ansaar mein se: Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Salim jo Abu Hudhaifah ke mawla hain, Ubayy bin Ka'b aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA)." Aur kaha: aur aap (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ko ek kalimah ke saath khaas kiya.

e: [AI] Umm Abdullah, the daughter of Raita bin Munabbih bin Al-Hajjaj, was kind to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . One day he came to her and said, "How are you, Umm Abdullah?" She replied, "I am fine, and Abdullah is a man who has renounced the world." His father told him on the day of Siffin, 'Go out and fight.' He said, 'O my father, are you commanding me to go out and fight, even though I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  things that I have never heard before? He said, 'I adjure you by Allah, do you know that what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to you was true? He took your hand and put it in mine and said, 'Obey your father Amr bin Al-As.' He said, 'Yes.' He said, 'I am commanding you to fight.' So he went out and fought. When the war was over, Abdullah bin Amr said, 'If you had seen the position and the scene of my station at Siffin, when in the evening the people of Iraq came like clouds in spring, and the Zawahir shook them. If you say that they have changed overnight, we have battalions of them that have stood firm, and other battalions shook. They said to us, 'We think that you should give your allegiance to Ali.' We said, 'No, we think that you should fight each other.'
hi: Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ki walida Raitah bint Munabbih bin Al-Hajjaj Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath narmi aur mehrbani se pesh aati thin. Ek din aap (SAW) unke paas tashreef laaye aur farmaya: "Ae Umm Abdullah, aap kaisi hain?" Unhone kaha: "Khairiyat se hun, aur Abdullah aisa aadmi hai jisne dunya chhod di hai." Siffin ke din unke walid ne unse kaha: "Nikalo aur ladho." Unhone kaha: "Abba jaan, kya aap mujhe hukm dete hain ke main nikal kar ladun, jabke Rasulullah (SAW) ka ahd jo aapne suna hai, woh maujood hai?" Unhone kaha: "Main tumhe Allah ka waasta deta hun, kya tum jaante ho ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumse jo ahd liya woh yeh tha ke aap (SAW) ne tumhara haath pakda aur use mere haath mein rakh diya aur farmaya: 'Apne walid Amr bin Al-Aas ki itaa'at karo'?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Unhone kaha: "To main tumhe hukm deta hun ke ladho." Raawi kehte hain: Chunanche woh ladne nikle. Jab jang khatam hui to Abdullah (RA) ne kaha [Bahr At-Tawil, shayri ka ek wazan]: "Agar tum Jamal (ke din) mere maqaam ko aur Siffin mein ek din meri haazri ko dekhte, jis se chotiyon ke baal safed ho gaye, us shaam jab Iraq waale aaye goya bahaar ke baadal the jinhe janubi hawaon ne jhakjhor diya ho. Jab main kehta ke woh tezi se bhaag gaye, to unke kuch daste hamare saamne jam gaye aur kuch daste bhari ho kar dat gaye. Unhone humse kaha: hum samajhte hain ke tum Ali (RA) se bay'ah karo. Humne kaha: balki hum samajhte hain ke tum aapas mein ladd..." (Yeh riwayat yahin adhoori reh jaati hai.)

e: [AI] We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a battle, and the people got scared. So, I went out with my weapon, and I saw Salim, the servant of Abu Hudhayfah, with his weapon walking calmly. I said, "I will follow the example of this righteous man." He came and sat by the door of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I sat with him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out angrily and said, "O people, what is this indecision? What is this negligence? Have you become so weak that you cannot do what these two believing men have done?"
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath ek ghazwe mein the. Logon mein ghabrahat phail gayi, to main apna hathiyar lekar nikla. Maine Salim mawla Abu Hudhaifah (RA) ko dekha ke woh hathiyar lagaye sukoon ke saath chal rahe the. Maine kaha: "Main is nek aadmi ki iqtida zaroor karunga." Woh aaye aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke darwaze ke paas baith gaye, aur main bhi unke saath baith gaya. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) naraazgi ke saath bahar tashreef laaye aur farmaya: "Ae logon! Yeh halka-pan kaisa, yeh aish-pasandi kaisi? Kya tum aajiz ho gaye ke woh na karo jo in do momin mardon ne kiya?"

e: [AI] I was with my parents in the neighborhood when a man approached. When the people saw him, they gathered around him. I was among those who approached his gathering, so I said, "Who is this man?" They said, "This is Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-Aas."
hi: Main apne walid ke saath Huwarin mein tha ke ek aadmi aaya. Jab logon ne use dekha to us ki taraf lapke. Raawi kehte hain: Main bhi un logon mein tha jo uski majlis ki taraf lapke. Maine poocha: "Yeh kaun hain?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas (RA) hain."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, may I take permission to write down what I hear from you?" He said, "Yes." I asked about pleasure and anger. He said, "Yes, for it is not appropriate for me to say anything except the truth in pleasure and anger." This hadith has a sound chain of narrators, but it was not mentioned in Sahih Bukhari or Sahih Muslim.
hi: Maine arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah, kya aap mujhe ijazat dete hain ke jo kuch main aapse sunun use likh liya karun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Maine kaha: "Khushi aur ghusse, dono halat mein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, kyunke mere liye munasib nahi ke main khushi aur ghusse mein haq ke siwa kuch kahun." Yeh hadith sahih ul-isnad hai, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] And where do the souls of Muslims gather? And where do the souls of polytheists gather? So Ka'b came to him and asked him, "As for the souls of Muslims, do they gather in suburbs, and as for the souls of polytheists, do they gather in Sana'a (a city in Yemen)? As for the first gathering, it is a fire that pushes people, they see it at night and do not see it during the day." So the Messenger of Ka'b returned to him and informed him of what he said, and he said, "This scholar has told the truth, so ask him."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...aur musalmanon ki roohein kahan jama hoti hain? Aur mushrikon ki roohein kahan jama hoti hain?" Woh aap (Abdullah bin Amr (RA)) ke paas aaya aur unse poocha, to unhone farmaya: "Musalmanon ki roohein Ariha mein jama hoti hain, aur mushrikon ki roohein San'a mein jama hoti hain. Rahi hashr ki pehli alamat, to woh ek aag hai jo logon ko haankegi; log use raat ko dekhenge, din ko nahi dekhenge." Ka'b ka qaasid unke paas laut kar aaya aur jo unhone kaha tha woh bataya. Ka'b ne kaha: "Unhone sach kaha, yeh aalim hain, unse poocho."

e: [AI] The name is Asmaa bint Harithah bin Hind bin Abdullah bin Ghiyath bin Saad bin Amr bin Amer bin Afsah, the servant of the Banu Harithah tribe.
hi: "Asma bin Harithah bin Hind bin Abdullah bin Ghiyath bin Sa'd bin Amr bin Aamir bin Afsa (RA), Bani Harithah ke mawla."

e: [AI] I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ on the day of Ashura and he said, "Are you fasting today, Asma?" I said, "No." He said, "Then fast." I said, "But I have already taken my meal, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Fast the remaining hours and instruct your people to fast." Asma said, "So I took my sandals in my hand and tied my saddle until I returned to my people and said, 'The Prophet ﷺ has commanded you to fast.' They said, 'But we have already eaten.' I said, 'He has commanded you to fast for the rest of the day.'"
hi: Main Ashura ke din Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Asma, kya aaj tumne roza rakha hai?" Maine kaha: "Nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To roza rakho." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, main to dopahar ka khana kha chuka hun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo din baqi hai uska roza rakho, aur apni qaum ko bhi hukm do ke woh roza rakhein." Asma (RA) kehte hain: Maine apni jootiyan haath mein uthayin aur jaldi se apni qaum ke paas pahuncha. Maine kaha: "Allah ke Nabi (SAW) tumhein roza rakhne ka hukm dete hain." Unhone kaha: "Hum to khana kha chuke hain." Maine kaha: "Aap (SAW) ne hukm diya hai ke apne din ke baqi hisse ka roza rakho."

e: [AI] Asmaa bint Haritha passed away at the age of sixty-six, when she was eighty years old.
hi: "Asma bin Harithah (RA) ki wafaat 66 Hijri mein hui aur unki umr assi (80) saal thi."

e: [AI] "I never saw anyone as committed and devoted to serving the Messenger of Allah except for Asma' and Hind, the sons of Harithah. They would constantly be at his door, serving him and in need of his assistance." (Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.)
hi: "Main Asma (RA) aur Hind (RA), Harithah ke dono beton, ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke khadimon ke siwa kuch nahi samajhta tha, kyunke woh bohot der tak aap (SAW) ke darwaze par rehte aur aap (SAW) ki khidmat karte the, aur woh dono hajatmand the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Hind bin Haritha Al-Aslami witnessed the Battle of Hudaybiyyah with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Hind bin Haritha died in Medina during the caliphate of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali. It is said that they were eight brothers, all of whom accompanied the Prophet ﷺ  and witnessed the Pledge of Ridwan. Their names are Asma, Hind, Khirash, Du'aib, Humran, Fadala, Salama, and Malik bin Haritha bin Sa'id.
hi: Hind bin Harithah Al-Aslami (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath Hudaibiyah mein shareek hue, aur Hind bin Harithah (RA) ki wafaat Madinah mein Amir al-Mu'minin Ali (RA) ki khilafat mein hui. Kaha jaata hai ke woh aath bhai the, sab ne Nabi (SAW) ki suhbat paayi aur Bay'at-e-Ridwan mein shareek hue. Woh yeh hain: Asma, Hind, Khirash, Dhu'aib, Humran, Fadalah, Salamah aur Malik (RA), Harithah bin Sa'id ke bete.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ sent a man who had embraced Islam on the day of Ashura, and he said, "Whoever has eaten or drank, let him complete his fast, and whoever has not eaten, let him fast for the rest of the day." It has been mentioned before that Asmaa' was the messenger in this narration, and it is also narrated that it was Hind.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Aslam ke ek aadmi ko Ashura ke din bheja aur farmaya: "Jisne kha pi liya woh apna roza poora kare, aur jisne nahi khaya woh apne din ke baqi hisse ka roza rakhe." Pehle yeh riwayat guzar chuki hai ke is paighaam ke qaasid Asma (RA) the, aur yeh bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai ke woh Hind (RA) the.

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  sent him on the day of Ashura and he said, 'Command your people to fast on this day.' He asked, 'What if I find them already eating?' The Prophet ﷺ  replied, 'Then they should complete their fast until the end of the day.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unhe Ashura ke din bheja aur farmaya: "Apni qaum ko hukm do ke woh aaj ke din roza rakhein." Unhone arz kiya: "Ya Rasulullah, agar main unhe is haal mein paun ke woh khana kha chuke hon?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To woh apne din ka aakhiri hissa poora karein."

e: [AI] "Sulaiman bin Surad bin al-Jawn bin Abi al-Jawn, also known as Abu Mutarif, embraced Islam and was a companion of the Prophet ﷺ. His original name was Yasar, but when he embraced Islam, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ renamed him Sulaiman. He held a high position and honor among his people. He lived in Kufa when the Muslims settled there, and he fought alongside Amir al-Mu'minin Ali in the Battle of Siffin. After that, he left to seek the blood of Imam Hussein bin Ali and under his banner, he led four thousand men. Sulaiman bin Surad was killed in that incident, and his head was carried to Marwan bin al-Hakam. Sulaiman was ninety-three years old at the time of his death."
hi: "Sulaiman bin Surad bin Al-Jaun bin Abi Al-Jaun, yaani Abd al-Uzza bin Munqidh bin Rabi'ah (RA), kunyat Abu Mutarrif. Woh Islam laaye aur Nabi (SAW) ki suhbat paayi. Unka naam Yasar tha; jab woh Islam laaye to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Sulaiman rakha. Woh umr-rasida aur apni qaum mein izzat waale the. Jab musalmanon ne Kufa aabad kiya to woh wahin muqeem hue, aur Amir al-Mu'minin Ali (RA) ke saath Siffin mein shareek hue. Phir woh Husain bin Ali (RA) ke khoon ka badla lene nikle, aur unke jhande tale chaar hazaar aadmi the. Sulaiman bin Surad us jang mein qatl hue aur unka sar Marwan bin Al-Hakam ke paas bheja gaya. Jis din woh qatl hue unki umr tirasi (93) saal thi."

e: [AI] "That Sulaiman ibn Surad killed Ubaidullah ibn Ziyad."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke Sulaiman bin Surad ne Ubaidullah bin Ziyad ko qatl kiya."

e: [AI] Sulaiman ibn Surad killed Ubaidullah ibn Ziyad.
hi: "Sulaiman bin Surad ne Ubaidullah bin Ziyad ko qatl kiya."

e: [AI] Abu Shurayh Ka'ab ibn Amr al-Khuzaai died in the year sixty-eight and his name is different in it. It has been said that his name is Khwailid ibn Amr.
hi: "Abu Shuraih Ka'b bin Amr Al-Khuza'i (RA) ki wafaat 68 Hijri mein hui. Unke naam mein ikhtilaf hai; kaha gaya hai ke unka naam Khuwailid bin Amr hai."

e: [AI] "Nouman bin Bashir bin Saad bin Tha'laba bin Khilas bin Zaid bin Malik Al-Aghar bin Tha'laba bin Ka'b bin Al-Khazraj bin Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj and his mother was 'Amrah bint Rawaha, the sister of Abd Allah bin Rawaha. Nouman's son was named Abd Allah and he was also known as Abu Abd Allah."
hi: "An-Nu'man bin Bashir bin Sa'd bin Tha'labah bin Khilas bin Zaid bin Malik Al-Aghar bin Tha'labah bin Ka'b bin Al-Khazraj bin Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj (RA). Unki walida Amrah bint Rawahah (RA) thin, jo Abdullah bin Rawahah (RA) ki behen thin. An-Nu'man (RA) ke ghar Abdullah paida hue, aur unhi ki nisbat se unki kunyat Abu Abdullah thi."

e: [AI] We sat with him and he mentioned the first newborn among the Ansar after the arrival of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Madinah. He said, "Nu'man ibn Bashir was born after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived in Madinah by a year or less." They mentioned Abdullah ibn Abi Talha, and he said, "If Umm Sulaim had been pregnant with him and gave birth after the arrival in Madinah."
hi: Hum unke paas baithe to unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke Madinah aane ke baad Ansaar mein pehle paida hone waale bachche ka zikr kiya, aur kaha: "An-Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke Madinah aane ke ek saal baad ya usse bhi kam muddat baad paida hue." Raawi kehte hain: Logon ne Abdullah bin Abi Talha (RA) ka zikr kiya to unhone kaha: "(Woh tab pehle hote) agar Umm Sulaim (RA) unse hamila hoti aur Madinah aane ke baad unhone unhe janam diya hota."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Musfir say, "Nu'aman ibn Bashir was killed between Sulamiyya and Hims. He was killed as a warrior."
hi: Maine Abu Mushir ko kehte suna: "An-Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) Salamiyyah aur Hims ke darmiyan qatl kiye gaye; unhe dhoke se (ghafil pakad kar) qatl kiya gaya."

e: [AI] "He fled from Homs and was working there, so he got scared and prayed for the son of Zubair. The people of Homs sought him and killed him and kept his head." This narration has been authenticated in Sahihain by hearing it from Nu'man ibn Bashir from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke woh Hims se bhaag jaaye, aur woh wahan ke haakim the. Woh dar gaye aur Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ke liye (bay'ah ki) dawat di. To Hims waalon ne unhe talaash kiya, unhe qatl kar diya aur unka sar kaat liya." Aur Sahihain mein sahih riwayaton se sabit hai ke An-Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se (ahadees) suni hain.

e:
[AI] "We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and we heard him saying,  
'Indeed, before the Hour there will be trials like pieces of the dark night. A man will wake up in the morning as a believer, but by evening he will be a disbeliever. And he will go to sleep as a believer, but wake up as a disbeliever. People will sell their religion for a worldly gain, albeit insignificant.'

Al-Hasan said, 'By Allah, we have seen them with our own eyes; they are like bodies without intellects, like fireflies and locusts. They go out with two Dirhams and return with two Dirhams. One of them sells his religion for the price of a goat.'"

Ad-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing this saying.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath rahe, to humne aap (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Qiyamat se pehle aise fitne honge jaise andheri raat ke tukde; aadmi subah ko momin hoga to shaam ko kafir, aur shaam ko momin hoga to subah ko kafir. Kuch log un fitnon mein dunya ke thode se saaz-o-saman ke badle apna hissa-e-aakhirat bech denge." Al-Hasan ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, humne unhe dekha hai: shaklein bagair aqal ke, jism bagair samajh ke, aag ke parwane aur lalach ki makkhiyan; do dirham ke liye subah jaate hain aur do dirham ke saath shaam ko lautte hain; unmein se ek apna deen bakri ki qeemat par bech deta hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Waqid Al-Laithi, his name is Al-Harith bin Awf bin Usaid bin Jabir bin Abdah bin Manat bin Yashju'a bin 'Amir bin Laith."
hi: "Abu Waqid Al-Laithi (RA) ka naam Al-Harith bin Auf bin Usaid bin Jabir bin Abdah Manat bin Yashju' bin Aamir bin Laith (RA) hai."

e: [AI] I heard Sa'id bin Kathir bin 'Ufair saying, "Abu Waqid Al-Laythi, Al-Harith bin 'Awf bin Usaid bin Jabir bin 'Awthar bin 'Abdinanah bin Yashju'a bin 'Amir was an early Muslim. He had the banner of Banu Layth, Wadhi'marah, and Sa'd bin Bakr on the day of the conquest (of Mecca). Abu Waqid remained after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for some time, then he went to Mecca, stayed there for a year, and died there."
hi: Maine Sa'id bin Kathir bin Ufair ko kehte suna: "Abu Waqid Al-Laithi (RA), yaani Al-Harith bin Auf bin Usaid bin Jabir bin Authrah bin Abd Manat bin Yashju' bin Aamir (RA), qadeem-ul-Islam the. Fath-e-Makkah ke din Bani Laith, Damrah aur Sa'd bin Bakr ka jhanda unke paas tha. Abu Waqid (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad ek muddat tak rahe, phir Makkah chale gaye aur wahan ek saal mujawir rahe aur wahin wafaat paayi."

e: [AI] "We returned Laythiy to his illness in which he died, and he died so we buried him in Makkah in the cemetery of the muhajireen with a stone. Indeed, it was named the cemetery of the muhajireen because those who came to Madinah, performed Hajj and stayed there until they died in Makkah were buried in this cemetery. Among them were Abu Waqid al-Laythi, Abdullah ibn Umar, and others. Abu Waqid al-Laythi died in the year sixty-eight when he was eighty-five years old."
hi: "Humne Al-Laithi (RA) ki us bimari mein iyadat ki jismein unki wafaat hui, aur woh faut ho gaye, to humne unhe Makkah mein Fakh ke maqam par Muhajireen ke qabristan mein dafn kiya. Is qabristan ko Muhajireen ka qabristan isliye kaha gaya ke usmein woh log dafn hote the jo Madinah aaye, phir Hajj kiya aur Makkah mein mujawir reh kar wahin faut hue. Isi qabristan mein Abu Waqid Al-Laithi (RA), Abdullah bin Umar (RA) aur dusre dafn hue. Abu Waqid Al-Laithi (RA) ki wafaat 68 Hijri mein hui aur unki umr pachasi (85) saal thi."

e: [AI] I was sitting next to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, my knee touching his knee. Then a man came to him, and he swallowed his ear, so the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed and blood started to flow to his cheeks. Then he said, "This is Rassul Amr ibn al-Tufayl, threatening me and threatening those who seek refuge with me, while Allah Almighty has sufficed me with the children of Ismail and the bani Qaylah," referring to the Ansar.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas baitha tha, mera ghutna aap (SAW) ke ghutne se lag raha tha, ke ek aane waala aaya aur aap (SAW) ke kaan ke qareeb apna munh kar liya (sargoshi ki). Rasulullah (SAW) ka chehra badal gaya aur khoon aap (SAW) ke chehra-e-mubarak ki shikanon tak chadh aaya. Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh Aamir bin At-Tufayl ka qaasid hai, mujhe aur un logon ko jo meri panah mein hain dhamka raha hai, aur Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe uske liye Ismail ki aulaad aur Bani Qailah ke zariye kafi kar diya." Yani Ansaar ke zariye.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the people who have high moral values will have stations in Paradise." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak mere minbar ke paaye jannat mein jame hue (mazboot) hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Zaid bin Arqam bin Zaid bin Qais bin Nu'man bin Malik bin Al-Aghar bin Tha'laba bin Kaab bin Al-Khazraj, who was also known as Abu Amr, died in Kufa during the time of Al-Mukhtar bin Abi Ubaid in the year eighty-six."
hi: "Zaid bin Arqam bin Zaid bin Qais bin An-Nu'man bin Malik bin Al-Aghar bin Tha'labah bin Ka'b bin Al-Khazraj (RA). Unki kunyat Abu Amr thi. Unki wafaat Kufa mein Al-Mukhtar bin Abi Ubaid ke daur mein 68 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] I said to Zaid ibn Arqam, "O Abu Amr."
hi: Maine Zaid bin Arqam (RA) se kaha: "Ae Abu Amr!"

e: [AI] The people went out seeking rain, and among them was Zaid bin Arqam. There was only one person between me and him, so I said to him: "O Abu Amr, how many battles did the Prophet ﷺ  fight?" He said: "Nineteen." I said: "And how many battles did you fight with him?" He said: "Seventeen."
hi: Log baarish ki dua (istisqa) ke liye nikle, aur unmein Zaid bin Arqam (RA) bhi the, mere aur unke darmiyan sirf ek aadmi tha. Maine unse kaha: "Ae Abu Amr, Nabi (SAW) ne kitne ghazwe kiye?" Unhone kaha: "Unnees (19)." Maine kaha: "Aur aap ne aap (SAW) ke saath kitne ghazwe kiye?" Unhone kaha: "Satrah (17)."

e: [AI] We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until we reached Ghadir Khumm. He ordered for a podium to be prepared, and in a day that was hotter than any other day, he thanked and praised Allah and said, "O people, no prophet was sent except that he lived half the lifespan of the prophet who came before him. And surely, I am about to be called, and I will answer. I am leaving behind among you that which if you hold onto, you shall never go astray: the Book of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic." Then he stood and took the hand of Ali and said, "O people, who has more authority over you than yourselves?" They said, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "Am I not more deserving of you than yourselves?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Whoever I am his master, then Ali is his master."
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath nikle, yahan tak ke Ghadir Khumm pahunche. Aap (SAW) ne ek bade darakht ke neeche ki jagah saaf karne ka hukm diya; us din itni sakht garmi thi ke humpar is se zyada garam din kabhi nahi guzra. Aap (SAW) ne Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki aur farmaya: "Ae logon! Jab bhi koi Nabi bheja gaya to us ki umr apne se pehle waale Nabi ki umr se aadhi hi rahi. Aur main qareeb hun ke bulaya jaun aur labbaik kahun. Aur main tumhare darmiyan woh cheez chhod kar ja raha hun jiske baad tum kabhi gumrah nahi hoge: Allah Ta'ala ki kitaab." Phir aap (SAW) khade hue, Ali (RA) ka haath pakda aur farmaya: "Ae logon! Tumhari jaanon se zyada tum par haq kis ka hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhari jaanon se zyada tum par haq nahi rakhta?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main jiska maula hun, Ali (RA) bhi uske maula hain."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  passed away when I was fifteen years old." This is narrated by Ibrahim bin Tahman, Abu Dawud al-Tayalisi, and Al-Walid bin Khalid, on the authority of Shu'bah. As for the narration of Abu Dawud, it is as follows."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ka wisaal hua aur meri umr pandrah (15) saal thi." Isi tarah ise Ibrahim bin Tahman, Abu Dawud At-Tayalisi aur Al-Walid bin Khalid ne Shu'bah se riwayat kiya hai. Rahi Abu Dawud ki hadith (to woh yeh hai):

e: [AI] "Shu'bah narrated"
hi: Hamse Shu'bah ne bayan kiya.

e: Staying at Al-Mahassab is not one of the ceremonies (of Hajj), but Al-Mahassab is a place where Messenger of Allah ﷺ camped (during his Hajjat-al-Wida). (Using translation from Bukhārī 1766)
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) Ibn Abbas (RA) se.

e: Staying at Al-Mahassab is not one of the ceremonies (of Hajj), but Al-Mahassab is a place where Messenger of Allah ﷺ camped (during his Hajjat-al-Wida). (Using translation from Bukhārī 1766)
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) Ibn Abbas (RA) se.

e: [AI] "Abu Al-Abbas Abdullah ibn Abbas died at the age of seventy-one, and he was born in the Shi'b before the migration by three years."
hi: "Abu Al-Abbas Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ki wafaat hui to unki umr ikahattar (71) saal thi. Woh hijrat se teen saal pehle Shi'b (Abu Talib ki ghaati) mein paida hue the."

e: [AI] I said to Ibn Abbas, "O Abu Abbas"
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) se kaha: "Ae Abu Al-Abbas!"

e: [AI] "I came to the Prophet ﷺ  while he was praying late at night. I stood behind him and he took hold of my shoes and stood me up. When he finished his prayer, he asked, 'What is the matter with you? I made you stand while holding my shoes and you became quiet.' I said, 'It is not fitting for anyone to pray in your shoes, O Messenger of Allah.' He was amazed and supplicated to Allah to increase my understanding and knowledge."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, aur aap (SAW) raat ke aakhir mein namaz padh rahe the. Main aap (SAW) ke peeche khada ho gaya. Aap (SAW) ne mujhe pakad kar apne barabar khada kar diya. Jab aap (SAW) apni namaz ki taraf mutawajjeh hue to main peeche hat gaya. Namaz se farigh ho kar aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tujhe kya hua? Main tujhe apne barabar khada karta hun aur tu peeche hat jata hai?" Maine kaha: "Kisi ke liye munasib nahi ke woh aapke barabar namaz padhe, jabke aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Aap (SAW) ko yeh baat pasand aayi, to aap (SAW) ne Allah se dua ki ke woh mujhe fahm aur ilm mein izafa ata farmaye.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in the house of Maymuna, so she set out water for him. Maymuna said to him, "Abdullah ibn Abbas has set out water for you." He then said, "O Allah, grant him understanding of the religion and teach him interpretation."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Maymunah (RA) ke ghar mein the. Unhone aap (SAW) ke liye wudu ka paani rakha. Maymunah (RA) ne aap (SAW) se kaha: "Abdullah bin Al-Abbas ne aapke liye wudu ka paani rakha hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Allah, ise deen ki samajh ata farma aur ise tawil (Quran ki tafseer) sikha."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The most compassionate of my nation towards it is Abu Bakr, and the strictest in following the command of Allah is Umar, and the most modest of them is Uthman, and the most knowledgeable of the recitation of the Quran is Ubay bin Ka'b, and the most comprehensive in understanding it is Zaid bin Thabit, and the most just in ruling is Ali bin Abi Talib, and the most knowledgeable in lawful and unlawful matters is Mu'adh bin Jabal, and the most truthful in speech is Abu Dhar, and the most reliable person in this nation is Abu Ubaidah bin al-Jarrah, and the most knowledgeable scholar of this nation is Abdullah bin Abbas." Kauthar bin Hakim is unreliable.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri ummat mein sabse zyada raheem Abu Bakr (RA) hain, Allah ke hukm mein sabse zyada sakht Umar (RA) hain, sabse zyada haya waale Uthman (RA) hain, sabse behtar qari Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) hain, faraiz (wirasat ke ahkam) ke sabse bade jaanne waale Zaid bin Thabit (RA) hain, sabse behtar faisla karne waale Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) hain, halal aur haram ko sabse zyada jaanne waale Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) hain, bol-chaal mein sabse zyada sachche Abu Dharr (RA) hain, is ummat ke amaanatdaar Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (RA) hain, aur is ummat ke bade aalim Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) hain." Kauthar bin Hakim saaqit (nihayat kamzor, radd kiye gaye) hain.

e: [AI] It was mentioned to Jabir about the red meat and he said: "That sea, meaning Ibn Abbas, recited: 'Say, "I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it"' (Quran 6:145)." Al-Dhahabi did not comment on it in his summary.
hi: Jabir (RA) ke saamne paaltu gadhon ke gosht ka zikr hua. Unhone kaha: "Is se us 'samundar' ne inkaar kiya" yani Ibn Abbas (RA) ne, aur unhone yeh ayat padhi: {Kah do: jo wahi meri taraf bheji gayi hai usmein main kisi cheez ko haram nahi paata} (Surah Al-An'am 145). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas used to be called "the sea" due to his vast knowledge.
hi: "Ibn Abbas (RA) ko unke bohot ilm ki wajah se 'Al-Bahr' (samundar) kaha jata tha."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas was the scholar of this nation.
hi: "Ibn Abbas (RA) is ummat ke bade aalim the."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas was called the sea due to the abundance of his knowledge.
hi: "Ibn Abbas (RA) ko unke bohot ilm ki wajah se 'Al-Bahr' (samundar) kaha jata tha."

e: [AI] I accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  one night to the mosque and he performed the last Isha prayer until there was no one left in the mosque except him. He then passed by me and asked, "Who is this?" I replied, "Abdullah." He said, "Welcome." I said, "My father has commanded me to stay with you tonight." He said, "Really?" When he entered, he said, "Make way for the slave of Allah." I brought a cushion made of palm fibers for him. Abbas approached me and said, "Do not sleep until you have memorized his prayer." The Prophet ﷺ  approached and slept until I heard him snoring. Then he sat on his bed and raised his head towards the sky and said, "Glory be to the Holy King" three times. Then he recited the following verse from the last part of Surah Al-Imran until the end, "Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth" (Quran 2:164). Then he stood up and performed ablution with his siwak, then he entered his prayer area and performed two units of prayer that were neither too short nor too long. He said, "I prayed" and then performed the Witr prayer. After completing it, I heard him saying, "O Allah, make light in my sight, make light in my hearing, make light in my tongue, make light in my heart, make light on my right, make light on my left, make light in front of me, make light behind me, make light above me, make light below me, and make the day I meet You a light-filled day. Make the light greater for me."
hi: Maine ek raat Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghar waalon ke yahan guzari. Main masjid ki taraf gaya to Rasulullah (SAW) ne Isha ki namaz padhi, yahan tak ke masjid mein aap (SAW) ke siwa koi baqi na raha. Phir aap (SAW) mere paas se guzre aur farmaya: "Yeh kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Abdullah." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya baat hai?" Maine kaha: "Mere walid ne mujhe hukm diya ke aaj raat main aapke yahan guzaru." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "To aa jao." Jab aap (SAW) andar dakhil hue to farmaya: "Abdullah ke liye bistar bichha do." Raawi kehte hain: Mere paas ek mote kapde (tat) ka takiya laya gaya. Aur Abbas (RA) ne mujhe pehle hi hidayat ki thi ke jab tak aap (SAW) ki namaz yaad na kar lo, soona nahi. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) tashreef laaye aur so gaye, yahan tak ke maine aap (SAW) ke kharraton ki awaaz suni. Phir aap (SAW) apne bistar par seedhe baithe, aasman ki taraf sar uthaya aur teen baar farmaya: "Subhan al-Malik al-Quddus". Phir Surah Aal-e-Imran ke aakhir ki yeh ayat shuru se aakhir tak padhi: {Beshak aasmanon aur zameen ki takhleeq mein} (hawala text mein Surah Al-Baqarah 164 likha hai). Phir uthe, peshab kiya, phir miswak kiya, phir wudu kiya, phir apni namaz ki jagah gaye aur do rakat namaz padhi jo na bohot mukhtasar thi na bohot lambi, phir witr padha. Jab namaz se farigh hue to maine aap (SAW) ko yeh dua karte suna: "Ae Allah, meri nigaah mein noor rakh de, meri sama'at mein noor rakh de, meri zubaan mein noor rakh de, mere dil mein noor rakh de, mere daayen noor rakh de, mere baayen noor rakh de, mere aage noor rakh de, mere peeche noor rakh de, mere upar noor rakh de, mere neeche noor rakh de, aur apne milne ke din mere liye noor rakh de, aur mere liye noor ko bada kar de."

e: [AI] Al-Abbas sent his son Abdullah to the Prophet ﷺ, and he slept behind him. There was a man with the Prophet ﷺ, so the Prophet ﷺ turned and said, "When did you come, my beloved?" Abdullah said, "Just an hour ago." The Prophet ﷺ asked, "Did you see anyone?" Abdullah replied, "Yes, I saw a man." The Prophet ﷺ said, "That was Gabriel, peace be upon him, and no one except me can see him except if he is a Prophet. However, it is strange that this happened at the end of your life." Then the Prophet ﷺ said, "O Allah, teach him interpretation and grant him understanding in religion, and make him among the people of faith."
hi: Abbas (RA) ne apne bete Abdullah ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas bheja. Woh aap (SAW) ke peeche so gaye, aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek aadmi tha. Nabi (SAW) ne mud kar farmaya: "Ae mere piyare, tum kab aaye?" Unhone kaha: "Ek ghadi se." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumne mere paas kisi ko dekha?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, maine ek aadmi dekha." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh Jibreel (AS) the, aur unhe meri chacha ke siwa koi makhluq nahi dekhta, siwaye Nabi ke; lekin yeh tumhari aakhri umr mein hoga." Phir farmaya: "Ae Allah, ise tawil sikha, ise deen ki samajh ata farma aur ise ahl-e-iman mein se bana."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  entered the exit, and there was a curtain. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  asked, "Who made this?" I said, "I did." Then the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "O Allah, teach him the interpretation of the Quran."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) qaza-e-haajat ki jagah gaye to wahan ek dhaka hua bartan (paani ka) rakha tha. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh kisne rakha?" Maine kaha: "Maine." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Allah, ise Quran ki tawil sikha."

e: [AI] "That Ibn Abbas witnessed our era; none of us lived as long as him."
hi: (Riwayat hai ke) agar Ibn Abbas (RA) hamari umar ko pahunchte to hum mein se koi unke dasve hisse tak bhi na pahunchta.

e:
[AI] I heard a man speaking like him, if a Persian and a Roman heard him, they would have converted to Islam."

(Dhzahabi remained silent about it in his summary.)
hi: Maine kisi aise aadmi ka kalaam suna ke agar Faaris aur Room use sun lete to zaroor Islam le aate. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Yes, the interpreter of the Quran is Ibn Abbas."
hi: "Haan, Quran ke tarjuman Ibn Abbas (RA) hain."

e: [AI] "I performed the Hajj pilgrimage with my companion and Ibn Abbas. He (Ibn Abbas) started reciting Surah An-Nur and explaining it. My companion exclaimed, 'Glory be to Allah! What great knowledge this man possesses! If people were to hear this discourse, they would certainly embrace Islam.'"
hi: Maine, mere ek saathi ne aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ne Hajj kiya. Woh Surah An-Nur padhne aur uski tafseer karne lage. Mere saathi ne kaha: "Subhan Allah! Is aadmi ke sar se kya nikal raha hai! Agar Turk yeh sunte to zaroor Islam le aate."

e: [AI] "I witnessed a gathering of Ibn Abbas that if all of Quraysh boasted about it, it would be a pride for them. I saw people gathering until the path became narrow for them, and no one could enter or leave. So I entered and informed him that it seemed as if they were at his door. He said to me, 'Bring me ablution water.' So he performed ablution, sat down, and told me to go out and say to them, 'Whoever wants to ask about the Quran, its letters, and what he desires from it, let him enter.' So I went out and announced, and they entered until the house and room were filled. He answered their questions and provided them with additional knowledge. Then he said, 'You are all brothers.' They left, and he told me to go out and say, 'Whoever wants to ask about what is permissible and forbidden, and jurisprudence, let him enter.'
