So I went out and announced, and they entered until the house and room were filled. He answered their questions and provided them with additional knowledge. Then he said, 'You are all brothers.' They left, and he told me to go out and say, 'Whoever wants to ask about obligations and similar matters, let him enter.' So I went out and announced, and they entered until the house and room were filled. He answered their questions and provided them with additional knowledge. Then he said, 'You are all brothers.' They left, and he told me to go out and say, 'Whoever wants to ask about the Arabic language, poetry, and strange speech, let him enter.' So I went out and announced, and they entered until the house and room were filled. He answered their questions and provided them with additional knowledge. Abu Salih said, 'If all of Quraysh were to boast about this, it would be a pride for them.' He said, 'I have not seen anyone like him among the people.'" (The narration ends here according to Al-Dhahabi)
hi: Abu Salih ne kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ki ek aisi majlis dekhi ke agar tamam Quraish us par fakhr karte to unke liye fakhr ki baat hoti. Maine dekha ke log itne jama hue ke raasta tang ho gaya, aur koi na aa sakta tha na ja sakta tha. Main unke paas gaya aur unhe khabar di ke goya log unke darwaze par hain. Unhone mujhse kaha: "Mere liye wudu ka paani rakho." Phir unhone wudu kiya, baithe, aur mujhse kaha: "Jao aur unse kaho: jo Quran, uske huroof aur uske maqsood ke baare mein poochna chahta hai woh andar aa jaye." Main nikla aur unhe ijazat di. Woh andar aaye, yahan tak ke ghar aur hujra bhar gaye. Unhone jo bhi poochha, Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unhe bataya aur utna hi ya usse zyada izafa bhi kiya. Phir kaha: "Apne bhaiyon ke liye jagah chhodo." Woh nikal gaye. Phir mujhse kaha: "Jao aur kaho: jo halal, haram aur fiqh ke baare mein poochna chahta hai woh andar aa jaye." Main nikla aur unse kaha. Woh andar aaye, yahan tak ke ghar aur hujra bhar gaye. Unhone jo bhi poochha, unhe bataya aur utna hi izafa kiya. Phir kaha: "Apne bhaiyon ke liye jagah chhodo." Woh nikal gaye. Phir mujhse kaha: "Jao aur kaho: jo faraiz aur unse milti julti cheezon ke baare mein poochna chahta hai woh andar aa jaye." Main nikla aur unhe ijazat di. Woh andar aaye, yahan tak ke ghar aur hujra bhar gaye. Unhone jo bhi poochha, unhe bataya aur utna hi izafa kiya. Phir kaha: "Apne bhaiyon ke liye jagah chhodo." Woh nikal gaye. Phir mujhse kaha: "Jao aur kaho: jo Arabi zubaan, shayri aur anokhe alfaaz ke baare mein poochna chahta hai woh andar aa jaye." Woh andar aaye, yahan tak ke ghar aur hujra bhar gaye. Unhone jo bhi poochha, unhe bataya aur utna hi izafa kiya. Abu Salih ne kaha: Agar tamam Quraish us par fakhr karte to unke liye fakhr ki baat hoti. Phir kaha: Maine logon mein se kisi ke liye aisa nahi dekha. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, I said to a man from the Ansar, "Come, let us seek knowledge, for the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ are still alive." He said in astonishment, "O Ibn Abbas, don't you see that people are in need of you? And among the people, are there any companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" I left that and approached to seek knowledge. If a hadith reached me from a person who heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I would go to him and sit at his door, with the wind blowing on my face. He would come out and say, "O cousin of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, what brings you here? What do you need?" I would say, "I have heard a hadith that was narrated to me from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." He would say, "Why didn't you send for me?" And I would say, "I am more entitled to come to you." So that man remained until the people gathered around me, and he said, "This young man was more intelligent than me."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal hua to maine Ansaar ke ek aadmi se kaha: "Aao, ae falaan, hum ilm talab karein, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ke ashaab abhi zinda hain." Usne kaha: "Ae Ibn Abbas, tumpar hairat hai! Tum samajhte ho ke log tumhari taraf mohtaj hain, jabke logon mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke itne ashaab maujood hain?" Maine woh baat chhod di aur ilm ki talab mein lag gaya. Agar mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ke kisi sahabi ke baare mein pata chalta ke unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se koi hadith suni hai, to main unke paas jata aur unke darwaze par baith jata, aur hawa mere chehre par mitti udati. Woh nikalte aur kehte: "Ae Rasulullah (SAW) ke chacha ke bete, aap kyun aaye? Aapko kya zaroorat hai?" Main kehta: "Mujhe ek hadith pahunchi hai jo aap Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat karte hain." Woh kehte: "Aapne mujhe bula kyun nahi liya?" Main kehta: "Main zyada haq rakhta hun ke aapke paas aaun." Phir woh aadmi (Ansari) zinda raha, yahan tak ke log mere gird jama hone lage, to usne kaha: "Yeh naujawan mujhse zyada aqalmand tha."

e: That 'Ali burnt some people who apostasized from Islam. This news reached Ibn 'Abbas, so he said: "If it were me I would have killed them according to the statement of Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever changes his religion then kill him.' And I would not have burned them because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Do not punish with the punishment of Allah.' So this reached 'Ali, and he said: "Ibn 'Abbas has told the truth." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1458)
hi: (Ali (RA) ne murtaddon ko jala diya tha; yeh khabar Ibn Abbas (RA) tak pahunchi to unhone kaha:) "Agar main hota to unhe qatl karta, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya hai: 'Jo apna deen badle use qatl kar do.' Aur main unhe jalata nahi, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Allah ke azaab ke saath azaab na do.'" Yeh baat Ali (RA) tak pahunchi to unhone kaha: "Waih Ibn Abbas!" (tareef ka kalimah; Tirmidhi ki riwayat mein hai ke 'Ibn Abbas ne sach kaha').

e: [AI] Umar used to ask me with the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , so Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf said to him, "Do you ask him, while we have children like him?" So Umar said, "From what I know, he said," So he asked them about when the victory of Allah and the conquest will come. Some of them said, "Allah has commanded us to praise Him and seek His forgiveness." And some of them said, "We do not know." So Umar said to me, "O Ibn Abbas, what do you say?" So I said, "He is the most knowledgeable of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." And he recited the Surah until its end, "Indeed, He is the Accepting of repentance." [Al-Nasr: 3] So Umar said, "By Allah, I do not know except what you know."
hi: Umar (RA) mujhse Nabi (SAW) ke ashaab ke saath poochte the. Abd ar-Rahman bin Auf (RA) ne unse kaha: "Aap isse poochte hain jabke hamare bhi isi jaise bete hain?" Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Woh us jagah se hain jise tum jaante ho." Phir unhone sab se Surah "Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aa jaye" (An-Nasr) ke baare mein poochha. Kuch ne kaha: "Allah ne humein hukm diya hai ke hum uski hamd karein aur istighfar karein." Kuch ne kaha: "Hum nahi jaante." Phir unhone mujhse kaha: "Ae Ibn Abbas, tum kya kehte ho?" Maine kaha: "Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ke wisaal ka waqt hai." Aur unhone poori Surah padhi: {Beshak woh bohot tauba qubool karne waala hai} (Surah An-Nasr 3). To Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main is Surah ke baare mein wohi jaanta hun jo tum jaante ho."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said regarding the Night of Decree: "Whatever you have been able to ascertain, seek it in the last ten nights. And in which odd night do you see it?" Some of them said: 'The ninth night', some said 'The seventh night', and some said 'The fifth night' and 'The third night'. He said, "What is wrong with you, Ibn Abbas, that you do not speak?" I said, "If you wish, I will speak." He said, "I did not call you except for you to speak." So I said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: 'Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, mentions the number 'seven' most.' He said: 'The heavens are seven, and the earths are seven.' And he said, 'Indeed, we have split the earth open, so We caused in it grains, grapes, green fodder, olives, dates, and gardens of dense shrubbery, and fruits, and herbage, and palm trees, and gardens of dense shrubbery, as sustenance for you and your livestock.' And the gardens of dense shrubbery are intertwined and each intertwined garden is a garden, and the herbage is whatever the earth has grown that people do not eat.' Umar said, 'Are you amazed that you say the same as this boy who has not reached the age of having wet dreams?' Then he said, 'Indeed, I forbade you from speaking, so when I call you along with them, speak.'"
hi: Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Laylat al-Qadr ke baare mein jo farmaya woh tum jaante ho: use aakhri das raton mein talash karo. To kaun si taaq raat mein tum use dekhte ho?" Kisi ne kaha: "Nauvi", kisi ne kaha: "Saatvi", "Paanchvi" aur "Teesri". Unhone kaha: "Ae Ibn Abbas, tumhein kya hua, tum kuch nahi bolte?" Maine kaha: "Agar aap chahen to bolun." Unhone kaha: "Maine tumhein bulaya hi isliye hai ke tum bolo." Maine kaha: "Main apni raaye se kahunga." Unhone kaha: "Main tumhari hi raaye poochta hun." Maine kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se suna ke Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne 'saat' ka zikr bohot kiya hai: aasman saat hain, zameenein saat hain, aur farmaya: {Humne zameen ko khoob chiray, phir usmein anaaj ugaya, angoor, sabzi, zaitoon, khajoor, ghane baagh, phal aur chara} (Surah Abasa). Hada'iq ghane (ulajhe hue) hote hain, aur har ulajha hua baagh hadiqah hai, aur 'ab' woh hai jo zameen ugati hai aur jise log nahi khate." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Kya tum is naujawan jaisi baat kehne se aajiz ho gaye jiske sar ke baal abhi barabar nahi hue?" Phir kaha: "Maine tumhein bolne se roka tha, ab jab main tumhein inke saath bulaun to bolo."

e: [AI] "That is a mature young man, indeed he has an eloquent tongue and a wise heart."
hi: "Woh bade-boodhon ka naujawan hai; beshak uski zubaan sawal karne wali aur uska dil samajhne wala hai." Iski sanad munqati (toot'ti hui) hai.

e: [AI] Regarding scholarship, it is as if we are drawing from an ocean. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...fatwa ke baare mein, goya hum samundar se chulu bhar rahe hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] So I said, "He only came at this time out of necessity." He said, "Then let him in." So he entered and said, "Won't you inform me about that man?" I said, "Which man?" He said, "Ali ibn Abi Talib." I said, "About what matter?" He said, "When will he be resurrected?" I said, "Exalted is Allah! He will be resurrected when those in the graves are resurrected." He said, "Do I not see you saying what these fools say?" So I said, "Get away from me, lest I strike you." And
hi: Maine kaha: "Woh is waqt kisi zaroorat ki wajah se hi aaya hoga, use ijazat do." Woh andar aaya aur bola: "Kya aap mujhe us aadmi ke baare mein nahi batayenge?" Maine kaha: "Kaun sa aadmi?" Usne kaha: "Ali bin Abi Talib (RA)." Maine kaha: "Unke kis maamle ke baare mein?" Usne kaha: "Woh kab uthaye jayenge?" Maine kaha: "Subhan Allah! Woh tab uthaye jayenge jab qabron mein jo hain woh uthaye jayenge." Usne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai ke aap bhi unhi ahmaq logon ki tarah kehte hain." Maine kaha: "Isse mere paas se nikal do, yeh mere paas dobara na aaye, warna main ise maarunga." Aur (adhoora jumla).

e: [AI] "That the people of Kufa had recited the Quran in such and such a way, and they praised him. May Allah have mercy on him. So I said, 'Did they differ?' He said, 'Yes.' So I said, 'What made you say that?' He said, 'Alas! How would you know?' I said, 'Because I have read the verse: "And among the people is he whose speech pleases you in worldly life, and he calls Allah to witness as to what is in his heart." [Quran 2:204]until it reached "And Allah does not like corruption." [Quran 2:205] So when they do that, the companion of the Quran does not show patience.' Then I read the verse: "When it is said to him, 'Fear Allah,' pride in the sin takes hold of him. Sufficient for him is Hellfire, and how wretched is the resting place. And there is among the people he who sells himself seeking the pleasure of Allah. And Allah is kind to [His] servants." He said, 'You have spoken the truth, and by the One in Whose hand is my soul...'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Mujhe bataya gaya ke Ahl-e-Kufa mein se itne itne logon ne Quran padha hai. To Umar (RA) ne takbeer kahi. Maine kaha: "Kya woh ikhtilaf karenge?" Unhone kaha: "Uff! Tumhein kya pata?" Phir woh naraz ho gaye aur main apne ghar aa gaya. Uske baad unhone mujhe bulwaya to maine uzr kar diya. Unhone kaha: "Main tumhein qasam deta hun ke zaroor aao." Main aaya. Unhone kaha: "Tumne kuch kaha tha?" Maine kaha: "Main Allah se istighfar karta hun, uske baad aisi baat dobara nahi karunga." Unhone kaha: "Main tumhein qasam deta hun ke jo kaha tha woh mujhe dobara batao." Maine kaha: "Mujhe likh kar bataya gaya ke itne itne logon ne Quran padha hai, to maine kaha: kya woh ikhtilaf karenge?" Unhone kaha: "Tumne kis cheez se yeh jaana?" Maine kaha: "Maine yeh ayat padhi: {Aur logon mein se woh bhi hai jiski baat tumhein dunya ki zindagi mein bhali lagti hai, aur woh apne dil ki baat par Allah ko gawah banata hai} (Surah Al-Baqarah 204) yahan tak ke yeh aayi {aur Allah fasad ko pasand nahi karta} (Surah Al-Baqarah 205). Jab woh aisa karte hain to Quran wala sabr nahi karta. Phir maine padha: {Jab us se kaha jata hai ke Allah se daro to ghuroor use gunah par ubhaar deta hai, to uske liye jahannam kaafi hai aur woh bura thikana hai. Aur logon mein se woh bhi hai jo Allah ki raza ki talash mein apni jaan bech deta hai, aur Allah bandon par bohot meharban hai}." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Tumne sach kaha, us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai."

e: [AI] "Umar said, 'I see that the Quran has become widespread among the people.' So I said, 'I do not like that, O Amir al-Mu'mineen.' He then pulled his hand away from mine and asked, 'Why did you say that?' I replied, 'Because whenever they recite it, they differ. And whenever they differ, they harm one another.' He then turned away from me and left, and I remained in his presence on a day that only Allah knows. Then His messenger, may peace be upon him, came to me at noon and said, 'Answer the Amir al-Mu'mineen.' So I went to him, and he asked, 'What did you say?' And I repeated my argument. Umar said, 'If I were to keep it hidden from the people...' and then the Dhahabi kept silent in his summary."
hi: Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Mujhe lagta hai ke Quran logon mein phail gaya hai." Maine kaha: "Ae Amir al-Mu'minin, mujhe yeh pasand nahi." Unhone mere haath se apna haath kheench liya aur kaha: "Tumne aisa kyun kaha?" Maine kaha: "Kyunke jab woh padhenge to (apni samajh se) mubahse karenge, aur jab mubahse karenge to ikhtilaf karenge, aur jab ikhtilaf karenge to ek doosre ki gardanein maarenge." Phir woh mujhse alag ho kar baith gaye aur mujhe chhod diya. Main unse ek aisa din door raha jise Allah ke siwa koi nahi jaanta. Phir Zuhr ke waqt unka qaasid mere paas aaya aur bola: "Amir al-Mu'minin ko jawab do." Main unke paas aaya to unhone poochha: "Tumne kaise kaha tha?" Maine apni baat dohrai. Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Main to is baat ko logon se chhupa kar rakhta tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was gifted a mare by the king of Persia, which he rode using a hair rope. He then put me behind him and rode with me on the back of the mare, traveling slowly. He turned to me and said, "O young boy." I replied, "Here I am, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Guard Allah, and He will guard you. Guard Allah and you will find Him in front of you. Recognize Allah in times of ease, and He will recognize you in times of difficulty. When you ask, ask Allah. And when you seek help, seek help from Allah. The pens have been lifted and the ink has dried. If the whole world gathered to benefit you with something that Allah has not decreed for you, they would not be able to do so. And if they gathered to harm you with something that Allah has not decreed for you, they would not be able to do so. If you are able to be patient in times of distress, then do so. For indeed, with patience there is relief. And know that with difficulty comes ease."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ko ek khachchari hadiya mein di gayi jo Kisra ne aap (SAW) ko bheji thi. Aap (SAW) baalon ki rassi se us par sawar hue, phir mujhe apne peeche bitha liya, aur mujhe lekar kaafi der chalte rahe. Phir mud kar farmaya: "Ae ladke!" Maine kaha: "Labbaik, ya Rasulullah." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah (ke huqooq) ki hifazat kar, woh teri hifazat karega. Allah (ke huqooq) ki hifazat kar, tu use apne saamne paayega. Khushhali mein Allah ko pehchaan, woh sakhti mein tujhe pehchanega. Jab maange to Allah se maang, aur jab madad chahe to Allah se madad maang. Qalam us sab par chal chuka jo hone wala hai. Agar saari makhlooq mil kar tujhe woh nafa dena chahe jo Allah ne tere liye muqarrar nahi kiya to woh na de sakegi, aur agar saari makhlooq mil kar tujhe woh nuqsan pahunchana chahe jo Allah ne tere liye nahi likha to woh na pahuncha sakegi. Pas agar tu yaqeen ke saath sabr ke saath amal kar sake to kar, aur agar na kar sake to sabr kar, kyunke jis cheez ko tu na-pasand karta hai us par sabr mein bohot khair hai. Aur jaan le ke madad sabr ke saath hai, aur kushaish takleef ke saath hai, aur aasani tangi ke saath hai."

e: [AI] "To me, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Preserve Allah, He will preserve you. Preserve Allah, you will find Him in front of you. Know Allah in times of ease, He will know you in times of hardship. And know that what has befallen you was not meant to miss you, and what has missed you was not meant to befall you. And know that if all the creatures were to gather to benefit you, they would not be able to benefit you except with what Allah has already decreed for you. And if they were to gather to harm you, they would not be able to harm you except with what Allah has already decreed against you. So when you ask, ask Allah, and when you seek help, seek help from Allah. And know that victory comes with patience, relief comes with affliction, and alongside hardship, there is ease. And know that the pen has run its course with that which has already been decreed." Issa bin Mohammed Al-Qurashi is not reliable.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ...mujhse Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah (ke huqooq) ki hifazat kar, woh teri hifazat karega. Allah (ke huqooq) ki hifazat kar, tu use apne saamne paayega. Khushhali mein Allah ko pehchaan, woh sakhti mein tujhe pehchanega. Aur jaan le ke jo tujhe pahunch gaya woh tujh se chookne wala nahi tha, aur jo tujh se chook gaya woh tujhe pahunchne wala nahi tha. Aur jaan le ke agar saari makhlooq is par jama ho jaye ke tujhe koi cheez de jo Allah ne tujhe dena na chaha ho to woh na de sakegi, aur agar jama ho jaye ke tujh se koi cheez hata dein jo Allah tujhe pahunchana chahta ho to woh na hata sakegi. Pas jab maange to Allah se maang, aur jab madad chahe to Allah se madad maang. Aur jaan le ke madad sabr ke saath hai, kushaish takleef ke saath hai, aur tangi ke saath aasani hai. Aur jaan le ke qalam us par chal chuka jo hone wala hai." Isa bin Muhammad Al-Qurashi qabil-e-aitemaad nahi hai.

e: [AI] "Muaawiya woke up as he heard their conversation, then he received the two corners of the Kaaba and Ibn Abbas said to him, 'Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not receive these two corners.' Mu'awiya said, 'O Ibn Abbas, there is nothing from it that is neglected.' So Ibn Abbas became restless, not leaving him whenever he placed his hand on anything from the two corners, except he would say to him, 'That's it.'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ...main un dono ki baatein sun raha tha. Mu'awiyah (RA) Baitullah ke dono rukn chhune lage to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unse kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) in dono rukn ko nahi chhuya karte the." Mu'awiyah (RA) ne kaha: "Ae Ibn Abbas, Baitullah ki koi cheez chhodi hui (matrook) nahi hai." Phir Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unka peecha nahi chhoda; jab bhi Mu'awiyah (RA) un dono rukn mein se kisi par haath rakhte, Ibn Abbas (RA) unse yahi baat kehte.

e: [AI] I heard Ibn Abbas three days before his death saying, "O Allah, I repent to You for the fatwas I used to give to people regarding exchange transactions."[^1]
hi: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko unki wafaat se teen din pehle kehte suna: "Ae Allah, main tujh se tauba karta hun us se jo main logon ko sarf (sone chaandi ki aapas ki khareed-farokht) ke baare mein fatwa diya karta tha."

e: [AI] "To have a garden of palm trees and vines, with rivers flowing underneath, and to have every kind of fruit in it." [Al-Baqarah 266] "Then it was struck by a whirlwind, in which there was a fire, and it burned." [Al-Baqarah 266] So, the people asked about it and said, "Who among you would like to have such a garden?" They said, "Allah and His Messenger know better." So, Umar became angry and said, "Say, 'We know' or 'We don't know.'" Ibn Abbas said to himself, "I know something about it, O Commander of the Believers." He said, "O nephew, speak up and do not belittle yourself." Ibn Abbas said, "It is like the deeds of a rich man who does good deeds, but then Allah sends the devil to him, and he starts doing evil deeds until all his good deeds are destroyed. He had a garden that burned down just when he needed it the most, when he had many children and reached old age." He said, "Does anyone of you want to meet Allah on the Day of Resurrection, being the poorest of all his slaves in terms of his deeds, and not having anything to present?"
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...kya tum mein se koi chahta hai ke uska khajooron aur angooron ka baagh ho jiske neeche nahar bahti ho, aur usmein uske liye har qism ke phal hon" (Surah Al-Baqarah 266) yahan tak, "...to us par ek aandhi aayi jismein aag thi aur woh jal gaya" (Surah Al-Baqarah 266). Umar (RA) ne logon se iske baare mein poochha aur kaha: "Tumhari raaye mein yeh ayat kis ke baare mein utri: {Kya tum mein se koi chahta hai ke uska baagh ho}?" Unhone kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain." Umar (RA) naraz ho gaye aur kaha: "Kaho: hum jaante hain, ya kaho: hum nahi jaante." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Ae Amir al-Mu'minin, mere dil mein iske baare mein kuch hai." Unhone kaha: "Ae mere bhateeje, kaho aur apne aap ko haqeer na samjho." Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh ek amal ki misaal bayan ki gayi hai." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ek maaldaar aadmi ke liye jo nek amal karta hai, phir Allah uske liye shaitan ko bhej deta hai aur woh gunahon mein lag jata hai, yahan tak ke uske saare amal garq kar deta hai. Uska ek baagh tha jo jal gaya jab use uski sabse zyada zaroorat thi, jab aulaad zyada ho gayi aur woh khud budhape ko pahunch gaya." Phir kaha: "Kya tum mein se koi yeh chahega ke qiyamat ke din aise bande ki tarah aaye jo apne amal ka sabse zyada mohtaj ho aur uske liye kuch bhi maujood na ho?"

e: [AI] "Glory be to Allah. Say, 'What is revealed to Ibn Abbas?' I said, 'He said, "I heard Ibn Abbas say, 'I heard Ibn Umar say, when the verse 'Verily, We have granted you Al-Kawthar (a river in Paradise)' was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'It is a river in Paradise, its banks are made of gold and it flows over pearls. Its water is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey.'" Then he said, 'By Allah, Ibn Abbas spoke the truth. Indeed, this is abundant goodness from Allah.'"'
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ..."Subhan Allah! Kaho, Ibn Abbas ki baat zaya nahi hoti." Maine kaha: "Unhone kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas ko kehte suna, unhone Ibn Umar ko kehte suna: jab {Beshak humne tumhein Kausar ata kiya} utri to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Woh jannat mein ek nahar hai, jiske dono kinare sone ke hain, woh motiyon aur yaqoot par behti hai, uska paani doodh se zyada safed aur shahed se zyada meetha hai.'" Phir unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ibn Abbas ne sach kaha, Allah ki qasam yahi khair-e-kaseer hai."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Nuaim saying, "Abdullah Ibn Abbas died in the year sixty-eight."
hi: Maine Abu Nu'aim ko kehte suna: "Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ki wafaat 68 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] And he said, "The religious clerics of this nation are doomed."
hi: Aur unhone kaha: "Is ummat ka rabbani (Allah wala aalim) chala gaya."

e: [AI] Translation: "About it, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing"
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...is se." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] "He came out of his grave, and when he was buried, this verse was recited on the edge of the grave and it is not known who recited it: 'O soul at peace, return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing. Enter among My servants and enter My Paradise.' [Surah Al-Fajr: 28] Isma'il ibn Ali and Isa ibn Ali mentioned that he was a white bird." (The narrator) Al-Dhahabi remains silent about summarizing it.
hi: (Riwayat hai ke) ek (safed parinda) unke janaze ke tabut se nikla, aur jab woh dafn kiye gaye to qabr ke kinare par yeh ayat tilawat ki gayi, aur pata nahi chala ke kisne ki: {Ae mutma'in jaan! Apne Rab ki taraf laut aa is haal mein ke tu uski raza par raazi aur woh tujh se raazi, pas mere bandon mein shamil ho ja aur meri jannat mein daakhil ho ja} (Surah Al-Fajr 27-30). Aur Ismail bin Ali aur Isa bin Ali ne zikr kiya ke woh ek safed parinda tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About him there are about four hundred Hadith.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...unse taqreeban chaar sau (400) ahadees (riwayat hain)."

e: [AI] I heard from Shu'bah, the servant of Ibn Abbas, saying: "Ibn Abbas died in the year sixty-eight in Ta'if, and he was seventy-five years old, and he used to dye his beard."
hi: Maine Shu'bah ko, jo Ibn Abbas (RA) ke mawla the, kehte suna: "Ibn Abbas (RA) ki wafaat 68 Hijri mein Taif mein hui aur unki umr pachhattar (75) saal thi, aur woh apni darhi ko peela rang dete the."

e: [AI] Yazid bin Utbah bin Abi Lahab mentioned the cloud that watered the grave of Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him. The Sea stated that Allah's mercy poured water three times and passed over the grave of Ibn Abbas. He used to inform us of this and we know it with certainty. So whoever is aware and whoever forgets, know that the sky quenches the grave with its mercy. By my life, this is a matter in the hands of the people. If the people had an opinion that they follow during engagements, they would certainly throw stones at Ibn Abbas. For his knowledge is divine and no one is equal to him during the discussions amongst the people. But you throw stones at a sheikh from the tribe of Yaman, who does not know what a fifth is to a sixth."
hi: Yazid bin Utbah bin Abi Lahab ne us badal ka zikr kiya jisne Ibn Abbas (RA) ki qabr ko sairab kiya [Bahr Al-Basit, shayri ka ek wazan]: "Allah ke aasman ne teen baar apni rahmat paani ki shakl mein barsayi, jo Ibn Abbas ki qabr par se guzri. Woh humein yeh batate the aur hum ise yaqeen se jaante the, to kisi ne yaad rakha aur kisi ne bhula diya, ke aasman qabr ko apni rahmat se sairab karta hai. Meri umar ki qasam, yeh logon ke haath mein (ek kaam) hai. Agar qaum ke paas koi raaye hoti jisse woh mushkilon mein mehfooz rehte, to unhone tumhein Ibn Abbas ke zariye nishana banaya, Allah hi ke liye unki samajh, aur kaun sa aisa aadmi hai jo khutbon ke faisle ke waqt logon mein unke jaisa ho. Lekin unhone tumhein ek aise buzurg ke zariye nishana banaya jo barkat waalon mein se tha, jise yeh pata na tha ke paanch ko chhe se kaise dohna hai."

e: [AI] "We, the Ansar, requested Umar or Uthman's ruling regarding the doubt of Ibn Abi Zanad. We walked with Abdullah Ibn Abbas and Nafar, who were companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . Ibn Abbas spoke and they discussed the Ansar and their merits, and the governor was demoted. Hassan said it was a difficult matter and we persisted in seeking it. He continued to consult them until they rose and made excuses except for Abdullah ibn Abbas, who said, 'By Allah! The Ansar have an esteemed position. They have indeed supported and sheltered (the Prophet) and their favor has been mentioned.' He also said, 'This is a poet of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  defending him.' Abdullah consistently presented comprehensive arguments that fulfilled all our needs. He found no alternative but to grant our request. He said, 'We left and Allah the Almighty had already granted our request through His words.' I held the hand of Abdullah, praised him, and prayed for him. I passed by the group in the mosque who were with him, but they did not reach the same conclusion. I said to them where they could hear, 'He was the best among you in this matter.' They replied, 'Indeed.' I said to Abdullah, 'By Allah! This is the outpouring of Prophethood and its inheritor, Ahmed ﷺ .' He replied, 'Hassan also indicated towards Abdullah Al-Bahar Al-Tweel, saying that when he spoke, he left no room for anyone else to talk. His words were concise and clear, healing the hearts. He did not leave any ambiguity or doubt in his speech. I listened to it without any difficulty, and I attained its essence without struggle, gaining its benefits without any loss."
hi: "Hum Ansaar ne Umar (RA) ya Uthman (RA) se (kuch) talab kiya" (Ibn Abi Az-Zinad ko shak hai), "to hum Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke kuch ashaab ko saath le kar chale. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne baat ki aur un logon ne bhi, unhone Ansaar aur unke manaqib ka zikr kiya, to haakim ne bahana banaya." Hassan (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh sakht maamla tha jo hum ne talab kiya tha." Raawi kehte hain: Woh unse bahas karte rahe, yahan tak ke sab uth gaye aur haakim ko ma'zoor samjha, siwaye Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ke ke unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Ansaar ka (bada) maqam hai, unhone madad ki aur panah di." Aur unki fazilat zikr ki, aur kaha: "Yeh (Hassan) Rasulullah (SAW) ke shaayar aur aap (SAW) ka difa karne waale hain." Abdullah (RA) unse aise jaame kalaam mein bahas karte rahe jo unki har zaroorat ka raasta band kar deta tha, to haakim ke paas hamari haajat poori karne ke siwa koi chaara na raha. Hassan (RA) kehte hain: Hum nikle aur Allah Ta'ala ne unke kalaam ki wajah se humari haajat poori kar di. Main Abdullah (RA) ka haath pakde unki tareef kar raha tha aur unke liye dua kar raha tha. Masjid mein un logon ke paas se guzra jo unke saath the, woh us maqam ko nahi pahunche the jahan woh pahunche. Maine unke sunte hue kaha: "Woh tum mein se hamare sabse zyada qareeb the." Unhone kaha: "Haan." Maine Abdullah (RA) se kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh nubuwwat ka baqiya hai, aur Ahmad (SAW) ka waris tum sab mein is ka sabse zyada haqdar tha." Hassan (RA) ne kaha: "Aur main Abdullah (RA) ki taraf ishara karta tha [Bahr At-Tawil, shayri ka ek wazan]: 'Jab woh bolta hai to kehne waale ke liye kuch nahi chhodta, aise alfaaz mein jinke darmiyan koi khalaa nahi dikhta. Woh kaafi hua aur seenon ki bimari ko shifa di, aur kisi maqsad waale ke liye na sanjeedagi mein na mazaq mein koi gunjaish chhodi. Main bina mashaqqat ke bulandi par chadha aur uski chotiyon tak pahunch gaya, na pasti ke saath na dushwari ke saath.'"

e: [AI] About him, al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...unse." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] It is said that he was born in the year of the Camel, at the age of thirty-six. He was the most handsome Qurashi man on earth, and he was the most respected and prayed the most. He was known as As-Sajjad (the one who prostrates frequently). And after him came the caliphate and Abbas, who was his eldest son and was called Muhammad, Obaidullah, Al-Fadl, and Lubaba, their mother was Zir'ah, the daughter of Musarih, the son of Ma'di Karib, the son of Wali'ah. Musarih was one of the four kings, not of the descendants of Abbas, Obaidullah, Al-Fadl, and Muhammad, the sons of Abdullah bin Abbas. As for Lubaba, the daughter of Abdullah bin Abbas, she was under the guardianship of Ali bin Abdullah bin Jafar bin Abu Talib. She gave birth to his children, and their names were Aqab and Asma.
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai ke woh Jamal ke saal, yaani 36 Hijri mein paida hue. Woh zameen par Quraish ke sabse khoobsurat aur sabse nikhre hue chehre waale, aur sabse zyada namaz padhne waale the, aur unhe 'As-Sajjad' (bohot sajda karne waala) kaha jata tha, aur unki nasl mein khilafat hai. Aur Abbas, jo unke sabse bade bete the aur unhi ki nisbat se unki kunyat thi, aur Muhammad, Ubaidullah, Al-Fadl aur Lubabah; in sab ki walida Zur'ah bint Musarrih bin Ma'di Karib bin Wali'ah thin, aur Musarrih chaar badshahon mein se ek the. Abbas ki nasl baqi nahi rahi. Ubaidullah, Al-Fadl aur Muhammad Abdullah bin Abbas ke bete hain. Rahi Lubabah bint Abdullah, to woh Ali bin Abdullah bin Ja'far bin Abi Talib ke nikah mein thin, unse aulaad hui aur unke bachchon ki nasl chali. Aur Asma bint Abdullah, Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Al-Abbas ke nikah mein thin, unse Hasan aur Husain paida hue, aur unki walida umm-e-walad thin.

e: [AI] "If you are patient with me for seven nights, you will not perform the prayer except while lying down, nodding your head. I will treat you and you will recover, if Allah wills. Then, I will send you to Aisha, Abu Hurairah, and others from the companions of Muhammad ﷺ , and each one will ask: 'What would you do with the prayer if I were to die in these seven nights?' So, he left his eye and did not treat it."
hi: (Tabeeb ne) unse kaha: "Agar tum mere liye saat din sabr karo ke sirf peeth ke bal let kar ishare se namaz padho, to main tumhara ilaaj karunga aur Allah Ta'ala ne chaha to tum theek ho jaoge." To unhone Aisha (RA), Abu Hurairah (RA) aur Muhammad (SAW) ke dusre ashaab ki taraf paighaam bheja; sab ne yahi kaha: "Aap bataiye, agar aap in saat dinon mein faut ho gaye to namaz ka kya karenge?" Chunanche unhone apni aankh ko chhod diya aur uska ilaaj nahi karwaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] And it is said, "Abu Amr is one of the residents of Damascus."
hi: Aur kaha jaata hai ke (unki kunyat) Abu Amr (thi), Shaam ke baashindon mein se.

e: [AI] "Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'i, nicknamed Abu Muhammad, and his residence was in Hims."
hi: "Awf bin Malik Al-Ashja'i (RA) ki kunyat Abu Muhammad thi, aur unka ghar Hims mein tha."

e: [AI] Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'iyy directed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when the Sadaqah was given to him by Abu Bakr as-Siddiq. Abu Bakr said to Awf, "Indeed, Allah the Exalted has bestowed the Sadaqah." Awf asked, "What is the Sadaqah?" Abu Bakr replied, "Forty camels from each forty camels." Awf intercepted and took a camel, but Abu Bakr intercepted him and took a camel for his own journey. Awf said, "This camel is for my journey." Abu Bakr said to him, "It is greater in reward for you, so give its right." Abu Bakr then took the camel and gave its right to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, informing him of Awf's actions and words. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Return to him and inform him that Allah has built a house for him in Jannah."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Awf bin Malik Al-Ashja'i (RA) ki taraf Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ko bheja jab sadaqa (zakat) ka hukm utra. Abu Bakr (RA) ne Awf (RA) se kaha: "Allah Ta'ala ne sadaqa utara hai." Unhone poochha: "Sadaqa kya hai?" Kaha: "Har chalees (40) unton mein ek untni." Unhone kaha: "Hum apni untniyan paish karte hain, aap ek le lijiye." Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhe dekha aur ek aisi untni li jo unki sawari ke liye thi. Awf (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh to meri sawari ki hai." Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh tumhare ajr ko zyada bada karegi." Unhone kaha: "To uska haq (hiqqah, yaani uske hisaab ka janwar) bhi saath le jao." Abu Bakr (RA) usay aur uske haq ko haankte hue Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laye aur Awf (RA) ka amal aur unki baat bataya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke paas wapis jao aur unhe khabar do ke Allah ne unke liye jannat mein ek ghar bana diya hai."

e: [AI] "Awf bin Malik al-Ashja'i witnessed the battle of Khaybar with the Muslims, and he had with him the banner of al-Ashja' on the day of the conquest of Mecca. Then Awf went to Syria during the caliphate of Abu Bakr and settled in Hims, where he remained until the beginning of the caliphate of Abd al-Malik bin Marwan. He died in the year seventy-three and was known by the nickname Abu Amr."
hi: "Awf bin Malik Al-Ashja'i (RA) musalmanon ke saath Khaibar mein shareek hue, aur Fath-e-Makkah ke din Ashja' ka jhanda unke paas tha. Phir Awf (RA) Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat mein Shaam chale gaye aur Hims mein muqeem hue, aur Abd al-Malik bin Marwan ki khilafat ke shuru tak rahe, phir 73 Hijri mein wafaat paayi. Unki kunyat Abu Amr thi."

e: [AI] "I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  during the Battle of Tabuk in the late night while he was in his tent. I greeted him and said, 'May I enter, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'Enter.' I asked him if I could bring some food, and he replied, 'Bring all of it.' Then he ﷺ  said, 'There are six things that will occur before the Day of Judgment. The first is the death of your Prophet Muhammad. Say, 'One.' I said, 'One.' The second is the conquest of Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem). Say, 'Two.' I said, 'Two.' Then he said, 'The third is the death of two individuals in which you will be affected like the shaking off dead hairs from a sheep skin. Say, 'Three.' I said, 'Three.' He continued saying, 'The fourth is the abundance of wealth among you, to the extent that a person will be given one hundred dinars and will still be discontented. Say, 'Four.' I said, 'Four.' The fifth is a trial that will come upon you until hardly a house, goat, or camel remains that will not be affected by it. Say, 'Five.' I said, 'Five.' And the sixth is a treaty that will be made between you and the Banu Asfar (Romans), and they will gather against you forces like the load of a pregnant she-camel, but then they will break the treaty and attack you with eighty banners, each banner carrying twelve thousand soldiers.' The narration was cut off by Adh-Dhahabi in his summary."
hi: Main Tabuk ke ghazwe mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aakhir-e-shab mein gaya, aap (SAW) apne khaime mein the. Maine salam kiya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, kya main andar aa jaun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aa jao." Maine kaha: "Poora ka poora?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Poora ka poora." Phir aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qiyamat se pehle chhe cheezein hain: unmein pehli tumhare Nabi ki wafaat hai, kaho: ek." Maine kaha: "Ek." "Dusri Bait al-Maqdis ki fatah hai, kaho: do." Maine kaha: "Do." Phir farmaya: "Teesri do maut (wabaa) hain jo tumhe bakriyon ki bimari (qu'as) ki tarah pakdegi, kaho: teen." Maine kaha: "Teen." Farmaya: "Chauthi, tum mein maal itna umand padega ke aadmi ko sau dinar diye jayenge aur woh phir bhi naraz rahega, kaho: chaar." Maine kaha: "Chaar." "Paanchvi ek fitna hogi jo tum mein hogi, shayad hi koi baalon ka khaima ya mitti ka ghar bachega jismein woh daakhil na ho, kaho: paanch." Maine kaha: "Paanch." "Aur chhathi ek sulah hogi jo tumhare aur Bani Al-Asfar (Roomiyon) ke darmiyan hogi, woh tumhare liye ek aurat ke hamal ki muddat tak jama honge, phir tumse dhoka karenge aur assi (80) jhande le kar aayenge, har jhande ke neeche barah hazaar (12,000) honge." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , he said, "My nation will divide into seventy-three sects, the largest of which is a group that causes trials and tribulations for my nation. They make their own opinions the basis for judging matters and they declare what is forbidden to be permissible, and what is permissible to be forbidden." The mention of this hadith was omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summarization.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Meri ummat tehattar se zyada firqon mein bant jayegi. Meri ummat ke liye sabse bada fitna un logon ka hai jo maamlaat ko apni raaye se qiyas karte hain, to haram ko halal aur halal ko haram thehrate hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The first born after the migration was Abdullah, the son of Al-Zubair, the son of Al-Awwam, the son of Khawlid, the son of Asad, the son of Abdul Aziz. His mother is Asma bint Abi Bakr As-Siddiq, and her mother is Qaylah bint Abdul Aziz, the daughter of Abdul Asad, the son of Nasr, the son of Malik, the son of Hissl, the son of Amir. Abdullah was also called Abu Bakr.
hi: "Hijrat ke baad paida hone waala sabse pehla bachcha Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr bin Al-Awwam bin Khuwailid bin Asad bin Abd al-Uzza (RA) tha. Unki walida Asma bint Abi Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) thin, aur Asma (RA) ki walida Qailah bint Abd al-Uzza bin Abd Asad bin Nasr bin Malik bin Hisl bin Aamir bin Lu'ayy thin. Abdullah (RA) ki kunyat Abu Bakr thi."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet peace be upon him named Abdullah ibn Zubair Abdullah."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) ka naam Abdullah rakha."

e: [AI] "The history was from the year in which the Prophet ﷺ migrated to Madinah and in which Abdullah Ibn Zubayr was born."
hi: "Tareekh us saal se shuru hui jis mein Nabi (SAW) Madinah tashreef laaye, aur usi saal Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) paida hue."

e: [AI] I was named after my grandfather, Abu Bakr, and I am nicknamed after him. Abdullah had two nicknames, Abu Bakr and Abu Khubayb.
hi: "Mera naam mere dada Abu Bakr (RA) ke naam par rakha gaya aur meri kunyat bhi unhi ki kunyat rakhi gayi." Abdullah (RA) ki do kunyatein thin: Abu Bakr aur Abu Khubayb.

e: [AI] Asma, the daughter of Abu Bakr, went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while she was pregnant with Abdullah ibn Zubair. She gave birth to him and then brought him to the Prophet ﷺ  to have him suckled. The Prophet ﷺ  took him and placed him in his lap, and a date was brought which the Prophet ﷺ  crushed, then he chewed it and put it in the baby's mouth to sweeten it. This was the first thing that entered his stomach, the saliva of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Asma then wiped Abdullah with a cloth and the Prophet ﷺ  named him Abdullah. Later, when Abdullah was seven or eight years old, he came to pledge allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ  at the command of his father Az-Zubair. When the Prophet ﷺ  saw him coming, he smiled and accepted his pledge. Abdullah was the first child to be born in Madinah after the arrival of the Prophet ﷺ . The Jews used to say that they would not be blessed with male offspring in Madinah, but when Abdullah was born, the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ  exclaimed in joy. Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Al-Khattab said, upon hearing the celebration in Sham for the birth of Abdullah, "Those who celebrated his birth are better than those who celebrated his death," referring to those who celebrated the killing of Abdullah ibn Zubair.
hi: Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf hijrat ke liye nikliin to woh Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) se hamila thin. Unhone unhe janam diya aur unhe Nabi (SAW) ke paas laayin taake aap (SAW) unka tahneek karein. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhe liya aur apni god mein rakh liya. Ek khajoor laayi gayi, aap (SAW) ne use choosa, phir chaba'i, phir unke munh mein daal kar unka tahneek kiya. Chunanche sabse pehli cheez jo unke pet mein gayi woh Rasulullah (SAW) ka laab-e-dahan tha. Asma (RA) kehti hain: Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke jism par haath phera aur unka naam Abdullah rakha. Phir baad mein, jab woh saat ya aath saal ke the, woh Nabi (SAW) se bay'ah karne aaye; Az-Zubayr (RA) ne unhe iska hukm diya tha. Nabi (SAW) unhe aate dekh kar muskuraye aur unse bay'ah li. Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke Madinah aane ke baad Madinah mein Islam mein paida hone waale sabse pehle bachche the. Yahood kehte the: "Humne unpar jaadu kar diya hai, ab Madinah mein unke yahan koi ladka paida nahi hoga." To jab Abdullah (RA) paida hue to Rasulullah (SAW) ke ashaab ne takbeer kahi. Aur Abdullah bin Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne, jab unhone Ahl-e-Shaam ki takbeer suni jabke unhone Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) ko qatl kar diya tha, kaha: "Jinhone unki paidaish par takbeer kahi thi woh un logon se behtar the jinhone unke qatl par takbeer kahi."

e: [AI] "He was chaste and devout in Islam, his father is Al-Zubayr and his mother is Asmaa. His grandfather is Abu Bakr and his aunt is Khadijah, his grandmother is Safiyya and his other aunt is Aisha. By Allah, I will hold myself accountable for him in a way that I did not hold myself accountable for Abu Bakr or Umar, because he intentionally acted better than all the others." Abu Ali Al-Qabbani said, "By 'Al-Humaydat' he meant Humayd ibn Zuheir ibn Al-Harith ibn Asad ibn Abdul Uzza, and by 'At-Tuwaytat' he meant Tuwayt ibn Habib ibn Asad. Al-Zubayr ibn Al-Awwam ibn Khuwaylid ibn Asad ibn Abdul Uzza" Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary.
hi: "Woh Islam mein paak-daaman aur Allah ke aage jhukne waale the. Unke walid Az-Zubayr (RA), walida Asma (RA), dada Abu Bakr (RA), phupi Khadijah (RA), dadi Safiyyah (RA) aur khala Aisha (RA) hain. Allah ki qasam, main unke baare mein apna aisa muhasaba karunga jaisa maine na Abu Bakr (RA) ke liye kiya, na Umar (RA) ke liye; lekin unhone qasd kiya aur Humaidat, Usamat aur Tuwaitat par (doosron ko) tarjeeh di." Abu Ali Al-Qabbani ne kaha: "Humaidat se unki murad Humaid bin Zuhair bin Al-Harith bin Asad bin Abd al-Uzza hai, aur Tuwait bin Habib bin Asad, aur Az-Zubayr bin Al-Awwam bin Khuwailid bin Asad bin Abd al-Uzza." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Mahā ibnu al-Zubayri nafsahu min al-dīwāni hīna qutila ʿUthmān."
hi: "Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ne Uthman (RA) ke qatl ke waqt apna naam diwan (sarkari fehrist) se mita diya."

e: [AI] Kaab narrated to me a story, and I have always found his narratives to be reliable. Except for this particular one, where he told me, "A man from Thaqif will kill me." Al-A’mash said, "And how does he know that Allah will abandon him and hide from him?" Adh-Dhahabi remained silent regarding this matter in his summary.
hi: "Ka'b ne mujhe jo bhi hadith bayan ki maine uski tasdeeq paayi, siwaye is ke ke unhone mujhe bataya tha ke Thaqif ka ek aadmi mujhe qatl karega." Al-A'mash ne kaha: "Use nahi pata ke Abu Muhammad (yani Al-Hajjaj), jise Allah ne zaleel kiya, uske liye (apni baat) chhupa kar baitha hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] It means: "It is as if he were a lion."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "goya woh Laith (sher) hai."

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi summarized.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...unse." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] I said, "I have never seen a supplicant like him, nor a worshipper like him, nor have I ever seen anyone who fears Allah like him. And I have never met a person who is more generous than him." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Maine kaha: "Maine na unke jaisa Allah se sargoshi (munajat) karne waala dekha, na unke jaisa namaz padhne waala, na Allah ke maamle mein unse zyada sakht, aur na unse zyada sakhi dil waala." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And he said, 'The simple sea has no softness for anything other than the truth, not even an ant, until the stone of the crusher becomes soft.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Aur unhone kaha [Bahr Al-Basit, shayri ka ek wazan]: "Aur main haq ke siwa kisi ke liye ek ungli bhar bhi narm nahi hota, yahan tak ke chabane waale ke daant ke liye patthar narm ho jaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] To bring him and it was said to Ibn Zubayr, "Gold shackles will be made for you, and you will wear the garment on top of them and break your oath, and making peace is better." He said, "May Allah not break his oath." Then he said, "And I will not yield except to the truth until the stone becomes soft for the tooth of the biter." Then he said, "By Allah, a strike with a sword in honor is dearer to me than a strike with a whip in humiliation." Then he called to himself and showed disagreement to Yazid ibn Muawiyah, and he ordered Yazid ibn Muawiyah to fight against the people of Medina. When he finished with that, he went to Mecca. Muslim ibn Uqbah al-Muzani was with the army of the people of Sham, and he commanded him to fight the people of Medina. When he finished with that, he went to Mecca. Muslim ibn Uqbah al-Muzani entered Medina and the remaining companions of the Prophet ﷺ fled from him on that day. He played around in Medina, indulged in killing, and then he left. When he was on his way to Mecca, he died and Husein ibn Numair al-Kindi was appointed as his successor. He said to him, "O stubborn donkey, beware of the plots of the Quraysh and do not deal with them except with hypocrisy, then go to Qift and summarize your stay there." So Husein went until he arrived in Mecca and fought against Ibn Zubayr for a few days.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ...ke use (Yazid ke paas) laya jaye. Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) se kaha gaya: "Aapke liye sone ki beriyan banwa di jayen, aap un par kapda daal lein, aur uski qasam poori ho jaye; aur sulah behtar hai." Unhone kaha: "Allah uski qasam poori na kare." Phir kaha [Bahr Al-Basit, shayri ka ek wazan]: "Aur main haq ke siwa kisi ke liye ek ungli bhar bhi narm nahi hota, yahan tak ke chabane waale ke daant ke liye patthar narm ho jaye." Phir kaha: "Allah ki qasam, izzat ke saath talwar ka ek waar mujhe zillat ke saath koray ke ek waar se zyada mehboob hai." Phir unhone apni taraf logon ko bulaya aur Yazid bin Mu'awiyah ki mukhalifat zaahir ki. Yazid bin Mu'awiyah ne Muslim bin Uqbah Al-Muzani ko Ahl-e-Shaam ke lashkar ke saath unki taraf bheja aur use Ahl-e-Madinah se ladne ka hukm diya, aur jab us se farigh ho to Makkah ki taraf chale. Raawi kehte hain: Muslim bin Uqbah Madinah mein daakhil hua; us din Rasulullah (SAW) ke ashaab ke bache hue log wahan se bhaag gaye. Usne wahan fasad machaya aur qatl mein hadd se guzar gaya. Phir wahan se nikla, aur Makkah ke raaste mein kahin marr gaya. Usne Husain bin Numair Al-Kindi ko apna jaanasheen banaya aur us se kaha: "Ae gadhe ki zeen ke kapde (yani kamzor aadmi)! Quraish ke dhoke se hoshiyar rehna, aur unse sirf munafiqat ka maamla karna, phir (jab waqt aaye) fasal kaat lena." Chunanche Husain chala, yahan tak ke Makkah pahuncha aur wahan Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) se kuch din ladta raha.

Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ne Husain bin Numair ko dawat bheji ke woh mubarizat (aamne-saamne ke muqable) mein aaye. Husain ne kaha: "Tumse milne se mujhe buzdili nahi rokti, magar mujhe nahi maloom ke fatah kis ki hogi. Agar tumhari hui to mere peeche waale zaaya ho jayenge, aur agar meri hui to maine tadbeer mein galti ki. Aur agar tum (Kaaba ka) tawaf karo to hum baqi ahwaal ki taraf laut jayenge." Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ne masjid mein ek khaima lagaya jismein auratein zakhmiyon ko paani pilati, unka ilaaj karti, bhooke ko khilati aur zakhmi sakht mardon ko sambhaalti thin. Husain ne kaha: "Us khaime se hum par barabar ek sher nikalta rehta hai goya apni maand se nikal raha ho. Isse hamare liye kaun nipatega?" Ahl-e-Shaam ke ek aadmi ne kaha: "Main." Jab raat chha gayi to usne apne neze ki nok par ek shama rakhi, phir apne ghode ko hanka aur khaime mein neza maara, to woh aag ban kar bhadak utha. Us din Kaaba qaaleenon (mote kapdon) mein lipta hua tha aur uske upar ek matka rakha tha. Hawa ne lapton ko Kaaba par uda diya, yahan tak ke woh jal gayi, aur us din us mendhe ke dono sing bhi jal gaye jise Ishaq ki jagah fidya diya gaya tha. Muhammad bin Umar ne kaha: Aur Yazid bin Mu'awiyah mar gaya aur Husain bin Numair bhaag gaya. Jab Yazid bin Mu'awiyah mar gaya to Marwan bin Al-Hakam ne apni taraf logon ko bulaya, to Ahl-e-Hims, Ahl-e-Urdun aur Filasteen ne use qubool kar liya. Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ne Ad-Dahhak bin Qais Al-Fihri (RA) ko ek lakh ki fauj ke saath uski taraf bheja. Dono ka muqabla Marj Rahit mein hua, aur us din Marwan ke saath Bani Umayyah, unke mawali aur Ahl-e-Shaam ke pairokaaron mein se paanch hazaar the. Marwan ne apne ek mawla se kaha: "Jis taraf chaho hamla karo." Usne kaha: "Itni badi tadaad ke saath hum un par kaise hamla karein?" Marwan ne kaha: "Woh ya to majboor kiye gaye hain ya kiraye ke hain. Un par hamla karo, tumhari maan na rahe! Kamyaab, behtareen neza-zani tumhare liye kaafi hogi, aur woh khud hi tumhare liye kaafi ho jayenge; yeh to dinar aur dirham ke ghulam hain." Usne un par hamla kiya aur unhe shikast di. Ad-Dahhak bin Qais aaya aur lashkar bikhar gaya. Isi ke baare mein Zufar bin Al-Harith ne kaha [Bahr At-Tawil, shayri ka ek wazan]: "Meri umar ki qasam, Rahit ki jang ne Marwan ke liye girne waale maqtoolon aur qaidiyon ko baqi chhoda. Mera hathiyar sabse tez hai, tumhari maan na rahe, aur jang mein mera josh sirf badhta hi hai. Kabhi kabhi charagah khaad ke dheron par bhi ug aati hai, aur dilon ki kudoorat jaisi thi waisi hi rehti hai." Aur isi ke baare mein yeh bhi kaha: "Kya haq mein yeh hai ke Bahdal aur Ibn Bahdal to zinda rahein aur Ibn Az-Zubayr qatl kiya jaye? Tum jhoote ho, Baitullah ki qasam, woh use qatl nahi karenge, aur abhi tak woh roshan, nishan-zada din nahi aaya, aur abhi tak tumhare darmiyan talwaron ki woh chamak nahi hui jo sooraj ke noor ki tarah ho jab woh buland hota hai." Raawi kehte hain: Phir Marwan mar gaya, to Abd al-Malik ne apni taraf logon ko bulaya aur uth khada hua, Ahl-e-Shaam ne use qubool kiya. Usne minbar par khutba diya aur kaha: "Ibn Az-Zubayr ke liye kaun hai?" Al-Hajjaj ne kaha: "Ae Amir al-Mu'minin, main." Usne use chup kara diya. Phir usne dobara kaha, phir chup kara diya. Phir tisri baar kaha: "Ae Amir al-Mu'minin, main uske liye hun, kyunke maine khwab mein dekha goya maine ek dhaal utaar kar pehni hai." Chunanche usne use jhanda diya aur fauj ke saath Makkah ki taraf bheja (Allah Ta'ala use mehfooz rakhe), yahan tak ke woh Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ke paas pahuncha aur wahan unse laraa. Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ne Ahl-e-Makkah se kaha: "In dono pahaadon ki hifazat karo, kyunke jab tak woh in par ghalib na ho jayen tum khair aur izzat mein rahoge." Zyada der nahi guzri ke Al-Hajjaj aur uske saathi masjid mein ghalib aa gaye. Jis subah Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) qatl hue, woh apni walida Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) ke paas gaye; us din unki umr sau (100) saal thi, na unka koi daant gira tha, na unki beenai ya sama'at kharab hui thi. Unhone apne bete se kaha: "Ae Abdullah, tumne apni jang mein kya kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Woh falaan falaan jagah tak pahunch gaye hain." Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) hanse aur kaha: "Maut mein to rahat hai." Unhone kaha: "Mere bete, shayad tum mere liye maut ki tamanna kar rahe ho? Mujhe pasand nahi ke main marun yahan tak ke tumhare muamle mein do mein se ek baat aa jaye: ya to tum ghalib aao aur meri aankhein thandi hon, ya tum qatl ho jao aur main (ajr ki) umeed rakhun." Raawi kehte hain: Phir unhone unhe alvida kaha. Unhone unse kaha: "Mere bete, qatl ke dar se apne deen ki ek khaslat bhi na dena." Woh unke paas se nikle aur masjid mein gaye. Unhone Hajar-e-Aswad par do kiwaad rakh diye the, bas manjaniq ka nishana ban jane ka andesha tha. Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) zamzam ke paas baithe the ke ek aane waale ne unse kaha: "Kya hum aapke liye Kaaba khol dein ke aap usmein chadh jayen?" Abdullah (RA) ne use dekha aur kaha: "Tum har cheez se apne bhai ki hifazat karte ho siwaye uski apni maut se. Kya Kaaba ki koi hurmat aisi hai jo is jagah ki nahi? Allah ki qasam, agar woh tumhe Kaaba ke parde se latke hue paayen to bhi tumhein qatl kar denge." Unse kaha gaya: "Kya aap unse sulah ki baat nahi karte?" Unhone kaha: "Kya yeh sulah ka waqt hai? Allah ki qasam, agar woh tumhe uske andar paayen to sab ko zabah kar denge." Phir unhone kehna shuru kiya: "Aur main bay'ah dekar zindagi kharidne waala nahi hun, aur na maut ke dar se zeena chadhne waala. Main chahta hun ke woh door nahi, main maut se mil kar rahunga, woh jis taraf se bhi rukh kare." Phir woh Aal-e-Az-Zubayr ki taraf mutawajjeh hue aur unhe naseehat ki: "Tum mein se har ek ki talwar uska chehra ban jaye; talwar ko jhukaye nahi ke aurat ki tarah apne haath se apna bachao kare. Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi koi lashkar nahi paaya magar sabse pehli safon mein, aur mujhe kisi zakhm ne kabhi dard nahi diya siwaye dawa ke dard ke." Raawi kehte hain: Woh isi haal mein the ke woh un par daakhil hua, aur uske saath sattar (70) the. Sabse pehla jisse mulaqat hui woh Al-Aswad tha. Unhone apni talwar se waar kiya, yahan tak ke uski taang kaat di. Al-Aswad ne kaha: "Aah! Ae zaaniya ke bete!" Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ne kaha: "Achhi baat kar, ae Ham ke bete! Kya Asma zaaniya hai?" Phir unhone unhe masjid se nikal diya. Woh wapis hue to ek qaum Bab Bani Sahm se daakhil ho chuki thi. Unhone poocha: "Yeh kaun hain?" Kaha gaya: "Ahl-e-Urdun." Unhone un par hamla kiya aur kehte jaate the [Bahr Ar-Rajaz, shayri ka ek wazan]: "Mujhe sailab jaise hamle ka ahd nahi, jiska ghubar raat tak nahi chhatta." Raawi kehte hain: Unhone unhe masjid se nikal diya, phir laute to ek qaum Bab Bani Makhzum se daakhil ho chuki thi. Unhone un par hamla kiya aur kehte jaate the: "Agar mera muqabil ek hota to main uske liye kaafi tha, use maut tak pahuncha deta aur use zabah kar deta." Masjid ki chhat par unke madadgaaron mein se kuch log the jo dushman par eenton wagaira se hamla karte the. Unhone un par hamla kiya to ek eent unki maang par lagi, yahan tak ke sar chheel diya. Woh khade ho gaye aur kehte rahe: "Hum pichhli ediyon par apne zakhmon se khoon nahi bahate, balki hamare qadmon par khoon tapakta hai." Raawi kehte hain: Phir woh gir gaye. Unke do mawla unpar jhuk gaye aur kehte the: "Ghulam apne maalik ki hifazat karta hai aur uski hifazat ki jati hai." Raawi kehte hain: Phir unki taraf badha gaya aur unka sar kaat liya gaya (RA).

e: [AI] "Allah will forgive you three times. By Allah, I only taught you to be a fast observer, steadfast, and to join your family ties. By Allah, I do not hope for anything against you equal to what you have done, that Allah will not punish you forever. Then he turned to me and said, 'I heard Abu Bakr As-Siddiq saying that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Whoever does evil will be punished for it in this world.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: "Allah tumhe maaf kare" (teen baar). "Allah ki qasam, main tumhe roza rakhne waala, raat ko qiyam karne waala aur silah rehmi karne waala hi jaanta tha. Allah ki qasam, tumhari un kharabiyon ke bawajood jo tumne kamayin, mujhe umeed hai ke Allah iske baad tumhe kabhi azab nahi dega." Phir meri taraf mutawajjeh hue aur farmaya: "Maine Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ko kehte suna, unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jo burai karega usey dunya mein uska badla diya jayega.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Al-Sha'bi said, "He who makes a mistake should not be greeted." This was said by Sa'id bin Muslim al-Yashkuri and Waah.
hi: Ash-Sha'bi ne kaha: "Usne galti ki, (sirf) sar par namaz-e-janazah nahi padhi jati." (Sanad mein) Sa'id bin Muslim Al-Yashkuri waahi (nihayat kamzor) hai.

e: [AI] Peace be upon you, Abu Khuwailib, who said it three times. I indeed forbade you from doing so three times. You were indeed fasting and observing night prayer, maintaining ties of kinship. He said, "Al-Hajjaj reached the position of Abdullah bin Umar and brought him down, throwing him in the graves of the Jews. He sent a message to Asma bint Abi Bakr to come to him, but she refused as her eyesight had gone. So, he sent her a message saying, 'Either you come to me or I will send someone to drag you by your hair.' She said, 'By Allah, I will not come to you until you send me someone to drag me by my hair.' So, his messenger went to her and informed her of this. She said, 'O boy, take hold of my garment and make me walk until I come to him.' So, he held her garment and she walked, dragging the feet. When she came to him, he asked her, 'How did you see what Allah has done to the enemy of Allah?' She replied, 'I have indeed seen that you have ruined his worldly life and his Hereafter. But as for the one whom you used to insult with regards to her two waistlines, surely I (Asma bint Abu Bakr) had one waistline which I covered with food for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the ants, and the other waistline was for the women and we cannot do without it.' I have indeed heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Indeed, there is a liar and a troublemaker in Ta'if.' As for the liar, we have seen him, and as for the troublemaker, it is you.' Then he left. The narrations have been authenticated in Musnad through the hearing of Abdullah bin Zubair from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his coming and going to and from him when he was only eight years old. And I remember by the will of Allah the Most High, in this place, his narrations that indicate this. Indeed, the exit (to Madinah) in his Musnad from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is ninety-seven hadiths.
hi: "As-salamu alaika, ae Abu Khubayb" (teen baar kaha). "Maine tumhe isse roka tha" (teen baar kaha). "Tum roza rakhne waale, raat ko qiyam karne waale aur silah rehmi karne waale the." Raawi kehte hain: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ke wahan khade hone ki khabar Al-Hajjaj tak pahunchi, to usne unhe (Ibn Az-Zubayr (RA) ko) utarwa liya aur Yahood ke qabristan mein phenk diya. Phir usne Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) ko paighaam bheja ke woh uske paas aayen, jabke unki beenai ja chuki thi. Unhone inkaar kiya. Usne dobara kahlwaya: "Ya to aap aayengi, ya main aise aadmi ko bhejunga jo aapko aapke baalon se ghaseet kar laye." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main tumhare paas nahi aaungi yahan tak ke tum mere paas aisa aadmi bhejo jo mujhe mere baalon se ghaseete." Uska qaasid wapis aaya aur use khabar di. Usne kaha: "Ae ladke, mujhe meri sawari/jooti do" aur uski khachchari us ke paas laayi gayi. Woh josh mein uth khada hua yahan tak ke unke paas pahuncha aur unse kaha: "Aapne dekha Allah ne Allah ke dushman ke saath kya kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Maine dekha ke tumne uski dunya bigaad di, aur tumne apni aakhirat bigaad li. Rahi woh baat jo tum use 'Zaat an-Nitaqain' ka taana dete the, to haan, mere paas do nitaq (kamarband) the: ek se main Rasulullah (SAW) ke khane ko cheentiyon se dhakti thi, aur mera doosra nitaq aisa tha jis se auraton ko chaara nahi. Aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Thaqif mein ek bada jhoota aur ek mubir (tabah karne wala) hoga.' Jhoote ko to humne dekh liya, aur mubir to tum ho." Raawi kehte hain: Phir woh nikal gaya. Hakim ne kaha: "Riwayaton se sabit hai ke Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se (ahadees) suni hain, aur woh aap (SAW) ke paas aaye aur gaye jabke unki umr aath saal thi. Allah Ta'ala ne chaha to main is jagah unki woh khabrein zikr karunga jo isi par dalalat karti hain, kyunke unki musnad mein Rasulullah (SAW) se sattar se zyada ahadees nikali gayi hain."

e:
That he came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was being cupped, and when he had finished he said, *“O Abdullah, take this blood and pour it out where no one can see you.”* When I had gone away from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I took the blood and drank it. 

Then when I returned to the Prophet ﷺ, he said, *“What did you do, O Abdullah?”* He said, “I put it in a place I thought was hidden from the people.” He said, *“Perhaps you drank it?”* I said, “Yes.” He said, *“Who commanded you to drink blood? Woe to you from the people, and woe to the people from you.”*[^1]
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur aap (SAW) pachhne lagwa rahe the. Jab farigh hue to farmaya: "Ae Abdullah, yeh khoon le jao aur wahan baha do jahan koi tumhe na dekhe." Jab main Rasulullah (SAW) se door nikla to maine khoon ki taraf qasd kiya aur use pi liya. Jab main Nabi (SAW) ke paas wapis aaya to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Abdullah, tumne kya kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Maine use aisi jagah rakh diya jise main samajhta tha ke logon se chhupi hui hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shayad tumne use pi liya?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhe khoon peene ka hukm kis ne diya? Tumhare liye logon ki taraf se halakat hai, aur logon ke liye tumhari taraf se halakat hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying,"Whoever recites the Quran openly or secretly, a tree will be planted for him in Jannah (Paradise), such that if a crow were to drop a chick under its shade, the chick would grow up before the leaf falls." - Reported by Muhammed ibn Bahr Al-Hajimi, a disreputable narrator of hadith.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jo Quran zaahiran ya dekh kar padhe, use jannat mein ek darakht diya jayega, agar ek kawwa uske ek patte ke neeche bachcha de, phir woh bachcha ud jaye aur budhape tak pahunch jaye to bhi woh us patte ko tay na kar paye." Muhammad bin Bahr Al-Hujaimi munkar al-hadith hai.

e: [AI] "I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on two separate occasions."
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se ek din mein do baar bay'ah ki."

e: [AI] It was said to him, "Which one of the sons of Zubayr was braver?" He said, "There was none of them except that he was brave. Both of them would walk towards death while witnessing it." In its chain (of narration), it is mursal (disconnected).
hi: Unse poochha gaya: "Ibn Az-Zubayr ke dono beton mein se kaun zyada bahadur tha?" Unhone kaha: "Dono mein se har ek bahadur tha. Dono maut ki taraf chale aur use dekh rahe the." Iski sanad mein ek matruk (chhoda hua) raawi hai.

e: [AI] "O son, have you seen me?" I said, "Yes." He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has brought his parents to me today."
hi: "Ae mere bete, kya tumne mujhe dekha?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone kaha: "Aaj Rasulullah (SAW) ne mere liye apne waalidain jama kar diye."

e: [AI] "Narrated by Yahya bin Ayyub, authentically according to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Yahya bin Ayyub se musnad ke taur par, Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: Do you remember (the occasion) when we three (i. e. I, you and lbn 'Abbas) met Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he mounted us (on his camel) but left you? He said: Yes. (Using translation from Muslim 2427a)
hi: Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) ne Abdullah bin Ja'far (RA) se kaha: "Kya tumhe woh din yaad hai jab hum, main aur tum, Rasulullah (SAW) se mile, to aap (SAW) ne mujhe sawaar kar liya aur tumhe chhod diya?"

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  gave me the call." It was asked, "Why is that?" He said, "Because they will have the longest necks on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe azaan (ka kaam) diya." Poochha gaya: "Woh kyun?" Unhone kaha: "Kyunke qiyamat ke din unki gardanein sab logon se zyada lambi hongi."

e: [AI] I disagreed with Dharr al-Murhibi about the pilgrims. A believer said, and I said, a disbeliever. "And the proof of its correctness is what Mujahid ibn Jabr stated."
hi: Maine aur Dharr Al-Murhibi ne Al-Hajjaj ke baare mein ikhtilaf kiya. Usne kaha: "Momin", aur maine kaha: "Kafir." "Aur iski sehat ka bayan woh hai jo Mujahid bin Jabr ne is baare mein mutlaq taur par kaha."

e: [AI] "And curse those who hate them and abandon them."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...aur un par laanat jo unse bughz rakhte aur unhe tanha chhodte hain."

e: [AI] Anas and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib said, "Ibn 'Umar witnessed the Battle of Badr." This is incorrect, without a doubt.
hi: Anas (RA) aur Sa'id bin Al-Musayyib ne kaha: "Ibn Umar (RA) Badr mein shareek hue." Yeh yaqeeni taur par ghalat hai.

e: [AI] "We left the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day he passed away, and none of us remained the same as they were, except for Umar and Abdullah ibn Umar."
hi: "Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ko jis din aap (SAW) ka wisaal hua chhod kar aaye, to hum mein se har ek apni pehli haalat se badal gaya siwaye Umar (RA) aur Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ke." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And it is said that he was buried in a trap in the cemetery of the immigrants. He was buried in the year seventy-four, on the day his son died, at the age of eighty-four years."
hi: "Aur kaha jaata hai ke woh Fakh mein Muhajireen ke qabristan mein dafn kiye gaye. Unhe 74 Hijri mein dafn kiya gaya, aur jis din unki wafaat hui unki umr chauraasi (84) saal thi."

e: [AI] "Al-Hajjaj, be quiet, O sheikh, you have gone mad. When they dispersed, Al-Hajjaj ordered a man from the people of Sham and he struck him with his sword in his leg. Then, Al-Hajjaj entered upon him to visit him, and he said, 'If I had known what had afflicted you, I would have struck your neck.' He replied, 'You are the one who afflicted me.' Al-Hajjaj asked, 'How?' He said, 'The day you entered the sanctuary of Allah with a weapon.'" The translation provided is a literal translation.
hi: Al-Hajjaj ne kaha: "Chup raho, ae buzurg, tumhari aql ja chuki hai (kharif ho gaye ho)." Jab log alag hue to Al-Hajjaj ne Ahl-e-Shaam ke ek aadmi ko hukm diya, to usne unke paaon mein apne neze se waar kiya. Phir Al-Hajjaj unki iyadat ke liye aaya aur kaha: "Agar mujhe maloom ho jaye ke kis ne tumhein zakhmi kiya to main uski gardan maar doon." Unhone kaha: "Tum hi ne mujhe zakhmi kiya." Usne poochha: "Kaise?" Unhone kaha: "Jis din tumne Allah ke haram mein hathiyar daakhil kiye." Atiyyah kamzor hain.

e: [AI] "He (referring to someone) said to Ibn Umar, 'You have killed me, and now you come back to me? Sufficient is Allah as a judge between me and you.'" This is a weak structure of a sentence.
hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne unse kaha: "Tumne mujhe qatl kiya aur ab meri iyadat ko aaye ho? Mere aur tumhare darmiyan faisla karne ke liye Allah kaafi hai." Umarah kamzor hain.

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Umar came from Basra to Fars, as a conqueror, and he died in Mecca in the year seventy-four.
hi: "Abdullah bin Umar (RA) Basrah aaye, aur Fars ki taraf ghazi ban kar gaye. Unki wafaat Makkah mein 74 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] "To bury him outside the sanctuary, but we were unable to, so we buried him inside the sanctuary in a hidden grave in the cemetery of the immigrants." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke main unhe haram se bahar dafn karun, lekin hum ye na kar sake, to humne unhe haram ke andar Fakh mein Muhajireen ke qabristan mein dafn kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] “I held back my hand and did not advance, while the one who fights upon the truth is better.”[^1]
hi: "Maine apna haath rok liya aur aage nahi badha, jabke haq par ladne waala afzal hai."

e: [AI] "That he does not fight with him, and Al-Radiyyan is content with that." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke woh unke saath na lade, aur Ali (RA) is par unse raazi ho gaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I and Ibn Umar were presented to the Messenger of Allah on the day of Badr, and he underestimated us, and we witnessed the battle of Uhud."
hi: "Mujhe aur Ibn Umar (RA) ko Badr ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne pesh kiya gaya, to aap (SAW) ne humein kam-umar samjha, aur hum Uhud mein shareek hue."

e: [AI] According to the opinion of Ibn Umar, he stayed after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  for sixty years and nothing regarding the affairs of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  or the affairs of his companions was hidden from him.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...Ibn Umar (RA) ki raaye ke baare mein, kyunke woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad saath (60) saal rahe, aur Rasulullah (SAW) aur aap (SAW) ke ashaab ke kisi maamle mein se unpar kuch posheeda na raha."

e: [AI] Regarding him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...unse." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] "I did not see it necessary to comply with the first command of Abdullah bin Umar."
hi: "Maine Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se zyada pehle tareeqe (Sunnat) ko lazim pakadne waala koi nahi dekha."

e: [AI] "He is from the people of paradise, for I bear witness regarding Ibn Umar."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke woh ahl-e-jannat mein se hai, to main Ibn Umar (RA) ke haq mein zaroor gawahi deta."

e:
[AI] "You spoke the truth, O my son, but I bear witness that his father was the most beloved person to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  than your father, and he (his father) was more beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  than you."

This is an authentic narration, and they did not exclude it. So, if someone assumes that this virtue is for Usama, then let him know that I only mentioned this hadith for two reasons. The first reason is the testimony of 'Umar for his son that Usama did not witness a scene except that I witnessed it, and this is because of the virtues of Ibn 'Umar. The second reason is that the two sheikhs (referring to Bukhari and Muslim) have mentioned most of the virtues of Ibn 'Umar based on their conditions from the chains of narrators. So, I strive to acquire an authentic report that they did not mention in their books."
hi: (Umar (RA) ne apne bete se kaha:) "Ae mere bete, tumne sach kaha, lekin main gawahi deta hun ke unke walid (Zaid (RA)) Rasulullah (SAW) ko tumhare walid se zyada mehboob the, aur woh (Usama (RA)) Rasulullah (SAW) ko tumse zyada mehboob the." Yeh sahih ul-isnad hai, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala. Hakim ne kaha: "Agar koi waham kare ke yeh fazilat Usama (RA) ki hai, to jaan le ke maine yeh hadith do wajah se nikali: ek, Umar (RA) ka apne bete ke haq mein gawahi dena ke Usama (RA) jis maqam par bhi shareek hue, main bhi wahan shareek hua, aur yeh Ibn Umar (RA) ki bari fazilatoon mein se hai. Dusri, Shaykhain (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne Ibn Umar (RA) ke fazail ki zyadatar riwayatein apni shart par musnad ahadees se nikali hain, to main koshish karta hun ke aisi sahih musnad khabar hasil karun jise unhone nahi nikaala."

e: [AI] "I pledged allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ  twice on the day of Hudaybiyah. 'Umar saw people gathered and said, 'Go and see what they are up to.' When I saw that the Prophet ﷺ  was pledging allegiance on the verge of death, I pledged allegiance to him as well. Then I returned to 'Umar and informed him, and he came and pledged allegiance after me. This is due to the virtues of Ibn 'Umar, who was not asked to leave, and 'Ubaidullah ibn 'Umar Al-'Umari (may Allah have mercy on him) was only mentioned for poor memory."
hi: "Maine Nabi (SAW) se Hudaibiyah ke din maut par do baar bay'ah ki." Unhone kaha: Umar (RA) ne logon ko jama dekha to kaha: "Jao, dekho unka kya maamla hai." "To dekha ke Nabi (SAW) maut par bay'ah le rahe hain, to maine aap (SAW) se bay'ah ki." Phir main Umar (RA) ke paas wapis gaya aur unhe khabar di, to woh aaye aur mere bay'ah karne ke baad bay'ah ki. Hakim ne kaha: "Yeh Ibn Umar (RA) ki sabse bari fazilatoon mein se hai, aur Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala. Aur Ubaidullah bin Umar Al-Umari (Allah unpar raham kare) ke baare mein sirf soo-e-hifz hi zikr kiya gaya hai."

e: [AI] None of us can reach worldly affairs without being influenced by them, and none can influence them except Abdullah ibn Umar.
hi: "Hum mein se har ek jisne dunya paayi, dunya ne use apni taraf jhukaya aur woh dunya ki taraf jhuka, siwaye Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ke."

e: [AI] From it, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...is se." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] Ibn Umar was the best of this nation.
hi: "Ibn Umar (RA) is ummat ke behtareen logon mein se the."

e: [AI] I heard Ali ibn Hussein saying, "Indeed, Ibn Umar is the most ascetic of the people and has the most accurate opinion."
hi: Maine Ali bin Al-Husain ko kehte suna: "Beshak Ibn Umar (RA) logon mein sabse zyada zahid aur sabse sahih raaye waale hain."

e: [AI] "From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...unse." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] "No one among the companions of the Prophet, peace be upon him, would hear a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and be cautious not to add or subtract from it more than Ibn 'Umar, as mentioned by Al-Dhahabi in his summary."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ke ashaab mein koi aisa nahi tha jo Rasulullah (SAW) se koi hadith sunne ke baad Ibn Umar (RA) se zyada is baat se khabardar rehta ho ke usmein na kuch badhaye na ghataye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I recited this verse, 'You will not attain righteousness until you spend from what you love' [3:92], so I mentioned what Allah Almighty has given me, and I did not find anything dearer to me than my servant girl, Radiyyah. So I said that she is freed for the sake of Allah Almighty. If it weren't for the fact that I don't want to engage in anything that I would dedicate to Allah Almighty, I would have married her. But I did marry her off to Naafi'. Hence, she became the mother of his child."
hi: Maine yeh ayat padhi: {Tum bhalai ko hargiz nahi pa sakte jab tak apni pasandida cheez mein se kharch na karo} (Surah Aal-e-Imran 92). Maine socha ke Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe kya diya hai, to apni laundi Radiyyah se zyada mehboob mujhe kuch na mila. Maine kaha: "Woh Allah ke liye aazad hai." Agar yeh baat na hoti ke jo cheez main Allah ke liye kar chuka usmein rujoo nahi karta, to main uske saath nikah kar leta. Chunanche Nafi' ne uska nikah kar diya, aur woh unki umm-e-walad (maa-e-aulaad) hain.

e: [AI] "If I saw Ibn Umar following the footsteps of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , I would say, 'This person is insane.'"
hi: "Agar main Ibn Umar (RA) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke naqsh-e-qadam ki pairwi karte dekhta to kehta: yeh deewana hai."

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Umar embraced Islam before his father. This is false.
hi: "Abdullah bin Umar (RA) apne walid se pehle Islam laaye." Yeh baatil hai.

e: [AI] "I have no knowledge of it." When the man turned away, Ibn Umar said, "Yes, what Ibn Umar said is good." Ibn Umar was asked about something he did not know, so he said, "I have no knowledge of it."
hi: "Mujhe iska ilm nahi." Jab woh aadmi mud kar chala gaya to Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ibn Umar ne kya khoob kaha! Us se woh poochha gaya jo woh nahi jaanta, to usne kaha: mujhe iska ilm nahi."

e: [AI] And Raafidh Bin Khadeej Bin Raafidh Bin Adi Bin Zaid Bin Jushami Bin Haarithah Bin Al-Haarith Bin Al-Khazraj Bin Amr, and he is the son of Maalik Bin Aws. Raafidh witnessed the Battle of Uhud and the Trench and all the other military expeditions alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Raafidh was injured by an arrow on the day of Uhud in his throat. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "If you wish, I can remove the arrow and leave the wound open, and I will testify for you on the Day of Resurrection that you are a martyr." Raafidh left the arrow in his throat based on the words of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he did not feel any pain for the rest of his life. When he laughed, his wound would open, but during the Caliphate of Uthman, that wound healed and he passed away.
hi: "Aur Rafi' bin Khadij bin Rafi' bin Adi bin Zaid bin Jusham bin Harithah bin Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj bin Amr, yaani An-Nabit bin Malik bin Aws (RA). Rafi' (RA) Uhud, Khandaq aur tamam ghazwaat mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath shareek hue. Uhud ke din unke seene ke upari hisse (tarquwah) mein ek teer laga. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: 'Agar tum chaho to main teer nikal doon aur qatifah (ek qism ka kapda) chhod doon aur qiyamat ke din tumhare liye gawahi dunga ke tum shaheed ho.' Rafi' (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke farmane ki wajah se use chhod diya. Ek muddat tak unhe usse koi takleef mehsoos na hui, aur jab woh hanste aur munh khol kar hanste to woh (nishan) zaahir ho jata. Phir Uthman (RA) ki khilafat mein woh zakhm phoot pada aur unki usi se wafaat hui." Yeh sahih nahi aur iska mafhoom durust nahi.

e: [AI] "Rafi' bin Khadeej, al-Haarithi, who was also known as Abu Abdullah, passed away in Madinah in the year seventy-four."
hi: "Rafi' bin Khadij Al-Harithi (RA), kunyat Abu Abdullah, ki wafaat Madinah mein 74 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] I saw Ibn Umar standing between the two beds of Rafee ibn Khadeej.
