hi: Maine Ibn Umar (RA) ko "Rafi' bin Khadij (RA) ki charpai ke do paayon ke darmiyan khade dekha."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  granted him permission on the Day of Uhud and appointed him in the archers." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhe Uhud ke din (jang mein shirkat ki) ijazat di aur unhe teer-andazon mein shamil kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He said, "I went on seven expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I went on nine expeditions with Zaid ibn Haritha, who was commanded by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to lead us."
hi: Unse riwayat hai ke unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath saat ghazwe kiye, aur Zaid bin Harithah (RA) ke saath nau ghazwe kiye; Rasulullah (SAW) unhe humare upar amir banate the."

e: [AI] "Wasalamah bin Al-Akwa was also known as Abu Sinan. He passed away in the city in the year seventy-four."
hi: "Salamah bin Al-Akwa' (RA) ki kunyat Abu Sinan thi. Unki wafaat Madinah mein 74 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] "Malik bin Sinan bin Tha'laba bin 'Ubaid bin Al-Abjar, and his name is Khudrah bin 'Auf, and he is the father of Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri, Sa'd bin Malik."
hi: "Malik bin Sinan bin Tha'labah bin Ubaid bin Al-Abjar (RA), jinka (yani Al-Abjar ka) naam Khudrah bin Auf hai, Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri Sa'd bin Malik (RA) ke walid hain."

e: [AI] Narrated Umm Abdul Rahman bint Abi Sa'id, from her father Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was struck in his face during the Battle of Uhud. Abu Malik ibn Sinan then licked the blood from his face with his tongue and spat it out. The Prophet ﷺ  then said, "Whoever wants to see someone who has interacted with my blood, let him look at Malik ibn Sinan." This narration is weak.
hi: Umm Abd ar-Rahman bint Abi Sa'id se, unhone apne walid Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (RA) se riwayat kiya, unhone kaha: Uhud ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre mubarak par zakhm aaya. Mere walid Malik bin Sinan (RA) aap (SAW) ke paas aaye aur apne munh se aap (SAW) ke chehre se khoon chaat liya, phir use nigal liya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise yeh khushi ho ke woh us shakhs ko dekhe jiske khoon mein mera khoon mil gaya, woh Malik bin Sinan ko dekh le." Iski sanad andheri (muzlim, majhool raawiyon wali) hai.

e: [AI] "And Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, Sa'd ibn Malik ibn Sinan ibn Tha'laba ibn 'Ubayd ibn al-Abjar, and his name was Khudra ibn 'Awf ibn al-Khazraj, and Qatadah ibn al-Nu'man was his maternal uncle. Abu Sa'id al-Khudri passed away in the year seventy-four."
hi: "Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri Sa'd bin Malik bin Sinan bin Tha'labah bin Ubaid bin Al-Abjar (RA), jinka (yani Al-Abjar ka) naam Khudrah bin Auf bin Al-Khazraj hai. Qatadah bin An-Nu'man (RA) unke maan ki taraf se bhai the. Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (RA) ki wafaat 74 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] "I went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the expedition of Bani Al-Mustaliq," Ibn Umar said. "And he (the Messenger of Allah) was fifteen years old at that time." Ibn Umar also said, "Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri witnessed the Battle of the Trench and other subsequent events."
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath Ghazwa-e-Bani Al-Mustaliq mein nikla." Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Aur us din unki umr pandrah (15) saal thi." Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne Khandaq aur uske baad ke tamam ghazwaat mein bhi shirkat ki.

e: [AI] I was presented to the Prophet ﷺ on the day of Uhud, and I was the thirteen-year-old son of my guardian. My father took my hand and said, "O Messenger of Allah, he has weak bones, even though he is a muezzin." The Prophet ﷺ then scrutinized me and pointed me in the right direction and said, "Send him back." So, they returned me.
hi: Mujhe Uhud ke din Nabi (SAW) ke saamne pesh kiya gaya aur meri umr terah (13) saal thi. Mere walid mera haath pakad kar kehte rahe: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh bhaari haddiyon wala hai, agar chahe woh muazzin hi ho." Nabi (SAW) mujhe upar se neeche tak nazar bhar kar dekhte rahe, phir farmaya: "Ise wapas kar do." To mujhe wapas kar diya gaya.

e: [AI] "Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri died in the year seventy-four."
hi: "Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (RA) ki wafaat 74 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] He used to say, "Speak, for indeed speech reminds of speech." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Woh kaha karte the: "Baatein kiya karo, kyunke baat se baat yaad aati hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "My father said, 'I have grown old and my companions and congregation have passed away. Take hold of my hand.'" He said, "So he leaned on me until he reached the farthest part of al-Baqi’, a place where one is not buried. He said, 'O my son, when I die, bury me here and do not strike a stone on my grave, nor walk with me carrying fire, nor mourn for me loudly, nor make a great announcement about my death, and walk with me in a deep alley, and let your walk be easy.'" So he died on Friday, and I disliked calling out to people when he forbade me, lest they come to me and say, "When will you take him out?" So I would say, "When I finish his preparation." He said, "So the people filled al-Baqi' and remained silent about it."
hi: Mere walid ne mujhse kaha: "Main budha ho gaya hun aur mere saathi aur meri jamaat chali gayi, mera haath pakdo." Raawi kehte hain: Woh mujh par tek laga kar chalte rahe, yahan tak ke Baqi ke aakhri hisse mein aisi jagah aaye jahan dafn nahi kiya jata tha. Unhone kaha: "Mere bete, jab main mar jaun to mujhe yahin dafn karna, mere upar khaima na lagana, mere saath aag le kar na chalna, koi noha karne wali mujh par na rowe, mere baare mein kisi ko ittila na dena, mujhe Zuqaq Amqah ke raaste se le jana, aur tumhari chaal tez ho." Woh Jumu'a ke din faut hue. Unke mana karne ki wajah se mujhe logon ko ittila dena na-pasand hua. Log mere paas aate aur poochte: "Aap use kab nikaalenge?" Main kehta: "Jab main uske kafan-dafan ke intezam se farigh ho jaun." Raawi kehte hain: Baqi logon se bhar gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "You will not write it (the Quran) nor make it a Quran, but rather preserve it (its teachings) as we have preserved. Then he said another time, 'Take from us as we have taken from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .'"
hi: "Tum ise (ahadees ko) likhoge nahi aur na ise Quran banaoge, balki humse ise yaad kar lo jaise humne yaad kiya." Phir ek aur baar kaha: "Humse ilm lo jaise humne Rasulullah (SAW) se liya."

e: [AI] On the day of Uhud, the Prophet ﷺ  was struck in his forehead, and then Malik bin Sinan, the father of Abu Sa'id, came to him and wiped the blood from the Prophet's face. Then he insulted him. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever likes to see someone who has mixed his blood with mine, let him look at Malik bin Sinan." Abu al-Abbas Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated to us, Abu Ja'far Ahmad ibn Abdul-Hamid al-Harithi narrated to us, Abu Usamah narrated to me, he said: Yazid ibn Abdullah narrated to me, and they both transmitted it.
hi: Jab Uhud ka din aaya to Nabi (SAW) ki peshani par zakhm aaya. Malik bin Sinan (RA), jo Abu Sa'id (RA) ke walid hain, aap (SAW) ke paas aaye, aap (SAW) ke chehre se khoon saaf kiya, phir use nigal liya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jise yeh khushi ho ke woh us shakhs ko dekhe jiske khoon mein mera khoon mil gaya, woh Malik bin Sinan ko dekh le." Hamse Abu Al-Abbas Muhammad bin Ya'qub ne bayan kiya, unse Abu Ja'far Ahmad bin Abd al-Hamid Al-Harithi ne, unse Abu Usamah ne, unse Yazid bin Abdullah ne. Aur dono (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne ise nikaala hai.

e: [AI] Abu Bakr and Uthman, the sons of Abu Shaybah narrated, they said: "Abdah bin Sulaiman narrated to us from Hisham bin Urwah, from Wahb bin Kaysan, he said: It was said to Jabir bin Abdullah, ‘O Abu Abdullah!’
hi: Hamse Abu Bakr aur Uthman, dono Ibn Abi Shaybah ne bayan kiya, dono ne kaha: hamse Abdah bin Sulaiman ne, unse Hisham bin Urwah ne, unse Wahb bin Kaisan ne, unhone kaha: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se kaha gaya: "Ae Abu Abdullah," (adhoora jumla).

e: [AI] "Jabir ibn Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Haram ibn Tha'labah ibn Haram ibn Ka'ab ibn Ghanim ibn Ka'ab ibn Salamah ibn Saad ibn Ali ibn Asad ibn Saridah ibn Yazid ibn Jusham ibn Al-Khazraj, and he was nicknamed Abu Abdullah."
hi: "Jabir bin Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram bin Tha'labah bin Haram bin Ka'b bin Ghanm bin Ka'b bin Salamah bin Sa'd bin Ali bin Asad bin Sarida bin Yazid bin Jusham bin Al-Khazraj (RA). Unki kunyat Abu Abdullah thi."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Nuaim saying, "Jabir ibn Abdullah died in the year seventy-nine."
hi: Maine Abu Nu'aim ko kehte suna: "Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ki wafaat 79 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] Jabir ibn Abdullah witnessed the pledge of allegiance at Al-Aqabah from the seventy Ansar who pledged their allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He was one of the youngest among them on that day. He desired to participate in the Battle of Badr, but his father left him behind to take care of his sisters. They were nine in number. Later, when he went out for the Battle of Uhud, his father left him again and he witnessed the events that followed.
hi: "Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) Aqabah mein un sattar (70) Ansaar mein shareek hue jinhone wahan Rasulullah (SAW) se bay'ah ki, aur us din woh sabse chhote logon mein se the. Unhone Badr mein shirkat ka iraada kiya, magar unke walid ne unhe apni behnon ke paas chhod diya, aur woh nau (9) thin. Unke walid ne unhe Uhud ke liye nikalte waqt bhi peeche chhoda. Uske baad ke tamam ghazwaat mein woh shareek hue."

e: [AI] "I used to entertain my companions on the day of Badr from the tribe of Qalib." It was omitted by Adh-Dhahabi in the summary.
hi: "Main Badr ke din apne saathiyon ke liye kunwen (qaleeb) se paani kheencha karta tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He said, "I used to test my companions on the day of the Battle of Badr by asking them questions." Muhammad ibn Umar said, "This is a mistake in the narration of the people of Iraq regarding Jabir and Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari. They attribute it to those who witnessed the Battle of Badr, but Musa ibn Uqba, Muhammad ibn Ishaq, Abu Ma'shar, and anyone who narrated the biography did not mention it."
hi: Unhone kaha: "Main Badr ke din apne saathiyon ke liye kunwen se paani kheencha karta tha." Muhammad bin Umar ne kaha: "Yeh Ahl-e-Iraq ki riwayat mein Jabir aur Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari (RA) ke baare mein ghalti hai; woh unhe Badr mein shareek hone walon mein shumar karte hain, jabke Musa bin Uqbah, Muhammad bin Ishaq, Abu Mashar aur seerat riwayat karne walon mein se kisi ne yeh riwayat nahi kiya."

e: [AI] Jabir ibn Abdullah came to us with his head and beard dyed yellow.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) hamare paas aaye, unhone apne sar aur darhi ko peela rang diya hua tha.

e: [AI] I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah say, "I entered upon Al-Hajjaj, but he did not greet me."
hi: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ko kehte suna: "Main Al-Hajjaj ke paas gaya, lekin maine usse salam nahi kiya."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sought forgiveness for me twenty-five times on the night of Aqaba."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Laylat al-Aqabah mein mere liye pachees (25) baar istighfar kiya."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  participated in twenty-one battles, and I accompanied him in nineteen battles. The last battle that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  fought was the Battle of Tabuk."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne ikkees (21) ghazwe kiye, aur main aap (SAW) ke saath unnees (19) ghazwaat mein shareek hua. Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka aakhri ghazwa Tabuk tha."

e: [AI] And others said that he was called Abu Talhah.
hi: Aur dusron ne kaha: unki kunyat Abu Talhah thi.

e: [AI] Abi and Muhammad ibn Al-Hijazi Al-Hajbi said, "Zaid ibn Khalid Al-Juhani died in Madinah in the year eighty-seven, at the age of eighty-five."
hi: (Unhone) apne walid se (riwayat kiya) aur Muhammad Al-Hijazi Al-Hajabi, dono ne kaha: "Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani (RA) ki wafaat Madinah mein 78 Hijri mein hui, aur unki umr pachasi (85) saal thi."

e: [AI] "Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani, known as Abu Abdul Rahman, died in the city in the year eighty-seven, at the age of eighty-five."
hi: "Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani (RA) ki kunyat Abu Abd ar-Rahman thi. Unki wafaat Madinah mein 78 Hijri mein hui, aur unki umr pachasi (85) saal thi."

e: [AI] "Asma, the daughter of Umays, gave birth to Abdullah, the son of Ja'far, the son of Abu Talib, in the land of Habasha. He passed away at the age of eighty, on the same day his son reached the age of eighty."
hi: "Asma bint Umais (RA) ne Abdullah bin Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ko sarzameen-e-Habshah mein janam diya. Unki wafaat 80 Hijri mein hui, aur jis din unki wafaat hui unki umr assi (80) saal thi."

e: [AI] To me, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: "For people, there is a migration and for you, there are two migrations."
hi: Mujhse Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Logon ke liye ek hijrat hai, aur tumhare liye do hijratein hain."

e: [AI] "That Abdullah ibn Zubayr and Abdullah ibn Ja'far pledged allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ while they were both seven years old, and that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw them, he smiled and extended his hand, and they pledged allegiance to him."
hi: "Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) aur Abdullah bin Ja'far (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se bay'ah ki, jabke dono saat saal ke the, aur jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne dono ko dekha to muskuraye, apna haath badhaya aur dono se bay'ah li." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "If you had seen me, Ubaidah and Qutham playing, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by us and said, 'Bring this to me.' So he carried me in front of him and said to Qutham, 'Bring this to me.' And he placed him behind him and supplicated for us. Ubaidah was more beloved to Abbas than Qutham, to the extent that he felt shy of his uncle. So I said, 'What happened to Qutham?' He said, 'He was martyred.' I said, 'Allah and His Messenger know best about matters.'"
hi: "Kaash tum mujhe, Ubaidullah aur Qutham ko dekhte jab hum khel rahe the ke Rasulullah (SAW) hamare paas se guzre. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ise meri taraf utha do.' To aap (SAW) ne mujhe apne aage sawari par bitha liya, aur Qutham ke baare mein farmaya: 'Ise meri taraf utha do', to unhe apne peeche bitha liya, aur humare liye dua ki. Ubaidullah Abbas (RA) ko Qutham se zyada mehboob the, aur unke chacha se haya nahi ki gayi." Raawi kehte hain: Maine poochha: "Qutham ka kya hua?" Kaha: "Woh shaheed ho gaye." Maine kaha: "Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain ke khair kis mein hai."

e: [AI] "The Prophet peace be upon him heard and the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him died when he was twelve years old."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ne Nabi (SAW) se suna, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal hua to unki umr das (10) saal thi."

e: [AI] "Regarding it, Al-Dhahabi in summarizing."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...unse." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] Ziyad entered upon Abdullah Ibn Ja'far speaking in five paragraphs. He gave him and he started saying, "We asked him a great deal and he gave us more than what we desired and increased it and improved it, then improved it again, then we returned and he improved it again, and I continued to go back to him repeatedly. I do not return to this world except that he smiled at me in amusement and folded the pillow." Al-Bukhari and Muslim agreed upon hearing Abdullah Ibn Ja'far Ibn Abu Talib from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when he was ten years old, and I remember by the will of Allah, in this place stating what they agreed upon with their chains of narrators.
hi: Ziyad Al-A'jam Abdullah bin Ja'far (RA) ke paas paanch diyaton ke silsile mein aaya, to unhone use de diya. Phir woh kehne laga [Bahr Al-Wafir, shayri ka ek wazan]: "Humne usse bohot kuch maanga to usne taamul nahi kiya, aur humari tamanna se zyada diya aur izafa bhi kiya. Usne ehsaan kiya, phir ehsaan kiya, phir hum laute to usne ehsaan kiya, phir main uske paas laut kar aaya to woh bhi (ehsaan ke saath) laut aaya, kai baar. Main kisi zamane mein bhi uske paas nahi lauta magar woh muskura kar hans pada aur takiya mere liye palat diya." Hakim ne kaha: "Bukhari aur Muslim is par muttafiq hain ke Abdullah bin Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se (ahadees) suni hain, jabke unki umr das saal thi. Allah ki mashiyat se main is jagah woh bayan karunga jis par dono ne apni asanid ke saath ittifaq kiya hai."

e: [AI] "I saw the Prophet ﷺ  wearing two garments dyed with saffron, a robe, and a turban."
hi: "Maine Nabi (SAW) par zaafraan se range hue do kapde, ek chaadar aur ek pagdi dekhi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding the price of a dog and the earnings of a cupper." Al-Dhahabi did not comment on it in the summary.
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko kutte ki qeemat aur pachhne lagane waale ki kamayi se mana karte suna." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ commanding a man, saying, "Ask Allah for forgiveness and well-being in this world and the hereafter." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ek aadmi ko hukm dete suna, aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah se dunya aur aakhirat mein afw aur aafiyat maango." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and what you have not seen, and do not tell us about others, even if he is trustworthy. He said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'What is between the navel and the knees is a private area.' I think it is a fabricated hadith."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ..."jo tumne Rasulullah (SAW) se suna aur jo tumne aap (SAW) se dekha (wohi bayan karo), aur humein kisi aur se bayan na karo, chahe woh thiqa ho." Unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Naaf se ghutne tak satr (chhupane ki jagah) hai." Mujhe lagta hai yeh mawdu' (gadhi hui) hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of its women is Maryam bint Imran, and the best of its women is Khadijah bint Khuwaylid." This was narrated by most of the companions of Hisham, and it is mentioned in the two Sahihs in this way.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is (ummat ki) auraton mein sabse behtar Maryam bint Imran hain, aur is (ummat ki) auraton mein sabse behtar Khadijah bint Khuwailid (RA) hain." Ise Hisham ke aksar shagirdon ne unse riwayat kiya hai, aur yeh Sahihain mein isi tarah nikali gayi hai.

e: [AI] "وَاثِلَةُ بْنُ الْأَسْقَعِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعُزَّى بْنِ عَبْدِ يَالِيلَ بْنِ نَاشِبِ بْنِ غَيْرَةَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ لَيْثٍ قَدِ اخْتَلَفُوا فِي كُنْيَتِهِ" translates to "Wathila bin Al-Asqaa bin Abdul Azza bin Abdul Yaleel bin Naseeb bin Ghayrah bin Saad bin Laith, their nickname differed."
hi: "Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' bin Abd al-Uzza bin Abd Yalil bin Nashib bin Ghairah bin Sa'd bin Laith (RA). Unki kunyat ke baare mein ikhtilaf hai."

e: [AI] Narrate to us a story that you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , which is free from any falsehood, additions, or forgetfulness." He said, "Did any of you recite anything from the Quran tonight?" We replied, "Yes, but we are not skillful in memorizing it." He said, "This Quran is written among you, and you recite it without memorizing it. Yet, you claim that you increase and decrease it. So how about the traditions we heard from the Messenger of Allah? Perhaps we only heard them once. It is sufficient for you when we narrate a tradition according to its meaning." It has been said that his nickname was Abu Qirsafa. Imam al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his compilation.
hi: Unse kaha gaya: "Humein koi aisi hadith sunayiye jo aapne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni ho, jismein na wahm ho, na izafa, na bhool." Unhone kaha: "Kya tum mein se kisi ne aaj raat Quran mein se kuch padha?" Humne kaha: "Ji haan, magar hum use poori tarah yaad rakhne waale nahi." Unhone kaha: "Yeh Quran tumhare darmiyan likha hua hai, tum uske hifz mein koi kasar nahi chhodte, phir bhi tum gumaan karte ho ke tum usmein kami beshi karte ho. To un ahadees ka kya haal hoga jo humne Rasulullah (SAW) se suni, shayad humne unhe sirf ek hi baar suna ho? Tumhare liye kaafi hai jab hum tumhare paas hadith uske maani ke saath le aayen." Aur kaha gaya hai ke unki kunyat Abu Qirsafah thi. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Do not fast Ramadan while traveling. Whoever fasts it should make up for it. Abu Al-Fayd said, 'I met Abu Qirsafa, Wathilah ibn Al-Asqa', and I asked him about it. He said, 'If I fasted and then fasted and then fasted, I could not make up for it.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent on summarizing it."
hi: "Safar mein Ramadan ke roze na rakho; jo rakhe woh unki qaza kare." Abu Al-Fayd ne kaha: Maine Abu Qirsafah Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (RA) se mulaqat ki aur unse poochha, to unhone kaha: "Agar main roza rakhun, phir rakhun, phir rakhun, to bhi qaza nahi karunga." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Wathila ibn al-Asqa' is known as Abu Qirsaftah. He had a house in Basra and it was said that his nickname was Abu Shaddad."
hi: "Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (RA) ki kunyat Abu Qirsafah thi, Basrah mein unka ghar tha. Aur kaha gaya hai ke unki kunyat Abu Shaddad thi."

e: [AI] I met Wathila ibn al-Asqa' and said, "How are you, Abu Shaddad?"
hi: Main Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (RA) se mila aur kaha: "Ae Abu Shaddad, aap kaise hain?"

e: [AI] Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' died at the age of 105 years and five years, in the year eighty-three.
hi: "Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (RA) ki wafaat hui to unki umr ek sau paanch (105) saal thi, aur yeh 83 Hijri mein hua."

e: [AI] I heard Yahya ibn Ma'in saying, "Wathila ibn al-Asqa died in the year eighty-three, at the age of one hundred and five years."
hi: Maine Yahya bin Ma'in ko kehte suna: "Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (RA) ki wafaat 83 Hijri mein hui, aur unki umr ek sau paanch (105) saal thi."

e: [AI] "My father used to sit facing the qibla after praying Fajr until the sun rose, and sometimes I would talk to him about a need but he would not respond. So I asked him, 'What's wrong?' He said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Whoever prays Fajr and then recites Qul Huwallahu Ahad one hundred times before speaking to anyone, his sins of a year will be forgiven."'
hi: Mere walid jab Fajr padh lete to qibla ki taraf munh karke baithe rehte yahan tak ke sooraj nikal aata. Kabhi main kisi zaroorat ke liye unse baat karta to woh mujhse baat nahi karte. Maine kaha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jo Fajr ki namaz padhe, phir kisi se baat karne se pehle sau (100) baar {Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad} padhe, uska ek saal ka gunah bakhsh diya jata hai."

e: [AI] When I embraced Islam, I went to the Prophet ﷺ, and he said to me, "Go and perform ablution with water and lotus leaves, and remove the hair of disbelief from your head." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then wiped over my head.
hi: Jab main Islam laaya to Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya. Aap (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: "Jao, paani aur ber ke patton se ghusl karo aur apne se kufr ke baal utaar do." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne mere sar par haath phera.

e: [AI] I heard Al-Abbas ibn Muhammad al-Duri say, "Abdullah ibn Abi Awfah is the father of Muawiya."
hi: Maine Al-Abbas bin Muhammad Ad-Duri ko kehte suna: "Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) ki kunyat Abu Mu'awiyah hai."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Abu Awfa, Abu Awfa's real name is Alqamah ibn Khalid ibn Al-Harith ibn Abu Usaid ibn Rifa'a ibn Tha'labah ibn Hawazin ibn Aslam ibn Afasah. He is also known as Abdullah Abu Muawiyah. The first major event witnessed by Abdullah ibn Abu Awfa with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the battle of Khaybar and thereafter he witnessed many other events. Abdullah ibn Abu Awfa remained in Madinah until the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, after which he migrated to Kufa and settled there along with the Muslims. He built a house for himself in Aslam and lost his eyesight. He passed away in Kufa in the year sixty-six."
hi: "Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA). Abu Awfa ka naam Alqamah bin Khalid bin Al-Harith bin Abi Usaid bin Rifa'ah bin Tha'labah bin Hawazin bin Aslam bin Afsa hai. Abdullah (RA) ki kunyat Abu Mu'awiyah thi. Hamare nazdeek Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath sabse pehle Khaibar mein shareek hue, aur uske baad ke tamam ghazwaat mein. Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke wisaal tak Madinah mein rahe, phir Kufa muntaqil ho gaye aur wahan us waqt muqeem hue jab musalmanon ne use aabad kiya, aur wahan Aslam ke ilaqe mein ghar banwaya. Unki beenai chali gayi thi, aur unki wafaat Kufa mein 86 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] I heard Abu Nuaym saying, "Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa died in the year eighty-seven or eighty-eight."
hi: Maine Abu Nu'aim ko kehte suna: "Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) ki wafaat 87 ya 88 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] "And it has been said that the last companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to die in Kufa was Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa."
hi: "Aur kaha gaya hai ke Kufa mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein sabse aakhir mein wafaat paane waale Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) the."

e: [AI] "Yes, and before that."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "Haan, aur uske pehle bhi."

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Abi Aufa was one of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ  and he was one of the 1,400 individuals from the Ansar who embraced Islam on that day which was known as "The Day of the Migrants.""
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) se: "Ashab ash-Shajarah (Bay'at-e-Ridwan waale) ek hazaar chaar sau (1,400) the, aur us din Aslam (qabila) Muhajireen ka aathwan hissa tha."

e: [AI] I went to Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa, the companion of the Prophet ﷺ  and greeted him while he had his sight obscured. He asked me, "Who are you?" I said, "I am Sa'id ibn Jumhan." He asked, "What happened to your father?" I said, "He was killed by the Azariqa." He said, "May Allah curse the Azariqa. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  informed us that they are the dogs of Hellfire." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi Abdullah bin Abi Awfa (RA) ke paas aaya aur unhe salam kiya, jabke unki beenai jaa chuki thi. Unhone mujhse poochha: "Tum kaun ho?" Maine kaha: "Main Sa'id bin Jumhan hun." Unhone poochha: "Tumhare walid ka kya hua?" Maine kaha: "Unhe Azariqa ne qatl kar diya." Unhone kaha: "Allah Azariqa par laanat kare! Hamse Rasulullah (SAW) ne bayan farmaya ke woh jahannam ke kutte hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] His name was "Huzn" but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named him "Sahl."
hi: (Riwayat hai ke) "unka naam Huzn tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Sahl rakha."

e: [AI] I said to Sahl ibn Saad al-Sa'idi, "O father of Abbas."
hi: Maine Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi (RA) se kaha: "Ae Abu Al-Abbas!"

e: [AI] I heard Abu Nuaym saying, "Sahl ibn Saad al-Saadi died in the year eighty-eight."
hi: Maine Abu Nu'aim ko kehte suna: "Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi (RA) ki wafaat 88 Hijri mein hui."

e: [AI] On the authority of Sahl ibn Saad al-Ansari, he said, "I witnessed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when I was fifteen years old."
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd Al-Ansari (RA) se: "Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ka zamana paya jabke unki umr pandrah (15) saal thi."

e: [AI] "About him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...unse." Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (iske baare mein khamoshi).

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, while they were saying such and such, if I came, they would not hear anyone say, "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'It is authentic according to the conditions of the two Sheikhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim) and they did not exclude it.'"
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...Rasulullah (SAW) se" aur woh log is is tarah keh rahe the, "aur agar main aa jata to unhone kisi ko yeh kehte hue na suna hota ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna." Hakim ne kaha: "Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, magar in dono ne ise nahi nikaala." Adh-Dhahabi ne bhi kaha: Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par.

e: [AI] I saw Sahal ibn Saad with his white beard and his mustache well-groomed.
hi: Maine Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ko dekha, unki dadhi safed thi aur unhone apni moonchhein bilkul chhoti kar rakhi thi.

e: [AI] He (the Prophet) attended the day.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas us din hazir hue..."

e: [AI] Saad bin Sa'd Al-Saedi, also known as Abu Al-Abbas in Al-Madinah, died in the year ninety-one (AH). He was the last companion of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  to pass away in Al-Madinah at the age of one hundred.
hi: Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Al-Abbas thi, Madina mein 91 Hijri mein faut hue. Woh Madina mein Nabi (SAW) ke Sahaba mein sabse aakhri faut hone wale the, aur unki umr sau (100) saal thi.

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Abi Hadrad al-Aslami, also known as Abu Muhammad, died in the year seventy-one when he was eighty-one years old. The name of his father was Salamah, and he belonged to the Banu Rifaa'ah clan from Aslam.
hi: Abdullah bin Abi Hadrad Al-Aslami (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Muhammad thi, 71 Hijri mein faut hue aur unki umr 81 saal thi. Abu Hadrad ka naam Salamah tha, aur woh Bani Rifa'ah se the, jo Aslam ka ek zeli qabila hai.

e: [AI] About him, Al-Dhahabi in summary
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...iske baare mein" Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (khamoshi ka).

e: [AI] "That he humiliates him with that."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke woh is ke zariye use zaleel kare."

e: [AI] "Anas bin Malik passed away in the year of ninety-three."
hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) 93 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] "Anas ibn Malik ibn al-Nadr ibn Dammad ibn Zaid ibn Haram ibn Jundub ibn 'Amir ibn Ghanm ibn 'Adi ibn al-Najjar, and his mother Um Sulaim bint Milhan."
hi: Anas bin Malik bin An-Nadr bin Damdam bin Zaid bin Haram bin Jundub bin Amir bin Ghanm bin Adi bin An-Najjar (RA), aur unki walida Umm Sulaim bint Milhan (RA) thin.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  arrived in the city and I was ten years old, and he passed away when I was twenty years old.
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Nabi (SAW) Madina tashreef laaye to meri umr das saal thi, aur aap (SAW) ki wafaat hui to meri umr bees saal thi."

e: [AI] "Steady, O Abu Hamza."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) Thabit ne kaha: "Ae Abu Hamza!" (Abu Hamza Anas (RA) ki kunyat hai.)

e: [AI] "I heard this from the Prophet ﷺ , so I wrote it down and presented it to him." The narration is considered munkar (rejected).
hi: "Yeh (hadees) maine Nabi (SAW) se suni, to maine use likh liya aur aap (SAW) ke samne pesh kar diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Yeh hadees munkar hai."

e: [AI] When Anas entered upon Al-Hajjaj, he commanded his head to be brought and then said, "O people of Sham, do you recognize this? This is the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Then he said, "Do you know why I brought his head?" They said, "The prince knows." He said, "Indeed, he endured afflictions in the first turmoil and hid his feelings in the last turmoil." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Jab Anas (RA) Al-Hajjaj ke paas dakhil hue, to usne unki gardan par waar (chot) karne ka hukm diya. Phir kaha: "Ae ahl-e-Sham! Kya tum ise jaante ho? Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ke khadim hain." Phir kaha: "Jaante ho maine iski gardan par waar kyun kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Ameer behtar jaanta hai." Usne kaha: "Yeh pehle fitne mein azmaish ke beech tha, aur aakhri fitne mein seene mein khot (bad-khwahi) rakhta tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abdul Malik, write to Al-Hajjaj, "O boy!" So he wrote to him, "Woe to you! I feared that no one would be able to fix things in your hands. So when my letter reaches you, go quickly to apologize to Anas ibn Malik."
hi: Abd al-Malik ne kaha: "Ae ghulam! Al-Hajjaj ko likho." To usne likha: "Teri tabahi ho! Mujhe darr hai ke tere haath par koi bhi theek na reh sakega. Jab meri yeh chitthi tere paas pahunche to uth, yahan tak ke Anas bin Malik (RA) se maafi maang le." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Anas said, "O Abu Muhammad, take from me, for I have taken from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has taken from Allah, the Almighty. And you will not take from anybody who is more credible than me."
hi: Anas (RA) ne kaha: "Ae Abu Muhammad! Mujhse (ilm) le lo, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) se liya hai, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Allah Ta'ala se liya hai, aur tum mujhse zyada bharose ke laaiq kisi se nahi le sakoge."

e: [AI] About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and whenever he spoke about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he would say, or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...Rasulullah (SAW) se" aur jab woh Rasulullah (SAW) se hadees bayan karte to kehte: "ya jaisa Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I asked Musa ibn Anas, "How many battles did the Prophet ﷺ  participate in?" He replied, "He fought in twenty-three battles and led eight expeditions where the months were settled." Then I asked, "How many battles did Anas participate in with the Prophet ﷺ ?" He replied, "He took part in eight battles."
hi: Maine Musa bin Anas se poocha: "Nabi (SAW) ne kitne ghazwe kiye?" Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) ne teis (23) ghazwe kiye, aur aath (8) ghazwe aise (jinmein aap (SAW) mahine-mahine thehre)." Maine poocha: "Anas (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath kitne ghazwe kiye?" Unhone kaha: "Aath (8) ghazwe."

e: [AI] "From the Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him, a man said: 'Did you hear it from the Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him?' He became extremely angry and said: 'By Allah, not everything we tell you did we hear from the Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him. Rather, some of us would inform others and would not accuse one another.'"
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...Rasulullah (SAW) se" to ek aadmi ne kaha: "Kya aapne ise Rasulullah (SAW) se suna hai?" Woh sakht ghusse mein aaye aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam! Har woh baat jo hum tumse bayan karte hain humne Rasulullah (SAW) se nahi suni hoti, balki hum ek doosre se bayan karte the aur ek doosre par tohmat nahi lagate the."

e: [AI] "Hamal bin Malik bin Al-Nabighah bin Jabir bin Ubaid bin Rabia bin Kaab bin Al-Harith bin Kathir bin Hind bin Tabikha bin Lihiyan bin Huthayl Al-Hudhali has a house in Basra."
hi: Hamal bin Malik bin An-Nabigha bin Jabir bin Ubaid bin Rabi'ah bin Ka'b bin Al-Harith bin Kathir bin Hind bin Tabikhah bin Lihyan bin Hudhail Al-Hudhali (RA) ka Basra mein ghar tha.

e: [AI] "Allah's Messenger ﷺ  decreed in the case of a fetus, and then Hamal ibn Malik ibn al-Nabighah al-Hudhali stood up and said, 'O Amir al-Mu'minin, I was between two women, meaning two slave-girls of mine, and I came out and one of them struck the other with a piece of wood and killed her, and she also killed what was in her womb.' So the Prophet ﷺ  passed judgment regarding the fetus of a slave or a slave-girl. 'Umar said, 'Allah is the Greatest, had we not heard about this, we would have decided differently.'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne janin (pet ke bachche) ke baare mein faisla farmaya." To Hamal bin Malik bin An-Nabigha Al-Hudhali (RA) khade hue aur kaha: "Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Main do aurton ke beech tha, yaani do sautanon ke, to main (ghar se) nikal gaya, aur unmein se ek ne doosri ko apne khaime ke sutoon se maar diya, to use bhi maar daala aur jo uske pet mein tha use bhi." To Nabi (SAW) ne janin ke baare mein ek ghulam ya laundi ki ghurrah (diyat) ka faisla farmaya. Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Allahu Akbar! Agar hum yeh na sunte to is ke ilawa faisla kar dete."

e: [AI] Abu Talib had three sons: Aqeel, Ja'far, and Ali. Each one of them was ten years older than his companion in loyalty.
hi: Abu Talib ke yahan Aqeel (RA), Ja'far (RA) aur Ali (RA) paida hue; har ek apne saathi se tarteeb se das saal bada tha.

e: [AI] Aqeel ibn Abi Talib came to Kufa, Basra, and Sham, and he died during the caliphate of Muawiyah.
hi: Aqeel bin Abi Talib (RA) Kufa, Basra aur Sham aaye, aur Mu'awiyah (RA) ki khilafat mein faut hue.

e: [AI] That the Quraysh faced severe crises and Abu Talib had many dependents. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to his uncle Abbas, who belonged to the lesser branch of the Hashemite clan, "O Abu al-Fadl, your brother Abu Talib has many dependents and the people are suffering from what you see from this crisis. So come with me to him and we will relieve him of some of his dependents. You take one of his sons and I will take one, and we will take care of them on his behalf." Abbas agreed, so they went until they reached Abu Talib and said to him, "We want to relieve you of some of your dependents so that the people may see what they are going through." Abu Talib replied, "If you leave me Aqeel, then do as you please." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took Ali and held him close to himself, and Abbas took Ja'far and held him close to himself. Ali remained with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  until Allah made him a prophet and he followed him and believed in him. Abbas took Ja'far and Ja'far remained with Abbas until he embraced Islam and became independent.
hi: Quraysh par sakht qahat-saali aa padi, aur Abu Talib ke ayal (bal-bachche) bohot the. Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne chacha Abbas (RA) se, jo Bani Hashim mein sabse zyada khushhaal the, farmaya: "Ae Abu Al-Fadl! Aapke bhai Abu Talib ayal-daar hain, aur logon par yeh qahat aaya hai jo aap dekh rahe hain. Chaliye hamare saath unke paas, hum unke ayal ka bojh halka karen: unke betoon mein se ek aadmi main le lun aur ek aap le len, aur hum donon unki taraf se unki kafalat karen." Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Haan." Phir dono chale yahan tak ke Abu Talib ke paas pahunche aur kaha: "Hum chahte hain ke aapke ayal ka bojh halka karen, jab tak logon se yeh museebat khul na jaye." Abu Talib ne un dono se kaha: "Agar tum Aqeel ko mere paas chhod do, to jo chaho karo." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA) ko le liya aur apne saath mila liya, aur Abbas (RA) ne Ja'far (RA) ko le liya aur apne saath mila liya. Ali (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath rahe yahan tak ke Allah ne aap (SAW) ko nabi bana kar bheja, to unhone aap (SAW) ki pairwi ki aur aap (SAW) ki tasdeeq ki. Aur Abbas (RA) ne Ja'far (RA) ko liya, aur Ja'far (RA) Abbas (RA) ke saath rahe yahan tak ke Islam laaye aur unse beniyaz ho gaye.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Aqil ibn Abi Talib, 'O Abu Yazid, Indeed, I love you with two loves: a love for your kinship with me and a love for the knowledge I had of the love of my uncle for you.' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Aqeel bin Abi Talib (RA) se farmaya: "Ae Abu Yazid! Main tumse do mohabbaton se mohabbat karta hun: ek is liye ke tum mere rishtedaar ho, aur ek is liye ke mujhe maloom tha ke mere chacha ko tumse kitni mohabbat thi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to say to Ali, "Verily, I love you, O Ali, with two kinds of love: love for you and love for the love of my father, Abu Talib. Beware of that." This statement is found in the hadith.
hi: Nabi (SAW) Aqeel (RA) se farmate: "Ae Aqeel! Main tumse do mohabbaton se mohabbat karta hun: ek tumhari wajah se, aur ek is liye ke Abu Talib ko tumse mohabbat thi." In dono hadeeson ki wazahat (Adhoora jumla:) "...us hadees mein hai jo..."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out of a house with his uncles Abbas, Hamza, Ali, Ja'far, and Uqail. They were working in a land. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to his uncles, "Choose from among them." One of them said, "I choose Ja'far," and the other said, "I choose Ali." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "You both have made a good choice, so I choose Ali."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ghar se (bahar) nazar daal kar dekhne lage, aur aap (SAW) ke saath aap ke do chacha Abbas (RA) aur Hamza (RA) the; aur Ali (RA), Ja'far (RA) aur Aqeel (RA) ek zameen mein kaam kar rahe the. Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne dono chachaon se farmaya: "In mein se (ek ek) chun lo." To ek ne kaha: "Maine Ja'far ko chuna," aur doosre ne kaha: "Maine Ali ko chuna." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine tumhein ikhtiyar diya, to tumne chun liya, aur Allah ne mere liye Ali ko chun liya."

e: [AI] Talha is a small sapling that grew due to the intensity of the heat. Because of the scorching heat of the summer, he started looking for shade and walking in it. So we approached him and Abu Talib said, "Your cousins claim that you harm them in their gatherings and councils, so refrain from that." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ lifted his eyes to the sky and said, "What do you see from this sun?" They replied, "Yes." He said, "I am not able to leave that from you, so that you may be occupied with it." Abu Talib said, "We have never lied about my nephew before, so go back."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Talha (babool ka darakht) ek chhoti si kopal tha..." Phir (Nabi (SAW)) dopahar mein shiddat-e-garmi mein aaye, aur saaya dhoondhne lage, garm ret ki shiddat mein us mein chalte hue. Hum un logon ke paas pahunche to Abu Talib ne kaha: "Tumhare chachazaad kehte hain ke tum unki mehfil aur baithak mein unhein takleef dete ho, to is se baaz aa jao." Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni nazar aasman ki taraf uthayi aur farmaya: "Kya tum is sooraj ko dekhte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main is (kaam) ko chhodne par utna hi qaadir nahi hun, jitna tum is (sooraj) se aag ka ek sholah jala lene par qaadir ho." To Abu Talib ne kaha: "Humne apne bhatije ko kabhi jhutlaya nahi, to lautt jao."

e: [AI] Rather say: "May Allah bless you and bless upon you."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...Balki kaho: Allah tumhein barkat de aur tum par barkat nazil kare."

e: [AI] "Ma'qil ibn Yasār ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Haraq ibn Lu'ayy ibn Ka'ab ibn 'Abd ibn Thawr ibn Hadmata ibn Lātim ibn 'Uthmān ibn 'Amr ibn Add ibn Ṭābikhah, known as Aba 'Ali, had a position in Basra. Ma'qil ibn Yasār died during the rule of Ibn Ziyad in the year fifty-eight."
hi: Ma'qil bin Yasar bin Abdullah bin Harraq bin Luayy bin Ka'b bin Abd bin Thawr bin Hadmah bin Latim bin Uthman bin Amr bin Add bin Tabikhah (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Ali thi, ka Basra mein ek khitta (zameen ka tukda) tha. Ma'qil bin Yasar (RA) Ibn Ziyad ki imarat mein 58 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded me to judge between my people, so I said, "How can I judge them well?" He said, "Just make a decision between them." So I asked, "How can I make a fair decision?" He said, "Just judge between them, for indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, is with the judge as long as he does not commit injustice intentionally." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe hukm diya ke main apni qaum ke darmiyan faisla karun. Maine kaha: "Mujhe faisla karna acchi tarah nahi aata." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke darmiyan fasl (faisla) kar do." Maine kaha: "Mujhe fasl karna bhi acchi tarah nahi aata." To aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Unke darmiyan faisla karo, kyunke Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala qaazi ke saath hota hai jab tak woh jaan-boojh kar zulm na kare." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Follow the Book of Allah and do not lie about anything from it. If you are uncertain about something, ask the people of knowledge, as they will inform you. Believe in the Torah, the Injeel (Gospel), and believe in the Criterion (Quran) for it contains clarification. It is the intercessor, and it is the one that will be pleaded with, and it is the one that will debate, and it is the one that will be summoned." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Allah ki kitab par amal karo aur uski kisi cheez ko mat jhutlao. Jo baat tumhein usmein mushtabah ho, uske baare mein ahl-e-ilm se poocho, woh tumhein bata denge. Tauraat aur Injeel par imaan lao, aur Furqan par imaan lao, kyunke usmein bayan hai; woh shafa'at (sifarish) karne wala hai, jiski shafa'at qubool ki jaati hai, jhagadne wala (maahil) aur jiski tasdeeq ki gayi hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "O commander of the faithful, Asbahan has been hit on the head."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Asbahan ka sar..." (lafzi tarjuma; sandarbh waazeh nahi.)

e: [AI] "Abdullah son of Mughaffal, son of Abd Nahim, son of Afif, son of Suhaim, son of Rabia, son of Adi, son of Tha'laba, son of Dhuayb, son of Saad, son of Adi, son of Uthman, son of Amr, son of Add, son of Tabikha."
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal bin Abd Nahm bin Afif bin Suhaim bin Rabi'ah bin Adi bin Tha'labah bin Dhu'ayb bin Sa'd bin Adi bin Uthman bin Amr bin Add bin Tabikhah (RA).

e: [AI] "And Abdullah ibn Mughaffal al-Muzani is known as Abu Sa'id. He mentioned this lineage and added to it that his mother is al-Attilah bint Muawiyah ibn Qurrah ibn Muzaynah, and he has a house in Basra in the presence of the mosque."
hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Sa'id thi. Unhone yehi nasab bayan kiya aur ismein izafa kiya: unki walida Al-Atila bint Muawiyah bin Qurrah bin Muzaynah thin. Basra mein jami masjid ke qareeb unka ghar tha.

e: [AI] "If I die, then add camphor to my last washing and wrap me in two shrouds and a shirt, for the Prophet ﷺ  did the same." (Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.)
hi: "Jab main mar jaun to mere aakhri ghusl mein kafoor daalna, aur mujhe do chaadaron aur ek qameez mein kafan dena, kyunke Nabi (SAW) ke saath bhi yehi kiya gaya tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Wa Ka'ab ibn Zuhayr and Bujayr ibn Zuhayr ibn Abi Sulma, and the name of Abi Sulma is Rabi'ah ibn Rabah ibn Qurt ibn al-Harith ibn Qatadah ibn Halaawah ibn Tha'labah ibn Thawr ibn Hadmata ibn Latim ibn Uthman ibn Amr ibn Add ibn Tabikha, they came to the Prophet ﷺ and accepted Islam and became his companions."
hi: Ka'b bin Zuhayr (RA) aur Bujayr bin Zuhayr bin Abi Sulma (RA). Abu Sulma ka naam Rabi'ah bin Rabah bin Qurt bin Al-Harith bin Qatadah bin Halawah bin Tha'labah bin Thawr bin Hadmah bin Latim bin Uthman bin Amr bin Add bin Tabikhah tha. Dono Nabi (SAW) ke paas wafd ban kar aaye, Islam laaye aur aap (SAW) ki sohbat paayi.

Ka'b aur Bujayr, Zuhayr ke dono bete, nikle yahan tak ke Abraq Al-Azzaf pahunche. Bujayr ne Ka'b se kaha: "Jaldi se isi jagah thehre raho, yahan tak ke main is aadmi, yaani Rasulullah (SAW), ke paas jaun aur suunu woh kya kehte hain." Ka'b thehre rahe aur Bujayr chale gaye. Rasulullah (SAW) tashreef laaye aur unke saamne Islam pesh kiya, to woh Islam le aaye. Yeh baat Ka'b tak pahunchi to unhone kaha [Bahr At-Tawil]: "Suno! Meri taraf se Bujayr ko yeh paigham pahuncha do: kis cheez par tujhe, tere siva kisi ki tabahi ho, rehnumayi di gayi? Aisi raah par jis par na tune maa paayi na baap, aur na uspar apna bhai paaya. Abu Bakr ne tujhe sairab karne wala pyala pilaya, aur Al-Ma'mun ne tujhe usse pehla aur doosra ghoont pilaya." Jab yeh ashaar Rasulullah (SAW) tak pahunche to aap (SAW) ne unka khoon rayegaan (mubah) kar diya aur farmaya: "Jo Ka'b ko paaye use qatl kar de." Bujayr ne apne bhai ko likha aur use bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne uska khoon mubah kar diya hai, aur kaha: "Bach nikal, aur main nahi samajhta ke tu bach sakega." Phir uske baad likha: "Jaan lo ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas jo bhi aata hai aur gawahi deta hai ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi aur Muhammad (SAW) Allah ke Rasool hain, aap (SAW) use qubool kar lete hain. Jab meri yeh chitthi tere paas pahunche to Islam le aa aur chala aa." To Ka'b Islam laaye aur woh qaseeda kaha jis mein Rasulullah (SAW) ki tareef ki. Phir aaye yahan tak ke apni ounthni Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid ke darwaze par bitha di, phir masjid mein daakhil hue. Rasulullah (SAW) apne Sahaba ke saath dastarkhwan ki jagah par the, log aap (SAW) ke irdgird halqa dar halqa baithe the; aap (SAW) kabhi in ki taraf mutawajjeh hokar unse baat karte, kabhi un ki taraf. Ka'b ne kaha: "Maine ounthni masjid ke darwaze par bithayi, aur sifaat se Rasulullah (SAW) ko pehchan liya, to logon ke beech se guzar kar aap (SAW) ke paas ja baitha aur Islam qubool kiya, aur kaha: 'Main gawahi deta hun ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi aur aap Allah ke Rasool hain. Aman, ya Rasulullah!' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum kaun ho?' Maine kaha: 'Main Ka'b bin Zuhayr hun.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum hi woh ho jo kehta hai...' Phir Abu Bakr (RA) ki taraf mutawajjeh hue aur farmaya: 'Ae Abu Bakr! Usne kaise kaha tha?' To Abu Bakr (RA) ne sunaya: 'Abu Bakr ne tujhe sairab karne wala pyala pilaya, aur Al-Ma'mur ne tujhe usse pehla aur doosra ghoont pilaya.' Ka'b ne kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Maine yun nahi kaha tha.' Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Phir kaise kaha tha?' Kaha: 'Maine to yeh kaha tha: Abu Bakr ne tujhe sairab karne wala pyala pilaya, aur Al-Ma'mun ne tujhe usse pehla aur doosra ghoont pilaya.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ki qasam, Ma'mun hi hai.'" Phir unhone poora qaseeda sunaya, yahan tak ke uske aakhir tak pahunche, aur use Al-Hajjaj bin Dhi Ruqaybah ko imla karaya. Aur woh qaseeda yeh hai [Bahr Al-Basit] (mazmoon ka tarjuma): "Su'ad door chali gayi, to aaj mera dil bimar hai, uske peeche aisa deewana ke jise fidya nahi diya gaya, zanjeer mein jakda hua. Judai ki subah jab woh kooch kar gaye, to Su'ad bas ek narm awaaz wali, jhuki nigaah wali, surma lagi aankhon wali thi. Jab muskurati hai to chamakte daant dikhati hai, goya sharab ka woh pyala jo doosri baar pilaya gaya ho; saaqiyon ne use ek moD wali wadi ke saaf paani mein mila diya, Abtah ke woh thande paani se, jise hawayein tinkon se saaf karti hain aur safed baadalon ki barish se woh labalab hai. Us dost ka bhala ho, kaash woh apne wade mein sachi hoti, aur kaash naseehat qubool ki jaati! Lekin woh aisi dost hai jiske khoon mein judai, deewangi, wada-khilafi aur badal jaana mila hua hai. Woh kisi haalat par nahi tikti, jaise Ghul apne libaas badalti rehti hai. Jis wasl ka usne dawa kiya uska bharosa mat karo, woh to aisa hai jaise chhalni paani ko rokti hai. Urqub ke wade uski misaal ban gaye, aur uske wade jhoot ke siwa kuch nahi. To jo usne umeed dilayi aur jo wada kiya usse dhokha na khana, woh sirf aarzoo aur gumrah karne wale khwab hain. Main umeed karta hun ke uski mohabbat qareeb ho, magar mujhe nahi lagta tujhse humein kuch milega. Su'ad aisi zameen mein ja pahunchi jahan tak sirf aale nasl, tez raftaar ounthniyan hi pahunchati hain, aur wahan tak sirf mazboot, tez daudne wali ounthni pahuncha sakti hai jo thakan mein bhi tez chalti hai. (Yahan se kai ashaar mein ounthni ki tareef hai:) uski gardan ke peeche pasina tapakta hai, kaale rang ki mazboot, jis par chichdi chal kar phisal jaati hai; uske jism ki banawat mazboot, kohni seene se juda hui, nigaah aur gardan tez, tez raftaar aur halki; uske pair aise ke zameen par tez daudte hue rukte nahi, jabke garmi mein seharaon ki saraab-numa mausiqi mein woh daudti hai aur dhoop mein girgit (haarba) bhi jalta hua tikta hai, aur ek waqt aisa ke bain karti hui aurtein, jinke bacche mar gaye hon, ek doosre ko jawab dene khadi hon, aur bain karne wali kamzor baazuon wali, jab bachon ki maut ki khabar sunane wale sunate hain, hosh kho baithti hain. Chugal-khor uske dono pehlu mein daud rahe hain, aur unka kehna hai: 'Ae Ibn Abi Sulma! Tu to qatl hone wala hai.' Maine kaha: Uske raaste se hat jao, tumhara baap na ho! Jo kuch Rahman ne muqaddar kiya hai wahi hoga. Har aurat ka beta, chahe uski salamati kitni hi lambi ho, ek din ek jhuki hui charpai (janaaze) par utha liya jayega. Mujhe khabar mili ke Rasulullah ne mujhe dhamki di hai, halanke Rasulullah ke paas se maafi ki ummeed hai. Main Rasulullah ke paas uzr karta hua aaya hun, aur Rasulullah ke paas uzr qubool kiya jaata hai. Thehriye, ae us (Allah) ke Rasool jisne aapko Quran ki ata ki, jis mein naseehatein aur tafseel hain! Mujhe chugal-khoron ki baaton par na pakdein, maine koi jurm nahi kiya chahe meri taraf se baatein kitni hi hoon. Maine ek aisi jagah khade hokar dekha aur suna ke agar hathi bhi woh sunta to kaanp utthta, siwa iske ke Allah ke izn se Rasool ke paas se use inayat milti. Yahan tak ke maine apna seedha haath uske haath mein rakh diya, jhagde baghair, ek aise ke haath mein jiski baat hi faisla hai. Mere nazdeek woh us waqt zyada khaufnaak tha jab mujhse kaha gaya: 'Tu nishaan-zad hai aur tujhse sawal hone wala hai.' (Phir sher ki misaal:) ek aise sher se bhi zyada jo apni jhaadi mein hai, jiske tez daant hain, jiske liye Atthar ki wadi ke andar jungal ke andar jungal hai; woh subah nikalta hai to do sheron ko gosht khilata hai jinke paas qaum ke aadmiyon ka bikhra hua gosht hai. Uski wajah se jungli gadhe dubley rehte hain, aur uski wadi mein paidal chalne wale nahi chalte; aur uski wadi mein tu hamesha bharosemand bhai ko paega, jiske kapde aur saamaan phenke hue aur khaye hue hain. Beshak Rasool ek noor hain jis se roshni li jaati hai, aur Allah ki talwaron mein se ek nangi talwar. Quraysh ke un jawanon mein, jinme se kisi ne Makkah ki wadi mein jab woh Islam laaye kaha: 'Hijrat karo!' Woh hijrat karne wale chale gaye, na ghabrane wale, na muqable ke waqt beparda (bina hathiyaar) aur na ek taraf jhuke hue ya hathiyar se mahroom. Oonchi naak wale bahadur, jinki jang mein poshak Dawood (AS) ke bune hue safed, kushada zirahen hain jin mein halqe jore gaye hain, goya ve halqe ek gunthi hui (rassi) hain. Woh chamakdar mazboot oonton ki si chaal chalte hain, jab kale kamzor log jang se bhaag jaate hain to unki zarb unhein bachati hai. Jab unke naize kisi qaum ko giraate hain to khush nahi hote, aur jab unhein zakhm lagta hai to ghabrate nahi. Naize ka waar sirf unke seenon par padta hai, aur maut ke hauzon se unhein koi hatne wala nahi."

e: [AI] Ka'b ibn Zuhayr ibn Abi Sulma recited in the Mosque: "Su'aad has appeared. My heart is today infatuated and captivated by her, never before has my love been so intensely expressed."
hi: Ka'b bin Zuhayr bin Abi Sulma (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko masjid mein sunaya [Bahr Al-Basit]: "Su'ad door chali gayi, to aaj mera dil bimar hai, uske peeche aisa deewana ke jise fidya nahi diya gaya, zanjeer mein jakda hua."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ recited a poem by Ka'b ibn Zuhayr that Suad was revealed in his mosque in the city of Madinah. When his words reached the part: "Indeed the Messenger is a sword that is illuminated by, and a scimitar from the swords of Allah, unsheathed in the youth of Quraysh," one of the youths from the people of Makkah who had embraced Islam [said], "They refer to the belly of Makkah when they became Muslims." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ signaled with his chin towards them so they would listen to him. And Bujayr ibn Zuhayr wrote to his brother Ka'b ibn Zuhayr ibn Abi Sulma, intimidating and inviting him to Islam, and he mentioned him in verses: "Who will inform Ka'b? Do you have any criticism against the one I address, even though she is most devoted to Allah, not Al-Uzza or Al-Laat alone? So, seek salvation when the salvation is there, and submit to me on a day where no one will escape, except those with pure hearts, submitting. So the religion of Zuhayr is not invalid, and the religion of Abi Sulma is forbidden upon me."
hi: Ka'b bin Zuhayr (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ko Madina mein aap (SAW) ki masjid mein "Banat Su'ad" sunayi. Jab woh apne is qaul par pahunche [Bahr Al-Basit]: "Beshak Rasool ek talwar hain jis se roshni li jaati hai, aur Allah ki talwaron mein se ek nangi talwar, Quraysh ke un jawanon mein jinme se kisi ne Makkah ki wadi mein jab woh Islam laaye kaha: 'Hijrat karo'", to Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni aasteen se logon ki taraf ishara kiya ta ke woh unse sunen. Raawi ne kaha: Bujayr bin Zuhayr ne apne bhai Ka'b bin Zuhayr bin Abi Sulma ko khat likha tha, jis mein use daraya aur Islam ki dawat di thi, aur usmein kuch ashaar kahe the [Bahr At-Tawil]: "Kaun Ka'b ko yeh pahuncha de: kya tujhe us (raah) mein dilchaspi hai jis par tu bewajah malamat karta hai, halanke woh zyada mazboot hai? Sirf Allah ki taraf (aa), na Uzza na Lat, to tu najaat paayega jab najaat hogi aur salamat rahega. Mere paas ek aisa din hai jismein koi nahi bachega, aur aag se koi nahi bachega siwa paak dil Muslim ke. Zuhayr ka deen kuch nahi, baatil hai, aur Abu Sulma ka deen mujh par haram hai."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  arrived in Madinah after leaving Ta'if, Bujair Ibn Zuhair Ibn Abi Salma wrote a letter to his brother Ka'b Ibn Zuhair Ibn Abi Salma informing him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had killed some men in Makkah who used to insult and harm him. He also mentioned that the remaining poets of Quraysh, Ibn Al-Ziba'ra and Hubayrah Ibn Abi Wahb, had fled in every direction. He advised Ka'b to seek forgiveness from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  if he had any need, as the Messenger would not kill anyone who came to him repentant. If he did not do so, he should flee for his own safety. Ka'b responded to his brother's message with a poem in which he praised the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and expressed his fear for his own life. It is mentioned that Ka'b showed this poem to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and it became well-known. Ka'b then left until he reached Madinah, where he stayed with a man who had a connection with him from Juhayna tribe. The next morning, he went with this man to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when he was praying Fajr (before sunrise). Ka'b prayed with the people and then the man pointed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "This is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Approach him and seek his safety." The man later told Ka'b that he had approached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and placed his hand in His hand, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not recognize him. Ka'b said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am Ka'b Ibn Zuhair, who has come to you seeking safety and repentance. Would you accept it from me if I bring him to you?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "Yes." Ka'b then said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am Ka'b Ibn Zuhair."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) Ta'if se laut kar Madina tashreef laaye, to Bujayr bin Zuhayr bin Abi Sulma ne apne bhai Ka'b bin Zuhayr bin Abi Sulma ko likha ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne Makkah mein kuch aise aadmiyon ko qatl kiya hai jo aap (SAW) ki hijv (burai) karte aur aap (SAW) ko takleef dete the, aur Quraysh ke baaqi shu'ara, Ibn Az-Zib'ara aur Hubayrah bin Abi Wahb, har taraf bhaag gaye hain. "Agar tujhe apni jaan ki zaroorat (fikr) hai to Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf ud aa, kyunke aap (SAW) kisi ko qatl nahi karte jo tauba karke aap ke paas aaye; aur agar tu na kare to apni jaan bacha kar jahan bach sake nikal ja." Ka'b ne kuch ashaar kahe the jinmein Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein zabaan darazi ki thi, yahan tak ke woh unse riwayat kiye gaye aur mashhoor ho gaye. Unhone kaha tha [Bahr At-Tawil]: "Suno! Meri taraf se Bujayr ko yeh paigham pahuncha do: kya tujhe mere kehne mein koi dilchaspi hai, teri tabahi ho? Mujhe bata, agar main yeh na karun, to kis cheez par tujhe, tere siva kisi ki tabahi ho, rehnumayi di gayi? Aisi raah par jis par na tune maa paayi na baap. Agar tu na kare to mujhe afsos nahi, aur thokar khane par main kuch nahi kahunga. Al-Ma'mun ne tujhe sairab karne wala pyala pilaya, to Al-Ma'mun ne tujhe usse pehla aur doosra ghoont pilaya." Raawi ne kaha: Ka'b ne "Al-Ma'mun" isliye kaha kyunke Quraysh Rasulullah (SAW) ke baare mein yeh kehte the. Jab Ka'b tak (Bujayr ki yeh baat) pahunchi to zameen un par tang ho gayi, apni jaan ka khauf hua, aur unke shehar mein jo unke dushman the unhone afwah uda di ke woh maara jayega. Jab koi chara na raha to unhone apna woh qaseeda kaha jismein Rasulullah (SAW) ki tareef ki, apna khauf aur chugal-khoron ki afwahon ka zikr kiya. Phir nikle yahan tak ke Madina pahunche aur Juhayna ke ek aadmi ke yahan utre jisse unki jaan-pehchan thi, jaisa mujhse zikr kiya gaya. Woh subah unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas le gaye jab aap (SAW) ne Fajr padhi; unhone logon ke saath namaz padhi, phir us aadmi ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: "Yeh Rasulullah hain, uth kar unse aman maango." Mujhse zikr kiya gaya ke Ka'b uthe yahan tak ke apna haath aap (SAW) ke haath mein rakh diya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) unhein pehchante nahi the. Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Ka'b bin Zuhayr tauba karke Muslim hokar aapse aman maangne aaya hai. Kya aap us se qubool karenge agar main use aapke paas le aaun?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main Ka'b bin Zuhayr hun." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Qurra ibn Iyas ibn Hilal ibn Rabab ibn Ubaid Allah ibn Dhuwai'ib ibn Aws ibn Sawwara ibn 'Amr ibn Sariyah ibn Tha'labah ibn Dinar ibn Sulaiman ibn Aws ibn Uthman ibn 'Amr, known as Abu Muawiyah ibn Qurra, had a house in Basra in the presence of Al-Awfa. He was killed by the Azariqah along with Ibn Ubayy ibn Ubayy in the year sixty-four."
hi: Qurrah bin Iyas bin Hilal bin Ribab bin Ubaydullah bin Dhu'ayb bin Aws bin Sawwarah bin Amr bin Sariyah bin Tha'labah bin Dinar bin Sulayman bin Aws bin Uthman bin Amr (RA), woh Abu Mu'awiyah bin Qurrah ke walid hain. Basra mein Al-Awfah ke qareeb unka ghar tha. Unhein Azariqa ne Ibn Ubays ke saath 64 Hijri mein qatl kar diya.

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am going to take the sheep to slaughter it, but I will have mercy on it." He ﷺ  said, "If you show mercy to the sheep, Allah will have mercy on you." Adi ibn al-Fadl is doomed.
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main bakri ko zibah karne ke liye pakadta hun to mujhe us par rahm aa jata hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aur bakri par bhi, agar tum us par rahm karoge to Allah tum par rahm karega." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Adi bin Al-Fadl haalik (tabaah-shuda raawi) hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The virtue of Aisha over other women is like the virtue of Tharid (a type of meat dish) over other types of food. We have not written about it except from him." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aisha (RA) ki auraton par fazilat aisi hai jaisi tharid (shorbe mein bhigi roti) ki baaqi tamam khanon par." (Hum ne ise isi (raawi) ke zariye ke siwa nahi likha.) Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever glorifies Allah with a loud voice at sunset on the seashore, Allah will reward him with the number of good deeds equivalent to the drops in the sea, erase ten bad deeds, and raise him ten ranks between every two ranks, each rank being the distance traveled by a fast horse in a hundred years." This is highly inauthentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo shakhs suraj ghurub hote waqt samundar ke kinare buland awaaz se ek takbeer kahe, Allah use samundar ke har qatre ke barabar ajar dega: das nekiyan ata karega, das gunah mita dega aur das darje buland karega, jinmein har do darjon ke darmiyan tez raftaar ghode ke liye sau saal ka safar hoga." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Yeh bohot zyada munkar hai."

e: [AI] "Aa'ith bin Amr bin Hilal bin Ubayd bin Rawahah bin Labibah bin Adi bin Amir bin Abdullah bin Tha'alabah bin Hadimah bin Latim bin Uthman bin Amr, also known as Abu Hubayrah, died during the reign of Ibn Ziyad and he had a well-known residence in Basra."
hi: Aidh bin Amr bin Hilal bin Ubayd bin Rawahah bin Labibah bin Adi bin Amir bin Abdullah bin Tha'labah bin Hadmah bin Latim bin Uthman bin Amr (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Hubayrah thi, Ibn Ziyad ki imarat mein faut hue, aur Basra mein unka ek mashhoor ghar tha.

e: [AI] "I was struck in the face by an arrow while I was fighting in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  on the day of Hunayn. When blood started flowing on my face, beard, and chest, the Prophet ﷺ  took care of me and wiped the blood from my face and chest until it reached my shin. Then he made supplication for me." Hashraj said, "He used to inform us about this incident while he was alive, and when he passed away and we washed his body, we saw the marks of the Messenger of Allah's hand from his face to the end of what he used to describe to us from his chest. There was also a protruding mark resembling a horse's protrusion on his chest." This narration has unknown narrators in its chain of narration.
hi: "Hunayn ke din jab main Rasulullah (SAW) ke saamne ladh raha tha to mere chehre par ek teer laga. Jab mere chehre, dadhi aur seene par khoon beh nikla, to Nabi (SAW) ne haath badhaya aur mere chehre aur seene se khoon ponch diya, yahan tak ke mere seene ke ubhaar (thandu'ah) tak, phir mere liye dua farmayi." Hashraj ne kaha: Aidh (RA) apni zindagi mein humein yeh bataya karte the. Jab woh faut hue aur humne unhein ghusl diya, to humne Rasulullah (SAW) ke haath ke nishan ko dekha jahan tak woh apne seene ke baare mein humein bayan kiya karte the, aur wahan ek behta hua ghurra (safedi ka nishan) tha, ghode ke ghurra ki tarah. Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Iski isnaad mein do majhool raawi hain."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Al-Sakhrah and Al-'Ajwah are from Paradise." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Sakhrah (chattan) aur Ajwah (khajoor) Jannat se hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About Urwah, in the naming of the one who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the Ansar of the Banu Khazraj, including Abd-Allah ibn Abd-Allah ibn Ubyy ibn Salul, Urwah said: "And he is Abd-Allah ibn Abd-Allah ibn Ubyy ibn Malik ibn Salim ibn Ghanm ibn Awf ibn Al-Khazraj."
hi: Urwah se, un logon ke naam bataane ke silsile mein jo Ansar mein se Bani Khazraj se Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath Badr mein shareek hue: Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Ubayy ibn Salul. Urwah ne kaha: "Woh Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Malik bin Salim bin Ghanm bin Awf bin Al-Khazraj (RA) hain."

e: [AI] "Abdullah, the son of Abdullah, the son of Ubayy ibn Salul, was martyred on the day of Yamama in the year twelve."
hi: Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Ubayy ibn Salul (RA) 12 Hijri mein Yamama ke din shaheed hue.

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, should I kill my father?" He replied, "Do not kill your father." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Kya main apne walid ko qatl kar dun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apne walid ko qatl na karo." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He sought permission from the Prophet ﷺ  to kill his father, but he prohibited him from doing so.
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) se apne walid ko qatl karne ki ijazat maangi, to aap (SAW) ne unhein isse mana farmaya.

e: [AI] "He suffered a toothache one day with the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ commanded me to get two golden teeth."
hi: Uhud ke din Nabi (SAW) ke saath unke do daant (chot se) toot gaye. Unhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe hukm diya ke main sone ke do daant bana lun.

e:
[AI] The translation of the given phrase "ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ وَسَلُولُ امْرَأَةٌ وَهِيَ أُمُّ أَبِي وَهُمْ بَنُو الْحُكْبَلَى" is:

"Ishaaq's son along with Salul, a woman who is my mother, and they are the children of Al-Hukbla."

(Note: The phrase "عاصم بن سليمان الكوري كذاب" does not seem to be a part of the given phrase. If you want it translated, it means "Aasim ibn Sulayman Al-Koree is a liar".)
hi: Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: Salul ek aurat hai aur woh Abi (yaani Ubayy) ki walida hain, aur woh Bani Al-Hubla hain.

e: [AI] Al-Nu'man ibn Qawqal, and Qawqal's name is Malik ibn Tha'laba ibn Da'd ibn Fahm ibn Tha'laba ibn Ghanim ibn Salim ibn Awf ibn Amr ibn Awf ibn Al-Khazraj, and Al-Qawaqil are the clan of Ubada ibn As-Samit.
hi: Aur Nu'man bin Qawqal (RA); Qawqal ka naam Malik bin Tha'labah bin Da'd bin Fahm bin Tha'labah bin Ghanim bin Salim bin Awf bin Amr bin Awf bin Al-Khazraj tha. Aur Al-Qawaqil, Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) ka kunba (qabeela) hain.

e: [AI] About Nu'man ibn Qawqal
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "Nu'man bin Qawqal (RA) se..."

e: [AI] He came the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, what do you think if I observe the obligatory prayers, fast in Ramadan, make lawful what is halal, and forbid what is haram, and I do not add anything else to that, will I enter Paradise?" He said, "Yes." He said, "By Allah, I will not increase anything beyond that."
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Aap ka kya khayal hai agar main farz namazen padhun, Ramadan ke roze rakhun, halal ko halal jaanun aur haram ko haram, aur ismein kuch izafa na karun, to kya main Jannat mein daakhil hounga?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main ismein kuch izafa nahi karunga."

e: [AI] I experienced something in my eyes, so I sent the narration to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: Meri aankhon ko kuch takleef pahunchi, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf (paigham) bheja. (Hadees ka baqiya hissa mukhtasar chhoda gaya hai.)

e: [AI] To his son
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...apne bete ke liye"

e: [AI] "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. In the name of whom witnessed the Battle of Badr among the Ansar, Ziada bin Labid bin Tha'laba bin Sinan bin 'Amir bin 'Adi bin Umayya bin Bayada bin 'Amir bin Zurayq, whose mother is the daughter of 'Abd Mudarib bin al-Harith bin Zaid bin 'Ubayd bin 'Amr bin 'Awf. He passed away during the first caliphate of Muawiyah, according to what I heard from the history of Shabbab."
hi: (Badr mein shareek Ansar ke naam bataane ke silsile mein:) Ziyad bin Labid bin Tha'labah bin Sinan bin Amir bin Adi bin Umayyah bin Bayadah bin Amir bin Zurayq (RA). Unki walida Abd Mudarrib bin Al-Harith bin Zaid bin Ubayd bin Amr bin Awf ki beti thin. Woh Mu'awiyah (RA) ki khilafat ke shuru mein faut hue, jaisa maine Tarikh Shabbab se suna.

e: [AI] "I came to the Prophet, peace be upon him, while he was speaking to his companions and saying, 'The time of knowledge has passed.' I said, 'By my father and mother, how can the time of knowledge pass when we are reading and teaching the Quran, and our children are learning it, and our children are teaching their children until the Day of Judgment?' He said, 'May your mother lose you, O Ibn Labid. Don't I see you as one of the most knowledgeable people in Madinah? Aren't the Jews and Christians reading the Torah and the Gospel without benefiting from them?'"
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke aap (SAW) apne Sahaba se baat kar rahe the aur farma rahe the: "Ilm ka waqt ja chuka." Maine kaha: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurban! Ilm ka waqt kaise ja sakta hai jabke hum Quran padhte hain, apne beton ko sikhate hain, aur hamare bete apne beton ko sikhayenge, qayamat qaim hone tak?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Teri maa tujhe kho de, ae Ibn Labid! Main to tujhe Ahl-e-Madina mein sabse zyada fiqh (fahm) wala samajhta tha. Kya Yahood aur Nasara Tauraat aur Injeel nahi padhte, aur unse kisi cheez se faida nahi uthate?"

e: [AI] About Urwah, in the designation of those who witnessed the Battle of Badr and Al-Aqabah from the Ansar, it is Ammarah bin Hazm bin Zaid bin Lawthan bin Amr bin Abd Awf bin Ghanim bin Malik bin Najar, he was martyred on the day of Yarmouk from the Ansar, then from the tribe of Malik bin Najar, Ammarah bin Hazm.
hi: Urwah se, un logon ke naam bataane ke silsile mein jo Ansar mein se Badr aur Aqabah mein shareek hue: Umarah bin Hazm bin Zaid bin Lawdhan bin Amr bin Abd Awf bin Ghanm bin Malik bin An-Najjar (RA). Woh Yamama ke din shaheed hue; Ansar mein se, phir Bani Malik bin An-Najjar mein se, Umarah bin Hazm (RA).

e: [AI] I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sitting on a grave, saying, "Get off the grave, do not harm the occupant of the grave nor let harm come to you." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe ek qabr par baithe hue dekha to farmaya: "Qabr se utar jao; qabr wale ko takleef na do, aur woh tumhein takleef na de." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Yazid ibn Thabit ibn Adh-Dhahhak ibn Zaid ibn Lawzan ibn Amr ibn Awf ibn Ghanim ibn Malik ibn An-Najjar. His mother and the mother of his brother Zaid ibn Thabit are Nawah bint Malik ibn Amir ibn Adi ibn An-Najjar. He witnessed the Battle of Badr and was martyred on the day of Yamamah."
hi: Yazid bin Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak bin Zaid bin Lawdhan bin Amr bin Awf bin Ghanm bin Malik bin An-Najjar (RA). Unki aur unke bhai Zaid bin Thabit (RA) ki walida An-Nawwar bint Malik bin Amir bin Adi bin An-Najjar thin. Woh Badr mein shareek hue aur Yamama ke din shaheed hue.

e: [AI] "He (meaning the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ) was with his companions when a funeral procession passed by. When they saw it, they stood up and remained standing until it disappeared. I think he (the Prophet) considered the deceased to be a Jew or a Jewess."
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) aur aap ke Sahaba ke saath tha ke ek janaza nazar aaya. Jab unhone use dekha to aap (SAW) khade ho gaye aur aap ke Sahaba bhi khade ho gaye, aur khade rahe yahan tak ke woh door chala gaya. Aur mera gumaan hai ke woh (mayyit) yahudi mard ya yahudi aurat hi thi.

e: [AI] From his uncle Yazid bin Thabit, he said: "They went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  one day with a funeral procession until they reached al-Baqi'. He asked, 'What is this?' They said, 'This is so-and-so, the freed slave of so-and-so.' He recognized her and said, 'Why didn't you inform me about her?' They said, 'We buried her during the day and you were sleeping, so we did not want to disturb you.' He stood up and positioned the people behind him, then he made four takbirs (saying 'Allahu Akbar') and said, 'None of you should die without my permission, for my prayer is a mercy for them.'"
hi: Apne chacha Yazid bin Thabit (RA) se riwayat hai ke woh ek din Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath ek janaze ke saath nikle yahan tak ke Baqi pahunche. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh falaan aurat hai, falaan ki azaad-karda baandi." Aap (SAW) ne use pehchan liya aur farmaya: "Tumne mujhe iski ittela kyun na di?" Unhone kaha: "Humne use zuhr ke waqt dafn kar diya, aur aap qailula (dopahar ke aaram) mein soye hue the, to humne pasand na kiya ke aap ko ittela dein." To aap (SAW) khade hue, logon ki apne peeche saf bandhi, aur us par chaar takbeerein kahin. Phir farmaya: "Tum mein se jo bhi mare, mujhe uski ittela zaroor do, kyunke meri namaz unke liye rahmat hai."

e: [AI] "Busr bin Abi Artah and the name of Abi Artah is Umair bin Amr bin Uwaymir bin Imran bin Al-Halbass bin Sayyar bin Nizar bin Ma'is bin Amir bin Lu'ay"
hi: Busr bin Abi Artah; aur Abi Artah ka naam Umair bin Amr bin Uwaymir bin Imran bin Al-Halbas bin Sayyar bin Nizar bin Ma'is bin Amir bin Luayy tha.

e: [AI] "Busr, the son of Abu Arta'ah, died during the caliphate of Muawiyah. He had reached an old age and suffered from dementia. He was also known as Abu Abdur Rahman. He passed away in Al-Madina, while his son was born in Basra."
hi: Busr bin Abi Artah Mu'awiyah (RA) ki khilafat mein faut hue. Unki umr bohot badh gayi thi yahan tak ke yaddasht kamzor ho gayi (khirf). Unki kunyat Abu Abd Ar-Rahman thi. Unki wafaat Madina mein hui, aur unki aulad Basra mein thi.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, that he used to say, "O Allah, make our end in all matters good and save us from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap (SAW) yeh dua farmate: "Ae Allah! Humare tamam umoor mein humara anjaam behtar kar, aur humein dunya ki ruswayi aur aakhirat ke azaab se panah de."

e: [AI] The imported son of Shaddad son of Amr son of Hisl son of Al-Ahab son of Habib son of Amr son of Shayban son of Muharib son of Fihr son of Malik died in Egypt during the reign of Muawiyah.
hi: Al-Mustawrid bin Shaddad bin Amr bin Hisl bin Al-Ahabb bin Habib bin Amr bin Shayban bin Muharib bin Fihr bin Malik (RA) Misr mein Mu'awiyah (RA) ki wilayat (hukumat) ke dauran faut hue.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The likeness of this world compared to the Hereafter is only like a man who dips his finger in the ocean, so what does he bring back with it?" Al-Dhahabi refrained from summarizing it.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aakhirat ke muqable mein dunya ki misaal bas aisi hai jaise koi aadmi apni ungli (samundar mein) daale, to dekho woh kya le kar lautti hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Khufaf ibn Imma ibn Rahadat ibn Harbata ibn Khufaf ibn Harithat ibn Ghifar, and his father, Imma ibn Rahadat, embraced Islam and was among the leaders of his people. Khufaf ibn Imma witnessed the Battle of Hudaybiyyah with the Messenger of Allah."
hi: Khufaf bin Ima bin Rahdah bin Harbah bin Khufaf bin Harithah bin Ghifar (RA). Unke walid Ima bin Rahdah (RA) bhi Islam laaye aur apni qaum ke sardaron mein se the. Khufaf bin Ima (RA) Hudaybiyah mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath shareek hue.

e: [AI] Abu Dhar said, "We came to our people as preachers before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived in Medina, and some of them embraced Islam. Their leader was 'Imamah ibn Rahdah." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his abridged version.
hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne kaha: "Hum apni qaum Ghifar ke paas aaye to unmein se kuch log Rasulullah (SAW) ke Madina aane se pehle hi Islam la chuke the, aur unki imamat Ima bin Rahdah karte the aur woh unke sardar the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: O Allah, hurl curse upon the tribe of Lihyan and Ri'l aid Dhakwan and Usayya for they disobeyed Allah and His Messenger, (and for) Ghifar Allah has granted pardon and for the tribe of Aslam Allah has granted safety. (Using translation from Muslim 2517)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Fajr ki namaz mein dua karte suna: "Ae Allah! Bani Lihyan, Ri'l, Dhakwan aur Usayyah par laanat bhej, jinhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmani ki; aur Ghifar ko Allah bakhshe, aur Aslam ko Allah salamat rakhe."

e: [AI] From Abu Basrah, a group of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  reported that they heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Indeed, Allah Almighty has increased your prayer, so pray it from the time after the Isha prayer until the Fajr prayer, and it is the Witr prayer." Abu Nasrah al-Ghifari said, "Abu Tamim and I were sitting, and Abu Dhar took my hand and we went to Abu Basrah. We found him at the door of the house of Amr. Abu Dhar said to him, 'O Abu Basrah, did you hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Indeed, Allah Almighty has increased your prayer, so pray it from the time after the Isha prayer until the Fajr prayer, and it is the Witr prayer'?' He replied, 'Yes.'"
hi: Abu Basrah (RA) se, jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke Sahaba ki ek jamaat mein se hain: unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Beshak Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne tumhare liye ek namaz badha di hai, to use Isha ki namaz se Fajr ki namaz ke darmiyan padho, aur woh Witr hai." Aur (raawi) Abu Nasrah Al-Ghifari hain. Abu Tamim ne kaha: Main aur Abu Dharr (RA) baithe the, to Abu Dharr (RA) ne mera haath pakda aur hum Abu Basrah (RA) ke paas gaye. Humne unhein us darwaze ke paas paya jo Amr ke ghar ke paas hai. Abu Dharr (RA) ne unse kaha: "Ae Abu Basrah! Kya aapne Rasulullah (SAW) ko yeh farmate suna: 'Beshak Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne tumhare liye ek namaz badha di hai, to use Isha ki namaz se Fajr ki namaz ke darmiyan padho, (yaani) Witr'?" Unhone kaha: "Haan."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "As for the child, he is your slave. So if she gives birth, then flog her with one hundred lashes and she shall have the dowry for what she has made lawful from her private parts." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Nabi (SAW)" ne farmaya: "Rahi bachche ki baat, to woh tumhara ghulam hai. Jab woh (aurat) bachcha jan le to use sau koray maaro, aur use mehr milega us ke badle jo us ki sharmgaah ko halal samjha gaya."
