Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] It is said that Khalid ibn Huzayn ibn Ubayd ibn Khaled was appointed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  as the leader of Medina when he left to conquer Mecca.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...aur kaha jaata hai Kulthum bin Husayn bin Ubayd bin Khalid (RA); Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Madina par apna naib banaya jab aap Fath-e-Makkah ke liye nikle."

e: [AI] Indeed, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out to conquer Mecca, he appointed Abu Ruhm Kulthum ibn Husein al-Ghafari as the leader of Medina.
hi: "Beshak Rasulullah (SAW) jab Fath-e-Makkah ke liye nikle to aap ne Abu Ruhm Kulthum bin Husayn Al-Ghifari (RA) ko Madina par apna naib banaya."

e: [AI] He heard from Abu Ruhm, Kalthum ibn Husein, one of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who pledged allegiance under the tree. He said, "I participated in the Battle of Tabuk with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . One night, I was walking with him when drowsiness overcame me. I woke up and realized that my camel had gone far ahead, along with the camel of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . I shouted to my camel to bring it back, but my eyes were heavy with sleep. It was during the night. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'What matters most to me is that the emigrants from Quraysh, the Ansar, and the Islams have not abandoned me, and the Gifār.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Unhone Abu Ruhm Kulthum bin Husayn (RA) ko suna, jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke un Sahaba mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche bay'at ki. Unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath Tabuk ka ghazwa kiya. Ek raat main aap (SAW) ke saath chala aur hum aap (SAW) ke qareeb the, ke humpar ungh taari ho gayi. Main jaagta to meri sawari Rasulullah (SAW) ki sawari ke qareeb aa chuki hoti, to main apni sawari ko aap (SAW) se door hatane ke liye daantne lagta, yahan tak ke raste mein kisi jagah meri aankh mujh par ghalib aa gayi; raat ka koi hissa tha. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere ahl mein mujhe sabse aziz yeh hai ke Quraysh ke Muhajireen, Ansar, Aslam aur Ghifar mujhse peeche rah jayen." (lafzi tarjuma; matlab matn mein waazeh nahi.) Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Hudhayfah, the son of Usayd, the son of Al-Aghwass, the son of Waqiah, the son of Haram, the son of Ghifar. Some say he is the son of Usayd, the son of Khalid, the son of Al-Aghwaz and he was also known as Abu Sariha. He moved from Al-Madinah to Al-Kufa and passed away there.
hi: Hudhayfah bin Usayd bin Al-Aghwas bin Waqi'ah bin Haram bin Ghifar (RA); aur kaha gaya hai: Ibn Usayd bin Khalid bin Al-Aghwaz. Unki kunyat Abu Sarihah thi. Woh Madina se Kufa muntaqil ho gaye aur wahin faut hue.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "The wind comes in which Allah seizes the soul of every believer, then the sun rises from its setting place, and this is the sign that Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, mentioned in His book."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh hawa aayegi jisse Allah har momin ki rooh qabz kar lega, phir suraj ka apne maghrib se nikalna, aur yehi woh nishani hai jiska Allah Ta'ala ne apni kitab mein zikr kiya hai." (Hadees mukhtasar naqal ki gayi hai.)

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to bring two fat rams and would sacrifice one of them, saying, "O Allah, this is on behalf of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad." Then he would bring the other ram and say, "O Allah, this is on behalf of my nation, those who testify to your oneness and believe in your message."
hi: Nabi (SAW) do sufed-siyah (chitkabre) mendhe qareeb late, un mein se ek zibah karte aur farmate: "Ae Allah! Yeh Muhammad aur aal-e-Muhammad ki taraf se hai." Phir doosra qareeb late aur farmate: "Ae Allah! Yeh meri ummat ki taraf se hai, har us ki taraf se jisne tere liye tauheed ki aur mere liye pahunchane (tabligh) ki gawahi di."

e: [AI] "Attab bin Usaid bin Abi Al-A'is bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams bin Abd Manaf and Umm Attab bin Usaid and Khalid bin Usaid, Zainab bint Abi Amr bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams, were used by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  as couriers to Mecca. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed away, and Attab continued his duties in Mecca. Attab bin Usaid passed away in Mecca during the month of Jumada Al-Akhirah in the thirteenth year."
hi: Attab bin Usayd bin Abi Al-Is bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams bin Abd Manaf (RA). Attab aur Khalid bin Usayd ki walida Zaynab bint Abi Amr bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams thin. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Attab (RA) ko Makkah par amil (governor) muqarrar kiya, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki wafaat huyi to Attab (RA) Makkah par aap ke amil the. Attab bin Usayd (RA) Makkah mein Jumada Al-Akhirah 13 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said on the night of his nearness to Mecca in the battle of Fatih: "Indeed, there are four individuals from the Quraish in Mecca who are more averse to polytheism and I am more inclined towards them in Islam." It was said, "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Utbah ibn Ussaid, Jubayr ibn Mut'im, Hakim ibn Hizam, and Suhayl ibn Amr."
hi: Fath-e-Makkah ke ghazwe mein Makkah ke qareeb pahunchne ki raat Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Makkah mein Quraysh ke chaar aadmi hain, jinke shirk se baaz aane aur Islam ki taraf raghbat ka main khwahish-mand hun." Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah! Woh kaun hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Attab bin Usayd (RA), Jubayr bin Mut'im (RA), Hakim bin Hizam (RA) aur Suhayl bin Amr (RA)."

e: [AI] "I heard Attab ibn Usaid, while she was leaning against the Kaaba, saying, 'By Allah, in all my actions, I did not acquire anything except for two folded garments, so I wore them as my attire, O my Lord.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine Attab bin Usayd (RA) ko, jabke woh Bait-ullah se apni peeth tikaye hue the, yeh kehte suna: "Allah ki qasam! Mere is amal (hukumat) mein jo Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe saunpi, mujhe sirf do gaanth lagi hui chaadarein hasil huin, jo maine apne ghulam Kaysan ko pehna din." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said about the Zakat of the dates crop: "It is separated as dates are separated, then its Zakat is given as raisins, just as the Zakat of the date tree is given as dates."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne angooron ki zakat ke baare mein farmaya: "Un ka bhi andaza lagaya jaayega jaise khajoor ka andaza lagaya jaata hai, phir uski zakat kishmish ki shakl mein ada ki jaayegi jaise khajoor ki zakat khajoor ki shakl mein ada ki jaati hai."

e: [AI] "And among the allies of Banu Hashim, without the people of Badr, were Shaddad bin al-Had and Shaddad Salaf, companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . With them was Sulma bint Umayis, whom he married after Hamza bin Abdul Muttalib."
hi: Aur Bani Hashim ke halifon (allies) mein se, Badr walon ke ilawa: Shaddad bin Al-Had (RA). Shaddad (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke salaf (saadhu, biwi ki behen ke shauhar) the; Salma bint Umays unke nikah mein thin, jin se Hamza bin Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) ke baad unhone nikah kiya.

e: a man from among the Bedouins came to the Prophet and believed in him and followed him, then he said: "I will emigrate with you." The Prophet told one of his Companions to look after him. During one battle the Prophet got some prisoners as spoils of war, and he distributed them, giving him (that Bedouin) a share. His Companions gave him what had been allocated to him. He had been looking after some livestock for them, and when he came they gave him his share. He said: "What is this?" They said: "A share that the Prophet has allocated to you." He took it and brought it to the Prophet and said: "What is this?" He said: "I allocated it to your." He said: "It is not for this that I follwed you. Rather I followed you so that I might be shot her - and he pointed to his throat - with an arrow and die and enter Paradise." He said: "If you are sincere toward Allah, Allah will fulfill your wish." Shortly after that they got up to fight the enemy, then he was brought to the Prophet; he had pointed to. The Prophet said: "Is it him?" They said: "yes." He said: "He was sincere toward Allah and Allah fulfilled his wish." Then the Prophet shrouded him in his own cloak and out him in front of him and offered the (funeral) prayer for him. During his supplication he said: "O allah, this is Your sloave who went out as a emigrant (Muhajir) for your sake and was killed as a martyr; I am a witness to that.: (Sahih) . (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1953)
hi: Dehaat ke ek aadmi ne Rasulullah (SAW) par imaan laya aur kaha: "Kya main aap ke saath hijrat karun?" To Nabi (SAW) ne apne Sahaba ko uske baare mein wasiyat farmayi. Jab Khaybar ya Hunayn ka ghazwa hua, Rasulullah (SAW) ko kuch ghanimat mili, aap ne taqseem farmayi aur us (aadmi) ka bhi hissa nikala. Uske saathiyon ne uska hissa le liya (woh unke jaanwaron ko charaya karta tha). Jab woh aaya to unhone use de diya. Usne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumhare liye taqseem kiya hai." Usne le liya, aur aap (SAW) ke paas aa kar kaha: "Ae Muhammad! Maine is par aap ki pairwi nahi ki, balki maine is par pairwi ki ke yahan (apne halq ki taraf ishara kiya) mujhe teer lage, main mar jaun aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jaun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum Allah se sach bologe to woh tumhari tasdeeq karega." Woh thodi der thehre, phir dushman se ladai mein (peeche hat gaye) aur use uthaye hue laaya gaya, use teer lag chuka tha usi jagah jahan usne ishara kiya tha. Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: "Kya yehi woh hai?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Us ne Allah se sach bola to Allah ne uski tasdeeq ki." Phir Nabi (SAW) ne use kafan diya, phir use aage rakha aur uski namaz-e-janaza padhi. Aur aap (SAW) ki namaz mein jo zahir hua woh yeh tha: "Ae Allah! Yeh tera banda hai, teri raah mein muhajir bankar nikla, aur shaheed hokar maara gaya, aur main iska gawah hun." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Osama bin Zaid bin Haritha bin Sharahil bin Ka'b bin Abdul Uzza bin Yazid bin Imri al-Qais al-Kalbi, may Allah have blessed him and His Messenger. Ahmed bin Ya'qub narrated this genealogy to me, through Musa bin Zakariya, through Shabbab. He added that his mother is Umm Ayman, the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He died in Madinah during the later period of the caliphate of Muawiyah, at the age of sixty. He was also known as Abu Muhammad."
hi: Usamah bin Zaid bin Harithah bin Sharahil bin Ka'b bin Abd Al-Uzza bin Yazid bin Imri' Al-Qays Al-Kalbi (RA), jin par Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ne in'am kiya. Mujhe yeh nasab Ahmad bin Ya'qub ne bataya (unhe Musa bin Zakariya ne, unhe Shabbab ne), aur usne ismein izafa kiya: unki walida Umm Ayman (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ki azaad-karda baandi, thin. Woh Madina mein Mu'awiyah (RA) ki khilafat ke aakhir mein faut hue jabke unki umr saath (60) saal thi, aur unki kunyat Abu Muhammad thi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The most beloved person to me from my family is the one whom Allah has bestowed His favors upon, and I have bestowed my favors upon Usamah." (Narrated by Umar ibn Abi Makhmoud, weak)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mere ahl mein mujhe sabse aziz woh hai jis par Allah ne in'am kiya aur jis par maine in'am kiya: Usamah." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Umar bin Abi Maslamah za'eef hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Usama is the dearest person to me."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Usamah mujhe logon mein sabse aziz hai."

e: [AI] "What made you do this? You can see that the palm tree has already reached a thousand. He said, 'My mother asked me for it, and she never asks me for anything that I am capable of giving her.'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...unse kaha: Tumhein is par kis cheez ne aamada kiya? Jabke tum dekhte ho ke khajoor ka ek darakht hazaar (dirham) tak pahunch gaya hai." Unhone kaha: "Mujhse meri walida ne yeh maanga hai, aur woh mujhse jo cheez bhi maangti hain jis par main qaadir hun, main use de deta hun." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Is hadees mein irsaal hai."

e: [AI] I heard our elders saying that the inscription on the ring of Usama bin Zaid was "The love of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
hi: Maine apne mashaikh ko kehte suna: Usamah bin Zaid (RA) ki angoothi ka naqsh "Rasulullah (SAW) ke mahboob" tha.

e: [AI] "Usamah ibn Zaid used to be addressed as 'Amir' until he passed away, and it is said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ appointed him." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Usamah bin Zaid (RA) ko wafaat tak "Ameer" kehkar mukhatib kiya jaata raha; log kehte hain Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein (lashkar ke saath) bheja tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I was behind the Prophet ﷺ on the day of Arafah."
hi: Main Arafah mein Nabi (SAW) ke peeche sawari par sawar tha.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "When a believer is praised on his face, faith blooms in his heart."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jab momin ki uske munh par tareef ki jaati hai to uske dil mein imaan badh jaata hai."

e: [AI] "Abu Rafe' was a slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for Al-Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib. When Al-Abbas embraced Islam, he gifted him to the Prophet ﷺ, and his name was Aslam, and it is also said Ibrahim. He embraced Islam before the Battle of Badr, but he resided in Makkah with Al-Abbas. He died after the assassination of Uthman in the year thirty-five."
hi: Abu Rafi' (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghulam (mawla), pehle Abbas bin Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) ke the. Jab Abbas (RA) Islam laaye to unhone unhein Nabi (SAW) ko hiba kar diya. Unka naam Aslam tha, aur kaha jaata hai Ibrahim. Woh Badr se pehle Islam laaye lekin Abbas (RA) ke saath Makkah mein muqeem rahe. Woh Uthman (RA) ke qatl ke baad 35 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  sent Ali to Yemen and appointed him as a commander. When he was about to leave, he said, "O Abu Rafi, bring him back to me and do not leave him behind, and let him stand and not turn back until I come to him." So he approached him and advised him about some matters and said, "O Ali, it is better for you that Allah guides a person through your efforts than the sun shining upon them."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (RA) ko Yemen bheja aur unke liye parcham bandha. Jab woh chale gaye to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Abu Rafi'! Unke peeche jao aur unhein peeche se mat chhodo (yaani wapas bula lao); woh ruk jayen aur mudkar na dekhein yahan tak ke main unke paas aa jaun." Phir unhein kuch cheezon ki wasiyat ki gayi aur farmaya: "Ae Ali! Agar Allah tumhare haath par ek aadmi ko hidayat de de to yeh tumhare liye us se behtar hai jis par suraj tulu hota hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He informed him that he had received a book from the people of Quraysh to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, "When I delivered the book, Islam entered my heart, so I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, by Allah, I will never go back to them.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I am not displeased with the treaty, nor am I displeased with coldness, but go back to them. If what is in your heart right now remains in your heart, then go back.' He said, 'So I returned to them, then I went back to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and embraced Islam.'"
hi: Unhone bataya ke woh Quraysh ka ek khat leke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye. Unhone kaha: "Jab maine khat pahuncha diya to mere dil mein Islam daal diya gaya. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Allah ki qasam, main un ki taraf kabhi nahi lautunga.' Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Main ahd nahi todta aur qasidon ko (qaid mein) nahi rokta, lekin tum unke paas wapas jao; phir agar tumhare dil mein woh baat rahi jo abhi hai to laut aana.'" Unhone kaha: "Phir main unke paas wapas gaya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur Islam qubool kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Salman al-Farsi is nicknamed Abu Abdullah. His loyalty was for the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Salman is one of us, the people of the Household."
hi: Aur Salman Al-Farisi (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Abdullah thi, unki wala Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye thi. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Salman hum Ahl-e-Bait mein se hai."

e: [AI] Salman Al-Farisi died in the year thirty-seven.
hi: Salman Al-Farisi (RA) 37 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, dug the trench during the Battle of the Confederates until it reached the deep spots. He then cut out forty cubits for every ten people. The emigrants (from Mecca) and the Ansar (from Medina) argued, "Salman is from us!" The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Salman is from us, the household of the Prophet." The authenticity of this narration is weak.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ahzab ki jang ke saal khandaq ka khaka khincha yahan tak ke Al-Madhajih tak pahunche, aur har das aadmiyon ke liye chalees (40) hath (zira') kata. Muhajireen ne dalil di ke Salman (RA) hum mein se hain, aur Ansar ne kaha ke Salman (RA) hum mein se hain. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Salman hum Ahl-e-Bait mein se hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Iski sanad za'eef hai."

e: [AI] Salman may Allah be pleased with him, said, "O Abu Abdullah, Omar asked me about an incident. I said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was leaning on a pillow, so he threw it to me and said, 'O Salman, whenever a Muslim enters upon his Muslim brother and throws a pillow to him in honor of him, Allah will forgive him.'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) Salman ne kaha: "Allah aur uske Rasool ne sach kaha." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ae Abu Abdullah! Hamein bayan kijiye." Unhone kaha: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, aur aap (SAW) ek takiye par tek lagaye hue the, to aap ne woh takiya mere taraf daal diya, phir mujhse farmaya: 'Ae Salman! Koi bhi Muslim jab apne Muslim bhai ke paas aata hai aur woh uski izzat ke liye uske liye takiya daal deta hai, to Allah use bakhsh deta hai.'"

(Adhoora aghaaz:) "...ke woh unhein apni kahani sunayen ke unka Islam kaise hua." Woh dono unke saath chale yahan tak ke Salman (RA) se Mada'in mein mile, jahan woh ameer the. Woh ek kursi par baithe the aur unke saamne khajoor ke patte the jinhe woh bat rahe the. Un dono ne kaha: Humne salam kiya aur baith gaye. Zayd ne unse kaha: "Ae Abu Abdullah! Yeh dono mere dost hain aur inka ek bhai bhi hai; yeh chahte hain ke aap ki baat sunen ke aap ke Islam ki shuruat kaise hui?" Salman (RA) ne kaha: "Main Ram Hurmuz ka ek yateem tha, aur Ram Hurmuz ke dihqan (zameendar) ka beta ek ustaad ke paas aata jaata tha jo use padhata tha, to main uske saath lag gaya taa ke uski panah mein rahun. Mera ek bada bhai tha jo apne aap mein maghan tha, aur main ek chhote qad ka ladka tha. Jab woh apni majlis se uthta to jinhe woh yaad karwata tha bikhar jaate, aur jab bikhar jaate to woh nikalta, apna kapda rakhta (ya kapde mein kuch lapet kar) phir pahaad par chadh jaata. Woh kai baar bhes badal kar yeh karta. Maine usse kaha: 'Tum yun yun karte ho, mujhe apne saath kyun nahi le jaate?' Usne kaha: 'Tum ladke ho, mujhe darr hai tumse kuch zahir ho jaye.' Maine kaha: 'Mat daro.' Usne kaha: 'Is pahaad mein kuch log apni khanqah (birtil) mein hain, unke paas ibadat hai aur nek amali hai, woh Allah Ta'ala ko yaad karte hain aur aakhirat ka zikr karte hain, aur hamein aatish-parast aur but-parast samajhte hain, jabke main unke deen par hun.' Maine kaha: 'To mujhe bhi unke paas apne saath le chalo.' Usne kaha: 'Main aisa nahi kar sakta jab tak un se ijazat na le lun, aur mujhe darr hai ke tumse kuch zahir ho jaye aur mere walid ko pata chal jaye to woh un logon ko qatl kar dega aur unki halakat mere haath se hogi.' Maine kaha: 'Mujhse yeh hargiz zahir nahi hoga, tum unse ijazat le lo.' Woh unke paas gaya aur kaha: 'Mere paas ek yateem ladka hai, woh chahta hai ke aap ke paas aaye aur aap ki baatein sune.' Unhone kaha: 'Agar tumhein us par bharosa hai.' Usne kaha: 'Mujhe ummeed hai ke us se wahi aayega jo mujhe pasand hai.' Unhone kaha: 'To le aao.' Usne mujhse kaha: 'Maine tumhare mere saath aane ki ijazat le li hai. Jab woh waqt aaye jis mein tum mujhe nikalte dekho to mere paas aa jana aur tumhare baare mein koi na jaane, kyunke agar mere walid ko un ka pata chal gaya to woh unhein qatl kar dega.' Jab woh waqt aaya jis mein woh nikalta tha, maine uska peecha kiya, hum pahaad par chadhe aur unke paas pahunche, woh apni khanqah mein the." (Raawi) Ali ne kaha: aur main samajhta hun usne kaha: "woh chhe ya saat the, goya ibadat ki wajah se unmein se rooh nikal chuki thi: din mein roza rakhte, raat mein qiyam karte, aur sehri ke waqt jo milta kha lete. Hum unke paas baith gaye, to dihqan ke bete ne ek aalim (habr) ki tareef ki. Unhone baat ki, Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki, guzre hue rasoolon aur nabiyon ka zikr kiya, yahan tak ke 'Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke zikr tak pahunche. Kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne 'Isa (AS) ko Rasool bana kar bheja aur unke liye woh sab musakhkhar kiya jo woh karte the: murdon ko zinda karna, parindon ko paida karna, madar-zaad andhe, korhi aur nabina ko shifa dena. Ek qaum ne unka inkaar kiya aur ek qaum ne unki pairwi ki, jabke woh Allah ke bande aur Rasool the, jin ke zariye Allah ne apni makhlooq ko azmaya. Aur unhone isse pehle (mujhse) kaha: 'Ae ladke! Tera ek rab hai, tera ek maad (lautne ki jagah) hai, aur tere aage Jannat aur Jahannam hain jinki taraf tum sab jaoge. Aur yeh log jo aag ki ibadat karte hain kufr aur gumrahi mein hain, Allah unke kaam se raazi nahi, aur woh kisi deen par nahi.' Jab woh waqt aaya jis mein ladka wapas hota tha, woh wapas hua aur main uske saath wapas hua. Phir subah hum unke paas gaye, unhone waisi hi baat ki aur is se behtar. Main unke saath lag gaya. Unhone mujhse kaha: 'Ae Salman! Tum ladke ho, tum woh nahi kar sakte jo hum karte hain. To namaz padho, so jao, khao aur piyo.' Phir badshah ko apne bete ke kaam ka pata chal gaya, woh ghodon par sawar hua aur unke paas unki khanqah mein aaya aur kaha: 'Ae logon! Tum mere padosi bane, maine tumhare saath acchi padosi ki aur tumne mujhse koi burai nahi dekhi, phir tumne mere bete ko mere khilaf bigaad diya. Maine tumhein teen din ki muhlat di; agar teen din ke baad main tum par qaabu paa gaya to tumhari yeh khanqah tum par jala dunga. To apne shehron mein chale jao, kyunke mujhe napasand hai ke mere taraf se tumhein koi takleef pahunche.' Unhone kaha: 'Haan, humne tumhein takleef dene ka irada nahi kiya tha aur humne sirf bhalai chahi.' Phir uske bete ne unke paas aana band kar diya. Maine usse kaha: 'Allah se daro! Tum jaante ho ke yeh Allah ka deen hai, aur tumhara baap aur hum kisi deen par nahi, yeh to aag ke pujari hain jo Allah ki ibadat nahi karte. Apni aakhirat ko kisi doosre ke deen ke badle mat bechna.' Usne kaha: 'Ae Salman! Wahi hai jo tum kehte ho, aur main in logon se peeche is liye reh raha hun ke un par zulm na ho; agar main unke saath gaya to mere walid pahaad mein meri talash mein nikalenge, jabke mere unke paas aane ki wajah se woh unhein nikaal hi chuke hain. Aur main jaanta hun ke haq unhi ke haath mein hai.' Phir main unke paas us din pahunchaa jis din woh kooch karne wale the. Unhone kaha: 'Ae Salman! Hum is jagah ka khatra mehsoos kar rahe the jo tumne dekha. Allah Ta'ala se daro aur jaan lo ke deen wahi hai jis ki humne tumhein wasiyat ki, aur yeh aag ke pujari Allah ko nahi jaante aur na uska zikr karte hain, to koi tumhein tumhare deen se dhokha na de.' Maine kaha: 'Main aap logon se juda nahi hounga.' Unhone kaha: 'Tum hamare saath nahi reh sakte; hum din mein roza rakhte hain, raat mein qiyam karte hain, aur sehri ke waqt jo milta kha lete hain, aur tum yeh nahi kar sakte.' Maine kaha: 'Main aap se juda nahi hounga.' Unhone kaha: 'Tum behtar jaante ho, humne tumhein apna haal bata diya hai. Jab aao to ek bojh ke andaze ka kuch apne saath le lo jo tum kha sako, kyunke tum woh nahi kar sakte jo hum haq ke saath kar sakte hain.' Maine aisa hi kiya. Humein mera bhai mila, maine usse (apna haal) pesh kiya, phir main unke paas aaya, woh paidal chal rahe the aur main unke saath chalta raha. Allah ne salamati di yahan tak ke hum Mosul pahunche. Hum Mosul mein ek kaleesa (bi'ah) mein aaye. Jab woh daakhil hue to logon ne unhein ghair liya aur poocha: 'Aap kahan the?' Unhone kaha: 'Hum aise mulk mein the jahan Allah Ta'ala ka zikr nahi karte, aag ke pujari hain, aur hum Allah ki ibadat karte the to unhone humein nikaal diya.' Logon ne poocha: 'Yeh ladka kaun hai?' Woh meri tareef karne lage aur kaha: 'Yeh us mulk se hamare saath raha aur humne iss mein bhalai ke siwa kuch nahi dekha.' Salman (RA) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, woh isi haal mein the ke ek pahaad ke ghaar se ek aadmi un par zahir hua. Woh aaya, salam kiya aur baith gaya. Mere saathi jinke saath main tha, unhone use gher liya aur uski ta'zeem ki. Usne poocha: 'Aap kahan the?' Unhone use bataya. Usne poocha: 'Yeh ladka aap ke saath kaun hai?' Unhone meri tareef ki aur use bataya ke main unki pairwi karta hun. Maine unki aisi ta'zeem kisi ki nahi dekhi. Usne Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki, phir un rasoolon aur nabiyon ka zikr kiya jinhe Allah ne bheja, aur unhone kya saha, aur unke saath kya kiya gaya. Usne 'Isa bin Maryam (AS) ki wiladat ka zikr kiya ke woh baghair mard ke paida hue, phir Allah Ta'ala ne unhein Rasool banaya, unke haath par murde zinda kiye, aur woh mitti se parinde ki shakl banate, usmein phoonkte to Allah ke hukm se parinda ban jaata. Allah ne un par Injeel nazil ki, unhein Tauraat sikhayi, aur unhein Bani Israel ki taraf Rasool bana kar bheja. Ek qaum ne unka inkaar kiya aur ek qaum ne imaan liya. Usne 'Isa bin Maryam (AS) ko jo kuch pesh aaya uska kuch zikr kiya, aur ye ke woh Allah ke bande the, Allah ne un par in'am kiya to unhone uska shukr kiya, yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein uthaa liya. Woh unhein naseehat karta aur kehta: 'Allah se daro aur jo 'Isa (AS) lekar aaye usse lazim pakdo, mukhalifat mat karo ke woh tumhein mukhalif kar de.' Phir kaha: 'Jo shakhs isme se kuch lena chahe le le.' To aadmi uthne lage, paani ka matka aur khana lene lage. Mere woh saathi jinke saath main aaya tha uthe, unhone use salam kiya aur uski ta'zeem ki, aur usne unse kaha: 'Is deen ko lazim pakdo aur khabardar, bikhar mat jana, aur is ladke ke saath acchi wasiyat kama lo.' Aur usne mujhse kaha: 'Ae ladke! Yehi Allah ka deen hai jo tum mujhe kehte suna rahe ho, aur iske siwa kufr hai.' Maine kaha: 'Main aap se juda nahi hounga.' Usne kaha: 'Tum mere saath nahi reh sakte, main apne ghaar se sirf har Ittwar (Ahad) ko nikalta hun aur tum mere saath rehne par qaadir nahi.' Woh apne saathiyon ki taraf mutawajjeh hua, to unhone kaha: 'Ae ladke! Tum uske saath nahi reh sakte.' Maine kaha: 'Main aap se juda nahi hounga.' Uske saathiyon ne kaha: 'Ae falaan! Yeh ladka hai, aur isse khatra hai.' Usne mujhse kaha: 'Tum behtar jaante ho.' Maine kaha: 'To main aap se juda nahi hounga.' Mere pehle saathi jinke saath main tha mujhse judai par ro pade. Usne kaha: 'Ae ladke! Is khane mein se utna le lo jo agle Ittwar tak tumhare liye kaafi ho, aur paani mein se utna jo kaafi ho.' Maine kiya. Phir maine use agle Ittwar tak soote hue nahi dekha na khate hue, siwa ruku aur sajde ke. Jab subah hui to usne kaha: 'Apna yeh matka lo aur chalo.' Main uske peeche peeche nikla yahan tak ke hum us chattan tak pahunche, aur dekha ke woh log in pahaadon se nikal kar uske nikalne ka intezar kar rahe the. Woh baith gaye, usne pehli martaba jaisi baat dohrayi aur kaha: 'Is deen ko lazim pakdo, bikhro nahi, Allah ko yaad karo, aur jaan lo ke 'Isa bin Maryam (AS) Allah Ta'ala ke bande the jin par Allah ne in'am kiya.' Phir usne mera zikr kiya. Unhone usse kaha: 'Ae falaan! Tumne is ladke ko kaisa paaya?' Usne meri tareef ki aur bhalai ki baat kahi. Unhone Allah Ta'ala ki hamd ki, to dekha ke bohot si roti aur bohot sa paani maujood hai. Unhone liya, har aadmi utna le raha tha jitna kaafi ho, aur maine bhi liya. Phir woh in pahaadon mein bikhar gaye, aur woh apne ghaar ko lauta aur main uske saath lauta. Jab tak Allah ne chaha hum thehre; woh har Ittwar ko nikalta, woh log uske saath nikalte, uske irdgird jama hote, aur woh unhein wahi wasiyat karta jo karta tha. Ek Ittwar ko woh nikla, jab sab jama hue to usne Allah Ta'ala ki hamd ki, naseehat ki, aur waisi hi baatein kahin jaisi kehta tha. Phir aakhir mein unse kaha: 'Ae logon! Meri umr badh gayi hai, meri haddiyan kamzor ho gayi hain, meri ajal qareeb aa gayi hai, aur mujhe is ghar (Baitul Maqdis) se kaafi arse se ahd nahi (mulaqat nahi hui), aur wahan jana zaroori hai. To is ladke ke saath acchi wasiyat kama lo, kyunke maine ise dekha hai ismein koi harj nahi.' Qaum ghabra gayi, maine unki si ghabrahat nahi dekhi. Unhone kaha: 'Ae falaan! Tum bade ho, tanha ho, humein khauf hai ke tumhein kuch pesh aa jaye, jabke humein tumhari sabse zyada zaroorat thi.' Usne kaha: 'Mujhse bahas mat karo, wahan jana zaroori hai. Lekin is ladke ke saath acchi wasiyat kama lo, aur yun yun karo.' Maine kaha: 'Main aap se juda nahi hounga.' Usne kaha: 'Ae Salman! Tumne mera haal dekha aur jis par main tha, lekin yeh waisa nahi: main paidal chalunga, din mein roza rakhunga, raat mein qiyam karunga, aur apne saath na zaad utha sakta hun na kuch aur, aur tum yeh nahi kar sakte.' Maine kaha: 'Main aap se juda nahi hounga.' Usne kaha: 'Tum behtar jaante ho.' Unhone kaha: 'Ae falaan! Humein is ladke ke baare mein khauf hai.' Usne kaha: 'Woh behtar jaanta hai, maine use sab bata diya hai aur woh isse pehle ka haal dekh chuka hai.' Maine kaha: 'Main aap se juda nahi hounga.' Woh ro pade aur use alvida kaha. Usne unse kaha: 'Allah se daro aur us par qaim raho jis ki maine wasiyat ki. Agar main zinda raha to main tumhari taraf lautunga, aur agar mar gaya to Allah zinda hai, use maut nahi.' Usne unhein salam kiya aur nikla, aur main uske saath nikla. Usne mujhse kaha: 'Is roti mein se kuch apne saath utha lo jo tum kha sako.' Woh nikla aur main uske saath nikla, woh chalta aur main uski pairwi karta; woh Allah Ta'ala ka zikr karta, na mudta aur na kisi cheez par rukta, yahan tak ke jab sham hui to kaha: 'Ae Salman! Tum namaz padho, so jao, khao aur piyo.' Phir woh khada ho kar namaz padhne laga yahan tak ke hum Baitul Maqdis pahunche. Woh apni nigaah aasman ki taraf nahi uthata tha, yahan tak ke hum masjid ke darwaze par aaye. Wahan darwaze par ek apahij (muq'ad) tha. Usne kaha: 'Ae Allah ke bande! Tum mera haal dekh rahe ho, mujh par kuch sadqa karo.' Usne uski taraf tawajjoh na ki aur masjid mein daakhil hua, aur main uske saath daakhil hua. Woh masjid ki kai jagahon ko dhoondhta aur wahan namaz padhta. Usne kaha: 'Ae Salman! Main falaan arse se soya nahi aur neend ka maza nahi paya. Agar tum kar sako to jab saaya falaan jagah pahunche mujhe jaga dena, main so jaunga, kyunke main is masjid mein sona chahta hun, warna nahi soya.' Maine kaha: 'Main aisa karunga.' Usne kaha: 'Jab saaya falaan jagah pahunche to mujhe jaga dena, jab meri aankh mujh par ghalib aa jaye.' Woh so gaya. Maine apne dil mein kaha: 'Yeh falaan arse se nahi soya, aur maine uska kuch haal dekha hai, main ise sone dunga yahan tak ke yeh neend se shifa paa le.' Aur jab main uske saath chalta, woh meri taraf mutawajjeh hokar mujhe naseehat karta, mujhe batata ke mera ek rab hai, mere aage Jannat aur Jahannam aur hisaab hai, mujhe sikhata aur yaad dilata, waisa hi jaisa woh log Ittwar ke din yaad dilate the, yahan tak ke apni baaton mein usne kaha: 'Ae Salman! Allah Ta'ala jald ek Rasool bheje ga jis ka naam Ahmad hoga, Tihama (Tuhmah) se zahir hoga' - aur woh ajami (gair-Arab) aadmi tha jo theek se bol nahi sakta tha - 'uski nishani yeh hai ke woh hadiya khata hai aur sadqa nahi khata, uske kandhon ke darmiyan mohr hai. Yeh uska zamana hai jis mein woh nikalega, qareeb aa gaya hai. Rahi meri baat, to main boodha shaikh hun, mujhe nahi lagta ke main use paunga. Agar tum use paa lo to uski tasdeeq karna aur uski pairwi karna.' Maine kaha: 'Agar woh mujhe aap ke deen aur jis par aap hain use chhodne ka hukm de to?' Usne kaha: 'Use chhod dena, kyunke haq wahi hai jiska woh hukm de, aur Rahman raazi hai jo woh kahe.' Phir thodi hi der guzri ke woh ghabra kar jaag utha, Allah Ta'ala ka zikr karta hua, aur mujhse kaha: 'Ae Salman! Saaya is jagah se guzar gaya, aur tumne apne upar jo (jagane ka) zimma liya tha uska kya hua?' Maine kaha: 'Aap ne mujhe bataya tha ke aap falaan arse se nahi soye, aur maine aap ka kuch haal dekha, to mujhe pasand aaya ke aap neend se shifa paa lein.' Usne Allah Ta'ala ki hamd ki, khada hua aur nikla, aur main uske peeche nikla. Woh muq'ad ke paas se guzra to muq'ad ne kaha: 'Ae Allah ke bande! Tum andar gaye, maine tumse maanga, tumne mujhe kuch na diya; tum nikle, maine tumse maanga, tumne mujhe kuch na diya.' Woh khada ho kar dekhne laga ke kisi ko dekhta hai ya nahi, kisi ko na dekha, to uske qareeb gaya aur kaha: 'Mujhe apna haath do.' Usne haath diya. Usne kaha: 'Bismillah!' Woh aisa khada ho gaya goya rassi se khol diya gaya ho, bilkul sahih, koi aib nahi. Woh uske paas se dur ho gaya aur chal diya, na kisi ki taraf mudta aur na uske paas rukta. Muq'ad ne mujhse kaha: "Ae ladke! Mere kapde mujh par laad do taa ke main apne ghar waalon ke paas chal sakun." Maine uske kapde laad diye aur woh chal diya, meri taraf mudkar bhi na dekha. Main uske peeche nikla usse talash karta hua, jis se bhi poochta woh kehte 'tere aage hai', yahan tak ke mujhe Bani Kalb ka ek qafila mila. Maine unse poocha. Jab unhone is jawan (meri baat) suni to unmein se ek aadmi ne apna oont mere liye bithaya aur mujhe apne peeche sawar kar liya yahan tak ke woh apne mulk pahunche, aur unhone mujhe bech diya. Mujhe Ansar ki ek aurat ne khareed liya aur mujhe apne bagh mein rakha. Rasulullah (SAW) tashreef laaye, mujhe aap ki khabar mili. Maine apne bagh ki khajoor mein se kuch liya, ek cheez par rakha, phir aap ke paas aaya. Maine aap ke paas kuch log paaye, aur Abu Bakr (RA) aap ke sabse qareeb the. Maine woh aap ke saamne rakh diya. Aap ne poocha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Maine kaha: 'Sadqa.' Aap ne logon se kaha: 'Khao,' aur khud nahi khaya. Phir jab tak Allah ne chaha main thehra, phir waisa hi liya aur ek cheez par rakha, phir aap ke paas aaya, aap ke paas log paaye aur Abu Bakr (RA) sabse qareeb the. Maine woh aap ke saamne rakha. Aap ne mujhse poocha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Maine kaha: 'Hadiya.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Bismillah,' aur khaya aur logon ne bhi khaya. Maine apne dil mein kaha: 'Yeh uski nishaniyon mein se hai. Mera saathi ajami aadmi tha jo 'Tihamah' theek se nahi keh sakta tha, to usne 'Tuhmah' kaha, aur usne kaha tha ke uska naam Ahmad hai.' Maine aap ke peeche chakkar lagaya, aap ne bhaanp liya, aur kapda dhila kar diya to mohr aap ke baayen kandhe ke kinare par thi, maine use pehchan liya. Phir main ghoom kar aap ke saamne baith gaya aur kaha: 'Main gawahi deta hun ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi aur aap Allah ke Rasool hain.' Aap ne poocha: 'Tum kaun ho?' Maine kaha: 'Ek mamlook (ghulam) hun.' Maine aap ko apni baat aur us aadmi ki baat bataayi jiske saath main tha aur usne mujhe kis baat ka hukm diya tha. Aap ne poocha: 'Tum kis ke ho?' Maine kaha: 'Ansar ki ek aurat ke, usne mujhe apne bagh mein rakha hai.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Ae Abu Bakr!' Unhone kaha: 'Labbayk.' Farmaya: 'Ise khareed lo.' To Abu Bakr (RA) ne mujhe khareed liya aur azaad kar diya. Phir jab tak Allah ne chaha main thehra. Maine aap ko salam kiya aur aap ke saamne baith gaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Nasara ke deen ke baare mein aap kya kehte hain?' Aap ne farmaya: 'Unmein koi bhalai nahi aur na unke deen mein.' Mujh par ek bada dukh taari hua. Maine apne dil mein kaha: 'Yeh woh hai jiske saath main tha aur jo maine dekha, phir maine use dekha ke us ne muq'ad ka haath pakda aur Allah ne uske haath par use khada kar diya,' aur aap farma rahe hain: 'In logon mein koi bhalai nahi aur na unke deen mein.' Main laut gaya aur mere dil mein woh tha jo Allah ne chaha. Tab Allah Ta'ala ne Nabi (SAW) par nazil farmaya: {Yeh is liye ke unmein qissees aur rahib hain aur woh takabbur nahi karte} (Surah Al-Ma'idah 82) aayat ke aakhir tak. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Salman ko mere paas lao.' Qaasid aaya aur main dar raha tha. Main aaya aur aap ke saamne baith gaya. Aap ne parha: Bismillah ir-Rahman... {Yeh is liye ke unmein qissees aur rahib hain aur woh takabbur nahi karte} (Surah Al-Ma'idah 82) aayat ke aakhir tak. 'Ae Salman! Woh log jinke saath tum the aur tumhara saathi Nasara nahi the, woh to Muslim the.' Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Us zaat ki qasam jisne aap ko haq ke saath bheja, wahi tha jisne mujhe aap ki pairwi ka hukm diya.' Maine usse kaha tha: 'Aur agar woh mujhe aap ke deen aur jis par aap hain use chhodne ka hukm de to?' Usne kaha: 'To use chhod dena, kyunke haq aur jo wajib hai woh ismein hai jiska woh tumhein hukm de.'"

Main Jayy ke logon mein se ek aadmi tha, aur meri basti ke log chitkabre ghodon ki ibadat karte the. Main jaanta tha ke woh kisi cheez par nahi. Mujhse kaha gaya: "Jis deen ko tum talash karte ho woh Maghrib (pashchim) mein hai." To main nikla yahan tak ke Mosul pahuncha. Maine poocha ke yahan sabse afzal kaun hai, to mujhe ek aadmi ki taraf rehnumayi ki gayi jo ek khanqah (sauma'ah) mein tha. Main uske paas aaya aur kaha: "Main Jayy ka ek aadmi hun, kaam talash karne aur ilm sikhne aaya hun. Mujhe apne saath mila lijiye, main aap ki khidmat karunga, aap ki sohbat mein rahunga, aur aap mujhe woh sikhayenge jo Allah ne aapko sikhaya hai." Usne kaha: "Haan." Main uske saath raha. Usne mujh par bhi wahi kharch kiya jo us par kiya jaata tha, aur us par sirka, zaitoon aur anaaj ka kharch hota tha. Main uske saath raha yahan tak ke us par maut aa gayi. Main uske sirhane baith kar rone laga. Usne poocha: "Kyun rote ho?" Maine kaha: "Main is liye rota hun ke main apne mulk se bhalai talash karne nikla, Allah ne mujhe aap ki sohbat naseeb ki, aap ne mujhe sikhaya aur meri sohbat ko acchi tarah nibhaya, ab aap par maut aa gayi aur main nahi jaanta kahan jaun?" Usne mujhse kaha: "Mera ek bhai Jazirah mein falaan falaan jagah hai, woh haq par hai. Uske paas jao, usse mera salam kehna aur use bata dena ke maine uske liye wasiyat ki hai aur tumhein uski sohbat ki wasiyat ki hai." Jab us aadmi ki wafaat ho gayi to main nikla aur us aadmi ke paas aaya jiska usne zikr kiya tha, use khabar di, usse uske saathi ka salam kaha aur bataya ke woh faut ho gaye hain aur mujhe uski sohbat ka hukm de gaye hain. Usne mujhe apne saath mila liya aur mujh par wahi kharch kiya jo doosre ke saath mujh par hota tha. Jab tak Allah ne chaha main uske saath raha, phir us par maut aa gayi. Jab maut aayi to main uske sirhane baith kar rone laga. Usne mujhse poocha: "Kyun rote ho?" Maine kaha: "Main apne mulk se bhalai talash karne nikla, Allah ne mujhe falaan ki sohbat naseeb ki, usne meri sohbat ko acchi tarah nibhaya, mujhe sikhaya, aur apni maut ke waqt aap ki wasiyat ki, aur ab aap par maut aa gayi hai, main nahi jaanta kidhar jaun." Usne kaha: "Mere ek bhai ke paas jao jo Darb Ar-Rum par hai, woh haq par hai, uske paas jao, usse mera salam kehna aur uski sohbat mein raho, kyunke woh haq par hai." Jab us aadmi ki wafaat hui to main nikla yahan tak ke uske paas aaya, use apni khabar aur pehle wale ki wasiyat bataayi. Usne mujhe apne saath mila liya aur mujh par wahi kharch kiya jo hota tha. Jab us par maut aayi to main uske sirhane baith kar rone laga. Usne poocha: "Kyun rote ho?" Maine apni kahani sunayi, kaha: "Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe aap ki sohbat naseeb ki, aap ne meri sohbat ko acchi tarah nibhaya, aur ab aap par maut aa gayi aur main nahi jaanta kidhar jaun." Usne kaha: "Ab koi deen nahi raha, aur zameen par koi aisa nahi bacha jise main 'Isa bin Maryam (AS) ke deen par jaanta hun. Lekin yeh woh waqt hai jis mein ek nabi nikalne wala hai, ya Tihamah mein nikal chuka hai, aur tum raaste mein ho. Jo bhi tumhare paas se guzre usse uske baare mein poochna. Jab tumhein khabar mile ke woh nikal chuka hai to wahi woh nabi hain jinki 'Isa (AS) ne bashaarat di thi. Aur uski nishani yeh hai ke uske kandhon ke darmiyan mohr-e-nubuwwat hai, aur woh hadiya khata hai aur sadqa nahi khata." Salman (RA) ne kaha: Phir koi mere paas se na guzarta magar main usse uske baare mein poochta. Makkah ke kuch log mere paas se guzre. Maine unse poocha. Unhone kaha: "Haan, hamare beech ek aadmi zahir hua hai jo nabi hone ka dawa karta hai." Maine unmein se kuch se kaha: "Kya tum chahte ho ke main tumhare kisi ka ghulam ban jaun is shart par ke tum mujhe apni sawari ke peeche bithaa lo aur mujhe roti ke tukde khilao, phir jab tum apne mulk pahunch jao to agar woh chahe to bech de aur chahe to ghulam bana le?" Unmein se ek aadmi ne kaha: "Main." To main uska ghulam ban gaya yahan tak ke woh mujhe Makkah le aaya. Usne mujhe apne ek bagh mein habshiyon ke saath rakha jo us mein the. Main nikla aur poochta raha, to mujhe mere mulk ki ek aurat mili, maine usse poocha to uske ghar waale Islam la chuke the. Usne mujhse kaha: "Nabi (SAW) aur aap ke Sahaba Hijr mein baithte hain jab Makkah mein chidiya chahakti hai, yahan tak ke jab unke liye subah roshan hoti hai woh bikhar jaate hain." Main bagh ki taraf gaya aur aata jaata raha. Habshiyon ne poocha: "Tumhein kya hua?" Maine kaha: "Mere pet mein takleef hai." Maine yeh is liye kiya ke jab main Nabi (SAW) ke paas jaun to woh mujhe gum na paayen. Jab woh waqt aaya jis mein us aurat ne bataya tha ke aap aur aap ke Sahaba baithte hain, main paidal nikla yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, aap ihtiba mein baithe the aur aap ke Sahaba aap ke irdgird the. Main aap ke peeche se aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne pehchan liya main kya chahta hun, to aap ne apna ihtiba chhod diya, aur maine aap ke kandhon ke darmiyan mohr-e-nubuwwat dekhi. Maine kaha: "Allahu Akbar, yeh ek hui." Phir main laut gaya. Jab agli raat hui to maine acchi khajoorein chunin, phir chala yahan tak ke unhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas laaya aur aap ke saamne rakh di. Aap ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Sadqa." Aap ne logon se farmaya: "Khao," aur khud nahi khayi. Phir jab tak Allah ne chaha main thehra, phir waisa hi liya aur aap ke paas laa kar aap ke saamne rakha. Aap ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Maine kaha: "Hadiya." Aap ne usmein se khaya aur logon se farmaya: "Khao." Maine kaha: "Main gawahi deta hun ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi aur aap Allah ke Rasool hain." Aap ne mujhse mera maamla poocha, maine bataya, to aap ne farmaya: "Ja kar apne aap ko khareed lo." Main apne malik ke paas gaya aur kaha: "Mujhe mere haath bech do." Usne kaha: "Haan, is shart par ke tum mere liye sau khajoor ke paudhe ugao." Maine unmein se ek paudha bhi na chhoda jo ug na gaya ho. Phir main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur bataya ke khajoor ke paudhe ug gaye hain, "to aap ne mujhe sone ka ek tukda diya." Main use leke gaya aur tarazu ke ek palde mein rakha, aur doosre palde mein ek guthli rakhi. Allah ki qasam, sone ka tukda zameen se uthaya hi nahi (guthli ke muqable mein bhaari raha). Phir main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur aap ko bataya, "to aap ne mujhe azaad kar diya."

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever." And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The longest people in terms of satiety in this world will be the most hungry on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Dunya momin ka qaidkhana aur kafir ki Jannat hai." Aur maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Dunya mein sabse zyada der tak pait bhar kar khane wale, qayamat ke din sabse zyada bhookhe honge."

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have read in the Torah that the blessing of food is preceded and followed by ablution."
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Maine Tauraat mein padha hai ke khane ki barkat uske pehle aur baad wudu (haath munh dhona) karna hai."

e: [AI] Zaid ibn Sa'na went out of the chambers and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  accompanied him. A man approached them on his riding beast, resembling a Bedouin. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, the people of Busra, a village of Banu Fulan, have embraced Islam and entered into the folds of Islam. I used to visit them and inform them that if they embraced Islam, they would be blessed with abundance of provision, but they have been afflicted with a year of drought, hardship, and famine. O Messenger of Allah, I fear that they might renounce Islam out of greed, just as they had entered it out of greed. If you see fit, please send them some provisions to help them. The Prophet ﷺ  looked at me, and Ali ibn Abi Talib was also present. He said, 'O Messenger of Allah, there is nothing left (to give).' Zaid ibn Sa'na approached the Prophet and said, 'O Muhammad, can you sell me a known quantity of dates from the wall of Banu Fulan until a specified time?' He replied, 'No, O Jew, but I will sell you a known quantity of dates until a specified time, without mentioning the wall of Banu Fulan.' I said, 'Alright, then sell it to me, so I pledged and handed him over eighty mithqal of gold in exchange for a known quantity of dates until a specified time. The man took the gold from me and he said, 'Deal fairly with them and assist them with it.' Zaid ibn Sa'na said, 'When the time before the due date was only a day or two, I went to him and took hold of the collar of his shirt and cloak, and looked at him with an angry face. I said to him, 'Why don't you fulfill my right, O Muhammad? By Allah, your kinsmen, the Banu Abd al-Muttalib, are known for their poor administration of justice.' At that point, Umar's eyes were rolling in his head, like a rotating celestial body, and then he struck me in the chest with his gaze, saying, 'O enemy of Allah! Are you saying things about the Messenger of Allah that I'm hearing, and doing things that I'm seeing?' By He who sent him with the truth, if I were not concerned about his strength, I would have struck your head with my sword.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was looking at Umar, calmly and with a smiling face, and then he said, 'O Umar, both he and I were more in need of people commanding us to perform our duties well, and advising him to follow me well. Take him, O Umar, and give him his right, and add twenty sa' to it as a quantity of dates.' I asked, 'What is this increase, O Umar?' He said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  has ordered me to add to it, an increase in proportion to your complaint.' I said, 'Do you know who I am, O Umar?' He said, 'No, who are you?' I said, 'Zaid ibn Sa'na.' Ink said, 'The scribe?' I said, 'Yes, the scribe. What did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  call me to do with him that I did not do? And what did I say to him that I did not say?' I said to him, 'O Umar, whenever he had any characteristic of prophethood, I recognized it in the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when I looked at him, except for two things that I did not mention to anyone. I said, "Does his forbearance precede his ignorance, and does his extreme ignorance overwhelm him except with forbearance?" I have experienced both of those, so I bear witness, O Umar, that I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, and with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ  as my prophet. And I bear witness to you that a portion of my wealth, and indeed I have more wealth than them, I give as charity for the Ummah of Muhammad ﷺ .' Umar said, 'Or for some of them, for you have no room for all of them.' I said, 'Or for some of them.' Then Zaid returned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, 'I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger, and I believed in him, and confirmed him, and pledged allegiance to him, and witnessed many things with him.' Then Zaid passed away during the Battle of Tabuk, while facing the enemy." May Allah have mercy on Zaid.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Zayd bin Sa'nah (RA)." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ek din hujron se nikle aur aap ke saath Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) the. Ek aadmi apni sawari par aap ke paas aaya, dehati ki tarah, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Busra mein falaan qabile ki basti ke log Islam la chuke hain aur Islam mein daakhil ho gaye hain, aur maine unse kaha tha ke agar woh Islam le aaye to unhein farakhi se rizq milega. Ab un par qahat, sakhti aur baarish ki kami aa gayi hai, aur mujhe khauf hai ke woh lalach mein Islam se nikal jayen jaise lalach mein usmein daakhil hue the. To agar aap munasib samjhein ke unke paas kuch bhej dein jisse unki madad ho to aisa kar dijiye." To ek aadmi ne meri taraf dekha, aur uske pehlu mein jisko main Ali (RA) samajhta hun, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Ab ismein se kuch nahi bacha." Zayd bin Sa'nah ne kaha: Main aap ke qareeb gaya aur kaha: "Ae Muhammad! Kya aap mujhe falaan qabile ke bagh se muqarrar khajoor falaan muddat tak ke liye bechenge?" Aap ne farmaya: "Nahi, ae yahudi! Lekin main tumhein muqarrar khajoor falaan muddat tak ke liye bechta hun, aur falaan qabile ke bagh ka naam nahi leta." Maine kaha: "Theek hai." Aap ne mujhse sauda kiya, maine apni thaili kholi aur aap ko 80 mithqal sona diya muqarrar khajoor ke badle falaan muddat tak ke liye. Aap ne woh us aadmi ko de diya aur farmaya: "Unke darmiyan insaaf se baant do aur is se unki madad karo." Zayd bin Sa'nah ne kaha: Jab muddat poori hone mein do ya teen din rahe to main aap ke paas aaya, aap ki qameez aur chaadar ke gireban pakad liye, aur sakht chehre se aap ko dekha aur kaha: "Ae Muhammad! Kya aap mera haq ada nahi karenge? Allah ki qasam, ae Bani Abd Al-Muttalib! Humne tumhein ada-e-qarz mein taal-matol karne wala hi paaya hai, aur mujhe tumhare saath ghulne-milne se iska ilm hai." Aur maine Umar (RA) ki taraf dekha, unki aankhein unke chehre mein is tarah goom rahi thin jaise gol ghoomta hua falak. Phir unhone mujhe ghoor kar dekha aur kaha: "Ae Allah ke dushman! Tu Rasulullah (SAW) se woh kehta hai jo main sun raha hun aur unke saath woh karta hai jo main dekh raha hun! Us zaat ki qasam jisne unhein haq ke saath bheja, agar mujhe unki (Rasulullah ki) quwwat ka khauf na hota to main apni talwar se tera sar maar deta." Aur Rasulullah (SAW) sukoon aur wiqar se Umar (RA) ki taraf dekh rahe the, aur muskuraye, phir farmaya: "Ae Umar! Mujhe aur isse is ke ilawa kisi aur baat ki zaroorat thi: tum mujhe acchi tarah ada karne ka kehte aur isse acchi tarah talab karne ka kehte. Ae Umar! Isse le jao, isse iska haq do aur bees saa' khajoor zyada do." Maine kaha: "Yeh izafa kaisa, ae Umar?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne hukm diya hai ke main tumhein is ke badle zyada dun jo maine tumhein naagawar guzra." Maine kaha: "Ae Umar! Kya tum mujhe jaante ho?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, tum kaun ho?" Maine kaha: "Zayd bin Sa'nah." Unhone kaha: "Al-Habr (yahudi aalim)?" Maine kaha: "Al-Habr." Unhone kaha: "To tumhein kis cheez ne aamada kiya ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath woh karo jo tumne kiya aur woh kaho jo tumne kaha?" Maine kaha: "Ae Umar! Nubuwwat ki koi nishani nahi thi magar maine use Rasulullah (SAW) ke chehre mein pehchan liya jab maine aap ko dekha, siwa do cheezon ke jinhe maine aap mein parkha nahi tha: 'kya unka hilm unki jahalat se aage badh jaata hai, aur jahalat ki shiddat unke hilm ko hi badhati hai.' Ab maine dono ko aazma liya. Ae Umar! Main tumhein gawah banata hun ke main Allah ko rab, Islam ko deen aur Muhammad (SAW) ko nabi maan kar raazi hun. Aur main tumhein gawah banata hun ke mere maal ka aadha, aur main un sab mein sabse zyada maal wala hun, Muhammad (SAW) ki ummat par sadqa hai." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Ya unmein se kuch par, kyunke tum sab ko poora nahi kar sakte." Maine kaha: "Ya unmein se kuch par." Phir Zayd (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas lautey aur kaha: "Main gawahi deta hun ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi aur main gawahi deta hun ke Muhammad (SAW) uske bande aur Rasool hain." Woh aap par imaan laye, aap ki tasdeeq ki, aap se bay'at ki, aur aap ke saath kai maqamaat (ghazwaat) mein shareek hue. Phir Zayd (RA) Tabuk ke ghazwe mein faut hue, aage badhte hue, peeth dikhaye baghair. Allah Zayd par rahm kare.

e: [AI] "As for the fact that I inform you of my name, my name was Qais, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called me Safinah (ship). I asked him, 'Why did you name me Safinah?' He said, 'He (Qais) went out with his companions, and their belongings became heavy for them. He said, 'Spread out your cloak,' so I spread it out, and he put their belongings in it. Then he loaded it onto me and said, 'Carry it, for you are nothing but a ship.' He said, 'If I were to carry on that day a load of a camel or two camels, or five or six, it would not be heavier for me.' It is a sahih (authentic) narratio and they both reported it."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Suno! Main tumhein apna naam batata hun: mera naam Qays tha, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne mera naam Safinah rakha." Maine poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne aap ka naam Safinah kyun rakha?" Unhone kaha: "Aap (SAW) nikle, aap ke saath aap ke Sahaba the, un par unka saamaan bhaari ho gaya. Aap ne farmaya: 'Apni chaadar bichhao.' Maine bichhayi to aap ne usmein unka saamaan daal diya, phir mujh par laad diya aur farmaya: 'Utha le, tu to sirf kashti hai.'" Unhone kaha: "Agar us din main ek ya do ya paanch ya chhe oont ka bojh bhi utha leta to mujh par bhaari na hota." Hakim ne kaha: "Sahih ul-isnad, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala."

e: [AI] "To serve the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  as long as I live." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke main Nabi (SAW) ki khidmat karun jab tak main zinda rahun." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] That the ship of the Master of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I rode the sea and my ship in which I was broke. So I rode a plank from its planks, so the plank threw me into a place where lions were. So the lion came towards me wanting me, so I said, 'O Abu al-Harith, I am the slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' So he lowered his head and came towards me and pushed me with his shoulder until he took me out of the place where the lions were and put me on the road. And he made sounds, so I thought that he was bidding me farewell, so that was my last covenant with him."
hi: Safinah (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghulam, ne kaha: "Main samundar mein sawar hua to meri woh kashti toot gayi jis mein main tha. Main uske ek takhte par sawar hua, to takhte ne mujhe ek jhaadi mein phenk diya jahan sher tha. Woh meri taraf aaya, mujhe chahta hua. Maine kaha: 'Ae Abu Al-Harith! Main Rasulullah (SAW) ka ghulam hun.' To usne apna sar jhuka diya aur mere paas aaya, mujhe apne kandhe se dhakela yahan tak ke mujhe jhaadi se bahar nikaal diya aur raste par rakh diya, aur ghurraya. Mujhe laga ke woh mujhe alvida keh raha hai, aur yeh uske saath meri aakhri mulaqat thi."

e: [AI] About Urwah, "Regarding the naming of the Muslims who pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Al-'Aqabah from the Ansar from the tribe of Harith bin Khazraj, Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi' was the leader and he witnessed the Battle of Badr."
hi: Urwah se, un Muslimon ke naam bataane ke silsile mein jinhone Ansar mein se Aqabah ke maqam par Rasulullah (SAW) se bay'at ki, Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj bin Al-Harith mein se: Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi' (RA), jo naqeeb the aur Badr mein shareek hue.

e: [AI] Regarding Ibn Shihab's narration, "In the naming of the martyr who was killed on the Day of Uhud from the Ansar of the Banu al-Harith bin al-Khazraj, Sa'd bin al-Rabi'."
hi: Ibn Shihab se, Ansar mein se Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj ke un logon ke naam bataane ke silsile mein jo Uhud ke din shaheed hue: Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi' (RA).

e: [AI] O successor of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who is this (referring to the daughter)? He said, "This is the daughter of the one who is better than me and you." He said, "And who is better than me and you except the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" Abu Bakr said, "A man who was taken during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  occupied his place in Paradise, and you and I remain."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "Ae Khalifa-e-Rasulullah (SAW)! Yeh kaun hai?" Abu Bakr (RA) ne farmaya: "Yeh us ki beti hai jo mujhse aur tumse behtar hai." Unhone kaha: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke siwa mujhse aur aap se behtar kaun hai?" Abu Bakr (RA) ne farmaya: "Ek aadmi jo Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein faut ho gaya, aur Jannat mein apna thikana le liya, aur main aur tum reh gaye."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  commanded Bilal to insert his finger into his ear and said, "Indeed, it is the most preferable for your voice. And indeed, the Adhan of Bilal used to be done in pairs, and his Iqamah alone. The prayer was established repeatedly. And he used to call the Adhan on Fridays when the crowd was like the size of the chaos. And when the Prophet ﷺ  would go out to the two Eids, he would pass by the house of Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, then by the people who sought help. Then he would begin the prayer before the sermon. Then he would say the takbirs seven times before recitation in the first rak'ah, and five times before recitation in the second rak'ah. Then he would address the people and then he would leave from the other side of the road, the road of Bani Zuraiq. Then he would sacrifice the sacrifice near the Raghaq with his own hand, with a blade. Then he would go to the house of Ammar ibn Yasir and the house of Abu Hurayrah, both made of adobe. He used to go to the two Eids walking, and return walking. And he used to say takbirs between the parts of the sermon and he would increase the takbirs in the sermon. And Bilal, when he would do the takbir in the Adhan, he would face the qiblah, then he would say "Allahu Akbar" twice. And say "Ashhadu an la ilaha illa Allah" (I bear witness that there is no god but Allah) twice. And say "Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasool Allah" (I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah) twice. And face the qiblah. Then he would say "Hayya 'ala as-salah" (Come to prayer) twice. Then he would turn away from the qiblah and say "Hayya 'ala al-Falah" (Come to success) twice. Then he would face the qiblah and say "Allahu Akbar" twice, and say "La ilaha illa Allah" (There is no god but Allah).
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bilal (RA) ko hukm diya ke apni ungli apne kaan mein daalen, aur farmaya: "Yeh tumhari awaaz ko zyada buland karta hai." Aur Bilal (RA) ki azaan do do (kalimaat) thi aur iqamat ek ek, aur "qad qamatis-salah" ek baar. Aur woh Jumu'ah ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein azaan tab dete jab saaya juute ke tasme ke barabar hota. Aur Rasulullah (SAW) jab do Eidon ke liye nikalte to Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) ke ghar ke raaste se guzarte, phir Ashab-e-Fasatit (khaimon wale) ke paas se, phir khutbe se pehle namaz shuru karte; pehli rakaat mein qiraat se pehle saat takbeerein kehte aur aakhiri mein qiraat se pehle paanch, phir logon ko khutba dete, phir doosre raaste se, Bani Zuraiq ke raaste se, wapas hote. Phir aap (SAW) ne Ar-Riqaq ke kinare par apne haath se churi se qurbani zibah ki, phir Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ke ghar aur Abu Hurairah (RA) ke ghar Al-Balat mein gaye. Aap (SAW) Eidon ke liye paidal nikalte aur paidal wapas aate, khutbe ke dauran takbeer kehte aur khutbe mein takbeer ki kasrat karte, aur asa (lathi) par khutba dete. Aur Bilal (RA) jab azaan ki takbeer kehte to qibla ki taraf mutawajjeh hote, phir kehte "Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah" do baar, "Ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah" do baar, aur qibla ki taraf rukh karte; phir qibla se hat kar kehte "Hayya alas-salah" do baar, phir qibla ke baayen taraf se hat kar kehte "Hayya alal-falah" do baar, phir qibla ki taraf rukh kar kehte "Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallah."

e: [AI] Sa'd al-Qarathi used to be a muezzin for the people of Quba. Then Umar ibn al-Khattab transferred him and made him a muezzin for the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Al-Dhahabi did not mention him in his summary.
hi: Sa'd Al-Qaraz (RA) Quba walon ke muazzin the, phir Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unhein muntaqil karke Rasulullah (SAW) ki masjid ka muazzin bana liya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Junada, son of Abu Umayyah, son of Nizar, son of Ka'b, son of Al-Harith, son of Ka'b, son of Abdullah, son of Malik, son of Nasr, Al-Azdi, passed away in the year eighty."
hi: Junadah bin Abi Umayyah bin Nizar bin Ka'b bin Al-Harith bin Ka'b bin Abdullah bin Malik bin Nasr Al-Azdi (RA) 80 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] "I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a group of Azd people on the day of Friday. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  invited us to a meal in front of him. We said, 'We are fasting.' He asked, 'Did you fast yesterday?' We replied, 'No.' He asked, 'Will you fast tomorrow?' We replied, 'No.' He then said, 'Break your fast, and do not fast on Fridays alone.'"
hi: Main Azd ke kuch logon ke saath Jumu'ah ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein apne saamne rakhe hue khane ki dawat di. Humne kaha: "Hum roze se hain." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tumne kal roza rakha tha?" Humne kaha: "Nahi." Farmaya: "Kya kal roza rakhoge?" Humne kaha: "Nahi." Farmaya: "To roza tod do." Phir farmaya: "Jumu'ah ke din akele roza mat rakho."

e: [AI] "A man said, 'O Commander of the faithful, do you know this passerby?' He replied, 'No, so who is he?' He said, 'He is Suwad ibn Qarib, a man from the people of Yemen who possesses honor and high status among them. He is the one who received a dream about the appearance of the Prophet ﷺ. When Umar heard this, he became angry and said, 'Are you Suwad ibn Qarib?' He answered, 'Yes.' Umar said, 'So you are the one to whom your dream showed the appearance of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?' He replied, 'Yes.' Umar said, 'Then you are in the same state of soothsaying as you were before, and he became extremely angry and said, 'O Commander of the faithful, no one has ever treated me this way since I became a Muslim!' Umar said, 'By Allah, we were in a worse state of polytheism than you were in soothsaying. Inform me about your dream showing the appearance of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.' He said, 'Yes, O Commander of the faithful, one night I was between being asleep and awake when a dream came to me. Someone struck me with their foot and said, "Arise, O Suwad ibn Qarib, and understand, if you are capable of understanding. Verily, the Messenger of Allah has been sent by Lu'ay ibn Ghalib, inviting people to Allah and His worship." Then he recited a poem which means, 'I am amazed by the jinn and their eavesdropping and their hard-heartedness. They quickly descended to Makkah seeking guidance. How excellent are the believing jinn, like you, compared to its disbelieving ones. So, leave for Safwa, which is a part of Hashim, and it is the name from your eyes to your head.' He said, 'I did not raise my head, but I said, 'Leave me to sleep, for I am tired.' When the second night arrived, the same thing happened. He said, 'Did I not tell you, O Suwad ibn Qarib, to arise and understand, if you are capable of understanding? Verily, the Messenger of Allah has been sent by Lu’ay ibn Ghalib, inviting people to Allah and His worship.' Then he recited a poem which means, 'I am amazed by the jinn and their news, and their hard-heartedness. They quickly descended to Makkah seeking guidance. How excellent are the believing jinn, like you, compared to its disbelieving ones. So, leave for Safwa, which is a part of Hashim, in its highlands and its barriers.' He said, 'I did not raise my head. When the third night arrived, the same thing happened. He said, 'Did I not tell you, O Suwad ibn Qarib, to arise and understand, if you are capable of understanding? Verily, the Messenger of Allah has been sent by Lu’ay ibn Ghalib, inviting people to Allah and His worship
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ...Ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Kya aap is guzarne wale ko jaante hain?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, woh kaun hai?" Usne kaha: "Sawad bin Qarib, Yemen walon mein se ek aadmi, ek aise ghar se jismein sharaf aur maqam hai; yeh woh hain jinke paas unka ra'i (jinn saathi) Nabi (SAW) ke zahir hone ki khabar lekar aaya tha." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Use mere paas laao." Use bulaya gaya. Unhone poocha: "Kya tum Sawad bin Qarib ho?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Poocha: "Kya tum hi woh ho jiske paas tumhara ra'i Rasulullah (SAW) ke zahir hone ki khabar lekar aaya?" Usne kaha: "Ji haan." Poocha: "To kya tum ab bhi apni kahanat par ho?" Woh sakht ghusse mein aaye aur kaha: "Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Jab se main Muslim hua hun mujhse kisi ne is tarah ka istiqbal nahi kiya." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Subhan Allah! Allah ki qasam, shirk jis par hum the tumhari kahanat se bohot bada tha. Mujhe bataiye tumhare ra'i ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke zahir hone ki khabar ke saath tumhare paas aana kaise kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Ji, Ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Ek raat main neend aur bedari ke beech tha ke mere paas ek ra'i aaya, usne mujhe apne paon se thokar mari aur kaha: 'Uth, Ae Sawad bin Qarib, samajh aur aql kar agar tu aql rakhta hai, Luayy bin Ghalib mein se Allah ka ek Rasool bheja gaya hai jo Allah aur uski ibadat ki dawat deta hai.' Phir usne ashaar kahe [Bahr As-Sari']: 'Mujhe jinnon par aur unki jasoosi par, aur unke oonton par jhooliyan kasne par taajjub hai; woh Makkah ki taraf hidayat chahte hue daude ja rahe hain; jinnon ka behtar unke napaakon jaisa nahi. To Bani Hashim ke chuney hue (Nabi) ki taraf kooch kar, aur apni aankhon se uske sar ki taraf buland ho.' Maine uski baat par sar na uthaya aur kaha: 'Mujhe sone de, main ghunoodgi mein hun.' Jab doosri raat aayi to woh phir aaya, mujhe apne paon se thokar mari aur kaha: 'Kya maine nahi kaha tha, Ae Sawad bin Qarib, uth, samajh aur aql kar agar tu aql rakhta hai? Luayy bin Ghalib mein se Allah ka Rasool bheja gaya hai jo Allah aur uski ibadat ki dawat deta hai.' Phir jinn ne ashaar kahe: 'Mujhe jinnon par aur unki talash par, aur unke oonton par kajaawe kasne par taajjub hai; woh Makkah ki taraf hidayat chahte hue daude ja rahe hain; jinnon ka sachcha unke jhoothe jaisa nahi. To Bani Hashim ke chuney hue ki taraf kooch kar, jo unke dusre logon aur parda-doron ke beech hai.' Maine phir sar na uthaya. Jab teesri raat aayi to woh phir aaya, mujhe apne paon se thokar mari aur kaha: 'Kya maine tujhse nahi kaha, Ae Sawad bin Qarib, samajh aur aql kar agar tu aql rakhta hai, ke Luayy bin Ghalib mein se Allah ka Rasool bheja gaya hai jo Allah aur uski ibadat ki dawat deta hai.' Phir usne kaha: 'Mujhe jinnon par aur unki khabron par, aur unke oonton par palaan kasne par taajjub hai; woh Makkah ki taraf hidayat chahte hue daude ja rahe hain; jinnon ke momin unke kafiron jaise nahi. To Bani Hashim ke chuney hue ki taraf kooch kar, unke aage waale unki dumon jaise nahi.' Phir mere dil mein Islam ki mohabbat dal di gayi aur mujhe isme raghbat ho gayi. Subah hui to maine apni sawari kasi aur Makkah ki taraf rawana hua. Raaste mein mujhe khabar di gayi ke Nabi (SAW) Madina hijrat kar chuke hain. To main Madina aaya, Nabi (SAW) ke baare mein poocha, mujhe bataya gaya ke woh masjid mein hain. Main masjid pahuncha, apni ounthni bandhi aur andar gaya, dekha ke Rasulullah (SAW) aur logon ne aap ko gher rakha hai. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Meri baat suniye.' Abu Bakr (RA) ne kaha: 'Qareeb aao.' Main barabar aage badhta raha yahan tak ke aap ke saamne pahunch gaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Sunao, aur apne ra'i ke aane ka haal bataao.' To unhone kaha [Bahr At-Tawil]: 'Mere paas ek sargoshi karne wala aaya, sukoon aur neend ke baad, aur jo kuch maine aazmaya us mein woh jhoota nahi nikla. Teen raaton tak har raat uska yeh kehna ke Luayy bin Ghalib mein se Allah ka Rasool tere paas aaya hai. To maine apni lungi ka daaman sameta, aur tez raftaar dubli ounthni mujhe ujaad maidanon ke beech le chali. To main gawahi deta hun ke Allah ke siwa koi rab nahi, aur aap har ghalib par amanat-daar hain, aur aap Rasoolon mein Allah ke nazdeek sabse qareeb wasila hain, Ae buzurg paak logon ke bete. To humein hukm dijiye jo bhi aap ke paas aaye, Ae behtareen chalne walon mein, chahe usmein baalon ki lat safed kar dene wali baat ho. Aur mere liye us din shafa'at karne wale hon jis din aap ke siwa koi shafa'at karne wala Sawad bin Qarib ke kaam na aaye.' Rasulullah (SAW) aur aap ke Sahaba mere Islam se bohot khush hue, yahan tak ke unke chehron mein nazar aaya." (Raawi ne) kaha: Umar (RA) kood pade aur unse lipat gaye, aur kaha: "Mujhe pasand tha ke yeh tumhi se sunun." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Isnad munqati' hai."

e: [AI] "Salman bin Aamir bin Aws bin Amr bin Hujr bin Amr bin Al-Harith bin Taym bin Dhuhl bin Malik bin Bakr bin Saad bin Dabbah settled in Basra and had a house near the Mosque Al Jami. He passed away during the caliphate of Uthman."
hi: Salman bin Amir bin Aws bin Amr bin Hujr bin Amr bin Al-Harith bin Taym bin Dhuhl bin Malik bin Bakr bin Sa'd bin Dabbah (RA) Basra mein utre, jami masjid ke qareeb unka ghar tha, aur wahin Uthman (RA) ki khilafat mein faut hue.

e:
[AI] I came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, my father used to maintain family ties, entertain guests, fulfill his promises, but he did not embrace Islam. Will he be rewarded for that?" He ﷺ  replied, "No." 
When I was about to leave, he said to me, "You will follow in his footsteps, and they will never be humiliated, disgraced, or deprived."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Mere walid rishtedari nibhate the, mehman ki mezbani karte the aur ahd poora karte the, aur unhone Islam ka zamana nahi paya. Kya unhein is par koi ajr milega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi." Jab main peeth mod kar chala to farmaya: "Us shaikh ko mere paas lao." Phir mujhse farmaya: "Yeh (nek amal) tumhari nasl mein rahega, woh kabhi zaleel nahi honge, kabhi ruswa nahi honge, aur kabhi muflis nahi honge."

e: [AI] Aqil, the son of Muhammad, the son of Sufyan, the son of Mujashie', the son of Darim, the grandfather of Farradhaq, the son of Ghalib, visited the Prophet.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...Iqal bin Muhammad bin Sufyan bin Mujashi' bin Darim, jo Farazdaq bin Ghalib ke dada hain, Nabi (SAW) ke paas wafd ban kar aaye."

e: [AI] "I came to the Prophet ﷺ  and he presented Islam to me. So, I accepted Islam and he taught me some verses from the Qur'an. Then, I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have performed some deeds during the time of ignorance. Will there be any reward for me?' He asked, 'What did you do?' I replied, 'I lost two she-camels and I followed them on a camel of mine until I found two houses in the middle of nowhere. I intended to claim them but I found an elderly man in one of them. I asked him if he had seen my two she-camels and he said, 'Yes, we found them and sold them. Allah has blessed us with them and they have benefited two families from your people, the Arabs, from the Mudar tribe.' While he was talking to me, a woman from the other house called out that she had given birth. He asked about the gender of the child, and if it was a boy, it would have been considered a part of their family. But if it was a girl, he requested me to bury her. The woman gave birth to a girl, so I asked, 'What is this newborn?' He replied, 'She is my daughter.' I said, 'I will buy her from you.' He then said, 'O brother from the Banu Tamim tribe, would you buy my daughter, while I am a man from the Arabs, from the Mudar tribe?' I responded, 'I will not buy her as a slave, but I will buy her to set her free. I will not allow her to be killed.' He asked, 'What will you give in exchange?' I said, 'I will give you my two she-camels and their offspring, and you will also receive my camel as an addition to the deal.' He agreed and said, 'In that case, send someone with me as a witness.' When I reached my people, I would return your camel to you.' However, during the night, I thought to myself that this was a great opportunity and no Arab had seized it before me. Islam has emerged and I have benefited from it by acquiring 366 camels in return. Each of them was bought with two she-camels and a camel. Will I receive any reward for that?' The Prophet ﷺ  replied, 'You will be rewarded for it, as Allah has bestowed His blessings upon you through Islam.'" [This narration was considered as reliable by Imam Al-Dhahabi].
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya, aap ne mere saamne Islam pesh kiya to main Islam laya, aur aap ne mujhe Quran ki kuch aayaat sikhayin. Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Maine jahiliyyat mein kuch amal kiye hain, kya mujhe unka koi ajr milega?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumne kya kiya?" Maine kaha: "Meri dus mahine ki hamila do untniyan bhatak gayin, to main apne ek oont par unke peeche nikla. Zameen ke ek khule maidan mein mujhe do ghar nazar aaye, maine unka rukh kiya, to unmein se ek mein ek bohot boodha aadmi paya. Maine kaha: 'Kya tumne dus mahine ki do hamila untniyan dekhi hain?' Maine dono ko pukara. To Miqsam bin Darim ne kaha: 'Humne tumhari dono untniyan paa li thin aur unhein bech diya, aur Allah ne un se tumhari qaum, Mudar ke Arab, ke do gharanon ko sahara diya.' Woh mujhse baat kar hi raha tha ke doosre ghar se ek aurat ne use pukara: 'Bachcha paida hua, bachcha paida hua!' Usne kaha: 'Kya paida hua? Agar ladka hai to hum apni qaum mein shareek hue, aur agar ladki hai to use dafan kar do.' Aurat ne kaha: 'Ladki.' Maine poocha: 'Yeh paida hone wali kaun hai?' Usne kaha: 'Meri beti.' Maine kaha: 'Main use tumse khareedta hun.' Usne kaha: 'Ae Bani Tamim ke bhai! Kya tum meri beti khareedoge, jabke main Mudar ka ek Arab hun?' Maine kaha: 'Main tumse uski gardan nahi khareed raha, balki main tumse uski jaan khareed raha hun ke tum use qatl na karo.' Usne kaha: 'Kis cheez ke badle?' Maine kaha: 'Apni in do untniyon aur unke bachchon ke badle.' Usne kaha: 'Aur tum mujhe apna yeh oont bhi do.' Maine kaha: 'Haan, is shart par ke tum mere saath ek qaasid bhejo, jab main apne ahl tak pahunch jaun to oont us ke hawale kar dunga.' Phir raat ke kisi hisse mein maine apne dil mein socha ke yeh aisi bazurgi hai jis mein mujhse pehle koi Arab nahi gaya. Aur Islam zahir hua jabke maine 360 dafan ki jaane wali ladkiyon ko zinda kiya hai, har ek ko dus mahine ki do hamila untniyon aur ek oont ke badle khareeda. Kya mujhe is par koi ajr milega?" To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare liye iska ajr poora hua, kyunke Allah ne tum par Islam ka ehsan kiya." Abbad ne kaha: Sa'sa'ah ke qaul ki tasdeeq Farazdaq ka qaul hai [Bahr Al-Mutaqarib]: "Aur mera dada woh hai jisne ladkiyon ko zinda dafan karne walon ko roka, to dafan ki jaane wali ko zinda kiya aur woh dafan na ki gayi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, perhaps I have been granted a virtue (Fadl) that I have kept hidden for the needy and the wayfarer." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, "Your mother, your father, your sister, and your brother have all the priority, all the priority."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Kabhi kabhi mere paas zayad maal bach jaata hai to main use kisi aane wali zaroorat (na'iyah) aur musaafir ke liye bacha kar rakhta hun." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni maa aur apne baap, apni behen aur apne bhai, phir jo tumhare sabse zyada qareeb ho, phir jo uske baad qareeb ho."

e: [AI] Qais bin Asim bin Sinan bin Khalid bin Minqar bin Ubaid bin Muqais bin Amr bin Kaab bin Saad bin Zaid Manatah, and he visited the prophet Muhammad ﷺ  and said, "This is the master of the righteous people."
hi: Qays bin Asim bin Sinan bin Khalid bin Minqar bin Ubayd bin Muqa'is bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Zayd Manat bin Tamim (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas wafd ban kar aaye to aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh ahl-e-wabar (khaimon aur oon wale dehatiyon) ka sardar hai."

e:
[AI] "O my sons, when I die, you should mourn and follow your fathers' footsteps, but do not mourn for your younger ones as it will cause harm to you. And do not wail for me, as I heard the Messenger of Allah forbidding wailing. You should focus on rectifying your wealth, as it is a means of honor for the noble and a means of sufficiency for the insolent. Do not give the rights of the camels to others and do not deny them their rights, and beware of any evil deeds because no matter how much happiness you experience, the greatest evil can overcome you. Beware of the children of your enemies, as they are your enemies on the same path as their fathers. When I die, bury me in a place where Bakr ibn Wael cannot see, as there were conflicts between us in the pre-Islamic era, and I fear that they will dig up my grave and cause corruption for themselves and harm your Hereafter. Then, he called his son Al-Abbas and said, 'Take out an arrow from my quiver.' He took it out and his father said, 'Break it,' so he broke it. Then he said, 'Take out two more arrows,' so he took them out and his father said, 'Break them,' so he broke them. But he could not break them. His father said, 'O my sons, this is how you are when you are united, and this is how you are when you are divided.' Then he recited:

"Indeed, the true glory is that which is built by a father who is steadfast and upright. Glory and bravery are sufficient for him when he has purity and abundance. O my sons, when you enter into treaties, be as strong as thirty in the hands of an archer; even if the arrows are severed, their unity remains. And the elders are more deserving if they are capable of leadership. And if some of you possess dominance, you should protect the younger ones until they reach the age of maturity, and their efforts should be combined."

- This is an excerpt from a longer speech by a father advising his sons before his death.
hi: "Ae mere bete! Jab main mar jaun to apne sabse bade ko sardar banana, taa ke tum apne baap-dada ke jaanasheen ho; aur apne sabse chhote ko sardar mat banana, warna yeh tumhare humsaron ke saamne tumhein kamtar kar dega. Mere upar nauha karne wali mat bithana, kyunke maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko nauha karne se mana farmate suna hai. Maal ki islah ko lazim pakdo, kyunke woh sharif ki izzat ka sabab hai aur uski wajah se kameene se beniyazi hoti hai. Oonton ki gardanein (yaani oont) un ke haq ke baghair mat do, aur unke haq se mat roko. Har burai ki jad se bacho, kyunke jo cheez aaj tumhein khush kare uska nuqsan kahin bada hoga. Apne dushmanon ke beton se hoshiyar raho, kyunke woh apne baap-dada ke tareeqe par tumhare dushman hain. Jab main mar jaun to mujhe aisi jagah dafan karna jis par Bakr bin Wa'il ke is qabile ki nazar na pade, kyunke jahiliyyat mein mere aur unke darmiyan zakhm (khuraashein) the, mujhe khauf hai ke woh meri qabr khod den, to tum unki dunya bigaad doge aur woh tumhari aakhirat bigaad denge." Phir unhone apna tarkash mangwaya aur apne sabse bade bete ko, jise Ali kaha jaata tha, hukm diya: "Mere tarkash se ek teer nikalo," to usne nikala. Unhone kaha: "Ise tod do," usne tod diya. Phir kaha: "Do teer nikalo," usne nikale. Kaha: "Unhein tod do," to woh unhein na tod saka. Unhone kaha: "Ae mere bete! Tum ittehad mein bhi aise hi ho aur judai mein bhi aise hi." Phir unhone ashaar kahe [Bahr Al-Khafif]: "Buzurgi to wahi hai jis ki bunyad sachche walid ne rakhi aur beta uske kaam ko zinda kare. Buzurgi, shuja'at aur hilm kaafi hain jab pak-daamani aur sakhawat unhein sanwaare. Aur tees (teer), ae mere bete, jab tum musibaton ke liye ahd bandho to woh tees teeron ki tarah hai jinhein zamane ke liye agar mazboot girah bandh de to woh nahi tutenge, aur agar teer alag alag ho jayen to bikhar jaana unke majmue ko barbad kar deta hai. Aur umar-rasida aur muruwwat wale awla hain, agar tum mein se kisi ko unki sardari hasil ho. Aur tum par chhoton ki hifazat hai yahan tak ke sabse chhota, jisko mashaqqat mein dala gaya ho, baligh ho jaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I went to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. When he saw me, I heard him say, "This is the master of the virtuous people."
