When I reached him, I started talking to him and asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what kind of wealth is there that does not burden me with obligations from guests and a large family?" He said, "The best wealth is forty or more and woe to those who have a hundred, except those who give from their wealth for their messengers, struggle for it, support its poor, and feed the content and the hungry." I said, "O Prophet of Allah, what noble and excellent manners! O Prophet of Allah, may it not come upon the valley where I have a lot of camels." He asked, "What do you propose to do?" I said, "We will count the camels and count the people, and whoever wants can take one of the camels and go." He asked, "What will you do with those who have poor or weak camels?" I said, "I do not consider the young or the old male camels as poor or weak." He said, "Then what do you prefer, your own wealth or the wealth of your followers?" I said, "My own wealth is dearer to me than the wealth of my followers." He said, "If you have used your own wealth, spent it, or worn it, then you have done well. Otherwise, it is for your followers." I said, "By Allah, if I had stayed, I would have spent it all." Al-Hasan said, "And he did it, by Allah." When Qais was close to death, he advised his children, saying, "Beware of asking, as it is the last thing a person earns. If someone does not ask, he will leave his earnings."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, jab aap ne mujhe dekha to maine aap ko farmate suna: "Yeh ahl-e-wabar ka sardar hai." Jab main utra to aap ke paas aaya aur aap se baatein karne laga. Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Woh kaunsa maal hai jis mein mujh par koi mutalaba na ho, mehman ki wajah se jo mere paas utre aur ayal ki wajah se jo bohot ho gaye hain?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Behtareen maal chalees (oont) hain, aur zyada se zyada saath, aur tabahi hai sau wale ke liye, magar jisne unhein narmi aur sakhti mein diya, unki peeth ariyatan di, aur qaani aur mu'tarr (maangne wale) ko khilaya." Maine kaha: "Ae Allah ke Nabi! Yeh akhlaq kitne mukarram aur kitne umda hain! Ae Allah ke Nabi, jis wadi mein main hun wahan meri kasrat-e-ibil ki wajah se kisi ko jagah na rahe." Aap ne farmaya: "Phir tum kya karoge?" Maine kaha: "Hum oonton ko ginenge aur logon ko ginenge, jo chahe ek oont ka sar pakad kar le jaye." Aap ne farmaya: "Aur unki peeth ariyat dene ka kya karoge?" Maine kaha: "Main chhote aur zaif daant wale ko ariyat nahi deta." Aap ne farmaya: "Tumhara maal tumhein zyada mahboob hai ya tumhare mawali ka maal?" Maine kaha: "Mera maal mujhe mere mawali ke maal se zyada mahboob hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Tumhara apna maal wahi hai jo tumne khaya aur fana kiya, ya pehna aur purana kiya, ya diya aur guzar diya, warna woh tumhare mawali ka hai." Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar main zinda raha to unki ginti ko fana kar dunga." Hasan ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, unhone aisa hi kiya. Jab Qays ki wafaat ka waqt aaya to unhone apne beton ko wasiyat ki: "Sawal karne se bacho, kyunke yeh aadmi ki aakhri kamai hai. Jis kisi ne bhi sawal kiya usne apni kamai chhod di."

e: [AI] "Amr, son of Al-Ahtam, son of Sumayy, son of Sinan, son of Khalid, son of Minqar, son of Ubaid, son of Muqais, son of Amr, son of Kaab, son of Saad, son of Zaid, from the Banu Tamim tribe. The name Ahtam is synonymous with Sinan. His valor was hailed on the Day of the Battle of the Dogs."
hi: Amr bin Al-Ahtam bin Sumayy bin Sinan bin Khalid bin Minqar bin Ubayd bin Muqa'is bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Zayd Manat bin Tamim (RA). Al-Ahtam ka naam Sinan tha; Yaum Al-Kilab ke din uske dono samne ke daant toot gaye the.

e: [AI] "Qais bin Asim, Al-Zubra' bin Badr, and Amr bin Al-Ahtam Al-Tamimi sat before the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. Al-Zubra' stood up and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I am the leader of the Tamim tribe, and they obey and follow me. I provide them with their rights and protect them from injustice. And this is well-known to Amr bin Al-Ahtam.' Amr bin Al-Ahtam said, 'By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, he is indeed arrogant, preventing others from expressing their opinions while being obedient in his own company.' Al-Zubra' said, 'By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, he knows things about me that he didn't mention, and envy is the only reason preventing him from speaking about it.' Amr said, 'I envy you, and by Allah, you are indeed a wicked relative, ignorant in financial matters, and a source of trouble to the family. By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, you spoke the truth in what you said first and last. But I am a person who is content, so I said the best of what I knew, and I became angry, so I said the worst of what I found. By Allah, you spoke the truth in both matters.' The Prophet, peace be upon him, said, 'Indeed, eloquence carries magic. Indeed, eloquence carries magic.' It is reported that Abu Bakrah Al-Ansari was present in this gathering."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas Bani Tamim ke Qays bin Asim (RA), Az-Zibriqan bin Badr aur Amr bin Al-Ahtam (RA) baithe. Az-Zibriqan ne fakhr karte hue kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main Tamim ka sardar hun, unmein meri itaa'at ki jaati hai aur meri baat maani jaati hai. Main unhein zulm se rokta hun aur unke huquq unke liye leta hun, aur yeh (Amr bin Al-Ahtam) is baat ko jaanta hai." Amr bin Al-Ahtam ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, ya Rasulullah! Woh sakht bayan wala hai, apne pehlu ki himayat karne wala hai, aur apni majlis mein muta'a hai." Az-Zibriqan ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, ya Rasulullah! Ise mere baare mein uske ilawa bhi ilm hai jo usne kaha, aur use bolne se hasad ke siwa kisi cheez ne nahi roka." Amr ne kaha: "Main tujhse hasad karun? Allah ki qasam tu kameena mamu wala, naya-naya maal-wala, ahmaq paida hone wala, apne qabile mein zaya karne wala hai. Allah ki qasam, ya Rasulullah! Maine pehle jo kaha sach kaha aur baad mein jo kaha usmein jhoot nahi bola, lekin main aisa aadmi hun ke jab raazi hota hun to woh behtareen baat kehta hun jo mujhe maloom ho, aur jab ghussa hota hun to woh badtareen baat kehta hun jo mujhe mile. Allah ki qasam, maine donon baatein sach kahin." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak kuch bayan sehr hota hai, beshak kuch bayan sehr hota hai." Aur Abu Bakrah Al-Ansari (RA) se riwayat kiya gaya hai ke woh is majlis mein hazir the.

e: [AI] We were with the Prophet ﷺ  when a delegation from the Banu Tamim arrived, including Qais bin Asim, Amr bin Al-Ahtam, and Al-Zibraqan bin Badr. The Prophet ﷺ  asked Amr bin Al-Ahtam, "What do you say about Al-Zibraqan bin Badr?" Amr replied, "O Messenger of Allah, he is a powerful leader in his tribe, with a strong presence and an influential position preventing anyone from opposing him." Al-Zibraqan then said, "O Messenger of Allah, I can assure you that he knows more about me than what he has described. However, he envies me." Amr continued, "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, he is a deceiving man, stingy in his generosity, wicked in character, and foolish in his actions. By Allah, you did not lie at first, and you have spoken the truth in the end. But I was pleased, so I expressed the best I knew, and I got angry, so I expressed the worst I knew." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Verily, eloquence can be magic, and there is wisdom in poetry."
hi: Hum Nabi (SAW) ke paas the ke Bani Tamim ka wafd aaya, jinmein Qays bin Asim (RA), Amr bin Al-Ahtam (RA) aur Az-Zibriqan bin Badr the. Nabi (SAW) ne Amr bin Al-Ahtam se poocha: "Tum Az-Zibriqan bin Badr ke baare mein kya kehte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Apni majlis mein muta'a hai, sakht bayan wala hai, apne peeche walon ki himayat karne wala hai." Az-Zibriqan ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Allah ki qasam, woh mere baare mein usse zyada jaanta hai jo usne bayan kiya, lekin usne mujh par hasad kiya." Amr ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, ya Rasulullah! Yeh muruwwat ko barbad karne wala, tang-nazar, kameena mamu wala, ahmaq paida hone wala hai. Allah ki qasam, maine pehle jhoot nahi bola aur aakhir mein sach hi kaha, lekin main raazi hua to woh behtareen baat kahi jo mujhe maloom thi, aur ghussa hua to woh badtareen baat kahi jo mujhe maloom thi." Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak kuch bayan sehr hota hai, aur beshak kuch shayri hikmat hoti hai."

e: [AI] "Sa'sa'a, the son of Mu'awiya, the son of Husayn, the son of Umair, the son of Ubada, the son of Nazzal, the son of Murrah, the son of Ubaid, the son of Muqais, the son of Amr, the son of Ka'b, the son of Sa'd, the son of Zaid, from the offspring of Manat, the son of Tameem, the uncle of Al-Ahnaf, the son of Qais."
hi: Sa'sa'ah bin Mu'awiyah bin Husayn bin Umayr bin Ubadah bin An-Nazzal bin Murrah bin Ubayd bin Muqa'is bin Amr bin Ka'b bin Sa'd bin Zayd Manat bin Tamim (RA), Al-Ahnaf bin Qays ke chacha.

e: [AI] I came to the Prophet ﷺ and I heard him reciting this verse: "So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it." [Al-Zalzalah 8]. So I said, "I don't care if I don't hear anything else, this is enough for me."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya to maine aap ko yeh aayat padhte suna: {To jo koi zarra bhar bhalai karega woh use dekh lega, aur jo koi zarra bhar burai karega woh use dekh lega} (Surah Az-Zalzalah 7-8). Maine kaha: "Mujhe parwah nahi ke iske siwa kuch aur na sunun, mere liye yehi kaafi hai, kaafi hai."

e: [AI] "And Al-Ahnaf ibn Qais ibn Husayn ibn Nazzal ibn Ubaydah al-Mukhadram met the Prophet ﷺ and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ directed his attention towards him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made a supplication for him, saying, 'And the name of Al-Ahnaf is Adh-Dhahhak, and it is said that his name is Sakhir ibn Qais ibn Mu'awiya ibn Husayn. He was born while his father was called Ahnaf.' So his mother said, 'By Allah, if it weren't for him having Ahnaf in his foot, there wouldn't be a boy as intelligent as him in the whole tribe of the Arabs.'"
hi: Aur Al-Ahnaf bin Qays bin Husayn bin An-Nazzal bin Ubaydah mukhazram (jahiliyyat aur Islam dono ka zamana paane wale) the, unhone Nabi (SAW) ka zamana paya; Rasulullah (SAW) ne unki taraf rukh kiya aur unke liye dua farmayi. Kaha: "Al-Ahnaf ka naam Ad-Dahhak tha, aur kaha jaata hai Sakhr bin Qays bin Mu'awiyah bin Husayn; woh ahnaf (pair mein tedhapan ke saath) paida hue." Unki walida ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar unke pair mein tedhapan na hota to qabile mein unke jaisa koi ladka na hota." Aur woh Arab mein sabse zyada burdbaar (hilm wale) the.

e: [AI] "Do you remember when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me to your people, the Banu Saad, and I presented Islam to them and invited them to it? I said to you, 'Indeed, you invite to good and command good.' So I conveyed that to the Prophet ﷺ and he said, 'O Allah, forgive al-Ahnaf ibn Qais.' Al-Ahnaf used to say, 'There is nothing more hopeful for me than this action of mine.'" The rest of what the Dhahabi said was omitted in the summary.
hi: "Kya tumhein yaad hai jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe tumhari qaum Bani Sa'd ke paas bheja, to main unke saamne Islam pesh karta aur unhein uski dawat deta tha, to tumne kaha: 'Aap bhalai ki dawat dete hain aur bhalai ka hukm dete hain.' Phir maine yeh Nabi (SAW) tak pahunchaya to aap ne farmaya: 'Ae Allah! Al-Ahnaf bin Qays ko bakhsh de.'" Phir Al-Ahnaf kaha karte the: "Mere amal mein se koi cheez mere liye isse zyada ummeed wali nahi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Al-Aswad ibn Sari' ibn Himyar ibn 'Ubadah ibn al-Nazzal ibn Murrah ibn 'Ubaydah, he had a house in Basra in the presence of the mosque, belonging to the descendants of Banu Tamim. He died during the reign of Muawiyah."
hi: Al-Aswad bin Sari' bin Himyar bin Ubadah bin An-Nazzal bin Murrah bin Ubaydah (RA) ka Basra mein jami masjid ke qareeb, Bani Tamim ke saath wali taraf ghar tha. Woh Mu'awiyah (RA) ke zamane mein faut hue.

e: [AI] Al-Aswad ibn Sari' said, "O Messenger of Allah, shall I not recite to you some praises that I have praised my Lord with, Blessed and Exalted?" He said, "Indeed, your Lord, Blessed and Exalted, loves praise and He does not accept any additional praising beyond that." (Correct chain of narrators, but it has not been recorded by either of the two compilers of the Sahih collections).
hi: Al-Aswad bin Sari' (RA) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Kya main aap ko woh hamd-o-sana na sunaun jinse maine apne rab Tabarak wa Ta'ala ki hamd ki hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak tumhara rab Tabarak wa Ta'ala hamd ko pasand karta hai," aur aap ne is par izafa nahi kiya. Hakim ne kaha: "Sahih ul-isnad, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala."

e: [AI] I approached the Prophet of Allah ﷺ  and said, "O Prophet of Allah, I have composed a poem in which I praised and glorified Allah the Almighty and praised you." He replied, "As for what you praised Allah with, give it to me, and as for what you praised me with, leave it." So I recited the part praising Allah, then a tall man entered and said to me, "Stop." When he left, he said, "Continue." I began reciting again, and before long, he returned and said, "Stop." When he left again, he said, "Continue." So I asked the Prophet of Allah, "Who is this man, O Prophet of Allah, that when he enters, you say 'stop' and when he leaves, you say 'continue'?" The Prophet replied, "This is Umar ibn Al-Khattab, and he does not interfere without reason."
hi: Main Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ae Allah ke Nabi! Maine shayri ki hai jis mein maine Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ki sana ki hai aur aap ki madh ki hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo tumne Allah Ta'ala ki sana ki hai woh sunao, aur jo mere baare mein madh ki hai use chhod do." Main sunane laga, to ek lambe qad, ubhri hui naak wala aadmi andar aaya, to aap ne mujhse farmaya: "Ruk jao." Jab woh nikal gaya to farmaya: "Sunao." Main sunane laga, thodi der hi guzri thi ke woh phir aaya, to mujhse farmaya: "Ruk jao." Jab woh nikal gaya to farmaya: "Sunao." Maine kaha: "Ae Allah ke Nabi! Yeh kaun hain ke jab andar aate hain to aap 'ruk jao' kehte hain aur jab nikal jaate hain to 'sunao' kehte hain?" Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh Umar bin Al-Khattab hain, aur woh baatil ki kisi cheez mein nahi."

e: [AI] Jariyah, the daughter of Qudamah bin Zuhair bin Husayn bin Rabah bin Saad bin Yahya bin Rabiah bin Kaab, also known as Aba al-Walid and Aba Yazid, had a house in Basra in the Sahat al-Bahariyyah.
hi: Jariyah bin Qudamah bin Zuhayr bin Husayn bin Rabah bin Sa'd bin Yahya bin Rabi'ah bin Ka'b (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Al-Walid aur Abu Yazid thi, ka Basra mein Sikkat Al-Bahhariyyah mein ghar tha.

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, tell me a phrase that will benefit me and make it easy for me, so that I may stick to it." He said, "Do not get angry." And he repeated it to me several times, saying, "Do not get angry."
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Mujhse aisi baat kahiye jo mujhe nafa de, aur mujhse kam kahiye, shayad main use yaad rakh sakun." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ghussa mat karo." Aur aap (SAW) ne yeh baar baar dohraya, farmate rahe: "Ghussa mat karo." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "When people came for Hajj in the year nine, Uruwah ibn Mas'ood al-Thaqafi, the uncle of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and sought permission to return to his people. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'I fear that they will kill you.' Uruwah said: 'If they find me sleeping, they can wake me up.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  gave him permission, and he returned to his people as a Muslim. He stayed there until after dinner, then the people of Thaqif came to him, so he invited them to Islam. They accused him falsely, disobeyed him, and said things about him that he did not deserve. Then they left him until it was late at night, when dawn was about to break. Uruwah stood up in his house, called for prayer, and started to recite the Shahada. A man from Thaqif shot an arrow at him and killed him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Uruwah is like the companion of Yasin (i.e., Prophet Nuh), who called his people to Allah the Almighty and they killed him.'"
hi: Jab log 9 Hijri mein Hajj ke liye aaye, Urwah bin Mas'ud Ath-Thaqafi (RA), jo Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) ke chacha hain, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur apni qaum ke paas lautne ki ijazat maangi. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe khauf hai ke woh tumhein qatl kar denge." Unhone kaha: "Agar woh mujhe soya hua paayen to bhi mujhe jaga denge." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein ijazat de di aur woh Muslim hokar apni qaum ke paas lautey. Woh shaam ko pahunche, to Thaqif unke paas aaye, unhone unhein Islam ki dawat di, to unhone unhein muttaham kiya, unki nafarmani ki, aur unhein woh kuch sunaya jis ka unhein gumaan bhi na tha. Phir woh unke paas se nikal gaye, yahan tak ke jab sehri ka waqt aaya aur fajr tulu hui, Urwah (RA) apne ghar mein khade hue, namaz ki azaan di aur shahadat di, to Thaqif ke ek aadmi ne unhein teer maara aur qatl kar diya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Urwah ki misaal Yaseen wale (Sahib-e-Yaseen) ki si hai, jisne apni qaum ko Allah Ta'ala ki taraf bulaya to unhone use qatl kar diya."

e: [AI] Mujashiu bin Mas'ud bin Tha'laba bin Wahb bin Aa'id, known as Abu Sulaiman, was killed on the day of the smaller Battle of the Camel in the year 36. He was buried in his house in the Banu Sulaim district, in the presence of the Banu Sadus tribe. He also had a house in Basra near the Jame Mosque.
hi: Mujashi' bin Mas'ud bin Tha'labah bin Wahb bin Aidh (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Sulayman thi. Unki aur unke bhai Mujalid ki walida Mulaykah bint Sufyan bin Al-Harith bin Labid bin Khuzaymah thin. Mujashi' (RA) Jang-e-Jamal Al-Asghar ke din 36 Hijri mein qatl hue, aur Bani Sulaym mein Bani Sadus ke qareeb apne ghar mein dafan hue. Basra mein unke kai ghar the, unmein se ek jami masjid ke qareeb tha.

e: [AI] "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with my brother Mujalid after the conquest, and I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have come to you with my brother Mujalid to pledge allegiance to him for the purpose of migration.' He said, 'The people of migration have already taken what they needed.' So I said, 'Then what shall I pledge allegiance to him for, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied, 'Pledge allegiance to him for Islam, faith, and jihad.'" (The narration by Al-Dhahabi does not provide a summary of this conversation)
hi: Main fath ke baad apne bhai Mujalid ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas laya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main apne bhai Mujalid ko aap ke paas laya hun taa ke aap us se hijrat par bay'at lein." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ahl-e-hijrat apni hijrat ka (ajr) le gaye." Maine kaha: "To phir aap us se kis cheez par bay'at lenge, ya Rasulullah?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Main us se Islam, imaan aur jihad par bay'at loonga." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Amr bin Abasa bin Amer bin Khalid bin Ghadirah bin Attab bin Amr bin Imru al-Qais. His mother is Ramlah bint al-Waqi'ah from the Bani Hizam tribe. He is the brother of Abu Dhar al-Ghifari through his mother. He is also known as Abu Yahya.
hi: Amr bin Abasah bin Amir bin Khalid bin Ghadirah bin Attab bin Imri' Al-Qays (RA). Unki walida Ramlah bint Al-Waqi'ah thin, jo Bani Hizam se thin. Woh Abu Dharr Al-Ghifari (RA) ke maan-shareek bhai the, Sham ke bashindon mein se the, aur unki kunyat Abu Yahya thi.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in prayer facing a camel which had been taken in booty, and when he had given the salutation, he took a hair from the camel's side and said: I have no right as much as this of your booty, but only to the fifth. and the fifth is returned to you. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2755)
hi: Maine Amr bin Abasah (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein maal-e-ghanimat ke ek oont ki taraf (sutra banakar) namaz padhayi. Jab salam pheira to aap ne oont ke pehlu se ek baal liya aur farmaya: "Is ghanimat mein se mere liye is jaisi cheez bhi halal nahi, siwa khums ke, aur khums tum par lauta diya jaata hai."

e: [AI] "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when he was still an ordinary person. I asked him, 'Who are you?' He replied, 'I am a prophet.' I asked, 'What is a prophet?' He replied, 'I am the Messenger of Allah.' I asked him, 'Did Allah send you?' He replied, 'Yes.' I asked, 'Why did Allah send you?' He replied, 'To worship Allah alone, break the idols, and maintain family ties.' I said, 'Indeed, Allah has sent you. So who follows you in this?' He replied, 'A free man and a slave,' meaning Abu Bakr and Bilal. Then 'Amr ibn Abasa said, 'I saw myself as one-fourth of Islam, so I embraced Islam.' I then asked the Prophet, 'Can I follow you, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied, 'No, but go back to your people. When I make my appearance, come to me.'"
hi: Amr bin Abasah (RA) ne kaha: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya jab aap pehli baar mab'oos hue the, aur us din aap chhupe hue the. Maine kaha: 'Aap kaun hain?' Aap ne farmaya: 'Main nabi hun.' Maine kaha: 'Nabi kya hota hai?' Farmaya: 'Allah ka Rasool.' Maine kaha: 'Kya Allah ne aap ko bheja hai?' Farmaya: 'Haan.' Maine kaha: 'Aap ko kis cheez ke saath bheja hai?' Farmaya: 'Is ke saath ke Allah ki ibadat ki jaye, but toode jayen aur rishte jode jayen.' Maine kaha: 'Kya khoob cheez ke saath aap ko bheja! To is par aap ke saath kaun hai?' Farmaya: 'Ek azaad aur ek ghulam,' yaani Abu Bakr (RA) aur Bilal (RA)." Phir Amr bin Abasah (RA) kaha karte: "Maine apne aap ko dekha ke main Islam ka chauthai (hissa) hun. Phir main Islam laya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Kya main aap ke saath rahun?' Aap ne farmaya: 'Nahi, balki apni qaum ki zameen par chale jao, phir jab tum ghalib ho jao to mere paas aa jana.'"

e: [AI] "And it is said that Aba Abdullah died in the province of Bishr ibn Marwan."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...aur kaha jaata hai Abu Abdullah; woh Bishr bin Marwan ki wilayat mein faut hue."

e: [AI] I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I heard him saying, "The affairs of this nation will remain apparent until twelve caliphs rise." Then he said something that I couldn't understand, and my father was closer to him than me, so I asked him, "What did he say?" He replied, "All of them will be from Quraysh." Jabir ibn Samurah also narrated another hadith from his father.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas tha, to maine aap ko farmate suna: "Is ummat ka maamla ghalib rahega yahan tak ke bara (12) khalifa ho jayen." Phir aap ne ek kalima kaha jo mujhse makhfi reh gaya. Mere walid mujhse zyada aap ke qareeb baithe the, maine unse poocha: "Aap ne kya farmaya?" Unhone kaha: "Farmaya: 'Un sab ka Quraysh se hona.'" Aur Jabir bin Samurah (RA) ne apne walid se ek aur hadees riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "We are people of the desert and nomadic life, so can we perform ablution with the meat and milk of sheep?" He said, "No."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se poocha aur kaha: "Hum dehat aur maweshi wale log hain, kya hum bakri ke gosht aur uske doodh se wudu karein?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Nahi."

e: [AI] "Abu Juhaifa died and Wahb bin Abdullah al-Suwayi was appointed as the governor of Bashir bin Marwan."
hi: Abu Juhayfah Wahb bin Abdullah As-Suwa'i (RA) Bishr bin Marwan ki wilayat mein faut hue.

e: [AI] I was with my uncle in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ  and he said, "The affair of my Ummah (nation) will continue to be righteous as long as there are twelve caliphs." Then he said a word and lowered his voice with it. So, I asked my uncle, who was in front of me, what did he say, O uncle? He said, "He said, O my son, 'All of them will be from Quraysh.'"
hi: Main apne chacha ke saath Nabi (SAW) ke paas tha, to aap ne farmaya: "Meri ummat ka maamla nek rahega yahan tak ke bara (12) khalifa guzar jayen." Phir aap ne ek kalima kaha jis mein apni awaaz past kar li. Maine apne chacha se, jo mere aage the, poocha: "Ae chacha! Aap ne kya farmaya?" Unhone kaha: "Ae mere bete! Aap ne farmaya: 'Un sab ka Quraysh se hona.'"

e: [AI] "Uthman ibn Abi al-As ibn Kathir ibn Dahman ibn Abdullah ibn Hammam ibn Aban ibn Yasar ibn Malik, known as Abu Abdullah, died in the year fifty."
hi: Uthman bin Abi Al-As bin Kathir bin Dahman bin Abdullah bin Hammam bin Aban bin Yasar bin Malik (RA), jinki kunyat Abu Abdullah thi, 50 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: The Messenger of Allah commanded him to build the mosque of Ta'if in the place where the Taghuts used to be. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 743)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke Ta'if ki masjid wahan banayen jahan unka taghut (but) tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] "Amir ibn Wathilah ibn Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Jahsh ibn Hayyan ibn Saad ibn Laith was born in the year of the Battle of Uhud and lived for 80 years during the lifetime of the Prophet ﷺ . He settled in Kufa for a while and then resided in Mecca until his death. He was the last companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to pass away. He died in the year 202 AH."

The quotation is incomplete and there is no mention of why Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Amir bin Wathilah bin Abdullah bin Amr bin Jahsh bin Hayyan bin Sa'd bin Layth (RA), Uhud ke saal paida hue aur Nabi (SAW) ki zindagi ke aath saal paye. Woh Kufa mein utre, phir Makkah mein muqeem rahe yahan tak ke faut hue, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke Sahaba mein sabse aakhir mein faut hone wale the. Woh 102 Hijri mein faut hue. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu At-Tufail said, 'I lived for eight years of Prophet Muhammad's life ﷺ , and I was born during the year of Uhud.' Adh-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary."
hi: Abu At-Tufayl (RA) ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ki zindagi ke aath saal paye aur main Uhud ke saal paida hua." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Al-Tufail Amer ibn Wathilah died in the year one hundred.
hi: Abu At-Tufayl Amir bin Wathilah (RA) 100 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] He informed him, and he said: "I was a boy carrying the organs of a camel, and I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ divided meat with a knife, then a woman came to him and he spread his cloak for her." So I asked, "Who is this?" They said, "His mother who breastfed him." The explanation is omitted by Al-Dhahabi.
hi: Unhone bataya, kaha: "Main ek ladka tha jo oont ka ek hissa utha raha tha, to maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ji'ranah mein gosht taqseem karte dekha. Ek aurat aap ke paas aayi to aap ne uske liye apni chaadar bichha di. Maine poocha: 'Yeh kaun hain?' Logon ne kaha: 'Aap ki woh walida jinhone aap ko doodh pilaya.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Muhammad bin Umar was Suraqah bin Malik's resident in Qudaydah. He died in the year twenty-four.
hi: Muhammad bin Umar (ne bayan kiya): Suraqah bin Malik (RA) Qudayd mein rehte the aur 24 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "O Surāqah, shall I inform you about the people of Paradise and the people of Hell?" So I said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "As for the people of Hell, every arrogant, tyrannical person will be among them. And as for the people of Paradise, they are the weak and oppressed. " Adh-Dhahabi is silent about this in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Ae Suraqah! Kya main tumhein ahl-e-Jannat aur ahl-e-Jahannam ke baare mein na bataun?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor, ya Rasulullah!" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ahl-e-Jahannam to har ja'zari (sakht-gir, bad-mizaj), jawwaz (motaa, akad kar chalne wala), mustakbir (takabbur karne wala) hai, aur ahl-e-Jannat kamzor aur dabaye hue log hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, delivered a sermon in Al-Bat'ha and said, "I entered Umrah in Hajj until the Day of Judgment." Suraaqah ibn Malik is the brother of Ka'b ibn Malik, whom Al-Dhahabi did not mention in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne humein Batha mein khutba diya aur farmaya: "Umrah Hajj mein qayamat ke din tak ke liye daakhil ho gaya." (Hadees mein hai ke) Suraqah bin Malik (RA), Ka'b bin Malik (RA) ke bhai hain. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about a stray animal that comes to its watering hole; does he receive a reward if he fulfills its hunger? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'In every moist liver, there is a reward.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se us bhatke hue jaanwar ke baare mein poocha jo aap ke hauz par aata hai, ke agar main use sair kar dun to kya mujhe ajr milega? Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har garm jigar (zinda jaandar) mein ajr hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'There is a reward in every act of goodness.'"
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Har garm jigar (zinda jaandar) mein ajr hai."

e: [AI] The name of Azwar is Darar bin Al-Azwar Al-Malik bin Aws bin Khuzaymah bin Rabee'ah bin Malik bin Tha'alabah bin Doudan bin Usayd bin Khuzaymah bin Mudrikah bin Ilyas bin Mudar. He resided in Kufa and passed away there.
hi: Dirar bin Al-Azwar (RA); Al-Azwar ka naam Malik bin Aws bin Khuzaymah bin Rabi'ah bin Malik bin Tha'labah bin Dudan bin Usayd bin Khuzaymah bin Mudrikah bin Ilyas bin Mudar tha. Woh Kufa mein rahe aur wahin faut hue.

e:
[AI] I came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said to him, "Extend your hand so that I may pledge allegiance to you on Islam." So I pledged allegiance to him. Then I recited:

I have abandoned carousing, the playing of the qayn (a musical instrument), and wine-drinking as a religious observance
I also abandoned incantations and divination, and scribing in ambergris
And I bear the burden of fighting for the sake of Muslims
O Lord, may my loyalty not be disappointed for I have pledged the allegiance of my family and wealth out of devotion

The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Your allegiance has not been in vain, O Dhirar."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Apna haath badhaiye, main Islam par aap se bay'at karta hun." Maine bay'at ki, phir kaha [Bahr Al-Mutaqarib]: "Maine teeron ka qur'a (jua), ganewaliyon ka saaz aur sharab chhod di, aur (Allah ke samne) girgira kar dua ki; aur Al-Muhabbar ko ghamr (bhid-bhad) mein daudana, aur Musalmanon par hamla karna (chhod diya). To ae mere rab! Meri bay'at mein mujhe ghabn (nuqsan) na ho, halanke maine apne ahl aur maal ko be-qadri se bech diya." To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Dirar! Tumhari bay'at mein ghabn nahi hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by me while I was milking and said, "Leave the one who calls for milk." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas se guzre jabke main doodh dooh raha tha, to farmaya: "Doodh ko bulane wale (daa'i al-laban, yaani thanon mein chhode jaane wale thode se doodh) ko chhod do." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Al-Nashajee's father Ma'bad bin Qais bin Ka'b bin Fahd bin Munqidh bin Al-Harith bin Tha'labah bin Doudan bin Asad bin Khuzaymah settled in Kufa and later moved to Al-Jazeera, where he passed away."
hi: Wabisah bin Ma'bad bin Qays bin Ka'b bin Fahd bin Munqidh bin Al-Harith bin Tha'labah bin Dudan bin Asad bin Khuzaymah (RA) Kufa mein utre, phir Jazirah muntaqil ho gaye aur wahin faut hue.

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "Do not use the backs of animals as pulpits, and the worst of these animals is the mule." This is a weak hadith.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jaanwaron ki peethon ko mimbar (khutbe ki jagah) na banao, aur in jaanwaron mein sabse bura khachchar hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Yeh hadees nihayat kamzor (waahi) hai."

e: [AI] "Khuraim bin Fatik bin L'Akram bin Shaddad bin Amr Al-Asadi" translates to "Khuraim, son of Fatik, son of L'Akram, son of Shaddad, son of Amr Al-Asadi."
hi: Khuraym bin Fatik bin Al-Akhram bin Shaddad bin Amr Al-Asadi (RA).

e:
[AI] I went out with camels to graze them, and lightning struck one of them and paralyzed it. I propped it up and leaned on the arm of another camel. This incident happened during the Prophet's ﷺ  time. Then I said, "I seek refuge in the greatness of this valley." He said, "That is how they used to do in the days of ignorance (before the advent of Islam). But then, a caller shouted and said, 'The sea, the storm!' Woe to you, seek refuge in Allah, the Possessor of Majesty, the One who has revealed the Haram (sanctified) and the Halal (permissible), and the One who has Oneness. Do not pay attention to what is terrifying, when they mention Allah on the vast distances, in the plains, the mountains, and in narrow winding valleys. The true guardian in travails is piety and righteous actions."
I said, "O caller, by what is diverting and can be seen as correct according to you, or misleading?"
He said, "This is the Messenger of Allah, the One who possesses goods. He has brought Yasin and Ha-Mim verses in chapters and verses that are prohibited and lawful. He orders fasting and prayer and forbids people from being negligent. There were evil deeds in the days that passed."
I said, "Who are you, may Allah have mercy on you?"
He said, "I am Malik ibn Malik. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me from the land of the people of Najd."
I said, "If I had someone to take care of my camels, I would have come to see him to believe and have faith in him."
He said, "I will take care of them until I bring them safely to your family, if Allah wills."
So I took one camel from the herd and went to Madinah. I arrived when people were praying on Friday, so I said, "They are performing their prayers, then I will enter. I am leaving now, my camel is thirsty." Abu Dhar came out and said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  says 'Come in.'" So I entered. When the Prophet ﷺ  saw me, he said, "What happened to the old man who assured you to bring your camel back safely to your family? Hasn't he delivered it safely to them?" I said, "May Allah have mercy on him." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, may Allah have mercy on him." Khuraym said, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and his Islam is beautiful." The end.
hi: Khuraym (RA) ne kaha: "Main apne oonton ke saath nikla, unhein Barq Uraqah (ke maqam) par aafat pahunchi, to maine unhein bandh diya aur unmein se ek oont ki taang ka takiya bana kar leta. Yeh Nabi (SAW) ke zahoor ke fauran baad ka zamana tha. Phir maine kaha: 'Main is wadi ke azeem (sardar jinn) ki panah maangta hun.' (Jahiliyyat mein log aisa hi kiya karte the.) Achanak ek ghaibi awaaz ne mujhe pukara aur kaha [Bahr Ar-Rajaz]: 'Tera bhala ho, Allah Zul-Jalal ki panah le, jo haram aur halal nazil karne wala hai. Allah ko ek jaan, aur parwah mat kar, kyunke hoshiyar aadmi ko khaufnaak cheezon ki parwah nahi hoti jab woh meelon mein aur hamwar zameenon aur pahaadon mein Allah ka zikr karte hain. Haq ka wakeel past hone par taqwa aur nek amal ke siwa kuch nahi.' Maine kaha [Bahr Ar-Rajaz]: 'Ae pukarne wale jo kuch keh raha hai! Kya yeh woh hidayat hai jo tere paas nazar aati hai ya gumrahi?' Usne kaha: 'Yeh Allah ke Rasool hain, bhalaiyon wale, jo Yaseen aur Ha-Mim wali surahein lekar aaye, phir mufassal surahein, haram aur halal karne wali; woh roze aur namaz ka hukm dete hain aur logon ko un burai ke kaamon se rokte hain jo pehle ke dinon mein bure samjhe jaate the.' Maine kaha: 'Tum kaun ho, Allah tum par rahm kare?' Usne kaha: 'Main Malik bin Malik hun, mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne Najda walon ki zameen se bheja hai.' Maine kaha: 'Agar mere paas koi hota jo mere in oonton ke liye kaafi ho jata to main aap ke paas aakar imaan le aata.' Usne kaha: 'Main tumhare liye unke liye kaafi hun yahan tak ke inhein salamat tumhare ahl tak pahuncha dun, in sha Allah Ta'ala.' Maine unmein se ek oont ko saath liya, phir Madina aaya, aur Jumu'ah ke din logon ko is haal mein paya ke woh namaz mein the. Maine kaha: 'Woh apni namaz poori kar lein phir main andar jaunga.' Main apni sawari bithane jaa raha tha ke Abu Dharr (RA) nikle aur kaha: 'Rasulullah (SAW) tumhein farma rahe hain: andar aao.' Main andar gaya, jab aap ne mujhe dekha to farmaya: 'Us shaikh ka kya hua jisne tumhare liye zimma liya tha ke tumhare oont salamat tumhare ahl tak pahuncha dega? Woh to unhein salamat tumhare ahl tak pahuncha chuka hai.' Maine kaha: 'Allah us par rahm kare.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Haan, Allah us par rahm kare.'" Phir Khuraym (RA) ne kaha: "Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah" aur unka Islam acha ho gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Yeh sahih nahi."

e: [AI] "He came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, 'O Khuraym ibn Fatik, if it weren't for two characteristics in you, you would have been the best man.' Khuraym asked, 'What are these two characteristics, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied, 'The length of your hair and the shortening of your garment.' So Khuraym went away, cut his hair and shortened his garment."
hi: Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye to aap ne farmaya: "Ae Khuraym bin Fatik! Agar tum mein do khaslatein na hoti to tum (kamil) aadmi hote." Unhone kaha: "Woh kaunsi hain, mere maa-baap aap par qurban, ya Rasulullah?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhare baalon ki ziyadati aur tumhari lungi ka lataka hona." To Khuraym gaye, apne baal kaat liye aur apni lungi chhoti kar li. Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Iski isnad muzlim (andheri) hai."

e: [AI] "Osama bin Umayr bin Asim bin Ubaidullah bin Hunayf bin Yassar bin Najiya bin Amr bin Al-Harith bin Tabikha bin Lihyan bin Hudhayl, known as Abu Abi Al-Malih, descended in Basra."
hi: Usamah bin Umayr bin Asim bin Ubaydullah bin Hunayf bin Yasar bin Najiyah bin Amr bin Al-Harith bin Tabikhah bin Lihyan bin Hudhayl (RA), jo Abu Al-Malih ke walid hain. Woh Basra mein utre.

e: [AI] "He (the narrator) prayed the two rak'ahs of Fajr prayer with the Prophet ﷺ . Then he prayed near him. The Prophet ﷺ  prayed two light rak'ahs. He heard him saying, 'O Allah, Lord of Gabriel, Michael, and Israfil, and Muhammad ﷺ , I seek refuge in You from the Fire, three times.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ke saath fajr ki do rakaatein padhin; woh aap ke qareeb hi namaz padh rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne do halki rakaatein padhin, to unhone aap ko yeh kehte suna: "Ae Allah! Jibreel (AS), Mika'il (AS), Israfil (AS) aur Muhammad (SAW) ke rab! Main aag se teri panah maangta hun" teen baar. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Abu Ubaydah was named Abu al-Lahm (Father of Meat) because he refused to eat meat.
hi: Abu Ubaydah ne kaha: "Unka naam Aabi Al-Lahm (RA) isliye rakha gaya ke woh gosht khane se inkar karte the."

e: [AI] And he said, he said, "Muhammad ibn Umar said, 'My father Al-Lahm used to descend to the yellow area in three parts of the city, and Umair, his attendant, used to descend with him.'"
hi: Aur kaha: Muhammad bin Umar ne kaha: "Aabi Al-Lahm (RA) Madina se teen (manzil) ke faasle par Safra mein rehte the, aur Umayr, unke ghulam, unke saath rehte the."

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi narrated to us, Hatim ibn Isma'il narrated to us, Yazid ibn Abi 'Ubayd said: I heard Umair, the servant of Abu al-Lahm, saying: My master ordered me to prepare meat for him, so a poor man came to me and I fed him from it. My master struck me, so I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him about it. The Prophet ﷺ  called my master and asked him: Why did you hit him? He replied: He fed my food without my permission. The Prophet ﷺ  said: "The reward is between you both." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Humse Al-Qa'nabi ne bayan kiya, unse Hatim bin Ismail ne, unse Yazid bin Abi Ubayd ne, unhone kaha: Maine Umayr ko, jo Aabi Al-Lahm (RA) ke ghulam hain, kehte suna: "Mere aaqa ne mujhe hukm diya ke main unke liye gosht ki qudeed (sukha kar patti) banaun. Mere paas ek miskeen aaya to maine usmein se use khilaya. Mere aaqa ne mujhe maara. To main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur aap se zikr kiya. Aap ne unhein bulaya aur poocha: 'Tumne ise kyun maara?' Unhone kaha: 'Yeh mera khana mere hukm ke baghair khilata hai.' Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ajr tum dono ke darmiyan hai.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  standing by the rocks of the oil, raising his hands to seek rain.
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Ahjar Az-Zayt par baarish ki dua karte hue dekha, aap (SAW) apne dono haath uthaye hue the.

e: [AI] "Amr, son of Umaya, son of Khulaid, son of Abdullah, son of Iyas, son of Ubaid, son of Nashita, son of Kaab, son of Jaddi, son of Damarah, son of Bakr, son of Abd Manat, son of Kinana."
hi: Amr bin Umayyah bin Khuwaylid bin Abdullah bin Iyas bin Ubayd bin Nashirah bin Ka'b bin Jaddi bin Damrah bin Bakr bin Abd Manat bin Kinanah (RA).

e: [AI] He said, "O Messenger of Allah, send my mount and I will rely on it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No, tie it and rely on Allah." The chain of narration is good.
hi: Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Kya main apni sawari ko khula chhod dun aur tawakkul karun?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balki use bandho, phir tawakkul karo." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Iski sanad jayyid hai."

e: [AI] "Umayr bin Salamah bin Montab bin Talhah bin Jaddi bin Damarah."
hi: Umayr bin Salamah bin Muntab bin Talhah bin Jaddi bin Damrah (RA).

e: [AI] While we were walking with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in a restricted area of ar-Rawha, we were riding on a lame donkey. So I mentioned this to the Prophet ﷺ  and he said, "Leave it." Then, the owner of the donkey, who was a man from Bahz, came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is your opinion about this donkey?" So the Prophet ﷺ  commanded Abu Bakr to divide it among the companions. As they were passing by a deer tied under a tree with an arrow, the Prophet ﷺ  commanded a man not to take it. So the people moved on and left it.
hi: Hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath safar kar rahe the, aur aap (SAW) ehram mein the, Rawha ke ek hisse mein, ke achanak humein ek zakhmi gadha mila (jiski taang kaat di gayi thi). Maine Nabi (SAW) se iska zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya: "Ise chhod do." Phir iska woh saathi aaya jisne ise zakhmi kiya tha, jo Bahz ka ek aadmi tha, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Is gadhe ka maamla aap ke hawale hai." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Bakr (RA) ko hukm diya "ke ise safar ke saathiyon mein taqseem kar den." Phir aap aage chale, aur jab Al-Athabah mein pahunche to ek hiran ke paas se guzre jo ek darakht ke saaye mein lota hua tha aur usmein ek teer laga tha. Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko hukm diya ke ailaan kar de ke koi use na le, to log guzar gaye aur use chhod diya.

e: [AI] "Abu Al-Ja'di Ad-Damriyy, Amr ibn Bakr ibn Junadah ibn Murad ibn Ka'b ibn Damrah."
hi: Abu Al-Ja'd Ad-Damri Amr bin Bakr bin Junadah bin Murad bin Ka'b bin Damrah (RA).

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Whoever misses attending the Friday prayers for three consecutive times out of negligence, Allah will seal his heart."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Jo shakhs laaparwahi ki wajah se teen Jumu'ah chhod de, Allah uske dil par mohr laga deta hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Hasan."

e: [AI] From him, Al-Dhahabi in summarization.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...iske baare mein" Adh-Dhahabi ka Talkhees mein zikr (khamoshi ka).

e: [AI] The translation of the given text is: "It was said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that a group of horses got loose at night and they harmed some of the polytheists' children. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'They are from their fathers.' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) se kaha gaya ke ek ghudsawar dasta raat ko hamla-awar hua aur mushrikeen ki aulad bhi uski zad mein aa gayi. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh apne baap-dada mein se hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Qabatha bin Ashyam bin 'Amir bin Al-Mulawwih bin Ya'mur bin 'Awf bin Ka'b bin 'Amir bin Layth Al-Dhibabi."
hi: Qabath bin Ashyam bin Amir bin Al-Mulawwih bin Ya'mar bin Awf bin Ka'b bin Amir bin Layth Ad-Dibabi (RA).

e: [AI] I heard Abdul Malik ibn Marwan saying to al-Qabath ibn Ashyam, "O al-Qabath, are you older or the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He replied, "No, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is older than me and I am younger than him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was born in the year of the Elephant and his prophecy was revealed when he was forty years old." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine Abd Al-Malik bin Marwan ko Qabath bin Ashyam (RA) se kehte suna: "Ae Qabath! Tum bade ho ya Rasulullah (SAW)?" Unhone kaha: "Balki Rasulullah (SAW) mujhse bade hain, aur main umr mein aap se zyada hun. Rasulullah (SAW) Aam Al-Fil mein paida hue aur Fil ke chalees baras ke sar par nabuwwat paayi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] That some men from his people and others from the Arabs came to him and said, "Indeed, Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Abdul-Muttalib has emerged, calling to a religion other than our religion." So Qabith stood up and went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When he entered upon him, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Sit down, O Qabith." So Qabith became silent. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Are you the one who said, 'If the women of the Quraysh were to come out with their ability, they would turn Muhammad and his companions away?'" Qabith said, "By the One Who sent you with the truth, I did not speak those words with my tongue, my lips did not stammer with them, and I did not hear anyone say them from me. It is only something that whispered in my soul. I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, alone, without partner, and I bear witness that you are His slave and Messenger. And what you have brought is the truth."
hi: Unki qaum ke kuch log aur doosre Arabon mein se kuch log unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Abd Al-Muttalib hamare deen ke ilawa ek deen ki dawat dene nikla hai." To Qabath uthe yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye. Jab unke paas daakhil hue to aap ne farmaya: "Baith jao, ae Qabath!" Qabath khamosh ho gaye. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum hi woh ho jisne kaha tha ke agar Quraysh ki aurten apni apni jamaaton ke saath nikal aayen to woh Muhammad aur uske Sahaba ko laut dein?" Qabath ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jisne aap ko haq ke saath bheja! Meri zabaan se yeh baat nahi nikli, na mere honth hile, aur na kisi ne mujhse yeh suni; yeh to bas ek khayal tha jo mere dil mein guzra. Main gawahi deta hun ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi, woh akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, aur gawahi deta hun ke aap uske bande aur Rasool hain, aur jo kuch aap laaye hain woh haq hai."

e: [AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "The prayer of two men, where one of them leads the other, is more virtuous in the sight of Allah than the prayer of forty individuals performed individually. The prayer of four men, where one of them leads the other, is more virtuous in the sight of Allah than the prayer of eighty individuals performed individually. And the prayer of eight men, where one of them leads the other, is more virtuous in the sight of Allah the Exalted than the prayer of one hundred individuals performed individually."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do aadmiyon ki namaz, jinmein se ek doosre ki imamat kare, Allah ke nazdeek chalees (aadmiyon) ki ek ke baad ek (alag alag) padhi hui namaz se zyada paak hai. Aur chaar aadmiyon ki namaz, jinmein se ek doosron ki imamat kare, Allah ke nazdeek assi (aadmiyon) ki ek ke baad ek padhi hui namaz se zyada paak hai. Aur aath aadmiyon ki namaz, jinmein se ek doosron ki imamat kare, Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek sau (aadmiyon) ki ek ke baad ek padhi hui namaz se zyada paak hai."

e: [AI] "Umair bin Qatadah bin Saad bin Amir bin Jundu'a bin Laith al-Laythi."
hi: Umayr bin Qatadah bin Sa'd bin Amir bin Jund' bin Layth Al-Laythi (RA).

e: [AI] There was a matter in my heart that saddened me: that I had not asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it, nor had I heard anyone ask him about it. So I kept watching for an opportunity. One day I entered upon him while he was performing ablution, and I found him in two conditions I loved to find him in: free (unoccupied) and in good spirits. I said, “O Messenger of Allah, will you permit me to ask you?” He said, “Yes—ask whatever occurs to you.” I said, “O Messenger of Allah, what is faith?” He said, “Generosity and patience.” I said, “Then which of the believers is best in faith?” He said, “The one with the best character.” I said, “Then which of the Muslims is best in Islam?” He said, “The one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.” I said, “Then which jihad is best?” He lowered his head and remained silent for a long time, until I feared I had burdened him, and I wished I had not asked him—especially since I had heard him the day before say: “Indeed, the greatest of the Muslims in wrongdoing against the Muslims is the one who asks about something that was not prohibited for them, and then it is prohibited for them because of his question.” So I said, “I seek refuge in Allah from the anger of Allah and the anger of His Messenger ﷺ.” He raised his head and said, “What did you say?” I said, “Which jihad is best?” He said, “A word of justice in the presence of a tyrannical ruler.”[^1]
hi: Mere dil mein ek sawal tha jo mujhe ghamgeen kiye rakhta tha ke maine Rasulullah (SAW) se uske baare mein nahi poocha tha aur kisi ko aap se poochte bhi nahi suna tha. Main mauqe ki talash mein rehta. Ek din main aap ke paas gaya jab aap wudu kar rahe the, to maine aap ko do aisi haalaton mein paya jinmein main aap se milna pasand karta tha: aap faarigh the aur khush the. Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Kya aap mujhe poochne ki ijazat denge?" Farmaya: "Haan, jo tumhare saamne aaye poocho." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Imaan kya hai?" Farmaya: "Sakhawat (kushada-dili) aur sabr." Maine kaha: "Momineen mein imaan ke lihaz se afzal kaun hai?" Farmaya: "Un mein jis ka akhlaq sabse behtar ho." Maine kaha: "Musalmanon mein Islam ke lihaz se afzal kaun hai?" Farmaya: "Jis ki zabaan aur haath se Musalman salamat rahen." Maine kaha: "Jihad mein afzal kaunsa hai?" To aap ne sar jhuka liya aur der tak khamosh rahe, yahan tak ke mujhe khauf hua ke maine aap ko mushqat mein dala hai, aur main chahne laga ke kaash maine na poocha hota. Maine kal hi aap ko farmate suna tha: "Musalmanon mein Musalmanon ke haq mein sabse bada mujrim woh hai jisne aisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jo un par haram nahi thi, phir uske poochne ki wajah se haram kar di gayi." Maine kaha: "Main Allah ke ghazab aur uske Rasool (SAW) ke ghazab se Allah ki panah maangta hun." Aap ne sar uthaya aur farmaya: "Tumne kaise kaha?" Maine kaha: "Jihad mein afzal kaunsa hai?" Aap ne farmaya: "Zalim hukmaran ke samne adl ki baat."

e: [AI] "Shaddad son of Al-Had son of Amr son of Abdullah son of Jabir son of Numair son of Utwara son of Amer son of Laith son of Bakra and the name of Al-Had is Osama and he is known as Abu Abdullah bin Shaddad bin Al-Had transferred to Al-Kufa."
hi: Shaddad bin Al-Had bin Amr bin Abdullah bin Jabir bin Numayr bin Utwarah bin Amir bin Layth bin Bakrah (RA). Al-Had ka naam Usamah tha, aur woh Abdullah bin Shaddad bin Al-Had ke walid hain. Woh Kufa muntaqil ho gaye.

e: [AI] "And he said, 'Indeed, it is called guidance.'"
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "Aur kaha: unhein Al-Had isliye kaha gaya..."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  came out to us during one of the prayers, either noon or afternoon prayer, while carrying Al-Hasan or Al-Hussein. He went forward and placed them near his right foot, and the messenger of Allah ﷺ  prostrated for a long time. I lifted my head among the people and saw that the messenger of Allah ﷺ  was prostrating and the boy was riding on his back. So, I sat down and prostrated. When the messenger of Allah ﷺ  finished, some people said, "O messenger of Allah, you prostrated in this prayer in a way that we have never seen before, something you were commanded to do or something that was revealed to you?" He replied, "No, that was not the case. Rather, my son was riding me, so I disliked to hurry him until he fulfills his need." The narration is authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) dopahar ki do namazon mein se ek, Zuhr ya Asr, ke liye hamare paas nikle, aur aap Hasan ya Husayn (RA) ko uthaye hue the. Aap aage badhe, unhein apne daayen qadam ke paas rakha, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne ek lamba sajda kiya. Maine logon ke beech apna sar uthaya to dekha ke Rasulullah (SAW) sajde mein hain aur bachcha aap ki peeth par sawar hai. Main phir sajde mein chala gaya. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne namaz khatam ki to logon ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Aap ne apni is namaz mein ek aisa sajda kiya jo pehle nahi kiya karte the. Kya aap ko kisi cheez ka hukm hua tha ya aap par wahi aa rahi thi?" Aap ne farmaya: "Nahi, aisi koi baat nahi thi; lekin mere bete ne mujhe sawari bana liya, to mujhe napasand hua ke main use jaldi karun yahan tak ke woh apni zaroorat poori kar le." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Iski isnad jayyid hai."

e: [AI] "Al-Harith ibn al-Barssa is Harith ibn Malik ibn Qais ibn 'Uwaydh ibn Abdullah ibn Jabir ibn Abd Manaf ibn Ashja ibn 'Amir ibn Layth, and his mother is al-Barssa bint Abdullah ibn Rabiah al-Hilaliyyah. He resided in Mecca and then moved to Kufa."
hi: Al-Harith ibn Al-Barsa' (RA), yaani Al-Harith bin Malik bin Qays bin Uwayd bin Abdullah bin Jabir bin Abd Manaf bin Ashja' bin Amir bin Layth. Unki walida Al-Barsa' bint Abdullah bin Rabi'ah Al-Hilaliyyah thin. Woh Makkah mein muqeem rahe, phir Kufa mein utre.

e: [AI] "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying on the day of the conquest of Makkah, 'Makkah will never be attacked again after this year.' Sufyan said, 'I heard it from Zakariya who explained that it means it will be protected from disbelief.'" (The narration was mentioned in Al-Talkhis by Al-Dhahabi)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Fath-e-Makkah ke din farmate suna: "Is saal ke baad Makkah par kabhi hamla nahi kiya jayega." Sufyan ne kaha: "Maine ise Zakariya se bhi suna hai ke iski tafseer 'kufr (ki halat) par' hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He is Malik son of Al-Huwayrith son of Ashyam son of Zabalat son of Hashish son of Abdul Yalil son of Nashire son of Ghayrah son of Saad son of Laith son of Bakr."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke woh Malik bin Al-Huwayrith bin Ashyam bin Zubalah bin Hushaysh bin Abd Yalil bin Nashib bin Ghayrah bin Sa'd bin Layth bin Bakr (RA) hain."

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  recited this verse: "So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment, and none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers]" (Surah Al-Fajr, 26). Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his concise summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unhein yeh padhaya: {To us din koi uske azaab jaisa azaab nahi dega, aur na koi uske bandhne jaisa bandhega} (Surah Al-Fajr 25-26). Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Fadalah, son of Wahb, son of Bahrah, son of Buhayrah, son of Malik, son of Qais, son of Amir, son of Layth, his mother is the daughter of Kaysan, son of Amir Al-Utawari. This is Abu Abdullah Fadalah bin Wahb, who migrated to Basra."
hi: Fadalah bin Wahb bin Bahrah bin Buhayrah bin Malik bin Qays bin Amir bin Layth (RA). Unki walida Kaysan bin Amir Al-Utwari ki beti thin, aur unki kunyat Abu Abdullah thi. Fadalah bin Wahb (RA) Basra muntaqil ho gaye.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me and what he taught me is this: Observe the five prayers regularly. He said: I told (him): I have many works at these times; so give me a comprehensive advice which, if I follow, should be enough for me. He said: Observe the two afternoon prayers (al-asrayn). But the term al-asrayn (two afternoon prayers) was not used in our language. Hence I said: What is al-asrayn? He said: A prayer before the sunrise and a prayer before the sunset (i.e. the dawn and the afternoon prayers). (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 428)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe sikhaya, aur jo kuch sikhaya usmein yeh tha ke farmaya: "Namazon ki hifazat karo." Maine kaha: "In waqton mein mujhe kaam rehte hain, to mujhe koi aisi jaami baat bataiye ke jab main use kar lun to mere liye kaafi ho jaye." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Do 'asr' ki hifazat karo." Maine poocha: "Do asr kaunse hain?" Farmaya: "Suraj nikalne se pehle ki namaz aur suraj doobne se pehle ki namaz."

e: [AI] Mu'asabu al-Habr is the son of 'Umayr ibn 'Ubaid ibn Hashim ibn 'Abd Manaf ibn 'Abd ad-Dar ibn Qusayy. He is the reciter (of the Quran) whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent to the Ansar to recite the Quran to them in Madinah before the arrival of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He embraced Islam with him, along with many other people, and he participated in the Battle of Badr.
hi: Mus'ab Al-Habr, yaani Mus'ab bin Umayr bin Ubayd bin Hashim bin Abd Manaf bin Abd Ad-Dar bin Qusayy (RA). Woh muqri (Quran sikhane wale) hain jinhein Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ansar ki taraf bheja ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke Madina aane se pehle unhein Madina mein Quran sikhayen. Unke zariye bohot si makhlooq Islam laayi, aur woh Badr mein shareek hue.

e: [AI] "The first of the immigrants who came to us was Mus'ab ibn 'Umair."
hi: "Muhajireen mein se sabse pehle jo humare paas aaye woh Mus'ab bin Umayr (RA) the."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was sitting at Quba' with a group of people when Mus'ab ibn 'Umair came to him wearing a garment that barely covered him, and his people were poor. He greeted them and they returned his greeting. The Prophet ﷺ  praised him and spoke highly of him. Then he said, "I have seen him with his parents in Makkah, they used to honor him and treat him kindly, and there was no young man from the Quraish like him. Then he left all that seeking the pleasure of Allah and the support of His Messenger. Know that he will not come to you except like this and this until Persia and Rome are opened before you. One of you would go in the morning wearing a dress and in the evening he would be wearing something else, and he would have breakfast with you in one place and have dinner with you in another place." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, are we better today or that day?" He said, "No, you are better today than you were on that day. If only you knew what I know of this world, you would have been at peace with it." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Quba mein baithe the aur aap ke saath kuch log the. Mus'ab bin Umayr (RA) khade hue, unpar ek chaadar thi jo mushkil se unhein dhaanp rahi thi, to log sar jhuka gaye. Woh aaye, salam kiya, unhone jawab diya. Nabi (SAW) ne unke baare mein bhalai ki baat kahi aur unki tareef ki, phir farmaya: "Maine ise Makkah mein apne walidain ke paas dekha hai, woh iski izzat karte aur ise naaz-o-naim mein rakhte the, aur Quraysh ke naujawanon mein iske jaisa koi nahi tha. Phir yeh Allah ki raza aur uske Rasool ki madad ki talash mein is sab se nikal aaya. Khabardar! Tum par yun yun guzrega, yahan tak ke Faris aur Rum tumhare liye fatah ho jayenge, to tum mein se koi subah ek joda pehnega aur sham ko ek aur joda, aur tumhare saamne subah ek bada pyala (khane ka) laya jayega aur sham ko ek bada pyala." Sahaba ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Kya hum aaj behtar hain ya woh din?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Balki tum aaj us din se behtar ho. Khabardar! Agar tum dunya ke baare mein woh jaante jo main jaanta hun to tumhare nufus us se sukoon paa lete." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Salama, Abdullah ibn Abdul-Asad ibn Hilal ibn Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Makhzum ibn Yaqađa ibn Murrah ibn Ka'b ibn Lu'ay ibn Ghalib ibn Fehr ibn Malik, was one of the Muslim emigrants from Ethiopia who migrated to Madinah and participated in the Battle of Badr. Um Salama, his wife, was with him. Abu Salama passed away in the month of Shawwal, in the fourth year after the Hijra."
hi: Abu Salamah Abdullah bin Abd Al-Asad bin Hilal bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Makhzum bin Yaqazah bin Murrah bin Ka'b bin Luayy bin Ghalib bin Fihr bin Malik (RA). Woh Habshah ke muhajireen mein se the, unhone Madina ki taraf bhi hijrat ki, aur Badr mein shareek hue. Umm Salamah (RA) unke nikah mein thin. Abu Salamah (RA) Shawwal 4 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: When one of you is afflicted with a calamity, he should say: "We belong to Allah, and to Him we do return." O Allah, I expect reward from Thee from this affliction, so give me reward for it, and give me a better compensation. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3119)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko koi museebat pahunche to kahe: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Ae Allah! Main apni museebat ka ajr tujh hi se talab karta hun.'" Aur unhone poori hadees lambi zikr ki. (Baqiya hissa mukhtasar chhoda gaya hai.)

e: [AI] "Suhail, son of Baydaa, is Suhail, son of Wahb, son of Rabee'ah, son of Hilal, son of Ahayb, son of Dabbah, son of Al-Harith, son of Fehr, son of Malik, son of Nadar. His mother's name is Baydaa and her name is Daad, daughter of Sa'eed, son of Sahm."
hi: Suhayl Ibn Bayda' (RA), yaani Suhayl bin Wahb bin Rabi'ah bin Hilal bin Uhayb bin Dabbah bin Al-Harith bin Fihr bin Malik bin An-Nadr. Bayda' unki walida thin, aur unka naam Da'd bint Sa'id bin Sahm tha.

e: [AI] About Uruwah, "Regarding the naming of those who migrated to the land of Habasha, the first migration before Ja'far bin Abi Talib's departure, Suhail bin Baydha and the naming of those who witnessed the Battle of Badr from Quraysh and then from the Banu Harith bin Fihr, Suhail bin Baydha."
hi: Urwah se, un logon ke naam bataane ke silsile mein jinhone Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ke nikalne se pehle Habshah ki taraf pehli hijrat ki: Suhayl Ibn Bayda' (RA). Aur Quraysh mein se, phir Bani Al-Harith bin Fihr mein se, Badr mein shareek hone walon ke naam ke silsile mein: Suhayl Ibn Bayda' (RA).

e: "The Messenger of Allah did not ofer gthe funeral prayer for shail bin Baida anywhere but in the Masjid." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 1967)
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Suhayl Ibn Bayda' (RA) ki namaz-e-janaza sirf masjid mein hi padhi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Suhail ibn Bayda'ah, a companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , were together on a camel, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Suhail ibn Bayda'ah!" He raised his voice twice or three times, and Suhail responded to him. The people heard the voice of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so they knew that he was calling them. Those who were in front of him sat down, and those who were behind him followed him until they gathered. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever bears witness that there is no god but Allah, Allah will make Paradise obligatory for him and prohibit him from the Fire." This narration has a good chain of transmission.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ek oontni par the aur Suhayl Ibn Bayda' (RA) aap (SAW) ke peeche usi oontni par sawar the. Rasulullah (SAW) ne pukara: "Ae Suhayl Ibn Bayda'!" aur do ya teen baar awaaz buland ki, aur har baar Suhayl (RA) aap ko jawab dete rahe. Logon ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki awaaz suni to samjha ke aap unhein chahte hain; jo aap ke aage the woh baith gaye, aur jo peeche the woh aap se aa mile, yahan tak ke jab sab jama ho gaye to Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jisne gawahi di ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi, Allah use aag par haram kar dega aur uske liye Jannat wajib kar dega." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Iski sanad jayyid hai, magar ismein irsaal hai."

e: [AI] "Ayyad bin Zuhayr bin Abi Shaddad bin Rabiah bin Hilal bin Wahib bin Dabbah bin Al-Harith bin Fahir Al-Fihri witnessed the Battle of Badr and died in Sham (Syria) in the year thirty."
hi: Iyad bin Zuhayr bin Abi Shaddad bin Rabi'ah bin Hilal bin Wuhayb bin Dabbah bin Al-Harith bin Fihr Al-Fihri (RA), Badr mein shareek hue aur 30 Hijri mein Sham mein faut hue.

e: [AI] "Abdullah son of Hudhafah son of Qays son of Adi son of Sa'id son of Sahm"
hi: Abdullah bin Hudhafah bin Qays bin Adi bin Sa'id bin Sahm (RA).

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  sent Alqamah ibn Muhriz on a mission. When we reached Maghzan, a group from the army was given permission by the Prophet ﷺ , and he appointed Abdullah ibn Hudhaifah ibn Qais Al-Sahmi to lead them. He was one of the people of Badr and was known for his sense of humor. He used to imitate the Prophet's ﷺ  camel during some of his journeys to make the Prophet ﷺ  laugh. The Romans had captured him during the era of Umar ibn Al-Khattab, and they intended to force him to renounce Islam, but Allah protected and saved him from them." (Ad-Dhahabi did not mention this in the summarized version)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Alqamah bin Muharriz ko ek lashkar par bheja. Jab hum apne ghazwe ki aakhri had par pahunche to unhone lashkar ke ek hisse ko ijazat di aur un par Abdullah bin Hudhafah bin Qays As-Sahmi (RA) ko ameer banaya. Woh Badr walon mein se the aur unmein mazaq-mijaaz ki aadat thi, kyunke woh kisi safar mein Rasulullah (SAW) ki oontni ko sajate taa ke aap (SAW) ko hansayen. Rum ne unhein Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ke zamane mein qaid kar liya tha aur unse kufr ka mutalba kiya, to Allah Ta'ala ne unhein mehfooz rakha, yahan tak ke Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne unhein unse najaat di. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  instructed me to announce to the people of Mina not to fast during these days, as they are days of eating and drinking."
hi: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne hukm diya ke main Mina walon mein ailaan karun ke in dinon mein koi hargiz roza na rakhe, kyunke yeh khane peene ke din hain."

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, who is my father?" He replied, "Your father is the one who impregnates the woman, and the stone belongs to the prostitute." He said, "If you invite me to Abyssinia, I will follow you." His mother said to him, "You have insulted me." He said, "I just wanted to rest."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "Ya Rasulullah! Mera baap kaun hai?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Tumhara baap Hudhafah hai. Bachcha firash (nikah wale bistar) ka hai, aur zaani ke liye patthar hai." Unhone kaha: "Agar aap mujhe kisi habshi ki taraf bulate to main uski pairwi kar leta." Unki walida ne unse kaha: "Tumne mujhe ruswa kar diya." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe pasand tha ke main sukoon paun." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Burdah Hani ibn Niyar ibn Amr ibn Ubaid ibn Kilab ibn Dahman ibn Ghanim ibn Dhibyan ibn Humaym ibn Kahil ibn Duhl ibn Bala ibn Amr ibn al-Harith ibn al-Haf ibn Quda'ah"
hi: Abu Burdah Hani bin Niyar bin Amr bin Ubayd bin Kilab bin Dahman bin Ghanim bin Dhibyan bin Humaym bin Kahil bin Dhuhl bin Bali bin Amr bin Al-Harith bin Al-Haf bin Quda'ah (RA).

e: [AI] "From Urwah, in naming those who witnessed the Battle of Badr, Abu Burdah ibn Niyar."
hi: Urwah se, Badr mein shareek hone walon ke naam bataane ke silsile mein: Abu Burdah bin Niyar (RA).

e: [AI] I met my uncle Abu Burdah and he had a flag with him, so I asked him where he was going. He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me to a man who married his father's wife after him, to strike his neck and take his wealth." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Maine apne mamu Abu Burdah (RA) se mulaqat ki, unke saath ek parcham tha. Maine poocha: "Aap kahan ka irada rakhte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe Rasulullah (SAW) ne ek aise aadmi ki taraf bheja hai jisne apne baap ke baad uski biwi se nikah kar liya hai; main uski gardan maarunga aur uska maal le lunga." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] It is said that he is an ally of the Bani Amr ibn Awf, and it is also said that he is one of their own.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...kaha jaata hai ke woh Bani Amr bin Awf ke halif (hum-paiman) hain, aur kaha gaya hai ke woh unhi mein se hain."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, chose me and chose companions for me, and He made from among them ministers, helpers, and in-laws. Whoever insults them, the curse of Allah, the angels, and all of mankind is upon him. His deeds will not be accepted on the Day of Judgment, neither his charity nor his justice."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne mujhe chuna, aur mere liye Sahaba chune, aur unmein se mere liye wuzara, ansar aur sasuraliye banaye. To jo unhein bura kahe, us par Allah, farishton aur tamam logon ki laanat hai; qayamat ke din uska na koi sarf (nafl) qubool hoga na adl (farz)."

e: [AI] Abu Lubabah Bashir ibn Abdul-Mundhir and Harith ibn Hattab "went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and went with him to the Battle of Badr. He sent Abu Lubabah back to Madinah and shot two arrows for them along with the companions of Badr."
hi: Abu Lubabah Bashir bin Abd Al-Mundhir (RA) aur Al-Harith bin Hatib (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf nikle, aur aap ke saath Badr ki taraf rawana hue, to aap (SAW) ne unhein wapas bhej diya aur Abu Lubabah (RA) ko Madina par ameer banaya, aur Badr walon ke saath unke liye bhi do hisse rakhe.

e: [AI] When Allah accepted the repentance of Abu Lubabah, Abu Lubabah said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have abandoned my people's land where I committed a sin, and I have pledged to give all my wealth as charity for the sake of Allah, the Almighty, and His Messenger." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Abu Lubabah, a third of your wealth will suffice." Abu Lubabah then donated a third of his wealth. (Note: The statement by Al-Dhahabi was not included in the given text.)
hi: Jab Allah ne Abu Lubabah (RA) ki tauba qubool farmayi, to Abu Lubabah (RA) ne kaha: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Main apni qaum ka woh ghar chhod dunga jismein mujhse gunah hua, aur apne saare maal se Allah Ta'ala aur uske Rasool (SAW) ke liye sadqa kar ke alag ho jaunga.' To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Abu Lubabah! Tumhare liye teesra hissa kaafi hai.' Maine teesre hisse ka sadqa kar diya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And the father of Habba, Thabit bin Nu'man bin Umayyah bin Tha'alabah bin Amr bin Awf bin Malik bin Al-Aws, and he was martyred on the day of Uhud."
hi: Aur Abu Habbah Thabit bin An-Nu'man bin Umayyah bin Tha'labah bin Amr bin Awf bin Malik bin Al-Aws (RA), Uhud ke din shaheed hue.

e: [AI] "There is no harm in what the man threw in the talisman of stones," said Abdullah bin Amr bin Uthman. I mentioned that to Abdullah bin Umar, and he said, "Abu Hubbah (the man) spoke the truth, and Abu Hubbah was from the Badriyyin (those who participated in the Battle of Badr)." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke jamarat par jo kankariyan aadmi phenke usmein koi harj nahi." Abdullah bin Amr bin Uthman ne kaha: Maine yeh Abdullah bin Umar (RA) se zikr kiya to unhone kaha: "Abu Habbah ne sach kaha, aur Abu Habbah Badri the." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I ascended until I reached a level where I heard the scratching of the pens."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Mujhe uroj karaya gaya (Mi'raj) yahan tak ke main ek hamwar maqam se guzra jahan main qalamon ke chalne ki sarsarahat sunta tha."

e: [AI] "The demand (or request) of al-Mutalib bin Abi Wada'ah bin Sabirah bin Sa'id bin Sa'd bin Sahm bin Amr bin Husays bin Ka'b bin Lu'ay bin Ghalib bin Fihr bin Malik, who embraced Islam on the day of victory."
hi: Al-Muttalib bin Abi Wada'ah bin Sabirah bin Sa'id bin Sa'd bin Sahm bin Amr bin Husays bin Ka'b bin Luayy bin Ghalib bin Fihr bin Malik (RA), jo Fath-e-Makkah ke din Islam laaye.

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prostrating to the star. People prostrated with him. Al-Muttalib said, ‘I did not prostrate with them that day, and I was still a polytheist at that time.’ Al-Muttalib then said, ‘So I will never refrain from prostrating to it.’ Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko Surah An-Najm mein sajda karte dekha, kaha: to logon ne bhi aap ke saath sajda kiya. Al-Muttalib ne kaha: "Maine us din unke saath sajda nahi kiya, kyunke woh us din mushrik the." Al-Muttalib ne kaha: "Ab main is mein sajda karna kabhi nahi chhodunga." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abdullah son of Al-Harith son of Jaz' son of Ma'di Karib son of 'Amr son of 'Usaim son of 'Amr son of 'Uwayj son of 'Amr son of Zubayd died in the year eighty-six."
hi: Abdullah bin Al-Harith bin Juz' bin Ma'di Karib bin Amr bin Usaym bin Amr bin Uwayj bin Amr bin Zubayd (RA) 86 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] "I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, 'After me, there will be rulers of turmoil at their gates, similar to the blessings of camels. They will not give anything to anyone without taking from their religion like it.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent on this citation, and Al-Dhahabi said in Al-Mizan, 'Al-Hakim asked him about Malik's fabricated traditions.'"
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Mere baad fitnon ke sultan honge, unke darwazon par (logon ki bheed) oontnon ke baadhon ki tarah hogi. Woh kisi ko kuch nahi denge magar uske deen se utna hi le lenge." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya. Aur Adh-Dhahabi ne Al-Mizan mein kaha: "Hakim ne kaha: iske paas Malik se mawdu' (gadhi hui) ahadees hain."

e: [AI] "That the name of the son of Umm Maktoom is Amr bin Qais."
hi: "Ibn Umm Maktum ka naam Amr bin Qays hai."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, circled around during his pilgrimage on his young she-camel, while Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum held onto its reins.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne Hajj mein apni oontni Al-Jad'a par tawaf kiya, aur Abdullah Ibn Umm Maktum (RA) uski nakel pakde hue rajaz ke ashaar padh rahe the.

e: [AI] "Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, his mother is Umm Maktum and her name is Atikah bint Abdullah ibn Ankathah ibn Amr ibn Makhzum. And he is Amr ibn Qais ibn Zaidah ibn Al-Asamm ibn Harim ibn Rawahah ibn Abd Ma'is ibn Amr ibn Lu'ayy. The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'If you have come to me with these two names altogether, then I have come to him.'"
hi: Abdullah Ibn Umm Maktum (RA), unki walida Umm Maktum hain jinka naam Atikah bint Abdullah bin Ankathah bin Amir bin Makhzum hai. Aur woh Amr bin Qays bin Zaidah bin Al-Asamm bin Harim bin Rawahah bin Abd bin Ma'is bin Amir bin Luayy (RA) hain. Baat wahi hai jo Mus'ab ne kahi, aur maine unke liye dono naam jama kar diye hain.

e: [AI] "The first of those who migrated and joined us was Mus'ab ibn 'Umayr, and after him, 'Amr ibn Umm Maktum, the blind one, came to us."
hi: "Muhajireen mein se sabse pehle jo (Madina) aaye woh Mus'ab bin Umayr (RA) the, phir unke baad hamare paas Amr Ibn Umm Maktum (RA) aaye jo nabeena the."

e: I entered upon ʿĀʾishah and there was a blind man with her and she was cutting up utruj (a ctirus fruit) for him and he was eating it with honey. She then said, "This ˹honor for Umm Maktūm˺ has remained since on whose behalf Allah ﷻ admonished his Prophet ﷺ " The Mother of the Believers then desired to ˹mention the reason for˺ revelation of Sūrat ʿAbasa wa-Tawallá.
hi: Main Aishah (RA) ke paas gaya, unke paas Ibn Umm Maktum (RA) the aur woh unke liye utruj (ek khatta phal) kaat rahi thin ke woh use shahad ke saath khayen. To unhone farmaya: "Aale Muhammad (SAW) ki taraf se unke liye yeh (izzat) hamesha rahi hai, us waqt se jab Allah ne unke baare mein apne Nabi (SAW) ko itab farmaya." Ummul Mu'mineen ka iraada Surah 'Abasa wa tawalla ke nuzool se tha.

e: I entered upon ʿĀʾishah and there was a blind man with her and she was cutting up utruj (a ctirus fruit) and serving it to him with honey. Then I asked her, "Who is this man, O Mother of the Believers?" She then said, "This is Umm Maktūm, the one on whose behalf Allah ﷻ admonished his Prophet ﷺ " She said ˹that once˺, "Umm Maktūm came to the Prophet ﷺ and with him were ʿUtbah and Shaybah. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ faced them ˹despite Umm Maktūm.˺ Then ˹the āyāt˺ were revealed: "He frowned and turned away; When the blind man came to him." (ʿAbasa 80:1-2) ˹who was˺ Umm Maktūm.
hi: Main Aishah (RA) ke paas gaya, unke paas ek nabeena aadmi the aur woh unke liye utruj kaat kar shahad ke saath unhein khila rahi thin. Maine poocha: "Ae Ummul Mu'mineen! Yeh kaun hain?" Unhone farmaya: "Yeh Ibn Umm Maktum (RA) hain, jinke baare mein Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko itab farmaya." Unhone kaha: "Ibn Umm Maktum (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur aap ke paas Utbah aur Shaybah the. To Rasulullah (SAW) un dono ki taraf mutawajjih rahe, phir yeh nazil hua: 'Us ne tursh roo kiya aur munh pher liya, is par ke uske paas nabeena aaya' (Surah 'Abasa 1-2), yaani Ibn Umm Maktum (RA)."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  went out one morning and said, "The Fire has been kindled for the people of the Fire, and trials have come like patches of dark night. If you only knew what I know, you would laugh a little and weep a lot."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ek subah bahar tashreef laye aur farmaya: "Jahannam walon ke liye aag bhadkayi gayi, aur fitne andheri raat ke tukdon ki tarah aa gaye. Agar tum woh jaan lete jo main jaanta hun to tum thoda hanste aur bohot rote."

e: [AI] I came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am an elderly blind man with a spacious house, and I do not have anyone to guide me. Between me and the mosque, there are trees and rivers. Do I have an excuse to pray in my house?" He asked, "Do you hear the Adhan (call to prayer)?" I replied, "Yes." He said, "Then respond to it."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main boodha, nabeena aadmi hun, mera ghar door hai, mere paas koi rehnuma nahi jo mere kaam aaye, aur mere aur masjid ke beech darakht aur nehren hain. Kya mere liye gunjaish hai ke main apne ghar mein namaz padh lun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya tum azaan sunte ho?" Maine kaha: "Ji haan." Farmaya: "To (masjid) aao."

e: [AI] From Abu Razeen and as for the story of Shayban.
hi: Abu Razin se, aur jahan tak Shayban ki hadees ka talluq hai (to woh yeh hai).

e: [AI] From Abu Razin, as for the narration of Hammad ibn Salamah.
hi: Abu Razin se, aur jahan tak Hammad bin Salamah ki hadees ka talluq hai (to woh yeh hai).

e: [AI] "From Abu Razin"
hi: Abu Razin se.

e: [AI] "The Hadrami, known as Abul-Ala, his name is Abdullah bin Abbad bin Akbar bin Rabia bin Malik bin Areef bin Malik bin Al-Khazraj bin Iyad bin Sadaf bin Hadramout bin Kindah. Al-Ala died during his return from Bahrain in the year twenty-one."
hi: Al-Hadrami Abu Al-Ala, unka naam Abdullah bin Abbad bin Akbar bin Rabi'ah bin Malik bin Areef bin Malik bin Al-Khazraj bin Iyad bin As-Sadaf bin Hadramawt bin Kindah (RA) hai. Al-Ala (RA) Bahrain se wapsi par 21 Hijri mein faut hue.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me among two groups, one of them being Muslim and the other being polytheists, to collect the tenth from the Muslim and the jizyah from the polytheists." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe do shareek logon ke baare mein bheja, jinmein se ek Muslim ho aur doosra mushrik, ke main Muslim se ushr (dasva hissa) loon aur mushrik se jizyah." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "He wrote to the Prophet ﷺ and began with himself," Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: "Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko khat likha aur apne naam se shuru kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.
