e: [AI] "And Abdullah ibn Jash ibn Rabab ibn Ya'mar ibn Sabirah ibn Kabir ibn Ghanm ibn Dudan ibn Asad ibn Khuzaymah, and his mother Ummayma bint Abd al-Muttalib, the paternal aunt of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: Aur Abdullah bin Jahsh bin Ri'ab bin Ya'mar bin Sabirah bin Kabir bin Ghanm bin Dudan bin Asad bin Khuzaymah (RA), aur unki walida Umaymah bint Abd Al-Muttalib thin jo Rasulullah (SAW) ki phuphi hain.

e: [AI] "It is an ally of Banu Umayyah ibn Abd Shams."
hi: "Woh Bani Umayyah bin Abd Shams ke halif (hum-paiman) hain."

e: [AI] Regarding Uroah's narration "In naming those who were martyred on the Battle of Uhud with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from the Bani Umayyah, there was Abdullah bin Jahsh, an ally of theirs, and he was from the Bani Asad bin Khuzaymah."
hi: Urwah se, Uhud ke din Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath shaheed hone walon ke naam bataane ke silsile mein: Bani Umayyah mein se Abdullah bin Jahsh (RA), jo unke halif the aur Bani Asad bin Khuzaymah mein se the.

e:
[AI] "Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Jash bin Rabbab bin Ya'amir bin Sabirah bin Kabir bin Ghanm bin Doudan bin Asad bin Khuzaymah bin Mudrikah bin Ilyas bin Mudar Halif bin Umayyah bin Ummu Abihi Umaymah bint Abdul-Muttalib Amatul Rasulullah ﷺ  wa'amatuhu Zainab bint Jash zawjunnabiyyi ﷺ ."

Translation: "Muhammad, the son of Abdullah, the son of Jash, the son of Rabbab, the son of Ya'amir, the son of Sabirah, the son of Kabir, the son of Ghanm, the son of Doudan, the son of Asad, the son of Khuzaymah, the son of Mudrikah, the son of Ilyas, the son of Mudar, the relative of Banu Umayyah, and his grandmother is Ummu Abihi Umaymah bint Abd al-Muttalib who is the aunt of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and his adopted mother is Zainab bint Jash, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ ."
hi: Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Jahsh bin Ri'ab bin Ya'mar bin Sabirah bin Kabir bin Ghanm bin Dudan bin Asad bin Khuzaymah bin Mudrikah bin Ilyas bin Mudar (RA), Bani Umayyah ke halif. Unke walid ki walida Umaymah bint Abd Al-Muttalib thin jo Rasulullah (SAW) ki phuphi hain, aur unki phuphi Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) thin jo Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah hain.

e: [AI] I was with the Prophet ﷺ  when he passed by Ma'mar who was sitting near his house in the market, and his thighs were exposed. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Cover your thighs, O Ma'mar, for indeed the thighs are considered awrah (private parts)." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath tha, aap Ma'mar ke paas se guzre jo bazaar mein apne ghar ke paas baithe the aur unki dono raanen khuli thin. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Ma'mar! Apni raan dhaanp lo, kyunke raan satr (parde ki cheez) hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And Yazid bin Abdullah bin Saad bin Aswad bin Thumama bin Yaqthan bin Al-Harith bin Amr bin Muawiyah bin Al-Harith was an ally of the Banu Mu'ayqib, and the Prophet ﷺ  ordered him to lead the battle of Yamama."
hi: Aur Yazid bin Abdullah bin Sa'd bin Al-Aswad bin Thumamah bin Yaqzan bin Al-Harith bin Amr bin Mu'awiyah bin Al-Harith (RA), Bani Mu'ayqib ke halif the, aur Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Yamama par ameer banaya tha.

e: [AI] He heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying: "None of you should take the belongings of his companion jokingly or seriously. And if one of you finds the stick of his companion, let him return it to him." And his son, Al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, met the Prophet ﷺ  and narrated this hadith from him. Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Tum mein se koi apne saathi ka saaman na le, na mazaq mein na sanjeedgi se. Aur jab tum mein se koi apne saathi ki laathi paaye to use uski taraf lauta de." Aur unke bete As-Sa'ib bin Yazid ne Nabi (SAW) ka zamana paaya aur aap se ek hadees riwayat ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "My father took me for Hajj with the Messenger of Allah during the Farewell Hajj, and I was seven years old." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 925)
hi: "Mere walid ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath Hajjatul Wida mein Hajj kiya aur main saat saal ka tha."

e: [AI] "And in it, died Al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, meaning in the year one hundred and ninety-one."
hi: "Aur isi saal As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (RA) faut hue", yaani 91 Hijri mein.

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  bringing out Abdullah ibn Khatal from among the curtains of the Kaaba and he killed him patiently. Then he said, 'No one from the Quraysh should be killed after this except with patience.'"
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha ke aap ne Abdullah bin Khatal ko Ka'bah ke parde ke beech se nikaala aur use bandhe hue (sabran) qatl kiya, phir farmaya: "Is ke baad Quraysh ka koi aadmi bandh kar qatl nahi kiya jayega."

e: [AI] "Abu Hashim, son of Utbah ibn Rabia ibn Abd Shams ibn Abd Manaf, his mother was Khunas bint Malik ibn al-Mudarrib ibn Hujr ibn Abd ibn Ma'is ibn Aamir ibn Luay, and he was blind in one eye. He was killed in the battle of Yarmouk during the time of Muawiya."
hi: Abu Hashim bin Utbah bin Rabi'ah bin Abd Shams bin Abd Manaf (RA), unki walida Khunas bint Malik bin Al-Mudarrib bin Hujr bin Abd bin Ma'is bin Amir bin Luayy thin. Woh kaane the, Yarmouk ke din unki aankh phod di gayi, aur Abu Hashim (RA) Mu'awiyah (RA) ke zamane mein faut hue.

e: [AI] Abu Huraira arrived in Damascus and stayed with Abu Kulthum Al-Saddusi. We visited him and discussed the middle prayer. We disagreed about it, so Abu Huraira said, "You disagreed about it just as we did when we were in Quba, near the house of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . And there was a righteous man with us, Abu Hashim ibn Utba ibn Rabi'ah. He stood up and went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and had a discussion with him. Then he came back to us and informed us that it is the Asr prayer."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) Dimashq aaye aur Abu Kulthum As-Saduusi ke yahan thehre. Hum unke paas gaye aur Salat Al-Wusta ka zikr kiya, humne is mein ikhtilaf kiya. Abu Hurairah (RA) ne farmaya: "Tum ne is mein ikhtilaf kiya jaise humne kiya tha jab hum Quba mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke ghar ke paas the, aur hum mein nek aadmi Abu Hashim bin Utbah bin Rabi'ah (RA) the. Woh uthe aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaye, woh aap se bebaak the, phir hamare paas aaye aur humein khabar di ke woh Asr hai."

e: [AI] "O uncle, what makes you cry? Is it pain or sadness over this worldly life?" He replied, "No, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  made a covenant with me that I have not fulfilled. He said to me, 'O Abu Hashim, wealth will come to you from people.'" Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "Ae mamu! Aap kyun rote hain? Dard hai ya dunya ka gham?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balki Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse ek ahd liya tha jis par main amal na kar saka. Aap (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: 'Ae Abu Hashim! Tumhe woh maal milega jo kuch aur qaumon ko diya jayega.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Al-'As ibn Al-Rabiah was the husband of the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and the cousin of her mother, Hala bint Khwailid, the sister of Khadijah. The name of Abu Al-'As's father is Muhasham, and he was known as Jirw Al-Bat'ha. Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was born to Abu Al-'As and his wife, Ali ibn Abi Al-'As and Ummama, the daughter of Abu Al-'As. Abu Al-'As passed away in the eleventh year of Abu Bakr's caliphate."
hi: Abu Al-As bin Ar-Rabi' (RA), Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi ke shauhar aur unki khala ke bete. Unki walida Hala bint Khuwaylid thin jo Khadijah (RA) ki behen hain. Abu Al-As ka naam Muhashshim tha aur unhein "Jirw Al-Bat'ha" (Bat'ha ka pilla) laqab diya jata tha. Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) se Abu Al-As ke Ali bin Abi Al-As aur Umamah bint Abi Al-As paida hue. Abu Al-As (RA) 11 Hijri mein Abu Bakr (RA) ki khilafat ke daur mein faut hue.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) annulled Zainab's marriage to Abi Al-As by the first marriage, and nothing else was mentioned. This is a valid chain of narration according to the condition of Muslim. It has been narrated that the Prophet (pbuh) returned her to him with a new marriage, which is incorrect."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zaynab (RA) ko Abu Al-As ki taraf pehle nikah par hi lauta diya, aur koi nayi baat nahi ki." Yeh isnad Muslim ki shart par sahih hai. Aur yeh bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein naye nikah ke saath lautaya, (magar yeh riwayat) sahih nahi.

e: [AI] Zainab, the daughter of the Prophet ﷺ, embraced Islam before her husband Abu Al-As by a year. Then, Abu Al-As also embraced Islam. The Prophet ﷺ sent her back with a new marriage contract. This statement is false, and perhaps he meant that she migrated before him by a year.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) apne shauhar Abu Al-As se ek saal pehle Islam laayin, phir Abu Al-As Islam laaye, "to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein naye nikah ke saath lauta diya." Yeh baatil hai, aur shayad raawi ka matlab yeh tha ke unhone unse ek saal pehle hijrat ki.

e: [AI] Abu Musa, "A noble young man from the Quraysh tribe has come to you, respected by mothers, aunts, and female relatives. He speaks about the wealth among you, saying such and such, or that he possesses many virtues. He was the one who conquered Khorasan and made Nishapur forbidden for pilgrimage, out of gratitude to Allah the Almighty. He also performed the ritual of offering water (siqaya) in Arafah."
hi: Abu Musa ne kaha: "Tumhare paas Quraysh ka ek naujawan aaya hai jo maaon, phuphiyon aur khalaon ke lihaaz se sharif hai, tumhare darmiyan maal yun yun lutata hai" ya (kaha) "woh bohot si khoobiyon wala tha". Yahi woh hain jinhone Khurasan fatah kiya, Allah Ta'ala ke shukr mein Naysabur se ihram bandha, aur Arafah mein siqayat (paani pilane ke intizamaat) banwaye.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever is killed while defending their wealth is a martyr." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jo apne maal ki hifazat mein qatl kiya jaye woh shaheed hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Hind daughter of Abu Halaah daughter of Malik, one of the descendants of Usaid bin Amr bin Tameem, a confederate of the Banu Abdildar, and the daughter of Khadijah.
hi: Hind bin Abi Hala bint Malik (matn mein isi tarah hai), Bani Usayd bin Amr bin Tamim mein se ek, Bani Abd Ad-Dar ke halif (hum-paiman), aur woh Khadijah (RA) ke bete hain.

e: [AI] "Abu Halah is the husband of Khadija, his name is Hind bin Al-Nabbash bin Zurarah, and their children are Hind and Halah. Hind witnessed Hind's martyrdom."
hi: Abu Hala, Khadijah (RA) ke shauhar, unka naam Hind bin An-Nabbash bin Zurarah hai, aur unke do bete Hind aur Hala hain. Hind (RA) Uhud mein shareek hue.

e: [AI] Regarding the adornment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , the mentioning of the hadith in its entirety.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...Rasulullah (SAW) ke hulye (zahiri sifaat) ke baare mein", phir poori hadees tafseel se zikr ki.

e: [AI] He entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was lying down, so the Prophet ﷺ  woke up and embraced Hala, bringing her closer to his chest and said, "Hala, Hala, Hala," as if he ﷺ  was delighted by her resemblance to Khadijah.
hi: Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye jabke aap (SAW) soye hue the. Nabi (SAW) jaag gaye, Hala ko seene se laga liya aur farmaya: "Hala, Hala, Hala." Goya aap (SAW) unse khush hue kyunke woh Khadijah (RA) ki qareebi thin.

e: [AI] "Abdullah, son of Zam'ah, son of Al-Aswad, son of Muttalib, son of Asad, son of Abdul Uzza, son of Qusayy, and his mother is Quraybah, daughter of Abi Umayyah, son of Abdul Uzza, son of Umar, son of Makhzum, and her mother is Atikah, daughter of Abdul Uzza."
hi: Abdullah bin Zam'ah bin Al-Aswad bin Al-Muttalib bin Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza bin Qusayy (RA), aur unki walida Qurayba bint Abi Umayyah bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Makhzum thin, aur Qurayba ki walida Atikah bint Abd Al-Muttalib thin.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was taken ill and I was with him in a group of Muslims, Bilal was called for prayer. He said, 'Choose someone to lead the people in prayer.' So I went out and found Umar among the people, and Abu Bakr was absent. I said to Umar, 'Stand up and lead the people in prayer.' He stood up and when he said the takbeer (the opening phrase of prayer), the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  heard his voice. Umar was a loud speaker. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Where is Abu Bakr? May Allah not blame him or the Muslims for that.' He sent for Abu Bakr and after Umar had finished that prayer, Abu Bakr led the people in prayer. Abdullah ibn Zam'a said, 'Umar said to me, "What did you do to me, O Ibn Zam'a? By Allah, when you told me to lead the people in prayer, I did not think that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had commanded it. If it were not for that, I would not have led the people in prayer." I said, 'By Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not command me. But when I did not see Abu Bakr, I thought that you were the most entitled to lead the people in prayer.'"
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki bimari shadeed ho gayi aur main kuch Musalmanon ke saath aap ke paas tha, to Bilal (RA) ne namaz ke liye bulaya. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kisi ko hukm do jo logon ko namaz padhaye." Main bahar nikla to Umar (RA) logon mein the aur Abu Bakr (RA) maujood nahi the. Maine kaha: "Ae Umar! Uthiye aur logon ko namaz padhaiye." Woh khade hue, jab unhone takbeer kahi to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unki awaaz suni, aur Umar (RA) buland awaaz wale aadmi the. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Abu Bakr kahan hain? Allah aur Musalman is se inkaar karte hain." Phir aap ne Abu Bakr (RA) ko bulwa bheja, woh Umar (RA) ke us namaz padha dene ke baad aaye aur logon ko namaz padhayi. Abdullah bin Zam'ah (RA) ne kaha: Umar (RA) ne farmaya: "Tujh par afsos, ae Ibn Zam'ah! Tune mere saath kya kiya? Allah ki qasam, jab tune mujhe hukm diya to mera gumaan yahi tha ke Rasulullah (SAW) ne iska hukm diya hai, warna main logon ko namaz na padhata." Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe hukm nahi diya tha, magar jab maine Abu Bakr (RA) ko na dekha to maine aap ko maujood logon mein namaz padhane ka sabse zyada haqdaar paaya."

e:
[AI] The translation of "شَبَّابُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ وَمَاتَ أَبُو أُمَامَةَ سَنَةَ سِتٍّ وَثَمَانِينَ" into English is:

"Shabab, son of Khayyat, and Abu Ummamah passed away in the year sixty-eight."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "Shabbab bin Khayyat (kehte hain) aur Abu Umamah (RA) 86 Hijri mein faut hue."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah sent me to my people to invite them to Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, and to present to them the principles of Islam. So I went to them while they were watering their camels and milking them, and drinking the milk. When they saw me, they greeted me and said, 'Welcome, O Suddi bin Ajlan!' Then they said, 'We have heard that you have become a follower of this man (referring to the Prophet Muhammad). I replied, 'No, but I have believed in Allah and His Messenger, and the Messenger of Allah has sent me to you to present Islam and its principles.' While we were in this discussion, they brought a vessel filled with blood, and they gathered around it to eat it. They said, 'Come, O Suddi!' I said, 'Woe to you! I have come to you from the one who forbids you from consuming this, as Allah has revealed to him.' They asked, 'What is that?' I said, 'Allah has revealed this verse to him: 'Forbidden to you are dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine...' (Quran 5:3) until 'except what you slaughter.' (Quran 5:3) I then invited them to Islam, but they refused. I said to them, 'Woe to you! Can you bring me some water to drink? I am extremely thirsty.' They replied, 'No, we will let you die of thirst.' So, I wrapped my head in my turban and fell asleep under the intense heat. Then, someone came to me in a dream with a glass cup that no one has ever seen anything better than, and it contained a drink that no one has ever tasted anything more delicious than. I was able to drink from it, and after I finished drinking, I woke up. By Allah, I did not feel thirsty or experience thirst after that sip.' I heard them saying, 'A man from our people has come to you, but you did not honor him with a taste. So, bring me a taste of what they would have given me.' I said, 'I have no need for it. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has fed and provided me. I showed them my stomach, and then they all embraced Islam one after another.' This is the narration of Suddi bin Hirmuz, who Ibn Ma'in deemed as weak."
hi: Abu Umamah (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe meri qaum ki taraf bheja ke main unhein Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ki taraf bulaun aur unke saamne Islam ke ahkam pesh karun. Main unke paas aaya to unhone apne oont paani pila diye the, unhein duh liya tha aur khud (doodh) pi liya tha. Jab unhone mujhe dekha to kaha: "Khush aamdeed, ae Suday bin Ajlan!" Phir kaha: "Humein khabar mili hai ke tum is aadmi ki taraf jhuk gaye ho." Maine kaha: "Nahi, balki main Allah aur uske Rasool par imaan laaya hun, aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe tumhari taraf bheja hai ke main tumhare saamne Islam aur uske ahkam pesh karun." Hum isi haal mein the ke woh khoon se bhara ek bada pyala laaye, use rakha aur sab uske gird jama ho kar khane lage. Unhone kaha: "Aao, ae Suday!" Maine kaha: "Tum par afsos! Main to us hasti ke paas se aaya hun jo is cheez ko tum par haram karti hai, us wahi ke zariye jo Allah ne us par utaari." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Maine kaha: Us par yeh aayat nazil hui: "Tum par murdar, khoon aur khinzeer ka gosht haram kiya gaya" (Surah Al-Ma'idah 3) yahan tak ke "magar jise tum ne zabah kar liya". Main unhein Islam ki dawat deta raha aur woh inkaar karte rahe. Maine kaha: "Tum par afsos! Mere paas thoda paani le aao, mujhe bohot shadeed pyaas lagi hai." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balki hum tumhein pyaas se marne ke liye chhod denge." (Abu Umamah (RA) ne) kaha: "Maine apna amama (pagdi) lapeta, sar us mein chhupa liya aur shadeed garmi mein tapti hui zameen par so gaya. Mere paas khwab mein ek aane wala aaya, uske paas shisha ka aisa pyala tha ke logon ne us se khoobsurat nahi dekha, aur usmein aisa sharbat tha ke logon ne us se lazeez nahi dekha. Usne mujhe pila diya, aur jab main apna sharbat pi chuka to jaag gaya, aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe us ghoont ke baad na pyaas lagi na pyaas ka pata chala." Phir maine unhein kehte suna: "Tumhari qaum ke sardaaron mein se ek shakhs tumhare paas aaya aur tumne use thode se mile doodh ka ek ghoont bhi na pilaya!" To woh apna thoda sa mila doodh mere paas laaye. Maine kaha: "Mujhe ismein koi haajat nahi, Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne mujhe khilaya aur pilaya hai." Phir maine unhein apna pet dikhaya to woh sab ke sab Islam le aaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Sadaqah bin Hurmuz ko Ibn Ma'in ne za'eef kaha hai."

e: [AI] Mu'awiyah ibn Haydah ibn Mu'awiyah ibn Qushayr ibn Ka'ab ibn Rabiah ibn 'Amir, his lineage traces back to Abdullah ibn Al-Jarud.
hi: Mu'awiyah bin Haydah bin Mu'awiyah bin Qushayr bin Ka'b bin Rabi'ah bin Amir (RA), unka nasab Abdullah bin Al-Jarud tak pahunchta hai.

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, who is the most righteous?" He said, "Your mother." And he mentioned the Hadith that we did not write down except from the narration of Ibn 'Awn from Bahz, except from him.
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main kis ke saath sabse zyada husn-e-sulook karun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni maa ke saath." Aur unhone (poori) hadees zikr ki. (Raawi ne kaha:) Humne Ibn Awn ki Bahz se riwayat mein ise sirf unhi (Ibn Awn) se likha hai.

e: [AI] "He said to his brother Malik ibn Haidah, 'Come with us to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , for he knows you but does not know me. He has imprisoned some people from my neighbors, so we went to him. Malik ibn Haidah said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have embraced Islam and my neighbors have embraced Islam. Leave them alone.' But he did not respond. Then he repeated his request, but he did not respond again. So he got angry and said, 'If you do that, they claim that you call to one thing and do something else.' So I scolded and reprimanded him. He asked, 'What did he say?' They said, 'He said such and such.' He then said, 'If I do that, then it is upon me and not upon them. Leave his neighbors alone.' Al-Dhahabi did not comment on this in his summary."
hi: Unhone apne bhai Malik bin Haydah se kaha: "Mere saath Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas chalo, kyunke woh tumhein jaante hain aur mujhe nahi jaante, aur unhone mere padosiyon mein se kuch logon ko rok rakha hai." Hum aap ke paas aaye. Malik bin Haydah ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main Islam laaya hun aur mere padosi bhi Islam laaye hain, to unhein chhod dijiye." Aap ne jawab na diya. Phir unhone dobara kaha, aap ne phir jawab na diya. Woh naraz ho kar uth khade hue aur kaha: "Agar aap ne aisa kiya (yaani na chhoda) to log yeh keh denge ke aap ek baat ki dawat dete hain aur karte doosri hain." Main unhein daantne aur rokne laga. Aap (SAW) ne poocha: "Yeh kya keh raha hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Yeh yun yun keh raha hai." Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar maine aisa kiya to uska (bojh) mujh par hai, unpar iska kuch nahi. Iske padosiyon ko iske liye chhod do." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I will be absent from water for months, and my family will be with me, will I be affected by them?" He said, "Yes, even if you are absent for twenty years." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main kai mahine paani se door rehta hun aur mere saath meri biwi hoti hai, kya main unke paas ja sakta hun?" Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: "Haan, chahe tum bees saal door raho." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married twelve Arab women who were chaste. This was followed by Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Aqil, and Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne barah paak-daaman Arab auraton se nikah kiya." Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Aqil ne is mein unki mutaba'at ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married twelve women. Qatadah ibn Di'amah and other scholars disagreed with him on this matter. As for Qatadah's opinion on this, Ad-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne barah auraton se nikah kiya." In dono se Qatadah bin Di'amah aur doosre a'immah ne is mein ikhtilaf kiya hai. Rahi Qatadah ki baat is mein... Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married fifteen women; six of them were from the Quraysh, one from the allies of the Quraysh, seven from the Arab women, and one from the Children of Israel. He did not marry more than one woman during the time of ignorance (before Islam), except for one. Abu Ubayda Ma'mar Ibn Al-Muthanna disagreed with them, and his saying, may Allah have mercy on him, is closer to the truth. Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne pandrah auraton se nikah kiya: unmein se chhe Quraysh se, ek Quraysh ke halifon se, saat Arab auraton se, aur ek Bani Israil se, aur Jahiliyyat mein sirf ek se nikah kiya." Abu Ubaydah Ma'mar bin Al-Muthanna ne in sab se ikhtilaf kiya, aur unka qaul, Allah un par raham farmaye, is mein durusti ke zyada qareeb hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, married eighteen women. Seven of them were from the Quraysh tribes, one was from the allies of Quraysh, nine were from other Arab tribes, and one was from the Bani Isra'il, from the offspring of Harun, the brother of Musa, peace be upon them. Abu 'Ubaydah said, "The first woman that the Prophet, peace be upon him, married in Jahiliyyah was Khadijah. Then, after Khadijah, he married Sawda bint Zam'ah in Makkah after embracing Islam. Then, he married Aisha two years before the Hijrah. Then, he married in Madinah after the Battle of Badr, Umm Salamah. Then, he married Hafsah bint 'Umar, also two years from the Islamic calendar. These are the five women from the Quraysh. Then, in the third year from the Islamic calendar, he married Zainab bint Jahsh. Then, in the fifth year from the Islamic calendar, he married Juwayriyyah bint al-Harith. Then, in the sixth year from the Islamic calendar, he married Umm Habibah bint Abu Sufyan. Then, in the seventh year from the Islamic calendar, he married Safiyah bint Huyayy. Then, in the eighth year from the Islamic calendar, he married Maymunah bint al-Harith. Then, he married Fatimah bint Shurayh. Then, he married Zainab bint Khuzaymah. Then, he married Hind bint Yazid. Then, he married Asma' bint al-Nu'man. Then, he married Qutaylah bint Qays, the sister of Ash'ath. Then, he married Sana' bint al-Salt, the Sulamiyah." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing them.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne atharah auraton se nikah kiya: unmein se saat Quraysh ke qabilon se, ek Quraysh ke halifon se, nau baaqi Arab qabilon se, aur ek Bani Israil se, Bani Harun bin Imran se jo Musa bin Imran (AS) ke bhai the." Abu Ubaydah ne kaha: "Jahiliyyat mein jis se Nabi (SAW) ne sabse pehle nikah kiya woh Khadijah (RA) thin. Phir Khadijah ke baad Islam mein Makkah mein Sawdah bint Zam'ah (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir hijrat se do saal pehle Aishah (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir Madinah mein Badr ke waqiye ke baad, taarikh ke do saal mein, Umm Salamah (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir Hafsah bint Umar (RA) se bhi taarikh ke do saal mein nikah kiya. To yeh paanch Quraysh se hain. Phir taarikh ke teen saal mein Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir taarikh ke paanch saal mein Juwayriyah bint Al-Harith (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir taarikh ke chhe saal mein Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir taarikh ke saat saal mein Safiyyah bint Huyayy (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir Maymunah bint Al-Harith (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir Fatimah bint Shurayh se, phir Zaynab bint Khuzaymah (RA) se, phir Hind bint Yazid se, phir Asma bint An-Nu'man se, phir Qutaylah bint Qays jo Al-Ash'ath ki behen hain, phir Sana bint As-Salt As-Sulamiyyah se nikah kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  married Aisha when she was seven years old, and consummated the marriage when she was nine years old. He passed away while she was eighteen years old, during the time of Muawiyah in the year fifty-seven." As for the part about Al-Dhahabi remaining silent in summarizing, it is not clear what specific statement or information is referred to, so it is not possible to provide a translation in that context.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Aishah (RA) se nikah kiya jabke woh saat saal ki thin, unke saath rukhsati hui jabke woh nau saal ki thin, aur Nabi (SAW) ka wisaal hua jabke woh atharah saal ki thin, aur woh Mu'awiyah (RA) ke zamane mein 57 Hijri mein faut hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Urwa wrote to Al-Walid ibn 'Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married Aisha after the death of Khadijah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw Aisha in a dream three times, and it was said to him, 'This is your wife Aisha.' Aisha was six years old on the day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married her and he consummated the marriage with her. He then brought her to Medina when she was nine years old. Aisha, the mother of the believers, passed away on a Tuesday night after the Witr prayer. She was buried on the same night at Baqi' cemetery, fifteen nights into Ramadan. Abu Huraira performed her funeral prayer, while Marwan was absent, and Abu Huraira took charge after him."
hi: Urwah ne Al-Walid bin Abd Al-Malik bin Marwan ko likha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Khadijah (RA) ki wafat ke waqt Aishah (RA) se nikah kiya. Rasulullah (SAW) ko khwab mein teen baar dikhaya gaya ke yeh tumhari biwi Aishah hain. Jis din Rasulullah (SAW) ne Aishah (RA) se nikah kiya woh chhe saal ki thin, phir aap ne unki rukhsati ki aur Madinah aaye tab woh nau saal ki thin. Ummul Mu'mineen Aishah (RA) Mangal ki raat Witr ki namaz ke baad faut hui aur usi raat Baqi' mein dafan ki gayin, Ramadan ki pandrah raatein guzarne par. Unki namaz-e-janaza Abu Hurairah (RA) ne padhayi, Marwan maujood nahi tha aur Abu Hurairah (RA) uske naib the."

e: [AI] "Aisha bint Abi Bakr, the daughter of Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, her mother is Umm Ruman bint Amir ibn Uwaymir ibn Abd Shams ibn Attab ibn Udhaynah ibn Subay' ibn Dhu'man ibn Al-Harith ibn Ghanm ibn Malik ibn Kinanah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married her in the month of Shawwal, ten years after the start of his prophethood and three years before the Hijrah. He consummated the marriage with her in Shawwal, at the beginning of the eighth month after the Hijrah, and she was nine years old on that day."
hi: Aishah bint Abi Bakr As-Siddiq, unki walida Umm Ruman bint Amir bin Uwaymir bin Abd Shams bin Attab bin Udhaynah bin Subay' bin Duhman bin Al-Harith bin Ghanm bin Malik bin Kinanah (RA) thin. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse nubuwwat ke das saal Shawwal mein, hijrat se teen saal pehle nikah kiya, aur hijrat ke aath mahine ke sar par Shawwal mein unki rukhsati ki, aur jis din aap ne unke saath ghar basaya woh nau saal ki thin.

e: [AI] "To be buried in her house with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Abu Bakr. She said, 'I have been married after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so bury me with his wives.' And she was buried in the Baqi' cemetery."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...ke woh apne ghar mein Rasulullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) ke saath dafan ki jayen." To unhone farmaya: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad ek naya kaam (hadath) kar liya hai, mujhe aap ki dusri azwaj ke saath dafan karna." Chunancha woh Baqi' mein dafan ki gayin.

e: [AI] "She is his ﷺ  wife in this world and the Hereafter."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke woh dunya aur akhirat mein aap (SAW) ki zawjah hain."

e: [AI] She said, "The Messenger of Allah peace be upon him died in my house, on my day, in my night, between my magic and my needlework." Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr entered with a wet tooth stick from Arak, and the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him looked at it. So I said, "O Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr, bite it from that spot." So he handed it to me, and I took it and bit from it and passed it back to him. Then he handed it to the Prophet peace be upon him, and he used it for tooth cleaning.
hi: Unhone (Aishah (RA) ne) farmaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal mere ghar mein, mere din aur meri raat mein, mere seene aur gardan ke darmiyan hua. Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr (RA) aaye, unke saath Arak ka tazah miswak tha, Rasulullah (SAW) ne use dekha. Maine kaha: 'Ae Abdur Rahman! Ise us jagah se chaba lo.' Unhone woh mujhe de diya, maine woh aap ko pakda diya, aap ne woh mujhe lauta diya, to maine use chaba kar theek kiya, phir Nabi (SAW) ko diya aur aap ne usse miswak kiya."

e: [AI] "Aisha, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad peace be upon him, passed away in my house, in my presence, on my day, while I was with her. Abdur Rahman ibn Abu Bakr entered upon him with a moist siwak (toothbrush), and he (the Prophet) looked at it until I thought he was in need of it. So I took it, chewed it, and softened it, then I handed it to him. He brushed his teeth with it, swished it around his mouth, and then returned it to me. He continued to do this repeatedly, until he raised his eyes towards the sky and said, 'The highest companion.' Then his soul departed. Praise be to Allah, who gathered his saliva with mine in the final day of this world."
hi: Aishah (RA) ne farmaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal mere ghar mein, mere din mein, mere seene aur gardan ke darmiyan hua. Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr (RA) aap ke paas aaye, unke saath tazah miswak tha. Aap ne use dekha, yahan tak ke mujhe gumaan hua ke aap ko ise ki zaroorat hai. To maine woh le liya, use chabaya, tora aur narm kiya, phir aap ko de diya. Aap ne itni behtareen tarah miswak kiya ke maine kabhi kisi ko aisa miswak karte nahi dekha. Phir aap use meri taraf badhane lage to aap ka haath gir gaya. Maine aap ke liye woh dua padhni shuru ki jo Jibreel (AS) aap ke liye karte the aur jo aap khud bimari mein padhte the, magar aap ne us bimari mein woh dua nahi padhi. Phir aap ne aasman ki taraf nazar uthayi aur farmaya: 'Ar-Rafiq Al-A'la.' Aur aap (SAW) ki ruh nikal gayi. To tamam taareef Allah ke liye hai jisne duniya ke aakhri din mere thook ko aap ke thook se jama kar diya."

e: [AI] "I used to enter the house in which both Umar and Allah were buried, and by Allah, I never entered except while my clothes were tightened out of respect for Umar."
hi: "Main us ghar mein jaya karta tha jismein un dono (Rasulullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA)) ke saath Umar (RA) dafan hue. Allah ki qasam, uske baad main jab bhi dakhil hota to apne kapde kas kar hi dakhil hota, Umar (RA) se haya karte hue."

e: [AI] "Aisha, I saw Gabriel peace be upon him standing in my room and the Messenger of Allah SAW was in conversation with him. When he entered, I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, who is this?' He said, 'Who do you resemble him with?' I said, 'With the appearance of Dihyah Al-Kalbi.' He said, 'You have seen much good, that is Gabriel peace be upon him.' I did not stay long until he said, 'O Aisha, this is Gabriel who sends his greetings to you.' She said, 'And upon him be peace. May Allah reward him with good.'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Aishah (RA) ne mujhse kaha: Maine Jibreel (AS) ko apne is hujre mein khade dekha aur Rasulullah (SAW) unse sargoshi kar rahe the. Jab aap andar aaye to maine poocha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Yeh kaun the?' Aap ne farmaya: 'Tum ne unhein kis jaisa paaya?' Maine kaha: 'Dihyah Al-Kalbi (RA) jaisa.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Tum ne bohot bhalai dekhi, woh Jibreel (AS) the.' Phir thodi hi der guzri thi ke aap ne farmaya: 'Ae Aishah! Yeh Jibreel tumhein salam kehte hain.' Maine kaha: 'Un par bhi salam ho, Allah unhein ek aane wale ki taraf se behtareen jazaa de.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Omar imposed a limit of ten thousand on the mothers of the believers and Aisha increased it by two thousand. She said, "Indeed, she is the beloved of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Umar (RA) ne Ummahat ul-Mu'mineen ke liye das hazaar (wazifa) muqarrar kiya aur Aishah (RA) ke liye do hazaar zyada kiye, aur farmaya: "Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ki mehboob hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The donation of the people of Badr was six thousand and six thousand. The donation of the mothers of the believers was ten thousand and ten thousand for each woman among them, except for three women: Aisha, for Omar said, "I prefer her by two thousand because of her love for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ", and Safiyyah and Juwairiyah, seven thousand and seven thousand.
hi: Ahl-e-Badr ka wazifa chhe chhe hazaar tha, aur Ummahat ul-Mu'mineen ka wazifa har ek ke liye das das hazaar tha, siwaye teen khawateen ke: Aishah (RA), kyunke Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Main unhein do hazaar se fazilat deta hun kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) unse muhabbat karte the", aur Safiyyah (RA) aur Juwayriyah (RA), jinhein saat saat hazaar diye gaye.

e: [AI] A package was brought to Umar from Iraq and it contained a gemstone. Umar asked his companions, "Do you know its value?" They replied, "No," and they didn't know how to divide it. Umar then asked, "May I send it to Aisha, the beloved wife of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" They answered, "Yes," so he sent it to her. When she opened it, she said, "What has been opened regarding the son of Khattab after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? O Allah, do not make me dependent on his gift for someone who will come after him."
hi: Iraq se Umar (RA) ke paas ek dibba aaya jismein jawahir the. Unhone apne sathiyon se poocha: "Jaante ho iski qeemat kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi", aur unhein yeh bhi samajh nahi aaya ke use kaise taqseem karein. Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Kya tum ijazat dete ho ke main ise Aishah (RA) ke paas bhej dun, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) unse muhabbat karte the?" Unhone kaha: "Ji haan." Unhone woh unhein bhej diya. Aishah (RA) ne use khola aur kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke baad Ibn Al-Khattab par kaisi fatuhat kholi gayin! Ae Allah! Mujhe agle saal tak uske atiye ke liye zinda na rakhna."

e: [AI] Her nephews asked her permission for him, for he is from the best of your children. She said, "Leave me and do not remind me of him." But they continuously went to her until she gave them permission for him. When he entered upon her, Ibn Abbas said, "You have been named Ummul Mu'mineen (Mother of the Believers) in order to make you happy, and it was your name even before you were born. Indeed, you were among the most beloved wives of the Prophet ﷺ to him. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ only loved what was good. The only thing that separates you from meeting the loved ones is the separation of the soul from the body. Surely, your necklace fell on the night of Al-Abwa, so Allah made it a choice for the Muslims in that matter. And Allah blessed and exalted revealed the verse of Tayammum, and there were revealed verses in you from the Quran. So there is no mosque of the Muslims where your excuse is not recited day and night." She said, "Leave me and do not remind me of you, O Ibn Abbas. I wish I had forgotten and been forgotten."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...unke bhateejon ne unse kaha: 'Ise ijazat de dijiye, kyunke yeh aap ki aulad mein behtareen hain.' Unhone kaha: 'Mujhe iski tareef se bakhshiye.' Woh unke peeche lage rahe yahan tak ke unhone ijazat de di. Jab woh andar aaye to Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: 'Aap ko Ummul Mu'mineen is liye kaha gaya ke aap khush naseeb hon, aur yeh aap ka naam aap ke paida hone se pehle ka hai. Aap Nabi (SAW) ki azwaj mein unhein sabse zyada mehboob thin, aur Rasulullah (SAW) sirf paakeezah se muhabbat karte the. Aap aur apne mehboobon se milne ke darmiyan bas itna hai ke ruh jism se juda ho. Aap ka haar Abwa ki raat gir gaya tha to Allah ne Musalmanon ke liye usmein aasani rakh di aur Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne tayammum ki aayat utaari. Aur aap ke baare mein Quran ki aayaten nazil huin, to Musalmanon ki koi masjid aisi nahi jismein raat din aap ki bara'at na padhi jati ho.' Unhone kaha: 'Ae Ibn Abbas! Mujhe apni tareef se bakhshiye, meri khwahish hai ke main bhooli bisri ho jati.'"

e: [AI] Aisha, the Messenger of Allah did not marry me until Gabriel came to him in my form and said, "This is your wife, marry her." Indeed, I am a young girl who is shy. Sufyan said: Al-Zuhri said, "Al-Hawf is a see-through garment in which a woman is wrapped."
hi: Aishah (RA) ne farmaya: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse nikah nahi kiya yahan tak ke Jibreel (AS) meri soorat le kar aap ke paas aaye aur kaha: 'Yeh aap ki zawjah hain.' Aur aap ne mujhse nikah kiya jabke main ek bachchi thi aur mujh par 'hawf' tha. Jab aap ne mujhse nikah kiya to Allah ne mujh par haya daal di jabke main chhoti thi." Sufyan ne kaha: Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Hawf chamre ki woh pattiyan hain jo uske (libaas ke) beech mein hoti hain."

e: [AI] To converse with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he commands the people to obey him wherever he is, for the people supplicate to him with their gifts on the day of Aisha. And indeed, we love goodness just as Aisha loves it. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained silent and did not respond to me. Then my companions came to me and I informed them that he ﷺ did not speak to me. They said, "By Allah, do not claim this, and why now are you making this claim?" She (Umm Salamah) said, "So I turned back and spoke to him and said, my companions have told me that I should speak to you and command the people to obey you wherever you are." So I said to him the same thing twice or three times. In response, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained silent regarding that matter. Then he said, "Oh Umm Salamah, do not harm me regarding Aisha, for by Allah, revelation has not descended upon me while I am in the garment of a woman from my wives other than Aisha." She said, "So I sought refuge in Allah from ever harming you regarding Aisha."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...ke main Rasulullah (SAW) se baat karun ke aap logon ko hukm dein ke woh aap ko tohfe wahin bhejein jahan aap hon, kyunke log apne tohfe Aishah (RA) ke din ka intezar kar ke dete hain, aur hum bhi bhalai ko pasand karti hain jaise Aishah karti hain." Rasulullah (SAW) khamosh rahe aur mujhe koi jawab na diya. Meri saheliyan mere paas aayin, maine unhein bataya ke aap ne mujhse baat nahi ki. Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, tum ise na chhodna." (Umm Salamah (RA) ne) kaha: Phir jab aap meri baari mein aaye to maine aap se baat ki aur kaha: "Meri saheliyon ne mujhse kaha hai ke main aap se arz karun ke aap logon ko hukm dein ke woh aap ko tohfe wahin bhejein jahan aap hon." Maine yeh pehli hi baat do ya teen baar kahi aur har baar Rasulullah (SAW) khamosh rahe. Phir aap ne farmaya: "Ae Umm Salamah! Aishah ke baare mein mujhe takleef na do, kyunke Allah ki qasam, mujh par wahi us waqt nazil nahi hui jab main apni biwiyon mein se kisi ke kapde mein tha, siwaye Aishah ke." Maine kaha: "Main Allah ki panah mangti hun is se ke Aishah ke baare mein aap ko naraz karun."

e: [AI] The translation is as follows: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  mentioned Fatimah and she said, "I spoke up," and he said, "Would you not be pleased to be my wife in this world and the hereafter?" She said, "Yes, by Allah." He said, "Then you are my wife in this world and the hereafter." This is narrated by Abu Al-Anbas Sa'id ibn Kathir Al-Madani, a trustworthy narrator, and the Hadith is authentic.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Fatimah (RA) ka zikr kiya. Aishah (RA) ne kaha: to maine bhi baat ki. Aap ne farmaya: "Kya tum is par raazi nahi ke dunya aur akhirat mein meri zawjah ho?" Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi, Allah ki qasam." Aap ne farmaya: "To tum dunya aur akhirat mein meri zawjah ho." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Yeh Abu Al-Anbas, Sa'id bin Kathir Madani hain, thiqah hain, aur hadees sahih hai magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala."

e: [AI] "During my entire life, no woman before me had what Allah Almighty granted to Mary, the daughter of Imran. I do not say this to boast over any of my companions," said Aisha, the mother of the believers. Abdullah ibn Safwan asked her, "Who are they, O mother of the believers?" She replied, "The Angel came in my likeness to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh), and he married me while I was a seven-year-old girl. I was presented to him as a gift when I was nine. He married me when I was a virgin, an age no one else among the people had. He used to receive revelations while I was with him under the same blanket. I was the most beloved to him among all people. There were revelations that were revealed specifically about me, which almost caused a calamity to befall the Ummah. I saw Gabriel ﷺ , and no one from his wives saw him except me. And he passed away in my house; no one other than the Angel took care of his body but me."
hi: "Mujhe nau khaslatein mili hain jo mujhse pehle kisi aurat ko nahi milin, siwaye us ke jo Allah Ta'ala ne Maryam bint Imran ko diya. Allah ki qasam, main yeh isliye nahi kehti ke apni saheliyon mein se kisi par fakhr karun." Abdullah bin Safwan ne unse poocha: "Ae Ummul Mu'mineen! Woh kaunsi hain?" Unhone farmaya: "Farishta meri soorat mein Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaya, phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse nikah kiya jabke main saat saal ki thi, meri rukhsati hui jabke main nau saal ki thi, aur aap ne mujhse kunwari hone ki haalat mein nikah kiya jo kisi aur ke saath nahi hua. Aap par wahi aati thi aur main aur aap ek hi lihaaf mein hote. Main logon mein aap ko sabse mehboob thi. Meri shaan mein Quran ki aisi aayaten nazil huin ke ummat halaak hone ke qareeb thi. Maine Jibreel (AS) ko dekha aur aap ki azwaj mein se mere siwa kisi ne nahi dekha. Aur aap ka wisaal mere ghar mein hua, farishte aur mere siwa aap ke qareeb koi nahi tha."

e: [AI] "It descended specifically on Aisha."
hi: "Yeh khaas taur par Aishah (RA) ke baare mein nazil hui."

e: [AI] I heard the words from the mouth of a creature more grand and beautiful than Aisha. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "Maine kisi makhluq ke munh se Aishah (RA) ke munh se zyada shaandaar aur khoobsurat kalam nahi suna." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I have never seen anyone more knowledgeable in matters of Halal and Haram, knowledge, poetry, and medicine than Aisha, the Mother of the Believers." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: "Maine halal aur haram, ilm, shayri aur tibb ka Aishah, Ummul Mu'mineen (RA) se zyada jaanne wala koi nahi dekha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "If all the knowledge of mankind were gathered and combined with the knowledge of the wives of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , Aisha would have had the highest level of knowledge." According to the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: "Agar tamam logon ka ilm jama kiya jaye, phir Nabi (SAW) ki azwaj ka ilm, to Aishah (RA) ka ilm sabse wasee hoga." (Yeh) Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par (hai).

e: [AI] "I have not seen anyone more eloquent than Aisha."
hi: "Maine Aishah (RA) se zyada fasih koi nahi dekha."

e: [AI] It was said to him, "Was Aisha good at performing religious duties?" He said, "By the One in whose hand is my soul, I have seen the senior companions of Muhammad ﷺ  asking her about religious duties."
hi: Unse poocha gaya: "Kya Aishah (RA) faraiz (wirasat ke hisse) acchi tarah jaanti thin?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, maine Muhammad (SAW) ke sahaba ke bade buzurgon ko dekha ke woh unse faraiz ke baare mein poochte the."

e: [AI] I said to Aisha, "You recite poetry, even though you are the daughter of Abu Bakr, and you don't mind it. And you speak about medicine, so what knowledge do you have in it?" She replied, "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  would fall ill and bedouin people would come to treat him, so I memorized what they would say to him." Al-Dhahabi omitted this from his summary.
hi: Maine Aishah (RA) se kaha: "Aap shayri kehti hain jabke aap Siddiq (RA) ki beti hain aur parwah nahi karti, aur tibb ki baat karti hain, to aap ko ismein ilm kahan se aaya?" Unhone farmaya: "Nabi (SAW) beemar hote the to aap ke paas Arab ke wafood aate aur aap ke liye ilaaj batate, to main woh yaad kar leti." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] She and her parents, Abu Bakr and Umm Roman, came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "We would like you to pray for Aisha with a supplication, and we will listen." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Allah, forgive Aisha bint Abu Bakr, the daughter of As-Siddiq, with a clear and apparent forgiveness." Her parents were amazed by the Prophet's ﷺ  beautiful supplication for her, so they said, "We are amazed by my supplication for someone who testifies that there is no god worthy of worship except Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah." It is criticised for the reliability of its chain of narrators.
hi: Woh aur unke walidain Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umm Ruman (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Hum chahte hain ke aap Aishah ke liye aisi dua karein jo hum sun rahe hon." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Allah! Aishah bint Abi Bakr As-Siddiq ko aisi maghfirat de jo wajib, zahiri aur batini ho." Unke walidain Nabi (SAW) ki is behtareen dua par hairaan hue to aap ne farmaya: "Tum hairan hote ho? Yeh meri dua us ke liye hai jisne gawahi di ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hun." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Iski sanad umda hone ke bawajood yeh munkar hai."

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ was asked, 'Who is the most beloved person to you?' He replied, 'Aisha.' It was then said, 'We do not mean from your family members.' He said, 'Then Abu Bakr.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se poocha gaya: "Aap ko logon mein sabse zyada mehboob kaun hai?" Aap ne farmaya: "Aishah." Kaha gaya: "Hamari murad aap ke ahl nahi." Aap ne farmaya: "To Abu Bakr."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ sent me on an expedition with Abu Bakr and Umar. When I returned, I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, who do you love the most?" He asked, "What do you want to know that for?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I just want to know." He said, "Aisha." I said, "I meant among the men?" He said, "Her father." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this incident in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mujhe ek lashkar par bheja jismein Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) the. Jab main wapas aaya to maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah! Aap ko logon mein sabse zyada mehboob kaun hai?" Aap ne farmaya: "Tum is se kya chahte ho?" Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main bas jaanna chahta hun." Aap ne farmaya: "Aishah." Maine kaha: "Meri murad mardon mein se hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Uske walid." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "O Messenger of Allah, who is the most beloved person to you?" He said, "Aisha." He said, "I mean among the men?" He said, "Her father." (This hadith is reported by Bukhari and Muslim.)
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Nabi (SAW) se, jab aap Ghazwah Dhat As-Salasil se wapas aaye: 'Ya Rasulullah! Aap ko logon mein sabse zyada mehboob kaun hai?' Aap ne farmaya: 'Aishah.' Unhone kaha: 'Main mardon ke baare mein keh raha hun.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Uske walid.'" (Yeh) Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par (hai).

e: [AI] "To me, all the mothers of the believers are dearer than Aisha." I said, "As for you, you have contradicted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Aisha was the most beloved among them to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...ne mujhse kaha: 'Ummahat ul-Mu'mineen mein se har ek mujhe Aishah se zyada pasand hai.' Maine kaha: 'Jahan tak aap ka talluq hai, aap ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki mukhalifat ki, kyunke Aishah (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ko un sab mein sabse zyada mehboob thin.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, who among your wives will be with you in Paradise?" He replied, "As for you, you will be among them." She said, "It crossed my mind that you did not marry a virgin other than me." The authenticity of the chain of narration is correct and it has not been rejected.
hi: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Aap ki azwaj mein se kaun Jannat mein hai?" Aap ne farmaya: "Rahi tum, to tum unhi mein se ho." Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta tha ke yeh is liye hai ke aap ne mere siwa kisi kunwari se nikah nahi kiya. Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Sahih ul-isnad, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala."

e: [AI] Aisha said, "I saw myself on a hill and there were cows being slaughtered around me." So I said to her, "If your vision is true, then you will be in the midst of a battle." She replied, "I seek refuge in Allah from your evil words! How terrible what you have said!" So I said to her, "Perhaps if this happens, it will benefit you." She said, "By Allah, having Ali descend from the sky is more beloved to me than that." After some time, it was mentioned to her that Ali had killed Thumadah. So she said to me, "When you arrive in Kufa, write down the names of those who witnessed that incident from those you know in the city." When I arrived, I found that people were divided into different factions, so I wrote down ten names from each faction who witnessed the incident. He said, "So I went to her with their testimonies." She said, "May Allah curse 'Amr ibn Al-'As, for he claimed that he killed him in Egypt."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Aishah (RA) ne mujhse kaha: 'Maine apne aap ko ek tile par dekha aur mere gird gaayen zabah ki ja rahi thin.' Maine unse kaha: 'Agar aap ka khwab sach hua to aap ke gird ek jang (malhamah) hogi.' Unhone kaha: 'Main teri buraai se Allah ki panah mangti hun, tune kitni buri baat kahi.' Maine kaha: 'Shayad agar yeh koi aisi baat ho jo aap ko bura lage.' To unhone kaha: 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe aasman se gir jana is se zyada pasand hai ke main aisa karun.' Phir jab baad mein un ke saamne zikr hua ke Ali (RA) ne Dhu Ath-Thudayyah ko qatl kiya hai to unhone mujhse kaha: 'Jab tum Kufa pahunchna to mere liye un logon ke naam likh lena jo is waqiye mein maujood the aur jinhein tum shahr walon mein se jaante ho.' Jab main pahuncha to maine logon ko kai giroh mein paaya, to maine unke liye har giroh mein se das aise logon ke naam likhe jo is mein maujood the. Phir main unki gawahiyan unke paas laaya to unhone farmaya: 'Allah Amr bin Al-As (RA) par laanat kare, kyunke usne mujhse dawa kiya tha ke usne use Misr mein qatl kiya.'"

e: [AI] "Bureira, you are fasting, so why don't you get us a dinar worth of meat?" Aisha said, "If I had been reminded, I would have done it." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Ae Barirah! Tum roze se ho, to tum ne humare liye ek dirham ka gosht kyun na khareed liya?" Aishah (RA) ne farmaya: "Agar mujhe yaad dilaya jata to main zaroor karti." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Umm Salamah said, "By the One in Whose hand is my soul, none was dearer to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ than her father."
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, woh Rasulullah (SAW) ko logon mein sabse zyada mehboob thin, siwaye unke walid ke."

e: [AI] Muawiyah said to Ziyad, "Who is the most knowledgeable among the people?" He replied, "You, O Amir al-Mu'minin." Muawiyah then asked him, "Who do you support?" Ziyad replied, "As for when you decide to support me, it is Aisha." Al-Dhahabi omitted this from the summary.
hi: Mu'awiyah (RA) ne kaha: "Ae Ziyad! Logon mein sabse zyada ilm wala kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aap, ae Amir ul-Mu'mineen." Unhone kaha: "Main tumhein qasam deta hun." Ziyad ne kaha: "Jab aap ne qasam de di hai to Aishah." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] "Aisha was the most knowledgeable and understanding among the people and had the best opinions in general." The author, Al-Dhahabi, did not comment further in the summary.
hi: "Aishah (RA) logon mein sabse zyada fiqh wali, sabse zyada ilm wali aur aam logon ke baare mein sabse behtar raay rakhne wali thin." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Hafsah bint Umar ibn al-Khattab ibn Nufayl ibn Abdul Aziz ibn Rabah ibn Abdullah ibn Qurṭ ibn Razah ibn Adi ibn Ka'b ibn Luay ibn Ghalib, and her mother was Zainab bint Mazh'un ibn Habib ibn Wahb ibn Hudhafah ibn Jumah, and she was among the Emigrants.
hi: Hafsah bint Umar bin Al-Khattab bin Nufayl bin Abd Al-Uzza bin Rabah bin Abdullah bin Qurt bin Razah bin Adi bin Ka'b bin Luayy bin Ghalib (RA), aur unki walida Zaynab bint Maz'un bin Habib bin Wahb bin Hudhafah bin Jumah thin, aur woh muhajirat mein se thin.

e: [AI] Afterwards, the Prophet ﷺ married Hafsah, the daughter of Umar ibn Al-Khattab, and she was previously married to Khunays ibn Hudhafah As-Sahmi.
hi: "Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Hafsah bint Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se nikah kiya, aur woh isse pehle Khunays bin Hudhafah As-Sahmi (RA) ke nikah mein thin."

e: [AI] "Do you have any interest in marrying Hafsah?" So he turned away from me and did not come to me at all. Then Umar, the Prophet ﷺ's companion, came to him and complained to him. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Would it be better for me to marry Hafsah and marry Uthman to Umm Kulthum?" So the Prophet ﷺ married Hafsah and Uthman married Umm Kulthum, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...kya aap Hafsah mein dilchaspi rakhte hain?" To unhone mujhse munh pher liya aur koi jawab na diya. Phir Umar (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unki shikayat ki. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Is se behtar baat yeh hai ke main Hafsah se nikah karun aur Uthman ka nikah Umm Kulthum se kar dun." Chunancha Nabi (SAW) ne Hafsah (RA) se nikah kiya, aur Uthman (RA) ka nikah Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Umm Kulthum (RA) se kar diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Hafsah was born in the Quraysh tribe before the Prophet's ﷺ mission, five years earlier.
hi: "Hafsah (RA) us waqt paida huin jab Quraysh Kaaba ki tameer kar rahe the, Nabi (SAW) ki bi'that se paanch saal pehle."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  divorced Hafsa bint Umar, then her uncles Qudamah and Uthman ibn Mazh'oon visited her. She cried and said, "By Allah, he did not divorce me due to any displeasure." Then the Prophet ﷺ  came and said, "Gabriel ﷺ  informed me to go back to Hafsa, as she observes fasting and upholds prayers, and she is your wife in Paradise." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this incident in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Hafsah bint Umar (RA) ko talaq de di. Unke do mamu Qudamah aur Uthman, Maz'un ke bete, unke paas aaye to woh roye aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, unhone mujhe sairi (bezaari) ki wajah se talaq nahi di." Phir Nabi (SAW) tashreef laye aur farmaya: "Mujhse Jibreel (AS) ne kaha: Hafsah se ruju kar lo, kyunke woh bohot roze rakhne wali aur bohot qiyam karne wali hain, aur woh Jannat mein aap ki zawjah hain." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] It is narrated that the Prophet ﷺ  divorced Hafsah. Then Gabriel ﷺ  came to him and said, "O Muhammad, you have divorced Hafsah while she is a righteous and obedient fasting woman, and she is your wife in Paradise. So, reconsider divorcing her." This statement has been omitted by Az-Zahabi in the abridgment.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Hafsah (RA) ko talaq de di, to Jibreel (AS) aap ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ae Muhammad! Aap ne Hafsah ko talaq di, halanke woh bohot roze rakhne wali aur bohot qiyam karne wali hain, aur woh Jannat mein aap ki zawjah hain, to ruju kar lijiye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Umm Salamah was the first female migrant."
hi: "Umm Salamah (RA) auraton mein sabse pehli muhajirah hain."

e: [AI] "And among those who migrated with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  from Makkah to Medina was Abu Salama, Abdullah ibn Abdul Asad, and his wife Umm Salama bint Abi Umaya."
hi: "Aur un logon mein se jo Makkah mein Nabi (SAW) ke paas Habshah ki pehli hijrat karne walon mein se aaye, phir Madinah ki taraf hijrat ki: Abu Salamah Abdullah bin Abd Al-Asad (RA) aur unki biwi Umm Salamah bint Abi Umayyah (RA)."

e: [AI] "Umm Salamah's name was Rumlah. She was the first female to enter the city of Medina as an emigrant. She was with Abu Salamah before the Prophet ﷺ  and was previously married to Abu Salamah, Abdullah bin Abdul Asad bin Hilal bin Abdullah bin Umara bin Makhzum. He was the first to emigrate to the land of Abyssinia and participated in the Battle of Badr. Abu Salamah passed away during the time of the Prophet ﷺ . Umm Salamah gave birth to Salamah, Umar, Durrah, and Zainab. Their mother was Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ  married Umm Salamah after Abu Salamah passed away, and her son Umar bin Abu Salamah narrated this hadith from the Prophet ﷺ ."
hi: "Umm Salamah (RA) ka naam Ramlah tha, aur woh sabse pehli sawari wali khatoon thin jo hijrat kar ke Madinah mein dakhil huin. Woh Nabi (SAW) se pehle Abu Salamah Abdullah bin Abd Al-Asad bin Hilal bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Makhzum (RA) ke nikah mein thin, jo Habshah ki taraf sabse pehle hijrat karne wale the, Badr mein shareek hue aur Rasulullah (SAW) ke zamane mein faut hue. Unse Abu Salamah ke liye Salamah, Umar, Durrah aur Zaynab paida hue, in sab ki walida Umm Salamah (RA) Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah hain. Abu Salamah ke baad Nabi (SAW) ne unke nikah mein unki jagah li. Aur unke bete Umar bin Abi Salamah (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki hai."

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ: When you attend dying man, you should say good words, for the angels say Amin to what you say. When Abu Salamah died, I said: What should I say, Messenger of Allah? He said: O Allah forgive him, and give us something good in exchange. She said: So Allah gave me Muhammad ﷺ in exchange for him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3115)
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum marne wale ya beemar ke paas hazir ho to bhalai ki baat kaho, kyunke farishte tumhari baat par aameen kehte hain." Jab Abu Salamah (RA) faut hue to main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Main kya kahun?" Aap ne farmaya: "Kaho: Ae Allah! Humein aur use bakhsh de, aur mujhe uske baad acchi jaanasheeni ata farma." Maine yeh kaha to Allah ne mujhe Muhammad (SAW) ata farmaye. (Yeh) Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par hai, agar un dono ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When any of you experience a calamity, say 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un.' O Allah, I seek reward from You for my calamity and ask You to replace it with something better.' I used to say this when I had any difficulty. When my waiting period after the death of my husband ended, Abu Bakr proposed to me and I turned him down. Then, Umar proposed to me and I turned him down. The Prophet ﷺ  sent someone to propose to me on his behalf, and I said, 'Welcome to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his messenger! Please convey to him that I am a widow and I have no guardian except Allah. As for your saying that I am a widow, Allah will take care of my children. And as for considering yourself as a replacement, I will pray to Allah to replace you with someone better. As for the guardians, there is no one among them who can testify and there is no one absent whose permission is needed. So, the Prophet ﷺ  sent me a message saying, 'As for your saying that you are a widow, Allah will take care of your children. And as for your saying that there is no one except me, I will supplicate to Allah to remove your difficulty. As for the guardians, there is no one among them who can testify and there is no one absent whose permission is needed.' So, she said to her son, 'Stand up, O Umar, and let the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  marry you to her.' The Prophet ﷺ  then married them. He said to her, 'I will not deprive you of what I have given your sister, Fulanah, including two garments and a cushion filled with palm fibers.' The Prophet ﷺ  used to visit her while Zainab was breastfeeding her child. Whenever the Prophet ﷺ  came, she would give the child to him and he would place her (the child) in her (Zainab's) chamber to breastfeed her. So, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was generous and honorable. One day, Ammar ibn Yasir visited her when the Prophet ﷺ  intended to visit her. Zainab hid in her chamber and said, 'Leave this disgraced and wretched woman (referring to herself) who has caused trouble for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' So, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came and looked around the house, saying, 'Where is Zunab? Why can't I see Zunab?' Zainab said, 'Ammar came and took her away.' The Prophet ﷺ  then left. He was planning to visit her one day when Ammar came and took her away."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko museebat pahunche to kahe: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Ae Allah! Main apni museebat ka ajr tujh hi se talab karta hun, to mujhe is mein ajr ata farma.'" Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: Jab main kehna chahti thi 'aur mujhe iske badle mein iss se behtar ata farma' to kehti thi: 'Abu Salamah se behtar kaun hoga?' Yahan tak ke maine woh kah di. Jab unki iddat poori hui to Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein paigham diya, unhone inkaar kar diya; Umar (RA) ne paigham diya, unhone inkaar kar diya. Phir Nabi (SAW) ne paigham dene ke liye kisi ko bheja. Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ko aur unke qasid ko khush aamdeed. Rasulullah (SAW) ko salam kehna aur unhein bata dena ke main yateem bachchon wali aur ghairat wali aurat hun, aur mere wali mein se koi hazir nahi." Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein kehla bheja: "Jahan tak aap ka yeh kehna hai ke aap bachchon wali hain, to Allah aap ke bachchon ke liye kaafi ho jayega. Aur jahan tak aap ka yeh kehna hai ke aap ghairat wali hain, to main Allah se dua karunga ke woh aap ki ghairat door kar de. Aur rahe wali, to unmein se koi hazir ho ya ghair hazir, mujh se raazi hi hoga." Unhone apne bete se kaha: "Uth, ae Umar! Rasulullah (SAW) ka nikah kara de." Unhone unka nikah Rasulullah (SAW) se kara diya, aur (Nabi (SAW) ne) unse farmaya: "Main aap ke liye us se kam nahi karunga jo aap ki falan behen ko diya tha: do matke, do chakkiyan aur khajoor ki chhaal bhara chamre ka takiya." Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas aate to woh Zaynab ko doodh pila rahi hoti thin. Jab Nabi (SAW) aate to woh use utha kar apni godh mein rakh kar doodh pilane lagti thin. Unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) bohot haya wale aur sakhi the, to waapis chale jate. Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ne iska andaza kar liya, woh unke raza'i bhai the. Ek din Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke paas aane ka iraada kiya, to Ammar (RA) aaye, andar dakhil hue, Zaynab ko unki godh se kheench liya aur kaha: "Is badshakl, mushkil bachchi ko chhod do jis se tum ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko takleef di." Phir Rasulullah (SAW) tashreef laye, ghar mein nazar ghumate hue farmane lage: "Zunab kahan hai? Mujhe Zunab kyun nazar nahi aati?" Unhone kaha: "Ammar aaye the aur use le gaye." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni biwi ke saath ghar basaya aur farmaya: "Agar tum chaho to main tumhare liye saat din kar dun, aur phir (baaki) auraton ke liye bhi saat din karunga."

e: [AI] That Umm Salamah, the daughter of Abu Umaiyah, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ married her, she took hold of her garment as a means to prevent her from leaving her house. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If you wish, I will grant you increase and I will consider you as a virgin for seven and a divorcee for three."
hi: Umm Salamah bint Abi Umayyah (RA) ne, jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse nikah kiya, aap ka kapda pakad liya, aap ko apne ghar se nikalne se rokte hue. To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Agar tum chaho to main tumhare liye zyada kar dun, magar phir hisab bhi karunga: kunwari ke liye saat (din) aur shaadi-shuda ke liye teen."

e: [AI] Umm Salamah's name was Hind, daughter of Abu Umayyah. Her father's name was Suhail, son of Al-Mughirah, son of Abdullah, son of Umara, son of Makhzum. Her mother's name was Atikah, daughter of Amr, son of Rabiah, son of Malik, son of Khuzaymah, son of Al-Qamah, son of Firas, son of Ghanim, son of Malik, son of Kinanah. She was married to Abu Salamah, Abdullah, son of Abdul-Asad, son of Hilal. He migrated with her to the land of Abyssinia (Ethiopia) in both migrations. There, she gave birth to Zainab, and later she gave birth to Salamah and Umar, and Durrat, daughter of Bani Abu Salamah.
hi: Umm Salamah (RA) ka naam Hind bint Abi Umayyah hai, aur Abu Umayyah ka naam Suhayl bin Al-Mughirah bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Makhzum hai, aur unki walida Atikah bint Amir bin Rabi'ah bin Malik bin Khuzaymah bin Alqamah bin Firas bin Ghanm bin Malik bin Kinanah thin. Unse Abu Salamah Abdullah bin Abd Al-Asad bin Hilal (RA) ne nikah kiya aur unhein le kar Habshah ki taraf dono hijraton mein hijrat ki. Wahan unse Zaynab paida huin, aur uske baad Salamah, Umar aur Durrah, Abu Salamah ke bachche paida hue.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Verily, Aisha has a characteristic that no one else possesses." He was then asked about this after he married Umm Salama. The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, remained silent. It was then known that Umm Salama had possessed that characteristic in his presence.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Aishah ka mujhse ek aisa maqam hai jahan koi nahi utra." Kaha: Phir jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Umm Salamah (RA) se nikah kiya to aap se poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah! Us maqam ka kya hua?" Rasulullah (SAW) khamosh rahe, to samajh liya gaya ke Umm Salamah (RA) aap ke yahan us maqam par utar chuki hain. Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e:
[AI] The following is the translation of the text provided:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married Umm Salamah, whose name was Hind bint Abi Umayyah ibn Al-Mughirah ibn Abdullah ibn Umara ibn Makhzum, before the Battle of Badr in the second year of the Hijri calendar. The first of the Prophet's ﷺ  wives to pass away was Zainab, and the last of them to pass away was Umm Salamah. However, it is incorrect to mention a specific period of two years in this context."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke waqiye se pehle, taarikh ke do saal mein, Umm Salamah (RA) se nikah kiya, aur unka naam Hind bint Abi Umayyah bin Al-Mughirah bin Abdullah bin Umar bin Makhzum hai." Aur Nabi (SAW) ki azwaj mein sabse pehle faut hone wali Zaynab (RA) hain aur sabse aakhir mein faut hone wali Umm Salamah (RA). (Raawi ne) "do saal" isi tarah kaha hai, aur yeh ghalat hai.

e: "I entered upon Umm Salamah while she was crying, so I said: 'What causes you to cry?' She said: 'I saw the Messenger of Allah - that is, in a dream - and there was was dirt on his head and his beard. so I said: "What is wrong with you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: 'I just witnessed the killing of Al-Husain.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3771)
hi: Main Umm Salamah (RA) ke paas gaya, woh ro rahi thin. Maine poocha: "Aap kyun rota hain?" Unhone kaha: "Maine khwab mein Rasulullah (SAW) ko rote dekha, aap ke sar aur darhi par mitti thi. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Aap ko kya hua?' Aap ne farmaya: 'Maine abhi Husayn (RA) ka qatl dekha hai.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I came to console Umm Salamah for the killing of Husayn ibn Ali."
hi: "Main Umm Salamah (RA) ke paas Husayn bin Ali (RA) ke qatl par ta'ziyat karne aaya."

e: [AI] "Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , informed him that when she arrived in Medina, she informed them that she was the daughter of Abu Umamah ibn al-Mughira. They accused her of lying and said, 'We would never believe such extraordinary claims unless we see people from your tribe performing Hajj.' So, it was said to her to write a letter to her family, and she wrote it along with them. They returned to Medina and believed her, and their respect for her increased. Umm Salamah said, 'When I gave birth to Zainab, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married me.'" (This passage has been deleted from the summarized version by Al-Dhahabi)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah Umm Salamah (RA) ne unhein khabar di ke jab woh Madinah aayin to unhone logon ko bataya ke woh Abu Umayyah bin Al-Mughirah ki beti hain. Logon ne unhein jhutla diya aur kaha: "Ajnabi log kitna jhoot bolte hain!" Yahan tak ke kuch log Hajj ke liye nikle to unse kaha gaya: "Kya tum apne ghar walon ko likhogi?" Unhone unke saath khat likha. Woh Madinah laute to logon ne unki tasdeeq ki aur unki izzat aur badha di. Umm Salamah (RA) ne kaha: "Jab maine Zaynab ko janam diya to Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhse nikah kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] "That Marwan ibn al-Hakam should pray upon her" - Al-Dhahabi removed this from the summary.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke Marwan bin Al-Hakam unki namaz-e-janaza padhaye." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan, who was previously married to Ubaidullah ibn Jahsh al-Asadi, from the tribe of Khuza'a. He passed away in Abyssinia (Ethiopia) while they were immigrating from Mecca. He converted to Christianity and Allah confirmed Islam for Umm Habibah and her migration. Her husband also converted to Christianity and passed away, but Umm Habibah refused to convert. Allah confirmed Islam and migration for her until she arrived in Medina. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  proposed to her and Uthman ibn Affan married her. Al-Zuhri said, "They claimed that the Prophet ﷺ  wrote to the Negus and married her to him, but this is not confirmed."
hi: "Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan (RA) se nikah kiya. Woh isse pehle Ubaydullah bin Jahsh Al-Asadi, Asad Khuzaymah mein se, ke nikah mein thin. Woh Habshah mein faut hua, woh unhein le kar Makkah se muhajir ho kar nikla tha, phir fitne mein pad gaya aur nasrani ho gaya, aur nasrani hi mara. Allah ne Umm Habibah (RA) ke liye Islam aur hijrat ko saabit rakha. Unke shauhar nasrani ho gaye aur nasrani hi mare, aur Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan ne nasrani hone se inkaar kiya, aur Allah Ta'ala ne unke liye Islam aur hijrat ko mukammal kiya yahan tak ke woh Madinah aayin. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein paigham diya aur Uthman bin Affan (RA) ne unka nikah aap se kara diya." Az-Zuhri ne kaha: "Logon ka gumaan hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne Najashi ko likha to usne unka nikah aap se kar diya aur aap ki taraf se chalees uqiyyah mahr ada kiya."

e: [AI] And it is said that Aminah, the daughter of Abd Al-Uzza bin Harban bin Awf bin Ubaid bin Uwaj bin Adi bin Ka'b, passed away before Muawiyah by one year.
hi: Aur kaha jata hai: Aminah bint Abd Al-Uzza bin Harban bin Awf bin Ubayd bin Uwayj bin Adi bin Ka'b, aur woh Mu'awiyah (RA) se ek saal pehle faut huin.

e: [AI] "And the mother of Habiba, her name is Ramla bint Abi Sufyan bin Harb, and her mother is Safiyya bint Abi Al-As bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams, the aunt of Uthman bin Affan. Ubaidullah bin Jahsh bin Rabab al-Halif bin Umayyah married her, and she gave birth to Habiba, who is known by her. Habiba married Dawood bin Uruwah bin Masood Al-Thaqafi."
hi: "Aur Umm Habibah (RA) ka naam Ramlah bint Abi Sufyan bin Harb hai, aur unki walida Safiyyah bint Abi Al-As bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams thin jo Uthman bin Affan (RA) ki phuphi hain. Unse Ubaydullah bin Jahsh bin Ri'ab ne nikah kiya jo Harb bin Umayyah ke halif the, unse Habibah paida huin aur unhi ke naam par unki kunyat hui. Aur Habibah se Dawud bin Urwah bin Mas'ud Ath-Thaqafi ne nikah kiya."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent 'Amr ibn Umaya al-Damri to the Negus to propose to Umm Habiba bint Abi Sufyan for him. She was under the guardianship of Ubaidullah ibn Jahsh. The Negus then married her to him and gave her a dowry of four hundred dinars on behalf of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Jarir said, 'We have not seen 'Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan give a dowry of four hundred dinars to any woman, except for this.'"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Amr bin Umayyah Ad-Damri (RA) ko Najashi ke paas bheja ke aap ke liye Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan (RA) ka paigham de, aur woh Ubaydullah bin Jahsh ke nikah mein thin. To Najashi ne unka nikah aap se kar diya aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf se apne paas se chaar sau dinar mahr ada kiya." Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Jarir ne kaha: "Hamara khayal hai ke Abd Al-Malik bin Marwan ne auraton ka mahr chaar sau dinar isi wajah se muqarrar kiya."

e: [AI] "He ﷺ  asked Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , how sincere the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was to his wives. She said, "His sincerity to his wives was twelve uqiyyahs and a half, which is five hundred dirhams. That was the dowry of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to his wives."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah Aishah (RA) se poocha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni azwaj ko kitna mahr diya?" Unhone farmaya: "Aap (SAW) ka apni azwaj ke liye mahr saadhe barah uqiyyah tha, yani paanch sau dirham. Yahi Rasulullah (SAW) ka apni azwaj ke liye mahr tha."

e: [AI] "Al-Najashi prepared Umm Habibah to go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and sent her with Sharhabil ibn Hasana."
hi: "Najashi ne Umm Habibah (RA) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ki taraf rawana karne ke liye tayyar kiya aur unhein Shurahbil bin Hasanah (RA) ke saath bheja."

e: [AI] "Zainab bint Jash ibn Rabab ibn Ya'mar ibn Sabirah ibn Murrah ibn Kathir ibn Ghanm ibn Dudan ibn Asad ibn Khuzaymah, and her mother was Ummayma bint Abdul-Muttalib ibn Hashim ibn Amr ibn Abd Manaf. Zainab was with Zaid ibn Harithah, but he divorced her, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married her. And in her respect, the verse was revealed: 'And [remember, O Muhammad], when you said to the one on whom Allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allah," while you concealed within yourself that which Allah is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allah has more right that you fear Him. So when Zaid had no longer any need for her, We married her to you...' (Quran 33:37). She used to boast among the Prophet's wives, saying, 'Allah married me to His Messenger, and He married you to your fathers, relatives, and Hamna bint Jahsh, who was menstruating at the time, and she was under the guardianship of Abdur Rahman ibn Awf and she was the sister of Zainab bint Jash.'"
hi: "Zaynab bint Jahsh bin Ri'ab bin Ya'mar bin Sabirah bin Murrah bin Kathir bin Ghanm bin Dudan bin Asad bin Khuzaymah (RA), aur unki walida Umaymah bint Abd Al-Muttalib bin Hashim bin Amr bin Abd Manaf thin. Zaynab (RA) Zayd bin Harithah (RA) ke nikah mein thin, unhone unhein chhod diya to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse nikah kiya." Aur unke baare mein yeh nazil hua: "Phir jab Zayd ne unse apni hajat poori kar li to humne unka nikah aap se kar diya" (Surah Al-Ahzab 37). Kaha: Woh Nabi (SAW) ki azwaj par fakhr karti thin aur kehti thin: "Allah ne mera nikah apne Rasool se kiya, aur tumhara nikah tumhare baap bhaiyon aur rishtedaron ne kiya." Aur Hamnah bint Jahsh wahi mustahazah hain, jo Abd Ar-Rahman bin Awf (RA) ke nikah mein thin, aur woh Zaynab bint Jahsh ki behen hain.

e: [AI] "Zainab bint Jahsh ibn Rabab, the sister of Abdul Rahman ibn Jahsh, remained silent about him according to Al-Dhahabi in his summary."
hi: "Aur Zaynab bint Jahsh bin Ri'ab (RA), Abd Ar-Rahman bin Jahsh (RA) ki behen." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina, and Zaynab bint Jahsh was one of those who emigrated with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She was a beautiful woman. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ proposed to her on behalf of Zaid bin Haritha, but she said, "I do not wish to marry him." She was previously married to someone from the Quraish tribe. The Prophet ﷺ said, "But I have already accepted him for you." So Zaid married her.
hi: Nabi (SAW) Madinah tashreef laye, aur Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) un logon mein se thin jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath hijrat ki, aur woh khoobsurat khatoon thin. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein Zayd bin Harithah (RA) ke liye paigham diya. Unhone kaha: "Main use pasand nahi karti", aur woh Quraysh ki be-shauhar (azaad) aurat thin. Aap ne farmaya: "Main ne use tumhare liye pasand kar liya hai." Chunancha Zayd (RA) ne unse nikah kar liya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Zayd b. Ḥārithah’s house looking for him. Zayd was called Zayd b. Muḥammad ˹at that time˺. Then when an hour had gone by, he said, "Where is Zayd?" He then came to his house looking for him but didn’t find him. Zaynab was standing next to him in regular housework attire (or nightwear) then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ then he avoided her. She said, "He’s not here, Messenger of Allah ﷺ, ˹please˺ come in." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, ˹however,˺ refused to enter and she was surprised at the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He turned around and was saying something under his breath that almost could not be understood from him except, maybe, for, "Glory to the Perfection of Allah, the All Mighty, Glory to the Perfection of the changer of the hearts."
Zayd came ˹back˺ to his house and his wife informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to the his house, and Zayd said, "Didn’t you ask him to come in?" She said, "He avoided to do that and refused ˹to come in˺." He said, "Did you hear anything?" She said, "I heard him saying something as he turned around but I couldn’t understand him ˹fully but˺ I heard him say, 'Glory to the Perfection of Allah, the All Mighty, Glory to the Perfection of the changer of the hearts.'”
Then Zayd came to see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "It’s reached me that you came to my house but you didn’t come in, Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
