Perhaps you have a liking for Zaynab and I shall part from her." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Hold on to your wife." However, Zayd did not have a way to ˹approach˺ her after that day. He would come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to inform him ˹of this˺ but he ˹would˺ say, "Hold on to your wife." Then Zayd parted from her and left her, and she completed her ʿIddah.
˹Soon after˺ while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sitting speaking to ʿĀʾishah, he was ˹suddenly˺ overcome by unconsciousness. Then when ˹the episode˺ had lifted, he smiled saying, "Who will go and tell Zaynab that Allah has married me to her from ˹above˺ the sky?", and then he recited, “...and when you say to the one Allah had favored upon and you had favored upon, hold on to your wife…” (Aḥzāb 33:37) the whole story. Then ʿĀʾishah said, "Then I started to wonder about what has reached us about her beauty. On top of that, she is the greatest runner of affairs and the best of them. Allah married her from ˹above˺ the sky, and I said, she boasts to us about this." Then ʿĀʾishah said, "Then Salmá, the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, insisted, then she told her about it, and she gave her clarifications for it."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Zayd bin Harithah (RA) ke ghar unki talash mein aaye. Zayd ko us waqt "Zayd bin Muhammad" kaha jata tha. Kabhi aisa hota ke Rasulullah (SAW) unhein thodi der na paate to farmate: "Zayd kahan hai?" Aap unke ghar unhein dhoondhte aaye, unhein na paaya, to Zaynab (RA) aap ki taraf uthin aur kaha: "Yahin hain, ya Rasulullah." Aap palte, aur palte hue kuch dheere dheere bol rahe the jo mushkil se samajh aata tha, siwaye iske: "Subhan Allah Al-Azim, Subhan Allah Musarrif Al-Qulub." Phir Zayd apne ghar aaye to unki biwi ne bataya ke Rasulullah (SAW) unke ghar aaye the. Zayd ne kaha: "Tum ne aap se kaha nahi ke andar aa jayen?" Unhone kaha: "Maine aap ke saamne yeh pesh kiya tha magar aap ne inkaar kiya." Zayd ne poocha: "Kya tum ne aap ko kuch kehte suna?" Unhone kaha: "Jab aap palte to maine aap ko aisi baat karte suna jo mujhe samajh nahi aayi, aur maine aap ko kehte suna: 'Subhan Allah Al-Azim, Subhan Allah Musarrif Al-Qulub.'" Zayd nikle yahan tak ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Mujhe khabar mili hai ke aap mere ghar tashreef laye the, to aap andar kyun nahi aaye? Mere maa baap aap par qurban! Shayad Zaynab aap ko pasand aa gayi hain, to main unhein alag kar dun?" Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Apni biwi ko apne paas rakho." Uske baad Zayd ko un par koi rasta na mila. Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aate aur aap ko batate, aap farmate: "Apni biwi ko apne paas rakho." Woh kehte: "Ya Rasulullah! To phir main unhein alag kar deta hun." Rasulullah (SAW) farmate: "Apni biwi ko roke rakho." Phir Zayd ne unhein alag kar diya aur unse kinara kash ho gaye, aur (iddat ke baad) woh halal ho gayin. Kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) Aishah (RA) ke saath baat karte hue baithe the ke aap par ek badli (wahi ki kaifiyat) chha gayi, phir woh door hui to aap muskura rahe the aur farma rahe the: "Zaynab ke paas kaun jayega jo unhein khushkhabri de ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se unka nikah mujhse kar diya?" Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne tilawat ki: "Aur jab tum us se kehte the jis par Allah ne ina'am kiya aur tum ne bhi ina'am kiya" (Surah Al-Ahzab 37), poora qissa. Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Mujh par door-nazdeek ki baatein tari ho gayin, us husn ki wajah se jo mujhe unke baare mein pahuncha tha, aur ek doosri baat jo sabse bada aur sabse sharaf wala maamla hai, jo Allah ne unke liye kiya ke Allah ne aasman se unka nikah kar diya." Aur Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Woh isi par humare saamne fakhr karti hain." Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki khadimah Salma (RA) daudti hui nikli, unhein yeh khabar di, to unhone unhein apne chaandi ke zewar de diye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Zaynab bint Jahsh recommended that she be carried on the bed of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) and a bier be placed upon it." It is said that Abu Bakr As-Siddiq carried it [the bier]. "And Umar ibn Al-Khattab passed by two grave diggers digging Zaynab's grave on a hot summer day and he said, 'If only I had struck them with a lash.' And it was the first time anyone had been struck with a lash on a grave in Al-Baqi'."
hi: "Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) ne wasiyat ki ke unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ki charpai par uthaya jaye aur uske upar na'sh (dhaanpne wala dhancha) rakha jaye." Aur kaha gaya ke Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ko bhi usi par uthaya gaya tha. "Aur Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) kuch qabr khodne walon ke paas se guzre jo garmi ke din Zaynab (RA) ki qabr khod rahe the, to farmaya: 'Kaash main un par ek khema laga deta.' Aur yeh Baqi' mein kisi qabr par lagaya gaya sabse pehla khema tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I saw Abu Ahmad ibn Jahsh carrying the bed of Zainab while he was blind and crying, and I heard Umar say, "O Abu Ahmad, leave the bed so that people do not criticize you for carrying it." Abu Ahmad then said, "This is the thing through which we have obtained all goodness, and indeed it cools the heat that I feel." Then Umar said, "Stick to it, stick to it."
hi: Maine Abu Ahmad bin Jahsh (RA) ko dekha ke woh Zaynab (RA) ki charpai utha rahe the, woh nabeena the aur ro rahe the, aur maine Umar (RA) ko kehte suna: "Ae Abu Ahmad! Charpai se hat jao, log charpai ke bare mein tumhein mushkil mein na daalein." Abu Ahmad ne kaha: "Yeh woh hain jinke zariye humne har bhalai paayi, aur yeh (kaam) meri jalan ko thanda karta hai." Umar (RA) ne kaha: "Laazim pakdo, laazim pakdo..." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Zainab bint Jahsh did not leave behind a dinar or a dirham, she used to donate everything she could and was a refuge for the poor. She left her house, which was sold by Walid ibn Abdul Malik when the mosque was demolished for fifty thousand dirhams.
hi: "Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) ne na dinar chhoda na dirham; woh jo kuch unke bas mein hota sab sadaqa kar deti thin aur masakeen ki panahgah thin. Unhone apna ghar chhoda jise logon ne Al-Walid bin Abd Al-Malik ko bech diya, jab masjid dhaayi gayi, pachaas hazaar dirham mein." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Ummu Ukasha, the daughter of Muhassin, was asked: How old was Zainab, the daughter of Jash, when she died? She replied: We arrived in Medina for migration when she was thirty-two years old, and she died in the twentieth year. Umar ibn Uthman said: My father used to say that Zainab, the daughter of Jash, died at the age of fifty-three.
hi: Umm Ukkashah bint Mihsan (RA) se poocha gaya: "Jis din Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) faut hui to unki umar kitni thi?" Unhone kaha: "Hum hijrat ke liye Madinah aaye to woh tees se kuch upar ki thin, aur woh 20 Hijri mein faut hui." Umar bin Uthman ne kaha: Mere walid kaha karte the: "Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) tirpan (53) saal ki umar mein faut hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to his wives, "The quickest of you to reach for something is the one with the longest hand." Aisha said, "Whenever we gathered in the house of one of us after the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , we would extend our hands towards the wall and compete to see whose hand was longest. We continued to do this until Zainab bint Jahsh, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , passed away. She was a short woman and not the longest among us. It was then that we realized that the Prophet ﷺ  meant charity by mentioning the length of the hand." He said, "Zainab used to engage in handicrafts with her hands, such as dyeing and sewing, and she used to donate in the path of Allah Almighty."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apni azwaj se farmaya: "Tum mein se sabse pehle mujh se milne wali woh hogi jiske haath sabse lambe hain." Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ke wisaal ke baad jab hum kisi ek ke ghar jama hote to deewar par apne haath daraaz kar ke naapte, aur hum aisa karte rahe yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) faut hui, aur woh kotah qad thin, hum mein sabse lambi nahi thin. Tab humne jaana ke Nabi (SAW) ki murad lambe haath se sadaqa tha. Kaha: Aur Zaynab (RA) dastkaar aurat thin, khaal ko dabagh karti, silai karti aur Allah ki raah mein sadaqa karti thin.

e: Zaynab used to say to the Prophet ﷺ, "I’m truly the best ˹one of all˺ your women; I’m better than them in marriage, and most honorable in covering ˹modestly˺, most closer in relation, and al-Raḥmān married me to you from above the Throne, and Jibrīl was the intermediary in that, and I am the daughter of your paternal aunt; you do not have from among your women one closer ˹in relations˺ to you other than me."
hi: Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) Nabi (SAW) se kaha karti thin: "Main aap ki azwaj mein aap par sabse bada haq rakhti hun, nikah ke lihaaz se main un sab mein behtar hun, parde mein sabse zyada laazim hun, aur rishte mein sabse qareeb hun." Phir kehti thin: "Ar-Rahman Allah Ta'ala ne mera nikah aap se apne Arsh ke upar se kiya, aur Jibreel (AS) is mein safeer the, aur main aap ki phuphi ki beti hun, aur aap ki azwaj mein mere siwa aap ka koi qareebi nahi." (Raawi ne kaha:) "Maine tarjame ke shuru mein zikr kiya hai ke Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) ki walida Umaymah bint Abd Al-Muttalib bin Hashim thin, jo Nabi (SAW) ki phuphi hain."

e: [AI] Juwairiyah bint al-Harith, the wife of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , said, "Indeed, your wives boast about me and say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not marry you out of choice, but rather as a captive. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  replied, 'Did I not ransom you? Did I not free forty of your people?' " Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Juwayriyah bint Al-Harith (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) se kaha: "Aap ki azwaj mujh par fakhr karti hain, kehti hain: 'Rasulullah (SAW) ne tumse nikah nahi kiya, tum to sirf milk-e-yameen (laundi) ho.'" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Kya maine tumhara mahr bada nahi rakha? Kya maine tumhari qaum ke chalees gardan (ghulam) azaad nahi kiye?" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ captured the captives of the Banu Mustaliq tribe, Juwayriyah bint Al-Harith bin Abi Dirar fell into the possession of Thabit bin Qays bin Shammas. She wrote a letter to the Prophet ﷺ on her own accord. She was a charming and beautiful woman whom hardly anyone could resist. She came to seek the help of the Prophet ﷺ in writing the letter." The statement by Al-Dhahabi in the summarization remains silent on this matter.
hi: "Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ko Bani Al-Mustaliq ke qaidi mile to Juwayriyah bint Al-Harith bin Abi Dirar (RA) Thabit bin Qays bin Ash-Shammas (RA) ke hisse mein aayin. Unhone unse apne aap ke liye kitabat (azadi ka mu'ahida) kar liya, aur woh meethi, khoobsurat khatoon thin, koi unhein dekhta to unka dil le leti thin." Kaha: "Woh Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayin ke apni kitabat mein aap se madad lein." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Juwayriyah bint al-Harith, daughter of Abi Dirar ibn Habib ibn Aa'idh ibn Malik ibn Jadhimah ibn al-Mustaliq from the tribe of Khuzay'ah, was married to Musafi' bin Safwan and was killed on the day of al-Muraysi'i."
hi: "Aur Juwayriyah bint Al-Harith bin Abi Dirar bin Habib bin Aidh bin Malik bin Judhaymah bin Al-Mustaliq (RA), Khuza'ah mein se. Unse Musafi' bin Safwan ne nikah kiya tha aur woh Muraysi' ke din qatl hua."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  raided the dwellings of the Banu Mustaliq tribe and took one-fifth of their wealth. He then distributed it amongst the people, giving two shares to the horsemen and one share to the foot soldiers. Juwayriyyah bint al-Harith ibn Abi Dirar fell under the lot of Thabit ibn Qays ibn Shammas al-Ansari. She was under the guardianship of her cousin Safwan ibn Malik ibn Jadhima, known as Safwan bin Malak. When he was killed, Thabit ibn Qays wrote a document freeing her for nine ounces of gold. She was a very beautiful woman, and whenever anyone saw her, they would be captivated by her beauty. While the Prophet ﷺ  was sitting with me, Juwayriyyah came to ask him about her situation. By Allah, I did not see the Prophet ﷺ  look at her until I disliked her appearance before him. I knew that he would see in her what I had seen. Juwayriyyah said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am Juwayriyyah bint al-Harith, the daughter of the leader of my people. I was captured and lost my freedom, and I fell to the lot of Thabit ibn Qays, who wrote a document for my freedom for nine ounces of gold." The Prophet ﷺ  asked her, "Do you want something better than that?" She asked, "What is it?" He replied, "I will pay off your debt and marry you." She said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Then I have done it." The news spread among the people, and they said, "The in-laws of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  are taking captives and setting them free. So, free those who are in your hands from among the captives of the Banu Mustaliq." They freed a hundred families as a result of marrying Juwayriyyah. A'isha said, "I do not know of any woman who brought more blessings to her people than Juwayriyyah." This was the end of the events of the Battle of Muraysi.
hi: Aishah (RA) ne farmaya: Rasulullah (SAW) ko Bani Al-Mustaliq ke qaidi mile. Aap ne unmein se khumus nikala phir baaqi logon mein taqseem kar diya, aur sawar ko do hisse aur paidal ko ek hissa diya. Juwayriyah bint Al-Harith bin Abi Dirar (RA) Thabit bin Qays bin Shammas Al-Ansari (RA) ke hisse mein aayin. Woh apne ek chachazad bhai Safwan bin Malik bin Judhaymah ke nikah mein thin, jo qatl ho gaya. Thabit bin Qays ne unse unki azadi ke liye nau uqiyyah par kitabat kar li. Woh meethi shakl wali khatoon thin, koi unhein dekhta to unka dil le leti thin. Isi dauran Nabi (SAW) mere paas the ke Juwayriyah aayin aur apni kitabat ke bare mein aap se sawal kiya. Allah ki qasam, jaise hi maine unhein dekha mujhe unka Nabi (SAW) ke paas aana na-pasand hua, aur main jaan gayi ke aap unmein woh hi dekhenge jo maine dekha. Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main Juwayriyah bint Al-Harith hun, apni qaum ke sardar ki beti, mujh par jo guzri aap jaante hain. Main Thabit bin Qays ke hisse mein aayi, unhone meri azadi ke liye mujh se nau uqiyyah par kitabat kar li." Aap ne farmaya: "Kya iss se behtar baat chahogi?" Unhone poocha: "Woh kya?" Aap ne farmaya: "Main tumhari kitabat ada kar dun aur tum se nikah kar lun." Unhone kaha: "Ji haan, ya Rasulullah." Aap ne farmaya: "Maine kar diya." Yeh khabar logon tak pahunchi to unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sasuraliye ghulam banaye ja rahe hain!" To unhone Bani Al-Mustaliq ke jo qaidi unke haath mein the sab azaad kar diye, aur aap ke unse nikah ki wajah se sau gharane azaad ho gaye. Aishah (RA) ne farmaya: "Main nahi jaanti ke koi aurat apni qaum ke liye unse zyada barkat wali hui ho." Aur yeh aap ke Ghazwah Muraysi' se wapsi par hua.

e: [AI] He is called Musaafir, son of Safwan, son of Dhi al-Shaffar.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...use Musafi' bin Safwan bin Dhi Ash-Shufr kaha jata hai."

e: [AI] "That her name was Barrah, and the Prophet ﷺ  changed it to Juwayriyah. He disliked it being said that he divorced her (or separated from her) from Barrah, authentic on the condition of Muslim, but he did not divorce her."
hi: "Unka naam Barrah tha, Nabi (SAW) ne use badal kar Juwayriyah rakha. Aap ko yeh kehna na-pasand tha ke aap Barrah ke paas se nikle." Hakim ne kaha: "Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, magar un dono ne ise nahi nikaala."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  struck Juyeria on her face while she wore the veil, and he divided his time equally among his wives."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Juwayriyah (RA) par parda muqarrar kiya aur unke liye baari us tarah taqseem karte jis tarah apni baaqi azwaj ke liye karte the."

e: Is there anything to eat? She said: Messenger of Allah, I swear by God, there is no food with us except a bone of goat which my freed maid-servant was given as sadaqa. Upon this he said: Bring that to me, for it (the sadaqa) has reached its destination. (Using translation from Muslim 1073a)
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Rasulullah (SAW) unke paas aaye aur farmaya: 'Kuch khane ko hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, ya Rasulullah! Humare paas kuch nahi, siwaye bakri ki ek haddi ke jo meri azaad kardah (laundi) ko sadaqe se mili thi.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Use qareeb le aao, woh apni jagah pahunch chuki hai.'"

e: [AI] He heard Anas ibn Malik saying: "When the Prophet ﷺ conquered Khaybar, he chose Safiyyah bint Huyay for himself, and he came out with her walking behind him. Then I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ resting his foot for her to mount it, and when they reached the Sada' al-Sahba, he married her to himself, and he made a wedding feast for her in a tent. He ordered me to invite those around him, and that was the feast of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Mus'ab said: "And she is Safiyyah bint Huyay bin Akhtab bin Sa'eed bin Tha'labah bin 'Ubayd bin al-Khazraj bin Abi Habib bin al-Nadr bin al-Nahham bin Yanhum from the children of Israel, from the lineage of Musa upon him be peace. Her mother was Barrah bint al-Samaw'al, who died in the time of Mu'awiyah." Al-Dhahabi stopped discussing it further in his summary.
hi: Unhone Anas bin Malik (RA) ko kehte suna: "Jab Nabi (SAW) ne Khaybar fatah kiya to Safiyyah bint Huyayy (RA) ko apne liye chun liya, to Nabi (SAW) unhein apne peeche bithaye nikle." Phir kaha: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha ke aap apna paon rakhte yahan tak ke woh us par khadi hoti aur sawar ho jatin. Jab Sadd As-Sahba' pahunche to aap ne unke saath rukhsati ki, chamre ke dastarkhwan par hays banwaya aur mujhe hukm diya, maine aas paas ke logon ko bulaya, to yahi Rasulullah (SAW) ka walimah tha. Mus'ab ne kaha: "Woh Safiyyah bint Huyayy bin Akhtab bin Sa'id bin Tha'labah bin Ubayd bin Al-Khazraj bin Abi Habib bin An-Nadr bin An-Nahham bin Yanhum thin, Bani Israil mein se, Musa (AS) ke sibt (qabile) se, aur unki walida Barrah bint As-Samaw'al thin. Woh Mu'awiyah (RA) ke zamane mein faut hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered Safiyyah's tent, Abu Ayub slept at the door of the Prophet ﷺ . When morning came and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw him, he raised his voice in takbeer (saying "Allahu Akbar") and Abu Ayub had a sword with him. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, she was a newlywed woman who had just gotten married, and I had killed her father, brother, and husband. So I did not trust her with you." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  laughed and said to him, "Well done."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne Safiyyah (RA) ke saath rukhsati ki to Abu Ayyub (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) ke darwaze par raat guzari. Subah jab unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko dekha to takbeer kahi, aur Abu Ayyub ke saath talwar thi. Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Yeh ladki nayi nayi dulhan thi, aur maine uske baap, bhai aur shauhar ko qatl kiya tha, to mujhe aap ke baare mein us par bharosa nahi tha." Rasulullah (SAW) hans pade aur unse farmaya: "Khair (acchi baat)."

e: [AI] I heard Anas ibn Malik saying, "The Prophet ﷺ  once ate bread and meat at Safiyya bint Huyay's home."
hi: Maine Anas bin Malik (RA) ko kehte suna: "Nabi (SAW) ne Safiyyah bint Huyayy (RA) ke (nikah ke) mauqe par roti aur gosht khilaya."

e: [AI] "I am one of the women who accompanied Safiyyah to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . I heard her say, 'I did not reach the age of seventeen when I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .' He said, 'And Safiyyah passed away at the age of fifty-two during the time of Mu'awiyah and she was buried in the Baqi' cemetery.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Main un auraton mein se ek hun jinhone Safiyyah (RA) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas pahunchaya, to maine unhein kehte suna: "Main satrah (17) saal ki nahi hui thi, bahut hua to satrah saal ki hogi, us raat jab main Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gayi." Kaha: "Aur Safiyyah (RA) 52 Hijri mein Mu'awiyah (RA) ke zamane mein faut hui aur Baqi' mein dafan hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered upon me while I was crying, and he said, "O daughter of Huwayy, what is making you cry?" I said, "I heard that Hafsah and Aisha are criticizing me and saying that they are better than me because they are the Prophet's ﷺ  cousins and wives." He said, "Do you not say: How can they be better than me when my father is Harun, my uncle is Musa, and my husband is Muhammad, may the blessings and peace of Allah be upon them?" Adh-Dhahabi did not include this in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) mere paas aaye aur main ro rahi thi. Aap ne farmaya: "Ae Huyayy ki beti! Tumhein kya cheez rula rahi hai?" Maine kaha: "Mujhe khabar mili hai ke Hafsah (RA) aur Aishah (RA) mere baare mein baatein karti hain aur kehti hain: 'Hum unse behtar hain, hum Rasulullah (SAW) ke chacha ki betiyan aur aap ki azwaj hain.'" Aap ne farmaya: "Tum ne yeh kyun nahi kaha: 'Tum dono mujh se kaise behtar ho sakti ho jabke mere walid Harun (AS), mere chacha Musa (AS) aur mere shauhar Muhammad (SAW) hain, un sab par Allah ki rahmatein aur salam ho?'" Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I am Mus'ab Bin Kidaam. The wife of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , Maymuna bint Al-Harith bin Hazn bin Bujair bin Al-Harim bin Ruwaiba bin Abdullah bin Hilal bin Amer bin Sa'sa'a told me. Her mother is Hind bint Zuhair bin Al-Harith bin Hamata bin Harith from the tribe of Himyar.
hi: Mis'ar bin Kidam ne mujhse kaha: "Mujhse Rasulullah (SAW) ki zawjah Maymunah bint Al-Harith bin Hazn bin Bujayr bin Al-Harim bin Ruwaybah bin Abdullah bin Hilal bin Amir bin Sa'sa'ah (RA) ne bayan kiya, aur unki walida Hind bint Awf bin Zuhayr bin Al-Harith bin Hamatah bin Harith thin, Himyar mein se."

e: [AI] Rasulullah married her. Her name was Maymunah bint Al-Muttalib. Al-Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib married her to Rasulullah. He granted her a dowry of 10 miles of land near Makkah. She was the last woman whom Rasulullah married, and this occurred in the seventh year of the Qadiyyah Umrah. Ibn Umar said, "Maymunah passed away in the sixty-first year. She was the last wife of the Prophet to pass away. At the time of her death, she was eighty or eighty-one years old, and she had wrinkled skin." Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...unse. Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse nikah kiya, Al-Abbas bin Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) ne unka nikah aap se kiya, aur woh unke maamle ke zimmedar the. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Sarif mein, Makkah se das meel ke fasle par, unke saath rukhsati ki, aur woh akhri khatoon thin jin se Rasulullah (SAW) ne nikah kiya, aur yeh 7 Hijri mein Umrat Al-Qadiyyah ke mauqe par hua." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Maymunah (RA) 61 Hijri mein faut hui aur woh Nabi (SAW) ki azwaj mein sabse aakhir mein faut hone wali thin. Jis din faut hui unki umar assi ya ikyasi saal thi, aur bade hone ke bawajood tandurust thin." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The name of my aunt was Maymuna Bint Harith, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  named her Maymuna." Sahih, Al-Dhahabi said it is authentic.
hi: "Meri khala Maymunah (RA) ka naam Barrah tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Maymunah rakha."

e: [AI] The name of Maymuna was Barra, so the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him named her Maymuna. Authentic.
hi: "Maymunah (RA) ka naam Barrah tha, to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka naam Maymunah rakha."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  left in the year before the year of Hudaybiyah, performing Umrah, in the month of Dhul-Qa'dah, which is the month in which the pagans prevented him from the Sacred Mosque. When he reached Yajaj, Ja'far ibn Abi Talib sent a proposal to Maimunah bint Al-Harith ibn Hazn Al-Amiriyyah and married her. She then entrusted her affairs to Al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, her brother. He was married to her by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ  stayed in Sarif for some time until Maimunah came, and he built a house for her in Sarif. Allah the Almighty decreed the death of Maimunah bint Al-Harith after that, and she passed away where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had built the house for her.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) agle saal, Hudaybiyah ke saal ke baad, 7 Hijri Dhul Qa'dah mein umrah karne nikle, aur yeh wahi mahina tha jismein mushrikin ne aap ko Masjid Al-Haram se roka tha. Jab aap Yajaj pahunche to Ja'far bin Abi Talib (RA) ko apne aage Maymunah bint Al-Harith bin Hazn Al-Amiriyyah (RA) ke paas bheja, unhone aap ke liye paigham diya. Unhone apna maamla Al-Abbas bin Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) ke supurd kiya, aur unki behen Umm Al-Fadl (RA) unke nikah mein thin. Chunancha Al-Abbas (RA) ne unka nikah Rasulullah (SAW) se kar diya. Nabi (SAW) us ke baad kuch arse Sarif mein thehre rahe yahan tak ke Maymunah (RA) aa gayin, to aap ne Sarif mein unke saath rukhsati ki. Allah Ta'ala ne yeh muqaddar kiya ke Maymunah bint Al-Harith (RA) ki wafat uske baad kuch arse mein ho, to woh wahin faut hui jahan Rasulullah (SAW) ne unke saath rukhsati ki thi."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  married Maymunah bint Al-Harith and stayed in Makkah for three days. Then, Huwaytib ibn Abd Al-Uzza came to him with a group of Quraysh people on the third day and said to him, "Your time has expired, so leave us." He responded, "What harm would it be if you left me? I would have married among you and prepared food for you. Would you have attended?" They replied, "We have no need for your food, so leave us." Then, he left with Maymunah bint Al-Harith and married her extravagantly.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Maymunah bint Al-Harith (RA) se nikah kiya aur Makkah mein teen din thehre. Teesre din Huwaytib bin Abd Al-Uzza Quraysh ke chand logon ke saath aap ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Aap ki muddat poori ho gayi, humare yahan se nikal jaiye." Aap ne farmaya: "Tumhara kya nuqsan hota agar tum mujhe chhod dete ke main tumhare darmiyan rukhsati kar leta aur tumhare liye khana banata aur tum usmein shareek hote?" Unhone kaha: "Humein tumhare khane ki koi haajat nahi, humare yahan se nikal jao." Chunancha aap Maymunah bint Al-Harith (RA) ko le kar nikle yahan tak ke Sarif mein unke saath rukhsati ki.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married her lawfully and built with her a lawful family. He built with her a house extravagantly, and she died in that same house the night he built it. She was my aunt, so I descended into her grave along with Ibn Abbas. When we laid her in the grave, her head was too tall, so I took off my cloak, gathered it, and placed it by her head. Ibn Abbas took it and threw it, placing it by her head as a sign. Her hair was shaved during Hajj, and her head was bald. Between Sarif and Makkah, there were twelve miles."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse halal (ihram se baahar) haalat mein nikah kiya aur halal haalat mein rukhsati ki; Sarif mein rukhsati ki aur woh Sarif mein faut hui, usi raat jismein aap ne rukhsati ki thi. Woh meri khala thin, to main aur Ibn Abbas (RA) unki qabr mein utre. Jab humne unhein lahd mein rakha to unka sar ek taraf jhuk gaya. Maine apni chaadar li, use tah kiya aur unke sar ke paas rakh diya. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne use le kar phenk diya aur unke sar ke paas ek narm safed patthar rakh diya." Kaha: "Unhone Hajj mein sar mundwaya tha aur unke baal chhote the, aur Sarif aur Makkah ke darmiyan barah meel hain."

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  married while in a state of ihram," said Amr. Amr mentioned this to Az-Zuhri, who then asked, "O Amr, who do they say it is?" I said, "They say it is Maymuna." Ibn Shihab narrated to me that Yazid bin al-Asamm informed him that "the Prophet ﷺ  married her while it was halal." Amr said to Ibn Shihab, "Do you make an Arab urinate on your heels like Ibn Abbas?" Ibn Shihab said, "She is his paternal aunt." Amr said, "She is also the paternal aunt of Ibn Abbas."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne ihram ki haalat mein nikah kiya." Amr ne kaha: Maine yeh Az-Zuhri se zikr kiya to unhone kaha: "Ae Amr! Tum kise murad lete ho?" Maine kaha: "Log kehte hain Maymunah." Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Mujhe Yazid bin Al-Asamm ne khabar di ke "Nabi (SAW) ne unse halal haalat mein nikah kiya." Amr ne Ibn Shihab se kaha: "Tum ek dehati ko, jo apni edi par peshab karta hai, Ibn Abbas (RA) ke barabar thehrate ho?" Ibn Shihab ne kaha: "Woh unki khala hain." Amr ne kaha: "Woh Ibn Abbas ki bhi khala hain."

e: [AI] Indeed, Allah has guided you until He made you among the family of His prophet. And by Allah, Maymuna is blessed, and you were thrown by your spear upon your prey. Surely, it was from the perfection and closeness to Allah, Almighty, and it connected us to our relatives.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein aage badhaya yahan tak ke tumhein apne Nabi ke ahl-e-bait mein shamil kar diya. Allah ki qasam, Maymunah (RA) chali gayin, aur tumhari lagam tumhari gardan par daal di gayi (ab tumhein rokne wali na rahi). Khabardar! Woh hum mein Allah Ta'ala se sabse zyada darne wali aur sabse zyada silah-rehmi karne wali thin."

e: [AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out one night from me, so I closed the door on him. He came to seek permission, but I refused to open it. He said, "I swear that you will not open it for me." I said to him, "You will go to your wives in my night." He said, "I did not do anything, but I found traces of urine."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ek raat mere paas se bahar nikle, maine unke peeche darwaza band kar liya. Aap aaye aur darwaza kholne ko kaha, magar maine kholne se inkaar kar diya. Aap ne farmaya: "Main tumhein qasam deta hun ke mere liye darwaza khol do." Maine kaha: "Aap meri raat mein apni (doosri) azwaj ke paas jaate hain." Aap ne farmaya: "Maine aisa nahi kiya, balki mujhe peshab ki ruki hui haajat mahsoos hui thi." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The sisters are believers: Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , and her sister Umm al-Fadl bint al-Harith, and her sister Salma bint al-Harith, the wife of Hamzah, and Asma' bint 'Umays, their mother's sister."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Behnein momina hain: Maymunah (RA) jo Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah hain, unki behen Umm Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith (RA), unki behen Salma bint Al-Harith (RA) jo Hamzah (RA) ki biwi thin, aur Asma bint Umays (RA) jo maa ki taraf se unki behen hain."

e: [AI] Ibn Abbas said, "This is Maymunah. When you lift her bier, do not shake or move it, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had nine wives, he would divide his time among eight and leave one without division." Ata said, "That one is Safiyyah."
hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh Maymunah (RA) hain. Jab tum inka janaza uthao to ise na hilao na jhatke do, kyunke Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas nau azwaj thin, aap aath ke liye baari taqseem karte aur ek ke liye taqseem nahi karte the." Ata ne kaha: "Woh Safiyyah (RA) thin."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, may peace be upon him, married Maymuna bint al-Harith ibn Frawah. She was the sister of Umm al-Fadl, the wife of Abbas ibn Abdul-Muttalib. He married her when he was performing umrah in Makkah, and she offered herself to the Prophet, may peace be upon him. In her, the verse was revealed: "And a believing woman may offer herself to the Prophet, if the Prophet wishes to marry her - [this is] only for you and not for the believers" (Quran 33:50). Then, she accompanied him to Madinah. Before that, she was with Frawah ibn Abdal Uzza ibn Assad from the Banu Tamim ibn Dawdan tribe. This was mentioned by al-Dhahabi in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Maymunah bint Al-Harith bin Farwah (RA) se nikah kiya, jo Al-Abbas bin Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) ki biwi Umm Al-Fadl (RA) ki behen hain, jab aap ne Makkah mein umrah kiya. Unhone apne aap ko Nabi (SAW) ke liye hibah kar diya tha, aur unhi ke baare mein yeh aayat nazil hui: "Aur koi momina aurat agar apne aap ko Nabi ke liye hibah kar de, agar Nabi use nikah mein lena chahein, yeh sirf aap ke liye khaas hai, momineen ke siwa" (Surah Al-Ahzab 50). Phir woh aap ke saath Madinah gayin. Woh aap se pehle Farwah bin Abd Al-Uzza bin Asad ke nikah mein thin, jo Bani Tamim bin Dudan mein se tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, married Zainab bint Khuzayma, who was previously married to Abdullah ibn Jahsh and he was killed on the day of Uhud.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zaynab bint Khuzaymah (RA) se nikah kiya jo Bani Hilal bin Amir mein se ek thin, aur woh aap se pehle Abdullah bin Jahsh (RA) ke nikah mein thin, jo Uhud ke din shaheed hue."

e: [AI] Zaynab bint Khuzaymah bin Al-Harith bin Abdullah bin Amr bin Abd Manaf bin Hilal bin Amir bin Sa'sa'a, the mother of the needy, passed away in Madinah after the Hijrah during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Al-Dhahabi remained silent about her in his summary.
hi: "Zaynab bint Khuzaymah bin Al-Harith bin Abdullah bin Amr bin Abd Manaf bin Hilal bin Amir bin Sa'sa'ah (RA) faut hui. Woh 'Ummul Masakin' (miskinon ki maa) thin, jahiliyyat mein bhi unhein isi naam se pukara jata tha. Woh hijrat ke baad Madinah mein Rasulullah (SAW) ki hayaat mein faut hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married Zainab bint Khuzaimah, who was the mother of the poor from the tribe of Banu 'Amir ibn Sa'sa'a. She was previously married to Tufail ibn al-Harith, but he passed away and she later passed away in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ , and she did not stay with him for long. Goldziher remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: "Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zaynab bint Khuzaymah (RA) se nikah kiya, jo Ummul Masakin thin aur Bani Amir bin Sa'sa'ah mein se thin. Woh aap se pehle At-Tufayl bin Al-Harith ke nikah mein thin. Woh Nabi (SAW) ke nikah mein faut hui aur aap ke paas bohot thodi muddat rahin." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married Al-'Aliyah, a woman from the Banu Bakr ibn Kilab."
hi: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Al-Aliyah se nikah kiya, jo Bani Bakr bin Kilab ki ek khatoon thin."

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ married a woman from the Banu Ghifar tribe. When she entered upon him and removed her clothes, he noticed the whiteness of her skin. The Prophet ﷺ told her, "Cover yourself with your clothes and join your family." He also ordered her to be given the marriage gift saying, "This is not what a generous person does, it is the dowry for Umm Salamah bint al-Nu'man al-Ghifariyyah." Ibn Ma'in says he is not trustworthy.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bani Ghifar ki ek khatoon se nikah kiya. Jab woh aap ke paas aayin aur apne kapde utare to aap ne unke pehlu par safedi dekhi. Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Apne kapde pehen lo aur apne ghar walon ke paas chali jao", aur unke liye mahr ada karne ka hukm diya. (Raawi ne kaha:) "Yeh Al-Kilabiyyah nahi hai, yeh to Asma bint An-Nu'man Al-Ghifariyyah hain." Ibn Ma'in ne kaha: "Zayd thiqah nahi hai."

e: [AI] Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ married Asma bint al-Nu'man al-Ghifariyah, who was the daughter of Nu'man ibn al-Harith ibn Sharahil ibn Nu'man. When he entered upon her, he invited her and she said, "Come." He divorced her. Al-Dhahabi did not mention her in the summary.
hi: "Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne Yaman walon mein se Asma bint An-Nu'man Al-Ghifariyyah se nikah kiya, jo An-Nu'man bin Al-Harith bin Sharahil bin An-Nu'man ki beti thin. Jab aap ne unke saath rukhsati ki to unhein bulaya, unhone kaha: 'Aap hi aaiye', to aap ne unhein talaq de di." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married Umm Sharik, a woman from the Ansar tribe of Banu Najjar, and he said, "I want to marry among the Ansar". Then he said, "I dislike their jealousy", so he did not enter into a marriage with her. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bani An-Najjar ki Ansari khatoon Umm Sharik se nikah kiya aur farmaya: "Mujhe Ansar mein nikah karna pasand hai." Phir farmaya: "Mujhe unki ghairat na-pasand hai." To aap ne unke saath rukhsati nahi ki. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  married Sanaa bint Asmaa bin As-Salit As-Sulamiyyah, but she passed away before he could consummate the marriage with her."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Sana bint Asma bin As-Salt As-Sulamiyyah se nikah kiya, to woh rukhsati se pehle faut ho gayin."

e: [AI] And some of them said, "There was only one dog, but they differed in its name." And some of them said, "No, we were all dogs, but each one of us had a different story than its owner." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Aur ba'z ne kaha: "Kilabiyyah sirf ek hi thi, bas uske naam mein ikhtilaf hua hai." Aur ba'z ne kaha: "Balki woh sab thin, magar unmein se har ek ka qissa doosri ke qisse se alag hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married al-Kilabiyyah. When she entered upon him and got closer to him, she said, "I seek refuge in Allah from you." He replied, "Indeed, you have sought refuge with a great Guardian, the one who has rights over his family." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summarization.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne Al-Kilabiyyah se nikah kiya. Jab woh aap ke paas aayin aur aap unke qareeb hue to unhone kaha: "Main aap se Allah ki panah mangti hun." Aap ne farmaya: "Tum ne bohot azeem hasti ki panah li hai, apne ghar walon ke paas chali jao." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "I asked Zuhri: 'Which of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ sought refuge with Allah from him? He said : "Urwah told me, (narrating) from 'Aishah, that when the daughter of Jawn entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he came close to her, she said: "I seek refuge with Allah from you." the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said : "You have sought refuge in the Almighty" go to your family." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2050)
hi: Maine Az-Zuhri se poocha: "Nabi (SAW) ki azwaj mein se kisne aap se panah mangi?" Unhone kaha: Mujhe Urwah ne Aishah (RA) se khabar di ke Abu Al-Jawn ki beti jab aap ke paas aayi aur aap unke qareeb hue to unhone kaha: "Main aap se Allah ki panah mangti hun." Aap ne farmaya: "Tum ne bohot azeem hasti ki panah li hai, apne ghar walon ke paas chali jao." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married a woman named Kindah, who was unhappy and asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to return her to her people and allow her to leave him. He agreed and returned her to a man from the Ansar, known as Abu Usayd Al-Sa'idi. Ibnu Hajar Al-Asqalani did not mention this incident in his summarization.
hi: Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Kindah ki ek khatoon se nikah kiya, aur yeh wahi bad-naseeb khatoon thin jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) se darkhwast ki ke unhein unki qaum ke paas lauta dein aur unse alag ho jayen. Aap ne aisa hi kiya aur unhein Ansar ke ek aadmi Abu Usayd As-Sa'idi (RA) ke saath wapas bhej diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Nu'man ibn Abi Jawn al-Kindi arrived and he used to stay in the land of his father after the drinking water. So he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  as a Muslim and said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ , would you allow me to marry the most beautiful woman among the Arabs? She used to be married to her cousin, but he passed away and she has desired you and proposed to you." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married her for twelve ounces of gold and a horse. Nu'man ibn Abi Jawn said, "May sorrow be upon you, O Messenger of Allah, send someone to take my wives to you, for I am leaving with your Messenger." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent Abu Usayd As-Sa'di. When they arrived, she sat in her house and gave permission for him to enter. Abu Usayd said, "The wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  do not compete with men." Abu Usayd continued, "I sent a message to the Prophet ﷺ  and he made things easy for me. He said there should be a curtain between you and any men you talk to, except for those who are forbidden to you." She accepted and Abu Usayd said, "I stayed with her for three days, and then I carried her on a camel to Medina and settled her in Bani Sa'dah. The women of the area came to her and welcomed her, and they praised her beauty." Abu Usayd said, "Then I returned to the Prophet ﷺ  while he was in Bani 'Amr ibn 'Awf and told him what happened. He entered her room along with the women who wanted to see her because of her beauty. She said to him, 'You are from the kings. If you want to enjoy yourself with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , seek refuge from me, for you will be indulged by him, and he will desire you.'"
hi: An-Nu'man bin Abi Jawn Al-Kindi aaye, woh aur unke baap ke ghar wale Najd mein Ash-Sharbah ke qareeb rehte the. Woh Islam laa kar Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Kya main aap ka nikah Arab ki sabse haseen bewa se na kara dun? Woh apne chachazad ke nikah mein thi, woh faut ho gaya to woh bewa ho gayi, woh aap mein raghbat rakhti hai aur aap ko paigham diya ja chuka hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse barah uqiyyah aur ek nashsh mahr par nikah kiya. Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Mahr mein unke saath kami na kijiye." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Maine apni kisi biwi ko isse zyada mahr nahi diya, aur na apni betiyon mein se kisi ko isse zyada deta hun." An-Nu'man bin Abi Jawn ne kaha: "To aap hi mein namuna hai." Phir kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Apne ghar walon ki taraf kisi ko bhejiye jo unhein aap tak le aaye, kyunke main aap ke qasid ke saath nikal raha hun, aur woh aap ke ahl ko uske saath bhej dega." To Rasulullah (SAW) ne Abu Usayd As-Sa'idi (RA) ko bheja. Jab woh dono unke paas pahunche to woh apne ghar mein baith gayin aur unhein andar aane ki ijazat di. Abu Usayd ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki azwaj ko mard nahi dekhte." Abu Usayd ne kaha: Yeh parde ki aayat nazil hone ke baad ki baat hai. Maine aap (SAW) ko kehla bheja to aap ne mere liye maamla aasan kar diya. Farmaya: "Tumhare aur un mardon ke darmiyan jinse tum baat karo parda ho, siwaye tumhare mahram ke." Unhone yeh qubool kar liya. Abu Usayd ne kaha: Main teen din thehra, phir main unhein ek oont par, ek mahfah (howdah) mein, sawari ke saath le kar chala yahan tak ke Madinah pahunch gaya aur unhein Bani Sa'idah mein utara. Mohalle ki auratein unke paas aayin, unhein khush aamdeed kaha, unke liye aasani ki aur nikal gayin, to unhone unke husn ka zikr kiya aur yeh baat Madinah mein phail gayi aur log unke aane ki baatein karne lage. Abu Usayd As-Sa'idi (RA) ne kaha: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas laut aaya jo us waqt Bani Amr bin Awf mein the, aur aap ko khabar di. Auraton mein se ek unke husn ki khabar sun kar unke paas gayi, aur woh sabse haseen auraton mein se thin. Usne kaha: "Tum to malikaon mein se ho, agar tum chahti ho ke Rasulullah (SAW) ke yahan qadr paao to un se panah maango, to tum unke yahan qadr paogi aur woh tum mein raghbat karenge." Adh-Dhahabi ne kaha: "Iski sanad bohot kamzor (waahi) hai."

e: [AI] Abu Ubaydah Mamarr bin Al-Muthanna then married the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when the delegation of Kindah Qutaylah bin Qays, the sister of Ash'ath bin Qays, arrived in the tenth year. Then, he fell ill halfway through Safar and passed away on Monday, having been bedridden for two days in the month of Rabi al-Awwal. She did not meet him nor did he have relations with her. Some of them timed their marriage to her and claimed that he married her a month before his death. Others claimed that he married her during his illness. And some claimed that he recommended that Qutaylah have the choice, and if she wanted, she could choose marriage. So, Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl married her in Hadramaut. Abu Bakr was informed about it and said, "I intended to punish them." Umar bin Al-Khattab said, "She is not one of the mothers of the believers, and the Prophet ﷺ did not have relations with her, nor did he hit her with a veil." Some claimed that she apostatized.
hi: Abu Ubaydah Ma'mar bin Al-Muthanna ne kaha: "Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne, jab Kindah ka wafd aap ke paas aaya, 10 Hijri mein Qutaylah bint Qays se nikah kiya jo Al-Ash'ath bin Qays ki behen hain. Phir aap safar ke nisf mein beemar hue, phir Rabi' Al-Awwal ke do din guzarne par Peer ke din aap ka wisaal hua. Woh aap ke paas aayi thin na aap ne unke saath rukhsati ki." Ba'z ne unke nikah ka waqt muqarrar kiya aur kaha ke aap ne wisaal se ek mahina pehle unse nikah kiya, aur doosron ka khayal hai ke aap ne bimari ke dauran nikah kiya, aur doosron ka khayal hai ke aap ne wasiyat ki thi ke Qutaylah ko ikhtiyar diya jaye, agar chahein to nikah ko chunein, chunancha Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl (RA) ne Hadramawt mein unse nikah kar liya. Yeh khabar Abu Bakr (RA) tak pahunchi to unhone kaha: "Maine irada kiya tha ke un dono ko jala dun." Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne kaha: "Woh Ummahat ul-Mu'mineen mein se nahi hain, na Nabi (SAW) ne unke saath rukhsati ki, na un par parda muqarrar kiya." Aur ba'z ka khayal hai ke woh murtad ho gayin.

e: [AI] "And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked for the hand of Maria al-Qibtiyya in marriage, and she gave birth to Ibrahim for him."
hi: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Mariyah Al-Qibtiyyah ko apne liye (laundi ke taur par) rakha, to unse Ibrahim paida hue."

e: Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ married Mariah b. Shamun, who was gifted to him by the Muqawqis (Cyrus, man of the Caucasus), the ruler of Alexandria. She came with her sister Sirin and a eunuch called Mabur. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gifted Sirin to Hassan b. Thabit. Coptic Muqawqis and them were Christians. Mariah bore Ibrahim to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah in the eighth year of Hijrah. Ibrahim died in Madinah when he was eighteen months old.
hi: Phir Rasulullah (SAW) ne Mariyah bint Shamun se nikah kiya, jinhein Iskandariyah ke hukmran Al-Muqawqis ne Rasulullah (SAW) ko tohfe mein bheja tha, aur unke saath unki behen Sirin aur ek khasi (khwaja-sara) jise Mabur kaha jata tha bhi bheje. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Sirin ko Hassan bin Thabit (RA) ko hibah kar diya. Al-Muqawqis Qibt mein se tha jo nasrani the. Mariyah ne Rasulullah (SAW) ke liye Ibrahim (AS) ko 8 Hijri ke Dhul Hijjah mein janam diya, aur Ibrahim (AS) Madinah mein faut hue jabke woh atharah mahine ke the.

e: [AI] When Ibrahim, the son of the Prophet ﷺ, passed away, Al-Dhahabi deleted the part about him having a wet nurse in heaven from the summary.
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ke bete Ibrahim (AS) faut hue to aap ne farmaya: "Beshak Jannat mein uske liye ek doodh pilane wali hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] Maryam and her cousin accompanied the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. She claimed that she fell and continued to carry a child. She said that her cousin separated her from him. The people of falsehood and deceit accused her of wanting a child from someone other than her husband. Her mother did not produce much milk, so she bought a lactating sheep to feed him with her milk. His flesh improved because of it. Aisha said that one day, he was brought to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and he asked her, "How do you see him?" She replied, "Whoever is fed with sheep's flesh has good flesh." He said, "And similarities as well." She expressed jealousy, so the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ordered Ali to take a sword and strike the neck of Maryam's cousin wherever he found him. She said that Ali went and found the cousin sitting on a palm tree, eating dates. When he saw Ali approaching with the sword, he became frightened, causing his cloth to fall and revealing that he had nothing that men possess.
hi: Mariyah (RA) ko Rasulullah (SAW) ko tohfe mein diya gaya aur unke saath unke ek chachazad bhi the. (Aishah (RA) ne) kaha: Aap unke paas gaye, ek baar, aur woh hamila rah gayin. Kaha: Aap ne unhein unke chachazad ke paas rakha. Kaha: To jhoot aur buhtan walon ne kaha ke aulad ki haajat ki wajah se aap ne kisi aur ke bachche ka dawa kar liya. Unki walida ke paas doodh kam tha, to unhone unke liye doodh dene wali bhed kharidi, woh uske doodh se paala gaya to uska jism achcha ho gaya. Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Ek din use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laya gaya to aap ne poocha: "Tum kaisa dekhti ho?" Maine kaha: "Jise bhed ka gosht khilaya jaye uska jism achcha ho jata hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Aur shabahat nahi?" Kaha: To auraton wali ghairat ne mujhe is par aamada kar diya ke main kah baithi: "Mujhe shabahat nazar nahi aati." Kaha: Aur Rasulullah (SAW) tak woh baat pahunchi jo log keh rahe the, to aap ne Ali (RA) se farmaya: "Yeh talwar lo aur jao, Mariyah ke chachazad ki gardan maar do jahan bhi use paao." Kaha: Woh chale, to dekha woh ek baagh mein khajoor ke darakht par taza khajoor tod raha tha. Jab usne Ali (RA) ko talwar liye dekha to use kapkapi chha gayi. Kaha: Uska kapda gir gaya to dekha ke Allah Ta'ala ne uske liye mardon wali koi cheez paida hi nahi ki thi, woh kata hua (mamsuh) tha. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr used to spend on Maria until she passed away, then Umar started spending on her until she also passed away during his caliphate." Ibn Umar said, "Maria, the mother of Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , passed away in Muharram, in the sixteenth year of Hijrah. Umar announced the funeral and prayed over her, and she was buried in Al-Baqi' cemetery."
hi: "Abu Bakr (RA) Mariyah (RA) par kharch karte rahe yahan tak ke faut hue, phir Umar (RA) un par kharch karte rahe yahan tak ke woh unki khilafat mein faut hui." Ibn Umar ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) ke bete Ibrahim ki walida Mariyah (RA) 16 Hijri ke Muharram mein faut hui. Umar (RA) ko dekha gaya ke woh logon ko unke janaze mein hazir karwa rahe the, phir Umar (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhayi aur unki qabr Baqi' mein hai."

e: [AI] "That the mother of Ibrahim was accused of adultery, so the Prophet ﷺ ordered for him to be executed. They looked, and there he was, decapitated." I said to Yahya, "Who told you this?" He said, "Affan reported it from Hammad ibn Salama."
hi: "Ibrahim ki walida par ek aadmi ke saath tohmat lagayi gayi, to Nabi (SAW) ne uski gardan maarne ka hukm diya. Logon ne dekha to woh majboob (jiska zakar kata hua tha) nikla." (Raawi ne kaha:) Maine Yahya se poocha: "Aap se yeh kisne bayan kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Affan ne Hammad bin Salamah se."

e: Go and strike his neck. 'Ali came to him and he found him in a well making his body cool. 'Ali said to him: Come out, and as he took hold of his hand and brought him out, he found that his sexual organ had been cut. Hadrat 'Ali refrained from striking his neck. He came to Allah's Apostle ﷺ and said: Messenger of Allah, he has not even the sexual organ with him. (Using translation from Muslim 2771)
hi: Ek aadmi par Rasulullah (SAW) ke bete Ibrahim ki walida ke saath tohmat lagayi jati thi. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ali (RA) se farmaya: "Jao aur uski gardan maar do." Ali (RA) uske paas aaye to woh ek kuyen mein thanda hone ke liye utra hua tha. Ali (RA) ne kaha: "Bahar nikalo." Usne apna haath diya aur unhone use bahar nikala, to dekha woh majboob hai, uska zakar hai hi nahi.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ took me by the hand, and I went with him to Ibrahim, his son, who was playing by himself. The Prophet ﷺ took him into his room and kept him there until his soul departed. He then placed him down and cried. I said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, you cry even though you have forbidden crying?" He said, "I have not forbidden crying, but I have forbidden two foolish and sinful voices: a voice produced during idle entertainment, play, and the devil's flutes, and a voice produced during a calamity that involves striking faces and tearing garments. This is mercy, and whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy. If it were not for the fact that it is a true promise and a true saying, and that the first will join the latter, we would have been more sorrowful for you than this. Indeed, O Ibrahim, our eyes shed tears, our hearts grieve, but we do not say anything that angers the Lord." (This part has been excluded by Al-Dhahabi in his summary.)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne mera haath pakda aur main aap ke saath aap ke bete Ibrahim ke paas gaya, woh jaan de rahe the. Nabi (SAW) ne unhein apni godh mein le liya yahan tak ke unki ruh nikal gayi. Kaha: Phir aap ne unhein rakha aur roye. Kaha: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Aap rote hain jabke aap rone se mana karte hain?" Aap ne farmaya: "Maine rone se mana nahi kiya, balki maine do ahmaq aur badkaar awazon se mana kiya hai: ek awaaz khel tamashe ke raag aur shaitan ke baajon ke waqt, aur ek awaaz museebat ke waqt chehra peetne aur girebaan phaadne ki. Aur yeh (rona) rahmat hai, aur jo raham nahi karta us par raham nahi kiya jata. Agar yeh sachcha wada, haq baat aur yeh na hota ke hamare pehle waale hamare baad walon se mil jayenge, to hum tum par is se bhi zyada gham karte. Ae Ibrahim! Hum tumhari judai par gamgeen hain. Aankh rote hai, dil gamgeen hota hai, aur hum woh baat nahi kehte jo Rabb ko naraz kare." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, walked barefoot behind the funeral procession of his son Ibrahim."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) apne bete Ibrahim ke janaze ke peeche nange paon chale." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Maryam, the mother of the Prophet ﷺ , passed away in Al-Madinah in the year seventeen. Amir al-Mu'minin Umar ibn al-Khattab performed the funeral prayers for her, and she was buried in Al-Baqi'.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ki ummul walad Mariyah (RA) Madinah mein 17 Hijri mein faut hui, Amir ul-Mu'mineen Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhayi, aur woh Baqi' mein dafan hui."

e: [AI] Rarely would a person come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complaining of pain, except that he would say to him, "Perform hijamah (cupping)." And if he had pain in his feet, he would say to him, "Rub them with henna." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Aisa kam hota tha ke koi aadmi Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aa kar kisi dard ki shikayat kare aur aap use na farmayen: "Pachhne lagwao (hijamah karo)", aur paon ke dard ki shikayat par farmate: "Dono ko mehndi se rang lo." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] From Maymuna bint Saad, a slave woman of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was asked about the offspring of adultery. He replied, "Two sandals that I strive with them are more beloved to me than freeing the offspring of adultery." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki azaad kardah Maymunah bint Sa'd (RA) se, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) se walad-e-zina ke baare mein poocha gaya. Aap ne farmaya: "Do jooton ka joda jinke saath main jihad karun, mujhe is se zyada pasand hai ke main walad-e-zina ko azaad karun." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I entered upon Umm Imama, the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and she said, "I was once pouring water onto his (the Prophet's) hands while he was performing ablution when a man entered and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I want to return to my family, so give me some advice that I can hold on to.' He (the Prophet) said, 'Do not associate anything with Allah, even if you are cut into pieces and burned in fire. Do not disobey your parents, even if they command you to leave your family and worldly possessions behind, so obey them and do not neglect intentionally performing prayers, for whoever intentionally neglects it has no guarantee from Allah the Almighty or from His Messenger ﷺ . Do not consume alcohol, as it is the root of every sin. Do not exceed limits in your boundaries, for you will come on the Day of Resurrection with the weight of seven earths on your neck. Do not flee on the day of battle, for whoever flees on that day has earned the wrath of Allah, and his abode will be Hellfire, and what an evil destination it is. Spend on your family according to your means, and do not raise your stick (to harm them) and hide them from Allah the Almighty.'" According to the transmitted chain.
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki azaad kardah Umaymah (RA) ke paas gaya. Unhone kaha: Ek din main aap ke haathon par paani daal rahi thi jabke aap wudu kar rahe the, ke ek aadmi aap ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main apne ghar walon ke paas wapas jana chahta hun, mujhe koi wasiyat kijiye jo main yaad rakhun." Aap ne farmaya: "Allah ke saath kisi cheez ko shareek na karna, chahe tumhare tukde kar diye jayen aur tumhein aag mein jala diya jaye. Apne walidain ki nafarmani na karna, chahe woh tumhein apne ahl aur dunya se alag hone ka hukm dein to alag ho jana. Jaan-boojh kar namaz na chhodna, kyunke jisne jaan-boojh kar namaz chhodi us se Allah Ta'ala aur uske Rasool (SAW) ka zimma bari ho gaya. Sharab na peena, kyunke woh har gunah ki jad hai. Zameen ki hadbandiyon mein (nahaq) izafa na karna, kyunke tum qayamat ke din is haal mein aaoge ke tumhari gardan mein saat zameenon ke barabar bojh hoga. Jang ke din bhaagna nahi, kyunke jo jang ke din bhaaga wo Allah ke ghazab ka mustahiq hua aur uska thikana Jahannam hai aur woh bura thikana hai. Apne ahl par apni gunjaish ke mutabiq kharch karna, unse apni laathi na utha lena, aur unhein Allah Ta'ala ke maamle mein darate rehna."

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sought shelter in a garden from the tribe of Quraizah, and it became joined with its people."
hi: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ne Bani Qurayzah ki Rayhanah ko (laundi ke taur par) rakha, phir woh apne ghar walon se ja mili."

e: [AI] Abu Ubaidah Ma'mar ibn al-Muthanna mentioned that Rayhana bint Zayd ibn Sam'un from the Banu al-Nadir, whom some said belonged to the Banu Qurayza, was one of the milk yamin of the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ . She used to be among the palm trees, and the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  would sometimes take a nap with her. He captured her in Shawwal in the fourth year. Abu Ubaidah stated that they were four: Maria al-Qibtiyya, Rayhana, and Jumeila, whom he acquired as captives and his wives feared they would have dominance over them. He also had another concubine, Nafisa, who was gifted to him by Zainab bint Jahsh. He had distanced himself from her concerning the matter of Safiyya bint Huyayy in the months of Dhu al-Hijjah, Muharram, and Safar. When the month of Rabi' al-Awwal came, during which the Messenger of Allah  ﷺ  passed away, he became pleased with Zainab and visited her. She said, 'I do not know how to repay you,' and gifted her to him  ﷺ . Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in "Al-Talkhis."
hi: Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki laundiyon mein Rayhanah bint Zayd bin Sam'un thin, Bani An-Nadir mein se, ba'z ne kaha Bani Qurayzah mein se, aur woh khajoor ke baagh mein rehti thin. "Rasulullah (SAW) kabhi kabhi unke paas qailulah farmate the, aur aap ne unhein Shawwal 4 Hijri mein qaid kiya tha." Abu Ubaydah ne kaha: "Aur woh chaar hain: Mariyah Al-Qibtiyyah, Rayhanah, Jumaylah jo aap ko qaidiyon mein mili thi to aap ki azwaj ko khauf hua ke woh unpar ghalib aa jayegi, aur ek aur nafees laundi jo Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) ne aap ko hibah ki thi." Aap ne unse Safiyyah bint Huyayy ke maamle mein Dhul Hijjah, Muharram aur Safar mein kinara kiya tha. Phir Rabi' Al-Awwal ka mahina aaya jismein Rasulullah (SAW) ka wisaal hua to aap Zaynab (RA) se raazi ho gaye aur unke paas gaye. Unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi maloom main aap ko kya badla dun", aur woh laundi aap ko hibah kar di. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The eldest daughter of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  was Zainab, the daughter of Khadija."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ki betiyon mein sabse badi Zaynab bint Khadijah (RA) thin."

e: [AI] I heard 'Ubaydullah bin Muhammad bin Sulaiman Al-Hashimi saying, "Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , was born in the thirtieth year after the birth of the Prophet ﷺ  in Makkah, and she passed away in the eighth year of the Hijrah."
hi: Maine Ubaydullah bin Muhammad bin Sulayman Al-Hashimi ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) Nabi (SAW) ki paidaish ke tees (30) saal baad Makkah mein paida huin aur 8 Hijri mein faut hui."

e: [AI] Zainab bint Rasul Allah (pbuh) said, as I was preparing in Mecca to go to my father, Hind bint Utbah ibn Rabiah followed me. She said, "O daughter of Muhammad, did it not reach me that you intend to leave with your father?" I said, "I did not intend that." She said, "O cousin's daughter, do not do that. If you have any needs for supplies for your journey and want me to deliver them to your father, I will do it because I have a need from you." Zainab said, "By Allah, I did not see it except for her to do so." She said, "But I was afraid of her, so I denied that I intended it and I prepared myself. When I finished my preparations, my brother-in-law Kananah ibn al-Rabi'a came and he brought a camel for me. I rode on it, and he took his bow and his spear and led me out in broad daylight while I was in my litter. The men of Quraysh spoke about it and went out in search of her until they caught up with her at Dhu Tuwa. The first one to reach her was Hubbab ibn al-Aswad ibn al-Muttalib ibn Asad ibn Abdul-Uzza, and Nafi' ibn Abd Qais al-Fihri, a relative of the Banu Abi 'Ubayd, from Iffriqiyyah. Hubbab intimidated them with his spear while she was in her litter, and the woman was pregnant as they claimed. When she was on the verge of giving birth, I exposed her belly, so her father-in-law blessed it and his spear fell. He said, "No man comes near me except that I will strike him with an arrow." The people hesitated about him, and Abu Sufyan of the Quraysh came to him in a delegation, saying, "O man, cease your actions against us until we converse with you." Then Abu Sufyan approached him until he stood in front of him and said, "Indeed, you did not achieve what you wanted. You left with the woman in public, and our misfortune and calamity are known. Muhammad (pbuh) has not come to us thinking that we have humiliated ourselves for our misfortune. It is weakness and despair for us. By my life, we are not withholding her from her father out of necessity, but return with the woman until the voices settle and people say that we have returned her, then secretly guide her back to her father." He did as he was told, and he returned and stayed for several nights until the voices settled. Then he took her out at night and handed her over to Zaid ibn Harithah and his companion. They brought her to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh).
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) se riwayat hai, unhone kaha: Main Makkah mein apne walid ke paas jane ki tayyari kar rahi thi ke Hind bint Utbah bin Rabi'ah mere peeche aayi aur kaha: "Ae Muhammad ki beti! Kya mujhe yeh khabar nahi pahunchi ke tum apne walid se milne ka irada rakhti ho?" Maine kaha: "Maine aisa irada nahi kiya." Usne kaha: "Ae chachazad behen! Aisa na karo. Agar tumhein safar ke saaman ki zaroorat ho jo tumhare kaam aaye aur jis se tum apne walid tak pahunch jao, to meri paas tumhari zaroorat ki cheez maujood hai." Zaynab (RA) ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mera khayal hai ke usne yeh sirf isliye kaha ke woh (mujhe rokne ka kaam) kare." Kaha: Magar mujhe us se khauf hua to maine inkaar kar diya ke main aisa irada rakhti hun. Phir maine tayyari ki. Jab main tayyari se farigh hui to mere dewar Kinanah bin Ar-Rabi', mere shauhar ke bhai, aaye. Unhone mere liye ek oont pesh kiya, main us par sawar hui, unhone apni kaman aur tarkash li aur mujhe din ke waqt le kar nikle, jabke woh apne hawdaj mein thin, woh oont ki lagam pakde hue the. Quraysh ke mardon ne is baat ka charcha kiya aur unki talash mein nikle yahan tak ke unhein Dhu Tuwa mein jaa liya. Sabse pehle unke paas Habbar bin Al-Aswad bin Al-Muttalib bin Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza pahuncha, aur Nafi bin Abd Qays Al-Fihri, Bani Abi Ubayd se qarabat ki wajah se, Ifriqiyah mein (matn mein isi tarah hai). Habbar ne nezey se unhein daraane lage jabke woh apne hawdaj mein thin, aur woh khatoon hamila thin, jaisa unka gumaan hai. Jab woh khauf zada hui to unhone apna hamal gira diya. Unke dewar ne oont bitha diya, apna tarkash undel diya aur kaha: "Mere qareeb koi aadmi nahi aayega magar main us mein teer utaar dunga." Log un se peeche hat gaye. Abu Sufyan Quraysh ke chand bade logon ke saath aaya aur kaha: "Ae aadmi! Apne teer rok lo yahan tak ke hum tum se baat karein." Unhone teer rok liye. Abu Sufyan aage badha yahan tak ke unke paas aa kar khada hua aur kaha: "Tum ne durust nahi kiya. Tum us khatoon ko logon ke saamne khullam khulla le nikle, halanke tum hamari museebat aur shikast aur jo kuch Muhammad (SAW) ki taraf se humein pahuncha hai jaante ho. Log yeh samjhenge ke unki beti ko hamare darmiyan se khullam khulla un ke paas le jaya gaya, yeh us zillat ki wajah se hai jo humein pahunchi, hamari us museebat ki wajah se, aur yeh hamari kamzori aur bechargi hai. Meri jaan ki qasam, humein unhein unke walid se rokne ki koi haajat nahi, magar tum is khatoon ko wapas le jao, jab shor thande par jaye aur log keh den ke humne unhein wapas kar diya, to chupke se unhein le jana aur unke walid se mila dena." Kaha: Unhone aisa hi kiya, wapas laute, woh kuch raatein thehri rahin, jab shor thanda par gaya to woh unhein raat ko le kar nikle yahan tak ke unhein Zayd bin Harithah (RA) aur unke saathi ke supurd kar diya, to woh dono unhein le kar Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aaye.

e: [AI] Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, narrated that when the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina, his daughter Zainab came from Makkah with kinana or the son of kinana. They were following her in her journey. Hubbār ibn al-Aswad caught up with her and kept stabbing her camel with his spear until he caused it to stumble and what was in her belly was cast out and blood was shed. She became pregnant and the Banu Hashim and the Banu Umayyah disputed over her. The Banu Umayyah said, "We have more right to her," and she was under the care of their cousin Abu al-'As. They brought her to Hind bint Utba ibn Rabiah, and Hind used to say to her, "This is because of your father." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Zaid ibn Haritha, "Do not go until you bring Zainab to me." He said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Take my ring and give it to her." Zaid left and left his camel behind. He kept walking until he met a shepherd and asked him, "Who do you look after?" He said, "Abu al-'As." He said, "Whose are these sheep?" He said, "They belong to Zainab bint Muhammad." He walked with him for a while, then he said, "Do you mind if I give you something to give to her and not mention it to anyone?" He said, "Yes." He gave him the ring, and the shepherd went home and gave it to her. She recognized it and asked, "Who gave you this?" He said, "A man." She asked, "Where did you leave him?" He said, "In such and such a place." She remained silent until nightfall, then she went out to him. When she came to him, he said to her, "Ride on (your camel)." She said, "No, but you ride in front and I will ride behind you." So he rode in front and she rode behind him until they arrived. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "She is my best daughter who has been afflicted." Ali ibn al-Husayn heard that and went to Uruwah and said, "What story have you heard about me that is used to belittle the right of Fatimah?" Uruwah said, "By Allah, I do not like to have anything between the east and the west, and I am belittling the right of Fatimah. It belongs to her. But after that, I will never mention it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah Aishah (RA) se riwayat hai ke jab Rasulullah (SAW) Madinah aaye to unki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) Makkah se Kinanah ya Ibn Kinanah ke saath nikli. Log unke peeche nikle to Habbar bin Al-Aswad ne unhein jaa liya aur apne nezey se unke oont ko marta raha yahan tak ke unhein gira diya. Unhone apna hamal gira diya aur khoon behne laga. Unhein utha liya gaya, phir Bani Hashim aur Bani Umayyah ne unke baare mein jhagda kiya. Bani Umayyah ne kaha: "Hum unke zyada haqdaar hain", kyunke woh unke chachazad Abu Al-As ke nikah mein thin. Chunancha woh Hind bint Utbah bin Rabi'ah ke paas rahin aur Hind unse kehti: "Yeh tumhare walid ki wajah se hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne Zayd bin Harithah (RA) se farmaya: "Kya tum jaoge nahi aur Zaynab ko mere paas nahi laoge?" Unhone kaha: "Kyun nahi, ya Rasulullah." Aap ne farmaya: "Meri angoothi le lo aur unhein de dena." Zayd chale aur apna oont chhod diya, aur narmi se kaam lete rahe yahan tak ke ek charwaahe se mile. Poocha: "Kis ke liye charate ho?" Usne kaha: "Abu Al-As ke liye." Poocha: "Yeh bakriyan kis ki hain?" Usne kaha: "Zaynab bint Muhammad ki." Woh uske saath kuch door chale, phir kaha: "Kya tum chahte ho ke main tumhein kuch dun jo tum unhein de do aur kisi se iska zikr na karo?" Usne kaha: "Haan." Unhone use angoothi di. Charwaha chala, apni bakriyan andar le gaya aur unhein angoothi di. Unhone use pehchan liya aur poocha: "Yeh tumhein kisne di?" Usne kaha: "Ek aadmi ne." Poocha: "Tumne use kahan chhoda?" Usne kaha: "Falan jagah." Woh khamosh rahin, jab raat aayi to unke paas nikli. Jab unke paas aayin to Zayd ne kaha: "Sawar ho jao." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balki aap meri aage sawar hon." Woh sawar hue aur woh unke peeche sawar hui yahan tak ke pahunch gayin. Rasulullah (SAW) farmaya karte: "Woh meri betiyon mein sabse behtar hai, mere liye (takleef mein) mubtela ki gayi." Yeh baat Ali bin Al-Husayn tak pahunchi to woh Urwah ke paas gaye aur kaha: "Yeh kaisi hadees hai jo mujhe aap se pahunchi hai, jise aap bayan karte hain aur Fatimah (RA) ka haq ghatate hain?" Urwah ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe yeh pasand nahi ke mere paas mashriq aur maghrib ke darmiyan ki sab cheezein hon aur main Fatimah (RA) ka koi haq jo unka hai ghatayun. Rahi baat uske baad ki, to aap ke liye hai ke main yeh kabhi bayan nahi karunga."

e: [AI] "In the end of this statement, the Imam Abu Bakr means that my best daughters are among my best daughters, because the news is proven to be correct from the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  that Fatimah, upon her be peace, is the leader of the women of this nation. It is also confirmed from the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  that he said, 'Fatimah is the leader of the women of the people of Paradise, except for Maryam, the daughter of Imran.' And I have also clarified in my writings that the Arabs may say 'afdal,' intending 'from the best,' but in my books, there are the rich and sufficient (explanations), if Allah, the Almighty, wills. And the Imam Abu Bakr has already clarified in his explanation of this statement, and we do not add to what he says, as he is the Imam who deserves it. However, beneath this word, there is a letter that leads to another meaning different from what he said, which is that knowledge encompasses that Zainab is older than Fatimah in age, as she was born before her. And it can be said that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, intended by his saying 'afdal' that Zainab is the greatest and oldest of my children. And Allah knows best."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Imam Abu Bakr ne is lafz ke aakhir mein ('meri betiyon mein sabse afzal') ka matlab yeh bataya hai: 'meri behtareen betiyon mein se', kyunke Nabi (SAW) se sahih saabit rawayaat hain ke Fatimah (RA) is ummat ki auraton ki sardar hain, aur isi tarah Nabi (SAW) se saabit hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Fatimah Jannati auraton ki sardar hain, siwaye Maryam bint Imran ke.' Maine is jins ki baat imla karayi hai ke Arab kabhi 'afzal' kehte hain aur murad 'afzal mein se' hota hai, aur meri kitabon mein jo kuch hai woh kaafi hai, in sha Allah Ta'ala. Imam Abu Bakr ne is lafz ki wazahat mein shifa de di hai aur hum unki baat par izafa nahi karte kyunke woh haqeeqatan muqaddam imam hain. Magar is kalimah ke neeche ek harf hai jo unke kahe ke ilawa doosre ma'ne tak le jata hai, aur woh yeh ke ilm ihata kiye hue hai ke Zaynab umar mein Fatimah se badi hain, unse pehle paida huin. Yeh kaha ja sakta hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ki 'afzal' se murad 'meri sabse badi aur sabse pehli aulad' hai, wallahu a'lam."

e: [AI] "Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, passed away in the eighth year of the Hijra."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) 8 Hijri mein faut hui."

e: [AI] Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, was the most beautiful of his daughters. The cause of her death was that when she left Makkah to go to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Hubbār bin Al-Aswad and another man intercepted her. One of them pushed her, causing her to fall on a rock, which caused her to miscarry. As a result, she bled, and her pain did not cease until she died from it.
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) aap ki betiyon mein sabse badi thin. Unki wafat ka sabab yeh tha ke jab woh Makkah se Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas nikli to Habbar bin Al-Aswad aur ek aur aadmi ne unhein jaa liya. Kaha jata hai ke unmein se ek ne unhein dhakka diya to woh ek chattan par gir gayin, unka hamal gir gaya kyunke woh hamila thin, aur khoon behne laga. Phir unka dard unke saath rehta raha yahan tak ke usi se faut hui." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] When the people of Mecca sent their prisoners as ransom, Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , sent a necklace as ransom for Abu Al-`As. Khadijah had given her the necklace, and she presented it to Abu Al-`As when he was imprisoned. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw her wearing it, he was deeply moved and said, "If you see fit, you can release her captive and return to her what belongs to her."
hi: Jab Makkah walon ne apne qaidiyon ka fidya bheja to Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) ne Abu Al-As ke fidye mein ek haar bheja. Khadijah (RA) ne yeh haar unhein tab diya tha jab unhein Abu Al-As ke paas rukhsat kiya tha. Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ne use dekha to aap ko unpar bohot raham aaya aur farmaya: "Agar tum munasib samjho to unke liye unke qaidi ko chhod do aur jo unka hai wapas kar do."

e: [AI] Zainab, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , rented a house from Abu Al-As ibn Ar-Rabi, the husband of her sister, Umm Habibah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  approved of their living arrangement. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent regarding this matter in his summary.
hi: Abu Al-As ki biwi, Nabi (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) ne apne shauhar Abu Al-As bin Ar-Rabi' ko panah di, "to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unki panah ko jaa'iz rakha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Zainab, I have hired Abu Al-As," said the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. "We have hired whoever Zainab hires, as he provides for the Muslims, especially those in need," Al-Dhahabi did not comment on it in his summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Zaynab (RA) ne kaha: 'Maine Abu Al-As ko panah di hai.'" To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Humne bhi use panah di jise Zaynab ne panah di. Musalmanon ki taraf se unka adna shakhs bhi panah de sakta hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] About Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, Zaynab bint Rasul Allah ﷺ received a message from Abu Al-Aas ibn Al-Rabi’ saying, "Take an amanah (a trust) from your father." She went out and peeked her head out of her room's door while the Prophet ﷺ was praying Fajr (morning prayer) with the people. She said, "O people, I am Zaynab bint Rasul Allah ﷺ, and I have given Abu Al-Aas his amanah." When the Prophet ﷺ finished the prayer, he said, "O people, I had no knowledge of this until you heard it. Know that he protects the Muslims who are less capable." Ad-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah Umm Salamah (RA) se riwayat hai ke Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) ke paas Abu Al-As bin Ar-Rabi' ne kehla bheja ke "mere liye apne walid se amaan le lo." Woh nikli aur apne hujre ke darwaze se sar nikala jabke Nabi (SAW) Fajr ki namaz logon ko padha rahe the. Unhone kaha: "Ae logo! Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti Zaynab hun aur maine Abu Al-As ko panah di hai." Jab Nabi (SAW) namaz se farigh hue to farmaya: "Ae logo! Mujhe is baat ka ilm nahi tha yahan tak ke tum ne bhi sun liya. Khabardar! Musalmanon ki taraf se unka adna shakhs bhi panah de sakta hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: “I saw Zainab the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wearing a shirt of Siyara’ silk.* (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3598)
hi: "Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) par resham ki dhari-dar (siyara') qameez dekhi."

e: [AI] Zainab, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , passed away. He went out for her funeral and we went out with him. We saw him sad and grieving. When the Prophet ﷺ  entered her grave, he came out with a shining color. We asked him about it and he said, "She used to suffer from illness, so I reminded her of the severity of death and the tightness of the grave. I prayed to Allah to ease things for her." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) faut hui, to aap unke janaze ke saath nikle aur hum bhi aap ke saath nikle. Humne aap ko ghamgeen aur udaas dekha. Jab Nabi (SAW) unki qabr mein utre to rang chamakta hua nikle. Humne aap se iska sabab poocha to aap ne farmaya: "Woh bohot beemar rehne wali khatoon thin, to mujhe maut ki sakhti aur qabr ka bheench yaad aaya, to maine Allah se dua ki ke woh unpar halka kar de." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  returned his daughter Zainab to her husband Abi Al-Aas after two years of their first marriage, and he did not renew the dowry."
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne apni sahabzadi Zaynab (RA) ko unke shauhar Abu Al-As ki taraf do saal baad pehle nikah par hi lauta diya aur naya mahr muqarrar nahi kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] About 'Urwah regarding the naming of those who emigrated to Abyssinia in the first migration before the departure of Ja'far and his companions, "Uthman ibn 'Affan with his wife Ruqayyah bint Rasulullah ﷺ ."
hi: Urwah se, un logon ke naam bataane ke silsile mein jo Ja'far (RA) aur unke sathiyon ke nikalne se pehle pehli martaba Habshah ki hijrat ke liye nikle: "Uthman bin Affan (RA) apni biwi Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Ruqayyah (RA) ke saath."

e: [AI] I heard Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Sulaiman bin Jafar bin Sulaiman Al Hashimi saying, "Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , was born thirty-three years after the birth of the Prophet ﷺ ."
hi: Maine Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Sulayman bin Ja'far bin Sulayman Al-Hashimi ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Ruqayyah (RA) Nabi (SAW) ki paidaish ke 33 saal baad paida huin."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Take the letter with you." He said, "Shall I take one of them who can withstand his companion?" Then the Prophet ﷺ  sent Asma bint Abi Bakr and said, "Bring me their news." So Asma went back to the Prophet ﷺ  and Abu Bakr was with him. She said, "O Messenger of Allah, bring a tied female camel." He loaded her onto it and took it towards the sea. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Abu Bakr, "O Abu Bakr, they are the first ones to migrate after Lot and Abraham (peace be upon them). May peace and blessings be upon them." This portion has been omitted by Al-Dhahabi in the summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...unse Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ruqayyah ko apne saath le jao.' (Aap ne) farmaya: 'Mera khayal hai tum dono mein se ek apne saathi par sabr karega.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) ko bheja aur farmaya: 'Mere paas un dono ki khabar lao.' Asma (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas lauti jabke aap ke paas Abu Bakr (RA) the.
