Unhone kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Woh ek zeen kasa gadha nikal laye, unhein us par sawar kiya aur samandar ki taraf le gaye.' Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Abu Bakr! Yeh dono Lut aur Ibrahim (AS) ke baad sabse pehle hijrat karne wale hain.'" Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] Ruqayyah lived until Uthman married her and a boy named Abdullah was born to her. Abdullah died at a young age and Uthman was thereafter called Abu Abdullah. Ibn Ishaq said, "Some knowledgeable people informed me that some young Ethiopians saw Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, while she was there with Uthman. She was one of the most beautiful people, and they were amazed by her beauty until Allah killed them in battle when the Abyssinian ruler marched against them." Ibn Ishaq also said, "It is said that Abdullah ibn Uthman died in Jumada al-Ula in the year four, when he was only six years old." Al-Dhahabi omitted this information in his abridged version.
hi: "Ruqayyah (RA) zinda rahin yahan tak ke Uthman (RA) ne unse nikah kiya, aur Ruqayyah se ek beta paida hua jiska naam Abdullah rakha gaya, woh chhoti umar mein faut ho gaya, aur uske baad Uthman (RA) ki kunyat Abu Abdullah ho gayi." Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: "Mujhe ba'z ahl-e-ilm ne bataya ke Habshah ke kuch naujawanon ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Ruqayyah (RA) ko dekha jabke woh wahan Uthman (RA) ke saath thin, aur woh logon mein sabse khoobsurat thin. Woh unke paas aate jaate aur unke husn par hairaan rehte, yahan tak ke Allah ne unhein jang mein halaak kar diya jab Najashi apne dushman ki taraf nikla." Ibn Ishaq ne kaha: "Aur kaha jata hai ke Abdullah bin Uthman Jumada Al-Ula 4 Hijri mein faut hua aur woh chhe saal ka tha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet (pbuh) left Uthman and Usama bin Zaid to take care of Ruqayyah during her illness. He then went to the Battle of Badr while she was still ill. Zaid bin Haritha came with the news of victory while carrying Ruqayyah's funeral. We heard the sound of joy and we didn't believe the news of victory until we saw the prisoners. The gold remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Uthman (RA) aur Usamah bin Zayd (RA) ko Ruqayyah (RA) ki bimari mein unke paas chhoda aur Badr ki taraf nikle jabke woh beemar thin. Phir Zayd bin Harithah (RA) Al-Adba' par khushkhabri le kar aaye aur Ruqayyah (RA) faut ho chuki thin. Humne shor suna, to Allah ki qasam, humne us khushkhabri ki tasdeeq nahi ki yahan tak ke humne qaidi dekh liye." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "When Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , passed away, the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'A man who has caused harm to his family should not enter the gravesite tonight.' Therefore, Uthman did not enter the gravesite."
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Ruqayyah (RA) faut hui to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Qabr mein woh aadmi na utre jisne aaj raat apni biwi se mubasharat ki ho." To Uthman (RA) qabr mein nahi utre.

e: [AI] I witnessed the burial of the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was sitting by the grave, and I saw tears in his eyes. He said, "Is there anyone among you who has not been intimate with his wife tonight?" Abu Talha replied, "I have not, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Then go down into her grave."
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi ki tadfeen mein shirkat ki. Aap qabr par baithe the aur maine aap ki aankhon se aansu behte dekhe. Aap ne farmaya: "Kya tum mein koi aadmi hai jisne aaj raat apni biwi se mubasharat na ki ho?" Abu Talhah (RA) ne kaha: "Main, ya Rasulullah." Aap ne farmaya: "To unki qabr mein utro."

e: [AI] I entered upon Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, the wife of Uthman, and in her hand was a comb. She said, "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, left from me earlier and I combed his hair." He said to me, "How do you find Abu Abdullah (referring to Uthman)?" I said, "Good." He said, "Honor him, for he is most similar to me in character among my companions."
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi, Uthman (RA) ki biwi Ruqayyah (RA) ke paas gaya, unke haath mein kanghi thi. Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) abhi mere paas se gaye hain, maine aap ke sar mein kanghi ki thi. Aap ne mujhse farmaya: 'Tum Abu Abdullah ko kaisa paati ho?' Maine kaha: 'Achha.' Aap ne farmaya: 'Unki izzat karna, kyunke woh mere sahaba mein akhlaq mein mujhse sabse zyada mushabeh hain.'"

e: [AI] "I entered upon Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and she had a comb in her hand. She said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  left from my presence a little while ago, and I combed his hair.' He said to me, 'How do you find Uthman?' I said, 'In a good state.' He said, 'Honor him, for he is one who resembles my companions the most in character.'"
hi: Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Ruqayyah (RA) ke paas gaya, unke haath mein kanghi thi. Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) abhi mere paas se gaye hain, maine aap ke sar mein kanghi ki thi. Aap ne mujhse farmaya: 'Tum Uthman ko kaisa paati ho?'" Unhone kaha: To maine kaha: "Achha." Aap ne farmaya: "Unki izzat karna, kyunke woh mere sahaba mein akhlaq mein mujhse sabse zyada mushabeh hain."

e: [AI] "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ assigned a share of the spoils of war from the Battle of Badr to Uthman. At that time, Uthman had been delayed due to the sickness of his wife, Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She had contracted measles. Zaid ibn Harithah came with glad tidings of victory, along with a grave shroud, while Uthman was burying Ruqayyah." This part has been omitted by Al-Dhahabi in his summarization."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne Badr ke din Uthman (RA) ko unka hissa diya, jabke woh apni biwi Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Ruqayyah (RA) ki wajah se peeche reh gaye the, unhein khasra (hasbah) ho gaya tha. Phir Zayd bin Harithah (RA) fatah ki khushkhabri le kar aaye, unke saath ek oont tha, aur Uthman (RA) Ruqayyah (RA) ki qabr par unhein dafan kar rahe the." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] And the name of Umm Kulthum, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , is Ummayyah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married her to Uthman after the death of Ruqayyah in the month of Rabi'al-Awwal. She entered upon him in Jumada al-Akhirah in the eighth year, and she passed away while she was with Uthman in Sha'ban of the ninth year. She was Umm Atiyya al-Ansariyya, who was the one who washed her body with the women of the Ansar.
hi: "Aur Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Umm Kulthum (RA) ka naam Umayyah tha. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ruqayyah ke baad Rabi' Al-Awwal ke mahine mein unka nikah Uthman (RA) se kiya, aur woh Jumada Al-Akhirah mein (matn ke mutabiq) 8 Hijri mein unke paas aayin, aur Sha'ban 9 Hijri mein Uthman (RA) ke nikah mein rehte hue faut hui. Unhein Ummu Atiyyah Al-Ansariyyah (RA) ne Ansar ki kuch auraton ke saath ghusl diya."

e: [AI] Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , passed away and Uthman married Umm Kulthum, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Ruqayyah (RA) faut hui to Uthman (RA) ne Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Umm Kulthum (RA) se nikah kiya."

e: [AI] When Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, died, Umar passed by Uthman and asked him, "Do you have any interest in marrying Hafsah, the daughter of Umar?" Uthman did not respond to him. Umar then went to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Perhaps Allah, the Exalted, will bring you a son-in-law who is better for you than Uthman." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ married Umar's daughter and also married Uthman with Umm Kulthum. Abu Bakr had proposed to her before, and Umar also proposed to her, but she was not married. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best intermediary for Uthman is that I marry my daughters, but Allah, the Exalted, arranges their marriages." [This part has been abridged by Al-Dhahabi]
hi: Jab Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Ruqayyah (RA) faut hui to Umar (RA) Uthman (RA) ke paas se guzre aur kaha: "Kya aap Hafsah bint Umar mein dilchaspi rakhte hain?" Unhone koi jawab na diya. Umar (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur khabar di. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Umar! Shayad Allah Ta'ala tumhein aisa damad de jo tumhare liye Uthman se behtar ho." Chunancha Rasulullah (SAW) ne Umar (RA) ki beti se nikah kiya aur Umm Kulthum (RA) ka nikah Uthman (RA) se kar diya. Isse pehle Abu Bakr (RA) ne unhein paigham diya tha aur Umar (RA) ne bhi, magar aap ne unka nikah nahi kiya tha. Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Uthman ke liye behtareen shafa'at karne wala (yeh hai): main apni betiyon ka nikah nahi karta, balki Allah Ta'ala unka nikah karata hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  met Uthman bin Affan while he was sad, so he said, "What's wrong, Uthman?" Uthman said, "By my father, O Messenger of Allah, and by my mother, has anyone been visited by people as I have been visited? My wife, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , has passed away, may Allah have mercy upon her, and the relationship between us has been severed forever." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Do you say that, Uthman, while Jibril ﷺ  is commanding me on behalf of Allah the Almighty to marry her sister, Umm Kulthum, to you for a bridal gift and with a marriage agreement like hers?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  married her to him.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) Uthman bin Affan (RA) se mile, woh ghamgeen the. Aap ne farmaya: "Ae Uthman! Tumhein kya hua?" Unhone kaha: "Mere maa baap aap par qurban, ya Rasulullah! Kya kisi par woh guzri jo mujh par guzri? Rasulullah (SAW) ki beti, Allah unpar raham farmaye, faut ho gayin aur mere aur aap ke darmiyan sasural ka rishta hamesha ke liye toot gaya." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Ae Uthman! Tum yeh kehte ho jabke yeh Jibreel (AS) mujhe Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se kehte hain ke main tumhara nikah unki behen Umm Kulthum se kar dun, unke mahr jaisa mahr aur unki muddat jaisi muddat par?" Chunancha Rasulullah (SAW) ne unka nikah unse kar diya. Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] Regarding silk, do women wear it or not? It was claimed that Anas ibn Malik narrated that he saw Umm Kulthum, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , wearing a silk dress.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...resham ke baare mein, kya auratein ise pehen sakti hain ya nahi?" To usne gumaan kiya ke Anas bin Malik (RA) ne use bayan kiya ke unhone "Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Umm Kulthum (RA) par resham ka dhari-dar (siyara') kapda dekha."

e: [AI] From Umm Kulthum bint Al-Nabi (the Prophet's daughter), she said: "O Messenger of Allah, is my husband better or the husband of Fatimah?" The Prophet ﷺ  remained silent, then said, "Your husband is one who loves Allah and His Messenger, and whom Allah and His Messenger love." She turned to leave, and he said to her, "Come back, what did you say?" She said, "I said, 'My husband is one who loves Allah and His Messenger, and whom Allah and His Messenger love.'" He replied, "Yes, and I tell you more: I entered Paradise and saw his place, and I did not see anyone from my companions who is higher in status than him." This narration was omitted from Al-Dhahabi's summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ki sahabzadi Umm Kulthum (RA) se riwayat hai ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Mera shauhar behtar hai ya Fatimah ka shauhar?" Kaha: To Nabi (SAW) khamosh rahe, phir farmaya: "Tumhara shauhar un mein se hai jo Allah aur uske Rasool se muhabbat karte hain aur Allah aur uska Rasool unse muhabbat karte hain." Woh palti to aap ne farmaya: "Aao, maine kya kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Aap ne farmaya: mera shauhar un mein se hai jo Allah aur uske Rasool se muhabbat karte hain aur Allah aur uska Rasool unse muhabbat karte hain." Aap ne farmaya: "Haan, aur main tumhein ek baat aur batata hun: main Jannat mein dakhil hua to maine unka makaan dekha, aur maine apne sahaba mein se kisi ko unke makaan mein unse buland nahi paaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] "None of the daughters of Abd al-Muttalib embraced Islam except for Safiyyah. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, 'And she has two shares.' She was the sister of Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib from her father and mother."
hi: "Abd Al-Muttalib ki betiyon mein se kisi ne Islam nahi paaya siwaye Safiyyah (RA) ke." Kaha: "Aur Nabi (SAW) ne unke liye do hisse muqarrar kiye." Aur woh Hamzah bin Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) ki sagi behen thin, baap aur maa dono ki taraf se.

e: [AI] "Safiyyah bint Abd Al-Muttalib, the mother of Zubayr ibn al-Awam, died at the age of twenty. She passed away on the same day that her daughter, Thalathin, died. Umar ibn al-Khattab prayed the funeral prayer for her and she was buried in al-Baqi' cemetery."
hi: "Safiyyah bint Abd Al-Muttalib (RA), Zubayr bin Al-Awwam (RA) ki walida, 20 Hijri mein faut hui, aur jis din faut hui woh tehattar (73) saal ki thin. Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ne unki namaz-e-janaza padhayi aur unhein Baqi' mein dafan kiya."

e: [AI] Safiyyah, the daughter of Abdul-Muttalib bin Hashim and her mother Hala bint Wuhayb bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah bin Kilab, is the sister of Hamza bin Abdul-Muttalib. In the era of ignorance, her husband was Harith bin Harb bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams, and she gave birth to Safiyyan for him. Then, Awam bin Khulaid bin Usayd succeeded him, and she gave birth to Zubair and As-Sa'ib for him. She embraced Islam, pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , migrated to Medina, and lived until the caliphate of Umar bin Khattab. She narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ .
hi: "Aur Safiyyah bint Abd Al-Muttalib bin Hashim (RA), unki walida Halah bint Wuhayb bin Abd Manaf bin Zuhrah bin Kilab thin, aur woh Hamzah bin Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) ki maa ki taraf se behen hain. Jahiliyyat mein unse Al-Harith bin Harb bin Umayyah bin Abd Shams ne nikah kiya to unse Safi paida hue. Phir unke baad Al-Awwam bin Khuwaylid bin Asad ne nikah kiya to unse Zubayr, As-Sa'ib aur Abd Al-Ka'bah paida hue. Woh Islam laayin, Rasulullah (SAW) se bay'at ki, Madinah ki taraf hijrat ki, aap ke baad Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) ki khilafat tak zinda rahin aur Rasulullah (SAW) se riwayat ki."

e: [AI] When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  went out to the trench, he put his wives in a place called "Fari"' and he placed Hassan ibn Thabit with them. The Jews came to the place seeking the attention of the Prophet's wives. A man from the place confronted us, so I said to Hassan, "O Hassan, stand up and deal with him." He replied, "By Allah, I would not do that even if it were done to me, and if it were done to me, I would have been with the Prophet ﷺ ." I said to him, "Tie this sword on my arm." He tied it for me, and I started approaching the man, hitting his head until I severed it. Then I said to Hassan, "Grab his ears and throw them at them." He replied, "By Allah, I would not do that even if it were done to me." So I took the man's head and threw it at them, causing them to retreat while saying, "We have known that Muhammad would never leave his family vulnerable with no one by their side." It was said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to send Hassan with him when the polytheists intensified their attacks, and he would stay with us in the fort. And when the Prophet returned, he would return behind him just as the Prophet would, and he would pass by us. Saad ibn Mu'adh also passed by us, having taken a banner, while he was at a wedding just a few days ago and he was adorning himself. He recited the verses from Surah Al-Rojz, "And when the wave covers them like shades, they say, 'Pray to your Lord.'" Aisha said, "I have never seen a man more beautiful than him on that day."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) jab Khandaq ki taraf nikle to apni azwaj ko ek qile mein rakha jise Fari' kaha jata tha, aur unke saath Hassan bin Thabit (RA) ko rakha. Yahud qile ke paas aaye ke Nabi (SAW) ki azwaj ki ghaflat ka mauqa talash karein. Ek shakhs qile par chadh kar humare upar aaya. Maine Hassan (RA) se kaha: "Ae Hassan! Uth kar usse mukabla karo aur use qatl kar do." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh mere bas ki baat nahi, agar mere bas ki hoti to main Nabi (SAW) ke saath hota." Maine kaha: "Yeh talwar meri bahon par baandh do." Unhone baandh di. Main uth kar uske paas gayi, uske sar par waar kiya yahan tak ke use kaat diya. Maine kaha: "Iske kaan pakad kar use un par phenk do." Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh mere bas mein nahi." Maine uska sar pakad kar un par phenk diya. Woh mutazalzil ho gaye aur kehne lage: "Humein maloom tha ke Muhammad apne ghar walon ko is tarah akela nahi chhodenge ke unke saath koi na ho." (Aishah (RA) ne) kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) jab mushrikin par sakht hote to Hassan Rasulullah (SAW) ke saath hote, aur woh humare saath qile mein the. Jab woh laute to unke peeche laute jaise Rasulullah (SAW) wahan wapas aate." Humare paas se Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA) guzre, unhone zard khushbu laga rakhi thi aur kuch din pehle unki shadi hui thi, aur woh rajaz ke ashaar padh rahe the [Bahr Ar-Rajaz]: "Zara thehro, thodi der mein oont jang tak pahunch jayega; maut mein koi harj nahi jab muqarrar waqt aa jaye." Aishah (RA) ne kaha: "Maine us din unse zyada khoobsurat koi aadmi nahi dekha."

e: [AI] "Urwah heard her say, 'I am the first woman who killed a man. I was at the fortress of Hassan ibn Thabit when Hassan was with us among the women and children during the Battle of the Trench, led by the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.' Safiyyah said, 'Then a Jewish man passed by the fortress and started roaming around it. I said to Hassan, 'This Jew is in the fortress, as you can see, and I do not feel safe that he will expose our vulnerabilities, especially since the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his companions are occupied elsewhere. So go and kill him.' Hassan said, 'May Allah forgive you, daughter of Abdul-Muttalib. By Allah, you know that I am not capable of doing that.' Safiyyah said, 'When he said that and I saw that he had nothing with him, I got angry and took a stick from the fortress. Then I went down from the fortress towards him and beat him with the stick until I killed him. Then I returned to the fortress and said to Hassan, 'Hassan, come down and take possession of him. It was only because he was a man that he prevented me from doing so.' He said, 'I have no need to possess him.'"
hi: Urwah ne kaha: Maine unhein (Safiyyah (RA) ko) kehte suna: "Main woh pehli aurat hun jisne kisi aadmi ko qatl kiya. Main Fari' mein thi, jo Hassan bin Thabit ka qila tha, aur Hassan humare saath auraton aur bachchon mein the, jab Nabi (SAW) ne khandaq khudwayi." Safiyyah (RA) ne kaha: Humare paas se Yahud ka ek aadmi guzra aur qile ke gird chakkar lagane laga. Maine Hassan se kaha: "Yeh Yahudi qile ke gird hai jaisa tum dekh rahe ho, aur mujhe aman nahi ke woh humari kamzor jagahon ki nishandahi na kar de, jabke Rasulullah (SAW) aur aap ke sahaba hum se mashghool hain. Uth kar use qatl kar do." Unhone kaha: "Allah tumhein bakhshe, ae Abd Al-Muttalib ki beti! Tum jaanti ho main is kaam ka aadmi nahi." Safiyyah (RA) ne kaha: Jab unhone yeh kaha aur maine unke paas kuch na paaya to maine kamar kasi, qile ka ek sutoon liya, qile se utar kar uske paas gayi aur sutoon se use maara yahan tak ke use qatl kar diya. Phir qile mein wapas aayi aur kaha: "Ae Hassan! Utro aur uska saaman utaar lo, kyunke mujhe use utarne se sirf is cheez ne roka ke woh mard hai." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe uske saaman ki koi haajat nahi."

e: [AI] The Quraysh did not deny the prayer of Duha, but they denied its timing. "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, would disperse to the valleys to pray in solitude or in pairs when the time of Asr prayer came." Tuleib bin Umair and Hataab bin Abd Shams went to pray in the Asjnad valley, some of them looking at others, when Ibn Al-Asaydee and Ibn Al-Qabtiyyah attacked them as they were committing immoral acts. They pelted them with stones for some time until they left. They then went to Abu Jahl, Abu Lahab, and Uqbah bin Abi Muayt and told them the news. They gathered and set out to attack them at dawn, while they were leaving in the darkness of the morning to perform ablution and pray. While they were in the valleys, Abu Jahl, Uqbah, Abu Lahab, and some of their foolish companions attacked and beat them. The companions of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, defended themselves, spoke about Islam, called out to them, and defended themselves. Tuleib bin Umair went to attack Abu Jahl, hitting him and injuring him. They took hold of him and bound him. Abu Lahab stood in front of him to protect him. He was his nephew. It was said to Arwa bint Abdul Muttalib, "Do you not see your son Tuleib following Muhammad, becoming a target for him?" Arwa had already converted to Islam. She said, "The best days for Tuleib are those when he is defending his cousin, who has brought the truth from Allah the Exalted." They said, "Have you followed Muhammad?" She said, "Yes." Some of them went to Abu Lahab and informed him. He approached her and said, "How amazing that you, along with your allegiance to Muhammad, have left the religion of Abdul Muttalib." She replied, "It was like that. So stand with your nephew and support him. Prevent him. If his situation becomes evident, then you will be in the best position, should you wish to join him or remain on your own religion. If you do not, then you would have excused your nephew." He said, "We have enough power among the Arabs altogether." Then they said, "He has come with a new religion." He said, "Then Abu Lahab left, saying, 'I have not found her Islam except in Al-Waqidi's account.'"
hi: Quraysh Duha ki namaz ka inkaar nahi karte the, woh to sirf waqt ka inkaar karte the. "Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba jab Asr ka waqt aata to ghatiyon mein bikhar jate aur akele akele ya do do ho kar namaz padhte." Ek din Tulayb bin Umayr (RA) aur Hatib bin Abd Shams, Shi'b Ajnad mein namaz padh rahe the, ek doosre ko dekh rahe the ke achanak Ibn Al-Usaydi aur Ibn Al-Qibtiyyah, jo fahash-go the, un par toot pade aur unhein kuch der patthar maarte rahe yahan tak ke woh dono bhaagte hue chale gaye. Woh Abu Jahl, Abu Lahab aur Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ayt ke paas aaye aur unhein khabar di. Subah woh un par pahunche, aur sahaba subah ke andhere mein nikalte, wudu karte aur namaz padhte the. Ek ghati mein the ke achanak Abu Jahl, Uqbah, Abu Lahab aur unke kuch bewaqoofon ne un par hamla kiya, unhein maara aur unse nuqsan pahunchaya. Rasulullah (SAW) ke sahaba ne Islam zaahir kar diya, uska kalam kiya, unhein pukara aur apna difa kiya. Tulayb bin Umayr (RA) ne Abu Jahl ka qasd kiya, use maara aur uska sar phaad diya. Unhone unhein pakad kar baandh diya, to Abu Lahab unke saamne khade hue yahan tak ke unhein khol diya, kyunke woh unka bhatija tha. Arwa bint Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) se kaha gaya: "Kya tum apne bete Tulayb ko nahi dekhti ke Muhammad ka pairoukar ho gaya aur unke liye nishana ban gaya?" Arwa Islam la chuki thin. Unhone kaha: "Tulayb ke behtareen dino mein se woh din hai jab woh apne mamu zad ki hifazat kare, jo Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se haq le kar aaya hai." Unhone kaha: "Kya tum ne bhi Muhammad ki pairwi kar li?" Unhone kaha: "Haan." Unmein se kuch Abu Lahab ke paas gaye aur use khabar di. Woh aaya, unke paas aaya aur kaha: "Tum par hairat hai, tum ne Muhammad ki pairwi ki aur Abd Al-Muttalib ka deen chhod diya!" Unhone kaha: "Yeh to ho chuka. Tum apne bhatije ke saamne khade ho, uski madad karo aur use bachao. Agar uska maamla ghalib aa gaya to tumhein ikhtiyar hai chaho to uske saath dakhil ho jao ya apne deen par raho, aur agar na hua to tum ne apne bhatije ke saath apna uzr pesh kar diya." Usne kaha: "Kya hum tamam Arabon ka muqabla kar sakte hain, phir woh kehte hain ke yeh ek naya deen laya hai." Kaha: Phir Abu Lahab chala gaya. (Raawi ne kaha:) Mujhe unka Islam Al-Waqidi ke siwa kahin nahi mila.

e: [AI] Her name is Fakhita.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) "...ke unka naam Fakhitah hai."

e: [AI] About Fakhita, who is the mother of Hani and the daughter of Abu Talib, she said, "I saw the Prophet ﷺ  praying the morning prayer on the day of the conquest wearing a single garment, with eight units of prayer in between." Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in the summary.
hi: Fakhitah (RA) se, jo Umm Hani bint Abi Talib (RA) hain, unhone kaha: "Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Fath ke din subah ki namaz ek hi kapde mein padhte dekha, jiske donon sire aapas mein ulte kiye hue the, aath rak'at." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  proposed to his uncle Abu Talib's daughter, Umm Hani, before receiving revelation. He proposed her with Hubayrah ibn Abi Wahb present, and Hubayrah married her. The Prophet ﷺ  said to him, "O Umar, you married Hubayrah and left me!" Umar replied, "O nephew, I arranged their marriage and the generous person accommodates the generous. Then Umm Hani embraced Islam, and Islam separated her from Hubayrah. The Prophet ﷺ  proposed to her himself, and she said, "By Allah, I used to love you during the time of ignorance, so how can I not love you in Islam? However, I am a woman prone to headaches, and I do not want you to be bothered by my illness."
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne apne chacha Abu Talib se, wahi aane se pehle, Umm Hani ka rishta manga, aur unke saath Hubayrah bin Abi Wahb ne bhi paigham diya. Abu Talib ne unka nikah Hubayrah se kar diya. Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Ae Umar (matn mein isi tarah hai)! Tum ne Hubayrah ka nikah kar diya aur mujhe chhod diya." Unhone kaha: "Ae bhatije! Maine unse sasuraal ka rishta joda hai, aur sharif sharif ka badla chukata hai." Phir Umm Hani (RA) Islam laayin to Islam ne unke aur Hubayrah ke darmiyan tafreeq kar di. Rasulullah (SAW) ne khud unse paigham diya. Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main jahiliyyat mein bhi aap se muhabbat karti thi, to Islam mein kaise na karungi, magar main yateem bachchon wali aurat hun aur mujhe na-pasand hai ke woh aap ko takleef den." (Baaqi hadees.) Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  proposed to me, but I declined and made an excuse. Then Allah, the Almighty, revealed, 'O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation' (Surah Al-Ahzab 33:50) until the part that says, 'who emigrated with you' (Surah Al-Ahzab 33:50). I said, 'It was not permissible for him (the Prophet) to marry me because I did not emigrate with him, as I was among the divorced women.' Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne mujhe paigham diya, maine aap se uzr kiya, to aap ne mera uzr qubool kar liya." Phir Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: "Ae Nabi! Humne aap ke liye aap ki woh biwiyan halal kin jinhein aap ne unke mahr de diye" (Surah Al-Ahzab 50) yahan tak ke "jinhone aap ke saath hijrat ki" (Surah Al-Ahzab 50). Unhone kaha: "To main aap ke liye halal na hui kyunke maine aap ke saath hijrat nahi ki thi, main Tulaqa (Fath-e-Makkah ke din azad kiye gaye logon) mein se thi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Umm Hanee narrated, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered my house and performed eight units of the Dhuha prayer.' Ibn Abbas came out saying, 'I have read what is between the two covers (of the Quran) and I did not come across the prayer of Ishraq except at a specific time.' (As Allah says in Surah An-Nahl, verse 18), 'They arise from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration.' Then Ibn Abbas said, 'This is the prayer of Ishraq.' Abdullah ibn Abbas also narrated another hadith from Umm Hanee, which Adh-Dhahabi did not include in his summary."
hi: Umm Hani (RA) ne kaha: "Rasulullah (SAW) mere ghar tashreef laye aur Duha ki aath rak'at namaz padhi." Ibn Abbas (RA) yeh kehte hue nikle: "Maine do jildon ke darmiyan (poora Quran) padha hai, magar Salat Al-Ishraq ko maine sirf abhi pehchana." (Surah Sad 18) "Woh shaam aur ishraq ke waqt tasbeeh karte hain", phir Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: "Yeh Salat Al-Ishraq hai." Aur Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ne Umm Hani (RA) se ek aur hadees bhi riwayat ki hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] That the mother of Hane' bin Abi Talib informed him that she said to the Messenger of Allah: "O Messenger of Allah, my son Ali claims that he killed someone whom I had employed." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied: "We have rewarded those whom you reward."
hi: Umm Hani bint Abi Talib (RA) ne unhein bayan kiya ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Mere maa jaaye bhai Ali (RA) ka khayal hai ke woh us shakhs ko qatl karenge jise maine panah di hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Humne bhi use panah di jise tumne panah di."

e: [AI] "From Umm Hanee'"
hi: Umm Hani (RA) se.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, entered upon Umm Hani and found a hanging pot, and he drank while standing. A narration has been narrated by the children of Umm Hani from their fathers through her."
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) Umm Hani (RA) ke paas tashreef laye, wahan ek mashkizah latka hua tha, to aap ne khade ho kar piya." Aur Umm Hani (RA) ki aulad ke liye unke aabaa se unse ek hadees riwayat ki gayi hai.

e:
[AI] I heard my mother, Umm Hani' bint Abi Talib, saying that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "Indeed, Allah Almighty has favored the Quraysh with seven qualities that He did not grant to anyone before them or will grant to anyone after them. Among these qualities is that they were given prophethood and the honor of being custodians of the Kaaba, and they were also aided against the people of the elephant (in the Battle of the Elephant). They worship no one but Allah, and for ten years they worshipped Allah alone without associating partners with Him. And a Surah (chapter) was revealed concerning them in which no one else was mentioned, because of the alliance of Quraysh." 

This has been narrated by Yahya ibn Ja'dah ibn Hubayrah, from his grandmother Umm Hani'.
hi: Maine apni maa Umm Hani bint Abi Talib (RA) ko kehte suna, unhone kaha: Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Beshak Allah Ta'ala ne Quraysh ko saat khaslaton se fazilat di jo na unse pehle kisi ko di aur na unke baad kisi ko dega: unmein nubuwwat hai, unmein hijabah (Kaaba ki kunji bardaari) hai, unmein siqayah (paani pilane ki khidmat) hai, Allah ne haathi walon par unki madad ki jabke woh Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibadat nahi karte the, unhone das saal Allah ki ibadat ki jabke unke siwa kisi ne uski ibadat nahi ki, aur unke baare mein ek surah nazil hui jismein koi doosra shareek nahi: 'Li-ilafi Quraysh'." Aur Yahya bin Ja'dah bin Hubayrah se unki daadi Umm Hani (RA) se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

e: [AI] "I would hear the recitation of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  at night while I was on the roof of my family's house."
hi: "Main Rasulullah (SAW) ki raat ko qira'at suna karti thi jabke main apne ghar walon ke chhappar par hoti thi."

e: [AI] Arwa bintu Abdul-Muttalib had embraced Islam, so Salamah bin Bukht narrated to me from Umairah binti Ubaadillah bin Ka'b, from Ummi Durrah, from Barrah binti Abi Tijrah, she said, "Quraysh did not deny praying Duha (forenoon prayer), they only denied the time." I said, "The hadith is as mentioned, so we do not repeat it here, so ponder." Al-Hakim said.
hi: Arwa bint Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) Islam la chuki thin. Mujhe Salamah bin Bukht ne Umayrah bint Ubaydullah bin Ka'b se, unhone Umm Durrah se, unhone Barrah bint Abi Tajrat se bayan kiya, unhone kaha: "Quraysh Duha ki namaz padhne ka inkaar nahi karte the, woh to sirf waqt ka inkaar karte the." Maine kaha: hadees jaisi pehle guzar chuki hai, isliye hum use yahan dohrate nahi, to ghaur karo. Hakim ne kaha.

e: [AI] "Muṣ'ab ibn 'Abdullah al-Zubayri narrated"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...humse Mus'ab bin Abdullah Az-Zubayri ne bayan kiya."

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah instructed her to move to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum when her husband divorced her. Marwan said, "Yes, that is what he commanded them." Urwah said, "By Allah, Aisha was greatly offended by that, and she said, 'Indeed, Fatimah used to live with her husband in a place that was wild and dangerous, and that is why the Messenger of Allah gave her permission to move.'"
hi: "Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke jab unke shauhar ne unhein talaq di to woh Ibn Umm Maktum (RA) ke ghar muntaqil ho jayen." Marwan ne kaha: "Haan, unhone unhein isi ka hukm diya." Urwah ne kaha: Maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Aishah (RA) ne is par sakht aitraz kiya aur farmaya: 'Fatimah (RA) apne shauhar ke saath ek weeran jagah par thin, to unke ilaqe ke baare mein khauf tha, isi liye Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein rukhsat di.'"

e: [AI] "And he said in the end, when her waiting period was over, Abu Jahl and Muawiyah ibn Abi Sufyan proposed to her. So the Prophet ﷺ consulted her and said, 'As for Muawiyah, he has good manners but no wealth, and as for Abu Jahl, I fear his harsh behavior towards you.' So he ordered me to marry Usama ibn Zaid, and I married Usama ibn Zaid. Jabir ibn Abdullah narrated this from Fatimah bint Qays."
hi: Aur aakhir mein kaha: Jab unki iddat poori hui to Abu Jahm (RA) aur Mu'awiyah bin Abi Sufyan (RA) ne unhein paigham diya. Unhone Nabi (SAW) se mashwara kiya to aap ne farmaya: "Rahe Mu'awiyah, to woh muflis hai, uske paas maal nahi; aur rahe Abu Jahm, to mujhe tum par uski tez-zubani ka khauf hai." Phir aap ne mujhe Usamah bin Zayd (RA) ka hukm diya, chunancha maine Usamah bin Zayd (RA) se nikah kar liya. Aur Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne Fatimah bint Qays (RA) se riwayat ki hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about a woman with irregular menstruation. He said, "She should count the days of her regular menstrual cycle, then perform ghusl (ritual bath) and pray when she becomes pure." Aisha and Umm Salamah also narrated this from Fatimah bint Qays. (Note: The ending of the sentence is unclear in the phrase provided.)
hi: Maine Rasulullah (SAW) se mustahazah ke baare mein poocha to aap ne farmaya: "Woh apne haiz ke dinon mein baithi rahe, phir ghusl kare aur apne pak hone ke waqt namaz padhe." Aur Aishah (RA) aur Umm Salamah (RA) ne bhi Fatimah bint Qays (RA) se riwayat ki hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Fatimah bint Qais came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, "I am experiencing istihadah (non-menstrual bleeding)." He said, "That is not menstruation, rather it is a vein. So when the days of your regular menstruation come, then refrain from prayers. Afterward, bathe yourself and seek purification with a cloth and then perform prayers."
hi: Fatimah bint Qays (RA) Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayin aur kaha: "Mujhe istihazah hota hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh haiz nahi, yeh to ek rag hai. Woh apne haiz ke dinon mein baithi rahe, phir ghusl kare, phir kapda baandh le aur namaz padhe."

e: [AI] Fatimah bint Qais consulted the Prophet ﷺ and said, "I have menstruation, so I am not pure. Should I leave prayer?" He responded, "That is just a vein, not menstruation. Performing a complete ablution is sufficient."
hi: Fatimah bint Qays (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se fatwa poocha aur kaha: "Mujhe istihazah hota hai aur main pak nahi hoti, kya main namaz chhod dun?" Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh to ek rag hai, haiz nahi. Aur ek ghusl wudu se zyada mukammal hai."

e: [AI] "And among the women of the Quraysh who accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was Shifa' bint Abdullah. She was the mother of Sulaiman Ibn Abi Hatimah Al-Qurashi, and the grandmother of Abu Bakr Ibn Sulaiman Ibn Abi Hatimah."
hi: "Aur Quraysh ki auraton mein se jinhone Rasulullah (SAW) ki suhbat paayi: Ash-Shifa bint Abdullah (RA) jo Sulayman bin Abi Hathmah Al-Qurashi ki walida aur Abu Bakr bin Sulayman bin Abi Hathmah ki dadi hain."

e: [AI] "And Shifa bint Abdullah embraced Islam before the conquest and pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah."
hi: "Aur Ash-Shifa bint Abdullah (RA) Fath se pehle Islam laayin aur Rasulullah (SAW) se bay'at ki."

e: [AI] A man from the Ansar was affected by an ant, leading him to think that healing comes from Bint Abdullah, so he went to her and asked her to heal him. She replied that she has not performed any healings since she embraced Islam. The Ansari man then went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him about what Bint Abdullah had said. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  called for Bint Abdullah and said, "Present yourself to me." She presented herself to him, and he said, "Perform the healing and teach it to Hafsah as you have taught her the Quran."
hi: Ansar ke ek aadmi ko namlah (jild ke phodon ki bimari) nikli to bataya gaya ke Ash-Shifa bint Abdullah (RA) namlah ka dam karti hain. Woh unke paas aaya aur unse dam karne ko kaha. Unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, jab se main Islam laayi hun maine dam nahi kiya." Ansari Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur Ash-Shifa ne jo kaha tha bataya. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Ash-Shifa ko bulaya aur farmaya: "Mujhe pesh karo." Unhone aap ke saamne pesh kiya. Aap ne farmaya: "Iska dam karo aur Hafsah ko bhi sikhao jaise tumne unhein likhna sikhaya."

e: [AI] She used to seek protection through charms in the pre-Islamic era. But when Islam came, she said, "I will not seek protection until I seek the permission of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." The Prophet ﷺ  then told her, "Seek protection with what does not involve associating partners with Allah, the Almighty."
hi: Woh jahiliyyat mein dam kiya karti thin. Jab Islam aaya to unhone kaha: "Main dam nahi karungi jab tak Rasulullah (SAW) se mashwara na kar lun." Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Dam karo jab tak ismein Allah ke saath shirk na ho."

e: [AI] "And when she migrated to the Prophet ﷺ, she came to him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I used to perform magical spells during the pre-Islamic period, and I thought of presenting it to you.' He said, 'Present it.' So she presented it to him, and among it was the spell of the ant. He said, 'Perform it and teach it to Hafsah. In the name of Allah, the crosses and knots break when one recites it, and it does not harm anyone. O Allah, remove the affliction, O Lord of the people.' He said, 'Recite it seven times on a qarn karm (type of tree branch) and place it in a clean spot. Then, rub it on a stone and anoint it on the locus.' Ibn Ma'een was asked about Uthman, but he did not recognize him."
hi: Aur jab unhone Nabi (SAW) ki taraf hijrat ki to aap ke paas aayin aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah! Main jahiliyyat mein kuch dam kiya karti thi, aur maine munasib samjha ke woh aap ke saamne pesh kar dun." Aap ne farmaya: "Pesh karo." Unhone pesh kiye, unmein namlah ka dam bhi tha. Aap ne farmaya: "Isse dam karo aur Hafsah ko sikhao: 'Bismillah, salub, jab woh unke munh se laute to kisi ko nuqsan na de. Ae Allah! Takleef door kar de, ae logon ke Rabb.'" Aap ne farmaya: "Isse angoor ki lakdi par saat martaba dam karo, use kisi saaf jagah rakho, phir use patthar par ragdo aur chuna par laga do." Ibn Ma'in se Uthman ke baare mein poocha gaya to unhone use nahi pehchana.

e: [AI] The following translation in English is: "Al-Asma'i said, 'The ant is a wound that appears on the side and elsewhere."
hi: Al-Asma'i ne kaha: "Namlah woh phode hain jo pehlu ya doosri jagah par nikalte hain."

e: [AI] "I came one day and entered upon the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , so I asked him and complained to him. He began to apologize to me, and I started blaming him. Then the first prayer time came, so I entered my daughter's house, and she was with Shurahbil ibn Hasana. I found her husband in the house, so I blamed him and said, 'The prayer time has come and you are here.' He said, 'O aunt, do not blame me. I had two garments, and one of them was borrowed by the Prophet ﷺ .' I said, 'I blame him, and this is his affair.' Shurahbil said, 'One of them was actually a shield, so we tore it apart.'"
hi: "Main ek din aayi yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi, maine aap se sawal kiya aur aap se shikayat ki, to aap mujhse uzr karne lage aur main aap ko malamat karne lagi." Kaha: Phir pehli namaz ka waqt ho gaya to main apni beti ke ghar gayi jo Shurahbil bin Hasanah ke nikah mein thi. Maine uske shauhar ko ghar mein paaya aur use malamat karne lagi aur kaha: "Namaz ka waqt ho gaya aur tum yahin ho?" Unhone kaha: "Ae phuphi! Mujhe malamat na karo, mere paas do kapde the, ek Nabi (SAW) ne udhar le liya." Maine kaha: "Mere maa baap aap par qurban! Main to aap ko malamat kar rahi thi aur aap ka yeh haal hai!" Shurahbil (RA) ne kaha: "Unmein se ek to zirah (qameez) tha, jise humne patch kiya." Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] "And among those who migrated to Abyssinia was 'Amir ibn Rabiah, along with his wife Layla bint Abi Hathmah ibn Ghanim ibn 'Awf ibn 'Ubayd ibn 'Uwaij ibn 'Adi ibn Ka'b."
hi: "Aur Habshah ki taraf hijrat karne walon mein Amir bin Rabi'ah (RA) the, aur unke saath unki biwi Layla bint Abi Hathmah bin Ghanim bin Awf bin Ubayd bin Uwayj bin Adi bin Ka'b (RA) thin."

e: [AI] "The first migration to the city was from Layla bint Abi Hathmah and her husband Abu Wahab, who was Aamir bin Rabee'ah."
hi: "Muhajirat mein se Madinah mein sabse pehle Layla bint Abi Hathmah (RA) aayin, apne shauhar Amir bin Rabi'ah (RA) ke saath."

e: [AI] "From his mother, Umm Abdullah, bint Abi Hathmah, she said, 'By Allah, we used to travel to the land of Habasha (Ethiopia) when Amr was present to fulfill some of our needs. Then Umar ibn Al-Khattab came forward and stood in front of me while he was still a polytheist. We used to face hardship and difficulty because of him, so he asked, "Is it true that you will be leaving, O Umm Abdullah?" I said, "Yes, by Allah, we will leave because you have hurt us and oppressed us until Allah provides us with a way out." He said, "May Allah be your companion," and I saw gentleness in him that I had never seen before. Then he left, and he was saddened by our departure. Then Amr ibn Rabee'ah came for his need, so I said, "O Abu Abdullah, if only you had seen Umar's concern and sadness for us." He said, "Do you hope for his Islam?" I said, "Yes." He said, "The one you saw will not embrace Islam until the camel of Al-Khattab embraces Islam." Then he said it with despair because of what he saw from Umar's harshness and severity towards Islam."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...apni walida Umm Abdullah bint Abi Hathmah (RA) se, unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, hum Habshah ki taraf kooch karne wale the, Amir humari kisi zaroorat ke liye gaye hue the ke Umar bin Al-Khattab aaye aur mere paas aa kar khade ho gaye, aur woh us waqt apne shirk par the, aur hum unse takleef aur sakhti uthate the. Unhone kaha: 'Ae Umm Abdullah! Kya kooch ka waqt aa gaya?' Maine kaha: 'Haan, Allah ki qasam, hum Allah ki zameen mein nikal jayenge, tum ne humein takleef di aur mazloom kiya, yahan tak ke Allah humare liye koi rasta bana de.' Unhone kaha: 'Allah tumhare saath ho.' Maine unmein aisi narmi dekhi jo pehle kabhi nahi dekhi thi, phir woh chale gaye, mere khayal mein humara nikalna unhein ghamgeen kar gaya tha. Kaha: Phir Amir bin Rabi'ah apni us zaroorat se aaye. Maine kaha: 'Ae Abu Abdullah! Kaash aap Umar ko abhi dekhte, unki narmi aur humare liye unki ghamgeeni!' Unhone kaha: 'Kya tum unke Islam ki umeed rakhti ho?' Maine kaha: 'Haan.' Unhone kaha: 'Jise tumne dekha woh Islam nahi laayega yahan tak ke Khattab ka oont Islam na le aaye.' Yeh unhone Islam par unki sakhti aur dil ki sakhti dekh kar unse na-umeed hokar kaha." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And among them is Fatimah bint Al-Khattab bin Nufayl, the wife of Sa'id bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufayl. She had embraced Islam before Umar, and she was one of the first to pledge allegiance in Makkah."
hi: "Aur unmein se Fatimah bint Al-Khattab bin Nufayl (RA) hain, jo Sa'id bin Zayd bin Amr bin Nufayl (RA) ki biwi thin, woh Umar se pehle Islam laayin aur Makkah mein sabse pehle bay'at karne walon mein se thin."

e: [AI] A man from the tribe of Banu Zuhrah met Umar before he accepted Islam, while he was imitating with a sword. Umar asked him, "Where are you heading?" He replied, "I intend to kill Muhammad." Umar said, "Shouldn't I guide you to something surprising? O Umar, your sister and her husband have embraced Islam and left their previous religion." Umar became furious and walked towards them with anger. When he reached their house, he heard a man named Khabbab reciting surah Taha to them. As soon as Khabbab heard Umar's footsteps, he hid under their bed. Umar entered the house and asked, "What was that whispering I heard from you two?" They replied, "We were discussing something privately." Umar said, "Perhaps you have both embraced Islam and left your religion." Then, Sa'id bin Zaid, Umar's sister's husband, said to him, "O Umar, what if the truth is not in your religion?" Umar became enraged and attacked him violently. His sister tried to intervene, but Umar struck her face and caused it to bleed. She said in her anger, "O Umar, what if the truth is not in your religion? I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." When Umar lost hope in making them renounce Islam, he said, "Give me the book you have." His sister told him that he is impure and only the purified can touch the book. Umar was told to wash or perform ablution before touching it.
hi: Bani Zuhrah ka ek aadmi Umar se mila, Islam laane se pehle, jabke unhone talwar latka rakhi thi. Usne poocha: "Kahan ka irada hai?" Unhone kaha: "Main Muhammad ko qatl karna chahta hun." Usne kaha: "Kya main tumhein ek ajeeb baat na bataun, ae Umar? Tumhare behnoi Sa'id aur tumhari behen dono apne deen se phir gaye hain aur us deen ko chhod diya hai jis par woh the." Kaha: Umar gusse mein unki taraf chale yahan tak ke darwaze ke qareeb pahunche. Unke paas Khabbab (RA) the jo unhein Surah Taha padha rahe the. Jab Khabbab (RA) ne Umar ki aahat suni to unki charpai ke neeche chhup gaye. Umar andar aaye aur poocha: "Yeh kaisi bhunbhunahat hai jo maine tumhare paas suni?" Dono ne kaha: "Bas ek baat thi jo hum aapas mein kar rahe the." Unhone kaha: "Shayad tum dono apne deen se phir gaye ho jis par tum the." Unke behnoi Sa'id bin Zayd (RA) ne kaha: "Ae Umar! Aap kya kehte hain agar haq aap ke deen ke siwa mein ho?" Umar apne behnoi par jhapte aur unhein sakht roonda. Kaha: To unki behen ne unhein apne shauhar se hata diya, Umar ne unke chehre par maara aur chehra lahu-luhan kar diya. Unhone gusse mein kaha: "Ae Umar! Aap kya kehte hain agar haq aap ke deen ke siwa mein ho? Main gawahi deti hun ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahi aur main gawahi deti hun ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain." Kaha: Jab Umar na-umeed hue to kaha: "Mujhe woh kitab do jo tumhare paas hai ke main use padhun." Unki behen ne kaha: "Aap napaak hain aur ise sirf paak log hi chhute hain, uthiye ghusl kijiye ya wudu kijiye." (Baaqi hadees.) Iske kuch alfaz saaqit hain.

e: [AI] When my sister opened the door for me, I said, "Oh, you enemy of yourself, did you get hurt?" She replied, and raised something and said, "Oh son of Al-Khattab, what were you doing that I should do it? For I have already converted." He said, so I entered and sat on the bed. Then I saw a newspaper in the middle of the house, so I asked, "What is this newspaper doing here?" She said, "Forget about it, O son of Al-Khattab. You do not cleanse yourself from impurity, nor do you purify yourself. And this can only be touched by the purified."
hi: Jab meri behen ne mere liye darwaza khola to maine kaha: "Ae apni dushman! Kya tu phir gayi hai?" Unhone kaha, aur (Umar ne) kuch uthaya, to unhone kaha: "Ae Ibn Al-Khattab! Jo karna hai kar lo, main Islam la chuki hun." Kaha: Main andar gaya aur charpai par baith gaya to ghar ke beech mein ek sahifah tha. Maine kaha: "Yeh sahifah yahan kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Hum se door raho, ae Ibn Al-Khattab! Tum janabat se ghusl nahi karte aur paak nahi hote, aur ise sirf paak log hi chhute hain." Iske kuch alfaz saaqit hain aur yeh waahi (bohot kamzor) aur munqati' hai.

e: [AI] She heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "There is no prayer for one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for one who does not mention the name of Allah the Almighty upon it, and he does not believe in Allah who does not believe in me, and he does not love the Ansar." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary in this context.
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: "Us ki namaz nahi jiska wudu nahi, aur us ka wudu nahi jisne us par Allah Ta'ala ka naam na liya, aur woh Allah par imaan nahi rakhta jo mujh par imaan nahi rakhta aur Ansar se muhabbat nahi karta." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is maqam par khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Um Nubayh, the daughter of Al-Hajjaj, the mother of Abdullah ibn Amr, was a woman who used to present gifts to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and show kindness to him. One day, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  visited her and asked, "How are you, O Um Abdullah?" She replied, "I am well, by my father and mother, O Messenger of Allah." He then asked, "And how is Abdullah?" She replied, "He is well, by his father and mother. Abdullah is a man who has renounced worldly pleasures. He has forbidden sleep, so he does not sleep. He has forbidden meat, so he does not eat it, and he does not fulfill the rights of his family." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "Where is he?" She said, "He left quickly, and he is about to return, O Messenger of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When he comes back to you, detain him with me." Abdullah did not delay in returning, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Verily, you have rights upon yourself, and your family also has rights upon you."
hi: Umm Nubayh bint Al-Hajjaj (RA), Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ki walida, ek aisi khatoon thin jo Rasulullah (SAW) ko tohfe bhejti aur aap ke saath narmi se pesh aati thin. Ek din Rasulullah (SAW) unse milne aaye aur farmaya: "Ae Umm Abdullah! Tum kaisi ho?" Unhone kaha: "Achhi hun, mere maa baap aap par qurban, ya Rasulullah." Aap ne farmaya: "Aur Abdullah kaisa hai?" Unhone kaha: "Achha hai, mere maa baap aap par qurban, magar Abdullah aisa aadmi hai jisne dunya se kinara kar liya hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Kaise?" Unhone kaha: "Usne neend apne par haram kar li, na sota hai na roza chhodta hai, gosht haram kar liya, gosht nahi khata, aur apne ahl ka haq ada nahi karta." Aap ne farmaya: "Woh kahan hai?" Unhone kaha: "Abhi nikla hai, ya Rasulullah, jaldi lautne wala hai." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Jab woh aaye to use mere liye roke rakhna." Thodi hi der mein Abdullah aa gaye. Rasulullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: "Tumhare nafs ka tum par haq hai aur tumhare ahl ka tum par haq hai."

e: from the women of Banū ʿĀmir b. Luʾaī was Sahlah b. Suhayl b. ʿAmr b. ʿAbdushshams b. ʿAbduwudd b. Naṣr b. Mālik b. Ḥisl. She was from among those who emigrated with her husband, Abū Ḥudhayfah, to the land of Ḥabashah, then she had a child, in Ḥabashah, ˹named˺ Muḥammad b. Abū Ḥudhayfah.
hi: Kaha: Aur Bani Amir bin Luayy ki auraton mein se Sahlah bint Suhayl bin Amr bin Abd Shams bin Abd Wudd bin Nasr bin Malik bin Hisl (RA) thin, aur woh un auraton mein se thin jinhone apne shauhar Abu Hudhayfah (RA) ke saath Habshah ki taraf hijrat ki, aur wahan Habshah mein unse Muhammad bin Abi Hudhayfah paida hue.

e: [AI] She mentioned to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, about Salim, the slave of Abu Hudhayfa, and his entering upon her. She claimed that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, ordered her to breastfeed him. So she breastfed him, even though he was a grown man after he had witnessed the Battle of Badr. There was no further mention of this incident by Al-Dhahabi in his summarization.
hi: Unhone Rasulullah (SAW) se Salim (RA), Abu Hudhayfah (RA) ke azaad kardah, ka zikr kiya aur unke apne paas aane ka, to unka gumaan hai ke "Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke unhein doodh pilayen", chunancha unhone unhein doodh pilaya jabke woh Badr mein shareek ho kar jawan aadmi the. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "The Messenger of Allah commanded the wife of Abu Hudhaifah to breast-feed Salim, the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifah, so that the protective jealousy of Abu Hudhaifah would be dispelled. She breast-fed him when he was a man." (One of the narrators) Rabi'ah said: "That was a concession granted to Salim." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3321)
hi: "Nabi (SAW) ne Abu Hudhayfah (RA) ki biwi Sahlah (RA) ko hukm diya ke Abu Hudhayfah ke azaad kardah Salim (RA) ko doodh pilayen taake Abu Hudhayfah ki ghairat door ho jaye, chunancha unhone unhein doodh pilaya jabke woh aadmi the." Rabi'ah ne kaha: "Aur yeh Salim ke liye ek rukhsat thi."

e: [AI] "And among the women of Quraysh was Umm Habiba, whose name was Hamna bint Jahsh, the sister of Zainab bint Jahsh, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . She was from the tribe of Asad ibn Khuzaymah, an ally of Banu Abd Shams."
hi: "Aur Quraysh ki auraton mein se Umm Habibah (RA) hain, unka naam Hamnah bint Jahsh hai, Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) ki behen, aur woh Asad bin Khuzaymah mein se hain, Bani Abd Shams ki halif."

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saw a rope stretched between two pillars in the mosque, so he asked, "What is this rope?" It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, it is for Hamnah bint Jahsh who prays, and when she becomes fatigued, she holds onto the rope." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Let her pray as much as she is able, and when she becomes tired, she should sit down." This narration was told to me by Ali, who was told by Ismail, who was told by Abu Nu'aiman, who was told by Hammad ibn Salamah, who heard it from Humaid, who heard it from Anas, with a similar wording. Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Rasulullah (SAW) ne masjid mein do sutunon ke darmiyan ek rassi tani hui dekhi to farmaya: "Yeh rassi kaisi hai?" Kaha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah! Yeh Hamnah bint Jahsh (RA) ki hai, woh namaz padhti hain, jab thak jati hain to rassi se latak jati hain." Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Woh utni namaz padhe jitni taqat ho, jab thak jaye to baith jaye." Aur mujhse Ali ne bayan kiya, unse Isma'il ne, unse Abu An-Nu'man ne, unse Hammad bin Salamah ne, unse Humayd ne, unse Anas (RA) ne, isi ke misl. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "May Allah have mercy on him. Indeed, we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. It was said to her, 'Your uncle Hamza has been killed.' She said, 'Indeed, we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return.' It was said to her, 'Your husband has been killed.' She said, 'We are saddened by his loss.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'There is a share for the wife in her husband that cannot be described.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Allah unpar raham kare, 'inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un'." Phir unse kaha gaya: "Aap ke mamu Hamzah (RA) shaheed ho gaye." Unhone kaha: "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un." Phir unse kaha gaya: "Aap ke shauhar shaheed ho gaye." Unhone kaha: "Haye gham!" To Rasulullah (SAW) ne farmaya: "Shauhar ka biwi mein ek aisa maqam hai jo kisi aur cheez ka nahi." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: Umm Habibah, daughter of Jahsh, sister-in-law of Messenger of Allah ﷺ and wife of 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf, had a flow of blood for seven years. She asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: This is not menstruation but only vein; so you should take a bath and pray. 'Aishah said: She used to take bath in a wash-tub in the apartment of her sister Zainab daughter of Jahsh ; the redness of (her) blood dominated the water. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 288)
hi: Umm Habibah bint Jahsh (RA), jo Abd Ar-Rahman bin Awf (RA) ki biwi aur Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah Zaynab bint Jahsh (RA) ki behen thin, Rasulullah (SAW) ke paas aayin aur bataya ke unhein saat saal se istihazah hai. Unhone aap se fatwa poocha to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: "Yeh haiz nahi balki ek rag hai, to ghusl karo phir namaz padho." Woh ek tasht mein ghusl karti thin yahan tak ke paani par khoon ki surkhi chha jati, phir uth kar namaz padhti thin.

e: [AI] His aunt, Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh came to Aisha and said, "I am afraid that I may be among the people of Hell because I have not prayed for about two years." She asked the Prophet ﷺ  and he said, "Leave the prayer for every month for the days of its reading, then perform ablution for every prayer, as it is only sweat." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Unki khala Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh (RA) Aishah (RA) ke paas aayin aur kaha: "Mujhe darr hai ke main jahannam walon mein se na hun, maine takreeban do saal se namaz nahi padhi." Unhone Nabi (SAW) se poocha to aap ne farmaya: "Woh har mahine apne haiz ke dinon mein namaz chhod de, phir har namaz ke liye wudu kare, kyunke yeh to ek rag hai." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] I accompanied you until, when I was in the city for a night or two, I cooked a meal for you. Then the fire went out, so I went out to get firewood. I found a pot and placed it on your arm, and I went to the city and brought you to the Prophet ﷺ . I said, "O Messenger of Allah, this is Muhammad ibn Hatib, and he is the first one to be named after you." He wiped your head and made supplication for blessings. Then he spat in your mouth and on your hand and said, "O Lord of mankind, remove the pain, heal, for You are the Healer, there is no healing except Your healing, healing that leaves no ailment." She added, "I did not leave you from his side until your hand was healed."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) "...Main tumhein le kar chali yahan tak ke jab main Madinah se ek ya do raat ke fasle par thi to maine tumhare liye khana pakaya, lakdi khatm ho gayi, to main lakdi talash karne nikli. Maine handiya uthayi to woh tumhare bazu par ulat gayi. Phir main Madinah pahunchi aur tumhein Nabi (SAW) ke paas laayi. Maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah! Yeh Muhammad bin Hatib hai', aur woh pehle shakhs hain jinka naam aap ke naam par rakha gaya. Aap ne tumhare sar par haath phera, barkat ki dua ki, phir tumhare munh mein thook diya aur tumhare haath par thook dene lage aur farmate rahe: 'Takleef door kar de, ae logon ke Rabb! Shifa de, tu hi shifa dene wala hai, teri shifa ke siwa koi shifa nahi, aisi shifa jo koi bimari na chhode.'" Kaha: "To main tumhein aap ke paas se utha kar nikli bhi nahi thi ke tumhara haath theek ho gaya." Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And among them is Umm Ayman, the caretaker of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and her name is Barakah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  inherited her along with five heads of livestock and a piece of land. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  freed Umm Ayman when he married Khadijah, and Ubayd ibn Yazid from the Banu Harith ibn Khazraj tribe married her, and she gave birth to Ayman. He was martyred on the day of Khaybar. Zaid ibn Harithah was gifted to Khadijah and she gave him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  freed him and married him to Umm Ayman after prophethood, and she gave birth to Usamah ibn Zaid."
hi: "Aur unmein se Umm Ayman (RA) hain, Rasulullah (SAW) ki azaad kardah aur unki parwarish karne wali, unka naam Barakah tha. Rasulullah (SAW) ko woh paanch oont aur bakriyon ke ek ramme ke saath wirasat mein mili thin. Rasulullah (SAW) ne Umm Ayman ko us waqt azaad kiya jab Khadijah (RA) se nikah kiya. Phir unse Ubayd bin Yazid ne, jo Bani Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj mein se the, nikah kiya to unse Ayman paida hue, jo Khaybar ke din shaheed hue. Aur Zayd bin Harithah (RA) Khadijah (RA) ke the, unhone unhein Rasulullah (SAW) ko hibah kar diya to Rasulullah (SAW) ne unhein azaad kiya aur nubuwwat ke baad unka nikah Umm Ayman se kar diya, to unse Usamah bin Zayd (RA) paida hue."

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  used to say to Umm Ayman, "O my mother," and whenever he looked at her, he would say, "This is the remaining member of my family."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) Umm Ayman (RA) se farmate: 'Ae meri ammi!' Aur jab aap unki taraf dekhte to farmate: 'Yeh mere ahl-e-bait ki bachi hui (yaadgaar) hain.'

e: [AI] From Nubayh Al-Anazi, from Umm Ayman, she said: The Prophet ﷺ  came to me in the night and saw a water container beside the house. He dipped his hand in it and splashed some water on his face. I also got up during the night while feeling thirsty, so I drank from the water container without realizing. When the morning came, the Prophet ﷺ  said, "O Umm Ayman, go and pour out what is in the water container." I said, "By Allah, I have already drunk from it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  smiled until his molars were visible and then said, "Surely, your stomach will never feel discomfort because of it anymore." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent regarding summarizing it.
hi: Nubayh Al-Anazi, Umm Ayman (RA) se riwayat karte hain, unhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) raat ko uth kar ghar ke ek kone mein rakhe mitti ke bartan ki taraf gaye aur usmein peshab kiya. Phir main raat ko pyaas ki halat mein uthi aur mujhe pata nahi chala, maine us bartan ke munh se pee liya. Jab subah hui to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Umm Ayman, uth kar us bartan ke paas jao aur jo kuch usmein hai use baha do.' Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, jo kuch usmein tha woh to main pee chuki. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) hans pade, yahan tak ke aapki daadhein zaahir ho gayin, phir farmaya: 'Khabardar! Ab iske baad tumhare pet mein kabhi dard nahi hoga.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "The mother of Ayman, the foster mother of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , passed away during the first caliphate of Uthman ibn Affan."
hi: Umm Ayman (RA), jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ki azaad karda kaneez aur unki parwarish karne waali thin, Uthman bin Affan (RA) ki khilafat ke shuru mein wafat pa gayin.

e: [AI] "Abu Bakr, you intended with this diminutive form, the state of Islam and the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying to her, 'O mother, and O mother of Ayman, may Allah, the Almighty and Glorious, not hold me accountable if I have mentioned you.' So he hit her with seventy lashes." (Translation by AI)
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) Abu Bakr, tumne is (lafz) ke zariye bas unhein haqeer karna chaha, jabke Islam mein unka maqam wahi hai jo hai, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) unse farmaya karte the: 'Ae meri ammi, ae Umm Ayman! Allah Ta'ala mujhe maaf na kare agar main tumhein maaf kar doon.' Phir usne us shakhs ko sattar koray lagwaaye. Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] Arwa, the daughter of Kariz bin Rabia bin Habib bin Abd Shams, embraced Islam and migrated to Al-Madinah. She passed away during the caliphate of Uthman.
hi: Arwa bint Kariz bin Rabi'ah bin Habib bin Abd Shams (RA) Islam laayin, Madinah hijrat ki aur Uthman (RA) ki khilafat mein wafat pa gayin.

e: [AI] "And the name of the daughter of Abu Bakr, her mother is Qutaylah, the daughter of Abdul Uzza, the son of As'ad, the son of Jabir, the son of Malik, the son of Hisl, the son of 'Amir, the son of Lu'ay. She is the sister of Abdullah, the son of Abu Bakr, from his father and mother. She embraced Islam at an early time in Makkah and pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . She was married to Zubayr ibn Al-Awam and she gave birth to Abdullah, Umm Kulthum, Asim, Al-Muhajir, Khadijah Al-Kubra, Umm Al-Hasan and Aisha, the daughter of Zubayr, a total of seven children."
hi: Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) ki walida Qutaylah bint Abd Al-Uzza bin As'ad bin Jabir bin Malik bin Hisl bin Amir bin Lu'ay thin, aur woh Abdullah bin Abi Bakr (RA) ki sagi behen hain (ek hi baap aur ek hi maa se). Woh Makkah mein bohat pehle Islam laayin aur Rasoolullah (SAW) se bay'at ki. Az-Zubayr bin Al-Awwam (RA) ne unse nikah kiya, to unse Abdullah (RA), Urwah, Asim, Al-Muhajir, Khadijah Al-Kubra, Umm Al-Hasan aur Aishah bint Az-Zubayr paida hue, kul saat.

e: [AI] "If a thief entered my house, I would fill his belly." And it was deleted by Al-Dhahabi from the summary.
hi: 'Agar koi chor mere ghar mein ghus aaya to main uska pet cheer dungi.' Aur woh nabeena thin. Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] Asma bint Abi Bakr died after the killing of her son Abdullah bin Zubair on a Tuesday night, which was seventeen nights past the first month of Jumada al-Ula in the year seventy-three.
hi: Asma bint Abi Bakr (RA) apne bete Abdullah bin Az-Zubayr (RA) ke qatl ke kuch raaton baad wafat pa gayin. Unka qatl Mangal ke din, Jumada Al-Ula ki satrah raatein guzar jaane par, 73 Hijri mein hua tha.

e: [AI] Umm Habibah bint al-Zubayr ibn Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim was married to the messenger of Allah [SAW] from Makhdad ibn Amr ibn Tha'laba, and she gave birth to Abdullah and Karima. Abdullah was killed on the day of the Battle of the Camel along with Aisha, and Ali passed by his body and said, "What a wretched nephew."
hi: Duba'ah bint Az-Zubayr bin Abd Al-Muttalib bin Hashim (RA) ka nikah Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Al-Miqdad bin Amr bin Tha'labah (RA) se kar diya, to unse Abdullah aur Karimah paida hue. Abdullah Jamal ke din Aishah (RA) ke saath (lad kar) qatl hue. Ali (RA) un par se guzre jab woh maqtool pade the, to farmaya: 'Kya hi bura bhanja hai!'

e: [AI] "She gave meat to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he chewed it and then prayed without performing ablution." Adh-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko gosht pesh kiya, aapne usse (daanton se) noch kar khaya, phir namaz padhi aur naya wuzu nahi kiya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And the mother of wisdom, Umm Al-Hakam bint Al-Zubayr ibn Abd Al-Muttalib ibn Hashim, was married to Rabee'ah ibn Al-Harith ibn Abd Al-Muttalib, and she gave birth to Muhammad, Abbas, Abdul Shams, Abd Al-Muttalib, Umayyah, and Arwa Al-Kubra."
hi: Umm Al-Hakam bint Az-Zubayr bin Abd Al-Muttalib bin Hashim (RA) ka nikah Rabi'ah bin Al-Harith bin Abd Al-Muttalib (RA) se hua, to unse Muhammad, Abbas, Abd Ash-Shams, Abd Al-Muttalib, Umayyah aur Arwa Al-Kubra paida hue.

e: [AI] "It is narrated that she provided the Prophet ﷺ with a piece of meat, which he ate from without performing ablution. However, Hammad ibn Salamah misinterpreted the meaning of this incident. Umm Hakim reported that Hammad ibn Salamah narrated this from Qatadah, who narrated it from Ishaq ibn Abdullah, but this narration is not authentic."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko gosht ka ek dast pesh kiya, aapne usmein se khaya, phir namaz padhi aur naya wuzu nahi kiya. Hammad bin Salamah ko is naam mein wahm hua, unhone 'Umm Hakim' kaha. (Yeh riwayat) Hammad bin Salamah ne Qatadah se, unhone Ishaq bin Abdullah se, unhone un (khatoon) se bayan ki, aur yeh sahih nahi hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ate a bone at my place, then Bilal came and called the Adhan for prayer. He prayed without performing ablution." This statement was excluded by Al-Dhahabi from the summarized version.
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mere paas haddi (par lagi hui boti) khayi, phir Bilal (RA) aaye aur aapko namaz ki ittila di, to aapne namaz padhi aur wuzu nahi kiya.' Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] "And Ummama bint Hamza bin Abdul-Muttalib bin Hashim, her mother Salma bint Umayis bin Ma'd bin Taym, the sister of Asma bint Umayis, lived after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and narrated from him."
hi: Umamah bint Hamzah bin Abd Al-Muttalib bin Hashim (RA), unki walida Salma bint Umays bin Ma'd bin Taym (RA) thin, jo Asma bint Umays (RA) ki behen hain. Umamah (RA) Rasoolullah (SAW) ke baad bhi zinda rahin aur aapse riwayat bhi ki.

e: [AI] Her master died and left only one daughter. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ decided that his daughter will receive half, and the other half will go to the daughter of Hamza.
hi: Unka ek azaad karda ghulam wafat pa gaya aur sirf ek beti chhodi, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne faisla farmaya ke uski beti ko aadha milega aur Hamzah (RA) ki beti ko aadha.

e: [AI] "Umm Kulthum bint 'Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ayt, her mother is Arwa bint Kariz. Umm Kulthum embraced Islam and pledged allegiance before the migration (to Medina) and she was the first woman to migrate after the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him."
hi: Umm Kulthum (RA), Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ayt ki beti, ki walida Arwa bint Kariz (RA) thin. Umm Kulthum (RA) Islam laayin aur hijrat se pehle bay'at ki, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke (hijrat farmane ke) baad hijrat karne waali auraton mein sab se pehli wohi hain.

e: [AI] The Qurayshi women who left their parents' house as Muslims and migrants to Allah and His Messenger were only Umm Kulthum, the daughter of Uqba. She left Mecca alone and accompanied a man from the Khuzai tribe until she reached Medina during the truce of Hudaybiyyah. Her brothers Al-Walid and Umara followed her, and they arrived at the same time as her. They said, "O Muhammad, you have conditions with us, and you did not fulfill them. In it [the Quran] it was revealed: 'When the believing women come to you as emigrants' (Surah Al-Mumtahina 10). However, she did not have a husband in Mecca. When she arrived in Medina, Zaid ibn Haritha married her, but he was martyred. Then, Az-Zubayr ibn Al-Awwam married her, and she gave birth to Zaynab for him. He divorced her, and then Abdul Rahman ibn Auf married her, and she gave birth to Ibrahim and Humaidan. He died, and then Amr ibn al-Aas married her, and she died during his marriage.
hi: Quraish ki koi aisi aurat maloom nahi jo apne walidain ke ghar se musalman hokar, Allah aur uske Rasool ki taraf hijrat karte hue nikli ho, siwaye Umm Kulthum (RA), Uqbah ki beti, ke. Woh Makkah se akeli nikli aur Khuza'ah ke ek aadmi ke saath ho li, yahan tak ke Hudaibiyah ki sulah ke dauran Madinah pahunch gayin. Unke peeche unke do bhai Al-Walid aur Umarah nikle, aur jis waqt woh pahunchi usi waqt yeh dono bhi pahunche, aur kaha: Ae Muhammad! Hamare liye hamari shart aur woh ahd (poora kijiye) jo aapne humse kiya tha. Aur unhi ke baare mein yeh aayat nazil hui: {Jab tumhare paas imaan waali auratein hijrat karke aayen...} (Surah Al-Mumtahanah 10), aayat ke aakhir tak. Makkah mein unka koi shauhar nahi tha. Jab woh Madinah pahunchin to Zaid bin Harithah (RA) ne unse nikah kiya, phir woh (Zaid) unke nikah mein rehte hue qatl kar diye gaye. Phir Az-Zubayr bin Al-Awwam (RA) ne unse nikah kiya, to unse Zainab paida huin, phir unhone unhein talaq de di. Phir Abd Ar-Rahman bin Awf (RA) ne unse nikah kiya, to unse Ibrahim aur Humaid paida hue, aur woh unke nikah mein rehte hue wafat pa gaye. Phir Amr bin Al-As (RA) ne unse nikah kiya, aur woh unke nikah mein rehte hue wafat pa gayin.

e: Abu Dawud said “I heard Muhammad bin Isa narrating this tradition who said Mu’tamar narrated it to us. And he (Mu’tamar) said “ I heard Al Hakam bin Aban narrating this tradition. He did not mention the name of Ibn ‘Abbas. Abu Dawud said “Al Hussain bin Huraith wrote to me saying “Al Fadl bin Musa narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2225)
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) Nabi (SAW) se (riwayat hai).

e: "I heard the Messenger of Allah after that seeking refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2061)
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko qabr ke azaab se Allah ki panah maangte hue suna.

e: [AI] "Abu Hudhaifah and his sister Hind went to pledge allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When he specified conditions for them, Hind said, 'Do you know of any women among your people who have these diseases or defects?' Abu Hudhaifah replied, 'Yes, pledge allegiance to him, for he stipulates such conditions.' Al-Dhahabi has remained silent in summarizing this."
hi: Abu Hudhaifah (RA) unhein aur unki behen Hind ko Rasoolullah (SAW) se bay'at karwane le gaye. Jab aapne un par shartein rakhin to Hind ne kaha: Kya aap apni qaum ki auraton mein se kisi mein in buri baatein aur aibon (al-hanat wal-ahat) mein se kuch jaante hain? Abu Hudhaifah (RA) ne unse kaha: Bas karo, bay'at kar lo, kyunke woh isi tarah shartein rakhte hain. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Hamnah bint Jahsh, who was with Mus'ab ibn 'Umair, was killed on the day of Uhud. Talha ibn 'Ubaidallah then married her and she gave birth to Muhammad bin Al-Sajjad, who was also called Abdullah bin Talha."
hi: Hamnah bint Jahsh (RA) Mus'ab bin Umair (RA) ke nikah mein thin, aur Uhud ke din woh (Mus'ab) un ke nikah mein rehte hue shaheed ho gaye. Phir Talhah bin Ubaydullah (RA) ne unse nikah kiya, to unse Muhammad bin As-Sajjad paida hue, aur usi ke zariye (Talhah ki) kunyat hoti thi, aur Abdullah bin Talhah.

e: [AI] She heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "Indeed, this worldly life is sweet and green. How many are those who strive and struggle for the wealth of Allah and His Messenger in this world, but on the Day of Judgment, they have nothing but the fire (of Hell)." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Khabardar! Dunya meethi aur hari-bhari hai. Kitne hi log hain jo Allah aur uske Rasool ke maal mein (na-haq) ghus kar tasarruf karte hain, unke liye qiyamat ke din aag ke siwa kuch nahi.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "And Umm Qais bint Muhsan bin Khawwat, the sister of Ukkashah bin Muhsan, embraced Islam in Mecca long ago and migrated to Medina with her family. She lived there after the Prophet ﷺ and narrated from him."
hi: Umm Qais bint Mihsan bin Khawwat (RA), jo Ukkashah bin Mihsan (RA) ki behen hain, Makkah mein bohat pehle Islam laayin aur apne ghar waalon ke saath Madinah hijrat ki. Woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ke baad bhi zinda rahin aur aapse riwayat ki.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  left with her, taking her hand, in the path of Madinah until he reached Al-Baqi' Al-Gharqad. He said, "O Umm Qays." I said, "At your service and at your pleasure, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Do you see this graveyard?" I said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Seventy thousand will emerge from it on the Day of Resurrection in the image of the moon on a full moon night, they will enter Paradise without being held accountable." Ukasha stood up and said, "And me, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "And you." Another person stood up and said, "And me?" He said, "Ukasha preceded you in it."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) unka haath pakad kar Madinah ki ek gali mein nikle, yahan tak ke Baqi' Al-Gharqad pahunch gaye. Farmaya: 'Ae Umm Qais!' Maine kaha: Labbaik wa sa'daik, ya Rasoolullah! Farmaya: 'Kya tum is qabristan ko dekh rahi ho?' Maine kaha: Ji haan, ya Rasoolullah. Farmaya: 'Qiyamat ke din is mein se sattar hazar log uthaye jayenge, unki shakal chaudhwin raat ke chand jaisi hogi, woh bighair hisaab jannat mein dakhil honge.' To Ukkashah (RA) khade hue aur kaha: Aur main, ya Rasoolullah? Farmaya: 'Aur tum.' Phir ek aur shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Aur main? To farmaya: 'Is mein Ukkashah tumse aage nikal gaya.'

e: [AI] "Juthamah bint Jandal ibn Wahb al-Asadiyah accepted Islam in the ancient city of Mecca and pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . She migrated to Medina with her family."
hi: Judhamah bint Jandal bin Wahb Al-Asadiyyah (RA) Makkah mein bohat pehle Islam laayin, Rasoolullah (SAW) se bay'at ki aur apne ghar waalon ke saath Madinah hijrat ki.

e: [AI] The sons of Ghanim bin Doudan participated in the migration with their men and women until their doors were closed. Among the women who migrated were Zainab, Umm Habibah, Hamnah, the daughters of Jash, Aaminah bintu Ruqaysh, Umm Habibah bintu Bunana, and Juthamah bintu Jandal. Juthamah bintu Jandal was married to Uns ibn Qatadah ibn Rabee'ah from the Aws tribe. She witnessed the Battle of Badr and was martyred on the day of Uhud. Juthamah lived after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and both Aisha and Juthamah narrated from her.
hi: Bani Ghanim bin Dudan ne hijrat mein apne mard aur auraton sab ko saath le liya, yahan tak ke unke darwaze band ho gaye. Auraton mein se hijrat karne waali yeh thin: Zainab, Umm Habibah aur Hamnah, jo Jahsh ki betiyan hain (RA), Aminah bint Ruqaysh (RA), Umm Habibah bint Bunanah (RA) aur Judhamah bint Jandal (RA). Judhamah bint Jandal (RA), Unais bin Qatadah bin Rabi'ah (RA) ke nikah mein thin, jo Aws mein se the, Badr mein shareek hue aur Uhud ke din shaheed hue. Judhamah (RA) Rasoolullah (SAW) ke baad bhi zinda rahin aur aapse riwayat ki, aur Aishah (RA) ne Judhamah (RA) se riwayat ki hai.

e: [AI] Narrated by Aisha, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , from Juthama ibn Wahb al-Asadiya, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , that he was concerned about preventing people from having intimate relations during breastfeeding. So I looked and saw that the Persians and Romans practiced it, and it did not harm their children. Aisha asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about 'azl (coitus interruptus). He said, "It is a secret contraception method." Both Sheikhs (referring to Bukhari and Muslim) agreed on omitting the hadith of Malik ibn Anas from Abu al-Aswad without the addition, as it came from Yahya ibn Ayyub.
hi: Aishah (RA), Nabi (SAW) ki zaujah, Judhamah bint Wahb Al-Asadiyyah (RA) se, woh Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat karti hain ke aapne iraada farmaya tha ke ghiyal (doodh pilane waali aurat se humbistari) se mana farma dein. Aapne farmaya: 'Phir maine dekha to Faaris aur Room waale ghiyal karte hain aur isse unki aulad ko koi nuksan nahi hota.' Unhone kaha: Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) se azl ke baare mein poocha gaya to farmaya: 'Yeh khufiya zinda dafn karna hai.' Dono Shaykhain (Bukhari aur Muslim) ne Malik bin Anas ki Abu Al-Aswad se riwayat nikaalne par ittifaq kiya hai, magar is izafe ke baghair, kyunke yeh izafa Yahya bin Ayyub ka hai. Un dono ne iska shuru ka hissa nikaala hai.

e: [AI] "And by Allah, it is as if I am looking at the Prophet of Allah ﷺ  on that morning when he entered the Kaaba, then came out of it and stood at its door. He had a pigeon in his hand from the sticks that were inside the Kaaba. He broke it and threw it when he reached the door of the Kaaba." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in the summarization.
hi: 'Allah ki qasam, goya main aaj bhi Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ko us subah dekh raha hoon jab aap Kaabah mein daakhil hue, phir usse bahar nikle aur uske darwaze par khade ho gaye, aur aapke haath mein lakdi ka ek kabootar tha jo Kaabah ke andar tha. Aapne use tod diya, phir use lekar nikle, yahan tak ke jab Kaabah ke darwaze par pahunche to use phenk diya.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Fatimah, the daughter of Abu Hubaysh, the son of al-Muttalib, the son of Asad, the son of Abd al-Uzza, was married to Abdullah, the son of Jash, the son of Riyab. She bore a son for him named Muhammad, the son of Abdullah, the son of Jash. Fatimah bint Abu Hubaysh lived and she saw the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and narrated from him."
hi: Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh bin Al-Muttalib bin Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza (RA) ka nikah Abdullah bin Jahsh bin Riyab (RA) se hua, to unse Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Jahsh paida hue. Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh (RA) zinda rahin, Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dekha aur aapse riwayat ki.

e:
[AI] The following translation provided is a basic interpretation of the original text: 
"And Busrah, the daughter of Safwan bin Nawfal bin Asad bin Abd al-Uzza bin Qusay, is the sister of Uqbah bin Abi Muayat through her mother. Uqbah is the grandfather of Abdul-Malik bin Marwan. And the mother of Abdul-Malik is Aisha bint Muawiyah bin Al-Mughirah bin Abi Al-As bin Umayyah. Busrah lived after the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) and she narrated a well-known hadith regarding wiping over the male private part during ablution."
