hi: Busrah bint Safwan bin Nawfal bin Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza bin Qusayy (RA), Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ayt ki maa-shariq (maan ki taraf se) behen hain, aur woh (Uqbah) Abd Al-Malik bin Marwan ke jadd (dada/nana) hain. Abd Al-Malik ki walida Aishah bint Mu'awiyah bin Al-Mughirah bin Abi Al-As bin Umayyah thin. Busrah (RA) Rasoolullah (SAW) ke baad bhi zinda rahin aur aapse us shakhs ke liye wuzu ki khabar riwayat ki jo apni sharmgah ko haath lagaye, aur yeh khabar mash'hoor hai.

e: My nephew, leave him for he defended Messenger of Allah ﷺ. (Using translation from Muslim 2487a)
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) Rasoolullah (SAW) se (riwayat hai).

e: [AI] Indeed, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  desired his honor and the beginning of prophethood from Allah, whenever he went out for his needs, he would travel far away until he could not see a house. He would traverse through the outskirts and valleys, not passing by a stone or tree except that it would greet him with salaam, saying, "Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah." He would then turn to his right, left, and behind him, not seeing anyone. This hadith is authentic.
hi: Jab Allah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ki izzat-afzaai aur nubuwwat ki ibtida ka iraada farmaya to aapka yeh haal tha ke jab qaza-e-haajat ke liye nikalte to itni door nikal jaate ke koi ghar nazar na aata, aur ghaatiyon aur waadiyon ke andar jaa kar haajat poori karte. Aap jis patthar ya darakht ke paas se guzarte woh kehta: 'Assalamu alaika ya Rasoolullah!' Aap apne daayen, baayen aur peeche muddte lekin kisi ko na dekhte. (Hakim kehte hain:) Yeh hadees sahih nahi hai.

e: [AI] I heard the son of Abi Nubayh narrating about his grandmother Safiyyah bint Shaybah, who narrated from Habibah bint Abi Tijarah, she said: "We had a custom during the time of ignorance. She said: "I climbed on top of a mountain between Safa and Marwah and I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  coming towards me and he was walking briskly. He said to his companions, 'Hurry, for indeed Allah, the Exalted, has prescribed for you Sa'i (the running between Safa and Marwah).' She said: "I saw him in the intensity of his movement, turning his waist wrap around his belly until I saw the whiteness of his armpits and thighs." [Note: The last sentence seems to be incomplete or has an error.]
hi: Maine Ibn Abi Nubayh ko apni dadi Safiyyah bint Shaybah se riwayat karte suna, woh Habibah bint Abi Tajrah (RA) se riwayat karti hain, unhone kaha: Jahiliyyat mein hamara ek chabutara tha. Unhone kaha: Maine Safa aur Marwa ke beech ek roshandan se jhaank kar dekha to Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dekha ke aap sa'i kar rahe hain aur apne sahaba se farma rahe hain: 'Sa'i karo, kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne tum par sa'i likh di hai.' Unhone kaha: Maine aapko sakht daud ke dauran dekha, aap izaar ko apne pet ke gird ghuma rahe the, yahan tak ke maine aapki baghlon aur raano ki safedi dekh li. (Hakim kehte hain:) Yeh sahih nahi hai.

e: [AI] "I entered the house of Abu Hussain in Niswah, from the tribe of Quraysh, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  was making Tawaf between Safa and Marwa, and he was moving quickly while his garment was clinging to him due to the intensity of his pace. He was saying to his companions, 'Hurry, for Allah Almighty has ordained upon you to make this effort.'"
hi: Main Abu Husayn ke ghar mein Quraish ki kuch auraton ke saath dakhil hui, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) Safa aur Marwa ke beech sa'i kar rahe the, aur sakht daud ki wajah se aapka izaar aapke gird ghoom raha tha, aur aap apne sahaba se farma rahe the: 'Sa'i karo, kyunke Allah Ta'ala ne tum par sa'i likh di hai.'

e: [AI] "And the mother of Farwah, daughter of Abu Quhafa, sister of Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, and the aunt of Aisha, her mother is Hind, daughter of Nawfal bin Bujaer bin Ubaid bin Qusayy. She was married to Abu Bakr Al-Ash'ath bin Qais and gave birth to Muhammad, Ishaq, Hubabah, and Quraibah."
hi: Umm Farwah bint Abi Quhafah (RA), Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ki behen aur Aishah (RA) ki phuphi hain. Unki walida Hind bint Nufayl bin Bujayr bin Ubayd bin Qusayy thin. Abu Bakr (RA) ne unka nikah Al-Ash'ath bin Qais (RA) se kar diya, to unse Muhammad, Ishaq, Hubabah aur Qurayba paida hue.

e: "I came to the Prophet with some other Ansari women to give our pledge. We said: 'O Messenger of Allah, we give you our pledge that we will not associate anything with Allah, we will not steal, we will not have unlawful sexual relations, we will not utter slander, fabricating from between our hands and feet, and we will not disobey you in goodness.' He said: 'As much as you can and are able.' We said: 'Allah and His Messenger are more merciful toward us. Com, let us give you our pledge, O Messenger of Allah! The Messenger of Allah said: 'I do not shake hands with women. Rather my word to a hundred women is like my word to one woman."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4181)
hi: Maine musalman auraton ke saath Rasoolullah (SAW) se bay'at ki. Humne aapse kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Hum aapke paas is baat par bay'at karne aayi hain ke hum Allah ke saath kisi cheez ko shareek nahi karengi, chori nahi karengi, zina nahi karengi, apni aulad ko qatl nahi karengi, koi jhoota ilzaam nahi laayengi jo apne haathon aur paaon ke beech gadh len, aur kisi nek kaam mein aapki nafarmani nahi karengi. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jitni tum mein taaqat ho.' Humne kaha: Allah aur uska Rasool humpar hamari apni jaanon se zyada meherbaan hain. Phir humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Humse bay'at le lijiye. Farmaya: 'Jao, maine tumse bay'at le li. Meri baat ek aurat ke liye wahi hai jo sau auraton ke liye.' Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne hum mein se kisi se musafaha nahi kiya.

e:
Umaymah is the daughter of Ruqayqah and Ruqayqah is her mother. Her father is ʿAbdullāh b. Bijād b. ʿUmayr b. al-Ḥārith ibn Ḥarithah b. Saʿd b. Taym b. Murrah. Her mother is Ruqayqa b. Khuwaylid b. Asad b. ʿAbdalʿuzzá, the sister of Khadījah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ.
Umaymah remained single and then Ḥabīb b. Kaʿb b. ʿUtayr al-Thaqafī married her. She gave birth to al-Nahdiyyah. Umaymah b. Ruqayqah lived after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and narrated from him.[^1]
hi: Umaymah bint Ruqayqah (RA), aur Ruqayqah unki walida hain; unke walid Abdullah bin Bijad bin Umair bin Al-Harith bin Harithah bin Sa'd bin Taym bin Murrah hain, aur unki walida Ruqayqah (RA), Khuwaylid bin Asad bin Abd Al-Uzza ki beti, Nabi (SAW) ki zaujah Khadijah (RA) ki behen hain. Umaymah ne (kuch arsa) nikah nahi kiya, phir Habib bin Ka'b bin Utayr Ath-Thaqafi ne unse nikah kiya, to unse An-Nahdiyyah paida hui. Umaymah bint Ruqayqah (RA) Rasoolullah (SAW) ke baad bhi zinda rahin aur aapse riwayat ki.

e: [AI] About Ummuimah, the aunt of Fatimah, daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , she said, "I heard her say, 'We pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he bound us not to associate anything with Allah.'" Then she mentioned a narration similar to what Ibn Ishaq reported from Ibn al-Munkadir.
hi: Umaymah (RA), jo Fatimah (RA), Rasoolullah (SAW) ki saahibzaadi, ki khala hain, se riwayat hai. (Raawi ne) kaha: Maine unhein kehte suna: 'Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) se bay'at ki to aapne humse yeh ahd liya ke hum Allah ke saath kisi cheez ko shareek nahi karengi.' (Raawi ne) kaha: Phir unhone Ibn Ishaq ki Ibn Al-Munkadir se riwayat karda hadees jaisi hadees zikr ki.

e: [AI] About Barirah, may Allah be pleased with her.
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) Barirah (RA) se (riwayat hai).

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  entered to relieve himself, and I entered after him but I did not see anything. However, I could smell the scent of musk. So, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I did not see anything." He said, "Verily, the earth has been commanded to suffice us, the company of prophets."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) qaza-e-haajat ke liye (andar) gaye, main bhi andar gayi to kuch nahi dekha, aur mushk ki khushboo paayi. Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Maine kuch nahi dekha. Farmaya: 'Zameen ko hukm diya gaya hai ke woh hum anbiya ki jamaat ke (is mamle ke) liye kaafi ho jaye, yaani use chhupa le.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "For a man from the Quraysh, the strength is equivalent to the strength of two men from the Quraysh." Al-Zuhri said, "It means obtaining leadership."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Quraish ke ek aadmi mein Quraish ke do aadmiyon jitni quwwat hoti hai.' Az-Zuhri ne kaha: 'Yani raay (soojh-boojh) paane mein.'

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said to Umar ibn al-Khattab, "O Umar, gather your people for me." So he gathered them, and then the Prophet entered upon them and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have gathered them. Should they come to you or should you go to them?" He said, "No, I will go to them." The Emigrants and the Helpers heard this, and they said, "There has come a revelation about the Quraysh." The onlookers and the listeners were present with them, so the Prophet stood among them and said, "Is there anyone among you other than yourselves?" They said, "Yes, among us are our allies, the sons of our brothers, and our supporters." The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Our allies are from among us, and our supporters are from among us." Then he said, "Do you listen to those among you who are righteous? If you are among them, then it is as I have said. If not, then hearken and beware, for people will not bring their deeds to you while you bring your burdens to them." Then he called out, raising his voice, and said, "Indeed, the Quraysh are the people of trust. Whoever transgresses against them, Allah will disgrace him from his throat." He repeated this statement three times.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) se farmaya: 'Ae Umar! Mere liye apni qaum ko jama karo.' Unhone unhein jama kiya, phir aapke paas aaye aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Maine unhein jama kar diya hai, woh aapke paas andar aayein ya aap unke paas tashreef le chalenge? Farmaya: 'Balki main unke paas nikalta hoon.' Muhajireen aur Ansar ne yeh suna to kehne lage: Quraish ke baare mein wahi aayi hai. To dekhne wala aur sunne wala (sab) haazir ho gaye ke unse kya kaha jaata hai. Aap unke beech khade hue aur farmaya: 'Kya tum mein tumhare siwa koi aur bhi hai?' Unhone kaha: Haan, hamare halif (ahd ke saathi), hamare bhaiyon ke bete aur hamare mawali (azaad karda ghulam) hain. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Hamare halif humse hain aur hamare mawali humse hain.' Phir farmaya: 'Kya tum sunte nahi, mere dost tum mein se muttaqi log hain? Agar tum woh ho to theek, warna dekh lo, phir dekh lo! Aisa na ho ke log amal lekar aayen aur tum bojh (gunahon ka) lekar aao, to tumse munh pher liya jaye.' Phir aapne awaaz buland karke pukara aur farmaya: 'Beshak Quraish amanat waale hain; jo unke liye lagzishon ki talaash mein rahe, Allah use munh ke bal gira dega.' Aapne yeh teen baar farmaya.

e: [AI] While we were sitting in the courtyard of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , a woman passed by. A man from the people said, "This is the daughter of Muhammad." Abu Sufyan said, "Indeed, the likeness of Muhammad among the Banu Hashim is like the sweet-scented flower in the middle of the fig trees." The woman went and informed the Prophet ﷺ , so the Prophet came out with anger apparent on his face and said, "What is the matter with people's words reaching me? Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, created the heavens and chose the highest, then He created creation and chose from His creation the Children of Adam, and from the Children of Adam He chose the Arabs, and from the Arabs He chose Mudar, and from Mudar He chose Quraysh, and from Quraysh He chose Banu Hashim, and from Banu Hashim He chose me. So, I am from Banu Hashim, from the best to the best. So, whoever loves the Arabs, then they should love me, and whoever hates the Arabs, then they should hate me." And it has been narrated in this chain from Muhammad ibn Dhuwān from 'Amr ibn Dīnār from Abdullah ibn 'Umar.
hi: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ahaate mein baithe the ke ek aurat guzri. Qaum mein se ek aadmi ne kaha: Yeh Muhammad ki beti hai. To Abu Sufyan ne kaha: Bani Hashim mein Muhammad ki misaal aisi hai jaise anjeer ke darakhton ke beech rehaan (khushbudar paudha). Woh aurat gayi aur Nabi (SAW) ko khabar di. To Nabi (SAW) is haal mein nikle ke chehre par ghussa pehchana ja raha tha. Farmaya: 'Un logon ki baaton ka kya matlab jo mujhe pahunch rahi hain? Beshak Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne aasmaan banaye to bulandi ko chuna aur usmein apni makhlooq mein se jise chaha basaya. Phir makhlooq paida ki to makhlooq mein se Bani Adam ko chuna, Bani Adam mein se Arab ko chuna, Arab mein se Mudar ko, Mudar mein se Quraish ko, Quraish mein se Bani Hashim ko, aur Bani Hashim mein se mujhe chuna. Pas main Bani Hashim mein se hoon, behtareen se behtareen tak. Jisne Arab se mohabbat ki usne meri mohabbat ki wajah se unse mohabbat ki, aur jisne Arab se bughz rakha usne mujhse bughz ki wajah se unse bughz rakha.' Aur is isnad ke baare mein kaha gaya hai ke yeh Muhammad bin Zakwan se, unhone Amr bin Dinar se, unhone Abdullah bin Umar se (riwayat hai).

e: [AI] While we were sitting in the courtyard of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he mentioned the entire narration exactly as it happened.
hi: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ahaate mein baithe the - phir unhone poori hadees isi jaisi zikr ki.

e: [AI] "O my son, if you are to be appointed over the people in any matter, then honor the Quraysh, for I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Whoever humiliates the Quraysh, Allah will humiliate him.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
hi: Mere walid ne mujhse kaha: Beta! Agar tumhein logon ke kisi maamle ki zimmedari mile to Quraish ka ikram karna, kyunke maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jisne Quraish ki tauheen ki Allah Ta'ala use zaleel karega.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever seeks to disgrace the Quraysh, Allah will disgrace him." This hadith was narrated by Al-Laith ibn Saad from Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn Usama ibn Al-Hadi, who heard it from Ibrahim ibn Saad. He is considered one of the trustworthy narrators when it comes to transmitting the statements of the elders from the younger generation.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo Quraish ki bezzati ka iraada karega Allah use zaleel karega.' Yeh hadees Al-Layth bin Sa'd ne Yazid bin Abdullah bin Usamah bin Al-Hadi se, unhone Ibrahim bin Sa'd se riwayat ki hai, aur yeh un hadeeson ke ghurar (behtareen) mein se hai jo bade log chhoton se riwayat karte hain.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Whoever seeks to humiliate the Quraysh, Allah will humiliate him without a doubt." Yusuf ibn Abi Aqil, undoubtedly the son of al-Hakam, and the narration from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  is authentic, that a child does not bear the sins of his father.
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jo Quraish ki bezzati ka iraada karega Allah Ta'ala use zaleel karega.' Yusuf bin Abi Aqil bila shak Ibn Al-Hakam hain, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) se yeh riwayat sahih sabit hai ke beta apne baap par jurm ka bojh nahi daalta.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying on the pulpit, "What is the matter with people who claim that my intercession will not benefit them? By Allah, my intercession is connected to this world and the hereafter. And oh people, I will have more followers at the Pond (of Kawthar), but when I arrive, some men will stand up and say, 'This is O Messenger of Allah, I am so-and-so,' and another will say, 'This is O Messenger of Allah, I am so-and-so,' and another will say, 'This is O Messenger of Allah, I am so-and-so.' Then I will say, 'I have recognized you, but you have innovated after me and returned to disbelief.'"
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko minbar par farmate suna: 'Un logon ka kya haal hai jo kehte hain ke meri rehm (qarabat) faida nahi degi? Kyun nahi, Allah ki qasam! Meri rehm dunya aur aakhirat mein juri hui hai. Aur ae logo! Main hauz par tumse pehle pahunchne wala hoon. Jab main aaunga to kuch log khade honge, ek kahega: Ya Rasoolullah! Main falaan hoon. Doosra kahega: Ya Rasoolullah! Main falaan hoon. Teesra kahega: Ya Rasoolullah! Main falaan hoon. To main kahunga: Maine tumhein pehchana, lekin tumne mere baad (deen mein) nayi baatein nikaali aur ulte paon laut gaye.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The safety of the people of the earth from conflict is through loyalty to the Quraysh, for Quraysh are the people of Allah. But when a tribe from the Arabs opposes them, it becomes a party of Satan."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Zameen walon ke liye ikhtilaf se amaan Quraish se wafadaari mein hai, aur Quraish Allah waale hain. Jab Arab ka koi qabila unki mukhalifat karta hai to woh Iblees ka giroh ban jaata hai.'

e: "We used to come across groups of Quraish who would be talking, but they would stop talking (when we approached). We mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'What is the matter with people who talk, then when they see a man from my family they stop talking? By Allah, faith will not enter a person's heart until he loves them for the sake of Allah and because of their closeness to me.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 140)
hi: Hum Quraish ke kuch logon se milte to woh baat kar rahe hote aur apni baat rok dete. Humne yeh Rasoolullah (SAW) se zikr kiya to farmaya: 'Un logon ka kya haal hai jo baatein kar rahe hote hain, jab mere ahl mein se kisi ko dekhte hain to apni baat rok dete hain? Allah ki qasam! Kisi aadmi ke dil mein imaan dakhil nahi hoga yahan tak ke woh unse Allah Ta'ala ke liye aur meri qarabat ki wajah se mohabbat na kare.'

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, when Quraysh meet each other, they greet one another with smiles. But when they meet us, they meet us with unknown faces." He became extremely angry and then said, "By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, faith does not enter the heart of a man until he loves you for the sake of Allah and His Messenger." Al-Dhahabi remained quiet on this matter in summary.
hi: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Jab Quraish aapas mein milte hain to khush-chehre ke saath milte hain, aur jab humse milte hain to aise chehron ke saath milte hain jinhein hum pehchante nahi. (Raawi ne) kaha: Aap sakht ghussa ho gaye, phir farmaya: 'Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, kisi aadmi ke dil mein imaan dakhil nahi hoga yahan tak ke woh tumse Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye mohabbat na kare.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The leaders are from Quraysh. The righteous ones among them are the leaders of the righteous, and the wicked ones among them are the leaders of the wicked. Everyone has a right, so give everyone their due right. And if I appoint a slave of Abyssinian descent as a leader over you, then listen to him and obey him as long as he does not command you to commit a sin. If he commands you to commit a sin, then none of you should choose between embracing Islam or have his neck struck, but instead he should prioritize having his neck struck, for he will lose both this world and the Hereafter after abandoning Islam." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this statement in his summary.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Imam Quraish mein se hain; unke nek log nek logon ke ameer hain aur unke fajir (gunahgaar) log fajiron ke ameer hain. Har ek ka haq hai, pas har haqdaar ko uska haq do. Agar main tum par naak-kaan kate hue kisi habshi ghulam ko bhi ameer bana doon to uski suno aur itaat karo, jab tak tum mein se kisi ko apne Islam aur apni gardan maare jaane ke beech ikhtiyar na diya jaye. Agar kisi ko apne Islam aur apni gardan maare jaane ke beech ikhtiyar diya jaye to woh apni gardan aage kar de, kyunke apne Islam (ko chhodne) ke baad uske liye na dunya hai na aakhirat.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] To the Prophet ﷺ , "Do you have a fortress and a fortress that prevents the entry of foes?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to a storage area for the Ansar and said, "Tufayl emigrated and a man from his people emigrated with him. But the man fell ill and said a word that made him distraught. He came to a horn and took a knife and cut his veins, and he died. Tufayl saw him in a dream and said, "What did Allah do to you?" He said, "He forgave me for my emigration to the Prophet ﷺ ." He said, "What is wrong with your hands?" He said, "I was told that we will not fix from you what you have damaged yourself." Tufayl narrated it to the Prophet ﷺ  and he said, "Oh Allah, be a guardian to his parents and forgive him." And he raised his hands.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... Nabi (SAW) se kaha: Kya aapko ek qile aur hifazat ki zaroorat hai, Daws ke qile ki? To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne (is peshkash ko chhod kar) us cheez ki taraf rukh kiya jo Allah ne Ansar ke liye zakhira kar rakhi thi. (Raawi ne) kaha: Phir Tufayl (RA) ne hijrat ki, aur unke saath unki qaum ka ek aadmi bhi hijrat kar gaya. Woh aadmi beemar ho gaya. Kaha: To woh tang aa gaya (ya isi tarah ka koi lafz kaha), phir ek tarkash (qarn) ke paas aaya, ek chauda teer (mishqas) uthaya aur apni ungliyon ke jod kaat daale, to woh (khoon behne se) mar gaya. Tufayl (RA) ne use khwaab mein dekha to poochha: Allah ne tere saath kya muamla kiya? Usne kaha: Mujhe Nabi (SAW) ki taraf meri hijrat ki wajah se bakhsh diya. Poochha: Tere haathon ko kya hua? Usne kaha: Mujhse kaha gaya: Hum tere us hisse ko durust nahi karenge jo tune khud bigaad diya. (Raawi ne) kaha: Tufayl (RA) ne yeh Nabi (SAW) ko sunaya to aapne farmaya: 'Ae Allah! Iske haathon ko bhi bakhsh de.' Aur aapne apne haath uthaye.

e: [AI] "They are the ones who migrated with the Prophet ﷺ to Medina."
hi: Allah Ta'ala ke is farman {Tum behtareen ummat ho jo logon ke liye nikali gayi} (Surah Aal-e-Imran 110) ke baare mein (unhone) kaha: 'Yeh woh log hain jinhone Nabi (SAW) ke saath Madinah ki taraf hijrat ki.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, the emigrants will have minbars (pulpits) made of gold upon which they will sit on the Day of Resurrection. They will have been saved from fear." Abu Sa'id added, "By Allah, if I had one of those minbars, I would have preferred it over my people."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Muhajireen ke liye sone ke minbar honge jin par woh qiyamat ke din baithenge, woh ghabrahat se mehfooz honge.' (Raawi ne) kaha: Phir Abu Sa'id (RA) kehte: 'Allah ki qasam! Agar main yeh kisi ko attia karta to apni qaum ko karta.'

e: [AI] Umar ibn Al-Khattab wrote a letter to Hattib ibn Abi Balta'ah to deliver it to the people of Makkah. Allah, the Most High, revealed to His Prophet ﷺ what had happened. So the Prophet sent Ali and Zubayr to chase after them. They caught up with a woman riding a camel and they took the letter she had concealed in one of the humps. They brought it to the Prophet ﷺ who read it and then sent for Hattib. The Prophet asked him, "O Hattib, did you write this letter?" Hattib replied, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." The Prophet asked him, "What prompted you to do this?" Hattib replied, "O Messenger of Allah, by Allah, I am loyal to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, but I was a stranger among the people of Makkah and my family was still there. So I feared for their safety and wrote a letter that would not harm Allah and His Messenger ﷺ. Perhaps it will be of benefit to my family." Umar said, "I drew my sword and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, allow me to strike his neck, for he has committed disbelief.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'O Ibn Al-Khattab, what makes you think that Allah has not seen the people of this group from the Battle of Badr? Do as you please, for I have forgiven you all.'"
hi: Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA): Hatib bin Abi Balta'ah (RA) ne Ahl-e-Makkah ko khat likha, to Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko is par muttala kar diya. Aapne Ali (RA) aur Az-Zubayr (RA) ko khat ke peeche bheja; unhone ek aurat ko ont par pa liya aur uski chotiyon (qarn) mein se ek se woh khat nikaal liya. Woh use Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas laye, aur aapko parh kar sunaya gaya. Aapne Hatib (RA) ko bulwaya aur farmaya: 'Ae Hatib! Kya tumne yeh khat likha hai?' Unhone kaha: Ji haan, ya Rasoolullah. Farmaya: 'Phir tumhein iski kis cheez ne ubhaara?' Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Allah ki qasam, main Allah aur uske Rasool (SAW) ka khair-khwah hoon, lekin main Ahl-e-Makkah mein ajnabi tha aur mere ghar waale unke beech the, to mujhe unke baare mein darr hua aur maine yeh khat likh diya jo Allah aur uske Rasool ko koi nuksan nahi pahunchata, aur ho sakta hai isme mere ghar walon ke liye kuch faida ho. Umar (RA) ne kaha: Maine apni talwar kheench li aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Mujhe iske mamle mein ikhtiyar dijiye, kyunke yeh kufr kar chuka hai, main iski gardan maar doon. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Ibn Al-Khattab! Tumhein kya khabar, shayad Allah ne in Ahl-e-Badr par muttala hokar farma diya ho: Jo chaho karo, maine tumhein bakhsh diya.'

e: [AI] The translation of the given phrase in English is: "Hold on, O Talha, for indeed he has witnessed the Battle of Badr as you have witnessed it, and the best among you is the best towards his supporters."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: 'Ruko, ae Talhah (RA)! Isne bhi Badr mein shirkat ki hai jaise tumne ki, aur tum mein behtareen woh hai jo apne mawali (azaad karda ghulamon) ke saath behtareen ho.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed, Allah the Exalted looked upon the people of Badr and said, 'Do whatever you wish, for I have forgiven you.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah Ta'ala ne Ahl-e-Badr ko dekha aur farmaya: Jo chaho karo, maine tumhein bakhsh diya hai.'

e: “When the Day of Resurrection comes, I will be the leader of the Prophets and the one who addresses them, and the one among them who will agree to intercede, and it is no boast.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4314)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab qiyamat ka din hoga to main ambiya ka imam, unka khatib aur unki shafa'at ka malik hounga, aur isme koi fakhr nahi.'

e: [AI] He said, "Indeed, the last sermon that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  delivered, he said, 'O congregation of Emigrants, indeed you have increased in number while the Ansar (Helpers) have ceased to exist. And they are my trust that I seek refuge with. So honor their righteous and overlook their wrongdoers.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein jo aakhri khutba diya usmein farmaya: 'Ae Muhajireen ki jamaat! Tum badhte ja rahe ho aur Ansar ghat gaye hain, aur woh meri aibah (kapde rakhne ka sandooq, yaani meri raazdaar aur bharose ki jagah) hain jahan main panah leta hoon. Pas unke nek kaam karne wale ka ikram karo aur unke galti karne wale se dar-guzar karo.'

e: [AI] The prophet ﷺ  went out during his illness, with his head wrapped in a cloth, and said, "Indeed, people have increased while the Ansar [the supporters of the Prophet] have decreased until they become like salt in the food. So whoever among you is entrusted with any task, let him accept from the well-doers among them and overlook the wrongdoers."
hi: Nabi (SAW) apni bimari mein nikle, aapne sir par kapde ki patti bandh rakhi thi. Farmaya: 'Log badhte jayenge aur Ansar kam hote jayenge, yahan tak ke logon mein woh aise ho jayenge jaise khane mein namak. Pas tum mein se jo koi koi zimmedari sambhale to unke nek kaam karne wale se (uski nekiyaan) qubool kare aur galti karne wale se dar-guzar kare.'

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying on the pulpit addressing the Ansar (the Helpers): "Surely, people are the armor of each other, and the Ansar are my flag. If people go one way and the Ansar go another way in a valley, I would go with the Ansar. Whoever honors the Ansar, Allah will honor him. Whoever disrespects them, Allah will disrespect him. Whoever troubles them, Allah will trouble him. He then pointed to himself and said, 'If it were not for the emigration, I would have been one of the Ansar.'"
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko minbar par Ansar ke baare mein farmate suna: 'Khabardar! Log mera dithaar (upar ka libaas) hain aur Ansar mera shi'aar (badan se lagne wala andar ka libaas) hain. Agar log ek waadi mein chalen aur Ansar ek ghaati mein chalen to main Ansar ki ghaati mein chaloonga. Pas jo Ansar ke kisi maamle ka zimmedar bane woh unke nek kaam karne wale ke saath ihsaan kare aur unke galti karne wale se dar-guzar kare. Aur jisne unhein khauf mein dala usne us (zaat) ko khauf mein dala jo in do ke beech hai,' aur apni taraf ishara kiya. 'Agar hijrat na hoti to main Ansar mein se ek aadmi hota.'

e: [AI] He entered upon the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, while he was in the pain in which he died, and he said, "Say salaam to your people, for indeed they do not know hardship and patience." Authenticated by the chain of narration, but it was not included in Sahih collections.
hi: Woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas us bimari mein gaye jisme aapki wafat hui. Aapne farmaya: 'Apni qaum ko salaam kehna, kyunke jahan tak mujhe maloom hai woh paak-daman (khud-daar) aur sabr karne wale hain.' Sahih ul-isnad, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] Usaid ibn Hudayr al-Ashhali came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was distributing food. He mentioned to him that there was a family among the Ansar from the Banu Dhafar who were in need. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Most of the household members are women." He then said to Usaid, "O Usaid, you have left us until what we had in our hands is gone. When you hear that something has been brought to us, please inform us about the people of that household." After that, some food from Khaybar came to him, which included barley and dates. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  distributed it among the people, among the Ansar, and among the family mentioned earlier. He gave generously to all three. Usaid bin Hudayr expressed his gratitude by saying, "May Allah reward you, O Prophet of Allah, the best reward or bestow goodness upon you." The Prophet ﷺ  responded, "And may Allah grant you the best of rewards, O people of the Ansar. Indeed, I know that you are gentle, patient, and will continue to support and uphold the matter after me. So remain patient until you meet me at the Hawd (on the Day of Judgment)."
hi: Usaid bin Hudayr Al-Ashhali (RA) Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye, aapne khana taqseem kiya tha. Unhone aapse Ansar ke Bani Zafar ke ek ghar waalon ka zikr kiya jinhein zaroorat thi. Kaha: Us ghar ke zyadatar log auratein thin. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse farmaya: 'Ae Usaid! Tumne humein chhode rakha yahan tak ke jo humare haathon mein tha woh khatam ho gaya. Ab jab suno ke humare paas kuch aaya hai to mujhe us ghar waalon ka zikr karna.' Kaha: Phir uske baad aapke paas Khaibar se khana aaya, jau aur khajoor. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne logon mein taqseem kiya, Ansar mein khoob diya aur us ghar waalon ko bhi khoob diya. Kaha: Usaid bin Hudayr (RA) ne shukr guzaar hote hue aapse kaha: Allah aapko, ae Allah ke Nabi, humari taraf se behtareen badla de (ya kaha: khair de). To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aur ae Ansar ki jamaat! Allah tumhein sab se paakiza badla de (aur farmaya: khair de), kyunke jahan tak mujhe maloom hai tum paak-daman aur sabr karne wale ho. Aur tum mere baad hukumat aur taqseem mein (doosron ko) tarjeeh milte dekhoge, to sabr karna yahan tak ke mujhse hauz par milo.'

e: [AI] Indeed, the Ansar were facing difficult times, so they went to the Prophet ﷺ  to ask him to pray for them or to dig a river for them. The Prophet ﷺ  was informed about their request, and he said, "Do not ask me today for anything except that I will give it to you." When they heard what the Prophet ﷺ  said, they said, "Pray to Allah for us for forgiveness." He said, "O Allah, forgive the Ansar and the children of the Ansar and the children of the children of the Ansar."
hi: Ansar par paani nikaalne ki (sawani) mushaqqat sakht ho gayi, to woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye ke aap unke liye dua farmayen ya unke liye nahar khod dein. Nabi (SAW) ko khabar di gayi to farmaya: 'Aaj tum mujhse jo bhi maango tumhein diya jayega.' Jab unhone Nabi (SAW) ki baat suni to kaha: Hamare liye Allah se maghfirat ki dua kijiye. Farmaya: 'Ae Allah! Ansar ko, Ansar ke beton ko aur Ansar ke beton ke beton ko bakhsh de.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ received young boys from the young boys of the Ansar, as well as maidens and slaves. He said, "By Allah, I love you all." This is an authentic narration according to the conditions of Muslim, and it was not excluded by Adh-Dhahabi in his summary.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ansar ke kuch ladkon, kaneezon aur ghulamon se mulaqat ki to farmaya: 'Allah ki qasam! Main tum se mohabbat karta hoon.' Yeh hadees Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Al-Hayyan, from the Ansar, felt proud and said, "Among us are those whose death caused the throne of the Most Merciful to shake, like Sa'd bin Mu'adh. Among us are those who were protected from harm, like Aasim bin Thabit bin Al-Afalah. Among us are those whom the angels washed, like Hanzalah bin Al-Rahib. Among us are those whose testimony was accepted by two witnesses, like Khuzaymah bin Thabit." The Khazraj tribe said, "Among us are four who compiled the Qur'an, and no one else did so. They are Ubay bin Ka'b, Mu'adh bin Jabal, Zaid bin Thabit, and Abu Zaid."
hi: Ansar ke do qabilon Aws aur Khazraj ne fakhr kiya. Aws ne kaha: Humare mein woh hain jinki maut par Arsh-e-Rahman hil gaya, Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA); aur humare mein woh hain jinhein bhiryon ne mehfooz rakha, Asim bin Thabit bin Al-Aflah (RA); aur humare mein woh hain jinhein farishton ne ghusl diya, Hanzalah, Ar-Rahib ke bete (RA); aur humare mein woh hain jinki gawahi do mardon ki gawahi ke barabar qabool ki gayi, Khuzaymah bin Thabit (RA). Aur Khazrajiyon ne kaha: Humare mein chaar hain jinhone Quran jama kiya aur unke siwa kisi ne jama nahi kiya: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA), Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA), Zaid bin Thabit (RA) aur Abu Zaid (RA).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The Muhajirun and the Ansar, some of them are allies of each other in this life and the Hereafter. And the free men of the Quraysh and the honorable ones from Thaqif, some of them are allies of each other in this life and the Hereafter."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Muhajireen aur Ansar dunya aur aakhirat mein ek doosre ke walee (madadgaar) hain, aur Quraish ke tulaqa (Makkah fatah par azaad kiye gaye) aur Thaqif ke urafa (sardar) bhi dunya aur aakhirat mein ek doosre ke walee hain.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to present horses, and with him was Uyaynah bin Badr Al-Fazari. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "I know more about horses than you." Uyaynah replied, "And I know more about men than you." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked, "Who are the best of men?" Uyaynah said, "Men who carry their swords on their shoulders and their spears on the manes of their horses, from the men of Najd." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No, you are wrong. The best of men are the men of Yemen, and faith is Yemeni, until it reaches Al-Lakhm, and scabs, and infectious diseases, and the meat of donkeys is better than their meat, and Hadramaut is better than Bani Harith. By Allah, I do not care if both Hariths perish. May Allah curse the four kings: Jamdah, Makhwass, A'bidah, and their sister Amardah." Then he said, "My Lord commanded me to curse the Quraysh twice, so I cursed them twice. And my Lord commanded me to pray for them, so I prayed for them twice." Then he said, "May Allah curse Tameem bin Murrah five times, and Bakr bin Wail seven times, and may Allah curse two tribes of the tribes of Bani Tameem, Muqa'is and Muladis." Then he said, "Ussayyah, who disobeyed Allah and His Messenger, are the slaves of Qays, Ja'dah, and Asim." Then he said, "Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaynah, and Ahlaf from Juhaynah are better than Bani Asad, Tameem, Ghatafan, and Hawazin on the Day of Resurrection." Then he said, "The worst two tribes among the Arabs are Najran and Banu Taghlib, and the majority of tribes in Paradise are Mudhij."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ghodon ka mu'ayna farma rahe the aur aapke paas Uyaynah bin Badr Al-Fazari tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: 'Main ghodon ko tumse zyada jaanta hoon.' Uyaynah ne kaha: Aur main mardon ko aapse zyada jaanta hoon. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'To behtareen mard kaun hain?' Usne kaha: Woh mard jo apni talwarein kandhon par aur apne naizey apne ghodon ke kandhon ke jod par rakhte hain, Najd ke mard. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tumne jhooth bola, balki behtareen mard Yaman ke mard hain, aur imaan Yamani hai, Lakhm aur Judham tak; Himyar ke ma'kool (zer-e-dast log) unke aakilon (ghalib log) se behtar hain, aur Hadramaut Bani Al-Harith se behtar hai. Allah ki qasam, mujhe parwah nahi agar dono Harith halak ho jayen. Allah ne un chaar badshahon par laanat ki: Jamd, Mikhwas, Abdaa'ah aur unki behen Al-Amardah.' Phir farmaya: 'Mere Rab ne mujhe hukm diya ke Quraish par laanat karoon, to maine do baar unpar laanat ki; aur mujhe hukm diya ke unke liye rahmat ki dua karoon, to maine do do baar unke liye dua ki.' Phir farmaya: 'Allah ne Tamim bin Murrah par paanch baar laanat ki aur Bakr bin Wa'il par saat baar, aur Allah ne Bani Tamim ke do qabilon par laanat ki: Muqa'is aur Muladis.' Phir farmaya: 'Usayyah ne Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmani ki; Abd Qais, Ja'dah aur Ismah.' Phir farmaya: 'Aslam, Ghifar, Muzainah aur Juhainah mein se unke halif (ahd ke saathi), qiyamat ke din Allah ke nazdeek Bani Asad, Tamim, Ghatafan aur Hawazin se behtar hain.' Phir farmaya: 'Arab ke do qabilon mein se sab se bure Najran aur Bani Taghlib hain, aur zyadatar qabile jannat mein Madh'hij hain.'

e: The tribes of Ansar, Muzaina and Juhaina and Ghifar and Ashja' and those from Banu 'Abdullah, they are my friends amongst the people and Allah and His Messenger are their protectors. (Using translation from Muslim 2519)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aslam, Ghifar, Ashja', Muzainah, Juhainah aur Bani Ka'b mein se jo bhi hain, logon ke baghair mere mawali (dost aur madadgaar) hain; Allah aur uska Rasool unke mawla hain.'

e: To the tribe of Aslam Allah has granted safety and to the tribe of Ghifar Allah has granted pardon. Verily it is not I that say this, but (it is) Allah the Exalted and Glorious. (who) says this. (Using translation from Muslim 2516)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ghifar - Allah ne use bakhsh diya, aur Aslam - Allah ne use salamati di. Khabardar! Yeh maine nahi kaha, balki Allah ne farmaya hai.'

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ used to stand in prayer and supplicate against some tribes of the Arabs, saying, 'May Allah curse Ri'lān and Dhakwān and the 'Usayyah tribe who disobeyed Allah and His Messenger, and Beni Lahyan.' And he would say, 'Ghifār was forgiven by Allah and He granted Sa'lamah safety. I did not say this, but rather Allah Almighty said it.' Then he would say the takbīr after supplicating against those whom he cursed." (Note: This translation might not be precise as the original text is not clear and there is a reference to a missing portion from Al-Dhahabi's work).
hi: Nabi (SAW) namaz mein khade hote aur Arab ke kuch qabilon ke khilaf bad-dua karte aur farmate: 'Allah Ri'l, Dhakwan aur Usayyah par laanat kare jisne Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmani ki, aur Bani Lahyan par.' Aur farmate: 'Ghifar - Allah ne use bakhsh diya, Aslam - Allah ne use salamati di; yeh maine nahi kaha, balki Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai.' Phir jin ke khilaf bad-dua karni hoti, bad-dua ke baad takbeer kehte. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Aamir ibn Al-Tufayl did not enter the city except under the protection of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When the Prophet ﷺ  arrived, he said to him, "O Aamir, accept Islam and you will be safe." Aamir replied, "Yes, but I will have the cattle and you will have the pasture." The Prophet ﷺ  then said, "This is not how it works. Either accept Islam as it is or leave." Then the Prophet ﷺ  said, "O Aamir, go and we will discuss your matter tomorrow." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent a message to the Ansar and asked, "What do you think? I have invited this man but he refuses to accept Islam unless he has the cattle and I have the pasture." They said, "Whatever Allah wills, then you may do as you please, O Messenger of Allah." They did not take anything from us except two headbands, so we took two from them. Allah and His Messenger know best." Aamir returned to the Prophet ﷺ  and he said to him, "Accept Islam and you will be safe, O Aamir." Aamir replied, "It is only on that condition." He refused to accept unless he had the cattle and the Prophet ﷺ  had the pasture. The Prophet ﷺ  refused and Aamir said, "By Allah, I will gather an army against you, including horses and men." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "May Allah forbid that to happen to you, the sons of the tribe of Aws and Khazraj." Then Aamir left and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Allah, take care of him." Allah caused him to be killed before he reached his people. Aamir said when the sacrificial animal took hold of him, "O Aal-Aamir, this is a fat cow, like a fat young beast. It destroyed him in an instant, separate from his people." Al-Dhahabi did not mention anything further about it in his summary.
hi: Amir bin At-Tufayl Rasoolullah (SAW) ki amaan ke baghair Madinah mein dakhil nahi hua. Jab woh aaya to Nabi (SAW) ne usse farmaya: 'Ae Amir! Islam le aao, salamat rahoge.' Usne kaha: Haan, is shart par ke mere liye wabar (baadiyah, khaima-nashin) ho aur aapke liye madar (shahri, ghar waale). Farmaya: 'Aisa nahi ho sakta, Islam le aao salamat rahoge.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Amir! Jao, hum kal tak tumhare mamle mein ghaur karenge.' Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Ansar ko bulwaya aur farmaya: 'Tum kya sochte ho? Maine is aadmi ko daawat di to usne Islam lane se inkaar kar diya, siwaye is ke ke uske liye wabar ho aur mere liye madar.' Unhone kaha: Jo Allah chahe phir aap chahen, ya Rasoolullah! Unhone humse ek rassi nahi li magar humne unse do rassiyan li. Allah aur uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Amir Nabi (SAW) ke paas laut aaya to aapne usse farmaya: 'Islam le aao salamat rahoge, ae Amir.' Usne kaha: Bas yahi (shart) hai, aur usne inkaar kiya siwaye is ke ke uske liye wabar ho aur Nabi (SAW) ke liye madar. Nabi (SAW) ne inkaar kiya. Amir ne kaha: Allah ki qasam! Main isse (Madinah ko) tum par ghodon aur mardon se bhar dunga. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah tujhe iski ijazat nahi dega, aur Aws aur Khazraj ke bete bhi.' Phir Amir muda. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Allah! Mujhe isse kifayat farma.' To Allah ne use dhibhah (gale ki ek bimari) se maar diya, uske apne ghar pahunchne se pehle. Jab dhibhah ne Amir ko pakda to usne kaha: Ae Aal-e-Amir! Yeh to jawan oont ke ghudde ki tarah ek ghudda (sujan) hai! Phir woh usi waqt jab dhibhah ne use pakda, apne ghar waalon ke paas pahunche baghair halak ho gaya. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever ascends the mountain of Marar, he will be shielded from what was shielded from the Children of Israel." The first to ascend it was the horses of Banu Khazraj, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "All of you are forgiven, except for the owner of the red camel." So, a Bedouin who had lost his camel came to him, and we told him to go and ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to seek forgiveness for him. He said, "I would rather find my lost camel than have the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  seek forgiveness for me."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo Thaniyyat Al-Mirar (Mirar ki ghaati) par chadhega us se woh gunah utaar diye jayenge jo Bani Israel se utaare gaye.' Sabse pehle jo us par chadhe woh Bani Khazraj ke sawar the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum sab bakhshe gaye ho siwaye surkh ont waale ke.' Kaha: Dekha to woh ek dehati tha jo apna gum-shuda janwar dhoondh raha tha. Humne usse kaha: Aao, Rasoolullah (SAW) tumhare liye istighfar karenge. Usne kaha: Meri gum-shuda cheez ka mil jaana mujhe is baat se zyada pasand hai ke tumhara saathi mere liye istighfar kare.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "A woman does not suffer harm if she stays between two Virgin Ansari women or between her parents."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Us aurat ko kuch nuksan nahi jo Ansar ki do ladkiyon ke darmiyan utre, ya apne walidain ke darmiyan utre.'

e: [AI] I heard three things from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about Banu Tamim: "I will never harbor hatred towards the people of Tamim. Aisha made a vow when she was still married to Isma'il's descendants, and some people from Banu Al-Anbar were taken as captives. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to Aisha, 'If you wish, you can fulfill your vow by setting free one of these captives.' So, Aisha liberated a captive from them and made him part of Isma'il's descendants. The Prophet ﷺ  then brought some blessings from the charity given to the people of Sa'd. When he saw it, he said, 'These are blessings from my people,' and he made them his people. He also said, 'They are the fiercest warriors in battles.'"
hi: Teen baatein maine Bani Tamim ke baare mein Rasoolullah (SAW) se suni, jin ke baad main Tamim se kabhi bughz nahi rakhta: Aishah (RA) par aulad-e-Ismail mein se ek ghulam azaad karne ki nazr thi. Bani Al-Anbar ke kuch qaidi laye gaye. Aapne Aishah (RA) se farmaya: 'Agar tumhein apni nazr poori karna achha lage to inmein se ek ghulam azaad kar do.' To aapne unhein Ismail ki aulad mein shumar kiya. Aur Bani Sa'd ke liye sadqe ke kuch janwar laye gaye. Jab aapne unhein dekha to woh aapko achhe lage aur farmaya: 'Yeh meri qaum ke janwar hain.' To unhein apni qaum banaya. Aur farmaya: 'Yeh jangon (malahim) mein sab logon se zyada sakht ladne waale hain.'

e: [AI] He heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying about Allah's saying, "You are the best nation produced [as an example] for mankind." [Quran 3:110] He said, "You are seventy nations, the best and most honorable of them in the sight of Allah, the Almighty."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) se Allah Ta'ala ke farman {Tum behtareen ummat ho jo logon ke liye nikali gayi} (Surah Aal-e-Imran 110) ke baare mein suna, aapne farmaya: 'Tum sattar ummaton ko poora karte ho, tum unmein sab se behtar aur Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek sab se mukarram ho.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You are the best and most honored of the seventy nations in the sight of Allah Almighty."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum sattar ummaton ko poora karte ho, tum Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek unmein sab se mukarram aur sab se afzal ho.'

e: [AI] Narrated by Abu Huraira, in his statement, Allah the Almighty says: "You are the best nation produced [as an example] for mankind. You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in Allah." (Surah Al-Imran, 3:110) "You will surely drag them in chains and enter the religion 'Islam'."
hi: Abu Hurairah (RA) se Allah Ta'ala ke farman {Tum behtareen ummat ho jo logon ke liye nikali gayi} (Surah Aal-e-Imran 110) ke baare mein (unhone kaha): 'Tum unhein zanjeeron mein kheench kar laate ho aur unhein Islam mein dakhil karte ho.'

e: [AI] The Ansar said, "O Messenger of Allah, indeed every prophet has followers, and we have followed you, so pray to Allah that He makes our followers from among us." So he prayed for them, "O Allah, make their followers from among them." I attributed this narration to Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Layla and he said, "This claim was made by Zaid bin Arqam." The chain of narrators is authentic, but it was not mentioned in a Sahih collection.
hi: Ansar ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Har nabi ke kuch pairokar hote hain aur humne aapki pairwi ki hai, pas Allah se dua kijiye ke hamare pairokaron ko hum mein se bana de. To aapne unke liye dua farmayi ke unke pairokaron ko unhi mein se bana de. (Raawi ne) kaha: Maine yeh baat Abd Ar-Rahman bin Abi Layla tak pahunchayi to unhone kaha: Zaid bin Arqam (RA) ne yahi bayan kiya hai. Sahih ul-isnad, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Verily, there will be people from my Ummah who will come after me and wish they could sell their faith, families, and wealth just to see me."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Meri ummat ke kuch log mere baad aayenge, unmein se har ek chahega kaash woh apne ghar waalon aur maal ke badle mera deedar khareed le.'

e: [AI] "We had a meal with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and with us was Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah. We said, 'O Messenger of Allah, is there anyone better than us that has believed and fought alongside you?' He said, 'Yes, there will be a people who will believe in me without seeing me.'"
hi: Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath subah ka khana khaya aur humare saath Abu Ubaydah bin Al-Jarrah (RA) the. Humne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Kya koi humse behtar hai? Hum aapke saath musalman hue aur aapke saath jihad kiya. Farmaya: 'Haan, woh log jo tumhare baad honge, mujh par imaan layenge jabke unhone mujhe dekha nahi.'

e: [AI] "I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ , and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Do you know who among the people of faith has the best faith?' They said, 'O Messenger of Allah, is it the angels?' He said, 'They are indeed, and that is fitting for them, as Allah has bestowed upon them a status that He has not given to others.' They said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what about the prophets who were honored by Allah Almighty with prophecy and messengership?' He said, 'They are likewise, and they deserve that. Allah has bestowed upon them a status that He has not given to others.' They said, 'So who are they, O Messenger of Allah?' He said, 'They are people who will come after me, believed in me without seeing me, and they find the pages hanging and they act according to what is written on them. These are the best people in faith.'"
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke saath baitha tha, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Kya tum jaante ho ahl-e-imaan mein imaan ke lihaz se sab se afzal kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Farishte? Farmaya: 'Woh bhi aise hi hain aur unke liye munasib bhi hai, aur unhein kya cheez rok sakti hai jabke Allah ne unhein woh martaba diya hai jo diya; balki unke siwa (koi aur).' Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Phir ambiya, jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne nubuwwat aur risalat se nawaza? Farmaya: 'Woh bhi aise hi hain aur unke liye munasib hai, aur unhein kya rok sakta hai jabke Allah ne unhein woh martaba diya hai jo diya; balki unke siwa.' (Raawi ne) kaha: Humne kaha: Phir woh kaun hain, ya Rasoolullah? Farmaya: 'Woh log jo mere baad aayenge, (abhi) mardon ki pushton mein honge, mujh par imaan layenge jabke unhone mujhe dekha nahi hoga, aur woh latka hua waraq (sahifa) payenge aur jo usmein hai uspar amal karenge. Pas yehi imaan ke lihaz se ahl-e-imaan mein sab se afzal hain.'

e: [AI] Abdullah ibn Busr, the companion of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Good tidings to the one who sees me and good tidings to the one who sees the one who sees me, and good tidings to the one who sees the one who sees the one who sees me and believes in me."
hi: Humse Abdullah bin Busr (RA), jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi the, ne bayan kiya, kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mubarak hai woh jisne mujhe dekha, aur mubarak hai woh jisne mujhe dekhne waale ko dekha, aur woh jisne mujhe dekhne waale ke dekhne waale ko dekha aur mujh par imaan laya.'

e: [AI] "To me, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'O Salman, do not hate me, for it will cause you to leave your religion.' So I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, how can I hate you when Allah Almighty guided me through you?' He said, 'You will hate the Arabs, and thus hate me.'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhse farmaya: 'Ae Salman! Mujhse bughz na rakhna warna apna deen chhod baithoge.' Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Main aapse kaise bughz rakh sakta hoon jabke aapke zariye Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe hidayat di? Farmaya: 'Tum Arab se bughz rakhoge to mujhse bughz rakhoge.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When Allah created mankind, He chose the Arabs, then He chose from the Arabs the Quraysh, then He chose from the Quraysh the Banu Hashim, and then He chose me from the Banu Hashim. So, I am the best of the best." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing this.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab Allah ne makhlooq paida ki to Arab ko chuna, phir Arab mein se Quraish ko chuna, phir Quraish mein se Bani Hashim ko chuna, phir Bani Hashim mein se mujhe chuna; pas main chune hue (khaas) mein se chuna hua (khaas) hoon.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "The narration has been confirmed to be authentic from Amr ibn Dinar. If it is from Salim, then it is a strange but sound narration. And if it is from Ibn Umar, then Amr ibn Dinar heard it from Ibn Umar." Adh-Dhahabi removed it from the summary.
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) Nabi (SAW) se isi jaisi (riwayat). Amr bin Dinar se riwayat sahih sabit hai; agar yeh Salim se hai to gharib sahih hai, aur agar Ibn Umar se hai to Amr bin Dinar ne Ibn Umar se suna hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Loving the Arabs is faith, and hating them is hypocrisy."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Arab se mohabbat imaan hai aur unse bughz nifaq hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Love the Arabs for three reasons: because I am an Arab, the Quran is in Arabic, and the language of the people of Paradise is Arabic." This was narrated by Muhammad ibn Al-Fadl from Ibn Jurayj.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Arab se mohabbat karo teen wajah se: kyunke main Arabi hoon, Quran Arabi hai, aur ahl-e-jannat ka kalam Arabi hai.' Is ki mutaba'at Muhammad bin Al-Fadl ne Ibn Juraij se riwayat mein ki hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Preserve me in the Arabic language for three reasons: because I am an Arab, the Quran is in Arabic, and the language of the people of Paradise is Arabic."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Arab ke maamle mein mere haq ka lihaz rakho teen khaslaton ki wajah se: kyunke main Arabi hoon, Quran Arabi hai aur ahl-e-jannat ki zubaan Arabi hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever among you is better in speech in Arabic, should not speak in Persian, for it only leads to hypocrisy." Among those who lied about this was Amr Ibn Haroon, as stated by Ibn Mu'een, and the majority of scholars abandoned him.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum mein se jo Arabi bolna achhi tarah jaanta ho woh Farsi na bole, kyunke woh nifaq ko virse mein deti hai.' Aur is (sanad ki kharabiyon) mein se Amr bin Harun hai, jise Ibn Ma'in ne jhutlaya aur jama'at ne chhod diya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whoever speaks in Persian, his wickedness increases and his integrity decreases." This narration is not authentic and its chain of transmission is weak.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo Farsi bole uski khabasat badh jaati hai aur uski muruwwat ghat jaati hai.' Yeh sahih nahi, aur iski sanad bilkul waahi hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the giver of bribes and the taker of bribes." Imam Adh-Dhahabi omitted mentioning it in Al-Talkhis.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne faisle (hukm) mein rishwat dene wale aur rishwat lene wale par laanat farmayi. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "May Allah curse the one who bribes and the one who takes a bribe, and the one who walks between them." I only mentioned Umar ibn Abi Salamah and Layth ibn Abi Sulaim in reference to the witnessed incidents, not in reference to the foundations.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Allah ne rishwat dene wale, rishwat lene wale aur raaish (dalaal) par laanat ki, jo dono ke beech chalta hai.' Maine Umar bin Abi Salamah aur Layth bin Abi Sulaym ko shawahid mein zikr kiya hai, usool (asal riwayat) mein nahi.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever is given authority over ten people and he judges among them according to their likes and dislikes, then it will be brought on the Day of Judgment, tied to his neck. If he judges according to what Allah has revealed and does not incline towards bribery or corruption, then Allah will remove it from him on the Day of Judgment. On that day, there will be no burden except for his. But if he judges by something other than what Allah has revealed, and inclines towards bribery and corruption, then his left hand will be tied to his right hand, and he will be thrown into hellfire, and he will not reach its depths for five hundred years." Sa'dan bin Al-Walid Al-Bajaly, the Kufi, reported this, and they did not disagree with him.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo shakhs dus aadmiyon par hakim banaya gaya aur usne unke beech aisa faisla kiya jo unhein pasand aaye ya na aaye, use qiyamat ke din is haal mein laya jayega ke uske dono haath gardan se bandhe honge. Phir agar usne us ke mutabiq faisla kiya jo Allah ne utaara, apne faisle mein rishwat nahi li aur zulm nahi kiya to Allah qiyamat ke us din jab uski apni zanjeer ke siwa koi zanjeer na hogi, use khol dega. Aur agar usne Allah Ta'ala ke utare hue ke khilaf faisla kiya, rishwat li aur tarafdari ki to uska baayan haath daayen se bandh diya jayega aur use jahannam mein phenk diya jayega, aur woh paanch sau saal tak uski tah tak nahi pahunchega.' Sa'dan bin Al-Walid Al-Bajali Kufi hain, thodi hadees riwayat karne waale, aur Bukhari aur Muslim ne unse riwayat nahi nikaali.

e: [AI] "That the people of At-Taff (tribe) do not pay Zakah (charity), so Bilal sent a man to inquire about what they say. The man found them criticizing his lineage and so he returned to Bilal and informed him. Bilal then raised his voice and said: 'My father told me on the authority of Abu Musa who said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Whoever competes with the people while lacking insight, he has something of it in him.'"
hi: Ahl-e-At-Taff zakat ada nahi karte the, to Bilal ne ek aadmi bheja jo unse puchhe ke woh kya kehte hain. Us aadmi ne dekha ke uske nasab par taan kiya jaa raha hai, to woh Bilal ke paas laut aaya aur unhein khabar di. Bilal ne takbeer kahi aur kaha: Mujhse mere walid ne bayan kiya, unhone Abu Musa (RA) se, kaha ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo logon ki chugli (shikayat lagane) mein lagta hai woh halal nasab ka nahi hai, aur usmein is (khasiyat) ka kuch hissa hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever is pleased with a ruler while being displeasing to his Lord, the Almighty, has abandoned the religion of Allah, Glorified and Exalted." Al-Alaq bin Abi Muslim mentioned this alone, and all the narrators to him are trustworthy. This is found in the last chapter of the book of judgments.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jisne kisi hukmaran ko apne Rab ki naraazgi ke badle raazi kiya, woh Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ke deen se nikal gaya.' Is riwayat mein Allaq bin Abi Muslim akele hain, aur un tak ke tamam raawi siqah hain. Kitab al-Ahkam ka aakhir.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  sent Ali to Yemen and said, "Teach them the laws and settle their disputes." Ali said, "I have no knowledge of judging." So, he placed his hand on his chest and said, "O Allah, guide him in judging."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (RA) ko Yaman bheja aur farmaya: 'Unhein ahkam-e-shariat sikhao aur unke darmiyan faisla karo.' Unhone kaha: Mujhe faisla karne ka koi ilm nahi. To aapne unke seene par haath mara aur farmaya: 'Ae Allah! Isey faisle ke liye hidayat de.'

e: [AI] Two men quarreled in front of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , so he said to 'Amr, "Settle the matter between them." 'Amr asked, "Shall I settle it while you are present, O Messenger of Allah?" The Prophet replied, "Yes, but if you make a just decision, you will have the reward of ten good deeds, and if you strive and make a mistake, you will still be rewarded."
hi: Do aadmi jhagda lekar Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, to aapne Amr (RA) se farmaya: 'In dono ke darmiyan faisla karo.' Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Aap ke hote hue main in ke darmiyan faisla karun? Farmaya: 'Haan, is shart par ke agar tum sahi faisla karo to tumhein dus guna ajar hai, aur agar tumne ijtihad kiya aur khata hui to tumhein ek ajar hai.'

e: [AI] "He (the speaker) heard the Prophet ﷺ  say in his sermon: The people of Paradise are three types; a truthful and just ruler, a person who is successful and fortunate, and a man who is compassionate and tender-hearted towards his relatives. Also, a poor person who is chaste and modest."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko apne khutbe mein farmate suna: 'Ahl-e-jannat teen hain: ek saahib-e-iqtidar jo musaddaq (jiski tasdiq ki jaye), insaaf karne wala aur taufeeq yafta ho; ek aadmi jo har qarabatdar ke saath raheem aur narm dil ho; aur ek aadmi jo muflis ho magar paak-daman ho.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Verily, the righteous will be on pulpits of pearl on the Day of Judgment, in the presence of the Most Merciful, based on their justice in this worldly life."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Dunya mein insaaf karne waale qiyamat ke din Rahman ke samne moti ke minbaron par honge, us insaaf ki wajah se jo unhone dunya mein kiya.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The oppressors and their helpers are in the Hellfire."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Zulm karne waale aur unke madadgaar aag mein hain.'

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "O people! Allah does not accept the prayer of an Imam who rules with anything other than what Allah has revealed." And he mentioned the rest of the narration.
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Khabardar, ae logo! Allah us imam ki namaz qubool nahi karta jisne Allah ke utare hue ke baghair faisla kiya.' Aur raawi ne hadees ka baaqi hissa bhi zikr kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever is given authority over ten people and does not treat them justly, will come on the Day of Judgment with chains and shackles."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis kisi ko dus ya usse zyada logon par ameer banaya jaye aur woh un mein insaaf na kare to qiyamat ke din is haal mein aayega ke bediyon aur zanjeeron mein jakda hoga.'

e: [AI] "That the first person to open it is not necessarily your best leader after what I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: 'The one who used to be obeyed in the disobedience of Allah, the Almighty, will be brought to the fire and thrown into it, and his intestines will spill out. He will continue rolling in it, just as a donkey rolls in a millstone. Then the people who used to obey him from among the people will come to him and say: 'O so-and-so, where are you commanding us now?' He will say: 'I used to command you with something, but I myself went against it and followed something else.'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... ke woh use kholne wala pehla na ho. Main yeh nahi kehta ke tumhare ameer tumhare behtareen hain, us baat ke baad jo maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se suni. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Us hakim ko laya jayega jis ki Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani mein itaat ki jaati thi, to hukm hoga ke use aag mein phenk diya jaye, woh usme phenka jayega to uski aantein baahar nikal aayengi, aur woh usme aise ghoomega jaise gadha chakki mein ghoomta hai. Phir uski itaat karne wale log uske paas aayenge aur kahenge: Ae falaan! Tu humein jo hukm deta tha uska kya hua? Woh kahega: Main tumhein ek baat ka hukm deta tha aur khud uske khilaf doosri taraf chalta tha.'

e: " Six are cursed, being cursed by Allah and by every Prophet that came: The one who adds to Allah's Book, the one who denies Allah's Qadar, the one who rules with tyranny by which he honors whom Allah has debased, and he dishonors whom Allah has honored, and the one who legalizes what Allah forbade, and the one from my family who legalizes what Allah forbade, and the abandoner of my Sunnah." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2154)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Chhe aise hain jin par maine laanat ki aur Allah ne bhi laanat ki, aur har nabi ki dua qubool hoti hai: Allah ki taqdeer ko jhutlane wala; Allah ki kitab mein izafa karne wala; zabardasti se musallat hone wala taake jise Allah ne izzat di use zaleel kare aur jise Allah ne zaleel kiya use izzat de; Allah ke haram ko halal samajhne wala; meri aulad mein se jis cheez ko Allah ne haraam kiya use halal samajhne wala; aur meri sunnat ko chhodne wala.'

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet, peace be upon him, the judges are of three types: two judges in Hellfire and one judge in Paradise. The judge who recognizes the truth and judges accordingly will be in Paradise. The judge who recognizes the truth but unfairly rules against it will be in Hellfire. And the judge who rules without knowledge will also be in Hellfire.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Qazi teen hain: do qazi aag mein aur ek qazi jannat mein. Jis qazi ne haq ko pehchana aur uske mutabiq faisla kiya woh jannat mein hai; jis qazi ne haq ko pehchana phir jaanboojh kar zulm kiya woh aag mein hai; aur jis qazi ne bina ilm ke faisla kiya woh aag mein hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are two judges in Hell and one judge in Paradise. The judge who judged with justice will be in Paradise, and the judge who judged with injustice will be in Hell, and the judge who judged in ignorance will also be in Hell." They asked, "What is the sin of the one who judges in ignorance?" He replied, "His sin is that he should not be a judge until he knows." (Narrated by Muslim)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Do qazi aag mein aur ek qazi jannat mein: jis qazi ne haq ke mutabiq faisla kiya woh jannat mein hai; jis qazi ne zulm se faisla kiya woh aag mein hai; aur jis qazi ne apni jahalat se faisla kiya woh aag mein hai.' Logon ne kaha: Phir is jaahil ka kya gunah hai? Farmaya: 'Iska gunah yeh hai ke woh qazi na bane jab tak ilm na hasil kar le.' Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "No one can be involved in any matter of this nation, whether small or large, without Allah disgracing him in the Fire." This is narrated by Uma Maqil bint Maqil bin Sinan al-Ashja'i, and it is authentic in its chain of narration. Sahih did not exclude it.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Is ummat ke maamlaat mein se kisi cheez par jo bhi muqarrar ho, thodi ho ya zyada, aur woh un mein adl na kare to Allah use munh ke bal aag mein gira dega.' Yeh (riwayat) Umm Ma'qil bint Ma'qil bin Sinan Al-Ashja'i (RA) ki hai. Sahih ul-isnad, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e:
[AI] Narrated Abu Huraira:
Allah's Messenger ﷺ  said, "There will be soon a man who will be called 'amr ibn Luhayy. He will cut the hands and legs of the people and will not be punished. And he will cause destruction on the earth and will not be punished." (Sahih al-Bukhari 3649)
hi: Humse koi aisi cheez bayan kijiye jo aapne Rasoolullah (SAW) se suni ho. Unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Qareeb hai ke koi aadmi yeh tamanna kare ke kaash woh Suraiya (sitaare) se gir pada hota aur logon ke kisi maamle ka zimmedar na bana hota.' Sahih ul-isnad, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: from the Prophet ﷺ that he said, “Woe to the rulers! Woe to the authorities! Woe to the trustees! Some people will wish their forelocks were hanging from the star of Pleiades on the Day of Resurrection rather than had been responsible for anything.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 8627)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Halakat hai ameeron ke liye, halakat hai urafa (sardaron) ke liye, aur halakat hai umana (amanatdaron) ke liye! Qiyamat ke din kuch log zaroor tamanna karenge ke kaash unki chotiyan Suraiya se latki hoti aur woh aasmaan aur zameen ke beech jhool rahe hote aur unhone koi zimmedari na sambhali hoti.'

e: "The Messenger of Allah said to me: 'O Abu Dharr, I think that you are weak, and I like for you what I like for myself. Do not accept a position of Amir over two people, and do not agree to be the guardian of an orphan's property.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 3667)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Abu Dharr! Main tumhein kamzor dekhta hoon, pas tum kabhi do aadmiyon par bhi ameer na banna aur na kabhi yateem ke maal ke walee banna.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever is appointed a judge, it is as if he has been slaughtered with something other than a knife."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo qazi bana diya gaya goya use bina chhuri ke zibah kar diya gaya.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ commanded me, saying, "Indeed, you are weak and it (the responsibility) is a trust. And indeed, it will be a source of shame and regret on the Day of Resurrection."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha: Mujhe ameer bana dijiye. To farmaya: 'Tum kamzor ho aur yeh amanat hai, aur qiyamat ke din yeh ruswai aur nadamat hai.'

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, command me." He said, "Leadership is a trust, and on the Day of Resurrection, it will be a source of shame and regret, except for those who governed with justice and fulfilled their responsibilities."
hi: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Mujhe ameer bana dijiye. Farmaya: 'Imarat amanat hai, aur qiyamat ke din ruswai aur nadamat hai, siwaye us ke jisne haq ke saath hukm diya aur us mein jo haq us par tha use ada kiya.'

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "Whoever seeks justice and seeks help for it will be granted it, and whoever does not seek it and does not seek help for it will be entrusted to an angel who will guide him."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jo qaza (qazi banna) talab kare aur uske liye madad maange use usi ke supurd kar diya jata hai, aur jo na talab kare aur na madad maange uske liye ek farishta muqarrar kar diya jata hai jo use sahi raah par rakhta hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The ties of Islam will be undone one by one. Every time a tie is undone, the next tie will be clung to. The first tie to be undone is ruling, and the last tie is prayer."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Islam ke kade ek ek karke toote jayenge. Jab bhi koi kada tootega to log agle kade ko thaam lenge. Sabse pehle jo tootega woh hukm (hukumat) hai aur sab se aakhir mein namaz.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever employs a man from a gang, and within that gang there is someone more pleasurable to Allah than him, then he has deceived Allah, deceived His Messenger, and deceived the believers."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jisne kisi jamaat mein se kisi aadmi ko amil banaya, jabke us jamaat mein koi aisa tha jo Allah ke nazdeek us se zyada pasandeeda hai, to usne Allah se, uske Rasool se aur momineen se khiyanat ki.'

e: Abu Bakr said, when he sent me to Syria: O Yazeed, you have relatives and you may give them precedence in allocating positions of authority; that is the most serious thing I fear for you, because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ʿWhoever is appointed in charge of any affairs of the Muslims and appoints over them anyone by way of favouritism, the curse of Allah be upon him and Allah will not accept any obligatory or nafl prayer from him until he admits him to Hell. And whoever allows anyone to transgress the sacred limits set by Allah has transgressed the sacred limits of Allah unlawfully, and on him will be the curse of Allah and Allah will forsake him.ʿ (Using translation from Aḥmad 21)
hi: Mujhse Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) ne kaha jab unhone mujhe Sham bheja: Ae Yazid! Tumhare kuch rishtedar hain, qareeb hai ke tum unhein imarat mein tarjeeh do; mujhe tumhare baare mein sab se zyada isi ka darr hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya hai: 'Jo musalmanon ke maamlaat mein se kisi cheez ka walee bana aur usne tarafdari mein kisi ko unka ameer bana diya to us par Allah ki laanat hai, Allah na uska fidya qubool karega na adl, yahan tak ke use jahannam mein dakhil kar de.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  sent me to Yemen, and I said, "You are sending me to a people with sharp teeth, and I am still young." He said, "When the two disputants come to you, do not make a judgment until you have heard from the other, just as you have heard from the first." Ali said, "And I continued to be a judge."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe Yaman bheja to maine kaha: Aap mujhe aise logon ke paas bhej rahe hain jo umr-raseeda hain aur main kam-umr hoon. Farmaya: 'Jab tumhare paas do jhagadne waale baithein to ek ke haq mein faisla na karo jab tak doosre se bhi na suno jaise pehle se suna.' Ali (RA) ne kaha: Phir main hamesha qazi hi raha.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah is with the judge as long as he does not act unjustly. And when he acts unjustly, Allah Almighty absolves Himself from him." This is narrated by Abu Al-Awwam, who is Imran ibn Dawud Al-Qattan, and the chain of narration is authentic.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah qazi ke saath hai jab tak woh zulm na kare, aur jab woh zulm kare to Allah Ta'ala us se bari ho jata hai.' Yeh Abu Al-Awwam Imran bin Dawud Al-Qattan hain. Sanad sahih hai, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] From Abu Maryam, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, 'Whoever has been entrusted with any matter concerning the Muslims and then secludes himself from their needs, poverty, and difficulties, Allah will abandon him in seclusion on the Day of Resurrection, disregarding his needs, poverty, and difficulties.'"
hi: Abu Maryam (RA), jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahabi hain, se riwayat hai, kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jo musalmanon ke maamlaat mein se kisi cheez ka walee bana phir unki tangdasti, haajat, ghurbat aur muflisi se parda mein ho gaya, Allah Ta'ala qiyamat ke din uski tangdasti, muflisi, haajat aur ghurbat se parda kar lega.'

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "Whoever closes his door to those in need, to companionship, and to shelter, then Allah will close the door of the heavens to him, despite his need, poverty, and shelter." Sahih.
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jisne haajatmandon, tangdast aur miskeenon ke aage apna darwaza band kiya, Allah aasmaan ka darwaza uski tangdasti, haajat, ghurbat aur miskeeni ke aage band kar dega.'

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave the decision that the two adversaries should be made to sit in front of the judge. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3588)
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... Nahi, Rasoolullah (SAW) ka faisla aur sunnat yeh hai ke dono jhagadne waale hakim ke samne baithte hain.

e: [AI] "Whoever is presented with a case, let them judge according to what is in the book of Allah. If a matter comes to them that is not in the book of Allah, then let them judge according to what the Prophet ﷺ judged. If a matter comes to them that is not in the book of Allah and the Prophet ﷺ did not judge on it, then let them judge according to what the righteous have said. If a matter comes to them that is not in the book of Allah, the Prophet ﷺ did not judge on it, and the righteous did not judge on it, then let them use their own reasoning. If they cannot determine what is right, then let them accept and not be ashamed."
hi: 'Jis ke samne koi faisla pesh ho woh us ke mutabiq faisla kare jo Allah ki kitab mein hai. Agar koi aisa maamla aaye jo Allah Ta'ala ki kitab mein nahi to woh us ke mutabiq faisla kare jo Nabi (SAW) ne faisla kiya. Agar koi aisa maamla aaye jo Allah Ta'ala ki kitab mein nahi aur uske Nabi (SAW) ne bhi faisla nahi kiya to woh us ke mutabiq faisla kare jo saleheen ne kaha. Agar aisa maamla aaye jo Allah ki kitab mein nahi, na uske Nabi (SAW) ne faisla kiya aur na saleheen ne, to woh apni raay se ijtihad kare, aur agar achhi tarah na kar sake to apni kami ka iqrar kar le aur sharmaye nahi.'

e: Two men claimed a camel or an animal and brought the case to the Holy Prophet ﷺ. But as neither of them produced any proof, the Holy Prophet ﷺ declared that they should share it equally. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3613)
hi: Do aadmiyon ne ek oont (ya janwar) ka dawa kiya aur Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur dono mein se kisi ke paas dalil na thi, to Nabi (SAW) ne use dono ke darmiyan barabar kar diya.

e: [AI] "Two men claimed ownership of a camel, so each of them brought two witnesses. The Prophet ﷺ  then distributed the camel between them." This hadith is also considered authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to Al-Bukhari and Muslim), but they did not include it in their collections.
hi: Do aadmiyon ne ek oont ka dawa kiya aur dono mein se har ek ne do gawah pesh kiye, to Nabi (SAW) ne use dono ke darmiyan taqseem kar diya. Yeh hadees bhi Shaykhain (Bukhari aur Muslim) ki shart par sahih hai, magar unhone ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] Abu al-Muwajjah narrated that Abdan narrated from Abdullah who said: "Usama ibn Zaid informed me that the servant of Umm Salamah narrated from Umm Salamah who said, 'Two men came to the Prophet ﷺ disputing about inheritance with no evidence. So the Prophet ﷺ commanded them to divide and choose, and then they should seek the decision from Allah ('Istihma'). And each of them should remove himself from his share.'" This hadith has a sound chain of narration, but it has not been included in the collections of Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim. And the servant of Umm Salamah is Ubaidullah ibn Abu Rafi, who has a separate entry in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
hi: Humse Abu Al-Muwajjih ne bayan kiya, unhe Abdan ne khabar di, unhe Abdullah ne khabar di, mujhe Usamah bin Zaid ne khabar di, Umm Salamah ke mawla se, woh Umm Salamah (RA) se, unhone kaha: Do aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas apni aapas ki mirasaton ke baare mein jhagadte hue aaye, jinke paas koi dalil na thi, to Nabi (SAW) ne unhein hukm diya ke taqseem kar lein, haq ka andaza karein, phir qur'a daalen aur har ek doosre ko mu'af kar de. Sahih ul-isnad, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala, aur Umm Salamah ke mawla Ubaydullah bin Abi Rafi' hain jinki riwayat Sahihain mein hai.

e: [AI] I heard Umm Salamah saying, "I was with the Prophet ﷺ when two men came to him arguing over inheritance, and neither of them had any evidence. Each one of them said to his companion, "O Messenger of Allah, this is my right that I asked from so-and-so." He said, "No, but both of you go and find someone to arbitrate, then both of you draw lots, then divide it between yourselves, and finally, every one of you who gets the share will give his companion his right."
hi: Maine Umm Salamah (RA) ko kehte suna: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas thi ke aapke paas do aadmi aaye jo apni aapas ki meeras mein jhagad rahe the, aur dono mein se kisi ke paas dalil na thi, aur har ek ne doosre ke baare mein kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Yeh mera haq hai jo maine falaan se talab kiya. Farmaya: 'Nahi, balki jao, haq ka andaza karo, phir qur'a daalo, phir taqseem karo, phir tum mein se har ek doosre ko mu'af kar de.'

e: [AI] "A man claimed a right against another man, so they disputed and came to the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet asked for evidence, but the claimant said, 'I have no evidence.' Then the Prophet told the other person, 'Take an oath.' So, he took an oath and said, 'By Allah, I have nothing in my possession.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said to him, 'Rather, you have what he owes you; pay him what is due.' After that, the Prophet ﷺ said to him, 'Your testimony that there is no deity but Allah is the expiation for your oath.'"
hi: Ek aadmi ne doosre aadmi ke paas apne haq ka dawa kiya, to dono jhagadte hue Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye. Aapne usse dalil maangi to usne kaha: Mere paas koi dalil nahi. To doosre se farmaya: 'Qasam khao.' Usne qasam khayi aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, uska mere paas kuch nahi. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Balki woh tumhare paas hai, uska haq use de do.' Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne usse farmaya: 'Tumhara La ilaha illallah ki gawahi dena tumhari qasam ka kaffara hai.'
