e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "If you see my Ummah (community) fearing, do not say to the oppressor, 'O oppressor', for you will become separated from them."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum meri ummat ko dekho ke woh zalim ko 'Ae zalim' kehne se dar rahi hai, to unse rukhsat kar li gayi (unse khair ki umeed khatam).'

e: [AI] Ali was sent by the Prophet ﷺ  to Yemen. Three individuals claimed to be the father of a child and argued about it. Ali separated the two and asked them, "Are you both willing to compromise for the sake of this child?" They both answered no. He separated them again and asked the same question, and again they both answered no. He then said, "I see that you are contentious partners, while I am the arbitrator between you." He resolved the dispute by assigning the child to one of them and determining that the remaining two-thirds of the compensation should be given to the other two. Ali mentioned this incident to the Prophet ﷺ , who laughed until his canine teeth were visible. Sheikhain (two scholars) have omitted the name of Al-Ajlaha bin Abdullah Al-Kindi from their narrations, but it is not considered a weak hadith, for the one who criticized it was Al-Ajlaha himself.
hi: Ali (RA) ko Nabi (SAW) ne Yaman bheja, to unke paas teen aadmi ek bachche ke baare mein jhagadte hue aaye, har ek dawa karta tha ke woh uska beta hai. Kaha: Unhone do ko alag kiya aur farmaya: 'Kya tum dono is baat se khush ho ke yeh baaqi (teesre) ko mile?' Dono ne kaha: Nahi. Phir doosre do ko alag kiya aur unse bhi aisa hi kaha, unhone kaha: Nahi. To farmaya: 'Main tumhein jhagadne waale shareek dekhta hoon, aur main tumhare darmiyan qur'a daalne wala hoon.' Phir unke darmiyan qur'a daala aur bachche ko ek ke hawale kiya aur use baaqi do ko diyat ke do tihaai dene ka paband kiya. Kaha: Phir yeh Rasoolullah (SAW) se zikr kiya gaya to aap hans pade yahan tak ke aapki daadhein zaahir ho gayin. Shaykhain ne Ajlah bin Abdullah Al-Kindi se e'raaz kiya hai, jabke uski riwayaat mein woh matrook nahi hai, kyunke jis cheez par us par aitraz kiya jata hai woh uska maslak hai. (Ajlah matrook nahi hai.)

e: [AI] There was a woman who used to serve Zama'ah and she thought that another man was having a relationship with her. Zama'ah died while she was pregnant, and she gave birth to a boy who resembled the man she thought was the father. Soudah mentioned this to the Prophet ﷺ , and he said, "As for inheritance, it belongs to him, but as for you, stay away from him, as he is not your relative."
hi: Zam'ah ki ek kaneez thi jisse woh humbistari karta tha, aur woh kisi doosre aadmi ke baare mein gumaan karti thi ke woh bhi uske paas jaata tha. Zam'ah mar gaya jabke woh hamila thi, to usne ek ladka jana jo us aadmi se milta tha jis par gumaan tha. To Sawdah (RA) ne Nabi (SAW) se zikr kiya. Farmaya: 'Jahan tak meeras ka taalluq hai woh uske liye hai, aur jahan tak tumhara maamla hai to tum us se parda karo, kyunke woh tumhara bhai nahi.'

e: While I was sitting with AbuHurayrah, a Persian woman came to him along with a son of hers. She had been divorced by her husband and they both claimed him. She said: AbuHurayrah, speaking to him in Persian, my husband wishes to take my son away. AbuHurayrah said: Cast lots for him, saying it to her in a foreign language. Then her husband came and asked: Who is disputing with me about my son? AbuHurayrah said: O Allah, I do not say this, except that I heard a woman who came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while I was sitting with him, and she said: My husband wishes to take away my son, Messenger of Allah, and he draws water for me from the well of AbuInabah, and he has been good to me. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Cast lots for him. Her husband said: Who is disputing with me about my son? The Prophet ﷺ said: This is your father and this your mother, so take whichever of them you wish by the hand. So he took his mother's hand and she went away with him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2277)
hi: Abu Maymunah Sulayman, Madinah wale, sachche aadmi, ne kaha: Main Abu Hurairah (RA) ke paas baitha tha ke unke paas ek Farsi aurat apne bete ke saath aayi, jise uske shauhar ne talaq de di thi. Usne kaha: Ae Abu Hurairah! Phir usne Farsi mein bolna shuru kiya aur kaha: Mera shauhar mere bete ko le jana chahta hai. Kaha: Phir uska shauhar aaya aur kaha: Mere bete ke baare mein mujhse kaun jhagadega? Abu Hurairah (RA) ne kaha: Main is mamle mein sirf yeh kehta hoon ke maine suna hai ke ek aurat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aayi jabke main aapke paas tha, usne kaha: Mere maa baap aap par qurban, mera shauhar mere bete ko le jana chahta hai, jabke woh mujhe Abu Utbah ke kuyein se paani pilata hai aur mujhe usse faida hua hai. Aapne farmaya: 'Is par qur'a daalo.' Uske shauhar ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Mere bete ke baare mein mujhse kaun jhagadega? To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae ladke! Yeh tumhara baap hai aur yeh tumhari maa, jis ka chaho haath pakad lo.' To ladke ne apni maa ka haath pakad liya aur woh use lekar chali gayi.

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning one, two or three date palms belonging to a man among other palm trees - when they differ concerning entitlement to the surrounding land. He ruled that the land around each of those trees, as far as their leaves reach, measured from the bottom of the tree, belongs to the owner of the tree. (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2488)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne ek, do ya teen khajoor ke darakhton ke baare mein faisla farmaya jinke haqooq mein log ikhtilaf karte hain, to faisla farmaya ke har darakht ka haram (hadd) utna hoga jahan tak uski shaakhon ki lambai pahunche.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "The depth of the normal well is fifty arms, and the depth of the well in the mosque is twenty-five arms." This hadith was narrated by Umar ibn Qays from Az-Zuhri from Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib from Abu Hurairah from the Prophet ﷺ who said, "The depth of the agricultural well is fifty arms, and the depth of the well in the mosque is twenty-five arms."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... Nabi (SAW) se (riwayat hai), farmaya: 'Purane kuyein ka haram pachaas zira' hai aur Nadi ke kuyein ka haram pachchis zira' hai.' Isse Umar bin Qais ne Az-Zuhri se, unhone Said bin Al-Musayyab se, unhone Abu Hurairah (RA) se, unhone Nabi (SAW) se muttasil aur musnad bayan kiya, farmaya: 'Purane kuyein ka haram pachaas zira' hai aur Nadi wale kuyein ka haram pachchis zira' hai.'

e: [AI] He heard the Prophet ﷺ  say, "The witness of lies will never cease to have his feet in the Fire until Allah makes Paradise obligatory for him."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jhoothi gawahi dene wale ke qadam nahi hatenge yahan tak ke Allah un dono ke liye aag wajib kar de.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Before the Hour, there will be the spread of private greetings, the flourishing of trade, to the extent that a woman will help her husband in business, the breaking of family ties, the appearance of false testimonies, and the concealment of truthful testimonies."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Qiyamat se pehle sirf khaas logon ko salaam kiya jayega, tijarat phail jayegi yahan tak ke aurat apne shauhar ki tijarat mein madad karegi, rishte tode jayenge, jhoothi gawahi zaahir hogi aur haq ki gawahi chhupai jayegi.'

e: [AI] Nothing was more detestable to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ than lying. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never tested anyone, even if it was little, without causing him to confess, until he renewed his repentance for him.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ko jhoot se zyada napasand koi cheez na thi, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) kisi mein jhoot ka thoda sa bhi tajruba kar lete to jab tak woh taza tauba na kar leta, uski taraf se apne dil se (naraazgi) nahi nikaalte the.

e: [AI] It was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  a man giving testimony, so he said to me: "O Ibn Abbas, do not testify except to what is clear to you, like the brightness of this sun." And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  pointed with his hand towards the sun.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke samne ek aadmi ka zikr hua jo gawahi deta hai, to aapne mujhse farmaya: 'Ae Ibn Abbas! Gawahi sirf us cheez ki do jo tumhare liye is sooraj ki tarah roshan ho,' aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne haath se sooraj ki taraf ishara kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Leave what causes doubt for what does not cause doubt, for verily, truthfulness brings tranquility and lying brings doubt." Strongly narrated.
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jo cheez tumhein shak mein daale use chhod do aur us ki taraf aao jo shak mein na daale, kyunke sach itminan hai aur jhoot shak hai.' Iski sanad qawi hai.

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is sin?" He said, "When something stirs within your chest, leave it."
hi: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Gunah kya hai? Farmaya: 'Jab tumhare seene mein kisi cheez se khatak ho to use chhod do.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The testimony of a Bedouin on the inhabitant of a village is not valid." The author did not correct it and it is considered a rejected (munkar) hadith due to the weakness in its chain of narrators.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Dehati ki gawahi gaon wale ke khilaf jaiz nahi.' Musannif ne ise sahih nahi kaha, aur yeh munkar hadees hai agarche iski sanad saaf hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The testimony of a suspicious person and a person with a reputation for lying is not valid."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tohmat-zada (jis par shak ho) aur kina-parwar (jis ke dil mein dushmani ho) ki gawahi jaiz nahi.'

e: [AI] "Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, said: 'The children are not among those who are pleased.'"
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... Allah Ta'ala ke farman {un gawahon mein se jinhein tum pasand karte ho} (Surah Al-Baqarah 282) ke baare mein (unhone) farmaya: 'Bachche un mein se nahi jinse raazi hua jata hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Whoever supports a dispute unjustly will remain in the displeasure of Allah until they desist."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jisne na-haq jhagde mein madad ki woh Allah ki naraazgi mein rehta hai jab tak ke baaz na aa jaye.'

e: [AI] "Whoever helps falsehood in order to invalidate the truth with it, has relieved himself of the protection of Allah and the protection of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: 'Jisne baatil ki madad ki taake apne baatil se haq ko mita de, to us se Allah ki zimmedari aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zimmedari bari ho gayi.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The child of zina (adultery) bears no responsibility for the sins of its parents." [And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another] (Quran, 6:164).
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Walad-uz-zina par uske walidain ke gunah ka kuch bojh nahi.' {Aur koi bojh uthane wala kisi doosre ka bojh nahi uthayega} (Surah Al-An'am 164).

e: [AI] The Prophet peace be upon him was asked about the child of fornication, he said, "He is the worst of the three." As for the second chain of narration
hi: Nabi (SAW) se walad-uz-zina ke baare mein poocha gaya to farmaya: 'Woh teeno mein sab se bura hai.' Rahi doosri sanad, (Adhoora jumla:) ...

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The offspring of adultery is the worst of the three."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Walad-uz-zina teeno mein sab se bura hai.'

e: [AI] The Aws woman said, "Who among us has been granted the privilege of his testimony being equivalent to the testimony of two men? Khuzaimah ibn Thabit."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... To Aws ne kaha: Humare mein woh hain jinki gawahi do mardon ki gawahi ke barabar qabool ki gayi, Khuzaymah bin Thabit (RA).

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  restored the right of the seeker of truth."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne qasam haq maangne wale (muddai) ki taraf lauta di.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Reconciliation is permissible among Muslims." This hadith is narrated by Amr ibn Awf and it is recognized as a valid narration.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Sulh musalmanon ke darmiyan jaiz hai.' Iska shahid Amr bin Awn ki hadees hai, aur isi ke zariye yeh pehchani jati hai. (Yeh) munkar hai.

e: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Reconciling between Muslims is permissible, except reconciliation that forbids something that is allowed, or allows something that is forbidden.'” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2353)
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Sulh musalmanon ke darmiyan jaiz hai siwaye us sulh ke jo kisi halal ko haram kar de ya haram ko halal kar de, aur musalman apni shartein nibhane wale hain siwaye us shart ke jo kisi halal ko haram kar de.' (Yeh) waahi hai.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  pledged/collateraled a debt for Mu'adh with his belongings and sold them."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Mu'adh (RA) ke maal par pabandi laga di aur uske zimme jo qarz tha uske badle usay baich diya.

e: During the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a man used to buy (goods), and he was weak in his intellect. His people came to the Prophet of Allah ﷺ and said: Prophet of Allah, stop so-and-so (to make a bargain) for he buys (goods), but he is weak in his intellect. So the Prophet ﷺ called on him and forbade him to make a bargain. He said: Prophet of Allah, I cannot keep away myself from business transactions. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: If you cannot give up making a bargain , then say: Take , and give, and there is no attempt to deceive. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3501)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke zamane mein ek aadmi kharid-farokht karta tha aur uske sauda karne mein kamzori thi. Uske ghar waale Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Ae Allah ke Nabi! Falaan par pabandi laga dijiye, kyunke woh kharidta hai aur uske sauda karne mein kamzori hai. Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne use bulaya aur kharid-farokht se mana kiya. Usne kaha: Ae Allah ke Nabi! Main kharid-farokht se sabr nahi kar sakta. To farmaya: 'Agar tum kharid-farokht nahi chhodte to kaha karo: Lo, aur koi dhoka nahi.' Aur (Adhoora jumla:) ...

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  gave me a name and I had never thought of that, so I asked him, "Why did you name me like this?" He said, "A man from the deserts came with two camels, and I bought them from him. Then I entered my house and came out from behind, and I found him seeking them. So I returned them to him and fulfilled my need through them. I was absent until I thought that the Iraqi [man] had left, but he found me and took me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and informed him of the matter. He asked me, 'What made you do what you did?' I said, 'I fulfilled my need with their price, O Messenger of Allah.' He said, 'Fulfill it.' I said, 'I don't have the money.' He said, 'You are free, O Iraqi, sell him until you receive your due.'" The people began to offer him higher prices and look towards him. He said, "What do you want?" They said, "We want to buy him from you." He said, "By Allah, I am more deserving and in greater need of Allah, the Almighty. Go, for I have set you free."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ne (yeh) naam diya hai aur main ise kabhi nahi chhodunga. Maine poocha: Unhone aapka yeh naam kyun rakha? Kaha: Dehat ka ek aadmi do oont lekar aaya, maine woh us se khareed liye, phir main apne ghar mein gaya aur peeche se nikal gaya aur unhein bech diya aur unke paison se apni haajat poori ki, aur gaib ho gaya yahan tak ke mujhe gumaan hua ke Iraqi chala gaya hoga, lekin Iraqi wahin mauzood tha. Usne mujhe pakda aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas le gaya aur aapko saari baat bata di. Farmaya: 'Tumne yeh kyun kiya?' Maine kaha: Maine unke daam se apni haajat poori kar li, ya Rasoolullah. Farmaya: 'Uska qarz ada karo.' Maine kaha: Mere paas nahi hai. Farmaya: 'Tum Sarq (chor) ho. Ae Iraqi! Ise le jao aur bech do yahan tak ke apna haq wasool kar lo.' Kaha: Log mujhe uske paas bhaav lagane lage aur woh unki taraf mutawajjeh hokar kehta: Kya chahte ho? Woh kehte: Hum ise aap se fidya dekar chhudana chahte hain. To usne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumse zyada iska haqdar hoon aur Allah Ta'ala ka zyada muhtaj. Jao, maine tumhein azaad kar diya.

e: Bahz bin Hakim, on his father's authority, said that his grandfather told that the Prophet ﷺ imprisoned a man on suspicion. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3630)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko tohmat mein qaid kiya.

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  detained a man for one day and night as a precaution and to ensure justice." Ibrahim Ibn Khuthaym is abandoned.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aadmi ko tohmat mein ek din aur ek raat ke liye ehtiyat aur tahqeeq ke taur par qaid rakha. Ibrahim bin Khuthaym matruk hai.

e: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'if one who can afford it delay repayment, his honor and punishment become permissible."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4689)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Qarz ada karne ki qudrat rakhne wale ka taalmatol uski izzat aur saza ko halal kar deta hai.'

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who bribes and the one who takes bribe. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3580)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne rishwat dene wale aur rishwat lene wale par laanat farmayi.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "May Allah protect you, O Ka'ab bin Ujrah, from the leadership of fools." He asked, "What is the leadership of fools?" The Prophet ﷺ  answered, "Leaders who will come after me and will not follow my guidance or adhere to my Sunnah. Whoever believes in their lies and helps them in their wrongdoing, they are not from me, and I am not from them. They will not enter my pool (in Paradise). But those who do not believe in their lies and do not support them in their wrongdoing, they are from me and I am from them. They will come to my pool. O Ka'ab bin Ujrah, the flesh that grows from unlawful sources will not enter Paradise. The fasting is a shield and charity extinguishes sins, and prayer is evidence (of one's faith). It is narrated that the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'The flesh that grows from unlawful sources' and this was reported by Abu Bakr and Umar." This is summarized from the narration of Al-Dhahabi.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae Ka'b bin Ujrah! Allah tumhein bewaqoofon ki imarat se panah de.' Unhone poocha: Bewaqoofon ki imarat kya hai? Farmaya: 'Aise ameer jo mere baad honge, na meri hidayat ki pairwi karenge aur na meri sunnat par chalenge. Pas jo unke jhoot ki tasdiq kare aur unke zulm mein unki madad kare, woh na mujhse hain aur na main unse, aur woh mere hauz par nahi aayenge. Aur jo unke jhoot par unki tasdiq na kare aur unke zulm mein madad na kare, woh mujhse hain aur main unse, aur woh mere hauz par aayenge. Ae Ka'b bin Ujrah! Woh gosht jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga jo haram se uga ho, aag uske zyada laayiq hai. Ae Ka'b bin Ujrah! Roza dhaal hai, sadqa gunah ko bujha deta hai aur namaz qurbat hai - ya farmaya: burhan (daleel).' Aur Nabi (SAW) ka farman 'woh gosht jo haram se uga' Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) se bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai. (Adhoora jumla:) ... Adh-Dhahabi ... Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Whoever grows his flesh from unlawful sources, then the fire is more deserving of him." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai: 'Jis ka gosht haram se ugaa, aag uske zyada laayiq hai.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "About Al-Dhahabi in summarizing."
hi: (Adhoora jumla:) ... Adh-Dhahabi ... Talkhees mein.

e: [AI] He informed him, saying, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever eats a meal from a Muslim, Allah will feed him with a meal from the Hellfire on the Day of Judgment. And whoever provides a position for a Muslim, Allah will provide him a position on the Day of Judgment with fame and honor. And whoever clothes a Muslim, Allah will clothe him with a garment from the Hellfire on the Day of Judgment."
hi: Unhone unhein khabar di, kaha ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jisne kisi musalman (ki aabroo ya haq) ke badle ek luqma khaya, Allah qiyamat ke din use uske badle jahannam ki aag ka ek luqma khilayega; jisne kisi musalman ke zariye (dikhaave ka) ek mauqif khada kiya, Allah qiyamat ke din use shohrat aur riya ke mauqif mein khada karega; aur jisne kisi musalman ke zariye libaas pehna, Allah qiyamat ke din use aag ka libaas pehnayega.'

e: [AI] It was narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that he used to say from the pulpit, "I will confront those who oppress the property of the weak, the orphan, and the woman"
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat hai ke woh minbar par farmate: 'Main do kamzoron, yateem aur aurat, ke maal (khane) ko gunah qarar deta hoon (aur is se mana karta hoon).'

e: [AI] I heard Aisha say, "Umm Sunbulah presented milk to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so she entered upon me with it and did not find him. So I said to her, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade us from eating the food of the desert Arabs.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and Abu Bakr entered, and he said, 'O Umm Sunbulah, what is this with you?' She said, 'O Messenger of Allah, it is milk that I presented to you.' He said, 'Pour it out, O Umm Sunbulah.' So Abu Bakr took it and drank, then he said, 'Pour it out, O Umm Sunbulah.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  took it and drank. Aisha said, 'I said, 'O coolness of their livers!' Aisha said, 'O Messenger of Allah, she told us that you forbade us from eating the food of the desert Arabs.' He said, 'O Aisha, they are not desert Arabs, they are the people of our outskirts, and we are the people of their center, and if they invite us, we should respond. They are not desert Arabs.'"
hi: Maine Aishah (RA) ko kehte suna: Umm Sunbulah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dudh hadiya kiya, woh use lekar mere paas aayi to aapko nahi paya. Maine unse kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein dehatiyon ka khana khane se mana farmaya hai. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) aur Abu Bakr (RA) andar aaye to farmaya: 'Ae Umm Sunbulah! Tumhare saath yeh kya hai?' Unhone kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Dudh hai jo maine aapko hadiya kiya hai. Farmaya: 'Ae Umm Sunbulah! Undel do.' Aapne Abu Bakr (RA) ko diya, phir farmaya: 'Ae Umm Sunbulah! Undel do.' Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne liya aur piya. Unhone kaha: Maine kaha: Kaisi thandak hai jigar par! Aishah (RA) ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Aapne to humein khabar di thi ke aapne dehatiyon ka khana mana kiya hai. Farmaya: 'Ae Aish! Yeh dehati nahi hain, yeh hamare sehra wale hain aur hum unke shahar wale, aur jab unhein bulaya jaye to woh jawab dete hain, pas yeh dehati nahi.'

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Associate only with a believer, and let only a God-fearing man eat your meals. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4832)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Sirf momin ki sohbat ikhtiyar karo aur tumhara khana sirf muttaqi khaye.'

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade the eating of the food of the proud."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne aise do aadmiyon ke khane se mana farmaya jo (dawat mein) ek doosre se muqabla karte hain (mutabariyain), ke woh khaya jaye.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  forbade sitting at a table where alcohol is being consumed or eating while a person is lying on their stomach.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne do tarah ke khane se mana farmaya: aise dastarkhwan par baithna jis par sharab pi jaati ho, ya aadmi ka pet ke bal let kar khana.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever feeds his brother bread until he is full and gives him water until he is satisfied, Allah will distance him from the Hellfire by seven trenches, each as far as the distance between two trenches, which is equivalent to a journey of five hundred years."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jisne apne bhai ko roti khilayi yahan tak ke use seer kar diya aur paani pilaya yahan tak ke use sairab kar diya, Allah use aag se saat khandaqon jitna door kar dega, do khandaqon ke beech ka faasla paanch sau saal ki masafat hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The expiations are feeding others, spreading peace, praying at night when people are asleep."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Gunahon ko mitane wale amal: khana khilana, salaam ko aam karna, aur raat ko namaz padhna jab log soye hue hon.'

e: [AI] I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, inform me about an action that, if I do it, will enter me into paradise?" He said, "Spread peace, feed others, maintain family ties, pray at night while people are asleep, and enter Paradise in peace."
hi: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Mujhe aisi baat bataiye ke main use apna lun to jannat mein dakhil ho jaoon. Farmaya: 'Salaam ko aam karo, khana khilao, rishtedari jodo, raat ko namaz padho jab log soye hon, aur salamati ke saath jannat mein dakhil ho jao.'

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, it was narrated that he said, "Whosoever earns money from lawful means, and feeds themselves and clothes themselves, then they have given zakat to the creatures of Allah other than themselves." (Sahih)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aapne farmaya: 'Jo bhi aadmi halal tareeqe se maal kamaye phir apne aap ko khilaye, pehnaye, aur jo uske ma-taht Allah ki makhlooq hai, to uske liye zakat (sadqa) hai.'

e: A man came to Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! I am suffering from fatigue and hunger." The Prophet ﷺ sent (somebody) to his wives (to get something), but the messenger found nothing with them. Then Messenger of Allah ﷺ said (to his companions). "Isn't there anybody who can entertain this man tonight so that Allah may be merciful to him?" An Ansari man got up and said, "I (will, entertain him), O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!" So he went to his wife and said to her, "This is the guest of Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so do not keep anything away from him." She said. "By Allah, I have nothing but the children's food." He said, "When the children ask for their dinner, put them to bed and put out the light; we shall not take our meals tonight," She did so. In the morning the Ansari man went to Messenger of Allah ﷺ who said, "Allah was pleased with (or He bestowed His Mercy) on so-and-so and his wife (because of their good deed)." Then Allah revealed: 'But give them preference over themselves even though they were in need of that.' (59.9) (Using translation from Bukhārī 4889)
hi: Ek aadmi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Mujhe sakht mashaqqat (bhook) pahunchi hai. Aapne apni biwiyon ke paas (khabar) bheji to unke paas kuch na paya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Kya koi aisa aadmi nahi jo aaj raat is ki mezbani kare, Allah us par rahm kare?' Ansar ka ek aadmi khada hua aur kaha: Main, ya Rasoolullah. Woh apne ghar gaya aur apni biwi se kaha: Yeh Rasoolullah (SAW) ka mehman hai, isse koi cheez bacha kar na rakho. Usne kaha: Allah ki qasam, mere paas bachchon ke khane ke siwa kuch nahi. Usne kaha: Jab bachche raat ka khana maangen to unhein sula do aur aao, chiragh bujha do aur hum aaj raat apne pet bhookey rakhenge. Usne aisa hi kiya. Phir subah woh aadmi Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaya to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ne taajjub kiya, yaani Allah Ta'ala falaan aur falaan (aurat) par hans pada.' Aur Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nazil farmaya: {Aur woh apne upar doosron ko tarjeeh dete hain khwah unhein khud tangi ho} (Surah Al-Hashr 9).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When any one of you buys meat, increase its soup (stock). If any one of you does not have meat, let him hit (by spoon) the soup which is one of the meat."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se koi gosht khareede to uska shorba zyada rakhe, kyunke agar koi gosht na paye to shorba paa lega, aur woh bhi do gostoon mein se ek hai.'

e: [AI] "From Abu Al-Ahwas, this is also correct."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... Abu Al-Ahwas se. Yeh bhi sahih hai.

e: [AI] "Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said: 'Whoever comes to a group of people as a guest and then is denied hospitality, it becomes the duty of every Muslim to support him until he finds accommodation for the night, from their produce and wealth.'" (Authentic Hadith)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Jo bhi musalman kisi qaum ka mehman bane aur mehman mehroom reh jaye, to har musalman par haq hai ke uski madad kare yahan tak ke woh un (mezbanon) ki kheti aur maal se apni ek raat ki mezbani wasool kar le.'

e: "When you come to a shepherd, call him three times. If he answers (all well and good), otherwise drink (milk from the flock) without taking advantage. And when you come to a garden call the owner of the garden three times. If he answers (all well and good), otherwise eat (from the produce of the garden) without taking advantage." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2300)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Jab tum kisi charwahe ke paas aao to use teen baar pukaro; agar woh jawab de (to theek), warna bina kharabi kiye piyo. Aur jab kisi bagh ki deewar ke paas aao to bagh ke malik ko teen baar pukaro; agar woh jawab de (to theek), warna bina kharabi kiye kha lo.'

e: [AI] About Umair, the Mawla (freed slave) of Abu Lahm, Umair was the Mawla of Bani Ghifarah. He said, "I accompanied my masters when we wanted to migrate. When we approached the city, they left me behind and entered the city. I was afflicted with severe hunger. Then, someone from the people of the city passed by me and said, 'If you enter one of the walls of the city, you will find dates there.' So, I entered a wall and found a palm tree, from which I cut two clusters of dates. At that moment, the owner of the wall came out with me until he brought me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger asked me about my situation, and I informed him. He asked, 'Which one is better?' So, I pointed to one of them. He commanded me to take it and ordered the owner of the wall to take the other one, and he let me go."
hi: Umair (RA) se, jo Abi Al-Lahm (RA) ke mawla the (Umair Bani Ghifarah ke ghulam the), kaha: Main apne aqaon ke saath hijrat ke iraade se nikla, yahan tak ke hum Madinah ke qareeb pahunche, to unhone mujhe apne peeche saaman ki hifazat mein chhod diya aur Madinah mein dakhil ho gaye. Mujhe sakht bhook lagi. Madinah walon mein se jo mere paas se guzra usne kaha: Agar tum Madinah ke kisi bagh mein chale jao aur uski khajoor kha lo? To main ek bagh mein dakhil hua, ek khajoor ke darakht ke paas aaya aur usse do khoshe kaat liye. Bagh ka malik aa gaya, woh mujhe lekar Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya. Aapne mere baare mein poocha to maine aapko bata diya. Farmaya: 'In dono mein se kaun sa behtar hai?' Maine ek ki taraf ishara kiya to aapne mujhe use lene ka hukm diya aur bagh ke malik ko doosra lene ka hukm diya, aur mujhe jaane diya.

e: [AI] We were struck by famine, so I went to the city and entered one of its walls. I took a handful of grain, rubbed it, ate from it, and put some in my garment. The owner of the wall came and struck me and took my garment. So, I went to the Prophet ﷺ  and he said, "Did you not know that if you were ignorant, you shouldn't have eaten from it? And if you were in need, you should have asked, and I would have provided for you." He returned my garment and ordered for me to be given half a sa' or a sa' of food.
hi: Humein sakht bhook lagi, to main Madinah aaya aur uske baghon mein se ek bagh mein dakhil hua, ek bali li, use masal kar usme se khaya aur kuch apne kapde mein rakh liya. Bagh ka malik aaya, mujhe maara aur mera kapda le liya. Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya to aapne farmaya: 'Tumne ise sikhaya nahi jab yeh jaahil tha, aur ise khilaya nahi jab yeh bhooka tha.' Kaha: Phir aapne mera kapda mujhe wapas dilaya aur mere liye aadha wasq ya ek wasq (anaaj) ka hukm diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came with Banu Amro bin Awf on Wednesday and saw something he had not seen before from his fortress on the palm trees. He said, "If you were to stay at your Eid until you hear from me." They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah, we will, as our fathers and mothers did." He prayed the Friday prayer with them on Friday, then he prayed two Rak'ahs in the mosque. He used to go to his house before that day, then he stood up and faced the people, and the Ansar or those among them followed him until they went with him. He said, "O gathering of the Ansar!" They said, "At your service, O Messenger of Allah." He said, "You were in ignorance when you did not worship Allah alone, but rather, you carried idols and did good in your wealth and provided for the wayfarer, until Allah bestowed Islam upon you and His Prophet upon you. Now, you safeguard your wealth and the food that a human being eats carries rewards, and the food that a wolf or a bird eats carries rewards." So the people returned, and each one of them destroyed thirty doors from his garden.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) Bani Amr bin Awf ke paas Budh ke din tashreef laaye aur khajoor ke baghon par unki deewar-bandi mein kuch aisi cheez dekhi jo pehle nahi dekhi thi. Farmaya: 'Agar tum is apni eid (Jumu'ah) par aao to ruk jao yahan tak ke meri baat suno.' Unhone kaha: Ji haan, humare maa baap aap par qurban, ya Rasoolullah. Kaha: Jab woh Jumu'ah mein haazir hue to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhein Jumu'ah padhayi, phir masjid mein do rakat padhi - aur aap is din se pehle apne ghar chale jaya karte the - phir seedhe hue aur logon ki taraf munh kiya, to Ansar ya unmein se jo log the aapke paas jama ho gaye yahan tak ke unki taadad poori ho gayi. Farmaya: 'Ae Ansar ki jamaat!' Unhone kaha: Labbaik, ya Rasoolullah! Farmaya: 'Tum Jahiliyyat mein, jab tum Allah ki ibadat nahi karte the, bojh uthane walon ka bojh uthate the, apne maal mein nekiyan karte the, aur musafir ke saath bhalai karte the. Yahan tak ke jab Allah ne tum par Islam ka ehsaan kiya aur apne Nabi ka ehsaan kiya, to ab tum apne maal ko deewaron se mehfooz karne lage ho! Halan ke jo kuch Adam ka beta khata hai usmein ajar hai, aur jo kuch darinda ya parinda khata hai usmein bhi ajar hai.' Phir log laute to unmein se koi nahi bacha jisne apne bagh ki deewar ke tees hisse (darwaze) na dhaa diye ho.

e: [AI] His father heard him saying, "O Messenger of Allah, we find camels that have milk while they are pregnant, and we are in need." He (the Prophet) said, "Call the owner of the camel three times, if he comes, then milk it, otherwise, let it relax and drink its milk, and untie its udders, then tighten them again, and leave the milk for its young ones." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in the summary.
hi: Unhone apne walid ko kehte suna: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Hum aise oonton se milte hain jin mein dudh hota hai aur woh musarrat (thanon mein dudh roka hua) hain, aur hum mohtaj hote hain. Farmaya: 'Oont ke malik ko teen baar pukaro; agar woh aa jaye (to theek), warna doodho, aur apne liye doodh nikalo, aur (apne liye) jaiz jaano, phir (thano ko) bandh do aur doodh ko uski zaroorat ke liye baaqi rakho.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] When the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  made a covenant with the women, a noble woman came to him, resembling the women of the tribe of Mudar, and she said, "O Messenger of Allah, we have responsibilities towards our fathers, sons, and husbands. What is permissible for us from their wealth?" He said, "You may eat from their ripe dates and give them as gifts." This hadith was narrated by Sufyan al-Thawri from Yunus ibn Ubayd, on the condition of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Jab Nabi (SAW) ne auraton se bay'at li to ek rob-daar aurat, goya Mudar ki auraton mein se, aapke paas khadi hui aur boli: Ya Rasoolullah! Hum apne baap, beton aur shauharon par bojh hain, to unke maal mein se humare liye kya halal hai? Farmaya: 'Taazi khajoor, tum khao bhi aur hadiya bhi karo.' Is hadees ko Sufyan Ath-Thawri ne Yunus bin Ubayd se bhi riwayat kiya hai. Yeh Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] A woman said, "O Messenger of Allah, we are dependent on our children and siblings, so what is permissible for us from their wealth?" He replied, "Dates and gifts that you give away." This is a correct hadith narrated by Abdul Salam ibn Harb, according to the conditions of the two sheikhs, and they did not exclude it.
hi: Ek aurat ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Hum apne beton aur bhaiyon par bojh hain, to unke maal mein se humare liye kya halal hai? Farmaya: 'Taazi khajoor jo tum khao aur hadiya karo.' Abd As-Salam bin Harb ki hadees Shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar unhone ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Verily, Allah the Most Exalted will admit into Paradise whoever gives a morsel of bread, a handful of dates or their equivalent in what benefits the poor; three things: the one who encourages it, the righteous wife, and the servant who serves the poor." And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "All praise is due to Allah who did not forget our servant."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah Ta'ala roti ke ek luqme, khajoor ki ek mutthi aur isi tarah ki cheez jo miskeen ko faida de, ke sabab teen ko jannat mein dakhil karta hai: us ka hukm dene wala, nek biwi aur woh khadim jo miskeen ko deta hai.' Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tamam taareef Allah ke liye hai jisne humare khadimon ko nahi bhoola.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Eat, drink and give in charity, without extravagance or arrogance. Indeed, Allah is pleased to see the traces of His blessings upon His servant."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Khao, piyo aur sadqa karo bina israaf aur takabbur ke. Beshak Allah Ta'ala pasand karta hai ke apne bande par apni naimat ka asar dekhe.'

e: [AI] "He sent to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  a dish of vegetables that contained onions or leek, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  did not eat from it. So he refused to eat it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  asked him, 'What prevents you from eating it?' He replied, 'I did not see any trace of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  eating from it.' Upon this, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'I feel shy in front of the angels of Allah Almighty, but it is not forbidden.'"
hi: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas sabzi ka khana bheja jis mein pyaaz ya karrath (leek) tha, to aapne usme Rasoolullah (SAW) ka asar nahi dekha aur use khane se inkaar kar diya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: Aapko isse khane se kya cheez rokti hai? Kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ka asar nahi dekha. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mujhe Allah Ta'ala ke farishton se haya aati hai, aur yeh haram nahi hai.'

e: [AI] "The king of India presented the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a jar containing ginger. He then fed his companions piece by piece, and also fed me a piece of it."
hi: Hind ke badshah ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko adrak (zanjabeel) ka ek martaban hadiya bheja, to aapne apne sahaba ko ek ek tukda khilaya aur mujhe bhi usme se ek tukda khilaya.

e: [AI] I witnessed a banquet at the house of Abdul A'la, and Abu Umamah Al-Bahili was with us. When we finished eating, he stood up and said, "I do not intend to be a speaker, but I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say after he finished his meal, 'Praise be to Allah abundantly, good and blessed in it, neither needy nor independent of it"
hi: Maine Abd Al-A'la ke ghar mein ek walima dekha aur humare saath Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (RA) the. Jab hum khane se faarigh hue to woh khade hue aur kaha: Main khatib nahi banna chahta, lekin maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko khane se faarigh hone ke baad farmate suna: 'Tamam taareef Allah ke liye bahut zyada, paakiza, mubarak, jo na chhodi jaye aur na jis se be-niyazi ho.'

e: when the table spread would be lifted from in front of him, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say: “All praise is due to Allah, abundant, good, blessed praise, without being left off, nor being without need of it, O our Lord (Al-ḥamdulillāhi ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīhi, ghaira muwaddaʿin, wa lā mustaghnan ʿanhu rabbanā).” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3456)
hi: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ke samne se dastarkhwan uthaya jata to farmate: 'Tamam taareef Allah ke liye, bahut zyada, paakiza, mubarak taareef, jo na chhodi jaye aur na jis se be-niyazi ho, ae humare Rab.'

e: [AI] "To die, so we killed it and cut it up except for its shoulder."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... ke woh mar jaye, to humne use zibah kiya aur taqseem kar liya siwaye uske dast ke.

e: [AI] I was with Hanzala in Al-Baqi' with Abu Hurairah, and Abu Hurairah narrated to us from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that he said, "The grateful eater is like the patient fasting person."
hi: Main aur Hanzalah Baqi' mein Abu Hurairah (RA) ke saath the, to Abu Hurairah (RA) ne Baqi' mein humein Rasoolullah (SAW) se hadees bayan ki ke aapne farmaya: 'Shukr karne wala khane wala sabr karne wale rozedar ki tarah hai.'

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Verily, the one who eats and expresses gratitude will have a reward similar to the one who fasts and perseveres." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Beshak shukr guzaar khane wale ke liye sabr karne wale rozedar jitna ajar hai.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took a man who was suffering from tubercular leprosy by the hand; he then put it along with his own hand in the dish and said: Eat with confidence in Allah and trust in Him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3925)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne ek korh (juzaam) ke marez ka haath pakda aur use apne saath bartan mein rakha, phir farmaya: 'Bismillah, Allah par bharosa karte hue aur usi par tawakkul karte hue.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Whoever goes to sleep with goods under his possession and someone steals from him, he should only blame himself." All of these narrations are authentic and have not been disputed.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo raat is haal mein guzare ke uske haath mein khane ki chiknahat (ghamr) ho aur use koi takleef pahunch jaye to woh sirf apne aap ko malamat kare.' Yeh saari sanadein sahih hain, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Ash-Shaitan has a sense of taste, for which he licks, so beware of him. So whoever spends the night with [a smell] on his hand and something happens to him, then let him not blame anyone but himself." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1859)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak shaitan bahut tatolne aur chaatne wala hai, pas apne aap ko usse bachao. Jo raat is haal mein guzare ke uske haath mein chiknahat ho aur use koi takleef pahunch jaye to woh sirf apne aap ko malamat kare.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever eats something which his tongue does not agree with, let him swallow it, and whatever passes through him, let him spit it out. If one does this, then he has done good, and if one does not, then there is no harm."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jisne khaya, to jo kuch zubaan se nikal aaye use nigal le, aur jo daanton mein phansa ho use thook de. Jisne aisa kiya usne achha kiya, aur jisne na kiya to koi harj nahi.'

e: [AI] I sought permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and then I entered upon him in a small room. And he was lying on a bed made of palm leaves, with some of it touching the ground and a pillow filled with palm fibers under his head. Above his head was a low-hanging curtain. On the side of the room, there was a glass of water. I greeted him and then sat down. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, you are the Prophet of Allah, His chosen one, and the best of His creation. The thrones of Kisra and Caesar are nothing compared to your golden beds and silk carpets." He said, "O Umar, those people have been given their goodness quickly, and it is about to be cut off. As for us, we have been delayed, and our goodness is in the hereafter."
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se ijazat maangi aur aapke paas ek baala-khane mein dakhil hua, aap khajoor ki chatai par let rahe the aur aapka kuch hissa mitti par tha, aapke sir ke neeche khajoor ke reshon se bhara takiya tha, sir ke upar kachchi khaal thi aur baala-khane ke ek kone mein qarz (daabagat ke patte) rakhe the. Maine salaam kiya phir baith gaya aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Aap Allah ke Nabi hain, uske chune hue aur uski makhlooq mein se pasandeeda, aur Kisra aur Qaisar sone ke takhton aur resham o dibaaj ke bistaron par hain! Farmaya: 'Ae Umar! Un logon ko unki paakiza cheezein jaldi de di gayi hain aur woh jald khatam hone wali hain, aur hum woh qaum hain jinki paakiza cheezein humare liye aakhirat mein mu'akhkhar kar di gayi hain.'

e: "Whoever eats the Tayyib and acts in accordance with the Sunnah, and the people are safe from his harm, he will enter Paradise." So a man said: "O Messenger of Allah! This is the case with many people today." So he said: "It shall be so in the generation after me." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2520)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jisne paakiza (halal) khaya, sunnat par amal kiya aur logon ko uske sharr se amaan raha, woh jannat mein dakhil hoga.' Sahaba ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Aaj aapki ummat mein aise log bahut hain. Farmaya: 'Aur mere baad ki sadiyon mein bhi honge.'

e: [AI] Aisha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , used to enter the rooms of some of his other wives, and she had a container of honey with her. He would take a lick from it and then sit with her. They noticed this and said to Hafsah and some of the Prophet's other wives, "We only find the smell of maghafeer (a type of plant) coming from you." Aisha replied, "It is honey that I lick at the place of so-and-so, but I am not affected by it." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Aishah (RA): Rasoolullah (SAW) apni kisi biwi ke paas jaate, unke paas shahad ka matka hota to aap usme se thoda chaat lete aur unke paas baithte. Isse (doosri biwiyon ko) khatka hua, to Aishah (RA) ne Hafsah (RA) aur Nabi (SAW) ki kuch aur biwiyon se kaha ke unse kaho: Humein aapse maghafir ki bu aati hai. Farmaya: 'Woh shahad hai jo main falaan ke paas chatta hoon, aur main dobara aisa nahi karunga.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Umm Sulaym had a bowl, and I did not leave anything from the drink except that I offered it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , in which there was honey, milk, wine, and water.
hi: Umm Sulaym (RA) ka ek pyala tha, aur maine peene ki koi cheez aisi nahi chhodi jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ko usme na pilayi ho: shahad, doodh, nabeez aur paani.

e: [AI] "My father said, 'We fought alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and we had nothing to eat except for two things.' He asked, 'Do you know what those two things are?' I said, 'No.' He replied, 'Water and dates.'"
hi: Mere walid ne kaha: 'Humne Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath jihad kiya aur humare paas do kaalon ke siwa khana na tha.' (Unhone) poocha: 'Kya tum jaante ho do kaale kya hain?' Kaha: Nahi. (Unhone) kaha: 'Paani aur khajoor.'

e: [AI] "If the month and half of the month would pass for the family of Muhammad and nothing would be lit in their homes, neither for a lamp nor for anything else." I asked her, "What used to sustain you?" She replied, "Dates and water."
hi: 'Aal-e-Muhammad (SAW) par aisa hota ke ek mahina ya aadha mahina guzar jata aur unke gharon mein na chiragh ke liye aag jalti na kisi aur kaam ke liye.' Maine unse kaha: Phir aap logon ki guzar kis cheez par hoti thi? Unhone kaha: 'Khajoor aur paani.'

e: [AI] Muhammad (SAW) never ate in one day except for two meals, and one of them was dates.
hi: Muhammad (SAW) ne ek din mein do khane nahi khaye magar un mein se ek khajoor ka hota.

e:
[AI] "O son of my nephew, do you see this stone? This is the stone of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. I have seen us (companions) near it, and none of us could fill his stomach with food until one of us could take the stone and tie it to his belly with a rope or a piece of cloth, and I swear by the One in whose hand is my soul, I have seen myself and the Prophet ﷺ distributing dates among us. Each one of us would receive seven dates and there would still be a residue in the seven dates, and I would be pleased with a good date."

I (the son of Abu Huraira) asked, "Why didn't you take a good date for yourself?"

He replied, "Because it caused me pain in my stomach, so I let it be on my shoulders."
hi: 'Ae Ibn Shaqiq! Kya tum is hujre ko dekhte ho? Yeh Nabi (SAW) ka hujra hai. Maine hum logon ko iske paas is haal mein dekha ke kisi ke paas pet bharne ka khana nahi hota tha, yahan tak ke hum mein se koi patthar utha kar apne pet par rassi ya kisi bandhan se bandh leta. Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, mujhe yaad hai ke Nabi (SAW) ne humare darmiyan khajoor taqseem ki to har ek ke hisse mein saat khajoorein aayin, aur meri saat mein ek sookhi, kharab khajoor thi, aur mujhe uski jagah koi achhi khajoor bhi khushi na deti.' Maine poocha: Kyun, ae Abu Hurairah? Kaha: 'Kyunke woh meri chabane ke liye zyada sakht thi aur main use der tak chabata raha.'

e: [AI] "She used to visit us for forty nights, and there would be no lamp or anything else lit in the house of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh)." They asked, "So how did you live?" She said, "With two black dates and water."
hi: 'Humpar chalees raatein aisi aati thin ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ghar mein na chiragh jalta na koi aur (aag).' Humne kaha: Ae ammi jaan! Phir aap log kis cheez par guzara karte the? Unhone kaha: 'Do kaalon, khajoor aur paani par.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  used to call dates and milk the two most delicious things.
hi: Nabi (SAW) khajoor aur doodh ko 'Al-Atyabain' (do sab se paakiza aur lazeez cheezein) kehte the.

e: [AI] I read in the Torah that performing ablution before eating brings blessings to the food. So, I mentioned this to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , and he said, "Performing ablution before and after eating brings blessings to the food." Qais ibn al-Rabi' narrated this hadith exclusively from Abu Hashim, and his narration is more likely to be true than to be left out in this book.
hi: Maine Torah mein parha: Khane se pehle wuzu khane ki barkat hai. Maine yeh Nabi (SAW) se zikr kiya to farmaya: 'Khane se pehle aur khane ke baad wuzu khane ki barkat hai.' Is riwayat mein Qais bin Ar-Rabi' Abu Hashim se akele hain, aur unka tanha riwayat karna, unke buland maqam ke bawajood, itna zyada hai ke is kitab mein unki riwayaat ko chhodna mumkin nahi.

e: I entered upon ʿAli bin Abi Talib along with two other men, one man from among my people and another from Banu Asad - I think and he sent us on an errand and said: You are strong people, so use your strength to serve your religion. Then he went to the outhouse and relieved himself. Then he came out and took a handful of water and washed himself with it. Then he started reciting Qurʿan. Then it was as if he realised that we found that strange, so he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to relieve himself, then come out and recite Qurʿan and eat meat with us. Nothing came between him and the Qurʿan except janabah. (Using translation from Aḥmad 840)
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... tumhare deen ke baare mein ... phir (Ali) bait-ul-khala mein dakhil hue, phir nikle, ek chullu paani liya aur usse masah kiya, phir aaye aur Quran parha. Unhone dekha ke humne isse nagawar jaana to Ali (RA) ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) bait-ul-khala jaate, haajat poori karte, phir nikalte aur humare saath roti aur gosht khate aur Quran parhte aur koi cheez aapko Quran parhne se nahi rokti thi - ya kaha: aapko Quran parhne se janabat ke siwa koi cheez nahi rokti thi.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ , Abu Bakr, and Umar came to the house of Abu Ayyub. When they ate and were full, the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Bread, meat, dates, ripe fruits, and fresh dates. If you have collected such things, you should strike them with your palms and say 'Bismillah' (in the name of Allah) and ask for the blessings of Allah."
hi: Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr (RA) aur Umar (RA) Abu Ayyub (RA) ke ghar aaye, jab unhone khaya aur seer ho gaye to Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Roti, gosht, khajoor, adh-pakki khajoor (busr) aur taaza khajoor (rutab)! Jab tumhein aisa kuch mile aur tum (khane par) haath maaro to kaho: Bismillah aur Allah ki barakat ke saath khao.'

e: [AI] If my mother made food for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and she made Tharid that was enough for his companions, my father would leave and call him. He would then place his hand on it and say, "Eat in the name of Allah." They would take from it, and when they finished eating, he would supplicate for them and say, "O Allah, forgive them, have mercy on them, bless them, and provide for them."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) Mere walid ne meri walida se kaha: Agar tum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke liye khana bana dein. To unhone thodi miqdar ka tharid banaya. Mere walid gaye aur aapko bulaya. Aapne uspar haath rakha phir farmaya: 'Bismillah, khao.' Unhone uske kinaron se liya. Jab woh khane se faarigh hue to aapne unke liye dua ki: 'Ae Allah! Inhein bakhsh de, inpar rahm kar, inke liye barkat de aur inhein rizq de.'

e: [AI] "I cooked food and brought it to the Prophet ﷺ  while he was sitting. I placed it in front of him and he said, 'What is this?' I replied, 'It is a gift.' He put his hand on it and said to his companions, 'Eat in the name of Allah.'"
hi: Maine khana banaya aur use Nabi (SAW) ke paas laya jabke aap baithe the. Maine use aapke samne rakh diya to farmaya: 'Yeh kya hai?' Maine kaha: Hadiya hai. Aapne haath rakha aur apne sahaba se farmaya: 'Bismillah, khao.'

e: From 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you eats food, then let him say: 'Bismillah.' If he forgets in the beginning, then let him say: 'Bismillah Fi Awwalihi Wa Akhirih (In the Name of Allah in its beginning and its end.)" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1858)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se koi khana khaye to kahe: Bismillah. Agar shuru mein bhool jaye to kahe: Bismillah, iske shuru aur aakhir mein.'

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, it is reported that he was brought some food. Then, an Arab man came, looking as if he was being chased away, and he took some of the food. The Prophet ﷺ held his hand, and then a servant girl came, looking as if she was being chased away, and he took her hand. Then, he said, 'When the devil sees that you have neglected mentioning the name of Allah (by saying Bismillah - in the name of Allah) before eating, he comes to the Arab man and the servant girl to make them permissible for him. Therefore, say the name of Allah and eat.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aapke paas khana laya gaya, to ek dehati aaya goya use bhagaya ja raha ho, usne haath badhaya to Nabi (SAW) ne uska haath pakad liya. Phir ek ladki aayi goya use bhagaya ja raha ho, to Nabi (SAW) ne uska haath pakad liya. Phir farmaya: 'Beshak shaitan, jab tumne use aajiz kar diya, to dehati aur ladki ko le aaya taake unke zariye us khane ko apne liye halal kar le jab us par Allah ka naam na liya jaye. Bismillah, khao.'

e: [AI] My grandfather, Umayyah ibn Makhshiyy, was one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . I heard him saying that there was a man who would eat while the Prophet ﷺ  was watching, but the man did not mention the name of Allah until he reached the end of his meal. Then he said "Bismillah" (In the name of Allah) at the beginning and end of his meal. The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The devil has been eating with him until he mentioned Allah, and whatever is left in his stomach will be vomited."
hi: Mere dada Umayyah bin Makhshi (RA), jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba mein se the, maine unhein kehte suna: Ek aadmi khana kha raha tha aur Nabi (SAW) dekh rahe the, usne Allah ka naam nahi liya yahan tak ke apne khane ke aakhir mein kaha: Bismillah, iske shuru aur aakhir mein. To Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Shaitan barabar uske saath khata raha yahan tak ke usne Allah ka naam liya, to jo kuch uske pet mein tha sab ulti kar diya.'

e: [AI] A Jew woman gave a sheep to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  as a gift. When the people spread out their hands, the Prophet ﷺ  told them, "Stop! One of its organs has informed me that it is poisoned." He then sent for the woman and asked her, "Did you poison this food?" She replied, "Yes, if you are lying, I wanted to free the people from you, and if you are truthful, I knew that Allah would inform you about it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Mention the name of Allah and eat." So we ate, and none of us were harmed.
hi: Ek yahudan ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko bhuni hui (sameet) bakri hadiya bheji. Jab logon ne haath badhaye to Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: 'Haath rok lo, kyunke iske aaza mein se ek uzw mujhe khabar de raha hai ke yeh zeher-aalood hai.' Kaha: Phir aapne us aurat ko bulwaya aur farmaya: 'Kya tumne yeh khana zeher-aalood kiya?' Usne kaha: Haan, maine chaha ke agar aap jhoote hain to logon ko aap se raahat dilaun, aur agar sachche hain to main jaanti thi ke Allah aapko iski ittila de dega. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ka naam lo aur khao.' To humne khaya aur hum mein se kisi ko kuch nuqsan nahi hua.

e: [AI] From Hafsah bint Wahb Al-Khuzaiyyah, she narrated to me, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to use his right hand for his food, drink, and clothing, and he used his left hand for other purposes."
hi: Jariyah bint Wahb Al-Khuza'i se, mujhse Hafsah (RA) ne bayan kiya: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) apne khane, peene aur kapdon ke liye apna daayan haath rakhte aur baayan haath uske siwa ke liye.'

e: [AI] "When we used to eat with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , we would not begin until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  started."
hi: Jab hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath khana khate to tab tak shuru nahi karte jab tak Rasoolullah (SAW) khud shuru na karein.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was with some of his companions when Uthman came leading a camel with two sacks tied on it containing fine flour, ghee, and honey. The Prophet ﷺ  asked him, "What do you have?" Uthman replied, "Fine flour, ghee, and honey." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Make dough." So they made dough and the Prophet ﷺ  called for a big pot in which he put the flour, ghee, and honey. He cooked it and the Prophet ﷺ  and his companions ate from it. Then he said to them, "Eat, for this is similar to the food of the people of Persia."
hi: Nabi (SAW) apne kuch sahaba ke saath the ke Uthman (RA) ek oont ko khinchte hue aaye jis par do bori thin, jinhein apni unti ki rassi se bandha hua tha. Nabi (SAW) ne unse farmaya: 'Tumhare saath kya hai?' Kaha: Aata, ghee aur shahad. Farmaya: 'Oont ko bithao.' Unhone bithaya to Nabi (SAW) ne ek bari handi mangwayi aur usme us aate, ghee aur shahad mein se daala, phir use pakaya. Nabi (SAW) ne khaya aur sahaba ne bhi khaya, phir unse farmaya: 'Khao, kyunke yeh ahl-e-Faris ke khabees (halwe) jaisa hai.'

e: I was the leader of the delegation of Banu al-Muntafiq or (the narrator doubted) I was among the delegation of Banu al-Muntafiq that came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When we reached the Prophet, we did not find him in his house. We found there Aisha, the Mother of the Believers. She ordered that a dish called Khazirah should be prepared for us. It was then prepared. A tray containing dates was then presented to us. (The narrator Qutaybah did not mention the word qina', tray). Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came. He asked: Has anything been served to you or ordered for you? We replied: Yes, Messenger of Allah. While we were sitting in the company of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we suddenly saw that a shepherd was driving a herd of sheep to their fold. He had with him a newly-born lamb that was crying. He (the Prophet) asked him: What did it bear, O so and so? He replied: A ewe. He then said: Slaughter for us in its place a sheep. Do not think that we are slaughtering it for you. We have one hundred sheep and we do not want their number to increase. Whenever a ewe is born, we slaughter a sheep in its place. (The narrator says that the Prophet ﷺ used the word la tahsabanna, do not think). I (the narrator Laqit) then said: Messenger of Allah, I have a wife who has something (wrong) in her tongue, i.e. she is insolent. He said: Then divorce her. I said: Messenger of Allah, she had company with me and I have children from her. He said: Then ask her (to obey you). If there is something good in her, she will do so (obey); and do not beat your wife as you beat your slave-girl. I said: Messenger of Allah, tell me about ablution. He said: Perform ablution in full and make the fingers go through the beard and snuff with water well except when you are fasting. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 142)
hi: Main Bani Al-Muntafiq ka wafd ban kar Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya. Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas pahunche to aap ghar par nahi mile, humein Aishah, Ummul Momineen (RA) mili, unhone humare liye harirah (ek khana) banane ka hukm diya, to bana diya gaya, aur humare paas qina' laya gaya - qina' woh tabaq hai jis mein khajoor hoti hai. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) aaye aur farmaya: 'Kya tumhein kuch mila ya main tumhare liye kuch hukm doon?' Humne kaha: Ji haan, ya Rasoolullah. Kaha: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath baithe the ke charwahe ne apni bakriyan baade mein pahunchayin aur uske saath ek bakri ka bachcha tha jo uchhal raha tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ae falaan! Is (bakri) ne kya jana?' Usne kaha: Bachcha. Farmaya: 'To uski jagah humare liye ek bakri zibah kar do.' Phir hamari taraf mutawajjeh hue aur farmaya: 'Yeh na samjhna - aur farmaya: yeh na samjha jaye - ke humne ise tumhari wajah se zibah kiya hai. Humari sau bakriyan hain aur hum nahi chahte ke woh sau se badhein; pas jab charwaha koi bachcha janata hai to hum uski jagah ek bakri zibah kar dete hain.' Kaha: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Meri ek biwi hai - phir uski zubaan-daraazi aur bad-zubaani ka zikr kiya - to farmaya: 'Use talaq de do.' Maine kaha: Mere uske saath bachche hain. Farmaya: 'Phir use hukm do - yani nasihat karo - agar uske andar khair hui to woh amal karegi, aur apni biwi ko apni kaneez ki tarah na maaro.' Kaha: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah! Mujhe wuzu ke baare mein bataiye. Farmaya: 'Wuzu achhi tarah karo, ungliyon ka khilal karo, aur naak mein paani chadhane mein mubalagha karo magar jab tum rozedar ho.'

e: [AI] "We made for the Prophet ﷺ  a pot made of clay, and I brought it to him. He looked inside it and said, 'I thought it was meat.'"
hi: Humne Nabi (SAW) ke liye mitti ka ek bartan banaya, main use aapke paas laya, aapne uske andar jhaanka aur farmaya: 'Maine usse gosht jaana tha.'

e: [AI] From Nu'bail Al-'Anazi, from Jabir bin Abdullah, he said: When my father was killed, he left behind a debt, so I mentioned it in detail. In it, I said to my wife, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  will come to us today at noon, so do not harm the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  or speak to him." So he entered and she spread out a bed and a pillow for him, and he laid his head down and slept. I said to my servant, "Slaughter these sheep, as well as this fat calf, and pour out the contents before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wakes up, and I will be with you." So we did not finish slaughtering them until we were done, and he was still asleep. So I said to him, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  when he wakes up, he will call for ablution, and I fear that if he finishes, he will stand up without completing his ablution until we place the sheep before him." So when he got up, he said, "O Jabir, bring me something to purify myself." He did not finish his purification until I placed the sheep before him. Then he looked at me and said, "It seems that you prepared a kind of soup with the meat. Call Abu Bakr for me." Then he called his companions who were with him, and they entered. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  struck with his hand and said, "In the name of Allah, eat." So they ate until they were full, and there was still a lot of meat left. And he mentioned the rest of the hadith.
hi: Nubayh Al-Anazi se, woh Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se, kaha: Jab mere walid shaheed hue to mujh par qarz chhoda - phir poori hadees zikr ki - aur usme zikr kiya: Maine apni biwi se kaha: Aaj dopahar Rasoolullah (SAW) hamare paas aayenge, pas Rasoolullah (SAW) ko takleef na dena aur unse baat na karna. Kaha: Aap tashreef laaye, usne aapke liye bistar aur takiya bichha diya, aapne sir rakha aur so gaye. Maine apne ek mawla se kaha: Is bakri ke bachche ko zibah kar do - woh ghar ki pali hui moti thi - aur jaldi karo, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke jagne se pehle faarigh ho jao, aur main tumhare saath hoon. Hum lage rahe yahan tak ke faarigh ho gaye aur aap soye hue the. Maine usse kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) jab jagte hain to wuzu ka paani maangte hain, aur mujhe darr hai ke jab woh faarigh ho to uth jayein, pas wuzu se faarigh hone se pehle hum bakri ka gosht aapke samne rakh dein. Jab aap uthe to farmaya: 'Ae Jabir! Mere liye wuzu ka paani lao.' Aap wuzu se faarigh na hue the ke maine bakri aapke samne rakh di. Aapne meri taraf dekha aur farmaya: 'Goya tumne gosht ke saath haisa (khajoor aur ghee ka khana) banaya hai? Abu Bakr ko bulao.' Phir apne hawariyon ko bulaya jo aapke saath the, woh andar aaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne haath se (khane par) maara aur farmaya: 'Bismillah, khao.' Unhone khaya yahan tak ke seer ho gaye aur bahut sa gosht bach gaya. Aur raawi ne baaqi hadees zikr ki.

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The tastiest meat is the meat of the back." This was narrated by Raqabah ibn Masqalah from this narrator of understanding, but it is not attributed to being authentic.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Sab se lazeez gosht peeth ka gosht hai.' Is hadees ko Raqabah bin Masqalah ne is Fahmi se riwayat kiya hai, aur unhone uska nasab bayan nahi kiya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The tastiest meat is the meat of the back." The narration is authenticated through both chains of transmission and it has not been excluded.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Sab se lazeez gosht peeth ka gosht hai.' Yeh khabar dono sanadon se sahih hai, magar Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] My father ordered me to make a silk garment, so I made it. Then he ordered me to take it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . When I arrived at his house, he asked, "What is this, O Jabir? Is this wool?" I replied, "No, O Messenger of Allah, but it is a silk garment that my father ordered me to make, so I made it and he ordered me to bring it to you." Then I returned to my father and he asked me, "Did you see the Messenger of Allah?" I replied, "Yes." He asked, "What did he say to you?" I replied, "He said, 'Is this wool, O Jabir?'" My father said, "May it be that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  desired meat, so he went to his poultry, slaughtered a chicken, and grilled it. Then he ordered me to bring it to him, and I did. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'May Allah reward the Ansar on our behalf, especially Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Haram and Saad ibn Ubadah.'"
hi: Mere walid ne mujhe harirah banane ka hukm diya, maine bana di, phir mujhe hukm diya to main use Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas le gaya. Aap apne ghar mein the. Farmaya: 'Yeh kya hai, ae Jabir? Kya yeh gosht hai?' Maine kaha: Nahi, ya Rasoolullah, balki yeh harirah hai, mere walid ne banane ka hukm diya tha, maine bana di, phir unhone mujhe hukm diya to main aapke paas le aaya. Phir main apne walid ke paas laut aaya. Unhone poocha: Kya tumne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dekha? Maine kaha: Ji haan. Poocha: Aapne tumse kya kaha? Maine kaha: Farmaya: 'Kya yeh gosht hai, ae Jabir?' Mere walid ne kaha: Shayad Rasoolullah (SAW) ka gosht khane ko ji chaha ho. Phir woh apni ghar ki pali hui bakri ki taraf uthe, use zibah kiya, bhoona, phir mujhe hukm diya ke use aapke paas le jaoon. Kaha: Maine use aapke paas pahunchaya. To Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah Ansar ko humari taraf se jazaa-e-khair de, khaaskar Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram ko aur Sa'd bin Ubadah ko.'

e: [AI] I heard Anas say, "I hunted a rabbit in Al-Baqi' and I followed its trail until it became intense. I was among those who excelled, so I preceded them to it and caught it. I then brought it to Abu Talhah and he ordered for it to be slaughtered. It was then cooked until it became tender. I presented it to the Prophet ﷺ and he said, 'What is this?' I said, 'It is a hunted rabbit that Abu Talhah sent to you.' He accepted it from me."
hi: Maine Anas (RA) ko kehte suna: Maine Baqi' mein ek khargosh ko uchhala to log uske peeche daude, main daudne walon mein tha, maine unse pehle us tak pahunch kar use pakad liya. Phir use Abu Talhah (RA) ke paas laya, unhone hukm diya to zibah kiya gaya, phir bhoona gaya, aur uska pichhla hissa alag kiya gaya, aur unhone use mere saath Nabi (SAW) ke paas bheja. Nabi (SAW) ne poocha: 'Yeh kya hai?' Maine kaha: Khargosh ka pichhla hissa, Abu Talhah ne aapko bheja hai. To aapne mujhse use qubool kar liya.

e: [AI] "I used to roast a sheep's belly for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he would eat from it before going out for prayer." - According to the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim
hi: 'Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke liye bakri ka pet bhoona karta tha, aap usme se khate phir namaz ke liye nikalte.' Yeh Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] I was cooking the stomach of a sheep for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he had performed ablution for prayer, so he would eat from it and then go out to pray.
hi: 'Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke liye bakri ka pet bhoona karta tha jabke aap namaz ke liye wuzu kar chuke hote, aap usme se khate phir namaz ke liye nikalte.'

e: [AI] I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and I was taking the meat from the bone with my hand. He said to me, "O Safwan!" I said, "Labbaik (Here I am), O Messenger of Allah." He said, "Bring the meat closer to your mouth, for it is more delicious and better for digestion."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe dekha ke main haath se haddi se gosht utaar raha tha. Farmaya: 'Ae Safwan!' Maine kaha: Labbaik. Farmaya: 'Gosht ko apne munh ke qareeb karo, kyunke yeh zyada khushgawar aur hazm mein asaan hai.'

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not eat the artery, for it is the sacrifice of Satan." Ibn Al-Mubarak said, "And the artery is when the soul comes out from it without cutting the throat."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Sharitah mat khao, kyunke yeh shaitan ka zabiha hai.' Ibn Al-Mubarak ne kaha: 'Sharitah yeh hai ke janwar ki jaan uski halaq ki naali kaate baghair, sirf kuch cheer kar nikal jaye.'

e: explaining the verse "But the evil ones ever inspire their friend to contend with you" They used to say: Do not eat which Allah killed, but eat which you slaughtered. So Allah revealed the verse: "Eat not of (meats) on which Allah's name hath not been pronounced"...to the end of the verse. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2818)
hi: 'Beshak shayateen apne dostoon ke dilon mein daalte hain, kehte hain: Jo Allah ke liye zibah kiya gaya woh na khao, aur jo tumne khud zibah kiya woh khao.' To Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: {Aur us mein se na khao jis par Allah ka naam nahi liya gaya} (Surah Al-An'am 121).

e: [AI] "To slaughter it with a sharp tool, I asked him, 'Is it iron?' He said, 'No, it is wood.' So, I asked the Prophet ﷺ, and he commanded him to eat it."
hi: (Adhoora aghaaz:) ... ke woh mar jaye (is darr se) to usne use ek khoonte se zibah kar diya. Maine usse kaha: Lohe se? Kaha: Nahi, balki lakdi se. Phir usne Nabi (SAW) se poocha to aapne use khane ka hukm diya.

e: a wolf bit a sheep so he slaughtered it with Marwah, and the Prophet allowed him to eat it. (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4400)
hi: Ek bheriye ne bakri ko daant se zakhmi kar diya to unhone use Marwah (tez patthar) se zibah kar diya, to Nabi (SAW) ne use khane ki rukhsat di.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The charity of the unborn child is the charity of its mother." This was followed by a statement from the trustworthy person, Ubaidullah ibn Abi Ziyad al-Qaddah al-Makki.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Janeen ka zibah uski maa ka zibah hai.' Siqah raawiyon mein se Ubaydullah bin Abi Ziyad Al-Qaddah Al-Makki ne iski mutaba'at ki hai.

e: [AI] Narrated Husayn ibn Ali al-Tamimi: Muhammad ibn Ishaq informed me, narrating from Muhammad ibn Yahya, who narrated from Isḥāq ibn Ibrāhīm al-Ḥanẓalī, who mentioned it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , who said: "The charity of the fetus is the charity of its mother."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat hai, farmaya: 'Janeen ka zibah uski maa ka zibah hai.' Mujhe Al-Husayn bin Ali At-Tamimi ne khabar di, unhe Muhammad bin Ishaq ne, unhe Muhammad bin Yahya ne, mujhse Ishaq bin Ibrahim Al-Hanzali ne bayan kiya, phir unhone isse zikr kiya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: The slaughter of embryo is included when its mother is slaughtered. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2828)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Janeen ka zibah uski maa ka zibah hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The zakah of a fetus is due when the zakah of its mother is due, but it is not to be slaughtered until it reaches the age where it contains blood." This is a significant topic discussed through various narrations attributed to Abu Sa'id. However, they have not been explicitly mentioned by him, and it is possible that some people mistakenly believe that the narration of Abu Ayyub is authentic, whereas it is not. Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Janeen ka zibah, jab uske baal ug aaye hon, uski maa ka zibah hai, lekin use zibah kiya jaye taake jo khoon uske andar hai woh beh jaye.' Yeh ek bada baab hai jiska daaromadar Atiyyah ki Abu Sa'id se sanadon par hai, isliye Bukhari aur Muslim ne ise nahi nikaala. Aur shayad koi wahm kar le ke Abu Ayyub ki hadees sahih hai, jabke aisa nahi hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The charity of the fetus is the charity of its mother." And the narration of Abu Al-Waddak from Abu Sa'id, which he narrated uniquely and it includes a mistake that cannot be substantiated by evidence. And whoever contemplates on this matter from the people of knowledge and expertise, it is astonishing that the two Shaykhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim) did not include it in their Sahih collections. It is not considered authentic.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Janeen ka zibah uski maa ka zibah hai.' Abu Al-Waddak ki Abu Sa'id se hadees mein Allan akele hain, aur usmein Ziyad hai jo bahut ghalatiyan karta hai, uske zariye hujjat qaim nahi hoti. Aur ahl-e-fann mein se jo is baab par ghaur karega woh hairat mein reh jayega ke Shaykhain ne ise Sahihain mein kyun nahi nikaala. Yeh sahih nahi hai.

e: The people of pre-Islamic times used to eat some things and leave others alone, considering them unclean. Then Allah sent His Prophet ﷺ and sent down His Book, marking some things lawful and others unlawful; so what He made lawful is lawful, what he made unlawful is unlawful, and what he said nothing about is allowable. And he recited: "Say: I find not in the message received by me by inspiration any (meat) forbidden to be eaten by one who wishes to eat it...." up to the end of the verse. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3800)
hi: 'Ahl-e-Jahiliyyat kuch cheezein khate aur kuch cheezein ghin (napaaki) ki wajah se chhod dete. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (SAW) ko bheja, apni kitab nazil ki, apna halal halal kiya aur haram haram. Pas jo usne halal kiya woh halal hai, jo haram kiya woh haram hai, aur jis par khamoshi ikhtiyar ki woh muaaf hai.' Aur unhone yeh aayat tilawat ki: {Keh do ke jo wahi mujh par ki gayi hai usmein kisi khane wale par koi cheez haram nahi paata...} (Surah Al-An'am 145), aayat ke aakhir tak.

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah has set limits, so do not transgress them; He has decreed obligations, so do not neglect them; and He has forbidden certain things, so do not violate them; and your Lord has left some matters unspecified ˹intentionally˺ as a source of His Mercy upon you; so accept them ˹as is˺ and do not delve into them.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah ne kuch hadein muqarrar ki hain, unse tajawuz na karo; kuch farz kiye hain, unhein zaya na karo; kuch cheezein haram ki hain, unki be-hurmati na karo; aur kuch cheezon par bina bhoole khamoshi ikhtiyar ki hai, tumhare Rab ki rahmat ki wajah se, pas unhein qubool karo aur unke baare mein kuredo (baht na karo).' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about ghee, cheese and wild donkeys. He said: ‘What is lawful is that which Allah has permitted, in His Book and what is unlawful is that which Allah has forbidden in His Book. What He remained silent about is what is pardoned.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3367)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) se ghee, paneer aur jangli gadhon ke baare mein poocha gaya to farmaya: 'Halal woh hai jo Allah ne apni kitab mein halal kiya, aur haram woh hai jo Allah ne apni kitab mein haram kiya, aur jis par khamoshi ikhtiyar ki woh muaaf hai.'

e: [AI] "That indeed the Prophet ﷺ  used to like eating thufal (a type of food made from flour and honey). So I heard Abu Muhammad saying that he heard Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Ishaq saying, 'Thufal is a type of thareed.'"
hi: 'Nabi (SAW) ko thufl pasand tha.' Maine Abu Muhammad ko kehte suna, maine Abu Bakr Muhammad bin Ishaq ko kehte suna: 'Thufl, tharid hai.'

e: [AI] "The Thareed was the beloved food of the Messenger of Allah (pbuh)."
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ko sab se pasandeeda khana tharid tha.'

e: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed the blessing descends to the middle of the food, so eat from its edges, and do not eat from its middle." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1805)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat hai: 'Beshak barkat khane ke beech mein utarti hai, pas uske kinaron se khao aur beech se na khao.'

e: [AI] We stayed for three days, and whoever went out to the mosque would take the hands of two or three people, according to their capacity, and feed them. He said, "So I was among those who made a mistake for three days and its nights." He said, "Then I saw Abu Bakr in the darkness, so I came to him and he recited Surah Saba' to me until he reached his house. I hoped that he would invite me to eat, so he recited to me until he reached the door of the house. Then he stood at the door and recited the rest to me, then he entered and left me. Then Umar approached me and I did the same to him as Abu Bakr did. And he mentioned that he did the same as Abu Bakr. When I woke up in the morning, I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and informed him. He said to the maid, "Is there anything?" She said, "Yes, a loaf of bread and a chunk of butter." So he called for it and he cut the bread with his hand. Then he took the chunk of butter and melted the bread with it, and then he mixed them with his hand until it became a lump. Then he said, "Go and invite ten, and you are the tenth." So I invited ten and I was the tenth. Then he said, "Sit down," and I placed the tray. Then he said, "Eat in the name of Allah, eat from its sides and do not eat from the top, for blessings come down from the top." So we ate until we were satisfied, as if we had brought it by our fingers. Then he took from it and added to it and brought it back. Then he said, "Invite ten more." And he mentioned that he invited ten, ten more times, and he said, "They were granted superiority, superiority."
hi: Hum teen din thehre rahe aur jo masjid mein nikalta woh do-teen aadmiyon ka haath pakad kar apni taaqat ke mutabiq unhein khilata. Kaha: Main un mein se tha jise teen din aur teen raatein yeh (khilana) na mila. Kaha: Maine Isha ke waqt Abu Bakr (RA) ko dekha to unke paas gaya aur unse Surah Saba parhne ko kaha, woh apne ghar tak pahunch gaye, aur mujhe umeed thi ke woh mujhe khane ki dawat denge, lekin unhone mujhe parh kar sunaya yahan tak ke ghar ke darwaze par pahunche, phir darwaze par khade ho gaye yahan tak ke mujhe baaqi (surah) parh kar suna di, phir andar chale gaye aur mujhe chhod diya. Phir main Umar (RA) ke saamne aaya aur unke saath bhi aisa hi kiya, aur unhone bhi wahi kiya jo Abu Bakr (RA) ne kiya tha. Jab subah hui to main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaya aur aapko khabar di.
