Aapne (ghar ki) ladki se poocha: 'Kuch hai?' Usne kaha: Haan, ek roti aur ghee ka ek loda. Aapne woh mangwaye, phir roti apne haath se tukde ki, phir ghee ka woh loda liya aur us roti ko tar kiya, phir use apne haath se jama kiya yahan tak ke tharid bana diya, phir farmaya: 'Jao, mere liye dus aadmi bulao jinmein tum dasve ho.' Maine dus aadmi bulaye jinmein main dasva tha. Phir farmaya: 'Baith jao.' Aur maine bartan rakh diya. Phir farmaya: 'Bismillah, khao; kinaron se khao aur upar se na khao, kyunke barkat upar se utarti hai.' Humne khaya yahan tak ke hum seer ho kar hate, goya humne usme apni ungliyon se lakeeren kheench di hon. Phir aapne usme se liya, use theek kiya aur wapas rakh diya, phir farmaya: 'Mere liye dus aur bulao.' Aur raawi ne zikr kiya ke aapne iske baad do baar dus dus bulaye aur kaha: Woh bahut sa bacha gaya.

e: [AI] He mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ  used to lick his three fingers after eating. Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko dekha ke jab aap khana khate to apni woh teenon ungliyan chaat lete jinse khaya hota. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to lick his three fingers after eating."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) jab khana khate to apni teenon ungliyan chaat lete.

e: “If any of his family members became ill, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would order that some broth be made. And he would say: ‘It consoles the grieving heart and cleanses the ailing heart, as anyone of you cleanses her face of dirt with water.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3445)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ahl ko jab bukhar hota to aap hisa (patla daliya) banane ka hukm dete, phir (bimar ko) hukm dete to woh usme se piyega, aur farmate: 'Yeh bimar ke dil ko taaqat deta hai - ya bimar ke dil se (bojh) utaar deta hai - jaise tum mein se koi paani se apne chehre ka mail utaarti hai.'

e: [AI] I saw the immigrants and the supporters digging the trench around the city and carrying the soil on their backs. They would say [Surah Al-Bahr Al-Rajz]: "We are those who pledged allegiance to Muhammad on Islam, and we will never forsake it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would respond to them, saying, 'O Allah, there is no good except the good of the Hereafter, so bless the supporters and the immigrants.' Then a plate would be brought containing a handful of barley grains that were roasted and prepared with unsalted fat. It would be placed in front of the people while they were starving. It had a horrible taste and a strong smell."
hi: Maine Muhajireen aur Ansar ko dekha ke Madinah ke gird khandaq khod rahe the aur mitti apni peethon par utha rahe the, aur kehte the [Bahr Ar-Rajaz]: 'Hum woh hain jinhone Muhammad (SAW) se Islam par bay'at ki, jab tak hum baaqi hain hamesha ke liye.' Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) unhein jawab dete aur farmate: 'Ae Allah! Aakhirat ki bhalai ke siwa koi bhalai nahi, pas Ansar aur Muhajireen mein barkat de.' Phir ek thaal laya jaata jisme mutthi bhar mota piska hua jau hota, jo purani badboodar charbi se banaya gaya hota, aur use logon ke samne rakha jata aur woh bhooke hote, aur gale mein uski kadwahat hoti aur uski badbu hoti.

e: [AI] "It used to, when she finished her prayer, cover it until her sweat dried up, and she would say: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Indeed, it is the most blessed.'"
hi: Woh jab tharid banatin to use dhak deti yahan tak ke uska ubaal khatam ho jaye, aur kehti thin: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Yeh barkat ke liye zyada bada hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Cool down hot food, as hot food is devoid of blessings."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Garam khane ko thanda kar lo, kyunke garam khane mein barkat nahi hoti.'

e: [AI] He heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "None of you should wipe his hand with a towel until he licks it, for a person does not know in which of his food blessings are bestowed upon him. Indeed, Satan lies in wait for people or mankind in everything, even during their food."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Tum mein se koi apna haath rumaal se na ponchhe jab tak use chaat na le, kyunke aadmi nahi jaanta ke uske khane ke kis hisse mein barkat rakhi gayi hai, aur shaitan logon (ya aadmi) ke liye har cheez par ghaat lagaye rehta hai, yahan tak ke unke khane ke waqt bhi.'

e: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Ash-Shaitan has a sense of taste, for which he licks, so beware of him. So whoever spends the night with [a smell] on his hand and something happens to him, then let him not blame anyone but himself." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1859)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Beshak shaitan bahut tatolne aur chaatne wala hai, pas apne aap ko usse bachao. Jo raat is haal mein guzare ke uske haath mein (khane ki) bu ho aur use koi takleef pahunch jaye to woh sirf apne aap ko malamat kare.'

e: [AI] He heard Anas ibn Malik saying, "The Prophet ﷺ  would walk behind him, place his food on the ground, respond to the call of the slave, and ride a donkey."
hi: Unhone Anas bin Malik (RA) ko kehte suna: 'Nabi (SAW) apne peeche (kisi ko) sawar karte, apna khana zameen par rakhte, ghulam ki dawat qubool karte aur gadhe par sawar hote.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When you eat, take off your shoes, as it is more comfortable for your bodies."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum khana khao to apne juute utaar do, kyunke yeh tumhare jismon ke liye zyada aaraamdeh hai.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ forbade me from performing two prayers, reciting two surahs, eating two meals, and wearing two garments. He prohibited me from praying after Fajr until the sun rises, and after Asr until the sun sets. He also prohibited me from eating while lying on my stomach. He forbade me from wearing a garment made of silk and from using a single piece of clothing that does not cover the area between my private parts and the sky.
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujhe do namazon, do qirat, do khane aur do libaas se mana farmaya: mujhe mana kiya ke Fajr ke baad namaz padhun jab tak sooraj buland na ho, aur Asr ke baad jab tak sooraj ghuroob na ho; aur ye ke main pet ke bal let kar khaun; aur mujhe mana kiya ke main sammaa' pehnoon aur ek hi kapde mein ihtiba' karun jabke meri sharmgah aur aasmaan ke beech koi parda na ho.'

e: [AI] "A bunch of dates was brought near the Prophet's hand ﷺ, and they began to attach them together. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade them from doing so."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke samne khajoor rakhi gayi to log do do khajoor milakar khane lage, to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne iqran (do do milakar khane) se mana farmaya.

e: [AI] I was in the battlefield and the Prophet ﷺ sent us a type of date called "ajwah". He poured it for us and we were able to satisfy our hunger. Whenever one of us would be given a handful, he would say to his companions, "I have been given a handful, so take some."
hi: Main Suffah mein tha, Nabi (SAW) ne humare paas Ajwah khajoor bheji, aur unhone humare liye undeli. Hum bhook ki wajah se do do khajoorein milakar khate. Jab hum mein se koi do khajoorein milata to apne saathiyon se kehta: Maine do milakar khayi hain, tum bhi milakar khao.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "The ajwah dates and the rock are from paradise." This is how he narrated it to us.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ajwah (khajoor) aur sakhrah (chattan) jannat se hain.' Humse unhone isi tarah bayan kiya.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Dates and stones are from paradise." This is how it was narrated to us, according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Ajwah (khajoor) aur sakhrah (chattan) jannat se hain.' Humse isi tarah bayan kiya gaya. Yeh Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "The Ajwah date and the rock are from Paradise."
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Ajwah (khajoor) aur sakhrah (chattan) jannat se hain.'

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  used to eat dates and throw the pits onto a plate."
hi: Nabi (SAW) taazi khajoor khate aur guthliyan qin' par daal dete the. Qin' ka matlab thaal hai.

e: [AI] "That the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  used to take dates in his right hand and watermelon in his left hand, and then he would eat the dates with the watermelon. And his most beloved fruit was the watermelon."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) taazi khajoor apne seedhe haath mein aur tarbooz ulte haath mein lete, phir taazi khajoor ko tarbooz ke saath khate, aur phal aapko sab se zyada pasand tha.

e: “Eat unripe dates with ripe one and eat old dates with new ones, for Satan gets angry and says: ‘The son of Adam will survive so long as he eats old dates with new ones.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3330)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Kacchi khajoor (balah) ko pakki khajoor (tamr) ke saath khao, kyunke jab Aadam ka beta ise khata hai to Shaitan ghusse mein aa kar kehta hai: Aadam ka beta zinda raha yahan tak ke usne naye ko purane ke saath kha liya.' Yeh hadees munkar hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the son of Adam does not fill any vessel worse than his stomach. It is sufficient for the son of Adam to eat a few bites that will keep his back straight. If he must eat more, then let it be: one-third for his food, one-third for his drink, and one-third for his breath." Sahih.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aadam ke bete ne pet se bura koi bartan nahi bhara. Musalman ke liye chand niwale kaafi hain jo uski peeth seedhi rakhein. Agar zaroor hi khana ho to ek tihai khane ke liye, ek tihai peene ke liye aur ek tihai saans ke liye.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] I ate a plate of bread and fatty meat, then I went to the Prophet ﷺ  and I started feeling bloated. He said, "What is this, hold back from your bloating, for indeed, most of the people in this life are full, but in the Hereafter, most of them will be hungry."
hi: Maine gandum ki roti aur charbidar gosht ka tharid khaya, phir Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya to mujhe dakaren aane lagin. Aap ne farmaya: 'Yeh kya hai? Apni dakaren rok lo, kyunke dunya mein jo log sab se zyada pet bhar kar khate hain, woh akhirat mein sab se zyada bhooke honge.'

e: [AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, and he saw a person who was satiated, so the Prophet ﷺ  pointed with his hand to his stomach and said, "If this were in someone else, it would be better for him."
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna, jabke aap ne ek bahut pet bhare aadmi ko dekha to Nabi (SAW) apne haath se uske pet ki taraf ishara karte aur farmate: 'Agar yeh isse (pet ke siwa) kisi aur cheez mein hota to uske liye behtar tha.'

e: ‘Season (your food) with olive oil and anoint yourselves with it, for it comes from a blessed tree.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3319)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Zaitoon ke tel ko saalan banao aur isse tel lagao, kyunke yeh mubarak darakht se hai.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  was brought a bowl containing milk and something of honey. He said, "I don't crave for something in a vessel that I neither eat nor forbid."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek pyala laya gaya jis mein doodh aur kuch shahad tha. Aap ne farmaya: 'Ek bartan mein do saalan, main na ise khata hun aur na haram karta hun.'

e: [AI] He heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "Successful is the one who is guided to Islam and lives a modest and content life with it."
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Woh kaamyab hua jise Islam ki hidayat mili, aur uski rozi bas guzara-bhar rahi aur usne us par qana'at ki.'

e: [AI] I went with my grandfather to a feast where Ghaleb Al-Qattan said, "Bring the bread," so it was brought and the people held their hands, and I heard Ghaleb Al-Qattan saying, "Why aren't they eating?" They replied, "They are waiting for the guest." Ghaleb said, "Karimah bint Himmam Al-Ta'iyyah narrated to us from Aisha, the mother of the believers, that the Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Honor the bread, and the honor of bread is not to be waited for.'" So he ate it and we ate it.
hi: Main apne dada ke saath ek walime mein gaya jis mein Ghalib Al-Qattan bhi the. Dastarkhwan laya gaya aur rakha gaya to logon ne haath rok liye. Maine Ghalib Al-Qattan ko kehte suna: Inhein kya hua, khate kyun nahi? Logon ne kaha: Saalan ka intizar kar rahe hain. Ghalib ne kaha: Humse Karimah bint Hammam At-Taiyyah ne Ayesha (RA), Ummul Mu'mineen, se bayan kiya ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Roti ki izzat karo, aur roti ki izzat yeh hai ke uske liye intizar na kiya jaye.' Phir unhone khaya aur humne bhi khaya.

e: [AI] I entered with my friend to Salman, so he brought us bread and salt, and he said, "If it were not for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding us from luxury, I would have prepared more for you." Then my friend said, "If we had some salt, I would have mortgaged it to the butcher and brought it." So he sent his ewer to the butcher and pawned it, and he came back with some salt and threw it in the food. When we finished eating, my friend said, "All praise is due to Allah who has satisfied us with what He has provided for us." Salman then said, "If you had been satisfied with what you were given, my ewer would not have been pawned at the butcher's."
hi: Main aur mera ek saathi Salman (RA) ke paas gaye to unhone humare saamne roti aur namak rakha, aur kaha: 'Agar Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein takalluf se mana na farmaya hota to main tumhare liye takalluf karta.' Mere saathi ne kaha: Kaash humare namak mein sa'tar hota. To Salman (RA) ne apna wuzu ka lota baniye ke paas bheja aur use girvi rakh diya, woh sa'tar le aaya aur unhone use (namak mein) daal diya. Jab humne kha liya to mere saathi ne kaha: Allah ka shukr hai jisne humein us rizq par qana'at di jo usne diya. Salman (RA) ne kaha: Agar tum us par qana'at karte jo mujhe diya gaya to mera lota baniye ke paas girvi na hota.

e: [AI] I heard Salman Al-Farsi say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  advised us not to burden ourselves for the guest."
hi: Maine Salman Al-Farsi (RA) ko kehte suna: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein mehman ke liye takalluf karne se mana farmaya.' Iski sanad kamzor (layyin) hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the most fortunate person according to me is a believer who has a light presence, has a good share of prayer, excels in worshiping Allah, and obeys Him secretly so that he is unknown to people and not pointed at with fingers. His provision is sufficient, so he remains patient in his situation." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  shook his finger and said, "His death will come soon, his descendants will be few, and his legacy will diminish." This is a reliable chain of narrators among the Sham'iyyin (people of Sham), and it has not been deemed weak.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mere nazdeek sab se rashk ke laayq woh momin hai jo halke phulke maal (khafeef al-haadh) wala ho, namaz mein se hissa rakhta ho, Allah ki ibadat acchi tarah karta ho aur chupke mein uski itaa'at karta ho, logon mein gumnaam ho ke ungliyon se uski taraf ishara na kiya jaye, uski rozi bas guzara-bhar ho aur usne us par sabr kiya ho.' Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apni ungli jhatki aur farmaya: 'Uski maut jaldi aa gayi, uspar rone wale kam hue aur uska tarka kam raha.' Yeh sanad Shamiyon ke nazdeek sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala; (Shami raviyon ke baare mein) kamzori ki taraf ishara hai.

e: He Is successful who has accepted Islam, who has been provided with sufficient for his want and been made contented by Allah with what He has given him. (Using translation from Muslim 1054)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Woh kaamyab hua jo musalman hua, jise guzara-bhar rizq mila aur Allah ne use jo diya us par qana'at ata ki.'

e: [AI] In the pre-Islamic era, people used to castrate camels and slaughter sheep to eat them. They would also carry the meat in pouches made from the animals' skin. When the Prophet ﷺ arrived, they asked him about this practice, and he said, "Whatever is cut from a living animal is considered dead."
hi: Jahiliyyat mein, Islam se pehle, log unton ke kohan kaat lete aur bakriyon ki chakkiyan kaat kar unhein khate aur unse charbi utha lete the. Jab Nabi (SAW) tashreef laye to logon ne aap se iske baare mein poocha. Aap ne farmaya: 'Jo hissa zinda jaanwar se kaata jaye woh murda hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about cutting the hump of camels and the tails of sheep. He replied, "Whatever is cut from a living creature is considered dead." This narration was reported by Abdel Rahman ibn Mahdi from Sulayman ibn Bilal from Zaid ibn Aslam, through a "mursal" chain. It is also said that it was narrated by Zaid ibn Aslam from Ibn Umar.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) se unton ke kohan kaatne aur bakriyon ki chakkiyan kaatne ke baare mein poocha gaya to aap ne farmaya: 'Jo zinda se kaata jaye woh murda hai.' Isey Abd Ar-Rahman bin Mahdi ne Sulayman bin Bilal se, unhone Zayd bin Aslam se mursal riwayat kiya, aur kaha gaya hai ke Zayd bin Aslam ne Ibn Umar (RA) se riwayat kiya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Whatever is cut off of an animal when it is alive is dead. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2858)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo hissa jaanwar se us waqt kaata jaye jab woh zinda ho, woh murda hai.'

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say, "The purification of every vessel is its tanning." So I said to him, "We travel with these non-Arabs who have pots in which they cook carrion and pork." He said, "If it is made of clay, then wash it and pour water in it, and if it is made of brass, then wash it, for water purifies everything."
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Har khaal ka zabah uski dibaghat (rangai) hai.' Maine arz kiya: Hum in ajami logon ke saath safar karte hain, unke paas deghen hoti hain jin mein woh murdar aur suar ka gosht pakate hain. Aap ne farmaya: 'Jo mitti (fakhkhar) ki ho, usmein paani ubalo phir use dho lo; aur jo taambe (nuhas) ki ho use dho lo, kyunke paani har cheez ke liye paak karne wala hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah said to his companions when he reached Al-Hijr, "Whoever uses water from this well to make food, let them discard it." Someone asked, "What about those who knead dough or cook meat using it?" He replied, "Let them throw it away."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne apne sahaba se farmaya jab aap Al-Hijr mein utre: 'Jis ne is paani se khana banaya hai woh use phenk de.' Kaha: Un mein se kisi ne aata gundha tha aur kisi ne haisa (khajoor aur ghee ka khana) banaya tha, to unhone use phenk diya.

e: [AI] A mule died in front of a man, so he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  seeking his advice. Jabir reported from Samurah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to the owner of the mule, "Don't you have anything that can compensate you for it?" He replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Then go and eat it." This narration is recorded in Sahih Muslim without any alteration.
hi: Ek aadmi ke paas ek khachchar mar gaya to woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas fatwa poochne aaya. Jabir ne Samurah (RA) se bayan kiya ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne uske malik se farmaya: 'Kya tere paas koi cheez nahi jo tujhe isse be-niyaz kar de?' Usne kaha: Nahi. Aap ne farmaya: 'Ja aur ise kha le.' Yeh Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, we are in a land with abundant dead animals. What is permissible for us from them?" He said, "If you don't slaughter them, nor find them dead, nor suspect that they were killed, then it is permissible for you."
hi: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! Hum bhookh wali zameen (makhmasah) mein rehte hain, to hamare liye murdar mein se kya halal hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Jab tum subah ka (doodh ka) peena na pao, shaam ka peena na pao aur sabzi (zameen ki ugi hui khaane ki cheez) na pao, to phir tum jano aur murdar.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "If you see your family consuming curdled milk, then avoid what Allah has forbidden regarding dead animals."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tu apne ghar walon ko shaam ke doodh se sairab kar le, to Allah ne murdar mein se jo haram kiya hai us se bach.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "In times of necessity or hardship, it is permissible to consume (eat) what is not normally permitted, such as a crow or a lizard." Al-Dhahabi did not mention this in his summary.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Majboori (ya sakht zaroorat) mein shaam ka doodh ya subah ka doodh kaafi hai.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "It was sent to the Prophet (pbuh) a cup of milk when he was fasting and it was during the heat of the day. The Messenger responded, 'How did you acquire this milk?' She said, 'I bought it with my own money.' The Messenger drank it. The next morning, Umm Abdullah, the mother of Abdullah, came to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I sent you that milk as a gift due to the severity of the heat and the length of the day.' The Prophet (pbuh) responded, 'The messengers were commanded not to eat except what is good and not to do except what is righteous.'"
hi: Unhone Nabi (SAW) ke iftar ke waqt doodh ka ek pyala bheja, jab din lamba aur garmi sakht thi. Aap ne qasid ke zariye unhein poochwaya: 'Yeh doodh tumhare paas kahan se aaya?' Unhone kaha: Meri ek bakri se. Aap ne poochwaya: 'Yeh bakri tumhare paas kahan se aayi?' Unhone kaha: Maine ise apne maal se khareeda hai. Tab aap ne piya. Agle din Umm Abdullah Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aayin aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! Maine aap ke liye woh doodh bheja tha, garmi ki shiddat aur din ki lambai par aap par tars khate hue, aur aap ne use qasid ke saath wapas kar diya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Isi ka rasoolon ko hukm diya gaya hai ke paak cheez ke siwa kuch na khayein aur nek amal ke siwa kuch na karein.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If one of you enters upon his brother, let him feed him with food, so he should eat from it and not ask him about it. And if he gives him a drink, he should drink from it and not ask him about it."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai ke paas jaye aur woh use khana khilaye to usmein se khaye aur us ke baare mein na poochhe, aur agar woh use kuch pilaye to usmein se piye aur us ke baare mein na poochhe.'

e: [AI] "When you enter upon your Muslim brother, and he feeds you food, then eat and do not ask him. And when he offers you a drink, then drink it and do not ask him."
hi: 'Jab tu apne musalman bhai ke paas jaye aur woh tujhe khana khilaye to kha aur us se mat pooch, aur jab woh tujhe kuch pilaye to pi aur us se mat pooch.' Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "May Allah protect you from rulers who come after me." The companion asked, "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Those who come to them and believe in them and help them in their injustice are not from me, and they will not reach my pool (of water on the Day of Judgment)." Sahih.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah tujhe un hukmranon se panah de jo mere baad honge.' Unhone poocha: Ya Rasoolullah! Woh kaun hain? Aap ne farmaya: 'Jo unke paas jaye, unki tasdeeq kare aur unke zulm par unki madad kare, woh mujh se nahi, aur woh mere paas hauz par nahi aa sakega.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: "The drink most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the sweet, cool drink." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1895)
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ko sab se pasandida mashroob meetha thanda (paani/sharbat) tha.' Abdullah bin Muhammad bin Yahya halik (tabah-shuda raavi) hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the master of all drinks in this world and the hereafter is water."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Khabardar! Dunya aur akhirat mein mashroobat ka sardar paani hai.'

e: the Messenger of Allah said: “Indeed the first of what will be asked about on the Day of Judgment – meaning the slave (of Allah) being questioned about the favors – is that it will be said to him: ‘Did We not make your body, health, and give you of cool water to drink?’” (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3358)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Qayamat ke din bande se sab se pehle jo hisab liya jayega woh yeh hoga ke us se kaha jayega: Kya maine tere jism ko tandurust nahi rakha aur tujhe thande paani se sairab nahi kiya?'

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to have pure water brought to him from the wells of Al-Suqya."
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ke liye Suqya ke gharon se meetha paani mangwaya jaata tha.'

e: It is more thirst- quenching, healthier and more wholesome. Anas said: So I also breathe three times in the course of a drink. (Using translation from Muslim 2028b)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) bartan mein teen saans lete aur farmate: 'Yeh zyada pyaas bujhane wala, zyada sehatmand aur zyada khushgawar hai.' Anas (RA) ne kaha: Aur main bhi peene mein teen saans leta hun.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade blowing or breathing into a vessel. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3728)
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ne bartan mein saans lene aur mashkize ke munh se peene se mana farmaya.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "None of you should breathe into a vessel when drinking from it. However, if one desires to breathe, let him delay it and then breathe."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum mein se koi jab bartan se pi raha ho to usi mein saans na le, balki jab saans lena chahe to bartan ko munh se hata de, phir saans le.'

e: [AI] Al-Qa'nabi narrated that he read from Malik, from Ayub ibn Habib, a freed slave of Banu Zuhrah, from Abu Al-Muthanna Al-Juhani who said, "I was sitting with Marwan ibn Al-Hakam when Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri entered. Marwan said to him, 'Did you hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  prohibit blowing into a drink?' He replied, 'Yes.' Then a man said, 'I only quench my thirst with one breath.' Abu Sa'id said, 'Pour the water into the cup and then breathe.' The man asked, 'But what if I see dirt in it?' He replied, 'Pour it out.'"
hi: Humse Al-Qa'nabi ne bayan kiya, jo unhone Malik par parha, Ayyub bin Habib se, jo Banu Zuhrah ke aazad-kardah ghulam the, Abu Al-Muthanna Al-Juhani se, unhone kaha: Main Marwan bin Al-Hakam ke paas baitha tha ke Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (RA) daakhil hue. Marwan ne un se kaha: Kya aap ne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko peene ki cheez mein phoonk marne se mana farmate suna hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Ek aadmi ne unse kaha: Main ek saans mein sairab nahi hota. Aap ne farmaya: 'Bartan ko apne munh se hata de, phir saans le.' Usne kaha: Agar mujhe tinka dikhai de? Aap ne farmaya: 'Use baha de.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  asked for water, so I brought him some water which had a hair in it. I took out the hair and the Prophet ﷺ  said, "O Allah, make it beautiful." I then noticed that he was only ninety-four years old and did not have a single white hair on his head.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne paani manga, maine paani pesh kiya to usmein ek baal tha, maine use nikaal diya. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ay Allah! ise zeenat de.' Kaha: Maine unhein dekha jab woh chaurani baras ke the aur unke sar mein ek bhi safed baal nahi tha.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ was once brought some water with sins in it, so he spat in it while standing and then drank from it.
hi: 'Nabi (SAW) ke paas paani ka ek dol (dhanub) laya gaya, to aap ne khade hokar us mein munh laga kar piya.'

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ prohibited drinking from the water container, as it is harmful."
hi: 'Nabi (SAW) ne mashkize ke munh se peene se mana farmaya, kyunke is se woh badbudar ho jata hai.'

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade tipping up water skins. After the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden that, a man got up at night and tipped up a water skin, and a snake fell out of it onto him.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3419)
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mashkizon ka munh mod kar (ikhtinath) peene se mana farmaya.' Aur ek aadmi ne, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke mana karne ke baad, raat ko uth kar ek mashkize ko mora to usmein se ek saanp nikal aaya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbade drinking from stagnant water. Ayyub narrated, "I was informed that a man drank from stagnant water and then a snake came out." This hadeeth is authentic according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari, but he did not include it in his collection.
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mashkize ke munh se peene se mana farmaya.' Ayyub ne kaha: 'Mujhe khabar di gayi ke ek aadmi ne mashkize ke munh se piya to (usmein se) ek saanp nikal aaya.' Yeh Bukhari ki shart par sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] He informed me that the Prophet ﷺ  used to say, "Secure the water containers and close the doors when you go to sleep at night, cover the drinks and food, for indeed the devil enters if he finds a door open, and if he does not find water covered, he drinks from it. And if he finds the door closed and the vessel covered, he cannot open the door nor drink from the vessel. And if any of you does not have something to cover his vessel with, then he should place a stick over it." This hadith has a sound chain of narrators and Al-Bukhari and Muslim did not include it in their collections.
hi: Aur mujhe khabar di ke Nabi (SAW) farmaya karte the: 'Raat ko sote waqt mashkizon ke munh baandh do, darwazay band kar do, aur peene aur khane ki cheezon ko dhaanp do, kyunke Shaitan aata hai; agar darwaza band na paaye to andar aa jata hai, agar mashkiza baandha hua na paaye to usmein se pi leta hai, aur agar darwaza band aur mashkiza baandha hua paaye to na koi gaanth kholta hai na band darwaza kholta hai. Agar tum mein se kisi ko apne bartan ke liye dhaankne ki cheez na mile to us par ek lakdi hi aarri rakh de.' Sanad sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala. Yeh sahih hai.

e: "I used to cover three vessels for the Messenger of Allah at night: A vessel (of water) for his ablution, a vessel for his tooth stick and a vessel for his drink." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 361)
hi: Unhone kaha: 'Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke liye teen dhanke hue bartan rakha karte the: ek unke wuzu ke paani ka, ek unke miswak ka, aur ek unke peene ka.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever wears silk in this world will not wear it in the Hereafter, and whoever drinks wine in this world will not drink it in the Hereafter, and whoever drinks from vessels of gold and silver in this world will not drink from them in the Hereafter." Then he said, "The clothing of the people of Paradise, the drink of the people of Paradise, and the vessels of the people of Paradise."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne dunya mein resham pehna, woh akhirat mein use nahi pehnega; jis ne dunya mein sharab pi, woh akhirat mein use nahi piyega; aur jis ne dunya mein sone aur chandi ke bartan mein piya, woh akhirat mein un mein nahi piyega.' Phir farmaya: 'Yeh jannat walon ka libas, jannat walon ka mashroob aur jannat walon ke bartan hain.'

e: during the campaign of Tabuk, the Prophet of Allah called for water from a woman. She said: "I only have a waterskin of mine made from an (unslaughtered) dead animal." He said: "Didn't you tan it?" She said: "Of course." He said: "Then it's tanning is its slaughter". (Daif) (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4243)
hi: Ghazwah Tabuk mein Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne ek aurat se paani manga. Usne kaha: Mere paas paani sirf ek murdar jaanwar ki mashk mein hai. Aap ne farmaya: 'Kya tum ne use rang (dibaghat) nahi liya?' Usne kaha: Kyun nahi. Aap ne farmaya: 'To uski dibaghat hi uska zabah hai.'

e: [AI] Regarding the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Raisins and dates are indeed wine." This means when they are fermented together.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai: 'Kishmish aur khajoor, yehi sharab hai.' Matlab jab dono ko milakar nabeez banaya jaye.

e: [AI] The prohibition of alcohol was revealed in two tribes from the Ansar, they drank until they became drunk and some of them started to harm each other. When they woke up, a man noticed the effect on his face, head, and beard, so he said, "My brother so-and-so did this to me. By Allah, if he was kind and compassionate, he wouldn't have done this to me." They were brothers without any grudges in their hearts, but these grudges entered their hearts. So Allah revealed the verse, "Indeed, intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone alters [to other than Allah], and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it that you may be successful." (Quran 5:90) until His saying, "So will you not desist?" (Quran 5:91). Some people, known as the "mukallifeen", said that it is impure and it exists in the stomach of so-and-so who was killed in the Battle of Badr, and so-and-so who was killed in the Battle of Uhud. So Allah revealed the verse, "There is not upon those who believe and do righteousness [any] blame concerning what they have eaten." (Quran 5:93) until it reached, "And Allah loves the doers of good." (Quran 3:134) on the condition of a Muslim.
hi: Sharab ki hurmat Ansar ke do qabilon ke baare mein nazil hui. Unhone pi yahan tak ke nashe mein aa gaye aur ek doosre se chherchhar karne lage. Jab hosh aaya to har ek apne chehre, sar aur dadhi par nishaan dekhta aur kehta: Yeh mere saath mere falan bhai ne kiya hai. Allah ki qasam! agar woh mujh par mehrbaan aur raheem hota to mere saath yeh na karta. Kaha: Woh aapas mein bhai the, un ke dilon mein koi keena nahi tha, magar ab un ke dilon mein keene paida ho gaye. To Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: 'Sharab aur jua...' (Al-Ma'idah 90) se le kar 'to kya tum baaz aane wale ho?' (Al-Ma'idah 91) tak. Phir kuch takalluf karne walon ne kaha: Woh to napaak hai, aur woh falan ke pet mein hai jo Badr ke din shaheed hua, aur falan ke pet mein jo Uhud ke din shaheed hua. To Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: 'Jo log imaan laye aur nek amal kiye un par us cheez mein koi gunah nahi jo unhone khayi...' (Al-Ma'idah 93) yahan tak ke 'aur Allah neki karne walon se mohabbat karta hai' (Aal-e-Imran 134) tak pahunch gaya. Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] A man from the Ansar invited us before the prohibition of alcohol. Abdur-Rahman ibn Awf led us in Maghrib prayer and recited Surah Al-Kafirun. He made a mistake in his recitation and instead of saying "Qul ya ayyuhal kafirun", he said "Qul ya ayyuhal mushrikun". This confused him, so the verse was revealed: "Do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated." [Al-Nisa 43]
hi: Ansar ke ek aadmi ne sharab haram hone se pehle humein dawat di. Abd Ar-Rahman bin Awf (RA) aage badhe aur unhein Maghrib padhai to 'Qul ya ayyuhal kafirun' padhi aur usmein ulajh gaye. Is par nazil hua: 'Namaz ke qareeb na jao jabke tum nashe mein ho' (An-Nisa 43).

e: [AI] "He (Referring to Abdul Rahman bin Auf) and another man were drinking alcohol, so Abdul Rahman prayed among them and recited 'Say: O disbelievers' (Surah Al-Kafirun). Then the verse 'Do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated' (Surah An-Nisa, 43) was revealed."
hi: Woh khud, Abd Ar-Rahman (RA) aur ek aur aadmi sharab pi rahe the. Abd Ar-Rahman bin Awf (RA) ne unhein namaz padhai to 'Qul ya ayyuhal kafirun' padhi aur usmein ghalti kar gaye. Is par nazil hua: 'Namaz ke qareeb na jao jabke tum nashe mein ho' (An-Nisa 43).

e: [AI] He called some of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  among them Ali ibn Abi Talib, and he recited the verse: "Say, O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship" [Al-Kafirun: 2] and we worship what you worship. So Allah revealed: "O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying" [An-Nisa: 43]. "All of these chains (of narration) are authentic and the ruling is based on the hadith of Sufyan Ath-Thawri, for he is the most reliable narrator among everyone who narrated it from Ata' ibn As-Sa'ib."
hi: Phir unhone Nabi (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ko bulaya, jin mein Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) bhi the. (Imam ne namaz mein) padha: 'Kaho: Ay kafiro! Main un ki ibadat nahi karta jin ki tum karte ho' (Al-Kafirun 2) aur (galti se kaha) 'aur hum us ki ibadat karne wale hain jis ki tum ne ibadat ki.' To Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: 'Ay imaan walo! namaz ke qareeb na jao jabke tum nashe mein ho, yahan tak ke tum jaan lo ke kya keh rahe ho' (An-Nisa 43). 'Yeh tamam asaneed sahih hain, aur faisla Sufyan Ath-Thawri ki hadees ke mutabiq hai, kyunke woh Ata bin As-Sa'ib se riwayat karne walon mein sab se zyada hafiz hain.'

e: [AI] The caller of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  used to say when he stood up for prayer: "Do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated." [Surah An-Nisa 43]
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ka munadi jab namaz ke liye khada hota to kehta: 'Namaz ke qareeb na jao jabke tum nashe mein ho' (An-Nisa 43).

e: [AI] "O Allah, make it clear to us about alcohol, so the verse was revealed: 'O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying' (Quran 4:43) until the end of the verse. The Prophet ﷺ called upon Umar and recited it to him as if he had not heard it before. Then he said, 'O Allah, make it clear to us about alcohol', so the verse was revealed: 'They ask you about wine and gambling. Say, 'In them is great sin and [yet, some] benefit for people. But their sin is greater than their benefit'' (Quran 2:219). The Prophet ﷺ called upon Umar and recited it to him as if he had not heard it before. Then he said, 'O Allah, make it clear to us about alcohol', so the verse was revealed: 'O you who have believed, indeed, intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone altars [to other than Allah], and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it' (Quran 5:90) until 'Are you then desisting?' (Quran 5:91). Umar said, 'We have desisted, O Lord.'"
hi: Umar (RA) ne dua ki: Ay Allah! humare liye sharab ke baare mein saaf bayan farma de. To nazil hua: 'Ay imaan walo! namaz ke qareeb na jao jabke tum nashe mein ho, yahan tak ke tum jaan lo ke kya keh rahe ho' (An-Nisa 43), aayat ke aakhir tak. 'Nabi (SAW) ne Umar (RA) ko bulaya aur unhein woh aayat sunayi.' Goya yeh us ke mutabiq na thi jo Umar (RA) chahte the, to unhone phir kaha: Ay Allah! humare liye sharab ke baare mein saaf bayan farma de. To nazil hua: 'Woh tum se sharab aur jue ke baare mein poochte hain, kaho: in dono mein bada gunah hai aur logon ke liye kuch faide bhi, aur in ka gunah in ke faide se bada hai' (Al-Baqarah 219). 'Nabi (SAW) ne Umar (RA) ko bulaya aur unhein woh aayat sunayi.' Goya yeh bhi us ke mutabiq na thi jo Umar (RA) chahte the, to unhone phir kaha: Ay Allah! humare liye sharab ke baare mein saaf bayan farma de. To nazil hua: 'Ay imaan walo! sharab, jua, but aur paanse napaak hain, Shaitan ke kaam se hain, to in se bacho' (Al-Ma'idah 90) yahan tak ke 'to kya tum baaz aane wale ho?' (Al-Ma'idah 91) tak pahunche. 'Nabi (SAW) ne Umar (RA) ko bulaya aur unhein woh aayat sunayi.' To Umar (RA) ne kaha: Ay humare Rab! hum baaz aa gaye.

e: "They (the Companions) said: 'O Messenger of Allah, how do you hold those who died while they were drinking Khamr - considering that the prohibition of intoxicants is now revealed?' So, (the following) Ayah was revealed: "Those who believe and do righteous good deeds, there is no sin on them for what they ate (in the past), if they fear Allah and believe and do righteous good deeds." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 3052)
hi: Jab sharab ki hurmat nazil hui to logon ne arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! humare un bhaiyon ka kya hoga jo is haal mein mar gaye ke woh sharab pite the? Kaha: To nazil hua: 'Jo log imaan laye aur nek amal kiye un par us cheez mein koi gunah nahi jo unhone khayi...' (Al-Ma'idah 93), aayat (aakhir tak).

e: [AI] The Jews said, "Are not your brothers who have died, those who used to drink it?" So Allah revealed, {There is no blame upon those who believe and do righteous deeds for what they have eaten} [Al-Maidah: 93]. So the Prophet ﷺ  said, "It was said to me that you are one of them."
hi: Yahudiyon ne kaha: Kya tumhare woh bhai jo mar gaye sharab nahi piya karte the? To Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya: 'Jo log imaan laye aur nek amal kiye un par us cheez mein koi gunah nahi jo unhone khayi...' (Al-Ma'idah 93). Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mujh se kaha gaya: Aap unhi mein se hain.'

e: [AI] When the prohibition of alcohol was revealed, some companions of the Prophet ﷺ walked to each other and said, "Alcohol has been prohibited and it has been made unlawful for partnership."
hi: Jab sharab ki hurmat nazil hui to Nabi (SAW) ke sahaba ek doosre ke paas gaye aur kaha: Sharab haram kar di gayi aur use shirk ke barabar kar diya gaya.

e: [AI] "He had an uncle who used to sell alcohol, but he would give the proceeds in charity. I forbade him from doing so, but he did not stop. So, I went to the city and met Ibn Abbas and asked him about alcohol and its price. He said, 'It is forbidden, and its price is also forbidden.' Then he said, 'O people of Muhammad's nation, if there was a book after your book or a prophet after your prophet, there would have been revelations sent to you, just as it was sent to those before you. But this matter has been postponed from your affairs until the Day of Judgment, and I swear by Allah, it is more difficult for you.'" (Sahih Bukhari)
hi: Un ka ek chacha tha jo sharab bechta tha aur uski qeemat sadaqa kar deta tha. Maine use mana kiya to woh baaz na aaya. Phir main Madina aaya aur Ibn Abbas (RA) se mila, un se sharab aur uski qeemat ke baare mein poocha. Unhone farmaya: 'Woh haram hai aur uski qeemat bhi haram hai.' Phir kaha: 'Ay Muhammad (SAW) ki ummat walo! Agar tumhari kitab ke baad koi kitab ya tumhare Nabi ke baad koi Nabi hota to tum mein bhi woh nazil hota jaisa tum se pehle walon mein nazil hua; magar yeh maamla tumhare liye qayamat tak mu'akhkhar kar diya gaya, aur meri jaan ki qasam! woh tumhare liye zyada sakht hai.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] "He (Abdullah ibn Abbas) heard him (the Prophet Muhammad) saying: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said that Jibril came to him and said, 'O Muhammad, indeed Allah has cursed alcohol and the one who drinks it, serves it, squeezes it (juice from grapes), carries it, the one to whom it is carried, sells it, buys it, offers it to others, and the one to whom it is offered.'"
hi: Unhone Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) ko farmate suna ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas Jibreel (AS) aaye aur kaha: Ay Muhammad! Allah ne sharab par lanat ki hai, aur use nichodne wale par, jis ke liye nichodi jaye us par, use uthane wale par, jis ke paas uthai jaye us par, use pine wale par, use bechne wale par, use kharidne wale par, use pilane wale par aur jise pilayi jaye us par.

e: “Whoever drinks wine in this world, he will not drink it in the Hereafter.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3374)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne dunya mein sharab pi, woh akhirat mein use nahi piyega.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Avoid alcohol, as it is the key to every evil." This hadith has an authentic chain of narration, and it has not been excluded from the authentic collections.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Sharab se bacho, kyunke woh har burai ki kunji hai.' Sanad sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala. Yeh sahih hai.

e:
[AI] The messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever drinks wine and becomes intoxicated by it, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days. If he drinks it again until he becomes intoxicated, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days. If he drinks it a third time until he becomes intoxicated, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days. If he drinks it a fourth time and becomes intoxicated, then it is rightful for Allah to make him drink from the pus of Hell."

It was asked, "What is the pus of Hell?" He ﷺ  said, "It is the discharge of the people of Hell."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne sharab pi aur nashe mein aa gaya, uski chalis din tak namaz qubool nahi hoti. Phir agar usne dobara pi aur nashe mein aa gaya to uski chalis din tak namaz qubool nahi hoti. Phir agar usne pi aur nashe mein aa gaya to chalis din tak uski namaz qubool nahi hoti. Phir agar usne chauthi baar pi aur nashe mein aa gaya to Allah par haq hai ke use Ainul Khabal se pilaye.' Poocha gaya: Ainul Khabal kya hai? Farmaya: 'Jahannam walon ka peep aur khoon.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever abandons the prayer while drunk once, it is as if he has lost this world and what is in it. Whoever abandons the prayer while drunk four times, it is the right of Allah the Almighty to make him drink the essence of Al-Khabal (a foul fluid). It was asked, 'What is the essence of Al-Khabal?' He ﷺ  said, 'It is the essence of the people of Hellfire.'"
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne ek baar nashe ki wajah se namaz chhodi, goya uski dunya aur jo kuch usmein hai woh us se cheen li gayi. Aur jis ne chaar baar nashe ki wajah se namaz chhodi, Allah Ta'ala par haq hai ke use Teenatul Khabal pilaye.' Poocha gaya: Teenatul Khabal kya hai? Farmaya: 'Jahannam walon ka nichoda hua (peep aur pasina).'

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  said: "There are three types of people who will not enter Paradise: the habitual drinker of alcohol, the one who cuts off ties of kinship, and the one who believes in magic. And whoever dies as a habitual drinker of alcohol, Allah will feed him from the river of Ghautah." It was asked, "What is the river of Ghautah?" He replied, "It is a river that flows from the private parts of the adulterers, causing harm to the people of Hellfire through the foul smell emitting from their private parts."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Teen log jannat mein daakhil nahi honge: sharab ka aadi, rishta tod ne wala, aur jadu ki tasdeeq karne wala. Aur jo sharab ka aadi hone ki halat mein mara, Allah use Nahr Al-Ghootah se pilayega.' Poocha gaya: Nahr Al-Ghootah kya hai? Farmaya: 'Ek nahar jo bad-kaar aurton ki sharmgahon se nikalti hai, jahannam walon ko un ki sharmgahon ki badbu se takleef hoti hai.'

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: There are three types of people whom Allah will not look at on the Day of Judgment: an disobedient child to their parents, a habitual drinker of alcohol, and someone who gives to others expecting something in return."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Teen log hain jin ki taraf Allah qayamat ke din nazar nahi farmayega: apne walidain ka nafarman, sharab ka aadi, aur diya hua ehsaan jatane wala.'

e: [AI] Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, Umar ibn Al-Khattab, and some of the companions of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, sat together after the death of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. They discussed the greatest sins, but they did not have knowledge about them. So, they sent me to Abdullah ibn Amr to ask him about it. He informed me that the greatest of sins is drinking alcohol. I went back to them and informed them, but they denied it and disputed with me until they went to Abdullah ibn Amr's house. I informed him about their denial, and he told them that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "There was a man from the Children of Israel who was given the choice to either drink alcohol, kill someone, commit adultery, eat pork, or be killed. If he refused, they would kill him. So, he chose to drink alcohol. After he drank it, he did not refrain from anything they wanted from him." The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, also said to us, "Anyone who drinks alcohol, Allah will not accept his prayer for forty nights, and if he dies within forty nights, he will die the way a pre-Islamic pagan dies."
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA), Umar bin Al-Khattab (RA) aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ke kuch sahaba Rasoolullah (SAW) ki wafat ke baad baithe aur sab se bade kabira gunah ka zikr kiya, to unke paas is baare mein koi aisa ilm nahi tha jis par woh pahunchte. Unhone mujhe Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ke paas bheja ke main un se poochun. Unhone mujhe bataya ke sab se bada kabira gunah sharab peena hai. Main unke paas aaya aur unhein bataya to unhone ise na mana aur sab ke sab uchhal kar unke ghar tak pahunch gaye. Unhone bataya ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Bani Isra'il ke badshahon mein se ek badshah ne ek aadmi ko pakda aur use ikhtiyar diya ke woh sharab piye, ya kisi jaan ko qatl kare, ya zina kare, ya khinzeer ka gosht khaye, warna use qatl kar diya jayega. Usne sharab peena chuna. Jab usne pi li to woh un ki chahi hui kisi cheez se na ruka.' Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein jawab dete hue farmaya: 'Jo koi ise piye to Allah chalis raat tak uski namaz qubool nahi karta, aur jo is haal mein mare ke uske mesane mein is mein se kuch ho, us par jannat haram kar di jati hai. Aur agar woh chalis raat ke andar mar gaya to jahiliyyat ki maut marega.'

e: [AI] Abu Muslim Al-Khawlanii performed Hajj and visited Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, who asked him about Sham (Syria) and its cold weather. He informed her about it, and she asked how they could endure such cold. He replied, "O Mother of the Believers, they drink a special drink called Al-Tala." She said, "May Allah be truthful and may my love for the Prophet ﷺ reach Him." I heard him say, "Some people from my Ummah drink alcohol without calling it by its proper name."
hi: Abu Muslim Al-Khawlani (RA) ne Hajj kiya aur Nabi (SAW) ki zawjah Ayesha (RA) ke paas gaye. Woh un se Sham aur wahan ki sardi ke baare mein poochne lagin aur woh batate rahe. Unhone poocha: Woh log sardi par kaise sabr karte hain? Unhone kaha: Ay Ummul Mu'mineen! woh apna ek mashroob pite hain jise Tala kehte hain. Unhone farmaya: Allah ne sach farmaya aur mere mehboob (SAW) ne pahuncha diya. Maine aap ko farmate suna: 'Meri ummat ke kuch log sharab piyenge aur use uske naam ke siwa doosre naam se pukarenge.'

e: [AI] About Maryam bint Tariq, a woman from her people said, "I was among a group of immigrant women who performed Hajj. We entered upon Aisha, the mother of the believers. She said, the women started asking her about certain matters. She said, 'O women, indeed you remember some matters that were numerous during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . So, fear Allah and avoid what intoxicates you, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Every intoxicant is prohibited, and if a large quantity of anything causes intoxication, a small amount of it is also prohibited.'"
hi: Maryam bint Tariq se, jo unki qaum ki ek aurat thi, wo kehti hain: Main muhajir aurton ki ek jamaat mein thi, humne Hajj kiya aur Ayesha (RA), Ummul Mu'mineen, ke paas gaye. Auratein un se bartanon ke baare mein poochne lagin. Unhone farmaya: Ay aurton ki jamaat! tum aise bartanon ka zikr karti ho jin mein se bahut se Rasoolullah (SAW) ke zamane mein nahi the. To Allah se daro aur us se bacho jo tumhein nashe mein daale, kyunke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Har nasha-aawar cheez haram hai, aur agar uske matke ka paani bhi nasha de to use chhod do.'

e: “From wheat comes wine, from barley comes wine, from raisins comes wine, from dates comes wine and from honey comes wine.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3379)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Gandum se bhi sharab banti hai, jau se bhi sharab banti hai, kishmish se bhi sharab banti hai, khajoor se bhi sharab banti hai, aur shahad se bhi sharab banti hai, aur main tumhein har nasha-aawar cheez se mana karta hun.'

e: "The drink most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the sweet, cool drink." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1895)
hi: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) ko sab se pasandida mashroob meetha thanda (paani/sharbat) tha.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The womb (kinship) is a branch from the Most Merciful, so whoever keeps connected to it, Allah keeps connected to him, and whoever cuts it off, Allah cuts him off." Sahih (authentic).
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Rehm (rishta) Ar-Rahman ki taraf se ek shakh hai; jo ise jode Allah use jodta hai, aur jo ise tode Allah use todta hai.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Allah the Exalted has said: I am Compassionate, and this has been derived from mercy. I have derived its name from My name. If anyone joins it, I shall join him, and if anyone cuts it off, I shall cut him off. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1694)
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Allah Azza wa Jall ne farmaya: 'Main Rahman hun aur yeh rehm hai, maine iske liye apne naam se naam nikala hai. To jo ise jode main use jodta hun, jo ise tode main use todta hun, aur jo ise bilkul kaat de main use kaat deta hun.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] He (the narrator) heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: "Allah the Exalted said: 'I am the Most Merciful. I have created the womb (i.e., the bond of kinship) and have derived its name from My Name. Whoever maintains ties of kinship, I maintain ties with him, and whoever severs ties of kinship, I sever ties with him.'" This is narrated by Abu Raddad Al-Laythi, with the addition of Sufyan bin 'Uyainah, Muhammad bin Abi 'Atiq, Shu'ayb bin Abi Hamzah, and Sufyan bin Husayn. It is an authentic narration.
hi: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Main Rahman hun, maine rehm ko paida kiya aur iske liye apne naam se naam nikala. To jo ise jode main use jodta hun, aur jo ise tode main use kaat deta hun.' 'Yeh Abu Raddad Al-Laythi hain, jinhon ne is mein Sufyan bin Uyaynah, Muhammad bin Abi Atiq, Shuayb bin Abi Hamzah aur Sufyan bin Husayn ka izafa kiya hai.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] Abu al-Raddad complained, then Abdullah bin Rahman came to him and said, "May the best of them and the closest to them be with you. I don't know Abu Muhammad." Abdullah bin Rahman then said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying that Allah the Exalted said, 'I am Allah and I am the Most Merciful. I created the womb and I derived its name from My own name. So whoever maintains ties with it, I will maintain ties with him, and whoever severs it, I will sever ties with him." (Sahih)
hi: Abu Ar-Raddad bimar hue to Abd Ar-Rahman unki ayadat ke liye aaye. Unhone kaha: Unmein sab se behtar aur rishta jodne mein sab se aage, jahan tak main jaanta hun, Abu Muhammad hain. Abd Ar-Rahman ne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Allah Azza wa Jall ne farmaya: 'Main Allah hun aur main Rahman hun, maine rehm ko paida kiya aur iske liye apne naam se naam nikala. To jo ise jode main use jodta hun, aur jo ise tode main use todta hun.' Yeh sahih hai.

e:
[AI] The translation of 7270 وَأَمَّا حَدِيثُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍصحيح into English is:

"And as for the narration of Muhammad ibn Abi 'Atiq, it is authentic."
hi: Aur Muhammad bin Abi Atiq ki hadees ke baare mein (yeh hai). Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] Narrator: It was narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said: 'I am Ar-Rahman (the Most Merciful). I have created the Rahim (womb) and I have derived its name from My Name. Whoever maintains ties with it, I shall maintain ties with him, and whoever severs it, I shall sever ties with him.'" [Saheeh Al-Bukhari]
hi: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Main Rahman hun, maine rehm ko paida kiya aur iske liye apne naam se naam nikala. To jo ise jode main use jodta hun, aur jo ise tode main use todta hun.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: Allah, the Most High, said: I am the Most Merciful; I have created ties of kinship and I have derived a name for it from My Name. So whoever maintains ties of kinship, I will maintain ties with him, and whoever severs ties of kinship, I will sever ties with him. "I returned to mentioning the companions, may Allah be pleased with all of them." Sahih
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Main Rahman hun, maine rehm ko paida kiya aur iske liye apne naam se ek shakh nikali. To jo ise jode main use jodta hun, aur jo ise tode main use todta hun.' 'Main sahaba (RA) ke zikr ki taraf laut aaya.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Kinship is a bond from Allah. Whoever desires for his bond from Allah to be fortified, then he should connect his kinship. And whoever desires for his bond to be severed, then he should sever his kinship.'" (Sahih)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Rehm Allah ki taraf se ek shakh hai.' Matlab Allah ke us naam se shakh jo Ar-Rahman hai. 'Jo ise jode Allah use jodta hai, aur jo ise tode Allah use todta hai.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] I heard Abdullah bin Amr say, The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Those who are merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on the earth and the One above the heavens will have mercy upon you."
hi: Maine Abdullah bin Amr (RA) ko Nabi (SAW) se marfu' bayan karte suna ke aap ne farmaya: 'Rehm karne walon par Allah rehm farmata hai. Zameen walon par rehm karo, aasman wale tum par rehm karenge. Rehm Ar-Rahman ki taraf se ek shakh hai; jo ise jode Allah use jodta hai, aur jo ise tode Allah use todta hai.'

e: [AI] I approached the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and he was inside a red dome, resembling the height of about forty men. He said, "Indeed, it is open for you, and you will be granted victory while afflicted. So whoever among you lives to see that, let them fear Allah and enjoin good and forbid evil and maintain good relations with their relatives. The example of those who help their people in falsehood is like that of a camel that is tied and continues to sway its tail."
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas pahuncha, aur aap surkh chamde ke ek khaime mein takreeban chalis aadmiyon ke saath the. Aap ne farmaya: 'Tumhare liye (mulk) fatah hoga, tumhari madad ki jayegi aur tum kaamyab hoge. To tum mein se jo us daur ko paaye woh Allah se darey, nekki ka hukm de, burai se roke aur apne rehm ko jode. Aur jo apni qaum ki na-haq par madad karta hai uski misal us oont ki si hai jo (kunwe mein) gir gaya ho aur apni dum se khinch raha ho.'

e: [AI] His father heard him saying, "O Messenger of Allah, advise me." He (the Prophet) said, "Establish prayer, pay zakat, fast in Ramadan, perform Hajj, perform Umrah, honor your parents, maintain family ties, be kind to guests, enjoin what is good, forbid what is evil, and be with the truth wherever it leads you." This hadith has a sound chain of narrators from the scholars of Yemen, and Ibn Mas'mud did not classify it as weak.
hi: Unhone apne walid ko kehte suna: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! mujhe wasiyat farmaiye. Aap ne farmaya: 'Namaz qayam karo, zakat ada karo, Ramazan ke roze rakho, Bait Allah ka Hajj aur Umrah karo, apne walidain ke saath husn-e-sulook karo, apne rehm ko jodo, mehman ki mehmannawazi karo, nekki ka hukm do, burai se roko, aur haq ke saath ghoomo jahan woh ghoome.' Sanad Yaman ke shuyukh ke lihaz se sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala. Ibn Mismul zaeef hai.

e: “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Al-Madinah, the people rushed towards him and it was said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has come!’ I came along with the people to see him, and when I looked at the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I realized that his face was not the face of a liar. The first thing he said was: “O people, spread (the greeting of) Salam, offer food to people and pray at night when people are sleeping, you will enter Paradise in peace.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1334)
hi: Jab Rasoolullah (SAW) tashreef laye to log aap ki taraf daud pade aur kaha gaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) aa gaye hain. Main bhi logon ke saath aap ko dekhne aaya. Jab maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ka chehra saaf dekha to jaan liya ke yeh chehra jhoote ka chehra nahi hai. Sab se pehli baat jo aap ne farmayi woh yeh thi: 'Ay logo! salam ko aam karo, khana khilao, rishte jodo, aur raat ko namaz padho jab log soye hue hon, tum salamati ke saath jannat mein daakhil ho jaoge.'

e: [AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, when I see you, my soul becomes content and my eyes become soothed. Inform me about everything." He said, "Everything was created from water." I said, "Inform me about an action that, if I do it, will make me enter paradise." He said, "Spread peace, feed the hungry, maintain family ties, pray at night while others are asleep, and enter paradise in peace."
hi: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! jab main aap ko dekhta hun to meri tabiyat khush ho jati hai aur meri aankhein thandi ho jati hain, to mujhe har cheez ke baare mein bataiye. Aap ne farmaya: 'Har cheez paani se paida ki gayi hai.' Maine arz kiya: Mujhe aisa amal bataiye jis par amal karun to jannat mein daakhil ho jaun. Aap ne farmaya: 'Salam ko aam karo, khana khilao, rishte jodo, aur raat ko namaz padho jab log soye hue hon, phir salamati ke saath jannat mein daakhil ho jao.'

e: [AI] Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , "It is written in the Torah, whoever wishes for his life to be long and his sustenance to increase, let him maintain good relations with his family."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Tauraat mein likha hai: jise yeh pasand ho ke uski umr lambi ho aur uske rizq mein izafa ho, woh apne rehm ko jode.'

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: *“Whoever would be pleased that Allah prolong his life, expand his provision for him, and ward off from him an evil death, let him fear Allah and maintain the ties of kinship.”*
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jise yeh pasand ho ke Allah uski umr daraaz kare, uske rizq mein wusat de aur us se buri maut door kare, woh Allah se darey aur apne rehm ko jode.'

e: Who will be pleased that their lifetime is extended and his ˹provisions˺ are increased, then he should ˹maintain good relations˺ with his relatives."[^1]
hi: Unhone farmaya: 'Jise yeh pasand ho ke uski ajal mein takheer ki jaye aur uske rizq mein wusat ki jaye, woh apne rehm ko jode.' Yeh mauquf hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah causes nations to flourish and increases their wealth for them. He has never looked at them with hatred since He created them." They asked, "How is that possible, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Through their ties of kinship."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah kuch qaumon ko lambi umr deta hai aur unke maal badha deta hai, halaanke jab se unhein paida kiya hai unki taraf bughz ki wajah se nazar nahi farmayi.' Logon ne arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! yeh kaise? Aap ne farmaya: 'Unke rehm jodne ki wajah se.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Know your lineage in order to maintain kinship. There is no closeness in a relationship when it is severed, even if it is close, and there is no distance to a relationship when it is maintained, even if it is far."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Apne nasab pehchano taake apne rehm jod sako, kyunke jab rehm kaat diya jaye to qurb ka koi faida nahi chahe woh qareeb ho, aur jab jod diya jaye to door hone se koi nuqsan nahi chahe woh door ho.'

e: "Learn enough about your lineage to facilitate keeping your ties of kinship. For indeed keeping the ties of kinship encourages affection among the relatives, increases the wealth, and increases the lifespan." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1979)
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Apne nasab mein se itna seekh lo jis se apne rehm jod sako, kyunke rehm jodna ahl-o-ayal mein mohabbat, maal mein izafa aur umr mein takheer (daraazi) ka sabab hai.'

e: [AI] I met the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so I greeted him and held his hand, and he held my hand. He said, "O 'Uqbah, shall I not inform you of the best qualities of the people of this world and the Hereafter? It is to maintain relations with those who cut you off, to give to those who deprive you, and to forgive those who wrong you. And whoever wishes to have a longer life and their provision expanded, then let them maintain their ties of kinship." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) se mila, maine pehal karke aap ka haath pakad liya aur aap ne bhi pehal karke mera haath pakad liya. Aap ne farmaya: 'Ay Uqbah! kya main tujhe dunya aur akhirat walon ke sab se behtar akhlaq na bataun? Jo tujh se kate tu us se jode, jo tujhe mehroom kare tu use de, aur jo tujh par zulm kare tu use maaf kar de. Aur jo yeh chahe ke uski umr daraaz ho aur uske rizq mein wusat ho, woh apne rehm waale se jude.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e:
[AI] I heard the Prophet ﷺ  saying, "Indeed, when Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, finished creating, the womb stood up and took hold of the Most Merciful. It said, 'O Allah! Is this the place for the one who seeks refuge with You from severing blood ties?' Allah said, 'Yes, would you be pleased that I connect those who maintain ties with you and cut off those who sever them?'"
(Recite, if you wish): "Then do you hope that they will believe in you, while a party of them used to hear the words of Allah and then distort the Torah after they had understood it while they were knowing?" (Quran 2:75) until His saying, "Do they not then ponder over the Quran? Or are there locks upon their hearts?" (Quran 47:24) and so on.
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jab Allah Azza wa Jall makhlooq ko paida karne se farigh hua to rehm khadi hui aur Ar-Rahman ka kamar-band pakad liya. Allah ne farmaya: Ruk! Usne kaha: Yeh us ki jagah hai jo tujh se qata'-rehmi se panah maangta hai. Allah ne farmaya: Kya tu is par razi nahi ke main use jodun jo tujhe jode aur use kaat dun jo tujhe kaate?' Phir farmaya: 'Agar chaho to padho: To kya tum se yeh door hai ke agar tum hukmran ban jao to zameen mein fasad machao aur apne rehm kaato?' (Muhammad 22) se le kar 'to kya woh Qur'an mein ghaur nahi karte?' (An-Nisa 82) tak, wagairah.

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: 'Indeed, the womb (family ties) is a branch from the Most Merciful. It says, 'O Lord, I have been cut off, I have been treated badly.' O Lord, her Lord responds to her saying, 'Are you not pleased that I connect with those who connect with you and cut off from those who cut you off?'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Rehm Ar-Rahman ki taraf se ek shakh hai. Woh kehta hai: Ay mere Rab! mujhe kaata gaya, mere saath bura sulook kiya gaya, Ay mere Rab! Uska Rab use jawab deta hai aur farmata hai: Kya tu is par razi nahi ke main use jodun jo tujhe jode aur use kaat dun jo tujhe kaate?'

e: [AI] On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ who said, "The womb (kinship) will come on the Day of Judgment with the appearance of a spinning wheel, speaking with a smooth, articulate tongue, saying: 'Connect those who have kept ties with you and sever those who cut off ties with you.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Qayamat ke din rehm aayega, uska ek tedha hissa charkhe ki ghirri ke tedhe hisse ki tarah hoga, woh sahih aur fasih zubaan se bolega, to jo use jode woh use jodega aur jo use tode woh use kaat dega.'

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "There is no sin more deserving for God to inflict punishment upon its perpetrator in this life and in the hereafter than oppression and severing ties of kinship." This hadith was narrated by Shu'bah from 'Uyaynah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Koi gunah is se zyada laayq nahi ke Allah gunahgar ko dunya mein hi saza de, us ke saath jo uske liye akhirat mein jama kar rakhta hai, siwa zulm (baghi) aur rehm kaatne ke.' Ise Shu'bah ne Uyaynah bin Abd Ar-Rahman se bhi riwayat kiya hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: There is no sin more fitted to have punishment meted out by Allah to its perpetrator in advance in this world along with what He stores up for him in the next world than oppression and severing ties of relationship. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4902)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Koi gunah aisa nahi jo is se zyada laayq aur munasib ho ke Allah Ta'ala gunahgar ko dunya mein hi saza de, us ke saath jo uske liye akhirat mein jama kar rakhta hai, siwa rehm kaatne aur zulm ke.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Migration is not permissible for more than three days. If they meet, then one of them should greet the other with peace. If the other refuses to return the greeting, he is free from sin and the other incurs it. I consider, he said, that if they both die while they are migrants, they will not be reunited in Paradise."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Teen din se zyada aapas mein judai rakhna halal nahi. Agar dono mile aur ek ne doosre ko salam kiya aur doosre ne salam ka jawab de diya to dono ajar mein sharik hain, aur agar doosre ne salam ka jawab dene se inkar kiya to pehla gunah se bari ho gaya aur gunah usi doosre par laut aaya.' Raavi kehta hai: Mera khayal hai aap ne yeh bhi farmaya: 'Aur agar woh dono is haal mein mar gaye ke ek doosre se judai rakhte the to jannat mein jama nahi honge.'

e: AbuKhirash heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: If one keeps apart from his brother for a year, it is like shedding his blood. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4915)
hi: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jis ne apne bhai se ek saal tak judai rakhi, woh goya uska khoon bahane ke barabar hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Who is your master, O Banu 'Ubayd?" They said, "Al-Jadd ibn Qays, because he is stingy." He responded, "What disease is worse than stinginess? Rather, your master and the son of your master is Bashir ibn Al-Baraa ibn Ma'rur." This hadith is authentic according to the criteria of Muslim and it has not been rejected. Sa'id ibn Muhammad, known as Al-Warraq, is trustworthy and reliable. We have recorded it from the hadith of 'Amr ibn Dinar, narrated from Abu Salamah.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ay Bani Ubayd! tumhara sardar kaun hai?' Unhone kaha: Al-Jadd bin Qays, magar usmein bukhl hai. Aap ne farmaya: 'Aur bukhl se badh kar kaun si bimari chhootdar hai? Balke tumhara sardar aur tumhare sardar ka beta Bishr bin Al-Bara bin Ma'rur hai.' Yeh hadees Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala. Said bin Muhammad, jo Al-Warraq hain, thiqah aur ma'mun hain, aur humne ise Amr bin Dinar ki hadees se bhi Abu Salamah se likha hai.

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wearing a coarse garment. Then a woman came to him and I was a young boy at that time. When she approached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he extended his garment to her and she sat on it. I asked, 'Who is this?' They said, 'This is his mother who breastfed him.' This hadith is authentic in chain of narration and it has not been excluded." (Al-Dhahabi omitted it from his summary).
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Ji'ranah mein dekha. Ek aurat aap ke paas aayi, aur main un dinon ek ladka tha. Jab woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ke qareeb pahunchi to aap ne apni chadar uske liye bichha di aur woh us par baith gayi. Maine poocha: Yeh kaun hain? Logon ne kaha: Yeh unki woh maan hain jinhon ne unhein doodh pilaya. Is hadees ki sanad sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala. Adh-Dhahabi ne ise Talkhees se hazf kar diya.

e: "The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1944)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ke nazdeek behtareen saathi woh hai jo apne saathi ke liye sab se behtar ho, aur Allah ke nazdeek behtareen padosi woh hai jo apne padosi ke liye sab se behtar ho.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest. His reward is one day and one night, and his hospitality lasts for three days and what comes after that is charity. It is not permissible for him to keep his guest with him until he forces him out." Zad ibn Wahb added in his narration, "And his reward is to serve him with the best of what he has." And Yahawi said, "Let the guest stay with him."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo Allah aur aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta hai woh apne mehman ki izzat kare. Uska jaa'izah (khaas khatir) ek din aur ek raat hai, aur mehmani teen din hai, aur uske baad sadaqa hai. Aur mehman ke liye halal nahi ke itna thehre ke mezban ko tang kar de.' Ibn Wahb ne apni hadees mein izafa kiya: 'Aur uska jaa'izah yeh hai ke ek din mein jo behtareen cheez paaye use pesh kare.' Aur kaha: 'yathwi' ka matlab hai uske paas thehre.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, should honor his neighbor." And he mentioned the hadith until its end.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo Allah aur aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta hai woh apne padosi ki izzat kare.' Aur unhone hadees ko aakhir tak zikr kiya.

e: [AI] "He heard Abu Shuraih saying that he heard it with his own ears, saw it with his own eyes, and felt it in his heart when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  spoke about it. He then mentioned a similar Hadith to the Hadith of Malik, regardless of whether the two sheikhs disagreed or neither of them made use of Abdullah ibn Ishaq."
hi: Unhone Abu Shuraih (RA) ko kehte suna: Is ko mere kaanon ne suna, meri aankhon ne dekha aur mere dil ne yaad rakha jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne yeh farmaya. Phir unhone hadees ko bilkul Malik ki hadees ki tarah zikr kiya. 'Rahe dono shaykh (Bukhari aur Muslim), to un mein se kisi ne bhi Abd Ar-Rahman bin Ishaq se hujjat nahi pakdi.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "By Allah, he does not believe, by Allah, he does not believe, by Allah, he does not believe." They asked, "And what is that, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "A neighbor does not feel safe from the harms of his neighbor." They asked, "And what are his harms, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "His evil actions."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ki qasam! woh momin nahi, Allah ki qasam! woh momin nahi, Allah ki qasam! woh momin nahi.' Sahaba ne arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! woh kaun? Aap ne farmaya: 'Woh padosi jis ke padosi uski sharaaraton se mehfooz na hon.' Unhone arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! uski sharaaraten kya hain? Aap ne farmaya: 'Uska shar (burai).'

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "One who does not feel secure from his neighbor's harms is not a true believer." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Woh momin nahi jis ke padosi uske makr-o-fareb se mehfooz na hon.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah has divided between you your characters just as he has divided between you your provisions. Allah gives wealth to the one He loves and to the one whom He does not love, but He does not give faith except to the one He loves. And whomever Allah gives faith to then He indeed loves him. I swear by the One who has the soul of Muḥammad in his Hand, a servant does not have Islam until his heart is in submission, and a servant does not have Islam until his neighbor is safe from his wickedness."[^1]
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ne tumhare darmiyan tumhare akhlaq isi tarah taqseem kiye hain jis tarah tumhare rizq taqseem kiye hain. Allah maal use bhi deta hai jise woh pasand karta hai aur use bhi jise pasand nahi karta, magar imaan sirf use deta hai jise pasand karta hai. To jise Allah ne imaan diya, usne use mehboob rakha. Us zaat ki qasam jis ke haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai! koi banda musalman nahi hota jab tak uska dil musalman na ho jaye, aur koi banda musalman nahi hota jab tak uska padosi uski sharaaraton se mehfooz na ho.'

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ  and complained to him about his neighbor. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, my neighbor harms me." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Take out your belongings and place them on the road." So the man took out his belongings and placed them on the road. Every person who passed by asked him, "What's your problem?" He replied, "I complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about my neighbor, and he ordered me to take out my belongings and place them on the road." They started saying, "May Allah curse him, O Allah disgrace him." The man heard this and came back to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, "Please take back your order, I will never be harmed by him again, by Allah."
hi: Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur apne padosi ki shikayat ki. Usne arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! mera padosi mujhe takleef deta hai. Aap ne farmaya: 'Apna saman nikaal kar raste par rakh de.' Usne apna saman nikaal kar raste par rakh diya. Jo bhi guzarta woh poochta: Tumhein kya hua? Woh kehta: Maine apne padosi ki Rasoolullah (SAW) se shikayat ki to aap ne mujhe hukm diya ke apna saman raste par rakh dun. To log kehne lage: Ay Allah! is par lanat kar, Ay Allah! ise ruswa kar. Yeh baat us padosi tak pahunchi to woh uske paas aaya aur kaha: Wapas chalo, Allah ki qasam! main tumhein kabhi takleef nahi dunga.

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ complaining about his neighbor. The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Put your belongings in the street." The man did as he was told, and people passing by cursed him. He returned to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have faced nothing but curses from the people." The Prophet ﷺ asked him, "And what did you find among them?" The man replied, "They cursed me." The Prophet ﷺ said, "If Allah has cursed you before the people, then there is no hope for you." The man said, "O Messenger of Allah, I cannot bear it anymore." Then the person who had complained to the Prophet ﷺ came back, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him, "You have either secured peace or cursed." This narration is according to the condition of being authentic in Sahih Muslim.
hi: Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas apne padosi ki shikayat lekar aaya. Nabi (SAW) ne us se farmaya: 'Apna saman raste mein daal de.' Log uske paas se guzarte aur us par lanat karte. Woh Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! mujhe logon se kya kuch jhelna pada. Aap ne farmaya: 'Tujhe unse kya mila?' Usne kaha: Woh mujh par lanat karte hain. Aap ne farmaya: 'Allah ne logon se pehle tujh par lanat kar di hai.' Usne arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! main dobara aisa nahi karunga. Phir shikayat karne wala Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya to Nabi (SAW) ne us se farmaya: 'Tu mehfooz ho gaya, ya (kaha) tujh par lanat ki gayi.' Yeh Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] "I heard Abu Huraira saying, it was said to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, that so and so prays at night, fasts during the day, but she speaks harshly towards her neighbors, causing harm. He said, 'There is no good in her, she is in the Fire.' It was also said to him that so and so performs the obligatory prayers, fasts during Ramadan, and gives charity, and she does not harm anyone else. He said, 'She is in Paradise.'"
hi: Maine Abu Hurayrah (RA) ko kehte suna: Rasoolullah (SAW) se kaha gaya: Falan aurat raat ko namaz padhti hai aur din ko roza rakhti hai, magar uski zubaan mein kuch hai jo padosiyon ko takleef deta hai, woh tez zubaan hai. Aap ne farmaya: 'Us mein koi bhalai nahi, woh jahannam mein hai.' Aur aap se kaha gaya: Falan aurat farz namaz padhti hai, Ramazan ke roze rakhti hai aur panir ke tukdon ka sadaqa karti hai, uske paas isi ke siwa kuch nahi aur woh kisi ko takleef nahi deti. Aap ne farmaya: 'Woh jannat mein hai.'

e: [AI] On the authority of Abu Yahya, the slave of Ja'dah bint Hubayrah, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: It was said to the Prophet ﷺ : Indeed, so-and-so fasts during the day and stands in night prayer, but she harms her neighbors with her tongue. He ﷺ  said: "There is no good in her; she is in the Fire." It was then said: But so-and-so performs the obligatory prayers, fasts in Ramadan, and gives charity from lawful earnings, and she does not harm anyone with her tongue. He ﷺ  said: "She is in Paradise."
hi: Abu Yahya se, jo Ja'dah bint Hubayrah ke aazad-kardah ghulam hain, Abu Hurayrah (RA) se, unhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) se kaha gaya: Falan aurat din ko roza rakhti hai aur raat ko qiyam karti hai aur apni zubaan se padosiyon ko takleef deti hai. Aap ne farmaya: 'Us mein koi bhalai nahi, woh jahannam mein hai.' Kaha gaya: Falan aurat farz namaz padhti hai, Ramazan ke roze rakhti hai aur panir (aqit) ke tukdon ka sadaqa karti hai aur apni zubaan se kisi ko takleef nahi deti. Aap ne farmaya: 'Woh jannat mein hai.'
