e: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is part of a person’s happiness to have a righteous neighbor, a comfortable mount, and a spacious dwelling." (Using translation from Aḥmad 15372)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Musalman aadmi ki dunya mein khushnasibi mein se nek padosi, kushada ghar aur aaraam-deh sawari hai.'

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "The believer is not the one who sleeps while his neighbor is hungry."
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Woh momin nahi jo is haal mein raat guzaare ke uska padosi uske pehlu mein bhooka ho.'

e: [AI] If I command for you, it will be cold for you, and I am the one who feels the heat (hot). And around me are the people of the city who have been killed by hunger. And I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "A man will not be satisfied until his neighbor is." Good reference.
hi: ...ke main hukm doon aur tumhare liye thanda ho aur mere liye garam, jabke mere irdgird Madina ke log hain jinhein bhook ne maar daala hai, aur maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna hai: 'Aadmi apne padosi ko chhod kar pet nahi bhare.' Iski sanad achhi (jayyid) hai.

e: [AI] I asked the Messenger of Allah, "I have two neighbors, with whom should I begin?" He said, "With the one whose door is closest to yours." This is narrated by Ja'far bin Sulaiman from Abu Imran Al-Jawni, and the authentic narration is from Shu'bah from Abu Imran Al-Jawni from Talhah bin Abdullah, a man from the tribe of Taym Allah, from Aisha. She said, "I asked the Messenger of Allah, 'I have two neighbors, to whom should I send a gift?' He said, 'Send it to the one whose door is closest to yours.'"
hi: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! mere do padosi hain, main kis se shuru karun? Aap ne farmaya: 'Jo darwaze mein tumse zyada qareeb ho.' Isi tarah isey Ja'far bin Sulayman se, unhone Abu Imran Al-Jawni se riwayat kiya hai, aur sahih Shu'bah ki riwayat hai, Abu Imran Al-Jawni se, Talhah bin Abdullah se, jo Bani Taym Allah ke ek aadmi hain, Ayesha (RA) se, unhone kaha: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! mere do padosi hain, main inmein se kis ko hadiya dun? Aap ne farmaya: 'Jo darwaze mein tumse zyada qareeb ho.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "You will not have faith until you love one another. Shall I not guide you to something that if you do it, you will love one another? Spread peace amongst yourselves." They said, "Indeed, O Messenger of Allah.” He said, "Extend greetings of peace amongst yourselves, for by the One in whose hand is my soul, you will not enter Jannah (Paradise) until you have mercy upon each other." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, we are all merciful." He said, "It is not the mercy of any one of you, but the general mercy."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum imaan nahi laoge jab tak aapas mein mohabbat na karo. Kya main tumhein woh cheez na bataun jis se tum aapas mein mohabbat karne lago?' Sahaba ne arz kiya: Zaroor, Ya Rasoolullah! Aap ne farmaya: 'Aapas mein salam ko aam karo, tum mohabbat karne lagoge. Us zaat ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai! tum jannat mein daakhil nahi hoge jab tak aapas mein rehm na karo.' Unhone arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! hum sab raheem hain. Aap ne farmaya: 'Yeh tum mein se kisi ek ka khaas rehm nahi, balki aam logon ka rehm hai, aam logon ka rehm.'

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "A disease of nations will afflict my Ummah." They asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what is the disease of nations?" He replied, "Sin and defiance, rivalry, seeking worldly gains, mutual enmity, hatred, and jealousy, until there is oppression."
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Meri ummat ko pichhli ummaton ki bimari lagegi.' Sahaba ne arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! pichhli ummaton ki bimari kya hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Itraana, akad, maal ki kasrat ki hod, dunya mein ek doosre ko dhoka dena (tanajush), aapas mein bughz aur hasad, yahan tak ke zulm hone lage.'

e: from the Prophet ﷺ that he said, "Whoever ˹would˺ love", and Hāshim said, “Whoever is pleased that he would taste the flavor of faith, let him love a person only for the sake of Allah Almighty.” (Using translation from Aḥmad 7967)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jise yeh pasand ho ke imaan ka maza chakhe, woh aise shakhs se mohabbat kare jis se woh sirf Allah Azza wa Jall ke liye mohabbat karta ho.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "O Yazid bin Asad, do you love Paradise?" I said, "Yes." He said, "Then love for your Muslim brother what you love for yourself."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ay Yazid bin Asad! kya tum jannat se mohabbat karte ho?' Maine kaha: Ji haan. Aap ne farmaya: 'To apne musalman bhai ke liye wahi pasand karo jo apne liye pasand karte ho.'

e: [AI] I entered the mosque of Damascus and found a young man with a radiant face surrounded by people. Whenever they disagreed on something, they would turn to him and accept his opinion. So, I asked about him and was told, "This is Muadh ibn Jabal." The next day, I migrated and found him praying. I waited for him to finish his prayer, then I approached him from the front, greeted him, and said, "By Allah, I love you for the sake of Allah." He asked, "For Allah?" I replied, "For Allah." Then he repeated, "For Allah?" I said, "For Allah." He then took hold of my collar and pulled me closer, saying, "Be glad, for I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, 'Allah, the Almighty, has declared that My Love is obligatory for those who love each other for My sake, those who sit together for My sake, those who exchange gifts for My sake, and those who visit each other for My sake.'"
hi: Main Dimashq ki masjid mein gaya to wahan ek jawan tha jis ke daant chamak rahe the, aur log uske saath the; jab kisi baat mein ikhtilaf karte to uski taraf ruju karte aur uski raay par hi lautte. Maine us ke baare mein poocha to kaha gaya: Yeh Mu'adh bin Jabal (RA) hain. Agle din main subah sawere gaya to dekha ke woh mujh se pehle aa chuke hain aur namaz padh rahe hain. Maine intizar kiya yahan tak ke unhone namaz poori ki, phir main unke saamne se aaya, salam kiya aur kaha: Allah ki qasam! main aap se Allah ke liye mohabbat karta hun. Unhone kaha: Allah ke liye? Maine kaha: Allah ke liye. Unhone kaha: Allah ke liye? Maine kaha: Allah ke liye. Phir unhone meri chadar ka kinara pakda aur mujhe apni taraf khincha aur kaha: Khushkhabri ho! Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: Allah Azza wa Jall ne farmaya: 'Meri mohabbat un logon ke liye wajib ho gayi jo mere liye aapas mein mohabbat karte hain, mere liye ek saath baithte hain, mere liye kharch karte hain aur mere liye ek doosre se milne jaate hain.'

e: [AI] A man passed by, so I approached him and said, "Indeed, this person informed me of a narration from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Have you heard it?" He replied, "He only informed you of the truth." So I informed him, and he said, "I have indeed heard this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, regarding those who love each other for the sake of Allah, then Allah will shade them with His shade on the Day when there is no shade except His shade. And nothing is better than it." I asked, "May Allah have mercy on you, what is better than it?" He said, "I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'My love is worthy for those who love each other for my sake, and my love is worthy for those who frequently visit each other for my sake, and my love is worthy for those who give generously to each other for my sake.' And I do not know with which of them He began." I asked, "Who are you, may Allah have mercy on you?" He said, "I am 'Ubada ibn As-Samit'. And this is a authentic chain of narration according to the criteria of the two Shaykhs (Al-Bukhari and Muslim) and they did not exclude it." Adh-Dhahabi refrained from discussing it in his summary.
hi: Ek aadmi guzra to main uske paas khada hua aur kaha: Is (aadmi) ne mujhe Rasoolullah (SAW) ki hadees sunayi hai, kya aap ne bhi suni hai? Yani Mu'adh (RA) se. Unhone kaha: Woh tumhein sach hi sunate the. Maine unhein bataya to unhone kaha: Maine yeh Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna hai, yani Allah ke liye aapas mein mohabbat karne walon ke baare mein ke Allah unhein apne arsh ke saaye mein saaya dega us din jab uske saaye ke siwa koi saaya na hoga, aur jo is se bhi afzal hai. Maine kaha: Haan, Allah aap par rehm kare, aur woh kya hai jo is se afzal hai? Unhone kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko Allah Azza wa Jall se riwayat karte suna, farmaya: 'Meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye aapas mein mohabbat karte hain, meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye aapas mein milte-julte hain, meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye ek doosre se milne jaate hain, aur meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye kharch karte hain.' Aur mujhe nahi maloom ke unhone in mein se kis se shuru kiya. Maine kaha: Allah aap par rehm kare, aap kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Main Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) hun. 'Yeh sanad dono shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar unhone ise nahi nikaala.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] He said, "In the shade of Allah on a day when there is no shade except His shade, and then he said, "In His remaining place, there is no doubt that they will be given chairs of light, and the prophets, the truthful ones, and the martyrs will envy them in their gatherings with their Lord, the Blessed and Exalted." I conveyed this to Ubada bin As-Samit and he said, "I do not narrate to you except what I heard from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, that he said, "My love for those who love each other is confirmed, as well as my love for those who spend on each other, my love for those who sincerely befriend each other, my love for those who visit each other, and my love for those who maintain contact with each other." Shu'bah expressed doubt regarding those who maintain contact and those who visit each other.
hi: Unhone farmaya: Allah ke saaye mein us din jab uske saaye ke siwa koi saaya na hoga, phir kaha (aur baqi mein koi shak nahi): 'Un ke liye noor ki kursiyan rakhi jayengi, un ki Rab Tabarak wa Ta'ala ke paas us majlis par ambiya, siddiqeen aur shuhada rashk karenge.' Kaha: Maine yeh Ubadah bin As-Samit (RA) ko sunayi to unhone kaha: Main tumhein wahi sunata hun jo maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ki zubaan se suna ke aap ne farmaya: 'Meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye aapas mein mohabbat karte hain, meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye kharch karte hain, meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye aapas mein sachchi dosti karte hain, meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye ek doosre se milne jaate hain, aur meri mohabbat un ke liye sabit ho gayi jo mere liye aapas mein rishta jodte hain.' Shu'bah ko 'mutawasilin' aur 'mutazawirin' mein shak hua.

e: [AI] I heard Abu Idris Al-Khawlani saying, "I entered the mosque of Hims and sat in a gathering where everyone was talking about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Among them was a young boy, and whenever he spoke, the people listened attentively, and when a man from them spoke, they also listened to him. Then they dispersed, and I did not know who that young boy was. Then he mentioned the Hadith in its entirety according to the conditions of Al-Bukhari and Muslim."
hi: Maine Abu Idris Al-Khawlani (RA) ko kehte suna: Main Hims ki masjid mein gaya aur ek halqe mein baith gaya, un sab ke sab Rasoolullah (SAW) se hadees bayan kar rahe the, un mein ek jawan ladka tha, jab woh bolta to log uski taraf khamoshi se kaan lagate, aur jab woh un mein se kisi se baat karta to woh bhi sunta. Phir woh bikhar gaye aur mujhe nahi maloom tha ke woh jawan kaun hai. Phir unhone poori hadees zikr ki. Yeh Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Verily, Allah has servants who are not prophets or martyrs, but the martyrs and prophets will envy them on the Day of Resurrection due to their closeness to Allah, the Exalted, and their positions with Him." Then, an Arab man kneeled down and asked, "O Messenger of Allah, describe them to us and make their situations clear to us." He replied, "They are people from different tribes who love and befriend one another solely for the sake of Allah. Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, will place pulpits of light for them on the Day of Resurrection, from which the people will be afraid but they will not fear. They are the allies of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, who have no fear upon them and will not grieve."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ke kuch bande hain jo na ambiya hain na shuhada, qayamat ke din shuhada aur ambiya Allah Ta'ala se un ke qurb aur us ke paas un ki majlis par rashk karenge.' Ek dehati ghutnon ke bal baith gaya aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! hamare liye un ki sifat aur hulia bayan farmaiye. Aap ne farmaya: 'Woh logon ke ajnabi, mukhtalif qabilon se aaye hue log hain, jinhon ne Allah ke liye aapas mein dosti ki aur uske liye aapas mein mohabbat ki; Allah Azza wa Jall qayamat ke din un ke liye noor ke manbar rakhega, log dar rahe honge aur woh nahi darenge. Yahi Allah ke auliya hain jin par na koi khauf hai na woh ghamgeen honge.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A person is upon the religion of his close friend, so let one of you look at who you befriend." And it has been narrated from Abu al-Hubab Sa'id ibn Yassar from Abu Hurairah.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aadmi apne gehre dost ke deen par hota hai, to tum mein se har ek dekh le ke kis se dosti karta hai.' Isey Abu Al-Hubab Sa'id bin Yasar ne Abu Hurayrah (RA) se bhi riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "A person follows the religion of his close friend, so let each one of you look at who he befriends." This is the authentic Hadith of Abu Al-Hubab, if Allah wills, and both narrators have not been criticized.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aadmi apne gehre dost ke deen par hota hai, to tum mein se har ek dekh le ke kis se dosti karta hai.' Abu Al-Hubab ki hadees insha'Allah Ta'ala sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala. Yeh insha'Allah sahih hai.

e: [AI] A man passed by the Prophet ﷺ and another man said, "I love him for the sake of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic." The Prophet ﷺ asked him, "Have you informed him of this?" The man replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Then inform him." So, I met the man and informed him, and he said, "May Allah love you as you have loved me for His sake."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas se ek aadmi guzra to ek aadmi ne kaha: Main isse Allah Azza wa Jall ke liye mohabbat karta hun. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Kya tum ne use bataya?' Usne kaha: Nahi. Aap ne farmaya: 'To use bata do.' Kaha: Maine us aadmi se mulaqat ki aur use bata diya to usne kaha: Tujh se woh (Allah) mohabbat kare jis ke liye tu ne mujh se mohabbat ki.

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "If one of you loves his brother, he should let him know."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se mohabbat kare to use bata de.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There is no two men who love each other for the sake of Allah, except that the one who loves his companion more will be considered better."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Do aadmi Allah Ta'ala ke liye aapas mein mohabbat nahi karte magar yeh ke un mein afzal woh hota hai jo apne saathi se zyada mohabbat karta hai.'

e: [AI] A woman came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am Fulanah bint Fulan." He said, "I have recognized you, so what is your need?" She said, "My need is for my cousin Fulan Al-Abid to propose to me." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I have already known him." She said, "He wants to marry me, so tell me the rights of the husband over the wife. If it is something I can handle, then I will marry him. But if it is something I cannot handle, then I will not marry." He said, "The right of the husband over the wife is that if he asks for her to lick his pus, blood, or pus-filled wound, then she should do so. If it were appropriate for a human being to prostrate to another human being, I would have commanded the wife to prostrate to her husband when he enters upon her, due to the preference Allah has given him over her." She said, "By the One who sent you with the truth, I will not marry as long as I live in this world."
hi: Ek aurat Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aayi aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! main falan ki beti falanah hun. Aap ne farmaya: 'Maine tumhein pehchan liya, tumhari kya zaroorat hai?' Usne kaha: Meri zaroorat yeh hai ke mera chacha zaad falan, jo abid hai... Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Maine use pehchan liya.' Usne kaha: Woh mujhe nikah ka paigham deta hai, to mujhe bataiye ke shauhar ka biwi par kya haq hai? Agar main uski taqat rakhti hui to uss se nikah kar lungi, aur agar na rakh saki to nikah nahi karungi. Aap ne farmaya: 'Shauhar ka biwi par haq yeh hai ke agar woh khoon, peep aur raal baha de aur biwi use apni zubaan se chaat le tab bhi uska haq ada nahi hota. Aur agar kisi bashar ke liye jaiz hota ke woh bashar ko sajda kare to main biwi ko hukm deta ke woh apne shauhar ko sajda kare jab woh uske paas aaye, us fazilat ki wajah se jo Allah Ta'ala ne use us par di hai.' Usne kaha: Us zaat ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke saath bheja! jab tak main dunya mein hun nikah nahi karungi.

e:
He came to al-Sham and saw the Christians prostrating to their bishops, priests, and patriarchs, and he saw the Jews prostrating to their rabbis, monks, religious sages, scholars, and jurists. He said, “Why do you do this?” They said, “This is the greeting of the prophets, upon them be blessings and peace.” I said, “Then we have more right to do this for our Prophet.”

The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: *"They lied about their prophets just as they distorted their Book. If I were to command anyone to prostrate to anyone, I would command a woman to prostrate to her husband because of the greatness of his right over her. No woman will find the sweetness of faith until she fulfills the right of her husband, even if he asks her for herself while she is on the back of a camel saddle."*[^1]
hi: Woh Sham gaye to dekha ke Isai apne bishopon, qissison aur patriarchon ko sajda karte hain, aur Yahudi apne ahbar, ruhbaan, rabbaniyon, ulama aur fuqaha ko sajda karte hain. Unhone poocha: Tum yeh kyun karte ho? Unhone kaha: Yeh ambiya (AS) ka salam hai. Maine kaha: To hum apne Nabi ke liye ise karne ke zyada haqdar hain. To Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Unhone apne ambiya par jhoot bandha jis tarah unhone apni kitab mein tehreef ki. Agar main kisi ko kisi ke liye sajda karne ka hukm deta to aurat ko hukm deta ke woh apne shauhar ko sajda kare, uske us par bade haq ki wajah se. Aur koi aurat imaan ki mithaas nahi paati jab tak apne shauhar ka haq ada na kare, chahe woh us se apna haq maange jabke woh oont ki zeen par ho.'

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, teach me something that will increase my certainty." He said, "Call that tree." So, he called it and it came until it greeted the Prophet ﷺ. Then, he said to it, "Go back," and it went back. Then, he gave permission to the man and he kissed his head and feet, and said, "If I were to order anyone to prostrate to anyone, I would have ordered the wife to prostrate to her husband."
hi: Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! mujhe koi aisi cheez sikhaiye jis se mera yaqeen badh jaye. Aap ne farmaya: 'Us darakht ko bulao.' Usne use bulaya to woh aaya yahan tak ke Nabi (SAW) ko salam kiya. Phir aap ne use farmaya: Wapas jao, to woh wapas chala gaya. Phir aap ne use ijazat di to usne aap ka sar aur paon choome aur aap ne farmaya: 'Agar main kisi ko kisi ke liye sajda karne ka hukm deta to aurat ko hukm deta ke woh apne shauhar ko sajda kare.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "The best of you are the best to women."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum mein sab se behtar woh hai jo auraton ke liye sab se behtar hai.'

e: she heard Umm Salamah say: “I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Any woman who dies when her husband is pleased with her, will enter Paradise.' ” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1854)
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jis aurat ki maut is haal mein ho ke uska shauhar us se razi ho, woh jannat mein daakhil hogi.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "A woman is not allowed to fast while her husband is present, except with his permission."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aurat roza na rakhe jabke uska shauhar maujood ho, siwa uski ijazat ke.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "There are two prayers that will not go beyond their heads: a slave who is disobedient to his master until he returns to obedience, and a wife who disobeys her husband until she returns to obedience." - Al-Dhahabi, in his summary.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Do aadmiyon ki namaz unke sar se aage nahi badhti: ek bhaga hua ghulam jo apne malikon se bhaag gaya yahan tak ke laut aaye, aur woh aurat jis ne apne shauhar ki nafarmani ki yahan tak ke laut aaye.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: "A woman came to the Prophet with two of her children, carrying one and leading the other. The Messenger of Allah said: 'They carry children and give birth to them and are compassionate. If they do not annoy their husbands, those among them who perform prayer will enter Paradise."' (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 2013)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne ek aurat ko dekha jis ke saath do bachchiyan thin, ek ko usne uthaya hua tha aur doosri ko haath se chala rahi thi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Bachchon ko uthane wali, raham karne wali maaen! agar woh apne shauharon ke saath jo kuch karti hain na karti hoti to unki namaz padhne wali jannat mein daakhil hoti.'

e: [AI] "A woman came to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) with two children, so he gave her three dates. She gave each of the children one date each. Then, one of the two boys cried, so she split the remaining date in half and gave each of them half. The Prophet (pbuh) said, 'Mothers who are pregnant and merciful with their children will enter Paradise if they fulfill their duties towards their husbands.'"
hi: Ek aurat Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayi, uske saath do bachche the. Aap ne use teen khajoorein dein. Usne har ek ko ek ek khajoor di. Phir ek bachcha rone laga to usne apni khajoor ke do tukde kiye aur har ek ko aadhi aadhi di. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Apne bachchon par raham karne wali, unhein uthane wali maaen! agar woh apne shauharon ke saath jo kuch karti hain na karti hoti to unki namaz padhne wali jannat mein daakhil hoti.'

e: [AI] The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  said, "Indeed, woman was created from a rib, and indeed, if you try to straighten her, you will break her. So, be gentle with her as her curvedness allows her to live with you." He repeated this statement three times.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Khabardar! aurat pasli se paida ki gayi hai, agar tum use seedha karna chaho ge to use tod doge. To uske saath narmi se pesh aao, uske saath guzara kar loge.' Teen baar farmaya.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Woman was created from a crooked rib, and indeed you will break it if you try to straighten it, but if you leave it, it remains crooked." This is an authentic narration according to the conditions of Muslim, and he did not exclude it based on the condition of Muslim.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Aurat tedhi pasli se paida ki gayi hai. Agar tum use seedha karoge to use tod doge, aur agar use chhod doge to uske saath guzara kar loge, halaanke usmein tedhapan hai.' Yeh sanad Muslim ki shart par sahih hai, magar (Bukhari aur Muslim ne) ise nahi nikaala.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah does not look at a woman who does not show gratitude to her husband and is not independent from him." It has also been said, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, connected.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Allah us aurat ki taraf nazar nahi farmata jo apne shauhar ka shukr ada nahi karti, jabke woh uski mohtaj hai.' Aur Shu'bah se Qatadah se muttasil bhi kaha gaya hai.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah does not look at a woman who does not thank her husband while she is not in need of him."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Allah us aurat ki taraf nazar nahi farmata jo apne shauhar ka shukr ada nahi karti jabke woh apne shauhar se be-niyaz nahi.'

e: [AI] He said, "Allah does not look at a woman who does not thank her husband and is not content without him."
hi: Unhone farmaya: 'Allah us aurat ki taraf nazar nahi farmata jo apne shauhar ka shukr ada nahi karti jabke woh uski mohtaj hai.'

e: [AI] "Oh Messenger of Allah, who has the greatest right over the woman?" He said, "Her husband." I said, "Who has the greatest right over the man?" He said, "His mother."
hi: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! aurat par sab se bada haq kis ka hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Uske shauhar ka.' Maine poocha: Aur mard par sab se bada haq kis ka hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Uski maan ka.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ, when something was brought to him, would say, "Take it to so-and-so, for she was a friend of Khadijah. Take it to so-and-so, for she used to love Khadijah."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas jab koi cheez laayi jaati to farmate: 'Isey falan aurat ke paas le jao, kyunke woh Khadijah (RA) ki saheli thi. Isey falan aurat ke paas le jao, kyunke woh Khadijah (RA) se mohabbat karti thi.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ used to slaughter sheep and then distribute them among Khadijah bint Khuwaylid's friends.
hi: Nabi (SAW) bakri zabah karte phir Khadijah bint Khuwaylid (RA) ki saheliyon ko dhoondh dhoondh kar (gosht) bhejte.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Were it not for Bani Israel, meat would not decay; and were it not for Eve, no woman would ever betray her husband." (Using translation from Bukhārī 3399)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Agar Bani Isra'il na hote to gosht sadta nahi, aur agar Hawwa (AS) na hoti to koi aurat apne shauhar se khiyanat na karti.'

e: [AI] From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Do not ask a man why he strikes his wife, and do not ask him who supports him among his brothers, and do not rely on them, and do not sleep except on a mattress."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat hai: 'Aadmi se yeh na poocho ke woh apni biwi ko kyun maarta hai, aur us se yeh na poocho ke apne bhaiyon mein se kis par bharosa karta hai aur kis par nahi karta, aur witr ke baghair na soo.'

e: [AI] A man from the Arabs used to cover up Abu Bakr, known as Ufair. Abu Bakr said to him, "O Ufair, did you not hear from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  anything regarding love?" He said, "I heard him say, 'Love is inherited and hatred is inherited.'"
hi: Arab ka ek aadmi, jise Ufayr kaha jaata tha, Abu Bakr (RA) ke paas aaya karta tha. Abu Bakr (RA) ne us se kaha: Ay Ufayr! tum ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se mohabbat (wudd) ke baare mein kya suna hai? Usne kaha: Maine aap ko farmate suna: 'Mohabbat bhi wirasat mein chalti hai aur bughz bhi wirasat mein chalta hai.'

e: [AI] Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq met a man from the Arabs named 'Ufair. Abu Bakr said to him, "Have you not heard anything from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about friendship?" He replied, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'Friendship and enmity are inherited.'" Yusuf bin 'Atiyyah perished.
hi: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (RA) Arab ke ek aadmi se mile jise Ufayr kaha jaata tha. Abu Bakr (RA) ne us se kaha: Tum ne Rasoolullah (SAW) se mohabbat ke baare mein kya suna hai? Usne kaha: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Mohabbat aur dushmani donon wirasat mein chalti hain.' Yusuf bin Atiyyah halik (tabah-shuda raavi) hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Shall I not guide you towards a charity or one of the greatest charities? It is your daughter, who will be a source of reward for you, and no one else will earn except you."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Kya main tumhein sadqe ki taraf rehnumai na karun, ya (farmaya) sab se bade sadqon mein se: teri beti jo tere paas lauta di gayi ho aur tere siwa koi kamane wala na ho.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Whoever has three daughters and remains patient with their upbringing and sustenance, Allah will admit him to Paradise through His mercy." A man then asked: "O Messenger of Allah, what if he has two daughters?" The Prophet replied: "Even if he has two." Another man asked: "O Messenger of Allah, and if he has only one daughter?" The Prophet said: "Even if he has only one."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ki teen betiyan hon aur woh unki tangi aur takleefon par sabr kare, Allah use unpar rehm karne ki wajah se jannat mein daakhil farmayega.' Ek aadmi ne arz kiya: Aur do betiyan, Ya Rasoolullah? Aap ne farmaya: 'Do bhi.' Ek aadmi ne arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! aur ek? Aap ne farmaya: 'Ek bhi.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  passed by some of his companions and a young boy between the sides of the road. When his mother saw the animals, she feared for her son to be trampled, so she hurried and called out, "My son! My son!" She carried her son and the people said, "O Prophet of Allah, she was not throwing her son into the fire." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "No, by Allah, Allah does not throw His beloved into the fire." The Prophet of Allah ﷺ  then reproached them.
hi: Nabi (SAW) apne kuch sahaba ke paas se guzre, aur ek bachcha raaste ke beech mein tha. Jab uski maan ne sawariyan dekhin to apne bete ko kuchle jaane ka khauf hua, to ghabrahat mein dauri aur kehne lagi: Mera beta, mera beta! aur apne bete ko utha liya. Logon ne kaha: Ay Allah ke Nabi! yeh to apne bete ko aag mein nahi daalegi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam! Allah apne mehboob ko aag mein nahi daalega.' Kaha: To Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne unhein laajawab kar diya.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone has a female child, and does not bury her alive, or slight her, or prefer his children (i.e. the male ones) to her, Allah will bring him into Paradise. Uthman did not mention "male children". (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5146)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ke yahan ladki paida ho aur woh use zinda dafn na kare, use zaleel na samjhe aur apne bete, yani larke, ko us par tarjeeh na de, Allah us ki wajah se use jannat mein daakhil farmayega.'

e: [AI] A woman came to Aisha asking for something and she had with her two young boys. So she gave her three dates and gave each of the boys a date, while she kept one date for herself. The boys then ate the two dates and she split her date in half and gave each boy half a date. Then, the Prophet ﷺ  came and she informed him about what happened. He said, "What impresses you about her? Surely, Allah has shown mercy to her through the mercy of her children."
hi: Ek aurat Ayesha (RA) ke paas maangne aayi, uske saath chhote bachche the. Unhone use teen khajoorein dein. Usne har bachche ko ek ek khajoor di aur ek apne liye rakhi. Bachchon ne dono khajoorein kha lin to woh apni khajoor ki taraf mutawajjah hui, use do tukde kiya aur har bachche ko aadhi aadhi khajoor di. Phir Nabi (SAW) tashreef laye to unhone aap ko bataya. Aap ne farmaya: 'Tumhein is par kya ta'ajjub hai? Allah ne is par uske bachchon par raham karne ki wajah se rehm farma diya.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever raises two daughters until they reach maturity, he and I will enter Paradise like these two," and he pointed with his index finger and middle finger. And there are two swiftly moving gates of punishment in this world: injustice and disobedience."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne do bachchiyon ki parwarish ki yahan tak ke woh baaligh ho gayin, main aur woh jannat mein is tarah daakhil honge jaise yeh do (ungliyan)' aur aap ne shahadat ki ungli aur beech ki ungli se ishara farmaya. 'Aur do darwaze hain jin ki saza jaldi dunya mein hi mil jati hai: zulm aur walidain ki nafarmani.'

e: [AI] "Zaid asked Abu Saad, 'Where did you come from?' He replied, 'I came from the Amir of the city, who shared a hadith with me.' Abu Saad then narrated the hadith to the people, saying, 'I heard Ibn Abbas saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Any Muslim who has two daughters and treats them well, they will be a cause for him to enter Paradise.'"
hi: Zayd ne unse kaha: Ay Abu Sa'd! kahan se aa rahe ho? Unhone kaha: Madina ke amir ke paas se, maine unhein ek hadees sunayi. Zayd ne kaha: To ye hadees logon ko bhi sunao. Unhone kaha: Maine Ibn Abbas (RA) ko kehte suna ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis musalman ki do betiyan hon aur woh unke saath husn-e-sulook kare jab tak woh uske saath rahein, to woh dono use jannat mein daakhil karengi.'

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , this is a rumor. Indeed, Shurahbil is Abu Saad, Shurahbil ibn Saad, a respected person from the people of Madinah, Shurahbil ibn Saad.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se isi ki tarah (riwayat hai). Yeh wahm hai, kyunke yeh Shurahbil dar-haqiqat Abu Sa'd Shurahbil bin Sa'd hain, jo ahl-e-Madina ke ek shaykh hain. Shurahbil bin Sa'd wahi (bahut kamzor) hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Those who do not show mercy to our young ones and do not realise the right of our elders are not from us. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4943)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo hamare chhoton par rehm na kare aur hamare bado ka haq na pehchane woh hum mein se nahi.'

e: [AI] "I approached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in the early days of his prophethood when he was in Makkah and he was at that time hiding. I asked, 'Who are you?' He replied, 'I am a prophet.' I asked, 'What is a prophet?' He said, 'I am the Messenger of Allah.' I asked, 'What has Allah sent you with?' He said, 'Allah has sent me to worship Him alone, to break the idols, and to maintain good relations with relatives.'"
hi: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aap ke mab'uth hone ke bilkul shuru mein aaya, aap Makkah mein the aur un dinon chupe hue the. Maine poocha: Aap kya hain? Aap ne farmaya: 'Main Nabi hun.' Maine poocha: Nabi kya hota hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Allah ka Rasool.' Maine poocha: Allah ne aap ko kis cheez ke saath bheja? Aap ne farmaya: 'Is ke saath ke Allah ki ibadat ki jaye, but toray jayen, aur rishtedaron se husn-e-sulook aur silah rehmi ki jaye.'

e: [AI] From his father Rifaa'ah ibn Rafee', who witnessed the Battle of Badr with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ : He (the Prophet) and his cousin Mu'adh ibn 'Afra'ah went out until they reached Makkah. When they descended from Thaniyyah, they saw a man under a tree. The Prophet said, "Let us approach this man, so that we may entrust him with our belongings and make Tawaf around the Kaaba." We greeted him with the pre-Islamic form of greeting and he responded to us with the Islamic greeting. We had heard of the Prophet ﷺ , so we denied it and asked him, "Who are you?" He said, "Come down." We descended and said, "Where is the man who claims and says what he says?" He said, "I am him." So I said, "Present yourself to me." He presented Islam to us and said, "Who created the heavens, the earth, and the mountains?" We said, "Allah created them." He said, "Then who created you?" We said, "Allah created us." He said, "Then who created these idols that you worship?" We said, "We made them ourselves." He said, "The Creator is more deserving of worship than the created. You are more deserving of being worshiped, as you made them, but Allah is more deserving of being worshiped than something you made." I invite you to worship Allah alone, testify that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and I am the Messenger of Allah. I also invite you to maintain kinship ties and refrain from oppression and transgression." We said, "By Allah, if what you are calling us to is false, then it would be among the noblest of matters and the best of characters." So we entrusted him with our belongings until we could go to the Kaaba. Mu'adh ibn 'Afra'ah sat with him and said, "I went to the Kaaba, performed Tawaf, and came out with seven cups. I gave him one of them and said, 'O Allah, if what Muhammad is calling to is true, then remove his cup seven times.'" He struck it seven times and each time, it emitted a sound. So I shouted, 'I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.' People gathered around me saying, 'This man is insane, he struck the cup seven times and it still made a sound.' I said, 'No, by Allah, he is a believer.' Then I went up to a high place in Makkah, and when Mu'adh saw me, he said, 'Indeed, Rifaa'ah has come with a face that nothing has ever harmed before.' So I came to him, believed in him, and Allah's Messenger ﷺ  taught us Surah Yusuf. We recited, "In the name of your Lord who created" until we reached the verse, "We will return to our family." When we were in 'Aqiq, Mu'adh said, 'I have never spent a night away from my family before, so let me stay here until morning.' So I spent the night with him and I had never done what I did before. Rifaa'ah would always present himself to his people after returning from a journey.
hi: Apne walid Rifa'ah bin Rafi' (RA) se, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath Badr mein hazir hue the, ke woh aur unke khaalazad Mu'adh bin Afra (RA) nikle yahan tak ke Makkah pahunche. Jab woh Saniyyah se utre to ek aadmi ko ek darakht ke neeche dekha (kaha: yeh Ansar ke chhe logon ke nikalne se pehle ki baat hai). Kaha: Jab humne use dekha to us se baat ki. Humne kaha: Is aadmi ke paas chalte hain aur apna saman iske paas amanat rakh dete hain jab tak ke hum Bait Allah ka tawaf kar lein. Humne use jahiliyyat ke tareeqe par salam kiya, to usne humein ahl-e-Islam ke salam se jawab diya, aur humne Nabi (SAW) ke baare mein suna hua tha, to humein ajeeb laga. Humne poocha: Aap kaun hain? Aap ne farmaya: 'Utar aao.' Hum utre aur poocha: Woh aadmi kahan hai jo dawa karta hai aur jo kuch kehta hai (woh sab)? Aap ne farmaya: 'Main hun.' Maine kaha: To mujh par (apni baat) pesh kijiye. Aap ne humare saamne Islam pesh kiya aur farmaya: 'Aasmanon, zameen aur pahadon ko kis ne paida kiya?' Humne kaha: Allah ne. Aap ne farmaya: 'Aur tumhein kis ne paida kiya?' Humne kaha: Allah ne. Aap ne farmaya: 'Aur in butoon ko kis ne banaya jin ki tum ibadat karte ho?' Humne kaha: Humne. Aap ne farmaya: 'To kya paida karne wala ibadat ka zyada haqdar hai ya paida kiya hua? To tum is baat ke zyada haqdar ho ke woh (but) tumhari ibadat karein kyunke tum ne unhein banaya hai, aur Allah is baat ka zyada haqdar hai ke tum us cheez ke bajaye jo tum ne banayi uski ibadat karo. Aur main Allah ki ibadat, is baat ki gawahi ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur main Allah ka Rasool hun, silah rehmi, aur logon ka maal ghasb karke zyadati chhodne ki dawat deta hun.' Humne kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam! jis cheez ki aap dawat dete hain agar woh batil bhi hoti to bulandi-e-umoor aur husn-e-akhlaq mein se hoti. To aap hamari sawari ko roke rakhiye yahan tak ke hum Bait Allah ho aayen. Mu'adh bin Afra (RA) aap ke paas baith gaye. Kaha: Main Bait Allah gaya, tawaf kiya aur saat teer nikaale, unmein se ek ko aap (SAW) ke liye muqarrar kiya, phir Bait Allah ki taraf rukh kiya aur dua ki: Ay Allah! agar Muhammad jis cheez ki dawat dete hain woh haq hai to unka teer saat baar nikal de. Maine teer chalaye to woh saat baar nikla. Phir maine gawahi di: Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan Rasulullah. Log mere gird jama ho gaye aur kehne lage: Paagal hai, ek aadmi hai jo be-deen ho gaya. Maine kaha: Balke ek momin aadmi. Phir main Makkah ke upar ke hisse mein aaya. Jab Mu'adh ne mujhe dekha to kaha: Rifa'ah aisa chehra lekar aaya hai jaisa le kar gaya nahi tha. Main aaya aur imaan laya aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein Surah Yusuf aur 'Iqra bismi rabbikal ladhi khalaq' sikhayi. Phir hum Madina ki taraf laut chale. Jab hum Aqeeq mein pahunche to Mu'adh ne kaha: Maine kabhi raat ko achanak apne ghar walon ke paas jaane ka tareeqa nahi apnaya, to aap hamare saath yahin raat guzaarein yahan tak ke subah ho jaye. Maine kaha: Main raat guzarun jabke mere paas woh khabar hai jo mere paas hai? Main aisa nahi karunga. Aur Rifa'ah jab safar se aate to unki qaum unke saamne pesh hoti.

e: Messenger of Allah said: "They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, whom should I treat kindly?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said :'Your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your father'. He said : 'Then who?' He said: 'The next closest and the next closest.'" (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3658)
hi: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! main kis ke saath husn-e-sulook karun? Aap ne farmaya: 'Apni maan ke saath.' Maine arz kiya: Phir kis ke saath? Aap ne farmaya: 'Apni maan ke saath.' Maine arz kiya: Phir kis ke saath? Aap ne farmaya: 'Apne baap ke saath.' Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! phir kis ke saath? Aap ne farmaya: 'Phir jo sab se qareeb ho, phir jo uske baad qareeb ho.'

e: "I enjoin each one to honor his mother,I enjoin each one to honor his mother,I enjoin each one to honor his mother(three times), I enjoin each one to honor his guardian who is taking care of him, even if he is causing him some annoyance." (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3657)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Main har aadmi ko uski maan ke saath husn-e-sulook ki wasiyat karta hun, main har aadmi ko uski maan ke saath husn-e-sulook ki wasiyat karta hun, aur main har aadmi ko uske baap ke saath husn-e-sulook ki wasiyat karta hun, aur main har aadmi ko uske us maula ke saath husn-e-sulook ki wasiyat karta hun jo uske qareeb ho, chahe woh usmein (us ki taraf se) usko takleef pahunchata ho.' Is ke liye shawahid bhi hain.

e: [AI] I asked, O Messenger of Allah, who has the greatest right upon a woman? He replied, "Her husband." I asked, then who has the greatest right upon a man? He replied, "His mother." And from her
hi: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! aurat par sab se bada haq kis ka hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Uske shauhar ka.' Maine arz kiya: Aur mard par sab se bada haq kis ka hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Uski maan ka.' Aur iske shawahid hain.

e: [AI] I reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and heard him saying, "Be good to your mother, father, sister, and brother, and then those closest to you, those closest to you." And among them
hi: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas pahuncha to maine aap ko farmate suna: 'Apni maan aur apne baap, apni behen aur apne bhai ke saath husn-e-sulook karo, phir jo sab se qareeb ho phir jo uske baad qareeb ho.' Aur iske shawahid hain.

e: [AI] From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Indeed, Allah Almighty advises you to be kind to your relatives, even those who are closest to you." Isma'il ibn 'Ayyash, one of the Imams of the people of Sham, was only punished for his poor memorization. And from it, we understand that Isma'il was only punished for his poor memorization.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Allah Ta'ala tumhein sab se qareeb ke phir uske baad qareeb ke saath (husn-e-sulook) ki wasiyat karta hai.' Isma'il bin Ayyash ahl-e-Sham ke aimma mein se ek hain, un par sirf hifz ki kharabi ka e'tiraz kiya gaya hai. Aur iske shawahid hain: Isma'il par sirf hifz ki kharabi ka e'tiraz kiya gaya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I dreamt and saw myself in Paradise, and I heard the voice of a reciter. So I asked, 'Who is this?' They said, 'Haritha bin Nu'man.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'This is righteousness.' And he was the kindest to his mother among the people."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Main soya to khud ko jannat mein dekha, maine ek qari ki awaz suni jo tilawat kar raha tha. Maine poocha: Yeh kaun hai? Kaha gaya: Harithah bin An-Nu'man. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Nekki aisi hi hoti hai.' Aur woh apni maan ke saath sab logon se zyada husn-e-sulook karne wale the.

e: [AI] "That Jaheemah came to the Prophet ﷺ  and said, 'I wanted to participate in a battle and I have come to seek your advice.' The Prophet responded, 'Do you still have your mother?' Jaheemah replied, 'Yes.' The Prophet then advised, 'Stay with her, for Paradise is beneath her feet.'"
hi: Jahimah (RA) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye aur arz kiya: Main jihad mein jana chahta hun aur aap se mashwara lene aaya hun. Aap ne farmaya: 'Kya tumhari maan hai?' Unhone kaha: Ji haan. Aap ne farmaya: 'Ja aur uske saath laga reh, kyunke jannat uske qadmon ke neeche hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The pleasure of the Lord is in the pleasure of the parents, and the anger of the Lord is in the anger of the parents."[^1]
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Rab ki raza walid ki raza mein hai aur Rab ki naraazgi walid ki naraazgi mein hai.'

e: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: I came to you to take the oath of allegiance to you on emigration, and I left my parents weeping. He (the Prophet) said: Return to them and make them laugh as you made them weep. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2528)
hi: Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main aap se hijrat par bai'at karne aaya hun aur apne walidain ko rota hua chhod aaya hun. Aap ne farmaya: 'Un ke paas wapas ja aur unhein hansa jis tarah tu ne unhein rulaya.'

e: [AI] A man got married, and his mother hated that. So he came to ask Abu Darda, who said, "Divorce the woman and obey your mother. For I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying: 'The mother is the best gate of Paradise, so keep it or lose it.'" Shu'bah narrated it from 'Ata' ibn As-Sa'ib, explaining it in the authentic interpretation.
hi: Ek aadmi ne nikah kiya to uski maan ne use napasand kiya. Woh Abu Ad-Darda (RA) se poochne aaya. Unhone kaha: Biwi ko talaq de de aur apni maan ki itaa'at kar, kyunke maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Walida jannat ke darwazon mein sab se bichla (behtar) darwaza hai, to chahe ise zaya kar de chahe ise mehfooz rakh.' Isey Shu'bah ne Ata bin As-Sa'ib se, wazahat ke saath riwayat kiya hai. Yeh sahih hai.

e: [AI] "To divorce his wife and make one thousand freed slaves or one hundred freed slaves, and he does not have a sacrifice if he does so. Then he went to Abu Darda and mentioned that he performed the Duha prayer, then he asked him. He said, 'Fulfill your vow and be dutiful to your parents, for I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'The parents are the middle door of Paradise, so if you wish, protect this door or leave it.'"
hi: ...ke woh apni biwi ko talaq de. Usne ek hazaar ya sau ghulam azad karne aur apna sara maal hadi (qurbani) karne ka (qasam ya nazr) kar li agar woh aisa kare. Phir woh Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ke paas aaya. Raavi ne zikr kiya ke unhone Zuha ki namaz padhi, phir unse poocha, to unhone kaha: Apni nazr poori kar aur apne walidain ke saath husn-e-sulook kar, kyunke maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Walid jannat ke darwazon mein sab se bichla (behtar) darwaza hai, to agar chaho to us darwaze ki hifazat karo ya chhod do.'

e: [AI] "There was a woman whom I admired and Umar disliked her, so he told me to divorce her, but I refused. Umar then went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, Abdullah bin Umar has a woman whom he has grown to dislike, and I ordered him to divorce her, but he refused.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to me, 'O Abdullah bin Umar, divorce your wife and obey your father.' So, I divorced her."
hi: Meri ek biwi thi jo mujhe pasand thi aur Umar (RA) use napasand karte the. Unhone mujh se kaha: Use talaq de de. Maine inkar kiya. To Umar (RA) Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaye aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! Abdullah bin Umar ke paas ek aurat hai jise main napasand karta hun, maine use hukm diya ke use talaq de de to usne inkar kar diya. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujh se farmaya: 'Ay Abdullah bin Umar! apni biwi ko talaq de de aur apne baap ki itaa'at kar.' Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: To maine use talaq de di.

e: [AI] "That you have knowledge from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  that you do not disclose openly?" He said, "Yes." He said, "Show me the sword." So I gave him the sword, and he extracted from it a paper containing a writing. He said, "This is what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ : 'Allah curses whoever slaughters for other than Allah, and whoever takes the lead of other than his own people, and Allah curses the one who disobeys his parents, and Allah curses the one who diminishes the minarets of the earth.'" Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summarization.
hi: ...ke aap ke paas Rasoolullah (SAW) se koi ilm hai jo aap zahir nahi karte. Unhone kaha: Logon ke baghair? Usne kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Mujhe talwar dikhao. Maine unhein talwar di to unhone usmein se ek sahifa nikala jis mein likha tha. Unhone kaha: Yeh woh hai jo maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna: 'Allah ki lanat us par jo Allah ke siwa kisi aur ke liye zabah kare, aur us par jo apne maulaon ke siwa kisi aur ko maula banaye, aur Allah ki lanat us par jo apne walidain ka nafarman ho, aur Allah ki lanat us par jo zameen ke nishan (hadd) ghatata ho.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: I came to you to take the oath of allegiance to you on emigration, and I left my parents weeping. He (the Prophet) said: Return to them and make them laugh as you made them weep. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 2528)
hi: Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas hijrat par bai'at karne aaya aur kaha: Main aap se hijrat par bai'at karne aaya hun aur apne walidain ko rota hua chhod aaya hun. Aap ne farmaya: 'Un ke paas wapas ja aur unhein hansa jis tarah tu ne unhein rulaya.'

e:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, *"Come toward the pulpit,"* and we all came. When he climbed a step, he said, *"Āmīn"*, and when he climbed the second step he said, *"Āmīn"*, and when he climbed the third step he said, *"Āmīn.”* When he came down ˹after the sermon˺ we asked, "O Messenger of Allah, we heard something from you that we had not heard before."

He said, *"Jibrīl ﷺ ˹came˺  to me and said, (1) 'Away with the one who found Ramadan and he was not forgiven.'", and I said, 'Āmīn.'"*

*"When I climbed the second ˹step˺ he said, 'Away with the one to him when I (Allah) am mentioned and he does not send ṣalāh upon you.'"*

*"When I climbed the third ˹step˺ he said, 'Away with the one who finds his parents in old age or ˹at least˺ one of them and they do not become ˹a means˺ for him to enter Jannah.' And I said, 'Āmīn.'"*[^1]
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Minbar ke paas hazir ho jao.' Hum hazir hue. Jab aap pehle zeene par chade to farmaya: 'Aameen.' Jab doosre zeene par chade to farmaya: 'Aameen.' Jab teesre zeene par chade to farmaya: 'Aameen.' Jab utre to humne arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! humne aaj aap se aisi baat suni jo hum pehle nahi suna karte the. Aap ne farmaya: 'Jibreel (AS) mere saamne aaye aur kaha: Halakat ho us ke liye jis ne Ramazan paaya aur uski maghfirat na hui. Maine kaha: Aameen.' 'Jab main doosre zeene par chada to kaha: Halakat ho us ke liye jiske saamne aap ka zikr kiya jaye aur woh aap par durood na bheje. Maine kaha: Aameen.' 'Jab main teesre zeene par chada to kaha: Halakat ho us ke liye jis ke paas uske walidain ya un mein se ek budhape ko pahunche aur woh dono use jannat mein daakhil na karwayen. Maine kaha: Aameen.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever is kind and dutiful to his parents, good tidings to him, may Allah increase his lifespan."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne apne walidain ke saath husn-e-sulook kiya, uske liye khushkhabri hai, Allah uski umr mein izafa farmaye.'

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: 'Show forgiveness to the women among the people, and your women will be forgiven. Show kindness to your fathers, and your children will be kind to you. And whoever seeks reconciliation with his brother while kneeling, let him accept it from him, whether he was wronged or wronged the other. But if he does not accept it, then I am not liable for his share in Paradise.'"
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Logon ki aurton se paak-damni ikhtiyar karo, tumhari aurten paak-daman rahengi; apne baapon ke saath husn-e-sulook karo, tumhare bete tumhare saath husn-e-sulook karenge; aur jis ke paas uska bhai maazrat karte hue aaye woh use qubool kare, chahe woh haq par ho ya na-haq par, aur agar usne aisa na kiya to woh mere paas hauz par nahi aa sakega.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: "Respect your fathers, you will be blessed with the respect of your children. Forgive the women of the people, your women will be forgiven. And whoever is entrusted with a favor, but does not accept it, will not be granted access to my Fountain."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Apne baapon ke saath husn-e-sulook karo, tumhare bete tumhare saath husn-e-sulook karenge; logon ki aurton se paak-damni ikhtiyar karo, tumhari aurten paak-daman rahengi; aur jis ke saamne maazrat ki jaye aur woh qubool na kare to woh mere paas hauz par nahi aa sakega.'

e: While we were with the Messenger of Allah! ﷺ a man of Banu Salmah came to Him and said: Messenger of Allah is there any kindness left that I can do to my parents after their death? He replied: Yes, you can invoke blessings on them, forgiveness for them, carry out their final instructions after their death, join ties of relationship which are dependent on them, and honour their friends. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 5142)
hi: Unhone Abu Usayd Malik bin Rabi'ah As-Sa'idi (RA) ko kehte suna: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas the ke Bani Salamah ka ek aadmi aaya aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! kya mere walidain ke saath husn-e-sulook ka koi hissa baqi hai jo main unki wafat ke baad karun? Aap ne farmaya: 'Haan: un ke liye dua-e-rehmat karna, un ke liye istighfar karna, un ke ahd poore karna, un ke dost ki izzat karna, aur us rishtedar ke saath silah rehmi karna jis se tumhara rishta sirf unhi ki wajah se ho.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  came and a man said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have committed many sins. Do I have a chance for repentance?" He asked him, "Are your parents alive?" He answered, "No." Then he asked him, "Do you have an aunt?" He replied, "Yes, I do." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Then be good to her."
hi: Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! mujh se bahut bada gunah ho gaya hai, kya mere liye tauba hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Kya tere walidain hain?' Usne kaha: Nahi. Aap ne farmaya: 'Kya teri khala hai?' Usne kaha: Haan. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'To phir uske saath husn-e-sulook kar.'

e: [AI] She said, "A woman from the people of Dumah Al-Jandal came to me seeking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  after his death, asking about something she had done regarding the matter of sorcerers but did not act upon it. A'ishah said to Urwah, "O son of my sister, I saw her crying when she could not find the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  to cure her. I felt sorry for her as she said, 'I fear that I have perished.' I had a husband who was absent from me, so an old woman entered upon me and I complained to her. She said, 'If you do what I command you, perhaps he will come to you.' When the night came, she brought me two black dogs. I rode one and the other rode by my side. I did not stay in any one place until we stopped at Babylon and I saw two men hanging by their feet and said, 'What brought you here?' I said, 'I want to learn magic.' They said, 'We are only a trial, so do not disbelieve and go back to your land.' I refused and they said, 'Go to that oven and urinate in it.' So, I went and was terrified, and I did not do anything. I returned to them and they said, 'Did you do it?' I said, 'Yes.' They said, 'Did you see anything?' I said, 'I did not see anything.' They said, 'You lied, you did not do it. Go back to your land and do not disbelieve, for you are in control of your matter.' I refused and they said, 'Go to that oven and urinate in it.' So, I went and urinated in it. Then, I saw a knight coming out of me with iron armor until he ascended into the sky and disappeared from my sight. I went back to them and said, 'I have done it.' They said, 'What did you see?' I said, 'I saw a knight coming out of me with iron armor until he ascended into the sky and disappeared from my sight.' They said, 'You spoke the truth. Your faith has come out of you. Go.' When I went to the woman, Allah, by Allah, I did not know anything and they did not say anything to me. They said, 'Yes, if you desire anything, it will be granted to you. Take this wheat and sow it.' So, I sowed it and said, 'Grow.' It grew. I said, 'Harvest.' I harvested it. I said, 'Thresh.' I threshed it. I said, 'Grind.' I ground it. I said, 'Bake.' I baked it. When I realized that I did not want anything, it fell into my hands, and I regretted it, by Allah, O mother of the believers, I have never done anything and I will never do it again. So, I asked the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  about the cause of the death of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while they were present with him at that time, but they did not know what to say to her. They were all anxious and afraid to give her a verdict based on something they did not know, except that they said, 'If your parents were alive or one of them, it would be sufficient for you.'"
hi: Unhone (Ayesha RA ne) farmaya: Dumah Al-Jandal ke ek ghar ki aurat mere paas aayi, woh Rasoolullah (SAW) ki wafat ke baad, unhi dinon mein aap ko talash karti aayi thi, aur jadugaron ke ek maamle ke baare mein poochna chahti thi jis mein woh dakhil hui thi magar us par amal nahi kiya tha. Ayesha (RA) ne Urwah se kaha: Ay mere bhanje! Maine use dekha ke woh ro rahi thi jab usne Rasoolullah (SAW) ko na paaya ke woh use shifa dete, yahan tak ke mujhe usper rehm aaya. Woh kehti thi: Mujhe darr hai ke kahin main halak na ho gayi hun. Mera ek shauhar tha jo mujh se gaib ho gaya. Ek budhiya mere paas aayi to maine uski shikayat ki. Usne kaha: Agar tu woh kare jo main kehti hun to shayad woh tere paas aa jaye. Jab raat hui to woh mere paas do kaale kutte lekar aayi. Ek par main sawar hui aur doosre par woh. Zara der na guzri thi ke hum Babil mein ja thehre. Wahan do aadmi the jo apne paon se latke hue the. Unhone poocha: Tum kyun aayi ho? Maine kaha: Jadu seekhne. Unhone kaha: Hum to sirf aazmaish hain, kufr na kar aur laut ja. Maine inkar kiya aur kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Us tannoor ke paas ja aur usmein peshab kar. Main gayi, ghabra gayi aur aisa na kiya. Main un ke paas wapas aayi to unhone poocha: Tu ne kar liya? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone poocha: Kuch dekha? Maine kaha: Kuch nahi dekha. Unhone kaha: Tu ne nahi kiya, apne mulk laut ja aur kufr na kar. Maine inkar kiya. Unhone kaha: Us tannoor ke paas ja aur usmein peshab kar. Main gayi, mere rongte khade ho gaye aur main dar gayi. Phir main un ke paas wapas aayi. Unhone poocha: Kya dekha? Maine kaha: Kuch nahi dekha. Unhone kaha: Tu ne jhoot bola, tu ne nahi kiya. Apne mulk laut ja aur kufr na kar, kyunke tu apne maamle ke sire par hai. Maine inkar kiya. Unhone kaha: Us tannoor ke paas ja aur usmein peshab kar. Main gayi aur usmein peshab kiya. Maine ek sawar dekha jo loha pehne hue tha, woh mujh se nikla aur aasman mein chala gaya aur mujh se ojhal ho gaya yahan tak ke main use na dekh saki. Main un ke paas aayi aur kaha: Maine kar liya. Unhone poocha: Kya dekha? Maine kaha: Maine ek sawar dekha jo loha pehne hue tha, mujh se nikla aur aasman mein chala gaya aur mujh se ojhal ho gaya yahan tak ke mujhe kuch nazar nahi aaya. Unhone kaha: Tu ne sach kaha, woh tera imaan tha jo tujh se nikal gaya. Ja. Maine us aurat se kaha: Allah ki qasam! mujhe kuch nahi maloom aur unhone mujh se kuch nahi kaha. Usne kaha: Nahi, tu jo kuch bhi chahegi woh ho jayega. Yeh gandum le aur bo de. Maine bo diya aur kaha: Ug aa. Woh ug aayi. Maine kaha: Khet ban. Woh khet ban gayi. Phir maine kaha: Bali nikal. Usne bali nikali. Phir maine kaha: Sookh ja. Woh sookh gayi. Phir maine kaha: Pees de. Usne pees diya. Phir maine kaha: Roti pakka. Usne pakka di. Jab maine dekha ke main jo kuch bhi chahti hun woh ho jata hai to mere haath se tote ud gaye aur main nadim hui. Allah ki qasam! Ay Ummul Mu'mineen! maine kabhi kuch nahi kiya aur kabhi nahi karungi. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba se, jo Rasoolullah (SAW) ki wafat ke bilkul baad ke dinon mein the aur un dinon bahut taadad mein the, poocha to unhein samajh nahi aaya ke use kya kahen. Un sab ko darr tha ke woh use woh fatwa dein jo woh nahi jaante. Siwa is ke ke unhone kaha: Agar tere walidain ya un mein se ek zinda hote to woh tere liye kaafi hote.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "All sins are withheld by Allah until the Day of Resurrection, except for disobedience to parents, for He hastens to deliver its consequence to the perpetrator in this life before death."
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Tamam gunahon mein se Allah jis ki chahta hai qayamat ke din tak mu'akhkhar kar deta hai, siwa walidain ki nafarmani ke, ke Allah Ta'ala use gunahgar ko maut se pehle zindagi hi mein jaldi saza de deta hai.'

e: [AI] "They were granted permission to maintain their tribal connections, even though they were polytheists. Thus, the verse was revealed: 'It is not upon you to guide them.' (Quran 2:272) until the verse was revealed: 'Whatever you spend of good, indeed Allah is Knowing of it.' (Quran 2:273) Then, permission was granted to them." This was explained by Al-Dhahabi in summary.
hi: ...ke woh apne rishtedaron ke liye (sadqa mein) rukhsat dein, halaanke woh mushrik the. To nazil hua: 'Unhein hidayat dena aap ke zimme nahi' (Al-Baqarah 272) yahan tak ke 'aur jo bhi achhi cheez tum kharch karte ho Allah use khoob jaanta hai' (Al-Baqarah 273). To unhein rukhsat de di gayi. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said: Allah the Almighty said, "I am the Most Merciful and it is through mercy that relationships exist. Whoever maintains good ties with his family, I will maintain good ties with him, and whoever severs his family ties, I will sever my ties with him."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah Azza wa Jall ne farmaya: 'Main Rahman hun aur yeh rehm hai. To jo ise jode main use jodta hun, aur jo ise tode main use todta hun.'

e: “The Prophet ﷺ said to me: ‘Do not show your thigh, and do not look at the thigh of anyone, living or dead.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 1460)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Apni ran (jaanghein) zahir na kar, aur kisi zinda ya murda ki ran ki taraf na dekh.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by a man and saw his thigh uncovered, so he said, "Cover your thigh, for indeed the thigh of a man is part of his 'awrah." Al-Dhahabi remained silent regarding this in his summary.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ek aadmi ke paas se guzre aur dekha ke uski ran khuli hui hai. Aap ne farmaya: 'Apni ran dhaanp le, kyunke mard ki ran uski satr mein se hai.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "I came to the Prophet ﷺ  while I was in a disheveled state and he said, 'Do you have any wealth?' I said, 'Yes.' He asked, 'Of what kind?' I said, 'Of all kinds, including camels, slaves, horses, and sheep.' He said, 'If Allah gives you wealth, let it be seen on you.' Then he said, 'Your people's camels will produce healthy offspring, so intentionally go to the one that belongs to Moosa and sever its ears, declaring it to be a Bahira, and slit its hump or cut its skin, declaring it to be a Surma, and thus prohibit it for you and your family?' I said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Whatever Allah has given you is lawful, and Moosa repelled an act of aggression from Allah worse than what you did, and Moosa is no better than you.' I asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, what do you say about a man whom I visited, but he did not honor me nor host me, but then he was visited by me and I honored and hosted him?' He said, 'You should honor him.'"
hi: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur meri halat bahut kharab thi. Aap ne farmaya: 'Kya tere paas maal hai?' Maine kaha: Ji haan. Aap ne farmaya: 'Kis qism ka maal?' Maine kaha: Har qism ka maal: oont, ghulam, ghode aur bakriyan. Aap ne farmaya: 'To jab Allah ne tujhe maal diya hai to uska asar tujh par nazar aana chahiye.' Phir farmaya: 'Teri qaum ke oont jab sahih kaan wale bachche dete hain to tu ustara le kar unke kaan kaat deta hai aur kehta hai: Yeh bahirah hai, aur unhein chir deta hai ya unki khalen chir deta hai aur kehta hai: Yeh surm hai, phir unhein apne aur apne ghar walon par haram kar leta hai?' Usne kaha: Haan. Aap ne farmaya: 'Allah ne jo tujhe diya woh tere liye halal hai. Allah ka ustara zyada tez hai, aur shayad farmaya: Allah ka baazu tere baazu se zyada mazboot hai, aur Allah ka ustara tere ustare se zyada tez hai.' Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! aap ka kya khayal hai us aadmi ke baare mein jis ke yahan main utra aur usne meri izzat nahi ki aur meri mehmannawazi nahi ki, phir woh mere yahan utre to kya main use badla dun jaisa usne kiya, ya uski mehmannawazi karun? Aap ne farmaya: 'Uski mehmannawazi karo.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, Allah is beautiful and He loves beauty." Al-Hakim wrote in his handwriting, "Here, it is emphasized by its length." Adh-Dhahabi remained silent about summarizing from this context.
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah khoobsurat hai aur khoobsurti ko pasand karta hai.' Al-Hakim ne apne haath se likha: 'Yahan ise poori tarah nikala jayega.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein is jagah se khamoshi ikhtiyar ki.

e: A man who was beautiful came to the Prophet ﷺ. He said: Messenger of Allah, I am a man who likes beauty, and I have been given some of it, as you see. And I do not like that anyone excels me (in respect of beauty). Perhaps he said: "even to the extent of thong of my sandal (shirak na'li)", or he he said: "to the extent of strap of my sandal (shis'i na'li)". Is it pride? He replied: No, pride is disdaining what is true and despising people. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4092)
hi: Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! main aisa aadmi hun jise khoobsurti pasand hai, aur mujhe usmein se utna diya gaya hai jitna aap dekhte hain, yahan tak ke mujhe yeh bhi pasand nahi ke koi meri jootiyon ke tasme ya mere jootiyon ke fite mein bhi mujh se badh jaye. Kya yeh takabbur hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Nahi, balke takabbur yeh hai ke koi haq ko thukraye aur logon ko haqeer jaane.'

e: [AI] So I went to him and with him was Malik ibn Murarah al-Rahawi. I caught the end of his conversation where he said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have been blessed with beauty that surpasses what you can see, and I do not want anyone to exceed me in their footwear. Is that considered wrongdoing?" The Messenger of Allah said, "That is not considered wrongdoing, but wrongdoing is when one rejects the truth or belittles it and belittles people."
hi: Main aap ke paas aaya to aap ke paas Malik bin Murarah Ar-Rahawi (RA) the. Maine unki baat ka aakhri hissa paaya, woh keh rahe the: Ya Rasoolullah! mujhe khoobsurti utni di gayi hai jitni aap dekhte hain, aur mujhe yeh pasand nahi ke koi meri jootiyon ke tasme mein bhi mujh se badh jaye. Kya yeh baghi (sarkashi) hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Yeh baghi nahi, balke baghi woh hai jo haq ko thukraye (ya farmaya: haq ko bewaquf samjhe) aur logon ko haqeer jaane.'

e: [AI] When the Haruriyah (a religious group) left, they gathered in a house and they were six thousand. So, I went to Ali (may God be pleased with him) and said, "O Commander of the Faithful, calm down with prayer so that I may come to these people and talk to them." He said, "I fear for you." I said, "No." So, I went to them wearing the finest Yemeni attire. Abu Zumayl (a companion) said, "Abdullah bin Abbas (a companion) was handsome and prominent." Ibn Abbas said, "So I went to them while they were gathered in a house and they were saying. I greeted them and they said, "Welcome, O Ibn Abbas. What is this attire?" I said, "Why do you criticize me? I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wearing the finest attire." And I recited the verse, "Say, 'Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants and the good [lawful] things of provision?'" [Surah Al-A'raf 7:32] Then I mentioned the famous debate of Ibn Abbas with them.
hi: Jab Haruriyyah nikle to woh ek ghar mein jama ho gaye, woh chhe hazar the. Main Ali (RA) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ay Amirul Mu'minin! namaz thandi karke padhiye, shayad main in logon ke paas jaun aur unse baat karun. Unhone kaha: Mujhe tumhare liye khauf hai. Maine kaha: Hargiz nahi. Kaha: To main unke paas gaya aur Yaman ke sab se behtareen joron mein se pehna. Abu Zumayl ne kaha: Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) khoobsurat aur buland awaz the. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Main unke paas aaya, woh ek ghar mein jama the aur dopahar ke aaram mein the. Maine unhein salam kiya. Unhone kaha: Khush aamdeed, Ay Ibn Abbas! yeh joda kaisa hai? Maine kaha: Tum mujh mein kya aib nikalte ho? 'Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) par sab se behtareen joda dekha hai' aur maine yeh aayat padhi: 'Kaho: Allah ki us zeenat ko kis ne haram kiya jo usne apne bandon ke liye nikali aur paak rizq ko?' (Al-A'raf 32). Phir unhone Ibn Abbas (RA) ka un ke saath mashhoor munazara zikr kiya.

e: [AI] Jabir, we went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  in some of his military expeditions. A man came out wearing two torn garments, wanting to drive the camels. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to him, "Doesn't he have any other garments?" It was said to him, "In his possession are two new garments." He said, "Bring them to me." So they brought them to him. He said to the man, "Take these two garments and wear them, and discard the torn ones." The man did as he was told, and then he proceeded with the camels. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  looked at his tracks, amazed at his miserliness towards himself with the two garments. He said to him, "May Allah strike your neck!" The man turned to him and said, "I am fighting in the cause of Allah." He was later killed on the day of Yamamah.
hi: Jabir (RA) ne kaha: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath ek ghazwe mein nikle. Ek aadmi do phate hue kapdon mein nikla, woh oonton ko haankna chahta tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Iske paas in ke siwa do kapde nahi?' Kaha gaya: Uske thaile mein do naye kapde hain. Aap ne farmaya: 'Uska thaila mere paas lao.' Usne use khola to usmein do kapde the. Aap ne us aadmi se farmaya: 'Yeh dono le kar pehen le aur in phate hue ko phenk de.' Usne aisa kiya, phir oonton ko haanka. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne uske peeche dekha, goya aap us ke apne upar do kapdon mein bukhl par ta'ajjub kar rahe the. Aap ne farmaya: 'Allah teri gardan maare.' Woh aadmi mura aur kaha: Allah ki raah mein! Phir woh Yamamah ke din shaheed hua.

e: [AI] From Jabir ibn Abdullah.
hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) se.

e: [AI] "My father used to sit with Abu Darda in Damascus, and there was a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  from the Ansar, called Ibn al-Hanzaliyyah. He used to isolate himself and rarely socialize with people. He would only engage in prayer, and when he finished, he would engage in glorifying and praising Allah until he returned to his family. One day, he passed by us while we were with Abu Darda, and he greeted us. Abu Darda said, 'There is a word that benefits us and does not harm you.' He said, 'What is it?' Abu Darda replied, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "You are coming to your brothers, so prepare your clothes and mend your means of transport, so that you appear as something good among people. Indeed, Allah does not like obscenity and vulgar speech."' "
hi: Mere walid Dimashq mein Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ke ham-nasheen the, aur wahan Rasoolullah (SAW) ke sahaba mein se Ansar ke ek sahabi the jinhein Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah kaha jaata tha. Woh tanha rehne wale the, kam hi logon ke saath baithte, bas namaz mein hote, jab namaz se farigh hote to takbeer, tasbeeh aur tahleel mein rehte yahan tak ke apne ghar walon ke paas pahunch jate. Ek din woh humare paas se guzre jabke hum Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ke paas the. Unhone salam kiya. Abu Ad-Darda (RA) ne kaha: Koi aisi baat sunaiye jo humein faida de aur aap ko nuqsan na de. Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tum apne bhaiyon ke paas jane wale ho, to apna libas achha karo aur apni sawariyon ke saman ko durust karo yahan tak ke tum logon mein ek til ki tarah (numaya) ho jao. Beshak Allah fahsh aur fahsh bakne ko pasand nahi karta.'

e: [AI] "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: 'Whoever abandons wearing clothes that he is able to wear out of humility for Allah Almighty, Allah Almighty will summon him on the Day of Judgment with the leaders of creation, allowing him to choose from the adornments of faith to wear whichever he wishes.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Jis ne qudrat hote hue Allah Azza wa Jall ke liye aajizi ki wajah se libas (umda) chhod diya, Allah Azza wa Jall qayamat ke din use makhlooq ke saamne bulayega yahan tak ke use imaan ke joron mein se ikhtiyar dega ke jo chahe pehen le.'

e: "They (meaning the people in general) told me that I was proud, while I rode a donkey, wore a cloak, and I milked the sheep. And the Messenger of Allah said to me: "Whoever does these, then there is no pride (arrogance) in him.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2001)
hi: Woh kehte hain: Mujh mein takabbur hai, halaanke main gadhe par sawar hota hun, bakri ko baandhta hun aur chadar odhta hun. Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne yeh kiya uske andar takabbur mein se kuch bhi nahi.'

e: “Umar bin ‘Abdul-‘Aziz sent for me and I came to him upon the riding animal prepared for swift mail delivery. When I came to him, he said: ‘We have caused you some trouble O Abu Sallam.’ He said: ‘Yes, by Allah, O Commander of the Believers!’ He said: ‘By Allah, we did not want to cause you any hardship, but there is a Hadith which I have heard that you narrate from Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, concerning the Cistern, and I wanted to hear it directly from you.’ He said: “I said: ‘Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “My Cistern is (wider than) the distance between Ailah and ‘Aden. It is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey, and its cups are as many as the stars in the sky. Whoever drinks from it will never feel thirst again. The first ones who come to drink from it will be the poor Muhajirin, with dirty clothes and disheveled hair, who do not marry refined women and for whom no doors are opened.” ‘Umar wept until his beard became wet, then he said: ‘But I have married refined women and doors have been opened for me. Certainly I will not wash the clothes that are on my body until they become dirt, and I will not comb my hair until it becomes disheveled.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 4303)
hi: Jab woh unke paas pahunche aur unke paas gaye to salam kiya aur kaha: Ay Amirul Mu'minin! dak ki sawari ne mere paon ko takleef di. Umar (RA) ne goya dard mehsoos karte hue kaha: Hum ne tum par mushaqqat nahi chahi thi, Ay Abu Sallam! balke mujhe ek hadees pahunchi hai jo aap Thawban (RA) se Allah ke Nabi (SAW) se hauz ke baare mein bayan karte hain, to mujhe pasand aaya ke aap mujhe woh khud sunayein. Abu Sallam ne kaha: Maine Thawban (RA) ko kehte suna ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mera hauz Adan se le kar Amman Al-Balqa tak hai, uska paani doodh se zyada safed aur shahad se zyada meetha hai, uske pyale sitaron ki tadaad ke barabar hain. Jo usse ek ghoont piyega woh uske baad kabhi pyasa nahi hoga. Us par sab se pehle aane wale Muhajireen ke fuqara honge: bikhre sar wale, maile kapdon wale, jo naaz-o-naimat mein pali aurton se nikah nahi karte aur jin ke liye (hukmranon ke) darwaze nahi khole jate.' Umar (RA) ne kaha: 'Lekin maine to naaz-o-naimat mein pali aurat se nikah kiya hai, Fatimah bint Abd Al-Malik se, aur mere liye darwaze khole gaye hain. Zaroor ab main apna sar nahi dhoyunga yahan tak ke woh bikhar jaye, aur apne jism se lagne wala kapda nahi dhoyunga yahan tak ke woh maila ho jaye.'

e: "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: 'You should wear white garments; dress your living ones in them, and shroud your dead in them, for they are among the best of your garments.'" (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5323)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'In safed kapdon ko apnao, tumhare zinda log inhein pehnein aur apne murdon ko inhi mein kafan do, kyunke yeh tumhare behtareen kapdon mein se hain.' Ya farmaya: 'tumhare behtareen libas mein se hain.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said, "I advise you to wear this white garment and shroud your deceased in it."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'In safed kapdon ko apnao, tumhare zinda log inhein pehnein aur apne murdon ko inhi mein kafan do.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You should wear this white garment and shroud your dead in it, for it is from the best of your clothing." It has been narrated by Abdullah ibn Abbas and Samurah ibn Jundub that the Prophet ﷺ added additional words to this statement.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'In safed kapdon ko apnao, tumhare zinda log inhein pehnein aur apne murdon ko inhi mein kafan do, kyunke yeh tumhare behtareen kapdon mein se hain.' Aur Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) aur Samurah bin Jundub (RA) se Nabi (SAW) se kuch alfaz ke izafe ke saath bhi riwayat kiya gaya hai.

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: Wear your white garments, for they are among your best garments, and shroud your dead in them. Among the best types of collyrium you use is antimony (ithmid): it clears the vision and makes the hair sprout. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3878)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tumhare behtareen kapde safed hain, to inhein apne zinda logon ko pehnao aur apne murdon ko inhi mein kafan do. Aur tumhare behtareen surme mein se Ismid hai, woh nazar ko roshan karta hai aur baal ugata hai.'

e: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Wear white, for indeed it is very pure and cleaner, and shroud your dead in it.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2810)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Safed kapde pehno, kyunke woh zyada paak aur zyada pakiza hain, aur apne murdon ko inhi mein kafan do.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came to us and saw a man with disheveled hair, so he said, "Doesn't this man find anything to calm his hair?" And he saw a man with dirty clothes, so he said, "Doesn't this man find anything to clean his clothes?"
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) humare paas tashreef laye to ek aadmi ko bikhre baalon wala dekha. Farmaya: 'Kya is ko koi cheez nahi milti jis se apne baal sanwaar le?' Aur ek aur aadmi ko maile kapdon mein dekha to farmaya: 'Kya is ko koi cheez nahi milti jis se apne kapde saaf kar le?'

e: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivering Khutbah during the farewell Hajj, and he was wearing a Burd which he had wrapped from under his armpit." She said: "I was look at muscle of his upper arm quivering and I heard him saying: O you people! Have Taqwa of Allah. If a mutilated Ethiopian slave is put in command over you, then listen to him and obey him, as long as he upholds the Book of Allah among you.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1706)
hi: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko dekha, aap par ek chadar thi jise aap ne bagal ke neeche se lapeta hua tha, goya main aap ke baazu ke pathe ko hilte hue dekh raha hun. Maine aap ko farmate suna: 'Ay logo! Allah se daro, aur agar tum par koi Habshi ghulam ameer bana diya jaye to bhi suno aur itaa'at karo jab tak woh tum mein Allah Azza wa Jall ki kitab qayam rakhe.'

e: [AI] I met the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in some streets of Medina, and he was wearing a scattered cotton garment with fringes. I said to him, "Peace be upon you, O Muhammad, or O Messenger of Allah." He replied, "Upon you be peace, the greeting of the deceased upon you be peace, the greeting of the deceased upon you be peace." I asked him about his garment, so he raised his back and held the lower part of his leg and said, "Here, if you want. If you prefer, it can be above the ankles. However, Allah does not like every arrogant, boastful person."
