hi: Main Rasoolullah (SAW) se Madina ke kisi raaste mein mila, aap par rooi ka tehband tha jis ka kinara khula hua tha. Maine kaha: Aap par salam ho, Ay Muhammad ya (kaha) Ya Rasoolullah. Aap ne farmaya: 'Aleyka as-salam murde ka salam hai, aleyka as-salam murde ka salam hai, aleyka as-salam murde ka salam hai. Salamun alaykum, salamun alaykum, salamun alaykum.' Yani aise kaho. Kaha: Phir maine tehband ke baare mein poocha to aap ne apni peeth jhukayi aur apni pindli ke bade hisse ko pakda aur farmaya: 'Yahan tak. Agar tu na maane to yahan, takhnon ke upar. Agar tu phir bhi na maane to beshak Allah har itraane wale fakhr karne wale ko pasand nahi karta.'

e: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ on a clear night, so I looked at the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and at the moon, and he was wearing a red Hullah, and he looked better than the moon to me." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2811)
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko chandni raat mein dekha, aap par surkh joda tha. Main kabhi aap ko dekhta aur kabhi chaand ko, to aap meri nazar mein chaand se zyada haseen the.

e: [AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  gave him a garment when he sent him to Heraclius, and when he returned, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  gave him a Coptic garment and said, 'Make its waist larger and give your wife a garment that she can ferment with.' When he left, he said, 'Make sure to cover it with something so that it cannot be described.'"
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne jab unhein Hiraql ke paas bheja to jab woh wapas aaye to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhein ek qibti kapda diya aur farmaya: 'Iska ek hissa qameez bana le aur apni biwi ko ek hissa de de ke woh orhni bana le.' Jab woh mudey to farmaya: 'Use hukm de ke iske neeche kuch pehne taake jism ka nakshah zahir na ho.'

e: [AI] "He used to feel shy in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and his companions, wearing clothes worth one thousand dirhams and even one thousand and two hundred dirhams."
hi: Woh Rasoolullah (SAW) aur aap ke sahaba ke liye ek hazar aur ek hazar do sau dirham ke joray bunte the.

e: [AI] "The king of Dhi Yazin presented a dress as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ  which was bought with thirty-three camels and a female camel, and the Prophet ﷺ  wore it once."
hi: Dhi Yazan ke badshah ne Nabi (SAW) ko ek joda hadiya kiya jo taintees oont aur oontniyon ke badle khareeda gaya tha, to Nabi (SAW) ne use ek baar pehna.

e: [AI] "The prophets used to prefer wearing wool, milking sheep, and riding camels."
hi: Ambiya (AS) oon pehnna, bakriyan duhna aur gadhon par sawar hona pasand karte the.

e: [AI] "I saw us with the Prophet ﷺ and the sky embraced us, and it felt as if our scent was the scent of sheep."
hi: Maine apne aap ko Nabi (SAW) ke saath dekha hai ke humein baarish ne aa liya, to goya humari boo bheron ki boo thi.

e: [AI] "I saw us with the Prophet ﷺ as if our scent was the scent of sheep because of our woolen clothing and our food was water and dates." Adh-Dhahabi did not comment on this in his summary.
hi: Maine apne aap ko Nabi (SAW) ke saath dekha hai, mujhe lagta hai ke humari boo bheron ki boo thi, is wajah se ke humara libas oon ka tha aur humari khurak do kaali cheezen: paani aur khajoor. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle ﷺ went out one morning wearing a blanket made of (camel's or sheep's) black hair with patterns of camel saddles upon it. (Using translation from Muslim 2081)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ek subah is haal mein nikle ke aap par kaale baalon ka naqsh-o-nigar wala (murajjal) mirt (oodhne ki chadar) tha.

e: [AI] The translation of the given text is: "The Prophet of Allah ﷺ  used to pray, and someone would throw mud at him."
hi: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) namaz padha karte the aur meri chadar (mirt) ka kuch hissa aap par hota tha.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  came with a garment that had a shirt in it. He asked his companions, "Who do you think deserves this shirt?" They remained silent. He called Umm Khalid and dressed her in it. Then he said, "Spin, O young girl, and beautify yourself." He repeated this three times. There was a red mark on it, so he turned to Umm Khalid and said, "Sana." Sana means beautiful in the Abyssinian language.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas kuch kapde laye gaye jin mein ek khamisah (naqsh wali chadar) thi. Aap ne apne sahaba se farmaya: 'Tumhare khayal mein is khamisah ka zyada haqdar kaun hai?' Woh khamosh rahe. Aap ne Umm Khalid (RA) ko bulaya aur woh unhein pehna di, phir farmaya: 'Pehno aur purani karo, ay meri bachchi! pehno aur purani karo, pehno aur purani karo.' Kaha: Usmein ek surkh nishan tha. Aap farmane lage: 'Ay Umm Khalid! sana, sana.' Aur Habshi zubaan mein 'sana' ka matlab hasan (khoobsurat) hai.

e: [AI] "She made a black woolen cloak for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he wore it. When he started to sweat, he could smell the scent of the wool, so he took it off. He used to enjoy the pleasant smell."
hi: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke liye kaali oon ka ek jubba banaya. Aap ne use pehna, jab pasina aaya to oon ki boo mehsoos hui, to aap ne use utaar diya. Aap ko khushbu pasand thi.

e: [AI] Two men from Iraq came to him and asked him about performing the ghusl (ritual bath) on Friday. They asked if it was obligatory. Ibn Abbas said to them, "Whoever performs the ghusl, it is better and purer." Then he informed them of the reason why the ghusl was initiated. During the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , people would wear wool and drink palm juice, which would cause sweat and emit an odor. The mosque was also small and had a low ceiling. One Friday, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  came out for the sermon on a hot summer day, and the pulpit was short and had steps. As he preached to the people, he sweated, and the scent of his sweat mixed with the scent of wool, causing discomfort to some of them. The smell reached the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  while he was on the pulpit, and he said, "O people, when this day comes, perform the ghusl and let each of you apply the best fragrance or oil he can find."
hi: Iraq ke do aadmi unke paas aaye aur jumu'ah ke din ghusl ke baare mein poocha ke kya woh wajib hai? Ibn Abbas (RA) ne unse kaha: Jis ne ghusl kiya woh behtar aur zyada paakiza hai. Aur main tumhein bataunga ke ghusl kyun shuru hua. Rasoolullah (SAW) ke zamane mein log mohtaj the, oon pehente the aur apni peethon par khajoor ko paani dete the. Masjid tang thi aur chhat nichi thi. Rasoolullah (SAW) jumu'ah ke din ek bahut garm din mein tashreef laye aur aap ka minbar chhota tha, bas kuch zeene the. Aap ne logon ko khutbah diya to log oon mein pasine se bhar gaye, unki boo pasine aur oon ki boo se phail gayi yahan tak ke ek doosre ko takleef dene lage, yahan tak ke unki boo Rasoolullah (SAW) tak pahunchi jabke aap minbar par the. Aap ne farmaya: 'Ay logo! jab yeh din aaye to ghusl karo, aur tum mein se har ek apne paas ki behtareen khushbu ya tel lagaye.'

e: [AI] "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  wearing two dyed garments with saffron – a cloak and a turban."
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dekha, aap par zafran se range hue do kapde the: chadar aur imamah.

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a speech to us; meanwhile al-Hasan and al-Husayn came upon there stumbling, wearing red shirts. He came down from the pulpit, took them and ascended it with them. He then said: Allah truly said: "Your property and your children are only trial" (Ixiv.15). I saw both of them, and I could not wait. Afterwards he resumed the speech. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 1109)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) khutbah de rahe the ke Hasan aur Husain (RA) aaye, un par do surkh qameezein thin. Woh girte aur uthte aate the. Aap minbar se utre, unhein uthaya aur apne saamne bitha liya aur farmaya: 'Allah aur uske Rasool ne sach farmaya: tumhare maal aur tumhari aulad bas fitna hain. Maine in dono ko dekha to sabr na kar saka.' Phir apni khutbah jaari rakhi.

e: [AI] He said, "One day I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while wearing two yellowish garments. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said to me, 'What are these two garments?' I said, 'My mother, Umm Abdullah, dyed them for me.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  then said to me, 'I swear to you, when you return to Umm Abdullah, command her to light the oven, then throw them in it.' So I went back to her and did as he instructed."
hi: Unhone kaha: Ek din main Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas gaya, mujh par kusum se range hue do kapde the. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne mujh se farmaya: 'Yeh do kapde kaise hain?' Maine kaha: Inhein mere liye Umm Abdullah ne range hai. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Main tujhe qasam deta hun ke Umm Abdullah ke paas jao aur use hukm do ke tannoor jalaye phir unhein usmein daal de.' Main unke paas laut gaya aur aisa hi kiya.

e: Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw me wearing two clothes dyed in saffron. whereupon he said: These are the clothes (usually worn by) the non-believers, so do not wear them. (Using translation from Muslim 2077a)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne un par kusum se range hue do kapde dekhe to farmaya: 'Yeh kafiron ke kapde hain, unhein na pehno.'

e: A man wearing two red garments passed the Prophet ﷺ and gave him a greeting, but he did not respond to his greeting. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4069)
hi: Nabi (SAW) ke paas se ek aadmi guzra jis par do surkh kapde the. Usne salam kiya to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne uska jawab nahi diya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "I do not ride on the rainbow, nor do I wear saffron garments, nor do I wear a shirt that is embellished with silk." Al-Hasan then pointed to the pocket of his shirt and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the scent of a man should have no color, and the scent of women should have no smell."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Main arghawani (gehre jamni rang ka kapda) par sawar nahi hota, na kusum se range kapde pehnta hun, aur na resham ke kinaron wali qameez pehnta hun.' Hasan ne apni qameez ke girebaan ki taraf ishara kiya. Aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Khabardar! mard ki khushbu woh hai jis ki boo ho rang na ho, aur aurat ki khushbu woh hai jis ka rang ho boo na ho.'

e: [AI] He said, "The people in the mosque today and the abundance of worshippers are nothing but similar to the Jews of Khaybar."
hi: Unhone kaha: Aaj masjid mein logon aur tayalisaon (chadron) ki kasrat ko main Khaybar ke Yahudiyon ke siwa kisi se mushabeh nahi paata.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not wear silk nor gold.'"
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jo Allah aur aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta hai woh na resham pehne aur na sona.'

e: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] used to tell his wives not to wear jewelry and silk. He said: "If you want the jewelry and silk of Paradise, then do not wear them in this world." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 5136)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) apne ghar walon ko zewar se rokte aur farmate: 'Agar tum jannat ke zewar aur uske resham ko pasand karte ho to inhein na pehno.'

e: [AI] The Prophet of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever wears silk in this world will not wear it in the Hereafter. Even if they enter paradise, the people of paradise will wear it and they will not."
hi: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne dunya mein resham pehna woh akhirat mein use nahi pehnega, chahe jannat mein daakhil ho jaye, jannat wale use pehnenge aur woh nahi pehnega.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ forbade remaining silent when it is harmful.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne sirf us kapde se mana farmaya jo (poora) khalis resham ho.

e: No clothing was dearer to be Messenger of Allah ﷺ than shirt. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4026)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ko qameez se zyada koi libas pasandida nahi tha.

e: "Makhrafah Al-Abdi and I brought some cloth from Hajar, and the Messenger of Allah came to us while we were in Mina where there w a man who weighed (goods) in return for payment. He bought some trousers from us, and said to the man who weighed: 'Weigh it, and allow more."' (Using translation from Nasāʾī 4592)
hi: Maine aur Makhramah Al-Abdi ne Hajar se kapde laye. Nabi (SAW) humare paas tashreef laye. Ek aadmi ne humse pajama khareeda aur ek tolne wala tha jo ujrat par tolta tha. Aap ne tolne wale se farmaya: 'Tol aur jhukta hua tol (zyada de).'

e: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, would wear a new garment he would mention what it was, whether an 'Imamah, a Qamis, or a Rida', then he would say: Allahumma lakal-hamdu, Anta kasawtanihi, as'aluka khairuhu wa khaira ma suni'a lahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lahu'" ('O Allah! For You is the praise, You have clothed me, I ask You for its good and the god for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.) (Using translation from Tirmidhī 1767)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) jab nayi cheez pehente to uska naam lete, imamah, ya qameez, ya chadar, phir farmate: 'Ay Allah! tere hi liye hamd hai, tu ne mujhe yeh pehnaya. Main tujh se iski bhalai aur jis maqsad ke liye yeh banaya gaya uski bhalai maangta hun, aur iski burai aur jis maqsad ke liye yeh banaya gaya uski burai se teri panah maangta hun.'

e: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone eats food and then says: "Praise be to Allah Who has fed me with this food and provided me with it through no might and power on my part," he will be forgiven his former and later sins. If anyone puts on a garment and says: "Praise be to Allah Who has clothed me with this and provided me with it through no might and power on my part," he will be forgiven his former and later sins. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4023)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne khana khaya aur kaha: Allah ka shukr hai jis ne mujhe yeh khilaya aur mere hawl-o-quwwat ke baghair mujhe yeh rizq diya, uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jate hain. Aur jis ne koi kapda pehna aur kaha: Allah ka shukr hai jis ne mujhe yeh pehnaya aur mere hawl-o-quwwat ke baghair mujhe yeh rizq diya, uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jate hain.'

e: [AI] "Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with that which covers my nakedness and adorns me in my life." Then he said, "Do you know why I said this? I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  calling for new clothes and wearing them, and I do not consider that he reached his limit until he said something like what I said. Then he said, 'By the One in Whose hand is my soul, no Muslim servant wears new clothes and then says something like what I said, and deliberately gives them to a poor, needy Muslim person, except that he will be in the protection and care of Allah, as long as he remains in them, both in life and after death.'"
hi: 'Allah ka shukr hai jis ne mujhe woh pehnaya jis se main apni sharmgah dhaanpta hun aur apni zindagi mein zeenat paata hun.' Phir kaha: Jaante ho maine yeh kyun kaha? Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko dekha ke aap ne naye kapde mangwaye aur pehne. Kaha: Mera khayal hai ke woh unke gale ki haddiyon tak bhi nahi pahunche the ke aap ne wahi kaha jo maine kaha. Phir farmaya: 'Us zaat ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai! koi musalman banda naya kapda pehne, phir wahi kahe jo maine kaha, phir apne purane utare hue pehle kapdon ko lekar kisi miskeen, faqeer musalman shakhs ko sirf Allah Azza wa Jall ke liye pehna de, to jab tak us kapde ka ek dhaaga bhi us par rahe, woh zinda ho ya murda, Allah ki panah aur Allah ki zamanat mein rehta hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Cover yourself and you will become more patient."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Imamah baandho, tumhari burdbari badhegi.'

e: [AI] She said, "I saw a man on the Day of the Trench, in the form of Dahyah ibn Khalifah al-Kalbi, riding on a beast and conversing with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He had a turban on his head which he had lowered onto him. So I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  and he said, 'That is Jibril (the Angel Gabriel), peace be upon him, who has commanded me to march towards the Banu Qurayzah.'"
hi: Unhone kaha: Maine Khandaq ke din Dihyah bin Khalifah Al-Kalbi (RA) ki surat mein ek aadmi ko sawari par Rasoolullah (SAW) se sargoshi karte dekha, uske sar par imamah thi jise usne latka rakha tha. Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) se poocha to aap ne farmaya: 'Woh Jibreel (AS) the, unhone mujhe hukm diya ke main Bani Quraizah ki taraf niklun.'

e: [AI] A man came to the Prophet ﷺ  wearing a turban, with one end hanging down between his shoulders. I asked the Prophet ﷺ  and he said, "I saw him, that was Gabriel, peace be upon him."
hi: Ek aadmi Nabi (SAW) ke paas ek tattoo (birzaun, ghode) par aaya, uske sar par imamah thi jis ka ek sira usne apne kandhon ke beech latka rakha tha. Maine Nabi (SAW) se poocha to aap ne farmaya: 'Tum ne use dekha? Woh Jibreel (AS) the.'

e: [AI] "We entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  while he was sick. We greeted him and found him sleeping, with his face covered with a coarse cloth. He then uncovered his face and said, 'May Allah curse the Jews. They prohibit the fat of sheep and consume its price unlawfully.'"
hi: Hum Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas ayadat ke liye gaye jabke aap bimar the. Humne aap ko soya hua paaya, aap ne apna chehra Adan ki chadar se dhaanka hua tha. Aap ne apne chehre se kapda hataya aur farmaya: 'Allah Yahudiyon par lanat kare, woh bakriyon ki charbi haram karte hain aur unki qeematein khate hain.'

e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the man who dressed like a woman and the woman who dressed like a man. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4098)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne us aurat par lanat farmayi jo mard jaisa libas pehne aur us mard par jo aurat jaisa libas pehne.

e: [AI] Aisha used to say when this verse was revealed, "Women took their waist-sheets, cut them at the edges and covered their faces with them."
hi: Ayesha (RA) kaha karti thin: Jab yeh aayat nazil hui: 'Aur woh apni orhniyan apne girebanon par daalen' (An-Nur 31), to auraton ne apne tehband liye, unke kinaron ki taraf se phaad kar unki orhniyan bana li.

e: [AI] The translation to English is: "The Prophet ﷺ entered upon her while she was fermenting and said, 'Why don't you have two?'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye jabke woh orhni orh rahi thin. Aap ne farmaya: 'Ek lapet, do lapet nahi.'

e: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ disliked ten things: Yellow colouring, meaning khaluq, dyeing grey hair, trailing the lower garment, wearing a gold signet-ring, a woman decking herself before people who are not within the prohibited degrees, throwing dice, using spells except with the Mu'awwidhatan, wearing amulets, withdrawing the penis before the semen is discharged, in the case of a woman who is wife or not a wife, and having intercourse with a woman who is suckling a child; but he did not declare them to be prohibited. Abu Dawud said: Only the transmitters of Basrah have transmitted this tradition. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4222)
hi: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) das cheezein napasand karte the: zard rang yani khaluq (khushbu) lagana, safed baal badalna (rangna), tehband latkana, sone ki angoothi pehenna, tawiz baandhna, mu'awwidhat ke siwa dam karna, pasoon (ka'ab) se khelna, zeenat ka bejaa jagah izhaar, apni biwi ke paani ko (seemen) ghalat jagah rokna ('azl bejaa), aur bachche ko bigaadna, jo (khud) use haram nahi kehta.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ said: "Oh Khureim, if it weren't for two things in you, you would have been the man." He asked, "What are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Your flaring trousers and your long hair."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ay Khurayim! agar tum mein do khaslatein na hoti to tum hi (kaamil) aadmi hote.' Unhone poocha: Woh kaun si hain, Ya Rasoolullah? Aap ne farmaya: 'Tehband ka latkana aur apne baalon ko khula chhodna.'

e: [AI] "That the Prophet (pbuh) wore a shirt that was below the ankles, and his sleeves reached his fingertips."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne qameez pehni, woh takhnon se upar thi aur uski aasteen ungliyon tak thi.

e: [AI] "Measure for me, my son, and cut off the excess at the fingertips," he said. So I cut off some from the sleeves, and the sleeves became stacked one on top of the other. I said, "If you were to even them out with scissors." He said, "Leave it, my son, for this is how I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  do." Ibn Umar said, "The shirt remained on my father until it wore out, and we would not pray until I saw some threads falling onto his feet."
hi: 'Mere bete! meri aasteen kheench aur meri ungliyon ke siron se lagakar jo bacha usse kaat de.' Kaha: Maine dono aasteenon se kaata to aasteenon ke munh ek doosre ke upar ho gaye. Maine kaha: Agar aap qainchi se barabar kar dein to? Unhone kaha: 'Mere bete! ise aise hi chhod do, maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko aise hi karte dekha hai.' Ibn Umar (RA) ne kaha: 'Woh qameez mere walid par rahi yahan tak ke phat gayi, aur humne namaz nahi padhi yahan tak ke maine kuch dhaage unke qadmon par girte dekhe.'

e: [AI] "Is Muhammad the Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Yes." And do you pray the five prayers? He said, "Yes." He said, "And do you fast in Ramadan?" He said, "Yes." He said, "As for you, O boy, you have a right over us. So wear a garment, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Whoever clothes a Muslim, Allah will continue to keep him in His protection as long as there is a thread or a fiber from it on him.'"
hi: ...ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain? Usne kaha: Haan. Unhone poocha: Aur paanchon namazein padhta hai? Usne kaha: Haan. Unhone poocha: Aur Ramazan ke roze rakhta hai? Usne kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Beshak tera humpar haq hai, ay ladke! ise ek kapda pehna de, kyunke maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Jis ne kisi musalman ko kapda pehnaya, woh Allah ki hifazat mein rehta hai jab tak us kapde ka ek dhaaga ya taar us par rahe.'

e: [AI] that the Prophet ﷺ  sent him on the Day of Hajj al-Akbar with four instructions: that no one should circumambulate the Ka'bah naked, only a Muslim soul would enter Paradise, and no polytheist would perform Hajj after this year. And whoever had a covenant between him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would have it extended for a certain period.
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unhein Hajj-e-Akbar ke din chaar baaton ke saath bheja: koi nanga Bait Allah ka tawaf na kare, jannat mein sirf musalman jaan hi daakhil hogi, is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj na kare, aur jis ka Rasoolullah (SAW) se koi ahd ho uski muddat us ahd ki muddat tak hai.

e: "I came with Ali bin Abi Talib when the Messenger of Allah sent him to the people of Makkah with news of the dissolution of treaty obligations." He said: "How did you announced that no one would enter Paradise but a believing soul, no one was to circumambulate the House naked: whoever had a treaty with the Messenger of Allah, then for its period, or, it extended to four months, and when four months had passed, and that Allah is free from (all) obligations to the idolaters and so is His Messenger. No idolater was to perform Hajj after this year. I kept on announcing it until my vice grew hoarse." (Using translation from Nasāʾī 2958)
hi: Main Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) ke saath tha jab Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhein Surah Bara'ah ke saath Makkah walon ke paas bheja. Poocha gaya: Tum kya ailan karte the? Unhone kaha: 'Hum ailan karte the ke jannat mein sirf momin jaan daakhil hogi, koi nanga Bait Allah ka tawaf na kare, aur jis ka Rasoolullah (SAW) se ahd ho uski muddat chaar mahine tak hai; jab chaar mahine guzar jayen to Allah aur uska Rasool mushrikon se bari hain, aur is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj na kare.' Main ailan karta raha yahan tak ke meri awaz baith gayi.

e: [AI] Abu Talib used to treat the Zamzam well, and the Prophet ﷺ  was one of those who used to transport the stones while he was still a young boy. So, the Prophet ﷺ  took off his clothes and covered the stone with it, and then he fainted. It was said to Abu Talib, "Go and check on your son, for he has fainted." When the Prophet ﷺ  woke up from his faint, Abu Talib asked him what happened, and he said, "A creature came to me wearing white clothes and told me to cover myself." Ibn Abbas said: "That was the first thing the Prophet ﷺ  experienced from prophethood, that he was told to cover himself, and his aura was never seen since then."
hi: Abu Talib Zamzam ki marammat karte the aur Nabi (SAW) bhi un logon mein the jo patthar dhote the, un dinon aap ladke the. Nabi (SAW) ne apna tehband liya to nange ho gaye aur usse patthar se bachao kiya, to aap par behoshi taari ho gayi. Abu Talib se kaha gaya: Apne bete ko sambhalo, un par behoshi taari ho gayi hai. Jab Nabi (SAW) ko hosh aaya to Abu Talib ne behoshi ke baare mein poocha. Aap ne farmaya: 'Mere paas ek aane wala aaya jis par safed kapde the, usne mujh se kaha: Satr dhaanp lo.' Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Yeh pehli cheez thi jo Nabi (SAW) ne nubuwwat mein se dekhi ke aap se kaha gaya: Satr dhaanp lo, to us din ke baad aap ki satr kabhi nahi dekhi gayi.

e: [AI] When the house was being built, people were carrying stones and the Prophet ﷺ  was carrying them with them. He took off his shirt and put it on his shoulder. Then it was said, "Do not expose your awrah." So, he threw the stone and put on his shirt.
hi: Jab Bait Allah ki tameer hui to log patthar dhote the aur Nabi (SAW) bhi unke saath dhote the. Aap ne kapda liya aur apne kandhe par rakh liya to pukara gaya: 'Apni satr na kholo.' To aap ne patthar daal diya aur apna kapda pehen liya.

e: I said: Messenger of Allah, from whom should we conceal our private parts and to whom can we show? He replied: conceal your private parts except from your wife and from whom your right hands possess (slave-girls). I then asked: Messenger of Allah, (what should we do), if the people are assembled together? He replied: If it is within your power that no one looks at it, then no one should look at it. I then asked: Messenger of Allah if one of us is alone, (what should he do)? He replied: Allah is more entitled than people that bashfulness should be shown to him. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4017)
hi: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! humari satr ke baare mein kya karen aur kya chhodein? Aap ne farmaya: 'Apni satr ki hifazat karo, siwa apni biwi ya apni milkiyat mein aayi hui baandi ke.' Maine arz kiya: Aap ka kya khayal hai agar log ek doosre ke upar (ek hi jagah) ho? Aap ne farmaya: 'Agar tum aisa kar sako ke use koi na dekhe to koi use hargiz na dekhe.' Maine arz kiya: Aur agar koi tanha ho? Aap ne farmaya: 'To Allah is baat ka zyada haqdar hai ke us se sharm ki jaye.' Aur aap ne apna haath apni sharmgah par rakh liya.

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ said, 'The nakedness of a man in front of another man is like the nakedness of a woman in front of a man, and the nakedness of a woman in front of another woman is like the nakedness of a woman in front of a man.'"
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Mard ki satr mard ke saamne aisi hi hai jaise aurat ki satr mard ke saamne, aur aurat ki satr aurat ke saamne aisi hi hai jaise aurat ki satr mard ke saamne.'

e: [AI] Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ  saw him while his thigh was exposed in the mosque, and he was wearing a cloak. So the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the thigh is part of the 'awrah (private parts)."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne unhein dekha ke masjid mein unki ran khuli hui thi aur un par chadar thi. Aap ne farmaya: 'Beshak ran satr mein se hai.'

e: [AI] He said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  passed by him while he was with Ma'mar, with his thighs exposed. He said, "O Ma'mar, cover your thighs, for the thighs are 'awrah (to be covered)." It has also been narrated from Ali ibn Abi Talib and Abdullah ibn Abbas from the Prophet ﷺ , similar to it. Adh-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summarization.
hi: Unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) Ma'mar (RA) ke paas se guzre, aur main aap ke saath tha, unki dono ranein khuli thin. Aap ne farmaya: 'Ay Ma'mar! apni ran dhaanp lo, kyunke ran satr hain.' Aur Ali bin Abi Talib (RA) aur Abdullah bin Abbas (RA) se bhi Nabi (SAW) se isi ki tarah riwayat hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Allah has not sent down any disease except that He has also sent down its cure. It is known to those who know it and unknown to those who do not know it."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Allah ne koi bimari nazil nahi ki magar uske saath uski shifa bhi nazil ki, jisne jaana usne jaana aur jo na jaan saka woh na jaan saka.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] Narrated by Abdullah, he said: "The Prophet ﷺ  said, 'Verily, Allah has not sent down any disease except that He has also sent down its cure, except for one ailment, which is old age. So, make use of the milk of the cow, for indeed it contains cure for every ailment.'" Al-Dhahabi remained silent regarding this in his summary.
hi: Abdullah (RA) se, woh ise Nabi (SAW) tak marfu' karte hain, aap ne farmaya: 'Beshak Allah Ta'ala ne koi bimari nazil nahi ki magar uski shifa bhi nazil ki, siwa budhape ke. To gaay ke doodh ko lazim pakdo, kyunke woh har darakht (ki ghaas) se (qaim-maqam ban kar) durust karta hai.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] "Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, poetry, and the Arabic language, upon the Arabs, who did you learn medicine from?" She said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was a sickly man, and the Arab physicians would come to him, so I would learn from them."
hi: ...Rasoolullah (SAW) se, aur shayri aur Arabi zubaan Arabon se (seekhi), to aap ne tibb kis se seekhi? Unhone kaha: 'Rasoolullah (SAW) aksar bimar rehte the aur Arab ke tabeeb aap ke paas aate the, to main unse seekhti thi.'

e: [AI] They said, "O Messenger of Allah, do you seek cure?" He said, "You should know that Allah the Most High has not sent down any disease except that He has also sent down its cure, except for one disease." They asked, "What is that disease?" He said, "Old age."
hi: Unhone arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! kya hum ilaj karwayen? Aap ne farmaya: 'Jaan lo! Allah Ta'ala ne koi bimari nazil nahi ki magar uski dawa bhi nazil ki, siwa ek bimari ke.' Unhone poocha: Woh kaun si? Aap ne farmaya: 'Budhapa.'

e: [AI] About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Solomon, the son of David ﷺ , used to see a growing tree in front of him when he stood during Ramadan. He would ask, 'What is your name?' The tree would reply, 'Such and such.' He would then ask, 'What are you for?' The tree would answer, 'For medicine.' So he would write it down, or 'For planting,' so he would plant it. One day, while he was praying, a tree grew in front of him, and he asked, 'What is your name?' It said, 'The thorn tree.' He asked, 'What are you for?' It answered, 'For destroying the people of this house.' Solomon, peace be upon him, said, 'O Allah, cause my kingdom to prevail over the jinn until it is known to humans that the jinn do not know the unseen.' Then he took the tree and carved it into a cane, and leaned on it as if it was a dead stick, while the jinn continued to work. Then they brought it water and the earth swallowed it, so it fell. When it fell, it became clear to humans that the jinn do not know the unseen. Ibn Abbas used to recite it in this way."
hi: Nabi (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: Sulayman bin Dawud (AS) jab Ramazan mein (ibadat ke liye) khade hote to apne saamne ugta hua ek darakht dekhte, poochte: Tera naam kya hai? Woh kehta: Aisa aisa. Poochte: Tu kis cheez ke liye hai? Woh kehta: Aisi aisi cheez ke liye. Agar woh dawa ke liye hota to likh liya jata, aur agar lagane ke liye hota to laga diya jata. Ek din woh namaz padh rahe the ke unke saamne ek darakht ugta hua dikhai diya. Unhone poocha: Tera naam kya hai? Usne kaha: Kharnub (karob). Poocha: Tu kis cheez ke liye hai? Usne kaha: Is ghar walon ki barbadi ke liye. To Sulayman (AS) ne kaha: Ay Allah! jinnaat se meri maut ko chhupa de yahan tak ke insaanon ko maloom ho jaye ke jinnaat ghaib nahi jaante. Kaha: Phir unhone use tarash kar ek asa banaya aur uspar tek lagaye ek saal tak murda khade rahe aur jinnaat kaam karte rahe. Phir deemak ne use kha liya aur woh gir gaye. Jab gire to insaanon par saaf ho gaya ke jinnaat ghaib nahi jaante. Aap ne farmaya: 'To jinnaat ne deemak ka shukriya ada kiya, chunancha woh uske paas paani laya karte.' Aur Ibn Abbas (RA) ise isi tarah padha karte the.

e: [AI] "What are you and for what reason did you come?" She replied, "I am the hoopoe bird. I have come to witness the destruction of this mosque." Solomon, peace be upon him, knew that his death was near and that the sacred house would not be destroyed while he was alive. So, he called upon Allah the Almighty to cause the devil's death to put him to sleep. The jinn believed that the devils knew the unseen, so he died while leaning on his staff. The earth swallowed him and he fell down, and so it was the right of the devils that the earth brought them water as a sign of gratitude for what they had done with Solomon's staff."
hi: ...usse kaha: Tu kya hai aur kis liye ugi hai? Usne kaha: Main kharnub hun, is masjid ki barbadi ke liye ugi hun. To Sulayman (AS) ne jaan liya ke unki ajal qareeb aa gayi hai, aur ke Bait Al-Maqdis un ke zinda hote hue kharab nahi hoga. Unhone Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke shaitan se unki maut chhupa de. Jinnaat dawa karte the ke shayateen ghaib jaante hain. Woh apne asa par (tek lagaye) mar gaye, deemak ne use kha liya aur woh gir gaye. To shayateen par lazim ho gaya ke deemak ke paas paani layen, jahan bhi woh ho, uski taarif karte hue us ke shukriya mein jo usne Sulayman (AS) ke asa ke saath kiya.

e: [AI] Narrated Abu Al-Muwajjah: Abdan informed me from Abu Hamzah, who reported from Ziyad bin Ilaqah. Abu Bakr Al-Shafi'i informed me that Ishaq bin Al-Hasan narrated to me from Abdullah bin Raja'a, who reported from Israel, who reported from Ziyad bin Ilaqah. Abu Bakr Al-Shafi'i informed me that Muhammad bin Bishr, the brother of Khattab, narrated to me, who reported from Muhammad bin Al-Sabbah, who reported from Asbat bin Nasr, who reported from Abu Ishaq Al-Shaiban, who reported from Ziyad bin Ilaqah. Ahmad bin Ja'far Al-Qati'i informed me that Abdullah bin Ahmad bin Hanbal narrated to me, who reported from Al-Muttalib bin Ziyad, who reported from Ahmad bin Uthman Al-Adami in Baghdad. Muhammad bin Muslima Al-Wasiti informed me that Yazid bin Haroon reported from Al-Mas'udi, who reported from Ziyad bin Ilaqah. Abu Bakr bin Ishaq Al-Faqih and Ali bin Hamshaz Al-Adl and Abu Bakr Al-Shafi'i said: The narration is for them. Bishr bin Musa informed me that Al-Humaidi narrated to me, who reported from Sufyan, who narrated to me from Ziyad bin Ilaqah. He said: I heard Osama bin Shareek Al-Amiri saying, "I saw the A'arib asking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , 'Do we have to be cautious in such and such?' He ﷺ  said, 'O servants of Allah! Allah has made things easy for you, except for the one who borrows from his brother, for indeed that is something that causes difficulty and destruction.'" (According to the condition set by Bukhari and Muslim)
hi: Humse Abu Al-Muwajjih ne bayan kiya, unhein Abdan ne khabar di, unhein Abu Hamzah ne, Ziyad bin Ilaqah se. Aur mujhe Abu Bakr Ash-Shafi'i ne khabar di, mujhse Ishaq bin Al-Hasan ne bayan kiya, unse Abdullah bin Raja ne, unhein Isra'il ne khabar di, unse Ziyad bin Ilaqah ne. Aur humein Abu Bakr Ash-Shafi'i ne khabar di, unse Muhammad bin Bishr ne jo Khattab ke bhai hain, unse Muhammad bin As-Sabbah ne, unse Asbat bin Nasr ne, Abu Ishaq Ash-Shaybani se, Ziyad bin Ilaqah se. Aur humein Ahmad bin Ja'far Al-Qati'i ne khabar di, unse Abdullah bin Ahmad bin Hanbal ne, mujhse mere walid ne bayan kiya, unse Al-Muttalib bin Ziyad ne, unse Ziyad bin Ilaqah ne. Aur humein Ahmad bin Uthman Al-Adami ne Baghdad mein khabar di, unse Muhammad bin Maslamah Al-Wasiti ne, unse Yazid bin Harun ne, unhein Al-Mas'udi ne khabar di, Ziyad bin Ilaqah se. Aur humse Abu Bakr bin Ishaq Al-Faqih, Ali bin Hamshadh Al-Adl aur Abu Bakr Ash-Shafi'i ne bayan kiya, unhone kaha (aur alfaz unhi ke hain): humse Bishr bin Musa ne bayan kiya, unse Al-Humaydi ne, unse Sufyan ne, mujhse Ziyad bin Ilaqah ne bayan kiya, unhone kaha: Maine Usamah bin Sharik Al-Amiri (RA) ko kehte suna: Maine dekha ke dehati Rasoolullah (SAW) se poochh rahe the: Kya humpar falan falan cheez mein koi gunah hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Ay Allah ke bando! Allah ne tang-dasti (haraj) utha di hai siwa us ke jo apne bhai ki izzat mein se kuch qarz le (le leta hai), to wahi haraj aur halakat hai.' Yeh Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: ‘Do you think that the medicines with which we treat ourselves, the Ruqyah by which we seek healing, and the means of protection that we seek, change the decree of Allah at all?’ He said: ‘They are part of the decree of Allah.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3437)
hi: Maine arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! aap ka kya khayal hai un dawaon ke baare mein jin se hum ilaj karte hain aur un duaon (ruqya) ke baare mein jin se hum dam karwate hain, kya yeh Allah ki taqdeer ko taal deti hain? Aap ne farmaya: 'Yeh bhi Allah ki taqdeer mein se hain.'

e: [AI] He said to the Messenger of Allah, "O Messenger of Allah, do you see a medicine that we can use for treatment, and a talisman that we can hang with it? Does that go against Allah's decree in any way?" The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "It is part of Allah's decree." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about this in his summary.
hi: Unhone Rasoolullah (SAW) se arz kiya: Ya Rasoolullah! aap ka kya khayal hai us dawa ke baare mein jis se hum ilaj karte hain aur un ruqyah ke baare mein jin se hum dam karwate hain, kya yeh Allah ki taqdeer mein se kisi cheez ko taalte hain? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Yeh bhi Allah ki taqdeer mein se hai.' Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Indeed, the One who has sent down illness has also sent down its cure."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jis ne bimari nazil ki usi ne shifa nazil ki.'

e: There is a remedy for every malady, and when the remedy is applied to the disease it is cured with the permission of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. (Using translation from Muslim 2204)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat hai ke aap ne farmaya: 'Har bimari ki dawa hai. To jab dawa bimari ko pahunch jati hai to Allah Azza wa Jall ke hukm se shifa ho jati hai.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Upon you are the two healers: honey and the Qur'an. This is a authentic narration based on the conditions of the two Sheikhs (Bukhari and Muslim), and they did not reject it." And it has been narrated by Wakee' bin al-Jarrah from Sufyan, based on the conditions of Bukhari and Muslim.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Do shifa wali cheezon ko lazim pakdo: shahad aur Qur'an.' Yeh sanad dono shaykhain ki shart par sahih hai, magar unhone ise nahi nikaala. Ise Waki' bin Al-Jarrah ne Sufyan se mauquf bhi riwayat kiya hai. Yeh Bukhari aur Muslim ki shart par hai.

e: [AI] The translation of the given Arabic phrase into English is: "The healing of Abdullah lies in reciting the Quran and drinking honey."
hi: Shifa do hain: Qur'an ki tilawat aur shahad peena.

e: [AI] Abdullah wishes you the healing of both the Qur'an and honey.
hi: Abdullah (RA) ne kaha: Do shifa wali cheezon ko lazim pakdo: Qur'an aur shahad.

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ  said, "When one of you is afflicted with fever, let him cool himself with cold water for three nights."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab tum mein se kisi ko bukhar ho jaye to woh teen raaton tak sehri ke waqt us par thanda paani daale.'

e: [AI] Cool it down with Zamzam water, for indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Fever is from the heat of Hell, so cool it down with Zamzam water."
hi: Main Makkah mein Ibn Abbas (RA) ke paas baitha karta tha, woh kuch din mujhe na paaye. Jab main aaya to poocha: Tumhein kis cheez ne roka? Maine kaha: Mujhe bukhar ho gaya tha. Unhone kaha: Use apne se Zamzam ke paani se thanda karo, kyunke Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Bukhar jahannam ki lapat se hai, to use Zamzam ke paani se thanda karo.'

e: [AI] The Prophet ﷺ entered upon her one day and found her grinding barley. He said, "What are you doing with this?" She replied, "Fulan drinks it." He said, "If something could repel death or be of benefit against death, then barley would be it."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ek din unke paas aaye aur unke paas shubrum tha jise woh kut rahi thin. Aap ne poocha: 'Tum isse kya karogi?' Unhone kaha: Falan ise piyega. Aap ne farmaya: 'Agar koi cheez maut ko rok sakti ya maut se faida de sakti to sana (senna) faida deti.'

e: "Shubrum" He said: "It is hot and too strong." She said:"Then I used Senna as a laxative." So the Prophet ﷺ said: "If there was anything that would have a cure for death in it, then it would have been Senna." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2081)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unse poocha: 'Tum dast aawar dawa kis se leti ho?' Unhone kaha: Main shubrum se leti thi. Aap ne farmaya: 'Garm hai, bahut garm.' Unhone kaha: Phir maine sana se li. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Agar koi cheez maut se shifa deti to woh sana hoti.'

e: “I heard Abu Ubayy bin Umm Haram, who had prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ facing both the Qiblah, saying: ‘I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “You should use senna and the Sannut, for in them there is healing for every disease, except the Sam.” It was said: “O Messenger of Allah, what is the Sam?” He said: “Death.” (One of the narrators) ‘Amr said: “Ibn Abu ‘Ablah said: the ‘Sannut is dill.” Others said: “Rather, it is honey that is kept in a skin (i.e., receptacle) used for ghee.”* (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3457)
hi: Maine Abu Ubayy ibn Umm Haram (RA) ko kehte suna, jinhone Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saath dono qiblon ki taraf namaz padhi thi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko farmate suna: 'Sana aur sannut ko lazim pakdo, kyunke inmein har bimari se shifa hai siwa saam ke.' Poocha gaya: Ya Rasoolullah! saam kya hai? Aap ne farmaya: 'Maut.' Ibrahim bin Abi Abla ne kaha: Sannut shibitt (soya) hai. Amr bin Bakr aur doosre kehte hain: Sannut woh shahad hai jo mashkize mein hota hai. Aur shayar ka qaul hai (bahr tawil): 'Woh sannut ke saath ghee hain, un dono mein koi bhalai nahi, aur woh padosi ko is baat se rokte hain ke use bepardah kiya jaye.'

e: "I heard Zaid bin Arqam say: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered us to use Qust Al-Bahri and oil to treat Pleurisy.'" (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2079)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein hukm diya ke hum zaat-ul-janb (pasli ka dard) ka ilaj qust bahri aur zaitoon ke tel se karein.

e: [AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ describe "oil and wax from the same source." Qatadah said, "It is squeezed from the side that hurts." And it was narrated by Abdullah bin Maimun from his father. Al-Dhahabi did not mention it in his summary.
hi: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko zaat-ul-janb ke liye zaitoon ka tel aur wars ka nuskha batate suna. Qatadah ne kaha: 'Jis taraf dard ho us taraf se munh mein daala jata hai.' Ise Abd Ar-Rahman bin Maymun ne apne walid se bhi riwayat kiya hai. Adh-Dhahabi ne Talkhees mein iske baare mein khamosh rehna ikhtiyar kiya.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prescribed Wars (memecyclon tinctorium), Indian aloeswood and olive oil for pleurisy, to be administered through the side of the mouth.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3467)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne humein zaat-ul-janb ke liye wars, zaitoon ka tel aur qust ka nuskha batayi.

e: [AI] The first time the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  complained in the house of Maymuna, his pain intensified to the point of him fainting. He consulted the women about his condition, and they cupped him. When he regained consciousness, he asked, "What is this that the women from this region brought upon me?" and he pointed towards the land of Abyssinia (Ethiopia), where Asma bint 'Umays was residing. They said, "It is a cupping procedure they do to treat a disease." The Prophet ﷺ  said, "Indeed, it is a remedy, but Allah would not allow me to be harmed by it. Except that all the people in the house were cupped, except Abbas (the Prophet's uncle)." He said, "Maymuna was truly generous that day, and she was fasting out of determination to follow the example of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ko sab se pehle Maymunah (RA) ke ghar mein bimari hui, aur dard bahut badh gaya yahan tak ke aap par behoshi taari ho gayi. Kaha: Auraton ne aap ko ladood (munh mein dawa daalna) karne ke baare mein mashwara kiya aur dawa munh mein daal di. Jab aap ko hosh aaya to farmaya: 'Yeh un auraton ka kaam hai jo wahan se aayi hain' aur Habsha ki zameen ki taraf ishara kiya, aur unmein Asma bint Umays (RA) thin. Unhone arz kiya: Unka khayal hai ke aap ko zaat-ul-janb hai, Ya Rasoolullah. Aap ne farmaya: 'Yeh aisi bimari hai jo Allah mujhe nahi lagayega. Ghar mein koi baqi na rahe magar use ladood kiya jaye, siwa Rasoolullah ke chacha ke' yani Abbas (RA). Kaha: 'Us din Maymunah (RA) ko bhi ladood kiya gaya jabke woh roze se thin, Rasoolullah (SAW) ke pukhta hukm ki wajah se.'

e:
[AI] "Oh son of my sister, I have witnessed a strange matter of the greatness of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . It happened that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  would wear a waist-wrap tightly, and we used to say that it caused the Prophet ﷺ  pain; we thought that the waist-wrap had caused him kidney pain. However, one day it tightened so strongly around him that he lost consciousness, and we became afraid and people rushed to him. We thought that the pain was on his side, so we took it off. Then the incident remained a secret from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and when he woke up, he realized that he had been wrapped tightly and found the mark of the tightness. He said, 'You assumed that Allah had placed it upon me, but Allah would never place it upon me. By the One in Whose hand is my soul, there will not remain anyone in the house who will not experience the tightness, except my uncle.'

Then I saw them experiencing tightness, one person after another. Aisha said, 'And whoever was in the house on that day, we would mention their virtue (for example, "the one who migrated with the Prophet, the one who participated in the Battle of Badr, etc.") and they would experience the tightness.' The tightness reached the wives of the Prophet ﷺ , and they would experience it, one after another.'

Abu Zinad said, 'And I did not know anyone other than Maymunah.' And the people said it was Umm Salamah. She said, 'By Allah, I was fasting.' We said, 'How could we ever leave you when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  had sworn that we would experience the tightness?' So we took it off her."
hi: Ay mere bhanje! Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ke apne chacha ki taazeem mein ek ajeeb baat dekhi. Hua yeh ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ko pehlu ka dard (khasirah) hota tha aur bahut badh jata tha, aur hum kaha karte the ke Rasoolullah (SAW) ko 'irq al-kulyah ka dard hai, aur humein yeh kehna na soojhta ke khasirah ne pakda hai. Ek din aap ko khasirah ne pakda aur bahut shiddat se hua yahan tak ke aap par behoshi taari ho gayi, humein aap ke baare mein darr hua aur log aap ki taraf ghabra kar aaye. Humne samjha ke aap ko zaat-ul-janb hai, to humne aap ko ladood kiya. Phir Rasoolullah (SAW) ki halat sanbhli, aap ko hosh aaya, aap ne jaan liya ke aap ko ladood kiya gaya hai aur us ladood ka asar paaya. Aap ne farmaya: 'Kya tum ne samjha ke Allah ne ise mujh par musallat kiya hai? Allah ise mujh par musallat nahi karega. Us zaat ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai! ghar mein koi baqi na rahe magar use ladood kiya jaye, siwa mere chacha ke.' Kaha: Maine unhein ek ek aadmi ko ladood karte dekha. Ayesha (RA) ne kaha: 'Us din ghar mein kaun tha jis ki fazilat hum zikr karen? Tamam mard ladood kiye gaye, phir ladood Nabi (SAW) ki azwaj tak pahunchi to unhein ek ek karke ladood kiya gaya yahan tak ke ladood hum mein se ek aurat tak pahunchi.' Abu Az-Zinad ne kaha: 'Mere ilm mein woh Maymunah (RA) thin.' Kaha: Aur logon ne kaha: Umm Salamah (RA). Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam! main to roze se hun. Humne kaha: Bura hai, Allah ki qasam! humne tumhein chhodne ka khayal bhi nahi kiya, jabke Rasoolullah (SAW) qasam kha chuke the. To humne unhein ladood kiya.

e: [AI] "That the Prophet ﷺ  made supplication."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne naak mein dawa daali (isti'at).

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The date palm, the rock, and the tree are from Paradise."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ajwah, sakhrah (chattan) aur shajarah (darakht) jannat se hain.'

e: [AI] The delegation of the people of Hijar from the tribe of Abd al-Qais came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. While they were sitting with him, he approached them and said, "There is a type of date that you call it this, and another type of date that you call it that," until he counted all the colors of their dates. Then a man from the tribe said to him, "By my father and mother, O Messenger of Allah, if I were born in the womb of Hijar, I would not be more knowledgeable than you about the hour. I bear witness that you are the Messenger of Allah." He said, "Indeed, your land has been uplifted for me since you came to me. I have looked at it from its lowest point to its farthest point. The best of your dates is the Barni, it removes disease and there is no disease in it."
hi: Banu Abd Al-Qays ka wafd Hajar walon ka Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas aaya. Woh aap ke paas baithe the ke aap unki taraf mutawajjah hue aur farmaya: 'Ek khajoor jise tum aisa kehte ho aur ek khajoor jise tum aisa kehte ho' yahan tak ke unki saari khajooron ke rang ginwa diye. Un mein se ek aadmi ne arz kiya: Mere maan baap aap par qurban, Ya Rasoolullah! agar main Hajar ke andar paida hota to bhi is waqt aap se zyada na jaanta. Main gawahi deta hun ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain. Aap ne farmaya: 'Tumhari zameen jab se tum baithe ho mere saamne uthayi gayi, maine uske qareeb se door tak dekha. Tumhari khajooron mein behtareen barni hai, woh bimari door karti hai aur usmein koi bimari nahi.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best of your dates is the Barni, it expels disease and has no disease in it." We have narrated it as a witness.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Tumhari khajooron mein behtareen barni hai, woh bimari nikaalti hai aur usmein koi bimari nahi.' Humne ise shahid ke taur par nikaala hai.

e: [AI] From Umm al-Mundhir al-Ansariyyah, who was one of the Prophet's maternal aunts, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered upon me while he had Ali with him, who was suffering from some illness, and there was some barley hanging in the house. The Prophet ﷺ  stood up and took some of it, and then he faced me and took from it. He said, "Leave it, for it does not agree with you, as you are a camel rider." So, I went and cooked some barley and meat, and brought it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "O Ali, eat from this, for it is more suitable for you." This narration was reported by Zaid bin al-Hubab from Fuleih bin Sulaiman, and it was also reported from Umm Mubashir al-Ansariyyah.
hi: Umm Al-Mundhir Al-Ansariyyah (RA) se, jo Nabi (SAW) ki khalaon mein se thin, unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) mere paas tashreef laye aur aap ke saath Ali (RA) the jo bimari se uth rahe the (naqih). Ghar mein khajoor ka ek khosha latka hua tha. Nabi (SAW) uthe aur usmein se liya, aur Ali (RA) bhi usmein se lene lage. Aap ne farmaya: 'Ise chhod do, yeh tumhein mauzoon nahi, kyunke tum bimari se uth rahe ho.' To main jau (sha'ir) aur chukandar (salq) ki taraf uthi, unhein pakaya gaya aur main unhein Rasoolullah (SAW) ke paas laayi. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ay Ali! isme se kha, yeh tumhare liye zyada mauzoon hai.' Ise Zayd bin Al-Hubab ne Fulayh bin Sulayman se riwayat kiya aur kaha: Umm Mubashshir Al-Ansariyyah se.

e: [AI] About Umm Mubashir al-Ansariyyah, some of the Prophet's ﷺ paternal aunts said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon me while Ali was with him, riding a camel that was sick, and he mentioned the hadith in a similar manner.
hi: Umm Mubashshir Al-Ansariyyah (RA) se, jo Nabi (SAW) ki kuch khalaon mein se thin, unhone kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) mere paas tashreef laye aur aap ke saath Ali (RA) the jo bimari se uth rahe the. Phir unhone hadees isi ki tarah zikr ki.

e: "Whenever one of the wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ became (feverishly) ill, he would order that some broth be prepared. Then he would tell them to take some of the broth. And he would say: 'It firms the heart of the grieved, and it rids the worries from the heart of the ill just as one of you removes dirt from her face with water." Another chain reports a similar narration. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2039)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke ghar walon ko jab bukhar hota to aap hisa (pat'la shorba/khichri) banane ka hukm dete, woh banaya jata, phir unhein hukm dete to woh usmein se piyate, aur farmate: 'Yeh gham-zada dil ko taqat deta hai aur bimar dil se (takleef) utaar deta hai jaise tum mein se koi apne chehre se paani se mail utaarti hai.'

e: [AI] I heard Ayman Al-Makki say: Fatimah bint Al-Mundhir informed me that Umm Kulthum narrated from Aisha that the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Stick to the beneficial hatred, by the One in whose hand is my soul, indeed he washes the stomach of one of you as he washes the filth from his face with water." He said, "When someone complained to the Prophet ﷺ  about a member of his family, the bottle would continue to boil on the fire until one of his sides was decided, either death or life."
hi: Maine Ayman Al-Makki ko kehte suna: Mujhse Fatimah bint Al-Mundhir ne bayan kiya, Umm Kulthum se, Ayesha (RA) se ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Us napasandida magar faida mand cheez talbinah ko lazim pakdo. Us zaat ki qasam jis ke haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai! woh tum mein se kisi ke pet ko aise dho deti hai jaise paani se chehre se mail dhoya jata hai.' Kaha: Aur Nabi (SAW) ke ghar walon mein se jab koi bimar hota to handiya aag par rakhi rehti thi yahan tak ke woh do siron mein se ek par faisla kar de: ya maut ya zindagi.

e: [AI] There was a child with Aisha, the mother of the believers, who was bleeding from his nose. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  entered and said, "What's wrong with this child?" Aisha explained the situation, and the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Woe to you, O women! Do not kill your children. Whenever a woman experiences bleeding or a headache, she should take Indian incense." He then instructed Aisha to do so, and she followed his command, and the child got better.
hi: Ummul Mu'mineen Ayesha (RA) ke paas ek bachcha tha jis ki naak se khoon tapak raha tha. Rasoolullah (SAW) daakhil hue to farmaya: 'Is bachche ko kya hua?' Unhone kaha: Isey 'udhrah (gale ki bimari) hai. Aap ne farmaya: 'Tum par afsos hai, ay auraton ki jamaat! apni aulad ko qatl na karo. Jis aurat ko 'udhrah ho ya sar mein dard ho woh qust hindi le.' Kaha: Aap ne Ayesha (RA) ko hukm diya to unhone aisa kiya aur woh theek ho gaya.

e: [AI] A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ with a young boy and said, "Extinguish the flame of circumcision from him." He replied, "Cauterize the genitalia of your children and take a piece of Indian incense and aloe and apply it to him."
hi: Ek aurat apne bachche ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas laayi aur kaha: Isse 'udhrah (gale ke warm) ko phaad dijiye. Aap ne farmaya: 'Tum apni aulad ke gale jalate ho? Qust hindi aur wars lo aur use naak mein daalo.'

e: [AI] I heard someone complaining to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about pain in his legs, so he said, "Rub them with henna."
hi: Maine nahi suna ke koi shakhs Rasoolullah (SAW) se apne paon ke dard ki shikayat kare magar aap ne farmaya: 'Unhein mehndi se rang lo.'

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The cure for women's ailments is the urine of an Arabian sheep. It is melted and divided into three parts, which are then drunk over the course of three days."
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Irq an-nasa (sciatica) ki shifa arabi bakri ki chakki hai, use pighla kar teen hisson mein taqseem kiya jaye aur teen din mein piya jaye.'

e: [AI] "The Prophet ﷺ  described the treatment for impotence as drinking the melted fat of a female Arab sheep. It should be neither too young nor too old, and it should be divided into three parts, with one part consumed on an empty stomach every day." Anas said, "I have described this to three hundred people, and Allah Almighty has cured all of them." This hadith was narrated by Habib bin Ash-Shahid from Anas bin Sirin from Anas bin Malik."
hi: Nabi (SAW) ne irq an-nasa ke liye arabi bakri ki chakki batayi jo na chhoti ho na badi, use pighlaya jaye, phir teen hisson mein taqseem kiya jaye aur har din ek hissa nihar muh piya jaye. Anas (RA) ne kaha: 'Maine yeh teen sau logon ke liye bataya, un sab ko Allah Ta'ala ne shifa di.' Ise Habib bin Ash-Shahid ne Anas bin Sirin se, Anas bin Malik (RA) se bhi riwayat kiya hai.

e: [AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  mentioned the broth of women and said, "It is taken from the shoulder of an Arabian sheep, neither too young nor too old, then it is melted and drunk for three days." Anas ibn Malik said, "I have described it to more than three hundred people, and they all disapproved of it." All of these chains of narration are authentic according to the conditions of the two sheikhs (referring to Imam Bukhari and Imam Muslim), but Hammad ibn Salama contradicted it from Anas ibn Sirin, and he reported it from his brother Ma'bad, who reported it from a man from the Ansar, who reported it from his father. "The saying among us about it is the saying of Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman and Al-Walid ibn Muslim." This is authentic.
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne irq an-nasa ka zikr kiya aur farmaya: 'Arabi mendhe ki chakki li jaye jo na chhoti ho na badi, use pighlaya jaye aur teen din piya jaye.' Anas bin Malik (RA) ne kaha: 'Maine yeh teen sau se zyada logon ke liye bataya, woh sab is se theek ho gaye.' Yeh tamam asaneed dono shaykhain ki shart par sahih hain, aur Hammad bin Salamah ne ise Anas bin Sirin se mu'dal kiya aur kaha: unke bhai Ma'bad se, Ansar ke ek aadmi se, unke walid se. 'Aur humare nazdeek is baare mein baat Al-Mu'tamir bin Sulayman aur Al-Walid bin Muslim ki baat hai.' Yeh sahih hai.

e: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘You should use antimony, for it improves the eyesight and makes the hair (eyelashes) grow.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3495)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Ismid (surma) ko lazim pakdo, kyunke woh baal ugata hai aur nazar ko roshan karta hai.'

e: [AI] Amr bin Yahya bin Amarah bin Abi Hassan informed me that Maryam bint Iyas bin Al-Bukair, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , narrated that the Prophet ﷺ  entered upon her and asked, "Do you have a child?" She replied, "Yes." So he called for the child and placed it between two fingers on his foot and said, "O Allah, make this child one who extinguishes the hardships of others and one who can be relied upon to take care of me." The child then became calm.
hi: Mujhe Amr bin Yahya bin Umarah bin Abi Hasan ne khabar di, mujhse Maryam bint Iyas bin Al-Bukayr ne, jo Nabi (SAW) ke sahabi the, bayan kiya, Nabi (SAW) ki kisi zawjah se, aur mera khayal hai ke woh Zaynab (RA) thin, ke Nabi (SAW) unke paas aaye aur farmaya: 'Tumhare paas zareerah (khushbudar powder) hai?' Unhone kaha: Haan. Aap ne mangwaya aur use apne paon ki ungliyon ke beech ek phunsi par rakha aur farmaya: 'Ay Allah! bade ko bujhane wale aur chhote ko bada karne wale! ise mujh se bujha de.' To woh bujh gayi.

e: "When Allah loves a slave, He prevents him from the world, just as one of you prevents his sick from water." Another chain reports a similar narration. (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2036)
hi: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: 'Jab Allah kisi bande se mohabbat karta hai to use dunya se bachata hai jaise tum mein se koi apne bimar ko paani se bachata hai.'

e: [AI] From Asim ibn Amr ibn Qatadah's Sahih (authentic).
I will not go away unless you get yourself cupped, for I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: It is a remedy. (Using translation from Muslim 2205a)

[AI] An Arab from the tribe of Banu Fazara, from the tribe of Banu Umm Qirfa, entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He found a hajjam (a person who performs cupping) cupping him with horns and a needle. So, he said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is this? Why do you let this person cut your skin?" He replied, "This is cupping, and it is the best treatment you seek."
[AI] The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'The best thing you can be treated with is Hijama.' As for the narration of Zuhair..."
This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 99)

[AI] I entered upon Abu Hurairah while he was cupping. He said to me, "O Abu Al-Hakam, do cupping." I replied, "I have never done cupping before." He said, "The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, informed me that Gabriel, peace be upon him, informed him that cupping is the best cure for people."

[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If there is any healing in what you apply as a treatment, then it is in cupping, a drink of honey, or branding (cauterization) with fire, but I do not like to be cauterized."
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best remedies you seek are cautery, leeches, cupping, and walking."

“The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘On the night on which I was taken on the Night Journey (Isra’), I did not pass by any group (of angels) but they said to me: “O Muhammad, tell your nation to use cupping.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3479)

Umm Salamah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ permission for getting herself cupped. He commanded Abu Tibah to cup her. The transmitter said: I think he was her foster-brother or a boy not yet of age. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 4105)
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever performs hijama on the seventeenth of the month will have a cure for every disease."
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The best days for you to observe fasting are the seventeenth, nineteenth, and twenty-first days."

"The Prophet ﷺ would get cupped in his jugular veins and his upper back. And he would get cupped on the seventeenth (of the month), (or) the nineteenth, and (or) the twenty first." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2051)
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "The vein in the middle of the head is a cause of madness, leprosy, drowsiness, and toothache." And he used to call it "savior."

[AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  saying, "Hijama (cupping therapy) increases intelligence and improves memory. Therefore, perform hijama on the name of Allah on Thursday. Do not perform hijama on Friday, Saturday, or Sunday. And perform hijama on Monday and Tuesday. No one catches leprosy or scab except on Wednesday night." All the narrators of this hadith are trustworthy except Ghazal ibn Muhammad, who is unknown to me for his credibility or weakness. The hadith has been confirmed from Ibn Umar, without a chain of narrators or a connected chain. Ghazal ibn Muhammad is unknown.
[AI] From Nafi', Abdullah bin Hisham Al-Dustouri is forgotten.

“Ibn ‘Umar said: ‘O Nafi’! The blood is boiling in me. Bring me a cupper and let him be a young man, not an old man or a boy.’ Ibn ‘Umar said: ‘I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Cupping on an empty stomach is better, and it increases one’s intellect and memory. And it increases the memory of one who has a good memory so whoever wants to be cupped, (let him do it) on a Thursday, in the Name of Allah. Avoid cupping on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays. Have yourselves cupped on Mondays and Tuesdays, and avoid cupping on Wednesdays, for that is the day on which the calamity befell Ayyub, and leprosy and leucoderma only appear on Wednesday or the night of Wednesday.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3488)
[AI] "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'When the weather becomes extremely hot, seek relief through cupping, but do not cause harm to anyone by drawing too much blood that may lead to their death.'"
“The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘What a good slave is the cupper. He takes away the blood, reduces pressure on the spine, and improves the eyesight.’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3478)
“The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever gives medical treatment, with no prior knowledge of medicine, is responsible (for any harm done).’” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3466)

In the pre-Islamic period we used to apply spells and we asked: Messenger of Allah ! how do you look upon it ? He replied : Submit your spells to me. There is no harm in spells so long as they involve no polytheism. (Using translation from Abū Dāʾūd 3886)
that the Prophet ﷺ saw in her house a girl whose face had a black spot. He said. "She is under the effect of an evil eye; so treat her with a Ruqya." (Using translation from Bukhārī 5739)

[AI] The Prophet used to, when visiting a sick person, sit by their head and say seven times, "I ask Allah the Mighty, the Lord of the Great Throne, to heal you." If it was decreed for them to be delayed in their recovery, then that pain would be forgiveness for them.

[AI] On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "Whoever visits a sick person and says, 'I ask Allah the Great, the Lord of the Great Throne, to heal you. It is a duty upon me to heal you seven times if death is not imminent.' Abu Khalid Ad-Dalani and Maysarah ibn Habib An-Nahdi narrated this from Al-Minhâl ibn 'Amr who narrated it from Sa'id ibn Jubair who narrated it from Ibn Abbas."

"There is no Muslim worshiper who visits one who is ill - other than at the time of death - and he says seven times: As'alullah Al-'Azeem Rabbal 'Arshil 'Azeem an yashfik ('I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne to cure you') except when he will be cured." (Using translation from Tirmidhī 2083)

[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever visits a sick person whose time of death has not come yet, and says, 'I ask Allah the Great, the Lord of the Great Throne, to heal you,' except that he is cured."
“The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade cauterization. I had myself cauterized and I have not prospered or succeeded.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3490)

[AI] A man from the Ansar was afflicted with a severe illness, so they prescribed cupping for him. They came to the Prophet ﷺ , but he turned away from them. Then they came to him again, but he turned away from them. Then in the third or fourth time, he said, "If you wish, you may do cupping for him."
[AI] He said, "The angels did not greet me until the trace of fire disappeared from me".
Jabir reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a phystian to Ubayy b. Ka'b. He cut the vein and then cauterised it. (Using translation from Muslim 2207a)

[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  returned with Saad bin Zurarah and had a thorn in his foot. When he went to him, he said, "This dead person (referring to the thorn) is a horrible thing. The Jews say that if he cannot afford to treat it and he cannot even take care of himself, then he should not be blamed for his father, Ummamah." He ordered for it to be removed, and he died.

[AI] I heard Umar and I have not seen anyone among us who is similar, saying that Saad ibn Zurarah had an illness and the people of Medina called it "dhabh" (slaughter). So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cauterized him and he died. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "May the Jews say about the deceased, 'If it was not for the intervention of his companion (referring to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ) and I had no control or possession over him, nor anything for myself.'"
‘Seek refuge with Allah, for the evil eye is real.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3508)
‘The evil eye is real.” (Using translation from Ibn Mājah 3507)
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "When one of you sees something pleasing from himself or his brother, he should pray for blessings, for the evil eye is real."

[AI] Waki' used to attribute the protection of his garments to a covering (siṭr), even when he saw that a piece of wool had been removed from them, he placed it and then entered the water. I looked at him and aimed at him with my eyes, then I heard a sucking sound in the water, so I approached him and called him three times, but he did not answer me. So I went to the Prophet ﷺ  and informed him, and he came walking and entered the water until it seemed as if I were looking at the whiteness of his calves. He struck his chest and said, "O Allah, remove its heat, coldness, and inflammation." Then he stood up and the Prophet ﷺ  said, "Whenever one of you sees something in himself, his wealth, or his brother that he likes, let him pray for blessings, for the evil eye is a reality."
[AI] I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وسلم saying: "Whoever wears an amulet, Allah will not complete his matter, and whoever wears a necklace, Allah will not leave him."
[AI] I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ  while having a ring on my finger, and he asked, "What is this?" I said, "It is from silver." He said, "Throw it away."
[AI] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "Whoever holds onto something, he will be entrusted with it." Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary.

[AI] I entered upon Zainab, the wife of Abdullah, seeking refuge in her from a burning ember that appeared on her face while she was wearing a talisman. I was sitting when Abdullah entered. When he saw the talisman, he went to a wooden pillar in the house and placed his cloak on it. Then he tied it with his arms restrained. He approached her and took hold of the talisman, pulling it so forcefully that her face almost hit the ground. It broke off and he left the house, saying, "The family of Abdullah has become rich enough to abstain from associating partners with Allah." He then went out and threw it behind the wall, and he said, "Oh Zainab, get rid of it! I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  forbidding amulets, talismans, and superstitious beliefs." So Umm Najiya said, "O Abu Abdur Rahman, we understand the prohibition of amulets and talismans, but what is 'tawliyah'?" He said, "Tawliyah is anything that incites women." (The narration ends here without any comment from Adh-Dhahabi)
[AI] From the Prophet ﷺ "Indeed, ruqyahs, talismans, and amulets are forms of shirk (associating partners with Allah)."
[AI] "The talisman is not what you hold onto after the affliction, rather the talisman is what you hold onto before the affliction."
[AI] "The amulet is not what is tied after calamity; rather, the amulet is what is tied before calamity."

[AI] She sent to Aisha with her brother Makhrmeh and she was treating a wound that children have. When Aisha treated him and finished, she saw two new ankle bracelets on his feet. So Aisha said, "I think you believe that these two ankle bracelets ward off something from him that Allah has written for him. If I saw them, it would not treat him and it would not touch me. By my life, two ankle bracelets made of silver are purer than these."

[AI] "A man complained about his stomach ache, so diabetes was diagnosed for him. He mentioned that to Abdullah, who said, 'Indeed, Allah has not placed your cure in that which He has forbidden upon you.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."
[AI] "Do not seek cure through anything that Allah has forbidden," Al-Dhahabi refrained from commenting on it briefly.

[AI] A woman came to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ  and mentioned that she was experiencing the presence of a jinn (evil spirit) with her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, "If you wish, I can pray to Allah the Almighty to cure you, or if you prefer, there will be no accountability or punishment upon you." She said, "O Messenger of Allah, then leave me alone."

[AI] He said that two men from Iraq came seeking a cure for their father who had urinary retention. The people guided them to a particular place, so the two men came with a cure. When the one they were to meet was mentioned, he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  say: 'Whoever of you or his brother complains of something, let him say: O our Lord, Yours is the sanctification of Your name in the heaven, Your command is in the heaven and the earth, as Your mercy is in the heaven and the earth, so forgive our mistakes and sins, O Lord of the righteous ones. Send down a cure, a healing from Your healing upon this pain, so that he may be cured."

[AI] "He came in a group of ten to the Prophet ﷺ , and nine of them pledged allegiance, but one refrained from pledging allegiance. They asked, 'Why is this man not pledging allegiance?' He replied, 'He has a necklace on his neck.' So the man cut off the necklace and pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ  said, 'Whoever attaches something (idolatrous) has committed polytheism.' Al-Dhahabi remained silent about it in his summary."

[AI] I said, "O Messenger of Allah, indeed Shaytan has come between me and my prayers and recitations." He said, "Indeed, that is a Shaytan called Khinzab. ʿUmar bin al-Khattab gave a speech and said: O people, we used to know you when the Prophet ﷺ was among us and revelation was coming down to him; Allah would tell us about you. But now the Prophet ﷺ has passed away and revelation has ceased, and now the way to judge you is this whoever among you shows us good conduct, we will think well of him and love him; whoever among you shows us bad conduct, we will think badly of him and hate him for that, and whatever is in your hearts is between you and your Lord. There was a time when I used to think that whoever learned the Qurʿan, seeking thereby Allah and (the reward that) is with Him, would be rewarded in the Hereafter, but some men learned Qurʿan seeking that which is with people. So seek Allah by learning Qurʿan and by your good deeds. By Allah, I do not send my workers to strike you or seize your wealth; rather I send them to you to teach you your religion and Sunnah, whoever has done to him something other than that, let him refer it to me, for by the One in Whose hand is my soul, I shall surely grant him retaliation. ʿAmr bin al-ʿAs stood up and said: O Ameer al Muʿmineen, do you think if one of the Muslims was in charge of some people and he disciplined one of them, would you allow that one to settle the score with him? He said: Yes, by the One in Whose hand is the soul of ʿUmar, I would not certainly allow him to settle the score with him. I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do that with regard to himself. But do not strike the Muslims and thus humiliate them, and do not keep them away from their wives on campaign for too long and thus expose them to temptation. Do not withhold from them their due rights and cause them to rebel; and do not make them camp in an area with a lot of trees, because that will cause them to be scattered.
